reviewSummary: It easy to find it I have not been inside but there is a lot of parking available Love This Church♡ A Great Mixture of Culture & Super Friendly♡♡♡ people are very friendly and know the Lord Jesus Christ. plenty parking... great message from the pastor...

name: 116 Church
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this church! I look forward to Sundays every week. The pastor and his wife are amazing, and the messages are always uplifting and full of truth. Billy is very funny. The atmosphere is so welcoming . I love bringing my friends and family here. It truly feels like home. Do NOT use the surface parking lot here. It is a scam. They charged $100 for exiting 3 minutes late. The delay was waiting for someone else to pull out. It is operated by LAZ which has litigation pending in other states for consumer protection violations. Pastor Billy & Jenn are special, authentic, enthusiastic and enjoyable to listen to about faith and their experiences with our Lord 🙏. I haven't been to church in a very long time because of a past church trauma experience. 116 Church feels safe and genuinely friendly.  Look forward to the next service.  Cheers Kelly 😎 Attended 116 for the first time, on Christmas Evening 2024. Very impressed by the ambience and spirit there, for sure! Their musical group was very talented, that’s for sure! Billy is a very accomplished presenter! What I honestly didn’t care for, to be honest, is asking the attendees to stand, for a majority of the service. I felt totally obligated to do this, with my younger family. DO NOT PARK in front of the church without paying for parking. I got - $106 parking ticket from PARKING REVENUE RECOVERY SERVICES from Colorado on 10/5/2025 for parking 30 mins sitting in the car. They made me pay for it even I am sitting in the car.
AVOID THIS PARKING LOT AT ALL TIME

name: 121 Community Church - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary:
This was an Ester Egghunt event organized by @ 121 Community Church in Grapevine. This was a good event for all families.

The event is organized well. The security team was there and many volunteers or church members. Parking was a bit far but was full of spaces. They had armbands for different age groups and also specific egg-hunt area based on age-group or grades. This is helpful.

Also had Carnivals with train ride, snacks, games etc which occupies a few hours of fun for kids. Several inflatable bounces for different age groups. Overall it was fun filled event by the community church!! Just to start. I'm a missionary for the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints. I was invited to go to a service. We went and they had a very welcoming staff and we got to sit and watch. Of course we got some attention because of our suits and ties but the sermon was great! I loved the scriptures they used. Would recommend. Very good community activities for all religion. Good people and service oriented. God bless Amazing church.
Biblically knowledgeable sermons from preachers.
Lots of community service provided from the church, and foreign ministry as well.
No money from Israeli government according to FARA. After traveling from Wisconsin for a journey with a new job, I had been in Texas for about a week going through training.   Saturday evening I prayed and asked the Lord for a Non-denominational church in the area that he would have me go to while 121 Community Church stood out to me during my search.

The Pastor was given a Word to touch on with the church.
Acts 2 : 42-47
Meanwhile, everything the Pastor was covering and preaching were specifically in line with much of what I've been struggling with in my walk of Faith recently.  Many answeres were given to me, my frustrations were mellowed and my mood was well lifted.

Funny how the Lord has dragged me all the way from Wisconsin to hear a Word that I greatly needed to hear.

name: 12Stone Church | Buford - Buford Campus
reviewSummary:
Just going to preface this with, we’ve been only once, for the first time, yesterday, looking for a church for our 19yr old daughter to plug in and attend while she goes to UNG.

Arrived in the rain to a host team lady dancing outside welcoming people in and singing Forrest Frank song about sunny days (forgive me, I forget the title). LOVE IT!

Loved the sermon. It was cast from a different campus, which isn’t my preference, but it was 🔥🔥 even if you don’t have a family (which was the series they were in). Most the church seems to be young families, which sadly my daughter saw very few her age or singles at the 11am service, but many events and things for families.

They showed photos from a serve week, which we loved seeing how they were involved in ministry outside of their church. Wonderful!

The reason for the 3 and not 5 stars is the music volume. It’s PAINFULLY loud, even with earplugs (which they offer on a table before you enter). If you have a heart condition, seizures, SPD, special needs, nervous system dysregulation, etc - things which we struggle with, this is not the location for you. This is sadly the way so many church worship times are going and we just can’t physically handle it. Very sad. Amazing church. A real passion for the community and people as individuals. Always a good time in the house of the Lord! Smaller more close knit family at this location. Same God, but a more intimate feel This is a solid church. There is no such thing as a perfect church but 12 Stone comes pretty close.  They are relevant and invest in serving people and their community and it shows. I love that.

A church that is for people for the city for the world for God. What more can you ask for? I have been watching this church from online as their online programming is very good for adults and kids alike. My children love 12Stone online programming and I highly recommend you check them out even if it's just for online service. They do not guilt trip you into giving them offerings which makes one want to support them financially even more. I believe my family and I have found a church we can call home and we look forward to visiting them once we feel it is safe to do so.

Five glowing and solid Google Stars and thank you to the church 12 Stone Church for being here. We love you. Incredibly good sermon every week and great music too. Inspiring, uplifting and humorous as well; all around great experience. It's the church for me and my wife.

name: 12Stone Church | Hamilton Mill - Dacula / Hamilton Mill Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended once with a coworker. I noticed they asked for money first thing. This coworker would not stop bugging me about church. Invitations.

Maybe the endless bugging was compensation for a failed marriage. I mean when you and your wife fail to do the whole bedroom thing for 6 years...

Anyway. This coworker was a big part of me losing my job. So. Don't go to this church. Great staff and overall great experience during my visit. I live closer to another campus, though, so I'll check that one out. Unfortunately I have to leave a 1 star review. I grew up in the church attended church every weekend and participated in all church events as a child. I wanted those same experiences for my child. I attended with my 1 year old daughter and was asked to come speak with an usher during service because my child was “disruptive and people were looking back” never in 33 years would I have imagined her telling me next time to sit in the hallway during service. This experience brought me to tears and really upset me because it’s important for the younger generation to know GOD. She was a joy during service and many others told me the same and that they can’t believe she said that to me. For me, this experience here was unwelcoming, and I know God would not want his children sitting in the hallways to hear his word. I will be looking for a new church home. I was informed I would receive a call about this and that never happened. This is not a place for me or my family. Love 12 stone, great messages but lacks church family every week people clear out of the sanctuary and the lobby so fast. I would hope to see campus pastors or kevin Meyers encourage church family and the church body seek it out more. But church family really does start with you as an individual I encourage the people of 12 stone to make efforts to know your church body and spend a few minuets talking with them. Serving at 12 stone is the best. Friendly people who love God and others. Finding a purpose

name: 12Stone Church | Lawrenceville - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary:
12 Stones is the church I attend when I visit my family , in Buford, and Swanee. Good teaching, praise worship, kids and youth programs. I love what the pastor preached today . That God is with me, beside me, in me, and through me. Yes I believe that God is yesterday, today and forever. God is faithful and as he promise never leave us or goresake us. Amen.  I really want to ask with love and respect want to ask why pastor Kevin doesn’t wear a suit for Sunday service. Personally i believe that for Sunday church service the pastor has to look his best. I know what you would say that God doesn’t look on the outside but on the inside. Yes absolutely. But if you would go to a wedding would you go with casual clothes I don’t think so, this how I believe we the pastor suppose to do, and the believers too. May God bless your life, family, Ministry. I attended church today and overall it was a very nice experience. The message and the atmosphere were uplifting, and I truly appreciated being there, I love the worship!

However, one thing that surprised me was the way some women were dressed. In my opinion, the way we present ourselves in the house of God should reflect respect and modesty. I noticed that some women, including those serving in the church, were wearing very tight and very short clothing.

I believe it would be helpful to have some guidelines regarding appropriate attire, especially for those who are serving. This could help maintain a respectful environment and avoid giving the wrong impression to first-time visitors. It's a life saver moment to meet nice staff and others here that makes you feel like family. I love the positive energy of God Almighty and Recovery process of all things. Even though I am New to Georgia I love this place already. I’ve visited 4 times to really see if I was missing something or if my feelings about the church were somehow misplaced. By the 4th visit, I’ve come to the conclusion this church is not for me. I will say friendly people, and the sermons I did hear did align with the Word. However, I don’t want to feel like I’m coming into a concert; the music specifically the drums/bass are obnoxiously loud. In my 30 plus years of church services, never have I ever felt uncomfortable through worship. The other thing is the church interior is so dark, seems stuffy and not a welcoming vibe you should feel in church. Lastly, the huge and obnoxious camera machinery hovering over your head. It blocks your view in certain areas, and just gives the impression of doing too much like putting on a show. I love the experience every time I come to this church I love and respect all the pastors at this church I love how friendly and welcoming everyone is when you walk in I love the praise and worship team they are incredible I try my best to come every Sunday or every time they have a event but I do love coming here it’s such a experience… for some time I’ve been battling depression and when I heard about 12 stone something told me to give them a chance and I can honestly say I’m glad I did it literally saved my life

name: 12Stone Church | Snellville - Snellville Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome Church home! I've been attending for about 5 years, they've been there for me when I needed them. Feels like family, non-denominational, it doesn't matter what your race is, moderate dress, no pressure! Great staff, Jeff, is very personalable, easy going, and capable of leadership! This is a fantastic Church and the people are very welcoming! I travel about 30 minutes to this Church and would never think of missing an in-person service! Great for kids, families and single people alike! The sermons are always on point! Plenty of parking, plenty of seating and a great band makes this Church a must attend! Great word, kind people, very inviting atmosphere! Highly recommend. I’ve actually read about how 12 stone church came about while I was incarcerated in Gwinnett County Detention Center year 2014. In 2017 I actually moved in Snellville with a significant other. The first time I attended the Snellville Campus newly built. A Christian campus. Very contemporary & lively. I even invited my mom here whenever she came to visit me & my SO during Sundays. I attended this campus years after moving back into Lawrenceville. There’s plenty of family oriented activities. For the past few weeks the sermons were very good. They can never stress enough the importance of each individuals role in a society; the core of a strong family & community. Fellowship here is great. There’s workshops for all ages and walks of life. I am a visitor from out of state.  I visited the Snellville campus and found the 21 Stone Church to be like family.  They welcomed me like family.  I found the message relevant and exciting.  The music was more modern than traditional.  The church uses modern technology to reach more people and receive tithes, offering and to schedule classes that are also quite relevant.

name: 180 Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Great young pastor really led by the spirit. Preaching the word of truth seems to be second nature to this man. He has really stepped into his calling. Incredible teaching! Pastor Aaron’s preaching is dynamic and powerful - he brings the Word! You will be encouraged, challenged and grow in your faith. God’s doing amazing things here at 180! Come and see! Please turn the music volume down as it’s disturbing the surrounding neighborhood.
Bass and drums carry much farther and more powerfully than you realize.
Thanks!
:) Neighborhood asks you please turn down the music during night church please.
Several neighbors have requested already.
The bass (drums and bass guitar) travel through walls and much farther than most people realize. Thank you for providing worship nights for the Rocklin community, it's very much needed for the youth and young adults in search of direction. Thank you Jesus!

name: 2 Cities Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Went and left a review that the pastor gave coins to the men in my group but not me, a woman. I also served, and was quite literally ignored. He went in a line and gave the 3 guys with me coins. Skipped me entirely. You guys responded to my review saying that “only active duty are given coins.” One- my husband is a VETERAN AS WELL. He still got a coin. Two- and maybe the most important- you never asked any of us!! How does that make any sense? Just admit you didn’t give me a coin because “you didn’t think I was active duty”. You didn’t give me one because I’m a woman. A church that welcomes everyone and teaches Biblical truth. This church is a wonderful church for those looking for a church home, even virtually (as the virtual community is very strong!). There are many life groups to join to stay connected to the church, as well. Pastor Jeff is such a wonderful pastor who teaches God's heart and love for His people! The first word that comes to mind when trying to describe 2 Cities Church is "different".  It is not only a  welcoming, friendly and joyful Church, but a Church where you feel like you are being taught about God, Jesus and the Bible and not just preached at. You are being informed of truths and encouraged to question. They aren't looking for bodies to just fill seats and to take your money (in fact they straight up tell you not to give money if you are not a member), but are offering themselves to help people when and where they can and to teach anyone who wants to learn more. Hello,

I don’t know much about this church. I live out of state, but I am asking on behalf of a friend. I have sent several emails regarding the basic teachings and beliefs of this church, but I have not received any response. Could someone from the church please reply to my emails?

Thank you.
Nathan We love this church family. The preaching is excellent and they offer virtual or in person. With the focus being on local missions, we really love meeting the needs of our neighbors.

reviewSummary: Our church is good.

reviewSummary: Innovative church community with campuses featuring community cafes and sports centers, dedicated to helping people take next steps with God in a modern, welcoming setting.

name: 28th Church of Christ, Scientist - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly people! Quiet, calm surroundings inside the church. During the service you can see the lush garden cradle the exterior of the church, giving it a feeling of being outdoors with it's large windows without having to see any suburban view or people walking by (just a garden to enjoy while contemplating the lesson) Not crowded when I visited.

name: 2nd Apostolic Church-Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I have been trying to find a church for some time and my husband took me here and ever since I really love it here its like family now God

name: 3 Degrees Church
reviewSummary: I honestly liked going to this church for awhile but now I'm having different thoughts about it. Pastor Steve seems very arrogant in the way he speaks. He calls people out a lot when he thinks they're not following God the way they should be and criticizes them. He talks a lot about himself so much that he obstructs us from hearing the word and all we hear is his words. And I think what he should do is be aware of what he's saying and how he's saying it because it gives the wrong impression. When he feels that the congregation isn't feeling what he's saying, he feels the need to force people to say Amen. Which I've always thought you say Amen when you've heard something that speaks to you. I don't like to feel pressured to say Amen. They used to have doughnuts in the morning but then they made it seem like it was necessary to address the doughnuts while at the same time offering them. The postive side to this church is that the people are friendly and you can tell they love the Lord. A spiritual oasis in the heart of the city. Whether you are struggling and need comfort or want uplifting nourishment for your mind and soul, visit 3 Degrees. Great music is a major bonus. What an awesome church!! Pastor Steve is the best! Great people that love Jesus and love others. My home away from home! The church family ever!

name: 412 Church Temecula Valley - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to 412 church for a year now and it’s an amazing experience every time. It’s a church that truly respects and encourages traditional values. The value of putting God first, the value of family and the value in being an honest and good child of God. Everyone is very welcoming!  I have finally found my home church. 412 Church is an exceptional place to worship. Our lead pastor is consistently honest, incredibly well-articulate, and deeply knowledgeable, always accomplishing his mission to lead the congregation forward. The Youth Pastor is equally phenomenal, offering inspiring and uplifting advice that is exactly what our young people need to navigate their lives. My husband and I have been attending 412 for just over 5 years and we are so blessed by the Lord’s faithful work in us and in our whole body of believers over that time. We have attended Calvary Chapel affiliated churches our whole married life and definitely appreciate the church leadership’s unwavering commitment to the entire Word of God in teaching and in practice. Practice is exactly what distinguishes this fellowship from any we’ve attended before. Leadership is not only completely committed to teaching the full counsel of God, but is also faithful to live it out in genuine Love for their congregants and all who the Lord brings across their path. We believe this is how Jesus desires  His Church to operate as His witness to a very dark world full of people who desperately need Him.We thank Him so much for planting us here where His genuine Love is so evident. If you want to learn about what is inside your Bible then this is the Church for you. Ive learned more in the few years I've attended then I ever knew before. The Praise and worship is wonderful and the message is always very relevant and engaging 😇👍

name: 5 Points Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church! We are a big family just trying to follow Jesus together and bring the Kingdom of God to Athens. I've been a member since we launched in 2024 and I couldn't be more proud to call this my church home. If you're looking for a church come check us out! All are welcome :) This church is firmly grounded in God's Word, committed to helping people grow as disciples of Jesus, and filled with people who sincerely love and care for one another. It is a special place where we get to do life with other believers who desire to know Christ and to make him known.

If you are searching for a church home, come check us out. From the moment you walk through the doors you'll experience incredible hospitality and a church that has a deep passion for serving the community with the love of Christ. So grateful for the community my family has found at 5 Points Church! Love the worship, great Scriptural teaching, and welcoming atmosphere. I’m also thankful for the wonderful kids ministry where my boys are loved, cared for, and learning about God each week. Very authentic, scripture focused and spirit led church. We’d been church hopping for a year when we found 5 points and immediately felt welcomed and at home here! We’ve since had our first baby and are so grateful to have found such a healthy church family to raise her alongside. I love the hospitality at 5Points Church.  This is a church that prays first then serves.

name: 5 Stones Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: We were just in town visiting and didn’t want to miss church so we checked out 5 Stones. Talked to many welcoming and friendly people. Felt just like being at church back home. Was a very nice service, gave a lot to think about. Please, if you haven't found a church, give 5 stones a try.  You will find Jesus there. 5 Stones church has changed the life of my family and I for the better. At first we were nervous because we wanted to find a church where we could get easily plugged in and feel welcomed. Walking into I guarantee you will be greeted with friendly smiles that are genuine and a fantastic group of people that just want you to be a part of the team and community without leaving you feeling pressured to do anything. The small groups have a good diversity as far as topics and formats. My challenge to anyone who hasn’t gone is to commit to just trying it for a few weeks! If you don’t feel part of then you might want to check the address because you may have gone to the wrong place! I love everything about this church. The people are so friendly, the message is so strong. A place where you can really feel at home while learning about the Bible. Pastor Sean Clark is a Bible teaching pastor with great values. The greetings you receive when u walk through the door are amazing, if you don't know someone, just wait, because you will find friends here. We absolutely love 5 Stones Church! When my husband and I moved to Thompsons Station as newlyweds, we knew it wouldn’t be practical to drive to church in Nashville. We started looking and felt like we were Goldilocks and the three bears hunting for the perfect (for us) church. We were invited to 5 Stones in Franklin and have been going there almost 3 years! The first thing you’ll notice is the genuine friendliness of the members. Pastor Sean is Biblically sound sound and relatable.  The worship team lead with passion and show their genuine love for God. Fast forward to now and 2 children later, the nursery team is loving and shares a biblical lesson each week. We’ve made some amazing friends and grown in our walk with Christ. No matter what stage you are at in your faith, please give 5 Stones a try.

name: 614 Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Community. The Father, the Son, the Holy Spirit. The true Word of God. You get to see it all here. Authentic worship and sermons. A place that is so warm to be. I love this church, the family we have, and the heart we carry. I was searching for loving community and I found it here at 614.
UNTIL EVERYONE KNOWS JESUS❤️❤️ The energy at 614 is amazing! My daughter and I attended for the first time. We were greeted by several people and felt welcomed even though we live hours away. Music was powerful! Sermon was inspiring and uplifting. Will definitely go back! I’ve gone to this church for 6 years and it has shaped my faith into what it is. I came into this church not knowing much of Jesus and this place has helped me encounter him in incredible ways and my life will forever be changed because of it. These people are super welcoming, authentic, fun to be around, and most important are in love with Jesus. Can’t wait to see how the lord uses these walls. cannot recommend 614 ENOUGH, the community is amazing but the way the honor and love the Holy Spirit is beyond beautiful. This is how the body of Christ is supposed to be, they are so welcoming + kind and have sound biblical teaching. the worship is also amazing, it is true worship not just singing songs about Jesus, they want to encounter Him! i’d recommend joining a life group as well, it helped me build so many strong friendships! if you are a college student as well go to college nights, they are AMAZING! all of this doesn’t even scratch the surface of how amazing 614 is, you really just need to go see it yourself! A Church where God is seen, Love is felt and Lives are Changed
Since the first time I came to this Church, I've felt like a part of a Family.... God's Family 🙏🙌 A Church where everyone is Welcomed 🙏🙌

name: 614 Church - Dublin - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: This church has been so amazing and welcoming. I look forward to coming every Sunday. It’s such a great place where I am able to grow my faith and meet people that feel like family. I am so grateful to call 614 church home! 614 - Dublin has been integral for building up my family's faith and finding community. It is a community of people striving to follow Jesus, taking God's word and his Holy Spirit seriously. So beyond grateful to call this church home. They keep the heart of Jesus at the center of everything. This culture is deeply passionate about knowing and walking closely with the Lord, doing it with life-giving community, and in step with the truth of the Word. I’m so grateful to get to do life with this church! My family has experienced real LIFE with Jesus and genuine community at 614! It has become our home. 614 Church has been such a welcoming and sweet place to grow in my faith- to ask questions, be challenged, be supported, and belong. The people are genuine, kind, and so in love with Jesus.

name: 633 Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: I absolute enjoyed this church and every aspect of it! At first glance it looked small, but honestly that didn’t matter to me. I wanted a church where I felt the Holy Spirit and where my family and I can hear actual truth from the Bible. I didn’t want religion but just something non-denominational where following the Bible is all we need. When we walked in we were welcomed as if we had been going there for years instead of first time visitors. We then got showed where the sanctuary and restrooms were. We got seated and when worshiped started it was like Jesus just walked in the room!! The Pastor greeted us as well which he was super nice. Preaching was definitely truth, the pastor even mentioned to fact check him from the bible! He broke scripture down and helped us understand the context of what was being talked about and how it’s applied to life today. The Pastor then talked to us after church as well when we were leaving while he stood to say bye to everyone at the door. Overall it was amazing, Holy Spirit filled, and welcoming. If you’re looking for a good church home for you and your family I HIGHLY recommend THIS church. My family and I have officially found our church home! I absolutely LOVE 633 Church! I've been attending this Church for about 8 years now, and I couldn't see myself or my family anywhere else! When you walk in those doors, you are welcomed with love, you are family. Everyone is so welcoming and warm. The whole staff is great! Pastor teaches and preaches the TRUTH. This Church is where the presence of the Lord dwells! If you're wanting a genuine, true experience of where the Glory of the Lord dwells and falls, a Holy Ghost experience, THIS IS IT!!! You will feel it as soon as you walk in the door! I'm so grateful to have found this Church, my Church HOME! 🙌 If this all sounds like what you need and want, then you have GOT to visit!! 633 Church is an amazing and loving church. Gods presence can be felt as soon as you walk through the door. The congregation is welcoming and you truly get to know your Pastors. Pastor Richard cares about each and every soul that walks into the church, and you are sure to receive God’s love and truth every service. It is a guarantee that you will have an encounter with Jesus here and experience real transformation 💙💙 This church is truly Holy Spirit-filled and grounded in the Word of God. From the moment you walk in, you can feel God’s presence. The worship is powerful and genuine, and the preaching is straight from the Bible — no sugarcoating, no watering it down, just truth shared with love and clarity. You leave feeling encouraged, challenged, and spiritually refreshed. Most of all, it’s real people who really love Jesus! If you’re looking for a church that stands firmly on Scripture and genuinely seeks God, this is the place for you, your family, and your friends. I have been attending 633 Church for almost 3 years and met Jesus here. My life has completely been changed. This is a spirit filled church and Pastor Richard brings fresh word twice a week. You will have an encounter with the Lord here. You will be changed and truly grow in your relationship with the Lord. Thank you Pastor Richard and Pastor Sherri for your hearts and love for everyone. You both are truly kingdom and that’s evident to anyone you meet.

name: 7 City Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Unfortunately I did not have a great experience at this church. I was drawn to it because it was smaller than a lot of the megachurches in the area. I was new to Texas and wasn't used to every church being so big (I'm from Ohio).

I did like the sermons I attended, and because I filled out a form online, I was gifted a Bible and sticker. The people working at the table were very nice.

However, after a month or so of attending, I signed up to help decorate the church for Christmas. I thought this was a lovely idea for an event and would be an easy way to meet people. Well, not a single person acknowledged me during the event. Usually in smaller churches, people will notice that I am new and come to me to introduce themselves. I am not an outgoing person by nature, so I always appreciate this and it helps me to open up. I really tried to be approachable (i.e. not on my phone, trying to help), but everyone seemed closed off. Initially, I sat down with a group of girls my age (young adult), including a singer on the worship team, and they acted as if I were invisible, even after smiling and initiating conversation. It was very odd and made me feel unwelcome.

Overall, 7 City wasn't a great fit for me. I don't write this review to be mean but to share my honest experience with others. Thankfully I have since found a church community closer to home with people I have bonded with. I have tried reaching out to this church in person, over the phone and no one picks up. Very unresponsive. Which is shocking to me with how great they seem on their website. A great community of followers of Jesus and disciples. Pastor Steven provides a powerful message each week.  The Church is come as you are and welcomes everyone. Highly recommend.  Community driven and involvement. Visiting Fort Worth for the weekend and wanted to attend church. What a blessing to stumble upon this welcoming, congregation!!  Convenient parking across the street, escorted across a busy street and greeted at the door.

Had the opportunity to witness two baptisms and 8 children be dedicated.  You could feel the Spirit moving in this place and in these people!

Pastor Steven delivered a message that really hit home. If you’re not liking the story being written, change your path.

Awesome, contemporary worship music.  Beautiful vocals and accompaniment by keyboard, drums and bass.

God had a plan for me on this random Sunday. I’m grateful He directed me to 7C!  If I ever am back in the area, I will definitely be returning.  7C, keep up the amazing work!!! My wife and I have been attending 7 City Church a little over a year now. We were at our previous church for 30 years, so we were not looking forward to searching for a new home church. God was so good to us and led us to 7 City, first church we visited, and we never stopped coming back! The preaching is Biblical and very applicable to life today, the church's heart for Ft. Worth is seen everywhere, and we love that our missions focus is local, national, and global. Community groups and opportunities to serve helped us meet so many new friends and we are truly thankful for 7 City Church.

name: 7 Hills Church - Cincinnati - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
My family loves 7 Hills Church! Pastors Jake & Cori are amazing! We’ve been searching for community & found it here. It’s so nice connecting with other families through small groups. We have 4 girls under 7 and they LOVE hills kids. They do a great job with kids ministry & the ladies taking care of them are truly angels.  I’m so excited to raise our girls in church & beyond thankful God brought us to 7 Hills. Our family really loves 7 Hills Church - Cincinnati! They are Bible focused, have amazing worship, a GREAT kids ministry (called Hills Kids), plenty of ways to get connected (small groups, daily devotionals, Summit and more)… I could go on and on!

My wife and I have been a part of this church through every stage of our lives: single, engaged, married, married with kids… and I can confidently say they have welcomed us, poured into us and loved us through it all.

I’m very thankful for this church family and I think you would be too! My first experience at 7 Hills Church at our Cincinnati location was so special. This was the first time attending any other location besides Florence, and I was so curious but quickly realized that yes it may be setup at Anderson High School, but God and the incredible team at 7 Hills transform what was a HS into a place where God's sprit and presence is so pure!

Pastor Jake and Cori do such a phenomenal job making it feel like a place you can call home, and from "Legacy" their Youth Ministry on Wednesdays to Sunday and their world class Children's Ministry "Hills Kids", there's truly a place for everyone in your family! God is moving at 7 Hills Church! Very welcoming, warm, friendly honest treat you as family. Helpful to our family, very considerate for all ages: young and  adult age.  Encouraging community outreach and very involved in local outreaches in both Ohio & Kentucky. Many church activities and groups, youth retreats offered as well. Always refreshing to see all ages come together and supporting praising Jesus leaning into your faith together. Try it! You won’t regret it. 7 Hills provides an organized and safe environment, offering a variety of ways to serve. It offers several different small groups, has impactful worship, and active community involvement. It feels like home.

name: A & M Church of Christ - College Station Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church! People are incredible! Seeing so much people worshipping Christ and serving Him is wonderful. Love classes and options it has for our kids and us. This Church is so amaysing, I have been going for a while and everytime I go I am always happy I went. I would highly recommend coming.🥰🥰 This church is simply outstanding. I found this congregation in the summer of 2015, when I was Google searching for churches in the College Station area. I had never attended a church before, and took a chance on this one. Thank The Lord that I did, because the kindness, compassion, fellowship, and warm welcomes from the members of this congregation kept me coming back! They facilitated my learning of the Gospels, and were always happy to answer my questions or discuss religion with me. Furthermore, they made me part of their family. If you are looking for a church that values relationships, and is grounded in The Word, I highly encourage you to give this one a chance! God bless this congregation. I've been going to this church for seven years now, at first glance that size of the church may seem intimidating but come with an open mind and an open heart. No church is perfect, I believe this church recognizes that, but they strive to be like Jesus to the best of their abilities. I've met some of the most Christ-like people in my time here. As my wife and I are now expecting, we've had the blessing of this entire village come to celebrate and support us through it. They've become family. There are opportunities to use your talents for the Kingdom, places you can get plugged in. Invest yourself and seek these opportunities out, we'd love to have you. We'll meet you were you're at. There are no expectations. All are worthy to sit at the feet of Jesus. Super nice ppl and they blessed me tremendously..

name: A meeting place for the church in College Station - College Station Campus
reviewSummary: This congregation is rich in life, spiritual nourishment, and solid biblical truth in a loving atmosphere. I can sense God's sweet presence in the believers here. These Christians really love Jesus and one another. It is 100% Bible based. You will learn how to live and live by Jesus and the Bible here. Great church for college students.  The saints here welcome students into their homes and they become family to one another. I have had a wonderful experience meeting with the believers here!  Although the meetings are not that traditional in the sense of pews and a sermon, the meetings are filled with focusing on Christ and enjoying him.  All are encouraged that "each one has" (I Cor 14:26) a portion of Christ and can share what they have experienced of Him throughout their week.  Besides meeting Lord's Day morning, they meet in small groups in homes throughout the week.  Being built with other brothers and sisters in Christ is so supplying to keep pursuing Him! It feels like family here, and full of life. I wouldn't want to be anywhere else in College Station. It's here I experienced the real love of Christ through the members of the Body.

name: A Meeting Place Of The Church in Fairborn - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been meeting with the church in Fairborn for almost two years now, and I have never met a group of believers who love the Lord Jesus as much as these. Whether it is on the Lord’s day or Tuesday night prayer meeting or meetings in the homes throughout the week, there is always fellowship to be had.

Once I started meeting with the church, I fell in love with the Lord and the saints. I am grateful to have received such care and vision regarding the truths of the Bible and the opportunity to meet and care for one another in mutuality. I love meeting with the brothers and sisters who love the Lord and God’s word here. This is very warm, welcoming, loving and caring community of believers and pursuing to know and experience Christ revealed in His word in their daily life. My wife and I have been meeting with the church in Fairborn for a few years now and have just had a wonderful experience. Here we have found a community that practice the Christian life and church life not just on Sundays in a formal meeting place, but also "day by day, house to house" as is seen in Acts 2. We have felt a tremendous amount of support in our walk with Christ, and we have also found a place and a way to apply ourselves in Christian service. As it is said in a hymn, "I'm so happy, in this lovely place, in a garden flowing in His grace!" The Church is Christ's own Body (Eph. 1:22-23), The Father's dwelling place (1 Tim. 3:15), the gathering of the called ones, God blended with man's race (John 1:1, 14); Elect before creation (Eph. 1:4; 1 Peter 1:2), Redeemed by Calv'ry's death, Her character and standing of Heaven, not of earth. From every tribe and nation do all the members come, regardless of their classes united to be one. No high there is, nor lowly, no Jew, nor Gentile clan, no free, nor slave, nor master, BUT Christ, the "one new man" (Col. 3:10-11)! This is the best place To enjoy The Lord On The Lord's Day. If you want to be fed by The Spirit come to the meeting place in Fairborn and you will know that you found real love. Keep on enjoying Christ in your spirits

name: A New Thing Christian Church - Lithonia Campus
reviewSummary: Best church ever! Message is clear and the holy spirit was definitely in that place. Surrounded by good people who just wanna be a blessing Great place to attend. 💯God 1st! A true place of worship

name: a2 Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: Rock City Churck, I am and have been watching from Madison WI.  Pastor Mike, I bless God for you and your ministry.   I am a Methodists, 63 years old, married with 8 children.  God has been good to my family, but watching Rock City Church, I now feel God's purpose on my life.  My mind has been expended in God's words and I comprehend Devine  applications Please visit, it's so nice and welcoming. Join them on Sundays. Service starts at 9:30 see 👀 you there... Sunday service is always good, drop in and visit, Easter is right around the corner 😀.. Great church if you are looking. Music is good. Non traditional style. The pastor has a great point of view and I like his style of preaching. Very down to earth and applicable to everyday life. The people are very welcoming, but not over the top with new comers! Worth a visit! You can also preview their past services online through their website before going, which is always helpful. We visited this church for Christmas Eve after having watched some of their live streamed services. We really enjoyed the music, ambiance, and the message. They also held communion and did a candle lit prayer at the end of the service. It was very beautiful and we would definitely return! Great church. It's very community based. It's on the small size, and has a cozy feel. The church is non-traditional style. The music has a rock-and-roll element to it, which I appreciate. That style of worship isn't for everyone, but I personally enjoy it a lot. The pastors at A2 church are all kind. They make genuine connections with people, which I appreciate. The sermons are interesting and are quite varied. The church goes through different "series" as they call it. Each series has a different theme for the messages. For example, a series titled, "got your six" would be focused on relationships and friendships. Another might be titled, "what comes after?" and focus on what heaven will be like. The church has a unique feel, and likely won't be for everyone. As for me, I really enjoyed the church. A2 is a church for people who have given up on church.

name: Abiding Christ Lutheran - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: I attend Zumba class here on Tuesdays and Thursdays with KTZumba! We have a great time and it's an excellent workout! We have our annual Christmas party for our heart support group here every year and do thankful that they open there doors for its and provide tables, chairs and so much more. Clean nice friendly. Thankful..... Great Adult education!!! The most efficient ESL course in the US! Thank you for allowing troop 15 to use your facility! I really admire what this Church do and have been doing for the community. Awesome Pastors and kind members.

name: Abiding Love Church - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: At Abiding Love church this is where Jesus is taught there is also love and healing in the house. The atmosphere  is right not perfect just forgiven.. Miracle signs and wonders God is doing great things in and with Abiding Love… come join us beat me there. When I leave Abiding Love Church I feel motivated, educated and most of all loved. Pastor Huggins not only relates when teaching and preaching, but he breaks down the sermon so that all audiences can take away knowledge. It is truly a blessing to be part of a great group Christians a family  Abiding Love Church They are very welcoming and the teaching is sound and practical! Great man of God and awesome church

I would highly recommend to try out Abilene Baptist Church. — Also has a great child care program. Bible study. Wednesday night services. Don’t miss out on all the fun while worshiping! Classic church , beautiful building , nice worship and a pastor that is close to people 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼

name: Abundant Church - El Paso Campus
reviewSummary:
I Love the environment and the message that my family and i receive every Sunday.

All pastors are unique and wonderful. Pastor Shannon Nieman and her girls night outs are indeed the best. Such a wonderful connection as a woman for the woman.

I love it !

You are welcome 🤗 💕 join us invest in your present, your future. Blessed beyond measure! I am home. My husband & I serve together & are in Circles (small group) with other married couples. All Pastors are a blessing to us and to all. If your reading this, then it's TIME to come to Abundant and be blessed! 🙏🙌 Used to go to Catholic Church, but it didn't seem enough.  Here at Abundant you get the word along with an explanation.  The music is wonderful and the people are great. Im in a wheelchair and its very accessible for me. Give all authority to Yeshua our Lord Jesus🙏🏽You want to get your Spirit at a level only our divine Father can energize you? Abundant is truly a place to worship and learn scripture 🙏🏽Don’t forget to bring your Bible and remember John  3:16 is No lie but the truth and the only way💞 I love Abundant. name: Abundant Life Assembly of God - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary: This church partnered with us to support missionary work among churches in Japan. With their help, we were able to successfully host an enjoyable three-day summer camp at our church. It was a wonderful opportunity for many non-Christian adults and children to gather and hear the Gospel; the team served with great dedication and a cheerful spirit. My mother Corrine (age 94) went to be with the Lord, last week and all her loved ones who have gone before her. I am so grateful to pastor Greg and the church for the heartfelt delivery of the most beautiful flowers. Thank you so very much. I love love love Abundant Life Church. Wonderful down to earth biblical church.   Caring people and real. Biblical teaching and the friendliest people! Everyone feels like family here. Thank God I found this place!

name: Abundant Life Christian Church - San Marcos - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
I knew when I walked in this place that the Spirit of the Lord was present. There’s a real connection with the Pastor and his wife here, they have a deep desire of love that overflows from their hearts to ALL.
I had to move away but that never stopped this family from loving me, I’m still a part in their hearts and it’s evident.
I would encourage you to go and see for yourself the love of Jesus in this place. Amen No judgment. Come as you are! This church has given me the most beautiful experience I’ve ever had. I’ve never felt so free to be myself at my own pace in any other place. They truly have loved me during my spiritual process. This is a place of healing, love, understanding, compassion, and grace. This truly is a place of god. My experience has been wonderful so far! I have visited this church several times now.
I have decided to be a part of this fellowship. because I love its heart to serve and minister to San Marcos outside the walls of the building.
Which is the mandate for the church body.  It is nice to see a church actually doing it and it's actually nice to see the Pastor and his beautiful wife desire to build God's kingdom and not theirs.
I'm Excited to grow with this ministry. Wonderful place of Word, worship, & fellowship.
Come see what the Lord is doing!

name: Abundant Life Christian Fellowship - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary: Came here for a leadership workshop. It's been years since I've been here. The building is well maintained and cleaned. The staff was super nice. Although, I don't get why you serve snacks but have to stay in the foyer and only allow water in the sanctuary- makes eating the snack or drinking the coffee not such a good experience lol. But that's neither here nor there. Went here Easter Sunday and the church didn’t look like anything in the photo on Google maps. It was smaller with a lot of empty seats and no offense to pastor but he just preached by reading the scripture didn’t really talk about any social justice issues which I was surprised by with everything tumultuous going on with America right now. The choir didn’t really move my wife and I and everyone on the stage was wearying all sorts of different clothing. Seems to need some unification of colors on the stage, it just looked too unorganized. Some guy came up wearing a nice suit did a great prayer while another guy came up wearing jeans and a jogging warmup top. Just was off…my wife and I won’t be coming back The sermon was very good! The worship service is very feminine and the sound system overpowers voices of congregation. If you enjoy a "rock concert" sound system you will probably find this a great place to feel the music and experience a state of worship. My 1st time visiting and I enjoyed the music, the people AND pastors preaching. He preached the word of God and made it clear. I really felt comfortable with the congregation and loved the diversity. I most of all enjoyed what I received from the preaching. Kathy in the info both was super sweet and listened to my heart. She was kind, empathetic and informative. I do wish that the website provided the specific time of the Sunday church service because the site still has the old church service times for when Pastor P. Sheppard was pastoring. I ended up missing the praise and worship (in person because I ended up watching online as I drove to church). I realized that ALCF now one service on Sunday (@10am). I will visit again. They do an amazing job of spreading the word of God.This church has been doing work all over the world for years now. This building has amazing energy and healing power.  It’s so much more than a church, it’s a loving community. Great place to worship God!

name: Abundant Life Church
reviewSummary:
I love the New Pastor and his family! If you never had a personal relationship with Jesus Christ, then come here, you will learn and be able to go out into the World and take on its evilness, you will learn how to build your relationship with God! I went to this church as a non believer
I now am a believer. I am going every Sunday and devoting my life to jesus and god. Amen gobbles Horrible place. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. People there caused me SEVERE mental distress after lying to me. TERRIBLE. Went to my granddaughter 'Autumn Francis' dedication back to God and the the entire service was a Blessing!! Godly Pastor, hospitable people, praise and worship. It's where faith and life connect!

reviewSummary:
Typical greedy pastor, ppl tithing won't save you but we should give back, I wouldn't give a penny to save this church, but a few ministries that do deserve support in my opinion are on youtube. Kent Hovind Creation Science Evangelism, Pastor D End Times News and David Lynn. The best place 2b.

name: Abundant Life Church of Moore - Moore Campus
reviewSummary: No doubt God's presence is in this loving, kind and friendly Church. You can feel him sweet spirit all around you. Everyone here from the Pastor, choir, ushers, altar workers and all its members are good genuine people who will welcome you with arms wide open and make you feel like you're finally home. Not to mention the Sunday school class it's great, definitely will highly recommended this place of worship to any one who's ready to experience God's love, compassion and blessing! smile emoticon It's a wonderful church. The people are so friendly, the pastor is anointed, and there are a lot of different ministry opportunities to get involved in. God is doing great things at ALC, and everyone is welcome to be a part of it! I absolutely love this church! God's presence is present and strong in this place. Pastor Mark is one of the most caring pastors I know, and we always feel welcome here :) I am not on the decided times of your church. So please advise. Best church ever!!! I know God is everywhere but i know for sure that He is in the place ever time I'm there. Amazing worship loving people and a great place to call home.

name: Abundant Life Ministries
reviewSummary:
The first time that I worshipped with Abundant Life the sermon was about family.
I knew that I was in the right place. I have continued to look to Bishop Crozier and the church family for prayer, encouragement, and advice. I am so thankful for their unconditional love, support and guidance. I was there tonight as a walk in guest and no one came to introduce themself to me nor ask my information as a GUEST.  Also, I noticed the Pastor only prophesy to his members and skip over guest.  Yes the anointing is in there, but a more welcoming atmosphere would be helpful to guest.  I'm from over 5 hours away and saw the church so I stopped in. :( Bible based teaching. Fun. Friendly and welcoming. Active youth ministry. This is a wonderful place for worship. I live in Huntsville Alabama,I watch online but anything I need to ask Bishop Crozier he is always there,I went to school with First Lady Renee,they are awesome people

name: Abundant Life Worship Center - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary:
The Abundant Life Worship Center is quite a place. I have served there now for a number of years. I feel valued, appreciated, and loved.

The focus is always on how to show our love for Jesus; be it through hearing the Word, serving the community, or fellowshipping with others who attend weekly services or special activities.

The Leadership Team is sincere, caring, and open to listen. A church should embody the character of Jesus - This place does! I truly feel blessed to be apart of Abundant Life Worship Center.  From the beginning I felt like apart of the family.  Everyone is warm and welcoming.  However, most importantly I have learned  so much about what it means to get involved and how that very decision help transform me in my everyday life. Not only have I learned the importance of getting involved, I have personally grown spiritually with my connection with the Lord. I believe it is important to find a safe body of believers to worship with and to grow with.  The pastors and loving and authentic and welcome you whether you've been there from Sunday to Sunday or even if they only on Easter.  I love my church and I thank God for leading my husband and I here. Since joining this ministry I have grown spiritually. I have made a choice to listen to the teaching, apply what I learn and watch God transform my life. My confidence in Christ is on another level, my mindset has completely shifted and my faith is rooted in God. Another area of growth since becoming a member of Abundant Life Worship Center is my heart posture toward serving others and building Godly relationships. Since opening my heart and mind in these areas life has become less about me and more about loving others. So many doors have opened in my life since I made the choice to allow God to have his way with my life. My family and I have been blessed to be members at ALWC for the past 9 years. As I attend Sunday services, weekly Bible studies and life Groups my faith and understanding of the Word grows stronger. The messages that our pastors teach are inspiring and useful for every day living. Im grateful for our Pastors who teach and live out the mission to walk in love, make disciples and manifest abundant life. The members are so loving and welcoming. The teachings of service and the transforming love of God are directed not just to the church but to the community and the marketplace. Abundant Life is a church filled with abundant love. The people are friendly and loving. The worship is amazing and the Word of God is taught with integrity. You will definitely be blessed at this ministry. You may come in broke but you will definitely leave out whole by the power of the gospel. Come on out and worship with us.

name: Abundant Mercy Christian Church - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary: Visit each Sunday at 915 for Sunday School and 1030 for a worship encounter and experience like non other. A fresh anointing awaits your presence each time. Bible Study on Wednesday is no comparison as the unadulterated word of God is taught with active application and demonstration. The love of God flows in and through this church body. Abundant Mercy Christian Church is an amazing place to call home! You feel genuine love as soon as you walk through the doors. The pastors are phenomenal and they definitely lead by example. It’s a Bible based church where Holy Spirit resides. I absolutely love being a member of this church, that’s why I don’t mind driving from Camp Creek to McDonough every week. AMCC is an amazing place to worship. We have a great children’s and teen ministry. The Praise team is lit, the word is authentic, and we love out loud. If no one has invited you, let me be the first to do so. Our pastors are the best pastors this side of Heaven. So if you are looking for a church where you can grow, AMCC is the one for you. If you are looking for a church home where you will be fed the Word of God, experience spiritual growth, and encounter powerful praise and worship, I highly recommend Abundant Mercy Christian Church International. Apostle(s) Robert and Dr. Janine Howard are true servant leaders who are dedicated to teaching and living the Word of God. Their continuous dedication, wisdom, and love are evident in everything they do. The church family is welcoming and genuine, making you feel right at home. This is truly a place where lives are transformed. I have been a member of AMCCI for 3 years, and it has been a tremendous blessing to grow under the leadership of Apostle(s) Robert and Dr. Janine Howard. This church family is exactly that! I had been following on social long before I actually joined. My soul has been blessed thus far beyond measure; I am learning in so many areas that have and will benefited me spiritually. This is my church family and “I don’t play about mine”, as the young folk say, lol!

name: Acacia Church
reviewSummary:
Great people, good doctrine, a love for the Lord, and others are clearly present. They also have great events like Block Party Sundays, Chilli Cookoffs, hikes, and other fun fellowship events. The Kids and Youth ministries are fantastic. A home away from home!  So many of us in the greater DC area are not from around here.  This is a beautiful place to worship our Lord and make connections with other believers to support you through the good times and the bad times.  Pastor Jeff Good is loving, honest and authentic.  A true shepherd for the flock.  I am so thankful for God for this church and want the world to know about it so they can be blessed as well. This church has been a blessing to my young family.  There are wonderful, loving volunteers in the children's ministry and just an awesome body of Christ to walk with through the highs and lows of this life. If you're looking for a place where you can anonymously sneak in and be entertained for an hour a week, this is not the church for you. But if you're looking for warm fellowship, authentic worship, solid Bible-based teaching, and a pastor who really knows you, Christ Community is the place for you. I really wish I would have come here sooner :( I live 4 min away, and today (Easter 2022) I came by myself since my husband and son are visiting family in NC before we move at the end of this month to Ohio.
They had a Scottish pastor speak today, I could have stayed and listened all day long. The service was beautiful, just what I needed and the people were so nice and welcoming when I came in. If we ever come back to Ashburn, Christ Community has my heart!💜✝️

name: Acacia Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
Very very clean n the love in the building was; So pleasant n watching everyone around me,feel the presence of God was a since of joy n peace, within me! I absolutely LOVE ACACIA CHURCH!!! Pastor Russ is amazing.😍 Before you walk in the door there is amazing people high fiveing you and just welcome everyone. I been going there 3 years moved away for 10 months and I missed it everyday. I am finally HOME at  (ACACIA). I will always tell everyone that God is in there. The praise and worship is amazing. They have awesome worship team and prayer warriors. I can't THANK GOD ENOUGH FOR having ACACIA CHURCH there for everyone to go to. If your new in town and looking for a wonderful church and you will make it HOME I promise. 💗💗💗🙏🙏🙏🫶🤗 We have attended their Sunday mid-morning service just a few times & each time it has been a positive experience! We were welcomed with a “good morning” & we’re allowed in with a smile. VIP: COFFEE ☕️ is on the right ➡️!!! Music was upbeat, People were standing, sitting, and/or  singing along!
The songs were worshipful. I loved seeing a mix of ethnic groups not only on stage but in the congregation!!!! It made me think, hey this is what heaven is going to be like, RIGHT?!!!
The messages so far have been, I think, more towards the evangelist style- which is my favorite!!❤️ I need to be reminded how much God loves me & YOU!!
Final thought: ⭐️We were given space & weren’t rushing to us like some other churches that look desperate 😒 !
🙌🏼worship was wonderful, one negative thing for me was that the 🎶 was WAY TOO LOUD😨! So I guess I need to bring some earplugs! So far so good. This place feels like HOME. It is Very welcoming, non judgmental and friendly people of all origins. I really love the diversity and hospitality of the people there. It is great church to visit when in town or to attend every Sunday Acacia Church is the most welcoming church I’ve ever been to.  They say “come as you are” and they mean it.  You see people dressed in shorts and flops and suits and ties and they’re all co-mingling - no judgmental or disapproving looks. These people are kind and loving to guests without a hard pressure sale. Worth checking out.

name: Academy Christian Church
reviewSummary: Beloved northern Colorado Springs congregation offering both traditional and modern worship services, authentic community groups, and strong student ministries.

name: Academy Christian Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Beloved northern Colorado Springs congregation offering both traditional and modern worship services, authentic community groups, and strong student ministries.

name: Academy Christian Church - Westside - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Couple times going and the word was spoken about very solidly with no watering down and the music had me cry, plus the pastors prayers were deep. I’ve had a NDE and a powerful testimony and can’t turn my back on Jesus ever again cause he never turned his back on me and he saved me on July 13th. I hope to see you at this church. it’s not a big church like 40 people max, but they are all older and well grounded in their faith and I had fun talking with many of them. I liked this church the best out of 3 different ones in Colorado Springs ✝️ that I went to and they also have a second church up north between Colorado Springs and Denver. I think 4 different pastors cycle between the two 🤔
Anyways love you children of god 🥰🥳🫡 I've only gone a handful of times but I've felt very welcomed and comfortable there! The people are warm and friendly and have made a point to recognize that I'm new and remember me, not just my second visit, but every visit! This is huge for me! The worship team is amazing, though a bit too loud for such a small sanctuary. The church is small, which has it's pros and cons but I believe it's one that can and will make a huge impact on the community! Pastor Kevin is very friendly and so far has given biblically sound and uplifting messages! Hi! I'm a community member in Old Colorado City and just want to give a big appreciation to this warm, welcoming church. I was genuinely taken aback by how community-centered this church is, offering its space for community use and activities on a regular basis. What a cool and beautiful thing! What a cool church!  We love the people here!  So kind and welcoming! I went with a friend that donates to this non profit!

name: Acts A Church the Studies - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: I attended there when I lived in Santa Monica years ago. Pastor Joe is an excellent preacher, and the people are super friendly. Their worship style is I know pleasing to the Lord.

name: ACTS Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a former friend pioneering pastor in the area. Since the advent of the Internet, I lost contacts with him and his family. First met him back in 1996 while he was just starting a new church. Lost all records and even pictures. Forgot his name, but he would probably remember me as Benjo Lee (having been with YWAM for many years). I was on my way back to Iraq during our time together in Brooklyn. Perhaps some of you would know him in case he is still around. - Vibrant Music
- Practical Teachings

- Food Pantry
- Shower program for the homeless
- Child-Friendly
- ACC Kidz
- Bilingual (Spanish/English)
