The pastoral team is very caring, relational, and down-to-earth. They will walk with you in your journey and love you unconditionally. They are also teachable and humble. They truly love God and people.

This church’s vision has four key components:
1. Know God
2. Find Freedom
3. Discover Purpose
4. Make A Difference

Free Coffee every Sunday!
A Hot meal once per month! Iron sharpens iron here at Acts Church, You are never alone. I've been in this church most of my life and honestly I love this place. I love  the people, I love the worship, I love  pastors!! This is where relationships are made!! I love ACTS Christian Church. Its a place that when ever you go you always feel like family. The love in this place is over flowing! Hallelujah!

name: Acts Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Great church congregation located in the industrial area off San Fernando Road & 134 Frwy. Pastor McGovern ministers the youthful members with the spirit & power of the Holy Ghost.  The true Apostolic message on Acts 2:38 is preached. I’m so bless to be part of this amazing group of brothers and sisters. Very great full for our Pastor David McGovern and his beautiful wife sister Monique!!! Greatest church in the Glendale area. A have to visit service. Powerful, Dynamic preaching, and a place where Miracles happen. Absolutely powerful and amazing church! So blessed to be a member! Great place to go to church, especially as someone new to faith.

name: Acts Church - Waco Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice enjoyable place to be. Sunday was my first time there and I loved it. I went with my daughter and  two grandkids. I will be back. God bless Great church. Great people. Very laid back. People just seem to genuinely want to be a part of each other's lives. Loving & Welcoming to all ❤️, a one of a kind church that truly cares 💕 The people are so loving and caring. My Daughter and Son-in-law are quite involved there and they love it. I'm growing to love it as well. They are non-denominational and they are not pushy. If you want to serve then there's opportunity to serve if you don't want to serve  then don't. We absolutely love Acts church. We were looking for a spirit led, family friendly community of people and that’s exactly what we found at Acts. We found Acts from going to the park originally and there were a community of women there with their kids that welcomed me and my kids to join them and seeing them live out the Christian walk outside of the church was amazing to witness. Since going, we have been able to see God working in each person and in each ministry. The kids ministry and youth ministry have been fundamental in my families lives. Cannot wait to see and witness what God has in store for this church and the community around them

name: Acworth Christian Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary: Have been members since 1991 when my wife , daughter & i moved here we visited another church for few weeks & then came to ACC & haven't been anywhere else since. We were welcomed & loved the minute we walked in. Never wanted to go anywhere else A historic church worthy of a snapshot.

name: AcZion Community Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a friendly, family environment, this is the right place. If you're in need to know what God has planned for you, this is the right place. Stop by, we'll receive you with open arms. A blessing being in a congregation were the word of God is preached. Finding a church that truly feels like home was something I had always prayed for, and I’m so thankful I found it here at Aczion Community Church. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with genuine kindness everyone is so intentional by saying “Hi” and even learning my name by the next Sunday I came to church! I felt like part of a family since the first day.

One of my favorite parts is the young adult group. It’s a place where you can build meaningful friendships, grow in your faith, and do life with people who genuinely care about you. The church also offers so many opportunities to connect outside of Sunday services, including home groups, hiking trips,  and other fun activities that make it easy to build community and friendships!

The messages are biblical, encouraging, and always point you back to Jesus. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, serve others, and find community, I can’t recommend this church enough. It truly feels like home. If you made it this far I really hope to see you on Sunday! This church is a unique experience where I've witnessed God so profoundly. It's where I awakened and took action in my life. I love the worship and how the pastor combines logic, spiritual wisdom, world news, and mental health in his sermons and teachings. I highly recommend this church. It has greatly helped me in my faith and in making changes in my life for my well-being. A few months ago, I discovered this wonderful family of faith, and I couldn't be happier to have met such special people. I felt welcomed among them and experienced a great sense of closeness from all the members and pastors. I recommend this place to anyone seeking an encounter with God and looking for a faith family where they can feel a sense of belonging.

name: Adobe Christian Church - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary: One of the most warm and welcoming churches I’ve experienced. Happy to call it my church home. Small but inviting .Good people, putting out a good message.

name: Adventure Church, Draper UT
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for about 7 months and I have felt at home. Their number one focus is God our Lord and savior Jesus and they really care about each person that enters their door. The love of God is felt and the messages are wonderful.  I would recommend this church to anyone looking for a church to call home. If you’re looking for the presence of the Holy Spirit and want to be in community to serve you have found the right church. My husband and I look forward to growing spiritually and serving in this church. I can't say enough good things about this incredible church. From the moment I walked in, I feel welcomed and accepted, no matter my background or where I’m coming from. The atmosphere is filled with positive energy and genuine kindness. The Christian rock music is uplifting and powerful, making each service an unforgettable experience. The messages are inspiring, rooted in love, and truly make you feel like part of a caring community. This church practices what it preaches—non-judgmental, inclusive, and overflowing with positivity. It's a beacon of hope and joy in my life. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a faith community that embraces everyone with open arms. ✨🎸🙏 If you are uncertain about life, faith, future, etc. Looking for a down to earth life experience. This is the place for you! It's very welcoming for EVERYONE and ANYONE! ZERO JUDGMENT! You feel right at home. Amazing atmosphere! The way I like to put it is, "It's just YOU, Jesus, and the Bible!" The sermons are  straight from the BIBLE! With real-life experiences! Amazing music! You feel it in your soul!! It hits straight to the heart! Awesome for kids of all ages. I have been attending since June of 2010.

Through the many recent and highly challenging trials of my life, the people of the Adventure have been an anchor for my family. The love they share as family is amazing and I am eternally thankful for their love and true friendship.

If you need the love of a family that truly cares for and about you, you should visit and see for yourself.

This is a casual, come as you are, church that actively praises God through amazing music and a message you can use and apply in your everyday life!

I love this place! Wonderful connection with people. Fabulous worship team and pastors.

name: Agape Christian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s very good to come here I am Hispanic, this week I attend twice this beautiful church..., it is celestial. Great people in the Spirit, welcoming loving attitude, the Joy Of The Lord is flowing in a reverent but high celebration of His Presence. God honors all of it and the romance of Christ and his bride is tangible.
Seven Stars, not four, I mistakenly put 4 stars. Everyone is so kind and loving.   This is a wonderful church that shares the truth of God Good church The place where filled with true love.

name: Agape Christian Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent Christian Church agape church hablo espanol. Food pantry food drive, Saturday Sunday cooking line. Off 25th and California downtown . Denver Colorado. If you are a family in need please come here. Pastor Bob,and Wife,good people .I am blessed to have them as friends.I'm a member,who has moved to salt lake.I still keep up with their posts online,they were there for me when I lived there.they're in my heart,on my mind.I can't ever forget how they welcomed me day 1.I love them with all my heart,I Pray for them;God Bless Pastor Dre,  is truly a God fearing man , he preach bible scripture not his interpretation of what of what the word of God says, and that's what I look for in God's shepherds. 🙏
They also have one of the better food banks in the city.😊 Remnant Rising held an event giving backpacks and school supplies to kids in need!! Such a great thing to do and I am so appreciative for all with Remnant. Agape was nice enough to partner with Remnant to have the event at their church, however their staff were the complete opposite and being there we learned they were no where near nice. They were rude, and disrespectful to the volunteers of Remnant. At the end of the event, while assisting to clean up, a volunteer was getting 1 last backpack for someone in need and the pastor slammed the door in the volunteers face making him walk around the entire church with a back brace from a broken back. I will never again attend anything with this church, we will never host anything with this church, and have no interest in dealing with anyone at this church again because of how they treated everyone who volunteered and attended. Definitely not working in a way God would want. Went to their food bank,great people ,made the experience pleasurable.you can feel the fellowship,and joy.loved it.

name: Agape Christian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Agape has such a diverse congregation with people of all cultures and ages. It's amazing to see the unity within, and the community come together. I personally am very grateful for Agape, specifically towards how the people and pastors have changed my life because of their message about God. You can feel the Spirit here, working in this place. A great community of people who love God! Growing and sharing in His Word!

I met this church family 13 years ago and since then I have been impacted in the most blessed ways! I have found friends, family and God. Thank you Agape for being welcoming to me and so many. I pray we can continue to grow in our understanding of what love means and share His love with others. If you are looking for a diverse, all age and intimate worship church in Pasadena, Agape Christian Church is the place to go on Sunday morning. I enjoy the fellowship they have after church. It is a wonderful small church where you feel welcomed and loved. Love this church. It is warm, friendly, Bible based, filled with Grace and so welcoming, wherever you are in your walk with God. Agape is love and it pours love into others. I cannot think of going to any other church. PANTS donkey_!

name: Agape Christian Worship Center - Albany Campus
reviewSummary:
Joined this church 2017. I have grown so much spiritually, emotionally, and physically 🙏🏼 Here !! I love the non traditional  atmosphere and energy… you feel grace from the time you touch the parking lot. def a free flowing church that provides a space that helps enhances your worship, fellowship, and relationship with the lord 🙌🏼 Highly recommend This a great place to grow as you learn about our Lord and Savior.
The leaders, Apostle and Dr. Odom, are outstanding and they will demonstrate the Love of Christ to you. Can on by for a visit and praise the Lord with us. God Bless This is the church you want to be apart of! There are no clicks or crews. They treat everybody like somebody. They preach practical messages to help you change your life not just to feel good in the moment. You can feel and see the love here! Being apart of Agape has changed my life in so many ways for the better. Seeing the genuine love of Christ demonstrated among the body is beautiful, encouraging and uplifting. Agape Christian Worship Center is where the heart of the people is to help one another journey through a Christ filled life together. The place where I receive my spiritual nurturing and growth with joy. A place where you’re part of a family. This is an awesome place of worship. A place with sound biblical teaching.  Services are engaging, great youth program, and loving atmosphere. A safe and secure environment to worship in.

name: Agape Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for true fellowship, and Christ centered love, look no more, because you found it! Agape Church it is your place to call it home. Here you'll be surrounded by brothers and sisters that will pour their love for Christ over you and your family.  Come, and see it for yourself; Sundays service 10:00am-12:00pm ; 6:00pm-8:00pm
Tuesday, Youth night  7:00pm -9:00pm
Wednesday prayers 7:00pm- 9:00pm/ Awana 6:30pm-7:30pm. The best church around!
Quality people and most importantly quality teaching and worship! Christmas Concert 2018 was wonderful. Excellent and professional, not to be missed. You get a feeling of the real Christmas, church who celebrate and honors the birth of Jesus Christ our Savior. People are so friendly and welcoming to everyone. My wife and I went to see the "What Child is This?" musical; we were pleasantly surprised by the loving, friendly, caring people who greeted and welcomed us, ushered us inside the sanctuary and over to the reception area for cake and coffee after the event.

The musical was top-notch, very well coordinated, and very entertaining. While about half of it was in Romanian, which we don't understand, they offered headsets for translation. They also had audience participation, the kind you 'want' to take part in.

Pastor Crini's 4-point message was short and applied directly to the theme of the musical:  "What Child is This?" And he used the exact right number of PowerPoint slides with applicable verses and bullet points.

Thinking about going? Don't think, just go; you'll be glad you did...We were! Good location, great assembly of well intentioned people who sincerely  seek the Lord in a good fellowship. While it has some Romanian roots, English is taking over more and more.

name: Agape Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: I haven’t been in many years went with my parents years ago. The new church after the tornado was so beautiful the praise and worship really move my heart. I would recommend it to anyone, love their support for Israel and all God‘s doing for his Jewish people as well as us who believe in Jesus, the Messiah. I've been here on and off for two decades (moved away for a few years), and this is now an incredibly spirit filled church! The pastoral staff very much care about their congregation, and it shows. My family is proud to call Agape our home church! Love this church and the staff.  My husband and I have been attending for over 6 years now and we love it.  We are learning a lot about our Hebraic and jewish roots.  (After all, Jesus was jewish!!!!!!)  Our pastor - Dr Scott Stewart and his lovely wife really do care about the people and our city and state.  Praise and worship is awesome!  I promise that you will feel like your home when you step into our building! We like to attend church whilst on holiday. This church campus was inspiring.they obviously do a lot in and for the wider community. Large car parks. Minibuses used to bring people to the church. A very warm genuine welcome especially when we said we were from the UK. the service it self was lovely. Orderly. The music band was good. The pastor's wife was the speaker as it was mothering Sunday.  Her talk was measured, challenging and knowledgeable. Based on the Song of Solomon. A nice experience. This is not just a church...it is a family, comprised of all different races, ages, ethnicities, and social/economic backgrounds.  Outside of the word that comes forth (which is amazing)...the praise and worship (which is amazing)...the youth and children's department (which is amazing).....at the end of the day, it is a group of people who are on a journey to be more like Jesus.  I love Agape!

name: Agape Hilliard - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary: I started going to Agape Hilliard in 2022 after visiting many churches and my family and I immediately felt welcomed. The leadership team are genuine and authentic. I encourage you to stop by one Sunday at 10am for the free continental breakfast and fellowship and stay for the praise & worship and teaching. They also have an adult discipleship class at 9:30am. If you are like me and like to scope things out you can get a sneak preview online as they livestream and record every service. I love going back and rewatching or listening to that week's message. If you come visit I would love to say hi. I am the one in the wheelchair ;) I hope to see you there. God bless you!!! I want to thank Shape Hilliard for providing an amazing opportunity to celebrate independence day. The love and generosity they provided to the community tonight was to be honest heartwarming to experience. Agape Community Fellowship is a great place to come as you are and be loved as you are. It's a very welcoming place, strong on fellowship. They have a lot of great kid programs on Sundays and community events throughout the year. There are great sermons and adult discipleship classes to attend. Two services are held Sunday mornings, one at 9 am and the second at 10:30am. I belonged years ago and have since moved. Even tho most everyone I knew has also moved to either start a new church ( multiply as the good word commands) or are older and watch online, I'm still welcomed back and faithfully prayed over any year or crisis I make contact. These are children of the one true king! They share the heart of GOD always and blessing be upon them all to continue! I love Agape Church. They make everyone welcome.  You can come as you are.  My mom visits a couple times a year from out of town and she has always felt welcome. The kids club staff and kids are amazing too!

name: Agape Life Church - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary: I came to this church with my son and his wife. I always felt like I was missing something with God. I found it here at Agape and so much more. I know God so much better, I do bible study, I help the community and am so happy because I belong here and always will. It's an awesome family and I love learning about God and how to have him iny heart, mind and soul. I enjoy bringing others for a visit to the church because they too feel so welcomed here. God bless pastor Jan and Rich for helping all of us in getting closer to God and understanding his teachings. Not only is Agape friendly, but they use a lot of scripture when preaching and have engaging worship. The pastors actually talk to everyone. This is a loving  church with friendly / loving people who love The Lord Jesus Christ and tell/ show you in Gods Word how to have a personal relationship with God/ and live by Gods word that Gid desires for are life!! The worship music is so touching / heartfelt it touches you to the very core of yr soul and the Preaching is so powerful that it touches you to the very core of yr being mind / body/soul and spirit and you can always feel the love and presence of God here, the minute you walk thru the doors , many times Gods live and presence brings tears to yr eyes and you can feel God doing something beautiful in you because you are so overwhelmed by Gods love, goodness and his presence. Many time I have talked to God in prayer, not knowing what to do about a  certain situation and The Holy Spirit always showed me what to do and he let me know that God|Jesus/Holy Spirit was rt there with me even when my heart was aching/ breaking or didn’t know what to do and even in the happy and good times in my life because Jesus never changes, God is the same yesterday today and forever snd he will never let you down , he is forever faithful he is yr best friend and a Good Father!! You will never be disappointed with God . To learn What Gods like and what his will/word is for yr life this us the church where you can learn and can grow !!  I love spiritual mom Pastors Jan and the pastors / people of the church/ Pastor Rich a spiritual dad And my husband and others who have gone home to be with Jesus!! This is a place you can call home!! Jesus loves you so very much and so do I! Jesus is Lord!! Come and see and taste the goodness of The Lord! Love Rhonda. You won’t be sorry/ let down!!  I been going here for about 19 yrs  appt. I've been going to Agape Life church for over 20 years and have felt at home and comfortable with the congregation.   It is a very loving and welcoming church.  Pastor Jan speaks from the word of God and I feel we are a very bible oriented,  Holy Spirit led church. Agape Life Church has been a part of my life since I was a child. It is an amazingly friendly church with excellence, kids, ministry youth, ministry, adult ministry.  Pastor Rich and Jan Houston are so amazing to follow in your relationship with Jesus. If you are looking for a church home, that has excellent worship amazing Bible-based teaching look no farther. I would recommend this church to any believer, looking for a nondenominational non-religious Jesus based church.  I cannot say enough about the people that attend that make this church a family and not just a building to hold services in.

name: Aguilas Centro Familiar Cristiano Richmond - Richmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I personally love this ministry. This has been one of the very few places in where I felt like I belong. This is a grate place to worship God. I have been in this ministry since 2011. Honestly the best years of my life. I have made sooo many new friends and so many great people that have been there to help me through tough times. I am proud to call Pastor Oscar y Zorayda Chavez my pastors. They have helped my family through sooo much. They prayed and visited a fellow family member that was in critical health. He got better and was declared a miracle. I honestly love them for everything. My life has never been the same since I’ve came to this church.

I have only been in this church for 2 years and have found myself calling this place my home.
I have encountered God and have developed a relationship with God.

I encourage anybody and everybody to come visit, it’s not the place but the atmosphere. The atmosphere as soon as you walk in is as if you walked into a cloud. It feels like this because the presence of God reigns in this place. If you are looking for a different “type” of church, then you are looking at the right ministry.

With a slogan, “There is a Place For You”, Pastors Oscar and Zorayda Chavez indeed make that a reality. Aguilas CFC Richmond offers a welcoming environment in which the pastors’ dreams are to see every person who enters through the doors grow into a successful person in all aspects of their life (spiritual, familial, social, and financial). Using a relevant biblical discipleship, a hard-working team of leaders, and a passionate congregation, Pastors Oscar and Zorayda are beginning to see the fruit of all of their years of hard work.

Pastors Oscar and Zorayda are some of the most passionate, dedicated, and trusting pastors you will come to meet. They have enormous hearts and have completely surrendered their life to God. They have been used heavily by God to restore the lives of many young people and many marriages.

I started my journey in this ministry broken-hearted, feeling completely alone, and simply living a life that felt purposeless. My relationship with my parents was pretty much hopeless. Pastors Oscar and Zorayda saw the potential within me, and helped me develop into a responsible, young man that was able to create a change in his family. More than that, I now live life knowing I have a purpose and that I can leave my mark on this world. This ministry has offered me an opportunity to develop my leadership skills (leading small youth groups and different group-projects) as well as my talents (acting in various church skits and playing the piano in the worship band).

I know this would not have been possible if not for the friendly and welcoming culture at Aguilas CFC Richmond (Eagles CFC Richmond), and the GENUINE love, care, and guidance that Pastors Oscar and Zorayda provide.

If you want a church that (1) indeed makes a difference, (2) has pastors that genuinely love and care for you, and (3) is truly welcoming to people of all kinds, then Aguilas CFC Richmond is the church for you. This place is awesome.it has helped me and my family go through some hard times .and their service is the best especially for their new people. This is one great place because like their motto says "there is a place for you"

name: Aimwell Missionary Baptist Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: Wow, I'm so impressed that the director of Aimwells Daycare managed to make our experience so utterly delightful with her unprofessional and rude behavior, especially after we were transparent about our child's needs and family setup, only to have her reject our child and then make a comment about the new daycare being black-owned, clearly motivated by her own financial interests, and to top it all off, she shared our personal business with others, because who needs confidentiality when you're dealing with a professional like her? Aimwell Missionary Baptist Church was where I attended as a young girl. My current pastor preached there this past Sunday, and the service was awesome!  The members were very friendly, and so many upgrades have been done to the church. It looks really nice. Been a member at Aimwell Missionary Baptist Church since I was 8 years old...we have always been a bible teaching church with strong religious and praying leaders as well as members...we believe in Christ Jesus and He is the head of our lives....we welcome all who believe and want Christ in their life regardless of race,age,and denomination ..come as u are I Bring My Cup And Fill It With The Spirit While Giving God The Glory and Praise Thankful For All He's Done and Doing In My Life. Get To Know Him Yourself Just Come Meet Me At The Well Aimwell's Learning Tree is one of the best daycares I have ever been to. All four of my children went there and two of them still do. Mrs. Jackson is a very loving and caring person. and she is professional and about her business. and I love that because many daycares I have went to are no where near as professional and this daycare. I would recommend this daycare to anyone.

name: Airport Church of Christ - South San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
While vacationing we were able to stop in for Sunday AM class and services.  They are located about 10 minutes away from the airport.
We were warmly greeted by the members of the congregation upon arriving, even though we had not been there before.
The adult class led by one of the men of the church used scripture and had us keeping the Bible pages open as we studied.
We were greeted by more of the congregation after class, before services.  The services, led by the men of the congregation, consisted of prayers, a capella singing, the Lord's supper and a sermon.
The sermon was surely spiritual 'food for thought' and presented very well by their visiting minister.
After services we were greeted by more of the church family.  It was a true joy to share the morning with them. If you're looking for an unpretentious, super friendly group of non-denominational Christians and a worship service drawn directly from the New Testament, you'll find it here. Bible study starts at 9:30AM every Sunday followed by a worship service from 10:30 - 11:30 and an evening service at 6PM to 7PM. No instruments, no outfits, no incense and no programs - just singing, praying, a sermon and communion. If that's what you're looking for, you'll be glad you came. Recently attended "Ladies Day". My family and I attended this church when we first moved here but soon found that we weren't worthy of their love or attention, the only 4 people that spoke to us were the ushers and door greeter's and mind you, we attended for maybe 7 or 8 months both Sundays and Wednesdays. I don't know if it is because my husband is covered in tattoos or if we're too brown for them. The only reason we continued going was because the praise and worship was amazing and to HEAR the word. The last straw was when the pastor brought in the assistant pastor and told the congregation that if they didn't like the fact of him bringing him into the church that they can just never come back, a pastor is supposed to lead his flock to the Lord NOT kick them to the curb because they don't like something. It wasn't because of the assistant pastor but because of what the pastor said and how he said it. It really upset my husband and we haven't been back since. If you want to find a church that welcomes you and HELPS you with anything you may need, I would recommend our new church TOWN EAST BAPTIST CHURCH, if you want to be ignored and looked down on by the pastor then go ahead and visit Alamo city church. I was so broken and lost when I came to this church in 2024, I didn’t grow up knowing who Jesus is so I came wanting to know more and came in high so many times and never I did  feel judged by the people greeting me and most of the time one lady would hug me when I smelled very strong of weed, the love they give is definitely the Holy Spirit in them and showing me Jesus in themselves , I got baptized here in 9/1/25 and now I am 1 year and 8 months sober Glory be to Jesus Our Lord and Savior  🙌🏽,  I thank pastor David and Pastor Albert for preaching the Good News  and all the staff who never looked at me differently when I was at my lowest, they all helped me to have my relationship with Jesus and I’m forever grateful to all in this church! ❤️ This church is great for people new to the area and they need a shoulder to lean on. (Posted Review)
I was trying my best to stop Satan from causing me to lose everything my late mother and I owned. I turned to God for help and believed I was reaching out to God's people, but Satan ended up being Alfred Street Church. They became the reason my things were placed in auction, and they showed no concern about the devastation this caused in my life. I made my payments in June and July and was current until the system covered their bounced check and placed me behind for July and August.

This would never have been allowed to occur because another church would have been contacted and helped, had Alfred Street not agreed to pay and who would ever expect a church to lie, break their word or place a homeless person at risk by seeking revenge for his complaints about loneliness, depression and not getting spiritual guidance when mourning ?

In April 2026, I was experiencing one of the darkest periods of my life. I had recently lost my mother, lost the home I had lived in for five years, exhausted my financial resources, and was battling severe depression. My spirit was broken.

I had read that Alfred Street Baptist Church had donated one million dollars to help prevent families from being evicted. Believing I had found a ministry committed to helping people in crisis, I reached out for assistance. My immediate need was to prevent my storage units from going into default. My balance was approximately $1,100 for two storage units that contained virtually everything I owned, including my late mother's belongings.

I was informed that the church would assist with the payment by the first of the month. However, the payment was not made until approximately the 12th, resulting in additional late fees. The payment process involved a church check, my debit card, and additional time for the funds to clear. During this period, my emotional condition continued to deteriorate.

As I struggled with depression and recurring suicidal thoughts, I repeatedly reached out to the church—not simply for financial assistance, but for ministry, prayer, encouragement, and compassion. Rev. Marcia had voluntarily provided her cell phone number, and I called seeking help. I also left voicemail messages and emails for Angela Liggins and Rev. Dr. Howard-John Wesley. I received no response. On Mother's Day, I asked for help. No one responded.

When I was hospitalized, I requested prayer. Again, there was no response. For me, this was painful. I was not only asking for assistance; I was reaching out to people I believed represented Christ. I was asking for ministry, counseling, prayer, and simple human compassion. As the weeks turned into months, the silence became overwhelming.

Nearly three months later, after feeling unable to continue carrying the emotional burden alone, I sent another email specifically requesting ministry and counseling. Once again, I received no response.

Then I received a devastating call from my storage company. I was informed that the payment from Alfred Street Baptist Church had been returned and that my account had accumulated additional late fees and returned-check fees.

I was told my balance had grown to approximately $2,300 and that my property—including my late mother's possessions—was scheduled for auction unless the balance was immediately paid. I was about to lose everything my mother and I had left.

Desperate, I contacted 7 On Your Side News to report what had happened. I also called the church's finance director, Solomon Michaels, and left a voicemail from the cell phone number I was given. When he returned my call, he allegedly told me
Nevermind, forget you," and hung up. Shocked, I called back seeking clarification, but my calls were not answered. I absolutely enjoy the Pastors messages and the worship . I’m in Florida and that’s unfortunate because I can not attend in person. I have shared the website with others and encouraged them to watch . I appreciate his encouragement in the word in some troubling times. We need hope and. Direction. God’s word through the Pastors preaching in an amen!  blessing Pastor Wesley! Thank you

reviewSummary:
I went to this church for a couple of months. The congregation is small and meets at the Fountains on the top floor of one of the buildings. The church has been active since 2021. It’s a welcoming community of believers. The worship music is played incredibly soft mostly due to the reflective windows, floors and ceilings. It’s not an ideal place for a church so I hope they soon will find a brick and mortar building. You hardly know they’re playing which is the toughest part of going to this church. I’ve seen them perform online and they are very talented. If you like your worship music played incredibly soft, you’ll love their worship music. From the moment you step into the front door you feel like you’re in the company of a family. The pastor is gifted in his teaching and is easy to listen to. You leave feeling like you’ve learned something and grew a little bit closer in your walk with God. From the moment you walk through the doors at Alinea Church, you can feel that this church is truly special. The people are genuine, loving, and incredibly welcoming—you’re not treated like a visitor, but like family. It’s the kind of place where smiles are real, conversations are meaningful, and you immediately sense that people care about one another.
Pastor Jeremy  is an outstanding spiritual leader. His teaching is biblically grounded, relatable, and Spirit-led. Each message is delivered with humility, wisdom, and a clear heart for God and His people. You leave not only encouraged, but challenged in the best way—to grow deeper in faith and live it out daily.
What truly sets Alinea apart is the community. There is a strong sense of unity, purpose, and love that goes beyond Sunday services. It’s a place where people support each other, pray together, and walk through life together. No matter where you are in your faith journey, you feel welcomed and accepted.
Most importantly, the Holy Spirit is alive and moving here. You can feel God’s presence in worship, in prayer, and in the way people love and serve one another. This church isn’t just a building—it’s a living, breathing example of what it means to be the body of Christ.
If you’re looking for a church that is spiritually rich, deeply welcoming, and led with integrity and heart, Alinea is truly a place where you can grow, belong, and encounter God. 🙏✨ This church has truly become a family for me! My now husband and I started coming over 4 years ago when we moved here for college, and it has been incredible seeing this church grow! Alinea is full of the kindest people I have ever met and my life has been changed by these people! They make it so easy to connect with others and get into serving! God’s presence is so evident here and I wish everyone could experience God’s presence in a loving community like Alinea! Alinea is small but growing.   That means there are plenty of opportunities for community and involvement.  If you are seeking a church and looking to be a part of something new, then you may want  to consider visiting Alinea.  Pastor Jeremy is funny, humble, relatable, and approachable.  His messages are both biblical and relevant.  I am looking forward to seeing God move in this congregation as Alinea continues to grow. My family and I love being a part of this Church. People are very friendly. Pastor preaches from the Bible, and in a way that is relatable. Pastor has a good sense of humor. He makes it easy to follow along. He likes to say things like, "First thing to note is, Letter B, and number next". Our daughter has enjoyed the Children's Ministry. She has so many good things to tell us after Church.  Being a part of Alinea has been such a blessing.

From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with genuine love and warmth. The worship is powerful, heartfelt, and led with humility—it creates space to truly encounter God, not just sing songs. The preaching is Bible-based, bold, and practical, speaking truth while encouraging real spiritual growth and transformation.
What stands out most is the authenticity of the people. This church isn’t about performance or hype; it’s about living out the Word, loving people well, and allowing the Holy Spirit to move freely. There’s a strong sense of community, prayer, and unity, and you can tell this is a place where lives are being changed.
If you’re looking for a church that values God’s presence, sound teaching, and genuine fellowship, this is a place where you can grow, be refreshed, and feel at home. Thank you Alive! Alive Church is more than just a church—it’s a family. Every service is filled with powerful worship and messages that are both inspiring and practical, helping me grow in my faith and daily walk with God. The community here is authentic, loving, and welcoming to everyone, no matter where you’re coming from. The leadership is strong, Spirit-led, and truly cares about people. My life and family have been deeply impacted by being part of Alive Church, and I’m grateful to call this my home church. If you’re searching for a place to grow spiritually and be surrounded by a genuine community, I highly recommend Alive Church. Have you ever walked into a church and the spirit of God met you at the door? That’s what it was like visiting Alive Church for the first time. The presence of God was so full in the atmosphere from the opening prayer, throughout worship and especially in the Word that was delivered. Everyone was so welcoming and made us feel like family. Even as visitors, when Pastors Derek and Susan found out my (then fiancé and I) were engaged, they offered to give us marriage counseling even though we still living in Texas. The time they took out of their busy schedules to ensure we were entering marriage on the right foot meant the world - so much so that we knew we were home. God provided confirmation shortly after and before we knew it, we were driving across the country to move to California and become official members of Alive Church. It has honestly been the second best decision we’ve made, (the first was choosing to fully surrender to God - something we truly hadn’t stepped into until visiting and tuning in to services at Alive regularly). We are so thankful for the extended family God has given us by joining Alive. There’s no place we’d rather be on a Sunday morning. We didn’t just find a community, we found a Christ centered family. *Highly Recommended!*

I've found a home at Alive Church! The community of people so loving and supportive, developing meaningful relationships that go beyond Sunday services.

Praise and worship is uplifting, and creates an atmosphere that allows for one to be free and themselves.

I've been blessed to be a part of this church since 2019, serving alongside amazing people and witnessing God's love and tangible presence in action.

Both Pastor Derek and Pastor Susan’s leadership and teachings are insightful, inspiring, and truly empowering.

If you're seeking a Holy Spirit-filled community, come visit Alive Church where we welcome all with open arms.🤗

name: All Church - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
I just love how the pastors teach . I love watching service because I’m learning about the word verse to verse. The Bible studies , book studies are awesome  if , you want to learn the history  of the Bible All Church is the perfect church. Everyone I’ve met is so kind, caring and loving . I thank God I found a family church. I love Volunteering that gives me an opportunity to meet new people. Amber has been so sweet and caring. I appreciate the opportunity to schedule meetings with one of the pastors Brad. Thank you All church for caring for the families and All who entered the doors of All Church. My goal with all Church is to become a leader and teach believers and non believe to give their lives to Jesus. Even if its leading a Bible study ❤️ thank you so so much All Church ❤️ The experience at AC is quite unique in my mind.  Parking is plentiful and when you enter the church you are greeted, but not accosted.  The lobby gives you choices to socialize, ask questions, or just grab a coffee and find your seat.  During worship, you will find plenty of people singing along so feel free to join in or just listen and enjoy.
The sermons seem, in my opinion, to be very relatable and applicable to today.  This is the reason we are there.  We can take what we hear and actually apply it in our lives. When we first visited ALL Church we had an incredible experience! From the moment we pulled into the parking lot, we were greeted with warm smiles and a genuine sense of community. They had a parking crew directing cars as we were coming in, to help find open spots, etc. The welcoming atmosphere continued as we entered the building, where friendly faces guided and greeted us. The worship service was uplifting, and the message from the pulpit was both inspiring and relatable. We felt truly at home, and we now do call ALL church home.
Highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a bible focused, Jesus centered place of community! I can’t say enough great things about ALL Church! As a young mom, I truly appreciated how welcoming and safe the kids’ area felt. My child had an amazing time, and I loved seeing them engaged and happy. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, which made me feel at ease during the service. It’s wonderful to know my child is in such caring hands. I’m so grateful to have this community for me and my child! My first experience at all church today at the 10:00 service.Loved the sermon.My Grandson and his family go to this church. And today my q5 year old great granddaughter and I went.I think we found our place.We will be back

name: All Hallows Catholic Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: It's a beautiful place to rendez-vous with Jesus Christ. I came here for Sunday mass one day and the words of the priest were so touching! Additionally, I have to say that the community is so welcoming and so warm, they make you feel like they've been seen you here week after week for a lifetime. Chorus sings beautifully, they performed just so professonally, I felt like attending a prime show in a Theater. love All Hallows Catholic church,  I was just visiting from Midland texas to La Jolla,  I attended this church on holy Thursday.  First of all, I have to say thank you to the priest,  his sermon and preaching was on point. The people are welcoming, nice, sweet, the church it self is beautiful, cozy, petty,  tu e architectural structure and design is great and nice. The choirs are superb. I love the church, if you are in that area , go there. The only problem is parking,  so I advice to go early to get a parking spot. But in General,  I will give All Hallows at la Jolla,  a five star. IS a small catholic church, I enjoyed it, i love it, ill definitely come back to worship at All Hallows Catholic church in La Jolla,  San Diego California again. Thanks Amasing place. Especially, holy music and song were very nice. And very kind father. Easter gathering of all religious men and women and diocesan priests of the Diocese of San Diego. This church is such a beautiful location for a wedding or any special occasion.  The staff here is so friendly and welcoming and Father Jerry O'Donnell gives such relatable and poignant homilies.  Highly suggest checking it out!  Full of the Holy Spirit!

name: All Nations Christian Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited ANCC one year ago, and I'm so glad that we did. We love our church and our Pastors. I can't say enough good things about ANCC. Come check us out. You will not be disappointed. I love this place. The first time I arrived, it was welcoming, and I could fell the spirit flushing through me. It is a great place and I have recommended it to many people already. My church is a wonderful place to worship and experience the power of God. Come worship with us! Great church experience!
Great people!
God is good! Great place to worship!

name: All Nations Christian Fellowship - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
The place where all kinds of people are worshipping and learning and fellowshipping together. Truly from many nations. This is a really special place. I’ve been a member since 2004 and I would not want to be anywhere else. I attended a Christmas Eve candlelight service last night [12-23-2018] at All Nations Christian Fellowship. I had had to leave the worship room several times during that service because the music had been too loud. It had been interesting, however, to hear several familiar Christmas hymns played [extremely loudly] by a rock band. The reception following worship had featured many delicious food items and had been extremely crowded.

During the 1950s, I had attended Plymouth Congregational Church [that had dissolved in 1961] in that very same building. My parents who had been married in that building in 1951; later, I had been born and then had attended church school there for the next several years. It had been interesting to be back in that space after so many years.

Christ Church Anglican has been in that building for many years but they are now looking for a new location.

A section of that building has recently been determined to be unsafe for human habitation by the City of Columbus; there are signs prohibiting entry into that section of the building.

One of the participants in last night's Christmas Eve candlelight service had his car broken into during that event. I guess that he had left his backpack visible in the passenger area of his car. Great people! Great sermon! People here are so friendly and try to embrace the international students and people from different countries! Thank you ANCF! This is the most loving and friendly church that I have ever been to. God really shows up at the church during the services and it amazes me every time that I’m there. Love this church. People helping and caring for each other.

name: All Nations Church - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary:
High turn-over, tribalism, lacking of social support in the church. Once you stay long enough, you start to realize it is more like a performative presentation -a show for others rather  than authentic care for new members or people outside of their main Ghana culture..
Meaning: when you are around them enough you realized performance on stage is on point, but they have bad character. :(

The pastors are great thou- First-time visitors are welcomed warmly. The praise and worship team truly set the atmosphere for worship. The senior pastor is a true scholar of the word of God.  I appreciated his teaching style backing up everything with the word of God. I'm not a fan of the no backing up into parking spot policy nor the seemingly lack of flexibility when it comes to seating feeling forced to sit in the middle of a row especially when I attend service early enough to select seating. Will definitely visit again. Come let's worship together. This is the church I have ever been to since I came to this country. All I can say is that our head pastor and his leaders have inspired me to be who I am today. I am very grateful to God for bringing such a church and man of God to our community. Pastor Frank and the Leaders, you are awesome... Such an amazing church to be at! Great community of many people, such uplifting services, and Pastor Frank is one in a million! I am part of the dance team they have and I love the group! Along with the dance team, they have a choir,media, and Sunday school teacher group, and many more!💖🥳😊😁

name: All Nations Church (Inland Campus) - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: God always with ther... The worship and praise are grace-filled, the congregation is kind, and the lunch is delicious. The church garden is spacious with many trees and beautiful flowers in bloom, and a large mountain stands to the north like a folding screen.

name: All Nations Fellowship Assemblies of God - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: If you don't have a church in the NOLA area...come check out All Nations Fellowship! The people are down to earth, and you will feel right at home! Please come and check it out. This may be the kind of place you've been looking for! I love this church. The messages from God's word are on target & relevant to reach out & bring people to the Shepherd of our souls. The worship is genuine & from the heart.  You can feel then presence of the Lord & the person of the Holy Spirit here. I am limited physically so I am grateful to the Lord to have found this online church & join in their worship services & rich teaching on the word of God. God is so faithful to feed His sheep.💗 Thank You Jesus Pastor Justus Freeman is intelligent and spiritual. He is doing a fantastic job discipling the people. The church building itself is amazing. It has a feeling of holiness and awe about it. This is a great place to develop relationships and grow in your faith. It's a great place to worship the atmosphere is great Pastor Anthony and staff are awesome I can say a lot more but don't have space so if you're looking for a church home try All Nations Fellowship you will be glad you did. 😊 Like the people at this Church. They are vary friendly. I can count on them if I need anything.

name: All Nations Old Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
We baptized my daughter in this church 10+ years ago and her quinceañera ceremony was also here about 3 years.
Both ceremonies were amazing, personalized, and I really felt the faith within myself
I am planning on baptizing my new baby there as well.
I wouldn’t change a thing about any of them.
At the end of the day, it’s about believing in God and being a good person while here on earth. Thank you Father Tom and thank you Old Nations Catholic Church! To those that think that the Sacrament of Baptism is not valid. A Sacrament of baptism only requires two things to be valid. 1. Water must be used and the water may be poured on the head or  the person may be immersed.  That is what baptism means  2. The person baptizing must use the Trinitarian formula. I baptize you in the name of the Father  and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.  Usually the person baptizing is a priest or deacon but it can also be a nurse in a hospital. The person baptizing doesn't even have to be Catholic as long as the water and Trinitarian formula are used . A valid baptism must be respected and the person should never be re baptized. A valid baptism has to be respected in every Catholic Church . If it isn't then complain to the diocese. Praise God fir churches like these. They are a haven for parishioners who were a step away from leaving the Catholic church. They are a safety net. Many have gone to protestant churches because they were ignored or did not feel welcomed in a Roman Catholic church. Love this church,  it may be small but it’s about the message you get while attending. Thanks be to God. It was the most beautiful service. They made it so special and we are so blessed we found this church. We baptized our two sons at this church, great and awesome experience. My first son was baptized 7 years ago my second son 5 years ago and now we are returning for the 3rd time to baptize our youngest! We wouldn’t be going there or recommending family members if we did not have good experiences! Highly recommend for baptisms.

name: All of Grace Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Expository preaching! From day one at All of Grace, we got Biblically sound clarity and perspectives on God, life, death, sin, meaning, morality, Christ and eternity. But, it was their love for one another and for us that stood out like a sore thumb. It was equally unusual to us when we saw Pastor Chan one night sweeping the floors after dinner. By the way, they serve lunch and dinner for the entire congregation every Lord’s Day. It’s a plus for those with kids. Not to mention that their youth group is the best. Our kids have never desired to attend church until this church. They truly model themselves after the church in the book of Acts. Every Sunday was a day spent with God’s family in God’s house. There were days that we even lost track of time. Seriously. It was sad to go home. And all of our time there was always spent centered around edifying one another through the word, brotherly love and in prayer. We grew so fast here in so many ways and so fondly at the same time of everyone at All of Grace. Whether we were evangelizing, congregating, practicing the one another’s etc., it was always a taste of heaven on earth with them. They have your back. No matter where you’re at in your walk, or life. It was here that my wife and I came to understand  what it means to be a true follower of Jesus Christ. Amazing place.

name: All Peoples Community Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: A church that really loves and cares for its community. Our family has been attending for several years and loves the kind community and its bible centered teaching. We feel at home at APCC. From Sunday morning worship, to wonderful kids ministry for our little ones. The diversity has always drawn us in — we love that Heaven won’t have everyone who looks the same and neither does our church. Would highly recommend this church for anyone looking to strengthen or begin their relationship with Jesus. We started going here 4 years ago and were initially drawn to the diversity of the church. But we've stayed for the caring, warm and patient people of the church. Tons of families right in our life stage so it's so fun to do life together. My husband and I just graduated and moved to the area from Kansas. When looking for churches we decided to try out APCC and wow! God truly blessed us newbies with such an amazing community that truly cares about all people whether they have been at the church for a long time or are brand new. We love that the atmosphere is welcoming to all and you can feel God's love in the room everytime we meet together💕 Love to have been coming here with my family for the past 5+ years.  APCC is so welcoming and makes it easy to get connected with others in the church.  I also love their intentionality to love on the neighborhoods around the school where we meet.

name: All Saints Anglican Cathedral - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great little big church. This church looks like something you would see back East in Vermont or someplace. Its so mom and pop, with great charm.
The members are friendly, and very welcoming. The music is wonderful along with the services.
If your looking for that church that makes you feel at home, this is the place.
The Christmas service is wonderful as well. A great church to start a tradition to spend Christmas and celebrate the season of our Lord and Saviors birth. Family friendly. All ages. Focus is on substance, which I appreciate so very much. Such a friendly place. Welcomed us like family. Handles money extremely well, keeps details records and makes them readily available. The church is very connected to the community. Love this place. Beautiful church and good people here. I enjoyed and have met the bishop! Very nice. Good experience. Great service and very friendly people. The pastor is down to earth and made an effort to get to know us as new people. Also a beautiful old building in a great Long Beach neighborhood. They also provide a hot meal for the homeless and providing food available the church will provide 2nd on the food. Keep in mind this only happens every third Saturday of the month. They start at 11:00 am

reviewSummary: Mass was very moving and to be able to receive the Holy Eucharist blessed me tremendously since I am 3,000 miles from my home church.   If you are in search of a traditional Anglican parish, I encourage you to visit.  I felt Christ's love amongst the parishioners and clergy. Such an amazing place Excellent

name: All Saints Community Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
Church service is every Sunday at 10:30am
ASCC is a beautiful church full of friendly, kind, welcoming people with great leadership and great worship. There are lots of ways to get involved and grow in your personal relationship with Jesus Christ. We have been attending All Saints Community Church for about a year now. I have connected with a couple of the activity groups: playing soccer and going on a backpacking trip. We live in South OKC and most of the other groups are centered in Edmond, so it is hard to get up there throughout the week. I'm just getting started volunteering with the visuals team for Sunday mornings.

The worship music is wonderful, led by various musicians and singers who all have great skill and a heart for connecting with God through music. The teaching is good, typically walking through Scripture verse by verse to unpack the depth and meaning of each passage. Occasionally, it will switch into preaching where you see the passion of the speaker behind the message.

The people are genuine, diverse, welcoming, and kind. It is a treat to see the Kingdom of God on Earth through them all. My husband and I have attended All Saints Community Church for the past year-and-half. We felt so welcomed and quickly connected with other believers who were tender-hearted, uplifting, and true in their walk with Christ. This church is full of people who deeply love God and love others selflessly! We’ve never been a part of a church community that does such a great job in doing all things it takes to be considered when choosing a church home.
Friendly, caring people; wonderful Word/Spirit balance, uplifting praise & worship, and tons of opportunities to on-ramp into serving, ministry & getting involved in a small group of like-minded believers.
This is our family ! ASCC is such a welcoming place. We felt at home from the first visit. Great Biblical teaching and plenty of space for the Holy Spirit to move. The kids team is amazing and almost everyone who attends serves in some capacity. What a beautiful group of people who clearly love the Lord!

name: All Saints Episcopal Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I attend 2pm service on Sundays 2x a month. Some of the members are nice while others still need Jesus. The Pastor and his wife are very welcoming and always look forward too seeing new faces.  Dinner fellowship in the dining room after Sunday Service.  In by 2 home by 4 😇 I haven't been to church in a long time. I grew up Catholic and honestly I don't know much about the episcopal/anglican church but it definitely felt progressive and I like that.

Too many churches and religions are hypocritical and I'll rather go somewhere that's accepting of people regardless of their background.

That's the most important thing Not professional Staff the Manager is  rude ever trying to make a party at that church I recommend not to When you"re told by the head of the church that you don't come to church enough to participate, You just stop going (2P Srvc) . name: All Saints Episcopal Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
All Saints Episcopal church both boasts beautiful gothic revival architecture—some of the nicest in LA county—and one of the most inclusive parishes and communities in Southern California. If you are looking for a church that walks the walk on LGBTQ+, immigration, racial, and religious inclusivity, this is the place for you. On Christmas and Easter, the church invites guest speakers of different faiths to read excerpts from their religious texts that relate to the Christian account of Jesus, creating a truly inclusive celebration of God’s love and the miracle of Christ. I cannot overstate this church’s commitment to spreading the love of God to the tightly interwoven and beyond friendly and inclusive community it creates. All Saints Church, I learned recently, is on the more progressive side of the spectrum in terms of churches. But I'm here mostly to comment on the amazing architecture. It has a Gothic Revival style, the building got completed around 1924, so it's been around for 100 years or so. The stained glass, internal structure, walls and everything else about it gives this place such a solemn, calm vibe. It's incredible to just randomly walk around in Pasadena and enter it like a lost tourist in a new city. Beautiful Architecture!!!
This review is not about the congregation nor its liturgy, but about the architecture. I was here for the Pasadena Symphony Holiday Candlelight performance. Even if you’re not religious, I’d recommend stopping by to admire the place have a moment of silence and if possible, offer a prayer. From what’s posted around, everyone is welcome! Beautiful service, beautiful people… inclusive and non judgmental place to go where you’ll be received with open arms and open hearts. Their sermons are phenomenal! Sometimes, they invite scholars from other churches to join their sermons, I always look forward to those as well! I promise you will be moved both spiritually and intellectually! I grew up in the church, and I have never felt more loved and welcomed as I do in this church! I feel this is what god intended a church and religion to be! A beautiful church! I was there for a Christmas concert and the vibe and performance were amazing. Highly recommended for a visit or an event.

name: All Saints Episcopal Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This church and its clergy have shown me that it's possible to be embraced by a community from day one. If you believe in experiencing church through deep, meaningful thought and loving embrace, try this one out. if i could give 0 stars i would. the pastor was super rude and wouldn’t listen to a single word we said. we wanted to have a conversation with her but she shut it down and laughed in our faces. she was very unwelcoming and mean. do NOT come here. you will get a warped view of the christian church. We were referred to All Saints, and couldn't be happier. We've found our spiritual home.... This is the kind of place that gives churches a good name. Friendly church. Good preaching. Great community outreach. Good Sunday School.

name: All Saints Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Peaceful, spiritual … a warm and welcoming church home A destination church for anyone looking for a reverent prayerful experience filled with sacramental music and a warm,  welcoming congregation. Takes you back in time and makes you feel comforted and welcomed! Love their Sunday service. Very traditional but carefully conducted. The church’s rector has a nice way of being brief, to the point, and inspiring. Sang in concert.  Very friendly.  Need more chairs.

name: All Saints Presbyterian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: All Saints OPC is such a breath of fresh air. The church has a welcoming atmosphere that makes it easy to feel both comfortable and focused on worship. From the moment I arrived, people were friendly without being overwhelming, creating a sense of community that felt sincere rather than forced. The service itself was thoughtful and deeply rooted in Scripture. The preaching was clear, engaging, and theologically rich, offering both insight and practical application. It was evident that there is a strong emphasis on teaching and understanding the Bible, which I appreciated. The strong reformed values and preaching is so encouraging. I don't live in North County, but this church is worth the drive. Overall, All Saints OPC stands out as a church committed to faithful teaching, meaningful worship, and authentic community. It’s a place where people seeking a deeper understanding of their faith and a grounded, Scripture-centered experience will feel at home. 10/10 would recommend! My family has been part of this church since its inception. Very blessed to be part of a Reformed, North County Coastal church that preaches gospel-centered messages, holds high regard for the sacraments, and is Biblical in its philosophy and design. Having three young kids, it’s important to my wife and I that they witness and experience gospel-centered liturgy before spending time learning in Sunday School with their peers. At this moment, All Saints Presbyterian Church is considered a church plant.  By nature, church plants are small in nature.  What is exciting about All Saints?  All Saints' pastor and congregation.  The pastor brings 5-6 years experience of pastoring.  He faithful preaches the word of God.  He has a desire for the congregation to grew in Christ. The congregation is warm and friendly.  When I first started attending, I did not know how would receive me.  They received me by having sincere conversation.  Finally, there is space to turn your faith into action by serving.  My wife and I enjoy weekly adding a small non-monetary contribution, and the congregation appears to appreciate it. If you are looking for a church that faithfully preaches the word of God with an encouraging congregation, then I recommend All Saints. The search for a traditional church grounded in Reformed values was a challenge until I found All Saints. The gospel is taken seriously, the congregation members (from young families to elder leaders) support each other and I believe the Lord is building something long lasting here.

reviewSummary:
saw amazing parishioners today walking in the parade. I see that many churches have chosen a more progressive direction, but those seeking a congregation that adheres to Christian teachings should be aware of where this church stands. Of course we are all sinners in need of a savior, our Lord Jesus Christ but promoting sin is not what church is about.
For Christians looking for a church grounded in traditional biblical doctrine, this is not the right fit. Feeling blessed to be part on this Choral eucharist and pageant, On the eve of the nativity of Our Lord Jesus Christ.
Merry Christmas and God Bless Y'all! The people were very friendly and welcoming.  Sign-ups were being taken for a number of small groups meeting on various interests, where it would be easier to get to know a group of parishioners better.  On Sunday we attended, there was a Ladies Luncheon, with beautiful flowers setting the welcoming tone. (I was sorry I couldn’t stay— previous engagement.) A BBQ for 20s & 30s is planned.  Also available— a beautiful playground for children under 12 with supervision from their parents. 5 stars when I started attending and found a vibrant, loving community. So much has changed. So many people hurt...during a pandemic. May God bring healing and reconciliation.

name: All Souls Anglican - Woodland Hills Campus

reviewSummary: I love two of the priests there. Their talks are very interesting. The church is nice. I'll go soon. Very caring, committed community. Priest is serious but loving, seems highly educated and at least bilingual if not multi. Parking is tough as the entrance is not obvious for newcomers. Metered street parking available. Stairs to rear and sides, difficult for seniors and disabled. Not sure where to find handicapped entrance. Church very cold even with multiple layers, hat, gloves, down parka. Dress accordingly. Was warmer outside despite windy winter day. Not a comfortable church. So cold it was a distraction for worship. Bilingual mass was great but canned music and videos a huge bummer and distraction. The fact that they spent so much money on AV equipment when they could hire live musicians is sad. The abrupt, clueless way they cut songs in awkward places ruined the flow, focus and sense of reverent worship. Clearly this is a smart group if they have nice, modern equipment but they have to learn to use it in a more graceful way to support the Divine Liturgy. Music is the Handmaid of the Liturgy. It is not meant to distract. It should be live so as to adjust in an immediate and sensitive manner. Very ugly architecture, not an aesthetic or pleasing experience. There was literally nothing one could focus on for beauty, elevating one's thoughts or moving to a higher spiritual plane. Worship was brutal and hard work that day but the gratitude for the Mass and Sacraments overcame the sacrifices. The wonderful people who were so reverent, pious, friendly and quiet made up for this. The low gluten host is available but one must arrive 15 minutes early to alert the priest and sacristan and Extraordinary Ministers of the Eucharist. Great church very beautiful. You can feel the history. I love the church but they had no one to translate English so I didn't know a word of what the priest was saying but I was raised in catholic church so I knew what to do . Beautiful church!! Dress in layers, it is very very Cold  🥶. Street parking. Don't know if they have private parking.

name: All Souls Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: I've had the privilege of visiting All Souls Church a few times, and each time has been a blessing. Pastor Harvey’s sermons are deeply rooted in Scripture and truly inspiring. This church has such a warm and inviting atmosphere that reflects Christ’s love. Grateful for the impact this church is making in the community! Love this church - its a new community that is welcoming, diverse, and small but mighty! I love the people that I've met through the church - and the leadership is solid. They are Christ-centered and Bible-based which was important to my family. I look forward to attending and getting involved & growing with this community for the foreseeable future! name: All Souls Church Of Boulder - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
I’d been searching for a place that felt more than just a Sunday routine, somewhere that genuinely welcomed everyone. It’s hard to find a church where you don’t feel like just another face in the crowd, especially in a world that often feels disconnected and rushed. Walking into All Souls Church in Boulder changed all of that for me.

From the first moment, I felt an unmistakable warmth—a sense that this was a place where people genuinely cared. The community here is open and welcoming; you’re immediately seen and valued. The messages are deeply thoughtful and rooted in compassion, offering insights that stay with you long after you’ve left.

If you’re looking for a church where you can find authentic connection and a sense of belonging, All Souls is the place. It’s not just a church; it’s a family that reminds you of the beauty of community. After a decade-long break from church, I’ve been attending All Souls in Boulder for years now, and it’s truly a special community. What stands out most to me is its thoughtful leadership, the way decisions are made with care and transparency, and the spirit of openness and curiosity that shapes its life. I’m grateful to be part of a church that invites questions and encourages wonder. All Souls is such a special church community. People truly care about getting to know you, and the services are unique in their style and content. It has been a supportive atmosphere for me as I navigate a new chapter in my faith journey and I’m forever grateful! Come say hello! All Souls is a place of genuine spirituality that has always said "you don't have to believe to belong." Although I don't regularly attend, I have found their events and Sunday services to be so helpful for my own spiritual journey. They seek to serve the Boulder community authentically and bridge the lines that often divide us as humans. I would highly recommend checking it out! All Souls has been a warm, welcoming, supportive community for my husband and I for 6 years now. It's the perfect blend of meaningful Christian tradition and belief, and modern creativity and openness. We're challenged when we need to be challenged, and nurtured when we need to be nurtured.

reviewSummary:
I am  Elliott im 11 years old and I went to dis church since I was 1 it is a W and the teachers are nice This is a wonderful, welcoming church with a lot of events!
