The brunch today was fabulous, and the gift cards we received were such a blessing. Centrally located, acoustically perfect sanctuary.
Nice congregation.
Often offer complex music We love our church home! Every service is Christ centered. The church building is beautiful. The people are so kind and welcoming. Great children’s programs!

name: All Souls Fellowship - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary:
I wish there were more churches like All Souls dotting Atlanta. Leadership here is in line with the Gospel and centered on Christ. I love their facility. I enjoyed my recent worship experience at All Souls. Music was upbeat without being over-the-top or going on for too long. Songs were not familiar, so many people were not singing, but it still felt worshipful.

The sermon was excellent. Thoughts about love in action—as followers of Jesus.

There were lots of young families, who seem to have positive connections with each other—always a healthy sign for a community of believers.

I love that All Souls is actually engaged in ongoing mission outreach in the local community.

A visitors’ table with church info, obvious visitor welcomers, and reserved visitor parking near the doors would have been a nice bonus. We absolutely love this church. Great people, great leadership, great heart for our community. A place for good believers to fall spiritually asleep.

My wife and I left this church feeling fuzzy. It feels like they were about nothing, but had lots of “good vibes.” Not once was the gospel preached in the songs or sermon. There was corporate repentance followed by an assurance of adoption into God’s family, but no idea that maybe forgiveness was because of the Cross.

Even the cross at the front of the church was fuzzy hidden in a collage of images of other things. The sermon was repetitive, but fine. There was truth preached, but you had to know what you were looking for to find it.

I can see why many get stuck at this church, because it is easy and seems not bad. Each of the congregants I spoke to seemed nice. One shared they had previous attended another more vibrant church, but now went here because it was closer and easier.

We were led in singing by a band which was musically pleasant with lots of “good vibes,” but it didn’t feel like worship. Most of the congregation didn’t sing, but just listened to the music. One of the songs that was sung went, “I’m laying down all my religion, I’m laying down, I want to know you, Lord.”

It felt watered down, but watered down what? Many non-Christians have described church to me as “it doesn’t do anything for me” or “I just don’t feel like I need it.” This is how I felt after attending this church. I don’t know if I am for or against it because what even was it?

I have never been to a church that so fully embodied the church of Sardis in Revelation 3. “Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your deeds complete in the sight of my God. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.” I have been attending All Souls for many years. I am so grateful for this church and the community that it provides. This church truly aims to embody what Jesus set forth. All of the staff and ministers are dedicated & caring people.

name: All Souls' Episcopal Church/Bach Collegium San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful Church!  Friendly, thoughtful congregation.  Priest is approachable, very intelligent. His sermons are second to none. Church space itself is beautiful -full of art and light and music. Music program in fact is one of the very best in California.  Be sure and stay for the coffee hour. You wont  want to have lunch later.. and the church seems to really value what they have- and that includes each other and newcomers. This church was built in the 1960's to replace a surplus chapel back in the day. The grounds are quite beautiful and it even has a labyrinth outside that is open to the public to meditate through. The dress code is really lax -- you can dress up or show up in sandals and t-shirt. And if you're not familiar with the liturgy of an Episcopalian church, the nice people at the entrance will hand you a bulletin so you can follow along. Found this place to be really special for my spiritual journey. My wife and I have been attending All Souls' for the last three years. In our time at the church, we have been welcomed by an amazing faith community. Members of All Souls' are both caring and dedicated to serving those in need across San Diego. There are ample opportunities to both volunteer and meet tons of really nice people. I have loved attending All Souls' and would recommend it to anyone looking for a new church. Beautiful venue for recital. Stained glass windows breathtaking. Garden wonderful for receptions. The community of people at All Souls are GREAT!  For me, finding a Church home was all about the community of people; to have other Christians surrounding my husband and I that share our faith-based values. It was also about having the leadership of the Church direct and guide us through the difficult road of life, towards a deeper personal relationship with God. Father Douglas is an excellent leader. And, he preaches practical, timeless, real and vulnerable lessons that seem to apply directly to my life on a weekly basis.  We’ve finally found a spiritual home that fills all our needs for us, and that doesn’t preach politics or pander towards the popular secular opinions of society today.

reviewSummary:

The pastor, Justin, is awesome and the music is great.  The church is doing good and important things to give back to the communities of the Peninsula.  We are so happy to have found this church. Best church that I've been to. Felt really welcomed to the church. They really made me feel like returning to the church family. I highly recommend this church to everyone who feels like they lost their church spirit. I give this church 5+ stars!!!!

#Best Church Ever!!!!

name: Allegheny Center Alliance Church
reviewSummary: I have been attending this Church for the last 2 years and it’s been a great blessing to my life. The people on staff and the congregation have been kind, welcoming, supportive and faithful to the Gospel of Christ. It’s a great Church to connect with Believers of all different backgrounds. Allegheny Center Alliance Church is a quick stop I made during my trip to Pittsburgh this past weekend. At first, I was surprised to see coffee being sold and the pastor discuss being in a strong financial position. However, it is clear that Rev Alan Hannah is genuinely passionate about fostering unity despite differing cultural backgrounds and potential differences in opinion. The choir is uplifting and powerful. This church is amazing.  They are so welcoming.  I have been attending their Faith in Action Business Networking Group.  Thank you for hosting the event each week.  The venue has great seating, a coffee kiosk, and free parking if you are visiting the church site. Great place to have worship. Great Christian Fellowship. Timely services. We were visiting Pittsburgh for the weekend when we found this church just blocks away from our hotel. This church reminds me of my church the way they conduct their service. The music was uplifting. The people were friendly. The message was spot on.

Friendly people to greet you & awesome children's ministry + a place where young people can go & feel "included" immediately! It's the place to be on Sunday mornings. Svce's:  9a. m. name: Allisonville Christian Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: A few different large gathering spaces & very kind folks!

name: Aloha Church | San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: As a Brazilian, I felt very welcomed at Aloha Church in Pacific Beach. The atmosphere is warm, friendly, and full of love. During the summer, services are held outdoors under the trees, which makes the experience even more special. After the service, everyone is invited to a picnic on the grass called “Stay a while”—a lovely opportunity to connect and build community while enjoying delicious food provided by the church! The church also offers small group meetings during the week, called mini-church, which help people grow closer and feel like part of a true family. I love this church; it brings me so much joy! Aloha Church feels like home. I’m so grateful to have found this place during my time in college. I’ve met so many kind people who really care to see me grow in faith. Drew’s preaching is always engaging, funny & life giving. I highly recommend going to Aloha for a Sunday service! Plus there’s always food after, can’t beat that! I’ve been to many different churches through the years. Some were wonderful and others I’d like to forget I ever went to but Aloha Church in San Diego has been my most favorite church experience of my life. It is such a sweet group of genuine people from all walks of life.  It doesn’t feel showy or preachy. Just real honest church community.   The stay awhile portion of the service is so sweet.  We all eat together and hang out on the lawn after the worship service. This makes getting to know people so easy.   I highly recommend!!! Aloha church has been a breath of fresh air. In the summer, they literally meet in the beautiful and shady grassy area at Mission Bay High School (auditorium in the winter). But I’m more refreshed by the pastor’s humble but funny messages that point out God’s true nature. We are not shackled to religious expectations; we are pursuing freedom in Jesus together. The worship is simple, not a production. The goal of the church seems to be relationship with God and with each other. “Come as you are” meets Biblical truth, gently encouraging us into God’s abundant life. Aloha Church is truly a special place! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm smiles and a genuine sense of welcome. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it easy to feel at home. It’s clear that this is a family-oriented church, where people of all ages are valued and included. Whether you’re new to faith or have been walking the path for years, Aloha Church offers a supportive and loving community. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a church that feels like ohana!

name: Alpha Church and Church Omega Church Disciples Church of Church Church Christ Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I love God and the church are my family. Join us to worship I love attending here. Everyone is welcoming and friendly. I’ve grown to find many friendships here. The most important friendship I’ve found through this church is God’s friendship. I continue learning more about god in every service and young adult class. I know that Jesus has lead me here for a reason. I’m so grateful and blessed to be able to attend Alpha and Omega. They have services in both English and Spanish. Classes for children and young adults. Youth services, family services, etc. All are welcome. Come and join all are welcome god bless you all. ☺️ 🙏🏼 I was at an all time low. I was facing being alone on the streets in a rough area. I'll admit I was scared. Those who were helping me,had all been arrested. So I was alone and I needed help. The men of this church had come out to the hood to bring hot dogs and drinks and other items for the homeless and drugs addicts and the neighborhood around 27th Ave and Glenrosa. I approached the men. They were packing up. And we're about to leave. I stood there quietly waiting for them to stop talking so I could say I need help! One of the men (these are Spanish Speaking Christian men). Look at me and said can we help you with something. I was crying and could hardly speak. The traumatic situations in the days before this. I hadn't reacted to all that had happened. It was not good. But here I was with my walker and my bag with blankets and a pillow. My drink bag with water and soda. And tears that wouldn't stop. I tried my best to explain my situation. What was clear was I was a homeless woman, who is disabled and elderly too. And my emotional state allowed these Godly men to huddle and find a solution. Which was usually a card with a 9 to 5 number where no one answers the phone. But to my surprise. The men were happy to inform me that I would be staying at a house owned by a church member. The house is being renovated. And there is a mother and her son living there right now. And so they took me there and gave me a room and a mattress blanket and pillow. I had some things of my own. I cried and cried with joy. That this church and these men and Jesus Christ has gave me hope for the future. And I could rest my mind about living in the streets for now. I accepted being at the house for now. And began my journey to a beautiful new relationship with Jesus Christ. And with my eyes wide open to the kindness and generosity of the church members of this church. I found my home church. And I'm forever grateful for Jesus and the family I've always wanted. Amen God bless us all. Dios los bendiga a todos in El hombre de Jesucristo mi dios. Mi to-do. Amen I hope my personal experience guide more people to this amazing church I have attended to this church for close to a month now and I see it as my home now this place bring me joy, happiness, and so many other emotions. The ppl make you feel so welcome.. the prist and everyone in this church have been an amazing support for my during this learning process for me.. if you want to feel God's present your going the right way by coming here. Best place to worship! Its not church, it's a Family! Sundays 9:30am bilingual service
And 3:30pm spanish and Wednesdays at 7pm!

name: Alpharetta Bible Church - Alpharetta / Milton Campus
reviewSummary:
A truly God centered church.  Everything they do is to lift up Jesus Christ as the King of Kings.  The sermons are amazing and very deep into the text of the word with the rest of scripture in full view and in context.  The worship is centered around worship of God and not a show put on for man.  This is a church that can truly connect you with Jesus and has love for each and everyone who comes.  Cannot recommend them more highly....been a life changer for me and I've gone to church almost my whole life! I was one of the first members at this wonderful church. The pastors and elders are true men of God. And the other members are truly like family. The pastors preach and teach the Bible as it should be taught.  And they have compassion for the lost. Please if you are searching for a church home come be with us. ABC is our church home. We were drawn by the promise of expository preaching, dedication to teaching God’s word (new and old testament) and fellowship of the body of Christ. We have been blessed by ABC. They are NOT affiliated with the Seventh Day Adventists even though they are meeting in a SDA building.

Alpharetta Bible Church is a solid and Biblically sound congregation of believers who truly love each other not only in words, but in deeds. It is led by Holy Spirit indwelled humble men of God who lead by the Word of God, The Holy Bible. They are Biblical scholars, yet, are very humble and treat other believers as better than themselves and make themselves available for questions or help. The Lord’s Day service is reverent and God-glorifying, Christ-centered and full of joy. If you desire to share the Gospel of Jesus Christ with others in public, they have a group of men who go out and share the Gospel with the lost every week. This is a true church family.  I have never experienced  anything like it before and it is refreshing and encouraging. This is a congregation where you can truly grow tremendously in your spiritual walk with the Lord. A loving bible centered born again God fearing,  God loving, Jesus trusting church with so many brothers and sisters in Christ, pastors, and elders who truly care for and love those in the Body of Christ.  Come here and grow in your walk with Christ or come here broken and surrender finally to the finished work of Jesus on the Cross for forgiveness of your sins and be born again.

reviewSummary: Love this church! Friendly people, great bible teaching. Really Nice People! A great group of Christians who follow God and study His Word! Nice old school.

My God bless your congregation and your work! This is my home congregation. I truly couldn’t belong to a better church family with wonderful members and genuine leaders, both my elders and deacons. It is a family integrated worship and I look forward to it every Wednesday and Sunday. Amarillo Church of Christ is the BEST church home and family you could ever be a part of. These people love God and serve others like no other. ❤️ Amazing singing, selfless people, and teaching that is true to God’s Word. Great singing and Biblical based teachings. Church members are friendly and welcoming.  I recommend you go there to worship if you have the opportunity!

reviewSummary:
Very, very welcoming and I’ve been going forever basically. The culture is everyone greets new people so if you go don’t be surprised if everyone comes up and genuinely tries to talk and make a connection with you! Paster preaches from the Bible just how I like it! Definitely a second family or even for some there first real family,  if you give the church a chance!🙏 AFC has been my home church for many years. It's really moving and the pastors and people there helped me get to where I am today. I'm very grateful for what they do for caprock

name: Amazing Grace Christian Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Warm and friendly.  The people love and embrace Jesus Christ and how he helps the afflicted, homeless and hopeless.  The community is very powerful and has a great track record in prison inmate transitional help. Awesome Church to come worship Our Lord Almighty. Come as you are but don’t leave as you come!! We are having many miracles and healing, many are getting delivered. Many Blessings!! Humble, little but powerful Christian church focused on helping and healing it's community through prayer but also action which in my view is something now days many churches are missing. reviewSummary: The first time I visited Amazing Grace I felt I had found my Spiritual home. My Pastor is a wonderful teacher and preacher. He and his wife genuinely care for the members. Pastor Davis and entire worship team is all about love and service--they collected 400+ pairs of non-slip socks to be distributed this Season to the elderly in nursing homes, hospitals, and other facilities. I noticed the AGM website was missing from Google Maps, so I submitted it--the least I could do for the grace and peace I experienced at the 11:00 service. His sermons are very powerful but not lengthy which is a plus and the choir is amazing! Whenever I'm away from Biloxi, this is one church I truly miss. Love this church,  either Sunday services or Wednesday services you feel truly welcome by the church body (the members) are the Pastor, his wife & his brother which I think is a Minister also.  Love the way they teach the word, chapter by chapter, verse by verse.  Address on web site will have you at cemetery,  so type in the name of the church on your GPS This place saved me at 15 I owe my life to the Pastor and his wife. reviewSummary:
Warm, friendly people who are so welcoming and kind. Wonderful music, great message, and beautiful architecture. Come one, come all. Regular people with the same difficulties we all face who come together to encourage each other, learn God's word and to praise & thank Him for all things..big & small.

name: Anaheim First Presbyterian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Baller architecture, very big and Stoney. Like the glass stained windows. Hello J man. My partner and I found this church when we moved to Anaheim a couple of years ago. We admired the architecture of the building, and I attended a meeting here of the Anaheim Historical Society. The interior is just as remarkable and beautiful and spacious as the grounds. Pastor Kim is amazing, and the entire congregation is welcoming to all. If you don't have a church home or if you haven't been to church in a long time or haven't felt comfortable going to random churches, this church and its members will make you feel at home. They have coffee fellowship after service and often have meet ups in the community. We became official members of this church because we felt so comfortable here, and although the membership is small, they are some of the friendliest and most wonderful and kind people you will ever meet. So I decided to go back to church. I am looking for the right congregation and went to visit Anaheim First Presbyterian. Nice chapel, beautiful choir and a good service. Lovely sanctuary, great choir and pastor. Small congregation. All are welcome! Sunday service is 10:30 am.

They also provide free drink, juice and someone bring food, fruit, egg to eat in the morning. I feel like I am at home when I played there. If you are new, you can book a coach to teach you some simple skill for beginner. The badminton facilities here are remarkably clean. Not only can you play badminton here, but you can also make new friends. It's suitable for hobbies, and there are coaches available for lessons. Sometimes, there are even tournaments held here.
The staff are very professional, and people who visit are friendly.
People of various races, including Koreans, Chinese, and Vietnamese, exercise together. The courts are great. The people are friendly Help me so much years ago really good people I love EM and we are family together

name: Anaheim Revive Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
AFMC is currently doing outdoor worship services at 10am. There’s options to worship from your car or sit under the canopy seating. Chairs are spaced out nicely and bathrooms are available. Services are about 1 hour long. They’re also live-streamed on the website and YouTube at anaheimfmc.org
Hope you can join us!😄 Grew up at this church. Great multi-generational church. Mostly Asian Americans, but all are welcome. 2 services on Sunday. Good kids and youth programs. Associate Pastor Wong stepping up as Pastor since Sr. Pastor retiring. Excited to see what the Lord has in store. I’ve been going to this church for most of my life and grew up with amazing people here, it was like my second home… but the superintendent that recently came had no regard for what this founding church had and decided to completely erase its name and it’s history in favor of another bigger church. Not to mention almost firing most of the staff that worked hard to keep this church running when they did nothing wrong. I pray that they find a way to change their minds about this. I’m not denying change, but I was appalled at how they executed this. Instead of taking the time handling it the most ethical way, within a week they took the easy way out and absolutely did not care about the livelihood of the church’s community because “it’s what god envisioned”. Pastor Taka was kind enough to soften the blow, but it still doesn’t change the fact that the church is being used for expansion. I’m happy for those who go to voice church and the opportunity for them to expand their community, but at what cost?

Edit: they changed the name back to afmc so I put an extra star for hope that this is one step towards reconciliation. The church my family has attended for 100 years was heartlessly absorbed and rebranded by Voice Church like a corporate takeover. 100 years of community, identity, and family were wiped out overnight. If I could rate zero stars, I would. It's unfortunate to see the church where my parents were married in 1967 has lost so much of its history.

name: Anaheim United Methodist Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Anaheim United Methodist Church on State Street in Orange, California allows Neighbors Pantry volunteers' to set up shop here four days a week Monday through Thursday. They are a non-profit organization that collects food items from surrounding big stores and donates to the people. Their goal is to gather, sort and donate food items during the week, every week. Myself and others go around to stores such as: Target, Walmart superstores, Trader joe's, Amazon fresh, Sprouts and Target. They donate products of all sorts which includes food and other items that they no longer need for us to give out. The donations are greatly appreciated, along with the tax incentives. 😊 Did a hula show Jeremy for the Plumeria Society. Was a good time! The church itself seems very nice. Very pretty grounds. I recently went to a Funeral Service here for my good friend Brett and his Wife whom passed on the 22nd of July, which happened to also be my Brother in law's birthday.  It was a very lovely service.  I truly hope everyone in attendance felt so. She was a wonderful person and will truly missed! The site for the Orange County Cactus and Succulent Society plant sale. Great place to worship, also we rented the facility and we were very pleased! Thank you brothers and sisters in the Lord!

reviewSummary:
A great online option for your spiritual journey to learn about Loving God, Loving Others and Serving both. Many online options for study during the week with Bible Study, book club and inspirational messages throughout the week. Please feel free to come as all are welcome. This is my home church. I walk to it, just about, every Sunday. If I can’t make it in person, I try and catch it online.
Here’s the deal. It’s like a second home.
I am spiritually eclectic. Both in terms of the kind of person I am, and who I chose to love, I am ordinarily scoffed at for my devotion to Jesus. But not at Anamesa.
Anamesa accepts all people who want to hear the gospel, regardless of their lifestyle or how they come to God.
Anamesa is my safe haven.
And the people of Anamesa are loving.

Come one come all to hear the real good news, at this sweet home church, where the love of Jesus is as strong as the love between its members. A local home church with ties to locations across the states. Come join in person or online- always a welcome and loving atmosphere. Such a positive and welcoming environment- so unbelievably lucky to be a part of this & really encourage anyone else to join and open your hearts to this wonderful community!

name: Anastasia Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
As always Anastasia Baptist Church and pastor Walter West have the best Christmas Eve service. It's such a welcoming church everybody that enters the doors there feels comfortable and loved. I visited multiple churches looking for the right vibe and message- I found it here and have been here for a couple of years now. I love the contemporary services, the music, the location, everything. I am fulfilled when I leave service. Also, when I travel, I join virtually. Love attending here with my kids and teenagers. Vibrant church with a heart for the community. Excited to plug in even further. It feels a bit odd, writing a review on a church but here goes....
We attend services here 2-3 times a year when we visit St. Aug from Canada. It feels like our home church! Nice and close to where we stay and I really appreciate the police directing traffic out of the church parking lot after the services.
We have tried both the contemporary and traditional services. We are very young seniors......so the contemporary service was just right. Excellent music ministry. The traditional service was a bit old for us! Having been attending for 35 years...best church ever.
Something for every age group..true gospel preaching and great music.
Kid programs are unbelievable

name: Anchor Baptist Church of San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment we walked through the doors as a new-to-the-West-coast military family, we felt right at home! Sound Biblical teaching and preaching that is down-to-earth, immediately applicable, and actively lived out by the Pastor and church members. If you are looking to grow in your walk with Jesus alongside a loving and encouraging group of people, this is the church for you! We’ve been attending Anchor Baptist for 5 years now!! Preaching is straight from the Bible with great application for today. Smaller ministry but has a family atmosphere. There are ministries for kids, teenagers, men, women. Highly recommend!!! So I served in the USAF with Pastor David Cajiuat and years later, we reconnected although I was living in VA and he was in CA.  I have had the blessing to know this man of God who has a servant’s heart for over 3 decades now.  Last year, I spent Thanksgiving with both his blood family as well as spiritual family and wow, what a blessing .  I attend a church to be connected to the body of Christ and that’s exactly what Anchor Baptist is.  I felt welcomed and part of their spiritual family while there.  Now that I am down in Texas, I still keep close touch with Pastor Cajiuat and his family.  They do more than preach the Bible…they LIVE the Bible! I wish more than 5 stars was an option.  I have been blessed with the opportunity to be a part of Anchor Baptist Church long before it was Anchor Baptist Church, since its inception as Metro Baptist Church.  Although my start with Anchor was in a service manner, I had always been blessed by their kindness to me.  In the beginning it wasn't practical for me to attend services due to caring for family members and distance.  After they moved from Rosecrans to Ronson Road, the trip was an easy one just off the 163.  And, caring for family no longer became an issue when they went Home to be with the LORD.
I have to say in all my years of going to church, I had never felt so welcomed, so loved, so included than when I started attending Anchor Baptist Church!  Our family was made to feel like family.  What a blessing it was to see Pastor David and his family show up at our son's baseball game!  And, they didn't just come to one game, they came to many.  And, the youth pastor (if I can call Jordan the youth pastor) had events and opportunities for our teenaged children to be engaged in fun and safe activities.  The church family are all so kind and friendly from day one.  There are no clicks or groups or the feeling that you don't belong when you attend Anchor Baptist Church.  And, Pastor David sincerely respects his position as shepherd over God's flock, and doesn't take that position lightly.  He is a SOLID study of God's Word and doesn't hem-haw around the Scriptures with simply 'feel good' messages.  He brings the FULL Word of God to the pulpit.  He challenges you in Sunday School to learn and memorize God's Word and plant it in your heart.  He knows his flock and wants to know them really and personally, not just superficially on Sunday morning with a 'hello'.  He is the same man Sunday through Saturday; he is not a Sunday show.  Pastor David is committed to the community and serves as Chaplain on the SDPD.  He has a heart for San Diego and the lost souls in the community.  If you want a refreshing place to worship and grow in your faith, Anchor Baptist Church in San Diego is the best kept secret that shouldn't be a secret!  I encourage you to check it out and be blessed.  If you're not able to get out, but are on Facebook, they also have a livestream on Facebook as well.  Wednesday night services can also be joined via Zoom with an email invitation.  I love and miss my Anchor Baptist Church family since moving out of state, but am so thankful I still am able to be connected and involved.  Thank you, Pastor David Cajiuat, for your faithful service! The weekly RU chapter meetings at Anchor Baptist are absolutely beneficial for anyone who is struggling with bad habits, destructive behavior and full blown addiction. The victory is found in Christ where we are "free indeed". If you are looking for help, hope and healing, the RU meeting is the place to be.

I feel very welcomed !
Thanks be to Grace To You In SunValley for referring Anchor Bible Church! I’ve been attending since day 1, which makes sense cuz the pastor does happen to be my father. Nonetheless, if it weren’t for the genuine concern, love, and devotion to Christ of the people from this church that the Lord has used substantially in so many peoples lives including mine, I would be lost in my sin on a straight path to destruction. You will see immediately from all the smiling faces that you will be welcomed and brought in to the family as if you were there all along. I highly recommend this faithful and devoted body. The church is friendly to new people.  The teaching is rock solid.  Great church! A true Bible believing church. God's word is supreme and taught well. If your looking for a church family come on down!

name: Anchor Church - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary:
Wow!  Talk about people who actually care.  Anchor church is filled with struggling people who strive to know the Lord and continue to encourage one another along the way.  Pastor Matt has a passion for the community and preaches the Bible every Sunday.  The music sung at Anchor is based on scripture and sometimes comes straight from the Bible.  There is a variety of songs so it seems to me to have something for everyone.  I have been going to Anchor for years and have enjoyed it tremendously.  Is it perfect?  No, but is it filled with genuine and authentic leaders and church members.  I’m excited to see what the future will bring and I truly look forward to every Sunday.  After the service, several church members hangout and talk afterwords because we all genuinely care about one another.  When someone says they will pray for you, they mean it.  I love God and am grateful that He put me at Anchor Church.  If you don’t have a church home, please join us! I am a former member of Anchor Church, but I go back to visit because of the fellowship, love, and compassion I receive from everyone. Most importantly I always love hearing God message to me done so well by Pastor Matt their new and blessed Pastor. God is doing great things at Anchor Church! Our pastor preaches straight from the Word of God and we just recently finished a great series of messages from the gospel of John. We hear truth every time the word is preached and are encouraged to search the Scriptures ourselves and to spend much time in prayer. Our worship leader is a blessing, and truly leads us in worship, choosing only those songs that actually praise the Lord and build up the church body. The members of our church love Jesus and use that love to welcome all who come to visit. I can see the Lord working in individual lives, and in the body as a whole, and would highly recommend that if you are reading this review, you should come and check us out at Anchor Church! Pastor Matt Tipton is on fire for the Lord.  He leads by example, loves the Lord, and loves people from all walks of life. Sermons are clearly backed by scripture.
Anchors worship leader selects song that wonderfully tie in with the sermon topic.
The Elders are committed Christ followers, and the congragation is very welcoming to visitors.  Attending Anchor has been a very positive experience for my husband and I, so much so that we joined.  We are thankful to be under great leadership, to feel connected, and loved. This is an exciting time to be part of Anchor. I am learning so much every week. Pastor Matt is insightful, convicting, and genuine. Music minister Matt is talented, worshipful, and humble. The congregation is learning to reach out and enfold with love and grace. I love being part of it.

name: Anchor Church Boston
reviewSummary:
My wife and I found Anchor soon after we moved to Boston - we immediately knew this was the church community we were seeking.

It’s a great community that’s focused on growing relationships - both with one another and with God. The teachings are Bible focused and practically applicable to daily life. Not only are the services welcoming, but the music is fantastic!

Anchor Boston is a great and diverse church community to call home whether you’re a undergrad/grad student, young professional, or established family. If you’re looking for an inviting space to worship, develop spiritually and foster new relationships, Anchor is that place. We googled churches in the area while we were staying in Boston and Anchor church came up as a place of great community, worship and looked vibrant. Just what you want for a jet lagged brain! So off we went and met the most wonderful brothers and sisters in Christ! Just shows that Bible believing truth seeking, authentic worship (beautiful singing 💕) and solid teaching can be found wherever you are! Thank you Ryan, Erica and team for a wonderful welcome to your great city! If you’re ever down under, look us up!! I've been so blessed to call Anchor home while in Boston for school! The extremely talented musicians will grab your attention, but it's the inspirational and life-applicable messages, along with the WONDERFUL community that make you want to stay. Our community is so welcoming, accepting, and diverse - and I'm so glad that these friends have become family! I recently joined the family at Anchor Church and only have good things to say. They have been beyond welcoming to myself and the friends I have since brought by. We attended their church picnic and have gone to multiple services where we continually feel welcomed. I was able to volunteer within their Kids programming as well and love that this community accommodates families as well as young college kids such as myself! We LOVE it here at Anchor! We found this church right after we got to Boston and it was just what we were looking for. Everyone is friendly, warm and they make you feel right at home. It's nice to find a church actually rooted in Jesus and the bible and not just "feel good" sermons, there is real substance here. If you're looking for a place to call home, Anchor is it!

name: Anchor Faith Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
First, I just want to say I am EXTREMELY disappointed. I am a ministry leader with 2 Christian non-profits and I was looking forward to experience this church that was well reviewed. Here is my full experience. This church does not sit in scripture. They talked for 20 minutes about pressuring people to give and said that (this is an exact quote) "You may unlock the promises of God by giving $100." They also wanted to raise thousands of dollars for "church cars" and $13,000 for a bus for one of their missions trips. They are not stewarding their finances well from an outside perspective, so I would recommend being careful with donating. The worship was an hour and only 4 songs, meaning they sang each one for about 15-20 minutes. The pastor preaches more that THEY (Christians) are holy rather than Jesus. He preaches on a spirit of feelings and not an overflow of the Lord or scripture. He gave many personal stories and read a total of 2 (singular) verses through the entire hour long sermon. In fact, the pastor did not even have a Bible when he was preaching. He talks about how we perform miracles and we are strong because we are Christian. He may have been trying to say that we do that through Christ, but he did not mention that a single time. They talked about the Kingdom of God quite a bit which was their only saving grace. God is talked about and they preach with emotional conviction, but the spiritual strength was not there. Again I need to emphasize, the pastor read TWO VERSES. IN THE ENTIRE SERMON. I don't even know if I can call it a sermon. He told 3 personal stories of his life and talked, but BARELY mentioned scripture. I do not want to put a bad review on a church, but people need to know. I pray for them and I hope that they dwell more in scripture and go back to the basics of raw faith. The inside looked very much like a Church. The outside looked similar to the rest of the Mall, where it's located. They were very friendly & helpful. The Church entrance was not very well marked. Enjoyed our visit even though it was to attend a good friend's fineral. A Powerful, Life-Giving Church – Anchor Faith is Home!

Anchor Faith Church is more than just a place of worship—it’s a family. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, seen, and loved. The atmosphere is full of faith, passion, and purpose, and you can tell right away that God is moving in this place.

The teaching is always powerful, Bible-based, and delivered with clarity and conviction. Every message challenges you to grow, walk in your purpose, and live out your faith boldly. The worship team is incredible too—spirit-filled and genuinely uplifting.

What truly sets Anchor Faith apart is the heart of the people. The leadership is strong, sincere, and fully invested in building up the church and the local community. Whether it’s through outreach, youth ministry, or small groups, they are committed to making a real impact.

If you’re looking for a church that will strengthen your walk with Christ, connect you with others, and empower you to live out Kingdom purpose—Anchor Faith Church is it. 5 stars all the way! If you are looking for a church that lives how the Bible says we are to live, this is the place. The Word of God is preached, and applied by this family of believers. They are actively involved with the community as well. My wife and I have attended Anchor Faith Church for a few years-certainly long enough to know the Pastors, leadership and staff. While I didn’t know the name or place at the time, this is the church I  prayed for many years to find. It is Scripturally founded and Holy Spirit led. The people and Pastors exude Agape love. From infants to the aged, we are all surrounded by effective, heartfelt care. I love this place. This is my home and these are my people. I simply couldn’t imagine recommending any place of worship more highly than Anchor Faith Church.

name: Anchor Hill Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. They are very friendly and the guest experience shows love to you no matter if they know you or not. I recommend this for any family, couples, or someone who wants to try a new church to call home. Feeling welcome, feeling like family and feeling the love and presence of Jesus is synonymous with Anchor Hill Church! ☺️

So whether it’s suit and tie, jeans and a T-shirt or  flip flops and shorts, doesn’t matter, come as you are and get ready for a great atmosphere to praise, worship, fellowship, meet new people, make new friends and grow together in the family and body of Christ, as we do life together and continue to grow and encourage each other in the The Great Mission Jesus set out and established on earth! 🫶🏽🙏🏽 Anchor Hill is an awesome place to help you find peace through Jesus! The people there are amazing!! The pastors have a true heart for those hurting. This Church moved to Centennial Hills High School , I visited today, and Its local for me I absolutely loved it .. Start off with feeling very warm and welcoming, and The music was anointed songs that lifted up JESUS not self,  I loved it!! Congregation was very mixed culturally loved that too and the message was Word based very relevant for today .. prayer was fervent what more can I say I look forward to going back ! This church is life changing. It is wonderful, I have never felt more connected with God and I am so thankful and blessed to know the pastors.

name: Anderson Ferry Church of Christ - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: On Sunday July 13th at 11:am i was looking for the food pantry, went downstairs to use the restroom, after that I saw the coffee bar area poured a cup of coffee and grated a doughnut hole. A gentleman saw me and I excused myself for helping myself I asked about the pantry and was told they were closed on Sunday. He invited me to the services but gold me I was not allowed were the coffee and doughnuts were I thank him refused the service offer, just asi was leaving a bunch of people came into the coffee area. Never mind that I have not showered in a week,  been living on peanutbutter and bread, and drinking dirty water out of my ice chest, I left with a heavy heart, all I can do is write this and pray for that man. There's not a more welcoming place than a church like this!!! So come witness God's glory and blessings he bestows upon us every day!!! It was my first visit today and I will DEFINITELY be back. Everyone is so friendly, so thank u all for the prayers, support, and unending love when yall didn't even really know me. I feel the love at this church so thanks again everyone for being so welcoming!!!!! God is so good!!! Anderson Ferry Church Of Christ is a Real and Genuine Faith-Based Church that is Located on the Westside of Cincinnati in Delhi. There are Loving and Caring People at that Church! They play the Guitar during Worship time and they have great songs! They help those who are in need and they have a Great Food Pantry! In fact, it is one of the Best Food Pantries on the West Side! The Church Paid almost $1,000 to get my Car Fixed so that I would have a working car to drive to my job. They Teach from the Bible and it is a Godly Church that Believes in Living By God's Word! My review is based only on the food pantry/charitable donations area. Well I've been going to the pantry on and off for a couple years now. They give you a great variety of food only issue is that most of the food is expired or frozen past expiration date but that's how they get the donations. I've never been sick from eating the food I've prepared. Now when it comes to the Christmas program where they give families Christmas gifts who can't afford, absolute joke, I participated 2yrs ago I was one of the first people in line and I don't want to seem ungrateful because I'm not but I assumed they got cash donations to buy brand new stuff for the children but that wasn't the case. We received very used clothing in ziplock bags some of which smelled like mildew. Used coats which were the highlight of the gifts because we needed coats. And a box with used lip stick and half a bottle of body spray. And other little things it seemed as if someone to there old jewelry box right off the dresser and donated it. I feel ungrateful complaining like this but that was the worst Christmas we ever had. I couldn't put those used things under the tree as a reminder to my kids how little we can afford. I mostly want any people who make donations to be aware of what is going on. I have no proof but I have heard that the volunteers take the good stuff for their selves. I never believed until that Christmas. The pastor gives phenominal sermons; the service drags into the 1.5 -2+ hour range due to numerous songs and misc readings.  Great if that's your thing, I can't go to service where 90% of the time all I'm thinking about is could we PLEASE get to the sermon?!?

name: Anderson Hills Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful, family-oriented, congregation. They practice love no matter who you are and welcome everyone as they are. We struggled to find a church in the area and fell in love with this one. The services are liturgical for those who like call and response and hymns. The messages are relevant and the people are extraordinary. A wonderful place open to ALL with caring people who love their community and love Jesus. Jazzercise is a great enjoyable way to stay in shape.  Highly recommend it. The church is very welcoming and open to people. The architecture is simple and windows are inspiring to congregation. Greetings are common here. Attention to children, prayers and music are appreciated and valued by me.

name: Anderson Hills Church - Cincinnati, OH - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Anderson Hills Church is a welcoming place for young families and all ages across the board. They have so many ministries, are prayer-focused, and they always offering opportunities and encourage personal growth with the Lord. The staff is absolutely incredible and provide a nurturing environment where everyone feels cared for and supported. I have found many areas to volunteer my time here and it brings me so much joy. The modern worship is fantastic. They have a big VBS program and a wonderful preschool as well. As wonderful as it is inside the walls, they help many missions and support in the community. It's more than just a place of worship—it's a vibrant community where families can grow together in faith. Warm greeting, great facilities, wonderful modern worship music, inspired teaching and preaching, engaging small groups, great ministry to children and youth, great mission and outreach. Welcoming body of Christians who are real and genuine. Amazing worship team and leadership. All four of the pastors are wonderful, teach sound biblical principles and each have a great hearts. Great for families up to seniors. Outstanding and rapidly growing children's and youth ministries. Lots of opportunities for spiritual growth and serving. The Holy Spirit is moving here and it's very exciting. I love being a member ofAnderson Hills Church. We are a welcoming congregation that makes you feel like family. So many opportunities to grow in my faith and express myself while learning about my relationship with Jesus. I recommend this church to anyone of any age from all walks of life whether they are just beginning their faith journey or have been dedicated to the Lord their entire lives. My children love attending Anderson Hills as well and have made great friendships and had many opportunities to learn about Jesus. Wonderful group of people who love the Lord. Kid-friendly; there's something here for everyone. Beautiful facility

name: Angel City Church Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: A small church with friendly people who love God, hearing the Word and fellowship. All are welcome. 1.7.2024: My first day fellowshipping ANYWHERE FACE TO FACE since March/April, 2020! Everyone I met was warm and welcoming, BEFORE MY FRIENDS ARRIVED. This is the true test of any "welcoming church" *- how you are treated as a stranger on your first visit! Kudos and thanks to the Pastor Jerrod (sp?) and his team!  Also attended morning prayers ahead of 10:00 am service with the W. family that I have known since 1990. 👍☮️🌍🌎🌏☮️🖖🙏💥💯💯💯 Always a wonderful place to be. A really great church🤩 Good place to visit

name: Angelica Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful Church ! The staff was also friendly and accommodating. Beautiful sanctuary whose primary attendees are Spanish speaking.right in the heart of MacArthur Park. Well worth a visit. New pastor is an awful person. Everyone there is immoral and evil. Never go there if you want to go to a pleasant Sunday service. At graduation for my first husband-Tommy Lee Moore ll
Beautiful church!!! beautiful church

name: Anglican Cathedral Church of the Resurrection - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: It is a serene place of Christian worship. The service is ordered and spirit-filled. If you need Definitions to life issues, it is a wonderful place to be. Colourful also😊😁 Nice place to worship. Nigerian-styled church. But services can run long. Ever since I joined this cathedral, I enjoyed the ministry, the music and the way that the church except you into the fellowship. I miss going to my church. I will be attending it soon. Being an American Christian is fine, but experiencing the Anglican Religion, the people, the clergy and married to the most beautiful woman of my life. I'm looking forward to going back to my original roots in Africa. Located in a nice quiet  neighborhood.  Parking is good. The church is spacious an serene. The choir is good too.

name: Annunciation Byzantine Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Byzantine Holy Divine Liturgy reverently chanted! Bishop Artur installation was sublime one year ago. Heaven on earth meets here. Fr. Stephen is loving chanting the Liturgy.  Beautiful growing church and people. My family and I visited this church on a Sunday and everything about it was stunning. They use a lot of icons, and incense which made church look and smell like heaven. After mass, they invited us to stay for coffee and donuts. Everyone was so friendly to introduce themselves to us since we were new. Even the deacon sat and chatted with my husband and I before the inquiry class after mass. They invited us to stay and join but we had to leave. Highly recommend this church for anyone in the area. First time to have Divine Liturgy. Stunning church. They sang every verse and very clear. God bless always. Though I’m a Western Rite Catholic, I fell in love with this church and believe this is a beautiful place to feel connected with the Lord and the chanting throughout their Divine Liturgy, felt delightful. Beautiful liturgy, friendly parish, gorgeous church. Was grateful to celebrate mass at this location.

name: Annunciation Catholic Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: I Was raised in going to  church here since a little girl, I had my catechisms on here. my mom and dad's 25th anniversary, Sunday church with my parents. And as an adult I go there with my bike at least 3 days out of the week this is pray they thank you sit on my bench there's a place of sanctuary I'm thankfulness. Please visit We love this church, the priests, the volunteers. Thank you all for the services for this community. God be with you all Amen! Beautiful church, good place to pray 🙏 Beautiful mass for my beloved nephew Sergio Mardueño Jr.  REST IN PEACE… The worst experience I’ve had in a church, the lady in the front office was very rude and seemed like she was having a bad day to provide you any information. Also told me “I shouldn’t be coming here if I wasn’t ready” if I wasn’t ready? It was my first time baptizing someone. How would I know this information. For working in a church there wasn’t nothing holy about that women. And I will be making sure to complain about this experience I’ve had. I’d recommend a church that feels welcoming and loved to be there.

name: Anthem Church - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary: Very genuine people, intentional about sharing the gospel inside and outside the church via many different methods, including sermons, and such a friendly church! I have been a member for nearly 6 years and I love every aspect of this church. From the first interaction on zoom during covid, and watching churches online, we were met with care and compassion and a very thoughtful approach to reaching visitors and members. They also have a teaching team, not just one pastor speaking all year. Not that having a majority of sermons delivered by one person is a bad thing, I personally prefer to hear from multiple people, different life perspectives, and styles. Each person brings an educated approach but in different lenses. The best thing is that the entire team meets, not just the one teaching, and agrees  on the message, and the Senior Pastor approves what they teach so it isn't just wide open to opinions there is accountability and leadership. They believe in strategic sabbaticals for leaders to prevent burnout, but also to promote growth through rest. One of my favorite aspects of this leadership is their intentionality in everything they do and it is obvious. They have purpose, vision, and a clear mission. There aren't perfect churches but this one comes really close. No, I am not on staff, I am just a member who appreciates everything this church body offers no matter where you are in life's journey, if you are new to the faith, just searching for answers, or a mature Christian, there is something great for everyone. And one more thing, their new children's wing is so exciting, inviting, and spacious for kids to learn and grow and they take security very seriously. When I volunteered to help with youth a few years ago, it is intensive training, background checks, and references. Protecting your most valuable and vulnerable are their top concerns. They have a dedicated security team to help monitor things from the parking lot to the classrooms. Hope this helps anyone considering visiting to give this church a chance. Even if you don't stay long term, you will definitely not be disappointed. Not too large where one gets lost and not to small. I love the worship and seems very scriptural.. I was looking for a church not necessarily to my life and put one where I could fellowship and grow together. I love visiting this church. The people are friendly and make me feel welcomed. You can truly feel the presence of God so strongly and the anointing flows freely. I enjoy the praise and worship. God touches my heart through the music EVERY time. The majority of the congregation is white, but they never make me feel awkward as a black woman they show me love. I pray God continues to bless this ministry in many ways. A special hats off to pastor Brad 🙌!!! This place is great! I've gone for over 5 years. Their emphasis on serving and inclusion is refreshing and powerful. We LOVE our church! Anthem Church families and staff are so loving, caring and compassionate! We have been a part of this church for more than 28 years (long before it was Anthem), have raised our children here and made lifelong friendships centered around our common love of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ! ❤️

name: Anthem Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary:
My kiddos and I came here for a Sunday service while visiting CA.  Such a blessing to find a biblical church that preaches the word of God faithfully.  Great sermon, music and very kind people.  We will visit again if ever we find ourselves back in CA on a Sunday. This church is such a blessing. My wife and I moved here from West Virginia and found this church quite refreshing and true to the Gospel. Their pastoral staff is so caring and really wants to see your relationship grow in Jesus. They truly live out the Gospel in their preaching, teaching, counseling, and everyday lives. I thank God for churches like Anthem. This is a great place to worship.  You can count on a clear and compelling presentation of the Gospel, God-honoring worship, and hanging with a group of people who love Jesus, want to follow Him and help make Him known.  It's a mixed congregation of all ages and ethnicity. It has a great Children's program that in addition to teaching the kids on Sundays gives parents tools to help their little ones all throughout the week.  My favorite part is that people are REAL.  Through the ups and downs of life, people live life together in such a way that helps to keep Jesus as the central focus.  It's a warm welcoming place to be. Such a beautiful and welcoming body of believers.  Great worship, the sermon was full of God’s word and taught by an open man. They love travelers just passing through and it seems like the members are a true family BIBICALLY BASED and will be back!!

name: Anthem Community Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: Happy to call Anthem home! Anthem Church has been such a blessing in my life! Their practical and engaging teaching has not only deepened my understanding of the Bible but also equipped me to apply its lessons in my everyday life. What really sets them apart is their genuine commitment to serving the community—both in action and financial support. Their dedication to funding and partnering with local nonprofits is truly inspiring. Attending Anthem has not only strengthened my faith but also motivated me to grow personally and serve others with purpose. I’m so grateful to be a part of this amazing church family! This is a non pretentious, easy to attend church that provides great music, a great message, and great child care. They are a community, pulling people together in the name of Christ. It just feels good to go. They welcome believers and non believers alike, and allow people to find their path without being pushed. They are non judgmental- it’s a place where you can be yourself. I love it here. Affiliate of North Point Community Church in Atlanta. We went to Woodstock City in metro Atlanta and moved down here and found Anthem. While I always loved the messaging while at Woodstock City, Anthem provides a smaller, more intimate church experience with the same great message we are accustomed to. Our children LOVE their kids' programs, Wambaland and Upstreet. They have fantastic programs for older children (middle and high school aged). If you want your children to develop a meaningful relationship with God, they do an amazing job of facilitating that and make everyone feel loved, welcome, and part of the Anthem family. Always inviting and a moving experience. Always leave feeling blessed and refreshed. I love when my kids run up to me excited to tell me what they learned or when they have a new Bible verse they memorized. God has really blessed my family and I through the leaders at this church.

name: Anthem Community Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
The worship songs are uplifting and updated, lots of energy! Friendly congregation and Pastor Marty is excellent at conveying the message of the gospel. Since joining Anthem last year, it has brought me closer to my Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. I have also gained a new family! Pastor Marty’s messages are word based so I can understand. I love my church!!!! After moving to the Las Vegas area and trying out several  churches, we finally found our "home" in Anthem Community Church. They have an excellent children's ministry, awesome weekly Bible studies, top notch worship, and solid, Biblical teaching. We've with many churches, in many states (we are military and move often)

Anthem is truly a blessing from the Lord. We moved away a few months ago and miss Anthem daily.  Marty and his wife have changed our lives for the better.

Will not find a better service for children, women's studies, or Sunday Worship.

This church is truly sanctioned by the Lord. The priest and others were very very unwelcoming to us. To tell us we cannot pray inside the church even for 10 minutes but rather should just pray outside when it very cold and windy is not how Jesus Christ would welcome someone in his home. We were very disappointed. Very "Unchristian" like particularly from a priest. Would we come back to this church even though we just moved in Seven Hills from LA? Most likely not. But we will pray for everyone so they can think right and be more welcoming.

name: Antioch Austin Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s been a bit since I’ve been to Antioch but I was part of Hope in the City when Antioch took over. HITC was exceptional when Ron was the pastor but when he stepped down things drastically changed. It became less and less accepting and more and more cliquish. Once Antioch took over I visited bc my parents were very involved but the pastor Jady seemed to be more about appearances and being cool. I’ll never forget meeting his wife. My mom wanted me to meet her because she said she was so sweet. When I met her she looked me up and down, gave me a fake smile and said nice to meet you and then walked away. This was probably the last time I ever visited. I was always told people are flawed you can’t just base all your feelings about a church on the people. Well shortly after this experience I began to deconstruct and it was the best thing I ever did. So in a way this church got me thinking about how flawed people are but when you are supposed to represent Jesus it’s a bad look when the people of that church are not accepting. And btw, my parents were very involved in this church but after Covid and how they responded to this pandemic was also absolutely nuts. This church is more focused on indoctrination and colonization than doing what Jesus would do. I know it’s been a while but this was my experience and one of the reasons I no longer go to church. I've found Antioch to be a pretty good church experience. It's non denominational so fairly low church and Baptist leaning, but there's a unique blend of charismatic and Biblical basis where the church focuses highly on relationships; with God, with fellow believers, and with the community around us. A great group of people where everyone is welcome. I rarely leave reviews online, and I have never left a review for a church, but I feel I must do so after my experience here for the sake of any other church seekers in Austin. This is not a church for the seasoned believer who wants in depth, exegetical teaching straight from scripture.

To start with something positive, we were greeted warmly by the welcome team, and the congregation was kind and friendly.

At my previous church, solid, Biblical, exegetical teaching was of utmost importance. Pastors prioritized teaching verse by verse, taking into account the historical context, original language, author, and audience. The pastor at Antioch Austin was teaching from Joshua 1, specifically doing a topical teaching on “How to step into promise.” It was a classic spiritual milky, prosperity gospel, surface deep, topical sermon, that did not take into account original audience, intention, or context at all. Using verse 8 specifically, “. . .For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success,” the pastor drew parallels from this scripture to Antioch Austin, insinuating that —based on this passage— a great promise of prosperity and success were on the horizon for this church body.

The worst part was a very unfortunate and embarrassing story about his wife’s first birth experience that he used as a sermon illustration. After his wife “thought she was going into labor a hundred other times,” the pastor said his heart had admittedly “grown cold towards her.” (cue laughter from the congregation.) When she was actually in labor, she said so to him, and instead of believing her this time, he said “Like the loving husband and suitable partner I am for my wife, I denied that she was actually going into labor and left the house to go get coffee.” (more laughter.) When his morning coffee run was interrupted by a phone call from his wife that her water had, in fact, broken, only then did he turn around and go home. The story went on, including embarrassing details about his wife’s profanity during labor that I’m sure she didn’t appreciate being shared from the pulpit, and more snide jokes that reflected very poorly on the pastor.

Whether his wife is truly cherished and respected at home, I won’t venture to speculate on, but any rhetorical device or sermon illustration that paints you as a deadbeat husband and your wife as a cursing sailor is evidence of weak teaching skills, and maybe even poor character. It was truly a tough watch.

We left 45 minutes into the service and attended elsewhere. I hope this can be taken as a learning opportunity for everyone. I will not be back to attend this church, but hope good things are in store for the church body, and that this feedback will be taken seriously by church leadership. The church is average, they are accepting and don't kick me out for coughing like others have. But the issues i have are with the cliques that form in life group when you've tried to belong and make friends, you get ignored or brushed aside. People already have their preferences and if you don't somehow get included in that or fit in with them, you'll feel like an outcast. It's an issue that i wish this church would be more apt to resolve or be aware of and take action. Great church that is relatable and effective. I (from Red River Church) have been partnering with them and Hope Chapel to raise up young musicians for a few years now, and it has been both fun and powerful. Thank God for Hope in the City!

name: Antioch Community Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
We lived in the east valley for a few years searching for a church that loves God, takes scripture seriously, and loves all His people. The first Sunday I visited I came with just my daughter. The worship and message were good - but the people. Oh my gosh, the people of Antioch were so loving and kind. We started attending in late 2019 and drove 35 minutes one way to go because it was just that good. We found our friendships and activities were all closer to the church, so we actually moved in 2021 to be closer. Best decision ever! Wonderful church. Antioch has a deep heart to make sure we are following Jesus and pursuing him wholeheartedly. I grew up in a more conservative church with solid theology and I love how Pastor Travis always makes sure we go back to the Word to build our foundation. Antioch does a fantastic job of building community through life groups to make sure life-on-life discipleship is happening, which is SO necessary for every Christian in their walk with the Lord. We cannot do this life alone, as Paul clearly states over and over again in scriptures. I am glad to be a part of a body of believers that want to know God personally, and make Him known. Leadership is clear and passionate about making sure our congregation builds a deep, healthy relationship with the Lord. I have been here for almost 4 years now and my relationship with God has flourished. I would not be where I am today without God and this community.

A word to those seeking a church- no church will ever be perfect- if you think you found one then please recognize that we all are on a journey with God on the path to righteousness; nobody is perfect, and no body of believers will be either. Aim to get involved with a church that is working towards being more and more like Jesus. A church with open hands, who has made Jesus Lord,  and is ready to be refined by Christ. I see that happening here at Antioch, a place where we can walk this road together and pursue a deep, healthy relationship with the Lord. Beautiful church and property. The people were so welcoming. I really hate feeling the need to write this review, but I feel that I have an obligation to those who are searching for a new church and have stumbled upon this one. A warning, specifically to incoming/current college students: myself and several others spent many years of their life as a part of this organization, only to become outcasts for questioning some of the theologies of this church. I started going to this church in my first week of my freshman year at ASU, and was awestruck by the community and purpose they could provide me. Unfortunately it was only surface deep, and I was one of many who blindly walked into their culture. I am still recovering and taking time to retrace my views because of this church’s teachings and how they handled myself and many others asking questions. And that’s all it was: we asked questions, and our church leaders and friends refused to listen or answer. They merely asked if we believed their theology, and if we didn’t, we were discarded. Please, take everything you hear with a grain of salt, and match it to the Bible (with real and true context). Ask other leaders of churches with seminary experience about the things you learn here. Read through Matthew 7. If myself and others had done so when we started attending Antioch, we may not have had to endure the difficulties we have had to. Some have had to go to counseling, many of us are having difficulties trusting the church again as we search for a new church home. 1 John 4:1 (ESV): “Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, for many false prophets have gone out into the world.”

*I would also like to add that there was a time when leadership asked church members and student leaders to write a five star review on the different review platforms. That is not the case for all reviews, but many of them. I do not recommend this church if you are Black. There are no Blacks Go There. Maybe a handful. The congregation do not make you feel welcome at all. They look at you strange. Then you have young adults jumping over the pews to sit down. Instead of saying excuse me and walking around the person to sit down. Then you have young adults running around with no shoes on in the sanctiury. I was shocked. Being that I have been saved over 37 years to see this. When I wanted to become a member. We went to some ownership class. Antioch does not believe in membership of the church. They believe in ownership.  I attended some outside fellowship dinners at some of the people homes. But you get grilled on your background. Very not okay. Anyway. The Lord showed me where he wants me to attend. And I am at that church now.

It’s modelled from the top (starting with the Trinity ;) and flows through the rest of the church through the small groups (lifegroups).  I love being part of this extended family! Definitely worth visiting if you’re interested in growing in your relationship with Jesus (or even if you’re just wanting to find out whether Jesus is someone you want to pursue) This is a friendly church! People want to get to know you and it's easy to make friends and join the community through LifeGroups with people in similar life stages. We are so glad we visited and thankful that Jesus has used this church to change our lives! Come visit!

name: Antioch Galveston Community Church - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
It has been a long time since I’ve stepped into a church and felt so genuinely refreshed and saturated in the presence of the Lord. From the moment I walked in, the body of believers are warm and welcoming, marked by humility and love. There is a clear hunger to be a house of prayer and a dwelling place for His presence.

The focus is entirely on Jesus, not on performance, but on ministering to the Lord. The spontaneous worship rose like sweet incense before Him, and His presence felt tangible in the most beautiful way.

This is a place where hearts are postured in surrender, where praise flows freely, and where the presence of God is honored and stewarded with reverence. I am deeply grateful for a church that truly makes room for Him and can’t wait to visit again! 🤍 Hey Galveston, I’m one of the worship leaders at Antioch Galveston, I love this church with all my heart.

We have Lifegroup that meet every week in homes all over the island, and soon we will be opening a 24/7 prayer room!

Robert (the pastor) is one of the most genuinely humble dudes I’ve ever met. His messages are all about Jesus.

Antioch Community Church is a part of a movement of church plants all over America, I went to my first one in College Station when I was in university and have loved Antioch since joining. This church really carries the heart of God for the lost, is laser focused on Jesus, knowing Him more, and his heart to see the great commission fulfilled.

Key verse for Antioch Galveston:

“One thing I ask from the Lord, this only do I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.”
‭‭Psalms‬ ‭27:4‬ I’ve stayed silent for a long time… but healing requires truth. ✨

A church that claimed to follow Jesus weaponised my mental health.
Instead of compassion, they used intimidation.
Instead of support, they used fear.
Instead of love, they used manipulation — even to the point of influencing situations that put my relationship with my daughter at risk.

But they failed.
I fought.
And by God’s mercy, my daughter is home with me. 💛🙏

⸻

🐍 A Serpent Spirit, Not the Spirit of God

The Bible describes a serpent as deceptive and treacherous — someone who exploits trust to betray (Genesis 3).

Jesus warned:
“Beware of false prophets…wolves in sheep’s clothing.” (Matthew 7:15) 🐺

That is exactly what I encountered — religion, not Jesus.

⸻

🔥 What They Did Did NOT Match Their Mission

They claim to be a loving, multicultural, multigenerational church with a mission to:

❤️ Love Jesus
🤝 Love one another authentically
🌎 Love those who don’t know Him

But nothing I experienced matched that.

Authentic love does not shame, manipulate, intimidate, twist someone’s vulnerability, or attempt to separate a mother and child.
Their actions didn’t reflect Jesus — only fear, image-control, and self-protection.

⸻

✝️ Shame & Guilt Are Not Love

Scripture says:
“There is now no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 8:1)

Shame is not love.
Guilt is not guidance.
Intimidation is not ministry.
Jesus came to set people free, not trap them in fear.

⸻

❤️‍🩹 I Forgive Them — And I Choose Healthy Boundaries

I forgive them — because Jesus calls me to forgive so I can walk free (Ephesians 4:32).
But forgiveness also comes with wisdom.

Forgiveness does not mean returning to unhealthy patterns.
Forgiveness does not erase the need for discernment.
Forgiveness simply means I’ve released the offense — not my boundaries.

Jesus said:
“Be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.” 🕊️🐍 (Matthew 10:16)

With that wisdom, I can acknowledge this truth:

They’re simply not the right people for those who are in vulnerable seasons or seeking emotional and spiritual safety — and it’s okay to say that.

I hold no hatred.
But I honor what God has taught me:
that healthy boundaries matter,
and not every environment is safe or suitable for every heart.

Ephesians 5:11 reminds us to shine light on harmful behavior — not ignore it.
That’s why I’m sharing my experience:
not to attack, but to bring clarity and truth. 🔦✨

John 8:32 says:
“The truth will set you free.”

I forgive them ❤️‍🩹…
but I also walk forward with wisdom, peace, and discernment.
I am healed —
and I refuse to stay silent where others might be harmed.

My voice is not bitterness —
it is clarity, stewardship, and light. ✨ Pastor Robert—a wonderful, humble, Spirit-filled minister we have known since about 28 years ago—leads a church filled with beautiful souls. I recommend Antioch Galveston!

The prayer sets throughout each week (one hour each of ministering to God with worship) have brought me nearer to God. Being in God’s presence like that has brought breakthroughs in my life, like delivering me from a lifelong sugar addiction. I have the power to overcome but confess I don’t always use it! More prayer and gratefulness needed!

Being involved with the lovely people at the church also brought deep healing. The ladies showed such love towards me and my family that it was transformative, and that’s no exaggeration.  ❤️🙏🏼❤️

And get this! 🙂 Thanks to Antioch Galveston, I discovered a thrilling calling to play the bass! And that experience came with a miraculous healing from severe carpal tunnel (the “rocks” that had developed in my wrists even disappeared). A physical therapist for carpal tunnel verified it had to be a miracle because playing bass is the last kind of thing they would recommend.

I was all in when I went to this glorious church, but I knew full-well it was temporary at the get-go. I was helping a family member to get settled and blessed — and the blessings have overflowed continually! Absolutely phenomenal!!! I loved everything about this church. The people, the atmosphere, the worship, the sermon, literally everything. Being a first time guest, they really strive to make you feel special. I even noticed that everyone there is a big family, which is a major plus in my book. I will definitely return for future Sunday services!! And I cannot wait to bring my children. I know they're going to love it, too!!! Thank you for such a wonderful time at your church!!

name: Antioch Indy Community Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: It’s not every Sunday where you feel like family right when you walk in! The humility and of this church is surreal. I checked it out one time and haven’t stopped going since! My wife and I have been attending for a year now and feel at home.
