reviewSummary:
Being a part of this ministry is helping me to become more mature and established in my relationship with Jesus.

The Sunday and Wednesday teachings at our fellowship are absolutely fantastic and I especially LOVE praise and worship.

We learn in-depth lessons about our Christian faith that are  not generally taught in most other churches.

I especially enjoy the many opportunities for us to fellowship and encourage each other. The Watsons (the family who began this church) are some of the kindest people I've ever known, and our church members are friendly and warm.  In the few years I have been attending here, I've grown as a Christian, more than at any other church I've attended through the years.  When you walk in, you will not remain a stranger for long; you will be welcomed and invited to chat over coffee.  If you don't know much about the Bible -- or you want to learn more -- this is the place; everything is grounded in the Bible.  If you want prayed for, they will do it.  If you have questions, they will answer them.  Just come on in on a Sunday (or a Wednesday night), and see what you think. I know Noah and Liana from this church. They are full of the Holy Spirit, very anointed and preach the absolute Word of God. If you really want a different life then what you're living now, this is the place to truly experience transformation. Rather than a humanistic doctrine, this church preaches the grace of God, that cost God everything in order to give us everything in return. If you are satisfied with two lifestyles, and want to stay the same person who goes to church, is called a christian, and loves to live in sin, and if you don't want to be challenged, you probably won't like it. On the other hand, if you want to encounter Jesus Himself, this is the place for you. This church is led by a family that cares, genuinely, for the anyone who attends. The lead pastors are young family men who also have full time jobs in the work force, one as a structural engineer in a large Atlanta based company and the other as a successful architect. I trust these people with the spiritual lives of my children and grand children as well as myself. All people are welcomed ! Amazing church to be around people truly filled with the Holy Spirit, and they are amazing with my little girls! This place and people within are a gift from God!

reviewSummary:
If you need community, a place to hear the true Word of God, and to encounter the Holy Spirit - Arise Church is it. The heart of this church is to see people changed by the love of Jesus, and to do it together. I am so thankful for the people here who constantly lift me up and push me to be the best version of myself.

I also love how real everyone is here. There isn't a need to be the "perfect" Christian or to have everything all together. The conversations are real, the messages bring truth (not an opinion), and there isn't a push to be something they are not.

My children also love the Sunday school classes and have learned so much about the word of God. Sunday is their favorite day just because we get to go to church.

Love this church so much! I have watched as the congregation that now makes up Arise Church has grown in faith as well as numerically! Pastor Ty has now been here 3 years and the joy and expectations have risen as our love for God, His Word and each other has continued to increase. The church reflects both the diverse ethnicities of the community as well as being honoring of the multi generations! God is praised and exalted in the worship, the Word is preached uncompromisingly and there are testimonies declaring the present active workings of God through the Holy Spirit! As we are lifting up the name of Jesus, He indeed is drawing men and women to Himself! In my first time visiting, I experienced genuine people who really seem to enjoy worshipping God, living out their faith, and building each other up. The music style was exuberant, but not too loud. The sound mix emphasized the vocals, which I really appreciated. The pastor seems to really love and care for his people, and the people seem to be welcoming and caring. You may also appreciate this local body of believers. Women's Christmas Tea was delightful. Full of cheer and spirit of holiness! What a beautiful place to worship. Plenty of parking, the church was very modern and clean but, above all, the people were so welcoming. If I lived in Apex, I would go there. The pastor is a very joyous and loving man of God. reviewSummary: Our family has been attending 7 years, and we love it this warm and welcoming church.  The Pastor  Kevin has taught verse by verse through so many books of the Bible, giving us so much insight. It is a tightly-knit community with deep friendship, a love for the Word of God, and a zealous desire to bring the Kingdom of God to the city of Arlington. If you want to feel loved, seen, and cared for, you have come to the best place possible here. This church has small groups where people pray for you, life-giving sermons, and intentionally serves to grow your faith. Love coming here every week!!! I’ve been part of this church since 2018 and I love it here. It’s okay to be unsure about things and ask questions, but still be loved and respected in response.

ACC really is a place where you can be known and the people really want to live out, teach, and experience the love of Jesus. This church has been an amazing blessing to my family. My husband and I moved our family 6 years ago to attend this church, and we have had no regrets. name: Ascend Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
So we visited this church yesterday for the first time for my nieces dedication, what was supposed to be a very exciting time turned into what felt like an attack. I was thrown completely off and alarmed when I was asked to leave the sanctuary because my 1yr baby was making too much noise. Mind you he was not crying, yelling or being loud at all he was simply making normal baby commentary. Some may even say praising the Lord but no that was not acceptable. We were rushed by this weird aggressive usher who was reprimanding us and made our entire experience very uncomfortable. I have NEVER in my life felt this way in a church and for it to be my first time with my child it left a horrible taste in my mouth. And for the lady to be constantly talking at us as she escorted us out was SO disappointing, it felt like we did something wrong. We then couldn’t even focus on the message and on what was being preached as well as missing my nieces dedication which was the whole purpose of our visit. Now if this is how you treat your saints, especially first time visitors, how do you expect them to feel? The house of God should feel welcoming inviting and safe, this did not feel like either which is so unfortunate. I do pray that the leaders of this ministry reevaluate how they treat those experiencing the house of God. My wife and I moved to Georgia to be planted at Ascend Church, and we are grateful beyond words. Pastor Brian faithfully preaches the Word with humility and clear dependence on the Holy Spirit. This is a Christ-centered, biblically grounded church that genuinely shepherds its people. In a time when many churches feel commercialized, Ascend stands out as sincere, reverent, and Spirit-led. If you’re hungry for Jesus and longing to be part of a true flock, this is a place to call home. Beautiful  presence  of the Lord
Worship  team is amazing you can tell they have been with The Lord .
The Pastor  and leaders have a deep and pure intimate love for JesusChrist and His Word.  The glory of God is in this place
Refreshing !!! Been listening online for a month and I’m hooked. Can feel the Presence so strong thru the broadcast even from Oxford UK.

Atlanta is my old stomping ground, and where I was reborn at 19! 46 now and smiling to see how God is still moving powerfully in my ‘hometown’ 🙏❤️🔥 I visited this church for the first time this morning, and unfortunately it wasn’t a good experience. I was very disappointed to learn that young children are not allowed to remain in the sanctuary and must be sent to children’s church. Young children make noise sometimes that’s normal. I’ve been to much larger and more prominent churches where families are welcomed together during service, so this policy felt unnecessary and unwelcoming.

What troubled me most was witnessing a child with autism have to leave the sanctuary because of the noises they were making. This is supposed to be the house of God, a place of compassion and grace. Seeing a child with special needs removed from the service was honestly heartbreaking and felt completely inappropriate.

The atmosphere was also extremely dark inside, much darker than a typical worship space, which made it feel more theatrical than sacred. The pastor’s message was fine but not exceptional, very average preaching, nothing particularly impactful or memorable.

I would definitely think twice about coming here with young children especially if you’re not comfortable with them being separated from you or for some other reason and me and my family will not be returning. I hope they will reconsider these inhospitable policies.

name: Ascend Worship Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
Ascend Worship Church is a welcoming community of believers in Christ with a spirit-filled atmosphere. You will encounter God and learn the word of God like never before. Join this vibrant, community-focused church experience. My family and I have been attending Ascend for over a year. We recently joined about a month ago. Everything about Ascend is authentic. The guest services team make you feel right home as soon as you walk into the church. The children and youth ministry are impressive. Our eight-year-old enjoys every bit of it. Our worship team and the musicians are the best. The best part about our church is, Pastor Williams preach directly from the bible and push you to grow. If you are looking to receive the word of God from the bible, then Ascend is the place for you to visit. We are super thankful to call Ascend Worship our home. Our family has been blessed to see the move of God throughout Ascend for the last five years. The way God has shown up in our lives under the leadership of Pastor Darrell and Elect lady Donna, has truly blessed us.  Following Christ, building one another up in Faith, Hope and Love. Blessed to be apart of what God is doing! I have been a member for about 5 years. Here at Ascend, we study the scripture line by line. Whether it's a touchy subject or not, Pastor Darrell preaches the scripture. We are a Bible solid church with a strong family community! I love my church!! Several months ago, I attended Ascend Worship Church for the first time and was amazed at the genuinely friendly greeters, the awesome praise and worship and the strong biblical teaching from the Pastor. My experience was transformational.
Since then, I began attending services  weekly and have experienced healing and family.  My children and I enjoy being a part of this ministry.  A few weeks ago, we became members and I am honored to call Ascend Church my home.
If you are looking for a church where Jesus is the center you belong at Ascend.

name: Ascension Lutheran Church and Preschool - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter's attended Ascension Lutheran Preschool and I couldn't have been happier.  My children love going to school to learn and play with their friends and teachers.  The teachers are very supportive and patient with my child.  The curriculum allows for the children to have fun while learning and also teaches them life skills (gardening, being independent and to be able to verbalize their ideas).  The teachers and director have a passion for teaching as well as introducing faith in a kid-friendly and non-denominational way. My daughter has been attending Ascension Lutheran Preschool for 2 yrs.  She has grown verbally, intellectually, and emotionally here. The staff has provided the opportunity for my daughter to learn in a loving group and to develop her own voice and interest.
The school has taught her life skills and to care for the garden.  I love how the staff is so creative in teaching the children. I have been a member of Ascension Lutheran Church for 25 years. Both of my sons were raised in the church and attended Ascension Lutheran School K-8 grade. While they both 'complained' about going to church every Sunday, they have both said as adults that they are grateful for the background it gave them to deal with life. Yeah!

The church welcomes all; children are especially cherished. They are welcome in both the conservative 8:15 service and the contemporary 11:00 service. If they make a little noise, the Lord and all of us hear them and are happy they are there. There is Youth Sunday school for children 2 years old through eighth grade and high school.

We have beautiful organ music in the 8:15 service and meaningful upbeat music presented by a powerful Worship Team in the 11:00 service.

Pastor Michael preaches God's word as presented in the Bible. His sermons are so easy to listen to and follow; the way he presents God's word makes me say, I get it!

After 25 years I am still going to Ascension every Sunday and am grateful to be able to do so. Great place to worship! Pastor Michael’s sermons are uplifting, inspiring and thought provoking. The doctrine is solid and questions are answered with thoughtfulness and care. The music is skillfully chosen to reflect the theme for the day to help provide the impact necessary for the sermon to stick with you.
Bible Studies are available Monday’s, one Friday morning a month before work hours for men, Saturday’s and Sunday ‘s, an active women’s group, things for kids and much more! I would definitely recommend checking Ascension out. We loved this school so much. Our daughter had severe separation anxiety and cried every day for at least a month and the staff was always so sweet to her. They would walk her around to water the plants or let her help out to distract her and after that month she completely changed. She had once been so shy and opened up so much. The facility was always clean and there were so many fun activities that the school planned. There was something so sweet about the families and it was a special community to be a part of. I could not recommend this school enough. It is the sweetest little treasure.

ALL are welcome, from the established Christian to those newly curious about this Jesus character. Hope to see you there! It is a very friendly atmosphere. It is comfortable place that teaches from the Bible consistently.  There are a wide range of ages involved as well. This is a great little Church that is not going to stay little.  The young preacher is delivering the goods: Bible based teaching that hits home.  The youth program is growing and attracting a diverse range of young people.  Do not come to get comfortable.  You will be challenged.

On the down side, some people might find this church a little to small; I have a feeling that is going to change. The preaching is from the bible - not motivational speaking. The pastor is down to earth, and congregation very welcoming. Very welcoming smaller church
Very nice people and also really enjoy the pastor s messages.

reviewSummary: Great place for church groups to volunteer with many different opportunities available. Wonderful place to have a meeting and they are always very welcoming. They sponsor the Festival Choir.  We go out and sing to nursing homes and churches.  Music is spiritual enrichment as much as sermons.

name: Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: This is our spiritual home. One of us grew up here since adolescence and the other came to call it a second home since we started dating. We are blessed to receive our Sacraments here (most recently our wedding!) and create memories with a very loving and generous parish family. We want to shoutout the young adult ministry in particular for bringing together many peers across Southern California. Come check ABVM out! It's always a beautiful experience attending Mass at Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary Roman Catholic Church in Pasadena California This is a Catholic church built in the early 50’s. The exterior is modest but the interior is true to its Mid Century design and aesthetics. It also features very detailed and thematic stain glass windows. A Catholic Church in greater los Angeles and you call their primary number and they don't speak Spanish.... I was here for a celebration of a friend life, nice church

name: At the Cross Christian Fellowship - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church for a while now, and I must say that it's been an amazing experience. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the people are friendly and caring. The messages preached are always thought-provoking and applicable to everyday life, and the worship is heartfelt and engaging. The leadership is excellent, and they go out of their way to ensure that everyone feels valued and included.

What I love most about this church is the sense of community and family that you feel when you're there. It's more than just a place of worship; it's a place where you can connect with others, find support, and grow spiritually.

Overall, I highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking for a place to worship, connect, and grow. The atmosphere here  feels so amazing and welcoming. I have been attending for a few years now and everyone is so friendly and caring. Leadership at this church is excellent and they  make everyone feel like family.  I highly recommend this church to anyone that is looking for a place to worship, the messages preached are always heartfelt. Recently moved into the area and with many churches around, I was really fortunate to know someone who serves here. Sound biblical teachings, great worship and a very intimate family vibe here. This is my church family now. There's a baptism coming up and I'm taking the plunge! My family has been going to this church for quite a while now if you really are looking for a church that will pray over you will show you the meaning of what God tells us to represent. We’re not perfect but we do try to not misrepresent God in any form shape or way we read right out of the Bible you will not be judged you will be loved  on The door is open come as you are as the Lord says all are welcome These people love the Lord and teach the Bible.  Not a big church to get lost in.  I'm enjoying the Bible study and the Bible centered preaching.  Not Calvary Chapel but approach preaching and teaching the same way as Chuck Smith.  I'm staying.

name: At The Cross Oceanside church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Where the rubber meets the road in Christian community and love. I am always so very blessed to worship with the family of At The Cross Oceanside Absolutely amazing church. Cleta and Adam have so many wonderful plans for this church and I just cannot wait to see what God has in store for them, Great plans most likely!! Excellent church! Monday night  there's a Celebrate Recovery meeting that starts at 6pm. They also serve dinner here as well as singing and praising the Lord Great church wonderful Pastor Adam and his beautiful wife, Cleta made us feel right at home. We will be back! Great Church.  Great Pastor only teaches the The Word Of God. Verse by Verse Chapter by Chapter.

name: Athens Christian Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary: Really nice people.  Small church with members who are eager to meet and accept others. Sound Biblical preaching. A very friendly group of people. The church is passionate about its mission.

name: Athens Church - Atlanta Highway - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
We were led to visit Athens Church, because our youngest daughter had a unique encounter with God during an outreach called the “Mix.” We were warmly welcomed from that very first visit! There was and is a genuine respect and reverence for God’s Word, a genuine desire to love people where they are, leading them into a growing and deepening relationship with Jesus and there is also a genuine humility among their leadership!
It wasn’t long before our daughter found a place to grow and be discipled in their high school ministry Transit. My husband and I quickly signed up to join a small group and volunteer in WAMBA (their childrens ministry) it’s here that we found authentic relationships. Athens Church became home and has been now for almost 9 years now. I love what God has done for me through Athens Church 🩷 there are two locations so it’s easy to get to the service regardless of if you’re on the east or westside! The 9:15 am service is good if you have work and the 11 am service is nice if you want to sleep in some!! I take my daughter to UPSTREET and she loves it! I know God always leads me here because I always seem to hear exactly what I need!! Athens Church has been a wonderful place for our family. The atmosphere is welcoming for people of all ages, and the staff and volunteers go out of their way to make everyone feel at home. The messages each week are both inspiring and practical, offering real-life encouragement and meaningful takeaways. I drive 40 minutes to this Church every weekend and I can say proudly that Athens church has helped be grow in my faith tremendously. They truly care, and want the best for you. I am so thankful God brought me to this church! Athens Church gathers in large groups on Sundays, but encourages worship in small groups (vice long rows). There’s a group for everyone, in every age, & every stage of life. You’re invited & welcomed here!

name: Athens Church - Beechwood - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
The church is beautiful inside, and out. There was a HUGE lack of diversity, and I was not a fan of the pastor being on a video verses actually bringing the word in person.  FYI: There was a coffee area, but there were no cups or lids, and the only option that they had for creamer was half and half (I’m lactose intolerant). I did love the coziness of the sanctuary, and all of the lights and screens. It gave a concert vibe to the sanctuary which I enjoyed. The parking was tight we (my husband and I) had to park at crunch fitness, and walk over. Guest services greeted us at the door, but once inside the church no one else spoke to us or really acknowledged us. There was little to no conversation from that point on. Also praise and worship was good no one seemed to be engaging in worship they were mostly just standing, and watching the praise team on the stage. I guess I’m use to more interactions, and movement during praise and worship. So I felt out of place. Athens Church is absolutely incredible. This is one of those rare places where you immediately feel welcomed, not judged. The mission, vision, and values are clear in everything they do: love people well, create a place of belonging, and help people reconnect with what matters most.

For me, Athens Church has become a peaceful refuge from the noise and chaos of the world. Every week, I leave encouraged, calmer, and more grounded. The messages are thoughtful and practical, the people are genuinely kind, and the whole environment feels full of grace.

If you are looking for a church, curious about faith, or just need a place where you can breathe and feel welcomed, go to Athens Church. It is a gift to this community. This church has been an incredible place to serve and grow. The environment is welcoming, uplifting, and full of people who genuinely care about one another. Working with the middle school and high school students has been such a rewarding experience because there is a strong sense of community and support throughout the entire church. The leaders are intentional, the students are engaged, and everyone is encouraged to grow in their faith together. If you’re looking for a church with a great atmosphere, authentic relationships, and a heart for the next generation, I highly recommend it! Been with Athens Church ever since relocating from Dallas, TX. It’s been a wonderful church home for 5 years now. Our kids enjoy it very much as well. Bible based sermons always, but always relevant to today’s world and challenges. Never preachy, but very direct in how we are commanded to live our lives. Even when the topic isn’t easy, they always have a way of bringing an approachable message for everyone. Three of my kids have been baptized since joining here as well. We started at the Atlanta Hwy location, before Beechwood opened, and we hopped in since it’s started about a year and half ago. Highly recommended! We joined Athens Church shortly after moving back to Athens and have been so thankful for the community that we have found. Our children adore going to Waumba Land and look forward to each Sunday! The leadership truly cares about each and every person there and it is evident through their words and actions. Highly recommend if you are looking for a church home!

name: Athens Church of Christ - Athens Campus
reviewSummary: Very engaging & welcoming community of believers of Jesus Christ. They have a great children's ministry with caring and loving staff and teachers. Church is a diverse community of young and old and from different ethnicities which is very refreshing. They worship with and without musical instruments. Loved the message on spiritual giving. They have fallen so far from God their Church is their God. They cast out members who have been loyal members , volunteering their time and are kicked out the door! Sonny was a great pastor but since he left it is not somewhere I would go or let my children go! One of the most loving congregations of believers I have ever been a part of. Variety of worship music to meet many needs, very practical and biblical and enjoyable teaching. There is always a desire to grow and meet needs, and small groups are very helpful in building close relationships. Highly recommend. We love the diversity here, and that people strive to make the Bible their standard. Very hospitable outside of the standard Sun and Wed meetings. Excellent children's program! The staff and elders allow for members to create unique service opportunities in the church and in the community. The members embrace those of unique lifestyles. The only church I will ever be a member of. It is based on biblical principles. I have grown and learned more about Jesus Christ than anywhere else. The congregation loves to worship our Father. We also do our best to obey His Word. No we aren't perfect. And we love the truth. Hope some of you decide to check it out.

name: Athens Victory Chapel - Christian Fellowship Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary: Great church to go to if you’re looking to build a strong relationship with Christ. Everything they preach comes from the Bible, and they always have lots of events going on to get/stay involved! They’re very welcoming of anyone and there’s an especially large amounts of teens/young adults (12-35) that are involved and seem excited to live for God. Definitely recommend Athens Victory Chapel for anyone from any background! Athens Victory Chapel is a big happy family! I have been a member for over 30 years and always look forward to going to church and being in God’s presence. The song service is so uplifting, and the sermons are always timely and encouraging. I am so thankful for our pastors and cherish my friendships at church. I’ve been going to Victory Chapel Athens since I was a teenager. I can’t think of no greater church in the Athens area than Victory Chapel. I’ve established friendships that have lasted for 25+ years! Great quality GOD fearing individuals that attend Victory Chapel. If you are looking for a church in the Athens area that strives to make Jesus a priority, come to Victory Chapel. Started going to this church when I was a UGA student. God led me to this church at the perfect time! Choosing to grow in Christ with the believers at this church is the best decision I’ve ever made. All glory to God! I had a friend who goes here. I sadly can't go to church due to my parents being busy. Does this church accept members of the LGBTQ+ community? I'm omnisexual which means to have an attraction towards all genders & have preferences & is regardless of gender so we do care about the gender. I want a friendly very accepting church for the future. 🏳️‍🌈👍😎

name: Athey Creek Church
reviewSummary:
Came to Athey for the first time on 8/2/2026 to the 12pm service.
Definitely a church I will come to again!

Pros:
- Pastor Brett is thorough in explaining the  Word of God by breaking down the bible verses and presenting it in a way that is tangible, relatable, easy, yet descriptive and true to the meaning.
- Amazing views and design internal and external
- There's a section for family's with noisy children to watch away from the main auditorium.
- The store has bibles, notebooks, merch, christian books. Absolutely love it!
- Free coffee
- Relating to other reviews, if youre disruptive to the service, someone from the church will come to you and either move you to the family section and address to see if youre okay. For someone who is easily bothered by uncessary noises (adolescent noises, speaking during the message, eating/wrapper noises) this was a huge plus!
-Plethora of volunteers, love to see it
- Music was great. Band and singers sounded amazing. Sang modern songs. No hymns.

Cons:
- Parking can be a maze coming in and leaving. Staying past the crowd leaving and arriving early can help with this.
- Limited bathrooms: I believe there's or 8 stalls in the women's bathroom. There was a line to go in after service ended.
- Amazing to see people packing up the auditorium but can be a little stressful. (They are opening a new campus on September 13th right down the street!!)
- May have to walk on tough terrain to get into the church (gravel, hills, grass)

Suggestions: a map/directory would be nice because its a big church!
Overall this is a great church to go to!!

This is the same church that did PDX Crusade!

Sat­ur­day – 4 PM & 6 PM (Begin­ning Sept. 12, ser­vice times will change to 5 PM)
Sun­day – 6 AM (Online Only)
Sun­day – 8 AM, 10 AM, & 12 PM
Sun­day Night Wor­ship – 2nd & 4th Sun­day of each month at 6 PM
Every Wednes­day: Night Bible Study – 7 PM
Prophe­cy Update – 1st Fri­days at 7 PM Great Bible based church. I truly believe they are Holy Spirit led. Sure it's a huge church,  but their team shows love and true fellowship without allowing entitlement of any person to be above an other. True Bible base. Not just the New Testament.  We've gone to many churiches and Athey is the real thing. Pastor Brett teaches people to know and have a real relationship with God the Father, God the Son, Jesus and God the Holy Spirit.  He's not afraid to preach boldly as God wants us to understand and "Know" Him (God). No pretty words that bends the true Word of God to make people feel good about themselves and allow them to be comfortable in their own sins. Book by book, chapter by chapter,  verse by verse.  No pandering to personal entitlement focused individuals. This review is simply to say:
1) keeping children out of the service is appreciated.
2) the Parking lot crew is amazing, shepherding so many cars in and out efficiently at the change of each service.
3) go ahead and wear shorts, Pastor Brett - I am going to!
4) keep making it about the main thing and the main thing is Jesus as told in Gods word, the Holy Bible. We had a wonderful experience at this church. Everyone was so welcoming and kind. The children’s ministry is excellent—our child felt safe, had a great time, and looked forward to coming back. The teachers truly care about the kids and create a fun, loving, and faith-filled environment. We are very grateful to have found this church. Highly recommended! Truly the best church. Pastor Brett and the worship team are so genuine and authentic. I moved away from the PNW in 2022 and still find myself live streaming the services here in Gainesville, Florida.

name: Atlanta Bethel Community Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
First visit, and became a member right after! Bethel Community Church is very welcoming and you will learn from the sermons. A small, Christ-centered church with solid biblical teaching and a warm, loving community. This church was instrumental in allowing me to know the Lord deeply and His love for me. Atlanta Bethel Community Church’s Bible study program also gave me the liberty to know God’s character and His plans for me when I was going through very dark and hopeless times in my life. The pastor and his wife as well as the members are people who truly serve the Lord and give their all for His Kingdom. They are like a family and it was through them where I was able to open my heart to God, and see Him work beautifully in my life. Just as the church helped me regain hope, truth, and life I also wish He could that to you in this wonderful place. God bless all of you reading this message. Amen. Atlanta Bethel Community Church got me through the pandemic which was very stressful on the elderly. It was an uncertain and fearful time, a time of isolation.  But the church had many services to minister to our needs. We had on-line  services,  morning services, Friday night Prayer Service in addition to Sunday and Wednesday services.  In addition to ministering to the needs of the elderly they served the surrounding college students,  with a strong soul winning effort to the college campuses.  The sermons are biblically based in the truth of God's Word.  They feed your body and your soul. Pastor Thomas and his wife, Sister Abu are kind and caring anointed  ministers of God.

If you need ministry and also want a place to serve, it is the place to go. This church is very active in the community. The members are really committed to spreading the good news about Jesus. All the times I have been, the atmosphere is welcoming and full of love. I have been to many churches before, but this one has truly changed my life.

name: Atlanta Chinese Christian Church - Tucker Campus
reviewSummary: God is here working so come here to hear the gospel preached by David Lee! Biggest and best Chinese Church in Atlanta I think the church was beautiful. Good 🤩🥳

name: Atlanta Christian Assembly - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary: Thriving multi-generational community in Eagle Rock bridging Pasadena and Glendale, praised for inspiring worship, life-giving small groups, and kids ministries.

name: Atlanta Christian Assembly - North Decatur / Emory Campus
reviewSummary: A Christian get together place, welcoming and loving place Great church, friendly church members Great experience U friendly patrons Great place to worship god

name: Atlanta Christian Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful community of Believers. I visited due to being invited by one of the leaders of the church who just so happened to be my neighbor. His daughter and mine go to school and do life together. My daughter LOVES attending here regularly and I feel comforted knowing she's in good hands with God and his people here while I serve on the other side of town. Thanks ACC! This is my daughter and son-in-law's church and my wife and I had the privileged to visit with them this past weekend.  Truly enjoyed the service and we felt that Pastor Sweatman delivered a wonderful Lenten message.
We look forward to more visits in the future when we are in town.   Thank you to everyone at ACC. Lead Pastor Derek Sweatman is a down to earth guy who leads the church well. Sermons are packed with knowledge and truth, but delivered in a way where you feel like you're just grabbing coffee with a friend. Atlanta Christian Church isn't pretentious and it's anything but "clicky". The church body includes people from all walks of life and everyone has a place there. It's easy to call it home. Great acoustics for congregational singing!!! Calmness and good

name: Atlanta Christian Fellowship Church - Lawrenceville Campus
Atlanta Dream Center Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: I'm new to Georgia, looking for a home church. Since there are so many churches, I decided to listen online first to find a fit for me. I just sat through their online service tonight. The message was AWESOME! He touched on many things I am struggling with right now. And a lot of those things were side notes from his sermon for the night. Perfect for me. I will be attending in person. Okay so I have been attending this church for over a year now and I have come every single week unless I’m out of town. I have not only attended, but have volunteered, joined fellowship groups, and worked closely with leadership. I’ve read the lawsuit. Would never accuse falsehood on trauma. I just want to come on here and say that NEVER once have I or any one of the volunteers I’ve personally encountered been treated untowardly or inappropriately. The actions in the lawsuit occurred over a decade ago and the church has changed leadership and programming since. Atlanta Dream Center today is a place where all can come and worship and enjoy fellowship together. Please come and see for yourself and make your own opinions. I know you won’t be sorry. By far the best church EVER!! God is definitely here and you feel him. I dont feel judged my ANYONE. I am shown nothing but LOVE!! Great pastors! The church and its members are doing great work in the city, working hard with youth groups from around the country to bring the Gospel to everyone. A Church for Everyone! That's the church moto, and it holds true. It's difficult not to feel at home and loved here; many people living like Jesus here. The love & care is tangible.

name: Atlanta First United Methodist Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended an organ recital here and reveled in the beauty of the music and the building. The staff is friendly and it's well kept.

The church is easily reached from the civic center MARTA station and there is limited parking.

There is a wheelchair accessible entry on the southern side of the building. This local place of worship that I have passed by time and time again for the past 20 + years was very kind in opening up their doors for people to use their facilities after the Dragon Con parade. They have a beautiful sanctuary Great place to worship, not a huge congregation so it won't take you long to get to know everyone. I've been looking for a church in Atlanta that is welcoming, passionate about God and their community, and authentic. I have found these qualities in this church, and am so excited to be a part of it now. Pastor Jasmine is a powerful and moving speaker, and carries a strong message into the hearts of the congregation. Definitely recommend. And a beautiful worship space! Nice but different than traditional Easter service.   Change can be good for us all.

name: Atlanta Good Shepherd - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is an incredible blessing! I've been a part of this vibrant community my entire life, and I can’t say enough about how amazing it is here. The pastor is inspiring, the people are welcoming, and the messages are uplifting. You absolutely have to come and experience the incredible work God is doing for everyone in the community. This church truly loves its neighborhood and actively reaches out to make a difference. Plus, there’s a fantastic community garden where everyone is invited to volunteer and connect with one another. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to be part of something special! I joined the Bible study on Sunday morning and Wednesday evening,  by Pastor Richard Bright and Pastor Hill. I live in Southern California and when I tune in, they make me feel as though I’m in the church attending services. Both pastors are very good and make you feel the word of God. I enjoy the knowledge of the members that attend the Bible sessions, every week.
God is so good to bring me back to the words of the Bible.
Thanks to Johnny McPherson and Glover Martin 🙏🏽 If you're looking to hear the word of God, this is the place.  If you are a Christian seeking growth,  this is the place. Lovely gardens out back. And love their supporting honey bees! Bravo. Community centric focused on God's assignment

name: Atlanta International Christian Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary: This church is transformed my wife & I’s lives in ways we could have never imagined! It’s very rare to find a group so loving and supporting while still striving to live out the principles of the Scriptures to the best of our ability. This is my family until the end! My life will never be the same. I’ve never seen such a revival of Discipleship and the love I’ve seen from this body of believers! This church is super diverse and looks more like heaven than most churches. This place has truly helped me change my life spiritually. You feel like family as soon as you walk through the doors. They also preach the word and nothing but the truth! 10/10 must recommend! Changed my life! The loving brothers and sisters here help me to live by the scriptures everyday and since joining my life has been nothing short of an adventure! Glory be to God 🙌 Our family was welcomed by so many and it was great to worship With other believers as we are from the Northeast- We moved our son & his wife here for college. We love the Lord and were able to be a part of 2 precious souls who have publicly professed their faith in Jesus and entered the waters of baptism- To God be all the Glory for the Great things He has done! May the Lord Bless you as you continue to serve Him!

name: Atlanta Vineyard Church - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary: Atlanta Vineyard Church is such a loving Family Church. The Homeless Outreach on Thanksgiving Day was a great way to show love. Come Visit you'll never experience anything else like it. I’ve attended a couple of times.  The preaching/teaching is very scriptural.  The focus is on GOD.  Worship is from the heart and truly worshipful. Everyone there has been very friendly. Been to church my entire life. Stumbled across Vineyard a few years ago. It has changed my life as a Christian. This church in particular is filled with loving people that will welcome you as soon as you step in the door. Come for the community, stay for the presence of Jesus. I go to this church in Atlanta! Great people, real welcoming, great small group to connect closer with the congregation, and pastor Ralph and his wife Vicki are really great people and the sermons are challenging and informative. Everyone was very welcoming, thoroughly enjoyed worshipping with them while in town visiting my daughter and her family.

name: Atlanta West Pentecostal Church - Lithia Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We had a great time and my kids all agreed we should definitely make a return!
The new building preview was very fun to explore on Easter Sunday.
Enjoyed the shuttle and very nice people. I visited this church for the first time on 3 May 2026 and was quite excited.  Everyone was friendly, from the shuttle drivers to the greeters at the doors.  A nice lady sitting in front of me greeted me warmly, and we chatted for a few minutes.  The worship service was nice, and all the announcements and impacts were great to hear.  Up to this point, I was good, thinking that if the preaching/doctrine is spot on in accordance with Biblical principles, then we would be home free.  A guest preacher spoke, and I have to say that what he preached did not align with scripture.  His message was about renewing your mind.  Nothing wrong with that.  He said he was going to do an altar call later, and he wants people to come up with their minds, not their hearts.  That was when the music screeched to a stop in my head.  It all starts in the heart, so I didn’t understand why he would say that.  He kept alluding to the mind only, without incorporating the heart.  He began in Ephesians 4:20-23, which discusses the renewing of the mind, but he failed to put that scripture in context with what was said before it in verses 17-19, where it says people are darkened in their understanding because of the hardness of their hearts.  Sound familiar? Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and other examples in the Bible.  You cannot have a changed mind if the heart is hardened, and this pastor did not incorporate the heart.  There was another scripture he brought up, I think it was Philippians 4:6-7.  He was trying to keep it about the mind, but verse 7 clearly states the guarding of hearts and minds.  Then, a lady in the audience just interrupted the sermon by “prophesying.”  Why was that allowed?   At the end of the sermon, he said it again: come to alter, but bring your mind, not your heart.  That was it, I got up and walked out.  This was a guest pastor, so if that kind of out-of-context teaching is allowed because people want to sensationalize the Word, then I do not need to return to hear what the actual pastor has to say.  I had such high hopes because I want to be connected to a local church that preaches the Word, not adding to or taking away from scripture that the Bible clearly warns against (Deut 4:2, 12:32; Prov 30:5-6; Rev 22:18-19). This has been my church for two years now, and when I say you can feel God‘s presence every time I mean that!!! God is making waves at this place!! Come check it out Such a sweet atmosphere! The greetings, the Word, the people, and the entire visit was beyond welcoming! The Pastor truly has a heart for GOD and preaches with such fire and passion. The Spirit of GOD is heavily here and I'm grateful that GOD led us to where His Spirit resides. I plan on returning soon! 🙌🏾🤍🫶🏾 I have to start off by starting that I have never attended this church.  I do sometimes give my best friend rides to and from there.  And my best friend said this church is great.  And I absolutely trust his judgement, especially in this area.  He knows a lot about different churches and can almost prove mathematically which one is the best.  Go here.  You won't be disappointed.  You might even see me there sometime.

name: Auburn Grace Community Church - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary: I visited Auburn Grace’s 10:45 service with my family. The greeters were very attentive and noticed us right away. We got a nice packet of information when we arrived. The worship was nice. Pastor Phil was starting a new series about Christmas Promises. I thought his sermon was well-prepared and thoughtful and he was very personable. We had a good experience. I've attended both the youth and adult services now and I like the pastors and the sermons are pretty good. The building itself is also very neat and the people are friendly. Would recommend. I love our new church. Services are always good and the church community events are top notch. We had an amazing time at a recent dinner and concert event with Tim and the Glory Boys. They partnered up with Food for the Hungry to get sponsors for South African children. My parents Mike and Linda attend this church and my children and I have come as guests. Recently I sent a kind note along with a gofundme to help keep my children’s heat on as a single mother; not only did they not pass along the information to their congregation (while collecting their money tax free) but I did not even recieve a response at all. So disappointing to learn who Christian’s really are. I was a little reluctant to come back after breaking up with the person that introduced me to this church. When I originally came with my friend a couple months ago it was my first church visit in many, many, many years, but my desire to build a closer relationship with Jesus over the last couple years prompted her to finally haul my nervous/reluctant fanny over to Auburn Grace Community Church. As I said we broke up so I tried to find another church and tried several others in the area, but none were as uplifting, kind, and meaningful in my experience as Auburn Grace (no offense to the other churches). Today's service was extremely uplifting, inspiring, and left me with plenty of contemplations to focus on throughout the week. I am excited to come back and hear more amazing sermons and meet some more nice folks. Highly recommended for new/renewed believers such as myself. Thank you Auburn Grace Community Church, I really appreciate your help. #prayersforjustin

name: Aurora Christian Center - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary: A year ago we visited and we felt welcomed by everyone. We felt the presence of the Lord and we haven't left. We made it our home church. I was led to visit this church. I am grateful I went although I was late to the service, the little time I spent there was wonderful. Where the spirit of the Lord is, there is joy. Such a friendly place of worship. Live it. True worship of God! Great preaching and people make you feel at home Warm welcome just like a family.

name: Austin Christian Assembly - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: PTL! Good. A warm church filled with God's love [object Object] [object Object]

name: Austin Christian Fellowship - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
This church lives out the truth and makes you feel at home. It’s very easy to get connected and they do a great job at giving you opportunities to serve and build God’s kingdom in many different ways! The senior pastor, Kenton and his wife Emily, are kind and humble people who preach the true Word! And the whole staff are kind and helpful! Just got back from the 2019 men's summit at camp Buckner.  I don't get much time to get to church because of work this was an amazing experience and everybody was so welcoming and understanding, I only wish I could have spent more time with them their knowledge and faith is strong.
Thank you ACF, I'll be looking forward to participating more, what a great community. Really disturbed about how they handle social distancing and  apparently disregard everyone's safety.
My daughter is part of the youth group and attended their Wednesday night program. The youth leaders told them not to worry about wearing masks and to pack the church next week.
Is this how you take care of you fellow citizen but putting them, their parents and grandparents in harms way? In my opinion this is highly irresponsible and should be addressed by the church leaders immediately.  We will not be sending our children back to ACF until this issue has been addressed. I've been attending ACF since 2007 and have served as a volunteer in many capacities.  ACF is mission-minded whose aim is to give away 50% of our monthly contributions to mission partners in Austin as well as around the world.  There are many ways to plug into volunteer opportunities, small groups, mission trips, women's/men's ministries, creative arts, kids/student ministries and guest services to name a few.  ACF feels like home, and it's a joy to serve.  I don't ever want to stop feeling the way I do when I serve.  ACF's mission is to know, love and serve Jesus Christ.

When a visitor walks through the door, they are embraced and if they fill our an information card, will be contacted with the information needed to dig deeper into the body of Christ.

There are many resources available to us all as a body, and have no doubt that ACF will remain at our side should we fall on hard times and assemble to meet any needs.

Give ACF a try, Sundays 9:3 am and 11:15 am with the Middle-and High School Students worshiping on Sunday mornings in the Student Building. I am truly impressed by this church! No church is perfect and have already ran into some “bumps” but God has used them to grow me. A lot of times “bumps” are areas we need to change.

I had walked away from God and KNEW that the guy moving into our apartment complex that shared a backyard was a believer. So I AVOIDED HIM LIKE THE PLAGUE! 😂

He ended up inviting us to church. And God began to tear us down to our foundation so HE could rebuild everything! My husband was set free from a 10 year pain pill addiction, and I solidified my freedom from clinically diagnosed depression among other things!

The main campus has a lot of wealthier attendees which can be intimidating for some, but if you go to some of the other campuses (meet in gyms and schools) you will find people that are in similar socioeconomic statuses. It didn’t bother me but it was hard for my husband to connect with people at the main campus.

Small groups were amazing within the first 3 months of attending we ended up having to move in with my parents which was SUPER embarrassing but God was rebuilding! Well our small group leader came and helped us move and stayed till 11pm and we had to force him to leave! And some other small group members helped as well!!

The senior pastor Will and Suzi Davis are amazingly kind and remind me of my parents. They are very warm and inviting! Will stayed after service numerous times to pray for us when we were going through all these really hard times! And to this day will give us and our kiddos big hugs when we see him! (we are at the Hutto campus now, started at the main campus, moved to Leander with my parents where we attended Brushy Creek campus, helped launch Round Rock campus and are now helping launch the Hutto campus)

Pastor Will is also very intellectual in his deliverance of his messages and they are always something I needed to hear! Also about 3 years ago he openly admitted he was experiencing depression and the church allowed him to take a sabbatical 😱... I have never seen a church do that! AND when he did he invited local pastors to come and speak!? 😱 That was amazing that he had no fear that he would “loose his congregation” to someone down the road.

Also this church gives away half of what comes in sometimes even to other churches 😱😱😱which is in the millions! The other half goes to the 6 campuses, staff at those campuses, bills for all those campuses etc it doesn’t all pad the pastor’s wallet! And have been at 4 of the campuses I can tell you they run them well and pour a lot of finances into them to operate.

For instance in Round Rock they have a FREE special needs Sumer camp (sometimes winter and fall!) that is a WEEK long they hire paraprofessionals to help with the kids. And then they also have church members help out so the brothers and sisters of the special needs kids can have fun with them too!! AND they send the parents out on date nights every day for 5 days and PAY for their meal or activity!? 😱😱😱😱

Also Suzi Davis the pastor’s wife is AMAZING! She helped inspire If:Gathering and cooperates and attends reconciliation circles with Be the Bridge (a racial reconciliation group). And Pastor Will meets weekly with Austin area pastors to pray and strategize on how to effectively spread the gospel. Which to me is amazing as the past churches I attended we a “us 4 and no more” mentality. And that isn’t how the church should operate in my opinion. But God has healed that hurt.

So to the lady who gave Acf a one star I am so extremely sorry you had a bad experience! I have been in your shoes before but I HOPE AND PRAY God brings healing to you and draws you back to him! And shows you the church you are meant to be at that clicks for you, and inspires you to grow. And that one day you will be able to forgive because when we do it is so freeing to let it go and move on! 😘😘😘

name: Austin Foursquare Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome Church It's great to listen to the sermons.  I go there on Sundays.  They also do more worship services on Wednesday  evening.  I'm not able to attend because I have to work.  All the people are nice.  It's absolutely wonderful singing songs of praise & worshiping  Christ Jesus with so many Christians that loves the Lord as much as I do. Really inviting. People are authentic. Best church in the area that I’ve been to. Lots of college age people and young parents. Quality worship. You can tell the band isn’t as worried about putting on a show as much they are just worshiping Jesus. The pastor is humble and lives out what he preaches (I have spent a lot of time with him/his family outside Sunday and he is the exact same person as he is on stage). His teachings are theologically sound and applicable to everyday life. Offers child care, has comfy chairs, A/C is good temperature, place is clean, and has donuts/coffee. People hang out before and after service, and the vibe feels like a family-get-together that isn’t awkward. Fantastic place of worship
This place of gathering is not only a church but we are a family. This church is my favorite due to the fact that they except you as you are. The first time I came to the church, the first thing that stuck out to me was how welcoming everyone is. Pastor Eric and Lea are the most down to earth people you will ever meet. I encourage you to come to our church. Al and I love this church for many reasons. They are authenic, loving, thriving and living the love of Jesus. Eric and Leah have the right qualities needed to lead and I trust them to do all that is needed to keep this church family healthy and alive spiritually. Love this life church great people welcoming to all. Need prayer come here. Need family come here . Need jesus come here. You can feel the love...

name: Austin Life Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely church, very friendly people with a good message. I liked how they worked to help their community out and it felt pretty low key. In Austin for the weekend and Attended the 9am service this morning.  Wonderful welcoming community of believers.  Solid Bible teaching and good worship.  Today’s sermon on ‘peace’ (2nd week of Advent) is timeless; thank you Pastor! I was staying in a nearby hotel and decided to walk across the parking lot for their 10:30 a.m. service. They hold church in what I believe is a Boy Scouts of America building.  I know that this service was perfectly planned just for me. :-) The Holy Spirit used this excellent young Pastor (Cory) to preach directly from God's Word into my heart.    I felt very welcomed and comfortable there.    Expect to hear about the love of Jesus and God's plan for His people to seek holiness.  Holy Spirit is moving in this church. We attended Austin Life for about 8 months before moving out of state. I really appreciate the fact that the pastors read full passages from scripture, break it down in a consumable way, and they don’t avoid the difficult topics. This is a church that follows the Bible and tries their best to walk in the same steps as Jesus. If you want to find community, get involved, and do life with genuine people - look no further than ALC. I found so much joy, guidance, life, and community at Austin Life! This church is preaching the gospel and shows what true community looks like. Cory Johnson and Mike Mobley are fantastic leaders. My community group not only helped me dive deeper into the Bible, but also provided much needed laughs and light heartendess when necessary. There is always a way to get involved around the community. They provide opportunities to evangelize and further your leadership skills. I participated in prayer nights, worship nights, prayer walks, and foundational classes on the Gospel.  Although I moved away from Austin, I made sure to stay plugged in. Cory and Mike still keep up with me, and aid in fostering my spiritual growth! I love Austin Life!!

name: Austin New Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
How does one review an experience so beautiful, powerful, and intimate?
Well, as this 1st-timer with no real expectations found out today, I was so moved by the VIBE in the ANC: the attendants, initial speaker, pastor, and the singing musician all let forth a wonderful and warm feeling in the spirit of Christ our Lord and just flat-out positive humanity.
The sermon was equal parts faith, history, progressive ideas, humor sprinkled with personal anecdotes, and encouragement to lift oneself up to share & give to our fellow person.
And who doesn't need more of that?
I feel very lucky/BLESSED to have heard of these ongoing Sunday at 10:30am services and am looking forward to the next one...
All was quite inspiring!
Thank You ANC. Peace & Love ❤️ Praise and worship...superb. pastor Jason, excellent man of God! Open, accepting, and honorable! A great teacher of the word. Thank you for feeding my spirit! First time here today and honestly such a beautiful experience. Cannot wait to go again next weekend. Beautiful worship, sermon, and Pastor was so kind. Just visited, very cool church.  Music was great, the building has lovely stained glass windows, and the message was inspiring.  People were very welcoming, and I got a sense this church is a place of healing for a lot of people.  It’s a very inclusive, progressive church. A beautiful welcoming community, guided by hospitality, scripture and pastors who open up brains and hearts with their kindness, questions and candor.

name: Austin Ridge Bible Church
reviewSummary: Clear, verse-by-verse biblical exposition by Brad Thomas, exceptional children and student programs, and strong community in West Austin and Bee Cave.

reviewSummary: Clear, verse-by-verse biblical exposition by Brad Thomas, exceptional children and student programs, and strong community in West Austin and Bee Cave.

name: Author's Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is amazing! The sermons are enthusiastic and made relatable which really helps. They offer child care and other family activities. They have a strong tie to the community and encourage people to take active rolls in it. This church has really reinvigorated my faith. It makes coming to church fun and something to look forward to. The music is amazing too. I was a big fan of Pastor Jim & Faith CC.
This new church is unnecessarily political.
Failed at being funny.
I will no longer be attending after 25 yrs of happily & proudly being tied to Reeve family churches. I’ve been attending this church for many years, and I’ve seen significant changes over time. While the church promotes values of family and connection, my recent experience was disheartening. I came to worship with my family, including my 1-year-old, and was asked to leave the service because my child was making some noise. Rather than feeling welcomed and supported, we were told to watch the service online, something I wouldn’t have driven to church for if that were my intention.

We weren’t offered a more accommodating space like an overflow room. Instead, we were directed to sit in the lobby, where the environment was so noisy that I couldn’t meaningfully participate in the service. The response we received felt more focused on maintaining a certain image for the livestream than on supporting families who are trying to stay connected to God in person.

It’s also concerning how much pressure is placed on families to leave their children in the kids’ area. Not every parent feels comfortable doing that, and it should be okay to keep young children with us during worship. Unfortunately, experiences like this are becoming more common, and it’s not surprising that many families have chosen to leave.

It saddens me to say this, but the church no longer feels as welcoming as it once did. I hope leadership reflects deeply on how their actions are impacting the very families they claim to value. An uplifting Christian Church, very direct and straight forward sermons.
If you come from a traditional conservative church, it will shock you but you will start liking it little by little. This is a very open minded church so please be open minded, don’t compare or judge.
I’m not a regular of this church but once in a while I like coming here because the amazing worship team and all pastors are energize and they are transparent as well. I like service that is direct and they can talk about any subject. I loved when the senior pastor mentioned the word “sex” couple time., it was hilarious.
Yes, they are not afraid to speak up when is tithe time, very direct and bold. Loved FCC and Pastor Jim. New Church and Pastor Dan not so much.

name: Avenue Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church! I have lots of great friends here. It’s a diverse/life giving church. If you’re in the southwest area and looking for a church home, check out Avenue Church!! I feel the message every time I’ve attended, today I was late but I always feel the power of the holy spirit. I feel It speaks directly to me. I love that!
I also appreciate the way pastor Jeremy connects with the youth. My kids understand the message I’ve witnessed them shed tears over how he actually gets through to them. Something, I’ve tried to do over the years. I appreciate this church so much. They’re welcoming, friendly and inviting “feels like family”. If you haven’t given this church a try and you’re searching for that feeling of “wholeness” this is it. Times have been rough for my family especially through Covid. I’ve felt my hope fade in so many ways and have watched the life get sucked out of my children. Today I was able to attend breakfast after service with laughter and smiles. Thank you so much for returning the Hope, faith, belief and trust to my kids and family. Can’t wait for next week😁 Pastor Jeremy really helped me today.
He had a young man on stage this morning that told his story which I could relate to similarly.  After the service I went up to Pastor Jeremy and asked him if I could speak to him and wanted to mention that. As well as a Thank you, and let him know a small portion of what burdens me mentally with a terrible end to my marriage.
He prayed over me for a few moments and Instantly I felt relief, calmness, tranquility and just lighter. I choked up couldn't beleive how much better and instantaneous it helped.
I am new to Christianity and those moments really make me beleive much more and maintain faith where as I wasn't brought up with church growing up. Each Sunday I attend feels Uplifting, and I can tell theres a great community here, of loving people.
So Thank you Pastor Jeff and Pastor Lindsay, You're helping ease a pained mind - For welcoming me, as well as my daughter Lilah when she attends the kids section.
Derick R. Avenue Church's kid's service is outstanding! If you have little ones and want them to get plugged into a age-appropriate service designed specifically for them complete with worship, prayer time, devotionals, and more! The Avenue Kids team are the cream of the crop. The best of the best. The cheese to my pasta. The burrito to my... you get the idea. Our kids are our future, so let's prepare them for it as best as we can by reaching them and teaching them through the amazing leaders that serve each and every Sunday at 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM. Can't wait to see you there! I was invited to this church by a coworker I hardly knew (who later became a great friend) and this church has become home. The pastors are so inviting and encourage all attendees to reach their full potential and deepen their relationship with God. If youre someone who has been trying to find a church to call home, definitely consider giving this church a visit! woooooo

name: Avenue Church - Murfreesboro Campus
reviewSummary:
Finding Avenue has changed my life and the life of my family. When I saw came, I felt lost and adrift, but after really discovering the beauty of a deeper connection to God and do in community has been life giving. Not only do I call Avenue home but it is full of people that have become family to me. I am so incredibly grateful and blessed to have each and every one of them in our life! 5 stars because they uphold their mission: “We exist to help you know and follow Jesus in community for a transformed life.”

I’m always excited for Sunday.
Avenue is my favorite place and Sunday is my favorite day. 🥹 I’ve attended Avenue nearly every Sunday for almost 3 years (!!)

I need community + worship + Bible. Avenue always delivers.
I don’t ever leave church thinking “eh, that could have been better.” I always feel welcomed, loved, rejuvenated, strengthened and exhorted after service!

Through prayer groups, small groups, the ample time to “linger,” it feels genuine because it is.

WHY AVENUE?
Verses that minister to me and align with my experience at Avenue.

- Hebrews 10:24-25 (Jesus can return at anytime. We must remain in community and motivate and exhort one another with love and kindness).
-Galatians 4:5-6 (Jesus paid the price for my freedom from the law; I am a child of God; and His Holy Spirit dwells within me).
-Matthew 6:33 (Everything I have comes from God. He is my provider and I must seek His kingdom above all else). 🙏
-Isaiah 58:6-11 (God yearns for our worship in the form of serving and ministry! And, that He knows our heart’s posture and “the Lord will guide you, continually,” He is constant and we are never forsaken. ❤️‍🔥).
-Psalm 100:2 “Worship the Lord with gladness. Come before him, singing with joy.” Avenue Worship team is a blessing. The music feels intimate and inviting.  The Holy Spirit filling the sanctuary.. is so …. Literally, filling. 😌 Amazing. Pastor Stephen is a such blessing. And the people at Ave are all so friendly and inviting.

Great Church. Could not recommend it enough. My husband and I have been going to Avenue since 2022, and on our first visit we instantly felt welcome and at home. The people of Avenue church truly have a heart to serve, and serve with joy. The pastors at Avenue are intentional with their relationships with the church members, and will always make themselves available for those who call on them for help. The people of Avenue Church are such a fun, loving, and generous community that embrace you and aren’t afraid to pray over you. Come and see for yourself!! Avenue has absolutely changed my & my husband’s life! We started coming here a few months after they had started as a church plant and after struggling with the church in general, dealing with hurt from past experiences, we came in vulnerable & really not ready to “join” another church. But GOD had other plans. He worked through the people at Avenue & gave us the most amazing local community, friends, & healing experience. I can’t imagine my life without Avenue! It’s not really about the church itself - but the people who serve there & who put themselves out there to be used by God & a part of HIS greater plan. Come for a visit & experience God’s love & the way of Jesus!

name: Avon Christian Church - Avon Campus
reviewSummary: This a welcoming church that invites all to participate. Every age is involved in the  life of Avon Christian. The church is at ground level and is completely handicapped accessible. This warm, friendly group of believers is a welcoming place to learn and grow spiritually. Down to earth, unpretentious and genuine people come together to welcome ALL people --people of diverse ability, ages, ethnicities, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, nationality, political affiliation, race, sexual orientation, or any other distinction. I've been attending church all of my life, and I can't remember a congregation that made me feel so welcome, so quickly. As much as anything, I value their love for each other and their willingness to embrace the fact that we all hold different beliefs and theologies that inform our faith. This church "walks the talk!" They are working with Habitat for Humanity to provide affordable housing in Avon. They are warm, and truly welcome all including LGBTQIA! This church is just like a family.   The church really works hard to serve the community as well.  Very friendly atmosphere. Great church filled with friendly worshippers. Senior minister is a terrific preacher.  Very powerful, thoughtful, bible based messages.

name: Avon Heights church of Christ - Avon Campus
reviewSummary: Today was my first time ever willingly going to church at almost 32 years old. Been many times to others for extended family etc but never liked it. Something brought me to want to give this place a chance.  ( complete randomness because 24 hours ago I would have not considered ever going to church ) I was immediately welcomed in and helped by two wonderful people Josh and Rachel who were very understanding just how clueless I was on how everything worked and took time out of their own service time to help me get a grasp on what to do. Took the anxiety right out of it. Everyone there was very friendly and welcoming and I definitely plan to return! This place is filled with people who love God and love each other. Very friendly people. Bible based, spiritually led pastor. Friendly biblical congregation of saints

name: Avon Light and Life Church - Avon Campus
reviewSummary:
I came here based on a recommendation from my neighbor of 6 years who attends with his wife. I’ve been struggling with some significant issues and health care system has not helped on 5 occasions so I decided to try on a spiritual level. I asked the man doing the food drive if there was anyone I could speak with who was open minded. He took me to Brooke. She was very cordial and polite but not welcoming or loving whatsoever. She didn’t hear me out and dismissed everything I said based on the fact that it didnt or hasn’t happened to her. I felt called to bring light to this information as I am early to know it and it affects society as a whole. I just have had more exposure due to work environment and was immunocompromised due to two recent eye surgeries which is why it’s so prevalent in me. I don’t feel that how she treated me and even walked me to the door was right. It wasn’t in a caring way but a make sure this crazy person is actually leaving way. I felt very judged and left in tears. I explained this was my first time back inside a church since age 7 and I am 32 now. This didn’t help but I’ll pray for Brooke and her family as she will unfortunately regret not hearing me out when all of this information starts becoming public knowledge and she could have helped the cause. I will also continue on my search to find someone who can be loving and accepting regardless of their own opinions and can be open minded enough to understand that just because you don’t have personal experience with something, doesn’t make it automatically wrong or false. This was a very serious conversation that was taken lightly. I was called a conspiracy theorist and told that there was nothing the church could do to help me when all I wanted was a true open conversation and some advice if there was any to give. I don’t need to have been in church physically to know the bible and people called Jesus crazy and tried to discredit him too including his own family, let’s not forget this. Amazing church with amazingly generous people who go out of their way to help. They have been feeding me on and off for years when money was tight and I needed help. Teri, Gwendolyn, Marsha, Karen, George, Chris, and others volunteer their time every single week to help keep hundreds of local people fed in the community. They are truly doing God's work and I couldn't be more thankful to them and the church for all of the help over the years. A truly great church with a big heart for helping the community. Thank you.

Sincerely, Michael I was treated like I was the lowest form of a human being today it was hard for me to even have to go to this pantry today my first time coming there and it will be my last I set in line for 45 minutes which I did not mind I was grateful for the help I watched the elderly gentleman going car to car he skipped passed mine I wasn't sure what he was doing as this was my first time coming there I even had to ask how do I get in line where do I get in line to another elderly gentleman that was directing traffic who directed me to the second line and I sat there for the 45 minutes patiently waiting my turn when I got up to the underpass where they were loading the groceries into the car the woman asked for my number I told her I had not received one she then walked away from my car and yelled we've got another line cutter which I was not she took my ID and the piece of mail that I brought with me and hollered again we have another line cutter second one which again I was not she then walked over to the gentleman that had skipped me and went to the car behind me obviously giving the numbers when I asked her did he let her know that I had been setting in that line she said no and I politely told her that she was being very rude that I was not a line cutter and that it was difficult for me to be here in the first place let alone someone to be calling me a line cutter and making me feel bad and then an older gentleman from the inside yelled at me and said we don't have to help you. you can go ahead and leave if you want. Well I wouldn't have been there unless I needed the help so of course I didn't want to leave I just wanted to be treated with decency. So like I said this is my first time going there and this will be my last. I know God will provide for me some other way all I can say to the dark-haired slender woman please do better because I don't think your attitude today was godly in any way. This pantry has helped me a great deal,
Today the lady asked us not to come till 12, Which is fine, I come after dropping children off, Because I have a limited amount of gas.
Then she came back and Told us all to leave, Angrily Because the car came through the parking lot too fast,
Why not tell them that they are not allowed to return, Instead of taking it out on everyone!
I understand safety for children, If they did not, then they should be banned.
But I do think she should be a little more professional, And compassionate To the people who are not causing the problem!
And we should probably tell our volunteers to slow down a volunteer just came through the parking lot as fast as the car she was mad at and parked.
