name: Awaken Church - Jacksonville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this community of believers, I have been attending for almost five years now. I am growing in the knowledge of God and in fellowship. ♥️🙏 Awaken Church has truly created an inclusive and vibrant community that welcomes people from all walks of life. As a relatively new member of this church, I have experienced firsthand the warmth, love, and genuine care that radiate throughout the congregation. The church's commitment to fostering a welcoming atmosphere for all ages and demographics is commendable and sets it apart from many others.

One of the most remarkable aspects of Awaken Church is its ability to connect people from various backgrounds and life stages. From families with young children to single individuals and even seniors, everyone is made to feel valued and accepted. The leadership and volunteers go above and beyond to create an environment where everyone can find their place and experience a true sense of belonging.

The range of connection groups offered by Awaken Church is truly impressive. Whether you're seeking a tight-knit community, spiritual growth, or a place to share common interests, there is a group for you. I have personally participated in the young adult group and a few of the home groups, and they have been instrumental in forming lasting friendships and deepening my faith. These groups provide a supportive space for individuals to connect, learn, and grow together in our faith.

Furthermore, the engaging worship experiences at Awaken Church are truly uplifting and meaningful. The talented musicians and worship team create an atmosphere of heartfelt praise and worship, which allows attendees to connect with God in a powerful way. The messages delivered by the pastors are thought-provoking and relevant, providing spiritual nourishment and guidance for daily living. I joined Awaken 4 years ago, and what immediately stood out to me was its community. The people are friendly and welcoming, and it's small enough that you get to know people, while large enough that there's always new people to talk to. They operate on a rotating model of leadership, so there are a few pastors who preach, meaning you get to hear different perspectives and styles (same with worship team, etc). All pastors are deeply rooted in the word and take a humble, realistic approach, though. I find the sermons relevant and socially aware, speaking firmly about Biblical truth in gentleness and with an understanding of how it relates to us where we are. Awaken emphasizes discipleship, and its leadership is accessible if you are interested in leadership or starting an initiative yourself. Overall I'd say Awaken focuses well on community and serving the Lord in a way that is adaptable and always striving for improvement. Definitely at least worth a visit if you're looking for a church to try. As a partner with Awaken for the past three years, I have really appreciated the welcoming environment, solid and relevant biblical teaching, and the community I have built through participation in small groups and the weekly service.

I love that it's small enough that I am able to know most of the regular attendees, and I feel that they have a very wise leadership structure. (Three pastors co-lead, hold each other accountable, and must be in agreement on church decisions.). They also approach a lot of ministries with intentionality and have structures in place to avoid burnout.

Ultimately, a small but dedicated church that is active in ministry and in the community. I've been a part of this community for over 12 years, and I love the teaching and the people!  It's led by multiple Pastors, so they have accountability with one another, and they genuinely try to submit to God's leadership over them and the Church.  The people are very welcoming and sincerely care about one another.  I've made wonderful friends here that are now like family!  They have a solid Children's ministry and Youth Group, not flashy or over the top, but they teach the kids and love them well.  And one of my favorite things is the Homegroups!  They have several options that meet throughout the week in homes around the city, and these are a great opportunity to go deeper with people and grow together.  Come on out and join us!  We'd love to welcome you. :-)

name: Awaken Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Hands down the best church around. You're welcomed from the second you walk in, on any day at any time. There is never a person "not in the mood" to give you the longer explanation, or help you. There is never a time where you feel uncomfortable, and if you do, someone is around eventually to offer a helping hand or direction.
From trying to figure out who God is to learning what a village actually is.. this is the best church to be apart of.
Thank you guys for always being there for us and helping me to know God, and my babies too. We love you, see you soon. 🦋 I have watched a few sermons online and they are great! This is a great church forsure! I'm currently a member of the volunteer team at new day christian church so I haven't been able to be there in person yet , But I hope and pray that soon I will be able to because I would love to meet these wonderful people! I noticed that they want everyone to get to know each other and love each other! That is what we need I'm so happy to see them push that message! Praise the Lord in Jesus name! Been going here for years Pastor Brian and his amazing wife Pastor Jacqueline are wonderful loving people who have a strong 💪 group behind them i encourage anyone to check this Church out it's not your normal service like you had when you were a kid Pastor Brian takes the scripture and breaks it down into real life scenarios to make you understand and appreciate the word in a whole different way We felt that the lord led us to Awaken; and we are glad he did! This is a house of the lord on Sundays and a school the rest of the week. Yet we saw the Bible leading its ministry, and felt Gods hands and feet in the church and community right away. Pastor Brian and his congregation made our family feel welcomed and encouraged us to get into a connection program. So we could become involved with what Gods people are doing in the church and community. Grace is preached, and his spirit is felt from the moment we arrived, happy to be apart of this growing body of Christ! We love our church!!  The community feel and most importantly the presence of God we feel
In every service!!

name: Awaken Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
The spirit of the Lord is definitely upon Awaken. The sense of peace and belonging our church brings my family is unmatched. You will be welcomed with open arms and warm smiles. We’ve been coming to Awaken for a little over 6 years and cannot boast enough about our community. We love it. My wife and I were looking for a good church where we could feel a real sense of community and from the moment we walked into Awaken Church, we felt right at home. Everyone was so welcoming, and over time we’ve made lifelong friends. We pray together, spend time together outside of church, and genuinely support one another.

I love how there are so many Groups created by members for different purposes and interests. My wife and I are part of two discussion groups where we relax, talk about the Bible, and share about life (kids friendly). I also joined a men’s pickleball group, which has been such a fun way to connect, grow in faith, and improve at pickleball at the same time!

What stands out most to me is the diversity in people, in perspectives, and in the message from our pastor. Awaken offers different pathways for every stage of your spiritual walk, whether you’re new to faith or growing deeper in your relationship with God. When we moved to Austin, we were looking for a church that was authentic with biblical teachings. We were especially looking for a community with people who we can friends with, people who have genuine faith, and people who can encourage us in our walk with God. We checked out 13 different churches, and when we went to Awaken Church for the first time, we just knew this was going to be our home (church). Awaken Church has powerful worship, purposeful, applicable, and Christ-center teachings, and people who truly care about you and want to connect with you. We have been here for a while now, and we love our church. We are connected with others at the church, growing in our faith, and finding different ministries to serve in. We welcome you to check us out this Sunday at 10:30am! My wife and I decided a few years ago that it was time to get back to church and wanted to go somewhere where we could meet others in our community. I wasn’t sure where to try first but my wife had heard about Awaken. We went the first time with the intention of trying out a few other churches.  After that first visit we felt so welcome and just enjoyed every aspect of the service that we never went anywhere else.
It’s been about 3 years now and are very happy to be attending Awaken.  We have made a lot of friends and always feel blessed to be there. So many ways to be involved. If you’re ever looking for a church to check out I’d highly suggest Awaken Church. This church has been foundational to my walk in Christ in this season in my life. So many great people who are intentional about community and staying connected. And they just love spreading the love of Christ to those around them.

It didn’t take me long to realize that this church was my home quickly after I started coming. And I haven’t looked back ever since. I love it here and would definitely recommend you coming to try it out for yourself. You never know what the Lord may have in store for you and your friends and family when you walk in through those doors.

name: Awaken Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
After trying a few different churches in San Marcos, Awaken Church honestly ended up feeling the most like home to me. I really love the smaller atmosphere because you actually get to know people instead of just showing up and leaving. Over time, the people here genuinely started to feel like family to me.

One of my favorite things about this church is how passionate they are about evangelizing and reaching people in the community. I actually found Awaken because a couple came up to me while evangelizing in Sewell Park and invited me to church. I’m really grateful they did because I probably never would’ve found this place otherwise.

What stood out to me most is how genuine and caring everyone feels. It never felt fake, forced, or cliquey to me, which was something I worried about when trying new churches. If you’re looking for a church where people truly care about each other and make you feel welcomed, I would definitely recommend Awaken. I absolutely love serving and worshiping at this church. The community is filled with people who are sincerely devoted to Jesus and who will walk with you, disciple you, and encourage you to live in the fullness of God. Serving here has strengthened my relationship with Him, and I’m so thankful to be part of this church family. If you're looking for a church home, this is the place :) God is moving through this place to reach the community. Our pastors believe in equipping the saints to BE the church, not just show up to the building. Real people reaching out to other real people with the message of hope in Christ Jesus.

Come check it out, 9 or 11 am on Sundays. We meet here, but we serve where God sends. A place where you will feel the spirit of God… Were do we start

name: Awaken Church | BALBOA CAMPUS - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Great location, great leadership team and lots of fun events. Accusations of "prosperity gospel" are likely the result of cognitive bias. The leadership does not embrace a leftist socialist worldview and occasionally this is revealed from the pulpit. If you want to just go to church and leave the same way you came, hit up your local Lutheran facility.  If you want to witness the power of Jesus, come to Awaken. My first visit and I liked it. Great worship and a good message. Yes, they do focus on tithing more than the average church and the media seems to have shed some negative light on them in the past for different things, but the people were friendly and inviting. They are very patriotic and pro military(which I like )I personally prefer a straight non denominational Calvary/ Maranatha Chapel type church, but I enjoyed the service . As I entered your doors today, the Security stopped in mid conversation and approached me not only did he look me up and down. He asked if I’ve been there before and told me he didn’t recognize my face. I told him I didn’t recognize his face either and I’ve been to awakened multiple times. As I went into church today I felt the message to be strong, but it didn’t hold the same meaning as the man who greeted me as I walked in as I left church today, I stopped, and I informed him the security guard of how I felt during our encounter this morning. He started to get very upset and told me about his past titles of employment and how he was just securing I informed him that I didn’t feel safe or welcomed when he spoke to me. I informed him that in the future, he should continue doing his job, but in a way to where someone does not feel as I did today instead of being humble and warm hearted as in the message it stated today he began to get aggressive in words, elevating his tone voice, and then told me that I did not have to attend this church again. I informed him that he didn’t own the church and that simply I was sharing with him how he made me felt I did not raise my voice nor did I use any rude words. I am a woman that did not get dressed for church today and My Hair was a mess. My heart was full. My mind was heavy and my body ached I came to be blessed by the word and others around me. This was simply the most opposite experience that I expected to have today due to your Security, who said I could speak with the pastor and they would back him up on this particular encounter. This church is far too loud. Children were running around, screaming in the halls, totally tone deaf, and couldn’t hear people telling them to stop it. They know that it’s too loud, and they offer hearing plugs at the entrance. There was an armed security guard at the entrance. There was five people standing in the coffee shop and they wouldn’t let me have a coffee. I don’t know why they were standing there. I guess maybe to give coffee to their friends only nobody offered to pray for me or greeted me, and I was just hoping they would offer to pray for me because I know somebody that needs prayer It is December 31, 2025, and I was looking for a church to bring 2026 in and this place has to be a front! I went to the website and not one mention of Christ or any references to the Holy Bible. It’s scary how many locations they have, all of which mimicking the other. This is more of a spirituality and community connection facility not a house of God. Which, I’m not mad at, just don’t call it a CHRISTIAN CHURCH! Sadly I will not be visiting because I don’t need another fake “church” leading me down a path away from Jesus Christ my Lord and Savior! Maybe it’s better in person, but the photos, websites, and reviews are plenty for me to stand clear of. If you like to check this place out on your own, best of luck and God bless.

name: Awaken Church | EL CAJON CAMPUS - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: My first time at this church and everyone was very friendly and welcoming.  They made me feel accepted and at home.  The choir was awesome, like a concert.  Lots of singing and high energy.  Everyone is super upbeat.  No doubt about it, this is a politically conservative leaning church, so  if you disagree with that then you probably won't like it.  They believe in the Bible  and if it's a sin in the Bible, it will be a sin regardless of what you'd prefer.  If you're conservative then  yes this  is a good church and you'll feel right at home.  God is the God of both Liberals and Conservatives, however it's good to have a place where people share similar political and moral values.  They also have full on armed security if you're worried about going to a Conservative church in a Liberal majority city.  They take your safety seriously.  It's not a huge mega church but not a small church either.  Check it out if you like high energy worship, and if you're low energy, you can still relax and essentially enjoy the show and be in the presence of God.  And if you're a Conservative in California, all the negative 1 star reviews are the best advertisement and recommendation for this church, all the negative reviews are what made me go to this church and I'm glad I did. Wonderful church which seeks to preach the Lord’s word while being relatable and lighthearted. The Holy Spirit is present here and all are welcome! Great church with pastors who speak truths and do not appear to fear repercussions. If you embrace a leftist socialist worldview and are looking for like-minded messaging you may find more comfort in your nearest United Methodist location. If you want to see and feel the transformative power of Jesus, come to Awaken. I brought my son in for youth group and all the women acted like i was there to steal their man 🤣🤣🤣 the leader of the youth groups wife had to come give him a huge kiss in front of everyone while he was talking to me, it was sooo awkward. awful look! Glad to see its not just me and this place already has terrible ratings. I've always thought it a little funny to write a review of a church online because it is such a personal experience, but I feel like I need to say that through Awaken, God has been transforming me. I am so proud of this church for reopening during the ridiculous shutdowns of 2020/2021 and breathing life into people every week despite the demands not to! Great leadership and a wonderful family atmosphere are what you will find!

name: Awaken Church | SAN MARCOS CAMPUS - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
As the owner of Performance360 gym in San Marcos, having a healthy mind/body/spirit is important to me. I have found my church family in Awaken church. I am on absolute fire for Jesus and only have this church to thank for that. Having a Holy Spirit filled church has changed my life. 🙏🏽 Thanks to Awaken and the way the preach about the Bible, I have found my faith again!!🩷 Amazing Amazing experience at this church! They are SO good at putting on productions that make people feel the gospel in Truth and with their message of love from God through Jesus! Thank God! The online buying of tickets through their Awaken app was quick and easy! I can tell they have numerous folks to guide when you arrive which helps since the building is huge. I’m sure thankful they have dedicated volunteers that are willing to give thousands of hours for their shows to be able to be what they are when it comes to production, lighting, and audio. Some scenes have a portrayal of demons in society which might be a tough watch for kids. They are relating the emphasis on the spiritual world which comes to life in the play. Other than that, for kids over the ages of 15 I might recommend. Just since the message is to spread goodwill and awareness about the importance of learning and seeking God in our society. Wanted to love this church and went, I don't know, 10 or so times before finally throwing in the towel. The word is extremely inconsistent here. It feels like this is more of an audition house for random people to come speak about literally anything. You can often find yourself in the middle of nonsensical political rants, that even if you find yourself agreeing with...you'll wonder to yourself....why am I listening to this at church?

There is usually a 15-30 minute section of each service dedicated to just tithing and why you need to tithe. The worship portion of the service is usually also pretty lack luster in comparison to others - not sure how else to describe it other than just not great. The actual spoken word of the church service seriously has lasted as little as 5 minutes in the past. This is after you sit and watch 2-3 promo videos of events coming up that you have to buy tickets for.

I've met a few wonderful people here and otherwise do agree with some of the messaging at this church, but it often feels like this is more of a money grab than a church. I was really excited the first couple times I came to this church but after realizing that I don't think I've ever heard the same person speak twice, and when whoever does speak, speaks, it can be a legitimate waste of time that has absolutely nothing to do with, God, church, or anything - but was just some guy trying to vent about whatever he feels like.

I often found myself leaving this church wishing I'd have gone somewhere else that takes God a little more seriously. I truly don't believe that I ever left this church feeling impacted by the word or wanting to do better as I have with other churches. Maybe this church will resonate with you, but it did not with me. I hope this review allows you to make an informed decision on your choice to worship. God bless. Praise the lord! Taking worship to another level. Breakthrough and be welcomed to a family of church goers that worship with a desire to embrace and empower the holy spirit. Cancel evil. Denounce evil. Nurture all that is good. Any campus and any service. They are all great.

Hope you make your way to a service soon. Pray to see you here. I grew up in a Christian home, went to church, attended church school my whole life, but I was never disciples. Fast forward several decades abd church shopping, my life changed completely here at Awaken with the fresh outpouring of God into my life. If you woukd like to be accompanied to a true Holy Spirit filled church, I will invite you. Thank.you God for the deliverance and the personal touching you did in me. ✝️🙏🔥

name: Awaken Church Las Vegas - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I have never felt so unwanted in a church. My kids attend awaken elementary school, love it. We typically attend Hope church and love it but have thought about finding a church closer. So we went to Awaken today, as my kid was performing for Easter service. I was immediately greeted with my one year-old being told I needed to sit in the back. I explained that my other child would be on stage. I was told I needed to sit in the back regardless, after some back-and-forth they allowed me to sit near the front, but told me after worship I needed to move... I was then told the same thing by three other ushers that walked past and seen I had a toddler. I handed my toddler off to family and went to retrieve my daughter who had just came off stage and was told she couldn't come sit by us and I needed to take her to the "kid area" at this point I was fuming, it's Easter... every service should be family friendly, but especially holiday services. After the sixth person told me I needed to take my kids and go to the back... Mind you they were not being loud at all and worship was still going on, so even if they had you wouldn't have been able to hear them... I went to the back to finish out service... Two minutes into the service, I seen two different ushers tell a toddler to be quiet and try to hush them with a toy and they approached the mom and the mother took the child and walked out... again this kid was babbling not even loudly.... I followed behind and will never enter a church service here again. This should be marketed as adult only church, or church where children should be seen and not heard.... Their family room had seats along every wall so you couldn't even see the service as the tv was behind and above your head, it was full with no where to sit. There was no couches or anywhere to lay a sleeping baby. I took my toddler to the foyer and there was no where to sit so I went outside and had to sit on a step for remaining of service. I went to look for the pastor after service and he was no where to be found. I've been to many churches here and all have been family friendly... except the one who literally owns a school... I will drive my 30 minutes to Hope Church where my kids are wanted and families are not just welcome but they are gracefully accommodated.

Also.... I was talking to another church goer here and she was saying their priorities must be messed up because they have a coffee shop in the foyer and they sell coffee and bakery items... you can take the coffee in but you cannot eat the bakery items in the chapel... I'm just in disbelief at this place... now I'm rethinking the whole school aspect. I miss attending this church due to covid but I’m glad we were able to attend Sunrise Service this Easter Sunday. I’ve always attended a Calvary Chapel Church since Downey California back in 2003. This particular Chapel is also amazing. Pastor Derek is a blessing to us and this church. I highly recommend this place for your spiritual journey. I pray you find the real love, joy and peace that only comes from having Jesus Christ. We love this Church we started going every Sunday when we discovered this but, Been sad of what happened earlier. this Church is too sensitive of small noise from children. Earlier we were ask to go to the other room even thou my kids and some of other kids are not making any noise because prayer is about to start. What’s the purpose of bringing your family to church if very small kids noise are not allowed in the worship center. We walked out. They should have put a sign no children allowed. 😔 The leadership at this church are doing some incredible things and focus on what scripture calls us to do versus what other modern churches are doing. Pastor Derek is a compassionate speaker who isn’t afraid to teach the congregation as pupils of the Word or God. Leadership here are humble and encourage us to work for the glory of the kingdom of heaven and regard themselves as called on in the same way each of us in the congregation are. Aside from that awesomeness, the praise & worship team is truly incredible. The Holy Spirit is present with them and poured out among all of us as we gather in praise & worship. I’ve never been happier and have visited many non-denominational churches in Las Vegas. I’ve finally found my home! Please consider this church as you made decisions and search for your church home! My wife and I attended service while on vacation. This place is GREAT! Solid worship and preaching. The congregation is on 🔥 Totally engaged in the worship and message. The first message I can remember with action steps! Love you guys 😀

name: Awaken City Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: We were camping in St.Augustine for the month. My wife picked this church to attend. We found it very welcoming, worship music was top notch, teaching was everything a Christian needs to hear. Sadly this is our last Sunday to attend, going home on Wednesday. Love to all those in attendance. From our first Sunday two years ago, we felt welcomed upon entering the service from start to finish. The pastors, greeters and parishioners went above and to accommodate. Since then, ACC has become our church family and we’ve forged relationships along the way. My husband and I have been attending Awaken City Church for a year and a half,  after an exhausting church hunt! We feel God has led us here and we have finally found our church home! From the moment you walk in the door and are greeted with genuine warmth and smiles, to the beautiful music and the awesome message given by either of the two pastors, you feel the Holy Spirit moving through you and through this church. Come join us for a wonderful experience! Love being part of this friendly, loving church community as we have formed many new friends and are also able to serve and help others. You hear the Word of God and how it applies to your life and you can also join life groups to grow with each other. If you're looking for a church with real people who actually care, you need to visit Awaken City. Since day one, my husband and I have felt welcome and part of the church family. The messages from Billy and Jeff are always practical and Biblical, and the worship is great at creating an atmosphere conducive for the Holy Spirit to move. You won't leave church empty handed. Plus, they have a big heart for our community and our world, and are sure to make missions a priority. Happy to be part of this church family!

name: Awaken LA Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: First time visiting this church and I have to say it’s so beautiful and peaceful inside and songs from elevation worship we sang , sermon was amazing and they give u  a box free food  and a meal in the dining room after church every Sunday ! I’m definitely going back , I loved the friendly ppl and  they prayed over me and many others , the Holy Spirit is definitely there🙏🙏🙏🙏 Beautiful  church where the Holy Spirit is the Main Guest of Honor. name: Awakening Church - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary:
We've been going here for almost 4 years (since we moved to the Bay). We feel at home with our community here and love it! The teaching & worship are great. Their passion for this generation is inspiring. My home church also rented out of a high school, so it feels like home ¨̮ My first impression 4 years ago when I started attending their services was how friendly and welcoming everyone was. I have found a community of believers who spur one another in discipleship. Not just Sunday Christians, but everyday Christians. Found this church via instagram in December when I moved from San Francisco , previously attending Hillsong SF, to Campbell in search of a new church home.

The moment I walked into service,  I was welcomed with warm smiles and greetings with heartfelt worship music and service that connected God's word to our modern daily life. The leadership team did not hesitate to get newcomers connected into the community making everyone feel welcome. Within a month I was plugged into a connect group, school of Faith classes, and serving.

I came in looking for a new church home and community and got so much more; we do LIFE with each other and continue to build our family/community with Jesus at the center

Come as you are - all are welcome Our family has been members of Awakening Church for four years! We feel spiritually fed through Pastor Ryan's sermons and supported by the wonderful and welcoming community. There are so many opportunities to serve in the church and the surrounding area. Our three children love the youth and kids programs as well. Would highly recommend anyone looking for a home church! Awakening church is a great church the people are really following the Lord.  They invest a lot of time money in outreach to people in the community.  The people are not judgmental and love people around them.  The worship is good and the teaching is solid.  I never felt judge or I was too bad of a person to go church.  Check out the church.  I promise you won't regret it.

name: Axis Christian Church - Mason Campus
reviewSummary: First time visiting Axis Christian Church today. Everyone was very friendly. Message was Bible based and relevant. Good experience for first time visitors. This church is awesome. All the people are extremely friendly and caring. Come check it out, 9:30 and 11:00! God bless. Great bible based church!  Congregation is not overwhelmingly large but very warm & welcoming.  Great place to worship. I love this church! The pastors are awesome and I love their messages! The music is very uplifting and the musicians are very talented. Delicious coffee and food! Great atmosphere! Wonderful place for meaningful conversations!

name: Ayr Hill Church - Vienna Campus
reviewSummary: This was the first Church in my life. My Mother and I started attending in 1967. Brother Phillip’s was the pastor then. The fire burns in my soul and even though I moved from Fairfax in the 1980’s, every Church that I have attended since, is compared to this one. God bless you. Todd Estep This is a great place to worship at.  I really enjoy the small atmosphere.  The congregation is caring and very much family oriented.  You must visit.  I love it! Awesome service and great people! Love my time spent there. Beautiful, life-giving church in Vienna! A great place to be

reviewSummary: I havent attended service here, but this 5 star review is for the messaging on their signs. Thank you for BEING the church. This was the perfect hall for the Veterans Day Recognition Lunch Event! Our musical duo, Mick and Rick, were honored to be a part of this very special day of thanking all those men and women who served our country to help keep us safe. Growing up here wonderful memories love all the years of services an learning experience with the family. Getting into so much with the youth group at the time. The history is wonderful. name: Banal Na Pag Aaral Inc - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Very touching reenactment of Jesus Christ's sacrifice for us.  He's the way to Heaven.. this we have to remember all the time of our lives.  Amen. Grace is freely given.
A beautiful, life-changing encounter where God's presence is truly felt. I became involved with the BNP for a number of years as it was presented as an opportunity to study the Catholic faith and share in some Filipino culture. Unfortunately, this was under false pretenses. Catholics beware as their practices have been officially disavowed by many leaders in the Church and by several diocese. As far as religious cults go, the BNP is relatively harmless, however my personal story is one of psychological and emotional manipulation. I continue to pray for those I know are still involved The BNP changed my life for the better. I want to offer my life to God and to fight the battle of temptation, distraction, and sin with full force because of the way Ate Salve taught us how loving and powerful and how GOOD the Lord is to all of us. Thank you Ate Salve for turning many souls, including my family and I, towards the love of Christ and for helping us live out our one true purpose which is to know, love, and serve God and purify our soul in our lifetime so we can reach everlasting love and happiness in God’s kingdom for all eternity. I pray that people find it in their heart to see that this woman is nothing short of a humble servant bringing lost souls back to their Father, Jesus Christ, whom may also be known as the King of Kings, God the Father, God the Son, God the Holy Spirit, our LORD, our God, Christ our Savior, our one and only Creator, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God we refer to him in tagalog Mahal na Ingkong, our Beloved Father. Thank you for teaching us how to humbly and wholeheartedly love our God and continue to become better servants to God. The founder never pointed glory towards herself but instead pointed EVERYTHING GOOD towards Christ and taught us how to glorify His name with our life as a testimony of how good he constantly is to each and every single one of us. Jesus was condemned and outcasted and called a false prophet too, many of the saints were outcasted and called false prophets and liars, be careful who you tear down… as you never know if you are cursing the very people God has chosen for a special task to gather souls and continue His salvation and spread His gospel. If you are worried, come join a retreat and see for yourself that the example people live their lives in the BNP and the way they CHANGED their whole self for the better to be presentable and worthy in the eyes of the Lord. Not through force but through the love of MNI. The change and the examples of these BNP member’s lives are much louder than the random hateful comments that are quick to put down a mission that only changed massive amounts of lives for the better and with the only intention to bring them back to God, where they belong. Attending the weekend retreat is once in a lifetime surprisingly delightful. The teaching’s and practices is Catholic and does not contradict the Bible’s content but indeed God’s comprehensive will  in a mysterious ways.

GREATEST CHURCH, BIBLE BASED AND THE PASTOR PLEASES THE LORD IN HIS TEACHINGS NOT THE PEOPLE.

name: Basilica of The Immaculate Conception - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a beautiful church! I am visiting and as a lifelong Catholic, I treasured the offer of confession shortly before Sunday mass and the rosary being prayed softly over the loud speaker for all in attendance while we wait for mass to begin.

After the rosary, the Divine Mercy chaplet was recited. This was something new to me but so beautiful!

Mass being offered at 10am allowed me to travel the 20 minutes to get there easily, no rushing.

Such an inviting, lovely parish! So glad I visited! Went for morning Mass on a Tuesday at 7:30 a.m. It was about 30 minutes long. The church is beautiful inside and out, with a long history and very well preserved. There is good information available, and the atmosphere is peaceful. Very cool piece of history and also an active church building with daily worship services and confessions. One of the most peaceful and beautiful basilica’s I’ve ever visited!

Church parking across the street from the main entrance! Music program was excellent. Love the more traditional feel. Men in suits ladies wearing mantillas. Very moving, and spiritually rich mass. The LORD must have been pleased.

name: Basilica of the National Shrine
reviewSummary: The largest Catholic church in North America. A stunning architectural masterpiece and national pilgrimage destination with daily masses and reverent worship.

name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone was welcoming. The only thing that was weird was they skipped our row during the communion but I think its because you have to line up instead of calling row by row. Nice mass and calm atmosphere The Basilica of the Sacred Heart is a stunning place of worship that blends timeless beauty with a sense of deep peace. Its intricate architecture, soaring ceilings, and beautiful stained-glass windows create an atmosphere of reverence and awe. Whether you visit to pray, reflect, or admire its artistry, the basilica offers a truly uplifting spiritual experience. My husband and I had our first experience with the Basilica back in 2022. We were supposed to get married at another church in the area, only to find out they overbooked us. We had already sent out save the dates and put a downpayment on a reception venue nearby. With 5 months before our wedding date, we frantically reached out to the Basilica. The date was available and they were extremely accommodating and helpful, even allowing us to use the priest from the other church. We had a beautiful ceremony thanks to the help of the coordinator, the flower guild, the organist, and everybody else involved.

Fast forward to a little over a year ago. My husband and I live on this side of town now, so we started going to the Basilica and have fallen in love. The sanctuary is beautiful, everybody is friendly, and Father John gives fantastic homilies. This is definitely home for us. Very welcoming people with a cozy atmosphere. Came here for Sunday evening mass. They have a relic from the True Cross of Christ. The artwork and stained glass is amazing. While walking out, look up to be captured by the Rose Window. ### Location
Sacred Heart Basilica is located on South Boulevard, Subbayah Salai, Pondicherry, close to the city’s railway station.

### Significance
Built in 1908 by French missionaries, this Gothic-style church was elevated to a basilica in 2011, making it an important religious site in Pondicherry.

### Attractions
The church is known for its stunning stained-glass windows, peaceful ambiance, and impressive Gothic architecture, making it a must-visit spot for both pilgrims and tourists.

name: BattleCreek Church - Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
So greatly appreciate of this church! The love they pour out into the kids ministry is by far the greatest, and it’s their mission to prepare and invest in the next generation and you just see it when you come! Kids camp for my 8 year old just lights a fire in him and he loved every moment of it, bringing him everyday made me want to be a kid again due to the energy! Pastor Alex is so passionate and an incredible preacher! Yes it’s a large church but there is a group for everyone! I love the atmosphere and zero judgement just loving people loving God and his people!

The only thing I would recommend is lowering the volume of music in the auditorium, it’s too loud for the space. I can’t sit close to the front or I feel vibration in my ears so bad that it hurts my ears. I know many who have left due to this and I’ve looked around at other churches and many comment on reviews due to the worship being too loud. Not all want to sit in the foyer or put ear plugs in to worship. It’s not a problem to just lower it a bit! We went Easter and this place is impressive! The music is like a concert, but is a little loud with some distortion on the mics. The musicians and singers are very talented and the songs were all contemporary.

The Pastor gave an amazing sermon from a perspective that was most importantly to me, based on the Bible. He offered a concept that made you more aware of how wonderful our God is.

We recently moved here and have been looking for a place to worship and Battlecreek Baptist Church may be our home! We will be back! When my daughter was 2 she was diagnosed with Autism and going to church has honestly been a struggle because she was having a hard time in kids church. When I heard about Battle Creek’s Haven program for special needs kids and adults we had to try it out. It’s been AMAZING for my daughter and she’s excited to come to church weekly. It allows us to serve and truly enjoy service again. There’s a plethora of other great things to share about BC but that program is special for my family. This church has changed my life in so many ways! The people are friendly and would do anything for anyone. Pastor Alex is an amazing pastor who teachers facts straight from the Bible. The campus pastors are amazing as well and the worship is my favorite! My son loves children's church and walks away every Sunday learning something new. The security is top notch and I’m confident knowing my son is safe while I’m in service. Love my church!!! What a wonderful place to fellowship with others while giving thanks and praise to God!!! If you need a place to call home, I invite you to join us. Pastor Alex and all of the staff are great!!!! It is the perfect place for imperfect people.

name: BattleCreek Church - Jenks - Jenks Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending the Jenks campus of BattleCreek for a little over a year now and from the moment I stepped foot into the building I felt the most welcoming presence and like it was a place that I could truly belong. Fast forward to today, I have grown a whole community of like minded believers who have helped me grow in every area of my life. If you are looking for a place to call home, I highly recommend trying it out. The BattleCreek Church Jenks campus is an incredible place to grow in your faith and find genuine community. From the moment you arrive, the team creates a welcoming and friendly atmosphere that makes it easy to feel at home. The worship is engaging, the teaching is biblically grounded and relevant, and there are meaningful opportunities for people of all ages to get involved.

What stands out most is the heart for people—whether it’s families, students, or first-time guests, everyone is valued and encouraged in their walk with Christ. They truly live out their mission for all people, all ages, all the time to advance in their journey with Christ! If you’re looking for a church that is passionate about helping people grow spiritually and build real relationships, the Jenks campus is a great place to be. It’s one of our favorite places to be! We love the come as you are mentality and that everybody is accepted no matter what they’ve done or where they’ve come from in their lives.  That’s what drew us in years ago and has kept us there for all this time!  We recently had a death in the family and felt so much incredible warmth and support through phone calls, messages, and meals for weeks! The loss of my mom was truly difficult but with the church behind me, I was absolutely able to get through it!   It’s a truly unbelievable place full of God’s love! Where do I begin? They are not good people. Every Sunday morning at 7:30 they start blasting their music in their tin can building and waking their neighbors. A year of complaints from us and no changes. Horrible Leadership. My family and I moved from Edmond, OK about a year ago and loved the church we had in Edmond.  We visited several churches in the Tulsa area, and it was hard to find one where we had a similar experience and felt like it was the place we were supposed to be.  We attended TC South Tulsa and loved the Pastor and the message.  We live in Jenks and were hoping to find a campus a little closer to us.  At about that time we heard that TC was opening a campus in Jenks.  We knew that is where God wanted us to be.  We started getting involved at the Jenks campus and it has been a wonderful experience!  The campus pastor and staff are great and the facility is going to be awesome!  They have a great kids area and my daughter gets so excited to go to church, which is such a relief.  I highly recommend checking out TC Jenks!

name: BattleCreek Church - Owasso - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church! For the first time in years, I feel connected and a part of the community. There are so many ways to find a place to fit and belong! In addition, the teaching is relevant, informed, and applicable.  The praise and worship music is outstanding which is super important to me.  It’s a multigenerational church that is making a difference! Hope you check it out! I didn't want another TV Screen Church, but the quality of teaching streamed in from Pastor Alex Himaya at the headquarters in Broken Arrow is so rich, profound, encouraging, and unapologetically committed to Jesus. We've been attending the Owasso campus for years, and there have been a few leadership changes. Although there's always room for improvement, I appreciated Pastor Alex and the BC HQ team coming to Owasso for Vision Night, answering all our questions, being down-to-earth, and inspiring the Owasso campus to have its own identity within the BC family of campuses. The music is easy to enjoy. The children's church is very attentive and security-focused. They have fun community events multiple times per year. There's so much to like about it. I very much appreciate attending a church that's committed as I am. The Church at Owasso is amazing! I love the teaching, the staff, and the volunteers! I feel like I can be myself, hear God’s Word preached, and have a safe place to be open and real. The campus pastor is awesome! He takes to time talk if you need him, is such a great teacher, and really seems to care about the people at the church. If you’re looking for a great church you should try this one! This is a wonderful church home. My wife and I were looking for a long time to find a church that had a pastor that was engaging, worship that was moving, a kids ministry that was nurturing and a church congregation that took care of one another and was involved with loving on the community. We have very much found all of this at the Church at Owasso. TC Owasso is an incredible place to worship. My family has already built lifetime relationships in just a short time of being members. Their kids ministry is fantastic as well and has made lasting impact on my children.

name: BattleCreek Church - South Tulsa - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
I don't ever leave reviews but I attended this church this morning at the 10am service. Let me just say very bizarre place. Felt cult like. They listen to a pastor on the teleprompter screens, it's weird. The pastor said in his message this morning the Bible wasn't written for us....I should have walked out right then and there. Majority of the congregation seem like robots. I've never felt this uncomfortable in a place of worship before. Too each their own I guess though. I felt convicted on sharing my experience. We love the intimate atmosphere here at South. After being long time members at the main campus
However, I wish the worship had not changed as of late. It's more of a production. Not intimate, it prevents a true worship experience. It's there a way we can alternate between the two? As a mom, I needed to find a place my kids love as much as I do. This church has that. The first Sunday my kids walked in they were greeted by high fives and excitement. When church was over my kids not only earned a lot about the Bible but they said “when can we come back mom?” Not only does this church help my kids but it helps me as a mom get refreshed. The people here truly care about people. I don’t have to dress fancy or be something I’m not. I’m allowed to be me. It’s the perfect place for imperfect people like me. The praise and worship is amazing and the preaching helps me grow and keeps me engaged. If you are looking for a place to call home you’ve found it. Just try it. You won’t be sorry. This place is home.  I feel welcomed every week by the parking crew, hello team, coffee bar...then on to incredible worship. The message is so on point every week and feeds my soul.  Our young children Love going every week and always surprise me with a new song or verse. The nursery is amazingly warm and I know my baby is getting the best care and is loved on for her stay! I whole heartedly recommend the church at South Tulsa for anyone looking for a new place to worship! Unfortunately I was not there to attend services this time. Hopefully I will be able to visit and attend services one day. My car broke and we had to pull off into the church parking. Why we waited for assistance we took a walk of the grounds. They were well kept and it felt very peaceful their. In fact me & my boyfriend were arguing at the time. But he grabbed my hand and said let's take a walk.  Something he never does anymore. I definitely felt God's love and presence just walking the grounds of your church. So I can only imagine what the services are like. 😊 Thank you for letting us wonder the grounds of your church, God bless.

name: Bay Area Christian Church - Palo Alto - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary:
People are super friendly and genuinely want to get to know you. People remember your name which is rare. Church doesn't care about membership and simply focuses on teaching what the Bible says. This makes you feel comfortable when going since you know there aren't any alternative motives to you being there lol.

Everyone there wants to go by the Bible as best as they can which is refreshing to see. I've never seen that anywhere else.

Sermons are powerful and inspiring. BACC is very outward focused and has strong ties with the community around them. They are continually trying to help out in the community.

They have almost everything for every age too! Whether your looking for events for professionals (young and old), married couples, college students, teens, or even younger, they have amazing people everywhere.

I definitely love this place and highly recommend going to check it out for yourself! :) I visited many churches in my life. Some had great music, some had nice facilities, good organization... but it became clear to me by the people at the BACC that THIS was a place where I could truly grow spiritually (and not wander off!) People in our church care about living by the bible. It isn't perfect. Sometimes the music or the lessons aren't always mind blowing, but the Christians at our church make this place THE church. I grew up going to the Bay Area Christian Church and I definitely couldn't ask for a better one.  This church has always been my family and has really amazing ministries for families, young kids, middle schoolers, teens, and more.  Now I'm a college student and the people in this church still help and challenge me to grow in my relationship with God in so many ways.  BACC has helped me develop a desire to make an influence in my community and has taught me important lessons like compassion for people who have special needs.  This is because BACC is so much more than just a church you go to on Sundays, it's a group that is truly devoted to changing lives. The Bay Area Christian Church is all about family. Our family decided years ago that we would make this place our spiritual home, long before they bought the awesome building in Palo Alto. Our marriage and kids have grown up in this church and we wouldn't consider anywhere else. With the wide diversity of people and small groups, we find all of our needs met even as our needs have changed with time. It's incredible to see the families taken care of - from married with newborns to empty nesters and everything in between. I have been attending BACC for many years starting when I was single until now married with kids. I enjoy the friendships, the diversity, the caring for special needs kids and the present of people from all life stages.
