name: Bay Area Christian Church - Sunnyvale - Sunnyvale Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a neighborhood church that reflects respect, peace, and care for the community. I would really appreciate it if group events could keep the volume down. Loud, prolonged music can be very disruptive to nearby residents. I respectfully ask church leadership to address this and be mindful of neighbors. We used to rent facilities to hold our Sunday services for Santa Clara, but with God's blessings, we were able to find this amazing place! Volunteers came and helped renovate the place especially during the pandemic and were so proud to call it our home! I love that there are rooms for the Children's Ministry now, and courtyards on both sides of the main church. There is even a snack bar?! Game room, etc.

During weekdays, it is also used by the youth ministry, or campus or just a hub to grow and learn involving community events. I have a teenager and a middle schooler and both of them will frequent this place as they get older! We are excited to welcome anyone who comes to visit us here or get to know us as a family! I have been attending BACC over the last 5 weeks while attempting to discern if it was a church that I feel is empowered by the bible and intentional about serving God.

Positives:
The congregation are very warm to new comers. I was met with kindness and wasn't made to feel like an outsider.

The church is focused on community support in a number of ways although it was a bit hard to find concrete information on the specific charities and who orchestrates them and the exact financials, I'm unsure how they proctor financial accountability with this system but I do have faith that information is somewhere.

The church has a robust focus on empowering leaders of both genders, seeing a church that encourages female leadership and discipleship is rare and welcome.

Cons:
Exclusive theology- having an anti queer theology at this point is not only unfounded and illogical its just lazy. Relying on mistranslations and inherited homophobic theology would be surprising from a church that parades as progressive if it wasn't so insanely boring, Ungodly, and uneducated of a stance to hold.

Anti-Semitism- Songs during the worship service use the term "Jews" as a slur, reducing an entire ethnic group to the actions of only a select few, and when asked why they choose to use this racist language a satisfying answer was nowhere to be found, and no commitment to change was made.

The final straw however was when I attended the Men's "Locked in" event and the man giving the message, had the audacity to defend colonization with his whole chest, completely trivializing the horrors of the Native American Genocide and destruction of their culture because it meant "He got to be free in 2025."

To say I'm disappointed is an understatement. We've been part of this church for many years and are fortunate to have met some of our closest friends here. The church focuses on the Bible, personal relationship with God, deep friendships, and doing good in the community. There's a wide age range, from young children to mature adults. It's awesome to have many other families with young children like ours.
We love the new building! The building has been thoughtfully renovated and is bright, open, and inviting, with an awesome park next door. It's so refreshing getting together in person again and we're grateful for the children's classes that have resumed on Sundays! Went here for easter 2025 celebrations. Great place and organizers. Everyone was friendly but a lady that was on a table with easter eggs shouted at a group of parents whose kids grabbed eggs before they were supposed to. She asked the parents to teach their kids manners in a rough tone and they told their kids to return the eggs. I am sure this is inconsistent with the values of the church and this lady needs to be taught a thing or two about how kids get excited about things and how to do her job. It seemed that she did not like this specific group, but anyhow, this is the only bad experience. Or else, a welcoming place for all types of humans.

name: Bay Area Church - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I officially became members of Bay Area Church two Sundays ago, and we couldn’t be more grateful for where God has led us.

From the very first time we visited, we were welcomed with genuine kindness. The greeters were incredibly friendly and made us feel like we were already part of the church family. That warmth and authenticity continued every time we came back.

One of the things I appreciate most is that Bay Area Church is a Bible-believing church that is committed to living according to God’s Word. Pastor faithfully preaches Scripture without watering it down or trying to make it fit today’s culture. He speaks the truth in love, and every message is rooted in the Bible. That was extremely important to me because I wanted a church that values biblical truth above opinions or popularity.

I also love the sense of community here. Everyone we’ve met has been welcoming, encouraging, and genuinely interested in getting to know us. It truly feels like a church family that desires to honor Christ.

If you’re looking for a church that faithfully teaches the Bible, stands on God’s truth, and welcomes people with love, I highly recommend Bay Area Church. We are thankful that God led us here and are excited to continue growing in our faith alongside this wonderful church family. Bay Area Church was awesome — I absolutely loved being there.

From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at ease. The atmosphere was warm, authentic, and genuinely uplifting. The pastor taught from the book of Acts, and the sermon on the conversion of Paul was excellent — biblical, clear, and deeply impactful. It was the kind of message that challenges you while also encouraging you.

I didn’t just attend a service — I experienced meaningful teaching and authentic community. I’m grateful for the time there and definitely look forward to coming back.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for solid teaching and a welcoming church family. Friendly and welcoming. Not too in your face for visitors. Pastor spoke to us directly on his own accord in a kind welcome. An awesome place , welcoming people like me to their church and I just love the people and the church This has been my church since I was 4. I absolutely love it here! If you're a college aged young adult, I definitely recommend joining the Compelled life group!

name: Bay Chapel - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: I have been lucky -- blessed (yes!) -- to sit by to some of the leadership from Bay Chapel in Tampa twice over the past few months. Their love of Jesus is infectious. An amazing group of people doing incredible things. God bless you!! Love is the best word to describe this place. I grew up in a Southern Baptist church, always felt judged, condemned, people giving funny looks if someone was not dressed right or reading a different version of the Bible. From the moment you walk in this place the entire staff and Congregation pour out nothing but Love. The people are what make this place such a great Church, but it's God's presence in them that shines the most. If you want a place to feel welcomed and love, this is your Church Great church amazing crew highly recommend This is not a church, it's THE CHURCH for you and your family. My family has lived in the Tampa Bay area for over 120 years. We have even pastored church's all over Tampa Bay. This church is the best church I have ever attended including our own when we pastored. The music is the best! The children's ministry is the best and we have 7 grandchildren. And all the pastors, staff and volunteers are truly loving to all the guest. You must visit Bay Chapel. My wife and I have been going to Bay Chapel for about six months and I want to share our experience. We have always felt welcomed and part of this family. I always sense God’s presence in this place. For example, in this morning’s service, I didn’t want the music to end because the praise was so meaningful. That is what Heaven must be like, right? And Pastor Bria’s preaching today (as well as how Pastor Wes preaches as our shepherd)  is biblically-based and beautifully vulnerable. I have never written a review on a church but felt led to voice this experience. If you are seeking a place to worship with kind and loving people, then try Bay Chapel. Bill Barksdale

name: Bay Farm Church - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor John's knowledge and ability to teach the congregation about how to implement what is in the Bible is fantastic.

Pastor Guy is such a blessing in many ways, such as his messages when he fills-in for Pastor John and his wonderful knowledge of technology that enhances people's ability to see our church services in person and on YouTube.

Joleen's dedication, especially to children and women, is ever present through the Children's Sunday School classes and the Women's Bible classes.  I cannot imagine Bay Farm Church being without her dedication and services to all who need her. Highly recommend checking out Bay Farm Church. A welcoming congregation seeking to live out the great commandment of loving God and others. Every Sunday, Pastor John delivers rich sermons accompanied by awesome worship, and there are a plethora of ministries for everyone, including men's, women's, kid's, youth, MOPS, sports, missions, prayer, and more. Church meets Sundays at 10am - see you there! BFC is a vibrant Bible based contemporary Christian church with upbeat worship music.  The sermons are relevant, topical and referenced with numerous Bible verses.  The Children's Ministry, where child care is provided, is amazing and  the people are very friendly.  BFC is a place where I can count on hearing God's Word.  Pastor John does not dance around the tougher issues.  He is very adept at relating the Bible to our everyday lives.  I leave Bay Farm Church each Sunday with tools to tackle whatever life has in store for me.   I look forward to spending Sunday mornings at BFC and give it my highest recommendation - CHECK IT OUT!! Rock solid church.   Pastor preaches a strong, bible based message, the music is great and the members are welcoming. Amazing children's/youth programs. Welcoming and friendly people and staff. Free doughnuts before the 10AM Sunday service!

name: Bay Hills Church - Richmond Campus
reviewSummary:
Best place on Sunday no passing judgment, and pastor Allan is very smart and funny This is a great church.  I love coming here every Sunday morning.  Pastor Dave is terrific.  He is very intelligent and has a great sense of humor.  I enjoy singing along during the worship.  They have a good band and singers.  The greeters and ushers are very friendly.  I like when missionaries come to visit and the special events at this church.  I would recommend this church to anyone. I love my church.
Come to Life while meeting like minded people. My wife and I first came to this church in 2012. We had been at Hilltop Community church for a few years prior, but after their assistant pastor left, we didn't really feel like anything was keeping us there.

We stumbled across this church after a few teenagers were overheard talking highly about, and that caught my attention because what teenager likes church?

We came in on Father's Day, and there was so much good going on. Fun, friendliness, community, laughter, celebration, joy. The kind of environment you would expect Jesus to actually participate in.

Well, 6 Year's later almost, and we're still here. We are involved in the fitness and fun small group. The pastor knows us on a first name basis. Our son became acclimated to a classroom setting through the children's ministry. He comes home singing songs, and has friends in preschool that are also in his Sunday school class.

I've bumped into friends and coworkers here. It's an amazing place to connect. The church is active and does stuff. And serves. And isn't pretentious. They're funny. The message is real. It's relevant. It's convicting.  We actually stick around after service to talk with people. (Free coffee and donuts doesn't hurt either). My first Sunday checking out Bay Hills, I was beyond nervous. I knew almost no one. I hadn't been to church in decades and I wasn't where I wanted to be with God. I wasn't even completely ready to socialize, but I took a leap of faith and showed up to check this place out. The second I walked up to the doors, I was greeted by two sincere people and with many other smiles. The music had already started and it was positive, encouraging and moving. I felt God in the worship. The message began and it made me laugh, cry (yes in the first day...lol) and think. Pastor Daves sermon was completely based on scripture. He used comprehensive examples, hilarious stories, and I didn't catch myself zoning out or checking the time...which...to be completely honest, I'm prone to in uncomfortable situations. Afterwards, I helped myself to coffee and doughnuts and bumped into a few people i knew! They were excited and surprised to see me there and we caught up. They introduced me to someone else who showed my the childrens ministry (epic!) And the nursery was a DREAM for me as a new mom. Time was flying, and before I knew it, I had to head out. I came back the next week...and haven't stopped going since. The messages at Bay Hills have helped me become the closest to God I've ever been, and the friendships i've made over the past year and a half are such an important aspect of my life. As an active member, I am now happily involved with the church including the children's ministry and small groups. Learning about the churches structure and community over the years has only made me feel more and more blessed to have found such a Jesus-focused, diverse, sincere, honest, and fun place to call home.

name: Baycities SouthBay Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Good people

They help people change Into powerful loving families that care about everybody’s health and well-being. Love you guys. Best community in the world loving caring in very inviting in the pastor is so comedic very comfortable setting The first time we ever came, we felt so comfortable, we 've been coming back ever since. If you are looking for a place where you can come as you are and be yourself, listen to biblical teaching by the most down-to-earth pastor, (also a very funny guy) this is a must-visit. The worship team is talented and inspirational. We don't even live in town, but whenever we come on business, we make it a point to join the great folks at Bay Cities Church! We feel right at home. Awesome church and awesome leadership group! The band. singers, and gospel music are inspiring to it's members. Jim ( the preacher), is an inspiring leader who not only preaches the word of God, but lives it daily. Always makes people welcome to God's house! Wonderful church for everyone to attend. I attended  the Celebrate Recovery step session. If you have any hurts, hang ups or habits come by on Friday nights at 6p.m

name: BayMarin Community Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: Bay Marin Community is a great church that really makes you feel at home. Matt, the pastor, was extremely welcoming to my family and he gives a very thought-provoking message. I would recommend Bay Marin to anyone looking for a church in the Bay Area.

name: BayNorth Church of Christ - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my wife had the pleasure of attending a Marriage Ministry Date Night event at BayNorth Church of Christ, and we were truly blessed by the experience. From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with warm, open arms. The people there were incredibly kind, sweet, and made us feel like family right away.

The event featured Christian comedian Tristan Johnson, and he had us laughing the entire night. His energy and humor were a perfect reminder that laughter and faith belong in every strong marriage.

The atmosphere was peaceful and full of love, and the dinner they served was top-notch. I normally don’t eat salmon, but it looked so good I gave it a try—and I’m glad I did. It was absolutely delicious! Every dish was fresh and full of flavor.

But what made the night even more special was being there with my wife. She looked absolutely beautiful, and sharing that evening with her reminded me how truly blessed I am. She’s such an amazing woman, and spending that quality time together in such a positive, uplifting setting meant the world to me.

BayNorth is a truly special church. You can tell they care deeply about marriage, community, and building real connections. We had a wonderful time and are already looking forward to the next date night. If you’re looking for a welcoming place to visit—or maybe even call home—BayNorth Church of Christ is a great place to start. After prayerfully searching for a church home and visiting for some time, we decided to make this our home church. Pastor Morris’s delivery of the Word, the inspiring choir, and the genuine spirit of fellowship have confirmed that this is the right place for me and my family. BayNorth Church of Christ is very welcoming and inclusive. All glory to God. God's will be done. This church is truly remarkable! The atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, and the community spirit is palpable. They go above and beyond to assist those experiencing homelessness by offering essential services such as showers, nutritious meals, and childcare. It's inspiring to see how they incorporate the gospel into their outreach efforts, making a profound impact on people's lives. If I could rate them, I would absolutely give them a perfect
score of 100 stars. Their dedication to serving others is a true blessing! I visited this church for the first time today. The guest Pastor, Dr. Thomas, was LIT🔥🔥🔥
My youngest sister passed away exactly a year ago today, but....
If it has not been for the Lord, who is on my side, I would never have gotten to spend time with her before she died.
I believe that my God got me out of prison because He knew that I'd need to see her and spend time with her before He took her 🙏🏾❤️

name: Bayou City Fellowship - Cypress - Cypress Campus
reviewSummary:
I wanted to leave a review to let everyone know great the people of this church truly is. My sister in law lost her life to the hands of her estranged husband in April 2026. We reach put to the church to see if it was possible to use the facility for her service. Not only did they allow us to use there facility they also help us with the table set us as well as the paster did her service. The people of this church is definitely from God. There heart is pure gold and we can not think each ans every one of them enough. Thank you Bayou City Fellowship for everything you did for our family in this terrible time of need. 1st Visit to this church. Its a Hidden Gem. Service was great! Message was easy to understand. I love that the pastor had a story to share of how God worked recently.
This place looks like a little villa far Far Away.. My parents and I have been going to this church since 2019 and it has been incredible!  Great worship, great sermons, and great fellowship! Pretty fascinatingly homey atmosphere. It really feels like a converted farm house or redeemed saloon. God makes simple things beautiful. He makes humble things grand. You'll find that humble grandeur in this little community Church. If it weren't for the amazing things that come from this loving church, my neighborhood would have suffered many more weeks than it did post-Harvey. They are truly a blessing.

name: Bayside Apostolic Center - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: This church is amazing ! If you want to feel the Holy Spirit , this is the place to go . Jesus walks in this church and you can feel it as soon as pastor saiz starts preaching! Beautiful church with such a warm, diverse, and welcoming congregation. Pastor Steve Saiz Sr. and his wife Debbie are exceptional. When we moved from Utah to Southern California, we were so thankful to find a church family where we fit right in. Lots of great programs and ministries to get involved in if you feel God calling you. Looking for a great Apostolic Holy Ghost filled church. I love my church, Pastor Saiz and First Lady Saiz are very loving, caring and supportive. The ministry is awesome. Everything about Bayside is AWSOME..

name: Bayside Church - Adventure Campus - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm sharing purely for awareness as it relates to data privacy & consent; a recently filed public doc under FARA lists this church as a location for geofencing advertising campaign conducted by a firm "Show Faith by Works LLC" based in California on behalf of Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs. I bring to your attention so the public is aware and in hopes you will update your privacy policies or consider informing the congregation. The core component is to track individuals at their place of worship by use of their phones The church held a Halloween event and parade.
Since it was hosted by a church, there were hardly scary costumes, unlike typical parades.

I expected some Christian messages since it was organized by a large church, but there were none, which was a bit disappointing.

However, aside from that, it seemed like a nice event to attend with kids. I wanted to experience a new church, so I decided to visit Bayside with my mom and my girlfriend. Unfortunately, the entire service—about an hour and 20 minutes—was spent talking about money and asking for donations. It was extremely uncomfortable and honestly disappointing.

At one point the pastor even said, and I quote, “your hand should be shaking as you write down your donation.” Hearing something like that made the whole experience feel more like pressure than encouragement. It didn’t feel uplifting or spiritual—it felt like the entire focus of the service was on getting people to give money.

I understand that churches rely on donations to operate, but dedicating an entire service to it felt excessive. Especially with the current economy, many people are struggling just to afford basic necessities like groceries. Spending that much time asking people to give more felt very out of touch.

I also noticed the church was surprisingly empty, and afterward it started to make sense. My sister later told me she stopped going for the exact same reason. Without me even asking, she said she left because the services always seemed to revolve around asking for money.

I went hoping for a welcoming and meaningful church experience, but unfortunately that’s not what I found. Blessed to call this Home!!!

We moved to Roseville and attempted to enroll my, then, incoming Second Graders at St. Claire's Catholic Church but were met with an unwelcoming, rude director, who said she 'can't help us, if we don't get the MONEY,  application and Baptism Certificates in by Friday' as the applications for the program were closing that week. I had explained we had just moved in July and she simply said it was 'open since June'. What a disappointing experience!  First Communion was done at Capitol Christian at Christmas Service instead.

In the months to follow, God connected our family to Bayside Church Adventure,  where we met a community of loving individuals who brought us in and welcomed us! We felt so loved and felt the love of God everywhere!  Everyone was positive with love, joy and compassion with no judgement or condemnation.  As time endured, my family got involved with various Ministries and we are now spreading the love of God to others through these Ministries on a daily basis.

Bayside Covenant Church @ Adventure has been such a gift to us.  Never knew God and never fully accpeted Him until starting the Christian Journey, initially at Capitol Christian and  later finding our Home at Adventure!  God Bless Bayside Church; thank you for being there for us! They were holding a 2 day conference. We went for 1 day and it was a lovely church with a great vibe for this woman's conference. It's a short drive, so I'll probably attend again... everyone was so friendly

name: Bayside Church - El Dorado Hills Campus - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to the Christmas service 12/24 @ 6:00pm. The message was strong but we went into the lobby when the music started. It was so loud that I felt the bass in my chest. Jesus Christ should be the focus, not painful music. We have been attending Hills Church for nearly 10 years.  For a fairly large church it is very friendly, homey and welcoming.  It has a small town church feel minus any judgy, smothering vibe.  Very family oriented with tons of things for everyone of any age.
They also seem to be accepting of people from all walks of life.
I believe it is non denominational which I like.  Further, I have yet to hear any sermon speaking on a topic other than salvation and/or stewardship within the community.  No dogma or special interest bias as is so often heard from pulpits in other churches.
It's not a "Spirit filled" church in the traditional sense, but nevertheless God is present. Really great on-the-lawn entertainment venue. Just be aware that there is little shade and can get very warm/hot, so plan accordingly. Such a lovely place.  They are so welcoming and kind. They have good skills with kids, teens,and adults! Would very recommend if looking for a wholesome Christian church Such a great church! It is a large congregation but the bible study groups and special events help things feel smaller. Sometimes you have to speak up a little to be noticed, but it is worth it as the congregation is incredibly kind once you get to know them. Pastor Jonathan and the associate pastors help everyone feel welcome, whether they have been Christian their whole life or are just curious about the faith. I'd definitely recommend it, especially for people that are interested in having a first time church experience.

name: Bayside Church - Santa Rosa Campus - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary: I’m actually Jewish, but went with my girlfriend for Christmas. As such I was highly skeptical, but I was pleasantly surprised. Everyone was kind and welcoming, and there was a lot of good energy. I was impressed with the music and how well the songs were played. I was especially moved when we all lit candles with the message that we all have light and love to give to the world, and they handed a check of $2500 to a struggling single mom. We need more good people like this! Redwood with Bayside Church is an amazing church. Their ministry and outreach programs are nourishing to the soul. I am so thankful that I had the opportunity to volunteer and attend this church. My kids ask me on Tuesday, "Is tomorrow Sunday"! Their children's program and events are amazing, and far beyond anything I could have hoped for in a church. Thank you guys, forever in a day! I love this church. They are very welcoming and loving people there. Lots of ways to get involved and have fellowship. Great music and worship time. you can raise your hands if you want-I like that too! The congregation are very involved in the community as well. My kids are grown but they did go to the children's program when they were younger and they enjoyed it very much. Looking for a church home? Come on over!!! Attended Bayside Church jn Santa Rosa this morning. OUTSTANDING!  Great, very welcoming, place to worship. The worship was exciting and uplifting and the Word was solid and presented well. We thoroughly enjoyed participating and we’re blessed to have attended. RCC has been a great church for our whole family.  Children's programs are strong, and the middle school & high school programs are fun but inspiring for students.  Sunday morning worship is helpful, creative and a great way to start a new week. Very welcoming, but not pushy.

name: Bayside Church Davis - Davis Campus
reviewSummary: I had the honor of being able to volunteer with this church while studying at the university- I have so much love for Pastor Wesley and the church team. I was also baptized here. Unfortunately I made the mistake of leaving without saying goodbye -yes, I know, what a shame- all that said, this is a great humble place to start or increase your faith journey if you need. Bayside Davis is such a wonderful church! It is welcoming to all ages and constantly creates an environment that is fun and joyful! I love how honest and biblically based the preaching is! The children's ministry is phenomenal and the college ministry continues to grow! This church really does make you feel like you're a part of a family! Bayside Davis is a very family based church. Pastor Wesley has been a very passionate faith filled man and always filled with positive insights on love . I have been apart of a wonderful faith filled message given with love for all .. Bayside Church provides the best Christian sermons/talks.  Our daughter attends U.C. Davis.  When we visit her again, we will definitely be returning to Bayside Church.  I can not imagine going anywhere else. This church is amazing! It's new but the teaching and community are amazing. I highly recommend.

name: Bayside Church Orange County - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
They may got food in front. Ok worship but lack to be simple. Too much work for follow up. Lack of people skills shown here. Too much tech involved with the lights through most of service. Not coming again for those reasons. We have had such wonderful experiences at this church , at both their new campus off red hill and their previous location at vanguard. I love how well they invest in the full family - especially the children's ministry. Their vbs is a great opportunity to try out the church and invite friends ! Great new church in Orange County. I love their verse by verse Bible teaching with practical application. Worship has been great as well as great opportunity for connections. I like that it's connected to the Bayside network in NorCal which is know for its focus on kids/families, compassion outreach to the community and youth ministry. I would encourage everyone to check it out. Bayside OC has truly been home for me. After moving to Orange County in 2020-in the middle of covid- I was desperately seeking for community, not just any community, but a faith believing community. I found Bayside in 2021 and it is the first church that felt like MY home church. From the beginning, I felt welcomed, supported and spiritually challenged in the best way. One special moment that left a long lasting impression was how intentional Tyler (our lead pastor) was with learning and remembering my name.

I was baptized in 2023 and Bayside is also where I met my now fiancé-that is why Bayside holds such a special place in both our hearts. We are now deeply connected with the church. We serve on Sundays because it is one way to live out our faith and be active participants in what God is doing through Bayside OC.

Bayside is a bible teaching church, with amazing pastors who believe and embody the teachings of Christ. Bayside isn't just a place we attend on Sundays-- its a family that has shaped our faith, our relationship and our lives. Love this church! Cannot say enough good things about the staff and people at Bayside OC. The true key is to get connected so that you can make connections and be known! My girlfriend and I were initially drawn in after attending Bayside Granite Bay, but the difference maker has been getting involved in the Young Pro’s group and on the service teams. Having a loving community of people that genuinely care and support you through all the ups and downs of life while growing in your faith can truly be a difference maker in your life! Bayside is the place to be!

name: Bayview Presbyterian Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Bayview Church is a wonderful, warm, family-friendly church where the word of God is reliably taught every Sunday by pastor Jason. The congregation is small, but it is filled with kind, welcoming people. The worship consists of hymns. I would describe this church as the opposite of a seeker-friendly church. They will not alter the Bible in order to attract more people. The sermons are straightforward and easy to follow. It’s a good church for people of all age groups. I can’t recommend it enough! I've been going to Bayview Presbyterian in Chula Vista my whole life (33 years!) and it truly feels like family. The teaching is grounded in sound, scripture-based theology, and the people are warm and welcoming. It's more than just Sundays — there’s real fellowship happening throughout the week, from Bible studies to beach volleyball in Coronado. What really sets Bayview apart is the personal care — our pastor genuinely knows and shepherds his congregation. If you're looking for a place to encounter Christ and feel His love, I highly recommend Bayview. Finding this church has been such a blessing in my life. When Hector recommended me this church and from the moment I arrived, I was welcomed not just by Pastor Roger (retired) and the people, but by the unmistakable presence of the Lord. There’s a deep reverence for God’s Word here, and everything — from the worship to the fellowship — is centered on Christ.

Pastor Jason and the community is warm, inclusive, and truly reflects the love and grace of Jesus. Whether you’re a lifelong believer or just beginning your walk with the Lord, you’re made to feel like part of the family. No pressure, no judgment — just truth spoken in love and genuine care for one another.

If you’re looking for a church home that honors God with reverence, welcomes all with love, and stands firm in biblical truth, I wholeheartedly recommend this church. My Family has been attending Bayview OPC consistently since 2/11/2024. I found it by looking for a reformed church in Chula Vista. This church family and the sermons on Sunday are nothing short of a blessing! If you’re looking for a church that preaches from the Bible alone and want to encounter a church family that is loving, kind, and compassionate…look no more! You found it. When I think of the word “family,” I think of this church: There is love, support, counsel, and spiritual nourishment all in one place. The atmosphere is welcoming and happy. Pastor Jason’s sermons are Christ centered and edifying. I’ve been attending this church for a decade and will continue to call this church my “home.”

name: Beach Bible Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Beach Bible Church is precisely where I want to raise my children. Karoll knows all the children by name and makes Beach Bible a second home for each of them. Jonathan, the youth pastor, both lives and preaches the Gospel and makes sure that the students are firmly grounded in Scripture. It's so easy to be known in this community; every ministry feels focused on bringing everyone closer together and closer to God. Amazing church. Very small, but that just means everyone is like family and grows together with God. If you look at the other reviews that gave them 3 stars or 1 star, they do not say anything to back up their claims... coincidence? I think not. We are new to the area but have found the people in this small church community to be about the friendliest on the planet. The dinners on Wednesday nights are a great way to meet people, as are the small groups and bible studies. Services are insightful and thought-provoking. I catch them online if I am out of town on a Sunday, because I don't want to miss out! I feel at home here already. I have been attending Beach Bible Church for Four year. I am blessed each week as I am refreshed and refilled with  Gods Word.
The amazing music, worship, praise time to our Lord, is a beautiful time for me. I am so happy to be a part of BBC and I love sharing it. I love this everybody in there is so wonderful so beautiful inside the service is wonderful the pastor is absolutely lovely and everybody in there is very nice and it's a good place to go get get a message of the Lord I just wish you would open up very soon because I need to go to church and I love that church

name: Beach Chapel - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church & amazing people that truly love The Lord! The praise and worship misic was awesome & their Sunday morning service was very powerful. This church also offers multiple classes & activities throughout the week! A truly amazing experience! My life led me in this direction, yet, my Ken guided me here and I am so grateful and thankful for the service. I am forever changed. Beautiful Ministries...I go to the Healing Rooms, and it brings me so much peace and happiness. My job involves serving and praying for others, and this is a sacred opportunity to have others pray over me. I am grateful! Barbara one of the most welcoming and loving churches. People are so nice and make you feel so wanted. The worship is also some of the best I’ve ever heard. If you are looking for a great family oriented church this is the place Great place loving and power of god move in gifts follow jesus in all the bible now like other churches not do heal amazing church

name: Beach Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Beach Church in Jacksonville Beach is a wonderful Christian church. The building is very nice, beautifully designed and decorated, large, has comfortable seating and childcare. The praise and worship team is truly fantastic and they do a great job every week. All of the pastors are really excellent as well. I was raised Baptist, My Husband was raised Catholic and we both enjoy coming here. They have a 9 AM and 11 AM service every Sunday. The people who come here are very welcoming and friendly! While this is not a church, I attend regularly, I recently helped out in their evening, homeless shelter, where they provided accommodation for nearly 90 individuals during a period of freezing temperatures.
They run a professional, kind, and generous operation that merits a tip of the hat Praise God for Beach Baptism in the ocean today! Jesus is smiling today!!!! I love this church!  The people are genuine and welcoming to everyone.  The music is outstanding and Pastor Jerry gives great practical sermons that can be applied to everyday life. Definitely a new experience!! It will kind of grow on you...  If you are more conservative,  this (church) will take some getting use to.

name: Beachcities Community Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We went here for the first time this past Sunday. At first I wasn’t sure what to expect. I have to say the sermon and service was absolutely fantastic. Pastor Kent is amazing and does a good job of relating with the people and having enthusiastic explanations of the bible.
They offer nice brunch style food and coffee for all.  Everyone there was very nice and kind.

Great church to praise and learn about our Lord and Savior. People are nice and considerate here. Gets mostly crowded for service but be kinda early for parking. Lots of brunch food to coffee. Service nicely done to a top standard. Sermon good and nice music. Sermon 's are to the point exceptional and are always meaningful to my life time experience at least in my heart and mind  Paster Kent is a master at showing me the way. I look forward to every Sunday God Bless Beach Cities Church One of the smartest pastors in Orange County Pastor Kent is unbelievable knowledgeable like no other and the whole church is very likable very family orientated. Once again very knowledgeable pastor Kent and very well balanced with what’s going on in the world. Our Faith walk is blessed each Sunday by the worship, teaching, & fellowship at Beach Cities Church of our great Lord & Savior Jesus Christ, in whom we have a new life.  All are welcome to come and partake of the new abundant life found in Christ.

name: Beachpoint Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I love going to Monday night services at Beachpoint.  Monday nights are called Celebrate Recovery followed by a men’s and a women’s group.  I’ve really enjoyed the teachings at Beachpoint Church and highly recommend Monday nights for those who need additional support during their recovery process.  You can be in recovery for anything, it doesn’t just solely target drugs and alcohol.  The music is wonderful and new comers are always welcome with open arms! I absolutely love Beachpoint Church! Their mission to develop authentic followers of Jesus Christ is inspiring. The church offers a variety of opportunities to serve both locally and globally. The messages are consistently relevant and encouraging. Whether you prefer a traditional or contemporary service, there's something for everyone. It's truly a multi-generational church with a strong sense of community and mutual support, who love God, one another, and our world. Sunday sermon at 4pm by Redemption Point Church pastor Bumble: The crowd is nice, fun, festive and good people about 30 to 45 years old.The sermons are serious. Fellowship after service is awesome. Not only The food to eat after service is amazing.( I love the eating part the most) [secret] The people and their expression of love, class and kindness are a vivid example of God's goodness. Such a welcoming church along with great send off feeling positive, grateful, and always apperciated that we showed up. and very important that enough the local kids are engaged supported and want to attend. Good things happening there. I recently played in a Pickleball tournament at the Church and everyone is friendly and welcoming I think the Pastor and his wife are down to earth lovely Christian people and it shows in how everyone treats one another and cares for the hurting and suffering in our community . They have listened to me endlessly crying over my son who has been suffering with dual diagnosis . They never stop being there for the community and the worship team is exceptional they have their own writers for children’s ministry and my boys went to the preschool and summer camps and still attend occasionally when they are healthy and in town .
