name: Beacon's Bible Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Was visiting this church while I was visiting my son in encintas am from Pennsylvania and this truly was my church away from home...will be my home church whenever I come to visit encintas.  Very friendly congregation and pastor . I was welcomed with open arms and had awesome fellowship while there. God Bless you all We've really enjoyed getting to know the people at Beacon's Bible Church. Our kids love it, we dig the worship and teaching, and meaningful relationships continue to develop.

We've been looking for a place to belong for years, I'm so glad God brought us here. Really caring fellowship. Small town feel and nice pastor.  Genuine. This is an amazing community church. People treat me like family here. My wife and two kids also love it. Nothing but great things to say about this church Wonderful church filled with loving and godly people!  The messages are always relevant and meaningful.  Great family church!

name: Beargrass Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: I recently visited this church with my 2 year old daughter. We are new to the area and I had heard good things about this church. Upon entering the church I was not greeted friendly but basically ignored. When I asked where to take my daughter I was told to follow a girl who basically walked in front of me talking with another member. i was then handed off to a children's worker (who was very nice, the highlight of the morning) once my daughter was taken care of I went to the worship service where not one person spoke to me or made me feel welcomed. When the service was over I went to get my daughter and they never removed her jacket and did not make an effort to thank us for coming or invite us back. I have never felt so unwelcome at a church ever. Definitely will not be going back. An open and welcoming house of worship.  A place where questions of faith are warmly received and encouraged to deepen the meaning and understanding of Christ's love.  A congregation of wonderful people from all walks of life lead by an educated, intelligent and caring professional pastoral team striving to helping others through the blessings of Jesus' teachings.  Beargrass Christian Church is not just a house of worship, but a place to warm the heart and nurture the soul through song, sermon, sharing, learning, laughter and love.  A great place welcoming all.  Looking for a place to share with others God's love, give Beargrass a try. It was hot in the building no ac Beargrass is the friendliest, nicest church I have ever attended. I loved it the first time I visited. The ministers are caring and friendly, the people in the church are amazing. I have brought friends to church with me and they were all impressed with the caring, friendly congregation. I have belonged to Beargrass my whole life and so glad I join when Idid. We've only had 3 preachers since I've been attending which started in 1954 and I've enjoyed and learned from everyone of them. Our congregation is the best and I don't know what I would without them when I'm down.

name: Beaumont Presbyterian Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: We had a great visit at the church and a delicious coffee hour afterwards. When we were first time visitors, we received such a warm welcome by so many people, we knew immediately that this was the church we were seeking.  The sanctuary is so beautiful, the traditional music, the choir and the solemness of the services fill our souls.  It offers so many opportunities for fellowship and bible study.  We highly recommend it. This is a lovely old church. We had my father's funeral there. The Pastor was very good, and the Labor of Love ladies were truly a blessing. Wonderful historic  church. The pastor Scott and his wife Rena have been pastoring there for 26 years. Very personable they both ycame to our women's function and made us all from the Presbyterian Women in the Presbytery of Riverside which include Riverside, Beaumont, San Bernardino and Redlands. A most beautiful church.  We were there because a friend passed away.  But a very nice church to frequent.

name: Beautiful Saviour Lutheran Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: I have not been back to church since my domestic violence incident in 2019. My exhusband and I were apart of a great church family, and I didnt feel I xould continue attending after our divorce. I have been searching for a place to call my spiritual home. I believe I have found it. My first in person attended service will be Sunday, October 27, 2024.  Looking forward to praising the Lord with a church family of my own.❤️ I love how true to God’s word they are! They also highly value the Christian education of young souls! Love the church and the school! Wonderful, welcoming church where God’s Word is at the center. Church that is true to God's Word.  Christ centered teaching. Very meaningful worship service and welcoming congregation.

name: Beavercreek Christian Church - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: Love this Church. Theologically sound preaching, They work hard to help their community with city serve efforts. The Special Needs Carnival is my favorite event all year. Praise God Best church I've ever been part of. I moved after about six months of attending and even though it's been 3 years I still miss it. Incredible community, outreach, small groups, etc. ♥️ Unfortunately, the church model is not biblical, neither is the preaching. The pastors do not believe in the inerrancy of scripture, nor do they preach a full gospel. The music is taken from problematic megachurches which lack theological depths and truths. Black liberation theology has made its way into the pulpit - preaching an impartiality that Jesus frequently warns against. Loving community that is centered in God's words and action. My house of worship and living freinds.

name: Beaverton Christian Church
reviewSummary:
It’s a wonderful church — I felt so warm and truly sensed God’s love for the people here. Even on my first visit, I was deeply impressed. This church community is welcoming, not awkward and consistent in the delivery of the good word. We relocated to Oregon, and it took us awhile to find a church community that we felt at home in. We found it here. Our whole family enjoys Sunday’s and the men’s and women’s groups are full of great people who continue to work towards walk the walk in faith. Love this church. Love Pastor Furman. Took me years to find a church where I felt I belonged. I love how Mrs Furman is always out in front on Sunday welcoming all church members. The music is amazing. Thank you for all you do for the community and the lost souls looking for Jesus and purpose. Thank you.

Jeremiah 29:11 (NIV)
“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.” Great church, not overwhelming and they communicate well. Great place for kids to play and learn about faith & Jesus. Family is happy to visit here every Sunday.

Update:
It’s been several years,- and we are still going every week except when we are out of town or unable to attend the service. Our children loves it here, the community is so lovely and centered around love and Jesus, and helping others in needs. It’s a very fun church that my kids are excited to come each time! Great people! ❤️ The band is amazing and I swear the sermons ALWAYS along with current struggles/events going on in my life. This church has my heart. Jon Furman is so amazing! I love how the culture, sayings, and historical events of the time are explained before we go over that chapter in the Bible. So insightful — especially for newcomers! I love that it is preached to be understanding/respectful of other cultures/religions. Amazing! Easily the best church I’ve ever been to

name: Bedrock Church Sarasota - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Bedrock! It’s such a welcoming and friendly environment. The sermons are always meaningful, the pastor is amazing, and it truly feels like being part of a family. We’re so thankful to have found this church! My first time going to church since I was a child—I had some questions for Pastor Blake after the service and he was happy to talk me through my questions and gave me a beautiful leather bound Bible because I didn’t have one at home! Definitely my favorite church I’ve ever been to, everyone makes you feel completely at home even if you’re brand new to the church or to faith in general and the service was very insightful and eye opening! Will definitely be going again :) Bedrock is a wonderful church with strong Biblical teaching, great worship and super nice people.  Pastor Blake has such an approachable, authentic and genuine style but doesn’t water down the truth of the gospel and expresses the great hope we have on the cross. He has great knowledge of the Bible but isn’t too preachy and talks so much about how the all of it impacts our lives. He makes it much more relevant to what’s happening today and we really have not found this kind of spot on teaching at any other church we attended in Sarasota. The worship style is engaging but not too much of a “show”. Thankfully, no strobe lights or massive performances on stage. Bedrock is one of the best I’ve seen, experienced and now a part of when building community.  From the day we walked in our family has been welcomed with open arms.  Blake is one of the best I heard when communicating the gospel.  The way he breaks it down, brings a story line and then at the end, brings it all together with nexts steps to grow in your faith.  The worship is an experience that really ushers in the Holy Spirit to move the way it needs to.

If your looking for a community of believers who are like minded, growing in there faith and just want to “do life together” Bedrocks your place.   Thank you guys for what you do!! Bedrock Church is a great community of believers who want to grow and serve and help point others to the cross. We enjoy the well thought out worship and the strong biblical teaching and preaching each service.There are many opportunities to be involved and use your gifts and talents for the Lord. Bedrock also is truly striving to be a light to the community it is a part of and is a very welcoming place to worship.

name: Bel Air Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Bel Air Church is one of those places that immediately makes an impression the moment you arrive, and it all starts with the views. Perched up in the hills, the scenery is nothing short of spectacular. No matter how many times I have been, the views never get old. They set such a calming, beautiful backdrop for the whole experience and really make it feel like a special place to spend your Sunday.

From the moment you drive in, it is clear that the church has thought of every detail to make the experience smooth and welcoming. There is plenty of parking, which is such a relief compared to so many other spots in Los Angeles. They clearly go above and beyond to make sure parking is never an issue. The attendants are some of the friendliest people you will meet. They greet you with a smile, direct you clearly, and honestly set the tone for how warm and kind the entire environment is once you step inside.

The hospitality continues as soon as you walk through the doors. On most Sundays you will find donuts, coffee, even popcorn, little touches that make it feel approachable, fun, and family-friendly. It is the type of detail that makes kids excited to come, while adults appreciate the sense of community it creates. And speaking of kids, Bel Air Church is truly great for families. There is always something happening for kids, and it is clear they are a priority. At the same time, I have often gone alone, and I can honestly say I have always felt completely comfortable. There is something about the environment that makes it feel safe, welcoming, and genuinely open to everyone, no matter what stage of life you are in or whether you know anyone else there.

The music is another standout. Week after week, it is consistently excellent, some of the best I have seen in any church. The quality, the energy, and the way it is presented all come together to make worship feel meaningful and uplifting. It is powerful without being overwhelming, and it adds so much to the overall experience.

Altogether, Bel Air Church creates a unique environment that combines stunning natural beauty with a true sense of community. Between the views, the music, the thoughtful hospitality, and the friendly people, it is a place that makes you want to come back. Whether you are going with your family, a group of friends, or completely on your own, you will feel at home here. For me, it has become one of those rare places that always leaves me feeling lighter, encouraged, and more connected than when I arrived. I have been attending Bel Air Church for years and beyond the amazing teaching by Dr. Drew Sams, I love that this church is intergenerational. Having members from different stages of life allows for different perspectives and insights for the growth of the church.

There is a traditional 9am service, with full choir and organ, and contemporary services at 11am and 6pm with worship band. All are amazing, and I encourage you to check one out!

If you're tired of "church shopping" and looking for a place to call home, we warmly welcome you! The church is in a beautiful site.  It's a moderate Presbyterian Church with a few different service options.  Maybe I'm old school, but I just wish people would come to church dressed a bit more appropriately.... instead of t-shirts, shorts, sneakers etc.  Message delivery is good but I wouldn't say amazing.  Anyhow come to church regardless.  God bless everyone! Gorgeous place! Looked at this sanctuary for a possible wedding ceremony and was absolutely amazed. The church sits on a hill overlooking LA, a breathtaking view. Their wedding coordinator is very accommodating and gave us a tour of the place. The sanctuary seats over 1,000 people I believe and there’s a hall across the sanctuary. There’s also a school attached at the lower part of the church. Very clean and staff are welcoming. I’ve never attended a service, but I am sure it is lovely. I am honestly surprised by the number of negative reviews this church has received, many of which seem to come from people who misunderstand its purpose. A church’s role is to teach and emphasize Scripture and the moral teachings of Jesus Christ. It should not be expected to alter biblical truth to avoid offense.

This church remains rooted in Scripture and clearly teaches biblical principles with love and conviction. I have never heard Pastor Drew speak hatefully or disrespectfully about any group of people. Instead, he focuses on Jesus Christ, moral accountability, and living according to God’s Word so that we may have eternal life. That clarity is rare and deeply needed today.

Pastor Drew is one of the best pastors I have encountered because he teaches the Bible as it is written, without watering it down. Just as a teacher must understand a subject fully in order to teach it properly, a pastor must faithfully explain Scripture and its purpose for our lives. That is exactly what he does.

Biblical passages such as Leviticus 18:22 and Romans 1:26–27 are part of Scripture and are often referenced in discussions about morality. Teaching from the Bible does not equal hate…it reflects faithfulness to Christian doctrine. Those who disagree are free to attend churches that align more closely with their beliefs, but this church should not be attacked for remaining biblically grounded.

I was baptized in 2023 and have personally experienced the presence of the Holy Spirit through this church. My faith has grown stronger, my heart has been transformed, and my walk with Christ has deepened. I do not judge or condemn anyone; I simply choose to follow Jesus Christ wholeheartedly and live according to His teachings.

This is a wonderful church for those seeking truth, structure, and genuine biblical teaching.

name: Belay Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary: I was nervous about finding a solid/biblical church when I moved to Boulder. This church has exceeded my expectations. It is intentional in ministry and community, sermons are based on scripture, and it feels more like a family than any other church I’ve been to. I was also pleased to see how many people from around the world gather to worship here! It’s very international. I’ve been here for over a year now and will attend as long as I live in Boulder. If you’re interested in visiting but unsure of what to expect, just try it out, we would love to have you! We meet in our pastors home, so expect to see a house when you pull up (I find this to be a perk!). It’s been almost a year since I joined Belay and what a year it has been. God answered a lot of prayers through this church. Finding a community to call home, a place where I instantly felt welcomed wasn’t something I was expecting. I was initially skeptical, having never been to a house church, but it turned out to be exactly what I needed. I have been challenged and supported in my spiritual growth, loved and nudged. Belay is a beautiful place of worship, education, faith, fellowship and laughter. If you are looking for a church, community and home or curious about God we’d love to have you. Belay Church is an amazing place to worship and hear the Word of God. I started attending this church last year and immediately felt like I was family. The people at this church made me feel like I belong. I have been challenged to grow in my faith through Pastor Paul (and others) weekly messages. And I am inspired to reach out to my community with the life giving message of Jesus Christ. I would HIGHLY recommend Belay to anyone who is looking for a solid bible believing Holy Spirit filled church!! Belay Church has been a major answered prayer! Paul and Patty are the most humble and kindhearted pastors I've met. From the moment I walked into this house church, I've felt so loved and supported by everyone. This church has pushed me well outside of my comfort zone and the community here is authentic. The sermons are solidly based in God's Word and the teaching is well done and accessible for newer believers. Not only that, the members of this church have shown up to help anyone in need and have a strong focus on prayer.  I was initially hesitant to check out a house church and after just giving this church a try, love being a part of this church family. Would highly recommend folks to check this church out, if anything they have great coffee and monthly potlucks! Paul and Patty are amazing pastors, and were Senior Pastors at my church in Beijing; a large multi-cultural, multi-denominational international church, with over 900 members, and part of a larger group of 14 congregations that all meet in Beijing.  Paul and Patty are exceptional pastors/leaders and they care deeply for the people around them.  During their time of leadership at our church, it not only became more dynamic and exciting, but the church became more of a family than it had ever been before, a place where everyone is welcome, and we still enjoy this culture today.  When they left our church they left with blessing and full support to start a new church in boulder, and I can fully endorse Belay Church as I have (and still am) enjoying the success of their ministry.  Do yourself a favour and visit them at Belay church.

name: Believe LA - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church family & Pastoral team At Believe  they bring the word of God weekly, 3 services times to be exact. One thing that our Pastoral team continues to do is lead by example. I was mentally going through a lot of trials and tribulations this past year, fighting up against spiritual warfare, and both of my Pastors came to my job and they helped me through one day. It doesn’t get better than that having Pastors who will help intercede and attack the enemy with prayer for you. Life sometimes is hard but one thing I know is that you can triumph with 4 amazing things THE WORD OF GOD, PRAYER, PRAISE & WORSHIP and A Great Church.  The Church is the people. At BELIEVE L.A.  they teach you how to walk in your everyday VICTORY with  3 GOD given tools. So glad I found this church because I searched for this place it’s nothing like this place, so this must be the place! It took me a while to write this review. I’ve attended this church on and off due to work but I've been there since its earlier days near the high school. It felt authentic and focused on Scripture and community. It was also nice seeing familiar faces from the music industry.

Over time it felt like the focus shifted toward growth rather than investing in the people already there. I joined a women’s group and was surprised the leader was a "new Christian" with limited biblical knowledge, the group began talking about zodiac signs and things got uncomfortable so I stopped attending. I later found out there was no system in place for how they picked these "leaders" you literally just volunteer and get can lead a small group...what?

There have also been instances where the pastor took jabs at “old school churches," which is not only where he comes from but a majority of us who now find ourselves in LA looking to fill the void of our home church. I find this off putting especially from the alter, or should I say stage as thats what its referred to and treated as. Once speaking in tongues and praise dancing was also being mocked from the pulpit, is anything sacred or off limits?  Although there are lead and associate pastors, both myself and two of my friends have tried to seek counsel/prayer and were not able to set a meeting with either. Instead as someone else commented here, I received a call from someone I had never met, which felt cold and awkward. Both of these people have since left the church and now it's my time to also move on.

Prioritizing growth and leadership without strong biblical teaching (like a consistent Bible study) is dangerous. Believe LA has been such a blessing. The pastor is incredible, and the worship service is always powerful. The church community is warm and welcoming, and we leave every Sunday feeling truly filled by the Word.

That said, for a church with such a strong young adult presence, it’s surprising how few opportunities there are to connect outside of Sunday service. There’s a real hunger among young adults to build community and grow in faith throughout the week, but currently, the church offers very limited options.

The young adult Bible study is only once a month (if that) and isn’t well-publicized. There’s no consistent mid-week prayer, no weekly men’s or women’s groups, no singles or marriage ministry, and no social gatherings or outreach efforts targeted toward deeper fellowship.

If you’re looking for a church that offers more in terms of weekly connection, discipleship, and community-building, you may find yourself needing to look elsewhere or supplement with another church.

Still, Believe LA is a beautiful place to worship on Sundays. I just hope to see more intentional investment in community life beyond that in the future. I initially started going to the church because I was invited by someone I knew. I went and enjoyed the church and decided to join. I took the membership classes and finished. However part of getting involved in a helps ministry you have to be interviewed by a member which is over the department. I decided to join the homeless or community service group and was interviewed by the leader. He was at first very nice but started asking me questions about church hurt and if I ever experienced it before. When I shared the story he told me I was gossiping which I wasn't, just answering a question he asked me. The call was very long and he eventually told me he would email me with more info on how to move forward. I never got a call, email, text, nothing after completing everything and sharing all these stories with a stranger on the phone. That was my experience so I stopped going. Also the church has a very Hollywood vibe so if you are into that you may enjoy it! ❤️❤️❤️ Let me tell you! This church is true community. From being genuinely greeted walking in, to the wonderful care at the children’s church. And can’t forget about the spiritually touching worship team singing and straight Bible teaching from pastor Aaron Lindsay. I’ve been attending since October and from the first service I knew I would call Believe La my church HOME! I LOVE IT HERE!! Anyone looking for real bible teaching and community, come check us out!  Till LA LOOKS LIKE HEAVEN 🙌🏾

name: Believers Baptist Fellowship - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary: I have called this church home for over 20 years and can't imagine a more loving group of people to spend time with in fellowship,, worship and praise.  We share one another's burdens and concerns as well as reaching out to the community to make a difference in mission projects. We also support missions far away. Our greatest desire is to be a light in our community that points people to our Lord and Savior through Bible Study, Discipleship, and Prayer. If you are looking for a small strong congregation please come and be a part our sweet family! This is a small church with a big heart and lots of love for the Lord. We just moved to this new space with lots of room and space to be COVID safe.  Come join us and enjoy a Sunday of music and worship.

name: Believers Church - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary: The Pastor preaches and teaches the word of God. Come as you are no judging. We have been going to Believers for over a year and a half. The church is a great mix of learning from the Bible and the leading of the Holy Spirit. Amazing worship and teaching. The kids ministry is over the top wonderful and our kids love going and are excited every time we go! This church has been so renewing to our heart, mind and spirit. We love Believers! If you're looking for a place that the Holy Spirit moves, this is it! This is home!! LOVE POWER AND COMMUNITY!! Join us 9:15 and/or 11:15 every Sunday to continue growing your relationship with God. The pastors and elders are spirit filled and ready to pray and BELIEVE with you! Come visit our diverse home filled with people who are imperfectly perfect because of Him!! May God bless those who are looking for a place to call home, a place to fuel your soul and/or a place of refuge. If you decide to visit please don't hesitate to say hello to me, Sunshine! If I see you I probably have spoken but just in case!!! ! :) I started going here as a referral from a friend! Love Mark Evan's and the staff!  Everyone is so friendly and not afraid to come up to you and welcome you!  I'm surprised so many more do not flock to this church because it is nothing but love and truth! And I always feel as though each day I travel from here my life improves.. so I come back as often as I can.  Emphasis on Music in the first 45 mins and then the sermon after... 9:15 am early service 11:15 later service! An absolute JOY to be here!!!

name: Believers' Church Of Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Believers' Church of Redlands is a very welcoming and family oriented church. Pastor Jeff is very heavy in scripture when he preaches and he really fills you up spiritually with meat and potato teaching not just milk like some of the other churches I've attended in the past. We have amazing members who all love on one another and are there to help eachother whenever in need. This church likes to do life together and have fun with one another! They welcome all new members with open arms and are excited to continue to grow the Kingdom of Heaven by reaching the lost. I personally have witnessed miraculous things happen in this church in my time here and it is truly my home. I hope you consider joining us sometime soon!! Pastor Jeff is an amazing pastor. He’s very informative and teaches with a lot of explanation for those who don’t understand Biblical words and phrasing. It is a little far of a drive as I live in Corona but I highly recommend this church especially if you feel lost and need some guidance. Everyone is very open and welcome as well. Hello, Pastor Jeff is a knowledgeable,  solid Bible preaching pastor. In addition, I have been w this church for several years now & he is very committed to his fellowship. He somehow manages to take care of his flock inspite of an otherwise busy schedule. He's never too busy to answer people's questions w whatever is going on n their lives. Not only is he good, but I enjoy the comraderie I have built w all the other members. It's easy to not only feel blessed by being n this church but also, to feel like u r a part of an extended family of God. Come join us sometime, if u r looking for a solid Bible based church. We would love to meet u. God bless u. Wonderful people to meet and friendly environment. Pastor Jeff and his Wife Marissa are warm and welcoming to all. Come join the family and feel loved This church has been integral my growing relationship with Jesus! There is such a strong emphasis on preaching the word of God and equipping Believers in how to live a life a faith!  I would highly recommend coming to this church!

name: Bellevue Baptist Church - Main Campus
Bellevue Christian Center - Main Sanctuary
Bellevue Church
reviewSummary: A really lovely local church. Not huge, not a lot of "extra fluff", just simple with good people. Exactly what one needs in this crazy world The most comfortable church I've ever attended. Fun, easy to understand the sermons, sincere, non-judgemental, and loving. Come in jeans, shorts, or a suit. They don't care. They just want you to have a relationship with God and they don't pressure you. The church makes you feel like family. We lived close to the church. It’s wonderful place and bring convenience to our community. The manager of the church is responsible and credible. Thank you so much for bring the safe environment to the peoples who lived here. We appreciated you did everything for the community. I need to go a few more times before I give a final evaluation I have to say yes the teaching and the worship were incredibly good however the one gripe I have is there sound system is really really poor I couldn't hear most everything they said I went to the tech and gave her a note basically which I said please increase the volume and lower the mid-range I think she looked at me like who the heck are you well I know enough about music and it the sound when it came to actual speaking I simply couldn't understand it I couldn't hear it I so halfway through the service I just got up and left now the cool thing is online in my computer I can hear fine so I will keep listening to them on the computer for the preaching but go back for the worship About 3 years ago me and my kids went here and we loved so much. One of my kids loved it to much so he cried because we had to leave. Can’t wait to see the new changes if their are any!

name: Bellevue Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
My family and I began attending this church in February of this year. With humble hearts, we came before God and began our journey—from being seekers to receiving baptism and becoming followers of Christ. We are deeply grateful to every brother and sister here. It is through your love, actions, and faithfulness that we were welcomed into the body of Christ.

Beyond the Sunday worship services and Bible studies, this church offers a vibrant community filled with rich fellowship and meaningful connections. There are potluck lunches, movie nights, sports and fitness activities, breakfast gatherings, and camping trips—so many opportunities to grow together and share life. Here, we’ve met friends from all over the world, united by a shared faith, learning together, and exploring the meaning of life in Christ.

This church has a rich history and a heart for global missions, actively supporting ministries in other nations. As a non-native English speaker, I was especially thankful for the thoughtful arrangement of live translation services, which made everything accessible and welcoming. The children’s ministry is also exceptional, with well-equipped facilities and, more importantly, loving and attentive teachers who care deeply for every child.

We thank the Lord for this church and for every person who serves so faithfully. May God continue to bless this community and use it as a light to the nations. Bellevue Church of Christ is a good church.
I've been going here since September 2023 and I love it.
Everyone is friendly, and we put Jesus first.
On Tuesday we have prayer nights.
On Wednesday we have Bible study and dinner.
We have sports ministry as well.
I met my wife here, so that is a sign from the Almighty
that I was supposed to be here.
We dress well too, because why not?
They don't push to donate, and we have baptized many people
this year too.
I would come here if you want a good Christian based community.
We meet on Sundays at 10:15 am. I really like that Church. I came here almost 2 years ago.  I met here open people and many friends. If you are looking for a study the Bible - that is The place. Here you may bring your children for the Bible classes, you may come to play ping pong, pikle a ball, badminton or basketball. Also many different seminars, conference’s and concerts. If you are in need of- here is foodbank. May be you are looking for a place to pray - come  and worship with us I visited a number of churches looking for a church where I could learn and study the Bible. I visited 12 churches and I heard the minister here and decided to come back. Ive also joined the Bible study and it's opened up my spiritual life and given me a place to understand the Bible. I happen to be in the neighborhood. I was being a little nostalgic . I attended that church up until 1974 with my mother and my 2 younger brother's. I did not.
Go inside the outside of the building has been updated and looks very nice.

name: Bellevue Neighborhood Church
reviewSummary: I've been attending BNC for a while now, and I'm consistently impressed by the strong and faith-filled teaching of the Word of God. The congregation is so welcoming and friendly, making it easy to feel like part of the family. The church also offers impactful events that have helped me grow significantly in my faith journey. As a parent, I'm also very grateful for the excellent Sunday school program that is nurturing my child's spiritual growth. This was my first day going here, i admit I was nervous entering a new atmosphere, but right away I was greeted with warmth and friendliness, I felt very welcomed there, and wanted to stay longer lol it felt more like a family in Christ. Definitely very nice people. I’m also excited to go again, I never felt this way in other churches. And I was looking for a community I can connect with, rather than just listen to a sermon and leave. I feel like they care about people here. If u want to go here, it will be one of the best decisions u can make. God bless you. Here is why I like Bellevue Neighborhood Church: it is almost 100 years old (so cool); I've made lasting friendships; the worship band is good; and I can relate to what the pastor says. There are people from different countries with services translated into several languages. We have interesting conversations about what the Bible teaches as a practical guide to life. I can bring my non-Christian friends to BNC events, and they enjoy themselves. Also, the donuts and coffee fellowship before services are fun. BNC is truly a wonderful church that feels like home the moment I walk through the doors. People are so warmth, kind and genuinely welcoming. The sermons are consistently powerful, thoughtful, and deeply rooted in Scripture. It makes me feel like I am part of the big family. really lovely church，for the first time I came here last November, I just felt that finally I got somewhere to belong. Now I have many brothers and sisters here, they make me not lonely in Bellevue anymore.

name: Bellwether Church - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: Bellweather is a nice church we've been going there since October and the people are so very nice we love this Church.... Just renewed my faith and I felt very comfortable. It was dress casual. The Pastor and his wife introduced themselves and were polite and encouraged me to come back. The sermon was a nice change from fire and brimstone type of sermons, it had more to do with daily life affairs. I will be attending again. Hands down, one of the best small, local churches. Bellwether offers care rooms from 1st to 5th grade and some baby care. The head preacher and high school youth preacher is very good. Speaking of that, every Sunday starting 6:00-7:00P.M. They offer food for the students, and a wholesome, developing experience. Their is also an adult small group on Tuesdays. Best of all is that some of the leaders in the youth administration will have a 1 on 1 Tim with you. They do great workin the community Very nice and friendly folks!

name: Belmar Church - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary:
Just went here for a food box.
You drive up to the first guy to check in, drive up to the next person and they place it in your car and away you go.
The whole process was quick and easy.
Genuine kindness:)
I appreciate the great food but most of all the interaction.  It was very short but very welcoming.
Thank you! :)
PS- If you've never been here and you are not signed up with Foodbank Of The Rockies, you may want to find out the sign up process first. I believe you can do it right there but maybe check first. Your Thursday night foodbank from 6:30pm - 8:00pm has rescued me. Especially appreciate the frozen meats. In deep gratitude with each meal. Well-balanced nutrition for no cost is an essential service to the community, we love you! Thank You Belmar Church!♡

❍☯︎• Truly friendly folks here. We are at a shelter, $100 worth of food was stole. These fine people went out of their way to help us and loaded up our truck. They are a genuine blessing. I wish i could praise them more. Hosted a wonderful memorial dinner for a friend that we recently lost. Thank you so much. Google needs to fix our directions. The entire congregation has made me feel at such peace and they are truly responsible for my restored hope.  The pastor, his wife, and staff are absolutely the most compassionate souls that I have encountered.  I look forward to joining them soon. Your prayers are felt everywhere and I thank you. See you soon
"Mary"Colleen Craig

name: Belmont Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Steve is an excellent employee, and an intricate member of the community! 🙏 I have been speaking with the ladies from Katherine House, Ms.TIFFANY and TERRISA and have been  invited to visit Services at Belmont Church!
They have told me about the many different Services and support that Belmont Church and the Members offer to the ladies at Katherine House and everyone in The Community in need! What an impression they have of this safe place!
Their sincerity is felt in my heart! More people and places like this is needed in this world! These woman are sharing their experience and love from this Church! That’s the point! That’s the mission; to serve to share! Thank you girls! 🙏🛐💕 We enjoy the church very much. My current young adult and mid-adult friends have been there on select occasions, as they visited Nashville, TN. Austrian current young adult couples, whom I have befriended, have enjoyed visiting US South, Mexico and Brazil, on their vacations. This church truly welcomes people from all over the globe. Wonderful inspirational messages galvanize and exhort people to live their very bests. Faith journeys with Triune God through Jesus Christ come as fascinating and unique to every individual. Yes, this church fathoms and appreciates diversities of people. This church is full of diverse authentic people who love the Lord and who love each other.  I find the worship to be real and not putting a show or performance. It's uplifting.The pastor has clear messages that challenge you to grow and to lean into God.  I find the warm and welcoming people, the coffee, the worship, their outreach to the homeless, their missions support, the varied small groups and the message to be a blessing. This makes Belmont Church a place to call home for me. My ex mother in law went to that church for years. I wanted them to check in on her when she was going through cancer treatments and I left several messages. They never returned my call. I wanted to work with them to help her out since I lived out of town. I was disappointed and for the last 12 years am very suspicious of churches.

name: Belmont Heights United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I have attended prayers  several times at this beautiful Church. Every Sunday prayers starts at 10 am. It is at Long Beach . Nice pastoral, beautiful atmosphere and nice people assemble hete . Friendly people, great message, beautiful music, and Ben Camp has a mission for Christianity emphasizing social justice. God's love is preached here! Great church It was nice inside the wesley hall

name: Ben Hill Christian Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: I was there fir a memorial service.  The people were kind and generous. They make you feel welcome. Love this church! It's definitely a family thang here! My church home enjoy going Excellent place to worship God! Nice , quiet location.

name: Beneficent Congregational Church
reviewSummary: All inclusive service. Very welcoming all people. Meaningful and relevant sermons. Warm and welcoming! I was church shopping years ago and this was my first and LAST stop! We are diverse in every way, but have the same mission: to love our neighbor as we love ourselves. The building was appealing to the eye, but the church is not appealing to the soul. An immense amount of heresy starting by “proclaiming” the name of Jesus Christ but  mentioning and treating God as a woman. Same with having an “all inclusive” church is just another excuse to bash the name of Jesus Christ and what a Christian church really stands for. Truly disgraceful. Very unique piece of the Providence skyline with the enormous emerald dome. One of the earliest buildings in Providence it is quite spectacular. Nice interior as well though far less ornate than Catholic and other huge churches. The best place to go

name: Bent Tree Bible Fellowship
reviewSummary: A grace-focused Bible fellowship in Carrollton with deep expository teaching and strong community life.

name: Bentonville Church of Christ - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary: This place is absolutely the best when it comes to helping people with utility bills and rent payments. They paid almost $100 toward my electric and almost $300 towards my rent. Now I kinda want to go see the service. Visited looking for a new church, new to area. Only 1 person said hello and there were hundreds present at service. I’ve grown up my whole life in CoC and I was shocked how unfriendly this one was. Even met an old friend who lives here and had the same experience and never returned to that location. reviewSummary:
One of the best churches in the area.
Disclaimer: Our family doesn’t attend Bethany, but we were introduced to their 2025 VBS. We have a home church due to language barriers within our family.

I had heard such wonderful things about this church that I decided to make the 25-minute drive to take my 5-year-old son to Bethany's VBS. My son is full of life, and honestly, most of my prayers are about him. He’s a very loving child, but he can also be quite a handful. I was nervous about sending him to VBS because of his behavior.
From the moment we arrived, Pastor Joe welcomed us with such warmth. He seemed to understand exactly what I was going through as a parent and took the time to truly listen. He even offered thoughtful advice throughout the week. On the last day, he gifted me a book by Paul Tripp. I haven’t finished it yet, but it’s already opened my eyes to the kind of parent God is calling me to be—not just the kind I think I should be.
Every single staff member we met was kind, attentive, and genuinely caring. We felt so supported and seen throughout the entire week.
If you have young children and are looking for a warm, loving church with a supportive Christian community, look no further. Bethany truly has a heart for families. This is a TRUE community of believers and a family of God!! That's why I made Bethany my home church! I'm blessed every day by my brothers and sisters in Christ because of the strong connections between us that God has blessed!
Furthermore, the pastor, Jared Burke, does NOT compromise on the Word of God! It is lovingly, firmly and honestly preached every time! Ida who works there is very rude and condescending This church is a place of loving fellowship and acceptance. The word of God is preached and we love Jesus. Come visit us!! This is great Church that preaches God's Word. The Pastor is very loving, caring, and cares about the people.

reviewSummary:
I attended a service here last week for the first night of the Advent. It was a joy to meet many members of the congregation and the guest Pastor who is filling in until the congregation receives their new pastor in January. I will have to go back to meet her as well.

I am not a churchgoer and it is not my religion but I appreciate the deep meaning that this church has for so many of its congregation. I am fortunate to know the family who is probably most responsible for keeping this church-going when they could desperately use new members. This is the reason why this spiritual but non-Christian fellow is reviewing this great church.

They have many events throughout the year and you can learn such things as mosaics. It's a classic old church building with lots of character and they usually leave the doors open up front on gorgeous days. They have a guy who does their music who plays the piano and has a great voice while leading the congregation in song.

Everyone is welcome and I do enjoy that Spirit of openness and warmth. If you're looking for a church I hope that you will consider Bethany Christian Church as a place to spend your Sundays and the other opportunities they offer for building community and strengthening the heart. name: Bethany Christian Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary: Wanted to explore churches in Houston. So one of the churches I selected, was Bethany Christian Church. It is a small church, originally built in 1947. Went there in the evening just to check out the stained glass artwork on the church wall which can be seen from the road. At night the stained glass artwork lit up with lights installed inside the church. In a large city like Houston, it is a breath of fresh air to step into a church like Bethany. Bethany's congregation is a welcoming and caring group that strives to make each member and visitor feel like family. Their traditional services offer beautiful music and inspirational sermons followed by a fun, family-friendly lunch every Sunday. Mr. Blanco, I am sorry to hear of your experience at BCC.  Ironically, our parking lot is used extensively by those outside of our congregational members, including students, teachers and construction workers from Lamar High School; multiple community organizations; and the staffs and parents of Bethany Christian School and Bethany School of Music.  Such high demand as well as the need to protect the many children, parents, and senior citizens using the church plant necessitate the presence of security.  Thank you for sharing your experience with us.  Sometimes we may not succeed, but we are constantly striving to more fully embody Christ's love to our neighbors.  With peace, Don Tuttle, senior pastor Visiting Houston and attended Sunday services her.  Reverend Tuttle gave an inspiring sermon and service.  Beautiful Sactuary and facility.  Very friendly congregation. Not a member, fortunately, but I can tell how they are just by the way they guard their parking lot and the rudeness of their security guard, I thought christians didn't need security, after all they have "god" to protect them, right?

name: Bethany Community Church
reviewSummary:
Bethany Community Church is a rare find, especially in Seattle. They make every effort to ensure everyone, truly everyone, feels welcome and accepted. The sermons go deep into scripture and their ministries reflect a sincere commitment to discipleship. The center justice and reconciliation in everything they do.
Uniquely, they have a thriving Wilderness ministry which brings people out into nature to experience God, with a host of enthusiastic and experienced volunteers. As a Wilderness Ministry leader myself, I am very impressed with how impactful this ministry is on the people who participate.
For anyone seeking hope or healing, they will find it at Bethany. This has been a wonderful community to be a part of for the past nearly five years. Kind, compassionate, loving and selfless leaders and members. The work they are doing in the seattle community for neighbors of all walks of life is tremendous. Grateful for the impact they are having in the lives of so many, by following the teachings of Jesus and inspiring us to do the same. I was praying to find a church that; 1) was near me, and 2) one that had amazing ministry. When I came on Sunday to see the church and see if it was where I fit in. God talked to me and told me you found your home in me, rejoice and those will see Him in all of His grace and mercy. Solid Bible-based theology. Parking.
Community, family, and service oriented.
Good coffee. Isn't a church supposed to make you feel welcome? Shouldn’t its congregants and clergy be an example of empathy and compassion? Not this church! Not at all! When the community across the street was having maintenance done, displacing many residents from their usual places to park, this church threatened to tow anyone who parked in their large nearly vacant lot. The next day, when they realized the maintenance was going to take a few days, they showed their true colors even more, by charging their neighbors to park in their large spacious almost empty parking lot. Pretty sure this is not what Jesus would do.. As a matter of fact, I would be embarrassed to be a member of a church, who threatens and then exploits their neighbors in their time of need. Think we should all be praying for this Congregation, that they one day truly understand, Gods grace is not for sale.

reviewSummary: I love my church. I love the school there too. My grandson went to this school for preschool and 8th grade and graduated. name: Bethel Church of Evansville - Evansville Campus
reviewSummary: I'm 40 and this is my FAVORITE church of all, i can no longer attend due to work schedule temporarily changing but i'm now online and about to attend their service online every Sunday. Glory to our Father, and thanks so much for your time fellow staff. The pastor is awesome, and the entire band who plays music and sings are outstanding. I got tears of beauty one time the lady was on the violin. 10/10!!! Bethel Church in Evansville has driven their senior class of more than 50 people out of their classroom and therefore the church.  These are folks who helped build that church from the ground up. Many have been there since the 60's. The senior class has been pushed out of one room to another until finally now being told that if they want to meet at Bethel, these elderly people will have to travel to the second floor to a small prayer garden. It was even made clear by one of the pastor's staff to the elders that the church is doing great financially. Clearly letting the elders know that their tithes are no longer that important. The pastor of the church (Prince Samuel) didn't even have the respect to meet with these people who have been the foundation of this church for so many years.  They've been forbidden to have an American flag or even say the pledge of allegiance in church. Now these wonderful, Godly people are basically forced to find someplace else to gather.  I guess I just don't understand a church who would do this to these members of their congregation.  Someone should ask this church what would Jesus do? 14 NEWS should interview these wonderful people about their treatment by this "church." An amazing church where they focus on not only understanding God’s Word, but on living it out. I love how we are encouraged to focus less on our own selfish preferences in favor of loving others obeying the commandment of Jesus to love one another! You can tell by the way people love one another here that they are constantly pursuing obedience to God’s commands! Making disciples is clearly the focus of our pastor. While there are people in every church who seem to focus more on legalism or traditions, or idolizing a pastor, you can see genuine followers of Jesus by observing the fruit of the Spirit in their lives: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. Even in the younger generation you can see these fruits lived out in how they speak to one another and pray for one another.   If you are looking to understand the Bible and grow in your spiritual walk, this place will challenge you to leave your comfort zone and engage in a life-changing relationship with Jesus. My church is not a building. My church is all the loving family who gather together to worship and praise. I really enjoyed the service as I passed through town.  The sermon was well researched and well spoken, and it was theologically sound. Plus, it was from the old testament which gets ignored a lot. The worship through music was also extremely well done. I didn't get to interact with a lot of people, but they seemed nice.  The facility was also nice and well kept. A few of the sinks in the restroom didn't seem to work, but other than that the facility seemed top notch. All said and done, it seems like a church well worth checking out if you don't have a church home and you live locally.

Outside of the church building, the Life Groups, Church in the Park ministry (focused on serving, feeding & clothing the unhoused community), along with the missions ministries across the U.S. and around the world, exemplify the hearts and testament of faith this church has in Jesus and His instruction to all believers. You get the sense that these people are genuine, and they don't pretend to lack problems just like you and me.  If you're looking for a family of believers that truly loves the Lord Jesus and takes seriously the call to love the brethren, you're sure to experience that warm and inviting atmosphere at Bethel! The worship is powerful and full of God’s presence, and the teaching is rich with truth and grounded in Scripture. The pastors and elders have truly become family—they care deeply and are always willing to meet or answer questions to help me grow.

This church has been a constant source of encouragement, support, and spiritual growth. I’m so blessed to live in community with people who love Jesus and live out their faith. Bethel Church is home. Bethel Church offers powerful worship and teaching that’s grounded in Scripture. The leaders are welcoming and care for newcomers and longtime congregants. The church is also active in serving the local area and meeting needs. It’s a great place to grow in faith and be part of something meaningful. Super disappointed in my family’s experience with Bethel on Good Friday. Let me first explain that I just recently gave birth to our second daughter, today was supposed to be our first time back at church, which we were very excited about. With much preparation and effort we made it out the door to church. We chose to attend Bethel today because our church does not accommodate my husbands work schedule. When I found out that we would still get a chance to experience a Good Friday service I was thrilled. However, our experience was absolutely disappointing and sad for a church to hinder members from hearing the gospel.
We arrived and my toddler was dancing in the foyer to the worship music, we went in to the sanctuary with our bassinet stroller expecting to have to sit in the back row, no big deal but was told (with a finger pointing at us) we could not bring our stroller. My baby is a newborn, she cannot go with out a bassinet. We were told we can leave her in nursery…. My Newborn will not be left with strangers. So we were told we could not be accommodated.
We left.
I know this church has a huge congregation, so one family’s experience might not mean anything, but I fear to think how many others have been discouraged to attend and hear the gospel because of a silly thing like no accommodation for families in our sanctuary. “Let the children come to me” and God leaving the “99” caring for the “one” come to mind.
I just wanted to share my disappointment in our experience at this church. No one should experience such a situation.

I first visited Bethel in July of 2023. From the moment I approached the church and was greeted so kindly by the members and Pastor David, I knew this was the place for me. The greeting continued after the service, being invited to the fellowship time by a different member of the church. The welcome continued after that day and continues to today. I made the decision to join Bethel right away and became a member just after Thanksgiving. I appreciate what Bethel allows me to do to serve the church and greater Beaverton community in a way that fits my talents and abilities . I appreciate the sense of belonging and family I feel when I am at church or joining an event. I would recommend Bethel to anyone looking for a church family. Rummage sale is wonderful, you can almost find things I love this church!! So family friendly - my entire family feels welcome, even my son with disabilities and my husband who is raised with a different religious background. Open and affirming and so warm. It’s like a warm hug of a community. Those seeking social and community connection- this is the place . I'm rating one of their long-standing community service features(?) that's been help for my family for the past 3 years: Faith Cafe.  Bethel runs Faith Cafe every Sunday from 5-6PM & I've loved the welcoming, warm, and safe atmosphere.
When you go into the Cafe you're greated by the volunteer church members that week, and of course, Arnie who seems to be one of the people that is fundamental in keeping Faith Cafe going.  Upon entry to the cafe, one can gather a few items from their fruits, veggies, bread, and random shelf stable area, which isn't always available at free meals & is a welcome edition to the meal.
You're served your meal by volunteers whom wait on you, which is a very nice touch.  Arnie and Barb (the 2 consistent and senior members of Faith Cafe) provide a birthday cake & sing to people, there's special meals for Christmas, Easter, and Thanksgiving & there's even a visit from "Santa" at Christmas time.  The staff really try their best to make you feel welcome each week, and unlike other dinners I've been to, I've never felt unsafe there & if someone does start to get upset there's an immediate volunteer intervention.  I've never seen an actual dangerous situation in the 3 years I've been there.
They offer seconds and take home meals in addition to the meal too.  The meals tend to be, in my opinion, fairly good quality ingredients.  Faith Cafe is the only free meal open on Sundays west of Portland.  If you're "down on your luck" or just would like to have a meal with company, Faith Cafe is a good way to go.  Thank you Bethel for this wonderful community service!

name: Bethesda Missionary Baptist Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: The members were very friendly and welcoming. Listening to CD's for praise team replacement was different. My mom's and my late grandma's church, had my mom's and Brothers service there. Bible teaching church,  no opinions just true gospel preaching! That's my church and good service

name: Bethesda Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
A beautiful and welcoming church that also opens its doors on Saturdays for prayer and meditation in the peaceful sanctuary. There is also a yoga program and AA meeting every week. This church has an astonishingly strong music program considering its size. The sanctuary's beautiful and the welcome is a warm one.  Sermons are thoughtful and the pastor is genuinely caring. Highly recommend. I have been part of this wonderful church for over 12 years.   It is a beautiful faith community under the wise guidance of Rev. Chuck Booker.  This church lives the practice of true inclusive Love. I love the welcome the BPC provides to immigrants, to the LGBTQ community, to the disabled,  to the elders, to the youth to those who question. BPC has navigated the COVID era with hybrid worship that has allowed the community to continue to grow and change.   Enjoy the quiet and beautiful sanctuary to medicate in most weekend days, and enjoy the music which fills heart and soul. This is a small church that makes a personal connection to all and yet  helps us all work towards a big vision for a better world. This is an absolutely WONDERFUL Church! The congregation is very warm and friendly from the very first visit. The preaching, music, religious study and social action are outstanding. It is a place to be happy. The church is a very special place if you want to grow and learn.   It is also know for healing and social action in the community.  I highly recommend coming to the church and enjoying the music, sermon and conversation.   If you are interested in community action, this is the place to be.

Marsha

name: Bethesda United Church of Christ
reviewSummary: Bethesda United Church of Christ is a very warm, welcoming community. When I first moved here 9 years ago, I immediately felt at home. I like this church because they have a childs summer program that my 6 year old son attends which he loves! It is located in the suburbs of Bethesda, next to Montgomery Mall and 495 highway. We rent space there weekly. It’s sufficient for our purposes. Some of the staff are not friendly. Excellent camp in the church, competent specialists. People

name: Bethesda United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: I grew up in this church and have never left it.  The pastors are great, as are the parishioners. It has an active and exciting youth program. This church is a very friendly congregation that cares about social justice for all! Very friendly, welcoming, socially conscious church. A "Wash more Feet Congregation" Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Bethlehem Lutheran Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly inclusive members.  Work with quilt group and they are all joy to be with. A light and bright church -- in spirit, style and atmosphere. The people are friendly and welcoming in the best possible way, genuine and easy going. Worship style is liturgical but not stodgy. The teaching is an excellent blend of biblical (without being lost in the minutiae), accessible, challenging and socially current. Our kids are grown up but the children's/youth programs seem well attended and energetic. A very happy find for us. Bethlehem Lutheran has been our church home ever since moving to Encinitas over 20 years ago. We did some church shopping at the time and really appreciated the welcoming feeling we got at Bethlehem and the fact it was so family-friendly. Our daughter grew up going to Vacation Bible School here, attending Sunday learning circles, and eventually going through confirmation and the high school youth program.

The support our family has received from both the youth programs and the pastoral care from both past and current pastors has meant the world to us. In addition, the music programs are welcoming of people at all levels of musical ability -- if you are enthusiastic and want to participate, they will find a place for you! My husband and I have been in the handbell choir for years and really enjoy it.

Lastly, it is so important to us that Bethlehem became an all-inclusive church through the Reconciling in Christ process. Our congregation is welcoming of all people under the LGBTQIA+ rainbow. Our congregation also somewhat unique in that we are made up of folks of differing political beliefs and socioeconomic levels. To be honest, our makeup at present is not very diverse racially and ethnically, but leadership has taken steps to offer adult educational opportunities about racial and economic justice that have been well received.

Come check out Bethlehem Lutheran for a friendly, grace-filled, all-inclusive church home with wonderful music! We have a mixed race family & many kids.  Each went through Sunday school. Ate good food, had great fellowship. Lutherans drink COFFEE!!  Very welcoming of all people. May take awhile for some to warm up, but each person is accepted.  Good short sermons & a little singing  No admonishing, just support. At BLC you see and hear the words "all are welcome" a lot. It is not just a cute slogan it is a reality.  For me, with this congregation and our wonderful pastors, I feel I get better reception to the message of Christ than most places.

name: Bethlehem SCV - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
I just moved down the street from this church a few months ago and When I first saw it
I was unsure about going because I had my church that I usually go to Porter Ranch, but I decided to give it a try one Sunday morning and I absolutely loved it. I honestly felt right at home And loved the intimate feel of it But most importantly, I really enjoyed the message From the preacher that day. I now have been coming for about two months And are so glad that it’s so close to my house. I’m looking forward to getting baptized there soon! I have been a member of Bethlehem SCV for 18 years.  What I love about our church is that all are welcome.  We have a beautiful music ministry that adds so much to our worship times.  The congregation has small groups, I enjoy our Wednesday night dinner and Bible study as well.  Our church feels like my spiritual “home.”
Our Pastor Joe is so articulate and his sermons are Biblically sound - it’s amazing how God speaks through his messages.  The perfect church for imperfect people! I have been enjoying this, Church.  I am always greeted with a “hello” & friendly smile.  I find myself arriving early just so that I can meet people.  The pastor is full of energy, (sometimes comical) and remains focused in a teaching way that helps me understand God’s message. The worship music is excellent & spiritually moving.  I recommend this Church; it is welcoming, the music is excellent & the Pastor is worth listening too  My family and I have been going to church here for over 16 years.  We have raised our kids in this church.  From our first moment here, we have felt welcomed.  It's truly like a second home to us.  Our children have both attended preschool here and are now part of Crossfire, which is the youth group for 7th grade-College.  Phenomenal program and a great way to draw your family closer to Jesus.  Small group environment where you get to know your brothers and sisters in Christ.  Highly recommend. I have never been much of a church goer. I always had my personal faith in God, but not so much in man's motivation. I was invited to come see what Bethlehem SCV was all about. I attended one service. I was interested in this Church, so I arranged a meeting with Pastor Joe. I had many questions. Pastor Joe was thoughtful, honest and true in his faith, as I am. I have since joined this wonderful Church and at the age of 62 I was finally Baptized. So do yourself a favor, come and take a look.

name: Bethsaida Christian Church - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary: Is a place to worship God Love to serve the lord! [object Object] [object Object] [object Object]

name: Beyond the Walls Community Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I, love being apart of Beyond  the Walls. Pastor Felton and his  lovely wife Lennette are truly God's
Blessing. The whole entire staff and the congregation, Greets you with open arm's  and treat you like a family. We have been going to  Beyond the Walls for almost a year.
And  My husband and I Serve  at church.  And I Can't wait  to hear the word  and the beautiful  music. I look forward on Sunday to see my brothers and sisters  at church learning the word of father Jesus. So  come  and  visit  us can't wait to meet you and share rhe word of the lord. I can't say enough good things about this church.  They are dedicated to building people up and teaching the Word of God. I was immediately impressed on how welcoming the volunteers and staff were and how much effort they put into every service.  I have been attending now for 8 months and church has truly become a highlight to my weekend.    They are a small church but growing quickly.  If you are looking to rekindle that light inside you then this is the place. It took one visit to realize Beyond the Walls was the church for us.  We were greeted by nearly every person that day. That was 3 years ago and we are still experiencing the same warmth, kindness and love as we did our first visit. If you're looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, be discipled and feel loved, I encourage you to visit Beyond the Walls. It is truly a church that loves God, and loves people. If you want the Word of God in it's purest uncut form, this is the place. It will push you to change and not allow you to stay the same. If you want a fluffy feel good word, this is not it. If you want a deeper understanding of God's Word and amazing fellowship which depicts the kingdom of God, this place is for you! This a great church! The people are genuine and loving! The Pastor is down to earth and teaches in a way that is very easy to grasp and apply to daily Christian living! This is a great place to connect and to be discipled with other believers!

name: Bible Baptist Church - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
I don’t attend this church and I’m sure they are nice people but I live next to it and almost every day, especially early Sunday mornings, all I hear is the dang leaf blowers in the parking lot and screaming kids into the night. How bad is your parking lot that you need to pollute the air with exhaust, dust and noise so often?! And remind the kids that we don’t mind that they have fun, but they don’t need to scream so much. Seriously on behalf of your neighbors, please stop or reduce it. Decent conservative Slavic Baptist church. The people didn’t seem too friendly after the service, as they hurried to leave the church. But we hung out for a bit and did end up talking to the pastor, as well as a couple friendly older gentlemen we met in the parking lot. Awesome people and the building is great since it has been newly remodeled/constructed.

Come at least 20 min in advance for Sunday morning services as those tend to be packed. A place to hear God's word being preached. The sermons and hymns are in russian but english translation through headphones is available upon request. The sunday services are at 10am and 6pm. The Bible studies are tuesdays at 7pm. They also have Bible school for children on tuesdays and fridays. You can talk to pastor after service or arrange an appointment at some other time. Really welcoming good church best people too.

name: Bible Baptist Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve attended GTBBC for 3yrs now. For me it has been a welcoming. A congregation of loving Brothers & Sisters in Christ. Pastor Greg is a humble man that dedicates himself to God’s service. I am amazed at how much Bible is in his head. GTBBC has been a blessing from day 1. Best place to know and learn about God.  And fellowship with a free lunch!!!....Very friendly and inviting church. Right Down

name: Bible Baptist Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: So happy to see this church is still here! My parents got married here in 1948! I was able to track it down because I have a picture of them coming out the front door, and the address was above the door in the picture, and still is today! They still threw rice at that time, and you can see it in the picture!  I live out of state and will look it up next time I'm in town!  It's nice to see it's been very nicely cared for! Excellent Pastor, Great teacher, if you love the Gospel this is the place for learning it.  No fanfare, old hymnals easy to sing.  Great piano, and Violin too.  Great Women's fellowship too. Preaching of the Word. Little to nothing added, or taken away. Simple as that. I love this place! Jesus

name: Bible Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: I bring my mom here in her wheelchair. Everyone is very friendly and kind. I feel fortune to have found such a genuine community and my mom just loves it there. We go as often as we can and they have evening services which is so helpful. We were blessed by the preaching of the word of God! Wonderful people, friendly and welcoming! Great church that still holds on to “the faith once delivered unto the saints.” Thank you for the warm welcome. I love everyone here.

name: Bible Baptist Church International - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I was lost in wrong doctrine and gave up on Christianity to over 20yrs believing that God must've made me to go to hell. Thanks to KJV Bible and rightly dividing the word, I now have the truth and my questions answered. I'm saved by grace through faith alone and once saved always saved without any doubt period.  It truly is the blessed hope and peace that can only come from the Lord. Real Bible Beliving Church. I've been to a number of Churches, and have never been to a Church that actually PREACHES AGAINST sin and THE FLESH like this Church. Too many Churches these days are focused on carnal and vain repetition, traditions, and false miracles signs , emotions, they forget to actually preach against the sin! Church is NOT a concert, or a comedy show (2Cor 11, 13-15) . Thank you Lord Jesus for the King James Bible, your perfect inspired and preserved word. Let us go away from dead works (Hebrews 6:1) and use God's word that's right infront of us to show THYSELF APPROVED, (2 Tim 2:15) Rightly dividing the WORD of Truth!

Do not let PRIDE get in your way from going to a real Bible Beliving Church! There are many FALSE demonic spirits that are masquerading themselves as spirits of "God" in these secular charismatic Churches, Thank you Lord for discernment and the berean mindset (1John 4:1) (1 Thess 5:21) I have been watching Pastor Gene Kim on YouTube all the way from S.C. for almost 3 years now. He really puts my mind at ease and explains the good word better than anyone I've ever heard. He put me back on track with our Father and keeps me there. I love his style and sense of humor as well. I have never felt closer to God,  truly enjoy these bible studies. I also appreciate how Dr. Kim delves into controversial and conspiracy type issues that most won't. Thank you! Been following the teaching of Pastor Gene Kim for a long while....  We all backslide and often miss moments where we should give the Father praise and glory in our lives.  The teachings I have received from this church have really put me and my life back on track with walking in stride with the Word. If you want to learn the Word of God the KJV Bible then learn from Pastor Gene Kim, I have learnt soo much since I began watching Pastor Gene Kim. Only The Lord Jesus Christ can save us trust on him Alone his precious Blood that was shed for us takes away all our Sins Amen.
