name: Bible Baptist Church Of Hendersonville - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
You all came to my home and knocked so hard on my door that it scared my cat under the couch. It took me an HOUR to get her out. Next time I am reporting you all to my leasing office in Waterview Apartments and I am not against taking further action beyond that. Pastor Snodderly is a humble preacher with a heart to protect the freedoms of Tennessee's men and women.   More than just a political advocate, he wants people to experience the freedom that comes through Faith in Christ.
This church also supports foreign missions and has sent out five of their own families into full-time service. Such a delight for our family visit this church where our son attends private school, we really enjoyed the personal/family atmosphere combined with a great time of worship and Bible-centered preaching. THE BEST CHURCH IN THE WORLD! THE BEST PASTOR IN THE WORLD! THE BEST CHRISTIAN SCHOOL IN THE WORLD! Wow, what a great place to worship God and learn His divine Word! COME JOIN US AND LET YOUR HEART BE TOUCHED BY GOD! This church and it's community is truly amazing. I was baptized as an adult back in 2013 and when I moved to Wisconsin my biggest struggle was leaving this church. Love them. 🥰

name: Bible Believers Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Since joining BBBC of El Cajon in March of 2021, I've come to realize that that was one of the best decisions I've ever made next to getting saved 4-8-2021. Pastor Joshua and his Family are the salt of the earth, truly genuine, caring and full of the love of our LORD. I got baptized in Oct. 2021 and became a genuine member of the church in Nov. 2021. Pastor Joshua teaches straight from the 1611 AV KJV Bible as the final authority in all matters of doctrinal truth. His services, hymnal singing and fellowship with the church Brethren is something I look forward to midweek Wednesday services and Sunday school at 10 AM Sunday with Main Service at 11 AM. Thank ❤️ you Pastor Joshua and Sis Shannon for having such a welcoming, inviting and truly loving church that accepts all members from all kinds of backgrounds and from all types of lifestyles. Both of you represent our church as our Bishop and as a Shepherd that genuinely cares for it's flock. I love ❤️ you both and I truly love the KJV Bible Movement. I would like to suggest:
1Cor.15:1-4, “Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures…”
This is a golden opportunity to share the good news with people.
Also, if the Old Testament scripture on the billboard I saw today (4/8/26) is for believers I’d like to also share a New Testament scripture.
Romans 8:2, “For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death." Great little church where the people are friendly and the pastor gives very concise and clear instruction from the King James Bible. Traditional worship service, children's programs, comfortable seating, and handicap accessible with multiple designated parking spaces. God led me to this church over 2 years ago through Gene Kim's online ministry. This is an old-fashioned King James Bible Believing church! Pastor Stephenson is truly a great pastor. I have learned and grown as a Christian so much since being here. It's an encouraging and loving family of believers. Great church family I got to meet and probably one of the top ten preachers out there I’ve heard!! Give them a chance and the Pastor will feed you Bible!

name: Bible Center Church
reviewSummary: Very wonderful worshipping home for all! Welcoming & Comfortable setting. Huge community outreach. Gorgeous areas for children and babies. Wonderful uplifting church! Good mix of traditional and modern religous services. Youthful and vibrant. Very active in the community and has great initiatives. Fantastic facilities for Little League Baseball. Thanks Bible Center for providing fields for your community! This church is huge , with programs for all age groups. The architecture and furnishings are gorgeous inside and outside. They generously hosted the 2022 graduation for Kanawha County Career and Technical Centers. It was spacious with seating for over 750 guests and 150+ graduates. The air conditioner worked well. The stage is large and the sound system works well. I saw advertisements for youth programs, daycare, and line dancing classes Tuesdays 6pm-8pm. I saw a large playground and walking path outside. It looks like they have a lot going on for the community.

name: Bible Church of Brownsburg - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary: The Bible Church of Brownsburg has excellent expository (verse-by-by) teaching and preaching.  The congregation is warm and inviting.

name: Bible Church of Little Rock - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church I've ever had the privilege to attend. Family friendly, you see all ages represented in the body, strong community, strong missions, strong support structure, and most importantly they preach the Word of God without compromise.

Listed on 9marks.org with associations and graduates from Masters Seminary, Southern Baptist Theological Seminary, and Association of Biblical Counselors (ACBC). I’ve been attending this church for about 5 years after a relocation. They present and uphold a cross-centered, Jesus-centered gospel.

Leadership is comprised of *biblical* officers: qualified and appointed by the church. This is essential for a church to stay on God’s track – as opposed to going off the rails into either legalism or an “anything goes” approach. Both of these errors are equally detrimental to the Gospel of Jesus Christ and church health, in my opinion.

The preaching has helped me really understand scripture, verse by verse. More specifically, the pastor will go through a whole book of the bible, verse by verse, over the course of several months. It has really helped a imperfect person like me, who didn’t grow up in a bible-believing church. I have so much to learn! I have been grateful to church leadership and my care group leaders for meeting where I am. When I don’t understand something or need help, I have been approached with mercy, respect, and inspiring humility. I really don’t deserve the treatment I’ve been given, so it is humbling to have “spiritual giants” approach me with such humanity. They aren’t perfect, but I hope that I get an opportunity to extend them the grace and mercy they’ve extended to me.

They adhere to biblical ordinances: believer’s Baptist and The Lord’s Supper.

The church community is tight-knit and has opportunities to gather throughout the week: two women’s bible studies, men’s bible study, mid-week service for youth, youth outings, and the list goes on. The congregation is comprised of a variety of people who strive not to judge upon minor lifestyle choices. For example, there are homeschool families, public school families, singles, couples, college-age adults, etc. From what I have experienced, people try not to judge people on these minor life choices. There is the full range of ages, abilities, etc represented in the body. God tells us to welcome all nations!

There is a focus on biblical counseling, meeting individuals where they are and encouraging them to improve their lives through Christ’s strength. The counselors go through extensive training and education to become certified.

The music is fantastic – both biblically-based and rich in presentation. If you are looking for a rock-concert church with smoke, fancy lights, etc, this isn’t it. The POWER behind the music comes carefully selected songs that are rooted in scripture. The presentation of the music is fantastic as well.  They have a Christmas concert mid-December that is phenomenal. Make sure you arrive early as it fills up quickly!

Come join us for encouraging worship and a welcoming community, based on the divinely revealed Truth of Christ in scripture. Listen to the words of Keith Howell and Abby Hall.  There is no Biblical counseling for reconciliation of marriage unless it’s with this church???  I have to talk to my wife through a guy at the church???  Hmmm. As a family this has been the best church we have attended. Sound Doctrine, feels like family, amazing care groups, beautiful service not for attention but to the Glory of God. Multi age, good biblical counseling, men and women bible studied as well as good teaching for the youth. Expository preaching and humble leaders. Faithful Bible teaching to men, women, youth, and children. The pastors, elders, and deacons serve with kindness and humility. This body of believers loves and serves and truly cares for the needs of the church members, and the community!

name: Bible Church of Owasso - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary:
An Awesome place to be to worship and learn how to live a life for our Lord and Savior. I've moved away, and I miss the fellowship with
this great bunch of Christians who strive daily to be like Christ. Very welcoming and selfless church to be apart of. Today was my first attendance to this wonderful sanctuary committed to the advancement of Bible study and sharing of the word. It was almost like the sermon or the message was written directly for me. I had a great time and it was extremely interesting oh, I will definitely be back. My family and I have been attending for about 2 years now and coming from a different cultural background, BCO is very welcoming but that's not the reason why we attended BCO. BCO takes the bible seriously and practice what the word of God says. If you're looking for sound doctrine, a body of believers that walk alongside you, discipleship, and expository teaching this is the church for you. I love the this church. I’ve gone this church’s Ironmen Summit multiple years. On top of that I have listen to many of their sermons. Truly a solid biblical church rooted in expository preaching and I will recommend it to anyone in the area. I want to thank this church for starting me on an intellectual journey that ultimately ended with me leaving the faith. The emphasis on intellectual discussion of christian beliefs showed me how many doctrines are incoherent, and there was no longer any reason to continue the faith.

name: Bibleway Baptist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: NICE.

name: Big Apple Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Great worship music and great messages from each Pastor and speakers. It is my favorite church I’ve attended. I love this church, the people are friendly, warm hearted and most are Christ like. The Pastors/Ministers and their wives are very humble, kind, and compassionate. They study and teach sound doctrine and that’s what I need in my walk as as a follower of Christ.  So thank you John and Arlene. I’ve never been to a church where there’s so much diversity, and so many young people motivated to be like Jesus in their careers! I spent some 1-on-1 time with Pastor John and he’s a super down-to-earth, loving and honest man. Over the 4 years I was in NYC, I made some awesome friends, all of which were from church and if it hadn’t been for my friends from church I would probably have been very lonely. But, thanks to God, most of all and to the Big Apple Church, I stayed very connected to a community that helped me through many seasons. I love the Big Apple Church! If you ever are seeking a community of believers in this beautiful city, you NEED to go here! I highly recommend it. In July, 2019 it will make 30 years that I've been worshipping with this church and I still learn something new, relevant, and challenging every sermon! This is a church of God. The word of God was spread to me through the scriptures. Disciples from the church helped me develop a love for the scriptures. I could not settle for less than the best for this church. We must rely of God, not church. Sometimes it helps to learn and pray with others.

name: Big Valley Grace Community Church - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary:
Great service and they also have a great kids program. Love the coffee bar and book store. It was our first time there and Aaron was so welcoming he also bought my daughter and I our first Bible then he got her a hot chocolate to enjoy before church. They saved my boy.
I've been going to this church for 25 years. My daughter used to go. She grew up in this church, and 1 day she just stopped going. Now my grandson started going a couple years ago. It has changed him. It has made him into a decent young man. I understand that it's Gods work, not the church. But the church is Gods work. So it is the church.

AMEN! Horrible they r very judgmental if u stand by urself they will ask if u would like to join the men's group. O and the paster there one day asked me in front of other people in the group I was attending he said I was even wondering y r u even here and he was all mad. So I told him cause God wants me here and he was very rude and very angry. So after all that I talked to someone about it and nothing was done. O and get this he said to me o ian it doesnt matter cause the head paster said he has my bad. Its sad very sad that they r very judgmental I have only been to the main campus; I do not know how the Ceres campus is conducted. They give a Bible centered message, and, yes, they do ask for offerings or commitments for big projects that help build church facilities or serve the missions work they support. As they should, because that is the purpose of giving: to spread the gospel and serve the community through the church.  I have seen some negative reviews that don't make sense: perhaps they are referring to the other campus or to specific situations. Also I have experienced being asked not to attend a Bible study by the person running it because they could not accommodate my children. Other than that, it is a standard big church. A school with a congregation attached and not the other way around. By and large, a friendly congregation with some dedicated volunteers and the usual challenges of a big church. I love this church I'm still a little new but getting to fill at home because the people are so open armed and nice.

name: Big Zion A.M.E. Zion Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: 177 years+ serving the “down the bay” area of greater Mobile, AL. Still going strong. Disciples making disciples—The church that cares! Total enjoyable time with parishioners  there I attended the 184th year celebration and it was on fire with the word from God. Will attend again. great atmosphere... a beautiful spiritual experience.. excellent service.... praise HIM God's glory was in the building. I felt free and welcomed to praise God

name: Biloxi Christian Church - Biloxi Campus
reviewSummary: Biloxi Christian Church has (at least at this point May 2026 - I'm sure it will grow) a small but powerfully loving congregation. If you are looking for a small church that will welcome you with open arms, this might be the place for you. The faith leader, Ken Wetzel, leads Sunday services with a close study of scripture and how God's word applies to our daily lives. The music is contemporary and the atmosphere is inviting.  Lovely church! A friendly place to go to ad to visit caring people I mean and to Hallelujah

name: Birch Street Friends Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church sooooo much the people here are so nice and welcoming 😍☺️ I love Birch Street Friends they treated like I was a friend. I love going here they are friendly

name: Birmingham International Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: Great place for worship. I just love it so much because it's the "whole world" That is united here. And everyone is very welcoming. If you're an international student or just a person looking for a church in Bham, you should definitely come to this place. I was harassed a while back at the riverchase galleria by this korean Christian lady and her 2 daughters to convert to Christianity .  I’m going to go through as many churches as I can until I find her and confront her The staff and members are serious about serving and worshipping God.

name: Bixby Knolls Christian Church - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary: Well this is the first time I am calling Food bank 211gaiv me a  referral, im going threw hard times Right now I really need help and here I'm,godbless all the kids that live in the street .love all the human been blessings .

name: Blackhawk Church - Downtown Location
reviewSummary: Love the Blackhawk Downtown middle of UW campus!  Also a big fan of Pastor Adam! Very nice worship area. Comfortable spots in the back and plenty of spaces. Stage is fairly visible from all areas and the 3 screens help. Good church, nice location and they do a lot of things for college students Great worship and solid Biblical message. Great college age ministry

name: Blakeney Campus
reviewSummary: Great community and awesome youth eGroups meeting in the Blakeney area.

name: Bldg 28 Church
reviewSummary: Vanessa and I have been at Bldg 28 for six years now. I Pastored In four different churches in the past and have also been part of large, great churches. I’ve never seen a church more healthy than Bldg 28. Not only is the preaching excellent with great theology and the worship time is awesome, The people at Bldg 28 cover all the age ranges, with lots of young families. They look out for the needs of everyone in the church, including in times of crisis.Everyone is loving, transparent, and they love God and they love theology. It’s an amazing work of God! This is the best church I have attended in a long time. Pastor Chad takes time and preaches the truth so we can understand Scripture better. BLDG28 takes time to get to know you not like other churches and their congregations. They look at you as a person not a number. I don’t know why but Building 28 has and always will have a special place in my heart. Yet it has been overrun by politics, hatred for God, and judgement, and also witchcraft. Also I don’t like the way they changed the decor when Pastor Aaron left. Or the fact that they got rid of the young adult group that was amazing a few years back when I was younger. But Pastor Chad seems awesome and he seems like a great person to lead the church. Everyone else pretty much is questionable. Pastor Don and Pastor Jonathan. Eh. God bless everyone though. We all need more of Jesus. I new to the church and been going for a few weeks now, but the service this past Sunday 9/14 bothered me. It wasnt so much the service itself but rather one of the pastor doing prayer reading. He made it all about praying for Charlie Kirk and I get that his death and the way it happened is a huge talk but isnt a church suppose to be a place about belief and separate from politics. I like Kirk and his stance but instead of just praying for him why wouldn't the pastor also say something about the kids who lost their lives the same day? For this reason alone it bothers me that they would only recognize kirk’s family but not the families of the kids who died. Just visited for the first time today....Very nice church with friendly people and the Pastor is a very eloquent speaker who keeps things interesting and he seems to have a really good sense of humor. It also doesn't hurt that he is easy on the eyes lol.

name: Blessed Hope Assembly of God - Long Beach Campus
Blessed Hope Assembly of God - Redondo Beach Campus
Blessed Hope Assembly of God - Torrance Campus
Blessed Hope Assembly of God - Westwood Campus
Blessed Sacrament Catholic Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
My journey to attend Mass at every church in San Diego County brought me to this beautiful church. Stained glass windows bathed the interior in a warm light, and there was ample parking available.

But what truly impressed me was the welcoming atmosphere. I was greeted warmly by the congregation, and they even offered me a free donut card as a token of hospitality. This spirit of generosity extended beyond their doors, as the church collects a significant amount of food donations for those in need in Tijuana. I really loved the 8:30 Sunday service. Was there this Morning for a Friend's Confirmation. My cousins got Baptized there. another cousin of mine and his wife got married there. good service - although had to make myself get over the fact that one of the priests used the word "allow" - as I am an adult with a disability ( Autism) and I am very sensitive to that type of language as I find it infantilizing. Attended Easter Mass at this gorgeous decorated church in San Diego. This church has a dedicated choir that was amazing and sang for each of the Easter week services.
What a large, long church this is! Plenty of seating for sure. Very beautiful family church to attended. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. Father is great and the sermons have good messages that leave you thinking about life and lessons to grow closer with our lord. I enjoy all my visits to this church. A lot of my family attended school here. My sibling, multiple cousins, and Myself. All from preschool to 8th grade. We were all alter servers and our families made Blessed Sacrament our Parish. To attend Blessed Sacrament, it is not cheap. Tuition, uniforms, and the sports programs add up. We grew up and had kids. I was asked to be a godfather. And of course we wanted to get her baptized at Blessed Sacrament. And my cousin also wanted to get their child baptized as well. Blessed Sacrament denied us from this Sacrament because we personally didn't give enough money. Our parents did but not us. We were denied these children's religious journey because of MONEY! Just like jesus would of wanted. The Lord always put money first. Do not support this church. They put money infront of their "beliefs".

name: Blessed Sacrament Catholic Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary: We baptized our son the Cathedral. The priest was so kind and had a good sense of humor. The baptism took place during Covid and they were very prudent and respectful. It was such a beautiful ceremony and I cherish our memories. I definitely recommend. So warm, so peaceful Blessed Sacrement Church of Westminster. Try to make it every Sunday morning mass Open and accepting. KINDA. Depends on your approach. EXCEPT For the ushers and the Knights of Columbus. The ushers and the Knights of Columbus They will turn you away if you're not dressed extremely conservative and the Knights as a whole are lgbt phobic. Came here on Sunday for the 11am service. I am new to Westminster and was welcomed warmly. May the peace of Christ the Lord be with you.

name: Blessed Sacrament Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Went there for this year's presidential election. Clean, simple, organized and very warm, the best experience ever! We love Blessed Sacrament preschool! We have now sent two kids here,  with a 3rd on the way. The teachers are fantastic and the school had a very flexible schedule. Lots of outdoor playtime which were really like.  Highly recommend! Last Wednesday, our family and friends gathered at the Blessed Sacrament Church in Placentia to bid farewell to my dear brother Victor. Amidst the sad atmosphere, we found unexpected solace and comfort in the embrace of Father Barrett and Father Batarseh.
Their collaborative efforts in leading Victor's funeral ceremony were truly remarkable. With unwavering compassion and grace, they gently guided us through the depths of our sorrow, offering words of solace that touched our hearts. Their presence provided much-needed comfort during our time of mourning.
We are deeply grateful to the church and Fathers Barrett and Batarseh for extending their love and support to our family during this difficult period of loss. Their kindness and empathy have left a lasting mark on our hearts. This wonderful Parísh has something for everyone.  It is a smorgasbord of spiritual offerings for all ages, including Worship, Music, Christian education, community outreach, and so much more.  The services provide a unique blend of a dignified traditional Mass, while the congregation creates a warm and Christ-filled love environment that is so special.  All are welcome to this intimate Bible and Prayer Book-centered church right behind the Placentia post office.  Come home and be blessed! Great break out rooms. Awesome worship center. I attended a big book workshop here. The facility was very welcoming and set up for a meeting.

name: Blinder Memorial Chapel - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Orthodox services were wonderful. We were Welcomed with open arms by Fr. and the congregation. Look forward to attending again. This is where Saddleback church does a Food Pantry Every 1st Wednesday of the month for Marines living at Camp Pendleton.  We help give them food donation from our Church. This place is easy to get to with base access. Small church with great value. This church also have a weekly food bank! Great function room right beside Blinder chapel! Was here for a retirement reception! Nice place to worship and meet with base religious leaders.

name: Bloom Lutheran Church - Santa Clarita Campus
Blue Ash Church - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church. Great atmosphere and friendly people. Excellent Bible teaching. Ample parking, just he careful how Google directs you as the church is in a business area and some of the surrounding entry areas may be closed (but it's worth circling around to attend!).

Full confession (forgive the church pun), we don't live in the area and only visit when in town. But if we lived here, this would be our home. In the meantime, it's our 'home away from home.' When I had hernia/gall bladder surgery, someone wonderful came to shovel our long, winding driveway and would take no $ for his service. My father is 90 and I was so worried that he would try to shovel our driveway since I was unable to lift. I knew he didn’t need to be out there and felt compelled to ask for help to prevent a serious accident or worse concerning my father. Blue Ash Community Church came to our rescue! We cannot thank you enough for your help; we are forever grateful to your church and to our precious Heavenly Father for watching over us, and providing help in our time of need! I am new to the area and was looking for a church to attend.  The Pastors and congregation are friendly and accommodating.  They went out of their way to make me feel welcome. Great community church. Very active in the community, perfecr for young families and attended by all ages. Attended for years with my now 2 year old and 15 year old. Wonderful church for worshipping our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ, with our sisters and brothers in God's family.

name: Blue Ash Church of Christ - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: Been visiting this congregation for over 20 years when in town.  Nothing has changed.  Solid Gospel Preaching.  Great brethren. Great Bible believing Church!!! Book, chapter. & verse gospel preaching Great congregation and friendly welcoming preacher A church family that will make u feel loved and at home

name: Blue Oaks Church - Pleasanton Campus
reviewSummary: Great pastor with great messages. Lots of God loving people. Highly recommend making this your church home. Blue Oaks welcomed my family with open arms. It really felt good to be there. Pastor Matt is great and the church's music group was really good also. Im happy to call Blue Oaks our home. I encourage anyone to go and check it out. Everyone is very friendly. If you have time this Sunday head down they have two services I believe 9 and 11. I became a Christian 11 years ago, in my small Pennsylvania town. Coming to it with little knowledge, I was thirsty for the Word and I also listened to sermons during the week to learn more quickly. I don't remember how or why, but I soon started listening to Pastor Matt VanCleave from Blue Oaks Church every Monday without fail... and I still do so to this day. Pastor Matt is a tremendous preacher, deeply learned but not stuffy, dropping a little joke here and there, yet often profound. He is willing to take risks when broaching difficult subjects, and he can be daring in the way he opens his heart. When my Sunday pastor and Pastor Matt's messages overlap (it happens several times a year), I take it as a signal I need to pay attention to this particular subject. Blessings to Pastor Matt and the Blue Oaks family from faraway PA. We are so blessed to be part of this beautiful community. Thank you for embracing us. We have nothing but good things to say. Today we got a chance to serve by making higiene kits for the elderly. What a wonderful way to guide the community to Jesus teachings. Love Ashley in the kids ministry, our Andy loves to spend time in the nursery, Sabrina also is such a blessing for my baby, thank you all for serving and helping us in our efforts for our Christ centered life. Great please to talk about Jesus. The music is great. Coffee and doughnuts always good !

name: Blue Sky Church
reviewSummary: Vibrant Eastside congregation near Microsoft attracting software engineers, families, and college students with practical biblical sermons and warm community.

name: Blueprint Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: I enjoyed my time going to Blueprint! The Pastors all have their own unique style of preaching and the community was amazing! They have small groups that Pastors lead, based on the area you live in so you can get to know your church community that lives nearby! We always had a great time worshipping, getting into the Word and praying for each other! I love the diversity, that we all come from different backgrounds, beliefs and whatnot yet are united as the body of Christ! Genuine people, humble Pastors who are real and living by the Word of God— and they have great discipleship! I love this church! Diverse group of people. Pastor Carly and Pastor Dhati are awesome teachers. Every week, I am more enlightened through the word. The teachings are practical. The people are loving. I've been a member at this church for over 5 years I will say this is the best church I have ever been too. Dhati the lead pastor is super solid. This is not a fee good church it's a truth sound church, so it might pierce, it might convict your heart, but it will change your life for the good. The examples of the families in this church are amazing to watch. I love this church A group of people in the urban context who desire to live out the teachings of the Bible (to love God and love others well) and to encourage others to do the same. People from all walks of life are welcome. Diversity of members seems to reflect the demographic of the city of Atlanta. A community driven and oriented church family. Stay around for a while and you can see for yourself. Blueprint is a church where you will learn solid Biblical teaching, be led by pastors/leaders who live what they're preaching and teaches from the pulpit and in intimate groups (Missional Community) how we can live it out too, it has a strong family community (you not only call people in the church body sisters and brothers, they actually strive to treat you as a sister or brother by helping out where help is needed: ex. coming by your house to change a light bulb, eating meals together consistently, and spending time together), it is also a multi-cultural church which is the design God created for humanity. To sum it all up, i LOVE my church and my church family!!!

name: Boca Raton Community Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
The church impressed me with being the most friendly, Bible preaching church I’ve ever experienced as a 1st time attendee. My wife & grandson were with me & had a great time meeting & getting to know several people before & after service.

We loved the music & the acoustics & the seating was excellent.  First time I’ve seen an escalator in a church ... very functional with their movie-theater style seating!

The preaching was very thought provoking, insightful, encouraging & moving.

Can’t wait to bring our entire  family here for Christmas services in December when we plan to be in Boca Raton for the holidays. Pastor Free really is something else! He treated me like a pastor never should! Real arrogant and self centered! Please don’t ever go to this Church they will just ridicule you and try to take your money! Horrible horrible place! SHAME ON YOU PASTOR FREE! I love this church!!  Pastor Mathew is a scholar and a teacher of The Word.  He is a faithful man of God, and the music there is THE BEST! Yes yes yes. Really lovely kind people of all backgrounds. Always greet each other with a smile and a hug. Praise and worship is me meaningful and powerful. Sunday school is informative and follows the days message. If your looking for a good place to belong, belong here. We feel very welcome when attending Boca Community Church. We are always greeted with a number of genuine smiles welcoming us to worship. The music is very moving and prepares us to listen to Pastor Bill speak. Pastor Bill speaks the word of the Bible. He does a great job of of helping us relate his message to our own lives. This is a great place to worship. We are blessed to have such a great place to grow and worship.

name: Boerne Bible Church
reviewSummary: Wonderful people. Excellent preaching. This is where we attend church so we're a mite prejudiced but it is a warm inviting church who teach the Word of God. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Boerne Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
I love this church! Chris is a gifted preacher, and Jenna his wife is my long time best friend from childhood! I walked in there and immediately was welcomed by so many loving people. I felt God’s love through the love of this church, and I’ll definitely be coming back to  visit again! This is a wonderful place to worship.  Truth is being taught from the scripture, great preacher, excellent youth director, and friendly & welcoming people with a smaller town feel.  The chruch is approximately 200 people and growing.  It is so much easier to get to know people with this size of a church.  They'll make you feel at home and valued when you walk in the door! Very welcoming! It's a place where people pray together to stay together.  Thank you, "BOERNE CHURCH OF CHRIST," for accepting me as I am... everyone make you feel right at home💕🙏🏽✝️ A Christ-centered church family that has great VBS programs. Close-knit congregation. Very friendly.

It’s a shame that the Starbucks fanatics next door ignore the CHURCH PARKING ONLY signs and steal their parking spots. As a visitor, I have attended several times when we come for visits to our Granddaughter, and found the congregation to be very welcoming, the teaching sound, and the spiritual attitude of the congregation to be uplifting!

name: Boise Community Church
reviewSummary: Boise Community Church has been such a great fit for our family. Our kids love going every Sunday and we love our mid-week small group. We've gained a great community since joining this church! We made Boise community our church home about a year ago. It has been a great community of people that loves and cares for each other. We have 3 little kids and they love going here. A great loving community. If you are looking to be seen and heard this a great place. Learning about the ways of Jesus in a loving environment. Boise Community Church is a church you will call home. Amazing people, very loving community. Great church, you will be known and loved here. Great group of people and sense of community.

name: Boise First United Church of Christ
reviewSummary: I live in the neighborhood and wanted an open, caring church to go to.  I walked in and immediately felt at home.  There were people of all ages, all backgrounds, and all welcoming!!!  The church embraces young families, divorced families, blended families, empty nesters, the  LGBT community, senior citizens, young singles and all caring folks!  The messages make sense to me, I love to sit and chat and have a free coffee and snack.  I love the optional book study and adult education too!!!  I enjoy the music, the children..... I can go on and on but suffice it to say, I became a member!!!  I would highly recommend coming to this church for a visit soon 😀😀😀 Great service the parishioners who were at the church the Sunday I attended were very warm and welcoming. The pastor gave a good sermon. I really enjoyed the organ music that was nice it was also nice that the organist moved back and forth from the piano to the organ. The Sunday I attended was the Sunday after Christmas it was fun to have the pastor let us pick which Christmas songs we sang We visited this church on April 29 and have been telling friends about it ever since. Friendly welcoming people, a very personable minister with a meaningful sermon, an enjoyable choir and programs and activities focusing on interfaith collaboration, arts, loving all people including those most vulnerable. We were impressed and felt welcome and inspired. We’ll look forward to another visit. Grateful to be apart of this community of progressive Christians! A place you can feel accepted and grow in your spiritual walk, no matter where you are in your faith journey. Love it!

name: Bonita Road Baptist Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: grew up here, love it. worships Jesus, the one and only true and living holy God. Pastor Bong preaches straight from the Bible. Thankful for being blessed with good friends and Church family 🥰🥹🙏💖 Is beautiful 😍

name: Bonita Valley Baptist Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I went to the church when I was 12 years old I was kicked out and I was asked to leave whoever knew that you could kick out a kid from church I'm curious who the pastor is now. Since that happened I've never gone to church again When I was pregnant with my second baby all the women gave me a beautiful baby shower. We had only been attending the church for less then a month. After I gave birth they showered me with love asking me if I needed help, and for the first week the  baby was home they cooked meals for my family and I so I didn’t have to. The amount of love these people show for you is unheard of. Your not just a number to them..your family. Pastor Jim is definitely gifted in explaining the Word of God so anyone can understand. They speak the truth of God’s Word unapologetically and the love and passion both the Pastor and his wife have for Jesus is incredible. Jesus is the center of it all! We attended BVBC for 4 1/2 years while we lived in San Diego. If I could give a million stars I would.  These people love Jesus, teach the Scripture faithfully, serve each other, and have sincere faith in the gospel of Jesus Christ. If you are looking for a church that really loves and values the Word of God (the Bible), you will find amazing teaching here. It has a smaller church feel, which means that you become family over time. No church is perfect or will offer everything to every person, but we adore BVBC and highly recommend it. Very beautiful facilities, great people who trully love God and people. Very family oriented and great youth group for my kids. They also have a Spanish ministry on Sundays 1:45pm I felt like God said welcome home when I landed here. Perfect for our family

name: Boston Church Back Bay
reviewSummary:
Loved the service. Biblical and relevant. Uplifting worship. Stacks of young people. A place where you truly feel God’s presence

Every time I walk into this church, the service genuinely touches my heart. There’s something powerful about the atmosphere whether it’s the worship, the message, or the sense of community that makes you feel connected the moment you enter the body of God.

The sermons are meaningful, relatable, and uplifting, and they always seem to speak to exactly what you need in that moment. You don’t just attend a service here, you experience it.

This church is a blessing, and I’m grateful every time I’m able to be part of a service. Great worship and fellowship service.  Highly recommend you attend. Feeling like something missing in your life.  Follow God's word and you'll find your answers.   Come check us out! I came to church here for the first time as an atheist over ten years ago. My college roommate asked if I wanted to go with her and I definitely wasn’t looking for God - I felt pretty strongly that religion was hypocritical most of the time. In this church I found the most genuine group of people I’ve ever met. I learned what it meant to be a Christian, started following Jesus, got my sins forgiven, found my best friends here, bridesmaids in my wedding. Met my husband here and later when we had a baby the church was where our most supportive guidance and meal train came from. It’s my family, my home, the place where I know we’re both supported and challenged to live by the scriptures and follow Jesus. I love it here. Can’t recommend it enough.

name: Boston Potter's House Church
reviewSummary: Visited this church while in the city on vacation. The pastor and his wife were incredibly welcoming and it’s clear they have a real heart for the Lord and for the city. Very insightful teaching too! Highly recommended This church is truly amazing, and it’s so welcoming. Pastor Sanderlin and his family are such incredible people. If you’re searching for a place to worship, I highly recommend coming to this church! Visited during our Tartan Army trip to Boston and it was wonderful to meet Pastor Matthew and his lovely family, who made us feel very welcome. The service has uplifting worship and biblically solid teaching and it was a nice touch to receive a Father's Day gift from the church given I was away from home. I highly recommend this church and believe God is moving in Boston through it. 11/10 recommend this church! Pastor Sanderlin and his family are the best people! This church is amazing! They love people & they love Jesus! Your whole life will change if you come to this church,best decision you can ever make! Great church! The preaching is always Bible based and I love that the Pastor and his wife seem to genuinely care about people!

name: Boulder Church of Christ - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary: The name of the father, the son and the holy Spirit.

name: Boulder Street Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: This is my church! We love Pastors Dan and Amy and the culture of the church. Authentic to its core. Not a big church, but great people who are welcoming. My husband and I stumbled into this church about two years ago (after sometimes attending HOME Downtown), and have since formed invaluable friendships with Pastors, the Elders, and other young married couples! We love the multi-generational aspect of Boulder Street. We’ve learned so much from members who have walked with Jesus for 30+ years! They value missions, reaching young adults in the city, and teaching kids to pray. Very spirit-led worship with engaging, biblical teaching. The Lord is glorified in this wonderful church. Worship, prayer, the preaching of the Word, outreach, missions and true community are esteemed and exampled by the leadership. The Holy Spirit is welcome at BSC. All ages relate so lovingly and authentically to one another. We love BSC! Great church and great people! I love praying here, such a beautiful historic church! I used to attend about ten years ago when I first came to Christ, the amount of love and encouragement they gave me in my time of need has helped shape me and who I am today. This church knows Jesus, and because of their love I am a pastor of my own church in Idaho teaching that same love I was shown there. Miss all of you and God bless

name: Boulder Valley Christian Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
I've attended Boulder Valley for a year now. My wife and I found it pretty easy to get involved in areas of interest and giftedness. The leadership is extremely personable, thoughtful, and intentional. We have felt free to be who we are (which, sadly I can't say at some other churches in the area we have attended). And, at the time of this review, there's a vibrancy to the church; it is growing. I haven't been this excited about my involvement in a local church in years. When we were new to the area, we found BVCC welcoming, young and old. (I’m 76) teaching is Bible based while relevant to most ages. The teaching pastors often touch my heart. They’re all dynamic speakers. The music brings the house down but ear plugs are available. Spirit filled sanctuary! Ive never been a religious person, in fact I’ve been extremely anti-religious for my entire life. I’m 34 years old and it’s only been this last year that I’ve been willing to explore Christianity. This church has allowed me to safely explore something that I’ve resented for so many years. The leadership is incredible and also so open to learning and growing. More inclusive, less exclusive as so many churches can be. Thank you Boulder Valley for fostering such a great place for a guy who believed in God but thought all religion was a scam. Thank you for taking the time to teach me and explain all the many questions I still have. Thank you for being so patient with me, and showing no judgement toward me or my initial attitude toward Christianity. I grew up outside of Boston going to Catholic Church as a kid and after high school, really stepped away from religion. Now that my wife and I have a young daughter, we wanted to instill in her the values, faith and sense of community that come from Church, however, we didn't want the experience we grew up with. At BVCC, we found exactly what we were looking for. Worship is awesome, preaching right on point.
To God Be the Glory.

Revs. Charles and Diane Wonnenberg My wife and I are vacationing in WPB and found Bow Down Church on Google. God is definitely in control as this was where we were supposed to be this morning. In Titus, the women's group, I was able to get real with the other women in a safe and welcoming space, something that I haven't found at other places. name: Bradley Hills Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
Our family loves this church. The pastors are outstanding, and the congregation is very friendly. They have an exceptional music program and many activities for children. We joined when our kids were 8 and 10. Only wish we had joined sooner! This is an amazing church. The pastors are warm, the people are friendly and engaged in the many activities here, and there are lots and lots of kids. I think the best part is that it is a big-tent sort of place, where all ideas and points of view are OK, and questions are encouraged, even if you're not sure about God. It is safe and welcoming. This is a vibrant welcoming church community that offers a range of programs and approaches to worship and Christian growth and development.  These include both formal and informal worship including thoughtful sermons and spectacular music.  There are ongoing opportunities for adult education, family connection, small group study, and dedicated mission outreach in both the local, national and international community. This congregation is fantastic - we had been coming to Christmas and Easter here for many years.  Their Christmas Eve children's service is really beyond compare - they have costumes for every child that shows up, they provide bells for every child and encourage their use throughout the service.  Recently we started attending on a more regular basis and have decided to join.

Their pastor, Pastor David, is really unbelievable - was a corporate lawyer, worked on the Hill and has been the pastor here since around 2010.

Important for us is their children's programs - our two young boys love Sunday school here (apparently they have a full time pre-K program).  Pastor David has 4 young children of his own, so they are very oriented toward young families.  Generally, they have tons of different outlets and ministries, so it seems like you could find a way to engage with the community regardless of your interests - yoga, ecology, sports, service, music, etc.

From a faith perspective, I would say they are a very tolerant community and acknowledge there are many different paths to spirituality.  They encourage questions and dialogue.  They actually share space with Jewish congregation and are building relationships with the Muslim community.  I have spoken with few folks who landed on Bradley Hills after another prominent local Presbyterian church took a position to not condone same sex marriages.  The other aspect that seems very important here is the education and democratizing the context for the bible - they put lay people on the same footing as the clergy, which was appealing to us.

They have not been pushy at all - would characterize them as warmly engaging.

Such a personal decision, but I would say this is definitely a church to consider if you are looking. Here is a welcoming and nurturing church home in which one can find Christian grace in community, the warmth of human connection, and acceptance for a diversity of walks of life and challenging questions. I am a second-generation Korean-American with a liberal education who desires to seek God with sharply critical thinkers and engaged citizens. I have found the programs and activities of Bradley Hills Church meaningful ways to participate and cultivate a collective purpose and sense of belonging.

name: Branch of Hope OPC - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: There are a few negative reviews about unfriendliness, snobbiness, and a lack of bible teaching. I wonder if there was a misunderstanding or if the people were writing a review for another google listing because this church is very friendly, deep in its teaching but not snobby, and they preach chapter by chapter. I think it is a great church! Been a member at this church for 9 years. I grew up in the church and, I believe, have been a Christian my whole life. I have grown and matured more in the these last 9 years, sitting under such faithful teaching and preaching, than the previous 20 years of being a Christian. No church will ever be perfect, this side of Glory, but the leadership here humbly desires and strives to faithfully preach the whole counsel of God & properly administer the sacraments. People are NOT friendly at this church, as with most that hold Reformed/Calvinistic theology. It will be hard to develop genuine relationships with people here due to the pervasive snobby intellectual atmosphere. Look elsewhere for a solid Christian community. We love this church. Pastor Paul is a gem among gems: a loving and kind shepherd, who earnestly seeks to properly preach the Word of God. Before the Lord led us to Branch of Hope, our biblical doctrine had been spotty at best. The teaching at Branch of Hope helped us to lay a solid foundation to understand and study God's Word and to trust in the Lord alone for our salvation. We became and stayed members of Branch of Hope for over a decade, and would have stayed there until the Lord took us home to glory, if employment changes had not taken us away. I pray that the Lord continue to bless His work through Branch of Hope for many, many years to come. Sadly, this church doesn’t teach the word of God. Unfriendly. And definitely not of Jesus! Visited the children’s room during service. Not a word of God taught…very sad!!!

name: Branches Christian Church - Stanton Campus
Branches Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
Branches church has an extremely low-key, unpretentious, and laid-back atmosphere. My wife calls it a "surfer church." That said there a people from all walks of life who attend with a strong contingent of young families.

The message is solid, but not pushy. I really enjoy the main pastor's delivery which often includes storytelling, historical context, and an explanation of the actual scripture language used. That may be my favorite part boiling down ancient teachings to terms that are easy to understand.

Should you decide to get more involved, there are many different ongoing service opportunities. They actually will support you if there is a cause you care about and want to start your own service initiative for others to plug into.

Last, if you have kids, there a two different rooms to drop them off to do crafts and activities that vary by their age.

Branches is a good group people up to great things. Definitely worth checking out if you are on a "church search." I moved to California for school and found myself feeling like a stranger in strange lands.  The folks at Branches were nothing but kind to me.  The community is very inclusive and participatory, and within a few weeks I was asked to share my skills as a musician and help the kids in worship.  Once I started hanging with the kids, I was really hooked!  I feel as though I was the one being ministered to.  The community poured back into me such positivity and rejuvenating love.  If that's not your thing, they also have donuts and coffee! If you are looking for a community of people that are genuinely seeking to bring about peace not just in their own lives, but in the community as well, then Branches is a place you'll want to visit.

Our family found that the community at Branches is great at welcoming people from any walk of life.  There is very little pretense here. If you're looking for a country club type of church, then this probably isn't the right fit for your needs. Things at Branches are pretty raw and honest and that seems to be the very thing that is healing this community and drawing others in.

This community is hungry for love, truth, and peace in the name of Jesus. So if you find yourself walking through the Dana Point Harbor on a Sunday morning, or if you're looking for a place to find a sense of belonging and purpose, then come visit Branches.

reviewSummary: A reformed baptist Church in Fullerton. A Great Lords day service! Solid pastor, beautiful church building, and a quaint coffee shop attached. I visited from out of town two weeks in a row and the people were genuinely friendly to me. The pastor is gentle and warm in person yet strong in his teaching and fidelity to truth. If you are looking for a place to grow and worship in community, this seems like a great church. Everyone has been extremely compassionate and supportive, we feel we've made life long friendships here. name: Brave Christian Schools - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
This Yelp review is longgggg overdue—if I could give Brave Christian Preschool 10-stars, I absolutely would.

We’re a military family without relatives nearby, and this school has truly become our extended family. We’ve been part of this community since my kids were just a few months old, and I can’t say enough amazing things about the school.

Why we love Brave Christian:

** Warm, family-like community
- The staff and teachers genuinely care—it feels like home
- My kids are deeply loved and supported every day.

** Engaging, thoughtful programming
- Daily fun and enriching activities
- Creative crafts (with special keepsakes for parents!); I look forward to all the fun "gifts" the kids make throughout the year.
- Personalized yearly binders filled with drawings, photos, and memories that capture the kids growth and development

** One-of-a-kind facilities
- Huge indoor gym
- Outdoor courtyard with play structures and swings
- Outside garden with weekly gardening activities
- Auditorium

** Unique extras
- Onsite Spanish teacher throughout the week
- Pet lizard and bird to greet the kids each morning
- Visits to the kindergarten classes up the hill for fun interaction with older kids
- Special events like petting zoos and visits with exotic animals

** Family & community events
- Harvest Festival
- Ice Cream Socials
- Science & Art Fair
- Other onsite events that bring families together
- Fun themes like Dr. Seuss week

** Nutritious (and fun) snacks provided that kids enjoy
- A lot of the "snacks" are even heated/warm!

** Great communication & safety
- Mobile App with daily updates and photos
- Strong onsite security for peace of mind

** Support for military & families
- Military discount + acceptance of military subsidies
- Sibling discounts available

** Above-and-beyond teachers
- Some have even become our trusted babysitters outside of school

It’s worth noting that Brave Christian is a faith-based school (as the name suggests), but the community is diverse, inclusive, and welcoming to families of all backgrounds and beliefs. They foster an environment where everyone feels respected and valued. At this age, the focus is on helping children grow into kind, respectful, and compassionate humans.

This amazing team has helped raise my kids, and I’ve truly watched them flourish under their care. I’m so grateful we found this place.

Thank you, Brave Christian, for pouring so much love into our family ❤️ Brave Christian Preschool and Elementary has been a literal saving grace. I had so much anxiety about enrolling my kids somewhere that was safe, inviting, had a faith based curriculum was just an added bonus, but to also have staff that truly cares about the well being of the children and their development was what drew us to enroll our kids.  Rina in the preschool is phenomenal. She embraces families, and takes the time to really get to know them as individuals. The teachers are incredible. Passionate, caring, loving, and truly special educators. In elementary Tara the principal is truly amazing. She gave us such peace of mind enrolling our daughter into kindergarten, and the teachers helped our daughter make such significant strides in her emotional and intellectual development. WE LOVE BRAVE CHRISTIAN SCHOOLS!!! We recently transferred our youngest son to Brave Christian Schools as a sophomore this year, and I cannot say enough good things about the experience. Transferring high schools mid-stream can be daunting, but the transition here has been seamless and incredibly positive.

From day one, the community has been welcoming and nurturing, making him feel right at home. It is such a relief as a parent to see him thriving in an environment that genuinely balances academic excellence with strong faith-based values.

We have attended Brave Church for the past five years, so we already knew and loved the heart of this community. Seeing those same values—integrity, kindness, and a focus on purpose—woven into the daily fabric of the school has been a blessing. If you are looking for a school in Dublin that truly cares about the whole student (spiritually and academically), I highly recommend Brave Christian Schools! Both our children started in the infant room at Brave Christian Preschool and now our younger one is in pre-K. This school has been a blessing! Our children have loved attending the school, they look forward to learning everyday as well as participating in special events. I have trusted the staff in keeping them safe in the school and I still in them Biblical values and a love of learning. Their teachers identified their strengths and encouraged them to build on those and worked with them to improve on areas where they were struggling. All in.

Brave Christian (formerly Valley Christian) Schools has proven to be the best choice we've ever made for both of our boys and family! The school continues to provide our current senior with a nurturing environment that has fostered growth, learning, and success, leading us to also enroll our younger son/sophomore at Brave High School.

The school's strong foundation of highly distinguished educators and administrators prioritizes our child's achievement in both academic and community contexts. The close-knit community creates a sense of belonging, making it feel more like an extended family than a traditional school.

We couldn't be more pleased & grateful to be a part of this amazing family & institution!

I kept thinking "Is it Racism?" 4 Older Mexican women rolled their eyes when I smiled and said hello. Pastor and his wife were welcoming and a few other Christians approached me to greet me warmly. I sat in on the Spanish and English service. Pastor had an interesting method of handing out the days scripture on a sheet where you fill out the answers to simple questions as he preached. What a great idea!! It kept me alert. The page had holes so it must go in a binder. It made me want a binder. Pastor's message was about Family and parental responsibilities. He seemed to advocate corporal punishment and shun transgender identity. His message, while powerful, was a bit on the "machismo" side. Then again, what do I know? I don't have a husband. Took my wife to their women's conference everyone was so nice to her ,she had a great time the pastor and his family are amazing people, please visit 🙏 ❤️ Everyone welcomed me just the way I am and for the first time in my life I felt so welcomed and blessed to have all of you guys now being part of my communion and where I most importantly found Jesus Christ.

name: Bread of Life Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
The church itself is okay, but the children center is very disappointing experience (BOLCC). I enrolled my son in their summer program for four weeks, and from the start, the teachers never greeted us—not even with eye contact. Later, they restricted my son from attending the weekly field trip because they felt he was “too playful.” The most frustrating part was that the teachers never spoke to us directly about any concerns. Instead, they always went through the Director, which meant we had no opportunity to discuss or work together on solutions.

We even offered to volunteer in the classroom to help with his progress, but they showed no interest in collaborating or making any plan to help my son stay in the program. Over time, my son became afraid to go to their school—a troubling sign, especially for a church-based program that should feel safe and loving. I personally saw him muster the courage to greet a teacher, only to be met with no eye contact and not even a quick nod. He was so disappointed.

While this may be an affordable option for families simply looking for basic daycare, I would never return, as the lack of professionalism, warmth, and genuine care was deeply disheartening. This church was very careful in controlling the flow of attendees. That was fine.
The service last Sunday was for Father's Day (June 17, 2022). But, instead of praising and encouraging the fathers,  the pastor scolded the fathers for 15 minutes for not taking care of the families, loving their children while using the American research of crimes, adding the Chinese traditional values of stern fathers.
He mixed up the two cultural differences, preaching to wrong choir, lumping them together to prove how good a father he was.
He mentioned he was preparing the sermon, his daughter screamed for pain from the earlier injury in a  game. He dropped the preparation to attend to his daughter, insinuating that what a good father he was.
But, earlier he said how a godly a minister he was.
Now let me ask you, " since how trusting you are to God, and a good minister faithful to your calling, then why did not you just pray to God's intervention to heal your daughter and continue to prepare for the sermon?"
He has already earned his reward on this earth (earthlings' praises).
Mat 6:1 ISV “Be careful not to practice your righteousness in front of people in order to be noticed by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven. This church is full of loving, caring people.  They made us feel part of their "family" and helped us in many situations.  If ever we are back in California, this is the church we would attend.  The Pastor gives fantastic sermons that hit right to the heart of your problems. Today, a group of blind Chinese Christian musicians came to visit the church. They performed serval music and delivered a very touching testimony. May God bless them and their mission. Bread of Life is a local place in Torrance for BSF on Mondays.
Come visit a selected BSF church.

name: Bread of Life Great Park Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Great people ;) So WONDERHOY 🌟 Life changing. Warmth, care, mission, worship, homecoming

name: Bread of Life Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: I would like them to open a Facebook account

name: Breakthrough Christian Church of Atlanta - Atlanta Campus
Breakwater Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Went to the youth group here every Wednesday evening way back in like 1999. I loved it. Miss the people I met there. Still talk to a few I met but lost contact with most. Live in Aaska now. But will always remember the time I spent there. What a blessing it was to be at the church. The people are friendly, God fearing, and a pleasure to around. I do not attend since I now live on the east coast it was highly recommended...I was referred to a new church in Greenwood South Carolina. Great pastor. Friendly people. Lovely church with loving people!

name: Breakwater Community Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
It was my first time visiting Breakwater Community Church. I was invited by Pastor Johnny Martinez and I sat down next to his wife Bonnie who attend this Christian Church on a regular basis.

I arrived early at 10:30 a. m. so I could meet snd talk to some of their church members before the
service began at 11 a. m.  Some of the men and women I spoke to were very nice and they were friendly to me being a guest at this church.

In the morning, hot coffee and pastries are offered to the church members at no charge.

The service began at 11 a. m. It was very relaxing and casual atmosphere. I was just wearing blue jeans and a tee shirt. Some people were dressed up who work for this church but the member were
dressed casually and wearing shorts and a tee shirt.

Pastor Roger spoke about the Lord’s Prayer and everyone recited this Bible verse out loud.
Also Pastor Roger read from the Bible on Moses Chapter 8 Verse 4 and Exodus Chapter 4 Verse 12.

Then one guy was playing his acoustic guitar and everyone stood up and was singing this song Who Am I? The Pastor’s daughter was playing the keyboards.  Also one older woman had a beautiful voice and she was singing a solo on God,  It was really wonderful to listen to live music.
This church service started at 11 AM and lasted until 12 p. m. I enjoyed listening to Pastor Roger
speaking from his heart and I could feel the Holy Spirit.  I also talked to Pastor Peter Kennedy who has a very warm and personable personality to me.
I will definitely come back again soon to attend their church services in the future. Outdoor service with canopies set up in the yard and on the patio, the ocean breeze was awesome and safe!  We love our church! My husband and I have been going to Breakwater for over a year and love the community and fellowship this church provides.   One of the first Sundays we attended, someone mentioned they were a "small church with big hearts" and it could not be more true!  Pastor Roger is an excellent teacher of the Word and cares deeply and genuinely for all who attend Breakwater.  If you are looking for a church home, Breakwater is definitely worth a visit! Hi, my name is Pete Copeland (Mattie Coley is my daughter). I have been attending Breakwater Community Church for 2 years and it has been an uplifting and wonderful worship experience. The worship services are well thought out and prepared which makes the overall experience such a pleasure. I invite all to come worship with us. We're located at 506 South Nevada St. Oceanside. We have two services on Sundays, both outside beginning at 9 and 11 a.m. respectively. So join us and I look forward to meeting you and hearing God's word together. God Bless! We worshipped with this community during our visit to Oceanside in October 2022.   Excellent in every way - quality music, friendly people and the preacher knew how to keep it short.   I was really pleased the preacher asked for any questions from the listeners after he was done.   Love the interaction that way!
