name: Brentwood Church of Christ - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary: Worshipped here while traveling. We were welcomed by several friendly members. The service was biblical, and it was helpful that the website let us know what to expect before we visited. Happy to have had the chance to meet these people! We had a wonderful visit here. Dan preach a very good lesson that offered some good incite about the Bible. Missed seeing Steve and Karen and the kidos Loving, caring congregation focused on scriptural teaching! Simple New Testament Bible worship 1 Tim 6:12.

name: Brentwood Hills Church of Christ - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Great preacher, and excellent song line up, but no hospitality or class at all. Visiting with my family today and I’ll admit we were under dressed, (me especially) as we just flew into town 2 hours prior for a wedding late this afternoon. Just ashamed no families approached us at all, I never pull the race card but we were the only hispanic/white family in the building. We’ve gone to a Church of Christ forever and have always felt welcomed when visiting other Churches of Christ, but it was the complete opposite at Brentwood Hills. Good delivery of a good message. I visited this church on my last trip to Nashville, and although none of the people I knew who attended here were in town that day, it was a pleasant experience. I didn't realize they wouldn't be having any preaching that day, but the marriage Inquisition was interesting and I did get to partake in the Lord's supper. This church's character really shows through their basketball team, and the people in the crowd. The girls are rabid, and I got called horrible names from the crowd.  If I could give 0 stars, I would. The only reason they have 5 stars is becuase they tell people to write 5 star reviews about the church.  I used to go to Brentwood Hills, I am very disappointed about how the church turned out.  0 stars. We are new to Brentwood Hills and were amazed by all the kindness. We feel very welcomed and are excited to get more involved.

name: Brentwood Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited here last night with a friend to attend their Christmas Exalted Oratorio concert which was actually quite well done. While I am not a Presbyterian, the people I encountered here seem friendly enough and the church, which is an older building, appears to be well kept up. There is a small covered church parking garage next to the church just past the alley. There was a unisex restroom upstairs past the Brides dressing room. Someone said there was a bathroom on the first floor but I didn't find it. I enjoyed my time here. :-) My therapist mentioned this place for my friend to sober up. He went but I guess they charge $3.00 per visit which adds up. Not sure if they give sponsors.
I have never been there personally I have my own church. But the secretary was very good at directions and what happens there.
Thank you My mother went to the Thursday meeting for 33 years.  A great meeting. ...the last meeting mom & I went to was in 2000 . I have such fond memories .. Of a place that kept my mother strong & sober.  RIP mom.  ( 1931 - 2005 ). I am in my late 80ts.   I have a difficult time getting around, Dr's, marketing. The church, was there for me !!  They have a special program for people like me, ANGELES.  I have been able to not worry about getting to a Dr and market because of these Brentwood Presbyterian church angels.  I try not to take advantage of their services unless it's really important BPC has been my church home for 29 years. It is a warm, friendly church where everyone is welcome. The music is so special, and the pastors are devoted to this church family and the community. Come check it out.

name: Brew City Church
reviewSummary:
I attended Brew City Church twice while searching for a Bible centered, non-political church here in Milwaukee. I want to start by saying that everyone I met was very kind, welcoming, and friendly. Despite the church stating they don’t preach politics, the messages were strongly tied to social and political themes rather than being rooted primarily in Scripture. If you’re looking for a church that intentionally connects faith with modern political or social issues, this may be a good fit for you. However, if you’re like me, seeking a church that adheres closely to the Bible and focuses solely on Jesus and Scripture traditionally, this likely won’t be the right place. Every church has its style—this one just wasn’t for me unfortunately. My partner and I have FINALLY found our home church that loves us unconditionally. Pastor Randy is such a personable and caring pastor and gets to know everyone in his congregation. While it is a smaller church, staff make sure you feel comfortable with welcomed and included in this environment. My partner and I cannot wait to see what God continues to do through this church. We just had our wedding at Brew City Church.  My fiance and I were both living out of state, and found Brew City as a church that could accommodate our long-distance needs. Shari, the coordinator, was wonderful to work with leading up to the ceremony, as well as on the wedding day.  She was organized, helpful, and friendly.  The sanctuary itself was beautiful and the perfect place for our families to witness our wedding.  (The pastor that married us was incredible throughout pre-marital counseling and during the service, but has since moved on from Brew City.)

So happy we were able to start this next chapter of our lives at Brew City Church. My first time at the church was a blessing. I am truly blessed by the people at the church. They were very nice and kind. Even welcoming. Thank you Jesus for the beautiful songs at the church. Coffee hot cocoa and snacks was a blessing. Thank you Brew City Church. Your church service was amazing. Loved it!!! I cannot give a review that will do justice to how amazing Brew City Church is! Brew City is family to my family and community to my community. The leadership is diverse and continually looking to get more diverse. The church is committed to the local neighborhood and to the justice issues that face our city including drug addiction and rehabilitation, racial conciliation, serving the poor and poor in spirit, and so much more. We love Brew City's challenging sermons, powerful and vibrant worship, and its commitment to the community through prayer and acts of service. I would invite you to come and feel the warm, welcoming embrace of the BCC family. My hope is that you will feel right at home the moment you step foot into the doors.

name: Briarlake Church - North Decatur / Emory Campus
reviewSummary:
I like the non-judgemental atmosphere. I ride my bike to church and no one bats an eye at me in my biking clothes.  Very friendly people too, they make you feel like family. Great community and absolutely amazing kids sports program.
Judson is a star! If you are looking for a Church home, this is the place to come. I have been a member for a decade, and I love this Church.  The purpose of Briarlake Church is to help people experience meaningful life in Jesus Christ. Pastor Steve Tillis has done an awesome job in pursuing this purpose. Truly something for everyone! Whether you prefer traditional or contemporary worship, have kids (a great program) or a "mature" adult wonderful classes and places to "plug in".  Welcoming and friendly members and large enough to offer great activities, but small enough to care. The preacher is "right on" too! Holy Spirit filled Church with wonderful Bible Beliving Born again Christians. They made me feel at home, a truley wonderful and Biblically sound Baptist ministry.

name: Briarwood Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: The founding church of the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA). Celebrated for deep reformed theology, majestic choir and organ worship, and Briarwood Christian School.

name: Bridge Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautifully welcoming church thats inclusive and engaging. You can feel the love within the community. Glad I joined. This place is friendly & welcoming, youthful & vibrant. The worship is led by incredibly talented musicians & vocalists. The preaching is dynamic and Biblical.

All that and you’re out in about 90 minutes! I joined Bridge in 2022. Before joining, I hadn't attended church regularly for over twenty years. At the time, I wasn't looking for a church and only came after being invited at the end of a party. When I went, it was transformational for me. I found a community for myself and my daughter and eventually met my future wife there. If someone is looking for a place to build their faith or just curious about who God is, I would highly recommend visiting on a Sunday or Wednesday. Great church and community! Welcoming, diverse, and genuinely focused on helping people deepen their relationship with God. Grateful to have found this place. This church has been such a blessing to me and my wife from the first moment we walked through the door. I were in desperate need of a loving and caring community and we found one here. There is an authenticity and humility that the pastor carries that trickles down to all of the members as well. I see us staying and serving here for a long time.

name: Bridge City Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary:
Great great Bible based church!!
Pastor Steven and Pastor Nikki are fantastic!!!    Many ways to get involved and become plugged in to a wonderful church family and community.  - Rena Lane Really inviting church with friendly staff and parishioners. Really enjoyed the music and the message. Truly heartfelt! If you're looking for a church home that is diverse, with a Pastor that will point you to Jesus every time- this is the place for you! The kids ministry is awesome. The heart for community is like no other. I'm blessed to be part of the Bridge City family! I am so grateful for this church. The love and community that I receive here at Bridge City Church is uncomparble. If you are looking for a praying church that embodies the practices of Jesus than this is the place for you. Bridge City Church has something for everyone, the kids, youth, young adults, senior adults, women and men. You won't regret it. Excellent house of worship! God giving Pastor Steven! Many years A great loving pastoral family who really shows God's true love towards everyone! Thank you pastor Steven and your family for giving us and showing unconditional love. We are always praying for you, family,  and church!.. Blessings

name: Bridge Community Church
reviewSummary: Great church community that’s part of the missions-focused Christian and Missionary Alliance organization. Solid leadership in the pastor, elders, music, children’s ministries and more. Having concurrent children’s services was important for us. We even have a communal garden, and church gatherings on and off site outside regular service. It’s very active for a relatively small congregation. I have never felt more welcome at a church, coming in as a stranger and becoming like family! It's awesome! You should come check it out. Great music, message, and friendly. Friendly people

name: Bridge Community Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I would describe Bridge as a multi-generational, community Church.

My wife and I were married in September 2022 at Bridge by Pastor Andy. The entire church staff made the sanctuary so beautiful for our special day! It was perfect and we feel so blessed.

My wife has been attending Bridge Community Church since she was 10, and I started attending in 2016 when we first started dating. Many of her bridesmaids were her close friends she grew up with at Bridge, and many of my groomsmen were close friends that I have made at Bridge over the last 7 years.

We love our church family and feel at home at our wonderful church! The place the holy Spirit is moving mountains. I had backsliden for over 27 years and Jesus has brought me to my knees so I can praise him the way I was meant to and submitting my will to his. This church is blessed with the Holy Spirit. My ears had heard all about Jesus for years, my brains knows who he is but going to this church my eyes have seen him and my heart is in love with him greater than my first love. Thank you Bridge for opening the door to my wife and I. God is good Wonderful GODLY people felt very welcome!!! Love this church. Have been going there since 2004.
Pastor Danny is great, and so is the entire staff.
'Following Christ Jesus' is the main focus.
** In short, we see a family that is united by a common desire to live for God and a drive to open their hearts to those in need of what only He can give.
We seek to achieve this on a practical level through worship services, home groups, regular Bible studies, special events, outreach to the homeless and working poor, church services in the Orange county jail, daily emergency food distribution, periodic overseas outreach ** Bridge is an amazing church. With a warm welcoming loving congregation. Great worship and soul feeding word of God preached every Sunday

name: Bridge Community Church - Village of Garden City Campus
reviewSummary: excellent opening day!  the worship was great and the people were very friendly without being overly happy in a creepy way (if you know what I mean) .. I plan to attend again...nice bright and airy sanctuary.  they are going to grow, I predict. Very friendly and welcoming atmosphere. A great place to build long term relationships/community. Great worship, word and children’s ministry! Excellent flow to the service, friendly team and beautiful worship. Well presented and prepared message and most importantly scripturally based. Where two or three are gathered.. Excellent Praise & worship. Good Word. Outstanding children’s church. Warm and welcoming atmosphere. All in all it’s a Wonderful church. Love it !!! Genuine people connecting to God while safely connecting to each other...

name: Bridge of Life Church A/G - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended services last Sunday.  Very warm and friendly environment where the presence of God can be felt.  Lot's of song praise to God and then a great sermon that was easy to follow.  I like having the scriptures presented up on the overhead so I can focus on what is being said.  Will attend again. Great church with a HomeTown feel. They really have it together. Service was perfect, good praise and worship, great message and perfectly allotted time for everything else and everyone was truly sincere like they were in it for God's Kingdom!
Looking forward to getting involved in this wonderful community of believers. Was a great service. Pastor Eliut has a great annointing bringing forth Gods word. People were genuinely friendly. If you are looking for a place of worship in St. Augustine,  this is the place to go. Great worship service....friendly environment and most important preaching the word of God thru love and truth. I enjoyed it. Keep up the good work. 👍 Great church, you can feel the holy spirit here and their actions follow their words. Lots of community work/support options as well to get involved with helping others

name: Bridge Pointe Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
Bridge Point Church is a wonderful place to worship! I’ve been attending for years, and it truly feels like home. The church celebrates the love of Christ in everything they do, and everyone treats you like family from the moment you walk through the doors. It’s a beautiful community filled with love, faith, and genuine fellowship. Bridge Pointe Church is a place of loving fellowship where the truth is spoken and Jesus is truly honored.

Imperfect people are everywhere, but that’s what makes God’s grace so powerful. I genuinely enjoy gathering with other believers who, though imperfect, share one common goal — to worship our Lord together.

I’m grateful for His grace, His mercy, and the opportunity to be part of this community. My Family has been a part of Bridge Point Church for 28 years, and it truly feels like home. This church isn’t just a place to worship—it’s a family. The love, support, and sense of community here have carried me through so many seasons of life. From inspiring messages to genuine friendships, Bridge Point has been a constant source of encouragement and faith. If you’re looking for a church that welcomes you with open arms and makes you feel like you belong, this is the place. BPC is about love for God and love for others!  I have been attending for 13 years and there is no place I’d rather be.  I also recommend the one-one-one Bible studies series.  It’s life changing! I've called Bridge Pointe home for the past six years! This is a loving, faithful church committed to upholding the truth of the Scriptures and spreading the gospel. I encourage anyone working to solidify their spiritual foundation or just looking for new relationships, to check them out!

name: BridgePoint Bible Church
reviewSummary: A Bible church in west Houston known for expository teaching and a warm, family-oriented community.

name: Bridgepoint Church
reviewSummary: Here, the truth of the good news of Jesus Christ is preached, great music is experienced, and loving people abound. There are many good churches in Boise, and this is one of them. It isn't fancy or flashy, but if you're looking for a Bible-based community that will walk with you and your family through the joy and sorrow of life and everything in between, worshipping God together, this is a great place to abide. Bridgepoint doesn't really look after newcomers.. I joined for the first time on 2nd Mar '25 and being the minority of non-white person, I tried to find the ushers or church staffs, but all of them too busy preparing pizza for business meeting... Nice people. TERRIBLE pastor. The following is what he did to me after he preached about how to treat widows: I brought my service dog to church and tied her outside. The staff said to bring him in and go to the balcony as it was family and dog friendly. I walked in the front door and the pastor told me I couldn’t come in with my dog. I told him that I had paperwork and went to get it out of my purse. He called me a lier and told me that I was not welcome in his church ever. Awful man and not worthy to be called a pastor. I’m a widow. I love and am humbled by how much Bridgepoint is involved in missions of starting / supporting churches and feeding kids! I'm so happy to be part of this group following Christ! We have been attending Bridgepoint for 3 months now and have felt at home from day one. Pastor Jeff speaks biblical truth without hesitation. Music is awesome as well.

name: BridgePoint Church Downtown
reviewSummary:
Bridge point church has been such a life changing, heartwarming place to experience God’s presence. Everyone welcomed my children to the kids club with happy hearts. And it gave me peace to be able to worship and know they are safe. I’m beyond grateful to find this church and I truly feel born again from the teachings and guidance that I practice in my daily life. When you walk into Bridgepoint you’ll immediately be greeted as one more of the family. This is a true community centered around your relationship with God.

A real place to find peace. Pastor Brad and his family is amazing, and so are the rest of the Bridgepoint staff.

Kidspoint is fantastic as well. I have a lot of anxiety surrounding my baby and they went out of their way to meet with me several times and follow my instructions.

Could not recommend them any more. Contemporary church with live video streaming from their main campus. The worship is live and very contemporary as well; a full band with lights, great sounds and good energy. They certainly appeal to a younger crowd. This is also a fantastic facility in a good location, plenty of parking and friendly staff. Seems like a nice place to meet people once you get past the generic weekly preaching catered to the first time visitors. It's certainly not very deep in terms of teaching what Christianity actually is. I've been there several times and the messages are generally the same; i.e. "relationship with Jesus", "what does God have planned for you", "Give your life to God", "make sure to check in on social media so your friends know you're here" ... same old same old marketing campaign.

I've been to churches like this before and while they do very well in terms of connecting people, there's very little depth in terms of understanding what Christianity actually is and it's doctrines concerning sin, morality, etc. They purposely keep it very broad and PC in order to refrain from the controversial parts of the Bible for fear of "offending" anyone.

They're not bad people; just more concerned about growing their church than staying true to their religion (which they have rebranded as a "relationship").

So if you're into tradition or deep Biblical study, this place isn't for you.  If you're just looking to meet friends and get involved in community functions, it seems like a good place. I plan on finding out more. First visit was so warm and welcoming.  Solid biblical teaching. Loved their children's ministry.  We are coming back.

name: Bridges Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Bridges is blessed with a core group of families who are dedicated to each other and the raising of their children. Its mission begins with glorifying God and sees transformation as something that starts with the individual and works outward toward the world. We have been blessed by our relationships at this church. The congregation is very active in community. The personal involvement and love they demonstrate is a reflection of Christ Jesus. I definitely recommend this church to anybody. This Bible believing loving church feels like home. We love it there and have been going for about a year. A friendly church speaking from scripture. Grateful for the people at Bridges that serve one another and the community

name: Bridges Community Church - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
20+ years ago, I searched for many churches in the bay area. I want a church that's focus on Bible teaching which based on objective interpretation than subjective opinion and also a family like environment where kids can grow up and members can bond.  I was lucky to find two. One I spent over 10 years to raise my kids and then they moved to another church because of their friends. And here I am. The other church I love.  Bridges community church.

The reason why I stayed at this church was not because of the sermon, church program or facility, it was the people, the life group.  I was invited to one of the life groups and was very impressed of the emotional and spiritual support in every aspect. Raising challenge children, praying for one another for various issues, even food delivery when I got COVID.  The brother/sisterhood love among everyone was amazing.  We have hiking activities in the summer, monthly birthday celebrations, men's Bible study group dinner, church Fall Family Fun on Oct 31, mid autumn festival celebrating, church choir/mini orchestra was amazing too! After 8 years, I've learned so much and grown so much.  Praise God for leading me to this church.  🙏🏼 A Christ centered church which leads others to Christ by their Biblical example in their daily life. Genuine, sincere people who not only truly desire a personal closer walk with Jesus, but a desire that others in our community will come to know Him as their personal Lord and Saviour. Friendly, welcoming people from all walks of life, all ages, singles and families. A community oriented church. I really like this church. I can learn bible and play with my friends. I also like playing badminton. However, they only have it once every 2 weeks! I wanted once every week! You should change it to once every week. Why can’t you guys do once every week? Why is it once every 2 weeks?😤😤 It's very nice and God's love is centered.  As a person formerly working with youths, and young adults in the city, I still find many churches in the tricity,  including here, still don't reach out to "single" young adults groups,  especially after 18 year Olds leaving youth. It's like orphanages that send 18 year olds out to the world on their own unguided.  Some mix single young adults group with married young adults.  Which is two different spiritual levels.  So far, I've found three churches with this issue.  Growing up in churches,  we never combined. Makes it hard to invite young single adults,  our future, to church. That's the only fall back I have with the churches within Fremont. Otherwise,  I  do like this church the best especially after covid. Nobody wants to go in person to watch a sermon video. I love the variety of cultures and they work hard to include all. Love the live in person worship and sermon. Only message and announcements video. Service is live.
They are all nice, worship good and Gods love is present. They help their communities.  Praying for our future generations. 🙏 I originally came to Bridges over 20 years ago when my children were young because of their children's ministry. Since then I have joined as a buddy assisting special needs children during Sunday school. They have many opportunities to serve and connect with others. Bridges offers Life Groups to help in your spiritual growth no matter if you are a new believer or a believer of many years. It is a welcoming and very diverse campus. Come join Bridges on Sunday at 11:00 am or for one of it's many events!

name: Bridgetown Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
Apparently, I'm the only Hispanic person visiting this church. I visited it the first two times this month, September 20-25, and I've experienced that all the members in the church reception area show very friendly  . From the moment you walk in, they greet you with such sincerity and kindness, demonstrating the love of Christ in their lives. I'm as impressed as the second time I returned to visit. They all remembered my name and stopped to talk to me and greet me. They demonstrate empathy, love, and diplomacy with people. The first time, I was also able to chat for 15 minutes with a sister from the church. The coordination of the praises with the lyrics displayed on the screen is perfect. I really enjoyed my ongoing study of the Book of Acts. I hope it's the will of my Jesus that I've come here with some purpose that my God has in my life to serve and bless others. I’ve called this church home for many years, but as a newly nursing momma, I was so relieved to find out there’s a Nursing/Pumping room! I’m new to the newborn mom life and taking our little guy out of the house brought on a lot of anxiety (what if he cries, where will I change him, how will he do with the cover, etc.), but I was thrilled to know there was a room dedicated for me and my baby! There’s bouncers, a changing table, gliders, etc. Most importantly, there’s a TV, so you can still be a part of the service and not miss anything! It was such a relief!

I cannot say enough good things about the church and all they do to take care of us and the community ❤️ My family and I recently moved here from Cali. We were used to contemporary Lutheran church and wanted to fd the same in the west side, we are so happy to find this very nice church of christ filled with young families and many kids which is what we were looking for. Our girls love the kids zone and their Sunday school teachers (the best)!.
The pacstors sermons are fun fresh and educational we always leave feeling good after church the music is always very good. As well as the people that attend, they make it easy to feel like you belong.(the best part) . Absolutely LOVE this church!! I've been to a lot of churches, and I never felt welcome or nearly as amazing as I do when I go to BCC. My husband and I have been going here for years, and we highly suggest it to anyone who is looking for a warm, loving and welcoming church. This has been our family’s church home for almost 5 years. We love it so much! The kids program is phenomenal and everyone is so welcoming.

name: Bridgetown Church
reviewSummary: Influential urban church community focused on spiritual formation, silence, Sabbath, and living as a counter-cultural family of Jesus in post-Christian Portland.

name: BridgeWater Church - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary:
If you craving for a warm loving family feeling this is the perfect place for you. If you want to feel blessed this is the church for you. If you want to feel welcomed and not to be judged, this is your parish. If you want people to not drive through your parking lot to get to the good stuff, contact google like everyone else and get them to cut it off. Youre just causing more problems for everyone and yourselves. We drive through it anyway, and then we drive through it again to get back out and go get the chicken and coffee we really want. Your makeshift blockade is impeding with traffic guided by gps. I had to rent a room at the cove motel in Hamilton..to my surprise and delight there came a knock on the door..."hi, we have food out here if you care for some" what! Oh my gosh,heck yeah...Thank You to everyone who took the time to come and help strangers..to offer your amazing smiles and some of the most delicious food I have ever eaten
There's good in this world and you will never know how much it meant to me!  Thank you! Jeannie McIntosh You can feel the spirit of the Lord here, it’s so comforting.
And the friendliest, nicest, down to earth people. They greet you with a smile and open arms and make everyone feel welcome.
It is relaxed and you will leave with your spirit stronger and a fuller heart. Thank God for this church. You will be happy you joined us, I always leave with a smile and feeling better. Remember what my momma always said: “when she felt like going to church the least is when she needed it the most.” ❤️🙏🙏 This church and its community are so welcoming.
The pastor is enjoyable to listen to and I feel happy listening to him. They seem to have a lot of good outreaches too! My kids really enjoy the kid nook they go to during service.

name: Bridgeway Christian Church - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
The logistics: Great church for Bible based teaching & Holy Spirit led service as best as can be done in large settings. Have Saturday & Sunday services, Monday night prayer nights as well as multiple classes throughout the week. Small groups meet throughout the week. Has multiple restrooms in convenient locations. Has a great kids ministry that my kids love as well as a nursing place for breastfeeding moms. Has a solid pastoral staff that is accountable to an eldership. Has prayer, worship & healing nights. Services are incredible, the presence of God is always there & I always leave church having learned something.

The personal:
I love this church with my whole heart. Pastor Lance was the pastor who through his teaching partnered with the Holy Spirit to have the Bible come alive for the first time in 2014 for me. I was raised a Christian but the Bible never came alive to me and I didn’t know how it applied to my daily living. Since that day I’ve been growing in relationship with Jesus and am incredibly thankful for Pastor Lance in his part in my story. Even though I moved 1.5 hours away, whenever I’m in town, I always try to make the services and it still feels like home every time I walk in. There’s always something you can find that you don’t like about a church but in general this church hits all of the boxes of what a modern day alive & active large church looks like. It’s a big church, but it didn’t feel impersonal when I visited. The people I spoke with were friendly without being pushy, and it was easy to figure out where to go. I appreciated that the sermon was clear, Bible-focused, and practical enough to follow even as a first-time visitor. During the event I attended, the coffee shop was staffed, families were moving through the activities smoothly, and several volunteers took time to answer questions and make sure visitors knew what was available. And the kids and youth areas seemed well cared for, which stood out to me. The worship was full and energetic, though still organized. I can see why people talk about the sense of community here, because the church seems to put real effort into teaching, fellowship, and making people feel settled. This is a larger church in numbers, however it has a warm family atmosphere, and the pastoral staff has some extremely solid teaching of the word of God, beginning with Pastor Lance Hahn. My grand kiddos love attending too..ages 8 and 10. I really enjoy the Cars 'N Coffee the first Saturday of every month. Free donuts too! Jesus is Lord here, and the worship is a real blessing! We are slowly becoming a part of this beautiful church. Pastor Lance and pastor Brian's sermons are captivating! We recently visited this church for the first time when they had an awesome trunk or treat fall festival bash! They had a fully staffed, coffee shop, and all of the church representatives were super friendly. We had an awesome time and definitely plan on returning on a Sunday very soon.

name: Bridgeway Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been attending here since 2021, and are grateful we came.  They have well attended 9AM and 11:15AM Sunday services, as well as dynamic children and youth programs that lift up Jesus Christ in all things.  Give it a try, you'll be glad you did!
P.S.  you can catch services on youtube, as well as hear the Sr Pastor, Michael Rowntree, on his podcast, "The Remnant Radio."  Look for Greg, you can sit with me in the 9am service, 2nd row, center/left!  😊 It was a real treat to visit Bridgeway church. They are an especially vibrant and generous community. I really enjoyed the passionate worship times, and impactful message. It's encouraging to see Jesus working in OKC, and the rest of the world. I recommend visiting anytime and especially joining their community if you have the opportunity! Welcoming. Biblical. Emotional. Gospel centered. This place has both challenged and welcomed me more than any other church I've been a part of. Definitely come check it out. really like this church. They teach God's basic word and don't water it down. Not a hellfire and brimstone church but good basic teaching. Sunday message comes straight from the Bible with a strong focus on expanding God's mission in the Community and among the nations.

name: Bridgeway Church of Silicon Valley - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary:
Service is 12:30-1:30 every Sunday. Have small groups for many nearby colleges and youth and daycare services. A powerful sense of community every service. I invited you to check it out! People are very friendly and teaching is biblical!
Been here a year now! I've been loving it! The most welcoming and loving church community I've ever known! I love BCC and the folks here. Terrific program for the kids. Loving and genuine caring preacher. The church is the hope of this age. It is a place where the word of Jesus is proclaimed. Thank you for caring for children with love!

name: Bridgeway Community Church - Columbia Campus
reviewSummary:
For anyone afraid of church or hesitant to go...whenever I introduce  this place to people they cant believe it. They feel absolutely comfortable here and attract to the good lively vibes. It's like no other church, in the best way.  Very welcoming positive qnd motivational
All the pastors are amazing and everyone is super friendly. I love this church and I have been attending since August 2023. I was welcomed with so much warm from the entrance, into the church lobby, and in the sanctuary. What an amazing experience it’s been for me. The praise and worship is amazing! The senior pastor is an excellent preacher. Indeed I feel God’s presence here!

This is a spirit-filled church led by a spirit-filled senior pastor Dr. David Anderson. The leadership at Bridgeway symbolizes kingdom mindset of leadership (servanthood, selflessness, humility, obedience and sacrificial love). Thank you all for what you do to foster God’s work. There are many ministries in the church, to which you can offer your service to the body of Christ.

I give God glory for leading me to this church. I prayed and asked God to lead me to a church which I can call my church home. I can now comfortably call Bridgeway my home after 19 months of attendance. I just have to take the final steps of becoming a partner.

Thank you Dr. Anderson and all the pastors, for bringing people from different races and cultures to worship God in spirit and in truth. God bless you and give you long life to continue to do His work. This is HOME! Multicultural, diverse and welcoming of ALL⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Truly building bridges across communities and nations to do Kingdom Building, all in the name of our Mighty savior 🙌🏽 I really loved the message from the Pastor. This is a wonderful teaching church. Pretty good size, very diverse. Not a lot of frills which is good but they do have awesome worship music and instruments. Plenty of parking.

Upcoming teachings on the miracles performed by Christ start 9/15/2024. The atmosphere is everything I have searched for in a church home. I love how much I learn every Sunday and all the different programs available for all ages groups.

name: Bridgeway Community Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: I miss BCC so much, since I moved to downtown Phoenix! I only get to worship once in awhile. I hope to celebrate Easter Sunday with my sisters and brothers at BCC. This is a great and wonderful Church come one come all International outreach missions as well as an active polling site. You will feel like family here! Solid bible teaching and great people

name: Brier Creek Fellowship - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: I had listened to two other Churches before I turned on Brier Creek Fellowship. The other two Churches were not talking about our Lord. They were prosperity teachers.I got into the service late, but he was showing how to enhance our faith. Not being distracted by what the world shows us. We are to keep our eyes on our Lord, only. When He tells us to do something, then we will succeed. I loved his sermon. Great job. I have been away from God for months now,where I wAs before God was always at he realm if my Life an My Life was Awesome. Then I let my lives struggles get in they way of my faith and let those becone my realm, became lost and blinded myself from my connection to God. I been wanting to seek my Lord and reconnect putting him once again First and always in my life,but I didn't know where to begin again until this morning. I woke up and eagerly search for a service to attend and he guided me here to this service ! This service blew my mind on how I was meant and needed to hear the word of God that I received! I finally understand everything about his word that  I have been seeking and couldn't understand from any of the other services I attended before. Thank You for service today, it was my first time and I found my home! I will be attending every Sunday and want to attend much more within this fellowship. Absolutely loved the service and I thank you with all my heart for helping me find my way back to my God and mending my entire being. Great place to worship. I was there during my vacation and I love it. The Pastor and his family are great and the congregations too are  amazing people. Only online and not in-person? Are they closed? A great place to worship! The Holy Spirit shows up and the people are so warm and welcoming!

name: Bright Angel Church of Christ - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a church who follows  the Bible, this is it. They are the warmest welcoming Christians I have come across in Las Vegas. They genuinely care about others instead of just going through the motions. If you're looking for a church family, give them a try. The gospel is preached here and the people are friendly! This is one of many locations of worship for the TRUE church that Christ established. I appreciated them for inviting other Church of Christ ministers to teach on various biblical leaders for June and July. I have lived in the area for years.  I am from the Bay Area of California and am a member of the COC out there.  I just recently began attending the Sunday evening sermons.  I love it!  I cannot stress enough how much I enjoy going to church and hearing the lessons.  I enjoy the members (although I am somewhat shy, several members make sure to speak and smile) and the location is nice.  The building is emaculate.  The size of the congregation varied for the few times I went in the evening, but that works for me.  The message and worship is accurate and established.  It is excellent and has top shelf Bible teachings.  I will attend more often. Since I moved to Vegas 4 years ago, I have not attended a church with proper biblical leadership. Bright Angel has elders and deacons who take the job of caring for the congregation seriously. There is a sense of peace and security I was used to but hadn't been able to find.I am back attending 3 times a week, I look forward to services again and gotten my spiritual life back on track. I just needed a good congregation. I stand corrected on my previous review.  The Bright Angel church of Christ does preach and teach the truth from Matt 19:1-9 on marriage, divorce and remarriage.  See the sermon presented by Mark Bassett on Feb, 26, 2024 on this topic.  I strongly recommend the Bright Angel church of Christ to anyone who is seeking a congregation to assemble and worship the Lord with!
Mike Tucker

name: Bright City Church - Durham Campus
reviewSummary: We love the teaching, worship, serving groups and community here! Great young adult program as well. My wife and I have been attending for five years and are so thankful to call this place our church home.

name: Britton Christian Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: Great service and everyone is very warm welcome to you. Totally enjoyed the service, met the pastor, welcoming environment focused on God and people. Wonderful Church! My family and I are excited for church every Sunday! God is moving in and through this church. There is a great community here with many opportunities for spiritual growth and to serve. There is a clear vision for local impact in their area. Sunday mornings are family-friendly with a place to plug in for all ages and walks of life. Teachings are focused on Biblical truths and who Jesus truly is. The staff is great and the pastor is the real deal. We’d love to see you visit us! This church is buns. Thoroughly unimpressed. 0/10. The evolution of this place since I was a kid is amazing! Led by wonderful people who put God first, and service is top priority.

name: Broadlands Community Church
reviewSummary: Excellent biblical teaching and very welcoming and inviting atmosphere, if you are looking for a new church you should definitley visit  Broadlands Community Church Wonderful community church. Great solid teachings. Welcoming members. Knowledgeable pastor. A wonderful church with a pure, Christ centered message.   Great friendly people. Peace. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Broadmoor Baptist Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary:
Our home church. We joined in 2006 when we were getting married and moving back to Madison. There are a lot of activities for kids, which is a huge plus. Our new pastor, new a year ago, is a good communicator.

📸HeathersLG and Bobbymontg Very friendly place. Wonderful setting for our ladies conference. Broadmoor is an absolutely AWESOME church you have to visit to be able to truly appreciate! Bro. Josh, the staff, and members are all great people serving the Lord! ✝️😎👍 Excellent church. Great message from Pastor Josh! First time in many many years going to church. The first impression was the best! Met Brian, who works there or helps out. So genuinely welcoming, open and friendly. I found this in many others who attend. Sandy who attends with her husband Lance. I was invited by my coworker and friend Katie. I met her ladies group who were also amazing and welcoming. My church before I loved the preacher, but no one really spoke to you first or ignored anyone they didnt know personally. I'd love to hear my old preacher, but this church congregation is so open and kind and the pastor is as good as my old favorite pastor. So I think I want to stick with these people for a while 😇

name: Broadmoor Community Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Fantastic family friendly church! This church is at a beautiful location and seemed kind of organized. The pastor is a woman, and there wasn’t much preaching, mostly just reading traditional scriptures, hymns etc. The people were nice, mostly elders.

What really bummed me out was a very major event had happened in the country that week. The pastor asked everyone what they needed prayers for, then told us to bow our heads and pray in silence. After that, she prayed out loud for Gaza, Palestine, South Africa, and Everhart school shooting. She failed as a pastor when she didn’t say a word of kindness for Charlie Kirk’s death at all.

Charlie Kirk’s brutal execution was all over the news, and people across the country have been mourning. Yet this church and its pastor failed to acknowledge it.. no prayer of sympathy for people affected by this major event. Dude was executed infront of the entire world. A brother in Christ was executed.

I don’t care what your political beliefs are or if you disagreed with him, basic human decency as a church means showing compassion. Instead, this felt like a “feel good” church that’s blinded by HATE. Honestly, it came across more like a cult than a church. It is not easy to run a great church community but this church is seriously top-notch, especially when it comes to their kids' programs. They've got something for every age group, and it's not just fun but also really engaging & soul nourishing for the kids. The pastors, Rev. Anne Cubbage and Rev. Lynn Hurst, are truly incredible. They're super dedicated and you can tell they really care about everyone in the congregation. The whole staff is amazing too. Everyone feels included and appreciated here. Wonderful community, the people here are SO KIND, they will walk right up and introduce themselves, and welcome you. Members will actively participate in getting to know you, I have found life long friendships at this church.
Their pastor is brilliant, I often feel like God is speaking directly to me through her, and it is very comforting. She is attentive, caring, and considerate.
Their music program is impressive, they have interns from local colleges, a well stocked choir, and even a children’s choir starting with kindergartners!
They run all types of community programs here, from toddler music to baby boomer get togethers. I am a parent with young children and I am so relieved that there are many others my age, and kids attending. The older adults are so happy to have them around, they compliment them and laugh at their antics during fellowship after service, or at events, when we have a snack, drink coffee or tea and talk, they provide water or lemonade also. They are truly considerate of everyone youngest to oldest.
My older child loves going to Sunday school and making crafts. The nursery is large and well stocked with toys of all kinds, books, and videos, plus a beautiful colorful mural on the wall.
If you’re on the market for a home church, you should definitely come by and check out BCC. I can almost guarantee you won’t be disappointed. I hope to see you soon. I love this church! Its dynamic and active with local organizations that help others in our community. The pastor is so caring and vibrant. The sermons are Bible-based with a healthy dose of application to our lives today. I also really love the music program. This church lives the statement, no matter who you are or where you are on life’s journey, you are welcome here. I am so fortunate I found this church family.

name: Broadway Baptist Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: One strong Bible believing church, led by a strong Pastor, with fantastic faith. A wonderfully friendly church, with people who love the Lord.

name: Broadway Christian Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: If you are a Bible-believing follower of Christ, you will feel right at home in this assembly. I visited here while traveling and the congregation was very welcoming. They members are exemplary of John 7:38-39, full of the Holy Spirit of God. They have a heart for local ministry as well as that of our nation and the world. And if you are not a believer, I'd say it's a great place to get started. Parked early in Lutheran hospital parking lot across the street... And met one of the leadership team. Very helpful and friendly. He knew a friend's family very well and helped me find what I was looking for. God lead me to this church two years ago. I have been discipled here and still being discipled. I have learned so many things about GOD, ministries and people in general. It is an alive church. Every Sunday after service, people still stays either in the sanctuary or other places in the church. You will see some people praying for one another. Talking and encouraging each other. You will also see people going to lunch after the service. It is truly a place for the body of Christ to Praise and Worship HIM. This is the kind of church that GOD attends. Not just my opinion but I feel it. Not just me but the whole body of Christ that attends Broadway. We went when they were supposed to be open and we could not get in however they did at ramps everywhere so it is wheelchair accessible it's about all I know about the place. This is a wonderful Church. If you are looking for a Bible based Church that is warm, welcoming and diverse, this is it. This is a family.

name: Broadway Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
First time.  Attended contemporary service.  Nice people. I love Broadway Church and consider it my church family and home. I've been attending Sunday service there and Celebrate Recovery Thursdays for over a year. There's something for everyone there and I highly recommend it. Love this church. The "new" service has great modern Christian music, super friendly parishionersv and is very inclusive. We feel the love. This pastor at this church helps me with groceries but they say that they can't help nobody else I spoke to the lady that they help with groceries but meanwhile they said they can't help nobody

Please on Sundays do not give money to this church. Dial 211 and see if they help you but we have to stop giving money to churches that don't help people because I came out here for a job got stranded and they can't even help me get back so to test this church pretend you are member of this church tell them you behind on light bill see if they will help you out you will see the true greedy church they won't help you let's get these churches shut down please Broadway Christian is such a warm and welcoming church. My husband and I looked for a church for almost a year. We have a contemporary and classic service and many opportunities to grow and serve the community.

name: Broadway Christian Church - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I had found a home church. Traditional music/songs was great. Not a Christian "concert". A retirement of music leader has lead to loss of most of that. When some negative feedback about the change came up, THEY CHEWED OUT THE CONGREGATION!
Lots of wonderful people there. Poor situation management. This is a progressive Christian church that welcomes LGBTQ members like me. The vibe is very positive. As a matter of fact they have a food pantry and they are helping people out during the SNAP benefits cut off. I just got a food box a couple of days ago. Thank you to everyone at the church for helping during hard times like now! Everyone is welcome here. People are very friendly and great biblical teaching. I am very disappointed with the way the church has changed and todays sermon was a disgrace.  I grew up going to the Christian church never missed one Sunday in 13 years and was taken as a baby. This church has been turned over to young people that can't even show respect in their dress-blue jeans not even dress slacks and preachers that have to cut down other religions and evidently doesn't know their true beliefs. I know Mormons that know the Bible better than he does and I have many friends of other denominations that never cut down other religions. That is not being a Christian maybe he is in the wrong line of work. I This is a very nice church very friendly people and provide transportation for senior citizens who don't drive. I was visiting this church with a friend who attends service here.

name: Broadway Christian Parish Church - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary:
Alright for mail, 15 minute timed showers, laundry... breakfast can be very small!
Rhonda helps folks were relieved by her saving generosity! Well worth 4 stars! yet, i dont like the place much! (hike is a mile distance, bus  stops 400 feet away) The only thing I don't like is that dropping stuff off ends at 10 AM. It makes it difficult to donate. I use it to get tax credits for my mother.

A place where you can get 2nd had clothing, food, and other pre-owned things.

Also a great place to volenteer, and drop off gently used items. They have people with the skills to repair broken electronics, so if your stuff is broken, don't let that stop you. #God is good!!
#All the time!! If you are in a tight spot you can go here every morning Mon-Thurs for a delicious breakfast with coffee and orange juice from 8 am until I think 11 am. (Possibly noon) They have showers, homeless can have mail sent there, food pantry, and so much more. A very.loving church that cares and reachea out to the community. A blessing for sure.

name: Broadway Church of Christ - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary: Really good church community. Loved going to Sunday and Wednesday bible class in the youth group. People were really nice, fun activities to do with the youth group. If you move to Lubbock- Broadway church of  christ is definitely a really good place to go. The people will have a really good impact on you. Amazing, warm, Spirit-filled place of worship! It is one of the very best preschool programs. Gifted staff, covered play area, and timely communication. It's a very wonderful place for worship and relationships with others. There is so much family and friendship that support and help you through the rough patches on your life. God is shown so greatly at this church. A amazing place!  They helped form me into who I am today!

name: Broadway Methodist Church - Glendale Campus
Broadway UMC Melrose Campus
Broken Arrow Church of Christ - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church family. A great place to worship God from the heart surrounded by Christians who want to make a difference in Broken Arrow and around the world.

Also, a great place to raise your family in the Lord. David is an outstanding person who goes there and lives as an example of his beliefs by going majorly out of his way to help those in need 🙏 We absolutely love our church family! We placed membership here last year because when we attended services people were so friendly and welcoming ( something that can often be lacking in a large congregation ). The people really care about serving God and doing His will by serving others and have welcomed us with open arms. Come visit and you'll see what I'm talking about! Whenever we combine our services I always enjoy the whole experience.  The sermon, the lessons & the teachers were very good. The song service was great. We topped it off by breaking bread together. I met a lot of new people. I even made a new friend & we enjoyed each other so much that we exchanged phone numbers. I've been a member since 2004 & I just love this church family! They have been a great source of support & strength for my family. We have one of the best VBSes I've seen - so much work is put into it! This congregation loves kids... not only did a team of volunteers provide childcare during the teacher walkout, but every summer, this church hosts New Heights Summer Camp for school aged kids. Our church family is constantly reaching out to the community through Rhodes Elementary, the food pantry, the clothing room, the prison ministry - the list goes on & on. If you're looking for a church family that loves to sing, has varied Bible classes, great sermons, & a place to get involved, then BACOC would make a great home for you as well. 😊

name: Brookfield Christian Reformed Church
reviewSummary:
I attended a little over a year and was grateful the Bible and Jesus are the center of sermons.  Much of the culture of the church is embedded in a longstanding and deep connection with Dutch ethnic representation and heritage.  Leadership needs to be mindful that this can and does deter others from feeling included.  Friendly does not necessarily mean inclusive.  The home Bible study groups are not public and give the impression that there is no access to participating in established communities. (Perception is reality!)
The last comment is an observation.  The senior pastor's office is a privileged space and not someone's home office.  It was disheartening to see the church's property to be treated with disrespect and entitlement.  It's not just messy - it's a complete pigsty. Family friendly, scripture based, great music and solid leadership.  Been attending for 20 plus years and it’s seen me through the ups and downs of life. attend a funeral of a friend.  the place was well laid out for observing the memorial presentations. Nice church and school, visited for Christmas program Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Brookhaven Christian Child Development Center - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary:
I am writing this review to express how sweet and wonderful of a director Ms. Delia is. My mother just passed Ms. Doris walker who been working with BCA Ms. Delia and Ms. Mary for over 20+ years. Ms. Delia came to her Memorial Service today and spoke such kind and beautiful words about my mother it had me i. Tears ..Thank You so much for yours beautiful words and working with my mother and being such a good friend to my mother❤️
God Bless you, Must love and respect
The Walker Family Terrific daycare. The director has been there over 20+ years. They have caring, patient & loving staff - with little to no turnover. I run an enrichment program in over 100 daycares within Atlanta, ( we don’t have a program here! I’m not incentivized to say this) but theyre one of the best ran & organized  daycares I’ve seen! 10/10 The most important thing is that the caregiver is kind and loving to the children. Most are not. They pretend in from of the parents and then are mean to the children when they leave. They yell at them, ignore them, and treat them unkindly.

Parents be very careful when you leave your children in the care of anyone. Had the worst experience at Brookhaven Christian Church CDC. The facilities are very untidy. The director Della is very loud and disrespectful. Each encounter I had with her if there was an issue, she initiated the conversation with an insult. The infant room is great and has wonderful care givers. The transitional process from infant to toddler room is horrible. My son was 11 months when they decide to transition him from the infant room to toddler room. They expect an 11 month old to do the same things as a 2 year old. My son was not being properly fed. The main reason was that they were too lazy to give him a warm bottle and they were too cheap to provide a small fridge and microwave in the toddle room. My son was not taking well to cold bottles, Della and staff felt it was only right to keep him on cold bottles after they observe that he isn't drinking the cold milk that they were providing. My son typically drinks 8oz every 3 hours. On his daily activity sheet, he would only have 2oz per feeding. They observed this and blamed my wife and I for not giving him cold bottles as they do at the daycare. If an eleven month old baby that isn't drinking cold milk how can you force him to???He has to be fed one way or the other which they refused to do. Everyday I picked him up from daycare he would cry the whole care ride home, when I got him in the house he would suck down up to 160z in one settings which isn't typical. we were excuse of having my son attend the daycare on the morning of a meeting my wife and I were to have with the Daycare. No forewarning or lead time to find another facilities. I previously discussed giving us 30 days to move on which they agreed to. This is something they will ask for from the parent as well if you decide to leave. Their reason for excusing us was because they can not provide 8oz of warm milk per feeding. By law you can request your child to be on a certain eating regiment. Della, Mary and Velina does not care about the well being of your child.

Also they allow anyone to walk to into the rooms where the kids are kept. There are children crawling around dirty floors which everyone walk on. My child was constantly sick which I get but to come home with HAND FOOT MOUTH Disease. Read up on what that is, it comes from uncleanliness. They also do not care to change your kids clothes if they are dirty. They bring your kids to their play ground and do not take the time to take the wood chips and sand out of their shoes. Asking for my child to have warm bottles and to keep him as clean as possible was too much to ask for.

I know finding a Daycare is hard and sadly you have to take what you can get. But if you do choose this Daycare please Voice your opinion on the care of your child. I've spoke to other parents who had similar the experience and they weren't as vocal about the care of their child. This facility can not continue with sub par care of kids. They do not deserve it!!!!!!

name: Brookhaven Presbyterian Church - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a very welcoming place. Very relax. The music is very good and invites you to stay focused on worship and adoration to our God. The sermons are very unique,  the pastor talks about life, how the gospel should impact our every day life in a very friendly way. This church is engage in very important ministries that help our community. I can see that the leaders have a heart for this community. This is an amazing church with a welcoming congregation, supportive staff, and incredible delivery of God’s word.  This church is the main reason we stayed in the city of Brookhaven for as long as we did. This has been such an amazing church and I am so glad my wife and I found it. It is a place full of people who love each other, love their community, and most importantly love God.

Please come and check us out if you are interested in learning more about Jesus or God, or if you know Jesus already then also please come! Fun atmosphere. German potato salad was solid. Loved the flavor of the brussel sprouts but I’d like them cooked a bit longer We stopped looking for churches after we found this one. Very family friendly, highly recommended!

name: Brookhaven United Methodist Church - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary: Such an incredible jewel located in the busyness of the city! A very nice, small town; home! Kind of nice actually having greeters, members, staff, and clergy with whom first name basis combined with anytime access feels like being home! The people are really caring. Snacks every other Monday. Pastor Don is the greatest teacher of bible study. I learned a lot. Friendly congregation, earnest soft spoken preacher, and uplifting new and old music. Does anyone know if they offer community service hours ? Great accepting community!

name: Brooklyn Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Popped into St. Patrick's on a recent weekday afternoon, just trying to get a moment of quiet away from the Midtown bustle. Honestly, it's wild how much the city just melts away the second you step inside. The sheer scale of the place is impressive, with those huge arches and the way the light filters through the stained glass is really something. I spent a good chunk of time just looking up at the ceiling and taking in the details; it feels like you could spend hours just noticing new things. What really made the visit smooth, though, was how straightforward it was to just walk in and explore without any fuss. I particularly appreciated how easy it was to find a spot to just sit and be still for a bit, and the staff I encountered were just there, unobtrusively helping people find their way or answering quick questions. It's a place that really offers a chance to reset before diving back into everything else NYC throws at you. My daughter and I used to go to the Lower East Side Fellowship church in Manhattan. My brother in law Joseph Maldonado was the Pastor and he was the best Pastor I've ever met. When he pasted away we became so depressed, because his Legacy died with him. LESF is no longer around. The person that took over the church is a wolf in sheep's clothing, (All in Church). Brooklyn Church is exactly how my brother in law Pastor Joe started out 15 years ago.
Jesus led my daughter to Brooklyn Church, because she prayed on it. She asked Jesus to lead her in the right direction. She went 3 times before telling me, only because she wanted to get to know the pastor and people of the church. When she took me to Brooklyn Church, I felt so at home the moment I walked in. When I tell you Jesus works through Pastor Alan. I couldn't be more happier from the first day at Brooklyn Church. There are no wolves in this church, just people of God coming together to worship our only Lord, Savior, and King, Jesus Christ 🙌 🙌 ❤️ Brooklyn Church meets at 1030am on Sundays at PS32 on Union and Hoyt. There is no perfect church as every one is filled with imperfect humans. But, Brooklyn Church is refreshing because they aren't out to wow you or sell you some prosperity gospel. They simply love God and love others. Exactly as Jesus commanded. It has been such a gift to get to know some of the team at Brooklyn Church. I am so grateful that they are in the community as examples of how Jesus cared for people no matter their background or circumstances. I would highly recommend this church as a sanctuary and place to meet others seeking to share God's love and grace. Alan has such a big heart for the community and is faithful to bring the word verse by verse and let it be used how God wants to use it. So grateful for having got to experience what you are doing over there

name: Brookside Community Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Dear Brookside Community Church,
Hello it's P0rkch0p
I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for the impact your church has had on my life and the lives of so many in our community.
Thank you for being a living example of God’s love in action. Your commitment to being a multicultural, Gospel-centered church is evident in the way you serve the Near Eastside community with compassion and purpose.
Your focus on holistic transformation—meeting both spiritual and physical needs—has made a meaningful impact. Through your outreach programs, partnerships, and dedication to community, you are not only addressing immediate needs but also creating pathways toward lasting stability and hope.
Your message of connection, purpose, and faith reminds me that I am not alone, and that through Christ, transformation is possible. Pastor Charles's great I love his sermons I like the way you articulate and put things together I look forward to going back every Sunday ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The ladies in the choir room were such kind, God-fearing, and inspiring women! They welcomed us with warmth and even let us eat inside the church after we grabbed food from the truck out front. Their hospitality truly reflected the love and grace of God. Thank you for making us feel so at home! Absolutely love this church they are the most welcoming people they greet you at the front door and make u feel so welcome there are all walls of life at this church and you don't have to dress up Very welcoming and amazing church staff and parishioners! Amazing breakfast Sunday morning before church! Great service with great music and sermons!

name: Brown Memorial CME Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: It's my church. I am there most Sundays.Have a dedicated pastor and first lady. Great inspiration and spiritual sermons every Sunday. Awesome choir. Sunday school.9:45a. Service11:00a. Bible study wed's at 7:p senior adult ministry on Weds. at 11:30a. Many organizations. Children's church and  activities.young adults ministry. Congregation is awesome. Wonderful  church. Come worship with us. You will be welcome with hugs and love. Best church I've been to in a while, everyone is so up lifting and encouraging its just like family.. Well more than family i would most definitely encourage everyone to visit. And the pastor is so down to earth and great with the youth... Brownsburg Church of Christ - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary: The people are always friendly and the teaching is Bible based. I love attending this church. Great people, great messages. God is alive and working in this church! name: Brownsburg Vineyard Church - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
Today, Easter Sunday 2024, I attended Brownsburg Vineyard Church for the first time. Pastor Denis, and his wife, Pastor Gwen were very welcoming. I felt very emotional just walking in the church, but after a brief chat and Gwen praying over me, I felt peace. I enjoyed the music worship and the message from Denis. I will most definitely be returning, as I have been seeking a church home for a while now. I know I was called to that church for a reason and I definitely received the blessing of BVC. Have attended for 3 weeks. Feel freedom in the Holy Spirit to worship and feel free to show how much I love God. Pastor Denis and Gwen are very welcoming as is body of Christ. Accessible for my adult son is a plus too. Lots of community involvement and a great ministry for kids and middle and high schoolers. God bless this portion of the Body. Brownsburg Vineyard Church is a great Church. On my first day at the Church I felt the presence of God and I found home church there. The words of God is being preached undiluted. The sermon will always connect you with God and create the zeal for more in you. It is a church that you can call a home, it is a place where you can find solution to all problems with intervention of Holy Spirit. Pastor Denis and Gwen Roy are  great servant of God with  large heart and they are always ready to be part of your joy and share your problems to find a lasting solution.
To experience God in first hand and live a righteous life, go to no other place but Brownsburg Vineyard Church. This is honestly the first church I have ever attended where I truly feel accepted for who I am right now. It's not a huge church, so don't expect anonymity. Instead, expect people will introduce themselves to you if they don't recognize you. The preaching is solid and the worship is authentic. So thankful we were led here and for the first time have a real church home and family. I absolutely love Brownsburg Vineyard Church and have found a real home there. Authentic people who preach, teach, and serve with integrity, and who care for the whole person. The teaching is full and gives you something to really chew on, and the weekly small groups you can join give you the chance to get to know people on a deeper level, creating that genuine community that we all are looking for. Love this place and so happy we found it!

name: Bryant Street Baptist Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been attending Bryant Street Baptist Church for a few years now.  The worship is awesome.  Pastor Mike and his wife Stacy are deeply caring and love the people.  With sound biblical teaching, a truly welcoming body of believers, and ample opportunity to plug in, to serve and connect, I highly recommend Bryant Street to anyone looking to become part of a caring church family.  You will be loved well there. ❤️ My husband and I have been attending regularly since Easter. We have experienced kind and loving people who want to share the love of Jesus with people. We were welcomed with open arms. I appreciate that the Bible is being preached and the messages from the pulpit are solid. I look forward to growing in my faith and walk with God through the encouragement of the people here at Bryant Street Baptist. Don’t hesitate to check it out . We would love to see you! I came to Bryant Street Baptist Church 14 years ago. I found a warm and welcoming group of people. Right from the start, I felt at home. The pastor at the time was very kind and generous. Then Pastor Mike and his family came , they brought new life to our church.
I am part of the coffee ministry, which I enjoy doing every time. I enjoy welcoming new people to our family.  Yes, we are a family of love. My husband & I have been going to Bryant St Baptist Church, Yucaipa for many years now. From the first time we showed up, we felt like we were home. God gave us a Bible teaching minister in Mike. He takes the time to listen to questions & give sound biblical answers. God through his biblical dedication has brought together a warm & loving church family. Bryant St helps each other in times of need, sorrow and truly share each others joy. I am thankful to be a part of Bryant St Church. I became a part of Bryant Street Baptist Church in Yucaipa 16 yrs ago.  I am closer to my Lord and Savior now than any time in my life. I can attribute that to sound biblical preaching and teaching. The music always reminds me of the joy I find in praising God. The talent and gifts of those involved in all aspects of the church point me to a loving God and a community that loves God and people. There are so many ministries available where your need to serve and also receive can be found. You will be blessed!

name: Buckhead Church
reviewSummary: Part of the North Point network, targeting the urban Buckhead demographic. Modern production, practical teaching, designed for young professionals.

name: Buckhead Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
•	People were very friendly and welcoming
•	The environment felt safe and comfortable
•	Parking was easy, despite the size of the campus

What could improve:

•	The church is huge, and as a first-timer I found it a bit confusing to navigate, better signage would help a lot
•	The pastor delivered the sermon via screen rather than in person. I’m not sure if that was just the case the day I visited, but it was a big factor for me. There’s something important about a pastor being physically present, reading the room and sensing whether the message is really the right one for that moment. In a world where we’re already staring at screens constantly, I’d prefer church to be a break from that, not more of it.

This isn’t a knock on the church as a whole  maybe I just caught an off day. I’ve attended multiple events here hoping for a different experience, but unfortunately, I won't be returning. Every time I visited, the environment felt incredibly unwelcoming. Especially when I walked into a small room full of people, and no one acknowledged my presence or said a single word to me. I stayed for the entirety of the events, yet the only interaction I received was occasional staring.

I genuinely dislike leaving a negative review for a church, but it is deeply disheartening when a community does not embody the love of Christ. I wasn't looking for anything grand—just basic human decency and hospitality. I’ve been searching for a church home, but this is definitely not it. I truly hope leadership focuses more on teaching love, warmth, and hospitality to newcomers in the future✌️ I recently attended this church for the 2024 No Longer Bound Banquet. I personally attended the men’s program 22 years ago and my life was changed. The Lord saved me from the pit of despair where I was reeling and addiction and hopelessness. Buckhead church hosted us for an incredible evening and their senior pastor made everyone feel loved and valued as he shared hope and love in Christ. I sat with one of the staff people, Cara and was blown away and honored by her kindness and hospitality. Lots of history in this place. Thankful to have been there for this event. I’ve been attending BC for almost 5 years now. I love it and my favourite is The Living Room for College students on Monday nights. The main service however I think could be a bit more diverse. It’s a totally different environment on Monday nights than on Sundays. I love their Sunday school and I actually volunteer there. It’s a good place to attend when you are building your faith. Pastor Andy Stanley I mean is usually on point with his preaching. A pretty good overall experience.
Traveled from out of town and this church was local enough to my hotel.
In an effort to not miss out on my regular Sunday services I made it a point to attend. The topic for the sermon series that week was around "Patience." Something many of us can all use more of.
The delivery was well put together. The supporting examples were humorous and relatable. The praise and worship was good. In it's entirety the service was short and sweet. About an hour 15 minutes.

When traveling to Atlanta I normally stay in the Buckhead area, this will be a church I frequent if my visits extend beyond Saturday.
If you're seeking the word and would like to fellowship on a Sunday, it's worth it to drop in.

I was disappointed. Pastor Givens preaches empowering sermons. The church family is friendly and inviting. The preacher and his wife are Awesome, its an Awesome congregation and service!!!! Jesus LOVES US ONE & ALL God Is Awesome!

reviewSummary:

The congregation is very kind and warming to visitors. This is a wonderful group of Christians who strive to follow God's directions found in the Holy Bible. Awesome Church! Awesome place to worship!

reviewSummary: (I'm talking about the Hispanic Church) my mom and I had gone there before but slowly the people stared showing their true colors they weren't rude to me but they we're very disrespectful to my mom.
