They made up nasty rumors about my mother they act all nice and caring but deep down all they care about is getting the money... Whenever a person felt uncomfortable and they decided to leave Raphael Cano would juge them and say that bad things would happen to them if they left.. when my mother had enough and we decided to leave everyone's eyes were on us I felt extremely uncomfortable, and recently I found out that they were calling my mother a bad parent just because she didn't take me to their dumb church anymore. They even made up lies about my mom... What kind of church is this? At this point it's not even a church anymore it's hell it's self. they have done far more worse. what I'm saying here this is just the beginning..they make up lies about an adult what do you think they will say about a minor?... Absolutely beautiful and very filled with the holy spirit.  Absolutely beautiful service Thank you for hosting the North GA women's conference . It was ana amazing experience and your work crew was dutiful and friendly. Take good care of them! I was deeply disappointed with my experience at this church. While the community may be welcoming to some, it became clear that LGBTQ individuals are not accepted here. The church's stance on LGBTQ issues made me feel unwelcome and judged, which goes against what I believe a house of worship should stand for—love, inclusion, and acceptance for all. I cannot recommend this church to anyone who is looking for an inclusive spiritual home. I love my moms church. Great music, preaching, spirit and always good to see friends from back in the day.

reviewSummary:
Pastor Steve jumped around a lot throughout the bible to make 4 simple points about trusting God to lead your covenant. Speech lacked depth of topic with many random inserts of quotes and stories to support claims provided at end. Unfortunately will not be returning but everyone seemed welcoming and friendly, the service was a normal 60-90 minute timeframe My husband and I absolutely love this church and the message “Go tell everyone, everywhere about Jesus”
You can definitely feel God moving in everything! I’m thankful to find a church home ❤️ First time visiting today and it was Beautiful! The message was meant for me and my family. Thank you! We will be back. I believe we've found a new home. 🥰

Re: I am going to have to take back a few stars for the simple fact that, don't get me wrong, the church is lovely, but when you need help they do not believe in that part. What would Jesus do? If you're not rich or wealthy, don't go to this church, period. Does Pastor Spencer know how the staff is treating a person in need?? The church is great! I love going and I invite my friends too. I think the church it great We absolutely love our church! We've made incredible friends and our pastors are truly amazing. I highly recommend it - stepping inside feels like coming home. Everyone is incredibly friendly and welcoming.

name: Burbank Christian Armenian Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church ever. I got blessed by the lord in this church. When I was walking on the street and i heard some music outside church the holy spirit pushed me and invited me to come to this church . I enjoyed the music and felt happy because of the encountance by the holy spirit. Pastor Albert prayed for me and from that day on many things start to change. The lord is great. Great church and wonderful,  knowledgeable pastor. Pastor Albert is a great pastor and knows the bible very well. If you need prayers pastor Albert is always there for you .You will enjoy beeing in this church because you will be filled by the spirit and you will feel lighter afterwards. The lord
listens to your prayers and answers them .The brothers and sisters are very nice and we have after ceremony tea and coffee. I recommend to come to this church and see the blessings of the lord. Amen and Hallelujah The lord is great and faithful. Thank you pastor Albert I visited the church during my many visits to Los Angeles. The members are very welcoming and warm. The worship was lively and the sermon was recent to life An amazing church family! It’s a place where everyone is welcomed, God’s Word is faithfully taught, and genuine friendships are built through love and fellowship. Great church and fellowship, great community of people who look out for each other. Very welcoming and warm church. It felt family oriented

name: Burbank First United Methodist Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: Highly recommend!  Most recently, summer 2015, a new and energetic Pastor Sam Kim has joined the and the experience on Sunday mornings and beyond is exactly what we are looking for.  Lots of families with school age children attend making the environment a great place to meet other families.  Our kids ages 12 and 13 love coming to church and we are happy to say we have a church home here in Burbank! If you're looking for your forever church home, come to the big beautiful brick church on GlenOaks (a long time staple and icon to Burbank).  Great family setting, and their motto of 'Open Hearts, Open Mind, Open Doors' is very true.  We have been attending this church since moving to CA in 2009.  Our new pastor, Sam Kim, along with his family, has been an invaluable addition to our church family, and his sermons are encouraging, insightful, and refreshingly engaging.  I hope you'll join us one week to see the same for yourself. I have been attending FIRST UNITED METHODIST CHURCH for 15 years now and it has truly become my church home.  The people are warm and inviting and the pastor is a great leader.  My children both attended Sunday and were confirmed in the church. The church has become very involved in community outreach and has provided countless life lessons for my kids.  I will forever be grateful to God for leading my family to this church. My wife and I started attending BFUMC in November 2013 and we were welcomed with open arms. We have since had a child and are very excited to be raising him in this church. I have become involved helping out with the youth, BUMPS (Burbank United Methodist Players Theatre Group), and other various activities. This is a very active church and they always have something fun going on. Highly recommended if you are looking for a fun, warm, and exciting church to be part of. My family is very blessed for finding Burbank First United Methodist. Attended twice in the last three weeks and felt a very good vibe in this church...the people are energetic, friendly, and are engaged in a traditional progressive worship service.  I look forward to learning more about the church and the congregation.  The children's Sunday School is well set up with good coverage and the kids came out carrying an actual activity page with Bible content.  I loved that.

name: Burbank Korean Presbyterian - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: The Church is God, Word, Light, and Love. The pastor's sermons are wonderful. The church members are also very warm-hearted. A church overflowing with grace Good Church

name: Burlingame United Methodist Church - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary: Really beautiful Methodist Church at Burlingame. Great service and venue. Pastor Ann Duncan is a great speaker. Highly recommend Every last Saturday  ! Of the month they serve the finest cooked bacon , and eggs and toast ! Along coffee,  and Orange juice  for free ! At 7:00 am Love love love this church. Extremly friendly, great music, coffee bar, amazing sermon. Great Pre-school. Lovely teachers that provide a loving secure environment.

name: Burlington Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
I moved to Burlington with my wife Michelle in the summer of 2013. We lived in Vermont until 2015 (when our son was born), and then we moved back to the Midwest to pursue work opportunities and to be closer to our family. I still wonder if we made the right choice! We've kept up with our friends and have only heard great news about this congregation.

Said simply, our 2 years in Burlington were the best 2 years of our lives. I believe God used the Burlington Church of Christ to help me to grow in my faith, improve my marriage, and equip me for the future. I'm forever grateful!

If you're reading this, you probably have a lot of options of where to go to Church. So if you're looking for a faithful, family-friendly, FUN group, who LOVE God's Word and each other... end your search, you found it. I started attending this church as soon as I moved to Burlington and I’ve felt so plugged in since day one! There is a great community of family within the church that is so special. And people are really striving to live out the Bible every day. If you’re looking for a place to connect with God and meet other people who share the same beliefs, then this is a great place for you! As a non-denominational church, they are open and accepting of everyone of all ages, races, and ethnicities. A wonderful place for everyone! I started attending this church back in July 2018 and I have loved it! I love it because it is a truly a diverse community but all members are unified in growing closer to God. It has truly become my home away from home Great group of people to help you learn about your personal value to God and to other people in this life. Highly recommend building friendships with them and asking for help to study the bible so that you can understand and develop your own faith.

name: Burlington United Pentecostal
reviewSummary: I had a wonderful time here--God is obviously touching the lives of these people and they have testimonies about how God has transformed and helped them.  I see eyes shining, people who are happy to be living for Jesus Christ.  Joy! Great church Great people and I am a member of the church but it's awesome Very friendly church. These people really love God,  and it shows! Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: burlpres church | First Pres Burlingame - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary:
I love our church. It's a welcoming and a non-judgemental place where you can find support comfort and a sense of peace. It's a true Community where people care about one another. Come and give us a chance. Y'all gotta leave people on PUBLIC SIDEWALK Alone, especially if they're minding their own business. Just cause they have a mask and a camera doesn't me go up to them and interrogate them and tell them to move from a PUBLIC SIDEWALK. Nice people, great music, thoughtful sermons, friendly vibe. I have been a member of this church for 40 years, and it continues to be a blessing in my life. The preaching is great each Sunday, and I am very appreciative of the wonderful friends I have made over the years. Our church would love to have new people come to check us out. You just might find a welcome home at Burlpres WORST Christmas sermon of my entire life! I have been going to this church since I was very little- I have grown up in this church- and this year was the first year for my newborn and my daughter to go together to the sermon.

Children’s Service had nothing for children- weird 3D glasses & stickers, along with the pastors daughter being the center of attention as ALL the other children involved in the nativity scene remained outside. I left after the pastor decided to rant about HIS daughter and her prestige riding skills... it was like watching pure narcissism. And there was a rant about how expensive & hard it is to live here... ummmmmmmm I don’t come to church to discuss Bay Area 1st world problems... it felt like this whole sermon was focused on ALL the wrong things. The petting zoo was nice... but how could that be the lesson for our children?? Seemed like a lot of it was just about getting money and seeming rich or something... very uncomfortable

I for one HAD to leave. I regret going and decided to go for a walk downtown as my daughter stayed with family

EVERY year- children have been the focus and brought in SO many new families. Children have sung songs, put on plays, and even read scripture- allowing for children watching to love it along with their parents. This year was dry, and only about the pastor... SO WEIRD

I will NOT be returning to this church and I highly suggest looking elsewhere for children’s sermons. This is NOTthe church I grew up in.

name: Burning Bush Missionary Baptist Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful services Nice name

name: C3 Church Manhattan - New York Campus
reviewSummary: I've been in the city for almost 6 years,  and 2 years ago I knew I needed a church community. My first Sunday visiting I was so welcomed and embraced, it was overwhelming! I knew I found my family and the missing piece to my life's puzzle. This is not a mega church where you feel like one in a thousand, but an intimate setting where you build strong, supportive, involved relationships. Thankful for the love, encouragement, and positive energy this group creates!💕 P.S. The worship is on FIRE!!!! 🔥🔥🔥 I walked into this church and felt like I was HOME. The people here are welcoming and kind, multi cultural and represent a diverse and flourishing selection of the body of Christ. In a city that sucks the life from me all week, I come here and find refreshment and encouragement with authentic, real Jesus-loving people. Connect groups are throughout the year during weeknights, and really allow for individuals to connect and grow with each other. The heart of this church is corporate encouragement and vulnerability with individual community growth through connect groups. I personally have not found a church so thoroughly grounded in the heart of Christ and so open and vulnerable about what they do and don’t believe, while also encouraging intelligent discourse between the members who may have slightly different views and or opinions. C3 Manhattan is one of the most welcoming churches I’ve been to. I don’t go every Sunday, but every time I go, there is always someone to greet me at the door and help me get connected. Their Connect group is one of the highlights of my week, and has given me a community in NYC. Pastor Melissa is warm and down to earth, as well as the other leaders of the church. Go visit! C3 Manhattan is amazing. After searching through other church communities in NYC I feel like I finally found my tribe. These people are a community of loving, diverse, honest, and inclusive individuals. The worship is great, the messages relatable and the leaders accessible. All are truly welcome. ❤️ I love this church;  the worship is God filled and the people are just so genuine, loving and their walk with God is so clear. The relationships built through connect groups are grounded in the individuals willingness to be open and vulnerable with each other in their pursuit of Jesus.

name: C3 Church Naples (Non-Denominational) - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
A great church To make home – – even if you’re just a seasonal attendee.

Jean is an excellent biblical pastor and preacher

If you come as a stranger, you won’t leave like one —  just make sure that you join for the food after service We visited multiple churches before coming to C3. None of them felt like "home" until we came here. You can truly come as you are, but don't expect to stay that way! Pastor Gene is very knowledgeable and will challenge you to grow in your faith and I love that! This is a true non-denominational church, which means everyone is welcome no matter your denomination as they keep the main thing the main thing and don't believe on dividing over non-Gospel issues. The staff and members are welcoming and super nice too! Beautiful and loving church. Come as you are, they make you feel at home no matter what. My sister it’s a member of this church, and I visited while on vacations in Naples. Great location, and facilities. They even have a designated parking for first time visitors, you guessed it right, that’s where I parked my rental. God is doing amazing things here at C3 Church! My husband and I started going to C3 four years ago and fell in love. It truly is a real church for real people. It doesn't matter where you are in your walk with God, you are always welcome to hear His message at C3. My husband and I absolutely love C3! Pastor Gene has taught us so much while we’ve been attending here. C3 has everything a church should. Fellowship, prayer, the breaking of bread, and phenomenal teaching. It’s hard to find teaching like this anywhere else. Our walks with Christ has deepened tremendously since being involved with C3

name: C3OC Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: For a long time, I chose to walk with a demeanor of discouragement as a result of years of "church hurt". I wanted to be in church, but I believed I wasn't good at being a part of a community. I found C3, and, while it hasn't been a smooth transition back into church community as I'm learning how to socialize again and learn what it truly means to be submitted and surrendered to the Lord, it has been one of the greatest blessings God has ever given me. The Spirit and His Word is alive and thriving in this family of believers. Gods Spirit is palpable and glorified in prayer, worship, teaching, encouragement, edification, fellowship, and the love everyone has for one another. C3 is a beautiful house built for the Lord and if you're like me and hesitant, hurt, or scared, I encourage you to seek the Lord, walk in faith, and trust that God has good things in store for you in life and at C3. There is healing with the Lord, your life has purpose, and God loves you so much. My husband and I had prayed so specifically for a church to call home and the Lord exceeded our expectations when He brought us to C3OC. From the incredible Pastors Joe & Christine Pringle, to the loving community, we were welcomed and poured into with loving arms & mentorship and we are forever changed for the best. This church is a declaration of God’s faithfulness, & goodness & if you’ve been searching to be healed, where you feel that you belong or to strengthen your faith with worship & great community, welcome home🤍 Church is at 10am every Sunday and we encourage you whole heartedly to come check it out! We were nervous about the prospect of searching for a church community in Orange County after we moved here. Amazingly, I was invited to C3 at a baby shower and we knew from the beginning we had found what we were looking for. We had been praying for strong friendships and sense of community that are prevalent at C3. Also, a strong theological commitment to the authority of scripture and worship that focuses on bringing glory to Jesus rather than catering to our Christian sensibilities was critical. C3 checked all those boxes and more and went above and beyond to nurture our family through my husband’s deployment. We love C3 and you can sit with us. This place truly feels like family – from the worship and the people to the pastors. I always leave each service feeling refreshed, and the powerful teachings inspire me throughout the week. They also have groups that meet during the week, so fellowship continues beyond just Sundays! Our kids love Sunday school too; they’re always excited to share what they’ve learned, which brings so much joy to our hearts as a family. Great to have a church that speaks biblical truth and stands firm on the word of God.. Talented worship team for a small and growing church.

name: C7 Church - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary:
Where the Spirit of the Lord is there is freedom!

I love this church. They follow the leading of Holy Spirit, are so encouraging and love with the love of Christ. If you go here, you will find healing of your spirit, soul, and body; you will encounter the presence and the love of God and will never be the same!

The leadership is amazing and genuinely care about you and want to see you grow. The church body is incredible and loves you no matter what, regardless of your past.

If you are looking for a church where you see God and want to see what following Him is supposed to look like, go here! I so appreciate the people and love that was shown to me. I began attending during a very difficult season in my life and was so blessed to be there.  After my first visit, I knew I would be coming back! The worship is some of the best I have ever experienced, and the teaching is Biblically solid and exciting. I love my new church home! The first time I visited C7, God told me I was going to love it here, and I can honestly say I have.
Today was an amazing day at church. God’s presence was there so heavy. Pastor Gary and his wife Mrs. Connie are very sensitive to Holy Spirit, so church isn’t dull because He’s there amongst a people who are hungry for God.
The people here at C7 are very welcoming and encouraging; it feels like a family here. The leadership/ Pastors aren’t unapproachable but friendly. They really care about growth and for the congregation to have a hunger for the Lord. This is a place where people here God’s voice and are allowed to share what God is speaking. People are encouraged to grow in the gifts of the Hoky Spirit as well. That’s something I was searching for and I found it here at C7. Recently, we were blessed to have Will Hart from Iris Ministries to speak at our church. It was such a blessing. I appreciate the diligence of our pastors in asking for Iris Ministries to come out.
Hope you get to come out and fellowship, learn and worship with us. Not since the early days at Anaheim Vineyard in the 80s and 90s have I been at a church (not conference) where Holy Spirit is given all the freedom He enjoys to move, heal, set free and encourage the Body.  A true family environment filled with love and acceptance. The people are amazing!

Each Sunday is a unique experience of worship and enjoying how God moves by His Spirit.  So fun to watch the gifts released! I have found 'home' again.
Deborah Stock I love my church home at C7! Everybody you meet is always smiling and friendly. I also love the intimate worship time and wonderful messages we get from our Pastor Gary! If you are looking for a spirit filled house of God then this is for you!

name: Cactus Christian Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a place to worship God, to learn,to become a part of the body of God,
To fellowship with like minded
People, to love & be loved,
To grow closer to the Lord,
To serve God, Please come & check it out , I love Cactus Christian Fellowship !!!
& I believe that you will too !!
Hope to see you there & give you a Hug ! 🥰❤️❤️❤️🙌🫶🙏😍😍 Very well secured church on a vast property, something about this place just says religious harmony. Friendly people, solid preaching. I inquired about getting a ride & someone came & got me. The only downside is their restrooms are in a separate building and toilets are obviously meant to be used by children. - ADDED NOTE: I found out that the handicap toilet is adult size plus the VERY NEXT WEEK they had built a handicap toilet a few steps from the sanctuary. Kudos! I love this church more than I love any church I have visited. Cactus Christian Fellowship has some of the friendliest people that I have ever met. Would definitely recommend going at least once, if not every Sunday! CCF is such a warm and loving family of God's children who always welcome you with open arms! I Love Pastor Bud's biblical teaching of the Bible and how well her orchatrates and delivers each amazing sermon!!!

name: California Central Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Good afternoon.  I am from Ukraine, I want to move to the USA under the U4U program, could you help me.  Thank you. One of the only few churches in the area that still preaches the true Gospel! I love this church, very welcoming The best! Where the truth is preached.

name: California Heights United Methodist Childrens Center - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: We have sent two kids here for full time pre school starting at age 2 and both made wonderful friends and thrived in their development.  They've learned to count, write their name and many sounds of letters after a few years! They also spend time doing art projects and playing inside and outside every day.  The teachers and staff are wonderful, good listeners and so sweet to the kids! Takes so much patience, bless them all! Our family and neighbors who have kids here love this place. They have the most caring teachers and my son is thriving. I couldn’t be more happy with how they had handled COVID-19 times and events around the area and world. Their number one priority are our kids and we are lucky to have them! Our daughter absolutely love Cal Heights children center. She was there from 11/20 until recently when we moved from the area. We were so sad to leave the kind teachers and community there. Continue to recommend to others I know and grateful for the time we had there Our daughter attends preschool here and we can’t say enough positive things about April, the program director of 25 years, and her entire team! The staff is well-prepared and professional, following a child-centered curriculum. Our daughter has thrived here! this place made me cry :3 i will go back again (>.

name: California Heights United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I went, I liked. Great school

name: California Los Angeles Mission Office - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: My good friend Rachel J. served here as a missionary. She loved it!! I served this blessed mission 83-85. They treated me with great hospitality.

name: Calvary - Redondo Beach Campus
Calvary Ahwatukee - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited today at the invitation of a Brother in Christ(Eric) and the sermon today was excellent and a thorough exegesis on Romans 11 and the dreaded “Replacement Theology” most mainline Churches assert.

Warm genuine believers everywhere and greeted my wife and I warmly, anyone in the area searching for the full council of God it is taught here.

Not a “Woke” seeker friendly congregation thankfully!!

name: Calvary Alameda - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:
This was my church a long time ago when I was a believer and lived in The Bay Area. I am happy to see that Nate and Geena are the Lead Pastors. I remember them when they were young and in the youth ministry about 20 years ago. I am happy to see that they are leading the church. I am also glad to see Ezra and Gwen are also still there, with him as Worship minister as well. Wow! Time has really flown by very fast. And to see that they even have their own familys is awesome! Best of wishes for them. This is more than a church, Jesus is in this place. The people are like family to me. I came from a mega church in Ohio and I thought I knew what a Holy Spirit led church looked like but God is good. He led me here and it doesn't look like much on the outside but there's so much to be had on the inside, you just have to have courage that God will show up and He will! If you are looking for a Christ centered,  bible preaching church, this is a great place to visit. It has contemporary music and an amazing pastor who is Spirit lead. Only go if you are ready to worship.
Visiting from Maryland. Beautiful place to worship and pray if you are in the island. Come and be connected with God. Feel the power of worship and prayer and be blessed! A great place to experience fellowship, family, healing of heart and mind, the word of God, and a loving relationship with Jesus!

name: Calvary Apostolic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: This church is the real thing and truly anointed messages. If  the people of LA only knew where  heaven is opening up I know they would be pouring into Calvary Apostolic Church. Best place to establish church family and receive full truth. May Jesus bless this church and give an increase in His mighty name. This is a hidden jewel. The best church I have been to in years. Pastor Rudy and his wife are amazing! God has blessed this church Spirit of God Church for the city of Anaheim, This is a people in Him with His witness,This is what matters, Very Much recommend this church ! If you want to feel the power of the Holy Ghost, this is the place to be.

He speaks from the heart and I  really understood what the meaning was. Im just wondering how long this church has been running as not a lot of people were there? name: Calvary Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
My recent visit to Salt Lake City, Utah, for the Wits Travel Summit was not just a professional trip; it was also a deeply spiritual journey for me. As a woman on a mission to get closer to God, attending church services was a must. I specifically searched for a church where I could find a community that looked like me, and that's how I discovered Calvary Baptist Church.

Walking into Calvary Baptist Church, I felt an immediate sense of belonging. The praise and worship team's performance was exceptional, and the pastor's sermon felt like it was speaking directly to me. My biggest concern was feeling welcomed, and the warm reception I received from the congregation melted away my anxiety.

If you're visiting the area and looking for a church home where you can worship and feel accepted, I can't recommend Calvary Baptist Church enough. My experience there was not only spiritually fulfilling but also a testament to the welcoming community it offers. Praise God! Most AMAZING HOLY GODLY CHRIST FEELING & LOVE, COMFORTABILITY ON EARTH. GREAT 4 everybody ALL ages,shapes,race & size. Attended SUPER Bowl watch there. So many people, good food 🍲, drinks,deserts,very good SAFETY  had a door 🚪 left open during watch party to air out so knowone catches covid. Very good, sweet,loving, caring, welcoming environment!!! I am trying to find a church home and am new to SLC.  I grew up in Tennessee and I’m Baptist and I wanted a church that felt like home.  I visited Calvary with an open heart.  The music was amazing, the sermon was amazing.  When I got in my car, I called my mother bawling. Not one person said hello or even smiled at me.  Not one smile.  I smiled and was met with hard faces.  The sermon was about having friends that bring you closer to God and that was my mission.  I left feeling sad, alone, isolated, and unaccepted. If you want politics while at Church this church is for you! Especially if your views are on the left.  Not for me! Im here for the word not your political views If you're in the state of Utah and looking for a church to worship let refer you to my newly found church family Pastor Moses and Calvary Baptist Church ⛪ 🙏🏾! Great place to receive great teaching and encouraging word. My 1st experience has phenomenal and looking forward to visiting again. God bless Calvary Baptist 🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾

name: Calvary Baptist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to worship God and learn. The community is friendly, our kids love meeting new friends here, and my wife and I love the strong relationships we have built here. Seems like each week we meet someone new. We especially like the music and teaching. The band clearly has an excitement for music, and the pastors are very knowledgable and giving of their time. I have grown in understanding of the true grace of God at CBCHB.  Our family is blessed by what we have learned through the teaching, fellowship and various ministries here.  In particular, we are delighted that our teenage children are engaged as a family in the faith community through the youth ministry. The teaching is biblical and points to Christ. The church is engaged in worship and singing. And the kids program was great. CBCHB is our second home! Our family has been attending Calvary Baptist of HB for the last twenty-one years. The atmosphere is very friendly, welcoming, loving and sincere. CBCHB offers a variety of ministries for the whole family. I personally am involved in Women's Ministry and Life Group with my husband.  Most importantly, sound doctrine is being taught here. It's also been a true blessing to see our three children come to know the Lord as their personal Savior, and not just their parent's faith. God Bless. I went to this church for my nephew's wedding. What a nice place for a wedding. It seemed like a friendly little church and it was a good wedding ceremony. My nephew and his blushing bride looked mighty happy. Looks like a great place for a wedding!!!

name: Calvary Baptist Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary:
This has been my home charge for quite some time! The preaching is dead on and very thorough and educated in scripture. They have a lot of activities. I’m not currently involved in a lot, but they are available. If I could change only one thing, I would change the singing and song service. Jay is very Set in his ways. We rarely if never sing any hymns. We never have any specials. We stand a great deal. The things he says seems so rehearsed and not natural. He seems to be reading everything. We have Same front leaders and you cannot really hear their parts. It is an excellent church and I would highly Recommend this church for its Bible, preaching, and atmosphere Calvary Baptist Church Covington ky is a Bible teaching church. They offer Sunday school at 9:15 and a church servchurch. 8:30 & 10:30.
Mondays they offer a drop in sewing group. Wednesday nights or Thursday mornings Precepts bible studies are offered. Their are a few ladies nights throughout the year . I also enjoy belonging to a book club through the chuch. One of the most warmest friendliest churches in Kentucky, love love loved it!!! We have been attending Calvary Baptist Church for 19 years. We love the church and the people. The pastor preaches from the Bible. They offer a lot of Sunday morning bible studies including classes for teens and kids. A really nice family church. In its day this church was beautiful

name: Calvary Baptist Church - McAllen Campus
reviewSummary:
I came at 9:15 to participate in a classic service and all I got was a bunch of contemporary songs that the normal lay person can’t possibly sing. I know several people to go there and they’re just a blessing to me I'm new to Calvary. I've only gone 3 times, it's awesome for both English and Spanish speakers, I also visited the youth and it's very welcoming and intriguing. Its open range of activities before and after the youth services are interactive and fun. I'll be coming again. Also, if anyone wants to go, you are welcome, no matter what state you might be in. Don’t go. This is a horrible church and possibly one of the worst ones I’ve ever been to. Sadly I grew up at this fake church and it was because of what this church teaches and doesn't teach that I was led to believe that God does not speak to people personally anymore and all we have is the Bible. This church is doing very bad things by literally robbing people of their relationship with God, by insisting that he only speaks through reading the Bible and ignoring any way to make this personal. Then they go around and insist that what matters is not mere intellectual knowledge of God. So they will tell you it's more than just intellectual knowledge, but then when you ask how to make it personal they can't help you because they're text only believers and don’t want to say that God speaks outside the Bible. They will just point you to Bible study, saying that that is the "primary way that God speaks to us." That is either a copout answer that basically means "I don't know" or they're saying all you have is the Bible because the days of visions, dreams, impressions, promptings, or other forms of divine guidance are over. (There is no reason for this belief. The closing of the canon or ending of the prophetic office has nothing to do with ending of divine guidance.) Or in the slight chance that it’s recognized that God speaks outside of reading the Bible, they will never fail to say that scripture is first priority and nothing can contradict it, as if that’s their way of downplaying any personal experience or justifying themselves for ignoring their own personal walk with God.

It's because of this church's syncretism with postmodern skepticism that I missed years of God's guidance and am still missing it, and if they don't teach how to connect with God personally, I'm gathering that this is the norm. They completely ignore spiritual warfare and miracles. How many people were left suffering when they asked for prayers for healing and this church thinks that not even one out of the thousand members has a gift of healing? Then the prayers are the most pathetic things I have ever heard. They try to comfort you by just asking if you have "talked to God about it" and then when you say yes, the response is to just trust in Him. But the prayer was nothing but contradicting themselves because they're just asking God to do what He already is going to do, if that is what He wants. Believers share in the Ascension and are seated as a royal priesthood in the heavenly realms and have the keys of the kingdom to bind and loose. Our prayers should not be weak, powerless requests to ask God to do what He already is going to do. What even is that? What were they trying to accomplish by saying that? If they think it will happen regardless of prayer because God wants it to happen, why are they asking him to do it? If they think God won’t do it even if they pray, why add that preface and ask Him to do it?

It’s worth mentioning as a side note that this church also has bad attitudes and views on mental health and dating and relationships, and it’s deeply sexist. It may take some time to really see it, but especially in how certain topics are discussed it’s apparent. Anytime dating/relationships is discussed, men are portrayed as heartless pigs while women are these fragile creatures that God cares so much about. That’s rape culture. Men are blamed for pretty much everything really. Porn, divorce, and any time a marriage problem happens it’s the man’s fault because women are the smarter and empathetic and spiritual ones. But I’m sure that attitude affects them for the worse too

Maybe they keep quiet about these spiritual issues to avoid getting labeled with the extensive errors of charismatic churches, but leaving people suffering or stealing their personal connection with God is not the solution. Yes, this church is friendly, diverse, and has developed programs for children, but you will not grow at this church, either personally with God or in your understanding of doctrine. This place is nothing but a sham. Attended a memorial service here.  Enjoyed a great conversation the minister. Felt very relaxing and accepted.  Touch my heart with the service and the conversation we had. Thank you for your grace and understanding. Peace be with you.

name: Calvary Baptist Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: I can’t thank Calvary enough for the love, support and strength they have shown my family and I in our time of need. We live out of state and just had my brothers service here, as were native to the area and consider it home. The churches kindness has been a blessing in such a hard time. Pam and Edwina have been so sweet. Pastor Mosset is truly filled with the spirit of our Lord and he spoke right to us during our service. I know it was God speaking because I was in deep sorrow and he knew just what to say. I also believe pastor may have gotten through to a non believer family member who showed up 🙏. It’s truly a miracle. Thank you so much, again. I've joined this church almost four years ago and I love it my pastor is great and the first lady is awesome and everyone is nice and helpful great service This is a historic house of worship in the city of Santa Monica.  At 102 years old, the spirit of the Lord of is new every time I attend.   Sundays, snacks are provided before service, so your stomach is satisfied you can focus on the relevant word of the day.  The Gospel choir is small but mighty and will have you clapping and singing along.  Reverend Mack Mossett and his wife, the first lady, Edwina Mossett are forward-thinking, spiritual leaders.  They are shining stars.  Their entire family is a gem of service to God. Our congregation is lucky to have them.  Join us online or in person for a spiritually nourishing experience at 10:30am Sundays. I grew up in Calvary Baptist Church. And was amazed to see so many of my family and friends still attending. The service today was truly spirit filled. Come to visit and worship with this friendly congregation and let your spirit by lifted. Met young man on beach working there bubbleing over talking about  the my GOD and your Jesus he was ambassador for city I'm coming to the church I thank God for that young man spirit

name: Calvary Baptist Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family visited this church tonight. We were in town just for the night, but if we lived in the area we would attend every time the doors are open. We were welcomed lovingly and there was something for the whole family. Two things that really stick out are the biblical preach and their love for missions. A friend snd I came on Sunday for the first time.  The visiting Pastor was  great with a very inspiring message.What was disheartening was  allowing a child to cry and whine  for the whole service in the back of the sanctuary..  IT was VERY disruptive and I was embarrassed for the church for  this to be happening for a visitng Pastor.to have to navigate.  It had to be difficult for him to consentrate .Fortunately he had a loud voice but the almost constant whining from this baby was beyond unacceptable and really prevented most people, I woukd think, from completely enjoying his sermon.  WHY didn't someone take these disrespectful parents and baby to the " CRYING ROOM" as soon as it was apparent that they were going to stay amongst us .  Want to come next Sunday but can't do another repeat ..too stressful Finally found a place to call my home church. Love the teachings and that they make God's Word the priority over politics. Super friendly and welcoming congregation and Pastor and staff. Definitely recommend to anyone searching for the truth about God and His love and mercy and grace. Great young pastor and various ministries. And, oh, the grounds are just beautiful.
Would make it my home church if lived here. Small, conservative bible teaching church! However, beware as an AA you may not feel welcomed. Message included many pics of Caucasian angels and also a Caucasian Jesus. Not sure how friendly the pastor may or may not be. He never greeted us even tho there were only a few people in attendance. There were a two members who did say hello.

name: Calvary Baptist Church NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
The security guard is going to have to take a vacation after all this. 😅🙏🏻 Why did they have to call the police just because some people were filming such a beautiful church from the sidewalk? Wow! 😳

In the end, a reaction like this can seriously damage the image of the place, because people who see the video might wonder, "Where is the love and kindness one expects to find in a church?"

Everything would have been completely different with a smile, a greeting, and a little bit of courtesy. They could even have taken the opportunity to say, "Welcome! God bless you." 🙏🏻❤️

A good attitude speaks louder than words. Courtesy, respect, and love make all the difference. 🙏🏻 As a foreigner, I’ve been so well received and conducted. They not just said hi, but embraced me as a brother.
If you look for solitude relief, learning opportunities in NYC, I truly recommend them. If you’re looking to actually grow with Jesus…. Truly grow…, then this is the church for you.

There is biblical truth, and, support! They don’t leave their congregation stranded, and nor do they ever lead them astray.
This is a church (just as all should be).. where, they will invest in you spiritually, care for your walk, care for your health, care for you..period. This is a church where you can gain valuable relationships that, God willing, you will keep for a very very long time.
Also: the young adults group is absolutely fantastic! (Ages all over the map, you won’t feel left out, or too old even if you’re in your thirties and don’t think you fit the bracket, don’t worry, you totally do!, and there’s plenty of people here of all ages!). There’s also a college students group, specifically for those in school. All their groups are so helpful and fantastic; all their bible studies, life groups, support and prayer groups, both women’s and men’s groups, etc. Plus, I really love that this church continues to evolve and grow more and more! The worship team and song selection is diverse, and so is their overall congregation.

Anyways… I could go on and on about this church..and its congregants. This isn’t just a setting or a, once weekly thing… this, is a FAMILY. An absolute and undeniable family.
We ARE family in the body of Christ, and this church absolutely embodies that truth.
I love this church with all my absolute heart and have so much to say about them and thanks to give…. It’s immeasurable and beyond words.. and far beyond what I could accurately convey through a simple google review.

Please attend Calvary Baptist,
and more so than that, please, invest in your spiritual growth, and invest in connection with the congregants.
Don’t just attend Calvary, become family.

Thank you Jesus for Calvary Baptist and how you have more than blessed me with every teaching, opportunity, connection, and profound love received since my initial discovery of this church.
Please continue to touch, use, and protect this church and all its congregants and leaders. And Lord, please continue to stretch the number of congregants and impact that this church desires to make for the glory and knowledge of your holy and precious name.
Thank you Jesus, my Lord; in your name, with all my heart,
I pray.

Amen. I just went for the first time. For me, these are the earmarks of what I would consider a church that I want to attend.

The pastor preaches straight from the word and exposits it with historical context. Near the end of the sermon he presents the gospel and extends an invitation to non-believers (who are of course welcome to attend). After this, the bread and wine is administered to the congregation and more prayers are given.

The commitment to biblical preaching and genuine community is what will likely keep me going to this church. Wonderful place to worship Jesus and meet friendly Christian people.  Three services on Sunday.  Solid bible based  church with various groups meeting together to support each other, and a caring leadership.  Various outreach ministries.  Very accessible by various subway stations; a couple blocks away from central park.  And surrounded by many restaurants and shopping.

name: Calvary Baptist Church of Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
An interesting old set of buildings from the 1940's. There are creeky stairs and storage cupboards and rooms down obscure passages containing upright pianos, old audio tech and a nursery ready for the 1980's. No parking lot to speak of but if you need a church filming location, they will consider anything that's not blasphemous. A loyal group still meets there on Sundays and midweek. A great place for time travel! It's mostly original everything from galvanized pipes to ADA-what's that? Kitchen is large 1950's style. Bathrooms are small. Attic has character. Services on Sunday mornings begin at 10:45 a.m. and Sunday evenings services at 6:30 p.m. If you are not experiencing growth in your relationship with God, if you have never heard the Gospel, or if you seek greater understanding of the Word or are weary of messages that merely validate you or dispense a watered down gospel, then please visit Calvary Baptist Church of Burbank.

Update

I have now been attending CBC for a few months.

This is a small church but one where the Word is taught without the "feel good" distractions that veer people from understanding that we are indeed saved by grace.

Pastor Anthony is highly astute and highly educated pastor who is imbued with the rare ability to explain scripture and cross-reference New Testament verses with the original or related verses found in the Old Testament.

I believe any person attending CBC will greatly benefit from studying the Word as taught by Pastor Anthony. Personally, I have experienced real growth and understanding of what the Gospel really means to my life and why it is important to share the gift of salvation to those who are perishing. I also finally understand why genuine repentance is necessary.

Original Review

This was my first visit. I chose to visit because internet reviews mention the the pastor teaches scripture indepth.

The guest who spoke conducted a wonderful and immensely insightful study of Psalms 93.

This is a small church but I found today's visit enlightening and hopefully will help guide me in my walk. Rich, solid and understandable expository bible teaching every week. Caring Pastor Anthony and lovely wife, Jenny lead this congregation steadily into maturity through God’s powerful word.

People who come to this church are looking for a deeper relationship with God by understanding his word and be used in the everyday setting and not only on Sunday.

This church is not for the faint of heart. You will find explanations to your bible questions. After looking into many Biblically sound churches in the Los Angeles and Burbank area, my family and I stumbled upon Calvary Baptist of Burbank one Sunday. We immediately fell in love with the small yet diverse community of caring Christians. Pastor Anthony's expositional preaching stood out as gospel-centered, circumspect in putting the pieces of Scripture in light of Biblical context, insightful, and genuine. We now call this church our home and could not wish for a better family of Christian believers. If you are curious about Christianity and are seeking to know the truth about what the Bible teaches in its historical and original context, I can guarantee that attending the morning service will enlighten you and you will walk away more informed. If you are a Christian who is serious about your faith and wish to grow by delving deeper into the Word God, this church is definitely for you. You will find like-minded believers who would love to walk along side of you and encourage you in your spiritual walk. I love this church.  The pastor is very knowledgeable. He doesn't interpret his own opinion like most preachers. He will give you word for word what the Bible actually says. He uses the best interpretation from the original transcripts. He makes sure you thoroughly  understand what he speaks about.  His wife has this amazing voice when she sings. I  love the songs they sing. A lot I never heard of,but easy to remember. This Church is not a feel good preaching. It is real and its what this world really needs. The people are very kind there. Right now its tough to get too close.  We sit in every other pew, come in with mask. We get our temperature when walking in. Sanitizer station right at the door. They are very careful.  If you can't make it, they stream live. Here is an update. Been going here since April 2020.  The restrictions have lightened up now. More pews opened up.I decided to join. I  noticed someone mentioned about the structure of the building.  Not sure what that has to do with anything.  If someone wants to go to a church based on what it looks like, or how old,or anything that has nothing to do with assembly together to be fed,worship, and fellowship, you are going for the wrong reasons.

name: Calvary Bible Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a solid, Bible-believing church that has sound doctrine and congregants who are practicing their faith in the Lord Jesus. The most prominent portion of the Sunday worship services is the strong preaching (mostly expository). The leadership (pastors and elders) are committed to faithfully teaching God's word and shepherding the members of the church.

Currently, this church is medium-sized (around 300 attendees), so it can be challenging to get to know people. While some people are welcoming, it seems that others tend to keep to themselves or the people they're comfortable with. To be clear, I'm not saying that there are clear factions within the church. One can definitely build Christ-centered relationships with many people if he takes the initiative to do so.

While I have some minor disagreements on certain elements of church doctrine and practices, I believe that this church is genuinely God-fearing, Christ-exalting, and Spirit-filled. I became a member of this church in January 2024, and I'm thankful to be part of a body of believers that seeks to worship and glorify God. I have been coming to CBC for about a year and a half now. I absolutely love CBC! This is a Bible preaching & Bible Believing Church. I enjoy how friendly and inviting everyone is. CBC has various fellowship groups for everyone at every stage of life. Surely, would recommend. I'm very impressed. This is what church should be. The 9am service is 1.5 hours long. It's structured like most services that I'm used to: Singing, announcements, message, and closing song. You all know churches have a "feel" to them. I was very comfortable here. Most importantly the preaching was sound biblical teaching. It wasn't just an encouraging Joel Osteen type of message. The pastor really explained the passage and how we can relate this to our daily life. I've been visiting churches for a while trying to find the right church. It's Monday morning and I'm still moved by the message. It definitely spoke to me. I'm happy to go back next week for my second visit. Grateful for this body of believers who worship in spirit and truth. The leaders & pastors teach the word of God in this confused and darkened culture. Praise God for guiding me to this church! CBC is a solid bible teaching church with many sunday school classes, children & youth ministries and biblestudies/small groups that encourage fellowship and unity within the church! I've been here for the past 12 years and couldn't imagine being anywhere else on a Sunday!
If your looking for a consistent bible teaching church where the gospel is preached weekly, CBC should be your home! Come visit us!

name: Calvary Chapel Beaumont - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: For anyone wanting to learn about Jesus this is a great place to start. Pastor Henry delivers the word verse by verse and delivers a great and powerful sermon all biblically based not opinionated straight from the book with love. If you don't believe me go see for yourself. We came here for the Wednesday 630 service i am familiar with calvary chapel, i have been listening to there radio broadcast since pastor chuck, and i continue listening with pastor laurie, , i heard a sermon with pastor henry and it was very good, we decided to come check out the church, pastor henry didnt speak but we got a great message with i believe a guest speaker playing a Shepard who walked us thru the birth and the day our lord sacrificed himself for our sins , he was excellent! The church was silent he had us feeling like we were in Jerusalem and.Bethlehem 5 star rating alone! We well be back for another Wednesday service it fits our work schedules, cant wait to hear more , I recommend Calvary Chapel Beaumont to anyone who is in need of a home based Church come as you are All is welcome. Ever since this church was started in Beaumont, I'd  drive by on Sunday's and saw the parking lot very full. I thought "this must be a good church." Years later I attended a service, and found that this church is 98% of what I had been looking for in a church. The people are friendly but not overly. The Worship part is just right. It isn't so long you don't enjoy participating. The Pastor is pretty good. He keeps himself with you and not above or better than you. His sermons are put in terms you can understand. He takes you verse by verse through the Bible and breaks it down to how it pertains to us in today's world. I'm  glad I went. New to the church (4 weeks) & my husband & I are praying about making CCB our new home church after just moving into Beaumont & we are loving the idea of it being our home church. We had the bar super high after moving 2 hours away from our home church where my husband attended for over 12 years & I attended over 6 years. Pastor Henry shares the word directly from the Bible & teaches it without bending the truth. That’s the most important part to us. He also encourages the congregation to bring your Bible, read & study the Bible for themselves, or request a free Bible from the church, & not to take what he’s saying blindly. We appreciate that he explains the word and its realistic application. He lays out main points of the sermon & points out main topics for note takers. His sermons are clear, organized, & flow well. It’s a plus that he has a great sense of humor & makes us laugh. He definitely has all the components of a great pastor. The church has an abundance of ways to stay connected to God everyday of the week with opportunities to fellowship with others & study the Bible. Everyone has been welcoming & friendly. I can’t say enough good things about pastor Henry and CCB church. My husband & I are intending to find a small group and get connected in more ways. I encourage anyone looking for a place to learn, worship, and grow to visit CCB.

name: Calvary Chapel BendiZion - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: We go to this church every sunday in the annex one. The Owner needs to fix the Airconditioning it's always warm in there whenever we have our service and it's uncomfortable for all of us. The restroom still stink. If you're collecting rent we expect the Owner to fix the problems.  That been going in for a long time now. Nice place. Pastor is genuinely caring for the sheep in his charge. Good folks there. I liked it very much. They pray up a storm on Fridays. My family and I enjoy hearing God's words every Sunday, this church is great everyone is welcomed with love. Awesome place to fellowship worship and hear the word of God!

name: Calvary Chapel Bible College, Costa Mesa - Newport Beach Campus
Calvary Chapel Bible College, Costa Mesa - Santa Ana Campus
Calvary Chapel Bible Fellowship - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Clark’s teaching is filled with life experiences and stories that reflect real life. It is a simple, yet in-depth application for the listener. While also learning the true meaning behind the words we are given a deeper, richer  understanding of our walk with the Lord, our families, and the world around us. Pastor Clark is an amazing Pastor!
He Teaches Us What Greek& Hebrew Words is and what they mean, He is Spirit Led!
He Talks Straight From The Bible, if You Need Prayer He Wants To Pray For You!
He Is Very Kind And Will Help You If You Ask!

Every Time I Get To Church And At Church They Play Phil Wickham for Background Music so it makes Ready for Church Service! I Love The Worship The Worship Team Does, I Learn New Songs Every Wednesday and Sunday Which I Love!
Very Kind People I Have Made A Lot of Friends from Here! 🦁🫁🙌🏾🕊😇✝️
This Church Feels Like Home!
JESUS Blessed Me With This Amazing Family Of Believers! May GOD Bless This Church! Thank you Pastor Clark for your dedication, preparation, and heart for teaching the Bible. It does not go unnoticed, and I am very grateful. I gain so much every week, and it has truly helped deepen my understanding and walk with the Lord. This has been our home church for 11 wonderful years. We are truy blessed to hear n learn from Pastor Clarks teachings every week. If you are in search of learning more about Gods word and a have a deeper  relationship with our Lord n Savior come join us to  have "the socks blessed right off your stinky little feet!" Oh and Pastor Clark has a wonderful sense of humor also, come visit us soon. I've been attending Calvary Bible Fellowship going on 10 years now.  Pastor Clark Van Wick and his wife Sally who is the Director of the Women's Ministry both love the Lord, as do all the other pastors and ministry leaders. CCBF teaches the full gospel from Genesis to Revelation, with ministry groups for all ages. I recommend visiting their website to see all they offer and come out and be blessed!

name: Calvary Chapel Boca Raton - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
I felt really welcomed, im just starting my process to come back to God. This church has been really good for me. IG: TRAVELWITHARCHER86

It's been quite some time since I last attended church, and my heart has felt some form of guilt. I've struggled with my understanding of God and have consistently, for years, desired to discover the clarity and a sense of certainty within my understanding and belief of God. I still am in the same head space. However, thanks to a wonderful friend who invited me to church tonight, I feel a sense of peace. The message from the young pastor who led the service was impeccable and RELATABLE. The message and story tonight (6/7/2025 Saturday) was about David and Nabal. I was captivated and fully invested from start to finish.

I want to directly give my thanks to the pastor and the PHENOMENAL band who touched my heart and re-invigorated my desire to search for my understanding and love for God.

Thank you!

-Joshua-
U.S. Coast Guard Veteran I truly love this church and I’m grateful to be a part of it. However, I feel the childcare situation needs more attention. Today during service there were 16 children placed in one room, ranging in age from 2 to 4 years old. While that may seem manageable to some, I personally felt that the age gap is far too wide and the ratio of children to caregivers is concerning. Younger toddlers have very different needs and abilities compared to older preschoolers, and it’s important for their safety, development, and overall experience that this be addressed.

Edit: today they moved my children to a different classroom without being told or informed of the change. The children’s ministry is a mess and for that reason I am leaving Calvary. I really feel  at home here. Truly a Bible centered church. The service was great and would love to be here full time. Unfortunately,  the Sunday school for the kids is very unreasonable and difficult to deal with. If you have young kids you might want to find another Sunday church home. If no kids or teenagers then a great church! Just not little ones.

name: Calvary Chapel Brentwood - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Rob Taylor and the Calvary Chapel Brentwood family has had such a positive impact on my life, that I don't even know where to begin to share how much love I have for them. Pastor Rob and his wife Lou have always been there for me, they are welcoming, loving, honest and genuinely care.
My life has become so much fuller and richer from Pastor Rob.....everyday I give thanks for his presence and Calvary  Chapel Brentwood in my life. I have witnessed first hand the power of Pastor Rob's belief and how his prayer and words and teachings help. Forever they will be my family, friends and teachers...... We are new to Tennessee and looking for a church to call home. We visited here this past Sunday and we were not even acknowledged the whole time we were there. It felt cold and awkward especially when it had to be obvious we were new. There was only about 50 people at the service. We won't be back. I went to the original Costa mesa calvary chapel all through high school in Costa Mesa and this was a far cry from Chuck Smith's beautiful vision of warmth and acceptance for Calvary chapel Great family atmosphere. Expository teaching of God's Word. Love the new church property and plans for the future. May our Lord continue to guide and provide according to His perfect will. Today was my first visit and I could not be more thrilled. I walked in by myself but I feel like I walked out with a host of new friends. Very welcoming and filled with the truth of the Word of God. I will be visiting again!
Leslie Overton Great teaching, worship and fellowship. Super blessed during our visit.

name: Calvary Chapel Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: I have been going to this Church since May of 2023. The congregation here are some very lovely and welcoming people. I love that there are many kinds of different people here and it's not one ethnicity more than another. I also really enjoy the way Pastor Tim delivers scripture. Granted, he reads right out of the bible but he takes the time to stop and breaks things down so that it is easier to understand.   Since the Bible was written so many years ago it's very easy to misinterpret things or perceive them in a different way. Pastor Tim is really good at getting the point across and Giving examples as to how these stories do pertain to this day and age. I grew up in church but I never knew what it meant to have a church family until Calvary Chapel Burbank. The warmth and love felt here is genuine. The teaching of the word is verse by verse- solid and grounded in the Bible and not cultural opinions. When my Dad battle an illness, and eventually passed, my family and I felt the love and support from this body. It was a hard time, made lighter by the love of Christ poured out through CCB. The church has a strong kids, youth, and young adult program. Men’s and Women’s Bible studies, as well as retreats, to encourage fellowship. If you’re hungry for Jesus and for godly fellowship- come! Worship and the word. Pure and simple. I cannot recommend Calvary Chapel Burbank enough. I started attending the church 19 years ago and from the moment I walked in I felt so welcomed. I have grown so much under the leadership, teaching and worship. They supported me as I stepped out to do missions 17 years ago and were such a comfort for my family and I when my Dad passed in 2019. I can’t imagine living my life without this church who has indeed become my family. If anyone is unsure of church or has been hurt by religion in the past, I highly encourage you to join us. Don’t let the faults of man keep you from knowing Jesus for yourself. CCB is a safe place where all are welcome, the Bible is preached  and Jesus alone is glorified. I’ve been a member of Calvary Chapel since 2008 and I thank God for this church. Pastor Tim teaches God’s Word simply and with great knowledge.  I see the growth happening in me and in the church body. I recommend you come see for yourself how the Holy Spirit is present and working in this church. I love the pastor at this church. He really delves deep into the Bible. If you want to learn about what God teaches us in the Bible, this is the right place to go. He is well-versed in the scriptures. The fellowship here is also really nice, people are very friendly and welcoming. They also have a great kids program

reviewSummary: Great church that preaches the word of God how it is written, the whole Gospel is taught. They have a children’s ministry for the kids and a youth ministry and men’s and women’s ministries as well, along with a very personable and loving Pastor. It is a nondenominational church,  very loving congregation,  I highly recommend this church. After work I attended the BS. I am learning and still love to learn more. I like the style of the pastor teaching and there is NO pressure.

name: Calvary Chapel Chico - Chico Campus
reviewSummary: Hello. Calvary Chapel in Chico is very Bible centered and Family Oriented. Pastor Samuel Allen and his Staff run a Bible following Church centered around God’s Holy Word; which is great! It’s a big Church with an awesome child care up to and including High School. Very clean and everyone is welcome. You change according to how God has designed us. My family and I visited this church. It was welcoming and I truly enjoyed the message that was preached that Sunday. I like the simple worship nothing fancy or flashy just praising the Lord. I have so much gratitude towards all of the servants at this church. They preach scripture the right way and the gospel of Jesus Christ. One of if not the best Church in chico! Pastor Sam is a righteous guy! Every one who goes there is so nice! Come as you are, there is no dress code. The Bible is taught chapter by chapter and verse by verse. Everything is Thoroughly explained! We absolutely love it! Childcare is provided at the 11:00 service! Great men and women watching your kids it is so nice! Our kids love it! May God richly bless Anyone who reads this message. He loves you! This church used to be a movie theater. It has a warm, friendly environment. They offer a cafe, a bookstore, and clean and spacious restrooms. They offer several services each week, which is quite convenient. You can connect online to explore the spiritual resources offered.
