name: Calvary Chapel Open Door - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church with amazing people who are always willing to help you whenever they are able.  From Pastor Marks teaching to all the other pastors and bible studies going on, there is something there for everyone. New people are welcomed with open arms at the church.  Nadine has helped my family out many times with whatever we need. Being a big family it is not always easy but she has made it so much easier on our family.  I would recommend this church to anyone. My kids have been going here now for over a year now and at first I didn't know what to think because we where coming from a pre school that was really good . So it seemed at first that I was trying to find something wrong all the time because I was still use to the last school. But with time my kids became family. We are good friends with the teachers, they know our kids good . My daughter knows bible  verses now . My kids are always being thought the word of God with there school work . You don't need fancy places  or fancy buildings to look like it's a good school . All we need is for teachers to love your children and teach them and protect them at school , so place does that for our kids . Thank you to Ms Christina , Ms Elda , Ms Fran , Ms Rose , Ms Sheila and to all the other teachers . Great job ladies ! Words can't describe the gratitude that I have for Calvary Chapel Anaheim. It is a wonderful church and family. Pastor Mark and all the Pastors at Calvary Chapel Anaheim are awesome men of God. They preach the word of God. Also Nadine is a wonderful woman who has helped my family in so many ways. For over 4 years, I attended the two main large Christian churches in orange county at separate times,...... including their bible studies during the week day. I did get some spiritual awakening, but I never felt spiritually fed in the way that I wanted. It seemed like each six months, the same information started over. There was no "meat" to review and ponder to make me want to be better, and say, "ahhh yes", that sermon fits me to a tee, I want to be better. I was really looking for a much stronger relationship with the Lord's word, and I wasn't getting it.
At the time, an acquaintance said "I'm going to a men's prayer breakfast, would you like to attend?". Sure I said. I liked the sermon at breakfast, because it was chapter and verse right from the bible. So I attended again on Sunday morning.
I liked the size and shape of the church hall. And the information in the sermon,..... well, there was so much information that I was overwhelmed to be honest. WOW, this was cool! Paster Mark's message was not only feeding me information chapter and verse, but referencing say ten or more other books and chapters in the bible to make the point(s) of his sermon. I went away that day thinking and thinking and thinking about his sermon and how I live my life. I knew this is what I was looking for. This pastor made me want to be a better person! I was home.
Pastor Mark is incredible, and his messages are incredible. I'm a thinker by nature, and like the challenge he brings to my life through his delivering of the Lord's word, chapter and verse.
My life has improved: confidence, satisfaction, happiness, income, sense of well being has been just some of the benefits that has come my way. I'm not going to dissect this part,...I know what it is, and I'm going to keep on doing it, cause' it's right for me, and I know that Calvary Anaheim is a big part of the changes in my life.
I'm a regular guy, a carpenter by trade and over 50. If your starving like I was, come give it a try. Know one will attack you,(if you know what I mean). CCOD has been such a blessing to me and my family. This church is filled with loving people who genuinely care for one another. They love God's Word and the worship is amazing!

name: Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church and Pastor Daniel always preaches the truth. The people are kind and welcoming and it is a wonderful community. I’m so happy to have landed at this incredible church! Everyone is warm and welcoming. The way the biblical teachings are broken down to give context, clear explanation and definition is something I find so helpful. They offer awesome kids ministry as well. We recently became part of this church, and I just had to share our experience. My family is open to different approaches to connecting with God, and we’ve visited quite a few religious places over the years. After reading some great reviews, I finally decided to stop by — WOW! For the first time, Pastor Daniel kept me glued to my seat the entire hour!!!
I’ve never seen a place so full, with a crowd so in sync it felt like our hearts were beating together.

Then I found out there are three services — 8:30, 10:00, and 11:30 — and I couldn’t help but wonder: will the same spirit carry through to the next one? Yes! Absolutely 💯

It was so engaging and powerful, I HAD TO COME BACK the following week just to hear what was next — Apostle Paul was on the move, boldly preaching despite being imprisoned multiple times.
Now my kids and I are looking forward to the next Sunday service.

Another beautiful part I loved is that they offer baptisms at Torrance Beach. There’s something about being baptized in the ocean that I personally find so raw, real, and deeply spiritual. This year’s baptism is on July 13, 2025 at 3 PM, in case you’d like to participate.

Speaking of kids — Johnny and Molly, the couple leading the kids’ ministry, are incredibly gifted and inspiring. Want your child to have a meaningful experience? When you see kids begging their parents to stay just a few more minutes, you know you’re in the right place.

What an amazing, spirit-filled community. We feel so grateful to be part of it. Stay blessed! 🌺💓 Pastor Danielle and his wife Leah along with the Orrs and other leaders have been partnering with the Holy Spirit as the Word of God is placed in the center of the banquet table. A feast to enjoy and to be shared with friends. Bring the real you to the real Jesus is an invitation to bring the person you’re becoming or want to be as we discover together  our gifts, how and where they can be used. The teachings are richly flavored and our pastoral staff are humble, genuine people who care for others. I felt welcomed from the moment I entered the church. Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes is a Bible teaching, Bible believing church where you get to learn verse by verse. It is a great church for anyone in any step in faith. The Gospel is taught weekly and love is shown through staff and church members.  I am very thankful I found this church! It is also a great place for non-Christian friends to come and understand the love Jesus and hear the Good News!

name: Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church and Pastor Daniel always preaches the truth. The people are kind and welcoming and it is a wonderful community. I’m so happy to have landed at this incredible church! Everyone is warm and welcoming. The way the biblical teachings are broken down to give context, clear explanation and definition is something I find so helpful. They offer awesome kids ministry as well. We recently became part of this church, and I just had to share our experience. My family is open to different approaches to connecting with God, and we’ve visited quite a few religious places over the years. After reading some great reviews, I finally decided to stop by — WOW! For the first time, Pastor Daniel kept me glued to my seat the entire hour!!!
I’ve never seen a place so full, with a crowd so in sync it felt like our hearts were beating together.

Then I found out there are three services — 8:30, 10:00, and 11:30 — and I couldn’t help but wonder: will the same spirit carry through to the next one? Yes! Absolutely 💯

It was so engaging and powerful, I HAD TO COME BACK the following week just to hear what was next — Apostle Paul was on the move, boldly preaching despite being imprisoned multiple times.
Now my kids and I are looking forward to the next Sunday service.

Another beautiful part I loved is that they offer baptisms at Torrance Beach. There’s something about being baptized in the ocean that I personally find so raw, real, and deeply spiritual. This year’s baptism is on July 13, 2025 at 3 PM, in case you’d like to participate.

Speaking of kids — Johnny and Molly, the couple leading the kids’ ministry, are incredibly gifted and inspiring. Want your child to have a meaningful experience? When you see kids begging their parents to stay just a few more minutes, you know you’re in the right place.

What an amazing, spirit-filled community. We feel so grateful to be part of it. Stay blessed! 🌺💓 Pastor Danielle and his wife Leah along with the Orrs and other leaders have been partnering with the Holy Spirit as the Word of God is placed in the center of the banquet table. A feast to enjoy and to be shared with friends. Bring the real you to the real Jesus is an invitation to bring the person you’re becoming or want to be as we discover together  our gifts, how and where they can be used. The teachings are richly flavored and our pastoral staff are humble, genuine people who care for others. I felt welcomed from the moment I entered the church. Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes is a Bible teaching, Bible believing church where you get to learn verse by verse. It is a great church for anyone in any step in faith. The Gospel is taught weekly and love is shown through staff and church members.  I am very thankful I found this church! It is also a great place for non-Christian friends to come and understand the love Jesus and hear the Good News!

name: Calvary Chapel Pasadena - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I started attending CCP at the beginning of this year and we know the Lord has led us here. We had been praying for a church with sound doctrine that teaches the actual word of God. The people here are very welcoming. The women's Bible study and marriage ministry have both been a blessing for us. It's really tough to come across a great church that teaches the word of God the way it should. We feel so blessed to have found this beautiful place. Thank you Jesus! 💕 if you're looking for a church that teaches straight from the Bible
, with a great community of believers and the gospel is not watered down then this one is it. I've been to other Calvary Chapels, namely the Chino Hills and Fullerton ones, and I have to say this one is by-far the worst.

They had a frankly absurd number of security staff, as though it were a TSA checkpoint or something. They all were wired up and mic'd up, all over the place, watching the congregation and patrolling the outside the whole time. It gave extremely dystopian, non-friendly vibes. Also, kind of LARP-y. There weren't that many people attending, and it is a pretty small building, so I think the amount of security was seriously overkill.

On top of all of this, the pastor (I didn't get his name, I don't think they mentioned it?) Gave a frankly horrible sermon. He is not the best speaker, and very clearly injected his own political bias' into every aspect of it. He repeated multiple times that he only abides by the bible, before quoting the bible, and building his own interpretation. It was also fraught with a level of smug that made me feel like they were more so trying to indoctrinate rather than build faith or new followers. He spoke badly about other churches, called them idiots, and said that essentially everyone he disagrees with is stupid, but he has the word of God on his side. But did not make a strong case for me to believe him.

If you're looking to convert a friend, or even just looking for a church that truly quotes from the bible, and doesn't build tenuous interpretations that are filled with political bias, DO NOT come here. I am shocked the Calvary Chapel would support this type of sermon. This is a Bible teaching church.  Pastor Reyes is super knowledgeable!. People are super friendly.  We were greeted and shown around by some people the 1st day. They have an amazing book store and a place to have coffee upstairs. Most people bring their Bible's and take notes.  If you're looking for a new church,  definitely check them out. I would like to Thank you ! For your prayers for my family! Psalm 23,91, I praise God for every church that has people open their Bibles and dive into the Word of God. Psalm 100 ! The book of Matthew and James was opened! Still my two favorites! I praise God for the couple next door to me! Their light was shining so bright! That Spoke to me ! what makes them. So different ? JESUS I can't say enough good things about my church! They have helped me in so many ways! I have a relationship with God today, that I never thought possible!

reviewSummary:

.
#BrokerDon CCPV is our home church. My family and I have been attending since 2018 when we moved back to CA after living away for almost 10 years. When we first moved back we started visiting Calvary Chapel churches in our area but just couldn't find a church where we felt at home.  One night, while searching online I came across CCPV and the following Sunday we were there with our three children. After the service my husband and I got in the car and we both agreed we wanted to return and we did and have been attending ever since. The lead pastor, Pastor Joe Tata is an admirable teacher and faithful servant of God. We are encouraged, convicted, and blessed my his teaching week after week. Our children love the children's ministry and we love seeing them grow in faith, knowledge and understanding of God. Very glad we felt led to make a change. I have always preferred a smaller church body that is very connected and we truly feel seen and welcome here. Ready to plug in and get involved where god places us. This last Wednesday was powerful as we broke into small groups to pray for one another. With so many struggling in so many ways these days this felt impactful and you could feel the holy spirit’s presence for sure🙏 Fantastic environment! Everyone was so welcoming and kind, great place with Godly people. Pastor Joe is so nice, he explains things in a way that’s so easy to understand! Love and miss this church highly recommend. CCPV is an expository Bible teaching church, worship is God centered, and great fellowship. The community of believers are warm and friendly. Multi-ethnic church. name: Calvary Chapel San Clemente - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Calvary Chapel San Clemente is an amazing church. From the first time I attended a service the people and Pastor Holland treated me like family. Pastor Holland is truly anointed by the Lord as not only a teacher, but a shepherd, teaching the truth of God’s word, and expressing the love, grace and great mercy of the Lord.  This is a great fellowship full of love, with sound biblical teaching, verse by verse, chapter by chapter, through  the word of God. Attended service yesterday hoping I could again fill that void that had been missing since my life apart from God for years living in the world with sin. Within a few minutes I knew I was home once again lmowing God's grace peace and forgiveness. Thank you church and pastor! We recently moved to San Clemente this past summer and as a military family we move around often as you can probably imagine. Once settled into our new home, one of our first orders of business was to find a Church to continue growing in our relationship with Christ. Our first choice ended in absolute success; we have attended Calvary Chapel San Clemente since July 4th of this year. Calvary Chapel San Clemente is a church filled with real  believers who LOVE the Lord. Attending this Spirit-Filled Church has truly enhanced our relationship with Christ and provided many opportunities to grow and serve the Lord. If you are searching for a Church that preaches truth straight from God's Word and seeks to love on others as well as offers many ministries within the local community, look no further than Calvary Chapel San Clemente. We have seen tremendous growth in our children since attending as well. It is evident that Pastor Holland and the entire staff are real Christ following believers who love the Lord with all their heart, soul and mind. We LOVE our Church! If you're looking for God's Church in San Clemente, This Calvary Chapel should be on your list to check out.  It only took one visit and something inside told me this was the place for me.  The atmosphere is warm & welcoming.  This is a growing church.  If you're interested in getting to the marrow of the Word, I highly recommend you come to the Bible Study on Thursday Nights.  Pastor Holland's knowledge of scripture is thorough and the Lord has blessed him with the ability to pass this knowledge on to you in a great way.  Don't take my word for it, I invite you to come see for yourselves. As far as churches in San Clemente, Calvary San Clemente is the best because they teach the Bible from Genesis to Revelation. If you want to grow in your relationship with Jesus  Christ, come learn the entire Bible. It's a very loving church!

reviewSummary:
Visited Calvary Chapel San Jose when they hosted an event from “Answers in Genesis”. During that event I had the great pleasure of meeting and listening to Ken Ham. A good place to worship and learn about Jesus. A generally welcoming- come as you are church. The worship team also does a really great job with the music. WARNING ⛔️ the senior pastor told me he doesn’t believe in psychology and he forbids d service animals in the church except seeing eye dogs. So I no longer attend. Went today for the first time and weird vibes all around to say the least. First red flag was the church has reserved “pastoral parking” right in front, never seen that before. They announced a “walk for life” event which I guess was a very vague “pro life” event but they didn’t condemn abortion once or mention it’s evil, very lukewarm. The last and biggest red flag was the entire sermon, they had a a guest speaker talk about the history and origins of Islam. If I wanted to learn about Islam I wouldn’t go to Christian church now would I? Weird quotes that people were eating up like “Somalis are on welfare” and stuff about how great republicans are.
We left early, wasted our Sunday checking out this church. We attended there for the first time , it was a great service , we love the pastor , they also have a Christian school and the church prayed for the teachers .
We were guests at this church and overall we had a great time worshipping the Lord . Biblical sound Teaching

name: Calvary Chapel San Marcos - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church. Feels like family and Pastor Dave has so much knowledge of the Word to take in. Welcoming non-judgmental non-dinominational verse by verse Bible teaching church I just have to share more of my experiences with this church. After being saved years ago on the radio I was looking for a bible teaching church. I was lead to this church when they rented the boys and girls club. the Pastor David James and his wife Lori James would be there at the boys and girls club Sunday's at 7 a.m. setting up the church I knew I wanted the same love for Jesus that they had. I have witnessed things that only Jesus can do in this church, so many lives saved and touched in this church, I can remember back when Jesus gave us a permanent building even though we had no money to even make it in to the building Jesus took care off it, and all the materials cost for the renovation Jesus took care of it, I'm a contractor and worked with my brothers and sisters to perform the renovations and what a blessing it was working with them sure it was had work almost every weekend for 2 years but to watch the blessing our good lord gave us I would do it all over again and even today years later our lord Jesus keeps on blessing this church. No matter what church you choose, be led by the spirit and get involved in a bible teaching church the lord will lead you remember fear is a liar so don't wait please find the church he has for you and remember to get involve let Jesus use you if you want see what the body of Christ is all about don't sit on the side lines. I'm still a work in progress but I can't wait to see what our good lord has next for me. And remember if God is for us than who can be against us. Love the small church setting, everyone welcomes you like family. This church has helped my family through a tough year. Pastor Dave has a great message to share every Sunday! Bible based teaching by Dave James. Great worship, nice people ,very welcoming. Great Bible based preaching, wonderful worship service, welcoming people.

name: Calvary Chapel Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
CCSC has been my home church for 12 years now. I love this church. It’s not just fellowship, it’s family. They teach the Bible verse by verse, book by book which is very important to me. Our pastor brings the application of scripture into daily life.
The people are so warm and welcoming.
The Children’s Ministry is amazing. My granddaughter loves it and is excited to come on Sundays. They teach and show her the love of Christ in ways that make it understandable and fun. They also have a really good youth program and pour into our teens along with fun events for them. I’m very grateful that my family is apart of this church. This is a wonderful church, great place to worship! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. Pastor is friendly, funny and I love how he explains the scripture. If you’re looking for a church this is the one for you, if you live locally it’s definitely worth giving it a try. I’m a bit new to understanding the scripture all its meaning but our pastor really breaks it down so that even someone that has never read the Bible can understand. I've been a part the CCSC family for many years.  I'm grateful for a place of fellowship where I feel like part of a family that puts God first in our lives.  Studying the Bible chapter by chapter, verse by verse, has been a tremendous blessing and a vehicle for growth in my relationship with the Lord.  There are many opportunities to serve which is a great deal of fun, and always draws me closer to my brothers and sisters in Christ.  I would encourage anyone who is looking to be a part of a Christ-centered, Bible-believing fellowship, to come and worship with us.  God bless you! What I love most about our church is the people of God who cares and love for one another. Like all Calvary Chapels, you get the Word of God going through each book and verse by verse. If you let yourself absorb this kind of learning, you will become a different person (closer to the Lord). If your desire is to know the Lord, like Paul's desire to only know the Lord and the power of His resurrection (Phl 3:8-10), then this is the church for you! Calvary Chapel is a great church. The pastor is very great with the scriptures. I love that everyone is very welcoming. God bless all of you.

name: Calvary Chapel Signal Hill - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My father was a regular attendee during the COVID-19 pandemic. He faithfully supported the church with donations and deeply appreciated Pastor James Kaddis's sermons defending churches against the government shutdowns in 2020.

He entered a memory care facility in 2022 and recently passed away on July 12.  I flew from San Francisco to arrange his memorial service, called the church and left two voicemail messages over several days simply asking whether Pastor  James Kaddis would be available to officiate my father's memorial service. I never received a return call.
It is understandable Pastor Kaddis may have been ill or out of town.  However, he is the figurehead of the Church is responsible for its administration.

Shame on the church for its silence and complete lack of response. In an age where many water down the gospel to appease the world, Pastor James Kaddis of Calvary Chapel Signal Hill stands as a rare and courageous voice proclaiming the uncompromising truth of God's Word. His teaching is not only biblically sound, but Spirit-led, powerful, and deeply relevant for the times we’re living in.

Pastor James speaks with clarity, urgency, and conviction—always rooted in Scripture and driven by a genuine love for the Body of Christ. He is unapologetic in preaching the full counsel of God, not avoiding the hard topics but confronting them with grace and authority. Whether he's addressing current events through a biblical lens or breaking down complex passages verse by verse, you can sense his commitment to honoring Christ above all.

What sets Pastor James apart is his fearless devotion to truth coupled with a shepherd’s heart. He doesn’t just inform—he equips, challenges, and encourages believers to stand firm in their faith, to live righteously, and to keep their eyes on the soon return of Jesus. His ministry is a beacon of light in a darkening world, and Calvary Chapel Signal Hill is truly blessed to have such a faithful servant at the helm.

If you’re looking for a pastor who teaches the gospel with boldness, integrity, and a deep reliance on the Holy Spirit, look no further than Pastor James Kaddis. His commitment to truth is unwavering, and his passion for God's people is evident in every message he delivers.

May God continue to bless and strengthen him as he leads others in the path of righteousness, truth, and hope in Christ. I've listened to many pastors, but Pastor James Kaddis is different, profoundly different. Every word spoken carries weight, spoken from a place of deep conviction, passion for God's hands at work in our world, and the spiritual warfare taking place in our world right now.

No, Pastor James is not the bad person some misunderstood people think. He is a no-nonsense, no sugarcoating speaker. God has His people all over the world, and each one is different, and has different talent. Pastor James is one of them. No one is perfect because only our Lord Jesus Christ is. But He uses His people to prepare His church. He uses people who do not conform to societal standard, crowd-pleasing people, but those bold enough to dedicated themselves to edifying and educating and preparing God's people.  I highly recommend attending this church or listen to Pastor James Kaddis on YouTube. Know that God does not use your standard "pastor looking" people to speak the truth, but those who are obedient to His calling.
Yes, every speaker is different just like everyone of us are different.

I urge everyone not to expect a perfect flawless person everytime you step into a church, but discern the hand of God at work in a church and the leaders to help and prepare and bless the church.

Pastor James has shown me so much deep knowledge of the spiritual warfare taking place in our world right now. We praise God for this blessings. I watch the YouTube Sunday mornings and weekdays. I love this church and the guests from other churches he has on his show. Weather you're looking for a church or just want to hear the true gospel this is the place to be. Pastor Dale and James are wonderful people God has blessed everyone with. I began listenimg to Pastor James on You Tube in 2020. I am THANKFUL for his boldness to.speak truth completely surrounded im scripture. It is a Pastors responsibility to direct his church and he is the EXAMPLE of that! Thank you Pastor James for your obedience to Gods calling on your life.

name: Calvary Chapel South Tampa
reviewSummary: Visited this wonderful church last Sunday. So pleased to see the loving, welcoming fellowship, compelling and motivating message and music. Truly multigenerational.... And no cliques. Loved the verse by verse teaching! Pastor Joe does not deviate from scripture in his sermons. Biblically based, rooted and led. The way it should be… Amazing community too! Love it here! As a middle-school student, I found this church extremely welcoming and the youth group amazing. They explain the gospel in words that I can understand so I can have a connection with God and Jesus. I also help out on Wednesdays at the Calvary Kids Club, which is for elementary kids, where we play games and learn the gospel. We also have Tuesday night youth hangouts over Zoom. This church has something for all age groups! I'm in middle school and I love going to Calvary Chapel South Tampa! My family started attending right after we moved to Tampa. I get to learn about the Bible verse by verse and how it applies to my life. I have a twin sister and two younger brothers who also love going. My parents attend couples class, which is good for their marriage. We love helping out at Calvary Kids Club on Wednesdays as junior volunteers. Calvary Chapel is like our second home and family. Pastor Joe Harris teaches verse by verse through the Bible and does topical teachings so you get a balanced approach to the Bible. He doesn’t shrink away from difficult passages. The focus is on individual growth of the believer in Christ Jesus. We love the people here-they are like family to us. We’ve been attending 5 years. There are also several small groups that meet in person and Zoom for Bible Study, prayer and fellowship so you can connect.

I get to learn about the Bible verse by verse and how it applies to my life. I have a twin sister and two younger brothers who also love going. My parents attend couples class, which is good for their marriage. We love helping out at Calvary Kids Club on Wednesdays as junior volunteers. Calvary Chapel is like our second home and family. Pastor Joe Harris teaches verse by verse through the Bible and does topical teachings so you get a balanced approach to the Bible. He doesn’t shrink away from difficult passages. The focus is on individual growth of the believer in Christ Jesus. We love the people here-they are like family to us. We’ve been attending 5 years. There are also several small groups that meet in person and Zoom for Bible Study, prayer and fellowship so you can connect.

Humbled and Grateful, that God would call us to make The Barn Christian Fellowship our home church📖🙏🫶🙌 Biblically sound, welcoming, and my new home church! Love it here! May God continue to bless this wonderful place! Simple verse by verse teaching. And very welcoming church Great message.. very friendly.. non judgemental very friendly!!!

name: Calvary Chapel The Rock - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this wonderful, Bible teaching church. So many events and opportunities to get connected immediately. Our family has been blessed by Calvert Chapel The Rock for years, and I highly recommend this Sonoma County church to any families in the area. I remember when this was called Harvest. Pastor Ken Benelli used to have a TV show on KFTY. It was around 1988, I remember because of the book 88 Reasons, my parents started the food bank back then and my dad ran the sound equipment. There used to be giant heated hot tub just past the lobby where you would be baptized. I wonder whatever happened to the the painting that was over it? Church turned family! The most inviting church you’ll ever attend. The sermons are amazing, diving into Gods word and worship is great. Kids ministry is awesome. There are Bible studies and groups for all ages through the week. Come check it out. You won’t regret it. The sermons resonate with me, and the people there are good souls that I can relate too. I really like it there. Please hold a yearly financial review meetings for the congregation.

Please periodicity hold question and answer meetings regarding Scripture. We have questions.

Please provide heathy snacks and cut out all the sugar. .

Thank you

name: Calvary Chapel Three Crosses - Main Sanctuary
Calvary Chapel Tracy - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly - we were greeted by a half a dozen people. The pastor was out of town, but the speaker brought a good message from the scripture. The music was moderately contemporary, was well thought out to correspond with the message, and had a good focus on worship. Being new to the area, and having visited several churches so far, this one so far feels the most like home. Lovely people who really do care, so grateful we found this church 5 years ago. If you're looking for a church home, please come! My husband and I visited this church several times, and we Love the church!
If you want to hear the word of God and know The Truth, this is the right place for you too. Salt and Light are here. Jesus is The Way, The Only Way.  Come and grow in Grace and Knowledge here at Calvary Chapel Tracy.  This church is for Believers in Jesus Christ.  "For God so Loved The World That He Gave His Only Son, that Whosoever Believes in Him shall never die, But have Eternal Life. My husband and I went here as a guest our home church is in modesto and manteca... but there was a marriage seminar on a Saturday here not to long ago and absolutely amazing the worship was amazing the people the body of Christ the messages preached from all the guest speakers...Pastors.... and the main Pastor of the Church was so young... maybe the youngest Pastor I've ever seen... but the annointing on this Pastor was unquestionable... he was empowered by the Holy Spirit and preached truth and definetly was a blessing to everyone there All Glory be to God.... I love all my brothers and sisters in Christ so Greatful for the opportunity to attend the marriage seminar here and I got delivered from something... from bandage of years... this pastor and his wife prayed over my husband and I and something big changed in my walk with God ... this Pastor is annointed.. all Glory be to God the Father in the ae of Jesus Christ 🙏 It brings me to tears of Joy what is happening in the body of Christ may God always guide and bless this Church this body of believers with edification sanctification to grow in knowledge and love for the Glory of God Halelujah Met with the Men's discipleship on Tues night's. 7 to 830. Powerful, Holy Spirit lead teaching and fellowship! Highly recommend it.

name: Calvary Chapel Turlock - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor is a great at teaching the Bible. The congregation is friendly and welcoming and the worship music is fantastic I highly recommend this church. Internally the people are very nice. Externally this is a beautiful  building. New bathrooms, kitchen, air-conditioning ducts along with a lot of other upgraded remodling. I agree with Bret. I've been looking for a church home for a while, and just got back from the first Sunday service. I am not really outgoing, but feel like it is a place I can engage with. Everyone I met eyes with had a warm welcome and the pastor preaches the truth from the Word of God. All the ministry opportunities that I have been looking for are here as well. I am pretty excited to say I will come back next week, if not go to their next Bible Study before then. I have been watching the online sermons past 2 weeks. I definitely like the pastor and associate pastor. When my health is better I do plan on going in person. If you want message of truth and who believe in the bible and following God's word this seems to be a great church to attend. People of all ages are excited to be here; they have a passion to worship together & to study the WORD.  Very friendly people whom are quite welcoming.

name: Calvary Chapel Vista - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
I just moved nearby, it’s the first time I came to the church. It’s good to be here Calvary church is the best. If you want to deep dive into the bible, this is the church for you. Pastor Jason is smart, humble, friendly and funny as well. The whole congregation is welcoming too. Called to ask for help or resources for homeless community and offered to volunteer for free not asking anything in return pastor who I spoke with rrefused to give me any name said no we don’t help others unless if church allows. Pastor also stated there’s no place in the church to help the homeless and looked up he’s church. this church is big…..many rooms but we can put beds down and help the community day by day. But you guys will come for Sunday service to glorify the man above but won’t help he’s people that are in need. I love this church! The redemption of Christ is evident and the joy of the Lord is in the people. So grateful for Pastor Rob's leadership! This is a church that teaches the Bible, speaks truth in LOVE and does not squash the spirit. Truly a Biblical balance of freedom in worship and order. A beautifully diverse church with one thing in common - Simply Jesus! Real praises practiced.
Real Biblical preaching.
Real sincerity echoed.

name: Calvary Chapel Waco - Waco Campus
reviewSummary: One thing I learned is that there are not many sleeping shelters in Waco but there was plenty of places to eat. You should not go hungry cause there are many places that feed the homeless. Calvary chapel and is one of them here you can receive a sack lunch Monday through Wednesday 11:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. the people here are also so welcoming and compassionate helping out all who come in need of something. Whether it be food or some spiritual Mana .church services are held here as well .I do want to thank them for doing the Lord's work and helping me in time of need Pastor Albert, oh how I love to hear you preach! Each time I hear the love of God flow gently and loving, from your lips. My Grandad was a preacher and oh how I loved him. Such a beautiful,  sweet spirt. And I hear the same from you. I pray I'm able to get off of this property soon.  God bless you and your family.  Nita This old VFW/ bar has been remodeled beautifully into a place of worship and they did and amazing job..The pastor: Albert reads and explains bible versus so you have a better understanding of what god is talking about, I've never been  able to find someone to preach the way this man does. It's a nice friendly/family place to come and feel so welcomed. You won't be disappointed!! I love going to church there if you have never been I suggest you go and give it a try loving and caring people very friendly and very welcoming I visit this Church online on Facebook frequently lately and I am thankful for the Praise , Worship and lessons to edify our Lives! Our Lord continue to bless us thru Calvary Chapel! I am not a member of this but i do visit. Look for us as also part of the body of Christ on Facebook and/or Website & Feed your Faith, It will be done thru this Ministry and may it always continue to be so. Say Yes to Jesus ~>>> Jesus is Lord!!

name: Calvary Chapel West Covina - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been a blessing. The single ladies ministry is what intrigued me to come. And is growing!! And now that I'm a church member I get to serve the Lord. I completely recommend it. It's Biblical teaching. Come to learn more about God! Come and hear the truth.
Attach are pics from the ministry that brought me here. These are some of the events that the church members host. All to praise the Lord. My family and I have been so grateful for this Bible teaching church. There is nothing better than to be equipped with understanding of Gods word and learning it in a practical way to be able to live it out. So grateful for the pastors and the congregation!! I found New beginnings through an unfortunate time in my life. My husband and I were separated and he asked me to go try this church with him. Pastor Tony came and introduced himself to me. It was so nice to feel noticed. I started attending and met so many sisters who encouraged me through what eventually turned out in divorce from my 32 year marriage. My ex stopped attending and I kept going. I believe the Lord led me there knowing I'd need a "safe" place where I could find comfort and peace. New Beginnings has been my home church since 2018. Even now that I don't live so close, it will remain to be my home church. Everyone there is so caring and we all make an extra effort to get to know new congregants. We need fellowship more now than ever in this fallen, dark world. Our church is a praying church with a prayer service every Monday night at 7pm. We have seen God move powerfully through prayer and we will continue to pray for one another. New beginnings is not a mega church so it's easy to get connected.
I pray that those who are in search of a Bible teaching, praying church will come to New Beginnings. You will be blessed!
Blessings to all through our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Amazing bible teaching church, so glad to call this place my home church I’m so thankful to have found this church more than 2 years ago when i needed community the most. My mom passed away 5 months ago and we got to enjoy this community together the last year and a half of her life. My eyes water thinking about how so many from this church including the pastors blessed us. Whether it was one of the pastors coming to our house to help me transfer my mom to and from the car when she could no longer walk just so that we could attend church together, to the worship team, young adults ministry, main pastor and senior pastor spending time in fellowship and worship in our home when she could no longer go to church, to the many congregants  that checked in on us frequently to see if we needed anything/ they could pray for us. In return i’ve made some lifelong friendships that i’ll cherish for as long as i live. This church really is the hands and feet of the lord and I’m so thankful for all the beautiful memories I had with my mom here and for the continued memories that I’ll have here moving forward. Everyone here is so full of the lords love and it’s evident in all of the ministries. God bless!

name: Calvary Chapel Westgrove - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Seem to be only greeted by the greeters and not by anyone else, members or staff.  Pastor seems to joke around a little too much.  A sermon will really stick only if there is a substitute preacher.  One of the worship leaders is too much of a showboat with oversinging as if she is expecting a talent scout to be in the audience. Great Bible teaching Church. At Calvary Chapel WestGrove we have a heart to serve our community and a church that has a heart for missions. If you and your family are searching for a church that you can get plugged in and grow in the Lord come by and check it out. Ministries for children,jr. High , high school students, young adults, men, women. Also have breaking the chains ministry on Monday nights at 6 pm come and check it out. We also have a Spanish service on Sunday mornings at 9:00am. If you have in question you are always welcome to contact the front office and get more information about the different ministries available. Love God Love People! God bless Had my brother's services there. Pastor John LaBelle did an amazing job. As my brother was deaf he also had an interpreter for the congregation. And had a small reception. Very nice inside. Started coming here when I was 16 years old.. now I’m 43 & been back going on 4 years. Pastor Eric & the staff have helped me heal, grow in my faith.. Grateful for my second home. Love the Ambiance, the updates of the buildings & all whom are a part of it. 🙏🏼🩷🫶bonus coffee shop next door 🙌🏼🙌🏼☕️ Pastor is amazing.  He brings the word of God to life. I can’t get enough. And he allows me to fall more in love with Jesus

name: Calvary Chapel Winchester - Murrieta Campus
Calvary Christian Assembly
reviewSummary:
We literally had the most beautiful experience! Today we just happened to be late for our traditional church. We figured maybe try one closer? And we took the exit.
I should mention I went here when I was very young. Every time we pass it on I5 I point it out to  my husband and kids.
We thought it perfect to try for a first time visit. We were not disappointed. Pastor Ryan gave a touching sermon. That roped us in, but it was everyone’s kindness afterwards! They all came and introduced themselves. Invited us to lunch and gave us a private tour of this absolutely gorgeous sanctuary! It was so educational and interesting learning about the building and history. Aside from its beauty, it carry’s the Holy Ghost like no other I have ever experienced! We told all of our loved ones about it! And will be back for Every group!
Thank you to all of you that made us feel apart of today! All of the directors and strong women we met! They played and laughed with our kids and they were so patient when my boys were just curious touching everything. What a God given community. I can’t wait to meet everyone else!
What a blessing! I had to share! 🥰🙏❤️ I LOVE MY CHURCH!!!

Charisma Christian Center and Calvary Christian Assembly has since merged as of May 11, 2025.

Lead Pastor James Reyes along with his fellow pastors and guest speakers give soul stirring sermons.

They recently threw an event where they gave free backpacks with school supplies for the children going back to school & free bags of groceries.

Lastly, the Worship Music Team will make you feel the Holy Spirit.

GOD BLESS!!! I was a DJ for a wedding there,
it has good access to the ground level for loading and unloading equipment to the gymnasium area. Parking was very nice, especially considering the area. Main worship hall was on the 2nd level and was very lovely with an actual air organ and tastefully done lighting and sound. I was campaigning for Scott Nazareno who is running for United States Senate for the State of Washington and he took me to the Calvary Christian Assembly and I was Very Impressed!  Scott has been going to this church since he was two years old.  They have an adult Sunday School Service that I never even knew existed.  This is a very Good Size church with many people who attend.  I recommend this church to all followers of Christ Jesus.  God bless you and your family always ♥️ ♥️ 🙏 🙏

"May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all".  Rev. 22:22.  Amen 🙏🙏♥️♥️ A Multi Ethnic church in Seattle. One can  recognize 30 to 40 Nations represented.

name: Calvary Christian Center Church - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary: Feels like family  here, pastor staff is great. It's a spirit filled place to worship! Visited 7 yrs ago and stayed! Now several of my family attend also. The Pastors Jim & Diane ministers from the heart. Passionately pours into everyone to enrich the Kingdom, believing in healing and wholeness, being Christ like in our daily life's. Calvary has several ministries to fit every age! Very happy attending here since I met my wife who has attended there most of her life. I always leave filled by the Holy Spirit which fuels me for the week. Good service. The Pastors were friendly. Not a lot of people at the 11am service. A gem out in the boonies of Hamilton. I love Calvary Church! Pastor Jimmy and Diane are the real deal, so down to earth and they tell it like it is and I love that!

name: Calvary Christian Center Elk Grove - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
I was impressed by the warmth of the volunteers when I visited. They greeted me with a smile and provided a brief overview of what to expect during my tour, which set a nice tone for the experience. The historical building itself was well-maintained, with clear descriptions next to the exhibits that made it easy to follow the local history. As I explored, I appreciated how knowledgeable they were; they answered all my questions thoroughly and even shared personal stories related to some of the artifacts on display. It felt like walking through a living museum, especially with all the additional buildings on the grounds that you could explore. The entire experience was smooth—there wasn't any wait, and everything flowed nicely from one area to the next... Overall, it was a relaxed way to dive into Elk Grove's past without feeling rushed or overwhelmed. Pastors  Brenda and Phillip Goudeaux are awesome Holy Spirit filled & led witness's, Ambassadors, pastors, teachers, disciples, evangelist,  intercessor prayer warriors, counselors, hearers and doers of God's word. 😀It is very true Pastor Phillip Goudeaux, "The Word works-When you work the Word!" I went to the 11am service and once again pastor Philip Jr didn't let me down I really like his style it's not so intense. I am an older Christian mbr for years so trust me you get the same food as pastor Philip Sr just
served on a different plate love the music that is really soothing thank you for your leadership and being the spiritual guidance I need Good sermon with lord of bible verses and they mention Jesus Christ YES
The praise team was jammin too.
Passed thru while helping my lil bro move so since I wasn’t at my home church this did not disappoint
If your spiritual battery is low from all the drama in the world and u want to reconnect thru the word visit this spot My family and I are new to this area and are looking for a home church.  I visited Calvary Christian Center this past Sunday.  The worship was wonderful but my biggest concern was that the pastor was using both the Message and the Passion translations of the bible.  The Message translation contains New Age mysticism according to reputable bible scholars.  The Passion translation is questionable with respect to textual accuracy, with non-biblical scholars playing fast and loose with the original languages then masquerading it as an accurate and authentic translation.  Maybe the leadership is unaware of this but I can't take chances when it comes to my spiritual health.  Don't get me wrong the pastor taught truth but the source of scripture is so questionable that I don't think I'll be returning to this church unless they renounce and stop the use of these two translations of the scriptures.  May they seek the truth about this because their flock follow their lead.

name: Calvary Christian Center Sacramento - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary: My first time coming in will be Tomorrow Sunday may 10th. For the past 6 months I’ve done virtual Bible study as I have a Pastor who is in New York. I’ve been wanting to get baptized as I have been before twice now. This time I have a better understanding and a relationship with the Lord. How can I go about joining and getting baptized? I was seeking a church that had evening service and was led to this church by a young man from another church who's service I went to in the morning. This has been my church home every since. I love Dad amd Momma Goudeoux. I can see the change happening in my soul since coming here. I advise you come check it out. I love the service this church family provides. I want it to become my church home if I can ever transfer my job from the Bay Area to Sacramento. Until then I will stay committed to attending online. I ask that you all to please pray for me to become more of a doer though after receiving and listening to the word of God. I have attended twice and walk by regularly, the parishioners I have encountered have been rude, unfriendly, and frankly not showing Christian traits. How unfortunate for our community. The shining stars are the food bank folks on Tuesdays.  Questionable contents, not worth the wait. I have been going to CCC for I do not know how long but I do know that when i came in the words of Pastor I was tore up from the floor up, full of anger, depression, hate for people, mistrust and just not wanting to even be here any more, my sister invited me to church one day and I came and have been here ever since. God knew me and he knew I would need a man of God like Pastor who would be able to speak to me from God and get me on the right track.  I being in church as my grandmother made sure we went every Sunday to  a Methodist Church, I never wanted anything to do with God and did not even believe he loved me assumed because of what I had gone through he was angry at me, but my sister kept speaking to me about God and I relocated with my kids and accepted her invitation to Calvary and it was a true life changer, I learned who Jesus was and what he had done for me and how much God loved me and I thank God for a man and woman of God that actually walks it like they talk it. I thank God daily for this Ministry and this Pastor and most importantly them bring me the truth of Jesus and the love of God, my children grew up here and my grandchildren grew up here, is it a perfect church but there is not one as there is not a perfect church. but it is as close as it can get.

name: Calvary Christian Church of the Apostolic Faith Inc - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Calvary is a blessed placed, with Spirit led leaders that are not just about souls but love and compassion for all God's people; it truly is The Place of Victory I started going here about 4 yrs ago, this church is def on fire. Trust me there is never a dull moment God is always in this place.
Def the place of Victory...Come and visit trust me you want be sorry. Pastor Kameron always gives God his all. I love my church its an amazing church. God gets all the Glory!!!!
First Lady J is also a amazing first Lady...Love her.
Come visit you will not be sorry❤️ I only went 2 Sundays in a row.  Last week Sunday, and yesterday.  So for it hit certain points I critique on.  #1 Humility: The Pastor sounds humble and preached on humility. Father God showed me the topic even before I got there, and a few other things.  #2. Genuine welcome:  people seem very caring, and welcoming.  So far this church is a winner.  The Holy Spirit really used the pastor, and I mean really really used this pastor to bring forth the word!!! Powerful preaching; I mean as Apostle Paul says on MEAT preaching and NOT Milk!! He used him to really rightly divide the word, and sew it altogether into to his topic sentence which was titled "THE HELP" !!!  OH yeah!!! AMAZINGLY DIDNT KNOW WHY I WAS THINKING ABOUT THIS MOVIE. I GET TO THE CHURCH, AND THEY HAD THE VERY PINK COVERERD INTRO PAGE OF THE MOVIE ON THE CHUCH SCREEN!! Which brings me to #3. Father and Lord Jesus manifested themselves directly to me in a special notable way!!! Worship and service are heartfelt and filled with the Holy Spirit. we always have a high time in the Lord

reviewSummary: The expository preaching of Dr. Munro is unmatched. Solid biblical foundation. A massive, beautiful sanctuary with a wonderful, welcoming congregation.

name: Calvary Church
reviewSummary:
Pastor Jim and Pastor Tom are two of the best preachers of the gospel. Pastor Ed. Dobson was my first pastor at Calvary, I will never forget how much he suffered from ALS. I was water baptized and shared my testimony in 1997. All staff, worship leaders, Elders and Decans deserve high respect! Beautiful space for the church to worship our God and gracious savior, Jesus Christ! Also a lovely venue to thank God for & celebrate recent graduates. I love the stained glass which is modern but still meaningful. I have been attending this church for over a year, and I'm amazed every week at how much preparation is put into each service. I can always feel that the pastor, staff, and volunteers give their all to fully dedicate the service to God. This church is a great role model. Thank you God for leading us to such an amazing church. Highly recommend!!!

The sanctuary looked reverent.

Everyone dressed up, ladies in dresses, gentleman dressed up, no going to the ball park attire.

The worship was a bit more contemporary but no crazy concert with light show. No background lyrics screens that takes your attention away from the worship

The pastor (well dressed in slacks and a button down) started our passionately and boldly explaining the Equality act. Then rolled into encouraging the congregation on being lovingly bold, and about persecution. All while reading a segment of Philippians.

Then communion while we sang: “Lord I need you oh I need you”.

So so good! good gospel preaching and a good worship Although, I have not visited Calvary's building, I do watch the pastor online. name: Calvary Church - Clearwater
reviewSummary:
I came to Calvary Church during a season of searching — not casually, but with intention. I was specifically looking for a Baptist congregation because of my deep personal connection to First Baptist Church in Lakeland, where I recently had the privilege of contributing to their campus through my work with Distinct Designs Custom Cabinets and Casework in Largo.

Only about four months ago, I was sanding surfaces, assembling drawers, fitting cabinetry, sweeping floors, and delivering finished pieces room by room — all alongside the great Jarek from Poland, one of the finest craftsmen I’ve ever known. To build even a small part of a church like FBC Lakeland was an honor. I prayed quietly as I worked, imagining the countless believers who would one day use those spaces. That experience left a mark on me, and it made me long for a Baptist church family of my own.

That longing is what led me to Calvary.

From the moment I arrived, the people here were warm, kind, and genuinely welcoming. The pastoral care team reached out quickly. Gaye Lene was attentive and organized, and both Pastor Mike and Pastor Justin took the time to speak with me about baptism and next steps. Their willingness to meet, listen, and guide me meant a great deal.

Calvary is a large, active congregation with strong teaching, heartfelt worship, and a sincere commitment to Scripture. You can feel the love of Christ in the way people greet you, pray with you, and make space for newcomers. For many, this church is home — and I can absolutely see why.

But as I continued my journey, something unexpected happened:
I found myself drawn back to a place that had been quietly woven into my life for decades.

I ultimately found my spiritual home at St. Alfred’s Episcopal Church on Curlew in Palm Harbor — a church I likely attended as a child with my grandfather, Harry B. Vassie, co‑founder of the NSA and later a beloved member of the Palm Harbor community. He served in the Coast Guard Auxiliary on Lake Tarpon and carried himself with the kind of dignity and quiet service that shaped my understanding of faith long before I had words for it.

For the past nine years, I’ve walked with Father Pete at Enterprise Dog Park — a man who never pushed, never preached at me, never tried to steer me. He simply listened. Month after month, year after year, he offered a gentle, patient presence that spoke louder than any sermon. And today, when he preached, something in his words reached a place in me I didn’t expect. His sermon brought tears to my eyes — not from sadness, but from recognition. From the sense that I was finally standing where I belonged.

So while Calvary was an important part of my journey — and I am grateful for the time I spent there — my path ultimately led me somewhere else. That doesn’t diminish Calvary in the slightest. Not every church is meant for every person, and that’s part of the beauty of the Body of Christ. Different voices, different traditions, different ways of drawing people closer to God.

Calvary is a good church with good people, and I’m thankful for their hospitality. If you’re searching, Calvary is absolutely worth visiting. And if your journey takes you somewhere else, that’s okay too. Sometimes God leads us through one door so we can recognize the next one when it opens. Thanks but no thanks.

In this country we have the freedom of the press, and Google reviews is a way for citizens to participate.

name: Calvary Church - Monterey Campus
reviewSummary:
Calvary Monterey has truly been a blessing in my life and in the life of my children. From the moment you walk through the doors you can feel the love, warmth, and authenticity of this church community. It is a place where everyone is welcomed no matter where you are in your walk with God and services are currently running Sundays and Thursdays for those with complicated scheduling needs. You can also watch online, but won’t regret coming in person and making this your home church!

The biblical teachings each Sunday are solid, thoughtful, and deeply rooted in scripture and always delivered with such conviction and even a sense of humor by Pastor Nate. Other pastors, have similar, sound teaching styles and bring variety and wisdom to the team. The messages are both theologically sound and incredibly relevant to everyday life; helping you grow spiritually while offering encouragement and hope. You leave feeling refreshed, challenged, and reminded of God’s goodness.

What really sets Calvary Monterey apart is their heart for families and children. Children’s Ministry programs are engaging, safe, and centered on God’s Word; making it easy for parents to trust that their children are being nurtured and taught well. It’s clear how much intentional care goes into nurturing the next generation and I am so happy that I have found a place where I can confidently leave my children and know that they will be well taken care of.

The sense of community here is amazing. The life groups are incredible and provide a space to build meaningful relationships, pray together, and walk through life side by side. This church doesn’t just feel like a place you attend on Sundays, it feels like a family you want to be a part of and who wants you to be present as well. Even “antisocial” folks like myself, find their place in the crowd.

Calvary Monterey lives out its faith through action. Their support of The Bridge and other social justice efforts shows a genuine commitment towards serving others and loving the community beyond the church walls!  It is inspiring to see faith put into practice in such a compassionate and tangible way. My favorite partnerships have been with Set Free Monterey Bay and Safe Families.

Additionally, there are so many diverse events throughout the year that bring people together in fun and meaningful ways (festivities, Easter, Women’s Events, Youth Camp, and so much more). Whether it’s worship, fellowship, or outreach, there’s always something that helps you stay connected!  If you’re looking for a church that is welcoming, Christ-centered, family-focused, and deeply committed to making Jesus famous, Calvary Monterey might be the church for you. Accommodating rooms available for mothers and outstanding children daycare. Inspiring youth program. I’m so elated to be part of such a great Church.
May Jesus continue to be famous with his unending love and grace!

name: Calvary Church of Santa Ana - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment you walk in the door you feel the spirit.  Debbie one of the greeters remembers everyone’s names and is the sweetest over the years she has become my spiritual mom loving and guiding my son and I to Jesus! Debbie and many others have become family to myself and my son Jaxon.  Raising my son as a single mom I have felt nothing but constant love and belonging! We started attending when my son was 3 he’s 11 now. Calvary is very relational and there is a place for everyone no judgment just LOVE! Highly recommend! We toured almost all of the Christian private schools in OC and could not be happier with our decision to choose Calvary Christian School of Santa Ana. Calvary is deeply rooted in Christian values, and you truly see those values lived out daily through the way teachers care for students and how the community supports one another.

One of the things we love most is the strong sense of community. Families are welcoming, and there are many opportunities for parent involvement, which makes you feel connected to your child’s education. We strongly believe parent involvement plays a huge role in shaping our children’s future. The school also offers many field trips and hands-on learning experiences that keep students excited and engaged.

The teachers are experienced, caring, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth—academically, spiritually, and socially. With over 50 years of history, the school has a strong foundation and clear mission. We also appreciate the diverse student body and the emphasis on mission opportunities. Academically, we love the focus on spelling bees, speech meets, and foreign language instruction starting in first grade. We couldn’t be happier with our experience! Went to the church for 20 plus years, married there, kids attended schools on campus. Begged the "Executive Pastor" Eric Wakling for help and he didn't even have the decency to return an email or call... nothing.......20 plus years of attendance and didn't even qualify for a call. Be warned about this church as they talk a great game but they'll never show up to help you even when you beg for help. Swing and a miss with the comedy act tonight that was light on reflecting Jesus but had severe racial overtones.  It appears this church has strayed from the days of strong Bible teaching I attended under Dave Mitchell.  I don’t think Matt Doan would be proud of what was conveyed in the Worship Center.  The laughing at marriage routine that we went to was TERRIBLE!  Comedian showed up super late, then went down the racial road while pedaling merch, pay-out for additional seminars, and pushing a book.  It was pretty bad and we left feeling taken advantage of.  I’m all for comedy, but not the kind that denigrates “white people”, making it their entire act with a sprinkle of a Bible verse or two.  Calvary staff, please do a better job of vetting who you endorse. Just a great church. Diverse, multi-generational congregation, lots of activities, fantastic worship team, messages that are true to the gospel. Everything a church should be.

name: Calvary Community Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Have you been looking for a church that ACTUALLY preaches about Jesus and isn't about politics or weird doctrines? Well Im pleased to tell you that Calvary is that church! The pastor and elders are incredible and on fire for the Good News and Jesus. There's plenty of programs for the kids including special needs. Tons of Bible Study opportunities and stuff for teenagers. But truly the strength of this church is in it's big time love for Jesus. Every sermon leads to Jesus and I love how the church isn't law based/pharisee glazing. I highly recommend coming here. 10/10 Was here for a their annual car show last weekend.  This is a straight up bias All American car show.  Only 1 import won, which was a BMW, and it was even under "People's Choice".  So obviously all the judges cared about and have been caring about are American cars.  WHY even accept Import cars during registration when not even 1 or 2 imports win in Top 10, or other categories.  There were import cars there that you never see around at all, rare import cars, a lot of people were amazed as I observed there reactions to these imports.  Not cool at all Calvary Love My Ride car show staff. Christmas Service. I brought 2 unattending folks, 4 attending another church folks and my bride and me. We all thought the giving section was repetitive... Brian repeated himself 3 or 4 times.

All of us felt the video after was guilting manipulation. Of course Paul wasn:t afraid to guilt the Corinthians to give, but really, at the Christmas service when you probably have more visitors the members? I bet Bill Hybels, who was an influence at one thime, might have a comment.

Pastor Brian was a real downer. His focus on sin and human suffering was not appropriate for families that travelled from all over the US to spend a joyous Christmas celebrating Christ' birth with their families. Further, after fighting a horrible reaction to the COVID vaccine for 3 years that resulted in me nearly dying a couple of times, Brian's message cound not have been a bigger miss. Does he have a clue?

Sean, as usual was Great and my grandson loved the presentation. He is 4 and this was his second time in church.

I get Jesus was born as a sacrifice for me. But I wonder if Jesus would be happy about focusing on the sacrifice over the the joy that came (1) after 700 years of God not speaking to His people, (2) the beginning of the new covenant of love for God and each other and (3) the joy that gentiles were adopted into God's family.

Scripture says there is a season for everything and there is also a good word for every season. Christmas is a season of joy. Our words should reflect that. Brian's word was for the easter season.  Isn't it interesting though, that our liturgical seasons are opposite of the lunar seasons? Beautiful place to stay and listen for God's message. The music always gets to me and my wife. It's always been a great experience  for us and my two kid's. My 10 year old son loves going to his age class friends and my daughter 22 years the enjoyment of hanging out with me and my wife while listening to the message... its her childhood church..
God bless this beautiful establishment being a church! I normally don’t post reviews, but as a parent I feel strongly that other families deserve to know how this church leadership handles serious situations with kids.

My son attended their youth camp this summer and was falsely accused of something very serious. Instead of investigating carefully, the pastors immediately labeled him with a damaging accusation, had the police question him without either parent present, and then sent him home. Later, the story shifted several times — from a very harsh accusation to “disruptive behavior” — with no consistency or clarity or response to my concerns. Even more troubling, my son was never counseled, warned, or guided by a leader at camp before being casting him out of camp, he has zero knowledge he had done anything wrong.

We all expect teenagers to need correction, and as parents, we welcome godly discipline. But what we did not see was Christlike leadership. Rather than using the opportunity to teach, shepherd, and help him grow, the church chose humiliation, much avoidance, and silence. Promised follow-up calls and apologies never came, and messages went unanswered.
When I did finally receive a response from Pastor Brian, who ignored my calls by the way, said 'we have a different perspective' and went without addressing not one concern that I addressed, not one. Truly, I expected more from the head of the head.

My son has taken accountability for the things he did do, but the pastors have not taken responsibility for their overreaction and lack of care for the hurt and damage they have caused. The result was deep embarrassment and harm to a 13-year-old boy’s reputation — all over an accusation later found to be untrue.

If you are considering sending your child here, please be aware: this is not the grace-filled, truth-led leadership that Scripture calls pastors to model. Families deserve better.

name: Calvary LIFE - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church since 2023. The people are welcoming. The music is lively and heartfelt. Pastor Chet, along with his wife and co-pastors, is amazing, passionate, funny, authentic, and extremely knowledgeable in the Word of God. His own life experiences show it. I recommend this church. Calvary Chapel South Bay has a healthy heart for missions and because of that it is very welcoming and service centered. The kids ministry is also robust and systematic while being able to entertain the children and educate them at the same time, I definitely recommend anyone to go and I’m glad it is here in the Southbay. Calvary life  changed my Life. Pastor Chet n his beautiful wife True people of God...God Bless you both n your children.

Teaching verse by verse through God's Word.  Scripture is the highest authority here. North Calvary is a church with a strong foundation built on the truth of the Gospel. They hold firmly to the core value that God sent His Son, Jesus Christ, to die on the cross for our sins — and that Jesus is both fully God and fully man. By His grace, we are given the gift of the Holy Spirit who guides, comforts, and empowers us daily.

The leadership and congregation at North Calvary demonstrate a genuine love for God’s Word and for people. The teaching is faithful to Scripture, the worship is heartfelt, and the atmosphere is one of encouragement and grace. This church is a wonderful place to grow in faith, experience community, and live out the mission of Christ. I have attended many churches over the years, but the family that fellowships at Calvary North truly stands out. The atmosphere is filled with genuine people who love the Lord, and it’s clear that the focus is on guiding people to the cross, no matter how broken they are. It’s not about flashy lights or shows, but about true fellowship and being fed the Word of God. This church helps believers grow and become disciples for Christ in a world that so desperately needs it. The pastors and worship team are such a blessing, and I’ve been fortunate to form lifelong friendships with fellow brothers and sisters in Christ here. They also provide a safe, clean, and loving environment for everyone who attends.

The kids’ ministry at Calvary North is equally amazing, providing solid teaching and nurturing the faith of the next generation. They regularly host events for the kids, including a jump house after service, creating opportunities for Christian families to meet and connect. The safe and welcoming atmosphere extends to every part of the church. If you’re searching for a church family where you can worship the Lord, experience authentic fellowship, and find solid biblical teaching, Calvary North is a wonderful place to call home. God bless!
