I also had bottle of drinking water that I was hoping someone could bless into holy water, (don't know the basics or protocol here), but I was reaching out blindly to see how it was here, and if I would like to attend one day)
My Observation:
she said, exactly,through the camera doorbell,
"NO, no one is here today that can pray for you, have a nice day". -End pep talk.
Okay, great, thanks. As I scratch this one off my list, Thanks.
I immediately called the church I usually view  view online and the receptionist answered, and I explained the same thing to her, and the receptionist said "ma'am, I will pray with you right now over the phone, and she did, and it was beautiful, and a blanket of divine peace covered me. ✨️ Their attentive to details in their ministry for the homeless and for the hungry and the needy is right on point they do last for the community Loving and welcoming congregation. Involved in community service specially with the homeless. Family atmosphere. Totally recommend if you are looking for a place where you feel accepted just the way you are. Not a church of good faith, several men seen going in through the back of the church late at night doing explicit things.

name: Calvary Presbyterian Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been walking pass this church for some time and noticed all the inclusive signage out front. I decided this past Sunday to attend their 10 am service.  Oh my!! They are not very inclusive!! I had a terribly racist experience.  It's merely a performance!!  I sat in the back last row and the white lady next to me treated me like I was going to rob her. Also, she was very rude and hostile. I didn't want to subject myself to further abuse so I decided to simply leave immediately.  I confronted her about why she did that and she held the bulletin next her face.  Blocking her from looking at me. The weird racist undertones are terrible.  I immediately left and I got looks as if I was the crazy person.  If you are black and don't want to deal with abuse then I recommend avoiding this congregation.  The sense I get is that the signage is a front so they can feel good about themselves when in reality they cool with you until you are black in their space.  Why have a inclusive signage only to be abusive!!!!? Ok. Wow.

Not only is this place beautiful but it is filled with beautiful souls. Can not go into the details without getting emotional but. This is probably one of the most inclusive churches I know of.

With strong community. If this last is what you seek give this place a try. Nice venue with queer friendly banners, interesting and fun events, and beautiful atmosphere. We saw an independent choir performance accompanied by a cellist and organist, wonderful performance! 🎭 Saw Ocean Vuong in conversation with Samin Nosrat for Vuong’s release of “The Emperor of Gladness” - beautiful, well-kept, and organized venue with friendly and knowledgeable staff. Longtime Calvary member, and still love the congregation's openness and welcome to all, service to the greater San Francisco opportunity and ample ways to easily join community service projects, and multi-generational church family. The gorgeous sanctuary and incredible music program are also great draws, and the church also increasingly hosts book events and concerts to share the space with the broader community.

name: Calvary Red Rock - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
That corner picture isn’t where they’re at anymore. Today is July 31 of 2025 and they moved,  I guess,  a couple of months ago. Solid teaching,  definitely a safe Church to go to.  From Genesis to revelation, they do teach the whole word of God. Best Church EVER!! Recently moved closer to Summerlin. Verse by verse reading/ teaching.  Fun for all.  Always have something going on to keep you involved in the word. Love the people, love the pastor, love the Lord!! This church teaches word for word from the Bible. There is no "sugar coating" or "twisting" of teachings to  bring comfort to our society or to make societies current ways of living more acceptable. The pastor teaches the truth and focuses on the truth.

There are many feel good churches around... I'm not here to feel good, I'm here to know the truth.

Thank you for staying focused on what is important. This is an amazing church! Very welcoming! This church prioritizes the Word of God, straight up.
At the Heart of this church is the Great Commission and the equipping of God’s people to share the Gospel in all areas of the world, to the reached and unreached! Which is very important and dear to me.
I totally recommend coming to this church if you are looking for a church that absolutely does not compromise on the truth of the Word of God and if you are looking for a church that is active in the mission field! There is no other church like this! Everyone is so welcoming and they know the word of God!

name: Calvary Road Baptist Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: The best people I ever met! Went for the first time today with my husband. We were warmly greeted and welcomed by many members before service and after. Service was excellent, the pastor preaches the WORD and doesn't modify scripture to suit the masses - so refreshing! Old fashioned hymns were sang and we were invited to lunch after by the pastor and his wife. The world needs more of these churches. Thank you. Friendly, warm and caring congregation.  Consistent able pastoral leadership. I love the people and the services are so important to me Great people awesome mission amazing pastor

name: Calvary San Diego - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
God's word taught simply and profoundly. Super great people. Lots of involment and investment in the community. Wonderful people. Excellent pastor and wife, and staff. I highly recommend. Lovely mid-sized church.  First visit today but they welcome me.  They have coffee and donuts and you may just want a small donation like $1.  They use this facilities for school during weekdays.  The church is location next to a community park! Friendly volunteers, amazing teachers, wonderful people, many playgrounds for kids. I feel so welcomed on the first day. Love this church. 👌🏻

Real people engaged in their community, focused on Gospel declaration and clear Bible teaching. This church is great, one session and I am hooked. I attended a few other Calvary Churches and this one was true to its name. Don’t believe me go and see for your self.
The worship had goosebumps down my arms the entire time. And the pastors where so friendly and the people here are so nice. Thank God for calling me to this place.

The facility and grounds are well kept.

name: Calvary San Mateo - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary: Nice Bible based teaching. Friendly staff and congregation. Pastries available after service where people can congregate and talk to people directly after the services.  Liked it very much. The church sits on a hill with beautiful views. Love Calvary San Mateo. Why? Cause they were DA Calvary Chapel that reminded me once again why I have always loved this movement. Practical love, consistent and solid Bible teaching, freedom to worship God and live for Him enjoying this world and so much it has to offer (including surfing :)). People at this church are amazing: caring, prayerful, gentle, humble, most welcoming and loving. You have never tasted Calvary San Mateo hospitality yumminess after a Sunday service? Oh my! Don’t miss it ;) But on a serious note, though, Calvary San Mateo has always been about offering you to taste and see how good the Lord is - through teaching, service, prayers and friendships. It’s the church I call my family now. Love you, CC San Mateo!! This church is a blessing! You can’t help but leave feeling loved and cared for! It’s a family here. The leadership welcomes you and prays over you. Worship and the Word are a blessing on Sundays! Calvary San Mateo is a “church on hill” that seeks the Lord. Praise God! Changed my life! Happy, joyous and free is attainable with this Strong fellowship in a casual, loving environment. The pastor is younger, in high tech and great at relating the Word to the rat race we live in in the Bay Area. Great mix of people/families. Not like Catholic churches I have become a Christian 4 years ago and believe in Jesus Christ for he died on our sins and this church is like really really good they teach from the Bible extremely good with personalities that won't quit

name: Calvary South OC, San Clemente - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
I rarely leave negative reviews, especially for a church, but my family left this church feeling deeply disappointed.
We were excited to visit and drove over 30 minutes to attend. Before the service began, our infant son was quietly sitting with us and was not making any noise or causing any disruption. After arriving, not a single person greeted us or welcomed us. Instead, we were approached and told that our infant could not remain in the sanctuary. The woman who approached us did not ask our names or introduce herself; she simply informed us that our baby had to leave.
As first-time visitors, this experience was disheartening. We ultimately left and attended another church that welcomes families of all ages into worship. Our baby loves being part of worship, and we believe children deserve the opportunity to witness the body of Christ worshiping together across generations.
In all our years of attending churches, we have never encountered a policy like this. We found it concerning and not reflective of the welcoming spirit we were hoping to find in a church community.
If you are looking for a church that embraces young children and welcomes families with open arms, unfortunately, this was not our experience here. Best church I've ever been to !
I'm so glad a friend invited me here!!
The message is absolutely fantastic every time!
What a beautiful and comfortable, welcoming and warm environment to learn and worship!
The worship team is absolutely fantastic!
I enjoy being outside in the patio area listening to the message ,enjoying the beauty of the green hills, and singing birds that surround us, while I'm sipping coffees or ice water provided and watching our fantastic pastor up on the outdoor screen sharing yet another awesome message.
Our Pastor John Randall is on fire for the Lord with an incredible love for teaching God's truths in a wonderful way and always spot on!
Never boring always something new going on to look forward to.
Come have a beautiful Christ centered, Joy filled morning with us! You'll be so glad you did! This Church is disgusting and evil. They gave my son medication without my approval during VBS. And when I called to question them why, the staff was very rude, vague, cut me off and never answered my questions or returned phone calls. Beware of letting your precious babies be alone with these people! We partnered with this church for a True Girl event and everything and everyone was so very helpful and amazing! So blessed. Been My Church Home for Over a Year—Couldn't Be Happier

I've been attending Calvary South OC for over a year now and it's been incredible for my walk with God. Pastor John teaches straight from the Bible using expository preaching—basically going through books of the Bible verse by verse so you get the full context and deeper understanding of Scripture.

What I really appreciate about Pastor John is how genuine and approachable he is. No celebrity pastor vibes here—he's actually plugged into his congregation and easy to talk to. His Daily Walk videos, Tuesday men's group (they have women's options too), and Wednesday services give you solid biblical teaching throughout the week.

Pastor John has this ability to make Scripture easy to understand and apply to real life. He keeps things relevant, throws in some humor, and never waters down God's Word. Whether you're brand new to faith or have been walking with Christ for years, his teaching meets you right where you are.

If you're looking for a church with solid biblical teaching, real community, and a pastor who actually cares about his people, I can't recommend Calvary South OC enough. It's been a blessing to be part of this church.

name: Calvary Worship Center - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m a pastor in Colorado Springs from another church. I had the privilege to visit Calvary on my sabbatical. I brought the whole family. Outstanding church. You can expect worship, a sermon from the Bible, an opportunity to make Jesus the “Lord of your life”, kids and student ministry, welcoming people and a lovely diverse congregation. The Sunday I was there was the Sunday they announced that their building had been paid for. No more mortgage. Praise God. Great Pastor and the overall feel here is very welcoming. And the view from the upstairs patio is amazing. I stood out on the patio while I listened to worship and it felt very special Especially while listening to the Song ' You can Move Mountains' . One of the only churches in my life to welcome me in the fold. I love this church the adult groups and service our amazing love everyone I have met.

However I really think they need to improve their youth ministry our reconsider the one teaching middle and high school. Our kids attend the churches camp this week and I’m very disappointed at what we were told . The camp was nothing like we were told .  They played weird games and Josh told them they need to change what they wear and listen to if they are to really be close to God. These are young kids and the way they went about camp is not a great way to get teens excited about God.

What the leader told us. Leaders would be watching these kids well. They did not drinking and smoking took place. We were told they would communicate with parents about arrival and check in they did not . They told parents and kids there would be all these activities horse back riding rope course camp fire and snores . They did not do any of those things. During campfire/snore time that kids no snores or fire ever lit.Parents asked at the meeting if it was extra or we need to pay for that prior they said no. No phones where aloud but certain kids were aloud to have them out and leaders allowed it for some. Josh bought a large group of kids ice cream but not everyone. These are kids and  a Jesus loving community where they should have had fun and felt included. The teen group is very cliky and it makes it hard for some of the other kids . I really had hoped many kids would come to Christ at camp and had high hopes of the youth group and was very disappointed.Needless to say I really think more training is needed or better planing. I’m sure we could have come up with better games than stealing kids nasty socks off their feet. I really hope to see improvement on the youth group as everything else has been so great. We visited on Easter Sunday. It was a nice service. A friendly church atmosphere.

reviewSummary:
My wife and I are soooo happy to be back in az after a long 8 years in idaho and we sure missed pastor Mark teachings. We noticed that the people here at calvary phx they do carry their bible to service and actually follow what pastor Mark is talking about. Praise the Lord for our wonderful church. Jose n Veronica This is a fantastic church. The best preaching of any church I’ve ever been to. No fluff, just straight Bible teaching the way it should be. Incredible worship music! Today I visited Calvary on 59th, and it was such a meaningful experience. I was thrilled to see Pastor Mark again—he was the one who first introduced me to Calvary Church when I was just 13 years old at the Cactus & I17 location. His preaching helped lead me into a beautiful life of faith, and now at 55, I continue to walk in that journey.

Although I’ve lived out of state for some time, I’ve had the blessing of attending Calvary in both Las Vegas and Maui. The Maui location was especially memorable—worshiping on the beach was such a unique and powerful experience.

Thanks to Pastor Mark and the foundation he helped build, I’ve been saved for 42 years. Calvary Church has remained a constant source of inspiration and spiritual growth in my life.

Highly recommend this church to anyone seeking truth, peace, and a genuine connection with God. Amazing church. Holy spirit speaks to you. It' s a church where you will find your peace. Pastor Mark and Leslie are amazing God's people.

reviewSummary:

Luke 6:31 Ephesians 4:32 and finally Hebrews 13:2 maybe your guy who drives the little black car should review some scripture and be kinder to strangers, more so to those who have attended your church in the past. Shame on you.

reviewSummary:
I attended a Sunday morning service. I was greeted by several men and women. I felt that these members sincerely  listened to the reason for my visit.
I was very encouraged to look at the Bible as God's  story ( the sermon). What an uplifting experience ! Very welcoming! Enjoyed the singing and the entire experience was spirit-filled! I attended the Camelback Rd Church of Christ one Sunday during a bus trip of Southwestern USA. The people were very kind and I was made to feel right at home for Worship Service. I returned at 6:00 pm for the evening service. I spent the hour working with, and fellow shipping with some of the members and felt as though I had made some new friends before I left. Over the years, as a traveler, I have had the opportunity to make several "cold call" visits to congregations of the Lords Church. This one was memorable. A special thank-you goes out to Taylor and Carole, who showed extraordinary
kindness to a stranger. I hope and pray, that I can return one day.

Sincerely

Praise God and SEEK the Lord Jesus Christ!!!...PSALMS 34 We have attended twice there on 2 Sundays .. they made u feel welcome but very disappointed  that no one has called  us and side do u need anything or help or why u haven't been back or can u get here or anything... So sad 😢😪

name: Camp Creek Church of Christ - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
We brought 18 students to this church to speak with the director of security and to take a tour of the facility. The intent was to teach how to work with house of worship security when visiting with a client you are responsible for. And you talk about the dangers houses of worship faced today..

The director of security was an outstanding host and gave a thorough tour while sharing information about the facility, security, and walking the students through emergency procedures.

We were so impressed by the team at the church we are going to continue working with them and try to bring the resources they need to help them and their mission to protect the congregation. Great biblical family fellowship in SW Atlanta, GA. Love this ministry. Justin Wallace is both a phenomenal singer and preacher. This is a perfect church to learn, grow and add value. Great Group of people. Started fellow-shipping over 20 years ago. I was also married in this church 2011 My husband and I first worshipped here in June of 2016. We didn't know anything about the congregation when we set foot in the doors. Before the worship service reached it's conclusion that day we both decided we wanted Camp Creek to be our church home. The phenomenal people here know how to make newcomers feel at home. i love this church this past sunday was my first time going wuth my aunt barbra talbert and i grew up in a church of christ in plant city really brings back memories of when i was going to church with my grandparents i love it

name: Campus Christian Center - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful people and place, good coffee and good vibes. It's pretty neat place to visit for small groups that are held here. soaked in prayer and the peace of God rests upon this place! Very nice people

name: Campus Church - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary:
Afraid of outwardly expression here without it being awkward. Clapping is not a common practice here during praise. The most noise they ever made was for high school seniors graduating. I travel extensively throughout much of the U.S. and I've come to truly value a church where I am made to feel welcome, where I find true doctrine being practiced, and where I am fed.

I found all of these at Campus Church.  If you like to be with the Lord's people then you may enjoy a visit to Campus Church, as I did. This is by far the most hospitable and loving church environment my family has ever known. We have been visiting for only two services and already feel at home. Love going here! Dusty is a great pastor and my kids love going here and look forward to going there every week. I go to Church for my relationship between God and I..  I have been apart of many Communities and Churches.  Every one of hold dear to my heart.  This is one of them. 😁

name: Campus Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church. Great for all age groups & stages of life. The kids classes are well staffed. The preaching was wonderful with plenty of scriptural references. This is a place where Christians and families can thrive. The campus church is not just a college/student church, everyone is welcome. Campus Church in Pensacola, Florida is a large congregation (could be classified as a megachurch). The church is located on the property of Pensacola Christian College, however, the church is a separate and distinct entity in which anyone in the community can attend. The church is an Independent, Fundamental, Baptist Church and conducts services accordingly. They follow a typical order of service, starting with video announcements, a worship service with traditional and new hymns, corporate prayer, and then a sermon (typically expository) from the Senior Pastor Dr. Jeff Redlin. Although, the church typically does not include an altar-call style come-down invitation.

Campus Church has a variety of ministries it conducts. For adults, the church has multiple Bible study groups during the Sunday school hour. They also have Wednesday evening small groups that meet for a variety of reasons (Lifeshare book study, Grieving and healing heart ministry, Overcomer Conquer series, Woman to Woman ministry, etc.). For the youth, they have an active Teen group which meets on Wednesday evenings. They also have a nice Children's Sunday School program which utilizes Joyful Life curriculum (last I checked, this could be changed by now). The church also conducts a Master Clubs service for the children on Sunday evenings. Campus Church conducts a variety of other ministry events and community events as well.

Campus Church is a great ministry. Though, no church is without some drawbacks. The size of this ministry makes it difficult to have a church "family" feel. It is nearly impossible to meet and fellowship with the majority of the church as the student attendees leave periodically throughout the year and the church members are so vast in numbers it is difficult to build those relationships. Although, after you eventually build those relationships, the bonds created can be great. Ever since COVID, Campus Church has started heavily relying on technology (livestream, video announcements, QR code Gospel tracts, Online giving, Realm) to which I personally feel is negative to the ministry, however, that is an exceedingly personal opinion. There is no stated dress code for non-PCC attendees, however, it can feel very judgmental if you arrive in anything less formal than Khakis and a Polo.

Overall, I recommend Campus Church as a great Bible-believing church in the Pensacola community. Although, I would recommend considering the drawbacks, and weighing them against the positives of the ministry. This is not everyone's style of church, but it should be a church everyone can consider to call their home. HUGE auditorium with plenty of seats. Several big screens so you can see everything going on, and the sound system was very well designed. The music was God honoring and the message was well presented. Coming from a small church congregation, I felt "lost"/out of place, but we still enjoyed worshipping with other brothers and sisters in Christ. 💜 It is a large church, but their goal is not to have a big church. It is to serve God. The pastor preaches good, Biblical messages, and even though you could get lost in the crowd, they work very hard to make sure that you are seen and understand you are welcome and valuable. Oh we highly recommend this place. We came here with our 6 children. We have always listened to pastor Jeff on rejoice radio from Idaho but since we were going to Destin for vacation we really wanted to stop by Campus church. The orchestra was beautiful, the choir was beautiful, God’s word was spoken by pastor Jeff. It’s a blessing to be here. The parking lot for visitors is plenty enough and we were guided by the helpers outside when we told them it’s our first time. It really is a blessing if you can come to this church!

name: Campus Community Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: It was all through God’s guidance and provision when I first arrived here as an incoming freshman at the U of A, looking for a church near campus. Unsure of what to do, I began praying and seeking God’s wisdom while preparing to move into my current apartment and attend several new student orientations. Within just two weeks, a Chinese student approached me on a Friday evening as I was exploring the campus. We struck up a conversation, and they introduced me to Campus Community Church. Reflecting on it now, I can hardly believe it happened—I didn’t even ask for it, yet Jesus provided exactly what I needed and more. Praise the Lord, my God! Thank you google maps

name: CampusView Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been in this church since 2019. I really enjoy how much this church dedicates themselves to the Word of God. They really love to quote the Bible, and make sure that we are not merely listening to the words of a preacher. I love all the church events from small ones to mega big ones. Highly recommend especially if you are someone who wants to get to know God over religion or an organization. We have people of all ages, from young children to retired elders. I started coming to this church in August of 2025 and it is by far the best choice that I’ve made in my life. The church has taught me to have my own personal relationship with God. Just a great place to learn about the Bible and God. So Blessed to be a part of CampusView Church. They teach the truth only from the scriptures, a family/college age/ singles/ pros, ministry. Very warm & welcoming to all ethnicities. I’ve been a part of this church since 2021 and am so grateful for the vision and community this church is building. Gainesville is such a unique town and this church is such a reflection of the diversity of the town. We have newborns to adults in their 90s and everything in between. As a mom of young children, I am so grateful for the community of young families, the strength of the children’s ministry and the heart of the children’s ministry volunteers, the teens and campus who pour time and every into our kids, and the mature adults who can impart wisdom and shepherd us as we raise our family.

The location is amazing and so central to so many but can be an important part of UF Campus.

Bonus! My School has the best reputation in town for high quality early childcare and it’s in the same building The sermons taught here are clear to understand and directly from Bible scriptures. Those who preach seem to have done their homework from the Bible and other texts before speaking to the congregation. They also encourage the listeners to study on their own. The people are warm and welcoming and not everyone looks the same. It's definitely worth more than one visit.

This church is homophobic and unaccepting of all members. If you are seeking a community, love, and acceptance DO NOT ATTEND. Growing up in this church made me seek therapy in my adult life due to all of the trauma this place caused me. This church confuses me. Most people are friendly and nice, but there are times the pastor talks a lot about donating money to the church. I went to this church on Easter Sunday and not one person said, "Happy Easter." The pastor didn't preach about Jesus rising from the dead. Easter is the whole point of Christianity and Catholisim, but no one said anything about it. I don't know what this church believes in. Canaan church is the place where you and your family can receive the true gospel of God.
The minister is very well educated and respectful of others. He is very knowledgeable of the word of God, he is Excellent teacher! If you want to learn about the word of God this is the place to be. I use to go to this church when i was young. The teachers i had treated me so bad to the point where i’d cry. I’ve always been a shy kid but they made me feel worse. I don’t know why anyone would treat someone badly especially while i’m a church.

name: Canaan Oromo Evangelical Church
reviewSummary: They give Hot food daily, Fridays they give enough food to last the weekend, so blessed and grateful 🙏 This place is very blessed by our Lord Jesus Christ. this Church service is extremely moving by the Holy Spirit and I absolutely recommend coming to this amazing Service every Sunday from 2:00PM-5:00PM.

name: Canaan Presbyterian Church - Riverside Campus
Candlewood Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Candlewood Church for approximately a year and a half. During that time, Pastor Glen and his wife were initially friendly and welcoming.

At one point, I submitted a prayer request online regarding my marriage. Pastor Glen called me and remarked, “Do you know how many people see that prayer?” I shared a little about the struggles I was facing, and he responded that he would need to speak with my husband to hear his side of the story and determine whether what I shared was true.

Last year, I confided in Pastor Glen and his wife about the emotional and verbal abuse I was experiencing in my marriage, as well as my feelings of emotional abandonment. I also asked if there might be a church member with a spare bedroom for me and my children, since I was considering separation and did not feel emotionally safe at home. At the time, I nearly sought shelter at a domestic violence home but ultimately did not go.

Later, Pastor Glen called me and said, “Stop telling people I don’t care.” He told me that he believed I was harming my children by separating and insisted that my husband and I simply needed therapy and to “work it out.” I explained that we had already gone through several rounds of therapy without change. I asked him, “What do you do when you’ve tried everything, and your spouse still refuses to change and continues these behaviors?” He admitted, “I don’t know, this is beyond me.” After that call, I felt devastated. I cried, felt alone, and deeply hurt. I did not feel compassion, empathy, or support in that moment, nor was I provided with any resources or constructive solutions.

Shortly afterward, I discovered that Pastor Glen had shared details of our private conversation with his worship pastor, who then told my husband. My husband confronted me, saying, “I heard you didn’t like what the pastor said. Maybe you should listen to them and stop trying to leave me.” This left me feeling that my confidentiality had been violated and that the trust I had placed in my pastor was betrayed.

It is my belief that Pastor Glen may not be adequately equipped to respond to situations involving abuse. Advising a couple to stay together simply because the abuse is not physical ignores the real harm of emotional and verbal abuse, which can severely impact both the spouse’s mental health and the children who witness it.

I eventually left Candlewood Church after that experience. A week later, I found a new, supportive church community that listened with compassion, provided resources, and stood alongside me in my healing journey. That care helped me feel less isolated and more hopeful. Since leaving, I have had no further contact from Pastor Glen, and I never received any follow-up from him or his wife.

I am sharing my experience because I would not want anyone else to go through something similar—feeling unseen in their pain and unsupported in their time of need. Very sweet pastor and wife.
There for me when I least expected.
Thanks for going beyond for my families funeral 🙏 ❤️
You guys are such sweet Christian ✝️ pastors.
Nice family vibe Amazing church service, wonderful praise and worship service. Absolute stellar staff pastor glenn is one of the greatest pastors i've ever met!!! I highly recommend this church Great church ⛪️ 🙏
Wonderful place to be filled with the holy spirit and the pastors are very caring and been there for me when I need them.
I love this church.

Nice small group of Christians trying to follow Jesus and be a positive influence in the world. what that video explain it tho. kinda sus Excellent lesson, and fellowship!

name: Canvas - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
A jewel in our current world!
If you are looking for an authentic church with heart, look no further!
Unlike most churches, queer people, and everyone in between are welcome. Like, truly welcome!
And Not in the ostentatious way most churches say “all are welcome”.
This is a genuine place of worship where Love, Service and Community are placed at the forefront Love this church. The pastor is one of the coolest intellectual Christians I know. If you are looking for a church in the area that is simultaneously progressive and Bible based this hits that perfect spot. I have called this church home for a year now and it’s been one of the biggest blessings. It is filled with kind, thoughtful, authentic people who affirm and love ALL types. If you’re a person who has struggled the find a church in our crazy world, you should come try Canvas! We would love to have you. I can’t say enough good things about this church. The community is so warm, welcoming, and genuinely inclusive—it’s a place where everyone is truly embraced. The theology is thoughtful, compassionate, and grounded in love. For the first time in a long time, I feel like I’ve found a church home! I really wanted to like this church and was ready to jump, but sadly, I had a negative experience.

I wanted to bring my therapy dog, since we were going to volunteer at JWA after church.  (Daisy is one of the AirPAWS dogs that bring joy and stress relief to all).  So I wanted to be respectful and ask if she could come and all the powers that be said “Yes, but if this is going to be a long term thing, we’ll have to figure something else out”.  I told her we’d sit in the back, to minimize any distraction which we did.

I was greeted by the woman with whom I spoke earlier in the week (Debbie?) and she was lovely and greeted me warmly.

It is a VERY small church with about 40 parishioners and staff.  Well, if this where God wants me, I’m game.  (I come from Saddleback and Mariners Church, so it was a bit of a shock).

Daisy didn’t create a fuss, except for several people looked as if they were happy to see her.  One woman sat with Daisy on the floor for a good part of the service.

The teaching was fine, a little dry, but I could handle it.

It was sad to me that everyone was so unfriendly, except one guy that wanted to talk about Daisy.  I had to introduce myself to three people and their response was tepid at best.  Didn’t they want people to attend?  Was it because I was there with Daisy?

Walking out the same woman who greeted me was pleasant.  Daisy’s buddy throughout the service didn’t even respond when I thanked her for sitting with Daisy.

Like I said, I really wanted this church to work. My niece is gay, and I was excited to find a church that I could bring her and hopefully she would consider accepting Jesus-something I’ve been praying about for decades.  This was not it.

I really didn’t want to leave a review, but I couldn’t find a way to email the church.  I just knew I had to share my experience with them, so maybe they can be more welcoming in the future.

Its a wonderful to be a church that accepts the LGBTQ+ community and it would more effective if new people felt welcomed.

name: Canvas Christian Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been looking for this kind of church for so long. I call it a boots on the ground church. Jesus calls us to fellowship, and they do. They are actively serving in our local community beyond their church doors. No cookie cutter sermons. No cookie cutter serving opportunities. Real life. Real servants just like Jesus taught us. Loving. Kind. Caring. Believers. Now I don’t say they. Now I say we. This church would be great if the praise and worship team was replaced. It’s so painfully off key listening to them sing that I couldn’t get into worship. It’s so distracting from the goal and purpose of worship. I hope that you take this heart and not take offense. Everyone should operate in their own gifting and the leadership should guide them in that way. This could be a great place for a family to grow in Christ but visitors like myself could never make it past the singing.

“For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function, so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others. We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us. If your gift is prophesying, then prophesy in accordance with your faith; if it is serving, then serve; if it is teaching, then teach; if it is to encourage, then give encouragement; if it is giving, then give generously; if it is to lead, do it diligently; if it is to show mercy, do it cheerfully.”
‭‭Romans‬ ‭12‬:‭4‬-‭8‬ ‭NIV‬‬ Another fantastic Sunday of worship and music and preaching.  I love this friendly caring Bible based Church.  It truly is a family Great church with people who care about helping each other grow closer to God. Wonderful church!

name: Canvas Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Ben and Katie Brinkman are hands down the best source of Gods word. They preach the word as it is written and it’s true meaning with no spin. Ben has an amazing way of preaching the gospel and capturing your attention. He has a great sense of humor that will make the time fly and leaves you wanting more. They truly care for their congregation and make everyone feel as if they’re family. I’d press anyone to find a better place to meet God and learn the true Gospel. Come and see for yourself. You will not be disappointed. This is an amazing church. It’s big, but not too big. The Holy Spirit is moving through the pastors and worship team and all who attend. You just feel it. There’s a real sense of “family” there. It’s very diverse, it’s a beautiful mix of ages and races and nationalities and backgrounds…no one will feel like an “outsider” there. This place fully and GENUINELY embraces the command to love God and love others. I am so thankful God led me to this wonderful community of beautiful believers and I am so excited to grow in my faith journey with them! Positively wonderful! I went to Canvas after not attending church for over ten years. I'm so glad I did. Warm and welcoming. People I never met prayed for miracles for me! I couldn't believe it! The pastor is knowledgeable and compassionate. His sermon was practical.
I'm still healing from much brokenness and much loss and heartache. I was convinced God abandoned me and I spent 13 years living like that. I'm so grateful I found such a loving church. No judgement...Such a loving, loving, LOVING place! They won't give up on you the way other churches would. Margo was fierce in her love and understanding. Amazing Church!! It’s by far the best one me and my family have been to. It’s definitely an amazing experience here than how we were treated at our old church. I would highly recommend this church because the people are very welcoming and so kind and the pastors are amazing people who bring a powerful and amazing word. This church deserves a 5 star rating and I would recommend this church to everyone. Love this place.  Have gained a whole new family.  Pastors Ben, Katie, Steve n Cathy are all beautiful, genuine people.  The family here is very diverse too which makes it super comfortable no matter who you are or what your situation is.  We all love Jesus and you!  Come check us out!

name: Canvas Community - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: Really good day shelter to get a hot meal. Friendly volunteers there and brother Paul is a very good person.  They have a calming, special prayer group that was really great. ( be aware that their schedule is a bit complicated, usually posted on the door - might be because they do the bridge to work program as well). Great place to eat and get help God is in that place I went here one time because its literally never open. I am thankful for that one time but literally they only feed like once a week. Which isnt enough to bridge the gap of a lack of resources in the Little Rock area. I was disappointed to see they have so much to assist the homelles but never opem to really assist the average homeless person in the area. Unless u attend the chuch.... Go figure. Thsts the problem with non profit chirch orgs. They do enough to feel like they helped alittle and that all they do. Help alittle. Overall great meal once a week ,warm space, thats it. If you are looking for a unique church that embodies Christ's teachings to feed the hungry, clothe the needy, stop by some Sunday evening at 5:30 for our service, open to all. Brother Paul has my upmost respect. Hymn and canvas are blessing to the community and do the homeless and people in need.

name: Canvas SF - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
The most welcoming, community and service oriented church we’ve been to in SF!! Gorgeous location in the Presidio (easy parking🙌🏼), welcoming people, amazing worship, sermons, and events all month long. We love Canvas! Canvas is the most welcoming and accepting church I have ever been a part of. It feels authentic, real, and honest. In past churches I’ve attended, I used to be the one to come in after worship and leave before the service ended to avoid any mingling. At Canvas, I’ve met the most incredible community and friends. The sermons are incredibly encouraging and transformative and the worship is great! Canvas SF is truly something special!  From the moment I walked in for the first time last year, I was met with a level of warmth and welcome that immediately stood out. After being part of the community for some time now, I can confidently say that experience is genuine and consistent.

There is a unique quality to Pastor Travis’s sermons. They are engaging, relatable, and often feel especially relevant to what you may be walking through. He thoughtfully addresses the realities of our day to day lives, especially within the context of living in San Francisco, and consistently brings it back to a meaningful invitation to live with intention, in love, and as followers of Christ in this city we are fortunate to call home. His approach is both thoughtful and practical, and it creates space for real growth.

One of the things I appreciate most about Canvas is the culture of authenticity. You are welcome to show up exactly as you are. Whether you are just starting to explore your faith or have been on your journey for years, there is a genuine sense that you will be met where you are. It is not about being perfect. It is about growing together in a real and supportive way.

Canvas has played a meaningful role in my personal and spiritual growth, and I am incredibly grateful for that. The community is filled with kind, welcoming, and authentic people, and there are many opportunities to get involved, whether through events, groups, or simply building genuine connections.

As an added bonus, it is located in one of the most beautiful areas of San Francisco, the Presidio, with stunning views of the Golden Gate Bridge just a short walk away! So many reasons to love Canvas!! My experience with finding the "right" church has been exhausting but I started attending Canvas when I moved here 5 years ago. My husband had gone for some time and I really wanted to support him. I love how each message is connected to our current life- it really feels like an hour of motivational speaking!!! For someone who is still exploring their faith, Canvas exposes you to the lessons of the bible in a gentle way (not the shouting, shoving down your throat, or passing around a money basket lol).

Other reasons why I love Canvas:
- I love volunteering for the Kid's program (Canvas kids)
- Travis & Jena are so warm, genuine, and real people!
- He'll throw in a few jokes :)
- I love the messages every week
- Donuts & coffee!
- The space is large and comfy
- LOVE the live band (everyone is so talented and it makes church music really fun!!)
- Travis officiated our wedding and supported us throughout our engagement and marriage :)
- The variety of groups that you can explore/join to build a deeper community. I've only been attending for about two months, but Canvas is already proving to be the community I've been searching for. As someone who finds beauty and truth across several world traditions, I was looking for a Christian church that holds other faiths with genuine respect and love: not as a performance of tolerance, but as an expression of its own convictions. From the Indian Vedas and Judaic concepts woven into Pastor Travis's book, to the way every human being is spoken of with dignity regardless of their path, Canvas SF shines with an openness that feels deeply, authentically Christian. It's a very special place, and I'm excited to keep putting down roots here.

Little bridges preschool, after school care, summer camps are also available on site. Warm & friendly pastors & congregation. No politics, very real
with a fantastic praise team. The congregation is friendly, the message is Christ Centered, the programs are wonderful for the kids! Wonderful place to be only housing is too expensive for me but its really beautiful

name: Canyon Hills Friends Church & Canyon Hills Childcare - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
Very good fellowship. Meant to write this review for a couple of years now. We were here for a few sundays but then moved to another fellowship to be with families of kids friends. Good word and genuine fellowship! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our family has been truly blessed to be a part of Canyon Hills. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were met with warmth and genuine hospitality that made us feel right at home. This small, personable church fosters a welcoming atmosphere where everyone is embraced like family.

What sets Canyon Hills apart is not just the incredible sense of community but also the amazing family events hosted throughout the year. These gatherings have given us the opportunity to connect with other young families, forge meaningful friendships, and create lasting memories with our son. It’s heartwarming to see our child grow and learn alongside others in a nurturing environment.

The teachings here are deeply rooted in Christ and the Bible. Each week, we are inspired by the insightful messages that resonate with our lives, providing us with guidance that carries us through our daily challenges. It’s a true blessing to be part of a congregation that emphasizes growth in faith and encourages us to live out our beliefs.

If you’re looking for a church where you can feel at home, connect with others, and grow spiritually, I highly recommend Canyon Hills! We are grateful to be a part of this wonderful family of believers! Friendly atmosphere. Very welcoming pastors and staff! The congregation feels like family!  If you are new in the area and looking for a church where you can feel part of the community, I highly recommend checking out Canyon Hills! I can't say enough wonderful things about Canyon Hills Friends Church. My husband and I wanted to find a community in a church closer to home and that's exactly what we did. In a short period of time, Canyon Hills has become home to us. God is in every part of this wonderful church from the Sunday messages, to the prayer events, outreach, worship ministry, and children's ministry. The people are genuine as is their love for individuals, the church, and God. Added bonus...Our son loves the children's ministry and asks constantly to go to church. So much love for this place! I have felt welcome in this church from the moment that I walked in the door, it truly feels like home. They live up to their motto of “Not a place you go but people you love”. They offer multiple activities throughout the week for all ages. No matter where I have been in my walk, Canyon Hills has always had a something that fit my lifestyle. Come say hi, I promise you won’t be disappointed.

name: Canyon Ridge Baptist Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I look forward to coming to church each week at Canyon Ridge!  We've grown so much in our relationship with Christ through the faithful Bible preaching and teaching.  I love the music on Sundays, the prayer times on Sunday evenings, and the small group Bible studies on Wednesdays!  Wish everyone would come here, experience Canyon Ridge, and grow in Christ . . . ! Been going to this church for over 15 years, I've grown up with it for basically my whole life, they are always loving and supportive! It has a great youth group for teens and an amazing children's ministry for younger kids! This place worships the pastor more than they worship Christ. Literally teaches about “obeying and yielding to pastor.” Creepy! Stay away from this cult! I came here multiple times but I can’t anymore. I’ve been attending Canyon Ridge for the past 8 months, and from the moment I stepped onto the campus, I felt genuinely welcomed and deeply loved. The sense of community here goes beyond fellowship — it feels like family. I’m truly grateful for every person I’ve met. Each sermon is rooted in Scripture, and there’s never any question — it’s the truth, straight from God’s Word.

If you’re looking for a church to call home, come visit — you’ll see for yourself. Whenever I visit San Diego, I always look forward to visiting Canyon Ridge! The church is so welcoming to everyone. The pastor and his family have been a huge encouragement to me as I've gone through a difficult time. The preaching always is both encouraging and convicting and comes straight from the Bible. I'm so thankful for the impact this church has had on me and would recommend it to anyone looking for a loving church in the San Diego area!

name: Canyon Ridge Christian Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment the instruments began to play and Rosie began to speak, the Holy Spirit was present and moving! It was the most impactful service I’ve experienced in awhile. Kristi did a beautiful job with the message and The Word will not return void. (Not to take away from the great messages we have been hearing for the last year - I love Pastor Drew and the other pastors on staff)  Today, the Spirit  continued to move after the service with those that stayed to pray and continue to worship after communion. The praise team was filled and anointed this service. If you need a place to worship, you really should try Canyon Ridge Christian Church. There is a place for everyone. I love  their Saturday 4:00 pm service.  May God Bless,  B. H. I visited Canyon Ridge Christian Church for the first time on Sunday 12 July 2026.  I was in Las Vegas for a short vacation and woke up that morning wanting to be in the house of the good Lord.  So I googled christian churches and was led to Canyon Ridge Christian Church.

GOD makes no mistakes and I was blessed with the sermon from Pastor Drew Moore and enjoyed the total atmosphere vibe and friendliness of the congregation. The music and singing from the choir was beautiful and I felt very welcomed.  I began my day at Canyon Ridge Christian Church and the remainder of my day was also blessed.  I felt the good Lords presence....with all the faith and praise in HIS HOUSE.

I plan to visit Canyon Ridge Christian Church on my next visit to Las Vegas.  The service was truly a blessing and I knew I had been led to the right Church ⛪️

Have a blessed and beautiful day to Pastor Moore and all the congregation of Canyon Ridge Christian Church ⛪️.
Brenda Wilson-Franz This has been my church for about 20 years now I’ve seen pastors come and go, but our pastor Drew, who is the current pastor, has such a unique way of touching all of us. I encourage you to go. They have a Womens Bible Study. They have a men’s Bible study they have daycare for children, while you’re attending service. They have a hiking group and many others. This is the best church in Las Vegas aside from Central Christian Church its Sister Property. I do encourage you to come and check it out yourself. God Bless I loved this church. It was the only church we've been going to since we moved here in Vegas. There's just some missing piece that's needed for the church pastors and leaders to do. To preach the gospel of "Revelation". We are near the end times, and a lot doesn't know anything about end of times. This should be added to the preaching. Have some time to pray with everyone regarding the calamity that's going on, pray for the affected nation. I've been waiting until a pastor will preach this, I know some may walk out and not hear it. But Jesus promised to come back and He will take his children with him, but if no one know that Hell exist the Revelation will tell the truth. Thank you. Excellent worship center with volunteers eager to assist us with our wheelchair access requirements.  A young man provided us with a movable chair that I could use to sit next to my wife.  Plenty of parking, handicap parking, a small area to get coffee, clean restrooms, and an amazing area to worship Christ.  The lesson/sermon and the references are displayed onto the big screens.  On the back of every few chairs is a bar code that I believe will take you straight to the notes of the service.  We enjoyed their praise and worship team and the pastor's message and will be attending service here again

We are near the end times, and a lot doesn't know anything about end of times. This should be added to the preaching. Have some time to pray with everyone regarding the calamity that's going on, pray for the affected nation. I've been waiting until a pastor will preach this, I know some may walk out and not hear it. But Jesus promised to come back and He will take his children with him, but if no one know that Hell exist the Revelation will tell the truth. Thank you. Excellent worship center with volunteers eager to assist us with our wheelchair access requirements.  A young man provided us with a movable chair that I could use to sit next to my wife.  Plenty of parking, handicap parking, a small area to get coffee, clean restrooms, and an amazing area to worship Christ.  The lesson/sermon and the references are displayed onto the big screens.  On the back of every few chairs is a bar code that I believe will take you straight to the notes of the service.  We enjoyed their praise and worship team and the pastor's message and will be attending service here again

name: Canyons Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: We really appreciate the welcoming and non-judgemental spirit of this congregation.   The music is amazing, Pastor Matt speaks inspiring messages weekly and our children love the children and youth ministries which are energetic and instructional.   I'm certain you'll fall in love with this church too. I had a hard time finding a church that truly kept its focus on Jesus, until I found Canyons Church. The messages are powerful, the pastor is engaging, and the sense of community is real. I got baptized here and finally felt what church is meant to be. The leadership, worship, and tech teams are all incredible. If you're looking for a church to call home, give Canyons a try and you won’t be disappointed. My first visit to Canyons Church and I was so impressed. Everyone greeted me and welcomed me as if I was part of the family. The worship was spirit filled and I felt the presence of God during both the worship and the sermon. I love that they went straight into the word following worship. Pastor Matt delivered  scripture rich sermon, and even packed in some humor keeping it light and engaging. I took notes and received greater revelation that will impact my prayer life. I was invited to their community charity event following service where I got to participate in preparing gifts for children in other nations. It was such a joy to be welcomed into this community and I look forward to making Canyons my home church. We’ve really enjoyed being part of Canyons Church. It has a welcoming, community-oriented environment that makes it easy to feel connected. Pastor Matt shares thoughtful and encouraging messages each week that are both practical and inspiring. We especially appreciate the children’s ministry—it’s engaging, well-organized, and clearly focused on helping kids grow in their faith. There are also plenty of ways to get involved, whether you’re looking to serve, join a group, or just connect with others. It’s been a meaningful place for our family, and we’re happy to call Canyons Church our home! I feel blessed that we found this church. It is a very family oriented place. The kids ministry is absolutely amazing. Our 5 year old literally counts down the days to Sunday. The pastor and his wife have a genuine gift for connecting with people in a simple way and truly helping us grow closer to God and overcome life challenges.

name: Capital Church
reviewSummary:
I’ve been coming to Capital Church for almost 5 years now. I came to this church during a time of desperately needing a community and church that allowed me to see a different perspective of who God is and what was happening in my life. I cannot begin to tell you how many people I’ve told to come to this church since. Everyone’s response is the same. Which is that was literally the best church I’ve ever been to. This is a church based on Christ & love but also not staying the same and growing through Gods love. This church is freaking AWESOME. Pastor Troy is a true man of God. He has such a way of communicating Gods word with love, compassion, humor and feeling like you can become a better version of you through God & Christ. The community here is also just as heavenly. Each sermon begins to teach me another way of how I can elevate my mind, heart and spirit. If I didn’t have this church I would not be who I am today. Seriously. I love this church more than words can describe. Thank you Capital team. You all know who you are🥹 I love all of you thank you for giving us all a space we can feel up there down here 💛 We have been attending this church for about 3 years. It's such a wonderful place to go. The kids activities are always fun for my daughter and the sermons are always amazing. This is an amazing, non judgemental Church with a welcoming and warm community. The lead pastor Troy is inspiring and thoughtful with wonderfully delivered messages that seem to be meticulously prepared just for me. They also feature a very good praise band! There is a satallite service in Park City on Saturdays but if you are in SLC, why not try it this Sunday! Thank you falls so short of what this little church deserves. They’ve embraced my kids as their own. Building them up and guiding them spiritually. Given them opportunities to lead and serve. The message is always heartfelt and there’s a simple warmth to everyone on staff. A gem of a church. “YOUR SHAME IS NO MATCH FOR GOD’S GRACE”
Easter Sunday message, powerful and inspiring. I am sure it was what many needed to hear I know I did, resonated deep.
For anyone wondering if God is loving, kind and forgiving YouTube the pastors message it is one I would highly recommend.

name: Capital City Christian Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: Tom Underwood remains a guide to me on what a Christian should be like in the modern day. And while I go to a different church nowadays, I want to thank you so much Tom for your example! Friendly folk. Great pastor. Relevant topics. Contemporary music. A welcoming congregation will make your visit a joyful experience, especially for the Seniors among the community Great place of worship! Glory to GOD 🙏 My first time coming and I love here

name: Capital City Church
reviewSummary:
Just moved to Cheyenne and this was the first church i attended. It was Easter weekend and the people just stood during the singing and the pastor gave a service lacking any emotion and looked angry! I want to see love and happiness and this church was the opposite! Getting hard to find a church here! Great to listen to the messages from Pastor Karl. Very friendly Church and great to fellowship with others! Attended a service this Sunday with my wife and 3 small children. What a welcoming environment! We very much enjoyed the message and my kids loved it! Highly recommend Capital City Church. I have attended First Baptist Church with my wife and her parents starting about 35 years ago. My wife and I stopped attending during the phase when the church went away from traditional service’s.
Her Parents attended and were very active members for over 60 years serving in the choir, on committees and teaching Sunday school for a number years. As they grew older my father in law would still attend and tied. My mother in-laws Health  reached a point that she no longer could attend. Slowly my Father In-law has reached a point when he could only attend a few Services a year.
At no point in their declining years did any church member contact them or offer to help them make services.
My mother in law passed away this August 2021 and when my Father in-law contacted First Baptist he was told that the church did not have anyone to conduct her funeral service even though not date for the service had been set.
I gave two stars for the early years of the Church. I don’t know if I’ve ever been more disappointed in a church then the way First Baptist treats their Elderly members. Went to service today for the first time, it was decent. After i sat sipping some lemonade at the largest table in the center. Not one person came up to greet me or say hi. There was a song in the service about no fear in gods love. So either they do still have fear, or they lacked the compassion to greet a stranger. Such a shame. Where is the love?

name: Capital City Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: Myself and the kids enjoy this church ! The kids literally remind me almost everyday that on Sunday we are going to church! Pastor Ben and Shelly are wonderful people and make you feel at home. Everyone is amazing Great atmosphere, great place to begin your spiritual journey or continue it.  Everyone is friendly and makes you feel welcome.  The church also tries to be involved in the community.  Its a smaller church but it provides a big impact.  I have been attending the church for over a year now and I am proud to be a part it, to see it grow and how it continues to impact people's lives for the better. intimate setting. I truly enjoyed the teaching style & could feel Christ love in atmosphere. Was looking for diversity & found just that here. Just small enough to not be overwhelmed. Hearts pure as gold here. Capital City Church is a small but vibrant church body that seeks to honor service in Christ while serving local residents in Baton Rouge.  I was seeking a bible focused church where I  am not just another pew sitter on Sunday, but rather an active member of advancing Christ's call to us in Mathew 28.  I welcome you to come and check out an upcoming Sunday service, I have know Ben and Shelly for almost 10 years now. They are two of the best Christ followers I know, and I can’t think of better couple to plant a church in Baton Rouge! I would highly recommend Capital City Church if you live in the Baton Rouge area or surrounding regions!

name: Capital City Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Matt is genuinely an anointed man of God. The people are welcoming and friendly, anyone in the building will pray for you at the drop of a hat.
Worshiping the one true God is a key focus here. I love this place, and am grateful the Holy Spirit led me to choosing this as my home church! Felt more like a concert than it did church. If you like to read off scripture I would not recommend. Sat in service for about 45 minutes and all they had done was played worship music. No hate like Christian love, huh? This church purposefully lights up their tv sign every night. Their sign so bright it blinds drivers and is also a huge light pollution problem for wildlife. It is unnecessary and vile. Shame on your lack of morals and care for your community. The Spirit of God is freely flowing through the anointed people ministering and arriving to worship in this building. I am excited to get involved in the smaller Bible study groups in order to get plugged in and grow up into the plan and purpose God has for my life. There have been wonderful testimonies of healing that encourage me in my faith. Bless God, I think I found a home! My husband and I are so  happy to be a part of this church family. If you just need a hug or someone to pray for you, we are here for you. Come join us....we have an awesome children's church and you will always receive an anointed message from our pastor. Be ready to be blessed!

name: Capital Community Church
reviewSummary:
Capital Community Church is the most welcoming, nurturing, family oriented, genuine church home that does an incredible job displaying the love of Christ as well as their commitment to showing up for the community. Every time I come here I experience a powerful move of God and leave changed. Wonderful staff and members who have gone out of their way to provide a nurturing environment. the church has not only hid my previous review addressing their greed but also deleted a response they drafted where they said it was to combat "crime" so allow me to use the scripture here for a second:
This church has chosen to allow towing in a low-income neighborhood — under the pretense of “security and maintenance.” In doing so, it has aligned itself not with Christ, but with oppression, economic cruelty, and the abuse of power.

Let’s be absolutely clear: this is not godly behavior. This is not love. This is not justice. This is exploitation.

Many of the people impacted by this decision are already struggling. people doing their best to survive in an uncertain and trying economy. Towing their vehicles isn't just inconvenient; it can be catastrophic. It means losing the ability to get to work, take children to school, reach healthcare — or simply live with dignity.

“Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.” — Proverbs 14:31

This policy is contempt dressed up as care. And the removal of previous critical reviews only reinforces what this is really about: control, not compassion.

“Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees, to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people…” — Isaiah 10:1-2

You can’t preach about Jesus — who ate with the poor, healed the outcast, and flipped the tables of the greedy — while enabling policies that crush the very people He stood for. You can’t sing songs of mercy while your parking lot becomes a trap for the vulnerable.

“You have dishonored the poor… Is it not the rich who are exploiting you?” — James 2:6

If your “security” measures only target those who cannot afford your exorbitant charges for passes , then what you’re really protecting is power — not people. Jesus didn’t die so churches could become agents of economic punishment.

“You have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy, and faithfulness.” — Matthew 23:23
“Do not exploit the poor because they are poor… for the Lord will take up their case.” — Proverbs 22:22-23

To the leadership of this church: if you care about being a true light in this community, reverse this policy. Stop hiding behind maintenance and start practicing mercy. Because until then, your actions preach louder than your sermons. As a fairly new resident to the area, relocating from PA to VA. I found to be very distasteful that a, "Community Church" would be hustling the Community. This is in my opinion, a Biblical sin. The ridiculous fees to park in their parking lot was my first red flag. However, I convinced myself, because I'm so desperate to find a Church home, to visit anyways. The entire service was about paying tithes and offering, and rebuking members who chose to pay theirs elsewhere. Even my kids were uncomfortable because of it. Yeah, for me and my house, it's a "NO." WE ARE LOOKING FOR A HOLYGHOST FILLED CHURCH, PLEASE. IF ANYONE HAS ANY RECOMMENDATIONS. Its a wonderful church with wonderful people! I am glad I joined this church! I find it incredibly distasteful for a church to be charging a parking fee. Very unwelcoming and unchristlike. Mark 10:25.

name: Capital Life Church
reviewSummary: A modern, diverse church community in the heart of DC offering contemporary worship and strong community connections.

name: Capital Life Church
reviewSummary: Diverse, spirit-filled congregation in Arlington welcoming ambassadors, students, and young families with vibrant worship and authentic small groups.

name: Capital Life Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church. Everyone is so friendly and makes you feel welcome. They also have a great young adult program (C3). My husband and I have been attending the church for about a year and a half and are so glad to have found a community away from home. The pastors are kind and give clear messages. We also attend the C3 (young adult) small group, which allows us to delve deeper into passages. The church also offers many outreach opportunities, which we love. Since we have been going here our faith and relationship with God has grown and we are so appreciative of those who have helped us along the way! Visiting from out of town! Recommend this amazing church to a local! Can’t wait to visit again when in DC! We have found a great community here. C3 was a great place to start as a couple moving back to the area and looking to get plugged in. I have volunteered with student ministry for 3 years and it has been so life giving. I love those kids! Bill and Lisa are very approachable, Julie has poured into me, and I have felt supported by other areas of the church like prayer ministry (thank you Victoria and Paul!). If you have kids Andy will make you feel welcome immediately and I have cherished his support over the last three years. One of the best parts is the worship team- they are phenomenal, but it’s not over the top such that I feel the meaning and purpose is lost. This is a genuine church with a lot to offer! I had the pleasure of finding Capital Life Church while I was temporarily in the DC area. Thank you God because it was such a great environment. Everyone was so welcoming, the worship was great, and the sermons are always very informative and very sound. I am currently out of country, but I’m still streaming the sermons on YouTube.

The church is very involved in the community and outreach. There are also plenty of groups and plenty of ways to serve. If I am ever in the DC area again, I know I have a church to go to!

name: Capitol City Church
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church! Been going here since I was a child. Ive never felt uncomfortable or out of place. The atmosphere is amazing and so welcoming. You don't have to dress fancy or anything which I think adds to the comfortability as well. This is our Church!  We have been attending since 2019.  My children and I were Baptized at Cap City.  The entire Church staff is AMAZING! If you don't have a Church do yourself a favor and attend a service, Pastor Rick, Jared, and Brandon are the BEST! Grandkids had great fun at their Easter Egg Hunt.  The volunteers were all very helpful and nice. I listened to the service online which I really enjoyed so I started coming in for service. I have a five month old, so I tried to put her in daycare and the daycare is overwhelmed with kids and not as many volunteers as I would feel comfortable with. So I tried to nurse my daughter in the designated nursing room which was very cramped and I end up missing the message the last three times I have come. Great church great people, but I am debating if I should just continue to watch online? Im not trying to be critical I just am a single mom so I really look forward to just having 40 minutes where I can focus on God and not feel so overwhelmed with responsibility This church is one of the best Bible preaching churches I have found in the Des Moines area. I never walk away feeling judge just loved and inspired. They are a God-fearing church and you can tell the moment you walk in.  Every week they preach the truth directly from the Bible which I appreciate so much. I feel like we found our home church for many years to come.

name: Capitol City Church Of God In Christ - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
I am a member of this church and I have been a member of this church my entire life. The people here are really friendly and they have never changed through all of those years. They are very helpful and very approachable. Is a small Church home feeling. You don't have to get lost in a Congregation of huge numbers were no one but a handful know your name. They are very helpful to your family and very welcoming. The Pastor and church family are down to earth. The services are very spiritual and anointed. I love my church, Capitol City! Come and visit us, you won't be disappointed!! If you want the word of God and get feed spiritually definitely come. You won’t leave the same way you came in. Great worship experience...
Always love the pastor of this church Supt. Robinson...

name: Capo Beach Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. It's very warm and welcoming. Come as you are. Doesn't feel Judgy. Music is very good. Have always missed pastor Chuck and I enjoyed pastor Craig's sermons. I pray it remains a warm church to attend for many years. A corrupt church. If you want to understand the truth of this church, go look at all the 1-star reviews that have been pushed down by questionably fake and pressured 5-star reviews. This church and current pastor, Matt, has pushed more people away from the lord and the community than any other church we have been to. Even worst, about a year ago, they wrongfully fired the long-time pastor and spread false malicious lies about him to some of the church members. They degraded a man who served 50 years at the church and poured his life and soul into the community - and the whole community loved him. Not only did the current pastor, Matt, plot against him and spread nasty things, but he refused to let Pastor Craig, the old pastor, speak and say goodbye. He also lied to the people of the church regarding Craig’s absence. Most likely out of fear that Craig would reveal the truth of the current pastors lies and sacrilegious behaviors. Lastly, if you read other reviews, you will see the pattern of the current pastors, Matt’s,  efforts to threaten and act in a gray area. I can assure you, we will never return. This was my first time going to this church people are very friendly what would be expected out of a Christian would love to concern about you also I love the service the song worship even though I'm not of the denomination but I am going back to Arkansas to my church pay that I come back to California for another visit I would visit this church again thank you I have been part of CBC for about 6 years now, and one of the most incredible things about this church is that my children are truly known. Every Sunday when we walk in, multiple people greet my children and me by name. The youth leaders and many leaders at CBC know their names and their stories. To be known and loved in your church community like that is so special and often rare.

The leadership at Capo is exceptionally strong, both the newer leaders and those who have faithfully served the church for decades. The new worship pastor, JC, is outstanding. Each week I genuinely sense that the worship and prayers in worship rise to the Lord as a strong incense (Psalm 141:2).  There are more hands raised in worship now than there has ever been (since I have been here) at this church. Lead Pastor Matt is an incredible Bible teacher and speaker. I appreciate how he consistently brings historical context into his teaching and calls the church to action. I love that he speaks directly to the congregation rather than relying heavily on notes; as it makes the message feel so much more authentic and engaging. Rod Mayer, who has served at the church for over 40 years, leads the youth ministries with incredible energy, joy, and reverence for God. The heart of the youth program is not only that students know the Bible (though that is deeply valued) but that they truly EXPERIENCE God. Students are given opportunities to serve and encounter the Lord in real ways.

One of the best things about this church is that they take God’s Word seriously when it comes to caring for orphans, widows, and those who are often overlooked or not usually welcomed. They truly are a "house of mercy" and never shy away from that calling. In Orange County, that kind of commitment is rare. This church genuinely welcomes and SERVES anyone and everyone through its doors! I am truly so grateful to be part of such an incredible church community! CBC has been my church for over 13 years.  I have been to many churches in my life time but when I walked through the doors of CBC I found my home.  Pastor Craig welcomed my blending family with open arms.  Later to Baptize myself and my 2 daughter and then 6 years ago he Married my amazing husband and I at our home in front of 130 witnesses, blending a family of 6 ♥️  Which was amazing !  Pastor Dan has been our marriage Counceler for 7 years now 🙏 keeping my husband and I connected to the Holy Spirit and our marriage strong through and with the Lord.  I am forever grateful to have found CBC 😇  my life has changed forever !  Thank you I feel so safe
