name: Captivate Church - Point Loma Campus - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
This place was absolutely wonderful! I came today, Palm Sunday, for the first time and had an absolutely amazing experience. Everyone was so friendly and kind, the service was stirring and the environment felt pleasant and welcoming. "Connect to Captivate" at Captivate Church of San Diego.

Come as you are from wherever you may be and in the name of Jesus Christ may you be set free that you may be free indeed and you will indeed find freedom!
-Amen

P.S. parking can be sparse so come early or enjoy a brisk morning walk ‍
#DontWalkRUNToTheCross Seeking a New Home Church – A Testimony from This Morning

We’ve recently been stationed in San Diego and have been prayerfully seeking a new home church. This morning, we woke up ready and excited to gather in worship and hear the Word of God. We decided to visit Captivate Church in Point Loma for the first time.

As worship began, I did what I always do—I closed my eyes, lifted my hands, and entered into the presence of the Lord. I opened my heart to the Holy Spirit, allowing Him to move in me as I sang, prayed, and worshiped. I felt a deep sense of joy and peace—the undeniable presence of God covering me.

When the worship ended, I opened my eyes and my daughter leaned over to whisper in my ear. She told me that the people around us had been pointing, whispering, and mocking the way I was worshiping. Her face fell, and she began to cry—feeling judged, excluded, and grieved instead of embraced with love, unity, and grace in what’s meant to be the house of the Lord.

Two women in front of us continued to whisper to one another. I gently leaned forward and told them, with respect, that I didn’t appreciate the way they were whispering and judging me while I worshiped.
I explained that I meant no disruption or offense—that I was simply moved by the Holy Spirit in how I chose to worship. I encouraged them to take any offense they felt to God in prayer and left them with a blessing. All they had to say was “you were being disruptive”.

I reminded my daughter that we don’t go to church to be accepted by people. We go to meet with God, to receive what He has prepared for us, and to walk in truth, love, and righteousness. I told her not to let judgment or mockery distract her from the presence of God. People may try to put us in a box—but God calls us to freedom, not performance.

Even though the experience with those around us was painful and disappointing, I still received the Word that God had appointed for us that day. He met me there. And for that, I’m thankful.

This experience reminded me that the Church is not perfect, and sometimes people can bring in judgment instead of grace. But instead of carrying offense, I’m choosing to lay it all at the feet of Jesus and pray for hearts to be softened—mine included.
We’ll continue to seek a church where the Holy Spirit is welcome, where worship is free and full of reverence, and where people are embraced, not silenced. We attended the Wednesday night service and absolutely loved it. Pastor Wes was a guest pastor at our church the previous weekend, and his passion, knowledge, and energy really stood out. He felt so genuine and real that we were motivated to come visit his church and we’re so glad we did.

From the moment we walked in, everyone was welcoming and kind. The atmosphere felt warm and inviting, and God’s presence was truly felt. It’s clear this church is growing and moving in the right direction, and it’s exciting to hear that they’re even opening another location nearby.

Our daughter especially loved the children’s ministry. The teachers, Mr. Landon and Mr. Brock, were incredibly welcoming, and she had such a great time that she asked if we could come back.

We really enjoyed the service and look forward to going back again. Thank you for creating such a loving, faith-filled environment for both adults and kids.

- Jason & Amanda I visited Captivate Church in Point Loma last Sunday after running into my friend Nathanael, and I’m so glad I joined him. From the moment I walked in, it felt very welcoming and comfortable. The service started with uplifting music and then moved into a powerful message from the Bible that connected directly to everyday life. It really spoke to me and left me encouraged. Overall, it was a great experience and a perfect visit. If you’re looking for a church home, I would definitely recommend checking out Captivate! Captivate Church is the community you’ve been searching for.

I’m not sure who will read this, but if you are looking for a genuine, Christ-centered church, this is it. Pastor Wes, the lead pastor, fully embodies Captivate’s mission to end spiritual loneliness. His messages are deeply profound, relatable, and always rooted in Scripture and the teachings of Jesus Christ. What makes Captivate so powerful is its focus: every sermon points back to Jesus—not personal opinions, not interpretations shaped by politics, not self-promotion—but the true Word of God.

Ending spiritual loneliness is no small mission, and I can say from experience that Captivate lives it out. I’m young, multiracial, and a California girl, and yet I feel completely at home here. So many churches today seem to adopt divisive ideologies or push political agendas, turning worship into commentary on culture rather than a reflection of who Christ calls us to be. Captivate is different. Pastor Wes is different.

For a long time, I stayed away from organized religion because of how far many churches had drifted from Christ’s message of love and humility. I was spiritually lonely, trying to navigate my faith on my own. It may sound strange, but I don’t know Pastor Wes’s political stance—and I’m so glad I don’t. What I do know is that he loves people, respects everyone he meets, and leads with humility. He doesn’t pretend to speak for God; instead, he helps us build a relationship with God ourselves.

If you’re looking for a church that’s truly about Jesus Christ—not about “the extra”—Captivate is for you. In just a few months, I’ve met so many wonderful people, brought friends, joined serving teams, attended weekly events, throw my hands up in worship, and volunteered alongside others from church. It’s been such a blessing and a true community.

That said, I do want to share one honest concern in the hope it helps leadership grow even stronger. I’ve experienced two supporting pastors who don’t reflect Pastor Wes’s example and sometimes bring political opinions into their messages. Unfortunately, their words felt divisive and not in line with the heart of Captivate’s mission. I’ve had to walk out of services when the focus shifted from God’s word to personal ideology. I say this because I know what political stances they take and I question how much these particular pastors respect all people, how well they live out the virtues of the Bible, and whether they love all as Christ calls us to. From what I’ve witnessed, they use their platform to speak for God on political matters—something no one should do. That is not what church is for, and not what Captivate stands for.

I share this not out of judgment, but from love for this church and its mission. I pray all pastors at Captivate follow Pastor Wes’s lead—keeping the focus on Christ, not current events or opinions.

Despite that, I truly love this church. It’s authentic, welcoming, and centered on faith. I give here because God moves me to, not because anyone pressures me. I serve here because I believe in what Captivate stands for—community, love, and the true Word of God.

If you’re searching for a church home that is genuinely about Jesus, come to Captivate. It has changed my life.

reviewSummary: Enjoyed the concert, loved the many Christnas tree's that were on display. There were two noticeable areas were there could be improvements-- the way tickets are obtained. They have wonderful  guest performers who have fantastic resumes and they come from other areas and military concert bands etc.  There was an amazing saxophone soloist brought in today who was amazing. My son plays with them  as well as other groups and this is one of my favorites. I have attended since 1976. It is a strong Bible believing church. We have Sunday school for all ages and Bible studies through out the week. The pastor is a humble man and preaches only the truth from God. The music is a blend of traditional and contemporary.  I love it here. Great church, true biblical teaching. Very friend and welcoming. if you are looking for Gods caring people, if you want a place to grow in the Lord among nice people this is one of them, thanks

name: Carmel Christian Church ( Disciples of Christ ) - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: A church that welcomes you, wherever you are in your faith journey. I've attended Catholic, Presbyterian, and Methodist for years. Carmel Christian, Disciples of Christ is the first church I felt comfortable becoming a member. After a long search, I’ve found my church home! Welcoming and inclusive, the ministers Jerry and Diane are enthusiastic and positive. The congregation has made me feel like I belong here from the beginning. Good first time try for people who may feel intimidated or lost in a “mega church”. Open and loving congregation. All are welcome. Blended service and casual attire is the norm. Come as you are. Communion every week open to all. Fellowship refreshments every Sunday. Occasional special lunches with all invited. Nursery and Childrens' Church during service. Very friendly church and warm welcome. I would invite everyone to come as you are! Wonderful sermons, beautiful music, friendliest people with loving hearts. All are welcome.

name: Carmel Church San Diego - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: You know I liked this church. I did the rooted program I volunteered with maintenance and helped out for their productions which are every weekend with the bounce houses. It's a good church good people. But Jerry and his wife kept bringing politics into the sermons and the church, And I don't care if it's voting season or not don't be talking about politics because Jesus is the only politician Jesus is the only leader that we need all these human leaders they're all the same they're all garbage no matter what their intentions so I left this church and I found a much better one with a lot more laughs but God bless to these guys hopefully they'll find their direction that isn't with the government . They say they live by the Bible. However, do NOT ever question it or quote the scriptures that contradict what they teach. I made that mistake and I was literally escorted out of the service by Pastor Nick and Pastor Gabe and told that I am no longer welcome to attend. Never in my life have I ever been kicked out of a church. It was utterly ridiculous and embarrassing. What is even more shocking is the lead pastor taught on forgiveness about 2 weeks prior but apparently that doesn’t apply to everyone. I do NOT recommend this church. Jerry the Lead Pastor  stopped by to shake my hand and welcome me. Went back a second time and I have been going through some things as we all do. Just when I needed it Veronica came and introduced herself and took me to Associate Pastor Toby who prayed with me on the spot. A man named Mike saw that happening and came right up offering his words and special message he felt lead to give. Words can not express how much I needed that support today. I know where my tithe is going. This church and its members are the real deal. Thank you guys from the bottom of my heart.

Offering to take my boys to thier area so I could grab a much needed coffee before service. Wendell , the youth pastor, was incredibly hospitable and even followed up with me via text. Jerry the Lead Pastor  stopped by to shake my hand and welcome me. Went back a second time and I have been going through some things as we all do. Just when I needed it Veronica came and introduced herself and took me to Associate Pastor Toby who prayed with me on the spot. A man named Mike saw that happening and came right up offering his words and special message he felt lead to give. Words can not express how much I needed that support today. I know where my tithe is going. This church and its members are the real deal. Thank you guys from the bottom of my heart.

name: Carmel United Methodist Church - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary:
No effort is made to INCLUDE nearby residents 65 and older.  They claim “OUTREACH” as a mission but mean they provide video streaming. Elderly can donate money on line for projects and mission but have NO WAY TO CONNECT WITH PEOPLE- the one thing we desperately need. No Bible study leadership, no Communion. Unable to serve with others at the Pantry or Kitchen.  No way to attend “special” music or celebrations.  Most of All - no way to be with people.
If you are 65 and older BE PREPARE TO BE ISOLATED FROM YOUR CHURCH IF YOU CANNOT DRIVE.
Sit alone, watch the service, sing by yourself, watch communion,, Remark about the sermon to yourself,  Feel the warmth of people worshiping together -ALONE.
There are not That many who would appreciate a ride, pay for gas, pay for your bus!
I have re- read your mission statement.  It should read, “. We want to connect with people as long as it doesn’t take up any of our time.  Old people are too much trouble to pick up. They are slow, mentally or physically or both.  If they can’t get here on their own, too bad.  We will happily take their tithes and gifts as well as money they leave to the church when they die.
Just as Jesus said, Love God and Love one another- if it’s not too much trouble… Great family church. Lots of groups to get involved with. Missions include the on-site food pantry, kids coats, and many other local and far away projects. The youth group is one of the best youth groups I have ever seen with many fun activities, seasonal retreats and  mission trips for the students. Preschool Rating Only. Great place, very organized,  professional, and friendly. They meet every kid and adult at the door and seem to recognize each. My interactions is from taking my nephew there, and he is doing great. Learning a lot. This church is amazing! They were voted the 2020 Best Place to Worship in Carmel by the Best of Carmel Awards! They have something for everyone. I especially love their Youth and Children’s Programs! I was referred here by a church member for help. Not only were we blown off in an emergency/one time situation but we were spoken to with pure disrespect and hate.  Never would we expect this from a Church of God. I think they should watch who they hire in their church because what they have now is ruining the good they represent.  I'm more sorry for the members of this church because I dont think they really have a clue on who they are dealing with behind closes doors.

name: Carolinas Christian Assembly - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary: Great place for authentic worship and Indian fellowship. It is a beautiful congregation with a great Pastor. We feel like family here. This is a great church! The preaching is great and the pastor is very passionate!  The worship is in multiple Indian languages and English as well! Great for Indians in the Charlotte area! We have been so fortunate to be part of this church for last 15 plus years. We were especially blessed by the Sunday schools (adult & children), inspiring messages and youth activities. Lots of opportunities to grow in Christ as a church family. This church helped me grow stronger in faith and helped me get closer to God. Everyone welcomed me as a family member and I felt like I belonged here to worship the lord with all these amazing spiritual people. This church is very welcoming, and has great Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, and English worship. So glad to be part of this church family!

name: Carolinas Cornerstone Church - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary:
While building a home in Baxter Village, our family took several months to visit all of the churches in the area.  We found Carolinas Cornerstone to be a friendly welcoming church in the Fort Mill area. Whether you are dressed in jeans/t-shirt or a dress, there is a comfortable welcome kind of feeling at the church.  The praise music is excellent, and Pastor Barry has a Bible-based heart-warming message carefully prepared every Sunday, usually around a theme for the month. You will also find a dynamic group of ladies who attend an uplifting retreat at the beach every spring, an awesome children’s ministry, men’s groups, and relevant life groups offered nearly every day of the week.  Please join us…and see for yourself. When I moved to the Fort Mill area a year ago I was looking for a bible believing church with preaching that would help me grow in my Christian walk. After visiting eight churches I stumbled upon Carolinas Cornerstone because I was running late to another church and saw they had an 11:00 service, so I decided to give it a try even though I had not checked it out online first. After attending for a few weeks I didn’t want to search for another one. This church gave me exactly what I was looking for. It is a warm, welcoming church family that truly cares about each other and a preacher who preaches with passion. Thank you, Pastor Barry, for all you do for our church family. We appreciate you so much! Amazing church! Pastor Barry Yates sacrifices so much time energy and money to build Gods Kingdom and help others.  He is amazing! He will go to the end of the earth to love, encourage and help others. He has blessed my family and so many others. He is a pleasure to be around all of the time.
I highly recommend this church. We have been members of Carolinas Cornerstone Church for over two years and have found it to be a wonderful church family.  It is a very loving church whose pastor cares so much about people and their christian life.  In my lifetime I have never been involved with a church that is so mission driven to help others and share the love of Jesus Christ.  Pastor Barry preaches inspirational sermons that are easy to understand and meaningful in our everyday lives.  This is a church experience that needs to be included in everyone's life. We've been coming here for over a year. It is the most wonderful church community one could ask for. Pastor Barry is a truly caring and engaged shepherd for his flock. I for one am proud to come here, and proud to have a pastor like Barry Yates.

name: Carrollwood Baptist Church
reviewSummary: We were searching for “Baptist Church Near Me” and Carrollwood Baptist Church came up.  Our family has been attending this small church for 6 years and could not be happier.  We wanted a small church so that we don’t feel like we’re just a number; at Carrollwood Baptist Church we feel like we are part of an extended family.  We moved to Lutz and still attend Carrollwood Baptist Church.  Wether you are looking for a Baptist Church near Carrollwood, a Baptist Church near Lutz or a Baptist Church near Odessa; Carrollwood Baptist is just amazing and only a 10 min drive for us.  Their program for children is amazing; they have many activities for children and just a blessing to be a part of this small church! Love the upward basketball program during winter over here. Everyone was so friendly. They not only teach the kid basketball but they teach them about god and how to be nice to others. I am impressed with this church, so much that it is going on 25+ years now. We raised our family in this church. From infants in the nursery, to the youth group which 2 of my children are in for another year and one for two more years. God has blessed this church and the families in it for sure. I can attest for the love of God, faith and family in this church. You need to look no further, come, join, and worship God the way he had intended it to be. Jesus is the light in this church for sure. A pastoral staff, including the retired pastor, and most pastors that have moved to grow other churches, they eat breath and preach the word of God, not just in there preaching and teaching, but in their personal life. I can attest for this, and my children can also. They are a great example of God raised by a loving caring church. May God continue to bless this church to do its great will, and love its members as he has done since its inception. Praise God for Godly men and women who rise up to lead. Love you all Allen and Patsy, A.J., Justin, and Jaime. I am a member of Carrollwood Baptist Church and am happy to say God has used this church to meet all my spiritual needs. The youth program, which meets every Wednesday from 6:00-8:00pm and Sunday from 9:15-10:15am, is amazing. During a rough time in my life, Hunter and Pastor Matt helped me grow in my walk with God. I gave this church 5 stars because it, along with the special people that work here and the family of believers, hold a special place in my heart. The senior pastor, Dr. Joe Alain is a truth speaker and preaches God’s word clearly. I have also had the privilege to be on the tech team while at CBC and enjoy the opportunity to serve God in this way. This is the best church ever. The members here truly know the love that Jesus has for them and they show that to everyone. No matter who you are or where you’ve been you are welcome here. You will hear true Bible based teachings and you will grow in your knowledge of the word. My kids  also love going. It is a blessing to attend this church.

name: Carrollwood Bible Chapel
reviewSummary: Great people, great fellowship, and Christ honoring and glorifying. We love this chapel. The teachings are according to the bible. It's a non-denominational. Very respectful to the word of God. We normally congregate in another chapel in Spanish as is our first language. But when we can't do it, We go to this this one as they are identical in regards of the clean and good teachings of the word of God. I hope you can enjoy  it here and congregate with the other brothers and sisters in Christ. God Bless you all. Lovely fellowship of believers, so friendly to guests!  Blest time of remembering the Lord and ministry of the word.  I learned a new chorus: “Jewels”, which I shall always think of this sweet place when I sing it! The brethren here are carrying and supportive, nothing short of a blessing and kid friendly as well! Lovely people who live Jesus in their lives. Beautiful property.

Much love always my 1647 family i love you guys.. And if you're ever near hear feel free to walk on in When the gates are open... Nothing but love Get your church on

name: Cary Church of Christ - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: I visited this church in 2011 after speaking with one of the elders who took the time to answer many of my questions & concerns. Shortly after, I invited my family & we are still members here. The CCOC is bible-centered & are a very loving family. I highly recommend. Their deacon over “local missions” is petty and goes around giving 1 star reviews to churches that they don’t agree with. Is that his “local mission”. Churches with leaders that are more focused on belittling other churches than building relationships and making an impact on their community clearly don’t understand God’s message. Older gentleman driving a Cayenne S, license plate 911 USMC, needs to control himself. Nearly sideswiped me before he cut in front, braked, then tried speeding ahead. Imagine my surprise when he pulled into the church parking lot. I doubt his boorish behavior reflects upon the congregation as a whole, but one bad apple spoils the bunch The ladies day this year was a success I thoroughly enjoyed myself I enjoyed the speaker I enjoyed the fellowship with the ladies and the lunch was delicious A place of worship anchored in the teachings of the Holy Bible

name: Cary First Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I’ve been a member of this church for four years, and it has truly been a blessing in my life. The praise and worship are uplifting, and the sense of fellowship here is genuine and welcoming. Pastor C leads with both spirit and truth, preaching every Sunday with passion and complete obedience to God.

My church family is loving, caring, and authentic. We support one another and grow together in the Word. I wholeheartedly invite anyone to come experience the love, the community, and—most importantly—the presence of the Holy Spirit. I love this place!

I have been a part of this church for some years now and it has rewarded me with numerous community service opportunities, friends, and a closer relationship with God. You can really feel the love of Jesus Christ in this church. The pastor of this church, Rev. Mycal Brickhouse is one of the greatest pastors I know. He is extremely smart, very loving, an extraordinary preacher, and a true man of God.

I pray that you find a great love for this place like I have!  I’ve been listening to the virtual services for years (pre-pandemic) and they do a great job making everyone feel involved. Excellent preaching and such a nice community! This is literally the most welcoming church I have ever stepped foot in—these folks inspire me to true hospitality! This is an amazing ministry that walks in unity & love to engage, empower, and equip Gods people to become disciples for Christ!

name: CASA Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this church around February three months after my father passed away, i was currently in a bad mental and spiritual shape. I came to CASA with no expectations what so ever.
I never even went into a christian church before.
From the moment i arrived i was received with smiles and hugs, i felt how LOVE ran through their veins and all they cared about was each other and everyone that came in through their doors.
Once i was sitting down for my first ever service i found myself resonating and falling in love with the each song that was sang but once the pastor (Ezequiel Fattore) gave his teaching i was amazed, i have felt like he was speaking directly to me.
I fell in love.
Once the service was done and i wiped all of the tears off my face, i told myself that i wanted more.
So i went ahead and started servicing CASA.
CASA is not a church, this is a family we love and care for each other.
CASA has opened my heart and made me fall in love with god, they have opened a new chapter in my life.
I am Internally Grateful.
I love you CASA for all you have done for me.

So do not be scared to come, grab our hand and we will walk with you in ever step of the way, and do not worry because we do not let go.
What they did for me they can do for you.

Ps: Here are a couple of pictures of my family. Me and my family love casa church so so much, and all thought we haven’t been able to come in person (yet) since we live 3 hours away we watch every Sunday online and we love it. This has been our church for years and honestly although we haven’t been to many churches physically where we live none have the atmosphere and the way of predicar (teaching) that casa church has, everything about it just special and it really does live up to its name and make you feel at home I’ve been going to this church for the past 10 years and counting. This is where I fell in love with God. I owe this place and it’s leaders and pastors so much. In my time as a Christian I haven’t found another community like this one. You’re not joining a church you are joining a family with Christ. You feel so good when you come in here. People greet you nicely, are attentive and make you feel welcome. People care and pray for you. It’s also a great place if you have kids for them to grow with a great community and have leadership opportunities surrounded by Christ - loving individuals. I wouldn’t be where I am today had it not been for this wonderful church and community. Love you guys so much. Thank you for everything you’ve done in the past years. 💯❤️🙏🏼 This is a place where without religiosity we are invited to have a relationship with God. I went to this church after watching a sermon called “empezar de cero después de una herida”. However, when I went on Wednesday night, It felt more like a social club than a church. Not to say that community and activities are not important but the word of God must be the priority. The leaders of these groups did not seem prepared to lead a Bible group. The Bible says that leaders will be judged more harshly so I would be careful with who you are letting lead groups. Also, I shared a personal experience that a family member was going through and I felt pity and lack of genuine care or follow up after. I felt uncomfortable. Definitely if you are going through something keep it basic. If you are going to church is to feel welcome and embrace by God’s family, there are still a lot to learn in this church. However you should go to the main service and remember that even when community is important and we should build relationships, we go to church to worship God and understand the word. There is work to do in this church. I hope this church does not become like Sardis or Ephesus churches mentioned in the Bible. Praying for your leaders and for your church.

name: Cascade Hills Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
My mother chaquinta introduced me to this church back in 2025 when I was going through a hard time. I’m now pregnant and me and my boyfriend has made this our home church and a promise to attend every Sunday at 11am. Everyone is full of joy and good spirited. It feels very welcoming no judgement at all. First time here. My daughter and her husband brought us here for Easter ceremony. This is the regular church. They live in Alabama and travel 30 minutes to come here every Sunday.
This Easter ceremony was held in the Columbus Civic Center. Enjoyed the service and the people tremendously. Very open-minded very welcoming very appreciative of everyone that attended.

Next year, if it is held here, I will have to bring a winter coat due to. It is held over the ice of the hockey team. That is there.

The message was good. The music was phenomenal and looking forward to coming here again upon visiting my daughter.

Anyone in the area that is traveling highly suggest given them an opportunity. A non-denominational church that is very welcoming. This church is a blessing. The spirit of God is in this place. How can I be sure? I’ve had countless top of mind things I was pondering,  read about or pray for and Brent gets up there and it will be that very topic. Not generalizing, specific!! The place is really laid back and feels like my home church from out west. They have wonderful book store and individual group meetings throughout the week. This church is on fire for Christ. Never once have they called me on the phone or pressured me. There welcoming and loving. I don’t highly recommend you have to go at-least once. this is the church to check out. Praise was awesome and the sermon was great, but I will not put my child through another sermon. Registered beforehand and showed up early as recommended. Hung out in the “Frogs” room with my 2 year old so that he could acclimate. He seemed to be doing ok, so I said goodbye and left to find the main service. Given directions on where the elevator was, but that was it. No one to help guide a new visitor.

50 minutes into the sermon, I was asked by an usher to give up my seat that was on the end of an aisle. I had sat there just in case I got a message from the nursery person and could leave quickly. I saw it was for an older person and said sure- and when I got up and looked, there were plenty of open seats in the back. I contemplated just leaving and picking up my kid, but decided to go to the very back and sat there. After a moment, the older person that had taken my spot asked to move to the back where I was. Just some weird decision making on the usher’s part.

And I should’ve listened to my intuition to leave early. When picking up my kiddo from the nursery, they told me that he had been sitting in the corner playing with some cars by himself the whole time, which is totally out of character for him. He did eat some goldfish, but they had decided since he wasn’t interacting with others (hello, he’s new??? And 2???) that he didn’t need a diaper check at 12, which was when they said they usually check. Lo and behold when I go to change his diaper, there’s poop dried to his bum and who knows how long he had been sitting in it since they didn’t have the courtesy to message me to let me know what was going on. Plus at pick up, it looked like there were some kids MUCH older than him (maybe 4-5 years old?) playing in the same room.

Sure, they have a nice cafe and a playground, but what difference does that make if your child will be neglected while in their care. I am deeply disappointed by the way this church has treated a single mother and her children, who are on the autism spectrum. Instead of showing compassion, understanding, and support—values that are central to any faith community—their actions came across as dismissive and, at times, harassing.

Families with neurodivergent children already face unique challenges, and places of worship should be safe, welcoming spaces for everyone. Unfortunately, this was not the case here. The lack of patience, empathy, and basic kindness shown toward this family is concerning and does not reflect the inclusive and loving environment that many seek in a church.

I strongly encourage the leadership to reflect on how they engage with vulnerable members of the community and to pursue greater awareness and sensitivity when interacting with families of children with special needs.

No family should feel unwelcome or targeted in a place that is meant to offer peace and support.

name: Cascade United Methodist Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s Sunday morning before 8:30am services, Thomas R Wright is an Uber driver with a flat tire who pulls into your church parking 🅿️ with a passenger in the car. Uber sends a new ride for the passenger and leaves the driver stranded. Your staff walks to the window, “I see you have a flat tire, services are about to start. you’re going to need to move your car.” Spare is located at home 45 minutes away. Can anyone help us get this tire 🛞 to him? he is still stuck in the parking 🅿️ of Cascade United Methodist church 3144 Cascade Rd Atlanta GA 30311 please Help?!? It’s 48 degrees outside. He’s cold, weary and cranky! Was stuck from 6:58am until 12:30 pm. They should’ve offered coffee, donuts and warm place to sit while her was waiting. They should have offered to pray over him. They should’ve invited him inside to go to the bathroom.  What happened to n God’s people takin care of God’s
people? Visited the Church for a concert I am a resident of Georgia but the people or staff at the Church are rude my son who was with me has four children so the concert was a little long for the kids so in order to settle them down he saw that they had a candy dish at the welcome desk so he went outside to pick up three pieces as he was getting the candy a security guard yells across the vestibule to say that it was not put there for that in saying that he embarrassed & humiliated my son I feel embarrassed that the city that I’m from can be so trivial for a candy dish
My question is why put the candy out if you are policing what is taken out of it and to top it off by the time the concert was over they had removed the dish from the desk not good hospitality cascade united I attended the "Cascade Music Under the Stars" production featuring Avery Sunshine and Yolanda Rabun.

Both artists delivered exceptional performances.

The weather cooperated and the venue was excellent. I haven't visited but the grounds are kept clean I plan om visited in the future I did not know it was the mission of the church to tell a broken down cold uber driver that they needed to move from where they were in the parking lot.

name: Casco Bay Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
Been a Christian all my life but this is the first church I've found where the members are like family truly and are all committed to learning to love like Jesus.   Check it out once.  If it's not for you God bless you.  If you like our loving family,  welcome. I have been a member of this church for almost 15 years and will sing its praises to anyone who will listen! I have been spiritually fed by the relationships and biblical teaching and have had ample opportunities to serve. Thank you to USM for providing us with a centralized, easy accessible location with plenty of parking! Love this church, as does my children! Was here for 3 1/2 years before I moved. The community is like a family I haven’t felt anywhere else! Everyone is reading their Bible, trying to be more like Jesus on the daily. I grew a lot, went through a lot with them by my side, and had so much fun I love this church! I've been going for about 6 years and I just enjoy the fellowship, the interesting and convicting sermons, and the heart of the congregation. If you show up you're instantly welcomed by the ushers and members. You'll never feel lonely either as it's easy to spark up conversations. Church members are diverse in every way and overall create this fun and family feel. Come see for yourself and you'll be glad you did! :)

PS: They also have big potlucks monthly with AMAZING Chefs! ;) I am so grateful for this body of believers. The emphasis on being an apprentice to Jesus and living in genuine community with one another has been such a blessing to my family.

My sons enjoy the kid's class and their faith is growing and they are building great friendships.

name: Castleton Christian Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a wonderful church! The pastor Jarrett Samuels preaches from the Bible. He doesn't do puff pieces! Amazing people that love you no matter what  very friendly and welcoming. CCC is a growing church with dynamic preaching and contemporary worship. It has a great program for kids and youth. Bible based. Small groups. Relaxed atmosphere. My kids played in their basketball league for years and then we have been members their for over 3 years, great family church, wonderful people I go this Christian church every Sunday, the services are always uplifting the people that go there are very nice
The pastor, Jarrett Samuels is very friendly and leads his congregation with a better understanding of God and Jesus.

name: Castleton Community Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Recently moved to Indy. Everyone at Castleton so far has been very friendly and welcoming, and I've made new friends quickly. They have lots of events and groups, and multiple services helps with the Sunday morning rush. Great environment! Great church with people who genuinely care for and love others. Not to mention that the people there also know and understand the Bible really well. My wife and I have been going for a couple years. We love the fellowship and preaching. #Family Such kind people. We were welcomed and felt so comfortable. Very friendly folks.  Solid Bible teaching church.

name: Catalina Church North | Christian Church Tucson - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
Honestly, one of the best church experiences I’ve had. The first time me and my wife came in we expected to slip in the back row and not be spoken to as that has been our experience at many a church. However, as soon as we got there we were greeted by a kind man named Ted who talked to us for sometime and made us laugh a bit. We then went into service, and that same kind, humble man walked up on stage and began to preach.

What a refreshing breath of air to be met with such a loving, fun community. Sermons are straight from the Word, no funny business but a lot of funny jokes. In a world of extremity in churches swinging one way or the other; this church focuses on the love and truth, not bending or compromising His Word to fit what’s convenient for man.

A few months later and we have many friends and a home church I brag on to my family about. So, so grateful we stopped by one Sunday.

If you’re thinking about trying a church or just trying church in general, give this one a try. You will neither be condemned or be asked to give money; but there’s a good chance you might make some friends, have a good laugh and hear a good word. I’m so grateful I found Catalina Church North through the reviews. It truly lives up to the praise! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at home. The teaching is heartfelt, grounded in Scripture, and easy to connect with. Pastor Ted is amazing, genuine, wise, and relatable. His wife Jenny is just as wonderful. She’s so kind and warm, and you can really feel her heart for the people. One of the things I love most is how much this church values connection and community. Everyone is kind, approachable, and intentional about making you feel like part of the family. My daughter loves coming too, which means so much to me. I’m so glad we found our church home! My husband and I recently found ourselves looking for a new church, and though it can be intimidating to walk into a church where you don’t know anyone, we were welcomed with warmth and kindness as if we’d been attending for years. It’s a great place to go and feel right at home, with thought-provoking sermons and a lovely congregation. I love this church!  Start your Sunday sipping coffee with friends while your kiddos learn about Jesus through games and interactive stories.  Connect to God with a worship band that should be touring.  Listen to a powerful sermon from the Bible with people that aren’t afraid to laugh at a seriously funny pastor.  You could go home afterward, but it’s too fun connecting over food in a place where people are genuine, kind, and living a life of gratitude to God.  There is openness about struggle, a culture of pressing forward, and friendship that reaches outside Sunday.  Jesus is alive here. I enjoy being greeted with a smile, a hug, coffee, and donuts.
I love the way the sermons connect to our everyday lives, there is humor, sadness, joy and unconditional love.  The way they are presented makes it so easy to apply to everyday life.

We are a community of people who care about each other. We are a family here.

This church is very family oriented.

There activities for the children that brings Gods word to them on their level of understanding.

There are faith based activities for the teens and college students as well.

There is lunch after church. We eat and socialize with each other. We pray together.

name: Catalina Foothills Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
We started attending Catalina Foothills Church (CFC) in 2025 and have been so blessed by this church and community. CFC has applicable and well thought out expositional preaching, meaningful worship, and a vibrant children’s ministry. We have been particularly blown away with CFC’s ministry focus on families and parenting. Their Loving Mom’s Class and Strengthening Dads Class are so helpful in instructing, growing, and encouraging community for moms and dads. CFC is very passionate about caring for and instructing the family, it has been the best representation of Titus 2 we have tangibly experienced thus far in a church. And the treasure to add to this, is that I know my kids are also being taught and cared for SO well during as I attended the mom’s class and women’s Bible studies! The children’s ministry leader, Heather, runs this ministry with such love, intentionality, and care! Other ministries that we feel CFC really excels in are women’s, senior/elderly, and grief ministry- to name a few. As we have walked through the membership process, the elders and church staff on a couple different occasions met with us to get to know our family (and for us to know them/CFC), this is a church that is committed to knowing its members personally. We thank the Lord for leading us to CFC to plant deep roots for our family! I heard about this church from a member that goes there.  She raves about it.  So I tried their Middle School Super Week (like a VBS) for my oldest son.  I cannot tell you how impressed I was with everything from the initial emails with Youth Director Chris Holland to Welcoming Committee at drop offs dancing to music.  My son LOVED this experience.  The campus is beautiful and everyone I met was so kind and loving.  We will be back!  Thank you Catalina Foothills Church! This is a nice house for worship.  Each congregation needs a home, and this one is nice! Had a chance to play in the kids' room due to a wonderful staff noticing me entertaining my grandson. So thankful as we were there for a celebration of life. Music, singing, worship.  This church understands how to engage an entire congregation in singing.  I have longed for a hymn based worship service where 4 part singing done with passion n meaning. The 1st of two services delivers that and more.

The lead K. understands that worship is different from a performance and has special gifts which results in rousing singing from those in the audience.  I feel as if heaven is opened each Sunday.

The singing is has energy and volume so a non singer can join in without feeling they would stand out.

Just fantastic! I love this church! I was not been able to attend church regularly for many years because I had a job that often required travel on Sunday for Monday work. But even though I was not a weekly attender, church members would often greet me warmly, and many would even recall my name when I hadn’t been to church in a month. The pastors and church staff are equally warm and accessible. But what really sets this church apart for me is the excellent Bible-centered preaching, which never fails to teach me something from God’s word and often deals directly with issues or questions I have. I give this church my highest recommendation.

name: Catalyst Church
reviewSummary: I came today for my first time and cried like a baby. Everyone was so kind and welcoming, the pastor was so funny and made everything so relatable! The atmosphere was just beautiful. I’m excited to come back next week! Catalyst Church is a special community of Christ followers conveniently located in Bethesda. My wife, daughter and I started attending in the fall of 2022 and we immediately knew this was our church home. My daughter LOVES the kid's ministry and my wife and I have developed so many meaningful friendships through Catalyst's many (many) community groups. It's rare for us to miss a Sunday, but when we do, we REALLY miss it. Catalyst makes it so easy to serve others using the gifts God gave you and in all they do- God comes first. Do yourself a favor and visit this vibrant, healthy and very blessed church. I moved to the area a year ago, and I feel so blessed to have found Catalyst Church, a place I can now call home. God is on the move here! 🙌🏼 I’ve seen lives healed, touched, and transformed, including mine, as I came closer to the Lord. The pastor's messages address essential topics, including relationships, work, finances, family, and more, with practical applications. People here are friendly and have a beautiful service posture. The church believes in the power of corporate prayer and genuinely cares about the community, hosting “Serve Days” three times a year. Every new season, there are numerous small groups to get involved in, creating safe spaces to take the mask off. The church is also a place that encourages you to grow spiritually and use your gifts to serve. Highly recommended – 5 stars! ⭐️ My family and I have been attending Catalyst Church for about 2 months. We have truly enjoyed the messages coming from Pastor Jeremy and his lovely wife. The messages are powerful and Pastor Jeremy and his wife are very real and transparent about the challenges they have faced and gone through. It is quite refreshing to see their genuine love for the Lord Jesus Christ and their realness every Sunday during the message. I fully appreciate the fire of the Holy Spirit that is seen and experienced from this new and growing church. Catalyst has been a blessing to our family. Thank you for being obedient to the calling of the LORD🙌 Such a warm and welcoming church.  Catalyst is a beautiful church community that has so many ways you can get involved, find support, and grow.

name: Catalyst Church | Woodland, CA - Woodland Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I love this church! This church is for those that don’t know about God, new believers, and those who have been Christians for a long time! This church loves and cares for the community! They do chili cook offs, the back to school carnival for the whole city and we have made amazing friends! Pastor Matt is phenomenal and always gives a message that is current and relatable in every day life! Definitely check this church out! As a new and senior member of the community, I'd like to thank you for the warm welcome I received at Catalyst!

The worship, Bible study and community service are shared and for all ages. Your words have encouraged me to introduce my friends to this church, and I intend to become more involved this year. Im from Woodland but had moved in 2013 to Stockton prior to my husband departing to heaven 8.21.23 weeks ago sold the home so I could come back to Woodland to be closer to my daughter and grandkids, rather than staying in Stockton. I was attending a church here and for some reason or another I ended up going back to Crossroads of the Valley in Stockton which I’ve loved and attended since 2013. This am about 3-4 ish am I was awaken with the thought of check out some churches in town. So I’m being obedient and doing just that. I’m as honest as can be so I’ll start by saying that ugh the welcome was not there, I  came to the door the girl says good morning I  responded with good morning but she didn’t say much else until I  said I’m new here just checking out if this is where I belong, she was smiling and seemed sweet. I had to ask “where do I go“ so she gave me direction just go through that door and pointed. I passed Quiet a few people as I walked in and not one said a hello god bless or anything for that matter. I went in sat down and people all around not one person said a word. I  then text my niece and said I  think I’m going to leave I’m not feeling this lack of welcome it feels like I intruded in someone’s gathering. Then a couple walked in ugh I forgot her name I’m so sorry but he was tall named Lee. After a while another nice woman came and introduced herself again forgot the name I’m so sorry but her husband and her are the couple who stood to the side to be available for us if we want prayer. However; other than that the sermon and the way the Pastor delivered it was fantastic, I’m the type of daughter that loves to acknowledge when the word resonates so I do say things during the sermon like “that’s right, amen, thank you Jesus” and I feel the sermon was the Lord revealing to me that going back to the beginning Joshua 1:9 (paraphrased) do not be discouraged. To me is meaningful more so since my husband passed over. Today Joshua 2 revealed that no matter what we do or who we were prior to being saved and accepting the Lord as our Savior doesn’t matter for God can do anything in us through us and for us if we are wholeheartedly willing to do His will even in the midst of my pain and sorrow. I know for certain that I am Only here today because I’ve been clinging to Him because life without my love my best friend is not what I ever Expected in all reality I just Felt God brought us together and He’s taking us together. Well that may have been our plan not Gods. Also the worship was different then I’m used to but I loved it and MOST IMPORTANTLY I FELT THE PRESENCE OF THE HOLY SPIRIT.  God is in this place regardless of the lack of welcome. If there is anything I can do to assist in this area please let me know.   Thank you Lord for revealing so much in one sermon and worship. God is good and He never makes mistakes. Pastor Matt always delivers a great message that is relevant to real life. The entire team at Catalyst are welcoming. I just completed my first small group experience and it was great getting to learn more about the church and the people who attend. I love how this church cares about the community we live in. It took me a long time to find a church in Woodland that fit my family and spiritual needs. I am proud and could not be happier to call Catalyst my home church. I began my journey with Catalyst 5 years ago as a volunteer at the Back to School Carnival. The heart of this community was contagious. I began attending regularly shortly after and my connection with God grew immensely! I’m able to relate each service to my life and learn how God is with me even through the most difficult times. At Catalyst we spread God’s love through our Give Love initiative and Back to School Carnival. Those events and the welcoming community reassure me that I’m in the right place.

name: Catalyst Church, NWA - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a church home that loves you and challenges you, this is the church for you. The leadership team is properly equipped to teach the Word and to let the church body execute the ministry that God has set before each individual. Community can be found quickly here if you are open to be a part of it.

I hope you will check it out soon! Amazing church home. We tried it out when we first moved here and didn’t need to go anywhere else.

If you’re tired of bland, patronizing sermons that just make you feel good about your spiritual apathy, then come here—it’s convictingly good every week.

The Dude doesn’t abide…this church does. And you’ll learn what that means here. This church is not afraid to study and teach the Bible. They teach the things others are afraid to talk about. They expose things that are full of bad worldview influencing Christians negatively away from truth and a life abiding by God's Word. If you want a Biblical worldview, which you need not neglect if you're a Christian, this place will give it to you. Staff are passionate that you would be surrendered to Christ, getting to know Him, spending consistent, quality time in prayer, and making Jesus known to the world. Went for a funeral service that was very well done. A great biblical community.  I love meeting with my family each week and hearing a biblically based message.  Very passionate about accountability and discipleship.

name: Catalyst Covenant Church White Bear Lake
reviewSummary: Great community! Super welcoming and hospitable. This church is young, but thoughtfully and intentionally led with a defining and unmistakable hope. Amazing worship and teaching with an excited energy hanging in the room. This is a community that always has more room at the table. I have deeply enjoyed every Sunday service/event I've attended and am indebted to Catalyst for much of my spiritual growth in the last couple months. Be sure to check it out if you are looking for a new church! From the moment we stepped foot into the building, we felt at home with Catalyst Covenant WBL. Everyone is so genuinely nice and interested in our family, and we have so much fun hanging out with everyone before and after church. The sermons and worship has been wonderful, and always leaves us with something to discuss and practice as we continue to grow in our faith. Highly recommend Catalyst! Phenomenal place to get connected and stay connected. Really strong community and very welcoming to all. Amazing church community and the people are so welcoming! Very welcoming community!

name: Catch The Fire Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
New to the area and seeking a spiritual family, I visited Catch the Fire after several other locations. Immediately received by the team, learning their values and significant research, I found the right fit. The alignment and relationship all of them share with God our father, Jesus our savior and the Holy Spirit is humbling. A professional organization, with many connect group opportunities, and devoted group leaders allows immersion. The worship team of talented artists, vocalists and media elevate to a higher place. Thank you I’ve been attending CTF for 7 years now and I’ve grown so much in my walk with Jesus!! My children (7, 10, 17, 18) love going to church. Their kids ministry is amazing and they pour into their hearts teaching them to hear God’s voice for themselves.
I can’t even begin to explain the healing transformation my husband and I have experienced and the community we’ve been blessed with!! My husband and I are always happy to serve our church and the new families who come through the door. Absolutely an amazing experience in the presence of the Lord! Came here for a conference & quiet solo time but left with fresh hunger for more of God. It's rare to find a church that truly operates in the 5-fold ministry and allows the Holy Spirit to flow. I was really impressed with the prayer team and loved that they all flowed in the gifts of the spirit. I watched countless people go up for prayer and receive deliverance, baptism of the Holy Spirit, healing, and more. I will be visiting again when I'm in the area. Praise God that revival is happening in Raleigh/Durham area!!! CTF is an amazing church. The community is so welcoming and authentic and the presence of the Spirit is tangible in this church. I bring my daughter here because she is free to worship with me and she loves to run around and sing. My daughter likes this church so we’ve been coming for over a year and it’s sad that no one greets me or even knows my name. I never get a “how are you” at this place which really doesn’t make you feel a part of the church.

My daughter likes it so that’s why it’s 2 stars.

name: Catford Assemblies of God Pentecostal Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Great church great people so welcoming and friendly would whole heartedly recommend good place to worship and gather for your Sunday service Not bad Small community

name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi - Downtown Plaza Campus
Cathedral Basilica of St. Peter in Chains - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: What is the oldest Cathedral in the U.S. that is still being used as a Cathedral? That's right, St. Peter in Chains (well, according to the Archbishop of Cincinnati anyway). A beautiful place to observe Confirmations, whether you are Catholic or not. Across the street from the historic Isaac Wise Temple and next to City Hall. A lot of history in this one block of Plum Street. We visited this place on a lark while attending a wedding in the area. This Greek Revival cathedral is one of the most unique churches we’ve seen in the United States. With its Corinthian columns and mosaics, it evoked feelings in us that we rarely encountered inside a Catholic Church. Honestly, it’s quite hard to describe other than to say there’s nothing quite like this cathedral among the many churches we visited, and it struck us as a singular achievement. It certainly was a memorable place to visit, and we’d like to go again after having learned more about it. The architecture is gorgeous. The building was built in the late 1850's, and definitely went full greek-temple-vibe. It was dark, but really really cool. It almost had the Bond villain aesthetic to it. The sacristan was kind enough us go in the back and see the museum and all the pontifical vestments. It was way cool. The cathedral is oriented exactly the way it should and was definitely worth the visit. Wow. What a magnificent interior. Must visit this unique cathedral We visited during a pilgrimage from Maria Stein. We really enjoyed the tour that David gave us after Saturday mass. This is a beautiful church with a lot of rich history!

name: Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: European Gothic cathedral in northern Kentucky!  Knowledgeable and friendly tour guide. We did not have a tour scheduled, but the host at the door basically gave us our own private tour. We also bought the self-guided tour booklet ($10) that you can do from any location, you don't have to be in the cathedral. Also bought a very nice book on the amazing stained glass windows (I think it was $25 or $30.) Prayer candles are real candles, not LED, and were $5. The organist was practicing when we were there, so that made it extra special. I was in town for work. It was a beautiful day so my coworker and I walked here from our hotel, the Radisson. It's a gorgeous cathedral. The greeter was lovely and so informative. They will tell you where you can walk and what you can take photos of (there is an area where no photos are allowed). The stained glass is amazing as well as the mosaics. It does not take long to view everything, definitely look at the hours and visit if you're in the area. One of the most beautiful Churches I have ever been in. The Volunteers are some of the most nicest people. I'm not Catholic but I enjoy going and love sitting in the pews and soaking up all the beauty and usually I say a few prayers of thanks. I've struggled with religion but somehow when I walk into this Church that all seems to go away and I feel like I am home again just like when I was a child and going to Church all the time. Breathtakingly beautiful. The carvings, paintings, stained glass pictures and the religious relics were stunning.  Grateful we had the opportunity to visit. This gorgeous cathedral is a must see for anyone with a love of architecture or art. The vaulted ceilings take your breath away, and the stained glass is of the finest craftsmanship. Our volunteer who was giving us information about the cathedral was very knowledgeable and welcoming. This church boasts two organs, one of them being the oldest working one of its kind in the world. According to our volunteer, he said 700 people were present at the Christmas Eve service and you can see from some of the photos that there are plenty of pews and seating all around the church. This is a beautiful facility and I highly recommend everyone to go. They do not charge admission and the parking is free.

name: Cathedral Church - Irvine (Woodbridge) Campus
reviewSummary:
When we moved to Irvine, I wondered what God's plan was for my family. I am still finding my path and God's vision, but the church has become the light leading us closer to Jesus. This church is such a blessing Very unprofessional and unholy culture. After the service the pastor runs out to avoid talking to anyone and never stays to engage with the worshippers which is very different than the culture of shepherd grove years ago and definitely different than the Crystal cathedral. I attempted to speak to him and was intercepted by an employee to give him enough time to dash out as fast as he could. I tested this the following two weeks and got the same results. He also now has an assistant pastor who basically speaks for him. He only reads off of printed material in front of him, feels very inauthentic and quite frankly he looks like he’s forced to be there; his messy hair, the shorts, wrinkled clothing and untrimmed facial Hair definitely don’t help. People who are more like actors are brought in to fall on stage and lay face down and cry and scream and shout in the microphones; feels more like a bad acting performance rather than a place of worship, love and kindness. Fortunately Irvine and Newport have innumerable real pure churches, save your sanity and avoid this one. I watch Shepherd’s Grove Church on TV YouTube from Kentucky, and Bobby Schuller’s sermons are powerful, grounded, and incredibly meaningful (I use to watch his grandpa when he was preaching getting ready for our church in the morning).  Bobby’s messages offer depth, emotional insight, and practical takeaways that genuinely help you grow and reflect, I always walk away having learned something.
If I lived in California, I would absolutely attend in person.  And love their worship music! This church has such a beautiful and thriving community! Their worship is so wonderful. We are so blessed by Pastor Bobby and his teaching! I watch The Hour of Power from Australia. Bobby's sermons are always educational, meaningful & inspiring. Hannah's Prayer Ministry is the backbone of this church's effectiveness 🙏✝️

name: Cathedral Church of Saint Peter
reviewSummary: An absolutely beautiful Cathedral! The worship service was amazing, the Choir was glorious, The organ with the antiphonal in the back and the Organist was so wonderful. Made my whole day! Very beautiful,  powerful and historical cathedral Beautiful historic house of worship where music, words, and sacrament are beautifully celebrated to inspire and nuture a loving flock. I attended a funeral in service and despite the nature of my visit and, I found it to be a wonderful service. Rminiscing the old school Catholic mass as a child. 45 minutes from my home, I may attend the more services there. Beautiful congratulations architecture as well. What a beautiful church. There is a kind staff and the acoustics are great! They could use more rest rooms.

name: Cathedral Church of St. Luke
reviewSummary:
This church has made me feel at home. As a lesbian with a family it's important to me that my place of worship is progressive and affirming, and St. Luke's has those qualities and more. From its beautiful architecture to the incredible people who pass through its doors, every aspect of this place is shining with God's love. ⛪Beautiful Exterior - Lovely Photo Spot⛪

While I didn't attend a service at St. Luke's or go inside, the outside alone are worth a visit. The architecture and horticultural is beautiful, and there's a stone bench that makes for a perfect photo keepsake with the cathedral in the background.

Located to the right-hand side of the entrance is a stone "maze" that reminds me of a meditation-walk garden. I've included pictures that showcase the exterior's key features. If you're a connoisseur of cathedrals and churches, be sure to stop by when in the area. Beautiful interior, spacious acoustics for the E.M. Skinner organ and choir, and either end adorned with something special -  a carved reredos at the altar and the chapel-in-the-round at the narthex. Nice liturgy. All are welcome. Good music. Welcoming congregation. Sound system needs a little tweaking for hard of hearing. The people are not nice and they ask you thing you do not want talk about . I feel like  a person Sara go to the church she was not nice to me . Have a church is being nice I am not going back at all . They make  see you  feel not good. A church should not to that and when you need food and ask for help they did bot to help you because you have money. I am done with the church to not like how feel about it

name: Cathedral Church of the Advent
reviewSummary: Historic downtown cathedral renowned across the Anglican Communion for vibrant grace-filled preaching, world-class choir, and legendary Lenten noontime lunches.

name: Cathedral Church of the Advent - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: Historic downtown cathedral renowned across the Anglican Communion for vibrant grace-filled preaching, world-class choir, and legendary Lenten noontime lunches.

name: Cathedral of Christ the King - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: My first time going to this church for mass and it was gorgeous! The air was filled with incense and it was warm. I also stayed for the rosary. A peaceful place 🤍 will come again on Saturday 🇻🇦 Undoubtedly the most beautiful parish for miles and miles - not only due to the architecture and stained glass, but also the warm and welcoming Christ the King community. Our family visited for mass on Palm Sunday. We were blown away with the beauty of both the church and the liturgy.  There was a huge crowd of visitors but the ushers managed everything in an efficient, friendly way. The homily from Monsignor was concise and thought-provoking. This was a beautiful experience, and we hope to visit again one day. Gorgeous cathedral very neo gothic beautiful stained windows and an amazing choir My home church since birth. One of the most beautiful Cathedrals in America and run by a great community. Thank you for all you do.

name: Cathedral Of Hope - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary: I attended the 90s hip hop on strings edition of the show. The musicians are extremely talented and rendered beautifully curated medleys of the artistes featured. They were engaging and definitely created a fun and upbeat vibe that was personal and intimate even though there were a lot of people there. They gave insight into little known facts about the music and musicians featured and allowed audiences participation while performing. Definitely a must attend! Beautiful and intimate experience—from musicians sharing background on the composer and what to expect in each movement to their willingness to chat post-show. Highly recommend arriving when doors open - we were in the first row which was magical. This is a great  way to enjoy a string quartet outside a more formal setting. The Cathedral of St. John the Divine in New York City is an impressive landmark that architecture and history enthusiasts should not miss. Getting there is convenient—simply take the A train to Cathedral Parkway (110th St) and enjoy a short 7-minute walk to the cathedral.

Often regarded as one of the largest Anglican cathedrals in the world, its sheer scale is breathtaking. Begin your visit by admiring the Gothic façade, which is adorned with intricate details, sculptures, and stonework that set the tone for the wonders within. Upon entering, you’ll be greeted by a vast, majestic interior featuring soaring ceilings, massive columns, and stunning stained-glass windows that fill the space with beautiful, shifting light throughout the day.

Admission fees are $15 for adults, $12 for seniors, and $10 for students for sightseeing visits, and it is well worth the price. Take your time exploring; each chapel has its own unique character, artwork, and symbolism. Be sure to check out the impressive nave, beautifully crafted altars, and the various architectural styles that reflect different periods of construction.

In addition to its remarkable architecture, the cathedral frequently hosts art installations, cultural events, and concerts, adding another layer to the experience. The surrounding grounds are also serene and worth exploring, providing a quiet escape from the city's hustle and bustle.

Whether you are drawn by its history, spirituality, or design, St. John the Divine promises a memorable and enriching visit. This is an absolutely gorgeous cathedral. UPDATE 11/1/15 - Time flies!  It's now been a month since I first came to this church.  After my previous review, a couple of members of the church reached out to me and invited me back, introducing me to other members of the church and welcoming me to their fellowship (and apologising profusely for my awful first experience!  Apparently it's not normally like that).

I've been given to understand the church recently grew from 100 members to almost 300 members and it's grown so much that they've had to split the Chinese services in two.  As such, they have experienced growth pains such as newer members serving who don't necessarily know who the new faces within the church may be.  Also not all members are as 'welcoming' as you may expect Christians to be (this is likely through no fault of their own, perhaps they are also one of the shy ones).

They've already made a couple of changes in the welcoming and introduction of new friends or visitors to the church so hopefully what happened to me shouldn't reoccur and I've now decided to settle in this church.  I remember before leaving my church in London that there are only 3 factors you should look for in a new church and if these are met, then you should stay:

1. The word of God is faithfully preached.

Pastor Wang does not mince his words and he is not afraid to offend man to teach the word of God.  I'm not sure about other small groups, but at least in the one I've joined, Bellman Fellowship, they will bring everything back to Christ.  At CBCWLA, this criteria is absolutely met.

2. The love of Christ is shown.

After re-attending and having now attended for about a month, I can safely say that whilst this is not shown perfectly, they are truly trying their best.  Nobody's perfect and you won't always feel God's love through every attendee, but you also shouldn't expect that since every attendee is at a different stage in their walk of faith.

3. You are able to serve.

You are very welcome to serve!  They are not strict, but they do require you to show commitment (and as they should).  This is also a great way to love your fellow brothers and sisters and get to know members of the church better, so please do come and make this your church as well.

I'm thankful that God has made something really good come out of this.  I was struggling to decide if I should stay at this church, but I remembered the words of my previous pastor and thank God that He brought me here as indeed all 3 key criteria are met.  Looks like I will be staying!

I was taught you should always give a church at least 3 tries, if after 3 tries it still doesn't fulfil all 3 factors then move on.  I'm very glad I came back as indeed it got much better after the 3rd time.

If you've experienced some of the issues I had below, please come and find me or one of the longstanding members of the church.  My name's in the review ;)  Or ask for Alight Tsai (M) or I-Shen Lai (F).  Please don't just leave without saying hi!
