If you’d like to get a feel for the ministry before visiting, you can also find their channel on YouTube @ CCOAN New York 😊 Highly recommended! Prophet Harry is a true servant of the most high blessed with all the spiritual gifts to teach and guide God’s people. We are so blessed to have this ministry in our city! God is so good! Thank you CCOAN - New York! I know this is a living church I watch ccoan online Saturday and Sundays. I wish so bad I could attend in person. But it's a 17 hour drive from my location in Michigan. God Bless and please pray God delivers me from smoking addiction and Rx medicine that I want to stop taking but I can't because I get sick if I stop taking. Please and Thank You. Blessings. I am so grateful to know that CCOAN is much closer to me. Still a bit far as I'm in Canada but much closer than Thessalonica and Africa. GOD is amazing! I am looking forward to visiting soon by the help of God. But until then I continue to connect in the Spirit online. For distance is not a barrier, in Jesus name!! Emmanuel! This ministry is like no other I've ever seen before. Seeing the power of God alive and working through the man of God has really strengthened my faith. Everything I've read about in the Bible is now coming to life! It stilll happening now!  God is still the same He was yesterday, today and forever!

name: Cedar Lake Christian Assembly - Biloxi Campus
reviewSummary:
Shout unto the Lord Jesus Christ!!!

Great church, many ways to contribute and lots of learning to do. Lots to do and tons to enjoy in the Lord! Making this my home church. Much love. Great church with a great Pastor. God is definitely in this church! Visited 1st service with my husband and son today and felt so welcomed. The church greeters are friendly enough for extroverts (me) to feel seen, but not intimidating for introverts (my guys) to feel overwhelmed. Worship was amazing. Today was movie-sermon day so the church had popcorn/candy/cokes/water. There was an invitation for salvation at the end of the service. Overall, really great experience with a Christ-first focus. Awesome church! Love the service and great worship! A park for kids and a whole section for Spanish with an impressive Going Global outreach to Kenya. May God continue to bless and prosper them in every way! In Jesus name! Amen

name: Cedar Park church of Christ - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary: This is a warm, welcoming congregation, concerned about following New Testament teaching and worship. I especially appreciate that there are so many kids. My son has made friends who are a good influence. The people were very nice and welcoming and didn't fret that my kids cried some during church. Friendly folks. Conservative,  not one of those big mega churches. They teach straight from the Bible, that is what we need more of!!!! Good assembly of God's people

name: Cedar Park Community Church - Cedar Park Campus
Cedar Pointe Baptist Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary: Cedar Pointe is a small, but healthy church centered on the gospel of Jesus Christ, with a strong reverence for God's word and expository preaching. It is a local expression of the body of Christ, and it seeks to function as just that, with members being active and involved in one another's lives. Members desire to grow and to help each other grow in the grace and knowledge of the Lord Jesus Christ. I'm very thankful for this community of Christians and how God has used them to grow me and strengthen my walk. If you’re looking for a Church and Hungry to learn about God’s Word, check Our Church. God Bless! I'm very thankful for Cedar Pointe Baptist Church. This is a warm and inviting group of believers gathering to worship God, live out the faith, and proclaim the gospel together. I encourage you to visit Sunday morning and believe you will find yourself welcomed warmly and encouraged in your faith. Love the Gospel centeredness of Cedar Pointe. Sound expositional teaching each week has really grown our family in the Word and Worship of our Sovereign God. So glad to be able to meet each week with these Christ followers. I've known Pastor Ben Wright at Cedar Pointe Baptist Church for 7 years. Ben's love of the Word, concern for people, and desire to see God's glory expressed in the Body is abundantly evident the longer I know him. If you're looking for a solid group of believers and a pastor who preaches the Bible and loves people, checkout Cedar Pointe.

name: Cedarcrest Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary:
The first time I walked through the doors of Cedarcrest Church, I knew there was something different about it. They call themselves a “Jesus church,” and that’s exactly what they are—Jesus is at the heart of everything they do.

There is so much intentionality behind every ministry and program they offer. They genuinely love everyone who walks through their doors and invest an incredible amount of time and care into creating spaces where people of all ages feel welcomed, valued, and connected.

It’s easy to find community at Cedarcrest because the people truly want to know you, serve you, and, hopefully one day, serve alongside you.

Their kids ministry is incredible! It’s high energy, lots of fun, and, most importantly, filled with volunteers who genuinely love pouring into children. Their student ministry is so much more than a youth program. God is moving in the lives of teenagers, and Cedarcrest is blessed to be part of that work. Students are being discipled in their faith and learning what it means to make Jesus not only their Savior but also the Lord of their lives.

I can’t say enough good things about this church. If you’re looking for a place to belong, a church that will help you grow in your relationship with Jesus, and a community where you’ll find your people, I highly recommend giving Cedarcrest a try! Cedarcrest Church has been our church home since 2019, and we are so thankful for the impact it has had on our family. This is a Jesus-centered church that has challenged, encouraged, and strengthened our Faith in ways we never could have imagined.
One of the things we love most is their heart for the next generation. They intentionally pour into kids and students, teaching them God's Word and helping them build a lasting foundation of faith. They also have a genuine passion for serving the surrounding communities and sharing the love of Christ beyond the walls of the church.
If you're looking for a church that is biblically grounded, focused on Jesus, and committed to loving people well, I highly recommend Cedarcrest Church. Cedarcrest Church has truly become our home. From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed, loved, and part of a family. The atmosphere is genuine, and it’s clear that everything they do is centered on Jesus.

One of the biggest blessings for our family is the incredible kids ministry. Our boys absolutely love going each week! The children’s area is safe, engaging, and filled with volunteers who genuinely care about helping kids know and love Jesus.

The preaching is consistently biblical, gospel-centered, and points people to Jesus in a way that is both encouraging and challenging. Every Sunday leaves us feeling equipped to live out our faith throughout the week.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, teaches God’s Word faithfully, and invests deeply in the next generation, we can’t recommend Cedarcrest Church enough. They are our family. Cedarcrest is our home. There aren’t enough words to express what Cedarcrest has meant to me and my family. From the very first day, we were welcomed with genuine love and kindness, and it quickly became so much more than just a church.. it became our home.

Through every season of life, Cedarcrest has strengthened our faith, reminded us of God’s unfailing love, and surrounded us with people who truly care. The biblical teaching is powerful, the worship is uplifting, and the community has encouraged us to grow closer to Jesus in ways we never expected.

I’m especially grateful that my family has a place where we can worship together, build lasting friendships, and raise our child in an environment centered on Christ. Cedarcrest has impacted our lives in ways we’ll always be thankful for, and I genuinely believe God led us here for a reason.

If you’re searching for a church where you’ll be loved, encouraged, and challenged to grow in your relationship with Jesus, I wholeheartedly recommend Cedarcrest. It has truly been one of God’s greatest blessings in our lives. WE LOVE OUR CEDARCREST FAMILY 🙌🏾 Cedarcrest Church has truly made Acworth feel like home.
After moving to the area 4 years ago and not having any community, Cedarcrest has exceeded our every expectation for a church.
We immediately felt surrounded by authentic community which made us feel a sense of belonging and made it easy for us to get plugged in.
Since then, encountering Jesus every Sunday, and being surrounded by fellow believers providing constant encouragement has caused up to really grow our faith.
We are so grateful for the way Cedarcrest has supported us as parents, for the way it’s stoked our passion for missions, and for the way it has filled our lives with purpose in God’s kingdom.
We are blessed to be in an area filled with so many great churches but I couldn’t recommend a better church!

name: Celebrate Church of Northwest Arkansas - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
This is my church. Inviting everyone to come if you do not have a church home. Pastor is wonderful! The people ate wonderful also! It starts 10:00 am every Sunday.... I used to go to an Assembly of God church but there was always a message in tongues but now I do not know the difference to that of a Baptist Church,
Russell Warnky from St Louis, MO If you are looking for a church that is centered on relationship with God and relationship with people this is the place.  They are warm ans welcoming. The most genuine people I’ve met. Impacted my life in the biggest way. Great group of young people and youth.

name: Celebration Beach Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
They eventually treat you like family. Paster James was the priest we chose to marry us. It's especially a great church during this time of year. The pastor is light and uses humor, while preaching God’s word. People were friendly. It was 50 degrees when we visited, so they cut the service a bit short since it meets outside. It’s in Cambier Park on Sundays at 9:30. Chairs are provided as well as refreshments. It’s a nice atmosphere. I wanted to love this church because the setting is so lovely in the park, and I really like the idea of an outdoor church and baptisms at the beach (only reason it gets two stars, not one).  I appreciate when a pastor has a good sense of humor and I absolutely love to laugh, but this pastor’s humor was negative and degrading.  We left feeling empty and insulted rather than uplifted, encouraged, and loved. We will keep looking for a good Bible-believing church of Christ followers that teaches from the Word of God with respect for the Lord Jesus Christ and His followers, and treats fellow believers with LOVE. Wonderful service.  Outdoors in a park!

The Pastor uses humor to keep it light while preaching God's word.

He welcomes everyone believers, non-believers, Catholics, Christians, gays, lesbians, tourists, etc.
to come and hear the Lord's message. So refreshing to be non judgmental.

4-5000 people there today on Easter Sunday. You will feel the love in this church in paradise, Pastor Gene and Pastor James are funny and kind. The word is always fulfilling and your heart will feel joy.
You can go to the park and enjoy the outdoors and the treats or watch online. Is awesome

name: Celebration Church
reviewSummary:
My family and I drive 30 minutes every Sunday to attend Celebration Church and it is worth every mile. Dr. Matthew Quainoo and First Lady Rhesa Quainoo lead with authenticity, passion, and a genuine heart for the people.

The teaching is Bible-centered, practical, and always delivered with conviction that meets you exactly where you are. Under the covering of Bishop Robbie Davis and Pastor Robin Davis, the spiritual depth here is remarkable. Bishop Davis recently preached a powerful series on marriage and family that challenged cultural norms while affirming biblical principles with grace, wisdom, and an urgency for the next generation. It was the kind of teaching that makes you take notes, have real conversations on the ride home, and look at your own life differently.

The worship is powerful, the community is warm and genuinely diverse, and the atmosphere is one where you don’t just attend. You grow. If you’re looking for a church home in the Columbia, MD area where the Word is taught with excellence and the leadership genuinely cares about your development, visit Celebration Church. You’ll understand why we make the drive. Always an excellent service. Come as you are and get ready for the word. Bishop Robbie Davis is the best preacher on the earth. He has a unique style of preaching, teaching, and spreading the gospel. He is an awesome teacher & I believe he could be a comedian if he wanted to. Service starts at 10 am and last about an hour and 30 minutes. Love it! Unfortunately we visited as a church for a funeral, one of the beloved mothers of our church has passed this life 🙏🏽🙏🏽 made our contribution to the service !! I hosted a women’s empowerment conference and everyone loved the conference space! The event planning team led by Nicole Ford and Pastor Rhema were wonderful to work with. If you’re looking for biblical teaching relevant to contemporary life this is the place. Bishop Robbie Davis and the preaching ministers are grounded in the bible. The music ministry is dope! Graphics and multi media on the video walls is very smartly executed.
The people are very friendly. The ministry caters to adults, teens, pre-teens, children and toddlers. The facility is modern and beautiful with plenty of parking.

name: Celebration Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Love my church and my pastor!! My family has been EXTREMELY blessed to call this church our HOME! We are a diverse group of Bible-believing Christians that seek the Lord beyond Sunday. I have been challenged, grown and molded in my time at Celebration through dedicated leaders of Bible study and other courses and classes offered. I serve in kids ministry and I know that the volunteers genuinely love and care for those babies with the love of Jesus. I praise God every day for my church family and I pray protection over our leaders and body physically, spiritually and mentally. Celebration Church was the final church I attended in Jacksonville before heading back home to Virginia Beach, Virginia, and what a great church to end that season with. If I had known it was only about 19 minutes away, there would have been many Sundays where I would have split my time between Celebration and the Church of Eleven22 campuses.
The worship music was incredible. In my opinion, very few churches have compared to the energy I experienced at 2819, but Celebration came close. It felt like a full-fledged concert for Christ from beginning to end. The worship was alive, powerful, and full of passion.
I had seen Pastor Tim Timberlake on Instagram and watched some of his reels before attending. I already knew he spoke well, but hearing him in person was different. He preaches with passion, boldness, and volume. He is not timid about the Word, and he does not seem concerned with people’s opinions. I appreciated when he said, “Don’t ask me, go to the Word. Don’t believe what I say.” That is the kind of preaching people need — bold, biblical, and pointing people back to Scripture instead of personality.
The people were also great. While I was sitting with my service dog, a lady named Frenchy came over, sat down, and asked if she could join me at the table. Of course, I said yes. Frenchy, shout out to you and your son. You were both great people. In a time when I needed fellowship, camaraderie, and simple human kindness, you listened, were polite, and made me feel welcomed.
There was also a man whose name I cannot remember, but he wore a cowboy hat. He brought me coffee and helped seat me in a place that was convenient for me and my service dog. He was also an Army veteran, and I appreciated the brotherhood and hospitality. Thank you, bro.
Celebration Church left a strong impression on me. Great worship, great preaching, great people, and real hospitality. I cannot wait to come back into town, hopefully with friends or family, and introduce them to the people and church we talked about.
Keep preaching the Word. I decided to visit this church during a time when I was trying to reconnect with my faith after having drifted away for a while. At first, I appreciated how digestible everything felt, it’s definitely an easy place for newcomers to step into without feeling overwhelmed.
However, when I made the decision to pursue baptism, I was surprised by how informal and unstructured the process felt. It seemed like something you could simply sign up for and complete after a service and then drive home without much guidance, preparation, or spiritual authority. For me, this was a deeply significant step, and I found myself longing for more direction, tradition, and spiritual grounding.
Over time, I also found it difficult to connect with the overall tone of the services, especially the sermons. They often felt crafted more around relatability, humor, and keeping the audience engaged than around reverence or a deep, scripture centered message. The frequent jokes and casual tone made it harder for me to experience the sense of sacredness and reflection that I personally believe church calls for. I guess I was hoping for something more rooted in tradition and exploration of the more challenging aspects of faith. Most of the sermons are just the pastor telling you what you can do to receive bigger blessings, which I do not believe is the fullness of the church.
The use of pop style music, teleprompters, and the overall presentation style further contributed to this feeling that the church is more focused on optics than reverence. Instead of being drawn into a space of reverence and contemplation, I often felt like I was attending something designed more to entertain an audience than to spiritually ground us.
Ultimately, I realized I was looking for a more structured and deeply rooted expression of faith. This led me to return to the Catholicism, where I feel a stronger sense of tradition, guidance, and reverence in worship.
I truly believe this church may be a great fit for those who are new to faith, but ultimately there is really no spiritual authority held at this facility and if you plans to grow in your faith, I would use this church as a steppingstone to do so. The message was “Hidden in Plain Sight “
It was good to be home and to take time to have and experience in our growth of being believers.

Look forward to Tim coming back to Union Church in Maryland . Church is alway AMAZING!  Been coming for 2 years now. This is the first time I’ve heard it like this. Today the Sound Engineer should be ashamed! There was way TOO much bass in the music during worship, it was difficult to concentrate. I hope this issue is fixed, if not I’ll be skipping worship in the future.  I could literally feel it in my chest and my daughter who is 14 even asked, why it was like that. Never got adjusted, never got lowered, never changed. MISERABLE!

Will gladly update this review if this was a 1 time thing. Tried to even ask who to speak to about the issue, no one knew.
