name: Celebration Church - Mandeville/Covington Campus - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary:
Celebration Church in Mandeville is a warm, vibrant community where faith and fellowship thrive. Under the leadership of Pastor Chad Richardson, the church has become a place of genuine spiritual growth and heartfelt connection for my family.

Pastor Chad’s messages are inspiring and practical, and his passion for people is evident in how he leads with authenticity and care.

The church offers engaging ministries catering to different age groups and life stages, including Life Groups, Celebrate Recovery, and youth ministries like The Social.

It’s a place where the love of Christ is lived out, not just talked about. If you’re looking for a church that feels like family and challenges you to grow, Celebration Church is a fantastic choice. This is where our oldest son and his family go to church. We went to see our newest granddaughter dedicated. The church meets in what might be a converted business location. It has a very laid back, casual feel. Everybody was cordial and welcoming. The worship style was geared towards the millenial age group but there was a wide range of people. The sermon was clear and concise, easy to follow and very encouraging. There is a strong emphasis on serving the community. We attend the Spanish service and love it! We went with the family to celebrate Easter. It's our tradition to visit family churches and dine together afterwards.
They have a lot of activities for teens and children.   The pastor was friendly and it was a Beautiful day. Wonderful church body and very family oriented. Try them out online or virtual if you choose to. You will feel the presence of God's awesome power working through the hearts of many.. 🌅

name: Celebration Church - Metairie Campus - Metairie Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly congregation. The message is Bible based. Everyone is welcomed without judgment. Great worship team ! Good evening, everyone . My daughter and I really enjoyed the fellowship tonight. The greeters at the doors are amazing. That's always a plus for me when I enter a church.
My co-worker invited me last year but due to the weather I didn't make it. I'm glad that my daughter and I made it this year. Welcoming, diverse, Bible-teaching church with space for everyone. Lots of activities for young, elders, single, married, families, etc. Celebration serves the community in many capacities and is an awesome representation of the Body of Christ. It truly feels like a second home here. Won’t you join us?

Edited with 2024 Christmas service dates. I had such a heartfelt and enjoy full day the congregation there had nothing but open arms for me even though it was my first time there they welcome me into their church family with no regrets. I still get text messages offering me to come back and visit I love the way they keep in contact and it makes you feel like, you have someone on your side praying for you even when you feel like you’re by yourself. I want to think that church for actually listening to that sermon that day and open my eyes up and letting me see a lot of things that I did not see the sermon was short, but it was straight to the point and if you were paying attention, I guarantee you left that message that day I want to thank you so much for the invitation to your church and to let you know that I had a wonderful time and I would not ever ever mind coming back again. Enjoy the sliding scale therapy they offer.  Also the thrift store has decent items and prices next door.  The church seems a bit too watered down from the actual gospel, but they offer good programs.

name: Celebration Church - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church, this awesome worship house of the Lord!! MUSIC IS OUT OF THIS WORLD!! Like a live loud concert. The singing is wonderful, most stand up to worship and sing, praising the Lord. The sermons are right to the point, detailed, and fill you with knowledge and spiritual growth.  Everyone is very friendly and nice. You feel welcome instantly.  I give this church more then 5 stars!! Great house of the Lord!!! Very friendly and very welcoming church here. Sometimes when I go to other churches I feel like nobody smiles or says hi but I get it no church is perfect. Here, someone always says hi and I LOVE LOVE the children’s groups. My 2 year old really enjoys being their and doesn’t want to leave when it’s time to go lol. Praise the Lord for He is Good and worthy Amen!! This church is amazing! Real people who love The Lord and don't pretend to be perfect! The pastors are so genuine and loving. My 7 year old and 2 year old love the kids classes! This is definitely a place where my family can grow in God! This is definitely a place to come and worship. Music is great, the people/staff are incredible, and the programs for kids are like none I've ever seen in any church. Never seen kids so eager to go to church as I see my kids and all the other kids every service. And the youth group/service? One word... WOW! I visit this church with my family whenever we can or are in town. They believe what the word says and preach the word without holding back and I love it!! It's the word of God that changes your life!!! One time I had a horrible migraine that I had never experienced in my life. It lasted for a few days and then I felt God tell me to go to church and have the Pastor pray for me and so I did. I sat through the entire service with horrible headpain listening to the word and my eyes gushing water from the pressure. After it was over, I asked Pastor Green for prayer. He prayed over my head and then said Go in Faith. By the time I got home I was feeling the presence of God all over me and the pain was gone within minutes and my joy had returned. I had not been able to eat without vomiting so lastly, I made a turkey 🥪 and prayed and thank God for it and ate it without vomiting. I was so happy. I will never forget what Jesus did for me and he can and will do it for you too if you only believe!!! He will make a way and continue to be faithful again and again and again!! Just don't give up!!

name: Celebration Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Thanks for letting me sit in. Very good music and very good message. Pastor Gary humbly teaches the Word in a straightforward and thoughtful way that most churches have given up for bright lights and loud music. It's a small church tucked into the Town and Country retirement community (which I don't live in) and all are welcome.  They've built up over the last few years with a little more parking. In fact the community outside has grown as well.  They have 3 services that multi cultural and multi generational. They also belong to an organization that is doing some amazing work around the world for God's kingdom. The service was awesome. Pastor Carlos and I had a real connection. It was like he was talking directly with me. Celebration church also wants to connect with Accountability Brothers in our quest to empty the jails one inmate at a time! This little church had a great service and the pastor is so inviting. If you're looking for a small Community Church I highly recommend this place. Folks here are humble and inviting.
They made.me feel very welcome here.
A great place to get your worship on.

name: Celebration Church DC - Alexandria Campus
reviewSummary:
Celebration Church DC offers an engaging, energetic environment and sound foundational teaching, but my overall experience was mixed. When seeking deeper community and membership, I found that authentic, lasting connections were often hard to come by, with interactions sometimes feeling surface-level until a specific focus is placed on an individual.

I was hoping for genuine pastoral and communal care rather than an environment that feels overly administrative or legalistic when navigating personal seasons. However, there are warm hearts here, and the church fills an important space for many.

“Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment.” — John 7:24 Celebration Church is a wonderful place to explore and strengthen your faith.  Pastors Anthony and Brenda and the entire staff make you feel welcome the moment you walk in the church doors.   Excellent for families! Been attending this church for about 5 months now and love every minute of it. The pastors are so kind and teach straight from the Word. Worship is lively, intimate and not rushed. The church family have been extremely welcoming. I've found my church home! Was in the area to visiting DC and doing all the regular touristy things. Couldn’t start the day on Sunday without being at church Googles, church near me and found celebration church DC . Wonderful experience , if I am ever back in the DC area I will definitely be back. This is an excellent church, and one that I love to call my home church.  Truly bible oriented teachings. Contemporary worship, on line viewing and campus in Fairfax too.  My son (16 months) likes the childcare area, and i like it too, so my wife and I can enjoy the service together.  Also, they have a cafe that serves Starbuck style coffee and espresso! Everything you would need for a church home is here.

name: Celebration Church OC - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary: Not at all what I expected!  Some weird guy ( Ruben Valdez)  in the hallway told me that he had anointing oil, special from Jerusalem . As if it had special power ! When I said wow this anointing oil smells like mine. I got it on Amazon. He said oh yeah that’s where I got mine lol ! He then proceeded to do some weird thing with my hand, where, as if he was pulling energy out out of my hand telling me that he was getting me filled with the Holy Spirit, even though I have been filled with the Holy Spirit since 2004… Gave me his business card like a used car salesman told me to text him because he’s so busy that he can’t take calls… What??? The whole church was like a three ring Circus. God is a God of order not confusion. I’d never go back to this place again. My husband Lee & I love this church and all of the members ❤!  Every time we walk through these doors we are showered by the presence of God! The love is absolutely tangible! Thank you Apostle Doug & Apostle Debbie Healy, we love you both so much! Me & my husband visited Celebration Church less than a month ago for a conference. Not only did we love San Juan Capistrano and Dana Pointe Beach; we loved the genuine friendliness and love if Gods people there. We were well received and had real conversations with a few people we met there. The Spirit and love of Christ flows there among all. They are like one big family. There atmosphere is the best part since the town is surrounded by the beach everyone is really easy going. I cant wait to return. Two years ago my wife and I were looking for a church. We found a Celebration family of joyful like minded people who lovingly welcomed us and showed us the blessings that come with living in the Kingdom of God and taught us how to be a participating disciple of Jesus Christ embraced by the Father's Love. Come see and worship with us. Blessings This place is incredible!  Such a loving family of believers. I didn’t know who God was until I came here!!  If you need somewhere to go for joy and belonging this is such a great place!

name: Celebration Church of The Woodlands - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going to Celebration Church of The Woodlands since 2020 and it has truly become such an important part of my life. My husband and I both serve, and through that we’ve met some truly amazing people who have become like family to us.

Before this church, I attended a church that was more of a feel-good style and mostly stayed on the surface level with topics. I’ve really come to appreciate that here, Pastor Frankie digs deep and helps me understand the Bible in a much clearer and more meaningful way. He is the real deal and I love that he just tells it like it is because that’s what we all need.

In this world we live in, we need a pastor like him to tell us the truth. I truly appreciate his teachings, and this church has become my second home.

If you are looking for a Holy Spirit filled place, please try us out—you will leave changed.

If you’re new or just visiting, come see me at the new guest table! I would love to meet you and help you feel at home.

So grateful for this church family 🤍 Just an amazing place to worship full of the nicest people, fantastic worship team, and a pastor who's down to earth message seems in touch with the congregation, poignant and right on time. It is a definite must if you're contemplating a visit. Prepare to feel at home, your spirit lifted, and to  anticipate your next visit. We have been going to Celebration for 6 years and love it! The congregation worships with passion and the worship team is phenomenal at providing an environment that welcomes the Holy Spirit and makes it easy to connect with God. My family has steadily grown spiritually in the time we have been there due to the depth of the sermons and how easily Pastor Frankie relates the message to everyday life. We’ve made celebration our home now for 5 years. Recently a member of the church lost his son in a tragic car accident. When he inquired about having the celebration of life at the church he was to it would cost 675.00
He tithes faithfully and this church turned their back on him. He went to another church in spring that welcomed him and let the family have the celebration of life at no cost. It really bothered because I’m told my tithes are going to support another church and pay to put the pastor’s daughter through college while a member of the church here is made to pay. I’m seriously concerned about this church. My home church! Favorite place to be. People are always so welcoming. Everyone is welcome. Best church in the Woodlands.

name: Celebration OC - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
Celebration OC is not just a church it's a Home! We were invited to celebration about 5 years ago and we instantly fell in love. From the moment you step in those doors you are greeted and feel the love from everyone. We were looking for a church where our daughter will learn about God and their kids ministry is doing just that. One of their core values is find friends, and at this place is very hard to NOT make friends, our family has been blessed by the friendships made at Celebration. We are honored to be part of the vision that Pastor Dan and Pastor Christina have for this church Making Celebration OC our home church 9 years ago was the best decision. Everyone here is always so welcoming and kind that it is not hard to find yourself making friends.
The worship is awesome. There is something for everyone here. You will not be doing life alone.  Pastors are awesome and I absolutely love that they know everyone by name. :) My wife and I have been coming for about 6 months and we absolutely love this church. People are so so genuine here and welcoming. The pastor is very detailed in teaching the word. Does a great job. The worship is amazing. If you are looking for a church look no further I promise this place is filled with God. Join us, you won’t be disappointed. This Church welcomed me from the parking lot to the front door and when I walked into the sanctuary I was met with a handshake and a hug. Made me feel comfortable and most importantly welcomed in a church. As we walked in we heard the worship music, which was GREAT. I love worship music and this church made it feel like I was listening to professional musicians. They did a welcoming/greeting during service where I was greeted by friendly faces and felt like they truly cared for me and my family. I have kids and the children's ministry was awesome. My 4 year old daughter sings me the songs she's learned and gets excited to show me what she made in class. The Pastor was funny and relatable. It's a Jesus first church and it truly shows in all the ministries. Glad I found a HOME. I know where I'll be Sunday mornings. If you're looking for a HOME church,  Celebration is it! There is so much LOVE for Jesus and each other.  Everyone who walks through those doors is just showered with love and you can FEEL the holy spirit ! Come as you are, I love how diverse it is.
LOVE the kids ministry,  I have a4 and 7 year old and they just LOVED going to church!  The worship is AMAZING!! They have small groups ti get connected and makes it easy to make friends.  Pastor is so awesome, he preaches with passion and fire for the Lord.  Just an AMAZING CHURCH!

I attended this church only a few months, it was the best most life changing few months I've ever experienced.  Even after moving away to Washington, back with my husband and my marriage coming back together is honestly a miracle of God! Through it ALL Celebration was there for me and with me and till this day being in Washington still feel the love, they call, text just to say hi, and see how I'm doing, and I know if I ever needed help or just to say hey,  or needed someone to pray with or for me they are there. I am so blessed to have been part of Celebration, made friends that became family and have a home I can go to when I visit! It's MORE than a church, it's a FAMILY!

name: Celebration of Life Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE my church family.  So much LOVE, HUMILITY, ANOINTING, TEACHING, and the list goes on. FREEDOM to WORSHIP all because the SPIRIT of the LORD dwells in that place. COLC has been life changing and I can’t wait to see what else God is about to do within this Ministry. 🙏🏽❤️💃🏾 If you have not visited I encourage you to do so.
My Pastors are the BEST! They exemplify such a LOVE for GOD and are not only hearers of his word but they are doers. My daily walk and talk has changed because of this ministry. I am seeing the hand of God move on my behalf naturally and spiritually. Such an anointing, loving, and peaceful atmosphere. The pastor Joseph Morgan did indeed give us a word from God. Something to make you think 🤔 . God's presence was in the house. It’s unbelievable you allowed that man to stand in your pulpit and summon the angel of death! And worse promote it on your Facebook page. How disgusting. If you are looking for a word from God this is the place to be. God will meet you there and make you whole. God has truly blessed the Pastors with his holy anointing. If you are looking for a church always my advice is to follow God's lead because he knows where we need to be nevertheless this church is great the pastor family and congregation are great very loving and the real deal the spirit of the Lord is definitely moving in this place and doing miracles all the time you will leave with the truth and encouragement both great place to worship

name: Celebration Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love this church! Everyone is so welcoming, worship is so amazing and at the same time professional. And the word that the Pastor brings is so impacting and he always gives you a smile when you least expect it he says something funny. I attend Celebration Jacksonville and decided to attend this campus while I was visiting Orlando this weekend. Praise and worship was outstanding, and Pastor Kieth preached a powerful message on walking in the Spirit and speaking the Word of God into the atmosphere. We’ll definitely come again next time I’m in Orlando for the weekend! It was a blessing to be there! This is a good church, and I'd recommend it to anyone. The pastoral staff is very engaging and easy to follow. The worship side of the service was okay. That being said, I felt like I was attending a concert, and th lead singer started preaching. The drummer was so loud throughout the entire service it was very difficult to hear either the worship team sing or the pastor speak. It could just be an easy adjustment with the audio controls, but it was very difficult for me to get into the songs being sung because it was all cymbals and high hats. To be fair, there was another time when the pastor was praying, and the pianist was playing in the background at full volume. I'm used to hearing some nice accompaniment noise in the background of prayers and sermons, but at this church, it was just too loud for my taste. I still walked away, saying to myself that I really liked the church. It was my first time attending this church, so just like anything else, this is a review for my visit there today.

NOTE: If this review has helped you in any way, PLEASE like this review so it can be elevated faster for the restaurant to be informed of how well that they are doing! If you have a different experience than I had, I'd love to know about your experience to see where our differences were. Thanks again for reading my review. It's one of the most peaceful places I've ever been to in my life. A place to spend hours with books and coffee. My husband and I were just visiting, as we were on a short Babymoon to Orlando, and God met us here. You could feel his presence all throughout worship and the teaching. What more could you ask for?

Everyone was incredibly welcoming and social.

name: Centenary United Methodist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I had the opportunity of going to Centenary UMC to listen to Rev. Ki Tae Choi's sermon and service. I was extremely impressed by his growth from an Associate Pastor to a Senior Pastor. His charismatic presence and spiritual energy reflects God's presence and is glowing brighter each day. Thank you Centenary UMC for sharing! I went to a funeral for a dear friend. Small enough to be intimate, yet open and light. celebration to 80 88 💒🎊㊗️ No one ever returns message Very quiet, and clean

name: Centenary United Methodist Church - Winston-Salem Campus
reviewSummary: Debra clapp is not a nice person she doesn’t even have manners and very disrespectful she shouldn’t be working at a church Beautiful church nice 11am service!! This is my sons parish that we attended when we visit his family. They are so welcoming. I especially love the projects they offer for adults (my son did a medical mission to Haiti twice) and the children (my Grands spent last Sunday building beds for children in the city who were sleeping on the floor). Faith in action! So they say they have a financial assistance program.  So I call to get help with rent.  I was told that they have a limit of $300.  Also I would have to have the rest of my rent in order to get rental assistance.  From what I can tell.  They are not helping anyone.  Because I'm sorry.  But who has rent as low as $300? I was told by the lady on the phone " we are not trying to make your landlord rich"!   As if making their pastor rich is a holy situation.  Again I'm lost as to if they are really helping people with rent or are they just helping their members. Because again!  What's $300 going to do and if I have to come up with the rest which could be $500-1200.  Then I wouldn't be asking for help.  Church of God and not too godly Wonderful people, wonderful music, and wonderful preaching. Strong youth and children's ministries. CUMC welcomes all, and as Jesus taught and lived, is seeking to love our neighbors and minister to others.

name: Centennial Covenant Church - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary: Long-time member, great place to have raised my family and find brothers/sisters to walk alongside. Love the heart for worship and prioritization of healthy relationship with God, others, and self.  Welcoming atmosphere, serious about strong biblical teaching, talented staff. Walk into this Church, and you feel right at Home. My Wife and I moved here and became members within a year after walking in the doors. Steve Thulson, the head Pastor, is very knowledgeable and has some great stories. We meet here every Saturday at 5.30pm, then 7pm, we have free dinner together at Inversion meet group, just awesome! I don't attend services there, but a group of us rent space there to meet weekly and share recovery. The staff and pastor are supportive and gracious. A lovely gathering of people. Solid biblical teaching and true heart of worship.

name: Center City Church - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: Center city church is a wonderful place to seek the presence of the Lord together with community!! I love everyone there🤍 This is so amazing!!! I magically got a life after going here!!!! A bit biased, sure, but I’ve found a home in this church! Have been looking for a church in the triad for the past 6 months and finally going the one. The worship is amazing, the community and child care as well. It's a cool Church. Me and my family of 5 have been going for just about a year. Regular attendance is between 50 and 100, kids church may have 10 to 20 kids on a Sunday morning, and there are a lot of big families who attend this church. They have fun small groups. I think they're non denominational, but definitely charismatic, prophetic-ee, Bethel Network type place. Every Church always says the people are nice and welcoming, but yeah the people are really nice and welcoming. One thing that was really interesting was when we left our kids at kids church for the first time they just walked in and didn't cry. All the other churches we have been to, and had been attending for some time they would cry when they went in the kids church. But here they just like walked into the kids church; and then we heard similar "cry free" stories from other people at this church. So that was kind of neat. So, we really really like it and it's the coolest Church we have been with.

name: Center Community Church - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: WHERE 2 OR MORE are gathered, there will I be. Let me tell you what!!! The precious Holy Spirit was there for Pastor Roger's message, and the other leaders of Praise, Announcements, special upcoming church involved events with Community involvement.😊😊😊😊😊☝️☝️☝️☝️☝️☝️🫂🫂🫂🫂🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🎤🎤🎤🎤🎵🎵🎵🎵🎼🎼🎼🎶🎶🎶 My parents attend here. They recently hosted my father's memorial service. Wonderful experience. This is a good place and highly recommend if you are looking for a smaller church. Wonder church! Wonderful people like Sharon Davis. She had a hilarious I Love Lucy routine. I was searching for a traditional American church and I found it in C.C.C.C. This  church  stands on the Word of God and does not cater to frills and fancy.  People  are wonderful. The warmest most loving little church in the nation. God resides there.

name: Center For Spiritual Living Carlsbad (CSL Carlsbad) AKA Carlsbad Church of Religious Science - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly and welcoming. Great uplifting message to last through the week. I miss it if I don't go. Livestreamed & YouTube. Sun 10AM in Carlsbad women's center across from Carlsbad high School.  on Facebook under CSL Carlsbad, also on youtube.  Quiet meditation at 9:30AM so whisper.  Great coffee and fellowship. For Ohhh ..
So MANY & ALL
The Right Reasons!...
This Place is Wonderful
& Very Special!!!
I'm so Happy To Enjoy
This Church!

name: Center Grove Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church! Our family has grown so much spiritually since we started attending. Great children's ministry and many opportunities for the whole family to get involved. Friendships we have made here had been such a blessing to us and many have become like a second family to us. Our family have been attending this church since it started services in September 1981!   We have a great church family that has been a great support during celebrations as well as the needs of our family and have prayed not only when we were in need but when we rejoiced in many blessings in our lives!!  It’s a very friendly place to attend and always welcoming to any and everyone! My family moved to Greenwood when I was in high school and started attending this church. I felt so welcomed and the youth ministry especially made me feel known and loved. Now as a college student, I still love to attend when I come back for breaks because it has become home to me and the people there are like family. We have been attending for many years and we love it.  There are many opportunities for the whole family to get involved in programming and also in service and outreach.  There is not a separate track for kids with special needs but they do a great job making accommodations and our daughter loves it. My wife and I have been involved with this church since it was built.  In fact, we were very involved in the supervision of its construction.  The congregation and staff are all very friendly and loving Christians.  You will feel very comfortable here from day one!

name: Center of Life Church
reviewSummary: Visited the church about six months ago and have loved it ever since. My first time visiting, everyone welcomed me, the worship team was on fire, and the pastor had a powerful sermon. We sang, praised, and were equipped with a message that helped to change our outlook on life and navigate everyday situations. I definitely left feeling like a new person and looked forward to returning each week and joining the Wednesday Bible Study group. This church is a blessing to Sioux Falls and great for all ages and backgrounds. You may come alone, but you will gain a church family. 🙏 Going to center of life was a prayer answered. The worship allows you to open up your heart to receive the message. Pastor Duncan gives a No Nonsense approach to delivering messages and makes them relatable to your life in the here and now. That you can apply in real time. Everyone is welcoming. There's a great work going on at Center of Life. Highly recommend that you come and experience it for yourself. I have been a member here for some times now and I've got to say... This place has been a haven. I was dealing with so much personal things, but with the community at COL and the messages from Pastor Joshua and the grace that was offered and still is,  All i can say is thank God for saving me. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Center of Praise Ministries - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
The most amazing House Of God led by Bishop Lovelace. This is home. When you know you know. GODS grace is so good. Warm and welcoming non-denominational church with   uplifting/informative while engaging and humorous
sermons/lesson  especially from Pastor Lovelace. They try to keep service to 1 hr 15 min. The chior expresses joy, enthusiasm and high energy but their genre of church music is not my personal favorite I experienced the first Christian concert in my life there. Slavic Chorale was awesome. It was God's presence there Awesome praise and worship! Great word! Wonderful people! I just wish they would simply post the exact time each service starts. It’s so frustrating when I go to your website to check the out the services it just gives the time span of the service & not the hour of each service. This is truly frustrating. Please can you post the hour each service starts on your opening page. Thank you 🙏🏾

name: Center Point Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
We love this church. It’s meaningfully active in the community and is reflective of the makeup of the community. I love being able to look out over the congregation and see a growing representation of diversity and members that are well spread out across all generations. Not perfect people. Not cool people. Real people. Pastor Jason has both his doctorate and a background of a former middle school history teacher, so he knows how to present Scripture with a level of hermeneutics and contextuality that isn’t always common to find in an evangelical church. However, he also has his finger on the pulse of culture, is relatable, impressively transparent, and funny.

Most importantly, you feel God at work. At the end of the day, nothing else matters. We make the short drive from Nashville each week, and it’s more than worth it. I recommend CP to anyone seeking a community of fellow Christ followers. Been here for 3 years. Pastor Jason is so real and funny, but is all about preaching from the Word! The community is awesome! I feel seen and loved by so many, which was not the case at other churches I have attended. Thank you Center Point Church for sharing Jesus with me and loving me like Jesus does. We have been going to this church for over 3 years now.  Pastor Jason is an amazing person to be leading our congregation.  The music is top notch!!! Our son who is 2 years old loves coming and will get upset if we drive by the church and not turn in he loves it soo much.  If you're looking for a church to get plugged in led by Christ, this is the place. I had a difficult time finding a "forever" home after my previous church had closed. Centerpoint has been the friendliest, kindest, and most loving group of Christians I have ever met and they have a phenomenal kids program! If your looking for God's presence it's here! We love Center Point because Pastor Jason is a truly amazing person and has been a family friend for several years. We love Kid's City and our son loves coming and learning about Jesus! Our family has grown together by coming to Center Point Church and it has helped us grow in faith!

name: Center Point Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Traveling through Lexington this morning on the way to West Virginia. Stopped to go to Church at Center Point. Was greeted by Luke as soon as we walked in. Very welcoming. Luke went out of his way to walk me and my friend to the sanctuary. The service was full of wonderful worship and a great sermon. The sanctuary was full of teenagers who actually carried their bibles to church. So nice to see them engaged in the service. Today was a blessing! Wonderful church. Bible believing, bible teaching. Mission focused, discipleship focused, community focused. We moved to Lexington in 2015 and visited many churches when searching for our future home church. Center Point Church had the most welcoming group of people! We loved the worship, the preaching, and Pastor Tim Parsons. The gospel preached here is not watered down, but biblical, deep and sometimes convicting. We've been here for 4+ years now! LOVE IT! Center Point Church is my favorite place to be! This church, built on a strong biblical foundation, has brought me some of my very best friends and led me closer to the Lord. The Sunday morning worship is always so encouraging. The teachings are practical and applicable to my daily life. It has been my experience, and the experiences of others I have known, that the staff is always willing to meet with you and give sound biblical advice. I am so grateful for this place and could go on and on about how much I love it. Good service, inspiring message, and good music.

name: Center Point Community Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended today & was very anxious to worship there while on vacation.  My husband & I enjoyed the worship team.  Beautiful angelic harmony was heard!

After being in ministry & church my whole life, the friendliness in this church was very disappointing.  One woman talked to us very briefly and then dropped our conversation immediately when another couple she knew came up to her. The kids love the Awanas, the people at church are so welcoming,  the services are educational and enlightening.   The worship is powerful.   I'm so glad we started attending this church. I have grown up in this church, and it has been amazing to see how much it has helped me with my faith. I have been able to be a part of the Youth, College, and Young Adult groups, and I have learned a lot from each one. The people are inviting, and they have been a great influence in my life. Is great for youth and big shout out to tom and Sarah in youth who deal with the camp sign up and tech and super big shout out or Mr. Estes who is the best at camps I’ve heard!!! Lovely, well balanced church! Excellent worship, very kind and wise pastor. Sermons are super engaging, relevant, and spot on scripturally. The people that we met were so kind, friendly, and thoughtful. We’ve finally found a church home we can feel loved and safe in.

name: Center Street Church of Christ - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
I felt the presence of God when I sat down. Good bible study, a lot of things featured during the main church service, good accessible message. They have very lovely traditional singing facilitation which is very nice. I was relieved it was not wired with guitar and drums. The pastor seems solid.  The church bible used seems to be the New Standard Version, if I remember right. Warm and welcoming church family. Numerous ministries to engage kids of all ages, and opportunities to serve for adults. Very friendly and teaches the Truth! My church Center Street welcomed my family and I with open arms. We recently placed membership here after many years at a nearby Church of Christ.

They have been great to us. The preaching is sound and the bible classes are full of vibrant discussion and focus on the Word.

name: Centered Church NOLA - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: Centered Church is so amazing. The people here are very personal and caring. Living for God's mission to reach, love and care for people. I am so happy to be apart of this church. I love this church! They were so welcoming and kind. Pure joy with everyone I encountered! Such a beautiful community to be a part of! Centered church Is a church where we all get to come together around the Gospel and as we grow closer to Jesus we get to build closer community with each other. Such welcoming and sweet people. After one day I’ve felt like they like they truly care for the people around them.

name: CenterPoint Christian Fellowship
reviewSummary: I absolutely love my church! My husband and I started attending CenterPoint in 2012, and since then, my faith has deepened and our family has grown with two kids. Along the way, we've built lasting friendships. CenterPoint is a welcoming community focused on making disciples who make disciples. If you're looking for a place to grow and connect, come visit CenterPoint and get involved! Our family found community, friendship and family. It has AWESOME worship that you can really get involved in. The preaching is outstanding and keeps your interest throughout the entire message. I Love Our Church! Pastor Bill and Erin are down to earth and I love them dearly. We have been coming here for 2+ years now and we are home. We have developed a lot of friendships. We love being involved with the different ministries. Our Church family are very supportive, loving, and we enjoy being a part of CPCF. God is Good all the time! Praise the Lord for wonderful blessings! If you are looking for friendly people, Christ-centered sermons, and a service-oriented community, this is the church for you! Our kids love the nursery and children's program and special events for families. Great place to worship and friendly environment. Pastor Bill is a wonderful pastor and preacher. My kid is 3 and he loves it. They have a free daycare for the kids. I would encourage everyone to try to come here, you will not be disappointed.

name: CenterPoint Church - Gahanna - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church since Easter this year. Since the lead pastor is on a summer Sabbatical, there is a young man named Tyler that is performing the service that absolutely delivers amazing sermons. He is definitely being led by God and I just want to say how much I have enjoyed his sermon. I definitely recommend this church. They are very engaging with all who attends. I enjoy the morning coffee and donut and the kind people that greet you. I even saw the we’ll known Christian musical group The Sidewalk Prophets with my mom, sister and friend. CenterPoint Church is a welcoming and authentic community that has been a blessing to my family and me for the past seven years. The heart of this church is its people, who are genuine and compassionate, and the leadership is dedicated to spreading the love of Jesus Christ.

Pastor Dave's preaching is engaging and relatable, making the Bible's teachings relevant to everyday life. Both Pastor Dave and his wife Vicki have a HUGE hearts for people and are always willing to lend a helping hand.

The worship services, led by a talented Worship Director, are uplifting and focus on praising God. And when I say talented, I mean EXTREMELY TALENTED.

The children's leader and volunteers are dedicated to nurturing the next generation of believers. And my kids (6 & 9) have both been blessed to learn from such a kind group of volunteers.

One of the things I appreciate most about CenterPoint Church is the authenticity of its members. There is a genuine sense of community and support. My family and I have found a home here, and we invite anyone seeking a loving and genuine church family to join us. Love this place and the people.  I’ve admittedly been with this church for many years now, but I wanted to write a review so people can know what to expect.

First, the pastor is gifted in preaching the Word (Bible) in a way that can be understood by anyone, and he connects it to our lives in a meaningful way.  He is kind and takes time to love people in practical ways and to help people when they are in need.  But more importantly, he is real.  He doesn’t pretend to have it all together, and this is so refreshing.  More than anything, he truly loves Jesus in a big way, and he wants every person he encounters to know Jesus as well.  He has a HUGE HEART.

The worship director is incredibly talented, but despite her gifts, she is focused on the act of praising God instead of showcases her individual talents.  She consistently involves people (and kids) in the worship music performance even when some of them have little to no training in music at all.  It is still done very well, but she is focused on God because she knows that true worship is about the heart.  She is AMAZING and so mature despite being fairly young.  All our kids absolutely love her, and my wife and I have so much respect for her..

The pastor, his wife, their family, the youth and children leaders, the people working behind the scenes, and the people in general are real and authentic.  I love that more than anything.  Overall, the people that make up this church don’t pretend they are perfect or have it all together.

No church is perfect and ours doesn’t pretend to be perfect, but I really value these things below.

This is a church for people who want friendship and to be known by others.  You can get to know people of different ages, races, and backgrounds both on Sunday mornings and in small group Bible studies and Discipling groups.  Relationships are important and emphasized.

This is a church for people who want to learn how the Bible applies to their life.  One of the best preaching pastors I’ve ever encountered, but you can also learn with others.

This is a church for people who want to worship God in an authentic way.  If you like very loud music or a concert-type experience that is 100% fine (we all have different preferences), but this church does music differently.  It has a lot of contemporary/modern Christian music, but there is also a good balance of hymns and older music done with a modern touch.  I personally love it and I think people of all ages can appreciate and enjoy the mix.

Ultimately, this is a church if you are unsure about this whole Jesus thing.  Come and learn who Jesus really is in a comfortable non-pushy environment. CenterPoint has been great for our family. It is small enough to feel a strong connection to the Pastor, members, and causes, but big enough to talk to new people every week. The congregation is social before and after with donuts every Sunday and regular potlucks which we appreciate. The people here are amazing!! Great congregation… Well the small handful that is left…are amazing people.

Unfortunately the pastor and wife are only worried about the image of the church, and using people. Was there for years. You can check out anytime you like but you can never leave…very much like a cult. If you leave you get shunned by pastor and that wife, then they blatantly lie to everyone about it. There was even an older gentleman that donated a large sum of money to a child care part of the church… The pastor kept begging us to make sure that guy felt welcome all of the time… Just in case he could squeeze him dry.

Remember folks… It’s about the body of Christ not the body of Jansen’s little church and empty parking lot. It’s amazing who they let become pastors. Situation is like this are the reason why there is so much aetheism, but I know enough to know that this is not gods fault and they are not a representation of him.

Should get negative stars.

name: Centerpoint Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Have been going to this church for awhile and surprise surprise it’s actually a church who preaches from the Bible. Most churches have diverted from that. The pastors seem humble and people are somewhat friendly but it’s a big church and you won’t get the intimacy unless you join a small group. Another church is about ready to be planted in Menifee. If you want a authentic church that preaches from the Bible this is it Came to receive word. The word can't fail, doesn't fail, it's not forced upon on anybody it's really on you if you really want it. Jesus is waiting when ever you are ready. And tired of being sick and tired of your own old ways. You can change all that by accepting Christ Great Christmas Eve service on 12/24/23
I went to the last one at 6 p.m., their 3rd. for the day, the 6th. in two days. Their joy and energy were wonderful, and I can imagine the last performance was as great as the first, second, third, fourth, and fifth!
Thank you for the "Glory" message, pastor! It was lovely and touched my heart! Top notch and all for the glory of our God and risen savior, Jesus!!
Well done, everyone!
Happy New Year! 💜💜💜 My wife and I took my brother in law and uncle for some Saturday night worship,  it was a great place in addition to are regular Sunday service at access church in menifee at 10:30 am I love this places energy and devotion to it's followers. Pastor John is beyond awesome, his message each week gets better and better with more of my attention towards God. I'm grateful for this team to put a awesome experience each and every time. Kidsworld is super convenient while I listen to the word

name: Centerpoint Community Church - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited this church for the first time yesterday to attend a concert put on by William Jessup University's awesome choir and orchestra! My brother has been at Jessup for two months and it was a joy witnessing him and the rest of the team put on an awesome concert last night, as well as get to meet and converse with some of the local churchgoers 🥰⛪

Beautiful sanctuary ⛪😇❤️ This is our family church which has something for everyone, a contemporary service, a blended service, and online service. Come join us and meet the love of God! We have attended church here for over 10 years. Great people to share the message of God and Christ with. This is an Evangelical Presbyterian Church (EPC). This church has 21 reviews other than mine. majority is 5-stars with only a small equal ratio of 2-Star and 1-stars. In the review comments. I can only find 1 1-star review, though. They serve the homeless and provide them nightly stays under the nomatic shelters. Took my mom there for Easter service. It was a great experience. I liked the music and the Pastor's message.
Thank you Centerpoint Church for a nice Easter service.

name: CenterPointe Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: We decided on  coming to this church while visiting Lexington and was not disappointed. Music was very good and the message was spot on. They had 3 baptisms that day and it was awesome to see people accepting Jesus and announcing their faith. I highly recommend this church! We love it here! You won’t find a better more supportive community to do life with My family and I been going to the church  over three years  and it's like one big family everybody speaks to you and we  have fellowship  after church and lots of friendships  have came about amongst  the kids and the adults.Good time in praise and worship and preaching  is awesome  like right now  we just started a series in  book Romans and its really going good if you haven't studied  Romans are you don't have understanding  of Roman's please come and join us I promise you want regret it !!! Come to everyone  is loved !!!! I walked into CenterPointe Christian Church about 15 years ago and it instantly felt like home. I felt accepted and loved -- flaws and all. I've repeatedly been shown the grace of God here and have made life-long friends who have blessed me and my family.  If you're looking for Jesus, this is a great place to find him and learn how to follow him! This church is full of genuine, friendly, and welcoming people.  It's a Bible based teaching church.  The worship is wonderful!  They have a great kids ministry as well as a Jr. high and High school ministry that the teenagers actually want to go to. I would highly recommend checking it out.  Services are at 10am & 11:20am-Sundays

name: Centerville Christian Fellowship - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary: We moved to Dayton 5 yrs ago from southern Oregon. We were church hunting and went to a service here at Centerville Christian Fellowship. Holy Smokes!! This Church was the best church for worship and solid teaching of the word. I can’t give 5 stars because I was a bit disappointed at the people. The connection wasn’t there. That warm hello, how are you, welcoming vibe. If it wasn’t 30 min away I would’ve definitely went back and made the connections myself. I’m capable of doing that. But dangggg the service was INCREDIBLE 💫💫💫 Faithful exegetical preaching, worship focused on magnifying God, and gospel centricity in all aspects of ministry - Praise the Lord. We’re blessed to be a part of this church family! I’ve been to this church 2 times and both experiences were good. The gospel is proclaimed. The worship is excellent. Definitely worth checking out. I use to go to this church from 4-12 it was great!!! Then we got the preacher Erik who was some what okay in church but if he saw you out in public he would act all  weird and act like he didn’t knew who you were or that he saw you and your family every Sunday (so do the math from when the age of 9-12) he would see you act if he didn’t know you ? Ya we don’t need this pastor. When he is asked to leave or leaves on his own please someone let me know cause that church was my home and I would like to come back btw I’m 24 now Not too big not too small, just the right size to easily fit into the community.  Teaching is straight from the Bible, all the Bible. Many opportunities to serve. I have always felt very welcome.

name: Centerville Church of Christ - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary: Wholesome congregation very focused on creating a safe and loving community of believers. To get a sense of the type of church as Churches of Christ tend to vary by region: there is Acapella music (lovely voices!), communion every Sunday including a Gluten Free option, great relatable preacher and sermons, lots of active youth and opportunities for said youth, and small groups that allow for better, more meaningful fellowship. Note that you will only see men in leadership roles and this is pretty set in stone. If that is something that you are favorable or otherwise neutral to AND you are looking for a church with great fellowship, a thriving a youth group, great sermons, and great food at potlucks, then I would recommend paying a visit on Sunday morning. Always make new people feel so welcome. Very welcoming-classes and sermons stream online. Good service you can also watch it online and they have youth groups and Elder groups really good support four struggling A congregation of loving people dedicated to God's will through love and study of the Bible.

name: Centerville Community Church - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary: I know absolutely nothing about coming to this church every Sunday. However, last night our friends invited us to an event. It was a comedian and fundraiser. The comedian was funny and completely appropriate for family. We sat in the balcony and could see perfectly and our seats were comfortable. Maybe st importantly, childcare was provided! There was one room for little ones and another for bigger kids. I came back to a happy boy and everyone be there was so kind. We felt very welcome and would definitely consider coming here again! A welcoming church with a wide variety of ages, including young families. Strong, biblically based teaching. Traditional (early) service and contemporary service. Family oriented classes and youth groups. Groups for seniors. God is good they are very friendly and welcomed us with arms wide open You know Jesus is there. Praying is very important to them which I love. Kids had a blast

name: Centerville Grace Church - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary: A very welcoming church. They hosted a middle school play, and accomodatied it well. (Picture taken backstage) I've only been here once but had a real good experience. My 5yr old son loved the kids Ministry and is excited to go back. And even though I didn't partake in the free coffee it was nice to see a they offered it for free. I've been to a lot of churches and this church is top of the line. Unfortunately once you know what happens behind the scenes you'll probably be looking for another church home. I’d advise you to skip this one. Welcoming community to worship in a contemporary setting with Bible based preaching. Great worship leader! Very friendly! Great children's area. Nice service.

name: Central Avenue Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
An incredibly relaxed and open-minded Church. LGBTQ friendly and welcoming. Pastor and associate pastor have incredible backgrounds and educated worldviews. They also have a great Children's Program here. Sunday morning Services include a fantastic music Ministry and there is a Wednesday night bible study / Discussion Group that is always filled with stimulating conversation. Central Avenue Church is a church unlike one you've ever gone to before.

The values of the church are progressive, lgbt-affirming and push for a space where it's okay to have doubts. There are a lot of folks who have been isolated or left lonely by the "church" but Central is a place to openly doubt and ask questions and feel comfortable in the space of unknowing.

The church is very service-based and gay friendly and truly about social justice in the world. Great people here.  You will find three congregations using this space. Different languages. Different cultures.  Newly renovated sactuary. Very kind and flexible pastor oversees the whole. Baptism pool available. Big eating hall. Full kitchen. Artistic exterior is liked by many but not all.  Look for the full length painting of hands on the outside of the building. My wife and I have been going there since 2013 and we love it. People are very friendly and open, the spirit is young and modern. There are tons of activities to get involved, including volunteering, sports, books, movies... We also hang out pretty often outside of church. I definitely recommend giving it a shot! I don't have the experience yet but just reading that they treat everyone equally,  I would definitely go to this church

name: Central Avenue Church of Christ - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve just moved to Fairborn, as a teenager, my goal was too find a good church. keep in mind this is the first church I’ve ever been too. Ever. The second I walked in, everyone basically lined up too shake my hand and welcome me. I even received other church members’ phone numbers in case I needed a helping hand outside of church. I will definitely be coming back, I’ve fallen in love with this place. ive been attending this church for years, and it has a great welcoming atmosphere and community. it has great culture, and a lot of support and hospitality to those who are sick and need help. Everyone treats you as family and more importantly, they adhere to the truth as the bible maps out! A true love for the Lord and His idea of worship. Very friendly and welcoming body of believers! Enjoyed the lesson and hospitality :) Great Bible study. They teach the truth right from the word of God quoting Chapter and verse.

name: Central Avenue Church of Christ - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church....  Love watching the children sing.   Our grandson was baptized on Easter Sunday.  Wonderful people Great group of people. Conservative. Biblical. If we're ever back in the area we'll definitely worship there again. Kraken Church been there for over 30 years if you're visiting Valdosta it's a nice place to visit or if you're looking for a good church that's a good place to start. 🚶💀 I adore my church family; come join us! The body of Christ, focused on God’s word and full of love.  Come and see!

name: Central Baptist Church
reviewSummary: I am 49 yearssince I was 10 years Central Baptist Church with Rev Patton & Elder Scott, Usher,Choir,Sunday School With our lil butter cookies wrapped up neatly napkins after Sunday School me and Reaven RIP rushing back across street for Choir practice with Sis Marjorie to hopefully pick a robe! Yes still today CB Educational Building with Tuesday Meals 🙌 and Prayers 🙌 STILL TODAY IS MY SAFE SPACE ! I CAN STILL SEE PASTOR PATTON AND HIS WIFE GEWN DAUGHTER BRANDIE AND BRANDON BUT HERE PASTOR SAY THE DOORS OF THE CHURCH ⛪️ OPEN COME ON DOWN ! GOD BLESS 🙌 🙏 CENTRAL BAPTIST CHURCH ⛪️ Central Baptist Church is an amazing place of worship! I joined the church going on 3 months ago and have committed to attending service since! I always feel so welcome, loved, and transformed. The members, deacons, ministers, assistant pastor, and pastor make you feel at home at central! I am thrilled to be apart of such a strong and loving community and happy to call Central my church home! The pastor was excellent Great message awesome delivery Great worship and praise team. Pastor and members were very friendly. The word of God is definitely taught at this church. This church is amazing. If you're looking for a church home just come out and visit this congregation they don't force you to join when the time is right you will know. They are more than welcoming they treat you like family. I have been searching for a place to belong and I found the right place. Thank you, Central for making me feel like I belong.

name: Central Baptist Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: God's House filled with his joy and grace for 135 years. I was lucky enough to have found Central after coming home from the military, and my home church Westside had closed.  Come and visit Sunday School 10:00 Church Service 11:00. Remember, We're All Welcome In His House! My kids and me just moved into the area we are looking for a church home Do y'all have a church van or bus Nice old historical church.  Could use alot of new members and growth Great youth group. My church

name: Central Baptist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Love that everyone loves Christ Jesus and good children ministry my children like to come Wednesday and Sunday. I loved this Church as a little girl. I have alot of good memories with this Church. I was at a friend's funeral, but the energy this place gave me was inviting. I do not live in Pomona anymore, but if I did this would be the Church I would attend. I pray that the community would come together and make this a mega Church like it once was. There is alot of love from the Church staff, they seem to really care about their community. We enjoy this church family. Meets the needs of the community.  Teaches the word from the Bible. Wonderful church family.  Has helped our family since  1978. Thank you in Jesus name amen This is one of the greatest churches I have ever come into contact with. Pastor Smith and his wife have a capacity to love and show mercy unlike anybody I've known. Thank the Lord for Central Baptist Church. This is a dynamic friendly church.  They have seasoned and compassionate leadership.  I am impressed with their enthusiasm for the Lord's work.

name: Central Baptist Church of NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Love the two Pastors, they are really filled w God's Love Great church. I really loved the moments in there. This is my church and for the most part it is well-run and on schedule. We sincerely give reference to our Lord through prayer and good attitudes. There are activities for all to learn and grow in our walk with Jesus, including an excellent Sunday school class at 9:40 each Sunday.

We hope you will join us one day soon.
Be blessed! Very nice church with a great atmosphere. It's very beautiful to listen to music and all members of God and Jesus. Amen As we near Halloween, I wanted to share a story about this church. My children and I were trick-or-treating on Halloween. Life had dealt our family a few blows and we were healing. I'm from the Deep South and the blues and gospel is genetically imprinted in my DNA. The  Emanuel African Methodist Episcopal Church had occurred a few months earlier and the story hadn't left my thoughts. We were walking home, and, I heard music from the church. Lively, soulful music. I had intended to peek into the church doors to allow my little ones the opportunity to see gospel in a church. We were met by a series of people who welcomed us and kept ushering us to join them. There was a band, gift bags for the kids in the neighborhood, to keep them safe on a rowdy night, and, there was just warmth. I sat in the pew, my white face by my children, younger than eight, and, I couldn't help thinking of Charleston. I was moved that the hearts of everyone we met that evening were still open to me. I will follow the events and goings on of this church. It is also is comforting to see a different version of Baptist than the one so often symbolic of white, oppressive power. These are the Baptists of my youth and I am forever grateful for the evening. Visit and say hi!

name: Central Baptist Church of Orange County - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been coming to this church for a few years and those years were one of the best in my life. I started coming in the year COVID was making many churches do online church and I didnt like that but this church kept the doors open and I'm so glad I started going there otherwise I don't think I would've had the relationship with God that I have now. They helped me so much in knowing if I was actually saved and the true Bible and sang beautiful hymns. Much more tight knit community where you can actually know people and make lifelong friends than a mega church. They never stop fighting for The Word and are warriors for God and they do a lot by going around soul winning too and inviting families with children to the church and have missionaries they support and come over to preach as well. They offer much more and I definitely don't believe the negative reviews about the "sidewalk preacher", Mike has helped me have a beautiful bilingual Bible that would've cost me a lot to buy but he gave them outside for free and he has the joy of God in him always. He just wants to make sure you're saved and how he has a relationship with God and not religious but he was definitely getting harassed by those people who took advantage of their rights just to try to push his buttons to get a reaction and everyone else's there who was out there just trying to get their usual 9 am church service started. I wasn't there at the time, but was out of state but I understand how the church members felt there. I pray for those people who decided to do that that day and that's just their thing that they do. Even though my family and I had to move out of state, I still would call it my church. And I pray that they continue to grow and keep doing what they've been doing. Don't let that YouTube video of the first amendment rights scare you. Just give it a try and you may realize that you've found a second family who won't give up on you. I've been coming to this church for the past couple of years and I know that they are fully equipped with the truth of the gospel. If you want to get saved and know 100% that you're going to heaven then you should definitely come! "For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord." Romans 6:23 1 old lady. 1 young lady. Said I wasn’t interested. Then Told me “then I guess you don’t want to go to heaven”.   I was shocked but ignored her.  She went to knock on my neighbors door and I said “he probably won’t be interested” she then said “so you want to go to hell?” You bet I came out of my home and escorted them off the property.  Awful!!! Cult!!!!! Keep following those Jesus foot steps. Excellent bible exegesis. This congregation truly values the word of God, written in the King James Bible, above everything else. This church is a safe, loving place for the family, and a place one can really learn the bible and improve one's life. Their website says "there is NO DRESS CODE for it's members or GUESTS"

So I came here wearing clothes of the opposite gender and I was kicked out.

This cult welcomes and accepts a select few. Who are they to judge?

Do not come here. There are better churches out there that do not discriminate.

name: Central Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I want to thank Pastor Rich, Michele, Noah, Dana, Jim, the cleaning couple/bouncer (lol), and everyone else that I haven’t mentioned. You all were so great to myself and my guests. I know this was a little unique and us traveling in from Texas. The communication was superb, the location was perfect, the planning was amazing with no flaws. Literally everything was breathtaking and full of love and emotion. Thank you for your hospitality, time, blessings, prayer, guidance, encouragement, references and love! Everyone loved their experience as well. For anyone looking to have their special day captured, their church; prayer room, garden and chapel offer some pretty incredible views for great shots on your special day For nearly 9 years this church has felt like “Home”!
I will always return here for some heart surgery and family hugs!

May the Lord always be in this place! They truly believe and practice what they preach. This church is the writing on the wall! The wonderful fellowship here.
Groups of all ages have activities for Christian growth.
Amazing Gray's for seniors. Pastor Rich has a heart for the saved and unsaved. Central Christian Church is definitely inspired by the holy Spirit! The hospitality & comfort in abundance. It's a place to grow in Christ along side Family, brothers and sisters in Christ Jesus our Savior!

name: Central Christian Church
reviewSummary: Welcoming multi-generational community in Coral Gables committed to biblical discipleship, community outreach, and heartfelt contemporary praise.

name: Central Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is stunning modeled on a 15 century Florence Church according to custodian Philip. It truly is a piece of spiritual history right in the heart of Austin and they continue to share the love of God and the way of Jesus even in this modern age, you could say it’s a modern day blast from the past. Pastor Lang’s words are a balm to the souls of those gathered and the choirs voices really lift the spirits. They also have a wonderful garden that is a pride and joy with occasional plant sales to help fund the church. There is real wisdom of the ages here. Amen! Amen! Amen! ☧🙏🏼🐜❤️‍🔥🧠🤖 I loved their traditional services held in such a beautiful and peaceful historical building. But do not feel intimidated! The vibe and message is “come as you are” and they mean it. Rev Layne and Pastor Heidi made me feel like I had a second home while traveling. The building and grounds are lovingly cared for and the amount of community outreach and support they provide is an incredible example of Christian love. Not protestant, base on website doesn't believe in Nicene Creed. Wonderful place to worship and meditate. It is one of the oldest churches in Austin. Beautiful working pipe organ and other instruments.
Come help us celebrate on Sunday at 11am 🙏🥖🍷✝️ I attended this Church for only one Sunday when I was looking for a Church over a year ago. There was largely an older population that was very small and was at the time meeting in a small room on the side due to issues with the HVAC system. I would neither recommend this Church nor not recommend this Church. I primarily attended this Church for the Architectural aspect and was saddened that I was unable to view the Sanctuary due to their HVAC issues. I 100% would recommend this building for anybody interested in Architecture.

name: Central Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary: Was needing help,  sent them emails. Every church has a community outreach, it was a shame that they were not the only one's there are ten reviews to do today.  Never asked for anything out of the normal. Just know sometimes God is trying to provide,  when he asks you to seek help,  then you do You realize church ⛪️ is some wood and nails,  and community is just word. A friendly, caring church providing lots of outreach, a Nearly New store and Kids Connection preschool. They did have a great pantry. I used to go in and help them on Thurs to put the food out for the people to get on Saturday morning. Now that the person was running it stepped down. The pastor is running it. The setup is Sat morning when the truck deliveries. We do not have the time to set it up safely before the people come thru. The pantry opens up at 10am. It takes at least 1 to 2 hrs to setup right and clean up. This will not be safe for anyone. Very warm and welcoming, my wife and I got married here. They have activities for children during worship, it's a great place to find peace and God. Went to a FAST meeting here and it is a nice church building. It seems that the pastor and members are very friendly.

name: Central Christian Church - Food Distribution Center - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary: Always feel at peace here. Great people. It's the Ccc family. Excellent service from the staff, I give them a 100! They are very helpful. Thank you all so much for your attention. The volunteers are very helpful people, thank you for your social work. I'd like to know how this program works; I'd like to volunteer. Thank you. Excellent organization!

name: Central Christian Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Children had a blast for the first day of spring break. Thank you so much for inviting us to block party. The time and effort is greatly appreciated. You helped lots of people laugh, heal, and feel welcome. Great church They treat God's word with care of responsible teaching, praising, both older hymns and fresh new anointing in Contemporary
praise music. Jesus is highly exalted here. Well this pass Sunday after the service we had a barbecue dinner.The pastor and His wife are such nice people. A nice place to worship. Turn the bells down please god I can’t take it anymore I was  invited to a service about a year ago and have been attending since. It is the right time and place to be to find some comfort and hope in our daily lives.

name: Central Christian Church - Gilbert - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
​"I can’t say enough good things about the Central Christian Gilbert campus! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is incredibly welcoming and high-energy. The worship is powerful, and the messages are always practical, grounded, and easy to apply to daily life.
​What I love most is the genuine sense of community—there’s a place for everyone here, whether you’re looking for a great kids' program or a way to get involved in local outreach. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, this is it!" Let’s be honest here… I can’t see why anyone could write a bad review about any church. But everyone’s entitled to their own opinion. I haven’t been to church in over 15 years… I was looking to go to church and stumbled across this one. It felt like a sign from God for me to attend today. I was immediately greeted by Sherri at the “New here” tent. She was a wonderful woman and very knowledgeable. We walked in and were given free vouchers for their coffee café. Initially, I was impressed; it was beautiful and welcoming. I loved the atmosphere, and the service was great. Numerous times I had tears in my eyes. The band was awesome, and so was the Pastor. I believe I have found my new church. God bless! I came to Central Christian this Sunday heartbroken over Charlie Kirk’s passing and hopeful to see so many new visitors searching for God due to what has been happing. it was no secret today had the biggest attending in church for many church’s. With the world shaken and more people in church than I’ve ever seen, it felt like a moment to call hearts to Christ, pray for bold faith, and speak to what’s happening right now.

While there was prayer, the guest speaker introduced as a former leader opened by apologizing for not having anything prepared. After three days to plan, there was still no focused message about the urgency of faith, no reflection on Scripture like 2 Timothy 2, and no invitation to salvation on a day when so many were ready to hear the gospel.

I’ve attended for three months and know there is good in this church. But on a historic day when people’s hearts were open, the sermon felt disconnected and unwelcoming to seekers. For me, this was a missed, kingdom-size opportunity and a deeply discouraging choice.

I will no longer attend, though I pray God continues to work here and that others who feel called will find what they need. I love love love this church! I've been going here for years and it is such an incredible place to worship! The messages are always amazing and very applicable to life. This church will talk about topics that other churches won't touch, and I value how real and helpful they are to difficult issues that could arise in life.

They have lots of groups (men, women, moms, single moms, children of various ages, those struggling with grief, those struggling with addiction) so everyone can find a place that they belong and get support that they need.

All pastors and staff are so personable, kind, and encouraging. They have helped me grow immensely in my faith!  I cannot recommend this church enough! What I am coming here to say is extremely difficult and heartbreaking. I am finally deciding to break my silence about the neglect that I suffered while attending the children’s service at this church during my youth. Both me and my brother are disabled and have ADHD and autism and we were both made to feel like outcasts for being different. name: Central Christian Church - Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I was contemplating on leaving a review but the way so many families are struggling rn , I felt like I should warn anyone else looking for churches who offer assistance. I filled out there benevolence form, I received a call back in 24 hrs just for them to automatically deny me, please there are families struggling right now if you are going to immediately turn families away there no point in calling back. Please provide more information on the requirements to getting help instead of just telling someone you guys don’t have funds and if you don’t have funds please also update information so people don’t waste there time filling out forms that they have no chance in receiving help . I use to attend this church when Dean Kuest was the pastor,  he was hardly there and when he was the first thing he would ask for to all the people who were in attendance is to donate MONEY? Church is not about MONEY?  It is suppose to be about enlightenment, inspiration, fellowship etc... I stopped going here because all Dean cared about was MONEY! He use to brag about his son's college education at ASU if I remember correctly. ASU's tuition was expensive back then and is more expensive! now. Also at the end of service he would ask  the congregation for MONEY! How do you think he was able to put his son through college? One day i went to attend service Dean literally followed me around in the lobby? Made me feel completely unwelcomed. I use to attend the Men's Recovery group on Friday nights also  but I stopped attending that cause it was unstructured. I'm happy to say I been Alcohol free since September of 2018.  The reason I'm sharing this now is because it seems nothing has changed here. The cost of living is outrageous in Phoenix and the surrounding areas there are people who can barely make ends meet! It's extremely disappointing and sad that all this place cares about is what amount of MONEY you can donate. That is the truth. After the band played a few songs before service all we would do is watch videos of another pastor? giving a sermon from another church location?  A huge let down! that's why so many people leave and go elsewhere. Dean and his crew would go to Israel on Vacation on your dime with the money people donated? And used it to live in their big nice houses and to drive their nice car's? While everyone else is struggling to pay rent,bills,groceries,gas and can't even afford health care or prescriptions? But this is a "Christian"church? You do the math. Big clean friendly church.  They offer free hot dogs after Saturday night service and a free t-shirt for newcomers.  I don't like how often they talk about money and how their main pastor is just a recording of some pastor somewhere else played on a screen.  The location pastor Dean barley speaks which stinks cause I like him better....They have a great band and good music, and offer several courses/classes It's a fantastic church full of committed people. And a great community to support and be supported in life's struggles. I have friendships here that have endured for nearly three decades (from the Mesa campus).  Come worship and find a community, a tribe, and a family. I truly appreciate how warm, accepting, and friendly everyone at Central Church is. The kindness and openness I experienced made a deep impression on me.

I firmly believe that God works in mysterious ways, guiding our lives to intersect with others in ways that bring encouragement, joy, and spiritual growth. Being able to explore this beautiful country, which I call home, has been a profound blessing in itself. Although my physical home is over 1,600 miles away, I’ve always found that every place I go in the United States feels like home in its own way. My time here has been nothing short of rewarding, and I can confidently say that my experience at Central Church has added to that sense of belonging.

I sincerely look forward to returning in the future, and when I do, I hope to spend more time getting to know more of this wonderful congregation.

reviewSummary: Very rude volunteers who will interrupt you and your social worker Terri Jo is a liar. After she rudely made loud noises on the phone and said the chruch couldnt help , she proceeded to ask me unnecessary questions like “ how i was going to pay my rent going forward “and “ if i had a job why i cant pay my bills” word from word what she said.
