name: Central Christian Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary:
I started coming to Central Christian Church about two years ago, and it has been a meaningful experience ever since. It’s especially special to me because it’s located in the same neighborhood where my grandmother once lived.

Through the church, I’ve been able to reconnect with familiar faces and build new relationships within the congregation. I’ve also had the opportunity to take part in service projects, including helping with renovations around the church, which made me feel even more connected to the community.

The support from members has been incredible—I was even able to attend a retreat thanks to their encouragement. Pastor Tim, his wife, and the staff consistently deliver a great message on the weekends—I always find myself looking forward to the next service.

I’m also part of the men’s group at the church. We stay in touch, and I try to attend the men’s breakfasts and events throughout the year, which has been another great way to stay connected.

Although my current work schedule doesn’t always allow me to attend Sunday services in person, I stay connected by watching services on YouTube during the week and keeping in touch with others.

It’s a beautiful, welcoming place with a strong sense of community. I’m grateful to be part of it and look forward to being back in person again soon. Went there for a funeral.The place was beautiful, everything went well.It's great place for a wedding as well.I would imagine I love this place, everything is just what we need right now for our family 😎💯👊🙏🧬 CCC is like a big family you can’t wait to see every week. The teaching is on point and from the word; the worship is amazingly coordinated and fun for everyone; there are no clicks or exclusive groups- everyone is there to encounter Jesus and help others find and follow Him.

Bonuses- great kids program, great espresso bar, lots of groups during the week; staff who are always trying to find new creative ways to give back to the community and make church fun again.

If you haven’t already, give them a shot, at the very least you can snag a welcome bag with popcorn haha Great family oriented church! If you want to feel like part of a family then this is the place to be. They include children at the beginning of each service but then allow them to go off to an age oriented children's worship experience. Sunday services are at 9am and 11am

name: Central Christian Church - Mesa - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Loved my old church, as we moved too far away to attend anymore.  I was a volunteer in the toddler room.  This church does what Jesus teaches us in the Bible. They help the surrounding communities and when I joined, they had only 3 campuses.  Now they have at least 6 and that tells you people love their work and the message of the Bible that they end up joining and they needed to expand.  I miss Cal Jurnigan’s preaching and love the way they serve the community around them. We attended this church twice as we were in the area for a month’s vacation. There were several greeters along the way to the auditorium who were all friendly and gracious. We enjoyed the worship very much  - we could hear the congregation around us singing which is rare these days in contemporary worship settings. We were surprised the sermon was by video however, you could tell this pastor was connected to this campus and it felt very personal, as if he was in the room. We were blessed by the worship and the sermon and the many ministries this church has weekly. If we were in the neighbourhood longer, we wouldn’t hesitate to make this our church our home and get involved in its weekly programs. Thank you, Central for being a blessing! God bless you in all your endeavours in the community and abroad. (PS in reading reviews of other churches, people take note of the air conditioning - the a/c at Central was very comfortable, we were not frozen out and no sweater needed 😎) I applied at this church for financial assistance. I received a phone call today the lady asked me two questions then told me they can’t help me. I asked her why and she replied they just can’t help me financially.
I lost my job on the 8th of this month. I missed too many days due to the growth I have in my left leg. If you gonna deny someone assistance that’s already at rock bottom the least you can do is provide some type of explanation. So Christian like Awesome church. The pastor, Cal, is extremely humble but is not afraid of standing behind God's word in a loving way. This place is not for the religious but for one who wants to follow Jesus. The cafeteria is large and serves a good variety of hot and cold drinks as well as bagels and sandwiches. They serve peet coffee which is a good brand of coffee. Best church ever! We decided to try this church out 12 years ago and it immediately became the church we wanted to raise our kids at, 3 kids later and we still call central home. My week can’t truly begin until we hear the amazing messages every weekend. I love the community we have built and the village we have to help us raise our boys up in Gods love. Don’t be intimidated by the size of the church, there is a network here for all people!

reviewSummary:
I'm going to do the Buts first. The worship music is great but loud. I know God hears us. The big down side is some of the men disrespect the Lord by wearing there hats in HIS House. The message is always Great. Yes it's a video feed. I'm not here to see the pastor but hear the word of God. So for those that don't like it get over it. It's the word and praising God your there for. P.S. bring the popcorn God love's it. So I honestly can't rate this church personally because I have only been there 1 time because God used them to answer me but here is my most honest question and I may be outdated here but is there a single Baptist church preferably southern baptist church in the east valley that does not distract their flock with standing and singing but instead reads from the word of God and explain. I feel like these days I can be closer to God by sitting in a empty field in pitch black surrounded by coyotes vs over bearing non stop singing and no true preaching if im wrong here im sorry but im looking for a true traditional baptist church Yeah, the disconnection is huge here. They say I read that it’s key for them to have a consistent message. That’s a lame excuse for what they are doing. It’s so they can save money from having to pay multiple pastors. At first it didn’t feel like a mega church, but then when the projector pastor came on. Man. Talk about a let down. Again- just so they have “consistent message” but really so they can make more money and have less payrolls. It’s that kind of church. Central has been home for me for the past 20 years.
I first started attending the Mesa campus in my teens, and later moved to Queen Creek when my husband and I began our family. The messages and the Word are what keep us rooted here.

Central’s main theme has always been to LOVE BEYOND — a value that’s deeply woven into our own home as well. Yes, sometimes the message is on a screen, but it could just as easily be on the radio — it’s still God’s message, and that’s what we come for.

If you’re looking for a place to start your journey with Christ, I encourage you to take the leap and come to church 🧡.
And if Central isn’t your cup of tea, that’s okay — find your cup of tea, but don’t stop searching. Please give a shout out to the volunteer who stands outside every Sunday morning at 9:20am, waving at people driving past. Every time I drive past and see him, I am tempted to pull in just because he seems so genuinely friendly. A great reflection of your church, as someone who has never been. I literally pulled over just to write this, and am now looking at your website and programs!

Peace ✌️
Brian Bruce I recently switched day cares and chose Central Christian after viewing several others in the downtown area. I fell in love with it the moment I walked inside. Miss Geraldine was so kind and introduced me to a really caring group of people.

And he is definitely Called man of God and he will stand before the Lord and hear those precious words one day "WELL DONE MY GOOD & FAITHFUL SERVANT" 💜💟 WE LOVE YOU PASTOR LORAN & WE THANK THE LORD FOR SUCH A HOLY SPIRIT FILLED PASTOR. THANK YOU FOR PASTORING YOUR FLOCK.

name: Central Church - College Station Campus
reviewSummary: Supposedly this church is part of the first 100 churches to go to Israel and  implement Israels mixed with Christians values. Pastor Chris is amazing. Unashamedly bringing us the truth with love and pure biblical teaching. There are plenty of things going on for young to old. SO many ways to serve! Sermon is interpreted for the deaf and hard of hearing and there is a Spanish ministry too. Great church. I attended a Wonderful Celebration of John Silas Sanford, he is a miracle Child of God, Amen. ❤️ Great service, definitely made you feel welcome. Kids enjoy the youth program This was my home church for the longest time. I am so saddened and angered to see what it has become. I visited this Sunday for old times sake and my spirit was absolutely enraged by what I witnessed. They didn’t even read out of the bible for communion. The sermon was very light and fluffy no meat and potatoes. But what angered me most to see was the church selling not just books and bibles but, merch, hats and t shirts with their central logo. My father’s house is not a marketplace. If there were tables in there I would’ve flipped them. Central has strayed far away from God, and really lost the heart of the church’s mission. I am so so disappointed and angry by what it has become. They have many members and their job is to lead them like Jesus would, not make a profit selling church merch.

name: Central Church - Henderson (Broadcast) - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
I was on this side of town for a listing appointment to list a home, I was so thankful it was so close to Central Church and would get to attend.
This church is awesome, teaching, preaching, singing, worshiping. I just love coming when I can. Pastor Judd is awesome and the rest of the crew. There is no doubt in my mind that there is passion at this church. I attended with my whole family last year at Easter. 🐣 I attended yearly for Surge. For the occasional it is absolutely fantastic. The huge screens and music is wonderful. They have a tendency to baptize a lot of people. I think 64 last night. It was moving.

I do attend another local church. I’m just being honest here: for me personally, I prefer a more biblical approach to teaching/preaching during service instead of anecdotal experiences. When I brought my 81 year old Mum to a few services they were during “special” services like Easter & Christmas Eve. The story of Christ’s resurrection and victory over death on behalf of his children/believers was not mentioned. In fact the entire teaching during the service was about how there was an argument in the car between spouses and we needed redemption.

I know there is a place for this, but my family left confused and slightly unfulfilled for such a meaningful occasion. It was just odd. I do believe that Central Church is on mission and works for Christ. Therefore, lives are changed.

Honestly-I need a more Bible centered approach. That’s just my preference. I support this church ⛪️. I love the church members and all of their efforts. I hope that whichever church home you find, it blesses you and draws you nearer to Our Savior. That’s what matters. Whether you’re a visitor in Las Vegas or a long-time resident, I encourage you to come and experience this church. It is a nondenominational fellowship that welcomes everyone, just as Christ welcomes us (Romans 15:7). No matter your past, your story, or your struggles—you are received here as family.

Here, it is truly okay not to be okay. There is no judgment, only grace (John 1:16). No whispers, only love (1 Corinthians 13:4-7). You are invited to come just as you are (Matthew 11:28-30), and let the Lord guide your steps back onto His path through the encouragement of this church and its faithful members.

We are one body in Christ (1 Corinthians 12:12-13), and together we walk in His light. So come and join us—there is a place for you in God’s house 🤍 11.15.25
Came to this church for the Life Surge event. So many people Under One Roof and yet it was still comfortable. Holy Spirit was definitely in that room! Staff was really nice and friendly...... would definitely come here for church service when I'm back in the area to visit 💟✝️ Last 2 Sunday May 24 & 31 I must say was really touching. This is my first time attending this church and I LOVE IT. The music and the Worship was so touching for me and will continue to attend Sunday service. Thanks to all who made every Sunday amazing! ❤️

name: Central Church - Summerlin - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: Searched for months for a church and finally found one we love. Pastor Jud is funny, relatable and always has a good message. Kids zone is great and provides parents with the chance to enjoy and listen to the message. The location is at a high school, but the auditorium makes the music and atmosphere that much better. The very first time my family and I attended our first Christmas, we felt welcome by the church members. It was an uplifting and enjoyable service which was something we had never experienced before. If you are looking for a place of worship where you feel relaxed and welcome, then give Central Church a try as you will be glad you did. A very diverse welcoming church. Non-denominational, great worship and service. They help a lot of people in need and offer a lot of programs that'll help anyone, no matter where you are in your faith walk. My family and I are so blessed to have found this church! We have been made to feel welcomed and service has been great. Only the 9 AM service is live, the 10:30 AM service that we go to is a recording of the service prior, but it is so engaging that you definitely forget that. I am so glad we finally found a place to call home. I am definitely looking forward to this weekend‘s Christmas events and performances. I really like the service and how the message is delivered!

name: Central Church of Christ - Amarillo Campus
reviewSummary:
Was trying to get information to help me with paying my rent. Because it was so close to Christmas they had used all of the funds used up. Now I'm 2 months behind for my rent. And this week I was serviced with an eviction notice. I have to be in court the beginning of February. I have been terminated from my job that I worked at for 5 years. I was out due to having back surgery. The staff was very helpful and friendly Great worship service Great church! However I didn't feel the holy ghost it was something strange and odd kind of? But nice ppl hands down. No talking behind others backs this time.yippipikhay..lol they don't even have to say a word.. Good shot When we went I honestly must say there were loving people in my Mother's generation that were friendly & reached out.  We wanted to be a part of a small group where the real connections are made. Each of the two we were invited to join was all people in my Mother's generation. No fellowship for our young daughter.  We tried visiting other classes to become part of a group with children.  We knew this way in time we might become included & involved.  Not one friendly gesture. To give an example; our daughter wished to be baptized & we had no way to get in touch with anyone but the preacher. He was in Israel at the time. We tried desperately but ended up baptizing her in our bathtub & streaming it on Facebook messenger to family as witnesses.  What do you say to a young Christian who comes home from school or the kids gym & tells you kids there are loving and excepting unlike at church?  This is a problem for God's church.  I find a great many Christian friends from college who no longer go to church now because they had no Christian fellowship.  I honestly believe a great many good Christians are so busy in their lives, & visiting their friends at church & busy doing good works they don't notice.  Central has good Christians there. A beautiful widow in the first class we were a part of loved me with a giving & Christian heart. She is always in my prayers & I miss her everyday. Central's amazing work to help those downtown is truly a blessing to Amarillo.  I have no anger or bitterness in my heart & I pray every morning & night for God's church.  I only pray now that he will give me the strength to keep myself & my family true to Him & to continue to go & worship him with no Christian fellowship to strengthen us except from our family who live out of town. May God bless & help all Christians to have their eyes opened as mine are now.
I remember a church in Abilene that assigned long time members who volunteered to new members.  They were called their Member key couple or family. The new members were given all contact information for them. These long time members would help them become involved, answer questions, meet with them each week & more.
I also remember that their Sunday night Care groups were shuffled up each year. So that the groups didn't become so tight knit that new members would not feel like intruders or outsiders & so all members got to know each other better. The care groups were made up of all ages to better learn from each other. The Soul Friends groups were never shuffled.
They met with us & have already started to help make things better.  We now have access to their member application & have synchronized our group calendars on our electronic devices.  Wonderful church that listens & is willing to help.
After this we never were put in small groups & we asked for help moving my mother in on a Wednesday night hours before class. We were refused. It would have taken less than an hour with just a few people. My husband & I did it ourselves took past 11 at night. We have met former members since we left & they were never included either & only called about money pledge to their ignite program. It is sad that the church is like this. The church isn't just supposed to be clickish or minister to the "unchurched".  I cannot even count the number of people who are baptized Christian who don't go to church anymore at all. Really sad! I just wanted to thank your church for helping with my electric bill yesterday. I feel so embarrassed that I had to ask for help. Everyone was so kind and non judgemental and I appreciate you for that. Thank you so much

name: Central Church of Christ - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary:
Really nice church, everyone was friendly and inviting. I will be going back, just know that Bible class starts at 9AM and Worship Service starts at 10AM. I was a bit late but I really enjoyed myself. Worth checking out if you are looking to meet some really good people. This is a bigger and growing church. With a new facility built only a few years ago able to accommodate 400+ people. The church itself is more conservative. Purely Acapella, and teachings based solely on the Bible. Despite the numbers of this church the visitors don't get lost in it. Members will find you and greet you!

Plenty of classes for all ages! 1-100. And a nursery service is available during Worship.

Elders and Ministers are friendly. And the church always has something going on in the community.  If you are looking for a place to worship or just to visit I'd suggest trying multiple places around the area as well as this one!

Sunday Classes- 9 A.M.
Sunday Morning Service- 10 A.M.
Sunday Evening Service- 6 P.M.

Wednesday Classes- 630 P.M. The Trunk or Treat was so much fun! We loved riding on the Choo-Choo Train! All the kid's costumes were great! We loved all the different Chilis & Boiled Peanuts!! Had free food, water and household items after Hurricane Helene.
Everyone so nice. And very well organized in and out in 24mins. Regular member, absent due to Covid concerns.
All measures and CDC guidelines followed.
Family friendly yet Bible directed so glad to be in fellowship again.

name: Central Church of Christ - Dalton Campus
reviewSummary: Central is a wonderful congregation. My family started attending about 2 years ago and the warmth and encouragement we got on our first visit has never lessened. I love my church family here. A very active, welcoming, loving group of Christians! Our family immediately felt comfortable and accepted here. Lots of opportunities to be part of a community, an active youth group, and great children's ministry. Central is an incredibly loving and welcoming spiritual family where I feel people seem to truly care about Jesus and each other. My kids also love participating in the children’s programs, and we enjoy being part of the life groups there. This church has been wonderful. I love the congregation and I've never met a more loving and helpful group of people. I invite everyone coming to join us! A welcoming and uplifting church with a genuine sense of community. The messages are encouraging and there is a Sunday school class for every age! Grateful to be part of it!

name: CENTRAL CHURCH OF CHRIST - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary: This church is quite different. From the very first day we attended 3 years ago to the present, this congregation treats you like family. It is definitely different than other Church of Christ churches in that they are focused on loving people and reaching out to support those who are struggling. I have yet to see much in the way of legalism. This truly a great place to worship. If you happen to visit, please be sure to arrive early or stick around afterwards to get to know folks. I love central church because you can come as you are and everyone still welcomes you with loving arms. This is a church like no other. The people are great and the services are great and I absolutely love their Bible studies. If I could give then stars I would. Great church!! Open to everyone and very diverse. Come as you are! My future husband has just joined the church and I go on Sundays with him I enjoy it very much I have never met such nice people who are so helpful to their community and truly are people of God Clean, nice. My wife & I got married there. The people want to know you. They try to make all comfortable and welcome.

name: Central Church of Christ - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
I have so much that I love about Central! The church is committed to loving this city and following Jesus together. The church values its diversity and is a place where the people really seem to care for each other deeply. there is a vibrant worship culture there (if a little quirky), and my family is excited to be there! My granddaughter Anaiya Williams was one of your high school Graduates of  2024 .
Thank you so kindly for your helping her with your high school program and your loving caring management hard work to helping each one of your students Achieve their high school diplomas and have this experience of success in their lives journeys .
Thank you for each person that has done a part in making this happen for each one of your Students of 2024 you are appreciated greatly .
May you EACH ONE HAVE MANY ABOUNDENT PROSPEROUS BLESSINGS  AND DEVINE PROTECTIONS WITH HOLY SPIRIT GIDEANCE TO HELP COVER AND KEEP YOU THROUGH IT ALL IN JESUS MIGHTY HOLY NAME AMEN. Nice people, nice church 💯 their always having special events for members and children 😁 Pastor Leon is warm and loving with a wonderful Gospel of Jesus Christ lesson to share. He has beautifully kept us in touch during this pandemic. Thanks be to GOD. This church provides a space for the hour long Narcotics Anonymous (NA) meeting called "Living Clean" on Monday (6pm), Wednesday (5:15pm) and Friday (6pm) in the "annex building" across the street from the main church building. This same group also meets on weekends a few blocks away at a place called "Recovery Central" at 1305 W Markham at 8pm.

name: Central church of Christ - Moore Campus
reviewSummary: We moved to Oklahoma in 2008 and Central has been home for us. The people are truly Christians (Christ like) - kind and loving - and the leadership is devoted to looking after the members. Words cannot describe this church.  Don't take my word though start Sunday morning at 9:30 & just see the blessing you will get.  Wonderful pastors, elders, deacons & members.  Only the true gospel is taught here.  No reading between the lines.  Love this church. ❤️❤️❤️ I've been introduced to this church's   strong messages, Bible based teachings. I can say alot, but to put it on a more personal level, if you love God and believe in the word u owe it to urself to attend and feel the presence of God's word. Friendly, welcoming, Bible knowledgeable. Practical lessons and life supporting. Great church for us to feel home away from home. Conservative, Bible based worship service. Very welcoming and friendly!

name: Central Church of Christ - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
My name is Armanda M. Roberts Wisman.
I am the only child of Harry Roberts Jr & Willie Mae Roberts.
We first attended this church in 1972 where i had my 3rd birthday party in the nursery of the church.
My father Harry was then stationed at Camp Pendleton base when he was a Marine.
My father at the time had many roles throughout his years here; ie teaching singing classes, preaching, decon, elder, and much more.
Then was recognized for 66 years of preaching, and teaching the true word of God.
My father passed away Jan 19, 2021 at 85 years of age 😥
He fought with the strength of God to hold on in these last day's.
Now my mother passed back in 1999 now my father. Im saddened more than anyone could know.
I am very happy that both my mom, and dad were right with God before their departure 😊
I needed for all to know this as it is close to my heart, and these beautiful building that holds all the great treasures of God.

To all who took the time to read this " Thank You"
This IS the church to truly learn Gods word, and not man's.

If anyone who needs to reach me ?
I'm on Facebook as Armanda Maria Roberts Wisman please contact me there 😊
To my church family I LOVE YOU ALL.

God bless you
Armanda, my hubby Jack,
My dad Harry's grandchildren Sonti Carl, Isaac Walters, and great grandson Vincent W. 💛 Best church in the world! Great church!

name: Central Church of Christ - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary: When we visited while on vacation, we found a warm and welcoming church family.  We were invited to stay for the after worship lunch and fellowship. It was delicious!   We were treated like the brothers and sisters that we all are.  Not only is the Bible is preached here, it is put into practiced. Wonderful People. Friendly and welcoming. Love when I’m in town and get to come and worship. Teaching provided which is seeped in Biblical truth but presented with ways to easily apply to everyday life. I accidentally had the pizza delivered to the business across the street.  It worked out.  The pizza was perfect. Great, loving people who love God and are dedicated to biblical truth! Good service times.  Easy to find w/Google.

name: Central Church of Christ - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: Central is a caring congregation of flawed individuals working to help each other get better every day and to spread the Word of God throughout the World. Friendliest church in Tuscaloosa county!! Many opportunities to participate--Ladies Bible class Wednesdays 10-11:15 Mid-August thru Mid-May: such a community outreach & world-wide outreach to help impoverished children & adult shut-ins. Sunday School classes 9:00-9:50--GREAT studies/hands on activities for children; a variety of adult Bible classes: textual studies & topics. July4-September 26, 2018 Wednesday 7:15 pm Ladies Bible class studying topics such as: Does God Have a Sense of Humor?, The Roles of the Holy Spirit, The Sins of the Tongue, Modesty for Christian Girls & Women, Textual Studies of Psalm 23, Micah 6:8, & the Lord's Prayer, Tithing in the Old & New Testaments, There's a Great Day Coming:Scenes at the Judgment, What is Hell Like & Who's Going, and How Beautiful Heaven Must Be! COME AND STUDY WITH US, please. This is a wonderful body of believers. Very welcoming and a positive encouraging lesson. The bible class in the morning before worship was enlightening. They seek to help their community. This is the Lord's church and the only church that will help you make it to heaven. Questions asked during teachings are always answered with the bible. All the Churches of Christ greet you.... Romans 16:16 Bible believing Church, if you have questions they will answer then. No question is not answer

name: Central City Assembly of God Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: It's a lovely place filled with lovely people, the pastor is a REALLY, really! awesome young man. This church really brought me closer to Christ and got me more connected to the people around me! I highly recommend this place especially in a world filled with many churches and churches that aren't being examples of Jesus, but this church you can definitely trust and you can trust the pastor he's a really good man and is very welcoming :)!! Thank you Cca I'm happy to be in this church! Starting coming to this church and never looked back. Love how the word is preached and not watered down. Sticking to the true doctrine of Jesus Christ and ALL of his teachings. 🙏 Visiting from out of state and felt incredibly welcomed. Solid Biblical teaching and wonderful worship! They have various outreaches and discipleship opportunities. Blessed to see a church family of faith on fire for the Lord! Love this church! Love the people! CCA has a wonderful, welcoming congregation that treat you like family. It is a small, intimate place where you get to know each other and make new friends. They have amazing worship, caring preachers, and activities to get engaged with others. If you're looking for a place where you get lost in the crowd, this is probably not the place for you. If you want to be noticed, valued and a part of something great than I invite you to come to CCA and try it out. I think you will like it.

name: Central City Christian Fellowship - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary:
Great ministry!!! Great people!!!! Pastor Darren & First Lady Serita are a FIRST RATE dynamic ministerial duo!!!!

They are active with their member & the community at large. They can be found hosting community giveaways & events that enrich & empower the masses.

The service they render in the Central City area of New Orleans is invaluable. They cover this area with the Word of the Lord. The area is FAVORED because of their presence. My Church is fill with members whom God hand picked his self to serve him🙏🙏🙏 The people r so great Awesome time Blessings

name: Central City Church - Macon Campus
reviewSummary:
Sharing my personal experience as a former attendee: this church lacks financial transparency—budgets and spending aren’t made available - or at least I never saw them. The pastor does not report to anyone - there is no board or elders, which presents a lack of accountability. Leadership feels disengaged from the congregation’s growth, and general spiritual health, and the pastor is often busy writing books, but it feels the church could use more attention. We left feeling unheard and discouraged after a year here. We pray for the people there as there are amazing people there. If you're looking for a church, I would strongly recommend looking elsewhere - there are many great local options. Everyone here is so nice and friendly. The pastor is awesome, i love listening to his sermons. They have the most amazing kids programs.
You can go dressed up or dressed down.
I highly recommend central city church I'm so happy and blessed to have found this church for myself & my daughter!
I've been going for 5weeks now.
After the very first visit, I immediately knew that
I wanted this to be my forever church.
Everyone is extremely friendly and the service/message is always amazing.
The band/singers are so awesome!!! I went as I am new to the area and am trying to find my new home church. I liked the facility and the worship. However, on this particular day, the pastor stopped in the middle of the sermon to tell a woman, over the microphone in front of everyone, that her kids were a distraction and that they needed to go to a different room and “if they settled down they could come back in.” The kids in question were behaving just fine, in my opinion. Personally, I found it more distracting that the pastor himself called her out publicly in front of everyone. I could only imagine her embarrassment. It could’ve been handled in a much better way, either after the service, or a deacon/staff member quietly talking to her. It most definitely did not need to be over the microphone in front of everyone. I liked it at first, but this incident quickly made me decide I will not be returning for a second visit. I could not even focus on the message for the rest of the time because I was so appalled at the situation and how it was handled. Overall, I just found it very unprofessional of him as a pastor. We were visiting our son, daughter in law and granddaughters. This church is AMAZING! We felt very welcome, and the Pastor genuinely loves the Lord. I can’t tell you how much we were blessed!!! Thank you!!

name: Central City Lutheran Mission - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
PROS
- They took me in during a time of an emergency
- They feed you Breakfest and Dinner
- You can take a shower everyday
CONS
- I was there for 3 days and was targeted by a few  people in there. Someone stole my clothes and was hated on because I had a job and car.
-If something comes up missing they are not responsible.
- They close you in where the bunks are with no outside air coming in or AC. This is how people get sick from others.

I thank God he was with me and allowed me to endure what I did. But I also thank Lutheran for allowing me to be there during an emergency time in my life.
God Is Good All The Time First , THIS IS A MENS ONLY SHELTER.
Unless things changed.

Also ,this was my experience at the time.
Maybe things have changed.....

Personal Pros

Better than no shelter at all.
You can sleep, clean yourself , get food and coffee in morning . Felt reasonably safe from violence.  You can keep a small amount of stuff there.

Personal Cons

Best for people who have almost nothing.
They have rules which can make an overall
decent , law abiding , freedom - loving person feel uncomfortable , and possibly
``less - than " , as if the place is for ex -cons and the mentally unstable.
Rules like daily  metal detection involving taking off ones belt .
They also require you to wear a mask and take your temperature before you enter premises, and they may comment if you don't have it on. You can get mail there, but , they put it on a common area table , that anyone has access to.
Apparently ,   they trust you not to steal mail , but , not enough to let you walk inside sleeping area without metal detection.
They have a weird rule about no bags inside sleeping area. Only one clear plastic bag for hygiene. Not good for some who keeps a lot of plastic bags to protect personal property
from moisture, and other potential damage .
Had important papers get damaged due to rain and wear .  The only shift you can work is a morning shift to the best of my knowledge.
This is said to keep from disrupting others.

Nothing christian about this place aside from it once being a church. This place gets funding from the government and seems to
lean towards government - style beuracracy.
That is good for enforcing repeatable, constructive rules and policies, but bad if one feels the policies and rules are not the best or  are counter - productive, due to rigidity.
I personally wish they only called it central city mission, and lost the Lutheran part.
Seems misleading in my opinion.
Again, best for men with close to nothing.
For men who are overlall , law - abiding  and freedom loving , it can feel unnecessarily complicated , in a way which negatively affects morale and self - esteem. This haven is such a blessing to so many men, including myself.
There are times when we can NOT do it alone, and we don't want to ask other people for the help.
Greatfully, there are establishments such as this in existence.

Thank you to all the people making LSSSC happen. It is a place to eat shower sleep. It is also a place to get on your feet. You get 90 days. In that time if you find work and do it right. You can have cash in your pocket at the end of 90 days. The office staff are very helpful and have great hearts. If you really want help they do all they can for you. Yes some RVs feel they are more then they are. But not all of them do. Rules are not hard not a lot to handle yes I am a RV here as well as a client. This is a shelter for men only so I've never had any personal contact with them outside of food giveaways which were pretty good..  I do know a few men that have or currently reside at the homeless shelter and have said that the RV's which are shelter residents  that work around the place in order to be able to stay on the grounds while everyone else have to leave for the day, are very disrespectful and mean to the other residents there. They taunt them and have thrown objects that the other residents need onto the floor and made them pick them up if they wanted it. I won't continue to go on about that although there is so much more to speak on about this issue. I've spoken to some of the guys there or were there that are giving me their written statements about their mistreatment by the RVs which will be forwarded to the proper management.. One of the guys left the shelter not having a place to sleep because of the mistreatment..  I feel that something should be done because it is unfair.

name: Central Community Church
reviewSummary:
Best "church" I have ever attended period, I am 66 y.o.
Watch online for a sample.  Although, that misses the humble and overflowing friendship offered from ALL.
NOT a church of wall-flowers nor judgmentalists. So I have to say... I went to Central ComAmunity Church last Sunday for my first in-person worship service, and it was amazing! I was walked in by staff and shown where to sit, got some coffee, and then went to find my seat in the back row *new guy move* and then almost divinely, the Pastor (Jeff) was the FIRST person who walked up to me and introduced himself. I let him know id been watching online for a couple months, and have been skiddish about church and he was super polite, asked about me, and made me feel at home. Brett, one of the church patrons, was also very nice and offered to let me sit with him which was really cool. Pastor Jeff gave an amazing sermon on the fruits of the spirit (Galatians 5, which was great by the way with prayer, song, and exegesis of scripture). After service, the other patrons of the church Hailey, Emily, & Mackenzie *hope i got that right* were super kind to me and told me about bible studies, and baptism, and made me feel very welcome. I ended everything giving the pastor a fist bump on the way out, and told him the sermon was great. I HIGHLY reccomend this church for anyone in the Seattle area looking for a loving community, that learns properly from the Word of God. AND i can confidently say, that I have found my home. Amen! I’ve gone here for quite some time, and am very impressed with this church. Sunday school for kids and tweens is great, the music is very nice too (drums and electric guitar sometimes!). Easy parking, not a lot of frills, and very good teaching. The people are very nice too. Pastor Jeff is humble, loving, God fearing, and knowledgeable. He teaches in a way that allows even the children to grasp a word. I thank for such a pastor. If you're new to the city of Seattle and looking for a family, the body of Christ is the place to start. I am from Dallas, Tx and I have found a new home in Seattle. Central Community Church is home away from home. I went there for second time. The first was okay. The second time was not so good. I ended up leaving early. Before the service I went to get coffee. There were these ladies talking in front of the   Coffee area. I said excuse me. They didn’t move. Just acted like I was interrupting them. When it was greet time, I was just standing wanting for someone to talk to me. No one came up to me. Everyone was engaged in conversation. I couldn’t walk up to them and interrupt them and go up and introduce myself. I was thinking what’s wrong with me. I left after greet time and cried the whole way home

name: Central Congregational Church
reviewSummary: This is an absolutely stunning church. The stained glass is immaculate. The Guastavino Tile work is amazing as well. The community is friendly and welcoming and were very accommodating with my visit. I highly recommend visiting this church. The artisanship is amazing and they continue to do well at the upkeep of it. Beautiful experience! Talented musicians. The performance itself was great. My husband and I really enjoyed the music and vibe. What was disappointing was one of the employees who was very loud and rude as she was scanning people's tickets and assisting with seating. If we were at a rock concert sure, be that way, but this was very offputting to be greeted by given that it was Coldplay and the venue was a church. Then throughout the performance she was moving in and out of the rows, even going around guests, to take photos. It was very distracting and unprofessional, especially when guests are not permitted to take pictures until the last song. It's gorgeous inside I will give it that. But they sing really old outdated hymnal songs I couldn't get into the worship music and even the sermon held no conviction or punch. I would say leave this church to the older people. Beautiful experience! Talented musicians. Historical building with so much character.

name: Central Lutheran Church / Iglesia Luterana Central - Van Nuys Campus

name: Central Woodward Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I went to this church and fell in love with it. As a transgender person, I was very, very highly appreciated, respected, treated. With kindness thoughtfulness, respect all around the congregation is very nice. Then, baptized, there. I'm getting married there. I'm a member now. There just an awesome church. If you aint been there, you should go. If you really want a place where there's no judging and people treat you like god and jesus wants you to be treated, this is the church two go to hugs Amen . love kelli This church’s decision to display a Pride and BLM flag is one of the most Christ-like things I’ve seen. Jesus constantly reached out to those who were excluded, marginalized, and judged harshly by religious leaders. He showed radical love and welcome, saying:

“A new commandment I give you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also should love one another.” (John 13:34)

Flying a Pride flag and a BLM flag isn’t about “promoting sin”—it’s about promoting love and welcome. It says everyone is invited to experience God’s grace without fear of rejection.

The Bible is clear that judgment belongs to God alone:

“Who are you to pass judgment on servants of another? It is before their own lord that they stand or fall.” (Romans 14:4)

This church is living out Christ’s call to love their neighbors as themselves (James 2:8), refusing to show partiality or exclusion (James 2:9).

If more churches followed this example—truly opening their doors and hearts to all people without condemnation—I think the world would see a much truer picture of Jesus’ love. I admire a church that shows the entire community and all the people in it the love of Christ.  Jesus said let those without sin cast the first stone.  Jesus spent his time with the marginalized and embraced them with love.  It was the Pharisees that he chastised the most for their rigidness, legalism, judgement and hypocrisy.  I have just found out about this church due to some very unfortunate recent vandalism, and I plan to attend one of their services as soon as I am able.  Thank you, CWCC for being a beacon of light in the community.  Please continue spreading Jesus' gospel of love and forgiveness. We were in town for Christmas and attended the Christmas Eve service. The congregation was lovely and we really enjoyed worshipping there. We would attend again when next in town! This church is amazing. It follows the teachings of Jesus, it is welcoming to all. We are an open and affirming congregation, who shares the love of Christ with all, regardless of where they are on their journey. This church does not require you to check your brain at the door and follow blindly. If you are looking for a church that is trying to live it's faith, not just preach it, give us a try.
Marybeth McCormick

name: Chaparral Christian Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up in a very conservative religious sect that left me gunshy with any church that forces conformity or claims to have "the" accurate interpretation of scripture. I've been looking for 10 years to find a church that loves Jesus, is egalitarian in leadership,  values love and acceptance over rigidity and rules, and welcomes curiosity and independent thought.  I also appreciate that the music is well done and that I'm not watching the clock during the service. A few specifics:
1. People aren't creepy, so you can come and visit without concern about being stalked, prayed over, touched, or converted.
2. The pastor is, in my opinion, hysterical, with a snarky sense of humor that challenges irrationality without being harsh. I feel like he focuses on the things that matter, and I appreciate that.
3. The DNA of the church is deeper than the pastor. I learned about the church from someone who'd gone through a traumatic time and felt continuously love and held. I felt that same kindness and instant welcome, and safety--which is a big deal if one has religious triggers.
4. Diversity and advanced empathy is shown in so many ways. I immediately noticed that they have a variety of chairs (see pics) to accommodate seating preferences and abilities. They've managed to hold respect for both the young and the old. There is a family room for people who visit and others who may want to watch the service but in a more comfortable space that is kid-friendly.
5. It feels easy to get involved, and that's a little difficult to explain. But the messaging, opportunities, and openness will make it easy for you to sit in the back for two years if that's what you need until you feel comfortable, or, to jump into the fray and make friends. No pressure. No guilt. Just come. I attended this church with my children for 5 years, feeling welcome and supported. However one day many months ago, I was told by the pastors wife that I was no longer welcome. This was announced to me in front of a large number of people in the coffee shop and she would not explain why during her discourse. She repeated her announcement, not in soft tones, several times over with the promise that she would explain later. In fact she began by referring first to my children as not being welcome.  I had absolutely no forewarning nor any idea of what it was about.  I attempted to contacted several members of the church and not one person would speak with me. Not one. I finally gave up trying realizing that I should not be begging members to explain to me what caused that humiliating scene. This church did not in any way follow their own doctrine of having the kindness and compassion to speak with me in private before  they publicly stoned me.  I conclude that this church is not at all what it appears considering this began with the pastor’s wife and I heard that the pastor completely supported her.  Despite my attempts to contact him, he also would not return my calls. They obviously felt I did something egregious which I think being a reasonably intelligent person,  I’d remember.  This was not done with love but evil intentions with the full knowledge and apparent blessing of many members of the board which I also tried to contact.   I can only see this is a church devoid of Christ’s mercy and love, kindness and compassion. I pray that God will bless and protect all who enter there.
Toby Ringland, Mark and Sarah I found this place when I was searching for a Church to start attending. I read the reviews went over the website as well. Was welcomed with open arms and was showed around by one of the members. They have a coffee shop, CrossFit gym, and are starting to open a school. The main thing that has encouraged me to continue going every Sunday is how open and friendly everyone is. Went there for 5 years and out of the blue without any explanation was told that  my children and I we not welcome. And that came from the pastor’s wife. A coffee shop worker who has mental issues said something about us but no one will tell me what. Not one person would talk to me to tell me what we were accused of. Must have been bad. But this person made threats against us so I guess she turned it around and totally manipulated then. This church is unkind, judgmental and if this is what they call “God’s Love” then I think they missed the mark. They’re all about “community outreach” but then eat their young. I've been a member at Chaparral for 26 years and have loved it for all that time!  We have the most friendly people ever!

name: Chapel Hill Bible Church
reviewSummary:
My family was looking for a new church family during covid and, while we never expected to like what felt like a large church, we felt at home at Chapel Hill Bible Church. CHBC has been a great place for our children both teens, and college age, to grow and learn. It has also been such a sweet community to serve in and kids ministry is full of real truth meant to prepare them for life today and fun. We see a genuine longing toward spiritual growth, emotional vulnerability, accountability, and support in/from pastors, leaders, and members. The Parish Model and life groups help make CHBC into a smaller community as well. I know who to go to in my area if I want help with practical things like meals or regular life things like moving. We also love the different cultures represented at CHBC. Being a mixed culture and language home, it was important to find a place welcoming all of us and where the value of that was honored. We love this church fam and are thankful God called us here. It is a joy to grow and serve at CHBC. My wife Pam and I have been going to CHBC for 19 years. It has been a joy to sit under pastors and teachers who explain the gospel message of Jesus Christ clearly with truth and grace. We are thankful to our church family who have encouraged, loved and blessed us through the years ~ Thanks be to God We are new to the area and looking for a church to make home. We have been on a "church tour" as my family calls it. We walked into the church for the 9am service. It was a ghost town. We arrived promptly at 9am and if I had to make an estimate I would say 25 people were in the room. It looked to be able to seat hundreds, we are used to also prefer a larger church. Felt cold. I attempted to speak with the Pastor but he wasn't very interested. I did speak to some people during the service and they seemed to be personable. Music was nice but there was hardly anything that was familiar to us. We come from a church background that sings more popular songs and enjoy ones that are generally more expressive. I respected that they want to be more traditional but it was boring for what we are used to. Most important we felt unwanted and out of place.

We will keep looking.

Edit: 3-17 is when we went, my review was just now approved Loved the church’s atmosphere and the pastor’s preaching. But the music felt unprepared and off-pitch, which made it hard to enjoy. For that reason, we’re moving on to visit another church. The church building is lovely and of course the people are nice here. I went for 5 weeks but I can't go anymore. For one, they keep the temperature much too cold for me. I realized this after my first time, so I changed my outfit for next, yet I was still too cold. My earrings were freezing in my ears and even my feet were getting cold within my boots. I'm not going to wear a winter coat in the middle of summer in order to be comfortable inside a church. There seems to be a very weak sense of community here, you walk around each other as if you are strangers. The people who volunteer here are inviting and welcoming of course, but the church goers are hard to connect with. I am looking for a holy place of worship that feels more like a community. Also, I'm not sure if this is normal, but they switch preachers every week which I personally find inconsistent. Lastly, I noticed so many people do not tithe, which is the only part in the Bible where God says "test me on this", because that is how important it is to welcoming in your personal prosperity. The messages of the Bible are to be used and taken seriously and I need a church that really understands how to convey the practical USE of the Bible in every day life, or else what's the point of going to church?

If you consider yourself in a group of people that they don’t deem worthy, I would say try other more welcoming and non judgmental churches.

I couldn't get through a song without tears rolling down my face. I will definitely be back and will make this my permanent home church. Awesome worship and word of God! Services was right on time.

reviewSummary:
I recently attended a food bank hosted by this church last Sunday. While I’m very grateful for the food provided, my overall experience was unfortunately negative. We were required to wait for about three hours in 85° weather, and were told we couldn’t begin unless everyone first sat inside the chapel. During this time, the pastor was yelling at attendees and came across as very rude and, at times, physically intrusive. I personally began experiencing an asthma attack due to the heat and stepped outside to catch my breath. When I did, I was questioned in a way that felt dismissive and lacked compassion, even after explaining my situation. While I appreciate the resources provided, the way people were treated made the experience uncomfortable and disheartening. We fell on some financial troubles despite working and attending school.We thank the most high God for allowing these volunteers to take the time to give generously to those in need. reviewSummary:
Coming to any one of three services offered at CCPC is participation of the heavenly worship described in Isaiah 6:3 and Revelation 4:8.  For the Church, the point of the Divine Liturgy included in each service is not so much an imitation as it is a participation in heavenly worship. You can choose from Traditional, Contemporary or an intimate Word & Table service. There is room for everyone here. Parked here in my $30k van for less than 15 minutes, came out of the church and there was a cop with his lights on parked behind me. Someone called the police bc they didnt like my vehicle is the only thing I can piece together. He drove away before I could walk up to see what the issue was.

Stuff like this is why people run away from the church and mock religious people, shame! We were here for suicide survivor day so didn't get to see the Chapel. That said it is a lovely facility Visited here for the 2022 Christmas concert. Super awesome! Really good quality. Overall I loved the traditional / beautiful song selection, and you could tell the director and musicians put a lot of time and effort into it. Each service is beautifully unique. Music is exceptional in each one. Sermons...no matter who is preaching...are a great learning opportunity.  Not as friendly as I'd expected, but could be because it's such a large church. Need to keep up with their website, though. Hard to prepare for worship when the site is 3 weeks behind. But overall a good place to be.

name: Cherrydale Bible Church
reviewSummary: I can't say enough about how kind the people are.  So caring and friendly!  They Love the Lord!!  The teaching is sound. So encouraging to hear God's word taught! A wonderful place where believers meet to worship the Lord and grow together. The great children ministry is a nice plus for young families. I love the family atmosphere! Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Chesterfield Community Church
reviewSummary:
There is a sense of safety and positive community that makes you feel like you are part of a family at this church.  I felt accepted, as I am, on day one by people who love God and love others.  That was a year ago. Sermon messages are authentic, shepherding, engaging, and most importantly,  Biblically-based  I always leave with something to think about, and/or be thankful for, and apply. There are a variety of ways to be involved and meet people in order to build relationships with other Christians.  I am thankful to be a part of this church! This church has wonderful sincere people who attend.  I've been going there the past 10 yrs.  They've recently remodeled.  They have a wonderful,  enthusiastic,  energetic youth pastor who really has a heart for them!  The teachers for the young children on Sundays and Wednesdays are so sweet and caring. Where you hear God's Word taught clearly and accurately every week plus you can connect with several small groups throughout the week. Multi-generational and family-like atmosphere. Comfortable size...you won't be invisible or get lost in the crowd here. Great church! Services are always Bible-center; music is contemporary Christian music glorifying Jesus Christ. You will be welcomed by the members and you will feel as if you knew them personally. They are loved by Jesus Christ and they share this same love & concern for you. I can not say enough about this church. I am from out of town, but every time I visit Chesterfield, I must go to this church.  It is my church away from home. Finally, if you and/or your family is looking for a church where you can grow in your relationship with Jesus Christ and be a part of an awesome church family, you must come to Chesterfield Community Church ... you will be welcome with open arms. This church is not flashy, but provides a consistent, pleasant experience for corporate worship time. The building is aging, but is well maintained. There have been various audio video technology updates, and the naturally bad (high ceiling, hard surfaces) acoustics (no longer desirable) have been minimized with sound deadening tiles. Lighting is easy on the eyes, making reading pleasant.

There is a good balance of men and women in this church - something many churches are lacking. The church ministers well to both sexes. In particular, the pastor provides the kind of practical, straight-forward preaching, mixed with some light humor, that catches and holds your attention quite well.

If that weren't enough, the congregation is quite multi-cultural, and multi-ethnic. You'll find attendees that are White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Jewish, young, old, married, single, divorced... If Almighty God intended for there to be diversity in His family, this church must have gotten the memo.

If you want to visit or become involved with a church that preaches Truth with practical personal application, and avoids the feel-good false church social club, definitely check out Chesterfield Community Church. There's a lot of formerly broken people that attend there. Recovering alcoholics abound. It's obvious something is going very right in this mid sized church (250-300 people?). I suspect it has something to do with the honest worship ministry, attention to those in recovery, solid preaching, and promotion to connect in small community groups.

As a group of people, they may not greet you as readily as some other church groups, complete with a Stepford smile, but you'll likely encounter genuineness, and your interaction will be positive. It seems the congregation takes seriously the words on their foyer wall. "People honoring God. God changing lives. Lives making a difference." What a community!

name: Chesterfield Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Friendly people.  Faith based activities.  Many options to participate in smaller groups and focused groups. This church is warm and friendly. They have ministries for every age group, children, youth, men and women, led by people that know how to love one another well and are passionate. The gospel is preached clearly and everyone is welcome. I have attended this church for over 20 years.  The worship style is contemporary, the preaching is Christ-centered, Gospel-infused and bathed in God's grace.  Active and vibrant children's and youth ministries, men's and women's ministries, small groups, and ministries for college student and young adults.  They even have a unique and mature ministry for adults with special needs which has thrived over the years.  You can come as you are and you are accepted and welcomed. I discovered this church in the midst of the pandemic, so I haven’t been in person, but I listen to Hugh on the podcast and am so thankful for his ability to speak and be a vessel of the love and discipline meant to be soaked up through God’s word. Feel an overwhelming peace after every sermon! Dr. Bartlett is a wonderful pastor and his sermons are amazing.  Pastor Loaney the Care Pastor is always there for those in need and has a way of making you feel better.  God bless you both and thank you.

name: Chestnut Ridge Christian Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary: A very welcoming church with loving biblically based sermons. Have been a member for decades.  This is a loving community that welcomes all of Gods children.  So thankful to journey though life with this church family. My wife and I have been members for many years.  Chestnut Ridge has always been a loving, supportive community for us—always helping us grow in faith and service. A wonderful, loving and welcoming Church. Been a member for over 10 years.  Great People, Great Congregation!

name: Chevy Chase Baptist Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Place where I worship the pastor and his wife are wonderful! Very beautiful design, nice people. I was given a ride home vs taking a taxi.  The pastor is easy to understand through his accent and I loved his preaching style. Great church

name: Cheyenne Christian Fellowship
reviewSummary: Very blessed by the warmth, hospitality, and love me and my family felt the couple times we visited (from out-of-state) over the years. They do strive to hold to the teachings of Jesus, even the very unpopular teachings, like divorce and remarriage. "He that is able to receive it (His teachings), let him receive it." Thankfully, Jesus words are life, though is sad most reject his life-giving teachings. A church full of very gracious, hospitable people. Plus, the sanctuary sounds excellent for choral singing. From the first time I visited cheyenne Christian fellowship I knew there was something wrong with them.  They have encouraged my wife and kids to stay away from me and that the leaders are her new authority. Not me.  With direction from the leadership  my family has taken me to court to put a protection order against me for even watching my children at a distance.  ( because I love them). These people operate as a cult. I would not recommend anyone to visit there. And of all people Robert preaches about Resentment in Gods people.  When he is the perpetrator of that very thing. Creating resentment in our own family. This church has no heart for single mothers or troubled young women, while they create them by refusing membership to any man (or woman) they feel need to leave marriages as they deem them not valid in God's eyes... they care nothing for the women and children affected by their church's influence and requirements for membership.  Assistance is only grated if the woman "submits" herself to being separated and then "submits" to church leadership as her new "authority"... They care nothing for the emotional and spiritual abuse they inflict on women having to "submit" to all the men in the church that now get to publicly discuss and decide over every aspect of her and her children's lives... you either submit or get "shunned" (which includes your children and no help of any kind).  I know this because Cheyenne Christian Fellowship did this to me and my children and not once in 8 years has the church offered any help of any kind (or even a kind word for that matter) after inflicting this tremendously painful blow to me and my children.  Mercy (unmerited favor / loving kindness) is the last thing taught and lived out in this church.  My children and I have endured great suffering as a direct consequence of my husband's leaving us.  Yet, they receive him warmly for visits offering praises for his decision to leave us... all while caring nothing for our hardships and suffering.   My husband has often been a guest in member's homes while me and my children could barley keep our home above 50 degrees. Anabaptist heritage beliefs unite this small group of believers in Jesus. The group  dynamics have changed as people and leaders have come and gone, but the desire to walk out the scriptures with integrity remains unchanged.

name: Cheyenne Hills Church
reviewSummary:
Worship is great, large children's ministry. But disappointed with the sermons. Need to spend more time teaching the Bible.

Pastor Galon needs to retire. John is great, but I'm so tired of Galon pushing the nonsense that we need to defend the GOVERNMENTAL NATION of Israel. God's promise was to the PEOPLE of Israel. Not the STATE of Israel. We've been there twice. Once for the early service and once for the later. A big church for Cheyenne. Services were fairly full. Good praise and worship. Good message. We'll be going back. They do ABSOLUTELY nothing to help homeless and struggling people! I lived in Cheyenne 2014-2016, this was a great church.  I came back to visit, 2024 and it has grown and displays Luke 16:10;
"Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much."
I don't normally write Google reviews unless something is extraordinarily bad or extraordinarily good! Here's to the salt that doesn't lose flavor! Much thanks, much love! Wonderfully inviting and warm church, easy to get connected and "plugged in," and plenty of events for all ages including an AMAZING children's church! We love Pastor Galen, he preaches from the Bible and adds in a lot of fascinating historical context that brings the Bible to life.

name: Chicago International Christian Church - Skyline
reviewSummary:
On July 24,1987, almost 39 years ago, I was baptized as a disciple of Jesus Christ and I am eternally grateful to God for helping me come to the Truth of the gospel at the age of 40.
I prayed specifically for the Acts 2:42 church, and asked God how I can know for sure that it is His Church. Then I realized that I must trust him and ask him for a sign, as I was desperate to find His Church in Acts 2:42. I prayed with all my heart that he would have someone knock on my door 3  times and then I would ask that person 5 test questions from the Bible to be sure it was His Act2:42 Church.
1. What is the name of your Church?
Answer:  "Church of Christ" (This was the name of that worldwide movement in 1987).
2. How often do you meet?
Answer: 3 times a week, but we are to encourage one another daily, (since we now have telephones I spent five years in this church, and it remains the most painful experience of my spiritual life.
At first, it appeared loving and familial—but that “love” quickly revealed itself as conditional. The church teaches a works-based form of Christianity, asserting that salvation can be lost at any time. This directly contradicts the assurance of John 10:28: “I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.”

Leadership and Culture
The leadership is marked by hypocrisy and moral compromise, frequently condemning others’ sins while excusing their own, including adultery. As Jesus said in Matthew 7:5, “You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.” They manipulate Scripture to control rather than to heal—using the Bible as both sword and shield to justify pride and deflect accountability. Members are often belittled, intimidated, and silenced in the name of “discipleship,” a practice far removed from Ephesians 4:29’s call to “build others up according to their needs.”

Doctrine and Practices
Favoritism and double standards are widespread. The Holy Spirit’s guidance is routinely replaced with the opinions of “disciplers,” whose authority outweighs Christ’s commands. Services resemble motivational rallies more than reverent worship. As Colossians 2:8 warns, “See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ.”

Finances and Family Values
Members are pressured to give financially far beyond their means, under the guise of “building churches,” though much of it seems to enrich leadership. Scripture cautions in 1 Timothy 6:10, “For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.” Even family duties are neglected, as members are urged to prioritize ministry over their loved ones—contrary to 1 Timothy 5:8, “Anyone who does not provide for their relatives...has denied the faith.”

Final Experience
When I finally left, leaders told me, “We don’t need you, we won’t miss you, and the church will move on without you.” That arrogance speaks volumes. Proverbs 16:18 reminds us, “Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.”

Conclusion
Avoid this organization at all costs. It masquerades as a church but operates more like a cult, spiritually abusing and exploiting those who genuinely seek God. There are many Christ-centered congregations that truly love, disciple, and restore people in truth and grace. As Jesus warned in Matthew 7:15, “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.” I've been going to this church the past 5 months since I moved to Chicago and its been really a great experience! The whole congregation is not just very loving but also keeps me accountable how to live according to the Word of God!  I love that we have  an amazing singles ministry comprised with a lot of professionals, we get to learn and grow together in our spiritual walk, and  have lot of fun while worshipping God! Studying the Bible with women here really helped me deepen my convictions and have a closer relationship with God! Jesus’ command to go and make disciples of all nations is alive in this church. I prayed in the beginning of this year for God to show up in my life and a month later was invited to church and to study the Bible. I was inspired by the love of God and the biblical leading of this church. If you want to be with a group of people who are lovingly obedient in the teachings of the Bible, please check this church out! I love being a part of a church that is extremely focused on God’s word!! The word of God is preached every Sunday! Less about us but more about Jesus, the son of God!!

I also appreciate the breakfast table provided every Sunday!! It truly feels like you’re a part of a family 💗🙏🏾

reviewSummary:
Been coming to this church since I was 13yrs old and I love my pastors and the members of my church.when I first became a member of the men’s home at C.V.C. In the 80’s it taught me at a young age how to become responsible and discipline so the seed was planted a long time ago.im back at my church loving to hear the word and wanting more and I thank “GOD” that I was welcomed.🙏🏽 I came to CVC in 1987, my life was a mess. Pastor Fernando Rivas helped me tremendously. Many things transpired between last year and then(1987), but when
re-dedicated my life to Christ. Pastor Fernando Rivas didn't turn back on me. Today he's still my Pastor. So greatful for Chicago Victory Church and Pastor Fernando and Pastor David and their families faithfulness. My life is not the same since I went into their women's home in 1999 til 2001.
Thank you for showing me how to be honorable and faithful to Jesus !
Sincerely Dorothy OBrien Havey Born down the street, a south side brotha invited me to this crazy rock n roll testimony church in the 90s. I didn't believe in crying but sinner prayer got me. After a while arguing with my conscience, Jesus spoke Audibly in a alley with Love "I Know Your Works". Radically Transformed me

Then Retired me to Texas but when I didn't want nothing to do with HIS abusive leaders & Big church politics, GOD spoke "Avoid evil People..like snakes" "where u gona go" & Again,
"Nobody Putting Thier Hands To The Plow & Looking Back, Is Fit For The Kingdom Of GOD"

10 stars for your faithfulness, Because there's no quitters in Heaven I first came here in 1989 with a broke leg and my little boy, in fact, they came all the way to the Southside to pick us up. I didn't get right the first couple of times, but I thank God for Jesus using this ministry to work with me. Pastor Fernando has never lied, misled, misguided or misused me all the 30 something years I've known him. I'm not afraid to tell anybody how proud and grateful I am to be apart of this ministry. I've been healed from hep c and mental illness from constantly be under the message they preach "The Message of the Cross". If you're on game, if you looking to come up, you're absolutely right - this ain't the place for you!!!!! Because the only thing comes up around here is the name of Jesus!!!!! And for all you haters, this place was here for you when you needed it - while you bumpin your gums. One great thing about this country: if you don't like what you see, change the channel!!!!! Peace out💝💝💝💝

name: Chicagoland Community Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been my church home for over 10 years.  The focus of this church is on glorifying the Lord Jesus in all it does and helping others to know Him.  The singing portion of the worship service is always edifying.  Pastor Jon's preaching is always insightful and practical for Christian living.  In addition, between small group Bible study, seminars, neighborhood outreach and fellowship events, this is a church that takes Christian discipleship more seriously than any I've ever attended.  The church leadership makes a deep, personal investment into every member, seeking to help them grow in their faith and loyalty to Jesus Christ.  Over the time I've been here, the Holy Spirit has used this church to shape me into the person Jesus calls me to be.  Come and see for yourself. Have you ever tried to go to a church and you walk in, try want to meet people but no one really tries to talk to you because you look terrified and new?  Or have you ever wanted to do something to help out the church, but they couldn't find anything for you to do, or have you ever wanted to meet with a pastor, but he could never find a time with you?  Well, this isn't that kind of church; the people who go there are friendly and they want to actually talk with you, the pastor is a great guy who is always available, and there's always some way that you could help out.  They have a great ministry working with the homeless in the neighborhood and they're not just flippantly throwing money at them either.  The rubber actually meets the road here when it comes to this church.
Don't get me wrong though, the church definitely has some flaws.  But what church doesn't?  If you want to come and disappear and just sit and enjoy a sermon, then you will find it hard to do since just about everyone in a 15 foot radius wants to say hello.  Or if you expect to come just to be "encouraged" and not actually be challenged to do better then you won't like it when the pastor asks tough questions.  I mean, that's why we go to church right?  To just be encouraged and disappear, right?
Overall, I would say that this is a great church.  It may not look like much, but we all have seen diamonds in the rough.  If you look past all of the preconceived ideas of what the church is "supposed" to look like and actually look at what these guys are really doing in their neighborhood, you'll see that their beliefs and their lives truly echo what you will see in the bible. My Wife and I live in Michigan, but we visited C3 with our five children for worship on a Sunday Morning, while we were on vacation.
The people here were genuinely loving, and welcoming.
This is a church which (I would submit) unmistakeably models Jesus Christ's Sacrificial Love for others.
If we are in Chicago on a Sunday again, this is where we would plan to worship the Lord; and I would encourage you to do the same. Everything is Awesome! The Pastor Jon and congratulations is fantastic. Service is great, the sermon is very understanding. Thank I thank God for sending me and my friend to the church. You will really like the service. This church seems to want to function more as a business than a church.  Perhaps it would be more efficient if the pastor were to go and sell used cars.  He pulls off the look quite well.

The church exploits homeless youth for grant numbers taking superficial "professions of faith" and trying to dunk...er baptize...youth who do not truly even believe in Jesus...for the sake of more grant money and a few more notices of spiritual pride.  Oh and if you're gay, the pastor might even offer you a crisp $20 to go to "straight camp."

They capitalize on the grant money from this community and charging Southern youth groups a nice sum of money to sleep in their pews so that they can put advertisements on your doors.

The marginalized street community is not even the true focus of the church.  While using them to gain financial support to continue existing, they really want to target well off young professionals in East Lakeview (forget Boystown) so that the pastor can up and move to England someday.

However, what bothers me most about this church is that they would banish a youth for having a minor mental disability which of course would impair judgment and he would make immature decisions.  Instead of working with his special needs they told him not to come back.  To quote the pastor, "Only Jesus can help you and we are not Jesus!"

Seems to me like I would want to go to a church where Jesus is.  If you're considering this church, I would look elsewhere.

name: Chico Community Church - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent church all around. Just moved to Chico and found a warm, but challenging in the right way church that's great for kids and excellent for worship and preaching Absolutely love this church. There is such a great community and inviting people. I would recommend getting involved in life groups and finding out how you can help around the church to get more involved in the church community. Especially in life groups you can find great people. They even have great life groups for young adults in college and they are a great community as well.
