reviewSummary:
I don’t know why people can’t rate church openly and transparently just like how they rate clinic & doctors, so will start from myself! And I encourage you too!!

I’ve been to CCIC Cupertino for 5+ years (serving here also) and have a mixed feeling for it. Pros:
1. kind people. They are mostly first-generation immigrants from China mainland and Taiwan, high education background. This place is also very close to Apple campus, you will find some apple employees here
2. Traditional and bible-oriented. This church is pretty traditional, they keep themselves away from Charismatic Christianity. No pastor, only elders.
3. Good children ministry. They have AWANA program every Friday, which is pretty popular.
Cons:
1. Very conservative, almost rigid. For example, Sunday worship still uses old Hymn book (not changed for 20+ years) and you won’t see women on Sunday lectrum.
2. Not a lot of young people. This might be a general problem for bay area church, but this church is an outstanding example. Most of adults here are over 40, and church leaders are generally over 50. Need to think deeply about why.

As a Christian, i think to find the right church ultimately is to pray through God. That I will leave to you:) Full stars....
Bible oriented. Really good program for kids: Awana. Come and see. Traditional and conservative church, Bible oriented and very solid fundamentals, won't lead you astray theologically. The place with love and nice people, be with God from young to senior Love it.

reviewSummary:

The worship music is upbeat with a mixture of Mandarin and English praise melodies and a traditional hymn or two.

There is a handful of people in the Adult English Sunday School and the children's class. It is good for children who get more attention.

reviewSummary: My family has been attending for about a year and we really enjoy the English service! All are welcome! We attend community service events and youth group! There are many ways to get involved! I went here for about a year. It is a great church and had many events for those who lived in the Carmel area. There is a large young adults group (21-30+) with 10+ people to learn about God and attend social events. Everyone is very nice and I felt welcomed coming to church. Been plugged into this church ever since I moved to Indy on August 27th 2023 and it's been nothing short of amazing. This is a multigenerational church with strong children, youth, young adult, adult, male, female, moms, elderly fellowship and ministries. The teaching is extremely solid and this church is Bible based and very missional. The church supports 23 different missionary families all over the world. From Awana, Mission Conference, Fall Retreat, discipleship, you will not ever be bored so come learn and grow in Christ while having tons of fun and making lifelong friendships and connections. I would say that at least 50% of the congregation serves in some kind of capacity which is much better than your typical 20%. People play basketball and volleyball in the gym after Friday night bible study and after Sunday school. We play sports on Tuesdays. We bike/walk together on Saturdays. We get together for board games, explore the surrounding areas. There are 3 congregations: Cantonese, English, and Mandarin. The Sunday lunch is also delicious. Come join us and check us out. You won't regret it! Awesome church! Everyone who attends is super nice and welcoming. Also the youth group is pretty awesome :) Very open and welcoming community. reviewSummary:
Pastoral care is phenomenal. This church exudes theological seriousness, gospel-saturation, and an unparalleled hospitality.

As a fellow pastor and minister, I would highly recommend any person to belong and commit to this church 中華歸主柏克萊教會(CFC Berkeley) is an incredible church that truly embodies the love of Christ. From the moment you arrive, you are greeted with warmth and kindness. The sermons are deeply rooted in biblical teachings, offering spiritual nourishment and practical life applications.

The worship services beautifully blend contemporary and traditional elements, creating an atmosphere of reverence and celebration. The music is uplifting, and the worship team leads the congregation in heartfelt praise.

The church’s commitment to its core values—Serve humbly, Walk faithfully, Act lovingly, Trust wholeheartedly—is evident in every aspect of its ministry. Numerous opportunities to get involved, from small group studies to impactful outreach programs, allow the congregation to serve others with humility and love.

The children’s and youth ministries provide a safe and nurturing environment for young people to grow in their faith, with dedicated co-workers ensuring every child feels valued and loved.

Overall, this church is a beacon of light in our community. It’s a place where faith is deepened, friendships are forged, and lives are transformed by the grace of God. I, as a member of the church since 2017, highly recommend it to anyone seeking a gospel-centered place of worship. My spiritual journey and family life began here in Berkeley. I came to this city 10 years ago as a single man with very little understanding of God. Today, I am blessed with a wonderful family, including two children. Though we have faced many challenges, God’s love has been revealed to us time and time again, especially through the support of sisters and brothers at our church. I hope my experience can inspire those seeking spiritual growth, God’s love, and the willingness to serve Him. His love is ever-present, and we are never alone on this path. A gospel-centered church serving the Berkeley community and UCB students for over 70 years. A community I find value to serve since pandemic.
Free lunch and dinner are served every Sunday, rain or shine. Food is basic, but how important is that if you are offered the Bread of Life? A Christ-centered church seeking the word of God with a godly congregation making an impact in the Chinese community. It is such a blessing for me to have found this church.

reviewSummary: I could not imagine being more blessed by a church! We are a family with small children and have been at this church only a few months but in that short time we have experienced incredible Biblical teaching and wisdom from the pulpit and also the practical support and genuine love of the community here. God is at work in this church and it has been awesome to see and be a part of! This church body has been such a joy to be a part of and so healthy for my family! People in this church truly know what it’s like to be loved by Christ and to receive full forgiveness through His work on the cross. I know that because of the way they love those around them—both inside and outside the church—and because their lives continually point me to Christ. If you’re looking for a community that loves God’s Word, recognizes their need in Christ daily, and loves people with unconditional love, Christ Bible Church is the place! Christ Bible Church is welcoming and consistently encourages us with solid Biblical truth. It’s a great place to learn, grow, and share the unmatched love of Christ Jesus the LORD. I am so thankful to God for this church. So thankful for Christ Bible Church! The church prioritizes solid teaching of God’s Word and intentional fellowship amongst the church members. Very grateful to have found both at this church body. It is a joy being part of this local church body seeking to live out the name "Christ Bible Church," for His name and glory!

name: Christ Cathedral - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Today I had the opportunity to visit Christ Cathedral and learn about its incredible history. ⛪️

I’m grateful not only to experience such a beautiful place, but also for the staff who took the time to show me around and share the story behind it. Hearing the history and seeing it through a different perspective made the visit even more meaningful.

Moments like these remind me how important it is to slow down, learn, and appreciate the people who help keep history alive. Thankful for the experience, the photos, and the memories made today. 🙏 TikTok/ Instagram:MABO.TRAILS A beautiful venue to experience a rich part of American Christianity and what God can do. It is a Catholic Church now but seeing what it was prior and the history of what makes it special was unique and breath taking. The Catholics have honored the memory of all those that took part in designing the original and building it. (With their own changes for the needs of the church met) while keeping it as original as possible. It shows unity between denominations. Crean Tower at Christ Cathedral is a stunning landmark and an absolute must-visit in Garden Grove. Its elegant design and impressive height make it stand out beautifully against the surrounding campus. The peaceful atmosphere, well-kept grounds, and unique architecture create a memorable experience whether you come for photos, reflection, or simply to admire the beauty of the cathedral complex. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area A stunning church that captivates with its architecture and style. A peaceful place great for pausing and reflecting on your life.

Lots of space - inside and outside bring your camera to take some good shots. There’s plenty of parking but I walked from my hotel. Beautiful Cathedral,  I left with a very peaceful heart. After every single incounter with Gods presence after Mass. If you have the time to attend at least once before easter it would be so beautiful.  The regular Mass is in 4 languages Vietnamese, Spanish, English and Chinese.

reviewSummary: I stopped in on a weekday to get a library card and use a computer for a few forms I needed to print. name: Christ Church - Central Phoenix Congregation - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I found Christ Church’s Central Phoenix campus in 2025 after searching for a church we could attend and grow in together as a married couple, and it has genuinely been life changing for us.

What we appreciate most about the teaching at Christ Church is that every sermon is grounded in Scripture, provides proper biblical background and context, and delivers timely, practical application for everyday life. What I especially appreciate is the “Call to Respond” at the end of each message. It gives you an authentic, reflective way to sit with the Scripture throughout the week rather than just leaving it at the door on Sunday. With pastors like Nick Ely, Adam Bailie, and KJ leading the teaching, there is consistent depth and quality no matter who is preaching.

Beyond the Sunday service, the small groups and Bible studies here are the real deal. They go deep, and the people in them genuinely care about growing together in faith.

We have found the congregation to be beautifully diverse, spanning a wide range of ages, racial backgrounds, and cultural experiences. The church reflects a genuine mix of people united by our faith, and we have always felt seen, included, and welcomed as part of this community.

Whether you’re new to faith, returning to church after some time away, have a family with kids, or are simply looking for a church that takes the Bible and discipleship seriously, we couldn’t recommend Christ Church enough. Come as you are and we hope to see you soon! Plagiarizing myself (I left the same review on their FB page):

I had planned to visit another church today, but when I arrived the parking lot looked full, and the inside looked jam-packed, so I decided to drive to Christ Church in central Phoenix - I was already considering visiting sometime anyway. Happy I did! The two staff members (Taylor and Michael) greeting new attendees were cordial, warm, and expressed genuine enthusiasm at my recent (re)conversion to Christianity. Michael gave me a brief tour of the church and walked me to the seating area.

Pastor Nick was pleasant to listen to. His zeal was evident but not overbearing. His willingness to openly confess his past transgressions and to use them to illustrate the point of his sermon was effective. He also had a knack for using spot-on analogies, citing debate terms (e.g. "strawman" and "caricature"), and quoting past Christian thinkers without coming off as intellectually showy (e.g. he quoted a prayer long attributed to Augustine: "Lord, grant me chastity... but not yet," eliciting a chuckle from the crowd). To wit: he struck a near perfect balance between faith and reason.

I definitely plan to return! I really like this church! This has been a church I’ve been able to connect with different members that want to encourage and pray for me. I’ve had experience with addiction and homelessness and the different members here were really able to be a huge encouragement to me while I battled that!

I also like how they go through chapters of the Bible. This is a very unique church and the staff and the pastor is very welcoming! I strongly suggest checking this place out. And introduce yourself to a random member, if this is your first time going and you’ll see the love as well! I try not to spread negativity, I am going to give my honest experience. I've attended this church 3 times in the last year or so. The positives are the wonderful musicians who honor christ and Nick, the lead pastor, who has a caring but strong steadfast love for Jesus and truly exemplifies his spirit through his sermons. However, I cannot ignore the elephant in the room. I am not white and do not look like the main demographic that attends this church. I love every background of people that roam this earth as Jesus did and would hope to feel welcome in the lord's house. I am routinely ignored in this church and today (packed house I'll add), one of the volunteers noticed me but spoke and addressed the Caucasian woman next to me as she was alone as well. She quickly helped her find a seat and I was ignored. I will unfortunately keep following my faith with the lord alone and I know this will not be a place I am welcome. Have a blessed day 🙏🏼 God is moving in this church! 🙌 The kids ministry is amazing and the worship is spirit filled! Praise the Lord for this church and the pastors overseeing this church! Continue to pray against opposition and for the schemes of the devil to not hinder the work of the Lord here! Thankful for this church and the impact they are having in the community! 🙌

"Spiritual Gifting
Christ Church affirms that the Holy Spirit continues to bestow spiritual gifting in every single follower of Jesus for the sake of building up each local church (Romans 12:6–8; 1 Corinthians 12:8–10; 12:28; Ephesians 4:11). While the New Testament office of apostle and prophet have ceased to function with the conclusion of their responsibilities in the church (Ephesians 2:20; Revelation 22:18–19), we believe all other giftings continue in various places, times, and contexts. Therefore, we will anticipate and celebrate every manifestation of the Spirit that is identifiable through biblical definitions and order (1 Corinthians 11, 12, 14; 1 Thessalonians 5:19–21). The pastoral team takes seriously the responsibility to ensure this biblical order and exercises of Spirit giftings in every church gathering (1 Corinthians 14:40; 1 Peter 5:1–5). We identify then as neither a Charismatic nor non-Charismatic church, but rather embrace the tension of Spirit-filled and Spirit-led diversity under biblical authority in our church family, as we are “eager to maintain the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace” (Ephesians 4:3)."

name: Christ Church - Mesa Congregation - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ Church is a fantastic church, not just because of the Sunday services, but because it truly is a church family!

God has providentially used this church to enrich my knowledge of Scripture, deepen my relationship with Jesus, teach me to depend more on the work of the Holy Spirit, grow my passion for the Great Commission to make disciples of all nations, and live in a community that is eagerly awaiting the return of Christ.

I found Christ Church in 2020 and became heavily involved in the life of the church after graduating from college out of state at the end of 2024. Finding Christ-centered community was one of my biggest prayer requests, and the Lord has done more than I could have asked or imagined. Being surrounded by young adults who are fixated on Christ and His mission has been such a sweet gift!

We have heartfelt worship, welcoming fellowship, expository teaching, fervent prayer, and a heart that desires every soul to come and know Jesus as Lord and Savior.

I could not recommend Christ Church more, and I have loved being a part of what He is doing in Mesa to make His name known. I know I can speak on behalf of our congregation when I say we would love for you to join us. Come and see what the Lord is doing! Absolutely amazing! It's all about Jesus. Reaching out with the love of Christ to others. Providing for those in need in many areas of need. And supporting our Kingdom family. Pastor Bailey and all the Pastors are amazing men of God and only teach from God's word. Great welcoming atmosphere. You won't be sorry, just thankful to be there, so come. Whether church has been part of your life for years or you have never set foot in a church, you will be welcomed here. I have been a member of Christ Church since 2018 and cannot put into words the work the Lord has done in my life and heart through the faithful biblical preaching/teaching, the passionate vertical worship, and the community of the church family that has developed. Our Mesa location has become a sweet gift and it is so beautiful to get to be part of what God is doing in and through Christ Church. There are so many ways to get connected—just because it is a big church doesn't mean it can't feel small when you make connections and join community. We weren't meant to live this life alone and it is so sweet to walk together as believers as we all pursue Christ! There are many ways to do that at Christ Church so there’s certainly a good fit for you. Come join us! Very welcoming congregation. Very knowledgeable pastoral staff. I felt welcomed and never once have I felt judged. If it's your first time visiting they have an awesome visitors hub. It doesn't matter how you're dressed or what you look like all that matters is that you are here. Pastor Adam quite often uses the term "Church Family" and that's exactly how it feels here. It feels like a family. Having been a member since 2018, I have witnessed firsthand that...
1. the leadership has been bold in preaching and teaching the truth, line by line vs. topical.
2. they have a mission driven heart, consistently reaching out to the community with genuine love and purpose.
3. they are very orderly and organized
4. there are plenty of ways to serve each other and the community.
5. this is a not a spectator church for believers. Be prepared to be active in your faith.
6. Absolutely everyone is welcomed, every tribe, tongue and nation are loved!
While no church may be perfect for everyone, this one may be perfect for you!

The message is in English which is great for my kids.  Pastor Suresh is a natural teacher and has a gift for applying the lessons of the Bible to current day life.  The church is centrally located, close to the I-17 and the I-51 and easy to get to. A wonderful gem I found in the Valley.  Looking for a more orthodox church, a number of friends recommended Christ Church Anglican.  We found a warm, friendly group of believers who praise and love the Lord reverently.  Fr. Chris Schutte and Fr. Chuck Collins are outstanding teachers of God's Word.

Needless to say, Christ Church Anglican has become my home church. Welcoming church with clear to follow liturgy.  Robed choir.   Message was thoughtfully presented and rooted in the biblical text.   Made welcome at the adult learning after the service in the hall. Spirit-filled church. Great prayer & healing team, everyone welcome for prayer.

name: Christ Church Anglican - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful parish I visited last summer. Very warm and welcoming. Stick around for coffee hour and get to know the good folks. I'm high church Anglo-Catholic but truly enjoyed the simplicity of the 1662 Book of Common Prayer. I even purchased a copy, Rev Father Steven is a gifted preacher and though preaching isn't my draw to church it's always appreciated when I walk away from a sermon knowing more deeply to truth of the Gospel. Give the parish a try and leave a review. I'm certain it will be a positive experience. If you want traditional Anglican worship with a very warm congregation and sound preaching then you should visit. The people are very hospitable and the building is beautiful. Organ player is excellent. They are faithful to Christ and committed to the 1662 Book of Common Prayer. Warm community with historical liturgy and beautiful organ hymns. Family-friendly and welcoming. I love this congregation and Pastor Steve!

name: Christ Church Apostolic - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: First time going and it was a Phenomenal service you can really feel the love of Jesus if they praise like that every Sunday they will definitely have a new member Our church used to visit Christ Church back when Bishop Tyson was living and the pastor. Haven't been back since he passed. But occasionally I get a video on my page. I am partial to the old way of pentecostal church praise and worship. I don't get much from the modern pentecostal church. I don't recognize the people in the vids, but the speaker looks like the presider of Bishop Roy Brown's organization Pilgrim Assemblies,, a Bishop Hudson (?) My rating is based on my memories and the high times we enjoyed back then at Christ Church. Beautiful church building. I have know the Tyson family for some time. The four men of God. That I know from this family. Have always presented themselves ss pillars of the community. My visit was great. This House of God is very big and very beautiful I was only there to help set up for a wedding but everyone I came across was very nice and very welcome restrooms were super clean and it seems that the presence of God is truly in the building everybody was so nice that I've decided to go visit on a Sunday Amazing service, everyone was nice and polite and egaer to welcome me yes yes yrs I will be attending this church in the very near future

name: Christ Church at Park Presidio - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: Very authentic Christ-followers with excellent, academic/theological teaching. It is a small group of young professionals who are part of a community vs just Sunday chatter. coffee, tea, bathrooms! it was a great visiting experience. would definitely recommend it. The best message from the bible I have heard. I believe this is the best church I have been to in the city. no one was there but it seemed pretty peaceful

name: Christ Church Austin
reviewSummary: Vibrant Anglican parish in East Austin blending ancient liturgical beauty, weekly Eucharistic celebration, and warm relational community.

name: Christ Church Birmingham - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: Attended for the first time this morning and absolutely loved the welcoming environment. My sons have attended many times with their grandparents and absolutely love the programs offered. Overall, our family as a whole have been very pleased. Very warm and loving atmosphere. I enjoy the worship and study at Christ Methodist. This body of Christ offers several opportunities to get involved in missions locally and internationally. I’m looking forward to getting more involved with missions and encourage you to attend this active church if you are looking for a new church home. It great I really enjoyed it. Christ Church is a wonderful place to worship the Lord with like minded brothers and sisters in Christ Jesus.  If you are looking for a true Gospel Worship experience, come and visit Christ Church! Two great Pokestops and a Pokemon Gym. Thank you for the use of your parking lot for a few minutes. Your green space next to the church is  beautiful.

name: Christ Church by the Sea - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely small church with warm parishioners. Pastor Paul's sermons are personal, inciteful and modern. Old-fashioned courtesy (and Methodist hymns) mixed with contemporary messages of love and acceptance. I love attending this church. The Pastor here, Pastor Paul Capetz is kind and thoughtful. The congregants are welcoming and I've found the right place for me to worship. All are welcome to attend. Warm reception. Wonderful music and thoughtful sermon. We'll go again. Looking forward to their Easter Sunrise service on the beach. This loving and inclusive church by the beach is a source of great joy in my life!  So thankful to have this church in our community. Wonderful staff, great building, very friendly people all around the place.

name: Christ Church Cambridge
reviewSummary: great episcopal church! very welcoming and affirming! Happy Valentine Days. I am fed Christmas. I meet many nice people here on Thursdays when I come as a volunteer for weekly dinner serving This church was especially welcoming to "seekers" like me. The priest gave a lengthy talk before communion about how all are welcome to take it. (I crossed my arms for a blessing.) This was the most welcome I have felt in any Episcopal church on that score. People generally were welcoming there. They have a library and the Christian Education class seems awesome with plentiful guest lecturers. This church certainly appeals to my intellectual needs. The church was very full, a nice thing to see. They seem to have a lot of visitors. (The two pews in front of me all had visitors too.) We attended a wedding and reception here. It was lovely.

name: Christ Church Cathedral
reviewSummary: The church was gorgeous and the people were so welcoming. Also, the choir was top-notch. I go here often. Always welcoming, nice chorus, nice sermon, they focus on helping the community and their members. So proud of the Episcopal church and their mission to help feed the poor Not open on wednesday. Lovely church with great acoustics and safe parking. Particularly liked friendly  members and after service social time with snacks.

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
The liturgy/service/mass is wonderful.  The congregation and clergy are so welcoming.  The music is outstanding.  Come join us us on Sunday at 10:00 AM.  Perhaps we can meet in person. This is a lovely church and the people seem great. Unfortunately they use incense at the main services (Sunday 10am). They call it 'hypoallergenic', it is so noxious and offensive that we developed sinus infections every time, my family could not continue to come. A couple of the older people I met said they've only been using it for a few years and they didn't in years past. When I mentioned it at the desk they suggested I try the noon service which is non traditional. We are only interested in the traditional service with the choir and the Eucharist. Unfortunate because this is the closest Episcopal Church to us. I cannot imagine anyone actually likes the incense. Bad aggressive energy from an older white male; just kept staring at me from across the Church street.  He had on a purple shirt left the church around 3pm Sunday. I visited here just for the historical building,  loved it, I know nothing about the church itself, but thinking of checking it out. I first attended the Cathedral when in Town for Easter Mass. The parishioners & clergy were friendly and welcoming. The mass was beautiful & thought provoking.

I returned to see the new meditation garden. It is small but well thought out an beautiful. I particularly like that it is a public space and has a “holy water fountain”.

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Houston Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church, architecture is absolutely stunning. Staff however are exceptionally unfriendly and inhospitable. Went to have a look and was told there was a private tour on, left and came back after the tour was done and the same woman told us to leave again. Despite her attitude and the fact I tried to go back and was told for a third time I couldn't go in because of "cleaning", I would still give this place a 5/5 simply because of the buildings beauty, not the people it contains. The service and food were excellent. I typically order the chicken fried chicken accompanied by mashed potatoes and a selection of fruits. I also highly recommend the chocolate cake, which is sizable and exceptionally delicious. The Sunday 11 a.m. service meets my spiritual needs through song, liturgy, and the message. The open table of communion is welcoming for all to receive Christ's gifts of bread and wine that represent his sacrifice of love for us. The church's stained glass windows remind you of Christ's journey to the cross, all for loving us. Beautiful Episcopal church right down the street from Minute Maid ballpark. Beautiful garden inside and they also have a terrific restaurant Treebeards inside with Southern style food. Would definitely recommend to check out I attended the 11 AM service on 12/15/24.  I found the sermon to be very uplifting in trying times and find their inclusiveness of everyone in the LGBTQ+ community & Hispanic Community to be refreshing.  The Gospel says love everyone. The church itself is very beautiful and the stained glass was gorgeous. Be sure to park in the parking garage at 512 San Jacinto St. that the church owns.

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: A warm and welcoming church with open-minded members. It doesn't feel like a traditional church focused on rules—it's a place where everyone is encouraged to come as they are. A wonderful community to celebrate God's Good News and grow in faith together. This church feels like my second family. It’s a tradition to attend the Strawberry Festival on the Circle in June. I have to say, this year was even better. The set up, the mist fans, the strawberry shortcake, and the weather was amazing. This is an event that you don’t want to miss. But, you have to get there because they will sell out! 🍓🍓 The Christ Church Cathedral looked so stunning that we decided to enjoy its beauty from the outside. We saw that they were having a wedding going on while we were exploring the area. #bucketlist Pretty church with nice stained glass Great place for worship. Had the privilege to attend this past Sunday and had communion with the locals. God is good 🙏

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
My name is Dnario and I'm a member of this church. This is one the best churches that I've ever been to. For one they except everyone no matter what you are, who you are, or what race you are. They also have very good attitudes. I love you all Really beautiful and historic church with a lovely staff. Welcoming of all. 🌈 HISTORICAL. This place is a MUST see for Louisvillians and people visiting Louisville!
I enjoyed the fellowship. The Dean gave me his business card. The food delivery from Panera Bread was delicious. I was impressed by their EXCELLENT coffee.
Again, this place is a MUST see!
HISTORICAL
Ten Roses out of Ten
🌹🌹🌹🌹🌹
🌹🌹🌹🌹🌹 Visited the service today while on a trip to Louisville.  The Cathedral is beautiful inside and out.  The service was traditional, but I enjoy that.  The choral selections were beautiful.  The parishioners were very gracious and welcoming.  I would certainly return if in the area on a Sunday morning in the future. I’m going through stage 3 possessions and stage 4 body take over I live a block away from this church and 4 priests I left message for nobody respond back from yesterday I just want to be baptized and if anyone can donate anything I can use it especially markers and coloring books images

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Main Campus
Christ Church Cathedral - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful service this morning celebrating Black History Month. Everyone wa so welcoming. Constantly blocking the road. Asked nicely to move some vehicle and a lady with blonde hair started yelling at me and insulting me. Not very Christlike Peaceful and serene. Nice place to worship with your family. I'm joining soon! Beautiful architecture Amazing stain glass worth hundreds of thousands.

name: Christ Church Cathedral - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this church! From the very first day, everyone made me feel so welcome. The people here are incredibly kind, caring, and friendly—it truly feels like being part of a family.

The worship music is beautiful and uplifting! Every service is inspiring, and you can feel the love for God and for people. This church has become a place where I feel encouraged, supported, and at home.

I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming church with an amazing community and wonderful worship! Christ Church Cathedral in Nashville is beautiful both inside and out.
The interior architecture is stunning, and the massive pipe organ is especially impressive — intricate, historic, and incredibly well preserved. The space feels quiet, grand, and thoughtfully designed, making it a great stop for anyone interested in architecture, music, or photography.

Even just visiting, the cathedral is worth seeing for its craftsmanship, details, and peaceful atmosphere. One of the most striking historic churches in downtown Nashville. Wow, this is one magnificent cathedral. Even though it’s not gigantic it’s still truly magnificent. It’s very rare to see this level of quality of craftsmanship mostly in wood on the inside of the curved ceilings and carvings on the alter and all around. The stained glass too was unique and brilliant. The organ pipes look world class and while we didn’t hear music while we were there we could just imagine how extraordinary the must be. Right up Broadway in a quieter area. Was open middle of afternoon Good Friday when we stopped by. Perfect place to reflect, rest, and just take in the beauty whether religious or not. Very much an “all are welcome” feel. It’s a special and memorable place. Beautiful service and inspiring message. I felt so comfortable here from the moment I got out of my car. I was greeted and gently guided instantly. Lovely people! I love to visit different houses of worship when I travel. What a welcome respite from the noise and craziness on Broadway in Nashville! The atmosphere was wonderful. The choir was outstanding. The architecture was beautiful. I especially loved the stained glass windows and the wood arches in the ceiling! We would like to thank the pastor for her excellent service. Well done on every level!

name: Christ Church Cathedral - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: During Mardi Gras, I was met with rude people working the bathroom line. As a Church centered around Christ, I thought there would be pleasant people but wasn’t met with kindness and compassion. If I were you, please bring your worship elsewhere to feel seen and included, as this church did not do the same for me. I love the stained glass windows in this church so much that I made a painting.  The choir, organ, and priest are also wonderful!  Amen! Beautiful episcopal cathedral from the late 1800s. I'm glad that my family and I attended this church. We were traveling in New Orleans, and our plans got changed. We didn't know what to do that Sunday, so we looked around for a church. Even though we aren't in the same denomination and didn't know how things worked during service, they were very welcoming and helped us figure out our troubles with the day. If anyone is wondering if their greetings were fake, I will be the one to say that that's not true. Very good people in that church. This church is lovely. There are so many beautiful arches and stained glass.  It was very peaceful.

name: Christ Church Conway - Conway Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a church where the Gospel is faithfully preached every week, the sacraments are observed with regularity, and the bonds of Christian fellowship are exhibited, come see us. I've been part of this community for over seven years. We enjoy the gospel-centered preaching, relatively small church community, and friends that we have developed here over the years. I have went here 3 or 4 times with family Very Good place to worship  in Conway Arkansas. Down to earth,  ready to tell you the Gospel Truth in love, and really care about you and your family. Have enjoyed attending. Super welcoming. Modern yet homey

name: Christ Church Detroit
reviewSummary:
I had the extreme pleasure of attending the Candlelight Bridgeton concert series.
Those candles are really cool and I highly recommend buying some along with your concert ticket.
The ambiance was magical, right out of a fairy tale!
It's one thing to hear the songs played through a speaker and become familiar with them that way. It is quite another thing to hear the same pieces performed live in a perfectly acoustic space!
It actually feels different in your body! This sound has a richness and a clarity that is difficult to describe, it has to be experienced.
Whether you attend the '90s Nirvana tribute or the Vivaldi series, I guarantee you are going to remember the experience for the rest of your life.
My one complaint is that the performance is only an hour long!
I could have easily sat there for at least another hour to listen to that quartet!
I will definitely be going back for another concert at Christ Church! Magical atmosphere! Hundreds of flickering candles, a talented string quartet, and a perfect back-and-forth between Coldplay and Imagine Dragons hits from the hauntingly beautiful “Fix You” and “The Scientist” to the explosive “Believer” and “Radioactive. Coldplay’s melodies shine even more emotionally in this intimate, classical style, while Imagine Dragons brings unexpected energy and drive. The balance of dreamy lyricism and raw power was spot-on. 60 minutes flew by like 10-intensely atmospheric, emotional, and stunning. Thank you so much for such a delightful night! 🕯️🎻✨ The Candlelight Concert at Christ Church was absolutely beautiful, the architecture is amazing. The atmosphere was incredible, and the sound quality made the performance even more powerful. Every piece was executed flawlessly. Looking forward to attending more of these events. It was absolutely amazing took my daughter for her birthday she loves Queen and the Muscians were AMAZING and cannot say enough. Thank you for a wonderful evening It was absolutely beautiful!! The music was perfect and the environment was calm and the candles really set the mood. My whole family loved it!

name: Christ Church East Bay - Berkeley Campus
reviewSummary:
When I lived in Berkeley for my studies, this was one of my go-to churches. I am grateful for every moment I spent there and for the warmth I felt in that community. I pray that the peace of the Lord, which transcends all understanding, will be with all of us forever. Love this church - it was like a second home to me for 5 years. Though I live elsewhere now, I still listen to their sermons from time to time.

* The Berkeley location has about ~200 adults on a given Sunday, which is a great size for getting to know people, but having some anonymity when you need it.

* Sermons are bible-centered and intellectual, but well-organized and applicable. The pastors are well-prepared. They are also very sensitive to non-Christians in the audience.

* The community is warm and welcoming, but also respectful of your space/privacy. It's a multi-generational community with a lot of young families in particular.

* Worship is a mix of hymns, contemporary music, and in-house songs. It is led by passionate, professionally skilled musicians.

* Aside from Sunday service, there are plenty of ways to get involved through mid-week small groups and a wide variety of local outreach opportunities. My family and I visited this church once and it was an easy decision to continue attending weekly. The people are genuinely warm and friendly, and currently in this pandemic season since reopening, people have been good about wearing masks. There are many things I love about this church, from its quaint and classic ambiance, to the genuinely friendly people, to the trusting & comforting children’s ministry where we can drop off our kids prior to the sermon. What I love most though is the quality and heart of genuine musical worship throughout the service, and the theologically sound and truthful message in each sermon. In my personal Christian walk, I started with developing a genuine heart for Jesus, to now seeking the Word in deeper and deeper ways to answer and deal with life’s most challenging questions and seasons. Every week, I come away with another nugget of wisdom and a more humble heart for the Lord. If you’re looking  for a heart-filled experience and deeper focus on God, look no further! Christ Church Berkeley has been like family for my wife and me, never more than right now during covid-19. The church leadership has been communicative and generous, and has leaned into the challenge of continuing to teach, shepherd, and serve the congregation through online services and community groups. Both now and in ordinary times, we've loved being involved on Sundays (talented worship musicians and solid Biblical preaching) and also throughout the week (in our 'community group' that meets each Thursday). It's also a welcoming spot for newcomers; they're used to having guests because of the nature of being in Berkeley, but aren't so big that you can't walk up and introduce yourself to the pastor after the service. I've been a part of Christ Church more than a year now. Something distinct about CC is they provide liturgies (physical paper with the order of worship) and it's helpful in guiding your meditation and prayer time during service. Lord's day service starts at 10:30am. Ends around 11:40, followed by coffee hour. That's when you get to meet people and mingle a little. I was surprised by how welcoming and approachable the pastors were. The pastors are awesome! love their preaching and how friendly they are. The music is a mix of traditional hymns and contemporary Xtian music. Very thought out and beautifully played. Anyways, if you're looking for a wholesome, not over bearing, peaceful and beautiful space to be in on Sunday mornings to worship God or explore Xtianity, come to Christ Church.

Lastly, this church emphasizes discipleship through small groups and community. So if you're looking to go deeper in faith, come to Christ Church!

name: Christ Church Episcopal
reviewSummary: Such a friendly and welcoming church- such a pleasant congregation. Father Ken is wonderful! I’ve been attending church my whole life, have been on staff as a children’s minister for multiple churches, and never have I ever attended a service that so beautifully lifted up the role of children as integral in the life of the congregation. The sanctuary of our church home is undergoing renovations, so we were simply visiting today, but our three young children absolutely loved it and I found myself drawn into worship in a way I hadn’t been for quite some time because of how much time and thought was so obviously given to making sure children felt a sense of belonging. Love this church! Have served in different Ministries over the 23 years of attendance and so glad that I am back! Went here as a kid and youth group. Great experience. Great place to go

name: Christ Church Episcopal - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
An incredibly beautiful and all inspiring church with intricate and gorgeous stained glass, wood paneling, and old world charm. The historic Cemetery is a feature to behold all by itself. The people were warm and friendly and the service was very well done. Kristen, she was wonderful today,
I can't thank you enough for being here for me though extremely difficult time,
Blessings To You All This church has been a pillar of the community for most of Greenville’s history.  The services are contemplative and reverent, and there are community events for all ages every week. I haven't attended a service but a very beautiful church with well kept grounds. An exceptionally beautiful historic church and cemetery.

name: Christ Church Episcopal - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary: Warm and welcoming community of loving, faithful folks! A New England church in Summit County

name: Christ Church Episcopal - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing experience at the historic Christ Church. The congregation and Church leadership were so friendly and welcoming. Oldest Episcopal church in Savannah. Impressive architecture and interior. A very warm and welcoming place. My wife and I are visiting from Florida and we were drawn to this place of worship while walking through the area site seeing. While inside learning about the history of this original church of Georgia we were invited to stay for a short service. Which we did.
The message of healing presented by the priest and our seemingly random attendance struck me to the core. This chance experience suddenly didn’t feel like chance but guidance. I was overwhelmed by it and the message of healing was so spot on to our personal circumstances.
I was not able to articulate properly at the time my thanks to the priest and congregation members. The priest approached afterwards seeing that I was struggling and personally engaged me in conversation. I was so overwhelmed with my emotions that I was unable to carry on a conversation. I just wanted to let you know that you and the members that were in attendance are making a difference in people’s lives that you encounter. Thank you! I have been very warmly welcomed at Christ Church Episcopal. This is truly a place of Christian love where faith and belief walk hand-in-hand. George Fergus’ music is outstanding. The worship experience here is  uplifting and just what I have been seeking! I participated in my niece's wedding at Christ Church and must say the Rector and all the people that help keep that church going our excellent examples of the Christian spirit. Totally gorgeous Church clean lines and a wonderful message of Christian Brotherhood

name: Christ Church Frederica - St. Simons Island Campus
reviewSummary: Quiet a little out of the way, but well worth it.  Stunning church with gorgeous stained glass windows.  The gentleman from the historical society was so well informed, and happily shared his knowledge and passion for the church.  We learned so much about its history and the people who contributed to it's existence.  Highly recommend taking this little detour if you have an hour or so.  No admission fee. Absolute treasure on the island. The warm glow of the stained glass fills the small structure and the grounds are wonderful for exploring. Cannot wait to go back! Make sure to check their website for open decent hours. Beautiful grounds and church has beautiful stained glass windows and a very interesting history. You can only enter the church while a docent is present 2-5 daily We went to photograph Christ Church Frederica last week on our recent photographic workshop to Jekyll and Saint Simons Island. Kathleen was our docent and she did a fantastic job giving us the history of the church. Very historical and very beautiful. The members of the congregation rotate the responsibility of staying on site to answer questions and so you can access the building. Fascinating architecture.

name: Christ Church Greensboro - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: CCG is a family that is always open to more of God's children. This church desires to serve each other and the community as Christ has loved us. There is genuine humility and repentance among the leadership that encourages all of us to live according to the Gospel.  Pastor Jeff is a wonderful, caring shepherd who faithfully teaches the Bible. CCG is a great place whether you are a single person, student, or married with kids.  I have found it very welcoming and non-discriminatory in all ways.  It has brought me closer to God and it has strengthened my faith.  It is a great community to belong to. CCG has some of the most friendly and down to earth people at any church I've been to. The sermons are meaningful and the Head Pastor is very humble. There are lots of opportunities for growth and community. They have small groups, womens ministry events, community service events, mentoring, and so much more. Over the summers they have supper clubs where you can prayerfully get partnered up with people you don't know to make friends. This is not the kind of church where you walk in and out just on Sunday mornings. This church is multi-generational and diverse. They preach the  gospel and live it out. My wife and I enjoy being part of the body of Christ at CCG.  It's very welcoming and friendly.  We've felt very cared for over the last several years and consider CCG our family. I love the staff and people of this church. There is genuine concern for each other as well as a deep desire to love and serve God. Strong teaching from the Bible, discipleship, outreach into the community, and wonderful fellowship.

name: Christ Church Greenwich - Main Campus
Christ Church Indy - Indianapolis Campus
Christ Church International - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church. Warm welcome. Came Christmas Sunday. Beautiful Christmas carols. One song let me know God's presence was in the place. Great message.
I would recommend this church to anyone looking for a great place to worship and find a family to fellowship with. Everyone is warm and loving. The space is peaceful and inviting. The music is amazing. All of the musicians and singers are very talented. Pastor’s Mark and Matthew are wonderful teachers and storytellers. They listen, are kind, wise, intelligent and funny. I love this place. The Praise and Worship is is powerful! The fellowship is like family and you will always want to be in each others presence.  Christ Church is my break in my week where i can forget all about the problems i might be struggling with, and just Worship God and learn more about him! Every Sunday makes me hungrier for God! This church is a safe place empowering believers for effective Christian living. The pastors are genuine and live their lives wholly to following the call of the Lord on each of their lives. The members of the church follow the mission of "Souls from every nation, one at a time" as the call not only for the pastors  but for them as believers and followers of Jesus Christ. God put me here 36 years ago. Experience the love, presence and power, and grace of the Lord God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit.  Souls from every nation.

name: CHRIST Church Irving - Irving Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ Church in Irving TX is Truly a Welcoming Church Home. This was Our First Visit to Christ Church, Irving and
From the moment we stepped through the doors of the Church my spouse and I knew we had found something truly special. As first-time visitors, we were a little unsure of what to expect, but any hesitations quickly dissolved in the face of the incredibly warm and genuine welcome we received.
Every single person we encountered made us feel not just accepted, but truly embraced. It was clear that the spirit of community and love permeates every corner of this church. We were genuinely touched by how supportive and understanding everyone was, especially as we navigate our own spiritual journey. It felt like we were instantly among friends who genuinely cared.
The worship experience was uplifting, spirit-filled, and deeply moving. We felt a tangible sense of God's presence, and the message resonated deeply with our hearts. There’s a beautiful balance of reverence and joy that makes Christ Church a truly inspiring place to worship.
We left our first visit with full hearts and a profound sense of peace. We are absolutely thrilled to share that Christ Church will undoubtedly be our new church home. We are so excited to become a part of this vibrant, welcoming, and spiritually nurturing community. If you are searching for a church where you feel truly seen, loved, and supported in your walk with faith, we wholeheartedly recommend Christ Church in Irving. You won't be disappointed! Love my new church! The main pastors, Keith and Greg, the entire staff and body  of volunteers make everyone feel welcome, the church is very involved with the community and their re:gen ministry is one of the most impactful groups I’ve ever belonged to. Made my first new friend here after moving from FL to TX. Thankful for this church!! Come visit and let God do the rest. I attended Christ Church for almost 4 years. The only reason I left was because I had to move with to another city with my husband. I started attending right before the COVID shutdown in 2020 so I only got to meet a few people but they brought me in like family. We stayed connected through online Bible studies. The Hispanic ministry is a huge blessing to the community and to myself.  The church truly cares about every ministry including kids, young adults, Hispanic ministry, Bible studies, and special programs like Regeneration (which truly helped changed my life). I also did appreciate the worship and the way we started having worship nights! I love the church and the people so much! The pastors are the best. They are so caring and funny and I feel like they have a heart for each person who walks through those doors. I pray the Lord continues to bless Christ Church Irving and empowers every member to spread the gospel to all people.  Great church, my first time going this past Sunday. The preacher is awesome and my kid had a blast! I love this church, I've been attending now for 2 months and can honestly say that the pastor's care about you, and your spiritual growth,and truly wish the best for you.If you want to feel welcomed this is the place.

name: Christ Church Las Vegas (CREC) - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: I am very grateful to Pastor Jeff, Jesse and Mason for faithfully bringing forth God’s Word and proclaiming the whole council of God. I have attended Christ Church for over 6 years, and it is a loving community and I highly recommend! This is a solid reformed church. The teaching is biblical. The people are very kind. They are a mission work of the CREC which is an added bonus. 1st half hour was nothing but ritualistic. Apostles' Creed and hymns. How is it reformed? Reformed from what? No movement of The Holy Spirit. Disapointed. Glad it blesses so many. Excellent theology and leaders here! If you’re looking for a Reformed Church that teaches the Bible, this is it! Christ Church Las Vegas is a spiritual oasis in the desert. Reformed, biblical teaching; honest, honorable, welcoming leadership; and most importantly, Christ-glorifying fellowship. We drive over an hour to be a part of this incredible and dynamic community of believers living life together. Praise God for this church!

name: Christ Church Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
A fantastic church and lovely welcoming community. When I arrived I was met with a vibrant and diverse group of people. Everyone made a real effort to make me feel at home even when it was my first time there. And they succeeded!

Services include great, biblically sound, teaching that is applicable to daily life, well thought out songs and prayers, and a talented worship team.

I can’t recommended checking out this church enough! We’ve been part of this church community for the past four years, and it has truly become a second home for our family. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were welcomed with such warmth and kindness. The people here are genuine, caring, and truly invested in building a strong, supportive community.

Pastor Ken’s sermons are a consistent highlight—thoughtful, deeply rooted in scripture, and always relevant. His teaching challenges and encourages us every week, and we’re so grateful for the wisdom and heart he brings to the pulpit.

Another incredible part of the church is the thriving kids ministry. Our three children (ages 7, 4, and 2) absolutely love attending. They’ve made wonderful friends and are always excited to go—something we’re so thankful for as parents.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like family, where you’ll be spiritually fed and your kids will thrive, this is it. My wife and I have been attending for almost a year now and we love this church. The people are friendly, the staff is very caring, and the total experience (sermons, prayer meetings, mid-week Bible studies) are very edifying to us. A great little faithful church with a welcoming posture towards visitors - I would highly encourage anyone to visit. Christ Church Los Angeles fosters a warm, inclusive environment with powerful sermons and authentic community. Great place to grow in faith and build meaningful relationships. I have grown tremendously as a Christian even in less than a year of attending Christ Church. Our pastors give faithful, nuanced, and practical deep dives into scripture, and our congregation is strong and diverse -- embracing all Christians (and even non-Christians) and are sincerely supportive and curious about each of its members and their individual journeys.

name: Christ Church Lutheran - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Ahh, my old(as a kid thru teenage years) school and church I went to from k-8!!  Great times, learned allot, wonderful school and great teachers for you too learn and make great memories!! You'll learn and love it here! At this point in time space, it's either absolutely not acceptable, or at least remarkably strange for any conscious adult human being to not be on the other side of what was the messianic/atonement believing religion of their childhood accounting for what their beliefs of general human, and spiritual advancement, and sovereignty ought to exclusively represent through it, only to then (and by way of built in misappropriated intent/plagiarism) "know" what such virtues as held "truths" mean exclusively, for both themselves and others as individuals. Pastor Shrank and his congregation are fantastic hosts. School kids help out with enthusiasm. This is an excellent congregation.  They had 2,400 church workers for a conference and the congregation was incredible.  Their worship services are top notch and they love to serve in the community.  One great ministry is in serving people who have addiction.  Their school is also excellent. My family always goes to the contemporary service. It mixes Bible knowledge with reality in today's world

name: Christ Church Milwaukee
reviewSummary: I love this place - our service starts at 10am. The coffee is mid but the people are fantastic. Come worship Jesus with us.

name: Christ Church Napa - Napa Campus
Christ Church Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: It’s really sad to see what this once very great and powerful church has now become.  It used to be a powerful church with a powerful doctrinal testimony, powerful services, a standard of worship - but Dan Scott killed this church.  His desire make it “all things to all people” and remove it from being a Pentecostal church because of his personal disdain was the beginning of the end.  It’s just so sad.   So many great people left because they couldn’t stand to see how he was destroying this great church.  So terribly sad.   Used to have two packed morning worship services.  Heart breaking. I came for the Celebrate Recovery Gathering and had an amazing experience. The church was perfect for our Gathering and God was definitely in that place. We went for the 2025 Celebrate Recovery East gathering. This is a great facility and had a fabulous time! God is amazing!!! More of a concert to make one feel good than literal worship. As a visitor attended with my son's family. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. They have multiple programs for all ages to participate. The minister teaches on the bible and easily understood. The choir sings beautifully and do several programs. The office staff was very helpful and caring when my son passed away

name: Christ Church North Bay - Novato Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve grown up in this church and now am raising my kids here. This community is such a wonderful, supportive and caring setting. I am so grateful for the relationships, friendships and support from these amazing people. I love that it’s a place where I can be genuine, authentic and be accepted for who I am. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing there are people who love me and my kids so well!! Surprised not to see more comments than 1.  I have been with the church for decades.  I have seen the seasons of the church come and go.  But the one thing that is constant is the message of salvation:  the acceptance of Him as Savior of Mankind.  The Lordship is a process in one's life.  His Son's blood shields me so I can be seen by God the Father.  The God the Holy Spirit continues His work of being counselor and helper.  So yes, we do believe in the Triune Deity.\
When I needed to talk to someone, there is someone to listen and pray for me.  Confidences are kept confident -- an important quality for any church.
This church is good for me, and they know that I have Spanish church culture connections -- an awesome privilege.  This is also encouraging for me.
So come and check up out -- there may be a divine appointment surprise waiting for you.//Janeen Great group of friendly people! Very good preaching by Pastor Matthew Holiday. Hope to see you there. 2 different churches meet here. I go to the one that meets here Sunday mornings 10am. They have free Peers coffee, kids church, a band, and their pastor is really down to earth and friendly! Great community of people. 1x a month they have potluck right after church. They have weekly social events. Camping 1x per year. All are welcome. I have been attending CCNB for 12 years. This church is a wonderful community of believers who love Christ and each other. We have engaging worship, solid preaching, a good children's program and some awesome events like a 4th of July parade float, VBS, Family Camp, Crab Fest and a Living Nativity at Christmas.

name: Christ Church NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church and lovely atmosphere. My great-uncle Ralph Sockman designed the church to welcome Christians of all denominations. In this United Methodist Church, you will find elements of Catholic, Orthodox and Byzantine architecture. I was able to light a candle for my daughter, with the thought of being in the constant state of prayer. Beautifully freshly restored..  if you're anywhere near Park&60th, stick your head in.  OR come on a Sunday to worship (I'm guessing. I went for Ash Wednesday service! The church itself is beautiful and the mass was absolutely enriching. I would go again ! May God bless us all 🙏 On 5/1/25 I was in desperate need of using the restroom. I went to a place that I thought was safe and would welcome me with open arms. However , upon my entrance into the church I kindly asked an employee sitting by the door to direct me to the restroom. He stated that the church does not have one. I was appalled by his response in the house of the lord. I pray that he does not do this to another individual who is in need. I attend an AA (Alcoholics Anonymous) meeting here called The Atlantic Group, which is the sister meeting to The Pacific Group of California, going on 7 years or so. The interior of this Church is stunning, beautiful, awesome and amazing! Literally and all at the same time!
One of the largest AA meetings in New York. I have not attended mass here yet, but the Church is very accommodating to our meetings, which number in the hundreds of members.
I recommend visiting this Church for it's beauty and I'm sure Mass here is just as fulfilling.

name: Christ Church of Arlington
reviewSummary:
Amazing church. Great community and ministry team. Very attuned to biblical truth. One of the most welcoming churches you will ever encounter. The congregation is a good mix of all ages. This is truly an excellent church.  My wife and I agree that it was the best we ever attended.  No small feat - as we've hopped around the U.S. quite a lot.

The minister and people are great.  Thoughtful, well-crafted sermons that inspire and inform.  The people are welcoming and genuine.

Though it's not the biggest church, one has the sense that this is really a strong one.  When we joined, my wife and I had been married only a short time.  It was a good choice for us then.  But we didn't appreciate how much it offered until we began to have children who attended Sunday School there.  My 3 year old learned a lot.

We're now in another state.  We miss NoVA/DC, but we really miss CCofA!  I wish my kids could have grown up there! Very good Bible based Gospel centered church.  Powerful sermons and friendly congregation very welcoming to visitors. Multi-cultural family of God. All are welcome. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Christ Church of Atlanta - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: Great service and communion! Marvelous, friendly church with superb preaching and teaching.

name: Christ Church of Cedar Park - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice Acts 29 network church! They have a window to the outside! You can view God’s creation while you get your learn and worship on! More churches need this type of setup. I've never attended this church so this has nothing to do with their services or doctrine. I already have a church that i attend and love. However, I also mountain bike a lot and i think it speaks highly of this church as a part of the community that they're willing to let people they don't know (me and others) use part of their land and parking lot to enable a great activity for local families. Thank you for your kindness and generosity as well as the example you set of how we as Christians can welcome our neighbors in. We visited these folks during a Christmas event and they were very kinds and loving.

"Christ Church is a community of believers seeking to lead all people to know, love, and serve Christ by being His church for one another, our city, and the world. Whether you are exploring the faith or have been walking with Christ for most of your life, we think you will enjoy the warmth of our people, our new ministry home, our worship and our commitment to teach the timeless truths of Scripture." I have been coming hear and worshiping and learning since I have been born, quite frankly. I love these people, they are amazing. I met some of my closest friends there! Great student ministry, awsome Sunday school, the Sunday service is outstanding! Amazing family/staff. (First service is always the best) definitely a five star place This is a relaxed, welcoming mixed age group that respects and embraces diversity. If you are looking for acceptance and learning The Truth- and you want to know more about Jesus- this a fabulous place to be a part of. Vibrant children's and youth ministry, excellent worship and inspired teaching will meet you there! There are several community groups functioning for those who want to be a part of a small group. Service times are 9:30 and 11 am Sundays.  Check out the website for more details!

name: Christ Church of Davis - Davis Campus
reviewSummary: Great community of Jesus followers!

name: Christ Church of India - San Ramon - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to worship as a family and participate in the various missions being supported by the Church. Wonderful place and people to worship the Lord Great place to worship 👍

name: Christ Church of King of Prussia
reviewSummary:
Far, far too many wonderful things about this church family to write up in a review, but suffice it to say, there is solid community available here!  People of all ages gather for energy-filled teaching which is always centered on the Bible, prayer is valued, music is worshipful and encouraging, and the staff is loving and supportive.  Folks from all over the suburban area have made this their church home, many for decades, and connections are not only wide, but also deep. Our family truly loves our church home at Christ Church, where we’ve been members for many years. Our family has grown and been deeply supported through Life Group, Christ Kids, VBS, special events, and youth group. The Bible-centered preaching, teaching, worship, and leadership are both authentic and strong, all within a close-knit community that genuinely cares for and supports one another. A church the really preaches from the Word. This has been a wonderful place for our family to “plant our flag”.

Shortly after we became members, our newborn was in the hospital. Pastor Matt and Pastor Jake showed up at the hospital with words to pray, when we felt like we didn’t have much left to say.

Praise the Lord for the work He is doing through His Church. We visited CC KOP recently and greatly appreciated the time of worship and the chance to meet the pastor.  Pastor Matt and the folks at Christ Church are extremely welcoming and desire to see people grow in their faith in Christ.  Highly recommend! I've loved getting to know the great people at this church. Pastor Matt brings it every week!

reviewSummary: This is a church that is focused on the Bible in their missions, care, and sermons.  Really appreciated the staff and the pastoral staff led by Pastor Carness Vaughn. Cannot thank the ministry enough for helping me turn my life aroumd. Christ Church makes you feel so welcome! Please remember Jo-Anne Pearcey and pray for her in heaven. She taught so many kids to read and write.  She touched my heart everyday I saw her. Truly blessed to know I was someone she was able to help because I needed it. She was such a good woman. Always always !! Put us first. I can go on and on how she made sure her students were treated fair and without judgment passed along. She will forever be in my heart. Love 💙 Lindsey Hershey - I think you are confused.  I am a member of Christ Church and, first of all, we do not order groceries to be delivered there.  Secondly, our church is a wonderful, spirit-filled, generous, and community-focused entity.  Every staff member is a strong Christian believer who treats others with utmost respect.  I'm not sure which church you are referring to, but it's not ours!  I know that, for a fact. Had a very negative encounter with the people trying to attend a Wednesday night service. They stopped my boyfriend from going to the bathroom so we left.

name: Christ Church of Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
EDIT: I am moving from the lofts tomorrow. Since this incident, I never had another issue, so I am changing my review to five stars.

I live in the lofts across the street. This churches band practice started about an hour ago at 2/17/23 at 8am. When I tell you the bass drum beat shook me out of my bed. And then continues bass notes for close to an hour now. It took me 45 minutes to track the noise across the street where I walked into the unlocked church and to my surprise I stumble into the band room around 845am where 3 sound techs are sound testing about 8 musicians. Obviously after realizing the situation I left without creating a ruckus. But dude seriously? I'm gonna have to report this to the city you guys are INSANELY loud I can hear that bass note from the front door of Target that is incredibly unreasonable for 830am. Please move your practices to later in the morning. The landscapers started at 9am per city code and you guys bass notes are significantly louder than their machines. Great church you’ll love! The church I had planned on visiting was on-line only due to renovations.
I knew of Christ Church Orlando thru social media and driving by their property. As a last minute decision I decided to attend the 9 AM service.
Absolutely a genuine worship experience. I told Mary sitting next to me that I would be back the next Sunday. I have been attending Christ Church for a number of weeks. It is a very friendly and welcoming church offering a meaningful worship experience including uplifting  music
And dynamic presentation of the gospel. The friendliness of this church is outstanding and definitely makes you want to return. This has been such a blessing in my life. This is a very spirit led church, we had a normal sermon turn into a worship service because Pastor Paul felt some people needed some healing that day and offered an opportunity for prayer for those who needed it. My life has been changed by attending and I've seen others come into some life changes here as well. Such a great and welcoming place. They preach Jesus and the word. I strayed away from another church because I was hearing politics and opinions from the pulpit. This has been a great church for me to really know what it's like to be a disciple of Jesus and to start seeing the benefits of that in my life as well.

name: Christ Church of the Bay Area - Burlingame Campus
Christ Church of the Bay Area - San Mateo Campus
Christ Church on Capitol Square - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I were taking a stroll downtown and happened up this little gem. I was immediately drawn to the beauty and care taken by the landscaper or others responsible for this property. Their love of God and His wonderful creation are evident in their handiwork. It brought joy to my soul and I commend those responsible. We visited Raleigh for a wedding and happened upon this beautiful church. We actually came back on Sunday when it was open just to be able to walk through the building and the grounds. A very nice man of the cloth noticed us and offered a tour of both chapels. They were breathtaking. I recommend anyone to stop by and see this beautiful landmark. This is the church that strengthened my relationship with The Lord... Jim's sermons are especially impactful. Love the welcoming community and online services while I am away at college. Music is beautiful and my heart is always full when I leave.❤️ We attempted to join the 11am Easter service but were treated so rudely.  We tried to sit down twice at an empty pew and were told the seats were being held for someone.  No ushers assisted and we felt very unwelcome. Would never go back.
We went up the street to the First Baptist Church and were greeted with open arms. Parishioners greeted us before and after the service and invited us to come back.  We will! Beautiful building, alter, and the service was wonderful.  The choir was amazing; I sat and listened to them practice before the service.  The Choir Director is very talented!  Unfortunately, the church seems very pretentious.  No one spoke to me, welcomed me, said hello to me.  I was like an outsider (well I was).  I left looking forward to my next Episcopal church service at a different location.

name: Christ Church on Harvard - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited Christ Church on Harvard about a week before Christmas and had a wonderful experience. They presented a Christmas play about Mary and Joseph that was very family-oriented and engaging for all ages.
From the moment we arrived, everyone was kind and welcoming. The congregation was friendly, and the pastor took time to introduce himself and ask if I had been there before since I wasn’t a familiar face. That meant a lot and really stood out.
Christ Church on Harvard feels like a place where people are noticed and welcomed. We left feeling encouraged and grateful for the warmth we experienced. Christ Church caring and putting up with me going through a lot thank pastor Aaron not giving up on me A very friendly and welcoming atmosphere with great praise music that is creative and inspiring.
I am always really blessed by Pastor Bob's and Pastor Aaron's engaging and bible based sermons.
Never feel like a stranger.
Great place to be on a Sunday morning. Instant reaction: wow they're excited I'm here and want me to feel welcomed and loved! A place where you'll never feel judged, only love and care. Early service is for the old school soul, who appreciates the traditions from their parents and grandparents, and second service is for those who enjoy a great band on stage and wearing what's comfy. They are very different but equally great.
I've had so many bad church experiences that getting up to go to a new church, where my feelings could get hurt because my clothes weren't right or became I didn't know something, while overal feeling like standing out like a sore thumb, made me want to give up on church. Then I was invited to Christ Church. It's truly special. A pastor even visited me in the hospital without my request.
If you're not a "church person," try their community events. They're fun & have no strings or pressure attached. It's months away, but I love their trunk or treat! Been a member at this precious church since about 1984. Can't begin to tell all the benefits I have experienced through the years. Loved Dr. Pierson and love Pastor Bob Feist. Currently in a fabulous Sunday School class. Hope you will come join us soon!
