name: Christ Church PCA - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
We had a great time at the church and the message was very direct and clear, everyone was very friendly and the crowd was diverse Found CCK on a Reformed church area search, did a little research on the staff where they attended seminary etc, & listed to several sermons before we went. We attended one evening service, knew I was in the right place. Not perfect, but definitely a place where the members are cared & watched over. Well-organized, established. Actively teaching the Word of God as authoritative through preaching, classes, events. Is more like a family now. Our family has been attending this church for about 4 months. The teaching is solid and serious. Being a Christian is not a game, hobby or accessory to them. It is everything and the best part is, is that I feel like they want to come along side of people and teach and love them. I didn't feel like they were an exclusive club.
They are conservative and hold tight to what the Bible teaches unlike other branches of Presbyterian that we have investigated. It is my first time to here a nice and good experience.
People from different countries and regions
The spirit of the selfless dedication moved me
Thank for Mary who sing like an angel
Every one enthusiasm and patience so nice

Thank you

Give a like👍 The people here are very kind and welcoming.

name: Christ Church Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
We enjoyed our visit on Sunday July 5th and felt right at home. Very friendly and welcoming. They had a very nice playground for kids. I’ve been going since February and I love it. From being greeted at the door to taking holy communion, everything and everyone is Christ centered. The Sanctuary is beautiful, the children’s facilities are great. We are very blessed to have such a great church in our community. Welcome to church in Rivendell. Are you too Catholic for Protestants but also too Protestant for Catholics? Are you tired of Ted-Talk sermons and rock-band worship? Want to put some church back in your church? CCP might just be the place for you.

The architecture of the main sanctuary looks to be of elvish origin,  attested to by the green and gold theme and simple elegance of it all. It brings in the feel of a traditional cathedral but with a modern minimalist twist. I truly enjoy seeing the clear blue Texas skies and rolling clouds ⛅️ through the filtered windows as I worship.

The sermons are relevant for today but with a traditional liturgy and excellent music ministry that ties you back into your connection with church history. The people are very friendly. The clergy all come from diverse theological backgrounds, but all have found their place and home at CCP. All of them are very approachable, collar and all.

They have an excellent children and youth ministry that our kids have enjoyed thoroughly. Bring a dollar on Wednesday nights for the pizza served to the 4th - 12th graders.

There are many ministries that reach the local community and beyond.

We have been taking their foundations class and have really enjoyed it. Every class begins with a fellowship lunch together. We've not been going here for very long but have found that people already know us by name.

If you want to dip your toe back into the traditional church scene, I truly do recommend giving this church a try. Great church to go to regardless of denomination. Incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the music and staff are excellent. Attended a wedding here. The church was beautiful, clean and full of natural light. The fellowship hall was spacious and turned into a beautiful reception venue. There is tons of parking and the seats were comfortable.

name: Christ Church Pompano Beach Chapel - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I lived on the streets for quite a while and this church along with pastor Rich were a complete blessing. I don't know what everyone including myself would have done without this church and the wonderful people that associated with it. Thank you pastor Rich and everyone else for the food the sanctuary the blessings and for helping me and so many others to see the love of God... So sad!  Church being demolished today (9/9/23).  Thank you for beautiful Worship in a beautiful sanctuary with lovely people!😭.........Worship at the Christ Church campus in Pompano.  Don't let the construction get to you, come worship with us. Beautiful campus. Ministry to the homeless population here is outstanding. So many types of ministries are taking place on this campus c Its a place that feeds the homeless. Those voleenteers are perfect. Mr. Richard is z very rude man. Very disrespectful to the new comer. What a breath of fresh air this chappel is to come to and worshiip Our Father God Almighy, His Son and our Savior Jesus Christ, and Our Holy Spirit.  I look forward to being a part of this congregation!

name: Christ Church Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: My family has been attending Christ Church for more than 10 years -- we were married here and our children were born and baptized here. We are so thankful to raise our family in this community and participate in beautiful, powerful worship every week. This church is one of the most integral parts of my life and it's the main reason why we're staying in Santa Clarita. As a visitor who is acquainted with many Christ Church families, I can attest that this is a wonderful and unique church community, full of quality people.  Pastor Garrett Craw tells it like it is, speaks with wisdom and authority, and demonstrates real pastoral care for his flock. I enjoyed attending this Seventh Day Adventist Church with a good friend. It is a nice group of people, and they seem to care not just for each other but for yet others, and they care about the place that the Bible has in teaching and instruction. Great like-minded leadership, beautiful music, reverent but enthusiastic worship, biblical teaching, traditional liturgy, diverse ages and backgrounds. This place is not safe especially for children.  I'm attached pictures to clarify.  Look through others posts as well.

name: Christ Church Sugar Land - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: Christ Church is the center of my life. I am in harps , bells, and choir, and I get my social interactions and spiritual sustenance from the groups. The music is inspired and the fellowship is perfect. I could not ask for more! While I do not have any experience with Christ Church services I can speak on their preschool. They have an amazing program for my two children. Both of which are always scrambling to exit our car as soon as we pull up. They are engaged with learning and the Word. I couldn't ask for a better place to have my children attend. Thank you. Christ Church is a remarkable place that fosters a warm and welcoming community. The atmosphere is uplifting, making it easy for newcomers to feel at home. The sermons are thought-provoking and inspiring, encouraging personal growth and reflection. The congregation is friendly and supportive, creating strong bonds and a sense of belonging. Additionally, the church actively engages in community service, demonstrating a commitment to making a positive impact beyond its walls. Overall, Christ Church is a place of spiritual nourishment and connection, perfect for anyone seeking a vibrant faith community.  I am looking to going every Sunday and joining the activities of the church.  Pastor Marquice’s leadership is definitely nurtured from God. Warm, friendly congregation. Wonderful pastors and they put their hearts and souls into mission. Wonderful , welcoming women's group and a great day school. My father-in-law is a member of this church. I often thought how crazy it was that he drove an hour to go to a particular Church. However when my mother-in-law fell ill and was in the hospital, Pastor Michelle drove in the middle of the night even though she does not live close just to pray with our family. Then after that every time I came to Houston I would attend this church with my father-in-law on Sundays. I completely understand why he attends this church.The people in this church are amazing, they are very welcoming, and seem to be none  judgemental. I started to Lose My Faith a long time ago in organized religion. But after coming to this particular Church I feel closer to God once again. I'm very appreciative of the people in this church that has helped my family. Also I am appreciative that they helped  restore my faith in the church, in his people, and helped heal my own person faith in the Lord.

name: Christ Church Tallahassee - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: We found this Church after a power-hungry bishop destroyed our Anglican Church that had been the focus or our religious life for 20 years. It made us realize that it has been bishops who have caused problems in all churches over the centuries. This Church provides us with the beautiful Anglican liturgy without the need to pay homage to unscrupulous and arrogant bishops. Most importantly, the clergy are caring, intelligent priests who provide incredible sermons every Sunday. What an incredible blessing Christ Church has been! I have been away from a religious life for decades. After I met and married Linda, we joined this church as it was forming and this had given us both tremendous blessings. The church family is small and very special. I have grown tremendously in my renewed faith and treasure this church and the closeness of our members. A loving, warm environment with kind, caring congregation. We are very blessed to have found Christ Church. A truly loving church for our family. May God continue to bless this sweet parish. Excellent family Worship in the Anglican tradition.

name: Christ Church United Church - Evansville Campus
reviewSummary: I have found love and community with this congregation. Thank you to all for welcoming me and my husband. I love this place. The people there are amazing. Awesome church family

name: Christ Church United Methodist
reviewSummary:
An amazing church to worship! Always a kind and giving Parrish. Attended a beautiful wedding NYE and it was just so breathtaking & very warmly welcomed by everyone. Love this Church and the loving congregation. I’ve always been treated with kindness and grace. Everyone there was absolutely amazing! They truly make you feel welcome and comfortable. The 3 ladies that helped me today had the warmest smiles and sweetest personality. I went in feeling like I had a weight on my shoulders, when I set down and started talking to these ladies that weight slowly lifted! Great place for church basketball games. Played there in my youth and still walk up four floors to watch the games! Lots of  churchs I've been to are quiet judgemental and don't greet you or follow up or even even take a second to talk during exit.
I can say this church and it's Pastor does it all includes public on activities and acknowledges them as people. When I do become a more active member again it will be here.
Great kids program and safety. We feel so blessed to have found The Growing Place. Ms. Cindy and her staff are amazing! My children are 4 and 2 and they both love going to school.

name: Christ Church United Methodist - Denver Campus
reviewSummary: I love this Church  I moved away and went on a Sunday . I shure was missed ! Im g I ing to try to come more often . I really feel like this church represents the Jesus I learned about as a kid, the Jesus who breaks down barriers and invites all, REALLY all, into community. The sermons are always both thought provoking and meaningful, and the community is welcoming, open, and represents the full spectrum of humanity. If you are someone who has left the Christian church because of how Christian churches the hostile way have treated the LGBTQ community in the past, or been in a church environment where there was only one way to think or be and everyone else was going to hell, but you still want to believe and miss church… come here. They’re doing their level best to put things right, while being wonderfully human along the way. I really love this church and I’m so glad they exist. This is the best Church I’ve been to. Great sermons and services given by the pastor.  She is so personable and engaging. Everyone there is welcoming.  Truly a place that represents Gods love and open arms. Such an open and loving community. A great place for family, the pastors aren't afraid to discuss difficult topics. There is a huge emphasis on social justice and uplifting the oppressed. I firmly believe that this sort of place is what Jesus meant when he talked about the church. A community of love and acceptance. These people are REAL. This Sunday congregation is one of the most diverse, open, accepting, friendly groups of people I've ever known. I'm an Athiest who was raised Methodist and no one judges or prods at my current religious beliefs if they find out or I tell them. They may want to hear more but it's in a super non-judgemental way, and guess what? I've never been more comfortable spending time in a church in my life. This Methodist Church reminds me a lot of the one I grew up with and the only church my parents attended that I'd previously called "my church".

name: Christ Church United Methodist - Kettering / South Dayton Campus
reviewSummary:
Great friendly welcoming holy people. Working hard to show God's grace to all that enter their doors. Unbelievable sermons worth a trip if you're looking for a place to Worship. Great child classes and childcare provided during all services Great community serving Christ with many service opportunities.   They have a variety of worship styles to choose from and multiple campuses.  Many different small groups to choose from.

Major organizer of the Kettering Backpack program which feed our students who need assistance.

Great online live services at christumc.org Visit the multi-cultural Fil-AM congregation on Sunday afternoon with my friend Pastor Rey and his wife Gaylen. Pastor Nonito 'Nitos' Dobles preached an enlighting sermon. Fellowship was excellent, and afterward, we had excellent Phillipiino food. I enjoyed the fellowship and food. I had the pleasure of catering a wedding reception in the gym and using the kitchen facilities.  Mr Ron and Mr Seth were so helpful! I have been here for lots of different things. Great place. Junior Optimist place

name: Christ Church United Methodist - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: This church is stunning.  We were there for a concert.  The welcoming team were fantastic. Great church and the choir during charol time. Very welcoming church!  Beautiful service for all saints Sunday! Pastors and greeters were very cordial and informative!  I will be back when I visit again! Annual Conference was great. The church was beautiful and the choir/music was top notch. The police were out front directing traffic to make it easy to enter.

name: Christ Church Vienna (Offices) - Vienna Campus
reviewSummary: My family has been attending CCV for 4+ years. There is a real sense of outreach to Vienna and wonderfully supportive community. Christ-centered, loving environment! We felt such warmth and kindness during our time in Northern Virginia at this church. Great community church, welcoming and accessible to everybody! [object Object] [object Object]

name: Christ Church Waco - Waco Campus
reviewSummary:
A church where the Word is proclaimed, where feasting is abundant, and where our mission flows naturally from Word and Table. I especially love Brazos Fellow, a learning community at Christ Church where you can be monk-ish in prayer and fellowship with other young people discovering their calling to follow Jesus in heart, soul, mind, and strength You've gotta check this Church out!

They put down and live out legit, unashamed Biblical teaching. Best place for spiritual gatherings with family and friends of the Faith! This church changed my life! The community here unlike anything else. Their love and obedience to the Lord is extraordinary. Friendly, beautiful church! Visit for your own awesome experience

name: Christ Church Wake Forest - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Christ Church Winston-Salem - Winston-Salem Campus
reviewSummary: I had the privilege of worshiping with my family at this church on the weekend of Rogation Sunday. The entire worship service combined Word and Sacrament, and on this particular Sunday the entire church met outside in the open air and offered extended prayers of thanksgiving to God for the gifts of His creation, and with special prayers for those who by the sweat of their brow and care for the land grow food for everyone to enjoy. I felt personally blessed by southern hospitality, and I was encouraged by meeting members who had moved from around the world to worship with this community. Went to an AA meeting here loved it defenitely will be going back It's a godly church with conservative Christian values. Non-woke! But they are all friendly, not stuffy, non judgemental and welcoming to a diverse neighborhood. God bless this church and all its staff and volunteers Warm community of Christ followers.

name: Christ Church, Georgetown - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: Visitor to D.C. and a friend recommended CCG for Ash Wednesday. Beautiful service. Gorgeous choir (some sung in latin!) The Rector was wonderful to listen to, thoughtful. Folks were welcoming. Beautiful rite II 9am Eucharist, it seems to be the perfect service for families with young children. There were several wiggly kids and no one batted an eye- seems very welcoming! I attended a funeral recently here and found the service, atmosphere, and feel to be welcoming. I found the building to be a sanctuary away from the multiple stresses that exist outside. The choir is beautiful. I have never been to an episcopal service and found it inspiring. I plan to go here as much as possible, if simply for a place to find quiet. This is a lovely church in Georgetown and just a short walk from M Street. I have been here twice now, once for a funeral and recently for a much more happier occasion, a wedding. It is beautiful inside and well worth a look if you find yourself this way or want to have a wedding here, or a funeral. What a wonderful building. Very quaint and very soothing.

name: Christ Church, Plainfield - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: My wife, and I started attending Christ Church 6 months ago after we were invited there by a friend! He, and I were talking one day about how my wife, and I had visited a few churches, but never found that perfect place! So he suggested visiting his church which was only 10 minutes from our home! He raved about how much he, and his family enjoyed it, and how they had gone there for a few years! He said you’ll enjoy it very much, and the pastor is awesome! So we came on a Sunday morning, and loved it immediately! The pastor Morris is amazing, and everyone makes you feel so welcome! They're not pushy either, just supportive, and we liked that! We have never missed a Sunday since, and really enjoy the worship music, sermons, and all the community programs they do! My wife also enjoys the women’s ministry, and we placed membership a few months after that first Sunday! We highly recommend Christ Church to anyone who is looking for a great place to visit, and hopefully make it their church home as well! Awesome church and pastor! I feel very welcome and will continue going. Thank you Pastor Morris and everyone at Christ Church. The best church I have attended the friendship and caring they showed to visitors makes people feel welcome the atmosphere is very happy and alive and the church  services and sermons delivered  by pastor Mott, is something that keeps a person for the whole week. Anyone who's looking for a church family this is the place to go. If you want to enjoy a wonderful Sunday at church try this one! Wonderful people, fantastic Pastor and great worship music! Check us out ! Outdoor concert was wonderful.... Pastor was very personable and friendly.  I had my 86 year old father with me and someone even brought him a bottle of cold water.  Very much appreciated. We will be checking out services soon.

name: Christ City - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ City Church has truly impacted my life in such a powerful way. Even though I’ve only been there for a couple of months, I already feel so welcomed and spiritually refreshed. From the worship to the Word, I genuinely feel the presence of the Holy Spirit every time I attend.
I’m so grateful for the leaders who serve with love, wisdom, and dedication. Thank you for creating a place where the Holy Spirit moves freely.
I am truly happy and blessed to be part of this church family 🤍✨ this is home 🏡 This ministry truly reflects the Spirit of God. From the way God’s Word is taught and displayed, to how the members are stewarded, God is evidenced at this church. I visit from time to time solely because of the distance, but if you’re looking for a Bible teaching church home, I highly recommend checking it out. I am very disappointed in this church. Two times I have been promised transportation to visit. Both times, nobody has contacted me or shown up for transport. They took my name, number, and address. Then they ghosted me. Twice! My home church, I love everything about it. The atmosphere, the people, the worship, the sermons and especially the presence of the Holy Spirit in this place. My experience at Christ City the word is authentic and bible based, which I love and appreciate. The Worship has brought me to a level of God-focus even though they do not have a full worship team yet. Peaceful atmosphere when you walk in. Grateful that they have children's ministry because I have 2 little ones myself and I can tell that they are growing Spiritually and are having fun. After service they always have a fellowship in the lobby which is great. The Pastor is kind and is willing to pray with you I love that. Also they do community outreach in west palm beach which is a plus for me i enjoy going out and serving!

name: Christ City Church - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary: My family has been attending since 2019, it’s a great community of people growing in their faith. Highly recommend. We have been attending for many years and so appreciate the tight knit community and encouragement to find freedom and rest in Jesus. My kiddos love church day and the friendships they have established. I met this church when my husband and I started dating. The pastor, Jeremy, officiated our wedding in 2021 and we have loved belonging to this faith family. I love the close knit community, humble leadership and the ways I’m challenged (not to do more) but to lean in to my need for Jesus. Everyone’s very welcoming and Jeremy (the pastor) is super nice and kind

name: Christ City Church - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
I've really loved my time at Christ City Church! As a young professional, I have found a place where it's easy to build meaningful friendships and feel genuinely known.

The preaching is rooted in Scripture and consistently points to Jesus, and the worship is amazing.

I'd definitely recommend Christ City Church to anyone looking for a church in Huntsville that's committed to the gospel and to loving people well. It's also conveniently located near UAH, MidCity, and downtown Huntsville! I am so blessed to be a part of the community at Christ City Church. Great place to hear Gospel teaching from the Bible and authentically follow Jesus alongside others! I got connected to Christ City Church and very quickly the community and environment was super welcoming and felt like family. The church has been a huge part of my walk with Christ.

They truly resembled a Christ-Centered church especially through their teaching. I love the mission they have to not only reach the city but the campuses as well! This church is full of the most kind, caring, and friendly people you will ever meet! Dropping off our daughter at UAH was such a blessing because we know she has a built in family at Christ City Church and their SALT college ministry. Christ City Church focuses on teaching the gospel. This church takes great care of its members. Love the mission, focus on all generations, and sound doctrine.

name: Christ Community Baptist Church - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary: I am charter member of C.C.B.C and the daughter of 2 loyal and loving founding members. I saw how those 66 determined Christians worked to build the church that we as the second generation must maintain and continue to grow. Come and join us and feel the love that the members still feel and share with all those who come to worship. Very nice, visited for a wedding, congrats Julie!! An awesome place to worship. Loving and welcoming congregation Has been my family church My Uncle Rev. Dr. Laurance G. Henry founded the church Did a neighborhood walk with a group and the Pastor of the church talking about HIV and passing out pamphlets

name: Christ Community Chapel - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church for about four months, and over time I saw enough to form a clear impression. They offer a lot of fun events and do a great job creating an engaging atmosphere, but the core issue is a lack of consistent gospel-centered teaching. At times it feels like the focus is on being a “cool” church rather than keeping everything centered on Jesus. Sermons typically begin with opening Scripture, but then shift into extended segments of personal stories, football references, or promotion, rather than deeper teaching of the Word.

One situation that stood out to me was when I brought a friend who expressed a sincere desire to be baptized. He clearly stated that he accepts Jesus as his Savior, believes in His death on the cross for the forgiveness of sins, and trusts in Him for eternal life. However, he was told he wasn’t ready and needed to produce more good works, which was concerning. The worship music is high quality, but the volume is excessive, I measured it at consistently over 100 decibels, which made it difficult to fully engage.
I do want to highlight one very positive aspect: the men’s pastor, Brooks. He does an excellent job taking what can feel like a surface-level message and turning it into a meaningful, Scripture-based discussion. He clearly has a genuine heart for the Lord.

Overall, my hope and prayer is that the church refocuses, repents where needed, and returns to a more Christ-centered, gospel-driven approach. Look into this church and you will find some pretty unsettling things. Google it. That Google search alone will make you NEVER want to attend this place. This "church" is all about entertainment worship, sure, but it's not Latria worship. Latria is only given in the holy apostolic Catholic church through the Eucharist and ONLY by a priest with apostolic succession through the apostles. There is no lineage or authority in these type of churches and therefore lack reverence. This church is all about feelings rather than worship. All your donation money goes to the church to make it bigger and greater, yet, not to the needy. If you want to hear all about the pastors feelings tide into the sermon and loud music this is your place. Or do you want to give God full honor through the Holy Mass? Come home to Jesus universal Catholic church that he founded. St Ignatius of Antioch (follower of apostle John said) "Where Jesus is, there is the Catholic church".  Your move. Have been going to this church for a couple years now, and I think I'm tired of the crowd, congestion, traffic of people, becoming winded from the time I get out of the car, to taking the kids downstairs, to making it back upstairs and finding a place to sit.  Thursday nights are a total joke, absolutely nowhere to sit!!!!!!!!!!!! I most definitely do not see a need to make this building bigger, are you kidding?? I came out of my house today in 95° weather to go to church...... By the time I got out of my car and into the church, put my kids downstairs, got back upstairs, found out where the gym was, because I've never been to the gym, which is where the service is temporarily, and sat down I was dripping sweat. This church is way too big and impersonal. All I am going to say is step back and think when approaching and attending this church. Are there crosses and pictures of Jesus everywhere? Or will you find images of the lead pastor promoting himself and his podcast? Do they really want to be there for you and your spiritual needs? Or do they want to dictate where you sit in the pews, tell you what service you have to attend and how much you have to give demanding a tithe commitment? Just approach with caution. This used to be a really good church but unfortunately with new lead pastors come new things and they're not always the best. The love of Christ is shown & taught in so many ways through all kinds of ministries. I recommend checking it out!

name: Christ Community Chapel - Student Center & Center for Care - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary:
They have just remodeled this building recently. It looks very nice and is welcoming and comfortable. I'm sure the students who use this building love it.

I came here for an event held by Christ Community Chapel's art ministry - Door#2. They set up a walk through stations, each using the 5 senses to weave a story and teach Truth. It was very well done, very organized, and very impactful. If they hold another event like this, make sure to go! You won't regret it. Always an uplifting, inspiration of Hope and Joy in our Lord and Savior! CCC is tought straight out of God's True Word. The staff are all so encouraging, loving and of course helpful when u have questions.  It is my home church! God Bless CCC and all members and everyone visiting.  You may be calling CCC yiur home church. Amazing facility geared toward toward the middle school crowd. Have fun, worship, fellowship, and get to know Jesus Christ. A counselor here touched my heart and drove me to tears

She told me something that will heal my life and I knew it was in truth

This is a beautiful facility with very kind people The Block is a great facility, and the middle school and high school ministry teams are wholly invested in showing students the love of Christ.

name: Christ Community Church
reviewSummary: A community-focused church in The Colony area offering modern worship and strong small group connections.

name: Christ Community Church
reviewSummary: A biblically solid community with outstanding expository preaching. Incredible youth group.

name: Christ Community Church
reviewSummary: For many years I searched for a church to call home. My search always seemed to end with failure. Today God guided me to this wonderful old church. From the minute I walked in the door I felt like I had been attending service here for years. I was made to feel welcome, to feel like a member of the church family. Many kind gentleman came up and welcomed me. The worship music was amazing but the service was even better. I felt God guided me home. I hope the members of the congregation continue to make me feel welcome. I hope to become a big part of the congregation and hope to find like minded friends. If you are looking for a church that teaches the word all while making you feel welcome. This is the place. Thank you to all. 2 years ago I visited this church with my wife. Two men at the door never greeted us though they appeared to be ushers. Communion was unusual...we received a crumbling cookie and there were no traditional Biblical words of institution. (Newcomers and seekers might think they were suddenly afforded a break in the service to share a snack!) This church has a great well known mens ministry that addresses sexual brokenness with love and strength. I will be praying for its pastor and leadership. Place to reflect on Scriptures and life applications. Real fellowship! Just learned that this church is the first settlement that roger Williams made. I literally live right near my states history An amazing church!!!! HUGE AND FULL OF ENERGY! But most of all true to Jesus 🙏

name: Christ Community Church
reviewSummary:
This church is AMAZING! The welcoming committee is next level and then the teaching of GODs Word! Wow! My family and I have truly enjoyed the teaching and actual breakdown of the current day application. Our walk with Chrtist has blossomed since we have been attending!
The community of believers is genuine, non-judgy, and truly shows the love of Jesus! I hope you are encouraged to come and see for yourself.  I pray the Holy Spirit would have you come, and if He would have you stay that would be amazing! Let us go and spread the gospel of JESUS!!!
C3 ROCKS!!!! This annex location of Wayside Chapel off i410 is a welcoming and healthy little church. I enjoy Sunday morning worship here quite a lot. Overall, I recommend to anyone looking for a church in the Stone Oak area. I was chased out of here during Christmas by the security guard. Achievement unlocked: heartless preacher. The Stone Oak Location of Wayside Chapel is continuing the long standing tradition of the original campus, extending to the community and being the hands of feet of the Lord! Pastor Will Davis leads this intimate campus in a very genuine, scripturally sound manner. If you are looking for a church to visit, please come by! Soon "Christ Community  Church"
I Love calling this church home for the past 3-4 years. Bible teaching the WORD of GOD.  Get feed Sundays from  11:AM -12:15PM.

name: Christ Community Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary:
The best church i have ever been to. Values, kindness, and True connection with the Lord. Many people have been going there for years and they're all part of a click! They treat others with disrespect they think they're all that and when you try and ask for help or understanding more about God they turned their backs on you and that's the same pretty much it's several of the churches in this community if you could even call it that. It's interesting that they even question others of what God wants them to do controlling manipulative and very unkind! They don't even take time to get to know people and they don't let them get to know them very judgemental condescending and if they really knew their Bible people's lives would truly be changed and kids wouldn't be practicing black cards and wearing stuff that is Unbecoming and not a good thing to be wearing among other things Experienced the most worshipful Easter Celebration ever today. 30-40 voice choir with a 12 piece string and brass accompaniment. The resurrection fills me with hope each day and it was so good to celebrate Jesus saving sacrifice with other believers-thank you! This church has been a blessing to our family. While I was dealing with a life threatening illness, this church (from the staff to the lay people) was there for us. They helped us raise the finances we needed for a major surgery,  they prayerfully supported us, and were there for us in so many ways. I wouldn't be here without this church community. Our church home for over 50 years. Solid in Word and truth always. Focus on Redemption in Jesus Christ. Saved by His crucifixion for those who ask to be forgiven of their sins and open their hearts for Christ to come into their life and make you a new creature. We are saved by His grace in faith.
Come and learn with good teaching and fellowship.

name: Christ Community Church - Brookside Campus
reviewSummary: We LOVE this church.   It's been such a great place for our family to grow.  Our teenagers love the youth group, we love the teaching and the community, and the church itself is beautiful.  We're so thankful that we found this church, and the community that we've built within it! My wife and I have attended Christ Community - Brookside for about 14 years now (ever since the doors opened). They have remained true to who they are and it is still our church home to this day. Pastor Bill has a gift of presenting scripture in an intellectual way while explaining historical context at the same time. He makes it relevant, convicting, & relatable at the same time. It's a gift. The church is also extremely inviting and intentional with folks visiting for the first time. If you live anywhere near by and are curious about a different church experience, Christ Community - Brookside is a great place to start! We love this church!! The atmosphere is so welcoming, the worship is wonderful, and the sermons are fantastic!!! Love going to service here!!! Beautiful campus, wonderful people, great community!! Too bad I don't live in KC or I would attend service here. Great message and wonderful, meaningful music. ❤️

name: Christ Community Church - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve read the negative reviews and felt compelled to share my experience. My family joined this church a couple of years ago after attending on and off for about a year.  My son and I were living and working in the Carmel/Westfield area and temporarily apart from our family.  The first time I walked in I was welcomed by several members and invited to the BBQ and bluegrass event the following weekend. Can’t turn down free ribs and brisket, right? We have found that this congregation is being fed a healthy dose of the gospel, the church is growing due to new people moving into the area, and babies lots of babies! The congregation is a nice mix of all generations including young families doing what the Lord commanded: be fruitful and multiply. This is the worst PCA church I have been to since 2006. The leadership here (Elders & Deacons) are absolutely pathetic. There is only one real Bible teacher here and he is OT only. The rest have no clue how to handle God's Word. These are men that have stopped following God's word, do what is right in their own eyes, fear the people especially the visitors more than God, and political correctness is their common language. At best, this is a non-denominational church. They allow anyone off the street to teach Bible study here. This church does not have ONE voice, therefore producing bad theology or watered down "I don't want to offend you" nonsense. Look elsewhere!!! Wonderful Biblical teaching and caring community!! Such a blessing! This was our first visit and we loved Christ Community Church! Great preaching, an active, friendly community, and great music. We were told most young people come to the 10:30, but the traditional service was really lovely. We’ll definitely be back! I was unimpressed. The sermons are put together with very little effort and unfortunately it shows. Most of the elders are more consumed with the perceived power they have and less concerned with helping or counseling church members. If you're looking for a real church family or some sense of community, keep looking. You won't find it here.

name: Christ Community Church - Chapel Hill Campus
reviewSummary: We just moved to North Carolina and couldn't be happier that we found this church. The very first time we attended, we were invited to dinner by two separate couples. That doesn't happen everywhere. Very cool. A group of devoted, faithful, faith filled believers. I loved being there! Our family has thrived here. This is a place where your kids will feel known and your whole family can worship.  I hope to see there.

name: Christ Community Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Praise God! If you are seeking a place to worship, praise, lift up the name of Jesus, a place to belong, this is it!  I have been blessed to be on this faith walk journey through life with these authentic, love filled, and amazing group of people for 1 year and it has helped my discipleship,  and commitment to Jesus through the Word of God and its application for everyday life. Hallelujah!! If you are broken, hurting, have hurts, habits and hangups, looking for wholeness that can only be found through Jesus Christ? Don’t take my word for it, come see! ❤️ A wonderful place to gather with others to worship God! Wonderful pastors at this church. I’m glad they accepted me into the fold and I also got married there! Great service this morning! Wonderful message! May we all remember the LOVE of Jesus Christ and that we are called (commanded) to share that love, mercy and grace to others! Not just to those we ‘agree’ with - but to all - not passing by on the other side of the road. Very welcoming staff. I do not regularly attend, but they did a beautiful job with my friends funeral. So not the best time to check out a new place. Looks like they have fun music, and their pastor seems like a wonderful guy.

Again. Unfortunate situation. Beautiful church. My wife and I attended from Oct 2014 until Dec 2019.  I still attend 2 meetings a week there although we no longer call it our church home.  Overall very good experience, solid theology, not too Evangelical or Right Wing Conservative, although there are those to be found.  Good mix, pretty open door overall.

name: Christ Community Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Christ Community Church does represent community! In Acts, we can read what biblical community looks like, and why its so critical to our walk with Christ. This isn't just "church"...its family. These are people who laugh with you, cry with you, pray with you, and are intentional with you. Praise God for a family of believers who embrace God, where sound doctrine grounded in God's Word is preached and where we still believe in potlucks. If you come on Sunday, you will be loved on! We had been searching for our home church for some time since moving to Covington and finally found CCC. It’s a wonderful Bible-based church with great pastors and a loving focus on community. They have a nursery/play room, a nursing room, Sunday school and a youth group. Come visit!! My family and I love being apart of this wonderful church.  The atmosphere of the church body is very loving and caring.  Any need you may have whether it physical, mental or spiritual is always met with Gods grace and everlasting love amongst this body.  The pastor is fantastic.  I love and appreciate the style of preaching pastor Jeff has.  You can tell he is passionate about the Word and Jesus, it shows in his sermons and daily actions. This church is like a family to me! First, I am welcomed by my friends and loved ones. Next, I worship Jesus with the worship team. Then, my Pastor teaches me new things about the bible. After, I get to hang out and talk to my church family and friends. On top of that, I get to participate in youth ministry and greeting others. I love my family and my family loves me back! I promise that you will be known and loved here! What a welcoming wonderful church home!  Jeff brings us Gospel filled messages each week!  Mark and his team lifts our hearts with worship music!  Milton always adds some humor in announcements. Christ Community Church is a perfect place to call your Church family!

name: Christ Community Church - Dalton Campus
reviewSummary:
Hidden Gems- Dalton Georgia

The small church on walnut may not look like much from the outside, but inside those walls,
hearts are healing, faith is growing, and lives are being changed. Great loud echoes of hope come from the smallest places. Maybe today, someone walks through its doors broken—and walks out believing again.

Some catch Rev. Chuck Harris on Sunday’s 9:30 and some enjoy breakfast with Ricky Townsend on Wednesday mornings at 7:30. I love the food it was wonderful great taste seasoned just right surface what's good to Beautiful building outside, but I have never been inside. These are really christ like people
They genuinely care for our community N/a

name: Christ Community Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are visibly Daytona, or new living in the area I would 💯 recommend this Church. Christ centered, deep message and good worship. You can feel
comfortable with a mature community that love God, take care of a sound doctrine, have good youth and children pastoral care. I love it!. And meanwhile we are in the area we decided to attend this community. My friends invented us here this place is very heavenly and welcoming and great snacks beautiful music too so heavenly I couldn't help but to fall asleep time to time 😁😂🥰 especially after school also great lectures and prayers I felt very blessed to join Bible teaching without compromise. Friendly staff & multi cultural intergenerational congregation. I went to visit and loved it. Such a great worship service, sermons were God centered and Bible center so it was impactful the 3 Sundays I was there. Child care was amazing, both my little ones loved it. The people at church were all really welcoming. I'm just sad I don't live in the area, otherwise this church would have become my church. God bless you all! The best  Pastor and staff you could ever hope to have.  Worship services are worshipful, challenging, and educational.  The facility is first class.  The members are wonderful.  If I were a better writer I would say much more.

name: Christ Community Church - Denton Campus
reviewSummary:
Was referred to this church from my southern Baptist pastor in east Texas. I was having a hard time finding a church where I wasn't judged immediately or listening to the preacher talk about stuff not even in the Bible. This church has been way different and the pastor man digs into the Bible. I haven't left one Sunday without gaining new insight and wisdom. If your like me and don't like large groups of people and wanna really learn the word of God this is the spot. Hope to see yah there sometime... Godspeed The most welcoming and wholesome church I’ve experienced. The community here truly makes you feel accepted and at home from the moment you walk in.
JT shares God’s word with a depth and clarity that I’ve been searching for, and it’s made a real impact on my faith. I’m incredibly grateful for C3 and everything it offers. Loving church family with biblical soundness, great teaching, and deeply engaged community. Kids program is wonderful, my 3-year-old loves going, and I enjoy that they don’t dismiss kids until after worship.

name: Christ Community Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Franklin TN Christ Community Church is the location for the Franklin Cars and Coffee Car Meet.
Wonderful Classic and new muscle cars plus the Mazda Miata club shows up plus a few JDM cars like my Toyota GR86, two Datsun 240Z and a Kei Van. Fun time. They meet every Saturday morning 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM. They are host to some amazing meetings full of amazing Godly men who are more than willing to disciple you. Great people, worship and preaching.  If you are looking for a gospel saturated church with both worship and mission go here! We are new to the area and visited several churches before deciding to join Christ Community. The kids program is great, there's something for the whole family on Wednesday nights, the music is contemporary and deep, the preaching spot-on, and the church was particularly warm and welcoming. They are committed to preaching the world and reaching out to their community in practical and loving ways. I have also heard many people in the area who don't go here themselves say good things about the church. We landed here looking for a preschool for our kids.  And the preschool is top notch.  We wish it went all the way to high school.  We visited the church just to make sure it was on track with our beliefs.  Now we’ve been here 3 years!  Everyone is welcoming, and there’s no pressure to be someone you are not.  I love walking the halls and seeing my kids engaged with every generation.  Their teachers past and present offer high fives and ask them questions about their lives.  The people here truly care and want to make a difference in the lives of others.  It’s also a place where you can be nurtured and and encouraged to use your spiritual gifts to serve.   It’s sound reformed theology meets engaging community.

name: Christ Community Church - Laguna Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Biblical Christian Church Best balance I’ve seen with solid truth, taught and practiced with love by gracious members.  Teaching is meaty and applicable.

Highly rated preschool during the week.

I’ve been attending for about 2 years now and my family and I love it. Great for all ages.

People who are just looking to check the box on Sunday’s every once and a while may even find that being part of an authentic Church family is quite a bit more rewarding than attending a event from time to time.

Please do keep in mind, no church is perfect; if you happen to find one it won’t be anymore after you (or I)  join 😊 For clarification of the churches response to my review, in Matthew 18, the Bible guides protocols for addressing concerns within a church. The first step is to address the issue privately with an individual involved, so I brought my concern regarding teaching yoga to a leader of the Women’s Ministry. Then I addressed the head of this ministry (now having two witnesses regarding this matter of concern). She informed me that the elders were consulted regarding the teaching of yoga during the Women’s Retreat and that all elders have vetted this practice.
Next I emailed the Senior Pastor twice who responded “While I certainly agree with your general theological position I don’t share your particular concern regarding Yoga class… we have vast freedoms in Christ.”
Since there is no indication on your website that teaching yoga has been approved by the Senior Pastor and elders, based on Deuteronomy 12:30–31 I felt compelled to alert those who want to honor these verses and not attend a church that integrates or mixes with other “religious” practices. I wrote the review to bring awareness for those who have discernment and try to honor all of God’s Holy Word. A pastor's primary biblical duty is to serve as an "overseer" or "shepherd" who guards the church against outside spiritual influences and no where is this information available on your website. I was also informed that I was not the only one who had brought this concern to the church elders.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
Caution, for those who understand the warnings of God's Word regarding NOT incorporating other religious practices into a Christ-based church please be aware that this church has vetted the practice of yoga into their women's retreats.
After bringing up my concerns, I was informed that the elders and pastors have approved of teaching yoga yet they will change the name from "yoga class" to "stretch class" because others have brought up the same concern. Changing the title does not change the truth of the eastern religious origin of yoga (so-called modern yoga still has its origin in eastern mysticism and Hindu "deities").
Isn't it wise to not risk incorporating controversial teachings into a supposedly Bible-based church? God's Word warns against even the appearance of associating with practices that honor other spiritual beliefs.
Romans 12:1-2, "Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living, sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God - this is your true and proper worship. Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is - His good, pleasing and perfect will." We’ve been attending CCCLH since July 2024. We love it! The sermons are solid Bible teaching including relevant historical and philosophical perspectives. The building facility is clean and functional with tons of space for all activities, the adult Sunday classes are top notch, our children enjoy their classes and the worship music is so good you worry they’ll leave and sign a record deal! Tons of opportunities to serve and ways to minister (or be ministered to). They also occasionally offer classes for topics such as Biblical Counseling and Parenting. Defiantly recommend this amazing community  to all of my believer friends.  It is a blessing to be a member of this church. I joined the community almost a year ago, and everyone has been super loving and welcoming. It has an awesome positive energy that makes you want t come back again. I am so great full and thankful  that I have the opportunity to hear the true word. Also, I would love to invite everyone to check out our website. We have all kinds of sources to educate our members in every aspects of our Jesus Christ. Such a beautiful picture of a healthy church. The preaching is biblically and theologically solid, and is entertaining and life-giving. The people are kind and welcoming, always willing to engage with you– even if you’re a new face. The music is a harmonious blend of both contemporary music and hymns. There’s a wide range of ages from the elderly to young adults. There are many church events and ministries to serve in and outreach is a growing heart in the church.

If you’re looking for a place to learn about what a healthy church looks like, or if you want to join a solid community, I highly recommend visiting Christ Community.

name: Christ Community Church - Leawood Campus
reviewSummary:
Returning to Kansas City after years away we sought God’s leading to a church home. He graciously led us to Christ Community Leawood where we have been loved, taught with excellence and helped to become more like Jesus. I love the balance of ages and stages of life of the congregants. The worship is excellent and the preaching and teaching is of highest quality. Meaningful friendships have formed and we have found it easy to connect with others. We are so thankful for Christ Community Church! I am so glad for this warm and welcoming place of learning and worship. We congregants at Christ Community Leawood are strong community givers led by a most loving and generous God!
We yearn to live in a way that being a church for Monday’ is more important than going to church and searching Scriptures merely for ourselves.
How do we live? We live as if Jesus Christ literally laid down His life for us to pay the penalty for our sins, which He did! We are a church gathered to be the church scattered every day, everywhere.
Come join us. We have many events on the web so you can easily get to know us. I play pickleball indoors most Monday & Thursday nights 5:30-8:00 PM! Check the website! I am so glad I found Christ Community Church - Leawood. My family has found a solid community here and we are very thankful for the children's ministries. The community is full of life, authentic and growing. My wife & I feel very connected and we feel comfortable leaning into our church community here. What's unique here is that the church staff is very engaging with the congregants. They are an excellent team, and they really care about spiritual growth and engagement of the congregants.

If you are looking for a church in the Kansas City area, I would highly recommend checking out the 9am or 10:30 service here as well as meet one of the staff members when you visit. I have attended Christ Community for over 30 years. Truth. It is carefully and prayerfully honored and taught. I've always been able to trust that. The sermon teachings are thoughtful, well-researched, and relevant.  Excellent women and children’s programming and it’s easy to become involved. Highly recommend visiting.

name: Christ Community Church - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary:
Not Living by What They Preach.

It’s heartbreaking to see people from a church — a place that should represent compassion and kindness — repeatedly throwing away and even stealing food meant for the community cats. It happened yet again today 11/02/2025 on Holy Sunday: two small containers of dry food and one container of water were thrown out before the cats could even reach them. Thankfully, we have multiple volunteers and check daily and spotted it right away.

Later that evening, one volunteer returned to leave a bowl of water and a small amount of food, only for two men from the church — wearing green t-shirts — to rush toward the feeding area as soon as she was leaving. A woman in a red dress was also seen nearby, waving her hands pointing her finger and expressing visible anger toward the volunteers for simply leaving a clean water and small amount of dry food near the wall behind the tree. This is unacceptable behavior, especially in front of church members’ children who were playing on the nearby basketball court and witnessed the entire scene. (around 5:30PM)

This isn’t an isolated event — it’s an ongoing pattern. We’ve spoken to the pastor before. Volunteers refill the feeding stations, only to find the containers taken again and again. The pastor and his wife even promised to replace the two water containers that had been previously thrown away, but that promise was never kept.

It’s disheartening to see people who claim to serve God act without honesty or compassion. They are not living by what they preach.

These cats are part of the registered colony that is being managed by Trap-Neuter-Return (TNR) program — they’re fixed, vaccinated, monitored, and responsibly fed. The program is fully supported by our county and helps prevent more kittens from being born. Volunteers use their own time and money to keep these cats healthy and the area clean.

Instead of respecting that effort, some individuals have chosen to show cruelty by interfering with their care. It’s deeply disappointing to see this behavior coming from these brand new tenants a church community.

Kindness costs nothing — if you can’t help, please at least don’t destroy the work of those who are trying to make a positive difference. Please be kind to our community cats. 🙏

As Scripture reminds us, “God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds… and God saw that it was good” (Genesis 1:25). All living creatures are part of His creation, and every life — big or small — matters in His eyes.

“Whoever is kind to the needy honors God.” — Proverbs 14:31

“Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to act.” — Proverbs 3:27 This Church family has blessed my husband and I! Awesome Bible teaching church that offers various Bible Study groups through the week, children’s programs and Sunday school. Sundays include wonderful worship music and Bible teaching straight from the Bible! Come join us at our new location and check out our new facility that has room for everyone! A wonderful church with such a welcoming and loving community. The preaching is firmly rooted in the Bible and shared with clarity and truth. I’m so grateful to be part of this church and can’t wait to celebrate my wedding here! Christ Community Church as been my church for the past 5 years. Pastor Darell is a wonderful pastor who reads write out of God's word not changing a single thing.The service starts at 10 am on Sunday mornings and coffee and doughnuts are provided! This church is not just for the elderly... But rather anyone, young or old who wants to come worship the our Lord Jesus!!!!!

This is good to see in a congregation. God bless you! Great church and awesome sermons!  The only "negative" is that I wish there were more time options for Bible study and small groups, but then again, maybe I'm just too busy.  :)

We love Christ Community Church in Frisco! Kind-hearted people, beautiful worship and faithful teaching and instruction from the pulpit.
We are very thankful that the Lord directed our family to join this church. Abundantly blessed! Love this church.  They are truly men and women of God. Great church. Great community. 10/10 would go again. A great place for community and hearing gospel. I love it here.

name: Christ Community Church C3 - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church with a very welcoming vibe. I loved their worship as well as the preaching. Involvement opportunity exist to really become friends with these people which I think is important for a church to have. I highly recommend 👍 Amazing church and people with humility and hearts that lead people to faith through grace and redemption Excellent church. The group of elders actively seeks to center the church around Christ. The staff working there is amazing. But above all else: Christ is preached, His Gospel, and His Kingdom. It holds sound doctrine, adheres to reformed theology, and promotes that Christians live in active fellowship with other believers throughout the week. It's the church we now call: our church. I love this church so much. Pastor David’s preaching is firmly grounded in the Word and also engaging and skillfully presented. There are so many great ways to get involved (especially community groups!) and the counseling ministry is a fantastic resource for members and nonmembers alike. If you’re looking for a church in the Houston area, for sure try this one. Let me first disclaim that no church is perfect and while C3 certainly fits that bill, C3 is also home to people who desire to live out their lives spent for Christ. It's a community that I can truly call home and most importantly, come and worship the one, true, living God.

This is a home where Jesus is praised, scripture is honored, friendships are real, and the church is vital. Christ is alive in this church and I would love to encourage you in coming out and paying a visit! Also, if you're new, please look for me because I'd love to welcome you personally to the wonderful community we have here at Christ Community Church!

Cheers!

Amazing Church you go there and you're so welcome it doesn't matter who you are or what race you are what your background you are treated like a person and they're so kind and the service is so awesome the preacher is so awesome he wears a tattoo how awesome is that been at the service get paid every week to really great time I love it and I will be back Went to here Andrew sandlin

name: Christ Congregational Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
A loving and inclusive Opening and Affirming (ONA) (an equivalent to Reconciling Ministries) congregation - "Affirming that all persons are created in the image of God, we honor and celebrate people of all races, cultures, ages, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. " I grew up attending this church. I highly recommend it if you are looking for a non-judgmental, inclusive place to worship. The congregation values music highly, they have a good choit that sings most Sundays, with organ. They also have an orchestra that plays around Christmas and Easter. The church owns a Retreat Center in West Virginia where generations of kids have attended camp and adults have bonded together. Sold building and looking for new home.

Liberal Christian Church, open and affirming. Great congregation that cares about each other and the world. Good Sunday School for kids, and good music for your soul. An all inclusive church that focuses on good works and loving their neighbors. You will feel welcome and at home here.

name: Christ Cornerstone - Chino Hills Campus
Christ Covenant - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Walking into Christ Covenant over a year ago was a breath of fresh air after a previous, horrible church experience where I almost walked away from the church completely! BUT GOD! He is so good & kind… and allowed me to find Christ Covenant, that lives out what they preach and has restored my faith that genuine, godly people exist 🙏🏼🙌🏼  I have so enjoyed the honesty, integrity, solid preaching, great community, biblical standards that are upheld, intentionality, accountability, potlucks, how they serve the city in so many different ways and more! The women’s gospel fellowship is such a sweet time of vulnerability, learning the Bible together, praying for each other & sharing God’s goodness with one another. The Tuesday Young Adults group has been a huge blessing and I love the time of worship, hearing messages from Thomas, as well as getting together w/friends before it! I love my small community group and how the people at Christ Covenant see your need right where you’re at and help you take the next best step for what you need! When the body of Christ is led by the Holy Spirit and they do what He is leading them to do, it is something beyond beautiful! Wherever you’re at in life, whatever you have been through and however old you are, there’s something for you at Christ Covenant and they’re more than happy to get you connected and help you grow closer in your relationship with the Lord OR introduce you to Him! I’m so grateful for them 🙏🏼🥹 I visited this church hoping for a genuine spiritual experience, but personally it didn’t connect with me. Some of the messaging felt closely tied to social and political viewpoints, and at times the approach toward newcomers felt a bit intrusive, with personal questions being asked early on, especially if you’re considering getting more involved as a member.

In my opinion, the environment came across as very organized and business like, with a strong emphasis on presentation and growth. I also didn’t feel the warm sense of community I was hoping for, and several interactions came across a bit distant, which seemed similar to what a few other visitors have mentioned in their reviews.

I left feeling more pressured than encouraged. Everyone has different preferences in a church setting, but if you’re looking for a more down to earth and faith centered atmosphere with a genuinely welcoming feel, I would recommend exploring a few other options to find the right fit for your spiritual journey. Word-rooted church with methodical teaching centered on Christ Few months before I left Athens after Grad school, I asked the church I attended for recommendations and Christ Covenant came up more than once. Also, I knew a very good friend, Jeremy Brooks who was a part of the church. I’m really glad I followed their recommendations because my family and I were able to find a Christ-centered community with so little hassle considering that we were moving from a college town to a city.

I’m impressed by the drive, creativity and singleminded approach the church has adopted to see their members like me know the gospel and actively live it out in my community. Really glad to be a part of the body and their vision for the gospel in the city of Atlanta. Here’s the thing with this church: it’s not welcoming. And what I mean by that is simple. First, I had to open the door to enter it on Sunday. Second, no one greeted me or shook my hand when I walked in. Third, at no point at the beginning of the service did we stop to take a moment to greet those directly near us.

It is a church and I know younger people are gravitating towards this church. Also, like younger people, they seem even worse at talking to total strangers.

name: Christ Covenant Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: This is a Christ-centered, Bible-believing church. You are ALWAYS welcomed at this church. Your kids will enjoy the youth programs here. There is Sunday school for both adults and children.  If you sing or play an instrument, your gifts of music are valued and appreciated. Seniors can enjoy meeting together for a monthly program and lunch. CCC has TWO wonderful, caring pastors who provide helpful, faith-building sermons. You will find friends here; you will have opportunities to share with others in the greater community, where there is much need. I am very glad to be a member of this church! Church and members are very welcoming. I brought my client with me and they made him very welcomed. My second mom goes to the church. Haven’t been in a bit do to health but I’m definitely planning to come for the Thanksgiving and Christmas season. Be blessed. This is my home church by way of my wife. All ages welcomed, sermons are intellectually stimulating, there are 2 services, kid's room, messages are uploaded to youtube shortly after sermons, adherence to local guidelines to respect the health & welfare of others. ECC is my family. I feel the love of the congregation and of the Lord every time I'm there. I particularly love the sermons that are right out of scripture. I thought churches were supposed to welcome you. Everyone there was looking down their nose at me. Like I was a heathen or something

name: Christ Covenant Church - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary:
I had the pleasure of attending their annual Faithful Conference. I came all the way from Malaysia to visit the seminary nearby and thought of dropping by. I am a pastor from Christ Evangelical Reformed Church and one of our apprentices is studying at Reformed Theological Seminary. It’s wonderful to meet like-minded believers here in the US.

Folks were friendly and introduced themselves to me. Spent time with many of them over a week. There are good people here. If you’re looking for a church that is serious about the truth, Christ and His gospel, come here. By God's grace, I moved from Kyiv to a small town where I preached to communists, atheists, and ordinary people on the street; strangely enough, it was Christians from other churches who rose up against me the most. Yet God performed a miracle among people who had never attended church before, and He established a congregation there; I served as its pastor for 26 years. However, due to the war, my daughter nearly lost her life, so I brought her to Spartanburg for medical treatment, and that is where we are now. I have never been to this church, but seeing both positive and negative comments about it made me wonder if I should visit; after all, people—specifically religious people—did not always speak well of Christ or His disciples. The devil, you see, does not like churches where God is sincerely worshipped and people are truly served. Expositional preaching. Solid music. Organized leadership. Warm people. Great small groups. I had to give this 4 stars since Reformed dogmas influence a lot thinking. I know every church has tradition; but the PCA has some controversial issues; where tradition is relied on a little too heavy. Many other things are very good at this church. Every time I drive by this church, I get cut off by people rushing there. Yesterday, I had an old guy almost run me off the road so he could turn in. I had my son in the car, and this isn’t the first time. Another time, I went to pick up my mom, and two old people in a golf cart came speeding up telling me they “know what I’m doing,” all with some nasty expletives. This is the least Christian church I have ever had the dishonor of going to. The people only think of themselves, and have no empathy. If these are the lessons the church teaches, I’d recommend steering clear if you want to make it to the Kingdom of Heaven.

Great church in Sandy Springs with Gospel-centered preaching and a strong focus on relational discipleship

name: Christ Culture Church - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary: Attended many different churches, religions & I have never felt more welcomed & received than that when I began to attend Christ Culture Church. I've attended CCC for about a year now & have enjoyed & grown heaps & bounds. It's biblical based & driven services are led by Pastor King & are wonderfully informative & spiritually thought provoking. The worship is interactive & spirit led. Classes to further your biblical knowledge & literacy are also available here. "A church alive, is worth the drive" as Pastor King says. Come on out & learn how to Belong, Believe & Become all that God has planned for you. Absolutely love my church family. From the day we 1st walked through the doors, they made us feel like family and showed us the love of Christ. Our spirits feel like home here.  Thank you Pastor King and church family. Best Church Ever!!!! we have been with Christ culture for quite a few years now and we absolutely love everybody there! I love how Pastor King explains the scripture! We have been to other churches, but by far that has been the best one! When you step in to Christ culture, you’re definitely automatically family! I’ve been attending CCC for about 2 months now. I like that Pastor King allows time for the Holy Spirit to move. So many churches are restricted because they have services back to back. In my opinion, that may influence their decision to following the Holy Spirit’s lead during service. I also like that when led, he will give a prophetic word. I am adapting to his preaching style. It takes time to adapt when you are in a new church. I am currently trying to figure out what church I should be attending. For now, I will stay put, watch and listen for the transformation of CCC. This church has been life changing!  From the genuine people who greet us to the amazing praise and worship to the great messages that are Biblical and always on time.  I highly recommend a visit!

name: Christ Culture Church Louisville - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have not been to church in a little over a year… I have had some rough experiences with churches and thought I was not going to go back to one. I heard about Christ Culture on social media and decided to give it a try. I went to the 9 am service and absolutely loved it. everyone was so sweet and friendly. I felt very welcomed! The worship band was amazing as well as the word given by pastor brandon! I plan on going back every week that I can and to hopefully get involved in the future! 10/10 recommend giving it a try if you are looking for a church, feel as if you cannot find your place or just curious to see what Christ Culture is all about! Thank you Jesus for sending me to the right place at the right time ❤️ I had an awesome experience, the word of God was rich, and it was refreshing to my soul, the pastor taught on who is the Holy Spirit? and what is the role of the Holy Spirit, his teaching was with power and the Holy Spirit was presence. I highly recommend this chuch ~ the location of this church is 10/10. The worship music and worship team lead an incredible introduction into the service. It was extremely welcoming from the people serving within the church greeting everyone as if they truly wanted to welcome them. The turnout of the launch was incredible and to be a part of the launch day service was something I'm glad I didn't miss. This is the church that I would be proud to go to in Louisville and to take people as the message was touching and so were the people. I really love the engagement and the social 360. I'm looking forward to seeing what this community offers to the community and all the upcoming ways to serve. I know off top they have mentioned needing more individuals to step up and the childcare department so that way the capacity could increase.Excited for the love and glory of God to be revealed and spread through the city! I visited for the first time today and I enjoyed it. I love that the community makes room for the Holy Spirit in their gatherings. The Bible teachings are powerful, anointed, and practical. If you are visiting or living in Louisville, I recommend that you visit. This is the place to be. If you’re ready to get a real word, a real message and have real change in your life - this is the place. Each weekend Pastor BG blows my mind, bringing the Word to life and changing* lives! Forever thankful. So happy to have found this church and the family within it.

Each person I’ve met here has been incredibly authentic and I love that C3 is transforming people to transform culture!!! This is the real deal 🙌🏽❤️‍🔥

name: Christ Culture Church Louisville - Main Campus
Christ Embassy Church. San Antonio - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary: Christ Embassy is a home to Christians and we all share a testimony! We welcome everybody that is willing to come. We do everything from the love God had given to us. It is an amazing church home if your interested or searching for a church home. I'm slowly growing as a Christian. I don't believe in speaking in tongues and unfortunately this Church speaks in tongues. They did feed me and pray for us. They give us (visitors) gifts. I continue to be reluctant trusting any of Christian Churches these (beginning) end of days. Everyone thinks that their brand of Christianity is correct before God. Of course no one is perfect in this life. The human heart and the human brain each have their own memories. Every knee will bow and every tongue will confess that Jesus Christ is Lord. The Holy Spirit is our Comfort and our conscious. God is our Creator and our judge. Proper discernment and living for God/the Holy Trinity and loving God is worth it. It is a very wonderful and lovely place to worship, And everyone is very welcoming, and the word of God being preached in this church is amazing. The pastor delivers powerful, relatable sermons that resonate deeply, and the worship music is uplifting and inspiring. I highly recommend that you visit the church. Christ Embassy Church is like no other. It's where you relearn the Word of God. I say relearn because a lot of what I thought I understood, I didn't. For instance, God didn't test Job and He didn't make him sick.  What good Father wants his children to suffer? And God didn't want me sick, so I received my healing the first day I visited Christ Embassy Church. Hallelujah!! You can feel the love of God and the presence of the Holy Spirit. I love the acclamations and declarations of health and blessings for my life; something I'd never done before.  I was amazed and in tears as I saw the blind see, the lame walk, the deaf hear, demons cast out and people's lives restored; just like Jesus did. This Word, the Word of God works and this ministry has proved it. Glory to God. I'm home! My life has changed for the better. Im living greater by the day and better by night. This ministry teaches you The Word, and that Word is the almighty God. Come in and worship with us as a family.

name: Christ Episcopal Church - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up at Christ Church, moved away 40 some years ago and never really found a church I was happy with. My parents and grandparents are all interred in their columbarium. They are very inclusive and I’m quite impressed with their clever ideas for cost-cutting. They still do a fair amount of public outreach, which I view as an extremely important function of a church. All of the people who work there are nice. The service & staff were most gracious. I went for a good friend's mother's funeral. I would recommend my friends & relative  attend this church. Welcoming, friendly and diverse congregation. Great music, and children's Sunday school program. The church graciously allows our Scout troop to meet in its basement and has done so for over 60 years. Historic chuch that Dr. Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. once spoke at this very location.

name: Christ Episcopal Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Join us. Christ Church is a spiritual home to many, all are welcome. Our mission: "Love God. Care for Each Other. Serve the World." reviewSummary: Local here.  I’ll tell you my experience. The sermon is more about delivering you to the voting booth, than it is to heaven.  Personally, I go to church, seeking spiritual energization. This is not the place.  If the flag on the front of the church wasn’t already telling you, this is a closed minded place. reviewSummary: Beautiful Church!  Great congregation! Very welcoming.  Services a bit long but very well done in content Love this place. My childrren attended school here. I'm so glad to be a member of Christ Family Church. Moving from NJ was an easier transition due to the love and welcoming feeling at CFC. From the first Sunday we visited, we knew we were home!
