Additionally, Christ Family Church are active members of the community through testifying of our Righteous Father love, faithfulness, and goodness towards man through the blood of his Holy Lamb. Shalom I love the Bible-based service and the members of this church are kind and welcoming.

name: Christ Fellowship - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary: Presence of God is manifested there each weekend. It is a small place that has intimacy in worship and you can get to know everyone. If you are looking for a small God-filled church - Christ Fellowship is for you. Friendly people.  Pastor Jon delivers God's Word just as it should be given.  Praise & Worship is awesome.  Come join us every  Sunday at 11 AM If you really want to experience  God's love. This is a place full of it. No members , everyone is family in God's Kingdom !!! Incredibly welcoming!  Excellent service.  Small and personable which is what we we’re looking for.  Cool, cozy atmosphere.  Love it! Honest, true, heartfelt worship. Relavent, powerful, life changing teaching every Sunday.

name: Christ Fellowship - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary:
You aren't welcome in this church if you oppose genocide. Contrary to what they claim on their website, it appears they care more about your political views than about your relationship with Jesus Christ.
=============
OK, this is my response to the below response from the church:

First, I wasn't "asked" to leave. I was ordered to leave on threat of the involvement of law enforcement and a charge of criminal trespass.

Second, if my "intentions" were "clear," what were they? Your head of the "security mission," too, made the same accusation that I was "going to do something." When I asked what he was talking about, he refused to say. (Actually, almost every word the man uttered was an outright lie. Shameful.)

In truth, the objection was to the anti-genocide mural on the side of my RV.

But I took video and posted them at my Substack, called Odysseus Unsheathed, and people can make up their own minds what Christ Fellowship opposes or supports. Love this church! Pastor Aaron is solid in his teaching. Also there are many activities to get involved in to help others and get discipled. Great time tonight with #goodshotjudy McKinney Community Concerts has outdone themselves with this amazing group of musicians!  Tickets still available for the rest of the season. Christ Fellowship is a lovely place to worship and praise God. If you're a young adult in the North Dallas area I highly recommend for you to come to CF on a Tuesday and visit Elevate YA. Amazing people and great sermons Great family  Environment everyone loves and care for each other gods word are great come and feel like family no Judging come as you are all are welcome

name: Christ Fellowship Baptist Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: I am visiting in Mobile for about a month.  So glad to know this church is open for worship!  It doesn't appear that this pandemic has slowed this congregation down at all.  They were friendly, even through facemasks and social distancing, the music was worshipful and the sermon was expository and excellent!  Seems to be a truly healthy church, from the outside looking in.  Being back in church, even as a visitor,  after so many months of not being able to attend in person, was wonderful and healing.  Glory to our God!! We visited Mobile for two months and searched out a Bible teaching church, which I must admit, is very difficult to find anywhere in the country. This pastor was a graduate of Master's Seminary in California, which John McArthur, a dedicated pastor of over 50 years started. Once I learned that, I knew we had found a church for our stay. We were not disappointed. From the moment we walked into the church, we felt welcome. No "entertainment,"  just God-honoring music and "open your Bible" verse-by-verse teaching. The congregation was wonderful and reached out to welcome us. Week after week we left the church hungering for more! Now we are back in Florida, and we really miss the teaching we received at this lovely church. The pastor is from South Africa and has a lovely family, and boy, can he preach and teach the Word of God. If you chose to visit this loving church, you will want to return again and again. No fluff in this church! Wonderful preaching & teaching! God’s word is held in the highest regard while practical application is supplied with every sermon. I don't like the fact that they use the ASV Bible. Other than that seem to be nice people. Refreshing to visit this church (coming from IFB)!  Enjoyed very much!

name: Christ Fellowship Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Have attended several times over the years from out of town while visiting our daughter’s family. Have been always been warmly welcomed and deeply blessed by the fellowship. The excellent exposition of the Scriptures has been consistently Christ exalting and God honoring and we’ve enjoyed hearing from many different pastors during those several visits. Just as importantly, they’ve ministered to our daughter, son-in-law, and grandchildren with heart moving love and tenderness. If we ever relocated to the Birmingham area, there’s no question where we’d want to be co-joined to the Great Commission adventure. Could not recommend it any more enthusiastically. This is the first time I attended any Bible study CFC offered. I was looking for Christian fellowship and was granted the privelege of participating in one of their Wednesday evening "Growth Groups." Visitors may be permitted to attend these groups by invitation, but these meetings are normally reserved for members only. Sunday formal worship is open to everyone. The meeting was held at their church building. The building is a former Salvation Army store/facility which they are currently renovating and it is beautiful. I was told these groups were normally held in various homes and cover different topics. The one I attended carefully reviewed the Pastor's message which had been preached the previous Lord's Day (chapter in Acts). The Elder who presided over the meeting was very knowledgeable. He reflected a heart and mind concerned with reflecting the priorities of our Lord and Savior Jesus. The attendees were warm and friendly.
The meeting was a blessing.
Romans 11:36 Not impressed. The pastor wears the same pair of ratty old jeans every week. Enjoyed listening this morning, great worship and teaching Appreciate the welcome greeters and the friendly people 🙂

name: Christ Fellowship Church - Downtown - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love my church. I’ve been attending since 2011. Pastor Rick Blackwood and his team were transformational for me. The new team of Pastor Omar, Carlos, Gideon, Tucker and others are filling those giant shoes nicely. I’ve grown so much of the years and I’m so grateful that I found this place. Not sure what rating to give this church. Attended for the first time this past Sunday, and while the message was honest and to my knowledge Biblically sound, I was slightly concerned at the lack of prayer. When the only prayer is the call to salvation and a flashy blessing at the end but there is no constant and humble communication throughout the service thanking God and reflecting all glory back to Him — I wonder, is the church and the worship team receiving the glory?  You are merely a vessel and should act more like one. This is my personal experience.
🚩1.Your not greeted when you enter, your immediately asked for your bag. To check for drugs or weapons
🚩2.There is no “physical” pastor, it’s a live visual electronically on a screen.
🚩3. Within a minute of me sitting down, a man came right in front of me and took a few picture’s. no there was not a single person sitting behind me all the way back. So that was very strange to me.
Again this is just my personal experience. It felt weird the moment I entered and it seems more like a rehearsal, versus an actual church. I’m not aware of the show that was being put on, but it definitely rubbed me the wrong way. The atmosphere didn’t feel very welcoming and I think there should be a disclaimer everywhere for any church.If there is not a physical pastor in it. When I go to church, I’m going there for the word of God. I want to be in Gods presence and physically hear from the preacher. The preacher is going to not only speak the word but feed off of the other energy and spirits in the place. Giving the word or the message that we may personally all need. So I did not stay long.
God bless anyone who does go to this church, it just wasn’t for me. Have a blessed day Absolutely an amazing church.   It’s Bible based  it’s a very kind loving environment.   We were here visiting.   The worship was top notch.   I suppose the only thing I didn’t like would be the fact that the senior pastor was preaching from the main church so he was on the screen but honestly it was just fine the msg was spot on.       If we lived in Miami this would be our home church.   The set up is perfect.  The safety team was fantastic.   I’m sure they don’t call them that but they were great The most amazing church! We have been coming here for about 13 years and are so happy this branch reopened. The staff, pastors and volunteers are second to none. Im grateful to be plugged in as a volunteer and that all members are encouraged to help be the hands and feet of Christ here. I can attest that the children's ministry and small groups are life-giving. My family and I have been blessed by this church and are so grateful for Pastor Gideon and all the wonderful members. If you are looking for a great church that focuses on God's word and living it out with your family, this is the church for you!

name: Christ Fellowship Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary: After trying many, many churches. We decided to make Christ Fellowship Church our home. We have loved their biblical teaching that goes through an entire book of the Bible and a time and is always centered on Jesus. There are so many ways to get involved and meet some great people. And the kids ministry is top notch, I know every week my kids are well cared for. I have been a member of the church since the founding and have nothing but great things to say.  The church is led by a young, very personable pastor named Justin Ely who relates to the congregation extremely well.  I would highly recommend attending if you are new to the area or are looking for a change of pace! Love this church family! The people are warm and inviting. They truly care about me and what's going on in my life. The worship service is Christ centered and biblically sound. I'm excited to worship and grow with this family! I have had a great experience as a member of this community of Christians. They are very intentional about serving the community and sharing the gospel. This is a great church to visit if you are interested in learning more about Christianity. CFC feels so much like home as a smaller church with its Biblical teachings each week from the pastors. It’s a great church for raising a family in as well. Grateful to be part of it!

name: Christ Fellowship Church in Boca Raton, FL - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary: What a wonderful church! We'd been attending the main campus at Palm Beach Gardens for several months before trying out the Boca Campus and finding this church family so close to home has been a huge value add to our lives. From our very first Sunday we felt warmly welcomed and genuinely included. The people are so friendly and the campus staff team are top notch! So grateful to have checked them out and now we have a new church home. If you're looking for a church in the area, I'm certain you won't be disappointed with Christ Fellowship Boca. Christ fellowship church has great people music and prayer. From the moment you enter their service you are welcomed and included. Kids and adults love it and we will continue to return. Feels so great to be there every Sunday Today was my first Sunday attending Christ fellowship at the Boca Raton location.  Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. I loved the look and feel of the actual church and the live worship music was great. I currently attend another Christian church and wanted to try this one out. I do have a few “cons” if you will. There were no Bibles to be seen. The actual sermon was not a live human preaching in the church. It was on a TV screen where they showed a recording of a service from their main church in Palm Beach Gardens. They said it was live, but was clearly recorded and shown at each service time. They also did not do communion. When I go to a church I really want to see the message in person live with a pastor that’s right there. Other than that it seems like a lovely place. Absolutely amazing up and coming church in the area! All Christ Fellowship locations are awesome but definitely must check this one out. I can not recommend it enough! Everyone is so welcoming/friendly and there are ways for everyone to get connected regardless of their age or stage in their spiritual journey. If you haven’t been you’re 100% missing out. Christ Fellowship makes you feel part of a family with lots of love since you first step in. The joy of seeing so many new people each week thirsty for the word of God. The children excited just to be there not only on Sunday, but on Wednesday night for the youth. We love our Pastor and the his lovely wife that is ready to serve you. The classes are so well taught to help you grow more in your walk with Jesus. Love serving there and can see the work of the Lord growing.

name: Christ Fellowship Church Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
A Truly Welcoming Experience — A New Home in Faith.

I recently visited this church for the first time, and it was hands down the most welcoming experience I’ve had in from a church in Tampa. From the moment I stepped in, I felt embraced by a sense of warmth, kindness, and genuine community.

Everyone I met was inviting and sincere, and it didn’t feel like I was walking into a new place — it felt like I was coming home. There was a true sense of family here, and I could feel the presence of God in the way people treated one another. This is exactly the kind of community I’ve been praying for.

As Romans 15:7 says, “Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.” This church lives that out beautifully. I’m thankful to have found this fellowship and look forward to calling it my new home as I continue growing in faith and walking with others in their paths with the Lord.

God is good, all the time! Awesome Church. I go there and I love it. It's not like a family.  They make you feel like real family.  I've met so many people here I connect with outside of church, who check in, who work with me, who hang out outside. I was invited by someone and so happy that I came. Everyone is welcoming and felt right at home from the moment I got out my car. I’ll be back next Sunday. If you are looking for a church please give them a try. Went to church here last Sunday for the first time.  Really enjoyed the music.  Lively and well done. It's actually easy for the congregation to participate with the musicians.  Love this . Many people greeted us, which doesn't usually happen in most churches these days.  Most people spend greeting time talking with those they already know. There was some of that, but a lot greeted all around the auditorium.  The preaching was very good. Easy to follow and understand.

reviewSummary:
The members are loving and caring people. The pastor is a true man of God. I would recommend to anybody wanting to visit or in  need of a church home. I would recommend also House of God Cogic in Thomson,Ga. Going to Christ Fellowship Church is fun to me because I am in the youth group called T.R.U.T.H Ministries and we do things like skating, Swimming, Church sports teams sometimes, and last but not least the whole church gets together and we Have a CHURCH FAMILY DAY.

I am proud of my church and our pastor, Pastor CD. Roberts Attention to the Word of God from the pastor. People are friendly and inviting.  I plan to return. The best church in the world. No churching as usual, nothing planned lead completely by the holy Spirit Outstanding, pastor. Must attend again.

name: Christ Fellowship Leesville - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: I loved Christ Fellowship Leesville from the first few minutes of my very first visit. I felt genuinely welcomed from the beginning, and have heard others comment similarly. It’s easy to get to know people on Sunday morning, but my Life Group has helped me form even deeper relationships as we meet weekly for conversation, sermon discussion, and prayer. The teaching at Christ Fellowship is consistently biblical, clear, encouraging, convicting, and applicable, always pointing to Jesus and our need for the gospel. This is true for the children’s curriculum as well, as I have experienced when I have had the opportunity to work with one and two-year-olds. If you are looking for a healthy church in Raleigh, I highly recommend that you visit! I started coming to this church for the excellent expository preaching, but it is the community of people who have truly become my family that I am the most grateful for. These are not fair weather friends - these are people who will carry you through all the storms of life with practical help, genuine love, and biblical truth. I believe this church truly exemplifies what Jesus wants His people to be: one unified body and overflowing with His love and grace. Christ Fellowship Leesville is an amazing church that genuinely loves God and seeks to honor Christ through honest expository preaching and loving Fellowship. CFL has a heart for the community and is an excellent church full of people of all ages. Fellowship is not only in the name of church, but the people here make that word true! Not only that but the sermons are expository (book by book verse by verse) teaching of the Bible which is always so great for better biblical understanding and knowing God better. The worship is also such an awesome mix of old classics and contemporary songs! I visited a bunch of different churches in the area and they all were generally pretty good, solid teaching, encouraging etc. But when my wife and I came to Christ fellowship we were immediately welcomed like old friends and it has been extremely easy to get plugged in a begin building a community that I know will last for years to come! Definitely visit here if you are considering

reviewSummary:
While the church itself may be a small and humble building, the hearts inside it are big and cheerful. We were immediately greeted with a big smiling welcome and made friends right away. In no time, we were invited to many get togethers, potlucks, church events and non-church events. There is a wide range of ages in attendance with many families homeschooling. They have classes for younger students, youth group for the teens, and an Awana program mid-week for K-6th grade. If you are looking for a small, modest church,(non-flashy), that is honest, straightforward and has sound Biblical teaching- then come visit.
Services start at 10:30. But if you want to come for an earlier Biblical teaching or small groups then come for 9am. A lovely place to worship. It's a rather small sized church that has a great music and helps ministry. Sunday School [Bible Study] at 9:00
Church Service at 10:30
Small community. Great people who love the Lord and others. Wonderful community of believers! Great Sunday morning service as well as Wednesday night AWANA program.

name: Christ First Christian Fellowship Center - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Truly this is a church of God. You can feel the Holy Spirit of God as you step across the threshold. It is a feeling of welcoming love. Under the leadership of Pastor Dr. Larry D Snead & First lady Jessie Snead the word of God is diligently taught preached and practiced to all who would listen. CFCFC is about leading souls to Christ that we may be saved, and then teaching that we may live holy and be joyful grateful doers of Gods word disciples of Jesus who is the Christ. Truly this is a loving God blessed place. Truly a house of the Lord. Under the loving leadership of Pastor Dr. Larry D. Snead coming here feels like coming home. Here there is family and support.  There is a focus on agape Love teaching the word of God creating and maturing a personal relationship with God as well as finding and putting into application the calling and gifts of the Holy spirit. There are also many community outreach events and programs to help heal and edify the body of Christ. Bible study Sunday school singles and couples ministry dance ministry mime ministry women and men ministry youth ministry and van service to name a few. God is at work in this wonderful place of praise and worship. I pray I see you there. 💓 My new church home. Pastor Larry Snead is awesome, personable a powerful preacher. The church is just like family and that's how they treat you from day 1. They believe in the community and work is put in. LOVE THEM ALL! A wonderful Church, Pastor and First Lady. Pastor Snead is truly a representative of Christ. He will always be my Pastor no matter where God leads me. I love love love this church!!! They teach the word not just speak it. The church family is very welcoming and Pastor Larry Snead and 1st Lady Jessie Snead are beautiful people… Join us online or come in, you will enjoy.

name: Christ Gospel Church - Rome Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ Gospel is a Pentecostal Church located in Rome, Georgia. They are a Christian group, and like most Christian denominations, it espouses a set of doctrines known as the Apostles' Creed. Like most Pentecostal groups, the church believes in the baptism of the Holy Spirit with the evidence of speaking in other tongues, and Christ Gospel services are exuberant celebrations. People sing, shout, dance, clap, run, praise, and worship God with all their beings.​​

Yet at times the services are quiet enough to hear a pin drop as members study the Bible attentively. Christ Gospel churches believe that worshiping God embraces the use of all kinds of music and instruments.​
​
At Christ Gospel Church of Rome, one will hear traditional church instruments -- piano, organ, drums, flute, electric and bass guitars, as well as traditional church instruments accompanying traditional church hymns, country gospel music, black gospel music, and as well as modern contemporary music.

The church emphasizes the importance of people being united in the love of Christ, regardless of nationality, race,sex, or creed. In fact, Christ Gospel churches were racially integrated long before the rest of society - not because the church was politically active, but merely because it strongly believed this was the right way for Christians to be.

Neither its leaders nor Christ Gospel Affiliated Churches believe that they are the only Christians going to heaven. In fact they maintain that Christians everywhere should rejoice whenever the name of Christ is upheld. Christ Gospel churches believe that their ministry is to help Christians discover a closer walk with God. Like other major religions in the world, Christ Gospel Churches believe that the ultimate experience of human beings is to achieve total oneness with the Divine; consequently, the church's teachings involve helping Christians grow spiritually until Christ totally fills their lives.
​                                                                                                   ​
Because they strive for perfect union with Christ, most church members renounce some activities that distract one's mind from God. These renunciations follow the standards of old-fashioned holiness. The women do not wear makeup nor cut their hair. All dress modestly. Their goal is to live full, complete lives while keeping Christ at the center of their thoughts and activities.

The church, however, teaches that there are different levels of commitment to God, which are a matter of individual conscience. Although the church has a strong sense of religious commitment, there are no rigid requirements of conformity for membership. People are encouraged to devote their lives to God, and to walk in the light of truth that God has given them personally. Most Christ Gospel members attend church, Bible study, or prayer groups several times a week. In all other respects they participate fully in all aspects of society. They believe in living full, wholesome lives, enjoying good, clean fun, marrying, rearing families, buying homes, going to school, college, developing careers, striving for excellence, and being responsible, moral citizens in all their actions.

​
​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​

​ I was raised in the Rome Christ Gospel Church. During my years living for the LORD, I had gotten away from the church due to circumstances out of my control. The past seven years have been a very rough time for me. Last year, I had reached the end of my rope. I had no desire to live and was ready to end it all. I was given an opportunity to re-locate to Rome, Ga with family and I accepted this opportunity. I was very distraught with my life and could see no hope. Reluctantly, I returned to Christ Gospel with my family. I loved the church and the people but I allowed my state of mind to rule, as you know, this rarely brings true peace.
It was not until after a few weeks that I had begun to realize why the great depression that I found myself in. For so long, I was looking here and there to fill voids in my life. I was skipping from church to church with NO stability in my natural or spiritual life. God allowed me to descend to a very low and dark place in order for me to see what I was missing. I had my heart in the right place but needed direction. I needed the LORD to lead me instead of myself, along with my own carnal choices. I do not say what I am about to say for NO other reason than to give GOD ALL THE GLORY!!! Without Him, I would not me writing this now to share with you.
The message of Christ Gospel has changed my life. I cannot express in words just how or why but I know that I am not the same person that I was last year. I now know who I am and why I have been down so many paths in life. It was not by chance that I am where I am now. When you have been awakened to the truth of Gods holy word, You come to realize that EVERYTHING you go through and endure is predestinated before the foundation of the world for YOUR GOOD!!!
If you are looking for a place of worship that is not scripted and restricted, I would highly recommend Christ Gospel of Rome, Ga. They teach and live BY THE BIBLE. Rev. and Sis. Calvert are wonderful pastors and they love the LORD with all their heart, soul, body, and mind.
The people there are no different. There is no judgement and there is no dictatorship, just a free and fresh environment in the LORD Jesus Christ!!!! If you are ready to break free from the chains of division, bondage, and perplexities of life, come snd see what God can do for you. I gaurantee that if you come with a true desire for more of God, There is no limit to the hieghts and depths in which you can grow in Christ Jesus. Believe me, I am experiencing new hieghts every day!! Every day with Jesus is sweeter than the day before. Asked for a ride n no one called me back or came...😔 Helps people I like this church

There is a traditional service at 8:30 and two contemporary services at 10 and 11:30 Christ Greenfield Lutheran church is my favorite church in Gilbert, and the best Lutheran church I've ever attended!

They are a part of the Lutheran Church of The Missouri Synod, a historic mainline founded protestant church, founded in America by German immigrants in the 1830s.

Ever since it's humble beginnings, the LCMS has remained a faithful Christian church, continuing in the spirit of the reformation; teaching the doctrines of Christ's Apostles, and the early church.

In a world that is ever changing, the LCMS remains the most consistently faithful mainline protestant church in all of America. Christ Greenfield is no exception to this Lutheran excellence.

At Christ Greenfield there are traditional services, as well as a contemporary service, but whichever one you go to, you will be sure to find a high value of the word and sacraments, community, and Christian charity.

CG cares for the ill, the afflicted, and the weak in faith. They are not perfect (as no earthly church is), but the Pastors at CG make up for their occasional lack of theological depth by the sheer passion and zeal by which they love their congregation.

Also, the summer choir and organ are beautiful for worship whenever used, and I long to be a part of their choir again whenever I get the chance!

God bless Christ Greenfield and the Missouri Synod. We were traveling and were looking for a place to worship. The congregation was welcoming and it was beautiful Easter celebration. Worship music was great! Thank you!

name: Christ Journey Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Every week after the service,  Christ Journey Church encourages members to join a ministry if they feel a calling in their heart. In response to that encouragement, I completed all required steps, including passing the mandatory background check and complying with additional requirements necessary to serve.
However, despite meeting every requirement, I was left completely in the dark. Certain individuals within some ministries chose not to move forward with my participation, yet no explanation was provided no conversation, no feedback, nothing.
This raises an important question: after someone has fully complied with all requirements, why are concerns or issues (if any) not addressed directly with the individual? On what basis are these decisions made appearance, past experiences, personal background, level of faith?.  Are the Ministries in Christ Journey exclusively for some people, and not for others?
I am genuinely asking: What would Jesus do in this situation?
I do not recall Jesus rejecting people without explanation or refusing them the opportunity to grow, serve, or be restored. I believed Christ Journey Church to be a family-oriented church a place to congregate, to find truth, honesty, and love for one another.
Sadly, that has not been my experience.
As a result, I have made the decision to stop attending Christ Journey. Finally, after much searching I found the place for my worship, sharing and service to God, the creator of heaven and earth. Finding others that understand and work together to help one another is amazing. I am in for the "journey". If you need to connect to the Creator, this place will offer you patience and love as you embark on your "journey". Come as you are. I am so happy to have made the decision one sunday to attend this church because i haven’t missed one since. I love this church the praising, praying and ways they teach and guide is amazing really has helped my life in so many ways and will continue to.  My family and I started attending Christ Journey around May of last year. We came from another church where we had been attending for quite a while, but we truly felt we were being called to leave and find another church home. Christ Journey has been that for us 100%. It has brought about healing, the people are so genuine, the preachings are taught in a way that is fresh and exciting while remaining whole and true, and the presence of God is felt in a way I’ve never seen at any church in Miami. This church has been a blessing to my family and I can’t wait to continue to grow in what God has for us! Also, if you have kids, they will absolutely LOVE CJ Kids! The time, consideration, and attention to detail taken with each craft, story, lesson, and event makes us so happy as parents and the kids love every second of it. ❤️ I love my Church community everyone is so friendly and welcoming and I love hearing Pastor Bill preach  you should go by and see for yourself

name: Christ Lutheran Church
reviewSummary:
I began attending Christ Lutheran Church a 701 S. Charles St., in Baltimore, MD in 1993 along with family.  What drew me to keep returning each week is the friendliness of the pastors, congregation and staff.  CLC is referred to as "The church you can't forget."
My kids, now adults, made many friends in the youth group and attending youth gatherings as high schoolers.  There are dedicated adult volunteers teaching Sunday school and confirmation classes.
The pastors always have a great message and leave me feeling God's presence in my life.  CLC has made a big impact on my life.
Our music program is probably the best I've ever heard.  We have a 9:00 contemporary service and an 11:00 traditional service.
CLC also provides space for organizations to perform wonderful free concerts. I have been a member of Christ Inner Harbor Lutheran Church for over 35 years and feel truly grateful to be a part of the ministry. The members consist of people local to far away, young to mature, and casual to committed.
The church is a wonderful place for a single visit while in Baltimore, or for coming every week. You will be welcomed. The Pastors, the music, the atmosphere, and the worship service are all outstanding!
Christ Inner Harbor is blessed to be a blessing. I joined Christ Church about 19 years ago when I lived in downtown Baltimore. It is a dynamic and inviting congregation with wonderful pastors and staff. The music program is phenomenal with a choir that is second to none in the greater Baltimore area. Even now that I live in Carroll County, my family still calls Christ Lutheran Church our home. I first came to Christ Lutheran for their wonderful toddler playgroup, and two years later have found so much more. This welcoming and vibrant church really "has it all;" an extraordinary music program, wonderful pastors, numerous education programs for both children and adults, a great nursery school, a loving congregation, and an incredible amount of service and outreach opportunities. Christ Lutheran does so much for the community near and far, it is astounding. I would be remiss not to mention that the church itself is an incredibly beautiful building, every week worshipping in that beautiful sanctuary is quite a treat. I love coming to church when I visit mom. I feel so at peace there and I can meditate more with the Lord.

name: Christ Lutheran Orland
reviewSummary:
I grew up here, and I loved every second of it. I was baptized, confirmed and married at this church. We called it home for literally generations. Unfortunately, the leadership just isn’t caring, loving, and respectful anymore. If you aren’t “in the in crowd” you’re literally asked not to come back.

I love this place, I love how I found Jesus at a young age, I love what it meant to my family for years and years. I hate what has happened. I hate that I’m leaving this review, and I hate the way things have gone down.

There are plenty of churches in the area, and I’d suggest checking out many of them, at least until the current leadership sees the need for a change.

If you’re still considering attending, I’d suggest giving the pastor a call and asking about the things that are important to you. I’d also ask about how he himself deals with conflict and conflicting opinions before you decide to spend time in his presence.

Pastor Ray, if you’re reading this, please know that we are continually praying that this community of amazing parishioners finds their footing. Pastor Ray’s 20 years of service was amazing and this is absolutely not a reflection on his commitment and dedication to Gods work in the community or his time at CLC.

I hope they can turn it around and find Gods voice and leading rather than their own selfish motivations. I joined Christ Lutheran many years ago when i sent my daughter to their preschool. My 3 year old said to me “mommy i love this church “ and i said “so do i honey.” That was 26 years ago. My girls were confirmed there and my eldest daughter was married there. The pastors came to the hospitals when my parents were ill and presided over their funeral services. Christ Lutheran feels like home to me. If you don’t have a church home please join us any Sunday. If you are looking for a wonderful loving preschool sign up for CLEWS. Give your little ones the gift of faith. We all need Jesus in our lives. All should believe in God, blessed beyond measure, this church is amazing.. good people and energy... Great church!
Pastor Chuck is excellent.
Tons of activities and life at this church. I highly recommend visiting to see for yourself! Wonderful Church and Pastor and follows the Bible.

name: Christ Lutheran Pre-School - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My littles has been attending here since she was two. Friendly staff and secure school ! Great school with caring teachers and an attentive Director Lisa who always takes time to make sure our needs are taken care of

name: Christ Lutheran Preschool - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve been really happy with our experience here. The teachers and admin staff are so kind and caring, and you can tell they genuinely love working with the kids. Our kids looks forward to going every day, which says a lot. We’ve seen our kids grow so much socially and academically. The staff does a great job communicating with parents and making everyone feel part of the community. They have so many fun outdoor activities and an AMAZING playground.

The school is so loved, and the waitlist is long. A good tip is to start with the Parent-Tot program (once a week) for 2-year-olds., since that helps get you on the priority list. Sign up for full-time if you can. The kids get great care and make the best memories with their friends and teachers there. Also, full-time kids get extra daycare on many days when school is closed for half-day students, including during the summer. I was surprised that the school does not have higher ratings until I realized that they are all quite outdated.  I have nothing negative to say about Christ Lutheran Preschool. My first child attended this school, and I fell in love with the teaching style and the attentiveness of the staff. Their prices are also very reasonable given the quality of education they provide. They are a play-to-learn school, and I appreciate how their playground allows children to develop in a variety of ways. So excited to now have my other child be a part of this wonderful community. CLP has been a safe space for both of my children to learn, explore, and grow. Their curriculum was developmentally appropriate. From the Mom and Tot class to the Fours class, my children thrived under their play based philosophy of teaching. It is obvious the teachers are all passionate about their place as teachers. Each classroom has a unique culture full of opportunity to develop socially, emotionally, and academically. Both children left prepared for elementary school.  The ongoing efforts to change and improve the school are evidence of their commitment to their families. We absolutely love this school and staff! My son loves going to school here! We loved his previous preschool but needed to send him somewhere closer to home in order to better manage morning drop off for his older siblings. We are so happy with the move and our son is happier than ever at school! This is such a lovely and enriching environment for kids. His teachers really care about getting to know him and encouraging a healthy social and academic development through play and exploration. This is the best preschool in Santa Clarita. The back play area is 10/10 you won’t find a bigger or more engaging space for your little. I have been going to this school for 8 years with all three of my kids. They have always loved school and alive always felt so comfortable in the environment and with the caring teachers! I really was turned off in my preschool search by stuffy rooms with diaper changes where they play—- CLP is a hidden gem! You won’t regret getting your kiddo into this awesome program

name: Christ Nation Church
reviewSummary: Great mixture of great people. The pastor has to be one of the most down to earth pastors I've met, and he loves God and is passionate when he speaks the Word. Looking for a non-denominational church that teaches the bible & only the bible from Genesis to Revelation? Then Christ Nation Church, Plum Grove Road, Schaumburg, Illinois is the place for you to fill your soul & your heart & grow in God's word daily. 📖 If you are searching for a real Bible-based church, then this is the church for you! Welcoming people and a very biblical church in Illinois. Such a welcoming Church that teaches solid biblical doctrine

name: Christ Our Hope Catholic Church
reviewSummary: I was visiting from NY the weekend of Palm Sunday and happened upon this church. May I begin by saying it is very welcoming. Although the inside physical space does not resemble a typical Catholic Church, more of a chapel, the congregation makes it feel majestic. The service itself was very theatrical and the choir and cantor appeared to be composed of professionals. If the same formula was present in my home parish, it would be packed every weekend. With a back injury on my walk across town to my improv class my phone died.  I saw a Catholic church with a homeless jesus sleeping on a bench outside.   I saw plaques about helping people.  I walk inside and explain my predicament to the desk guy.  I need my phone to navigate public transport or hail a ride.  I don’t know how much further I can walk due to my injury.  Guy says he doesn’t have a phone charger.  Completely unsympathetic.  I say you don’t have a usb c cable?  I say looking at a modern desk setup, his own phone present.  He explains that no, he does not.  It’s funny how this interaction compresses everything about why I don’t go to church despite coming from a Catholic family into a single moment. The priest was probably the best homilist that I've ever heard.  The congregation was a pure community and they were committed to assisting in any way they could to help the residents.  God's presence could definitely be felt. Beautiful place to worship & extraordinarily welcoming. Brought my family on Easter Sunday (pic below). Lovely dainty little parish with an active and enthusiastic community, friendly church servers and absolutely wonderful choir!!

name: Christ Our Hope Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited once recently in fall 2023. Extremely welcoming and friendly congregants. However, was shocked at the preaching, which  was horrible — and very political. “Not social Justice but Biblical Justice…” etc etc. Right-wing evangelical extremist talk. I found it so offensive that I left before the sermon was done. The pastor kept repeating over and over the same points (didn’t follow the outline given in the bulletin at all) and the sermon went on for far, far too long without delivering a message other than what I perceived  to be his frustration about feeling like Christians are on the losing side of the culture wars.  Really odd juxtaposition between the warmth of the one-on-one interactions before the service and the tenor of the sermon. Also was taken aback by their rules about communion, which were not biblical. I lived overseas in various places for quite a few years and—  whether in the U.S. or abroad,— always look forward to sharing in the Lord’s Supper with other Christians. However, the bulletin made clear that I, as a baptized and practicing believer and follower of Christ, was not welcome at “their table” serving the Lord’s Supper unless I was a church “member in good standing” What happened to us not needing a mediator between God and man other than Christ? I was a longtime member of another local church but left last year due to concern about political messages pervading worship and advice coming from leadership. What about those who just moved and don’t yet have a new church home? I really wanted to like this church, as it is in a very convenient location and I was a dedicated member of my Presbyterian church when I lived in Philadelphia for 10 years. But, sadly, I was very disappointed. My family and I became members of this church six months ago after visiting all of the other PCA churches in the area.  The teaching is phenomenal and it is clear that the pastors spend a lot of time preparing for each sermon.  The church also works hard to equip members with gospel knowledge through great bible studies.  The greatest asset of this church is definitely the sense of community and family.  Members are willing to go above and beyond to care for each other and we noticed this right from the start.  Christ Our Hope Church is a great example of Christian community and we are so grateful that God provided a place for us here. I have been a member of Christ Our Hope Church for 20 years. It has been a great church for our family as our kids have grown from babies to their 20’ and teens now. While no church is perfect-filled with a bunch of sinners, I have found nothing but a gracious, loving community that has only wanted to help build me up as a person, mother, and wife.  If you are wanting a church community where you can grow in Christ then you will find it at Christ our Hope. My family went to this church 10 years ago when we lived in North Carolina until a move out of state sadly took us away.

The relationships we built are still some of the most precious we have. We have been back a couple of times over the last couple of years. The pastor, Scott Cook, who planted the church is a man who loves the Good News of Jesus, loves people and is committed to seeing Christ formed in their lives. The Spirit of God is present in this church: in the preaching of the Word, the Sacraments, in the love the people have for each other and their community.

Planting a church is no easy task. It requires faith, patience, endurance, wisdom and a great deal of teamwork. No one plants a tree in their yard and expects a fully mature blossoming tree by the next season. It is really cool for me to return to this church and see how that little tree planted 10 years ago is now becoming a healthy, blossoming and maturing tree.

No church is perfect. The bride of Christ has spots and wrinkles but she is the beloved of the Father bought with the precious blood of Jesus. This church would be a great home for any person who senses their own brokenness and need of God's grace in their lives. I am so proud to see how God continues to work here! My wife and I have been attending for about 2 years and have found this a great church.  We were looking for a church that had a strong bible believing message and  good music that we found upbeat and worshipful. We found all this and much more.  The church has taught us what true Christian community is and we continue to grow in this Christ honoring church.

name: Christ Our King Christian Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful family friendly atmosphere to worship.  This is a Church that gives back to the community. They have a great Pantry which caters to senior citizens 55 and older every fourth Thursday of the month; they also offer Pantry service to the community durning the Summer months.  I would advise everyone to visit this wonderful God-led Church at least once. May God continue to bless you! I love this Church so much. There they Welcome you like you are family and all I truly love that church We are a small church and people come and go but the one thing that remains is the love of God for by any one that walks through those doors. I went to a Church service there today, enjoy the Service I love the Lord you never go wrong with the Lord 🙏

name: Christ Our Redeemer AME Church - Main Campus
Christ Our Redeemer Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A modern church facility with traditional worship service of the A.M.E denomination Order 30 + LaCroix. That's 540 pounds. And tip 5.00 dollars. Not cool. That's not a fair wage, for the work expected.

To give you perspective. A normal compact car can only hold about 1000 pounds. That's what most gig workers drive. This order is unreasonable and a bad testimony to the generosity and easy yoke that Jesus gives.

Could you see The Lord giving you such back breaking labor for 17.00 dollars?

Do better brothers and sisters in The Lord. When today on a invitation from my daughter. Experience was God sent. The word was awesome. The preacher can "preacher",  the choir was great. The love can be felt. I will be attending again.
Gregory Newman As a Christian woman, I wanted to find an church home having recently moved to the area. Although their reviews looked good, and church was very welcoming, the message given by a man who was from CALIFORNIA State Dominguez  Hills (the college President) gave his harsh opinion of our President. He spoke with distain an he , though entitled to his opinion,  was wrong to do that in the house of God. When you speak about God and peace and love your neighbor out of one side of your mouth , and verbally assalt the president out of the other side of your mouth who would believe anything you had to say? The comments he made  called the president racist. It was a personal assult.  Never going back obviously don't want to be part of a church that talks of love and preaches hate.  Hypocrisy......  What would Alveda King think about that?  What would God say about that? my forever favorite church. Have been there since birth, a church that is so welcoming and loving. Always brings a warm and heartfelt message.

name: Christ Our Savior Catholic Parish - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
The new church building has been open about 4 and a half years now.
Leading up to Easter/Resurrection Sunday, we've had great attendance from Ash Wednesday into the Easter Triduum.

As a tri-lingual parish is can be hard sometimes, reaching out to the English Spanish and Vietnamese communities. With Fr Joe and Fr T in the lead those special masses and rites reach the whole parish community in unity.

A great place to worship and get to know the parishoners . This community is young and accepting.   It is a beautiful church that feels open and bright. Father Joe is very easy to talk to. Great shepherd. My mother had her services there.And it was very beautiful , we love the way the priests spoke clearly , and we understood everything he said Beautiful place of worship ❤️ Feels like home 🏡 Beautiful church, enough parking and clean restrooms.
But did notice dirty floor inside the main hall ( church )
Definitely a new option to visit from now on.

name: Christ Pacific Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️

Massive appreciation, gratitude, and blessings to everyone at Christ Pacific Church for the incredible work they do serving the community every Sunday.

Programs like the Sunday meal service and the Lord’s Closet may seem like simple acts of kindness on the surface, but for many people they make a much bigger difference than most will ever realize.

Life can get busy. Life can get complicated. Sometimes people are carrying challenges that nobody else can see. Having a place where you can show up, be welcomed with kindness, receive a meal, browse clothing resources, and simply be treated with dignity is something truly special.

What stands out most about Christ Pacific Church is the atmosphere.

Nobody makes you feel like a burden.
Nobody makes you feel judged.
Nobody makes you feel like you’re standing in a line asking for help.

Instead, you’re welcomed with compassion, respect, and genuine kindness.

That matters.

The volunteers, staff, donors, and everyone involved create an environment that feels uplifting, organized, and filled with positive energy. You can tell there are a lot of good people behind the scenes putting in time, effort, and resources to make sure these programs continue helping others.

And honestly, programs like this save people more than money.

They save stress.

Knowing there’s a meal available on Sunday from 3 PM to 4 PM might seem like a small thing, but sometimes removing even one worry from someone’s week can make a huge difference.

That’s real impact.

The Lord’s Closet is also an incredible resource and another example of people helping people in a practical and meaningful way.

The entire experience carries a spirit of generosity, humility, and community that is becoming harder and harder to find.

No fanfare.
No ego.
No expectations.

Just people serving others because they genuinely care.

That’s timeless.

That’s leadership.

That’s faith put into action.

To every volunteer, donor, staff member, and person who contributes to making these programs possible:

Thank you.

Your kindness matters.
Your work matters.
And your impact reaches further than you probably realize.

Absolute six-star experience.

Nothing but gratitude and blessings for everyone involved.

𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️ 𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️

There are some places that simply open their doors, and then there are places that open their hearts.

Christ Pacific Church falls into the second category.

Every Sunday from 3 PM to 4 PM, this church provides something that goes far beyond a meal or access to clothing through the Lord’s Closet. They provide peace of mind, dignity, encouragement, and a reminder that community still exists.

The volunteers, staff, donors, and everyone involved deserve tremendous recognition for what they do here.

From the moment you arrive, you’re treated with kindness and respect. There is no feeling of judgment, no feeling of being looked down upon, and no feeling that you’re inconveniencing anyone by being there.

Instead, you’re welcomed.

And that simple act carries more weight than most people realize.

The meal program is incredibly appreciated. In a world where grocery prices seem determined to qualify for astronaut training, having one less meal to worry about can make a meaningful difference for a lot of people.

It’s not just food.

It’s breathing room.

It’s one less thing on the mental checklist.

It’s one less stressor during an already busy week.

The Lord’s Closet is equally amazing. Being able to access clothing resources through a program run with such care and compassion is something that deserves recognition and support.

What stands out most is the culture.

Everyone seems genuinely happy to help.

The volunteers aren’t simply going through the motions. You can feel the kindness behind the work. You can feel the compassion. You can feel that the mission is bigger than the task.

That’s rare.

And honestly, in a world that can sometimes feel rushed, disconnected, and overly transactional, places like Christ Pacific Church remind us what community is supposed to look like.

People helping people.

Simple.
Powerful.
Timeless.

The entire experience carries that white-glove hospitality energy that isn’t built on luxury, but on kindness.

Professional organization.
Compassionate volunteers.
Meaningful programs.
Real impact.

To every volunteer serving meals, every donor contributing resources, every person organizing the Lord’s Closet, and every individual working behind the scenes to make this possible:

Thank you.

You are making a difference.

Absolute six-star experience.

Nothing but gratitude, respect, and blessings for everyone involved.

𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️ A lovely church with super kind people. I visited their Celebrate Recovery on a Friday night with my friends from our local Celebrate Recovery. We were treated so well and enjoyed a delicious dinner with homemade desserts. The church building itself is nice and immaculate. The worship center where services are held was very spacious, comfortable and offered a peaceful ambience. I cannot say enough nice things about Christ Pacific Church. I have been searching for a church with a heart to serve those in need, and this is it! They practice what they preach- literally! They offer a variety of opportunities to help others in the community of Huntington Beach and around the world. The people here are incredibly kind and sincere, and Pastor Peter is the most amazing teacher. The Holy Spirit shines through him and the entire church. The worship team is also very gifted and their talent is amazing. If you want to attend a church with the heart of Jesus, search no further. It's here! I decided to give this church a try. Many people there were nice.  I did not feel a connection to Pastor Peter’s sermons at all.  He doesn’t preach strongly based on the Bible.  It’s not bad; it’s just OK.  I don’t believe he is gifted to preach to others.  Nothing like Pastor Charles Stanley or Pastor Joel Osteen. There are many Pastors and churches out there, but only a few are genuinely great.  This church is not one of them.  Their worship team isn’t all that great either.  The lead worship minister could barely sing.  I don’t understand why they have her lead the worship team.  She does have a pleasant voice though.  They don’t even come close to singing as great as the worship team at Saddleback church.  Their music also needs to be better.  One guy is able to hit the high notes and sing well but overall, their worship team needs a lot of improvement.  Praising GOD is one of the most important things at church, so why not do it amazingly well or at least pleasantly well?  Also, their graphic designs need improvements.  They don’t really capture the themes properly and do not look very appealing either.  It doesn’t look very creative.  It’s not a big deal but if they want to present to the audience, we do deserve a better presentation. I won’t be going back to this church.  It did not feel right for me.

name: Christ Presbyterian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I recently visited Christ Presbyterian church in Carlsbad Ca, and it was a wonderful experience. The sanctuary is absolutely stunning, one of the most beautiful worship spaces I’ve seen in North County San Diego. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality. The community was friendly, inclusive, and made me feel right at home.

What stood out most was their tagline: “A Place of Grace.” It truly reflects the heart of the church. If you’re looking for a welcoming church in Carlsbad with inspiring worship, a strong sense of community, and a beautiful campus, this is a place worth checking out. Lovely, welcoming church in a suburban neighborhood near a community garden. They offer both contemporary and traditional services, special holiday events, family and youth activities, groups for seniors, missions involvement, and other opportunities to get involved. For a smaller church, they really do a lot ! This church has the most loving, faithful, brilliant, and compassionate pastors I've ever encountered. They will help you expand your spiritual and human awareness through sharing their insight as well as being the authentic and caring people they are.

It's not a megachurch so you'll be able to establish a true connection with the people who actively practice their faith. The children's ministry is excellent. Plus the choir and music director, being immensely talented, will probably touch your soul with their heavenly sound. I am not a Christian, but I attended a couple of services at this church because of my wife. What sets this church apart is not just its active engagement with the community but also the dynamic leadership of the  pastor.  The pastor also emphases events with fellow Muslims and Jews.  His sermons are a blend of motivation, wisdom, and a refreshing sense of humor that resonates deeply with all who listen. It's a rare gift to deliver messages of faith that are both profound and accessible, yet the pastor does so with an ease that speaks volumes of his dedication and understanding of the human spirit. CPC is a warm and friendly church that is active in the local community. There are several fun-filled family friendly events throughout the year. The Pastor has a good sense of humor and his sermons are interesting.  The congregation is committed to making a difference.

From Rachel Garrett... Hi Pastor,...I cherish Christ the King.
After our Maundy Thursday service I sent the following to several friends and I thought you and Amanda might also like to know what that service meant to me.
My text to some friends: “I wish you could’ve gone with me to my Lutheran Church Thursday night. It’s much different, much smaller than North Shelby. I think you would have liked the service.
The Seder meal was in the Fellowship Hall and then we moved to the sanctuary for the service. The Pastor spoke only several minutes. Scriptures were read about Passover, the Lord’s Supper, and the washing of feet, then the congregation participated in foot washing, then congregational prayers ending with the Lord‘s Prayer, then Communion.
The final act in the service was the stripping of the altar in preparation for the celebration of the Resurrection on Sunday. Everything that represents and was used during the 40 days of Lent (all the purple banners, flags, stoles, etc) and the wine cup, Bible, candles, actually everything, is removed from the altar as the congregation watches silently. On Easter Sunday everything that was purple will be replaced with white and everything else is new, all to represent new life.
The stripping was done this way  – several people gathered at the back of the sanctuary and one person at a time walked up the center aisle to the front, paused with bowed head for a moment, then stepped up to the altar and picked up one item and took it from the altar out of the sanctuary, then went back and got in line again. They rotated until everything had been removed, silently, reverently, one candle, one cup, one piece of cloth, at a time.
That in itself is moving, but last night while that was happening, all of a sudden the organist began playing “Gethsemane”, the song from Jesus Christ Superstar that Jesus agonizingly sang before his crucifixion where he asked God why he had to die. Shocked, I recognized the song immediately.
Then even more shocking (since the musicians are in the back of the sanctuary and you don’t know what’s happening unless you’re sitting back there) a soloist began to sing, matching the same intense, agonizing emotion that the Jesus in the production had had back in 1971. Andrew Lloyd Webber‘s words to the entire song were printed in the bulletin and the soloist performed it perfectly. The only thing he wasn’t able to replicate was Jesus’s heart-wrenching scream at the beginning of one of the phrases. (Of course the Jesus back then was Ian Gillan who at the time was the singer for the band Deep Purple and he had a range that few people could match on a good day!)
Oh my gosh I cried. My mind’s eye was reliving the vivid memory of sitting in Boutwell Auditorium in total darkness, with just one backlight illuminating three crosses, and offstage the horrible echoing sound of the hammering of the nails being driven into Jesus‘s hands and feet.
The service last night ended with only one single light left in the sanctuary as the Pastor carried the last remaining thing, the crucifix draped in purple cloth with a black hood covering Jesus’s body, down the center aisle to the back of the sanctuary, and as he stood there with the crucifix the congregation filed out silently on either side of him. No music, no benediction.
Oh my gosh. The symbolism. The reverence. It made Jesus‘s last days feel so real. The Christ-centered, disciple-minded, servant- hearted, biblically oriented nature of this church is palpable. If you want to be surrounded by a true ambodiment of Christ' loving nature, come to CTK. I personally am not a member here, but find myself inside these doors several nights out of the week to fellowship and enjoy community. I have had my 2 children, now 3 and 5 at Christ the King preschool since both were infants and there is no where else I would rather have them. The teachers and the administrators are the best and there is a loving Christ filled atmosphere.
I would reccomend anyone who is looking for child care to use them.

The combination lock system code had left us too vunerable when it comes to safety, and it only takes one wrong person to obtain the code and cause harm. Todos estan, y siempre han estado, bienvenidos a la capilla de adoracion del Santisimo en Christ The King!! Esta abierta de 6 am a 9 pm, despues de las 9pm simplemente deben seguir el protocolo, llamar y  registrarse, como guardianes, o pedir una tarjeta para entrada para una vez, esto es para seguridad de todos los guardianes.

POR FAVOR VENGAN TODOS, BIENVENIDOS A ESTA HERMOSA CAPILLA A ADORAR AL SANTISIMO!!

name: Christ the Redeemer Catholic Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: This has been my home for many years.  I joined the prayer group last year.  This is the best thing I have done.  You feel the presence of God in the congregation.  We have adoration all the first Fridays of the month.  Rosary at 6:30 pm followed by the mass and all night adoration with the Holly Sacrament.  Need healing?  You have a troubled life? Need love?  Yes I needed all those and I have received all three here and more.  You are welcome to join us!  Jesus is Love! Very peaceful Church loving community been going here for the past 14 years. Fr. Anthony, the pastor of Christ the Redeemer Church, is an attentive and welcoming priest. (I love his inspiring homily). During every Sunday Mass, there is always a welcoming message for new visitors and seminarians. Blessings are given to kids under 18,  those having birthday and couples having wedding anniversary. I also love the community. My beloved parish. Great Catholic community, open and comfortable. Friendly and welcoming. First parish I've officially joined since I moved from Boyle Heights in 1991. Fr. Anthony is new to Christ the Redeemer; we're blessed with yet another kind, smart, easygoing pastor. It's a beautiful community, people is warm and embrace every one.

name: Christ the Redeemer Church of Marietta - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
Quite acceptable
Community was very inviting and very God centered.
Am making this my family's main church. Music is good but the songs would be better if shorter.
The people are all very warm and welcoming.  Pastor exceptionally good speaker. A very blessed worship experience here ! Loving church focused on God's grace I love this place.  They love Jesus.

name: Christ the Redeemer Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Pioneering urban congregation founded by Tim Keller. Celebrated for intellectual rigor, compassionate city mercy ministries (Hope for New York), and cultural integration.

name: Christ the Rock Church - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary: Just really loud when I walked up to pick up my sons. My mom takes my boys here not sure why this isn't our type of church. When I was little I remember it use to be a catholic church. Good teachings about spiritual warfare, true holy gost Friendly Pastor and Pastors Wife A perfect place to feel God's love, His presence, and His peace. Pentecostal Church M.I. Services: Saturdays 7 PM, Sundays 5 PM Because it's a place to worship our God. Of course, you can worship anywhere, but it's better in church.

name: Christ the Vine Lutheran Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: This church is absolutely amazing! I went here from the age of 8 to about 17 they've had a few different pastors in that time, one being my grandfather. But their newest pastor, Anthony, is unbelievably amazing at what he does. If you're looking for a church that holds to the traditional text and honors Martin Luther's beautiful change he brought into the church then this is the church for you! Praise be to Jesus!🙏🏽🙏🏽 I love this church. The pastor is very personal and gets to know the visitors in friendship. I didn't know the pastor and he prayed for me during my cancer treatment. It worked I'm cancer free. Small Church with big loving heart's. If you need a church this is the place to worship with open arms. My family and I have attended CTVL since 2005. We love our church and it's Bible based doctrine. I am thankful for the opportunity to worship and to be spiritually nourished each week. Great church wouldn't go anywhere else WELS Lutheran church with K-8th school.  Pastor Bartelt is GREAT!!!

name: Christ United - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ United has been a very gracious host to a non-denominational discipleship group by providing meeting space, point of departure for retreats and other means of support! Great Church overall. Lots of potential to do great things in Jackson. Rocky Shack has the right idea for ministry. They should get Calvin Cosnahan back, to help balance and grow the ministry. Major downside is pastor turnover. 5 star for potential though. Went with our small youth group to this wonderful facility.  These gracious folk hosted The Gathering again, with almost 1,000 young people.  THANK YOU CUMC! The Greek Fest was awesome. Great Mediterranean food, traditional dances and stalls. We had good time this year. I have worship with Christ UM Church for the last 4 Sunday's
I was pleasantly surprised with the warmth and friendliness
Everyone seem so nice and made me feel very comfortable
I volunteered and help pack the food my second Sunday there
For 2 hours afterwards enjoyed lunch and outside service
I also was invited to UM Women's meeting and Cindy offered me Transporation if I needed it and dropped me off after the meeting
Easter Sunday was a beautiful service and very  moving
I plan to to fellowship with Christ UM again next Sunday a beautiful Churh and beautiful Christian people

name: Christ United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Very pretty church in downtown St. Pete. Has street parking and near a lot of shops and restaurants. Italian flag on st paddy’s day…. Disrespectful Been attending the 10 o'clock services previously. Yesterday I attended the Hortin CDC Children's program and it was truly enjoyable. Love the services and since it's within walking distance, when I can make the walk I love to hear the word from Pastor Jackie! An awesome group of members attending. Absolutely love the preschool here. They are the best. My sister and brothers in Christ 🙏🏿❣️

name: Christ United Methodist Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
In my 18 years attending here, I’ve found this church to be a safe place to be broken and to heal. If you look at our welcoming statement, “Christ United Methodist Church welcomes and values everyone, no exceptions. We strive to show the hospitality of Jesus Christ to persons of all ages, genders, races, sexual orientations, economic situations, and abilities. Believing that life is better together, we invite you to share  your God-given gifts in this community of faith to spread God's love in our world.”
We truly welcome everyone! The most loving and accepting of any congregation I’ve ever been a part of!!!
ALL of us are WELCOME!!! I moved to the area about a year ago. I visited CUMC and decided to call it my church home. I haven't officially joined the church but I support it and enjoy the family atmosphere. My children are young adults and live in other areas of the US, so it is refreshing to see families of all ages together at this church. CUMC is casual, so come as you are. Our family has found a home here. It's all about relationships and healing God's hurting world. Wonderful youth programs, great small group study and fellowship. Great place for worship, study, prayer, and outreach witness in a friendly open welcoming community of faith.

name: Christ United Methodist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Went to an AA meeting there today, it was great, met a lot of great people I love everything about Christ Ministry Center. There are varieties of help. Free Community clinic Tuesday and Thursday good neighborwood center every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. There's also help with immigrants What a lovely congregation we are so lucky to have it in normal Heights did you so much for our community and I really like that Minister though I do not know his name this group is deeply into service to other people. They provide free food and other necessities for those who are poor or extremely poor. You got to love these people Visited for an NA meeting. Could use signage to guide people to the correct room when arriving because there are several meetings taking place at the same time, kind of confusing.

name: Christ United Methodist Church, Westfield IN - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary: Been attending this church in Westfield for some time.  (3) things have become pivotal for me.  First, the arrival of Pastor Jeremiah has been monumental.  The sermons, renovations to the FLC, and the band.  Second, my new Church family the Duff's have been extraordinarily gracious.  Third, the church family. I’ve gone to this church forever. I grew up attending CUMC and was in the preschool program there in which I met many of my best friends to this day. I’ve got to witness all of the amazing things this church has accomplished within the last twenty years. CUMC  offers such a great sense of community, love, inclusiveness, and compassion. If you’re looking for a church where you can be yourself, raise a family, get to know others in the community, and want to have a good time then CUMC would love to welcome you! Christ UMC is a great place to draw closer to God and to fellow Christians.  I feel connected here through small groups,  golf league, mission trips, brew theology and many other ways.  Come check us out today and find your own greater connection to the Body of Christ. Great worship experience and thought provoking sermons.  It feels like an extended family atmosphere. This is a welcoming Church with a pastor who is working to grow the church community.  The Church is also in the heart of Westfield and supports the local community in many ways

name: Christ's Chapel Anglican Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This is a fantastic church that cares about biblical fidelity, community, and the beauty of the liturgy. This is where my family worship. It's a small congregation of believers. Public worship is conducted by the clerics using liturgy congruous with that of the church of England. Services are open to the public. A great Riverside church that’s welcoming, engaging and has beautiful, reverent, approachable Anglican worship services. Sound Biblical teaching, friendly congregation- all age groups present from infants to seniors Amazing church, love the work that is being done there.

name: Christ's Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: I love calling Christ's Church my home! from the moment we walked in, to ANY of the campuses, everyone has always been so warm and welcoming. Ended up meeting some of my greatest friends, and now I attend several services and have joined a small group that feels like family. Following the book of Matthew on Jesus's religious challengers was an awesome sermon. Praise & worship very hosanna music style and anointed. A great message on Mother's Day. The Family ministry team & volunteers do a great job pouring their hearts into the next generation! Love getting to serve alongside them! If you are looking for an inviting, but not pushy church to attend, this is the place. Personally, Christian music is how I feel closest to God and they have an excellent Christian band that starts the service. But, I also enjoy Pastor Jason's sermons. When he ends most prays with '.... less of me and more of you (God)', it fills my heart with joy. Great Church for the whole family! Amazing programs and resources for the whole community.  They make a big church feel small when you get connected at Starting Point and Growth Group.
