name: Christ's Church - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
I don't do church or religion but but this is a nice place built on a old farm, the falling down barn with the vw beetle is gone now and there's a nice play ground sitting way off the road. Unless its Sunday there never any one here I like it cause it safe I usually pick up the balls laying around and some trash since we get to use this play ground Ill never understand lazy slobs the dumpster ain't even 100 feet away anyway sure beat a strip mall or apartments. They also have well groomed soccer fields to let older kids burn off energy too. It's a beautiful church...they held Galen nursing graduation there lastnight We have lived in the area for over 10 years and tried a lot of different churches trying to find the right fit. This Church is absolutely amazing. The people, community and amenities make it feel like home. The pastor is incredible and explains the Bible very well. He brings some comedy, laughter and personal stories into the sermon as well.

I highly encourage you to come check it out! The energy at the services is fantastic and the people are all so friendly! We occasional attend services, my kids go to preschool there and I'm a part of mom's group there. I can't say enough good things about each of those aspects of the church! My kids were so ready for kindergarten and mom's group has given me such a great, helpful community. We have found our "village". We attend church at Christ's Church and it was very special for us to get married here. Carol was great to work with and was very prompt during wedding planning. Trevor did an awesome job with our ceremony. I would recommend Christ's Church for a ceremony venue even if you don't attend the church!

name: Christ's Church at Moore Square - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Feeding the hungry. Tending to those less fortunate.These people have a heart of gold. I have observed their self-sacrifice and love for those in need. Truly they are the hands and feet of Christ. They say God works in mysterious ways... The staff and pastor here are miracle that motivates gods work through another level. Saved my family's life by preventing my 4 kids, my wife and I from becoming homeless especially in the cold weather. Stay humble stay blessed stay strong !!! Amen Christ’s Church at Moore Square has no walls but regularly meets to listen, and pray with those who congregate in Moore Square and at the bus station. Eddie and Pat share God's word, provide food, water, and clothing items to the homeless men and women they meet at Moore Square. Because of the faithful and consistent outpouring of Christ's love by these men for these people- I highly endorse this church. These folks teach and minister as Jesus did. I've followed their devotion ministry for years, and the teaching is spot-on. It's the same here at Christ's Church at Moore Square. No denomination, just straight Bible and God's love for us. They ARE the hands and feet of Jesus! There's a place where true Jesus faith is practiced. Meeting physical needs is important, but add a listening ear and people gain significance. Christ's Church at Moore Square makes a difference.

name: Christ's Church of Billings,MT
reviewSummary: Friendly and welcoming place to attend church. Experienced the body of Christ. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
CCV has changed and enriched my life in so many ways for the last 10 years! Pastor Ashley and all the messages and teaching always comes from God and is relevant to real life. They are selfless and embrace our mission to bring all people to Jesus and to Love God and Love People! They are a true blessing in my life! ✝️ We are in love with CCV! I’ve never felt more connected in a church than with CCV. I’m incredibly spiritual, and feel all the warmth and welcoming faces all around. The staff is compassionate and engaging. I’m beyond blessed to be one of the ones to have been invited to go on the CCV mission to Uganda. Life with the lord and with this church is beautiful. All locations are wonderful, we love this one because it’s close to home and works best for when we have Sunday’s off. On Saturdays we enjoy going to the Peoria since it’s fully live. Keep spreading the holy energy, big love! CCV is enjoyable to attend including relevant messages that generate an internal urgency to implement. I always leave feeling refreshed, positive and motivated. I love watching and singing along with the professional musicians who play and sing at every service. Several flat screens throughout the lobby have all the current sports playing, so you won't miss anything. And there are several areas to gather and chat or just hang out and watch whatever sporting event is currently being played. I love love the coffee bar and cafe for made to order coffee, smoothies, sodas and snacks, including sandwhiches, yogurt parfaits, chips, hot cookies and muffins.
Most services you can grab fresh bacon cheeseburgers, hot dogs and other food from the grill. Really a great church for your soul.
Services Saturday 4 pm, 530pm, Sunday 830AM, 10AM 1130AM. Please click 👍 if this was helpful. Such an amazing church and community! We’ve been going for years, our boys have grown up at CCV. So thankful for Pastors Ashley, Mark and Dave for their teaching and guidance. We love the music and all of the volunteers make it so warm and welcoming. If you’re looking for a church, I can’t recommend CCV enough! Wonderful place to experience new perspectives on life. Provides many practical ways to use God's word in your day to day world. The pastors are amazing and sincerely care about everyone that attends. Very welcoming and warm environment. If you come for the first time, a free gift is provided to give you some history on the church and a free meal... depending which campus you are at. I always leave feeling better knowing that I am loved no matter my past. Very positive place.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV)
reviewSummary: Arizona's largest multi-site church with 30,000+ weekly attendees. Famous for high-impact practical teaching by Ashley Wooldridge, modern worship anthems, and state-of-the-art youth and children's sports leagues.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Central Scottsdale - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: Arizona's largest multi-site church with 30,000+ weekly attendees. Famous for high-impact practical teaching by Ashley Wooldridge, modern worship anthems, and state-of-the-art youth and children's sports leagues.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Chandler - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
They provided an excellent tribute to my beloved step mom which was memorialized in a very beautiful tone and with her favorite music. Thank you for being a huge support to my father family and her many colleagues and friends. Daughter invited me to the service and it was very good, variety of people, very kind greeters (John) and ushers. Wonderful people, friendly childcare. We had an amazing experience. They were so nice to our whole family. Definitely will attend again
The food is incredible too! Everyone is friendly. Beautiful outdoor area for kids and to enjoy a meal. Biblically based teachings. Several service times. Saturday night services with child care and live or past weeks online viewing options make it easy to never miss a sermon. Several small group options. The Pastors keep you engaged, the messages are easy to understand. They offer an outline on the app to take notes which is very helpful. I like East Mesa because it is more convenient to my home, but when my granddaughter in Tempe said she wanted to go to church I said yes to the closest campus. Turns out there was a bonus, her father (my son) ended up coming and said he may come to the men's night that is coming up. Praise God.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Downtown Phoenix - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: This place has been open just 8 weeks.. super convenient location, just 5 minutes away from where we live downtown.. The people are so warm and welcoming. We love this church! Worship is fantastic and the message is always relevant and relatable. CCV Downtown Phoenix is truly a blessing! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, loved, and part of a genuine community. The worship is powerful, the messages are impactful and rooted in truth, and the people are warm and uplifting. Pastor Ashley brings such energy and clarity to every message, making it easy to connect and grow in your faith. Whether you're new to church or looking for a fresh start, CCV Downtown is the place to be. I’m so thankful to have found this church—it’s truly changed my life for the better! I found the community I’d been seeking at CCV. Their focus is on loving God and loving people. In the heart of Downtown, there is plenty of opportunity for that. The small campus provides an intimate experience, making it easy to get to know people. It’s a highlight of my week! Yes! You should visit CCV you won’t be disappointed. I visited a few times. I always feel welcomed. I leave feeling blessed & hopeful. DT is a new a growing location. You have nothing to lose… A new life to gain. We've been over a dozen times and every time we go they still ask us if its our first time there then no one else says anything to us lol. Doesnt feel like community

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Midtown - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to ccv midtown to get baptized. Something I think that should be a very special experience. There was 2 of us getting baptized. Myself and my friend. The pastor didn't even look at me or wait for me to answer the questions? Our other friend recorded it and even brought it up afterwards, wondering what that was all about. It was very impersonal and strange and felt like a "drive through" baptism. I'm kind of sad about it! I give it 3 stars though because there were 2 very nice ladies there that showed us around. A place where you feel welcomed, loved and the love of Jesus, God the Father and the Holy Spirit. A great biblical teaching straight from the scriptures led by God. An amazing church. Pastor John and the Midtown  Staff team are reaching the valley for Christ. An excellent staff.  Application based sermons. Great worship and great Christ centered community. The Doorkeepers Of His Kingdom are great LoL
Worship team is anointed  , so theres no reason that building shouldnt be louder than a basebal game . I was welcomed without judgement and nothing but love & kindness . Given a warm breakfast burrito and coffee and they even reach out to invite me back. The world is falling but God will carry us through.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - North Phoenix - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
A friend and I heard about this church and decided to stop in for a Sunday service.  As we pulled into the parking lot we got that Mega Church feel seeing the grounds and worship center.  The large parking lots were being directed by attendants so finding parking was no problem.  Neither of us had been to church for several years and didn’t know fully what to expect.

Upon entry to the very busy lobby entrance I felt we got lost in the sea of parishioners, as we weren’t greeted by any staff or volunteers - they were present, just not enough to greet everyone or at least newcomers.  There is a Cafe which was something I didn’t really expect in a place of worship, but it was nice to be able to grab a snack, coffee or smoothie before the service.

Once it was time for the service we entered and were welcomed by a greeter and there were ushers guiding folks to vacant seating or away from blocked off areas, so it was orderly for the size of the congregation.  There was nice live Contemporary Christian music being played as we arrived for the service. After the music finished a pastor came up onto the stage and commenced the service which happened to be on the book of Revelation.  He turned the service over to another pastor who presented the sermon remotely (possibly prerecorded) as there are multiple CCV campuses around the valley.  It was an enlightening and thoughtful take on the book of Revelation. Something curios about the service was that there was no tithe plates/baskets being passed around before, during or after the sermon (or if they were, they never made it to us).

After the service we looked around a little closer at the other facilities which included an outdoor grill area outside of the Cafe and worship center, along with the Children’s Center and play area.  The Children’s Center was well attended by staff and/or volunteers and there were plenty of children playing in the play area outside with other parents present as well.

All in all it was a nice and lively service to attend, but it would have been nice to have been greeted at the entrance and welcomed to the church. Always felt welcomed here I got baptized here as well. Highly recommended to try out this church. I loved the parent room I used that the first few visits with my newborn and transitioned into the childcare . They have an amazing cafe and don't forget your free coffee for your first time visit So my husband and I had went to this church recently. On the outside we weren't greeted, especially by them that were out side greeters from a distance, rather other people, I am assuming continual comers were even though we were the new ones too. When we had gotten into the sanctuary it was loud, like way too loud. I didn't feel no holy Spirit here. People were just standing around like they were dead and in a trance. We didn't even feel welcomed. In fact the place had felt cold internally, and off, and like they were all about the money. I was invited to attend CCV by my eldest daughter to the downtown location over a few months ago on Buchanan Street. It is so welcoming and beautiful there. It is much further so I decided to come visit for the first time yesterday on Sunday 1/11/2026 to the North Vally Location. It’s only 4.9 miles from my home. It was a very nice service (I was a little late) but do plan on going back. I wasn’t really welcomed or given much notice to but then again I don’t go for all that attention or who’s doing what by looking for others faults. I attend to hear God word. Thank you for making my experience pleasant as I enjoyed the service (New year so beginning with Genesis the year of new beginnings) 🙏✝️✨ I thought this church was more accepting and with the times until a few years ago they had a “saved” gay man preach about how homosexuality is a sin. In this day and age?? To my disgust, the entire room was cheering and clapping this homophobic rhetoric on, that is not backed by scripture in the slightest by the way. I have never gone back to church since. Shame on you.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Peoria - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary:
Biblically solid teachings. Very welcoming staff. Friendly people, and a super Fantastic worship team. Comfortable Inviting atmosphere
All the Pastor's here at CCV are awesome.
We are blessed to be apart of this Church family. Also their Bible study groups have something for everyone, and there are Hundreds to choose from across the West valley. Come check it out. 💯Worth the visit. We attended the CCV North campus on 163rd. in Surprise. There are 18 campuses across the Valley. This place is like heaven on Earth! Watching people get baptized every week feels like being a part of a great revival.
Thank you for giving us faith in God's people again. Best Church in all of Arizona! The pastors are all knowledgeable. All their messages are Bible based, and are able to put it on a level that everyone can understand. If you're looking for a church, I highly encourage you to check out one of the multiple locations they have in Arizona.
The Peoria campus is absolutely beautiful. We always feel a sense of peace anytime we step foot on that campus.
A big shout out to James who has been the absolute best! He has been a huge support for my husband and myself even before we started attending there. We could never thank him enough! Great message even so I was expecting a live speaker. I guess I didn’t know they have live at different time or day. They got everything for everyone just need to get involved to serve. God bless the church and everyone involved. The lead pastor here has lost his ability to manage other churches under their name, allowing the church to be nothing more than a mouthpiece there's no action. There's no accountability. There is limited practicing of the Bible. They will turn their back on the Bible and ignore its practices and callings. Just a modern-day wolf in sheep's clothing is what the sturch is.

name: Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) - Queen Creek - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Christ's Church of the Valley (CCV) for over 10 years, and after recently visiting the Queen Creek location, I can honestly say the culture is just as strong welcoming, genuine, and aligned with what first drew me in; what stands out most is how a church that’s been around for over 40 years continues to grow with intention, investing in local communities and global missions in a way that produces real fruit, especially in the next generation; I’ve heard some people say recorded messages feel less impactful, but from my experience, it actually strengthens the clarity and consistency of the teaching, allowing the message to scale without compromise and for those who prefer it live, you can always attend at the Peoria campus; ultimately, I don’t judge a church by preference but by fruit, and CCV demonstrates the character of God through its impact, its commitment to Jesus-centered teaching, and the way it creates both a large vision and a personal connection through over 800 small groups Arizona has many great churches, but for me, CCV is a place where you can truly come as you are and grow.

From my personal experience attending consistently over the years, CCV is absolutely a Bible-led, Jesus-centered church while every service may not emphasize the same words in the same frequency, the message of Jesus, the work of the Holy Spirit, and the truth of Scripture are clearly present in both teaching and application; I’d encourage anyone to attend a few services or get connected in a group before drawing conclusions, because what you’ll find over time is a church deeply committed to reaching people and pointing them to Christ in a way that’s both authentic and impactful. I can’t say ENOUGH great things about this church.  First off, it’s MORE than a church !  They want to help you transform your life if you’re struggling , help your kids follow Christ and also allow them to participate in amazing sports programs.  Curt and the crew are off to an amazing start at this beautiful church and I’m so grateful to be a part of it ! Thank you CCV QUEEN CREEK! 🙏 I have attending the Queen Creek campus for about a month now.  It’s a very warm and welcoming campus.  Staff and members of the church are very friendly and helpful.  I’m new to the area and enjoying the atmosphere and meeting people. The music is amazing. The people who are serving to help members find their way to what they need is very helpful. These guys and gals are the sweetest ever. The pastor is one of the most amazing I've met ever. The campus is beautiful. They have get togethers so that people can meet each other and be with people who they feel comfortable and like-minded with. I love this church!!! Been looking for something non-denominational. Looking for somewhere I could feel safe and feel like I could trust others. Found it. First service was last Sunday. Beautiful church and friendly people. Definitely plenty of mentions of Jesus and the holy spirt. Only thing I could say negative is that they didn’t have an in person pastor. It was either recorded earlier or live from somewhere else. Great message but less impactful. Will be going again this Sunday and looking forward to it.

name: Christ's Church of Yukon - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary: Christ’s Church of Yukon is a gospel and Christ-centered church that understands its mandate to love God and love others. The people there are consistently engaging the community through their monthly clothing ministry and other special community events. They are a loving group that welcomes all into their family setting. While no church is perfect, this church focuses less on what they are against and more on what they are for—loving others, service, community, and family. Our family loves being a part of this greater Christian family. If you are looking for a solid biblical, loving, community-engaging church, then give them a try. If you are looking for a place that loves God and loves people, this is the place!  A great community of believers who understand we all are saved by grace. Wonderful worship, strong Bible-based teaching from the pulpit, classes, to the children and youth programming. We work to bring the Good News of Jesus outside the church walls to our community here, and abroad. Come see what God is doing at Christ’s Church-Yukon! Great Family Church! CCY has a great spirit about it, missions, families, mix of all ages and local support for the community is CCY Yukon. Many activities to do and prayer groups to get involved in. I love going there. Pastor Clay is also a great minister and Pastor. From activities together to local and overseas missions, Christ's Church Yukon is a great place to bring your family. CCY is such a welcoming church home for everyone!  If you are reading this I truly hope you visit us. My husband and I moved to Oklahoma 17/18. We started searching for a church home in 2018. There were a lot of great places, but they didn’t speak to us or feel like the right fit.  We wanted to feel welcome and not lost in a crowd, enjoy praise and worship, have great sermons and a place for my kids to grown up loving Jesus with others. We also, wanted to have opportunities to serve the community and give back and build upon our selves with small groups. All of these boxes were checked and more. God has shown us so much love since we have started at CCY. I encourage anyone reading to join us and I’m thankful for all of you that have made us feel at home here! I absolutely love this church. The people here are so down to earth. They treat everyone like family. Everyone has been so open and is willing to help with any situation. I have never met a congregation that has made me feel so welcome. If you are looking for a church home like I was look no further stop by and see what I'm talking about.

name: Christ's Community Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended here for 3 years.  Hated leaving because of these great people.  I would give highest review possible.
Preaching and worship are very good. First in today. Great experience, I see the fellowship and the music was great Brian has good sound Bible teaching...highly recommended if you are looking for a home church that feels like you are part of a family. Very nice place enjoyed my friends service very much! Thank you guys This place is wonderful service is good my kind of place you go in wait itz 1hour straight

name: Christ's Community Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is small enough to feel known, big enough to find friends you can relate to. Lots of young families and a great children’s ministry, but also lots of opportunities for older folks too. Nate’s preaching is thoughtful and engaging and always based in biblical truth. We’re so glad we found a church home here five years ago. Not sure came up.as visited, but no need for church in life. Follow your own path of positive vibes and you will live live to the fullest.
Religion is only taught to you not natural at all, think before you follow. Again you "follow" s faith. You must lead your life and let others tell you how to. Life is amazing once you start to see it clear for yourself. If you want a pastor who spends his time online gossiping, criticizing, running down and putting down other pastors, then this is the place for you.
Nate Pyle, the pastor, says "“I dream of being a part of a church where true transformation happens as people encounter the risen Jesus. Where it is safe for all of us to express our deepest needs and be met with the grace of Jesus in a kind smile, a comforting embrace, or words, “'Me too'.”
Barf and puke.
No truly tansformed pastor would gossip and run down fellow pastors the way Nate Pyle does.
He should spend less time gossiping and more time re-writing his weak sermons and writing what on earth his church believes. Friendly, intentional, and Christ centric--not in that order! It's a great place to worship God! Fantastic community

name: Christ's Community Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful church full of beautiful people! Very faithful, biblical preaching. Lots of programs for kids, including nursery and children’s Sunday school. They also have a playground that is a great place to hangout after church. God is at work in this church! Love Pastor Mike and his wife Jamie and their leadership.  Big things are happening and it’s exciting to be a part of of what God is doing here. Meet new friends! Worship @ 10:30am. Join a small group! We love our small group. A year ago when Covid shut everything down, our Pastor called many families, got their shopping list, went to Costco, bought their list, delivered it to their homes, and offered prayers when he delivered their needs.  Pastor Mike Dahling is not flashy or braggadocio, he just cares about people.  Do you need someone who cares and teaches and lives the words of Christ?  We are here on Liberty Mills. This church is very welcoming! My family and I love attending and have greatly enjoyed getting to know everyone. Lovely traditional worship, meaningful and Gospel-filled preaching, and heartfelt fellowship. ❤️❤️❤️ A great church where you, as a person, actually matter. The minister and congregation are friendly. You don't feel like a number, you feel like family.

name: Christ's Community Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Went to brunch that was held at the church. I can't give an opinion on the church itself because I did not attend the Sunday service. However the people at the brunch were inviting and kind and overall loving. I do plan to viist on a Sunday and will update my review after. Community Church is a safe place to be at and I appreciate the church prayers and welcoming. This congregation is very friendly and loves its neighbors.  We have a lot of activities for the kids and adults, too.  The pastor's sermons are so right on and based on the Bible.  He is also fun.  There are many, many volunteers any time something needs to get done.  The people are the church! Our family discovered CCC via After the Bell Program and we could not feel more blessed. We absolutely love this Church. The leadership, staff and community members who serve are wonderful people who always make us feel loved and welcome!  We have definitely found our home here. If you have not made it out I recommend you do; you will not be disappointed! You will leave feeling AWESOME! Thank you Pastor Randy and “ALL “ of you that make this all possible for us. And thank you Pastor Serena for loving our daughter like your own. We appreciate you all so much! Dinner on Wednesday evening’s is one of our favorite weekly visits to CCC; so much to offer our family and friends. Come on out!!! God Bless all my brothers and sisters of the world. ❤️ Today was my First time at a church and I loved it. My sons first time in an actual daycare/nursery and he had a blast. I would definitely come back. The whole staff and people were friendly. I definitely left with God and i felt like god spoke to me. Thank you very much

name: Christ's Community Church - Hayward Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending CCC since I was a child, and it has truly become my second family. Growing up here, I have been surrounded by loving, supportive people who have encouraged me through every stage of life. Some of my favorite memories are from Vacation Bible School (now Kids Bible Camp), where I learned valuable lessons and always looked forward to coming back each year!!

What makes CCC so special is the genuine care and support from its members. Whether you’re celebrating life’s joys or facing challenges, there is always someone willing to listen, pray, and help. The sense of community, kindness, and faith here is something I am incredibly grateful for.

CCC has played a huge role in shaping who I am today, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming church family and a place to grow in faith. ❤️🙏 Christ’s Community Church (CCC) is a place that feels like home. My family attended services here for 12 years. On Sunday mornings we always received an encouraging message from the Word of God. Pastors Zac and Sue care deeply for their flock. The congregation of CCC comes from a wide variety of ethnic backgrounds and faith traditions. This church reflects the diversity of people in the Bay Area. It is a special place to worship. It was hard for me to go to a new church alone, without knowing anyone. I felt very welcomed from the first time I attended. I took the membership class and became a church member. I felt such love and warmth as I met more people. Recently I was hospitalized for 2 weeks. I had many prayers and visits from church members. Two women from Women's Bible Study brought Holy Communion to me. My faith has grown as  I have been attending Sunday Worship and Women's Bible Study. What an amazing church.  I’ve been a church member for 34 years .  People are so warm and make you feel like part of the family. Family groups and activities are offered to participate in.  Sunday worship includes praise and worship songs and God’s word is included in the encouraging message . If you're looking for a church family and solid Biblical teaching, I invite you to join us on Sunday morning's at 10a.m. and stay for coffee afterward to get to know us. We'd love to meet you.

name: Christ's Fellowship Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ’s Fellowship Church loves Jesus Christ immensely.

If one word can be used to describe CFC, that word would be GENUINE. Genuine worship, genuine fellowship, a group of genuine Jesus-loving Christians. Top it off with solid doctrine preached weekly! I thank God daily for bringing my family to this church.

Come, be set free! (John 8:30-36) Me and wife just started going to Christ's fellowship church my wife has been to several churches and for me it was my first time in church in 50 years + we have gone 4 weeks in a row now and I really love the whole experience looking forward to becoming members that's how much we enjoy it and getting a relationship with god is so important to me and my wife we will continue to pray and return to our new church thanks and may god bless us all 🙏🙏🙏 Great Church! Sound teachings, loving congregation, awesome bible studies! My family really enjoys it here! Feels like home! This is a word preaching church. A church that loves and show so much love to each other. I am glad to be a part Fantastic family oriented and loving congregation serving the Lord and each other. It feels like and is home.

name: CHRISTCHURCH MIAMI - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary: Christchurch Miami is a truly special place! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed like family. The worship is Christ-centered and uplifting, the teaching is biblical and practical, and the community is full of genuine love and warmth. You’ll find people of all ages and backgrounds coming together as a faith family on mission. If you’re looking for a church in Miami where you can grow in your faith, connect with others, and discover your God-given purpose this is it! This church has helped me grow in my faith so much. The community is super welcoming. The worship is so authentic and the teaching so practical.  I really would encourage anyone to check it out if you’re in the area! Godly leadership, biblical teaching, faith family on a mission. I encourage you to visit more than once and get to know the church. You will be pointed to Christ and all he has done for you! Very theologically sound, heartfelt worship, very friendly people and well organized. Family community feel. Love this church family… caring, authentic, and Christ-centered! Helps my Faith become relevant & practical

name: ChristChurch Presbyterian Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
We joined this church in 2013 (6 years now) and have been blessed to have pastors preach the gospel. This church is blessed with many wonderful families and little children. name: ChristChurch Tulsa - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
I was denied entry due to being an addict. I was and had been sober when I went on Easter morning. The preacher came out and would not allow me to come in. From what I've understood Jesus didn't turn away the sinners. #HerSecretShame #domesticabuseawareness
Thank you to ChristChurch Tulsa for not having my car towed yesterday. Lucifer is so busy trying to keep me from spreading my message and telling my story. My car stopped yesterday while I was driving. And where else do you go but to God when you need help? I came back this morning and, thankfully, my car was still here. But then I locked my keys in it when I got out to check the oil. 🤦🏽‍♀️ I will be coming to one of your services so that I can express my gratitude to you in person. I almost died over little things several times in my life. I've decided to live for the little things as well. It may only be parking lot to some...but this was my safe place. This brings me back memories... I was a member to this church with my family, I was a child to teenager when my family moved to a different church, we attended Christ Church for more than 10 years, this was way before the larger part of the building was built, at the time I attended there, it was just the orange part of the church and it said Christ Church at the top in white... The red house next door, that's where the previous pastor use to live, his name was pastor Fred and Cynthia Brown, I remember there was a wooded area next door of the church as well and when I was 14 or 15, we would cut down trees because pastor Fred Brown had a vision to build a building there connected to Christ Church to make it bigger and I just want to thank you for making that possible who ever continued pastor Fred Brown's legacy... Just so you know pastor Fred Brown passed away a couple of years ago, very sad but he's in Heaven and we will see him again... A lot of memories at this church... Loving the church and congregation. This church is so welcoming and thrives on a spirit of community. Father Everett Lee is fantastic as well as all of his support team. Services at 9 & 11 with children's church available. This is a wonderful church if you are looking right now. Everyone is treated like family, and it is a very great place to worship. Pastors Anthony and Linda Harper really make you feel welcomed. Great children's ministry and praise and worship as well. This will be my permanent place of worship.

name: ChristChurch Westerville - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary:
My first visit to WCC was in November of 2023. Everyone was welcoming and better than that, just real. When they say '"come as you are," they truly mean it.
The people of the church walk the walk; feeding & clothing those in need and praying for ALL churches in Columbus. I'm happy to call WCC my church home. Powerful worship and very loving people..I'm new here and was so genuinely welcomed..thank you CCW We love our church and felt at home immediately. Have been attending over a year now, the services and worship team are always meaningful and every person has been welcoming and helpful. There are so many opportunities to plug in, study the Bible, meet friends, serve the community and most importantly grow in your relationship with Jesus! I’ll save a seat for you! Had a great morning visiting WCC. Our family was at the 11:00am service, but they also offer a 9:00am time. Parking was easy, and we followed the regulars to the main entrance. The lobby was welcoming and they have a coffee shop inside with lots of options.

Service started with a few worship songs led by a team that represented the multigenerational congregation. This was followed by a sermon from a guest speaker who was also a church member. There was time after the sermon to reflect on the message during another worship song, then a final song to close the service. Service was just under an hour. I’d recommend WCC to any locals looking for a place to attend and participate. Great overall experience! Friendly people and welcoming building. Worship was amazing and the teaching truly hit home. Definitely coming back!

name: Christian Assembly
reviewSummary: Thriving multi-generational community in Eagle Rock bridging Pasadena and Glendale, praised for inspiring worship, life-giving small groups, and kids ministries.

name: Christian Assembly Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm thrilled to share my experience at Christian Assembly Church, a vibrant and welcoming community under the exceptional leadership of Pastor Robert Concepcion. Since Pastor Robert took the helm a few years ago, the Filipino community within the church has seen remarkable growth, now boasting over 200 active members. These devoted individuals are not just attendees but pillars of the church, deeply engaged in serving, praying, and passionately preaching the Gospel of Jesus.

Pastor Robert is truly a servant leader, embodying the heart of a shepherd with his dedicated and compassionate approach to guiding his flock. His leadership not only inspires but also fosters a strong sense of unity and purpose among us. The church's atmosphere is one of genuine warmth and fervent faith, making it a wonderful place to grow spiritually and connect with fellow believers.

Whether you're looking for a church home or a place to explore your faith, Christian Assembly Church and its thriving Filipino community welcome you with open arms. It’s a place where you can truly feel the love of Christ in action. Highly recommended! I love the Young Adults community. They are very welcoming, the worship and sermons are generally great! And I found it very easy to get connected with people through their life groups I went to this church since birth until leaving the church in my Junior year of high school. I left as I was shunned for speaking out against homophobic preaching from our youth pastor. I tried to have discussions with other pastors and was told that “The bible teaches that marriage is between a man and a woman” and to not question it past that. Youth groups should be a place for children to learn the LOVE of God, preaching HATE to lgbtq+ individuals is not what God teaches. Following a faith blindly and being told to not question the pastor (a non-holy man) is not what God teaches. Was invited by a friend Rico for Woman's Night worship was amazing everyone singing to Lord God & the Hope for Garden sang was very beautiful made me cry the joy God brings. I love to come for Bible Study hopefully next Wednesday It's a beautiful church and a wonderful place to pray and listen to God's words

CC is a very mission oriented church, partnering both locally and globally, with big and small scale mission groups/work. name: Christian Fellowship Church
reviewSummary:
March 14, 2019 attended Unashamed forever tour here! Excited to see 4 of my favorte Christian Rap Artist tonight! Lecrae, Trip Lee, KB, Andy Mineo! I came late (30 min) so take what I say with a grain of salt. I was driving in from Maryland so I live pretty far. I’ve been trying to find a good church to go to.

There weren’t any ushers or volunteers randomly standing around. I was used to that from the small town church I grew up going to (even if you were late there were always volunteers). Nobody really acknowledged me (but that’s okay!). A bunch of people were talking outside the auditorium…no one was really paying attention to the pastor preaching. I just shrugged it off but still found it a little bizarre.

Quietly found a seat in the auditorium. The pastor was talking about the Pharisees and having the heart of a Christian and it’s not just about your outward actions? I don’t know. A lot got lost in translation.

Again, I came late so I really want to give this church another chance.  The pastor was not the most eloquent pastor I’ve listened to. He was hard to follow at times.

I sympathize with him a bit because the church was dead. Not lively at all. The people outside the auditorium seemed to be enjoying themselves more than those inside the auditorium during worship and the sermon. It kind of made me sad.

I will give it another shot because I want to be fair (with me being late and all) but I’m not sure this place is for me. I found the whole experience very cold. I will go back in 2 weeks and change my review if I feel differently. Great place to worship. They offer many classes and have children's, teen, and young adult teachings and classes.  It's a church of diversity. They host community events with serving it as well. This church is another definition of a fluff church. And I'm focusing on the people that consider themselves volunteering and Christians.  Today was my first time visiting this church and waking in it was beautiful on the outside, like some things that are beautiful on the outside, this inside was rotting with the people inside. I walked up the stairs assuming there was a top entrance not to disrupt service as I was late.  I ran into this brunette, who didn't introduce herself, but seemed taken back that I was there interrupting her conversation with her other volunteers. She asked what I was looking for I said honestly I don't know. She asked where I was trying to go, I honestly said I don't know I'm new.  She walked me ONLY to the top of the stairs and pointed, go there for first time and go around the corner for kids service.  REALLY that's being Christian? That's helping your fellow man. Just point. Lord if you can see some of your children now and the kindness that stops only at their comfort. She could've walked me down introduced me to the front desk and down me the kids center, but no she was apparently performing heart surgery and going out of her way would ruin that person's life (sarcasm, I apparently interrupted her conversation and she couldn't be bothered).

I couldn't stay after this experience. I can't speak on the service but after this experience with one person filled me with disappointment that it doesn't matter how expensive your county maybe. What is portrayed by what you pay can still lack what you are taught. Money or not - what is on the outside does not represent the fake heart that lives underneath. I truly don’t recommend this place specially if you don’t want to be disrespected don’t go here smh what a bad experience. This place is a Godsend. If you are in need of help with food then I would suggest for you to call this place. They do usually have certain days & times that they have and distribute food but if they can help, they will. These are good people and they love to help those they can. Hugs, love and prayers to the people at Christian Fellowship of El Cajon. Friendly , warm, and inviting.  Offering a wide range of assistance from discipleship training to family restoration ASL classes bible studies

name: Christian Growth Ministries
reviewSummary: I LOVE MY CHURCH FAMILY SO WELCOMING AND YOU FEEL THE LOVE ITS LIKE NO OTHER. MY PASTORS ARE AWESOME LEADERS AND THEY LOVE YOU FORREAL COME AND WITNESS A MIGHTY MOVE OF GOD. I came to bring my son to service he is a member and I stayed to wait for him and to hear the word and I really enjoyed the service and the people, and the Pastor had a great message and I came again the next week.I really enjoy the service I'm gonna keep attending it may be my new church home soon, but come and visit u definitely won't be disappointed First time for their food bank nd clothing they were very generous peopls and gave my family nd i a prayer blessings Went to this location for a event, had a great time the members were friendly and the food was delicious If you are looking for a spirit filled, loving , welcoming church this is the place to be!!

name: Christian Harvest Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: The new world of difference between people who love GOD. HE'S MANIFESTED as LOVE here on historical Route 66 ....LOVE EVERYWHERE. ..... GOD BLESS. ........... Freedom :) God's church!! Home sweet home The church is large and beautiful, and the people inside are very friendly. The sermons by the pastors and preachers are excellent, and there are special programs for special holidays. A free charitable lunch is served after Sunday worship. Thanks and Praise God!

Been going to CHC for quite awhile now and love,love,love all the venues they use to help others!!!

Isn’t God GREAT!!!! I was raised very old school when it comes to religion and I heard one clear thing mentioned. Now I understand the times have changed but church especially should not. The issue I had was when the minister used the phrase "his or her church" during his prayer. No there is nothing wrong with women playing a role in the church but the role of leading the church as a pastor is clearly set out to be a man. This church is a very awesome great church I love it and look forward to being there every Sunday you truly feel the holy spirit when you walk thru them doors and I love it they have many great loving caring people who go here as well THIS CHURCH ROCKS! I enjoy singing praise songs to GOD. The sermons always seems to ring a bell concerning my life. I leave feeling a heart full of love. We have been here for a little over a year. From day one we have been made to feel like part of the family. Come by, visit, say hi. You will feel as welcome as we did. Can,t wait to see/meet y,all.
Lee, Dee, Nevaeh and J

name: Christian Hills Church
reviewSummary:
An amazing church with top tier pastors who preach the Bible in an easy to understand and relatable way. They have an amazing school also. The congregation is super welcoming and kind. Wonderful place to grow with God and in community with others. A true “light on the hill” for the community. Wonderful church and congregation.  I worshipped at Christian Hills for years until I moved an hour away.  I studied and grew in relationship to the Lord.  I learned so much from each person at this church.  The pastors and leaders are warm and welcoming.  Pastor Mike even officiated at my father’s service.  Will never forget his kindness.  I made many friends here. Great place for worship, wonderful message. God focused, Jesus centered, Holy Spirit filled.
Non-denominational, fantastic experience. Looking for a church home? Give this place a try. I found mine! I feel very grateful and blessed to have come back across this church. I have memories of going here as a child when my parents would take me here on Sundays, they look and faces of the church have changed since then but the home like atmosphere has not. CHC still has very loving and kind people here every Sunday and is lead by Pastor Mike who is awesome. Myself and my wife love it here and although we no longer live in the area we always will stop in when ever we are in town. If you are looking for a church that is filled with great people and on a more smaller scale than some of the larger church’s in the area then this is the perfect place for you. I will always think of Christian Hills as my home base church. They welcomed me and my son when I was just 22. The people are genuinely warm caring and on fire for God. I moved to the northern suburbs last year and have started attending a new church, but this will always be my church and the standard I hold any other church to. If you’re looking for a new home church with biblical teachings, and a pastoral staff that really cares, this is the place to come to.

name: Christian Home Christian Church - Apex Campus
reviewSummary: Today April 3rd, my wife and I got our Covid 19 vaccine shot here. The people were so friendly and was working like a well oiled machine. Thank you so much for this event Where can I began !?…..  a church ? More like a dictatorship! I’ve been quiet for over 10 years and today is the last straw… I was born into this church in 1998 when Dr. Gibson was alive. Back then the church FELT like a place of worship if you ever had a problem that was the place to go ! But unfortunately ever sense his passing back in 2008 the church has fell apart! The rules and regulations are ridiculous! I’ve seen multiple people KICKED out of church during service including myself …. As a 25 year old black male I find it a shame than when you try to run to the church the pastor looks at you with his nose turnt up with his eyes rolled back as if his stuff doesn’t stink… the church doesn’t have a decent choir neither anymore due to whatever reason… the whole atmosphere has been shifted toward a negative presence.. from the time he was first impeached to now ! I was born into this church but for someone to tell me I’m not able to come there to worship is a shame ! Most pastors would want to see a young black male trying to do better for himself and his family but not this guy or this church !! We’ve lost so many people in the congregation over the years due to the way the church has been ran, and it’s so sad to watch it keep being destroyed with Blasphemy…. I hope this reaches back to whom it may concern because this guys character needs to come to the light ! It’s a shame every other pastor in apex feels the same exact way !  1 CORINTHIANS 13:11 I want to say thank you so much for being so polite and helpful when I was there to get my vaccine God blesseach one of you Pastor Green was inspirational! Great place to Worship!

name: Christian Home MBC - Richmond Campus
reviewSummary: The word of God is spoken in Spirit and Truth the pastor Albert Featherstone is on fire for Christ Jesus, For the Lord giveth wisdom and out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding...Amen Pastor Albert Featherstone is Very Good Speaking And Preaching The Word Of God 🙌 Amen Because it's the house of God and I'm a member at this Church Good church Good place to give thanks to God

name: Christian Hope Church - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent church if you are looking for a God fearing community and a Bible centered teaching. Jesus Christ is coming soon. Amen. While in town, I visited this church with my sister.  I felt the Lord was truly in this place.  The Word was preached and worship was sincere.  If I lived here full time, I would be attending this church as my home church. if you are looking for a church that teaches "Truth", that flows with God's love than this is the Church for you.  We may not be big in numbers, but we are big at heart!!  We have children's church, youth church, nursery, prayer meeting on Tuesday morning, Church wide prayer first Friday of the month, last Wednesday of the month we have prayer. Our youth Pastors take the youth to conferences and activities to help them grow Spiritually.  Pastor Mark Watkins and Pastor Melanie Watkins are both beautiful people that walk the talk.  I honored and special that God sent me to Christian Hope Church!!!  Thank you Jesus If you want to be a part of a church that becomes family, this is the place!  I felt welcome and connected with people even on my first visit. I'm happy to call Christian Hope Church my "home church."  Pastor Mark gives enthusiastic sermons, and when he can't be there, Pastor Shane and Pastor Chad do great at sharing The Word of God. Pastor Mark is the best kept secret in Warner Robins! Come if you want to hear a word from God.

name: Christian Institute-Spiritual - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. Come for services on Sunday at 11 am. Open-minded and small. We talk about various topics after the lecture. You will be warmly welcomed.
Come back later for the Mind over Movies Friday night. Great place for brief services on Sunday and recovery meetings during the week.

name: Christian Joy Center - El Paso Campus
reviewSummary:
One of the best churches I have ever been to, by far.
The members of this church are incredibly welcoming, and the love in this place is felt the moment you walk in. Bishop Mikel Brown goes above and beyond to make sure the Word is understood in a way that truly reaches every heart.

I was baptized through this church and dedicated my child here, and since becoming a member, my faith has not only been renewed.It has grown stronger than ever. The worship at the Border event shifted my mentality in both my career and my walk with God. It helped me level up spiritually and mentally in ways I didn’t even know I needed.

The Christian Joy Center has given my family a new, stronger foundation rooted in faith, peace, and purpose. Miss Alma is amazing at guiding you to every resource the church offers and making sure you feel supported and connected.

If I could give ten stars, I would. This church has changed my life for the better. Thank you God for all the work the members and Bishop have put in to make this a reality for our community. Red flag after red flag. It started the day before when the Holy Spirit whispered “no” to me. My wife had been to a seperate event that she liked and wanted to check out Sunday service so She needed peace of mind about it.  1st a swat looking officer searched my wife and I before we made it into the building, Never in over 40 years of assembling has this happened or have I seen it. Then the first greeter like a robot tried to direct us like cattle to fill out a business card, I said no maybe later, but somehow we still got funneled to a lady at table to fill out a “business card” is what they called it all the while trying to talk to us about getting the children in children’s church and nursery. We like to take our 4 and 2 year olds into worship when we visit a new church before just pushing them into childcare. We get in the sanctuary and a sister immediately escorts us to the back row because of our children and says we have to sit there, no freedom . I take my sons to the stage to check out their music setup and I’m praying and some guy makes me feel uncomfortable again titling himself elder so and so and making sure I know his title. Bruh.

The message was all about increase. My 2 year was bored and very active so I took him out. We were immediately stopped and told no one is allowed in the foyer with the nice leather seats, or maybe it was because of my son, not sure. Either way that shuffled us to their “ overflow “ room which is just a kitchen with hard metal chairs with a tv playing the sermon with like one scripture . Terrible experience. At the end we were back in the sanctuary and the security guarded the  bishop and escorted him out like a rockstar after his ending prayer. Just felt so prideful, and zero freedom unless you were the dancing guy at the alter showing the whole church your blue underwear and immodest outfit. there were more red flags like how they introduced the bishop as “ the angel of our church”….   I’ve never experienced so many errors and gut check feels I don’t think in all my years of assembling and ministry. This church needs series brokenness , freedom, deliverance humbling. YHWH help them Incredible Mind Love is what I can say when I went. When you set foot inside the campus you will have a full dose of fresh awakening. You have to check it out and you can feel the Positive Energy all around you. I wanted to like it because it was recommended but it’s not for me or my small kids. They search my diaper bag, ok fine, but me taking my baby to service seemed like an inconvenience and so they sit me in the back. There’s “guards” with bullet proof vests and handguns, it feels over the top and in my opinion they don’t have their priorities straight, God protects and the church is there to praise God and be a community. If I breast feed I have to go to a separate room which is dark and I have all to myself so that’s ok but I have to ask every time to unlock it. But then my 2 year old wanted to eat a snack. You can’t eat or drink at service except for water so somehow I ended up in the kitchen which was freezing for my then 5 month old and 2 year old in a hard chair. My 4 and 6 year old enjoyed their own class but that was that. Everyone was very nice upon arrival but as the service started there was so much talk about finances, then the pastor actually said he does not really evangelize anymore that people are going to do what they are going to do🤔 The scripture they read must be different than the version of the Bible I read cause I thought souls are what we are supposed to be winning for the kingdom and not to worship money? It’s as close to Joel Olstein as you can get

name: Christian Leaf Center - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary: It is simply fantastic!! Leaf Church—I love being part of something new that God is doing! Great church! The pastor are amazing God fearing people Beautiful and welcoming.

name: Christian Life - Austin Campus - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
Really enjoy the the atmosphere. Very friendly and welcoming. Pastor Brad is a great person and very cheerful when spreading the word. My 4yr old loves the kids rooms and never wants to leave. The coffee shop is good. Not pricey. Seating is comfortable. Wow, wow, wow--if you are looking for a diverse church, this is the place! I am so excited to have found a church that I can call home and serve. I love the pastor and the team. I am so excited to share, and I hope you guys come and check it out.

Make sure to go to the welcome center after and speak to the team.

Also, for a midweek service on Wednesday at 7pm.

So excited for you to be there! Just moved to Austin needed a church to go to today. And i must say, the church is amazing.  The music is good, the greeters are welcoming, the message was even better. Cant wait to continue listening to the message. Also I love the fact that there is multiple services. My mind is at ease now You can truly feel the presence of God here and the worship team is 10/10. Every service lifts my spirit and the pastors always relate everything back to the Bible, stay on subject, and never make you feel uncomfortable. Their preaching is easy to understand and relatable. This church is wonderful for beginning Christians, especially if you are unsure what to do with the spirit of God or Jesus. There are so many groups you can join and be a part of, making it easy to feel connected. They are very organized with parking. When the main lot fills up, they direct you to park at Burger Stadium or further out, and they have shuttle buses and golf carts running every 2 to 5 minutes. There is a cafe and free coffee, and if you are a first time guest they give you a gift and front parking. They have youth groups and a young adults service every Tuesday with Pastor Sam, who is amazing for that age group, plus services every Wednesday at 7 PM and three services on Sunday. They offer Spanish translation, ASL interpretation, and earplugs and headphones for kids or anyone who needs them. I am part of the LGBTQ community and I feel completely welcomed here. Come as you are. Everyone is very friendly and will do their best to accommodate your needs.
If you're looking for a church, highly suggest to come here. Everyone is welcomed. Wish I could give it a negative! And if you're LGBTQ+ community do yourself a favor and don't even attend. Mission statement says, "Come as you're and allow God to move YOU where he wants you to be"
Which that's a lie! That's God's job.
Am I upset, absolutely!
I have been coming to this church for over 10+yrs and recently was asked to step down as an usher because of my lifestyle. Big communication error on their part! Then asked can we even attend this church after?!? Which is valid! But now understand! It's your church, and your place of business at the end of the day! What i don't appreciate is how they went about telling me and my wife after knowing we were married! Yall are all about a certain LOOK AND CLEARLY WANT PEOPLE TO CHANGE ON YOUR TIME, NOT GOD'S! HIGHLY DISAPPOINTED IN EVERYONE WHO WAS INVOLVED!!!💔❤️‍🩹

name: Christian Life - Murfreesboro Campus
reviewSummary: Great church filled with friendly people.  They offer youth, children and an array of small group classes that support different demographics and interests.  Pastor Ron builds his sermons from the scriptures and is thorough. Pastor Landon is, as well.  Pastor Shawn and the worship team leads the church into a powerful time of giving God praise. Come join us next Sunday at 10. This church is friendly and loving. They have a great worship team and the pastor had a great sermon that was entertaining  yet educational.  I will be back as my schedule allows No church is more loving and easier to connect. We love it! Christian Life has been a great church for my family. Everyone here(that we've met so far in ministry, worship, etc.) takes being a vessel for God's word and a light to the world to heart. I can't say I've ever been to a church where the pastors and leaders are so approachable, yet so profoundly impactful in their ministry. Our lives have been forever changed for the better by the love and teaching we've received here. Can't say enough about this place. Amazing church, rooted in Christ. We love how easy it is to plug in and get connected. Our kids look forward to every Sunday too!

name: Christian Life Cathedral - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
The people here are friendly and diverse. The leadership seems genuinely interested in the congregation and their spiritual growth. Many people call this church their home for good reason. Traditional values are strong here.

Also, this church hosts both a Trail Life USA troop and one for the American Heritage Girls. If you're looking for strong alternatives to the Boy Scouts or Girl Scouts, this is definitely the place. Both troops are very active and well run. We’ve been going to CLC as a family here for almost four years.  Our kids love Children’s Church and we really appreciate the warmth, diversity, music and overall joyful spirit of the congregation and pastor. The chapel is a wonderful option when you need a quiet place throughout the week to pray/process (in picture). Probably the best church I have ever found. The people, warm welcoming,the music is top notch and will inspire you down to your very soul. Messages are in depth and will stir you to listen, act and grow. Awesome Bible believing church. I thoroughly enjoyed the choir and the timely message! Loved the smaller venue to watch We the Kingdom place.  Beautiful campus.

name: Christian Life Center - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: I love attending Christian Life center.I love that the pastor and his wife are genuine and very humble people.I love the freedom to worship God to the fullest measure!!! I absolutely love the heart of the people because they have the heart of God and the awesome presence of God!!!! Very uplifting and loving atmosphere!!! Spirit-filled Spirit led. The gospel of Jesus Christ is preached. The hungry are fed. The naked or clothed. And yes here we are God is our attitude towards God everyday for years now Your church might be a fantastic one, but as a fellow Christian who drives past your marquis every day, it is embarrassing that you have had "Here we are God" displayed for over two years now! Honestly . . . what's the point? Doesn't this have to make non-Christians think that we're all a bunch of idiots to think that God Almighty doesn't know the location of every believer on the face of the earth? Doesn't this have to make non-Christians think that we as Christians have nothing better to say to the world? It seems like someone at your church is trying to make a point, but . . . what point can it possibly be? At least put a new scripture verse on your marquis several times a year, because at least we know that God's Word never returns void. Me and my daughter went here one evening after hearing they do a dinner and service upon our arrival we was treated less then average we ended up eating our dinner outside on the ground after bein tossed back and forth between 2 lines really rude and short andbwe never figured out wat the 2nd line was for wood not recommend this to anyone Great place to worship God great people and fellowshipping they also host an awesome food pantry and dinner on Wed evenings

name: Christian Life Center - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary: This church made my best friend try to kill herself TWICE just for being her genuinely get better, open minded staff✌️ Love this church I have nothing but great things happened in my life since I started attending CLC and love all the leaders and Pastor Steven. I made great friends and relationships here. Come as you are the doors are wide open this is a no judgement church that focus on developing leaders for the kingdom of God. Fantastic non-denominational church. Atmosphere is fantastic and the pastoral staff make you feel welcomed. The singing is nice. I enjoy hearing the Pastor’s relatable message the most. Church is about 2 hours, but the time goes by fast. My 5 year old goes to children’s church. I wish they broke down the age groups a bit more for the kids, but she enjoys the energy regardless. If you’re reading this, Jesus is real and He loves you oh so very much.  He is waiting for you to call on Him. Come to this church and ask more about this Jesus. They’ll be happy to tell you about the Good News❤️ Heaven sent love. I am truly blessed. I wish to thank everyone for the love and support ❤️  you have shown. God has truly shown countenance upon me. May the joy I feel in my soul show you the way and may all of God's glory light the way. Amen My home.  When you walk into this house and take a seat at the table, you can be sure to walk out full with the best flavors that was served to you from that pulpit. You go back wanting more.( Jesus said feed my sheep) in this place you get feed here. ❤️

name: Christian Life Center - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been attending CLC coming up on 10 years. The loving, caring, and compassionate hearts  of our pastors and congregation plus the drawing of God's Divine Holy Spirit has kept us there. We love how our pastor teaches and preach directly from the Word of God and our worship  team is a blessing to our congregation! We are growing in our walk with Jesus together as a church family. The very first time we attended CLC, I felt an overwhelming sense of peace. I just knew the Lord was present in that place. After the service, my husband looked at me and said, “It felt like Jesus was sitting right next to me the whole time.” That was all the confirmation I needed—we had found our church home.

Twenty-five years later, it’s not just the amazing pastors, the wonderful congregation, the heartfelt outreach, the sweet children’s ministry, or the Bible-based messages that keep us coming back. It’s the fact that every time we walk through those doors, we experience that same intimate encounter with the Lord that we felt on our very first visit. I love my CLC family.  We have been part of CLC for about 30 years and don't plan on leaving. I came into Lafayette for work this week and decided to attend their 10am service.  Was warmly greeted when I came in and the venue was very clean and well decorated.  The service began and I'm happy to say I very much enjoyed the subject and delivery by the pastor.  He's very thoughtful and passionate.  The congregation was missing some of their regulars because summer break had just started some there were lots of seating.  The worship was nice.  I would gladly attend again if I was back in the area. People that go there have love in their heart. If you are feeling hopeless, unappreciated and at the end of your rope don't give up. As long as your heart is beating there is still hope for you. Jesus said 'All who come unto Me , I will in no wise cast out'. Call on Jesus and ask him to be merciful and forgive and save you and The Almighty God will hear and save. Need a friend come by and ask for Bob. Would be happy to introduce you to some great people that were there for me the day I came and walked through the door. Come by Sunday at 9:30am and get some coffee and a doughnut. Service at 10am.

name: Christian Life Center - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: The atmosphere of love in this church is something to behold. Love Christian Life Center! The most loving group of people you have ever met. The pastor teaches you about the bible.

name: Christian Life Center - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: It's so beautiful to feel God's presence and Love I was lonely looking for a home, and not only did I find it but I found family here at christain life center. I'm an outsider I wasn't raised in a church home so them welcoming me and believing I can change and transform into the woman I am becoming made me praise the lord more. Loving, caring, spiritual church. I will come back🛐 Such a beautiful group of people! 😇

name: Christian Life Center - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Sound doctrine church! No "light" Jesus here! You want the truth word, this is the place! I've been going to CLC for 6 years and I've seen the power of God here. You can really feel the sincerity in this church from the music to the preaching. I love this church and if you're looking for a church to attend you should stop by and check us out. An on time Word!
Pastor preached about a Higher Calling that would require a bigger commitment tied with greater discipline! Luke 5:4 "Launch out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch."
Obedience is required!
And discomfort will be a prerequisite to where God wants you to go in order receive the blessing you've been wanting/need.
#Go Deeper#
God wants you; your time, your talent, YOU. He does not want a pew sitter; He wants you in your potential; He wants you as who you are meant to be; which is in Him Christ Jesus!And to get there; you will have to go DEEPER, to unfamiliar grounds/uncomfortable grounds. But TRUST and Believe that if "GOD SAID IT- HE WILL DO IT."🙌 Yo, yo From. brother, Bruce, the holy ghost kid, Merry Christmas And keep God's blessing. We love our new home church!

name: Christian Life Center - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has that smaller church close community vibr. My kids go to the youth group that Luke and Rebeckah run and I am so grateful for them. My kids enjoy it every Thursday evening. Pastor is funny and convicting... Music was good too. The Pastor is very knowledgeable of the Word and preaches an incredible message.

The children’s department (Local Motion) is amazing. The leaders are so talented with their curriculum, organization, and present a wonderful, themed lesson to our children. Their multi-media should be packaged and sold! This church is super stingy about the students that go to the school, ever other church in the district allows student to park in their lots for a few hours during the school day, because there are no services at 8:30 in the morning.. this church threatens to tow any car in their lot. Super ungrateful and in-church like. Disgrace to god CLC is a church of loving &  kind people. Pastor Cris is full of energy in giving messages. He’s kool & comfortable to talk with. Lastly the Worship Team is uplifting w/ their repertoire every Sunday. 🙏

name: Christian Life Center - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary: There is truly no other church like this one. Everyone is kind, sincere and welcoming. If you are looking for a church, if you are looking for friendship, if you are trying to find God, or if you simply need a place to feel at home while you worship God, take the time to visit Christian Life Center, I guarantee you will not be disappointed. This church has changed my life I first came to get a slip signed!! But God had other plans he put people in my life that are forever friends and family through Jesus he has put safe women in my life I can call on to get wise council when I need and for someone Like me it’s extremely important love my life and what Christian Life Center gave me the true connection with love!! Amazing church! This congregation loves God and loves people. I felt very welcomed when I attended. The worship is amazing and they speak truth. Christian life center has changed my life forever.We are a family.We have the most precious pastor ever.He preaches truth.And he is not afraid to tell it like it is.Come join us be loved on and your spirit fed. What a dynamic place to come.  If you want to truly hear from God, you will.  Bring the broken, the hurting,  the sick, and the addicted.  God will move on their life if they really want him to.

name: Christian Life Center Fullerton - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
Always make sure You pray for Gods guidance and direction and if you do that be sure he will answer!
I prayed to God and asked him to show me if this church is the right church for me and my son to go to tonight he answered me. I Spoke with Pastor Dwayne Edwards on Wednesday evening inquiring about his church services I found out there was some sort of support Group they had available Tuesday evenings at the church I explained to the pastor that I was very interested in coming to check it out. I also let this pastor know that me and my son who would be coming with me have been very hurt and traumatized by people in churches we’ve gone to he welcomed us to come to the Support Group that they had Tuesday at 6:30 PM. Tonight when I went to go to this church which is about 20 minutes from my house… I got there and I saw that the pastor had a special marked parking space for himself where his car was parked in a parking area that was mostly empty. I parked my car got out tried every door in the church building which was locked I found it to be strange but the pastors car was parked in his special spot so I know he had to be there… I called the church number no answer… I searched through my phone looking for this pastor’s number. After finding his number in my phone from Wednesday night I called and he answered the phone I told him hello I talked to you Wednesday night and I’m here for the Support Group. As he answers the phone he’s coming out a back door of the church talking to me on the phone at the same time. He jokingly laughs shakes my hand and tells me that the Support Group was postponed! What!!! As I am walking back to my car he tells me I can come back next Tuesday! This kind of behavior is very inconsiderate and rude and not what you would hope to expect from a pastor especially after telling him that me and my son have been extremely hurt and traumatized by church people and the whole point of coming to the Support Group is to try to get some kind of healing!!! But I can’t be mad because I asked the Lord to show me if this is the church, he wants us at and I got my answer tonight! Needless to say I will not be coming back here Tuesday night or any other night and definitely would not be recommending this church to  anybody by the way, I forgot to mention I drove to this church on very little gas money I am a single mother of a child with special needs. This was not only an inconvenience and a disappointment but I could’ve used that Gas money to go somewhere else that would’ve benefited us. Great Pastor who preaches the truth and lovely members. Thank you for having us. Great place very friendly staff we stopped by they had a Saturday drive-thru prayer we went through prayers answered God bless you and thank you all you prayed for us that my children would come to the Lord and my mom was missing and my mom was found thank you for all your prayers once again God bless you all and your families We LOVE YOU!!!. Thankyou Lord For CLC Amazing Pastor Dwayne Evans always a blessed word 🙏🏽 Loving church family 💚

name: Christian Life Center Fullerton - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Always make sure You pray for Gods guidance and direction and if you do that be sure he will answer!
I prayed to God and asked him to show me if this church is the right church for me and my son to go to tonight he answered me. I Spoke with Pastor Dwayne Edwards on Wednesday evening inquiring about his church services I found out there was some sort of support Group they had available Tuesday evenings at the church I explained to the pastor that I was very interested in coming to check it out. I also let this pastor know that me and my son who would be coming with me have been very hurt and traumatized by people in churches we’ve gone to he welcomed us to come to the Support Group that they had Tuesday at 6:30 PM. Tonight when I went to go to this church which is about 20 minutes from my house… I got there and I saw that the pastor had a special marked parking space for himself where his car was parked in a parking area that was mostly empty. I parked my car got out tried every door in the church building which was locked I found it to be strange but the pastors car was parked in his special spot so I know he had to be there… I called the church number no answer… I searched through my phone looking for this pastor’s number. After finding his number in my phone from Wednesday night I called and he answered the phone I told him hello I talked to you Wednesday night and I’m here for the Support Group. As he answers the phone he’s coming out a back door of the church talking to me on the phone at the same time. He jokingly laughs shakes my hand and tells me that the Support Group was postponed! What!!! As I am walking back to my car he tells me I can come back next Tuesday! This kind of behavior is very inconsiderate and rude and not what you would hope to expect from a pastor especially after telling him that me and my son have been extremely hurt and traumatized by church people and the whole point of coming to the Support Group is to try to get some kind of healing!!! But I can’t be mad because I asked the Lord to show me if this is the church, he wants us at and I got my answer tonight! Needless to say I will not be coming back here Tuesday night or any other night and definitely would not be recommending this church to  anybody by the way, I forgot to mention I drove to this church on very little gas money I am a single mother of a child with special needs. This was not only an inconvenience and a disappointment but I could’ve used that Gas money to go somewhere else that would’ve benefited us. Great Pastor who preaches the truth and lovely members. Thank you for having us. Great place very friendly staff we stopped by they had a Saturday drive-thru prayer we went through prayers answered God bless you and thank you all you prayed for us that my children would come to the Lord and my mom was missing and my mom was found thank you for all your prayers once again God bless you all and your families We LOVE YOU!!!.
