name: Christian Life Church - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary: Thanks for honoring your church's history. I was baptized here by Steelberg. By the way, Bob Weiner (Maranatha Churches) came out of this church. I didnt know about T. Richey's hand. My family stayed until the end of '76. I was 10. We were here nearly a year during T. Ray Rachel's tenure. My dad was healed of a serious kidney illness when the church laid hands on him at the church. I think it was a Sunday night. There was another pentecostal pioneer associated with Steelberg. Well, two. His dad, whose broadcast CM Ward carried on after his dad's passing. Then, his stepfather was Howard Carter. (Not the archeologist 😆) Lester Sumrall has a book about his ministry and partnering with Carter. He was an AG leader in England. Google the book. It's a free download. CLC has a powerful heritage in the Holy Ghost!!! I  truly love this church,  although I don't attend regularly due to my busy schedule in the medical field, I try to attend church with my family as soon as I get a Sunday off. What I really appreciate about the wonderful members of the church is that even if I haven't been attending for a while,  they welcome me with open arms. It doesn't matter if is a month or 6 monthso they are just glad to see me. I am praying I can get Sundays off so I can go to the early Sunday service and get together to meet them. I enjoy God's presence every time I do attend. Although I don't know the pastor personally, whebut you hear his message you can immediately tell his love and passion for God and his love for the members.He is awesome. I am praying for God to continue blessed him, guide him to care for the church and his members. I love the church and the people are so friendly Very friendly church ! Always feel very welcomed ! Godly people who are family that want to share  lifes experiences with you.God is the center of it all

name: Christian Life Fellowship
reviewSummary:
I came to CLF 22 years ago but I’ve known the core leadership now for nearly 30 years overall. I will readily admit that due to sin in my own life, I only stayed for a couple of years, and then left for almost 10 years. When I left the church I was dealing with a number of things that I was unwilling to let go of and was in disobedience towards God.  That being said, when I came back, I expected some level of anger, but instead what I received was the love of God. I’ve been by back for over a decade now and it’s where I am happily raising my family. Is the leadership perfect? No. But are any of us? “ Perfection is to be strived for but not obtained.” What I have experienced at CLF is a sincere striving to bring honor and glory to the One True God. If you are looking for family, you will find it here. This church is made up of real people living out a real walk. More than trusting them with my life, I am trusting them with my family. If you are looking for the “perfect” church this isn’t it- and that doesn’t exist. There is no perfection where humanity is involved. But if you are looking for people who are real, and who love God, and where the presence of God is- you’ll find it at CLF. If you are reading this- I hope to see you soon! I know there are other Churches in Raleigh but this one is just special, it is so obvious that the Holy spirit is there i went to after hours and people were praying in tongues and just filled with the Holy spirit. Pastor Scott had a really amazing sermon about speaking in tongues and about the Holy spirit. (I'm not sure if you can listen to it on Facebook) I really wish I could come every Sunday. Not the church for me.

My initial review was done at a time of hurt and offense. Although many things I’ve said were true. The way I presented them were not godly. There’s a difference between telling the truth and telling the truth “In Love”  This church is not my enemy.  Many of times we as people clump people who have hurt us as enemies. But if you go look up the word “Enemy” you will find the people of the church do not fall in that category. The enemy here is satan who wants to cause division in the church. After 5 months of the Lord working on me I have to be obedient and apologize for my choice of words when it came to the hurt that was cause to me by this church. I don’t know why I was treated the way I was treated by this church but I do know that as brothers and sisters in Christ we are to be obedient to the word of God.
“If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.”
‭‭Romans‬ ‭12‬:‭18‬ ‭NIV‬‬

Leave the door open for reconciliation. No that does not mean agree with everything this church believes. They will have to answer to the Lord one day for theirs. We will have to answer for ours.  Our job is to love one another. Even if they don't love you back. Because when I betrayed Christ, when I cussed him out. When I  rejected him. He still chose me. He still made the choice to love me despite it all!  We are called to be like him.

This church is made up of humans. None perfect. I was treated the way I was treated because they didn’t know me. They don’t know better. It took me years to know that! I had lots of growing to do myself.  There are some beautiful hearts in this church. But this church was not for me. This church is a great representation of what heaven should look like on earth. This church really works with you not only just in groups but also individually. This church is heavy on family and amazing friendships.They encourage you without pressure to increase your capacity and capabilities with your walk with God. You’ll find a home a sanctuary, where you can receive nothing but therapeutic love. The presence of the Lord is most definitely there. I’ll will most likely be there for the rest of my life. I’ve been attending Christian Life Fellowship (CLF) since 2012, and it has truly transformed my life. This church is a welcoming, diverse community where people from all backgrounds come together to worship and grow in faith. The genuine relationships I’ve built here have been a source of strength and encouragement. CLF’s commitment to making disciples and serving the community is evident in everything they do. If you’re looking for a place to experience God’s presence and be part of a loving family, I highly recommend CLF.

name: Christian Valley Church - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary:
Christian Valley Church is a second home to our family!  We have gone to a few different churches in the past, but we have never felt so loved as we do at CVC.  We have become closer to one another in the love of Jesus and there is that strong sense of belongingness!  The relationships in the church are loving and genuine!  Each sermon is biblically sound and Christ-centered!  Pastor Colton’s preaching is convicting, challenging and engaging!  He is a man after God’s own heart and genuinely loves people and the pursuit of people being saved!  His wife, Irene, is such a great helper to Colton and has a such a big heart in serving others!  And if you have youngsters, check out the children’s ministry!  The kids are being taught the love and mercy of the Savior! I’m so grateful for this church. For a long time, I didn’t attend regularly because I never quite found a place that felt comfortable and genuine. This church changed that for me.

It’s a smaller church, which I actually love. The worship is sweet and heartfelt, and the messages are always straight from the Bible, clear and grounded in truth. You can truly see Pastor Colton’s love for the Lord in the way he teaches and cares for people.

There’s something really special about walking into a place where you feel known, welcomed, and encouraged. It feels personal, it feels real, and it feels like home. I look forward to Sundays again, and that says everything. 🤍 This church has blessed our new, growing family more than words can describe! We have truly found our home here. God is working through Colton and Irene is amazing ways, and it’s an honor to witness it. Something I absolutely love about CVC is how they have moms and babies in mind; they provide a mother’s room for breastfeeding mothers and their children 2 and younger. They also offer children’s ministry for older kids. It’s great to be able to feed the baby in privacy and not miss a word! This church is a breath of fresh air. The Pastors Colton and Irene are true shepherds. After losing my husband to cancer I came here and the people welcomed me and made me feel like family. The worship is honest and truly from the heart. Colton teaches directly from the Word and gives the history as well as then how we apply it to our daily lives. God is so present and moving here and it is evident in the many generations from young to old. If you want to experience God’s grace, love, truth and acceptance. This is a great place to come. Such a sweet church and all the people that attend. You truly feel the Love when you walk through the doors of Christian Valley. Pastor Colton and Irene’s hearts are so big and they love sharing the word of Jesus.

name: Christland Church - College Station Campus
reviewSummary: This church is the real deal.  The teaching is Bible based, the worship is anointed, the people live out what they believe, and we are not afraid of letting the Holy Spirit work in and through us.  There is no backbiting, no gossip, no seeking power or position, no cutting off what the Spirit is doing.  It is just people loving Jesus and trying to let Him live through us. A welcoming Church home where Jesus is preached and lived out! Biblical beliefs, effective discipleship, and a place where God is welcome and present. I’ve experienced growth in so many aspects of my life and walk with Jesus, genuine community, and help in spiritual health, disciplines, and understanding. I’d recommend giving Christland a visit and seeing if this is where God wants you to be! This church is the real deal. Sermons straight from the Bible. Worship is real. You can feel the Holy Spirit. People are welcoming and authentic. I absolutely love this church!! I have grown in faith, community, and biblical truth with amazing leadership and church family. Christland has been my church home for 6+ years and it has been such a blessing to me and my walk with God. I have been so encouraged by being around people who genuinely deeply treasure becoming more like Jesus in their everyday lives. I love this church and the wonderful community within it. It’s a welcoming place for families, college students, newlyweds, and people of all generations and backgrounds. The church is rooted in biblical values, and its mission remains firmly grounded in God’s word.

reviewSummary:

A wonderful place to visit, grow, and belong. Quite clean and ambient. My son joined the scout troop 800. Awesome people around here I took my sister here to donate blood with the Red Cross. name: Church at Baton Rouge - Lacy Hawkins, Minister - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
Security told me that I looked tired and dirty.How about you go home?
And I did. And I never went back.........Jack!!!!! I mean Melvin I was introduced to the Church of The Latter Rain at the age of 2 by coming with my mother.  My soul was brought alive at the age of ~5 when I received the baptism of the Holy Ghost.  Through the teachings of this ministry, I developed a personal relationship with Jesus  and at the age of ~16, I committed (to my friend Jesus), that I would commit my life to him so that I can see him face to face and one day, thank him for everything he has done.  After many years (decades), I remain forever thankful to this ministry because they have pointed me to Jesus and encouraged me to have a personal relationship with him by reading my bible, learning the ways of the Lord and implementing them.  So very thankful for this place where we can find life for our souls!!! I came to the United States with my family when I was 12 years old from Michoacan, Mexico. Although my parents had converted to Christians and I heard a lot about Jesus from an early age, a lot of confusion and dishonesty I experienced in churches made me reject anything that had to do with God, Jesus and religion when I reached the age of accountability. In the pursuit of finding something to fill the void I felt, I sought education thinking that would fulfill me, but it didn’t. I went through 10 years going through an immigration situation where I grew up very isolated and focused on surviving through education. Then the Lord brought me in contact with a sweet couple at the age of 22 that testified to me not with words but with their lives. I was able to feel and see the genuine love they had for people and for one another. Their conversation was safe and full of understanding. They invited me to church and while I was very hesitant to attend because of my previous experiences with churches, I attended a national meeting out of respect for the kindness they had shown me.

The love I felt from the People of God was so overwhelming when I attended the meeting I didn’t come back for another six months. Because of past pain and the walls I had built to protect me, it took me another six months to receive the Holy Ghost. It was through love and time with my new environment that I was able to see I was in a very special place. I received truth from a five Office Ministry that spoke from verses in the Bible I had never seen before. They spoke of the order of God, the Principles of the Doctrines of Christ and Four Major Doctrines and many other truths that created a spiritual foundation in me. As a true academic, I began to search the scriptures and confirm that what they were saying was indeed in the Bible. I have seen and I’m convinced that the scripture in Acts 10:34 is true: “Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons, But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted of him.” Life Changing! Excellent rating
Positive learning environment, friendly and welcoming.

name: Church at Glass Chapel - Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
We started attending Church at The Glass Chapel a few months ago, and we absolutely love it. It has been exactly what we were looking for in a church. The worship services are truly amazing—you can feel that they are led by the Holy Spirit and not rushed by a schedule. Every sermon we’ve heard has been biblically sound and encouraging.

What really stands out is how welcoming everyone is. From our very first visit, people were friendly, inviting, and made us feel like part of the church family instead of just visitors. If you’re looking for a church in the Broken Arrow area with powerful worship, strong Bible-based teaching, and a genuine sense of community, we highly recommend Church at The Glass Chapel. CGC is an incredible church! Spirit filled family church is accurate! There are great people who serve and attend here! Each week they have the nicest little set up for people to enjoy before going into fellowship and worship in the main room. Fresh hot steaming coffee, teas to choose from, ice water, and a beautiful spread of donuts!  There’s also awesome t shirts to rep this house of God! It’s a very sweet meeting place. Can’t recommend it enough ❤️ I've been attending CGC for five months. I am loved, accepted, and valued there and I've found a strong sense of community. I'm very thankful to be a part of this amazing group of people. My wife and I love Church at the Glass Chapel! From the moment we arrived, everyone was so welcoming and kind — a true reflection of Jesus in every way. Our grandkids loved the Contagious Kids children’s ministry, and we were deeply moved by the authentic worship and heartfelt expression of ministry. The presence of God is truly felt here.

If you’re looking for a place to connect, explore faith for the first time, or find a church filled with authentic people and worship, I highly encourage you to visit Church at the Glass Chapel. It’s a wonderful place to grow in faith and experience God’s love. 🙏✨ A church that feels like family like no other church I have experienced before. They’re such an amazing spirit of kindness and genuineness. Love being part of this family.

reviewSummary: Very kind church with very moving sermons! I just can't get past having cauldron drinks at Halloween. There's no way to spin that, cauldrons are only for witches. Then they have a Santa Clause and letters to santa for their Christmas Jamboree. It's a real shame. We're supposed to be 'not of this world' not confirming to the world. I feel like the jingle Jamboree was more about their new building and Santa clause and had nothing to do with Jesus besides the one person that decorated their trunk with a nativity scene. If anyone is supposed to push the true meaning of Christmas it's the church. Secular distractions from the purpose of Christmas are very damaging to the church and the impressionable children. Best place in Henderson. The worship leader is hands down better than anyone you'll hear on popular radio. Fellowship is amazing. There are tons of different small groups and fellowship groups to get involved with. People here are always kind. The youth ministry program is amazing as well. The pastors treat everyone like family and preach with conviction. If you're looking for some place casual but not worldly then this is definitely it. As I grow and feel the draw to more positive spiritual beings, I like to come here. The congregation has always been very inviting and never made me feel out of place. They are all very close. Like good children of the Lord they are adamant about keeping Henderson a great place for our families and friends and I will stand with them every time. Keep us all vigilant and strong as we fight against evil, Lord. Amen. This church was literally an answer to prayers.  I found friendship, community but most of all - Jesus.  I love the theology and messages every week.  This place has so much of Gods favor, I can’t wait to see what God does through the church the coming years. From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt enveloped in a warm embrace of faith, love, and community. What sets this church apart is its commitment to serving not only its members but also the broader community. I am grateful for the opportunity to be a part of this incredible community and look forward to continuing my journey of faith and fellowship with them.

reviewSummary: Church at the Cross, follows Biblical ethics, evangelism empowered & have a very energetic young Pastor. A conveniently located church with people that really care. The cross displayed in the back is a constant reminder of hope and love for all local citizens who commute daily on the turnpike. Love it. Church at the Cross is an amazing place! I've been going to this church for over a year and I loved it the first day I visited. They have different life groups that you can join for bible study on Sundays. They are not your traditional church and that's what makes it amazing! They have different events for all walks of life. They even have a school for the children. This place is very welcoming and the pastors here make sure when they see you around they say "hello" and introduce themselves if you don't look familiar. Highly recommend attending!!

name: Church at the Park - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
Dear Wayne, we see how you live your life each day, in Christian service, with grace, love, kindness, and patience with others.
I am so thankful for your eagerness and passion to reach people for Christ. You live out your Christian walk in front of others, and set an example of a personal relationship with Christ Jesus. Thank you for sharing that with others for the sake of the kingdom of God. Open Table Church is truly a second family to us. We moved here almost 4 years ago and knew how important it was to us to find a church community. Our first Sunday in Walnut Creek we walked into Otc and haven’t been anywhere since :) they welcomed us with open arms and have been such a support through small groups, prayer, and just being there in any time of need. The list could go on and on. We feel so blessed to have found this church family. We love the way that Pastor Wayne preaches directly from the Word and also connects to his congregation on a personal level. Open table church has been my church home for the last 6+ years. They do their best to make you feel welcome and at home. There are lots of small groups to help you connect with other people and build life-giving relationships. There is a prayer time after the service and all are welcome to come and we will join with you to gift your need or situation up to God and let the HS minister life to your body and soul. We look forward to seeing you. And the coffee is GREAT! OTC is a wonderful church. My wife and I have been attending for six years. There are numerous small groups throughout the week with excellent leadership and sound biblical teaching. It’s wonderful to meet in Civic Park, a natural cathedral. And, when the weather’s cold or raining, we have access to the assembly hall and the library. My wife and I highly recommend this church. We are extremely thankful to Pastor Wayne and the leadership of the church for their gracious welcoming spirit to all different kinds of people. The Holy Spirit of our Lord Jesus Christ is present in this church. OTC is a great place to ask questions and explore and learn about the Bible and what it means to follow Jesus Christ. Wayne Phillips is excellent at communicating and has a down-to-earth style. And bonus - we meet outside at the park Sunday mornings. We love it!

I consider OTC family and love the mix of people from different backgrounds who attend. There’s a lot of opportunities to join various small groups and get involved.

name: Church at the Well
reviewSummary: I stayed in Burlington for the weekend on my way to Canada for work. And while looking for a place to worship that Sunday, came across "Church at the Well".  Jesus is with this church, these are his people! I pray that God will continue to call on his people here and strengthen them! God bless! thank you for your service 🙏 Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Church at Vallejo - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the place that changed my life. A girl from a single parent home. Raised in the inner city, my mother would bring me and my siblings to church my whole childhood, but the thing was I never felt a connection to the Lord where I was going. I saw and felt so many things that I did not understand that hurt. I just kept searching for a place where the taught me about God and how to connect with Him. It was not until I was introduced to the Church of the Latter Rain in 2014 I began to feel a spiritual connection to the Lord. It was the first place I attended where not only did the people there cared to know my name, but were genuinely interested in my well being both naturally and spiritually. I felt comfortable. I was able to let me walls down because I felt safe. These people are not going to hurt me. I now know it was the Spirit of God shining through the people that made me feel loved. My walls were broken down and I was able to open my heart to the Lord and received the Holy Ghost with the evidence of speaking in tongues. Instantly the hurt, the disconnection I felt all my life was immediately taken away. The weight of life I was carrying by myself, the Lord gave me his spirit, and has been helping me ever since that day.

I have to also say something about the ministry at the Church of The Latter Rain. It felt so good to see a group of men working together to minister the Word of God to minister and care for the people. I could tell right away something was different. They had a connection. They were brothers. I felt a sense of protection. Safety. It felt good! It has been consistent and even stronger since day one. The same safety I feel. The same love I experience. The same spirit I feel you can feel too. Just like the scripture in Romans 10:13, For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved. This church has truly changed my life! I began faithfully attending this church at a young age — right after the lose of my mom. I was broken and hurt but mostly afraid of what life would be like without a mother ,but the love of the people truly lifted me. As a child I always wanted true friends and to be a part of a family that was unified. I found that here. I truly found a people who cares.

To this day I am still impacted by the love of the people , their testimonies , and the teaching/preaching of the Word of God. Through my daily personal studying and readings of the Bible I have found this place to be true and scripture based. My relationship with Jesus has increased immensely and I’m so thankful that Jesus led me to this glorious church. I came to this church when I was 8 years old by way of my parents. We lived in Southern California, and my dad came to Vallejo to attend a funeral, and during his visit he came to this church with his parents. When my dad came back home, he knew he had to come back to the church because of the spirit and love that he felt, and shortly after we moved to Northern California. I didn’t understand it at the time, why we would move so quickly because of a church, but as I grew up I began to learn for myself just how special this place is.

Fast forward to age 32, I’m still attending this church, and I’m so thankful that Jesus led me this way and that I had the opportunity to serve him in my youth and now as an adult. Jesus has had great mercy on my life, and allowed me to build a personal relationship with him. The people, the environment, the ministry preaching the Word of God, and the Holy Ghost has changed my life and I owe everything to Jesus.

If you’re looking for a change in your life, for the chance to have a fresh start, Jesus has the power to do that. I would encourage anyone to come visit. I felt strongly compelled to write a review of this church.  Before I go into my personal experience I want to say that this is a place where you can truly learn about the Bible.  Not just what it says but what it means.  Also, this is a place where you can get spiritual guidance.  There is a group of people in this church that are truly committed to serving God and supporting one another along the way.  This is also a place where you can bring your problems and get help.  That last point is what has characterized my personal experience. My mother came to this church during a turbulent time in her life, pregnant with me, and distressed.  What she found at first was a safe, clean place to raise a child.  As I got older I found myself in a place where having access to mentorship, love, and guidance was simply my reality.  More importantly though, I was introduced to Jesus in a way that is very personal.  I’ve found that my relationship with God is a personal journey, but it’s impossible to keep without consistent access to spiritually dedicated people. Also, it’s something about hearing the truth of Gods word that is just different.  I’ve been coming to this church almost 40 years now and I’ve never once gone spiritually hungry.  I’m not a perfect person, or even a particularly important person, but I am compelled to continually recommit myself to a spiritual walk of life, so that I can return the love that was given to me when my mom and I walked through the doors of the church for the first time. If you are looking for a change and some peace in your life, somewhere that can give you a new start in Jesus this is the place! 2 Corinthians 5:17- Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: OLD things are passed away; behold, ALL things are become new.

Coming here at the young age of 5 and growing up in this environment over the years has not only helped me spiritually but also naturally. I wasn’t old enough to know I needed a change at a young age but my mother was the one that was looking for a church to attend. A church that was following the King James version of the Bible and that was Holy Ghost led. Here is where she found both of those things plus more! Through her deciding to coming and stay, I was given a chance to benefit from that decision.

Receiving the Holy Ghost at the age of 8, I can see how Jesus has covered me in every area of my  life until this day. With the support of the people as well as the guidance of the ministry here, I am who I am today. I am so thankful there is a place like this for people who are looking for a change and the truth.

name: Church at Wieuca - Atlanta Campus

I could not ask for more. Our adult Bible study has also been fabulous; I hate to miss a Sunday. I have been amazed at how easily we have made genuine friends in such a short time. Wieuca is an authentic church filled with people who are committed to God, to each other and to the church itself. Atlanta can be a big place, and it is nice to have a church family that feels like home. Thank for opening your Chapel for us to worship.   I believe  Late Bishop Cornelius Sawyer  is smiling from heaven at you Pastor Mark and your staff.  Friend  always  Lavonne Sawyer Stone.  This is how real God fearing Christian respond to the needy.   Well done; race is not factor

name: Church by the Glades - Fort Lauderdale - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary: The most amazing place in Fort Lauderdale. A true illustration of how the Lord works in mysterious ways and brings people together. Absolutely love my church!  It’s never enough and every service has me looking forward to the following weeks service.  Thank you They are teaching the Good News... What else is there to say? If you're looking for a church in downtown Ft. Lauderdale, or even if you're not, you need to come check out Church by the Glades FTL. I feel so welcome here and I really feel like I'm a part of a family. The worship music is amazing and I always feel uplifted, encouraged and strengthened after hearing the pastor speak. I would say this isn't your grandma's church because this is NOT like any church you've ever been to before, but that's not true—everyone is welcome here, all generations, races and creeds. Come on by! We're here every Sunday at 5 PM! My husband and I have been coming since August and I have not missed one service yet! We have thoroughly enjoyed the word, the people and the music. It's not like any other church you have ever been to I promise. We have gotten to know some of the staff and volunteers and everyone is just wonderful. We LOVE the 5pm service time because I feel like we still get a full weekend and then it wraps up with an awesome message.... every time! Thank you CBG for putting a location downtown. It has greatly impacted me, my husband and our kids!

name: Church By The Sea
reviewSummary: A wonderful, Bible-centered community. Love the contemporary worship and friendly people.

name: Church Experience Jax Beach - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
The first Sunday was great. The holy Spirit was in this place and will be weekly. Pray for more to join us in this launch and help us to grow and become closer as a church family as reach more of Jax Beach. Come join us I'll save you a seat. From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the love and welcoming spirit of the people in this church. Everyone is friendly, genuine, and makes you feel like family no matter your background or where you are in life. The Word is preached with truth, passion, and encouragement, leaving you spiritually refreshed and challenged to grow closer to God.

Although the church is still new, there is such a strong sense of faith, vision, and expectation for what God is going to do. You can truly feel the prayers being lifted for expansion, growth, and reaching more people in the community. It’s exciting to see a church with such a loving foundation and a heart for people. Looking forward to watching this ministry continue to grow and flourish!

If you’ve been looking for a church home or simply want to experience a warm and uplifting atmosphere, I encourage you to check it out for yourself and see if you don’t find the same loving spirit and welcoming environment. The atmosphere within the American Legion Hall was very welcoming.  There was a small group of people, and everyone was friendly.  Even though this is a new "startup" fellowship, the worship service was excellent.  The audiovisual was clearly a temporary system, but the presentation was of good quality.  God's presence was obvious, and a good message was given by Pastor Brad Marschke.
This weekly meeting is one that should not be missed.  These are good people, and the Lord is present in their gathering. Church Experience is the BEST, I LOVE Paster Brad and Kate! What a beautiful church I am so excited to be apart and see God work! Stop by on Sunday for Experience in Church

name: Church for All Nations - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
This is an awesome church. . Grate worship and grate people.  You really feel at home and everyone is real there is always love going and you can definitely feel the holly Gost ... God love is definitely there. .. Real world learning without the preaching. Great music and sincere people really wanting you to find a place and grow.
Love this place and Mark Cowart is the man...! Off topic but this church looks like they opened it up in a old best buy, I wonder if this church was a Best Buy store at one point, just the blue thing in front of the building is really making me wonder if it used to be a Best Buy store, like one of those smaller Best Buy stores. Come and Worship with Lovers of God! Rejoice! Found my church! It's wonderful and they speak the true gospel.

name: Church In Anaheim—District 3 - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s a place where the believers meet together to enjoy Christ and express Him as members of His Body, in the reality of the one new man.
All believers in Christ are welcome. The only church I know has blending of  Christians of 5 languages : English, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, Vietnamese. All are one in Christ! This is the place of Rest, Joy, and Happiness I really enjoyed the Lord, and His pleasant presence meeting with the saints every week. The place for all the children of God gather together to enjoy the words of God and growth in Divine Life, Love n Nature I experienced Gods presence among these people. Emmanuel God with us experienced here on earth.

name: Church in Arcadia - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: A place that truly pursues the truth, with saints who are full of genuine love. Jesus Christ revealed Himself in me. Family place to search or worship the True God, recommended for the whole family or single person. We love the Church life! a warm place

name: Church In Arlington - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary: Love the Spirit of truth and life that is there with the believers in Jesus. I enjoyed my church life in Arlington many years! Praise Him! Grew up in a Buddhist family, later came to the U.S and became a Christian, this is the place where the Lord has put me and my family here to grow and to be built up for His body. If you live in Arlington you should visit this place Nice 👍🏻 they help me alot

name: Church In Athens - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
God, Who desires all men to be saved and to come to the full knowledge of the truth
— 1 Tim. 2:4

If you want to believe in Him and to know the full knowledge of the truth in God’s word and to find the warm community full of love and care, this is the place. If you are hungry for the Lord and seek the riches in the Word of God, you need to fellowship with this group of believers!  They have a dedicated Bible study for local students that meets on the UGA campus! I went here all through college! It was such a great experience. I moved away from Athens, but I still go back to visit all of the lovely families that took care of me. A great place to read the Bible, fellowship over the Bible, learn from one another, enjoy community and Bible based teachings. Great place! Biblically based sweet fellowship! So much encouragement for believers daily living!!

name: Church in Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: They got both the truth and the living that I was looking for. These are genuine lovers of Jesus. They definitely know the Bible and live by it. No hypocrisy. Lots of love and  I'm very thankful I got to meet them! (Pic: Reminiscing the picnic in the back lawn before the pandemic) By far the best church you will find in all of Austin. Very friendly and warm people who love to meet new ones. They also invite you over for hone meetings where you eat together and discuss different topics in the Bible and each person can contribute. Uts very rich and life giving. They give the Church a meaning or makes you want to come back. I highly recommend. The church in Austin is a great place to be if you want to know the Lord and grow as a Christian. People meet here from very diverse backgrounds in a simple way day by day and house to house to love the Lord Jesus and grow in the knowledge and experience of His word. We also meet in various places around town in larger groups on Sunday morning for fellowship and to share on various Bible topics in mutuality. It is a wonderful community! They welcomed me with open arms when I first moved to Austin as a college student from abroad years ago, stuck around with them for a long time because I really enjoyed meeting loving Christians in the group till I moved out of Austin a few months ago. I love that they teach things based on the Bible and help you to read the Bible on your own also. Highly recommend! I love bill and Camilla ard she knocked on my door and led me to Jesus

name: Church In Bellevue
reviewSummary:
I’ve found my home and ended my search at last! When I walk in those front doors, I just feel like I’m with my family. Everyone is so welcoming and there’s really an atmosphere of love in the meetings. I also appreciate how this group of Christians follow the word of God closely and I can see that these people genuinely love the Lord Jesus. I always walk out of the meetings feeling supplied, strengthened, and spiritually nourished. It’s just full of life and a bit hard to describe. You just have to try it out yourself. I honestly don’t know how I’d be able to go on in my life without the church meetings. It’s really my life line. I also like how it’s non-denominational and diverse. You feel welcomed no matter what your background or upbringing might be, or where you are in your Christian journey. There’s something here for everyone - young children, teenagers, college students, parents, working ones, seniors, etc.
One thing to be aware of is that it’s a bit tricky to find… it’s right next to the Presbyterian church and the Church in Bellevue sign isn’t super visible so you kind of have to look for it.
Come and see for yourself! :) Wonderful assembling together of God’s called out ones seeking to know Him, gain Him and experience Him. Jesus is Lord! This is the best church if you want to know our lord's economy Wonderful place and wonderful people. I was scared to tell them that I was homeless but I think that I still would have been treated with the same loving kindness ❤️ He said God is great praise the Lord

name: Church In Berkeley - Berkeley Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church, I really do! Everyone is so welcoming and lovely and it very much reminded me what the early churches would have been like. Whenever I come back to Berkeley (I came for a two week holiday) this is the church I'd attend every time! Not a regular, but I attended a gathering here and it was a very memorable time of fellowship over God's word. Hope I can visit again This is a wonderful place to enjoy & praise the Lord Jesus Christ with other sweet believers! From what I've seen, visitors are always welcome. :) I’ve visited a lot of Christian churches and this particular one feels more like a sect. Very scary ! They scream and moan altogether! Nothing spiritual about this group ! I would not recommend this place to anybody ! Good place to meet up with family and friends. Good fellowship and prayers. And good worship service and good preaching of the word of God

name: Church In Bethesda
reviewSummary: This is the best church I have ever been to. I just moved to Florida and hope I can find a similar church. They made me feel welcomed at a time in my life when I felt hopeless and alone. Pastor Ryan's sermons are amazing, insightful, and touched me deeply. The environment is incredibly inclusive and warm. I felt that his sermons were smart and based on true knowledge of the bible. It felt like a breath of fresh air to be in a non-judgemental space where we were valued as humans and children of God. Really sweet, non-denominational church.  They have gatherings in Spanish sometimes too.  Every once in awhile I’ll see them helping the homeless and providing food.  It is nice to see people who give back! We had a bad night and got up too late to go to church services at most places.  Being new in town, I went online trying to find a Bethesda church with 11 AM services.  Hard to find! But I finally found this one, only about 5 minutes away.  We couldn’t possibly get there by 11, but I decided to go anyway.   We arrived about 11:20, in the middle of a great devotional about being thankful regardless of bad things that might be happening to us.  I could relate to that! When they had a part of the service where people told about what they were thankful for, I told the crowd I was thankful I had found them. They naturally applauded.  After the service, a lot of them stood around talking- a sure sign of a great church. We were of course included. They greeted us like old friends who had been away for years. Public Meal ends at 12pm allegedly on Bethesda Cares site so why was I turned away @ 11:40 am being told it’s finished.. I was out to the Sunday market  in August 2018, when I found this church.  Or let me say, "when this church found me".  When I walked through those blue door I felt the warmest welcome I had ever felt.  The congregation was of many colors and smiles.  The music was lively and it reminded me of my childhood in the gospel church.  I really like this church and when my family came in December for Christmas, they really like it too.  If you are looking for something real, this is the place, CIB.  Come join us every Sunday, I think you're going to like it.

name: Church In Cambridge
reviewSummary:
We came here to visit from the church in Ottawa and we found that the people here loves the Lord Jesus Christ very much. The beliefs, practices, and truths are very in line with the Apostles' teaching, and follows the Word of God closely. May the Word of God dwell in all of us richly. Whether you follow this ministry or are looking for a church to attend, this place can help with our spiritual pursuits. I foretaste here the reality of the Body of Christ, the one new man in Christ, keeping the oneness of the Spirit in the uniting bond of peace. I always enjoy blending with the saints in Cambridge. They love the Lord and are very hospitable. They love the Lord, love the Bible and welcome all every language tribe and toung we are all onencess in Christ Come as you are, but you won't leave the same!
“We love because he first loved us." (1 John 4:19)

name: Church In Cupertino - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary: An inconspicuous and homely little church with  great community. The Bible uses the recovery version. The building itself is easy to miss since it doesn't exactly have a big sign to it. Conveniently close to subway and De Anza college for students! Genuine Christian believers meeting like the early Christians in Acts. It's called the church in Cupertino because it's an inclusive name which includes all the genuine Christian believers living in Cupertino (and because that's how churches were named in the Bible - by city (e.g. Revelation chapter 2) Praise the Lord for the Church in Cupertino! I though this was apple main headquarters. This is my church!

name: Church In Davis - Davis Campus
reviewSummary: The Sunday service was very uplifting and spiritual. The singing and praising of congregation was lovely. It is a great place to worship. Beautiful singing and refreshing worship. Wonderful place to go to. Excellent service including in-depth bible book/verses study! Come and worship Christ the King! Come and see the Body of Christ.

name: Church In Denton - Denton Campus
reviewSummary: We have enjoyed sweet fellowship with many believers here :) The Church in Denton is a remarkable place of worship and community that stands out for its welcoming community and commitment to spiritual growth. The congregation's warmth and inclusivity make everyone feel at home, fostering a sense of belonging. The church's vibrant worship services and insightful teachings provide spiritual nourishment and encouragement to all who attend. Thank you to all the saints serving there! ☺️🙏 This community of believers in Denton is a real family. When I first came I admired their genuine love for Jesus, love for one another, and their dedication to unfolding and speaking the pure Word of God. Now, I'm enjoying a richer, fuller, daily church life where I am both supplied in my Christian life and challenged to grow more as a member of the Body. Best community around! A place to grow in God, and a place where everyone is encouraged to handle and speak the Word of God for the building up of the body of Christ. Also a rare group of believers who remember the Lord Jesus at a table meeting like no mass, but full of mutuality, love, and praise for Christ (often times it can be loud with praise and full of loud "Amens!" As a believer here I've had many realizations about Jesus Christ and His purpose and I have enjoyed going through trainings via Living Stream Ministry which have time and time again catapulted my experience as a Christian. It is not a once a week deal here but rather, a "church life" experience. Not a bad church. Sadly was not the church for me.

name: Church in Edmond - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary: And you will know them by their love.  A real body of believers who live for the Lord Jesus.  No lights, camera, action.  Just Jesus. A spiritually refreshing experience. A vibrant, welcoming group of believers who love Jesus. Love the brothers and sisters meeting at the church in edmond, because we love the Lord Jesus and one another. Glad to have a home away from home near campus! I love the Body

name: Church In Fort Worth - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
The believers who meet here realize the basic need of every man is life, that is, Christ as life.
They take Christ as the reality of every positive thing in the universe. What this means is they believe in God, Christ, and the Spirit.
They believe in the Bible, they believe in living the normal Christian life by enjoying Christ in their human spirit.
Not only do they know the Word but they also enjoy its practical out working.
There is prayer, fellowship, and enjoyment on every level in homes as well as in the meeting hall. A wonderful place to rear a family. I enjoy this place, because we are simple people that love the Lord. It is not only about knowledge or doctrine but about our expience of Christ as life in us. In His and by His life, we become  body centered and body conscious for the building up of His dwelling place on earth! :) We had such a sweet time with the believers here! I would say it felt like being with family, yet at the same time being such a welcomed and honored guest. Very dear lovers of the Lord Jesus here! God is compassionate and gracious. I’m really thankful to Church in Fort Worth. Thank you for the care, love, and life-changing fellowship. Thank You Lord, for abolishing in Your flesh the law of commandments in ordinances (Eph 2:15), and for the practical expression You have here in Fort Worth, of the one new man You created in Yourself.

name: Church In Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have enjoyed the meetings of the Church in Huntington Beach especially the joint participation of all the members. It is so good and helpful to hear the truths of the Bible spoken by all, including the daily experiences of our living Christ. I’m from the Church in LA, and then I move to OC in 2019, and I went to the church in Irvine, then the pandemic happened and I lost touch, and felt like I was in a Dry desert place, hungry and thirsty. But I started meeting this summer and now I’m happier, more secure and confident. I believe as Christians we really need to meet and be in the church life. Praise the Lord, we have this awesome place to meet, eat and be like a family. This church really helped me to know Jesus and cultivate my relationship with Him! This is a genuine church of genuine believers! Thank you Lord Jesus for this church! Bless everyone there and bless the meetings! Praise the Lord, this is a place for His family! It really felt like I was visiting a big family. So grateful I got to meet you all! Good evening “today 12/12/23 God gave me an answer”. As I was coming out from my house, I saw cross street two gentleman knocking my neighbor door, suddenly I heard a voice saying that’s like Joshua and Caleb. But I wanted to continue with my errands and began to drive off, then I said to myself “wait” let me talk to these two guys “I’m curious”
So I got off my car and asked them two guys their name “sure enough their names are “Josua and Caleb” wow,
Then I told them what happened, and mentioned that I’ve been looking for a church for a long time. They pray for me and invite me to church ! Guess what I’m going to church 😃.
God answered my prayer in a very unique way. Thank you Jesus. Warm and welcoming congregation. In-depth Bible study. You can tell that these people definitely are serious about their pursuit of God.

name: Church In Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been meeting with the Church in Irvine for over a year now and I am so thankful the Lord placed me here among other genuine Christian believers who love Jesus.

John 17:17 Sanctify them in the truth; Your word is truth. Terrible soulless music, reflective of the souls of those that attend here. Out of tune piano and guitar players that clearly can't play music are of tone dead levels are allowed to play for service. UNPROFESSIONAL. Congregants shout and spit into people's ears while singing makes for a unhappy Sunday morning service. The riches of the word of God are enjoyed experienced and expressed in reality and spirit, not only outwardly. The church is truly the expression of Christ. Anyone saying this is a cult is the very uneducated. I've looked up the definition of cult, and this church is the opposite of each definition. We follow the Bible, we are born of the Father, in Christ, by the Spirit. And nothing else! Praise God for His move all over the Earth! Saints love the Lord , enjoy Christ and building Him body as central goal. This is a wonderful spot for everyone. A great place to get closer to Christ.

name: Church in Lexington - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
By believing into the Lord Jesus, we receive His life and get saved. But to grow as a Christian, we need to love the Lord Jesus. I have been loved and learned to love Jesus by meeting here! This is a spirit filled church.

I have never felt so loved and taken care of as I have here.

This has definitely become my home church. Everyone here truly loves the Lord.

The church in Lexington is a great example of how the bride has to be.

May the Lord keep blessing this congregation for they have definitely blessed me with their kindness and charity. Very loving, caring and warm community of Christians!
Everyone is connected to one another and can easily share your enjoyment of the Word with other members.
If you love God and His word, this is the place to be. God brought me to this group of Christians in March of 2020. I immediately felt at home. The caring atmosphere and love for the Lord and His Word has helped me to grow in my Christian life. I have been meeting with the Church in Lexington since we moved here in 2011. The people love the Lord and love one another. We also love the Bible and the gospel. Come and see for yourself.

name: Church In McKinney - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary: A pleasant place to enjoy This place is wonderful for people to learn and be at peace. Everybody should visit this place. If you love the Lord Jesus and seek a purpose for your salvation with joy unspeakable,  this us the place for you wonderful place A place full of positive emotions

name: Church In Newton
reviewSummary: A true feeling of community in loving the Lord Genuine Christians seeking to know and experience the Lord Jesus as found in the scriptures. If you are serious about Christ this is a great place to meet and fellowship. Great people that our welcoming and love god ❤️! A welcoming group of people who love God and love his Word. Good place

name: Church in Norman - Norman Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been meeting here for more than 15 years and week by week I enjoy the fellowship, speaking and care from all the members and with all the members. As Peter said to the Lord when the Lord asked Him if they too were going to leave, Peter answered and said “Lord to whom shall we go? You have words of eternal life,” my experience is the same, I find words full of life meeting here! I met the believers in the Church in Norman when I was at OU for grad school. I was seeking God, but knew little about the actual content of the Bible. Fast forward 6 years and the Bible has become so clear and real.

Come here for reality. If your are seeking God Himself, to know His will, His purpose on earth today, this is the place for you.

“God is good to those who wait on Him, to the soul that seeks him.” -Lam 3:25 I really enjoy the fellowship with fellow brothers and sisters in the Lord Jesus Christ. Every time when we are gathered together, the time was filled with the presence of the Lord and the sweetness of fellowship with one another. I highly recommend this place. Thank you for offering great parking near The Palace! Go Blue! The welcoming atmosphere really impressed me! Looking forward to inviting my friends and family :)

name: Church in Ocean Park - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely loved this eclectic spiritual place of worship. The atmosphere here is amazing. Perfect spot for anyone with an inclusive non-dominational spirituality,  if you hate organized religion, this is the place for you!
I came here for a funereal event, for a friend of mine, and I was so impressed with the multi-spiritual, open minded and ecclectic crowds and vibe. I did not know it can be this good!!!
This is hands down the best event of the kind I have ever seen, the inside is wonderfully wide-spaced, the stained glass windows are enchanting, and the staff is very helpful and attentive 👉 even though I walked in late, once I started crying, suddenly a hand gently stuck some tissues in my line of blurred vision. It was a staff member! That touched me a lot, how attentive they were with one’s grief and sorrow. Excellent service all around ✨✨✨✨✨ Great people and a place to find commraderie and support for justice and human rights. I was in a summer group run by the church. It was run by hippies and local people. I danced the Mexican hat dance on may 5 1969 with the cutest Mexican girl. If you think the church is woke you should have been there in the 60’s. It is all about love and helping others! Now and for ever Minister Janet is delightful and everyone is welcoming A very warm and diverse faith community where all are welcome!

name: Church In Oklahoma City - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
A wonderful church full of wonderful followers of Christ. The times I’ve been have been so lovely and all the people I’ve met are friendly and welcoming. The services are different than what I am used to, but they are just as great. Each time I’ve attended I’ve left feeling refreshed and more confident in my faith. @the one star commentor on "food": Our last special potluck couple wks ago were from over 70 people which brought over 70 dishes whether from Carnivore-lovers, Vegetarians, American-food lovers, and also from people of different races/ethnicities/backgrounds. There was a dish for everyone - even for the diet-restricted such as GF and dairy sensitive found plenty, the largest "buffet" I've ever seen. MY opinion? That recent potluck Feast we had was phenomenal and better than any buffet restaurant I've gone to......
PEOPLE OF EVERY TRIBE AND NATION: LET US ALL PRAISE THE LORD!!! Yes a really good church and I hope to come again praise Jesus 🙏💖💘🙏💖💘 Church full of truth according to scripture and shepherding care in faith and in love!!! I've had a chance to attend a youth event each of the last 7yrs and more. I'm always impressed with the hospitality, depth & breadth of the truth and richness of the Spirit expressed by all of the believers here!

name: Church In Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: Come together to worship the Triune God leaving aside all the anxieties of the world. We need to be filled with Him, He is our life giving Spirit. When we call upon His name, we are released from all the vanities of our mind and we will have a fresh appreciation of Him. Coming together to blend with other saints, brings us out of our own individual world to the body of Christ and we are added to the Church organically. Just say "Oh Lord Jesus!, Oh Lord Jesus!, Oh Lord Jesus" and you will find peace. The best meeting to understand the truth  of the Bible and the purpose of God for us 🙏. I've received much help in my walk with the Lord through the things shared and learned amongst this group of Christians Pursue Christ with those calling on the name of Lord with a pure heart!! Praise the Lord for we can meet as the Church in each locality.

name: Church In Pleasanton - Pleasanton Campus
Church in Riverside - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus

name: Church in Round Rock - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary: This church has been a true blessing. You can sense the Lord’s presence, and the love among the saints is so genuine. If you’re looking for a place to grow and be encouraged, come visit It is a pleasant place and the people are friendly.  They teach based on the pure word of the Bible, and everyone is free to share. The fellowship here has revealed to me the eternal purpose of God of which we all have a part (Eph. 3:9-11)and it keeps me close to the Lord in my heart. I always look forward to coming again every Sunday. Great gathering of fellow Christians. Touching the word and the spirit whenever they meet. I love it. Incredible place for Christians to meet and share our love for our lord, Jesus Christ. This place is great! I can sense the Lord's presence, and the theology is based in the Bible. The people here are welcoming and will take the time to get to know you if you visit.

name: Church In San Bernardino - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
I appreciate the believers here. They all love the Lord Jesus and I sense peace joy and the Spirit when I’m among them. Very nice fellowshipping.
They read the word of God and follow it. Everybody shares what the enjoy of the messages, truly is the body of Christ in practically every member is active. Very nice people. The best place to go to... In my opinion. Going there since I was a baby. The fellowship is great, the hymns are awesome as per usual, and it has a great atmosphere with nice people. These people are full of the enjoyment of the resurrection life, the body of Christ. Love this community which is full of joy and God's mercy

name: Church In San Francisco - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great community of believers who love the Lord Jesus. I get refreshed every time I meet with them.  I appreciate their focus on the Lord and His Word. It is very strengthening to my Christian life. The place in San Francisco for seekers of the truth of all races and languages to pursue and to enjoy the Lord Jesus with other Christians who love the Lord and to experience reality of the Bible. Love from a brother from the Church in Hong Kong. We share the same language in Christ. I really felt at home during every gathering. This is a wonderful place to pursue the Lord Jesus with other Christians who love the Lord and to really have the Bible opened up for our experience and enjoyment of Him I visited here a few times in recent years and have always enjoyed the fellowship. So happy that there are believers who see and practice the oneness of the Body of Christ

name: Church In Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Jesus is taught and pronounced which is great.  The doctrine and teachers do not speak enough about how the ("Holy" Spirit) helps us in our lives, and to follow Jesus. Amazing church, so warm and welcoming. Love that they speak from the Bible and try their best to practice from it. A community where Christ is the Center. The Best Experience with The Living God!, Praise Him!!... Very easy to find

name: Church In the City Beth Abraham - Denver Campus
reviewSummary: A must for anyone searching. Find God here! Worship Jesus in spirit and in truth. The Lord's anointing on this church, and the sincere desire of others seeking Him, attracts me. It is so fascinating to hear of its history. God has not let go. This church is rising despite incredible past opposition. Great church food bank every Wednesday between 11am to 12 no paperwork needed if you need food help or Jesus come get some Amen 🔂🌟 I enjoyed the Dr Martin Luther King, Jr program and food they had provided. This is exactly what a church should be: serving God and his children: feeding the homeless, teenage mothers, a safe place for high school kids across the street. It's definitely not the kind of church where the parking lot is empty Monday through Saturday. There's always something going on. I was invited to attend services here today. What a wonderful group of dedicated individuals! Praise the Lord for all they do!!

name: Church in the Garden - Village of Garden City Campus
reviewSummary: This is a warm friendly congregation with a down to earth pastor.  The atmosphere is light And nonpolitical. I Love attending this church. I was invited to church service about 7 months ago. The Pastor is Awesome! I Love while during the sermon he explains things in the simplest way so you can and Will get a Complete understanding of the Bible scriptures. The Pastor and all of the congregation are very kind and welcoming each and every Sunday. There's Bible study and other events throughout the year held here. All are welcome.☺ Great place to worship.Pastor Thorpe gives a great word every week. I have visited this house of worship several times this year, and have enjoyed Rev. Thorpe's sermons each time.  I always leave there feeling BLESSED by the Message and by their MUSIC Ministry!  Another plus is that their church members are very friendly!  I would recommend the C.I.T.G. to anyone searching for a church home! Love Pastor Thorpe and the members of CITG.  It's a very friendly and open place to worship.  All are truly welcome to attend.  Service 10a-11a.

name: Church In the Gardens - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
My friends, staff and I have been inside this church to clean inside the church and that the people that worked there were friendly and helpful like Javier. The Church-in-the-Gardens is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. Also, that many people come to worship this place. EVERYONE is welcome at the Church In The Gardens. Welcome Home ! ! !
Worship Service ⛪ & Sunday School are at 10:00 AM every Sunday, followed by Fellowship-Hour and/or Choir 🎼 Practice.
We have lots of inspirational, educational, comforting, and fun activities, and a lot of Community Outreach. We help our neighbors throughout Queens and beyond to the region, the country, and the world. We enlighten the soul, we enhance the mind, and we feed the body. Come and join with us! I  recently attended this Church. Despite them going through a transitional time in their church,  I  couldn't have met a kinder more inviting congregation of people. I would recommend sticking around for their coffee hour. Attended 15 years ago. Great memories. If I ever move back to NYC, this will be the first place I visit. Happy 100th! Great

name: Church In The Valley - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
My family & I love Church in the Valley. It’s our church family. The pastors are genuine, wise, & kind. We receive practical Biblical help for our marriage, parenting & more. Our kids LOVE the kids’ ministry & youth group. As a result of going to this church we have learned more about following Jesus, Christian living, and loving others well. We are so grateful to God for this church. I was greeted with a warm, friendly welcome. Everyone made me feel welcome and not out of place. I liked that everything was in proper order. The preaching was right out of scripture and properly explained. It was a very nice, friendly church with a very friendly atmosphere. I felt welcome and enjoyed my first visit. I see no reason not to attend this church's services again. The important thing was that God's word was taught. ​We've been attending for three years, and our experience has been fantastic! It checks all the boxes!

The pastors are not only very personable but also deliver solid, Bible-based teaching that is easy to follow and apply.✅️

Great Worship ✅️

The people here are genuinely friendly and welcoming.✅️

The Kidzone area is thoughtfully organized, lessons are prepared, and classrooms are decorated  beautifully.  Teachers are kind and loving with the kids. ✅️

Easy parking! ✅

Delicious Coffee, yes please! ✅️

Lots of homeschoolers and like minded parenting!✅️

Small groups!✅️

The list goes on!

Our whole family looks forward to attending  and serving week after week.

If your looking for a smaller church community, we highly recommend it! Our family has been attending Church in the Valley for many years and we love the warm & welcoming environment. We appreciate the practical teaching and help during this stage of life as we are raising a family. Very grateful for the community. We love our church! My wife and I have been attending for nearly 20 years and are grateful for the impact this church (and these people!) have had on our lives. The church has helped me grow with God, be a better husband and father, and grow with the Lord.

name: Church In the Wind - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Major issues:
-They teach a false works based doctrine, calvinist doctrine. They teach that you need to constantly repent of your sins to be and stay saved, and that you can lose your salvation, those are extremely false. The only way to be saved, is to have your full faith and trust in the Jesus, if you believe that you can do anything to be saved, and stay saved, then you do not trust in Jesus as the one true savior, and you being prideful, and pretending like we have any ability to save ourselves.
-The pastor and his wife are very dramatic and prideful people. The pastor Mike, picks favorite, and likes those who drives harleys, and does not like those who don't ride harleys. The pastor often kicks people out for various sins that he finds out about them, the proper way is talked about in the bible, which he does not follow.
-Pride is a huge sin, and the pastor and his wife live by pride, and their egos.

So, if you want to go to a church that preaches the wrong way to be saved, and that you can lose your salvation, along with a pastor who picks favorites, and if he doesn't like you he'll treat you like an outcast, be my guest.

Love the family atmosphere.  Pastor Mike, Pastor Bill are awesome.  We love going to Celebrate Recovery,  Bible study and Church services on Saturday Best place of worship I've personally ever been.  If you ever felt like "you don't fit in at church" this is the church for you to try. Of all the churches I have attended in my life CITW is the most Bible based, loving church I have been a part of. The ministry staff and supporting members of the congregation are wonderful so dedicated. They know the Word. Come join us. You will be welcome at any service. The best place I have ever really felt accepted and understood. Perfect place to learn about GODS' love. I love Pastor Mike and Dawn and we'll, everyone else. I loved what I did to help and singing in the band for worshipping God.

name: Church of All Russian Saints - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary:
A holy place where faithful Orthodox Christians can find hope and express their love for the Lord God Jesus Christ, pay respect to their deceased loved ones, and pray for the health and happiness of their friends and families.

A wonderful person, always responsive and ready to help people. A very beautiful and traditional church. Wonderful choir and people. I would love to visit there again, and give thanks to the kind people there, especially Mr. Alex, the teacher of Sunday School. Beautiful church Get people What a comfy church! Nice and small, people are friendly, lots of motherly babushki, your local church that is pleasant to go to, the priest Fr. Stephan really cares about his parishioners.

name: Church of Christ
reviewSummary: Worshipped here while traveling.  Friendly people and good bible based preaching. Alright church I guess. No microphone so the message was hard to hear. A lot of murmurs throughout the crowd mostly kids. I hope and pray the work they are doing is for the Lord and reaches beyond the confines of this quiet church. This Church and its congregation is amazing. The teachings and preaching is right out of the Bible. A   stranger  came  asking  for  help there  --  a  young  well  groomed lady  --  desperately  trying  to  get  relocted  and  get  to  a  new  job  --- they  mocked her  for  her  good  grooming  and  her  vehicle  ---- guess  they  wanted  to  get  her to  sell  it  to  them  cheap  since  she  was  low  on  $   nice   show  of  christian  ethics  ---church   members  closely  watch  your  funds---not used   properly Very friendly. name: Church of Christ - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:

The preacher pays careful attention to ensuring you understand the gospel and always take something with you that is applicable and true.
