Excellent honest, insightful teaching
Proverbs 30:5-6 NKJV
Every word of God is pure; He is a shield to those who put their trust in Him. [6] Do not add to His words, Lest He rebuke you, and you be found a liar. I fellowship here..the people are wonderful and caring, its small but a growing congregation. Great place to praise Him. Sending all my 🙏 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏💌

name: Church of Christ - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recomend this congregation!

The discussion based Bible classes are informative, understandable and enjoyable. There are classes for all ages.

The weekly worship is simple, edifying and includes the Lord's supper, singing, prayers, Bible reading, preaching and a collection from members (guests are welcome to give but not expected to).

The fellowship is friendly, warm, helpful, encouraging and inviting! Very friendly and great message A Scripturally sound church. Always good always.

name: Church of Christ - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful experience. Was trying to find a Church of Christ in the area I was visiting and ran across this one. Everyone there was so nice and friendly. The message was very inspiring. It’s so nice to be able to travel to another state and know that there is Church family just as nice and friendly as the ones back home, so if you’re searching for a home church or just one to visit. This is the place!!! Where you can get all that and the One true word! I love this. People are welcoming and kind. If you're traveling and looking for a friendly Church of Christ stop in and be taken in as family and made welcome! We was uplifted by service and loved the singing as well the sermon. Thanks Brothers And Sisters For sharing your love I really enjoyed worshiping with everyone of you the word of our God Say salute one another with a Holy kiss and that is what happened may God continue to bless the Congregation their at Palomar 🙏🏽 your Sister in Christ Jesus Teresa Harris People are genuine,the word is spoken in Spirit and truth,it's a good place to learn about the word of God

name: Church of Christ - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: On March 2, 2014, I was baptized at the Church of Christ in Costa Mesa.  I am so grateful at the age of 64 to have done that.  (Actually, one should say "eternally" grateful!)  This congregation is the most unpretentious and loving group I could imagine, and they are like 'family' not only in Christ, but personally too.  Our minister, John Begin, is a very easy man to talk with and he's gone extremely out of his way to counsel and help me.  Please join us for an embracing and non-judgemental experience.  And most important, if you haven't been baptized, do it.  We all want to see you in Heaven! Great place for Tuesday's meals and taking a shower. The man who runs the showers there us a but surely, but has a good heart. Just doesn't have much patience for new ppl. The map directions will often try to bring you to the gate off of Avocado, but that gate is closed. It is best to enter from the gate off of Wilson. Wonderful people who go above and beyond to help those less fortunate.  They have a daily food pantry, community dinner once a week, and showers twice a week for the homeless. This is a small, very friendly, warm church which preaches the WORD.  If you are looking for entertainment this church is not for you but if you are looking for a church that preaches from the Bible, this is where you want to go!!!

name: Church of Christ - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My grandmother donated to this church tens of thousands of dollars, $1000 a month for at least 40 years. When she had multiple strokes, had to be cared for by a facility, developed clotting disorders and had to be hospitalized for blood transfusions multiple times, as soon as her estate was controlled by family not a single person of the church ever bothered to visit her. I always felt this church had a facade, Christians in name only. Absolutely disgusting. What an encouraging and God-honoring experience! From the Bible class, to singing, to scripture reading, to prayer, to preaching, everything was solid and "by the Book." It was my 1st time attending the church. I went to the 10:30am service. I was cheerfully greeted by what seemed like every church member. I thank you all for that. Im not used to not having music. Having said that I loved the praise and worship sung by the congregation. The message was very well done and easy to understand. I live in Port Orange and will be attending services at Church of Christ Beeville for some time to come. Message was preached directly out of scripture. It is so encouraging to visit a congregation and immensely enjoy worshipping with brethren and hear a challenging but uplifting message from God's Word -' and on this day witness someone acting on their belief in the Gospel Message and taking on Christ in baptism! What a wonderful church. We visited while on vacation and we were greeted by friendly members. They had a very uplifting worship service and teaching. One thing I enjoy is seeing a church enjoy worship while staying true to biblical principles.

name: Church of Christ - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: The message we received from Pastor Joshua's preaching was great, he emphasized that we should serve our neighbor in the name of Christ, what we do to others we do to ourselves, the presence of God we seal with our person, we are Christ's Ambassadors. Kind, loving Bible based group.  Sincere in following the pattern of the first century church as found in the new test testament. A friendly group of people who are serious about studying the Bible and applying it in their lives. Fellowship of christians

name: Church of Christ - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Very inspiring and welcoming congregation! Bible based sermons, Kenny Marrs is a wonderful preacher. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. Great family atmosphere. Sermon is bible based. Met several members, all were friendly. Very welcoming and scripturally based congregation. People were delightful and the teaching was focused on the word of God

name: Church of Christ - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: I love visiting here as often as I can, and I meet each Monday for Ladies Bible study virtually. Friendly, welcoming, and diverse. You will find the love Jesus demonstrated locally and globally here. Nice little church. Friendly folks. Welcoming atmosphere.

name: Church of Christ - Eureka Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful congregation!  Such a wonderful group of people!  I so enjoyed having the opportunity to visit. get ready for hugs because they love guest, don't be shy Very friendly people and pastor. The church where my granddaddy preached for years from the 40's and where my aunt who's almost 90 still attends. A friendly bunch who'll welcome you with open arms This congregation  made me feel welcome!

name: Church of Christ - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Love going to church to fellowship with my brothers and sisters in Christ. ALL are welcome to come and fellowship with us. Great music and teachings of the Bible. Very nice people! Was not "dressed up" and was not the only one in casual clothes. Comfortable seating. Spanish speaking as well as English. Excellent, very Inspiring.

name: Church of Christ - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
Although I started regularly attending church as a preteen, it would take over 30 years for me to come into the knowledge of the truth.  Once I committed myself to studying the church Jesus established, the biblical church, I came to the realization that I had never been in that church.  I then researched churches to determine which churches were modeled after the biblical church.  I was surprised to find only one, The Churches of Christ, that is teaching what Jesus taught for people to join God’s family!  I was on the wide path of religion for over 30 years, hell bound right through a church.  There is a difference between a church and God's church, and all believers have the responsibility of studying to know the difference.  All paths do not lead to God, and all churches do not teach the biblical gospel.  The Bible tells us that there are only a few that find the narrow path that leads to eternal life!  There is only one church, and that church was established by Jesus in Acts 2, and the Apostles fervently taught the process of becoming a Christian as depicted in the New Testament!  We are commanded to maintain the integrity of the original and only gospel of Jesus.  Are you in God's church, or a church that preaches something other than the gospel of Jesus Christ? King St. Church of Christ is home. From the moment I met everyone here they showed me nothing but love and affection. They welcomed me with open arms, and that’s something I wasn’t used to in the world.

I got baptized here, had marriage counseling sessions, and had my wedding ceremony at the church by Leo Judie. God blessed the broken road that lead me here and I couldn’t be more grateful.

Don’t be scared. I was at first, but once you get over that feeling of fear of wanting to do/be better... you will never regret it. You are loved! I love this church.they are above and beyond the best church ever.thank God for sending these messagers.they totally show what real fellowship is.thank you Wonderful congregation, dedicated to truth and fellowship. Thank you for the services. Everyone is very nice and helpful. Thank God.

name: Church of Christ - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly group of people. Amazing bible study. The minister is very knowledgeable about the Bible. Preach the word! Great visit with Bible believing brethren. Choir practice wouldn't hurt American CHRISTIANS TAKEN A STAND!  PREACH ON! Super awesome people!

name: Church of Christ - Napa Campus
reviewSummary:
We Love Church of Christ church.
We went there to visit 3 yrs ago and have been there ever since.
It's been a huge growing experience for us as we recieve the teaching of God's Word.
The Preacher and everyone who attends are very friendly and genuinely love the Lord. God

name: Church of Christ - Novato Campus
reviewSummary: What a wonderful group of faithful Christians that desire to serve and worship God. My wife and I visited this church while in the area during the Independence Day weekend. We were greeted with a warm welcome and given the opportunity to worship, pray, learn, and partake of the Lord's Supper with them. This church of Christ is one of the few that worship in spirit and truth.

name: Church of Christ - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to learn and grow in the Lord. When you are looking for a church family, please join us on Wednesday @ 6:00, Sunday morning class is @ 9:00 and services @ 10:00. We want you to visit with us,  you will feel like your home with our family here in Oxford. The Oxford Church of Christ is my home church. I was there two weeks ago delivering food items for the Oxford Pantry because November was our church's month to help serve the public at the pantry. Our church meets at 9 a.m. for Sunday school and 10 a.m. for services each week. Prayer meeting Wednesday night is at 6:30 p.m. Contact the office for information on virtual services, if you have that need. if you’re looking to come to a welcoming church family, whether your visiting Oxford, a college student, or looking for a permanent church home, the Oxford Church of Christ is the place for you. there are classes Sunday morning at 9, worship at 10, and Wednesday night class at 6:30. Les Ferguson Jr. does a mighty fine job preaching and this church is very supportive of visitors. Worth a pop by This is my home Church here in Oxford. What a great family to be a part of.

name: Church of Christ - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome place ,may God bless them always for their kind hearts and life changing activities they do!!! I grew up going to the Church Of Christ on Laurel Avenue, Every since I was A Baby. I haven't been there in years and I miss it so much and I plan on coming back. That is my Home. I love and miss you ALL! CHURCH OF CHRIST  SUNDAY WORSHIP  TUESDAY BIBLE STUDY AFTER WE HAVE OUR FOOD PROGRAM ITS FOR EVERYBODY. THURSDAY DISCIPLE CLASS. PEOPLE ARE GRATE VERY WELCOMING They have an excellent organized food pantry program system with masks required. Everyone working there or volunteering are super nice and friendly

name: Church of Christ - Petaluma Campus

name: Church of Christ - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: The second oldest INC locale in the Far West. Its sorounded by victorian houses. Great Church worship service are 5:30am/7:30pm on Thurs. & 7am & 11am Sunday. Cws 11am sunday. Service start time is listed incorrectly. New visitors not made to feel welcome. Praise God. I've been a member of this church for over 30 years now.  Sign up as a Bible Student and ask away! a place of solace in a time of distress and sadness - a place where you can meditate and feel closer to God 🙏

name: Church of Christ - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
Welcoming small church that is bible based. Pastor Johnson is awesome and he will show you how to get Jesus in your life. Minister sent by Matthews 28:19,20. God to go into all the world preached the Gospel to everyone. Volunteered here very nice pastor that lives close by.
Very biblical and professional. Bible Based sermons. Congregation is really nice...God is Good. Thank you Jesus..... No actual info on mass times and no one was willing to help in any form in regards to attending and knowing more about the church.

name: Church of Christ - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm a homeless man who's traveling, I go to church every Sunday, Saturday night I couldn't find a place to sleep so I went to a church because I'm a Christian and the house of god is usually the only place people don't judge and hate me. I woke up to the pastor yelling at me, telling me I'm lost and my lifestyles bad, before I could tell him I'm trying to attend church he's on the phone demanding law enforcement, he didn't ask me if I wanted to hear about god or anything, just abject fear and apprehension, gave me a display of disgust and wrath, judgement and pride. The spirit of god cannot be found in churches full of lukewarm believers, Christian's are fisherman of people and of the hundreds of churches I've slept at this was one of 2 that ever acted like this. Most of the time they ask you what you are doing, I explain why I'm there and that I'd liked to attend service and they welcome me in.

This church doesn't want the homeless or rough around, they aren't looking for the lost or sinners, they want their safe insidery community club and are afraid of clear oppurtunities to spread the gospel of our lord and savior Jesus Christ Wonderful people...very welcoming. Awesome @ Friendly congregation Preaching from the Bible.

name: Church of Christ - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary: I wish zero stars was an option this church is incredibly misogynistic I went in there and one of the women said to me "You can fill out a contact card and give it to one of the men the men are in a meeting right now." Very friendly. Trreated me like family. Will visit again! I go 3 try times a week. Good Bible study & Great folks Great group who love the Lord

name: Church of Christ at Gaines Avenue - Albany Campus
reviewSummary: This is a friendly church in my adopted home town of Albany GA. They Teach the Word of God as it is written, as well as is humanly possible. The Church where Jesus Christ is the head and the baptized in Christ is the body. A home of worship where salvation is taught. What is important to me ; is how much I have learned from the teachings of this congregation,   that helps me in my life. I am proudly to say I have worshipped with the baptized believers of this congregation and most of all I Thank you Jesus for placing someone in my life , who led me here. Real Preaching & Teaching Still Exists! I’m honored to call Gaines Ave. COC my Church home and Family. Call and ask about Ministries and service times. Hopefully Covid will ease off and more members can join physically but I am thankful for the Virtual Option and early morning Sunday addition. Amazing wellness lunch and learn. Great congregation. They are very welcoming and there is a Children's Church held on Sundays during Sunday's worship service.

name: Church of Christ at Gold Hill Road - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church.  I attended for several years and loved it.  They preach the truth.  The people are friendly, helpful and workers.  They reach out to the community.  I moved away a year ago and still miss it so much.  I would recommend this church to all my friends and family. Most welcoming congregation I have experienced in some time. Wish I lived closed COCGH would become my home family. Members were welcoming, the biblical truth is preached and the song leadership was exceptional. I will surely visit again. This is a great church for you. They have wonderful Gospel hymns and their sermons are exactly what the Holy Bible says we must all do! Their internet follow through easily keeps you in touch with their members and Ministers. Try it. Be not fearful. Just do it! A place where the truth is taught (book, chapter & verse) with love and no judging.  To truly please the Lord, a relationship is required.  That relationship starts, grows and is matured through His word.  Come join us and begin the most rewarding relationship that will last for eternity!  A relationship with the Father, Son and Holy Spirit. A wonderful congregation of loving people. The Word of God is taught and preached.  The focus is God and Jesus Christ and what we are need to do to be the people we need to be.  We're family on our way to heaven.

name: Church of Southland - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church and was part of a cell group. I eventually stepped away because of concerns around privacy, transparency, and spiritual pressure.

When I joined cell (small group), I was told that what was shared in the group stayed in the group. I later learned that cell leaders write weekly reports summarizing personal sharings, which are passed up to zone leaders and pastoral staff. This was not disclosed upfront. Because I was not comfortable with that, I specifically asked my cell leader not to include my sharings, and she agreed, until recently, when she informed me that she would be including them going forward. This was not presented as a request for my consent, but as a decision. The reasoning given was "spiritual covering," and I was told it had been prayed over and confirmed by multiple church leaders.

For me, this felt like a breach of trust. Privacy and consent should not be reframed as spiritual obedience issues. Prayer and care do not require sharing someone's personal information up a leadership chain without their agreement.

Shortly after leaving my cell group, I was also removed from a ministry I had been faithfully serving in. The reason given was that cell membership is a requirement for serving. This happened around the same time as my last cell attendance, communicated by my zone leader to the ministry leader. It is worth noting that the church is currently in a cell break period through the end of August, meaning this decision was made without waiting to see whether I might find a new cell group when the new season resumes in the fall. I understand that churches can set ministry requirements, but in my experience, the way this was enforced felt rigid and discouraging. To me, it was another example of how this church's institutional structure can override a person's genuine desire, faithfulness, and willingness to serve.

The broader culture here is highly hierarchical and top-down, with pastoral staff, zone leaders, and cell leaders, and a strong emphasis on structure, reporting, and membership requirements. Becoming a member requires regular tithing, cell group participation, a weekend retreat called Encounter, and an 11-12 week Experiencing God program. Some may find that meaningful. For others, it may feel controlled and performative.

I also believe the church should be transparent about how attendance is tracked. There is a small camera on the stage that captures zoomed-in footage of individuals' faces during service, not for security purposes, but so church leaders can identify who attended. This is separate from the headcount that ushers conduct. Attendees are not informed that this is happening. Whether or not it meets a legal threshold for disclosure, people have a right to know they are being visually identified during worship.

There are sincere and kind people here, and I appreciated some aspects of the community. But based on my experience, I would encourage anyone considering this church to ask clear questions about cell reports, privacy practices, ministry eligibility, leadership structure, and attendance tracking before getting deeply involved. I came for the Friday night praise singing and praying session between 7:00 to 9:00 p.m. It was so fun and serious. we have 10 minute quiet pray sessions and 15 minutes pay outloud sessions.  No sermon on Friday night. I brought my friends and they loved it. If they chose church over dancing clubs and bars on a Friday night, Southland Church PRAISE and PRAY must be great because my friends are 👌 smart, or at least they think they are.

I saw alot of people bringing coffee cups with them.

the church is hidden behind a big car dealership. please come early to find it. navigation took us to the area only . we had to drive around to find the hidden church. 🫥

Plenty of parking and safe even at night. I really want to say thank you for showing GOD'S LOVE to the community of orange county, when I went to this place for the first time to receive the food bank, it was extremely heart touching to see all this amazing church people serving other people and showing how God is still caring for his creation.

Thank you guys, for touching people's life with God love through your services, you guys truly are God instruments.

We set down roots here and the school and parish community has become our family. Our children thrive academically and socially, and we couldn't be happier. Wonderful Spiritual Experience , I highly recommend it 👍

name: Church of the Angels - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
This episcopal church is beautiful inside and out. Built in 1889 and incorporating elements of the arts and crafts movement, this building is a movie star in her own right having appeared in dozens of films, TV shows and music videos over the years.
As for the service, it’s currently lead by a thoughtful female interim priest, a choir and an historic organ and its talented organist. If you like a stoic, thoughtful and beautiful spiritual experience filled with smells and bells and tradition, this church is for you. ALL are welcomed and respected. Beautiful looking church with a lot of history. Originally a part of Garvanza later jerrymandered to Pasadena. Much more history. Beautiful holy place. Friendly people and Beautiful music. I love this Church. Beautiful stone church from the outside. I have not been there when it is open to look inside Very pretty English style exterior with Craftsman style interior. Well set on its property and well proportioned inside and out.

name: Church of the Bay - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
Church of The Bay is a Super Wonderful Place to Bring your Family to Worship and to Fellowship. There's Also Children's Church for the little ones to Learn on their own Level. We are a Real Church for Real People. Looks like a nice church – and my friend from Galveston Island likes it very much.

But I have been loving the sweet peacefulness of Galveston, and the drive up here on I-45 was a trip through hell.

We could have made it to the church on time. But I decided to take me and my dog to some green area where we could do our worship through nature.

Having gotten really clear with myself that I will not choose to make this drive on another Sunday, anybody I would meet there today would be someone I would never see again.

Mother Nature I will be seeing on a daily basis.

I will, in future weeks, keep my Sabbath sweet and simple and peaceful on Galveston Island – or maybe the wonderful Bolivar Peninsula.

I wish all good things for the sweet people of the Church of the Bay.

Have a good Sunday – just leave me out of it. I wasn’t raised in church and never felt comfortable enough to call the church my home..I’ve tried many in the community and never felt welcome or would end up leaving feeling like I would be damned to hell. COTB just gets it and REALLY IS a Real Church for Real People !!!  They welcomed me with open arms met me where I was and allowed  me to find comfort in a word that stays focused on god’s purpose for us in our lives. I’ve been attending for about four years and  a member of the dream team worship service for about a year. So thankful and blessed to finally find My Home!! Pastor Dru and Jackie Johnson thank you for obeying god and being a blessing in our community! I felt welcome as a visitor so I came back. Church of The Bay is fun and informative! Pastor Dru preaches and teaches while being insprational to people in a non-judgmental way! The services aren't so long that you want to leave early. You may nake a Sunday Brunch. I visited several times and the other 5 churches that I 'd visited just weren't Church Of The Bay... so now I'm a member! Absolutely life changing and wholesome. Real people from all ethnicities worshipping together. Never been to a church more authentic than this. Highly recommended for families, Spiritual growth, and BIblically based education. ❤️❤️❤️

name: Church of the Beloved
reviewSummary:
I have never felt as immediately welcomed as I did at this church. I wish I was here longer because the services are touching and truly moving. Been a part of this church since 2016. The church has changed a lot but God’s been good throughout all this time. Great community of believers that want to grow their faith. Most of the church is young working professionals given the location downtown, but all are welcome :) I may be partial, but I love the community.
Also personally a fan of the Heal, Grow, Go vision, and appreciate the pastors and elders working through biblically based concepts. Our family was glad to find a church near our hotel in the Loop with live worship and Biblical preaching. We were blessed by the sermon and the fellowship with other believers.

Note: you'll need to check the website and stay up to date on meeting locations, as the address on Google Maps appears old. Overall I thought the community aspect was done well. It is also one of the few asian churches accessible to people in the city.

The crowd is mainly young adults and a huge influx of students from the nearbye medical school.

So for the reason I deducted two stars:

-I thought the main pastor had some interesting takes in his sermons that might be a little controversial and was very scattered/hard to figure out the main points. So it was hard to follow along on Sundays and left me with more questions than takeaways from the message.

-Also, when I asked to call to discuss my questions on the message because I was unable to make it to church the next few weeks, the pastor told me to come to church and we can set up a call. Which defeated the purpose of why I was asking for a call. Just lack of appropriate response to their members when they were questioning the teaching. I personally felt that there was an overall position on making us see what they wanted to see and not backing up most of what they said with biblical or historical reference in the sermons and also in messages. This led me to believe that a lot of the messages were not biblically backed and were based on their assumptions and own cultural biases.

Some of the sermons were also pretty generic and had lackluster messages/didnt teach me something new.

I would only go back for the fun social aspect. They also did a good job of engaging with the community in regards to volunteer opp at the food pantry.

Take my review as u will. My personal opinion/experience will not be the same as the next person..Some ppl have a good time there but I just wanted to put a candid review of my own experience.

name: Church of the Bible - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: My friend and I were blessed to visit this small but special church. Very friendly people, loved the singing and they had tambourines which is awesome. As a pastor's granddaughter this was one of the most informative, interesting and spirited sermons I've heard. Pastor really knows his stuff and has a gift. I learned some new things. Highly recommend! And thank you! Gods presence has Blessed me for many years in this Church for years. Recommend it . MY EXPERIENCE  AT CHURCH  IS GOOD.  SIGN MG. Love this church! It's small but very cozy, the people are incredibly nice

name: Church of the Canyons - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: This church practices the same unbiblical no-restoration possible counseling as Grace Community Church. It seems normal till it isn’t. Prayer services over your particular sin- of pride - but never able to say why yours is different from the rest. Your repentance is different from their own. Elders meet in secret without counceling or interview before excommunication. The reason given- it would be a waste of time. Congregations are lied to regularly.  This is a lottery ticket for church hurt. I’ve been going here ever since I was a small child. The staff and community at this church are nice, and they are welcoming new people. We have many fun events such as VBS. Another nice thing about this church is that they have many cool worship classes for all ages. There is a youth group with lots of events. Come to this church for some friends and nice worship! My husband and I have attended this church since 1983. It is home. We love the body of Christ and work hard to serve it well. It breaks my heart to see negative reviews for this dear church. No one is perfect. God’s church is run by fallible humans, sinners who have made themselves available to work for the Kingdom and the gospel. I give four stars because no church is perfect. But I also believe you will find none better. Warm and friendly congregation, Not-a-Tickle-your-Ear message; but, a Godly direction for your life and not a mega church. People really seemed to want to welcome and were genuinely wanting to get to know you. As a physically disabled senior I was seated in the cafeteria with coffee watching services on the television. Another woman who regularly sat in the same area caused trouble for me as she wanted me to move so her friend could sit where I was at. Basically I was removed from my seat told that they could place me in a room with a television.very rude people. Ignorant. That was the third time I was insulted and the last.

name: Church of the City
reviewSummary: Rapidly growing network known for its focus on 'Spiritual Formation' and 'Presence'. The culture is thoughtful, modern, and deeply community-oriented.

name: Church of the City - Downtown - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
We were driving through Easter weekend and attended their Easter service.  Everyone was very friendly and welcoming, they had cool little packages for kids to keep them occupied during the service, the message was very good.   If I lived in Nashville I could totally see this being my home church.

Thank you to all the volunteers that helped us feel so welcome and putting those kids packages together. I am new to Nashville and was a little nervous the first Sunday I went alone to this church. But let me tell you I am so glad I did! The congregation is largely comprised of younger,(than me) people. But at 60, that is nothing new. The music was contemporary but respectful and not distracting as some worship bands are to me. The pastor taught from the Bible, and did an excellent job of making the message applicable to daily life. I was greeted warmly but not in an overly invasive way. The dress is casual but again, I felt it was respectful. I feel this body of believers is hitting every aspect of “church” well, as reflected in the New Testament church. There are also small groups that meet during the week if you want to have a more intimate experience   In your life and the church ministers to the community in which it is located. If you are looking for a church in East Nashville, you could look a long time and not be as blessed as you will be going here. They also have multiple campuses in and around Nashville. Also, great childcare. And COFFEE! Most importantly for me, COTC-D delivers biblical teachings that feed all stages of spiritual maturity, while challenging us to serve our community in ways that deliver meaningful results and tangible impacts.

COTC-D has an extraordinary variety of teaching pastors that skillfully share their diverse perspectives and personal experiences when interpreting the Scripture with integrity - "Truth & Spirit". The teachings are biblical, scholarly, engaging, and provocative . They help me re-examine my faith practice of following Jesus, and how I demonstrate it publicly and privately.

Yet, one of my favorite things about COTC-D are the efforts made to engage and connect people with each other in "Circle Time" and , "Without getting weird," (listen/share with respect)
I grew up in a very small church as a Pastor's daughter, and COTC-D is the first large church that I've attended that consistently makes time for small group reflection after the sermons,  asking:

1)!What stood out to you?
2)What are we going to do about it?

It is brief but powerful 5 minute chat that creates a space for everyone to be "seen and heard". I've learned a lot from the people seated next to me, during "Circle Time". And because I'm new to Nashville, it has also helped me make new authentic friendships and fellowships that edify and encourage me to LOVE IN ACTION  (with everyone whether they share my faith or not), which is especially important in these current times of global crisis and in the face of all injustices.

Yet, I didn't give COTC-D  a 5 star rating for being "perfect", for no church is perfect, but seeking to commune with God ( The Author of Perfection) in worship and study of the Scriptures.

COTC-D gets my 5 for being a SAFE place for an imperfect human being, like myself, to continue to authentically pursue  of a better way to live, love, learn, and purposefully serve. We were here for Christmas 2024. Came on Sunday and then again for Christmas Eve. GREAT expository preaching. Anointed worship. Beautiful community. 5/5 🙏🔥🕊️ First time attending this church, enjoyed the sermon. But, it was a Christmas service and the  pastor referred to the Roman province of Judea as “Palestine” twice. Said that Jesus was born in “1st century Palestine”. This is not a historical controversy, it is simply a matter of record that Jesus was born in Judea and it wasn’t until the 2nd century that the Romans renamed the province “Palestine” shortly after a violent Jewish rebellion in Judea. I don’t know why he would pull that out of thin air.

name: Church of the City - Franklin - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful Easter service. We visited from out of state with our son and family who are beginning to attend this church. It is a large church with a very welcoming congregation. The message was very good and bible based. There are programs for children to attend during church service. Many mission projects underway as well as classes, Bible studies and outreach opportunities. Come here if you want to be entertained. The "sanctuary" is painted dark 🌑 purple and black like some night 🌃 club. It features a LOUD rock and roll band and a short spiritual "Ted talk" 🦜 that is designed to make people feel good. Not 🙂‍↔️ very kind to newcomers or the poor judging from the other reviews. I'll give this entertainment center a pass...👋 Church of the City - Spring Hill advertised a 1300 service and then without notice canceled it. Public facing organizations need to do better when it is comes to canceling advertised times. There are plenty of tools and ways to communicate these items to potential new members. We were visiting from New Brunswick, Canada on July 13 th, 2025. We enjoyed wonderful worship, witnessed so many take next steps in baptism and an absolutely fantastic Bible based, God honouring sermon! Such a wonderful joy to be visiting COTC, Franklin! We felt right at home and left knowing we had been Christ! Could not recommend Church of the City more! I was there alone with my children, lost and unsure where to turn for prayer; no one seemed to care. There were too many people for them to be truly attentive to so many sheep. Nevertheless, I tried to contact them online to register for a group, but they were all full; I sent an email to ask what could be done and never received a reply.

reviewSummary: Online has a 1300 service listed. Showed up at 1250 and waited. All yhe doors were locked. Let us know if you’re coming and I’ll meet you at the door and show you around. They really want to mentor the kids and not just build an epic program. No church is perfect but we have felt like this is a healthy church for our family. Grateful.

name: Church of the Foothills - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
From the very 1st services I attended I knew I was now home. I was looking for a long time to find a Christian Church that's focused was on the teachings of Jesus, instead of judgements.
It wasn't until after I joined that I discovered that this was the church my pilgrim grandfather built (the first church in Boston, of the Massachusetts Bay Colony)... I really was home again! Progressive & all people are welcome Pastor Mike and the whole congregation are the most friendly group of people you could hope to meet.  Right from the start everyone is welcoming.  Our 2 little girls love going to church which is not something at all I remember from my days many years ago in Sunday school.  They have a terrific program for children.  We love Pastor Mike’s sermons, the community we found and supporting the good works.  Very rewarding to be a member of this congregation.  This is not a rigid fundamentalist church that ignores the teachings of Jesus.  This is a church that follows the latest biblical scholarship on the historical Jesus.  This is an inclusive church that loves all our brothers and sisters. Friendly place. Nice music. Good message. This is a christ centered church. Very welcoming to everybody. There are interesting activities for all. The minister is an interesting person with a  well rounded knowledge of bible literature. When this church opens  up again it will be a nice church to go too.

name: Church of the Good Shepherd
reviewSummary: Wonderful welcoming traditional Christ-centered church! It is a church where people know your name and the names of your children, where people like and support each other, church filled with lots of traditional songs (no electric instruments) and children's laughter. Come join us and see for yourself! This is my home church--and I love it!  Solid preaching, lots of hymn singing, and wonderful activities and community groups. Church of the Good Shepherd is a beautiful budding community. You can expect a warm welcome, a liturgical and deeply meaningful order of service, plenty of kid energy, lots of opportunities to use your gifts, and familial feasts and celebrations. Weekly communion is nourishing to our family. As a very new Anglican congregation, the identity of the church is being formed all the time as we are unwrapping the tradition we are a part of. The church is rich in tradition, but focused on the essentials, which makes it a welcome place for people with many faith backgrounds (or no faith background!). I'm thankful for the anchor this community has been for the last year+. A community-focused, Bible-based church centered around honoring the beauty of the Anglican heritage and engaging the entire family. Their music is amazing! Great community, great theology, and great service. I've come to really appreciate everything about the Anglican way from its solid theology rooted in scripture, its reverence of Christ and His church, and of course, the Book of Common Prayer. The flock at the Good Shepherd is the best! We are are community of single worshippers, families, young and elderly alike. Nothing beats coming together as the body of Christ to worship together every Sunday.

reviewSummary: My husband and I joined 1 year ago and we love it! I go their frequently drop off and pick up my granddaughter from her preschool, which is excellent. Great people! So friendly. Folk group meets here for sings. AWESOME Spirit and people!

reviewSummary:
Places is awesome pastor Dan is the sweetest person I’ve ever met and Miss Taylor and Pastor EJ are awesome. name: Church of the Highlands
reviewSummary: One of the largest churches in the US. Known for its impeccable 'Growth Track' system and life-giving culture.

name: Church of the Highlands | Alabaster Campus - Alabaster Campus
reviewSummary:
Someone asked me what I loved most about Church Of The Highlands? I told them— I love the people, godly community, the love shown as soon as you pull in the parking lot and the smiling faces that greet you at the door. The word of God is pouring out into each campus. Worship sets the atmosphere. I love it here. I’m growing here and I call Alabaster home💞 30 minutes of hearing damage, followed by a very short message. Candle lighting was outstanding. I can't emphasize enough how loud this was. I've operated armored vehicles that made less noise. Ear Protection required.

So many things were nice, but even in the back row the volume of the music was painful. Always loved this church and attending. Just moved to this area and can worship here again! Attended a wonderful Christmas Eve service. Beautiful  singing with hymns and focus on Gods gift and Jesus's birth. It included the kids and a candlelight service and a sermon that made my husband pay attention. Not over extravagant like typical Non denomination churches that feel to me more like concerts than church services. Just want to thank those with the SERVE team at National Night Out tonight! They were phenomenal, and I'm forever grateful! ❤️

name: Church of the Highlands | Columbus Campus - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: We went today and we met at the door with warmth, no pressure. The lady at the entrance was very nice and once she knew it was our first time she walked the entire way with us telling us about the church. We entered and let me tell you the people and the feel made it feel like home. It was a wonderful experience and I believe we found our new home church. Ty so much for the love you can definitely feel Gods presence there. Highly recommend Church of the Highlands is a campus church which means you are watching the pastor on the screen in a movie theater style setting. Worship is done by a live band. The music is modern and trendy. The youth program seems to be done very well. Kids church is organized and well structured. The church offers small groups as a way to connect with one other because it is a rather large church. There is a large military presence and we appreciate that. Started going to Church of the Highlands the last Sunday in March 2025! I took the yearly challenge to see how it could change my life! I am finding joy again. I went through growth track, got Baptized and serve at the church! It is now January 2026 and I am so glad I did the challenge. My life is so much better! Give your life to Jesus and feel his love and see your life change for the better!!🙏🙏 Been going to this church for  few weeks now at first had a bad experience with the greeting but after I got to know somebody that goes to the church I highly recommend it just got to get past to that services on a screen but very great atmosphere Last Sunday, I visited for the first time. I did not know what to expect. I was tired of churches that were political, so I was pleasantly surprised that this church was not like that, especially given the circumstances that we are in referring to our National discord.

name: Church of the Highlands | Daphne Campus - Daphne Campus
reviewSummary: Great church teaching the word and building amazing community. Highly reliable service content. This is one of the highlands satellite campuses (there are many throughout the Alabama region), so the service is live streamed from their main campus. I don't mind it, especially since the teaching is so good, and they have the framework in place to build community throughout the week. Highly recommend this church! My family LOVES this church. The energy is contagious. The people are friendly and welcoming. The services are always so relevant, relatable, and usually have a good chuckle in there a time or two. Attending Highlands and being part of this church is truly an enjoyable experience and for the first time in my 34 years of life I FINALLY understand why it's so important to belong to a great church.... give it a try!! Come experience and worship God with a church that is, in my opinion, the best church ever. I was traveling through from Houston Texas to Panama City Florida and realize that it wasn't that far off my travels to be able to stop in to catch a service in person. It was awesome to be able to drag my 5th wheel RV trailer and truck into the parking lot for the service. Church of the Highlands is always serving the Lord and I miss being able to go to the churches in person. I do listen to the on Internet. If you're looking to find a church or hear a service I would highly recommend you hear what the Church of the Highlands has to teach and offer through their Pastor Chris Hodges and his team. Nice job Mobile Bay! COTH is a one of a kind church experience that's like no other. I recommend anyone looking for a new church to consider COTH as it offers a powerful worship experience, impactful messages, and opportunities to grow with other Christians. Pastor Jimmy Bowers is awesome and his leadership is resonated through his team at this location. Their Christmas Eve service was a very good opportunity to enjoy celebrating the birth of Jesus, my Savior, with my family.  The atmosphere was very welcoming.

name: Church of the Highlands | Greystone Campus - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you for serving fantastic lunches when I went to your Growth Track to become a member!  It was above and beyond♡  Such a warm welcoming church.Love your multiple small groups to choose from also.
Being new to Alabama I have made dear friends in the Small Groups.
Kind Regards Sherry B We went to pre k graduation. It was a great experience to watch the young kids show what they had learned at an early age. Church of the Highlands | Greystone Campus offers dynamic worship, impactful sermons, and a friendly community focused on faith, service, and meaningful connections. A truly inspiring place. We’ve been members for over a decade and feel at home here. Our pastor, Chris Hodges, is an upbeat storyteller who never fails to inspire. The church does millions of dollars in charity work here locally as well as internationally. So amazing. Absolutely amazing. It’s so wonderful how every time I come to this church I feel at home. I feel the presence of God every Sunday in worship, and Pastor Chris does an amazing job preaching his message of God to us. I’ve had many instances of changing a particular area in my life that I’ve had a lot of growing in the Lord. If I hadn’t gone to this church in the first place, I wouldn’t have been in an amazing walk with Christ today. Pastor Chris and many other pastor choices that spread the messages every Sunday are brilliant in doing their job. The Lord is so amazing in getting this church established. I’m so thankful I can be a part of this. Much can be said about my experience but I will leave it here because it would be so much to write. I can say that the Lord, with so much love and power, will continue to make this church stronger. I love my church and I definitely recommend it! I also can’t wait for new campuses to be built and for the Grandview Highlands College to be built!❤️🙏🏻

name: Church of the Highlands | Huntsville Campus - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
We Love our Church!
Worship is awesome all Glory to God!
Sermons are Biblical and love how all Sermons easy to understand.
God speaking through the Sermons. Added visiting Campus #5 with my daughter yesterday.  The consistency as far as the local campus.  Very friendly and helpful.  Great worship and great message by Charlotte.

Have now visited Tuscaloosa, home at Madison, The Shoals, Grants Mill, and Huntsville.

Will be back home next Sunday at the Madison Campus. I have moved around a lot in several different states. This is by far my favorite church I have been to. Full of life, grace, and challenges you to grow and be a better Christian. Great service, enjoyed seeing my son Eric and granddaughter  get baptized. When visiting again will definitely attend  service I read a couple of poor reviews - one passing judgment based on a mailer, and a couple of non-specific but critical comments - but attended anyway.  I don't usually like large churches but... this place is DIFFERENT in a good way.   I've been around the world and been to quite a few different churches and denominations.  I can confidently say I've never experienced a place like this.  The Lord is moving through this place in a mighty way.  What one gets from this place is what one brings into it.  If you want to be anonymous, it's not hard to do that in a place this big.  But if you want to get connected to the body of Christ, all you have to do is let it be known and - you're there!  They make it easy to plug in if you choose to.  It's also easy to fade into the background if all you want to do is show up and exist.  If you really want to live, plug in and get ready to take off!

name: Church of the Highlands | Montgomery Campus - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: Went to my grandsons graduation from the Montgomery Police Academy.  I was so proud of him and the other officers accomplishment. The church had plenty of space and great seating. It was so nice. Plenty of parking and bathrooms were convenient and easy to find,  It was a really great venue for this event. Yeah hard pass! If the values your church instills in Steve Marshall is any indicator, then I know what this church is and will steer clear of it. Jesus who came to give life would be disgusted with this man. I can only imagine what's preached here if he feels comfortable attending. Had the pleasure of attending my first service at Church of the Highlands here in Montgomery after moving back here where I was born and raised. I was a member of the Highlands in Florence for almost a year and enjoyed my time there so I knew that attending this one wouldn't be no different. It was exactly what I expected, experiencing the presence of the living God through the worship, prayer, and the preaching of the Word. Great people, great building, great experience. I prefer the convenience of online services, but if you're going in-person then this is the place to go. A little chilly in the upper seats by the vents, and quite a few people.have complained about how loud the music gets...but otherwise a wonderful church. I'm a member of Church of the Highlands. It's a friendly church that welcomes everyone. Worship services are held at locations across Alabama and Georgia. I invite you to attend a service and see for yourself how we serve others in Jesus' name.

name: Church of the Highlands | Newnan Campus - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
Our lives have been changed by Church of the Highlands! We love the inspiring teaching, spirit-filled worship, and life giving community it offers! Come check it out! I was looking for a local Church to visit and chose Summit because it was close to my home, and I liked early service (not exactly an in-depth spiritual approach).  It was and Awesome experience, the music was unbelievable and the sermon was powerful. Definitely a Spirit filled service.  I went to the early service and it wasn't as full as I would have expected but it didn't take away from the experience.  I will definitely be back.

As an update, I enjoyed the services so much I became a regular and I found some foundation and direction for my life. I joined two weeks ago.  The teachings and sprit filled service helped me immensely, I am so proud this is my new Church Home & family. My husband and I felt right at home from the first time we visited Summit. Personally, I have never experienced a more accepting and loving church. Their doors are open to everyone in all walks of life. Now, 2+ years later we still loving being a part of Summit! We have been a member of Church of the Highlands Newnan (previously Summit) for over 8 years. We have made lasting friendships through our involvement.  We find ourselves encouraged each week and challenged to grow. The message is understandable for the new Christian but has the depth needed to feed the soul of a well-tenured Christian. Summit is such a sweet church. You feel so welcomed the second BEFORE you walk into the building! They truly care and are passionate about each person as an individual contributing to the kingdom of God in their own way with their own specific personality and God given gifts. There is a special feeling I get when I'm in this church. It is very different and I am more than grateful that I found this church. The pastor is sweet and passionate and I have learned lots of new great worship songs through this church ! Overall has been a very life changing experience!

name: Church of the Highlands | Riverchase Campus - Hoover Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely awful. I wish I could leave negative stars. They were horrible people. Cannot recommend strongly enough that you go to ANY other church.

It is 100% not ok to put hands on people that do not want to be touched.

It is also equally as not ok to withhold children from their parents regardless of your program.

I will also not be interrogated or asked where I work when I say that the emergency (required for getting my own kid) is, "I have a lot of things to do before work. It's urgent that I get home."

Keep in mind, this was after verifying with multiple people that I am indeed (my kid's) parent. And was told a bunch of times that they were getting her.

They did allow me into the worship room and "informed" me that a teacher had my daughter. I could see her. This wasn't even close to true. I loved seeing such a diverse group of people here. While they have a wide range of activities, none of them seemed to fit my current interests. Still, it’s a nice place to experience a modern church service. This church tool care of our funeral and our family. The staff is extra nice. They showed great kindness in our time of sorrow. Recommended by Black MEN Network - Intelligence Working Together. Been coming to this location for several years. They have a coffee shop on inside, a daycare center, and plenty of parking. A police unit is on standby and doing security. The information usually has the pamphlet and the notes sheet to put in your notebook. Due to COVID-19 they have suspended the later services on Sunday. Each location their times are sometimes different! Love my Church! My first visit to this location for ReCreate conference. I really enjoyed & had a blessed time.

name: Church of the Hill - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited Church of the Hill today for the first time and honestly had a really great experience. The atmosphere was welcoming and genuine from the moment I walked in. You can truly feel that this church cares about people and community.

The sermon really stood out to me. It wasn’t just motivational speaking or religion for tradition’s sake — it was deep, practical, and centered on living a real life with Christ every day, not just on Sundays or holidays. The message about “sin’s gravity,” identity in Christ, forgiveness, and living a resurrected life every day was powerful and thoughtful.

I also loved how they honored both mothers and graduating seniors during the service. It felt very personal, warm, and family-oriented.

The worship team was great, the printed materials were beautifully organized, and overall the church felt alive, authentic, and full of grace.

Definitely thankful I stopped here today. Best youth group in the area, fantastic children's program, and hands down friendliest church with an amazing message from the two wonderful pastors each week. They've handled this pandemic with grace and wisdom. I'm so happy to call this my church home for the last 20 years. My first time back since 20+ years ago! The sermon was great! Pastor and youth pastor introduced themselves, very friendly. Music was not so great. They took a while to get into a good rhythm and singing in tune. I was expecting something a bit more modern, upbeat, and contemporary. Covid has ruined the personalization of the whole church experience. I want to shake hands, converse, and hug but we can't😷. Overall, I had a good experience! Excellent place to gather to worship! Excellent pastor and people. Come feeling welcomed and plenty of stuff to involve your family. I have visited many time now with my fiance who is a member. Recently worshipped at Richmond Hill UMC while visiting my daughter. What a warm and welcoming church. If I lived closer, this would be my church!

name: Church of the Holy Angels - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary:
Holy Angels is a wonderful parish to be apart of. Fr.  Max is on fire with the Holy Spirit and if you can allow yourself to be emerged in the celebration of the mass, you will find there is no better church around to bring your children to mass. So many young families here! It is said that a quiet church is a dying church. Let me say that this church is alive and thriving. Join us all! Very pretty venue.  Priest was nice enough.  Not being Catholic, the more services I attend the less religious I become. Beautiful church... Lovely Mass. Very nice community and beautiful church. I do find it disturbing when the pastor sprinkles holy water on the congregation laughing as he soaks certain parishioners. It's inappropriate and irreverent to use the blessed water to get a laugh. The parishioners here are on fire for the Lord Jesus. Under the guidance of the Pastor Max Cole they are getting everything thing they need to worship and praise God. Very generous parishioners.
Rick Costanzo

name: Church of the Holy Faith - Downtown Sanctuary
Church of the King - Baton Rouge - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church. People are so warm and friendly. God’s love is here for sure. There is something for every age. Pastor Troy and Jennifer  at our Baton Rouge campus love the Lord and the congregation. Pastor Steve , our Senior pastor and his wife Jennifer from Mandeville are real also and love God  and the people at all the campuses.  I love the small groups where you can support and pray for each other, while learning to get closer to Jesus. When I first came to this church I was lost and hopeless. Not sure where my life was going. I felt defeated and felt I had no one to turn to. When I first walked through these doors at the church I was hesitant and didnt know what to expect. I was looking for a reason to keep running from God and leave the church but the church never gave me a reason to leave. They all loved me how I was and accepted my brokenness and was so kind and loving every weekend I came in. As the walls I had built up slowly started coming down I started to make family here. It’s a church who truly cares for the people in it. The Lord brought me here for a reason. This church has helped me find purpose in life and has helped me build a relationship with the Lord. Through the church pointing me toward Jesus I have found freedom.  It’s a bible preaching church who has amazing staff, an amazing serve team and amazing attendees who truly care. If you’re looking for a home church and people you can call family this is the right place. Truly grateful to be a part of such an amazing church. As soon as Jennifer and I became a part of Church of the King in 2018, we knew this is where God had called us. From the very beginning, it felt like home. This church is more than a place you attend—it’s a family you belong to. It’s a place where you build real friendships, do life together, and walk through every season with people who care.
The family atmosphere is hard to put into words. There is such a tangible sense of God’s presence here. It feels like God Himself is in the middle of every relationship, every conversation, and every moment. Pastor Steve’s messages are powerful and practical. He has an incredible gift of communicating the Bible, making it easy to understand and apply to everyday life. Each message is rooted in Scripture and delivered in a way that challenges you, encourages you, and leaves you feeling equipped to live out your faith beyond Sunday. The worship is powerful, and the heart of the church is centered on helping people know God, find freedom, discover their purpose, and make a difference.
Church of the King has deeply impacted our lives, strengthened our faith, and helped us grow closer to God and to others. We are so grateful to be part of what God is doing here and couldn’t imagine calling anywhere else home. The Church of the King in Baton Rouge has a wonderful children's ministry, Kings Kids, led by Zoe and others.  It teaches children about God through worship, games, and discussions, and has been a blessing to me and my granddaughter. This church is the definition of “come as you are”. The moment you walk in, you feel the Holy Spirit and you meet people that have an abundance of love because they choose every day to walk with Jesus! No matter where you are on your faith journey there is a place for you! The kids, youth and young adult programs are so transformative for young minds! If you are looking for a family church or just a beautiful, accepting christian community, Church of the King could be the vessel that God will use to change your life!
Why not take the first step of faith? Let Him guide you the rest of the way!

name: Church of the King - Biloxi - Biloxi Campus
reviewSummary: The first time I visited the Church was amazing. The friendly staff and connect team made me feel so welcome. The service worship music is beautiful and gets you ready for worship. The message is in the scriptures. Stop by for a visit at 5 pm on Saturday afternoon or Sunday at 8, 9:30, 11:15. Hello, my family has been attending this Church for eight years, and what a wonderful experience this continues to be every day. So, if you are looking to get involved in Bible teaching and growing in the Word of God, come and be welcomed into the Church of the King family in Biloxi, located at 920 Cedar Lake Road. Our pastors and church staff and volunteers are here to answer any questions you may have, help you grow spiritually, and fellowship with others. We are a beautiful and family-centered church, from infants to young adults, and men and women ministries. Everyone in the family can and will get fed in the Lord every day. We have Second Saturday Serve events, Foster Care and Adoptions events, Christmas events, and other community events ( support First Responder, prayer & fasting, blood drives, school partnerships). We have a monthly praise and worship night on the first Friday of each month at 7 pm, and this is a fantastic night to come together and praise the Lord and fellowship with others. The Church also has Men and Women's Night during the Spring and Fall; Freedom, Financial Peace, learning about tithes and offerings, mission trips. We have small group meetings, and these are so powerful, to grow together create fellowship and friendship. So I highly recommend you come and visit us. Open on Saturday at 5 pm, and Sundays at 9:30 am and at 11:15 am we offer Next Steps (1-4) classes at 12:45 pm each Sunday after service to learn about the Church and how you can become a member of our Dream Team and your purpose and growth in Christ. I hope to see you all this Saturday night or Sunday morning. Be blessed and learn the Word of God, and grow new relationships. Hugs!! Didn’t know what to expect with it tucked away in a packed shopping center but once I walked in i knew it was home immediately. Genuine people and staff that love the Lord, excellence in all things, passion to reach the lost, families, and for the next generation, and a phenomenal senior pastor that teaches in a special way. This church immediately felt like home! Pastor Dan was super welcoming and introduced me to a group of people that took me in and even contacted after church which showed how intentional people are! Definitely coming back! I couldn’t be more thankful for this church! They teach the Word of God and foster an environment that points others to Christ and community. Everyone is so welcoming!

name: Church of the Living God Galveston - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
They are so welcoming and nice .
I found my other home .
The music is amazing mandi really puts her soul into her music and will bring tears to your eyes.
Each message by pastor trey or guest speakers are amazing its not all rainbows and butterflies it's actual teaching of your walk with Jesus.
I hope whoever comes here feels the presence of the holy spirit because I certainly do! I was in a dark way and this church has totally transformed me but most importantly jesus did. Please come you are all so welcomed and loved ❤️❤️ After traveling full time in an RV across the United States, I experienced so many beautiful places, met incredible people, and saw God’s creation in ways I never had before. But no matter where I went, my heart was still searching for something deeper—a place to be planted, a church to truly call home.

Church after church, city after city, I visited many congregations along the way. Each one served a purpose for that season, but I knew God was still leading me. I kept praying, trusting that when the time was right, He would make it clear.

Then one day, after all the miles, all the movement, and all the waiting, I walked into a church and immediately felt peace. I cried on the way home because God’s presence was undeniable and I knew I was “HOME”. The worship stirred my spirit, the Word spoke directly to my heart, and the love of the people felt genuine and unforced.

After a season of being on the road, God showed me that rest, connection, and spiritual covering matter. He reminded me that while the journey shaped me, He had a place prepared for me to grow, serve, and belong. Walking into that church wasn’t just finding a building—it was finding alignment with God’s timing and purpose.

What I searched for across the country, God had already ordained for me. This church was not a coincidence. It was confirmation. When we entered there was several people greated and helped us.  The praise team was very good.  The pastor did a good message and he was easy to understand.  If I lived in this area this would be the church we would attend. It felt like a welcome home from from the first door that was opened for SuzyQ & I. We're home,Dad...I'm following in the walk of my Father, Phillip Sawyer,RIP. Praise God. I'm home and safe. A sanctuary of love & peace where the air is filled with the Holy Spirit!
I am so blessed to live on an island where there is a church that praises our Creator & Heavenly Father,  His only begotten Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit.
Come broken.
Leave welded.
Pastor Trey and his wife Marlo are authentic, transparent, funny, caring, and passionate about leading people to Jesus Christ.
