name: Church of the Most Precious Blood - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s really heartbreaking to see how this church has changed. For years, families from Lauderbach Elementary relied on the church parking lot for safe drop-offs and pickups. It used to feel like a kind and welcoming part of the community.

Before picking up my son, I would even go inside to pray it brought me peace and made me feel spiritually connected. Now, not only are we not allowed to park there, but I can’t even go in to pray anymore. That hurts more than anything.

Now, we’re being treated like intruders  as if we’re criminals just for trying to get our kids to school safely. The traffic outside has become more dangerous, and the stress it causes on both parents and kids is unfair.

Isn’t a church supposed to be a place of compassion and support? I truly hope leadership reflects on the values they’re meant to represent  because right now, many of us are feeling pushed away instead of embraced.

We’re not asking for anything unreasonable — just a little grace and understanding from a place that’s supposed to stand for those very things.

Zoom in on the picture you’ll see the man from the church standing there like a guard, as if we’re a threat. It’s sad 😢 that it’s come to this. Small church, very warm welcome when you arrive. Sunday Spanish mass at 1 pm. Plenty of parking! ♿ Excellent place to play Bingo. Volunteers are great. They serve food and drinks. Free coffee. Different types of flashboard's, double action, show me the money, and free speedy with buy in. Pay off bingo games $200 and consolation $50 Church is open during the day for prayer and has parking. The best feature is the 24 hour adoration room, with its beautiful statues and reverent exposition of the Eucharist it is a great resource for prayerful Catholics. Small, but welcoming and friendly. I've only been here a few times, but I feel elated when I set foot in here. And after Sunday Mass, there are fundraising events. The food there is delicious. I simply have no words when I try out their dishes.

This has to be, in my opinion, the most beautiful church in all of Chula Vista.

name: Church of the Nativity
reviewSummary: At first I find the crucifix a bit odd. I’ve never seen such depiction of our Lord suffering but closely pondering about it; I’ve seen His strength and courage. Despite of what is to come, He bravely endured pain knowing it will benefit all of us who will look up and believe! 🙏 Very beautiful church.  I love the holy water well as you walk in the door. It looks like postcard, inside is just so breath taking. Was in the Leawood area from out of state and attended Mass. Everything was terrific. Great church, music, homily…it was all terrific. Great church community. People come into Mass late and Father visits with them at the back of the church, never starts mass on time as we cater to those who can’t make it to mass on time. Kids scream and cry with parents taking no action. Very hard to pray and get your mind right when church seems like you are at a picnic. Why don’t the priests have homilies anymore about common curiosity??? First time attending Mass here. Beautiful Catholic Church and community.

name: Church of the Open Door - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a church that I haven't gone inside of, but I went up their nicely maintained Open Door Trail to the Azusa Peak today. rom that trail you can go up to Glendora Ridge Road and Glendora Peak. There is a way to the cross called, "Open Door Nature Trail,'' on the property of Church of the Open Door in Glendora. Unlike the Garcia Trail, which is closed indefinitely, this route is less forgiving and affords a direct approach to the cross on Azusa Peak. There is plenty of parking and the grounds are open to everyone. This is one of the most friendly churches I have ever been to! I think that they have good solid teaching, they have a great kids program, the campus is beautiful! And above all they just have a warm inviting group of folks and relationships there. I love this place. A welcoming, grace filled community of believers that love Jesus. They have solid bible teaching, discipleship, an amazing children's and student ministry, great Sunday school classes, a very popular VBS program with hundreds of kids, they're very own camp IDRAFOJE (ID RAther Follow JEsus, a sell out every year), a really beautiful campus on the hillside, and a lot more. You should check it out for sure. A church in the following of Jesus Christ, outdoor services currently under a very large tent.
Very kind and loving community with humble followers. Also very welcoming environment. This Church of the Open Door has lots of land in the Glendora foothills with Deer that graze on the Church's land. It has a Open Door Nature Trail alongside it's Road to the Church @ the top of the hill.

name: Church of the Open Door - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: Open Door is a warm, welcoming group. When we moved cross country, my husband and I found a new California family here. We are grateful for the support and love of our church family. Diverse mix of age, life stage and economic status. We also love that they support YoungLife! I am so grateful for this local bible believing church. The word of God is preached faithfully with the Gospel every Sunday without the sugar, whip cream and cherries on top of it. The worship is delightful and honouring to the Lord Jesus. Behold how good and pleasant it is when brothers and sisters dwell in unity. This Church follows the teachings of Jesus. It's filled with true believers who are learning to "love one another" Come and be loved! I visited this church in 2010 and came back because of the warmth of the pastor, the friendliness of the people and the amazing worship during the service. This church has become home. Open Door is coming home. The people here are welcoming and the Spirit of God is present and working in hearts and lives.

name: Church of the Pines - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary:
We LOVE Church of the Pines!! We have been members since we moved to Tyler. Everyone there is very welcoming and Pastors Les and Angela Harvey are the BEST! If you're looking for a Church, this is the place. Church of the Pines is such a special place! Pastor Les and Angela Harvey are absolutely incredible—genuine, passionate, and full of wisdom. You can feel their heart for people in every message. The kids’ director, Anne, is incredibly gifted at creating a fun, faith-filled environment where kids love to learn and grow. Mrs. Amanda is wonderful—she has such a heart for children and raising them up as true disciples of Jesus. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, encouraged, and part of the family. If you’re looking for a church that’s both inspiring and authentic, this is it! I absolutely love this church. It was so great the first person I met their and I didn't know but, it was the pastor I me and him talk. I really like the sermon and how it was conducted very mixed group with mix ages. I even like the hand out and how it fall along with their Church sermon great job on that. It really made you pay attention to what was going on and helped you follow along. I saw the pastor and we have some fellowship because he mentioned Miles the passer in the Rock in San Diego (my house town) and we talked about him for a little bit and I told him a little bit about my story and have some fellowship with him. I really connected to this church on a personal and spiritual level. It's pretty much a new church and today was their first year anniversary. I can go on and on about how much I love this church I definitely have found a new home.
😇👍👍😇 I’m so thankful for this church! I’ve heard so many people say “when I walked in, it felt like home.” And that’s exactly what it felt like for me too. I promise you will feel welcomed and loved while you’re in this church and with the body of Christ. If you’re church shopping, put the Pines on your list! Such a great church love all the people there are so sweet in the welcome view with open arms

name: Church of the Reconciler UMC - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
They fixed the bathrooms, they fixed the dates there available, there handing out bus passes.  Thank you for your help 🙏🏾 Words can't fully express the incredible experience I had at this church. It's a true haven where people from all walks of life come together. The sense of community and nourishment is palpable. Whether you're unhoused and in need of resources, hungry and looking for food, or just in need of a caffeine boost before work (9-10am Mon-Thur), this place has got you covered.

I wish I could have stayed longer, but every moment spent here was truly cherished. Community on the Rise also resides in this building. COTR creates stunning jewelry from #5 plastics and offers community share time and yoga too. It's a place where you can walk in and get completely nourished, whether you're sorting mail, sweeping the floor, serving coffee, or hearing a sermon. It's a spiritual cup-filling experience. Pastor Sarah and Pastor Adam will never be forgotten in this community. Met with senior pastor and looking forward to future visits. What an amazing vision for our city! Truly helping the homeless. Thank you. I recently visited Church of the Reconciler and took a tour of the facilities. Speaking with the pastors I found that they have a tremendous ministry in downtown Birmingham meeting the needs of the community where they live. I pray that God will bless this ministry with an abundance of blessings. Great church, great ministry.

name: Church of the Redeemed-Vallejo - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary: Its very easy to get there by bus. So it's very convenient. Also they don't put in the show. Its educational which is was supposed to be If you are looking for a place to worship, have a good time in Jesus and learn about Christ and who you are in Him then come to Church of The Redeem Is this the church that is supporting the Valle police department? If you want.to.hear a good.word friendly and.loving Awesome worship

name: Church of the Redeemer - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: A beauty to be sure. The Church of the Redeemer is a beautiful sprawling campus that includes the lovely stone church, the newer church annex building, and the cemetery. The grounds are peaceful and well shaded by mature trees and shrubbery. Plenty of parking for service days. A pleasant place to take a walk and admire the grounds and the interior of a beautiful gothic church. Attended a memorial service in this beautiful space. A reception was held afterwards in a lovely parish hall. Wonderful church and community. Fantastic state-of-the-art new Parish House. Highly recommend! A welcoming community in a beautiful space. Fantastic educational and children’s programming. Thoughtful sermons, great music, active youth group and a welcoming and interesting community.

name: Church of the Redeemer United Church of Christ - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary: We came to the Journey to Bethlehem event. It was a wonderful event put on by the congregation where you take a path to find baby Jesus in the manger. The congregation does a great job playing various costumed roles of characters along the path. There were live animals to feed and pet. Afterwards there is refreshment. Church was decked out for Christmas and looked lovely. A very welcoming and warm place for service and faith. Pastor Brooke is very inspiring as her well thought out words and delivery was moving by reaching deep inside yourself. Gathered participants were extremely welcoming too. Beautiful church.... beautiful wedding there! Small and convenient spaces for congregation. Beautiful church

name: Church of the Resurrection - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary:
Church of the Resurrection is truly on fire right now! We have been blessed with incredible priests over the years, and our newest additions, Father PC and Father Dave, are amazing. They are both excellent homilists and bring fresh energy and openness to trying new things and I’m excited to see what this new chapter brings.

The parish is alive with vibrant ministries. The high school ministry is strong and welcoming, while adult faith formation offers multiple bible studies each year. The women’s bible study, Walking with Purpose, has been a powerful source of connection and community.

I’ve been a member for over 30 years, and I don’t know why it took me 30 years to finally write a review. In that time, I’ve grown in faith while watching the church grow right alongside me. It truly feels like home. Attempted to go to the Holly days craft show and was literally turned away because strollers are not allowed. There was an old lady that refused my entrance as I have a child in a stroller. Leave it to the church to somehow exclude everyone. I grew up in the Catholic Church and have continued to have nothing but negative experiences every time I set foot near a church. I immediately left and went to spend my money at target. I hope someone reads this review and understands how unwelcoming you are and how your rules exclude families and young people from events. Do you also not allow wheelchairs in your establishment? I would recommend avoiding this church all together. Nice people there. I was there for the farmers market. However, considering it was located in New Albany, no one was snooty or stuck up. A very friendly experience indeed. A beautiful Catholic Church community. The church itself is beautiful and creates a very special environment for worship. The clergy and staff are also wonderful and kind. They are very accessible for any needs or questions you may have. Mass offers great hymn's and homilies. There are tons of ways to get involved in the church. Adoration is offered with accessible times. Also, the Church of The Resurrection integrates technology in a very effective way through an online website and streaming Sunday mass in case you are out of town. This Church has it all. If you are looking for a parish, I would start here. Went for a wedding.  Priests didn't speak up enough. Had hearing aides in and only 4th row back but couldn't hear what was being said for the most part.

name: Church of the Resurrection - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: Great church with great people in a great location.  If you're in New Orleans, you should check it out.  All are welcome.  Services are Sunday mornings at 10am. I've been a member of Church of the Resurrection for over 2 years and I can't say enough about how much our family loves it here. They are so welcoming and friendly to anyone who walks through the doors. The music is amazing and uplifting and makes the service so special. Pastor Ben has such a gift for preaching and consistently delivers such emotional, relatable, and impactful sermons. This is a young church full of life! Family, children, community, and service are some core values that are evident. I would highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a Presbyterian church, or just any church to feel welcomed to. Church of the Resurrection has become a really important part of my life. It has introduced me to a community that seeks to support one another in knowing Christ through Bible Study, building relationships with one another, and serving the community. You can tell the people really love Jesus and one another! Not to mention, the worship space is absolutely gorgeous. Also, a great place for families with kids! Tremendous church community intently focused on the Lord. Every Sunday you can experience lively worship and hear the good news of Jesus. The space itself is amazingly beautiful both day and night. But what really sets this place apart are loving people you’ll find gathered here each week. Church of the Resurrection is a community of people who love the Lord, each other and the city of New Orleans.  I absolutely adore my church and have been blessed to have brothers and sisters in Christ who encourage me to grow spiritually, to serve my community and who keep me accountable.  Pastor Cunningham’s Gospel-centered teachings convict me each Sunday and I leave church seeking to know my Lord and Savior more.  I have been immensely encouraged hosting a Women’s Bible Study each week where we delve into the Word of God together and pray for one another.  It has also been a treat to watch our church community interact with my two young children as they teach them in Sunday School and take seriously God’s call to help raise children to love Christ at an early age.   What a privilege and blessing it has been to be a part of Church of the Resurrection!

name: Church of the Resurrection L.A. - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Did anyone take my son kanan sharp here as a resurrection tell me it's my kid and I'm about to flip out Great church. Really caring and friendly people. Liturgy was beautiful, preaching excellent. The congregation was truly involved in worship, not just going through the motions. Music was a blend of traditional and contemporary. Lots of young families. a good place to pray and meet with other Christian people I find Church of the Resurrection to be an authentic, loving, welcoming congregation with all ages and backgrounds integrally involved living life together in a serious Christian context.  Great teaching and worship! Community that's real! Beautiful people

name: Church of the Saviour
reviewSummary: Sprawling Main Line congregation in Wayne known for exceptional children's check-in facilities, engaging biblical messages, and deep local volunteerism.

name: Church of the Saviour - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: Sprawling Main Line congregation in Wayne known for exceptional children's check-in facilities, engaging biblical messages, and deep local volunteerism.

name: Church of the Saviour - Tredyffrin Township Campus
reviewSummary:
Check this place out if you are looking for a good church to be a part of.  This church has 2 different services,  traditional and contemporary.  There are so many kids of all ages involved and many friendly people.  They also have various groups tp be a part of, such as a grief group for those of us who lost someone close to us etc.  Today we heard about the mission trip to India.   This church has a fantastic mix of people and do many different nationalities all there to worship the same Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.  I just started going here myself and am enjoying what I hear and see so far. Don Spooner was amazing to speak with an absolute delight. He got right back to me addressing an issue. He also introduced me to all of the churches ministries. He was very informative and kind. Great guy to have at this church. Well diverse and knowledgeable a 5star). Hmmmm....1st time to attend a service here.  Beautiful church, good band, excellent sermon.  In fact, I'd go back to hear the sermons, but probably take soft earplugs to reduce the volume of the music.  I couldn't hear myself singing, let alone anyone else except for a brief moment when the band pulled back.  Great song selection!  Two people briefly said "hello", but that was it.  I went in feeling a bit lonely and left feeling even more lonely but am imagining size has something to do with that.  So will I go back?  Not sure. I can watch church online and feel the same amount of connection.  It is very well attended.  I would imagine that getting involved in activities and groups would make the experience more meaningful. I experienced spiritual abuse at the hands of the head pastor when he became antagonistic, domineering, and coercive with me. I addressed my concerns to the elder board. The elders did find the head pastor was antagonistic, but they intentionally overlooked the head pastor's most egregious actions. I expressed my concern that the elders did not address the pastor being aggressive and coercive with me. The elder assigned to my concern intentionally ignored this issue and proceeded to use my words against me when I objected. Their final letter to me downplayed the head pastor's actions as having made "inappropriate statements" while they then went on to exaggerate their concerns with me. It frankly felt like DARVO.

I also requested a partial refund of my tithe -- that request went unanswered.

I am still recovering from the spiritual abuse and trauma. I am undergoing counseling at my own expense. I am also aware of other people who have been abused by the pastor.

There are many members of the congregation who have been a blessing, but the abuse was damaging enough that I left this church.

Since then, an elder attempted to find out how I am from a third party. Rather than try to resolve the issue that broke fellowship, he went behind my back to try and obtain information about me. He also approached me at an event where we were both in attendance. His behavior was unwelcome and unappreciated in both instances. This crazy large church needs a map to explain the many buildings, twists, and turns. It's filled with nice people ready to serve and help and I met one of the pastors because I was lost trying to locate a class. What hospitable people. Good impressions !

name: Church of the Three Crosses
reviewSummary:
Church of the Three Crosses is a truly welcoming and thoughtful spiritual community in the heart of Old Town. The congregation is very progressive and inclusive. The services are approachable with meaningful sermons, beautiful music, and a relaxed atmosphere where no one feels out of place. We are a small congregation, but we are mighty!

I have been attending COTTC with my family since 2002 (all 24 years of my life). If you’re looking for a church in Chicago - especially the Old Town or Lincoln Park area - where you can ask questions, build a community, and wear jeans to service, I highly recommend giving us a visit. My wife is a congregation member. When we first arrived in Chicago, she struggled to find a church with a community and values that resonated with her.

A couple of years ago, she found this church and it was just what she was looking for. This is a very open, very welcoming group of people and that is a core value for them.

I myself am not a Christian, but I really like the pastor and the congregation. I participate occasionally in activities on their behalf because I think they are genuinely good people who do good works.

To anyone who has struggled with other churches and are seeking one with a more open, congregation focused experience, this is a really good one to check out.

And to anyone who is curious about Christianity or is non practicing and just looking for a new community to be a part of, I'd encourage you to attend a few sessions and see if this is a fit. Church of the Three Crosses is a wonderful community. My wife and I checked it out when we first moved to the Old Town neighborhood, and we connected instantly with the progressive, thoughtful sermons. It is also important to us that our faith community be welcoming and affirming to the LGBTQ community, and have found this to be one of COTTC's best qualities. We moved away from the neighborhood four years ago, but we still choose to keep COTTC as our faith community because we have found them to be like family. I came to Church of the Three Crosses for their connection to the UCC and their Open and Affirming stance on LGBT issues. I have stayed because of the welcoming atmosphere, creative worship, and intellectual opportunities. This truly is an incredible community that allows you to experience spirituality in your own way! This church community has so much to offer.  What attracts me is the open and welcoming atmosphere which brings in a diverse group of people.  I'm also impressed by the commitment of this small organization to externally-focused ministry and volunteer programs...this tiny group touches a lot of lives for the better.  The pastor is simply great and empowers the members to lead the church as well.

name: Church of the Valley - San Ramon Campus
reviewSummary:
My friend and her family have gone to this church for years. She asked a favor to park a trailer in the back since there’s other trailers they said no I am going to encourage her to leave church of the valley go any other church that is rude she volunteers. Her family has helped. She does vacation Bible school she does Live stream. She gives her heart and soul to that church and they treated her so badly go to the ROCK go to Easttown go to any other church than church of the valley. I am going to encourage her to leave that church and anyone else you give everything to them and they can’t do you a favor for a month two months Leave that church Bible based sermons with a friendly congratulation.  Contemporary worship.

Adult Sunday school at 9:00 and services at 10:30am.  Classes are thought provoking and interesting.   Children stay with parents during worship and school age kids go to children service while adults stay in service.  Family room available for families with small children. Very sound church and Very loving church Best church of the valley Trinity church with low funding. Semi private with secularity, possibly a private residency donated to public gathering

name: Church of the Valley - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary: This is our favorite church. The entire staff and congregation are so friendly and welcoming. You feel like family.  They have a fantastic children's program,  the director is absolutely amazing. My boys actually get mad at me when we have to miss church. They are 3 this is an amazing thing! Have been going to Church of the Valley, checking things out, for a couple of months now.  This is a strong bible-teaching church with the senior pastor, Tim Reilly.  Tim's personal story of how he came to Christ is a powerful testimony.  The regular members are friendly and sincere.  Both the early service and the later have the same message , but the demographic for the earlier one is slightly more senior.  The worship music is modern and the takeaway discussion at the end of the message is a chance for reflection.  Really like it! Growing church with all age groups; Sunday school for youngsters; nursery; STRONG active  Women's Fellowship group; small group Bible studies; both a traditional (9:30am) and a contemporary (11:00am) service on Sunday morning; college and youth activities; upcoming Vacation Bible School; Stay and Play activities;  and Sunday morning sermons from the GOOD BOOK -- the Holy Bible  -- the Word of God!!  IF YOU'RE LOOKING FOR A HOME CHURCH, COME AND CHECK US OUT!!!!!  WE'D LOVE TO WELCOME YOU!!! Great preaching and contemporary approach by Pastor Tim Reilly.  He is sensitive to the needs of young people as well as older people. He understands the Great Commission, and our place in history. We highly recommend this church! I got married here in 1990 and it was a wonderful experience.  They were very accommodating and provided everything but the rings!

name: Church of the Valley - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: I was looking for a church that had something special…maybe the people, the message, or the music… I hit the trifecta!   Dorothy put it best when she said there’s no place like home.  I recently had a surgery. My Church family texted , called, brought soup, and came to sing Christmas carols in my home.  There is room at the table here for everyone and I thank God for my Church family… called earlier today lady on the phone was very rude giving me attitude for asking a simple question very rude and unprofessional employees A True open and affirming church. A wonderful community of diverse backgrounds. I luv this place close to home Now. I am. Girl. Good

name: Church On A Hill - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending COAH for just under a year. From the first visit our family was welcomed and felt at home.
There is an pretty even mix of every generation, with a growing number of families with littles. The services are in English, but the music is provided in English and Spanish and all preaching is translated live.
Small groups meet throughout the week for deeper discussion and study. I love that questions are welcomed and encouraged. It doesn't matter if we may agree on preferences or cultural "hot topics" or not, the heartbeat of COAH is the gospel and that is felt from the moment you walk in the door. No church is perfect, but a group of people who are willing to humbly set aside their own differences to learn and grow closer to Jesus is a place I want my family to be a part of. No a reformed church. Its also filled with old people and will not exist in ten years. From the moment you step in you are greeted by loving caring people . Pastor Matt is passionate about preaching God's word. The music is a mix of contemporary and traditional.  There is something for the whole family to be involved in. They make me feel like family.  Come and join us ! Very nice Church.  Was welcomed by all.  I have been on their prayer list for some time.  Will be going back.  If you haven't found your
"Church home" yet, stop in and enjoy the service as I did. Fantastic picleball with Warren Harris Mon- Fri 0800-120]!

name: Church on a Mission - Metairie Campus
reviewSummary:
My personal experience at this church has been amazing! Definitely a place where I have been consistently coming to be watered and uplifted. I’ve made so many different friends and if you’re looking for community I’ll recommend you come here! I have never felt more welcomed and invited in a place like church on a mission. Pastor Ryan and Leah are the warmest hearts! I look forward to Sundays more than ever! I am so grateful that Jesus has led me to this church! Pastor Ryan is wonderful, preaching truth from the King James Bible, breaking it down so we can truly understand the word of God. It's the combination of the KJB and his clear and engaging delivery, the focus on a personal connection with the Lord that really stands out to me.
I feel the presence of the Lord in this place,and I haven't been excited about church in a long time. The powerful singing, including Pastor Ryan's wife, Leah along with all the other singers angelic voices, the entire team is wonderful. This church allows people to serve and be more involved, as part of our mission to spread the gospel. I'm just happy to be a part of it, and my kids love it too. Great church! Pastor Ryan seems to preach on everything I’m dealing with everytime I attend. I highly recommend you give Church on a Mission the opportunity to become your home of worship. I love all aspects of this church. The pastor is phenomenal.  The worship music which is live really makes you feel so close to Jesus. I cannot say enough. You’d have to see it for yourself.

name: Church on Main - Snellville Campus
reviewSummary:
I go there. I PRAY that they will do another pool party this year. It is wonderful what they do. Tell me what you think. I watch online, and occasionally attend in person. I love that Pastor Brian teaches the Bible book, chapter, and verse. I wish the praise & worship was less old baptist hymns and more representative of the congregation.
I went to a church where the music was diverse and we sang in English, Spanish, Italian and Yorùbá. The congregation grew to be ethnically, culturally, academically, financially, and economically so diverse. The worship and the Word made you NEVER want to be late, let alone miss a service. The Spirit of God moved, the people grew in faith, it made you want to be part of ministry to support the growth! I'd love to see that for Church on Main. But for now, I'll faithfully continue watching and occasionally visiting. GREAT leadership and it's a Bible believing Bible preaching church! It's great to belong and be part of God's family serving Jesus with our home church- Church on Main 🙏🏼♥️ Great church the Bible is taught every Sunday 🙏🏾 Its definitely a homely church for sure. We will make it our church close to home. My 6yr old wont like it because the 3 grades are crammed in a room. So is the baby room its like babies and toddlers are crammed in a room. Its waaaay too many kids in the baby room.

name: Church on Mill - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
I think the message is fine and the pastors really teach biblically (which is great, bc you don't get that a lot these days), but the congregation seems very clique-y. Christian Challenge kinda stinks too. Probably won't come back physically. A great place to worship God. The message is always relevant and practical. Although, I live in the neighborhood, I just never noticed this wonderful church nestled in. This was the best EASTER EGG Hunt by far.

As kiddos get older, it becomes tricky finding the right variety that will keep them engaged and OFF their phones. All this fired on all points.

Games, races, bouncy houses, grilled free food, food trucks and Easter Egg Hunt!

The church family was super sweet and not too pushy in their invitation to "recruit" new members, and it wasn't too overt or in your face.

But, great vibe and wholesome as are all the things we participate in. This is my home church. We have a heart for everyone but also have a lot of students. We have free lunches every month for college kids and people that wish to interact with and serve college kids. We also have a lunch for international students every month for the same reason. Mission trips happen around the world. We have a good youth program. Child care is present and always looking for volunteers. Before and in between services we have a coffee bar that I help run with some awesome volunteers. The in-between time also has a nice freshly made treat for everyone. We value members and newcomers alike and have a strong biblical foundation. We have small groups for people to get together on a more personal level and classes of varying topics throughout each semester. Wednesday nights has youth group, child care, and disciple makers classes. It's a lovely family to be a part of and we have churches we pray for and love as well if you want to hear about others. A great place for spiritual growth in Christ

name: Church on Morgan - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
Another cute little cozy shop you must come here, especially for first encounters. I know I know I enjoy a nice game of checkers here. I’m definitely coming back. I love this place. The music is incredible, which is the biggest draw for me. My family has found this community to be open and welcoming, and we have already found friends that we will keep for years. This church is welcoming and open for ANYONE who wants to attend. Christ's love shines in each person here, come see for yourself! We are all for one & one for all! Together we fight the good fight of faith at Church on Morgan. We are proud to call CoM our church home. CoM has a no-nonsense approach and life application teaching of God's Word. We were searching for an all inclusive, affirming church and CoM fits our family perfectly. Highly recommend their online or in-person Sunday service!

so their eyes cannot see,

name: Church on the Hill - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a very friendly and down to earth church!  The teaching style is straightforward and really digs into the Bible.  They have a nice coffee bar with some breakfast snacks for sale, and nice classes for children.  My 2 year old grandson loves his class!  They also have evening gatherings and classes for adults throughout the week, and special events like concerts and "serving off the hill" events where people can contribute to the local community.  I think you should check it out! My wife and I have been part of Church on the Hill for 20 years. Over that time we've continually seen God at work, changing lives right before our eyes.  We deeply love the worship, the preaching, and the ministry and mission work happening both inside and outside our church walls.  Our greatest blessing, however, has been our Community Group.  We gather regularly to study God's Word, pray for one another, and offer each other support and encouragement.  That group has been essential to our journey here, keeping us connected and giving us a real sense of belonging.

Mike B. Our family has been attending this church for about 10 years, and we are so grateful for the impact it has had on our lives. Pastor Scott, consistently delivers sermon series that truly help us grow in our faith. He brings humor, kindness, and a genuine desire for each of us to develop a personal and intimate relationship with Jesus, which makes every message both meaningful and relatable.

The kids and student programs are absolutely fantastic...from babies through high school. The high school ministry played a huge role in leading my daughter to accept Christ as her Savior and helped keep her grounded on a healthy path through high school and now into college. We will always be thankful for that investment in her life.

I also love how intentional the church is about connecting individuals and families into community groups. If you want to dive deeper in your faith and build authentic relationships with other believers, the opportunity is there, but there’s never pressure. The services are incredibly welcoming, and no one is made to feel like they have to serve before they’re ready or if they’re still seeking.

The worship is current, engaging, and truly enhances the overall experience. This church goes beyond simply being seeker-friendly. It creates a space where people can grow, belong, and encounter Jesus in a real way. We’re so thankful to call this church home. Church on the Hill was the starting point of my journey in finding Christ. I was apart of the highschool ministry, kids ministry and got to go to Hume, Lake Shasta on houseboats over the summer, and even got baptized November 2023. The community here is unlike any other church I’ve been too. Everyone makes it their mission to talk to you and make you apart of the family. I’ve never felt so welcome at a space than here.
I remember the first time I came to church on the hill I was welcomed by the entire highschool ministry and I knew then that this was my church for good.
The worship is also beautiful, Tyler Lee has a powerful voice!
The main pastor, Scott, delivers his messages so well and knows how to connect with the community so well, you never feel like a stranger!
Small groups here are also wonderful and the kids ministry (new born to highschool) focus a lot on integrating God and the Bible into everyday life.
Love this church! Church on the hill is a welcoming and loving church! this church has helped me grow so much not just in my faith but as a person. I’ve found amazing friendships and a loving community. It’s a place where I feel safe, supported, loved and cared for. Worship is one of my favorite parts it’s uplifting and helps me feeling closer to God. However the high school group has been an important part of my experience it’s a place where i can be comfortable being myself and growing in my faith with people my age but leaders make a huge difference they care about us, they are there when we need guidance, and encouraging. But in general church on the hill is a welcoming environment that feels like family, where everyone is valued and loved!

name: Church on the Move Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
Background: I started attending this church a few months after it launched in 2018 and had gone there weekly up until I moved out of state just a few weeks ago. Not only had I attended there but I had been on staff there starting roughly a year after I began attending up until a few weeks ago.

Review: as someone who had been around for years and gotten to “see behind the curtain” I can’t explain more that life only gets better at this church the deeper you go. The people you see on stage doing the announcements, preaching, worshipping, the ones smiling and holding the door for you to walk in, are truly the same-if not better- behind the scenes when you get to know them.

The staff spends intentional time weekly praying for prayer requests that come in, praying for specific needs and families when emergencies happen. They are always going above and beyond to genuinely care for every single person in the church regardless of their length of attendance, amount they give, or their volunteer hours. These are real people, who work at this church because they care deeply about helping people get connected to Jesus through this church community.

Ethan and Ian, the two main communicators at this church are exactly the same off stage as they are on stage. Having spent years with them inside and outside of work situations I can confidently say, they are men who exude genuine care for the people in this church when off stage, and are filled with the fruit of the Spirit no matter the context you see them in— they are NOT just putting on a show for the weekend.

Having attended all 5 services every week for as long as we’ve had them, you can’t choose wrong, each service is filled with absolutely incredible people who if you take steps towards getting to know, quickly invite you in to homes, groups, and post church meals. Try out different services until you find one that fits!

Theres so much I could share, but in summary: This place completely changed my life by creating countless opportunities for me to take steps towards Jesus alongside others, and if you take a chance, attend next move, or even ask a pastor out to coffee, the next 8 years of your life may also fly by filled with incredible memories, life long friends, and most importantly, countless stories of Jesus moving in your life in significant ways.

This is a church you can trust, not to get it perfect every time, but one full of real people, truly trying follow scripture, teach it well, and end each year more like Jesus than the year before.

Disclaimer: No one ever asked me or remotely suggested I write any review, I wrote this purely in hopes that other people would see this post and experience what I had experienced during my time there by taking a chance to try a weekend. Parking was rough, people were nice and welcoming, however it’s stupid loud, way to many people in a small area. That combined with loud music it was pretty overwhelming, my 1 year old started crying about 10 mins in the door which never happens at church, my 12 year old had a anxiety attack start to come on. We sat in the lobby for service which was nice but I can’t say we will be coming back. We go to a larger church normally but it’s an appropriate size for the amount of people. Beautifully decorated for Christmas though. I went there for the first time today and it was awesome. Pastor Ethan had a wonderful message from the book of James,the music was great and I really appreciate the Bible they gave me. The free coffee and snacks are great to.Ill definitely be back often as I can. I think I found a good church family   God bless!!!!! I love attending this church because, honestly,.. it feels safer to me. You get the good worship music and talent of a larger church, with the safety and security of it not standing out as a target to crazy people. Plenty of security and BA PD there also put me at ease. I struggle with anxiety in crowds, however when I'm here I can actually close my eyes and worship and not worry about anything, just focus on worshipping the King of Glory! Had a great time visiting our family who attends. They were so sweet and accommodating. Very similar vibe to our church at home!

name: Church on the Ranch - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: This has been our "church home" for over two years. We felt welcomed and appreciated right from our very first visit. Pastor Scotty Vaughn (a former long-time member of the Flying W Wranglers) preaches inspiring, Scripture-based sermons. The praise team provides the good old traditional music, performed in Western style. The congregation are some of the kindest, friendliest  people you will ever meet. The church offers Bible studies and Sunday school classes. The congregation are mostly older folks, but there are plenty of young adults and kids, too. The motto is "a place of grace and truth." That is a very accurate description of this wonderful church. Very sadly, this is the most unfriendly church I have ever attended.   I am 78 years old.    I fought tears the entire service, and cried when I got to my car after church.  I have never felt so lonely, or so invisible…..in a church, or anywhere else.    Not one person said Hi to me, not one person.   I was very sad.   I attended because I longed for the old hymns, and the possibility of making new friends, and becoming involved in the church.   The music and sermon completely filled my heart and soul.  However, the loneliness I felt while attending was overwhelming.   Not one person greeted me when entering the church, or when I left.  Not a single person acknowledged me in the sanctuary, not a single person.   I felt invisible.   I was raised in the Church of the Nazarene in San Diego, from the age of two weeks old.  We went above, and beyond, to welcome and include every person who entered our doors.  Our church was widely known for our friendliness.   Because of that, countless thousands came to know our Jesus Christ as their Lord and Savior.   It’s common sense, and Christian like, to make people feel welcome, and that their life matters.  To my dismay, I will not attend again…..but I pray your church will not lose more prospective members due to the coldness of the people 🙏✝️ This is a great church. People are very welcoming here. My children go to Sunday school and love it. This is a non denominational church. We are looking for a new church. We watched a video of last Sundays service. We can’t make it today but we will come next Sunday at 8:30 to check it out. God is good and we feel he is sending us to ROTR. Keep smiling! Pastor Scott is the best pastor I have ever met. He really cares for his flock and makes you feel at home. His wife Cindy is an absolute joy she greets everyone that coms8nto the church and has so much love in her heart. If you're looking for a church to feel at home with those is the place. The songs they sing are the best gospel songs and they encourage you to sing along with them.

The message is solid, music is mixed so should please everyone, and the people are friendly. The bathrooms are clean and well stocked. We'll definitely visit again. Fantastic church! Very welcoming, wonderful vibe and community. The music is a contemporary mix of drums, keyboard, guitar, bass and vocals, the messages are relevant and freshly given. Pastor Jeff is so incredibly down to earth, you can't help but relate to him. He isn't one of those types of pastor's who put's themselves above their congregation, but is down there in the trenches with you, telling you what he's battled or battling with.

If you are in the Columbus, GA region and are looking for a phenomenal church experience, look no further than here. Honestly.

name: Church Project - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Happy Easter everyone. We found ourselves visiting Church Project church in The Woodlands for the very first time. It's never an easy thing reviewing a church. Everybody is searching for something and where your spirit is will determine how you feel about a church service when you're there. Let me begin by saying The Church Project church is a big church. Looks like over a thousand to two thousand people on a given Sunday. Plenty of room and parking. Classes for just about all ages under Pre-K. There's a coffee shop there also that will rival any Starbucks. The music was good and uplifting if not loud. The preaching on this day was about the resurrection of Christ with not a lot of substance and that may have been due to them cutting the message short because of the serving of communion (bread & wine). Biblical traditions of the church. I was hoping to hear more meat and potatoes in the message. I'm sure next week will be better. All in all a church with many ministries to offer and no shortage of people who will open their homes to the many church houses they offer. Large churches are not for everybody so allow your spirit to guide you to where you're most comfortable. If you're looking for a church home as I am, this is a good place to begin. God's blessings to one and all 🙏 Love this church and the pastor. Jason does an amazing job about speaking directly from the Bible and specifically what the Bible says without adding to it. Making it very clear that its not the gospel plus anything but strictly the gospel. He explains scripture in an easy to understand manner and makes it feel as if you are being spoken to and not spoken at! I moved to Texas a little over a year ago and struggled to find a church that truly felt like home. That changed a few months ago when I attended CP for the first time with my boyfriend. I knew almost immediately I had found the right place for me.

A big part of that is Lead Pastor Jason. His teaching is grounded in Scripture, yet consistently practical and applicable to everyday life. What I appreciate most is how authentically he communicates. There’s a sincerity and calm confidence in the way he preaches that stands in stark contrast to the polished, high-production “megachurch” feel I experienced elsewhere. Instead of forced intensity or performance, his messages feel genuine, thoughtful, and rooted in truth, which makes them resonate on a much deeper level.

That authenticity, combined with the biblical foundation of his sermons, is what made CP finally feel like home. Great Bible believing, Christ following church! They are a church of house churches. Warm and welcoming with a solid lead pastor and hardworking, friendly staff/volunteers. Amazing nursery and children’s area to take your kids during service. Good City Coffee Shop inside with a lively atmosphere. Highly recommend visiting if you’re looking for a church home! It's a decent church, they are true to the Bible most of the time. They have pretty good home groups that you can get involved with but I think the church lacks in good leadership. My spouse and I had an individual that we were trying help, they fell on bad times and we were trying to get that person back to church. We brought it up to our home group and nobody really wanted to help. We were basically left to carry the load ourselves. When we brought it up to the leaders in the church they said there was nothing they could do the home groups take care of that. This person ended up leaving the church.  Pretty disappointing but my spouse and I are still attending church project for now, we have friends there and we do like the church overall.

name: Church Tsidkenu San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Update:
The owners response to my review just confirms my entire experience. I definitely would not recommend this church to anyone. They don't even know the people doing deliverance AND notice the owner only cares that i made a public review about my experience rather than fill out a private feedback form.

I had a deliverance session with a pastor and his wife, and ever since then, something in my spirit hasn’t felt right about the experience.

When I think back on the session, everything was being read from packets of stapled papers, including the deliverance prayers themselves. Nothing felt genuine to me; it all felt forced and rehearsed.

The pastor — whose name I honestly can’t remember — seemed bored and tired, almost like he didn’t even want to be there.

At one point, the pastor’s wife began calling out certain spirits she believed were within me, such as Jezebel and others I can’t specifically remember. She kept demanding answers from the “spirits” inside of me, and honestly, I just gave whatever answers came to my mind in the moment.

As the session continued, both the pastor and his wife instructed me to start coughing into a trash can, saying it was a way to cast the spirits out of me. I did what they told me to do, but I have a very sensitive gag reflex, so the more I coughed, the more I gagged and spit into the trash can.

Toward the end of the session, they prayed for me to receive the gift of speaking in tongues. During the prayer, the pastor’s wife told me to repeat what she was saying and copy her, so I did. Afterward, she was convinced that I had received the gift of tongues, but something about the entire experience has continued to trouble me spiritually ever since.

I was then supposed to have a healing session with someone else, but the appointment always fell through and eventually the person just stopped contacting me. I take that as the Holy Spirit intervening on my behalf to save me from this church.

I would not recommend this church at all just based on my own experience. Church Tsidkenu is not a church for your average Christian on Sunday service, it’s a place for you to encounter the presence of Jesus!  WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 … Church Tsidkenu is not a church for your average Christian on Sunday service, it’s a place for you to encounter the presence of Jesus!  WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 The weekend I went was because TSNL with Daniel Adams was there. Many deliverances and healings by both TSNL, Pastor Ben, Pastor Art Montgomery and the Fire Academy.
The Body of Christ here at The Church of Tsidkenu are a beautiful family of worshippers and lovers of Christ Jesus and move in the anointing of the Holy Spirit. 🚩Felt like a dream church, turned into a nightmare!!❌😭PLEASE DO NOT GO HERE

🚩Extreme Manipulation
🚩No accountability (no church board) (no voting on where the money goes!)
🚩”Pastor” Ben does whatever he wants even if it’s sinful and if you don’t like it, he may gaslight/manipulate/gossip about you
🚩Pride in leaders
🚩money mismanagement (lost/possibly stolen money confirmed by multiple witnesses)
🚩if you speak up about a leaders unrepentant sin, you may be preached about and shunned like a CULT

This place has officially turned into a CULT sadly.

If you don’t want a traumatic experience, do NOT go here!!

After years of involvement, my wife and I sadly witnessed SEVERE SPIRITUAL ABUSE and manipulation within the leadership of this church, which caused us deep hurt. We’re sharing out of sincere love and concern for others😢

I hesitated to write this for six months, but it's important to speak up when there’s harm in the Body of Christ. Scripture tells us to expose the works of darkness—not to shame, but to protect and bring things into the light for healing📜✝️
I first attended this church from 2017 to 2024, with a break from 2019 to 2022. In the beginning, I genuinely believe Pastor Ben Wisan started the church with good intentions. However, over time, pride and lack of accountability took root.

🚩No accountability
There is no real accountability for leadership. Pastor Ben’s "spiritual covering" consists of books he reads, and while he claims to consult elders, there's no formal elder board, church board, or congregational voting. In practice, he operates without checks and balances.
🚩Gaslighting, manipulation & jezebel tactics
In 2024, I spent significant time around Pastor Ben during several mission trips, including one abroad. It was during this time I began to see the subtle manipulation and gaslighting that many others, including my wife and I, experienced. When we brought concerns to leadership—often involving actions of other leaders—we were dismissed, blamed, or accused of being “victims,” even though we approached situations with forgiveness and a desire for resolution.
🚩pastor gossiping and slandering
It hurt when Pastor Ben began to gossip and spread false stories about us to close friends in the church. This was done in a polished, spiritual-sounding manner, but beneath the surface, it was gossip and slander. He even went on to publicly accuse us of the very things he was doing—bearing false witness and undermining our character(the devils job as described in John 10…the accuser of the brethren). I now know more than 20 people who’ve experienced similar spiritual trauma under this leadership and are still healing.
My wife and I got married at this church. But just weeks later, God began exposing what had been happening behind the scenes, and the mistreatment worsened when we attempted to address things biblically. Pastor Ben responded NOT with compassion but with harshness, accusations, and a refusal to listen.

I expect this post may be met with defensiveness or attempts to discredit what I’ve shared. That’s been the pattern. We are now planted in a healthy, Spirit-filled church and are growing and healing. I write this only because I care deeply about those still being harmed and deceived—and I hope and pray for repentance and true freedom for this church.

These are some wonderful church options in town where Jesus is truly glorified, including:
The Rock Church

Faith Chapel

Red Seal

The Flood

Jesus Culture

Skyline Church
...and many more.

Skip the trauma and the heartache and go find another church that is actually healthy, because there are multiple healthy churches around San Diego but sadly it is not at Church Tsidkenu😢

God bless you and I pray that this church repents for all their pride and sinful ways and then God will exalt them and bless them. I love all you guys and hope this brings healing as the Lord guides you through the process.

I pray that God will lead you dear reader and guide you to where you are supposed to be under safe care in Jesus name 🙂

They don't even know the people doing deliverance AND notice the owner only cares that i made a public review about my experience rather than fill out a private feedback form.

I had a deliverance session with a pastor and his wife, and ever since then, something in my spirit hasn’t felt right about the experience.

When I think back on the session, everything was being read from packets of stapled papers, including the deliverance prayers themselves. Nothing felt genuine to me; it all felt forced and rehearsed.

The pastor — whose name I honestly can’t remember — seemed bored and tired, almost like he didn’t even want to be there.

At one point, the pastor’s wife began calling out certain spirits she believed were within me, such as Jezebel and others I can’t specifically remember. She kept demanding answers from the “spirits” inside of me, and honestly, I just gave whatever answers came to my mind in the moment.

As the session continued, both the pastor and his wife instructed me to start coughing into a trash can, saying it was a way to cast the spirits out of me. I did what they told me to do, but I have a very sensitive gag reflex, so the more I coughed, the more I gagged and spit into the trash can.

Toward the end of the session, they prayed for me to receive the gift of speaking in tongues. During the prayer, the pastor’s wife told me to repeat what she was saying and copy her, so I did. Afterward, she was convinced that I had received the gift of tongues, but something about the entire experience has continued to trouble me spiritually ever since.

I was then supposed to have a healing session with someone else, but the appointment always fell through and eventually the person just stopped contacting me. I take that as the Holy Spirit intervening on my behalf to save me from this church.

I would not recommend this church at all just based on my own experience. Church Tsidkenu is not a church for your average Christian on Sunday service, it’s a place for you to encounter the presence of Jesus!  WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 … Church Tsidkenu is not a church for your average Christian on Sunday service, it’s a place for you to encounter the presence of Jesus!  WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 The weekend I went was because TSNL with Daniel Adams was there. Many deliverances and healings by both TSNL, Pastor Ben, Pastor Art Montgomery and the Fire Academy.
The Body of Christ here at The Church of Tsidkenu are a beautiful family of worshippers and lovers of Christ Jesus and move in the anointing of the Holy Spirit. 🚩Felt like a dream church, turned into a nightmare!!❌😭PLEASE DO NOT GO HERE

🚩Extreme Manipulation
🚩No accountability (no church board) (no voting on where the money goes!)
🚩”Pastor” Ben does whatever he wants even if it’s sinful and if you don’t like it, he may gaslight/manipulate/gossip about you
🚩Pride in leaders
🚩money mismanagement (lost/possibly stolen money confirmed by multiple witnesses)
🚩if you speak up about a leaders unrepentant sin, you may be preached about and shunned like a CULT

This place has officially turned into a CULT sadly.

If you don’t want a traumatic experience, do NOT go here!!

After years of involvement, my wife and I sadly witnessed SEVERE SPIRITUAL ABUSE and manipulation within the leadership of this church, which caused us deep hurt. We’re sharing out of sincere love and concern for others😢

I hesitated to write this for six months, but it's important to speak up when there’s harm in the Body of Christ. Scripture tells us to expose the works of darkness—not to shame, but to protect and bring things into the light for healing📜✝️
I first attended this church from 2017 to 2024, with a break from 2019 to 2022. In the beginning, I genuinely believe Pastor Ben Wisan started the church with good intentions. However, over time, pride and lack of accountability took root.

🚩No accountability
There is no real accountability for leadership. Pastor Ben’s "spiritual covering" consists of books he reads, and while he claims to consult elders, there's no formal elder board, church board, or congregational voting. In practice, he operates without checks and balances.
🚩Gaslighting, manipulation & jezebel tactics
In 2024, I spent significant time around Pastor Ben during several mission trips, including one abroad. It was during this time I began to see the subtle manipulation and gaslighting that many others, including my wife and I, experienced. When we brought concerns to leadership—often involving actions of other leaders—we were dismissed, blamed, or accused of being “victims,” even though we approached situations with forgiveness and a desire for resolution.
🚩pastor gossiping and slandering
It hurt when Pastor Ben began to gossip and spread false stories about us to close friends in the church. This was done in a polished, spiritual-sounding manner, but beneath the surface, it was gossip and slander. He even went on to publicly accuse us of the very things he was doing—bearing false witness and undermining our character(the devils job as described in John 10…the accuser of the brethren). I now know more than 20 people who’ve experienced similar spiritual trauma under this leadership and are still healing.
My wife and I got married at this church. But just weeks later, God began exposing what had been happening behind the scenes, and the mistreatment worsened when we attempted to address things biblically. Pastor Ben responded NOT with compassion but with harshness, accusations, and a refusal to listen.

I expect this post may be met with defensiveness or attempts to discredit what I’ve shared. That’s been the pattern. We are now planted in a healthy, Spirit-filled church and are growing and healing. I write this only because I care deeply about those still being harmed and deceived—and I hope and pray for repentance and true freedom for this church.

These are some wonderful church options in town where Jesus is truly glorified, including:
The Rock Church

Faith Chapel

Red Seal

The Flood

Jesus Culture

Skyline Church
...and many more.

Skip the trauma and the heartache and go find another church that is actually healthy, because there are multiple healthy churches around San Diego but sadly it is not at Church Tsidkenu😢

God bless you and I pray that this church repents for all their pride and sinful ways and then God will exalt them and bless them. I love all you guys and hope this brings healing as the Lord guides you through the process.

I pray that God will lead you dear reader and guide you to where you are supposed to be under safe care in Jesus name 🙂

name: Church Two42 - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: I HAVE to leave a review!!!! I wish I could give this church all the stars in the sky! It’s so personal and intimate. I drove all the way down from Orange County to surprise my mother for Mother’s Day. I was not expecting to fall so deeply in love with a small but mighty church. It is also very clean and well organized. The children’s center was lovely too! I have been too many churches before, and have never felt comfortable or felt as though the pastor was really in the spirit. But pastor Craig.. Delivered the most beautiful story, and it was organized and structured in a way that even a beginner can understand! I was blown away and held back tears 4 times. I can’t get the word out of my head, the message and the heart- Truly incredible. I own a business on Sunday is our busiest day- However, I decided right then and there that I would be at least live streaming their sermons three times a month and closing my business down for one Sunday to be there in person once a month. If I could go every Sunday in person I would, But for now this is where I will start and I look forward to  growing with this church and Seeing the Holy Spirit light up in pastor Craig! May God continue to bless and prosper the church, his bride. Great pastor. Great staff. Kids program top notch. Amazing Church!! Amazing family! I started attending this church a little over five months ago and my life has changed dramatically! I was welcomed with open arms and treated like family instantly. Pastor Craig is fantastic, he teaches with love and an easy understanding of the Bible. The worship team is phenomenal, and the entire congregation is full of love and compassion for one another. This church truly mirrors the image of Jesus! Come join us, be part of our family and experience the Lord moving in the church! ❤️ 🙌 Love this church. Pastor Craig is awesome and the worship is beyond powerful. Since I started attending this church in spring 2018, I have grown in leaps and bounds! The church family here are so loving and caring, they have helped my family through some really tough times... I'm so happy to have found Church Two42 ❤ This church is absolutely amazing and Pastor Craig is awesome!  The teaching and worship team aregreat! If you are looking for a welcoming awesome church, you really need to visit this one. There are two Sunday services one at 8:30 and the other at 10:30am.

name: Church Unlimited - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Church Unlimited has truly been a place of restoration for my faith. From the moment our family walked in, we felt welcomed, loved, and seen. The people here genuinely care, and there’s a strong sense of community that makes you feel like family.

What I love most is the clear and consistent message of grace. The way Pastor Brandon teaches God’s love and grace has reignited my passion for Him and reminded me of who I am in Christ.

Our boys love getting to learn about the grace and love of Christ through kid friendly songs, teachings, and games each week in Kids Unlimited.

If you’re looking for a church that loves people, displays compassion over judgement, and teaches the clear message of the new covenant, then Church Unlimited is the place to be. So thankful my family found it! Church Unlimited is an incredibly welcoming and inclusive place to worship. From the moment you walk in, there's a sense of community and warmth that makes you feel right at home. Pastor Brandon Ball is an outstanding communicator of the Word—he not only teaches Scripture with clarity and passion but also provides rich context about the audience and setting, which deepens your understanding in a meaningful way.

He’s personable, funny, and highly engaging, which makes every message both insightful and enjoyable. I especially appreciate how thoroughly he breaks down the passages, making even complex topics easy to connect with.

The church also hosts occasional events that are perfect for socializing and building genuine connections with others. The community is full of kind, friendly people who are easy to talk to and truly care about one another. On top of that, the cultural diversity within the church is something I deeply value—it creates a beautiful reflection of the kingdom of God and adds richness to the experience.

If you’re looking for a place to grow in your faith, feel genuinely welcomed, and connect with a vibrant community, I highly recommend giving Church Unlimited a visit. I love this place. It’s a beautifully diverse group of people. Scripture is taught in context, with an emphasis on grace through Jesus. It highlights the old covenant vs the new covenant,  and praise God we live in the new covenant! It’s not just three take aways for the week from cherry-picked verses. My kids love the children’s church. This is a place I want my friends to come and experience, everyone to come and experience. Jesus.  A name you will hear early and often at ChurchUnlimited (CU). Not just as a salutation to end a prayer or a mascot-type figure for the faith.  No, you will learn to see Him in everything throughout your Bible.  I’m all for self-help and self-improvement tips, tricks and habits, but you leave CU knowing clearly there’s ONE thing you have to do.  There are things we need to be doing in life for better circumstances, but if I’m only leaving with a list of things I need to do to better, we can get that outside of a preacher.  What you leave with when you leave CU is an assurance that Jesus finished the ‘work’ for your salvation, you’re forgiven and accepted by God.  That  it’s our faith in Jesus’ work that is our required work.  We learn it’s cause and effect. Jesus is the Cause, the work He did, the grace and love He shows really is the simplicity of the Gospel.  The Effect is us receiving that free gift and it motivating us to do His work.  Never out of a ‘do it or else I’ll miss Him’ mentality, but out of a heart of ‘why wouldn’t, shouldn’t I love well when I know I’m loved so well’.  CU alludes that we’ll do more ‘work’ on accident under Grace than we’d do on purpose under an obligation and a self-righteous earning mindset.  My flesh still wants to take credit, it’s our human nature, it’s our competitive nature, but CU reminds me week in and week out of Who Jesus is.  Jesus is the hero, not me. I was in a place of uncertainty and trying to find a loving environment for the entire family. My husband prayed, and after a couple of visits we decided to join because of the beautiful genuine family atmosphere. The people have become friends and even the children have found friends and we now have lifelong partners. Pastor B brings the word in a way of love and acceptance and correction. It helps you want to be a better person because you love the Lord and beyond a shadow of a doubt you know he loves you and always will no matter what!!

name: Church Unlimited - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary:
We were visiting from another state, and since this church was nearby, we decided to check it out.
I had read some negative reviews about prosperity preaching, but that wasn’t our experience at all.
The worship was amazing, and the message was powerful, very biblical, and sound.

Things to know before you come:
Bring a sweater or jacket—the AC is very strong. I was quite cold in my short-sleeve T-shirt. Come visit and learn the lords word.
God loves you, Jesus loves you. God will turn your mess into a message, your trial into a triumph and your test into a TESTIMONY.  Come visit and join church unlimited.  The volunteers the staff and worshippers are all amazing. You’re most certainly invited. I love visiting and serving here. I moved to Kingsville and tried a few churches but unfortunately I could not find anywhere like church unlimited. I drive to Church Unlimited every Sunday now because its the only place that feels like home. Thank God for Pastor Bill. He really is special. Thank you church unlimited! ❤️ I’ve been to this church a couple times.   You walk in and the music is Christian and lively.   Then the pastor will spin a sermon that has Christian elements woven in, but the message is more about self-help, being a better you, and avoiding being a ‘middle of the road’ person.   You can tell it’s counterfeit and prosperity gospel.   Very slick.   Shame on them for distorting the Gospel.

This church is like counterfeit money.   It looks real, it smells real, most people will accept it, but hold it up to the light and you can see the flaws.   And ultimately it gets you thrown in jail.

If you really love Jesus and want to lay down your life for Him, at the expense of your own selfish personal desires and dreams, Yorktown Baptist is the real deal and is place where you can grow in Him. W church. W friends. W pastors. Ws all around. Church unlimited is my forever home! I first began attending Church Unlimited as an Intern in the AMAZING internship program back in 2021. Ever since then I have made life long friendships and everlasting memories while getting the opportunity to serve the youth! From Roddfield to Rockport, Stone Oak, Broadcast, whichever campus you attend, This is your dream church and forever church home once you attend. If you’re looking for a new church and don’t know where to go or don’t know if you would fit in or even if you think church isn't your thing! Trust me, once you attend you’ll feel how loving and caring everyone around you are. 5 star definitely recommended.

name: Church Unlimited - Rodd Field - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary: The best church I've ever been to they are sowelcoming to new comers and so frendly! Wonderful Church. My daughter and grandson love it too. It's like a learning experience every time I go. The preaching is wonderful. Very down to earth, friendly people. The singers in the beginning of Church are very good. The coffee bar in the front is a plus for sure. Great coffee. Again !! Employees using the top dryers and leaving us Seniors to use the bottom dryers. Which is difficult for us Love this church pastor Evan is great. Plenty of activities for kids. Doing at movie check out this wonderful church. I’ve attended Church Unlimited for a while, but I’m deeply disappointed with the experience. Pastor Bil Cornelius focuses heavily on tithing in nearly every sermon, often emphasizing giving over 10% to “unlock worldly benefits.” This prosperity gospel feels manipulative and far from genuine spirituality. His son, Mason, who’s only in his 20s and lacks experience, takes over preaching during Bil’s frequent, months-long vacations, which disrupts the church’s leadership and message. The family’s lavish lifestyle—driving Range Rovers, Teslas, and wearing expensive designer clothes—clashes with the humility I expect from spiritual leaders. I can’t recommend this church to anyone seeking authentic faith over prosperity preaching.

name: Church Unlimited - Stone Oak
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a nondenominational church with a feel of great community and amazing worship, Church Unlimited~Stone Oak is where you should be. With amazing Pastors, wonderful Kids Unlimited program, and amazing Youth Service, Church Unlimited will not disappoint. You will feel right at home. Love my church!  From the music to the service to the people, I always leave with a smile on my face.  Very welcoming to everyone. I’ve been coming to this church faithfully for almost 5 years now. I love it here! It has changed my life tremendously in so many ways. I now also serve here in the Kids ministry which is amazing and all of my three boys go there as well. They love it there and are all loved on by the other sweet volunteers. Pastor Bil is amazing. Every single message is relatable. There are so many opportunities to become more connected to God and the church community in general. It’s just an amazing church and you won’t regret coming to try it out. Church Unlimited, wow! Such a wonderful place to be. Been attending for the past 3 years. Feels like home, everyone is always so welcoming and loving, everyone is real.! Pastor Paul is such a great leader, Pastor Bil always has such amazing messages to share! God moves through this place tremendously. I can’t thank God enough for this beautiful community!! I love my church family ! 💙🤍 Been going for 3 years and love it.  At the Movies summer series the best part of the year. Great church for people who have never been to church or have church wounds. Never seen so many people who attend but also volunteer here.  That's really special and shows lots of people have skin in the game to make this church run.

They have small groups, a great children's ministry, and a great youth group. Very friendly.  I dig the music, too!  Churches these days need music like that shake things up.  Elevation Worship (a Christian band) popular here.

Something different about this church that can confuse newcomers is the fact there is a campus pastor but also a main pastor.  The campus pastor and his wife of course, are there in person, say hi to everyone, and welcome and introduce the main pastor before the sermon starts. The main pastor is Pastor Bil, and his sermons are broadcast live out of Corpus on a big screen.  Absolutely love his preaching.  He never misses, and God has spoken through him into our lives tons of times.  Wanna try something different? Try out CU!
