name: Church@Main - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
This place does things alittle different from what im used to, but as a visitor, I was treated very well, the congregation all seemed very nice, it started with singing for the Lord, and then the preacher did alittle preaching about the letter Paul wrote to the churches of Galatia, he seemed very knowledgeable. One could feel the presence of the Lord threw it.
I'll definitely be back, if the Lord puts me in the area on a Sunday morning again.
May God bless this church Attended once and was met with hostility twice by that Sundays pastor. Luckily a gentleman made up for it in the foyer before my son and I walked right out. remember, we are known by our fruits. His impression will have a lasting impact. Also, message incongruent to scripture. Curious which doctrine/ version used; Man driven not holy spirit driven. Church is big, beautiful area for children. Fun church for kids. Why it’s important not to walk into any church—even in support of others. Always be lead solely by Elohim and our best friend, the Holy Spirit. When I came to the Springs I had visited 4 different Churches around the Villages, Wildwood & Summerfield. None of them filled me spiritually.
When I visited the Springs I was immediately greeted but not in a pushy way more of a friendly manner. Pastor Drew said to the congregation that give the Springs 3 visits and if you don’t like it they would name some other ChurchesI might like. Well after 3 visits I was convinced that this is the Church for me. The openly honest people caring about me was so natural that I gravitated to a Bible Study almost immediately.
Through that group I found a real connection to my Lord. It was then that I began to have a strong personal relationship with God. I actually could hear Jesus  talking to me. Not literally but so loud in my heart ♥️ that there was no question of who was talking to me. Besides wonderful  people I have met there hearing my Savior speak is the best gift I could have.
Give the Springs a try. The music was good, really enjoyed the message it was great.  The reason I only Gave a 3 star rating is due to the fact no one said a word to me, not even the door greeters.  I was 15 minutes early, dressed casual ( jeans and nice shirt), phone put up, arms not crossed and just watched how most of the people there had their groups and kept to them. I saw others who were ignored like me. Not sure if I will return. I am looking for church home where I can grow and be an active member. My husband and I have visited Church@Main the past two Sundays with our toddler, and we are loving it so far. I've grown up in church, and I can definitely say I have never been to a friendlier church. As a guest, attending a new church can be intimidating, but the folks at this church are SO welcoming and seem genuinely happy that you are there. We haven't actually spoken to the pastor yet, but from what I hear he and his wife are great people. I really enjoy his preaching style. I'm excited to keep coming back.

name: Church180 - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I started to like this church and our family decided to start to volunteer for Sunday Service. Tragedy happened and my son passed away. Kyra asked me 2 days after my son passed if my family was still going to volunteer that Sunday. Straight to business. I gave her the benefit of the doubt that she might not have known, but she did. She said she was sorry after the fact and please feel free to take time off if needed. If needed?? Wow…needless to say, I don’t go there anymore. Just moved back to San Diego and was looking a church that I felt would be the right one for me and then find a place to stay in the vicinity of the church and Church180 was what I kept coming back to in my searches, felt right even before ever stepping foot inside.

Went to my first service today and it was all that I expected and more! Everyone was so welcoming and inviting and genuine! I would recommend coming here for anyone looking for that  feeling of being welcomed and also just being able to be in the word and being able to get something out of it, I will definitely be going back! This church is very welcoming, and built on foundation of leading people to Christ. Great community for kids and little ones. Events and community service are a pillar in the churches outreach program. I love the people I’ve met along the way from day one. This church is highly encouraged to give a chance and check out on a Sunday @10am. Warm and welcoming atmosphere, genuine people.

I was nervous about attending church after being an Atheist for my entire adult life, but I was curious about studying Christianity and could not have had a better experience. Pastor Tony has a way of relating the Bible to modern times and I always leave church feeling renewed for the week ahead.

I have two young kids who eagerly attend Kids180 and nursery. They’ve learned a lot about Jesus and are excited to continue expanding their knowledge and faith.

After attending regularly, my heart felt ready to receive baptism and what a glorious experience it was to get baptized in the Pacific Ocean with my church family gathered around.

If you feel at all compelled to check out Church180, absolutely do so. You’ll be welcomed with open arms. Went to the grand opening 2 yrs ago and can’t see being anywhere else. From the moment you arrive there are warm welcoming smiles. I have found a church that has become a family.

name: ChurchLV Green Valley - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
We are from California, but  visit our family in Las Vegas.  We discovered Church LV one Sunday while looking for a place to worship.  What a blessing God definitely lead us there.  We love it, and have been taking my grandkids when we go.  We call it our home away from home family .  God is really moving.  If you haven't  been, try it, it is worth the visit.🙏🏻✝️📖❤️ Very welcoming. Two services on Sunday. This is not a typical atmosphere but there is a lot of music, singing, a band and usually guest speakers weekly. They do an offering but it is not high pressure. They have weekly activities with a few bigger activities that are seasonal outreaches.

Update: a snippet for your listening pleasure. This church just opened a second location.  I haven’t visited that one. I enjoy this service. The family leads. Husband, wife and son. It’s pretty remarkable. Check it out.

This church is very friendly and community oriented without a denomination that I noted. There’s plenty of seating but the inside feels more like a big conference room than a chapel and there are no handouts or programs. We had a great visit to this church. Music acoustics were great. The pastor is engaging and funny. Such a great experience.
See a video on our YouTube channel Coolest Life. My mom and I started attending 2 months ago and enjoyed the worship but always felt like there was a personal motive behind the messages. This last time was the last straw. "Pastor" Wendy preached (more like shouted the whole time) on how we need to be like Mary and give all that we can (relating to money) and continued to fleece the flock the whole sermon while stating that we dont have to give under compulsion. Not only do I feel like the scripture was being twisted to fit the narrative I also felt the message was not led by the Holy Sprit at all. If I was an unbelievaber (Ive been saved 15 years) and that was the first time I stepped in church and all I heard was a plea for money to pay for the leaking roof, coffee shop and kids special needs area for a month straight why would I feel led to give my life to Christ? Asking for a offering is one thing but if you need to keep pushing people to give for your own church needs maybe you aren't trusting in God to provide and should just take out a loan or downsize to a smaller location. I hope leadership sees this because something needs to change as we are all going to have to give an account to Jesus and especially if we are called to be pastors. I was really hoping to make this our church home but my mom and I will have to keep looking  unfortunately 😢 ChurchLV has been such a blessing in not just my heart and life but in my families as well. We moved to Las Vegas a few years ago and have been praying for a local church near us that we can pour into and “rattle these dry bones” sort of speak. We attended a few other churches and they were great but ChurchLV felt like HOME the second we walked through the doors… I mean we felt an amazing presence of community and the Holy Spirit. There’s truly nothing like it. My kids ask to go to church throughout the week and look forward to service. Everyone from the pastors to each serve member are truly special and I cannot praise them enough. I have cried my eyes out during multiple sermons due to being overwhelmed by the Holy Spirit and truly it’s been life changing. I joined Pastor Bennys kingdom first for my birthday gift to myself and my husband and I have been blessed in so many ways from our marriage,  finances, community and to a change of mindset to grow in our walk of faith. We know this is a journey and not a sprint and we are in it for the long haul. I cannot WAIT to pour into our amazing local church for more years to come and I’m so blessed we get to raise our children to do the same. Thank you to the entire ChurchLV fam you guys are amazing! May God continue to answer our God sized prayers of reaching more people in this world to know and love Jesus!

name: Churchome
reviewSummary: Known for Judah Smith's relatable and passionate preaching style. A digital-first community with a strong following.

name: Cielo Vista Church - El Paso Campus
reviewSummary: I have been searching for a Christian church for me and my partner to attend. This church is very welcoming and has great service. The only issue is this past Sunday there was a guest pastor . I was suprised that he brought up politics during service and said “support Israel “ …. I will not be returning due to this . Not everyone has the same political views and it was inappropriate. A great community, with theologically sound and biblical pastors. Always a pleasant experience whether you come in person or watch online. In person is always preferred and recommended. This church is awesome, if you are looking for a church in El Paso this is the place to be. Wonderful believers bible study is amazing, they have community groups I have friends from this church. Our pastors holds the standard of God high. I became a believer in this church Iam now going to bible study and reading my Bible I love this church.May God bless Cielo Vista church abundantly. This is a friendly place for the entire family. If you are hurting emotionally, feeling lost or depressed. There is help from GOD for everyone in this place. Feel free to come as you are with all your hurts and scars. GOD'S presence is really here, and help from GOD'S Holy Word heals the broken hearted and brings peace. Love this place, been going for the past few days and its such a wondeful community. Everyone is so welcoming and friendly and it was so easy to just fall in love with this church.

name: CIL Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing house of worship. Great people who make you feel at home the first time you walk in. Worship was incredible!! Pastor Aubry and his team are outstanding!! Everyone is so kind and welcoming. Worth giving it a shot at either the 900am or 1045am service. You won't be dissapointed! This is one of the best churches I've ever been to in a long time I loved it took a picture of one of the singers in the choir it was unbelievable experience they treat us like king and queen One of our fav churches in the Hendersonville area.  Lotsa cool things for the kids to do.  Very vibrant and full of ALL age groups, including young families :-)   The Holy Spirit is sooooo present during worship, and Aaron and the teachers give sermons/teachings that nourish and educate from a biblical Christ-centered perspective. CIL has been more to a church to us, it has truly been a family.  We've been members since the beginning, and have always felt so loved.  The staff are such people of integrity.  The worship is amazing. The people love each other.  There are lots of opportunities to serve and be served.  I've attended several churches in my life, but once I found CIL I've never wanted to leave!  Going on 17 years with these people! My family and I have been attending CIL Church for around a month now.
This is one of the best churches we've been to. We have finally found somewhere we can call home! The music and the lessons behind the sermons are very fulfilling. We are truly blessed to have found this Church.

name: Cincinnati Church of the Brethren - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor is a wonderful woman. They are a very caring community asset. I love their church.

name: Circle of Peace Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: What an amazing church! Loving, seeking God. Pastor Jeremy is a wonderful speaker and a smart, kind man. The congregation is welcoming with open arms. You will LOVE being here and being along side these Godly people who are huge difference makers for Christ. My church. If you need Jesus come join us in worship, music and a warm, loving atmosphere. Services are 9A and 10:30A I call this church family home.  I have for most of my life.  Jeremy is a phenomenal pastor who speaks right to me. I learn every time I go.    Diverse congregation, unpretentious, friendly, "real" people who are looking to live their lives more like Jesus, plain and simple.  All are welcome! Fantastic music every Sunday. Energetic, positive vibe keeps me coming back. I know God led me and my family to this wonderful community.  I am so glad he did.  It felt like the right church home from the first time I visited.  I love the community of welcoming people, the worshipful music, the Bible-centered, and the thought-provoking sermons, and the opportunities for Christian fellowship and discipleship.  The thing I love the most though is the focus on the things that matter most to me- growing in our relationship with God, prayer, following the teachings of the Bible, Jesus as our Lord, and the Holy Spirit's daily work in our lives! I am thankful that this church strives to put him first and let him guide! Every time we drove by this church on our way to try to fit into another church, my husband said, " I wonder what they're all about." So, we went one Sunday and then some more Sundays. What we found is that this church is all about loving without judgment and growing in the Spirit. The welcome is real, the acceptance is genuine, and the opportunities to learn and grow are endless. We have brought out grandson with us since he was an infant and he sat in church with us, now he toddles off to nursery when he's not trying to run outside and play on the playground. Safe, loving, and warm place for humans of all ages. I hope you stop in one Sunday - there is a place for you!

name: Citadel of Praise
reviewSummary: Powerhouse urban church in Detroit led by Pastor Spencer T. Ellis, renowned for spirit-filled gospel choir worship, empowering biblical preaching, and extensive city outreach.

name: Citadel of Praise Church & Campus Ministries - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: Powerhouse urban church in Detroit led by Pastor Spencer T. Ellis, renowned for spirit-filled gospel choir worship, empowering biblical preaching, and extensive city outreach.

name: Citipointe Church Boulder - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
I call this church home.  I love to see what God is doing in Boulder here. Heartfelt worship
Real biblical teaching
Caring staff that wants to love all with lots of outreach

And free meals once a month to feed ourselves even more with food and fellowship

I’m so excited for this church and all it’s going to do is

Please check it out

name: Citipointe Church Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Incredible church that has gone above and beyond for our family! They have loved and embraced our daughter with special needs, made accommodations for our family as needed, and provided us with the most rich and vibrant friends and community we could have asked for. Biblically sound and alive in the Spirit of God. We are thankful for our home at Citipointe! Not just a great church it's a great community, incredible pastors, and an unbelievable worship team The church offers lots of education to help you be the best Christian you can be. I'm happy to call citipointe my home for the last four years this church is Holy Spirit driven. You can feel the presence of of the Lord! Citipointe has become my home. Everyone is genuinely welcoming and caring. The Worship team is amazing! I have grown so much in my faith since I first walked through the doors. The presence of Jesus is undeniable! Thank you, church family! I could not possibly say enough great things about this church and its leadership. Not only is it impossible to walk through the doors without being welcomed, but you won’t make it too far inside without people wanting to have genuine conversations and get to know you. They call themselves the friendliest church in nashville and it’s true - you will absolutely make a friend the first time you show up. The pastors and leadership team are 100% genuine. This church is incredibly Holy Spirit filled as well. I’ve seen so many miracles, healings and deliverances here in this place. All glory to God. No one is on a pedestal here except Jesus Christ. The worship is also next level, such an anointed team. Lots of life groups and community outreach events too. This church is so special - come visit and you’ll find out why! Powerful two nights with David Hogan
Atmosphere was charged with God's presence

name: Citizen Heights Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary:
I love CH ♥️ I’ve been attending for almost 2 years and I can’t be grateful enough for the things God has done in my life. The lord saved my live and I got baptized there.
Ps Michael and Heather are amazing! always listen to God’s voice through their sermons.
They have a so many great groups every season to build community.
Worship is also amazing! I am definitely can feel the presence of the holy spirit at this church. My church 🫶 We would love if you come and visit! I've found my spiritual home at Citizen Heights. The congregation is incredibly friendly, and the word of God delivered here is always solid and timely. I've met so many wonderful people and it's heartwarming to see everyone come together as one to worship Jesus. We have a great youth group and kids ministry. The worship team is amazing, consistently bringing new and relevant songs that everyone can sing along to. Despite the transient nature of the DC area, I plan on growing roots in this church and making it my home church for many years to come. I remember the first time I visited Citizen Heights. Looking back, I could have never imagined what God was about to do in my life through this church. Citizen Heights became family, a place of support, and an amazing community.
It’s such a joy to serve and to be there for one another, literally the true meaning of church. Here you find people who love God and genuinely care. We care because we know that every person who walks through the doors matters to us and to God.
There are so many opportunities to worship, learn, grow, share, and create memories together. Small groups make it easy to build deeper connections, and I love seeing so many young adults living for God side by side.
For almost six years now, I’ve had the privilege of calling this place home, and I’m so thankful that God opened this door (not just for me, but also for you!) I have been a part of the Citizen Heights Community for at least 7 years.  I have found this community to be a family. Always encouraging, always inviting, always believing for more for everyone who steps foot in our community. If you are seeking a vibrant, Jesus centered Church home,
I encourage you to find your place here at Citizen Heights Such a friendly church with deeply spiritual and rousing words of faith. Amazing worship team!

name: Citizens Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
I went last Sunday on Labor Day weekend for the first time. Attended the service. Pastor Jamin Roller was the lead. He spoke about the Bible and Jesus. There was a band and good singers. The hall was pretty full but I was still comfortably seated in the back. After service I saw a lady who took me upstairs to a newcomer meeting. There we met pastors and other staff and it was inviting and interesting. They prayed for me in the end and that felt good. I am signing up for Bible studies on Tuesday mornings. Was visiting Texas to see my grandkids and we came here for Resurrection Sunday. Who ever thought that Ecclesiastes was a great book to preach the risen Christ! Loved all the welcoming people. Our family is thankful for these people and this place, our new church home. If you’re looking for people to heal, learn, laugh, grow, and follow Jesus with, Citizens is a great church to try. We’d love to have you. My dear friend and dentist Dr.Barrett Davidson saw I was in need. What does Dr.Davidson do he gets with his church family ALL OF YOU and other angels that have come into my life and gets me a car I have thanked as many as I could or as many as I know about. Now I want to thank all of the wonderful people at Citizens Church much love and gratitude to all from someone who is feeling so blessed. My prayers and thoughts go out to all of you.
Thank you,
God Bless i’ve never felt more welcome nor loved, than at Citizens. the sermons are very convicting in a gentle yet honest way, that is truly to steer one closer to Christ. i started coming here as a non believer, and Citizens is now my second family. there is a great college and young adults ministry, and there are also so many families and elders who are deeply involved in the community. something unique about here is that they have a recovery ministry, and believe that through Christ, anything can happen, which is very refreshing and faith restoring. love Citizens!!

name: Citizens Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: We walked into this church 3 weeks ago. My anxiety instantly lowered, every single person we met on day 1 was remarkable and welcoming. We were able to dedicate our son to the Lord this last Sunday and that experience was nothing shy of a warm embrace. I have even joined a crew and couldn't be more happier that my family landed here. I've never felt so at home, and so seen in a church. One day, I look forward to giving back in the same way that this church has given me. Citizens along with the holy spirit has reignited a fire back in my soul. Beyond happy to call this place home 💖. Further, our 3 year old son after just 2 weeks looks forward to going to "Jesus" and playing with his friends in the kids ministry. Great atmosphere.  Why the ropes though I feel like I should be able to sit where I please I feel more comfortable towards the back . Also my wife has high functioning anxiety so she prefers to sit towards the back. # no ropes My husband and I are looking for a home church and visited this wonderful church on Sunday.  From the moment we got to the church we greeted with extremely warm welcomes. The worship team is AMAZING! Both message and fellowship were great! I believe we found our church home! I am home! What a wonderful place to worship. The toddler's program during church is awesome and the church service is GREAT. Pastor Chris Norman is an exceptionally blessed worship leader. I leave the services truly appreciating the word of God with a greater understanding. The worshippers are warm and welcoming! I , my daughter and granddaughter love it! Friendly people. Great sermons. I also love the music yet it is too loud for me because of the headaches I have. Yet I get to watch it online ...I love that they have cgroups (small groups) where they meet at different homes to go over the sermons etc, and get to know each other. They have become a part of my family.

name: Citizens Church Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Really thankful for this church community. Scripture is clearly and faithfully taught, community groups help members dive deeper into relationship with Jesus, and resources are regularly created to equip members in their walk with Christ.

Spiritual disciplines, Biblical literacy, relational reconciliation, Gospel centricity and missional living are consistently emphasized. Incredible small church with great music even better sermons and Jesus at the center of it all Extremely welcoming environment, great worship, So fun! Great church. Great people.

name: Citizens LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I think there's a mismatch on Google Maps in terms of which page this belongs to. This review is, in specific, about Citizens LA Church, a Korean American church that meets at a High School in DTLA (near Chinatown). Overall, service was fantastic. The pastor was grounded in Scripture, the worship was Spirit-led and the ushers were helpful and kind. I've been checking churches in the area but it's tough given that most of the churches with young (20s and 30s) people fall into the Korean American group and, although I have like 4 or 5 Korean friends, it's definitely a more homogeneous, closely-knit and insular group to try and fit into than any other out there (Asian or otherwise). That's on me, though. I came due to a friend's suggestion (he's KorAm), but at the last minute, he flaked on me, and I ended up at a mostly KorAm church by myself, lol. Highly recommended church if you're Asian or Asian American, in college or are post college and still relatively young (20s, 30s), as I think this church specifically caters to that community. Absolutely fantastic experience of church from the sermon to the praise. They have guest speakers here once in a while whom are really great at speaking. The worship is like a live concert. That's how great the praise team is. Pastor Alex is funny uses excellent rhetoric and has awesome sermons. This church has made me grow drastically in my spirituality. PTL. btw all are welcome. I'm gay and I'm happy with their stance. LGBT friendly is a plus. truly an amazing place that shows the strength of the faith of the Korean American community but with one huge issue- nearly a hundred toddlers and babies that share the same large echoing hall for worship service. we could never get into the sermon as babies are crying and screaming and the pastor speaks very loudly to drown out the baby noises with the speakers blasting and ringing in our ears. Go here.

name: City Bible Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
New satellite service of City Bible Church Cerritos.  All the great things about the Cerritos location in an urban context.  The gospel desperately needs to be brought back to the city as it has become such a dark place without the hope of Christ.  City Bible Church is truly that light in a dark place.  In addition to regular Sunday worship there's a lot of other events and outreaches that take place at the church site as well as other places nearby.  If you're looking for a church that has solid biblical teaching, genuine community, and is willing to engage with the culture then I encourage you to come visit us. My original Yelp Review: I started going to City Bible in 05/2018 because I found them on Yelp!  Nice small church w/ the organic taste of hospitality.

Update 02/2022: I've grown so much at this church, and have seen many others grow at this church.  Especially in relation to church community, it's been a fresh experience of The Lord's design for church.  Deeper commitment to a church has resulted in good fruit of steadfastness, longsuffering, self-control, and that shared bond of gospel partnership.
During the pandemic, It's been fine meeting outdoors in the parking lot, and the Lord is doing some great things in 2022: Little Tokyo City Tours, Street Evangelism, Orphanage Mercy Ministry, Creative Art Shows,  Theology Class, Board Game Tournaments & Meetups, Prayer Retreats, and more! This is a small church that was meeting on the parking lot. The people there are very friendly. They welcomed me and visited with me but there was no pressure on me. The pastor preached a very good bible-based message. We sang a lot of Christmas songs and concluded the service with a candle lighting ceremony. All in all I would highly recommend visiting this church to spread the Gospel light in the city of Los Angeles. A great local church that is all about the three words in the name. A church about the Bible and reaching the city. City Bible Church is on the smaller side with about twenty people every week so it has a nice cozy feeling. They have another service later in the day in Cerritos which is the bulk of its membership. It's on the 2nd floor of the JEMS building and has it's own parking lot which makes it really easy to attend.

name: City Bible Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love City Bible Church in Sacramento. The worship is Christ-centered, genuine, and focused on glorifying God. The biblical teaching is solid, faithful to Scripture, and consistently challenges us to grow in our walk with Christ.

The Bible studies are also excellent—thoughtful, engaging, and grounded in God’s Word. We’ve found a welcoming church family, meaningful fellowship, and countless opportunities to deepen our faith. We are truly grateful to be part of a church that is committed to sound doctrine and helping people follow Jesus faithfully. At City Bible Church, our faith centers around Jesus Christ, who lived, died, and rose again to offer eternal life to all through God's unending love and grace. We believe the Holy Spirit empowers us each day to walk in that love by serving our community with compassion, welcoming everyone as Jesus would, supporting one another through both joy and struggle, and actively loving both God and neighbor as the most important calling of our lives. It is this faith in and devotion to our Triune God, and the difference we strive to make through living it out, that we invite all people to come experience with us on Sundays at 10:00 a.m. as we worship Christ and encourage one another in our journey of faith. We see His love and the abundance of fruits in every service and community. Dirty Rags to Calvary. Expository preaching. True theology. The blood of Christ. Miracle Worker. Promise Keeper. Light in the darkness. Great place for worship and praise!
The Gospel is definitely preached and taught here. City Bible has been home to our family since November 2017. We love the people, the pastors, and everything that God is doing for his glory through this local church! Come by on a Sunday morning at 10am and see for yourself! :) Ok, it is a little weird to "review" a church on google but this is how I found this church to go to, so here I am!

This church is solid theologically and that is the main reason I am writing this review. I was visiting from out of town and I wanted to go to a theologically sound, gospel preaching church that doesn't water down the message. All/most of the pastors seem to have come from Grace Community Church (John MacArthur church) and the senior pastor, Vlad, was preaching that Sunday I visited and he was so good with the exegesis. He explained a very difficult passage in 1 Corinthians with grace, using the previous passage to interpret it. The people were welcoming and my friend and I were greeted by a few people at the welcome desk. They weren't too overwhelming with attention, just the right amount :) If I'm ever in the area I will return. So encouraged to see a solid biblical church. Hard to find these days.

name: City Blessing Church San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Feel great and awesome worshipping, praising and meeting wonderful people here. Friendly congregation, had an awesome time!

name: City Central Church
reviewSummary: City Central has given me a huge impact in my life. I encourage you all to join Knowing Freedom Immersion, you will find God in your heart and you will heal from anything that you are struggling with your life. They are very helpful and encouraging in any situation you may encounter. They will accept you with grace and kindness. I will never forget what they did for me to see God in my life. Everyone is so warm and welcoming. The pastor is great and very personable. Always so nice and non judgemental and we always feel comfortable here. I enjoy the things they do and the support and prayer team they have is just awesome. I really like coming to this church and it only took one time of my family and I attending to go back so that really says something to me about this church. Honestly this church is beautiful inside and out. Sunday school is provided for all ages based on the age of your children.  Theirs a coffee shop inside. The music is good and this is a wonderful place to worship God.  Theirs a bus stop #57 right out side if you needed and the church is 1 minute from Tacoma mall but closer go startbucks and the dollar store and Wendy's.  Check it out . The hospitality and welcoming feeling at thus place is so far unmatched. The preachers are amazing people and give real by the bible sermons. I've loved my time here so far and recommend to everyone I can This experience is a must for almost everyone. After being a believer for over 45 years, I have never had this kind of teaching. You will uncover things you never thought were binding you in your life. I can't say enough about the loving spirit of the entire team at City Central Church. So much love, kindness and most important...Jesus. Thank you for a true blessing to have an opportunity to learn and grow spiritually.

name: City Church - Alpharetta / Milton Campus
reviewSummary: City Church is absolutely wonderful-very inviting, they do a great job facilitating getting you connected whether you're interested in serving or joining a community group.  I really appreciate how relatable and easy to follow Pastor Billy Lowe is.  My sons even enjoy going and are able to discuss takeaways with me afterwards.  I'm excited to see what God has in store for City Church! I just have been visiting the City Church for a month. Very nice church for newcomers and locals who wanted to grow spiritually encouraged and get stronger in the word of God, its a perfect Church. God is doing great in this church. As today’s message “Love IN Action” as Paul says in 2 Corinthians 9: God multiplies giving capacity so this church is doing the same. It's been a very blessed and devotional place to worship God and be joyful with the Services. God is Good ✝️ Most friendly, welcoming group of people l have ever encountered in a church setting in a long time…..preaching is both biblical and relevant to today’s world…..music is inspiring….highly recommend you visit if you are considering a new church home. City Church is a wonderful community of genuine, solid people. I’ve known Pastor Billy and have also spent time with Jim Boyle and other members of the church. They truly believe in their mission and, more importantly, live it out every day. If you’re looking for a new church and a strong community of people, I highly recommend City Church.

name: City Church - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary:
Been coming here since 2018. All of the Pastors and Staff are extremely welcoming and caring. The part that kept me coming back is how the messages are based off of biblical content and context. Direct information straight from the source.

They have a lot of local events and even have a great Kids program. Worship team is always putting together an amazing set every week and you can tell everyone gives a little above and beyond every week.

If you are questioning visiting just go and experience it for yourself. Who knows it might change your life. It did to mine. Thank you ❤️ I was truly moved by the atmosphere and total experience here. Upbeat praise and worship and direct and positive sermon. A very moving experience that brightened my entire week! Had a great visit!  Worship was great, Pastor Obie told a funny story about going to the wrong airport in his sermon, and the BBQ smelled amazing.  Wish I could have stayed for the BBQ, but I had a great visit! I was not impressed, I didn't know anybody.
The pastor went on for 3.5 hours he kept crying about everything he talked about. And he spoke about things that didn't make any sense about people from the church that I'd never heard of and all the projects that were going on.  There was no scripture reading, not much prayer and the coffee was mediocre. They have this million dollar reach out which they want you to donate to.So that's a complete turn off. Another church asking for money don't bother. Everyone is so pleasant and very helpful there worship is great
Message is meaningful

name: City Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
A place to wrestle honestly with faith, doubts, and your relationship with God without pressure or pretending. Over time, through the people, the teaching, and just showing up, it’s become a place I genuinely look forward to being each week.

It feels real, welcoming, and grounded. If you’re looking for a church where growth happens naturally and community builds over time, this is a really special place. If you are looking for a SAFE SPACE to explore who God is, or what Jesus is all about - this is the place for you!
I moved to the area about 7 months ago. I first noticed the banner "In the City, For The City" and that is what drew me to check out this church. When I visited EVERYONE was so kind and welcoming. I felt at home right away, but took about 4 more months to officially join. What is unique about this church is it is focused on intimacy with God, not ministry for Him. It was planted to help other move toward God from where ever they are at. There is no judgement. No Posturing. Just pointing towards Jesus and His loving father who wants to know you and love you where you are.

I have never been a part of a healthier church, and the more I learn, the more impressed I am with Drake, the pastor, and all that call city church home. I am now stepping into learning more about leadership in this church and it is so freeing to feel encouraged to use my gifts, but no pressure to have to lead.

I would love to personally invite you into this space and hope I see you there. I explored 4 different church’s in the Boulder area, and when I first went to City Church I knew it was the right fit. It truly is a family, and they’re so proactive on making you feel like part of it! Couldn’t recommend this church enough. Hands on approach, community oriented, incredibly kind and welcoming. I love it!! City Church has been such a gift. From the moment you walk in, you’re met with authentic warmth, friendliness. There’s genuine care. The teaching is thoughtful, grounded in Scripture, and deeply relevant to everyday life, while also being sensitive to where people are at in their relationships with God.

The community is a place where you can show up as you are, ask honest questions, and feel both welcomed and encouraged to grow. The leadership is humble and intentional, and there’s a clear heart for loving the city well.

Whether you’re wrestling with the concept of God or in deep intimacy with him, City Church is place worth exploring. What first brought me to this church was an experience I had with a member at my work. The man prayed for me in the aisle, in front of many people, with such boldness and confidence...I was INSPIRED! And I wanted to see what church this man came from.
The reason I have decided to continue to attend and become a committed member is because at my first visit to the church, I felt the Holy Spirit fill the room during worship and my tears just started to flow...
I can see that the Pastor has such a desire to reach the people with the love of God, almost to the point of possibly being misunderstood...
I'm looking forward to continuing to grow in my faith and be a part of the community at this humble church of God.
✝️🛐🌅🙌🏼🫂💓💪🏼🐎💯✨

I forgot to mention that I learned how protective this sheherd is of his flock in the things I learned about the church in the growth track meeting and that's another one of the many reasons I've decided to stay a while 😄🙌🏼🌅

name: City Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
I've never been compelled to review a church, but this is a really special place. This was my first visit. Free, on-street parking is available everywhere.
When I got to the door I was greeted by two members of the church, who introduced themselves. It's so rare for a stranger to do that so I assumed we'd met and,let's just say, I sounded like an idiot. She didn't act like I am and I'm grateful for that. Everyone I talked to that day showed the same warmth and kindness. I am most impressed by their sense of community. That day they had a potluck brunch after the service, which I believe they do every month. They also have small groups that meet throughout the week so the families really get to know each other.
I'm lucky to have a diverse group of friends,so I've been to lots of places of worship. This was the most welcoming, by far. City Church in Tremont is a super authentic place of worship. There’s a beautiful simplicity to the service that feels deeply holy and grounded.

It’s not flashy or performance-driven—it’s honest, welcoming, and focused on what really matters. A peaceful and powerful place to connect with God. Very welcoming.  Easy to find   Great biblical preaching, engaging music and worship service.  Several families and staff connected with us either before during or after the service, just taking the time to know us.  Glad we were able to worship together while we were apart from our home church. This is my church home (2017) after a couple of years of looking. Services are bible based. Child friendly. name: City Church - Murfreesboro Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church with a non denominational vibe. All the people are very welcoming . If you’re looking for a church that really values authenticity and community, this is your place. This church has challenged me to grow in my faith unlike anywhere else. They don’t shy away from any of the hard questions of life or difficult situations you may find yourself in. The people there truly demonstrate the Gospel in action. I am so thankful that my family and I started attending City Church a little over 5 years ago. I could write a novel about all of the ways this church has challenged, encouraged, and grown us through community, truth and grace. I love how they do not compromise truth, accountability, or purpose while also maintaining a safe place for the broken and seeking. I would encourage anyone seeking a church home, or even trying church out, to come and spend some time in a few services or sharing a meal with a community group. For seven years, my wife and I drifted, visiting various churches without finding a true spiritual home. That changed dramatically in April 2023 when we attended City Church's Easter service. From the moment we walked in, the genuine atmosphere was striking – the genuine people, the heartfelt worship, and the pastor's relatable sermon resonated deeply. It was clear the Lord was speaking to us through this congregation.

Just months later, I found myself needing pastoral guidance. The executive pastor's willingness to disciple me, through thoughtful discussions and insightful resources, revealed the profound beauty of the gospel. This level of personal connection, I believe, is a testament to the church's intimate size and commitment to individual care.

The impact has been transformative. My relationships, especially my marriage, have flourished. City Church's unwavering commitment to preaching the Word of God, with every sermon pointing to Jesus Christ as humanity's ultimate hope, has been life-changing.

Their mission, "Multiply gospel change for broken people on purpose," is not just a slogan; it's a lived reality. I've personally experienced its power. Now, as a covenant member, I'm honored to be part of this mission. I wholeheartedly encourage anyone seeking genuine faith and transformative community to experience the remarkable work the Lord is doing at City Church. I love City Church. I never really experienced true community or church family until I became a part of this church. I have always felt accepted, included and cared about. I so appreciate how everyone invests in each other and loves each other right where they are. I have gone to church my whole life, but have grown more in my relationship with Jesus and my knowledge, understanding and love for the Gospel more than ever. I feel it really is a true picture and representation of what God wants His church to be.

name: City Church Chicago
reviewSummary:
PLEASE BE ADVISED: Prosperity “gospel” galore!!! The way the new building was discussed, I had a bad feeling. It was framed as a “were ‘good Christians’ so good things are happening” not as “we think this is God’s direction for us.”
THEN: As the sermon is introduced, Pastor Kent revealed that City Church is associated with Lakewood Church and its pastor Joel Osteen (notorious for prosperity gospel teachings), as Pastor Kent is related to staff members of Lakewood Church in Houston, TX. It continued to get worse as the prayer to introduce the sermon reminded everyone that “God wants to rearrange your life to make things easier for you and for your happiness” (the goal of communing with God is not to make things “easier for you,” but to rely on God to get through the difficulties promised in John 16:33) and asked for God to “grant us the supernatural ability to communicate with him” (more than the veil torn in two did?).

I wish I could say the theology was the only disappointing part about my visit. The tagline “we love you already” seems pretty shallow when there’s no actions to back it up. My husband and I walked in, smiled and made eye contact with many people talking, hung around the lobby, asked for directions, and… nothing. People answered our questions with as few words as possible, then IMMEDIATELY turned to resume their prior conversations. We were treated as an inconvenience. That is UNTIL we were being seated, when we were placed in the front row lol. Even during the “we’re good hosts, take some cups of skittles” time for greeting your neighbors, people did not talk to us. Sadly, I was disappointed in our treatment even before I had a chance to hear the church’s theology! It’s the best Chicago church! Pastor Kent and Alli are amazing people. The messages have a positive uplifting tone. Several young adults ages 25-40 attend. Plus the worship is Hillsong inspired.

Take a break from a street fest and go to church! You won’t regret it.

(P.s. Jeremiah 29:11 & Exodus 14:14) First impression was good, the worship was solid and nothing in the teaching struck me as off. However once Pastor Kent, introduced the guest speaker, who he said was his uncle and who he mentioned works with Joel Osteen's ministry and at Lakewood Chuch. Lakewood and Joel specifically are known for promoting prosperity gospel theology. At the beginning of the sermon, the guest's prayer and he leaned heavily on God supernaturally aligning circumstances for our benefit and blessing us. This language sounded like prosperity theology to me rather than the gospel. It is worth knowing that Pastor Kent Munsey's father, Steve Munsey, is a prosperity preacher out of Munster, Indiana. Overall, while the church is very welcoming and upbeat the prosperity gospel theology is a no for me. Walking in for the first time, the worship caught my Spirit woman in seconds. Genuine, pure, true expression to the heart of God. The message is mature... palatable for those who need milk, and digestible for the meat of the sWord! Intergenerational, diverse, inclusive- I'M HOME. THANK YOU ABBA FOR A BODY TO PLANT MY SEEDS, LITERALLY. Amazing church i definitely felt the presence of God there. I haven't been excited about church and God in a very long time but that church touched me . I think God lead me to go to this church last Sunday because my sisters and i supposed to go to our church but i asked them lets find a nearby church instead because our church is a long drive from home. we googled this and bam! i wont be able to tell you how great the place and service is until you see for yourself

reviewSummary: Since of the nicest people you will meet and a beautiful, newly renovated church! Great things happening here! Terrible neighbors they destroyed the neighborhood. There is no shame in or expectations  of where you are in your faith when you walk in the doors, all are welcome to explore Gods word together  🙏🏻 I can’t say enough great things about City Church! My fiancé and I both grew up in different denominations and have found a church home that we both love. He had been going to church here for a while before I joined but I immediately felt welcomed. People took a genuine interest in getting to know me and supported me and it’s amazing to see the community we’ve developed already. It’s a diverse, engaged, genuine group of people from all walks of life. The two Pastors are awesome people, when they preach you can’t help but be engaged, and it challenges you in the best ways. The ministry partners and opportunities for service are unique and so great for the city. There are so many ways to get involved and be engaged- city groups, men and women’s focus groups, volunteering, etc. and this is what allowed us to meet so many people and really find a home. City Church has become the thing that makes Houston feel like home and I encourage anyone looking for a church home to give it a try! No matter where you are in life or in your faith, there are so many people at City Church that would love to meet you and welcome you in. The first time we visited First Church Heights we were blown away by the Holy Spirit in this church. The love was so thick in the room it was beautiful. The Pastor embrace us as visitors and yhe members mad us feel like family. The teachings are directly from scripture. No phony business here. name: City Church International - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
Such an amazing church. This place has changed my life and I have seen countless people's lives be changes as well. A church that proclaims both spirit and truth in the heart of Dallas. The love of Jesus is evident here and it is a praying church. Come check us out if you are curious about Jesus and are hungry for the abundant life of following him! PRAYING FOR GROWTH; GREAT PLACE TO WORSHIP

I have been attending City Church International since April and I can honestly say that I appreciate much about this church. The unity of having one location and most of the congregation attending one service carries real weight for me. Scripture tells us, “so we, though many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another” (Romans 12:5). Gathering together as one church reflects that truth in a simple and meaningful way.

The worship has been consistently excellent, not only in sound but in substance. I value that they place Scripture references under many of the songs. It reminds me of Colossians 3:16 which says, “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly, teaching and admonishing one another in all wisdom, singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, with thankfulness in your hearts to God.” They also read full passages of Scripture in their services, which should be normal but is rarely practiced by other churches. Hearing the whole counsel of God read aloud brings to mind 1 Timothy 4:13 which says, “Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, to teaching.”

I also appreciate what this church does not do. There is no merch, no sales, no pressure giving, and no marketing of personality. It feels refreshingly free of the commercial mindset that has become far too common with American churches. The communal atmosphere between services is warm, and that reflects Acts 2:42 which says, “And they devoted themselves to the apostles teaching and the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.”

There are a few areas where I would love to see growth. It is sometimes difficult to discern who the primary teacher or shepherd is. Since April, Brad has preached infrequently, and consistent pastoral direction helps a congregation in the long run. Scripture highlights the importance of clear shepherding. I Peter 5:2 says, “Shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you.”

I also wish there was a more robust avenue for men to study Scripture deeply, ask questions, and be equipped to defend the faith. I Peter 3:15 commands, “but in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy, always being prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you.” A structured apologetics or theology study would help the church obey this calling in a practical way.

Still, I have nothing negative to say about the culture or the motives of this church. Compared to many places I have attended, City Church International feels sincere, reverent, and free from self promotion. They keep the service simple and centered on Scripture, and for that I am grateful. I would gladly encourage others to visit and see for themselves.

Overall, I am thankful for my time here and pray that God continues to strengthen this church in truth, clarity, and discipleship. I walked in mid service right next to where the pastor was preaching. I was embarrassed but the love the congregation showed to me was unbelievable.  They didn't judge me based on appearance didn't care that I was right out of prison, in fact showed love to me even more. I found my church home. Great Church and body of believers. The community here really cares about each other, the worship is so sincere, and the preaching is solid. It’s really worth giving a try! Love City Church! So lucky to have found a comfortable place to be with God and fellow believers and followers. The worship is incredible and the Spirit is palpable here. Always a great message with sound, Biblical doctrine. This is an ethnically diverse and loving congregation and you will feel welcome here!

name: City Church Madison
reviewSummary:
This church is full of love. I can really feel God’s spirit too.
As for Pastor Tom, he’s a very loving and he truly loves God. His sermons are so inspiring.
Check out our church, you’ll feel at home and feel God’s presence, love and glory. A Bible believing church filled with people who are truly seeking Christ. Holy Spirit is welcomed here, and the worship is excellent. Great preaching and discipleship programs, too. Come as you are, and leave touched by God! I have been going to City Church for years. It’s a beautiful place that I can call home. When you walk in you definitely feel the presence of God and through the people. Pastor Tom is wonderful and delivers powerful inspirational messages to everyone. I hands down HIGHLY recommend this church. It’s AMAZING. I absolutely love City Church. My favorite place to go on Sunday; on Tuesday night also. They represent what a church family should be. "Come as you are" is their main saying, and they back it up. Worship is always good, and they never push for money. If you feel like giving, they have boxes in the back of the sanctuary where you can put money. Pastor Tom is an amazing man of God and has personally helped me through rough times in my life. I am very happy to go to a church that is so focused on building relationship with Jesus and focusing on the Holy Spirit. We have been regularly attending City Church for over a year and NEVER once have we been asked for money!! No basket is passed during the service. There is a box if anyone wants to give a tax deductible offering.  What we give is between us and God.
There is a very informative meeting where 2 of the 9 Pastors are very candid about the foundation of City Church as well as the vision. Pastor Joel Alberti reached out to me and welcomed my questions. He has been available to me each time I have requested.
Pastor Joel is kind and compassionate.  He is tenderhearted and knows the Word of God. He gives wise council!
Each of the Pastors have their area of specialty, but they all work together as a Team. There is always a Pastor on call for Emergency situations.
City Church is a great place to learn how the Word of God applies to our daily lives.
Where you attend Church is where you feed your Soul. Like where you eat to feed your body. We are full and satisfied at City Church.
Come see for yourself!
