Everyone was very welcoming and kind. I plan on returning Very friendly and welcoming.  Comfortable seating and facilities.  Outstanding worship band.  Excellent Bible message and fun delivery by the pastor.  I definitely plan to attend on my next visit to the City. Humble, kind, and gracious people. Leadership spends so much time and energy making sure all feel welcome and known. Everyone truly has the hearts were called to have as believers.

name: City Church of East Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the place to be on Sunday morning if you're a Christian (or even if you're not).  They still hold fast to their young, hip roots, even though they have a morning service instead of an evening one now.  However, it is a church full of sinners, so don't go if you're perfect or looking for perfect people.

In fact, some of them even disagree with each other about things.

If you're looking to experience Christ with other people who believe that he was a real person who actually was/is the son of God, then show up at 10am on Sunday morning.

Actually, show up at 9:50 so you don't walk in late and have everyone turn to stare at you.

EDIT: You don't have to be a Christian to show up. A safe place for those who want to explore Christianity for the first time, or grow in discipleship for long-time Christians. Unpretentious about themselves but serious about what they do. First time visit. Lovely and friendly atmosphere as the Church family gathering together should and will always be 😊 Pretty amazing place for a church office! Grass is mowed regularly and there's space to meet together. I'm a fan. Nice

name: City Church of Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. Great church in downtown Gainesville. If you're new to Gainesville, near UF or downtown this is a great church to check out!!
Chipper, Ryan, Jay & the crew are great folks. They are remodeling the building and it’s going to be an awesome facility when it completed. Everyone is very friendly and always makes you feel welcomed.  Your church community becomes your family and this church does that perfectly. The Lead Pastor is very genuine and down-to-earth.  If you ever need a community of followers of Jesus, this place will make you feel right at home! Completely Recommend!  5 stars! Nothing more needs to be said! My family and I began attending City last summer. Since that time we've become involved with small group, and a local outreach/service. I highly recommend this church for a number of reasons. Firstly, the people have a heart for this city and community, and they express it in very practical ways. The church actively engages with mercy and justice initiatives in the community, and its presence downtown is very intentional in order to be a place of refuge and hope. The Pastors are men of integrity and with deep knowledge and reverence of the Bible. There is clear and transparent governance, the voice of the congregation in decisions is welcomed, and the church body is invited in sharing their testimonies, using their talents, and supporting missions. A unique aspect of this church is weekly communion, which reminds us of the importance of this sacrament in remembering Christ's mission and love, and inviting others to participate. Amazing community of believers with wise, loving elders/pastors leading the sheep. On our first Sunday, and every time we've had people with us who are visiting for the first time, the lead pastor has come over to intentionally talk with us and actually want to get to know those who are new.
We've found so many people on Sunday and in our community group who are extremely loving, caring, mature in their faith, and genuinely in love with the Lord.
The church community also does an amazing job of looking for opportunities to get involved with loving downtown Gainesville, especially with those often marginalized or overlooked.

May the Lord continue to use City Church for His glory! Being involved in a City Church has been such a great experience from the community to the gospel-centered teaching to the social events. I've enjoyed walking alongside the people during this past year and growing in understanding of Christ's love and sacrifice for us.

name: City Church of Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a nice little church. Just what I was looking for. It's small so you can't hide in the messes. I mean like a lot of people. When the preacher introduced himself he also said my pronouns are he and him. That was a surprise to me which it's a good surprise but I'm glad he said it though it let people draw their lines of how they want to believe. It is getting a turn around visit from me again. There are no such thing as coincidences but after not being in church for 20 years it was right there it was spot on a coolant happened any better. Incredible church with amazing pastors. Can’t wait to go back with my family. I highly recommend this church if you are looking for a compassionate and grounded church home where truly caring for others is at the forefront of the mission and sermons. This is my church! I have been attending here for about three years. I love the pastoral staff and really enjoy the sermons presented by Pastors Bill and Brenna. They may not always say what I want to hear, but they always  say what I need to hear.
The people at this church are pretty much like the people anywhere. They are a bunch of sinners. Maybe that's why I feel like I fit right in. It is a diverse, inclusive and welcoming church. This church pretty much welcomes anybody. Kind of like Jesus does. I am in the anybody category. This church truly embraces being a "Christ follower", rather than the typical Christian we've come to know. They are a very welcoming and caring congregation. It's small but mighty. ". .small is the gate and narrow is the road to life and few will find it." If you are looking for a radically open and loving Church, try City Church of Long Beach. I was taken to City Church Long Beach by a friend of mine and I have never been happier at a church than this one! This church has such an amazing community of people always willing to reach out to one another. Theres so much love and peace in my heart after each sunday i spend here. If youre looking for a place to worship or possibly even just a community to support you I recommend coming to city church long beach.

name: City Church of Sacramento - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary: Wish I could give it 0 stars. People were not friendly at all and it’s very cliquish. Church was hot and steamy (No AC). If you’re a potential member the leadership is very pushy and even call you son and daughter. Once you decide this church isn’t for you magically you no longer exist. Get the sense it’s all about numbers. Very unfortunate. There’s a lot more but I’ll keep the rest to myself. I was about to give up on Christianity until I found City Church.  In the two years our family has been worshiping with City Church, we have felt loved and accepted.  Everyone is very kind and treats you like family! Hello, my name is Anna, my family and I want to move to the USA from Ukraine under the U4U program. I am looking for a sponsor and ask you to help me with this. Please contact me if you have the opportunity and desire to help with the move. Really enjoyed service. This is a very nice church. Praise and worship team was great. This is a church like no other  I love the Pastor and the First Lady this is my Church Family I am so blessed to have found this church.

name: City Church OTR - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: City Church is a safe haven for authentic worship, honest preaching, and community that feels like family. Proud and honored to call this place home. My kids have a blast at City Church OTR! My son asks everyday if we are going to church. I love that he has been learning about the love of Jesus and developing great friendships! I have also developed great friendships at CCOTR. The space is beautiful. The teaching and worship are great. City Church OTR is truly different. I feel like it's pretty rare to find a church that lives out their values and truly practices what they preach - in the case of City Church OTR, I've found something special. Friends at City Church really do feel like family. Amazing atmosphere and blend of old with new. Will try out again soon City Church was a space I came into with so many questions and reservations. It’s been a safe space for me and I couldn’t be more thankful for the community I’ve found. CCOTR is led by people willing to be honest about what God says, while inviting his presence and challenging hearts to experience who God is. So much tension is held in this space between truth and love, and the spirit and truth. You won’t find perfection here, but I hope you experience part of who God is.

name: City Church Saint Louis
reviewSummary: Wonderful church with dedicated and faithful leadership and genuine and inclusive members. A wonderful place to worship God. The people are just awesome!  I come for the sermons. They're always spot on. Really nice and welcoming church family Great Church ,I love this place!!! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: City Church San Francisco - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: I have been at this church for many years and seen it go through lots of changes while staying true to its mission.  The sermons, lectures and events are thought provoking and insightful. My children have enjoyed the youth and teen ministries. The outreach they are doing is inspiring and impactful.  I have grown as a Christian through different community groups, serving and ushering. I am so grateful for the love, support and teaching of this church. There is something for EVERYONE at City Church. I love this church.  I've been coming here for the past five years.   The pastors are amazing and show a lot of care to the community of San Francisco.  Grateful to have them as part of my life. “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.  For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.” Matthew 11 28-30. This is the message that makes this  church home for sinner and saint - alive with Jesus' message.  - A UCSF grad school member. Friends, I have read through the comments and I am blessed by the steadfastness of this church. It's amazing to hear a church maintaining its vision and mission in this changing world. There's hope for America Really appreciate how City Church is accepting of all demographics and how much they help the community.

name: City Church Savannah - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
I found my second home! The people here made me and my boys feel so welcomed. I have a son who has autism and they understand his needs. Not only that but my children are young kids and they loved them as their own.”, I could feel it. I love how all the kids from toddlers to teen age look so united. I’ve only had two visits and knew this would be my church from the first visit. I was even looking for the right church not only for me but also for children. I thank God for directing me to this one. Thank you to Pastor Jim, the worship team, and the congregation at City Church Savannah. We had a great time of worship and the message on Discipline and Gossip in the church reminded and sobered us on how God expects his church to handle these matters. We are very appreciative of our time at City Church. It was a highlight of our time visiting beautiful Savannah! Warm, wonderful people. Bible-based, honest teaching.  Pastor Jim brings the word in all its weight.  There is a well staffed childcare center, as well.
No feeling of being pressured at all, just welcome there.  Good free lattes and coffee.  Music is current, very relevant, but excessively loud... But they do have earplugs for those who need them. Great church, I mean like really great church. We were just visiting the area but we went twice and I’ll always have a place in my heart for this body. We are church planters by happen stance, we’ve seen healthy church and non healthy church, this one was solid. The spirit was alive, solid teaching, and it truly felt like a welcoming family.  I’ll always pray for the health and grounding for this church and it’s leadership. I can’t recommend it enough. The service is always spirit filled and backed by scripture and the volunteers are warm and welcoming. Thousands of lives in the community are being touched and they also support local missions who are making an impact for Jesus. The worship is contemporary and the message challenges you in your faith and walk with the lord. Great place!

name: City Church St. Petersburg
reviewSummary: My family and I have been attending City Church for about a year, and we have had a wonderful experience there. The people are friendly and welcoming. The preaching is faithful to the Word of God and also challenging. The worship is beautiful and engaging. It is always a joy and a delight to join City Church for worship! I first visited City Church in July 2017. I had just moved to St Pete and did not know anyone in the city. From the very first Sunday at City Church I knew this church would be my spot. If you are looking for a Jesus preaching, gospel centered church in the city for the city then this church is for you! A place to come experience gospel community, be known and welcomed no matter your background. I don't go to church every week but I am always welcomed and loved when I go to City Church. It's an amazing community where I don't feel like I need to be perfect but where I can be myself, broken. The music is lively and contemporary. Justin speaks in a down to earth way, and I always take something away from his messages. I recently moved back to St. Petersburg and I was looking for a church that was rooted in the Word, had a heart for community, and that was easy to make new friends. City Church has made my transition back seamless. It was easy to make new friends and to get plugged in. I have never felt so welcome by a church! Attended City Church while visiting our son who currently attends Eckerd College. Biblically grounded church, contemporary music, excellent teaching, confessional and has communion each week. This is just what he has been looking for. Justin delivers a great message and is very engaging.

name: City Church Tallahassee - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended the Christmas Family event this past Christmas and it was magical for all! My son had amazing time playing  in the bounce houses and going on a train ride. We enjoyed hot cocoa along with arts and crafts. we were even able to snap a picture with Santa!  Thank you City Chirch for hosting this event! My family and I have attended City Church for roughly 10 years, and never been disappointed. We love it, and so do our children. There are tons of ways to get involved and it’s been nothing short of amazing watching the congregation continue to grow at an astonishing rate. The music is phenomenal and Pastor Dean preaches directly from the Bible. He does not waver to what people  WANT to hear, should it oppose scripture; yet he is incredibly graceful & tactful in the way he represents Gods Word. City Church will remain our home for many years to come and we are exceedingly grateful to have started attending here. City Church is like no church I've ever been to. The moment you drive/walk on campus someone is there to greet you and welcome you. This is a Bible based, faith based church that makes no apologies for loving God and telling the world of His good news. They have a large children's service that kids are thriving in and learning about Jesus and God and the Bible. They're music ministries is uplifting and moving. They have a wonderful middle school youth fellowship that meets every Wednesday and am amazing college ministries that is reaching college campuses across the country. If you're looking for a home base church, check it out! Lots of musical talent and an excellent congregation. The pastor has tons of energy and passion - strong messages. I was moved by the love, spirit, and baptisms - my first visit was today. Jessie was very friendly at the guest support table. I look forward to getting “plugged in.” Thanks! For YEARS I have been hearing so many positive words about City Church, and finally decided to give it a try. We have spent the last 5 weeks at City Church. Thus far, the sermons feel relevant and relatable.

After attending Catholic Church for nearly 25 years, I decided I wanted our kids to experience something different within the Christian faith so that their journey to Christ could truly be theirs. City Church felt like "something different" yet still comfortable and close to home.

We arrived at the beginning of a series on politics, and I maybe cringed a little. Politics in church?! Is that even appropriate?! Glad we stuck around for it, even if it made me feel uncomfortable at times.  Found myself truly looking forward to Sundays!

I have so much respect for Pastor Dean Inserra's willingness to actually discuss the really difficult societal topics by tying everything back to the teachings of the bible with sensitively and without judgement. Looking forward to the next series through Christmas and Easter.

We definitely feel welcome here, plan to stick around, and eventually get involved. :-)

We really enjoy the music, too!

name: City Church Warner Robins - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church with a great pastor and music. You will not get bored in the worship service. Quality children’s programs along with first class nursery. The people are friendly and non judgmental. Truly anyone and everyone is welcome at City Church. My wife and I have been attending for almost 2 years. We will attend until the Lord calls us up.  The Pastor and the whole congregation are incredible people with deep integrity, ethics and faith. We are honored to be part of their family. If you would like to attend a church that is Bible oriented, come to see us! We have all you need and He is all you need. Thank you, Jesus. Its open for Two Sunday services, for "social distancing" ( with masks & gloves) & cheerful givers as helpers for seniors & a clean safe daycare for children ...
We love "Pastor Evor",whom is highly anointed!!! Pastor Evers as a great man of God you will experience his anointing through him

name: City Church Wilmington
reviewSummary: This is a great place to learn about God and worship him. The people here are warm and caring — we love how they welcome newcomers. The teaching is centered on God's Word and the community groups are a great way to really get to know others! We love City Church's heart for the city! Started going here just to hear a friend of mine speak,and now I still go there. I haven't joined yet... but it's the best church I've been to in years I've been going here now for 7 months I love it😍  Pastor Jason teachers just sound Doctrine comes from. God's word the Bible....Im at peace when I sit in the service. City Church is an open arms ministry ready to receive you. Bring your heart whether you are young or old, you will be uplifted. Gospel centered community. Great place to worship. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: City Church. Corpus Christi - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary:
There is something so special about this church. As a military family we tried out many churches and whole heartedly agreed we would grow in our knowledge of the Word here, but more importantly in how we walk out our faith. There are seasoned souls in this church and younger ones that are just as sweet and cared for. We pray weekly for our children/families. We love the strong community here and friendship. Today we spontaneously locked hands and prayed, and each Sunday there is a special prayer time. I can’t say enough how much we love this church. I began going to City Church while I was in college in 2002. Immediately I was welcomed in and ministered to. Friendships began to flourish there and City Church was my home church for 16 years. The teaching and worship is like no other church I’ve experienced. My husband and I got married in that church; the congregation helped us welcome our four children. The emphasis of community runs deep and brought us through some difficult and trying years. If you are looking for a place to worship, I highly recommend attending. You will not be disappointed and you will make long lasting friendships and relationships. I'm editing my review due to an email response I received from the pastor of the church. He is very pro-breastfeeding and will allow a mother to feed however and wherever she so chooses. That is wonderful! But apparently not the whole staff feels this way.

City Church's stance on nursing in public is disturbing. They have a nursing room, but it's not optional. They will physically remove your child from your breast and stop you from feeding your child and then tell your child directly that they can't have milk in the sanctuary. I delight in the worship of our Lord from the Call to Worship, Confession of Sin and Pardon,  Confession of our Faith, Worship in Psalms, Hymns and Spiritual Songs, in the Worship that comes in Giving of Tithes and Offerings, the Prayers for the People, the Preaching of God’s Word and the Sharing Together of the Lord’s Table!  What a wonderful way to celebrate the community we have in Christ and with one another. Come worship the Lord! They offer Bible Study Fellowship at this chruch. They have a beautiful and modern worship area. The space is great for study and praise. Wonderful community of women involved. They have servings hearts, full of love and compassion. So thankful this church has opened their doors to this opportunity. Check out BSF website for more details.

name: City Grace Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: A small and intimate Church that’s filled with warm, inviting people from different parts of America and the World. I found my experiences here pleasant and beneficial to my growth as a person and spiritual belief and understanding. Also, a cool pastor whose relatable to most and will take the time to speak and understand you. Worth the visit for those in NYC looking for a new Church and those who are visiting or just moved.👌🏾 City Grace Church is a very welcoming church.  The first time I entered the church the greeters at the door made me feel like a "Rock Star." The message is on point dealing with the issues of today from a biblical standpoint and the music is always enjoyable.  They make a huge effort in trying to serve NYC's diverse communities through love to whomever is willing to receive it. I've been at city grace for 9 years and I've seen many of it's ebs and flows, but the one thing that has remained consistent is the people are genuine and I've always felt welcomed. They truly preach and live out the gospel and I highly recommend you visit sometime. Small intimate church. Really get to know everyone. Members are very transient but the Pastor has been around since 2008. [object Object]

name: City Hill Church
reviewSummary: Faith, Community, family, welcoming, gospelizing, and outreach oriented. I have called this church home for almost 9 years and their umbrella ministry Truebridge Churches my home since I was a teen 16 years ago. The entire ministry family is well rounded and holds each other accountable and makes sure pastoral leadership is well-fed as well to keep them going. This is a loving church family that extends beyond the front doors into the community around them. They are missions oriented and has many ministry partners that it supports both in far reach countries where the gospel has not been heard and right here in the twin cities which is what drew us to attend in the first place. We love the people, we love their support for one another, and love their deep care for each person they meet. Their leadership really reflects the heart of the gospel. Super welcoming church! It's clear that everyone here loves Jesus and loves each other. They've got great diversity in the congregation. The worship every Sunday is amazing. And they also do extra worship nights called "refuel". They also have a great coffee shop. They're are all around just outstanding! Such an amazing church! I love City Hill! My wife and I went there and were welcomed with open arms from the first day. God brought into such a fantastic community that has become family to us here in MN! Definitely recommend checking it out! I love this church, they love others. I could say they have a great kids program or cool worship or friendly people, because that is all true...but I think the thing that matters is they love Jesus and know how to love others no matter where they are at in life or faith. This church has been the site of many supernatural God-experiences in my life. Many of my friends attend there. What a blessing.

name: City Hills Church
reviewSummary:
I grew up in church my entire life, and for a long time church was all I knew. When my dad had to close the church due to health issues, it left a deep gap in my heart. For years after that, I struggled to find a church that truly felt like home. I visited many churches, but I always felt like I was just passing through never fully settled, never fully rooted.

Finding City Hills Church was different. From the very beginning, there was a peace and confirmation in my spirit that this was where God was leading me. The pastors preach the truth of God’s Word straight from the Bible, with clarity, love, and boldness. It’s not watered down, and it’s not about opinions it’s about Jesus.

The pastors’ hearts, along with the pastor’s wife, are genuine, humble, and deeply caring. You can tell they truly love God and His people. There is authenticity here, and that has meant everything to me after such a long season of searching.

Now, I’m not only attending I’m serving, growing, and being stretched in the best way. This church has helped restore my faith, strengthen my walk with God, and remind me why church matters so much.

City Hills isn’t just a church I attend it’s a place God used to bring healing, direction, and a renewed sense of purpose back into my life. I’m so grateful to call this my church home. City Hills is a GREAT church. Spirit filled and biblically founded. Pastor Mitch delivers The Word of God with passion and in an applicable way. The worship is united from the front row to the back and side to side. You can really feel the presence of God in that place. This is the type of church you want your kids to be raised in and the kind of church your own faith can grow with. My wife and I recently made the (not so far) move from San Antonio and loved our local church to Stone Oak but wanted to find something a bit closer to our new home. We tried several local churches and instantly found home when we walked in the doors of City Hills. Mitch, Brandy, and team made us feel so welcomed and went over and beyond to make sure we felt at home. It's so important to find a church that you feel at home with and I definitely recommend trying City Hills. I'm glad we found our new church home. I LOVE City Hills.  The pastors are AMAZING and the staff goes above and beyond!   We have found our family! The BEST church in the hill country! Immediately felt at home from the moment I walked through the doors. You won’t regret coming! See you on Sunday! ❤️❤️

name: City Hope Church - Malbis - Daphne Campus
reviewSummary: Almost 2 year's now since I have called this church my home. Just came back from my 1st Mission Trip with 9 other Brother's and Sisters in Christ. Words cannot describe or define the feelings I now have for this church! Amazing pastors and staff. Amazing church family indeed!!! I didn't know anyone when I 1st started here and still only a few now but they are all family now. Please, just come and see for yourself, by yourself if you have too but know by yourself will not always be for long. That's FACTS !!! 😃 WORST CHURCH EVER! My parents are getting treated like they are roaches and the others don't talk to each other and the kids room is the worst, and when a baby cries, they kicked you out! They boss ya around and it was chaotic, never returning again 😤 What I love about City of Hope is the Praise and Worship Team and the music. The worship experience is uplifting and inspiring. Really Nice Church Came For Youth Night and I immediately felt very extremely welcome by everyone This Church reminds me of when Moses came down from the mountain and saw his people sining and partying all the time. They don't help people like they say they do without a huge check list to help when someone financially needs it, but they will take your money! I know from personal experience. Also you can't go up to the alter to pray or worship during their worship, and the Bible says his house is a house of prayer, and Jesus was upset with selling in the church, so biblically this Church is a worldly Church, and I rather be a part of a church that follows God's laws and his ways not the world. The Bible says to not be of the world and try to follow God because them you are Luke warm and he won't accept that. So this Church is all about taking your money and entertainment and worldly. A little positivity there are some really nice and great people that go here that have really good hearts, but they are being mislead unfortunately.  Find a Church that gets you closer to God not Entertain you to draw you in the church to grow and be about money and entertainment, then you will experience how powerful God is and see him move in a mighty way in your life. God Bless!

name: City Hope Church - Mobile - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary:
Audio is horrible there. Too loud so that it is all flat under high gain, and the mix is horrible - drums and bass drown out the rest, can't hear the acoustic guitar but the guy playing it doesn't appear to know how to play anyways. They play each song for way, way, way, way, way too long and folks give up in it, put their hands down and just stand there waiting.

They have the smokey atmosphere so they copied the others on this.

The Sunday 11am service is either a simulcast or re-play, so no one in the sanctuary is giving the message.

The message was so-so, lots of scripture referenced, but a lot of filler.

Plenty of free parking.

The young Asian guy at the desk in the lobby must be on the spectrum because I tried to ask him a simple question and he just looked at me, came around the table and put his hand in my face because I guess he wanted me to shake his hand - all with a blank look on his face. He never said 'Hi' or 'can I help you?'. Being here I can be myself and not feel judged. I trust believe this church has God's word at the very heart and I can't imagine my life without this church. Everyone is so welcoming and passionate and I always feel at home. I have grown tremendously spiritually since I've been here and I can't wait to continue growing. At city hope it's all about Jesus . After years of going to different churches  I have found a campus that is inclusive, in no way bigoted, positive,  caring and offering some of the best day-to-day human advice substantiated by the truth of The Bible. Kindness and compassion fill the air.  The church doctrine is simple; truth,  not rules and bylaws supported through human interpretation. Instead here the truth is Jesus,  the way is His love. We are a congregation focused by the pastors to praise our Lord and make a difference.

Great music, inspired pastors, involved community living Gods way for us. Charged with bringing light to the world...please trust me and check in to what's happening here I was blessed to meet a group of missionaries today that blessed my life with the love of God as they were truly the hands and feet of Jesus.  Louisiana is in a state of turmoil and you guys came to meet the needs of many!!!  Nothing is meaningless!!!!!  I will always remember your church in my prayers!  Thank you for helping in our time of great need!!! I have been attending this church for over 7 years. It is a very friendly, upbeat, welcoming place! The pastors love God and love people! Most importantly the teaching is from the Word of God!

name: City House Church
reviewSummary:
AWESOME CHUCH. A real family in the city. Honestly, one of the best preachers I’ve heard in a long time. He is spot on with his accuracy of the Bible and explains it to you in layman’s terms. Extremely welcoming group of people from the first day I met them. I wholeheartedly suggest people visit, you will not be disappointed! So thankful for this Church family. These guys are the real deal. Sometimes you wonder if there are normal people who are really trying to follow Jesus, Love people and not be weird about it. I’m so glad to have a place like CityHouse to invite my Milwaukee friends to. A friendly church that has practical messages and works to take care of the surrounding city. Their stated mission of "reconciliation" is about becoming closer to both God and other people, which I think is an incredibly important message for our city. We love city house church!
We had tried a few in the area before this one and we continued coming after that. Pastors  Mike and Tiffany are the real deal! The church has a real community first feel.

name: City Life Church
reviewSummary:
This is a great church supported by caring church members.
I learned a lot from the English Conversation Club. The classes were very helpful to me.
Stacey is kind, and the wonderful volunteers do a great job leading the English classes. I love this place. I found a true family who accept and love me unconditionally. With that I am becoming who God wants me to be.
The Kid City remodel is near completion. It's an awesome way to give to the children as they connect with God. Love this Church Pastor Adam and Pastor Kristy cares a lot..great service, great sermons and skits. A lot community activities...great fellowship and music. They help out community a lot. Come as you are Mix community of People are friendly always greeted and welcomed. A very diverse church that challenges me to surround myself with people who are different from me in many areas. They make the gospel simple and are focused on intentional loving and caring for the low income population that is in the neighborhoods surrounding them. Love this place. This is my church home for life!! They are so warm and kind. They welcome anyone in and try to decipal others to be the hands and feet of Jesus!! We are the church together and city life makes you feel that unity!!

name: City Life Church
reviewSummary: City Life Church has sound biblical teaching with a warm and friendly atmosphere! My husband and I started attending two years ago and were struck by the number of people who came up to us and introduced themselves. After that, we never really left! There are “Life Group” gatherings available during the week, all-church classes a couple of times of year, men’s and women’s retreats, and many opportunities to connect with other believers through Bible study and social events. Young or old, exploring faith or looking to deepen your faith in God, City Life Church is for you! Found Jesus at this church. I got married, moved, now attend a church closer to home. If you want to learn The Way make your way to City Life. God is good. I love our pastor Dave he is a great guy and always makes scripture interesting. Also, it was an awesome worship band. You really need to check it out... praise God Lovely people here. Thank God I stopped by. If God wasn't with at least some of us I would have left. God is love. Not everyone has God though. This place is decent from what I have witnessed. The Pastors name is Dave. I recently started coming. City Life has been such a saving grace for me the past 7 years! The people love well and care deeply. I married the love of my life in the church May 2014, and we dedicated our daughter May 2016. We have moved far south but still make the trip to attend Sunday service when we can!

name: City Life Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church with great God-centered worship and preaching! The pastors are very nice and welcoming as well as spiritually sound. They also have a great youth ministry and friendly volunteers so everyone can feel welcome no matter their age. I went to this church during a trip to Houston and absolutely loved it! We felt very welcome and at home. Definitely recommend! Today was my 3rd visit to City Life Church.
I am new in pursuing a relationship with God. I was raised in the church but never practiced. I belong to a very traditional Lutheran Church and I have an extremely hard time getting into the messages unless something really resonates with me. My first visit to City Life was life changing. First off, the atmosphere is so welcoming and there is so much diversity, it just feels like home. The pastor was not preaching that day but the gentleman who gave the message spoke about Leah and I truly resonated with that. After the service I went to the front and weeped to one of the women and she prayed over me. My life has never been the same since I left that day. I still struggle with my relationship with God but I actually understand the Bible now. God is working through me because of City Life church. I highly recommend this church. I get excited after every service for the next week. Honestly, the messages are so good now — I can’t wait to see how the actual pastor is. I plan to become a member in due time. Thank you, City Life. I had the opportunity to visit this church 2 weeks ago when I traveled to Houston and I can honestly say they were extremely condescending and disrespectful. They made me feel very unwelcome and uncomfortable. I opened up to one of the pastors about a personal life challenge I was facing and he intentionally had other leaders of the church belittle me because of it. I will never visit again and I do not recommend anyone else visit this church either. I loveeeeee this place. This is definitely a spirit lead and scripture based church!
I believe this is a place you can grow in Christ & experience the goodness of God and His community! I’ve been attending this church for a while now, and it truly feels like home. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, the messages are always meaningful and grounded in scripture, and the sense of community is something special. The worship is powerful, the leadership is authentic, and there’s a genuine heart for serving others. Whether you’re new to faith or have been walking with God for years, this church is a place where you can grow, connect, and feel encouraged. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to belong!

Let me know if you want to make it more personal or tailored to a specific church!

name: City Life Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to City Life Church while visiting nyc! Everyone here was very welcoming and the worship was a great experience. We read through John and the message was based explicitly on the Word. I am so glad I got to come to a church that was led by the Bible and went into depth of its teachings. Hope to come again soon! :) I love this church,  it's Pastors and especially the congregation/community it is built around. I have been loved by these people and grown so much that I know, only God could have provided this peaceful oasis. I have passed though many churches over the years. Some I have very fond memories of, and others.....  I have been part of this church body for about ten years. Great leaders who are not distant, and warm people. Casual and not stuffy but on target with its Bible teaching. A good mix of old and young people. An English and a Spanish service is held at the same time in different parts of the building. Occasionally they all get together for a special service. Great people who are very accepting. Everyone is super welcoming, and the teachings are centered on the Bible. Their sermons have definitely resonated with me, and I know people love God and they love Jesus here. I feel at home! City Life Church is our home away from home. We love our Church family and we look forward to worshipping with them on Sundays. The Pastor is a wonderful man who genuinely cares for those around him. If you're looking for a friendly Church where both children, and adults will learn Biblical truths, come visit City Life. We look forward to meeting you there.

The Reyes family.

name: City Life Church Downtown Fort Worth - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary: What a wonderful experience going to city at life Church. My wife and I have enjoyed every service we’ve been to so far. The pastor seems very genuine and truly a man of God. The praise and worship team is off the wall very anointed and have a heart for the Lord. I would say if you’re looking for a good church to go to city life would be wanting to get involved with small enough that you’re not just a number but large enough to affect the world. City Life Church is an authentic place where people love God and each other. My life has been forever changed since coming here! Pastor Tim is the best pastor in Fort Worth! You will be welcomed with open arms and genuine friendship. The shortest review would be that City Life is a contemporary Bible based Jesus seeking church. But it is so much more than that. This is where my little family has found true church community. This is not a place where you blend into the background and go unnoticed. The people of City Life will genuinely and  actively seek to meet you and get to know you. There is a strong focus on children’s ministry and I have seen huge growth in my children and their knowledge about Jesus. The music is modern and the musicians and singers radiate their passion for the Lord through every beat of every song. The message is relevant, honest and straight from God’s Word. A year later this is a home. A place and community that we love and look forward to reuniting with all week long. I have been attending City Life Church since 2016.  It’s a small, Bible-based church where attendees experience the love of Jesus and spirit-filled worship.  And Pastor Tim is the finest pastor in the city of Fort Worth!  At City Life Church, we love God and love making Jesus known! As a new resident in Fort Worth, I was eager to find a church in downtown to not only strengthen my relationship with Christ but also to meet new people and build friendships. City Life has done that and more! Through City Life's refreshing Sunday services, volunteering opportunities, and Social & Growth Connect groups, I feel right at home in Fort Worth!

name: City Life Church San Francisco - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
As a visitor from out of town, it was lovely to find a local ARC church to attend.  We don't normally attend church in the urban setting, and we were so pleased to see the church was right in the middle the city, shining the light of Jesus right in the middle of it all.  The worship was spirit-filled and encouraging.  We came during a series highlighting the reality of the Holy Spirit and how to walk with Him daily.  The sermon on Acts 10 was very good (by Pastor David - youth pastor).  As a believer for over 20 years, I was fed, encouraged and learned new things from his sermon.  Also, the church was very welcomimg to all kinds of people, and I think it would be a great place for a "brand new to church" person as well as a seasoned believer.  God Bless! I really enjoyed myself when I came to visit City Life Church. I felt welcomed right before I came inside, it has been a long time since I been here. I am looking forward to becoming a member (again). I want to stay connected to God and I believe City Life Church San Francisco is the place! Really good service, worship, atmosphere, word of God.
No parking, you have to park on street or Lower’s…
Very nice church, I love the environment and people.
One bad thing is the SMOKE MACHINE during the worship! Terrible smoke! Really bad, every time I feel sick. Most of the time I prefer watch from home cause of it.
They have simultaneous translations for Spanish and Portuguese.
There’s a kids room, my wife wanted to come inside with my daughter and the lady in charge told her that’s not allowed, REALLY? And my daughter didn’t went to the kids room alone. 😮
Water and coffee in the lobby. Great church community. The pastor explains the Bible in a way people understand and the members support each other. If you want a place where people care about you, visit this church. A place where you will be linked towards building a relationship with God.  Super diverse.  They have two services one at 9am and 11am.  They have Spanish and Portuguese translation available.  Plenty of options to join different groups.  And a top notch worship team that will get you feeling the music and off your feet. Love this place.

name: City Life Church, San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I walked about five miles from downtown San Diego to attend a service there when I was in a pretty unfortunate situation.  Pastor greeted me right after service and made me feel accepted.  They let me choose a Bible and offered me food when I had nothing to eat and even gave me bus fare so I didn't have to walk all the way back to downtown San Diego.  I was sad to leave but God was calling me elsewhere. I started to visit this church in July and I still going because I liked and feel comfortable. People from the church made you feel like home! ⛪️ 🏡 🤍 This church is the most friendlyest church you ll ever been too City Life Church cares for the community. They love people. I love the people at this church and how authentic they are!  They love their community and God!

name: City Lift Church - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
2/22/26--A day or two ago I started to feel something missing inside me. I needed to be around believers. I needed church. The Bible says, “Let us not give up meeting together… but encouraging one another” (Hebrews 10:25). My soul was saying, go find your people.

So yesterday I searched for churches near me. I found one… but when I checked their beliefs, it was more like a we made God to our liking and image and not the other way around a  club with a cross decoration. I was looking for a Bible-believing church, not a “feel good and go home” place.
I prayed: “Lord, lead me.”
Because the Word is clear: “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me” (John 14:6).

Then I found City Church. I went straight to the statement of faith like a spiritual detective 🕵️‍♀️ — if it doesn’t say salvation through Jesus alone by faith alone, I keep scrolling. But this one… this one was solid. I said, maybe this is it.

Just because I am in Florida does not mean I will visit any church. Even on vacation my faith travels with me 😄.

I woke up super early (that is already a miracle — resurrection power level). I took a Lyft and went. But before that… my husband and I had an argument about his brother, the professional, certified, gold-medal pathological liar. Yes, I arrived at church holy on the outside and boiling on the inside. I even said, “Get me a flight back to New England. I am homesick. Florida is not my place!” yes, I don't like Florida , there , I said it!

So there I was — mad, dramatic, and in a Lyft — very spiritual moment.

But when I arrived, a kind gentleman greeted me, and I smelled coffee and pastries… and suddenly my sanctification process started ☕🥐. I was still fuming inside, believe me , I wanted to talk to noone. I made the conversation with that gentleman short and told him look, I am a believer, It is okay! I wanted to be alone , he led me to the sanctuary and I sat there writing in my journal, in my mind with my thoughts and prayers.

Truth to be told, People were so friendly. The worship was beautiful. And the message — wow.
Not many churches preach in a way that challenges you. This one went deep into Scripture, even into the book of Revelation (yes — the book many churches treat like it is classified information).

“He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches” (Revelation 2:7).

The message reminded us that we must share our faith. And I felt convicted — in a good way. Because honestly, I have been quiet.
But “we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard” (Acts 4:20).

So here I am sharing with you:

Jesus is salvation.
Only through Him we receive eternal life.
“And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son” (1 John 5:11-12).

There is a New Jerusalem prepared for those who belong to Him (Revelation 21). That is our real home — not Florida, not New England 😄. I have to remind myself of this.

Any other way leads to eternal separation from God. The Bible says it with love and truth, and real love tells the truth.

So now you know.
The choice is yours.

As for me — I arrived angry, homesick, and dramatic… and I left with coffee in my hand, peace in my heart, and my boarding pass to heaven already confirmed ✈️.

“How lovely is Your dwelling place, Lord Almighty… Blessed are those who dwell in Your house” (Psalm 84:1-4).

This building used to be a library they rent there, so for those complaining about not being handicapped friendly I did see a ramp a  long ramp that leads to the entrance on the side of parking lot.
What I can tell you based on Sunday morning preaching , I would def visit again. My experience at City Lift Church has been phenomenal so far. Coming from an Organizational leadership perspective everything from the coffee station the times, the functionality, the structure, the delivery, and the communication has been very intentional. I don’t feel judged or pressured, I feel loved and accepted. City lift Church is welcoming and aesthetically pleasing.

The service is meaningful, powerful, uplifting, and engaging. The pastor has a way of connecting with all walks of life and making you feel seen and heard. The First Lady is always joyful, expresses gratitude, patient, and calm. Her harmonic tone brings ease yet pulls you in as she shares whether it’s a word from the Bible or a testimony.She’s a bright spot in an anyone’s day. The two together is dynamic you can see the hard work and hustle, but also see the softness and care for others. You can see their heart through their actions, their words and their presence.

And last, but not least my kids absolutely love it from the first day they stepped foot in the doors. The lessons are meaningful and fun, and it’s always great to discuss after church and always excited to go the next time they’re with Mommy. 10/10 experience! This is such a great church where the theology is sound and Pastor Matt teaches with clarity and conviction. The worship team truly creates an atmosphere that invites the presence of Jesus into the room.

And the community, just wow. We’re not meant to do life alone, and being part of this church is a beautiful reminder that God is in the “together” moments.

I’m so grateful for Pastor Matt and Pastor Alyssa and their obedience to God in creating a Christ-centered space for the people of South Florida.

If you haven’t visited yet, come join us at ArtServe at 10:30am! In the past, I was searching for a small church close to home. From the very first time I visited, I felt truly welcomed. That feeling stayed with me, and before I knew it, this became a place I can call my own church.
I’ve already started serving, and even though it has only been one month, it honestly feels like I’ve been here for a whole year. The love, connection, and sense of belonging have been unbelievable.
The pastor is truly inspiring, delivering messages that are both powerful and easy to understand. You can feel the genuine care and passion for the people and the community, which makes a big difference.
One thing I really appreciate is how comfortable and relaxed the atmosphere is—you don’t have to stress about what to wear, you can just come as you are. I love it here! The people are always so welcoming & kind. I’ve never felt pressured to serve God or participate but the pastors allow it come from your heart. Pastors are family orientated and really about the people. Worship is great and the preaching is biblical.

name: City Light Baptist Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a new church that has a vision to impact Irvine with the gospel of Jesus. They are a healthy and vibrant church with great servant leaders. Pastor Kim is a great pastor and spiritual leader. I’m glad I was able to visit during the early weeks of this ministry. Come and see what God is doing here. My son really enjoyed the children’s class. Genuine biblical teaching and pastoral heart

I'm so grateful to have found City Light Baptist Church in Irvine. Pastor James Kim is truly remarkable - you can clearly see that the Holy Spirit is working through him in his ministry. He is someone who has genuinely heeded the call of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ to preach and teach others here in Orange County about who the Lord Jesus is.

What I find most refreshing about this church is the commitment to solid, biblical preaching and teaching of the Holy Scriptures. In a time when many churches focus on "hyping up" congregations with emotional speeches rather than sound doctrine, City Light Baptist Church stands apart with authentic, Christ-centered messages that truly feed your soul.

On top of all that, the people are nice too! In fact, I would say they're the family away from home.

If you're looking for a place where you can grow closer to the Lord through faithful biblical teaching and genuine pastoral care, I wholeheartedly recommend visiting City Light Baptist Church. This is a church where God's Word is honored and His people are shepherded well. Great church! Love this area, and the people!! What a blessing to worship in this church! The preaching is always inspiring and thought-provoking, with a focus on biblical teaching and practical application. Pastor James is genuine, compassionate and truly cares about the well-being of his flock. I highly recommend City Light Baptist Church to anyone looking for a spiritual home where they can grow in their faith, connect with others, and serve the Lord. City Light Baptist Church is a wonderful church to be at. Especially in Irvine, where it is in need of a SOUND DOCTRINE, Pastor James Kim does a great job organizing the church and spreading the GOOD NEWS. Salvation is through faith only, no amount of works can get save you from eternal damnation and Pastor James DOESN'T COMPROMISE on any doctrinal flaws. Not only that, this church seems to be deeply caring for each member, work in unity, and is motivated to grow in Christ. Highly recommend to those who are seeking deeply for the sound truth.

name: City Light Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for about three months now, and it has truly been life-changing. A friend from work invited me to a Friends Night service on a Saturday at 5 PM, and from that moment, I knew I had found something special. I’d been searching for a church home for a long time. I’m originally from California, where I attended La Patria Church in Rancho, and I loved it. After moving to Vegas three years ago, this is the first church I’ve consistently attended—and I am so grateful I did.

This church brings so much peace, clarity, and love. The worship team is incredible—I’ve even added their songs to my Spotify because they bless me so much! Pastor Jabin is an amazing pastor who speaks with genuine love, care, and purpose. Through his messages, I’ve been able to understand and learn more about God and Jesus in a deeper way.

I also want to thank the church for supporting families in need during the holidays and for taking such good care of your community. And Amen to NOT serving coffee—because we need both hands lifted high in worship!

Parking and seating have never been an issue, and everyone is always so kind and helpful.

I’m truly blessed to have found this beautiful church. I attended City Light Church for the first time today, and I just got back, and absolutely loved it. The service was powerful, and today’s message really resonated especially the focus on winning the battle within, “word wars,” choosing your source, and being transformed by renewing your mind. I appreciated the reminder that God’s will is revealed through a renewed mind and intentional choices to follow Him. The worship was meaningful, the atmosphere was welcoming, and the teaching and delivery by Pastor Jabin Chavez was both practical and deeply spiritual with amazing delivery. Huge thanks to my friend Carissa for inviting me, such a great experience, and I’m excited to come back! Our family have attended for 5 years now.
How do we know the kids ministry is the best? Our kids have never been so excited to go to church.

Pastor Jabin speaks truth, teaches the Bible, and remains relatable.

Staff are all fantastic, volunteers are great.

We love City Light! 6-20-26 4:13. M so very disappointed in this church! I've been praying for 5 years to get my husband to attend church with me not to just drop me off! Finally I heard such great things about this church. My husband was so sure if he wore shorts the church would not let him in. I told him God didn't care what you wear just come and hear His Word
We felt so welcome with all the signs welcoming us and encouraging us to smile. I thought finally my husband would experience a true Christa church experience. When we went to go to the auditorium he was informed he could not enter with his coke. But they would give him a bottle of water! He uses his coke to help him not choke when he coughs. I could not believe they said he could not enter I had my container of water. Which they allowed me to take in. I just want to cry. I cannot believe they denied him entrance. We left of course I pray it won't take me another 50 years to go to church. You all need to read Jesus words. Love. Welcome. All A Powerful House of Worship — Grateful for the Invite! 💌

I was invited to City Light Church by a good friend, and from the moment I walked in, I immediately felt the presence of God 😭 The worship music is powerful and anointed—every song lifts your spirit and ushers in the Holy Spirit in such a beautiful way. The sermons are filled with truth, wisdom, and real-life application that deeply speaks to your soul 💗

One of the highlights for me has been the amazing prayer team! 🔥 They are Spirit-led, compassionate, and truly stand in agreement with you in faith. I left feeling encouraged, refreshed, and more connected to the Lord than ever before.

If you're looking for a church that is alive, grounded in the Word, and overflowing with love and purpose—City Light is it! 🙌

“For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.” — Matthew 18:20 📖

name: City of Angels International Christian Church - Inland Empire Region - Riverside (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I had to post this to balance out that one star the other reveiwer put. First off, the church is called the city of angels international church. Nowhere in it does it contain the word "empire," that is just the region it is in. name: City of Grace, Phoenix Campus - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been a member of this church for over 20 years, and it has truly been one of the greatest blessings in my life. All of the pastors are incredibly authentic, caring, and genuinely love people. Their faith is evident not only in what they teach, but in how they live and serve others. Terry and Judith Crist’s leadership sets a genuine and spirit filled tone across the entire culture of the church.

From the moment you walk through the doors, you are welcomed with warmth and kindness. The atmosphere is inviting, encouraging, and makes people feel like they belong, regardless of where they are in their faith journey.

What stands out most is City of Grace’s unwavering commitment to serving the community. Supporting and caring for others is not just something that is talked about from the stage—it is reflected in the actions of the church members, staff, and leadership. There is a genuine alignment between the church’s mission and the way it lives out that mission every day.

After more than two decades, I can confidently say that this is a church that loves God, loves people, and strives to make a meaningful impact in the community. I am grateful to call it my home. Amazing graduation ceremony for AZ School for the Arts. Acoustics are great in this house of worship! There is some good preaching. But i recently tried to see a pastor but they wouldnt help me they only asked about me and my member status about a Church i used to go to i call my home Church. And the lady on the phone when i showed up asked if i had an appointment the call got disconnected they didnt answer again. I even called a first time and they said the pastors were busy. I said i was a minister then their attitude changed for the better as if i was important.  they left me outside the Church standing in the heat when they called back i let the pastor know why that i need another man of God to talk to it was something that was needed for my spiritual health and faith and only the things a man struggles with especially being a Christian man. I rebuked the pastor and hung up. I just hope they repent not just for what happened with me but to have consideration as a Church of Christ  to assist and minister to the next man that needs help. We are supposed to heal the world and be there for those in need as The Lord was for us. I updated my review there response is a lie a pastor called me on the phone from the Church and why aint there no pastors but there was people at the Church. Repent in The Name of Jesus The lady at the office said they were busy I used to go to the Mesa location, but then they moved to the Phoenix location and I was trying to find one closer to me, but no matter where I tried it didn’t feel like I was home. City of Grace feels like home I don’t care how far this church is from me I will find away because this is where I wanna go with my kid if you wanna know the true meaning of the gospel, this is where they preach it it will become your home away from home Pastor Terry brings the Word on the reg in this blessed place. Come as you are!

name: City of Lights Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming and approachable church environment. Focuses on the right things and doesn’t feel like a performance or a flashy motivational seminar. Gets involved with the neighborhood and makes being like Jesus the main focus. Not the true true, apostolic Church that the Lord stated in the Gospel. For he gave Peter the Church and through apostolic succession is the Catholic Church! I received a warm welcome! I saw a multi * diverse & generational group of people. Pastor * Jon Ownes gave a sermon anyone can relate too, in this day & times! Know each day is new & with God all things are possible! A Happy Mother's Day Farwell an gifts awaited those woman !  One light @ a time * together we can all shine!!!! I encourage near or far to visit. I shall return * God Bless and Thank you!! Great group of “Christ”ians seeking after the Lord, without pretense, with the shared goal of doing so in spirit and in truth. Also, a very welcoming, vibrant, and diverse congregation. Lastly, great teaching, not verse by verse, but nevertheless, sincere and poignant. Love this church family. Genuinely a welcoming and diverse atmosphere.

name: City Of Refuge Christian Church
reviewSummary: Come and let your soul be blessed! No judgement at all just love! Come as a visitor, leave as family! We love you with the love of Christ. Great fish fry! Very friendly people! Great church and Great Pastor!!! Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: City On A Hill Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
I also, attended the Heritage House. Sept. 10. 2021 was when I showed up. I wouldn't even saumy I had a strong program. I screwed up, alot. But the Grace of God was applied. I completed with a heart that was changed. Seeking the Kingdom First! God is faithful!! 3.5 years later, I'm married, and have been for over a year, and now just bought my first home with my wife, closing Monday. FEBRUARY 10TH. While people are not perfect, God is! Heritage House prepared me, exactly for where I'm at now! City on a Hill is a wonderful church, with sound doctrine that comes out of that pulpit!! The Blood of Christ, Repentance, and baptism of the Holy Ghost! Biblical Sound Truth! If you give God an inch of your life, not only will he take a Mile, but begin to prepare you for the life long course, or race, with endurance, remaining in living in and expressing the fruits of the spirit! Pastor Billy is a wonderful Pastor, with a vision to see many wrecked young men, to come to Christ and be restored, with offering that opportunity! I left what was my home in Missouri, and now, never even considere going back, other than visiting my mother's Grave site, and seeing my niece. Christmas to be exact!! I tried everything. Heritage House is THAT PLATFORM, if you're at the end of yourself and ready for change!! Much Love, Blake Abernathy!! I absolutely love this church. I feel welcomed every time I walk in the doors. They're involved with the homeless community outreach and recovery. Praise God for this church and his spirit for leading and guiding them. City on a Hill is an amazing church where you can worship and be welcomed into the family of God! There are many opportunities to grow as a believer, be discipled, and carry out the great commission through outreach to our city and beyond! I've honestly never been inside this church. But I can say that the exterior is beautiful now. I've lived by here my whole life, and this place used to be sooo ugly. Outside paint is beautiful as you can see from the pictures I uploaded, very inviting! They have nice looking signs and banners that have the service times (see photo).The parking lot has also been nicely repaved. There's also on street parking and in the ally way behind it. There are several entrances, so it looks wheelchair assessable. I might check it out sometime. It's on Mozart right behind the "White" restaurant that sells those famous sliders. I'm with Cliff and Dani. Great programs you offer for locals but...
The Sunday service is WAY TOO LOUD! Starts around 9/10 and goes until 3ish EVERY SUNDAY!   Can't enjoy a nice peaceful morning outside in my own backyard for my 1 of 2 days I have to relax from the work week.  Overkill.
We've called and been told it's a rare occasion but the people who LIVE around you can say otherwise.
PLEASE be considerate of those living around you.

name: City Park Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
After months of searching, my husband and I feel so blessed to find our home at City Park Church. The Lord is moving and doing great things! Sweetest people, good coffee, but best of all is hearing the Word of God spoken so powerfully every week. Praise God for this church and the community we have at CPC🙌🫶 Love the community and the worship! Everybody is so welcoming and nice! The pastor is very biblically accurate and passionate about the word of God! For sure coming back! God's presence is very strong. Teaching from the Bible. No big band. Not all of the hype like some of the other big churches in Fort Collins. Really enjoyed the people very nice and friendly. My bride and I have found a church home. Great Service, Really appreciate the parking space and Access for all those with disability A couple years ago I came to ICC because I needed a church that provided a hearty Sunday message as well as guys who I could call brothers who would keep me accountable in life's adventures. Since I've been at ICC I have seen how this community has been used by God to influence nearly every aspect of my life in some form or fashion. I also found guys here who have held me accountable wherever I need it in life. The messages on Sunday will leave those with a receptive heart challenged with healthy conviction and encouraged to fear and seek our awesome God. Our lead Pastor is like a humble surgeon who God has used countless times to clean out my heart when I grow calloused from life or when I act like a Jonah. This community has been a tremendous blessing for me when I've been at life's lows. The relationships are genuine and real. You won't have to feel like the only one struggling with life or feel like you have to go through struggles alone. If you choose to get plugged in you will find brothers and sisters of all ages who can encourage, pray, pass along wisdom and offer accountability.

God has really blessed me with countless friends from this community that I can share life and have adventures with. What's kinda cool is how a large group of us can hang out somewhere here in Fort Collins when we all look like we have nothing in common. Only God could bring us together. Yet another reason why this church is such a huge part of my life and could be a huge part of yours. Can't say enough good stuff about this Church!

name: City Point Church - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: The people here never let you walk out without having made you feel totally welcome and a part of their church family. The sermons are awesome. Very poignant and right on target for today's society!! This is a church for those that don't feel comfortable going to church. It wouldm't take them long to feel right at home! I felt at home the moment I walked through the doors! The workship music is amazing, the children’s ministry is great that all three of our boys get excited for Sundays. We have built some amazing relationships. Can’t say enough about the pastors and how down to earth they are! Their messages are easy to understand, challenges me to grow with engaging stories, and absolutely Biblically sound. Great coffee lovin’ bunch! Can’t ask for more! I love this church, but beyond that I love this congregations mentality. This is a group of people that truly support our mission to LOVE, SERVE, and MULTIPLY, and also support the ideology that saved people serve people. I love that this church isn’t a stagnant group of Christians, but rather the start of an impactful movement for the kingdom. Amazing worship music and sermons always relevant. Cant say enough good things about this church!! Love this church! Energizing and heartfelt worship. And sermons that feed the soul.

name: City Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
City Reach Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my home church. Sunday service and worship is always amazing and good for the spirit. They have tons of Bible study groups, too. More importantly, everyone here is so genuine, caring, and friendly. Especially the Dream Team! Great experience. Feeling welcome as soon as you park. Lots of genuinely nice people. Service is strongly Bible centered and attendees are diverse and unified in upbeat worship. Our family with 2 teenagers felt right at home. I was a church hurt girl avoiding church as much as I could.  Then my husband attended a men's retreat and that changed everything.  Pastor Chris is unapologetic about being a bible believing Pastor. No opinions, just the truth from the Word. If you are out of sorts and looking for a community who believe in the Word of God, the spirit of God and the Son of God, this is home. Oh and don't get me started on the amazing worship Team🧡💛 We are so happy to find our church home. As you walk into the auditorium, you will feel the Holy Spirit. It feels so electric. The new church is beautiful. Pastor Chris has an amazing way to deliver his sermon. As a first time person going to this church on their second Sunday of service in this location, here is what I thought:
I need to say that I grew up going to a Catholic church so had no idea of what to expect going to a non-denominational church.
We got there early so we were not late walking in. The parking process is great. They have lots of people pointing you in which direction to park, with plenty of parking spaces, it was easy to figure out which door to go into if this is your first time to the church.
I had read some reviews that said it was extremely loud in there. I have to agree. It literally hurt my ears to be in there for the hour long service. You don’t have to play the music or have the pastor’s microphone up so loud to keep their attention. I was immediately turned off by that, and it was hard to concentrate on anything that was sad during the service because of it.
The first 10 to 15 minutes of the service was all songs. For me, it just it was just too much/too long. Breaking it up over the course of an hour would have been nicer in my opinion. The singers were really good but just way too loud.
I was unaware that you were supposed to bring your own Bible. I assumed that something would’ve been provided for the service. I didn’t think it was appropriate to have people on their phones during service trying to follow along because that’s a distraction - for me. A notification of some sort on their website would have been nice as a heads up to bring your own Bible. I now know going forward to bring my own.
I realize they had the Bible verses on the monitor next to the pastor on stage, but for someone sitting in the upper back, it was very hard to see or read what bible verses they were or read what the monitor said. It would be nice if the large screens on either side of the stage actually had what’s shown on the monitor instead of showing him with the monitor.
The pastor had a great story. I think he did well in interpreting the Bible verses to make it relative to the story he told and easy to understand what he was trying to relay in his message.
I don’t know if we will return for another service based on our first visit. If you go and have sensitive hearing, bring ear plugs. Also bring your own Bible. Be prepared for standing a minimum of 10-15 minutes in the beginning while they sing. Also be prepared that people will be filing into the room after the singing starts and will continue until after the pastor goes out on the stage.

name: City Reformed Church
reviewSummary:
We attended our great nieces wedding there. The wedding service was very Christ centered. Reception and dinner was held in the gathering area and courtyard. Everything was lovely. We visited for the first time this week. A more traditional style of service than we prefer, but a great experience.

The pastor noticed us right way and said hello, as did multiple other congregants. Everyone was kind and welcoming, but also didn't make us feel overwhelmed with conversation. After attending CRC for several months I experienced a death in the family, which I informed church of (in hopes of help with the service planning). The only response I got from church leadership was a text a week later asking, "Who died?" I'll let you make a decision from there. A wonderful gospel-centered church who seeks the peace of Milwaukee. attended a memorial service there.  a very pleasent atmosphere.
