name: CityChurch San Antonio - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
The Worship team is the Best, you can feel the Holy spirit move here 🙌🏼  Thank you Lord for allowing me to try something New, and I love it ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Definitely will be one of my places to donate my time and portions of my tithe too. Thank you Pastor for being uplifting and firm in the word. Jesus is the way the truth and the life noone gets to the father but through him 🙏🏼 🙌🏼 ❤️ They can call us sinners but, through Jesus we are sealed and saved . Amen 🙌🏼 I have been attending City Church San Antonio for about seven years now, and my family absolutely loves it. From the moment we stepped in, we felt welcomed by the warm and inviting community.

Pastor Brett and Pastor Jon Pyle do an incredible job delivering sermons that are not only insightful but also deeply meaningful. Their messages bring a sense of peace and emphasize the importance of family, which resonates deeply with us.

The Sunday worship is truly amazing! After a long, stressful week, it feels so refreshing and uplifting to be part of such a powerful worship experience. Kudos to the entire worship team for leading with such passion and dedication.

One of the things I love most about this church is how inclusive and welcoming it is. No matter who you are or where you come from, you are embraced with open arms. The atmosphere is uplifting, and it truly feels like a second home.

If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, connect with a great community, and feel at peace, City Church San Antonio is the place to be. Been attending this church for over 20 years! Enjoy the Pastors; Brent, John, and Andrew! Love the music, you can truly feel the Spirit of God move! They have wonderful programs for youth and adults! If you are looking for a new church or just want to hear a great message, come visit BRCC, you won’t be disappointed! Well this is the quickest microwave version of the gospel. If you like that this is perfect for you. If you like the home cooked meal where they take time to make it from scratch this is not the church. Amazing worship- like the brownie in the tv dinner you always look forward too. Though the this has the imitation Salisbury steak… it was the best at the time it, you knew it wasn’t the real thing… A good juicy steak… Homemade tortillas… Whatever your favorite home-cooked meal is.. This is not it. Like I said, it’s a good microwave dinner. In-N-Out in one hour - too much hype… nothing like the 90’s - my sodium just went up with that iodide bleached out sodium salt… Today 7/5/26 we attended the 1pm service and as soon as we pulled into the parking lot my husband waved hi at the parking attendee and we didn’t get any acknowledgment. We started to walk in and there was no one there to great any new people. We went in sat down. The worship felt a bit off beat and I can feel like a dark presence as I stood there trying to worship. I heard a child crying 1/2 way through the worship (it didn’t bother me because I’m a mom and understand not all days are great) service started they played a marriage counseling video to recruit other married couples after the pastor came out to start his sermon and the child was still crying and he said out loud “I’m going to pause for just a moment” the entire church turned to look at the parent having trouble to leave with the child and the child was crying saying “I don’t want to go” none of the ushers went to help this mother. Then she leaves out the door and the pastor says “well you can’t always get what you want” then continues to preach. I should’ve left right there and then yet I stayed because my husband as intrigued into the series they had going on but I will never be coming back here. Not welcoming, no friendly greeters, pastor was rude for pointing the mother out and that was ridiculous. Being a mother can be hard and having a grown man point you out in front of 100s of people is embarrassing! Word to the pastor: DO BETTER!

name: Citygate Ministries - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome place of praise and worship. The pastors are fun and very down to earth. The service is shorter than my past experience but the amount of teaching cannot compare to the longer services. At City Gate you get the Word, Ministries, encounters,and blessings. Most of all the Pastors and their wives are one of us on and off the alter. Thank you Jesus for answering my prayer as I transition to SWFL A place to call home and find family. They offer many groups and workshops. You can find community without judgement. This church has changed my life. CityGate is my home church and I so enjoy it! Seen in the videos and pictures in this review is a Sunday morning service and a couple pictures from Men of Honor/The Herd, CityGate’s Men’s Ministry on Tuesday evenings.

From the first time I walked through the doors, knowing only one person who attends, CityGate has always welcomed me in and encouraged me to become involved.

During my time, I have been able to volunteer at a women’s conference, be a youth group leader for 9th and 10th grade boys, be part of the choir, and everything else that I can’t remember.

I so appreciate that CityGate speaks life during this world living broken.

CityGate does not shy away from the difficult topics and approaches everything with a biblical context and focus.

Glad to be part of CityGate! The pastor called and completely agreed with my battle. Thank you guys for being vigilant.

Thanks for the call and look forward to the meet. This was my first experience and I loved the praise and joy.
Thank You God

name: CityLife Church - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting CityLife Church was one of the highlights of my trip to the United States. As a visitor from Poland, I was welcomed with genuine kindness and made to feel at home from the very beginning.

The church is truly international, bringing together people from many different backgrounds and cultures. It perfectly reflects its mission of helping people "Find Home, Encounter Jesus, and Pursue Gospel Change Together."

The worship music was beautiful, and the live band created a wonderful atmosphere of praise. I highly recommend arriving a little early to enjoy the music before the service begins.

A special thank you to Kody, who went out of his way to make me feel welcome. He was incredibly friendly and gave me several excellent recommendations for places to visit around the area, which made my stay even more enjoyable.

If you're looking for a Bible-centered, welcoming church where everyone is accepted and encouraged, I highly recommend visiting CityLife Church. Thank you for your warm hospitality—I hope to visit again in the future! A perfect place to build a relationship with God and meet people who are all so friendly and down to earth. It’s about a connection to Jesus rather than religion. A very welcoming church, they start at 10:30 with modern worship songs, break for bagels and meeting each other then the sermon goes from 11-12pm. They have a kids ministry too during the hr sermon. They have a wonderful mission! Thanks for welcoming us City Life. Worship is inspirational with a sensitivity to the Spirit and God’s family. At City Life you find belonging in the midst of a multicultural, multiracial, and multigenerational worship environment. Be prepared to do brunch with the family afterwards. And don’t forget to check out one of their MCs. Despite a small and humble infra-structure, the church is a close-knit community, which worships God in spirit and in truth, preaches from the Word of God and how to live a Christian life the 'God way'. How i describe City Life Church: Christ centered, big in community, young professionals...  bunch of awesome people!

name: CityLight Church
reviewSummary: This church was great the guy doing worship was a great singer and the message was amazing Carl is a great pastor and teaches a lot the even have the teens helping with church there is so much and they said they will soon have an entire kids class and a great teacher. name: Citylight Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary: Love Citylight Church! My husband and I have been attending for over two years, and we settled on Citylight when we moved to the area because we felt so welcome and decided we could jump in with getting connected to the life of the church very easily. Great teaching, growing ministries, and, most of all, many intentional believers to do life with! Citylight has been my church home for almost four years now! Their motto is: “We are not an organization to affiliate with, but a family to belong to.” This has been absolutely true for me! The community here is incredible, along with Bible-based teachings and opportunities for service, leadership and community engagement. If you’re looking for a church family, I would highly recommend Citylight! We chose to make Citylight our home because the first time we went (and many times after!) people were so welcoming. Citylight is a bible-centered church focused on Jesus and the gospel. We love how the college ministry is so intertwined with the broader church, encouraging intergenerational discipleship. I have been involved with the CityLight family since it started in Omaha, NE and the Fort Collins church is led by two faithful servant leaders/pastors who speak truth from the Bible with relevant application to life's challenges.  You will feel welcome and a great place to connect with a community group. This local body of Christ is truly a spiritual family to belong to. Each week the sermons are centered around the word of God and the Gospel of our Lord Jesus. A bunch of brothers and sisters in Christ seeking and worshiping Jesus together to glorify his name!

ns. name: CityLight LA - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Exegetical teaching straight from the Bible. A modern church atmosphere and appearance, but rooted in God’s unchanging Word and this church stands on that truth as THE ONE and ONLY truth. Unashamedly preaching to a world and city in need of the Gospel. Amazing community of people. Pastors are amazing devoted men of God. Young adults, parents and families, older folk; it’s a biblical picture of the different cultures, age ranges, and skin colors God has created to make up the church.

Been going here 3 years, and won’t be leaving! Friendly and respectful.  Great for kids and families in the area.  They always have activities to get you involved and have a passion to support the community.  The staff does a fantastic job providing support and go the extra mile to make the experience positive and uplifting.  I’ve been attending here since 2010. After years as a Christian I found a home in Citylight Baptist. The welcoming congregation and youth of the pastor has been a tremendous blessing in my life. Pastor Nick Reed, being a young leader, provides enthusiasm and energy while remaining absolutely true to the word of God. Also, he is able to appeal to younger members and visitors with references to today's technology and how it impacts our lives. Come join us and you will not regret it. Citylight is a wonderful place for all the whole family.  They have wonderful nurseries, childrens classes and teen ministries.  The church leadership are warm, receptive and helpful.  It is a great place to find the true word preached straight from the bible.  The Pastor is on fire for the word and makes it applicable to everyday life.  There are several community events throughout the year that allows us to give back to our community.  Come check us out. For a long time I was looking for a church in where doctrine was more important than the "right" atmosphere or music. Stepping into Citylight, formally Victory Baptist, not only was I greeted by friendly workers but Pastor Nick Reed preached a relevant, but convicting message. Citylight strives on serving the community, and gives people many opportunities to be able to serve in different aspects of the church.  The children's program is wonderful! This is just the right church needed for the LA metro!

name: Citymark Church - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
I can’t say enough good things about this church, from the moment you walk in, you feel something different an atmosphere of genuine LOVE, warmth, & purpose. The pastors are truly anointed, delivering messages that are powerful, practical, and deeply rooted in truth. Pastor Matt is hilarious but delivers the message that the heart needs & Pastor Kate is the sweetest ! They make a great Pastoring team. You can tell they don’t just speak, they live what they preach.
One of the standout parts of this church is the kids ministry. It’s not just childcare, it’s a place where children are poured into, encouraged, and taught in a way that’s engaging, meaningful, and fun.My kid love going to church an now they talk about Jesus all the time. Moving states we “church shopped” attended a few in the area but our kids LOVED CityMark so we started attending and slowly serving now it’s a way of life is better to serve than be served.  It’s rare to find a ministry that invests so intentionally in the next generation, and it shows and I as a parent of 4 love it because they are our future. One day they are the only ones we will get to take to heaven with us.
Beyond Sunday services, the church/the people go above & beyond to give back to the community, whether it’s outreach programs, support for families, or meeting practical needs, they consistently show up and make a real impact. It’s clear their mission extends far beyond the walls of the building.
What truly sets this church apart, though, is the CULTURE. EVERYONE is welcomed, valued, and embraced no matter where they come from or what their story is, what color they are or how far they think they are it’s the kind of place where you don’t just attend you belong 🫶🏽

If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, where faith is alive and people genuinely care, this is it I am proud to call Citymark my home 😊 Citymark Church has been a tremendous blessing for our family. My daughter absolutely loves it and genuinely looks forward to going every week.

The Wednesday night youth program is outstanding. The leaders do a great job connecting with the kids, creating a welcoming environment, and teaching values that matter. It’s clear they care deeply about the students and invest a lot of time and energy into the program.

From the moment you walk in, everyone makes you feel welcome. If you’re looking for a church home or a place where your kids can grow in a positive, encouraging environment, Citymark is well worth a visit. I started going to Citymark church at the beginning of this year in January and I really feel like this is where I need to be right now.  My daughter, son in law, my son and all my grandkids are going there as well and we all really feel like the sermons are great and really what we all need to hear.  Pastor Matt, Kate, Blake and all the others are great and they tell it just like it is and that's what I love about this church. I pulled up here in my travels as I was traveling across the United States was here maybe an hour in the shade to keep my dog from overheating in Texas under the trees in an empty parking lot not bothering anyone about to go get some dinner and be on my way then some random guy from behind the church on the side comes up and tells me I can't be hanging out there in that empty parking lot in my truck in the shade with my dog..... Can you call yourselves a church Amazing church. Started going 3 weeks ago and it just blows me away with the awesome sermons every time. My 4 boys go to the kids center to learn about Jesus and they really enjoy it. It’s a truthful church. Something over been looking for for years. Definitely recommend going the pastor is so good!

name: Citypoint Church - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
I have never seen a church emphasize prayer and connection more than Citypoint has. God is moving on this campus and I'm so fortunate that He has chosen me to take part in His purpose here on this campus and in this city. If you are church shopping come join us for a service, this was my very first church on my "church shopping list" two years ago and I've never turned back. At Citypoint Church everything is to and for Jesus!  From the time you walk on campus, you feel welcome and are enveloped by Jesus’ love.  The worship team leads the congregation in a time of praise to the King, the pastor shares the Word in a way that I can apply to everyday living that makes me a better person, the prayer team is always available and approachable to intercede for and with me, the rhythm of community has helped my husband and I to integrate into the church body and feel like we belong and every week, we go away knowing we are loved!  If you are looking for a church family, please give Citypoint a visit! Last Friday, we rented the church for our graduation ceremony, which was terrific.  Thank you to all at CityPoint who made it possible, especially Danielle, Derek, and Tyler.  You made our kid's special day exceptional.  Thank you for all the coordination and hard work.
Sincerely, Melanie Rivera, Manager of Student Services at Pinnacle Charter Schools Love this church! I look forward every Sunday to getting together with this group! It's such an encouraging, loving, and supporting environment. The church's mission is to help people find and follow Jesus and that is exactly what they've been doing! I'm thankful I get to be a part of what God is doing here! They had a community event, with bounce houses and programs for the kids. All my kids had a great time, and the staff was very nice. The pastor held a parenting workshop and I met some really nice families in the neighborhood.

name: Cityreach Church Murrieta - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Never have I felt his presents as deep as I have here.. This church is truly a blessing to all that enter.. Love the new CRV ... I go here

name: Cityview Bible Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary: This has been a really great experience!! Finally found real passion for God and not just for show. With so many different Christian Denominations in the Austin area it’s hard to find a true church that is faithful in action and in works. They are the real deal soo happy we found this church. Our kids love it and we do too. They are family friendly and welcoming My family and I REALLY enjoy attending Cityview Bible Church.  While visiting their services, I have found their pastoral staff to be friendly and focused on Christ.  The music and singing are heartfelt and uplifting.  Cityview is located in a fast growing community with a congregation that looks like the general assembly of the United Nations.  Cityview teaches traditional conservative, Christian values, but they work very hard at steering clear of the toxic political morass that has swallowed up many Evangelical Christian churches today. Know Who you belong to, who you can become, and you will go beyond any limitations of the world by the power and blood of Christ Jesus. This church is doing the work, fighting the good fight, and finishing the race. Praise God for answered prayers and Kingdom Warriors🙏🏼✝️❤️ The Word of God is taught and in practice by the members of this church. The moment you arrive, you will be greeted by some of the friendliest people that love God. The children ministry is fabulous and also the different ministries for our young people. You will definitely have opportunities to get involved in the church community. Pastor Keith is a very humble servant of God that truly cares about the souls of the lost and preaching the truth to his members. Regardless of your gender, ethnicity or socioeconomic status, you will be welcomed in this church. I love this church. I started coming here after divorce, as a single mom going through it, barely hanging in some weeks. It was how I came back to God. People were kind and welcoming but not pushy. The sermons go deep and aren’t dumbed down, worship is moving and everything is Christ-centered. There is a solid children’s ministry, tons of support groups and other opportunities to get involved. I’m now a member and love watching this church grow.

name: CityView Church
reviewSummary:
From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt welcomed and accepted. The genuine love for God and for people is evident in everything they do. The  worship services are uplifting and inspiring. I highly recommend this church to anyone seeking a place to grow in faith and feel at home. This is a solid, Christ centered church.  Very welcoming and a great way to connect with a community if you are new to the area. Wonderful wholesome Church experience. Love hearing the word of God, passionately preached, and I love worshiping with the Saints! A church that truly loves its city and lives out its faith.

​CityView Church doesn't just gather on Sundays; they are actively involved in serving the community all week long. I love that their focus is both "upward and outward."

​Joining one of their life groups completely changed my experience, allowing me to build deep, authentic friendships while studying the Word.

The leadership is deeply committed to sound biblical teaching, equipping the congregation, and planting seeds of faith locally and globally.

It’s a wonderful community to grow spiritually and serve alongside others. This is a welcoming church with great people and worship! The sermons are encouraging and easy to connect with, and the sense of community is pretty strong.

name: CityView Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
What a fabulous church!  The leaders are thoughtful in both word and deed, good listeners, and passionate about their work & their message. They are a truly multi-ethnic church who have that rare combo of both personal salvation and social justice. 5 Stars without any reservation. Very kind loving people!! ❤️ The best fellowship you can ever get in Cleveland.
The church is so welcoming and loving This a very welcoming church that walks the walk. They are entrenched in the city and makes a difference in people's lives. Amazing Worship and the Word .  Encouraging and loving, not without direction.  Modern, enlightening, community...

name: Clairemont Emmanuel Baptist - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: What a lovely church! I came visiting from Florida and a gentleman who works at the enterprise at the airport told me about it. Thank you Philip! Thank you Kay for being so kind! Best church in San Diego. Great leadership, bible oriented, great fellowship, incredible teaching/classes, variety of ministries for all and much love here. This is my home on earth before I am taken. If you are looking for a family friendly place to meet new friends and worship, this is the place to be. The early service is more traditional, then there is time for refreshments. The later service is more contemporary than the first, not Toby Mac style, more like Michael W. Smith. People are friendly. Childcare is available. An amazing view of Mission Bay is the cherry on top! The nicest people all together worshipping and truly caring about their congregation and people around the globe. My wife and I have been members of CEBC for many years. It is a Christian church that teaches biblical principles, sends out and financially supports missionaries, has two services each Sunday and is very family oriented. The membership is counted in the hundreds, not thousands and welcomes newcomers with enthusiasm.

name: Claremont United Church of Christ - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I just photographed a wedding here and this church was amazing. From the gentlemen that was more than helpful showing me around to the construction crew that made sure we knew they would stop working prior to the wedding. There were some great spots for photos with the sun behind us.. so ideal. I'm posting some photos for inspiration.. and the church doors are soooooo beautiful. ~Maria • Pink Heart Photography I love this church so much. Open and affirming! The pastors are forward thinking and embrace all equally. The organ is to die for! And the new choir director is pretty awesome! Here at CUCC you will find a love and life affirming congregation.  It is a mainline Protestant, but very progressive, church that truly practices what it preaches — “All are welcome here.” Here, you will be welcomed with open arms and open minds. Amazing church, open and affirming, welcoming to all, and has a strong focus on social justice and working for the most vulnerable among us. In addition to all of the above, it's a very active church with many activities for different age/interest groups, and offers a lot of support for its congregants. I came to this church after bad experiences with other churches my entire life, and I'm so happy I found it. Come check it out - you won't regret it! I so enjoy the sermons at this church.  They are relevant, timely, practical and inspiring.  They are based on parts of the Bible I haven't explored in the past.  And then the prayers are written to support the sermon and message.  As is the wonderful music.  Everyone is  welcoming and friendly.  I have found a wonderful community.

name: Claremont United Methodist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I am in another part of the country and am giving you 5 stars just because of your manger scene! Bless you for "saying it" like it is!!! If we all SPEAK UP and ACT, maybe we can rid our country of this hate and those spewing it. This would be my home in the United Methodist Church! I love that Claremont is an open and affirming church that welcomes all God's children no matter who they are or where they find themselves on the journey of faith. I love that Claremont UMC walks the walk and talks its talk about social justice and serving the least among us both nationally, globally and locally as Jesus taught. I am deeply and passionately moved by their worship that is liturgical and yet full of spirit especially at Easter and Holy Week. I was baptized in this church on Holy Saturday two years ago. Pastors Sharon and Dan are wonderful servant leaders and I am proud to know them as friends, children of God and my brothers and sisters in Christ. God bless you, Claremont UMC! I would highly recommend this church. These 1-star reviews are 5-star reviews for anyone who has an actual clue about Christ's ministry. Highly recommended for people interested in legitimate exploration and expression of their faith Very nice church . went there for my aunts memorial serv.😟 Friendly, open and welcoming people and traditions. Lots of community service.

name: Clear Creek Community Church - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
I gained more out of 1 service than I did in 6 months at my home church/parish up here in Green Bay, WI.
Jude 1: 17-23!

The pastor, a young guy early 40’s.  Spoke with passion, conviction, and from his heart and soul. He shared the letters from his wife over a summer apart. His daughter was a 3rd grad graduate. I felt a sense of home! The volunteers greeted me with open arms, smiles…. I left that morning in TEARS OF JOY AND RELIEF! I felt a spiritual awakening that was overwhelming.  My fiancée looked at me during the service, as did my father and step-mom. They saw it in my face!

I wish I could experience this wonderful place EVERY SUNDAY, and participate in all of the resources they provide! I don’t really leave bad reviews. But today’s sermon was more like a business meeting instead of preaching the word of god. More like a recruiting meeting. I had brought someone who needed some saving they needed some preaching and you never know when you have 1 opportunity to preach the word of god and save someone’s life. But instead of preaching the word of god you want to lift your church up and try to recruit people. Its sad! Loved the praise and worship and the sermon. Staff was very welcoming and helpful. Will definitely be back. I applied for assistance I attended 528 location. Was very thankful for their help but the woman who I met with told me my kids have no business being in sports if I couldn’t afford it. I told her my kids got recruited for their teams so it was not cost to me. It’s important for me to keep my kids involved in sports. Let her know I am currently looking for a part time job because I will have to be able to pick up my son up at 3:30 everyday. She said I won’t find a job if I have to do that. I said I would take anything but it has to work around my kids schedules. Their dad is not in the picture nor pays child support. I was uncomfortable in the first place asking for help but it was my only option. I was embarrassed and ashamed to begin with. She called me the next day and told me they would take care of my phone bill but they wouldn’t take care of my daughters braces payment and that was totally fine and I was so grateful. Thanked her etc. but then she proceeded to criticize my parenting. She said my son shouldn’t be able to use my phone bc he is 5 and I do not allow him to use my phone. But he does take it without my permission sometimes. She said he seems to be “running the household”. Which is not true I do discipline my son but that was none of her business. Very intrusive assumptions and made me feel even more uncomfortable in an already extremely uncomfortable situation. I understand they want to make sure they aren’t giving money to drug users etc. but I am no where near close to that. I’m a single mom doing everything for my kids just having a hard time. I was belittled and disrespected multiple times. It seemed she wasn’t there to help but more so to judge me. Her name is Ruth. She was very insulting and has me questioning if I want to keep attending, maybe find somewhere else to go. I felt very offended I prayed about it and called to let someone know. They apologized but did not acknowledge her rude behavior towards me. I don’t like taking handouts iv worked since I was 16 and I’m doing my best. Just going through a rough spot. She made it clear they won’t be helping me again and that’s fine I am grateful for what they have helped with. This has nothing to do with financial help. This has everything to do with the way I was treated during this hard time. I hope no one who is truly in need gets treated like this because I know how it feels to be kicked while your down. I do appreciate them for keeping mine and my daughters phones on I just wish I was not criticized, belittled and disrespected multiple times. I’m a good person and very genuine. I help others any way I can and I didn’t deserve this. As much as I just want to move on unfortunately her comments hurt my confidence and over all made this whole terrible financial crisis I’m having worse mentally. I wish I would have never asked for the help. But unfortunately I had no other choice. So I took the mean comments about my parenting and insinuations that I’m not doing enough or I’m doing too much. Something I will never do again. I just thought it would be more helpful than judgmental. Which is what I thought church service was all about. I do love the sermons but it seems the judgment and belittling of my current unfortunate situation isn’t healthy for me. Do not attend a Wednesday service if you have any difficulties with loud noise. I visited for the first time and the music was blaring and physically made me hurt. Why? When the music is that loud you can’t even hear the voices of the congregation. God is having trouble hearing his people praise him when the music is so loud.

name: Clear River Church - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to this church for 7 years. I was a small group leader there for several years. I was an elder on a church plant that this church sent out in 2019. I love and care for the people here, even the ones I do not know. I have people I count as dear friends there, including on staff.

But I urge anyone considering going here to choose a different church.

The leadership of this church insists on continuing to be part of something they call “the Network.” If you search the terms “Leaving the Network” you will find abundant resources describing its deep problems. These resources include information from former pastors in “the Network,” former elders, former deacons, and many others. Some of the resources directly relate to Clear River itself.

You can no doubt find people here who are kind, faithful, and growing. I know some of them personally. You might find that here too, but you can also find it elsewhere and avoid some of the systemic problems that plague this church. Please, consider going somewhere else. I’ve been part of Clear River Church for almost 10 years now as I started attending while I was a student at Purdue. In that time Jesus saved me, I was baptized, God knit me into a wonderful community, I’ve grown and been changed, I met my wife, God blessed us with children, we’ve seen 4 churches planted, and God has been faithful in many more amazing ways. I’m so thankful for this church and for all the loving people God put in our life through it. Thank you God for Clear River Church. I was a member of this church for 8 years. On the surface, it seems like a Bible believing church, but there is so much hidden beneath the facade. This church is part of "The Network", and has a questionable history and some serious issues. Members have no power in voting on leadership or even knowing how money is spent. The church is located blocks from a homeless shelter and bus station and does nothing to help it's neighbors. Women are not allowed to lead small groups, serve on the leadership team, or preach. Please do your own research before you attend this church. There are plenty of other churches in Lafayette that are better than this one. I've attended church at Clear River for about 4 years now. The bible is preached during every meeting (Sunday mornings, small group meeting, service team meetings, etc), and it is taught in a way that is tangible and challenges you to grow in your relationship with the Lord and the people in your life. I've also really enjoyed serving in the Kid's Church! The kids have fun while being introduced to important biblical concepts and shown how they can apply those concepts in every day life. I have rarely met a church that is kind, compassionate, open, and patient once you get to know them. I wish people would be welcoming toward guests. Not that it's unwelcoming by any means, however it's easy to get lost and just look like a regular. The child care is pretty spectacular. Clear River's secret sauce are their small groups. My two very best friends attend CR and the proof is in the pudding. All of that said, Clear River is not my church and I don't think it's right for me. But they're great people with hearts in the right place and I know I can always return to open arms and compassionate hearts.

name: Clear Springs Baptist Church - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary: Clear Springs is an amazing place to come for Sunday Worship! Pastor Leonard Gibbs teaches biblically, people are incredibly friendly and inviting, and you will hear and feel the love of Jesus here! There are small groups available, children's ministry, and Sunday School starting at 9:45 a.m. Pastor, Leonard Gibbs and Associate Pastor, Tom Jennings, are excellent Pastors and teachers. Their teachings aren't "opinions" but only taken directly from the bible, the divinely inspired word of God. I truly appreciate this in these times where some Pastors are "reinterpreting" what God actually said. This is a church where " love abides" and people want to stay after church just to chat and "catch up" with one another.  Highly recommend a visit! Amazing church that is close knit and has a very loving community. No church will welcome you in quite like Clear Springs. They have teachings straight from the Bible and ministries for all ages. Thank you for VBS, Let's Making God's Kingdom Together! Be Blessed Good Church! Loving church. Great Awana and VBS programs.

name: ClearWater Christian Ministries-Eastern Shore - Daphne Campus
Clearwater Community Church
reviewSummary: I attended this church for about 4 months. It's a nice, easy going, medium-sized church. I was happy there until I learned that they prohibit women from attaining leadership roles within the church (such as becoming an "elder"). I spoke with one of the pastors and was offered a meeting so that he could explain their reasoning in depth. I declined, as there is nothing that he could say that would convince me to continue bringing my daughters to a church that intended to teach them that they are someone less qualified to lead just because they are women. Jesus preached inclusion and love, not division and discrimination. I will not be going back. I’ve been coming here about a year now and the preaching is awesome, straight out of the Bible. The people are warm and friendly and I truly look forward to seeing EVERYONE. If you’ve been thinking about joining us, just do it. You won’t be sorry. The worship service is pretty great too! I attended this church 3 times after moving down here trying to find the right church home. Great church, sticks to biblical teaching not all about a performance, motivational talk or lights/smoke show type of sermon which is a relief. That being said the third visit the sermon was about Matthew 34-36 and the topic of telling the truth. My 8 year old was present with me when of all examples the pastor decided to go into detail how Santa is a lie and not real. Which IS TRUE. I became a believer 1 year ago, my husband is not. I talked about not lying about Santa, he had no desire to nix that tradition. So when the kids asked I said nothing. So not to disrespect my husband or my God. If I were at dinner with an unbelieving family would I say 'Mommy and Daddy don't participate in grace because the are going to hell and don't believe.' is that true? Yes. Is there a GRACEFUL way to share truth that is not forceful or eager to spoil other's family traditions. Yes. Don't lie is pretty self explanatory, the nuances of application require wisdom. Lacking grace when explaining Jesus' teachings is just not for me, I won't be attending again. I love my church family. Have been a member for about two years. The teaching is sound and centered on God’s Word. Great programs for the kids, teens and adults of all ages. Come check it out! Wonderful church.  It hosts many recovery groups like CR and FA. A genuinely Christian Church. A truly spiritual place that preaches and teaches the Bible correctly. The staff and members are true Christians.  A genuinely friendly and welcoming place. You have to see it to appreciate it!

name: Co-Cathedral of the Sacred Heart - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Very nice and beautiful service my experience was very blessed I will try to come back as soon as possible. Just one thing to add be very careful with your belongings and make sure you don’t leave anything unattended. I am ashamed to post this on behalf of others especially in a house of God, so my wife’s sunglasses were stolen but i am a man of faith and just wanted to keep everyone aware…. Praise God and in Jesus name I forgive whoever did this🙏🙏🙏 This church is amazing! It is very beautiful and it is very nice. The organ sounds so beautiful with the choir, and it was very nice to pray and to worship the Lord. This is a great place for mass or prayer if you need to find a place. Beautiful, feels like home you must come to see for yourself my opinion won't do it justice. This place has changed my life I attend every Sunday rain or shine and attend almost every event held we can't get enough of this place or the feels its brings...the presence is so strong in there. It was nice and different experience from the church we go on a weekly basis. This is the first time we where here and it was amazing. Its a nice and beautiful Cathedral right in downtown.

A parishioner helped explain and answer questions as we walked through the church and the security guy was very kind and polite.

Mass is beautifully done. Will come back again. Beautiful church with welcoming staff and great sermon.

name: Coast Bible Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up at this church. I have also visited and attended many other churches in my life but C. B. C. is more than just a building filled with songs and a sermon. It's a family of people who actually care about each other. A smaller church with a big impact in the community. With a focus on family and the kids/youth, there are lots of great programs and ways for you to get involved. Solid bible teaching that is relatable and great worship make this a great place to call home. Firstly the people here are like non other,  classy,  genuine, have the up most respect for other humans. Secondly there facility is always immaculate, it's kinda hidden [which I personally like] looks small but seems to never end hehe so it is truly a nice place. COOL CHURCH !   This is a nice place to go if you are looking for a church in mission viejo or ladera ranch.  It's not too imposing and they have good worship music.  Coast bible church also has great kid and family program. Even though I was out of town visitor I felt at home I’ve gone to the church a few times and it’s been an amazing experience. It’s a comfortable place to be connected with God, and those around you.

It’s a comfortable place to be connected with God, and those around you.

name: Coast City Church - Biloxi Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I came up to Biloxi for a birthday party on Easter weekend. We wanted to attend a church service for Easter. We chose this church and we were very surprised on how beautiful this service was. We arrived a little late, but we didn’t feel judged or embarrassed. They welcomed us with warm hearts and open arms. The children church was AMAZING. My daughter who’s 3yrs old had a great time. She was welcomed in and made plenty of friends. The pastor gave a good message, and was very passionate. We didn’t have to dress all the way in suits and dresses, and that felt amazing. We came for the word and didn’t need to be preppy about it.

name: Coast City Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending when I saw their sign in Sept of 2020 and a lot of churches were not open due to COVID. This church is about community and loving people. There are many ways to connect and everyone is so welcoming. Very personal staff w/great Pastors. Music includes drums, guitars, multiple singers with high energy and upbeat songs!
Love this place of worship.
Live streaming on YouTube, and FB! I love this church. Pastor Doug (main pastor) is great, also Pastor Bob. There may be others, these are the only 2 I’ve heard. My grandkids love the youth Pastor. The music is great to worship to. It’s a wonderful community church! We’ve been attending this church now for over 2 years and since the first day we came we’ve felt like family. Pastor Doug is an amazing speaker and very intentional with his messages. Everyone there is so kind and loving, immediately walking in you can feel it. Worship is amazing!!! Childcare is very professional and fun for the kids, my son loves the nursery there! Each teacher has a huge heart for the kids. There’s free coffee & donuts and who doesn’t like that?! Haha but in all seriousness, Coast City is an amazing church and we will be very sad to leave when we move. Love you all! I was so worried coming out here across the country from North Carolina. I had such a solid church family and I was afraid we wouldn’t find that again. I was wrong! We absolutely found that at Coast City Church. They made us feel so welcomed and loved when we first came but what got me to stay was that they simply kept loving me and my family! They teach from the Holy Bible, the good news of Jesus Christ.
They have a great youth and child program and they engage the community more than I have seen of most churches!

Come here! You won’t be disappointed!

name: Coast Hills Church
reviewSummary: A welcoming mid-size church in south Orange County known for its modern worship and strong community feel.

name: Coast Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church with wonderful people! I have been a Christian since I was a child and love the authenticity of Pastor Jason, who speaks the truth in love yet is not afraid to preach on hard topics and real life issues. It is not always what you want to hear, but always what you NEED to hear and in accordance with the word of God. Coast Hills Church has encouraged and strengthened me in my relationship with the Lord and started the healing process from my childhood and teenage years of legalistic teachings and misquoting of scripture (other church’s NOT Coast Hills). I love the focus at CHC on real and right relationships with God and with others. My family and I love Coast Hills Church and it has become our church “home.” You will get sound Biblical teaching and solid sermons that focus on leading you to look to the Lord and not the world for your eternal hope. I also love that the pastor is not afraid to speak the truth in love-not all roads lead to Heaven-Jesus Christ is the way, the truth and the life. The pastor and church community are welcoming, real, and we love that it encourages us as believers to always be growing in our relationship with the Lord and with others. Love Coast Hills Church! If you seek solid Biblical teaching, friendly people and beautiful worship music, you will love it here! Pastor Jason's expository teaching of the Bible is amazing and sadly, so hard to find in South OC. I grew up with expository teaching, then switched to "seeker friendly" topical teaching and wow, my eyes were opened about the dangers of purely topical studies. I've learned so much more studying the Bible verse by verse again than I ever learned at churches who have the topical study model. Pastor Jason comes across as humble and very down to earth which is also important and rare, in my experience, for a senior pastor in South OC. I've prayed for about a decade that God would guide us to the right church and I finally feel like God has answered that prayer with Coast Hills Church. Come check it out, you will LOVE it! This is a family-friendly community church with energetic, contemporary worship, and Pastor Jason is an amazing teacher who likes to connect with the people. Great outreaches, children’s ministry, and fabulous women’s ministry too. Loving church. We love this body of believers and the Pastor- such awesome teaching. Pastor Jason picks a book and goes through verse by verse in an easy to understand but also a deep way (milk & meat and potatoes). Great children's program with super fun undersea murals and such warm teachers. Love the women's Bible study too! There's all kinds of support groups there as well (ie cancer care- which was a blessing in a lonely time).

name: Coastal Church - Daphne Campus
reviewSummary: This is my church home and I am proud to worship there. This is a more laid back, casual atmosphere that strives to make everyone feel comfortable no matter where they are in their spiritual walk. In addition to spiritual nourishment, we offer multiple church and community events throughout the year. We do all this for the building of the kingdom and so that the Gulf Coast (and everyone else), will be saved. Came all the way from Coffeeville to do some Christmasing and stopped to see the nights in lights well worth the $5 and the Cafe was awesome......nice to see a church basically dumping money back into the community with all they've been blessed with. We do not attend church here, however everyone has always been so kind and welcoming when we visited the WONDERFULLY shaded playground ( with big fans! ). Today we visited the splash pad for the first time. Again everyone is so kind. Even the big kids are so respectful to my little ones. The cafe is lovely and Rebekah was so welcoming. I wish I lived closer. I imagine the church is just as welcoming. What a wonderful community service to help the children beat the heat! I had the privilege of visiting this church this morning. It was an amazing service and moreover, this pastor preached the Word of God. So many churches today are “feel good” and have no substance. This one, however, makes you feel the love of each other AND the love of Jesus. I will be visiting here when I am back in town. My family and I have been apart of this “ church family” for just over a year. We absolutely loved the casual laid back environment and all the activities put on. We also loved that you could donate to the dollar club if you weren’t comfortable with tithing. Nor my husband or I had been raised to pay tithing but were actually very seriously considering it and would put money towards the dollar club. May 1st I was laid off and am the sole provider for our home. Finances became really tight and how we were going to pay rent was at the height of our concern. We turned to the church in our time of uncertainty with faith. They turned us down because there was no record of us paying tithing. This was the moment we decided this was not the right church. God was still at work in our lives and a couple things came through which not only paid our rent but will get us by while I transition into my new role and position. In my opinion helping others should not be done as a bank transaction. It should be based on need. My faith is in god is not shaken but my faith in coastal is gone.

name: Coastal Community Church - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
We are visiting from out of town but we’re invited to attend by our soon to be daughter-in-law.  Brother Leo from Katy, TX brought a solid word presented flawlessly.  We were welcomed and felt at home.  The Worship Team brought some great music.  So glad to see the camp prayer bracelets like the ones we brought with us from our home church in Fredericksburg.  We will come visit the next time we are here.  If you are local and looking for a Galveston church this one should be on your list to visit! My family and I recently had the pleasure of attending Coastal Community Church in Galveston, Texas, and I must say, it was a wonderful experience. From the moment I walked through the doors, I was greeted with warm smiles and open arms. The atmosphere was inviting, and the energy was contagious.

The service itself was incredibly inspiring. The pastor delivered a powerful and thought-provoking message that spoke directly to my heart. It was evident that he truly cares about his congregation and wants to help them grow in their faith to follow Jesus.

The worship team was also fantastic. They led the congregation in heartfelt worship music, and I could feel the presence of God in the room.

I highly recommend Coastal Community Church to anyone in the Galveston area looking for a welcoming and uplifting place to worship. This church is welcoming and full of families. God is in the people and the worship and the message. Prayer Tesm is amazing!!! Such a fabulous Church with some Great people if God... This is a must visit... Check out their Facebook for service times and events. I had high hopes for "the church of the unchurched." I expected a friendly, evangelical environment. I expected an encounter with the Spirit of God. What I found instead were unwelcoming, cliquish people and the spirit of religion. I didn't even stay for the service, as I didn't feel welcome there and churches operating under the spirit of religion are a dime a dozen.
I made eye contact with a dozen people and smiled at them. NOT ONE smiled back. No hello. No "welcome to our church." They were in groups and if you are not part of their community, you're really not going to feel welcome.
I'd rather go to a church where the love of Jesus shines.

name: Coastline Baptist Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited Coastline approximately 14 years ago for the first time. I had very little interest in getting back into church, because I had grown up in church and had strayed far from Christ and His church. Through living people and positive interactions, I returned several times over the next few years before getting my heart right, and ultimately joined. Over the last 11 years, my wife, daughter, and both sons have come to accept Christ! This place has been such a blessing to our family.
The Pastor - preaches God’s Word unfailingly and has a heart for winning souls to Christ.
The facilities are top notch, having recently been completely renovated.
The programs are friendly and have a class for everyone of every age.
The message is to “love God, and love others”
The congregation is friendly, engaging, and very diverse.

Whether your first time ever attending a church, or for are new to the area, you should definitely visit Customs!! Great church… All around… True Bible based teaching, amazing worship Kind of people and a great children’s ministry We love Coastline! We’ve been attending for close to 3 years. We “church shopped” for quite a while in North County, but landed here, and we feel at home!

My husband was raised Lutheran, and I was raised Catholic. We knew we were missing out on a church where we could truly just learn from the Bible. Coastline has been awesome for that. We love that the pastor teaches from the Bible. He teaches us what specific words mean, and their origin, which really helps those (like me) who need it translated a little more.

We’ve felt welcome there since our first day. We’ve had SO much community as a military family since joining their small groups. Our children have loved it as well.  They’ve learned just as much as we have.

We will be so sad to leave this church. I highly recommend Coastline. Pastor Steve is the best. Very welcoming church full of great people From the warm welcome we received on our first visit to the genuine sense of community that permeates every aspect of this church, our experience has been nothing short of exceptional.

The leadership at Coastline Baptist Church is both inspirational and compassionate. Pastor Chappell delivers sermons that are not only spiritually enriching but also highly relevant to our everyday lives.

The worship services are uplifting and filled with a powerful energy that leaves a lasting impact. The music ministry is outstanding, featuring talented musicians that add a beautiful dimension to the worship experience. The blend of traditional hymns and contemporary worship songs caters to a diverse congregation, ensuring that everyone can connect with the music on a personal level.

I wholeheartedly recommend Coastline Baptist Church to anyone seeking a welcoming, spiritually enriching, and community-focused place of worship.

name: Coastline Church
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful I found Coastline in January 2024. Even though I was raised in a Christian family, I couldn’t have imagined how much my faith and spiritual life would grow while attending this church.

The preaching is biblically grounded, the worship is uplifting, and the friendships I’ve built here have such a blessing. One of the things I love most is the size of the church. It feels large enough to offer opportunities to serve and get involved, yet small enough to foster genuine community and meaningful relationships.

Coastline has become a place I genuinely look forward to every Sunday, and when I’m out of town, I miss being there. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a Christ-centered church and a welcoming community in downtown Seattle. If you want to be a part of a church community that prays together, does life together, and shares the love of Jesus with others, then Coastline is the place for you! My wife and I joined Coastline back in March 2025 when we first moved to Seattle. On our first day of church, not only were we personally greeted by leaders in the church, but we got invited out to lunch for intros and even camping trips. Because of Coastline, we  never had to experience the Seattle Freeze. My wife and I soon got more involved at Coastline and joined the Dream team where we both serve as greeters and prayer partners. Highly recommend visiting us! We would love to meet you😁 I first visited in December 2025. Was warmly welcomed by the greeters and was offered some snacks and hot cup of coffee, which are free for all. I only needed the hot coffee but immediately, I felt loved. Now, it has been about 3 months and I absolutely enjoyed listening to Pastor Brice. He articulates himself clearly and his message is the true word of God. There are many viewpoints and style within the Christian community across the country, so many different denominations. It was so refreshing to find out how fast I connected with this church and how my views aligns so well with Coastline's. It was a blessing to have run into this church, which is considered my home away from home. Absolutely do come if you are thinking about it! We will welcome you! As someone new to the city, I’ve felt extremely blessed to find Coastline Church. From the moment you walk in, there’s a genuine sense of welcome and care. The people are friendly without being overwhelming, and there are many opportunities to get involved, serve, and grow.

The sermons are biblical, the worship is Spirit-filled, and there’s a strong sense of peace throughout the community. It’s clear this church deeply values community and has a real love for both the city and God. A truly warm and inviting church in Seattle. Coastline has been my church community for 2 years now and I could not be more excited and thankful for the wonderful people who are making it possible.

The volunteers and staff are all very friendly and welcoming. And attendees are highly engaged every week.

Given the downtown location, the Coastline community is composed of many younger working professionals, but we are getting new people every week! Our age and cultural diversity is always growing. I love seeing how many people from different backgrounds, countries, and ethnic groups are brought together to worship the same God and love on one another.

I highly recommend coming on Sunday to check out a worship service in our cozy coffee shop setting.

name: Coastline Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I am on vacation and visited this church for the first time today, and I absolutely loved it! I felt so close to the Lord during the service. The worship team was incredible, and the music was uplifting and heartfelt. The pastor did an amazing job delivering the message in a way that was both easy to understand and deeply impactful. I wish I could go here every Sunday! Highly recommend! Its a place of community, small groups, serving, and love. As with any church, if you get connected you will feel connected. Come join our "Dream Team" . Gods word and love is alive here. Cafe open Monday & Wednesdays 7:30-10:30 am for a complimentary cup of coffee and fellowship. Come join us & get connected. I’ve attended numerous churches since childhood, but i have to admit, that Coastline is indeed a powerful experience for young or old, that want to grow in their Faith. In addition, our young children love coming to church each Sunday., come visit and see for yourself. The least freindly church I have come across of. I was not talked to once other than greeter. Beautiful grounds. Organized parking lot. Looked like they took the safety of the children in the kids minstery seriously. Their worship is good. The message was interesting. I could tell that a lot time and money was put in to the place by the equipment I saw. That was the first impression of the church. Fantastic church— Loving, giving, caring members— Pastor is genuine, very intelligent, annointed with continually moving messages— Fantastic worship and audio/video mixing and presentation. Truly a one of a kind experience and grateful every day for having found such a one-of-a-kind fellowship and discipleship of Christ Jesus. Coastline Church is lead by people of God who know what the meaning of integrity is without falling into judgemental attitudes that sometimes come with devout churches. They have a kind of motto "No perfect people allowed." Seeing as I'm about as far from perfect as any man could be, I have never once felt judged or shamed for my poor life choices, but those who I have made closer connections with have lovingly kept me accountable for my actions to help me not live my life in the self-destructive ways I once was familiar with.
I always thought of the church as having a giant church experience but with that small church feel. Plus we got the best pastor around.
