name: Coastline Covenant Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Coastline Covenant Church is such a blessing!! Solid and impactful sermons, an amazing sense of community, incredible youth groups, and worship that feels like a gospel concert every Sunday! There are not enough stars here to give!  If looking for a new church to go to look no further.  This church feels like home.  They offer excellent kids programs, community groups that meet in homes, solid biblical teaching, engaging worship and an overall strong desire to connect with each other. This is the first church I have been to, that I truly feel excited to go to every week. It is a church that feels welcoming and encouraging to everyone that steps inside. They have an amazing worship team, relatable pastors, and great kids programs. Coastline is not like any other church but rather emphasizes the importance of loving God and loving others as a FAMILY. You are immediately welcomed in and know you belong before you even walk through the doors. A great church with good worship, solid teaching and excellent programs for kids and youth!

name: Codex Christ Church, Corp - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
Coffee Creek Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is invited, and I do mean everyone. God loves you, and so do the people in this church building; that is evident.
Friendly and warm atmosphere with straight from the Bible teachings and people who are only here to serve.
Love God and Do Good - the motto here - is very fitting for the people of this church. ❤️ How does the love, hope, and peace of god touch the world around us? We have been so blessed by members of Coffee Creek being the hands and feet of Jesus as they serve the homeless with Feed His Sheep in downtown OKC once a month for years. It goes beyond the wonderful home-style meals. Much needed survival needs are taken care of. Friendship and prayers extended. Just having someone to talk to or care about them means a lot to so many. A church can be a living body when it reaches beyond walls to be inclusive of a needy world around them. Touching hearts of real people, real lives that matter to God. I've been a member of Coffee Creek for almost a year but have been attending for the past year and a half. The people are friendly, caring, and supportive. The atmosphere is relaxed, the music is moving, and the sermons have practical applications to daily life. It is a wonderful place to worship, serve, and develop relationships with other believers.
We also LOVE food (coffee & donuts on Sunday mornings, 3rd Sunday luncheons, and any other excuse to have yummy goodies) plus we love to have fun!

We'd love to have you visit us! Highly recommend Coffee Creek Church! The overall feeling is relaxed, they allow you to worship on your own terms at your own pace. Pastor Clark is amazing. He truly wants to bring the word of God to people and finds ways to relate scripture to our everyday life. You'll see pop culture references and even television clips during the sermon. All of their community & holiday events are wonderful! They are still growing and you could be a part of the growth. I whole-heartedly recommend Coffee Creek for any individual or family looking for a new Church to call theirs! Warm and welcoming. This is one of the many churches we are trying before we settle in our home church since moving. Smaller but packed with love and a good message. The preacher is on point. We highly recommend visiting

name: College Park Baptist Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: The most caring, loving church I've been to that peaches straight from the bible.  Love the pastor and the ppl Great church!  The Bible is preached without apology, and the people there are very welcoming and friendly. College Park Baptist Church exists to worship God, follow Christ and help each other in the process. This is a great church that loves teaching about Christ stop going around and solicit on premises

name: College Park Church
reviewSummary: Nationally recognized for expository preaching under Mark Vroegop, rich theology, congregational singing, and deep pastoral care.

name: College Park Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Nationally recognized for expository preaching under Mark Vroegop, rich theology, congregational singing, and deep pastoral care.

name: Colonial Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: The cops threatened to forcefully remove my husband if he didn’t leave while he was having a panic attack. Distasteful and offensive at best. I don’t think Jesus is involved with these wolves I’ve had such a wonderful experience at this church! From the very first time I visited, I was welcomed with genuine kindness and open arms. Pastor Matty, along with the Colonial Staff, prioritize community and offer a place where people of all ages can grow in their faith! St Augustine is incredibly fortunate to have this church. Colonial Church welcomed me like family from day one. The people here truly care, and through prayer groups, Grill & Chill, and community, my faith and relationships have grown stronger. This church is more than Sunday services—it’s a family that helps you live a God-first life and gives you the support you need when you need. Me and my wife has been going to Colonial for few years now and we absolutely love it.  All the Pastors there preaches from the Bible not their opinion of what it says but straight from the Bible. They uphold the true word and most inviting folks I've ever met. I feel like I'm family Matt and Jill don't take credit for "being awesome," but they certainly are. Their energy, love and enthusiasm is deeply felt, and is experiential through their music, their worship and sermons! Making others feel "at home" in their Church seems to be effortless, which is a gift to the community. We are excited about their shared "vision" for 2023.

name: Colonial Hills Baptist Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful Baptist church. Very Bible centered. Great variety of classes and programs for all ages and ranges.  Services are translated into many languages live and several languages also available to read online. Live streaming also for most services.  On going activities during the week as well. Great church! Great school!
My child thrived in her first year. My only complaint is that they took the fact that we praise in private, and wouldn’t let our child in the next year.
After letting her graduate kindergarten and giving her a “you’ve been promoted to first grade at colonial” paper.
They waited until after school was out to let us know she couldn’t come back(our child was not a problem kid, the only reason she couldn’t come back was because we didn’t go to church every week). So we basically scrambled to find a new school, had to explain to our 6yo why she couldn’t go back to her old school with her friends, because they didn’t want to give us an official heads up.
There was a concerning teacher issue during our child’s first year, and we looked past it because we felt they handled it well.
I’m glad they handled that well, forgiveness IS imperative. But to have so much grace in one situation and then depriving a child of a good Christian upbringing because they didn’t make it to church every week when sometimes work just doesn’t allow for that ? Is very upsetting.
The Bible talks a lot about how the youth are our future. And how Jesus talked and played with kids when others didn’t.
Failing our children fails our future.. I hope the next person who comes in new gets a little more grace then we did.
Or can make it to church every week. Our children, Steve, Holly and family attend Colonial and also work at and attend the school. We've been visiting from Florida, on vacation for quite a few years. We've made many friends through the years and always feel at home when we visit.  We love Pastor Phelps and the sweet spirit of the congregation with each visit. We are thankful that our children and their family have such a wonderful church and school  to attend and work at...✝️Pastor Jim & Hope Vail...Florida⛱️ We love this church! We have 4 kids and they are all involved in the children and teen ministries, and love every minute. My husband and I love the small group Sunday school classes and the great preaching from Pastor Phelps. Our kids are also privileged to attend the school which is also excellent. We have made so many wonderful friends here, the church as a whole is loving and friendly. We love it here! So glad to have finally found a Church home. Everyone is SO friendly and welcoming. Immediately they knew we were visitors, even at a Church this size, and we so accommodating, gregarious, and eager to help. My family and I are so excited to be connected to such a loving place of worship.

name: Colorado Christian Fellowship - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
Tonight Wednesday Service Purify was a great message.  To see a sister come to Christ was beautiful.  My new Church home. The final part of the message was Come as Jesus calls us. Thank you Adrian for welcoming me in. I called today asking if your church offers utility assistance or could point me in the right direction for help.
The man who answered was dismissive and assumed I was selling something, saying “this isn’t a utility company” and “we’re not interested.” I clarified that I was genuinely asking for help, but was quickly turned away after being asked if I was a member.
I understand that not all churches offer assistance or may have eligibility requirements. However, the way this call was handled lacked basic kindness and respect. Even a simple referral to another resource would have made a difference.
I hope this feedback is taken seriously so others reaching out in difficult situations are treated with more compassion. I don’t typically leave reviews but I was previously stationed out in Aurora and had been far from God for sometime. During my time there I began building my relationship with the Lord and had prayed to find a church home. The very next day, I was driving by CCF and they were outside offering drive-through prayers. I knew it was a sign for me to attend. I’ve been going for the last 2 years and I’ve recently had to move to Maryland but I must say, I’ve never felt closer to God than during their sermons. I cried so bad when I realized I’d have to leave solely because of how much I’d miss this church. The pastor and his wife are so extremely kindhearted, genuine, and caring people. I unfortunately didn’t get too involved in the church out of nervousness but I wish I had. I cannot say enough about the love and joy I felt in this place of worship. I owe so much gratitude to them for helping me find God again, and I will truly miss it there. ❤️ Life changing, we experienced healing, Holy Spirit power, truth straight from God's Word and friendship. The childcare was tender and intentional. This is a church to receive the unadulterated word of God, straight from the Bible, Anointed worship In the family atmosphere!

name: Colorado Community Church - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is truly Christ centered, welcoming, and beautifully multicultural. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the love, the humility, and the heart for serving the community.
They offer so many opportunities to grow with Christ  from Bible classes, women’s & men’s groups, ministries, community outreach, community events, and spaces to actually connect with real people who walk out their faith. I’ve met some amazing brothers and sisters here.
Also The more life community center is serving the community in so many ways . Such a blessing .

If you’re looking for a church where people are authentic, the sermons are solid, and the focus is always on Christ, this is the place.
I’m grateful I found it & made it my church home.
Definitely worth checking out! The coffee shop at worship times is absolutely delicious as well :) Have been attending Chuch here for 3 years. Good messages, good people. Very diverse parishioners from age to ethnicity. A great place to worship GOD and meet like minded people. I am from out of town and I attend a God fearing Church. It is what is needed today so I decided to search and recommend for my daughter and son in law to go to. Reading the reviews, I am getting mixed responses. The  bad reviews  are given 1star.. Each person expresses feeling not accepted as though this church is clicky. However, it is the people who make a difference and The Holy Spirit which guides. However, I recommend my daughter and son in law before I read the reviews. Thus, everyone has different needs and prospectives so if they decide to attend, it would be their choice but I hope in this area, it will get bette, feeling genuinely welcome regardless of the circumstances. This is an area that should be considered looking at.🌷 I loved this church until I found out that this isreli organization were paying this church to geo fence our data. You will start receiving pro Israel texts to ask us to support the war in Gaza. It's too bad, I enjoyed that church. I emailed the regarding this with no response.
CHRIST IS KING This is my home church. They made me feel welcomed and they prayed for me to help me deal with what I'm currently going through. Truly an amazing group of people trying to make this city a better place.

name: Colorado Cowboys for Jesus Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Small Westside church with the friendliest people you will ever know. Pastors are former flying w ranch cowboy singers. How awesome to worship with such talented people. Come for a visit, you will want to stay and hang your hat for keeps. It's Awesome. Great musíc,great message and very nice people.🙂 Wonderful to worship there! Music was good ole singing. Message about the origin of The Star Spangled Banner was wonderful. I started going to this amazing Church and met the most amazing and caring people I've ever met. When I started going I was very, very sick and they welcomed me with open arms. Through their love and singing, I believe they are the reason I invited Jesus back into my life and I know he loves me and is the reason I have made such a recovery. I want to thank all of those people and Jesus for their love. I have been attending church services here for two months!  I love rhe music, the casual attire, the heart warming sermons.  I highly recommend you give this church a try.  No stiff colors here!! Just good Christian atmosphere!

name: Colorado Springs Christian Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
This church doesn’t believe you’re saved unless you’re baptized and if you didn’t get baptized in this church you have to be re-baptized by them. Very loving fellowship. Good preaching from the Bible. Very active Loving and friendly. Doctrine spot on!! Beautiful place. Must see and attend if you can. Service starts at 10:30  am. They also have Midweek (Wednesdays) night service starting at 7:30pm. Was visiting from out of town and chose this church based on the written information here and the reviews.
Other than the greeters at the front door no one else said one word to me.  Everyone appeared to know each other, and they seemed to have lots of great members activities planned so it seems like a tight knit congregation, I just didn't feel very welcomed as a visitor. My husband, son and I moved from IL to CO last year and felt so at home and welcomed here from the beginning. It was easy to get plugged in with smaller groups within the church, which really helped us to feel like we were a part of a family! Our son is a part of the Children's Ministry where he is learning about God from people that are doing their best to live out their faith in Christ, and helping to train him up in the ways he should go. Colorado Springs Christian Church is a bible teaching church where the members are truly doing their best to live out those teachings every day, as we interact with one another, study the bible together, and grow in our faith in, and understanding of, God.

name: Columbia Community Church
reviewSummary:
This place is traditional and thought provoking.  The best kept secret about this place are the plays; Easter and Christmas.  So quirky and full of fun, melting your heart to Christ. Wonderful church. Very welcoming and genuine. Bible-based teaching  all the way.
God's word is not changed by time, politics or popular trends but provides stable navigation through all those "circumstances", for the Christian believer. That is what this church teaches.
It  is not  the church for any popularity contest and does not aim to provide  a "feel-good" option. Informative, powerful end-time messages. A very warm & welcoming congregation with active youth & adults. Pastors preach Jesus and keeps us up with current events and how they relate to end times. also much love from the parishioners. 27years and counting🙌🏾

name: Commission Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family had been searching for a church where we could truly feel like we belong- just as we are. With two young daughters, including one on the autism spectrum, finding a welcoming and understanding environment was not easy.
From the moment we visited Commission Church, we felt that sense of acceptance. It’s a place where our child is embraced and supported, and that means everything to us. The church offers incredible childcare and even provides dedicated buddies for children with special needs, which is very amazing. This is a truly Spirit-filled and Bible-based church where the presence of God is real, word of god is taught in truth and you are welcomed just as you are.
Beyond that, there are so many opportunities to get connected, grow in faith, and build meaningful relationships with others. No matter your age or stage in life, there’s something for everyone. We truly feel blessed to be part of this church community and are so grateful we found a place where we are genuinely welcomed and loved. “This church is truly a place of God’s presence and genuine community. The worship is heartfelt, the teaching is biblically grounded, and the leadership demonstrates sincere care for people. I have personally experienced spiritual growth and encouragement through the ministry here. I highly recommend this church to anyone seeking a deeper relationship with God and a loving church family.” Commission Church has changed my life it is the true definition of what a church is suppose to be!! I have been going to Commission since June I am so grateful I listened to the Holy Spirit that led me to Commission! Paster and his wife are amazing the realest people I have ever met! You talk about the Holy Spirit moving come see us , come be apart of our mission!!! Loving God , loving our neighbors!! After visiting numerous churches in Fort Worth and Dallas, my wife and I landed at a Commission Church.  The people are so welcoming and kind! The pastor brings a fresh message that delivers the TRUTH in a loving and understanding way.  The church is diverse and is growing! My wife and I attend now with our kids.  Children’s, pre-teen, youth and young adult leaders are all genuinely caring people that truly want each person to feel connected and grow in their faith.  Love this place. 5 stars! We love Commission Church! My husband and I have been attending Commission Church for about a year and a half. Though we are introverts, the gentle way Pastor Ashish encourages people to get involved has helped us to find our place to serve. In serving, we have gotten to make new friends. I love the multicultural and multigenerational aspect of our church – so many people who love and respect each other.  I also love the Bible teaching and the opportunity to praise and worship the Lord!

name: Commission Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Wonder community of people at this church. Our daughter love their youth group. Which meets every Sunday  afternoon. And Mallory their youth pastor she really has a heart to serve in these kids and we're very thankful that we found the church as well as our pastor Cam he is really transparent and full of the spirit Beautiful service and beautiful members. I thank God for putting this church family in our lives. Would prefer to hear more of the teachings but the praise and worship is fire too.  We moved out of the area, (which is over 50 miles away). But my great nephew is looking for a church in RC, so I’m making that drive to introduce him to this great church family. May God continue to bless all of you! CCF was my home church for so many years before I moved to live with my daughter. They were always so caring and supportive. When my husband went home to be with the Lord, they were there.  i wish I lived closer to still be a member of this church family. Melanie, Ann and Bob, I really miss you.  God bless you. Betty Torres I miss my church home everyday since we left moved out of state. I found my family there, married there, and dedicated my daughter. This is a place where the broken find not only a place to heal, but a place to grow into who God has always seen them as, perfect, untouched, loving children. It's a place that digs deep and gives you the tools you need to make it in this walk we call life. Holy Spirit dwells within those walls of his people. I love this place.!! Pastor Frasier is the best.. He has dedicated my daughter then yes later also baptised her also. My life has been a struggle as a single mother & pastor Frasier has been there the entire time with & for me.. I love this church!!

name: Commission Church Chandler - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary: Been coming the past 4 Sundays for worship and I love it. I also go to Recovery group Sunday evening at 6:30. AMAZING. Home away from home. The presence of God and Holy Spirit completely lead this church. Raw, real, fun & funny. Truth. No perfect people allowed no keeping up with the Jones. Jesus transforms people in and thru this place and its leadership. Very thankful to God for leading us here to grow our faith and then to help others do the same! I've been here twice now on Sundays and I really like it, I'm very impressed. God bless all of you guys.🙏 I have know pastor Cal for several years now.   I attend his church whenever I am in AZ.   The messages are always strong and what I need to hear when I attend.    The church is welcoming with a great staff .  It is easy to get in and out of. beast church that you will ever go to. Awesome environment and has translation for Hispanic people who don't understand English. There is also child care from 5 months old to 5 years old. There is also classes for kids from 8 to 14.

name: Common Ground Christian Church West - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful group of believers. Very friendly and inviting.

name: Common Ground Church
reviewSummary:
CGC is a collection if diverse people from different backgrounds and ethnicities who come together to worship Jesus and experience community. It is a smallish congregation with a huge heart for people, for God, and for the community of Beaverton and greater Portland. They are welcoming, casual, and real people. The people here are very kind. There's lots of fellowship at this church. They are a community Church I go to the Baptist Church that is at the same place. There are 4 different churches that meet there. I have always enjoyed going. Solid Multicultural Bible believing community I had a horrible experience with this church.

I spent approximately six months as part of this community. At first, people seemed welcoming. Over time, however, I experienced repeated mocking, exclusion, disparaging comments, and increasingly hostile treatment, both directly and behind my back.

Eventually, I sent church leadership a strongly worded email addressing what had been happening. Their response was to contact the police, send me a cease-and-desist letter, and hire private security to prevent me from attending another service.

I sent polite goodbye emails to several people whom I had believed valued my presence in the community. I did not receive a single response.

Afterward, I watched a livestreamed service in which I believed a pastor made joking references to the incident. Several members of the congregation laughed in response. After everything that had happened, watching that was particularly upsetting.

I came to this church looking for community and initially believed I had found it. I left with a very different impression.

Based on my experience, I would recommend looking into one of the many other churches in the area.

name: Common Ground Northeast Christian Church - Indianapolis - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Close-knit church dedicated to multi-culturism, anti-racism, and a heart for the marginalized. No frills, Bible-teaching, kids’ classes, coffee. Love attending here with my family! God orchestrated the way that we got connected with the church. My wife and I met Pastor Erik at Starbucks after a friend connected us. There were details about our connection that were undeniably set up by God. So in light of that, we have been plugged into the church participating with them to accomplish God’s mission in the Castleton area. I want to honor pastor Erik and pastor Ken. They are amazing men of God. Erik is a humble and patient man that makes every effort to know the people plugged into common ground. Pastor Ken is a passionate and creative man whose love for the church is evident. Jesus is here A diamond in the rough, my family found the social justice focus of this church to be very special and unique. Years later, we specifically enjoy the house church model of small groups and my teens love the youth group. I highly recommend giving this church a try. There were times I thought we were the only ones who questioned what we were seeing as 'Christian' in our country that did not match at all what we see in Scripture and in Jesus life. Coming here I found church family. So good We have been very blessed by the community of CGNE. Our kids love the youth group which is priceless!

name: Common Thread Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
If your looking for in depth answers to your questions about doctrine, spirituality and what authentic community looks like, this is a really great place to explore that. I started attending CTC online during the start of Covid. I love this Church and its people!  I was involved with several groups while everything was still online and enjoyed the fellowship very much.  I'm not living close enough to attend in person (about 4 hours away) but my heart feels at home here.
While I'm still attending regularly online, I have made the trip In person to meet these people I have grown to love. All are welcome here. We like to say "If you're here, you belong." After a long search we finally found a church that is truly welcoming, kind and spiritually challenging. Rather than doctrine, we learn to be better individuals so we can be better community members. Every week, you leave with something to think about, something to challenge you to be a better you. Many opportunities to get to know other church members if you so choose. Nothing to force you or make you feel guilty. If you are looking for formality this is not your church. If you are yearning to grow personally and spiritually, please come join us. Come as you are. You are truly welcome❤️ We value our membership at Common Thread so much that we’ve stayed connected (online) even while moving to two different countries. It’s such a uniquely welcoming space that has made us feel absolutely at home. I love how Pr Doug explores the tough questions, charting a path to rethink Christianity for the 21st century! I have been going to this church for about 8 years now... I could go on and on about what I love about it, but instead I'll say that if you are looking for a spiritual community that a.) is accepting of ALL people, b.) will give so much value and not ask for anything in return other than that you keep giving church a chance c.) is not tied to doctrine, but also does not throw it out completely; then this may be a place for you. Read the website, and come in one Sunday, and I hope that it moves your life and heart the way it has moved mine.

name: Common(s) Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: What a fantastic church community! I haven’t been to church in years and was a little hesitant and nervous to come at first, but I am so glad did because I was welcomed with open arms. Great messages, great people and great things are happening here! Visiting my big bro for the weekend and picked this church across the street from his apt. 10:45 service—everyone was so warm and welcoming! And we had FUN. Come on in! Love this church. Found it a couple months ago in walking distance from where we live, and now it's our church home! I now see why it's so important to find a church home. Powerful sermons, amazing association, great fellowship and ways to stay connected to the church family. Even from online, their messages are powerful, Word driven, and applicable to our daily lives to become better stewards for Christ. Kids services are every other week, and our 13 month old daughter loves it there! Join us for service on Sundays at 10:45 a.m., and join one of our circles that are almost every day of the week, to get connected and fellowship even if you work on Sundays! Luminous City Church is unlike any church family I had been a part of! Their culture is so loving and accepting, and they truly love their city. They do monthly I Love My City events around San Diego to spread the love as Jesus would want us to. They talk the talk and walk the walk! Amazing and refreshing! This church is high energy and down to earth, so glad i came. They have powerful messages and amazing worship, and everyone is so warm and friendly. It feels like home

name: Community Action Partnership - United Methodist Church - Food Distribution Center - Santa Ana Campus
Community Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I came here this morning for the first time ever and I have not been to A Church in years. Today Was "Family & Friends Day" at the church. No I did not stand up nor introduce myself when it was time to. I wanted to but I'm sort of an introvert and have social anxiety a little bit (which I'm working on) so do know when I got home I let it all out & thanked God and spoke highly about the entire service to my small circle. The service was pretty good and was spoken by A Pastor White I believe. Everybody who spoke today was pretty good and I liked the flow of this church and it wasn't any pressure at all. God Bless everyone who was in the service today around 11ish am.  I might come back. Very good church. Everyone should check out the service and see for yourself Thought I'd never want to go from Bayview after Timothy  Winters passed but here at Community  I get that feeling you want in church...welcome...family❤️ Very United Brothers And Sisters Highly Recommend.

name: Community Bible Church
reviewSummary: San Antonio's flagship community church with inspiring worship, warm South Texas hospitality, stellar kids ministry, and authentic relational small groups.

name: Community Bible Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: San Antonio's flagship community church with inspiring worship, warm South Texas hospitality, stellar kids ministry, and authentic relational small groups.

name: Community Bible Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: 🙌 The Spirit of The LORD is here! Dr. Pastor Steve is a great teacher and pastor of the Word of God. He is like my Spiritual Professor. I enjoy being schooled through his teachings, he keeps me knowledgeable like a student through the Holy Bible. I'm so blessed God lead me here in 2018. Just in time when I was starting to get back into reading my bible for myself. Pastor Steve has been a wonderful guide and leader and kindhearted along with his wife Liz. It was a Divine blessing being baptized here in 2020. The members here are some good-loving folks. I feel like I'm part of a loving family. The hymns we sing are incredible, I love that we sing Keith and Kristyn Getty hymns/songs here. CBC - that's my Church! 💒🙌✝️🎵🎶🎻🎹 Terrific biblical teaching! Kids ministry isn't about babysitting it's about teaching the gospel. Refreshing place to be. It was my first time visiting this church in Baton Rouge. Everyone was receptive and friendly. Great sermon by Pastor Alf Nelson who was filling in for Pastor Foster while he and his family  were attending their son's wedding. The most loving Christian Church I have ever experienced. The Word of God is taught thoroughly. Pastor Steve Foster is very knowledgeable about the Bible and studies and preached from highly regarded preachers and Commentators through out history. Very nice, warm church. just the right size - not too big but not too small. Sound expository preaching each Sunday. Easy to get involved with weekday ministries. Highly recommend.

name: Community Bible Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: Community Bible Church has been our church home for many, many years. If you want to be welcomed as “family” and hear the Bible taught practically and accurately, you will find it here. We love our CBC family.  The teaching is solidly Bible based, and the church is non-denominational, which means we are self-governed (if that's the right term), not by a leadership group in another state or country.  I can't say enough good things about the congregation. You can feel the love and respect each has for the others.  Truly God's family.  Come join us! I have been attending CBC fot 20+years, always good foundational Bible teaching, dedicated believers who truly care about others.  Come worship with us - you will be warmly welcomed!! I appreciate Pastor Jonathan's messages and style. I have found the church for me. We love the church family.  Such a loving warm group of believers.  Strong biblical foundation with faithful believers.

name: Community Bible Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary: Today was my first time at CBC. The people were genuinely warm and inviting. The worship music was beautiful and the pastor gave a solid, Biblically based sermon. I will definitely go back! No Lord's Supper and no invitation to be baptized to join the Lord's church. Jesus fills the church everytime we attend. Pastor Clark is such a blessing. I had the delight of visiting CBC! I’m from out of town, but if I lived in the area this is a church I could call home. I experienced such a loving and free environment that revolves around Jesus! I met some wonderful people there: Shout out Nicole, Anastasia, and Clark. Clark preached a powerful message on the love of Jesus. I was so blessed to be there and to meet him after the service. I’ve been to many churches but I’ve never seen one like this that so values family and children especially!!! The kids had so much joy and freedom even in a hard year of a pandemic. You bet I’ll be back if I’m ever in the area. It’s all about Jesus there!! So glad our prayers were answered finding this bible based kid friendly Church!

name: Community Bible Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I have a had so many blessings from listening to the sermons at CBC. I’m not a suit and tie person so the elders and the congregation were always kind and welcoming to me.I guess giving a poor rating for a church should be looked at seriously if we all really care but I give CBC “love” Wonderful church, the pastor Nate is an incredible guy, man of God! Super worth checking out. Visited, did everything properly as I was raised to, left very empty hearted.  Creepy experience.  Giving time at this church is one of the scariest I've seen.  I understand pastor needs help, but whoa.  I had tried them based on what a homeless woman said of them, but she's just on the hustle, too. New roof and cross!! I loved going back to this church after missing out on it for the past few years.  I was happy to see familiar faces again and glad they haven't changed the Faith Bible based structure that led me there.

name: Community Bible Church - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary:
I started coming to CBC in 2007, my daughter was 3. We have made many friends there, and look forward to seeing them every week, as well as hearing the sermons and song.There are so many children now, it's very family friendly! This is an excellent church. It has no specific denomination, but it holds to verse-by-verse exposition and tends toward Reformed theology. Its people are real and gracious. They help one anothet and help community members in need. They emphasize family life very strongly. It's a great bastion for the kingdom. Recommended if you are in the area. I visited the church parking lot, where my nearly 14 yr old, 100 lb rotti mix, HarleyGump had an appointment to assess the immobility & possible pain in his hind legs. Dr Wolf, the missionary who provides veterinary care to the community, offers appointments in the parking lot 2x a week out of his RV. Our slot was scheduled at 10am but we were running late, as always. We arrived just after 11am but it didn't seem to pose an issue with their laid back flow. We understandably had to wait for an open slot, but Harriet?,the woman sitting at the table in front of the RV who was handling patient check-ins, was exceptionally accommodating, enthusiastic & personable. She approached shortly after we parked to suggest we stay in the car where it was warm & she'd let us know when we were next.
Dr Wolf was great! His vet service came recommended by a friend, so I already knew a bit about his mission. After meeting him in person, I felt very optimistic about the care that my big boy would receive. Sometimes you can just tell by a handshake and a moment of eye contact, & Dr. Wolf immediately gave off a warm, genuinely kind vibe with his entire demeanor. He expressed concern about Gump getting up in the RV, and proceeded with the exam right outside the door without a 2nd thought. He thoroughly explained the discomfort that  HarleyGump was experiencing & openly answered all of my question. He then wrote Gump an Rx which miraculously improved my Gump's mobility in just a day! We have attend your church several weeks and like.  We heard the Sr. Pastor the first 2 weeks and found that I liked his sermons.  We are really thinking about making your church our church.  John & Yong Song Williams Great church family! Come visit us!

name: Community Bible Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: A friendly church with solid Bible teaching.  Many families with children. Never visited inside but looks awesome It's w a wonderful church

name: Community Bible Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
The most inviting experience in town. Ed is the best. I loved him b/f and while the tattoos caused a stir in my house and while i disagree with him. My heart still stirs with the message that God annoints Dr. Newton with. Good work is done in that house, but the message is always Grace. If God can give me grace, i can give the good pastor it as well. God changed me and through this church he can help you with all the resources they have stay committed even when you backslide. Those are just the tests, but your neighbors in that place lift you up or will put a hand on you. So please go to the altar give it all to God and watch miracles happen. We recently moved to the area and the church was very welcoming. Parking was a bit tricky as we arrived a bit late, but they did a great job to help find us seats. We will be coming back and looking forward to getting involved. When Pastor Ed preaches, he speaks God's word with passion.
Wonder praise and worship time.
Greeters are friendly and helpful.
Nice coffee cafe.
Big on helping the community. I really enjoy attending CBC. There are hundreds of people that attend the 11am Sunday Service. I love the positive messages that I learn. The pastors have a sense of humor. I would recommend CBC to anyone.*9/29/24 - My family & I attended the 2pm service which was incredible! Pastor Ed opened my eyes to the fact that we need to teach our children to be aware of satanic symbols in music, etc. We need to worship God. Noone else. I highly recommend you go visit or watch the service online.✝️ Love this church! Pastor Ed is so amazing. We used to go when it was Pastor Emmett. But when he left. We stopped going. My sister told us about how this new pastor is so good. So we decided to go back after 10yrs. And I'm glad we did because he is such an amazing godly man and speaks so beautiful. I'm so happy we are back in church🙏

name: Community Bible Church - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
I walked to the church from the parking area and was greeted several times. The people were friendly to my girlfriend and I. The sermon was engaging and impactful. I have been there again and watched a sermon online one week I didn't go to the church. I recommend this church. The people here are friendly and welcoming.
The messages from the pastor are scripture-based and relevant to our lives today.
The prayer team will gladly meet with you after services if you need agreement prayer.
I am enjoying the fellowship! Very nice time of worship. There's a good mixture of ages in the congregation with a lot of young families. It seems to be a thriving church with many activities for all age groups. Spirit filled, good praise worship, Bible based sermons CBC is by far the best church that I have every attended. I am a member and absolutely love the people, the ambiance and the diverse congregation. The sermons are always A+ and appeal to all ages.
I especially love how our church is always going above and beyond to help other people in need. Bill Fowler and his family are wonderful and kind as well!

name: Community Bible Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary: We came to the area for the summer and wanted to find a church home for our short time. This church is very welcoming with great music and a relaxed atmosphere. We really enjoyed the preaching and look forward to coming every week and will miss it when we go back to Texas. Friendly people. Big but not too big. Pastor kept me awake even though I was tired which is always a good sign. Best thing was the music! New Christian songs like Brandon Lake My husband and I were welcomed with open arms and have since been able to encourage others by participating in as well as assist leading a few bible studies. We joined after COVID-19. I particularly enjoy the fellowship and support I've found in the Wednesday Sisters bible study that meets @ 7 pm (Wednesdays of course). It is an awesome group of women that are there to pray over and love-on each other.🦋❤️✝️ We watch online since we live in Clover, SC and we love your services!  We met your pastors and some of their families on the KLove Cruise and watch your service after attending ours here at home. Friendly welcoming environment always. Lots to do for all ages throughout the month. Pastor Bo and congregation are awesome!

name: Community Bible Church - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary:
For sure the best church I’ve ever been to. Words can't explain how much being apart of this church has changed my life. I give all credit to God, His mercy has kept me and led me to this church and even though im still a baby believer in Christ i see why God has led me there. Now im not trying to say they are a perfect church but they Exalt Christ Jesus and put Him on the throne where He's supposed to be on the right hand of God ! this church is not a feel good church NO . they care about everyone's spiritual well being and preach the Truth-the word of God to save souls,But oh they are so welcoming and address the urgency of the gospel especially in these times in the world . i strongly recommend this church God is definitely working in this place. I came here without any expectations, and I end up being surrounded by a body of believers who love the Lord and His word. Haven't heard false teaching, tickling of the ears, just the sound saving Gospel of Jesus. The choir and the entire congregation sings so powerfully together. The songs and everyone singing makes me wanna sing! They even offer home fellowship groups/Bible Studies which is a great way to get plugged in to this community of believers that feed you the Word, get you discipled, and even get accountability partners.

Definitely a gold mine of sound doctrine, a welcoming community, and a great place to have fellowship that'll help your own walk with the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

I even got cousins and extended family that go to CBC which is pretty crazy too! Quite a coincidence that God allowed me to even come to blood-family entering this building. “Lordship salvation” false gospel taught here. My joy in the Lord was slipping away with each passing Sunday. I saw a single mom and daughter quietly praising God during worship, and she got in trouble for bringing a tamborine. Sadly, they never returned.
A big push was on to donate to the building fund and do construction debt-free. Then when almost all the money was raised, they took out a loan anyway. Even the church’s youth were shocked at this hypocrisy.
Remember, we are saved only by grace through faith “apart from the works of the law”. Constant preaching about self-examination takes our eyes off Jesus, and the simplicity of the gospel. This inevitably leads to discouragement, and strengthens sinful tendencies in our flesh. Run from this place! My girl friend had brought me too this church when we first started dating,and I've been going ever since. They preach the word very clear and provide you with the spiritual food you need to grow into your christion walk. God bless all those who come out.....

name: Community Bible Church Denver - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary: One of the best churches in Denver! Run by incredible people! Definitely worth checking out! A place to find community, love and purpose! Ask multiple times for them to stop sending us mail. They continue to do so Great church with friendly people, I would highly recommend! This is my church! Real people doing real good in Lakewood!

name: Community Bible Church Riverside - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Great people. Great word. Loving environment. Come and join the family. Check out my YouTube channel: building stronger men I am having my daughter's quinceanera party event on September 2019 and this is a big beautiful place and  affordable. I highly recommended.😍 A lot of friendly people there and God's word is preached they welcome you with open arms The word of God and Spirit of God is there a bless place to grow in the body of Christ Binging in the sweet spirit of the the lord and family

name: Community Bible Fellowship Church - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary:
This church stays true to the Bible. We live a bit away, but love to visit and I participate in the summer Bible Study sometimes. Super friendly people. Pastor also likes to talk to the people in the lobby which is very rare in large churches these days! A loving church that cares for others! Has great kids programs, student programs, and small groups in addition to the sound preaching and worship on Sundays. While the church itself is nice and rather modern in terms of general aesthetic, from my family's personal experience wanting to try out a new church - we did not enjoy the sermon - which leaned too heavily into political topics.

Too much of a focus on hate - too little of a focus on love in my opinion.

The best part was the work from the violinist - and the other wonderful musicians and singers- absolutely astounding.

John 8:7-11
So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her. Praising the Lord for every person in Jesus who loves and cares for others. Those believers are like a beautiful, bright light in a very dark world.I don't know how people can go without the Lord and His own people. A healthy church is God gift to the world to help us press on. I believe CBF church is one of those healthy churches. I have been in the church for a while. Gifted, caring pastor and wonderful godly people. This area is fortunate to have many churches to choose from-- and we visited almost every one in the area during a year long "search for a church". There are many good churches, but we are a bit picky. For us, we found that, like most areas, some churches are huge and flashy, some are too small with nothing going on, some are too "stuffy", and some are too "political".

After looking at many, many churches, CBF is home for us. People were *genuinely* warm and welcoming BEFORE we stepped in the door. They have the best greeters- if you are more reserved, so are they. However, if you, or your kids, like more energy, they will bring that too (Tom- you're the best!). Beyond that, people will greet you warmly. They do want to get to know you. It is NOT the fake "Sunday morning smile" that many of us know.  There are people from all walks of life at CBF.

Pastor Dave is also friendly and approachable. He goes DEEP in The Word. This is not a digested PowerPoint sermon church. You are going deep in the history, context, and linguistics of each section and verse, as well as related or connected verses. Pastor Dave gets to know the people in the congregation as well. I have not seen anything quite like depth of preaching before in other churches.

The music is great, and CBF is blessed to have some really great musicians (looking at you, Ben and Ashley!). The AV team is really passionate, and they do a great job as well. All of them put tons of hours in. What is really unique is that CBF spends a lot of time trying to make the music interesting, while also focusing on The Lord, and not just trying to entertain people. Another really cool thing is that the AV team is mostly comprised of kids- cameras, sound, and everything. This is a unique opportunity that I have not seen elsewhere. Great job to Nate and company!

There is great fellowship at CBF, with lots of church activities to participate in. CBF has a refreshing number of men's fellowship activities compared to other churches. The guys are grounded and friendly, and they will keep you accountable, if that's what you are looking for. If not, that's cool too, no pressure.

There are also a lot of kids activities, which our kids actually want to go to- and that has not happened before. Great job to pastor Mike.

CBF is, for us, just the right size; not too big, not too small. Just the right number of people to make friends. Large enough to have different ministries, and governance, but not so big that you feel overwhelmed. If you want to focus on the actual truth of The Word, with some really great, grounded people, CBF may be you.

I can say that CBF (well, Christ through CBF) has meaningfully changed our lives for the better.

Note that this church used to be hosted in Westfield high school, but now has it's own building, which is really nice.

name: Community Bible Fellowship Church of Irving - Irving Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely the best church in the country and I mean it.  The teaching & preaching that takes place in this church is phenomenal!  The choir is amazing, and it's a great if you have children(they have children's and teen church too).  Aside from encouraging the congregation to be good stewards of money, there is not this big focus on money.  They take one offering and you are reminded to only give what you can cheerfully(I wish that was more common). The pastor is SO  committed to sharing the gospel and teaching the Word of God it is breathtaking. I wish he could be cloned and placed in some of these churches that need sound teaching.
It is something you have to experience yourself! CBF is a church that is Bible-based and family-oriented. You really can't ask for more an in the heart of the Metroplex ,easily accessible, no matter where you live. The congregation is small, which is a plus if you don't want to be lost in a sea of members. The ministries are very active and it's just a wonderful environment to learn and grow in your faith. CBF is a wonderful family!  Pastor Harris delivers fantastic Biblical teaching sermons and studies.  Choir is truly awesome! Bible study class on Wednesday nights is unlike any I’ve experienced. All questions are welcome and answered within Biblical context and with academic clarity. I'm unbiased in my assessment.. even though I'm the pastor.  The choir is great!  The teaching is biblical.  The pastor is kinda OK.

name: Community Center Fellowship - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
This pastor is a Spirit filled man who loves God and is definitely anointed to teach and preach the Word of God .
This body of believers are growing in God's ways and really enjoy worship as well.
It's a great place to call home and fall more deeply in love with our Heavenly Father.

name: Community Christian Church
reviewSummary: Great place for an event.  Very comfortable seats and a very nice place.  I love that it has food and drinks.  I went for a book signing but it looks like a wonderful church too. Community Church Naperville was in an awesome experience. It was my first time at that location. I attend community Church in Downers Grove and was there to listen to a special speaker at the Naperville location today beautiful location, beautiful people absolutely recommend. I love this church I've been going since December 2025 and still going to this day! ❤️ I'm from Houston my son and daughter in law are members here. Everytime we are there visiting we attends. each time we are greeted with love. such a nice welcoming church. Attended TEDx Naperville. Venue is clean, fresh, and modern. Stage equipment was very professional. Never attended a service, but you would barely realize you were in a church during the TEDx event. Could use extra staff during mad latte rush, but the latte was good.

name: Community Christian Church
reviewSummary:
Community Christian Church in Lincoln Square I think the location closed down now but I'm not sure but the church was a welcoming church when I used to go there; I moved so I couldn't attend there anymore..... Hannah a great singer...... Sharry was a good pastor..... snacks were good, the music was good, the church environment/decorations, cleanliness, powerpoints, bible readings, verses chosen, activities, activities with the community were good, awesome and welcoming all those things were great and good. The many locations are very good to. The Facebook page and communication outside of the church for church events were good. The music chosen was good to. The Christmas and other holidays that God would want us to celebrate were good like the night of a candle or of a silent night at church was very good. The other pastors were good to. The brother pastors they were both good pastors. Lastly but not least the trips especially to Jerusalem was very exciting and a good, great and wonderful unforgettable idea. My kids and I visited out of town and I was very pleased by the experience. The sermon on anger and unity in the body of Christ was very good. The pastor and other leaders did not come across arrogant, but seemed to have their identity rooted in Christ. They focus much on true Christian community and seem to have a genuine desire to reach their community with Christ’s love.
I also noticed that people were genuinely warm and welcoming as we entered the building before the service.
If you’re looking for a solid church community in Chicago, you should at least go to a couple of services. My first impression was that people genuinely cared. A welcoming place in the city to worship and make friends.  My wife and I have been attending this location since it opened in 2013.  The worship music is great and the weekly message seems always on point. The people are really friendly and really seem to care about you.  Their mission is helping people find their way back to God.  Everyone is welcome. I visited here and the atmosphere was really friendly and welcoming! They have something for all age groups and everyone is learning about Jesus! Definitely will visit again. One of, if not thy, best churches in the city. Extremely welcoming, not at all judgemental. Just a great place to start your way back to God.

name: Community Christian Church
reviewSummary:
My grandparents and father were long time members here, my parents were married in bonfils chapel and I was also baptized here when I was young and was a member for over 20 years. My family attended the first lighting of the Steeple. I will always feel like this is my home church. Sending peace and love to all. This is such a wonderful and caring congregation.  I've been a member for 25 years and each year it gets better.  There are good programs for children, a focus on social justice, and amazing music and arts to feed the soul in other ways.  I can't imagine attending anywhere else. I’ve been at this church for over 18 years and have watched it get better and better.  If you want a church that doesn’t require you to check your brain at the door, you should try this one.  All are welcome and All means All.  The ministers are excellent, the staff is skilled and the congregation is warm and welcoming.  We have started seeing more young families and the kids in the church are great fun.  The architecture is classic Frank Lloyd Wright, which is to say, kinda stark.  Don’t let that put you off, the congregation will make you comfortable.  There is a good thing going on here.

BTW - I don’t understand people who leave a one star rating and don’t say one word why. I have been attending Community for nearly 20 years. It continues to offer fresh, progressive energy to make sense in an ever-confusing world. I appreciate the inclusive atmosphere, the commitment to social justice, and the inspiring worship services. It is a big part of my life. We started going to church here about a year and a half ago. We were having a hard time finding a church that felt like "ours" and we're about to give up. We're in our 20s with two young children (my son was just 9 weeks old on our first visit) and this church has been incredible for us. Community Christian does a great job of reconciling our inclusive, progressive Christian beliefs with a more traditional service. The messages challange me to really think about my beliefs and work on growing. More than that, it's an amazing place for kids and parents. The children are all very close with one another and play regularly, both in and out of church (my kids can't wait to go and never want to leave) and us parents (and the non-parents too) are a huge source of friendship and support for one another. We've found a second family and a meaningful community here.

name: Community Christian Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been members of Community Christian Church for over 25 years.  I love this church!  I am proud that we welcome people of all walks of life to worship with us.  Our minister is compassionate and dedicated to everyone.  The strong lay ministry is an asset.  The music program is outstanding.  The youth programs are of the highest quality.  I invite everyone to come and worship with us. Community Christian is a church of welcome for all people, regardless of where they may be on their faith journey. It is a small church characterized by compassion and care, service to humanity and Christ's love of all people. It's not mega-church but instead offers a genuine, reflective and uplifting worship experience. Personally I find it a  welcome break from our noisy world. Pastor Sarah sticks to Biblical teachings and yet interprets them for everyday life. The music is classic, familiar and inspirational. Communion is served every Sunday and all are welcome at the table. I am thankful to be able to worship at this little gem of church right on Main Street in a community grounded in faith & family values. I am so thankful for Community Christian Church.  Sarah , our minister is a very loving, kind and compassion person.  I consider all of them my church family.   When I am there I feel the Spirit of the Lord a
among us.  If you are looking for a church, come and see the love of God within his congregation.  You will have a peace that is awesome. We have been attending Community Christian Church for 39 years.  Traveling all over,  this is the most welcoming church we ever found.  We are a "bridge" church, welcoming worshipers from all races, walks of life and denominations. We celebrate the Lord's Supper every Sunday and believe in the "priesthood of all believers ", with each worshiper free to interpret the words and message of the Bible. All are welcome. Community Christian Church is a church of family. When you are here you are home and those members around you are all family. Our Minister is a leader of faith and character. She makes everyone feel important and needed. Our church is a giving church where we not only care for our church family, but we carry that love into the community. I am certain there are other churches where their membership feels the same way, just as there are those who feel,it necessary to degrade because there feelings are not agreed with. I can assure you Community Christian Church is a church of God!

The brother pastors they were both good pastors. Lastly but not least the trips especially to Jerusalem was very exciting and a good, great and wonderful unforgettable idea. My kids and I visited out of town and I was very pleased by the experience. The sermon on anger and unity in the body of Christ was very good. The pastor and other leaders did not come across arrogant, but seemed to have their identity rooted in Christ. They focus much on true Christian community and seem to have a genuine desire to reach their community with Christ’s love.
I also noticed that people were genuinely warm and welcoming as we entered the building before the service.
If you’re looking for a solid church community in Chicago, you should at least go to a couple of services. My first impression was that people genuinely cared. A welcoming place in the city to worship and make friends.  My wife and I have been attending this location since it opened in 2013.  The worship music is great and the weekly message seems always on point. The people are really friendly and really seem to care about you.  Their mission is helping people find their way back to God.  Everyone is welcome. I visited here and the atmosphere was really friendly and welcoming! They have something for all age groups and everyone is learning about Jesus! Definitely will visit again. One of, if not thy, best churches in the city. Extremely welcoming, not at all judgemental. Just a great place to start your way back to God.

name: Community Christian Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church home!! We have the best Pastor, Rev.Chatman! Went on Father's day to be with family. This great church has lots of history, and is still standing. I got married at this church in the 80's. This church has helped individuals go to college, and many other life changing adventures throughout the community.. Please come and worship!! My Church great time can be had by all. Super Pastor. Excellent Praise Team. Extra Super Musician's. Attended a service there, very friendly. Good staff. Pastor was nice. Grew up in the church. Had to return to do a memorial for my mom.

name: Community Christian Church - Moore Campus
reviewSummary: not the place for me

name: Community Christian Church - Nashville Campus
Community Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly staff and members.  When I went there, they don’t discriminate on appearance or ethnicity.  The congregation has a very diverse background.  They even have many people coming and driving from New Jersey and upstate. However, most members spoke to me to try to make me feel welcomed.  They also have complimentary breakfast, which is very nice, and communion.  Their service is in a school auditorium, which has these annoying concrete stubs on the floor behind the chairs that I tripped on.  I like the pastor’s way of preaching (he is from the south and more aligned to my Southern Baptist roots).  The service is very short (about an hour), so that’s nice in my opinion. I've been going to this church fairly regularly for a few years. I have always found the congregation to be friendly, supportive, and spirit filled. Pastor Jeff's sermons are practical, inspirational, and sometimes pretty funny. His messages are based firmly on scripture, yet remain compassionate and non-judgemental. Newcomers are welcomed warmly and encouraged to explore the various programs and classes the church offers. The congregation is richly diverse and  gloriously reflects the melting pot that is New York. I think this church is a great place for spiritual nourishment, and they have great bagels too! I recently decided to visit Community Christian Church.   The welcome was so warm and loving.  This is what my grandson with special needs needed.At first he attended Sunday school and was doing his own thing. The next time he really was participating with the other children The 3rd time the teacher said he lead the pray in the class.  I must say thank you to these teachers of God.  He begs to go to Sunday school now, and I am so grateful for there patience and tolerance with my baby boy.  LOVE children know LOVE . Especially GODS Love.  See  you Sunday. When my wife and I moved to New York, we were looking for a church that was more than just worship songs and a sermon. When we visited CCC, we were welcomed warmly and found a small yet diverse congregation of good people doing their best to follow Christ. We don't all agree on everything, but that's kind of the point -- anyone can come and be who they are, from where they are, in community with other believers. And the music turns out to be pretty good anyway. Awesome congregation! Pastor Jeff is an excellent leader who does feed the flock. The members are very welcoming and I love the idea that he leads Bible studies. Thank you for embracing us in His love 🙏🏼

name: Community Christian Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church family!  Stop by and see for yourself.   No judgment, come as you are. Love
The Potluck and Bingo on Sunday. Great message from Jason  on Sunday. The fall was beautiful. Come by and visit our Church one Sunday. We will be happy to see you. We spent several months visiting churches, none of them felt like our home church until we visited Community Christian Church!  Everyone is so friendly and welcoming.  We love this church, the pastors, and all the people we have met.  I made the best decision of my life and got baptized!  We also joined a small group which has made a huge impact in our lives!  I cannot imagine being part of any other church!!  Once you visit Community Christian Church you will feel the same! Best church I’ve ever been to in my adult life. I absolutely love the people and the atmosphere. No pressure to dress up. Lots of opportunities for children and adults. My children love the kids and youth programs and I love the whole church in general and the softball team I play on. There are so many things to get involved in. I hope to go on the next mission trip. Love my church. Folks, my wife and I have searched for a church home like this for years. This truly is, The Church for The Rest of Us!

It is so great that I highly recommend that you visit one Sunday to see for yourself. They have two convenient locations with multiple service times.

There is a wonderful children's church staffed by great people. You will find an abundance of middle school children in attendance also.

You can also checkout sermons online and I promise, you will enjoy and benefit from the message, even if you still attend a different church.

You really have to visit and see first hand what makes this church so wonderful. It is unlike most churches you have visited and I can tell you, we love everything here.

Oh. And come dressed as you please. Casual. Shorts. More dressy or less dressy. Wear what you please, relax, and enjoy church again. You will be so glad you visited, and so will your family.

Highly Recommended.

name: Community Christian Church - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary: Came here for some last minute testing. Lines were short and staff were so helpful! Thank you to everyone who is helping with vaccination drives and community testing, we are so grateful for everything you do!!! I WENT HERE THIS MORNING 1-6-21 TO GET A COVID-19 TEST I MET A NICE FELLOW DR..LAWRENCE VAN HOOK  THAT IS THE PASTOR OF COMMUNITY CHRISTIAN CHURCH HE REALLY GAVE ME MUCH RESPECT. IT WAS MY FIRST TIME GETTING TESTED IN THEIR BACK PARKING LOT DR. LAWRENCE VAN HOOK GOD BLESS HIS SOUL . Very efficient Covid 19 site. Wonderful staff. Highly Recommend. Warm and welcoming group. Great service, starts on time and ends on time. This is a wonderful church with an amazing pastor, minister and congregation. From the moment you enter you feel like family

name: Community Christian Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
I have had the best experience in Community Christian Church...
What a lovely group of people, and so friendly! I feel like Jesus is right in church with me as the music and worship is so inviting and very grounded in the Word....Pastor Justice is a very sincere and caring Pastor and always takes time to be personal with all....He really cares about the family here. The Worship Team is always available to give "hands on" prayer for those whom need to be lifted up and prayed for....I have only been attending since September 2014 but I feel like I am a long time family member......thanks. Even though I oversee a Home Church in my house the Lord has expanded my world and brought me up to Community Christian Church last year (2016). It is a church on fire for the Lord. Pastor George goes deep into the Word and brings out the meat. It is a family. We enjoy lunch every Sunday after service. We have had teachers from Bethel and Oregon Epic Center. We have had a Discovery Weekend from with Kingdom Catalyst to help bring revival to San Pedro and the South Bay. CCCis my new home away from home. I have said more than once that one of the reasons I love Pastor ❤️ George is because he believes in sharing the message he said God had downloaded into him and it comes across that way! To put it simply it may not be what you want to hear but it's What you Need To Hear!! I challenge you to check It Out. IF you are looking for a church Family Look no Farther you have Found IT AT CCC! I attended CCC with my mom Frances, people were really kind to my MOM. She had a nice celebration of life on 6/20/15. Pastor Justus was very kind and friends commented on it. I want to thank all who attended, I know MOM is watching, she  would have wanted to give all of you a big HUG and dance with you. Thank you all again. Andrea Espinosa, MD

PS please update your calendar and web site. I know there is a speaker tomorrow, I wanted to invite a friend but name of the speaker not on your calendar. Please update calendar weekly thanks Great Spirit led worship. Bible study and services based on the word of God. Pastor George, his wife Olivia, and the congregation makes you feel like family from day one!

name: Community Christian Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
The building is old but well loved. I've only ever been in their annex/meeting room as they host a puzzle swap/exchange meet up there once a month.

I've never been in the chapel or attended services, but it seems from their wall postings and such that ive seen that they are very active and supportive to the local community.

The biggest thing though is the construction of the roads nearby. The road is being widened to accommodate the increase of traffic over the years. This means that a) there's already more traffic than the road can handle, b) they've narrowed the road to make room for the construction, and c) there's signage, raw asphalt, dirt road turn offs, etc. Making the whole thing a hot mess of accidents waiting to happen.  Drive careful. Be safe. Don't look further . The moment you stepped in  you feel loved.  people  here are genuine and caring. My kids look forward  every Sunday  to meet their Sunday school teachers..great kids ministry  .we have really grown  with this place.
Aduarable pastor. I'm a member of Community Christian Church. I love the church, the minister PJ Condit and the congregation is warm and welcoming. Though this is a small group of people, I like that they genuinely care for one another while attempting to live out their faith. Good place

name: Community Christian Church - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary: Was there for family  memorial christopher  Martinez  great service  and beautiful church  fabulous minister  she was AWESOMENESS 🙏🙏♥️✌️☕️🦢 Glad they're here for the NA groups that need a space Nice Church and I do accept all people especially the church doesn't care if you're gay lesbian transgender from another planet they just accept everybody for who they are and they also let 12-step recovery programs user building to host 12-step recovery meetings that's all a plus in my book May God Bless you richly for providing to the homeless, addicted and mentally ill. My daughter uses your service and I am grateful for your non-judgmental service. In Jesus' name. ❤️🙏🏾 I love this place for its support of the LGBT community I also attend meetings here

name: Community Christian Church Hamilton Ohio - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary: I cannot say enough amazing things about this church!!! Such a comfortable atmosphere, so uplifting and inspiring! My kids LOVE the child care! The services are so personable! And the music... aaaahhhh!!! I look forward to attending each week! This is a wonderful place to worship.  My wife and I both came from different church backgrounds and were looking for a home where we both fit in.  The staff are knowledgeable and teach the love of God. We have raised our children at Community and have developed so many relationships with people of all walks of life.  We love it here. Love Community Christian Church!!  The worship service is wonderful and the preaching team has great series that speak the truth.  We have a small group that we do life with.  Come to one of the services and see for yourself.  They have something for every age. Service times at 9:00 and 10:30. Thank you community Christian church for welcoming me with open arms every year when I visit my friends! My Sunday morning visit has quickly become one of my favorite parts of my trip, and I look forward to the sermons each time I come by! My husband and I were at a point in our lives where we were looking for a new church. We had heard of CCC before, and as we were looking into various churches,  my husband had stumbled across their online services. For several weeks we watched services online and decided to take a leap of faith and attend in-person. We started attending CCC a little over a year ago and we couldn’t be happier. The church has much to offer, such as a wonderful program for children and teens, all types of bible study groups, and an amazing staff and congregation that has absolutely made us feel so welcomed! We know that God guided us in this direction as we were able to reconnect and rebuild our relationship with Him, and for that we are so grateful.

name: Community Christian Church of Pompano Beach - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church in Pompano Beach!

This is a great church. Whether you have had issues with a church in the past, are searching, or new to town, this is a great church to visit.

The campus is beautiful, the people are welcoming, and everyone is energetic. I’ve been attending and serving at the Tamarac location for 5 years. The renovations and live worship at the Pompano Beach campus are amazing! I’m so excited to be attending here and meeting new people from the area. I love the way Community Christian Church invests in the kids and students, sowing into the next generation. Love this place a lot!! Super friendly people!! Fantastic music! Really good preaching. Easy to get to and great parking!! Wonderful church with wonderful people ❤️ Wow! This place is awesome! Completely remodeled and re-energized!  Just had their grand opening on Easter.  Everyone is super friendly and the worship music and message were excellent.  Vibrant, multicultural church.  Highly recommend!

name: Community Christian Fellowship - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I was watching your service online and was planning on making this my permanent church. However, I was disappointed to see the way the pastor handled a situation. There was a baby being a little fussy and the pastor said, "You know there's a day care you can take your baby too and you don't have to go check on them. The people watching them will call you if they need you." I was so shocked a Pastor said this during a sermon and embarrassed the mother. I'm leaving this review because I hope you the pastor will have more patience and not call people out unnecessarily. CCF Ontario is a very friendly, welcoming, spirit-filled church.  The pastors are great and not afraid to teach about the rapture or sin, which are both hugely important Bible topics.  Thank you, CCF Ontario for making me feel like a part of the family! The word of God is taught here the pastors are filled with the Holy Spirit and genuinely care for all Jesus flock. Worship team is amazing filling the room with Gods love to His people while giving praise and worship to God the Father. They also have Celebrate Recovery program here and Wednesday night Bible study. One Big Happy family being taught to be mature followers of Christ. Pastor Larry E. Is amazing! Great worship team! You get to Sing and praise before hearing an awesome message! The people are so loving, kind and friendly. Wonderful for all age groups, families and kids! I enjoyed getting what I Paid for.
