name: Community Church
reviewSummary:
Before I even visited for the first time, the pastors reached out by a weekly text (just to check in) and also sent my contact info to another special needs mom. I attended their support group recently, and it was such a safe space to share our own individual stories. It was therapy for my soul. Community church went BEYOND my expectations, and they were pretty high after experiencing "church hurt." This is a life changing church.  That is the testimony of this man, one whose life was changed by stepping into the Community Church.  One of the hardest challenges for a church this size is to love and care for a large and growing congregation on a personal and genuine level.  But that is exactly what they do.  If you're running hard (NoVa lifestyle), hitting all of life's big targets (keeping up with the Joneses type targets), but still wondering what's missing, I encourage you to come to Community Church next Sunday. We have been going to Community Church for a few months now. From our first service, this church has welcomed us with open arms. If you are like us and new to the area, or in a season of life where you’re in need of Christ-like care and support, this is a great place to be it roots down and be cared for. Everyone from young to old, families to singles have a place at church and are welcome here. We look forward to Sundays and leave service feeling lifted up, refreshed and blessed. We love our new church home!!! It is with great joy that I recommend Community Church to anyone seeking a place to grow in their faith and be part of a loving, Christ-centered community. My family and I became members a few years ago, and from the very beginning, we felt welcomed and embraced as part of the church family.

Community Church has been a tremendous blessing in our lives. The biblical teaching is strong, the worship is uplifting, and the atmosphere is one of genuine care and fellowship. The pastors and leadership team are faithful servants of God who not only teach the Word with clarity but also lead with humility and compassion.

Our involvement in the church has helped us grow spiritually and build meaningful relationships. There are many opportunities to serve, learn, and connect — whether through small groups, ministry programs, or community outreach.

We are truly grateful to be part of a church that lives out the gospel and reflects the love of Christ in every aspect. I wholeheartedly recommend Community Church to anyone looking for a place to worship, serve, and belong. I’ve attended many churches in my life but I’ve never had a Church Family who truly embraces me like Community Church does! Community Church and the encouragement from their spiritual leaders through sermon and worship has saved me from alcohol addiction and my marriage and family. No abundance of words can describe the love I’ve desired over the years from a Church Family and Community Church has delivered on all aspects! No matter if I’m showing up for Sunday service in a suit or all Denver Broncos attire, Community Church accepts me for who I am and are accepting of my authentic self!

100 out of 100 stars if this was an option!

name: Community Church - Brunswick Campus - Brunswick / Golden Isles Campus
reviewSummary: Probably the most hypocritical and superficial church I’ve ever been to. I’m not sure how they keep deleting the bad reviews they receive. I personally know others that have left bad reviews and their reviews are removed. I don’t want to share and/or expose any names but people they have on stage singing every few Sundays are also spreading gossip and insults about those in the congregation. Their staff has some very questionable moral characters and they don’t want it exposed. Instead of going after the lost sheep as Jesus did they’d rather just grow their flock. Typical. We are from NC and were headed to South FL for Spring Break with our 3 young kids. We were stopping in Brunswick for the night and I really didn’t want to miss Easter Sunday service so I googled looking for a church. We went to Brunswick Community at 930. It was amazing. The people were super friendly, the inside was beautiful and clean, it was easy checking in my children to their places, the music was amazing and so was the service. The music was a mix of new songs and old hymns with a new twist. It was modern but not so loud I couldn’t hear myself, which is my weekly complaint at our regular church. It was fantastic. The sermon was good and to the point and didn’t drag out. I liked how people actually had their Bibles, which you don’t see much anymore. My kids loved their area and had fun as well. If we lived in this area this is where I would attend. Thank you for a beautiful Easter service, a biblical message, nice people, and great music! Definitely worth going to if you live in this area. God is sooo good! I was looking for a Church for our family and thought I would be on a long search. God led us to CC-Brunswick the first week. What an incredible worship experience! Great music, messages, and ministries for the whole family. Looking forward to getting more involved and serving the Lord with this awesome local church! Warm and welcoming church family.  Great Covid Protocols and safety.  They preach the Bible at this church and give present day applications to live and learn by.  Worship teams are full of people that love music and mostly love the Lord.  Don't like to even think about missing a service! My 1st time going today & I like it a lot. Very welcoming but, not pushy! The service was short & sweet, with a great message. Great band too. I'll definitely go again!

name: Community Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone was so nice and welcoming. I loved the diversity and inclusive feel! You can feel the Holy Spirit moving. I felt my kids were safe and my kids can’t wait to go to church each week. The kids ministry is amazing. We love this growing church! My family and I love being a part of Community.  The environment is welcoming and friendly, the worship experience is amazing, and Pastor Nate's teachings are phenomenal.  He breaks everything down that in a way that is easy to understand and easy to apply to your everyday life.  I have grown in my walk with Christ because of his leadership! Such a wonderful place to worship! They’re very welcoming. We visited Community Church for revival when our Bishop Samuel Blakes was the guest speaker and had a phenomenal experience! The anointing is ever present! Pastor Young, we will gladly visit again. Been a member since 2014! This church will change your life! Pastor Young is the greatest pastor I have ever heard, gotten advice from, blessed in my classes with him and been given the amazing tools to become closer to God! I can't say enough good things. I have a second family and that is Covenant Church! Some of my best friends and favorite people I get to see every Sunday here. This church prides on changing lives and it is constantly changing mine! I love my church! Community Church is an awesome place to come and experience God and see first-hand the love that we as Christ followers are called to show. The children's ministry is top-notch with background checked staff and informative learning plans. The worship music is unparalleled and powerful. The preaching is simply life-changing.  But above all, come, taste and see the goodness of the Lord!

name: Community Church - Covington Campus - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Community Church is where you want to be on Sundays. The people, singers put you in a great mood. You can feel the presence of God. And best of all, Pastor Nate. It’s been a honor knowing him the last 10 years. Powerful Spiritual Worship and Praise Fellowship. Amazing Experience Ever! I am Always Excited to enter through the doors because I know I'm going to leave Filled with the Spirit! Dr. Nate A. Young is a PHENOMENAL SHEPHERD and Spiritual Leader who tells it "Like It IS"... Straight from the Bible!🙏♥️💯 Great Pastor people, love, hugs,, kindness, friends & Glory to God!  Great teaching’s with down to earth help in every day life & situations. Praise & worship & laughter. So enjoyable every week & learn something new & useful. Thank you Lord that you led me to this church!  Praise God over & over I was visiting my family in Folsom LA for Easter 2023 and they invited me to church with them. I am so grateful that they invited me. The members were so friendly and spoke to so many welcoming smiles. The music was amazing and the sermon was insightful, stimulating and fresh. "Fresh" you wonder what I mean; I felt the true meanings of the word and related to the style of preaching. Thank you all for sharing in your word. I have been a member of this great worship center for 12 years, and when people ask me why, my answer is simple. There’s never been a dull moment for myself or my family here. We love our Spiritual Family. They love on us as if we were blood relatives. We get Awesome teaching from our Leader, Pastor A. Nathan Young. We have awesome Sunday and midweek services. There are all kinds of activities for Men, Women, and children to participate in including life groups, bible studies, and many others. Everybody has an opportunity to SERVE. I thank God for the grand opportunity to be apart of such a loving spiritual family who truly cares about what’s going on with you, and will help in any way they can through prayers, counseling, and in any way they can. I love my Church! Come see us so we can love on you too.

name: Community Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting town over the weekend, I decided to attend the 11 am service before I headed back home. This church is the real deal folks. A wonderful worship team, a beautiful and inspiring message, and some of the most kind people I have met in awhile. I felt right at home and people greeted me without hesitation like I belonged there.

Thank you for what you are doing! This was my home church.  No longer is.  Try it. It's a great church if you have no baggage.  If you do, you may want to try a church that deals with conflict better. I have found this this typical of most corporate churches today, so I'm not singling this one out.

They are a loving, caring body dedicated to serving their community. The Minister was very genuine in taking the time to tell some things about a member of the family that had passed away I have recently moved to Goodlettsville and was looking for a Church.I liked the atmosphere of the people that were there,even though I had never been there they were very friendly I definitely will be revisiting Awesome Church. I believe we found it!! Really enjoy the sermons. The pastor is wonderful. & the worship is awesome! Feels very community driven. Everyone is very nice. Totally recommend to check it out.

name: Community Church at Sun Village - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary: A welcoming, non-denominational community.  Pastor Chuck is a great speaker, he and his wife are kind, caring people who live the values of Christianity and help me to do the same. I attend this church online.  Pastor Chuck's sermons (can be accessed through the church website) are very interesting and it's obvious he puts a lot of time and effort into them. Highly recommended. The preaching is top notch!

name: Community Church Atlanta - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been a member of this church all my life, literally since I was in diapers lol. I currently sing on our praise time, where the worship is always on point. Our Pastor and his family are awesome. When you enter our church you feel God’s presence and we make you feel like family. Just know at Community Church you are going to have an awesome experience!!!! Welcome CCOGATL's new "Rookies" - Cameron the Worship Art Director (on mic) Dermaine our Outstanding organist and who can say enough about our Worship Arts Coordinator Godfrey. Gotta Love em. Growing up here and meeting all ages of people along various paths in life made a huge impact with people that I greeted! Thanks for the donations too! God always has an open gate for His believers! I recommend this church to anyone. The people and the leadership are open and kind. They are passionate about building community and helping those in and out of their community. Also, there is plenty of opportunity to find your place and get involved! A warm and welcoming congregation. Authentic worship with God's love in true action.

name: Community Church Congregational - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We are so thankful for CDM Community Church Congregational and what a wonderful experience we had with our wedding! We love pastor Bob and loved meeting with him, if we didn’t move to Nevada we would have stayed with the church. Lesslie was a star in making sure everything went seamless with everything to do with the ceremony, just happy beyond words on how smoothly everything went even with little bumps in the road (I forgot my vail in the buss, had to hide coming to church from groom, he was wondering outside the grooms room. It’s such an amazing memory and I hope others will have the same amazing experience here too. We loved how charming, and beautiful the inside and outside of the church is and the photos and lighting came out perfect. Even during pandemic the church has a YouTube live channel set up so our family from back east could watch!!! I am leaving this review as a vendor, not as a church member:

I photographed a wedding at CCC on 09/14.  As soon as my team and I arrived to the church, Leslie (the church coordinator) greeted us, showed us the space, and went over important ceremony information. She and her assistant were helpful and a pleasure to interact with. They ensured that the bride and groom had anything they needed while getting ready in their suites and were always nearby should any family member had any questions. The church space was impeccably clean and looked beautiful (see attached photos to admire the natural light).  I highly recommend CCC to anyone looking to get married at a gorgeous church! We are incredibly grateful that this is the church where we became husband and wife; this church provided everything we were hoping for and more for our wedding ceremony. To start, the location itself is beautiful, with a natural elegance that sets the atmosphere which is both warm and reverent. It was great working with Leslie, the church coordinator: she was notably well organized and provided valuable coordination services during the ceremony, which freed up our wedding coordinators to focus on reception logistics. We also greatly appreciated Emma, the pianist at the church: Emma was so impressive in learning and perfectly playing several songs for us that were sentimental to our family and our love story and added really meaningful touches to our ceremony. Last but certainly not least, we loved that Kipp was our officiant: there is no one else like him. Despite our not having a relationship with him before choosing the church as our ceremony venue, Kip brought a warmth and kindness that made us feel instantly comfortable and blessed to have him start us on our marriage journey. Many of our friends and family who met him also commented on these qualities. We recently sat down to watch the video of our ceremony and were as touched by Kip’s beautiful sermonette as we were on our wedding day.

We look forward to coming back to the church in the future and showing our children where we say our family was born. A beautiful church for weddings! I attended a wedding there this past weekend, and it was a fantastic experience. The space was clean, the instruments sounded great, and the overall atmosphere was perfect for such a special occasion. The only downside—and the reason for my 4-star rating—is the parking situation, which was quite challenging. Other than that, it’s a wonderful place! We had our wedding there last year.  The location is ideal, but it's a wacky little church.  The "pastor" who was our interface was really the pastor's husband and had some odd quirks, so we had to fight to keep him from being prominent  in our ceremony like he seemed to expect.  Also they had a very odd rule of not allowing the congregation to take pictures during a wedding.  I mean come on, this is wedding!  Only those behind the last occupied row were allowed to take pictures.  Of course everyone took pictures anyway (smartphones), but man, what a weird setup.  The location makes for great pictures (which is how they make their money), but I wouldn't recommend anyone getting married there.  Too much weirdness.  I had another friend who had a  similar experience there too.

name: Community Church of Chapel Hill Unitarian Universalist - Chapel Hill Campus
reviewSummary: My daughter introduced me to this wonderful church and now I attend more often than she does....I love it! Whether it's the head minister or a summer sub, the sermon is always meaningful and often laced with humor, allowing us to laugh amidst serious topics. Great music is always featured, from the choir to pianists to guitar players--and attendees often sing joyfully along. Loving. And more then accepting, nurturing actually to me as a gender non confirming human so must be a kind and safe place for others dealing with marginalization and violence This is a wonderful place to examine your own beliefs and spirituality. It is a UU church that encourages people to continually search for their own meaning. People of the church are open to all and support a wide range of social justice issues. The staff is amazing. And if you are looking for a church with great music opportunities, this is the one. Also a great children’s program. Have seen several music concerts here. Parking can be tight but they squeeze everyone in. Nice room for concerts, big and open with good acoustics. At intermission the church sells homemade desserts and coffee. Friendly place and people. The people at this church are very welcoming and inclusive.  There are a number of great programs such as the covenant groups, woman's group, and activities.  Most of all, the sermons are inspiring. The minister (Tom) goes to great lengths to make sure that what he says is clear and organized so that I can easily understand his points and think about what he has said throughout the week.   After attending a service I leave feeling that my life has been made better.

name: Community Church of Greenwood - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary: This is where I have attended church for many years. The church is rooted in the Bible, and that is evident all throughout whether in the preaching, the kid's wing, and in small groups. The environment is open and inviting. O recommend coming to CCG if you are looking for a church home or if you are seeking answers about Christianity. Great service great people they are so nice and friendly and very welcoming they have an area for kiddos from newborn and up they are placed by ago group while you are at service and during Bible study they also have a room for nursing mom's and they have a huge fitness center with classes and things like Zumba and there is classes for senior citizens they also have child care for when you go work out they also have sports teams for kids to adults they also have many great opportunities for you to be a disciple great pastors and their sermons are really good and they have a really good live band that plays during service as well and they have a really nice easy to use app Pastor 'C' is a Real, tell it like it is pastor. He lives in the real world, not some make believe one where we are all perfect. He is the best most down to earth guy I've ever heard preach. We were going to 'shop' churches when we moved to the area but never wanted to miss a weekend to try out some place else. So we have decided to stay here because it just made sense. They serve the community with multiple programs and the people are genuine. My kind of place. Great people here! I love the fellowship here. Still working on finding a permanent pastor but otherwise the staff is really good. Definitely a great place to worship. My first visit to the church on 5-7-23 was a great experience, very warm and welcoming. I will definitely be returning, thank you😀

name: Community Church of Henderson - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
I love the Community Church of Henderson!  Everyone is so kind!  It feels like family.  The church offers Bible-based sermons and multiple Bible study options.  I love the old hymns that we sing on Sunday!  Sunday Service starts at 10:30am. Wonderful Bible teaching church. The pastor refers to and teaches biblical scripture weekly, encourages community interaction, small groups, Bible studies. Baptism by submersion performed Often. And did I mention the wonderful children’s programs-nursery through 12-year-old … something for the entire family.
Sundays 9 AM and 11 AM Services We were visiting our children and grandchildren in Henderson and they are members of this church so we attended with them as we have on other visits. Very friendly with a good sermon their new pastor is relatable and just an all-around good guy. Warm loving church.make us your home church and family.
Looking forward to meeting you. A Wonderful Church and a Loving congregation.

name: Community Church of Hoboken - Hoboken Campus
reviewSummary:
Grew up in this church, attended over 30 years. It’s a beautiful place to worship in the heart of Hoboken.
Not happy about the ever changing pastors every few years now tho. Growing up, the pastors had their own families and stayed for many years, and it was very close knit, why a constant carousel of pastors the past 7 years now Idk, but it doesn’t help grow the church community. More locals need to attend instead of doing latte and bagel runs on Sunday mornings. A group I'm in borrows the main church hall weekly.  It's a beautiful space with stained glass windows and a raised up organ in the back ( I haven't heard the organ.).  It plays a strong role in the community and the building fits well onto the quiet (for a city) residentia block. I am so happy I found this church. So welcoming and diverse. Pastor Sooah is amazing and always reminds us what’s important- love! [object Object] [object Object]

name: Community Church of Oxford - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary:
We look forward to the weekly Bible study. Wonderful group and Fish is amazing. The first time I visited Community Church, I knew I found my church home. You could feel the love in the parking lot. The preacher's name is Fish. He is not only a great speaker, he is a great communicator.  He gets to you, he makes sure you understand. He tells you about the love of God. The church has lots of involvement in the community. I have been attending for seven or eight weeks now and I already can see that they live up to the name of Community Church of Oxford. Community Church of Oxford is such a blessing! It starts from being greeted by the parking attendants, greeters on the sidewalk and entrance and then if you need help finding a seat they are right there. You will feel welcomed at Community Church of Oxford. When you walk through the doors you can feel the presence of The Lord.
All dominations and backgrounds come together for a worship and praise time through singing and then they have wonderful sermons that always prepared me in so many ways for the week.
Community Church is just that...reaching everyone in the community through so many ways. It doesn’t just end on Sundays when you leave. There are small groups, bible studies, children’s, youth, college, men’s, women’s ministries, missions and so much more. The outreach to the community is never ending.
Fish Robinson is our main pastor. He and his beautiful wife Beth and his two boys, Adam and Caleb are just a regular family doing what God has called them to do and are available for their Community Church family.
I have moved from Oxford and I miss my church family and what God did through Community Church so much. As I went to look at reviews of churches where I am now, I see the importance to voice my feelings of Community Church of Oxford. If I can encourage one person to visit OCC, that will be a blessing to you and me both. Praying for all who are looking for their new church home. 🙏🏻❤️ Wonderful teaching of the word 🙏🙏🙏

name: Community Church of Poway - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful looking church. The congregation are nice & humble. A wonderful old church. Oldest Christian, non Catholic church still in operation. Wonderful congregation but always trying to find itself and paying others to review, analyze and redirect. Soon to retire long time pastor. We can't wait to visit! I'm from Oregon and my nephew Marcus wants us to go. Early 5 star review, 🌟 to be continued...... My brother in law married his wife in this church 30+ years ago. It was beautiful. I hope others can enjoy this historic church for many years to come. Scout Sunday with chartered organization - great support for Venture Crew, Troop, and Pack 109! Sermon of course always a plus.

name: Community Church of Providence
reviewSummary:
Pastor Sara is absolutely amazing! This church is so warm, welcoming.
My family has been going through some really hard times lately, and the Community Church of Providence has supported us every step of the way. There’s been no judgment, no shame—just genuine love and compassion. They welcomed us with open arms and continue to check in on us daily, making sure we have what we need, even if it’s just someone to listen or a shoulder to cry on. I can’t say enough good things about this church. For a family who had lost faith and found it again just recently, I am beyond grateful for Pastor Sara and Community Church of Providence. My partner and I went to church here today and were warmly welcomed into a beautiful sanctuary.  The congregation was very friendly, diverse, and conversational.  The service had great music, good scripture pulls, and the pastor gave a wonderful sermon that didn't avoid calling out social issues as they are and was true to Jesus' teachings of community care, truth telling to power, and good mischief.  Lovely church and nice experience. This church is a safe haven...it is grounded in Christ's love and is without judgement. Pastor Sarah brings a heart of healing and reconciliation and Pastor Ken brings a heart of helping those in need and encouraging others. If you are seeking a true community based worship experience, this would be the place to be. The outreach is growing and if you have a heart to help others who are in need...your ideas and creativity to advance those ideas will be embraced. We all come to the alter covered in God's grace and mercy. I am a member of Community Church of Providence, I am advanced in years and have attented "Church" all my life. When i found Community Church 20 years ago, I found Christ!  Community church is now my family, it is welcoming, loving and caring of all people, something I never felt in previous churches.  Our Pastor is a friend, a confidant and a true instrument of Christ.  Please make a visit and see for yourself, you will not be disappointed. I have been a member for 20+ years.  They are progressive, while remaining true to their historical roots.  They welcome everyone and are far less prescriptive than you might expect. They don't debate the small details that divide so many of us. This is difficult to find today's churches.

name: Community Church Rancho - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: This place feels like home. Ever since I first stepped into this church, we have been coming here almost every weekend for over a year. People are friendly and welcoming, and the beautiful hymns are touching and inspiring, often bringing me to tears. There are different Sunday school classes for children of various ages, including preschoolers, students from grades 1 to 6, and teenagers. Every weekend, I feel a sense of peace and love here. Be careful with this church as it also serves as a home base for Legacy Christian home school/private. We were recommended to the school by what we thought was a friend from our old church WOL. We quickly realized the racial undertones disguised as “like minded” people. Including the different treatment to those that are white or light skin tone. Many incidents with multiple people in leadership to support our conclusion including our so called friend. They are not an “outreach” church as they say. They are not about reaching the lost as Jesus did. Instead those that they feel are worthy to be in their circle/click. They are about keeping themselves and their kids in a bubble. Didn’t Jesus teach us to go out and make disciples? Didn’t Jesus eat with sinners? This is Christianity 101. The mother, daughter running this program will need to stand before Jesus one day. I hope they wake up and repent. Used to go here a lot as a kid was a nice place.They've done a lot of upgrading Loving, accepting, caring church with people and staff who cultivate love, joy, peace, patience, humility, kindness, and self control. Great music, inspiring insightful preaching, memorable heart touching word pictures and video illustration of various themes and passages. Free coffee tea lemonade and treats in the patio after and between services with a generous number of chairs and tables in the refreshment area for comfortable conversation. The Pastor touches your souls, the church community is amazing! I’d recommend this church to anyone and my family and I do!

name: Community Covenant Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I have been attending this Church for 3 months.  These people love our Lord and everybody.  We search for about ayear before finding this Church.  They do so much for the community  Mexico and everyone is approachable. The pastor keeps me on the edge of my seat with his teachings.  If you are new to the area or looking for a down to earth great group of people to fellowship with, both my husband and I recommend you come check out our church.  William and Teresa Pernack Warm and inviting! Real people who truly care about you as a person and your spiritual growth. Highly recommend you to check out the service if your truly looking for a relationship with God and a church family. Absolutely a very exciting church and beautiful congregation. Thanks for all you do in the City for the Homeless!

name: Community Faith Center - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending Community Faith Center about 10 years ago. I stopped attending church about 8 years ago. When I decided it was time for me regularly attend church services again, I choose Community Faith Center. I contacted Pastor Eddie and met with me before my first Sunday service. This immediately helped me feel connected and loved.  When I attended the first Sunday, the church treated me as though I never left! Such love, acceptance, and kindness. As of today, I have been attending for three months.
Pros:
Warm and friendly staff and congregation, down to Earth pastor that cares for the need's of the people, experienced and anointed singing and music, lively and fun atmosphere during praise, diversity of ages, cultures, ethnicities, and languages. Updated facilities in a historic building. Sermons that bring life application. A mix of mature and new believers. Focused believers seeking a connection with a Living God. God honors the church's seeking and devotion with powerful manifestations of joy, understanding, and the gifts of the Holy Spirit. God's Spirit confirms His Word. This church believes in fun. There are children's ministries, youth ministries, and other activities to do and participate.
Cons:
If you are not used to a bilingual service, this may come as a surprise and a challenge to your worship. The service is equally English and Spanish. I find this an asset, but others may see it as too challenging. I encourage you to give it a try. If you’re searching for a church where you can worship God with liberty, this is the place for you. Vivacious worship music and anointed sermons that touch your heart and soul. You will be thoroughly fed Good the Word of God, and deeply enriched. You will feel the Holy Spirit- God is alive-Jesus is the chief cornerstone and the center of every worship service. I’ve been attending CFC for two years now, and I felt a very warm welcome from day one. I enjoy the Spanish music, language, and people. The church continues to grow, and more ethnicities seem to be coming in and creating a diversity of people. However, traditionally this Church was founded as a Spanish Apostolic Assembly which still prevails in a beautiful way. Powerful services, and a lovely serene presence of Holiness, and freedom to Worship the King of all kings, Jesus Christ. Everyone is welcome here! My home church absolutely love it ,there is nothing like being in the presence of the Lord. My pastor is a God fearing man and has genuine for his members and any who walks thru the doors Need a church come join us you will love it ,God bless. If your seeking for the lord Community faith faith center is the place to go.

name: Community Gospel Truth Church - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a place for those who love to worship The Lord Jesus and get encouraged with the testimonies of what God is doing. Also to learn about The Word of God and feel welcomed by a family of believers. I love this church.  They teach right from the Bible.  Come.check them out. This  worship atmosphere is amazing. I feel as though Jesus’s teachings have been well heard and received. May you keep blessing all. God is good all the time and all the time God is good!🙏🙌💛 Unadulterated WORD of God preached here! I love the freedom to worship in Spirit and in Truth, which is what the Father seeks. As we lift Jesus higher, our lives are being transformed from glory to glory. Come and join us and experience the LOVE of God, and where you will see HIS glory manifest! This church is where God reigns. A House of Praise. An atmosphere where you will experience God’s presence in real soaking worship. A church where the truth of God’s word is taught. The preaching is heart felt. Straight from the heart of God. The Pastors are the “real-deal”. Both Pastors Jerry & Maria are powerful teacher. I love them.

This is a place to develop spiritual muscles and grow emotionally and spiritually. I love the teachings. Hearing and feeling God’s word come alive in my heart. It’s a loving wonderful awesome     place to experience God as you learn and worship God together in unity. You will most certainly feel the manifestation of His loving, powerful presence every Sunday!

There’s always a special visit from Holy Spirit. He always joins us. God is always present. This is a place of love. Everyone is accepted and will feel connected and loved. “Come taste and see that the Lord is Good”,

name: Community Life Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
This place has bring me closer to God. I am a youth member and the youth group is amazing. The new pastor nit only gives the word but also simplify it and talks about his experiences. The people are always friendly. Just to clarify, I have been in this church almost my whole life. God bless you Motivational Pastor Mark leads inspirational sermons always tied to truth & scripture. I call him my Spiritual Coach.
Friendly welcoming community.
On fire 🔥 worship team.
They have a kids center and a children's school too now!
Come join us to transform your life for the better. I have gone to this church for 20+ years and now my husband and I are raising our daughter up here as well. Always a great time of worship! Many classes for children from birth-12th grade. We love that there are "LifeGroups" where you can really get connected with people your own age! Everyone is very welcoming and the Pastor is one that is very anointed and brings the word EVERY Sunday. If anyone is looking for a home church, I encourage you to try my church! I wanna say ,I thankGod for this church and its not just a church but a place where ,we can come as we are ,not having to come with a smile or act fake ,Thankyou guys for your kindness, and the love that the Lord has given u guys 🙏 Amazing pastor and his staff who preaches the Word of God with passion. This diverse church community does not pander to worldly views. A special place of worship with plenty of programs to be involved. Mens group on Wednesday is uplifting and they organize food giveaway for people in need on Thursdays.

name: Community Life Church Peoria - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful our family has found a church that not only preaches verse by verse of scripture, but also genuinely cares about our personal relationship with Jesus. This church is named perfectly because we have certainly felt loved and encouraged by the church. We hadn’t even been attending the church all that long when our second child was born, and the church took it upon themselves to organize a meal train for us! We even had people we personally hadn’t been able to meet yet bring us a meal to celebrate our daughter’s arrival ❤️

From game nights, small groups (biblestudy), Women’s Ministry meet ups and annual retreats, and serving in the kids ministry a couple of times a month, I have personally enjoyed establishing new friendships. I look forward to any opportunity to spend time with the wonderful people at Community Life Church! Community Life Church! Wow! We were looking for a church home and a pastor from a former church recommended we visit Community Life Church. What a huge blessing that invitation was to us. When we arrived on that first Sunday, we were warmly greeted and walked over to the worship center personally.  So welcoming!!
That was just the beginning! The preaching was Christ centered and met our needs on a personal level. We kept attending and felt that God was leading us to become members of this amazing community of believers.
We invited our nine-year-old granddaughter to visit with us. She loved it and began learning about salvation and making a commitment to Jesus. She has invited Jesus to be the Lord of her life and followed Him in baptism. She is thriving in the Children’s Ministry which is led by an amazing team of Christ-centered believers.
Other family members have started attending, becoming members, following Jesus in baptism. We are so grateful for the support found in this community of believers.
If you are looking for a church home or just want to know more about Jesus, then Community Life Church is a great place to start your journey!! Community Life Church has been one of the biggest blessings from God for my family. We were immediately welcomed in with Kindness and love to a congregation of Christ seeking people of all walks who want to worship God and belong to a church family. The children's ministry has been a huge blessing as well! My sons are learning about what it means to have and grow a relationship with Christ at their level, while having so much fun in the process. I have been volunteering in the kids ministry and developing friendships that will last a lifetime. CLC is striving to reach and support  our community in many others ways as well. If you are looking for a church to call home, please come and visit us! When I moved here, I searched for a very long time for a church. The day I walked into Community Life Church, I knew I had found my church.

The people are friendly and warm. The Pastor and staff are so welcoming and  take time to know you.

Most importantly, it is all about Jesus. The sermons are incredible There are many small groups and opportunities to learn, serve and enjoy activities together.

It’s a small church with a big heart. I have been coming to CLC since 2021 and have seen it grow in many ways from the volunteers, to the pastor, to the church goers, and even myself. From the excellent leadership of Matthew and his protege Noah, they have continued to work with me over the last 5 years and helped me grow in my faith. Going from attending church every so often to volunteering on the kids team and the music team, baptism, and personal counseling this church has helped me grow in my faith and lead to the baptism of my younger sister and younger brother. Going on 5 years now I have grown in more ways that I can count and am continuing to do so with the help of the church. This is a great and welcoming community to be apart of that shares the goal of bringing more people to love christ and spreading the message through our own actions.

name: Community Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Good preaching and singing.
Attended as a First-time visitor but would be comfortable coming back.
The Good Friday Service was really good. There was music and preaching plus various meditative stations around the room.
I like the level of volume for the music, and singing hymns is nice to. The music accompanied the singing rather than trying to sing along to the music; very centering.
The stations allowed for personal reflection and how Christ is available at any level since he was at the lowest on Good Friday and died.
Friendly people and meaningful experience. One of the most inviting churches I have ever attended. Very family oriented and inclusive of children.  Pastor Matt's messages are always interesting and encouraging. The love of Christ is truly felt in this church. I have been a member for 19 years and love being in this church family. Excellent church in a beautiful location on the hill above O'Neill Regional Park. The people are friendly and the Pastors keep the Sunday service insightful and fun. They start the Sunday service with inviting the kids up front for a children's message which puts a smile on everyone's face. The music is very high quality and I am looking forward to hearing Pastor Matt's version of Lutheran worship in a modern praise style starting this week. If you are looking for an online worship service to participate in, this is a good one. Recorded the day before by only five people, over time you will hear a variety of organ, piano, flute, french horn music and a clear proclamation of the Good News of God's love for all people in Jesus Christ. My family has also worshipped here several times. Full disclosure: Pastor Marty is my nephew. This is my cousin's church He's the pastor there in rancho Cucamonga California and I've been there a few times to watch him preach It's a great Lutheran Church!

name: Community Lutheran Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: I went here with my Oma and Opa and Sister. I loved every minute here. This was over 20 years ago. We attended for many years and of course my oma and opa have now passed. My sister still lives there in Omas and Opas home we were raised in. I hope she still goes here with her family. God Bless, Jesus is Lord and Savior. We miss you, Erich and Phyllis Wild. They reside by our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Long members of this church. -Your Loving Grandson Lots of kids today at the second service! The pastor does a great job relating the Bible to our lives now. I highly recommend this church. We felt very welcomed visiting in Escondido at Community Lutheran Church.  Message was on target and our whole family was graciously received in this congregation.

name: Community Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: THE HOLY SPIRIT ALICE AND WE'LL HERE!

name: Community Lutheran Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Caring people. Free food 3rd sat. Of every month rain or shine..

name: Community Lutheran Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church with great pastors and an awesome theater group. The sanctuary is large and beautiful. The Community Players Theater produces Broadway type shows on a small budget. Even if you don't attend church here, you should attend some if the plays. Nice and cozy church facilities, and lots of parking.

name: Community Missionary Baptist Church of Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Community Missionary Baptist Church is a Church filled with love. The Pastor Dr. Robinson is awesome. This Church feels like family.Always Praising God. Will welcome you with open arms. Your soul and spirit will be feed, you can feel the present of the Lord. You'll leave there with food for thought. God bless and keep you all. I've never been to this church,,I've passed by it many times ,and thought to myself ,what a lovely church!!I'
I will stop in and worship I did love the lady who played the  piano and sang. I was there for a funeral. Wonderful fellowship, great worship experience.

name: Community of Christ - Lexington congregation
Community of Christ - Troy Oaks
reviewSummary: I grew up going here and I love it. Community of Christ believes in gay marriage, women in the priesthood, and I definitely suggest just looking it up or coming for a visit. We attended a concert. It was a pleasant time. A wonderful place to worship.  A very friendly congregation. Nice concert for a great cause! Welcomed, loving to all of those who are searching  or are lost.

name: Community of Christ - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: Great space, welcoming, tolerant, and loving people. I'm from a Community of Christ in Michigan and I'm only in DC for an internship but these people have been really accommodating. LGBTQ+ friendly as well! [object Object] [object Object] [object Object] [object Object]

name: Community of Christ Church - Akron Campus
reviewSummary: Lot of nice people, ARC is really great too. Good staff, large meeting and the awesome Megan!! Perfect I want to hear for an AA meeting and it was a wonderful experience and I'm going to go back Good place to worship.  They deal with a lot of recovery as well.  Good place to recover.  Pastor is helpful & I've met with him many times.  Any church I go to, I like to sit down with the pastor & have a conversation with.  It shows me they have time for their flock. This place was a huge part of my life.  I lived in their recovery house. Stayed in recovery for 5 year's once I left. This place was like a home to me. I also played for their softball team for 3 Year's. They have a great recovery meeting Friday night's that is like no other faith based meeting. Very cool place to be. Definitely more like a family then just a church. This church is an awesome place of worship,great preaching of the Word of God, and welcoming to all people!! Recovery meetings available, Wednesday night worship service at 7pm. Felt like I belonged the first time I came to this church in 1995, I've been hete ever since!!

name: Community of Christ Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Caring and kind Very helpful and comforting in a time of need. Community of Christ Church

name: Community of Grace Lutheran Church
reviewSummary:
Welcoming atmosphere. Pastor invited people to open and read their bibles during the sermon.
Has both contemporary and traditional worship. Amazing community of welcoming people that genuinely care and enjoy getting to know you on a individual level. Contemporary and traditional style services held at multiple different times on Sundays. Lots of ways to get involved in the local community of White Bear Lake and beyond. Many opportunities to  connect with people in the church and make friends. Through Growth Groups, Volunteering, Next Steps, Bible Study groups, and,Youth groups. Or even stopping by to attend a  community event like the Annual Garage Sale, Easter Egg Hunt, Food Shelf, Diaper Drive, Project Home and, Hope for Haiti, just to name a few. Its a Great place to start/continue your relationship with your higher power. This is just heartbreaking and devastating to my mom and I. I grew up going to first Lutheran. Still to this day, it was the best church I've ever come across. We were heavily involved. We would be there almost every day of the week. My brother and I did wings, summer stretch, we were in the choir and we're in the plays put on by the church. Living in Wisconsin now and wanting my kids to have the same amazing church experience we did growing up, I decided we would make the hike and attend and join. Only to find women pastors? The bible is super clear on this. I just can't join a church that is going to bend the word of God and the bible to be acceptable to the world today. Are you guys an affirming church now as well? What happened here? This is not the first Lutheran I attended from infancy to 18. The Bible is the authority, not the world. Once you start bending on things like that to be acceptable in today's climate, who knows what else your bending God's word on. I would be leery of being lead astray here nowadays. Truly devastating. One more thing modern times have destroyed 😥 Wonderful preaching that is bible based but also applicable to every day life.  No drama.  No hidden agendas.  Friendly, warm atmosphere.  Yummy cookies on Sundays too!! My great grandfather helped make this church so 5 stars he did a good job lived to be 97 great man

name: Community Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
The upkeep of this building is definitely evident every time I walk by.  The place from the outside seems very neat and clean.  It is conveniently located near the local neigborhood and it makes for a great sight on any daily walk.  There also seems to be plenty of parking. Update of my review:
We sent all four of our children here. The teachers are kind and encouraging and all of our children flourished and were well-prepared for Kindergarten/Transitional Kindergarten after going to school here. I truly appreciate the family-oriented atmosphere at this school.

First review:
The teachers are so kind and work well with the students.  The work and crafts they do in class are well-thought out. My son loves going to school. Pat, the director, is great at communicating what events are happening. I am so glad we decided to send my son here. Definitely worth it! Beautiful place to have a marriage for under $3000 for rent. The staff will work with you and stay with you for the venue time. Great reception area too. Works with all food venues too. Pastor Ko know the Word well and communicates it with skill and grace. NICE CHURCH .
SURE ENJOYED MY TIME HERE .
MY BOYS EVEN MADE FRIENDS .

name: Community Presbyterian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing PCA church in East Louisville. I've visited many churches in the city after leaving my home church of 17 years and this one has felt the most like home. Super kind and welcoming congregation, great covenantal worship. Good mix of both young and old families. And the pastors are awesome! Would easily recommend to anyone. Visited there this morning as we are up in the Louisville area for the holiday weekend.  PCA church with lots of young families, but a good balance of seasoned believers as well.  Everyone was very friendly and I could tell the Spirit was in this fellowship.  Style is old-school Presbyterian (meant as a complement) and substance is strong biblical teaching (Psalm 4 was the teaching text but the whole service was suffused with Scripture).  Lots of old hymns, Nicene Creed, the Table.  I was very impressed and uplifted by fellowshipping there this morning. This is a growing church that dives deep into the scripture. If you're looking for a church where you can get involved and grow with your brothers, this is a great place to look. The leadership has gone downhill considerably. An overall terribly clique-y organization, and not at all how a church should operate. Wolves in sheep’s clothing. Covenantal worship, expository preaching, and great fellowship

reviewSummary:

Whe  I arrived in South Orange County I immediately wanted to find a church family.   This was the first church I went to.  I was amazed by the friendliness of everyone.  Since then I have participated in church life.  I have truly found the church family I was looking for!‐

.

name: Community United Methodist Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Been here a couple of times for the Pacific Chorale concert. Nice main hall that can seat around a hundred people. Nice big garden outside, and the parking lot is quite spacious too. Restrooms are outside in a building across from the main hall - clean and well maintained. Acoustics inside the main hall were pretty good. Church is easy to get to - pretty close to the 405. We absolutely love Community United Methodist Church (CUMC) in Huntington Beach! Each year, they generously host our annual Green & Clean Shred Event, a day dedicated to paper shredding, E-waste collection, and gathering donations for the Food Pantry. CUMC's unwavering commitment to serving the community truly stands out, making a significant impact on our lives and the lives of many others.

Scott and Philip, long-standing members of our team, have been part of CUMC for years and consistently praise the church's dedication to community service and outreach. Their stories and experiences highlight how CUMC extends its warmth and support not just within its walls but throughout the entire community.

CUMC offers a wide range of programs and events all year round, fostering a welcoming atmosphere for new visitors and regular attendees alike. It's a place where anyone can feel at home, embraced by a community that cares deeply about each individual's spiritual journey and well-being.

We're excitedly preparing for our 11th Annual Green & Clean Shred event in the CUMC parking lot, another testament to the church's support for environmental stewardship and community engagement. If you're looking for a church that truly embodies the spirit of community and open-heartedness, Community United Methodist Church in Huntington Beach is the place to be. Good to the less fortunate with real people just helping serve humanity. Genuinely kind & caring staff leadership  + members!  🙏⭐️❤️ A church that helps the least of God's people and Loves the Lord, they are very welcoming and actively serve to those in need on Fridays food and other resources .

name: Community United Methodist church - Santa Ana Campus
Community West Church
reviewSummary:
Several of our houses back to the Community West Church property.   At night, it looks like a landing pad for UFO'S with all the lot lights on, supposedly at 50% intensity.
The lights are disturbing and disruptive to our living spaces, health and quality of life.  We (several neighbors who are impacted) asked the church to do something multiple times and initially they replied "Hi! We are required to have lights by the county before we can occupy our building. We are trying to work on settings this week to ensure they turn off at some point in the evening and will be on a timer. We apologize for this inconvenience while we work through this."   CWC did not keep their promise.
The lights are on EVERY night and spill into our houses and lives. The lights are so bright that we don't need night lights for the bathrooms or bedrooms at the back of the house after dusk.
We are forced to buy black out shades to mitigate the light in our living spaces. One of their trustees asked if we had blinds. Blinds can't and don't stop the light.
Now we're told by Community West that they will have the lights on at 50% to combat vandalism.  Guess what, vandalism isn't the only thing the church is combatting. We may not attend CWC, but we're a part of the community.  We live here 24/7.  These are our homes. We're here 100% of the time.  CWC is here twice a week.   What about love thy neighbor? There's No Hate Like Christian love.
All the pictures were taken after dusk without a flash. The pictures are from my daughter's bedroom,  master bath, inside the house, outside the house and of our once tranquil yard. A yard we no longer enjoy being in. We're in light hell.  My attorney said, "It looks like a prison behind your house."

My neighbors and I have lived here 10-25 years, long before the church was built (2022). Maybe on Sundays the church can pray about a solution so we can enjoy our houses and sleep without the lights disturbing us every evening and all night long.
COMMUNITY WEST CHURCH, STOP LIGHT TRESPASSING ON OUR PROPERTY AND LIVES. Posting in support of my former neighbors. We've lived on the other side of the fence from the church too.  We recently sold our house and moved.  We complained to the church about the lights as well.  To say the lights were intrusive would be an  understatement. It's not isolated to one property.   The degrees of intrusion vary, but a number of us are/were affected.  When I contacted Community West Church, they said they were under no obligation to create barriers between our properties and the church. They also said it wasn't in their budget.

I once told my neighbor that "Yes, the lights last night felt like a torture tactic they use on prisoners of war."  The people along the fence between the church property and the houses have lived there long before the church built their building.  One neighbor for about 25 years and their house is impacted.  The neighbor in question for almost 10 years.  We were there for over 10 years.

The church certainly did not respond to us or our neighbors in the way I expected them too.  Doesn't the bible say the second great commandment  is "Thou shall love thy neighbour as thy self." If Thou shall love thy neighbour as thy self does not apply here, when does it? This Church was recommended by several members from a Bible Study group. Upon walking through the door I was feeling a little nervous as I would walking into any Church for the first time. I immediately felt the warmth and calmness while I was being greeted by many smiles. That was many years ago and I still enjoy seeing those smiles. I may get the longest commute award every Sunday but I know I don't have to go to Church. I enjoy going to this Church and feels more like coming to a family gathering. Such a wonderful and welcoming faith community. I’m sorry to hear about the lights and believe the church is doing and will do whatever they can to help the neighbors affected. Working together to help the community and neighbors will take time and I believe it can happen. I have worshipped here once.  I loved the worship and the message.  Great community church.  Blesses the neighborhood several times during the year as well as every Sunday.

name: Compass Bible Church
reviewSummary: Distinctly 'Expository'. Reviews consistently praise the 'Verse-by-Verse' teaching style. This is a destination for those seeking 'Meat' and deep biblical literacy over entertainment. It attracts a 'Serious Student' demographic.

name: Compass Bible Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has caused and continues to cause unbelievable amounts of harm to countless strong believers in the area. The problem stems from the very top down into most of the pastoral leadership and some of the staff. Compass has time and again prioritized image, money, and status over actually shepherding their congregation in a biblical and loving way. The lack of love- specifically from the pastors here- is painfully evident. Even more so when you are on the receiving end of sinful behavior at the hands of leadership. Great community can be found here, but one is immediately cut off if one dares to share how they were treated by leadership. The issues here are so serious that most other local Christian pastors are not only very aware of the problems, but frequently discuss them amongst themselves to try to best serve the poor souls that are fleeing from Compass to their churches for refuge.
There are also disturbing issues with the biblical counseling program here. Expect your information to not be kept confidential at the very least.
There is also a great lack of any accountability at the top of leadership here. No lay elders. Everyone who is an elder here is on the payroll and ultimately answers to one man. This model is not only dangerous for both the church and the man, but is also unbiblical. The culture here dares not question this man, but instead almost worships him. In an era of mega churches and social media chasing pastors, do not aim to follow and exalt one man. Instead, aim to follow and exalt Christ. There are some of the finest Christian men and women at this Church. I had the pleasure of meeting Joseph, who’s in charge of much of the music there. He could not have been nicer to work with. He takes a genuine and sincere interest in the kids who learn about God, and music as a form of praise. Good people expressing Christly character. 🙏🏻 Pastor Mike’s verse by verse in depth preaching has grown mine and my husband’s faith immensely! Even though we have moved out of state, we continue to listen to his sermons and other theology series as often as we can and are always convicted and inspired to live out our walk with Christ better! Expository teaching is over the top amazing and life changing.  I tell everyone Compass is a preview of Heaven and they really are my extended family.  We really care for one another ❤️If you want a church that propels your sanctification to a new level this is the church for you😊 I listen to the Compass Bible Church radio program called, “Focal Point” on the app and on 107.9 KMBI FM  Spokane.
I was blessed to be able to attend a National Equipped Conference in Boise a couple of years ago. I am currently watching and listening to the 2024 conference on YouTube and have been greatly encouraged. May the Lord continue to bless and keep  Pastor Mike and his solid Bible teaching.

name: Compass Bible Church Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent ministry and very 'open' and accepting new people into the church. Pastor is very committed and his sermons are very well spoken and and enlightening! I've been a Roman Catholic all my life and was raised in a strict Christian setting. I've been to many different churches that were different beliefs and have only found one church out of the many hundreds that I have been to that I would recommend anyone that asks me, to go to: Compass Bible Church Huntington Beach! The music is very good and moving. Uplifts the spirit! But, the pastor is the bestt part of the service.! He speaks the Word with REAL emotion and fills the room with his love of God and knows what he is telling his congregation! He is NOT talking to hear himself speak or crave the attention of the crowd! He seems very genuine and you can feel God's love through his words and sermons! And, it's spoken with true feeli ng, and in a way that is very transparent and makes a point of his sermons. He does NOT just stand up there and babble on about bits and pieces of a particular part of the Bible and not teach us something. He is feeding our souls with God's word and you leave with a full heart and feel uplifted! That's what it's all about! Learn love and follow God's word! Solid Bible teaching church where the Gospel is proclaimed every week! Awesome children's ministry. A church for every family! I enjoy the church and pastor Bobby's teachings. My greatest struggle is that I have tried to get into a small group, but the ball has been dropped several times on their part. I have gone through the foundations course, met with The person in charge of connection, and again put my name in with someone with the Connections group. I have yet to be put into a small group. 😥 It looks like I am going to have to pursue another church to get put into a small group. Feels like the Pastor Bobby back doors salvation. Like you’re saved by faith BUT you’re saved by works?? Idk I was not feeling that sermon at all…

I would avoid this church…watched the sermon online and the Bible is not being preached, but salvation by works is…which is something false religions believe.

Christians are not under God’s wrath btw…The whole point in Jesus dying on the cross is so we WOULDNT perish…not because we have the potential to if we don’t work hard enough.
JOHN 3:16💫🗡️

Be careful in these last days. There will be a lot of Pastors saying “Did God really say?” Like the serpent in the garden. Whether they perceive it themselves or not. But I pray those types of Pastors repent for making Christians think they have to work for their salvation.

Our works is evidence of our faith and we want to do it because the Holy Spirit lives in us, BUT just like Paul we will have moments when we sin and it’s because we live in the flesh still
( read ROMANS 7:19-25 )🗡️💫

We will never be sinless on earth, that includes us Christians. Sinless perfection is heretical and so is salvation by works. If the Bible says we are saved by grace through faith and it’s not of ourselves, it’s the GIFT of God not of WORKS lest any man should boast…we should trust that over false teaching…

Salvation is a FREE gift. 🎁 Amen! My colleague had told me about her church and mentioned they have a week long summer camp for kids.  So we checked it out one Saturday and then signed him up for the camp.

All I gotta say is I was blowwwn away by how amazing they made the camp for the kids.  From completely decorating the kids building floor to ceiling, from the performances, to the worship music/ dances that make it fun for kids, the games, they make fun unique treats and provide snacks (asked my son the first day what he liked about it and he said the bomb snacks 💣) but most importantly their mission to teach kids about Jesus.

The kids absolutely love this place and im so happy my colleague told us to check them out.

Everyone i met so far has been friendly and gone out of their way to talk with us about the church and even their own personal stories of what brought them and their families to this church.

I wish the adult worship had some fun dances like the kids side... I was too into it. 😄
