name: Compass Bible Church Tustin - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
We attend and love this church! The pastors are amazing and teach the Word as written from the Bible. The family atmosphere is incredible and growing by leaps and bounds. There is child care offered at each service, along with youth services at 11:00 a.m.
Also on Tuesday mornings there is Navmo (Navigating Motherhood) where Mom's are welcomed and gather with other mom's that provide practical help, encouragement, and friendship for moms. Join us on Tuesdays from 9:30-11:30 am. Navigating Motherhood is free of charge, where childcare is offered and breakfast is served.   Such a wonderful opportunity for meeting other Mother's. Great church that truly preaches God's word and strives to live out the Gospel. Pastor Elliott's expository sermons are Biblically sound and cuts to the heart. Pastor Nate is caring, wise, and compassionate. Awesome staff and people here. Friendly Staff had my kids going here but removed them after learning they share the building with a cannabis vape factory it should be illegal to operate that next to children Great Bible based church that does not water down the Gospel!  Senior Pastor Mike Elliott does an amazing job at making the sermons relevant to real life and provides practical ways to get to know others in the church and the community!  If you are looking for a home church, and live in Tustin or the surrounding areas,  you MUST check out Compass Bible Church Tustin!!! Fantastic church with a great pastor who loves the people there! This church is centered on teaching God's Word accurately

name: Compass Bible Church Tustin - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
We attend and love this church! The pastors are amazing and teach the Word as written from the Bible. The family atmosphere is incredible and growing by leaps and bounds. There is child care offered at each service, along with youth services at 11:00 a.m.
Also on Tuesday mornings there is Navmo (Navigating Motherhood) where Mom's are welcomed and gather with other mom's that provide practical help, encouragement, and friendship for moms. Join us on Tuesdays from 9:30-11:30 am. Navigating Motherhood is free of charge, where childcare is offered and breakfast is served.   Such a wonderful opportunity for meeting other Mother's. Great church that truly preaches God's word and strives to live out the Gospel. Pastor Elliott's expository sermons are Biblically sound and cuts to the heart. Pastor Nate is caring, wise, and compassionate. Awesome staff and people here. Friendly Staff had my kids going here but removed them after learning they share the building with a cannabis vape factory it should be illegal to operate that next to children Great Bible based church that does not water down the Gospel!  Senior Pastor Mike Elliott does an amazing job at making the sermons relevant to real life and provides practical ways to get to know others in the church and the community!  If you are looking for a home church, and live in Tustin or the surrounding areas,  you MUST check out Compass Bible Church Tustin!!! Fantastic church with a great pastor who loves the people there! This church is centered on teaching God's Word accurately

name: Compass Bible Institute - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I took a one-year Bible program at CBI & it was the best decision! I have grown so much in my faith & love for God! We not only took Bible classes but got to go on two trips including one week on the East Coast & a week & a half in Greece & Rome. I grew in my faith & made so many good relationships this year. I strongly recommend this program to anyone who is looking for a year to get biblical grounded no matter what they are planning to do for college! I took the year-long gap year program through CBI and would recommend doing the same to anyone in the post high school stage of life. It not only helps you become grounded in the Christian faith but provides a plethora of opportunities for service in the local church and personal sanctification as well! Along with that, the trips were incredibly helpful in my own personal life, both to Greece and the East coast. Understanding the foundations of Christianity in the US and then also seeing the Bible come to life by visiting Nee Testament sites was something I can use every day for the remainder of my life! Taking courses at Compass Bible Institute was one of the best decisions I have made. CBI is church-based, and you can really feel that. All the classes are focused on preparing you to help you grow and serve effectively in the local church. I took some of the Pastoral Ministry training courses, and I was given opportunities to preach, serve, and lead under the mentorship of godly pastors. The classes are all biblically grounded and faithful, and on top of that, they all transferred to the Southern Baptist Theological Seminary, where I am currently a student. CBI grew my love for God, his word, and his people. If you want to be trained in a setting that holds the Bible high, prioritizes the local church, and keeps Christ at the center, I highly recommend Compass Bible Institute. I was part of a one-year program at CBI and I cannot recommend it enough. CBI provides a highly devoted group of professors and pastors to teach at a professional level for a fraction of the cost. Each class had something unique to love about it and no work or studying feels useless, a big turn-around from my school experience prior. If you have any interest whatsoever in learning more about the Bible, CBI should be at the top of your list! Taking class courses at CBI was so informative for how I am rightly to understand the bible and live it out! It also was a great experience from the teachers who were interactive and experienced in the varying fields they taught!
Plan to take a few more classes there this summer!

name: Compass Christian Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
I just returned to Jesus and regained my Faith back in Sept 2025 and began watching Compass Christian ✝️ Church online services because of disabilities that prevent me from large outings and events. I was finally able to attend for the first time for Easter services and I enjoyed it immensely! I would recommend this church to anyone seeking a Community of wonderful people for gaining new Friends and Family. They have so much to offer for EVERYONE. They are non Denomonational and a COME AS YOU ARE because nothing else matters Jesus wants you and all are welcome 🙏 🤗🌴💒⛰️🎵✝️

We Love God
We Love People
We Share Jesus
💜💜💜💜💜💜 I live in Phoenix and I usually attend my church I’ve been going to for years. How ever, I work in Chandler and I took my lunch early to attend this Church. Everyone was so accommodating. From the moment I parked, I had someone offer me a ride to the front of the entrance. I met a lady and told her it was my first time attending. She was so nice and she offered to show me around the facility. She introduced me to the senior pastor and told him it was my first time attending. The pastor welcomed me with open arms. The experience was amazing. Today felt really special. I want to say thank you to everyone that was so helpful today and I will definitely be back again. GOD Bless As a musician, I have to be concerned with my hearing, and I bring my dB meter to most venues. This church was peaking at 90 dB (lawn mower loudness) at the entrance door to service. When they asked people to come down and pray while the band was playing, the average dB was 88. That's when the security asked me what I was doing, and I told them I was checking the sound because that level is hearing loss as per the FCC and OSHA. I pointed to my ear plugs, and then they put their hands on me and forced me to leave. They are asking people to come down and pray at average 88 dB (deciBels) and get hearing loss. My family and I have been members here well before it was called Compass, and it was known as Chandler Christian Church. Brian and Matt do an awesome job spreading the message. The new worship center is great, and I love the diversity of the congregation that attends. They’re baptizing people weekly, and this past Easter baptized 180 people! God is certainly doing his work through this amazing church. The music  wasn't as loud as I thought.  Still too loud for my ears but sitting further back and using ear plugs during the music helped. The sermon was inspiring. There is a bible study on October 1st that I am looking forward to. 6-9pm

name: Compass Christian Church - Louisville - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: This is a new and growing church plant that is still figuring some things out, but they have praise music from several styles, warm and dedicated community, room for the spirit to move during the service, and Bible based preaching. These people follow Jesus and will love you!

name: Compass Christian Church - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
The people here are friendly, caring,  when I 1st started attending they all welcomed me with open arms.  If you are looking for a great church with a small town feel, this is the place This is a friendly welcoming church open to all seeking to show the love of Christ. I love that CCC is open and affirming and when they say "all are welcome" they mean ALL. I turned my back on God and organized religion for many years, then I spent years of church shopping.  Joining Compass was the best thing I have done for myself in years. I have never experienced church which encouraged questions, and the outpouring genuine caring. I look forward to Sundays to attend - there is so much variety in music, pace, sermon topics.  I have learned more about the biblical time history and how scripture relates to our world.  Love not hate, hope not fear is truly the message. I know each person's faith journey is unique but I no longer am doing that journey alone. This church and people have gotten me through some of the lowest points in my life.  I am blessed now to have chances to ReachOut and serve God and our community. I have been attending TRCC since November 2015,  I am enjoying and feeling right at home here.
Everyone is so friendly and make you feel welcome. I am beginning to feel here may be my new Church home.
Letha Hendrickson

name: Compass Church - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary:
Too much rah rah & fakeness, especially with old pastor. Decided on smaller more welcoming church with real message of help & hope for ALL in community no matter ages or wealth. Church shrunk during covid & is rebuilding now, including the music & handbell programs. Great kids & adult  programs & participates in community program for warming shelter meals. (Also has a separate day are if you need those services.)
& currently is home to the Salinas Senior Singers. I like this church so much better than Compass which used to be known as 1st Presbyterian. Great place to worship:  contemporary worship music helps connect with God. Pastor. Todd preaches the Bible as it applies to us. Its a great church. They also have Bible study in English and Spanish My home church, so I am biased. Jesus is preached here. Ministries are for the community. Pastor wears Hawaiian shirts. Marina has a small intimate setting as opposed to the traditional worship service of the brick church or the concert style of the main campus. Laid back setting that just wants to introduce you to our Lord Jesus. Compass is a unique Church. There are three campuses one on Padre one on Main Street and on Crescent in Marina. There is one message about God's love. But matter where you are, watching on TV in your home, or while in prison, we are one family in Christ.

name: Compass Church Colleyville - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary: I really love going to Compass Church in Colleyville! It has made me feel closer to God. I also like the Bible Study classes I go to at 8:30 in the morning. I really like the band and the songs they play. I also got baptized last year in October. I like the pastors here at Compass Church in Colleyville. The best part is their coffee shop! Thank you Compass for making me feel closer to the Lord our God!😊👍 I signed up my child for the moms day out, I paid 400 to have a spot, then my husband got laid off soI told them we could no longer afford the program I asked for a refund or partial refund since we were struggling financially,  they said money is non refundable,  I ask if they at least could keep the deposit for  next year when we could be in a better soot they said NO!  Be aware those are the Christian values and compassion they have (none). Greedy church! All about money Everytime I step into this church I feel like I'm at home and the messages are always point on and the worship absolutely touches my soul and allows me to set the tone for the message Went as guests.  Warm and welcoming congregation.   Enjoyed the music and message. A great welcoming church with activities for all ages.

name: Compass Church North Fort Worth - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
We started attending this church when we first moved out to Haslet. It’s the best thing to have happened to my family. My daughter is in the 6th grade and since we have become consistent with Wednesday night church I feel her bond with Christ has grown. She’s at such an impressionable age and I’m so grateful this church has provided a place where she can worship and form bonds with other kids that put God first. I hear her stories of children crying from being moved by the Holy Spirit and it is such a beautiful thing to be a part of. THANK YOU COMPASS!! Plus they have the coolest pastors, attention grabbing service, & work books to make you feel like you’re learning on Sunday mornings. It’s enrichment in every sense of the word. Such an AMAZING Church! A group of people that know how to love like Christ. From the Pastor all the way down to the volunteers. The leadership of this group is unmatched. Pastor Nate and the Grella family are gems! The youth group is lead by Anthony and his team, your teens will fall in love with this group. The praise and worship team is so anointed. Your faith like my will only grow stronger here. This church is different, it’s here to love on the community all while helping navigate you to Christ. I can't speak for the church's religious views or sermons.

However, they have an amazing outreach by opening up their indoor playground during the day. It's a huge playground open from 9:30-4 and it's a great way to get out of the heat. Multigenerational, intentional, dynamic, candid, and passionate—these are just a few words that capture the essence of Compass NFW. The moment you walk through the doors, you'll know you’ve found a place to call home. It’s a community where you can truly come as you are, feeling welcomed and accepted from the very first moment.

Whether you're looking for a place for your kids, students, or yourself, or seeking to engage in meaningful community outreach, you’ll find the connection and support you’re looking for here. Compass NFW isn’t just a church or a building—it’s a family, and we’re so grateful to be a part of it. There is a place for everyone at Compass NFW.  Pastor Nate, Anthony, Marshall, and the entire staff are amazing.  God is doing great things in the community through Compass.  If you are looking for a new church or just a little curious, you are welcome at Compass!  Three service times to choose from on Sunday (8:30am, 10am, and 11:30am).  Join us early or sleep in a bit.

name: Compassion Christian Church - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
Have been to CCC many times as a visitor for vacation and conferences. Super welcoming, genuine and shepherding pastor who preaches the Gospel without any shame and loves people well. Amazing, amazing worship! Well, what can I say. Everything is perfectly orchestrated here. From the moment I parked my car to walking out of the door. The church is huge, and very crowded. This makes it into a victim of its own success. Apart from those assigned to talk to strangers, people here are minding their own business. I had a good feeling when I left the church, but it was the kind of fulfillment you get after going to the movies or a concert. If you are seeking a spiritual encounter, I don't recommend Compassion Church. If you just want to feel good on your Sunday morning, look no further. It honestly wasnt too impressive. Its felt more like a concert with the general vibe and the parking lot situation. The music was pretty good and I felt the spirit a little bit, but the preacher wasnt very engaging and his sermon wasnt all that helpful, it was more like "be a good person and do good things" type of sermon. Kinda felt more like a history class teacher than a preacher. All the cameras and special lighting equipment kinda took away from the vibe and they had WAY to many angles, it also made the sermon about being humble and not relying on riches feel kind of redundant. They weren't very welcoming and the most we got was a smile and a welcome. Overall we probably won't be back but it was a fun experience The journey was a great event put on by Compassion Church. A reenactment of the birth of Jesus.  You had the opportunity to go back in time and experience what it must have been like to live during that time. They did a fantastic job putting this together. It really brings the Bible to life. This was walking through an outdoor trail starting with Mary learning that she was going to have a child and ended with the birth of Jesus and the three wise men. Even walking toward the start of the trail, you were greeted by Roman soldiers who were not so friendly, just as you would have imagined them to be. The actors did a great job playing their roles and staying in character. The props were very detailed including walking through the market in Bethlehem and paying your taxes (which they provided the gold coins at the beginning for your taxes) and being counted for the census.  This experience took 2 hours to go through but very worth it. We will be driving up there to experience the church service at some point. We are not looking to change churches but we would like to see what there services are like. My family and I were looking to possibly start going to a new church. We found this church on Google and decided to give it a try. All I can say is this is not a church that cares about new comers or 1st time visitors. From the moment you walk in, you're lost. No greeters or anything to accommodate helping you navigate the lobby area. We finally made our way to the kids check in counter, and it was apparent that the people working this counter did not want to be there. Not one person looked happy or excited to be there, no one said hello, nothing, it was super odd. Well the odd behavior didn't stop there.

Once we made it upstairs to check in the little ones, we ran into a guy that was trying to speak as if he were Donald duck. Starts speaking to my 5 year old and doesn't even acknowledge us, the parents. Then he starts to direct us to the door to go into, and stops me from walking them up to the door to drop them off. There's some kind of weird line where parents have to stop, like me and my wife walking our children all the way to the door and seeing where our kids will be for the first time is some kind of dangerous thing to this church. Now, remember, we have never been here, we aren't from here and this is what we encountered in the first 15 min.

The service was ok. Again no information from anybody so we were unable to take the communion because we were unaware that they have the cups outside of the sanctuary doors like it's a newsstand. As if that wasn't enough, what really pissed me off was picking up my daughter who had been crying for most the time and no one notified us. As I was standing there in their disorganized pickup line I could see my children straight ahead but they had me in a line going around the corner to another room. And who do you think put me in that line, you guessed it, Mr Donald duck guy again. I told one of the members working the counter that my children are right there, 5 feet behind her. My little one saw me and sprinted towards me with tears running down her face. Apparently she had been crying for most of the time and instead of getting us, her parents, like we explicitly told them to do, they went and got her sibling. I spoke with the head of the children's area about all of this nonsense right then and there and she already knew without me telling her who was the main problem, the Donald duck guy. He shouldn't be working in the kids area at all. She apologized for the trouble. If you don't know how to run or operate a kids play area for a want to be mega Church, then shut it down. It's supposed to be fun for the children. Not something that scares the living crap out of them to where they feel like hostage and never want to go back.

After all of that, we stopped by the information desk to ask a couple of questions about the church. Again we were met with people who did not look to happy to be standing there. I was asking about the church's values and things like that, no one could answer me, they would only say, "I think it's on our website, or you can take the class." I would think a church would staff people at these areas that would have the knowledge to answer  new visitors questions. To me it also shows you have members that care and love their church. Needless to say none of my questions were answered. They gave us one visitor gift bag. And this concluded our first visit to this church. Never again will we return.

What I want to say is stay away from this church, but this still may be a blessing to someone else in search of a church home. This place really has potential if it truly cared and was passionate about growth.

name: Compassion Christian Church East Campus - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
Compassion Church is amazing. Ive been going here for 3 years now. If you are looking for a church to call home this is it, and they have a great band. Sometimes, they even have movies with free drinks and snacks! (For the tired people, you can always get the complimentary coffee.) Welcoming, friendly and informed leaders and congregation proffering a strong understanding and exploration of the word of Christ. Deep community and global involvement in spreading and practicing the principles of the Bible. Geographic locations throughout the Savannah and area(s). I called many but This church and Pastor Wingfield was the only pastor that took my sons needs seriously and my son was baptised today by Pastor Sisqo. I will always love, respect and support this church. True followers of Jesus are here. Very receiving. Pastor Drew was just called to go to Henderson Campus. He was a very good person and a lovely family. Today I visited Compassion Christian Church for the funeral of Mrs Virginia Woodward.
When I arrived the entire property was beautiful. The staff greeted me at the door, gave me instructions and from there I was seated.
The service was wonderful, the video and all music were clear and perfect!, and even though I was at a funeral.. the comfort provided  by Compassion helped me to get through a hard time. The bottom line is this…. They provided a beautiful Christian service for a beautiful  Christian lady. Thank you so much!
William Morris

name: Compassion Christian Downtown - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary: We are visiting from Seattle and wanted to attend church. We walked in and everyone was super welcoming. Great service and nice people. Would totally look at joining if we lived here! I love this church so much. My family and I just moved here, but you can tell that the lord is surely in this place. Wonderful people, amazing words📖, worship every Sunday. Great atmosphere and the loving, caring people you will ever meet📖✝️🕊️❤️ Awesome! Do you L ❤️ ve Lord Jesus Christ? Do you really want to get to know Him? Do you want to experience Heaven on Earth and His presence? Then I invite you to come to 611 West Jones St downtown. Come see us here. We are looking forward to meeting you.   By the way, if you are new in Savannah and/ or have any needs be ready to be greatly blessed cup we L ❤️ ve you. I go 25-30 out of my way to go to this church and I truly enjoy this church. The pastor is energetic and definitely holds your attention. The music well let's just say I always feel better when I leave. So with that being said. I dare you to check them out. You won't be disappointed. Have a blessed day. Amazing!!!  I really enjoy this campus location.  We usually hit late service on Sunday and go eat downtown because of the convenient location.  The kids love it too!  The ONLY time it’s “less enjoyable” for me is when they do a broadcast from one campus either live or pre-recorded on the huge projection screens.  As much I love hearing the lead pastor, Cam, preach… that part seems impersonal and makes me feel like I could have had the same experience from my home on my laptop.  But that doesn’t happen too terribly often!  Go check them out!!!

name: Compassion Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
Do you unfollow people from your instagram account because of what? Because you haven’t received a big money donation or because we are Hispanic? Thank you for showing me I was trying to find my path in God by going to your church. The only time we were welcomed with a smile was the first day we went. (A really nice lady was welcoming people at the entrance) after that we were just a family that didn’t exist there. If I could give -5 stars, I would. I attended Compassion with my family for almost 5 years but left not too long ago. This place is horrible and will ruin church for you and possibly even your faith, as it has mine. They only care about money and aesthetics. The Pastor's wife is extremely rude and doesn't care about anybody but herself, her kids, and her own little circle. She's very much into her looks and posts about her lavish life on Facebook, all while asking the church for more money constantly. Plus if you confide in them about things, she will post it on Facebook and play the victim as if she's in junior high. They take absolutely no accountability for their actions, even when they know it hurts people. But if you're not rich, pretty, or in their clique, you don't matter and they won't make actual time for you. And they treat their staff horribly. Also, if you have children with disabilities, you will be told to find another church and that they're too distracting, when people with special needs are literally some of God's most precious gifts. They have no heart at all for those with special needs.
I'm super sad writing this and I was a little bit hesitant to leave this review, as we loved Compassion and all of the people for a long time. But my heart has kept telling me to leave this review to warn others..
I will always pray for Pastor Myron and Julie, that they have a real spiritual awakening, because they will have to answer to someone much higher one day, and that's on their hearts. 🙏🏼 I've been looking for a church that focuses on the teachings of the Bible. I immediately felt welcomed and noticed. The entire staff went out of their way to make me comfortable. I was able to be baptized the first time I attended. They offered coffee and breakfast, I don't think that's every Sunday, but it was a nice addition. They gave me clothes to be baptized in and I got to keep the shirt. The lead pastor and his wife (the executive ministry director) came out to greet everyone after the service and made a point to thank me for coming and congratulate me on getting baptized. I am excited to go back this Sunday. I love it because of their own music playing 3 songs then tell the stories about out there to get involved. I visited on 7/16/23
It's a small family church. The people were standoffish, other churches I've visited the people greet you like a long lost family member finally coming home. I just didn't feel that here. The first service at 9 a.m. was going on   so I waited in the lobby filled out a welcome card and a greeter took it from me.
After first service I went into the church and waited until next service began at 10:30. Some people smiled at me but no one approached me and made me feel welcomed. I was there for the word of God , in which the Lord spoke to me by the awesome preaching from a visiting pastor. Overall the church is Nice and pleasant

name: Concord Bible Church - Concord Campus
reviewSummary: Welcoming and friendly church that welcomes everyone and extends service in English, Spanish, Arabic, and Tongan. Awesome church. This is what church should be. Very informative and inspiring. Visited many times and always enjoyed. This is God based and not a rock concert like many false churches out there. I love the family atmosphere at CBC. The love for our Lord Jesus is  powerfully felt among the congregation and is led by our charismatic pastor, Jeremy Cook. They try hard to change people and guide them to Jesus the saviour. They have a sort of daycare for kids too, Mon to Fri that helped us a lot during summer school break. God bless them! Great church with great diversity services in multiple languages and great children and youth department

name: Concord Community Church - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary:
When I came to Concord, I quickly noticed the children ministries for all ages birth-5th grade offered on Sundays. I also noticed the beautiful mothering room for nursing moms. This church really loves families!!! Concord has been our home for the last 10 years! We have found lifelong friends here and have been loved SO well by all generations of men and women that attend church here. Concord is more than a place to come once a week to say “you went to church”. Concord Community is our family. People that we want to share our lives with (the good and the ugly). So thankful for this church family.  Soon after my wife and I started attending here, my family went through some tough times with my Dad's decline and eventual passing due to dementia. That affects everyone, and is a lot to deal with.  Though we were new and hadn't done much for anyone there, people loved on and supported us in so many real ways, from meals and emotional support to helping move in and out of memory care, near-constant check-ins and so much more.  This is what it means to be the body of Christ.

Beyond that, it has been wonderful to see and be a part of a church that is intent on serving the community OUTSIDE of the church walls - loving and serving people that will most likely never visit the building.

Love first. Love Always. Love Everyone.  It's not a trite or political phrase here, it truly is the mission and action of Concord Community Church. “Love first, love always and love everybody” & “I love you and there’s nothing you can do about it”... quotes from the pastor. Need a hug? Need somewhere you can be accepted as you are and encouraged? Come visit. We are knowing, loving, serving, reaching...come see us and learn more. First time visitor recently. Pastor Jeremy has a very welcoming demeanor, very humble. He was a trooper as the church family poked fun at the day being his 40th birthday.

Worship was incredible! This church has an outstanding focus on missions and purposeful work in the world. If you live around Brentwood or Nolensville, I highly recommend Concord.

name: Concord Road Church of Christ - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church family in Brentwood, TN. Very active youth group growing & serving in their faith together as a family. Simply following God's word in worship, service, & relationships. You belong here! This place is terrific. I do not go to church there but my daughter goes there for preschool 3 days a week. Ms Molly is her teacher and she is so wonderful. My daughter is three and she is learning so much and with the socializing with other kids her speech has improved. I would recommend this place for preschool to everyone we love it. I am grateful to be part of this family of God's people. I'm grateful because they are friendly and genuinely care for people, wanting nothing less than truly following what God commands. Are we perfect? Far from it—we're as flawed as the next person, but we believe God's grace is nothing short of amazing and we're forgiven thanks to Jesus. If you're looking for a church family—look no further. There is a great youth program, college program, young professionals program, and programs for families at all stages as well as seniors. Preacher ain't half bad either. ;) Friendliest people around. Great preacher with in depth study of Scripture.  Outstanding acapella singing only. Meaningful prayers. Reverent partaking of the Lords Supper as easily understood by reading the Bible. Outstanding teachers for Bible study and examination for all age groups. Professional program for students with special needs and disabilities. Top ongoing security. Coffee cafe available during adult classes. Spacious.  Lots of Deacons administering lots of service work. Meaningful. I am not a member of this church...however I was visiting and was attending a meeting there. The staff was so accommodating and friendly. The meeting was set up for social distancing and I was impressed with the cleanliness.

name: Concord Street Church Of Christ - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended a memorial service there yesterday. Very lovely historical building and the congregation  was friendly and welcoming. The preacher was a great speaker and the singing was beautiful. We are members of this congregation primarily because it's a sound congregation. They keep the pure doctrine of Christ in the teachings and the worship service. We only follow the model for worship found in the Bible.
Second, the people here are super friendly, they make you feel at home, you leave with joy in your heart.
Third, because we like that there are a lot of children so our daughter can grow up with buddies her age.
Last, they have a Hispanic service, my husband and I are bilingual, so attend both services. Awesome place to worship!!! Love the singing!! Love the classes for all ages n the day care is very clean n very friendly n great community!!! You feel well welcomed n they are always willing to help you in any way they can!!! Real good for the Spiritual side!!!! So much Church activity n lots more!!!! It's where your heart ❤ has a real home!!!! Great friendly welcoming  atmosphere to worship. Was visiting family, but will definitely come back when in town for bible centered engaging worship and Bible class A little slice of heaven here on Earth. You can not imagine the love displayed at this church. Lots of programs for you to join and a mixture of people. The minister, Mike Baker, is also relatable but still scriptural. I love this church!

Update 3-31-2025
We have a new minister (not that new anymore but different than my original post). David Pharr has been such a blessing. He is the youngest minister that I have ever had but is filled with so much knowledge. It is an honor to have him (and his lovely wife Amber and beautiful family) to be a part of our congregation.
We also have an also youth minister Connor (and his lovely wife Kadyn). They have done some amazing things here at the church with the youth and provided so many incredible memories for us to cherish. Even though they are on the way out, they have left a strong foundation for the next youth minister to continue the traditions.
This is a loving church. Correction is done in love and there is a heavy focus on scripture.

name: Concordia Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Concordia Preschool ! Our oldest attended from 3s through Pre-K and she was way over prepared for Kinder. Our youngest is there now in the 2s room. Ms Danae is amazing and he is always excited to get dropped off every day.  It's a very small family feel to the school. They also offer before/after school program for kids who go to Camarena with drop off and pick up times that truly support working families. My youngest daughter graduated pre-k from Concordia yesterday and she is our second child to go to school there. I didn't realize how emotional I would be knowing that yesterday was going to be our last time bringing our kids to school at Concordia.

Every single person on staff to Ms. Schmidt the director, Ms. Rachelle the assistant director, and all of the teachers (special shout outs to Ms. Priscilla, Ms. Phyllis, and Ms. Amy) have been absolutely amazing.  Both my daughters are really shy around strangers and everyone at Concordia has made them feel safe and comfortable. Every day after school when I asked, "how was your day?" the answer was always, "Great!" or "So much fun!"

Thank you to everyone at Concordia for a wonderful experience and for preparing my daughters for kindergarten and beyond. We are going to miss the Concordia community! When you're looking for a church home, Concordia will welcome you at the door with a friendly smile and no judgment.  Pastor Schmidt's sermons are so easy to understand and follow, it feels like he's speaking right to your heart.  He'll say, "It's not me, that's the Holy Spirit".  Our family joined this church about 6 mos ago, and have been attending for over a year.  Their council and policies are transparent.  Nothing is hidden, and you feel the honesty.  Concordia does amazing things for its surrounding community.  Every member, from small child to elderly grandparents and beyond, has a purpose and can get plugged in somewhere to make a difference for and within this church.  Concordia's message reaches beyond the four walls, which inspires more Christ-like love and good works.  Live and love like Jesus. We were in search of a church and after many we had sat thru, we knew immediately that Concordia in Eastlake , was the church for us.
I love this church !! Everybody welcomed us and with true sincerity. Answered our questions and made us feel like we belonged. Pastor Schmitt and Melissa are so open and great . The services of worship have brought my faith deeper and there are refreshments and coffee after the service.
Bible Studies are available and kids are always welcome .
Thank you ❤️ for your words of support and I hope everyone reading this will come and see for themselves how our church can be a great part of your life . The people are great at Concordia Church!  Pastor Schmidt is very skilled at relating the Bible to our everyday lives. If your looking for a place you can feel welcome regardless of how experienced or mature you are in your faith, stop looking, you have found it!  All are welcome to Concordia Church!

name: Confluence Church - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary: The word is preached here with boldness and truth. You can tell there is a deep commitment to scripture and not just surface level encouragement. The worship is powerful and genuinely engaging. you really feel led into a space of reverence and joy. Everyone I have interacted with is sincerely warm. This is a place where faith feels alive and centered. I am not always make it in person so I am very thankful to attend through the live stream. I visited Confluence the Sunday after Thanksgiving. Very friendly greeters, great worship, and the message really hit home for me. The service went from 9:30-11:15ish and they gave everyone a chance to come to the front for what you might call an altar call toward the end. I don’t know if that’s a normal thing at Confluence but I thought it was pretty powerful and I’m glad I got to be there for it. This was the Christmas party for the s f a r c ham radio club. There were about 122 people that attended and it was a great time. That's about half of the club. It is always a great party with this group. If you are a member, the Christmas dinner and many other events around the year are free. The meetings are free for everyone. Really great bunch of people. The church is a good place for the club events and the club gets to use it at least in the recreation room without charge because we all bring a big load of food for the food bank. It is a very good exchange. Friendly and wonderful church! Pastor is wise beyond his years, bold spirit led teachings from the word of God. Great kids ministry and worship. Love this church! This church offers a truly welcoming and warm community. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the genuine presence of God. It's not just a place to attend services, but a place where real friendships are formed, and people genuinely care for one another. The atmosphere is filled with kindness and support, making it easy to build connections with others who share your faith. It’s a community that encourages spiritual growth, fosters authentic relationships, and makes you feel at home.

name: Congregational Church of La Jolla - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Love! this oldest, progressive & only LGBTQ affirming La Jolla church. The relevant sermans by Harvard trained Pastor Tim speak beautifully about our common humanity on this precious planet. Members of all religious backgrounds feel welcome & uplifted at this gorgeous church. There is great musical talent from the Director to the small Choir. A perfect Sunday, with the nearby Farmer's Market, & ocean activities. I attended last week. A very close-minded church that is more focused on political signaling than on Jesus.  Sad.  If you don't agree with their beliefs, you will feel unsafe and uncomfortable.  Really not a welcoming church A very close-minded church and pastor.  Non-welcoming.  If you support traditional beliefs and want to hear about God, not their political beliefs, stay away.   Way too much political signaling, inside and outside the church.  I felt horrible here. I felt so welcomed in this 100 year old church, where you get to know the people.
After church they have coffee, pastries and fruit in this lovely sunny room with the big french doors opening up to the patio.

The minister Sam gives sermons that gives lots of food for thought.
They truly embrace being open and affirming to all people.

I finally, after going to churches in different countries, feel like coming truly home in this church.
Thank you! We have attended this church when visiting from Canada on many occasions. We deeply appreciated Sam's ministry and wish him well in the future

name: Congregational Church of San Mateo - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary: This place is an ABOMINATION to the neighborhood. Blasting music and drunk people singing past 10pm. This so-called place of worship has zero respect for the community. If you’re looking for a place of worship that actually values kindness and consideration, look elsewhere! The church is nice. Northern California liberal take it for what it is. Always helpful and right on time. Thank you Lord😇 Come be part of this exciting place of worship.  We care a lot about social justice and have a deep sense of community.  We have a choir, an organ, and a dynamic staff that aims to serve. Love this Church Been a member here now for 22 years All are welcome to our Radical Hospitality and Love

name: Connect Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: We've been coming to Connect Christian Church for years. The music is amazing. The preaching is down to earth, practical, and challenging. It's delivered in a way that's easy to understand.The Children's Ministry is fantastic. My kids love going to church every week. They have fun and learn about God each week. Also, there are lots of different teams to serve on and a number of small groups for you to plug into as well. We felt welcomed the first day we decided to attend. We still feel welcome years later. It's a great place! I have been a part of Connect for over 9 years. I love my church, but it may be more accurate to say I love my Connect family. The children's program has helped my kids grow and they love going each week. My oldest is now excited to be a part of the student ministry (6th-11th grades). Connect groups provide my family the chance to do life with others. If you are looking for some fantastic preaching that is full of love, truth, and a little bit of 'did he really say that' than this is the place. Finally, the worship band is amazing and I am blessed each week by their rocking talent. We've been coming for years, and I can't say enough good things. Down-to-earth, relatable preaching, awesome worship music and lots of ways for our kids to put their faith into action. Definitely check out this church, especially if you aren't afraid to get involved. There are tons of really active teams to serve on, but more than anything, we love the people! Dawn and I have been part of Connect since its inception.  Connect is all about connecting people to Jesus and leading them into a growing relationship with Him. Basically, it is all about Jesus at Connect!  At Connect, you’ll find a place where you’ll be welcomed, a place where questions and doubts are okay, a place where you can encounter God in a powerful way, and a place where you can find, connect and serve with people on the same journey as you. Come and check us out. I love my church.  I always feel welcomed and my kids have found Jesus in all the partners that volunteer their time.  It is my second family.

name: Connect Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
I really love this church.
Especially the presence of God.

I truly enjoy the sermons, and the worship is very powerful as well.
But what touches me the most is God’s presence in this place.

I haven’t been attending this church for very long, but there hasn’t been a single time when I didn’t feel the presence of God there. This church presents itself as a place of love, yet consistently treats homosexual and same-sex couples as lesser, broken, or unworthy of God’s grace. That contradiction cannot be ignored. Love that is conditional is not love at all. When people are made to feel that who they are disqualifies them from belonging, the damage is deep, and lasting.

What is most troubling is the hypocrisy. This community speaks often of grace, mercy, and humility while practicing judgment, exclusion, and quiet cruelty. Jesus spent His life rebuking religious leaders who elevated rules over people and righteousness over compassion. He sat with those deemed “unacceptable” by society and reserved His harshest words not for the marginalized, but for those who used faith as a weapon. By that standard, this church has aligned itself far more with the Pharisees than with Christ.

If Jesus were present today, He would not be proud of words that shame, divide, and wound. He would not recognize Himself in teachings that deny the inherent worth of people created in God’s image. Until this church confronts the harm it causes and chooses love without qualifiers, it cannot honestly claim to reflect the heart of Christ—only the fear and prejudice of those speaking in His name. Great church for the whole  family! Family oriented and value the next generation. Very welcoming and loving church people even the leaders would love connecting to everyone. We feel at home the first Sunday we step in to the church, we did not leave the church. A spirit filled and Bible based church. This church is truly unique, and we’re so grateful it’s close to home. We’ve been attending for over a year and feel deeply connected. No wonder they changed the name to Connect Church! Pastor Jason has a remarkable way of preaching the Word, and there’s something distinct about this community. The people are incredibly friendly, and you can genuinely feel the Holy Spirit at work here! Very nice church! Visited here to see my old pastor preach a special service & the hospitality was wonderful. Definitely a place that I’d recommend for anyone in the area who needs a new home church.

name: Connected Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been members over five years. We are thankful for Connected Church family!

Christian worship and fellowship. We receive inspiration and Biblical principles for Spiritual development , growth,  and opportunities to share  love and support to each other and our community. Pastor has always been really great and I appreciate that. However, some of staff are very rude! It's Easter! I was actually invited to come and worship God. I did not to come to deal the freshly attitudes of Seth and Gayla. If I hadn't prayed and God told me to stay I would have already left! I'm not perfect nor will I ever be but I do not treat them any other way as brother and sisters in Christ. I'm very ashamed of them as staff. I'm posting this because they've already caused one person to stumble and they won't be back. I'm sure I won't either aftet this. So yeah, I'm sitting in service now praying that someone will read this and address the issue. I just came to simply worship God  without an attitude.. Very pleasant church and people are friendly and very approachable.   Wonderful message from the pastor who is a very good speaker. Music was traditional and overall a pleasant experience. This is a really great place to be to get the Word, fellowship, and the love of God. People are allowed to use their gifts here.  And, God is moving in this place!  I want to clarify the post by Braian. He is not talking about The Life Church. The people he is referring to attend another church in Bloomington.  I know because I attended that church. Beautiful church that seeks to make a difference in people's lives. Pastor Carter is a great speaker and obedient to deliver God's message in a way that you can understand.

name: Connected Life Christian Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
We had an amazing experience at this church! The gospel was preached faithfully, the worship was powerful, and the hospitality was top-notch. Our kids loved the children’s ministry as well. We’re especially thankful for the church’s heart for local missions.

Hoops on Mission Boca Raton coming soon! I love this church!  Been coming here for almost three years and it is definitely turning into my church family.  Pastor Nhu and his family are so dedicated to bringing the Word of God to everyone!  When you are there you feel like you are at home in so many ways.  Women’s Bible Study is wonderful also.  Everyone is so friendly and kind. I love Connected Life  Church in Boca If you want to go to a church where you will learn about God and Jesus directly from The Bible in a clear-cut and easy to understand way this is the church for you! Pastor Nhu makes everything make sense! The people who go here are warm and inviting. I have learned so much and my faith has grown immensely in just over a year. You may need to give it a few Sundays to feel what I feel🙃 My home church since 1968. Update on my original post. The pastors name is Nhu Nugyen. Our family has lived back and forth between boca and the Carolinas and always comes back. A great place for those new to church or those that have grown up in church, everyone growing and learning together.

name: Connecting Point Church - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary: Connecting Point Church is a place that I get to call home. From the moment I arrived there, everyone was kind and caring, and on a level more than just a standard hello and smile. I always feel accepted and loved, no matter how I arrive to church. "Come as you are," is the best way to describe the atmosphere. I love this place, and I come down from college to visit every time I get the chance. I recommend this place for all who seek the Lord, desire good fellowship, and want a place to be comfortable and to call their home church. A wonderful place to experience the true meaning of WORSHIPPING GOD. The pastor and his wife and family are leading the way of true Christian living. I am so blessed to have such a wonderful church!!!!!!. All of the fellowship are kind and loving, PLEASE COME FOR A VISIT, you will feel right at home. GOD BLESS YOU AND YOUR FAMILY. I TRULY APPRECIATE OUR CHURCH. PLAN A VISIT, WE WILL BE LOOKING FOR YOU!!!!!!! I have been looking for an accepting (of out of state people), non-denominational church for over 20 yrs. We HAD to move here for my husbands job w/Delta. We had tried 3 different churches, being called names, ignored, pushed aside, & not included. To the point where my husband said, "That's it, no more churches in the south". All because we weren't raised here. Where we came from, everyone fought to get time w/the new family. Ironically one was from Ga. We tried one in Griffin, where we 1st lived, one in Fayetteville (which was so politically ran by the wealthiest family) (?) After moving to McDonough, I tried 3 more. Nothing & no one seemed to notice me! Soo far from what we were used to in Ore. 20-30yrs ago. Everyone was friendly there. Now, the city of Portland is such a liberal sewer, we never plan to go back! I was going to a church still listed online, only to show up and find it closed. I was all dressed & ready for church, I looked one more time online. I found a small, but BIG at heart church off the Henry Co. Sheriff's parking lot, called Connecting Point. It had all we wanted. Contemporary music w/band & awesome message! That was almost a yr ago, & we both go when my husband isn't flying. I go alone the rest of the time! Pastor Randy got us envolved in an app  w/sooo much to it, including reading bible in one year!! It caused me to look up our fav Christian rock/pop bands we listened to in the 90's w/our kids. Im now hooked on Toby Mac (his words pack a punch!), the bible app, & have for 1st time in over 20yrs, have found Peace, most importantly "JOY"!! I spread that joy every day like Confetti. Doesn't cost a dime to bring a smile or Joy to someone's life! That's my goal, to "be the light" in this dark & ugly world! It's free, & helps me too! I don't hold any bitterness anymore to the South. It only hurt me. We still get pushed aside, called names, etc... but my JOY keeps me going everyday! Connecting Point is such a warm and welcoming place. The people are friendly, band is awesome and every time Randy speaks I feel connected. Definitely recommend! It's taken me many years to find a church that had the right music, nice people, and wonderful women who have embraced me! Always a good msg.

name: Connecting Point Community Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
A place to feel, know, and experience God’s presence not just on Sunday but every service and location. CP has blessed and changed my life for the better. My walk with God has increased day by day.. I have never ever met a pastor that cares and loves so much for an individual. Also, the worship department rocks! I love this church! A place to feel, know, and experience God’s presence not just on Sunday but every service and location. I have never ever met a pastor that cares and loves so much for an individual. Also, the worship department rocks! I love this church! WOW. Been going to Connecting Point for 2 years now. I can't stand missing service. You can feel the presence of God every service if you give him the Praise he deserves. We also get the deepest Bible studies you can ever imagine. I love the fact that the Church isn't there to entertain me, it's there to entertain God so we can encounter him. Pastor Pounds shoots straight from the Word of God and that's what I really need. He is truly led by the Spirit and a man after God's Heart. Come and Visit one time and you'll see what I'm talking about.

More important, you will always see their Consistent* love for God and eachother. Experience it for yourself, the whole church crowd is friendly and welcoming. A strong Spirit Led church . name: Connection Christian Church - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary: I grew going to this church. They are a wonderful caring kind Christian community that truly desire to help everyone find their way to salvation. I love Danny and Carmen V. What a blessing to know them! We left a large contemporary church because of the lack of depth and teachings of the Bible. Danny the Senior Pastor does an excellent job bringing God's Word to terms that a non-Christian or new Christian can relate to. The worship service is contemporary and brings the place alive! Their children's and youth programs are phenomenal. My 2nd and 6th grade kids love coming to church to learn about Jesus. We feel blessed we found them! My home church..Love it! Warm, friendly people who really care.  They teach & share God's Word from the Bible providing direction for life.  There are a variety of teaching/learning/sharing options available for adults & children - stop by and see us.  God loves you! The church allows use for outside events during its off-hours.  This was for the 2018 Enchanted Care preschool Tap and Tumble recital.  Great atmosphere! Christ centered preaching and teaching.  Love the friendly congregation.  I am proud to call Hilliard Church of Christ my church home.

name: Connection Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
My son had invited me to come to church. The one thing that stood out to me was the Pastor of the church even though he was sick God still used him to minister to the congregation it showed me that he was a true man of God and a selfless person not a selfish person I will be visiting this location again I recommend anyone who want to fellowship and give their life to the Lord. The pastoral staff is so knowledgeable, and caring towards their flock. The members are warm and welcoming, they make it a point to learn your name and encourage you to become a part of the church family.
If you’re looking for a home church or a place to fellowship, Connection Corona is an amazing place to visit. Great church! I’m so glad I found this community. Everyone is so welcoming, inviting, and intentional. It truly feels like a family. The worship is spirit led and powerful, and the pastor teaches the true Word of God with conviction and with love. We visited this church and I loved it because of the strong teaching of the Pastor. My oldest son was in a different place emotionally and spiritually, perhaps because we were leaving our very large church where he was not really engaged. He did not want to stay. Our youngest son loved it because as long as he got to play in the children’s ministry and get snacks he was fine!
We returned after the pandemic and joined. I loved the strong teaching. The size was perfect for us to get involved and enjoy! That was November 6, 2022. name: Connection Church Longmont - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone was so welcoming and made you feel included. The worship was top notch. If you haven’t found a church home, I highly recommend. This is a great church; the pastor’s sermons are are very down to earth, easy to understand, and encouraging. I left feeling so much better than when I entered the building, I felt feeling loved.  The pastor’s wife is truly a lovely person, be sure to meet her. very welcoming church, everyone is welcome. Felt right at home very quickly. At first I was definitely nervous but the Pastor and his team did not hesitate to make this my second home. These are some of the nicest people I’ve ever met! They truly love and welcome everyone and have such a heart for the Lord! If you live in Longmont I definitely recommend trying this church out, you won’t regret it!

name: Connection Church Richmond Hill - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: We stopped here for Easter service while traveling away from home. Everyone was very welcoming and genuinely glad to have us. The pastor was great and took some time to speak with us after service. He believes in letting God’s word speak for itself (surprisingly not all churches do that). If you’re looking for a church that teaches the Bible and where you won’t just be a nameless face on Sunday, come check them out! A beautifully led and Christ filled church. I attended once and never left! My children love Sunday School with their age groups. If you are looking for sound biblical teaching and fulfilling fellowship, I do believe Connection Church at Richmond Hill is worth a visit. A wonderful church with wonderful people that takes worshipping the wonderful God of the Bible seriously. This is great growing church with a wide variety of opportunities for both children and adults. I would definitely recommend this church to anyone searching or “church shopping”. Give it a try! A great church and they have one of the friendliest and inviting congregations I've ever encountered. The pastor is an  amazing speaker and genuinely one of the most likable guys you will ever meet. My wife and especially my young girls absolutely love it here and it has done wonders for them in how they behave and view the world. their youth program is fantastic! Been going here for awhile now and I must say, this is not your typical church. Everyone is welcome and that wholesome feeling starts when you walk through the door. Live music and worship makes a difference. The Pastor is relatable and speaks God's Word directly to the members every Sunday Service. This is the best Church for me and my family. I feel connected and leave filled with the Spirit every visit. God has blessed this fold.

name: Connection Point - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: My wife, Luz, and I had a wonderful experience at this church this morning.  We were invited by my colleague,Tim, and we were very happy that God gave us the opportunity to attend. Pastor Dane's sermon on learning the Word, loving the Word and sharing the Word (taken from Ezra) was inspiring.  If you want a welcoming, nurturing and inspiring experience, I recommend you try this church. Awesome small church with powerful worship and anointed Word. Love the people there, very welcoming... & great services Pastor Dane is the best Great place to connect with God.
