I loved the relaxed come as you are feel, the welcoming spirit, the music and above all the sermons which always resonated with me and kept me coming back each week eager to hear more. Try this church—you won’t be disappointed. Right off of I-80 (Pena Adobe exit). Totally enjoyed this church. The music is fantastic. My grandson thought it was a concert. Pastor John's compassion for God and those in the church is evident in his preaching. All are welcome. We've been attending New Life for 8 years. They are like a life application bible, where you receive the message in a way that is practical for for daily living, and breathes life into you, as you go closer to Jesus!

name: Connection Pointe Christian Church - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
No church is perfect but this is full of genuine believers practicing their faith.
Concert style worship, excellent teaching. There are many good ministries  within the church. Youth ministry is thriving. The facilities are nice without being extravagant and are well maintained. This place is well used by many people. Arrive early as the parking fills up and you want to find yourself good seating for theain services. I’ve been attending this church for 22 years. It has been a great church throughout the years. I enjoyed pastor Steve back in the day and I enjoy pastor Ron. However this year pastor John has seemed to shift the focus away from Christ and more towards politics. First he spent a whole month doing sermons that begged the congregation for as much money as they could give so they could continue to buy more real estate and expand their campus. Then a couple months later he did 2 sermons that were almost purely political where he bashed other faith communities and ideologies that were different from his own. This completely contradicts scripture.  As Christians we should not be hating on other religions besides satanism. I would love to stay with this church but I’m worried about the direction it is going in. Great message and the worship music was stellar!  The band is phenomenal We have been attending CP for about 6 years. We love this church. Yes, it is a large church. That made me apprehensive to join such a church as I was raised in a small congregation. What is clear to me now is that a large church gives everyone an ability to serve and make connections with others. The pastors preach faithfully from the bible and weave the gospel message into their sermons often. I would recommend to anyone who is apprehensive of attending a large church. They have wonderful programs for all ages, but what I appreciate the most is they are faithful to the word of God. It is clear from the day 1 that they want to make Jesus followers (for life) and they understand and respect that we all have our struggles. Regardless of wherever you are in your faith, even if you have no faith, you should feel welcomed and treated well at CP. Great message from a Church that gives so much to the community and it's residents.

name: Connection Pointe Christian Church Avon - Avon Campus
reviewSummary:
My family keeps telling me to audition for the worship team. They seem to have a lot of fun. This church has helped me get to know Jesus in a way that is really refreshing. My wife and I are normal people, been going for about a year now and have heard so many stories of people's lives being changed. Never felt the pressure to say or do anything weird/religious while being part of small groups or asking questions about God. They have also followed all the Covid guidelines and had janitors sanitize after every service, if that's something you care about. We have been attending Echo for 6 months.  The members are very caring.  The messages are directed and powerful.  The worship team is talented.  It has been a great experience to be part of a new church plant.  Everyone is welcome to visit and make Echo your church home.  Starting Aug. 5th, 2018 services will be at 9 and 10:30 at the Avon YMCA! I started going to this church when I would go to the gym at the YMCA to workout every few days. Everytime, I would see the signs all around the Y and I finally decided to join the service one Sunday back in December last year.
If this tells you anything about Echo, I rarely go to the gym to workout anymore, but instead I’m at the Y every Sunday for the service. It’s ’s amazing and has done works for my entire family!
Ironically, I put down a good habit of exercising, but from Echo church I have picked up an even better habit for worshiping and connecting spiritually within. Echo really is home and I couldn’t be happier! I was attending Heartland Church before I moved to Brownsburg in Oct. 2017. The Senior Pastor at Heartland took up an offering for ECHO Church, which I took as an endorsement, and motivated me to attend for the first time. I have been very pleased with Pastor Chad's teaching, which is very insightful and relevant to your life. I also enjoy the worship music. I understand they have an excellent children's ministry. ECHO voluteers are very friendly and make you feel at home. The church also has small groups, where you can connect with and get to know others better, while discussing the prior week's message. Have been looking for a church home for a while. Echo has the small, close feel while delivering powering worship, spiritually challenging sermons, and Echoing God's love to all who join!

name: Connection Pointe Christian Church Fishers - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: Every one was so friendly & welcoming.  Felt like home. It is a nice place ,plenty of parking. You can donate to them . Great friendly church! I love CP! Great church.

name: Connections Christian Church - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
We wanted to hear The Bible proclaimed. Share Communion every Lord's Day. Opportunities to grow stronger in Christ. New ways to serve. And to top it off, a place that felt like home (we were basically looking for the sun, the moon and the stars). The morning we found ourselves at  Connections, we knew it was right. Jeff, Carolyn, the Music Team, Elders and Children's Ministry are warm & welcoming, but most importantly: At Connections, you will hear about Jesus. And how His love can change your life now and forever. A great community of Christ-followers. Jeans to suits, people come as they are, and are welcomed and loved. A live band plays traditional to CCM to self-written songs. A diverse congregation worshipping God. Not Heaven on earth, but we try to point the way. Join us! I ran across these reviews as I was looking up the address to send flowers for a funeral. Totally incorrect information. As we know there are evil people around us and you try to think that they're there to worship God.. You must overlook them and realize we should be worshiping and praising God every day. That  makes us CHRISTIANS...God will judge us in the end and those people who has lead a life of taking and being dishonest...God will judge them....So take a few of these reviews and realize we have to look beyond them...
I live an hour away but visit this church when I can. If I could I'd pick it up with all the wonderful people and carry it closer to my farm. Pastor Jeff is wonderful man who is trying to teach us the word of God.So many people have gotten away from the bible teachings and look around at how this world is acting....
My hope and thoughts for you...if your looking for a family church with genuine love for our God and who wants to know more about being a Christian....come check this church out....You wont be disappointed! I'm sorry , but I felt the need to tell you the truth...
ONLY LOVE AT THIS CHURCH...
So with that being said, Let's praise God everyday...We are so blessed. Take evil people with a grain of salt and everytime  the devil trys to push in front of you....TELL HIM TO GET BEHIND ....BECAUSE YOU'RE FOLLOWING GOD....GIVE YOUR WORRIES AND PRAISE TO GOD.... Great community of people. Small church but focused on growing and expanding its ministry. Would highly recommend for someone who is looking for a Bible based community. The extremely judgmental pastor has a severe control issue. You will be deeply hurt by him. Run from him. Hurt people (the pastor by his father) always hurt other people (his family and church members)

name: Connections Church - Highlands Ranch Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to Horizon for Easter Sunday.  The people here are very friendly and made me feel special when I walked through the doors. Pastor Tom's sermon was excellent on what the resurrection really means and how we can use that in our daily lives. Youth Pastor Jared was very good with the children while the parent's stayed and listened to Pastor Tom's sermon.
I definitely recommend. Visited the place for easter egg hunt.. this church is  neatly maintained and staff are friendly.. nice place.. we had a lots of fun on easter day.. all kids enjoyed a lot with a breakfast, photo shoot and egg hunt and lastly for each golden egg they had a prize for kids.. kids enjoyed a lot. we like this place. Thanks for all I feel welcomed and accepted here.  I don't feel as though I need to put on a false pretense in order to be here.  The messages I get here are genuine and what I feel is needed specifically for me.  The people here are wonderfully accepting of who you truly are. Does everyone knows this Church is amazing, Friendly Nice Welcome people, with different ages, I really get in love and I did a really good connection. I'm not a member of this church but they seem very nice. Thank you for treating me with respect, Rich

name: Consecrated Bible Church #F - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Bible teaching and holy spirit killed with joyful and loving people.

name: Consumed Church - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited this church while staying a couple weeks in the Savannah area last October. I was researching churches online and was impressed with their website. We fell in love with the church after our first visit and our schedule allowed 2 more visits which included a powerful midweek worship service. You could tell immediately that the pastors message was God-driven and the people couldn’t have been more welcoming and friendly, the music was incredible. They even remembered our names when we returned the 2nd time. We’ve since moved into our new community in central Florida and praying to find a church where we felt at home like Consumed. Still searching. If we had moved to Savannah finding our church home would have been an easy choice. Visited while Passing through on vacation.
Nice people.
Relaxed vibe.
Good worship.
Pastor preaching the kingdom. The Best Worship, Service, Church I have ever attended‼ Was saved, transformed, and Baptized in this Church‼I now joyfully serve here‼❤💕 Roads were rough, but overall very nice place I love this church it is the best. They love Jesus and speak the truth of the bible.

name: Contra Costa Gospel Church - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
I come from the Antioch Chinese Gospel Church, a branch of the Contra Costa Gospel Church. What moved me here was not the faith itself but the frequent "food-grabbing" scenes in the church, which made me feel uncomfortable and even hurt. After Sunday worship, there is usually a mealtime. However, what confuses me is that even before the worship ends, some adults begin to freely take food. As adults, can we wait until everyone is gathered before taking food together? The answer I received was no. Because of this, I truly dare not go anymore.
The Bible teaches us, "But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way" (1 Corinthians 14:40). Order in fellowship is not only a manifestation of the unity of the church but also a practical expression of our love for one another. Furthermore, Luke 14:10 states: "But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all the other guests." This verse reminds us to have a heart of humility and patience—not to rush ahead or compete, but to respect one another and demonstrate the beauty of the Lord through our actions. It's a good church toh worship on Sunday,  CCGC has Both English and Mandarin services. This is our church. Like it, love it, even not able to go to church during the time of the virus. A nice little church. Get there early!

name: Contrast Church - Upper Arlington - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: People are super friendly. I love the teachings and the vibe this place of worship has. A great place to check out. Cannot get a better Christian community than at Contrast. If you’re looking for a place with great friends, youth programs, groups and more, check this place out! Contrast is such a special place. The people are solid, the teachings are impactful, and the opportunities to get involved are endless. I love these people and this church dearly. If you are looking for a new church, don’t hesitate to come on Sunday! Contrast is a beautiful place that is passionate about making Christ’s kingdom known to ALL people. I have felt so welcomed, challenged, and loved here and I recommend giving it a chance to grow your relationship with Jesus Proud to call contrast our family’s home. The fellowship and community at contrast is truly special!

name: Converge Church - Longview Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful place where strangers become friends who turn into family. Wonderful music and engaging sermons with practical advice for developing your relationship with God. We have been attending for about a year now. This church does so many things well. Their musical worship time is great all the way around. For those musicians out there and sound people, you won't be disappointed. And of course if The Lord didn't meet us in this corporate setting, all the niceties wouldn't matter......every week is different with a solid word and worship to Him, in its many forms.  God is good and God is definitely with us at Converge! just come one time and you will meet Jesus in everyone there, it is a church with genuine love for the people. This is a amazing church and Pastor Kenny is awesome and everyone in this church thank you for making me and my wife Debbie very welcomed Warm atmosphere, friendly people, worship experience uplifting and preaching is solid, biblical and relevant.

name: Convergence Church - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
Not the most friendly or welcoming of churches except for Frank on the door he was the stand out church representative. Small normal coffee was 4 dollars lol only the second time in my 64 years I've had to pay for refreshments at church and perhaps that is reflective in the common California themed sermon on God's provision and Tithing. Worship again mostly performative like a lot of churches not pure worship with confusing lyrics for none Christians and it was super loud perhaps at an ear damaging level. No prayer for the millions of the worlds suffering and persecuted church and no gospel message. Having said that I was invited by a member and there is no perfect church. Ive tried two churches during my visit this time not sure from both experiences what the lord wanted me to learn from both visits. Have attended several times with my girlfriend and we are both big fans of this church.  Probably my favorite worship music of any church I've attended and I also really resonate with Pastor Greg's attitude/views/style of communicating.

Update:  My (now) wife and I continue to enjoy this church! Awesome church great worship Holy Spirit for sure present and outstanding word.
If I was to complain about anything, is when he was preaching the anointing on pastor Greg was there and wished he continued sermon!
God Bless and Stand Strong in Jesus! Great church, been attending for a few years now. They offer a lot of meetings throughout the week to meet people and build community. The worship is always phenomenal. Very welcoming place with a coffee bar inside for Sunday 10:30am service. My family and I have been attending here for 5 years now and we absolutely love it! Pastors Greg and Wendy are amazing leaders! In both with their family and congregation. God's Holy Spirit is present and in control. The preaching and teaching is always on point and straight out of The Word of God. And we as a congregation are attentive, soaking up every word and lesson as if we were in a class room.
Oh! And praise and worship is always awesome  and an honor to be a part of, and a glorious experience. Our youth ministry, Momentum, is also amazing! The kids love attending both regular Sunday service and their youth service on Tuesdays at 7pm. If your looking for a home church or just heard about CHOP, come visit and experience it for yourself. I'm positive you won't be disappointed. I'm proud to call Convergence House of Prayer my home. Amen!

name: Copper Hills Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: Having lived many years, I’ve moved a few times in my life. Each time it has its own unique challenges. One being finding a church that fits my Christian beliefs. Raised Catholic, my obvious go to would be a Catholic Church. Not having that option near by I search for a Christian church and go from there.  Easter eve my family and I attended service at Copper Hills Church, it feels a bit like a school auditorium, but many new  churches have a pop up feel these days and grow into something. However it was hard to get past any of those feeling when the man who was speaking was going on and on about it being hard for people to believe that Jesus rose from the dead. Somehow he went off on a tangent about him in a speedo! I know right!! Here it was the time of year when Christians all over the world were celebrating the renewal of faith and this guy turned it into him in a speedo! Needless to say that isn’t the church for me. Should you go I pray they have that person removed or at least educated. Before moving here I pastored a church in LA for forty years and had a hard time finding a church in the area. I could say a lot, but I'll limit it to, "Copper Hills is a very good church, under solid leadership, and a loving community." I love this church! I would love it even if it wasn't a block away from my home. But that's an important part of it. This church is in my community and this church loves my community the same way I do. I have spent so many great times here over the years, and not only just on Sundays and holidays. Sometimes its a stroll in the cool evenings through the breezeway, or an early morning coffee at The Well Coffee Co. If you are looking for a great place to be part of something, this is it. This place is amazing. Very welcoming and family friendly. Love Brad and Matt. Also The Well is a bonus! God bless. Peoria Florist has had excellent experiences delivering to Copper Hills Church and the Copper Hills Center for the Arts. The campus is easy to access with plenty of parking, and the facilities are clean and well-organized. Staff and volunteers are friendly, communicative, and helpful—making floral drop-offs for services, performances, weddings, and memorials smooth every time. Pro tip: on your way in or out, stop by Well Coffee Co. on campus for a great pick-me-up. A caring, community-minded partner and a pleasure to work with!

name: Coral Gables Baptist Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
FBC Coral Gables is a true blessing to the neighborhood. I recently visited for the second time and had a great experience at the Sunday Bible School. The Service started at 11 am with beautiful hymn music played by a talented pianist. It was a great feeling to sing along with the rest of the congregation as one voice. My husband and I have been coming to this church for the past two years now and it has blessed us in ways we never expected.

From the pastor who humbly shares his incredible breadth of knowledge of the Bible while connecting individually with his congregants, the choir who leads us in singing traditional hymns and the deep fellowship with its loyal, steadfast community. It is the kind of church you can put down roots in, that truly feels like home- where you’ll grow in heart, mind & most of all spirit 🤍 A church that truly feels like home. My husband and I visited several churches in Miami and this one was the one that we connected with. The church members are friendly and inviting and took genuine interest in us. Everyone is caring, thoughtful and genuine. The church is a Christ-centered and bible-based place of worship and prayer. Sunday Service wonderful.
Tks God. This church is filled with the Holy Spirit And the Lord Jesus Christ is alive and well here!! Also just as a heads up at 11 AM is the Spanish worship service, call ahead for English service times!!

name: Coral Gables Congregational United Church of Christ - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my wife have been to many concerts at the church. We often go and sit on the bench in front of the church, looking at the Biltmore Hotel and taking in the chirping of birds and the rustle of the palms and trees canopies. And best of all, today we came across the sign outside listing unconditional love for all humans. That really moved us. This church has a big inclusive heart, true to Christ's teachings! Christmas  eve midnite mass was truly amazing!! All were welcome, super talented Christmas  concert!! Made the greatest memories  for myself and my family!! Bell choir 30 min singing and 30 min of the Christmas  story was so perfect it made my Christmas dreams come true!! Not even crowded  seats super padded!! And free cookies  after the service!! Soo beautiful  nothing else compared it really MADE MY CHRISTMAS!!! THANK YOU!! God bless everyone!!! An evening of pure enchantment at the candlelight piano concert in the chapel! The combination of the beautiful venue, the gentle glow of candles, and the soul-stirring melodies played on the piano created a truly magical atmosphere. It was a memorable experience that touched my heart. Beautiful, inspiring, uplifting event.  The candlelight concert pianist is truly a virtuoso! She immersed herself in music and culture to prepare for this event! Her love for music, performing,  hip hop,  and her overall passion is most evident!!I I love and appreciate the connection made between the music of hip hop and social justice!

I also had the privilege to meet the lovely pastor of this church and she was most gracious and altogether wonderful.

I highly recommend this place of worship as well as the music series held there! What a great church trying to create world unity 👍🏼🙏🏼

name: Cordova Church of Christ - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary:
Cordova Church of Christ, it is the most awesomeness Church home that I have ever been associated with in my life.

The ministry here does such good work for the community and a broad. All the members here are so helpful, loving & caring, they are truly God's children.

If your needing or looking for a great church home, please come and check us out. I pray that you all have a blessed Sunday. God bless you all, and I love you!

P.S. if you have the opportunity to visit us, look me up, ask from Rodney Lewis. Very friendly and loving.  I would recommend this congratulation to anyone seeking a Christian family home. One of the things I love is the encouragement of Bible study and messages from the pulpit. They were spot-on. The singing was encouraging and everyone joined in.  Two thumbs up and 5 star rated. A very loving, tight knit church. I have felt nothing but welcome here. They hold traditional services and have small groups for a variety of ages and interest groups. Very service and community oriented. This is where Grandma goes 3 days a week for adult care we really like the way they treat her and she enjoys it. They are very hospitable and kind also we help Feed the Homeless once a month very communitive orientated A loving group of Christians. Wonderful youth program, and great classes for children of all ages. Proud to call this church our home, and the people there our family.

name: Cordova Neighborhood Church - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary:
I went because of one of my friends and have been going sents.  Grate place you are treated like family the minute you enter the church.  The staff are grate and vary friendly. Cordova neighborhood is the best! The people are so friendly! The staff is kind and teaches what God wants us to know. They have a adult softball team and it's as HUGE as you think it is! Huge from highway 50!!! Great people here! Great church family
Welcoming
Bible teachings It is a blessing to be at Cordova Neighborhood Church. I always have a great start to my day and week ahead.

name: Core Church LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I started attending a few months ago and it’s become our home church. The community is warm, welcoming, and encouraging. The men’s discipleship on Saturdays has been personally impactful. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I needed to find a good Church in Los Angeles. I google searched Church Near Me that teaches the true word of God. Core Church LA popped
up. I remember I have heard pastor Steve preach on 95.5 KKLA. So I call my mom and ask her what is the best church to go to in Los Angeles? She tells me go to the Chruch that Steve Wilburn pastors. She said I have heard him on the radio and I remember his name it sounded familiar. I look up his name and Core Church LA pops up the same church that was first in my google search! I’ve been reading the Bible for the past 14 years. I was stuck half way in the book of revelations and stopped reading the Bible for a little time maybe 2-3 years. So when I first came to Core Church it was in 2019. I am instantly greeted by the most awesome family of Christ you can imagine instant fellowship and welcome arms. I sit in the service and guess what Pastor Steve is preaching in the book of revelations in the exact same chapter that I stopped reading at in three years ago. I followed through with him through the whole study of the book of revelations and that was the Holy Spirit signifying to me this is the church you need to be in! Not only did I finish reading revelations but I understood what it meant and God has been revealing His word incredibly to me now. After I finish reading revelations I started reading the old testament because I started in the New Testament first and I will have finished reading the whole Bible cover to cover by the end of this year. I promised God I would read the Bible before He would come back and it could be any day now so pick up the word of God the Bible your armor from God Himself come to Core Church and get filled up with the Holy Spirit and let’s spend eternity in heaven together rejoicing and celebrating with our father Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior. I plan on reading the Bible every year for the rest of my life now every morning when I wake up fellowship with the Lord. This church will help you grow in the Lord God bless you all and see you at church! Core Church LA delivers passionate sermons, engaging worship, and a welcoming atmosphere. A place where biblical truth is taught boldly and lives are genuinely transformed. The word of God is always preached 📖. They have so many ministries throughout the week. This is an active church, equipping everyone to become people after God's heart. You will feel LOVED ❤️and KNOW that there is a GOD in heaven that loves you. It seems strange to rate a church so I'll do it like this:
⭐ Not Woke
⭐ Always preaches with an open Bible
⭐ Expository Preaching, not Pastor's topic of the week
⭐ Truth without apology
⭐ Gospel is preached every time
⭐ Christ's love here is Evident in leaders and believers. A safe place to worship in Truth
⭐ My new home 💯

name: Corinth Baptist Church - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary: Bible teaching from KJV.  Great music. The best preaching on subject.  Friendly staff. Just a 5☆☆☆☆☆ worship service all the time.  Couple three years listening and learning more about  the Bible,  both old and new testament.. This is a church that goes by the book! The holy one that is! Pastor Tommy Foski takes his messages straight from the Bible. The people here are very welcoming! The youth group is an awesome place for kids to fellowship and get to know about Jesus! It's definitely a great place to come and worship! Great place to worship  our Lord  and Savior   Jesus Christ. Lots of loving  friendly  people.  Great Pastor and Staff. Beautiful campus.   Where God's word  is shared. My family and I felt welcome since the first moment! But the most important thing is that they teach us how to live our lives by the Book! We love it!!! They still do traditional music, Sunday school and preaching. Wednesday night services for adults, youth department for teens, and Awana for the younger kids.

name: Corinth Christian Church - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to a car show and won a plaque for top 25 in show. Awesome turnout with over 100 cars and trucks. The competition was great. I give blood regularly here. Come in today and save lives by donating.
Come see the new buildings and huge parking lot.
Great folks here. Pastor Adam Turner, as well as Don Hardison are two of the greatest speakers ever had the honor and pleasure of listening to when talking about Jesus. I go away after every one of their sermons feeling a bit closer to living to God's word.  It's a work in progress.  The entire staff as well as church members, new and old, very personable, greet every stranger is if they were family at the door. I don't find any airs being put on here.  There are three Sunday services, daycare for parents attending church and or Bible School,  multiple choices of Sunday School classes, as well as a great youth program lead by Josh Moore.  Corinth does great things. Caring staff.  Godly preaching - speaking truth.  Friendly believers ready to make a space for you. If you're looking for a church to call home...this is it.  Friendly people, good worship through music, fellowship and teaching.  Classes for kids of all ages and adults.  Can tell a lot of people here love the Lord.  4 service times on Sunday morning to accommodate busy schedules.

name: Corner Books & Coffee at Calvary Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Nice place. You have to know it’s there to find it as there are not signs on the street. Good selection of books and other items. The cafe portion was nice and service is quick. This is really a sanctuary for people like me. I like it in here, there are a lot of books to choose from and the all are affordable, I can stack up my library and never go out for days. Great atmosphere and beverages, one of the best Chai teas I've had anywhere. Love this place! Great place to get books for Bible study material. Great customer service and very helpful in Christian books . Great environment! Good selection of Religious books, great coffee !

name: Corner Canyon Church
reviewSummary:
I started watching this church online during COVID and this year I finally came in person. Easter Sunday was my first and I’ve been coming back ever since. I didn’t plan to get this involved at first but I saw that they needed some help with the worship team and I reached out.

Fast forward to today and I’ve found my home. The worship team is killing it every Sunday. The lights and AV are looking great. And the sermons are deep and meaningful. I am fairly skeptical in my faith and the people here have accepted me and we’ve had some great discussion.

Pastor Nate is a great guy. He’s fun and charismatic, but he’s clearly highly educated and his heart is in the right place. I really appreciate that Nate spends time in academics and isn’t afraid to tackle difficult subjects on Sundays. They also have a great security team and they run background checks on all children’s ministry staff.

This is definitely a small community church but in my humble opinion, that’s how it should be. I love it here. I wholeheartedly recommend Corner Canyon Church, Pastor Nate Taylor, and the church family to anyone searching for a good Bible-based Christian church with excellent teaching and learning opportunities.  I prefer a Pastor be equipped with extensive Theology education tools for teaching God's word.  (I also prefer a doctor with a medical degree.)
**I have listed Pastor Nate's Education and Degree's at bottom of this review.

From the moment I stepped into the historic, red brick building, I felt a strong sense of belonging.  Pastor Nate's sermons are truly inspiring and I found myself hungry to learn more.
The congregation and leaders are defined by love, faith, and a solid foundation, which brought me to a profound sense of peace.
As a Christian minority born and raised in Utah, my journey has been centered on finding a good Bible-teaching Christian church.  Unfortunately, the search was often confusing and overwhelming.  Having attended CCC for many years now, I can confidently attest that Pastor Nate possesses a remarkable gift for teaching the Bible.  He has successfully reached numerous individuals, young and old seeking good Bible teaching.
If you are Not seeking God's truth in the Bible, you may not like Corner Canyon Church.  I pray for those who are bitter and vailed, to embrace God's powerful love.  Amen.

Education:
Bachelor of Bible and Theology from Biola University.
Master of Divinity from Westminster Seminary California.
Master of Philosophy of Religion and Ethics from Talbot School of Theology.
Languages and Study:  Koine Greek and Biblical Hebrew The community at this church is amazing, small churches struggle to hold communities together at times and I think this church has gone through many trials and tribulations but one thing I appreciate is Gods will to grow this church and grow a healthy and beautiful community of awesome people. I’ve never felt more at home. You get lost in mega churches but here at Corner Canyon you feel apart of it. I’ve made some of the best connections and friends here and that has allowed me to grow to change as a Christian. The pastor here is especially awesome, he tries so hard to care for people here as well as connect with them. I’ve never met a pastor who has the ability to have as much care and concern for his congregation in my life. This is seriously the best church I’ve ever been to. I’ve never been to a more welcoming and kind environment like Corner Canyon Church. The Pastor is just as amazing now as he was in the past. The church in all honesty has gotten better. Pastor Nate is really good at answering your questions about the Bible. My husband and I started attending this Church in 2020 after moving to the area. The Pastor and his family are kind, caring and loving to the congregation.  The teaching on Sunday morning is solid - never veering from Biblical truth. The Church also provides additional Biblical studies outside of Sunday morning service which provides an opportunity for spiritual growth and fellowship.  Overall, we love the Church because the Pastor is genuine, the teaching is sound, and the congregation has many kind people. We are glad we found CCC and are very happy here.

name: Corner Church
reviewSummary:
Church is in the coffeeshop sundays 8:45am and 10am.
At 10am service - kids can enjoy the kids space with volunteers so parents/caregivers can enjoy the service.  See kids space in video- its in the basement.

If its your first time to corner church…

What you should know-
All services are conversational.  Speaker will give about 4 questions to discuss with people at your table.

Great way to meet local neighbors-  most attenders live close.

Everyones welcome!  Just do your best to be a little chatty and your’ll likely find interesting people searching for genuine faith. Love that you get to talk with other people about the text. Not just some dude taking at you for an hour. Wonderful welcoming church community.

reviewSummary: Finally a church that is not afraid of speaking the Truth.  I had the best time being around great people. Worshipping God does not have a time limit. As for me I would worship all if I could. I will be back. I am guilty and in need of the spiritual 🙏 uplifting I get from this church. I've seen the people who go to Cornerstone Abundant Life Church before. Always smiling and waving at traffic. I like that they have a positive message and don't scream about hell like some churches. God sent me to Cornerstone Abundant Life Church for a purpose and plan. I understand the purpose and plan for my life. I’m at a soul saving ministry which the word of God changed my life. Psalms 37:37

name: Cornerstone Baptist Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Bible believing, Jesus worshiping church. Great pastors who love the flock. Great community that really feels like a family. Highly recommended! Cornerstone is a new church full of people of different walks of life and different journeys in their faith.

I have been a longtime member of 4 different churches and have faithfully served as a pianist in 2 since childhood. I can confidently tell you that the presence of God is in this church in a way that I've never experienced. I have never seen a church so committed to reaching their city like Cornerstone.

Pastor Joey's preaching is anointed, emotional, genuine, and sometimes painfully challenging, but in a way where you never have to question the source because he truly loves people, has no hidden agenda, and is just a ball of joy representing the love of Christ.

So glad I found this church that doesn't just do Sundays together, but does life together. It’s a church where surely FATHER ,Son, and Holy Spirt dwell,I haven’t gone due to health issues, but cornerstone is in my heart , as soon as I can I will return , because God dwells there, and I want to be there too . God bless my brothers and sisters . I was looking for a church for my family , then I get a knock on my door w a flyer inviting us to a new church in Fullerton down the street from my home .This pastor (Joey Díaz) moved from Arizona to start this church and I’m so happy he did that.Been there since day one & now 7 months later .Praise God ! Best church Great Bible teaching Church with loving congregation.

name: Cornerstone Baptist Church - Lithia Springs Campus
reviewSummary: When I arrived to the property I immediately noticed how manicured the lawn was. I was greeted by security and I felt good at this location. I Felt like I was supposed to be there. At the front entrance there was plenty of ushers and they were very professional. The Choir sounded so good and the music was very anointed and exceptional. You have to visit this sanctuary it's a beautiful inside very well cared for inside and outside a beautiful charming place that honors the Lord and His house. I was treated to a wonderful message by Reverend Lang. The whole experience is what I was looking for for Resurrection Sunday. Thank God for this wonderful Church. I attended this summer camp as a child and I am now 24 years old. My life has been forever changed. I am now serving Jesus wholeheartedly and spreading the gospel of Jesus Christ. Pastor Ben Lang is a true servant of Christ and I’m so grateful to God for him and this amazing summer camp! Love our other family. We are blessed to be campers of this wonderful loving church every summer. Pastor Lang is genuinely interested in the development of our youth becoming their best selves. Not just because it is my blessed church home, but the family that God has blessed me to discover and become part of if beyond ANYTHING I've ever experienced in my life. I haven't had the blessed opportunity of growing up in church or faith in NYC, but Cornerstone and my Pastor/father in Christ Ben Lang is amazing and genuinely anointed. Thank you Heavenly Father for my Cornerstone family. Im not a member but I have been attending for a few months . Pastor Lang preaches right from the bible and gives plain talk real world bible based knowledge of who you should be in Christ. I love how he explains and has detailed outlines so I can follow and study at home later. The church atmosphere is relaxed you don't have everyone trying to be in your business like some ppl think Christians are. You come you hear you go home changed. The size is moderate parking is fine children's church is available and that's it. I hope a new person is helped by the this and checks Cornerstone out its a great church. Ill join soon.

name: Cornerstone Baptist Church - Moore Campus
reviewSummary: I didn't attend services, but they throw a killer garage sale! Those working the sale were friendly, helpful, and kind. They represented the Lord in a very good light. If I didn't have an Independent Baptist Church around the corner from my home and were looking for a good place to worship, I would definitely be driving from Mustang every Sunday to give them a try. Finding out they shared my denomination excited me. The facility was very nice. We have been blessed to have our son in Cornerstone Baptist Child Care for well over a year now. The staff there are more like family to all of us. Each member is kind and caring to both our son and to us. Having experienced other centers and private home settings in Oklahoma and in other states as we raised our older children, it was difficult for us to truly trust that our youngest was being cared for and loved on the way we believe he needs and deserves. They have exceeded our expectations and shown us the love of Christ through their steadfast commitment to His Word. The new Director, Rebecca, is an outstanding leader of her team and the Assistant Director, Jenni, is as well!  We are consistently informed about the day making us feel we are right there. Our child is safe, happy and learning so much as are his parents! Thank you for making our choice of childcare so easy! Such a great Church!  We love Pastor Eric and his family, and it is revealing and heart warming to see the Johnson’s heart for the Ministry in the Church and community.  It is so obvious the Lord has led them to Moore “for such a time as this.” So excited and so looking forward to witnessing and being a part of what the Lord is going to do at Cornerstone!  I  encourage anyone that is searching for their place in the world to allow Cornerstone to be a partner in that search, God’s blueprint for humanity is not for us to go-it-alone in this life. We have been attending Cornerstone Baptist for over a year now.  What drew us to this church was the friendliness and warm spirit and unity that we felt.  We love and appreciate Pastor Eric Johnson and his family.  A very caring pastor! Amazing Church and equally amazing people!! Very loving, tons of opportunity to help and participate. Sound and solid and definitely the kind of church you want your children to grow up in! I love my Cornerstone family! ❤

name: Cornerstone Bible Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re new in the area looking for a church that teaches God's word from the Bible. A wonderful family church with good worship and great teaching by pastor Bruce French. We have truly been blessed to find this church. They’re all kind loving people from the community. Pastor Bruce is humble and honest. The staff and volunteers are gracious. I feel this church strives to honor God with teaching the Bible, with worship, with prayer. I've seen how this church strives to honor people with discipleship, service to the community, and support of missionaries. My family and friends have been kindly welcomed and accepted. We love worshiping here with our family. Such an active church. We travel 50 miles one way to attend. Wish we were closer so I could be more involved but it's good to know we have a family of christians for a respite from the messy world we are in.
Thank you pastor Bruce for your sincere love of Christ and your church family. Larry Edit: No longer attend but did not leave with any animosity or issue
Services are currently held at 8:00, 9:30, and 11:00 AM on Sundays. The 9:30 service is the busiest. Finding seats at the 11:00 service is relatively easier. There is no dress code. It is very welcoming to families. A parking lot is planned for the future but parking at this time is limited to street parking. A wheelchair accessible door can be found on the eastern side of the building. The main entrance is at the southwest corner of the building. I have hesitated in writing a review on Cornerstone Church only because the experience I had upon going to the church for the first time was not a welcoming one. I was so upset because we stood in the foyer waiting to be welcomed. It didn't happen in fact I went across the street and walked off my frustration while waiting for services to begin. I've never gone to a church that hasn't welcome to at the door when you're a first-timer or even a second or third or a member of that church. Cornerstone Church made me rethink how we are supposed to behave and match like Jesus did. The service was very good and the music was wonderful we stayed for the service my fiance and I and we enjoyed it tremendously but the people they're the ones that make the church and these people don't make their Church. I went for this sermon in the music and that's what I enjoyed. I don't plan on going back there cuz I feel like we were not welcome we were Outsiders. Being new to the area we were investigating churches to find our home church and this is one of their churches we visited. I was just appointment.

name: Cornerstone Bible Church - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary: Peter O'Neill, the senior pastor, teaches God's Truth. With very engaging supplemental projector slides. Visit this church if you want nothing but God's Truth taught. Also a very welcoming community. I love how the sun shines through the church's big windows too. This is a beautiful quiet place with an welcoming congregation! I enjoyed the worship and the Word very much! I have just moved in 2 months back and I feel at home here. They welcomed me to their choir too knowing that Iam interested in singing! This is an amazing church group where they support one another through prayers and physical support too! Jesus and the Bible, front and center.  Teaching is very thoughtful, just academically south of a reformed church. It's really geared to a college educated believer who's seriously thoughtful, so don't expect sermonets. The unfortunate consequence is that the congregation is pretty demographically monolithic, albeit  welcoming with the best of intentions. Few kids, and they, surprisingly, aren't the focus considering that a good arm could break windows in two huge schools thrown from the church parking lot. Few racial minorities, as the church culture there is very stereotypical of the majority makeup. Lots of late mid-life, well-educated white folks;  but it is highly attractive in that niche and in the distinct minority of growing/vibrant churches, in spite of its one-dimensionality.  Heavy on teaching and discipleship. As you might imagine,  there's a conspicuous lack of lasers and smoke machines during worship,  and the rare instances of clapping are comically arythmic. Peter O'Neill is a great guy,  a genuine believer who's bet the farm on Jesus, and a great teacher to boot.  Although he is the church leader,  it is definitely not a one man show, as the church leadership appears to hold the lion's share of operational ballast, for better or worse. (Think US president as opposed to Venezuelan) Hard to sum up the church,  really,  except for fact that it's incredibly attractive in all the areas that appeal to me, personally;  and that's precisely my biggest criticism against it.  Definitely worth a visit. I like the minister however the congregation I found to be much older.  I would say it's not necessarily the church if you have small kids. But the ministry's is younger and has two young children. He started his post-graduate career as a chemist and I have found that most ministers is that have other career paths before going into Ministry understand their congregations better then ministers who go directly to Seminary School. Generally speaking I found him to be pretty wise. Wonderful church! My son is the Pastor , with a heart that loves Jesus! I love his sermons because they are lessons about God's Holy Word!

name: Cornerstone Bible Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
This town needs more churches like this. My family has attended for about four years and from the first time we came we were welcomed as family. Any church I've been to, the service ends, and everyone is in their cars driving home in 15 minutes. Not this church. People will hang out and talk and catch up after church for at least 30 minutes and once a month we do a potluck. Pastor Al does a great job of bringing the word of God each week. His preaching is straight from scripture and he does a great job of always sharing the gospel. I read a comment about someone who didn't like talk of politics in church. One thing I appreciate about pastor Al is that he does not shy away of talking about abortion, and other current world issues. He does a great job of speaking the truth about what's going on in the world  . If you're looking to grow in your faith and hear scripture based teachings, and enjoy fellowship with great people than it's a great church for you. Excellent church with wonderful, rich, reformed theology. I first attended a service here shortly after being stationed at Davis-Monthan. The church is very family friendly with a park/play area outside, and has several big families. The worship is very God centered and the church overall has a more casual, familial atmosphere. Once or twice a month Cornerstone has an after service meal/fellowship and once or twice a month there is a prayer breakfast on Fridays. Communion is administered every Sunday. This is a wonderful place if your primary concern is Biblical preaching, education, and God centered worship music. We are new to the area and looking for a new church. Our first impression was this might be the church for us. However, one sermon made it clear to us it was not.

I do not believe politics belong in the church. Most political speech today is counter to what Christ taught. Love God and love your neighbor as yourself. All other commandments are based on these 2. If any teaching strays from these, beware.

I am sure there are good people at this church, but we are moving on. This is my other home Church in Tucson, after being grafted in to the Vine in the summer of 2019, by being born from above through the Spirit of God.  At that time, the LORD Jesus became no Longer the Stumbling Stone, but the Living Risen Saviour of my soul, who IS the Cornerstone, the ONLY foundation for this New Life in Him.
Although currently, from March 2021-2022, this Artfest Show Host has been blessed immensely to be utilized as a part of planting Cornerstone's Sister Church in Coolidge/Casa Grande area, known as Redemption Bible Church (RBC).  Cornerstone is where our RBC head Pastor, Greg Thornberg, will sometimes do guest teaching, as well as future Pastor in training, Jacob Thornberg, his son.  This is true for the secondary RBC Pastor, who I can, with Much thanks to God, claim as my son, Pastor Joshua Franklin.  In addition to Joshua Teaching at Cornerstone from time to time, he also is at times given opportunity to serve God as an infrequent Worship Music Leader, and his sisters and brothers and I sometimes have the Joy of Serving God with him.  But Pastor Al is the human heart of Cornerstone Worship and Teaching, as Led by The Cornerstone Himself, with ALL Praise, Glory and Honour to our Great God and Saviour Jesus Messiah 🙏🙌☝️.
For you see, Pastor Al has many Gifts from God, including a heart and mind with a clear understanding of the purpose and use of Apologetics, and Solid & Doctrinally Sound teaching  that utilizes his speaking gifts, but is tempered with humbly desiring the Spirit of Truth to lead the listeners in the WORD of Truth.
And God also mightily uses First Lady Angela & Pastor Al's Children to join him in leading the Worship Team, as God has gifted both them and he with beautiful, well-trained voices and other skills & gifts on instrumentation.  This usually results in a high level of excellence in 🎵🎶 Music, with prayers & hopes that they help inspire Cornerstone attendees to Exult our Great Triune God, worshipping in spirit and in Truth, as our LORD calls us to in John 4:23-25 ❣️  There are many other behind the scenes workers, worship team members, and other servants, like Deacon Joe Goodale, who does the excellent sound and other aspects of keeping the Service running smoothly and ordered --just to focus on a few of those serving God at Cornerstone.  The people are friendly and some of them will most assuredly reach out to you, when you visit.
All are ❤️‍🩹 🤗 welcome who desire, to Worship, Fellowship or simply  learn more about Yeshua Messiah--Jesus, the Christ (JesuCristo 💗), who is "the stone you builders have rejected, which has become the Cornerstone.  Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other Name under Heaven given to men by which we must be Saved."
(Psalm 118:22/Acts 4:11-12) Very Family friendly and sweet,

name: Cornerstone Boulder Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
The Bible Verse- Not all have the gift of Healing. This means that some people do not have this gift. Please dont claim to have some sort of healing ministry gift and then really are not blessed with it.
Almost every sermon Pastor Brian claims to have this ministry. I have not seen or felt this gift from the ministry and just felt like it was lacking sinceratiy and any form of closeness. First its emotional healing- then Im told its physical- then they dont have any time at all to talk to me.
Move on.
Cornerstone is a small church- still in the same building after 20 years. It seems like just a waste of time- and a new way to get MORE people in the door. Get noticed and more attention. That is  in fact my experience. I have been going to cornerstone for about four years now and I’ve got to say that cornerstone truly feels like home! I’ve been to a couple of other churches before cornerstone that I just wasn’t able to feel connected at but at cornerstone I have so many people that I know will be my friends for life. I am in high school and I have loved how the youth group has a balance of fun as well as seriousness and spiritual growth. I am always learning something new at both high school group as well as main church and the Holy Spirit is definitely moving, working, and teaching in this church. All of the pastors and leaders truly have a heart for Jesus and serving him and loving on people. My leaders that I have been with for four years have truly been such a blessing as well as a safe and loving space to go to! If you’re looking for a church home I could recommend no better place! God bless you! You don’t find community like this everyday. A beautiful church with authentic and kind people. If you’re looking for a unpretentious, safe environment to explore your faith and make real connections, this is a place worth investing in. Made up of open people who are genuine and non judgmental, great leadership, and sound teaching. Check it out, you won’t regret it! I have to say this church is seriously lacking. I had my child do dedication here and they mispronounced their name in front of the whole church multiple times. I sat through a service listening to the pastor spend over 5 minutes talking about how challenging it was for him to write a sermon while passing kidney stones and that due to this experience he fully understands what childbirth feels like. It was embarrassing and disgusting. Another sermon, the pastor spent over 10 minutes talking about karate kid, a show I’ve never even seen. Other sermons feel like history lessons not messages of faith and inspiration. There are some great people at this church and great ways to get involved in community, but overall the spirituality here is seriously lacking. It’s hardly a Christian feeling church. There is not a single cross in the entire building. I got burnt out trying to derive meaning out of shallow messages and having uncomfortable interactions with the staff. Moreover I feel they put a lot of emphasis in trying to collect money from people and expect everyone to pay for these poorly done sermons. It’s a great place to meet people with similar faith, the bad acoustics make it difficult to sing because there is no reverberation. I think after the child dedication I was so humiliated and horrified I really gave up on this place. Visiting from Austin, and was warned about all of the theologically skewed churches and lack of authentic Christians in Boulder. This place says otherwise! As far as I could tell, seems like a fantastic and Biblical community, full of welcoming and loving people dedicated to truth, and led by a solid pastor.

name: Cornerstone Christian Baptist Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: They very friendly and they treat you like family. THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT ANYONE EXCEPT THEMSELVES. ALL THEY WANT IS A GOOD OPINION. They do bit care about an anyone's struggles or hardships. All they care about is what make themselves look better. GO ANYWHERE BUT THIS CHURCH First time coming here and I've it ...It feels like a close family and so heartfelt :) An amazing place to grow your family with Jesus.

name: Cornerstone Christian Center - Antioch Campus
reviewSummary:
Former graduate here. This school has amazing education, semi okay teachers. Math is easy if you pay attention, Science is a breeze, etc etc. History class doesn’t teach much in black history and has three pages of black history in the books. Physical education is the best class in my opinion. Always doing something, make sure you dress out. Bible class is great, I’ve personally gotten closer to God that way. English, isn’t all that fun or pleasing. Unless you make a personal friendship with Ms. Escorsia, she’s either going to be rude to you, contradict what she says or she’s chill and she’s your her “favorite” student. (Which will change. In the next week or so) Watch out for Ms. Amerson, you’re on her radar and she’s watching your step. Dont get into fights or arguments, the teacher will dramatize it even if it’s playful. Ms. Scott isn’t any better. A lot of people are very mean. A great church for young families. We have been attending regularly for three years, now. Our kids love the nursery and children's staff and I am always confident that they are well taken care of, while we participate in the worship service. The congregation is warm and friendly with free coffee and donuts at every service. There are lots of small groups to get plugged into and an awesome youth service that meets on Wednesdays. I am proud of the work our church does in the community and the services we hold on Sunday mornings. We really do love it, here. The Sunday service was such a wonderful experience. My three year old loved the live music. This school offers great education for its students. The downside is that it is not inclusive of all students and situations. I can only speak for my experience and pray that we were the outlier.

My family was in the middle of a big transition, which the staff was well aware of. My child became inconsolable at school, and later informed me that he did not feel safe going to teachers because they would brush off his concerns when he reached out. The school admin spoke of my son as an "issue" to be dealt with and ultimately had no faith nor support for us. They never tried for my child and turned their backs on a child and their family.

I will not recommend this school to anyone in my network. However, if your child fits into the school's ideal, then it should be a perfect fit for your family. Make sure to do your research as well. There are many great choices in the area 😉 Cornerstone is on fire for the lord and the people are awesome!
They make you feel at home when you walk in. I been going here for a year and found my self getting involved and being more apart of this great church. I love that the praise team is all different ages from 16 and up and to see hands lifted high and the spirit moving you cant help but be humble to the sprite and let go. Its a great place for a family with teens the youth group is outstanding and the youth pastor has got a calling from god. Thank you lord for bringing me to this place! It

name: Cornerstone Christian Church - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary: I'm new there, but everybody was very friendly and I appreciated it. It's not a large huge place, but it's not small, either. They have communion every week Gorgeous setting all around Loving people! Marsha heard I was coming from my neighbor who brought me and she glued herself to my side so that I wouldn't feel like I was alone. She and her husband Barry even offered to stay for a second service to give me a ride home if I wanted to stay. If this church is anything like the driver that is driving the church bus .. that almost ran my ONE YEAR OLD son and I off the road today approximately at 3:50 pm … which I have pictures , Plate number B409AC !! reviewSummary: My children loved it there. The teachers and Deepa at Cornerstone are so loving and caring. They took the best care of my children over the last 6 years. name: Cornerstone Christian Fellowship - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary: I love Cornerstone! They have a great relationship with college students, young families, and townies in Bloomington. They do an amazing job at outreach and serving the community. If you're looking for a place that loves people from all walks of life, is biblically sound, and teaches you how to follow Jesus in the every day stuff of life- Cornerstone is the church for you! Love this church! Everyone is inviting and compassionate. Sound doctrine and teaching. The worship is really good as well. Would recommend this church for anyone regardless of where they are in their faith! Caring about missions is biblical, and I fully support helping people in need. That isn’t my criticism. My concern is when nearly every service includes another appeal for money, to the point that fundraising becomes one of the church’s defining characteristics. The New Testament doesn’t simply tell churches to support missions; it also tells leaders to guard against an unhealthy focus on money. Elders are to shepherd the flock “not for shameful gain” (1 Peter 5:2), an overseer “must not be a lover of money” (1 Timothy 3:3) and “must not be greedy for money” (Titus 1:7). Giving should be voluntary, “not reluctantly or under compulsion” (2 Corinthians 9:7). Supporting missions is commendable, but if members consistently leave remembering the fundraising more than the preaching of Christ, it’s worth asking whether the church’s emphasis reflects the New Testament’s emphasis. So many kind and loving people there. I live in the neighborhood and love hearing people gathering. A lot of life is being lived well in that Church. They are probably one of the most generous groups of people in the way they live that I've ever met. :) I love Sunday services at Cornerstone (great preaching and worship) and a really great community of people.

name: Cornerstone Christian Fellowship - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
From the very first time I visited Cornerstone Christian Fellowship, I knew this church was special. I still remember seeing the Pastor outside throwing a football with a group of kids before service. That simple moment spoke volumes about the heart of this church.
When I dropped my children off for "kids church," I immediately saw how children and families were respected, prioritized, and genuinely loved. That was back in 1994, and for the past 32 years, my family has proudly called Cornerstone our home church.
The preaching of God's Word is powerful and life-changing, and the worship truly brings you into God's presence. Cornerstone also offers multiple ministries for people of all ages… This church serves the community and reaches far beyond the church walls. Now, seeing my grandchildren being loved and cared for in the children's classes has been such an incredible blessing!
If you're looking for a church home where you can come as you are and be welcomed like FAMILY, I encourage you to come see what God is doing at Cornerstone Christian Fellowship! We found Cornerstone when we attended The Little Mermaid play. We could immediately feel the overwhelming amount of love, support and family atmosphere.  We attended a Sunday service and instantly fell in love. Our daughter had a hard time separating from us for Sunday School but they met her where she was at every Sunday. They have classroom directors to ensure consistency and a familiar face every Sunday for the kids and it helped tremendously. We've been with Cornerstone for 2 years now and it and all the people has been such an incredible blessing. They have welcomed us with open arms. We have had so much growth in ourselves, but especially our daughter, in her confidence and knowledge of being a Christ follower. This has been our home church since 1999, even when living out of state it was home.  The pastors and leadership for the church are welcoming.  There is always a come as you are, no one is perfect but we are all loved by God feeling! From the moment we walked in the door we felt welcomed and at home.  We love our cornerstone family. I was so nervous to come here for my first time. My husband told me about this place because he came here as a child and said it was his favorite church still to this day. When I went inside I was instantly welcomed with open arms. I met a wonderful woman who introduced me to everyone. The service was amazing. I came from a larger church that seemed to be more "entertainment" than Faith-focused and I'll say this church is everything I've been looking for. They focus on the Bible, on Jesus, and on loving everybody despite where they came from. This church is like a family, and they welcome everybody new instantly as one of their family members. I'm so blessed to have found this church.

name: Cornerstone Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Today I went here for the first time and it was a good experience. The staff were welcoming and kind. The pastor we had (even though he said he was a temporary one) was cool too. Absolutely love Cornerstone. Pastor Jerry and Pastor Dan teach straight from the Bible with conviction, context, and relatability. The worship team is awesome, I am often moved to tears. Such a warm and welcoming body of Christ. The best thing we did was get plugged in, we attend the families group, moms group, dads group, women's and men's Bible studies, and others. Members open up their homes for Bible studies and I feel so grateful to have joined one, I literally didn't know people did that. So many ongoing events and great ways to get involved.  The women's minister Grace reaches out personally, she gets to know so many people and remembers their names. Our kids love going to church. When we're super busy we watch services online but being in person is really special. We started in June 2024 and are sure we have found our home church. They follow the Word 100%. Everyone is very welcoming and kind. Services are also streamed online. Pastor Jerry is very accessible and will pray over you if you ask him. He is very knowledgeable and uses his many experiences to help illustrate God's message. He has a great sense of humor too, and I always learn something new each week. This church has alot of missions abroad and outreach programs that serve long beach. They also have local activities for everyone. I love Cornerstone! Solid preaching. I attend the more relaxing 6pm Sunday night service. Not such a big crowd, plenty of parking. A place to call home for you and your and your family. Solid tradition biblical teaching that doesn't sway from the truth. The Congregation and pastors are friendly and warm and care about you and your walk with Jesus. Amazing children's program, great worship music in the morning. Cornerstone has a lot to offer.

name: Cornerstone Church - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited once
Loved the traditional worship and hymns
Sermon was alright but nothing unbiblical or heretical

Very nice congregation We are members at this church and have been attending for 5 years. We continue to be impressed by the pastors' humility and intentionality in everything they do, particularly making the word of God central. It's a smaller congregation and the pastors make significant effort to get to know everyone and Shepherd them well. The goal is to be the body of Christ and to be family to one another. Our family has definitely experienced this. It's a diverse body in age and ethnicity. Strong young adult group. Growing youth group with spiritual depth. We love it here. I went here four Sundays in a row and found it to be a very slick operation with truly outstanding sermons from three different speakers (pastors?). No one ever said a thing to me aside from a hello at the door and when I asked to meet one of the pastors I was told no. I doubt if I will go here again. Maybe I will try to watch them online. If you want to check the block then this is as good a spot as any but if you want meaningful interaction (or any interaction at all) with fellow Christians at a Sunday service perhaps look elsewhere. The three stars are for the sermons and the band. God bless them all.

Follow up: I went here again about ten months later, two Sundays in a row, thinking at least I can hear a great sermon, and give it another chance as far as the social aspect is concerned. As usual the presentation and speaking were fantastic and the interaction was sparse (none) except for one notable difference. A person introduced himself and we began a conversation that resulted in him inviting me to his weekly Bible study. I thought that was pretty cool so I added this and bumped up the review to four stars. Great stuff! Very welcoming. Comforting, warm, friendly atmosphere. No rock bands here. I want to learn and understand what the Bible actually says, and this is a great place to do it. The pastor reads from the Bible, and explains. How refreshing! I grew up in the cornerstone and cayon ridge mother church in Las Vegas. This is a fellowship that has stand the test of time and does well to help members and the community around their church's. Feel free to ask for help or simply starting your journey to salvation. They have been around for years and I speak from experience when I say they are doing what our Lord and savior would expect from such a large church group.

name: Cornerstone Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending Cornerstone Church for over 35 years. Our kids were born here and now our kids have kids. Cornerstone is a welcoming place that reaches out to the community with free bread every week and free pickleball play on Saturdays. Being here for so long is special because people who have moved away and come back to visit are still recognized and loved. Cornerstone is a very welcoming environment. From the very first day my daughter and I attended, we felt welcomed and included. Our church family has grown considerably since our arrival. There are opportunities for engaging in smaller groups, which we both a participate in, as well as a variety of events throughout the year. Pastor Ed and his wife Karen lead the church with big hearts for Jesus and the congregation. Everyone there, from the staff to the leadership to the volunteers, provide a relaxed and comfortable environment where you can grow your faith. We highly recommend Cornerstone if you are looking for your forever church home! My husband and I are so grateful the Lord has brought us to Cornerstone Church. We had been praying for a year for His leading and guidance. We were looking for a church that would teach the Bible. We believe the Bible is God’s Word and it’s inerrant. Pastor Ed  stays true to God’s Word and teaches it faithfully. We appreciate how he emphasizes the Gospel and Jesus being our Savior. The people in Cornerstone are also very kind and loving. We were greeted and made to feel welcome immediately. Now a year later, we are grateful for what the Lord has done. Please consider joining us if you are looking for a home church. We would love to walk alongside you. Praying for God’s will be done! My husband and I have been attending Cornerstone Church for 2 yrs now and have made it our home church.  From our very first visit we felt the warm, welcoming love and support from Pastor Ed, from the staff, and from all of the members.  We love the Sunday sermons in which the main idea of the biblical text is the main idea of the sermon, and how we are challenged to apply God's word to our lives.  The worship music that is lead by  Pastor Joey is awesome and we enjoy gathering with our bothers and sisters in Christ to praise and sing to the Lord!  Love for God and for others is truly alive in this church, we see servant leadership that has a clear vision and strategy for its congregation.  There are so many services this church offers, from café/fellowship, children's ministry, youth ministry, small groups to deepen your relationships and understanding of God's word, to gathering to play pickle ball, to Believers Baptisms, Foundation classes, Grief Share classes, Men's/Women's Retreats, one on one discipleship, and so much more!  If you are looking for a church to call your "church home" I would highly recommend visiting Cornerstone and see for yourself how they can help support you in "your walk with the Lord".  No matter where you are in life's struggles, or uncertainty of where God fits in your life, you will find support, and love to help you along  your journey! As new believers my husband and I have experienced this and the power of how Jesus can change your life! Thank you Cornerstone Church for welcoming us into your church family, we are truly blessed! I love Cornerstone Church! Everyone is so loving and caring. It feels like extended family to me. I've gone to this Church since I was young. Not only are thier good people there the people prove year after year to be consistently good and upstanding people that honor God.

name: Cornerstone Church - Rome Campus
reviewSummary:
Cornerstone Church is more than just a place to attend—it is truly a congregation of God’s people. The love of God is felt as soon as you walk through the doors, and it’s clear that this is a family of believers who genuinely care about others.

The people of Cornerstone aren’t just friendly—they live out their faith by serving the community in countless ways. Their heart for God shines through everything they do, from worship to outreach, and it’s inspiring to see a church that puts love into action.

Pastor Stephen is a true servant-leader. He makes himself available, he listens, he encourages, and he serves everyone who walks into Cornerstone with humility and compassion. His heart for God and for people is evident in every message and every interaction.

If you’re looking for a place where God’s presence is real, where people love deeply, and where you’ll be both welcomed and encouraged, Cornerstone Church is that place. It’s a home filled with love, faith, and purpose. 4th Sunday we’ve attended so far and we LOVE it! Definitely will be our church from here on out. Only church I’ve attended that’s had me so excited to show up. ❤️ Hello, I wanted to know if you offer service in Spanish. Our church had dissolved and I was not interested in just jumping into another church. We started visiting other churches though for my wife's sake. We were expecting to visit several different ones and, after a few services at each one, then choose a new church home. However, as soon as the first service was over, we knew we had found the right church for us. Cornerstone is a church of the kindest and most relatable people. The music is more modern, which we love and appreciate. The pastor and messages are challenging without being condemning. I would suggest anyone looking for a new church family to visit Cornerstone. We absolutely love Cornerstone!!! Such a warm and inviting atmosphere! My kids love the children’s services! I have attended this church off and on since I was 14! So almost 20 years

name: Cornerstone Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
We ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS CHURCH! Out of all the churches in San Antonio this one takes the cake. Not only bc it is beautiful but bc the GOSPEL is preached with spirit and truth. Worship if always fire! So many programs along with an amazing childrens ministry and my husband is now attending his 3rd Mens Academy Retreat! It was great to visit Cornerstone Church. This church felt welcoming when we've attended. I love the preaching style and they do not hold back by sugarcoating the Bible. Would be awesome to be closer, because the volunteer opportunities and group activities look great. Thank you for being a great church. Thank you! Absolutely unforgettable night at the Jeremy Camp concert at Cornerstone Church! From start to finish, it was an incredible experience filled with powerful worship, amazing energy, and a strong sense of God’s presence. The lights and production were stunning — every song felt larger than life with the way the visuals and sound came together. The sound quality was top notch, crystal clear and full of depth. You could feel the bass in your chest during the upbeat songs and then be completely moved during the slower, worshipful moments.

Jeremy Camp delivered a heartfelt performance that felt genuine and spirit-led. His testimony, the passion in his voice, and his connection with the audience made it so much more than just a concert — it was a night of ministry and worship. The crowd was engaged, hands lifted, voices raised, and hearts open. It was truly a night of unity in faith.

Cornerstone Church did an amazing job hosting the event. The staff was welcoming, organized, and everything ran smoothly. Parking was easy, and the venue was clean and comfortable. I left feeling inspired, refreshed, and closer to God. I would definitely come back for another event. Highly recommend! Its a place of entertainment, but not really a place to listen to the word of God, the bible is lost in translation in my opinion, they sell coffee and pastries inside the "church" and also have a restaurant. I went just once and saw enough to assume, the worship the prosperity gospel, and something they called the healing scriptures, which didnt really make sense to me, but It is a place you have yo go experience yourself, I myself didnt feel connection God through their sermon.

name: Cornerstone Church - West Chester Campus
reviewSummary: My youngest grandson started preschool here at Cornerstone. The drop-off and pickup arrangements are fantastic... smooth, safe, and relatively quick.
