name: Cornerstone Church Assemblies of God - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a loving house of the Lord!  Cornerstone Church is special because the humility of the congregation reflects the heart Jesus has called us to have. It is a home of broken people, believers who know they are still sinners, knowing each day we must praise God for his mercy and gracThe members walk hand in hand with one another in our spiritual journey.

There are amazing ministries such as children and youth, women’s, men’s, and Celebrate Recovery. Worship is anointed by a wonderful worship pastor and team.  The senior pastor understands life’s ups and downs, and encourages the members to stay close to God through prayer and worship. I love this Cornerstone Family and look forward to every opportunity to serve the Lord and my church. Cornerstone church is such an amazing church. We’ve been going for a year now and every message from Pastor Doug has been great. We love his teachings and his humor. This is a true church community. Not one member has been rude or judgmental. You will feel the Holy Spirit here and grow your relationship with Christ in this community! Cornerstone is a great church to attend! You definitely can feel the Holy Spirit! Brother Doug is the realest pastor you can find! If I need him he answers or calls me back everytime. He has been there for me at a very low time in my life, also his wife. I am a newbie to the church but he makes you feel like your part of a family. I looked at many churches before I found Cornerstone.  He is the realest pastor that you will ever meet. He preaches God's word and I definitely felt the Holy Spirit there. I recommend this church 100%, you will not be disappointed! I miss Cornerstone and often think about stopping by whenever I’m in town. My family moved out of state 8 years ago. I know Pastor Doug would embrace me and talk like I am still a part of his church family.

Pastor Doug has grown and matured since we were there and the church has become a valuable resource for the St Tammany community.

If you’re looking for a place to worship and belong, visit Cornerstone Church. Great Place, Great People, Great Messages!! A place where you can really connect with the Lord our God and with your fellow brothers and sisters in Christ. Originally went here to reconnect with God, but not only did I reconnect with him….I found a group of people I would consider family.

name: Cornerstone Church Athens - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
If you truly want to come as you are, feel cared for, respected in your own season with God, be loved on and be a part of the community (not just the church, but society) and make a difference....this is an amazing place to be. Not only are there so many areas to help serve no matter if you've known God all your life, new to having a relationship with God, or a non-believer who knows you're missing something (that's the spirit talking to you by the way 😉), you can find a place to grow here.
The credo here is Hope, Love, Grow and Cornerstone is adamant about sticking to that. Currently our wonderful Pastor has been on a new study with us (yes study, we have sermons but sometimes you need to just be relatable, reach people and be honest) to restoring the mind and renewing the heart. Mental health is so important and depression and anxiety is very real! For anyone! (My attestation to that is facts, but oh God saves).
So if you're "Feeling so 2020" (title of the series now) and you need to just breathe away from the havoc of the world around right now or seek guidance on the stress of your thoughts and relationships please come join us. You come as you are but leave ready to change for the better, lighter and with more hope to live than to just feel like you're surviving. I've been looking for a new 'Church Home' for quite some time now. Cornerstone has always seemed to "Reach out and grab me"  if you will, every single time i passed by it (everyday +). I can say with certainty, (after going half a dozen times so far before I go to work) this place comes off as beyond welcoming, downright genuine and unbelievably trustworthy. That means so much at this point in life! I look forward to hopefully getting more involved. You also won't hear a better "Pastor/Teacher" than Pastor Scott. Thank yall for all you do for God and this community! ❤️ Our place of worship for 10 plus years. Wonderful loving body of Christ's. Always feel God moving My husband and I have found our church at Connerstone. Love coming here, always feel uplifted and filled with the Spirit from the worship to the preaching, and the prayer. Highly recommend to anyone looking to continue or start a relationship with Jesus. Amazing church. Love the pastor sermons and worship there.

name: Cornerstone Church Inland Empire - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: I’m a regular attendee to the Sunday services and although its a small community, they are welcoming and strong in their faith. If you want a more personal option of understanding the word, there are bible study groups for people of all ages. This Church feels home to me and my family. I’m blessed to be part of it.

name: Cornerstone Church of God (Holiness) - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Loved the music, the message, and the food.  There is a good group of kids and teenagers, and the people are friendly and seem to care about others.  There was a good "spirit" in the service. It's the church that I usually go to. It's a Hispanic and Caucasian mixed church. The people here are well welcoming. I Been going to this church longer than I can think and Its a little church family over at this church Nice small neighborhood family Christian church

name: Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful place to grow in faith and community. The pastors and congregation are warm and welcoming, and the sermons are rooted directly in scripture. They’re intentional about building community through sports, game nights, picnics, and other gatherings beyond Sunday service. There are also opportunities to join the Christmas or Easter choir, or take part in deeper dive studies offered each fall and spring. I’m grateful that my boys (one of whom attends UCLA) and I visited Cornerstone Church this past Sunday! The positive Google reviews swayed us to attend. We were warmly greeted by Pastor Scott at the entrance and by another attendee in our pew. The worship team’s music was a blessing. Pastor Brian delivered an inspiring, powerful message that challenged us to regularly hear from God through scripture, believe it as the entire truth, and use it to navigate life. My older son said it was one of the best, clearest sermons he’s ever heard. We look forward to worshipping there when we’re in LA again; I’d probably become a member if we lived there! Hoping my Bruin will visit it again. Been a member since May 2022. One stop shop to a great community--personable pastor-elders who preaches straight out of the bible, a community who prays together, sports after service (basketball/volleyball/frisbee), board game nights and a parking lot! :-) Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles provides inspiring sermons, a caring community, and meaningful worship—perfect for those seeking growth and connection in faith. Highly recommended! Cornerstone Church, led by a dedicated group of elders, deeply values the Bible and strives to love God and serve His people in Los Angeles. It's a welcoming community where faith and fellowship thrive, making it a true blessing to be part of for 15+ years.

name: Cornerstone Community Church
reviewSummary:
I was reminiscing fondly of this body of believers today! ❤️ My husband and I had the pleasure of being the camp hosts at Parkside Campground last summer, and Cornerstone was one of the groups we had the pleasure of hosting! They illustrate the heart of the Gospel and service of the Great Commission incredibly! Every member was so kind, courteous, and hospitable! Thank you for allowing us to get to know you and for welcoming us to the cookouts and worship nights! How to handle confrontation.

Jesus said what is to love those who love you? Even the tax collectors do that.

Reformed theology.
Great worship.

name: Cornerstone Community Church - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful for a church that truly teaches and lives out the Word of God. The messages are always rooted in scripture and challenge you to grow deeper in your faith and relationship with Jesus. It’s clear that the focus here is not just on hearing the Word, but on applying it in everyday life.

What makes this church especially meaningful is the people. The congregation is filled with some of the most caring, loving, and genuine servants of the Lord I’ve ever met. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, supported, and encouraged. The love of Christ is evident in the way people serve one another and the community.

If you’re looking for a church that faithfully teaches the Bible and truly reflects God’s love through its people, this is a wonderful place to grow spiritually and be part of a Christ-centered family. Cornerstone has been our family’s Church for more than 25 years.   Teaching the truths of the  Bible, welcoming all, and sharing the Gospel of Christ are the foundations of this Church.   If you are looking for friendly folk, worshipful live music, and a place to learn, fellowship and feel blessed or share your gifts,  I highly recommend Cornerstone church.      It’s worth the drive I absolutely LOVE Cornerstone, the church community, and Pastor Mike's sermons and wisdom. My life changed when I went to my first service here. I was welcomed with open arms by everyone, regardless of age, male or female, or life experiences. Thank you for opening my eyes to Christ! Not as much as a Godly church I thought they were, GOD REALLY DOESN'T CARE THAT YOU GOT INSURANCE FOR YOUR CHURCH IF IT FORCES BELIEVERS AWAY. BECAUSE THAT IS NOT GOD. they care more about their reputation and image than they do about God. I visited it back in 2012 I liked the music and service back then. I called them recently asking for a ride to church and back, but they want to hold my past against me from almost 20 years ago even though God forgave me along time ago, and all temptation and sins are common to man. I feel discriminated against, they treat strangers better than me. What did I ever do to them. The Bible says that if you don't forgive and forget a person's past God won't forgive and forget your past. Best church in Auburn. Mike preaches from the Bible. Fellowship with others is quite relaxed and friendly.

name: Cornerstone Community Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love my church, Cornerstone Community Church. The teaching is Bible-based, thoughtful, and genuinely relevant to everyday life. Our pastors are knowledgeable Bible scholars, but also down-to-earth, authentic people who humbly strive to follow Jesus. That combination makes the teaching both deep and relatable.
The worship is amazing and consistently spiritually moving. It creates space to truly encounter God, not just attend a service.
There are countless ways to get involved — through groups, events, or volunteering — which makes a large church feel like a close, caring community. People are known, supported, and encouraged here.
Of course, I think my church is the best 😉 — but no matter where you attend, being connected with others who are also seeking to follow Jesus is so important…and where else in our society other than church do you find so many people who are doing their best to be kind, loving, giving, encouraging, etc?
As a man, the men’s ministry has been especially meaningful to me. It offers the perfect balance of real and vulnerable conversations, strong spiritual mentoring, and everyday connection through things like hiking, camping, sports, and doing life together. I’m grateful to call Cornerstone my church home! When I was 20 years old I lost my faith. Due to some hurt I received from the church. I never wanted to ever go back to church again.  My cousin invited my husband, myself and our daughter to Cornerstone. I have never been more nervous or afraid. It's been 20 years since I stepped in church or walked in faith. We have never looked back. It's only been a little over a year. But this place has helped us build our relationship with God. I never thought I would have my relationship with God back. I hope to someday be more plugged in to the church as far as being involved. I would highly recommend this church. They are a amazing group of people. My husband and I have been attending Cornerstone for two years in December. While it is a large church, we have found small church friendliness. There are many varieties of groups to help you find your people within the church. We appreciate that Pastor Andy’s teaching is Biblical and relevant and allows for daily application in our lives. The pastoral team incorporates the spiritual disciplines into our spiritual growth journey and over the past two years, I have noticed that u am drawing nearer to God through daily Bible reading, prayer, and giving when there was a time in my journey that I used to practice these as more of a check list where now they are more like a love expression  between God and I. As a result, my peace and contentment have grown and I find my self more of God’s presence through those activities than I want other things that have made me restless in the past. I am on a spiritual journey through religion and it has carried me through very challenging relationship issues, health changes, and life heart breaks. Our time here has not been perfect, but it has been perfectly God! We have been attending for two  years in  December. My husband serves on the Greeting Team. We have found, that while a large church, there is a small church friendliness and many areas to connect and find your people. We are thankful for Biblical, balanced, and relevant teaching that allows for practical application everyday. Pastor Andy brings spiritual disciplines into our growth experience and I find myself  drawing nearer to God through prayer, Bible reading, and giving rather than practicing these behaviors out of obligation. My understanding of and yearning for God is growing as well as my dependency on him through my life’s ups as well as downs. I want to be near him.  My contentment and peace are increasing and I find myself wanting to be entertained by stuff less and less. I am so grateful to be serving God through this community. I love Cornerstone Church.  Been a member for 28 years.  Have watched this church grow and bless this community we live in.  A great children’s ministry. Support groups.  The worship team is amazing.  👩‍🚒🚒😎😆

name: Cornerstone Community Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Cornerstone Community Church in San Clemente, CA is truly something special. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, loved, and at home. The community here is sincere and genuinely Christ-centered — you can feel the presence of God the moment worship begins.

Speaking of worship — incredible. Dave, the lead guitarist and worship leader, has a voice that honestly rivals Bryan Adams, maybe even better. His worship comes straight from the heart. The whole worship team is talented, unified, and Spirit-led. It’s the type of worship that fills the room with peace and joy, and stays with you long after Sunday.

The messages are grounded in Scripture — real teaching that helps you grow in your walk with Jesus, not just motivational talk. There’s a strong sense of family, community outreach, and authentic fellowship here in the heart of South Orange County.

As the founder of FaithFlow Records (a Christian music & worship label dedicated to uplifting and inspiring believers worldwide), I can say we were truly moved. We would love to explore future collaboration with the worship team here at Cornerstone — the talent and the heart for Jesus are something rare and beautiful. FaithFlow Records is always searching for worship musicians and singers who lead with authenticity — and this church has that in abundance.

If you’re looking for a Christian church in San Clemente that is welcoming, Spirit-filled, and passionate about worship and the Gospel — this is the place.
Highly recommended. Amen. 🙏 Cornerstone Community Church is my second home where I was welcomed 16 years ago and found place to worship our Lord with Holy Spirit. I have experienced the love of God very closely and sang with energy and tears for welcoming Jesus in my life. Pastor Ron and his wife Diane are servants of true God. Pastor Ron gets connected to congregation through his teachings, experiences and love of God. Now that we are moving to different city I’m going to miss my church the most. name: Cornerstone Fellowship Bible Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello, I don't do many reviews, but this church, the pastor, and its congregation deserve this one. I have to say not only are their teachings solid and Bible-based, but the pastor (Milton) and the congregation are a fantastic reflection of Christ's love. I have felt more than welcomed here, invited into a family of believers that truly chase after God's heart, not just by reading or talking about the Word but by practicing it in real time, by being transparent, and by honoring God in their everyday walk. far from perfect but being perfected in Christ.

"Expository teaching at its finest, to say the least!"

Anything that says otherwise about this church, its pastor, or its teachings is either a misunderstanding or the enemy trying to attack those who God loves and to keep you, the fellow reviewer, from finding a perfect home church family with a healthy mix of ages and cultures, where the nuclear family is visible and growing.

You will feel welcomed here!!!

Give it a try…. Went to this Church today. Heard a great sermon on John 3:16. A way I had not heard it broken down before. It was great. How God loved the ENTIRE world ALL tribes, All nations, all people even us sinners.  That his son, not us was the only trusted one to die for us. The pastor even said we are still sinners even after accepting even him. That we all need to strive to have a great relationship with God. Except the gift knowing we are not nor will never  perfect. It was very good.....BUT at the end of the service he, the pastor, got up and spoke about a MEMBER IN DETAIL! In the churches defense, said member did do some things that were in direct contrast to the Bible.  They did try working with said member with no luck. So he threw him back to Satan! Hold on wait WHAT did he just say. He went on about this. I thought I just heard this fantastic sermon about Love ❤️.  I do not know how anyone could know someone's heart. During the sermon he even talked about the worst sinners could still be with the Lord! But he had the right to throw him back to Satan. I was so disappointed I thought we found our new church. So people beware you might get mixed messages I know I did! You release them from the church,  release them from their membership and then release back to the Lord to help them because as men we  can not do anything more for him! No pastor you can NOT throw him in the lake of fire. You continue to pray. It's God's time not man's time! I pray for the family I was embarrassed for them! When I first walked into this church I knew something was different. I have attended church full time my whole life but something was different, in a way I had not experienced in a church since I was a kid.  It was all about JESUS.  Not about the latest politics or the latest top single on the radio for worship.  It was to the bone teaching all about Jesus, all about humility, all about the church.  I didn't remember the pastors  name because it didn't matter.  It wasn't about him or any of the other shepherds...only Jesus.  This may sound dramatic but sitting in that pew, I felt like I was sitting at the feet of Paul teaching.  The Love is abounding and the teaching is directly in accordance to the Word of God.  I knew after that first Sunday....."I am home." I have never been so deeply moved to surrender myself to the Lord's gracious will and work as now.   Under the teaching from the Pastors here at Cornerstone, I have been profoundly affected by the commitment to solid teaching, both true to the text and with humility. I enjoy the Sunday Bible studying. And also I have been learning a lot from the Thursday Women Bible Studying. I can feel the God is working on my heart. I’m so glad I found this place.

name: Cornerstone Fellowship Church - Apex Campus
reviewSummary:
Great little church - wonderful layout, parking, comfortable, and friendly staff.  Great central location in Apex.  I was there on a Saturday morning for conference on missions. Fantastic support system for young parents. I don't know what I would have done when I had my twins and my husband was working 70 hr weeks without this incredible group of people. They have been with us through many wonderful celebrations as well as many terrible tragedies in these past 21 years. name: Cornerstone Fellowship Napa, Calvary Chapel - Napa Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church!  Come as you are and find a welcoming church family! Bible preaching and contemporary Christian worship music. Even a potluck every Sunday after service! This is a very welcoming church, and a bit on the smaller side, which I like because it's easier to develop meaningful relationships in the community. The Gospel is preached during every sermon, and Godly people worship here. I went to the Christmas dinner. The people were very nice to me. I feel welcomed. I have attended since 1995 and have this thing to say about their leadership, they genually love people, they genually love Jesus and God's Word. name: Cornerstone Fellowship Walnut Creek - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
Cornerstone (in the East Bay) is like no other church I’ve experienced. Open, loving, kind, food for the soul. I’ve been going to this church for a couple years now and love it. We watch the sermon from Livermore on a screen (which can take some getting used to), but have our own staff (pastor, worship team, etc). The people are friendly, the worship is great, and the sermons are always thought provoking and encourages growth. Our midweek bible study is an amazing group of people that I’ve really grown with and love. I highly recommend Cornerstone Fellowship, on any of their 5 campuses. We’ve been coming to Cornerstone Walnut Creek for nine years now. It’s a church with a strong mission to impact the East Bay with the gospel and to live out authentic lives following Jesus. What really drew us in initially was the people and how incredibly welcoming the community is.

Sunday services are now at 10am at 535 Walnut Ave and we now have live preaching every Sunday (we used to watch the sermons from the main Livermore campus). You have to be pretty bottom of the barrel to give a church in one star. I came to this address to try this church.  Not church but office.  No service at this address.  Its not on the website where they worship at.  Poor experience and not inviting to where they worship

name: Cornerstone Lutheran Church Carmel - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary:
They preach a truthful message about God's grace and our salvation.  You would not leave this church unsure about what they believe or where you stand.  The entire congregation stands up every service and recites their beliefs out loud.  No room for misinterpretation there.  They also encourage children to be IN worship...the same service as the adults, not some dumbed down Children's version in another room (though Sunday School is divided by grade level).  They make a point to not just welcome children, but to involve them.  Every service has a Children's Message before the sermon, where kids are invited to the altar to hear a message designed for their understanding.

It is not an intimidating place for a first timer and anyone from any background is fully welcomed.  That doesn't mean the church preaches an 'anything goes' message, but it does mean that all are welcome at the foot of the cross and that your sins are no greater or lesser than anyone else's...including the Pastors.

The Pastors don't lord over you or live a different life than their congregations.  They don't enrich themselves out of the offering plate. They are just regular people who have the gift of preaching (and a seminary education).  They are married and have kids.  They live normal lives which gives weight to their preaching...you may even see them having a few pints at Oktoberfest. But above all, they acknowledge they are sinners in need of saving just like the rest of us...God isn't hearing their prayers more than anyone else's, letting it be known that we are 'in this together'.

They practice two sacraments, baptism and Real Presence communion (not symbolic, but more like Catholic belief).

Maybe the most important aspect is this: there is are multiple Bibles in every pew and they are opened and read at every service.  There are no gimmicks, just Gospel. I went to an open gym for volleyball and I noticed other people who were apart of the church(I over heard them talking about the church) were getting in more often than me ever though we decided to do a rotation. I also over heard specifically these two women talking about, I didn’t confront them but it definitely affected my experience. I read on google that the church was accepting of all people but I felt as though I was in a hostile environment. The women who were talking about me also was kicking out kids because they were too young. I WILL NEVER be attending ever again I hope anyone else reading this doesn’t have to go through what I did, please take this as a warning. I went to a volleyball open gym and they wouldn’t let me play because of my age. There was one lady who thought she ran things and specifically told us to leave. I thought they would be accepting of me and my culture but I guess not, they thought they were better than me. Very blessed to have found this church. We look forward to every Sunday attending here, and our kids love going too. There is a contemporary and traditional service but both have the same sermon. It is also comforting to know that the church is part of the LCMS and is committed to staying true to the Word. Visiting from Florida, and enjoyed your Christmas Eve service. Thank you for being so welcoming!

name: Cornerstone Metropolitan Community Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary:
Randal I am sorry you missed our signs.. There is a permanent sign and a sandwich board that is put out on Sunday morning. Our piano player is a wonderful piano player and music leader. I have attended many different churches since I was a child and I find nothing strange about ours, except communion. We welcome all God's children to communion because it is God's table not ours. I love this church. They are eagerly accepting, passionately preaching and joyfully singing. Best choir in town with the best pianist I've heard in decades. The members of this church are led by a fantastic pastor and are all loving and caring people. It doesn't matter if you are straight or LGBTQ, everyone is welcomed and made to feel at home.  Love this church. Everyone is welcome here.  Very loving, friendly place.  I live in Mississippi and still make the drive to mobile as much as I can to go there Not an easy to find location. Didnt see any visible sign, or address.
Finally googled it and found it by map. Strange uneven muddy parking area (and I was told they had been operating since the 1970s!!) o.k.
I went in the front door, again, no signs, nothing, not even sure if I was in the right place. I looked all over for a welcome information page or something indicating how the service takes place. Nothing. A somewhat aggressive, dressed in men's clothing women said 'Hello."  that was it. Not welcome to Cornerstone, or have a seat, or this is for you, etc. Then I noticed the rainbow flag kinda thing draped around a cross near the alter, so I figured i must be at Cornerstone.
Hardly anyone here, those that were there very very noisy, loud, and very strange there were a few people mostly women sitting on the stage area just staring ahead and kinda mumbling and sorta singing. Very very weird.
Mostly older mannish women here. Maybe two older gay guy couples.  A few blacks all in one group. Maybe like 18 people in the whole place.
A woman made an announcement and then they played a strange music video that no one there really seemed to know but I guess everyone was expected to sing along to?
People talking through the entire service if you would call it that, very loud, more music videos.
May be a F.T.M.? person played the piano very loudly a few times, but at least it was lively and better than hearing people talk all around me.
Didn't recognize any of the music and they didn't hand out anything to tell you what it was.
Sound system kept acting up again im wondering havent they been here since the 1970s?
Very strange service the only thing close to a real church was the communion part.
Didn't see any men do anything in the service it seems to be a place for older mostly white women only.
They never gave me any information and there wasn't any coffee or place to talk after the service and no one ever talked to me, I was the only guy sitting by himself but there was older ladies sitting by themselves up near the front.
Never heard of this place until someone told me about it at Pridefest.
Looks like they are barely putting on a service and I felt very out of place for being a gay dude by himself and for wearing a shirt and tie like I always wear to a church.
Wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

name: Cornerstone Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
Wonderful teachings  from the Bible.
Friendly and respectful and supportive.
Betts🍁 Love the easy going vibe and accessible facility.  Not too busy but enough that you fill like you can meet like minded folks. Very friendly LEADERS one offered me a ride bu i JUST purchased a car GOD BLESS YOU ALWAYS RESPECTFULLY ROBERT R CALVERT A really nice facility, very nice and friendly people at the church.  If you live in the area and Christian, this is definitely a good church to go to. Gospel-centered preaching and teaching.  Very friendly worship experience.  Delicious and free coffee!

name: Cornerstone United Methodist Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: A heartwarming, kind, and friendly church that feels like home. I’m so happy I came here and discovered that this is the church where I belong. I think anyone who visits will feel like they belong here. The church’s young adult small group is fun and faithful to Jesus Christ. We have so many great and unforgettable events and weekly small group gatherings! Highly recommended! 👍 Good worship and sermons.  More traditional flow, but with contemporary music and strong missions and community support.  Lunch after worship! I attended my old church for three years. I never felt accepted there so I was searching for another church for quite some time. I ended up finding Cornerstone in Placentia because one of my best friends went there. Ever since, I have fallen in love with this church and the church family. Pastor John is a great pastor who likes to get to know everyone on a deeper level. The warmth is like no other; it really feels like God is on the move here. If you’re seeking a fun-loving, vibrant, faithful community, this is the place for you. I love this church! The pastor really cares for everyone who visits and will pray with you if you need prayer. There is a fellowship luncheon after service every week. Everyone here is so warm and welcoming. I am so thankful that I have found this church. The people of this church are like family to me now. ❤️🙏 Cornerstone Methodist Church is warm and a prayerful church. They are faith based and believes in Trinity; God the Father, Jesus who died for our sins, and the Holy Spirit.  I came with many flaws and scars but from the compassion and care from this community church, i feel accepted and healed as i shared in my small group.

name: Cornerstone Word of Life Church - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
Good singing, very welcoming to new comers. The pastor give the sermon like a class you can identify with and apply to your life. I went with family that are members. Very good service. My wife and I were visiting for the weekend and searched for churches in the area. We found Cornerstone and decided to attend—and we are so glad we did! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and I could truly feel the most important aspect of our faith: love. The pastor delivered an excellent message on walking with God, and the worship was both powerful and uplifting. I was pleasantly surprised by the diversity and the selection of songs—it really made the experience meaningful.

We left feeling refreshed, encouraged, and grateful. Thank you, Cornerstone, for making us feel at home! All I can say is wow. ❤️ You feel God’s presence in every service. The pastors are truly anointed. They preach and teach from the Bible. They’ve taught me so much in three visits. If you want to strengthen your relationship with God and create a good foundation then this is the church for you. It’s truly life changing. 💕 If you’re really serious about, deepening your relationship with Jesus Christ this is the place for you. I’ve been attending for almost 18 years and can truly say the faithfulness of our pastors is prevalent in these uncertain times;
Their love for God‘s word, supersedes, this chaotic world. CWOL motto and mine too, is knowing Him and making Him known. 💕🫶🏻 For a church located in the Bible belt, "everyone and their mama" know the general stories and messages of the Bible. This church speaks to "not what momma-nem, and friends and other Bible thumpers" do, but actually what it is to understand what is being said. Not in the way people accept one sentence then forget to apply the next sentence. The pastor here really has a message that will call you out to really have you think on what you think you know, and how many people cheapen or take the shortcuts in faith. I Really appreciate the approach to the word given. They follow the Bible, not just making our own interpretations of "God is love" [which he is], and fluffy, but just because Granny quoted a verse of  the Bible to tell you to do something, your relationship with the Word is what matters, not Granny's words to you about the Word.

If this makes no sense to you.... Just go. Experience it yourself and you'll know what I mean.

From my multicultural upbringing, I also appreciated it being a diverse church.

name: CornerstoneSF Church - Mission Campus (Sunday 10:00am at Riordan campus) - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: My most recent visit here was a couple weeks ago. This church tries to make every visitor welcome and does a good job of doing so. The hot chocolate, coffee and baked goods are not essential to hospitality but they do add to the welcoming and celebratory atmosphere. Walking into the building after being warmly greeted by ushers it truly feels like a celebration, where the worship team leads the start of service.  I believe it was Odalis Turincio who gave the message that morning and she did it in a way that was clear and explained Scripture simply and an easy to follow way. This place has connected with me and does connect each time I go there. My faith has always been non existence but when I come here I connect my life with everything the pastor says and then the people are the most welcoming and friendly people I have ever encountered there’s anywhere. I could not say too much good about this church and I really encourage no matter what your believes are to go and sit for one of there days I went night time.  You will see what I’m talking about.  And the app is really nice has older taped sessions.  So impressed about everything this church offers and stands for.  Thank you cornerstone! Amazing place!  It is a beautiful church and the people are terrific! We visited from NYC and our friends in San Francisco who took us to Church on Sunday morning. We had a blast ! Friendly atmosphere , nice singing fun times ! Friendly Californian lively church but also typical of Californian Christians. My none Christian son visiting from Europe said people are superficial in California and the churches are no different nice people but often the Lord seems an afterthought. Music is nice but like so many other churches entertainment seems to be the theme and real worship secondary. Church does not practice the gifts of the spirit and mostly a teaching church with very little preaching to the list.

Corona Church of Christ - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Every year on the saturday before Thanksgiving this church and its community give out food to families in need. This week you had me in tears
By the way, Shirley and I are worshiping together, what a blessing! Nice people, great services and everyone is super active with different projects.

reviewSummary: I love this church and the congregation! Friends Church Corona truly knows what loving your neighbors means. They go above and beyond for our local community. They serve serve Jesus selflessly. I have never felt so welcomed anywhere!  Not just friends more like family. Went community Easter event and tonight a family movie night.  Beautiful people here. Friendly place to worship, and belong to a community of Believers. Thank you for the food bank.

name: Corona International Christian Fellowship - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly and caring Pastors and families. Bible teaching and preaching church Great bible teaching church!

A sweet congregation that loves the Lord Jesus Christ gathers here. His gospel of salvation and grace is faithfully proclaimed in the worship service. I how to visit again sometime. Wonderful, God-honoring, faithful and loving services and congregation.
Highly recommended.
ALL are welcome, saved and unsaved alike.
Many different cultures and ages here.
Please come and ask for me/Gayle if you want to.
God bless you!

reviewSummary:
A wonderful church for the family to grow in the Christian faith. Youth, young adult and adult education. An elevated Sunday service. Numerous groups of interest you can become involved with.  Exciting things are happening here. Have always felt very welcome at this church. Come here every time I come out to visit my son's family
Jan Anderson Manito, IL Very friendly congregation. They are Christ centered and it shows!!! Fellow brothers and sisters in Christ.  Thanks for your hospitality. It was a disappointing experience

name: Coronado Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I would've gave a better Rating but im very disturbed and disappointed of the judgemental acts towards my son at their daycare that they have. My son my not be a shy quite kid but he's NOT special needs. I dont know why they tell me to get my son some help im sure if i was a high class person they wouldn't even have gone there with me. If you guys can't handle a kid that has extra energy then you shouldn't be a daycare at all or even believe in the Lord with your judgmental acts and i will report you guys to the county of san diego. Im so disappointed. Very old building. But beautiful stained glass. A new leader is running it and it looks terrible with signs on the front and covers over the stain glass and no more access for the disabled. Liked the old management better. Ok first like really I don’t now why this has a so good review for such a wierd church ⛪️ bless god but really when we first got in there was a possible homeless putting music at all volume then we start to notice the place is really really ugly it didn’t look like a church so no 👎 but it’s my opinion This website won't allow you to skip all the stars. The pastor doesn't even deserve any star. Not a sincere person. Only looking out for himself. #Stay away! Great place to worship and great preaching that changed my situations.

name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church
reviewSummary: Corpus Christi faith family is so active. The liturgy is beautiful. A vibrant Roman Catholic community in Aliso Viejo. Love the Sunday Mass times.

name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We love this Catholic Church! Fr. Mike Rizzo
has done wondrous changes here and Fr. Brandon Dang is continuing the same path. Always feel welcome! ❤️ I attended daily mass. It was absolutely freezing in the church. I looked at my uncomfortableness as penance. 😞
The service was nice. Check out the pictures! The devotion to the Mother of Heaven and earth was nice. Remember that Jesus is God and deeply loves you, so turn to Him in this life. Turn from your sins. His life is so much better than anything this life has to offer. ❤️ Corpus Christi has been my home since its inception and I love it more and more each year. You can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit in the people and the music and especially our Pastor. After visiting several churches in the area, we have found our new home. Fr Dang is a breath of fresh air; his warm demeanor and positivity are infectious. After a very long hiatus, we now look forward to mass every Sunday. Absolutely beautiful church and service, it feels so Holy!

name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Spent 8th day Simbang Gabi and Misa de Gallo at Corpus Christi Church in Corona. Many Filipino parishioners. Get involved and everyone is welcome. I love this church in a way that’s hard to put into words. The people here aren’t just involved they make you feel welcomed the moment you walk in. Every time I’m here, I feel drawn to come back again, whether it’s once a week or even more, just to be part of this community and share in the worship that fills this place.

There’s something about the simplicity of this old church that feels like home to me. The music, the warmth, the way God’s presence seems to settle over everything it makes me feel connected. Being here reminds me why faith matters and why community is such a gift. Beautiful church

Father Fidel is a great pastor and Father Leo is Great and The other priest are very great there 🙏.

My God bless them 🙏 💯

Confession Friday (No adoration)and Tuesday 6-7pm (with adoration)
Confessions every Tuesdays except every last Tuesday of the month
Healing Mass at the last Tuesday of the month at 7pm cozy church a little small but has outdoor seating as well Beautiful church, music was great. Traditional ceremony! Enjoyed the sermon. When passing through we will be back.

name: Corpus Christi Christian Fellowship - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary: After spending a few months looking for a new church, this is it! This is my Church Home! Everyone is very accepting and welcoming. I made friends from the young adults group. I look forward every Wednesday evening and Sunday morning to hear Pastor Don’s message. This church talks nothing but Christ. Knowing the hardships I’ve been through in life, I’m glad I’m learning more about the Lord and I found a place to praise the Lord and worship Him. Since I’ve been going to this church more often, I feel like I’ve been growing stronger and wiser through Christ. I’m blessed to meet such beautiful people here at CCC Fellowship! This is where I belong!🖤✝️ You walk in and are welcomed with the love of Jesus. Wonderful place of worship, God's presence is truly felt. Everyone is amazing , full of God's love . Where Jesus' name is truly blessed and praised . You can't help but open up your mouth and shout with joy up to the Father in heaven and bless His holy name. Oh how I love You Jesus!!! This is an awesome place I was greeted at the front door and even treated like I was already a member. When I'm in town the will be my place of worship. Thank you Christian Fellowship. I felt so welcomed. My mother went to this church for 30 years. She had put in multiple hours of service and thousands of dollars into this place and its people. When she passed away, these people wouldn’t even pay to get her cremated. Three weeks later, I had to apply for a pauper’s burial. Once the church leaders found out the application had been accepted, they offered to pay for her services. I let them know the arrangements have already been cleared, but asked if they would donate the money to me, as I needed financial assistance to get things settled after her passing. They scoffed and said nothing else! The leaders were in a hurry to have my mother’s memorial services and wouldn’t let me schedule it. She was still in the morgue for crying out loud! Till this day, I cannot understand how they could allow a devoted member of their church family, lie in a freezer for three weeks and not lift a finger to offer assistance. This experience has exposed the true nature and character of this establishment. Large auditorium. Ample parking. Attended a funeral. Good sound system

name: Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Systematic expository preaching and outstanding worship. Highly recommend.

name: Cottage Grove Church
reviewSummary: Cottage Grove Church (or "Cottage Cheese," as I affectionately refer to it) is the greatest church I have ever had the privilege of attending. The presence of God in this establishment is overwhelming, and its affect on the vivacious congregation is undeniable. The worship team is remarkably talented and notably modest; their performance is dedicated wholly toward praising the Lord. The sermons, preached by Pastors Recab Gray and Andy Norris are deeply profound and validly rooted in scripture. The body of attendees is very diverse, despite Iowa's majority white population. I could continue, but if you, the reader, wish to know more, I urge you to spend a Sunday morning there. It is a wonderful experience. I love my church home! I may be a little biased, but I think the welcome team is great! Pastor Andy and Pastor Rechab are both great. Adam White does an amazing job leading worship. And everyone who is apart of worship at cottage grove is amazing! Being born and raised a Catholic, I think I have found a new home. I love my Catholic church, but it's not fulfilling my needs. I live down the street from the Church, but due to illness, I can't walk that far. My son comes down every other weekend from Fort Dodge to take me. Very welcoming and they encourage you in your faith while challenging you to grow. We really enjoyed our time at Salt Company...excellent community for college students/young adults! So relaxed and welcoming. We love this church and we haven't been coming long. Looking forward to many more visits!

name: Cottonwood Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely church in Orange County located in a great junction with good grounds for parking and ambient  surroundings for worship and fellowship. Loved the ceremony and the pastor. Huge church. I felt very welcomed. Since 1st time there they gave me a Bible and a welcome bag. Their are prayer tents in front for you to pray in after ceremony. Really enjoyed it. Def will be going back. I love this church. Drive from the border of San Diego and Riverside County every Sunday. Communion every 1st week. Baptisms every 4th. My entire family got baptized here. My tithe goes to Cottonwood. Wonderful church with indoor and outdoor seating. Great pastors with a great pastor in pastor Bayless who greets his members every Sunday. I've been to a few big churches and you will never see the pastor outside of the pulpit. I started going to church here regularly after 2 decades of running from God. I just wish I was closer to join small groups. Do yourself a favor and just go. I want to personally thank everyone in this church. Everyone is so welcoming, newcomers are treated respectfully, you don’t have that feeling of entitlement or obligation of any sort. There are hundreds of, maybe even thousands of people at the service, and it’s so heart warming. I’ve gone to other churches and this one sets the bar high for all churches because it’s spectacular. It is 20 minutes of worship (not the biggest fan of it personally) then 45 minutes of Bible study / lecture on a deep dive of the verse that day, and how you can actually apply it to your life day by day. Many wonderful pastors whom rotate every Sunday, and it’s just amazing. Thank you, this service actually give you goosebumps when whatever the speaker is saying actually applies to your life or things you can relate to (this happens a lot). Very clean and professional and various ways of seeing the sermon (outside, inside the church, live on their website). Phenomenal church! This is my first time; this is a great place to worship. Multi-ethnic. Great Bible teaching; message is based on Repentance, baptism, and spreading the Gospel of Jesus. Love, compassion. I am so glad to see where,time is taken out to pray for those who need prayer. The Ministers stay after church and wait for anyone to come forward.

It is 20 minutes of worship (not the biggest fan of it personally) then 45 minutes of Bible study / lecture on a deep dive of the verse that day, and how you can actually apply it to your life day by day. Many wonderful pastors whom rotate every Sunday, and it’s just amazing. Thank you, this service actually give you goosebumps when whatever the speaker is saying actually applies to your life or things you can relate to (this happens a lot). Very clean and professional and various ways of seeing the sermon (outside, inside the church, live on their website). Phenomenal church! This is my first time; this is a great place to worship. Multi-ethnic. Great Bible teaching; message is based on Repentance, baptism, and spreading the Gospel of Jesus. Love, compassion. I am so glad to see where,time is taken out to pray for those who need prayer. The Ministers stay after church and wait for anyone to come forward.

name: Country Club Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I am so proud to call Country Club Christian my church home of over 25 years. Open and welcoming to all. There are enriching and educational opportunities for all ages, providing even more connectivity to my church family.
Please don't let the name or location deter you! Our Country Club name stems from our being in the Country Club district of Kansas City. Nothing more. So inconsiderate to the city to shut down Ward Parkway so your parishioners- what? -don't have to walk more than twenty feet? Clearly, funding isn't the issue. This group is out to serve themselves.

#buildyourownparkinglot I drove by and had to stop after seeing the architecture of the building. there was a massive wood sculpture of the last supper inside. I couldn't believe the detail and it left me wondering about the artist Domenic Zappia and how much time and effort he put into making this Magnificent sculpture. the stained glass windows had amazing detail as well. i appreciate that they let me see these great artworks. We just moved to KC and are looking for a new church. We wouldn’t call this the most welcoming church. There were no hellos or welcomes from any of the parishioners. Even the usher walked past us a few times without saying anything. I said a few “good morning”s but I only got back the slightest wry smile. But I did take the opportunity to say a nice prayer for the Chiefs today. I love this church! Most welcoming church I have ever been too. It's amazing to take my sons to a church that teaches love. I don't have to worry that ANY hate or intolerance is taught to my kids. You don't have to turn your brain off to be in this church! I am an be encouraged to be an educated, and strong woman of the world by this church...amazing!

name: Countryside Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
A True Spiritual Home!

From the moment I walked through the doors of Countryside Baptist Church, I was met with warmth, love, and a genuine sense of community. What started as a visit has turned into something so much more—I’m now a proud member of this incredible church family!

The welcoming atmosphere here is unlike anything I’ve experienced before. Everyone—from the greeters to the pastors—made me feel at home right away. The messages are grounded in truth, full of encouragement, and always speak to the heart. The worship is powerful and uplifting, creating such a strong connection to God every time we gather.

What I love most is how real and relational this church is. They truly care—not just on Sundays, but throughout the week. Whether it’s through small groups, outreach, or just grabbing coffee and sharing life together, the sense of belonging is amazing.

If you’re looking for a place to grow in your faith, connect with loving people, and truly feel part of something meaningful, Countryside Baptist Church is it. I’m so thankful God led me here—and I can’t wait to see what’s ahead! Stop littering! Leaving flyers on cars creates waste and pollution!! Protect His planet Psalm 24:1 I love pastor I was there when we set in car outside
Im going to come back god spoke to me
See you soon god bless

Debbie reiss The Pastor at this church really cares, I joined this church because the values are truly Christian. I felt that it was more in depth to the word, they have outside service at 9:15am on Sundays and you can stay in your car. Also inside service at 11am Sunday school and kids classes between services. I really do feel like family every time I visit this church and my soul always feels rejuvenated. Just swing on by and check it out. I don’t get anything but the possibility of helping another soul find joy. Review from Stacey Pesce: A 5 star rating for CBC is not high enough!! No words could ever describe how special this church is!! Starting first with Pastor John-he is one of a kind! ❤️ The entire church staff and each of the members exemplify the words “church family”! I have never in my life experienced more warmth and love in a church home. The impact that CBC has had on my life and my family is beyond anything I could ever express in words. If you are lost and looking for a church home-CBC is your answer. You will never feel alone again and you will grow closer in your walk in faith surrounded by members/ Pastors that will lift you up every step of the way. Let God lead you here-your life will be blessed beyond measure!

name: Countryside Bible Chapel
reviewSummary: This church is so welcoming and friendly! It has programs for all ages! They have an AWANA program that kids love! The youth group on Saturday nights is a great time for teens to have fun. I would highly recommend this church looking for a family oriented atmosphere focused on Christ and biblical truths. We're fairly new to this church but can't believe how quickly it's become like home! Every time we go we feel the Christ-like love from everyone there. We also love that there is communion every Sunday! I've really only met some of the members, never attended. Seems like a sweet and Christ-centered church, however I'd have to attend several times before I will say so conclusively. Great place to worship! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Countryside Bible Church - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary:
II’m a big John MacArthur supporter and Tom Pennington (Countryside pastor) was the associate pastor under John for 13 or 14 years.
Pastor Tom teaches very similar to John if you know what that’s like. I like a more traditional worship too. Choir, horns, string instruments.
Its big but can feel small as there are lots of programs too This church distinguishes itself as a sanctuary for those seeking a profound spiritual experience.

It is not suited for those seeking casual diversions.

Conversely, this church is ideally suited for individuals seeking a community where the teachings are grounded in deep respect for God and Scripture, cultivated from an early age.

Attending Pastor Pennington's sermons provides a uniquely enriching experience, with many finding the depth of analysis and insights derived from each verse remarkably comprehensive.

One particular sermon stands out, which solidified my commitment to this church. Pastor Pennington announced a sermon focused on a single verse, and while I initially anticipated a shorter service, the sermon maintained its usual length and generated an even greater volume of notes than I had ever taken in a church service.

Pastor Pennington's profound reverence for God and Scripture is evident in his ability to effectively elucidate the Scriptures. This approach allows the youth within the congregation to grasp the teachings while providing an engaging and intellectually stimulating presentation for the adults.

Pastor Pennington's sermons are not merely intended to impart knowledge about the Bible; instead, he delivers his sermons as an act of reverence and worship to God, inviting the congregation to participate in that worship.

The church features an orchestra and choir, with the congregation and choir performing both hymns and theologically sound new songs. The choir and special singers are of exceptional quality. Having participated in choirs since childhood, I can attest to the difficulty of achieving a cohesive choir sound. The choir director, Seth Bigelow, excels with the orchestra and choir, making it a joy to sing with and hear them each week.

Pastor Pennington and his wife have also written several theologically sound and beautiful hymns.

Regarding the children's ministry, my initial experience is noteworthy. During my second visit, my preschool-aged child asked a memorable question: "So I don't understand something." She then asked, "Which comes first sanctification or propitiation?" This demonstrated that my four-year-old was being taught and comprehending more theology than I had in my lifetime.

Their VBS is of exceptional quality, and the children walk away with such an in-depth knowledge of the subject matter that I am truly amazed each year.

Each year the children's and youth choirs (Kinder, 1st-2nd, 3rd-5th) put on special performances at Christmas and in the spring. The 3rd-5th put on an amazing musical play that consistently brings laughter and joy, while also being theologically sound (as the youth pastor gives the biblical wrap up at the end of the play, there is no doubt that the church believes these historically accurate stories are true, as Biblically told.)

Witnessing my child's academic progression, I am consistently impressed by the deepening of her understanding and appreciation for the Scriptures and her relationship with the Lord. We've been going to Countryside Bible Church for a while now. The teaching from Tom Pennington is excellent, and this review is coming from a reformed guy. Everyone seems really friendly as well. Best Christian church in the metroplex. Reformed, mature and godly pastor, organized services, godly worship, friendly saints, respectable attire, solid teaching in Sunday School, mature and godly elders, well-stocked book store, large modern campus, easy parking. You will not find anyone on church staff wearing skinny jeans here! May God continue to bless Countryside Bible Church!! If you want to experience a truly caring congregation with teachers that are Biblically sound I would highly recommend Countryside Bible Church.

name: Countryside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family have been attending Countryside Christian Church for about 3 years now. I just realized I have never done a review about it. There are so many great things about this church! Pastor Glen and his son Andrew ( as well as many others) do an amazing job at delivering the word in a easy to relate to way. They all teach straight out of the Bible and always make people feel welcomed and loved.

Our son has been attending the youth church there and absolutely loves it. This will be his second year attending the middle school /high school summer camp and he is so excited about it. If you have a high schooler or middle school age child I highly recommend this camp. The first time he went he came back and said he feels closer to God.

As a bonus there is a cafe inside of the church. We eat breakfast there every Sunday. They have pastries, fresh fruit, scrambled eggs with bacon and toast, breakfast burritos and much more. It's all very good food and very reasonably priced. We always look forward to eating breakfast before church starts.

If you're looking for a church that is non-denominational, preaches the good news, and lots of friendly people, this is the church you need to try. We have been attending Countryside Christian Church for almost 6 months now and absolutely love it! The worship team is fantastic and the sermons are always filled with valuable and meaningful messages - the pastors are amazing!! We’ve learned and grown so much in our faith already just in our short time here! ☺️💗 We always feel welcome and have invited numerous family members to attend and they all feel the same.

And their podcast is amazing!!!

We look forward to getting more involved and coming here for many years to come! ☺️ Countryside Christian Church is amazing!! My family and I all attend on Sundays and Midweek, and it is truly a great place with great leadership. Want to shout out Pastor Marcelo— he has poured into my son and made him feel comfortable going to youth group. All of the pastors at this church are incredible, and we are so grateful for Countryside. This month is officially one year for my husband Wayne and I attending Countryside Christian Church. We now consider it our church family. When we came a year ago for a Wednesday night worship service, our lives changed forever. For me, I felt a genuine sense of belonging. Despite the size, this church, the pastors and it's leaders make you feel so welcome, as if you're visiting family that you haven't seen for a long time. Pastor Glenn Davis is the lead pastor and such a down to earth man. He and his wife Elaine are exceptional stewards of God. He's a rare type of pastor, who leads from the sidelines matching the same challenges we all face in life. The culture he has created here is that "you never walk alone" and he's fostered a sense of peace for the church, knowing, that if you fall, you fall into the hands of people who truly love you. The Co-Pastor is his son, Pastor Andrew, and he is a vessel for deep truths and preaches with a purpose. He has an incredible ability to pull you into the word of God and His message and his passion for the Lord is catchier than his punchlines, it is such a joy to listen to him preaching. Pastor Marcelo is the executive pastor of "next gen" and online. He is an inspiration, especially for our youth. There is an undeniable old soul to the quality of his ministry. He echos great revivalst of the past that captivates and encourages you to dig deep within yourself and confront the person that God is calling you to be. Without hesitation, we quickly signed up for bible study, marriage group, woman's and men's small groups, we've taken the growth track class, volunteered a few times and are currently in Alpha. We're both ready to start serving and do whatever we can to be fully dedicated followers of Christ. Because of this church and the messages we've received from God through the leaders, through the small groups and the fellowship we've experienced here, we both have a new found and deeper love for God and pray His light will shine through us, and everyone we cross paths with. From the moment we first attended, we were amazed by the incredible children’s services and the uplifting worship led by an amazing worship leader Alaina. The energy, passion, and dedication to creating a welcoming atmosphere for all ages truly set this church apart.

The pastors are genuine, down-to-earth people who teach about God’s love in a way that is both meaningful and relatable, often sharing personal stories that make the messages even more impactful.

Beyond Sunday services, the church is alive with events and personal groups that help foster real connections and spiritual growth. Whether you’re looking for a place to worship, a community to belong to, or a place for your children to grow in faith, this church is a wonderful home for all.

We are so grateful to have found this church and highly recommend it to anyone seeking a faith-filled, welcoming community!

name: Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa Campus - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
A few years back, I surprised my mom for Mother's Day by showing up to church at Countryside Christian South Tampa, after some not-so-subtle "hints" that she'd like me to attend church with her since my younger sister who always went with her, had moved to TX. I made it a few more occasions the remainder of the year like most "Christians" often tend to do (you know, the big Christian holidays). I later committed to making it to communion Sunday each month the following year. And did so. After that, for the following year, I made a commitment to myself that I'd attend service as often as I could. I haven't looked back since. I'm a dreamer and often dream of winning that big lottery jackpot and moving somewhere that's much, much cooler and doesn't exist under the threat of hurricanes. Now, it actually kind of hurts me to think about not being able to be at church with the amazing people I have come to love over the past few years. We have a saying: "Welcome Home." And it really is the only way I could describe Countryside Christian Church. I attend the South Tampa campus and have made it to the main campus in Clearwater. The people are all the same. They're all wonderful and welcoming. Our leadership are all kind, loving, welcoming, and caring. If I'm sick and can't make it to service, I can always watch the streaming service, but it just isn't the same. I am glad I surprised my mom for Mother's Day when I did. And I am proud to be a member of CCC. I even took the step to be baptized as an adult (I was baptized as a teen, because it was the "cool" thing). It was truly one of the most amazing experiences. Come home to Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa. Countryside is truly an amazing church. Our entire family loves it! Our toddlers love going to their classes and always ask if it’s church day.
If your looking for a family friendly church that really live out what they believe you just found it. Countryside Sounth Tampa is truly a loving, helpful, and God-filled place. From the moment you walk through the doors, you're welcomed like family. The atmosphere is full of kindness and genuine care, and it's clear that the presence of God is at the center of everything they do.

There are so many ways to get involved—whether it’s through small groups, outreach programs, worship teams, youth ministries, or volunteer opportunities, there’s something for everyone. It’s more than just a church; it’s a place to grow, serve, and belong.

If you're looking for a church home where you can build real relationships and deepen your faith, Countryside Christian Church ST is a wonderful place to be. We first heard of Countryside when a chance meeting with a person in need spoke of their food pantry where he volunteered. We went to the South Tampa campus and were so warmly greeted that we felt like we were with family. We also found that the service was very accurately based on scripture, and very relevant to today's issues. The personalization with us, we realized, was the beginning of building a more personal relationship with Jesus. Clearly, landing on Countryside was not by chance! We love this church!!!  Such a great experience for our family to have a place where we felt welcome from the moment we parked our car.  Everyone is so welcoming and the atmosphere is great.  You are greeted at the door by friendly people who not only make you feel welcome but make it a priority to provide your family with an amazing experience.  Countryside South Tampa Campus has something for everyone in our family from childcare to youth group, adult groups and opportunities to serve at the church and in the community with their Helping Hands ministry.   Ever since attending they have always provided an exceptional Bible based Godly message with a wonderful worship experience.  Pastor Dan and his amazing staff were especially wonderful to me and my family and I would highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking to have a closer relationship with God.  My wife and I whole heartedly believe that Countryside South Tampa can make a huge impact in your life and your families the same way it has for ours.

name: Courageous Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church home in Tampa, this is it.

I was searching for a place where I could hear the Lord clearly and grow deeper in my faith — and I found that here. The Word is powerful, the atmosphere is genuine, and the presence of God is real.

As a mom of kids under 11, the children’s ministry means everything to me. My girls love coming to church, and that alone speaks volumes. We didn’t just find a church — we found community.

If you’re looking for a place to belong and grow, come visit. It feels like home. 🕊️✨

If you want it even punchier or a little more fire in it, say the word. Courageous Church has transformed my entire family. The pastors lead with their entire heart and the passion they have for the Lord’s people is evident in everything they do and say. We are eternally grateful for Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy’s faithful “yes” to the people of Courage Church and advancing the kingdom of God. I love Courageous Church! I have found a wonderful church family through the courageous life program here and have been attending for over a year. I love serving with the children and in production! This is an amazing mid size church on fire for the Lord! I would recommend this church for young adults, families, people that have been in church their whole life and children! Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy care so much about everyone who steps into this building and you will not leave the same! Courageous Church is an amazing local church right in the heart of Tampa 🙏 I’m grateful for everything they do to impact the community. If you’re looking for a Bible-based church where you can truly grow in your relationship with God, find family, and be encouraged in your faith alongside other believers that are on fire for the Lord… Courageous Church needs to be your church home! I mean.....just look at my picture! That picture I took my first time to Courageous Church and I am still here!!  God is all up and through this church. I am so happy I decided to come to this church and become a member. The pastors actually WANT to get to know you personally!! I haven't joined a church since I was a young child and I finally have a church that I feel at home at!! I was even re-baptized ❤️

name: Cove City Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
Cove made Cleveland become home for my husband and I. Having not known anyone when we moved here, it took no time for this community to take us in and deeply get to know & love us. Cove is so intentional with relationships within the church & with the greater Cleveland community. God is doing amazing things through these people. I was visiting from out of town and wanted to go to church and luckily found this one in my google search.
As we were walking up we were greeted very kindly at the door. Proceeding into the lobby some of the ladies there noticed I was knew and went out of their way to greet me and even offered to sit next to me. How sweet and thoughtful!
As soon as we walked into the main auditorium you could just feel the Holy Spirit and the genuine care/compassion the pastor and its members had. The worship experience was incredible and I was moved to tears.
After worship some of the leaders came on stage to talk about upcoming outreach events/opportunities and WOW! This church's heart for the community was beyond words. You could feel Jesus' love in their mission. This church embodies loving your neighbor as yourself.
The sermon preached had so many relatable notes and was all backed up and explained through scripture. I only wish I lived in Cleveland so I could go every weekend. A fantastic church in downtown Cleveland. The past year and a half my wife have been a part of this community, we've felt continually loved and supported. The presence of God is here. Loving people. Loving Family this church if the definitive of what Christian fellowship mean.❣️❣️ A place to call home!!!

name: Covenant Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
Covenant Christian Church
reviewSummary: Love the church, congregation, and great message.  My husband and I were married by the pastor and we were grateful for all that Pastor Chris did to help us through the process too. I like that they have two types of worship services.  They have community events a few times a year as outreach which is really a nice thing for them to do. If you're looking for an inclusive, welcoming church community I really encourage you to give them a try. The most inclusive caring church family ever. Truly understand OUR LORD JESUS and HIS WALK for us. 9am worship is casual contemporary, communion served every wk. Uplifting and spiritual messages. People actually introduce themselves. Church walks in CROP Hunger Walk.  Has a community garden & a playground. Lots of children. 11am a bit more formal. Diverse congregation. I don't attend this one, my neighbors did, they liked it. It would be nice to walk to church I delivered pizza to this church and they didn't tip a cent.  Good way to represent christ...

Church walks in CROP Hunger Walk.  Has a community garden & a playground. Lots of children. 11am a bit more formal. Diverse congregation. I don't attend this one, my neighbors did, they liked it. It would be nice to walk to church I delivered pizza to this church and they didn't tip a cent.  Good way to represent christ...

name: Covenant Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: I've known Pastor Young and his family for 40 years and have watched him change a large part of this community through his faith, love of people, and sheer force of will. He is a great, great man. The worship here is great, and the love and respect one feels in this church is admirable. Teaching is very practical, well intended and well delivered. 1014 W. 32ND AVE.

name: COVENANT Christian Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: A multi-generational, Filipino-American church that teaches you the Bible and how to grow your relationship with Jesus. For the music worship ministry, it is a mix of contemporary and hymns for the band and the choir. There are also ministries for kids, discipleship, and bible study groups for everyone to join. I've been here for 6+ years since I was in high school and there is no other group I'd like to call my church family. Check out their FB for more photos. For anyone seeking to know more who Jesus is, you are always welcome to join any of the groups or ministries :D Covenant Christian Church is a very friendly and loving church , you will be feed spiritually and materially . A lot of opportunity that you can be involved in any area of ministries.. Come and join with  us this Sunday . Praise The Lord. We finally found the house of God where we can worship and glorify Our Lord Jesus Christ. A beautiful and welcoming place to praise the Lord with wonderful people. Great fellowship! God is glorified in this church!
