name: Covenant Church
reviewSummary: Known for extended, passionate worship times and prophetic teaching. The culture is expressive and Spirit-filled.

name: Covenant Church
reviewSummary: Known for extended, passionate worship times and prophetic teaching. The culture is expressive and Spirit-filled. A strong emphasis on covenant relationships.

name: Covenant Church - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice church and welcoming environment Nice big church with a lot of space behind and a small enclosed park where children can play.  I used to take my son there when he was little.  Now I walk my dog through there.  Very nice vibes. I’ve been a member at Covenant since I was in 5th grade (I’m now technically in the 14th grade). I’ve been poured into by so many people from this congregation. I can not recommend it enough! I love the fellowship that I can find every time I walk into the building. Very good. Matthew 25:32, says, "All nations". This is a judgement of nations and how they treated Israel. Not the Judgement Seat of Christ or the Great White Throne Judgement. The sequence of these events is clear in scripture. This judgement of nations is at Christs second coming, Matthew 25:31. Great place for worship. Kind people. Very interesting church background and intellectual approach of ministry.

name: Covenant Church - Smyrna / Vinings Campus
reviewSummary: They had a fun little trunk or treat event that was fun, a bit disorganized, but it served it's purpose for the small amount of people that arrived for the event. The staff/volunteers seemed, and the building is also nice. Covenant is a loving church family where the people genuinely love Jesus and the expression of that love is seen on everyone's face. The teachings from Pastor David are biblical and very sound! Friendly, very welcoming, great nursery and child care.   Coffee and donuts were a nice touch.  Good singing and I also really liked the sermon. Wonderful family church that loves Jesus! Felt welcome from day one! Friendly people excellent women's conference

name: Covenant Church Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Covanent Church Burbank represents how our community comes together to share the fellowship of Christ our Savior. That’s how I perceive it because everything comes together when we put out trust in His divine timing. There is something amazing when we grow in Christ together. Welcome to attend our services Covanent Church website will have all resources available, there service hours and events taking place. We hope you join us. Blessings. I was invited one day to the Covenant church in Burbank and pastor Brooks messages are so strong. He gets right into the the message and the spirit comes alive. It's a beautiful church and the best part that I like about is on evening worship, after the preaching, we are able to ask pastor Brooks questions to try to stump him, I love that part plus they have the Communion once a month.  They music is great and the environment is just wonderful.  The building looks like a castle when you drive up and inside the big garage door there's tables. It's just a beautiful church and you should really try it. But pastor Brooks and his wife Amanda are just two of the sweetest and nicest people you want to meet as well as the whole church congregation, they're all wonderful and the preacher you never get bored of him.

When I came to the church, I was living in my Van, and they accepted me just as I am the whole congregation did. They saw me through 4 surgeries and one of them was cancer.  They prayed the whole time for me. This is the kind of church you want to go to. Because they are  Powerful, their prayers and the care about everybody. I don't live in CA, but if I did, I would definitely go to Covenant Church Burbank! Pastor Brooks and his wife are some of the most genuinely caring people that I know. I am always encouraged whenever I get to talk to them. Plus, Brooks prepares a worship service and a message about Jesus that will reach both your mind and heart... both thought-provoking and joyful at the same time. This is the place to visit if you are seeking the peace of Christ. In my experience I have been to many churches.  So far, Covenant seals the deal where most churches swear by: perks, bells and acclaim. Covenant has ardent faith, steadfast love of community and fellow believers, a great commitment to sound theology all packed in a studio!
Covenant is lead by God through a wonderful Pastor Pipher and many founding members. Three  years prior, it grew from a house church into a church of strong faith and devotion. This church welcomes all those seeking Christ, seeking answers and seeking a fresh start to a new life.

At Covenant, all I see are God’s wonderful people filled with love, joy, compassion and patience and a firm reverence to Christ and His teachings!  To those looking for a new church or just passing by, Covenant Church will not disappoint. This is a wonderful church. There is a noticeable culture of hospitality. The worship is joyful, reverent and biblical, with the preached Word at the center of it all. I’m so thankful for a Presbyterian church in Burbank. If you are in the area, you should definitely visit. Pastor Brooks and his wife Amanda are such encouraging and prayerful people.

name: Covenant Church of Mobile - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: Our grandchildren go to this school and occasionally we pick them up. The entrance and exits are easy access to major streets in the area.On a hot day we can park in the shade until we have to que up. When we get to the pick up place the kids wait in the shade of the school building and an assistant escorts them to the appropriate vehicles and makes sure the kids are secured in the vehicle. The best school, staff, and curriculum anywhere. So glad we chose to send our child here. Such a great foundation for the rest of his education. A friendly Church where you will hear the Word of God taught as it applies to everyday life. Come and see for yourself! Extremely welcoming! Played a game

name: Covenant Church of Schaumburg
reviewSummary: The most welcoming loving kind caring members & church a blessing I was led to the church the spirit of the Lord resides there very comforting Comfortable and cozy feel, friendly members. They have a lot to offer in Bible study, fellowship and worship. I want their for service and it was amazing and beautiful The concert on December 8th was  Was very awesome I was not there. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Covenant Church: North Campus - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary:
We appreciate our campus pastors, particularly Josh and Stephanee Perez, who deserve more recognition for their hard work. To maintain a personal connection, it's essential for Amy to focus on the south campus rather than relying on screen preaching from another location. This approach will help prevent the loss of talented pastors. The Pastor is 🔥🔥 on point!! She taught precisely what I needed to hear. I was in town visiting from VA and myself and two other guests found Covenant North on Google. We are Pentecostal but felt this would be a great church to visit based on other google
Reviews. The praise and worship service as well as alter call were different than what I’m used to but I know the sermon was spirit led! We arrived an hour before church started because Google said the service time was 9am when in fact it starts at 10. No one, and I mean no one at all spoke to us to try and help or guide us as we walked around confused. Once we returned at the correct time we were met by some friendly greeters at the front. Glad I gave it a try while visiting TX. I would explain my experience as incredible!

We came for Easter Sunday.

Our family traveled to Texas to see family and this is their home church.
At first we didn't want to go, and not because we aren't church people. We just wanted to relax because we thought we would be leaving that day to head home. But when I tell you it was the most invigorating experience we have ever had. As a married couple, this was the first time in 6 years of marriage that we have gone to church as a family. I wish I could just pick up your church and bring it here. We do watch the Sunday service online. And we still feel like we are in and one with the church. It's so amazing, so inclusive. We are a LGBTQ family and we also saw other families there as well that morning. So we just felt included. So with a long winded review. I just want to say I can't wait to come back to your church for a service. I would love to do the woman's retreat one time as well as get baptized. And baptism for our whole family.
I look forward to visiting again and coming to another service. This church is full of diversity, love, passion, and the Lord God himself. Check the experience out for yourself and see if this is a great home for you. ♥️ Come as you are. Don’t know the dress code? Forget it, because you’re not in Gods house to impress others but be loved on. Be reachable and teach-able in His house. You can be comfortable and accepted here by their leaders, pastor, elders, and the community. Ask God if this is the home for you and we’ll see you there! Today was our 1st as a family and we loved everything about the service! We will definitely be back, and we can't wait to take our 2 middle schoolers to youth church this Wednesday for the 1st time. The Word, Worship, and people were Amazing! God's presence was so thick!! Also, very diverse which I love!!

name: Covenant Community Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: I'm sorry about the,recent post please,disregard anything with this name on it great church and,awesome people I highly recommend there,Wednesday supper service I love tis 💗💒💗 Pastor JR is a very caring, funny, loveable,  spiritual person. I just love him ❤ he's truly God send to his church n Me being a visitor. I'm just like family 😍 Today was his Anniversary of 20 years of being there.  Amazing 👐👐 I had a void it, but it's gone. U cld just feel the love his church has for him. Great job Pastor J. R 😍😍 Love this church you are welcome no matter who you are. And now no mask required for vaccinated attendees. Come worship with us Sunday's at 11:30 come see how good the Lord is. And if you wear a mask that's ok. I love my church Periodt!! It doesnt matter what your walk of life is.. you're welcome here... come visit us on a sunday or a Wednesday night for mid week Supper and a lesson for your soul.. we'd love to have you! Welcoming friendly wonderful servce  pastor and parishioners. Definitely a big asset to our community. Christ and scripture oriented.

name: Covenant Community Church - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary: This my home church.  I love everything about it.  The pastor is a wonderful teacher and he definitely fills the role of a pastor.  The music ministry is filled with Spirit lead professionals or professional quality musicians.  The wisdom and kindness that the elders and their wives employ daily as they minister to members is inspierational.  I am so very blessed to have found these people.  I hope to immulate them as I grow in Christ. Gods Word is taught here. Awesome mens ministry. A place of healing. The Church truly wants and will help in any way. Has alot of classes,ministries and opportunities to serve. A true God sent This church has a nice, friendly atmosphere, unfortunately the preaching is not exactly to my liking, as I prefer more expository preaching, but overall, still a good doctrine and contemporary worship. Friendly and welcoming.  No shaming or judging.  Pastor Carlon is a dream to listen to Great biblical teaching and wonderful, loving people. Been here almost 40 years.

name: Covenant Fountain Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church!… CFC has been a blessing to me and my husband teaching me how to step out of my comfort into God’s presence.
A love our great Pastor and his uplifting Godly messages 👍

Every service touches deep in your heart and mind. This is how God works to reach your soul 💒❤️🙏🙌 Covenant Fountain Church is a body of Christ where I fellowship. The preaching and teaching by the Prophet is enriching and changing my life spiritually. Truth and the whole counsel of Jesus Christ is taught and people are richly enhanced in every aspect of life. I always look forward for time of worship and praise, fasting and prayers and of course listening to the preaching and teaching of the word. I have grown spiritually so through this ministry, closer to Jesus than ever before in my entire life. A real place to experience and feel God's presence. Pastor Emmanuel is an extremely humble man. I recommend this church to anyone looking for a local place of worship or for a place to just come and allow the Holy Spirit to really minister to you, in a way that know they are not your emotions but, something supernatural. Thank you! Keep up the great work ~ If you want to experience the presence of God and the resurrection power of Jesus come to Covenant Fountain Church. An amazing place to worship, learn the word of God and be filled with zeal and passion for spreading the gospel of Jesus to the world. Come and be blessed, we love one another as family because we are one in Christ. There is so much love shown towards me when I first visited.
The teaching is such a blessing with powerful revelation knowledge.
Your understanding of the word of God is opened up to understand
the word of God on a new level. I will continue to be a part of this
ministry for this season. So glad to have been made aware of this ministry

name: Covenant Grace Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: We really enjoyed worshiping with the Covenant Grace Church family. Visiting from out of the state, we wanted to find a local church that faithfully teaches scripture and Pastor Mike did just that. The whole church was very welcoming and they made us feel right at home.

name: Covenant Life Christian Center - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
It is hard to find a good church. After a year or so of my husband and I looking for a good church we finally found one at Covenant Life Christian Center. It truly feels like you’re family there. Everyone is so nice, warm, and welcoming. Our son loves the children’s area. And most importantly we have grown so much in the Word of God and in our relationship with Jesus Christ than we ever have before in our entire lives just by going to this church. The worship and teaching is so anointed we are so very blessed! my husband and I had said we would never join another church based on our previous experiences with other churches.
After attendig here we deiced we would become a part of this family. We love the leadership here, they are so very real. the Pastor follows the leading of the Holy Spirit, as does the praise and worship leader. There is so UNCONDITIOnAL much love and acceptance here . We have finally found our church home and family. This is the greatest church! I've been attending for about 5 years now and the people are very loving and giving and kind and it's an awesome group. The pastor preaches by listening to the Holy Spirit which is very important and
he's really awesome and real. I'd recommend this church to everyone who's looking for a great church home. Covenant Life is definitely home. As soon as you walk in the doors you're welcomed with love. The pastors and leadership are wonderful and walk out what they teach. This is a great group of people loving the Lord and I couldn't say better things about this church. What a wonderful family and brotherhood church.  They are truly glad to see you each week and are always eager to know you better.  Their message each week is fresh and anointed of God and is always pertinent to these times we are in right now.  They stick to what the Bible says and want the congregation to be more and more empowered as you grow in Christ Jesus.  We thank you so very much for all you do.

Larry and Dawn

name: Covenant Life Christian Fellowship - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve called this my home for 36 years. I was born into this church,  my grandparents were going and my parents as well. I met my wife here. I’m raising my kids here. Holy Spirit filled and our pastors have held their example for over 40 years. Perfect place to fulfill your call and raise a family! First time here 🙏🏼 The warmest of the people brought me here.  Met Becky and her kind family at the Halloween event .  I know she was chosen to be one of my angels💕 Was here from a baby until I left in when I was in High School, spent many years pursuing everything opposite of Jesus and Church. Came back and was welcomed with open arms and have been abundantly blessed by the Love, commitment, fellowship, and dedication to one another here by the Pastors, Leaders, and congregation.
This is home. Pastors should always be impartial not take sides. That is not the case here. Not only was Pastor Sandy Rude in front of other parishioners it was hurtful and embarrassing for her. I went and it did not feel welcome and will not return.
So sad to put this review about Pastor Jesse and Pastor Sandy but hope they change their outlook 🙏🙏 I was having a bad day awhile back and I was passing by this church and some of the members noticed I was upset and asked if they could pray for me. I agreed and a few others gathered around me and prayed. Although we were complete strangers, the members of this church reached out and left an impression on me that I will always remember.

name: Covenant Life Church
reviewSummary:
I was invited by a friend of mine, & have just started attending their service, but I feel very welcomed. Everyone has been so friendly to me. They sent me bibles, daily devotionals & some journals for at least a year before I was able to attend my first service! Anytime I am in the area, I will be attending service & worshipping our Lord. So thankful for the staff, & the experience! This the most amazing place. My family and I have been attending since July. Pastor Shane and the staff make you feel welcome right from the beginning. But it’s so funny though. So does everyone else! These folks have a genuine love for Jesus and a love for people. I can honestly say my relationship with Jesus has gone to another level. If you truly are seeking a place to worship & connect. Online or in person…This is it! I have been going to this church for just a few weeks and have never felt more like God was meeting me where I am more, then here.

Between service on Sundays and City Groups throughout the week to feed my desire for a community, and I have found it here.

Don't know what I would have done without finding these people, this place, but most importantly, God in it all. After a year of not being in a church,  we found one!  Everyone is very sweet and welcoming. The music is loud in the front, but the preaching is phenomenal. A friend of ours goes there and he recommended this church and we tried it out. A home for us now. Covenant Life Church is a place that gives back to the community through acts of service like a large backpack give away before school starts, prison ministry, and food pantry.  This is all done with the mission of winning souls to Christ.  The people in the church are friendly and welcoming.  The messages are biblical and inspiring with great worship.

My family and I have been attending since July. Pastor Shane and the staff make you feel welcome right from the beginning. But it’s so funny though. So does everyone else! These folks have a genuine love for Jesus and a love for people. I can honestly say my relationship with Jesus has gone to another level. If you truly are seeking a place to worship & connect. Don't know what I would have done without finding these people, this place, but most importantly, God in it all. Covenant Life Church is a place that gives back to the community through acts of service like a large backpack give away before school starts, prison ministry, and food pantry.  This is all done with the mission of winning souls to Christ.  The people in the church are friendly and welcoming.  The messages are biblical and inspiring with great worship.

name: Covenant Life Church - Tampa Campus
reviewSummary: Being a part of this church is one of the best parts of being in Tampa. There is true God-centered, biblical community here, focused on expository preaching, genuine worship, and love between believers and for the world. God is glorified here! CLC is the place to be if you’re looking for a solid church family. Every Sunday the word is convicting and impactful. The time of worship is filled with songs that are theologically sound and beautiful reminders of who God is. The call to worship through prayer always points you back to Christ and encouragement. The people are welcoming. Come check it out for yourself 💞 A loving church that seeks to glorify God in all they do. Great expositional preaching, emphasis on scripture, and commitment to sound doctrine. The members are incredibly welcoming and eager to get to know you. Sunday worship services are well laid out and always encouraging. From community groups to men’s and women’s ministries to classes and events, this church has blessed us with awesome and genuine fellowship. We have grown so much in our faith, learned lots, and been cared for in many different ways. Would highly recommend for anyone on looking for a local church! This is an incredible church that values and loves the Word of God. The preaching is expositional, the music is theologically sound, and the community is  inviting and friendly (aka not cliquey ).  I moved here not knowing anybody 3 years ago and immediately felt at home at this church!  The depth of teaching has really helped me grow in my love for and understanding of the Bible.  This church is also used to a large number of transient members, in part due to its proximity to the MacDill AFB.  They do a great job of enabling those of us who are only here for a few years to really make this church our home,  and not feel like we’re just passing through! I've been a member here for almost five years. This is a genuine body of believers who cares for the purity of the church body, is faithful to the preaching of the Word verse by verse, and cares about the sharing of the Gospel to the ends of the Earth. The members are serious about doing life together. This is the first local church body that I have been apart of that really feels like family. Members have brought me meals when I've had a baby, attended my children's birthday parties, worked out with me, shared deep struggles and encouragements, and have faithfully held out Scripture and the Gospel to me.

name: Covenant of Grace - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been attending Covenant of Grace for about two months now. From the first Sunday I showed up, I felt such a warm welcome. I was ushered right into this fellowship that truly enjoys spending time together and wanted to get to know me. The intergenerational aspect of this fellowship has been a huge blessing, too.

The pace of Sundays doesn't feel rushed. When the service ends, people stay and visit. From sharing lunch after church twice a month to monthly women's gatherings, it has been so easy to become involved. It is a joy to worship together, and I look forward to continuing to grow here! My family and I started attending Covenant of Grace two years ago.  The congregation was welcoming and came alongside us through trying times. We have been blessed immensely by the robust teaching in the Sunday School, the God-glorifying liturgy, and the tight-knit community. We see growth in our own lives and those of our children. Covenant of Grace is a wonderful church of faithful members. From the first time I walked in for worship (by myself) until now, I have been impressed by and grateful for the warmth and welcoming character of the congregation. Furthermore, the reformed theology is excellent, and the session is readily available for questions and/or discussions about anything. Regardless of background, I recommend visiting Covenant of Grace if you are looking for a committed, biblical church and a loving church family. I am from Atlanta and have attended many of the PCA churches here. Covenant of Grace is different. Doctrinally the church is similar to  what other Presbyterian and Reformed churches in the city believe; however, the application of those doctrinal beliefs in worship and through the means of grace is entirely different. After attending Covenant of Grace for only a short time my family noticed changes in our desire to worship, in our progress in sanctification, and in our love for one another and this community of believers. The church’s commitment to excellence in all things, the primacy of worship on Sunday, and a robust commitment to the means of grace and shepherding is what set Covenant of Grace apart from other churches. If you want to experience transformational worship, grow in grace, and live life in a community of believers that are doing the same, I highly encourage you to join us one Sunday. My entire family wakes up on Sundays excited for church, to hear God’s word, worship together, and fellowship together. The teaching is God’s Word, it’s truth, and it’s engaging. You are surrounded by people who genuinely care, want to connect with you, and pray for you. You leave refreshed and blessed. We’ve never experienced anything like this and are so thankful for Covenant of Grace.

name: Covenant Of Promise Christian Fellowship
reviewSummary: I love this church, great place to worship God, great people family oriented and Pastor preach right out of the Bible. Are you looking for a bible base church and a real place to worship God? I recommend this church come and worship our Savior with us. I attended this church the teaching is excellent the members are warm I am sure to attend it again

name: Covenant Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: While my automobile was inoperable for the holidays, I spoke to the Pastor about trying to work for them to make money to pay for the repairs.  She spoke to her husband (also a Pastor) and although they didn’t have any work for me, agreed to not have my vehicle towed as long as I move it by the following Friday, which was quite the relief as I’ve had other major vehicle expenses recently and didn’t need a tow expense on top of another major vehicle repair.  Just for that act of kindness, I pushed my vehicle off of their lot as soon as I could so as to not worry or trouble them any further.  Small acts of kindness go a long way in my book.  Thank you! First time here. Praise God for having another church I can go to who's dedicated to God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit. It was fun singing from a hymnal again. They have a Bible Study afterwards with coffee and snacks. Lots of teenagers involved was encouraging to see. Saddened... I arrived about 33 minutes early. (Sunday November 25, 2018).  There were 2 people setting up for an obvious function in a courtyard area at the main sanctuary entrance.  I bad them good morning, & asked the time.  I was curtly informed that church didn't start for 30 minutes.  The main entrance doors were locked, & not another word was spoken.  So... I don't know what kind of church this is.   I couldn't get in the front door, on Sunday but with such first reception, & locked doors... I'm saddened, moreso than disappointed. When the expression comes up at church save my life this one literally did. When I was 12 years old single parent home on the streets the church acted as if they were family. Pastorrob and Adele welcome to me in the church. I am now 33 years old business owner married with 3 children my wife is a nurse I owe it all to if it wasn't for the church the guidance that help probably would have went down a different path And drop someone off there and that was it a nice church nice individuals there great experience.

name: Covenant Presbyterian Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Truly a wonderful rebuild of the old school churches that once’s dominated the world scene. Every attention to detail in the sanctuary reminds you of the saints who came before and laid the groundwork for the furthering of the gospel and worship in a church today.
Solid biblical teaching as well. We will definitely visit again if we are in Nashville again! A church that preaches the gospel and sound doctrine in spite of today's cultural norms.  We started attending 3 years ago when the pastoral staff was preaching through Leviticus... and every sermon connected straight to the Gospel.  If you want topical sermons and good-feels, go somewhere else.  If you want the redemptive plan and truth of our glorious Redeemer, the teaching at Covenant in both sermons and Sunday Connect classes, provide a rich understanding of who God is, who He has made us to be, and a constant reminder that we need him to live and serve others in this life. Beautiful church. Solid reformed preaching. Friendly people. I would like to return the next time I am in Nashville and when there is not a pandemic going on. I attended the church here during my time here in TN for my summer internship and I have to say it was an absolutely beautiful experience! Whatever the leadership here is doing keep it up! I'm going to miss it. Openly embracing all who enter their sanctuary, we were welcomed by this friendly Body of Christ. In a culture of instant gratification, their sanctuary offers ancient peace, holiness, and hope. We have found a church home…all glory to God.

name: Covenant Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Warm church with lots of kind and welcoming people. Pastor Jeannine is wonderful and supports an inclusive church. So happy our family started attending. Best Church, Amazing Pastor, Wonderful People. My family has been coming to Covenant Presbyterian for 50+ years. It represents the heart and fabric of Westchester. I remember the days with old Pastor Tom. The new pastor Sue Fisher is brilliant. She makes each sermon relate to current topics and issues, and has such contagious energy. This church is an amazing place for families from young to old. The sunday school, preschool and childcare services are also amazing! Not to mention that the main chapel with its brilliant stained glass windows and smaller chapel are breathtakingly beautiful! The Covenant Presbyterian Church is a place where you can genuinely feel good because there is good people to congregate with here. God Bless. I went there for a memorial service for my best friend. It was a beautiful service and tribute to my friend. I went there for a "HOME GOING" for my Daughter's friend's it was lovely.

name: Covenant Presbyterian DTC - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary:
They have a good pantry. You can get enough food from them to feed a family of four people for a week. A fractured and humiliating food pantry signup system.  Not loving, not respectful.  I know Christianity is a better feeling than this, but maybe this church doesn't have time to fix what needs fixing. They have a wonderful food bank on Fridays staffed with wonderful people. Food Bank on Fridays,  online check-in,
nice volunteers.  Have been volunteering at Covenant Cupboard for several years.  If you want to volunteer or need food, it is a good place. Flowering bushes smells so great in the spring!

name: Covenant Reformed Presbyterian Church, RPCNA - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary:
Word, worship, sacrament. We were grateful to find this church while we were in the area. Faithful preaching, and beautiful RP style psalm singing in an acoustically excellent historic building. This is a small congregation. We have visited a few times, the people have always been kind and make efforts to talk with you. The teachings have always been scriptural. I love the acapella singing in the psalter. They have communion every Sunday.
We will visit again. This is a godly assembly, altho very small. Probably the only church in NE Ohio that actually follows the Regulative Principle of Worship as originally understood (prob the only one in Ohio!). We drive 70 miles one way to worship with this church. Spiritual progress cannot be counted by numbers:

Mt. 7.13--...for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in there at:
14: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

May the Lord continue to bless those that worship here. Where worship and praise is interpreted through the inspirational leading of the Holy Spirit! Come and see. Grow in grace, knowledge and love of the Lord. See you there soon. Be blessed or be a blessing! God is good. All of the time! Amen?

name: Covington Church of Christ - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Bible based preaching. Friendly GOD loving congregation. A loving group of faithful believes in the Word of GOD! Great Church of Christ!

name: CPC (Community Presbyterian Church) - Danville Campus
reviewSummary:
Good, friendly people in a Bible centered church. A blessing to all who attend. Absolutely love this church and the community. Friendly people, clean facilities and great structure.
Service is amazing, pastor Tyler is very knowledgeable and the services are Bible based with life application.
The worship is like any other! They just released their album. Check them out on Spotify: Landmark! Our family has been attending CPC for over 5 years now and it feels like a home away from home.  We have learned so much about God and the Pastors each share the gospel in such insightful ways that we walk away with not only more knowledge but a greater heart for God each time.  I would definitely recommend this church to anyone thinking of attending. Love this church so much! I go with my parents when I visit town and LOVE LOVE LOVE it! Such friendly, welcoming, people! Very faithful church. Always feel loved here, and learn a lot about Jesus! Our family loves attending CPC Danville. Pastor Tyler Scott pours his heart into his sermons and you will feel it. All of the pastors care deeply about everyone in the congregation and the entire community and beyond.

name: Creekside Bible Church - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary:
Careful! Service at the house of God is only on Sundays! That means if you try to walk your dog around the church any other day/time someone will come out and tell you to take your “flea ridden” dog away and threaten to trespass you! It’s fine if you come to Sunday service though! Such a shame residential space is being occupied by such a self proclaimed holy establishment. I love this church. I am biased though because I am a member here and serve as a deacon at the time of this writing. Gospel proclaiming and Bible teaching. Elders shepherd the flock, and there are lots of ways for you to get involved. They have potluck quite often on Sundays after the service. Highly recommended. From 10/27/19 Church will return to this location.
Till that day correct address is 653 W. Fremont Avenue, Sunnyvale, 94087.
Thanks Elder Sam Kim for perfect conversation.
And one more time - if you need my help you are more then welcome to let me know! Come meet new friends beginning at 9am each Sunday for Sunday School.
There are classes for all ages.
There is also a nursery for little ones.

Stay for church learning the Truth about our beloved Scriptures at 10:30am.
Coffee, hot chocolate and donut holes are served on the Patio!
Hope to meet you soon! Life-changing a great church that is focused on the Bible in Jesus

name: Creekside Christian Church - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Service times: Sundays at 8am, 9am, and 10:45am.

Parking is free and there’s plenty available within the complex. They also offer free coffee, decaf, tea, and water. Inside the building, there’s a café selling pastries and specialty coffee with comfortable seating areas.

Restrooms were clean, bright, and spacious with plenty of stalls. The women’s restroom also includes a nursing/changing room for mothers and babies.

The worship center itself has very high ceilings and feels bright, airy, clean, and well air-conditioned without being overly cold. The church appears to have a very organized and fully functional volunteer team including worship, musicians, ushers, kids ministry, and even a rotating sign language interpretation team for both worship and sermon.

Worship music is modern contemporary Christian music (Elevation Worship, etc.). A nice touch was that after each song, they displayed the song title and credited the artist on screen.

They provide printed sermon notes, which helps the congregation stay engaged and take notes during teaching. On the back side are weekly Life Group discussion questions and prayer note sections for the upcoming week.

At the end of service, there is a prayer team (around 10 people at the front) available for anyone wanting personal prayer.

This week they also launched church merchandise: hats for $20 and t-shirts for $16.

The sermon itself was Bible-based and taught in depth. Their Life Groups include categories for adults, marriage & family, men, women, and elders.

A couple areas for improvement:
- I didn’t notice any traffic coordinators in the parking lot.
- The OHP/lyrics coordinator missed several song lyric transitions during worship, which made it harder for some people unfamiliar with the songs to continue singing along smoothly.

Overall, the church felt welcoming, organized, and focused on both worship and biblical teaching. This church was recommended to us. The beginning felt like walking into a concert! However, the sermon was very thoroughly done. There are slips of paper to fill in the blanks from the sermon as well. Loving this church. Went there for a memorial service. Very nice and quiet. I was a member of another church in Hercules CA for over 30 years, moved away and thought to myself it's going to be really, REALLY hard to find a church that lives up to the very VERY high standards my previous church (Valley Bible) set for all those years...excellent ministry support in various areas including children's ministry, multicultural members (which to me is what heaven will consist of), very personable pastor who doesn't compromise on God's Word...one who reaches out and touches with genuine caring, members who are warm and genuine as well. When I visited the first time, I was impressed enough to visit again, the second time I was ABLE to check each of the boxes on ALL my desired wants and needs with Creekside Christian Church, oh and I do want to mention their excellent choir which my prior church had as well...very important! My next step is to become a member and make Creekside my new church home, I'm sure my beloved previous pastor Phil Howard would approve! It's almost not fair that I write a review of Creekside since I'm the lead pastor... but CREEKSIDE IS A GREAT CHURCH! While it's big, it still feels like a friendly family. The generosity, kindness, love and willingness to serve at Creekside is as refreshing as it is unique. The atmosphere of worship is awesome and these people are serious about seeking the heart of God! There's something for everyone. You have got to check Creekside out!

name: Creekside Christian Church - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary: Some guy driving a Ford Superduty that works for them tried to run me off the road coming down Westerville Rd. I caught it on dashcam. I would not recommend, harming people doesn't seem very Christian. This is a nice little church with a fun service. I really like that the use hymns as well as a modern praise band. Very friendly. Preacher does a good job of breaking down the bible. Good to see old friends and loved ones They have a good food pantry!

name: Creekside Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: We’ve been coming to Creekside for almost 6 years. We have loved every service. Pastor Jason is absolutely meant to be in this role. The ENTIRE staff has helped us through major life events. Creekside Church is a wonderful place with a big heart for the community and a genuine desire to connect people to Jesus. They offer a variety of programs, including school, sports, Bible studies, MomCo, Ladies Night of Worship, and VBS. What makes Creekside truly special is that anyone can be welcomed into the community, regardless of their membership status. They create a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The church’s preaching of the Bible and its congregation of faith-filled, friendly people have made it a close friend to my family and me. Creekside Church embodies the spirit of being the “hands and feet of Jesus,” which is a rare and inspiring example. I am incredibly grateful to have found this local church in my life. Attended a funeral service there. The pastor gave a very nice service. Creekside has been our church home for over 5 years. We chose this church because we wanted to find a place that would walk beside and guide us as we raise our children in our faith. We have found friends who have become our church family and our kids love coming to church to participate in all the activities offered through the children’s ministry. We are blessed to have found Creekside Worship was great, but seemed forced. Worship leader tried, but congregation seemed unreceptive. The pastor's message was spot on, but again the congregation seemed uninterested. Felt God wanted to do something there but was hindered.

name: Creekside Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have attended Creekside for five years now. It is a community where we feel supported in our walk with Christ, whatever season of life we’re in. There is a strong emphasis on fellowship, service, and the centrality of the “simple Gospel,” without top-down or doctrine heavy preaching. The worship is modern but not geared toward entertainment, and there’s often moments of quiet reflection and tributes to tradition. We have been attending since 2019. Immediately felt welcome, Pastor Mark has a way of explaining things that just make sense.
GLORIFYING GOD BY FINDING LIFE IN JESUS TOGETHER & INVITING OTHERS TO DO THE SAME. I was just visiting town to attend my cousin’s Memorial Service & even though I wasn’t expecting there to be so many in attendance, all those involved in the production (refreshment makers, extra seating attendees, smilers, bookmark makers, friends, family, musicians) were so very welcoming and warm for such an unexpected Celebration. I was (and still am) in awe of the Love put into this building and it’s congregation. Very grateful and indebted for all at Creekside Church. Outstanding pastor, leadership, fellowship, and community. Challenging and real and positive at the same time. Funny but also serious. Worship leaders are amazing and kid care is great at all ages. They harassed me for eating lunch in the parking lot. The same parking lot as my work. Claiming people are "living back here" and wanted to make sure I wasn't. What a church!

name: Creekside Community Church - Danville Campus
reviewSummary: This church has no regard for their neighbors. They are blasting music at all times of day and let kids scream bloody murder all day long. At night, the parking lot is open to the public, so idiots are doing wheelies and speeding around in it. They should care about their community more. 👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽 A wonderful Bible centered community in the East Bay. Everytime I visit friends in the bay over a weekend, I give the community at Creekside a visit and they always love on my family and i This is a great church facility they have lots of very nice rooms beautiful landscaping large parking area and a wonderful staff My home. My family. This Church is full of amazing people with a thirst for knowledge and desire to build a community of loving servants. there was an awesome thing behind the chuch and my friend said, "just looking": it was awesome 👍👍👍. it was like my favorite anime chiwawariko no shoujitte 😁😁😁

name: Creekside Covenant Church
reviewSummary: Very nice place, I have been going there for a year now. It has Spanish service. The people there are very nice and welcoming. I haven't been. They did a lovely job with the broadcast of my dear Uncle Norms memorial on June 5th 2021 Thank you to Mark for such a beautiful blessing.  God bless all of you. Preaches about God. *Private property parking lot* Will tow! Authentic, warm and welcoming, and committed to the full Gospel of Jesus

name: Crescenta Valley Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
They might not return your phone call if you have an issue with any of their members. I love this church. The people are diverse and friendly. The music is phenomenal. And you can hook into a small group during the week easily. They have every type of group, so a person feels included: recovery, women's, men's, young adults, singles, teens, children, and entertainment. Plus bible studies, family camp, youth camp, and concerts. They really walk their talk! This is a loving and supportive family of believers who are waiting for you to join.
The music is top notch modern worship mixed with traditional influences. The decor and hospitality match its bright and warm atmosphere of kindness.
It has a multiethnic flavor of encouragement and support for all souls who are looking to rest in a peaceful nest of joy and light.
The pastor preaches recovery and hope in a very clever, real and straight forward way.
On Friday nights they have a biblical program based on the 12 steps called Celebrate recovery  which provides freedom from life's hurts habits, and hang ups. Check it out! They even have a thoughtful gift bag for newcomers filled with fabulous goodies inside. CV church has been my home church since forever! So welcoming and loving! The message always speaks to me. My kids are all growing up in this church and we all love being a part of the CV church family! Love the authentic in-depth teaching by Scott Wood. allows one to embrace the same meanings for everyday life from those of it's ancient history. Awesome Music too!

name: Crescenta Valley United Methodist Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
The pastor's messages strengthen our faith and nurture our spiritual growth. The fellowship is genuine and loving.
Blessings to the church and minister! ESL classes and day care on site Great place for party and family get together We are the Ark of Salvation, a church that conveys the treasures of the Kingdom of Heaven..

Meet Jesus through the Word that conveys the secrets of blessing^~

name: Crest Avenue Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
There's a great men's study I try and attend every Tuesday night at 7pm.  great fellowship and welcoming to everyone.
I recently started to visit their Sunday service and enjoyed sound doctrine. I really enjoy that the pastor teaches straight from the Bible (NKJV). It is a place of worship and growth. This is our home church. Love my church family. I like to attend the men’s group meetings on Tuesdays at 7pm. Every guy welcome! (They also have a womans group at the same time, just different building. A church is a safe place to bring all of your questions or doubts concerning your spiritual salvation. If you seek the Lord with all of your heart and allow Him to rule your life then you will not be taking a leap of faith but the first step to recognizing that you are and have always been sinful in nature. Let Jesus Christ, our Lord take you by the hand and lead you back unto the path of righteousness. No matter how difficult you think your life has treated you, it's nothing God can't handle. There is hope right now. God bless you.

"For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven and do not return there but water the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater, so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it.   -ISAIAH 55:10-11 The pastor preaching was great. n the friendly  people. They great  you soon as you walk in the church. I definitely would be back. Sound doctrine, people passionate about serving Christ and NOT a King James Only Church

name: Crest Community Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Started attending this church with my children last Easter. Absolutely a bible following, scripture based church with amazing warmth and welcoming atmosphere, like a small town church- you will not get lost in a crowd here like we did in a mega church. Pastor Ray is a wonderful teacher who keeps to the word and does not stray from it. I find his sermons ALWAYS pertain to my family/life and I never feel bored or lose interest when he is preaching and that says a lot coming from me, the queen of ADD! We feel at home here and so glad we came for that first Easter service. The crowd is a nice mix of all ages and very kid friendly with precious Sunday school classes :) Please come and visit this amazing church, God bless Crest! I’ve been attending here for four years going on five. It is a solid biblical church. The preaching from the pulpit is chapter by chapter verse by verse solid theologically and so is the worship. No fluff or condoning and patting your back because of your sin, but just straight gospel. Calling everyone to repentance and faith in Jesus Christ alone. They have Tuesday night men’s Bible study at 6:30 Wednesday night coed Bible study at 6:30 Thursday night women’s Bible study at 6:30 and Friday night prayer meeting at 6:30 and of course Sunday morning service at 10:45. Come via part of a solid biblical church, because there are very few of them around anymore. My father in law Pastor Gerald Woodhouse founded this church.  I trust you are still a lighthouse for Christ and reaching out to the whole world     I presume you are still supporting world missions.  Stay faithful to Jesus. I've been going to church here for over 4 years and the people are like a family. Preaching is straight forward and from the Bible. This is truly a community church with lots of opportunities to get involved. Small church but good pastor and good sound Bible teaching. Friendly congregation. Weekly evening Bible studies. A church to feel right at home.

name: Crest Community Church - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary: this church is my home Church and reaches out to the community. it certainly is a community orientated place. The ministers and fellowship are very family orientated and multilingual as well as multiracial. Small church in the UCR neighborhood full of wonderful, caring folks who care about their city and want to follow more the way of Jesus. Peace lovers, community gatherers, kingdom bringers. Great hosts. Frequently volunteer as a polling place. Hosts University Neighborhood community meetings regularly, cant ask anything more of them. Fantastic little church. If you want to grow in your faith, visit this church. God blesses people personally here without a doubt.
