name: Crestwood Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: I have called before and the woman is the most rude and smart mouthed IV ever encountered at a church b4 Can your congregation please not try to run over pedestrians crossing at the stop signs around your church with your cars? The STOP sign means stop. It is not a busy road, you are not saving a significant amount of time nor gasoline when following the rules of the road. You definitely won't be saving souls when hitting someone with your car. Went for YPG and it was a good meeting for people around my age. Very good "old world music" concert. Enjoyed listening to songs from medieval  Europe as well as instruments from the same centuries. Super nice gym! Parking was good too

name: Crieve Hall Church of Christ
reviewSummary: A traditional Church of Christ congregation in Crieve Hall known for a cappella worship and scripture-centered teaching.

name: Crieve Hall Church of Christ - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church!  Can't say enough about Crieve Hall as a family and community and about the quality of relationships that I've developed over the years here.   The community here really cares about God, each other, and helping the lost find Jesus. My brother stays home with Mama (bed bound invalid) and they worship with y'all on Sundays. Thank you. He lets me go to Church of. Christ in Elizabethtown NC little bitty Bladen Church of Christ. Iove them. Friendly people that love God. A group of Christians striving to serve God while serving others. If you are looking for a congregation where you can go to work in the kingdom you should give Crieve Hall serious consideration. Love this family!! Remember Bill and Beverly when he preached at Mt. Juliet church of Christ
Had a great lesson when he came to our church today at center chapel church of Christ

name: Cristo Rey Ontario Iglesia Católica Antigua NO ROMANA - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
This is not a Roman Catholic Church.  The Baptisms, 1st Communions and other classes are not approved/valid by Roman Catholic Church. Very Powerful Not the kind of Catholic Church I was looking for. I came to Cristo Rey Ontario looking for a church, and what I found was a family in Christ. Father Duque is an excellent human being, full of peace, love, and wisdom. I thank God for putting him in my path and my family's.
Cristo Rey Ontario is a wonderful church. This Catholic Church is not in communion with Rome. They do not have a valid Eucharist. This church is not in communion with Rome. Because it is not united with the Catholic Church, it does not possess a valid apostolic succession recognized by the Catholic Church, and therefore does not have a valid Eucharist.

name: Cross & Anchor Church
reviewSummary:
C&A feels like home where everyone is always welcome. A great place to learn to love God, the city and the people of the city! Pastor Josh and emily are great leaders with indepth understanding of the word with simple explanation and easy application.
Love the worship here! And love the social media  content that they put out! They also have baby/kids ministry. Follow them on Insta/Fb/Youtube! Love this church right in the downtown of Detroit. Pastor Josh loved this city and his people. Beautifully diverse & great music. Check this church out! A welcoming church establishment. Modern, contemporary, family-oriented, and feels safe. Located on the Milwaukee Junction in Detroit.  Provides two services and a children's church service, plus other events and services during the week. Gives the vibe of "come as you are". Their mission truly is to support Detroit, and I appreciate their values in helping the homeless and providing mission trips to countries around the world. They have online and in-person services, so you can participate in your capacity. They also have their own praise and worship album! Appreciate the transparency of the pastors and keeping attendees abreast of future goals for the church establishment. If you want a community space where you are not judged, that is diverse in all backgrounds and is family-oriented, I suggest this space for you. Jacob and I found C&A in March of 2023 after moving to Milwaukee Junction area. C&A was right down the street from us so we enjoyed being able to walk there! We were welcomed in by Josh and Emily and some other leaders on our first visit. Pastor Josh even prayed with us. After attending for over a year, we’ve definitely made C&A our home church. I would definitely recommend checking it out. You won’t be disappointed! Finding a church can be hard and scary but being surrounded by people who all love Jesus is easy! Love Cross & Anchor and what they are doing in Detroit. A great community who loves everyone! They teach the Bible and the sermons are relevant and applicable. They also feature different pastors or worship leaders from other churches from time to time. The worship is awesome, too!

name: Cross & Crown Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
A refuge in the middle of Columbus!

Pastor Shane Huey is Spirit led and intentional in all he does. He leads, stewards, and encourages in love and biblical truth.
The people that make up the congregation are kind, humble and dedicated to loving those around them as the journey with the Lord.
We felt at ease the moment we walked through the doors and then experienced a worship service that was Christ centered and Spirit filled. We had to keep coming. Now we call it our church home. Very intimate church in Clintonville! Welcoming of all cultures, races and socioeconomic backgrounds. Offers childcare services for ages 6 months through 8 years old. Pastor Shane preaches with a profound knowledge of the Word that will grow your hunger and love for Jesus! Learn, explore and grow your faith with us, every Sunday at 10 am. A diverse community that’s turned into family. A Pastor worth following. Endless support by great leaders. I continue to grow in faith and knowledge here. Advancing the Kingdom and making Columbus a better place So thankful to have found a church I can finally call home. Thank you Pastor Shane for being an amazing leader and thank you Cross and Crown for always making me feel like family 🤍 Truly can’t say anything but great things about this place. Gods presence is evident in this church, it is very welcoming, holy spirit filled, and composed of great people. Truly recommend trying Cross and Crown!

name: Cross and Crown Lutheran Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Cross and Crown Lutheran Church Office - ELCA - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
This is our polling place. Parking was fine and we were able to get in and out without any delay. The people working the election were nice and friendly. Can't wait til November....... Such a welcoming and friendly church and Pastor Stephanie is wonderful.
So happy I baptized my daughter at Cross and Crown. Small and clean church God bless His people Ok

name: Cross Bridge
reviewSummary: My exp has been great.  Introduced to the church through my girlfriend, congregants have taken me in as their own.  The pastor is great, and so are those who lead the weekly fellowship groups.  Lots of young adults, and Sunday service doesn't start until 11:15am.  Home-cooked Chinese food is $2 after service, and guests eat the first time free.  The teaching is Biblical, and the music is contemporary with good lyrics and a strong presence! Started going to church in 4th grade so this is where it all began! Sermons are very Bible-centered, relevant, and people are very warm and friendly! 1000% recommend checking it out! Love it Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Cross Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross church is such an amazing church! I love the environment and how welcoming the staff are. I definitely can feel Gods presence in the church and the leadership is great as well! I absolutely love Cross church! As a lifelong follower of Christ, I can honestly say I’ve experienced true transformation here over the past few years. This is a Bible-based church that’s intentional about relationships and creating a warm, welcoming environment where everyone feels like family.

Pastor Josh and the entire pastoral team do an incredible job making God’s Word both understandable and deeply applicable to everyday life. Their teaching is thoughtful, relevant, and always grounded in truth.

From master classes to life groups, special events and community outreach,  there are so many opportunities to grow in faith and community. The church is truly committed to making heaven more crowded and being a faithful steward in the community. I’m so thankful to call Cross my church home! Our first Sunday here felt like being welcomed home. This is a church full of imperfect people living life like Jesus the best they can--with authenticity, community, and love. Pastors Josh and Monica lead so well with such honesty and integrity. The youth programs are thriving and growing. Spiritual growth, discipleship, and doing life together are part of the culture here, and it shows. We couldn't be happier to call Cross Church home. We were looking for home church for several months and on the Sunday we decided to visit Cross Church, the title of the sermon that Sunday was "Home". Pastor Josh preached and we felt like God was speaking straight to us! The leadership team at Cross Church spend a lot of time pouring into their people and make sure everyone is seen. Love our new home! This church is amazing, I have been VERY leery of churches because I grew up in some very suspect churches and affiliations.
This church though, practices what they preach. The children's program for my kids has been amazing for my young kids (elementary), teens. There is a young adults program for the older crowd who aged out of teens but still want more.

*They're also accommodating for kids AND adults who are a bit different in any ways* there's sensory toys, accomodations in church AND church excursions like camp etc, NO ONE is going to side eye you if YOU or YOUR child(ren) is/are loud or doing something aside from paying strict attention (I'm the crocheter  who has to sit in the end seat crocheting the whole time).

They do quite a bit of outreach and community service. They're very transparent with where funding is going which I greatly appreciate. I like to know how my money is helping and where EXACTLY it's going.

All in all this church has been more than fantastic for me and my family and I'm forever grateful.

name: Cross Church - Denton Campus
reviewSummary: the most multi national church i ever been to. i love the overall spirit, energy and work being done here. if you need a place to visit please give it a try. I had an amazing experience with  the men of Cross Church.  The Man Up event was everything I needed. PV and the staff did and amazing job! I was truly blessed! Thank you all! I absolutely love this church! I started attending at the beginning of 2022 after reading all the wonderful reviews on Google, and I’m so glad I decided to give it a try. From the very beginning, I felt welcomed and at home. I especially love the diversity and the sense of community—you really feel like everyone is welcome here, no matter their background. It has become a place I genuinely look forward to coming to, and I can’t imagine going anywhere else. They are truly about loving God and people. Love it so far. It's  small with great potential for growth. Very  friendly and diverse congregation. Most important is the teachings are straight out of the Bible. That is very important to me. I recommend this church to anyone looking to be filled spiritually,  and want a place that is growing. Recently moved from another state and was looking for a local church. I drove by Cross Church and figured I’d attend a service the following Sunday. What I found was - a culturally diverse church, great worship, and warm and friendly people. Pastor V preaches simple and practical messages, a real good way to start the week. Service is short and sweet. I haven’t been looking for a church since my first Sunday visiting Cross!

name: Cross Church - Norman Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a new chuch for me. I've only been their twice and have enjoyed both time. The people make you feel welcome. Small but just what I was looking for so will be going back! I want to state that I became part of the church back in January of 2021. When I first came to the church I felt truly welcomed during a time where people were keeping their distance and being very standoffish. This church was very welcoming and very loving when we first arrived. This church made me feel like I truly found a loving church home.

Now I'm the Associate Pastor of this church and I pray others come and feel the same wonderful experience I had and continue to have every Sunday! In the summer of 2020, my wife and I found ourselves seeking a new church home. We decided to visit Cross Church, and very quickly realized the Lord had led us to something incredibly unique. Since then, the Cross has become our family and home; the people are welcoming, the Gospel is preached, and Christ is the focus of every event. You couldn't ask for more from a church home! I absolutely love this church, it’s been a long time since I’ve been in church and I so happy God lead me to this one. When I was looking for a church home I wanted a place that felt like family and where the preacher actually preached the word. That is what I found when I found my church home at Cross Church of Norman. I found a church family and a pastor that preaches the word. I love my church and my church family.

name: Cross Church Fayetteville - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
This establishment is an excellent depiction of 21st century Christianity and helped expedite my exit from the religion.

They proudly drop millions of $ on facilities that get used for a total of...MAYBE 10 hours per week? Instead of directing that money towards people in need and just doing church under a big tent.

I would be interested to see what % of tithes go towards actually helping people in need vs the % that goes towards maintaining low-use facilities and paying salaries.

It's just so weird to me that people continue to participate in something like this and then will say that they're somehow...helping the world?

All they talk about is essentially becoming a better person, but then where does all of their time and money go? To a glorified book club with cool modern music?

Almost zero energy expended towards "spreading their word" outside of the 4 walls, even though they believe people who don't believe will spend an ETERNITY being tortured...?

You will never hear them talk about getting together to go spread the gospel to people across the street, even though they are supposedly filled with the undying, invincible Holy Spirit of the Creator of the Universe?

What could they possibly be afraid of? And how could they not want to do such things if they actually believe what they say they do?

It simply makes no sense.

I mean if you knew nothing about Christianity and then attended this church, you would just think that it's a fancy book club and nothing more. People love going to church here because it matches their "aesthetic".

Ask them about what makes their religion the "true religion" instead of the 1000 others and they will have no answer for you other than saying that their book says so... They are just blind followers who like the vibes of the organization.

People's motivations for joining a church like this are more akin to people's motivations for joining a country club than a humanitarian movement.

Christianity is just an upscaled cult.

Once you pay attention to all the talk about "hearing" the voice of God, blood, death, suffering, spirits, spiritual warfare, sacrifice, good vs evil, holy books, rising from the dead, and prostrate worship of an imaginary being you realize that it's all actually very odd and unhealthy.

Just because a lot of people believe this stuff doesn't mean you have to. You don't have to be religious whatsoever. We visited this church on Sunday, November 20, 2022 because we were in town visiting my daughter who is attending the University of Arkansas.

I was thoroughly impressed with the church, and would very likely attend regularly if I lived in Northwest Arkansas.

One of the things that I was most impressed with was that many in the church leadership are doctors.  Having scholarship behind the word is something that I have been personally looking for in my spiritual journey.  I appreciate that they have it.

The facilities were immaculately maintained.  The church felt safe with uniformed Washington County Deputies onsite.  The free coffee is always appreciated and allowed in the sanctuary.

Dress and the worship style was casual and uplifting.  The message was bold, especially for being in a university town, but also grace-filled.  They understand the importance of speaking the truth, gracefully.  I heard a huge emphasis on welcoming and loving people where they are in their life and not condemning people because their sin may be different than mine.

Before we went into service we were welcomed and struck up conversations with no fewer than three other people.  The conversations were genuine and unforced.

The service was crisply delivered and we were out and on with the rest of our Sunday.  It’s clearly not an accident.  The leadership here knows what they are doing, they understand logistics, and they have designed a service around people’s lives.

I truly enjoyed the experience and see the Lord at work in this congregation.  I wish I lived in the area where I could attend more often. Warm, welcoming people. Bible-based message I am glad my daughter at UARK has found a church that has solid teaching! I enjoy going to church with her when I am in Fayetteville. Side note - seats are cushy! The preacher tried to say to a bunch of kids that their animals don’t have souls on Easter. How messed up do you have to be in the head preaching the word of God and say that to a bunch of kids. get out of. Everything on the planet has a soul by the way. Should be judged hard at the pearly gate. It probably won’t make it in.

name: Cross Church Indy - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: The last I remember of the place I was walking up to a family friendly event with the family and the politic preaching pastor saw me coming and instead of extending an open hand he decides it best to turn his phone on selfie mode and take a nice grinning picture of the good time he was having. If that tells you how welcoming it made me feel. Great teaching, even better community Warm and friendly place to worship. Wonderfully tranquil setting.   Welcoming all ages...lots of well-behaved children.   Bible lessons are very clear and directly from the Bible. I attend the Saturday morning men's breakfast. It's a great place to be and the people I've met are very friendly and open to newcomers. If you want to get closer to the Lord or just need the Lord in your lifeThis is the placeThey are for real you can feel it as soon as you walk through the doorThis is the place they are for real you can feel it as soon asYou walk through the doorThese people are compassionateAnd love everyone

name: Cross Church Pinnacle Hills - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is good for scenic walk around the lake. Wen went for evening walk and found this place amazing. I went there for a while. I couldn't stand how they spent so much money on their place. Like that could feed the homeless.  And then I got kicked out of a singles group  pool party after hours at someone's house for asking a new girl if she wants to ride bikes with me and my sister or do other stuff with us. Cause the group manager thought I was asking her on a date. Like well its a singles group pool party. We cant date others in the church? We cant marry others in the church? We cant have kids with others in the church?  He told me go have kids with an atheist. I thought the purpose of the after hours pool party and singles group was to get us in group to marry each other and stay in the church.

Im an atheist now cause this church and them kicking me out cause I looked for a wife there. We have had the best experience at Cross Church.  The people have been so welcoming and compassionate.  There are so many small groups and activities to be a part of.  We’ve attended for almost 3 and a half years.  I highly recommend Cross Church Pinnacle Hills! Best church i have ever attended in the 49 years of being a believer.
Great preaching from the Word. Great music. Very loving and accepting. I have amazing friends I have met there. I was there for a funeral reception.  Nice, big and clean. Great place to worship as well I'm told

name: Cross Church Springdale - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. I was visiting NWA from Arizona and attended Vision Sunday at the Springdale Campus in September 2022 after watching a number of online sermons.

Pastor Nick always provides inspiring sermons and was nice enough to chat with me for a bit when I attended church in-person.

I look forward to attending Cross Church and serving the community whenever I have the opportunity to relocate to beautiful Northwest Arkansas. Great place for whatever your season in life. Welcoming for all to grow in their relationship with Christ. Don’t expect a decent funeral if you take your own life. The anger and sadness I feel for someone I loved due to how the pastor spoke of her “behaviors” made me ill. We are new to Ar.  Over a couple of months we church shopped and found Cross Church.  It is a real blessing. God has a purpose for us all! Ryan is an awesome new pastor, and I love hearing Jim Crawford speak.  Of course, everyone enjoys hearing Pastor Nick.  Many amazing preachers.  It’s an absolutely huge church.  My husband enjoys Hispanic church group.  I’m very grateful he feels welcome at his group with a wonderful leader, Miguel!  Feeling welcome is very important at church.  My husband and I also appreciate the diversity here.  I used to attend a group for 20 year olds at the cross church in Fayetteville, and met a few of my best friends there. Things are a little slow regarding groups right now due to Covid, but it’s understandable and probably the same everywhere.

name: Cross Church Surprise - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary: A larger church, they have fun things for the kids, ex: a water park and blow ups most Sundays. Water park is available to public every day but Friday, thats only for the school that day. The people at Cross are all so friendly and welcoming! My daughter has been attending the Christian Academy located here for over a year. They do not press the religious aspects nearly as hard as other places. Depending on your religious views, this could be good or bad. But, their socialization and education services are spectacular with fantastic staff. My spouse and I have attended several times now. Initially,  the music was incredibly loud,  uncomfortable loud but they have a new song worship leader and the loudness is significantly better. When we Initially started Pastor Jackie was there , now it's Pastor Andy. Their preaching is spot on, Biblically sound. I do feel like we have found our home church now. We have listened to other local churches but have found Cross Church to be much like what we were accustomed to from our church back East. We use to go to Palmcroft Church but we now live in Surprise and it is a bit of a drive now. We moved from Phx to Prescott then back down to the Valley and now reside in Surprise. I truly believe Cross Church is a really good place to be....try it out. I have been a member of Cross Church for 19 years and have served under 3  pastors. When I left Rhode Island my husband and I prayed to find a church that was close to home.  Ironically Cross Church has the same address as my church in Rhode Island and is only 1 block from my home in Surprise. That was an answer to prayer.  I go to worship and praise the  goodness of God and how he has blessed my life.  Since my husband passed away, the pastors and congregation have been so good to me and my family.  All glory goes to God, our father. We stumbled onto this church while visiting my parents here in Surprise.  Visiting from OH.  What a great church!!  The worship team, worship leader, the pastor, the biblical teaching, the programs.  All are top notch. 5/5 highly recommend!  I can't wait to  come back.

name: Cross Connection Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
If you want great line upon line teaching from the Word of God, friendly people to greet you, and a place to connect with other folks young and old, this is a church you should visit. God loves you and is seeking those who want to know him. Please come join us each Sunday 7:30, 9:00 & 11:00 AM to worship the. Lord. Our Children’s program is wonderful and we offer donuts & Coffee and a place to sit and visit with new friends. Come and join us soon. Great Bible in context teaching going through the books of the Bible. Great worship in music. Presence of the Holy Spirit in praise and adoration and gratitude to the Father for the Good News in Christ Jesus. An excellent body of believers, served by a truly committed and loving leadership. Miles DeBenedictus, the senior pastor is a gifted teacher and speaker with an ability to impart the vision of God's work better than anyone I've ever heard. He's not afraid to speak the truth in love and his passion is truly to reach out to those who don't yet have a church to call home, to seek and to save the lost and show them the Father, as Jesus did and still does, through His people. Excellent sermons from a very gifted teacher! Nice and  friendly congregation.
Many activities to join in. If you are looking for the weekly teaching of God's word, look no more,
If you are looking to feel included and loved not judged look no more,
If you are as me a struggling sinner, but by God's Grace have found peace, look no more,
I cherish few things in life, but this body of Christ of which I am a member, I could never find more.

name: Cross of Christ Fellowship
reviewSummary: I am thankful to God for this wonderful community, the way we connect as one big family.  Pastor Tom and his wife are very caring. And this church is truly Gospel centered. It was quite a while ago, since I have been started going to Cross of Christ Fellowship Church. It is a great community of believers! Pastor Tom preaches very spiritually and we can feel the blessings all across. Each & every families are very close to my heart. I feel like my home and it’s a pleasure being a member of the church. The whole families are very connected and helpful to grow us spiritually. I’m blessed to a part of this community. Thank you! Great Church. Great People. Pastor Tom preaches Christ centered theologically rich expositional sermons and truly has a heart for people. Cross of Christ is a loving welcoming church. If your exploring faith or looking for a church to call home you should check them out. We attended Cross of Christ Fellowship for two years prior to our return to Scotland. Tom the pastor preaches the gospel and his sermons are always uplifting.  The members of the church are extremely welcoming and we felt at home from "day 1". Pastor Tom Schmidt and his wife Rachel, are two of the most caring individuals I know. They are all about the Gospel and family. Tom is one of those individuals know I can go to when I have questions on Christian Living and get a response based on God's Word. I can also go to Tom and get a biblically sound and easy to understand explanation on topics related to theology and doctrine.

name: Cross of Grace Santa Ana at the Ebell Club - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross of Grace Church has become home for my family. This is the place where we’ve built real friendships, grown in our faith, and found a community we truly love serving alongside.

What stands out most is that they preach the Bible clearly and faithfully. The teaching is grounded in sound doctrine, but the church is also warm, welcoming, and full of people who genuinely care about each other. It doesn’t feel fake or shallow. People show up for one another here.

I also love how much the church reflects and cares for Santa Ana. The community is diverse, engaged, and focused on serving neighbors well instead of staying disconnected from the city around it. There’s a real vision for reaching people and loving the community in practical ways.

My family is deeply grateful for this church and the people in it. A friendly church community full of people that love Jesus and their Santa Ana neighbors. Great sermons that closely follow scripture and are always Gospel centered. Best place to be on a Sunday morning! The community here is so wonderful. But what makes this church so great is that it actually teaches from the Bible. There's community groups, youth groups, kids classes, men's and women's meeting, and they actively invest in their city. Faithful, gospel-centered church that preaches the Bible and joyfully worships God every Sunday. I've experienced a wonderful community here, with genuine people who love Jesus and their neighbors. Great spot for kids as well! There is childcare and classes up to 5th grade, and parking in the Ebell Club parking lot right across the street. My husband and I love the messages preached from the church and how the Gospel is proclaimed every week. Everyone cares for the city and each other. The community is top notch and would highly recommend anyone to give it a visit.

name: Cross Point Christian Church - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Feels like home, the people feel like family, and the kids are excited to go every week! Relaxed service, sound beliefs. I've been looking for a church like this for a long time. ❤ This church loves Jesus and preaches from the Word. Since our first visit it has felt like family. Wow! Really impressed. Great people, perfect for the kids. Nice place.   Traffic is pretty crazy passing by

name: Cross Point Church
reviewSummary: Known for its 'Everyone's Welcome' philosophy and 'Technicolor' brand. The environment is casual, creative, and accessible to seekers. Very strong digital presence.

name: Cross Point Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
There’s something really special about the 5:30 PM service at Crosspoint. Sweet intimacy fills the room—from the powerful worship and the timely Word to the space for genuine prayer. It’s come-as-you-are, meet kind people and you’ll find Jesus here. A beautiful atmosphere for those hungry for more of Him. Good church and very welcoming… stopped here to meet a friend with my coworker definitely worth the stop here on our way to Florida. Absolutely Wonderful!!! The volunteers and believers are so welcoming... unlike other churches I've attended, they do not place restrictions on people who attend...if jeans and sneakers are all you have to wear ,  wether guys or gals...it doesn't matter, as long as your there. I also love how involved they are in the community. If you are looking for a Church Family...I Highly recommend Crosspoint. It was my solo birthday weekend and I was at the hotel across the street and I heard Christmas music. So I walked over to see if they were having a night service or Christmas special program. They were having a special event not for newcomers BUT the lady I talked to who walked me out was so very sweet & welcoming. Jesus is always the answer! Showing the fruits of the Holy Spirit to strangers. 💕 A FEW SUNDAY'S AGO I WENT TO THIS CHURCH AND HAD I BLESSED EXPERIENCE I WAS ABLE TO SHARE MY MUSTARD SEED BY PASSING IT ONTO ANOTHER MEMBER OF THE CHURCH I ALSO MET SOME GREAT PEOPLE WHO ALSO HAS SOME AWESOME TESTIMONIES OF WHAT GOD HAS DONE FOR THEM
I MUST SAY THIS CHURCH WAS FILLED WITH THE SPIRIT THE ASSISTANT PASTOR MESSAGE FOR THE BELIEVERS WAS POWERFUL AND IT HIT STRAIGHT HOME & WAS ON POINT
IF YOU FELT SOMETHING TUGGING AT YOUR HEART IT WAS NOBODY BUT GOD I'VE ONLY FELT LIKE THIS IN A FEW CHURCHES IN MY WHOLE LIFETIME & I DO MEAN LIFETIME
THIS CHURCH REMINDS ME OF MY OLD CHURCH IN RAEFORD NORTH CAROLINA
IF YOU NEED A CHURCH HOME THAT MAKES YOU FEEL WELCOME & MAKE YOU FEEL LIKE YOU ARE TRULY A PART OF THAT CHURCH THIS IS THE CHURCH LOOK NO FURTHER THIS IS THE CHURCH IT NOT ONLY HAS WHAT YOU NEED TO FEED YOUR SPIRIT BUT WHAT YOUR CHILDREN NEEDS TO FEED THEIRS AND SO MUCH MORE ....ALL I CAN SAY IS WHAT A MIGHTY GOD WE SERVE
HE MAKES ALL THINGS POSSIBLE
APART FROM HIM WE CAN DO NOTHING
COME ON OUT AND ENJOYING
THE FAMILY YOU'LL SEE YOU ARE FAMILY 🙏❤️💖💕💝

name: Cross Point Church Franklin - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Cross Point Church Franklin for a little more than a year. We had such an incredible experience.  From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed and seen. The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and full of genuine community.

The worship is powerful and meaningful, and the message was both relatable and deeply impactful. It’s clear that this is a church that cares about people and is intentional about helping you grow in your faith.

What stood out most was the heart behind everything—they make it easy to connect, feel comfortable, and experience God in a real way even reaching beyond the doors to the surrounding communities.

If you’re looking for a church home or just a place to visit, I highly recommend Cross Point Church. We have found our home church! Joined a service while vacationing with my 13 year old for his birthday.   If we lived closer this would be our home church.  Such a welcoming place and could feel God's presence thru the praise team, sermon and everyone.  Can't say enough good things about my experience there! Cross Point Church has a wonderful worship service both in person and online. However, I was extremely disappointed and uncomfortable when I attended this past weekend’s worship service and I noticed that wearing masks throughout the service was NOT enforced. There were a large number of individuals without their masks on during the service and they were not drinking a beverage or eating. During an active pandemic with increasingly raising numbers, it is paramount that we all follow safety precautions to keep each other safe.

I won’t be returning for another in-person service until after the pandemic. Go at your own risk. I expected a huge place, but it was small and intimate.  The congregation seemed very kind and welcoming.  The worship music was fantastic.  Simulcast sermon is not for me. This is such a great place to go to church. People are just really great here including the pastor. I come here every Sunday for church and always enjoy the songs, verses, and people. I suggest this place to anyone faithful to god.

name: Cross Point Church Mt. Juliet - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary:
Loved visiting with this faith family this morning. Getting to see countless souls choose to follow Jesus and be baptized in the 11am service was super encouraging. Loved the worship team as well! My precious kiddo and I started attending Cross Point Mt Juliet in 2021 after my divorce. I felt the Lord convicting my heart to get my girl and I back into church post 2020 madness. We tried one other church before coming to CP MJ and that church just never felt like home.

Our first Sunday at CP MJ is the first Sunday in over 15 months that I was able to enjoy a full service. My kiddo had never been away from my side for an entire service. Churches would always have to text me and ask me to come console her because she would be so upset to be away from me. The first Sunday at CPMJ, somebody from our children’s area texted me a picture of her in the “buggy” out in the hallway being pushed around and my heart was elated. A few weeks later, I received another text with a photo of her dancing saying she was loving the story time. This time, tears of joy were falling down my face.

Fast forward a few years. I still had not gotten super involved but were still attending CP MJ. The Sunday before Mother’s Day in 2023 after church, I rolled my ankle while carrying my 3 year old just outside the church doors. I fell down, my daughter hit her head on the front door of the church, and our church family SHOWED UP! Reid went and grabbed ice packs, someone helped me, and even offered to help us to to our car- which I declined because I was mortified. I ended up breaking my foot that day. BUT GOD! He used that moment to get my girl and I involved. I volunteered  with a broken foot (while on crutches) at the children’s event Super Awesome Summer. We had such a great time at that, I reached out and started volunteering with our GE team under the ever AMAZING Reagan. (Whom my kiddo thinks hung the moon!!)

Fast forward a few more years… My kiddo and I are on the GE crew. She is with me every other Sunday and proudly greets before heading back to the children’s area. I’m serving as the Greeter’s Lead, and I am absolutely blessed by my GE family. They have become more than just friends- they are family. When there is a conflict in my personal life- one of my amazing GE girls prays over me and offers to accompany me. When I need a baby sitter because my parents are out of town, my GE girls have me covered.

I genuinely cannot find the words to express just how much CP MJ means to us and has become my home and mine and and my daughter’s family. I am so thankful to the Lord for His provision and guidance and leading us here. We moved to Mount Juliet little over 3 months ago and were looking for a home church. This church is all about people and the community. They have a lot of groups to get plugged into. Really good Pastors and staff. We highly recommend Crosspoint church to anyone who wants to hear the Good Word and be part of something bigger than yourselves. Do NOT bring your own coffee cup. I got a stern warning from the pastor on my first visit about filling up my 18 oz travel mug. Music was amazing and made it worth going. People mostly don’t bother you so if you’re an introvert like me and just want to slip in and out mostly unnoticed  this is the perfect church. Have called this place home for over a year now! My wife and I were both baptised here and have just loved the community and the staff that surround this church. It pushes you to get yourself out there to serve others and have a closer relationship with god!

name: Cross Pointe Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is nice and welcoming, the pastor's funny and engaging and the worship is amazing. All of this is nice, but if you're looking for a new home church you need to experience it for yourself. I'd recommend this church for my family. Pray into it and find if this church is right for you. My husband and I were warmly welcomed at the door. We didn't feel out of place in any way. It was nice to see the diverse congregation. We enjoyed the worship team as well. A great church family!  So many dedicated people and the services are always uplifting.
I've been a member here for over 20 years.
Thank you to all of you! I go here regularly; it's always a good praise and worship service! Members are very friendly and helpful with any questions or concerns I grew up in this church. They're like family. The people there are very welcoming and caring. You'll enjoy the pastor and his family.

name: Cross Pointe Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I visited Cross Point Church for the first time yesterday while we were in town from Tennessee, and we had such a wonderful experience. From the moment we walked in, everyone was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and inviting. You could genuinely feel the warmth and kindness from the church family.

One of the highlights of our visit was having the opportunity to meet Dr. James Merritt. He was so kind, friendly, and personable. He took time out of his day to speak with us, which meant a lot and made us feel truly welcomed as first-time visitors.

We left feeling encouraged and blessed by our experience. Thank you to everyone at Cross Point Church for making us feel at home! This church truly lives out its mission of pointing people to Jesus and inspiring others to live a cross shaped life! From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the passion for Christ that fills this community. The next generation ministries are especially inspiring, as they do an incredible job of leading children and students to grow in their faith and follow Jesus wholeheartedly. What makes this church so special is the people. The sense of community is unmatched, and everyone is welcomed with open arms. Whether it's your first visit or you've been attending for years, you'll always feel valued, encouraged, and at home. I’m so grateful to be part of a church that genuinely practices what it preaches! I would not recommend this church to anyone looking for a welcoming and friendly church. From my experience, the atmosphere was not warm or inviting. Despite attending regularly, my family and I always felt like strangers and never truly experienced a sense of belonging within the church.
The leadership team appeared unapproachable and lacked the warmth, humility, and genuine care that many people expect from church leaders.

A church should be a place where people feel valued, supported, and encouraged in their faith journey. Unfortunately, I did not experience that here. Instead of fostering a sense of belonging, the environment felt distant and unwelcoming. Based on my experience, I would encourage others to carefully consider whether this church aligns with the values and fellowship they are seeking. Wonderful church.  Our family has been going here for years. Would highly recommend to individuals and families looking for a new church to grow in. I’ve been a member of this church since my oldest was about 2 or 4 years old. When I first joined, I saw this church as loving and dedicated to the community. However, when I truly needed help, I was turned down. Later, I was told I could call again—only after they realized who I was.

My oldest daughter, who is autistic, began to get bullied every time we attended service. The church was aware of her condition, and I mentioned it several times, yet nothing was done. Eventually, I started receiving strange looks myself, which made it even harder to attend.

It’s been three years since I’ve been there, and during that time, no one has checked on us or reached out. It’s disappointing that the church shuts down reviews or avoids addressing real issues instead of providing real solutions. Also, there’s very little diversity within this church, which is something that really stands out.

You won’t find me under this name, but my real name is in your system. I just hope this message brings awareness and encourages the church to reflect and do better for its members.

name: Cross Pointe Community Church - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming non judgemental place of worship. Pastor Larry and his wife Rosanne will make sure you are warmly welcomed if they see a new face. Pastor Larry is filled with the holy spirit and is not afraid to spit fire and truth. Great place hope to see you soon! If you are looking for a Bible based church in Northwest Arkansas, look no further than Cross Pointe NWA.  Pastor Larry and the staff are welcoming, and he preaches straight out of the Bible in a way that everyone can understand. My girls and I decided we would try this church on Easter. Immediately a red haired woman who was a member of staff was very unkind. We took our seats and during the a worship music and my 8 month let out one squeal. A woman named Rosanne who was staff as well came and said we should leave to the nursery. Those 2 members of staff were very passive aggressive when we were only trying to enjoy our Easter. This is a response to Mr. David Freeman. I'm sorry you seemed to have had such a poor experience with this church. It honestly sounds like you have a grudge against the church as a whole as opposed to Cross Pointe specifically.
You failed to mention that the "No Assistance" sign also states two local and non-profit organizations supported by the church with phone numbers in order to call. Both provide exceptional assistance to our area. To boot, where you aware that Cross Pointe has a life group to assist the elderly and single parents? Did you know that members of the church bring produce from their gardens for free to single parents and those with food insecurity? Did you know they reach out to the college students who have no place for the holidays or nearby families? They indeed serve the community.
I'm not sure why you're angry about security. Why does Walmart have security? Why do banks have security? Why are all of our public schools locked up? Because there are terrible people with terrible hearts bent on the most destruction and pain possible against innocent and soft targets like church offices. They aren't hiding anything, they're taking general precautions against an evil world. Just ring the doorbell next time.
I have a grudge against the church and now been attending Cross Pointe off and on for the past thirteen years. There is no other church I've found in the area that doesn't hold itself pretentious, massive, or focused on growth, but on the people present in its sanctuary. I would challenge you to return for a solid month of services and engage with their community. Bring your anger, your disappointments, and hurts, because this church knows a God who can handle them.
Hope to see you there. What I love about Crosspointe: Perfect for those who are burnt out on religion but want relationship. When you come, you won't find perfect people but sinners who love Jesus with all their hearts who are thankful and greatful to be able to build lasting relationships with other believers. Been going since 2009 and so proud of all the growth in everyone especially how much my relationship with Christ has become deeper with the in depth sermons and life groups that you can plug in to. You will quickly become family, warmly welcomed and hopefully feel at home. Great kids programs for all ages, great for those with a heart to serve or those parents and grandparents who need a break where they know their kids will have a blast and learn about Jesus.Thankful to have a pastor, worship, leadership and admin teams that truly function as a unit. Two services to pick from with a continental breakfast just in case life happens!

name: Cross Street Christian Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: Church a place of good!😘😍 Nice church

name: Crossbridge Church | Brickell - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going to Crossbridge Brickell, and it’s honestly one of the friendliest and most down-to-earth churches I’ve been to. The people are warm, welcoming, and really care about building community. What stands out is how seriously they take living with purpose — not just at church, but in everyday life.

The messages on Sundays are focused on the life and teachings of Jesus, and they do a great job of showing how that applies to real life — especially here in Miami. The talks are rooted in the Bible but easy to understand, relatable, and engaging.

They also care a lot about the city — the church regularly supports local nonprofits and encourages people to give back and help those in need. You’ll find a good mix of people here — lots of young professionals (especially in medicine and finance), but also families, kids, and older folks. There’s a great children’s program, and small group meetups during the week help people build friendships and grow personally and spiritually.

On top of that, they host fun events like cookouts and parties where everyone’s welcome, even if you’ve never been to church before. They also occasionally team up with other local churches for worship music nights, cookouts, and community outreach.

If you’re in Brickell and looking for a place that combines meaningful teaching, uplifting music, and a genuine sense of community, I highly recommend checking out Crossbridge Brickell. Here you can belong before you believe! My husband was a skeptic and now is a firm believer all in part to Crossbridge teachings. This church will meet you where you are.

As a person who approaches finding a  church very cautiously , you never know if a church is sticking to biblical teaching until you hang around for awhile. Crossbridge is an amazing gem in the heart of Brickle.  My husband and I recently became official members because we believe in the work their doing.

Our lead pastor Carter has an incredible gift for sharing scripture in a way that feels practical. I always leave church better equipped to progress in my faith.  . Johnny our campus pastor is also so personable, and integral to all of the progession of the church.

It doesn't stop there The community at Crossbridge is SO WELCOMING, no matter how much you may want to run out of there right after service, the more you linger  you start to make meaningful connection . Also Crossbridge has a lot of community driven events  both for the broader city of Miami and the church body including movie nights, dinner parties, food drives , marches, Bible studies and more.

God is doing great things through Crossbridge!
Highly recommend. This is the best church ⛪️ I have ever seen in my life ❤️! I love it, awesome 👌 people and good vibes ❤️ 🙌 💜 God bless pastor John 🙏 his great ! Highly recommend for everyone to go and visit! AMEN Put God first in everything you do! Excellent worship and teaching on Sundays!  Many opportunities go deeper - both in community and in God's Word - throughout the week.  After living decades in another city, Crossbridge was a key factor in helping us feel like Miami was "home." I visited Crossbridge Brickel two years ago and quickly found it to be a community of Christ centered believers with solid Biblical teaching and cross focused worship.   I now call it my church home.  If you are looking for a church home.  Visit!   You won’t be disappointed

name: Crossbridge Church Brickell
reviewSummary: Urban congregation in the heart of Brickell connecting professionals, young couples, and families through thoughtful theology, neighborhood dinners, and community engagement.

name: CrossBridge Church of Christ - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Is this a church of Christ? I said the name on here says, "Church of Christ"... But then I read things like " worship dancing".. I see a choir on stage... Praise teams?

I graduated from heritage Christian University. My sister's husband's dad is the vice president of Faulkner.... I wish this church has not called Church of Christ. This is not what we believe this is not how we act and this is not what the Bible instructs. This is heartbreaking to see Attended Community Sabbath with my lawyer boss and Martin and Kayla Briggs!  Thank you so much for the invite!  Rabbi Jeff & his wife Sherri are wonderful!  There was worship dancing!!  💃
Highly recommend this experience if you’ve never been. The services are casual, which I could question in terms of the churches in the Bible, but overall they have a wonderful and very active service, which I liked. So you really can't fall asleep here. Also you can drink coffee which will bolt you awake as well. The singing is very passionate and contemporary, so you should definitely visit! I grew up in this church. If I had to highlight two things that made this church special it's this; they make it very clear that no one is perfect or sin-less but everyone is a Child of God, and that the church is the people gathered together inside, not the building surrounding them. I can attribute at least part of my loving gentle nature to Pastor Garry and the sermons he raised me with. Lovely preacher, kind staff.

name: Crossbridge Church Pinecrest - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross Bridge Pinecrest is truly a special place. From the moment you walk in, you feel a sense of care, professionalism, and genuine community. The environment is welcoming, well-organized, and thoughtfully run, with a team that is attentive, kind, and deeply committed to excellence.

What truly sets Cross Bridge Pinecrest apart is the heart behind everything they do. You can tell there is intention, integrity, and passion woven into the culture. Communication is clear, standards are high, and the overall experience consistently exceeds expectations.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trusted, high-quality, and uplifting environment in Pinecrest. A true gem in the community. 💫 CrossBridge is one of the most important parts of our lives today. We were deeply blessed that it was our first church when we moved to Miami nine years ago.

Our closest friends are from CrossBridge Pinecrest. We share our challenges and our victories, and there is always someone walking alongside us through every season of the year.

Through this community, our faith in God grows stronger each day. CrossBridge also creates many opportunities and events that help us connect with others and truly feel supported. Pastors Felipe and Marcus are wise, kind, approachable, and genuine in their love for God.

We are truly blessed to be here. Our lives would not have the same peace in our souls without CrossBridge, our friends, and their prayers.

Thank you, CrossBridge Pinecrest My husband and I have called this place our spiritual home for 18 years. It has been a place to grow in our faith, our knowledge of the Bible, and most importantly, to grow in and be held accountable by a loving community that is corporately committed to honoring God. This church is a reflection of the diversity of Miami. I love playing my violin in the band and our kids are absolutely at home and comfortable here. Their lessons are not watered down, but they challenge them and stay focused on the truth of the radical love of our savior, Jesus. This is a place where anybody can come and belong even before they believe. Questions and discussions are welcome. Atmosphere is modern but not too contemporary, reverent, warm, fantastic musicians and excellent practical teaching. Have been attending for 12 years. Mix of all ages and rich community building and support. Multi cultural and welcoming to all. We were looking for a non-political church where the Word of God is preached truthfully, and where we could find fellowship with other believers. We have recently started attending Crossbridge Pinecrest, and we always feel welcomed. We enjoy the worship services and the sermons. There are many groups available to help us grow spiritually, along with various activities and events. For women, there is a monthly gathering that features inspiring testimonies to encourage one another. We are hopeful that we will find what we were looking for in this church. ❤️

name: CrossBridge Community Church
reviewSummary:
CrossBridge is the family friendly worship center one expects it to be.

Access to the site from Overlook Pkwy is made safe with directed traffic and a line of pylons.

Once in the parking area, a clump of pylons on the way to First Time Visitor parking made the approach confusing. A parking lot staffer improved things a bit but not much. The restroom was also not the easiest to find even with signage and appears to sit next to the children's area.

A pavillion at the front walkway contained name stickers and writing instruments making it easy for first timers and old timers to get to know each other. Greeters are lined along this walkway rather than crowded at the door.

The auditorium or sanctuary features a bank of floor to ceiling windows on one outer wall added bright and natural light, a nice change from the usual windowless sanctuaries.

The song service was average. The worship team consisted of the leader and one other with a guitar, a keyboardist, one female singer, a drummer and a bass guitarist. The keyboardist and bass guitarist were fitted with stand mics, although it was not clear why since they were never used. The leader provided a good selection of songs with plenty of heartfelt adoration of Heavenly Father and the Christ.

The teacher did a very capable job. His preaching style was a mix of Narrative and Topical. His delivery was lively and energetic. He interspersed humor, inspiration and anecdotes into the teaching, and was effective at keeping the congregation's attention and eliciting a response from them. He showed emotion and vulnerability as well.

DOG IN THE SANCTUARY
Um...what? The accelerating trend of dogs in public spaces just slid to a new low. Well, it can be said to their credit that CrossBridge did not deprive an unwittingly divisive family from experiencing God by banning them and their dog.

Meet and greet occurred at the end of the service. Throughout the entire service, tithing and offering were not mentioned which was a blessing. The prayer team came up during the song service with the song service continuing uninterrupted.

Four and a half stars for CrossBridge Community Church. As mentioned, CrossBridge fits in well in a neighborhood of families with children. If you want to visit a church that puts missions, prayers, and the importance of attending a lifegroup over their church services?  This IS the place! We attended here several years ago for a few months. Friendly people for sure. So-So teaching and preaching in me and my wife's opinion. Went here for Easter service last week and seemed just the same. I had hoped to hear a very evangelical message but it was more of a    God can make your life better message. Unsaved people need to hear clearly the radical truth of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. They don't need self improvement or just to sin less. They need to be raised from spiritual death into the life of Christ. Such a loving group of people…And the presence of God is felt/real here! Very good church to get plugged in. Love the service and the message

name: Crossbridge Community Church - Helena Campus
reviewSummary:
We have recently moved to town and attended crossbridge this morning in an attempt to find our new church home. The people were very welcoming. There service was wonderful. One of the pastor's spent some time talking with us after the service which was great, normally it is hard to pin a pastor down after service. Will say definitely plan to be back. We visited today at Crossbrige Church and words are no enough to say how we were BLESSED the Music & Preaching wear Awesome. The People there made us feel welcome. Looking forward to going back
And been Blessed. Thank you  Lord🕇 What a wonderful fellowship! Such a sweet spirit and loving body of Christ. Highly recommend Love the church love the people and they're willing to help you when you're down-and-out Very welcoming and friendly.  Service was great

name: Crossgates Church - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary:
I reached out for counseling. The counselor saw me a couple of sessions and then I was pretty much ghosted. I tried to let the church know about it, but they just ignored what they were being told. I was told by a couple of members that he has a history of not calling people back. Ok ...then why is he still there and counseling? Why is this being ignored? I love this church!!!   It is a large church.  Yiu have to take your time, and find the place you plug in, once you do, you will feel Gods calling and purpose that He has for you.  Pastor jet is an amazing pastor, the music is wonderful and spirit lifting.  The childrens activities are beyond what you can imagine.  They work hard raising our future generations up.  The prime timers keep our elderly with events all the time.  The youth group has few activities, but do meet only on sunday night.  Its a wonderful church. From 9-2022 to 7-2024 I was bullied by a member inside the Church. The leadership ignored my repeated requests for help finding out why I was being bullied and stop it. I was eventually driven out of the Church, never knowing why I was attacked. Imagine this - You're in your 30's and decided to move back to MS after being away for a decade. Wanting to attend a church that is around 25 minutes away instead of 45 minutes or more (moved to a different location in MS, so i would end up driving a further distance than the churches that I attended when I was a kid). Walked in wearing a red dress (had to purchase new clothes since I gained weight) and am put towards the center, where the podium is located. During the time, you decide to use your cell phone to look up the Bible verses that the pastor mentions so you can read multiple verses and you will remember it better. (And since I enjoy making sure that a pastor kept with the concept and doesn't try to take the Bible out of context. I've seen pastors do that.)
He notices someone who looks to be in their 20's, at one point asks that everyone look at him, and then during the altar call mentions that some people might need to be delivered from social media. The last time I was "called" out was by another pastor who said that I should get married and it would give me courage. I honestly think this pastor should pray more - in his daily life and while on stage - the Holy Spirit would have revealed I was following along with the Bible. Will I be attending another main service? Nope. I'll be attending a church that has a regular prayer meeting.

P. S. At the other churches where a pastor has done this, and nothing changes, the churches shrink because of the lack of prayer and relying on God. Great worship service. Very modern, contemporary music. Great praise experience. The worship leader's (D. O.) posture was always one of humility in that his presence on stage was commonly in the background. We were impressed with his lack of desire to be front-and-center.

Unfortunately, connection with staff is almost nonexistent with newcomers. There seems to be an intentional wall between churhgoers and church employees. Multiple attempts to establish a relationship with ministerial staff went unrequited.

Further, even the most humbly submitted request for a change in some process was rejected with discourteous pride.

In summary, it's a great show but they're missing the point of ministry.

name: Crossing Church North County - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
(I'm Swedish) Me and my husband visit Crossing Church two times in November, during our 7 weeks in Escondido.We just love the loving atmosphere, "family feelings" and we will come back next time we visit our daughter and her family. Good and anointed preaching from the Word of God, and as a "worshiper" from Sweden I love the worship ❤️. Pastor Billy and his wife came and introduced them self for us, and we talked to a couple of others too./ Blessings from 🇸🇪 Sweden Sorry but the worship and atmosphere like most churches today, are like concerts and entertainment centers with colorful fancy stage lighting, wanting everything to look appealing to draw people in, it was difficult to follow and sing with the worship leader because of the range of his voice, I wouldn't even call it direct personal worship to God, it seemed more like the words were more like what we can get from God than direct worship to Him for who He is, today in most churches worship just isn't what it use to be, most disturbing today is you have people drinking coffee and eating their pastry during the worship and preaching of the word, absolutely no reverence towards God,  I also noticed the sermon wasn't really all that inspiring to convict you in drawing closer to God and living a godly life by the pastor, I attended here when the last pastor was here, until he was relocated somewhere else, supposedly because the church wasn't growing fast enough was their excuse, my gosh is the assemblies of God church leaders into numbers now, personally I thought the last pastor was an awesome pastor, I believe he was given a bad unjustful break, he gave some super spirit filled engaging powerful sermons, personally I believe when people hear the raw undeniable truth of God's word, most people get squirmish and uncomfortable because it challenges and convicts them, so they go somewhere else where they can hear cotton candy watered down gospel that makes them feel good, nothing that challenges their selfish manicured controlled lifestyle, something that tickles their itching ears, with that being said, I use to look forward going to church back then, worship was great as well, I was heartbroken when the pastor left, when I visited crossings church some years later, it wasn't the same, and it was still the same size regarding people 🙄 ?, till this day I'm still without a church home. I'm home at Crossing Church! I love the pastors, the messages, the people, the outreach, the atmosphere of praising the Lord. I'm so thankful for finally finding a church home and would encourage everyone to come to service any Sunday at 10:30. You'll be so glad you did! Our family loves the message, the worship songs and the people. Great preschool teachings (Sundays) and Youth program (high school age) on Tuesday evenings.

Looking into Life Groups on Wednesday evenings (aka small group & Bible study) This is not a review for the church, but for Pastor Billy who officiated our wedding. Pastor Billy did an excellent job, both with our ceremony and with our pre-marital counseling. He really took the time and got to know us, and tailored our ceremony to us. He learned about our most memorable dates and included parts of them into what he said. As Pastor Billy told us, though, Weddings take wedding clothes, but marriages take work clothes, and he put his work clothes on with us during pre-marital counseling, which is yet another thing we cannot recommend enough, especially when working with Pastor Billy.

name: Crossing Community Church - Newtown Township Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I were invited by a friend to come last summer, and we haven't stopped since. Pastor Tim knows his people well, preaching with a lot of heart and keeping the gospel at the center. Jarred, youth pastor, leads the worship, with modern hymns and spiritual songs. (They are beautiful!) Marla heads up the kids ministry! They are excellent leaders, and your family will be blessed for visiting. Pastor Tim is excellent. Great guy even though he is a Cowboys fan, he was genuinely happy to see the Eagles win because of the unique faith the team carried. If looking for a local church is Newtown / Langhorne / Yardley area, this is definitely the one to give a shot to. A caring community of Christian believers. A great place to go for people who are searching for the truth. Outstanding children's programming and Youth groups. Friendly. Not legalistic or judgmental. The Bible is the authority in this church. These people have helped carry us through our hardest times.  If you are looking for a support system get involved in a small group or Bible study and you will know God’s love through his people. Crossing is like family you always wanted. Love the people, the worship,the preaching by Tim. God has changed my life by coming to Crossing.

name: Crossings Community Church
reviewSummary: A beloved OKC institution with thoughtful biblical teaching, outstanding family facilities, and a dedicated community medical and dental clinic.

name: Crossings Community Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: A beloved OKC institution with thoughtful biblical teaching, outstanding family facilities, and a dedicated community medical and dental clinic.

name: Crossings Community Church Katy - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
When we move to Katy 2 years ago, we had not lived in the suburb for over 20 years. We had gone to an inner city church in Albuquerque. The burbs were very different for us. We craved a church where we could serve and who knew us well. We needed a church that wasn't too big and had diversity. We started googling smaller, biblically sound churches in the Katy and Richmond areas. Crossings Community was the fifth church that we went to and we never left. They immediately open their arms to our family, have biblically sound teaching, have a good youth group, and friendly people who we now call our brothers and sisters. If you're looking for a church in the Katy area, please come visit! Strong gospel saturated Christ centered teaching of Gods word every week.  The congregation is a very welcoming fellowship with a desire to make disciples. Children's ministry is thriving and provides a good biblical foundation. The primary mark of this church is its commitment to Gods gospel as the power to transform lives and communities. Awesome church!Small church where you will find people who love you. You get to hear solid expository messages each week. Usually a book from the bible is taken and the series is continued. Very touching and practical sermons. Simple music and songs used are mostly contemporary. Good committed child care as well. Great place to belong to! God bless this church!
No word of faith or prosperity gospel heresies. You'll be hard pressed to find more passionate, biblically faithful teaching in Katy than here. You won't be getting "5 ways to be a better ______ " every Sunday. You'll hear the bible explained, usually verse by verse, and the gospel of Jesus Christ made central while personal application flows from the text. Check sermons on the website to validate for yourself. You'll also find a welcoming body of believers who are serious about discipleship along with reaching the lost. The worship through music/singing is contemporary and is consistently done with excellence in an acoustic format. The kids 3 yrs and up join the congregation in singing and go back to have their bible lesson when the preaching begins. Leadership here is authentic and this flows down throughout the rest of the church. Crossings is a small to medium sized church with friendly and engaging members. The Bible is preached verse by verse, and there are programs for kids and youth, ministries for women and men as well as small groups! We love it here.

name: Crossings Edmond - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church after being away for several years following my grandmother’s passing. I really enjoyed the service and felt it was meaningful. However, the young adults ministry and Sunday school felt unwelcoming, and there wasn’t much fellowship for newcomers. It felt very cliquish, and I struggled to connect with people my age. I hope there can be more intentional effort to include new attendees :( I don't attend this church, but my son does attend their Teen 2 Teen group once a month. It's a group of autistic teens that get together and just hang out without judgment. My son (15) LOVES going. For the first time ever, he feels like he fits in somewhere. Let kids play or sing while parents sit and patiently wait, allowing their teens to socialize in their own ways, with as many or as few people as they want. The kids wear color coded name tags that identify the level of social interaction they feel comfortable with. There is never any pressure on them to do anything they don't want to. This group has truly been a blessing for my son. I love this church. I recently lost my husband, and I'm ɓgoing thru a pretty rough time financially, mentally and physically. I'm staying with my son(Thank you Jesus) and I'm slowly learning more about God, which is what I desperately need. I feel better after listening to their service. I do wish they would sing some of the older hyms. Singing to a Christian song makes me feel good.
I'd definitely highly recommend this church. Everyone is so super friendly!!❤️ Came here for a back to school event. They outdid themselves! Everything was so well organized! They gave backpacks full of supplies, free books, and indoor games where you could win prizes, and they had 4 food trucks where you could get a free meal for the whole family! (We got bbq!!!) Talk about being highly impressed.
Thank you to everyone who put in the time and worked to make this event successful! We we will definitely be coming back next year. I love Crossings Church! Wonderful pastors, classes and attendees. It’s very social friendly and something is happening daily. I’ve been in a church since I was young and this one is the very best out of all them. You can come dressed like you want and be welcomed with open arms.

name: CrossLife Bible Church - Irvine Campus
Crossline Church
reviewSummary: Extremely friendly and active church. Thriving kids programs and excellent sermons. A great blended approach. The chapel service is very intimate and sweet.

name: Crossline Community Church
reviewSummary: A casual, outreach-oriented community church in Laguna Hills with a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Crossline Community Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly biblically sound church. Pastor JP Jones is an outstanding teacher. Extremely warm and welcoming congregation. Great food pantry volunteer opportunities.

name: Crossline Community Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
From what I've seen, it looks beautiful. Hope the message delivered is just as good. They have a private lake too that isn't open to the public for fishing but they may hold fishing events. Crossline has become so much more than a church for our family- it’s truly home! From the very first Sunday, 5 years ago.. my family felt genuinely welcomed and embraced.
Pastor JP has a gift for delivering messages that speak straight to your heart — always grounded in faith and full of encouragement.
Women’s Bible Study has been a true blessing in my life; the friendships I’ve built with other faith-driven moms have meant the world to me. Crossline doesn’t just talk about community, they live it. So grateful our family found this place! If you are looking for a church to try, Crossline welcomes everyone. If you are looking to learn the Bible, this is a teaching church with modern day, application. Crossline has several women’s ministries, a great men’s ministry, free counseling services, a relationship & marriage ministry. Not to mention a gorgeous lake and is a wedding venue. It is a tranquil and wonderful campus. My home church is great. Been going here to get fed spiritually and literally for 10 years plus. Got baptized here in 2020 and there are so many wonderful loving people here, you have to experience it. Their motto is "Love God, love people, and have a blast!"

Pastor JP is a solid Holy Spirit Filled Man of God! Food Bank
I am grateful for all the people that serve there at the food Bank.
When registering just walking to that  area workers are not kind, forklift man. When inquiring about what to do and how do I register people there are not patient. It's routine to the volunteers.
They do not explain well.  The lady that said a prayer for me and my family I was grateful however, I felt perhaps that was the wrong job for her. Sometimes it's better not to attend or volunteer if your hearts not into it. All I want is compassion, A reflection of Jesus Christ, An Ambassador of the Crossline Church.

Thank you!
