name: CrossPoint - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: We love Crosspoint. All praise and Glory to Jesus ~ the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords! We are made to worship Him! It's Sunday services are awesome. Holy Spirit filled.  The warships and messages are beautiful. 🙌🙌👍 My first time worshipping there. Amazingly diverse congregation. Youth ministry facilities are spacious and well thought out. Pastoral leadership is young, fun and faith driven. Sermon was very biblical.  Foursquare churches are huge in Nigeria and it was such a blessing to see quite a few African believers in attendance including one lady wearing an elegant tribal dress. I'm being attending for over a year now and I love it I'm making this my home church and family in Christ, thank you Pastor Leaf This church is doing big thing. Bringing families and the community together. My family had a great time at this year's Christmas event in the parking lot. This place was covered in  SNOW yes SNOW. Thank you so much we had a great time.

name: Crosspoint Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor and his family have a heart for Jesus. I am new at this congregation and my family and I love it. We love to see some people holding their Bibles during services. We visited other congregations in the area and some don’t take their bibles just their phone and we felt weird taking our bibles. This church is Bible based and we are grateful for that. My little daughter loves the children ministry at Crosspoint. What a God beautiful friendly people! The Best church I have ever been to! Welcoming to all, very friendly congregation! The messages are always bible based, encouraging always lifting up Christ and glorifying him! The pastor and his family offer a 14 week bible study for new believers or anyone interested in digging deeper into their faith! Come check it out, by the grace of God, you will see me there! Solid, Bible-believing church. Pastor has a heart for Jesus and the Great Commission of spreading the gospel. Has been a huge blessing for me and my family; have seen Christ magnified in our lives. If you are in the area, come check it out. Very welcoming environment. If you want to meet a group of people you can call family, come to Crosspoint! You’ll hear a clear message from Pastor Phillip that comes straight from God’s word, hear the gospel preached, and be surrounded by people who actually care. The music is also really great, incorporating both old school hymns and modern contemporary songs in every service. They have a kids class, and weekly bible study where you can dive into the Word and fellowship with others. They also do outreach in the community. So thankful to call Crosspoint my church family! Such a great church! The pastor and his wife have such a love for God and people and it's so evident. A great place for anyone of any age where you can grow in your walk with God and leave inspired to be more like Christ in whatever life stage you're at.

name: CrossPoint Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I started attending this church over a year ago.  I can't say enough thank you's to this church and to our Lord for this ministry.  I came in hurting, alone, thinking here I am again in a new church.  I've gone through many trials and tribulations, family crisis, daughter with mental illness, and much more.  I came in by faith.  I would drive by the church daily and see the big cross outside which stood out to me.  My first Sunday I was greeted by loving people and met the sweetest lady named Marlene, who showed me so much love. She walked with me after service to get a cup of coffee which meant so much to me.  She introduced me to people.  The lead pastor Don is very loving and teaches sound biblical doctrine which was key for me.  He teaches grace, another plus for me.  He's genuine, down to earth, humble, and kind.  I met Pastor Lon,  pastor of Discipleship, who prayed for me after service.  I like that they have prayer available if you need it.  He's also very compassionate.  I was able to call him at the church for some counsel and he called me back and was very present and provided support and prayer.  I attended a "Starting Point" meeting with Pastor Danny, pastor of Community Life, and he provided information about the church, what they believe, and is also a great asset to the team.  All three of these pastors teach on Sunday mornings and all add a different spiritual dynamic.  The three pastors make a great shepherding team.  They have many small groups, children's classes, my grandkids attend the GEMS and Cadet group there which are like girl/boy scouts.  They have an awesome group of deacons here too!  The Lord used them (Patty, Norma, Mario, Nick) in my time of need and I can't thank them enough for their acts of service.  Thank you so much Crosspoint, pastors, deacons, elders for all that you do for the Lord.  I'm truly grateful for you. Great place to hear God's word being proclaimed. Very good church Fantastic church with very friendly people. Plenty of small groups and Bible studies for both men and women.  People actually care and are involved. We met more people in our first month than we did in 15 years at Calvary Chapel. It has the best pastor, he is both humble & his love for the Lord & his energy in describing the Bible, is so motivating. And the congregation is so warm & welcoming filled with the love of Jesus.

name: Crosspoint Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: If you have not experienced a Super Bowl service (connected to faith), you are missing out. Great culture for people who are exploring faith. Did not know church could be this inviting. I do not go here anymore as we moved, but I really enjoyed going here. It was definitely very modern, the pastor wears a nice tshirt and jeans, it’s dark (like a movie theater or concert), and it felt like attending a TED talk. The ladies I worked with in the nursery and attended small group with were wonderful. And most importantly, the teaching was relevant and easy to understand. They were very much proponents of not being in your face about religion, but telling people about Jesus organically. Like if he’s a big part of your life it’ll just come out naturally in conversations. I have been there a few weeks and will continue to attend. The atmosphere is awesome! Nice seating, lighting, and sound system inside. The preachers do a great job of being interesting but still giving a good message. The worship is led by a band, All The Astronauts, and they do occasional fun performances that tie into the theme of the message (like "Bad" by Michael Jackson or the Spider-Man theme song by Aerosmith). I don't know if it's always like that or just because of the current "At the Movies 5" event for the month of August. There is also free WiFi and free tea or coffee, and there are nursery rooms for kids during the services. You can attend the early service (at like 9 am) or go to the 11 am service like me. They also have small groups and age specific groups, events, and more. I highly recommend it. Crosspoint is a wonderful church no matter where you are in your spiritual journey. The music (and the coffee) is always amazing and everyone you meet is kind and welcoming! Comfortable, inclusive and awesome music! Pastor makes everyone feel welcome and loved. Very welcoming, easy going!

name: CrossPoint Church - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church, welcoming atmosphere, excellent sermon! Powerful teaching, great pastor, a loving place for families and bible believing and seeking people who love and want to know Jesus and  God’s Word better and more truly. I have attended CrossPoint many times. Every time they teach what is  in the Bible, nothing more, nothing less. They have many ministries to meet the needs of different types of people going through life. There are many types of well taught Bible studies available to you either at the church or in homes. They have several excellent, well educated, loving, caring pastors ready and willing to help you with anything. This will be our new home. Pastors Bruce and Gregory... PRAISES and WORSHIPS and SINGS ands ENCOURAGES and LOVES and ACCEPTES me WHERE I AM in my walk with Jesus Christ as my savior.
...Titus 2:11-13 READ THIS...
Pastor Bruce teaches me topically and also by book and chapter. This Church body helps me stay connected to God and Christ with LOVE.
Thank you Pastors.
Dennis/M68 Not much social distancing coming here for service. A friend of friend invited me though. Hard to find parking coming here. Felt a bit pressured on how they run on Sunday once visited. Wish they are more nicer.

Based on my experience, it was just complicated to understand and prefer not to visit.  Irresponsible when some are not safe even with masks. Having a hard time process coming. On issues I had, they tend to brush it off and not care to solve. Hard to trust them when they can't handle the real truth.

Seen passing by on their page, there was a youth group and hardly any masks. No proper social distancing as seen during their in-person program. I went to service before once and not much safety they even care meeting up.

name: Crosspoint Church - Pearland Campus
reviewSummary: We love our Church and the leadership that God has put together. Excited for what God is going to continue doing! We rented out the kids Adventure Point party space and my son and his guests loved it. It’s so difficult to do parties in the summer with the heat, bugs, and constant rain. This place was the perfect solution. The time and price for everything was perfect! Thank you for making my son’s birthday a memorable one. I would definitely recommend the Adventure Point party rental to anyone! Nice people and a positive message. Drastically oversimplified description and analysis of scripture. Just became an official member at church! I love the spirit filled worship but I especially love that Pastor Tom and Pastor Shippey are always very clear, passionate, and through with their message. The message is always backed with the word and well structured. They reach out to the community and truly help those in need as well as offer so many ways to get connected. Excited to make this my home church! Love this church. Very welcoming, great music, and many opportunities to join in to serve others. This church does amazing work for the community. The men's and women's Bible studies are a great way to meet new friends.

name: Crosspoint Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Changed rating from 2 to 4. Visited again with a friend and the culture seems more friendly. Church seems to have changed a few policies to be more inclusive of people from various phases in life.

Visited several times...
Pastor speaks about different kinds of people following Jesus, yet church feels cliquey, as if the only way to truly be accepted is to break into the right friend groups. Lots of emphasis placed on joining small groups. If joining is difficult because of erratic work, family, or conflicting schedules (or you're simply not ready yet) there won't be many resources for you or people willing to connect.

Messages were bible-based teaching through a book of the bible. Pastors were inclusive of many different political views while still holding onto sound biblical teaching. There was a clear, continual message that political views don't save. Jesus saves. Also, an overemphasis on personal condemnation.

Songs were upbeat and many instruments used including guitars, drums, and keyboard. Services opened with a couple songs and concluded with a couple songs and communion. Baptisms followed a few of the services.

Parking is challenging, so arrive early or look for guest parking near entrance. Outside of the building is pretty plain, but inside is nicely decorated, especially the children's area which includes a climbing wall, a log cabin stage, and bench seats.

In conclusion, may be a good fit if you instantly feel at home here. If not, you may want to keep moving. Leadership and regular attendees probably go out of their way to make you feel welcome. My husband and I moved to Temecula a year ago and got plugged into Crosspoint right when we got here. This has become more than just a church for us, they are more like family. The whole staff is kind, knowledgeable, helpful, fun, easy to be around and creative. They always have fun events scheduled and the sermons are well laid out and easy to follow. I feel like I have grown so much this past year due to this church family, Jesus is really present. I recommend getting plugged into a small group, it’s a wonderful way to get connected and strengthen your faith. They have two different campuses and a variety of times to satisfy most schedules. I would highly recommend Crosspoint to the established Christian and to someone just curious of what it’s all about. We found this welcoming, Biblical teaching church in the middle of the Pandemic.  We have been attending since October and have had tons of opportunities to get involved serving using our gifts.  The  small groups really helped us to get to know some people on a deeper level and establish community.  Love this church and the people!  You should definitely check it out! We might be biased, because we are partners now, but this is truly a unicorn church that checks off all the boxes when looking for a new home.  Teaching from the bible, all kinds of people welcomed, and true servant leadership….thankful for the way we have been poured into so we can bless others. My first time visiting Crosspoint church and it was an amazing welcoming and the sermon was very nice, love the music. I really think I found my new church. I like the fact that they have service on Saturday night. I really thank my neighbor friends for taking to Crosspoint church.

name: Crosspoint City Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary: Hey lost lambs are you seeking the word in a down home friendly Sunday church service?  Walk over our threshold, get greeted and welcomed in a loving way.  Take a tour of our Canton location church.  Pick up a FREE warm cup of coffee and grab a seat.  Our band and production team will fill your soul with worship songs that stay with you all week.  Our loving volunteers in child care are ready to love on your children like their own.  We offer two Sunday services each week so you can pick the best one that fits your family.  If you like our services we offer voluntary posts within our location to serve and welcome in others to the word of God.  Come home to a church that offers more than just a sermon. Never have I experienced a church so welcoming, interactive and just overall a representation of Christ. I started attending two months ago upon starting my faith journey and don’t regret it. Pastor James makes it so easy to understand the bible. Its 100% according to scripture. Great balance between love and also letting you know when you are doing something wrong or interpreting scripture wrong. Not a lukewarm church. Not a condemning, un-righteous judgment church. Perfect balance. These people really love Jesus and act like it!!! Thank you for changing my life and bringing me so much closer to Jesus♥️ Praise God for putting this location near my house and leading me to it!! Just tried out Oak Leaf Church today for the first time…what a warm, welcoming, friendly, kind church! Felt like a part of the family from first moment in the door. Great worship, authentic, Spirit filled…great message from Pastor Tony, strong truth delivered with a compassionate, soft heart. If you are looking for a church, please try this one out!! Thank you for the blessing today Oak Leaf, and May God continually bless your Kingdom work…you guys are a great picture of Jesus! They allow vaping during service. It is distracting and smelly. What a great home to have been placed in. God shines through the church family here, and I'm glad to be a part of it. The services are at 9:30 abd 11:00 and we would love to see you there!

name: CrossPoint Community Church - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary: Been coming here for the past 2 weeks will continue coming here. I like how they have child care services. I like the songs and energy, It's a great church I grew up going to this church. The music can be awesome. However the staff (especially the high school group) puts on a good show. The church should be named The Community Gossip Church. I wouldn’t recommend this church and definitely don’t recommend the high school youth group. Thank you I love crosspoint community Church they make you feel at home they love people come and visit us at just bring your camera your phone so you can take note if you have a Bible on your phone like I do and then there's always a place to write your thoughts down there too so I hope you have a wonderful time and if you do my name is Shirley Baker look me up I never Sunday I might be running from class to class I'm in second service and I'm in probably the back road somewhere singing and then after the singing so I do a little listening and then I go across to pacesetters into Sunday school class so I enjoy that I also go to the class for grieving people that have lost somebody but you know it's not just that you might have lost your best friend as a cat or a dog or anything like that that is grief and you need to be in a grief class so happens we have one and it's still open so get in there and register if you can't get in this one register for the next one and I'll be there too because I'll be going to the book again he has two books one's a workbook and then one is a beautiful book about what they put on the your page every morning the the morning prayer and everything like that it's great crosspoint is good about doing these things so I hope everybody will come but she's just post Thank you for the clothing it was very nice to be able to get clothing from Crosspoint Church. Again thank you I look forward to being able to get clothing again sometime.😁 I have been a member since 2002. I really like Pastor Matt Whiteford, Pastor Ross. name: Crosspoint Community Church - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary:
I can't remember when I felt more included and a part of a community. This church epitomizes the love, grace, knowledge, understanding, mercy, and forgiveness of Jesus Christ. The pastor is young, vibrant, and extremely knowledgeable. The elders and deacons are incredible. There is an entire Latino contingent of the church that celebrates with the English speaking contingent in their own language with the same message. The children's programs are amazing, the music is top-notch, the feeling of family and inclusion is beyond description. I cannot speak more highly of any church in any city, in any country. Please consider stopping by and being a part of this wonderful community. We spent quite a bit of time church shopping, looking for one that had friendly people, moving worship and bible-based messages.
So for just over 3 years, Crosspoint has met and exceeded our needs from a church.  Friendly, genuine people; worship that keeps things fresh and doesn't follow the same format week after week; and messages from gifted speakers that are not only from God's word, but that are educational, easy to apply and relevant for everyday life.
With Ministry groups for all ages, regardless of gifts or talents, we've been able to connect deeply with people outside of just Sunday mornings and can fondly call them "family"! I have been attending Crosspoint for over a year now and I have applied to become a member of this wonderful and fulfilling Church!!!  Ever since walking through the doors of Crosspoint, I have felt at home with God.  Pastor Mike is truly inspiring as well as the members have welcomed me with open arms.  I feel truly blessed to attend Crosspoint and I look forward to spending many years here. The friendliest church I've ever met! My wife and I are from out of town and the people were so kind and welcoming. Even on our first visit it felt like we were family and home. I absolutely LOVE this church!! Pastor Mike gives amazing sermons.  This place is AWESOME!!

name: Crosspointe Church
reviewSummary:
If I could rate the community and the pastors alone, I would give this church a billion stars.

My family and I found a genuinely welcoming home here. The people were kind, the environment felt safe, and the teaching deepened my understanding of Christ and God’s call to love, serve, and live with integrity. That matters, especially for anyone carrying hurt or complicated history with church. I did not feel like a project here. I felt like a person. That is rare, and I am grateful.

Because I take faith seriously, I also want to be honest about the one thing that ultimately made us leave: the worship music.

For many of us, worship is not a “warm-up” before the sermon. It is formation. It is one of the primary ways we offer our hearts to God, become present, confess, remember, and join our voices with the Body. Music can open the soul to receive the Word, and it can knit a room of strangers into a single, living community. When worship is healthy, it lifts our eyes, softens our defenses, and helps us practice joy together.

In our experience, the worship music here repeatedly did the opposite. It felt outdated, disengaged, and spiritually flattening, to the point that it was difficult to stay attentive and open. It did not feel like joyful congregational worship. It felt like background noise that drained the room.

At first, I wondered if this was just personal preference. I am a person of color, and I grew up in a Black church where worship is often more participatory and embodied. I know styles vary, and I do not expect every church to match my background. But this was not simply “not my flavor.” It was consistently unengaging. We asked several others around us, including white members, and they shared the same concern.

Over time, this became more than an annoyance. It became a barrier to belonging. We found ourselves timing arrival to avoid as much of the music as possible, but with kids drop-off, that is only so workable. Eventually, we had to admit the truth: we loved the church, but the worship experience was making it hard to participate with a whole heart. So we moved on.

I am writing this with respect, not contempt. I believe humility and honesty are part of discipleship, for congregants and leaders alike. If the church is open to learning, this may be an area to seek outside input, invite guest musicians periodically, invest in new leadership, or rethink what “congregational worship” should feel like in this community.

I truly hope you address it, because the church itself is doing real good, and the preaching and community deserve worship that helps people draw near to God instead of pushing them to endure the moment until it passes.

If this changes, I would genuinely consider returning.

P.S. I want to be very clear about what I am, and am not, saying. This has nothing to do with theology, faithfulness, or whether the worship team is “teaching the gospel” in a style I prefer. We chose this church because we resonated with the values and the preaching, and I still stand by those values, which is exactly why I’m taking the time to write this. The issue is simply musical and communal: the music itself is not strong, it is boring, and it does not invite congregational engagement. It consistently felt like it shut the room down rather than drawing people together in worship. ANAZING church that practices scriptural teachings and the practices of Jesus by accepting all people where they are. Great for youth services, music ministry and very service oriented. So thankful to have found this church!! This is my Church of choice. I enjoy how open they are to ALL people. They are friendly and always welcoming. There are many things to do for all ages. I especially like the teaching from the pastors. They are relevant as well as use Bible verses. If you're in search of a church, I would recommend looking elsewhere. From what is presented on the Crosspoints website, it is clear that this church does not adhere to Biblically sound teachings.

After reviewing their site, it's evident that this "church" aligns with the warnings given in 2 Timothy 4:3-4, which states: "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine.
Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear."

Take a look at their "Values" page. Jesus isn't even mentioned until the third bullet point…. This alone speaks volumes about how central He is to their mission.

As you continue reading their "Values" page, it becomes increasingly clear that the leadership embraces an Omnist perspective, which holds that other religions contain valid truths and that their followers have something to teach us. This is contrary to the Great Commission, which affirms that Christianity is the only true faith.

Furthermore, the "Values" page shows that this church does not view the Bible as the inherent Word of God. They state, "not tolerating the promotion of toxic, theological ideas that measurably harm others." While it’s important to address harmful teaching, this sentiment seems to suggest the selective dismissal of parts of Scripture with which they disagree.

This is a dangerous path that mirrors the world’s approach, not God’s. Scripture is clear on the matter: "All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness, so that the servant of God may be thoroughly equipped for every good work" (2 Timothy 3:16-17). We cannot cherry-pick which parts of God’s Word we accept based on personal preference.

Moving on to another statement in their "Values" page: they reject the traditional teaching of eternal, bodily punishment in Hell, claiming it is counter to Love and not found in Jesus' teachings. This claim either indicates a willful disregard for Jesus' clear teachings or a lack of understanding of basic Christian theology.

Jesus speaks of Hell numerous times in the New Testament. Here are just a few examples:

Mark 9:43: "If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell, where the fire never goes out."

Matthew 25:46: "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."

Revelation 21:8: "But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters, and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."

I could continue listing verses, but the point is clear: Hell is a reality that Jesus spoke about often.

This "church," if it can even be called that, bears a striking resemblance to the church of Laodicea, as described in Revelation 3:15-16: "I know your deeds, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either one or the other! So, because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth."

Like the Laodicean church, the leadership of this “church” and the congregation seems to lack the fervent, uncompromising faith in Christ that marks a true believer. Their approach to doctrine is diluted, compromised by worldly views and a refusal to embrace the truth of Scripture, much like the lukewarm church that sought to blend in with the culture instead of standing firm in the truth.

For those seeking to know Jesus Christ and to form a genuine relationship with Him, I urge you to find another place of worship. I am compelled to warn others and refute this church's teachings, just as Titus 1:9 instructs: "He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it."

I speak from personal experience, as I once attended this church before the leadership made changes that led it away from Biblical truth. This is an extremely liberal church. Have attended here for some time due to lack of options and trying to have an open mind. They consistently echo democrat, mainstream media and leftist viewpoints under the guise of inclusion. All of the pastors seem to come from some sort of religious trauma backgrounds and attempt to “retake his word”. Definitely a Us versus Them mentality and approach. The patrons and leadership are initially inviting amd welcoming, but if you hold anything than the most liberal views you will not feel comfortable sharing or expressing your personal beliefs.

name: CrossPointe Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church to worship our Lord with sound preaching! Just wanted to say how amazing this church is. It’s the overall sense of love and community here. The main staff, Brad, Warren, Tyler, Paul, Springer and Robert, y’all all embody what I believe is a Christlike leadership role in the church; honest, transparent, and just so genuinely in love with Jesus. What a honor it is to know you Men and learn from ur “quiet” footsteps day in and day out. It’s not the major things that impact us, it’s the consistent steady Christlike love and behavior that truly shapes others! Thank you for living this out week after week! Pastor gossips about and speaks badly about his own church members as well as people in the community. He is rude and judgmental. Do NOT go to this church if you’re looking for a place to feel welcomed and worship.
We came here as a new military family to the area looking to become connected to a new church home and were deeply disappointed. Military families run and go straight to Cascade Hills or other local churches where they practice what they preach. Very nice, felt at home, come as You are type Church. Good mixture of music prayers and preaching. They have coffee available donuts children's church resource center, and on the overall seem like a very friendly and loving Church. When we visit our friends in that direction we will go back This church is rooted in sound Biblical doctrine, rich in the Gospel, and full of fellow servants of Christ who love others. They have an outstanding children's ministry filled with excellent caregivers who also do a wonderful job spreading the word of Christ to the little ones. Brad, Robert, and Will preach the word boldly and confidently. You will not get a watered-down version of the Gospel or a sermon full of cherry picked verses here. Wear a suit, or jeans and a t-shirt... It is truly a come as you are" environment full of people who are genuinely happy to see you and not full of judgemental looks and such. Visit this church and open your heart to our Savior!

name: CrossPointe Church - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
Last Sunday at approximately 2:00 pm (May 31, 2026), while visiting Bridge Street near Old Navy, a woman from your church approached our group after hearing us speaking French. I do not remember her name, but I do remember that she introduced us to her son, Landon (maybe 3-4 years old). She warmly invited us to attend your church, and I wanted to take a moment to recognize what a meaningful interaction that was.

I am originally from Alabama and I now live and work in Dakar, Senegal. I was accompanying several visitors from Côte d’Ivoire who were in Huntsville for a week of training. Before their trip, they had researched Alabama and the American South and had many concerns based on what they had learned about our history, including slavery and the civil rights era, as well as current events they had seen in the news. Naturally, they arrived with some apprehension.

This woman’s simple act of kindness, courage, and willingness to share her faith made a lasting impression on them. She demonstrated genuine warmth and hospitality toward people she had never met before. In doing so, she helped reinforce what I had been telling them all week: that while every place has its challenges and history, there are many good, caring people here.

I want to thank her and thank your church for cultivating people who are not afraid to reach out to others, share their faith, and show kindness to strangers. Encounters like this reflect positively on your congregation, on Huntsville, on Alabama, and on our country as a whole.

If you are able to identify the woman who was at Bridge Street with her son Landon last Sunday, I would love the opportunity to thank her personally. If not, please know that her kindness was noticed, appreciated, and remembered. I will send a separate email to the Church in case you are able to identify her and she allows me to contact her to thank her personally.

Thank you for being a church that encourages people to live out their faith through genuine care for others. Saw Big Daddy Weave and friends there on the 17th. Amazing show and the members of the church were so friendly and welcoming. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐. Praise God 🙏🏻 Where is the praise? Its so quiet, such a large amount of people go here to check the box they went to church that week. I will always remember this church for hosting a Major League Eating contest in 2022, wasting money and resources in advertising and prize money to watch people eat over 15 lbs of food in just a few minutes. It may have been fun for many people to go and watch, but it endangered people’s lives for the sake of entertainment and made a spectacle of the name of Christ, proudly displaying gluttony underneath the cross placed on top of their church building. And the ministers there had the audacity to defend their position, answering criticism solely in the form of jokes from the pulpit. This public disgrace demands a public apology from the pulpit, but I do not expect one. Wonderful, caring pastors who aren't afraid to preach the truth, amazingly talented worship leader and great, secure children's ministry.
