name: CrossPointe Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary:
I have 2 daughters both enrolled in the education side of crosspoint. My youngest is currently attending now. Without a doubt THE BEST ALL AROUND STRUCTURE for your kids. Teachers and staff are 5 star top notch. Attentive, respectful, encouraging and have boundaries. There's no feeling judged or looked down on and I don't attend church and I'm not a spiritual man.
But every kid I've ever seen there is smiling (unless they don't want to get out of car at dropoff haha!). Overall joyful place and people.

We are very grateful for teachers and staff. Your due diligence and attentiveness is acknowledged and appreciated. Thanks CrossPointe Absolutely love this church! Even though it’s a huge congregation it has a small hometown feel to it. The people are welcoming and genuine. I am from AL but whenever I visit Valdosta again I will most definitely visit here again. So for Military personnel at Moody AFB if you are looking for a church, I definitely recommend you visit here. I assure you won’t be disappointed 😄 I love this church is my favorite place to go the people thier help with people in need they go on missionary to help people learn about God thier kids worship and for 6-12th grade and for college they help you make friends Ross and pastor Dave is the best they help me though when I was in foster care. In my opinion they are the best church to go to Out of my 23 years of living, this is the church I’ve come to love and cherish the most. Want to know the craziest part? I didn’t even go a full 2 years. I feel as though some may say that it’s, crazy? Is the best word I can think of? To have so many “standards” when it comes to what you want in a church.

I deal with anxiety (more times than not) and depression (here and there). Macie Green is a sweet soul, although I’m not sure if she still attends this church bc ik she just graduated and maybe even moved back to her hometown, but anyways.. She reached out to me and was my friend. Through the fear and anxiety. While her friends at church did not become my friends, they were still a community. There were a couple of times I believe where we all went out to eat after church together and just sat, talked, laughed, and had a good time. Enjoyed ourselves.

January of last year I moved to Northern Alabama and it has still to this day been the BIGGEST struggle finding a church that I can love as much as I love this one right here in little old Valdosta, GA. There is a CrossPointe church in the town that I live in, and while it’s beautiful and great it’s nowhere NEAR as great as this one. Pastor David and Miles are really the only two individuals who truly made an imprint on myself and my life, but each and every day I miss this church. Every chance I get when I go back home and visit GA, I try my best to go to a Sunday Sermon. If I could give this church 10 stars, I absolutely would.

One last thing.. There was a friend of mine who happened to fall away from Jesus. I convinced him to come to church with me here one Sunday and he fell in love with it. I knew he needed God more than anything. He fell back in love with God. He’s a very good friend of mine and my boyfriend’s, and seeing him find himself in Christ has been such a blessing. It’s been ever so clear that God has made a difference in him. Even the Sundays that I was sick or not feeling well enough to go, he went. He even got baptized at this church. He still thanks me to this day for bringing him back to God.

All in all, this church, the worship team, the people, the Pastor, everyone. Everyone will always have a special place in my heart no matter how far I go. My family and I have been attending and serving at CrossPointe Church for about eight years now.  We love the worship and pastors, the opportunity to serve our church and community, and attending a church that helps further our relationship with Christ.

name: CrossPointe Church - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary: This is a local church like no other—truly. People are so friendly, leadership is wonderful, staying faithful to Scripture and unafraid to apply God’s Word to everyday life and culture. Wonderful kids ministries, thriving youth group with an amazing leader, growing young adult ministry. Plenty of classes for adults as well, and a rich network of small groups. If you want to hear about Jesus for the first time, or if you’ve been a believer for years and desire to continue to grow, this is the place! So thankful God led my family here! Come visit! Great Place to Worship and Biblical teaching and Preaching . Kids and Youth programs are both growing and equally great about teaching the Word of God in a context that the kids can understand. Expository preaching with an extremely welcoming environment to new members and guests. A church community that truly does life together serving and glorifying God. Tremendous children’s ministry, adult Sunday school, Wednesday evening Bible study, interactive small groups, young adults and youth ministry! This is a church you can call home while being fed the true Word of God! My family and I have been members for almost 2 years. We are grateful to God for allowing us the blessing of the CrossPointe community and church in our lives. Love this church! It is a joy to be in this place each week. When I am on vacation I actually miss going to church at CrossPointe. Great kids ministry, music, and most of all expositional preaching. If you want a Bible teaching church that is true to scripture, this is the place. Great teachings from the pulpit and from the classrooms. People are warm and friendly. This is the church to make your home at!

name: Crosspointe Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
I went there for the sunday church service and loved it. A lot of friendly people, everyone was welcoming. I hope to build a strong god fearing community and make good friends i can count on and rely on. The performers on stage are amazing and very talented. The stage effects are on point and get the crowd into it. From the moment I walked through the doors I felt welcomed. Now it feels like home! If you are looking for great worship, authentic community, and people who love the Lord, come check us out! Pastor there prayed for the protection of ICE agents after the murder of Renee Good and wouldn’t even say her name.
I have to conclude that either he is ok with the immoral and often illegal behavior of the agents or he doesn’t want to offend the cruel people who are in favor of their actions.
Either way it’s a dealbreaker for me.
I had been attending this church for the last 8 years and am now going to a new church which didn’t politicize the latest murder of Alex Pretti. The pastor there simply expressed sorrow about what happened and prayed for the actual victims and their families. "To whom it may concern,
I am writing to express a serious concern regarding Pastor Jeff Snodgrass. A pastor is entrusted with the responsibility to live out the message he teaches, but I have observed behavior and conversations
from Pastor Jeff that do not align with the principles he preaches. This inconsistency is troubling, as those in pastoral leadership hold a duty not to cause others to stumble or lose trust in the church. I respectfully request that this matter be taken seriously and reviewed with care, as the spiritual health of the congregation depends on leaders who walk in integrity."
血 It's a great place to worship God. Pastor Brian is amazing he explains the scriptures  into detail. This church also Offers Different  prayer group's to help Marriage Couples,  children/Adolescence  and just regular people who are struggling with gaining a better understanding and connection with God. I love this church everyone is so kind and friendly. This is my new favorite place.

name: Crosspointe Church Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Crosspointe Brea is truly a welcoming church that has a desire to have a deep connection with God and fellow believers. I have found the congregation to be incredibly generous, serving one another and their community with love and compassion. It is a place where my faith is nurtured in Him. Crosspointe church Brea is a very warm and welcoming place. They love and care for people and I am touched by that! Pastor Rick is wonderful! I am blessed by their generosity to me! Very friendly, encouraging to all ages. Crosspointe Brea is a great place to worship and hear God’s word. The teaching is always on point, the staff is friendly, Kidpointe, the kid’s ministry is engaging and a fun environment for the kids to learn about Jesus. Our family loves attending weekly on Sundays and participating in weekly growth groups! This is a very loving and generous congregation.  I am not even a member of their church and community and despite this, these kind people heard about the hardships my daughter and I have been facing and they gave us a donation to help purchase school clothes for her senior year of high school.  God bless this church!

name: CrossPointe Community - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Michael Martel the great service on the Holy Spirit! This is a very friendly and great place to be, come on in and bring a friend!! "No perfect people allowed!" Very warm and welcoming community. Also very tolerant, respectful and helpful I was there for a wedding, very nice cozy church Thx Best church around

name: Crosspointe Community Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary:
My family has been attending for over 4 years and this church feels like home for us. The staff has wonderful unity, the teaching is very sound, and the worship is relevant and Bible based. The people there have a genuine love for one another and live out their faith.

If you are looking for a church home in Greenwood I highly recommend visiting Crosspointe! I love our church. I have never been at a church with such selfless and servant people in the body. I feel people are intentional in my family’s lives. We have a great middle and high school youth group. The pastor is a really good teacher and makes it real and applicable to your life. God is good and I know my family is in the right place. Come join our church family. I attended last week with my grandma as a guest. These people are very chill & welcoming. The atmosphere is positive & I really needed that after having terrible experiences with church in my time The bathrooms are spotless and the music isn't too loud. Been attending Crosspointe for almost 3 years and my wife and I feel very loved and cared for there. We recently have had a huge life change and there have been many members of the church help us through that. The pastors, Ben and Joe, are both great and very knowledgeable. A welcoming community of God loving people. Strong biblical preaching/ teaching. A family full of sinners just like me, forever thankful to our Lord for saving us. There are men’s and women’s groups, small groups and tons of children and student activities.

name: Crosspointe Community Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary:
A warm and inviting place to learn Biblical truth. This is a great place for those who are interested in learning more about Christianity where your questions are welcome as well as a wonderful church family for long time believers. Crosspointe is definitely not a "spectator" church; there are lots of ways to be involved and active! Crosspointe is a church where you will feel connected and a part of the family. The pastoral staff give relevant and engaging messages and are invested in the lives of the people of the church. Love how close and personal this church is. Really focuses on growing relationships with Jesus and with others. It's bad and the only thing you do is sing and read  Spanish stuff I was received with such love!
This place is great!

name: Crosspointe Dalton - Dalton Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I went here for almost 3 years. Everyone is really nice and the worship is powerful but the sermons are not convicting at all. The pastors seem really nice but the messages are like shows. The movies at church series is odd in my opinion why are we comparing secular movies to the Holy Bible? Yes the messages are very easy to understand but do not preach the half truth! Wonderful community and if youre a new Christian I dont see an issue, but Christ is pulling us deeper in faith and we have moved on from Crosspointe. God Bless. They lost my child then blamed me even though she was checked in and left under their care and I was at service and they didn't even realize she was missing until I came to pick her up she was found outside roaming in the parking lot I would NEVER recommend this church to other parents. Broke my ankle in their balcony because they don't have proper railings. The pastor has given me dirty looks and given me attitude for reasons I don't know I've been nothing but friendly to everyone. Feels like most services are about politics and topics about racism. Tried to get baptized here but they wouldn't do it. Overall the bad experiences I've had here WAY out number the good experiences. Most of my family attends church at Crosspointe. It is a great place to go worship with a family oriented, and loving, caring fellowship amongst the congregation. The pastor is great. He teaches the scripture. Crosspointe also has a great youth program as well. Come, and worship with us, and we can embrace God's Love through his word together. We attended Night To Shine Prom at this location.   EVERY volunteer we encountered -from the parking lot guides, the red carpet, the buddies, the food and coffee cart servers, the emcees, the photographers, the prom pack delivery team members, the setup crews, the clean up crews, etc- was helpful, smiling, pleasant, and just wonderful souls with good hearts.
Thank you for what you do each year !
❤️

This church has plenty of parking--- which I suspect is full each and every service judging by the people we've  met and spoken with who attend there .   God Bless y'all. 🙏 Crosspointe Church is a warm, welcoming place to be as soon as you walk in! Extremely passionate about God and the teaching of the Bible. The Pastor is sincere in his teachings and his heart for people! The youth and children’s programs are the best!! Very focused on our next generation at this church and the importance of getting connected! If you are searching for a place to bring your family and learn how to know God, Find Freedom and discover your purpose, then Crosspointe is where you want to be!!

name: Crossroad Christian Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary: Church is a great environment for young people.  The leadership us passionate about the growth and development of young people.  Young men appear to learn from the leadership life experience.  Great for millenials and younger. It's a great church! There motto is " We are changed people,  changing people." If you want a place to worship,  come here. More worshipers, the better! Food pantry treats everyone very nicely. Great food pantry Friendly congregation. Alonzo B. Taylor is the Asst. Pastor.

name: Crossroad Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: Crossroad Church is the place to go to hear nothing but the truth straight from the Bible.  Come as you are and feel the presence of the Holy Spirit.  A place to deepen your relationship with the Lord and a place that will introduce you to Jesus should you not know Him as your Savior! The 1st time i experienced going to church. I encouraged myself to know more about jesus. People here comforted me, i didnt feel a stranger. I was very proud that i was babtized on my birthday😎 i told all my sibling that I was a Christian now! I didnt care what theyr reactions. At that time i dont know how i pray, now almost everyday I pray at least i put HIM in my mind all the time. Awesome small loving Church...The people at this church are loving people and help the community every way they can...Definitely recommend this church and you will find the love of God here!!! Crossroad is known as The People Place for a reason.  Come on over worship with us and you will understand why Very warm and loving church body of believers. The music and message glorified God…

name: CrossRoads - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I stand corrected, the church’s website does not identify itself as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church. Google identifies Cross Roads church as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church.

Contemporary music with electric guitar and drums on the platform. Service was opened by a woman (lead singer) who opened the service with prayer (if correct, there is a chapter in Corinthian’s that speaks about women leading the service).

In regards to my comment on a woman opening the service in prayer, please read 1st Corinthians Chapter 14 and 1st Timothy Chapter 2. Women are an extremely intricate part of any church ministry, however, they are not to lead the men.

Most importantly, there was NO presentation of the Gospel to the lost / unsaved visitors present! A presentation (invitation) of the Gospel should always be given to afford the lost to respond. There was NO presentation or even an altar call.

It appears the Pastor is more interested in pleasing his congregation than preaching biblical truths and salvation by and through Jesus Christ! Loved the Walk Through Bethlehem special event.  Very loving and kind church community dramatization of time of Christ's birth place. CrossRoads church has a great children and youth ministries that our kids enjoy. Preaching is focused on teaching the Bible and how to apply it to your life. We also have Bible Institute classes that you can take for audit or credit. We also have an indoor playground with a cafe that is open during the week. This is the same church that I went to one afternoon. On line it said it was open. Certain times during the day. I was new here in fl and desperately needed to speak to a pastor.
When I got there there 2 cars there so I knew someone was was there. After all it said they were open
I went to door and it was locked. I knocked. I knocked and I knocked. Then another car came in and went further down to park and disappeared in to another door but I believe still connected to building. I ran down there. I knocked. I knocked and I knocked. No answer. As I stopped knocking someone must have very quickly come out of the first glass door part I was knocking at, becouse in a blink a car drove away. Back up to glass doors and gave it one more try. ..
I came home and waited for that call from the pastor himself whom I had left it with promising he'd return thier call. Needless to say, I never got a call like he said on his messege.
Too bad .it looked so pretty. Was looking right now today dec 23 2025 for a church open Xmas eve..candl light. Upon comming to website I only then saw by pictures it was the same church & Pastor who ignored both my knock and my call. I was introduced to crossroads three years ago coming here as a snowbird. Loving and caring. The pastors are wonderful. From the music to the worship and Messages the spirit of our Saviour is felt in a wonderful way. God Bless this church.

name: Crossroads Bible Church
reviewSummary: An active, vibrant and effective Ministry that exudes the mission of Christ to those wanting to live out their Faith in a meaningful way. Unique programs tailored to the needs of the Community and parishioners. If you want to grow in your relationship with Christ, this is the place! Hearts led in worship, Bible teaching which included some Greek and Hebrew wording to clarify concepts, open sanctuary to  seekers and believers-come visit.  I wished I lived here instead of joining for a Sunday traveling though Michigan! Love this place! Teaches the truth directly from the Bible, providing practical, relatable, and solid doctrine, filled with the presence of God, worship atmosphere is genuine and uplifting loving, welcoming family of believers who genuinely care for one another, serves the community, relatable pastoral team, caring environment for children. Nice friendly people, services are usually pretty on point and can leave with a little for for thought. Felt a bit out of place though but that's likely just me but only 4 star because of that. People don't feel as welcoming as should for a house of the lord but again could be me. Other than that great place to spend your Sunday morning. Wonder place to worship. Great people and great service

name: Crossroads Chapel Colorado - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
The fellowship is amazing. The sermon that Pastor speaks is from the heart from the Bible and is absolutely wonderful. Worship team the songs we sang today gave me goosebumps I know he was with me the whole time like he is everyday. The congregation very caring very loving family praise God. I was invited to play music for the congregation at their regular service because their chief musician was on vacation. Everyone was kind, and I give them credit for participating with music that they likely wouldn't have known. I was impressed that the pastor, who is older, had an organized presentation that even included slides ("PowerPoint" for Boomers like me). This is the second year my kids have attended VBS at this church. What an incredible experience for them! Each day I was amazed at how much love, time and attention was poured into each of my kids. (You should see the crafts they came home with each day!!!) The VBS program was incredibly well thought out and planned. My kids literally cried on the way home when it was over. To the staff: Thank you for loving on,  and teaching my kids about Jesus. I couldn't have asked for a more positive experience, you have set the bar incredibly high! I have been blessed to have known Pastor Mitchell since the mid 1980's.  When my world was in such a disarray  he brought sense to it.  My time with him in person has been limited I know his love of his friends is beyond imagination.   Your church is an extention of his leadership.  Please continue to pray for me and my family.
David Hudson, MSgt, USAF (ret) We went there today for their Fall Festival and all my family and I can say is that they were very hospitable and personal. We like the atmosphere and the people. They were all super friendly. If we were closer we would attend. We felt the joy there. My family had fun and we definitely recommend going to this church if your looking for a small but intimate church feel.

name: Crossroads Christian Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church, and their passion for sharing Jesus' love with their city! We love being members at Crossroads!  The message is inspirational and the music is so uplifting.  After searching at so many other churches and leaving bored and disheartened, now I finally have a place where I am learning and becoming closer to God.  We have also made some life long friends here and feel so supported by the Crossroads community. Very friendly and welcoming group with casual and modern style, yet very biblically rooted. Wonderful place to praise the Lord and sing his praises! [object Object]

name: Crossroads Christian Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a beautiful community church. The people that work here are absolutely wonderful. LINDA is always the most helpful whenever I come here to release Doves. She always has everything under control. Big beautiful facilities. Everything is so clean. There is a beautiful waterfall and even a coffee shop. Wonderful place to bring your family.

Bobby
Socalwhitedove If I could give Crossroads ifinite stars I would Chuck is amazing and it reflects through his fellow staff members. If you really want to find and persue a personal relationship with god come here. Because the lord has filled this church with the holy spirit. Through him all things are possible and this church family makes the impossible possible. SEE YOU SOON!!! Love Crossroads!! The people are warm and welcoming. The music is awesome and all the pastors deliver meaningful heartfelt messages from the Bible. They have kids ministries and welcome special needs families. There is something for everyone. In my opinion. I wouldn't recommend this church to my worst enemy. What they say about mega churches is true. I was hoping it wouldnt be. Also dont come here if your trying to make a change. They judge you right when you walk in to the main entrance. I always left feeling worse everytime leaving there. Sometimes in tears. There nothing but a buisness. Very rude people. No matter how nice you are to them. There the stereotypical christian forsure. But that didnt make me turn away from him. Made me realize we need to spread the real way how jesus wanted it. Jesus came down to abolish slavery an boom years later creates another 1. Not what he wanted. I hope no one else has to go through this. Try an other church in corona. This is my family's church. I'm from Arizona and I was visiting, I got to volunteer with my sister and also worship. They had a public speaker. I had a beautiful feeling attending. I would definitely love to come again when I visit.

name: Crossroads Christian Church - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: I'm not the church going person, let alone religious. I went for my daughter. I must say they are really nice people. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. I didn't feel out of place like I do at most other churches. I wore leggings, sandles, and a casual dress shirt and I fit right in. So it's not all fancy dressing. Jeans and a t-shirt and you'd be fine here! I had to use the restroom while I was there and I noticed a basket with female products next to the door. I think it was a thoughtful touch. Yes it's simple but so many times I've been places that just didn't think about it. They had Mary Lou donuts this morning which was so nice as well. They really seem to care about the members. It's not huge or small but a nice in between church. The church was clean and the auditorium was cute. Very well light and a classy modern feel. Though I'm not a religious person as I said before, I hope my daughter would like to go back. I'd honestly go with her every once in awhile cause that's how comfortable it is there. Have been going to CCC for approximately 9 yrs. Love the people. Always evolving. Great service, very welcoming people Very loving and accepting church Love it here!

name: Crossroads Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent place for Sunday worship. Varied group of people of all nationalities and age groups. Pastors are down to earth and friendly.  Bible led church for sermons and prayer meetings. The church members are supportive and friendly. There are lots of groups to support parishioners, from family groups to singles this church covers it all. Love this church, I've been attending here for almost a year now. A very welcoming environment. If your looking to hear the word of God, and grow in your relationship with Jesus Christ this is the place to be, this church has great Pastor that helps deliver that. Love the fellowship at this church as well. This is an amazing church. Pastor Will delivers great messages, the praise team does an excellent job, there's bible study to get everyone involved and they do a good amount of volunteer work. Highly recommend everyone to come here. Awesome people. Great sermons. Incredible kids ministry and activities. I feel very lucky to raise my kids in this church! Awesome church! Been going here for 8 years, very welcoming, diverse congregation, lots of events and ways to get plugged in! Highly recommend

name: Crossroads Christian Church - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place, anointed, perfectly imperfect people who aren't afraid to be so.  Family focused ministry.  Love this Church for their HEART and for the love they show.  I have been singing on the worship team since last year and I'm glad we have our forever home. Pastor Bruce ( Sr. Pastor) has a genuine deep care and concern for us, I always see him interacting and loving on people, he really tends to the flock.

I have had access to things like Celebrate Recovery (which is a fantastic ministry, which isn't your typical "Hi Bob" program, they invest into your healing, spiritually and physically with accountability and non judgement 👌) and it's not just drugs and alcohol that receive healing here, it's everything from Anxiety to Codependency to Anger Management and everything in between!
The youth ministry from crawlers on up get to have access to so many amazing people who get to love on them. I am amazed at what God has done and is doing through this Church.  I sincerely welcome people here, especially those in search of Love, the Real Agape Love of Jesus shown by a group of Beautiful, Perfectly-imperfect people.  I love my church! One body with many unique parts!!♥♥ I really love Crossroads Christian church; they’re non-denominational and super loving and accepting. They are a Jesus preaching, Holy Spirit believing church. They have a ton of small groups including Celebrate Recovery on Friday nights.
I love that they have an 11:30am Sunday service! I go to church with my family in Vacaville at 9am and then get to go to Crossroads at 11:30! God always makes a way, and He has used this church and congregation in my life many times! I’m so thankful for a place to worship Jesus and listen to His word! Thank you Crossroads for always being an open door to the presence of God!! Wonderful, family oriented and welcoming church! It has been home to us for a couple years and we continue to grow more attached each week. Truly compassionate ministry team and the Word of God is delivered in such a soul moving way each week! They offer so much more outside of Sunday services as well, movie nights, holiday carnivals and plenty of one on one interactions with the team if needed for means of growth, counseling and even marriage mentoring. Highly recommended! This church and all of the wonderful people involved have changed our lives! I only love it because of what it represents and the fact that Jesus and his father God are being worship there. God is working in my life he's helping me remain calm and collected my faculty. I love you disciples of God. Even though you were out of food for me, I went to the church by Vacaville high, to get the food that they said they would give away and they said no to my face. Sent me all the way back from where I road my bike. But if you work for Jesus then I love you. In Christ Jesus Amen I love this church, Crossroads is family friendly and very welcoming, I currently go here and it’s amazing, all the people and staff are accepting and supportive. I am the drummer for our Youth Worship, so if you need a church to come to, I recommend Crossroads!

name: CrossRoads Christian Church of St. Matthews - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Evangelical Christian Worship center at St. Matthews area, Louisville, KY. Sunday School/Bible Study at 10am on Sundays and Worship service from 11-12 noon. Everything is right on time. People are warm and kind. There's ample parking space right next to the building too...you don't have to worry about where to park. Love the feeling and atmosphere there.  Minister and congregation very friendly. Wonderful Church. Very friendly people and the you could feel Gods presence. Was there for a Baby Announcement. It's a very nice place. Beautiful and uplifting services.  A growing church.

name: Crossroads Christian Reformed Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderfully warm and welcoming with a dedicated pastor and wise counsel of elders and deacons. Beautiful building and location with ample parking. Bible-focused, Christ-centered teaching, fellowship opportunities, and kind, caring members. Tip: Get to know Pastor Jeff by attending the Thursday Bible study in the church office, from 10 to 11 am. Hope to see you there! Crossroads has been our church home for many years now, and it is a big part of our lives. Wouldn't have it any other way. We love our church family. Pastor Jeff is a great and faithful leader. great christian chruch many friendly people with lots of church history and knowledge , come visit We have found the church to be incredibly warm, friendly, and supportive.  We especially love how they include the young people as singers, instrumentalists, and other support roles. Great Place, Nice Crowd and Program. Very Welcoming.

name: Crossroads Church
reviewSummary: Known for being 'Unfiltered' and addressing gritty topics. A church for people who have given up on church.

name: Crossroads Church - Avon, IN - Avon Campus
reviewSummary: From the first time we walked into Crossroads, we knew it would become our home church.  The presence of God is real. The people are real and love each other. There are so many ways to be involved in the church.  Pastor Craig is a man after God's own heart. His staff is amazing also. Love the friendly atmosphere. The preacher is Great! But the thing, the most important thing is feeling the presence of JESUS there This is a wonderful church I really like it I've been going there since February of 2025 We've been attending Crossroads Church for 18 years.  You will not find a better group of Bible believing people in the area. A true Bible church.  Pastor Craig is a true believer and an amazing preacher.  The staff leads well in their areas, and the congregation is warm, welcoming, and true Christ followers.   Lone my churxh.

name: Crossroads Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church, felt welcome being there as a first timer passing through the area. Mostly older adults, but they're trying to relate to younger audience with the music, kids ministry and contemporary look and feel. The LED lighting was pretty fun and helped set the mood for different parts of the service. We attended today 4/12/26 Pastor awesome !!! He was specifically to the times what we shall be watchful  for in our days...  I dont live here, but will relocate once I retire...this will be my church... Hope the Kord gives him many years ahead as a shaped  to God kingdom.
Thank you Pastor...
Norma Aronne Bad experience, pastor didn't show welcoming vibes, not even an effort to show us this church. Tells us to bring our high schoolers to youth program and nobody shows up at all.  If you want to go to a church with leaders who don't care and unorganized, this might be the one.  Don't waste your time on this horrible place they call church. Horrible church, wanted to visit church and once pastor walks out he shows no welcoming vibe, just wanted to answer a few questions and leave. Would never recommend a garbage place like this to worship God. Also, Waited an hour outside for youth service because they told me to bring high schoolers for youth group and then of course nobody was even at the church during that time. What an absolute junk they call church here! Stay away! Everyone is so friendly! I love this place! The church is newly built and VERY nice. Pastor Bob seems to know my life because it seems 9 out of 10 times his message is related to something going on in my life. I love that after service, people go to lunch nearby for fellowship and food, and everyone is invited. It's is a wonderful place for worship, friends, and family. They make you feel like family from the first time you walk in!!

name: Crossroads Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Crossroads Church in Temecula is a very welcoming church that embodies a very loving and nurturing atmosphere with bible based teaching.  I have experienced 3 of their pastors sermons while attending and all 3 have the same approach and are all on the same page representing Jesus beautifully.  Their sermons are straight from the bible (utilizing translations from the NIV, ESV, NLT and a couple others) while also revealing the original languages and meanings there in.  I can really feel the presence of our Lord here.  I’ve never felt more at home in a church before as I do here.   What a wonderful representation of the body of Christ.   I love it! A warm friendly church. Love the different groups. Went to one in a home and it was so nice, good fellowship. The sermons have been excellent and seemingly led by the Holy Spirit. They have all touched different areas of my life. Tuesday night Bible study has been excellent and inspiring. I love the music worship and Prayer time you can feel the presence of The Lord. I'm happy we have made this our Church home. We have been persistently blessed with the dimensionality of our well being: spiritually, mentally, and socially. It is time for us to learn to serve Jesus through this church. Thank you 😊 Have felt at home from the first time attending several months ago. Our children (ages 5 &7) love the Crossroads Kids program. Everyone is so warm and welcoming. Pastor Gary is the real deal. He teaches from the Bible with passion, boldness, integrity and honesty. His messages are easily applicable to our daily life as well as intellectually stimulating. Love it here. 🙌🙏 Great Church, Friendly People, A Diverse range of Attendees, always make you Welcome.  Previously attended a mega church for some years. Got to thinking I needed more, didn't really know anyone except a few people I worked with, listened to pastor preach but never met him. Needed more in A Church. Where you know these People & you can share your Christian Life as a Whole Church Family from children, teens & adults. Great Pastoral Staff, feeding & teaching The Word of Our Lord Jesus Christ. Something for All, Love This Church💒.

name: Crossroads Church - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary:
Crossroads church is a great place to worship on Sundays. Pastor Jerry is very practical and down to earth with his sermons. Crossroads services feel like a family get-together with Christ at the center. Wonderful pastor who speaks the truth love the music Great friendly people I really enjoyed the atmosphere. Very comfortable feel for our first visit. Was very disappointed in the offering speach regarding tithing. I understand completely why it is important. It's our giving back to God and Gods work. But asking the congregation to start with 10... Then go to 11 then increase 1% every year until you are at 20% makes it look more like a business. I get that building and expanding a church is both good for the community and the message... It was just a very large surprise for newcomers. Great place, have been attending for a year having moved here from out of state. The pastor is family, so I love him as a person, but I really like his teaching style. He loves the Lord and is sharing that passion with us.
Crossroads feels like a "family" - not a stuffy church at all. And they probably do things differently there than anywhere else you may go. It's very relaxed and welcoming. Pastor Jerry is always on point with the message, I always walk out feeling like he was talking directly to me or my family. This is a true family church. The worship team is a team. Great music! Everyone is so warm and welcoming.

name: CrossRoads Church At Westfield - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you crossroads church for loving your neighbors!!!!
Showing them how much you care by the works that you do-whether they come to your church or not you are a true example of God’s love for His people.
Thank you!  I have enjoyed coming to your free Zumba classes for I think about 3 years or so. Thank you, thank you! I pray that people will see God, though you! If you want to learn about God and his love for you, Crossroads is the church for you. Beautiful people who love helping our neighbors. Our Pastor teaches us about God and stories of the Bible. Best band & music anywhere! Please come, you will be glad you did!🙏 With great pleasure, I call CrossRoads, my home church.  The congregation is extremely outwardly focused, helping countless people around the world with their support (financial and hands on) with their program,,,Do Something Now.

If you are seeking to experience Christ,this is an excellent place to be. For Our Neighbor mission for Westfield residents is awesome to be apart of. CrossRoads has been our church home for a year and it there is so much MORE to come! I love this church home!  We have been attending for about a year and we belonged here the minute we walked in.  If you are looking for a Christ centered church family, this is your new church home.

name: Crossroads Church Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This Church deserves a no star. But that's not a option. This church deserves to be shut down. U sent me a email to talk to someone about why I left this one star review.  My husband and I not conferable calling. So I'm gonna explain why on here. And supposedly in the email u said u guys will correct it. I doubt it. But any way. My husband was told by a woman that this church would help us. So my husband called. Pastor Paul I believe was the Pastor. The Pastor said he come to help us in a few hrs that day. This was about two weeks ago approximately. But the Pastor never showed. Then the Pastor said he was not coming at all. The pastor gave no explanation nothing. Then my husband called again. The pastor said they could help if my husband comes in person only. We're a homeless family literally living in a tent at a park. Family of six. Two adults and four kids. Two handicaps in the family. No vechile. Broke. Yes have called other resources for help. Waiting for help, waiting for openings, there's waiting lists and so on. But my husband should not have to come in person to receive help or to get help, etc. My husband told the Pastor he had no way to get there and so on. That didn't matter to the Pastor. The pastor didn't care. So the Church did not help us at all. Not right, so cruel, unprofessional and more. This church should be able to help u rather u come in person or not. Sometimes people can't come in person. Because of reasons. But that should not stop this church from helping u. But it does. Etc. God bless all your soul's ✝️🙏🕊️ Great worship and fellowship. The Holy Spirit is alive and working here. Love this Church. Everyone is so friendly. There always There for you. Pastor Paul is a Great Pastor. If you want to feel free please stop by. CROSSROADS CHURCH. 1900 E South St Long Beach Cal 90805. Corner of South and Cherry. In my opinion Crossroads Church in Long Beach is a very loving and supportive Church to our community. Are head pastors are led by the spirit and you can see the growth in our community and  congregation. In the last 4 months we have grown in size and grown in helping our community in many different ways.

Sincerely
Anthony steinbring

name: Crossroads Church Mason - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
Enjoyed the message and worship songs very much.  First time visiting and the parishioners at the welcome center were very friendly and helpful.  The only thing different for me was the pastor was not physically at the service at this location.  He gave the message from another location and it was up on screens to watch. My mother-in-law was visiting and wanted to go to church on Mother’s Day, so we decided to check out Crossroads Mason. I was somewhat apprehensive - not much of a church guy because of the way I was raised -  but I WILL definitely be back. It’s refreshing to receive truth and to find Christians unafraid to stand up for the true teachings of Jesus.  I want to believe that real Christians practice love, peace and community, not war, scapegoating and greed. I have felt very disenchanted with this church after going here for about 6 months now. I would love to hear the actual pastor speak and not watch a Ted Talk through a video screen. I would also love to get involved with a small group but I’m not a mom, and I’m in my 30s, so it doesn’t quite feel like I’m welcome here. I might as well watch a different, much better church service from home at this point with the lack of community and lack of an actual live sermon. I have attended for 6 months, and am now looking to move churches because I feel like I can’t be an “all in” Christian attending this place. I was ON FIRE for the Lord before switching to Crossroads, but ever since moving here, I’ve felt very lukewarm and like my relationship with the Lord isn’t where it once was and I do think that has to do with the lack of community and lack of opportunity to get involved and the fact I don’t get anything out of the sermons. It’s too dark in there to even be able to note-take to stay engaged.

The positive thing I will say about this church, the music is good because I do like some loud worship, and they are an open minded church. You can show up in jeans, tattoos, crazy color hair, etc and they will still welcome you with a smile and open arms. I love Crossroad Mason. My family and I moved to the area from Memphis and we searched for a church that’s outside of traditional church and we found Crossroads. My family’s perspective is to practice for Heaven so a church with diversity was a must. Not just a minority here and there, I get to worship with Asians, Indians, Blacks, Whites, Latinos, and they even have inclusion for handicap people and deaf people. Real people that love and serve a real God.
I love the Mason Church Leaders, from the campus pastor to the worship leaders, from the security team to the parking leaders and kids club. I know I have a church with people that will pray with me and for me and be there if I have a need. A real big church to service a big community.

Someone once told me, Sunday is the most segregated day of the week.  People only want to worship with people that fit in “Their” comfort box. Whelp! Lol not here. White people singing gospel music! Black people singing country Christian music…… And they have a CHOIR?!?!  I love this church. My husband daughter and I started going here because it wasn’t far from us. Been going for a couple years and when my kid turned an age older they moved her class without consulting us. She cried and hated it so bad. She didn’t want anything to do with that. Then we found out about the kicking the Bible Stunt on Super Bowl Sunday and I told my husband that’s it. That’s my last straw. I will Not sit in a “church” that disrespects the Lord in order to appear “cool” to the modern world. The female pastor is disrespectful to the Word. I’m not coming back to this rock concert. If I wanna hear a sermon by the pastor (who only preaches in Oakley) i can flip on the tv from my living room.

name: Crossroads Church Oakley - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
On a weekend when most spend their time tailgating and dissociating from anything related to Christ. Crossroads came up with a brilliant idea on how to tie football with the church. We had an electrifying experience. Ample parking, services for kids, and a great environment. Placing God above everything else. Wow. Very nice service yesterday. I was in town visiting family. I definitely felt the Holy Spirit. This was my first service. I was worried about parking. That's definitely never an issue. I'll definitely be back. I met a friend of mine there,  he lives in Amelia. He will definitely be back as well. A service I look forward to attending. Message speaks to me every time. Rejuvenated after worship. A church where everyone is welcomed and feels they can belong. Joining small groups is encouraged outside the big church feel. So dark could not even see my Bible or notebook.
Very little Bibles or
Notebooks. Great graphics and stage focus. Yet rest of areas dark like a concert. Loads of diversity. Probably a great seeker level church. Thanks to my friend I joined her in today’s church session. I love how it’s not judgmental very welcoming energy! I love how they see people for people and it doesn’t give off cult ! The pastors are very transparent and relatable I loved the way how they include that it’s okay that we make mistakes and GOD is still there to talk to about anything! I love how the baptism service is here as well the people on the screens were very nurturing and speaking God to those going under the water ! Even the people who were nervous or been through trauma or depression were able to cry with the words and song of GOD ! I love this church and will be back!

I love that they have classes for the babies and don’t play ! Your babies are safe and they have identification for the babies ❤️
Thank you

name: Crossroads Church of Douglasville - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary: I’m a female in my 30s and have more of an alternative look. I have never once felt judged at crossroads. I also love the diversity within the church and the people who attend, down to the pastors and staff. I now volunteer most Sundays and attend some of their international mission trips. I’m the last person people thought would LOVE going to church! Crossroads has opened my eyes and heart to what being a Christian is all about. 6 months after first attending I was Saved. I’m proud to call myself a Christian. Crossroads and Jesus have changed my life for the better in too many ways to list. This church has become a great way to meet people in my community in a healthy environment. If you’re someone feeling lost, wanting to explore Christianity or just wanting to meet some nice people locally, you won’t be disappointed with Crossroads! Come join the family :) outcast welcome! And come by the cafe they have they best grits in town! The church is nice and the service is nice. However, I just experienced a not so nice moment from someone who was working behind the food and beverage counter. Older, white, blonde woman with glasses interrupted my conversation with another member working behind the counter to tell me that I would not be able to get in line even just for a drink because they had to close it at some point. While during this time, several people were ignoring the “we are closed” sign that was posted, building the line back up to even more than it had been since I went to them and asked about the drink. Please keep in mind that they had not even started service yet. So what am I supposed to do in this situation? Break and ignore the rules like the other members of this church? Or go without after asking permission to purchase a drink? It makes me question the people of the church. I’m no perfect princess by any means but this one particular person did not seem Christ like at all. Maybe I shouldn’t judge the whole church for one person’s actions. I’d just like to think a member of the church who works for the church would exhibit a more kind and giving nature than what was shown to me. Or maybe this is just how they treat strangers because I’ve only been here a couple of times. If I start coming more frequently would I be able to get away with more things? Pastor Brandon was amazing!! Spoke from the heart and you could hear his passion! I gave a ride to someone who signed up for the free baby supplies. With the dangerous weather these past couple of days, you would think that some one would have had made alternative arrangements andaccommodations for people not to stand outside, lined up, like giving out free supplies SHOULD NOT look like. I mean if people are here, they obviously need the supplies. Why have people wait without dignity? It was freezing outside, and once the sun sets, it will be unsafe. This is not a small church, and has plenty of square footage inside to accommodate these folks seeking assistance. What? You didn’t want the inside of the facility to get dirty? Simply horrible. There’s small kids here, infants, pregnant women, older individuals. There were two picnic tables in between the crowds, and several pregnant ladies cut the lines to sit. Shameful. If you’re going to do something for the community, do it taking every aspect into account. To make matters even worse, they didn’t open the doors until 4:45 PM. Plus, no one answered the phone to provide any information as to the new start time. People were outside freezing, sniffling, and if they weren’t sick already, had a good chance of catching a cold. The plus side is it wasn’t raining. I find it very hard to believe this is an atmosphere anyone would feel welcome to worship, being a total stranger. My grandson and I attended a Christmas celebration here and we had fun. Everything was so organized. There was a children's dance performance with Freddie Falcon, sermon, hot chocolate and cookies, painting, games, photo booth, train rides, actually making s'mores outside, prizes, taking pictures with Freddie Falcon, and more. We had so much fun December 14!

name: Crossroads Church of Dunwoody - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church facilities, very accommodating. Visited when our son's AMP group did a joint concert there. The Word is proclaimed; Christ is exalted. A doctrinally sound and Biblical church. Very nice place to worship our Lord. God is really moving in this place! My family began attending Crossroads Church 5 months ago. We’ve been blessed to see and be part of what is happening here… the preaching is biblical, deep, honest and unpretentious. The worship is rich in truth, passionate and able to connect with the widely varied ages in the congregation. And the growing kids ministry has been one of the greatest blessings as our youngest has just accepted Christ as his Savior. Thankful for the presence of Crossroads in this community. Nice location. Good parking lot access close to the buildings with plenty of handicap spots. There are 3 buildings, including a banquet-type room for ladies Bible study meetings. Multi church group of ladies meet every Wed at 7pm to study the book of Amos. (Using a workbook study aid along with the Bible)

name: Crossroads Church Uptown - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
Was that to George for a wedding. Was a very nice Church. The inside design was great. Everyone was polite Curtis everything went off without a hitch.  Had a really nice courtyard for pictures. The architectural design on his side is very unique and nice 👍 Crossroads as a whole is doing powerful stuff that is positively impacting the world.

Uptown is a beautiful campus and they do a great job of making both college students and locals in the Clifton area feel welcome.

Music is always great, lights and visuals are on point, and the staff is always welcoming.

Go! and allow God to work in your life. He wants you! Outstanding people who work their. The company is work for does alot of business with them & they could not be friendlier & the all their churches are beautiful & inviting. Friendly welcoming place. Lovely architecture. You must see the courtyard strung with lights. The service was good and had good messages and well prepared. The music was inspiring. The Sunday evening service was great for students with a lot of camaraderie. Everyone was so welcoming. We left feeling uplifted and inspired for our week. Jace / Jesse / Ghost here,  I came by one day and now I go almost everyday. very nice come say hi!

name: Crossroads Community Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We were visiting our daughter and son-in-law who just moved to the area near this church for the Easter weekend. She had heard about Crossroads Church from a mom in Ladera Ranch that she met. She told us that she would love to visit Crossroads for the Easter Service as they are currently looking for a home Church. We were happy to try a new church with her! What a absolutely sweet Spirit-filled Community they have at this church! We could feel the Holy Spirit all around as we were greeted and given name badges when we showed up! We were shown to where the kids have activities rooms. Everybody we met was very interested and happy to have us there. The sermon given by the pastor was excellent! It was an Easter Service so it was all about the historicity of the Risen Christ. Pastor Kevin came over and introduced himself and chatted with us after the sermon.  If you are looking for Christ I think you will find him here waiting for you with his arms outstretched! Beautiful to fellowship. Pastor Kevin is astounding - a sincere man of God and an avid reader. Glad to have met him in person. If you happen to be in the neighborhood, you should definitely visit and fellowship. A friendly church distinctly different from most. Membership is heavily Asian and Hawaiin and they have hula
presentations on holidays. They have a wonderful vacation bible school they call KFC and Pastor Kevin delivers simple practical sermons. I cannot be happier to call Crossroads Community Church my church. It is a warm, welcoming, Christ centered church. Pastor Kevin and Theresa are wonderful caring people. Awesome church family. THE SPANISH SPEAKING SERVICES ON SUNDAYS @5PM ARE THE BEST.WITH THE PASTOR/WIFE TEAM.THANK YOU!! THE ASIAN PASTOR ON SUNDAYS IS THE BEST ALSO THANK GOD WE FINALLY FOUND A REAL CHURCH IN MISSION VIEJO CA. PEOPLE ARE VERY REAL,HAPPY AND NICE.

name: Crossroads Community Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
What an incredible feeling to be treated genuinely like family. This church is not huge, it is small enough that people take care of each other in sickness and sadness. There's always a way to serve our community here. The music isn't overwhelming like some places, but it's alive and the beat is contagious. We came to the area without knowing anyone and now I can safely say this church took us under their wings and showed us love and respect. Ms. Allison's hugs make you feel like you're the most important person in the world. She runs the children's program with her husband. The sense of unity within this church is second to none. And there's always a festival, a get together, a teacher project, or a feeding project..it is truly a family that wants to help everyone they can and bring light into a world that sometimes gets dark. I am so thankful for Crossroads Community Church. If you're looking to be welcomed and loved the way that Jesus loved and loves, this is the place for you. This is my new church home. I feel so comfortable here. I know a lot of the members.  The pastor ( Chris ) is so awesome he preaches in a way that you just get it. I redecorated my life to christ on Father's day in front of the church. Although my husband and I had a brief absence at Crossroads it is our home. Being a regular since 1994 says a lot as to how good Pastor Morris is at preaching the word of God. The praise and worship team along with it's leader Chris Bailey is outstanding.
I highly recommend Crossroads for its dedication to our youth. And today's service was branded on my heart, one I will never forget. Our teenagers performed a act that was so amazing that it brought tears to my eyes. At the end I was the first one to my feet.
I love my home Church and I highly recommend Crossroads Community Church to anyone.
Julia McGinnis The spirit of our Awesome God, His Precious Son Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit are present in this wonderful church. The music is phenomenal and the sermon fantastic. This was our first visit but we will be back. Most amazing church I mean family I could ever ask for t they love me unconditionally and they treat me like they have known me for ever and I love this family church so much
