name: Crossroads Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
A small but beautiful church teaching straight from the Bible. This is not my home church, but I have attended service here before and loved it. I had the pleasure of meeting pastor Todd, we discussed the church and its direction. I was appreciative for the time he took speaking with me (he knew I was a visitor). The preaching is encouraging and the messages are strong. This church cares about its community, you can see it on the faces of all its members and church staff. It's directly across the street from my place of employment, Thursday nights are always pooping over there. Goes to show the dedication of its members to this beautiful strong church. If you are wondering whether to come here, do it! It'll be an awesome church experience/church for you. Great job Crossroads Community Church. Pastor todd ,,speaks from the direct word of God ... I love every Sunday with them ...the spirit allways touches me in some way hear . Amen ..keep the faith...good work coming ...Amen I love you all.. My wife and I really enjoy the services. We watched Pastor Todd’s sermons on YouTube during Covid and decided to start attending in 2024. He has the rare gift of being able to break down the scriptures through scholarship, depth and clarity while at the same time, delivering a message with complete sincerity, humility and even a little humor.
We learn amazing truth from God’s word every Sunday!
The coffee and donuts are a nice treat too! Great place with friendly people. Praise team is inspiring and pastor is both funny and biblical which is not common.  This church also organizes the Easter service at college of the canyons on their football field which is pretty amazing and very well organized. This review about the conduct of the church members and the so-called "pastor" there. This church is next to my office. They apparently have an agreement with my landlord to use some of the parking spaces on Sundays or if they have some event. No issue there. But I have and pay for a reserved parking space. It is clearly marked on the asphalt and by a sign. They are not to park in any reserved spaces but they do whatever they want any way - rules don't apply to them, apparently. I've even seen them parking in the handicap spaces. Yesterday they parked in my space and when I went over to have them move. I was meet by a jerk who did nothing to find the person who parked there but instead tried to play Mr. Tough Guy even intimidate me by constantly squaring up on me. I had to tell him to back away from me many times. Turns out this jerk is the pastor there. I eventually found the guy who parked in my space by yelling "Who has the gray minivan!" and the guy moved his car. He also apologized to me. The jerk of a "pastor" never apologized or made any effort to find the person who parked in my space. He is a short guy with a big time Napoleon complex. You don't park in someone else's spot. You  don't park in handicap spots. You don't park illegally. You would think supposed "Christians" would act better. But they don't.

name: Crossroads Fellowship - Millbrook Campus - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
I have went to this church couple of times and I didn't feel the welcome there. Also, I have in the past (for a short period of time) and now attend Community Bible Study there on Thursdays. I don't feel the welcome there and as a black woman, I am being serotype. I also sense racist there. I keep asking myself why would I continue to go to a church and Bible study if I don't feel welcome there. Even when I volunteered in childcare, I was being serotype by some of the people there. I don't want to be apart of a church like that. God's presence is not there. Also, if you are a babe in Christ then this is not the Bible study for you because you will not learn anything. It's a waste of time going there for Bible study. This has been our church for close to 2 years now, and it has been transformational for me and my family. I accepted Jesus here, got baptized here, and will be continue to develop as a Christian here for many years to come. I've been working here this week cleaning up due to a fire so water and smoke damage,  but this is one huge church that is televised every Sunday morning!  They have a thrift store in the church as well. Also children will love it! I'll post a few pictures  so check it out!!! There's a huge room for the service also 2 more overflow rooms with big TV screens.  A chapel,  a kitchen , snack and drink machines,  a library,  meeting rooms a welcome center and many others! Very inviting church environment. All are welcome to come as you are to worship. Been here consistently since 2021 to 2024 and visit inconsistency since 2018/2019. Unfortunately I had to leave for reasons not listed here...

♡The positives♡
- There really is a lot to do & ways to connect outside of just listening to the sermon. I personally loved the apologetics class! 💖💜✨
- Mostly warm community! I’ve made a lot of friends and mentors there that I love dearly.
- Lots of resources (from partners). Front desk people can help find you help with one of their partnered ministries if you have a specific need.
- Solid primary beliefs from what I can tell and they were open to answer questions I had.
- They collectively give financially a lot to local ministries that help the local community. They are pretty transparent about their finances too.
- It’s very contemporary, causal dress, and like a mix between being Baptist and Pentecostal.

♡The Negatives♡
- They follow and have speakers that come from megachurches, are apart of the NAR, and big Eva. Ex: Elevation and Hillsong Church.
- When they make a mistake publicly never make a statement about it publicly… idk it's a bit odd. Ex: teaching the ennagram.
- Some of the secondary theological labels they assign themselves with they don’t always follow which is sus. Ex: saying they’re complementarian when they let women preach sermons and act as a pastor without the label of pastor.
- They have a favoritism problem. “Wolves” tend to be given influence & more 2nd chances for awful things without much real consequences… while others are given more swifter consequences for similar or even less worse actions.
- Very topical sermons and some patsors will blantly copy other pastor’s work like Pastor Daivd Guzik.
- CRF as a whole comes off very “seeker friendly” and isn't super active in helping the community in tangible ways despite having the space and money to do so. Ex: they don't like homeless cause some tend to steal, do drugs, and litter so they build stuff on the their property (like frisbee golf course) to keep people from settling there... 😐
- I don't really like how the senior pastor would sometimes talks about people (without naming) that he disagrees with randomly before the beginning of the sermon. One target, the old Youth Pastor that deconstructed made some good observations but they were completely ignored because he's deconstructed… 🙃

♡Other things to note♡
- It usually is very very cold on Sundays.
- The music is so loud they have earplugs in the back of the worship room.
- They don't seem to have to best communication with each division which makes some sense because it is a big church. It just be like that.
- Feedback can be slow. From when I was there leadership just has a lot on their plate, so I’d give them some grace.🙏🏿

I pray that whatever is going on in darkness would come to light, so CRF can grow in a spiritually healthy way. Leaving was very bittersweet and I kind of felt forgotten, but I also did benefit from being there for a season. After going here I’m a lot more cautious about the churches I attend.

name: Crossroads Fellowship - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to learn about the word of God. They teach from the bible, and it has the amenities of a larger church because they are part of crossroads fellowship in Millbrook, but they have a small church feel Feels like “home” from the moment you walk in. You won’t find a church family more welcoming or a better atmosphere to raise a family. Very friendly and welcoming but it is big so you might want to check the web site first. Also go to the welcome center, they are great. Non-denominational  between conservative Methodist and Baptist in theology, but more of a focus on helping you wherever you are ie  divorce, financial issues, etc.. Great kid program from 0 - 18! Well attended. We've been attending Crossroads Fellowship for 14 years. We helped get the Wake Forest campus up and running in 2008 I think it was. Anyway,  we live it here and have fine through a generation almost of small groups and ministry.  The people we've met and become close to will always be a reminder of how Christ lives us. Amazing place. You feel welcome from the time you pull into the parking lot until you leave. Down To earth and very active youth groups and soooi many ways to get and stay connected.

name: Crossroads Lexington - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Despite believing I was done with church, God had another plan and I’m so glad He led me to Crossroads. The teaching is presented such that I learn a lot and walk out of many services with new understanding or epiphanies. It’s a place with people who foster growth in my relationship with God and my church community. I’ve never felt more seen or loved by a church congregation or staff. I don’t have kids but I serve in Kids Club - the kids have a blast and the lessons are so good. I wrote a review that was really unfair to this local Body of Believers and had to do with a poll taken one Sunday and it centered around the revelance of the bible in their lives (those that were in attendance that particular day) and while a large percentage didn't read the bible on a daily it doesn't speak to the warmth and love shown me the few times I did attend. The worship and praise team were explosive and the messages were always timely and revelant to my "every day" life. I in no way intended the first review to be a reflection of the overall health of this church. I would definitely recommend Cross Roads to anyone seeking a bible believing church where the love of Christ is shown through the Believer's that belong....When church meets every day life you are accomplishing great things in Christ! I love my church. If you are looking for a place to feel welcome and learn about Jesus this is the place for you. It’s a come as you are service with multiple locations. The music is top notch, upbeat and lively. There is no falling asleep here. You’ll be up on your feet rocking it out showing all your love to the lord. Best Church for us. Love the Weekly message and feeling of community plus Working with the community to help out. I LOVE CROSSROADS!!!! God sent me this church and I've fallen in love with it. The groups they have to foster community, the genuine kindness they give, the openness of the leaders about their own lives and struggles. I love this place so much and I chose to join the Adult-ish group (24-34) and the last 2 Tuesdays have been phenomenal. I joined it to make friends that have three same values as me and yesterday I made 2 new friends! I love this place and the opportunities they provide. The camps, the workshops, etc. I'm just happy I found a church that's actually promoting God's word and not their opinions on God's word.

name: CrossTrail Community Church
reviewSummary:
Welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like you belong. Nice mix of all ages from young to old. Worship services well doted. Outings and community involvement /outreach/college student outreach etc was what attracted us in first place. The fact that it's not meeting in a church per se is another astuce as we believe the church should be out there, not within 4 walls. The preaching is Bible based, without shortcuts or deviations according to the world or current events, and practical which we feel is the most significant aspect. This is a wonderful church with a Holy Spirit atmosphere that hugs you as soon as you enter the building. The vibe of prayer, worship, community care and love of God is evident, and is a reflection of the leadership here. Pastor Chris's messages are Bible based, thought provoking, well presented and relevent to the Here and Now! You feel the life applications of God's word and you leave with your life's compass pointed in a better direction. A building doesn't make a church, the sincerity and love of the people do. That's what I've found to be well represented at Cross Trail; sincere love of God and love of people. I’ve lived in NC for 10 years now. I left my home church in NJ. Four years ago I visited this church. This church has become my home church. Our Pastor Chris is a Godly humble man who lives a Bible believing life along with his wife Michelle. The members of the church have become my family. Right now I am going through a very hard time and I wouldn’t know where I’d be without the support of my family church. Come visit our church. You will feel a Godly love like no other!!! At CrossTrail, I found a family. From the very first day, everyone welcomed me with kindness and made me feel at home. Pastor Chris and his wife, Michele, are wonderful leaders, and every person at CrossTrail has a unique and loving heart ♥️

Thank you for all the love, support, and for teaching me how to walk with Jesus. Being part of CrossTrail has been one of the best experiences of my life, and I will always carry this church and its people in my heart.

If you are looking for a church where you can find love, support, faith, and a true sense of family, I highly recommend the CrossTrail family. This is a very small, "hands on" type of church where almost everyone is involved in some capacity in mission work and helping the broader community. Pastor Chris's messages are often grounded with relatable anecdotes and remain topical to what's going on in the world while avoiding politics. If you're someone who believes in gentle love toward your neighbor (even when it's hard), acts of service, and a desire to grow while retaining humility, you will fit in pretty well. Connect Groups are also a great way to socialize and form friendships that will genuinely push you toward becoming a better person. I feel extremely blessed to have found this place and to be able to look back on the progress I've made in my mental, emotional, and spiritual health through the bonds I've formed over the years. Every Sunday is a highlight of my week that I look forward to.

name: Crosswalk Church - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Crosswalk Church has become my second family over the years. People from all walks of life here.  You will hear God’s word and understand how to make it applicable to your life with the sermons and connect groups. The staff and church members really do care about each individual and invest into each  others lives.
The children’s programs are AMAZING! I can’t brag enough about it! The middle school group and high school groups are outstanding also. Crosswalk Church is a great community of believers that share the love of Jesus with each other. It is a very friendly place and my family loves to worship there. We are blessed by a wonderful worship experience and a systematic teaching of the word of God. We are blessed with great teaching by all of our pastors. We have programs for all of our families including the nursery through adults. After many years away from church, I visited Crosswalk, and it quickly became my church home.

From the moment I walked through the doors, I was welcomed with genuine kindness. The people are warm, authentic, and truly make you feel like you belong.

The worship is one of my favorite parts of every service. The worship team is incredibly gifted and does a beautiful job of preparing your heart to receive God’s Word.

The preaching has been exactly what I had been searching for—biblically sound, practical, and encouraging. Senior Pastor Josh and Associate Pastors Austin and Gavin each have their own unique style, yet every message is firmly grounded in Scripture and applicable to everyday life. Every week I leave feeling challenged, encouraged, and strengthened in my faith.

I’ve also been blessed by the Connect Groups, especially the classes taught by Ron Creech, Jeanna Murray, and Carol Castillo. They have helped me grow spiritually while building meaningful friendships.

The café before service is another wonderful aspect that I love. It’s a great place to enjoy coffee, homemade treats, and conversation with new people and friends. The women’s ministry is outstanding, and the church offers many opportunities to serve both inside the church and throughout the community. Although I don’t have children, my friends consistently praise the children’s and student ministries.

After spending many years without a church home, I am so thankful God led me to Crosswalk. The leadership is faith filled, grounded in truth.

If you’re looking for a church where the Bible is faithfully taught, worship is Christ-centered, and people sincerely love one another, I highly recommend visiting. It has been a tremendous blessing in my life, and I believe it could be in yours as well. Solid biblical teaching, friendly people, and a great place for kids and youth to grow in their relationship with Jesus and with peers! Crosswalk is where believers become disciples. If you are looking for a church that teaches sound doctrine, biblical principles, and also provides historical context into a sermon, this is your home. This is where the Body of Christ is being fed. Not only is every sermon educational and edifying, the Spirit of the Lord is present within the building and within the hearts of leadership and the church community. This is the first time I’ve been involved in fellowship and there are not enough stars to rate the women’s ministry! My only qualm is that my and Sarah’s team won trivia night several times and were robbed of our championship title. I am currently engulfing myself with the titles of children’s movies and learning as much as I can about the animal kingdom to prepare for next year. Vengeance is mine.  Also, the snacks are good. 10/10 recommend!

name: Crosswalk Church - Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my home church. Learning to love well here has been such a life giving journey. You are welcome here! I have been a Member in Crosswalk Church in Redlands California myself, for over 5 years.  I can confidently say that Crosswalk Church is an exceptional church that truly exemplifies the love of God.  We have 3 weakly in person church service every Saturday starting at 9:00 AM, 10:30 AM, and 12:00 PM.  Kids church also meet at 10:30 AM.  Youngsters, teens, and young adults also have meetings Saturdays and other days of the week.  Weekly homeless feeding every Thursday night, and Medical, Chiropractic, PT, Dental, Occupational therapy, and other free services are also offered.

One of the most striking features of Crosswalk Church is the warm and welcoming environment that greets visitors as they step into the church. The church is known for its inclusivity and its emphasis on making everyone feel like a part of the family. The congregation is made up of people from all walks of life, and the church actively works to create a sense of community and belonging.

The service production at Crosswalk Church is also incredibly professional. The church invests heavily in technology and media to create a high-quality worship experience. The church also has a strong emphasis on music, with a talented team of musicians leading the congregation in worship.

Perhaps the most impressive aspect of Crosswalk Church, however, is the way in which it embodies the love of God. Members of the congregation speak highly of the way in which the church consistently demonstrates compassion and care towards those in need. The church is active in the local community, reaching out to those who are struggling and offering support and encouragement.

Overall, Crosswalk Church is a church that is deeply committed to sharing the love of God with those around them. The church's focus on community, inclusivity, and professional service production, along with its friendly and welcoming atmosphere, make it an excellent place to worship and grow in faith. I would highly recommend Crosswalk Church to anyone looking for a church home in the Redlands area.

We do church different here, give yourself a chance to connect with Jesus one more time. Great place! The atmosphere is not like other churches I have been to. They serve free coffee at the cafe in the lobby, and people were really friendly and welcoming. Great experience and I'll for sure be back as much as I can! Great place to worship ! The pastor Andreas Baccai is very thorough in his teaching and delivering the message to all! No political agenda spewed from the stage or parishioners, people were genuinely friendly and respectful and free coffee is served in the lobby ! Was invited by my daughter and son in law who regularly attend I think we found a place that feels like home ! Have been attending this church almost my entire life. I can confidently say this is one of the best churches I've ever gone to. The community is incredibly inclusive, loving, and warm. There are many ministries for many stages of life, cultures, and so on. This includes the Women's, Hispanic, Children's, Junior High, High school, and so on.

Truly, an amazing church that I am happy to see grow to such blessings.
Pastor Tim has done an exceptional job in leading people to god, and helping people come closer to him.

name: Crosswalk Community Church: A Progressive Alternative - Napa Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been members for 15 years. If you expect church to be narrow minded, legalistic and to worship the Bible you will be surprised that CrossWalk checks none of those boxes. While the oldest Baptist church in Napa, (American Baptist, as in MLK's affiliation) founded in 1860, it is not stuck defending antiquated culture. It is egalitarian with women in pastoral roles, leadership and teaching positions. It is LGBTQ welcoming and fully affirming with members of that community participating in leadership. We also have outstanding teaching from toddlers through Middle School. Pastor Peter Shaw's teaching is intellectually challenging but emphasizes spiritual and meditative practices as well. It is a very relaxed, come as you are atmosphere full of real people. People of other faith practices are welcome here. Services at 9 and 10 AM.
We believe following Jesus also means serving the community in a sacrificial way. We host 40+ recovery groups on a weekly basis. Our parking lot is almost always busy. We operate a food pantry and supply food and cooking essentials to people moving off the street and into safe housing. We also work with other churches to feed unhoused people in Napa on the weekend. We provide space on our large campus for non-profits such as citizenship clinics and immigration legal aid. Our gym is used by schools, clubs and sports leagues.
Crosswalk is the first Emergency shelter to open and the last to close. Fifteen minutes and we can open the doors. During the recent earthquake and fires we housed evacuees and were an information hub. We are currently remodeling our large but antiquated kitchen to modern standards so as to be able to provide meals. The bathrooms and gym showers have been upgraded to ADA standards to better serve everyone.
Come experience CrossWalk. Instead of higher walls, we make bigger tables. Used as a reception hall for our visit.  Clean, easy access.   Bathroom clean and well stocked. It was less church and more town hall meeting meets poetry night at a coffee house. I appreciate the message and sentiment but I go to church for communion with God not someone else's sexuality. That is none of my business. Great concept bad execution. And also, spring for a band, that karaoke nonsense was laughable. I'm an extremely progressive and bible-dubious "Christian" who mostly wonders whether I can reconcile my inclusive beliefs with a religion now too often wrapped up in hatred and bigotry. I was skeptical about CrossWalk, and I was completely wrong. This is a wildly progressive church (YES, in Napa!), full of amazing quirky individuals, an incredibly frank and vulnerable pastor, a fabulous kids' ministry, and an open and relational theology that has made me feel excited about spirituality again. Don't judge the book by its cover; come eat a donut some Sunday soon and see for yourself. I'm thinking of attending church here on Sunday. I've met some great people in my neighborhood but crosswalk takes the cake. Come anytime a see for yourself. They give out food boxes an clothing. Ive attended a meeting or two here. Another great place to be when you want to hear a good word be in the company of loving an caring people please feel free to stop by, and give me a shout out! Kreektyme!!

name: Current - A Christian Church - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
The singing is awful. The worship pastor Andrew is so terrible that everytime they begin singing it is the boldest display of heresy I have ever seen in my life. He never allows other male singers to even be heard. Everything else is OK but something needs to be done about that man. Everyone knows his singing bites and that’s the reason why so many members of the congregation are running for the hills to Venture Church to escape from this mockery of worship and music as a whole. The other singers are alright and the instrument players, especially the electric guitarists, are extremely talented and deserve to be able to display their talents where they won’t be overpowered by him. Absolutely disappointing. Current Church in Katy has some of the best soccer fields in the area! Well-maintained grass, plenty of space, and a clean, family-friendly environment. The kids love playing here and there’s always a great community vibe. Perfect spot for practices and games! Very beautiful and very spiritual. You feel it as soon as you walk in. It's a modern church, with an old school feel. I have been looking for a home Church in my area and had started attending this church about a month ago. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and the pastor is usually on point, for the most part, but the lackluster Praise and Worship team just kills the vibe every time!. It seems like they are afraid to sing popular or upbeat praise songs and choose to highlight tune-less, far-fetched, unknown songs that are never uplifting to the spirit.
I attended the highly promoted event for Christmas on December 23rd and brought 6 people with me to the 8pm service. Expected to hear the popular Christmas songs that bring joy to the heart, only heard 3, out of possibly 10 that were sung. Instead we heard strange, unrecognizable Christmas songs that seem to have been made up by the Praise team. Chosen songs were very  slow, boring, nothing we could sing along to.  Because we could not participate in the singing, we felt no joy in the celebration, no happiness in being there.
Music is a big part of worshiping God .. it revives the spirit. and He expects us to make a Joyful Noise, especially for the birth of his Son.  Sadly this was not the case. Poor singing coupled with what should have been a "Good Friday" sermon about being God's enemy if we don't follow him, left us feeling empty and  very disappointed. We expected more from a celebration of the most important event in history.
I'm still looking for a home Church, hoped this was it, but realized I have to keep looking. This is a great church! We have been attending for about 8 years and they are very friendly and make you feel like family. They also have children church and services for teens. They also help in the community and serve many mission trips around the world.

name: Currey Creek Church
reviewSummary: I didn’t really get along well with the crowd here. To me, the sermons sounded more like self help speeches than sermons. I probably won’t come back. I'm grateful for Curry Creek, which my family and I have been attending for 5 years.  I have seen the pastoral staff, led by John Free, remain focused on the Gospel.  The expository teaching is wonderful. This has been our church home for over 5 years now and the biblical truth that is taught is amazing! If you are looking to go deeper into your faith walk than this is the place to be. If you are looking to start your walk or just have, then you are also in the right place!! It has been along time since I heard a pastor  preach and is a exegesis. Very excited to hear more.  Most preach feel good inspirational sermons that is not Christ lead.  Thank you for going the distance and not caving in to what society  wants to hear. I've attended the services over the last year during Covid. I was looking for a church that had in house services. They've been really nice and friendly and I've enjoyed the sermons from Pastor John. This guy can preach! There are times when the whole congregation is totally mute. Very poignant messages that get through to the heart of the believer. If you're new to Boerne and looking for a church home that won't just make you feel good about being a Christian, but will convict you to appreciate what Jesus did on the cross, then this church is worth looking into.

name: Cutten Community Church - Eureka Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I were praying to find a church like this in Humboldt County and upon our first visit, we were welcomed in with so much love and warmth from the church family. This is the best church I have been to and the pastor is really caring and his wife too Fantastic pastor and a loving congregation. Great place to worship. Come and worship God here too!!

name: Cy-Fair church of Christ - Cypress Campus
reviewSummary: A great church to meet with.  I have known them for 45 years. They are friendly, and they know the Bible well. A friendly place to worship God. A group of Christians striving to teach and follow God's word. Excellent church.  Very welcoming. name: CyLife Church - Cypress Campus
reviewSummary: CyLife church has been such a blessing on my life and my family’s lives. We find truth being spoken there no matter what the world says. reviewSummary:

name: Cypress Creek Christian Church - Spring Campus
reviewSummary:
Today I took my children to the Easter event because one of the church members invited us. I appreciate everyone's hospitality, although I ended up feeling a bit disappointed. I have an 8-year-old daughter who was very excited to get her face painted; she stood in line for about an hour and was the second-to-last person in the queue. When her turn finally arrived, she was passed over, and the person behind her—who was accompanied by an adult—was served instead. In the end, they refused to do anything for her; she only wanted a little bunny nose and some whiskers painted on her face. She left feeling very sad and in tears... At the very least, they should have told her beforehand that they wouldn't be able to do it. It didn't seem fair to me that they ignored her in that manner; she is just a child. She missed out on the opportunity to participate in all the other activities because she spent all that time standing there, only to be cast aside at the end so that other people could be served. This is a great church! The people are wonderful and loving. Very LGBTQ friendly my wife and I feel Affirmed and welcomed with open arms We have our school graduation ceremony here in the forum building and have for the past few years. The facilities are excellent and everyone working here is an absolute joy to be around. I used to stress about graduation until we started coming here. This place is so awesome I don’t feel any stress. This church family changed my life.  I was Baptized here last week at the age of 46, in fact, and I cannot imagine anywhere else I'd have wanted that moment with God to occur.  They LOVE EVERYONE.  They don't just say they do, THEY DO.  Everyone, from every walk of life, is not only welcomed... but truly loved for who they are.  Reverends Bruce, Paula, and Mariah are a Dream Team.  I could write hundreds of more words about this church family, but you'd get bored and stop reading.  LOL.  Trust me, if you need to find a place to truly nurture your relationship with God... or even help you find one in the first place... this is it.  I didn't trust anyone when I arrived, and wasn't sure where I was with my faith.  After the first visit, my family knew it was where we needed to be.  Within a month, I couldn't imagine being anywhere else.  God blessed our family by sending us here. My wife and I have been members  for over 30 years. First with Glenn Wilkerson as pastor and now with Bruce Frogge.  Both are excellent ministers and men of God. We also have a caring group of lay ministers and others  who strive to show the love of Christ and God the Father.
The people who make up this church family are some of the most caring; compassionate and loving people I have ever met and mean the world to me and my family.

name: DAYSPRING Church - Pelham Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I visited Dayspring Church in Pelham, Alabama last Sunday, and we truly felt like our prayers had been answered.

We were visiting from out of town because we are looking to relocate and retire in the Pelham area. We had been praying not only for the right place to live, but also for the right church home. Finding a church home is not easy for most people, but I can tell you this: God is so good, and He answered us.

The first church we pulled up to had only one car in the parking lot. Out of respect for that church, I will not mention the name, but we were uncertain if there was a service or if it was the right place for us. So we quickly looked online and found Dayspring. It was only about a five-minute drive away, and we were hurrying because we knew the service was about to begin.

As soon as we pulled up and parked, we saw more cars. When we got out, the door opened wide and a young man greeted us warmly. As we walked in, we were welcomed by Diamond at the front desk. What a beautiful smile she had. The warmth was felt immediately as we crossed the doorstep.

We walked down the short hallway into the main worship room and found our seats. As we came in, we were met with smiles and kind words: “Welcome,” “Thank you so much for coming today,” and “How are you?” We were not sure what to expect or where to go, but God led us to a place we now know will be our church home when we finally make our move to Pelham.

What you will find at Dayspring is an incredible pastor and wife, along with a warm, welcoming, wonderful congregation. It felt like we had found family — brothers and sisters in Christ. When you come here, you will not feel like a number. You will not feel like an outsider. You will feel like part of a community, part of a family, and part of something greater as this church continues to grow.

Pastor Tye and Rhonda were gracious enough to walk us around and show us the different rooms, spaces, and plans for future growth. The next morning, we went to breakfast together and continued our conversation. It was so comfortable — no awkwardness, no trying to force conversation, just beautiful fellowship between two couples who love the Lord.

I did not want to mention this in the beginning, but my husband and I are a white couple, and we have never felt this much love before in any church we have been in. God does not see color. He does not see race. He does not see financial demographics. He sees the heart. We are all wanting the same thing: to worship a God who loves us all, who is our Father in heaven, and who created us all. In this place, God’s love rises above all of those things.

If you have been looking for a place where you feel that the person sitting next to you, across from you, or standing at the pulpit truly sees your heart and loves you with the love of God, this is the place for you. Here, you will feel like you are part of something. Here, you will feel the family you have been looking for. Here, you will feel something different — that you are part of God’s Kingdom, and together we stand unified in Christ Jesus.

Thank you so much to Pastor Tye and Rhonda. We were so blessed by both of you and by your congregation. We were blessed by the friendliness, the welcoming spirit, the worship, the teaching, and the fellowship. We are so looking forward to being part of the weekly services when we move.

Thank you so much, and God bless. Had a wonderful time at Day Spring Church! The message was uplifting, and everyone I met was so warm and welcoming. Truly a blessed experience being in such a friendly and engaging church! I LOVE THIS CHURCH! I visited for the first time on 19 Oct 2025. The pastor and his wife are two beautiful people led by God and it evident in their ministry. I felt very welcomed by the congregation and the message delivered was an on time word. A remarkable Pastor with an exceptional sense of church spirit. Great Church!! Have been blessed to attend here as well as the FIYA Conference and love it so far!

name: Daystar Church - Madison - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary: Oh my goodness, we are in love with this church.  God is very present through her people, her pastors and the worship.  They just recently opened their brand new campus here in Madison, literally 2 miles from our home.  We were serving in a nearby church (another county) but felt we needed to be serving the people in our own community.  Moving churches is not for the faint of heart, it is a big deal (to us anyways) and we wanted to make sure God was present before making that leap.  This is HOME for sure.  God will do enormously great things through this Madison Campus. We Love Daystar Church! We had not been to church for 2-3 years for various reasons. We wanted to go back to church but didn't know where to go. An invitation to Daystar Church arrived in the mail so we decided to check it out. It would be the first Sunday service in Madison. We were so glad we did. We have been at Daystar since that first service 3 years ago. If you are looking for a "judgment free" church you will find it at Daystar. You can come as you are. No matter what you wear or who you are or what you believe you will be loved and welcomed at Daystar. Our mission statement is simple-Community transformation through the love and power of Jesus Christ- and that is what we live by. The Pastors and staff are awesome. The children's ministry is also GREAT! If you are looking for a place that your children can have fun and learn about the love of Jesus then come and check us out, like us you may never leave! My family and I love Daystar Church in Madison. As a military family we moved around every 2-3 years and having to find a church to fit into can be challenging. Daystar was great from the beginning. The mobile site allowed us to watch the message before we even moved. Everyone is welcoming and we leave every Sunday feeling uplifted to be better people to ourselves and the community. I recommend that anyone looking for a church stop in at Daystar in Madison, it truly is a great experience. I LOVE Daystar Church in Madison. I felt Loved the second I walked in the doors and have never once felt judged. Pastors Eli and Cody are Awesome. The Children’s Ministry is Incredible. Today our children need to hear about God’s Love more now than ever. With the 32 acres we’ve purchased off of Martin Road I look for our Church to be a Shining Light in the community. I love Daystar Church!  I have grown so much spiritually over the past 2 years.  Since becoming a member, all my children have received Christ!  My family is growing in Christ and so am I!  Every time I walk the doors I feel welcomed and loved!  I don't get lost in the crowd.  The pastor and his family know me by name and pray for me!  I am truly not just another face in the crowd.  I am a member of this church and I know I am part of a family making an impact for Christ on a daily basis!

reviewSummary: What a great idea to witness to the community and visitors. Preaches the Word of God. Great sermon. Attended for the free outdoor movies they have annually. Great event, excellent atmosphere, plenty of space to park, good view of the screen. Good choice for family time. Great church, very friendly and helpful people, short services packed with worship and powerful, contemporary messages, and coffee and Krispy Kreme doughnuts available before and after each service (8:30 am and 10 am Sundays). So welcoming and a fun option.  We were greeted with a warm welcome and invited into the friendship hall for coffee, tea and donuts before the service. Easy to get in and out.  Communion was shared. Enjoy this church immensely. Attend in you car or sit in the chaple or friendship hall,which is phenomenal. Great people and activities and missions. Very pleased with my experience here

name: Decatur City Church - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up attending a traditional Lutheran church and was turned off of church as a teenager. Upon moving to Atlanta I started attending Buckhead Church and grew to enjoy Andy Stanley sermons. Post Covid, I moved a little further out and got out of the habit of going to church. I started attending Decatur City occasionally. Eventually, I chose to volunteer and they were super welcoming. It has become a second family. This church specifically is much smaller than some of the other Northpoint churches. It gives you that smaller community church feeling while still giving you the options of the larger church. If you were looking for a small group, this is a great place to go. If you were looking for options for children and teens, this is a great church to go to. I love that they regularly have programs to engage people at all levels and frequently lean into sermons that are meant to engage non-believers. If you’re looking for a traditional service, this probably is not the best place, but I would give it a chance because you might be intrigued by something new. These videos are from a small Service they did to celebrate their volunteers recently during Christmas. They go all out with their decorations. This chuch is welcoming, kind and supportive. It actively engages with local needs and lets each attendee seek God at their own pace. The kid programming is second to none. Hands down, the best! Enjoyed visiting here. It is a contemporary worship service in a smaller church setting which is a nice mix. They have live music, but stream the sermon (this is a North Point Ministries church). The only thing is parking can be somewhat of a challenge if you're not familiar where to go, but the traffic is definitely much less than that at larger nearby churches. North Point community church with in unique venue. Traditional pews and pipe organ, but renovated with a modern touch. Music production rivals major concerts. Children’s area is first class and very clean and safe. Volunteers are amazing! I have attended Northpoint ministries since 2003 and have attended three different campuses during that time. I started attending the Decatur City Church Nov 21. More artsy people live in this area of town. And I commend the leadership in using these talented people in worship. It is nice to be in a smaller campus than the other locations.

I especially like that it is non denominational. People of all backgrounds are welcomed here. And they can get involved and serve without having to become a member. Some roles do require membership.

Music is designed to appeal to young people. I love the preaching. And I have learned to appreciate the music. But I support the mission of the church to appeal to youths. And the music is the first point of interest for the young.

I have written what I have written in response to some of the reviews. No church will or even can appeal to everyone. A couple of the reviews didn’t understand what this church is about. I could write a book on all the things I love about this church. I selected these few things to help enlighten you on a few misunderstood ideas and practices.

Randall
