name: Decatur First United Methodist Church - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary: Our spiritual home for the last 4 years, there are so many good things to say about this community of believers. We love Decatur First, the congregation, the staff, and the vision to create the Beloved community. I am just disgusted with the treatment here. My son got expelled because he wrote a paragraph kinda raunchy note to a girl he liked. Mind you this is preschool so what we should have been focusing on is the fact that a tiny person wrote near perfect with minor grammatical errors a understandable note. With no help. Sure I'm a little freaky myself but not freaky enough to help my mini me write a sexy note. Hell I should have gotten free tuition. LEts see what my nephew does when he finds out. Lmao What a great community!  It is wonderful to be a part of such an open, friendly and active church.  I am the children’s ministries director and love working with so many incredible volunteers to provide faith formation for kids! My son attended preschool for three years here, and we were always more than pleased with everything.  The current staff and administration is superb when caring for my child.  I honestly get that this preschool was a gift from above when going through certain things.  Highly recommended. My grandson attends Preschool here.  The staff makes you feel like your child is the most special ever. Very positive atmosphere that is warm and happy.

name: Deeper Life Bible Church, Hudson, Ohio - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary:
A Christian community where love is seen, felt, and experienced in all services.
This is where all spiritual needs are met, and God is being worshipped in spirit and in truth.

I highly recommend attending one of the Sunday services, and I am promising you that your life will never remain the same again! This is an awesome place of worship. It isn't just a church, but indeed a family of God's people where every member is treated with love and respect. It's fondly called the Church of Champions - where champions and pacesetters are raised. It is also a solution center. We are open to and look forward to seeing more people from the Hudson community.

Heaven is the only goal. Great place of worship! You can't afford to miss the word, worship, the wonder! This a home away from home. My spiritual life gets refreshed and nurtured. The sermons are what I need to get to heaven as a Christian.

Spacious parking lots are also available and a conducive atmosphere An awesome place of worship. You should all check it out.

name: DeerCreek Community Church - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary: I feel very welcomed in this close community of believers. I feel challenged and encouraged to grow closer to God.

name: Deliverance Christian Church Of Stark County Ohio - Canton Campus
reviewSummary: Great Community CHRISTmas Gathering! The children loved it! They received lots of gifts! I recommend anyone that would like to donate to this place , would really bless many children! I  enjoyed just helping another family have a great CHRISTmas! They always need someone that has a heart to give! Real nice church that cares about their community! Love it Very helpful God is Good

name: Denton Bible Church - Denton Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely fire. If you’re looking for rich messages and a biblically sound and peaceful community of believers, you just found em, my friend!!! So the secretary at this church.Let me know if they help people, they wouldn't be able to afford their own bills, if they help assist people.I was passing through with my family, and I asked them to help me.So I can get back home with anything.And they let me know they cannot help people. Large church where we attended a funeral and forgot which of the doors we came in.
Very nice Christmas nativity scenes inside. Volunteers were there in abundance. I visited Denton Bible Church with friends on Christmas Eve.  The service was beautiful.  I addition to the choir was an orchestra.  Later I learned that the orchestra and choir are at all of the services. Large church with ample everything but judging by the eulogy given by the Pastor for my friend I would say if you are in the area, this is your new home church.

name: Denton Christian Church - Denton Campus
reviewSummary:
Thanksgiving season is upon us. Come and give thanks to a glorious GOD with like minded believers in Denton. This is a welcoming church with plenty of opportunities for fellowship and service. Highly recommended. For so long I searched for a small community church and I am truly blessed to have found Denton Christian Church. This is a wonderful church that I attend with my family. If you are looking to strengthen your personal relationship with Christ this church is the perfect place to do so. All walks of life are welcome and they are happy to share the gospel with anyone who is ready to receive the good news. A friendly place to worship & fellowship with God's loved ones. I loved my visit
So friendly
Interactive Everyone is welcome. The Word is preached.

name: Denver Church of Christ (Aurora Campus) - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone I've ever encountered through this church has been so nice and welcoming. They seem like they're a big family, inclusive, and encouraging. I don't go weekly because I don't live in Colorado, but I attend sometimes when I come back to visit, and watch online. I know there are other pastors and campuses, but I've seen Rick Ramunno preach several times and he so relatable, down to earth, and teaches practical biblical messages. Go check it out! Awesome church, having a great experience of it, everyone there are really open and friendly This church community is near and dear to my heart. I noticed my first time to a Sunday service how genuine, welcoming and supportive the church is to each other. I love that it is a part of each service to give church members an opportunity to share something about their journey with God and a scripture that relates to what they are sharing.
I grew up in the “Bible belt” and attended a number of churches and this is the 1st time I’ve experienced this.
Also, I see and can have confidence that I have a whole family of support on life long journey with Jesus. Our devotional group huge part of it as well. We connect at least twice a month and it really is an important part of staying connected.
They are there for me, good, bad or ugly!
This is my church home! 💕 Such an amazing church to be apart of. Everyone is welcoming and loving! I love being here on Sundays and apart of a small group during the week. Doing life with other faithful christians is so helpful for my own walk with God! Wow, the best church I have ever been to. I have been going there for over 30 years and I will continue to go there. They're teaching on the scripture, relationships, and example in how to live your life has always inspired me. If you're reading this and you've never been, it is worth atleast one visit. You'll probably want to come back but atleast one visit.

name: Denver Community Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. Instead of sermons on random topics, they go through each book of the Bible, a few verses each week, and then they make it relevant to our modern lives. I've not seen a church do that before.

The worship music is all live and they have some great singers. The building is beautiful, and the people are welcoming. Plus if you want to feel more "plugged in", there's an active men's group, lady's group and LGBTQ group that you can participate in. Always loved this church. They evidently no longer know who they are. Unless todays service was a fluke, I will never be back. This is such a beautiful church. The architecture, the stained glass windows... It is absolutely beautiful.  Great walk but lots of closures on the streets recently due to contractions that seem to be never ending.
The church has to put fencing around the building itself-which is a bummer; Realizing that many of our historical, cultural and religious places of worship are actually under threat from being completely TRASHED, due to lack of respect and possibly proper healthcare to those that walk the streets below. It's saddening.
I pray that someday we find a way to make our streets safer,  we take care of the space we all inhabit, and people start to Love Thy Neighbors otherwise. Great walk and beautiful church- all the while. Unfriendly to newcomers. Group leader excluded me from a decision for a needed hiatus that benefited the group, excluded me from the results, and only let me know when I asked half an hour before the cancelled session. Did not check up on me as work and recovery from cancer kept me from service and gatherings after the hiatus was over. My family and I have attended Denver Community Church off and on for about ten years, and we recently decided to return to see if it was still a good fit for us. Unfortunately, it no longer feels like the same church we once knew. In our experience, the messages seem to focus more on promoting certain viewpoints than on teaching directly from God’s word. This may work for some people, but it no longer aligns with what our family is looking for in a church.

name: Denver Friends Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has truly become home for me. I started attending before joining staff, and what kept me here was the people. There’s a genuine sense of community, care, and desire to follow Jesus together. I’m thankful for the ways this church has supported and encouraged me through different seasons of life. We enjoy this church, they allow you to be as involved as you would like.  You can come and just worship on Sunday morning or you can be involved in children's activities. They will pray for any of your requests without knowing who they are praying for just as they pray for someone they have known for 50 years. I love this church
It lives up to its name. They are very friendly and caring people. I have been going to church here since 2005. But lately I have missed a whole lot of services because I live in Thornton and not Denver anymore. No ride. My first experience with the church and I have to say they are very nice people. It is a small congregation and they made my husband and I feel very welcomed. Thank you This is a good place to come to, to hear the Good News of Jesus Christ taught and preached. It's a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Denver United Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church in the Denver area. I've been coming here since March this year. I'm new to Denver, Colorado and I've never felt at home at a church like I do here. I feel so blessed to call this home and the people there my extended family. They make me feel so loved and welcome. With the loss of both of my parents fairly recent this is exactly what I need. Thank you for being the hands and feet of Jesus and I'm thankful I've been given the opportunity to do such as well. Thanks DU Family. Sweet and warm. They are paper cups free so don't forget to bring your mugs to have some good coffee and tea. :) Nice warm and lovely church and people. Very good music. Except for the lady who rudely asked if she could help me in a very condescending way as though I was not just in the church for three hours. I was in my car for approximately 2 minutes texting my fiance. When a volunteer of the church came up to me in the most non Christian unfriendly unbelievable way possible. Jesus would NEVER do that.
But this is a great church otherwise. Well chosen worship team, theology is solid, free bagels & coffee. Clean, well maintained with free parking. Great people, small groups, and young adult groups.

name: Des Moines Christian Church
reviewSummary:
This is a great Bible-based church with sermons that touch your heart, a wonderful worship service, and meaningful fellowship.  There are great classes for the kids where bible lessons are taught at age appropriate levels.  Diverse group of believers of all ages, races, and backgrounds.  Something for Campus, Singles and Marrieds.  Worth checking out!!! I feel so blessed to be apart of an actual family of bible-believing and practicing disciples whom not only meet during churchwide gatherings, but even strive to build the one another relationships described in the Bible. It’s also cool to see Acts 2:42 lived out. People keep it real and strive for repentance, thus making me feel safe to be vulnerable. The Spirit is alive and evident.  The sermons are inspiring, yet challenging - addressing the heart and pointing to Jesus. Discipleship is practiced. Worship is of vertical praise. What’s more, this church is part of an even larger international group, where disciples connect on a global scale. I can attest to this after having visited my brothers and sisters in India, Canada, Romania, Isreal and the Philippines! Absolutely thankful to DADDY GOD for the Kingdom!! This is an amazing church! I have been a member for over 25 years. There is diversity and unity among all the members and visitors. The friendships are wonderful helping each other to be more like Jesus. Come and join us for service! This church is very personal, from the time you enter there is a lot of support and love in this place. The teachings are from the bible and my family learns something each time we go. This a family place to learn, grow, and share in the mission of Christ. Been coming here for just over 3 years. It's a group of people devoted to each other and loving each other when the loving gets hard. Theres a lot of emphasis on evangelizing and having 1:1 relationships. If you're looking for a friendly place to 'hang your hat' I'd try this one.

God will definitely show up!

name: Desert Bible Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: The teaching at this church is solid and consistently true to the Bible. I have found the messages to be deeply rooted in scripture and very impactful. Excellent church in Scottsdale AZ rooted in scripture and solid Biblical teaching. Nice small church that isn’t focused on all the showy stuff and is passionate about teaching the Word of God. If you’re looking for a great church in Scottsdale I’d highly recommend Desert Bible Church. You sit there while one man monologues about his thoughts for an eternity. True biblical teaching! This is a wonderful community of people banded together by the love of Jesus and the truth of His Word. You will find a warm welcome here inspired by the love of Jesus for people just like you!

name: Desert City Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
A church that preaches the gospel and cares for its community.

We've been attending for a little over a year, and we've loved it since the first Sunday we visited. The church staff and congregation truly care about you. This has been a place of rest for me and my family.

There are a lot of positive words to describe Desert City, but "authentic" may be the one that best describes it for me. There's no show or big production, just authentic believers who love Jesus and are living out their faith.

The music and preaching are excellent.

They have amazing kids and youth programs and our kids were immediately plugged in.

I would highly recommend a visit, whether you grew up in the church or have never stepped inside one! My wife and I started attending back in September after moving to Phoenix. We told ourselves we'd try a handful of churches with Desert City being the first one we'd visit. We are SO glad that God led us to this church and community. We've felt welcomed and a part of the community from the first week we attended. We're in our mid twenties with no kids yet, which is usually a tough age range to find a church, but we've found a place that is truly for every generation and walk of life. The bible is read from every service and DCC does a great job keeping things simple and sacred. We are so grateful to have found this church and I hope that this review can help anyone who may be interested in attending. Our first time here. Very friendly and not just staff. Enjoyed the message and worship time. Music wasn't loud or flashy, as has been our experience at other places of worship. Definitely Christ centered in all the aspects we experienced. Long time friends had invited us and glad they did. My husband and I started going to Desert City in May. We have loved the sermons and the community of people. Every Sunday it is a consistent welcoming and peaceful experience. Desert City Church is an amazing place to worship God and study the Scriptures. The Pastoral leadership makes the Word of God come to life.
They witness to the power and love of Christ in our lives.  The Blessings I receive here are comforting and encouraging..

name: Desert Hills Bible Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Churchgoer Warning!

This church has all the hallmarks of a good church - theologically sound preaching and great music, nice people, lots of activities for all ages, etc.

If you should choose to attend, do not ever ask for guidance or help, ask questions, respectfully disagree on secondary matters, or bring any dispute issue to the elders. They will do everything possible to have an appearance of church unity, using their position of authority and twisting scripture to require meek compliance or expulsion.

True shepherds do not wound the very sheep they are supposed to care for and protect. This is home. Solid soil to plant your feet in the Word of God and grow. The leaders follow the Word and use wisdom for the people here to grow in Christ alone.

It’s not about numbers, it’s about conversions to Christ. That’s a church I want to grow in unity with my family of God.

I thank the Lord for His will being done through Desert Hills and pray you come here as well to enjoy the fruits of the Spirit. Stay away from the elders at this church. Oh and the Stallard’s. Stay away from anything related to them. Take it from me that no one will actually care for you when you actually need it. In fact they might just kick you out cause it’s easier for them. And forget about “biblically grounded”. As long as it’s easier for the elders, they’ll justify it “biblically” somehow. Seriously, do yourself a favor and run. It's been very hard to find a church. One of the most common issues is churches that preach feel good sermons. I'm pretty tired of searching but I have teens that need to hear truth. I've only been to 2 services but I've listened to 7 online. I DO believe healing is today because God healed my kidneys after an evangelist called me forward 14 years ago. Also, I had severe back issues that needed surgery. I also went forward for prayer and God healed me. That also, is rare to find these days. However, being Arizona is starved of sermons filled with both truth and grace, I'll take this any day. This church is rare. I've always desired to go to John MacArthurs church and this is a lot like it. I don't think they believe in gifts of today, which I very much do, but being so many churches abuse this and dabble in new age practices, I am CAREFUL. So far I have loved the sermons. I realize I will never find the perfect Acts church but this is pretty darn awesome and I'm grateful, so grateful, to hear truth. If you’re a person of color don’t come to this church. They’re very racist . The made me feel so uncomfortable. As soon as I arrived they asked for my papers and they assumed I didn’t speak English. This is unacceptable. Church is supposed to feel welcoming. When I was there I felt so unsafe. This place is terrible and racist. Do better.

name: Desert Springs Bible Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been going to this church since I moved to Phoenix, AZ. The head pastor Caleb Campbell is phenomenal  and the kids' Sunday school center is amazing. It goes all the way up from infants to college. Each of the age groups are separated out. All in all, an amazing church for the study of the Lord God and Christ Savior. Wife an I love this church ..we've visited here a few times while visiting phoenix..we know god has us a calling to this church.. trying to wait patiently on god to help us move from Tennessee to scottsdale to start our next chapter in our walk jesus ..love yall god bless Been going here since Covid because all other churches shut down, my son also went here for pre school we’ve never had any issue there we love DSBC also pastor caleb does a great job Great church with a great environment. I am apart of the teen program and am very proud to say they have help me in my hard times. They are very supportive and kind. We were looking for a new church home after 25 years at our previous church. After visiting several churches, we felt at home at Desert Springs right away.
Bible teaching, fellowship, awesome worship music, friendly people. Diverse and inclusive. We love DSBC. Highly recommend! ❤️

name: Desert Valley Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
We love the Pastor Dwain and his family. We had such a warm and loving welcome the second we walked into the church. The staff and volunteers love as if you are their family. The people who attend church are all so very friendly and caring. The service is great! The Pastor has a sense of humor and keeps the attention of the congregation. During each service, I learn so much about God and what the scripture means and how we can apply it to our lives. My spiritual walk with the Lord has grown so much since attending this wonderful church. Thank you Desert Valley Church. Love this church!! Pastor Dwain makes the Bible come alive!  He only teaches what the Bible says.  No twists and turns trying to make God's word fit the masses.  Awesome praise and worship team, too.  Everyone is loving  welcoming, and friendly....one church family.  Please drop by one Sunday and join us.  We'd love to meet you. Rev. Dwain & Debbie Peregrym are so incredibly kind & welcoming! Love them! They are truly wonderful people.

They have an amazingly talented crew for the live band music during worship! They sing your favorite Contemporary Christian jams so you can sing along too, it's like you're at an awesome concert! Drummer, guitarist, keyboard, and multiple stellar singers who will have you feeling those good kind of goosebumps!

They really do a great job of making you feel welcome as a new comer.  I have friends who have truly fell whole heartedly in love with this church and everything they are about, I definitely recommend checking them out if you're in the area and searching for a new church to call home!

They have excellent and soul moving worship, it truly is a wonderful experience!

Swing on by, pop in for a service and see what they're all about! Missing something in your life or facing a challenge? This is a must for your Sunday. Desert Valley Church feels like you’ve walked into the sincerely loving  and non-judgemental home you only wished you’d grown up in. The people are real, they’re friendly and they’re genuine. From the greeting at the front doors to the sanctuary, you’ll feel welcome. The worship is soulful and invokes the Spirit of God to come. The preaching is awesome! I just love this place! The worship and the preaching are stellar! The pastors are the greatest - so real, relatable and nice! They have started a student ministry program again and you can tell the kids/teens really enjoy it.

name: Desert's End Church - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
Non-denominational Christian Church that loves God, Jesus, and the Holy Spirit. Sound Christian teaching and doctrine. Worship is genuine. My family and I have been going to this church for 13 years and love it. The community is incredible, builds you up, and very welcoming. Kids ministry is fun and Bible based. Our oldest son and daughter are in the youth group called Fellowship of the King and are inspired to know, love and follow Jesus. I have been a member of Desert's End Church Community for the past 13 years. I'd been without a church home for about 14 years due to transportation issues and although I made my apologies upon their invitation to attend, they unflinchingly offered to drive me and my grandchild, continuing until I was blessed with a vehicle. This community is a family, not merely warm bodies filling seats. The hearts and minds of its people are in love with God! Their faith is sincere and there love is pure.

Our church serves ASU with a group for students offering support and guidance and Bible study; there are, during the work week, small group meetings with a variety of goals (I'm in the Empty Nesters). We even have a group of young teens who have done amazing things! I have watched them grow from babies! We've supported individuals, couples, and families who go into the mission field, and those who choose homeschooling here in Arizona!

We truly are A Desert's End Community! Desert's End Church has an on campus ministry for Arizona State University called The Well. My son attends ASU and when looking for a Christian club on campus, found The Well to be Biblically based. They took him under their wings, showed genuine care for him, and have discipled him. He's found true friendship with the people in this group. They have the opportunity to meet a couple times a week on campus for discipleship and fellowship. Shortly after attending The Well at ASU, my son started fellowshipping at Desert's End on Sundays. I've visited the church a couple of times while out visiting my son at school. They are a true example of how Christ would want us to gather as a body. They teach straight from the Bible, led by the Spirit, have time of fellowship, and disciple one another. Anyone in the area looking for a tight-knit, Biblically based church would be very blessed here. Love this church. The leadership is really caring. Community is really friendly and if you're looking for genuine connection you'll find it here. This small church meets at Tempe Prep Academy school Sunday mornings. They love Jesus, the Bible, each other, visitors, and the world around them. They sing loud.

name: Destiny Christian Center International - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: This church is definitely word based and faith based. As soon as you walk through the door you are family. The pastor and church meme are are very kind and I felt blessed in this house. Definitely returning! I'm so grateful to Bishop Allen and the DCCI family for all the love they give not only at church but every day! This is such a great family to be a part of! I decree and declare continuing blessings and favor over this house of God and all who dwell in it in the name of Jesus. From day 1 I knew this was my church home. Bishop is a great and wonderful person that gives powerful messages. Everyone is welcoming and assures your comfortable. My decision to become a member was the best! Being a member of DCCI has enhanced my life  beyond measure.  I've grown spiritually and my walk with God is sustained with the Word that Bishop Allen teaches.  Our church sincerely loves! Your life will never be the same once you experience Destiny Christian Center International!! Being a young adult it’s often times hard to find a church that connects to you and your walk with God. From day one of walking into Destiny I felt loved and welcomed. The way I have been blessed spiritually is amazing and my faith has grown tremendously. I love how God is not put into a box at Destiny and anything is achievable. I’d advise ANYONE from ANY walk of life to please stop by and experience God in a WHOLE NEW WAY!!!

name: Destiny Christian Fellowship - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
I really wanted to find a church home at Destiny Christian Fellowship. I had been attending services online and decided to take the next step by getting involved in a local church community.

I first filled out a Connect Card, but no one ever contacted me. Thinking it may have simply been overlooked, I followed up at the information kiosk. The person there took down my information and assured me it would be passed along, but again, I never heard back.

I also tried to join the Women of Destiny group, which meets on Zoom. Unfortunately, the website did not list a meeting ID or clear instructions for joining. I sent an email to ask for help, but I never received a response.
Later, I attended the ministry fair, hoping that would be another way to get connected. This time, I did receive a reply, only to learn that volunteering requires church membership.

After multiple attempts to get involved—through the Connect Card, in-person follow-up, email, and attending the ministry fair—I was left feeling discouraged and unwelcome. I understand that churches can be busy, but for a place that emphasizes community and connection, the lack of follow-up was disappointing. In the end, I took it as a sign that this was not the right fit for me. I live stream services and they are fantastic! God is truly leading this part of the world body of Christ. Pastor Paul is a good under Shepherd and I love 1st lady Meredith and the praise team.May our Lord continue to bless them. Very welcoming and inclusive to people attending online. Pastor Paul preaches in an understandable way and knows how to get serious points across without talking down to people. Lady M is good at making everyone feel cared for, the worship music is fantastic, and the prayer is powerful. What a wonderful church - I wish it was closer to my home. If you haven't listened to Pastor Paul Shepard on the Destined for Victory podcast or his online videos/audio, I highly recommend it. It's on my top 5 ministry podcasts I listen to all the time. it will bless you mightily to start, because this pastor teaches God's Word! and makes sure he addresses how it must be applied practically for heart and mind transformation in Jesus. This is a fun, loving, and dynamic church congregation. Don't believe people who knit-pick on faithful ministries where the Holy Spirit is working powerfully in people's lives. One pastor doesn't have time for personal appointments with everyone, esp with so many people wanting to get counseling from him. We have many ministers in the church in a division of labor to accommodate for that so that all God's people labor in ministry for each other and we are not overwhelming just one person. Please folks, be gracious when you come to this church with unrealistic expectations on its leaders and people. Go there to humble and submit yourself to God. Pastor Sheppard (the comedian) is one of the GREAT Pastors that I have come across.  The DCF family is also friendly.   I have enjoyed the few months I have been going.  Great place to be.

name: Destiny Chuch of Jacksonville - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Destiny Church of Jacksonville is such an incredible place to be! It’s a non-denominational church that’s full of life, positivity, and genuine people. I’ve been going with my boyfriend and his family, and every time we go, I leave feeling encouraged and uplifted. The worship is powerful, the messages are always meaningful and easy to connect with, and everyone there is so welcoming. You can really feel God’s presence in the room. Every message is heartfelt and spoken straight from the Bible. I’m so thankful to be apart of this church it truly feels like home! About 10 years ago, my family was looking for a non denominational church in the Jacksonville area when we came across destiny church! We came and immediately got connected through family friends of ours, and we haven’t looked back since! Since then my parents, girlfriend and I have joined the serve team and attended on Sunday. It’s an amazing spirit filled environment with donuts and lemonade every morning! The people are very welcoming and loving! The message is always STRIGHT from the word and the worship is incredible. We are in love with this church! On the outside.it may not look like much but dont judge a book by its cover. First let me say you are greeted and welcomed with open hearts and arms as well as coffee,doughnut and fruit.
The seating was the most comfortable you will ever find for Any church services . The Pastor and Service was excellent and the Spirit of the Holy Ghost Was in the House Praise God.
This is Definitely Word Checking Out.  Hope to See Ya There. Praying For You and Yours. May God Bless and Keep Yall till We meet and Always. Destiny Church is a spirit-filled non-denominational church in Jacksonville that truly makes you feel at home. From the moment I walked in, people were friendly and welcoming. The community is genuine and it’s clear that everyone is valued. The worship is powerful and full of life, and you can tell the team is passionate about creating an atmosphere where people can encounter God. The preaching is straight from the Bible, and it’s always relevant and easy to apply to everyday life. Every message challenges and encourages me in my faith. If you’re searching for a Christian church in Jacksonville that’s full of God’s presence, strong teaching, and a great sense of community, Destiny Church is the place to go. I moved to Jax in 2018 and this makes the third church I have attended since moving and it will be the final church I attend because I have found my church home. What an amazing group of people who make you feel welcome, and just like family from your very first visit to your twentieth visit. Pastor Chris is the real deal and isn't afraid to step on toes and preach the truth... the spirit of the Lord of felt in this church...  each and every Sunday through praise and worship. Come check it out.

name: Destiny Church - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary: I’m so grateful I found this church it’s been a true blessing in my life. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, supported, and seen. The messages are grounded in the Word and speak straight to the heart. The community is loving and genuine, and I’ve grown so much in my faith since joining. Whether you’re new to your walk with God or looking to deepen your relationship with Him, this is such a safe, encouraging space to grow. So thankful for this church family! We recently moved to the area.   We were looking for a church that was large enough yet felt like a small church, and this church fits the description.   We want the large church type service with all the great activities and different groups, but we also want to feel like we are not just a number but a part of something bigger.  One thing I did notice is that the people attending this church truly believe. Also, the pastor is passionate about his congregation and his sermons.  We look forward to learning & growing here at Destiny. Went to vote.  As far as the church goes, I haven't been in a while.  The service was wonderful, but I did not feel welcomed like I have felt at other smaller churches.  I can imagine it's hard getting to everyone on a busy Sunday. This was my second time here. Had to leave 5 min into praise and worship. The drummer was just beating the living heck out of the drums, and drowning everything else out. Very uncomfortable experience. I don’t understand why churches refuse to use electronic drums. This place is amazing kind staff feel God's presence here definitely home

name: Destiny Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending this church for well over a year now and absolutely love it. I find myself taking pages of pages of notes and then carrying that book throughout the week to remind me of so many insightful moments related to the word & God‘s goodness. People here treat you like family. And, I’ll be honest, the tasty coffee on my way in the door is definitely what I need to add that extra pump of “let’s do this!” It’s also a huge bonus for my family that they offer a children’s church so that the kids can also experience and learn more about God in a setting tailored to them, while the adults get to focus in themselves We are new to the area and decided to try Destiny Church. We had lined up other churches to try after going there but we never did make it to the others. We felt we found our church on our first visit. My son loves the children's ministry. Everyone is so welcoming but it's not overwhelming. We love it! A true Christian place of worship! Warm people, honest Bible based Teaching! Pastor Terry teaches the whole word, not just the good or the bad. But the whole word of God. If you want to meet Jesus, this is a great place to go. This is gonna be a long one folks...

I love it when religious cowards will down talk a church anonymously. How much credibility can you give this person? We've been at Destiny about 5 years. It's far from perfect but what church is unless they only operate as a social club? I reject churches that are seeker sensitive, relativist, into the prosperity movement, the small gods' doctrine, and other false teachings. I wouldn't waste my time attending a church where Jesus doesn't show up each week.

Yes, sometimes we try too hard to fit in with the current culture and the campaigns can get a little annoying. But we have a pastor who speaks the truth and proves his sincerity by his life and serving his family. Pastor Terry is open and honest and does not compromise on the Word. If you have a "beef" he'll listen. If you're a coward you'll leave silently and write an undermining review somewhere. If you're a true believer who loves the church, you'll have enough cojones to talk to the man. He's open to criticism and loves to hear your opinion.

As far as being Rick Warrenesque? I think not. Listen for yourself! All the sermons are on the website. Destiny is a great place to attend and hear God's message for you. It's also a great place to use your talents serving God.

I believe we are living in the days of Matthew 24 and 2nd Thessalonians 2. A great falling away from the truth just before great persecution. But we must be careful we don't reject the church that Jesus loves and calls His bride.

I cannot wait until the govt strips away the 501C3 for non-profits. 501C3 has created state-run churches whose leaders are afraid of telling Biblical truth for fear of losing their tax exempt status. Once it's gone we'll know who the true believers are. There won't be a tax benefit from giving so I imagine tithes will suffer. Churches will shrink in size along with revenues. On the positive, preachers will be able to speak the truth once again. At least for a short time before the persecution starts. Megachurches will die off and the persecuted church will once again thrive with a remnant of believers.

I know I sound like a religious fruit cake. Only true believers will connect with what I'm saying. Are ya hearin' me?

So, I give Destiny 5 stars. The more I get to know my pastor, his wife and family the more I love them and trust them. A wonderful church community. Welcoming, supportive,open and well organized.

name: Destiny Church Assemblies of God
reviewSummary:
I am a recent transplant from Colorado to Cheyenne 9-2017.  I had three churches on my radar before arriving in town, and visited each one.  The first lacked the Word!  The 2nd lacked the Spirit!  AND the 3rd was all about the Concert....  So I asked the Lord for a fourth option.  I am happy to say that Destiny Church includes a good balance of ALL THE ABOVE: great worship, active presence of the Holy Spirit and a Pastor who preaches the WORD!

I would also like to say that I have met more people in 4 weeks here, then I did in 4 months at church #1, and 2 months at church #2.  From my perspective, this body of believers understands what it means to Love thy neighbor and goes out of their way to make visitors and newcomers feel welcome.  I can say the same about the Pastor as well; Pastor Rick went out of his way to meet me, introduce me to like believers and is consistently checking in on me to make sure that I am plugged in and getting my spiritual needs met within his flock.

If the Lord is prompting you to get involved in a church that resembles that written about in the Book of Acts, give Destiny Church a try.  Shalom! Going to a church where the holy spirit is allowed it move is wonderful.  Service was not regimented. The bible is preached. Pastor Rick has a way of sharing what God has put on his heart in an understandable way. Worship time was not hurried.  One of the best parts was.. calling people to the altar for prayer. Nice friendly atmospere. Genuine people of God with integrity who want to here your side of the story, on just about any subject, such as relationships, God, fishing and many others.  Plus, they put on a pretty good Worship service ( music and singing) and the pastor has a good Word from God. It's worth checking out. Friendly pastor and church members. We were just driving through, but enjoyed the energy they put into worship (which was pretty good I might add), and the thought put into a good sounding sermon series. I would definitely visit again if I were in town. Love LOve LOVE! This church! Amazing pastor who loves god with all his mind heart and soul!!! Spirit filled church! Many miracles happen here! Testimonies after testimonies of what God is doing in people's lives!! The pastor and his wife take the time to meet everyone and stay connected with people!! Doers of the WORD and not hearers only. Powerful teaching and worship is beautiful!!! Can not say anything bad about this church!

name: Destiny Church Rocklin - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary:
In Roseville’s heart where hope does rise,
Stands Destiny Church beneath open skies.
Not built on show or flashing light,
But on the Word, pure, bold, and right.

Pastor Greg—a shepherd true,
Not swayed by trends or worldly view.
He speaks the truth, both sharp and kind,
With Holy Fire and Spirit mind.

While others chase the wealth and fame,
And turn God’s house into a name,
Here still the altar stands unshaken,
The cross upheld, not once forsaken.

Each sermon strikes with heaven’s grace,
You feel the peace, you see God’s face.
He teaches straight, no sugar shell,
Just timeless truth that saves from hell.

No business plan, no watered wine,
Just Scripture's voice in every line.
As Jesus said—His promise stays,
“Peace I leave with you”, He prays.
“Not as the world gives,” calm and deep,
“Let not your heart be troubled,” sleep. (John 14:27)

So if you seek what’s raw and real,
Where broken hearts are taught to heal—
Then Destiny’s doors are open wide,
Where Spirit and the Word abide. While the messages are uplifting and filled with hope, the little political jabs towards liberals is a cause for concern to push an agenda and feels controlling and cult like, im glad I did not attend in person because I know I would be judged from head to toe. Glad I watched online before attending. The choice in shallow biblical  doctrine worship music was a bad experience for my family, with the majority of the service being worship with a very short 20 min message. I’m fine with contemporary songs, but the ones they chose had repetitive, very shallow content without any Christ mention or traditional hymns with deep biblical doctrine. Also the women pastors In church leadership I disagree with, other than to lead women’s only groups. The audio is very loud, to loud. No personal interaction with congregation having been 1st time visiting Our family has long appreciated this church community, but we have become increasingly concerned with the recent direction of our services. The growing emphasis on speaking in tongues feels inconsistent with the environment we initially joined. Furthermore, the worship experience has become disproportionately centered on a single vocalist. While Rachel is talented, her dominance on stage frequently overshadows other gifted team members, specifically Stephen. We would love to see a return to a more collaborative, balanced worship style that allows the full breadth of the team’s talent to shine. Bold, Faithful, Energetic church and congregation. Lots of ways to engage.
Bible believing. Bible oriented.
God Bless Destiny.

reviewSummary:
God meets and greets me at DWC and I feel most welcome among my people. My mother
Karen Ayemou
Was born may 28th 1950

name: Destinyland Christian Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Destinyland Christian Center is an awesome church. You will grow and mature not only mentally but spiritually. You will definitely learn the Word of GOD as this is a Bible based church. You will work on things you never knew you needed and not by force by the will of the Lord. I am very proud to be a member of such an amazing church. We are family and we strive to be better each and every day! Ohhh and I can’t forget we are multi cultural 💜. There’s so much more that’s offered come in and check us out! I recommend this great establishment. No matter age, gender , race, etc. This place is so enlightening. I been attending here for almost two years. Bill and Britain are great genuine welcoming couple to all new people that enter through the door .I have been consistent to come to Bible study on Wednesdays and learned so much. First Wednesday of the month is “women of worship” & can say I really loved the experiences and so much that is applied to your own life we can draw strength on and relate to one another when it takes place. People are friendly and it’s lovely to have more come and add to the church and go on the path, to be better and do more by the word of God. I love this church! Great place to grow in your relationship with the Lord! Welcoming but not intimidatingly over-friendly. The Pastor and his wife are kind, wise, caring, and thoughtful. This church feels like family and the Lord will use it to draw you closer to Himself and know Him better. My son absolutely loves this church! The teaching is great, I can tell they really love me and my family. The Wednesday night service is also great at 7 PM. Come check it out if you want to learn more about God and the Bible. My wife and I have been PRAISING the LORD for almost a year now at Disneyland Christian Center.  I've been in California for 55 years now and visited many Churches and joined a few, but  this Church is unique because you feel as if you're at HOME with a family atmosphere,  and the HOLY SPIRIT moving in your Heart and the preaching touches your soul. The members are always loving and welcoming so one realize you have to return to make sure this is real. We attend on SUNDAY SERVICE, WEDNESDAY BIBLE STUDY, AND EVERY CHANCE WE GET.

DEVO Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Devo church is awesome! If you are looking for a church where community sees and loves you and God is everywhere you look, this is the church for you! I have only ever felt loved at this church. I have learned so much about God and have grown so much in my faith. Pastor Nate is amazing and he truly has a servant’s heart. I love this church community so much and I am always at one of the events throughout the week because this church is so fun! God is truly moving through this church! I’ve been attending DEVO for a year now and absolutely love this church. It’s truly diverse, welcoming, and a place where the message is easy to understand and apply. Pastor Nate’s teaching style is relatable, practical, and always rooted in real-life application that helps you grow both in faith and as a person.

What I appreciate most is DEVO’s genuine commitment to serving the community and creating real impact beyond Sunday service. This church not only pours into its members but also into the city and it shows. DEVO Church is a great community! It's a welcoming, diverse place perfect for anyone looking to find a church home, connect with others, and grow their faith. I'm thankful for this amazing church family. Such an amazing Church. The serve people here are so welcoming and kind. The people are so welcoming and the pastor has such amazing words to say!! From the moment my family set foot inside DEVO, we knew this was the church for us. The people were so welcoming, the leadership is outstanding, and the sermons were everything we were looking for. Pastor Nate is constantly preaching the bible and challenging my family to grow in our faith. It is no longer just a church to us, but has become a family.

name: Dexter Avenue King Memorial Baptist Church - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: The tour was awesome and are conducted by longstanding members of the church.   A very good review of the history about the church was provided.  I learned a lot.  This tour is definitely a must do. The church was closed when we visited, but it was still inspiring to see it. I had no idea it was so close to the Capitol where King spoke...and to the Confederate memorial and Jefferson Davis' home, which was jarring. We thought the Dexter Avenue King Memorial Baptist Church was a lovely example of churches from the period. The history that occurred here is undeniable and this was a definite crucible of change. Unfortunately it was locked the morning that we visited but you could not miss the history here, even viewing only from the outside. Absolutely Loved! This is my second visit here and it is still heartwarming to be in the place where THE DR. Martin Luther King, Jr preached and lived. The history is amazing! Awesome Church And A Greater Historical Monument For Dr. Martin Luther King, History At Its Best For All To See On Dexter Avenue, Right Down From The Capital Of Montgomery, My Cousin, Anthony Moody And Natalya Moody, Visited My Wife, Heather, And I Here In Montgomery From Toledo, Ohio And They Were Very Fascinated To See History At Its Best.

name: Diocese of San Bernardino - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
The “chancery” of our Diocese of San Bernardino. It is extremely clean, spacious, and the chapel is very beautiful. Please pray for our wonderful bishop, priests, and all the people of God. Staff was unable(refused to help) obtaining copy of baptism certificate. Also tried the actual church ( San Salvador in Colton) was given the same help. None!!! I sent my prayers up offered ensense to the Lord blessed my home and I felt a since of relief then I opened my door and felt another spirit or spiritual pressure enter by me through my front door I said you are not welcome and I command you to leave in Jesus name and the neighbors started speaking and saying that I need to pray to there fertility God I'm sure now that this is so hard because the neighbors are keeping it going. The Diocese of San Bernardino has completely failed in its duty to act with integrity and transparency. A serious complaint was made involving a priest and an unlicensed therapist, yet the response was nothing short of negligent. They outright refused to meet, ignored opportunities for dialogue, and appeared more concerned with protecting themselves than addressing wrongdoing. This wasn’t just disappointing—it was a deliberate attempt to avoid accountability. The Church should be a place of truth and justice, not silence and cover-ups. SB Diocese, SB Diocese, Why have you forsaken us?
I echo the sentiments Jesus last spoke as he was crucified by his people in response to how the Diocese of San Bernardino has foresaken its people in Riverside, Ca. A cornerstone of the work of Vatican II was to understand the Church’s need to celebrate Mass in the language of the local congregation to appropriately and effectively “get closer to the people of God so that they could understand well what it does, and this is important for us” Pope Francis, 2015.
St. Thomas the Apostle Church in Riverside, CA has a Parochial Vicar- Celestine Afugwobi who fails at bringing the Word of God to our community. He is unable to effectively communicate in either in English or Spanish to be able to share the Good News. He leaves our community to the time prior to Vatican II where God’s people did not understand the language of the Sacraments being celebrated. This is a huge disservice to his flock. Besides being unintelligible, Celestine’s primary focus is evident: his hometown and his people back in his home country. Celestine does not promote the well-being or development of his community in Riverside but rather capitalizes on ways to extract funding and resources from his home community to take back to his home country. We need a priest focused on improving and developing our community, not one looking to exploit us for the benefit of his friends and family back at home.
