name: Disciples First - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been a member since 1981 and cannot make myself change my membership even though I don’t go there anymore. They are very liberal, kind and caring. Both ministers give wonderful sermons. The First Christian Church is a great place to worship God. The congregation is very caring and giving to the community. They are always having fundraisers to help people in need as well as for the David Lopez Community School at Edgemere.  The church is very nice and comfortable. Disappointing experience. Was attracted by the architecture but was unceremoniously turned away. First time I've ever shown up to a church on a busy Sunday morning and not been welcomed inside! They have a great building, but they need to learn a few things about proselytizing. I cannot say enough good things about this church. They are some of the most welcoming people you will ever meet and go out of their way to provide a genuine spiritual experience. They aren't as concerned with filling seats as they are showing through their actions what Christianity is supposed to be about. This includes offering ministries to serve the poorest of the poor, the outcast and the rejected. You don't even have to be a follower of Christ to be a part of the worship experience and the congregation is made up of people from all walks of life be they recovering from a difficult past to the LGBTQ community. This is an accepting environment whose only creed is love all the people. Yes, that includes you. Many many fond memories of my children growing up in the same church in which my mom and grandma grew up, my parents WERE married ...the Easter egg hunts/ ice cream socials...my grandma preparing Tuesday meals for meals- on-wheels program and her dedication to the Crisis Cupboard. the Jewelbox Theatre, etc...
I miss my grandma Helen Beaird and my mom Kay Meyers so so much, life will never be the same. I absolutely cherish the memories we made together in this church.  Thank u for that. God bless you all.

name: Discover Christian Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: We visited today and had a great experience!  The worship team did a great job.  The stage was beautifully decorated for Christmas.  The songs were well chosen and tied in with the message about Hope.    People were friendly to us.  It was a great message about Hope from the story of Zechariah and Elizabeth.  Kids church was available.  I recommend if you are looking for a nondenominational Christian Church! Grew up at this church when I was younger and would visit periodically over the years. Discover is very biblical and not flashy like a lot of the trendy churches in Columbus. Very authentic. The church motto is love God, love people, make disciples I absolutely LOVE Discover Christian Church.  I have been consistently attending this church for the last couple years.  Everyone is so welcoming and you truly feel like you matter and aren't just a number.  This could easily happen since there a so many people who attend.  They are so involved in the community and are so willing to help anyone in need.  The pastoral staff is wonderful and every time any of them speak on Sunday, you will hear a great message.  I also LOVE the worship music that the worship team sings.  You will hear a great mix of the current worship songs and still hear the traditional hymns.  If you have kids you will love the children's programs.  The teaching staff is amazing!!  This church lives and breathes it's mission statement.  I would highly recommend it to anyone. My time with Discover has been great so far. I really feel the spirituality associated with the Lord since I've been going here. I've even started praying a lot & learning as much as I can too. Its been a while since I've been at church but ever since I started going to this one. I've been getting really into it. At Discover you'll learn much & be a part of a great community in the process as well. I’m so blessed to call Discover my home! They have an amazing community, with ample opportunities to get to know people and also serve. Pastor Steve is incredibly welcoming and has a relatable preaching style.

name: Discover Church Raleigh - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Discover Life Church | Melbourne Campus - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary: I am visiting Discover Life Church in Melbourne. I first began attending the Viera campus, and I thank God for allowing me to be part of this beautiful congregation. I pray for the Pastor, the leaders, and everyone who comes together to pray, intercede, and do God’s good work. May His purpose be fulfilled in our lives, and may we continue sharing His love and the message of salvation with others. May God continue to bless this church abundantly. Very disappointed in this church. It was our first time attending with my husband and our 12 month old baby. We haven’t been to church in months and we were really excited to get back into it as we felt that’s what we needed in our lives. We were enjoying the message the pastor was preaching. Occasionally our baby would make a small noise maybe 2-3 times. Everyone got loud at a point and she also did because she is in the stage of copying other people’s noises. She never cried or screamed and they kicked us out. They said “we are going to have to ask you to go to a different area in the church, we are recording”. This was probably the most disappointing experience I’ve ever had in my life. Jesus would never do that. Apart of the message was “read the room” and trust me we read the room, if she was crying we would’ve left, if she was screaming we of course would’ve left. She made the tiniest noise twice and that was enough to kick a family out. So clearly recording the message and making sure the recording isn’t ruined is more important than the family showing up to worship Jesus with their baby. They state they have a family room where you can watch it on the screen and wanted to send us there but at that point it wasn’t worth it to us. We will never be back and we’re just so disappointed in this experience here. I prefer not to say how I truly feel about this church except to say, I pray they become more approachable,  very sad If you are looking for a church that is Spirit filled, speaks truth over you,  multicultural, welcoming, genuinely loves everyone, helps the community, doesn’t judge, has a come as you are mentality and offers a family like community, then this is the church for you! My family searched for a church home for a long time and once we found discover life we knew this was it. Pastor Ken is 💯🙏 a REAL MAN, one that Loves Jesus and the MEN of our community.   I'm encouraged by Pastors line Ken because HE tells it like it is "straight no chaser" JUST like Jesus does and backs EVERYTHING up with the very word of God, the truth is the truth and if that hurts one's feelings, then maybe YOUR feelings needed to be hurt in order for ETERNAL REWARDS to manifest in the lives of the believer or the LOST....... Pastor Ken and the team of associate Pastors, elders and volunteers truly care about YOUR healing and eternal inheritance and will stop at nothing to show you how to develop a relationship and direct access to THE GREAT PHYSICIAN, JESUS CHRIST OUR LORD.   All men need to register for the next FIGHT CLUB at Discover Life, there is sooooo much power in a room full of men worshipping God on a FRIDAY night when the rest of the world chooses otherwise devicive influence and consequences.

name: Discovery Christian Church - Davis Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending this church for 5yrs and I have really been blessed by the relationships I have had and the people I met. We don't have any family in the area but we have found an extended family that supports us in all seasons of life.  This is a Christian church that believes in basic biblical principals and loves people. If you are undecided or contemplating going to church again, this is a good place to start. IF you have KIDS.. This is even better Upon seeing this church's website and certain sermons, I noticed that it is a church that practices middle age mysticism and headed in the emergent church movement (a movement that places experience above God's word and wants to get rid of Holy Writ from your hands). This is a big red flag. The book recommendations they give have to do with practicing middle age mysticism, this is the trash they promote. The pastor is a false teacher because he is teaching and promoting mysticism to the flock. This is a church that does not bow down to the authority of scripture. If you attend this church I would leave and if you are planning to, find another church that preaches from the bible. This has been my home for six years. It’s full of kind, thoughtful people who are eager to grow in pursuit of Jesus and are not afraid to ask difficult questions. Active service community and healthy small groups. Such a great church. It is a mix of students and younger couples and families. Jesus-centered worship and teaching. A great place for people looking for a church home in Davis. I started coming here because of people's truthfulness and sincerity about their lives and their desire to follow Christ. A great place to worship and fellowship. My church fam through and through!

name: Discovery Church
reviewSummary:
Coming in as a youth, and now a young adult, I really feel the Holy Spirit working through Discovery Church. It's a good place to hear the word, be encouraged to know it yourself, and then go out and do. The crowd attending regularly is normally an older generation, with smaller groups of youth and adults. And the connection to be made with the people here is worth it. Discovery has a great way of avoiding cliques and just being one wholesome family, enjoying one another where they're at. They also practice and enjoy being opened armed with new people and including them as family too. I have the sense God's led more than a dozen people here and it's crazy seeing a part of His plan in person. Discovery has provided ample opportunity for me to see the Holy Spirit in action and love others, as well as worship and hear good substance from the Word.  The speaker changes frequently as well, which can also be refreshing.

Either way, after attending a couple weeks or more, Discovery can start to feel like home. It's been amazing connecting with God's people here. I have been a member of Discovery Church for many year.  If you're looking for authentic worship, challenging sermons and the opportunity to study the Word, give us a try.  I've made lifelong friends and so can you! Disconnected from God       Waste of Time
Sing. Sing. Sing. Talk abt what Discovery Church has done in the community & THEIR future plans for Discovery Church. I have been there twice. First time. Sing for an hour straight (2 songs), then talk about two verses he wants to read for 15 minutes to half an hour b4 finally reading ONE verse & ending services. Second time. Sing. Sing. Sing. Very boring music. The whole first Hour is singing just one jingle over & over & over. Talk about what Discovery Church has & will do in the near future for the neighborhood. That's great, but what about Jesus? What abt God? Bible anyone? Overall very boring & plain. A GREAT WASTE OF TIME!
Also, IDK the Pastors name, but I DO know his face, & I'm pretty sure Steven Reames is The Preacher. Nice church. People mostly ignored us but the 2 that didn't were friendly and we had been there several times. Pastor had good messages. A church full of love for Christ and people. There is community and so much going on here!! Love it!!

name: Discovery Church - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary: Go to youth group on Wednesday and it is fine! We had my cousins memorial service here. They were very kind, they were absolutely great with our family and friends. They made a very tough time a little more bearable. Discovery is the best! Very family oriented and very welcoming. The messages are always excellent! I highly recommend every check it out! Very friendly people. Worship music was uplifting. Sermon was inspiring. Great place to worship and immediately feel like  you're with family.

name: Discovery Church - Gulfport Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place of God! The pastors and congregation are so loving and accepting. Came from outside of town and they welcomed me with open arms. Great mix of people. Got baptized here because I felt a conviction before I ever attended a service. This would be my home church if I were local. Need a church like this where I live in Florida. Great people. All are welcomed and all are loved. Totally recommended this church You always feel welcome when you visit, and the services are heartfelt. You may come in feeling weighed down but, you’ll leave refreshed and encouraged, knowing you can make it through whatever you’re facing. The atmosphere genuinely says, Welcome Home-YOU belong here. This is my "go-to," church when I am in the area. They are the most loving, Godly church family outside of my home church that I have been to in the last 5 years. Love you, ALL Discovery Church fam!!!!! Born and raised in this church . Had always been spirit led and always will
Be. Amen I love my church family. They are always there for me when I need them. They pray with me and pray for me. And I, them. I'll never forget the first day I stepped foot in Discovery Church. I came skeptical, I came anxious, but I was welcomed as if I had always been there. Arms wide, and genuine smiles that lasted even after my "newness" wore off. I was a part of their family as soon as they met me. Even when I went through a season of distance with them, they let me know they loved me, and missed me. I've felt nothing but love, and compassion from these beautiful souls and I am happy to be a part of this family. 💕
If you're  in Gulfport and  craving this same sense of community, this would be the place to go.

The presence of God here is beautiful as well.

name: Discovery Church - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
From the first day I visited, I felt loved and accepted. The pastors genuinely care about people, and the church community is amazing. I’ve grown spiritually so much here. Always feel like you’re apart of a beautiful family at Discovery church. Been coming here almost 8 years now and I absolutely love it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a new church! Great Christmas carol celebration at Discovery Church. My daughter Debbie Soni was one the lead singers in this musical band. The decor was amazing. I cannot give this church good reviews at this time. My daughter and her husband attended one of the Orlando locations. At first I was praising God that they are finally attending church. Unfortunately,  they started attending classes that taught my daughter that I was a terrible mother and should be avoided at all cost. The biggest problem I had was it taught her forgiveness is not actually biblical. I cannot give good reviews to a church that teaches its congregation to not forgive. I really enjoy the sermons especially when Don Cousins preaches and the worship team.
I always enjoy young adult nights and the groups this church has to offer which provides opportunities to meet and connect with others building discipleships with one another. I think this church does that very well.

However here's the reason I stopped going to Sunday services at this church. If you're reading this discovery then this is something that you need to be aware of and put in consideration. I understand that the one woman who preaches the sermons every now and then is on fire for Jesus and has the desire to share the word to others, and I'm not trying to talk down on her or be mean but the Bible makes it clear that "The women are to keep silent in the churches; for they are not permitted to speak. but are to subject themselves. just as the Law also says. If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home; for it is improper for a woman to speak in church" 1 Corinthians 14:34-35. 1 Timothy 2:12-14 also makes that very clear. Some may think that it was a call from God for her to preach in church but be aware that "No wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light."
2 Corinthians 11:14
We need to look at scripture to really determine God's voice and whether it's a call from God or a lie from the enemy.

name: Discovery Church Colorado - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church! This church is non judgmental, casual, and friendly.  From the first time we visited my family and I felt welcomed and was able to relate to the pastors and their teachings.  The first church here in the Springs that I get excited to go back to every week. In fact, i live in Fountain and have never thought it was too far because of how great this church is.  If you are looking for a church to attend, then I would highly recommend Discovery Church. Going to sign up for men’s retreat. Nervous but excited. Been church hunting with my soon to be wife. And we agreed to stay here. The service was amazing. And the baptisms were so special. I would tell everyone to not step foot in this establishment because it's not a church id recommend to anyone.  For example I was out of gas and walked in to find a friend of mine and was greeted by the coldest people..it was 18° outside and when I was told my friend had left I explained my situations and with the fastest response from the coldest heart I've ever met in 68 years of life was told we don't give out cash and won't help with gas. Now sit and tell me is this the kind of church that teaches the principles of Christianity or humanity.  Who would let a 68 year old man sit in his car freezing and not extend the love of christ to a former member and to a child of God. This is a disgrace of a church representing the love of God..from the young lady at the coffee stand to the older woman who literally told me to leave in so many words.ive never been humiliated and treated like that before any where in my life I think her name is lorane im not positive but I am positive that's not how your treat another Christian.
Like I said disappointment is the feeling I receive and I encourage people not to go there.
If they would allow a 68 year old former member sit stranded in 18°weather with no heat then they shouldn't be a church teaching the word of God because that's not what the word of God is When it comes to being real, this is the place. I admit, the music is loud... really LOUD. But the sermons are excellent. They hit home.. The staff are as real as it gets, and there is grace in your daily struggles... something I have yet to find at other churches. If you are a Christian, they will challenge the way you think about things. If you are not a Christian... you are TOTALLY welcome here! No judgment! This is a safe place to share your troubles... in love. If you are NOT normal (or do not WANT to be normal) this place is definitely worth a look or 5. I love this church. Greg is a great Pastor. The have kids and youth programs. They are very involved in the community of Colorado Springs.

name: Discovery Fellowship Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary: Good preaching. There is a strong sense of community in the church and a desire to help those in the outside community. I would like to share that I was recently introduced to this wonderful place with awesome loving and caring individuals, called The Shine Pantry. They all were very welcoming. And one could tell that they had big caring hearts. Explained how everything went. They offer food for our fur babies, diapers for adults and babies, and so much more. I got a Thanksgiving bag with lots of good stuff. But the best part was when asked if we would like them to pray for us. And did I need it that day. Thank you for being there for our community and for being Beautiful Angel's. Very Blessed. Excellent Biblical teaching, wonderful worship, and amazing loving and kind people. We are very happy here and have grown in Christ so much. I love that they have adult Sunday School. They also are very loving to their community and have several outreach ministries. Wonderful, Pastor Rick is so sincere, as is the entire staff. This church is very blessed to have so many blessed knowledgeable teachers. I highly recommend their bible study groups as well as fellowship on Sundays. I am   always trying other churches and never fail to end up back here at Duscovery; I am done looking around, I have found home here at fellowship. The lead pastor is amazing. Thats something that everyone says. But this pastor is like Oakley Prizm lenses, you can't explain how good it is, you have to try it for yourself.

name: Discovery Pointe Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: I love the church and the pastors and just the surrounding of people gives me the feeling of being in love again with Jesus Christ and the band and music that inspires me to be more involved with everything that the church has to offer. Pastor Greg and pastor Rod are both very supportive and very kind to us and they both have great communication skills and passion for each other’s lives and family. Love them both and their families. My prayers and love to you all and your families. God bless you all I was a visitor recently and absolutely loved it. The people were very nice, wide range of ages, you can dress how you want, and most of all the service was absolutely terrific. There are 3 services- Sat 5:30, Sun 9:00 and 10:30 so there's a time for everyone. Can't wait to go back! Great prayer team... so impressive. I can't say enough about them. Also got to meet and know the pastors and their wives, and they are just as dedicated to serving God as their other halves. Sermons are very, very pointed, and incredibly relevant. Family atmosphere and spiritually blessed church community. #lovemychuch Years ago I was in a dark place. My marriage was falling apart and I was making bad decisions based off that. This church showed up in a big way for me. They have genuine leadership that truly cares. They left a bigger impact than they can probably imagine. Years later so much of my life is healed and I look back on my time spent here and never being judged. Don’t hesitate to attend here. They’re a giving church and your tithe will be used the way God intended here. If I lived closer, I’d go back in a heartbeat! Great Spirit filled church with a vibrate community. Men show up on Saturday mornings for Iron Sharpens Iron Men’s Group, and get filled for the week. You will come out renewed and be a great blessing to your family and community

name: Discovery United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: I personally emailed the pastor of Discovery Methodist Church in Richmond multiple times on behalf of someone in need. He never responded. For a leader who claims to represent Methodist values of compassion, service, and care, this silence is unacceptable. A pastor’s role is to shepherd, not ignore. Failing to even acknowledge a plea for help is not leadership—it’s hypocrisy. A church that welcomes people with open arms. I dont feel like i am out of place here. I finally feel like i found a place that i beling to and want to explore my faith. Discovery Methodist Church completely failed to respond to repeated outreach from a person in need—calls, emails, nothing. For a church that claims to follow Methodist values of compassion and service, this silence is hypocritical and damaging. Ignoring the vulnerable is the opposite of living Christian values. Took me a long time to find my church family, but Discovery instantly provided the welcome I was seeking and engagement my children needed.  Plus their small groups are extremely interesting, educational, and thought provoking.  Participating in my 5th book now - Five Love Languages. Walking through Discovery's doors 3 years ago has given my family the worship, community and friendship to enrich our lives. Thank you! I have been a member for over 10 years. Still just as inviting as it was then. Pastor Adam Sowder is genuine which is important to me because he's not just up there doing a job, he's a true believer and preaches from the heart.

name: District Church
reviewSummary: A mission-driven church targeting young professionals in DC with modern worship and strong community engagement.

name: District Church - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Today I went to church after 17 years. “This church is truly something special. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the warmth, love, and genuine spirit of the people. The pastor was absolutely amazing—authentic, heartfelt, and deeply inspiring. Nothing felt forced or rehearsed; it was real, honest, and moving. The message spoke right to the heart, and you leave feeling uplifted, encouraged, and closer to God. So grateful to have experienced such a beautiful and welcoming place.” I recently photographed a wedding at District Church and it was absolutely beautiful! The vineyard provided a great backdrop to their outdoor wedding ceremony on the lawn. There was plenty of space for their reception and a perfect, paved spot for dancing right by the building. Although I have not gone to a service at this church, I met a lot of guests who attend and they were all extremely kind and treated me well. What a perfect spot to get married! I hadn’t gone to church in quite some time. My husband and I were invited by a neighbor friend to join on a Sunday for a service. We gladly accepted the invite as we were wanting to find a church that we could call home. The Sunday rolled around and we went to the 10 am service and our 3 kiddos went into the kids service. It was amazing! The pastor was incredible! We felt right at home! We quickly realized how much we love this church. Two years later and our family being baptized there we have only grown so much more fond of District and the entire team! All the pastors are great! The worship team are amazing! All in all a great atmosphere! If you’re looking for a church that the people are nice, the environment is comfortable, you don’t feel awkward, and is more than just a Sunday service then I’d say this is the place for you! Attended for the first time today and was appalled by the comment the pastor made against trans people. Church should be a place of welcoming and acceptance, not judgement against others. I won’t be back. Some friends of ours invited us to church at District on Easter in 2024 and we found our home! This place is amazing in so many ways. Community based, relaxed environment, they bring the Bible into everyday life which for us is super important coming from a catholic church where that doesn't seem to happen as much. All the staff are very welcoming, the music is great, just can't say enough about this church! It has brought my wife and I back to church regularly but also brought us closer to God on a daily basis. Thanks to Stephanie and Patrick Norville, we will be a part of District for as long as we live here.

name: Divine Grace of OC - Placentia Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful sanctuary, and great place to worship where the truth is being preached!  Pastor and First Lady are very warm and welcoming. Love it! On my first visit my daughter received the Holy Spirit and got baptized. The Lord will definitely meet you there. A lovely warm place to worship 🙏🏾 Awesome place to worship the Lord Jesus Christ .  Hallelujah!!!!!!

name: Divinity Christian Fellowship - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: I was possessed by a demon and felt like fornicating recently. I stopped by this lovely fellowship and they cured me of my sinful thoughts! Thanks Jesus!

name: Dolores Mission Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent Catholic Mass! The congregation is full of beautiful, thoughtful, committed people who love God and their community. You will receive a warm welcome when you visit Dolores Mission. Father Brendan is absolutely BEST priest ever! Warm welcoming community, beautiful masses, amazing fresh food in the yard, and even free medical check ups and legal counseling offered regularly. Thank you so much 🙏💗 Gabriel "Lopez). Relax Ben . coach friend, family, Cousin, Couzins. New rockets  tunder Birds , Rosemeat .  Gerber baby bumperz Cans kans shechickens My Granddaughter Greysen was Baptized on 2-21-2021.  Great service. The Priest was awesome 👌he also Baptized Greysen's Daddy 25+ years before! What a Blessing 🙌 I was referred to by 211, which I came around 12pm. Was told by the receptionist at the time that there was available space and to come back at 4pm or a little later. Left to pick my clothes up and attempted to return as soon as possible but traffic was heavy. Called ahead to inform them I would be late but was told that there wasn't any space available because a client returned from a hospital that day. And failed to inform ahead of time, short story is don't come here, waste of time.

name: Dolores Park Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
These are the most loving, most outreaching people I’ve ever met. They become your family the way a church should be. The first time I came I had to go back. The word of God is number one in this church. They proclaim the Gospel and the Love of Christ. If you are looking for fellowship and the Gospel truth you will find it in this fellowship. I love all of my brothers and sisters in this church. Dolores Park Church has been my spiritual home for years and years…Pastor Lloyd really cares about our multi-cultural and multi-generational church family. We learn from each other, but most importantly, we are digging deep into the truths of God’s Word. Must mention that the music and food are not to be missed.
A welcoming place to worship! After you come here awhile, this is a church where everyone will know your name. Here you can find community of lasting friendships. DPC has become my church family.
Many years ago I came here as a new Christian. At DPC, I have been able to grow closer to God through the teaching of the Bible. I have also been able to use my God-given gifts in serving which has brought me great fulfillment. There are some churches in SF that put on entertainment, or commentary based sermons, or are crowd pleasers. This church is not one of those. The Bible is central here, and sermons are for strengthening growth and developing people with a heart for God. The Bible Studies are inquisitive and educational - thought provoking. The congregation is multigenerational and mostly wonderful, caring older folks, but that should not matter if meeting God is your primary objective. Great for learning from older folks. Few churches offer what DPC offers in SF, and it's truly a lighthouse for Biblical Christianity in the city. Highly recommend. Great church with a small town friendliness and feel if you're 40+, single or married and just want to get serious about your faith and understand the Bible deeper, better, and discuss it with mature adults who have more lived experiences in life. They have a nice children's Sunday School, and ample street parking.

name: Dominguez United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Dominguez United Methodist Church is a very loving and caring church who loves our Lord Jesus Christ.  Pastor Jeffrey Grant's messages are on point full of scripture and relates it to current life circumstances. It is amazing how the Lord leads him with all his messages every Sunday.   Do you sing?  Join the choir.  The choir director Rob is very talented with his gift of music for everyone. This church is very blessed!!  Fellowship after is awesome.  There are healthy snacks and other items to enjoy all while getting to know this very loving families in this wonderful Christian church. Our church worships our lord Jesus christ and none other please come by and see for yourself, don't believe the lies spread by the evil one on multi media. God bless all who believe in christ. This beautiful little neighborhood church is full of lovely and welcoming people. They are full of love and do their best to meet people as they are. Wonderful pastor and talented musician! They worship the devil no bs

name: Dominion Life - San Ramon Campus
reviewSummary: The place has really changed my life. The leading pastor, Pastor Segun is a kind man truly led by God. He is very patient, non judgmental, and really does focus in on the word. You will grow and learn a lot from his teachings. He doesn’t sugarcoat anything in the Bible and pushes people to go forward. Praise and worship team is amazing and there is a family like community in this church. I am so blessed to have found this place. The word of God is alive and fresh. Praise and worship definitely goes to the heavens and the father is glorified and the host of angels bow to worship too. Its a Bible believing church anyone looking to live a Christ-led life should join. This is a place where you get sound deep teaching I am definitely a witness of seeing miracles take place in this church. My life has gone up to high levels, since becoming a member. The presence of God resides in this place. I thank God for bringing me here. I love this place and all of the members. This place is a TASTE of HEAVEN on Earth! When I was down and out, a Stranger in their midst? Pastor Issac quickly assisted me and my son with URGENT SUPPORT NEEDED ON THE SPOT! The staff Michael and Keisha picked us up FAITHFULLY, checking into make sure we were alright? I can hardly wait to return so I can share the BLESSINGS the Love they showed us brought forth in our lives! GOD BLESS DOMINION LIFE! 🔥🏆🔥

name: Door of Hope Northeast
reviewSummary: Gritty, gospel-saturated community meeting in historic Northeast Portland, acclaimed for deep theological preaching, authentic transparency, and missional living.

name: Double Oak Community Church - Mt Laurel Campus - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: This is a very warm and welcoming community church. We look forward to attending when we visit family in Birmingham. God is good… Double Oak Community church welcomed my family and I and immediately included us in several events. The community at this church is exceptional, if you are looking for a place to belong and be loved this is it. The sermons are expositional and biblically accurate with amazing application to life today, the worship is diverse and includes many styles and types, and the children’s service is second to none. I highly recommend. After visiting alot of well known area churches, we felt that this church was the friendliest church in all of Birmingham! We immediately felt at home on our very first day visiting. Such a loving congregation! Didn't take us long to decide on joining this church! Double Oak is such a wonderful church. They genuinely love their community, pour into families and honor God with how they love others. I highly recommend this church. Incredibly leadership in Pastor Adam Robinson and the elders. Great church! This is such a wonderful, welcoming place. I have found a real church home here. Music, sermons,  staff, and people who attend are all the heart of this church.  You can feel God's presence when you walk through the doors.

name: Douglasville Church Of Christ - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary: Anything that has to do with the Lord in a good manner is wonderful.  This place is absolutely great I l9ve this church and everyone  there A great place to worship. Friendly

name: Dover Congregational Church - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary: Dover UCC is a very warm and friendly church where all are welcome. Pastor Keith's messages are inspiring and thought provoking. I love this church!!!! Reverend is kind humorous. Most of all great memory . Remembers everyone's name The minister gave a wonderful sermon for jeanette barclay. Had a meeting there.. clean and airy

name: Downtown Baptist Church Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
My friends go to this church, they like it, it's a beautiful building. I love architecture. My husband and I just moved to the downtown Orlando area and have been wanting to find a new church. We went this past Sunday and we are so happy that we did! Everyone was so sweet and welcoming! We waited to meet the pastors at the end of service and met Pastor Brandon. He was so kind and willing to listen to us and get to know us. We are excited to call Downtown Baptist Orlando Church our home 😊 excellent bible based church!!!  Perfect place for a new christian to start fresh in the downtown area. Been attending for 3 weeks now.  I love the Sunday School fellowship before service and the Music is awesome.  I can't wait till they form a choir some day.  Marty is very talented on the Organ.  I love the prelude and postlude music.  A very moving church with alot of growing going on. A staff member kicked me and two homeless friends off the premises at 5am this morning. We weren't causing any trouble or making a mess. We just needed a safe place to sleep because Orlando is very very dangerous at night. And I'm from Chicago so that says a lot!

My friends waited 5 minutes for me to return from the local restroom so the staff member called the police on us threatening trepass.

Nice Christians. These folks are obviously here to cater to the rich and get the pastor his new BMW.

Growing up my mother always told me that church was a "sanctuary". I guess the spirit of sanctuary passed this church over.

I have 3 interviews this week in effort to get back to good, and I have to sleep in the ghetto while this enormous building lies empty. And they won't even let me sleep on the sidewalk in front. Define "greed" As a Christian, this church makes me so sad. The way this church treats the homeless is just wrong. The homeless were given a guaranteed spot to sleep on the porch of Downtown Baptist(while they had spare buildings to accommodate for shelter if they wanted to) if they were registered with the church by giving their social security number. Their social security number brought in funding to the church that was never used for the homeless. It's as if this church prostitutes the homeless, in their own community, to line their own pockets. In order to eat or get a shower (only once a week) from Downtown Baptist, it was mandatory that the homeless attend their church service, however, the homeless were purposely segregated to their own homeless section, as if on display. During one service that a personal friend of mine was forced to attend just to eat and shower, the minister was speaking of how they were going to repaint the inside alter area. There was nothing wrong with the original paint job. The minister bragged about how he was going to spend $25,000 to hire a company in order to unnecessarily repaint. Meanwhile, a whole group of homeless were sitting there wanting to work. Something needs to be done about this, and the word needs to be spread. The sad thing is that this is not the only church doing this. As a Christian, please take a look at yourself, and your own church. Are you being the hands and feet that God asks you to be? Search your heart, and help the helpless.

name: Downtown Christian Church (DCC)
reviewSummary:
This is a small, welcoming congregation that has many benefits typically only found in larger churches. The talent and size of its music/worship team is almost twenty strong with many different instruments played. There is usually a different ecclesiastic bringing their own style and message each Sunday. And the setting inside the Goei Center is breathtaking- it's an old West Side factory turned beautiful event center, and the church rents the space for it's needs.

When we arrive on Sunday morning and the band has already begun, we can hear the bass and vocals pouring through the doors and it is energizing! The band plays more contemporary songs but they are so good it is like having a private concert each week! I find myself going to my Amazon account mid-week wanting to hear a song only to realize it is the church band! Went for sunday service. Very relaxed atmosphere and friendly people. This church is different from any church I've ever attended.  It's not legalistic and has a good understanding of God's grace and mercy in a very healthy way.  I'm actually excited to attend and tell people about my church for the first time in a very long time...... After having attended for a few years now it’s time to update my review. Being from the boomer generation at first DCC was “different” and “untraditional” (however they stick to a correct Biblical Worldview). Their heart towards people is amazing and comforting. If you are looking for Jesus and relationship with Him this is the place to find it. Love it here, I wish I had a ride i would keep going

name: Downtown Church at The Steeple - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: The Steeple was an amazing Venue for the wedding that we just attended. There were plenty of rooms that were decorated perfectly. The stained glass was breathtaking. Stairs were easy to navigate and there was even a elevator. A beautiful Venue. You won't be disappointed. Beautiful Location to attend church on Sunday mornings. We attend Downtown Church which meets each week at The Steeple. This historic building has the feel of "what church was like one hundred years ago. The location is used during the week for various events and weddings. If you are in need of a location Downtown to host an event, this is the place. A church turned into events venue. An amazing acoustic, ample rooms and great staff. If you are organizing something for more than 60ppl, this is the place. It’s a very nice venue for a wide array of events both small and large. Absolutely love this church

name: Downtown Church of Christ - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary: We went there the 1st time today and felt very welcomed. I've had a hard time making connections in church, but upon 1st visit, I feel like this is a good church. Very friendly members. We felt right at home and welcome This is a wonderful group of God’s people. They made me feel extremely welcome. They can really sing too! Friendly group of Christians doing God's work in God's way. Reverent, simple, scriptural worship.

name: Downtown Community Church - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary:
I never been there  my wife past September  n for the first time in my life im alone. A wonderful woman named Coroma n her son James brought me food for Thanksgiving I was crying tears of joy  im a senior.  N trying to start over at my age 65   she made me believe in humanity again. I miss my wife so much  just let the superiors at the Chu Great fresh service centered on Jesus Christ with authenticity and great message. I liked the enthusiasm and clearness of the sermon. THANK YOU.

Just been here again (work in town) and enjoyed the great service. Thank you guys. I’ve been a Christian for around 25 years.. fairly studied, and own a boxing gym… I’m not in the best environment to be fair all week.. but i gotta say/ going to this church to get invigorated to coach and inspire has been an awesome experience. I find myself going not for duty or religious obligation but to feel the love, the caring and to recharged.. Had a wonderful time and lovely people!!!! [object Object]

name: Downtown Cornerstone Church
reviewSummary: Reformed urban church in the heart of Seattle featuring verse-by-verse expository preaching, vibrant young adult community, and passionate city missions.

name: Downtown Harbor Church - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing community and church for our family.  Their services always have a great message to carry along throughout our days ahead.  Band is great. The people are so kind and love the child care during the service.  Highly recommended if you truly want to understand the scripture and how to apply it in your own life and modern day. Every Sunday my husband and I are there, pastor John and Adam are so great, the singers are fantastic   we want to stay longer, cant wait for Sundays to get here :) Good word and Good vibes, but more importantly, the pastors are knowledgeable of the word and intelligent. Great way to start your Sunday and a new week! I will be going back soon. God bless! ( only 4 stars because parking is a challenge). Amazing leadership team. From the moment you walk in you are welcomed, truly welcomed. Great music and practical real life messages add to the overall experience.

For those with children, the youth ministry is just as great. The staff and volunteers are focused on building relationships with the kids while providing the kids with biblical lessons they can relate to.

If you are looking for an authentic church home, where all are welcome no matter where you are in you walk, this is the place for you! I don’t believe there’s a “perfect” church
But we are traveling to visit mom here the next two weeks…. Since they’re closed next week I don’t get a second chance at an impression.
The singers could sing
The message was Christmas 101
This could be a two star
They could be four star
I’d have to be here 3+ services
But I never heard repent…
No salvation without repentance.

Jesus is Lord
Repent Believe Follow Jesus

name: Doxa Church
reviewSummary:
This church has quickly become a home for me! I first attended a service and a meet and greet event back in June, and I could tell that Doxa was a loving, God-honoring community. That impression has been proven accurate in the following months. Every staff member and member alike makes this church a safe, theologically sound environment for people to encounter Jesus, grow in faith, and be fruitful in community. I thank God for leading me here! I had been going to another church and started to feel led to be part of something different. Never occurred to me to go to Doxa. A friend told me about their experience and I decided to go. It has been nothing short of an amazing experience. The pastor is so real. His message always hits close to home. It is always relevant and I totally know what he's talking about. It's like it's for me. The people are easy to get to know. I would encourage you to become part of a missional community. I joined one and have been serving at the church as well. It's awesome how in just 6 months I have so many great relationships and totally feel like I belong. Thank you for creating such a welcoming environment. Most importantly it has helped me so much in my walk with the lord. I love it. Thank you pastor Jeff. We came to Doxa after searching for a new church coming out of Covid. The minute we walked into the church my wife and I both felt at home (e.g., welcoming, family oriented, right sized), and after hearing Pastor Eddie preach, participating in worship, and taking communion...we knew this is where we wanted to serve and build community.  The location in Redmond by Marymoor/Wholefoods is very convenient for us as well. I have been going to this church for almost 5 years and i love every single person i meet with. They are very caring, warm welcoming and friendly as well. The lead pastor Jeff is amazing. I will highly recommend if you are new to Bellevue areas and that are looking for a church near by. Stop by and meet new people in PNW. Doxa is home. The love for people, encouragement, service to the community and sound Bible teaching make this the best church for our family to call home. The church is so much more than dynamic preaching, it is about raising up people who believe in Jesus as our savior and sending them out into the world to demonstrate His love for us.

I encourage anyone looking around the area for a church home to strongly consider Doxa. Join a family dedicated to walking alongside those in the community regardless of what trials life brings. The worship is great, the kids ministry is growing, there is excitement for what God is doing in the area and there are seats waiting to be filled. See you Sunday!

name: Doxology Bible Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Regular attendee here. Wonderful church. My daughters funeral service was there. Can't say enough about the caring,kind people there We visited Doxology today while visiting our son for Family Weekend at TCU. We absolutely loved the welcoming culture, enthusiastic Kids Ministry team, authentic worship experience, excellence of the campus, and solid, biblical teaching from the Pastor. One of the college leaders personally introduced himself to our son, shared info about their college ministry and asked for his number to keep in touch with him - which meant the world to us as parents! We live over 500 miles away and knowing our son is connecting to this church was the cherry on top of the whole weekend. Thank you Doxology! Keep up the amazing work! This church is so amazing. Amazing pastors and such great people. I was close to calling this my home church until I got a divine calling to be somewhere else. I will definitely definitely be visiting and worshipping with them when I can still! Excellent place for all people!! My first time there today and the first 15 minutes seemed to be all about money, giving, and financials. I can find many other types of conviction that could be preached about except money. I don’t even know how you are helping the people here in the Fort Worth area who are struggling but instead, I see you are collecting money for missionaries to be in Argentina.
I’ve leave that you do not need to give to or through a church but directly to those who need it the most.
Thank you but I’m not sure if me and my family will be back. #ConflictedNotConvicted José Luis Camacho is the pastor, he is an amazing person, I learn a lot from him, the church is a Bible base church.

name: Dream City Church • Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
The Joseph zee ministries Voice of God conference was an experience of a lifetime! The church campus was beautiful and well kept. God is very familiar with His children here! Was there to Umpire a high school Varsity Softball game. Field was in terrible condition. Fair/foul lines were not chalked and the pitchers circle was not marked. Field had not seen water in a while. So amazing VBS 2025 was amazing! Our first time at the church. I cant wait to go to a Sunday service 😍 been to phx dream center many times and loved it. and Glendale didn't not disappoint ❤️ im so excited for next year's vbs This is a comment on Dream City School, not the church, because for some reason Google is not allowing people to leave reviews of the school, which is a shame because that would be helpful to parents in deciding whether to send their kids there or not. The school is overall a good school but can improve in the following areas:

1) Better communication with parents - there is none. These are your customers - receiving their feedback is essential for the success and improvement of the school. Without it you have an autocratic system, with it a more democratic system like the representative democracy we are truly blessed to live in. When parents feel they have a voice they will feel more like they belong there and are appreciated and their opinions matter - that results in loyalty and more of a sense of community. Patents should be represented on school board instead of  mysterious nameless, faceless individuals you can't reach (that email doesn't even work) that make significant decisions that affect other people's children that attend school there and don't care what parents of those children think. Students should also have a voice as elected student government that can discuss student concerns with administrators and school board members. I think the school board should be composed of parents of current students elected by all other parents, the elected presidents of the high school and elementary/junior high schools and the pastor. The PTA just does fundraising activities for the school - they don't represent parents or try to help parents address any concerns, questions, or desires about how the school does things. School administrators themselves appear not to be concerned at all about parental suggestions, concerns, or questions about school policies.

2) High school tuition is priced at $14,000 per year and the school doesn't appear to give discounts/financial aid to anyone except foreign students who are tall and very good basketball players. K-8th grade tuition is $10k annually. Why the difference? It appears the extra $4k in annual high school tuition is used to cover the cost of giving foreign basketball players free tuition plus free room and board. The question is why is having an awesome basketball team more important than offering more reasonably priced tuition to local residents? I don't know, but it appears that something like a third of the high school student body may be composed of these basketball players receiving free tuition and school-paid room and board using the extra $4,000 tuition payments made by local parents without their permission. The school billing is also not designed to work easily within the ESA program - parents must pay the tuition up front monthly then request reimbursement from the ESA program. To request the reimbursement, parents must make a special request from the school finance office to create quarterly receipts showing what parents paid for each student. There is a sibling discount. Registration related fees are over $500 per student.

3) The Uniform policy is very strict and rigid and expensive. I don't even know why private schools always insist that students all dress the same. Again, not very American or democratic. Communion and the prayer team are great. However, too many personal stories and not enough Scripture. It’s good to have stories as analogies so that the people can understand. Nevertheless, more Scripture ought to mentioned than personal stories. Posting Scriptures along with points would be better.

name: Dream City Church Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome. Very welcoming smiles on everyone.
So many great people serving with kids church for the children all ages babies to highschool.
Great camps for kiddos. Outreach amazing people. Thank you Pastor Matt and Pastor Melanie for everything you do Bless you and your family 🙏🙏🙏 They treat you like family, from the time you walk up for a complimentary refreshment, being welcomed by Melanie, and great worship and church service. They have children's ministries of all ages, an amazing staff and atmosphere to grow closer to the Lord. I don't understand how anyone can give a church a bad review. That's patently absurd and reprehensible!.If you don't feel comfortable or have your own reasons or judgments, go somewhere else. Let each person have an experience without trying to taint it. God bless them. Anyway, I absolutely love this church, and, despite having been critical in the past, I have an open mind and heart now. God has led me back here. I attended a second time today, as before, and I loved it. Always a great laugh too; nothing like hearing the word of God delivered with a great sense of humor. Joy for the morning, a good way to start the rest of your day. I will definitely return. I would like to go every Sunday, but, due to my schedule, I may not be able to. Thank you, Pastor, and I will pray for you as you asked for during the service today. We all need prayer, right? "The devil prowls around.” Thank you again! “For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.”
— Galatians 1:10 (ESV)

We’ve been attending this church since 2014. It’s led by faithful and courageous leaders. Though there have been ups and downs—and at times, hard truths that needed to be spoken—they have remained steadfast.

In California, it’s rare to find a church that boldly preaches the uncompromised truth of God’s Word, even when it’s not widely accepted.

I pray that this church continues to reach more hearts, drawing people closer to Jesus through love, truth, and unwavering faith. ❤️ While this is a very beautiful church, and the pastor is sweet.... it just lacks that fire. Also my family and I came a few times and for Easter a church group leader singled my family out multiple times about random things that other members and leaders were doing and also approve of. Super judgmental and felt very unseen. I dont know if it's bc we were newer or bc we are a diverse family but the way she made me feel on multiple occasions gave me the ick. We genuinely tried with this church but it's safe to say it isn't for us. ALSO there is like 30+ groups here and there wasn't any talk about an addiction group, single mothers group, helping homeless people....So that was what also contributed to my decision.  I hope this church does well on it's future endeavors tho!

name: Dublin Baptist Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
Great services.. My son used to go in Mom's day out (play school program). The teachers are so kind and amazing. The director is very friendly and kind hearted. They keep on conducting kids enrichment program, which is amazing. Also in Summer there is a Summer camp for kids.I like the way they organize it. Wonderful, inclusive church, where the true gospel of Jesus Christ is preached and lived.
Classic and contemporary services are available on Sunday at different times.

It has Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Spanish, Portuguese and maybe more services going on with small groups. ESL classes are also available!

Kids care is great. My son and daughter learn so much about the Bible and have fun with activities. They particularly love VBS.

Staff is very attentive and caring! This is a wonderful place to meet people of all nations, connect in a Bible study, and let your children grow in Sunday School. We have many special events for the community and members to gather throughout the year! It's very much a traditional Southern Baptist church in Ohio.  The youth group is cliquish, kids whose parents are not involved in the church are treated like tag-alongs or outcasts, they don't really take an interest in the spiritual wellbeing or development of youth.  If the parents aren't involved, don't expect your kids to ever be invited to anything outside the scheduled events.  A number of families have been involved for a very long time and treat it like they own the church--if you're not them you're kinda part of the decor.  A lot of hyprocisy which isn't Biblical imperfection striving to serve Jesus...it's really just hypocrisy. Reason for two stars instead of one is they've long had a great Japanese ministry with a caring, dedicated leader of that congregation. Our family came for a visit, and loved the warmness of the Pastor and church family so much that we became members of the church! The Pastor teaches God's Word with a truth and sincerity of heart, and everyone is so welcoming! If you are seeking a church family and good friends, a supportive environment and sound teaching, and opportunities to be a blessing to others, we recommend Dublin Baptist Church!

name: Dublin Community Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has TWICE helped my family! Full of godly, sweet, selfless people who genuinely CARE about their people! This church helped people they didn't even know, people they only knew needed help. This church is the example of people Jesus asked for. The reason for humanitarians. I've never seen such a giving, selfless church in my life! (And my father was a preacher). This is the best example God left for people helping one another and keeping hope for the human race alive! We are all a family, young, old, rich, poor, fat, skinny. We all are a product of Adam and Eve. And this church represents what family means and how we should all be a part of helping our fellow man. I'll never forget what they have done for my family! God bless these people and their families! I have been "a friend of" Dublin Community Church [United Church of Christ] for much of my life though I have been able to attend events there only occasionally.

I had grown up at a different United Church of Christ [UCC] church in central Ohio [First Congregational Church in Columbus] so I have been familiar, over the years, with many of Dublin Community Church's programs and efforts.

Several weeks ago [4-9-2022], I attended a "Coming Together for Ukraine" concert to raise money to help those who have been impacted by the current war in Ukraine. The church had been filled to capacity; nearly $22,000 had been raised.

While waiting for that concert to begin, I heard two people, clearly non-members of Dublin Community Church, sitting in the row behind me, speaking with each other about that church. I overheard one of them say to the other at one point, "I hear that they are a great church. They welcome gay people."

For many years, Dublin Community Church [UCC] has been an "Open and Affirming" UCC congregation that has made "a public covenant of welcome into their full life and ministry to persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and gender expressions."

I learned, after the 4-9-2022 "Coming Together for Ukraine" concert had ended but before I had decided to leave for home, that Dublin Community Church [UCC] hosts WORD, Women of Religious Diversity, a multi-faith women's group of 40-50 women who meet on Friday mornings for Bible study, book discussion, support, and fellowship.

If you are looking for a friendly UCC congregation that truly welcomes all, I strongly recommend Dublin Community Church. A very nice church where I spent a pretty cool time with the Young Ambassadors.
Greetings to Bob Very friendly, has food pantry for community and the church hosts outside organizations. Lovely place

name: Dublin-Powell Church of Christ - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: A very wholesome church with friendly folks. Nothing negative here. So much love here!! Very welcoming church Great sermon given Lovely place

name: Dublin-Powell Church of Christ - Powell / Delaware South Campus
reviewSummary: A very wholesome church with friendly folks. Nothing negative here. So much love here!! Very welcoming church Great sermon given Lovely place

name: Duc Me Hoa Binh Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I was fortunate enough to visit Our Lady at this location twice. The last time I went, I was looking for a new job and asked her to help me find one. Shortly after returning home, I received a job offer from a company I didn’t think would hire me. This place is very popular with the Vietnamese community, and I can see why, Our Lady does not say no to those who run to her. There is a beautiful Virgin Mary here that you can come visit. There are many people that bring flowers to adorn this statue. You should come by here and see this & enjoy the sunny weather as it is located directly across from the beach. We love the Virgin Mary. Stopped by to check this out as every time I drive by, regardless of time of day, there is a huge crowd around it.

There seems to be a never ending cycle of worshippers coming to pay respects and then homeless people coming and stealing the donations.

Supposedly this Virgin Mary statue was ordered to remain by the Buddhist monks that took over the property, which unsurprisingly was a convent prior to becoming a monastery. Our Lady turned her eyes to the sea as a sign to always watch over the fishermen and boats. Around Our Lady, there are always beautiful flower pots, Catholics from all over the world visit her and pray with her. May Our Lady bless us and the whole world. This has become a place of comfort for many elders within my family and community. As Catholics they come to seek solace in times of distress and gratitude in times of joy. Every so often my mom would ask me to drive her here so she could visit Mary. It’s where all my aunts and uncles near and far ask to visit when they’re in town. Just a few quiet moments of reflection and we’re off. Yet somehow those few moments make them feel better, happy as if they’ve visited a loved one. While my devotion is not nearly as strong as theirs, I still find myself saying a soft prayer ever time I’m there. This has become a significant location for Vietnamese Catholics. It overlooks the ocean and is surrounded my bouquets of flowers year round.

name: Dulles Church of Christ
reviewSummary: CoC in general has a very personal feel. Many members are connected to other CoC churches nationwide. There are no frills - just simple Bible study and hymn worship Sundays and Wednesdays. This is the distinction of a local CoC community. Attendance for the purpose of consistent fellowship is prioritized. This local community is very warm and engaging. It's a mixed demographic from nearby rural and urban neighborhoods. The majority are educated professionals in the Defense, IT, and policy disciplines. Lots of kids which is attractive to young families looking for commonality. Great Church family! Sound Church with kind Brethren. Good place! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Duluth First United Methodist Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary: I live in the neighborhood, part of my almost daily walks is to traverse the large parking lots and circle the church. The building is beautiful. Particularly I like the stained glass windows depicting many of the gospel stories. Sometimes I will stop to consider the art and meditate on the stories. And there is an interesting cross in the back, I am thinking constructed by a creative youth group? Along the way I have met the contemporary church pastor and was invited to worship, very kind thing to do. Once I was searching for a lost dog, the custodians went out of their ways to be kind and helpful. I think all this reflects on a good church, I am honored to be their neighbor. I have been a member of this church for almost 30 years and have raised my children in this wonderful, caring community. I am proud to belong to such a loving congregation who exemplify the best of what it means to be a Christian. Main sound system not working. Beautiful sound from organ. Christmas music was good Staff, clergy, and members are friendly, sincere, and welcoming. This is a church where you can learn about, grow with, and serve God. The music is great, the outreach is great and the congregation is amazing. Sunday school is available for children and adults. Cub scouts, girl scouts, boy scouts, and other social activities meet on campus throughout the week. There is a place for everybody. As I am assisting a friend with gathering her rent we called here and the receptionist Tracy straight out said, "Sorry ma'am we aren't offering ANY assistance." She did not refer, put a extra thought or even offer a PRAYER. Its amazing we tithe to the very churches that make you fill a form out (if you're lucky)  or simple tell you no when its YOU that needs the help. The way she cut us short was absolutely amazing. But what if the IRS did that when they want to  claim non-profit???

name: Dunwoody Baptist Church - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary: Love everything about this church.  The  Pastors are very caring and kind. Great church for families with children. Great childrens programs. Large teenager programs. Lots of opportunities for mission trips. A bible believing church. Traditional service at 8:00 AM. Sunday school on campus at 9:45 AM. Contemporary service at 11:00 with great music and singers. No hipocrisy here. A great place to make friends. A great place to worship. Wholesome! Lively! Beautiful building My church for 40 years and it keeps getting better.  Sr. Pastor Allen Jackson is an excellent teacher of the Bible. Come see for yourself. Great place for pickleball! 3 courts Indoors!

name: Dunwoody Community Church - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary:
My First visit was on First Sunday in November and they gave COMMUNION!! PRAISE JESUS!!
Along with receiving Communion, the warm friendly welcome as I entered DCC, awesome Worship team, and the Great Message from the Pastor taught from the book of ACTS, made it a Winning Sunday Visit!!
I'm looking forward to returning SOONER than later... 🙌🙌🙌🙌 Best Christmas concert EVER. So professional, and interesting. Various artists. So talented. Loved all of it, especially SEVENFOLD group. DCC is one of the greatest family churches I have ever been to. Having said that I miss the family and friends I found there. The teachings and fellowship are wonderful, check out DCC and make it your home church. They know how to welcome you in. Other churches I've been to push me away and stared at me. Dunwoody community church VERY WELCOMING AND FRIENDLY PEOPLE Best worship for Christ Jesus

name: Dunwoody United Methodist Church - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary: A lovely place to start your Sunday morning. I've been honored to play drums at the modern worship service a few times. Great folks! I just love this church!! Very warm people and I love the sermons always. Keep up the great work. You reach a lot of people with the love and unforgettable messages I've been a member of Dunwoody United Methodist Church since 2010 and joining has been one of the best choices I've made.  I've seen my daughter grow in confidence and depth of faith through the wonderful children's programs like choir, drama, Sunday School, Youth groups and soccer. My wife and I are very active and consider many other members some of our closest friends.  The pastors and staff are amazing too. The friendliest most welcoming congregation. Lots of activities for all ages continually. Whether contemporary or traditional they never disappoint. The ministering staff is exceptional. I don't like this school. My son was going to this school  for 2 years old . He wasn't speaking and delayed. I got him evaluated at clinic and public school system and shared details with the school. Instead of getting support from there they suggested me pull off my son and enroll in public school system . They didnt give him admission for 3 year saying seats are full . I must say thank you for not letting him in . Though I felt very bad at that time but it was blessing in disguise. I enrolled him another school and he did great . Racist and un - supportive school.

name: Dwell Community Church - 4th Street Pavilion - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent coffee at great prices. Delicious bagels! Very friendly staff. Good place to study or just chill. Free wifi. Saw this place had great reviews went in got some coffee very friendly guy named Dan? Whatever... coffee was great. Lowkey what also impressed me was how sturdy these Cups are. I mean like I'm just grabbing this coffee with really gross hands and this cup is not deteriorating at all keeping my coffee warm in a cold environment. My coworker got a latte and he loved it too Have been a member for MANY years. It's not the perfect church but there isn't a perfect church on earth! It's not a "cult" either! I have enough backbone to stand up for what I believe!  No one has ever controlled me or forced me to do anything I didn't want to! name: Dwell Community Church Main Campus - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to this church for years and the Scientology documentary made me realize this church is cult like. They teach Christianity but it’s very similar to Scientology where you pay for classes to move up the ranks, very political and social. No boundaries and nothing is private. It’s very hard to leave here and if you do, you are basically excommunicated from everyone. Speaking from experience. Have had a wonderful experience with Dwell. The community here is welcoming and warm to all.  You will find no worship music during teaching, which I actually enjoy, but can be a turn off for some I understand. The kids programs are amazing and our two years attending vacation bible school here have been a fantastic experience! Been going to this church for a couple years. I have really enjoyed the focus on community and teaching straight from the Bible.
I have especially appreciated the support by the community during tough times of grief. I was visiting my son one weekend and went to a service with him and his wife.  I LOVED the teaching!!  I wish I could find one that teaches for an hour with no announcements, and no singing for 30 min.  After the sermon there was a Q & A session for about 15 or so minutes about the sermon.  Never ever I ever been to a church like that.

This may be considered a cult but I loved the Bible teachings and format they use.  I wish I could find one where I live. It's not that there's no truth taught here, but there are lots of spiritual landmines and you are very likely to step on at least some of them. I personally didn't experience the control or manipulation some have claimed, nor did I witness drunkenness. Still, I believe there are better choices.

The only thing that bothers me as a 69 year old woman is the music is beautiful, but way too loud. At my age I dont want to lose any more of my hearing then I already have. name: Eagle Pointe Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary: Great friendly place to get your God on! Cool music, real messages that touch your heart and people that are down to earth and really friendly. The pastor is  a passionate "Puertican Deacon" named Tim Roman who is a caring guy who will make you smile. This church has gone through some changes in the last few years, but now it seems it is a fresh new church and a clean, pure mission to meet and helps its visitors. Eagle Pointe Church is a very loving place. You will be welcomed as family and Pastor Tim Roman and the elders teach the word of Jesus straight from the Bible. If you are lost and looking for a second chance in life, this is the place to help get u started. My Mom & I knew God existed but after being raised in a Catholic family, we cut religion out of our lives. We started going to EPC & today, faithfully believe in Jesus & know how wonderful & miraculous he is. Give it a try one Sunday 10am, u will LOVE it! such a good place I went here as a 4 year old in 2015 for preschool they are so sweet!   you don't have to worry about your kids when you go to church because they have a class room where your kids are doing crafts while being supervised by a adult. they also do camp here my little brother Ayden goes here for camp all the time before the pandemic hit this is where he met his best friend. Eagle Pointe Church is a very welcoming and warm place. The messages are deeply spiritual, yet down to Earth and practical. The staff is full of dedicated people who truly love God and care about others, and the congregation is full of people who share the same passion for Christ and the community. EPC incredibly manages to turn the experience of the church stereotype on its head. The people are genuinely friendly, openly honest, and sincerely care about everyone. You walk in the door and you are WELCOME. Make no mistake, EPC is strongly bible-based. They proudly say their "head of this church is Jesus Christ", instead of one of their many talented teachers of God's Word. Come. Relax. Make a new friend. Smile and give Glory to your Father in Heaven. Experience getting as close as you can get to Joy on Earth. Worship. Sing. Get connected to extraordinary people serving a Loving God. Welcome Home.

name: Eagle Rock Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Eagle Rock Baptist Church (ERBC) since 1993, when they planted a church in their building, and it has truly been my church home ever since.

Pastor Rick, Andrew, Seth, James, Raquel, and Judy are all incredible people who genuinely care about others. From the moment you walk through the doors, they make you feel welcomed, valued, and like you’re part of a family.

ERBC also has a wonderful children’s ministry and youth ministry, along with small groups that make it easy to build meaningful relationships and grow in your faith.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll find biblical teaching, authentic community, and people who truly love and serve others, I highly recommend ERBC. It’s been a blessing to my life for many years, and I’m grateful to call it my church family. I was on a mission to find a church for community to help build a better relationship with God, and that is exactly what I found here. I first was able to try the Sunday sermons by livestream, and I absolutely loved how their lessons are focused on the Word and how their staff are knowledgeable on context and history. And then I went in for my first Sunday service, and the community immediately welcomed me with open arms. The people here are so kind and friendly, and they encouraged me to participate in everything from feeding the homeless to women bible study. I really wish I could have stayed in the area for this church alone because I know it will be hard to find a community like this one. More people, More like Jesus.

5 years ago, in the darkness of COVID, God led us to this little church. We were searching for a Bible-based community where we could hear God’s Word and where our children could put down roots.

We live in days where “due to the increase of wickedness, our hearts have grown cold.”  It’s all too easy to align ourselves with churches that fit our preferences or political views. (I confess this sin right here!) But this is not that kind of church. ERBC is Jesus-focused. Only in the presence of Jesus can our stone hearts truly melt—and here, our hearts melted.

Pastor Rick is a gifted speaker with a sense of humor that appeals to everyone—think dry, British-style humor—while Pastor Andrew takes us deep into the Bible with thoughtful, challenging teaching. We love them both, and we are so grateful for all the servants here at ERBC.

In just five years, reading and hearing God’s Word has transformed us—and continues to transform us every single day.

If you are looking for validation of who you voted for, this is not the place. But if you want Jesus—more of Jesus—this is exactly where you need to be. This church is home to a diverse community of welcoming individuals.  I feel the makeup of the church reflects the makeup of the city. They are welcoming to families, and my two elementary-school aged kids have enjoyed going to Sunday school and have made friends. Eagle Rock Baptist Church has been a second home for me. I’ve been in attendance at this church for now going on 7 years. From the first day up until now I’ve grown spiritually-through life group, mental-through understanding the word, intellectually-through the importance of community, and financially-through understanding how money works when God’s word is applied.

I’m alway eager to return to church on Sunday’s & Wednesday’s to learn more about the word with like minded people. Though I’ve become like family to many of the members at ERBC. I can’t help, but to think about how difficult life would be without a covering of Christ while doing life.

I believe that we the people are the church, and God is within us. From the first time I attended ERBC I was able to see that same model duplicated throughout all the members, pastors and other individuals attending sermons.

ERBC has made coming to the house of the Lord a safe and friendly environment for families to grow together in Christ while striving to be exceptional at loving people. If you have a family & your interests in growing not only a community, but knowledge and understanding of the word with your children & God ERBC Is most definitely the place for you!

Hope to see you there!

reviewSummary:

name: East Sarang Community Church - Chino Hills Campus

reviewSummary:
