reviewSummary: If you're looking for a place where the Gospel is shared well from the pulpit, fellowship and love abound in the people, and you appreciate the beauty of liturgy- this is the place for you. An added plus is weekly communion. Pastor Eric is wonderful and the congregation is welcoming (without being creepy ;-)). I have been going to ECPC for a few weeks now. I came from a larger church and  I love this small young, and friendly congregation. I was made to feel at home on my very first visit! The pastor and sermons are wonderful and biblically based. The fellowship here is warm and people stay after church for food and fellowship and don't rush out when the service is over. Love worshiping at El Camino. They welcomed us in from the start and have been so genuine in their care for my family. The preaching is always so encouraging and I love their mission as a church! El Camino is a welcoming church with great community and solid teaching. Whenever I'm able to show up for worship here, it makes my week! El Camino is a great family friendly church community with focus on worshiping the Lord together as a spiritual family

name: El Getsemani United Methodist Church - Orange Campus
El Getsemani United Methodist Church - Santa Ana Campus
El Toro Baptist Church-International - Lake Forest Campus
Element Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place to get community and receive biblical teachings. You get a real sense of belonging there. There’s no place like it. My church stands out for its warm and welcoming atmosphere, fostered by its genuine nature of is members. A sense of love and care is felt from the moment you enter. Under Kelly’s guidance and Tracie’s hospitable spirit the church feels like home away from home. Element Church is truly something special! From the moment you walk in, you feel like family. It’s a spirit-filled environment where God’s presence is real, and people genuinely care. The messages are powerful, the worship is passionate, and there’s something for everyone—kids, youth, and adults alike. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, this is it! Me and my wife have been coming to this church for over a year and a half now.

We have met so many people that truly love God and are so friendly and supportive here.

If you are looking for a spirit lead Church that aims to equip you for Gods Kingdom. This is the one to go to! This church provides an uplifting worship experience and insightful biblical teachings. The community is welcoming, and the sermons are both powerful and enlightening. It's a wonderful place to grow in faith and connect with others.

name: Element3 Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm still listening to old CDs from this church. They just gave them away for free over 15 years ago but the CDs are still bearing fruit. Thank you. People here are dedicated to understanding God's word and bringing His word to the world.
There are many ways to serve the community and the world. A Wonderful & welcoming house of worship where one can become a disciple of Christ, find ways where you can help and serve others near & far. Increase your knowledge and understanding of Scripture.

E3 has become my spiritual home. I love how inclusive this church is. So welcoming to everyone who wants to worship at every phase of their faith journey. I am very grateful to have been able to call Element3 Church home over the past few years. Our church has been cautious through the pandemic, but we have been faithful and committed to continue creating opportunities for worship, even when those opportunities have been digital. I'm really excited about our progress as our country finds its way beyond the pandemic, and I'm looking forward to seeing God do amazing things in the years to come. Are we the right church family for you to learn to follow Christ in? I hope so. We'd love for you to come out and visit and see. You can also join us online each Sunday at 10:00 AM at element3.online.church.

name: Elevate Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church, my wife and I have been going for a few weeks now and they do a great job of making everyone feel welcome and grow closer with Christ. If you are looking for a church in Lexington I highly recommend you check out Elevate! Just took my 10 yr old daughter to their Easter egg hunt! Sooooo many eggs! Most places you have to pay and they limit what the kids can get. EVERY child had an overflowing basket! Plus free hot dogs and chips! So nice! They also had a separate field for ages Three and under. Thank you so much for everyone who put that together.
I was really impressed! I am brand new to Lexington and I was invited to this church a little over a month ago! If you are looking for a church that will open its arms and welcome you from day one, then look no further! The nicest people and church I have come across in years! The sermons are informative and easy to relate!  I feel like I have found a new family and community of people that truly care!! The best! Amazing. Genuine. Courageous servants of Jesus. Love these people

name: Elevate Church - Alexandria Campus
reviewSummary:
I happened to join my mom for church service while visiting one weekend and I fell in love with Elevate, the sense of community, the diversity, and the message and pastor of course was everything I’d been looking for in a church. It just feels right. Unfortunately I don’t live in VA, but I happily tune in every Sunday morning virtually. And whenever I visit family, I make sure to visit in person🫶🏾 Was looking for a “woke” church and I’ve found it. No mentions of how they're going to change politics, no stereotypical religious ideologies, etc. Truly people following Christ/the Word of God. Fun experience but they didn’t provide any snacks. Everything a church should be. I hadnt been to church in several years; mainly due to leadership trust issues. I decided it was time to search again. Ive been attending Elevate for 4 months consistently, inconsistently a for a few months prior to. The regular attenders (no membership) are so welcoming and actually ask questions to get to know you. Its not forced or awkward. I cant say enough great things about the pastor and his wife. Genuinely caring and always acting in the best interest of others. You wont know who they are unless you go to a service. Why? Because they give all glory to God and don’t want their names and pictures plastered all over the internet. This is a church where you can actually have conversations with the leaders and feel like you have matter. Every sermon is Bible centered teaching, practical thoughts, without the guilt and judgement. And its never boring because there are always hilarious jokes throughout. Just normal down to earth good people. I really do love this church family! First time visitor and the people were VERY FRIENDLY! I love they have coffee while you can listen to the sermon. Pastor spike from the Bible and he shared his stories to encourage hope. I like that there were no hollering, screaming into the mic preaching or nobody running around the church and passing out! LOL. Just good ole’ church.
It’s a small church doing BIG THINGS!

We going back for Bible study this Wednesday!

name: Elevate Church - Midland Campus
reviewSummary:
I travel the country and visit many different churches every Sunday and this one by far stands out and is worth the visit !! Amazing atmosphere, welcoming people and a great preacher ! This a very good Church. If I was staying in town I would join a lot of their groups. Pastor Sheldon is awesome 😎 and his wife Sarah too. She sings beautifully. Thank you. ❣️ I’ve been coming alittle over a year o decided maybe 4months back to actually get “involved” in the church. It’s such a big church it’s easy to feel left out but if you put the effort to join a group your automatically made to feel like family.

Pastor Sheldon may not be some people’s cup of tea but I know the Word of God intimately and he preaches straight from it. I’m yet to hear something that doesn’t align with Bible. I have heard some things I don’t think a pastor should be saying but everyone will cry about something wherever they go. You’re not gonna find the perfect church until we get to heaven so be the church out here. If you are looking for a good church,  here it is! I've traveled through many states and have attended many churches in the past 45 years. This one is one of my all time favorites! The Pastors here are Awesome. Th he church family welcomed me and greeted me with friendship and care. I love it! I highly recommend! #TcMacDesigns You can really feel the holy spirit at this church. My family loves it here. The men's group is amazing. Pastor Sheldon and the rest of the team are so passionate and loving.

name: Elevate Church - Moore Campus
reviewSummary:
We are full time RV’ers and stopped by when passing through the OKC area and so glad we did. The people were friendly and welcoming, the worship was meaningful and the pastor taught Gods word faithfully. If we pass through OKC again we will definitely stop by but if you live in the area check them out. We've been attending for six years! This is our family now. You feel God's presence as soon as you walk through the doors! Best church I have ever had the pleasure of being a part of. Pastor Steven Earp is enthusiastic and passionate. His sermons are always heart felt and based 100% in Scripture. I could listen to his message for hours! Since being at Elevate I have come to have a much better understanding of what a true church family looks like. There are no cliques here and everyone treats you like family from the first time you attend. Elevate is very active and invested in the community. If you are looking for a church that will feed you spiritually, led by a Pastor that is passionate about the Lord, and where you will always feel welcome then I encourage you to give Elevate a try. This has been my 2nd home for 11 years now. The community is so strong and the way the staff care for people is something I have only seen there. Love this place. 5 month update: out and about in Moore, on separate occasions, I ran into TWO DIFFERENT FAMILIES with autistic children who had really bad experiences at Elevate. I am sure this is a sign from the Lord that the horrific abuse of my family wasn't our fault, but just the natural consequence of standing up to bullies. I wonder how many other people in our community are broken and bruised from this church. I am so sorry for anyone who shares this pain, this trauma of being abandoned by your entire support system. We believed them for years when they claimed to be family. When they preached unity, forgiveness and love. They are so good at marketing.

Nobody from Elevate leadership has checked in to see how my family is doing. I am still really traumatized, I feel sick to my stomach just driving down 4th Street past Broadway. I am terrified to entrust my children with a church again. However, I'm incredibly thankful my family is free from this charade. At a park, we ran into a former kids church worker who had known my kids since they were tiny. He said am uncomfortable "hi" and quickly escaped. A guy who spread lies about my family and said the most horrific disgusting traumatizing things to me by messenger. Probably still teaches the children's church with a big smile every Sunday, without any care for the broken people so easily discarded.

Also, they censor their social media: anything unflattering is deleted & users blocked.

(Original)
Expect spiritual abuse and bullying. Not sensory friendly. I've attended and participated here for 7 years. We were shunned over a bench and a sideshow. I suggested a bench by the back door because my autistic son was always stressed by the loud music and loud lobby- he wears sensory headphones, but those can only go so far. My son would sit on the hard concrete to destress, while he waited on my husband and I serving. Oh, and we served for 7 years. My husband literally built many parts of the church. I designed the exterior, installed tile, drywall, painted and so much more. But suggesting a bench ( we even offered to buy our build it!) got me on the pastors bad side, because I used the term "sensory friendly". And they misunderstood that, thinking I was accusing the church of being unfriendly.

Then, the sideshow was the notorious Power Force. The elders were not even asked before this sleazy group was brought in, and taking to some different church members, I was not the only one who saw through the charade and felt disappointed about Elevate promoting it. But for simply expressing my disappointment,  I was blocked from MY church's social media. Without even a call or text. If this wasn't traumatic enough, Pastor Jermaine and Rene chewed me out in the middle of the church lobby, during Sunday service. With I had a panic attack,  trouble breathing and needed to step out,  Jermaine mocked me, saying, "oh sure just run away!"

Then he demanded we go in front of all the elders, and that's not ideal for someone with anxiety disorder. But we met with 2 elders, who acted like they cared but afterwards shunned us and wouldn't communicate on messenger. I think these kind of people want "in person" meetings so they can intimidate you, and there is no written record.

Shunned by our church "family". My kids were really hurt. Almost everyone in our social support system ghosting us as we go through one of the most traumatic events as a family. Acting like we never existed. Telling gossip behind our backs, but not actually talking to us. Blocking us online.

Good families don't shun each other. They talk it out, they keep trying. They are patient. Elevate is none of that. Please, don't let your kids experience this. No one deserves to be humiliated and abandoned because they unintentionally hurt the pastors ego. We autistic and adhd folks already spend our lives trying so hard to fit in, but even then we struggle to be socially acceptable. I thought this church was a safe place for people like me, like my socially challenged sons (Think sheldon from big bang theory).

name: Elevate Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place my family and I get to call home.  The Sunday school teachers are trustworthy and their curriculum is bible truth. The pastors are phenomenal and they truly walk the narrow path that leads to life.  Grateful to God that such a community exists and have taken us in as one of their own.  This church is the church that Christ intended. Loving one another and not playing religious games.  Solid doctrine and Pastor Mauricio is a man of prayer.  A man after God’s own heart. Hard to find genuine nowadays. Shining in the darkness brightly. I love this church! You will too. Non-denominational Christian church that teaches the bible as it should be taught. Their goal is for you to know God, and make him known. Not watered down. Pastor Mauricio is the real deal. He talks the talk and walks the walk. You'll notice the difference from just one visit. What happened to other night was truly special.. every Wednesday night is special.. but sometimes you can feel the presence of the Lord Jesus Christ fill the entire building.. a thick anointing.  Thank you Jesus for forgiving our sins and blessing us, day after day. Love pastor Mauricio and you can tell he loves Jesus with all his saved heart. God bless the associate pastors Chris and Henry. A great church to finally be planted in!!  A lot of churches are mislead, lost, deceptive and empty spiritually.. not this place! I attend this church for 7 months and I decided to find another church. The pastor is more interested in your money than he is getting to know you.  The majority of the people that serve in the church are stuck up and act like they’re better than everyone else and it’s because the pastor sets the example. The worship is good but the pastor and others there act like they’re better than you. I left this church because it was the best thing for me and I just wanted to share my experience there. And the reason I lasted 7 months is because a friend of mine went there with his family and I didn’t want to hurt his feelings but I finally had to tell him that I started attending a better church. 3/3 UPDATE: documents were provided only after posting a review

This place seems genuine up front but after attending for 6 months I witnessed Pastor Mauricio and the ushers get physically aggressive with a person in the church during worship. I was so appalled that I have not been able to trust another church. Lastly I gave tithes and donations to this church for which I am yet to receive any tax documents for.

name: elevate church HI
reviewSummary:
As someone who was not raised with church upbringings, and unfamiliar with being a Christian, I can tell you that I'm usually very uncomfortable when I attend church and could never bring myself to attend faithfully. But Pastor Dennissa and Pastor Zach really bring a different and very comfortable vibe in their church. They make you feel welcome, respected, and they don't put you on the spot and announce your attendance when you first start attending like some other churches do. For me, this is a very important thing and helps the process to transition feeling comfortable at your own pace.
But at the same time, they make you feel like family.
The church is a smaller, more intimate church, that definitely does not have you feeling like you're just another member attending the church, but more like a family member, being welcomed into their home, and it's awesome!!
You feel like their messages are spoken directly to you, and for you too. Just be careful, because they will definitely get you all emotional and make you cry lol, but in a good way! After leaving their services, you feel revived, recharged, renewed, and ready to face the everyday battles you have been facing, but this time, you don't feel so alone, facing them.
Elevate is also a family friendly church, and has definitely brought my 11 year old daughter and I closer to each other, and to lord together, and I'm grateful for that and them.
I highly recommend this church, and hope that if you read this, you will consider checking the church out, and maybe l'll see you there! Friendly, inspiration ✨️, soild, teachable message bible base, 🙏 powerful prayers, Caring n 😇 kind. True aloha spirit shared with each one. Welcome coffee or 🍵 ☕️, smiles n hugs if like. Real down to 🌎 peoples. Pastor Zach n co pastor Dennisa Bumgardner.  Better in person.  Worship from the ❤️. ♥️🤍🕊💙🌻🐝🏝🐬⚓️✨️🙏😎 I’ve been making Elevate my home church since June of this year. I love the pastors here and the people here are so friendly. It’s a smaller church which is nice because it feels like everyone is family here. The messages are short and sweet and the worship is great. I love what this church has done for me and my hope is that everyone who visits Elevate has a similar experience to mine. We have seen the signs for this church along the roads and didn’t stop until one Sunday. We are so glad we did! What an excellent pastor and team! The church messages are delivered with great heart and the church itself is amazing. Convenient location as well. Very welcoming and you feel like family. Amazing church ! I've gone all my life never feeling like I fit in or belong at church until I walked through the doors here. I like that it's small and intimate. Everyone gets to know each other real quick! That's probably my favorite thing about Elevate, are the people. Pastor Dennisa and Pastor Zach are so genuine in their faith and want to ensure that everyone at Elevate feels seen, heard and welcome. Welcome to show up as they are and welcome to freely and comfortably explore their faith. Everyone is on their own journey and you are not expected to come in as someone you are not, but as the person you are. Flaws and all. I am so grateful for this church, for the people of the church and for the opportunity to grow my faith alongside those who are there to support me every step of the way. Elevate is my home ♥️

name: Elevate City Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary:
My partner and I have now had two disappointing experiences at Elevate City Church, and unfortunately we won’t be returning.

A few months ago, we attended a sermon where a speaker shared a story about a woman being “saved” not only from drug addiction, but also from “becoming a lesbian,” framing it as part of a sinful lifestyle of “doing whatever you want.”  and very clearly looking down upon people of this marginalized group. The message came across as deeply uncomfortable, hurtful, and, frankly, bigoted. We left feeling like LGBTQ+ people are not truly welcomed or respected in this church, which goes against the "come all" messaging our Father has taught us.

We decided to give it another chance today (Easter Sunday), but ran into another issue. We checked both the church’s website and Google, which listed the service time as 11:30 AM. We arrived about 5 minutes early, only to find the sermon was already mostly over. We were there for maybe 20 minutes total before everything wrapped up. The remainder of the service felt rushed, there was a quick message about giving your life to God, a connection card prompt, a song, a very brief prayer, and then it ended.

Between the misleading service time and our previous experience with the messaging, we are left feeling frustrated and unwelcome at this church. We were really hoping for a meaningful Easter service, but this didn’t meet our expectations. My godmother Sherri flora and godbrother helped found elevate city ! Both Sherri and Kyle helped bring a Christ centered church to Fort Wayne . Elevate city church is a church that helps individuals find their purpose that God created them for. Elevate city is a church about helping bring people closer Christ despite their imperfections and faults. Elevate city  also makes it a priority to always follow Gods world and not the way of the world. Elevate city is a place where you can find the love of Christ demonstrated through the individuals of the church. I started going here during my daughters and I time at Charis house, and, there have been ups and downs, but hearing some of the messages, have been really good.
I really respect Pastor Matt for going out of his way to help my family last year, as well. Amazing church that is for the city and for the people that attend it. You are guaranteed to feel at home at this church. This church has the kindest people that are ready to serve and assist you . Give it a chance! Very inviting.  Talented staff.  Well put together and thought out service.

name: Elevate City Church - Sandy Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a place I truly call home. My family and I have been attending and serving at Elevate City Church for over 5 years now, and in that time we’ve experienced the beauty, the challenges, and the incredible growth of a church that started from the ground up.

We’re always excited to share this place with friends, coworkers, and even people we meet for the first time—because Elevate is a place where you can feel loved, welcomed, and safe the moment you walk in.

Our kids absolutely love Elevate Kids and Wake. They look forward to coming every week and serving wherever help is needed. This community has become family to us, and we’re grateful for every moment we get to be part of it I attended Elevate City from June 2025 to December 2025. Throughout my time there, there were many things about this church that stood out to me.

Starting with the positives:
1: There is an emphasis on creating a nice worship environment. The dark ambience with an emphasis on synths, electric guitars, and a loud bass may deter some people, but I appreciated it.
2: The "equip" groups are a 10-week discipleship-making journey that connected me with a group of believers and outlined how to effectively spread the gospel. In addition to this group, we went out and served the community through discipleship outreach opportunities, which shows this church's dedication to spreading the gospel.
3: Just as it is advertised, this church is a "Jesus" church, and they are true to their message. Everything is Jesus-centered, which is what a church should be.

The negatives:
1: The preaching style from Pastor Joey can be very "culturally inclusive". Yes, the point is to not fall into the traditional "boring" preaching style in which a pastor simply reads from the Bible and fails to connect with the audience using modern-day references. However, the disconnect is when the preaching seems to be pushing an agenda for a sermon series using movie clips, quotes, or random cultural icons, then pointing to the Bible and trying to fit them into the Bible. The Bible should be the center of the message, and there were certain sermons that felt as if the Bible was secondary or not the primary focus while the preaching was occurring.

2: There are minimal small group opportunities. I reached out to leadership individuals seeking a small group. I was pointed to equip, which I had already participated in. I was then told about "equip x" which is the year long discipleship journey. However, the requirement for you to join that "small group" is that you have to lead your own equip group. This to me does not make sense, as the purpose of a small group is a Biblical theme of finding fellow believers to share life with and to uplift one another in daily life, using the Bible as the base. That should come before "leading an equip group." This church does not currently have small groups offered, so if that is something you are seeking immediately, I would look elsewhere.

3: Pastor Joey is not very accessible. In the fall before the PTC campus was announced to be opened, I reached out to Joey to grab lunch and connect with the church. We set up a time, which he canceled, and after I followed up twice with no response, I dropped it.

4: This church is very "young". This does not have anything to do with the age of the church as an organization; it is thriving and doing well for the age in which it is. The leaders are all in their 40's or younger, the average age of the congregation looks to be in their 20's-30's. You see very few people above 60, which to me is concerning for the congregation as a whole. 1 Peter 5:5 is an example of how we should submit to the elders, not those young or young in their faith.

5: This church does not have readily accessible information to the congregation regarding the list of elders and those who lead the congregation. Does this church even have a suitable list of elders to care for the congregation? 20-year-olds leading other 20-year-olds is wise.

6: Building a community in this church requires you to reach out to them to find community, instead of the church helping you find it.

7: The constant camera work during worship, filming individuals while they worship, and then posting it on social media feels very people-centered instead of gospel-centered. It seems this church intends to be more of a "look at me and what my work as a church is doing", instead of "look at the work that God is doing through my church". I appreciate the church’s efforts to reach young people, but I wanted to share some feedback. I’ve noticed the pastor and his wife sometimes don’t greet members, which can feel unwelcome. I’d love to see more emphasis on humble leadership and traditional teaching styles. Also, the volume during services can be overwhelming at times. This church needs a lot improvement. They don’t give opportunities to young children to play either. They already have their band. My friend left disappointed that there is no opportunities to be part of this church. Typically white people! We absolutely love this church, it truly feels like home. As a family of four, we all look forward to Sundays here. If you’re searching for a non-denominational, family-friendly, Jesus-centered church in Sandy Springs, this is the place. And the worship? Simply incredible! Wonderful church family! Pastor Joey is phenomenal in my personal opinion. If you want to learn to disciple to others this is the church for you.

name: Elevate Life Church
reviewSummary: A modern, energetic church in Frisco with contemporary worship and a focus on elevating the community.

name: Elevate Life Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Elevate Life Church a lot. Praise God for guiding me to this wonderful church. When I went for the first time back on 1st of August 2025 to attend a young adults bible study, I felt welcomed and loved by others and I sense that this church will be a good fit. It took a bit of time to get adapted and getting to know other Christians. I got to meet Pastors Tom and Heather, one of the most loving people you'll ever meet! I love them a great deal! I took that big step on attending service, though I started with Wednesdays before doing Sundays and now I can do both. I have grown and I feel like a different person a year later from the fellowship with others to attending service almost every week to making the Lord proud by praying and reading his Word. I am glad to have such a community who is there for me with support, love, and prayer. No doubt I'll give them 5 stars! Visited Elevate Church recently and had a really positive experience. Everyone was welcoming from the moment I walked in, and the atmosphere felt warm and genuine. The message was encouraging, easy to connect with, and uplifting. Music was great, and the overall service was well organized. It’s a place where you can feel comfortable whether it’s your first visit or you’ve been attending for a while. Definitely worth checking out. This church is not alive and not worth the drive!

I attended Elevate Life Church for about two years. When I first started attending, the slogan “Loving People to Life” genuinely reflected what I experienced. The church felt welcoming, focused on discipleship, and passionate about helping people grow in their faith.

Over time, though, it felt like the priorities shifted. From my perspective, the emphasis became more about polished productions, book promotions, comedy-driven sermons, large women’s conferences, and theatrical performances than about discipleship and reaching people. While there’s nothing inherently wrong with those things, they seemed to take center stage in a way that felt different from what originally drew me to the church.

It also seemed like there was an increasing focus on image and presentation. Even the worship felt noticeably different, and the overall culture no longer felt as authentic or Christ-centered as it once had.

I truly hope Elevate Life Church rediscovers the heart that first made it such a welcoming place—a church where loving people to life is more than just a slogan. Really does feel like coming home, even for those of us raised in the church, this place is for the broken and hurting.
If the world, past "churches" and life in general has beat you to death, come on home it's safe and inviting, regardless of your past.
There is power in the name of Jesus.
Amen. Glad I found Elevate.
Pastor Tom and Heather along with everyone there has made going to church something I look forward to.
My understanding of Jesus has grown tremendously since I've been there. I really feel a part of this place.

name: Elevate Life Church Frisco - Frisco Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve read a lot of the negative reviews about Elevate Life Church and a lot of them feel like people judging an entire church body off of one service or a very limited experience. And I say that as someone who did the exact same thing years ago.

Then life humbled me, I came back, got involved, joined the Saturday men’s group and actually experienced the community instead of standing on the outside criticizing it.

Church isn’t supposed to be a country club for perfect people. The reality is we’re all just broken people trying to grow and become better and walk closer with God. The Bible literally says in Romans 14 for believers not to condemn each other over personal opinions and preferences. Are there imperfect people here? Absolutely. Welcome to every church on earth. But what I’ve personally experienced here is brotherhood, accountability, leadership development, strong preaching on faith, family, purpose and becoming a better man of God. And that has had a real impact on my life.

A lot of reviews seem written out of emotion or being offended, politics or personal expectations that weren’t met. People visit once and think they fully understand a ministry that has helped thousands of people for decades. Which says more about modern culture than it does the church in my opinion…You don’t have to agree with every sermon to recognize when a church is actively helping people grow spiritually, mentally and financially.

If you’re looking for a perfect church, you won’t find one. But If you’re looking for a place to grow, build relationships and strengthen your walk with Christ, then maybe experience it for yourself before letting internet outrage make a decision for you. Elevate life has become my family of choice. Since I first walked in the door in May of 2024 my life has transformed completely. I have found Jesus in my life again. I serve in production and prayer team, which has been great and helping me steward my talents for Gods kingdom. Mighty Men and Pastor Keith’s messages have created everlasting impact on me and my new family. If you are reading this and have not attended, do yourself a favor and walk through the doors. 🙏 The atmosphere is amazing. All the staff are super friendly and welcoming. Pastor Keith does a wonderful job on his sermon and delivers it with such conviction and passion for God . The music is outstanding and makes you feel like it’s ok to be present and worship in the way you want. I’m so incredibly disheartened to make this review. My family and I have been coming to ELC for years, but after last night’s “Christmas at the Cathedral” I will not be back. A service that is supposed to be about the birth of Jesus and giving our lives and fears over to him became a political statement. Condemning democrats and those who do not follow the current conservative administration. But somehow in the same breath “the government won’t control this church” There were many children in attendance, an event for friends and family to celebrate Jesus became about political views. I don’t want to go to a church that believes in telling me and others how they should vote and what to believe. Stick to preaching about the word of the God! Hubbs and I are here visiting our kids and of course we do things together-so we had the privilege of visiting this  beautiful and inspiring church.

Everyone we encountered was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The church itself is absolutely breathtaking in a richly modern way, so very pleasing to the eye.

I had watched my son get baptized online a few weeks ago and was engaged with the music, the message, the energy that I got from the service I tuned into.

Seeing the church in person and feeling the energy within the congregation, the energy in the music and vocals, the energy in the pastor was amazing.
If I lived here, this would be my church home! And there’s a great likelihood that I will watch online weekly.

Thank you for the opportunity to come visit, thank you for the inspiring message!

name: Elevate Miami Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church, Great Pastor's, Great Place
It's contemporary and very balanced with the word and spiritual gifts, it's a very prophetic place and the people are very nice. I love the people here. I had great experiences here and consider them to a great church to come and visit if your in the area. It's home for us.  We have been part of this church family for years.  Many special events are shared during the holidays and all year long.  Fall and Winter are my favorite!  Can't wait for Sunday mornings.  It's what you need to get you through the week.  Jesus is the Reason for the Season! I agree somewhat with one of the posts here.  The worship is amazing and that the sermon is a bit too long.  However!  It is by far NOT boring!  Pastor Kevin is an amazing teacher and the time goes by very fast.  Because it's Sunday and I do spend time with my family, yes, it would be best if the preaching was shorter, but we should not tell the spirit what to do and I am sure the pastor is being guided by it.  And yes, all churches need more bodies of Christ, but if we are going too judge it by this and other small details, no one would go to any.  I have been going for over a month, but due to my job, I haven not been able to go every Sunday.  I follow the sermons on Sound Cloud and wish I could just go.  It really is much better bring there.  If you think it needs members, then come and give this church the 5 stars it deserves! Only God knows us perfectly. He used Pastor Kevin and Jeremiah to confirm and give me direction in specific and accurate prophetic words last Sunday. Truth resonates from the teaching and accountability of this ministry which bears great fruit! I immediately moved in the favor if God toward my destiny! Perfect love casts out fear. It's a new day and God has great plans for your life too! Listening to the previous sermons via the cloud now that I'm back in Austin...so thankful for godly men and women who are called to preach, teach and declare heaven on Earth!! Go GOD!! I love this church! The preaching is on amazing! I can’t get enough, the word is preached and you know it’s set you free to help you go to the next level! If you want to grow in Christ this is the church to go to! It’s like a small church in a big city. They have everything you need there. Prayer, God’s Love, Freedom, they have coffee & bagels in the Sunday service. The Pastor has a heart for his people very caring and his wife is so kind and loving, I am so happy my son found this church! Couldn’t be any happier. ❤️✨❤️✨❤️✨

name: Elevate Ministries - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Can't say enough good things about this place. The community is strong and has a lot of staff that are caring outgoing and helpful. The message of generosity yesterday was so powerful and spirited. The services are amazing. The worship team is off the chain! Both pastors I've seen have given powerful sermons and reached me very deeply. I enjoy  all the people serving this church so much!! Thank you all! Ever since the first time we stepped into the building we have been treated with love and respect. We are glad to call Elevate ministries our home church.  I am so thankful for the leadership and all the friendships we have  made while attending Elevate Ministries. Such a wonderful church. People are so genuine and really do care to get to know you and build Godly friendships. The services are relevant, exciting and filled with truth from the Word of God (Holy Bible). The pastors and staff continuously go out of their way to make you feel included as well as make it clear that they are there to help and serve you whenever needed; even outside their hours of operation. My children love their kids ministry and have learned and matured so much. Choosing to join Elevate Ministries has been the best decision we have ever made for our family. Around 2003 They collected 1 million or so from the congregation for something called the six-year plan which I heard about repeatedly every Sunday. It was for a new church a new building. That never happened instead the pastor's wife got a new mini Cooper and the son got a house.. I remember as a kid seeing the tithing baskets being passed around three times just to see who would give again. They are very much focused on money. They do it to the youth group as well, harping on tithing taking what they can from young adults and children. But they do have a great graphic design team and photographers. At one point the youth program here was peak and it felt like very much in tuned with the neighborhood its in. Also this says that it's in Fullerton. It's not important it's two cities away from Fullerton approximately 13 miles. The youth group in the mother church are in the same industrial cul-de-sac on Alvarez Street in Orange California. Absolutely love the atmosphere at Elevate ministries! I’ve been welcomed from day 1. I’ve grown up going to church and have never experienced Pastors who are so dedicated to helping you and your family grow together. They are the example of living out the Word and we all truly appreciate them and the ministry.  This place is home for us and we have made beautiful, lasting friendships that I cherish.

name: Elevated Life Church - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
ELC IS THE PLACE TO BE! If you want to be apart of a family that is on fire for God 25/8, then look no further. Elevated Life Church showed my family and I so much love from the first day we walked through its doors. My children are loved and cared for beyond measure and I would encourage anyone who is looking for a church home, make sure to stop by ELC!!!!!!! “I came from New York and found my home church at ELC. The Pastors are incredible leaders who genuinely love people, serve the community, and care deeply for every soul that walks through their doors. I’m so thankful to be part of this church family My name is Duane Singleton when Gwendolyn Thomas invited me to your church I really enjoyed myself I love your praise and worship and I love Bishop word .. and I love to ginuwine people who were sitting there thanks again and I'll be back 🙏 and I have seen a lot of changes in Gwendolyn This church is amazing!! The atmosphere is very welcoming and the pastors are great people. If you’re looking for a church, ELC is the place to be! Elevated Life Church is truly a place where you can experience the presence of God. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with a warm smile and genuine hospitality from the greeters and ushers who make you feel like family.

The preaching is powerful, practical, and biblically sound, delivered with passion and anointing that challenges and encourages you to grow in your faith. Every service is filled with heartfelt worship, a spirit of excellence, and an atmosphere where lives are transformed.

Whether you’re visiting for the first time or have been attending for years, ELC is a church where you feel loved, welcomed, and inspired. If you’re looking for a church that teaches God’s Word, values people, and creates an environment for spiritual growth, I highly recommend Elevated Life Church. Five stars all the way!

name: Elevation Chapel Newton
reviewSummary: Elevation online has transformed my life. Thank you Pastor Steven and Elevation Team. We love attending Elevation Church. Great music and great people! 😁 It's a good and gospel filled church. Friendly Christians and good Bible studies. Awesome place! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Elevation Church
reviewSummary: Known globally for Elevation Worship music. Steven Furtick's preaching is described as 'dynamic' and 'engaging'. The atmosphere is high-energy, concert-like, and attracts a younger demographic.

name: Elevation Church - Ballantyne - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Finally was able to come visit. Love how they have VIP parking for first time visitors and free items,  parking attendant very helpful, friendly and a great sense of humor,  awesome service, and the  guest speaker did a great job. Staff checked on me via text and email during the first week. That caught me off guard, so unexpected and sweet of them. I was so grateful and appreciative. Awesome church and staff! Thank you so much Elevation! I really enjoyed my day and your church/staff. After years of being eFam members, my husband and I through faith and obedience packed up our belongings and kids and moved to Charlotte in August 2023 for church. It was the best decision we have ever made! I love Elevation. I love the diversity, the Biblical teaching, Pastor Steven & Pastor Holly, our Worship team, the volunteer staff and all the campus Pastors. I just love my church 🥹🥰🥰🥰 Come visit 😁 Love this church! Always welcoming and definitely recommend you trying it if you are in the area, or even if you want to visit! They get a lot of visitors as well. The main pastor preaches at the 9:30 am and the line starts early. I would recommend going there at least an hour before. If the seats are filled you will be placed in the overflow area and watch the service from a tv. There is an 11:30 service that runs the sermon from the 9:30 am on screen as well and less crowded, but still live worship! My wife and I visited here for the first time and it was great. We got there 20mins early and didn't know you wouldn't be able to get a seat. We told the ushers (that it was our first time) and they got us a seat in the sanctuary. Pastor Steven gave a great word and the worship was awesome. Everyone was extremely kind and helpful. God bless elevation church. Hey there buddy! Just wanted to share this with you. 💒 I visited this sensational church and it's truly awesome in all it does. 👏 You won't believe they baptized over 500 people today! 😲 Their actions radiate so much love, the music is full of power and very stirring 🎵✨. And, oh boy! The sermon.. it’s like they’re speaking straight to my heart. 🙏 The pastor and his wife, truly remarkable people they are. Though I don’t know them up close, I can vouch for their immense contribution to the community.👫 This time was my second visit 🕊️, only the first time I was with Doves Nest so didn’t really get the full experience. This time around, I took my husband along, it was his first time. And trust me, we had a transformative, deeply moving experience that was absolutely beautiful. It's safe to say, we’ll be going back every Sunday. ⛪️😇 Hope you can join us one of these days. 🙌🤗

name: Elevation Church - Blakeney - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family went for Easter, coming in from multiple states, and filled the front few rows. We absolutely enjoyed worshipping together. I had never been to a service where the sermon was on the screen and only music was live; however, I really enjoyed it. I can’t wait to go back and I wish I lived closer. Such a God-filled awesome experience. Even though I attend online, It's nothing like going in person. Ambiance, aroma, smiles, relaxing environment, awesome sound system, nice praise team, and great sermons👏 overall a really good feel. I will be going back and making myself comfortable. I had been searching for a Church Family and found it.  From the parking team and hospitable greeters who are genuine in welcoming you to the ushers who will find you a perfect seat.  The Worship Team and music is quality that you will want to download the songs.  Pastor Steven Furtick is anointed.  His sermons will inspire you to get involved and be a better person.  Since attending I got involved with a small group (E-Group) who has become my extended family.  I also volunteer by serving food to the volunteers.  There are so many opportunities to serve at the church and in our community and the church makes it so easy to participate.  If you are sincere in finding good Christians to befriend and become a better person by following God's word - try it.  I promise it will change your life for the good! This church has changed my life.

The worship is experience is like no other and I'm usually in tears before pastor even gets up to preach his message.

He appeals to all ages. My 11 year old son looks forward to going every Sunday!

In regards to not being able to choose where you sit, the church completely fills up (and goes into overflow) every service. The seating is for 1. safety and 2. so that they can fill up the auditorium. It would be mass chaos if the ushers weren't there to help seat people. If you want a better seat, get there early :) I'll give this 2 stars, because years ago (2012) this church hosted a revival (Code Orange Revival), and invited Matt Chandler to speak. God used this man, mightily, in my life that evening...and I'm grateful I was there to hear the sermon before the church took it off of their website.

Other than this, I cannot recommend this church from previous visits. Just never connected here.

name: Elevation Church - Greenville - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love to hear Steven preach bc he holds nothing back and I believe that he truly has the Holy Spirit in him and he explains things so I can understand what he’s trying to get across to his congregation. Also they reach a lot of young people and that’s really inspiring to see that they are all being touched by God and his Holy Spirit and having fun worshipping the Lord our God. BEST CHURCH EVER! PASTOR STEVEN FURTICK, the Holy Ghost blessed him with how he preaches, his teachings as a pastor and I used to find church boring a lot of times. Pastor Furtick is hands downs one of the greatest pastors I have ever had the pleasure of learning from and I'm genuinely excited to learn more from. I'm at the Greenville location, but one day I might just make the drive to go to the Bellantyne location in Charlotte. Come visit one of his locations or better yet just watch one of his sermons online! LOUD ACTUALLY IS BETTER AND I LOVE THIS CHURCH 💯✝️🦋🌸🫶💯 This is the best church ever! Started out at the Lake Norman campus in North Carolina in 2017. Moved to MA in 2019 became eFam. We decided to check out some of the local churches up there, just to be able to be in-person, but after months of searching, we decided that Elevation is our 'home', even having to be eFam. We had the opportunity to move to Greenville SC in 2023 and I was so happy that there is campus and we started going, in-person again! I started volunteering and there has never been a bad experience in the 9 years we've been a part of this ministry. We are blessed to call Elevation Church our 'home' and its people and staff our 'family'. ❤️🙏🏻 We found Elevation online 5 years ago. They now have a  location in Greenville, at the beautiful Furman Campus. You have to try it if you are looking for a church family.
The people who serve make the experience perfect. They make it feel like your coming home every week. The worship music is food for the soul. Campus Pastor Matt has taken it to the next level. And of course, Pastor Steven is the best. This is a great church…from the parking lot, to the entrance, their workers are very friendly, caring, and helpful in every way. The worship, and the Word are excellent!!! The people are friendly, kind, and caring. If you’re wanting an impactful, spiritual experience…come! You won’t be disappointed!

name: Elevation Church - Lake Norman - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
Best Church in NC! Love it. My 13 year old son picked the church and we have been going ever since. Would highly recommend if you are surching for a community based church. Their Christmas Eve experience was lovely. Great music. And a  lovely story. And a fun snow machine outside afterward.
I'm so glad their treats were gluten-free free, so I could have some.
Loved the photo backdrop areas for families...
For us older folk, I wish there was seating in the entry area... hard to stand and wait... I love my church. The people are very nice and they treat you like family. God is great and this spirit field church is so good at bringing God the glory he deserves🙌 As a family we stopped going to Elevation some years back when our marriage got difficult. We decided if there was going to be dysfunction immediately after church when going to eat and turmoil at home then why pretend at church? Fast forward a few years, now we're going through divorce. 2022 was my first Easter as a single Dad and it was incredibly hard. Mom and older brother were missed. Our two youngest were not old enough to experience eKids so were understandably apprehensive. Ekids did not disappoint! They had a great time while being spiritually educated. Even made some friends that we saw at Robbins Park after church!

Resurrection 2022 sermon 'Life After Let Down' spoke to me on multiple levels. Being responsible for the part I played in our divorce(it takes two), not stressing about the future of me in my children's life(make the most of the time I have with them now, let God handle the future), etc.
Praise and give thanks now for what is AND what will be!

name: Elevation Church - Matthews - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and mine first date was elevation nights, Columbus, Ohio. We have been together for 24 years and have never gone on a date. Well, not a proper date anyway. We watch elevation, on YouTube every weekend. Heck, just bought any chance we get. Every time they upload, we watch. I even listened to stephen  during the day when I at work. Gods message through him inspires me. Keeps me grounded keeps me making the right decision. I'm not perfect and I fall all the time. I am at constant need of Gods mercy and grace. Jesus be the name. Forever on my lips. Hearing those amazing singers in person really touched our soul. We both highly recommend going and experiencing this amazing preaching of Gods word. And the amazing music you will experience while you're there. Is the absolute best experience of your entire life? See what God can do through you. Thank you elevation. Stephen. Holly. We will forever be elevation members? God bless elevation church's. And their amazing mission throughout the world. We were first time visitors this past Sunday & what an experience! 🙌🤩 We received the VIP treatment with lots of welcoming smiling faces. 🥰 The worship part of the service is NEXT LEVEL. As a primarily Baptist churchgoer, this was so refreshing and exciting. I love their enthusiasm and hearts for Jesus. We attended a Block Party afterwards that was equally enjoyable. I've received a couple messages since from members reaching out. It's lovely seeing how everyone is serving the Lord. Be mindful that the worship portion can be loud and overstimulating for some. They do have childcare available up to 5th grade level. Overall, we had a great experience! We hope to return! Best church I have the privilege to be a part of, Pastor Steven and his group are amazing. Everything about this church is amazing the work they do, community programs, helping the needy, food distribution, helping people in other countries with portable water, community outreach and so much more. We need more people like this in the world. Wasn't for me. I was just visiting, I am active at my church in Wilmington on the production team so I am familiar with this type of service. I was greeted warmly.....I was surprised to not be able to choose my own seat. Didn't want to sit where I was seated. The bass was WAY too elevated. I get that they have earplugs, but I'm also in production and that was barely tolerable.  Constant reference to all of the other locations. I felt very strange. I also didn't realize we would be watching the sermon via satellite. Not for me. Best church ever!!!!!! Even when pastor furtick is traveling they always have great speakers.. I thought it would be weird going to church and watching a screen at my location but the experience  is so integrative I feel like I'm standing in front of the speaker!! Love this place I always feel recharged!!!

name: Elevation Church - Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
About four and a half years ago, we made the move to Orlando, Florida, and it’s been one of the best decisions for our family.

From day one, the Elevation Pastors welcomed us like we were their own. Over time, we’ve seen a real transformation in our family through the youth programs and Sunday mornings.

It’s become more than a place we attend, it’s something we genuinely love being part of. In 2022 my son and I moved to Orlando Florida. We had been following Elevation Church for years, but had no idea there were campuses. We immediately started coming and haven’t looked back. God has used this church to transform our lives and after four years our story is not finished. Believing God for the exceedingly abundantly more than we can ask think or imagine. I have to say I’m a Christian man and I’ve never taken the time to write a review about a church, but this situation was just crazy and I could not let it go without the body of Christ knowing this. I went as a first time guest. I showed up late to the 930 service so I decided to stay for the 11:30 AM service. When I walked in the energy was definitely off. It was predominantly Spanish and white people are there so maybe they had something to do with it. I am a black man. But I was bombarded with people just asking me so many questions and just wanting me to join things and they just really made me feel uncomfortable. Then as I’m sitting in the 1130 service is Beginning since there’s something behind me and I turned around and there are two police officers just there and I know that they were there for me because one of the ladies that was initially nice to me. I could tell she was texting about me and things of that nature so maybe Me just standing there quiet made them uncomfortable and feel like they needed the police there but the Holy Spirit is definitely not in that place. I can tell it is a spirit of racism. Who knows whatever else is present there in the spirit, but it’s not the Holy Spirit. Thank God, I have been walking with the Lord spending time in prayer and reading my Bible for years. Because baby Christian new to the faith would’ve been highly offended, and probably would’ve turned away from the Lord, and that blood would be on that churches hands; that ladies hands. I did not deserve that treatment for just standing there and existing. The only thing I can Think of is maybe that lady is demonically influenced and the demons in her recognize someone who really has the Holy Spirit entered that church. I could go on for days, but that was my first time experience there. We came to Elevation Church on Easter Sunday of 2023. I was worried coming from a traditional Lutheran Church that we wouldn’t like the service. As it turns out we loved the Worship Experience and the sermon and when we left I told my wife we need to figure out how to get involved.  We have been involved in serving regularly and have met some of our greatest friends. We have really found family. Pastor Furtick is one of the best communicators and Pastors that I have ever heard. Sermons are relatable to todays life and weekly I learn more to keep my faith. Love my church family! This place is amazing! If you are looking for a community that will love on you, genuinely pray over you and yours as well as help you grow in your faith, than this is the place. We have 2 small kids that love going to church not because they have to but because they get to. Love how much they too are growing in their faith! Church doesn’t just stop on Sunday with them they keep it going all week with the e-groups.  You should visit and see for yourself 🙏🥰

name: Elevation Church - Raleigh
reviewSummary: This is a great church that we've been watching online as a family for years. I've been to multiple campuses, all of which have been amazing in their own way. The Raleigh Campus has some of the sweetest, kindest people. Coming in, my daughter and I felt so welcomed. The preaching and music got us on our feet and praising Jesus! I remember this used to be an open space that looked natural and nice. It would have been great if it had been turned into a park for everyone to use. The new building doesn’t fit the area and honestly looks like a gray box, more like a warehouse than something that belongs there. Visited for Easter Sunday for the first time. While I’m sure there’s lots of lovely people that attend regularly, it’s definitely not a place to go to feel close to God. The pastor acts more like a motivational speaker/celebrity and his sermon (if you can even call it that) had absolutely no substance. He repeated the same two lines of scripture 10 times and gave an extremely surface-level talk. The music is obnoxiously loud, to the point where you wish you had ear plugs. It feels like a MLM rather than a church. The pastor has 4 million insta followers that buy his books and support his lavish lifestyle and he gives what in return? I’d urge people who are serious about their spirituality and relationship to God to find another church that is truly centered on Christ’s teachings. Christ would be appalled at this performative, profit-focused organization. Great sermon and music at the Raleigh location we visited this past Sunday. My Apple Watch went off and said I was at Elevation Worship and the decibel was over 90! I thought it was loud… apparently I was right😎 So welcoming! Praise and worship exceptional. I love the sermons from Pastor Steven Furtick

name: Elevation Church - Winston-Salem - Winston-Salem Campus
reviewSummary:
In the beginning, Elevation Church will definitely put on a facade that will make you want to come back. You get a t-shirt, and hugs at the door. But pretty soon you'll realize that unless you sign up to volunteer, join a team and be there at every event, you aren't considered part of the community. The music is exceptionally loud. You almost need ear plugs. And you will have to get used to everybody from the musicians to the campus pastor, selling Elevation Church newest music. It's all about popularity. And then Selling t-shirts, and other merchandise, like you're at a concert and not a church service. As a new volunteer, you will also spend most of your time setting up early on Sundays, and doing special events. And not getting home on Sundays until 3:00 p.m. or later. This is what they will expect. And mask it as "family." Unfortunately under the surface it's another mega church, where they don't address societal issues going on outside of the church. It's another clique club, where you will never be a part of the Elevation inner circle. It seems like a community, but quickly you realize that it's all just a facade. Nice community of people, never felt uncomfortable going here I’ve been going on and off for a couple years. The building itself is always clean and smells nice, the people are friendly and Steven preaches good. I came out of state to visit.  I felt the spirit of God all around.  Can't wait to come back. As members of the volunteer team, we are dedicated to serving our community and our church. We are a close-knit group and consider each other family. We were baptized at Elevation Church and it is our spiritual home. We are passionate about our faith and love being a part of this church. In short, our experience at Elevation Church has been nothing short of remarkable. We visited for first time. Took the foster kids with us to visit. "Some" of the staff were friendly, even very friendly. Others not so much. We asked about the welcome gifts and was told we had to wait until after the service. Then after the service, I was asked what size, I said Medium and he insisted I take an XL. I'm not a big guy. It was a little weird TBH. Not offended, just thats not a good first impressions.

The music was really good. It was very loud, but that doesn't bother me. I think the overall thing that stand out to me is that this is a "satellite" church and we aren't going to let another person preach/teach at this location. The head pastor is broadcast live from their main campus.

I see this becoming more and more of a trend. I don't care for it. It's impersonal and disconnected to a degree. It just all felt so structured and cookie cutter. Even if the speaker today would have been at our location, I still wouldn't have cared for it.

name: Elevation Point Church - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary:
I really connected to The Holy Spirit during worship.  It was authentic and sincere and it didn't feel like a show.  I'm not there to be entertained so it feels silly writing a review.  I'm there to praise God and the guy leading just took us there.  Past performance and show.  Thank you for being in love with Jesus and pouring out your heart in song to God.  He is worthy!  🙏🙏🙏👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻🔥🔥🔥💥💥💥✝️✝️✝️ A great place for worship, fellowship and opportunities to get involved.  Pastor Dustin is an amazing storyteller that delivers the message in a way that makes it easy to understand the Word; the Word come alive. Everyone is welcome as you are. You won't be disappointed. My family and I had the experience of having a great time at the church, good word, my children Really enjoyed themselves, They are wanting to go back children’s church was very organized structured and the children also learned about the subject of the day which happened to be a very important one. Church  service was not long at all the Pastor was spot on with the word, worship was powerful and heartfelt. This is Awesome church everyone is very friendly....and most of all the Pastor Coy Barker is down to earth....which makes his message easy to comprehend.....if you drop by and visit
I promise you will come back again Awesome, loving, powerful, Holy Spirit filled, Jesus centered Church! If your in the area and don't have a place to worship and call home give them a try!

name: Eleven Sixteen Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary:
I go to this Church. I really wanted to say. I’m new to going and now I get excited for Sunday’s. It is so much like family. I had Ms Pam prayed for me and I’ve felt so good. She’s and everyone that attends 1116 Church are so friendly.
Thank you,
Teresa - Bible based teaching
- Spirit filled praise and worship
- Spirit led leadership
- Community and fellowship centered
- Family-centered
- Discipleship and Spiritual Transformation
- Healing and Wholeness for the individual and family A genuine church that loves Jesus through loving people and preaching and teaching the Bible, without all the secondary, divisive junk. Amazing place and transformation is impossible to miss here. Love the leadership team, mission, and people of My 1116!!

name: Elim Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful historic church building with a wonderful, progressive ELCA congregation.

name: Eliot Church of Newton UCC
reviewSummary: You couldn’t ask to find a more welcoming, heartfelt congregation. There is so much drive at Eliot to make a positive impact on their community, to be good stewards of the environment, and to be knowledgeable followers of Christ. Their music is also phenomenal. I was blessed to be a part of Eliot for the past two years. A place welcoming everyone! Congregation member or not all are welcome. The atmosphere of this church is warm and bright, truly the embodiment of a church without any judgment but lots of encouragement and understanding I don't think I actually wound up going to Elliot Church. They were staging point for the walk against hunger which my son went to. Great people make great places  !

name: Elk Grove Church of Christ - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary: I love it. The people are so nice. Love the preacher/teacher. He speaks in a way that touches points in ur life but doesnt make you feel guilty or bad it makes u think about aspects in ur life that make you want to make a change and better ur self as a person. And the buolding it self i personally feel is well design and my children love going too and their teachers. They also have a nursery. Had my taxes done there by AARP don't know anything about church..nice building Very nice & welcoming church! Come visit This is a medical school. The environment is very well protected. It's clean, and the green plants are neatly arranged. It's a very good university medical school. Awesome! 👍

name: Elohim Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Elohim Christian Church is a wonderful, family-friendly, and community-oriented place of worship. It is truly a spirit-filled church where the Bible is taught with clarity and passion. There is something for everyone here, whether you are a senior, a young adult, or bringing your little ones. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the church is well-structured to meet the spiritual and practical needs of every age group. If you’re looking for a place to grow in faith, connect with others, and feel at home, this is the church for you! Very nice looking church with decor. I came here to a wedding ceremony/celebration. We first came into the main church hall to the ceremony. We then followed it up with heading over to the fellowship hall to do the celebration of the new union. They have two sections for parking your vehicles. Nice size bathrooms that kept clean. I am not personally a member but by the looks of thing's and reading a few past comments, that talks values to anyone. Must come and visit I’m a new member myself
I can tell you I received a warm welcome with loving open arms Elohim is such a beautiful place to call home and to grow as a leader. I built great relationships, I grew spiritually, and still continue to connect with their great leaders. I have attached a beautiful picture of The brotherhood NYC that I continue to host at Elohim. Thank you Elohim for being a great blessing in my journey. It's tough finding a God-genuine place of worship and growth. Especially in today's world. Well, this is a wonderful church. Those who run it, do so in a genuine manner. So do open your heart and mind and God will lead you where it is meant for you to be. But if you need to go, this is a blessed place. God bless.

name: Embassy City Church - Irving Campus
reviewSummary: Church is not about and outlfit or a hairstyle! Its about God! People we have to wake up! God sees everyone hearts. God is love! Ladies please learn to love yourself as christ does for us daily. Favorite Place other than Home. I love it here. Great Bible Based Word, Great Worship and Excellent Church. More than great place to worship our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Family atmosphere, singles support and orayer services. Visit once and you will be back. I love this church. I went on my own which is a big deal because I only been forced to church in the past but I had to come here because the preaching is always backed up with scripture. The environment is so loving and everyone is so nice here  , I feel right at home. I love the atmosphere and the pastor. We learn, grow and meet new people. It’s family oriented, we’re we fellowship with others . Much Love 💜🙏🏾

name: Embassy SF - South San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is home. Finding this church has truly been one of the greatest blessings in my life. Since 2021, this has been the place where I encountered the Lord in a real and personal way, and began to truly learn His ways. It’s not just a church… it’s a place where I’ve been able to grow spiritually, be poured into, and experience transformation from the inside out.

This very place is where I learned what it means to come alive in Christ and discover who I am through Him. Every time I walk through the doors, I feel the presence of the Lord, and I leave encouraged, strengthened, and challenged to become a better version of myself.

Over the years, I’ve also been blessed with an incredible church family. Pastor Joshua and First Lady have been such powerful leaders and spiritual parents in my life and my family’s lives… I truly consider them family. Along with them, the entire Embassy family has become a community I cherish deeply, united through the blood of Christ.

This church is not just about attending services… it’s about becoming a strong disciple of Jesus Christ. I’ve learned how to be a soul winner, to step out boldly, and to help lead others to Christ with love and truth. If you’re looking for a place to grow, be challenged, and truly walk in your purpose with God, this is the place to be.

I’m beyond grateful for everything God has done in my life through this church. I would give this place zero stars. Not going to say too much, I don’t want them to mail me a cease and desist letter for writing a review.

I was told before I left “Mark my words, your life will not get better” ..why would someone who claims to be a man of god tell me that? because I chose to leave because of the disfunction my family and I experienced.

People here ‘were’ so called family, but we learned quickly that wasn’t the case when we left, we became the “demonic rejects” and were cut off instantly.

It’s been a blessing to have left this place and never looked back! WARNING: this pastor is cruel, dismissive, and dangerously unfit. Instead of reflecting the compassion of Jesus, he belittles the vulnerable, denies real mental health suffering, and elevates his own ego above the well-being of the congregassion. Embassy SF is currently harmful and spiritually unsafe. Avoid, or proceed knowing what you’re in for. I only visited the church a few times but what I saw from the preacher made it easy not to go back.

Examples:

The preacher openly spoke poorly about members of the congregation. “I don’t care what your husband says, I’m your pastor” was said while looking at a member in attendance

I don’t remember him mentioning any bible verses but I do remember him bringing up his “nice nip ples” once or twice.

While preaching about tithing, the pastor spoke poorly about those who didn’t or couldn’t give their 10%. This really stood out because he later spoke about his overseas trips. I have been a faithful member of this church for years now. I don’t know where I would’ve ended up if it wasn’t for Pastor Joshua and the EmbassySf family.

Let me tell you this now, this church is for the hard-headed, the stubborn,  for those who can even come to an honest realization that we are sinners, we are wicked by nature and we need Jesus as our savior.

The Gospel is taught and lived out in this house.  So if you are looking to be accommodated- this is not the place for you. In this house, Biblical truths are the core of each message and each ministry.
Yes!  Some may not have their Bibles on hand, because like me- I personally read the word on a daily.
If anything bring a notebook- so you catch the anointing from the Pastor and study it for yourself later. 🔥
So if you’ve come to change your life, doing It God’s Way, please come! This is the place for you!!
Otherwise,  save yourself gas and watch the  livestream first. 🥲

name: Emmanuel Assembly of God - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful place of worship! Our pastor, Tom is approachable and always available for his disciples and parishioners. We're a small congregation which makes it more personal. Pastor Tom is one of the finest men you'll ever meet! Small friendly church great worship music too ! We attend a 12-step fellowship here on Tuesday nights. Love reverend Tom and Janie Shriver

name: Emmanuel Christian Church - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: I love the people for God at ECC and there is no place I would rather be! I love my church! Great! I had an awesome time and everyone was so kind. The KOK youth department had a wonderful time also. This sunday I when to ECC, what a awesome time I had to worship with people's of God. Pastor Griffin was so amazesome with semon. Aligment with God. I had a great time Emmanuel Christian church is an amazing place with great people who love Jesus. If you are any where near the area bring your entire family. I love this place. GOD truly is With Us

name: Emmanuel Episcopal Church of Fullerton - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: The folks & property were nice but went there for one of my best friend's Celebration of Life.  It was more of a Christ has risen, I thought could of been more about David jmho & that is reasonable for score. Adm.4+, cleanliness 4+, parking 4+. CELEBRATION of Life for David he deserved better. What is with the cartoon car that appeared on my map and all the other extras. I just want a map to get me there, not all this other carnival garbage. Get back to what you did best, Google. A place of true worship, humanity, simplicity, community and above all.. love of people ❤️ Love my church ! Inspiring sermon and especially the  music by Fr Rob and the band. . My children have enjoyed everything about this Preschool since day 1. Warm and loving staff. Peace of mind. My 8 year old came here and now my 4 year old is attending. Great experience!
