name: Emmanuel Evangelical Free Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Great spiritual Bible based church
Was welcomed the first day I attended. Great Bible studies lead by Pat McCauley a kind & spiritual lead lady. Made friends by joining the Chior. Pastor Andrea is enthusiastic & shows his love by greeting each Sunday at the front door. Started coming this April and it immediately felt like home! I'm in my early twenties and Emmanuel has a great group of young people as well as super cool people of all ages. Amazing church body! Very welcoming church! Love the biblically-based preaching and the spirit-led worship. If you're looking for a home church with all your future best friends this is it. I have been coming to Emmanuel Church for 25 years and simply put, it is home.  The people and community here are warm, welcoming, and caring and the preaching is always biblical, relevant, and meaningful.  The worship is absolutely amazing and always provides a space for people to encounter God.  I would recommend this church to anyone looking for community and a place to be known and loved. Burbank, California has no shortage of choices when it comes to selecting a church.  Where Emmanuel stands out is the people.  On a Sunday morning, you will be greeted by a team of caring individuals who actually do want to know how you're doing.  Inside those glass double doors is a warm and welcoming sanctuary where you can connect with God and his people.  Emmanuel wants you to have a strong relationship with Christ and has many opportunities to facilitate spiritual growth.  Also, their personal barista, Dan, is THE BEST! :D I came to this church questioning, doubting and in need (of God, of friends, of change...). The people of Emmanuel welcomed me with open arms and without question. I have grown stronger spiritually, mentally and emotionally since coming to this church. If you get involved in classes and programs, or just attend regularly, you will meet some great people!

name: Emmanuel Faith Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church! Has a thriving children and young adult ministry. A lot of options for adults to connect. Also has Care and Counseling ministry which includes recovery groups. The Spanish speaking community is integrated into main church, which is unique and fantastic! This is an awesome church. It was the second visit, and my wife and I were very happy we did. The worship is great, and the service was awesome. We found a home church. The fiesta Latina was amazing. And the music is very good. This is a great community. I have enjoyed this church for 33 years. We drive from South Oceanside to attend EFCC. There are many places to be involved and serve the Lord. Absolutely love this church! The lead pastor Ryan Paulson is an amazing communicator: always has plenty of humor, but boy can he layer into a message! Every Sunday we are excited to go to church …and we are never disappointed after! I feel like I am growing more in my spiritual walk now through this church than at any time in my life. So grateful!
Also, really great Kids ministry, including high school.
Great community of people! We have been going about 20 years but must comment on Pastor.Ryans sermons.  Every Sunday you know he has prayed and studied for each sermon.  So enjoying  the study of Revelation.  I have taken the study of Revelation twice through Bible Study Fellowship and I have learned so much more through the Pastors sermons.  God bless you in your ministry to us.  Cherie Hudson

name: Emmanuel Hispanic Prebsy - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Emmaus Church
reviewSummary: Beautiful church! I was there for my best friend wedding. I am not sure how it is for church wise, but it was very inviting and everybody was extremely friendly . The dining area downstairs was also spacious enough for everybody. My family and I attended Emmaus for 2.5 years. Emmaus is a lovely community that is oriented around the person and work of Christ and around the Bible as God's written word. If you're looking for a solid church in the White Bear Lake area, this one is worth visiting. Spiritually tranqill I'm a lovely village. So friendly. Preaches from the bible. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Emmaus Church - Buford Campus
reviewSummary: I live out of state therefore unable to attend in person, but I've been watching services online for years. The messages are thoughtful, Christ-centered, and encouraging. The worship and teaching have been a blessing to me. I would highly recommend Emmaus Church! Beyond blessed to be a member of this church! The Pastors are ON FIRE for the Word and for what the Lord is doing in our community and in our hearts. Everyone is welcoming and willing to help. My husband and I feel better and feel closer to God every time we step foot on this campus. Cannot wait for what God has in store for this wonderful group of believers and staff. I’ve been a member for about 3 years, and I know that this church is a complete blessing from God. I’ve grown so much in so many ways, and especially spiritually since I’ve been attending Emmaus. In a world plagued with false teaching, this church is dedicated to the Gospel, and nothing else more than that. I love this church for its teaching, its people, and the ways the pastors shepherd and lead the church. All of the pastors lead with humility, and I am always encouraged how their stories and highs and lows sound just like mine. I am not afraid to share my raw struggles when I need prayer, and I believe our church leaders have facilitated this safe environment. I’m so happy and blessed to call Emmaus my church home. First time visiting a few subdays ago and we loved it! Been going since. Everyone is so sweet and welcoming and the teaching is so good! Our family attends here and we come when we’re in town. It is always on point and exactly what we need to hear! Praise the Lord!

name: Emmaus Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
This is my home church.  No gimmicks,  just the word of God and the love of Jesus Christ.  Lots of young families,  singles and the wise ones too.  Find true joy inside these doors.  Then walk out and spread the joy to the world. Real, no gimmicks, come as you are.  Lots of seniors, middle aged, young families = healthy church family.  Join us Sundays@ 10:00. A welcoming church community. Strong emphasis on the gospel.

There are many young families with children in the church (along with people of every life-stage as well.) Many families in the church foster and/or adopt. Preaching the Word of God unashamedly. Large congregation, by my standards. They invite everyone to get involved in a small group, and in ministry, from the beginning, which not all churches do. My daughter and grandson lived in a house that was right in the back very nice people but they are sailing the church. She had to move.

name: Emmaus Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Wes really brings good messages and brings glory to our Lord Jesus.
The church family is friendly and welcoming.
The praise and worship really welcomes the spirit in.

name: Emmaus Road Church
reviewSummary: Grateful to God that He has established this church in Sioux Falls. This church helped me walk through a very hard season in my life.  The pastors truly love the people they serve.  They have provided meals, care, friendship, counsel, and support.  The teaching and preaching is always Biblical sound and relevant to common struggles that we face in this broken world and the brokenness we battle from within.  I have received free counseling from Pastor Ryan that has been incredibly helpful.  And Pastor Greg has become a faithful shepherd to help me through all the transitions in my life for over two years now.   The community is rich, deep, and friendly.  This is one of the unique characteristics of Emmaus Road Church.  If you reside in the Sioux Falls, I cannot think of a better church! Great message but very loud drums. Awesome gospel truth preached. Amazing community. This community truly feels like family.

name: Emmaus United Church of Christ - Vienna Campus
reviewSummary: Churches are important institutions for our communities and this small church helps in many different ways like Little Free Pantry, Covid aid, local food banks, seniors, youth projects, etc. Also, Emmaus is open and affirming. Most important it, welcomes everyone wherever they are on their faith journey. Overjoyed to have found this loving, welcoming, supportive and socially engaged church. It’s a spectacular place for me and my children, alike, encouraging us on our faith journey, meeting us where we are and committed to bettering our community. A monument to empty virtue signals. A wonderful church and a welcoming community to all. You will find live and kindness here.  Search no more 😊

name: Emory Presbyterian Church - North Decatur / Emory Campus
reviewSummary: Emory Presbyterian Church is such a hidden gem for weddings. The chapel is absolutely stunning—filled with beautiful natural light that photographs like a dream. The staff on site was incredibly helpful and welcoming, making the entire experience seamless. It’s a lovely, peaceful setting for a heartfelt ceremony. Absolutely beautiful church! We love being a part of special moments in this great space with great attentive team. Highly recommend! We hope to be back soon. Emory Pres is home to a tightly-knit, progressive congregation that welcomes everyone. The sanctuary is a beautiful, neo-gothic space that brings together the tradition of the church’s history with the modernist perspectives of the members. They also know how to have fun. :) Grandchildren attended summer camp here and really enjoyed it. Received T-shirts and worked on really cool, age appropriate projects. Attended the same summer camp last year and never had a complaint. They did have to bring their own lunch and snacks and drinks, though. I thought that it should have been provided, considering the cost. It's  a small, friendly church that shares the love of God with everyone!

name: Empowered Life Church..Henderson Campus - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: Great church! Solid preaching and a loving congregation. I have been a part of this church for over 10 years, but the past 3 I have been out of town far more than in town. "I'm not always in Vegas, but when I am, you'll find me here" This little church is Spirit lead, full Bible, teaching, and filled with love.  Whether you’re just trying to figure out if church is for you, or you’ve been walking with the Lord many years I highly recommend ELC and pastors, Toni and Jerry!❤️ Great church teaching the Word of God.  Very friendly! Great coffee too! When I moved here 6 years ago my wife and I had a heck of time finding a church we could feel at home at. Then we found ELC and we were welcomed in with open arms. This church and these people aren't just people I see on Sunday. They are family and friends. People I can always count on and people that genuinely show the love of Christ every single day. If you're looking for more than a church then this is the place. We moved to Henderson from Southern Calif. in July 2022. Our new neighbors invited us to this church and we’ve been attending ever since. We love it. The pastors are amazing, the members are so welcoming and friendly. It’s our new Church home. We are so happy! We feel fulfilled after every service. It’s small but mighty and it will be our forever home.

name: Encanto Community Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this warm, welcoming, very community-involved church. They have some beautiful buildings, too. The sanctuary has some modern stained glass windows that are inspiring and beautiful, and remind me of the church I grew up in. The pastor is the salt of the earth and willing to dig and work alongside the parishioners. It's clearly not a wealthy church, but they do all they can to help out needy folks in the neighborhood. I just go to a meeting there, but their warmth, welcoming attitude, and visible involvement in the community has inspired me to give money and donate clothing and personal care items whenever I can. There are three UCC sister churches in the Phoenix Metropolitan area.

They all met at the Encanto campus for Maundy Thursday with a potluck dinner, consisting mostly of different soups from around the  world, at 5:30 pm.... followed by service at 7,:00 pm.

All three churches have female pastors and are very involved in service to and for the community outreach programs.

They are very inclusive to every walk of life and practice the teachings of Jesus to a fault.

Their motto:   "Jesus never rejected anyone.. neither do we."

If this style of Christianity appeals to you... definitely give them a chance and check them out...

Once the worship is over...the service begins.... I don't personally go to this church, but I do know all of the staff that works here, and the pastor, and they are a delight! If the staff, or pastors character, says anything about the church, then I'm sure it's wonderful! A fantastic place to spend a Sunday morning.  The congregation is welcoming to people of all faiths no matter where you are on Life's Journey! It's just what I have been looking for... UCC church which also cares about helping the community (Eco-Christians)...

name: Encanto Southern Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place for foodbank, just be careful a lot of older women cut the line. You can be waiting and hour and the older ppl well let there friends cut the line. So call them out. Take a phone of the ppl in front of you when getting in line. Then show them
You know they are cutting. Very nice church. The members were very accommodating to family and friends during bereavement ceremonies. I would love to visit again under other circumstances. What Church doesn't give great experiences! But we were there for covid19 testing and we are glad that they made the Church available. Went to funeral  Friday  every one was friendly, pastor & choir great Thank you for having the covid testing  available I was in and out within less than 10 - 15 minutes..

name: Enclave Community Church - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Andrew is an amazing compassionate man. His love for our LORD is awesome. On Tuesday I heard him trying to help some people from Pakistan find resources to help them find jobs. He prays with everyone who wants prayer. He is so uplifting to those who are hurting. He will have many stars in his crown. I am not a member of his church so my review is accurate. Great church in Turlock. There is an atmosphere of people who genuinely love each other. Been going for about 5yrs now. Got baptized went to jail split up with my husband. They always welcomed me back with Open arms ❤️🙂 Pastor Andrew's teaching always very poignant and christ centered. Our first visit was very welcoming I love them, they are like family. Some awesome people. Have made a huge difference in my life.

name: Encounter AZ - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Compassionate caring loving house of prayer worship praise and healing in spirit and truth…
All welcome without judgement… powerful anointing in the preaching of the word in Pastor Brent unlike any church I’ve ever attended. Come one, come all to find peace and healing.
Family church for youth and children. Services available for kids… This church is awesome! I recently started going there and they were all so welcoming and warm. The pastors are phenomenal with their sermons, the music and praise is awesome, and most of all the presence of God and the Holy Spirit is so strong in here. If you have been longing to feel the presence of the Lord and to strengthen your relationship  with God, I would strongly recommend  checking out this church. It is worth the drive!! I absolutely love this church. I feel so blessed that God has placed my family here. From the moment we pulled into the driveway we felt the love of Christ through each person we encountered. I guess that is one of the reasons for the name. The Bishop and his family are awesome and loving. I am glad to call them family. I love this little church. The pastors are wonderful and the worship is awesome. They regularly participate in outreach ministries to help the community and do a lot to help others. I would recommend this church if you are looking for a Christ centered, family friendly, community oriented and smaller than the big box church.

name: Encounter Christian Church - Winter Park Campus
reviewSummary:
A place where faith comes alive and the heart finds peace. This church inspires me with its atmosphere of love, unity, and hope. Every service is a reminder that God is present, guiding our steps and strengthening our faith. A space where the community becomes family, and I always leave renewed and grateful. Great place only been here 5 times. Very nice people. I will be coming back all the time now. I have attended many Bible-based Christian churches over the years in many different states.  Encounter Christian Church is one of the best!  Pastor Preston delivers messages directly from the Bible; and the Worship team offers a Spirit-filled/God-centered praise that brings me closer to God.

ECC also has an amazing program for youth and young children to help teach them how to grow in a relationship with Jesus.  Pastor Sean is an awesome youth pastor who keeps teens engaged through innovative and Bible-based experiences. This church has a great children's and youth ministry. The preacher is top notch. Great service and great community here!

name: Encounter Church - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely LOVE this church!! Some of the warmest most welcoming people I have ever met!! The sermon was so refreshing, the word of God is clearly very important to these people. I have never felt the Holy Spirit so strongly through people. I will absolutely be back!! Thank you Encounter Church!! I love this church! The most welcoming and truly Christ like community I’ve witnessed! I was welcomed with open arms the first time I came here and when I left and came back! Truly showed me what it means to love like Christ! This will forever be my home church wherever God leads me when i first came to this church, all there was was breakthrough. this is the first place that had felt like a true home to me, where they let the Holy Spirit move + linger throughout the services. it’s such a welcoming place to be and everyone should go! My friend invited me to Encounter Church in the very beginning of my freshman year at Kennesaw State, and I’ve been attending the church ever since! I truly believe that God placed me at Encounter Church and I’m honored to be at a church who truly fears the lord and pushes its members to God and to make disciples. This place is home! It's full of the holy spirit, warm hugs, and joy! Because this church truly leads by the word of God, I have learned how to have a personal relationship with Jesus

name: Encounter Church Denver - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary: The people at this place claim to be very religious, yet they leave the parking lot without using their turn signals, putting other people at risk. Does your religion—or your God—teach you that it's okay to ignore traffic laws and endanger others? For a church they sure are disrespectful loud music going on 10 pm with a HOTEL right across the street. Dogs at the hotel have barked NONE STOP ALL DAY!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Pastor Pat was extremely welcoming. I could truly feel the Lord’s presence throughout the service. Powerful prayer and everyone was a true believer. Definitely a smaller church community but it felt very close and was extremely welcoming. I’ll attend again whenever I’m back in the Denver area on a Sunday morning. Place where you can have Encounter of Jesus, please join and enjoy the rich presence of God ! This morning we were in the Denver area after a procedure for my wife and we decided to stop by Encounter Church on our way to the airport.  We stopped by for the 9am service where we had a great talk with their lead pastor Reece, and listened to his daughter give a great teaching, and it was all kicked off by amazing worship from Bri Wilson and the team, it was like going to a live concert. Thank you all for the hospitality, everyone in the church were extremely nice and we recommend this church for anyone passing by or in the area. Thank you to all the staff and people at Encounter.

name: Encounter Church Vegas - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: I hesitate to rate a church less than 5 stars but about a month ago or so a pastor was preaching and something just didn’t set well inside of me. He went on a tangent about some random podcaster’s and was telling us his/her income. The things he was saying just kinda felt strange to me. I am trying to be nice but I wanted to warn others When I lived in Vegas I was going to Encounter and you most definitely get an Encounter with the HolySpirit, this Church is very Special and unique in the Lord , Enjoy your Encounters with the Lord I do not recommend this church to anyone! I had just moved and was searching for a new church and noticed this church has great reviews. Once service started, worship lasted over 40 minutes accompanied by the lead Pastor. Then, 5 minutes for offerings. Another 10 minutes for information on becoming a volunteer. After almost an hour, the message finally had started with a brief read through from 1 Kings before Pastor Chris decided it was time to talk politics and how he enjoys getting hate on social media. Words he spoke were very hateful towards others and I didn't feel comfortable with all the judgements. Speaking in tongues is also very popular here, everything felt like an act. I am very disappointed that I brought my family here and wish someone would have left a review like this to save us from even coming. Unfortunately, I did not feel God here. Filled with the Spirit. Very welcoming and friendly church.  Good worship service. Amazing church! I would move away from Vegas but I don’t think I’d ever find a church community like this. Their worship is genuine and they listen for Holy Spirit and allow Him to move. So if you are used to 6 songs in 30 minutes for worship, their worship might be different. But it’s real. I’ve never felt God’s presence like I do here. Their pastors are so wonderful. The church community is full of wonderful people.

name: Encounter Community Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
This is my church I love this place I was baptized there they have a food bank second Wednesday of the month bring a wagon or cart they give out both items on the foods This place has a special place in my heart. From the first time we went, my sons and I felt welcomed and loved. Pastor Ken's sermons always lift me up and gets us ready to face the new week. I absolutely love this church. They don't teach you to fear God as some churches do, simply how much He loves us no matter what we have done. Pastor Ken has such an amazing way of using scripture to help us apply it to our daily lives with everything going on in the world.
Thank you to everyone at Encounter. You are a part of our lives now and I'm blessed to have found such a wonderful place to worship and learn! This is a wonderful worship community and Pastor Ken really makes scripture come alive and relates it to our modern day life.  Wonderful place to feel welcome! Amazing church. Everybody is loving and good spirited. The pastors are awesome, funny and they’re great to listen to. THE PASTORS DO NOT USE FEAR TACTICS!!!!!! Pastors uses fear tactics in sermons. Really uninspiring services and don't recommend this church. The people are nice.

name: Encounter Life Church Newnan - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
Anointed Holy spirit filled services! Pastors Jake and Marlana Gould are amazing! Greeter and hosts are friendly and welcoming.  Worship team is anointed and flows with the Spirit of God. Kids ministry is delightful! Ill be back again and again! How can I express my deep gratitude unto God for guiding me to ELC with just words… ELC has been pivotal in my walk with the Lord and a gift to me from precious Abba. I was embraced by this church since the first time I stepped through those double doors. I truly love the community, the mission mindset we collectively hold together, but especially the fact that there is room kept every service for the Holy Spirit to move however He wants to. I can’t attend every Sunday due to my current job but I miss them while I’m away.

We’re not perfect, no church is, but I Thank You Lord for this small taste of heaven. 💜 Have been going to this church for close to 3 years, became a member little over a year ago! Am so thankful to be a part of such a wonderful, blessed body of faith believers! A pastor that seeks the will of God for sermons & loves his congregation! Come & join us as we grow, accomplish great things for our Father God🕊🙏 I’ve never felt more at home at church! We absolutely love it here!! The worship is always amazing. The message is always on point. The children’s ministry and youth group are absolutely wonderful. My kids love going to church!!! We are so blessed to have found out church home!! Absolutely LOVE this church. It felt like home from the moment my husband and I walked in. Everyone is so welcoming. Worship is genuine and led by the Holy Spirit & Pastor Jake’s messages are real and relevant, but more importantly actually from the word!
There are so many life groups of different kinds. And the children's ministry has something for kids of all ages! My son loves going to church and seeing his nursery teachers and has made so many friends

name: End-time harvest Christian Center - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church home. Pastor Womack is a real man of God and has been a blessing to me. When I first visited the church I was hurt, confused, and completely lost. Now I’m free and striving to become the woman God has called me to be. I felt God’s presence in this church and immediately joined. If you want a church home where you’ll be taught the Word of God and feel His presence, here’s your place. I came to Jesus as I was, I was weary- born in sin. I found in Him a resting place. And He has made me glad. Home Sweet Home where I am equipped, corrected, directed, supported, encouraged and loved UP. GOD IS HERE. I am very grateful 🙏 and thank God for the fellowship of the saints I enjoy the praise and worship on YouTube and I enjoy the teachings. They have one of the best Wednesday night bible studies if you want to learn scriptures and how to apply scriptures to lifestyle. This place raise community awareness and development. I am pleased to be a part of the body and God's Kingdom is excellent here! May His Grace and Mercy follow us all the days of our lives. From grace to Great Grace. From glory to glory! Agape It's where I gather together with my brothers and sisters in the Lord and worship. Pastor Melvin Womack and his lovely wife Minister Julia Womack have been preaching the word of God there twenty plus years. If you want to know more come visit. Also you can Google them.

name: Endurance Church - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been a member of Endurance Church since it opened, and it has truly become my church home. One of the things I love most is the intimacy and genuine sense of community that comes with a smaller church. From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the love, warmth, and care of the people.

The pastors and leadership team are incredible. They genuinely care about the congregation and the surrounding community, and it shows in everything they do. If you’re looking for a church where you’ll be welcomed, known, and encouraged to grow in your faith, I highly recommend Endurance Church. I am so grateful that I have connected with Endurance church. Endurance is a Bible based church filled with people who love the Lord and unapologetically share the Gospel of Jesus Christ! The leadership team of pastors, associate pastors and elders are very knowledgeable and walks with the congregation to make sure we all have and can sustain biblical literacy. When I walked in the doors, I was greeted with the biggest smiles and warmest hugs! I knew that I would be back! If you are looking for a church home, I promise that you would not be disappointed if you came to visit Endurance Church. I hope to see you there! Endurance church has been such a blessing to me. I’ve been attending for about eight months now and I can truly say I’ve grown a lot spiritually. This church is not a church you come by often. They also have learning opportunities if you’re interested in evangelism, discipleship and learning how to understand the word. When you come here you will automatically feel welcomed and loved by the members. If you’re seeking a true church home this is the place. I’ve been attending Endurance church since 2017, and from the very first Sunday it felt like home. There’s something really special about the atmosphere here.  It’s warm, welcoming, and genuinely full of love. It’s the perfect size, big enough to have a variety of groups and opportunities to get involved but small enough that you truly get to know people on a personal level.

What I appreciate most is how diverse and family-oriented it is. You’ll see people of all ages and backgrounds worshipping together, supporting one another, and doing life together. It doesn’t feel like just a place you attend once a week, it truly feels like a second family.

If you’re looking for a church where you can grow in your faith, build real relationships, and hear the word of God, Endurance church is for you! This church is such a blessing. I’m so grateful God led me here. As an out-of-state college student, finding a church home was very important to me. After church hopping with my friend, we found Endurance Church and immediately felt welcomed. It was easy to get connected and build meaningful friendships centered around Christ. This church has truly become a home away from home for me.

name: Engage Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: Simply the best church in the world. Always focused on the bigger mission, the bigger picture, while telling the biggest more beautiful story of how Jesus came to save mankind. Thank you for Engage. Pastor Adrian is the goat idc. What I like about Engage is the relentless pursuit of Christ and the love that I have received here. Everyone loves me and it’s something that I have never really felt from a lot of other churches. Also, it’s one of the only places I’ve seen where people are actually TRYING to get Christ’s love 24/7, I’ve experienced a lot of fakeness in other places and would always view religion on a negative aspect. Engage has shown me love from the Father is such a powerful way that there’s no other church. Very real bible based teaching. If you want "feel good" non challenging teachings this might not be your cup o tea. I would encourage anyone looking for a church home, anyone looking to fill that God sized hole in your soul, anyone questioning, seeking, to come in give yourself a chance to find what your looking for. The people are friendly, helpful ,non judgmental, and welcoming. We have found a home. Definitely different than any other church I've been to. The people are genuine, you can come as you are, they talk about real life, real issues and keep Jesus at the center. They're creative and intentional about engaging the city they are a part of. Plus worship is lit and Pastor Adrian is always on point. I love being a part of Engage Church because it is one of the only places in my life where I can tangibly experience God's kingdom and its vastness. I love Engage because I'm challenged to never become comfortable where I am, and I am encouraged to learn more every day. I love that my gifts and talents, no matter how small or insignificant they seem, are valued.

name: Enjoy Church OC - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Too much energy to deal & early to pounce on. So much shout & complex at the end of service. Too many different subjects of prayers. Got food but only able to get before & after service. At least able to talk without dependence. This church is off the hook! I went there and the anointing was very strong. If I lived in Irving, this would be my home church. They were so sweet and nice. My family and I love this church. It has helps be more aware and have experienced the power of the Holy Spirit of God in our lives. The teaching of the Word of God was transformational. Exudes a family atmosphere where the love for each other was evident not expecting reciprocity. This place is amazing!!! I have been in church my entire life, and I have never been in a community like this. The presence of God is priority over everything. The people are kind, and genuinely love God and love others. Their heart for children and families is tangible. The kids always have a blast! The leaders are authentic and transparent in ways I have never experienced, and it makes me feel like I’m not alone in my own struggles. I highly recommend this church to everyone! We were invited to Arise Church in Irvine by a family friend in 2021, during the pandemic, and now have been attending for 3 years. Pastors Jason and Christine are so genuine and loving. We have found our church family home and everyone at this church welcomed us in with open arms when we were new. I never knew the importance of having a church family, compared to just attending Sunday church services, before attending Arise. We are now serving in church, and our son serves alongside us as well. God blessed our family by bringing us to Arise!!!!

name: Enlightened Christian Center - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
Rooted in BLESSINGS!!!

This has been my church home since I was a young teen. I grew up with this mentality and was able to grow aligned with their methodologies, though I was living out of state. I’ve been watching online for years. Glad to be BACK 😍😍🔥🔥🔥 #godliveshere This is the best church ever! The word is easily broken down so you can understand and the people are amazing. Visited this church while travelling from Australia and felt so warmly welcomed from the moment we arrived. The worship was vibrant, heartfelt, and beautiful—loud and proud in the best way. The sermon was grounded in Scripture, clear, and deeply relevant—a timely message that spoke directly to us. What stood out most was the genuine warmth of the people. It wasn’t just a friendly greeting; it felt like an open invitation to come again. We left feeling encouraged, uplifted, and grateful for this faith-filled community. Sermon was preached using scripture and real life scenarios however some things said made me clutch my pearls. I will continue to look for a home church. Honest Experience – Still Searching for the Right Church

I relocated to Georgia a little over a year ago and have been attending this church for about six months. The greeters are always warm and welcoming, which initially drew me in. I actually chose this church based on the positive reviews I read.

However, I recently had a personal issue that I needed to discuss with the pastor. After service, I introduced myself, and he greeted me politely, even introducing me to his wife. When I mentioned that I needed to speak with him privately, I was informed that I would need to become a member first and that there was already a long list of members waiting to speak with him. While I understand that pastors have busy schedules, I was surprised that there was no effort to at least acknowledge my concern or check if I was okay in that moment.

Unfortunately, this interaction left me feeling like I wasn’t truly valued as someone seeking guidance. I left with a smile, but inside, I knew this wasn’t the place for me. I’m still looking for a church where I can connect with leadership without needing to be a member first.

name: Envoy Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church with amazing people. Being in the military, I've traveled lots of places, and this is the best group of Christians I've been around. It is a very welcoming place and you can definitely tell the Spirit of the Lord is on it with the number of baptisms that happen every Sunday. I'm not a fan of Colorado or Colorado Springs in general, but this place makes me want to stay here. You know what’s great about this church, It actually does in action what 90% of the churches here in Colorado Springs just talk about. Churches is here in Colorado Springs  talk about doing good but when it comes time to actually do good, nobody shows up. High 5 🙌🏻and awesome Christ like actions feeding homeless people. There’s only a few churches in the springs that actually care IN ACTION. And faith is dead without works. ✝️🙌🏻🙌🏻🙏

If Satan can’t stop you from becoming a Christian, he’ll do whatever it takes by all means necessary to make sure you’re not effective at it, filling your mind up with *thoughts* of “don’t help anyone, you had better things to be doing, you don’t wanna look at poverty in the face” kind of thoughts and whatever else it takes so people never show good works. Thank goodness this Church has gotten over that hurdle.❤️✝️🙌🏻🙏👍 Envoy is one of the biggest blessings in this phase of my life. I came to Envoy during a time in which I really needed a sense of community, and everyone has been so welcoming and kind, it has easily felt like stepping into a new family. Those who work here and those who attend alike are good people and I am grateful to know them. God’s presence shines throughout. Thank you, everyone at Envoy! Great Church!  My Church of course but want to give a sincere and truthful statement about Envoy Church. Envoy is wonderful, helpful, generous and most of all, a truthful place to receive the word of God. Paster Cory creates a good connection for understanding and learning the scripture. There are many ways to connect with people here (1) small groups (2) weekend men's breakfast or women's lunch and (3) summer retreats for men to name just a few. If you're looking to expand your knowledge, create a better life, and make some friends with other like minded minded people then this is a wonderful choice to start or continue your journey with Christ. You quickly feel God's love in this Church. The congregation quickly becomes your family. There's not much more you could ask for. Come have a life changing experience with Jesus here and you'll know what I'm talking about.

name: Epic Church Center City
reviewSummary: Engaging, practical Christian community in Center City Philadelphia designed to help people know God, find freedom, discover purpose, and make a difference.

name: Epic Church Center City - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary:
Praise be to God for The Kingdom of God is within you. It was really great being there this past Sunday. Two months ago I went to a church that was inside a modern corporate building called Victory Church and it was packed since I can see why they had 3 services in the morning it was in Audubon, PA in the King of Prussia area. The pastor was Ed Crenshaw. Than early last month I went to freedom church which is few blocks away from Epic Church. The was pastor Gabe Bouch at Freedom Church was really filled with the holy Spirit and really preached the word of God really deeply. God bless him as he and everybody was really friendly there. It was also like Victory church 3 services in the morning and about all the seats were jam packed. But this very much a lot like the first two but the main differences was that the Pastor himself wasn't there in person instead he was live on a theater screen and that they had 2 services. Michael the Youth Pastor was the one on screen. Have to say that's a unique one of a kind experience. The seats wasn't as packed Which left me more room. Plus being the fact that this church has three churches two in Philly and one in King of Prussia is a great blessing. First time I came to this church was about 9 years ago through a random invitation. I come once in a while, on and off, never committed..

About 2 years ago, I decided to challenge myself to go to church every Sunday. Not long after that, life happens, heart break, stress, whatevs... People from church shows up makes me feel that I don't have to carry this alone, when life gets hard also in everyday moment..

One thing that I love about this church is that it doesn't feel overly religious, judgemental, or holier-than-thou attitude. Their messages are practical and relatable, in a way that connects to real life, real problems, and everyday situation. Wonderful church. My husband and I were in Philly for a medical procedure he was having ar UPenn. We found  Epic  Church online and decided to attend Sunday morning. What a welcoming church. The message was Biblical and applicable. The worship was amazing!  Brought tears to my eyes.
After the service, we met Pastor Will. Such an engaging and kind man. He asked what brought us to the church and we explained why we were in town. He stopped immediately and prayed with us.
We were so moved by this, considering everyone wants to talk to the Pastor after church and we were strangers to him😊
God is moving at Epic and has placed faithful leaders to do His work there. If you live or are visiting Philly, please check it out! I am very picky about spiritual community! So much so that I've been attending an online church for almost a year because I couldn't find a space in Philly I felt was a good fit. I literally came across this place by a dance instructor's IG page and decided to check it out. So grateful I did! I have never felt so welcomed, so safe and just so much love and peace in a space. I'm so grateful I was led here 😭♥️ thank you! Epic church is AMAZING. I always feel so welcomed when I go on Sunday's, the pastor that give the message is full of hope, great knowledge and connects well with so many of us. I always get texts from Epic with heartfelt messages, I love my experiences at Epic church!

name: Epic Church King of Prussia
reviewSummary:
Epic has had a profound impact on my family. The entire team at Epic is amazing! They create a comfortable and welcoming place for my family to meet Jesus at our level.

I have children, and the kids program is not only impactful, but fun for our kids. Each week, our kids ask if we are going to “fun church.” My kids leave church with a lesson from the bible that they cannot wait to tell my wife and I on the ride home.

I truly love being a part of the community, and I cannot recommend it enough if you are ready to take the next step or continuing your faith journey! What are you waiting for? Come join us😃 We started attending Epic when it was one location in a movie theater. Now they have 3 locations and online. No excuse to miss church. The teaching is practical and easy to understand. There are excellent kids spaces and staff. This is a community where you can learn about God and grow your faith. Everyone is kind and welcoming.  You can dress comfortably, there is no dress code.   They also provide coffee, tea and water. EPIC is home. I couldn't imagine going to church anywhere else, it is a great fit for me. It is diverse, welcoming, and scripturally solid. Also shout out to Allie, the children's ministry director. She is a blessing to the church, and has also been to me personally in service. Her and Justin are THE BEST! Epic Church, in my perspective, is a place where everyone is welcome. It is a safe haven where people from all walks of life can come together to grow in their love for God, deepen their faith, or simply learn more about Him. Epic creates a supportive and accepting community where everyone has a place to belong. I found Epic at a time when I was over church and was trying to hide. But let me tell you, I was found AND I found in Epic: a safe space, a dynamic and vibrant community and best of all somewhere my spirit could call home. Epic isn't just fun and bright, but it also PUTS JESUS FIRST. And when he's at the center everything else falls into place. And I've seen it with my own eyes over and over since I've been here. You should definitely come check it out for yourself!

name: Epic Church San Francisco
reviewSummary: Warm, culturally relevant downtown San Francisco congregation meeting at the Scottish Rite and online, dedicated to helping people in the Bay Area experience life-changing faith.

name: Epic Church San Francisco - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: Warm, culturally relevant downtown San Francisco congregation meeting at the Scottish Rite and online, dedicated to helping people in the Bay Area experience life-changing faith.

name: Epicentre West LA - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited for the first time this morning. Epicenter West LA church seems to be a younger generation, 20s and 30s very popular. Here’s a little information about my visit.

Parking: Street— I arrived a few minutes late and was still able to find parking along the street. This church meets at a synagogue across the street from Trader Joe’s. They have a small sign out front which is the only indicator that Epicentre meets there.

Welcoming: from the moment I walked up the stairs, I was greeted by Lauren and Kenter. They were both super welcoming and super sweet. They seemed so happy to be greeting visitors and regular comers alike. We exchanged words for a few minutes and they gave me a name tag. Most people wear a name tag at the church. If you leave your visitor badge with your name as you exit, they will make you a permanent badge for when you return. The badges are all placed on a large board at the entrance of the church so you do not forget it from Sunday to Sunday. Kinda cool concept and very helpful to remember people’s names.

Worship: Lights were dimmed and the worship team with about five members did a great job with the music. I really enjoyed the songs and still have one that I’ve never heard stuck in my head. A few people lifted hands but does not seem to be the norm. Pretty small congregation but I understand there are a lot of people out sick this week so they say they may be missing about 30 or 40 people.

Sermon: The message was brought by a young pastor name Steve. It was very short, probably about 15 minutes or less. Apparently the pastor and his whole family are out ill with the flu this week. We went back into worship and sang a few of the same songs we sang through the worship time. Between worship and the sermon, a young man came up and gave the announcements and provided information about the church as well as the Epicenter app they use to transmit information throughout the congregation.

Snack and chat: They had a very cool concept and which I’ve never seen in a church. They provided snacks and encouraged people to hang around to visit and socialize. Lauren and Kenter came after service and brought me a little gift for visitors and we chatted again for a bit during snack and chat. Very sweet couple. I met the girl sitting behind me her name was, Shina.

Life Groups: I went to visit the wall which has the connect groups locations and was greeted by a young doctor from UCLA carrying a baby. (Again, so friendly!) He explained the various groups. There did not seem to be one for my age group really (40s/single) but there seem to be plenty of groups for the younger generation and one even for married people.

This was a friendly church, probably one of the friendliest churches I have ever attended. I would highly recommend it for the younger generation although it doesn’t feel like there’s much of a group my age. Seems to be multicultural although the largest population seems to be Asian. I would absolutely recommend this church to someone looking around for a home. Everyone was so friendly which makes it much easier to connect. Epicentre West LA has an incredibly devoted and inviting group of Christ followers. My wife and I started going to this church upon moving to West LA. We could not be happier with our decision. This church has brought us closer to God and provided us with a community of believers that help us feel like we're a part of something greater. There are no stuffy traditions or hypocrisy at this church. We are invited to come as we are and to love one another as Christ has loved us. Hope to see you here! I've been a part of a church my whole life and many different ones as my wife and I have moved around the US and lived in various countries.  That said, we've been attending Epicentre West LA for a while now and can say that we feel really welcome here.  The community is still small (church just started in February) but very welcoming.  The pastor gives challenging sermons, grounded in Scripture, and always makes sure to make it relevant to life.  We don't have kids, but know there's an excellent children's program.  I also like that they're focused on meeting in "Lifegroups" during the week and have enjoyed being part of one of them.  This is a great place to grow in your faith. Love this church! The moment my girlfriend and I arrived we felt welcomed. Afterwards we looked at each other and said that this church immediately felt like home. People are so passionate in worship, and preaching is super applicable and down to earth. Also, there's food after! They really focus on community and life groups so we'll be checking that out for sure. This has been my church since 2015. I felt welcome right away and had so many people engage with me and care about me. I love how this church has grown and how it encourages its member to truly dive into their community and love this city.

name: Epiphany Fellowship
reviewSummary: Nationally recognized urban church founded by Dr. Eric Mason, combining profound Reformed biblical scholarship with vibrant urban culture and restorative community care.

name: Episcopal Church of Our Saviour - Mill Valley Campus
reviewSummary: Easy to pop in and check if the world's coming to an end, so far so good. Boring speeches  but nice people. Just missed Jesus though,  sadly he was called away on personal business. Great Easter service!  Thank you. Great sermon

name: Episcopal Church of the Transfiguration - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church, nice warship Married here and our children were christened here.  Beautiful church with very nice people. Great preacher
Caring congregation
Lots of care and love for newcomers Wonderful place... I wonder what the "new" rector is like? This Parrish has a caring and welcoming community.

name: Episcopal Church-The Messiah - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
The Episcopal Church of the Messiah is more than just a place of worship—it’s a sanctuary of peace, love, and genuine community. From the moment I first walked through the doors, I was welcomed with open arms and warm hearts. The historic beauty of the church is breathtaking, but what truly moves me is the spirit of compassion and inclusivity that lives here.

Every service is filled with thoughtful reflection, inspiring music, and a sense of sacred presence that stays with you long after you leave. The clergy and congregation are deeply committed to justice, mercy, and serving others—not just within the church, but throughout the city of Santa Ana.

Whether you’re searching for spiritual growth, a place to belong, or simply a quiet moment of connection, the Church of the Messiah offers it with grace and humility. I’m so grateful to have found this community. It has been a source of light in my life, and I know it will be for anyone who steps inside. Grew up in this church. Moved away and haven't been there in many decades. This is a very nice church. I do not attend the church services but I have used space here for community based programs. They hav a lot of space to have a variety of functions from studying scripture or having weddings and receptions. There  is a nice courtyard for these things as well. Everyone I came in contact with was very friendly and more than accommodating for those type of things.  Well maintained. Just all around good experience here. Love my home Church.  Very affirming.  Open to and for all. Really nice old rustic feel of the building. Very welcoming and nice service

name: Episcopal City Mission
reviewSummary: Great location and beautiful building. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Episcopal Diocese of Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: uganda

name: Equipped Church - Highlands Ranch Campus
reviewSummary:
Going to Equip church , especially just  moving from a different country/continent made it feel like home and the family that I use to have back at home , the sermons are so powerful and you can really lean into them , the people are lovely as well some of the kindest and most generous people I’ve meet , but over all it’s a 9/10 we just need more young people 😂😂 Come and be filled with the word of God. The community is very friendly, caring and welcoming. You will be greeted with a smile and a hug if you need one. The worshipping is wonderful. You will leave with Gods joy in your heart. Come and see it for yourself. Stay after for a cup of coffee, hot chocolate or tea and some yummy snacks. Love to see. 😊 Equipped Church is a truly special place. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed with genuine warmth and kindness. The people here aren’t just friendly—they’re family. There’s a deep sense of community that’s rooted in a shared desire to know and follow Jesus more closely.

The teaching is Christ-centered, encouraging, and grounded in Scripture. Worship is heartfelt and powerful, creating space for people to encounter God personally. What really sets Equipped Church apart is the way they prioritize relationships—people are known, loved, and supported through every season of life.

If you're looking for a church that combines strong biblical teaching, a passion for Jesus, and an authentic, caring community, Equipped Church is a place you’ll want to call home. Talk about a biblical foundational church. Equipped has been such a a fruit of a find. Feels like a small family, an actual sense of community. Everyone is so engaging, and you can truly feel the connection. Pastor reads directly from the word, and your heart is full on Sunday afternoons. Highly recommend dropping by We are so happy to have found Equipped Church! Everyone is so welcoming, authentic, and caring. Pastor Chris brings the love of Jesus and his Word alive each week. Praise and worship time is powerful and personal as we're drawn into the Throne room. Everyone at Equipped Church does a fantastic job encouraging littles, tweens, teens and adults alike to press in to what God has for them and wants to do in and through them! We are so grateful to call this church, home!

name: Escondido Christian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: Use to attend long ago, sadly it changed in more ways than one, we no longer felt God's presence there, so we left, hopefully it will return to it's former spiritual statis when pastor Coleman was pastor. Totally Awesome Fellowship, Music, and Message. My wife and I received friendly greetings from the members of this Church family. We were Blessed by the Music and really felt the love of the Lord. The message really spoke to us. We have been praying for the Lord to help us find a new Church home since we moved to Escondido. He answered our prayers this last weekend. Thank you Lord for our new Church family. Looking forward to the days ahead as we continue to grow closer to you . This Church has been our home for years! So warm and welcoming with no push. They love God and preach real life situations from the  Bible. So relatable! Love this place and happy to call it home! My daughter and I had been looking for a church that could make us feel like family for the longest time and this church and congregation welcomed us with open arms. We can say that we are finally home. You can feel the presences of God here members always welcoming you with a smile. love our church. The pastor is amazing and the way God use is him to speak to you through him is incredible. This church is our home. It’s where I learned that you don’t need religion but rather a personal relationship with God. Everyone is genuine and welcoming with open arms. Most of all Pastor Joel and the rest of the crew are amazing teachers and leaders. We drive 30 minutes from Oceanside to attend every week and we’ve been doing this for 12 years. There’s a reason for that. I’ve considered so many times attending a local church so it’s easier to fellowship but God has made it very clear that Escondido Christian Church is where we’re supposed to be. Whether you have attended church in the past or if you never knew God like  me, I’d like to encourage you to come and get to know the big man in a real way. Forget church and religion and come learn how to hear the Lord speak to you. You are so loved, come and experience that ❤️

name: Essential Church Huntsville - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Today was the very first time I have ever voluntarily stepped foot inside a church (as an adult), both for myself and for my 5-year-old daughter—and I can honestly say, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience than at Essential Church.

I had spent weeks combing through websites, searching for a place that felt like “home” the first time, because I didn’t want my daughter’s first impression of church to be a negative one. Some churches made me uneasy right away with things like asking about annual income on visitor forms or stating they would “discipline you into loving Jesus.” That’s not what I was looking for at all.

When I found Essential Church’s website, it immediately felt different—welcoming, genuine, and aligned with what my heart was hoping for.

From the moment we arrived, we felt seen and cared for. We had to park down the road, but a church bus was already out, ready to give rides back to the building—such a thoughtful detail. Inside, people noticed we were new and went out of their way to greet us and make us feel welcome.

As a mom who has never left her child with anyone besides grandparents, I was especially impressed by the level of safety and protection in the kids’ ministry. The secure check-in system gave me a unique code that matched with my daughter’s, and there was even a police officer present for extra security. That gave me such peace of mind.

The main assembly was filled with people from all walks of life—no pressure to look a certain way, no judgment. Just everyday people gathered to worship. They even had coffee and snacks available, which felt like a sweet blessing since we drove 30 minutes to get there and I had skipped my morning coffee to get out the door.

The best part of all? When I picked up my daughter, she ran to me smiling and said, “Mom, I loved it here. I hope we come back!” My heart was so relieved—and I couldn’t agree with her more.

Before we left, they gave us a thoughtful gift and even a card with the pastor’s direct contact info, which made the experience feel personal and sincere.

Essential Church lived up to its name—it was exactly what we needed, and I’m so thankful our first church experience was here. We will definitely be back! Best Church in town!! Great Bible based preaching, and the only church I found in Huntsville that allows misfits like me to come and jump Right In and serve... And if you haven't been there you got to go because Jesus is moving in this place!!! I love this church! When we first moved to Huntsville we tried 2 different churches and we weren’t really feeling a spark then we found essential and immediately fell in love! It is a “small” church and it feels like home, they are sooooo welcoming and we are very involved in the church and the worship is AMAZING! They annoy all the neighbors by knocking on doors trying to preach at us.  This is Five Points, many of us (more than the average population) don’t believe as they do.  The Presbyterian church that was there before was much better, they minded their own business. Wonderful experience attending Essential. Have been going for several months. This is my home church now. Pastor Tim is amazing and everyone is happy. It is a very happy place filled with love, worship and song.

name: Estrella Mountain Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
Good church with solid biblical teaching. Taekwondo classes at the church on Sunday and Tuesday for ages 5 and up.
5-7 year olds class is 6:00 to 6:30 pm. 8 and up is 6:30 to 7:00 pm. My husband and I moved to Estrella Mountain Ranch 2.5 years ago and wanted to find our hone church. We were looking for biblically based teaching, an intimate environment where we could connect and form relationships with others and get involved. Our 1st church we visited was Estrella Mountain Church (EMC) and we never looked at another church. We have made some amazing friends and feel that we are apart of a church community family. My husband recently lost his nephew unexpectedly and the entire church prayed for us and our family, reached out to us, loved on us, it was something we had never experienced before. We have seen the church circle around and love on everyone at this church. So if you are new and looking for a church that is biblically based and lives our Christ's definition of what a church should be, then I would recommend checking out EMC! A wonderful experience... the people are authentically seeking Christ and show so much kindness. The pastoral staff are wise & compassionate. The worship is fun and thoughtful. I love the sermons that are a great mix of history, theology, thought provoking. These people really join together in difficult times and take care of each other. I see a lot of grace here. Enjoyed the smaller church feel... the music was great, and service was decent. Pastor seems friendly.  However, it was absolutely freezing (air conditioning) and very hard to stay focused because of it. For communion, slightly concerned with everyone breaking off the same bread loaf and dipping into the same "wine" because of Covid being out there. I took communion, but my boyfriend did not which was a shame. We were looking for a bible-based, loving church and found Estrella Mountain Church on a google search.  We listened to a couple of the sermons on their website and liked that they were bible based and practical for everyday living.

We attended the church for the first time last Sunday.  It was a casual and very friendly environment, the music was inspirational and the Pastor's message was "spot-on".   We look forward to our next opportunity to attend.

name: Eternal Church - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this place and I’m calling it HOME! Eternal feels like home. A community of believers who care for one another well. Teachers who consistently and humbly hold to the truth of God’s holy Word above all personal preference or opinion (and encourage the congregation to do the same).
Refreshingly void of subversive political messages. The musical team does a fantastic job leading the congregation into worship through song, and the pastors do a fantastic job leading us into worship through faithful preaching of the Word.

Sometimes you leave the service (in person or YouTube), scratching your head, but in a good way. The itch is put there to make you pray, think, and research.

name: Etiwanda Community Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church and faithful pastor who cares about scripture however this is most certainly not a non-denominational church but Pentecostal (Oneness Pentecostal in particular).

Edit: While the owner denies any association with Oneness Pentecostalism I believe transparency is extremely important when it comes to believers seeking churches. The following is taken from the Wikipedia page on Oneness Pentecostalism, the defining tenets of which, in my experience, Etiwanda Community Church adheres to:

"Oneness Pentecostalism derives its distinctive name from its teaching on the Godhead, which is popularly referred to as the "Oneness doctrine," a form of Modalistic Monarchianism. This doctrine states that there is one God, a singular divine Spirit, who manifests himself in many ways, including as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. This stands in sharp contrast to the doctrine of three distinct and eternal persons posited by Trinitarian theology. Oneness believers baptize in the name of Jesus Christ, rather than using the Trinitarian formula, of baptizing "in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit." Oneness believers state that Jesus is the one name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, and so should perform all religious activities in that one name.
Besides their beliefs about the Godhead, Oneness Pentecostals differ significantly from most other Pentecostal and Evangelical Christians in matters of soteriology. Whereas most Pentecostals and Evangelical Protestants believe that only faith in Jesus Christ is the essential element for salvation, Oneness Pentecostalism defines salvation as saved by grace through faith and "true" faith leads to repentance, full-submersion water baptism (in the name of Jesus Christ) and baptism in the Holy Spirit, with the evidence of speaking in other tongues." This is a growing church with a loving pastor. As a fellow Minister, I am excited to see where God is leading this pastor and this local assembly. This church  is one of the most socially acceptable churches I have been to since I was Jr high. I have learned more here about scripture and myself than I have in the 30 years of my life. Connecting point community church is life changing..Great atmosphere and the presence of God is well felt..🔥🙏👏👏👏💯 It's a old church that is delicate but strong

reviewSummary: We've been searching for a church home for months since we moved to Columbus. So many circumstances kept leading us here. Once I got here, I understand that it was God leading us here. Also, everyone was very kind, and I felt very welcomed. My kids loved it so much, they wanted to stay. Great church! Great relaxing park and coffee I'm not a memeber but the environment is a positive one Great playground and facility!  Thank you Evangel Church for sharing your space with the community! This was our second time visiting Evangel and we have enjoyed both services! The church body is ethnically diverse, friendly, and welcoming. The pastor is down to earth, approachable, and humble. It’s clear Evangel appreciates the need for healthy children’s and student outreach programs — then carried out a successful plan to sow into those ministries. We look forward to visiting again this Sunday! Pastor Paul is a gifted pastor and always gets his message across.

They have a rare combination of being both sound biblically and outreach oriented. Love this church! They have been there for us through all of the good and tough times over the years from health concerns to job issues.  ! So thankful for the Biblical preaching! name: Everwell Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve gone to church most of my life and the best way to describe my experience with Everwell is PEACEFUL.  This is not a church you go to be entertained - this is a church you attend to be deeply reminded of how much God loves us and loves others. Everwell is a community of amazing friends and family who are fed by the word, and a place where the gospel is preached every week.

I am so thankful to have found Everwell. My husband and I started going about a year ago, and we have since gained an amazing family, friends, and a greater relationship with God.

The church has about 40-60 people, who are a mixture of people: young singles, new families, and those who have been Christians for many decades. There is a Wednesday night community group in CDM that we love going to, in addition to a monthly women’s and men’s coffee. Amazing local church with a great community After living in the world for about 27 years and working as a Deputy Sheriff for about 6 at the time, I had the opportunity to see just how dark the world can truly be. As Jesus started to tug on my heart, a dear friend of mine (who had been going there for years) invited me to Everwell. The message as well as the genuineness of the people seemed sound after the first visit. After the second, The Pastor, Josh ran up to my friend and I as we were at our cars, introduced himself to me and insisted to pray for me. Next thing I know, I’m ugly sobbing in the parking lot with my newfound brothers, the spirit had lit a fire in my heart. A year later, I’m baptized in the name of Jesus and astonished at the vastness of Gods will. It’s safe to say this is my new family.

If you’re nervous about Church in general and you’re with believer with bad church experiences, in that case go for GOD and experience HIM, not for the people (even though the people here are fricken awesome). If you’re unsure about the whole thing that is Christ Jesus, in world full of deception and wickedness, you owe it you to yourself to seek the TRUTH. Come with an open heart and I have faith that you’ll find it.

May God bless anyone who takes the time to read this, I look forward to seein any new faces.🫶🏼
