reviewSummary:
As a spiritual leaders in NY my wife and I are excited each week to attend the evening service at 6pm at 414 West 51st street.  The worship, preaching, and the genuine love for people pours out into each service.  If you choose to attend, God’s love will touch and change you!  That’s a promise. See you there this Sunday.
Much Love, PR ❤️ Every Nation Church is truly a place of warmth, community, and spiritual growth. The messages are powerful and inspiring, making it easy to connect with both the teachings and the people. The staff and congregation are incredibly welcoming, creating a supportive environment where everyone feels like family. The worship experience is uplifting, and the programs they offer for all ages are engaging and impactful. If you're looking for a church that truly makes a difference in your life, Every Nation is the place to be. I absolutely love this church. From the moment you walk through the doors, you're greeted by genuinely warm and kind people. When you enter the main service area, one thing stands out to me: the beautiful diversity of the congregation. You'll see individuals from all walks of life, of all ages, and from various backgrounds and nations. It's a Bible-based, Spirit-empowered, and socially responsible church that truly embodies a welcoming and inclusive spirit. Highly recommend this church to anyone :)! I LOVE the evening service at this church! The atmosphere is just as welcoming and inviting as the morning services. What stands out to me most about the PM service is how it feels both intimate and powerful. The message is consistently gospel-centered, biblically sound, and action-oriented. The diversity of the congregation is truly beautiful, with people from all walks of life coming together to worship Jesus. The church I got baptized in. Very welcoming even if you are new in the city you will feel welcome. Church that teaches how God loves you

name: Every Nation Church Seattle
reviewSummary:
Pastor Perry is a wonderful teacher, father, and pastor. Makes this place feel like a true home 🔥
Will be relocated to Hallows church next Sunday at 10:30am. Beyond grateful for this church and their willingness to stay rooted in Seattle and serve this city. The pastoral care and willingness to shepherd their community through the highs and lows of life is absolutely amazing.

They have a deep and evident love of Jesus and His teachings and is a place where you can be spiritual fed and emotionally cared for as well. One thing we also love about this community is how the name EVERY Nation really is represented by the congregation - we love the diversity and beauty that is represented in the room and in the community! It's a blessing to know this amazing church and be a part of their ministry! Come on in and check the church out. Pastor Perry and Danielle are awesome and really care about their community and neighborhood. Small to mid-sized church, active community and welcoming to new people. They have a heart for the next generation and loving people well.

Very transparent about their organization, finances, structure, etc. with their church family. Really good about making that stuff available for others to examine.

The location moved from a theater to a building, to their current location now so it’s been a journey but they are still committed to their mission of loving God and loving people no matter when they end up. If you’re looking for community, it’s a good place to start. Thanks cross and crown for hosting, y’all are awesome! The seattle churches really do believe in helping one another in need and they do what they can for each other as a body of Christ. My family and I have been a part of Every Nation Church Seattle for over 13 years.

Family
Over the years it is obvious that ENCS puts people over place, making anywhere we have met feel homey and welcoming. This family feel extends towards helping each other with practical things.

Finances
For such a small church it is astounding how invested ENCS is in the community and abroad.  The yearly financial report and vision casting/review is a great opportunity to see what ENCS as a whole has been doing.

Fun
There's so much fun involved! From anime clubs, to game nights, to zumba dance parties, to grabbing boba next door, there's always a way to connect with others. I have called this church family for 8 years now. This church has seen my wife and me go from boyfriend and girlfriend, to fiancé and fiancée, to husband and wife, and now to father and mother.  We have grown and flourished here, and now we get to see our kids do the same. At every turn, the people here have been there for us to celebrate life's wins and to mourn life's losses. It's an understatement to say that the ENCS's people and leadership are warm and generous. They go out of their way to open their hearts to those looking for connection; they preach the Gospel with knowledge, conviction, and passion; and most importantly, they keep Jesus at the center of everything. If you're looking for a solid, Christ-centered church that cares deeply for its members, the local community, and the City of Seattle, then please come to a Sunday service! We would love to welcome you!

name: Every Nation Cincinnati Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: A well trained group of volunteers. They provided a welcoming environment while also maintaining excellence and safety. Very diverse: ethnicities, ages, socio-economic. The teaching/preaching expository and well done. Music ministry is serious about ushering in the presence of God. Parking can be challenging. Overall a definite recommend: not just to visit, but stay and learn of God! After searching for a church in three different cities over many years, the first time I walked into Every Nation Cincy, I knew I found my place. People from throughout the world come together to serve, love, play and pray. Everyone makes you feel comfortable, and you can be as involved as you choose to be. I can’t speak highly enough of the staff & lead pastor, Brian Taylor, & his family, too. Went for a baptism. Very welcoming. Nice sermon. 3 services on Sunday. Was a wonderful process an Easy Love the teaching and diversity. Coming from other members of the Every Nation family we felt right at home and welcome when we first walked in.

name: Every Nation Downtown LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This was one of the most disappointing church experiences I've ever had. In my personal experience, the environment felt judgmental rather than welcoming, and I often felt that people were more focused on criticism than genuine spiritual growth. I also felt that certain leaders used their personal opinions in ways that were presented as God's will, which made it difficult for me to trust their guidance. I did not feel supported, valued, or encouraged in my faith journey while attending this church. The leadership came across as more concerned with appearances and finances than with serving the congregation. I also felt there were issues with favoritism and unequal treatment that were never openly addressed. If you are looking for a church focused on compassion, humility, and helping people grow in their relationship with God, this was not my experience here. Others may feel differently, but I cannot personally recommend this church. Services are 11am-1230pm Sundays. If you wanna get in touch the rest of the week go to the website and socials!

Love Every Nation!!! I went to their church in PH, Boston and now in LA! EN DTLA is the newest church plant of Every Nation Ministries in LA! Can't wait to check out their services and see what God will do!

name: Evident Life Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church right in the heart of downtown Gilbert! A truly multi-generational and Spirit-filled community that is intentional in everything they do and deeply rooted in God’s Word. Such a welcoming and genuine place to grow in faith and community. It was a really good church until I was seeking for more.  Pastor Eric stand up guy love Velvet.  When I split with my husband, I was totally cut off.  I thought i had made some real solid friends I was aiming to share lol.  But it could also be outta sight outta mind.  My ex still goes with my ex bestie. I love this church all people there  are so kind if you want to makes friends this is a church for you I am so glad I came to this church Solid in the Word and comprehensive in the variety of ministries. The pastor seems solid and is not afraid to talk about sin or about current events. You can sense the Holy Spirit here but there are few physical evidence of it (no tongues, prophecy, etc). Not sure, but women do not seem to have leadership positions. We love this church so much me and my family go there every Sunday everyone is so friendly and pastor Eric we love him so much  best church in the valley ❤️

name: Exalt Community Church - Daphne Campus
reviewSummary: I love this Church. Great fellowship and deep teaching of the word of God.

name: Excel Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Terribly rude and not very churchly to have your security ask 3 ladies and 2 kids to not sit at your benches and ask them to leave because it's private property. you should be ashamaded of yourselves that you'd rather have an empty courtyard, than filled with a couple women and children. shameful. My wife and I just moved here and fell in love with this church. Great place for children, teens, young adults, and adults to experience Christ in fullness. This place is laid back and arms open, but they don't compromise the Gospel. The church is very friendly and loving. The worship is comparable to HillSong!! **Seriously!! The Holy Spirit is moving in this place. Come check it out It's difficult for me to communicate my full affection for this church.  I attended for 6 years before moving out of the state of Florida.  I have spent 6 more years looking for a church like this one, without success.  The wisest, most genuine, most caring, group of people I've ever met.  The quality of teaching has few peers.  They are proactively involved in their city.  If you are looking for a church home, you should try Excel Church. My family and I relocated to FL a little over a month ago. We do not know anyone in the area and was looking for a church. I was a little hesitate to use google to find a church because I believe you have to be led by God in finding a church. To me googling churches is so impersonal.  Despite my discomfort...I decided to google churches because I had no other choice. I came across Excel Church and attended service. I am so happy I did. They have youth ministry for all ages and Pastor Derrick was great! His delivery was so clear and precise. I did not leave asking myself "What was the message".

If you are new to Jacksonville looking for a church...God will lead you. If you are still unsure check out Excel Church on YouTube and listen to Pastor Derrick message and let the spirit guide you on deciding of this is the place you should be. No frills and show here. Plain and simple truth. The Word of God spoken, taught with simplicity and understanding. Come as you are, but expect to be welcomed and treated with so much love and respect. Pastor Mike and Connie, along with their team of ministers, leaders, and congregation are truly about the business of God. I am not a member, but visit as often as I can, and when I can't there is I-Church.

name: Excel Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
I have now been a member of this church for a year and a half, and it is amazing! The pastor teaches the kingdom of God. The way he breaks things down so you can better understand God is incredible! Everyone welcomes you with open arms! My kids love coming to church and that also was very important to me! I love the kids ministry! What church you is teaching the kids the alphabet in Hebrew? Come and be ready for a life changing experience! ❤️ If you come to this church get ready to come again and again! You will feel the presence of the Lord in the room while we praise Him! Everyone is so nice! My daughter is 3 and I know she is well taken care of when I drop her off in the kids ministry! You will love it! The first 5 days of the year 2025 God has shown us His favor by blessing us with a fully covered trip from Puerto Rico to Atlanta, all expenses paid just to answer one of our prayers of celebrating new year’s (2025) in the assembly in person (since we are online members at the moment) and to finally meet our Pastors Mike Darnell and Ghilaine Darnell, it has been an honor, and we are so excited for what God is doing. Pleased to say our Excel Church Atlanta is excellent there is so much love, so much energy words cannot express the feeling we got as soon as we entered the parking lot. Since July 2024 when we heard Pastor Mike Darnell’s preaching in Bahamas about Kingdom technology, it impacted our lives. Every Sunday, every event, every message is life changing, it will literally challenge everything you know about God and His Kingdom, transforming your mind and completely changing your life into Kingdom living. God is moving and doing BIG in Excel Church and we believe this is just starting, honored to be part of Excel Church👑 - Cotto Family Love, love, love Excel Church!

I’ve been tuned in since 2023, and I can honestly say this church has transformed my walk with Christ. The in-depth Kingdom teaching is unmatched—and believe me, it’s extremely hard to find! Even though my family and I live in Houston, Texas, we periodically travel to attend in person because that’s how deeply we’ve been impacted. We are thirsty for the message of the Kingdom, and Excel Church continues to deliver Kingdom revelation, teaching, and technology week after week. My life is truly a reflection of the understanding I’ve received under the leadership of Pastor Mike and Ghilaine. If you’re ready to go deeper in your faith and experience the Kingdom life now, this is the place.

Highly recommend Excel Church to anyone hungry for more than religion—to those who want to walk in truth, power, and purpose. The kingdom is here now! I Love this  church and I love all of the people at this church it is.\nA praying church.\nAnd we love this so much the pastor teaches us lifeless for god and the way to walk in his spirit

name: Exchange Community Church - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
Mark and his wife Elli  are amazing Australian American pastors  who  manages Sunday’s services in a fun and  interesting way.

He has been able to attract all different ages and people from various walks of life.

He teaches  bible in his unique fun style.

The atmosphere is nice and relaxing. This is by far the best church I have attended.  It is more than just a church. It is an awesome group of people who genuinely care about you and the community. I have been attending services here for 3 years now, and it continues to get better every week. Immediately you will feel welcome and at home after attending one service. The worship is authentic, and the teaching is bible based.  The kids ministry and youth group is amazing.   There is a true passion and love for the kids and youth.  You can see that all are welcome by the diverse congregation. Whether you are a long time church goer, or a first time attendee, Exchange Community Church is a place you can call home.  Come see for yourself! Love Jesus and love the people of Exchange and what God is doing. Super inviting and friendly environment, full of generosity, where you can explore your faith; Know God, make Him known, build His Church and bring Heaven to Earth. Don’t come to Exchange to find out what Church can do for you - come to Exchange to find out what you can do with Jesus for His Church.

I have four kids (11,9,4, and 4) who love the Exchange Youth Staff and children’s program. Many of the staff have day jobs as teachers and have a passion for this next generation. They connect authentically with my kids and have helped bring the conversation home and revealed so much about Jesus to them.

Sunday is a celebration of all that God is doing in the lives of this community and we worship God - and the worship is sooooooo good.

I am personally grateful and thankful for the faith that has built Exchange and how it has impacted our family’s lives. I love that we’re all on a journey together and we’re doing life together.

You don’t want to miss this!!! My husband and I are Bible college graduates and have been active in church ministry all our lives. In the past we have helped plant a church in the San Francisco East Bay which is going strong today. We are also volunteers for the organization, City Impact, that ministers to the poor and needy in one of the worst districts of San Francisco called the Tenderloin.  I mention all of that to make a point that we have always been careful to attend churches that teach the true gospel of Jesus Christ and that have the heart of Jesus at the core of all that they do. We have been active members of Exchange Community Church for over a year now and consider it a joy and privilege to serve there. We have come to know the pastors personally, as well as others who serve in leadership roles, and have found them to be people with hearts that genuinely love Jesus and people. Just as important, we sense the presence of God during the worship services in a powerful way, and the Biblical teachings have been sound, accurate, and inspired. The children's program is two thumbs up too! There is no doubt that God has His hand of blessing on this church and that He has a great purpose for it in the community and beyond. Each time I attend Exchange Community Church I feel connected in and encouraged through the body of Christ. The teachings are rooted in scripture and translate with ease to encourage me in my day to day struggles and vicotries. The teaching staff is incredible, the worship is amazing I can't say enough good things about the house Exchange Community Church has created!

name: Exciting Central Tampa Baptist Church - Tampa Campus
reviewSummary: It was a phenomenal experience beautiful church . We were there to hear Tauren Wells  do some music and a book review.And it was just an all around wonderful experience. As a long-time member of Exciting Central Tampa Baptist Church, my experiences have been both uplifting and inspiring. When I started visiting this church in 2006, what stood out to me was how the Men of God took pride in being present and leading this church. It gave a sense of safety and order that I appreciated. What stands out to me now is the powerful, biblically grounded message each week; it's clear that the pastor has a genuine passion for teaching and helping people discover their purpose and understand their calling in Christ. Beyond the messages, the church's commitment to community is something truly special. From various events to outreach efforts, there's a strong sense of connection and care that goes beyond Sunday service. If you're looking for a house of Godly worship, rooted in the Holy Word, and focused on spiritual growth and authentic community, I highly recommend Exciting Central Tampa Baptist Church. I love my church! It is the best church in the Tampa Bay Area; or anywhere for that matter! The congregation is truly loving! We are a REAL FAMILY! I look forward to each Service! Our Pastor breaks down the Word of God so masterfully! If you come once; I know you will be back!!!!!! A welcoming place of faith that does their best of inviting anyone in to attend and participate. This has been my church home for almost 10 years now and I'm still encouraged and joyful when I gather with them. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a church home. Great Church! Always engaging and very loving. I highly recommend this church to singles and families of any stage or background.  Come worship at Central and I'll see you there.

name: exodus3 - Irvine (Woodbridge) Campus
reviewSummary: great church!  The simple truth of God's love, grace & power is preached here.  Highly recommend! Amazing Church and the preacher is on fire!

name: Expectation Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: This church really makes every person feel welcomed. There are so many great aspects about this church from the incredible and compassionate pastors to the e-groups and amazing volunteers. It is always a refreshing Sunday experience and I feel ready to take on the week with every amazing message. Thankful to have found this church and call it home! Been going with my husband for 8 months now. Can't believe its already been 8 months! Every Sunday the welcoming team makes it really feel like you're coming home and I am eager to see how our relationship with God will grow here🙏 Expectation Church is an amazing place to worship! The atmosphere is welcoming, and the people are kind and genuine. The messages are inspiring, practical, and always point to Jesus. The worship team is excellent and creates a great environment to connect with God. I always feel encouraged and spiritually renewed every time I attend. Highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a strong, loving community. A very welcoming church! Worshiped with them for almost 4 months! Loved their sermons! God richly bless you all especially Pastor Chris, Jackie, Omar and Arianna for making my stay in Fairfax an enjoyable and memorable one!! Visited from Ohio while our adult son has moved to this area.  We wanted to end our family time and this was the perfect place to do just that.  Biblically sound,  amazing message with grace and humbleness and on fire! Worship music was fantastic!  Lee connected with our family,  and my son made a connection with another member and the Pastor. God and being a part of a faith community has been an integral part of our life as a family unit. I am excited to visit again and see my son flourish in his new home!

name: Experience Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: Moving away/just attended my last service and so so sad to be leaving this church. Genuinely one of the most welcoming, bright, and truly joyful churches I’ve ever been a part of. Was invited once by a friend and was hooked immediately. Pastor Jordan is not only hilarious but does an amazing job preaching the word AND stands by the door after and personally thanks every person for coming. If you have had bad experiences before and feel like church isn’t for you I truly urge to you to come try experience for a service- you will be welcomed like a friend just like I was. A group of people that truly practice what they preach and love like Jesus. This is the only church where I was greeted outside, at the front door, the sanctuary door and by some others on my way in.  And the greeters seem genuinely happy to serve.  I had visited a few other churches,  but Experience Church is the friendliest I've been to locally.  Great worship and applicable, relevant sermons.  Grateful. My family has attended Experience Church for about a year. From the very beginning we were welcomed with open arms and immediately felt at home. Our family supports the vision of the church and have so much respect for our Pastors and the way they lead and take time to get to know and understand you. Our kids love our church home as well and the youth group is amazing! The teaching from the pulpit to youth is relevant for today and encourages you to be your best self and make serving Jesus priority in your daily life. Worship is wonderful and the teaching bible based! If you're looking for a church family come check us out! You will find small groups to connect with and areas to serve in, if you desire. We'd love to get to know you and am certain you will find Hope, Healing, and a Home! Experience church is an incredible church! From the first day we went we felt welcomed and loved. People want genuine friendships with you. It is a place of wonderful community. Pastor Jordan and Spencer are great leaders! The messages always speak to me and encourage me. It’s a multicultural church where everyone is welcome. Experience Church is one of the friendliest churches I have ever attended.  From the moment you walk in the door, you feel at home with family.  The music is uplifting and encouraging, the preaching is always laid out in a way that allows me to really understand and hear Gods message.  Welcoming, casual and Dynamic!

name: Expression58 - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Great word! Thank you Brandon Smith for your heart for Christ! Thank you Jennifer and Ryan. If you attend this church, you will feel the Holy Spirit move. You will feel lifted and you’ll feel called to serve and you will feel changed from glory to
glory to glory. The worship is fantastic. Highly recommend. Feeling beyond grateful to have found this place. I had been looking for a church home for a while, and wasn’t sure where to begin. Meeting a church member at a premiere allowed me to see a whole new side of the industry. My first visit there felt so good, inclusive, and beautiful. Gave me a whole new experience with the church, changing my mindset of what church can be. Here I am 2 years later, getting more involved every month. Never thought I’d see myself back and church, and I’m so happy to be back This church is such an amazing house of the Lord ! They offer so much discipleship and amazing fellowship gatherings . A great Christ centered community.  This church is full of kind, generous, caring men and women of God. I highly recommend this place for anyone who wants to be apart of a body of Christ who genuinely walks out the gospel . I just started  coming here 3 weeks ago. I so far really like this church. It a perfect size for me. Everyone is very friendly and kind to me. They also made me feel welcomed. They offered to help me with anything I need.  I really love the worship team.  I feel the holy spirit in this beautiful church.  I really enjoyed the Candle light Christmas service. I used to think writing reviews for churches was so silly -- it seemed so weird to "rate" a faith community, especially when people's experiences with churches tend to be very personal and subjective. But I relent. The Lord has altered my life through Expression 58 and so I have to testify! I'm not even sure how to concisely do this, so this review will probably will end up being extremely long, lol.

Five years ago I moved to LA from the midwest, leaving a vibrant and faith-filled church community behind. I knew no one in the city, and the moment I moved I knew I needed to connect to a faith community -- both to stay rooted and also just... because I wanted friends. But upon my arrival in LA I was completely intimidated by the sheer number of options for churches, as well as the prevailing stereotype that churches in this city are vapid and have weird, worldly theology. While this may be true of some, this is the antithesis of E58. It was immediately obvious to me the moment I heard the first worship song that this is a people passionately running after the Lord's heart.

I cannot say enough about the worship at this church. Worship is a living, breathing thing; it is a conversation with God, prophetic at times and often spontaneous. You are invited to worship any way you like -- you may stand still, sit, kneel, dance, raise your hands, shout, stay quiet. It is truly a community where I feel safe to worship in whatever way I need to, no performance.

The lead pastor, Jen, is a fierce and intelligent woman that does not hold back on theology in her sermons. No pandering... you are gonna LEARN and actually be challenged on Sundays. Not only that, this community walks the talk. They preach the Lord's heart for justice and follow through with numerous justice programs as well as by responding to the immediate justice needs in our community. They preach the importance of diversity, and can boast incredible diversity not just in the congregation but also on the staff and in leadership roles. This diversity extends to age too. While there are many young adults, this is a community for families as well and people at any stage of life.

The community I found at Expression has truly been my village. When my husband (who I also met at E58!) and I were getting married on a budget, there were so many goods and services that we could not afford. SO many people from our E58 community stepped in to help and bless us when we needed it. This made our wedding both successful and unforgettable. Our community is strong and grounded, as well as amazing with accountability and advice.

Do not be mislead -- this church is made up of human beings and therefore is inherently imperfect. We of course deal with very human problems. But if you're looking for a perfect place filled with perfect holy people, I can guarantee that you will not find one. I am deeply grateful to be in a community that embraces difficulties and imperfections, and is constantly re-surrendering to the Lord's perfection.

Okay I'll end it there, even though I could say so much more. If you are searching, may the grace of the Lord bless you on your search. If you ever visit, come say hi!

name: Eyes Wide Open Christian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Fairborn Church of Christ - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: I cannot say enough about this group. Everyone is so uplifting, the services are edifying, and you know that the truth of the Bible is going to be discussed every time you walk into the doors. If you are looking for a family atmosphere, a place to worship in spirit and truth, and a church where you really feel like you can grow in Christ, look no further than the fairborn church of christ All my experiences have been wonderful! I’ve also enjoyed coming to Fairborn to see my family and friends. I’ve loved all the Bible classes, I do really feel like I can learn a lot from the teachers. If I lived in Ohio, Fairborn would definitely be the best where I would attend church! This is a wonderful group that strives to follow the teachings of Christ. Biblically sound in their doctrine, they truly work to "speak the truth in love" (Ephesians 4:15).  Very welcoming and eager to answer questions. A loving, faithful group of Christians striving to follow the teachings of the Bible. Very uplifting services and lessons that are timely and encouraging! You’ll definitely be made to feel welcome! “Come and see!” Such a wonderful congregation of Christians that deeply care about your soul & teaching straight from the Bible. I have learned so much & have grown in Christ since attending here. Visit anytime 😊

name: Fairborn Community Tabernacle - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful church that preaches bible truths. HAS A SUNDAY SCHOOL FOR SCHOOL AGED CHILDREN. A lot of benefits to partake for the edifying of the Body of Christ; I love to hear the Word of Truth, no leaven but fresh, the eagles food, in this season!the deep things of God become simplicity. Been my home church for 25 years it's been a blessing to come across since a diamond in a rough An experience unlike no other, has been my church since for the last 33 years. Couldn't imagine going anywhere else. Marvelous enthusiastic preaching of the true word! Relaxed atmosphere and nice people!

name: Fairborn First Church - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary: Our family has donated a lot of clothes and some shoes to this church for their free clothing closet every Monday. They are very sweet people there and I love talking to them. When we had to sell my father-in-laws house, we donated a lot of stuff for their church(garage) sale a couple of years ago These wonderful volunteer are great. They offer such great clothing. I live going here. They will feed you if your hungry. They helped us so much with wonderful clothing when we were in need. I'm not a member of this church but go there for their clothing pantry on Mondays Very nice people very friendly and very clean the pastor was polite and concerned he preq he'd my sons funeral

name: Faircreek Church - Fairborn / Beavercreek / Wright-Patterson Campus
reviewSummary:
I really like the church.   The fair creek church has so much going on for young children and the youth, they also a have great pastors, but what I don’t like is that they are not fans on the actual Bible. Wink, they read everything from the online app or what ever they use to copy and paste to prepare there mass for that Sunday.   Also they don’t really tell anyone to bring the Bible.  Which for me is big plus.  We as children of God need to have the Bible at hand even the Pastors themselves.  There will be a point in this life that all bible will be burn or destroyed cause we are giving ourselves to the world.   We also need to start preaching more on Gods words and not hide anything especially the truth in God’s word.  It is so important cause we want to make sure that no one stay behind when Jesus Comes.   We also need to study more of God’s words and prepare ourselves when it comes to spiritual warfare.  To also concentrate and meditate on the truth of God words.

Also there has to be light in the church I feel like I’m in a movie theater. I'm so conflicted here. I like this church.  It's great for kids and families. The problem I have is the church buy its sermons. I wouldn't say these sermons are fulfilling either. I always leave feeling like I went to dinner and only received a starter. The main entrée never appears. I really wish they would stop buying the sermons. I end up just listening to other pastors online after church because this one just isn't enough for me. Don't get me wrong. I'm thankful for this church - but stop buying your sermons. Also not everyone wants to do a video to be baptized. It's just awkward and weird.... Have been going to this church for over 15 years and enjoy the sermons that are always given there. It is family oriented and in good hospitality. The atmosphere is amazing, great people and tons of activities to do to help out the community around the church. Great pastor they also make coffee and serve orange juice on Sunday morning yum! The children’s ministry is very kind they also have several activities to do to help out the community and have fun like retreats, cleaning things and even going and having fun at Kings island. All around a great church I recommend going there see you next Sunday! The head pastor is pretty amazing. He is very knowledgeable of the Bible and is excellent at communicating through story telling.

The people are very friendly and welcoming. Even the youth group welcome new kids into their activities.

Jesus is the center of all the activities.

name: Fairfax Baptist Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: Very small church without youth programs. Small-minded pastor, just a small congregation trying to weather the storm that has been laid upon them since the changing of leadership many years ago. Was once a large thriving congregation filled with joy, young families and children during the last pastors stay. This is no longer the case. My wife Michele Witherow (maiden name Boyd) and I were both baptized and then married at this church. These services were done by the pastor, Pastor Joby Tricquet, who is a very knowledgeable man when it comes to the theoretics of the Christian religion. I would recommend this church to anyone that is looking for a good church to begin or rekindle their fire for worship. The number of great people that ourselves, as well as our kids have met there, is uncountable! The pastors wife Cathy has been such a blessing to our lives! So kind of them to offer a community shredding event! Love this pastor, the church is amazing and the fellowship unmatched. Went here for a funeral, nice church.

name: Fairfax Bible Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: We have been attending Fairfax Bible Church for over a decade. If you’re looking for a smaller, Bible preaching, Bible believing church, this is the place for you! Harvest Bible Chapel Fairfax is a wonderful church filled with people who truly love the Lord!  I heard about the church from a couple of friends who helped start this plant.  If you are looking for a church that has solid, Biblical teaching, you will find it here.  If you are looking for authentic worship, you will find it here.  If you are looking to explore who Jesus is and have people pray over you, you will find that here.  One thing I really appreciate about Harvest that has set it apart from other churches is the humble, transparent leadership.  The Pastor not only is a great communicator, but he's an all-around great family man.  Harvest is connected to the larger Harvest Bible Chapel Fellowship too so there are opportunities to connect with other Harvest folks at larger events!  The vision and mission of Harvest go after God's heart.  Although it's still a smaller church than what I am used to,  I am excited to see God moving in this place and look forward to what's to come! Me and my wife started coming here about a month ago and we felt welcomed the minute we walked in, you can also register your child for care and the volunteer staff is great, they also teach the kids about the word of God. If you want to feel God's presence, this is the church for you, the Pastor is a great teacher and very knowledgeable in the word of our Lord and saviour Jesus Christ. I really loved beign there. Amazing church! Come and experience the glory and love of God!

name: Fairfax Christian Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: I attended Fairfax Christian Church as a visitor from out of town this past Sunday. The sanctuary was comfortable and welcoming. The large stained glass window at the front is beautiful, and large windows on the left provide a view of a serene lawn and a distant tree line. I felt a sense of calm and peace throughout the Service, and sensed the Lord's presence there. The sermon by Pastor Max was excellent, and the music and communion service were uplifting. I look forward to a future visit. I’ve been coming to Fairfax Christian with my wife and daughter for a couple of years now. Very welcoming and a great atmosphere for children. I would recommend this church to anyone interested in being part of a wonderful family. The congregation is very warm, and the grounds are breath taking. I’m happy to say only after a few weeks with this body of Christ I’m happy to now call it my home church! [object Object] [object Object]

name: Fairfax Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I love attending Fairfax Church every Sunday. The services are wonderful, and we really appreciate that they offer Sunday service for kids too. They also host special events for children, like Easter activities, which makes it a great church for families. Fairfax Church has felt like home from the start. The people are real, welcoming, and it’s been easy to connect, I joined a small group and made some great friends.
I appreciate how Pastor Rod Stafford teaches. His messages are practical, clear, and really helpful for everyday life. Just a solid place to grow in faith and community. My personal experience ratings (1-5):
Church building: 5
People: 5 (more people and diversity)
Worship: 3 (bit too charismatic)
Sermon: 2 (classic charismatic sermon, tithing focused on the day I was there). Low rating b/c I understand the Deuteronomy tithing that contrasts from the charismatic contemporary definition.

*These are my own personal felt experience. Your experience may vary. The people are very friendly and inviting.  There is a service Saturday night, and 2 services on Sunday morning.  You can watch the services online.  The services are entertaining.  The worship music is modern and fun.  The pastor, Rod Stafford, provides concise and memorable messages.  The kids activities are fantastic.  There is a coffee shop inside.  The church is currently building a large addition to support the growing community. This is a wonderful church and I enjoyed it very much. They do a lot for the community and that seemed to be the main focus here. I was very impressed and ready to help by volunteering!

name: Fairfield Christian Reformed Church - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary:
This has been my church home for 40 years now! We’re are committed to honoring our faithful God as we serve one another and our community.

We’ve love hymns, old and new. And sadly, yes we have to post a tow away sign in our parking lot, just like most parking lots in America, to keep people from abandoning their old cars, garbage, and furniture on the property. My family almost didn’t visit this church because of one of the reviews on Google. Saying it wasn’t a loving church because they tow cars that are not supposed to be parked there.  After searching for months for a church in Fairfield that has sound teaching and a loving community, we were referred to this church. I’m so thankful we came. Teaching is straight from the scriptures. Sunday school has started back up (since Covid). The people aren’t perfect… but that just means we fit in 😉.

I’ve thought  about the reviewer who is bitter about the parking. And I understand that Christians are held to a certain standard to love others (as they should)- but that doesn’t mean to just let people walk all over you.

If you’re on the fence about visiting just go for it. I’m so thankful we did! A wonderful Christian community! My granddaughter became member of this church by her own choice when she was 9 years old and was trying to find a church that  would lead her to God. yes . She was embraced by the church, and was baptized after a year and half. Pastor Nick, his wife Anne and Ms Amy Lefever have been wonderful to her and have nurtured her faith and spirit in so many ways. She is turning 13 in seven  weeks and is active in the church youth group. I think it's really sad that you preach love and kindness while you threaten to tow a car that's parked in your parking lot because the apartments across the street have an unfortunate parking situation. I understand it's not your business and it's not your problem, but in the end do we practice what we preach? Do we lead by example or is it all smoke and mirrors? Are the several people who park in your lot really taking up THAT much space? What would Jesus do? Such disappointing actions taken by people who supposedly care about their community. Beautiful church service and very thoughtful sermon.

name: Fairfield Church of Christ - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent God-fearing people. Made me fill like family on my first day, and we have only grown closer and  gotten more familiar 2 years later. This is the place to go if you want to find peace and comfort! A very welcoming and loving place to be with your family and loved ones. Full of sanctuary and peace. A perfect place if you also want to be free as this place is very warm once you step inside the door. We visited here about 6 weeks ago. I was impressed with the humility and Joy in the members here. A very loving church that welcomes everyone as they are. I love this church great Ministry

name: Fairlawn-West United Church - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary:
If inclusiveness is important to you, you’ll want to check this church out. If you like contemporary church, with comfortable chairs instead of pews, full contemporary band instead of a choir, and a congregation that sets out to make a difference in the community, not just within its 4 walls, you’ll want to check this church out. Very open and loving church They truly love God and people!  A true example of Christianity. This friendly open & affirming congregation welcomes everyone. Music is on the contemporary side with solid preaching by Rev. Rhinesmith. I love this church, very friendly, they take time to celebrate God...
God's Love, is in this place.

name: Fairview Community Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: I can't really say too much about it because I haven and wasn't even able to find anybody at the church I was trying to inquire about the parking that they are renting out and if they had any leads on being homeless or where to get help from I'm sure they will get back to me and I will make a review after that happens I was driving by and saw their electronic sign and was saddened and very upset at the derogatory comment about President Trump. You are inviting people into your church to “escape Trumps hate” That is not Christian behavior. I’m sure that sign has turned off any new people who might have considered joining your church. Shame on you for your “hatred”. I have not yet been to this church.  Can’t really make a comment. We have been going to Fairview Community Church for almost 18 years. The sermon's and music are upbeat and inspiring. We were looking for a small, personal church and definitely found it. The congregation is like an extended family. When somebody is sick, the church members gather and start a food train or plan visits. If somebody has no place to go for Christmas Eve, there is usually an open house at one of the church members home nearby. Everybody cares and prays for each other. After every Sunday service the congregation gathers on the patio for coffee, tea and some snacks. Fairview Community Church also is very much involved in the Community with feeding the hungry, community garden etc. After visiting several churches in Orange County, we made FCC our home. Not a Christian church! Very disappointed in this place. They are disguising as a Church yet not following biblical values.

name: Faith 4 Life Ministries
Faith Baptist Church - Gulfport Campus
reviewSummary:
I came for the engineer’s retreat program several times and this was a great place away from the base! Very welcoming and hospitable to us military folks. Thanksgiving dinner was a blessing even though I was away from home. The food was always great and you can tell the congregation cares. Thank you and God bless! My kids love when the bus comes to pick them up from home! I think this is an awesome way to introduce introduce children to Christianity and the Love of Christ! Keep doing awesome duty! Teacher miss Cloe she act one way to andelt one way to kids she has a fraivet
Duuu Dan carr great preacher teach God's words tell truth,help people get saved and baptized praise Lord amen The best church ever! Life giving! Great people always!

name: Faith Baptist Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited Faith Baptist Church a few years ago while visiting family in the area.
We were well pleased with the friendliness of the people and with the pastor's message. Amazing! Come and see for yourself what a Church of ACTIVE Faith looks like. The auditorium is full on Sunday morning, Sunday Night , and Wednesday evening . Then there’s an army of dedicated Christians of all ages who go out and spend their Saturdays to go spread the Gospel and invite people to come to Church and become a part of the family of God. And this has been going on every week, month and year for over 40+ years and never a Sunday missed. Come and See As a 87 year old retired military and law enforcement person, I have watched the Utube presentation of "let us pray" as well as many other negatives from a few with ongoing gripes.  These web site productions are full of flaws and half truths, and is doing a dishonoring of God's work.  Some need to take time to speak to God through his son Jesus and ask for his Holly spirit to give them peace and guidance for HOPE, FAITH, AND LOVE!

Watching the young people grow and develop a love of Christ and desires to serve our Lord and Savior is paramount in this church group. Numerous young people grew up here and are now preaching the gospel as adult ministers, as well as working in the mission field.

Those who are throwing stones must remember that God tells us to love our brothers and sisters in Christ, not judge them as that is his to do.  My prayers are with the church in its ongoing ministries and producing christian leaders for tomorrow.

May 31, 2025 I watched as ten Faith Baptist Academy high school seniors graduated from High School in preparation for their future.  Many are already committed to ministerial training in Bible School.  This is what this church excels at, winning young folks to Christ and mentoring them in their Christian life.  Let's think about the future of our young who hold our future in their hands as we await the return of our Lord and Savior.  For those who have a problem with recognizing these blessings, may I humbly suggest time on your knees in prayer.

May God continue to bless the Pastor and his flock of Christian people who are doing a great job in our community. Amazing church, the people are very welcoming and the teen department is spectacular. I’m very sad to write this, we were extremely excited to try a new church. My only reason for even writing a review is to further educate staff for misleading people. Last week I called, trying to get some info about the church. I explained I had a special needs child and if they are able to accommodate him and his needs. I was told they had a class for special needs kids and they had someone that could be one on one with him. Upon arrival Sunday we were greeted and everyone was extremely kind and welcoming (which I absolutely loved) we were being shown around and we arrive at the classroom for my son. This was a class with neurotypical kids that were seated so nicely, I said to them that this will not work for my son. He can be aggressive, and will not sit still for lesson in that way at all. They insisted we try, so we did. 3 min later they called asking us to remove him because he was hitting (which I tried to warn them) my husband goes to get our son and the teacher had my son ‘pinned’ to the window. Now I’m not saying it was in an aggressive way but it was clearly lack of experience with special needs children. This ruined my child’s day. Just 3-5 minutes of this. His day was in shambles. I’m upset that we were mislead on accommodation rather than being honest. I don’t expect everywhere to have a solution for my son. Which is why I’m trying to find a church that works for us. It was a waste of time. Please work on communicating to parents what to expect and what you can and cannot accommodate. There are many families with disabled and special needs children, so please..either work on communicating to families or consider opening a class room geared to special needs kids/teens/adults too.
Sad to say, we will not be back.
This review is not based on anything other than our experience. Everyone was very kind and welcoming. I wanted to share in case any other families with high needs children look into this church.

name: Faith Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Great people there. No games, pretense or posing just meeting to study the Bible and sing songs. Is this a KJV Only/Conservative Traditional Hymns/Soulwinning Independent Fundamental Church or is it a compromising liberal Church?.  Post-Trib would be a bonus This church is awesome they faithful and friendly and very well preached I love this church

name: Faith Baptist Fellowship - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I've never been to this church, but the website is very unfinished and out-of-date. Everything I click just takes me to the top of the homepage. Please edit your site!

name: Faith Bible Church
reviewSummary: Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Faith Bible Church
reviewSummary:
Everyone was so welcoming the first day that I couldn’t help but want to go back, but the 2nd time I brought my whole family with me! The Pastor is amazing and the congregation is full of love! I love this small church. If you are looking for a faith-filled, scripture-led, truthful, revealing, Gospel-pursuing church - look no further. This beautiful church offers a truly spirit-filled worship experience followed by a weekly communion which is hard to find at many non-denominational churches in Boerne who only celebrate the Lord’s Supper monthly or twice a year - I’m not sure why as I believe it is important to remember Jesus as the perfect sacrifice who took our sins and gave us the greatest gift and hope that through belief in him we shall live with him forever.

Luke 22:19

And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me.”

1 Corinthians 11:25-26
In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me.” For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

This wonderful church offers two concurrent adult Sunday school classes from 9:40am-10:30am as well as a terrific weekly small group which meets Thursday nights from 7-9pm.

This church may be small in size but it is huge in spirit and truth. There were never any kids. We spend almost 5 years there and I never made any friends. I missed out on one of the most beautiful important parts of my life. The teaching was okay, but our Sunday school teachers always taught the same things over and over again, and none of them lasted over six months. What a wonderful country church. It feels like coming home. Friendly, great worship band and music snd Pastor Tim’s message are the best. His sense if humor snd ability to connect with his listeners is a plus. His messages are Christ center snd Biblical. Will be back every time I am near Boerne. Christ centered teaching.  Casual attire.  Sunday services at 8:30 & 10:40.  Sunday school at 9:35.  Music is traditional at 8:30 and more contemporary at 10:40.  Communion is served during every service.

name: Faith Bible Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Christ-glorifying and people-loving church! Focus is on the Gospel, they have a deep love for our Savior & His Word, solid theology, expository preaching, and truly a family that loves and cares for each other. I’m so blessed by this church!! Pastor is great, but the bass player steals the show. Drummer also has some chops too. If you want to be taught from the Bible weekly, be reminded of the gospel often and be part of a church community that knows and loves one another, this is a great church for you. Bible believing Christian church, the Faith shows!

name: Faith Bible Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: The only reason I do not attend on a regular basis is because I play bass guitar and sometimes 6 string on a he worship team of a different church, but this is a great church and is closer to my house. So, I do attend occasionally. We had a very hard move from our old church, and I left a lot of friends thinking that I would never be able to make new ones in a different community. Now, here I stand with close ties to youth group, serving on the tech team for service and helping out with Children's Ministry, which has been an amazing experience. FBC is my home, and I would take a miracle for me to leave it. Get involved and you'll notice a difference. I've been attending going on almost 9 years now and it makes a huge difference being connected with other believers within the church. Great family church dedicated to God's Word,  discipleship, missions and fellowship. Seasoned pastors, long history and wonderful people. We've been there 6 years. We go here for Awanas, and the staff and volunteers here are always nice. Lovely playground for the kids, and great location.

reviewSummary: Praise God for FBC! I have been a part of many churches and this one is special. No bells or whistles. Just a very profound and mature understanding of the Gospel and how that gives us joy and the power to live the Christian walk. The focus on the Gospel for everyday life translates to a very loving church body; and love from the heart, not just externally. Christ is truly glorified here. My own faith has been radically transformed. The pastors and elders are so humble and gentle. The expository preaching convicts and encourages me every Sunday. I cannot recommend this church enough for anyone looking for a safe place to learn and grow in Christ.

name: Faith Bible Church - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Exegetical based Bible teaching rather than just positive, self help style sermons. Genuine, kind people and a ton of wonderful small groups and workshops to plug into to help navigate whatever life stage you might be in. We have been attending this church for about 3 years and love it!  The student ministry was amazing for my high schooler.  I have really enjoyed the Women's Bible Studies.  The church does a fantastic job of teaching directly from the Bible. They also have an amazing amount of groups and classes that meet you wherever you are and bring you closer in your walk with Jesus. If you’re looking for a strong, Bible-teaching, and welcoming church, this is it. The pastor is the best teacher in The Woodlands. I’ve visited many churches—this one feels like home. If you are looking for a place to rest and heal your heart—this is it. If you are searching for a space to worship in Spirit and in Truth—this is it. If you desire to grow deep roots in your Faith, learn to study and apply God’s infallible word, and see His love at work—this is it.

Having moved from New York then to CA and now Texas, I was weary of looking for a church home where I could grow, serve, and heal. Some places I visited offered community but void of God’s Truth. Others offered small groups and great programs without intentional discipleship and biblical teaching.

In January 2024, I walked into Faith Bible tired and discouraged. And from the moment I walked in, the love of Christ was evident in the warm greeting and welcoming smiles. The Praise and Worship was all directed to God. This wasn’t about a “worship experience” with lights, smoke, and special effects. It was a team of Spirit filled believers offering praise and thanksgiving to a Living God—with their voices, instruments, lifted hands, and surrendered hearts.

Then the best part began—Pastor Russell began to teach the word of God. For 30 minutes, the inerrant word of God was taught with love, conviction, and clarity. Scripture interpreting scripture. No fanfare, simply the Living Word instructing, correcting, encouraging. Truth building up the church in love. It was exactly where my heart and spirit needed to be and heal.

Haven’t missed a Sunday since then. And…have finally found a church home that i enthusiastically invite others to come!! I know for certain God will meet them exactly where they are and His Spirit will
lead them into all matters of Truth because His word is shared, taught, lived, and spoken at every turn at Faith Bible Church.

Hope you and your family will come visit and see (test!) for yourself! A wonderful community of believers. A strong sense of a larger church with a strong push for everyone to connect within a small group.

name: Faith Bible Church Hope Center - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church

We are all lost in terms of finding peace in this world

Tired,  work got ya down, too much money, too little money, marriage ain’t working out.

God designed us to be in church but moreso in a relationship with Him

Sunday church 930 and Friday bible study after work! This is the church family I come home to. We are not perfect but we give our all to the Lord in this place. It’s nice here, come join us if you’d like, all are welcome [object Object] [object Object]

name: Faith Bible Church of San Bernardino - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I decided to visit this church with my family in search of a well-grounded, non-political church filled with the Lord’s love. Sadly, I don’t understand why so many believe this church is truly grounded in the Lord when it seems to lack love for others. The messages often emphasize “submission to all government authorities” to justify their points, and typical Christian nationalist ideals are promoted within this church.

For those who claim it is grounded in the Lord, I encourage them to reexamine their outlook. Jesus is not a Republican or a Democrat, He transcends political affiliations. The only love this church seems to have is for themselves or for citizens who fit their mold, not for all of God’s children. The church, while perhaps well-intentioned, appeared devoid of genuine compassion and love for others. Last year I started attending this church. I have been looking for a Bible preaching and God honoring church for quite some time and found it here. It's congregation is small but growing. The fellowship of the believers is genuine. Jesus preached in scripture correctly, check. The worship not about self, check. The giving not about making the pastor rich, check. It's hard to find such a church in a sea of churches so I thank God I was led here! Welcoming congregation. Bible based study and not bounce around topical homilies. Simple and straight forward. Good Sunday school programs. Diverse population. Lots of introverts here, so no pressure to be outspoken or over the top. Music is both old and new. A number of fellowship opportunities. Pastor Scott Anderson is a humble and sincere man of God. I attended this church for about a year. During that time pastor Scott gave me Godly advice, he took of his personal time to counsel me on a one to one meeting a few times. You can grow here, the word preached is unadulterated and seeks to glorify God in our lives as we die to ourselves. I'm grateful and I bless pastor Scott's ministry and family.

-Angel M. I really enjoy it here, I had been searching for a church that I felt welcome and comfortable at and this is it. It's pretty small but the faith and the teachings are great. Everyone is very friendly and I recommend giving them a visit on sundays

name: Faith Bible Church of Vallejo - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This religious organization is welcoming, people are friendly even if you're unfamiliar with everything. The place is clean and the atmosphere is warm welcoming and uses music and singing to praise the Lord. You will never feel sleepy here. They also have various activities for all ages. I was able to attend the worship and left the children in their preschool area. There is a separate area for the teens or youth as well. Across the street is Faith Food Fridays which I have known in the past and helped me during the difficult times of life. Not sure why there's low ratings, this church is awesome. They do so much for the community, they have strong leaders up and down from the kids to youth to college career and adults. Great place to worship with fellow believers, if I didn't live as far I would come here every Sunday and what makes it better they have multiple services on Sunday theres like 3 services I believe. The youth/college career programs are great, summer camp, winter camp you name it they do a lot of outreach. Great congregation here. Most welcoming, loving, genuine people you'll ever meet! If you are looking for a place to be loved and belong, and be reminded how much God really does love you, come to this church. You will be blessed, inspired and grow in your love for God and others.

Grace based, Gospel focused, Christ centered! My first time to attend very good service from Pastor Reuel about the “Last Call” from God. What a blessing it is to come to this church I feel so connected. They even gave me groceries to share with my neighbors.
My husband is in the construction field so we go wherever the job is, this is truly the most welcoming church I’ve ever been to. Our home is in Wisconsin and FBC made me feel like part of the family. They do so much for the community and I want to be part of it. I can’t wait to bring my husband to church when he comes back. Thank you! Ever since I've been going to Faith Bible Church I've felt nothing but family. Christ is truly present and the word is easily understood. It's like the hyperbolic time chamber for the word. You learn so much every service.

This is where I was born again. Every moment building up to my baptism felt like a volcano within me ready to erupt with different emotions. The most intense feeling ever. That is something I will never forget.

name: Faith Builders Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: I recently relocated, and while I wish I could share this current moment with everyone in person, I am so thankful for what I’ve learned through the teachings and discipleship at Faithbuilders. This was truly a place of healing for me, and the Lord met me here every time. Now that He has called me elsewhere, this is definitely bittersweet. My heart is full of gratitude for the community here. Everything happened so fast... Thank you, Pastor Barb, for your prayers and leadership. May God continue to bless you and this ministry. May the blessings continue to flow! Experienced the Stations at the Cross event today.  So beautiful...I felt the Holy Spirit and was overwhelmed by His presence.  Thank you for this event! Started attending Faith Builders church in the beginning of 2024. I am enjoying being a part of this family community. The worship is great and powerful. The Pastors are teaching strong biblical principles. I really glad I am attending here at this household of faith. Come see us. His arms are open. God love you, Faith builders church is a solid word-based church, with a great Godly covering! Pastor Barb is dynamic, always allowing the Holy Spirt to direct the services. The teachings are bible based, speaking truth with out being seeker sensitive with in depth teachings of the scriptures. They have a friendly family atmosphere, offering ministries for all members to plug into. Their mission is help the lost to know God, find freedom, discover their purpose, and make a difference. They offer classes for personal growth also. This church has been proven and tempered with trials and tribulations and  is solid. We enjoy the Sunday and Wednesday night services and always look forward to the joy with prayer and edification of the spirit. I love this church I have never experienced such an amazing anointing in a church before the Holy Spirit moves through this church body like the book of Acts talks about.  Faith Builders brings only truth to the people (straight Word never watered down) ..... and OH the worship is amazing Lead Pastor Barb Pruitt and all the Pastors and Elders are faithful God fearing and people loving kind of group. Come as you are there is no judging hear only loving God Bless!!!!

name: Faith Center Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I listen to Pastor Melissa Scott, M-Thurs., every week for the past 1-1/2 years. I have never heard the Bible taught the way she teaches. God has given her the gift of teaching. I think of her church, Faith Center, as the University of Faith and she, Melissa Scott, as my Professor. Attended 35 years ago and ignorantly began financial support of Dr. Scott's efforts to preach the gospel. I watched live as Faith Center owned KHOF went off the air for due to the fact that teaching was constantly held up on live TV until set amounts of money were donated from the audience before teaching would continue. KHOF was a UHF band broadcast TV station in Los Angeles. The FCC ended it.

2 weeks ago I discovered their social media stream, which is running 24/7 with a constant message of how important giving is as means to exercise faith and how dangerous backsliding can be. There are promises of 'meatier' messages at the facility, along with reminders of giving where you are being taught. None of the 'chat participants' knew proper English and I let 'them' know how obvious that was. After making adjustments and rebuilding their chat log several times over several days, the chat window still confirmed the obvious.

Access to services at this facility are by phone reservation only which is no surprise. Stay away from Faith Center. A very controversial assembly.  It’s sad they won’t let people walk the grounds.  That’s kind of a backwards mentality and perhaps that’s a symptom of why they had to discontinue their television ministry. Heck, even the Mormons even invite non Mormons to walk their temple grounds, what they consider to be their most sacred space.  My church also has security, but they’re in the shadows and not stalking folks.

As for the Scott’s:  They’re so intelligent that they’re weird.  Perhaps too much for their own good.  Doc used to draw a crowd with his unorthodox style of preaching.  A lot of good nuggets of truth though.

“Kill some Pissants for Jesus” is pretty cool though LOL. If you want to learn about God, Jesus Christ, and the Bible, then come and see. Pastor Scott’s teaching’s are straight out of God’s word which are all encouraging, thoughtful and edifying. Her teaching has inspired me to study more, but more importantly has helped me develop a closer relationship with God and Jesus. It’s all I ever wanted. II Timothy 2:15 thank you for teaching The Way

name: Faith Christian Center - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
After moving to the Phoenix area about 2 and a half years ago I sought a full gospel, non denominational Christian church.  After visiting close to 10 churches, I found my home at FCC.  Pastor Sean and his leadership team are phenomenal.  The church also has the hearts of the youth, and they help to shape and mold them for future leadership and service.  The church is friendly and welcoming to all.  The Holy Spirit's presence is felt when you walk through the front doors.  This church has helped to save me multiple times through prayer and intercession.  This church also has many small groups dedicated to fellowship and improvement in various areas of life.  Its definitely worth a visit to those seeking a church home!  Thanks FCC for all that you do for God's people! ***my family started attending here December 2025**
I just read the review left by "RJ". His experience was seemingly written with a closed heart and wrought with negativity.  If you are looking to build a community at church, THIS is it!
If you are not pentecostal this is not the church for you!  The pentecostal faith is one of emotional spiritual connections.  We thrive on the gifts of the spirit!

My husband and I were saved in a small pentecostal Assemblies of God church in Louisiana.  We tried CCV 1st when we moved here bc we were thinking of building community and were super eager to find Christian friends.  The atmosphere at ccv, -to the pentecostal heart, is luke-warm. The only way to build community is to join a small group, and even then in a church congregation of over 30k people the most you could hope for is maybe a friend group of 20-30. After years at ccv we moved to a different town so we tried our local AG church. Unfortunately it has the same model of ccv.

As far as some of Rjs specific complaints:
The church building is small with a large following.  The pastors are passionate and intentional. The "sacrificial"  offering is a building campaign. This is also a principle from Mark chapter 12 and Luke chapter 21:"They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on."Luke 21:1-4: "For they have given a tiny part of their surplus, but she, poor as she is, has given everything she has."
The congregation is family oriented and are all in agreement that the church needs a larger building.
As for the music: the worship team is gifted!! Eclectic and energetic! Again Pentecostal worship! As far as the sound/loudness, the building is small what else do you expect?
Seating: - the church fills fast and they want to make sure people are not left out because a seat gets overlooked or saved for a person that never arrives.

If you want to come to a church, stay quiet, be surrounded by quiet people and never be seen, then "RJ" is correct. This is not the church for you.
If you want to build a church family and be challenged and fully engaged with your relationship to God, i suggested you come immediately and come with expectations!  THIS CHURCH IS EXACTLY WHERE IT NEEDS TO BE❤️‍🔥💝 I have visited this church several times since I relocated to Arizona. The message is always Gospel. The Pastor and his wife speak truth to where even a youngster can understand. Having gone this past Resurrection Sunday, I can say the Spirit of G-D, Unity, and Love is in this house. You literally feel welcomed, free to worship freely, convicted but not condemned, drawn to the Savior and not to the church. Blessings to you Pastor for your obedience to the call. This is not a compliment but simply acknowledgement. You are truly drawing people to Christ. Last year, I was looking for a church to attend for Easter, so I decided to visit FCC (Faith Christian Center) the weekend before Easter and I instantly fell in love with the church. From that first visit, I felt welcomed and encouraged, and I made the decision to commit to attending weekly.

That one decision truly transformed my life. I stepped out and joined a small group with like-minded women, and through that community I gained meaningful relationships and friendships that continue to bless my life. I also began volunteering at events like our Backpack Drive and Generosity Drive, which allowed me to serve others and grow in my faith.

Over time, I became more and more involved, and now I’m fully immersed in serving at FCC as an Assistant Project Manager, helping support the mission and community that has given me so much. God has truly transformed my life and shaped me into the woman of God I know I am today.

All of this started because I gave FCC a full year of commitment, and I’m so excited to see what the next years will bring. I’m incredibly grateful for this church and the life-changing community I’ve found here. FCC felt like home immediately after walking through the door over a year ago! Pastor Sean and Erica PREACH & teach us how to live set apart.

reviewSummary: I visited this church in 1996, Me, my husband and kids. We went there with my dad n we enjoyed Pastor Curtis Merriweather's teaching/preaching 🙏❤️ I've learned a lot about God and his word. name: Faith Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
What a great experience visiting this congregation.  My spirit leapt the moment I walked in. We were passing through as we continue on the Americas great loop but i wish that I could attend every week.
If you want or need to experience God’s presence go to a Sunday praise and worship service here. Full gospel teaching, pastor and the team members are humble, gracious and true servants of Christ. Wonderful to be in the presence of the Lord! Great church friendly loving people :) Great out reach missionary opportunities. It is right on it
And you can feel God is there
The word it on point Great place to Worship! All feel welcome there!

name: Faith Christian Fellowship - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
A blessed time of worship and fellowship with the Saints.  We visited the area and definitely recommend Faith Christian Fellowship. The singing reflects the joy of Christ in His body.  The teaching of God's Word was solid, edifying, and convicting. 🙏
We will definitely visit again when we come to the area ☺️ This church preaches the word of God in a powerful way. Not out for money, no big band, its not a show its the word of God. I am blessed to have pastor Daniel Ozuna speaking God's word. It convicts you which is what people need. Truly an edifying church best in town. Truly wonderful and welcoming people as well. I moved to Henderson, NV  this past December  and the pandemic restrictions prevented me from attending a church in person. During this time, I decided to visit the websites of some of the local churches in the Henderson/Las Vegas area to listen to the preachings of each church so that I can get an idea of which church I was going to attend once the pandemic restrictions were lifted. After listening to the preaching that is being expounded and taught from Pastor Daniel Ozuna at Faith Christian Fellowship, I knew that this was the church that I wanted to attend once things opened up again. Being led to this church was like being led to an oasis in the middle of a dry desert. God’s Word is treated with the utmost reverence and respect by pastor Daniel during his sermons. In his preaching and teaching, he carefully walks God’s people through the biblical text and provides many proof-texts to show that the words being spoken are God’s Words and not his own. The name of Jesus Christ alone is exalted throughout the worship and  preaching. I finally got the opportunity to attend this church in person last Sunday, and I am so grateful to the Lord for leading me to this awesome congregation.

"When looking for a church, don't look for one that is closest to your house. Look for one that is closest to the Bible."
-Paul Washer As a newcomer to the church I feel very welcomed. Parishioners gladly welcome you to their Church. They have several Bible studies during the week. They answer the phone when I called on Sunday which surprised me and I talked to the pastor directly. Considering I don't drive I've acquired friends at church that are willing to pick me up which is a godsend. Although I’ve not had the chance to attend, my husband and I met “Rod” on Fremont Street handing out Gospel tracts. What a blessing it was to meet an outward Christian in the middle of “Sin City”! If Rod is any example of Faith Christian Fellowship, I can recommend this church heartily!

name: Faith Christian Fellowship - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
Faith Christian Fellowship is an amazing, Bible based church in which I feel blessed by simply walking into the building,  The congregation is non-judgmental, accepting, loving, and strong in Christian values.

FCF offers something for everyone--men, women, children, teens, young adults, and community outreach programs such as this weekend's Chili Cook-off, Pumpkin Fest, and Vacation Bible School. . .to name a few.

I also love the music!

I cannot close this review without telling you about the leaders:  our pastor Dude Evans, his wife Bonnie, Associate Pastor Rob Gabbard and his wife Pastor Marsha, and another instrumental teacher, Steve Connors. I'm sure I'm omitting someone and I don't mean to.

The bottom line is that I hope you will visit our church a few times to see for yourself that we have a God-inspired group of people who would love to meet you, share worship time with you, pray with you, and grow with you.

God loves you, and so do we!  Come and say hello! I love this church. We are all family. We welcome new people and you become family
