name: Faith Church - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary:
The Worship was high quality, but way too loud. The gospel was effectively and lovingly preached. Hospitality was great from the welcome and information desk, but nobody in the congregation said hi. They had a homemade donut bar, if you could pay for it. Overall a good church. While me and my family never attended this church (me and my mother attend the UMC of Louisville), my mom would always bring me and my sister to the Easter Passion Play the Faith Church holds every Easter when we were kids.  Though question, does the Faith Church still holds the Easter Passion plays, if so, will they have it in 2025?  We haven't been to one for a long time and me and my mother want to see it this year. I went here once last week for the first time and I'm all in!  The music was very professional, one of the best groups of musicians I've heard in a long time, very refreshing.  The people are friendly, we met quite a few.  The number one thing I love about this church is that they are 100% bible based.  They don't push the money agenda, and they call sin a sin as called out by the bible.  No twisting the word of God for a political agenda, to get bucks and buts in the seats, or to boost their status.  This was actually covered in the last sermon, fantastic stuff.  I was so tired of churches with an ulterior motive trying to get something from you other than just joining together to worship God.  I left my last church because it was money money money every other sentence throughout every single sermon, a huge guilt trip.  I bet they lost more people from that then they ever won to God.  Shame on them. My husband and I have attended Faith Church for 4 years and appreciate the humility, wisdom and servant hearts of the entire staff, the purity of Biblical teaching and the sweet and powerful worship!  This Church has a big emphasis on serving community and mission minded! If you and your family are looking for a welcoming church family- please join us!!
PS- the homemade donuts served every Sunday are the best!!!! I was invited by a Friend & was so happy I accepted.  The Congregation was very friendly, warm, kind & loving...just what I needed! The message was very moving & powerful, also just what I needed. Although I belong to another Church, I will definitely be going to visit Faith Church again. Thank you, Faith Church for having me.

name: Faith Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
Great passage and modern mixed with old traditions, I always feel leaving like a have a purpose and want to be the best version of myself Pros: Great church, Gospel centered teaching, close proximity to Chick-fil-A (too bad it's closed on Sunday!)
Cons: Caleb Patella is often there I used to attend this church several years ago and it's good church mostly if you have connections to people.. if not, then it's very difficult to get connected regardless.  The teachings are great and music is decent.. but the issue that I have is like someone else has mentioned.. that if you are different then them in anyway they aren't going to reach out to you and your basically going to drown.. I was one of the only asians in the church and got excluded alot and didn't make friends.. even though I tried.. there was even one couple there that very obviously had issues with me for no reason and treated me poorly.. I am not a member of the church and I do visit weekly on Monday mornings at 9AM for the NoCoNet job networking meeting.  The church has made the facility available for a number of years to those folks who are seeking new employment.  This is a great location and a great facility and we very much appreciate Faith Church for being so consistent in supporting this effort. Faith has done a terrific job continuing services during the Covid pandemic!

The in-person services are carefully managed to ensure safety. The streaming services quality increased dramatically during the pandemic - now state-of-the-art.

The leadership, staff and volunteers commitment to the congregation and to the community is an ongoing inspiration.

For anyone struggling with the pandemic and finding themselves in spiritual need, consider live-steaming on Sunday. Better yet, come in-person . . . even though the social side is currently limited, the live music and joyful congregation makes in-person more special.

name: Faith Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: This place is wonderful. I study English here. The people are kind to everyone. Everyone truly works from the heart. They are supportive and respectful, regardless of class or race. They give us many opportunities to learn and enjoy a pleasant environment full of love, a good attitude, and lots of learning!😎🙏🏻💯 Very welcoming. I was greeted by many people and each was willing to have a conversation. Good biblical message. Hymns in the early service. Several members told me that after their first Sunday at Faith they stopped looking for a church. That says a lot! Ian so excited to be in Faith Church. I love seeing everybody and it is a good feeling to give all glory and praise to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. He has brought me a long way since my time on the streets of Cali. I have my own apt. I also have a job that I love and look forward to helping as many people as I can. God bless faith church!!! Ron Sonti A good-sized church (not so big you can't know and connect easily with the pastors well, nor so small it's "awkward"), this is a church that is serious about understanding the Scriptures deeply, about understanding that the Kingdom of God reaches all corners of the world, which includes people of diverse groups across the continents and a vast population of immigrants and refugees in its own neighborhood as well. People come from those neighborhoods and from all across greater Indianapolis for a reason...this is a unique place that is theologically serious and solid, is intellectually-challenging, but thoroughly comfortable and welcoming, and has a heart for justice and mercy. All ages "fit" here...rather rare today in the American church. Vibrant traditional worship and energetic contemporary worship co-exist happily because those who attend each see the bigger picture. Sunday adult classes are outstanding, with excellent teachers, and last only three months (not an "eternal commitment"). Amazing opportunities for kids to grow and flourish. Lots of opportunities to be connected or just to grow. The facility was just remodeled and seems to make a visit much easier. I'm really blessed to be a part of Faith church community!!! Everybody is really welcoming and they are family to me. Sometime back I had several eye surgeries and they brought food to my apartment and gave me rides  to Eskenazi. I love Faith!!!

name: Faith Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a wonderful Church to call home? This is the one, folks! Every single person you meet is just full of the Spirt of God. The people here welcome you with a big smile on their face, and it is such a joy to serve and attend here at Faith. I look forward to hearing the message every Sunday, whether it be Josh, Christian, Tyler, or any of the other wonderful pastors/guest speakers they have speak. Each message is so detailed, interesting, and helpful. The worship leaders do a wonderful job leading the service in worship!! This Church is not an average Church. It’s special. It’s comfortable. It’s inviting and loving. This is a family. It’s one big family getting together and worshipping God. Me and my family have been coming to this church for almost 11 years and gladly call it our second home :)
Although I’ve been coming for quite awhile I still learn something new every Sunday!
This church is full of intentionality, joyfulness, great worship (for all ages!!) and amazing people :)

And FcStudents is SO fun!! I’ve called this church home for over a decade! My husband and I have found spiritual family here who have walked with us through many seasons of life. Our kiddos love it here too! They have services on Saturday and Sunday, a variety of small groups to choose from, an amazing kids environment, a private mothers room, men’s and women’s events throughout the year, youth services on Wednesdays, VBS in the Summer, and so much more! Come see what FC is all about! I started attending Faith Church almost 4 years ago. I was in search of a spirit-filled community, and I found exactly what I was looking for. I felt cared for, loved for, and invested in. Faith Church is a church that invested in me from the start and built me into the person I am today. The pastor's teachings are straight from the word, and he cares deeply for everyone he interacts with. The leaders are amazing and will walk with you through any situation. All in all, Faith Church is just AMAZING! We've been attending here since 2017. It felt like home the second  my family walked in that Sunday in February in 2017. They care so much about our kids, our Next Gen. I wouldn't want to be anywhere else. Our FC Family is so welcoming, loving and kind. We truly care for our families.

name: Faith Church | South Tulsa Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
Faith Church in Tulsa is a place where my wife and I have found a community of people who we have grown to love.
We started attending on Wednesday nights at the women’s and men’s groups and found people like us eager to learn and be connected with a community. Our attendance has grown beyond Wednesdays and now we regularly attend all services and events at Faith Church. (Our daughter and son-in-law attend now too! )

The Pastor’s, Dr. Kelly and Lisa Goins are amazing people with hearts passionate about serving their Church and helping others grow in their walk with God.

If you are looking for a Church with a Pastor that genuinely cares for you, a children’s and youth program that is second to none, and a congregation of people you can connect with and love, Faith Church Tulsa is where you want to be. I have been attending this church for a little under 10 years now and my favorite thing about this church is the pastor(Dr. Kelly Goins) speaks the Bible and not his opinion. Would recommend this church and people in this building 10 out of 10 times An amazing church, they restored my faith and are very outgoing. They really care. Love this church This is a place where people GENUINELY CARE about you. No getting lost in the crowd. We LOVE our church! The people here are authentic. Pastors Kelly and Lisa and the real thing - kind, loving, and truly bring the word of God.

name: Faith Church | West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church so much!! Anyone is welcome! Service is Sundays at 10am in the high school. Always uplifting and very easy to get connected if you choose to. Amazing staff and always preaching from the Bible. Absolutely LOVE Faith Church, Lots of friendly people who care and Family oriented. Everyone is welcomed with open arms and a cheerful attitude.  Pastors David and Nicole Crank are Absolutely AMAZING people. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church that puts the Lord First, and wanting to become part of our family. Love Faith Church I mostly go on line no transportation but these past 2 Sundays I have been blessed with a ride and have fully enjoy being in God’s house. The music the people Pastor’s absolutely amazing. Come join Faith Church you won’t regret it. It is not boring at all. Very educational and fun. This church is inside of Palm Beach Lakes High school, and I really hope they are able to get a permanent location because they are doing great things there.

I am visiting from out of state and went with a family member, and I love how diverse the people are and how friendly everyone was. The pastor was live on screen today since he was at the other location for baptisms, but that didn't stop him from making me feel connected to the sermon and what he had to say.

He has a hilarious and entertaining personality, and he isn't afraid to be vulnerable and honest about his own shortcomings and mistakes in order to bring people to the joy and goodness of Jesus.

If you have never been to church or are looking for a church home, try this place out. It will change your life. Even though we entered through the wrong door Pastor Austin and Pastor David greeted us with open arms and showed us the way to join into this loving congregation.  I love this church because no matter where you are from or how you got here they make you feel welcome. They are committed to inspiring you with an awesome worship service and incredible sermons spoken that help you experience the true Love of God. Thank you

name: Faith Church Lubbock - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely LOVE this church! From the first day I attended I have felt welcomed and loved. I love that I can attend the services here and feel like I've been fed. The pastor teaches straight out of the bible and teaches in a way that my children can understand his sermons. The kids program is phenomenal! I have never been to a church where they were so organized with the children. Our teenager loves to do things with the youth here and I fully trust the staff to take care of him. The people that attend FCFC are the best people around ... and the music is AWESOME! Have visted about month now with my family, People are friendly but do stay to themselves. I do not mind that during sick season. Church members are warm and welcoming. The Pastor and his wife seem pretty great. We are new and coming from the baptist church served as members for many many years, but it was time for something different. Something strictly from the bible without denominational doctrine and "rules" and opinions ESPECIALLY political, sermons for the most part have been just that. The most important thing's to me when attending a church whether I'm a offical member or a visitor is whether or not my faith is growing and I'm gaining biblical knowledge and moved by the holy spirit and the sermons are straight from the bible and opportunities to serve. I feel that here so far and that's very important to my family aswell. The music is a tad lengthier than I'm use to and there's not many recognizable hymns it's alot of the new music and fairly loud however the band and song leaders are very amazing, I do enjoy them very much, but I do miss hearing the congregation singing. There's nothing more moving and spiritual than hearing the people around you sing out to the Lord. I would love to hear something from the hymnal and maybe a quieter band for atleast one song so the people can be heard. I was also confused my first visit when it came time to talk about giving and tithing there's no collection plate passed around. This is my first time attending a non denominational church I'm not sure if they all do this but I had to ask where I could give my tithe. Just a FYI there is boxes on the back wall for that. I'm also confused on how to serve this church or if they do church membership in the event we would like to make this our church home and become more active members, I can't seem to find anything on the site and not much has been talked about during service about opportunities to serve. I will have to ask. Anyway I do like it here. I'm still in prayer for a Church home and I'm letting God direct our steps in that direction. I'm thankful he has brought us to faith church. If this is to be my families new church home I have no doubts we wouldn't grow closer to Our Lord and Savior. I hope this helps anyone planning a visit I highly recommend you do. Also I don't have little kids but seems as though they have pretty good size youth groups. Theres a big line for pick up as we walk out. When my son was little it's was very challenging finding a church with kids his age. This seems to be a great place for those with littles. God bless ! I was sitting on my couch one day scrolling facebook about a month ago now and the advertisement for there Fearless conference popped up. And immediately it interested me to see more about this church. So I went and found the page and the first thing I went to was Who we are? Everything lined up with my beliefs and the Holy Spirit in the moment told me to gather the family to visit. Thats what I did and we have been every Sunday since. My adult children love it they range from 23-28 my grandchildren love it they range from newborn to 5 and I love it. It just feels like home, the teachings are by the word, the congregation doesn’t mind putting their hands 🙌🏽 up and worshipping God. 10/10 recommend if you ready for a judgement free church, with a great learning environment for all ages, all walks of life and  you ready to get your soul right, look no more! Best church in Lubbock, the second time going they knew my entire families name. Pastor stormy preaches the Bible exactly how it is and is awesome at it. It trickles down to the youth and kids church as well. Highly recommend. Sweetest community I’ve met. I’m 18 and grew up catholic but I decided to try something new because that’s what was calling my name, I have been going to Faith Church for a few months now and I felt so welcomed and so comfortable. You know being young and going by yourself can be nerve racking but I felt at home and loved! I really recommend Faith Church. God is more than just “religion” and that’s how I feel at this church. Not judged for being human and not being perfect.

name: Faith Church Midland - Midland Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to die of deeper into the word and understand your faith on another level. The pastors truly have you at the forefront of their hearts. My wife and I went for our first time and we have only been to 2 other churches in Midland. We are shy people and we're nervous but we felt very welcomed by everyone. Our 2 children had fun with the amazing people there in the kids room. Pastor Johnny was great he really knows how to get your attention and is a great pastor. We laughed, cried a little, felt very blessed to be there. We found our church ❤️ I really enjoy my church amazing people and just loving Pastors My family and I had given this church a try and have found our church home since! I truly appreciate the impact our pastors as well as the amazing church family have made on us. We are beyond blessed to have found this church and the greatness that comes with it😊 My fiancé and I experienced a wonderful service the first time we visited. The pastor really speaks the Word and you feel genuinely welcomed!

name: Faith Community Bible Church
reviewSummary: I came as a UW student and found spiritual mothers and fathers. I appreciated the diversity of teachers and worship teams, and how everyone had an opportunity to contribute to the Sunday gatherings. This is a great place to make your church family. As a member for more than 50 years, I’ve seen a change in the founder, Pastor Ken Kellenberg’s original intent;   Straying from a church with a passion for the pure Gospel and missions to a focus on more on controversial political issues.  They do not have a pastor to guide them, but have a weak team of rotating preachers including women.  Their strongest area is  in supporting and helping one another and greet guests openly. I felt really welcomed the first time I attended and I've thought it has been a great place of community ever since.  There's a team leadership model to just about everything, which means there's different people preaching and leading worship.  I haven't seen any other church model the priesthood of all believers concept in the same way.  Worship is just wonderful.  Despite not being particularly large, the church has a long history of sending people around the world to advance the gospel.  Housegroups provide more intimate fellowship communities.  I'd gladly recommend checking out this Bible-believing church. I grew up in an intellectual, evangelical subset of the Christian faith that approaches the Bible as God's Word.  When I started coming to FCBC I saw that same value was honored...and along with it was a realness, a culture of vulnerability, a genuineness that is sometimes missing at other churches.  I love it.  We don't have to put on airs at FCBC; we can admit our mistakes and still be accepted.  And my intellect is stimulated by outstanding teaching! This elder led church takes hosting the presence of Jesus seriously, giving him first place in making their ministry decisions. At the time of this review their strategic focii are... 1) the UW Madison campus, and 2) the Triangle, a low to middle income housing community bounded by Park St, Regent St, and W Washington.  They have historic evangelical roots as the founder came from the Elmbrook Church network, but through the years have thoughtfully embraced the present work and gifts of Holy Spirit, women in leadership and ministry, and the house of prayer for all nations (c.f. IHOP KC, 24-7 Prayer USA, Bethel Redding etc.).  Worship expression has been the vision and crafting of Laurie Croasdale, a pillar of the local music scene.  Artistic expression has been carried and birthed by Bobbette Rose, well known on the local art scene. You'll have to bring your real self to this place (in transformation through Jesus of course!) because this is a family of raw, earthy, and passionate brothers and sisters!

name: Faith Community Bible Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: For solid Bible-centered, Christ-focused teaching, great fellowship, and really inspiring hymns this church is a rare jewel nowadays. This is what most churches were all about many years ago. Friendly warm welcome. Fine Bible teaching and activities for children! Beautiful music beautiful people!

name: Faith Community Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a sweet church community! If you're fatigued ad nauseum with the mega church scene, this family of tight knit believers is for you. I've been a member for almost three years now and haven't regretted a single day of it. The disconnected, country club/jesus points/dressed to the nines/I came to get free child care and coffee nonsense that is so pervasive and cancerous with giant churches in San Diego isn't a factor at Faith Community in the slightest. Having once been a devil worshiper and heavily in the occult, finding a church that totally accepted me, personally counseled me, is currently providing and helping for my wedding via premarital counseling and young engaged fellowship group, there's nothing more to be said concerning whether FCC "walks the walk". Never have I felt more appreciated and intimately cared for by any other religious organization. Not even close.
So if you're venturing to find a church whom's intent is to invest in you on a real, impactful level, this is for you. If you're just showing up to get a box checked and wear your Sunday best to parade around in so people notice you while getting some nebulous sense of moral satisfaction just by being physically present at a church building, I'm sure there are other places more suitable.
It's about the love of Jesus and how he can compassionately and breath takingly change your life for the better. No other elder board, pastors, mentors, A/V department, child care center can come within a hair of FCC. I would give 10 stars if I could. Sound doctrine, sound theology, and not a flashy, pretentious person to be found. Come on in for a visit and get your life changed. :) We love visiting when we are in Cali visiting our Son in the Marines.  Very welcoming group and always good message Probably my favorite Church to go to service and the people there are really great and friendly plus service starts a little later in the morning for those of you that aren't morning people The missionaries who live here are very kind, welcoming, and willing to engage people in discussions of faith and worldview.

name: Faith Community Church - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: We went there as part of an interfaith tour.  It was a warm and educational experience. Great singing. organ and diverse group.  thinking about changing my membership to here. My son volunteers there and has had a great experience helping at the center. Very kind and loving community.  💗 This is a place for the community. ALL  are welcome.

name: Faith Community Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. I've been looking, unsuccessfully for 10 years for a church that was faith based and not a business. Not only is this a truly faith based family, full of loving believers but it's fellowship is wonderful.  If you're looking for a home church I would definitely check this place out and let your soul decide. Last year I'd prayed for God to lead me to a good church, and He led me to "FCC Indy".  From the moment I walked in, I was greeted, felt welcome, and truly loved by the people I met!  The people readily gather around people in need of prayer during the service... They truly are the hands and feet of Jesus!
- Pastor Steve Nanney is one of the best pastors I've ever had, SO full of the Holy Spirit and love!  He faithfully preaches, even the "harder truths" but does so in a way that feels more exhorting, challenging and encouraging (and not condemning).  Every message has been so powerful and timely!
- They have wonderful men's and women's ministries, each of which have Saturday morning prayer gatherings where God has shown up powerfully and answered prayers big time!  Wonderful youth ministry and private school too!
- FCC Indy is a beacon of light and love of Jesus in Indianapolis! This is an amazing church, we have been coming here for, three year’s now. We love to pray for one another at, any time during the service. We are filled with love, laughter we will get in the trenches with you and stay there. We really are doing life together as, the body of Christ should do. We understand the assignment, and truly care about our community. Our pastor is one of a kind he does not peach at, you like most do. He allows the holy spirt to convict you. He preaches the truth and many don’t like to hear it these days and ages. You feel the love from everyone when, you enter in the doors. We do communion every Sunday. We have church on Sunday nights and Wednesday. We have children’s church and nursery and even women’s and men’s prayer on sat morning so if your looking for a small church filled with love and truth look no more. We would love to meet you and to meet with you as well. Have a blessed day in the lord. My family and I have been coming to this church for one year now. We have been so blessed by the pastor and his wife, the elders of the church, and the precious people who attend church here and to have the opportunity to serve as well.
If you’re looking for a solid, Bible being taught, Holy Spirit filled and lead church family I would highly recommend visiting and considering making this your home church. Pastor Steve truly has one of the most solid, Jesus and Holy Spirit, Bible  focused  hearts that I’ve met. He just literally oozes with love for people. We’ve seen a few of the ups and downs and this church and its leadership stand firm on the word of God, their faith, and I am thankful that the Lord brought us here. This is not a safe place. The pastor is shady and has hurt many people over the last few years. They have lost so many good people. They do not practice what they preach. Please be careful trusting the leader, his wife, or their friends.
They like to cover and hide major issues and act like nothing is wrong in front of the congregation.

When you first attend, it is a great place that is loving and accepting, but the deeper you get into serving, the more you see how deep the sin and pride are.

name: Faith Community Church - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to fellowship and hear the word of God. Doing great things in our county

name: Faith Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have called Faith Community our home for over 25 years. We love this church family. The Word of God is taught faithfully and the people truly love one another. Although we are imperfect, our desire is to continually grow to become more like Christ. We visited Faith Community Church as we were visiting family in the area. We were in town from Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Congregation at FCC were very friendly and welcoming. Great sermon. Absolutely love this church family! My wife and I have been members now for only 2 years, but it feels like we've been here all our lives. No gimmicks, no facades, no smoke and mirrors. Solid, Biblical teaching from series that are both topical and exegetical. Rotating worship bands with different leaders who all exceptionally lead the congregation through modern anthems and classic hymns. Great adult studies, small groups, children's ministries and youth program! Come check us out for a couple of weeks and see if this is where God would have you! The word is preached faithfully here, people love God and love one another well (imperfectly but with genuine care, concern, and desire to reflect Christ well).

The ministries that currently exist (2024) truly seek to magnify Jesus and see their participants know him better.  Children's ministry (CMD) is amazing!! The kids learn so much, are hiding God's word in their hearts, and growing in relationships with each other (we've had 7 of our 10 kids come through this ministry).

FSM, the jr and sr high youth ministries have not only fun activities for the youth, but solid teaching and small groups helping young people apply what they're learning.

Young adults ministry does our best to connect 18-30 year olds to each other through fellowship, teaching, worship, prayer, and to answer/ work through relevant issues in adulting as a believer in the 2020s.

Men's and women's ministries help connect men and women to midweek Bible studies, fellowship, and accountability.  Testimonies of God's faithfulness are shared and individuals grow more deeply in community.

Life groups, global Outreach, some truly amazing men and women in the Spanish ministry... if you've read this far you've picked up that I could go on...😉 ... music ministry, the audio/ visual team... there's so much being done and so much more to do... We are part of the classical conversations Community hosted at this church. It's a wonderful facility and we love our CC community! Anyone who is looking how to find a great Homeschool Group that focuses on education, character development, and growing your children as human beings, check out the CC groups here! There are three CC groups that meet at this church. They are not affiliated with the church. They are made up mostly of families who live in Santa Clarita and every campus has a Wonderful group. CC Community meetings are on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays.

name: Faith Community Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary: I love faith community! The church family are so genuine, kind and caring. Especially In times like these, it’s good to know we have people who will reach out beyond our four walls and into our community to help support others who maybe struggling. Church used to be a place of judgement but not at faith community, we can each find a sense of belonging and real acceptance. Authentic, Jesus-loving community who accepts people just as they are.  My children have found life-long friends here, and adults who really care and pour into them.  As a parent, I have always felt supported.  I have truly found a home in this church. We've been a part of faith community Church since the day it started. We love the Jesus centered teaching and helping the local community, schools, and others in need. It's a great place for families or anyone! We love this church! Great sense of community, solidly grounded in Biblical truth and wonderful place to attend as a family (lots of kids and families also attend). Wonderful church where you can come as you are. It is not a church where you have to put on a fascade. It is full of broken, imperfect, but genuinely loving people.

name: Faith Community Church - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary: Visiting today from out of state. I am so excited to find a Biblical Church here in Vacaville. The volunteers were very friendly and welcoming. The sermon was expository and completely biblical. If you are looking for a church community that will you teach you solid biblical truth and make you feel like you are part of a loving family in Christ,  I invite you to come and worship with us. Check out our website, listen to a sermon and read about many of the groups we have. There is something for everyone.  I found FCC to be a community that will pray, teach, serve and come along side you in all circumstances in life. Pastor Jon loves us and is passionate about teaching the word of God. We have many wonderful people who would love to meet you. My faith has flourished over the past years and I desire to give it all to my Savior, Jesus Christ!  Come worship and hear truth with me and my family, we would love it. Faithful, Biblical preaching with a loving, passionate delivery by Pastor Jon. I have been attending FCC for almost eight years now, and cannot say enough about this wonderful church, from regular Sunday worship services and the praise-filled music to the mid-week Bible studies, faith groups and individual mentoring. This church has come alongside me and my family and showed their loving care for us in countless ways. Even after moving away from Solano County, FCC has been such a big part of our lives that we can't imagine attending anywhere else and continue to make the drive each week, and it is worth it a thousand times over. Attended this beautiful church last Sunday and I have been several times before but the pastor is wonderful. Joe and Cathy are fantastic people . Great service I love Fairh Community Church.  I have been a member since it started up over 16 years ago.  Pastor Jon has not wavered in his teaching of the word of God.  He preaches the truth.  I love the worship music as well.

name: Faith Community Church - Woodstock Campus
reviewSummary: Expository teaching at its finest! The first time my wife and I set foot in this church, we were greeted so warmly, we could truly feel the love of Christ. Then, after one hour of Bible study in Cornerstone Sunday school and a one hour sermon as well as all the wonderful God honoring worship music, we knew that this would be our church from that day forward. Thank you for accepting us. We love our new church and our new church family. Biblically sound church centered on Jesus Christ. This church preaches verse by verse in order that we may grow in likeness with Christ. Beautiful and stunning new church build in Woodstock, GA! People are friendly & welcoming. Church leadership really tries to teach and lead with what scripture says and disciple one another. Love the new building! The simple lines point one's eyes upwards towards heaven, while inside the music glorifies God working with the exigetical messages brought from God's word! Best church ever.  Teaches sound doctrine and the pastor (Shane Koehler) gives the most spectacular, entertaining sermons.  In addition, the congregation is just great; they're friendly, talented, and all around great people.  I have been going to this church for about 10 years now and would recommend it to anyone.

name: Faith Community Church of Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: My home, my friends, my comfort! Best little church in Southern California!! The people are a little crazy and its to loud who the hell sings so loud at 7 am I'm trying to sleep geez Best church ever

name: Faith Community Church Redding - Redding Campus
reviewSummary:
I want to take a moment to share just how much my church, Faith Community Church in Redding, has meant to me and my life, especially during one of the most challenging and painful chapters I’ve ever faced.

Throughout my dearest Christian’s fight against Cancer, he found so much love, peace, and comfort in his brothers and sisters in Christ. The support and prayers he received from this incredible community strengthened his faith and reminded him daily that he was never alone. Christian’s love for all of you was so deep and genuine; he cherished every kind word, every prayer,  every thoughtful gift, and every moment of fellowship.

As his battle with cancer drew to a close, one of the greatest sources of comfort to him was knowing that I would never be without family, and that he would see us all again someday. He found peace in knowing that I had this church and this church had me—a family bound not just by faith, but by unconditional love and support. That assurance brought him so much joy, and it has brought me immeasurable comfort as well. I can't imagine where I would be if not for the wonderful people at Faith Community Church, and I thank the good Lord everyday that I don't have to.

This church has been more than a place of worship for me. It has been a sanctuary, a home, a source of strength, and a community that embodies the love of Christ. Your unwavering support, prayers, and kindness have carried me through the hardest of days. You’ve shown me what it truly means to live out faith in action.

To anyone searching for a place to belong, I want you to know there are places like this—where love and faith are alive, where people stand with you in your darkest moments, and where you can experience the peace that comes from knowing God and His people are with you.

Thank you, my church family, for being such a profound blessing in both Christian’s life and in mine. I will always carry the love of this community in my heart, and I am forever grateful for all you have done for us and continue to do for me everyday.
I love you and God bless you all! Pastor Mali is the first pastor in 42 yrs that was able to teach me any thing new about the bible and I'm well learned Faith Community Church makes you feel like you’re part of a family.  I love their devotion and Pastor Mali is a great pastor.  I’m glad I checked out this church. While the church, and the pastor, are friendly and loving, some other facets of the church, such as adhering to biblical ways of dealing with issues, are lacking. The power of God is here you can always tell when there's kleenexes in the aisles this move of the Holy Spirit you can't throw what it God you have to go to the depths of your heart

name: Faith Community Church-Nazarene - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
I like this church.  I was here for an after-hours function. I met the pastor and several members of the congregation.  They were friendly and very welcoming.  The grounds were kept up well, and it looked like a place to go if you are looking for a new church. The place was clean, and easy to find.  Thank you Pastor Jim for your grace and hospitality. Very friendly. Made me feel wanted.  The music was good.  The most important was the Word of God was proclaimed

The Pastor and the Assoc. Pastor were very approachable and caring. The services were amazingly beautiful. The Pastor was wonderful & thought provoking. Property is nice & groomed. This was the best choice for our family. Friendly people. Great Pastor. Welcoming place. Good food 😊⭐

name: Faith Community UMC - West Chester Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been going to Faith Community UMC in West Chester Ohio for about 8 yrs now. We really like it. They have a contemporary and traditional services to choose from. We usually go to the traditional one. I like that they offer Sunday school for my kids during the services. My boys really like Sunday School. I found it really easy to get involved and help with the food pantry, be apart of the services, and I like helping with Sunday School too.

The Church offers great children’s events throughout the year. Activities for all ages and also Upward basketball and cheerleading. My boys love the Easter party, Big Bible Events, and VBS is second to none. I like helping with that too!

If you are looking for a Church home, I highly recommend Faith Community UMC! This is a wonderful place. The staff are amazing and always great fellowship. They provide so many programs and services. There is no excuse for anyone to not get help. The Tuesday dinners are great thanks to those who prepare and volunteer their time. If I were not a member at another fellowship I would attend there. They have a food bank through the church and all volunteers attend the church. You can go on Tuesdays between 9-11am and  Saturdays between 12-2pm. They bag up the food and essentials such as toilet paper, shampoos, deodorants, etc. Depending on your household size, they will give you more then most food banks will. They are the nicest people I've ever encountered and so caring. Coming here every Tuesday has been such a blessing. The community is wonderful. The food is great. They have multiple programs to help such as the getting ahead program and have a food pantry here too. This Church is very Compassionate who serves their community with so many resources!!!!God bless this place..They have pantry as well as community Dinners to bring everyone together..God bless this place..Such and Extraordinary Experience even plays live church Music😍🎶🎶🎶🎶 The Best🙏God is so Good!!!!

name: Faith E Church
reviewSummary: Faith E emphasis scripture and the power of prayer. It is an expression of authenticity delivered through sermons, music, community and community outreach. It stands alone in its sincerity to reach people right where they are. Wonderful Easter Service and great options for kids to stay entertained while the sermon given. So far biblical principles are applied. People have been very friendly. The staff are loving and genuinely friendly. They love the community and literally anyone they come in contact with! They offer you prayer and fellowship, as well as a safe place to go. Prepared for the pandemic and taking all necessary precautions to prevent infection from covid. What a wonderfully friendly place to meet people and take in the word of God.  And follow a path through scripture.

name: Faith Episcopal Church
reviewSummary: A peaceful and exceptionally friendly local parish. Truly open hearts and minds.

name: Faith Episcopal Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I have attended Faith Episcopal Church for over 25 years.  It is a warm and compassionate community of people committed to living out God's purpose on earth.  All are welcome to join us at the Lord's table. We have a new Vicar who is an amazing and compelling speaker.  He gives us a lot of things to think about each week. There is always a wonderful fellowship after the service. I encourage anyone who is looking for a rewarding spiritual experience to visit our church. Celebrating our new Vicar in 2018: Rev. Dawn Vukich. We are a small church with a big heart. All are welcome, wherever you are on your spiritial journey. Or even if you just want a warm place to connect woth people. This is a great small-community church. The people are so loving, kind, and welcoming! They are amazing My church home & family.

name: Faith Family Billings Church
reviewSummary: Very welcoming congregation and pastors. Felt very comfortable at my first service. Teaching completely from the Word and Holy Spirit moving in the service. Devotional bible study released each week following the sermon is fantastic to dive deeper into the lesson series. This is a small bible based Protestant congregation with a Christ centered pastor delivering meaningful sermons with a mixture of humor and compassion. Holy Spirit is allowed to move in the Service. Prayer after service is offered. Very welcoming people. Felt right at home I love my church and all of our members. It is growing by leaps and bounds. If you are looking for a church home, please join us. Our Pastors love God and His word and they are well versed on everything they teach! Come on Sundays and meet our Lord and Savior right where  you are!! This is an amazing church that hosts the presence of Holy Spirit.  It’s loving, easy to get to know others and most importantly, they teach the uncompromised Word of God in a way to apply it to daily life.  A great place to  grow spiritually no matter how new or how seasoned you are in your walk with God!

name: Faith Family Church
reviewSummary: Faith Family Church is a place that I have found the love of God for the last twenty plus years. The people are wonderful and the truth of the Bible is taught constantly. Please come join us. Things you will learn at this "church:" Only they have the truth, beyond their doors are lies, there are levels of acceptance and association within the church. This church operates like a networking scheme. One of the famous quotes from the pastor: "you don't go to a restaurant and eat and not pay the bill, you were fed the word of God, so pay your bill." If you’re looking for a church home this is it. People who are friendly loving and will pray with you and walk through life with you! This church has a top notch children’s ministry! My kids absolutely can’t wait for church every week! They wake up asking if it’s church because they want to go to class! And they don’t just have fun in class but they learn the word of God and memorize scripture and are encouraged to bring their bibles! Best people and best pastors and best church in town! Great church. They teach the Bible like it is! I love it. Great for kids. You can tell the amazing time and excellence they put into kids service. Thank you for all you do! This church has changed my life and my children's life and my extend families life and my friend's lives. I absolutely love being in the house of the Lord! This church helped me see the connection to God and how to connect to God! This church has helped the words of the bible come to life through God! reviewSummary:

We wanted to be sure that this was the church for us, so we prayed, and we both came to the conclusion that Lifeway Church was where God wanted us. What also solidified our decision was the degree of genuine love and acceptance that were shown to us by the congregation. The Pastors took the time to get to know us. They genuinely care about people. They are truly about seeing people get saved, healed, discipled, equipped, and serving in the ministry. If you are looking for a church home where the truth of the Word of God is taught, where there is a family of faith, and the Holy Spirit is leading.... well, I personally want to invite you to Lifeway Church. We are waiting to welcome you and fellowship with you. We'll see you soon!!

The love that you will feel when you walk through the front door is unmatched. Everyone genuinely loves each other and WANTS to be at church! The people are not uptight and stuffy but are instead fun, real, authentic, and genuine. Messages are full of challenging "meat" (as the Bible says) instead of elementary "milk." Pastor Bruce AND Pastor Sheila Rhodes are Rhema graduates, which for me was super important to know when my husband and I were looking for a church when we moved here. They are FULL of faith and full of the Word! Pastors genuinely LOVE people while at the same time speaking the Truth to them in love and challenging them to come up higher in the Word and mature in their walk with the Lord. There are life groups and get-togethers for every age as well. While at Lifeway, you will meet people from every generation, profession, ethnicity, and background, and it feels like one giant FAMILY who loves Jesus and loves each other! Well, everyone who serves at church all got in a big huddle (see the photo) and sent a video to us telling us how much they wished we could be there and that they missed us! Seriously, what church notices when you're gone and yet takes it a step further and has the team send a video to you telling you that you're missed?!? I'll tell you what church does that... reviewSummary:
Believers are no longer under the Mosaic covenant (Rom. 6:14–15; 7:5–6; Gal. 3:15–4:7; 2 Cor. 3:4–18).

The commands stipulated in the Mosaic covenant are no longer in force for believers. Some appeal to the division between the civil, ceremonial, and moral law to support tithing. Yet these divisions, I would observe, are not the basis Paul uses when addressing how the law applies to us today. And even if we use these distinctions, tithing is clearly not part of the moral law. name: Faith Temple Church
reviewSummary:
Reposting for a friend

I visited the walk through food drive on 07/10/2026 with my service dog and was extremely disappointed with how I was treated. After waiting in line for nearly two hours, I was refused service because someone reportedly had a dog allergy.

I explained to multiple staff members that, under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), a service dog is not required to wear a vest, and businesses cannot require certification, registration, identification cards, documentation, or any other proof that a dog is a service animal. My dog was not wearing a vest because of the extreme heat, and I was concerned about her overheating.

Under the ADA, if it is not obvious that a dog is a service animal, staff are only permitted to ask two questions: (1) "Is the dog a service animal required because of a disability?" and (2) "What work or task has the dog been trained to perform?" Instead of asking these questions, I was asked for documentation, which is not permitted under the ADA, and was told my service dog was not welcome because of another person's allergy.

Rather than working toward a reasonable solution, I was confronted by the pastor, who told me my service dog was not welcome and instructed me to leave. When I asserted my rights and asked them to call law enforcement if they believed I was violating any rules, the pastor instructed the volunteers not to serve me. At one point, he pushed past me to speak with a volunteer and again told them not to provide me with service.

Despite making it through the entire line, I was only given two small cartons of milk and was otherwise refused service.

When law enforcement arrived, I stepped outside to speak with the officers because the situation had caused me to have a panic attack.

Overall, I am very disappointed by how this situation was handled. I understand that allergies can present challenges, but the ADA requires businesses to make reasonable accommodations for both individuals with disabilities and those with allergies whenever possible, rather than excluding a person with a service animal. In the future, I will only use the drive-thru and will not be going inside again. I have only visited Faith Temple twice the fellowship is amazing. I have only attended twice. Very nice church the pastor is very down to earth I grew up in this church and the faces may have changed but the welcome nature and love of community and God has not. They do a remarkable food give away that helps Sioux falls community and brings the members of the church together in a way I have never seen in any other house of worship. Pastor Jeff is a true believer and has the ability to make you feel the power of his words Wonderful church . Came here back in the early 90s, everyone was lovely to have church with . I like the music here as well. My old church preached against this music, and I truly began to believe it was wrong and stopped listening to it altogether, believing it was displeasing to the LORD; but after my pastor defected from the faith and began to believe he was God, also doing subtle signs around the church to give a message to the church, (ex. not replacing the water heater, even during winter, so our hands were frigid when we would wash them; and then altogether removing the water heater, and not replacing it, despite the $10,000 tithe we received one week in April of last year, which was about 10x our usual tithe: this he did to subtly state he saw us as a cold church, and then a lukewarm church, before subtly claiming to be God behind the pulpit, and then putting in his 2 week notice to leave the church); after he defected, I reflected on verses of Scripture, such as how we are called to "make a joyful noise unto the LORD"; and how "they who worship the Father must worship him in spirit and in truth, for the Father seeketh such to worship him". I realized that, even though his heart may have been in the right place before he defected, it was wrong to believe we should put a limit on what type of joyful noise we are to make unto the LORD. If it comes naturally and from our heart towards him, then I believe He is well pleased with what we are singing.

I love how there are also children's services here, and opportunities and invitations for both services to the church and charity drives for the local community. The people here have a heart to give, and the atmosphere seems warm and inviting.

I would suggest, though, that you bring your own KJV Bible if you have one. It's the only version of Scripture that you can find that has no copyright on it in its most basic format (no paragraphing, red letters, etc.), because you cannot copyright History; in order to copyright something, you have to make enough changes to something to make it "your own", or else you can be sued in accordance with copyright laws. To test and see if this was true, I went to the Dollar Tree one year, and found both the NIV and the KJV versions in their most basic format, with no bells or whistles. The KJV had no copyright, but the NIV did. I also reflected how I truly began to grow and change in my walk with God, and retain his word better, when I switched to the KJV. This is because it's like a true letter from God, in his own words; the other versions are like if a friend rewrote God's words to you in their own words- it would miss out on his voice, the same way if someone rewrote the words to you of a letter your mother, father, child, spouse, or other loved one wrote.

I love also how they do communion services, which Scripture states how we do it as essentially a memorial for what Christ did for us, in dying on the cross for our sins; and though I do wish you had more services, I realize maybe the pastor himself wants to receive spiritual nourishment by visiting other churches on Sunday or Wednesday evening. I'm also thankful they have a prayer ministry here, and people can anonymously submit prayer requests for themselves or their loved ones, so they can get help while also maintaining privacy.

So all in all, I see a lot of good in this church, and enjoy coming- and I feel safe here. Just make sure you are sober and watch for the coming of Christ, because I have seen now two people claim to be God in America alone; and while I was abroad, I heard rumor of others in other countries doing the same, as well as others claiming to be angels. I couldn’t recommend Faithbridge church enough. I started coming around May of 2023 and it has been and will forever be my church home even as I move to college. I’ve gotten close with almost half of the staff now and have even been able to serve with some of them and they are the most loving and supportive people who just want the best for you as a person. I watch every single one of them work hard to make not only Sunday services but LIFE in community something that’s inviting, loving, and safe for everyone. There is a life group, class, and space for everyone of every walk, age, and need at Faithbridge and they are always diligently working to improve. I have never felt more loved by Christ and by people than I have since joining this amazing community and now I have lifelong family. My siblings love kids ministry, my friends love Young Adults, and my parents enjoyed Easter Sunday service. If you can attend at least one service I highly encourage it! Praise God  My first introduction to Faithbridge Church was for Christmas with my mother about 7 years ago. It was a beautiful experience with lovely decorations, food, friendly people and a great Christmas message. Since then, my family started attending regularly, joining Bible study and other activities. After returning from Australia, I came again for Christmas and was happy to find the same love and warmth I experienced the first time. The pastor even played piano in the lobby. It was such a joyful and uplifting vibe. Very well organized!

I love the community at Faith bridge Church. Always greeted with friendly smiles that lifts my spirits when I arrive. Always feel welcomed with a great message to strengthen my faith.

The women's bible study has also been very well organized, made me feel welcome, accepted. The food and snacks are always beautiful. Come away feeling really nurtured and cared for. I feel the Christian spirit is alive and well. I went there for a baptism and at ,76 it was my first experience to see at least 20 people baptized at the same time it was very organized and very spiritual and I totally enjoyed the experience

name: FaithBridge Church
reviewSummary:
When I was looking for a church for my young family, I had three non-negotiables:

1. It had to be a Bible-believing church that doesn’t water down Scripture or shy away from the truth, especially on difficult subjects.

2. There needed to be opportunities to serve, use your gifts, and get your hands dirty.

3. Most importantly, the senior pastor needed to be not just a godly man or a good role model, but a man I would follow into battle.

FaithBridge Church met all those criteria when my family joined nearly ten years ago, and it still does today. What has stood out just as much over the years is how much people genuinely care about each other. I’ve seen over and over again that when there is a need, people step up quietly and sacrificially.

There is a lot happening behind the scenes that you may not pick up on if you only visit on Sunday mornings. Most of our members are actively involved in weekly discipleship groups and various community service projects. Even as a relatively small church, there’s a consistent focus on missions, church planting, and supporting local ministries. We often say we’re a “sending church,” so don’t get too comfortable!

It’s hard to capture everything in a review, but my family has been blessed to call FaithBridge home. If you’re looking for a church in the Manchester area, I’d encourage you to come visit a couple of times. We found our church family 3+ ish yrs ago. I wish we had found it sooner, when our 3 were toddlers, or when our Kendall girl was here with us on earth.
I like to believe she guided me to FaithBridge.
My favorite is the Worshipping. And all the extra events put on for the community. And I actually look forward to going to church.
Everyone is so welcoming, and helpful, trying to help with our 3. They love them like their own and I am so thankful to belong to such a welcoming and loving community  I enjoyed visiting. The people were very friendly and I felt very welcomed. The coffee was good. The music and preaching were great. Lots of happy kids running around. I appreciate the family atmosphere. We’ve been attending faith bridge for a while, we love the community, how friendly everyone is and how welcome our kids feel. It’s home ❤️ I have been attending since 1999.  The atmosphere is homey and like family.  There is no flash or glitz, no major pop culture themes...just The Word preached with love and some humor.  All child-care workers are screened and CAPP-trained.

name: Faithlife Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
This church community has been such a game changer in my walk with the Lord. The people are kind friendly, and genuinely do life together. The discipleship at this church is intentional, and biblically sound. So thankful for this church and its people. Couldn’t recommend it more. Faithlife Church is a vibrant, welcoming, and deeply connected community where faith truly comes to life. From the moment you arrive, you can feel the love, energy, and purpose that flow through every part of this church.
The worship is powerful and spirit-led, the teaching is biblically sound and incredibly relevant, and the atmosphere is full of hope and joy. Every message encourages you to grow spiritually and live out your faith in practical, meaningful ways.
What makes Faithlife Church stand out is its heart for people. Whether it’s through local outreach, youth programs, small groups, or simply being there for each other, this church lives out the message of Jesus in everyday life. It’s a place where everyone, no matter their background or season of life, can find belonging, support, and purpose.
There’s something special happening at Faithlife. It’s not just about Sunday services, it’s about building relationships, impacting the community, and being part of a church that truly lives by faith and love. This church has changed my life! Great community, close knit family feel. Love the House young adults group and Rooted youth group, welcoming and warm environment to grow with one another and most importantly your relationship with Jesus. This is truly a spirit filled church. This is the first spirit filled church I have ever attended and you certainly know you have been to church after you have been to this church.  Our Pastor and his family are wonderful.   I have been a member of this church for 13 years and have been blessed in so many ways. Come join us.  You will love it. This church has questionable theology and preaches out of a paraphrased Bible "translation". The music is SO loud, it's uncomfortable. They bribe the kids with video games and candy. And if that is not bad enough, when we visited for the 3rd time, the pastor's wife told me my kids were not welcome in the sanctuary because they are a distraction, and that I should sit in the nursery with them if they won't stay alone. They "love kids" if they don't actually have to see them. So if you want a church with half truth preaching and anti-family culture, this is the place for you!

name: FaithWay Baptist Church - Evansville Campus
reviewSummary:
What a great church! We recently visited and were welcomed by the pastor personally and he was super kind to our family. Since then I have personally counseled with the pastor and have found him to be wise beyond his years. He’s a second generation pastor at this church, but it’s obvious he has the call of God on his life and not “mama-papa called”.

Secondly, my recently married daughter and son-in-law stopped in on their way through town and received the same welcoming experience. They were thankful for their time spent their and the thoughtful, biblically sound advice they received.

It’s rare to find a church with first class music and a place where each family member has a class or an activity where they can jump in and be like family.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟from this fam! Very friendly church! Sound Bible teaching! The Pastor visited us at home to check up on us and talked about coming back and if we had any concerns! Liked that very much. Most Pastors don't take the time to do that!! We will keep going there! I’ve recently discovered 93.1 FM Christian Radio. Thank God for such a blessing!
I know that the preaching of Faithway Baptist Church is a reflection of the music on their radio station and vise-versa.
It’s obvious to me that the hand of God is on this ministry!  I highly recommend these ministries to anyone searching for a solid, Bible-believing foundation in a church. Very beautiful facility.. sanctuary was done in a very comfortable atmosphere! Great location right off of 3635 Pollock Avenue in Evansville Indiana! The pastor stuck well with the word of God, while  preaching! My church. The people are absolutely wonderful@! Pastor Russ delivers a message while engaging is with his speaking ability. This is a church full of Holy Spirit and a house of blessings! Everyone is welcome and come as you are!

reviewSummary: I’m a FCCI church member. It is my joy to serve God  in this church. Youth are super active and living for God.

There is so much heart.  They have also allowed me to serve according to my gifts and talents.  Serving brings a huge blessing every time I'm given the opportunity. What a great place. Pastor Lance is a great asset to the whole community. It's a bit hidden with the entrance at the towards the back street side of the business building complex. The guest pastor who preached had a strong message. Wish we were in town longer to return and hear the word from the lead pastor. Keep up the strong work. Praise God for allowing Pastor Bob to use him to spread his word he teaches straight from the Bible and breaks it down where you can understand. Praying for God to continue to bless this church with much Abundance in the name of Jesus. This has been the best church by far. reviewSummary:
These people are some of the best in the world. They are certainly doing God's work as instructed in the Bible, you should read it, well worth your time! This church is fabulous. It is exactly what I have been searching for. Come as you are....if you want to dress up, okay. If you feel like getting spiritually stronger in jeans, that's cool too. You can literally feel God's energy through the assistant pastor who preached last week. GOING tomorrow to listen again. I love ❤️ their music too before and after the sermon. They also volunteer their services through their awesome food pantry, which is held on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of every month. 8am-10am. Truly we were BLESSED TO COME HERE THANK YOU  😊 🙏 I wasn't sure when the Food Bank was. I finally found out its still on the 1st & 3rd Saturday, from 8-10am.

Wherever we saw it listed on Thursday is NOT CORRECT.

This is a great food bank. I bring my elderly friend here once a month. It really helps her out, since she can't drive anymore. The food they give out is really good. It helps when you're on a fixed income and the price of food has gone up so much. Thank you so much for what you do for the community. God bless you. Real deal preaching, truth, no neo-liberal "church" doctrine, Bible based church. Very welcoming, our daughter loves the kids ministry and we have been welcomed warmly every time we have been. Both the pastor and the associate pastor present a fiery sermon that both engage, as well as challenge the congregation. "Family" is the right name, because that's how you feel when you are here. If you are looking for a place to grow in you faith, look no further than Family Church.

name: Family Church Downtown - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Super thankful to call these amazing family of God my church family!!! They have something for all ages and all stages of life at first it was a bit rocky but once I got to learn more about the foundation of the church and what they are about God really laid it on my heart to not only attend the church but to serve this amazing church and spread the gospel of Jesus to our neighbors and each part of the serving team whether it be on Sunday mornings or Thursday nights all come together as one and I would Highly recommend this church to everyone super Thankful and blessed for this church!! Let the record show: I am writing this review to inform, not to attack.

In June 2025, I reported a sexual assault by a member of Family Church Young Adults. From the beginning, my experience has been deeply disappointing. Instead of pastoral care, I was met with disbelief, spiritual manipulation, and attempts to silence me “for the sake of unity.” I was told that if I spoke out, I would be causing division in the body of Christ.

No one from leadership consistently walked alongside me, checked on my well-being, or provided meaningful protection (as they are trained and obligated to do). At one point, I was even pressured to meet face-to-face with my perpetrator to “hash things out” and “get to the bottom of the truth,” because “it was possible that I had misunderstood the whole situation.” This was neither safe nor biblical.

The church also allowed my perpetrator to attend our co-ed overnight Young Adults retreat, despite my expressed concerns and discomfort. When I continued to raise concerns and finally went public after three months of isolation, I was removed and banned from fellowship—told not to attend church gatherings at any Family Church location, or I would be trespassed and arrested on sight.

Leadership even attempted to criminally charge me for exercising my constitutional right to speak out online. Family Church went so far as to post police outside a Tuesday night Bible study. The West Palm Beach Police Department confirmed the church had no case against me. However, these extreme actions have now drawn further scrutiny and launched a larger investigation into the church’s handling of abuse.

Scripture is clear:
“Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them” (Ephesians 5:11). Unity is never built by covering sin; it is built on truth and accountability.

I am now working with law enforcement and legal counsel because what I experienced at Family Church was not only a failure of leadership but also potentially a violation of victim protection rights. This is not about one individual’s sin but about how leadership chooses to handle serious allegations.

If you are considering attending here, please know: churches should be safe places where victims are believed, protected, and shepherded with care. Sadly, that was not my experience at Family Church—nor has it been the experience of others, who are now coming forward because of my bold stance.

I pray they choose repentance, transparency, and true biblical accountability moving forward.
But until then, prospective members should ask: What are they hiding? And how many others have been silenced? Horrible experience 😪 I walked in wanting to hear the word of God not be judged for being homeless or treated as if I was trying to steal something or what she tell me we don't feed or hand out food ok I didn't ask for anything all I asked was how do I get inside and even then she acted like she didn't want me to go in whole time talking to me like I'm dumb just very judgemental yes I'm going thru a rough season and the only food I wanted was god's word. Anyways never going back there i feel worse than when I walked thru the door. I just moved to the area and tried this church out a couple of times. Though this church may not be for me, I encourage anyone who feels led to, to give it a try. This is just my perspective and my own personal experience, so please take my reasoning listed below with a grain of salt

Worship: The music team is so talented, but at times, it could feel more performance based geared toward streaming than a space for the congregation to truly engage with God. The volume and presentation (lots of lights )  sometimes distracted from the heart of worship. But we are living in different times and a lot of churches are like this nowadays, so it's understandable.

Community: The people are friendly and engaging! I did reach out twice via the website to see about a particular small group and see if spots were available, but i never heard back. It could be that the website isn't working properly, but i did receive emails from the church about other things, so maybe they were just really busy!!!

Financial Talk: I completely understand churches need to be transparent about giving, but there were moments when it felt like  financially heavy discussions, but it could have just been the theme for that service. (I went to this church 7 times)

Sermons: The teaching was biblical, but It could feel a little shallow. For example when addressing a message on temptation in corinthians, the example used was "eating too much ice cream" while entirely relatable it felt like the messages would often times avoid addressing deeper real life struggles with sin that adults may wrestle with. I was hoping for more substance and depth, but like I said, maybe it was an off service, too.

Political and personal focus: some services where the message centered around political figures instead of christ felt a little off to me while it's appropriate to talk about current events.  I can understand bring up some things especially in light of recent events, But often time the events felt cherry picked over which ones were actually relevant and it felt more like political commentary and the politization of Christianity.

I will say however  whoever gave the sermon last Sunday about the "main thing is the main thing:  was a phenomenal speaker.

Needless to say, im glad I tried this church out, I will be moving on, but I sincerely wish them the best of luck out there and encourage them to keep it up! Inspired messages with focus on family and children. Something for everyone! Great musicians!

name: Family Church PC - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited numerous churches when we first moved to the area. We kept coming back to Family Church. You will find
Wonderful expositional sermons from Pastor Jim, an awesome worship team, family groups for every one, an excellent children’s ministry and even our school , Family Christian Academy.  Oh, you will also find lots of new people to call family. Please come visit us! The first time we visited Family Church we were warmly greeted.  Upon attending services we discovered that Pastor McCarty and the family groups (Sunday school) teach the whole Bible with accuracy and in a way that's easy to understand.  The friendliness and truth have continued for the entire 19 years we've been attending.  The music is uplifting.  It's a great church for every age with different ministries for children, young adults, seniors, widows, and many others. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The moment I walked into Family Church, I felt the presence of God in a real and powerful way. The worship is filled with genuine praise, the sermons are rooted in truth, and the people welcome you like family. This church isn’t just a building it’s a home where faith grows, hearts heal, and lives change. Every message speaks directly to your spirit, reminding you that God’s love is alive and active. If you’re searching for a place to belong, to grow closer to Christ, and to walk in purpose this is it. I have grown spiritually, there are Family Groups for everyone,  they take you in and you feel like you have come home. Each Service is up lifting and touches your heart

name: Family Church Village - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:

The members of this church make you feel comfortable and valued, creating a sense of belonging that is rare and special. The love, support, and encouragement shown here reflect the true spirit of faith and community. It is not just a place of worship, but a place where people connect, grow, and feel at home. My place of worship,I love learning and worshipping with pastor Kevin Smith he makes you feel like home along with his story times Teaching vs Preaching! Please teach the youth to be kind and welcoming to others. Though I am Presbyterian by conviction, this group of churches function more as I would say God designed. Hence the name Family Church! name: Family of Christ Lutheran Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful congregation with great leadership - not perfect, as no person or organization is - but they seek to do things well and right, always putting Jesus first and lifting high the cross.  FOC has wonderful programs for women, men, children, & students as well as many ways to reach out with Stephen Ministry, helping people in need, supporting local and global need and ministry organizations. We have been attending church here since we moved to the springs and both our children have gone to daycare here. Wonderful community with a lot of outreach opportunity. The worship team has always been great and the messages are focused and applicable. A very friendly congregation with a nice worship space. Love the donuts and coffee after service.

The Church also has a Child Development Center (CDC) onsite, so weekdays are ran like a school unless an appointment is setup with church staff (who are very caring and nice). I LOVE IT. PASTOR IS GREAT. BEAUTFIAL HYMNS FREIDNLY COMUNITY. MORE EASY TO UNDERSTAND. CHILDRENS MESSAGE IS GREAT LOTS OF FUN CLUBS AND GOOD DONUTS AMEN. Our family started attending Family of Christ 6 years ago. Pastor Moreno has been a true blessing to our family. He leads the church with Christ centered preaching, a loving heart for our community and a desire to strengthen all of us to share the Gospel. He is also a Navy Chaplain which gives him the skills to support our Military. Our Associate Pastor Moon brings a fresh approach and connection with younger families. Whether you are a family with young kids, older kids; or you are a grandparent; we have a space for everyone. Men's groups, women's groups happen weekly and many seasonal activities are planned. Everyone can get plugged in a ministry. We are incredibly thankful for our Family of Christ family.

name: Family of Christ Lutheran Church and School - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: We are so happy our family found FOC and made it our church. We have enjoyed Worship w Pastor Landon and our kids love Sunday school. The church staff is so friendly and welcoming, and everyone makes you part of the family! Highly recommend to anyone looking for their church home. We love Family of Christ Church.  It is a warm and friendly environment with members of all ages.  Our 5 year daughter loves attending the Kidz Praise group for ages VPK-5th grade on Wednesday evenings.  We have made great friends and enjoy working together on special events and projects that involve our church and school family, as well as the community.  Everyone is welcome there. We have been members of Family of Christ Lutheran Church for 7 years now.  We can't imagine going to another church!  We have enjoyed all 3 services; Saturday night, & the 2 on Sundays.  We normally go to the contemporary service.  The church has plenty of activities for all ages and you can be as involved as you would like. Family Of Christ Lutheran Church is wounderful place! The pastor's and people who attended this church are wonderful and kind! They have children's programs for all ages. They also have programs for adults and senior citizens! My family has attended Family of Christ Lutheran Church since my eldest daughter was 4 years old she is now almost 12 years old!  So in total we have been coming here for 8 years! They also have a nursery to take care of infants and children ages up to 3 and a half 4 year olds go to Sunday school. Over the years it has changed a lot but the main focus is family and community! They serve homeless on Thursdays at 6pm. their services are Saturday 6pm and Sunday 9:15am and 10:45am they also do a Spanish service and have Tamil. As well as a West Campus. Also they have school from kindergarten through 8th grade and a child care center on the premises. My son has been a regular at Family of Christ after school care and summer program for 5 years now. He will be in 4th grade. I have never felt more like family anywhere else. They treat my 9 year old son like gold and he considers them family as well. Hands down the best child care I've ever found for my little one.

name: Family of Christ Lutheran Church, LCMS Ahwatukee - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: No other church in Ahwatukee will make you feel more welcome and a part of the family. Great daily preschool learning center and a great pastor. Best preschool in town!
