reviewSummary:
Love love love visiting this church! They make you feel so welcome. Pastor Littlefield and First Lady or truly just Fabulous!
Recommend to anyone go visit and enjoy what God has to offer. My palace of worship!! The  Apostle Greg Littlefield and our Wonderful first lady Pastor Liz Littlefield will give you the Spiritual food you need.. plz come and join us one Sunday @ 1045.. It will change your life...The most  exciting church in east Texas.. It’s all about money and it’s all about them. Not a true Bible based church. They brain wash everyone about why you have to give them all this money and they don’t talk about important sermons on real life situations. The Pastors are fake and two faced. The wife gossip and very judgmental and the Pastor is very controlling and very demanding. It’s his way(not Gods way) or the Highway. And a different highway, not the one on 271. name: Family Revival Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
July 2024 will be one year attending this church. I loved it and connected to the church from the first time I decided to attend. I totally feel the presence of our Father God in this place. I never had attended a church where it teaches you about life itself, the pastors guide you and teach you how to be at work and specially at home. I love my FRC Family. Please come and feel the LOVE! The Holy Spirit is moving in this church. I am not attending yet but watching online services. I watch last week service and I was blessed. This week again the Spanish service I didn't stop crying. The Holy Spirits presence was with the children speaking today in Spanish service. God is already preparing our up and coming leaders at a young age in the church. Praise God, they spoke from the heart with God's Holy Spirit leading them. Right when you walk through the doors you feel welcomed and part of the FAMILY! The atmosphere is amazing. Each person there gives their all to go serve and worship God with gratefulness. The Pastors and their family are the most loving and hilarious people you’ll meet. Come enjoy community and Gods love! 5 Stars!!! Because its a Place of Resorting Families!! A place where we feel his presence 🔥 and see changes in us and families! Our Pastors Adriana and Mario Alonso are the Best pastors I've ever had We they are so loving, caring, they see for your spiritual Life 🙏 and so much more! We are going on 3 years being part of this beautiful Family we call FRC! Come and join the movement! 🙌 The moment I walked into this church I knew there was something special,people greeted us like if we were members since a long time ago.
Pastor gave us the attention we needed to my family and I,my 3 kids,ages 10,9 and 7 loved the music and the classes they received.
When the service was done I felt different,my wife felt different and my kids gave us good feedback.
Awesome place!!

name: Family Worship Center - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
We traveled five days by motorhome to get to the Resurrection Camp Meeting 2026. We came expecting a great moving of God.  From the very first service, which started in full gear, then each and every service throughout in overdrive.  It exceeded our expectations. From the Spirit filled professional musicians and singers, to the anointed, Holy Ghost filled preaching. There were a lot of hungry people there, hungry for God's Word, ready to praise, ready to worship, ready to receive. We are so glad we came. It was an incredible experience and will always be remembered. Thank you Donny, Gabriel, Matthew, Tommy, Joseph, Loren, Shaun, Paris, Tim, Don. Always wanted to check out this church. I grew up listening to Jimmy Swaggert preach. Was in the area, but unfortunately not on a church night. Beautiful grounds! May God continue to bless this ministry. This is an amazing and fantastic Church. I came to visit in 2013 for the first time I ended up moving here to Baton Rouge in 2015 and had the privilege of having brother Swaggart as my Pastor until he passed away in 2025. And now his son and grandson run the church and believe me they are doing a tremendous job. I highly recommend this Church for anybody and everybody they have a great children’s program tremendous singers and the preachers are amazing. You will learn more in one year than you have learned in 20-30  years in any other Church. You can also watch on the sunlight broadcasting network or YouTube or Facebook live to broadcast 24 hours a day. First off , meeting Ms Gale the coffee inspector was a joy as was meeting Ms Loretta both in the Lobby area n very warm and welcoming.
We Met Pastor Borg while sitting in our area and he’s a genuine person.
My wife Loves SBN and I try to bring her for Easter Services from our home in Texas. The sermons were uplifting and informative. The pastors were passionate. The attendees were wonderful and seem to be getting younger and more inclusive over the past few years.
We will see you again hopefully before next Easter I just called their phone line to ask how I could live stream this Sunday to watch Guest speaker Anthony George. The gentleman whom I spoke to asked if I had ROKU. I told him no. Asked if I had cable, told him I had internet services and watch church services from there for livestream and I never watched any of their church services before. He asked again, do you have roku? I said you just asked me that and I told you NO. He then said, “I don’t like your attitude” and hung up.  How incredibly rude and not what I would expect from a true christian answering the phone lines for a church !  This was a very simple question. You either livestream from the internet or you don’t!

name: Far East Mission Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
Had a great worship and praising God Summer fun is great for people learning there languages and having fun last day real fun!
Snow cones pizza and more! Had a great worship experience here. Very friendly people, highly focused on missions One of the greatest places in Tulsa to see international people and sharing God's loves to each others. That is my church best one to

name: Faro Church Assemblies of God - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
Faro Church is a welcoming and vibrant community that truly feels like a family. The atmosphere is warm, and the congregation is made up of friendly and supportive individuals. One standout aspect of Faro Church is its Young Adults Group. The group is not only active but creates an inclusive environment where young adults can connect, grow spiritually, and support each other in their faith journey. . For anyone looking for a church that values community, spiritual growth, and active participation, Faro Church is definitely worth a visit. I love coming into church the worship is great and I can always feel the Holy Spirit of Jesus Christ in the building. The pastor's can really help you focus lince on God, brighten up our lives. God bless this church.
I love you Faro✌ The experience is awasome. You feel welcome by the congregation and the pastors. The worship and the Word are Christ centered.  This is a missionary church also. Great ministry for the children and all ages. Plus a weekly Bible study for seniors. You'll not find a more loving, devoted, genuine community of people committed to real life and top quality in serving their community. A fantastic blend of Spanish – English services that flow without hiccup or pretense. God bless His Church!  I pray that my family can bless Faro Church more than how they blessed us.  They have and are blessed/ing us and their community as a Church.

name: Father's House OC Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Approx 15 years ago I started to attend this church. I have NEVER been in a more accepting, and loving church as this one. The casual, open, and worshipful atmosphere is full of The Holy Spirit, and -the messages are relevant and quite moving. This place has the heart of God- check it out- you will be blessed and find it to be a homecoming. This church is amazing! I love all the people there and they make you feel like family! I knew after my first visit that I had found my home church! My kids love the children's ministry and I love to see their growth! Love. Life. Purpose. Learn of and experience the love of God through Jesus, celebrate the free gift of eternal life, and take that life into the world with an ordained purpose to love and bless others. That's what Father's House OC lives, teaches and celebrates with worship, fellowship, serving  and teaching in a graceful and loving family atmosphere. I've been a part of this beautiful community for over 15 years and I keep coming!  Join us!! I have always felt comfortable and safe at Father's House OC. As soon as you walk through the doors you are greeted with open arms and open minds. Pastor Tim and Pastor Matt are so gifted as pastors, speakers and worship leaders. This is my church home and my family! Visited while in town from St Louis and had a wonderful experience and encounter with the presence of the Lord. Worship was pure, not entertainment and the Senior Pastor oozed the love of the Father while ministering. Met the sweetest Jesus loving brothers and sisters in Christ. Highly recommend.

name: Fayette Family Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
Fayette Family Church is truly an incredible place to grow in faith, build authentic relationships, and experience the presence of God in a real and life-changing way. From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the love, the energy, and the spirit of excellence that flows through every part of the ministry. The worship is powerful, the Word is relevant and impactful, and the atmosphere is welcoming for people of all ages and backgrounds.

The Youth Worship experience is absolutely next level! H.Y.P.E. Nation is not just a youth ministry — it’s a movement. The services are vibrant, engaging, and culturally connected, while still being deeply rooted in the Word of God. The young people are not sitting on the sidelines — they are leading, serving, worshiping, and growing. The messages are practical, dynamic, and speak directly to what this generation is facing, and you can see the confidence and boldness being built in them week after week.

What makes it even more special is the intentional focus on community, discipleship, and creating a space where young people feel seen, heard, and valued. There is a genuine passion for developing the next generation spiritually, academically, and personally.

If you’re looking for a church that is alive, impactful, and committed to excellence — especially for your students — Fayette Family Church is the place to be. Youth Worship alone is worth the visit. It’s powerful, it’s relevant, and it’s changing lives! Our family has truly loved being part of Fayette Family Church. We started attending shortly after the pandemic when we were in search of a new church home that was diverse and also felt like somewhere I would want my children to be. From the first day we attended, everyone was extremely welcoming and genuine. I can honestly say it feels like a true family. Pastor Young is spot on with his messages that are rooted in scripture and practical for our day-to-day challenges. This church has provided a space for my teenage son to really grow in his faith as well as my younger daughter to develop Godly friendships.

What really stands out to me is the heart of the church. There is such a strong sense of community and a real desire to serve and love people. My family and I have been attending Fayette Family Church now for 5 years and we love it. The people are genuinely friendly and want you to grow. The Pastor is excellent and always seems to have a word that seems just for you when you hear it. The youth ministry is exciting and engaging and my son wants to go and learn more about Christ. The church family is from various backgrounds and ethnicities which is a good reflection of how Heaven is going to look when we get there... My family and I appreciate the acceptance and generosity and I'm sure you will too!!!  See you at service soon!!! I've walked into many buildings on Sunday morning that are called "church". I wasn't until walking into this building did I truly understand; it's not the building, it's the people. When you walk in, expressions like "warm welcome" or "make yourself at home" make sense.

My family and I were immediately greeted at the door and guided through the church, not just told where to go. It seemed as though it was one large family as I walked through the foyer. Before I could make it into the sanctuary, several members greeted me with a handshake and a smile.

It's been a little over a year ago since this first interaction. Since then, I walk into this building every Sunday to know God a little more, find purpose in doing His will, and connecting with the people that showed me such love and hospitality as a guest. The building is great, but the people are the church! It is this church that makes a difference. I started going to this church about three months ago. I kept passing by it and decided to pop in one Sunday. I was immediately welcomed with warm welcome arms, followed up by a genuine service.

I tend to be a very reserved person when I first attend places especially when I come alone so it was nice to be acknowledged but also slip off peacefully into my own little space on a row.

The church is clean, everyone is friendly, they offer breakfast and it’s a great place for all ages. It was also very important for me that the messages are Holy Spirit led. If you a looking for a place that’s treats you like a (Christ-centered) family it is just that!

name: Fayetteville Christian Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to the Fayetteville Church for a blood drive.  I scheduled an appointment early, verified with my donor card. Done a little over an hour,  and off to my next project.
One can save time if you completed the rapid pass. The group then asks about five questions,  do the vitals, if all checks out you sign your name so the process can begin.
This Church is less than five minutes crom my house.  Thankful l was able to donate for a need. The Fayette Samaritan are an absolutely wonderful group and have helped me and anyone I’ve referred! They have never made me feel bad or uncomfortable !This is a Christian organization and some of the finest people I’ve ever met! God bless them! Christopher Slade If your a fayette county resident this is a great place for family services like, food, clothing, rent assistance, and things of that mature.
I've been dealing with this organization for many years now and would suggest anyone in need to pay them a visit or call and see if they can help. Goid Samaritan help with utilities, clothes food. Nice people. I have come across one that made me cry how he said things Been going there off and on for four to five years last few Services have just been plain weird don't believe a church should have to pay a consulting firm to raise membership but I'll be praying for them

name: Fayetteville Church of Christ - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has a lot to offer to both its members and visitors alike. While my feelings have changed since my initial reviews, I still encourage anyone interested in attending FCC to do so.

Safrina People are humble, friendly, Bible centered students.  The Church is focused on following the Bible.  The members are involved in College Bible classes for credit.  The members examine themselves daily in order to you make sure that they are obeying God.  They believe what Jesus said, "If you love me, you will keep my commandments."  The simplicity and pure worship is evidenced in all that they do. Loving caring disciples of Christ! If you want to understand the scriptures this is the place to worship… Loving and supportive church family...the epitome of the church found in the New Testament. Great people who truly care and understand the meaning of love.

name: FBC Davis - Davis Campus
reviewSummary: Great congregation! Very friendly, accepting, inclusive and caring staff. Fun events and activities for members to socialize and interact with each other. Great sermons that are relevant to what's going on in the world and are relatable and useful for every day application. In my times visiting FBC as a newcomer, I've been quite impressed at how welcoming people have been. The community seems to be strong in the basic, but important acts of welcome: remembering my name, what I do, and connecting me with others in the congregation who have similar interests. I've not been around long enough yet to see how deeply that inclination goes, but even these basics make it easier being a visitor. Definitely worth getting to know this community. FBC is a community tailored by the love of Christ. We can see the care and passion for the scriptures within each ministry’s department. It’s been only three months since my family and I started attending the services, and even though we come from Brazil, we didn’t feel much difference from the church we used to attend for the last 15 years back in our country. I guess this is what defines the body of Christ: regardless of cultural differences, as the language of Jesus is love, this love is the same anywhere, and this is what makes us bond. I recommend FBC for its inclusive and respectful environment, but above all, for its bible centered view and teachings. FBC Davis is a great church to worship! The worship sessions are highly uplifting. The sermons are awesome. My family and I call this place our Home Church. I'm glad we could connect with this amazing community of God's people. Whether you are new to the Christian faith, still searching to understand it, or have practiced your faith for years, FBC is a welcoming home church in which to continue your journey. I have been worshiping, learning, and making friends at FBC for about 14 years. Like any family, we have our struggles from time to time, but I have come to respect the leadership at this church in how they guide us all to continue to grow in our relationship with God and one another. I highly recommend visiting and/or making this church your home church.

name: FBCScottsdale - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
The first time I attended a Sunday service at FBCScottsdale, I was impressed. The service was super cool! Anyway, I always attend the Contemporary service now at this church. I like the people here who welcome me with their kindness. As an international student who will live in the U.S. for a year, the people at FBCScottsdale help me a lot to make me feel like home. The pastors are marvelous, the worship team is outstanding, the tech team is fantastic, the grow groups are stunning, and the youth ministry and kids ministry are gracious! Besides, there are a lot of fun activities every week and month. I love this church! If you visit Scottsdale or live around Scottsdale, Tempe and Phoenix, I suggest you to come and join us worship God here. God bless you! I have really enjoyed the past two Sunday services and plan to return next Sunday!! The sermons were very good and helpful. The worship music was really great!! There is a potluck barbecue after church, 10/26/25!
Do come worship here!! 💕💕💕 *Welcomes diversity and people from all walks of life!*

My family has absolutely loved attending this church! The people are so welcoming. Pastor Jim is a great pastor and gives a solid sermon. The worship is amazing. And my kids have enjoyed their children’s program. If you’re looking for a new home church, come check it out! There are many opportunities to get plugged in, groups for young adults, moms, families - all are welcome! I’m so thankful to have found this church! First Baptist Church of Scottsdale, nestled in the heart of Old Town, is a true gem for those seeking authentic fellowship and spiritual grounding. Unlike so many popular mega churches, this mid-sized welcoming community fosters genuine connections, ensuring everyone feels valued and seen. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, rooted in love, faith, and meaningful relationships. Whether you're looking for a place to grow spiritually or simply seeking a community that truly cares, this church offers a space where you can belong and matter. Highly recommended for anyone searching for a faith-driven, Christ-centered, authentic experience. nice people

name: FCCHB - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Stephen Pate gives wonderful sermons. His enthusiasm, humor and ease in delivering God's message is refreshing. 2 years sgo, I left fcchb as I tired from the previous pastor whom resigned for other endeavors. I wish him well. Having attended fcchb for a few weeks now, I like fcchb's newness. Newly remodeled sanctuary and music sermon are very nice too. Blessings to fcchb.

I suggest next step volunteers that see new  people walk up to them and say hello and introduce themselves. Hello, I do not recognize you. Are you new to FCC? I sat in coffee area and do not know anyone. Just a thought. Not bad of a church. They can do better with more initiative rather do some work get connected. Sermon is good overall here with water & nice space. Typical experience for me even on application. My first time at their drive thru food bank. I am so impressed at how organized and amazing everyone is. Truly blessed and grateful for the  assistance and each person that volunteers.. thank you. I have been active at FCC since 2020.  In a time of growing division, they have kept the focus on Jesus and experiencing his grace and purpose.  FCC has many ways to get involved, grow your faith, and support the community.  I was new to my faith when i joined and always felt welcome.  I love this church and invite you to come check it out. I just love how our church really practices what it preaches. Loving kindness to all. I love how it gives back to the community in so many ways from our food pantry to our Nativity Christmas event and so much more. The Sunday messages are thought provoking and really push you to be more like Jesus. It has lots of ways to get involved and lots of stuff for kids young and old. Happy member for 15 years and 2 blossoming, public school educated, young adults walking in the Word.

Pastor Stephen Pate gives wonderful sermons. His enthusiasm, humor and ease in delivering God's message is refreshing. 2 years sgo, I left fcchb as I tired from the previous pastor whom resigned for other endeavors. I wish him well. Having attended fcchb for a few weeks now, I like fcchb's newness. Newly remodeled sanctuary and music sermon are very nice too. Blessings to fcchb.

I suggest next step volunteers that see new  people walk up to them and say hello and introduce themselves. Hello, I do not recognize you. Are you new to FCC? I sat in coffee area and do not know anyone. Just a thought. Not bad of a church. They can do better with more initiative rather do some work get connected. Sermon is good overall here with water & nice space. Typical experience for me even on application. My first time at their drive thru food bank. I am so impressed at how organized and amazing everyone is. Truly blessed and grateful for the  assistance and each person that volunteers.. thank you. I have been active at FCC since 2020.  In a time of growing division, they have kept the focus on Jesus and experiencing his grace and purpose.  FCC has many ways to get involved, grow your faith, and support the community.  I was new to my faith when i joined and always felt welcome.  I love this church and invite you to come check it out. I just love how our church really practices what it preaches. Loving kindness to all. I love how it gives back to the community in so many ways from our food pantry to our Nativity Christmas event and so much more. The Sunday messages are thought provoking and really push you to be more like Jesus. It has lots of ways to get involved and lots of stuff for kids young and old. Happy member for 15 years and 2 blossoming, public school educated, young adults walking in the Word.

name: Fearless OC Church - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is for sure the real thing when it comes to community, family and involvement!
From the amazing sermons to their fantastic coffee, their amazing welcoming team and super energetic kidz team!
My wife and I absolutely love the this church!
And our glad we made the move to OC to be apart of it! Absolutely incredible church! Could not ask for a more incredible welcoming team and Pastor. Super convenient parking. Amazing kids ministry. If you are looking for a vibrant, new, passionate church that also has great espresso coffee then this is the place for you! Incredible church! you’ll feel at home and most importantly the presence of God in every second of service. An added plus there is an incredible Kids area with loving and genuine teachers! If you’re looking for a community and friends this is the place for you! There’s so much going on in the week to be a part of be loved! I stumbled on a clip of Pastor Jeremy Johnson speaking on Instagram about identity and it was filled with so much truth and encouragement I decided to dig deeper into their vision. After just a few visits to the church and spending some time with the people, I can honestly say that this is a genuinely anointed group of loving people who are so focused on serving and loving people until people ask why. My wife and I were looking for a church who was about relationship and a pastor who is a man after Gods heart and it was obvious from the first day we had found what we were looking for. Rich, Dalisha, PJ and his wife, and the rest of the family at fearless are truly caring and pure men and women of God. No gimmicks, and no personal agendas. Just honest love for God and the people around them. It’s been great to find amazing friends to do life with the best way Such an amazing church! I went on Sunday and have never felt so welcomed. They had incredible worship and the message felt like it was just for me. They even have their own coffee shop. Can’t recommend enough, I’ll be back! 😊

name: Federated Church - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful welcoming church. They have a new minister that re-writes scripture. She changes the words of Jesus to suit her personal and political narrative. I grew up in this church. It is very disturbing to see the direction it has gone.  2 Corinthians 4:2 "Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God." I've been a member of this church for many years.  I originally joined because of the dynamic ministers and the music program (I sang in the choir). The people here are so open and welcoming!  It is an open and affirming congregation... everyone is welcome.  If you're looking for a church home, come check it out! I have meetings I go to in their big room. It is a very nice place. The best Rev. Throckmorton is one in a million! Best sermons.

name: Fellowship Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I've only been here once, so far, but we were very impressed. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. The sermon was Christ based (most important) and easy to follow. We're looking for a church to call home and this seems to be the place! I found out about Fellowship Baptist Church after I had been researching online to find a solid, Biblically sound, home church for me and my family (I'm a single mom). I liked what I read (and the sermons that I heard) online and decided to visit. I was *not* disappointed! From day one everybody was so warm and friendly; the kids programs were GREAT. I never stopped going. I felt refreshed every time I left the service, and I always learned new things from the preaching. I loved the fact that the pastor wasn't afraid to talk about sin/ungodliness. It wasn't very long after I started going that I got to know Pastor Barrett, his wife Elizabeth and their kids. They're so down to earth, super-duper-approachable, and had a great sense of humor; all in all I found them to be caring people who love  The Lord. There's something to be said about a Pastor that's accessible; if you have an issue you can call him up or email him and he's always quick to respond. If you happen to be looking for a genuine, homely, *Baptist* Church I'd put FBC on the top of your list; you won't regret it.

I need to say something about the family of believers there, too. I went to FBC for several months before I decided that I wanted to officially join the Family there, but to tell you the truth I felt like I was a part of the FBC Family from my first visit. The people are so very loving and sacrificial with their time in helping everyone and anyone who needed it or wanted it. There are so many kind people willing to go out of their way to be a blessing. I'm not talking about a 'painted-face' type of Christianity, but a real genuine spirit of love and humility.

The Elders at FBC are amazing, they weren't critical or mean spirited but approachable and easy to talk to. At the same time, they (along w/the Pastor) provided strong leadership and stayed close to the scriptures as opposed to a lot of liberal entertainment driven churches.

Sadly the time came where I had to move out of state and unfortunately I could no longer attend FBC. I absolutely love my church family at Fellowship Baptist; I miss you all so much! We moved to Riverside in Jan 2002 and I did all kinds of research on different area churches, their doctrine, their mission, their history, etc.  My husband and I prayed for it to be super obvious which church God wanted us to be ministered in and the help minister too.  We ended up never checking out any other church.  It was so obvious that God wanted us here.  This church family has been such a blessing to our family all these years.  We have an awesome group of imperfect people who love Jesus and trust him as our Lord King and Savior.  We believe that God is ROYALTY, the most high king, creator of all.  Therefore, God has every right to be in charge, not us.  However, we REBELLED and are still rebelling, wanting our own selfish ways.  We needed to be RESCUED from our own destruction, which that RESCUER was Jesus Christ, who died in our place when we really deserved the punishment .  But He didn't stay dead because only He has the power over the grave and Jesus ROSE AGAIN (was RESURRECTED).  Knowing that information, you have a RESPONSIBILITY to RESPOND.  Either your reject the truth or accept it.  PIlate asked Jesus "What is truth?"  when truth was staring him in the face and he didn't even recognize it.  I hope that you realize what truth is and I hope to see you here!

P. S. - I was here when Joe was attending.  He seemed to be harboring anger and guilt from his last church that he forced a pastor to counsel a couple who was having problems, even though they didn't ask for his help and then blamed the pastor for their divorce and then tried to claim that the pastor was wrong getting paid for a book he wrote instead of donating it to the church, among so many other things, yet he can be a CPA and get paid for his work.  Very hypocritical!  His friend invited him to our church thinking that Joe had matured.  He was a great children's teacher, so I was told.  However, to be part of our ministry and use your God given talents, you must be a member.  He DESPISED that word and said membership is a cult and all other kinds of things that are said out of anger instead of love.  He claimed there is nowhere in the Bible that says the early Christian church had a membership.  The Bible also never uses the word Trinity but that doesn't mean it's not implied.  However, "we are all MEMBERS of one body" (1 Cor 12:12 & 20-22).  We are all to love our brothers and sisters in Christ.  Joe was NEVER forced to try to be a member, he just had to be a member to minister.  I can never agree with someone who's goal is to tear down a church congregation because they don't agree with his point of view.  We are to be encouragers to each other.  His family was.  Unfortunately HE was not.  He was encouraged to find a church that his family as a whole, including him, could minister.  However, that was not good enough for him.  Toward the end, his nature was sadly so angry I could barely recognize him as a follower of Christ.  I wish Joe and his family no ill will but facts are facts: This church family LOVED him but when there is a cancer you have to cut it out and purposely driving over here constantly to cause discord among fellow believers is wrong.  Joe, I still pray for you and your family.  I hope you found a church that let anyone just plug in without vetting them and caring about their congregation as a whole..  But the Bible is very clear about membership, appointing, elders, deacons, deaconesses, etc.  He and his friends that left with him could've allowed God to use their talents here but unforgiveness and anger do not a good leader make. WENT FOR A SHORT TIME AND FOUND OUT THEY TRY TO FORCE YOU INTO MEMBERSHIP VERY QUICKLY AND ARE VERY AUTHOITARIAN AND FOUND OUT THEY BELIEVE THAT IF YOU DO NOT BECOME A MEMBER YOU ARE NOT SAVED. EVEN THOUGH THEY HAVE BAPTIST IN THE NAME THE REALITY IS IT IS VERY UNBALANCED TOWARDS LEGALISM AND LEANING TO CULT LIKE BEHAVIOR. PLEASE SAVE YOUR SOUL AND SHAKE OFF THE DUST FROM YOUR SANDALS EVEN BEFORE YOU TRY IT. A SPLIT IS HAPPENING SOON! Fantastic place! Very Biblically sound, gospel centered, full of great and loving people!

name: Fellowship Baptist Church - San Bernardino Campus

name: Fellowship Bentonville - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited Fellowship for the first time while on vacation this past Lord’s Day. Although we normally worship at an independent Reformed church in Michigan, we found Fellowship’s website especially helpful as we looked for a place to worship. I appreciated that the church clearly identified its elders as biblically qualified men and supported its beliefs with numerous Scripture references. That gave me confidence that this is a congregation committed to the authority of God’s Word.

We arrived a little late and sat in the back, but we were immediately encouraged by what we experienced. The congregational singing was well led and worshipful. The pastor preached from Acts 23 and did an excellent job remaining grounded in the text, helping us understand it in its original context and drawing faithful applications for today.

Thank you for your faithful ministry. We were grateful for the opportunity to worship with you and were greatly encouraged by our visit. They should offer singles meet ups to widowed and divorced middle aged and older people, not just younger. The church has a huge opportunity to meet needs in this area. Marriage was the first institution God ordained. Why aren't they trying to specifically help in this area? Many Christians are going to the world (dating apps) to try to find a mate when the church should be equipped to help with this Loving it here. My kids are connected. Preaching/teaching is really great. Love the worship. Only negative is the traffic but it’s kind of exciting that so many are coming to hear the Truth and worship God together. So you just get over it. Truly Amazing church with great leaders.  Fellowship is a really caring place, with a place for everyone. We have loved going there for the past year or so. I hate to mention it, but the only slight negative is the parking situation due to the location on the end of a dead end street. it is a good reason to take your time and visit with many great folks after the service! We’ve been attending Fellowship Bible for 18 years and have enjoyed their preaching, Bible study groups, and community groups, as did our teens in their community groups: Biblical teaching with many opportunities as well for small group fellowship.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Brentwood Campus - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Enjoyed the contemporary worship service this morning. The sermon was great too. I attended the location in Brentwood. I like the multiple worship times. The latest one is 11:10am. Excited to go back!

Update: I’ve joined a small group Bible study class. I’ve enjoyed the young adult events too. Highly recommend. Both pastors are amazing. I love the fact that I can apply what they preach to my life. So very disappointed. We are new to the area and the entire family is so excited to find a new church family.

Not one person said hello to us or acknowledged our existence. I have never seen anything like it.

We attempted to find our way to the sanctuary through dozens of people, no one spoke to us. How can you treat people in this fashion? “Family of God”, that’s our belief. I pray that someone who does not know the Lord as their personal Savior,  receive this sort of welcome, that would be horrific.

We love you in Christ regardless. I love the personal attention that I have received at fellowship. I made a wonderful girlfriend the first service that I attended. She and I have so much in common and her children are Very well behaved and precious.  That was a godsend. Truly, a miracle that day that we both needed to meet each other and become friends.
Thank you, Fellowship Bible Of Brentwood I really don’t like to give negative feedback. When I was walking on the wide sidewalk into the building the first service was leaving. Men and women coming towards me did mot attempt to move to the right side to allow others to walk by. I ended up on the grass as I watched grown men allow a woman to get off the path so they could go by. When I entered I said hello and just got a head nod. Not a single person spoke to me while I was at this church. I have been in church my whole life. Just moved from Oregon and can’t believe how entitled folks are here especially didn’t expect it in God’s house. Very sad. I love this church. We've made so many great friends here. My 7 yo daughter loves coming. She stayed in the MDO Promiseland for several years. I love their bible studies, the teachers are amazing. I love their global missions. I also love that the people there are real! I have never felt judged and there are tons of ways to get connected. It is a big church but it feels so personable. Also love that you can watch it live when traveling. One of my favorite things is that they will do something different from time to time. So great and fun. I really enjoy that they teach out of the bible too. I learned how to actually study the bible and best of all, I actually developed a relationship with Christ here! Thankful and blessed to have found this church!

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I have visited for the past few Sunday's and have been very pleased. Everyone was extremely welcoming and warm. I sincerely believe they are running this Church for the right reasons. Nice church. Good place to take the family on sundays Great ambiance. Food leaves much to be desired. Won't stick around for long. To be replaced with a car dealership. Great teaching!  Friendly people.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Conway Campus
reviewSummary:
Happy, happy, and more happiness is what my day was like all because of such an amazing church. Firstly,  everyone was so welcoming.   From the indoor and outdoor playground, to the delicious food court, it's all perfect. There's even a smaller chapel, a living area with sofas, a fireplace, and the temperature was perfect too.  Even getting out the almost full parking lot was easy-peezy.

The music was amazing.  The singer's voices and the annointing of the Holy Spirit was like stepping into a sanctuary where all worries ceased.

The lighting was state of the art, and the transition video from the music to the sermon was a captivating, slow and easy winter scene.

The sermon was so timely for the Christmas season.  I especially enjoyed the teacher's statements about this yule tide season's being driven with both sadness and sorrow. He touched on bad things happening to good people also.  Everything clicked with real-life events.

We will be back, and we plan to bring our entire extended family.

I hope to get more information about the home meetings, children's church, and so much more. After having 3-4 different people tell me how much they loved this church, we decided to check it out. Our first experience there, the lobby staff were so welcoming, helpful on finding the children’s rooms and sign in, even though we were running late, and all had such smiling happy faces to see me. I haven’t felt that seen and welcomed in any church I’ve been to. Not that I need all the attention on me, but after my last church where we went for several months and nobody even knew you walked in the door ever, this was an amazing adjustment.

My kids RAVE about how fun the youth group and children’s church are. They were (10 & 3 when we started, now 11 & 4 and still love it!) When my kids beg me to go to church, you know something is right! My son asks me all throughout the week “Can we go to church today” and he loves the playground too! It is a super nice one. My daughter is on a youth group retreat this weekend and is having the time of her life. This is what I’ve been searching for, a place she can get childhood experiences, trips, bonds and a deeper understanding for God. I’m so happy watching her thrive here, I could cry! lol

For me, as an adult experience, the coffee bar on Sunday mornings is where I met and talked to several members who are now some of my best friends. I immediately got plugged into a home group church which I know is crucial for building relationships but even before that I’ve had so much interaction with the congregation I feel like they genuinely do care! I am honestly blown away with this churches hearts to serve our community.

This is EXACTLY what I have been searching for; a place my kids could love, an amazing youth group and children’s ministry, and a way I can get more involved in my own home town. After being here for 5 months now, I am still convinced that God led us to this church and grateful my prayers have been answered. 🥹

If you’re searching for a good church to try, give Fellowship Bible a go. It’s non denomination and leaves religion out while the Pastor does an amazing job at helping understand the Bible. He breaks things down in a way I haven’t thought of and makes me laugh. These are GOOD people and do so much for others! I’m just so happy I can be apart of it all. 🙏 If you see me walking around, say hello and I’d love to visit with you too. My family went to this church for a number of months and did not have an enjoyable experience. At first, it seemed ok, but after awhile it became apparent that the congregation had quite a few cliques in it. Unfortunately, we came to learn that if you were not in one these cliques then you were often ignored by the congregation as a whole. This weekly neglect paired with how the pastor teaches (half of each sermon is him simply quoting other pastors & biblical scholars) and the amount of self-marketing the church does caused us to leave. We are a military family new to Conway and have been struggling to find a non denominational church. We tried this church, and not one person even said hi to us or greeted us. The service was so DEAD, not one person raised their hands or even said Amen. Definitely had more of a Baptist or Church of Christ feel. I love the learning.  The Pastors really do a fantastic job of bringing the knowledge of the Old Testament into focus of what is in the New Testament that we can apply to our Christian walk with the Lord.  Praise Jesus for them.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Dalton Campus
reviewSummary: Thank you to all 3 past and present Pastor/Teachers for holding fast to the Word of God. I am blessed to have been a part of this church for 46 years. I have seen the ups, downs, valley’s and peaks. I’ve watched and I have waited and I have seen Gods blessing and goodness as we have continued to pursue Him by dividing the Word rightly. I am beyond thankful for those who lead us so well at Fellowship Bible Church. We always come out on TOP because we commit all of our ways to HIM! All praise goes to The King of Kings, Jesus Christ as we seek to honor only Him. 🙌🏻 Pastor had a great sermon this Sunday on Adoption. A very unique insight into how we are all "adopted" into God's family. Wonderful church. Only thing I didn't care for was how to pick up kid at end of service. I understand it's for safety reasons but having them behind locked doors and on another floor always made me nervous. You can't get to your kids and leave if you need to. Beautiful church, warm people, warm pastor, you will feel home here :) Talky enjoyed it, i will be going back.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Franklin Campus - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: I have felt so welcomed and blessed by this congregation from the first Sunday I attended.  The pastors are super approachable, and many in the congregation have welcomed me into their family.  I joined a small group of men that meets weekend and they've been awesome too.  Can't say enough about what a great experience I've had across the board. I just tried to go to your Tuesday night. A A meeting in there at 8 o'clock again. And it was freezing cold, just like last time. I mean, there's no reason to make the entire building freezing cold, like that.It's not good for people.And it can give people pneumonia. You're wasting a lot of money on. Electricity is extremely uncomfortable and it's no fun going in your building.And i'm not gonna go back. I appreciate Fellowship Bible Church for not only their expository preaching, but for their “so what” at the end of each message- application!  I need help in that area!  My Mom recently passed away, but we watched the service on livestream, and even though she had dementia and was 93 she loved the worship services and the preachers.  It has been such a blessing! The best worship and teaching ever in a friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Our pastors, nursery workers, musicians, coffee are wonderful. Franklin is smaller, so more cozy than Brentwood, but both pastors team teach at both locations. Try them both! My Church for more than 10 years. Superb teaching, excellent fellowship. Rob and Lloyd superbly present Scripture.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing worship, preaching, and hospitality. They really care about the Gospel and getting folks connected. As brand new members of the community this church truly made us feel welcome and at home.  We immediately felt comfortable and connected.  They also seem to really have a passion for their community and for sharing the gospel! This is the best church I have ever been to, because they truly show what it is like to be a Christ-follower.

No condemnation will be felt as you experience messages full of compassion, forgiveness, mercy, grace and amazing love. And who doesn’t need to hear a message like that nowadays? And it’s truth! ❤️

What an amazing place to attend for people with a growing family, too! When I walked in for the first time 7 months ago, I was in awe…there was a slide going from the second floor to the first, and part of the stairway area was a rock climbing place for kids. They also have a Cafe that serves all kinds of breakfast and drinks!

It IS a pretty big building, which I wasn’t sure about when we first pulled up. But the kindness of everyone I encountered from the staff and volunteers quickly eased my mind and helped me to begin to embrace the experience…

Wow!! The message was fantastic! I had to come back and hear more. Each week the message is taught by one of 4 teaching pastors, all with their own style, but every one of them speaks the Word of God and of Truth in a beautiful, Spirit-filled way.

I love this church. Please, if you are looking for a church, give this one a try! It has so much more to offer than I even could cover here. God bless you! ❤️ I'm 60 years old and this is truly one of the best places that I have been to worship God on this planet. I've lived in a couple of different countries, been to Christian churches all over the world and say that I would model this worship experience everywhere. Love, worship, hope and direction is what you will receive here. It's a great place to know and learn about Jesús Christ. Wonderful time to praise and worship him.
They are all very friendly. The atmosphere is very nice.  They have three options for congregating in the same building ... with its contemporary main room.  A Chapel for the more traditional believers and have a very cool Spanish English bilingual campus with very good preaching ... and from the pastor and his team to his members ... everyone is very loving ...
Also, children and tweens have their own space to share and play while they can sing and learn about God.  There is a very nice cafeteria to have breakfast with the family on Sunday before entering the service ...Everything is always clean and very organized ...
It was a great time in Fellowship Bible Church...
God continue to bless and use them to bless others.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Metairie Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Pastor Bill and he doesn’t even know me. I like Sandy Mac below am in Utah. where nothing close to this caliber of teaching exists. I found FBC by downloading the Truth Network Radio app and was listening to the Charlotte North Carolina station one morning. It comes on at 8 AM my time, and I look forward to it every day. I’ve been listening to him for around 6 months now. I wish there was a way for my wife to connect with Sandy Mac.  We live in North Ogden and wouldn’t it be cool if she was close to us and we could start a Bible study together? Anyway I am definitely going to start supporting this ministry financially, since I don’t have a home church here in Utah. So those of you who read this, please pray for us in Utah. We are starving for actual biblical truth to be preached without apology and gimmicks. God bless. Fellowship bible church is a small neighborhood congregation. Dr. BILL GERHARD leads us in study and worship of our Lord Jesus Christ.  Very insightful leadership in directing our personal relationship with King Jesus Christ. Great help in my daily walk repenting and changing my sinful way to accepting and following Jesus example of loving everyone in our life. I haven't been able to attend the church as I live in Utah, however, I found pastor Bil online about a year and a half ago. I know the Lord led me to this Bible believing, gospel preaching family. I live in a very rural area surrounded by LDS (mormon).  My nearest church is Pentecostal with hardly any teaching. Praise God for pastor Bill gephart and his family! Bil Gebhart is a true man of God.
Gifted pastor, absolutely true to God’s Word. He reveals the intricacies of Scripture in the most knowledgable and  practical. A true blessing.

Listen to one of Bil’s sermons online No words can convey how deeply my spiritual walk has grown under Pastor Gebhardt's teaching. Relatable, practical, Biblical TRUTH for everyday living...with the emphasis always on GRACE.  The staff at FBC are truly servants among us with a heart for preaching God's Word for the glory of His Name and to reach those still in darkness. The Lord is honored here...so blessed to be part of the FBC family.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Midtown - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I live in Texas, but visited Little Rock for a weekend getaway. We chose to attend Fellowship Bible Church, Midtown Campus, 11:00 am service on September 21, 2025.
We arrived at approximately 10:45 am and the church was bustling. My wife visited the restroom while I had some coffee, which was great. We found a seat in the sanctuary, which soon became crowded, not 100% capacity but at least 85%.
Only negative comment is that no one greeted us before the service. Not surprised because most churches think they are friendly, but not really.
Everything else was top notch, good worship music and congregation really sang and participated. They did a baby dedication that was very well done. Mark Henry preached a strong Biblical message on discipleship.
If you live in Little Rock and are looking for a church to worship, you should visit Freedom Bible Church Midtown. Always a good place to visit with a loving ❤️ family atmosphere ❤️ It's been an excellent place to be for the year that I've been here. They have, so far, been incredible at preaching the whole Bible while not ignoring/glossing over anything said within it, which includes the hard stuff. They're true to their name and have an overabundance of opportunities to connect, especially if you're a young adult. As someone who is 25, it can be incredibly difficult to find believers my age that actually care to grow deeper in the Lord, so I was surprised to find a church that was filled to the brim with people my age that chose to let the Lord be the center of bith their morality and decision making. It was good to finally no longer be walking this walk alone.

Of course, no church is perfect, just as no person is perfect, as we are what makes the church what it is, and it is the sick that need a doctor, not the healthy. That said, in my many years of searching, this is the first church that's truly felt like home since my childhood. Hopefully, you'll feel the same, so feel free to come as you are. I started going to Midtown Fellowship with friends in the winter of 2020, and it’s made for many good experience and memories. As a young, new college graduate in a new city, FBC Midtown was very welcoming especially with its’ young adult focus and community. Undefiled  religion is helping the poor and needy my family will find a church for the heart of jesus to share God's love by giving and helping the comunity this is a buisness establishment making money in the name of Jesus is just wrong  I would not bother giving tithes to this church because if your ever in need  in life don't think for a minute they are going to care nor be concerned about any need you have God Bless stay away is all about money not the heart ❤ of Jesus

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary:
Every Sunday I experience Jesus through the YouTube channel. I’m so grateful to have been led by the Holy Spirit to Fellowship. Pastor Cook and the Team are wonderful people to walk this journey with. Keep Moving Forward. Writing to you from St Petersburg Florida. Peace. My family started attending Fellowship in 2024, and it has been an amazing experience for us. As a biracial family, we have been praying for a diverse church for a long time. It can feel a little overwhelming (that’s trying any new church) but we quickly saw how welcoming everyone really is. The children, student, and special needs programs are hands down some of the best I’ve ever experienced. Pastor Jason not only preaches some of the best sermons I’ve heard in a long time, but he’s also a man of God leading his family and church incredibly well. The worship is a nice mixture of CCM, Gospel, Hymns, and more (I love the diversity in culture and generations). I hope if you’re looking for a place to belong, you’ll come check it out! We’ve been attending Fellowship Bible Church for about 8+ years. Crawford was SO good and we both walked out of church with a WOW.
Now, Jason brings in his love for the scriptures, his passion, entertainment & amazing explanation of the stories.
I’m so happy I can call FBC my church.
I’m working to get more involved.
Thank all of you for always being there for all of us ! My family came to Fellowship Bible Church because we were looking for solid Bible teaching in a contemporary format. We have been here for 36 years, raised our children here and are now retired and serving with the Trailblazer's Community Group on Sunday mornings at 11:00 AM in room 103 (close to the sanctuary and on the first floor). We liked it so much we bought our home next door in the Greenway Hills community. We have great biblical teaching, solid ministries to our community and a relaxed contemporary culture. I recommend FBC to anyone interested. Jim M Awesome church! We watched and visited so many churches after moving to East Cobb during COVID. We even attended a few regularly, but no where quite felt like home. Then we found Fellowship and it's been such a blessing to our family. The community is multigenerational, diverse and welcoming. The worship is authentic and they give all the glory to God. Preaching and teaching is powerful and rich. Just a really great place to call home.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary:
To have a church of this Biblical caliber in our area is a massive blessing.  Pastor uses ONLY the Word of God with amazing ability--- partly learned from Masters Seminary and sitting under John MacArthur.  We are a true family, no matter our age or income level.  I want to give THE strongest positives possible.  HERE is where you can really hear truth and be welcomed no matter who you are Attended with my family since summer 1999.
Genuine caring people. True to the Bible message. Best place for healing The pastor does a great job of explaining the Bible. One can learn a lot. People are very compassionate good church to grow your faith.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Tacoma
reviewSummary:
I have gone to Fellowship Bible Church my entire life, and I hope I'm blessed to get to be there for the rest. The preaching is incredible. This church has been blessed with pastors who teach directly from the Bible with engagement and depth like I've not seen at any other church I've visited. The worship is wonderful, an excellent mix of modern worship songs and hymns. They have greeters at the door, and hosts to make sure that no one is left unnoticed or unwelcomed. Their children's ministries are thriving and vibrant, and include nursery care, Sunday school classes for all ages,  and a great youth group for teens and tweens, with lots of opportunities for extra activities for those kids. They encourage community engagement through a number of opportunities, including an annual community festival, an annual free vacation Bible school, and sponsoring opportunities for homeless individuals trying to get their lives back on track. They sponsor and fund ongoing missions in Liberia, Turkey, and Nicaragua, among others. They offer so many resources for those who attend, including weekly Bible studies, home groups, and free classes on varying topics. The people here are genuinely kind, welcoming, and love the Lord so evidently and deeply. I truly can't say enough good things about this congregation, the people of whom it's composed, and the leadership who, under God, continues faithfully to guide this church as it grows and thrives. Absolutely loved it here.

They made me feel as if this was my home. Their youth group is outstanding, all the leaders are super caring and supportive. When I was new, and standing in a corner alone afraid to talk to anyone, a leader or another student would always come up to me and invite me to play a game or just simply talk with me. Sometimes you just need that push, literally. (Shout out to Makayla.)

The pastor always had great messages to deliver, and questions for us to answer or ponder on. Small groups were always great, and we had amazing discussions each time.

Not only have I grown in my relationship with Christ here, but I have grown in my relationships with other kids and adults that attend here. A big thanks to you all!

10/10 would recommend this place to everybody wanting to take their relationship with God to the next level, or get started in growing one. Not only that, but to people who are even just the slightest bit curious about the "whole thing."

I'll never forget the time I spent here, and thank you guys so much for helping me to feel so loved and cared for.

-A fellow student If you desire a place where you can get involved, grow, and serve alongside other believers who will encourage you in your relationship with the Lord, FBC will be an excellent place for you! I have been attending this church for 30 years now, and my love, value, and respect for this family of Christ has only deepened the longer that I have been there. If you see me, come say hello! I would love to meet you and hear your story. I'm somewhat new to this church and I'm enjoying it a lot. The music isn't straight out of 'The Preacher's Wife' but the sermons are awesome. My baby loves the play room and my pre-teens fellowship with us in adult church - also awesome. This type of church is the kind that any family could blend right into and that's exactly what we were looking for. This Church is a community of believers that have a strong emphasis on solid theological teaching, while at the same time, focus on family and children. The pastors love the Lord and base their teaching, and lives, on the Word of God.

name: Fellowship Bible Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
I enjoy worshipping at Fellowship. The people are friendly, the pastors do an excellent job of expository teaching, and I love that there are several ways in which we serve the community together. They helped me when I had nothing i love these people so much especially the women in the office have my heart ❤️ thank you so much!!!!!!words cannot speak it enough GOD is soooo Great! I love u Our family moved to Tulsa from Phoenix, AZ last year and I was looking for a church home for not long until I kept passing Fellowship Bible Church and I felt called to attend this church out of the hundreds that are around. It astounds me how many churches there are which I love! I thank the Lord for allowing me to find Fellowship, it’s such an amazing church and everything we’re looking for, just truth from the Word of God. My personal relationship with Christ has grown so much and I have FBC to also thank God that. Thank you for being a loving, caring place where I feel welcomed and loved as the Lord would as well. 🙏🏻❤️✝️💕💐⛪️ We visited this church in 1994 and it was visitor hostile.  We tried again in 2015 and it was a completely different place.  The people are warm and inviting.  The messages are Biblical and relevant.  The focus of the church has turned outward.  They are more and more committed to engaging and serving the community in a way that honors and glorifies the Lord and honors and shares the gospel. I have been looking for a church home for sometime. I actively attend services somewhere else. I came to Fellowship Bible Church on a controlled whim. I asked my children if they would be open to it? They happily encouraged the thought with eagerness as well.

Positive Note #1: I was greeted by Brad who was patient and polite and helped me with getting the children set up for Sunday School.

Positive Note #2: Brad escorted me to the sanctuary so I was not in danger of getting lost. I listened to Pastor Eric deliver his message, of which I was sorry for not getting there earlier. It was a good message.

Positive Note #3. I met Paul and Susan and Bill and Debbie who took me aside and we had a great introductory chat. Questions were answered, stories exchanged, and prayer finished it all up.

Positive Note #4. When I picked up my children they were very excited to have gone and asked if we could come again. They also recalled the Bible lesson that morning and shared it with me including comprehensive details that one only gets from being engaged.

Positive Note #5. Pastor Eric reached out to me to connect with open arms. I had a couple of questions which needed to be answered if I were to consider a return visit to Fellowship Bible Church. Pastor Eric addressed my issues with tact and consideration and void of a defensive mentality. I was struck in my heart that he understood my concern and handled it with grace, of which I truly appreciated. I was not going to FBC to feel good about going there. I went there looking for the truth and to see if the truth was being lived there. If the truth is being lived there then I will in turn attempt to pursue Christ there where I may come to know others and others may come to know my family and I.

Thank you for a beautiful introduction.

name: Fellowship Bible Church New Braunfels - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary: I learned that I had gifts that glorified God when I came here n  2019.befote that I didn't know about the gifts God gave  matter of fact I didn't even know God for myself,  in 2022 I got saved  and my husband baptized me in the paluxy y river in glen rose tx Our kids attend youth and AWANA at Fellowship and enjoy the teaching and fellowship with kids their age. The Wednesday night program has expanding with lot and lots of kids attending.  I wish we were free on Sundays as we would definitely attend here.  I really appreciate the leaders here.  Our kids feel safe and have so much fun while learning more about the Bible.  What more could we ask! Incredible church experience. Sunday school is at 9:30am, and they have one for every different age group. The service starts at 10:45am with traditional worship (only instrument is the grand piano), and solid Biblical teaching from a great pastor who truly cares for the congregation. There is also an evening service at 6pm for those who wish. Very welcoming church and lovely atmosphere. Very clean physical property as well. I highly recommend this if you're searching for a traditional home church that will become your family. Everybody helps everybody here. I have yet to attend a church service here, but I had the honor of meeting around 30 members who were students in my American Heart Association Heartsaver/AED/First Aid class via Central Texas CPR. The church members here are of all ages, welcoming, down to earth, generous, and care about one another- as a family. They quickly welcomed me into their family. I am looking forward to attending a service and I expect the service will share the same welcoming message I received when teaching them CPR. I met many church members here while teaching a CPR class. They were welcoming, a joy to be around, and are well prepared for emergency situations. Their personalities are fantastic and all of this speaks to the Church's open arms for new members. I doubt anyone who decides to try this Church would be disappointed.

name: Fellowship Bible Church of Longview, TX - Longview Campus
reviewSummary:
The facility is very nice! The partners are very friendly and welcoming! The worship leadership is incredible and make service a true joy to attend. My family and I have been attending FBC Longview for over 6 years and I simply can’t recommend them enough! We are a homeschool family of 7 and have several other homeschool family friends that attend as well. Although there are a lot of homeschool families here there is a great mix of public and private school kids as well. The youth program is the best we’ve ever seen in East Texas and helps keep our kids grounded in God’s word. If you’re looking for a new church home I encourage you to come to Fellowship Bible Church in Longview and see for yourself! A very nice church that are friendly and welcoming. The message was great. However I dont believe that they are taking COVID precautions serious enough. Hardly anyone there were wearing masks or social distancing. We are new to our neighborhood (1 year) eventhough we have lived in Longview for 19 years. Several new acquaintances / friends. Mr. & Mrs. Ben Rempel invited us to join them for Easter service at FBC. We have enjoyed the teaching and fellowship. Sunday messages are well presented by Pastor Todd Malone.
Thank you Mr. and Mrs. Rempel and FBC. A wonderful place where the people are so inviting and friendly.

Great location. They preach the truth of the Bible. You will be welcomed here and want to come back.

name: Fellowship Bible Church of Northwest Arkansas - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Fellowship Rogers. We’ve been attending for over a year now and have felt so seen and welcomed and blessed throughout the last year. Their staff and their prayer warriors have stepped in to support us tangibly during a hard season. We’ve never felt more loved at any church. It's like a college campus.
You adapt and people will tell you where things are located if you just ask them. I found the help I’d been searching for most of my life.  Recovery from my hurts, habits and hang ups literally is possible.  God has worked healing in my life through this program and I’m so grateful.  I can’t say enough good things about this program and the spirit filled people running it. Our church home from now on. Amazing youth program, the best I’ve ever seen. Our son has been a part of their student ministry for a few years now and it has been an enormous support for his spiritual and social wellbeing. The elders here are respectable and the devotion to the body of the church is soul warming. Community groups and support groups for various genres available year round. Absolutely love this church home. This church is not qualified to be called a church it speaks with storytelling and songs not sung with the spirit of the joy of the Lord

I pray for you…Awake, oh my soul, and rise with the spirit of the Lord! Let His joy fill every song and His truth guide every word.
