name: First Baptist Church of Provo
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ First Baptist Church – Provo, Utah

I visited the First Baptist Church here in Provo, and honestly, I felt like I had been dropped right back into North Carolina. The whole atmosphere had that warm, familiar Southern hospitality vibe that I grew up with. The people were welcoming, the pastor was genuine, and the spirit of the place just felt real.

What really got me was what happened after the service. They had culinary experts — actual cooks — downstairs making sure I had something to eat. They didn’t ask for anything, didn’t hint at anything, didn’t try to make it awkward. They just fed me. That’s straight-up Jesus right there. Feed the hungry, care for people, no strings attached. That’s the kind of church I’m used to, and it meant a lot.

Provo is obviously dominated by the LDS Church, and I’ve even attended a few LDS services before. The people are friendly, no doubt. But the pressure around money, tithing, and financial expectations never sat right with me — especially knowing how much wealth the institution already has. It just didn’t make sense to me personally.

Walking into First Baptist was a totally different experience. No pressure, no financial speeches, no guilt — just community, sincerity, and people who were happy to have me there. It felt like home, even though I’m far from home.

If you’re in Provo and want a place that’s genuine, humble, and welcoming, this church is worth a visit. I walked in as a stranger and walked out feeling like family. I had a wonderful experience at First Baptist Church of Provo! The congregation and pastor were so welcoming and genuinely friendly. The sermon was great, and I really enjoyed it. I’ll definitely be coming back! Looking for a biblical based church who loves God and loves people well. Look no further! We moved here a little over a year ago and not only were we welcomed into this church family but we do life with this church. We have grown close with many people at this church and do extra curricular activities with them. It’s not just a gathering place once a week it’s a life changing experience. We gather on Sundays at ten but after our gathering we share a meal. We gather on Thursdays for evening programs also for all ages. Come and join us! My family and I have been members/attenders for over 3 years. We love the pastors and fellow brothers and sisters like our own family. The word given each Sunday keeps you wanting more, thirst for Gods word is quenched each week and i couldn’t ever see us leaving this church family. Love you all!! God bless Thankful for the brothers and sisters in the LORD there. In our digital world, it's "word of online"!  A student from Japan found FBC Provo online, started attending and soon confessed God's grace, trusting in Jesus alone as Savior and Lord!  It was a blessing to witness his baptism and hear his testimony. Finally realizing being a sinner, he was powerless to earn his own righteousness.
Also thankful for the past opportunities my wife and I had with this sister church sharing about our International Mission Board work during our years in Japan.

name: First Baptist Church of Raleigh - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to the clothing closet barefooted an praying they had shoes that would fit my big ol feet, an the volunteers were ready for me before I ever got into the back and had going shoes in the back that were my size, they were truly an answered prayer in my time of need. The clothing closet has a lot of options, I was focused on shoes but found a change of clothing also.
!❤️ תודה רבה
(todáh rabáh)
Thank you very much❤️!
w/gratitude, Jstn. CrazyHawk We have been members of the church for the last 3 years.  The preaching is excellent, and the staff members are wonderful.  My daughter has had many great experiences in the children's ministry.  We are grateful to have found this place and call it our church home. We have been going to FBC for years now - we have and had are kids enrolled in the Preschool program and just love it! The staff is so wonderful and caring. They give the kids snacks and a homemade lunch daily. The hours work out super well for our family's needs. We feel like for everything they do the tuition rates are also very fair and very reasonable.  We highly recommend them to all of our close friends and family looking for part-time child care. The church itself is wonderful, the sanctuary is beautiful however, the staff, in particular Rodney is not the nicest and in fact quite rude. During an event, I attended here, one of my colleagues was treated less than a person you would think that in the church others would be kind but instead I would recommend you do not host any events here. I bring all my donations here!  I love that refugees and people in need can shop here for free on Thursdays from 11-2:30.  They accept donations any time during the church office hours, which are M-F 8:30-5 and Sundays 9-12.

name: First Baptist Church of Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful Church, very friendly people. The best church! The people make you feel so welcomed and accepted! The pastor is great! I enjoy listening to the sermons. The Wednesday night dinners are really delicious too!! First Baptist in Redlands is a fresh breath of air. It makes me happy knowing there's a Baptist Church where faith and reason compliment each other, where all God's children are welcome where all means all, where men and women can serve faithfully in Christ's church, where peace and justice intersect. I am also proud of First Baptist's willingness to be ecumenical and to do interfaith outreach. The worship is thought provoking and is spiritually uplifting. Keep up the good work and God bless you, First Baptist! Plant more theologically open and accepting Baptist churches in the Inland Empire. Very beautiful church. Open and welcoming community. Wonderful place for spiritual growth and to celebrate God. Great place to Worship, friendly,family atmosphere.

name: First Baptist Church of Rock Hill - Rock Hill Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly and welcoming! Great place to worship and hear the good news of God’s grace, love, and direction for life! attended a funeral today for a friend. it was a soap service until the preacher told the filled church (300 or so) that our friend could not read! and that his deacon church group taught him to read. why in the hell was his (preacher) idea of telling the whole gather this. so sad to be a Baptist preacher today. A compassionate preacher he is not… shameful at best… I've been following Pastor Steve Hogg's YouTube devotional for the past several years. He has truly helped me in my faith walk and overall understanding of the Bible; so grateful for his instruction and guidance. On my recent visit to Rock Hill, SC from NY I decided to stop in for their 11AM service (on 6/1) and it was an absolute blessing. From the worship music to the message I enjoyed everything about it, so much so I returned on 6/8 before departing for a flight back home that evening. Nothing beats sound teaching and believers who are welcoming and kind.  I look forward to attending in the near future. May God continue to bless this church and reach those outside of its walls, as it did with me. I visit this church every year for the Steadfast Apologetics and Evangelism Conference, and have had good experiences at this church. Nice church. Just check their website as the service times may change.

name: First Baptist Church of San Luis Rey - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
First Baptist Church San Luis Rey is a welcoming, warm church community with a growing ministry and a down-home, community church feel.  The congregation is a blend of different cultural backgrounds but they are truly one in Christ.  This church has recently experienced a revival, as Chris Flores became interim pastor, and has dazzled us with some of the finest expository preaching I have ever heard.  There are lots of ways to serve in this growing ministry, from worship team, to children's ministry, to youth group (every Friday).  Worship is a blend of traditional Baptist hymnity and contemporary praise, performed with fun and joy.  This is truly a place to belong! A wonderful church, congregation, a great worship area great staff and a wonderful place to praise the Lord God Jesus Christ Amen.
Come and be welcome. Praise him! He has blessed us! The church has had it's ups and downs but mostly downs. I grew up in this church and left years ago. I don't know what it's like now. But had gone from roughly 100+ people to a couple families when I left. I left because I felt it was time for a change and still pray it grows. Great Church! Great ministry!
They Love Jesus,  their church family, and make strangers feel like  they're part of the family! Pastor Tate gives a great message. God is good.

name: First Baptist Church of Sandy Springs - Sandy Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up in this church and have returned here after many years. The community here is loving, supportive and friendly. Pastor David provides wonderful leadership, humor, theological perspective and a vision for spiritual and community growth! Highly recommend a visit or a return visit :)! We visited during the week to use the field next to the church to play football. The pastor came out and spoke with us, and you couldn't ask for a more polite or courteous man. They said anyone is welcome to use their field any time, which is great since most parks in the area fill up fast. This is a JESUS CHURCH !  We've been attending for about a year now and the Pastor, David Shivers is a genuine pastor who shares a lot of scripture and heart.   If you are looking for a good church to call home, this is it. Thi is a loving, praying church and Pastor David always has a wonderful message. Come join us Sunday at 10:30. Sunday School at 9:30. Christ centered church.
Such a wonderful church.
Everyone is warm and friendly.

name: First Baptist Church Of Savannah - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary: We were visiting Savannah.  Walking around we found First Baptist Church.  We weren't intending to attend a service but the gentleman at the door invited us in.  Impressed by the pastor's message of forgiveness. We always feel welcomed when we go here during our occasional visits to Savannah.  It's a formal service, 11:00 AM.  Program and flow of service is easy to follow with the bulletin.  Beautiful piano and organ music. Incredible tour. Can’t say enough good things about our time here. History and soul all at the same time. A must see/do in Savannah. Thank you for sharing your beautiful church and history with us! This is a wonderful Sunday service. We were welcomed by so many and the love is very real. The music director uses the pipe organ every service and that alone makes it wonderful. They love Jesus and He is exalted!! Built in 1801, it is a church that must experienced, from the people to the worship. Can't wait to return!! Very warm and friendly. The building is beautiful. The church is generous in giving space for community events.

name: First Baptist Church of Strongsville - Strongsville Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church. My husband and I recently started going to this church and everyone is very welcoming. They all truly love the Lord and bring him glory in all they do! Truly happy to be a part of this church! Great place to worship our God and Savior Jesus Christ!  It's clear that these folks really love the Lord and are serious about serving Him in unselfish and community-centered ways!  I would highly recommend anyone to check out the church services at 10:45 a.m. on Sundays! Really like the people and the music. Pastor is very lively and enjoyable to listen to. We are  members  of  over  20 years Very friendly Church

name: First Baptist Church of Tampa
reviewSummary: I have come to know many of his congregation. They have become my very good friends. I feel comfortable there. I feel that my healing is coming from the Lord and I believe the Lord put me in the right place. Friendly members.  The word of God is taught with integrity, music program is a great mix of traditional and contemporary. This is my home church and has been for 30 years. Through all the changes in times and personnel, it remains a Bible based, multicultural and multigenerational church. It supports missionary work with a passion as a Baptist church should. Many programs for differing needs . Has fostered seed churches locally and internationally. If you wish a church that is the best it can, go see how they make you feel walking in the door. Amazing place to worship God!! So glad we visited, from the moment we stepped out of our car we felt welcomed and saw smiles. The church is beautiful and the service was amazing. Thank you God for leading our family there. Praise God!!! This church has been around for a long time. My brothers and I used to live on Cardy street just down the road from First Babtist. We attended church on a regular basis as it was the place that we could all go to hang out with our friends not realizing at the time how God played a roll in all of our lives then and now. They had Wednesday Spaghetti  dinners and still offer a Wednesday and Sunday breakfast and dinner for everyone including  those who could not afford to pay, and even had a place in their activity building to go bowling, and a large skating rink where we also had an opportunity  to be off the streets and safe. I also sang in the choir. I stopped by this special place just a few days ago and met Nell who is a member and was gracious enough to show me around. I sat outside in the parking lot of the church remembering those old days at the church. Happy days of my brothers and I when we were young.  Seeing this church agian made me remember the importance of family and helping others as they did for my brothers, friends and loved ones. I plan to attend their Sunday services tomorrow, come and join us!

name: First Baptist Church of Tempe - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful church! They have been so warm and inviting. So much so that since I started coming , I haven’t stopped. I encourage you if you’re on the fence, to come worship with us😇 I was Trespassed January 11th 2026.  Call them or Tempe Police to ask why....
No violence. No obscenities. No threats.

My son was excluded from Kid City in 3rd grade - 2022. After he spent a few years in the Extra Ordinary Blessings class.

I was hit in the face while working in 2019 without aid rendered. A pastor was on campus but did not stay to help.

I sang in choir August 2018 until Christmas 2025, I asked countless times in the rehearsals leading up to the evening and very politely for a seat that would suit my abilities. I ended up far behind many large men and could not see our conductor.

My trumpet that my grandmother gifted me when I attended Connolly Middle School is left stuck on campus and my Bible, without me being given opportunity to take them with. January 11th 2026- was aweful, I cant imagine what my son felt when he was asked to leave. My sons bible was lost there too around the time he was excluded. This Church is nice with good people there. But they are struggling. We've been going there for quite a while. The new pastor they got just doesn't quite do it for me. He constantly talks about his kids. Every sermon is either about his kids or about when he was a kid. His stories are really irrelevant. The christmas sermon was about his driving in traffick and road ragging probably on the way to disney land again.
The music in the church is also struggling they have good musicians but the vibe that you get from them doesn't inspire the movement or energy of Jesus Christ. It all seems a bit depressing. Bless them for having the heart, courage and want to do what they do but they need some good direction. Another aspect I find a little frustrating is the offerings. It's really difficult to make offerings the old fashioned way. At this day and age a simple QR code put on the projector during the offerings will help tremendously.  I know this church does a lot of good for the community with free food service and teachings/schooling during the week but their Sunday services needs a resurrection. My name is David sidabras My mom and I have always attended this church i ma I have made a couple sins but she deserves to have a memorial but since she (hasn't attended there in a few years they say no my mother would be ashamed of this church she thought better of them after this I would never consider having anything there they are not full of christ the christ I was raised with was a forgiver and very loving they obviously are not I am ashamed that I ever considered this church as family I discovered this church about 7 years ago. I had tried a few other ones when I first moved to Arizona. From the moment I walked into the door, I felt welcomed! It is truly a family. The personal experience of this place does not get lost in the size of it's congregation. Their gentleness and focus on Christ is inspiring and comforting. The senior Pastor, Roger Ball has wonderful sermons that connect with out daily lives. They have a full choir and orchestra that is kind of hard to find these days and the worship Pastor Phillip, I cannot say enough about his colorful and engaging spirit. He loves the Lord and it shows in his songs and praises during worship.

They have a wonderful youth program. Kid City is broken down by age and grade for the 0-12 years old children including a nursery as well as an amazing teen program. The youth pastors are young and really connect with the teens. They thoroughly seem to understand what the youth of today faces with social media and peer pressure.

Their message of love and kindness and living "Christ like" is gentle but powerful.

I highly recommend coming here to get a feel for it.

name: First Baptist Church of Vienna - Vienna Campus
reviewSummary:
First Baptist Church of Vienna is a church that  is on the move doing God’s business evangelizing the lost and out-reaching to the community with food give away and tutoring to the community kids! First Baptist of Vienna has been my home church for 30 years, we have raised our 3 children in this church and have grown spiritually since joining. The members are warm and welcoming and I love the innovative ways that we reach out to the community for ministry opportunities!! All are welcome to join us in ministry opportunities and in Sunday morning and Wednesday evening worship services, we have something for all generations. First of all, thanks to Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ for Pastor Vernon C Walton in how he presents the Word of God for understanding and knowledge that will strengthen you in your Christian journey. Charles and I have experienced the LOVE of God throughout the ministry. From greeters at the doors, ushers hugs and giving of information,  praises and worship songs through the music ministry.  Each person who has come across our path has shown us the LOVE of GOD in this ministry. We are blessed!!

And many thanks to the Deacons and Deaconesses , who call and take the time to check on us. Thanks for bringing us the LOVE and  Communion when we can not attend church services.

It is appreciated and we say THANK YOU!

Charles and I are glad to be members of the First Baptist Church of Vienna. Big hugs to you all ❤❤ It's  been  a blessing  to  my life to be a member of First Baptist  Church for 31 years. I can attest to the fact...no one can love you like the members of "First".  There is always "Par Excellence ", preaching by our Pastor.  Many of the members genuinely  care. We are not a perfect  congregation.  Nevertheless  we are striving  to  be  more like Christ. Our Christian  Leadership  Academy/Sunday School are taught by Instructors that have prepared,  and equipped themselves  to  engage  the students, to bring about "Transformation" to those who seek to find God. Thirty-two years ago, we entered the doors and joined First Baptist Church of Vienna as a young family with young children, new to the area and new to a bible believing and teaching church in the Washington Metropolitan Area. The worship experiences are filled with excitement, education and emphasis to renew my walk on a daily basis. With a phenomenal spirit to service and open heart for people regardless of background, status or experience,  Pastor Vernon C. Walton has continued the legacy of community engagement and involvement and renewed an inclusive spirit of ALL ARE WELCOME!  First Baptist Church  is THE place to be each week at midweek service 7p on Wednesday and Sunday mornings!

name: First Baptist Church of Westwood - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Nice little church! Bible study was really good. From the Bible, not opinion... Great little gathering

name: First Baptist Church of Woodland Hills - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor is such a wonderful teacher. Things become so plain. Love the music, the old hymns. And the pianist is truly amazing. They are truly a loving family. We drive 50 minutes when we can just to be with them all. Such a blessing. Good place to worship God!  Excellent biblical preaching on Sundays. New to God, join the service.  Not a Christian, join the service. Service starts at 11am on Sundays.  Women's Support Group on second Saturday every month A very welcoming church with many activities for all ages. A holy place where I feel peace of heart and get energy from the people and Lucas's father Great place to visit

name: First Baptist Church of Yorba Linda - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Edited 2/2026:  My orig. review was referencing Pastor Cliff Sampson.  Not Paul Reinhard.  I love this church. The retired Senior Pastor was awesome. Some of the people here were friendly. Beautiful old church located in Yorba Linda on Lemon Drive next to the newly Yorba Linda Town Center area. Join the free workouts that they have on Mondays, Wednesdays,  and Fridays at 7am. The Yorba Linda Rotary Club Members rent three rooms in which they host a Food Bank with food from the GREATEST SUPER MARKETS IN SOCALIF!!! This is such a loving church. Solid Bible teaching. Made us feel welcome and at home from our first visit. I fell at home everybody's very friendly there are welcome you to their home and it's a beautiful environment

name: First Baptist Church Offices - Corona Campus
First Baptist Church Pelham - Pelham Campus
reviewSummary:
Our daughter attended FBC Pelham's VBS week, Blaze, and I honestly can't recommend it enough. I was blown away that this entire week of kids' camp was offered free of charge. Such a testament to how this church does things with excellence in a way that causes the whole community to take notice.

Everything was done with care, kindness, and excellence. Over and over, we were surprised and encouraged. You could tell the whole church membership had gotten behind this, not just the kids' ministry. From the student ministry serving, to retirees teaching woodworking, to college kids running around keeping the energy up. If we didn't already have a church home, we would seriously consider making this our faith family because of how they love and care for people.

Thank you. The best part: my little one put her faith in Jesus on the way home from Blaze. Multiple people had shared the gospel with her that week in a way a 7-year-old could understand — she came home and shared it back with me three different ways: a bracelet, a visual drawing, and the testimony of other kids trusting in Jesus. Way to go, and thank you. In part because of your love, my little one will be in heaven for eternity. Thank you a million times over. Wonderful worship, and I really enjoyed the bible-based preaching. Truly a blessing. WOW! I've visited a lot of Baptist churches the last few years, and this one blew all the others out of the water. Everyone was so kind and welcoming, but they went out of their way to make it known they were happy I was there and wanted me to come back. I highly suggest just asking one person about connecting with people your age/Sunday School, and they will make sure you find what you're looking for! The music is great, but the preaching is even better. This is a God-filled place! I love this church.  My family has joined and we just love it.
Love the worship, the music, the Sunday School Classes, everything.  It’s a big church so I haven’t met everybody but those I have, I just adore.  All friendly and ready to take the gospel out
to the people.  My granddaughter from Prattville got saved at our church and now would like to be baptized there.  My husband and my son both were baptized there.  It’s a great church!  Come try it out! We have been going to FBCP for 20 years..They have wonderful child care,great activities for the children & teens. Many Bible study groups. Great staff. Our Pastor is one in a million. Once you hear our wonderful Pastor preach ,you'll not want to miss a Sunday!

name: First Baptist Church Pensacola - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Very neat, friendly, and cool! There is the English service and the Vietnamese service, which are both equally amazing. I really love it here. (Left photo is a photo from July 2023 and the second photo is from April) Was here to see a chorus concert and was amazed at what a beautiful church this is.  Very nice people as well. I was calling in to reference a woman who need help her mother in bad condition and she lost her job trying to help out older mother her mother only have a few months to live and pastor's assistant hung up the phone when I was speaking of the latest need and I think that was pretty rude as a Christian. Very friendly congregation and the Pastor is very knowledgeable!  He takes time to teach and uses excellent examples to share experiences.  I can actually relate to him as a person that accept, and admits, faults and teaches us that it's ok to be human!  He loves The LORD and it definitely shows when he preaches!!  Congregation is very friendly and welcome you constantly!!  My granddaughter loves it because we come to the contemporary service but they also offer traditional as well!  They are very involved with the community and you can tell they genuinely care about others.  I've only been going a little over a year and if I can't get there I can go online and watch!! Excellent church to attend if you need a caring church family! I stayed in this town, when I would have otherwise moved away, only for this church. That was a decade ago.

The preacher is super and the traditional worship services are awesomely inspiring. It just keeps getting better and better.

This is not a huge church but big enough to give choices. The people are low key and friendly. This church is the best reason to live in Pensacola.

name: First Baptist Church Pomona (original location) - Pomona / Claremont Campus
First Baptist Church Richmond Hill - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: As a family that moves frequently, finding a church is very important to us and often takes awhile.  Not this time!  We visited for the first time and know who our church family is while we live here!  The preaching was passionate, gracious, and theologically sound. The people were genuine, connected, and committed.  We came as visitors, we left with friends and community. We love this church. We have been coming here for 2 years now, and just love the people. We love the children's ministry. And have loved being apart of the women's ministry. They also love and support military members. They offer a deployed spouse's Sunday school too! We have been traveling around the South for the last 6 weeks. We are regular Baptist Church attendees in Arizona. We have visited a different Church every Sunday. No one I repeat no one made us feel welcome at this Church. Sorry All the other Churchs made us feel very welcome. Your Intern Pastor Preached a Great Sermon, Music Great. Need to work on your welcoming Skills. I've been attending FBC since 1999. This is a wonderful home town feel church. Very good for young children and military families. Has a great Mops program and other great programs as well. This church will love on you and your family. Great support for military. Thanks FBC. Absolutely best church I’ve been too. I grew up catholic even went to catholic school (1st-12th). I couldn’t tell you anything about people I went to church with. No names no acts of services no Sunday bible study groups. My family and I were so lucky to have found this church to call our church home. The people are so friendly and helpful and we have a good time with bible studies and my kids love their kid groups and Awana.Really made some great friends and our relationship with God stronger and better . #FBCRH

name: First Baptist Church Round Rock - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
This church does so much for the community. Everyone is so welcoming and kind. We love this church and appreciate all they do! I was encouraged by the teaching, but I left with serious concerns about financial transparency and stewardship. A Sunday flyer previously available to the congregation documented reserves in excess of 3 million dollars; later communications now show roughly 1.8 million, without explanation, while weekly reports continue to state that giving is “needed” to meet the church budget. While inviting generosity is biblical, removing or withholding previously shared financial information while still requesting contributions creates confusion and undermines trust. Scripture teaches that resources entrusted to the church are meant to be stewarded openly and used to serve people, support missions, care for the poor, and equip those called to go but unable to afford it (Matthew 25:14–30; Acts 2:44–45; James 1:27). Transparency and visible fruitfulness are essential so giving can be done freely, confidently, and in alignment with the church’s biblical mission. name: First Baptist Church San Francisco - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
The First Baptist Church is a beautiful place to visit, and we felt very welcome 🙏🤗We loved the Nordic Winter concert. It was a lovely time. We highly recommend it! A true church of Jesus Christ, where the word of the Lord Jesus Christ is preached like it is supposed to be delivered. FBCSF is a very sound and Christ-centered church that exhibits the grace of God in their preaching and practice. Every true church is characterized by people who have placed their faith in Jesus, repented from their sins, bear the fruits of repentance, and desire for others to do the same. God has His hand on this local church.

The church practices kingdom generosity and has people who are characterized by Christian love for believers and people who do not know God. They demonstrate mercy and demonstrate kingdom generosity to the people of the Bay Area and the world, as disciples who have received the great mercy of God.

If you want to find the word of Lord Jesus Christ preached like it is supposed to—not sugar coated or adulterated—then this is the place. The shepherds here are true and do not play games or fool around, demonstrating themselves to be people of the kingdom community who give hope to the hopeless, preparing sinners to meet God, walking down the difficult path that leads to salvation. We are either with God or against Him.

The discussion questions convict me of my sins. The shepherds and disciples are very helpful in helping me deny myself to follow the way of Jesus.

It is continually emphasized that the relationship with God is between the individual and God. We are taught that we the people of God are called to live repentant lives and shine as lights in the darkness everyday in the world, in school, in the workplace, in the home, in services to people, and many different avenues. The Sunday services are intended to equip believers to live out the ways of Jesus practically day by day. The members emphasize that the one true church of God is neither a religious organization nor a building, but the people of God.

I love it when Pastor Benjamin prays: “We pray that our church gatherings will not be empty rituals.” Since our identity is in Christ, we live out the love of God in the community, in the workplace, among or family members, among our unbelieving friends, in the arts, and in any community service organization that helps people. If we have God inside us, we live out the church everywhere. This is what the church leaders teach.

It is taught that our foundation is not in good deeds we do, because no good deeds can merit God’s forgiveness. There is nothing we can do to gain God’s favor and we bring nothing to God that he needs. The church teaches that we are sinners who are adopted into God’s family. The whole Gospel is preached with nothing missed. We are saved through adoption, not through our own efforts. All of our sins, past, present, and future, are forgiven. Jesus paid for our sins on the cross. We have an identity much deeper than ourselves.

The church teaches us to love people in very tangible and real ways, like Jesus did. Sharing the Gospel with people takes many different forms. It is not about parroting facts about the Bible and talking about the doctrines of salvation in abstract theological ways to everyone.

The church emphasizes the importance of accountability to God and worship through a lifestyle of continual repentance, prayer, love for neighbors, and God’s mission to win people to Christ. It is taught to build our relationship with God in have a balance in all the areas of faith. I’ve been coming to FirstSF for over 4 years now and it’s still one of the best Churches I’ve ever been to! Everyone is so welcoming, and always has been even from the day I arrived. The staff, Pastors and volunteers all truly care about you and want to have you there. The sermons are amazing and always Biblically based. The worship is also just incredible! I especially love that questions are encouraged. I get to ask as many questions as I need about the faith to the Pastors and Staff and they don’t shy away from answering.

If you are considering coming, you should totally do it!!! I still consider this my family’s church. My brother and I actually attended the elementary school when Larry Peterson’s father was the pastor, 45 years ago. I will always cherish the memories of camping at Yosemite with the church. I miss the old congregation with all my heart. We had a great time yesterday worshiping with the FBC San Francisco congregation.  There was beautiful worship singing; then, Dr Ben Day delivered a powerful sermon.

Pastor Steve is an awesome teacher as he teaches the Word and doesn't sugar coat, which is refreshing. Grateful to find a church where you are welcomed, loved upon, encouraged and equipped in your walk with the Lord. This is a Christ centered church that seeks to equip its members to mature in their faith through sound Biblical doctrine and teaching. They truly do help you to know, love, obey and exalt Jesus Christ.

name: First Cary United Methodist Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: I have been a First Cary United Methodist Church member for 4 years now and love it. This place is ALIVE with kind, giving people, and everyone is welcome. Zero pretense or judgment, and no hard sell. Sermons focus on linking today's life to God's word. It strives to connect among members and with the Cary community. Knowledgeable and approachable pastors and support staff. Traditional and contemporary services. Complete children's and youth programs and activities; an active Young Adults group; and bible study and fellowship groups. Lots of volunteer opportunities to help the community. I joined several Habitat for Humanity builds with church members; a monthly food distribution effort; English as a Second Language and Read and Feed programs; Grief group; Easter baskets and Christmas presents for those in need, and more. Participate in church life as your time and desire allows. This is your personal invitation. Come visit and experience it for yourself. I look forward to seeing you. My entire family has deep roots in the Methodist Church, all the way back to the 1700's. I met Laurie when I first arrived at the church. I told her that I was hungry and that I had been sleeping in my truck and was desperate. She told me that she couldn't give me permission to sleep in my truck in the church parking lot, but that she also couldn't say no. I didn't know what to say or do after that. So I left. I don't know what Jesus would do. But that's what I did. I didn't feel welcome at all. I held back tears as best I could. I'm still homeless. Would not recommend if you are looking for a Church and I would recommend leaving if you attend here. There are so many options and I would pass on this one. I grew up in this Church and my Father and his Father were members. The current leadership is far from responsive to members. I once led a Bible class here, but sadly the Church is not the same Church it once was. I am glad I left and took my family to a Church that follows the Bible. First United Methodist Church is located at 117 S Academy St, Cary, NC 27511. We visited United Methodist Church on Saturday afternoon but it was closed and not open to public. Could see the holey place from the outside only. Just opposite is located another beautiful First Baptist Church. Its location is prime and it is situated near Downtown Park, Cary Community Library and Cary Arts Center. United Methodist Church is beautifully constructed, its design is awesome and attractive. It look small but get attention of everyone passing through Care Down Town. May God bless this beautiful Church. I visited for the Martin Luther King Jr Sunday 20024 dinner and interactive activity.  I enjoyed the presentation and history awearness feature.  Everyone appeared to participate with enthusiasm. It was refreshing to discuss a history that I could relate to, that has been my own life. Thank you First Unuted Methodist Churc Cary.

name: First Chinese Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I've been going to this church for quite some time and it's awesome. Very clean, nicely cold, worship is amazing, and people are friendly. This church is kept together so nicely! I come here almost every Sunday. They have so many programs to pick from. I love this church! I've been going to FCBC for a year now.  You'll be impressed by how intricately connected this Church's community members are, and how zealously they support one another. Get your security guards retrained. Them and your congregation know nothing of American rights. Security punks harass and assaulted tourists on the street Visited a few times tried to give this church a  chance but no.  Not a visitor friendly church, childrens ministry is disorganized and all over the place.  We stood around outside trying to figure which 3-4 buildings to go to, but all they kept telling us was "Its next door".  Parking is nonexistant, find what you can on the street.  Seems to be a chinese church with a 2nd-3rd gen english congregation, school and college oriented, just not neighborhood friendly-A comfort zone church.

name: First Christian Church
reviewSummary: I visited this church last week as I was passing through Billings on a road trip. I went to their morning Bible study and the service afterwards- it was wonderful. I had a hard time finding churches in the area that promoted sound doctrine and Im so thankful I ended up at this church. Their Bible study was informative and well done and their service was the same. Everyone was so kind and multiple people talked to me before and after church. Pastor Jeromy was wonderful and offered to pray over my trip and I am very thankful. God bless all these people and I hope I am back to visit again someday They care about their homeless neighbors.  Excellent pastor and preaching.  Family atmosphere. Sound Biblical teaching and preaching, a diverse congregation, and a heart for the marginalized in the heart of downtown Billings. This is my church! Here's a place you can find good family's but to now them as Godliness get to the for six months. Wonderful church downtown.

name: First Christian Church
reviewSummary:
If you’re searching for a church that genuinely reflects the core values of Christianity—integrity, compassion, and humility—I would highly encourage you to look elsewhere. In my experience, the leadership at FCC has repeatedly demonstrated behavior that stands in stark contrast to those principles.

There appears to be a troubling pattern of hypocrisy and a lack of accountability, which undermines the trust that a faith community should provide. Rather than fostering a supportive and honest environment, interactions often feel adversarial and, at times, deeply concerning and antagonistic.

I would strongly encourage anyone considering this church to carefully evaluate whether it aligns with the kind of spiritual guidance and community they are seeking. The fact they continuously help people suffering from addiction hold meetings here is a true testament of how we should behave towards the less fortunate. God bless this beautiful church to continue doing their good service. At first I really enjoyed going, but after seeing how my best friend was treated and then let go from her job, because I helped her with projects and in her classroom, I will never go back.
They say treat others as you would want to be treated and they unfortunately do not do that. So many people there claim to be godly people and in reality, they are far from it. Not everyone was like that, but most of them are sadly.
I grew up going to church and this was probably one of the worst ones I've been to throughout my life. They have some great rooms in the basement that have changed my life. I'm grateful to them for letting us use them. I did a service call there. The staff was excellent to work with. The invoice was paid on time with no disputes.

name: First Christian Church - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:
Grew up in this church and the people have been wonderful.  Unfortunately membership is currently low but the new pastor Ron Malone offers nice sermons and bible study utilizing scripture well.

There are 3 churches operating in this building now and the hall is available to rent for events.

I added a couple of pictures to show the space available to rent. Very warm members and pastor I have a couple friends that go there I don't actually go myself but they love it Great sermons great people

name: First Christian Church - Amarillo Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending First Christian Church in Amarillo, TX, most of my life. I am blown away by the sense of community and fellowship here. The congregation is welcoming and friendly, and there are plenty of opportunities to get involved and meet new people. The kid's program is outstanding, and my children love coming here. The church also offers various events and activities that cater to people of all ages and interests. I am grateful to have found such a wonderful spiritual community and highly recommend First Christian Church to anyone looking for a supportive and inclusive place to worship." After over 40 years of attendance at First Christian Church - Amarillo what keeps my family coming back?  FCC has all the typical programs: music, youth, fellowship, outreach, Bible studies, etc.  While these and other programs are important and provide the membership opportunities for involvement and service, they are not what drives our family. One could ask "why not" when considering membership at FCC. Our sanctuary is beautiful and sets a spiritual tone. Our ministers speak as one when it comes to the Sunday message, The message is based on the Bible, and we always come away feeling like we have a better understanding of the scriptures. What can you expect to see when you walk in the door of FCC? FCC is a place where anyone can serve formally or informally. FCC is a place where you are made to feel like family. Our family cares about others and is cared for. Our ministers and staff care for the members of our congregation. FCC ministers, staff, and members have arms wide open and are anxious to welcome others into membership. I decided to give this church a try because I saw all kinds of people in leadership. I needed to feel like I belonged. The communion table is open to everyone who wants it, you don't have to be a congregation member. I stay because God is here, and my church family is amazing. Come worship with us! First Christian Church (Disciples of Christ) of Amarillo is the church where my wife and I have been members since January 1980. We have seen many changes since that time, but the one constant has been the friendliness and love we have have felt. My mother is the one who started my family in the church in Fort Worth, and one of the reasons I love our church is the taking of communion every Sunday.
It has been a tradition of the Disciples of Christ since the 19th century, and no I was not a member back then. It connects me back to our Savior no matter what kind of week I have had or how badly I have lived my week. He is always welcoming us back to Him by the sharing of the bread and cup at the Table.
FCC allows us to study the scriptures and interpret and discuss what it means to our lives in a free and thoughtful manner. We are not dogmatic but the freedom to think is a very important part of our faith. We have many personalties, viewpoints, and thoughts here, but no one will judge you. Come to our church just the way you are - dressed up or dressed down. Just bring yourself!
If you are looking  for a way to help in the community, we have many chances to do that, such as SnackPak4Kids and the High Plains Food Bank. FCC Amarillo is our sanctuary, make it yours and relish what God has intended for your life. This church is a loving accepting congregation who believes in community support and the missions of the church. Pastor Coe is engaging, thought provoking, and helps feed your soul.

name: First Christian Church - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary: I felt welcomed my 2nd visit here; thankful for the kind usher who listened to my story on how I came upon your church, and then led me to my seat for worship. Thankful to Renae, for her hospitality throughout the service, as well. I’m Baptist, but I appreciate the fact that y'all receieve Holy Communion every week. I wish more churches did the same. May the Lord continue to bless your congregation and increase your membership! Grace and peace to you all! Really cute pumpkin sale. I took my girlfriend and she picked one out. They had different prices depending on the size. Ours happened to be in-between two sizes so they charged us halfway the price from the two pumpkin sizes ours was in the middle of.  They were still good for carving. Everyone is so nice and welcoming! It's a different environment from other churches! I happy that I went there. A wonderful church in the heart of the Metroplex, sharing God's heart for all people through service,  study,  worship and joyful community events. We are very blessed to be able to join the weekly church.  Thank you.

name: First Christian Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
Best Church Family! Loving and Accepting! All are welcome at First Christian Church. A beautiful church, in the heart of Baton Rouge. Some of the friendliest people I have ever met.  The service is  focused on Christ, as it should be, and always very meaningful. Reverend David has a great message, each Sunday, that is thoughtful, and easy to relate to. Most of the music consists of traditional hymns, we all know and love, with some contemporary songs added, as well. I knew from my first visit, that I would become a member of this beautiful church. All are welcome, here. Come visit, and worship with us. Great church which allows us to attend A.A. meeting's. Friendly people especially Charles the Maintenance man. Passing through town. Been sleeping in my car to save up money to get a place when I get to Colorado. Went in the office and asked a gentleman if I could park there for a few hours to get some rest. He was nice and said sure no problem. Few hours later a few cars started pulling up and I could tell instantly it was time to go. One man purposely set his car alarm off which said police vwere coming and another guy pulls up right next to me. Could tell he parked there for a reason. Anyways I left and Bethany church which has no problem with me parking there. I appreciate the guy in the office that gave me permission
Because I was tired. Only place I feel safe to sleep in my car at is in church parking lots. Very friendly church. Sincere people. I appreciate the thought provoking sermons.

name: First Christian Church - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary: 2 Tim 4: 3 - For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear. 4 They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths. This church welcomes all people. It is not our places to judge each other. We love  the sermons given by both Pastor Don and Pastor Mark. This church walks the walk and doesn’t just talk. The amount of community help given is amazing, We love FCC. The people at the church have a true heart for community. If you want to be part of the community & live out what the gospel calls us to do it’s a great place to worship. Everyone is welcomed fully. Come as you are. Come join our community! We praise God by caring about others.This church welcomes all without judgement! Awesome youth group for teenagers! Beautiful choir music and great leadership.

name: First Christian Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: What a warm, friendly and special place  FCC is. If you are looking for a church where you will truly be loved and cared for as you experience the grace and goodness of a loving God, come check us out. All are welcome… And we do mean ALL. I like FCC because you don't have to check your brain at the door , love prevails over close minded dogmas And folks sincerely care about each other. FINALLY! A church family that is welcoming to all, not pretentious, and not trying to sell you on a “membership” or “investment”.  Their motto is that ALL are welcomed to God’s table and you truly do feel that way here. If you’ve given up trying to find a church, try this place. 👍👍 My kids went to preschool here years ago. My wife and I returned tonight for her dodgeball tournament. Yep adult dodgeball. It was awesome and no one got seriously injured. The facilities were great. A loving Church full of people with exceptional  strong values for compassion, mercy, kindness and love !

name: First Christian Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: This church is open and affirming, meaning that it welcomes people of all backgrounds and identities, including those from the LGBTQ+ community. It strives to create a safe and inclusive environment where everyone can worship and be themselves. As a queer person, it can be difficult to impossible to find a church that feels affirming. FCC Burbank is a safe and invigorating space that not only preaches through a framework of liberation theology, but actively works to live that out in the Burbank community and beyond. I attended a Burbank Community Band Halloween Concert here. They are fantastic!! It is great that the Church supports the community in this way. So fun. Such talented people. It has been around for 80 years. We discovered this wonderful church after moving to southern California from the bay area. It has become our favorite church ever and we’ve been going 70+ years. The congregation is so welcoming, kind and sincere. The pastor approaches scripture with intellectual vigor and historical context and makes the gospel of social justice and equality real. He is very caring and relates well to everyone. This church is open and affirming to all people. They have ministries to the community as well as to the congregation that are very meaningful. There is a nice diversity of people of all ages, national backgrounds, races, genders and orientations. Highly recommended as you will find community, ways to serve and a lively church family.  Check out the website God bless

name: First Christian Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
This is why I go and worship God what a great place love it here What a great church! I got to the service a few minutes late today and Pastor Shawn went above and beyond to greet me with a big smile and open the auditorium door for me. This ripple is greatly impacting not only the number of doors that have been opened to me but the number of doors I’m opening for others. Thank you Shawn and the FCC team! Mostly we attend in person and when we can't we watch online.
All the pastors are super friendly and approachable and the programs they offer to the partners and the community are spectacular.

They do so much for the kids. I really want to start attending church here as well. Such a warm and friendly atmosphere. First time I've been to a church where I felt welcome and wanted which means a lot to me. The word is amazing and the music is awesome! I wish I would have started here long ago and raised my children here especially with our world today. But I am grateful for everyone here and thankful 🙏

The Reverend Wright presented a message both honoring to God and graspable to us in the pews. One can tell he really has a heart for Jesus and this body of believers. When we are in Corpus Christi again, we will definitely return to First Christian Church. First Christian Church is such a welcoming and peaceful place. The people are kind, the messages are uplifting, and you can truly feel a sense of community here. Whether you’re new to faith or just looking for a place to belong, this church makes you feel at home. I was ready to step into a smaller church to get to a sense of worship that made me feel the holiness of God in reverent submission to him.  The megachurches don’t help me experience that because they’re too overwhelming.  I find that here. I went with my friend Belen to her church service there and it was wonderful service, I also brought my service dog Rocky with me with no problems.  Happy Preacher Rusty is Very Good! My wife and I enjoy his sermons.

name: First Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending 1st church for about 4 years. This congregation has continually been open, big hearts open minds. We are welcoming to All. We have many ministries that you can participate in or lead.
Our building is beautiful, 100 plus years old.
The Worship Center/ Sanctuary is a perfect atmosphere for a contemporary blended service. We invite you to come worship with us, join the church if you are looking for a church home with a loving family. We are not seeking people to “pay our bills” we are looking to find new desciples to work side by side with to be the hands and feet of Christ in Covington Kentucky. First Christian Church on the corner of Fifth and Madison, Covinton, Ky.  Is a Beautiful  bldg. whose doors are open to all who wish to serve and worship God.  We welcome all people to come in and be comfortable in your skin......straight, gay, it matters not! We had our wedding ceremony at First Christian Church and had a great experience. Sheri and Pastor Tracy were a pleasure to work with. They were responsive and worked with us to meet all our needs.  I would recommend First Christian Church if you want to get married in an open and accepting church that does not feel stuffy with classic traditions. they SERVE GOD & HELP HIS OTHER CHILDREN
they invited Breakfast of Covington to serve the homeless or other hungry people Tues, Wed, Thurs mornings.
They serve community dinners Sun@4pm
They also host two N.A. homegroups,
"Garden of Hope" Fri8:30pm
"Becoming Something From Nothing" Sat10pm
"we serve God by service to others" Truly a place that tries to live up to their mission " to welcome wholly, love authentically, and share God's grace abundantly." I get way to excited when I'm here. It makes me so happy!

reviewSummary:

reviewSummary: We were lost trying to access the Friends (Quaker) meeting, were welcomed and given access to their library that kept us well engaged for a rapidly passed hour. Disciples of Christ teaches you have to be water baptized to be saved. They do not understand how to be saved. They are considered a cult by some for their form of discipleship

name: First Christian Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve never once sat in their pews, yet these remarkable people have served me a warm breakfast more times than my own mother.

If that isn’t the very embodiment of an exemplary church, I don’t know what is. There is a lady that sometimes serves breakfast on boulevard she's Susan surandons twin she is so nice I don't attend church there but because of her I'm going too I don't attend services here but they are an excellent group of people who help the community with their free breakfast program, sack lunches and 4th of July parade booth of snacks and drinks My great grand father DR.Lloyd Taylor  & great grand mother Dorthy Taylor brought me up in this church Great memories was made ! name: First Christian Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: My wife first visited this church in the fall of 2005, while I was still completing our move and transition to Fayetteville from the Houston area.  She was excited by the service, the music, and most of all the people she encountered that Sunday.  It took a while for us to leave our deep Presbyterian roots behind and join in wholeheartedly with everything FCC had to offer, but now and for the past many years FCC has been our Christian community and home base for our faith and spiritual development.  Since Covid times we have welcomed many Christians who have felt judged or not welcome in other churches into our loving arms at FCC.  During my recent struggle with Stage 4 prostate cancer, I was fully loved and supported by our church community and am now in full remission.  Come visit and see how it feels to be in a church community who really loves and cares for each other! I grew up in this church from an infant. My love for god and humanity blossomed here. First Christian Church will accept you at any path that you are on. It’s a beautiful church family and love that you’ll realize you have never accepted before. Cheryl and Ryan are amazing and the experience here will make you feel like you are at home. I’ve been real down on my luck before and called and Cheryl picked up and she made me feel like I had a family and she cared so much for me. Highly recommend FCC Fayetteville. I grew up in this church and am glad to be back home! I experienced a welcoming, beautiful congregation Worse places . ABUSED by them.Event gathering took abuse Friday Oct 27 Adbused

name: First Christian Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending FCC for some time now, and I can honestly say it’s become a place we truly consider home. From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt welcomed and embraced by everyone. What stands out the most about FCC is the sense of community—it’s not just a church, it’s a family.

We’ve made so many meaningful friendships here, and the connections we’ve formed have been a huge blessing. The people here genuinely care for each other, and it’s clear that the church’s leadership is committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels like they belong. Whether it's through small group gatherings, Sunday services, or church events, there are always opportunities to build relationships and grow spiritually alongside others.

Our kids have also flourished in the children's ministry. It’s not just childcare; they’re learning and growing in their faith, and they love going to church every week. The youth program is active and engaging, which gives our teenagers a place to connect and grow in their own faith journey too.

We feel incredibly blessed to be part of First Christian Church. It’s more than just a place of worship—it’s a community where we’ve grown spiritually, made lifelong friends, and found a sense of belonging! Very welcoming & friendly brothers & sister of God. I joined under Pastor Gary who welcomed me whole heatedly to FCC. I pray God richly bless the FCC family now & forever I had an uplifting Sunday morning at First Christian Church! The spacious setting was perfect for the powerful message from Pastor Jimmy Akers. He spoke about King David and how, from his rooftop, he saw Bathsheba and made a costly mistake. “The Lord sees the heart” (1 Samuel 16:7) was a key takeaway, reminding us that God’s perspective is different from ours. The service was a great reminder to stay humble and seek God’s guidance in all things. Highly recommend a visit for anyone looking for insightful teaching and a welcoming atmosphere! :) When I came to FCC, I had a good bit of church hurt I brought with me. My faith in Jesus never wavered, but my love for the ministry of the Church had been damaged.

I see now that God has used this church and community to patch up that hurt I experienced. The staff truly support one other and the congregation through good times and bad. I feel that my soul is cared for, and I know that on bad days, people will be there to pray with me and uplift me out of the mire.

I couldn’t ask for a better place to call home in Fort Myers and I’m glad that this church has embraced me! Good worship, solid biblical message, great demographics. Seems like a healthy church!

name: First Christian Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone is welcome.  Friendly congestion has food bank. No judgment come as you are. Always friendly and nice. They didn't have any tacos Kids go over to do  homework and play pool Really nice people.

name: First Christian Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Saw this amazing church, on sunday before going to a México vs England World Cup Match, downtown Fort Worth Texas and how I love the history of displace, especially this place holds a lot of history, not just around fort worth, texas, but around US history as well.
I wish I could go inside and see what's inside this church, but it was closed.
Amazing architecture church. I flew to Texas from Warsaw, Poland for a few days.  It was a great experience for me to participate in the Sunday mass in this beautiful church.  wonderful people, wonderful energy.  I left this church filled with new strength and I will think from every place on earth to this church.  Thank you very much.  I am sending greetings to the two wonderful ladies with whom I had the opportunity to talk to after the mass. I've never left a Google review of a church before, but today, a lady I assume to be homeless quietly slipped into the back early into the service and sat alone at the end of an empty pew. She wasn't bothering anyone, but they called the police to escort her off the property. After the service, people were talking about her and I asked if they knew why the police were called. I was told she smelled bad. I said "apparently the table of Christ isn't big enough for people who smell bad. Got it."

At this church, they talk a lot about the table being open to all (I fully agree), and today's sermon (really good btw) highlighted the way we dehumanize others, but after what I'd just seen, I've concluded it's all just talk. I shouldn't be surprised, but after decades seeing churches openly close "the table" off, I am disappointed to see this church is no different. I'm a member of First. We're the oldest congregation in town. The church was built in 1914. It's a beautiful building. Beautiful historic  church in downtown Fort Worth. Beautiful music, stunning pipe organ, great congregation!

name: First Christian Church - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
EDIT as of 2025: We no longer attend this church. While it is a fine space for white gay people, we did not find them receptive to our conecerns about POCs feeling underrepresented and listened to. The pastor of this church, whom we had a six-year relationship with, met us with defensiveness rather than concern and understanding. We cannot in good faith recommend this church to any POC.

--
My partner and I found this church after we were kicked out of our former church for being gay. This church actually MEANS what they say about welcoming, loving, and fully including EVERYONE. Yes, this means affirming gay people in the church- in leadership and all positions- and not treating them like second class citizens. Pastor Mandye's messages are deep and often cover important social justice issues in our world today. This church also commits to helping our local community in Fullerton. This church is everything a church SHOULD be and puts their time, effort, and money into helping rather than keeping up with "appearances" like some of those other "hip" churches that don't practice what they preach!

If you have been hurt by the church or have religious trauma- this is a safe place of healing for you This is a loving and gracious church!  The first time I visited, I had many people come up and welcome me but no one ever pressured me to join. The congregation is kind and giving - it does feel like a "church family".  Pastor Mandye is open-minded, listens and reminds us that our service goes outside of the church walls.
It is wonderful to belong to a church that accepts and welcomes everyone regardless of race, housing situation or sexual orientation. The Outreach Ministry is very active in the community, from offering quarters to people at the laundromat to supporting a soup kitchen at a neighboring church. There is also an arm of the church (Week of Compassion) where you can donate to any cause or disaster and 100% of your donation goes to the cause.  (The charity is supported by a substantial endowment.).
There is no particular dress code, they sing praise songs and they sing hymns. The atmosphere is comfortable and loving...just as Jesus would want!  I'm so happy I found this church! I was looking for a local church where I can worship, learn, connect, contribute and serve people in our community.  I was intrigued when I'd seen this church feed the homeless.

After checking out the website, I called Pastor Mandye to arrange an appointment to chat about what she believes, what she teaches and how the congregation works together outside the Sunday Experience.  She spent dedicated, focused time with me and arranged for me to meet other parents in a similar situation.

After a bit of previous "church trauma" it was difficult for me to enter a church building again. I was warmly welcomed by so many people and invited to participate in the choir and the Outreach Committee.  I'm learning, worshiping, serving and have new friends!

Pastor Mandye has a heart for truly including everyone and for social justice. I've found that Pastor Mandye and the people of this church "walk the walk" of including all, by welcoming, inviting people to join in and even electing a variety of folks to leadership positions.

This has been my church "home" for over a year.  I invite anyone seeking a loving church community to come and experience what I have. I am hearing worse and worse stories about how this church treats the public. The first thing that popped up was an auditor recording in front of this place on the sidewalk and these folks demanding to know their biz. Entitlement is not a good look, do better FCC. I go to the feed for the hungry on Wednesdays here and everytime i go i get harassed by the volunteers because the fact that I'm in my twenties and not homeless but i am hungry and in need. They judge me for the way i look not taking in to account that im in a financial rut with no money to feed my self or to buy my self clothes. I love going  dont get me wrong but sometimes its my only meal of the week. If the volunteers are really doing this for God they need to look at themselves and stop judging people for the way they look.

name: First Christian Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
Foothill Christian Church is a truly special place with deep roots in Glendora's history, having served the community for over 100 years. It’s a beautiful reflection of tradition and faith, offering a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes everyone feel at home. Pastor Karen leads the service with such grace and authenticity, creating an inviting space for worship and reflection. Her kindness and genuine care for the congregation make every visit meaningful.

The church members are incredibly friendly and open, fostering a sense of community that’s hard to find. Whether you’re new to the area or looking for a spiritual home, this is a wonderful place to build a relationship with God while embracing a supportive and loving community. Foothill Christian Church is a true gem in Glendora, blending history, faith, and fellowship in the most beautiful way. The First Christian Church of Glendora is a truly remarkable community where inclusivity and warmth are at the heart of everything they do. My journey with this church began when a member invited me to attend a wedding vow renewal ceremony. Initially hesitant due to my background—I grew up Jewish and often felt forced to attend temple, which distanced me from organized religion—I was skeptical about stepping into a place of worship. However, that one visit changed everything. The ceremony was beautiful, and the atmosphere was so inviting and genuine that I found myself returning multiple times since. Their array of engaging classes, such as cooking, ceramics, painting, paper mache, drawing, and a puzzle club, has provided me with new opportunities for growth and connection. The church’s commitment to embracing everyone, regardless of their background, is deeply inspiring.

A key part of my positive experience has been the leadership of Pastor Karen. She has an incredible gift for making everyone feel seen and heard, connecting with people in a way that is free of judgment and full of compassion. Though I am not a member of the church because I haven’t converted—and I’m not sure if I ever will—I have found it amazing to be surrounded by so many kind and beautiful souls. This experience has been a wonderful opportunity to learn about a religion that is not my own, and I can’t imagine a better place to explore and grow in understanding than this church. The First Christian Church of Glendora has shown me the true meaning of community, and for that, I am deeply grateful. Great place to talk to God at! Especially when he is already in your heart. You can communicate with him anywhere your at! I did not have a good experience at this church and it's no place for children. Very nice and wonderful people the Elders known their Bible very well. Church is Alive and Well

name: First Christian Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church and the people they are so sweet i went here for daycare and pre-k from around 2012-2015 the only fond memories that i remember are when i was in pre-k 2 (2015). i remember during the Mother’s Day tea party, i saw everyone else’s mom come but i thought my mom was not going to come, but little did i know they were all just really early. i still cried though but it wasn’t a loud tantrum, it was just a silent cry. fortunately though, my mom showed up and everything was normal. after the party, i didnt want my mom to leave and so i cried (honestly, im pretty sure i just didn’t want to be with those teachers, since i remember they were really mean to me) but the teacher screamed at me and made me stand by myself to “think about my actions”. after that, during nap time, i heard the two teachers speaking about how they should have a “talent show” for us and make me cry while i held a baby because im a “crybaby”. another memory i have is before we went outside, the teachers made us wash our hands. after we did so, one of us forgot to turn off the faucet so the teachers called all the girls in to do some kind of interrogation. during this, i knew i didn’t forget to turn off the faucet since i was not the last one to wash my hands, but the teacher blamed me of it and threatened that if i did not tell the truth, i would not be able to go to the soccer class that my mom enrolled me in. but since i was like 4 years old, i told the teacher that it was definitely one of the other girls. somehow the teacher was mad at ME and gave me a teddy bear which they called the “taddle teddy” because i told the truth but they called it “taddling”. they made me sit out of recess but not the girl who forgot to turn it off? so your teaching little kids to not tell the truth and if you do you will get punished for it? ugh. the teachers at that school would force me to finish my lunch when i was full, they would make me say bad words to entertain them, and they would be nicer to the white boys and girls (im not pulling the race card, im simply telling the truth) i remember looking forward to days where one teacher was only there, because i noticed that they got nicer. before pre-k 2 i have memories of the other kids in my class who told me that the pre-k 2 teachers were mean, since they had heard stories from their older siblings. its not just pre-k  though. there was a  time where i went to another daycare class for the first but i at that age (2-3 years old) i was really shy and scared. i didn’t want to go inside, so the teacher thought it was a good idea to carry me inside as if you were carrying books around a school hallway. but anyways, the teacher of pre-k 2 mrs rosemary (or mary) has retired already but im not sure about the other teacher (she was young, had black hair and tattoos). these memories make me angry to this day, because why would these grown adults spread so much hatred to little kids that were 10x younger then them? and before you say “you were too young to be able to remember those things”, i believe that when little kids go through things that are traumatic to them, they stick for the rest of their lives, and that’s exactly what happened. even years after leaving that school, i kept telling those stories all throughout elementary school and middle school. do better I gave a conference on orchids to the Federation of Houston Garden Clubs, Nov. 13

reviewSummary:
We were told to pick up our Miracle League medals at this church. I live very far so I sent a friend who happens to be black. The ladies of the church refused to acknowledge him, refused to respond to 2 voicemail messages I left during hours of operation stating the times my friend would come by and pick up. He tried twice and was ignored and not acknowledged. Extremely sad as this a church. Obviously they have some issues with race. I grew up in the first Christian Church of duncanville Texas. This is a lovely church with beautiful people :) Welcoming.   Lovely organ music sometimes other instrumental solos.  The sermons, while based on the Bible have a real day message and application. Be sure to appreciate the exceptionally lovely stained glass. Hope to see you there!! I found this place on a day, my father passed ( it has been 9 years since his passing) and I really needed a church, that is open on a week day and after 12 as I was at a doctor's office all morning.
Google led me to First Christian Church))🙏
It was pure miracle.
I drove there and there were no cars in a parking lot.
I still called the number and very nice lady with a British accent  said that Pastor John is in and  will now open the door for me.

I am so grateful for this wonderful man.
He spent at least an hour with me, as I told him about missing my dad, who tought me music and poetry, who raised me and my sister, pretty much by himself...
He lit the candle in dad's memory and  listened to me, crying about the horrors of being infected with Sepsis during open heart surgery, 1.5 years ago as I cried, while telling him that my Sepsis was later hidden as medical records were falsified by two local doctors - Dr.Jahangir ( cardio thoracic surgeon),  who uses cruel violence against me in every hospital ( through armed guards)and Dr.Pham (internist) who abused me in Desert Springs hospital- later  dumped me through armed hospital guards, in order to get rid of me, after I kept asking to stop with abuse on his dimentia floor, where I was shoved with Severe Sepsis, in order to make me look - "crazy", while all records were later illegally  falcified by both doctors...
Pastor John listened to me for a long time and we prayed together... English is my 4th language and I was used to prayers in my native language, but, after meeting this wonderful man of God- I am reading his prayer(written by his hand for me).
I actually  said, that I can google it as it is a long prayer, but he  insisted to write it for me by his hand as he was full of empathy and light...
I am so grateful for this man.
I feel, like my dad in Heaven sent me his way and into his church, where he comforted me on a day of my dad's passing...
I am so grateful for Pastor John.
Please, go to this wonderful church as this is a place, where you will feel love and God's presence.
I am reading his prayer every day, while fighting for my life, post deadly Sepsis infection, given to me during open heart surgery...
I am grateful that I met him.
I can not thank Pastor John enough. I wish, there were more people, like him on this planet.
