name: First Presbyterian Church Of Newhall - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm and friendly!  Best people I have ever been around.  2 pastors and 2 different kinds of services: one traditional with organ and choir, another contemporary with a great praise band.  Take your pick.  A good place to pray and praise the Lord. The First Presbyterian Church of Newhall is the oldest church in Santa Clarita Valley, Serving Christian Families, since the 1800s. FPCN has  continued in  services to Christ and our community.

A friendly hospital congregation who extends their warmth to you to join us at worship, fellowship, mission, studies, and one of the Presbyterian Women Circles.

See you next Sunday at our service.  Add your strength by sharing your gifts and talents through our many churchwide events and committees.  When you join us, we will become a five-star church.  Everyone is welcomed. The church is a very warm and friendly church where you can become a part of a loving family.  Great children's programs, adult programs, family life trips and events, and all-church events. Lots of mission opportunities and Vacation Bible School for all young children. Great church. Wonderfully welcoming. Should you choose to visit, it is a clique oriented congregation. Should you wish to get involved, beware, the Interim Pastor and some of the congregation might shock you with their actions and lack of caring.

name: First Presbyterian Church of Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary: The church has a beautiful facility and the congregation was very friendly and welcoming during my visit. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this church because they have departed from the biblical qualifications for leadership by having a female pastor. Scripture is clear that the office of elder/pastor is reserved for qualified men (1 Timothy 2:12; 3:2; Titus 1:6). While there were many positive aspects to the visit, fidelity to God's Word must be the top priority for any church. Friendly, astute people in a lovely venue.  Choir and pipe organ were uplifting. I’ve been attending this church since May of this yr. I usually bring a tote that includes my Bible, a book, and my water bottle because I read in the park after. Before I could enter the main chapel a security guard flags me down and demands to see what’s inside my tote and then said “I can’t go in with it”. All that was in my tote was my Bible, another book, my water bottle and my house keys. The gentlemen that always greets me every Sunday then intervenes and tells the security guard “hey totes are actually fine it’s only back packs that are not allowed and he doesn’t have anything bad in his tote” he then tells me that I can go in. A few minutes later I’m sitting and in comes the same security guard with another security guard. Asking about my tote again and to see my tote again. Now the second security guard tells me “you can’t be in here with a bag and you have to put it out side in the cubbies”. These cubbies are meant for kids and they’re literally outside of the actual church building. I’m looking around and countless people had bags in the chapel so I was confused. So I followed the security guard to where he was instructing me to put my tote bag  and I left instead actually because I felt disgustingly disrespected and I doubt I would ever step foot in this church again Great group of people faithfully worshipping God in the Presbyterian tradition Wonderful Christmas and Easter services with beautiful and professional music. Sermons are very thought-provoking and delivered well. My favorite Christmas service this last year was the family service where parents and grandparents brought their littles without having to worry about perfect behavior. There were lots of little voices chiming in. Nobody minded. The Christmas story was read by children and families - so lovely! This seems like a very family-oriented church with many generations. Lots of young people too.

name: First Presbyterian Church of Pittsburgh
reviewSummary:
This was my grandma's church. She passed in the 90s. Christmas eve was the first time I have attended church here since I was a preteen. I was warmly greeted. It truly was a magical service for me. I don't live in the city but I'll do my best to attend here when I can in her honor. Came here on vacation. It is a beautiful building, beautiful people, and an amazing sermon. Most importantly, they have sound doctrine. I would strongly recommend this church to anyone. Visually stunning inside. It's hard to accurately describe how beautiful it is inside. It's even more amazing when you realize how old it is and that this was built over one hundred-fifty years ago. A tip I learned while visiting is that the 30-foot tall doors are so perfectly balanced that 1 person can move them. They ride on tracks in the floor. The stained glass is Tiffany. If you ever get the chance, stop in and look at this place. It's breathtaking. Absolutely stunning. This church has amazing architecture. We went for a pipe and drums concert for New Year's Eve. Everyone was very nice and the music was phenomenal. I felt welcome and at peace 8n this church. The outside and inside are truly breathtaking. Feel so blessed to see this 250 years old church. Woooow 🤷
So nicely built and huge church. Wonderful pastor and Good cooperative members.

name: First Presbyterian Church of Pomona - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: This Church has become an amazing home for our family.  We have become part of the community and share in supporting their very large “free little library” and their community “sharing table”.  The people in this community are thoughtful, engaged, encouraging, loving, funny, and full of Faith & Wisdom.  It’s been a great place for me to continue to grow in my own pursuit of being a disciple of Jesus. First Presbyterian of Pomona (aka Pomona Pres or just Po Pres) has had a long and impactful presence in Pomona in all kinds of ways. I now live in Seattle, but continue to be encouraged by what God is doing through the Pomona Pres folks. The pastor and service is always a great day I love this church community! name: First Presbyterian Church of Portland
reviewSummary:
Beautiful place, very detailed crafted, an amazing art workmanship!
Been here for a few weddings, and was amazed how every chair, every beam, every pillar, every edge is sculpted with an artistic detail. Welcoming, inclusive full communion mainline protestantism ;) and nice snacKing after.  Focused on Love, service, informed by tradition(al) structure plus amazing vintage woodwork sanctuARy. Very welcoming congregation, beautiful sanctuary and music, and engaging Word of God in transitional times. All are welcome and encouraged to attend, either in-person or online. Definitely not going back there. Security guard instantly treated me with suspicion when I walked in and asked to search my bag. He then treated me with more suspicion when I asked to use the restroom. Then during the sermon all they talked about was personal anecdotes and contributing money to the church. They literally did not talk about scripture at all or give a sermon that integrated scripture into how we live our lives. They brought up money at least four times during the sermon. A lot of fluff and rituals, no substance. Just a cult in a beautiful building, that's it. It was back in the early 2000s that I met Dr. Dudley Weaver. He was the Pastor at that time. What a Wonderful Father Figure he was. We spent so much time together online when yahoo was around. I loved just spending time alone online in the chat rooms with our Cams on. He spent so much time developing the underground Parking Garage and I remember the day it was dedicated he came home that afternoon and got online with me and he was so devastated to the point he was almost in tears because he felt he didn’t get the recognition he deserved. I wanted to just hug him and hold him, it made me so sad. He left and went to St Augustine in Florida. Y’all really lost a Great Person in Dudley.  If things had only been different in our lives. I really Wished they had been. I loved him so much.

name: First Presbyterian Church of San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
We love attending this church when we visit San Diego. It is downtown and parking can be difficult to find but the church has two lots available without a fee. The building itself is historic, beautiful and very majestic.
The music is always spectacular! You may hear the band, the organist, the choir or the orchestra. Often, you are privileged to hear all of them.
Pastor Jeff Meyers, the staff and local parishioners are very welcoming without making visitors feel awkward. We often feel like the sermon was written just for us and we don't live in the area to be able to attend regularly. This church has a presence in the downtown community and we feel fortunate to experience or worship here when we are in town. Beautiful building inside and outside. The congregants seem welcoming.
However, I don't think the church wants new members or visitors because there is no place to park. Good luck with the side street parking meters. Most are broken and the last thing one would want is to go into a place of worship to hear a good sermon and come outside to a parking ticket Beautiful historical building. Architecture inside and out is gorgeous. We have attended the Resurrection Presbyterian worshipping community for the past few months and reall enjoy it. Biblical teaching is spot on. Love that Communion is celebrated every week. This church building is stunning and the way they serve the San Diego community is powerful. Come on by and be part of this amazing faith community.  You we be welcomed. I do not attend this church but went to see our son perform with the Pacific Coast Chorale. It's a BEAUTIFUL church with an impressive pipe organ and organ player, I can't remember her name, but she came out of retirement to play, and she was amazing. Folks were very welcoming.

I love this church so much the worship music the pastor explains everything so good that I can understand verses in the Bible. They have a lot of cool church small groups. For example, there's a small group for little kids, teenagers, women Bible study, etc. They have sports camps too. There's so many fun things to do on this church campus. ⛪️ 💖 My wife and I visited many churches right after Covid and found our home at First Redeemer Church. They have wonderful worship, spirit filled messages, incredible Bible classes on Sundays and Wednesdays. The Wednesday night supper is also amazing! We are so happy we found our home at First Redeemer Church! Excellent… beautifully conducted Christ first, driven worship congregation w/ Pastor Jeff.

name: First UMC Preschool and TK of Santa Monica - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
Our experience with First United Methodist Church Preschool has truly exceeded our expectations. The program offers wonderful enrichment opportunities that are thoughtfully integrated into the curriculum, making each day engaging and meaningful. It’s clear that a lot of care has gone into designing a well-rounded experience for the children. Our daughter even asks to go on the weekends!

The staff consistently go above and beyond, creating a warm, nurturing environment where children can thrive. We couldn’t be happier with our experience and highly recommend this preschool. We couldn’t be happier with our experience at First United Methodist Preschool of Santa Monica. The teachers are incredibly caring, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth. The environment feels warm, safe, and thoughtfully structured, and it’s clear how much effort goes into creating a positive experience for both kids and families.

Our daughter looks forward to going every day, which says everything. We’ve seen meaningful development not just academically, but socially and emotionally as well.

We truly can’t recommend this school enough. We couldn’t be happier with First UMC preschool. It’s an incredibly nurturing, supportive environment with fantastic directors, teachers, and strong values.

It also has the BEST hours—an 11-month schedule—and they serve delicious lunch and snacks each day. It’s an incredibly convenient setup for working families.

The yard alone sets it apart—easily the best in Los Angeles (and I’ve looked at just about every preschool). The enrichment is also outstanding.

The community is wonderful—engaged, down-to-earth families that we feel lucky to be a part of. Our child is genuinely happy there, and it shows every day. This is a phenomenal school environment for the little ones! We have been so impressed by the leadership of Dane and Johanna. The classrooms are interactive, organized, colorful and engaging for the kids. They are truly focused on cultivating a safe, loving and nurturing place to raise children into caring adults. Highly recommend this vibrant school community!

name: First United Church - Bloomington - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary: The Pastor is delightful. The Sanctuary is of a contemporary style with lots of wood throughout and is spacious. The facility has been well planned for a living and growing community. name: First United Gospel Assembly - Gulfport Campus
First United Methodist Church
reviewSummary:
Very friendly congregation.  Extremely talented organist and the choir performed perfectly. Join this congregation to get involved in wholesome Sunday morning activities such as displacing the homeless and throwing away their possessions behind their backs!

That group was unfortunate enough to set up camp on their property this last evening, and this morning the congregation was throwing all of their stuff in the trash. 10/10 Christlike behavior right there if you ask me! This place is cool. It makes me sad that I can tell the building really needs some help with upgrades and repairs. Hope funding happens so the building stays with us for years to come.

The people on the other hand and the Reverend are all five star people. I like pastor Elisabeth, she's accepting of all people, she knows the executive laws, and follows Christ's example.  No judgment for being homeless(almost like she's actually read James 2), no judgment for being a transwoman(almost like she's read Matthew 7), no judgment for being LDS(almost like she's actually read Joshua 24 in context, containing verses taken out of context allot) . While I am lds, I left it, became Lutheran for a while, then just a hellion for a while, before reconverting to LDS. While Lutheran and while at a bible camp, I got to see allot of mainstream Christian churches and still like going to different churches, especially this one, pastor Elisabeth is a great lady.  The kind of person you can trust to be a good clergy, and there's plenty of clergy(both inside and outside the lds church)  that probably shouldn't have become clergy.  But I'm not to judge, the powers that be placed them there and they have my respect (Romans 13). I feel like sometimes I'm called to serve as clergy in "the church", the Matthew 18 kind of church (depending on translation) not necessarily what most latter-day saints consider a church (which are officially called meeting houses or stake buildings, fyi) They provide a first of it's kind in slc over night shelter during the frozen days in the winter. Thank you Larry, Pastor AJ and the second and second coalition.

name: First United Methodist Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: I had a really nice time here, and it felt like a good value for the money. The trails gave me more than I expected, with a mix of easy walking and a few steeper spots that kept it interesting. The overlook was worth the trip, especially for the views. Everything felt peaceful and well kept, and the parking fee seemed fair for what you get. I’d definitely come back when I want a solid outdoor break without spending much. The staff and service leaders made the visit feel organized and easy from the start. I attended the Loft service, and the message was clear, thoughtful, and easy to follow. And the people I interacted with were friendly without making it feel forced. Overall, it felt like a welcoming church with a good sense of community. My great-great uncle, Dr. Tom Slaughter helped establish this church. He would be appalled at what it has become. I don’t see that this church can offer people any more than a thousand secular organizations could offer just as well or perhaps even better. Shallow and lack of theological substance. Mother God? We are all grownups and know that God is neither male nor female, but Jesus called Him “Father.” It’s not wise to tell Jesus, “let me correct how you reference God.” Seems like a really nice church. I was only here for a funeral so I can't comment on the regular Sunday worship service. The pastor seemed very nice and well spoken. I was very disappointed when I attended this church. Being a gay man and always dealing with being accepted I definitely didn't feel welcome here. Only one person spoke to me and that was the pastor that was there when I attended. They have a "welcome team" not one spoke and welcomed me. This is sad for our community

name: First United Methodist Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending this church for over a year now and really enjoy it. The church is very welcoming and inclusive of EVERYONE, inspire of race, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, etc. Pastor JT is great. Very friendly and has a great heart. He seek to help nurture people in their faith. One thing I appreciate the most is that he teaches that it is ok to ask questions, and in fact encourages people to ask questions about their faith, and social issues and how the fit within our faith. The church does strive to make a difference in the community through providing a place for homes to shower on Saturday mornings (as well as providing socks and underwear), giving money to various relief programs through the United Methodist Church, participating in the local hunger walk, etc. If you are looking for an inclusive church that doesn't shy away from social issue, this may be the church for you. Dr Darrell Wesley presided over my late son’s funeral service and gave a beautiful eulogy. He did an excellent job and we’re grateful. Losing our 25 year old son was the hardest thing my wife and I have ever endured…by far. If you are tired of evangelical, Trumpism Christianity and need a change. Come be with like minded adults that are environmentally sensitive, believe is social justice and science. You may want to join one of our services at 9:30 am on Sunday and see if we are a good fit. The church members offer an amazing gift to the Homeless and less fortunate of Redlands on a weekly basis by offering hot showers in the morning and an early dinner in the late afternoon on a weekly basis. All who have served the homeless of Redlands are greatly appreciated and thought of fondly. Amazing Pastor and Amazingly  kind and caring people 🙏🏻☝🏻

name: First United Methodist Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: As a member of the unsheltered community I am mostly greeted by coughs and sometimes spit. This congregation are some of the most righteous and kind people in the country, all the while rich too. Majority of wealthy people don't look too kindly on homeless based off my experience in Orange county where I was born. The Methodist Church always makes me feel welcomed and loved. Thank you so much. A welcoming and loving place to worship with great music and children/youth ministries. Excellent Church that has a hot meal every Wednesday from 4-7 and they give out clothing. I was able to get a pair of women's shoes for a friend needing a pair and a pair of pants for another guy who is homeless in a wheelchair. Then we take the meal to a shut in Senior before it gets cold. It's a great resource for helping others less fortunate!💒 This church is outstanding. They go out of their way every week to serve a hot meal to those in need. They also warehouse food, sleeping bags, blankets, clothes and much more to help as well. They have managed to keep this going during this Covid-19 pandemic with changes like masks and social distancing. This church has been providing support through this pandemic, when others have gone. Thank you, the community appreciates you. Small, beautiful place of worship for community residents and visitors. Several community events are held each year, commencing with a cultural affair in September. Congregation is welcoming.

name: First United Methodist Church - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: Hospitality! They make you, your kids, your whole family feel welcome. Beautiful space, with wonderful worship. This is our new home. They share blessings not matter to whom, as the Gospel demands! Is good to know, nowadays there are Jesus followers practicing their faith with fulfilled mercy and joyous This church is a warm, inviting, accepting church.  I was a member here for 12 years and have returned now to visit regularly again.  What strikes me most is how every person is welcome and people are friendly and you instantly feel like you belong there.  The ministers are awesome as well as the choir. I love all the missions that this church has working towards making their community better! Love, love the worship, the music, and the people! Great Chior, but I've been 3x and not once has the pastor reached out to speak to me. Even after service in passing.  I'll go a few more times.

name: First United Methodist Church Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Very Friendly accepting of all who enter their doors. Pastor Val is awesome and welcomes all regardless of their race,religion,or economic status. The church has a large homeless ministry that is open to all on Sunday morning First United Methodist means so much to me and my family.  It truly is a home away from home. It is a beacon in the heart of the city promoting and standing up for justice for ALL. If you truly want to be part of a congregation who supports the community, the entire community, then First United Methodist is the place for you!! LOVE. The best daycare hands down. They support you with Everything and understand you and your child as humans and not just as $$. They try their best to do their best and always make you feel like family and never a burden. I love this school and my son went here for almost 3 years and since then i had twin and a newborn and they would be there as well but currently they have a wait list. They are worth the $. The director is kind and personable and the teachers are beyond loving. If you make your way to the top of the list GO!!! The best child care hands down. The only place I can trust in terms of safety, nutrition and education. Their playground is well kept. All teachers are highly educated. And mu child is happy to go there every day. I am singing in The Messiah on the 15th and really looking forward to it.  It's free there is an offer plate that goes around. The money goes to music scholarships for kids in music here in Charlotte.

name: First United Methodist Church Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
This "All Are Welcome" church fulfills all my spiritual needs. The preaching is always Biblical and aligns my heart, soul, and mind. The option of attending a traditional or a contemporary style service is also welcoming.

But wait. There's more!

I'm a music guy and the 5 music ensembles and amazing musicians add even more energy every Sunday. Additionally the robust Concert Series is a delight. The opportunities to serve those in need are abundant with various local food banks and home building in Mexico. There are also discipleship courses and a dozen Life Groups to encourage deeper relationships and fellowship for all ages and stages of life. Scholarships are available for Summer Camps grades 3-12.

Who could ask for anything more?
A preschool? Yes the church has it's own open 5 days per week! I usually come as a guest with my girlfriend, and wow—this church really impressed me! The atmosphere is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and I’ve always felt accepted, even as a visitor. The sermons are short, concise, and meaningful, and the worship team is truly wonderful.
Oh—and the food! That’s just the icing on the cake.
If you’re looking for a new church home, definitely give FUMC a try. You won’t be disappointed! I absolutely love my church, First United Methodist of Chula Vista! The traditional and contemporary services are both inspiring, and the preaching and music are  exceptional.  There are 2 adult choirs, a children's choir and a Praise Band that includes some of our talented youth. There are Life Groups, Discipleship classes, Women's Fellowship and a Men's group.  Activities for children include an active Children's Ministry program and busy youth group.  We invite our pre-School families to participate in community events like Vacation Bible School, Trunk or Treat, and a yearly Easter Egg Hunt Celebration. The church sends lots of children and youth to summer camps, and a large number of our congregation travel to Ensenada every January to build homes for needy families.  FUMCCV offers something for everybody.  It is a special place where you can grow in your faith and where everyone is welcome! My family and I have been worshipping here for many years. We were looking for a church that was welcoming, had childrens ministries and good sermons on how to be more Christlike. We found this and a whole lot more. We quickly became part of the First United Methodist family by helping to build a house in Ensenada. On that trip we made amazing friendships rooted in our Christian faith and passion to help others in needs.  We attend the contemporary service at 11am which has an amazing crossing band and is in the fellowship hall which is a little more informal. There is also a more traditional service at 9:30 in the church that has an amazing choir. I highly recommend First United Methodist Church to anyone looking for a place to worship where ALL are welcome! FUMCCV has been my family's home church for over 20 years. This is a church community that year after year, continues to teach us the love of Jesus; to lift up the other, to value the forgotten, to love our neighbor, and to care for the least and the lonely. Come and join us in worship.

name: First United Methodist Church Of Akron - Akron Campus
reviewSummary: This is a very lovely pretty  church. I was a member of the old one that burnt down which was pretty too. It's been along time since I have been there. But this church is as giving, friendly, and welcoming  as ever. It has a choir that sings beautifully . Friendly greeter and ushers. And a most friendly congregation.  Also a pastor that keeps you engaged with a great sense of humor.  Thank you for welcoming my family. I think very very highly of this church they help the community so much they're also affiliated with Jesus said which is a non-profit great organization they feed the public they closed them and they give you all the spiritual things that you need there are preachers to talk to there is one in particular Pastor Howard and Pastor Bill they are great guys and they are very close to God and they inspire me and they feed me spiritually I have been away for a few weeks I have to get back to them because I'm in dire need how Jesus and they can fulfill all the needs that I have How kind of this church to welcome Gospel Meets Symphony! It is a beautiful church and I appreciate the ample parking. This is where I worship God every Sunday. All are welcome to come and her the word of God. Either at 10 am or 1130 am Great place free meals on Saturday at 9am and Tuesday at 11am.

name: First United Methodist Church of Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful people.  They would do anything to help. Great place to worship. Offering meals through out the  Holidays, as you can see in the photos.  It has been a blessing to know each and every one of them. They care more about virtue signaling than preaching truth.

No wonder your memberships are dwindling. Hope you close soon. Stand for nothing, fall for anything. located next to the Capital of TEXAS., This church community stand tall with faith as a service to a community in need.  What GOD has call us to do? How has others have effected your life?  This church cares. They feed those who hunger ( tues & thurs) and clothed the homeless (Thurs)  they help the addict with out judgement ( AA & Oxford House).  How do I know?  😎I was the homeless and addicted that was helped by this church I'm ONLY leaving 5 stars because the staff that took care of me at the event yesterday where phenomenal and it shouldn't take away from the wonderful experience I had but I am a homeless black woman who has went through unimaginable experiences and yesterday a man not only had the confidence of walking in the Women's restroom while I was on the toilet but announced he was coming in when I already had a woman come in and talk with me he had NO RIGHT to violate my privacy. I was very uncomfortable and told him to Leave immediately and to get a woman. I will NOT be returning as I was looking forward to attending Sunday services. Really HATE that experience occurred and pray that other homeless women don't have to experience the disrespect I did just because of her disposition 😔 This church also serves as a hub for the unhoused and those in need alike,here they have what you call the big breakfast on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30 a.m., during the big breakfast, you can also take a shower and ask for a voucher to wash your clothes, coffee is also offered and you can get as many cups as you need, this church also serves as a A.A. meeting place or gathering days vary,, and remember to always ask for other resource information from around the city

name: First United Methodist Church of Chicago - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
This was a phenomenal experience. The Chapel in the Sky is a treasure that is steeped in history.
David was our tour guide and he was extremely knowledgeable of both the Temple downstairs as well as the Chapel in the Sky. I loved it!! Musicians were excellent and the venue in downtown Chicago was beautiful. ABBA and Queen are two of my favorites. Unbelievable place, it was my first time visiting the sanctuary and the chapel. It's a pity the service was over when I came. I took a picture of the schedule in case you need it. I was lucky to have a tour to the sky chapel. Magical place! I believe it's not just the building - David definitely shares his admiration and his love for this place. I am stunned. This is my new  place of strength and inspiration in Chicago. Thank you to the community and thanks Mrs. Walgreens. As a newly immigrant you do have times when you're very close to giving up, days and places like this help you along the way.
I want to finish my review with the words of Psalm that David quoted to me when he showed the main window:
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! With love, your Ukrainian visitor. This review is for the Grace Place homeless services from approx. 2020-23. They were hit-or-miss. There would be free coffee and food and clothing, but sometimes the volunteers or partner organizations were judgmental. There was a legal aid org there to help with guaranteed income applications. I requested help and was rebuffed, possibly due to my race, gender, and overall presentation. This would have been a life-changer, and it's inexcusable that a group came by to offer help, then cherry-pick the homeless people they preferred. Did the free tour with Jerry as the guide and it was great! Great piece of Chicago and Methodist history!

name: First United Methodist Church of Colorado Springs
reviewSummary: Historic downtown cathedral and vibrant Prairie campus. Known for rich musical heritage, caring pastoral ministries, and active community outreach.

name: First United Methodist Church of Coral Gables & The Growing Place School - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
We went for a Sunday drive shortly after Christmas to explore the town of Coral Gables and saw the magnificent  Birth of Jesus Christ - Holy Nativity scene display in the front of the First United Methodist Church.  These were tall sculptured figures. You couldn't miss them.  We were awe-struck at how beautiful the display was!. Not only the statues of Mary, ,Joseph and baby Jesus but also the animals, the shepards, and the Three Wise Men. A beautiful and meaningful sight to see what Christmas is really all about. We were touched deeply.

We didn't go inside the church as we are not members and the church was not open. We had our wedding here, and so glad we did! Everyone was super helpful, professional, and friendly.
Pastor Lucas made us feel very comfortable during the ceremony. He made us feel at ease, and we were so happy with how the ceremony turned out. He was also super friendly, and had a good sense of humor!
Laura, the wedding coordinator for the church, was also great. She had great customer service skills, and was also flexible, responsive, and accommodating.
The soloist we hired for our ceremony was also A+, highly recommend her!
Besides all that, the church is really big and beautiful :)
We were very happy on our special day! Very grateful to the church and their staff. What an amazing and loving place! The Children and Youth Ministry directors are wonderful. The kids have so much fun. The church is beautiful and the ministries do an incredible job. They welcome everyone with a friendly smile and loving arms. My family and I are so grateful to call FUMCCG our home! Our son has attended The Growing Place since he was in the early 2s program and we love the school. The staff is very caring and it is a great environment for the kids. Good service

name: First United Methodist Church of Costa Mesa - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: So Amazing! You must go you you won’t regret it! Such a beautiful church! I photographed a wedding here and it was filled with such warm and welcoming people. The sanctuary and exterior architecture are gorgeous! The venue, staff and musicians were all awesome.  It was our first time and definitely a different way to appreciate holiday music. I attended an AA meeting last Sunday with a friend for her homework. It was Great these people really care about staying sober and so honest. Don't know much about the church but it had a lot of stained glass windows and I love stained glass windows. Outstanding Christmas concert by 4 very talented and personable musicians.

name: First United Methodist Church of Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor and assistant pastor very warm
Engaged and connected with everyone And friendly. Messaging applies to real life and real time.Able to talk about the Bible in easy way to understand and able to pick up the message. Years ago I used to be a Methodist church member.  While visiting in Glendale, CA., I decided to visit this church on the Sunday that I was there. Enjoyed it tremendously the choir is phenomenal! CAB :) Wonderful music ministry and the choir is fantastic Great old church with lots of amenities such as meeting halls and classrooms. Really good place. The people are really nice. Activities are really fun.

name: First United Methodist Church of North Hollywood - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly people worshipping Jesus. It has an early 20th century feel in architecture, but a very welcoming, diversified 21st century vibe. Impressed with the church interior and wedding arrangement. My Grandparents belonged to the church that began before it was built. My Grandfather helped to build this church and attended and served in it from the 1st day when Dr. Boyer began preaching there. My grandmother was head of the Prayer chain and dialed thousands of numbers on a rotery phone asking for prayers. My parents were married Here. My grandparents memorial services were here. I attended until I was 40 and only stopped because my Grandfather had passed in 2002 at 89 yrs of age and my Grandmother passed in 2008 at age 91 and I had moved out of state. I love this church and am so glad it is still so well loved and attended!
I'm only saddened to see that it's diverted away from scripture to not uphold God's plan and commandments of Love while not supporting distortions of Gender and sexuality. I always think of Jordan's catholic school from The Bernie Mac show. RIP Bernie Mac This is the beautiful church! Sydney Andrews died on the show Melrose Place in 1997 here.😢 One of the most beautiful churches ever.❤️

reviewSummary: A warm, genuine church family. Excellent praise band and very practical sermons. Very inclusive, supportive, and active in local downtown outreach and ministries.

name: First United Methodist Church of Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful and welcoming place in the heart of Downtown Orlando. The building has a great atmosphere, the staff and community are friendly, and it’s a peaceful spot with a strong sense of history. The location is convenient, surrounded by downtown attractions, and the overall experience feels warm and inviting. A great place to visit whether you’re attending an event, service, or simply appreciating the architecture and community. What a beautiful venue for the Comissions on Homelessness Central Florida meeting. The restrooms here were clean and well maintained. The church is huge with 3 levels. Enjoyed the meeting, and what a wonderful experience at First UMC! The First Church community has the nicest people. Truly welcoming of everybody and great messages about how to be better people. Great ways to plug in and do service too.

Love this place! Wow what a great graduation celebration for my neighbor son. The food was beyond you imagination all catered by one lady and help. The Decoration was immaculate with good friend. and church members with other neighbors. A lot of planning and work went into the most small details. The First United Methodist  Church of Orlando is a very beautiful building and taken care of it's preservation and up keep. All my life I never new that there was a parking garage under the church. With elevator to bring you to the main floor.
A warn felt sent off for her son a single mother raised him proper with good character and proper morals. Hat is off to Jose Andre graduate and mother's Lydie Pierre, GOD mother Ms., Lisa Ansley. This was just beautiful.  A quartet playing as if it was a hundred musicians.  I love Vivaldi's four seasons and every piece was played beautifully.

name: First United Methodist Church of Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: It is a beautiful church, imbued with a spiritual energy that makes you feel safe. The people there are kind, and the Sunday service possesses a beautiful sense of sanctity. Everyone is welcome here. I made a stop at this location in order to place a request for "Meals on Wheels ". Very kind and loving staff. Extremely helpful. Patti, was very nice to answer my inquiries and very helpful. Yesterday, the youth at our church,  First United Methodist in Pasadena, came out and painted anti-graffiti paint on the mural that are nonprofit commissioned to depict the history of the Once thriving African-American Business district on North fair Oaks.  Was a joy to see them work so hard and have fun.  I love this church. I felt very loved and supported in our housing justice work we do.  People are genuine and real and totally committed to serving the community and beautiful ways.  Pastor Amy  really understands grace and how to love and fully accept people. We are all on a journey to follow the command that the Apostle Paul in the Bible gave us to accept one another  even as Christ has accepted us.  I feel that in this church. Love the interior decor of the church. They have amazing Organ and colorful stained glass. The ceiling is so pretty. The acoustic is wonderful. Even though it doesn't have air-conditioning, but it's wonderful architecture! It is lucky for me to have the chance to perform with a Choir in this famous church with long history. Very sacred and beautiful place to sing the song for Glory of the God and I really enjoy it.

name: First United Methodist Church Of Riverside - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I've been Enjoying the Services off & on for 2 months. Last Sunday Before Easter Pastor J.T. KIM Delivered a Very Passionate Sermon on the Life of Paul-Saul of Tarsus! I studied Theology in the late 70's - early 80's & Paul was my favorite of All of the Early leaders in the Christian world! I So Enjoyed his Sermon that I am going to continue to attend First UMC and, hopefully, get to meet with others & attend Bible Studies too@ Currently My grandughter attends nursery school there so did my other grandkids. Years ago 😁 my daughter and nephew. Outstanding nursery wonderful teachers and staff. Lots of supervision on the playground and lots of bikes slides etc. Not like kindergarden at public schools not sure why they removed all playground equipment. So happy my family was able to enjoy First Methodists nursery school.😊😊 Group meetings all week. Nice grounds. Great meeting place. Plenty of parking. Different groups meet there. It's really a nice Church on the inside. Kind of Oh that is in really great shape. I'm not sure when it was build. Said it has been there for a while. You can tell just by looking at the architect Friendly and inviting. Nice choir. Beautiful stained glass windows.

name: First United Methodist Church of San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you would have told my younger self who gave up on the Catholic Church, all churches AND God that we’d become a member of a new church, I would have laughed and continue my self-destructive behaviors to prove that there is no God.

Sounds dramatic right? But 100% true. Until something in my heart started to call out for something greater than myself. That call led me here to this church. There’s so many things that I didn’t like about religion, church and what was being fed to us. But, this place spoke to me.

This IS a reconciling congregation and I love that. I love how the pastors are women from different ethnicities. I love how they unapologetically connect scripture to the world we live in today. I love how there’s traditional service with choir and organ music but if you’re uncomfortable with that, the church also has a contemplative way of worship. The organist and choir has my head bobbing to all the notes lol. I love that they integrate technology in a way that I’ve never experienced at another church including a podcast! I love that there’s many ministries and different ways to be of service. All to say, I love church, I love God and I love the spiritual journey I’m on.

At the end of the day, it’s up to you to come and decided if this church is a good fit. To really experience and take it all in. Not what these reviews say, including my own, not what your family or friends say, but you and only you. Centrally located Church in Mission Valley. Off I-8,  Texas St. Mid-day/Mid-Month events for seniors & singles. Bible study, and Wednesday Organ Concerts!!! 🎶🎹🎼 Very hostile and unwelcoming environment.  If you have traditional beliefs they will make you feel like you are evil.  They care more about promoting their leftist political beliefs, than bringing people to God. We were there for Grossmont High School Choir Spring Festival. It is a beautiful church and we are very grateful for being allowed to perform there. Forget about all of the should's of Christianity, Give yourself 2 or 3 minutes to just sit and be with God. No itinerary, No list of shoulds, Just be present like you're with a loving parent. All God ever wanted was to be with you Just the way you are.!!!

name: First United Methodist Church of Santa Ana - Main Campus
reviewSummary: A historic church in Downtown Santa Ana with a huge heart for community outreach and serving local families.

name: First United Methodist Church Of Torrance - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm visiting my brother here in Cal
This is my second time coming here
Unfortunately they having some issue between their pastor and some members
Hope and Pray that they can resolve whatever it is Aca meetings there Monday and Wed nights...strong support...all you need is the desire to recover from a DYSFUNCTIONAL family...if your human...this means YOU! Provides Homeless meals Clothing and Shower needs Don especially a Very nice man A very nice and diverse church with lots of good people. Very open and welcoming. Lovely people with a outstanding Pastor

name: First United Methodist Church of Tucker - Tucker Campus
reviewSummary:
My heart is with this church. From my first visit to Georgia the Lord lead me to this church. It has played a pivotal part in my journey. My wife and I got engaged in December 2017 just after the annual Christmas play. The people are great and the word of God is very active here. A very warm and friendly family environment. Children will love the various ministries that cater to them. There are free keyboard and music lessons on Wednesdays, and many other free services. I love attending Tucker First UMC in Tucker, GA. The church has wonderful Sunday worship services (traditional and modern) but it also has a ministry for every member of the family. We have active ministries for music & arts, children, youth, and missions as well as a wide variety of classes and Bible studies.

I fell in love with this church the first time I visited because it felt like home. You could feel its history in the walls and in the people but you also got a sense that the congregation knew to keep pressing forward and not rest on the laurels and achievements of the past. One of the Atlanta area churches that offers support to the homeless. Showers, laundry, and a meal on Sundays. Friendly, kind-hearted volunteers. Thank you First Methodist of Tucker for your help and hospitality. This story began 23 years ago.  I gave my heart to Christ our Lord in 1996 at a Unitarian church.  Shortly afterwards, that sweet little Church closed its doors.  Being a minority, a US citizen, who has been in this country for 49 years, living in the South, I've encountered a lot of prejudice, snide remarks, and all else that goes along with 'looking' different and not having been born here, by the GRACE of GOD.   I've attended many churches during special holidays throughout the years and have met many "Christians" who talk a great deal about God - but don't follow neither the 10 Commandments nor the New Covenant delivered to us by our King, Lord and Savior.  All of that left me disillusioned with organized religion.

Many of the "Christians" I've encountered are really good people, they do good deeds and care for others, but every once in a while in conversation it would slip... that deep down they didn't see the Christ in those less fortunate or marginalized.  Everything Christ taught us NOT to do.
The prejudices towards those who don’t look, live, or believe exactly as they do was palatable to me, being an empath and highly sensitive to the deep feelings of others...

I finally gave up on finding another church like Unity, where I felt accepted and loved for who I truly am in my Soul, just a couple of millimeters below my outer exterior.  I worshiped at home in my own way, doubted God even existed on many occasion... but God in his wisdom and grace, continued to be patient and kind.  He never gave up on ME.  Then one day, a sweet and dear friend of mine from High School invited me to see her husband Michael Duffee perform (sing and play his guitar) at their church. God has blessed him with a beautiful voice, musical talent, and kind loving soul who is admired and loved by all those who are blessed to know him.  The contemporary service was fun and uplifting.

Being a music lover, I was hooked on the loving, positive energy I felt each time I visited. So, every chance I could, I joined Nancy at her church.  Then, one day... life took an amazing turn.  On Easter Sunday 2019, I was so blessed to attend the tradition service.  Pastor Gerald, a Godsend, explained the true meaning of Easter like I'd never heard it before.  In simple terms, he explained the HOPE that our King bestowed upon mankind when He rose from the dead and why there was so much reason to be happy, not sad about the Crucifixion.  He said, "not only do we not have to fear death, but we also no longer have to fear LIFE." That ONE sermon, in an instant, literally healed my heart.

I left that day as a NEW person, literally.  Gone was the pain, the weight, and the worry of the world I've been carrying for 40 plus years.  A few weeks later, on Mother's Day 2019, the Holy Spirit called me to take the final step towards accepting Christ once again, as my King, Lord, and Savior.... and at the end of Pastor Gerald's sermon, he always asks if there is anyone there who feels the calling to join their ministry.  I felt a voice inside saying… NOW, go now!  I walked down to Pastor Gerald, with my dear friend by my side, and took the vow to join this amazing place of worship.  All those I've met at Tucker First United Methodist are some of the most caring, truly loving, and accepting people I've ever met.  They're not just talking the talk, they're walking it with everything they do for their communities and outreach to those less fortunate, here in their own community and beyond.

I've finally found my forever Spiritual home... a place where I can continue to grow, worship, help others, and live my life as a true Disciple.  I can't say enough about this amazing Church, Pastor, and Church Family.   For the first time in decades, I finally feel WHOLE again.  I hope you decide to visit this sweet little church to see and feel the Love and kindness for yourself.   Excellent message from the pastor. Awesome music, especially the organ! People were welcoming. Felt that God is at work here.

name: First United Methodist Church of Upland, California - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: The church was the perfect location for my mother's funeral service. Lesa was there ever step of the way.  The hall for lunch afterward was conveniently located on the grounds and had a full industrial kitchen. They have a preschool. The directors and teachers are great. They are very kind and do not allow yelling at the children, it is a kind discipline school. They play areas are really neat. The teachers are very hands on and the children are just lovely. Beautiful church and great location downtown Upland This beautiful brick church with its friendly welcoming congregation is special for many reasons. It has many outreach opportunities, is a beautiful setting for weddings, and is a peaceful refuse for prayer as well as for funerals. Service and fellowship bind together all facets of this loving community.  They also have a marvelous preschool. Beautiful historic sanctuary. Perfect facility for a wedding, memorial service.

name: First United Methodist Church Winter Park - Winter Park Campus
reviewSummary: Good church with activities and learning and growth opportunities  for all ages. Many opportunities to connect and give back to the community.Open to member input and suggestions.  Eager to include persons at whatever level or interest without being too pushy. Have to say that parking is awful and difficult to come by all the time. But I don't know how to make that  better considering it's beautiful location. Parking attendents available at important times but parking can still be daunting I am new to Florida as a resident. My experience at this place of worship has been exhilarating! I came here heavily burdened and stressed. I’m still experiencing separation anxiety, but the more I surround myself with positive affluence, the better I feel. Everyone has been so welcoming and personable. My goal is to become active in the community of which I want to reside until God sends me elsewhere. I prayed for God to enlarge my territory just as He did for Jabez. However, I wasn’t expecting Him to answer me so quickly or perfectly. I did not expect to be placed in what most would consider a heaven on Earth; a Utopia. Serenity is an understatement and does the description of my experience thus far no justice. Yes, there have been growing pains such as adjusting to the rainy season and the intense heat for a short period of time, but I don’t remember that as much as I remember the sun shining every single day that I have been here!  God is merciful and kind and always willing to do what our heart desires even when we are uncertain or apprehensive. Change is necessary but can be difficult. We must learn to trust our Heavenly Father in everything and at all times. There may be times we will go outside the lines when exercising our free will, yet we will soon realize that it’s during those times that God’s Grace covers us beyond measure. We don’t always understand God’s plans , especially when we’ve made our own (lol), but He will help us to realize that He makes no mistakes and that He knows best...ALWAYS... Wonderful people and a beautiful place to find peace from the storm, and worship our Lord. Friendly and with many activities and programs. Great for families with young childd3. Prayer chapel, open to the public. We pray here often.

name: First United Methodist Church-Downtown Orange Preschool - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Very grateful for this Church for hosting my dear friend’s Memorial service and reception. How in the world can you give a place of worship anything but 5 stars?!? They were very welcoming to our group and provided great hospitality to us. Its a nice church that caters to a diverse community excellent place to worship God!! I go every Sunday morning church  YES I am an member of the  Methodist church
