name: First United Methodist Church-Santa Monica - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: As a queer millennial, I know personally how rough it can be finding loving and accepting Christian spaces, especially in the current political climate. This church community has always been a safe and supportive space for me and my friends. Their go to hymm has always been “All Are Welcome”. There is no pressure to be at every service, no fear of not fitting one mold of Christianity. You are free to question religion here, free to explore your personal beliefs here and free to be authentic to you. First UMC Santa Monica has become my home away from home and I always feel a little bit more love walking through their doors. I went there to see a choir with a full orchestra. The church is beautiful. Come a little early. The parking lot is across the street. The street. Very handicap friendly. I've been attending Santa Monica FUMC for over 30 years and it's still my favorite place to be on Sunday mornings! Great spiritual community that provides opportunities for growth and fellowship, as well as service. Come check it out and look for me! went to Easter service today and it was really terrific.  A beautiful church and very friendly people.   The story of Easter was powerfully conveyed and the choir and organ music was beautiful! Wow!  The Christmas music program on Sunday was superlative! extraordinary!  The instrumental interludes to the carols were inspirational.  Thank you to all who participated.

name: First United Presbyterian Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Reverend Small will "knock your socks off" with his sermons. I have heard him preach at First Presbyterian Church Charlotte, and he is awesome. If you want to hear the word of God, listen to Reverend Small. He'll open your eyes, your ears, your heart and your mind. Thank God for Reverend Small. Great venue to host catered meals in conjunction with the QCT Charlotte Black/African-American Heritage Tour by Queen City Tours and Travel. Staff is very friendly and accommodating and the banquet hall very clean. This is my church so maybe I lack objectivity but if you ever want a feeling of Family, community and a true understanding of the word this is the church to join. I have been a member for three years and believe this was an excellent decision. Great Pastor, thoughtful, caring and supportive congregation...please come visit us, 11 am Sunday service. They offer dinner and jazz every first Friday. Unfortunately December is the close of an era

name: First United Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: First United Reformed Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: A true reformed church, confecional, covenental and calvinistic, where christ is preached and the call of the Gospel goes forth every Lords day. A church who is doing God's work It is a traditional church with hymn books, choirs, and a message for you from our Lord. Nice, friendly people. Come visit us! Engaging sermons, preaching Christ from the whole Bible. Great preaching and sweet fellowship.👍☺

name: First Works Baptist Church - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: I am convinced that Pastor Bruce Mejia and Pastor Steven Anderson will be part for the 24 elders seated by God's throne. Thank you for preaching the clear bible way to heaven. My church, word of life slavic basptist church in Portland OR, does not preach that faith alone in Jesus saves you. It is hard to listen to because all glory belongs to Christ! There is nothing I can do to justify myself before God! Believing on Christ is the only way to get saved. All our righteousness are as filthy rags! Thank you for being the voice of reason, may the Lord Bless you and your families. This church and its pastor are solid on the Gospel. The KJV is their final authority. Pastor Bruce Mejia loves the Lord, the church has been through trials and tribulation. They, even they were bombed by  LGBTQAYZ+, only for standing on the Word of God. One of the BEST CHURCHES, hands down, in the world. This is my church when I’m visiting my hometown. If you’re looking for a church, look no further. May God bless you. Beautiful church, I would definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for depth and real teachings. The pastor was spot on, making the message of the Lord easy to hear. Very refreshing hard to find a church on this level. Hard preaching. Real preaching. Recommended by Pastor Steven Anderson thru faithful world Baptist website. So thankful. I’ve been looking for a church of this caliber. Old school vibes. Welcoming, safe, kids friendly, family integrated, strong and clear preaching, great hymns and happy people.

name: Fishers Church of Christ - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: I am hoping to make the Fishers area my home one day and have been looking for a bible-based church, which obeys all the commands of God. I have been listening to sermons online and I am very excited to join the congregation some day. Had a great time visiting this morning.  Very kind, friendly, and engaging people.  Great lesson with a well delivered application.  Thank you so much for making us feel welcome! Great church.  Fundamental Bible preaching and driven to spread the Gospel. Love this church! They really follow the Bible and love one another. This Church has helped me to forward to vote my life to God. This is a place that is very friendly and focuses on bringing people to Christ. The teaching and preaching is all centered on the Bible. If you are looking for a church without all the extra things of the world then this is the place for you.

name: Fishers United Methodist Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve not attended any of their services. However I saw a post from one of my fishers facebook groups that this church was giving away free pumpkins and I went and it was pumpkins galore. I loved it ! The associate pastors wife was so nice and LITERALLY let people how ever many pumpkins they wanted. Congratulations on meeting your mission goal !!! This church offers a public pantry for this living in Hamilton County that have encountered life situations that make it difficult to buy groceries and provide healthy nourishment for themselves and their family. They are very hemoglobin and encouraging and provide the spiritual support if requested. They provide a variety of staples as well as other products that vary by availability. They are sure to meet your needs of you find yourself in this unfortunate situation and need uttermost help. I recommend that you check them out as your need arises or donate items for them to use for distribution to others. Prayer is a wonderful part of the service and sermons are thought provoking. Homeless outreach and food pantry help the community. People are welcoming. Satan will always point out the negative about every church to keep you away, so be wise to this. We really enjoy attending Fishers United Methodist Church. We have met wonderful people and have enjoyed attending Truck or Treat, Vacation Bible School, the church wide Thanksgiving dinner and Upward Basketball.

It seems the church is always busy and there is something for everyone: bible studies, book clubs, plays, bell choir, youth group, confirmation classes - the list goes on.

It makes us proud that the church sponsors the Come to Me Food Pantry - so many families in Hamilton County are able to feed their families thanks to this pantry.

We also like that the church is always striving to better itself - to find out what it's congregation enjoys and doesn't enjoy - it's never stagnant.

All in all, we consider this our church, perhaps it's not for everyone, but it is for us. Ugh.  Visited twice.  First time, kids had fun at Sunday school back in Spring 2012.  Went back recently (Fall 2012).  Seems like a very different place.  Kids still had fun in SS but everything seems to have changed. Different people running Sunday school, not so warm and fuzzy.  In Spring, and after reading vision statement on their website, I had the impression that this church was money hungry but after recent sermon, it was confirmed for me. The pastor gave a sermon where he tried to shame people into giving more money.  Pastor seems like he wants to build a huge church to compete with the big churches in the area.  Newsflash! Not every body wants a big church!  Nothing seems very real, bunch of plastic Christians led by a poser.  Going to find a smaller church where people are friendly and real, warts and all.
If you are the kind of person who goes to church to be seen, and you don't mind sermons begging you to empty your pockets so the pastor can be glorified by building a big church, then go here. Otherwise, move on.

name: Five Rivers Church - Kettering / South Dayton Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church! Good church

name: Five-Fold Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Apostle Kathryn Krick leads this lively Christian church. If you are not able to attend in person, you can watch the Sunday service on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Most of the in-person services take place at the Belasco Theatre. I have been planted at 5F for almost 4 years now, and I have received so much from our Father through the pastor, Apostle Kathryn Krick.  This church truly feels like the Book of Acts come alive.  There are countless miracles and testimonies of God's people being set free.  God's anointing is truly moving through his obedient vessels, and this church is living proof.  All are welcome here.  My prayer is that God would spark curiosity in everyone who hears about or comes across this church online.  May hearts continue to be transformed and drawn closer to Jesus Christ as the good news spreads that God's Revival is here NOW.  May all who have ears to hear receive the good news, and become vessels that share it with others. I’ve gone to many churches in the Los Angeles area and this church is hands down my favorite! God is really moving powerfully here! I struggled with anxiety and depression and conception issues and since coming to this church, I’ve not only been completely set free of anxiety and depression and had a miracle baby, but I also have continued to be equipped for spiritual warfare, grown in my relationship with God, grown in the fruits of the spirit, and matured spiritually. Apostle Kathryn Krick’s teachings are filled with the Holy Spirit and I gain revelation every time! Another great thing about this church is the people! It’s such a pure-hearted, non-judgemental, wonderful family with a fire for God and heart for others. The worship team is really amazing too! I look forward to every Sunday service and love listening to the teachings on podcast or YouTube! I highly recommend checking it out! Revival is truly now at 5F church and for the whole world. Apostle Kathryn is a pure true servant of God. I have been delivered of anxiety, paranoia, desire to drink and smoke, severe nightmares, sexual dreams, lust and unwanted impure thoughts, generational curses of rage, control and manipulation. Truly so much more. I’ve been healed of constant sickness, old injuries that never healed properly, impacted wisdom tooth, years of hip pain and more! By Gods power moving here at 5F church! All glory to God! I’m no longer stuck going around in circles in my faith. I am growing through the teachings and Gods power. The community is on fire for God and full of Christ love. If you need healing, freedom or fire of God you have found the place. God is pouring out His love and power like I’ve never witnessed before! Thank You, Jesus! I started watching videos from 5F Church in 2021 when I was hungry and seeking for more of God. I was completely in awe as I listened to Apostle Kathryn preach because it was simple and powerful, my spirit was leaping within me and I soon planted myself at 5F Church. From that moment, Jesus began to revive my life, He delivered me from fear, panic attacks, rejection, trauma, depression, and more! For the first time I learned that as a child of God I have authority over the devil! As I began walking in that authority I saw the devil flee and victory came! This was mindblowing for me because I had grown up going to church, but never seen change and freedom in my life that I longed for, but the anointing God has entrusted to Apostle Kathryn began to pour into my life and I got to taste abundant life!! Since then, I have remained firmly planted, and Jesus has taken me from glory to glory, I have received more peace, joy and walk in overwhelming victory over the devil! REVIVAL IS NOW! I encourage you to come to 5F Church and experience God’s power and love for yourself! Glory to God!
/Mirjam

name: Five14 Church - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Don't know why they are trying to make the church look as cool as possible god doesn't care what it looks like?? Also they were doing way to much for the last Celly they had, like how did you just have 10k lying around to rent bounce houses and A zip line + a lot more😭🙏 It is a beautiful church full of wonderful people. I’ve only been there once so far but now that the weather is nice I plan to attend more often. Really welcoming and engaging leadership makes for an environment that feels safe to worship without shame or self-consciousness.  I would recommend both to life-long church attendees and newcomers. ❤️✨❤️✨ They also have world-class youth ministry and childcare. I love this place when we are in Columbus, the music is great, the message is always good, they also have coffee for right before service, and a bungalow area for if you dont want your kids to go to the kids center. Five14 is a great non-denominational church!  The people make you feel welcome, the worship service is awesome, and the message is practical and inspiring.  Love visiting this church when I am in town!

name: Flatirons Community Church - Aurora Campus - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary: This church hit all of my key points for a church in the western civilization apathy world of churches.  There was a mass baptizing on Easter which was phenomenal.  Churches wont survive or thrive if they don't believe in these fundamentals and teach them.  Spiritual fruit; love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.  Then there are the spiritual gifts, laying on hands and healing, casting out demons, prophecy, bringing the seemly dead back to life, miracles and speaking in tongues.  Some people might have one or two or none, but I tried and each time I did postured my heart for God.  He came through in all three, so when you pray earnestly for the above gifts, God heals almost immediately thousands upon probably over a million but God and Jesus advise to tell no one.  Because then you are exploiting yourself and not God.  But just doing in secret if possible.  But what God commands above all others, is the Great Commision.  The only thing we can take to heaven is others, God commanded this not just for the extroverts, or people who have time for it.  He commanded ALL.  This church believes in these, as I do.  Will never belong to a mainstream church, catholic, baptist, presbyterian, etc.  They bring their laws not Gods.  Its just religon.  True believers align with God not men. We’ve been attending Flatirons Aurora for a little over a year now and we love it so much! At first was a little skeptical with it being a satellite location and having the “we can watch at home mindset” but it so much more than that. The community there is just so welcoming. We’ve been fortunate to meet lots of wonderful people here. My kids have loved being part of their kids ministry and VBS during the summer! It’s a smaller church part of an even bigger community but I love the small church feel. First campus visit-have been online member for years.  Welcoming & friendly hospitality.  Lots of hugs between bro’s & sis’s in Christ! Pastor Josh and the staff here are amazing and pour the love of Jesus into the community.  The fellowship I have found here means the world to me. My son loves youth group and camp in the summer. If you feel lost or broken, this is the place for you. I love the worship team and the message Jim be bringing on a screen. Unfortunately it seems like you need to have your life together, to be able to be part of their church family. No email back from pastors or no call from staff  just to check up on you when they know you have a serious life problem going on.

name: Flatirons Community Church Longmont Campus - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary: Perfect gateway church to be introduced into the body of Christ! They were very welcoming at the door and provided so much information about the Holy Spirit and how Christianity works since I’m new!! I can’t wait to leave this church to go and make disciples of Jesus! We love coming here for the message and filling our service cup. Jim is the best pastor that we have experienced since being here in CO. We have been to the main campus in Lafayette, and since moving north, we now attend the Longmont campus. Watching the stream, to me, is no different than seeing him Jim person. He is relatable and personable. The staff at Longmont has been so welcoming and amazing. The lead pastor for the Longmont campus always greets us with a warm greeting. We also love serving along with the other amazing volunteers. We feel at home here! Who doesn't love Flatirons?! If you want somewhere that feels like home and will impact your life for the better, give it a try. You will be surprised to find that when you keep going that God will do wonderful things in your life and you will learn so much along the journey. The staff and so warm and caring. Church leadership is astounding. If you want to have church leadership that teaches relevant things in needed times you are at the right place.....and they throw in humor to keep it engaging so you listen to the important nuggets in the service. Love Pastor Jim. He is the one that kept me coming back week after week so I could grow spiritually. It has been a very tough year and was able to get through it with God's love and grace. Oh and Dawn with Kids Min is one of the most special people you will meet. Such an amazing heart. ❤️ Powerful singing,  and a wonderful sermon.  It will be my church now All I Can tell you after attending this church and volunteering at this church for many years , is that this is a horrible nonbiblical church focused on fame and fortune.

name: Fletcher Hills Presbyterian Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: This church is incredible and I highly recommend for those seeking a judgment free community where you can learn and grow in your faith. The people and pastor are loving and kind to all. The kids Sunday school is great for our kids (infant through high school ages available) and for us. We love the unique blend of traditional scripture teaching and modern worship.

name: Fletcher Hills Presbyterian Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: This church is incredible and I highly recommend for those seeking a judgment free community where you can learn and grow in your faith. The people and pastor are loving and kind to all. The kids Sunday school is great for our kids (infant through high school ages available) and for us. We love the unique blend of traditional scripture teaching and modern worship.

name: Flood Church
reviewSummary: Artistic and welcoming community in San Diego centered on grace, vulnerability, and active compassion, drawing college students and professionals seeking authentic faith.

name: Florida Coast Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. For anyone who is seriously wanting to be rooting in Christ centered scripture for themselves and or their family this is the place to go in this area.  The people are loving and elders are knowledgeable, personable and loving as well as theologically capable.  It’s hard to find a gem like this. You will be lovingly challenged to grow in holiness. True to the Gospel and sharing the Good News are their top priority! Family in Faith, warm, friendly and welcoming! I have been attending Florida Coast Church for most of its eight-year history, and not a week goes by that I don’t thank God for making me part of this special congregation.  There is a warm, friendly family atmosphere that is felt the moment you walk in the door.  The worship is simple, participatory, and heart-felt.  Sound biblical preaching provides rich spiritual food, bringing fresh insights to Scripture passages I have been reading and studying for years.  Want more?  There are prayer meetings and Bible studies during the week and an active women’s ministry.  This is authentic, biblical Christianity.

In first posting my review a few years ago, I failed to mention the many wonderful people God has used and continues to use at Florida Coast Church, especially our pastor Larry Trotter and his wife Sandy. They are a seasoned ministry couple, having worked together for over a quarter century as missionaries in Mexico before starting our congregation.  Larry’s teaching and leadership gifts are beautifully complemented by Sandy’s caring hospitality and her work with women and children. We love them both! Great church great sound teaching loving people and excellent pastors it is an amazing place for community Florida Coast Church was welcoming and kind to us as visitors. Many people went out of their way to introduce themselves to us and make us feel loved. Pastor Trotter preached a sermon that was Christ centered, expository and encouraging. Prayer was heart felt and they are strong in supporting missionaries. If you are local to the Pompano Beach or Ft Lauderdale area, please consider attending and becoming a member of this authentic, caring body of believers.

name: Folsom Bible Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary: Great bible based church! Great pastors!! Very organic, not like a huge corporate mega-church. Come check out this church if you want good honest worship or if you need some good bible teaching, you will not be disappointed. I can't say enough about this church!! Have been going here for a few months and I am beyond glad for all those that attend. Folsom Bible Church correctly handles the word of God and is faithful to adhere to what it says which is always encouraging and uplifting.

name: Folsom Church of Christ - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary: Today I came to this church with my family, hoping to receive a little help in a difficult time. Unfortunately, we were refused, and this deeply saddened me. I believe that God guided us to this place and I am convinced that He also saw the way we were received. I bear no hatred for anyone and I pray that the Good Lord will give everyone more wisdom, kindness and compassion towards those in need. In life you can lose trust in people, but never in God. A beautiful congregation where you can learn the truth about the church and our Creator. Roman's 16:16 A great church to attend for anyone. Great teachers, great preachers, great song leaders, and great people in general. This is the church of what God wanted. This is a friendly group of Christians dedicated to serving God and following His Word. Friendly people, but the music is, well, different. The sermon wasn't based on any particular Bible verse - it was kinda rambling and not quite to the point.

name: Fondren Church - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: I have a feeling of acceptance every time that I walk through the doors. Robert Green is fantastic and each sermon seems to be directed to me and he always strikes a cord. I enjoy the atmosphere and the people. I feel that God has lead me here Fondren Church, and pastor Green specifically, restored my faith in God. Not only are they able to worship God with love and affection, but the sermons give wonderful advice that helps with everyday life. If you don’t know your denomination, or if you don’t think denomination matters, or if you are questioning God’s loyalty and existence, Fondren Church is the place to be. Pastor Green baptized me, and brought me back into the Christian faith. I love Fondren church.  The people there are very kind and loving.  They are very active in the community.  They help a lot of people.  They show the love of Jesus and are truly the hands and feet of Jesus.  I am so blessed to have found a church family that loves so unconditionally.  They are always praying for me and my family.  Thank you sweet Jesus for leading me to Fondren Church.  Sherry Pender 💜🙏😘 This community is the most accepting and loving! You will feel welcomed here and it is a place of comfort for anyone! There are many ways to get involved and the pastor and his family are the most genuine, and compassionate people I know. Wish I lived closer so I could be a part of this amazing church. This past Sunday was my first time going. They had an awesome live worship band. Also, the pastor spoke on things that were very relevant to my life. Then the place was so full with people my age, so a great place I can meet good friends.

name: Fontana Church, First Assembly of God - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
The presence of God is moving in this place , such amazing worship and the sermons are amazing , 2 services one for English and other for Spanish, This church changed my life for the better ,
This is an amazing church where I met so much amazing people that welcomed me and now we are all a family , the pastors are amazing and makes everyone part of the family, this place is truly amazing and is considered my home My daddy, my faithful heavenly father saved me and my family riding in the car with me from what would have been a ghastly car accident on early morning of October the 6th 2024 driving home from my son's wedding.
Satan thought that he could take the glory that belongs to God, but our Almighty God, the lion of the tribe of Judah, the one that has showed me time and time again that He is ever present in my life rescued us, and prevented the accident from happening.
I have too many reasons to give praises unto God. This is not the first time that He have protected me from a car accident and I know that it will not be the last.
I give Him all the praises, honor, adoration, alleluia, hosannah unto His holy name, Amen and Amen! I remember the first time i came to this church. It was around 10 years ago, I was not yet a member but an invited speaker.  We helped host a youth conference here and from that moment, I can already tell this church was special. As the years have passed, this church has been the place i decided to call my spiritual home. I was married in this church, started my family in this church. And now with my family, we serve this church, which is also our family. A place we pray people will come to and experience community, sound teaching, healing and  restoration. Pastor Daniel and Raquel have been my pastors since I was 8 years old. This has been my home, and I am thankful to the Lord for the community He has given me—a spiritual home, The Lord has been so good to me. If you are looking for a church that is on fire and seeking the Lord, I invite you to come visit us. “With God, we always win; we never lose." – Pastor Daniel. Fontana First Assembly of God is a church full of people who have loved on me and supported me in my walk with Christ. It is a church where I have been able to grow in knowledge of His word and experienced the presence of God. I learned what it is to serve God with my entire heart, and I thank Him for leading me and my family here. This church is my second home ❤️

I give Him all the praises, honor, adoration, alleluia, hosannah unto His holy name, Amen and Amen! I remember the first time i came to this church. It was around 10 years ago, I was not yet a member but an invited speaker.  We helped host a youth conference here and from that moment, I can already tell this church was special. As the years have passed, this church has been the place i decided to call my spiritual home. I was married in this church, started my family in this church. And now with my family, we serve this church, which is also our family. A place we pray people will come to and experience community, sound teaching, healing and  restoration. Pastor Daniel and Raquel have been my pastors since I was 8 years old. This has been my home, and I am thankful to the Lord for the community He has given me—a spiritual home, The Lord has been so good to me. If you are looking for a church that is on fire and seeking the Lord, I invite you to come visit us. “With God, we always win; we never lose." – Pastor Daniel. Fontana First Assembly of God is a church full of people who have loved on me and supported me in my walk with Christ. It is a church where I have been able to grow in knowledge of His word and experienced the presence of God. I learned what it is to serve God with my entire heart, and I thank Him for leading me and my family here. This church is my second home ❤️

name: Foothill Christian - Napa Campus
reviewSummary: I was expecting discipline and punctuality specially from the members of the church there is a time when the worship team clock is announcing when they will will start singing and all the regulars were outside cheat chatting then it is very distracting when they entered and start greeting people or going back and forward of the auditorium doing nothing.  :(  I tried to close my eyes to enjoy the worship team and my worship time with God, but . . . The best church I have attended and the Pastor is awesome! Foothill is a family and filled with so much spirit 🙏 Foothill is a awesome place to follow the Lord. There are very friendly people, that make the experience unforgettable. Such an awesome place to worship the Lord and Men's coffee on Saturday is great too! Can't wait for every Sunday to come every week to see my family at Foothill!!!

name: Foothill Church (Baseline Campus) - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary: Great place of worship.  Christ centered, and Bible based.  People are warm and welcoming.  There are weekly classes, 3 services each Sunday, and classes for the young ones, including babies. Classes to introduce, enhance, and engage you to build a relationship with our LORD JESUS CHRIST. I’m so thankful for Foothill Church! The teaching is solid and biblical...not just for adults but for kids and youth too. The youth group is amazing, and the weekly prayer meetings are such a special time to connect with others and with God. I also love the classes that help you learn more about the Bible. Foothill is also very welcoming and supportive of families with special needs, which means so much to us. It’s a warm, genuine community where you can truly belong. I've been attending Foothill for over 11 years.  I started attending before I was a believer and felt very welcomed.  Eventually I did become a believer and got baptized here.  I love that they preach the gospel and lean into the Bible.  The main pastor is a true gem and we're blessed to have him.  All of the staff is great.  If you're looking for a church I encourage you to stop by for a month to see what we're about. We have been attending Foothill Church in Glendora for over three years now. It is such a gift!! The sermons are fully Biblically based. All ages are included and encouraged to participate. Everything is done intentionally and with excellence. We have felt welcome from the first time we walked in the doors. I am proud to say “This is my church!” Foothill Church has been one of the greatest blessings of our lives. Come learn how to apply the Bible to your life, and be part of a community that will love and welcome you and your family just as you are. There’s something special about Foothill Church—come and see for yourself! And when you get here, enjoy a great cup of coffee.

name: Foothill Family Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Mike has changed my life! He teaches the Word of God practical & straight forward. Always backing up what he says with scripture! At Foothill Church I learned more about God’s will to heal, prosperity & speaking in tongues. He has equipped me for this spiritual battle & I’m forever grateful for Pastor Mike! Pastor Mike Webb is one of the truest anointed Bible teachers in our time; preparing hearts for the coming days. Pastor Mike is an amazing teacher; full of the Spirit and love. The staff and congregation are awesome. They love  God, love people, and passionately serve in the ministry. Everyone is sincerely warm and welcoming. Foothill  family, Pastor  Mike is so lead by  the Holy Spirit .  Please  listen to his "Every Word".

Susie Vann Pastor Mike is an awesome spirit filled man who teaches Gods word clearly and simply

name: Foothills Baptist Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: This place is an extremely loving, welcoming, Bible-teaching, Jesus-honoring center for all human beings. The music is amazing, too! This is a rare combination indeed. Truth in a spirit of welcoming love. We moved here from Texas and received such a warm welcome from folks that we did not look any further after our second Sunday and decided to stay. Also joined a great bible study group on Wednesday nights while kids attend the Awana youth group. I really like the Sunday morning worship and our kids are enjoying their Sunday school. We prefer the early morning service but you also have a second option a bit later in the morning. I would definitely encourage folks & blokes to come check it out. Visited againg after visiting 10 years ago when they ran a great VBS for my kids. At first I was afraid the band would be too loud. Fantastic worship music. Excellent bible based preaching. The people are friedly and helpful. Foothills is a great fellowship of Christian believers who gather together to worship God and grow in Christ. I have been a part of this wonderful fellowship for 4 years, and am excited about what God is doing here! I visited Indiana. Great small groups. Great worship music. This Church is  Bible believing, and I highly recommend it.

name: Foothills Christian Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
“I’ve been to Foothills Church in the past and have always enjoyed the uplifting messages and welcoming community. This week I stopped by their huge rummage sale, and I loved seeing how the proceeds were going toward winter camp for the kids. It really shows their heart for investing in the next generation. The sense of community here is so strong, and every time I’ve attended, I’ve left encouraged and inspired.” Ya’ll better check the lord’s teachings, having to deal with someone so rude letting no space in the 10 item lane in the grocery store while I carry heavy packs and then give me a disgusted look when I ask to be able to set it down. At least the logo of this church on their car they almost hit me with in the parking lot let me know what the values of this church are.
Have the day ya’ll deserve! The best church the best pastors! I love it the songs worshIp Jesus Christ !
This church is like a family Pr Mark and David are amazing and humble people and his soon so beautiful I have no words ! They are the best I attended a service with my brother (who already is a member with some friends) and I was very pleased with the message that was given, the welcoming staff, the first timer gifts, and most of all the prayer said for me by a staff member at end of service. I have been going through a troubling time with grieving a separation from spouse, physical injuries and surgeries and it has hit me mentally not being able to do the things I like (for example just taking a simple walk, I’m a very active person). I do plan on coming back once my surgery wound allows me to walk again. I just got a cardiac ablation procedure Friday and my wound on leg hurts a lot. I could use some extra prayers for those of you who pray everyday. 🙏 I love this church I been going to foothill Church about 10 years now. My 10 year old daughter got baptized on Easter 2026.

name: Foothills Church - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
We've been going here for over 20 years. So many great people, families, and amazing facilities. There's so many opportunities to connect with Jesus and others who love Him! I actually can feel the holy spirit there in a tangible way.  First time in my life.  If you feel like you are just going through the motions of life then come here.  The worship is amazing. Last year our son was invited by a friend to attend awana at Foothills Church. Upon enrolling him, we are told because we were not members of the church that one of us had to volunteer in order for him to attend. Although it was an extremely busy time in life for my husband and I, my husband agreed to volunteer so our son could have the experience.  Our friend told us she volunteered the first year too, but after that we will be "in." Come this year I go to sign my son up and I am told we have to volunteer again due to us not being members of the church. I called an left a vm and received a call back from Jim, whom was in charge of awana and was indeed told my son was not allowed to attend unless one of us volunteered. The way he spoke to me and the things he said were very rude. I most definitely did not feel as if I was speaking to a leader at a church. This year between new businesses and a new baby being born there was no way we could make it work. My son was so upset and still to this day asks when he can go back. I never imagined writing a negative review about a church, however I feel like this is totally backwards. Our home church is exact opposite of this and constantly asking for their members and those who call it their home church to volunteer in order for them to be able to reach more people and bring more people to Christ. Needless to say, my family and I will not be atrending this church in the future. We will stick to our home church where we feel God and know he is moving! Love that they hold volleyball ternaments This church is a Living Testimony to their teachings of Jesus Christ. Their practice of Service to all is a testimony of their Faith.
I was not a supporter of churches in the past until I experenced first hand that, what I heard was actually practiced in Living color. Amen n Amen.

name: Foothills United Methodist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi everyone, I found the true meaning of humanity in the warm and loving community of Foothills United Methodist Church. Every single member radiates kindness, compassion, and a genuine spirit of hospitality. The moment I walk through the doors, I feel surrounded by peace, love, and positive energy.
What makes this church truly special is that their words are lived out in their actions. Their faith is not only preached but practiced with open hearts and helping hands.
As a foreigner, I came in as a stranger and yet, I was welcomed as family. Today, I feel that this community is not just a church; it is home.
Pastor Leigh, thank you for your unwavering support and gentle care. And dear Susan, director of the Good Shepherd Ministry, thank you for guiding me to this beautiful place. You have given me more than just a church , you’ve given me belonging, love, and hope.
With all my heart, thank you.
Neda❤️ Very lovely setting. I was passing out flyers for a new nonprofit dance studio, Blossom&Bloom in La Mesa. I briefly spoke with personnel at the child care and the pastor of the church.  I mentioned to him that the campus looked beautiful and ready for learners. Anyone looking for childcare would be smart to check out Foothills United Methodist and its childcare programs. Foothills United Methodist Church is an absolutely beautiful venue for a wedding! As a photographer and videographer, I really appreciated their friendly attitude and no restrictions. The warm, inviting atmosphere helped create a memorable day for everyone involved. If you’re looking for a picturesque and welcoming place for your wedding, I highly recommend Foothills United Methodist Church! I loved Foothills when I attended there. At the time Rev. John Farley was Pastor. I found the congregation to be welcoming and most were friendly. It was a “higher scale” with more than average having college degrees and in a higher economic group. That said, the sermons were down to Earth and enjoyable and to the point. I attended two years before joining because one of the Associate Pastors said, God was “Awesome”. Coming from my Baptist upbringing it didn’t seem that was the “right way”, to refer to God. So I attended, watched and listened. At Christmas they hosted a reenactment of Christ’s birth, outside for the community to watch. They featured live animals in the manger, where children could pet them after the play. I met several women, when I volunteered, as they did, to be shepherds on the hill, tending our wooden cutout flock. It was a rewarding experience and we repeated it a few times. On Maudlin Thursday, (the night before Good Friday)
many of us gathered for a Seder Meal. I found it interesting and educational. It’s a church for families and singles alike. I think it’s important to attend a church that has a history and “fellow churches”, you can go from city to city and still find a Methodist Church. You can count on a Pastor who has graduated from a Seminary College and knows what he’s talking and teaching about. That he Believes in God, Jesus Christ as His Son, who God sent  to forgive our sins and be our Savior. I moved to AZ to care for my Granddaughter, so my daughter could go to Nursing School. The “start up” churches here, are pretty much everywhere these days, and can’t compare to a UMC, Baptist, or Congregation Church. I took a nine month Bible course at Foothills and learned so much more about the Lord’s Book. If you’re in the neighborhood and live on Mt Helix, El Cajon, La Mesa or Rancho San Diego, I would highly recommend giving Foothills a try. It’s been twenty years or more since I’ve been able to attend there. I would bet though,  there’s still a Welcoming Source there,  who would love to greet you any Sunday. I have been attending at the church for 2 years. Great teaching from pastoral staff and really great music both from contemporary and traditional services. Congregation is not huge, so you won't feel lost in a huge crowd. There is a school here for wee ones. Kind, open and inviting people.

name: For Eternity Christian Church - Stone Mountain Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing and God leading church! Everyone is welcomed and you will never leave the same way you entered. True warm loving church for the believers, those seeking help, and those who don't know. Wonder time and great services. “The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; He delivers them from all their troubles. The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.”
Psalm 34:17-18

There was a season in our lives where everything felt uncertain, heavy, and honestly overwhelming. We were searching for answers, for peace, and for something real we could hold onto as a family.

From the moment we walked into this church, we experienced something different. Not just a place to attend, but a place where the message of Jesus Christ is lived out with sincerity, compassion, and truth. The pastors lead with authenticity and care, and you can feel that this is not about routine or religion, it is about a genuine relationship with God.

Through this church, we have witnessed real change in our lives. Prayers that we once spoke in desperation were answered. Areas of pain and uncertainty began to heal. What felt broken started to be restored in ways we cannot fully explain outside of God’s grace.

This church did not just impact our Sundays, it helped transform our daily lives, our perspective, and our faith as a family.

If you are searching, hurting, or simply wondering if God is real and present in your life, this is a place where you can come as you are and encounter Him personally. What we found here was not just hope, it was healing, direction, and a deeper relationship with Jesus Christ that continues to change our lives every day. I am so blessed to be in attendance here at For Eternity where God's Word is truthfully spoken and lived. Thank you God for this church and all who abide in your Word here. Love abounds greatly. It is a fantastic worship experience every time. Visiting with family and friends is always a joy. Great bringing New Years at this church. Everyone was kind

name: Forefront Church Brooklyn - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Very inviting interdenominational progressive Christian church ❤️❤️❤️ so open and free spirited congregation. I always enjoy worshiping when I visit !! I am almost at 3 years of being an active member of forefront and all I can say is this church has changed my life for the better. Before coming to forefront I was at a low point in life. I was working at a job that did not fulfill me, had hardly any friends and those that I did were not the most healthy relationships, and I desperately was seeking God but couldn’t find any churches that aligned with my values. Since coming to forefront I now am in a career and job that is more aligned, I’ve gained several friends, and get to share my gifts and talents. I am on the worship choir, I volunteer with the kids, I’ve even facilitated meditation and yoga!

This September 26th, 2025 we are hosting a benefit concert to raise funds for our amazing community. Come through and get a taste of what this incredible church is all about ! An honest and authentic place to seek God, Forefront is a safe place in a crazy city. This is somewhere I can invite ANY of my friends to church and be confident they’ll have a positive experience. No church is perfect, but this one comes close. The best Christian church I’ve been to. Progressive, great leaders and goers. Check it out Great experience. Loving people. Took a picture next door.

name: Forest Hill Christian Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
Forest Hill Christian Church is a small, intimate church with very small congregation / attendees. It is -- unconventional. Pastor Susan, married with grown kid(s) is most warm, open, welcoming, approachable to all. Whites, blacks & Asians worship here.

For LGBT, hipster, or people seeking religious experience yet dislike formality, you might find it home here.

Sunday worship is at 11am. Then, you can hang around for a bit social. Cheese & cracker, good coffee (Peet's -- which Susan likes) are served. Feel free to bring snacks to share. My brother Clarence Lee Lewis hasSunday morning services at 8:30 at Forest Hill Christian Church I love the service it is very uplifting he is a great gray pastor I was warmly welcomed by the caring community of Forest Hill. Thank you!

name: Forest Hill Church
reviewSummary: A welcoming multi-campus community known for accessible, practical Bible teaching and authentic small groups. High emphasis on life application and engaging kids programming.

name: Forest Hill Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: A welcoming multi-campus community known for accessible, practical Bible teaching and authentic small groups. High emphasis on life application and engaging kids programming.

name: Forest Hill Church, Ballantyne Campus - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this place on Sunday and the place has great worship services. The music is excellent- they didn’t put up much worldly performances and the worship leaders are excellent. The deacon of the church is friendly and very good. When I came they are using livestream from the main campus so I can’t comment on the current pastor. The Word from the central church is pretty good though.

The place has an excellent parking. The church is clean. The church also has a prayer team if you need prayer or encouragement. Love this church. Love the pastor. Love the senior pastor over all FHCs. The Spirit and Word are preached here which is a major PLUS! We really enjoyed our visit to forest hill. The music and the message were refreshing.
We were also impressed by the children and youth ministry. First time.  Friend of Holly.  Loved the services. Reception great and felt great from parking lot to pew!  Will visit again. The church has several times to be able to attend Sunday service. The music is amazing and the two people I believe are the main music directors, both Sarah and a man (sorry I don't know his name), are AWESOME.  I am amazed by her voice. The congregation is very friendly. The senior pastor David does a good job of communicating the sermon. In those cases where he is not around, the local Ballantyne team also does a good job.

name: Forest Hill Church, Fort Mill Campus - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary: Great church! Love the teaching! FHC teaches the Word of God. Beautiful atmosphere where the presence of the Lord is evident.Friendly, loving, helpful people who love God and exemplify His love. Great children’s church and youth church as well! Worship is so Amazing!!! I love FHC Fort Mill Wonderful children's ministries from birth - adult! Great services from great pastors that will help you feel great all through the week! ❤️ 🙏 We have been attending the Ft. Mill campus for a few years. The best thing l love at this church  is the music. Your musicians are awesome. God bless them. I am new to NC someone recommended this church. I came alone because my husband had to work Last Sun. Greeters opened the door not even a good hi was spoken. I looked lost and was trying  to figure out where to go for the service. After a min. A nice gentleman Justin came over to see if I needed help. He was great showing me around and talked to me. Besides Justin, from my car to my seat and back out the door to my car passing many couples, families, and greeters and singles I felt no one even seen me there. No hi, I haven't meant you, what brought you here today, just no responses from anyone. Only when told to greet people around you.  I left wanting to cry. I was hoping to make a connection with more than one person in a church this size. Maybe everyone  there Sun. was new? One church we tried 20 people came right up to us and not only said hi we got hugs  Yes, was still looking for a different type of worship so I came here. To be honest the people in the grocery store have been more outgoing and friendlier than this church. So sad! If you can't connect in a church where should I try next? Very disappointed!  The worship and message was very good. Attended this church while visiting family in Fort Mill. If we lived in the area this is where we would be going. What a wonderful message on loving one another and Christian “care-ability!” Beautiful worship, reverence for the Word of God, sweet spirit and presence of God, and benediction blessings. Thank you Forest Hill Church for the welcoming, encouraging, shepherding, loving heart of Father God today!

name: Forest Hills Baptist Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent church that is doing a great job at being inclusive while not compromising scripture. Not overly worried about attire or your status or career or pocketbook or pressuring to give xx much. Have attended regularly for over a year now and feel safe to say the main pastor and many of the other staff are just as loving and dedicated as they appear at first glance, if not moreso.

Very refreshing to hear convicting messages, getting into the word, and have a community of people who legitimately care in an age and city very focused on tolerance and catering to cultural norms.

Great outreach opportunities year round makes it beneficial to the community too.

Thankful there are churches preaching truth while doing it with love and that I'm close enough (35 mins) to visit 2-3x a week. Nice staff. Updated facilities. Biblically based church. After moving to the area, we couldn't wait to try Forest Hills Baptist. They have a modern and traditional service to choose from. I attend the traditional in the beautiful sanctuary. The hymns and choir are amazing. The preacher brings a wonderful message each week. My daughter attends the youth activities on Sundays and Wednesdays and is now signed up for camp and her first mission trip. They give back so much to the community, locally and abroad. You won't be disappointed if you visit. We love it, Nicki and Rivers Reeves We visited 25 years ago and never left. We came because of the then small church feel where you meet and get to know people across all generations. And even though it has now grown to a much bigger church, there is still a close, welcoming feel. Come visit and worship with us, and you just may find yourself a home for the next 25 years too!! I love this church Family! The pastor and S.S. teachers teach the truth without fear or hesitation, the people are kind and friendly...  The children's dept is safe, bible-based, and very helpful... Overall words can't really describe this church body...you just have to go visit..if the building seems awesome, you should meet the people!

name: Forest Hills Baptist Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
Missing my friends! It is the best church, there are Sunday young adult school and ESL Bible study. Also there is Chinese Baptist Church.

So grateful that I have ever been here and gotten baptized. Welcoming people make all the difference!

My wife and I are in the process of finding a new church family and we had a great time at Forest Hills today. The people couldn’t have been nicer, my kids truly enjoyed Sunday school, and the sermon was strong. Others looking for a new church would be wise to give it a look. My family and I feel at home at Forest Hills. My husband is not a Christian, but he wants to come and hang out with friends he has made at this church.  That says a lot about the church's focus on loving all people. The members are warm and inviting. The ministerial staff is there to listen to your needs and help you grow spiritually. I couldn't ask for a better place to serve God and his people. Friendly Brazilian church that welcome all! The pastor gave a Christ centered message for all to understand. Was able to use a translator app on my phone. So blessed to have found this community of faith in Raleigh. I'm glad to be in the "big city" but still have a close-knit church where I can get to know and grow alongside people of all ages and backgrounds.

name: Forest Park Christian Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is welcome. There's  usually a full house.
There are extra activities which bring many others to church. It is a place to meet good people and worship. The music is wonderful. They strive to be the hands and feet of Jesus through their community outreach and serving the unhoused population in the area. They are the most accepting and loving group of people I have ever met. I love this church i got to it every time i can as it’s filled with very good people and very supportive of everyone What they are telling me this doesn’t make any sense A place to belong, grow spiritually and discover God's call to serve, love and care like Jesus to wholeness and healing for the world.  We can make a difference right where we are! Love our Rev.

name: Forest Park Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
We held our VPK graduation at Forest Park Church, and it was a wonderful experience! The facility was clean, spacious, and perfect for our celebration. The staff was incredibly helpful and kind throughout the planning and event. We’re so grateful for their support and would absolutely recommend this venue for any special occasion! Just spoke with Pastor David - “this is David”  let’s you know the mettle and humble spirit of this pastor. I phoned to tell him personally how much I was helped by his sermon this past Sunday.

Pastor David is a master of didactic preaching, the lessons
all girded by scripture and presented in a didactic manner are magnificent and shew forth for all to hear and SEE the Glory of GOD in action! Our church went this week to feed the people in tent city.  You could definitely see that the Forest Park UMC  and its people are very interested in doing what is best for those that are hurt by the storm.  We spoke with the minister and his wife and both are full of God's love for all.  I know Shawn York and know where his heart is.  He has sacrificed a lot for the betterment of all involved.  They want each and every one to be in a better place than they were before the storm.  May God Bless those who have lost so much and those that are there to help. I've been a member of FPUM for a decade. Its a lovely church, but too big. I was married 4 yrs ago & bulletins still came in my maiden name. My birthday nor my anniversary was posted, & when I finally decided to transfer my membership, I was told that they were happy I found a home. Wait...I had one. I got lost among the other patrons. It upsets me. I loved this church and the people, but in the end I was left feeling forgotten or judged. We recently visited Forest Park while serving lunch to many tent city residents.  The church volunteered the use of their kitchen and a dozen or more rump roasts.  There is a donation section set aside for everyone to obtain clothes and other supplies. The United Methodist Committee on Relief is on campus helping people obtain needed services.  Many tent city residents are poor with no place to go. The magnitude of assistance needed from the hurricane disaster is far more then news coverage shows.  Forest Park needs your prayers, group assistance and contributions.

name: Formation Church - Brea Campus
Formosan Presbyterian Church of LA FPCLA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Yo A very clean and quiet place to enjoy a coffee or tea and a delicious dessert.

name: Fort Myers Christian Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
At Fort Myers Christian Church, I found a warm welcome from Linda. Preacher Zach led this small and inviting congregation. His message today echoed in my heart: 'Everything is possible for one who believes.' Just as Jesus healed the afflicted boy, we're inspired to overcome doubt and strengthen our faith. A truly faithful and friendly church community! :) Rev. Zach Seitz is the best!

Not a ractical preacher thank god.
Good old fashion day's church.
The church is new beautiful n spot less inside. Lots of congregating there. Pot luck once a month etc. Zach Seitz is in it for the community not for himself. An exceptional place to worship,  mostly seniors,  great facilities,  dynamic young minister.  You are welcome to come worship with us!  Sunday school @ 9:30. Church @ 10:30 every Sunday. One thing though..Zach neefs to provide coffee hour after service's n use our money we give him to run the church to buy coffee n donuts not as a church attendee to foot the bill! This is such a warm  welcoming and loving church. Come worship with us.

name: Fort Myers Community Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Fort Myers Community Church (FMCC) has been such a tremendous blessing in the life of our family, drawing us closer to our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. We are forever grateful for the amazing work God is doing through this church and its leadership. Pastor Bill has been given a true gift in sharing the gospel in such an inspiring, relatable, and powerful way. His messages resonate deeply and have helped guide us in walking with Jesus and honoring Him in our daily lives.

We feel truly blessed to have found this beautiful, God-glorifying church. FMCC continually reminds us of God's love for us and encourages us to live out our faith. From being baptized here, attending weekly Bible studies, and having opportunities to serve our community, to Pastor Bill’s amazing reminders of the biblical reasons God brings couples together in marriage during our heartfelt wedding ceremony. Every experience has been a profound blessing.

We are incredibly thankful for this church family, and we look forward to continuing to grow in faith and serve the Lord together. We are truly honored to be part of this incredible community. God bless you all, and thank you, Pastor Bill, for leading us with such grace and wisdom!

With heartfelt gratitude,
Erin & John I was in town visiting a friend. Warm welcome. Greeted as a new comer by multiple people. Worship was great. The message was very well communicated. I went up for prayer and got absolutely crushed by The Holy Spirit. I could not walk. I dropped to my knees. I have never been brought down like that before. It was amazing. Praise God for was I experienced that day. Amazing worship, biblical truth preached without compromise, and a genuinely friendly church family. This is a place where you can grow in faith and feel connected. This is the best church I’ve been to in a very long time… This church truly serves the God of the Bible, as well as Jesus Christ.  Pastor Bill is so genuine, and his messages speaks right to the heart.  My wife and I moved to Fort Myers for the winter months and we found this Church on Facebook.  We walked in and instantly the vibe was amazing.  Young and older people all interacting and being so kind to each other.  The worship was vibrant and extremely talented, and you could tell the Spirit of God was there.  But it definitely wasn't too showy. And at the end of the service we had a lovely young couple come up, say hi, and get to know us.  If you want to go somewhere that's Biblical-based, passionate, genuine, welcoming, and uplifting... definitely check this church out.  We're continuing to go here, so maybe my wife and I will see you there!

name: Fort Street Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: We loved the history of this church. It was absolutely a beautiful building. I had a awesome experience here. After a conference, I walked over to Tommy’s. The staff was amazing and the vibe was perfect. Feels like old Detroit. Which I really liked. The monster burger plus half a salad and a labatt blue on draft was more than a guy could eat! And very good. The Christmas performance of Handel's Messiah is an annual tradition for as long as I can remember They serve a good lunch every day for people that need food. They also will let you have your mail delivered there if you have nowhere else to have it delivered. And helpers are all really nice to you. I give it two thumbs up. I got a referral from DES to go to their clothing closet. The "service" was so good that I felt like I was... SHOPPING! They didn't treat me like a poor man getting free stuff. I want to go back one Sunday & checkout their services.

name: Fort Worth Bible Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary: I have lovveeeddd attending FWBC! I have felt so deeply known and cared for from the minute I first walked through the doors! This church has challenged me, grown me, and always pointed me back to the person of God. I can’t put into words how blessed I have felt by knowing and being a part of this church body. If you’re looking for a church that passionately teaches Gods word and values discipleship and service, I would absolutely recommend checking us out!! This is truly a special place! I had no idea how much my life would change walking through those doors. Church made personal… this church has been such a blessing in my family’s life. Forever grateful. A wonderful small church that treasures Jesus above all — and makes you feel like family! My family’s experience has been overwhelmingly positive. The Lord is using  the FWBC family to make Church personal. Texts of support, empathetic and truth filled emails, prayers for comfort, childcare for our son, and meals from both pastors and other members were provided during a time my wife and I experienced the loss of a close friend. If you are looking for a Church home where you will be known, loved and walk with people trying to know Jesus better, please come and visit! Awesome church and sermon over John 10. I enjoyed getting to visit Dallas and meet Graham with my sisters family.

name: Forward Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Historic Northville congregation providing both majestic traditional choir worship and vibrant modern praise, anchored by robust biblical preaching and strong student discipleship.

name: Forward Church - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
Love my Forward family!! If you are like me and the number one thing you look for in a church is community involvement, then look no further! Brandon and Danielle are amazing pastors who care deeply about this community and constantly work towards helping those in it. We’ve done everything from Trick-Or-Treats for local neighborhoods to providing roses to Widows on Valentine’s Day, to serving food to those in need on Thanksgiving. You will find that the people here genuinely care about your well being and there are so many ways to get involved! 🖤 I went to this Church for the first time today and honestly, I had goosebumps the whole time. My family and I have been going through a rough patch and the message today was exactly what I needed to hear. I have been stuck in the mindset of wanting the people who wronged my family to be punished instead of wanting them to be saved by Christ. It was a great way to shift my perspective back into wanting Gods grace for everyone and not his wrath. Thank you for having us today and God bless you all! Love this church in downtown Rogers! The people are so friendly, they have kids classes for your children, and the pastor is passionate about teaching biblical truths and sharing how they apply to our lives today. The worship is also AMAZING! They love their community well & find ways to serve them and have a lot of fun events like Mothers day flower giveaways, women’s events, men’s breakfasts, craft nights, etc. We absolutely LOVE Forward Church!
Brandon and Danielle Hollis are down to earth, kind, and some of the best people we know. They serve The Lord wholeheartedly and make you feel like family.
I would t hesitate to recommend Forward Church to anyone on Northwest Arkansas! Biblically accurate theology, biblical worldview, impactful sermons that demonstrate real-world application, beautiful music, welcoming community, & opportunities to serve (if you want to—they are not pushy)

Finding Forward Church was a blessing.

name: Foundation Christian Church - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church! Pastor Jake’s message is inspiring. The spirit is there. The word brought us to tears and we always leave inspired. I gave my heart to Jesus in this church in 2015,  was married and baptized here the same year and I love my church family here. The love I feel here is immeasurable and I am proud to call this my church home. Nice Church!

Greater is He whom is in me than he who is in the world!
Pentecost (baptised with the Holy Spirit)
John 14:20
20 On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.
Blasphemes against the Holy Spirit
Mark.3:23-29
23 So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables:“How can Satan drive out Satan? 24 If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.25 If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand. 26 And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.27 In fact, no one can enter a strong man’s house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong man’s house.28 Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter, 29 but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.” I absolutely love this church! Feel so at home here. Especially love the womens ministry ladies!  Such a loving group! Pastors and staff is great too. I love this Church. Pastor Rhodes is excellent! Great fellowship! Come for a good time worshiping the Lord!

name: Foundation Christian Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
My name is Becky and my Husband's is Louoe Laboy. We came frin New York 4 yrs ago. I googled for non denomination churches in Newnan. We visited a Church but my husband did not like it. Then we walked into Foundation at Ruth Hill School on the Sunday after 4 Birtjday Sunday 2023. We where not only coming from NY but are Puerto Rican we where not sure how we would be treated or if we would like the church. We walked in and where created by Tim Keim and Mr Johnny and my husband looked at me and said this feels like home, this is are church. We love Foundation we have God through sickness family issues and Found nation is not only home but family. Pastor Clint has encouraged us and continies to bring the untanted word of God. Most churches we have been to to talk to the pastor is like going through the Secret service but at Foundation Clint stands out side and any one can talk to him. We make visitors feel welcomed, we want to make them feel like they Belong because that is Foundation did for us. Foundation is Trueto the You Belong Here Movement. Please.co.e you will also love it as much as we do. From the very first time we attended Foundation Church, everyone made us feel so welcome. The atmosphere is warm, genuine and inviting and it truly feels like a place where you belong.

One of the biggest highlights for our family is the childcare program. Our almost 3-year-old absolutely loves going, which makes it so much easier for us to enjoy the service knowing he's happy and well cared for.

We've also attended several small groups and they have been such a great way to build relationships and feel connected beyond Sunday mornings. The people are authentic, encouraging and truly care about one another.

If you're looking for a church where people are friendly, the environment is uplifting and it's easy to find community and connection, I highly recommend Foundation Church! Jesus loves everyone. Foundation embodies the spirit of Christ on that fundamental level. They eat, sleep and breathe their “You Belong Here” movement. My family and I felt welcomed from our very first visit. I love that it’s a Bible-based church, deeply rooted in community. It’s where faith and works come together to fulfill the promises of God. I recommend visiting and becoming a part of Foundation. My family and I started attending 2.5 years ago. We came because of the fun July 4th parade. We stayed because of the message. Clint and the Foundation team really get it. They are serving the community and loving people all in Jesus name. It’s so refreshing to find a church home that truly wants you to walk with Jesus. 10/10 recommend a visit. You won’t regret it. After my husband passed away in November 2024, I began attending Foundation with my family. Before attending in person, my husband and I would watch the services on YouTube.
Once I started attending in person, my life changed. I met so many wonderful people who have become like family to me. I also began serving at the church and participating in Bible studies.
Through this journey, I gave my life to God and have been truly blessed to find Foundation and Clint Holder.

name: Foundry Bible Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary: We happened to be walking by our neighborhood park in West Roseville today, Norm Fratis Park and there were a number of easy up tents and chairs and blankets and other cool stuff scattered throughout the park with lots of people around. It happened to be that the Foundry Bible Church was holding its Sunday services and children Bible classes outside in the open. What a really cool thing to walk by and notice. That is doing God's work right there and we certainly welcome them to our area. All of the parishioners seemed so relaxed and comfortable outside on a Sunday morning having their services. That's the great thing about America's freedom and religion. You are welcome back! Loving place to visit

name: FOUNT Church | Brooklyn - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely love this church and totally recommend it for people new to the city! You will find a lot of vibrant people who love to fellowship together! There are options to watch on YouTube and there are two service times. So plenty of opportunity to attend church on Sunday. There is also dinner parties on Wednesday which i absolutely recommend! Love their music and energy.
Jesus is only hope. We love our Fount church community, but the sermons are just often TOO LONG!! — like 45 minutes to 1 hour just for the message. By the end I often lose track of what the main point was… it just feels like the preacher just keeps following the emotion / enjoying hearing themselves speak.

I really wish they would keep the message concise and to the point, 30-40 minutes. Otherwise amazing church! Been going to this church for 2 years. Pastor Josh and Georgie seem to be such genuine people! So are the other pastors. The community is strong and everyone has their hearts towards God. Great music too 😊 Always a pleasure to be here. The souls are vibrant, vibratious, wonderful, caring souls. The atmosphere is child friendly and equipped w/ elevators. accommodating to everyone welcoming to everyone of all walks of life. No judgment. You cant call this place of worship a church. No the proper word to reference is we are all one big family. No one chooses family we are blessed and i believe everything is gunna be ok. Great job guys. stop by and become an addition to the constant growing family. Walk with god and learn to enjoy life. What are you waiting for go check it out! Ill see you there! Peace n love -Bless
-Mandy.

name: Fountain Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: This church feels like home. The pastors are great speakers and their services are very uplifting and REAL! Highly recommend visiting to see for yourself. The love of God is undeniable at Fountain Church Fountain Church has some of the best people in the Bay Area/Tri Valley! Everyone is very welcoming, diverse congregation, and the Pastors are all so caring. It's been my home for 4 years and I've build so many friendships. If you're looking for a church in the Bay Area, Fountain is home! Fountain is home for us! We came one Sunday and knew this is where we belonged. The pastoral team is REAL and vested in their congregation. I have never had a church care so deeply about my family. They know and teach being the hands and feet of Jesus!! I can’t thank God enough for this church!!! ♥️♥️♥️ We love Fountain Church.  The teaching is spot on.  The people are very friendly and outgoing.  They do a lot of community service.  When you are in the "sanctuary" you can feel the Holy Spirit.  We have been to several churches in the area and this is our final home. Fountain Church has literally changed my life from the inside out. My children love their experience, and it has helped them with anxiety and depression and has helped restore them. It’s the most welcoming church and fellowship experience we have ever been apart of. Deep friendships have been built and the love that everyone exemplifies shows Christ through and through….

name: Fountain of Life Baptist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A small Church with a big Heart! I am blessed every time I visit. The Pastor and his family are great, the people are very friendly and kind, the music is Christ-honoring, and the preaching is impactful. God is truly glorified here! They leave junk mail on your porch. I have a No Soliciting sign and they woke up my baby shoving this in my screen door. “How to have eternal life”. Wow thanks, my baby is awake, I have extra trash, but I will live forever now! One of the best decisions of my life was joining Fountain of Life Baptist Church. Pastor Daniel and his family are always faithful, consistent, and loving to each one of us.

This church includes weekly soul-winning evangelism, which very few churches in south Orange County are focusing on. There are also choir opportunities, Sunday School for children, and nursing home ministries.

This is a wonderful church family, and I'm so glad I'm a part of it! My wife and I , the Stiefel family have attended  Fountain of Life Baptist Church since 2006 when we moved to Rancho Santa Margarita, after a visit from Pastor Daniel Pigott knocked on our door and he was doing a survey and we said yes and went to visit with the church from gospel track address. We loved it He shared the gospel and preached from the Word of God we loved it and the worship and a family atmosphere of loving people hungry to know more and more of God His Holy Spirit  transforming lives over the years. What a Blessing we are close to the Pastor and His family so caring and loving and so sacrificial in their love towards and other over the years
