name: Fountain of Life Christian Fellowship - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I was a visitor passing through the area and needed to be around some of my Christian brothers and sisters. I was lead to come to this church and was not disappointed. They are filled with the Holy Spirit and worshiped with truth and from the heart. It was refreshing to see a church that was filled with love and doing Kingdom work. They were very inviting and I felt right at home. Nancy, thank you for the prayers and kind words when I walked through the doors, you were a blessing that God knew I needed. Pastor Tim's message was on point, easy to follow and biblically sound. Everyone's involvement in worship was also a breath of fresh air. God is alive and working in this place and I was glad to be a part of it. Thank you Fountain Of Life Church Family for making me feel welcome and for following what Jesus has taught us and living by His word. Transforming lives through honest and true worship. Pastor brings the word to enlighten and strengthen our daily walk to draw closer to our Father. We are family, full of love and welcome all to come as you are. My experience is I didn’t leave the same way I came. I first walked through the doors of Fountain of Life in 2014, and honestly, I thought it was another ministry trip for me. I was not ready to gain a rich family relationship with these precious people. We have walked through so much life together over the years, more than I could ever put in a review. These people have cared about my life, my family, the ministry God has given us, and so much more. When I walked through one of the most difficult seasons of my life, these people were there for me. They walked with me and prayed me through.
I am so grateful for my Fountains family. This is a Jesus-focused body of believers who walk with Him and each other with integrity. And if I may be so bold, the best is yet to come! I had never been to this church. I was referred to their healing room by a  friend for bad dizzy spells I started to have.

The secretary does  not share what you need prayer for - to the people praying - but God knew. They just prayed and gave me scriptures God gave them. First, the scriptures they gave me were so relevant to my life I could not believe it!!! There was no way on earth for them to know those things, they had just met me. God, was literally speaking to me through them! I am so emotional about it! The Bible is for everyone, church services are for everyone. But those scriptures were just for me- God was literally speaking just to me through them !!! I tear up every time I think about it! I love God so much! He led me to this church. It has been over  2 months since that Healing room appointment- I had those spells for weeks and a bad one the night before my healing session . But I have NOT had one since that healing session- praise God I am healed ! I drive for a living and I could not work many days due to the spells- this was important for me.

I have started attending this church and I am not use to small churches but I love this church!!!! I love pastor Tim and the members I have met. Thank you Tim and members for serving God like you do! We all need to keep in fellowship! Anyone reading this needs to check out this church! And their healing room!  Fellowships builds us up and keeps us focused on Jesus! In these times that’s the most important thing we can do- keep focused on God ! And yes he still performs miracles! Thank you God in Jesus’ name for everything including finding this church ! Fountain of Life is a perfect name for this church!! All of the Pastors are continually reaching up to Jesus and reaching out to the church body and the community.  The messages go straight to the heart and make you hungry for more of God and His presence. I'm grateful to The Lord for bringing me here. I've experienced nothing but love, compassion and understanding from our pastors.  The preaching and teaching is incredible and life changing!

name: Fountain of Praise Apostolic Church - Oceanside Campus
Fountain Of Truth Apostolic Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
I Love The Church And I Have Felt A Connection Stronger With The Holy Spirit Different Time In This Church Before Went Leaders Have Touch Me And Have Pray For Me!. Well May Our Grand King Lord God Jesus Christ And The Rest Of The Trinity, Bless You And Your Family, Always And Forever!!. Please Always Take Care With Love First For Our Grand Lord God Jesus Christ Always And Forever!!!. And Don’t Forget To Love For All Your Brothers And Sisters, Always And Forever Like How God Jesus Christ Wants It In Your Life!!!. My mom says love people & like things. So I'll say I really enjoyed it & five stars for their passion. The guest pastor talked about the process to get to the top of a mountain - the process starts in the valley. 1st Kings 18:41-43. Religion makes us  comfortable at the mountain top & we fail to continue on to the mountain PEAK!
(As of May2018 they moved) The presence of God is moving at Fountain Of Truth Church. I truly felt  welcomed. My mother and I moved from Mississippi May of 2018 and was looking for an Apostolic church that has fire for the Lord. My mother attended services and told me this is the church to be at, so I went with her the next time. I LOVE THIS CHURCH SO MUCH!!!!!! The people are so kind, warm, and caring. You can really feel the presence of the Lord in this church. And no one is ashamed to praise and cry out to the Lord not even the men! I received the amazing gift of Holy Ghost attending services one Sunday!!! If you are looking for truth and to be filled please come and visit. As you enter the door you are greeted warmly, not overbearing..
The beginning of Service is song and praise .
During the Sermon every aspect is explained, read directly from the Bible, given history and relevance to the topic. The teaching is thorough and complete, easy to follow, with relevance to the time and age we live in.
Prayer afterwards is warm, complete and the congregation is friendly.

name: Four Corners Church - West Chester Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I enjoyed visiting with our son, Christian, and daughter-in-law, Olivia, along with our new grandchild, Charlie. I think this was our fourth visit to your church. To God always be the glory for all things he has done in our lives. Merry Christmas to you and your congregation with much love as we celebrate the birth of the CHRIST child. Vibrant church that is full of the Spirit! Faithfully serving the Lord with great Biblical preaching! Four Corners is the most real and loving church I have ever attended. Pastor Ben preaches on topics that other pastors wouldn't. His messages will grow you in ways that you never thought were possible.
The kids ministry is excellent. They are extremly considerate and accommodating to any allergies your child may have, any behavioral needs your child may have, special needs..ect It's a great place for your Child to learn about Christ.
The music at this place is great.
These people love each other, they are real. They are open and honest and come here to repair the brokenness in their lives. This isn't a museum for perfect people. All of these people are honest, real and accepting. I have loved moving to the Cincinnati area and being able to call Four Corners my home since day one! It is so fitting for all ages and welcoming with open arms. God has done great things in this church and through all the people in it, and will continue to do so! My husband and I moved here from Michgan, and before Four Corners, Cincinnati did not feel like home. As soon as we walked through the doors of Four Corners, we knew this was the place for us. Through our time here, we have made life-long friends, engaged God God more deeply than ever, and have found our church home! This place is one of a kind with amazing and caring people!

name: Four Points Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I did our pre-marital counseling here with Ben and Julie when we first started attending Four Points… wow, they are amazing people! We are greatful to have had their leadership and advice going into marriage! Several years later, we still enjoy coming to Four Points on Sundays. Pastor is honest and Biblical based… we came here after leaving a huge church that sugar coated the truth because they were more worried about likes and follows on social media.. it’s so refreshing to see the TRUTH of Jesus preached! Praise the Lord! Experienced one of the worst sermons I’ve ever heard here today. I came here after reading the website saying that all things that are not biblical are up to you, and not preached about at church. So you can imagine my dismay when the guy preaching decides to sprinkle PLENTY of political opinions throughout his sermon. Not only did they disrespect the congregation and visitors by ignoring their own promises from their “Theology” section, but this guy was so worried about leveraging his platform to make political remarks, that he would rather t drive people away from the Lord than hold his tongue. The things he mentioned weren’t backed up by scripture; it was just topical post-election talking points. The messages here are also the same: “Jesus love you”. Yes, we all know that. Let’s try learning about HOW to live like him. It seems they’re more concerned with absolving their members’ guilt each Sunday than actually teaching them how to live as commanded. Extremely disappointed and generally disgusted at the guy preaching today. He should not have access to a microphone. My wife and I have been attending Four Points for about 8 years. We love that the church is committed to true gospel centered preaching, dissecting the Bible line by line, verse by verse of through books of the Bible. We lead a small group within the church and have great fellowship doing life with one another. If you want to dig deeply into the Word of God, this is the place for you. We attended here for several years. We moved to Florida last year. We miss this place and these people so very much. We have been unable to find a church that teaches the Bible with such passion and knowledge. We continue to watch online so that we are fed the word of God each week. Blessings to all!!! We are so grateful to be part of Four Points Church - it's been such a joy!  We have been at Four Points for over 5 years, and it is definitely home.  My relationship with the Lord has only deepened as we walk verse by verse through God's word.  I didn't realize how hungry for the Word I was until I was really being fed.  I hope you will join us; our fam would love to see you there! :)

name: Four Winds Church - Conway Campus
reviewSummary:
This church requires children to pay 10$ to attend VBS for a tshirt and snacks. Why should children have to pay money to hear the word of god? 100’s of church’s across Arkansas are providing VBS, dinner, lunch, ect for free because that is why tithing is offered. Tithing is to support community outreach and the needs of the work of god. Yet, children are expected to pay 10$ to attend. This is absolutely shameful and a disgrace. Think of how many lives were not given to god because children couldn’t afford to attend. You might as well require people to pay for Sunday service! Very friendly people
Comfortable and Pleasant Good MESSAGES LOVES GOD ❤️ and  it SsShows Four Winds Church is always nice
They have a real good garage sale in March and October, everyone Welcome!!!!! People are so friendly and make you feel at home. Wonderful inviting atmosphere. Not overwhelmingly large.

Place us huge / people were nice Which is very very very great church if you have moved to Columbus and looking for a great church new wine ministry is a place to go we currently moved out on 161 in Dublin to the movie theaters follow us on Facebook if you need to church to go to the very understanding they also were Madison covid-19 and you can trust how you want to dress come how you want to come it's all about God and the worship of him I give this place 100% with cleanliness and support for anything that you need Cult

name: Fourth Avenue Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: We love worshipping here. Located in downtown Franklin on 4th Avenue, this church family lives their motto, “Love God, Serve others, Share Jesus.”  Worship is every Sunday at 9:30 a.m. classes are at 11:00 a.m.  They have nursery, preschool, KAF (K-4th), Club 56 (5th-6th grades), YAF (7th-12th grades), and several adult classes at 11-11:45ish. They also stream worship on YouTube. There is parking behind the church off 5th Ave/Columbia Hwy, on both sides, and across 4th Ave. behind Triple Crown Bakery. On Sunday mornings if you are attending worship here, you do not need to pay for parking even though signs indicate it is a paid lot. They have an indoor prayer room and an outside prayer garden. For accessibility, they have a ramp off the back parking lot. There is an elevator to get to the basement and third floor. My husband and I have been attending fourth Avenue for about six years now. At that time we had been visiting different churches trying to find a home. When we walked in the doors of fourth Avenue, we were immediately welcomed. As we found a seat people all around us introduced themselves and ask about us. We felt so welcome and wanted and loved. Six years later, we feel even more loved and a part of this church. The church has become our family and we are so blessed to be a part of it. Fourth Avenue Church offers a unique experience of providing a Christ-centered family atmosphere where humble people of faith gather to be the hands and feet of Jesus while offering both healing and opportunities for Spiritual growth. The Holy Spirit is on the move to gently offer healing from the wounds of life (including old, deep religious wounds), and also challenging us to grow in our faith and in service to the community around us. The messaging from the pulpit is convicting, the worship is genuine, and the teaching is Biblically-based and sound. Words cannot accurately describe the experience. I would invite you to come and experience it for yourself! 4th Avenue has been home for us for years and years. The intentional connection with the community and from within is amazing. We worship, serve, pray and lift up together as a family. It’s a wonderful community for people of all ages to connect and model the love and acceptance of Christ that we strive to follow. Come visit and you will find a warm welcome! For me, Christianity is about worshipping Jesus, sharing Jesus and serving others. (Fourth Ave. brings plenty of all of that). But it's more. God made us to be people who need to belong; people who need community. When a service or anything else ends at Fourth, half the people are still there 20 minutes later -- just talking, hugging, laughing, enjoying one another. Or sharing some deep conversation. Just being in community -- regardless of our backgrounds. And, if you have kids (babies through teens) and you want them plugged in at church and learning about God and faith, Fourth Ave. is amazing for kids.

name: Franklin Church - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going to Franklin Church for years and love it! Everyone is so friendly, welcoming and personable. Feels like a big family and has a very small town feel which I enjoy! Pastor Mike is an amazing pastor and very encouraging. He makes it a point to reach out to every member of the church. Franklin Church is such a great asset to the New Albany community! Pastor Mike has been the sponsor for Boy Scout troop 450 for many years.  He has been very gracious to allow the use of the facilities with nothing expected in return.  The children of this community have benefited from this act of kindness. Friendly church.
Great hymns.
Excellent teaching! If you are looking for a church you really feel like a member, this is the place. Awesome church that teaches God's word.

name: Franklin church of Christ - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: I'm watching TV and I'm enjoying the singing and the preaching to But what I really enjoy is hearing the babies crying out that is music to this old great grandma ears.just let the young parents know it's ok we love them and thank them for bringing the children and letting them sing for us. Fantastic group of faithful servants of God ! Established and mixed. Warm and welcome. Resourceful. For those of you who are seeking, try by visiting for a month. One service doesn't do justice for  your soul. This is an investment for the rest of your life. Ask questions,  investigate. Don't judge a book by its cover , but rather open the explore.  You will never find the perfect church, but find the one that best fits you. For me, I ve found the stabilities that allow me to visit other congregations. This is one congregation that recommend for all demographics.  Being a member of the body has its blessings. The best advice that I can give any of you seeking a church home, is to never stop seeking. Be real with who you are and look with all honesty, and honesty will find you. This is unadulterated teaching, not according to the societies trends , but According to the word of God.   I pray that you find the one true church that God adds you to. Extremely friendly congregation.   We were just passing through, but anyone in the area should visit and experience a welcoming group of Christians. I love going to church there with my cousin and am made feel so welcome.

name: Franklin Circle Christian Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary: I began attending Franklin Circle Christian Church after moving to Ohio City. I was looking for a community in which I could be my authentic self, deepen my faith, and serve the community. FCCC is a diverse community centered on inclusivity and belonging. If you are thinking about attending the church, you can expect to be be welcomed at the door and invited to join a loving community. What a great place. I went knowing I had a call to find a new church home. I found them to be extremely open and welcoming as soon as I came in. The pastor found me before service and struck up conversation and then proceeded to introduce me to the kindest folks the rest of my time. I usually wouldn't stay for coffee hour but felt comfortable enough to do so. I enjoyed the service very much and unexpectedly met a bunch of great people. I found the pastor's sermon touching, deep, scripture based, and relevant to my personal circumstances and the world at large. I completely plan to return and I'm not generally an easy sell and pretty set in my patterns. They are a diverse progressive group of people, service driven, and very inclusive. Clearly walking the path of Jesus Christ. Very affirming, inclusive church that seems to work to make all feel welcome! I'm not one for a traditional church gathering, but I truly feel welcome and a part of a community when I step foot in this beautiful church. Pastor Richard challenges us all to live like Jesus in our everyday lives! This is the most welcoming and friendly church I've attended in CLE! The messages are relevant and the pastor genuinely cares for everyone who walks in the door.  They are open and affirming of LGBTQIA+ and working towards racial reconciliation.  Come join us! This is a very warm and welcoming congregation in a very beautiful and historically significant church. Come as you are.

name: Franklin Vineyard Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: I am so grateful to have found this church! I was searching for a home church and I knew the Lord would give me confirmation when I found the right place, but I didn’t know how clear it would be. After just one night at one of their events, I was absolutely certain that I had found my home church. I actually feel like I’ve gone there for years and it has only been a couple of months. I have been so blessed by every interaction I’ve had here. They regularly hold events throughout the week, prioritizing community and relationships. In the short amount of time I’ve spent here, members have gone above and beyond to get to know my child and me. A significant portion of their ministry is dedicated to equipping the members of the church (along with non-members, who are also welcome to attend all of the events). I love the childlike faith I see in the people around me. It’s beautiful to be in an environment where expectations of the Lord are high, and I’m constantly reminded that anything is possible. I have seen so much vulnerability since I’ve been here. People feel free to be open and honest about their struggles without worrying that anyone is going to judge them or gossip. It’s really special to find a place where that exists. I know that we’re humans so there will always be flaws, but I can confidently say that the people I’ve experienced here are striving to be more like Jesus. I have been offered diapers for my son, I have been invited to coffee, I have been given opportunities to ask hard questions, I have participated in multiple one-on-one healing prayer sessions, and my son has found friends who treat him like he’s family. If you’re feeling lonely in your walk and are too tired to find Christian friends on your own, come here! I was exhausted by the thought of building a social circle that would grow my faith, and by joining this church I inherited one that’s far beyond my expectations. Great experience visiting this church. Very friendly and warm. Worship had a deep sense of the presence of the Holy Spirit! You can tell the lead pastor loves this community My wife and I absolutely love worshiping and attending services at this church.  The Pastors and entire staff are so caring and humble towards each and every person there, from long-time members to those who just set foot in the door for the first time.  The worship service messages are very practical yet entirely biblically based, and the praise and worship music team is awesome.  You will enjoy getting to know the people you get to worship with here, and quickly form lasting friendships with great people who love to worship and serve the Lord.  Plenty of child care and events for young people as well.  The English service begins at 10 AM on Sundays, followed by the Spanish service at 2 PM.  If you are in town and looking for a place to worship while visiting, or if you live nearby here and are looking for a great place to call your church home, look no further than The Franklin Vineyard! This is a loving, strong, and well-lead congregation. If you are looking for a church that is active in outreach, has powerful worship, solid, Biblical teaching, strong community, and not so large that you get lost in the shuffle... this is the church for you! We love our Vineyard family! What an awesome place to come, fellowship, worship and learn. The pastors, staff and church family here are friendly, authentic and real.  You can tell they care about you. The teaching is 100% Bible based, relevant to our time and place, and is also actionable.  Lives have been touched in a positive way.  Praise and Worship is also authentic and through it, one can sense the love and fellowship from the heart of our Heavenly Father to His family.

name: Frederica Baptist Church - St. Simons Island Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful church with an amazing children's program. The members love having children at the church, and they pour into them every Wednesday and Sunday.  Our kids love going and always come home having learned more about Jesus. Visited Sunday for the first time. The church family was very friendly and made us feel welcome..... most importantly, the message was Christ honoring. We will visit again, I'm sure, even though we live in Waverly it's not that far to us., Wr traveled from Jasper to Woodstock First Baptist before we moved here a couple months ago. We always enjoy visiting when we are on the island Woman's Bible Study is Outstanding
Come Tuesday Mornings
. New study TBA for September 2019.  All are welcome Wonderful loving people who welcomed my sister and i and comforted us as we traveled there for our dads passing. We thank you all for your kindness and love that you showed us.

name: Free Chapel | Alpharetta Campus - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary: I enjoyed my visit there for the Easter service, but I was not aware that the Pastor was not in person. Had a great experience!! The holy Spirit really fills this church!! Free chapel is the best church! I’ve been going for 13 years and it has completely transformed my life. I went to the main campus in Gainesville for the first 11 years and in the past year started coming to Alpharetta because I moved this way. The worship team at this location is great and the campus pastor Tim always does a great job when he speaks. It is a satellite campus but you still feel the Holy Spirit just like you do in Gainesville. Nice folks. Too loud, feels more like a concert than worship. Went 3x, met zero people. Amazing place to worship 🙏🏼. I love it, thank you ❤️

name: Free Chapel | Gainesville Campus - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
We drive almost 60 miles every Sunday and wouldn’t have it any other way! The Hy Spirit is present in this place! Best pastor I’ve ever seen preach. Free Chapel has been one of the most wonderful and steadfast institutions of North Georgia for the entire entirety of my life. Mr. Jensen Franklin, a personal and family friend is truly a testament of God through words, actions, intentions and vibrations. As devout attendance daily Catholics, my family will ex communicate me if they see this review 😅 but I do not care because Free Chapel is wonderful and so worth it. Felt right at home like it was my home church and not like a first time visitor. Friendly staff and a wonderful worship experience! Movie 🎥 series sermons. Always great to see how things can be pulled from movies and relate to scripture.  To spire one in their faith. Friend and helpful ushers and volunteers.  Caring community. Almost 24 years ago I attended Free Chapel worship center three times a week as I was a resident at a Christ centered recovery program No Longer Bound. It was in this church that the Lord Jesus Christ powerfully transformed my life.  Just last Sunday I took my family for a worship experience as we were coming back from officiating a wedding in North Georgia.  We attended Palm Sunday.  Pastor Jentsen Franklin was not preaching, but a very strong message was given by Pastor Javarn (I think that’s how you spell)….

Amazing and deeply anointed worship !!!
🔥🎚️🔥

Over 100 staff in volunteer serve on the greeting and hosting team giving an amazing experience to all people who attend. No one enters or leaves this place without experiencing the love of God, expressed through faithful believers.  ❤️⚓️

For many years, I’ve been listening to Pastor Franklin  bring the word. He has an amazing gift to not only preach and interpret scripture, but also build clear parallels into bridging the application to everyday life. The edification of the word of God comes alive by the Holy Spirit, which is very present at this church.

As an ordained pastor and minister of the gospel now myself I love attending this church. Coming back to the church attending with my three daughters this past Palm Sunday is a worship experience that I will always remember and cherish in my heart.

Roughly 2000 people or Moore attended the 9 AM service which was packed

They have campuses all over the country and state of Georgia.  When I was in seminary, I got to attend the Orange County location in California.

It’s truly amazing to see the favor. Jesus has bestowed upon Pastor Franklin and this ministry.

💯⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🔥🎚️🔥❤️⚓️

name: Free Chapel | Gwinnett Campus - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary: Come experience a powerful word from the Lord along with a warm welcome through fellowship and acceptance of the body of Christ! Free Chapel is a truly inspiring place. The worship is powerful, the messages are uplifting, and the sense of community is amazing. Every time I attend, I feel encouraged, spiritually refreshed, and closer to God. The pastors and staff are warm, welcoming, and genuinely care about people. It’s a great place for families, and there are so many opportunities to grow in faith and get involved. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church home! I look forward to going there every Sunday.  High energy and they love God and Jesus ! I love Free Chapel Church and Pastor Jentzen Franklin. I love the music and I always enjoy the sermon he gives. I always walk out of there happier than ever. Very clean church. Good job to everyone involved. I’d give it 10 stars if I could. Amazing God we Serve Bryan did a great job, and the Worship team was awesome as well. Pastor Jensen has prepared an exceptional lesson. We enjoyed our experience very much!

name: Free Chapel | North Campus - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: For some reason, I have started to received emails from Jentezen Franklin every day.  I did not sign up for the emails.  Even worse, the unsubscribe link in the emails doesn't work.  Please fix this.  Thank you. Wednesday nights for teens. The get the kids out of the car. Next week they're going skating. Be there or be square I love free chapel and my daughter likes Wednesday nights. Im glad she likes going but I don't like how it sounds like they are at the club when I pick her up. Wish it was Christian music played. Biblical and encouraging for the body. Outreach is authentic and spirit filled. The leaders have integrity and bear the fruit of the spirit. They feed the body of Christ, while equipping saints to go into all the world. Their prison and jail ministries continue to minister to people who get out of the provision, thus discipline thrm until they are strong. WHICH...is the great commission. Amazing ministry to watch you all the time. The anointing upon Pastor Jensen is just amazing. I encourage so many people to watch this program every day. God bless you richly for all that you’re doing for the kingdom.

name: Free Chapel | Orange County - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary:
Love the truth of God's Word in the sermons, bring on the fire of heaven.  It's feels like heaven is parting open during service.  PREACH!!  And so much respect for Pastors who wake up extra early to lead mid-week Prayer meetings!!  Thank you so much for your faithful leadership, this church is blessed 🙏 There is too much flash and no depth in the bible. So much standing even with the services. Too many red flags to be seen here.

Sadly, I witnessed a few people physically push a new guy. In all honesty, he did nothing wrong. Angry remarks spoken in private are narcissistic.

The worship music was played at a volume that hurt your eardrums. As they demonstrate, false promises. Nobody even said hello or tried to put me in touch with a group.

No one on staff, including Jason Jesudasen and Jentezen Franklin, is responsible to the pastors. Lack of appropriate respect and insufficient genuine caring. I was there for winter fest for the youth.It was a great facility and the team there treated as well Visited on vacation. The worship is inspiring & the Bible is preached here! We really enjoyed the service and our experience. The volunteer team was great as well, we felt welcomed and loved the spirit right when pulled up to the parking lot! This church has top notch pastors.  I try to come late though because I cannot take the boring adult contemporary style music.  I feel that they HAVE TO put the words on the screen because you can’t understand what they’re singing. Sounds like shouting. Also, I feel this is why so many come to church when the senior pastor is there.  He often brings old time hymns with him.  I still go and if I miss, I watch online. But the music seems more for the singers singing it than the congregation. Just my honest opinion

name: Free Chapel Midtown - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I love going to this church! Everyone treats each other like family. The sermons are powerful, spirit lead and easy to understand. Pastor Jordan makes everyone fill welcome. He is the Pastor of the Midtown Campus.    The word of God is easily imparted. I love going to the 9am service with my family. Roger and his wife makes us feel so at home. My family and I have been attending Free Chspel Midtown for over 2 yrs. We attended the Gainesville campus beforehand. The church is  reprersentable of all nationalities, so when God looks down upon us, he smiles. As a native Atlantan, I enjoy going to this church on Sundays. You are always welcomed to come as well. Renita Burns  ❤️ I’ve been looking for a new church and have been watching online. I felt led to attend today, and the word was specific to what I’ve been studying in my Bible. Jesus is in this place! The gospel is preached, and there is discipleship and outreach. It’s like a bit of heaven on earth - multicultural and generational. I was encouraged to start consuming online content after reading Fasting by Pastor J. Franklin. A church alive is worth the drive. 🙌🏾 Today is the second time I decided to check out Free Chapel. I am new to my decision to check out church, and I must say it was interesting to be dissuaded from attending.

The first time I attended I was descended on by about five people to check my bag. This was explained to me, and I explained I would have to have my bag to attend. Not everyone drives….

I left under the impression that my bag would just be checked on future attendance. This is not the case. Although I was permitted to attend today, I ended up leaving. What would be the point of staying knowing I cannot return?

I want to say, I do not feel personally attacked by any of this, but it is worth pointing out that, if an on-site solution is not formulated you are turning people away based on assumption. I find that unfortunate.

It also feels like a stance of privilege to be told, after an hour of walking to mass, that because I do not have a car to set my bag in, I am not able to attend mass.

Something to think about, and a warning to all those who may be in a similar situation.

I am off to find a different church. Though I would love to return if the issue is addressed. We love Pastor Franklin and his messages. We have been to the Gainesville location a few times, but it is just too far of a drive for us. We went to the Atlanta location this past Sunday. Once again it was a great message and the staff are very friendly. The only issue we had that would make us not return to the Atlanta location again, is that the sound for the music and service is extremely loud. Almost deafening. I was thinking more about loosing some off my hearing than worshiping. Even when the pastor was speaking, it was very loud. The room is very small so perhaps they can tone it down a little on the sound...  Other than that we loved it. Keep your unsolicited junk mail out of my mailbox

name: Free Methodist Church - Escondido Campus
Free Will Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church, ❤️ sharing the Love of God. I absolutely love this place of worship ALL the people are so nice and our pastor is the real deal I love this church! There is Sunday schooI for the children, men/women Church Retreats for the adults, dinner and Bible Study on Wednesday evenings, AA Meetings everyday at 3pm, Holiday activiities, and much more! It's a great place to share in giving Praise to the Lord.  I really adore Pastor Rick and his Wife, Christina. They always speak from the heart and carry a great message. I am very grateful to have found my way to Princeton Free Will Baptist. We have had many events at this church. Birthday parties, weddings, etc. It is also a very nice Church and has a great choir. I do my NA meetings here the pastor is extremely caring great place

name: Freedom Bible Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary: Freedom Bible Church is my church home. It's a Christ-centered church rich in grace, love, fellowship, and Bible study. The perfect place for perfect, imperfect people to worship Christ, learn the Word and fellowship with one another. Everyone is welcomed wherever their walk with Christ is, seasoned or yet to begin. One of the most loving places you could ever be!  From the Pastor's passionate Christ - centered messages to the generous hospitality of the congregation, you will feel the love when you visit! Love, love this church. It is a spirit led church! Centered on Christ and discipleship. Pastor is passionate for the Lord and truly loves his flock. Sweet genuine people. They WILL hug you (pre corona) so be ready for that.

name: Freedom Christian Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
It's everything other folks have testified to. The people are very friendly. The new pastor as of a year ago speaks directly to you from his scriptures and from his life.  You will be blessed by these people the Holy Spirit lives here. Pastor Eric is one of the most righteous men I know. He preaches directly from the Bible and brings it to life and truth for what it really is. He is family oriented. His church is so down to earth. The people are so sweet and friendly and definitely family oriented. Diverse and humble. I ve been to the big churches where theyre money hungry ( charges for counseling like Some of these churches) . They really care about you and want God in your life.  Not your money. I love this church and their members. They amazing and lovely, I recommend this church 100 %, if you looking for a place where the Word’s God is explain with passion and truth. I am a single woman. I also have PTSD from things that have happened in my life. When I was changing after a long day at work two men literally beat on my door and window more than once. I was immediately scared. This is not ok!!!!! They left a Easter Sunday Service invite. I love god but this is not ok with me. I do not answer the door to anyone I’m not expecting. Most of all two men. Please spend the money to send through the mail. The guy banged on my door and window. Please never come to My house again. Not Happy!!!!!! This church is more than that, it is a family of believers worshipping together because we love the Lord and love one another🙌

If you don't have a church home, I invite you to visit and feel the love as the Holy Spirit is alive and well.

name: Freedom Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary:
I chose this. Church at first bc I needed a late service due to my work schedule. Since then I've joined, God has led me here and I feel like im at home. I got baptized here in September and involved wkly service groups. Im also looking forward to serve soon after attending the freedom way. Thank you pastor JR. God is using you to help alot of people hear  the truth,  like me. I have recently walked into the doors of this church, three weeks ago was when I said Yes, I'll go!  Each Sunday's & service's has been eye opening for me to understand who & what Freedom Church is. The door greeters, The worship team, and each sermon has been easy to understand not to much water down, and great people to start up a conversation with if anyone is going to visit by themselves. I would do it all over again! to visit Freedom Church. Plus they have a section with high tables, allowing you to take a daily journal, bumper magnet, and information you will want to read. Walk in it's just inside to the left of the auditorium doors their about seven doors. Come try each service out, make it fun for your self to see who are the people of Freedom Church. 🤙 Catch me there, if you see me. Very realitable messages given by an articulate speaker. Awesome services that give me the positivity and strength to live a productive and successful life.  Would highly recommend attending! I've been going to this church for a few years now and I thoroughly enjoy Pastor J.R and the entire congregation. The message is always on point and everyone is always warm and welcoming. Check out the photos of blockbuster weekend. Idk why I never thought to write a review lol
I found God at Freedom. I was an atheist and a recovery addict the first time I walked into their doors. JR and the team are absolutely amazing. I was always welcomed. Every Sunday I leave better than when I walked in. Freedom students is amazing as well for your youth!

name: Freedom Church - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary: After moving to the area, I visited several different churches. One Sunday, I decided to check out Freedom Church and have been attending ever since. I have never experienced the love of a church congregation quite like this one. There is no judgment here, just a genuine love for the Lord and one another. Freedom church is my wife's church, and while I'm not a religious person I do accompany my wife there on occasion. All the people I've met there are very friendly ,  warm, and so far are not high pressure to the point of obnoxious to "bring me into the flock" like some other religious groups tend to be. Great outreach to and for the neighborhood and local families, underprivileged kids and families . Love our church! All are welcome and everyone is so friendly. If you want have change and growth in your life this is the place to be! Love Pastor Tim Winton and his wife!! The love of Jesus and family is what you will find here. Not the typical church. You feel like you are home,with family and he best part is, NO JUDGEMENT come as you are, whatever background. They love you in the good times and help you through the bad. The music leaves you out of your seat, goose bump raising kind of worship and praise. Fellowship outside of Sunday's is like nothing I have ever encountered before at another church. When I say family, that's what I mean. Think bon fire's, bowling, basketball, park picnic. Ministry in the community is  blessing in its own. Showing the love of Jesus is what we are called to do. You will see and be blessed to be a part of this. Pastor Tim and his family are a blessing to us and this community. God has big plans for Freedom, and I'm so incredibly blessed to be apart of that journey. Great place for worship, super music and if you want the word, stop in we would love to have you. We have a nursery, and children's church.

name: Freedom Church Center City
reviewSummary: Dynamic downtown church in Center City Philadelphia drawing young professionals and families with high-energy worship, practical sermons, and warm small groups.

name: Freedom Church Center City - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary:
The users ruined the whole experience. I am 36 years old and I know how to seat myself. In all of my years of church, I have never had an usher try to move me when I was actually on time for a service. I needed an end chair because of a health condition that I have. She still continued to seat people where I was, but she didn't make a big deal out of that, just me.

The service wasn't that great to put up with egotistical, power hungry people like that. The other side of the auditorium actually needed an usher. Best service as always. Lovely welcoming bunch. So glad to visit our home church again. Now I'm all prayed up 🙏😄. It's a great all inclusive church, where all are welcome to hear the word. There are also three services available most Sundays. Come on out and invite a friend! It was really great being there this Sunday. Last month I went to a similar so much like this church it was in Audubon, PA in the King of Prussia area. The pastor was Ed Crenshaw. This pastor Gabe Bouch at Freedom Church was really filled with the holy Spirit and really preached the word of God really deeply. God bless him as he and everybody was really friendly there. I loved this church for eight years donated It hundreds of dollars in donations and hundreds of hours in services  Just to try and volunteer and be told for eight months that there was no opportunities, even though I saw tons of new faces of volunteer greeters and different volunteers I would see come and go
The woman who runs the back end grace is not nice to me for some reason and would not allow me to volunteer so I had to leave unfortunately even though I love the actual church pastor and small group I was in she made the experience so bad I had to leave so I will miss it in some ways that I’m relieved to have a new church that values my willingness to volunteer

name: Freedom Church Jersey City - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a church home where you can grow in your faith, look no further. Praise and worship hour is amazing, you will definitely feel the presence of the Holy Spirit. The Pastors and other speakers do an excellent job breaking down the word in ways easy to understand. They have a variety of small groups that are awesome. This church is the true definition of what the Bible teaches us to come as we are, the Lord will take care of the rest. I highly recommend! maybe it was a off day me & my family attended for the first time 2 weeks ago me & my wife sat in the very front of the service the music was excellent, but the whole Sherman was about how the pastor had story about him and his wife gave $10,000 when they first join the church, and the whole sherman was about offering the whole hour we sat there, never experienced a church were the whole hour was talk about giving money but my on the bright side of things our daughter  went with the teen said she has a nice time with them, sorry we won’t be attending there again The best decision I could’ve ever made 7 years ago was to take a chance and visit this church!
I call this place home! It’s 2025 and I’m looking forward to the years to come 🫶🏽 I came to this church because I visited years ago and then church hopped for a few years. The ONE thing I could not stop thinking about was Tapestry.  Once I rededicated my life to Christ of course I went back to Tapestry. BEST DECISION ever. Being shy I would zip in and out of church I was very lonely, and I craved community but didn't know how to belong. After a few months I took a chance and went to their women's retreat!  (FYI - come join us for the next one in October. They offer a discount if you join before August.)  First let me tell you that Jesus went up that hill and met me where I needed to be and told me "I see you"...Secondly, I made 2 connections when I signed up to help carpool sisters that needed a ride. we have been in contact on a daily basis.  Thirdly, I now have a community of sisters/brothers that I never feel alone when visiting. I joined a small group, and the Lord met me and freed me! (the small groups are starting again in June I believe, come join us! they have many different varies for both men, women and young adults) the band/singers are fire! most of the time the front of the church are people jumping in praise and worship! Nobody cares how you come dressed, so don't feel you need to spend money on a new wardrobe. Jesus only cares about your heart, not your clothing or shoes or jewelry! There are background checked dream teamers watching your children! (our Church takes the safety of your children very seriously!!) The chairs are very sturdy (this was a concern for me being on the plus size). There are dozens of opportunities for you to volunteer and become a dream team member. (there's a great feeling of coming together and serving others that's indescribable.)
The church offers free hot/cold coffee and tea during service hours of 9, 11 and 1 pm every Sunday. We also offer live streaming! There are many opportunities for your children and young adults to participate. They have their own groups that are thriving! Bring your child and expose them to a Christ centered lifestyle. Now let's discuss the Pastors. First of all, the Pastors don't even insist on being called by their titles. They are just like you and me. All the pastors are approachable and some even glow! I love them all and have had interactions with them all on one level or another. Not standoffish or arrogant and they never look down their nose at you! They are kind and very relatable. I've had the opportunity to have the Pastor's wife pray for me...all I can tell you is every time she laid hands on me; I felt fire from heaven come down!! a true testament of their spiritual life. Sometimes ppl call themselves Pastors but have no real spiritual life. Not our Pastors! They have cast out demons and have Christ filled authority! That means that they have a strong, personal connect with Christ, hours spent in prayer and their Bible's!! They take their God given roles seriously. This is the main thing we can be thankful for when looking for a Bible based church. Give us a chance and you will not regret walking in thru our doors! We are waiting for you to come worship Christ with us!!  Also, the Baptism services are wonderful. You get to hear from real life ppl that Jesus have touched them and turned their lives around. There's only one thing you must keep in mind...NO perfect people allowed! :) On my very first day coming to this church, I felt drawn to the altar.
I went up and asked for prayer. As they prayed over me, I felt something shift.
I felt good — lighter — like something heavy had finally started to break.

But the real miracle happened when I stepped outside.
Suddenly, I couldn’t stop spitting. It wasn’t normal — it felt like something was being expelled from me, like God was physically removing something dark that had no place in me anymore. This church has helped me have a relationship with God and has anointed me with a beautiful testimony. I love it here and God bless everyone.

name: Freedom Church of Gwinnett - Tucker Campus
reviewSummary: My Church Rebuilding, Restoring, Reclaiming  life's for Christ .helping the Community.  Praying to bring life's to Chirst Pastor Baker was raised by his grandparents. In my experience, usually ppl raised by grandparents seem a little more grounded and wise. That's Pastor Baker.

name: Freedom Church Raleigh
reviewSummary:
We’ve been going to Freedom Church Raleigh since Sept. 2025. My family has truly been blessed ever since. I was welcomed into the church and people genuinely engaged us.

We sporadically attended another church, but never felt connected. We also had concerns about some of the things that other church was promoting that didn’t align with our faith.

Since coming to Freedom - Raleigh, we’ve all gotten involved! Our family has experienced a baptism, joining several small groups, volunteer activities, enrichment programs, and leadership development and opportunities. The LOVE of Jesus is always present and the messages connect with modern issues. We love serving and our kids love the youth programs.

Pastor Josh and his team have reignited 🔥 my faith and connection to God, Jesus, and the Holy Spirit. Full transparency, I was slow to warm up to the worship here. The music wasn’t my “typical flavor” and I was not comfortable publicly expressing praise in that way. I’ve now folded several of the songs we sing at church into my rotation 😎. I often wake up singing them. For the first time in my life I can honestly say, “I LOVE MY CHURCH!” 🙏🏾 Over the past 4 months I have been coming to Freedom Church has been a truly life changing experience. Unlike any other church I have attended Freedom has felt like home from the very beginning. I have found an incredible community and built lifelong friendships with people who genuinely care about me and support one another during hard times and with prayers. It is comforting to know that I have a church family I can talk to anytime whenever I need prayer my brothers and sisters prayer over me to help me get through tough times.
Most importantly Freedom Church has strengthened my relationship with God more than ever before. Through the teaching worship and the people around me my faith has grown significantly and I am grateful to be part of such a welcoming and community.   I LOVE MY  CHURCH

FREEDOM CHURCH Well, visited for the month of April 2026, and have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Freedom Raleigh to one & all. Great worship, fantastic preaching & a welcome which is second to none. If you’re looking for a personal experience with Jesus & a community of believers who will very quickly become family to you, then this is the place to go. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been blessed to call this church home. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed with genuine love and kindness. The biblical teaching is practical, inspiring, and always points people toward a deeper relationship with Christ.

What I appreciate most is the strong sense of community. The people truly care for one another, and there are plenty of opportunities to grow spiritually, build meaningful friendships, and serve others. Whether you’re new to church or have been following Jesus for years, you’ll find a place where you can belong and grow.

If you’re looking for a church that is passionate about God’s Word, committed to serving the community, and dedicated to helping people grow in their faith, I highly recommend visiting. It’s a place where lives are being changed, and I’m grateful to be part of it. I’m so thankful to have found a church family in Freedom! From a season where I came once a month or so, to joining in one of the many groups, and then being supported through my baptism I am beyond grateful to call Freedom Church home. They are a community filled with loving individuals and there is truly a space for everyone in every season of life at Freedom Church. If you are looking for a church who actively seeks, praises and shares the gospel, you have found that in Freedom!
