name: Freedom House Church International, Stone Mountain, Georgia - Stone Mountain Campus
reviewSummary:
This awesome church is the house of GOD. It's a spiritual hospital! "Jesus Does Miracles Here!" You will be blessed, and Revived. Jesus is here! Pastor Addison and First Lady Twanna Adamu are the best. I love them. They are real servants of God, spreading the good news of the gospel of Jesus Christ and the Kingdom of God. Come, it's "Not Church as Usual!" God will meet you there. Truly! Miracles happen here. When I came to followship at this church about six years ago. I felt the presence of The Lord it was so strong. Which, I appreciated because I grew up in Holy Ghost filled  and fire baptized church. Where repentance was preached as well as the true word of God. Not this watered down message you get now a days. I enjoy when the true word of God is being preached and wherever the spirit of The Lord is moving. I don't mind being in the middle of it. Because God so so so so God. He never will leaves us nor forsaken us. And you know what else he does not treat us according to our sins. God is a good good God. His mercy and grace is renewed every day.
Know that you are blessed and loved Pastor Addison and his wife Twanna has the most peaceful annointing that I felt when visting their church. I came for healing, but did not go up for prayer. After he prayed for the many people who stood in line, he looked to his congregation and called me up. I believe God and I will say that Pastor Addison’s work is genuinely a gift from God. It’s real!! Addison Adamu is a Holy Spirit filled Jesus centered Mighty man of GOD like no one you've ever met. I have witnessed him cast out demons and bring healing to a boy deaf and mute since birth, an old man that had a stroke, and dozens and dozens more situations like this and he always gives God all the glory and remains humble and love radiates from him like I would expect it to from the Lord Jesus himself, whom he serves. If I had a relative that needed miraculous healing that would go to him that is where I would take them instead of the hospital. Jesus Christ is the same yesterday today and forever and he is still a Healer and a miracle worker and the lover of our souls and we need more men of God that don't lose sight of that.... men like Addison Adamu. The Anointing on Pastor Addsion Adamu and his Ministry is definitely the Power of The Holy Spirit. Praise God for His works here as well as Pastor Addison soon to be Bride(His Big Catch just like Peter fishing in the bible) Mrs. Tawanna Addison, very humble and willing Spirit. His staff is very hungry and humble as well. Thank you for an amazing experience!!!

name: Freedom House Lake Norman - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
We have attended this church a few times, but our recent experience left us deeply disappointed in how they view young families. During a service, our 13-month-old son was making normal toddler noises (not screaming). A staff member approached me and explicitly asked me to step out to calm him down.

When I reached out privately to express that a one-year-old cannot control their noises and that young families need grace and patience, the leadership's response was defensive. They essentially explained that children are a biological distraction to others and validated asking us to leave to maintain a "distraction-free" environment.

Additionally, the preaching felt heavily focused on historical and opinionated topics (specifically a heavy focus on 1776/Man) rather than centering on Scripture and God. If you are a young family looking for a place of grace, patience, and a deep focus on the Word, you may want to look elsewhere. They prioritize Sunday morning production over welcoming the next generation. Freedom house is a non denominational church. I started coming here a little over a year ago and immediately got plugged in into a couple life groups - bible study, pickleball, lake and pool "party" gatherings. I enjoy the teaching team concept - having a live communicator at every campus. The pastors/speakers are real people with real problems who guide/ teach/ set higher standards for good living and giving back to the community. Each month is focused on a specific theme connecting Bible teachings and modern day application. FH's huge focus is on strengthening family unit and cultivating community support. This cause is very close to my heart and is precisely what keeps me coming back. I have grown/matured tremendously spiritually thru and with profound messages they highlighted/discussed. FH offeres complimentary child care during services. The worship music team is outstanding - they do a great job creating environment to open your heart and mind to hearing God's word in a new way. The church also offers the Authentic Woman and Strong Man groups for ladies and man respectively. It feels wonderful to be surrounded by strong successful woman (in my case) who serve as a real example of kindness, warmth while working thru struggles and pouring their energy into their family. FH is patriotic and politically outspoken church community. If you like to keep politics and church separately it may not be your cup of tea. Overall, it has been an incredibly positive experience. 100% recommend to see for yourself. Freedom House Church is deeply rooted in biblical truth, and they unapologetically stand  to proclaim the gospel of Jesus and fight to protect our God given rights endowed by our Creator.  This church is not scared to speak the truth in love.  The Maxwells are amazing people that put the Word of God above people’s feelings.  I am thankful for this beacon of light and truth in our community that shines the brightest. I recently just started attending after coming from Grace covenant. What I like about this church is I learn something new almost every time I visit. It's a growing church that building started as a gym originally so it's growing and improving in its journey but there are 2 more and soon to be one more out in other parts of Charlotte. Lead pastors the Maxwell's are informative, they care to talk about the hard conversations and what's going on in the world and how to walk it in truth. It's not just a "love" church it's a "I love you so I'm going to be honest with you even if it's not the things you necessarily want to hear." The other pastors are just as caring and informative and they are enthusiastic to have people approach them and be involved, your not just a number or a wallet at freedom house. (Kingdom building and tithing is important though) When you walk in those doors you are greeted with a smile, conversation, love and care. They Teach our children and I can say each Sunday I can ask my son what they talked about and to hear him tell me what he's learned is so important, my kids didn't always have that at previously attended places. I absolutely love this church They have a deep love for community and family, they encourage men to be men and set certain activities aside just for men to be involved. That's rare as many positions can easily be filled with the willing hearts of women. I can say from experience, they have a wonderful children's ministry and they believe children and youth are the generation of today and the church is not afraid to stand up for our children. And right now I'm in a women's life group that does life together. And we study the actual word of God. And we pray for one another and encourage each other in our faith as the Word instructs us to do. I've definitely grown in my spiritual relationship with the Lord since being a part of this church. (FREEDOM HOUSE CHURCH)

name: Freedom House South End - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: After reading some of these reviews, I need to share some peace. Freedom House, at all of its locations, goes above and beyond to welcome and keep the new members. I'm reading a lot of negative assumptions about political affiliation or an 'unwelcoming' spirit. However, after having attended the church for several months I can assure you each of these negative reviews were only met with welcome and community within the church walls. I'd push back and argue that if YOU do not agree with the politics the church upholds that's fine but just maybe this isn't the place for you? There is nothing wrong with supporting strong conservative belief and ideology and any disparagement you may have might only stem from the fact that you are in a place not aligned with YOUR OWN values. Do not blame Freedom House.... as they welcome all.  Freedom house is a fantastic place to learn and grow in your faith in Jesus Christ. It is a Bible believing, Jesus-first church that isn’t afraid to speak the difficult and sometimes challenging realities of being a Christian in today’s society. All the members are welcoming and kind, and the pastors are passionate believers. If you want to grow in your faith and pursue the calling Jesus has for your life, come to Freedom House. Jesus changed my life through this church!! I cannot say enough amazing things about the community at Freedom House! I have found amazing God girls to do life with that hold me accountable in my faith walk and encourage my relationship with Jesus. The pastors remember you, love you, come talk to you, pray over you, and give you the tools to know Jesus better and strengthen your faith. My relationship with Jesus has never been better! Freedom House is always giving to the local community and I have served a long side of so many wonderful people to see heaven come to Charlotte. I have joined an awesome lifegroup and have been able to do life with my group not just on Sunday but throughout the week! I've read my bible more, prayed more, and heard from God so much more by actively participating in all the Freedom House has to offer!! The is a bible preaching church that's looking to see you and the community transformed by Jesus! I love Freedom House! I've found my church home! My family and I love this church. The Freedom house pastors are amazing and so welcoming. You will feel loved the minute you walk in. They have something for every age. My 15 year old loves Vertical, my husband loves the Men’s groups. We highly recommend finding a great church like this to build your relationship with Jesus. Visited with my daughter because she's looking for a church more in her age group. We felt very comfortable and welcome. The Sunday we were there, they had a guest preacher from Australia.  She was fantastic! The worship team and music were really uplifting. We enjoyed being there and are planning on returning to hear the regular preacher. It was very uplifting to see such a younger crowd freely worshipping.  Lots of young people in their 20's and 30's with a mix of some older couples.  An energetic feeling that is fantastic to see coming from the younger generation.  Looking forward to our next visit.

name: Freedom Place Church - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary:
Spectacular service and message! I haven't been to a Church in a long time. So many judge and whisper behind your back, so stopped going.

Tonight I took 3 of my children and went. It was such an amazing experience, the warmth of everyone, feeling welcome and everyone so friendly. Especially David and Alena their message and her beautiful voice. Oh my goodness was absolutely WOW!! There was so much love and feeling like we had been attending for years!

I 100% recommend attending. Especially if you are searching for a Church to call home. This is the place. Heck my 6 year old ask if he could come back tomorrow 💜 If that doesn't tell you something 😍 My youngest son said he wanted to come here more than the church we usually attend. The friendship that my family felt here was just amazing. Parking was great with super easy access into the building. Was greeted with kind faces and truly genuine people that really seemed to care about you. The singing was awesome! The lady singing was probably the best I’ve ever heard, full of heart felt worship. The preaching seemed like it was just for me. There was time at the end to pray and really seek God and hear what He wanted to say to you. Didn’t want to leave! Recently, I  watched a Freedom Place Church event on line that was amazing!  I loved the music , the songs, and the amazing passion of the singing !  The pastor spoke about things that are relevant to my “everyday” life .I could feel the love of this church , even on line.  Whenever I’m in the Tulsa/ Owasso area I will be visiting Freedom Place Church. I suggest anyone  in this area do the same ! Absolutely loved this church. You could feel the Presence of God as soon as you enter.  The people were so welcoming and there is a true spirit of family, unity, and love without judgement. Society has embraced alot of motivational speaking in church, which feels good but I really enjoyed the Bible being brought to life in the sermon. If you crave non judgemental, Bible based teaching wrapped in family love and unity, this is the place! I moved to Oklahoma three years ago and have visited so many churches in Owasso and surrounding area.  I can honestly say I always feel so loved and welcomed at Freedom Place…the pastor and congregation go the extra mile to check on you and always help you.  If you need to feel a part of a family this is the place.

name: Freedom's Way Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I thought a church like this did not exist in this valley. Solid King James biblical teaching, amazing pastor, the congregation is one of the most welcoming I have come across. I knew the minute I walked in, this was the church for me. The sermons are ones that when you walk out of church you remember them. I’m so thankful I have found this amazing church. Pastor Cook is very accessible, He is always available for his congregation, and he always makes you feel like he has time for you any question or concern you have Went here because one of my family members had a concert here. Beautiful church. My family member’s friend is actually the pastor of the church. The bathrooms are clean and well decorated. Very friendly people and community in general. There’s actually a Christian school on the lowest floor. It’s really nice and I recommend going here. Thank you Freedom’s Way Baptist Church!!! If you are looking for a solid, King James, bible believing church, this is the place to be. Pastor Cook is great at preaching Gods word without worrying about who it might offend. The way preaching should be done! If you're unsure, you can visit the church's Facebook page. Here you will find past sermons. I encourage all to visit. The people there are very welcoming and nice without all the "fluff". Sunday school and Jr. church for the kids is great. The church is located in a beautiful building that's dedicated solely for this ministry After searching for quite a long time for a local church that preaches and teaches the actual Bible from the King James Bible, I am so grateful to have found Freedom’s Way Baptist Church which is currently located on Sloan Canyon Road in Castaic. Pastor Jerry Cook is a great preacher and with a sense of humor; the members are friendly and caring. I am grateful to be a member of a true Bible Believing church!! Freedom's Way is a fantastic Church home with a lovely community of people gathered to learn from and have a relationship with God. Bible Believing fellowship and fantastic learning programs. Thank God for the opportunities that Freedom's Way provides for its people.

name: Freedomhouse - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve grown tremendously in our walk with Jesus since attending Freedomhouse. The pastors are welcoming, convicted, Bible & truth based. My family and I went to Tuesday night conference, there was a guess speaker  . I enjoyed the worship and teaching . My daughter came with me to freedom house church in San Jose and  she wanted to go to the Tuesday night conference. I was very happy when she asked my son to go with her during alter call , she stood there and no one took the time to encourage her or pray for her . She felt rejected and started to cry . There were several ministers praying for others they looked right at her and  passed her as though she didn’t matter and prayed for others . I was heart broken . She asked me  , didn’t he said all who needed prayer to come up ? She thought she had to fall on the floor and scream to get pray for . I can deal with it , but to a person who just coming to Christ . I am offended and hurt by this . This needed to be shared ! I hope and pray the next person  who needs prayer ,  there will be compassion for  all Was in Santa Cruz from out of town for Christmas and felt like visiting a church here since I was out of town! I didn’t notice the (seemingly given I was a guest) lack if diversity but it stuck out towards the end. Towards the end, the pastor made a few statements about a Nigerian pastor which were initially fine! The comments continued and eventually there came a sense of mockery.The congregation beginning to laugh at the Nigerian pastors former involvement in the Black Panthers which had no humor in my opinion. Finally, the straw on my back, was when recounting being blessed by the Nigerian pastor he made the remark that, “He was blessed by a Nigerian of ALL people.” Then, “even by a Nigerian from Legos…Lagos…LLL…However you pronounce it,” (Lagos is actually the largest city on the continent of Africa, mind you…) This somehow was humorous to the congregation for some reason. Needless to say, my family was offended by the mockery and we felt that it was very unfortunate. As Black guests, the pastor’s comments obviously made us feel extremely uncomfortable to the point of walking out which we never do or leave reviews. As someone who comes from generations of pastors, this wasn’t a godly experience and it was truly disheartening to say the least. Still, we hope that the pastor and congregants are able to grow beyond it! God bless. Presence Of God dwells within this church.
Perfect representation of the Body Of Christ !
My wife and I miss all the smiling faces and great people @ Freedomhouse. Pastors are true leaders and servant's Of God. We thank the Lord for the time we were able to share .
Blessings from Texas ! This is the place where I have found true freedom in Christ. Since I’ve started attending this church, my spiritual growth has skyrocketed. There isn’t many churches like Freedomhouse. I’m forever grateful I found this church.

name: FREEDOMHOUSE CHURCH - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place to worship. I love it. Me an my boyfriend go on Sunday's. Enjoy the friendly people. Got a great pastor. 👍🙂 If you’re looking for atmosphere, production, and personality, you will find ample of it here.

If you’re looking for conviction, humility, and a trembling submission to Scripture — test everything carefully.

Wolves don’t announce themselves. Pastor Joshia and Pastor Marie are great. The atmosphere is very family  oriented. They have a children's  ministry. Also for young  adults  is a great place to be everyone is very friendly and kind. FH also has a small coffee shop within the church. They give back to the community every chance they get. I would recommend  their women's conference too! I was invited to this church by a friend and attended twice. From the start, I had a strong sense of discomfort that I now recognize was my discernment. The services felt more focused on appearances and social media presence than truly teaching the Word. There was also a heavy emphasis on giving money, which to me came across as taking advantage of people who may be in a vulnerable place.

As someone who has been walking in faith for a while, I’m grateful I trusted my intuition and kept searching for a church home that reflects humility, truth, and genuine fellowship. If you’re looking for something flashy and “Instagram worthy,” you might enjoy it here, but if your heart is after authentic teaching and spiritual growth, I would encourage looking elsewhere.

This was my very first Christian church experience, and it honestly turned me off at the time. I just wish someone would’ve shared a perspective like this with me beforehand. To each their own, but I hope this helps someone who is also seeking! And God Bless ♥️😊 Love this church good soil holy Spirit Field

name: Freeway Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: This church has always been an amazing blessing to our family. We love being a part of a genuine community with kind people. Been a part of Freeway for a few years. Have been thankful for a community that feels like family and a community that seems to worship Jesus and love each other. Great church filled with great people. We moved to the area and attended Freeway our first Sunday in town and we haven’t left. Caring Pastors, Solid preaching, strong community, superb kids ministry that does more than just babysit the kiddos, and a real heart for loving their neighbors. I love that they take Jesus seriously but not themselves. I came to Freeway Church over 2 years ago and have truly been blessed. I have become part of a family who challenges me in my spiritual walk, loves me where I am and encourages me to grow deeper following Jesus. As a single person, it can be easy to fall into the shadows of a church or like I'm just a seat being filled but I have been genuinely welcome into so many families and have authentic community with them where I can help them and also receive support in times of loneliness. I could probably go on for another 5 paragraphs but would invite anyone (believer or not) to come and see how this church loves Jesus passionately, others authentically, and the Cary area generously. YOu will feel like home whether Freeway is a place you make yours or like you are visiting extremely hospitable guests that make you feel like you are good friends in town visiting My husband and I visited this church while taking a anniversary trip and visiting the area. We fell in love with how welcoming everyone was and felt like this church was like family . We ended up moving from Wisconsin two years ago to become more involved in Freeway church and have build so many amazing friends and have seen our kids grow to know the lord better . Our 10 year even gave her life to the lord and got baptized! If your looking for a amazing church this is the place to be ♥️♥️

name: Fremont Community Church - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
So thankful for this community! I just moved to California a few months ago when I started attending this church, and immediately felt welcomed and loved. There are so many opportunities for you to get connected to groups to dive deeper into the bible and to gain some amazing friends.

I feel refreshed after the worship which is so important to me! There are also awesome classes for the kids to go to from new born all the way through High School! Wednesday nights they offer youth group called FCYG and they have worship, food, games and a great message! I think this is so important to grow the next generation.

I'm looking forward to seeing the future of this church! I love FCC. I have become a much better Christian and just love all the support and fellowship. They have a great children's program that my kids love. It's like a family and has a lot of activities. PLEASE BE AWARE.  THIS IS REAL:
Called for spiritual encouragement.  Senior "pastor" David Chae called me back, and in our initial conversation asked me what my financial status was.  Keeping in mind this was first time I ever talked to this guy, and he knew I was NOT calling for financial reasons but comfort and guidance due to family tragedy, why would he ask my financial condition first 2 minutes of talking to me?  When we finally did meet, which was a challenge to get him to take the time, he took me to a restaurant, he ordered all the food, and had ME pay.  I later called and asked him to stop by and pay his half of the bill.  I was ignored.  It appears you have to be in a certain income bracket to be considered worthy of this church.  Don't recommend at all. Had my faith be invigorated time and time again at this church throughout my life. A loving group of people that I feel comfortable with sharing life's downs & ups.

name: Fresh Anointing House of Worship - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
I really enjoy the church services at Fresh Anointing House of Worship.  The service is so real and all about God, that is what I like about it.  How to connect and serve God and let go of your ego, selfishness......etc.  and let God take over your life just live through his grace and goodness and kindness.  Just be humble and serve the Lord.  I also like how they reference the Bible teaching straight from it.  I could go on. Are you looking for a church where you can feel the presence of God?  Fresh Anointing House of Worship is the place you want to be! There is a River there that represents God's presence, life-giving power, and blessings. Our Senior Pastor Chris Searcy is an awesome teacher of God's word.  You will not be disappointed. Praise and Worship anointed! Come and see for yourself! We welcome you with open arms of ❤️ Love. Fresh Anointing House of Worship is a beautiful place to find community in a church. The atmosphere is very welcoming and friendly and open to new people. The worship expos top-notch and the world is foundation and aligns with the Bible. The pastoral leadership is humble and passionate about Jesus. The people are welcoming and inviting. You will leave FAHOW feeling loved, welcomed and at home. Blessings. Excellent, excellent, excellent place of worship with a truly outstanding staff and wonderful, powerful Ministers. Very proud of the young minister, Mr. Searcy. If you need direction and help with anything that is bothering you this just might be the place for you.   From Apostle Searcy and his wonderful wife to the rest of his ministers; all are top notch.  Nothing but praise for all the ministers and prayer team and leadership in general. 💯🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Check it out one Sunday, when you have time.  You will love it Amazing Church with a great atmosphere. Some of the most generous members I have ever encountered. I recommend this Church to anyone who wants to enjoy a great praise and worship service along with a beautiful word of God and many more weekly activities and events for all ages.🙏🏾

name: Fresh Hope Church - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
This has been our new home church for almost a year.  We really enjoy listening to Pastor Brady every Sunday.  Fresh Hope is very welcoming to all! Pastor Brady and the whole serve team have been very welcoming and I have been praying for such a community of believers to walk through life with. I have been to many churches in the past and this church, though young, is great about unity in the church and striving to love one another as we bless and serve this Denver area! No pretense, no dogma at this church…just a pastor that leads by the example that if you love God, you’ll love “all” people. Pastor Brady makes an effort to reach out to all who enter his church. He  truly wants to get to know you and hear your story. He’s building a community of believers that feels like family. My daughter invited me to visit this new church. Because they are new they're still meeting at Liberty Middle School in Aurora.
The congregation is still rather small but large in heart very friendly and welcoming. The pastor and his wife exhibit the grace and love of God and share his word with a zeal that is refreshing.
I have attended service here several times now and will probably make this my home Church.
If you decide to visit please ask for me, I'd like to meet you. Fresh Hope has fresh vibes and is a wonderful place to bring your family to learn about God! Love Pastor Brady and Bridget. Highly recommend worshipping here.

name: Fresh Life Church - Salt Lake City
reviewSummary:
Looked up this church while planning a business trip to SLC. Made to feel totally welcome and at home right away as soon as I arrived. Super friendly crowd starting from the parking lot greetings, croissants (!), great worship, excellent/relevant message... Made a very good connection with a fellow countryman as well. Fantastic experience. Highly recommended if you are looking for connection and to be filled in your spirit. Awesome and awesome people. I went for the first time the other week and everyone was super welcoming and nice. The worship was good and the message was awesome.

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone. I’m not a church person but thinking looking into it! I’m a combat veteran! 38, and struggled with a stroke this year! And looking for clarity! Just wanted to know how well this place is? I’m skeptical when it comes to this! And if it helps! Awesome church! Best church in Salt Lake City. Non denominational and great worship music. You can watch online as well and the venue is the Infinity Events Center and the services are 9am & 11am. Awesome groups to get involved in and make a big church seem smaller and the people are really genuine, welcoming, & kind! This church is amazing. The greatest messages of all time. Levi is hilarious! Never enjoyed a church before where I wanted the message to be longer! The people have beautiful hearts.

name: Fresh Start Christian Church - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: Fresh Start is a very welcoming church.  Lots of community outreach, children's activities, and family support.  Many opportunities to worship. Join us! I went there for a funeral and was treated WONDERFULLY. Prayer breakfast was great.

name: Fresh Start Community Church - Moore Campus
reviewSummary:
The most uplifting, welcoming, and genuine church I have visited. Everyone is there for everyone. Not overbearing, not in it just to collect, and people notice when you miss a Sunday. They see you for you, and are glad to have you. Love the community, and the sermons that reach you. Small enough to be intimate and large enough to cater to the entire family. From children, teens, families and seniors.

They also have a wonderful Celebrate Recovery program for those who are hurting or working on habits they want to break on Tuesday nights. Food pantry 1 day a month. November 20th. So much for assistance during the SNAP/ government shutdown I have attended here for 4 years now. My attitude has NOT changed. I am loved and accepted despite a serious criminal background. By far the most Christ centered church I have ever attended. Great church, Mark is great made me feel very welcomed...

name: Fresh Start New Beginning Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: I wanna make an active website for this church... how can I go that? Never have I experienced the Presence of God and an ever-increasing understanding of His Word more than at this church. It is a pleasure to learn, grow and fellowship here with such a great Pastor, wonderful First Lady and devoted congregation. Come and enjoy the Word the Joy and the Love!! I am so happy to have found 1st Lady Lynda & Pastor Terry Starks.  I will be attending. Love and miss my church family and friends! What a awesome experience to grow in this ministry in GA. A very friendly and loving international church. All are welcome.

name: Friends Church - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
It is one of the churches that walk-in the love of Christ and share it constantly to the community and one another. You just HAVE TO experience it to really know the Gem Friends Church is!! I've been going to the church for about 2 years. I really enjoy this church it's filled with love and joy. Pastor Tweed is an excellent pastor I really enjoy his sermons. They're taught from scripture and he has a really good sense of humor to keep things light. The people that go there are really kind. I have been going through a medical situation for over a year and some of the people have reached out to me through text and email I really appreciate that during my time of difficulty. Soon I will be able to get back into the church in person right now I enjoy it online. If you're looking for a church that's going to help you feel empowered in Scripture then this is the church for you give it a shot I think you'll like it
Ken McComb Biblical teaching, awesome and authentic community, it's a wonderful church home! It's a great down to earth church. Great people, not a bunch of ceremonies or judgement. Just straight up Bible. Just people being people. All are welcome. We do love community. Yesterday we had a church picnic after church. Were starting on a new 5 week series that involves daily scriptures. Dress how u choose. We have youth group. We offer child care. Come check us out. Sunday mornings at 10:00.  Questions let us know! We enjoyed worshiping & the message at Friends church today.  The congregation is a little quiet & not what we are used to, our kid babbles a little & it seemed to be distracting a lot more than any other church we have visited so far.  If you are looking for a neighborhood church with a solid message you should definitely check them out.

name: Friends Church - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended Easter service at Friends Church and had a really uplifting experience. The energy was great from the moment we arrived very welcoming, friendly, and full of life. It’s a large church, but it still felt inviting and well organized.

The service lasted about an hour, which was perfect for families and kept everyone engaged. The music was excellent and really set a positive tone, and the message was meaningful and easy to connect with. They also have a coffee shop on-site, which is a nice touch and great for gathering before or after service.

Overall, it was a wonderful Easter experience. If you’re looking for a church with strong energy, great music, and a welcoming atmosphere, this is definitely a place we would recommend. My son attends the Fortified group here, and we truly feel that everything happened through God’s guidance. Friends Church has been such a warm, welcoming, and positive place for our family.

The community is kind and genuine, the leaders truly care about the kids, and the environment encourages both faith and personal growth. We are very grateful to have found this church. Yay!  I enjoyed the worship songs.  Sound too loud, IMO, but good worship songs.  Very pleasant experience except for sound volume at Sunday 9 AM service. My kid had one week VBS in Friends Church, and he loves here so much. Especially , the kids morning worship was so awesome, everyone was so moved. And even the parking lot employees prayed together. Definitely, we wanna come again. Most Sundays we go and just listen to service. Pastor Matthew is incredible and always delivers a beautiful message. Though we haven't really connected with other families at the church, we still enjoy attending and listening to the messages. I would like to connect more with other members of the community but because it's such a big church, it can be tough to do that. Our kids do love coming here as well. I have recommended this church to several friends.

name: Friends Church Anaheim - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary: Simple from the outside, well kept grounds, the church was beutifull inside !  was a wonderful place to see my grandmother to heaven and lay her to rest in adjacent cemetery, a great last memory. Thank you friends church My kids love to go to Waymaker Church. We're happy to know here. People are really warm and friendly. Thank God! I attended the Sunday service at 10:30 am. The people here are very kind and open to everyone. Both the music and the message was outstanding. We love this church.specially the pastor and his family.great.and i just love he talk about god and everything.makes u laugh.good happy and we always welcome with hug.and clean.serve coffee and cold water. Nice location and property very clean. 730pm FRIDAY NA meeting held towards rear left in building walk thru the courtyard behind main 2 story building to locate

name: Friends Church Fullerton - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
Friends Church Fullerton is a place where relationships are valued & important. It is a place where you feel welcomed and at home. Families are a priority and they have provided so much love & support for my children. The small groups have been a great way for my family to grow & develop a deeper relationship with God & with one another. The pastor and his wife truly care about you and are so welcoming. So grateful for this place we call our church home! Being able to be a part of the church family has been such a blessing for me and my girlfriend especially at Friends Church Fullerton. We were shocked by the love and care this church family shows towards one another and especially for the new members as well. We enjoy the worship and messages and being able to be part of a small group. This church truly does care about your walk with God and will help and support that in anyway they can. We recently moved into the area and were looking for not just a church, but a family.  We found it here!  The congregation opened their arms & hearts and welcomed us with so much love!  The worship is amazing, and I appreciate that they welcome different pastors to speak.  We've been a part of different small groups due to our changing schedule, and the conversations are always God & bible centered.  If you're looking for fellowship, come by and check it out!! Friends Church Fullerton is a new church established in early 2020.
I became a member of the church in June of 2020 , and it has been a wonderful experience building relationships with God fearing people!

Pastor Teddy is a down to earth pastor who doesn’t look at himself any higher or better than his congregation . He is completely engaged with the body , and offers many services to our church for anyone who is in need , or dealing with spiritual warefare!
They offer a wonderful children ministry , weekly Bible study groups, and many family activities throughout the year .

So if your looking for a church home , where you want to be used by God , and grow closer to the body then Friends Church Fullerton is your destination to grow, and strengthen your LOVE relationship with Christ!!

With Love
Roland A. Going to a new church is not easy but Friends Church Fullerton is by far one of the most warm and welcoming churches I’ve ever been to. My boyfriend and I were looking and praying for a church and God answered our prayers. This church and church members have made a huge impact on deepening my relationship with God. Really thankful that God led me to a church that exudes the love of Jesus and genuinely cares for and prays for the members and community. I’m happy to call Friends Church Fullerton my church.

name: Friends Church Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice atmosphere.  Not what we are used to in a Catholic Church, but worship music and singing are good. Sermon seemed a bit long, but good message. I miss receiving communion though. I was able to Go about 16 times. Every Saturday at 5pm while I was living in Orange County. I Loved the Music led by Torie, Leader Vocalist, followed by Pastor Kyle on most Saturdays and I felt like he was talking to me everything and I always felt better after his Sermon's. Thank You Friends Church for Helping me ReNew and Strengthen my Faith in GOD. It was my first time visiting the church. I felt  so happy, and  thanks to my friend Luisa  and her husband, who invited me to the church service 💖 💗 💓 💕 They were cool to us when others weren't.
I think at all least... then one morning someone called the police to ask us to leave. (Always a fiasco) now I want to think it was the CrossFit dooshbags and not the church - because I want to think highly of them, but honestly, I don't know who called the cops. Anyways, please pray for us Friends church. ABSOLUTELY LOVE this church

name: Friends Church Sacramento - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
After trying out several services, my wife and I call Friends Community Church in Sacramento home . The people are genuinely kind and loving people free of judgement keeping their Christian values sacred and loving one another. Service is every Sunday at 10:30 am and there is also a children’s service! All are welcome. Try it out, it is honestly the best. Outstanding! The congregation at Sacramento Friends Church practices loving God and loving people. This is a place to experience God through worship,  teaching, and fellowship with others. Pastor Jared 's bible teaching is clear, honest, and engaging. He is authentic and available for having conversations about growing in faith. The children's ministry is awesome! Lot's of volunteers, bible teaching, and smiles in a bright clean environment. Friends Church in East Sacramento has been such a gift to our family! From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt genuinely welcomed and embraced with love. The people are warm, the atmosphere is uplifting, and there’s such a strong sense of community.

Pastor Jared shares the Word in a way that’s both deep and relatable, and you can truly feel his heart for God and people. The worship is Spirit-filled, and the kids’ ministry is AMAZING—our children are learning about Jesus in fun, creative, and meaningful ways.

This church doesn’t just talk about love—they live it out in their actions, outreach, and relationships. If you’re looking for a place to grow in your faith, connect with others, and experience God’s presence in a real way, Friends Church is the place to be! Friends Church Sacramento is a welcoming community of people who love God. The teaching is excellent and grounded in Scripture. Their life groups (mid-week), provide adults with the opportunity to connect with others, ask spiritual questions in a supportive environment, and grow in faith.

Our grandkids love the "kids' church" and the volunteers who teach and care for them.

This church is located in a nice, quiet neighborhood and feels like home. I love this church! So welcoming and friendly and the message from Jared, the Pastor, is always relevant and inspiring. The music is great as well!
If you are searching for a good place to worship, try Friends Church.

name: Friends Community Church | Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Invited by a friend,  to attend afternoon  mass then enjoy a food fest..
I really enjoyed my visit,  and jade bew friends. Love my new church , Pastor Rick is the Best ! I can't say enough about this church and the wonderful people here. My Mom loved her church and her church family.  On Christmas day,  she went home to be with the Lord. Pastor Rick has been wonderful along with all who have been assisting us with my Mom's memorial service. I have always felt welcomed everytime I attended and Mom felt joy and peace and I will always be grateful. We attended a memorial service for a friend who had passed away recently. It seems like a nice Church. The sound person that is referring to the person controlling the volume of the sound of the speakers tends to run it for young ears in other words too low to be of any use for most of the audience. Which is unfortunate because a lot of what was said was missed being clearly heard. Friendly church with traditional values, positive messaging and classy worship. I felt comfortable here and that was nice.

name: Friendship Assembly of God - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church so much. It's been my home ever since I was a little girl and the spirit of God has filled this place ❤️❤️ We try to live up to our name "FRIENDSHIP ". We have a great senior Pastor who hears from the Lord and brings us "THE WORD". His wife Tierney is our Worship Leader and she really tries to hear from the Lord about the songs  she picks. We also have a wonderful Connection Pastor who makes visitors feel welcome. We have a great Women's leader and her husband heads up the Greeters/Ushers. We also have a man that heads up the Security team. Our Youth/Children's Pastor is great!!!  (full of energy). If you're looking for a " Friendly" Church, come and check us out. Preacher was excellent and his message was great.  Congregation was friendly. Very friendly staff, clergy and members of the body were all very welcoming. Extremely clean and overall excellent vibe. Very good security, especially for the children's areas. Highly recommend to anyone new to the area, with or without kids, or anyone looking for a new church. Have been going for a year there. Love the sermons and structure of biblical teachings and encouragement to mature in the faith. Holy Spirit is the main attraction!

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Can't believe I was actually here for an event "Black Health Matters".  Beautiful historic Church.  Met so many amazing people with wonderful conversations. 01.18.26: Can't get enough of the Bells. So happy to see my mom's memorial brick 💓
-------
Update 12/21/25: Happy  Holidays to all
‐--------------
July 9, 23: Love my church! Young and old alike.  Thank you for being a community institution.  You've been a home for me. We have a tremendous viable treasure in Atlanta.  We have a responsibility to care for this treasure.  Come and worship.
________________
Love the peace that inhibits the sanctuary.  Week come again.

Men's Day. Men do worship and attend church.  Come out and worship with us.  Hear the Good News. Listen to both new and old hymns. Raise your have and praise.  Dress up or come as you are.  All are welcomed. Beautiful church. Friendly members. I was there to celebrate a graduate. It's a beautiful building. I have been a frequent visitor at Friendship and finally joined last Sunday. I found the church warm and welcoming, the music is incredible  with a lot of variety and the new pastor is a gifted preacher, teacher and Biblical scholar. His sermons always hit home and are delivered with depth,  humor and inspiration. Love this church and free concerts for the community Thank you

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Hospitality, Jesus joy, and inclusiveness. The praise and worship is phenomenal. The people of this church love the Lord and love serving the Lord. Pastor Curry is a true man of God. You will feel the spirit of the Lord and the kindness of the worshipers. Go visit, you just might become a member! OMG!  The building is beautiful.  You can feel God's presence the moment you step onto the property.  The Pastor is very excited & welcoming.  I enjoyed learning from the Worship Leader!  Sonja, she's cool!  Fly!  Sings like an Angel!  Great memories. I've been a member since 1997 and the church services and chior are outstanding. I last rememembered a shuttle bus that picks you up from the parking lot because the church had grown with so many members. All the holidays events were spent at the church and my children loved it so. The church used funds appropriately by building an after school room also added many more additions to keep the children happy while learning. I moved to Nevada but I'll soon be reuniting with the best church in Orange County. I love the family atmosphere. I love the worship experience from the beginning to the end. There's a place for everyone. I have felt uplifted and more at peace with each service that I attended. I enjoy the songs and the singers are wonderful. Pastor Curry puts his all into his sermons. May God bless this church.

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
First timer utilizing the Friday Food Pantry ministry. The older gentleman that handed out the facial masks and directed cars was very cold and stern. He never acknowledged my hellos or well wishes and seemed somewhat emotionally detached from the true purpose of dealing with vulnerable people.

I was considering visiting the church, but he put a bad taste in my mouth. First impression is everything!! Good Customer service especially in a church based ministry is key!!

Besides that, the food items were decent and good variety. Thank you for your assistance and God bless I reached out to Friendship Baptist Church during a time of real need, hoping for guidance, prayer, or any form of assistance. Unfortunately, the experience was incredibly discouraging.

I was declined the opportunity to speak with a pastor, denied benevolence assistance, and told there was no help available for emergency food, or clothing. When I asked to speak with a director or receive an email contact for follow-up, I was told no.

I even asked if they could point me toward any other community resources, and that request was also declined.

I work in the medical field and was simply trying to find help to continue working and survive a difficult moment. While I understand organizations have policies, the lack of compassion and refusal to provide even basic guidance or referrals was extremely disappointing. Friendship Baptist Church is truly welcoming and full of love. Pastor Bowens delivers uplifting and powerful messages, and the worship is joyful and inspiring.

I am blessed to be part of the Outreach Ministry, which I truly love. Friendship is more than a church to attend, it is a place to belong, grow, and serve.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a loving and spirit filled church home! The heart of God beats on the inside of this divine pastoral kingdom leadership team. The true gospel is preached, taught, and echoes within the walls and on the land of this historical site. Come be led, fed, and loved on by the church Christ built-you can feel it in the atmosphere. My forever faithful family! I visited FBC for the first time today. It was mostly as I expected. I arrived a little late so I am not able to assess their welcome and parking and welcine ministries.  Although the shuttle bus driver did offer me a ride up to the church.

The grounds and the building are immaculately kept.  The sanctuary is modern.  The musician are professional, though it seemed that some were on vacation today.  The music was good. The video presentations were  poor.  The graphics seemed very amatuerish and not up to the standard of the rest of the worship.  They should invest in a proper church graphics presentation software.

The praise and worship was very good. There was very good  congregational participation and the songs seemed to be well known.

The service was very organized.  The ushers all seemed to know exactly what they were doing. There wasn't a bulletin. The order of service was broadcasted on two jumbo screens on either side of the stage.

I liked that the offering seemed to be an  important part of the service.  A bible verse was read prior to the offering prsyer.  Tying tithing to biblical principals.

The sermon today was entitled "The Cave Experience "  it was all about David being in a dark cave but not losing his faith in God.  God puts us all in dark places for a reason and if your follow his lead we will come out better and stronger in our faith in God.  It was biblical based and it connected with the congregation including me.

The preaching was sterotypical Baptist with a lot of hooping and hollering at the end.

All in all its a good place to get a good word.

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Food Distribution Center - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
Great customer service all stuff!

Great Donations food right there too ! I attended a funeral.
However, the church and the members are wonderful. They are always nice and generous Great church and friendly people The nicest people, and none of the food is expired

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Love watching the service on YouTube all the way from Minnesota. I love how the pastors preach during the service, the emotion you can feel in their voices. The choir is fantastic. The church is great but please the Spanish church is not. It really requires a different leader and not reflective of the English pastor. Really disheartening that power and greed have overridden the message of Gods love. Be careful! Friendly friendly friendly peeps. That's really the only thing you should expect from a church called Friendship Baptist. The music was classy and old fashioned, though their Christmas concert featured Dan Forrest's arrangements pretty heavily (I'm a fan so it was fine) and the tempo of the music Sunday morning was all the exact same basically. Unfortunately I didn't get to hear the head pastor preach they had a guest speaker in, but when I heard him speak you can't help but love his very radio-like voice. Again, I was blown away by the feeling of community at this church. Would highly recommend if you're looking for a young marrieds, newlywed, traditional, family friendly church. They even have a softball team! Friendship is not just a church, but a family in Christ! Everyone is welcoming, their focus on Bible centered teaching is outstanding. Nice, pretty, following covid-19 restrictions, good parking, friendly people.  I really didn't have enough time to say anything about the sermon or ideology.

name: Friendship Baptist Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Its Fellowship reflects its name Friendship. It has been there in Venice, Ca. for about 75 years 🙏 Great place people are kind, as well as pleasant cant wait to visit again. ive been here before with my ulcle' Amazing teaching 🙏🏾

reviewSummary: This  Church is the Best church on this side of heaven…the members are definitely Friendship Family❤️❤️❤️❤️ I visited here and it was a blessing! Planning on going back soon. My church!! Friendly, just as it says. Services are well organized and not too lengthy. Special programs and food is good. Come on down and see for yourself!! Awesome church I will be back I was treated like family Godly and blessed family!

name: Friendship Pasadena Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church! Beautiful Pastor Lucius! Just celebrated 130 years in Pasadena CA! There is no dressing code. The girls there  are too revealing, and over exposed. Having the word of God, not by need, just is not making any sense if a church is all about living right and make repentance as main goal Amazing! Sunday service and  Bible study Best place I know to truly be taught the living WORD and feel the presence of all mighty God inhabiting your worship there. Join us! Favorite church in all of Pasadena! I will visit other churches but Friendship is my home church

name: Frisco Bible Church
reviewSummary: A Bible church in Frisco offering expository teaching with a strong family-oriented community.

name: Frisco Campus
Frisco Community Church - Frisco Campus
reviewSummary: Jesus’ heart is evident in this church! They truly love people! We found FCC late last year and have not felt so loved in a long time.  The leadership and the members reached out to us and helped us find our place here.  We mentioned a serious dietary allergy to them, and everyone has been so accommodating— even changing communion wafers so that my son and I can participate with the rest of the community.  I’ve seen the love of Jesus lived out here and am grateful for finding FCC. This is not somewhere that actually is a “come as you are” environment. Their mission statement is merely words on a website and not something they practice. They are very quick to judge and Pastor Michael is unreachable for the most part and when he does finally deem anything worth a response after his staff places judgement on others for past mistakes, which were out of their control and mutually wrong by the other party in question, deems people unfit to be in their church while threatening to block them and condemn then further, while questioning their character when speaking up for themselves without ever having heard them and making assumptions about sister church’s views on people which are incorrect as well. I would not recommend this place to anyone as this is why so many turn away from church in the first place. It should be a safe place without judgement and condemnation and you will not find that here. This church does not follow what they claim on their website. They are judgmental about a person's past without knowing the full story. They are unwilling to discuss concerns about their judgments. I would not recommend this church to anyone who has had past mistakes. We love our church!! If you are looking for an authentic place to worship with a supportive community of believers, come join us!

name: Frisco East Campus
Frisco First Baptist Church - Frisco Campus
reviewSummary: Used to go here when I lived in Texas, amazing church! The community is outstanding, and Pastor Chuck always has such a good, biblically based sermon! Everyone here is very kind and Christlike, and will always be a big part of my walk! I pray only the best for this church! I took my kids here for a quick afternoon stop after running errands nearby. The park is on the smaller side, so it is not really a place I would choose for a long walk, but it works well when the goal is letting kids play. Whoever handles the upkeep has done a good job with the main playground area, because the fenced layout, splash pad, garden area, veteran tribute, and clean pavilions made it easy to settle in while the kids moved between the wooden play structures and the zip line. I appreciated that the play area felt contained, especially with younger kids who like to wander. There are picnic tables and a grill, and the covered areas looked cared for enough that I would consider using them for a small birthday or lunch. The basketball court and nearby sports areas are useful to have, but the court surface could use attention since there were wet spots and uneven looking concrete. A little more shade and some repairs to older playground pieces would make the park more comfortable. Overall, it is a convenient neighborhood park with a lot packed into a compact space. Love paster chuck!!! Everybody here is very welcoming and friendly. Did not feel odd coming to a new place. So glad that we're able to join this church family. I feel very loved and blessed. This church has been a blessing to our family. Biblical teaching. Loving people. God’s hands and feet. Awesome church my family and I are new members. Church service is really good and the Sunday school for the kids is awesome with a very professional set up and my kids love it, they get excited every Sunday.

name: From the Heart Church Ministries of Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly greeting staff and ushers. I attended for a funeral. The pastor dida beautiful eulogy and spoke well to the living. That we must exceed the righteousness of the Pharisees, we must love!!! I'm trying to get back and visit, but it's been difficult. Much love to this pastor and the congregation of From The Heart Church, Charlotte, NC This church has been a blessing to me and my family for many years.  It's rich in God's Word and an awesome family atmosphere.  We teach everyone, no matter your age or background...Jesus is Lord!! I immediately enrolled in new members' classes. This is a REAL church...old school. WONDERFUL PEOPLE, THEREFORE A WONDERFUL CHURCH. Great Resurrection Sunday Service I was a member.  Loved the atmosphere and Teaching from Pastor Cherry.

name: Front Range Christian Fellowship - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary: A friendly congregation of people. I didn't see anyone under the age 20 years old. Definitely a lively involved group of people. Services start at 930am for Sunday school and church service go from 1030am to 1230pm. I felt pretty comfortable and welcomed by the people who attended. The pastor and his wife are very nice people too. The message of the day was straight forward and to the point. They have a praise and worship team that plays instruments and sings with relevant consistency. I definitely would return to follow up and learn more about this church. Really great service better than life bridge in my opinion still looking for my church home they were pretty good might be in again I don't know I greatly appreciate this church's outreach programs and the they were quick to respond to my questions. Thanks so much guys! They are a very caring Christan family  come join us Great people good preaching

name: Frontier Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church! Everyone you meet from start to finish is incredibly warm and welcoming. The worship is heartfelt and the sermons are easy to follow and captivating. I love Frontier and feel honored to call it my church home! The community here is exceptionally kind and makes it easy to connect. I love the message of renewing the beauty of Jesus on the frontiers of modern culture! We need that in Los Angeles! Since we have set foot in this church 5 years ago, we have found nothing but love and grace and a new family!  These people love Jesus, pursue the Holy Spirit, foster warm and loving community, and love to worship with all their hearts!  I love that my kids have friends who can pray with them and amazing role models in the volunteers that serve wholeheartedly in the most genuine ways possible!  People here seek no glory for themselves; rather, selflessly pour themselves out to encourage one another and make room for the Holy Spirit to minister among us!  Love you guys!  Thank you Christian and Sue for setting the spiritual temperature to blazing hot! I've been attending Frontier for a little over a year now and found it through a random google search of churches near me but I believe the result was a divine appointment. I have found a church community that is loving, supportive, encouraging, accepting and Spirit led/filled. I also value and cherish the transparency, honesty and genuineness of the leadership - headed by Pastors Christian and Sue. No pretention or facades, just sincere followers/lovers/disciples ofJesus encouraging, equipping and teaching us to be(come) the same in the midst of the messiness, questions, doubts, tensions, etc. Pastors Christian and Susannah are enthusiastic about sharing the Love that is the promise of the Lord. The sermon last week enriched my understanding and educated me about the ways humans make sense of our faith. This church truly seeks to be inclusive. The upcoming Alpha Class sounds really wonderful! Thank you for loving people, Frontier!

name: Frontline Church Edmond - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I wanted to thank the staff and people of Frontline Church. We have attended there for about a year now. I've tried being bald as much as I can. My wife has some special needs, I was hoping we could fit in but I think the church is just on an upswing and have really focused on the growth. The message is always good. The congregation is more reserved. The message always has some real depth and not just for the new believer. The Wed prayer is something I'll keep attending it's such an uplifting time. After going to the senior staff about my wife's special needs about how ignored we felt I learned they don't care. If you wear a Bernie and grow a beard you can fit in. Time to grow up. I'm about as disappointed in a church as I could possibly be. Not one person reached out to my wife after I begged them too. Pastor Cale couldn't wait to refer us to another church. They were not to be burdend in any way. Church visitation is non existent here. Church of the city? Which city. I was involved in some prayer groups and felt like I wasn't wanted. I'm 63 and been a Christian my whole life and never have I felt less wanted. I asked if maybe the church could open in the summer when temps were in the high 90s. That's not something they do. As a matter of fact the church is locked most of the time. It's definitely not a church for the city. I'm extremely disappointed in the care and compassion my wife and I have received. When your spouse has terminal cancer We have loved going here the past 4 years! Such a lovely community in Christ. I love how much they encourage you to be a light and helper in the neighborhhod and community you live in. We also are encouraged by the community groups each week. The teaching has been convicting for my husband and I as well, not just surface level but really going deep into scripture. So grateful for the community we’ve found in Frontline! My husband and I have grown so much in our knowledge of & love for the Word during our time here. We appreciate the way they preach verse by verse through books of the Bible, never shying away from the hard topics but working through them with humility, truth & grace. I’m amazed every week by the things our young kids are learning too! The children’s ministry is more than just babysitting, they are working to lay a strong foundation of Biblical understanding for the next generation. We’re so glad the Lord led our family here! A church centered on the Gospel! Staying true to preaching God's inherent Word, worshiping His name in humility, and submitting to Him in prayer. We are still new but we love this church so far! We have been welcomed by staff and recognized each week after. We are looking forward to growing in our relationship with the Lord, and growing our family in this church. Truly wonderful church committed to preaching the gospel, calling members to repentance, humility and service to others. Outstanding Biblical worship!! Very friendly and loving. Simply a fantastic church.

Almost all one star reviews here have no comment. Possibly organized hit job on Frontline from activists. Too bad too because Frontline is a very solid church committed to Biblical preaching and worship.

name: Full Life Fellowship Church
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been searching for the perfect fit church for a while. We found that here at Full Life Fellowship. The number one things that I love about the church is the welcome feeling you get when you walk in the doors and the real life messages spoken from Pastor Tony. This is not like any other church we have visited. The music is a mixture of old school county hyms and contemparay christian. There are no smoke or lights! You can tell that the message preached is God given and I guarantee it will speak to you. The parishioners here are so welcoming and friendly. This tight knit church is like family to us. After our first day we were hooked. We've been coming ever since! For two and a half years now. Our children have been born in this church and we have always been encouraged to have them present vocals and all! We love this church and we hope you will too! Oh and I should probably mention there is always a yummy breakfast, coffee, and water available at the beginning of the service. It's come as you are, just come! What a wonderful experience. Relaxed Bible based church. The fellowship is just amazing. Everyone's welcome, casual dress, come as you are, and share our love for Jesus.

If your unable to attend. Check us out on u-tube. Paster Tony delivers a powerful message every Sunday. But still come when can. You will feel the love of this congregation. No matter who you are you are welcome. My wife and I have attended this church for 12 years. This church, its members and it's pastor have the greatest blessing of our lives. Awesome message!  Great fellowship!  Christ centered ! Come visit! A true heart-felt message every week.

name: Fullerton First United Methodist Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up attending Fullerton First United Methodist Church and attend every time I visit.  This church provides so much service for the community through its ministries.  This community has a cornerstone in this long living church.  Come as you are, you will be welcomed. I grew up in this church. My husband and I got  married here 45 years ago. Great !

name: Fullerton First United Methodist Church Preschool - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: FFUMC Preschool provided a warm environment for our daughter to learn through play. The teachers and staff are kind, thoughtful, and patient in their instruction. The Director puts a lot of effort into building a community for the students and their families. I recommend this preschool without reservation, especially to anyone looking for an option that coincides with the academic calendar! We’ve been coming to FFUMC for over 5 years!  All three of our kids attended here.  The staff is amazing and truly care about your children’s development.  I highly recommend FFUMC if you’re looking for more than just a daycare. It’s a place for your child to grow! Fullerton first is such a special place! The teachers really love on each of the kids and take the time for them as individuals. I would recommend it to anyone! This has been our preschool for over 1.5 years. Our second son has also been attending their daycare and will be starting at the preschool in the new school year. We absolutely LOVE this preschool.  It is montessori style, which is amazing, but the biggest factor me me is how it truly feels like a family. I cannot stress enough how wonderful each and every teacher is. I had such anxiety with leaving my oldest for the first time, and trusting someone else with my baby, but they quickly ended that anxiety. They genuinely care about the kids and families, and are happy to help with anything and everything. They have been particularly amazing with supporting both my boys through their potty training journey. The student teacher ratio is perfect and my boys get the attention and love they need, as do their friends. The school is clean and well stocked with good quality toys, and my 3 year old tells me the snacks are pretty great too! I drive 30 minutes each way, twice a day and have zero regrets. I feel so lucky that I managed to find this little preschool, especially when I was an overwhelmed first time, expat mum. I, literally, cannot praise and thank them enough. Loving caring preschool. I felt at ease dropping off my daughter knowing that she was in good hands.

name: Fullerton Free (EvFree Fullerton) - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful community church for 40 years or so. We love their Easter sunrise service and the Saturday Farmers Market! Went for the farmers market on Saturday mornings. Small market, but lots of good stuff. Specially the granola bars, hummus, yogurts and veggies. 3 services and more than 20 adult fellowships, teen and kids programs. All happening on Sunday. There's something for everyone. Also, just hired a new Lead Pastor, who's a dynamic speaker & can present biblical Truth. Check it out for yourself. The 1st class to Have a live Commencement 🎓 Trinity Law School classes 2020 & 2021.... A blessing to walk the stage.... 😍😊😁 One of the best churches you can attend in Orange County, if not all of Southern California.

name: Fullness Christian Fellowship - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: I get it. It's a small church. But the thing is, in a small church you tend to know a bunch of the people. Everyone is very embracing, loving and supportive. The pastor and his wife are a terrific tag team. Highly recommended for all people, yound and old. Just come as you are. Rarely have I been to a church, where I am so constantly, so fulsomely filled with God's word.  Not booming oratory, but Bible-based sermons, the type I look for at which if you don't have a Bible (though scriptures are, actually, projected), you may not understand the message fully.  I don't want to know the pastor's interpretation; I want to know God's word.  When taking segueing onto current events, Pastor Bart Groom evidences a conservative belief set that is not in line with my beliefs, but no church will give you everything you are seeking.  The members seem very connected and supportive of one another.  A especially blessed Sunday morning almost every time I attend. I've been going here for years. Super friendly church,  very kind people. Great worship full of life and joy; and great Biblical preaching and teaching. All are welcomed. Amazing family oriented church! Very Welcoming. Loving Congregation.

name: Fundamental Baptist Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
While the church members themselves I am sure are good, the current pastor's judgement is ethically questionable at best.

When attempting to resolve issues with the leadership, the pastor refused to communicate and the leadership failed to hold their pastor accountable. Such lack of accountability is echoed in various other independent fundamental Baptist churches with long histories of abuse. Exercise great caution if you have a family with children. Great church, best Pastor ever!  Been here since 2013 & still glad that God led us here! We were on vacation with the family and hoped to slip in and out of the service. We were greeted warmly by many members. It was a teen girl who offered to walk us to the nursery. The preaching was Biblical and thought provoking. When we vacation in this area again, we will definitely be back! I have gone to this church since i was 5. Pastor is so very nice and encouraging his daughters are so very sweet and the whole church is like my 2nd family . They make me feel so welcomed the teachers are very nice and make learning gods will way more fun than it already is . I highly suggest you visit us!! The people are friendly,  and the Word of God is faithfully preached with energy and excitement.

name: Fusion Christian Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful Bible teaching local church with a great pastor(s), superb children's ministry, energetic youth directors, talented worship team, and welcoming faces of the church family! The church staff is always on top of day to day operations and usually respond to inquiries promptly! No matter what stage or chapter of life you're in, I highly recommend attending Fusion Christian Church And becoming part of the church family. First Sunday Service 11/30/25.
Walked in (nervous and new) and saw the most beautiful smiles in every direction. People fellowshipping, talking, laughing and smiling who did not hesitate to greet and welcome me (again, with those lovely smiles!).
Thought to myself how I would love to experience some of their joy.
I don't remember ever being invited to join a church in the past. I have since completed the Fusion foundational membership classes. I am now a CHURCH MEMBER! I am making  new friends and joining them in studying God's precious and life giving word.
I hope I never take for granted this cause of joy I am experiencing (fellowship, hope, faith and love) and all those smiles that greet me each time I enter this Church.
I am truly blessed and pray I may bless Fusion church and it's mission to reach and to serve others.
In humble appreciation,
K.B. For anyone searching for a church home to grow in community and strengthen their relationship with Jesus, Fusion Christian church is for you. Fusion has been my church home for about one year now and it has been one of the greatest blessing the Lord has given me and my family. The leadership is marked by humility, sound doctrine, and genuine care for Gods people. You are made to feel welcomed and like you belong there from the moment you walk in the doors.

The kids ministry is amazing! There are separate classes for nursery, prek, kinder through 2nd, and a 3rd through 5th grade where every child is welcomed with love and acceptance. I was so glad to hear that Fusion requires anyone who works in the kids ministry, or is around the children, to undergo a background check and live scan/finger printing! It is such a relief for parents and caregivers to know their children are safe and those given the privilege to care for the kids are held accountable and can be trusted. I’ve never seen such a well organized, safe, and Jesus focused approach to a kids ministry with Bible-centered teaching about the love of the Lord.

There is also a great weekly youth group and so many small group options for people looking to connect with others and grow in their faith through their hobbies or passions.

You actually matter at Fusion, and when you come to church you aren’t just attending a service, you’re welcomed into God’s house where there is always a seat at the table. Trust God. He will bring exactly the right people at His perfect timing to walk alongside you in life to share and celebrate in your joys and weep alongside you when we experience the sorrows Jesus promised this life would bring. His mercy is new every morning and it shows in the outpouring of grace and love this church congregation demonstrates in their service and care of those God brings through the doors.

Fusion has in person services, live streams, social media, monthly Wednesday night services, small home groups, and discipleship programs that are open to everyone who wants to grow in their love of God and learn to serve others.

God is using Fusion for such great, impactful ministry work for His kingdom in the Temecula valley region and local surrounding areas through outreaches and international ministries with the heart to love our God and spread the gospel in love to everyone. We just moved to the area and we’ve been searching for our new home church. We walked into fusion with our 5 month old and sat in the service for about 10 minutes when someone walked up to us and gave us this card. I was really confused because our son was not crying or anything. He was just coo-ing but not consistently. He coo’d maybe once or twice. I felt like we were being kicked out but genuinely feel like our baby was not disrupting the service. Felt discouraged because this is the first time we have tried going to a new church since our son was born. If i knew this would have happened i would have just watched the live stream from my home. We will keep looking. God bless After many years of trying to find my “church home”, I was invited to Fusion by my (then) girlfriend. It felt like the perfect fit. The lead pastor, Zac, is funny, relatable, and caring. Three months later, I was baptized, three months go by, I was married. Soon after that we were expecting our baby girl! Fusion provided us with so much love and support. I don’t know where we would be without them. Praise Jesus for saving us and thank you Zac for always being there.
