name: Future City Church
Futures Church Alpharetta - Alpharetta / Milton Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I were looking for a church where we could not only connect with the members but also build a personal relationship with the pastor. We previously attended a mega church, and while the worship was wonderful, we found it difficult to truly connect with leadership.

Futures Church has a beautiful, tastefully decorated space and even a well-structured coffee area where people can gather after services, which creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The members we met were very friendly, and we are thankful for the kindness we experienced.

That said, our biggest struggle was feeling connected to the pastor. Understandably, he is very busy, especially with the exciting work of planting new churches, which is an important mission. Still, for us, having a relational pastor is essential to growing in our faith. At times, the church felt more like a business hub than a spiritual home, and I found myself longing for a deeper pastoral relationship.

We share this with love and hope, wishing that Futures Church continues to grow not only in numbers but also in building meaningful relationships that nurture faith on a personal level Our family first began attending Futures Church in 2017 at one of their very first campuses near Alpharetta. This was prompted after a close friend reached out during a major health crisis in our lives. From the moment we stepped in, we felt the presence of God and the genuine love of the community. It’s been amazing ever since.

Our son absolutely loves it here, and every Sunday fills us with spirit-filled energy that carries us into the week with strength, clarity, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

Pastor Ashley and Jane Evans are truly incredible. Ashley’s book No More Fear helped guide me out of one of the darkest places of my life and realigned my focus with the truth of God’s word. It was a powerful and timely gift.

Pastor Ryan and his wife Lindsey are equally amazing, and everyone involved in this church brings humility, passion, and purpose to what they do.

We are so grateful to call this our church home. Futures is a place of transformation, encouragement, and deep spiritual growth. Highly recommend to anyone searching for a powerful, Spirit-led community. Futures Church Alpharetta has been my church home for two years now. It's an exceptional church, where God's word is taught, the Holy Spirit is obviously present, and Christ is at the center. It's the friendliest church I've ever been to -- it's not just that people greet you & smile (though they do!) -- people have a sincere desire to get to you know as a person. In addition to Sunday services (worship, prayer, meaningful sermons & fellowship), Futures offers small groups, weekly prayer times, outreach events (like Easter egg hunts, family Sundays & an annual fashion show) and more. Come visit and see for yourself. Future Church was the first church I visited here in America, and it has long impressed me with its strong presence of the Holy Spirit and hospitality. Our family has been attending Futures church for over 3 years and we have felt welcome from Day 1! It’s been an awesome place for us and our kids to grow and find genuine community!

name: Futures Church Alpharetta - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I were looking for a church where we could not only connect with the members but also build a personal relationship with the pastor. We previously attended a mega church, and while the worship was wonderful, we found it difficult to truly connect with leadership.

Futures Church has a beautiful, tastefully decorated space and even a well-structured coffee area where people can gather after services, which creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The members we met were very friendly, and we are thankful for the kindness we experienced.

That said, our biggest struggle was feeling connected to the pastor. Understandably, he is very busy, especially with the exciting work of planting new churches, which is an important mission. Still, for us, having a relational pastor is essential to growing in our faith. At times, the church felt more like a business hub than a spiritual home, and I found myself longing for a deeper pastoral relationship.

We share this with love and hope, wishing that Futures Church continues to grow not only in numbers but also in building meaningful relationships that nurture faith on a personal level Our family first began attending Futures Church in 2017 at one of their very first campuses near Alpharetta. This was prompted after a close friend reached out during a major health crisis in our lives. From the moment we stepped in, we felt the presence of God and the genuine love of the community. It’s been amazing ever since.

Our son absolutely loves it here, and every Sunday fills us with spirit-filled energy that carries us into the week with strength, clarity, and the power of the Holy Spirit.

Pastor Ashley and Jane Evans are truly incredible. Ashley’s book No More Fear helped guide me out of one of the darkest places of my life and realigned my focus with the truth of God’s word. It was a powerful and timely gift.

Pastor Ryan and his wife Lindsey are equally amazing, and everyone involved in this church brings humility, passion, and purpose to what they do.

We are so grateful to call this our church home. Futures is a place of transformation, encouragement, and deep spiritual growth. Highly recommend to anyone searching for a powerful, Spirit-led community. Futures Church Alpharetta has been my church home for two years now. It's an exceptional church, where God's word is taught, the Holy Spirit is obviously present, and Christ is at the center. It's the friendliest church I've ever been to -- it's not just that people greet you & smile (though they do!) -- people have a sincere desire to get to you know as a person. In addition to Sunday services (worship, prayer, meaningful sermons & fellowship), Futures offers small groups, weekly prayer times, outreach events (like Easter egg hunts, family Sundays & an annual fashion show) and more. Come visit and see for yourself. Future Church was the first church I visited here in America, and it has long impressed me with its strong presence of the Holy Spirit and hospitality. Our family has been attending Futures church for over 3 years and we have felt welcome from Day 1! It’s been an awesome place for us and our kids to grow and find genuine community!

name: Futures Church Gwinnett - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
I was hurting and looking for a place that was genuine and wouldn’t judge me for my past, for things I’ve decided to no longer do, but nevertheless they did happen IN MY PAST. I went to 3 other highly recommended churches and each time my checklist of 4 simple things I wanted to see, wasn’t met. I went in the front doors of Influencers with my checklist written in my heart. I had only been there 5 MINUTES and all 4 were met!

This church is genuine in its love and devotion to God and to His word. They love Him and love people, irregardless of their mess. I’m proud to call this place my home church, a place where I can bring my family and friends and know that they’ll be loved for who they are.

If you need a church, you won’t be disappointed! A warm and welcoming church where the worship is spirit-filled and the sermons are rich and deep. God’s presence feels so REAL in this place. Growing up I always had a hard time finding a church I felt welcomed, loved & not judged. This is the most welcoming, humbling, and overall accepting church I’ve ever attended. Hands down this will be my church each and every Sunday from here on out! If your struggling and looking for a church you call your home then I highly recommend giving this one a try! I promise you will not be disappointed! We’ve attended Influencers for fifteen years and we love this place! Our kids are growing around like minded people who love Jesus and are unashamed of their faith. We’ve made lifelong friends and have a wonderful community - we’re proud to call ourselves Influencers. After a year of attending, I wish I could say that I loved it. There's friendly people, awesome worship, inspiring messages but it kind of stops there. I found the church to be very clique-ish and despite my efforts, I just never clicked. Most members have been there since the church began. Their global vision is 200 churches and 10K leaders within the next few years and that is their focus - not so much healing hearts, growing in God teachings and faith💔 I started going at one of the most difficult times in my life and they just are not equipt to minister to  people with serious issues. I was not ready to follow the formula -#1 Go to their BlueRoom to meet church leaders, #2 complete their DNA course (4 Sundays) which teaches you about the church's culture, #3 Join an ministry within the church and serve, serve, serve, #4 join a "House Party" (small group). Then go to fun events, leadership school, conferences, and more on their pie chart. But life isn't always a party or fun. I was not looking for anyone to solve my problems - I sought out help and still came up short. There are definitely some tender-hearted members... but I have to say [in love] that I did not feel it in the overall atmosphere of the church.

name: Futures Church Kennesaw - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary: I finally found a Godsome church i can call home. Soooo happy. Everyone is so nice here, the worship is amazing and the pastor really hears from God and is very anointed. You will be very glad you visited This is a wonderful Life giving church that is centered around fellowship and doing life together. The worship is upbeat and modern. The teaching is spirit filled and always excellent. We have two services on Sunday morning, 9:30 AM and 11:30 AM. We also have a worship and prayer night on Thurdays at 7. If your looking for a great church to attend; this is the best one I know of. If you are looking for a church family that really loves one another,  this is the church you should visit.   Pastor Andy is a great preacher and every week he will teach you something that you will think about all week.   The Holy Spirit speaks through Pastor Andy. Go experience it for yourself, with a open mind and heart and no regrets will come about from that decision Excelente ligths of joy. I like it.

name: Gainesville Christian Center - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: I experience a vibrant, living Spirit of Fellowship in this community. The sound is LOUD. I brought cotton balls for my ears for my second meeting to savor the Living Spirit fully.

name: Gainesville Church of Christ - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: Friendliest  church I've ever known. The Bible -and the Bible only - is taught  to all ages. Preaching is sound. Non-denominational; it belongs to Christ. No recreation; its mission is to bring the lost to Christ and worship God in spirit and in truth  No instrumental entertainment to "tickle the ears." We gather solely to worship and study, but we have fellowship  meals  at our homes or at other locations, such as Hurricane Shoals. If you want to become a Christian and learn and grow, this is the place to go. Truth seekers gather here, sharing love, peace kindness and not fear. I have visited several times over the past month and have thoroughly enjoyed the services and the people.   Truly a loving and concerned Christian congregation.   They are interested in meeting  you and getting to know you and willing to discuss any concerns.   I will be back.   Lesa This is a great group of Christians that are trying to live in the example of Christ and the first century Church. Very warm and welcoming. I highly recommend you visiting. Very great place with brothers and sisters. Very nice experience and communion.

name: Gainesville City Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
City Church has a heart to serve its city. Their motto is “everyone is welcome because no one is perfect” and that’s exactly how you feel walking in! The Bible is taught, the Holy Spirit is present, and kind people are there to share the love of Jesus. service time is 10@AM. City church is filled with authentic people who love Jesus. It’s all about real genuine interaction, loving one another, and ultimately-ministering to Gods heart. From the moment we entered, it was evident that something special was happening. The preaching was not just words, but a channel through which we could feel the presence of God. The worship, too, was an awe-inspiring experience that touched our hearts deeply. Highly Recommended!!

My family was impressed with Pastor Beau Robson & his preaching style! Their worship team is also very talented! My wife and I enjoyed the KLOVE style contemporary Christian music...

Service is at 10am each Sunday, and the children’s ministry has a designated class for my two children! Awesome music, awesome message,  and awesome people. This place is real and full of genuine people looking to help one another and be true followers of Jesus and His teachings.

name: Gainesville International Christian Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church really helped me at such a low point in my life. I was kind of alone living in Gainesville for school, but this the members of this congregation became family with such genuine love. They taught me how to follow God in a biblical way, which ultimately, changed my life forever! I’m currently a part of our sister church in a different city, but the GICC will always have my heart! I highly recommend it to anyone & everyone  The Gainesville International Christian Church is a church that feels like home. It is a great example of what God’s kingdom is supposed to look like because despite all of our differences we are one. This is the church for you‼️🥹❤️🙌 Most importantly, it is a church that relies heavily on God’s word which is crucial as it will help us stay rooted in God‼️ This is my family and I am right where God wants me to be😌 It is a family focus environment. Great singing and lessons that are impactful and crucial to life change.
The first time out I was amazed by the love that was shown. Even how they were willing to walk with me in my daily life. I love this church!! I've been attending the GICC for almost five years and I feel so at home, with being at Santa Fe College and now UF. Plus they preach and obey the Bible FULLY... I've never seen that until coming here. Seriously, check it out... you won't regret it! (They even do personal Bible studies and small discussions, ANYWHERE & ANYTIME.) Sooo many forever friendships made! Such an incredible group of God-loving individuals! My time here has spurred so much spiritual growth, maturity, and wisdom in my life. I really appreciate how this church is bible-based, deriving sermons, teachings, and lifestyle from the scriptures. This congregation calls everyone to live to the standard that the word of God calls us to live. A true Acts 2:42-47 church.

name: Galilee South Community Church - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to Colorado from other state back in 2019 and have been at Gagilee South last seven years.  It has been a wonderful experience.  You can find God's word, truth and love here.  I encourage everyone who is seeking to come and meet us. The best Chinese church in Denver, full of energy and joy.
May God use this church to impact many lives. I came to Denver from New York to start a new life. I met many new friends in this church. It is also a very warm place for me to belong. I am grateful to my God for allowing me to come back here! I'm homeless and they gave me all the leftover food from the prayer meeting. I went and got sandwich bags and a package of spoons and a case of water. Then I filled the bags up I got 12 potions , got ice for the cooler and went on a mission from god ... I spread their love 💕 to all the homeless people knowing that all the places that serve the homeless were closed on Sunday . I prayed with them all I had so much fun doing it ... Thank you God for this opertunity to serve you .... God bless ... Galilee Community Church is truly a special place. I was baptized here last year of December, this church has been a part of my life since childhood. Although I was away for a few years, God led me back to what I now proudly call my second home.

name: Gallery Church Baltimore
reviewSummary:
I have a wonderful morning in the church the last Sunday... The brother and sister have a lot of love to cheer...

I come from New York I so blessed one angel show me the door...🙏 What a warm welcome this visitor received from the members of this church. Visiting from PA. and hope to be back! A very lovely building. Most enjoyable wedding and a fun evening. Best place of worship. In the historic 1840s building in Downtown Baltimore.

name: Galveston Bible Church - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church.  Small enough that the Pastor knows my name (keeps me accountable), Big enough to spread a LOT of love.  Praise group are infinitely talented!  Bible based teaching! Love it! I was most impressed by the friendliness of the people and the emphasis on prayer. I am also happy  that people  can attend in person (Jan. 2021) and masks are optional. Pastor Jason is that rare combination of a great teacher who can bring a bible-based message into your heart. If you choose to give your email address you can receive weekly updates on programs and matters relating to the church, dates, times, opportunities etc. which I find very helpful. This is not a huge church that you will get lost in and not be greeted personally, this is a church where you will be welcomed. (though not pressured). Demographically this is a good mix of young and old, student and working people, with many nationalities represented. I'm sorry that it took me awhile to find this church and would encourage anyone to come who is looking for a loving church with solid biblical teaching. Awesome church! Got baptized there~
Great scripture, preaching and emphasis on fellowship and sound doctrine.

If you need a body of believers that wants to know you and help you grow in Christ this is it! We were visiting from Indiana and were looking for somewhere to attend Sunday morning worship. 👀LOOK NO FARTHER!! Friendly and Factual Bible believing church, we enjoyed the upbeat music and the sermon .We also admired a lot of different age groups attending and a lot of younger folks really getting involved! Great worship experience!!! Pastor Jason teaches the Bible as it should be taught and does not sugar coat the gospel.  Your ears will not be tickled. It is good solid teaching.  Bring your Bibles and your note pads. His sermons will leave you focused  for the rest of the week on what was taught Sunday.  You will not walk out of there and forget about it. If you are in the area and looking for a home church, please give this church a try.

name: Galveston Central Church - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
God is in this place!  Hallelujah!

My husband and I visited for the first time yesterday and it was such a wonderful experience.  The church building is over 100 years old filled with stained glass and lots of beautiful architecture.
There's all sorts of seating including couches, stuffed chairs, etc.
But what we appreciated most was the message, the infant baptism, open communion and the general warmth of the community.
They also serve the homeless in their community and provide all sorts of services for them.  It was such a blessing to have them join the service.  We'll definitely return! God's work is shown in everything the pastor and his wife do for this community. Drop off shoes, garments or food for distribution to needy people in Galveston.
They furnish showers and laundry facilities.
Lost your I.D. ? They try to help. Personally I've some hard times,bad time and good..They have always been supportive and helpful to me and my friends and family.. This place is unlike any church I’ve been to before in all the best ways possible.
It’s made a point to get to know you and have you feel welcome and loved. None of the ideology is radical or drastic and you have people from all walks of life that attend in unity as one.

Very proud of this place and everything they do for the community like an authentic “Church” would do.

Cheers to us! I found my family here. ♥️

name: Garden City Church
reviewSummary:
We are so thankful to have found this church! It has been our home for over ten years and continues to be such a special place for our family. Pastor George delivers inspiring sermons that have helped us grow both individually and together, and the worship band is absolutely fantastic and one of a kind.

What truly sets this church apart, though, is the loving community. The people here are authentic, welcoming, and deeply supportive. You really have to experience it to understand just how special it is!

If you’re looking for a family-friendly church in downtown Tacoma, this is a wonderful place to check out! My family and I have been part of Garden City Church for over 10 years, and we have nothing but good things to say about our experience. This Church has been an incredible source of Community for us here in Tacoma.

The teaching is thoughtful, grounded, and does a great job of avoiding polarization, especially in such a politically and socially charged climate.

One thing I especially appreciate is the recognition that many of the issues we face in society are complex and multifaceted. Garden City Church creates space to thoughtfully wrestle with those tensions while staying centered on the teachings of Jesus.

Another one of our favorite parts of this Church is the creativity of the music. It feels fresh, authentic, and unlike anything you would typically hear at most churches. The worship experience is unique and meaningful, and it reflects the creative spirit of this community.

We’re incredibly grateful to be part of Garden City Church and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming Church and genuine Community in Tacoma. Greed greed greed. A church that does absolutely nothing for the community that they planted themselves in. They dumped a couch from their parking lot onto an apartment lawn rather than calling 311 to have it removed from their property, or to simply throw it in the dumpster behind their church. Please, go back to wherever you all are from and leave our community alone. You guys make parking on sundays a nightmare for everyone who lives in the area. You close off your perfectly useable parking lot to use it one day a week, a parking lot that has been open for decades for free use that a small amount of cars park in. I have observed and no one camps out in their car in your parking lot. There is no reason to close it 7 days a week. Quit being greedy and please relocate to wherever your guests live. None of the surrounding neighbors want to attend your church or like your church presence. My husband and I started attending here when I was going through one of the most stressful and difficult seasons of my life. This place is, without a doubt, home. The people are authentic, the worship is amazing, the teaching is honest, engaging, and theologically sound. Whitewater is engaged in the community and always looking for opportunities to bless others without pushing any sort of agenda. You will find a family here - people who will be honest with you, who will be there for you through anything, and who will encourage you towards Christ. If this church disappeared would anyone in the community notice?  There are so many needs in Pierce county and the people at Whitewater want to be a blessing.  From middle school to youth center, foster care to seasonal celebrations we take loving our neighbor seriously.  Not everyone is at the same place spiritually, but anyone can come and belong.  My wife and I have been coming for a few years now and I am glad our family has such a great group to do life with.

name: Garden City Church - Akron Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Brian is the best!!
He's been a great help in my journey to the Lord.
His sermons are excellent too
Love it here, come check us out! Authentic, spirit-filled, compassionate are three words that describe this church. When seeking churches after moving into town this was the one. Come for truth and love and care. This church has been such a blessing and beautiful place to grow and serve. Our little family has been coming here for years, we initially migrated from The Chapel since Garden City is a 5 minute walk from our house. Pastor Brian was also at The Chapel when we attended, and we enjoyed his teaching and his sermons there.
Garden City has a warm welcoming non-judgmental atmosphere, Pastor Brian and Pastor Kemp teach the true Word of God, and the Spirit is always flowing throughout the church. The worship leaders are phenomenal and are obviously motivated by God, and you can feel the presence of Jesus here every Sunday and every day that you attend Garden City.
Garden City Church will always be our destination for church worship, as long as it is standing and as long as we are breathing. Praise you for being in the community and for all that you do! Great people and has a welcoming feel for all. The church makes it a point to live out the body of Christ by bringing everyone together with keeping a family model in mind. The sermons are great and are always very compelling. Everyone is super nice and is excited to share the love of Christ with the city of Akron. Jasmine is amazing so full of the Holy Spirit! Kemp is filled with the love of Jesus! Awesome church!!!!

name: Garden City Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary:
Incredible church and congregation -- deeply devoted to their mission, clear in their values (with a healthy dose of discernment often not found in protestant churches these days), and supremely welcoming. overall 10/10 youth group sponsored by domino's btw I'm not a member, but I've been coming for the last year, and it's been great. Bible-centered, inspiring sermons. A huge loving community that seeks to serve God and the outside community. Life Groups are the absolute backbone of this Church and creates for a tight-knit family that showers everyone with the love of God A great gospel proclaiming church. The people were super welcoming.
Really enjoyed the fellowship here.
Can't wait to get back here.

reviewSummary:
I don’t understand why these people not open the church Sundays for believers to pray
Mention garden city public church we just pass by and like to pray Sunday noon all doors closed Nice building, very helpful to 12-step fellowships Lovely place, Lovely community Nice church. Attended a christening Amazing Vespers service 🎄🙏❤️

reviewSummary: Garden Grove Church of God is one of the best churches in Orange County. Don't sleep on this church. It is a loving community of people in Covenant together. The pastor always give a relevant Word of encouragement and deliverance. They also have special events like Christmas concerts that uplift the soul. If you live in or are visiting Orange County and looking for a good church experience look no further than Garden Grove Church of God and celebrate Life Divine with Pastor James Darby and the Garden Grove Church of God family  you will never regret it. These are my friends and family and it’s always good to hang out with Garden Grove.  The people are wonderful, warm and friendly.  The Spirit of the Lord is in this place.  Always great worship and fellowship.  I recommend this place for anyone looking for a church home. Pastor  always gives a powerful    message.  Very friendly and welcoming congregation. A pleasant Church to go to love the people love the energy and it was a safe place to go to

name: Garden Grove United Methodist Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Whenever I return to this place, it feels like coming home 🏡. The warmth and kindness from everyone here make me feel cherished and valued, just like any other visitor. It’s a wonderful reminder of how much care and compassion can be found in this community. Prices to rent the hall are super affordable. We go almost every weekend for an event. Sometimes when there's a concert across the Street, parking is a bit annoying so come early for whatever event you come in the evening. I square dance here around once a month. It's a huge hole has everything that they need to serve refreshments and still have room for 20 squares. The thing I don't like about it is you can't hear when the colors call. I don't know if it's the Acoustics or what but it's just terrible. That's the only thing I can find wrong with it Was there for a loved one's rosary. The viewing times was from 5-9pm andddd they ain't playing about getting everyone out at 9pm.😒

Everything was beautiful Was baptized in 1963 here before the property was updated (1965) and began singing in the Choir back in 1980. Planning to get married here in 2019 to my sweetheart, Pamela Akers, when it becomes possible.

name: Gardena Torrance Southern Baptist - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
This is what home and family is... everyone is friendly and caring. The church is bright and clean with a large parking lot. Visitors are always welcome. Some folks are dressed up and some are casual in jeans.

Sunday school/Kids Zone starts at 9:30am on Sundays for all ages.  Worship service begins at 11:00am and the message is streamed live on Facebook.

Potluck fellowship / monthly birthday celebration on the 4th Sunday of the month. The Lord's Supper is on the 1st Sunday of the month.

There is also a Wednesday night bible study at 7pm.

There are three other churches in this building. Iglesia Cantico Nuevo is a Spanish speaking church. Gardena-Torrance Japanese Baptist Church is a Japanese speaking church. East West Baptist Church is a Chinese speaking church.

The worship includes both contemporary praise and worship songs and classic hymns. If you are looking for a small family orientated church for worship, this is it. Bible driven sermons with open arms that welcome all. One of the best churches I've been to. I loved it. Just Awesome! From parking to inside Loving ever moment of the time i was their

reviewSummary: Visiting from Philadelphia and wanted to share my experience at the Frisco campus. The facility is impressive and the setup is professional, but I left feeling a bit underwhelmed. I was worried upon moving back to Dallas and coming back to the church, it wouldn't be the same. I was actually expecting a train wreck.  I am happy to find that some things have changed but most of the what I appreciated years ago, are still in practice.  Speaking of religious beliefs and  point of view.  I am happy with my experience today. I will return.  Gateway has saved 1000's of lives and regardless of failures in one person or another,  the church has proven to me its bigger to the community than one person.  Keep going Gateway. They act as if they don't need to hear the message and thats very discouraging but I blame this on the church for making it so dark in there. Maybe if yall would turn up the lights people would be respectful and pay attention but instead because its dark people just walk around like nothing. Ive literally witnessed a lady in front of me crying looking like shes going though a hard time while trying to hear the message and yet a bunch of young girls kept getting up and down making the lady get up everytime they would move and then after that play with a baby in the pews while the service is going on?  (and yes they were daughters of leaders because I recognized them)
Ive tried to keep giving this chruch a chance cause I do feel the Holy spirit here but the lack of care from the people in charge here is something I cant look over look anymore. Ive heard the peacher talk about they're 2026 goals and wanting to get so many people baptized and open so many church's while they cant even get people to stay or fill up the chairs? Thats when it hit me that this place is all about numbers and not actually caring for the people inside the church instead on just building more churches. I say all this with love and i hope the church takes my view as constructive criticism and not hate because I truly believe they are people here in search for God's heart and fellowship but they way yall have it set up here is not helping. It should not be easier to walk into a nightclub and have people come up to you but then walk into a church and be ignored. Forget social media, forget the likes and actually try to get to know inside your church. Attended this church for about 2 years. But stopped going for numerous reasons. Their main focus is money money money, if they aren’t making enough then the congregation is at fault. They talk about how much they are in debt but then continue to open numerous churches they cannot afford to. I understand opening church’s is fantastic but when you’re in debt don’t you think making decisions is better? Then after I stopped attending a family member said they basically said you’re going to hell for not Tithing but no where biblically does it say that. Every series is about money in some way or form. They also like to challenge God a lot. “Pledge to tithe x amount for 90 days and if God doesn’t answer your prayer we will give you your money back” growing up following Christ your prayers are answered according to Gods timeline not a timeline a church gives you. They don’t really preach biblically it’s more of life story life story 3 Bible verses life story life story life story give us money. Then you go up for prayer thinking it’s confidentiality but then the whole church knows your business. It’s so much gossip it’s sad, I attended small groups still getting back to my faith and was already being thrown into leading my own small group when I wasn’t called by God to even lead , it can be VERY clique like if you aren’t apart of a small group nobody would talk to you, only 1 person spoke to us every Sunday and he was such a kind man. The church is super dark and I feel like they try to make worship like a concert, I also feel like they give the pastor title to just anyone in the church. Why is there a pastor of finances. For a church trying to preach the Gospel they are missing so much. They care about money way to much and the Bible says the love of money is the root of all evil, the leaders gossip, which is also in the Bible to not do. It seems like the last review I read about them caring about numbers is true.  It’s sad when church’s are like this, I’m sure God is hurt but how church has become. At one point they made the congregation put their tithe in a envelope and go place it on the stage so they could see who did and did not tithe, I know there are families who have a fire for God but just barely make it by and cannot afford to tithe , now I understand having faith is huge. But when you humiliate and berate you’re church just to see who is and isn’t tithing isn’t a church I want to be apart of. Gateway Fellowship Center is one of the best churches I've never been to and experienced the grace and holy spirit of the Lord. There is undoubtedly a great blessing from God upon this place. The lead pastor John Van Pay is a incredible leader and his teams are amazing, friendly and very engaging to their community. This is non-denominational church supported by the community and parted of Chi Alpha campus ministries (ΧΑ).  The small groups are truly barebone of this church youth/family ministry. I enjoyed their company and community outreach. The leaders are great and they have such a big hearts for all new member and "lost sheep" of Christ. They have a awesome kids centers next to main congregation. I heard the student ministries is amazing. The moms love them. Only been in SA for a few months, I had to say this is a wonderful home church for everyone who seek and accept Jesus Christ salvation into their lives. Overall, this is a humble church and one of the fast growing churches or a "body of Christ"  in San Antonio. I believe God is doing amazing work and discipleship in this area and beyond. There is a big oversea ministries that Gateway coordinates such as Russian, Vietnam, Mexico, Europe and Southern America mission trips. Come by and say hello to the amazing staffs and member. The nicest greeter and usher teams to find more information about Gateway Fellowship Church. Great message from the pastor. The greeters, parking attendants and kids adventurers check in volunteers were all so friendly, caring and welcoming.

name: Gateway Franklin Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Very God oriented Church that Loves God genuinely. They have amazing people who love God and are very cheerful in their walk with God. This church has an amazing testimony that is inspirational and makes you want to see this church succeed.

The problem is becoming “apart” of the church. The people are indeed friendly....but they all have their own clicks and friends that they gravitate to each Sunday. While that is a human thing, this is frustrating for someone who’s trying to find a church home.

They encourage you to join small groups in hopes to help you get closer to people who share your interests. You’re surrounded by amazing people who love God and share your interests....however, they’ll still be more focused on the people who they are most familiar with and you’re stuck just listening to conversations that you don’t know how to join.

Overall, if you are used to jumping into conversations and can adjust to any situation quickly, this is the church for you. They LOVE God and are a beautiful church.
If you’re more shy and prefer being approached, or if you’re struggling with communication, then you might want to find a different church. Spirit filled Church, Lord God is there everytime you enter. Lots of Praise, Prayers, and Peace . Just where I want to worship my King and draw closer to Him. May God richly bless this Church, let it be dedicated to annoint us to be fully open, and willing to serve God. Not our will, but God's will be done. Our family found this safe place to worship and raise our kids and do life with loving Christian friends over 12 years ago. Pastor Charlie & Gina are the most down to earth caring leaders you will ever find. So glad to have found a church home! Friendliest folks you ever did meet and Pastor Charlie preaches straight from the Word! Worship is authentic and Holy Spirit led by incredibly talented leaders! We have been members here for many years now.  Have felt welcomed and loved from day one.  If you'd like to try it, message me and we will join you.

name: Gather Houston - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
A few years ago, I was ready to give up on church. I went to Gather as a last ditch effort. Two things they said stuck out to me:

1) “We believe our beliefs are never more important than the person right in front of us.”

2) “God’s never needed to change his mind about us, but maybe we need to change our minds about God.”

I’ve kept going and it’s been a safe place for me to heal from religious trauma. And the best part - make some new friends 😊 I almost gave up on Church. If it weren’t for Gather, I would have.

A lot of churches say “all are welcome.” Gather means it. I’ve never been in a Christian environment where hard questions are welcomed and the response is often “I don’t know, let’s figure it out together.” This kind of conversation can only happen where there’s psychosocial safety, and Gather truly provides that. I wish we lived closer and could attend Gather Houston regularly. It’s so hard today to find church communities that truly live out the gospel in action and see the divinity in all humans, and Gather Houston does just that. A welcoming place to share God’s love with all. The most amazing, welcoming, safe, Jesus centered space with an incredible pastor and community. Josh is an incredible pastor that holds Jesus at the center of his teachings and genuinely strives to live and teach a Christ like life. I moved out of state about 3 years ago, and I still think about and miss Gather every single Sunday. That’s how impactful this space is. If you want to learn how to live a truly Christ like, Jesus centered life, surrounded by loving people striving for that as well, this is the place to go. I’ve been going to Gather for about two years and absolutely love everything about it! The teachings are thoughtful, grounded in Scripture, and always focused on what really matters: loving God and loving others. I consistently walk away feeling encouraged, challenged, and more connected to my faith! I’m so grateful to be part of a church that truly reflects the heart of Jesus. If you're looking for a church home where grace, love, and inclusion are more than just words—this is it!!

name: Gathering Place Church in San Diego, CA - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I found Gathering Place Church in 2010 after we moved to San Diego from the East Coast. After a long 7 months of "church shopping", we decided to try one last church. When we got there, we immediately had this feeling of "home". We knew that first day, this was where we were supposed to be. GPC is a spirit filled church, with powerful messages and worship, and an amazing community of people. We love it, and our kids (who have grown up there) love it too! My wife and I visited several churches in north county after we got married and found our new home at Gathering Place Church. We found out immediately that GPC is: welcoming, friendly and loving; the worship is awesome; they believe in the bible and the messages will encourage, strengthen and motivate you; and the prayer is abundant and powerful. In our shared love for God, we are proud to make this our home where we can make a positive impact on the world, our community and you :)

**2025 UPDATE**
Figured I should give a 10 year update :)
My family are still loving Gathering Place Church! The lifelong relationships that have been built is such a blessing. I'd recommend this church to anyone who wants to grow closer to God as well as build lasting friendships. Added picture of a powerful time the men had as we went up to Palomar this past year to encounter God together unified as his mighty men. I began attending The Gathering Place Church in 2010. From the day I walked in seeking more of the Holy Spirit, I felt at home in the presence of God and wanted more! The worship is authentic and powerful, God-exalting, and drenched with the Spirit of God, and the teaching is relevant and penetrating, firmly rooted in the word of God, and tethered to the heart of Jesus. I respect the leadership as those who live what they preach and truly emulate the character of Christ. I treasure the friendships I have built here over the years and the community that genuinely welcomes, loves, and serves one another and lives for the Kingdom of God. I moved out of state for several years, and when I returned, I knew this was the home I would be returning to without question. I love my church and love serving the Lord here and its people. I have lived in many states in the U.S. and have never found anything like it. There are good things about this church.  But at least for me, all that is overshadowed by the fact that in my and my family’s time of crisis (became extremely sick from a prescription medication) we received very little support.  One elder was a notable exception to this and I admire him a lot.  He consistently called to talk to me even though I didn’t know him well prior to my illness.  Thankfully I have mainly recovered ~3 years on.

Ultimately, I don’t believe any church that fails to support a very sick man in healing or seeking reconciliation to his wife (over disagreements related to his illness) is an organization that can be consistently trusted to do right. After a very contentious and costly divorce, I am dislocated to the Midwest, and our children are growing up in a split household situation which hurts me (and more importantly them, in comparison to what should have been) every day.  And I will always wonder if a church showing serious love and support to us might have made a difference. This is a special place.  The people who go here are so kind and inviting.  I normally live in Montana but my family is in Ramona. There  is something for everyone here. The music is uplifting and modern. , the Pastor John has a heart so big, his love for everyone is undeniable. He speaks truth and has a great sense of humor.. There are outreach activities/ministry, kids are in age appropriate classes  with amazing teachers. Mentoring youth, couples , singles young and old. My 5 yr old grandson (new to church -from MT but with us ) absolutely loves it. My 8 and 10 yr old grandchildren have been there for ever. If you are looking for a real place of worship with authentic people and no drama. Please try the #Gathering Place. If you want a family church, or church family, if you want to feel #God in your life, if you try the Gathering Place, He is there. Be blessed and be a blessing,.

name: Gayton Baptist Church
reviewSummary: I went across the river to help pack meals for the program Gayton Baptist Church sponsors called Feed My Starving Children (FMSC). I had a good time and hope to do this next year. My wife and I attended the church's Jazz Cafe Christmas program. It was our first time going and we thoroughly enjoyed it. Beautiful church. We attended the "Jazz Nativity", a wonderful event, so well done. My new tradition. Their members are extremely kind and helpful. They do an amazing job of helping the elderly community with food to help them through the month. My 5 year old goes to Agape preschool in gayton church. . it is a good environment with good kids playarea

name: Gayton Road Christian Church
reviewSummary: Gayton Road Christian Church (DOC) is a family of friendly, accepting, God-centered people. With our come-as-you-are attitude and nonjudgmental philosophy, we believe we are called to love and care for one another, and share the Good News of God's love and grace with the community through our words and actions. Friendly, open, and welcoming to everyone! Traditional worship with child care and Sunday school. Come as you are in your life journey This is my church home for a very good reason.  All are welcome to worship and serve Our Lord here! Great fellowship Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: GC2 Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church!  Great people, bible -based, great teaching, great location, family friendly, and loving community of people.

Make sure to check out GC2 church!

Pastor Jason is an amazing pastor and his preaching is awesome!

God Bless! I praise God for GC2 church that really emphasize the Great Commission and the Great Commandment mindset and what I love the most is the multi-ethnic atmosphere of Christ-body which is a glimpse of what it will be when we all worship describe in Rev. 7:9. GC2 embodies the rock solid doctrine they espouse. The church, all churches, are only as strong as the spirit within them. You will find the Holy Spirit at work here. Really great preaching and spiritual songs. Very friendly people who put God first in their lives I am probably as discerning an individual as one can be, I have been to so many churches with my children in search of a home with authentic love and priorottization in the Lord and his word and we finally found our home here. The entire congregation is welcoming and sincere and the youth programs are excellent and a great time for the kids.

Pastor Luke always seems to deliver and expand on scripture as it applies to our lives at times when I need to hear that particular scripture most. Sometimes I wonder if he can read minds :)

The group had more of a family dynamic than a government dynamic like so many churches, and for this I am particularly grateful :)

May GOD bless this congregation and particularly it’s wonderful children - We pray in Jesus’ name - Amen

name: Geist Christian Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church. So welcoming and so many great ways to get plugged in Our experience with the GCC is through the school and we love it here. Good worship. Good people. Contemporary service without mega church vibe. Just good worship low key but good. Great people who are god friendly and love you like family. I highly recommend this church! My churh.

name: General Assembly & Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly people, pastor sticks to scripture, simple old style service with hymns and piano playing along

name: Generation Church - Ahwatukee - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: This church truly feels like home. The community here is incredible. You can feel the warmth and presence of Christ from the second you walk onto the campus. I love how everyone is so friendly and truly makes you feel welcome. Pastor Ryan always preaches a bold message from God’s word. This church is so unique and I’m so grateful I’ve been able to deepen my roots here. From the teaching to the community I’ve made through life groups, Jesus has called me here and changed my life for the better through this church. It’s easy to make friends and feel like you’re apart of a family! The Church here in Ahwatukee loves the Lord and loves to worship and serve Him. As soon as I walked up to the church and said I was there for the first time, I was taken personally and cared for, and led to a good seat in the auditorium.  I love it here, and Im so glad God brought me to Generation Chuch. Great for singles, great for families and all ages! Our whole family has been so blessed by GC. Amazing worship and kid’s ministry. Pastor Ryan really dives deep into scripture and helps you grow as a Christian. Lots of community and life groups too, including Bible studies during the week. Have made great friends here. 10/10! Our family loves Generation Church and have really experienced Gods presence in our lives through the preaching of Pastor Ryan and Pastor Amy! Our adult children go to the Mesa campus and we attend the Ahwatukee campus. We love the communities at both! If you’re looking for a place to call home, make new friends to have fun with, share life and grow closer to Jesus, you have found it! My family and I have been attending generation church for 6years. We started watching online during the pandemic. We thank God for this church. The pastor and staff are amazing. If you are looking for a church who preaches on biblical truths, won’t shy away from any topic. This is the church for you!!! God has used Generation church to change me and my family for the better. Thankful everyday for our church family.

name: Generation Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary: Passing through town, I got to experience this church and was really impressed. It felt very family-oriented with a strong sense of community. The worship music was surprisingly not loud like many churches — bonus points for that. Very passionate, God-loving people here. So thankful I got to experience this church. A faith-filled multicultural church with pastors who lead with transparency and excellence. You shouldn’t do life alone—our awesome small groups make it easy to build real connections. If you’ve been missing something in your life, come give God a chance—you’ll meet Him here. We all have a family in JESUS. The HOLY SPIRIT leading the way every way. We were on holidays in FL early January this year and when in Miami, randomly selected Generation Church for a Sunday service. This was a decision for life. The message was great (as all messages from God) and  clearly and easy understandable (we live in Hungary), people are very nice. Wish to live in Miami - if so, I would attend this church,no doubt. It’s really Spirit filled, I could feel God’s presence there! It is a Church of sound doctrine and The Word of God is being preached. They welcomed me right away as I was stepping in with love and Pastor Rich came to speak with me right after service which was a huge blessing and I was also introduced to other staff members and Church family. Most importantly I believe that they are worshiping in Spirit and in Truth which is The kind of worship that God wants. I’m grateful to God for giving me the opportunity to be able to attend service at Generation Church in Coral Gables, Florida. Looking forward to seeing you soon!Thank you and God Bless you all🙏❤️⛪️

name: Generation Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Our multigenerational family spent the Easter break in Oceanside. I found this wonderful church through a Google search and it was just what we were wanting! Everyone commented on the wonderful worship, sermon, quaint sanctuary, and how blessed they felt. If I lived in Oceanside I would come to this church. I would describe this church as non-denominational, evangelical, and a multigenerational family church. Oh, the donuts were top notch too! I love this church. No matter where you're at or where you've been, we believe there is hope and freedom found in the grace of Jesus Christ! Generation is a church for every 'generation' and every walk of life. No pretense. No pressure. No guilt. Just Jesus. Come as you are and experience the love of God along with us. Humble leadership; solid guidance based on the Word of God. The Holy Spirit was undeniable the first three visits to Generation church. We found a welcoming home here in the midst of growing our family and going through the hardest times in our life. So thankful for the love this church has for God and the community. Young pastor...Tim....I believe was his name....preached a great Bible based sermon. We are in the days that the Bible speaks about brothers and sisters...pray, read the WORD, choose LOVE and JESUS. And a good Bible based church. Be Blessed 🙏

name: Generations Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family absolutely loves Generations Church. Even after moving away, we still talk about how special this church is and how deeply it shaped our family’s faith journey. Pastor Kraig is one of those rare leaders who teaches with clarity, warmth, and genuine care for people. His messages are biblically grounded, practical, and always centered on Jesus — the kind of teaching that sticks with you long after Sunday morning.
Worship at Generations is consistently powerful and joy‑filled. Our kids loved it just as much as we did — expressive, engaging, and always pointing hearts toward God. The church has an atmosphere that blends authenticity, community, and a true love for Scripture.
Generations Church is also incredibly intentional with families. Events, seasonal gatherings, and community moments are always done with excellence and heart. It’s a church that invests in people, develops strong leaders, and creates an environment where you immediately feel welcomed and seen.
We’re so grateful for our time at Generations Church. It’s the kind of place you don’t easily forget — a church where your kids grow, your faith deepens, and your family feels genuinely loved. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a Christ‑centered, life‑giving church home. Called begging for help to pay for my daughters cancer bills. I was told to pray on it. I drove by and saw a fleet of 150k vehicles in the property during a time that service was not held. It belongs to the church leaders. They attempted to have my review removed as well. I’ve attended Generations church for a while now and I can’t say enough good things about this place. There is a true sense of community and love for each other here. The pastors and leaders lead with integrity and humility, and boldly live out the messages that they teach.

Pastor Kraig’s thought-provoking sermons are rooted in scripture and challenge you to grow in your spiritual maturity. If you are looking for a place full of people who love Jesus and love people, this is it! Grateful for our church! Having relocated from California to Tennessee, we were eager to find a great church for our family. Generations Church quickly became a safe place to feel known and welcomed in. Our son loves his Sunday morning pre-school class, the pastors are true friends of God, and we've been strengthened in our faith. Thank you GC family! I have an incredible encounter with God here every Sunday! The praise and worship is always on point and helps usher in the Spirit of God! Such a loving, warm, and friendly atmosphere where miracles happen every week.

name: Generations Church (Formerly Watermark OC) - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re a young family looking for a church, this is a great place to land. We’ve made real friendships here with other parents in the same season of life, and that’s been huge for us. Our kids have friends, we have friends, and it didn’t take long to feel like part of something.
The kids ministry is excellent, which makes a real difference on Sunday mornings. The church is medium-sized but has a big vision for Costa Mesa, and the pastors genuinely care about this city. They’re also very approachable. You can actually have a real conversation with them, which isn’t something you find at every church.
The other thing that’s stood out is how service-oriented the church is as a whole. There’s a real heart for the city and the people in it, and that shows up in tangible ways throughout the year. It’s been a great place for our family to grow, serve, and build community. Highly recommend checking it out. My kids and I went to the open play time (Wednesday mornings!) and really enjoyed it. There were so many activities for young children to partake in, and everyone was so kind. Bethany was great to talk to and made us feel very welcome :-) I don't go to services here but venue beautiful inside and pastor did wonderful funeral service We really enjoyed the worship, teaching, and friendliness of the people. Also, the in-house Coffee Cafe, Lion and Lamb, is superb. Come see for yourself God bless you

name: Generations Church LA - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Local, Christ-centered, community church with wonderful, but simple musical worship and strong biblical teaching.  The growing congregation comprises of young families, lots of student youth and their parents (1st and 1.5 gen.)

Lead Pastor Mike Kim and Associate (Youth) Pastor Andy Kuo are 2nd generation Asian American pastors. The preaching is expository, yet practical.  Pastor Mike always ends with words and key points to "marinate" and put into practice.

They are located in the auditorium of Arcadia Christian School. I've been a member of Generations Church LA since beginning of 2017.  This church was planted as the 2nd generation families of EFC LA had a desire/heart and prayed to start their own English ministry church to spread God's love to all ethnic groups not just Asians. We just recently hired a passionate God loving lead pastor Mike Kim.  We welcome all to join us every Sunday 11am.  We are open for "indoor dinning" to have a wonderful feast with our heavenly Father and fellowship with our brothers and sisters in Christ. We also have many other fellowship including Friday nights youth fellowship and Young Adults just to name a few.

name: Genesis Bible Church of Dunwoody - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary: They teach the whole counsel of God. Reading the word. Expository preaching. You'll can expect 2 weeks of messages/teaching per Bible chapter. Great music ministry with a student praise band. Space shared with 7th Day Adventist church who doesn't use the facilities on Sundays. Warm, friendly congregation members who adhere to the Bible's teachings AND  practice what it preaches.

name: Genesis Church - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place! I love it at this church! They really know their congregation. They go the extra mile to make you feel welcome. They have amazing programs for kids. My children have a great time and actually want to go. Their live bad is awesome as well! Amazing place where you can feel ‘The Church’ alive in its leaders and congregation. A Christ center house of worship that seeks the Holy Spirit in its fullness to lead inside and outside in our broken world.
Continue to be humbled by the love and support Genesis Church offers. We were visiting Indianapolis and found Genesis Church. They were very welcoming, the service was comfortable yet challenging. Exactly what we were looking for. Would highly recommend for anyone visiting or looking for a home church! Whether you're looking for a church home or for a nice place to visit, you gotta check out Genesis Church in Carmel. Pastor Jerry Naville is a great guy and the staff are all "top shelf". Love this church when we are visiting the Indy area. Great worship, solid Bible based preaching, friendly people!

name: Genesis Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: its a good church. they have a clothing closet for those in need. they offer a free meal and service every sunday morning for the homeless community. they even help the trash pickup crew with a free lunch when they work( thats a group that gives some of the homeless an opportunity to make money legally) if you need resources they'll help you out and point you in the Right direction guaranteed We loved the community free meals on Wednesday and a couple of young people 20's sat with me and my girlfriend and listened to us and prayed for us and they were radiant and filled with light of God. this is my first time there this morning, and I can honestly say it is one of the most welcoming churches grounded in love that I’ve been to in Northwest Arkansas. They made me feel very welcome and there was coffee and breakfast and good community and fellowship  They truly know how to love people well  I will definitely be back to visit 1st time visitor 4/6/25.Very Blessed experience in every way! Extremely friendly welcoming Pastoral staff& congergation!!! Inspired  Praise/ worship leaders/ songs! name: Genesis Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
Genesis

Genesis is a church that truly lives out the Gospel in both word and action. Their teaching is firmly rooted in the belief that God, in His love, sent His Son Jesus Christ to die on the cross for our sins. They proclaim that Jesus is fully God and fully man, and that by His grace we receive the gift of the Holy Spirit who equips us to walk in faith and obedience.

reviewSummary:
I bought a ticket for Mother's Day Brunch. Having been to many similarly advertised events, I thought it would be very low key. The music was much too loud, to the point that my party, an elderly woman and a young child, wouldn't even go in the restaurant. We've also attended a number of events like the "Trunk or Treat" for kids, and they're always well staffed with kind and caring people.  If you're looking for a new church, give them a try! If you're a believer & want a church to feed you spiritually, then Genoa Church in Westerville is it! If you want to hear the "full truth of God" then Genoa Church is it! If you want to hear a "beautiful" choir + singers in front whom sing to our Lord God in full joy & worship, then Genoa Church is it! If you want to go to a church & just listen to "what your itching ears want to hear," then this isn't for you....UNLESS you're hungry for the truth of God's Word! There's no wallowing of words to please, there's just the "true Word of God" from the Holy Bible!" I have never been to a church that was filled & taught with such amazing, pure love as this one is! So, if you would want to experience this showing of love, listen to the whole truth of God being taught & leave knowing your cup was filled, then give this church a visit! My husband & I drive from Marion to go to this church because it delivers "truth!" Pastor Frank said, "a church alive is worth the drive" & trust me when I say..it is! There's not a person who attends whom won't greet you with sincere friendliness! We have been going for a little over a month & by the time the next Sunday is here are excited to go again! Come listen to Pastor Frank, Pastor Scott or Pastor Joe. Pastor Frank is senior pastor & I've not met such a sincere, kind & loving pastor but we have heard Pastor Scott & Pastor Joe as well & that loving shoe fits them all! They are sincerely concerned for your "Salvation!" Sincere people, sincere love & most of all sincere truth taught of our Lord Jesus Christ!! They have 2 services...9am & 11am so it can fit anyone's schedule.....if you're hungry for the Word that is! God bless all! A church that teaches the truth as is without diluting it but always teaching in love. Pastor Frank and the team of pastors are rooted in the Bible and they make the sermons interesting and hilarious. The worship team needs a special mention, the worship is straight from the heart and no gimmicks. We love being part of this church ♥️ Genoa Baptist Church is a Bible Believing, Bible Preaching church where you get fed the word of God. They have wonderful Pastors who speak the name of Jesus. It is a church for all ages, races and backgrounds.

name: Gesù Church - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
Not a typical Jesuit parish ...

Was hopeful when visiting Miami and Sunday Mass was interesting. Gesù is the oldest Catholic Church in all of South Florida, founded in April of 1896. Gesu is in the heart of Downtown with beautiful architecture and stained-glass windows. ent to the 8:15 bilingual mass this morning and walked out genuinely moved. The readings and prayers switch between English and Spanish in a way that actually works — nothing feels forced or repeated just for the sake of it, you just follow along in whichever language speaks to you. Honestly didn’t know that kind of seamless bilingual liturgy existed until today.
The building itself is stunning. Didn’t realize until afterward that it’s the oldest Catholic parish in Miami (1896, current church from the 1920s). The stained glass windows and the vaulted ceiling are worth showing up early for. Quiet, unhurried atmosphere despite being right in the middle of downtown. GESÙ established in 1896 (the same founding year as the City of Miami itself ) is the first Jesuit Catholic Church ⛪️ in Miami. The land upon which the church stands, was donated to the Roman Catholic Archdiocese by Henry Flagler, an entrepreneur industrialist who settled here and built the railroad from Saint Augustine to Key West. A Catholic School once stood by the rectory. Today the school no longer exists and has, unfortunately been replaced by a parking lot. Love this church and the administration. Thank you. 🥰❤️🙏
Gesù Catholic Church in Miami, built in 1895, radiates timeless beauty with its historic charm and sacred atmosphere, a true spiritual landmark of the city.

He invited us to lunch w/his sponsor. Fellowship was heartfelt and genuine…Truly Love of the Lord was present. Not religious but relationship driven. I can see why GOD has blessed this church family. name: Glendale Christian Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello, this is the most RACIST church I have ever been to! DO NOT ATTEND. (I am a black women). I was going to church with My friend/roommate who was also worshiping on stage. Which meant she had to get there much earlier than me, so I ended up meeting her there instead. We also both had to be moved out of our apartments that morning. Which meant her car was packed with her stuff and I had my suitcase with me because I was catching a flight that day. Before I got there, I called her and asked if she could leave her car door unlocked so I could put my suitcase in her car before I walked into the service. As my Uber dropped me off, I went straight to my roommate's car and noticed this older man circling around the church like some form of "security" and was constantly staring at me. I did not think anything of it at the time and proceeded to put my luggage in her car. A little bit later he finally walked over to me and asked me a bunch of questions. "Is this your car?" "The license plate says..." "What are you doing?" (Another man who works there also kept staring at me and asked me questions as well). I answered their questions, but they were not convinced, and the old man proceeded to walk over to me. He then said "so, if you went inside your friend would know you were coming?" I said "yes?" He just proceeded to stand there until I went inside. I said I needed to go to the driver's side to get something out of my bag and then he followed me all the way to the driver's seat and watched me intently as I got my stuff out. Then he kept yapping, but I tuned out. He escorted me to the church entrance doors and made sure I went inside, but I sat outside instead. I felt so uncomfortable and out of place and no one should ever have to feel like that in a house of God. A little bit later a white person showed up late, but he did not talk to them or escort them to the service. Then a black woman shows up a little bit later, he sees her in the parking lot and proceeds to escort her to the door. Hell no, I was not going to stay anymore so I called an Uber and waited at my friend's car for it. While I was waiting for my Uber I saw him, the other guy who was asking me questions and a random guy, staring at me, and talking about me. So like I said, it is a terrible church do not attend!!! Literally so disgusting. The people were somewhat friendly. The music for worship seemed more like entertainment than worship. They do a communion each week. The problem with this is there was no real explanation to what the communion stands for, it was not done with prayer, and it was not really done as a community. This was a very weak way to do what should be a very meaningful part of the service. The pastor holds a seminary degree but shows a lot of need for improvement. His message was on 1 Peter 3:18-20. He started off by stating that this is one of those verses in the bible that leaves you wondering what God intended to say. He then gave us 4 possible understandings for these verses. His points were weak and left us wondering why he even preached on this topic. His number one view seemed to support that those in prison were the fallen angels mentioned in Genesis chapter 6. I disagree with the concept that the Nephilim were  angelic beings. I would not recommend this church based off of my visit today. We have been Members for 4 years,Straight from the bible preaching and teaching, Understanding Gods Grace and how he Loves and forgives.Very Friendly, Welcoming, and Loving Church Members I encourage visitor's to attend a bible study class after service, best way to get to know the people and feel the warmth of it's members. There are many different groups to get involved with for the young and elderly. It seems hard in this society to find a church that actually preaches the word of God and actually requests you personally to get into the word.  This church after looking for months is someplace we intend on calling home.  The bible studies right after church dive deep into the word of the Lord.  You can and will grow in Christ here.

Joshua 1:8. Keep this book of the law always on your lips.  Meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful. This is an elder-led church full of Bible-believing Christians and the Pastor is highly educated, but very down-to-earth. Warm, friendly people you will love. You will also love the music.

reviewSummary:

I hope this message finds you well. My wife Alona (27) and I, Ivan (31), are a married couple from Ukraine, reaching out to express our strong interest in the Uniting for Ukraine (U4U) program. We are excited about the possibility of relocating to the United States and beginning a new chapter in our lives.

I have a solid background as a Web Graphic Designer, specializing in creating visually appealing and functional websites. On the other hand, my wife Alona excels as a Social Media Manager, effectively curating captivating online stories and cultivating active online communities.

With the current situation in Ukraine marked by ongoing conflict and instability, our desire to ensure a secure and promising future has become even more pressing. We view the U4U program as a means to not only escape uncertainty but also contribute positively to our new community in the United States. Our English proficiency and dedication to a healthy lifestyle will undoubtedly aid in our smooth integration.

Upon arrival, our primary focus will be rapid adaptation, securing employment, and self-sufficiency until we establish ourselves professionally. Your support, whether through guidance, advice, or potential sponsorship, would be immensely valuable to us as we undertake this transformative journey.

Thank you for considering our request. We eagerly await your response and the possibility of creating a brighter future together.

Best regards,

Ivan and Alona I absolutely love the Glendale Church of Christ. As a teenager I attended the church from time to time when I visited my Aunt who was a member there and really enjoyed the youth group. Many years later while a member of a different congregation I attended a marriage workshop series at Glendale and felt so at home and comfortable with the changes they had made towards being a more welcoming church. The church family was extremely encouraging and their involvement in their community sparked an interest in me I decided to stick around a little longer to see if Glendale was the right fit for my family. It’s been 6 years now and I still love it. We moved to Orange County for work 7 months ago and have visited a hand full of congregations in the surrounding area but have not found one that has the amazing uplifting singing, active community participation, and amusing encouraging messages all like Glendale. name: GLIDE Memorial Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
𝐶𝑜𝑚𝑝𝑙𝑖𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑒 & 𝐴𝑐𝑐𝑜𝑢𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑏𝑖𝑙𝑖𝑡𝑦 𝐴𝑢𝑑𝑖𝑡

It is profoundly disheartening that a non-profit corporation operating with over $𝟓𝟎 𝐌𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐧 in net assets and heavily funded by public taxpayer dollars systematically fails to comply with mandatory disability accommodations. As a Palestinian transgender domestic violence survivor navigating severe systemic friction, I expected standard compliance and human dignity from an institution that receives massive public subsidies to serve the vulnerable.
​When I explicitly informed the downstairs supervisory staff of my documented medical conditions—Celiac disease and severe lactose intolerance—and kindly requested a reasonable accommodation regarding the food resources being distributed, my request was met with an immediate, unyielding "No." The supervisor issued this refusal flatly, without entering into an interactive process or considering the health risks involved.

The reality of what is placed on the plate is a direct hazard to my health:
​Cross-Contaminated Gluten Vectors: Food containing wheat/gluten that triggers an immediate autoimmune reaction due to Celiac disease.
​Dairy Products: Items containing lactose that directly conflict with my documented gastrointestinal medical needs, forcing severe inflammation on someone who is lactose intolerant.
​Expired Provisions: Items clearly marked past their expiration metrics, compounding the physical risk.
Because GLIDE operates a massive physical facility open to the public and accepts extensive municipal and government contracts, their flat refusal to accommodate a disability—especially for an individual navigating Autism and severe autoimmune/gastrointestinal conditions—stands in direct violation of state and federal statutes:
​The Unruh Civil Rights Act (California Civil Code § 51): This law explicitly mandates that all business establishments and public non-profits in California provide "full and equal accommodations, advantages, facilities, privileges, or services" regardless of sex, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, or disability (including Autism and autoimmune conditions like Celiac disease). Refusing to engage in an accommodation request violates this civil mandate.
​Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act (42 U.S.C. § 12182): Federal law classifies severe food allergies and autoimmune responses (like Celiac disease) as physical impairments that substantially limit major life activities. Public accommodations are strictly required to make reasonable modifications to policies, practices, and procedures to prevent discrimination and severe health risks.
​✦ 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐛𝐲𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐝𝐠𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐜. ✦ Glide Church is amazing. Its radial inclusiveness makes everyone feel welcome. reviewSummary:

name: Gloria Dei Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Gloria Dei Lutheran Church is a place of reverent worship with beautiful hymns and liturgy. I’m very thankful for Pastor Horn and his faithful preaching and care. Each service points clearly to Christ and His gifts. 💝✝️ Gloria Dei is a wonderful place to worship with members that are warm, welcoming, friendly and spiritual! My husband and I have been members for fours years and previously my parents were devoted members for 25 years. Pastor David is very compassionate and gives meaningful and challenging sermons each week. There are many activities and events for everyone; youth groups, Bible studies, celebrations and volunteer opportunities. Gloria Dei is a wonderful place to worship and to feel like you’re part of a family. Pastor David and his wife have been incredibly helpful to me as I struggled with problems with my husband. I am very thankful for their help after my husband physically abused me. They packed up all my belongings and shipped them to my son's home on the East coast and drove me to the airport. They were wonderful!!  I am happily living with my son’s family of five and listen to the Gloria Dei services every week!  In His love,  Sandy Pyle Pastor David and Pastor Sabrina were amazing to our family at a difficult time in our lives. They were caring, welcoming and supportive.  Pastor David visited our home. Pastor Sabrina helped us plan a Celebration of Life for our dear father. She was compassionate and understanding.  She made the service special and personal.  Thank you both for everything.  To the church members who set up coffee and drinks for our guests,  thank you. All was done in a beautiful and restful church and outside setting. Everyone is very friendly. My kids love the Sunday School and youth activities. The Youth educator, Quinn, is a riot. The kids really like him. My family goes fairly regularly. I find that it has a small church feel and a very nice sense of community.
