reviewSummary:
We have only recently begun attending Glory Bell Church in person (a few months now); before that we watched them online for about a year.

We are very happy with the church and are beginning to feel like part of the "family" there.  We enjoy their community groups and special events. Our grandchild loves the children's church and special children's activities.

We really feel that the Spirit of the Lord is in this place and the hearts of His people here! If you are looking for a church where you can come as you are, you’ve found it. Glory Bell does an amazing job at making you feel like you are where you are meant to be. My husband and I are a mixed couple and it is often hard to find a place where we feel completely welcome, but Glory Bell has definitely welcomed us with open arms.  There is no doubt that God is working at Glory Bell and you can feel it as soon as you walk through the doors. Also they have coffee, childcare, great worship, and incredible pastors. Pastors Chuck and Ashley listen to the prompting of the Holy Spirit and always deliver timely, relevant messages with the LOVE of Jesus. Pastors Anthony and Erin are always there to answer any question you may have or just to welcome you. Give Glory Bell a try, you won’t regret it! Glory Bell church welcomed us from the moment we walked through the doors.  If your looking for a church family to call home,  Glory Bell is it.  We love there vision and look forward to helping make Heaven crowded.  Pastor Chuck and Ashley are amazing.  We are blessed to be involved with this incredible church.  Come and join us, you won't be disappointed. I was looking forward to visiting this church, but unfortunately, my experience left me feeling pretty uncomfortable. One of the greeters introduced herself and immediately brought up an inappropriate topic that my husband and I had not initiated or expressed any interest in discussing. I don’t believe her intentions were bad but the conversation was in poor taste. It was an awkward start to what we had hoped would be a welcoming and positive visit. I wanted to leave after the interaction but did not want to cause a scene.

Additionally, we felt pressured into sharing personal information with the church, which added to the discomfort. I understand that not every experience will be the same, but I hope the church takes steps to ensure that their greeters and staff approach visitors with more tact. I love the vision of Glory Bell Church! Things like “restoring the ruins” and “everyone has a place at the table” are at the core of what this church is all about. Glory Bell church it’s a place where no matter how broken or defeated we think or feel we are, Jesus can take our ashes and in exchange give us His beauty! We can come and experience God’s presence and be refreshed and restored without fearing rejection. Glory Bell church is about being in relationship with God our father!

name: Glory Church of Jesus Christ - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
On June 28, I attended the second service at Lord's Glory Church (pastored by Rev. Shin Seung-hoon), located near downtown Los Angeles.
After the service, the entire congregation went outside and lined up to have a bowl of *gukbap* (rice in soup) for one dollar.
Although the chef announced that they had run out of rice and would serve noodles instead, the cashier took it upon herself to hand me a bowl of *gukbap* anyway.
Even though the person was a cashier, she took it upon herself—without any authorization—to go to the table and hand me the *gukbap* (soup and rice) directly, preventing me from even picking it up myself. Handling cash and then touching the food I was about to eat with those dirty hands is a clear violation. Please be careful. Our vision is to be a community of disciples who gives glory to God by being filled with the Spirit through the Word and prayer. See a video on YouTube of guy filming on the side walk and a church member and the security guard followed this guy around it out on the public sidewalk and then the guard and the "ceo" as labeled on his phone, thought it should say pastor but ok, Put hands on the guy and the guard got pepper sprayed out on the public sidewalk. Keep your hands to yourself. I don't agree with everything the auditor was saying but the same amendment that gives him the right to film is public is the same one that gives us our right to our religion. Great place, great people and community. Attended a few events and it definitely feels like one of those production mega churches that's really about making money. Just look at how they treat the homeless and how they make the surrounding area so hostile to outsiders. On top of that, they regularly host far right organizations and speakers. I would stay away from this church that involves so heavily in far right media and big production church services instead of centering on God and empathy for all.

name: Good Hope Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
We visited Good Hope and felt a warm welcome by the people at the church. When we walked through the doors we had about 10 different people welcome us and say hello.

When we dropped off the kids in the children’s ministry we felt comfortable and confident with the team of volunteers.

We walked into the main service and when we turned to greet someone, people noted that they hadn’t seen us before and came up to greet us. This was the most known and seen I have felt going to a church.

While we aren’t able to stay in the area with changing jobs and being moved around we won’t forget this experience.

The people at Good Hope show they care and are creating eternal impact. I attended Good Hope from 2011 (when I graduated college) to 2017 (when I moved out of state). I was baptized in the most beautiful chapel surrounded by the most welcoming and caring people. They were like my family, as my own family are out of state. I attended church and young adult Bible study here for those six wonderful years, and leaving was one of the hardest things I ever did BECAUSE of the community at Good Hope. I hated leaving them.

Fast forward to 2025, I’ve just moved back to the area in August and have 8 years of growth and life experience and a service dog in tow. They have welcomed me back with open arms, and have loved my service animal so unconditionally as well. We went to Good Hope our first two months back here, but the past few we’ve been doing some traveling mostly for work so have only been able to listen to the messages online. Once things calm down in the new year, I can’t wait to get myself and my dog back and dive into our beloved community.

I can’t say enough good things about Good Hope and the amazing people serving God, each other, and the community there.

To attend here is to be loved here and be a part of an amazing chosen family. My husband and I found Good Hope after recently moving to the research triangle from Michigan. We had been to other churches in the area prior to Good Hope, but Good Hope by far was the most welcoming and active church we’ve seen since moving to NC and we wish we had found them sooner!

GH is also the most diverse church we’ve personally been to with 27 nations represented in the church population. You instantly feel like family when you visit.

My husband and I were searching for a scripturally sound church with a bible study geared to our current stage of life as young newlyweds. Some churches we visited lacked such a group and tended to lump us with high schoolers. We were very excited to learn that GH had an active and friendly young adults (20+) bible study group with 30-50 members fellowshipping each Wednesday night.

There are tons of opportunities to volunteer and mingle every single week and seasonal activities as well such as our fall retreat and Christmas party.

If you’re looking for a new church home look no further and come visit Good Hope! Great preaching from the Word of God (10:30-1200)
Sunday school classes (9-10:15)
A variety of activities for children and yourh Pastor Scott and Luanne Adams sure does have an awesome way of keeping us engaged in God's word! Each Wednesday night, I am always so excited to hear what Pastor Scott has to share when I login to Zoom. Thank you for everything Good Hope Baptist Church! You can bet that the town of Cary is absolutely on my destination list if I head to North Carolina one day!

Huge blessings from your California pal,
Aaron Yang

name: Good Samaritan Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I thought this place was great until I was made deeply uncomfortable by a man commenting on my daughter’s “blossoming puberty.” And then another time finding it appropriate to comment on her needing a bra. Complaints go unheard. Will not be going back. Glad to be a member of the Good Samaritan community since 2014. Love the joyful worship, music, and community building and service activities for every age and stage of life. Amazing visit to an important place in my life! Surprised how tall the buildings are! Amazed how close the transit system is to the church! The Seagull sat on the glass on Pentecost Sunday for the entire service! Really followed the Liturgy! I'm homeless came here for help. Was told to come back on a Friday best they could do was 20$. Fed my dog and sent me off. In my opinion that's not help that's an act to keep someone in the situation. I asked for a shower. Was told there isn't one. (It's actually in one for the bathroom stalls). What's the sign for salvation for? After moving for school I came here looking for a good place to connect with the local community and service opportunities. After attending Good Sam I didn’t look any further. The community is so welcoming. Young families, single people from UCSD and a solid group from the surrounding community attend. I was instantly welcomed and shown around.

The congregation seemed used to new attendees and were really helpful to me as I found my footing (I did not grow up Episcopalian).

The congregation is also integrated into the larger San Diego service communities. I was connected to food and clothing drives, opportunities to volunteer at soup kitchens, and opportunities to help families in San Diego’s sister city, Tijuana.

Plus there is coffee and snacks after the service!

name: Good Shepherd Catholic Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
We are from of state were visiting family. We were impressed with the  warmth of the greeters, the community, lots of
Family, the beautiful music/choir, and most of all the beautiful homily of the Monsignor. I was here for a memorial. I am not a religious person. So I am rating this based on the building, it's amenities and location. So I giving this 5 stars because I found parking easily. Also, the place was clean. After the religious ceremony, a reception was held in the basement. And although it was a basement, it was clean, and modern, and had a very nice remodeled kitchen. There was plenty of sitting for all guests. And while this was a very sad occasion, and I am not a member of this congregation, I felt welcomed. Priest was friendly and greeted people before the service (he inquired after my regular church and vocation). Music was feminine, 2000s film-music style (a la movie about a girl who takes care of a horse). Altar girls instead of altar boys for the ceremony. Sermon was frank and about giving money. Priest is well-spoken. Wafers were given in the hand. The building is ridiculously beautiful (real limestone detailing all along the outside). Community and priest are glad and gleeful with the guidance of the governing pope. This is one of Denver's finest Catholic churches. This beautiful church has a great history located on the beautiful seventh Ave Parkway and all this is next to a wonderful Catholic school. A good place and faith-community to start or even restart your personal spiritual journey. Very warm community

name: Good Shepherd Christian Preschool - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
We are incredibly grateful for our experience at Good Shepherd Christian Preschool! From the very beginning, this school has felt like a second home to our family. The love of Christ is evident in every classroom, every interaction, and every activity. The staff go above and beyond to ensure that each child is nurtured spiritually, emotionally, and academically.

While there has been some recent staff turnover, I want to commend the leadership committee and the director Ms. Yahaira for how they handled the transition. They communicated openly and promptly with families, and it was clear that every decision was made prayerfully and thoughtfully with the children's best interests at heart. New staff members have been brought in who are not only highly qualified, but also warm, engaging, and deeply committed to the mission of the school. The consistency and care my child has continued to receive has been outstanding, even in the midst of these changes.

Our child is thriving in this environment--growing in faith, confidence, and curiosity each day. The curriculum is rich with hands-on learning, Scripture-based lessons, and opportunities for social and spiritual development. We especially appreciate the way the school partners with parents to create a strong sense of community and shared values.

We couldn't be more pleased with the way the preschool has continued to shine, even through a period of change. It speaks volumes about the strength of the leadership and the heart behind this ministry. We wholeheartedly recommend this preschool to any family looking for a Christ-centered, nurturing, and high-quality early education! My son loves going to school and we love everything about it. They care
for our son so well and all of the teachers/director are all so helpful and loving. They have a strong, fun curriculum and I'm always surprised at how much my son learns every day. Their lunch/snack menu are great too and my son who used to be such a picky eater now eats more of a variety. We also love how they have service/worship on Fridays. Thank you Good Sheperd! It's a very clean preschool with adequate natural lighting in classroom and the playground space is perfect for outdoor play.  In christian environment, teachers and kids ratio is great and they are loving and respectful toward the kids.  Strong emphasis in art and music is a great plus!  Lunches/snacks provided in their menu calendar is a variety which is important especially in their young developmental growth years! Great school! My daughter loves it here and everyone is sweet and nice.

reviewSummary: We love Good Shepherd! We came to this church 4 years ago and experienced amazing hospitality from the staff. Great pastors with shepherd's hearts who truly care for the people and preach realistic, authentic, and applicable sermons that speak God's truth, love, and grace. The congregation has a big heart for the local community and overseas (mission outreach). The best preschool in Irvine! And the only church that emphasizes spiritual formation in discipleship! If you are looking to grow your Christian faith and find a sense of community, Good Shepherd Lutheran Church is the place for you. I have been a member since 2013 and enjoy attending the traditional service at 8:00 am. Our church hosts programs such as Rooted, Invitation to a Journey, and various Bible studies that help me learn about and deepen my faith. I also enjoy developing friendships both within my Life Group and by attending church sponsored social events. The 8am traditional service is truly inspiring with choir, organ and a faith based message. It’s the perfect way to start my week. The community at Good Shepherd is tremendous and heartfelt. I love the various local and global Outreach programs and the opportunities to serve those with specific needs. This is a great church for families as well as couples.  Very welcoming and lots of great activities and a great choir! Good Shepherd Lutheran Church has been out church home for 23 years. Our pastor Tom, his messages, global missions/local outreach, and the relationships we have made over the years makes this a special place.

The well-maintained gardens and peaceful outdoor spaces also provide a peaceful retreat for reflection and prayer.

The worship services at Good Shepard Presbyterian Church are truly uplifting. The sermons delivered by the pastor are thought-provoking, relevant, and delivered with passion. The messages are rooted in biblical teachings and are designed to inspire and encourage personal growth in faith. The pastor's ability to connect with the congregation and convey complex ideas in an accessible manner is truly commendable.

From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with smiles and open arms. The church encourages participation in various activities and ministries, providing ample opportunities to connect with others and build meaningful relationships.

The church offers a wide range of programs and ministries catering to all age groups. The dedication of the volunteers and leaders in ensuring the spiritual growth and well-being of the congregation is evident.

In addition to its strong spiritual foundation, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church also places a strong emphasis on community outreach. The church actively engages in serving the local community through various initiatives, such as food drives, charitable events, and partnerships with local organizations. This commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of others is truly inspiring.

Moreover, the church's support for missions and global outreach is noteworthy. It actively participates in supporting and sending missionaries to different parts of the world, demonstrating its commitment to sharing the love of Christ beyond its immediate community.

The Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills is also known for its excellent music ministry. The worship team leads the congregation in heartfelt and uplifting worship, blending contemporary and traditional music styles. The quality of the music, coupled with the participation and enthusiasm of the congregation, creates a truly uplifting and engaging worship experience.

Overall, my experience at Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills was nothing short of exceptional. The beautiful setting, inspiring sermons, strong sense of community, and commitment to outreach make this church a spiritual haven. Whether you are seeking a place to worship, grow in faith, connect with others, or serve the community, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church offers a welcoming and fulfilling experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend Good Shepard Presbyterian Church to anyone seeking a church home where they can deepen their faith, find meaningful connections, and make a positive impact in the world. What impressed me most about this church was the sense of community and fellowship. The members of Good Shepard Presbyterian Church are warm, welcoming, and inclusive. From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with smiles and open arms. The church encourages participation in various activities and ministries, providing ample opportunities to connect with others and build meaningful relationships.

The church offers a wide range of programs and ministries catering to all age groups. From vibrant children's ministries to engaging youth groups and adult Bible studies, there is something for everyone. The dedication of the volunteers and leaders in ensuring the spiritual growth and well-being of the congregation is evident.

In addition to its strong spiritual foundation, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church also places a strong emphasis on community outreach. The church actively engages in serving the local community through various initiatives, such as food drives, charitable events, and partnerships with local organizations. This commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of others is truly inspiring.

Moreover, the church's support for missions and global outreach is noteworthy. It actively participates in supporting and sending missionaries to different parts of the world, demonstrating its commitment to sharing the love of Christ beyond its immediate community.

The Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills is also known for its excellent music ministry. The worship team leads the congregation in heartfelt and uplifting worship, blending contemporary and traditional music styles. The quality of the music, coupled with the participation and enthusiasm of the congregation, creates a truly uplifting and engaging worship experience.

Overall, my experience at Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills was nothing short of exceptional. The beautiful setting, inspiring sermons, strong sense of community, and commitment to outreach make this church a spiritual haven. Whether you are seeking a place to worship, grow in faith, connect with others, or serve the community, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church offers a welcoming and fulfilling experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend Good Shepard Presbyterian Church to anyone seeking a church home where they can deepen their faith, find meaningful connections, and make a positive impact in the world. Pastor Ko, he really allows to be guided in the holy spirit and sets good standards. The word shared through pulpit really challenges you to reflect on your own living and grow in the Word and in your relationship with God. Really, love coming out to the Church on Sundays and Friday evening services. The gospel and sacraments are given faithfully. Best Korean food in a 20 mile radius. I grew up with the people of this church, it may be a new building but the church and it's people still fight on.

name: Good Soil Lutheran Ministries - Rocky River Campus
reviewSummary: As a former member, I was visiting. It was great to be back and see old faces and meet new friends. Pastor Mariasa is wonderful and caring. Tower City Chorus meets there every Tuesday evining at 7pm. We're an all mens barbershop chorus. Come join us anytime for an evening of song. Good Soil Lutheran Church is my church.  It has been a huge part of my life, and to see it change from Our Savior's to Good Soil is exciting and I can't wait to see how we continue to grow! A welcoming place and congregation.  Great for families with young children. Good place all around friendly environment

name: GoodNews Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: We were looking for a new church a few years ago who moved in the power of the Holy Spirit and not just cookie cutter sermons. Wow, we found our perfect spot! We haven't left since and feel we are home. Our young kids love it here too and ask to go to church multiple times a week. If you want to grow in your gifts and stay in tune with what the Spirit is moving in, this is your place. It's a great place to visit the Schroeders are special people. The Church is full of the Spirit of God. Amazing church- the Holy Spirit is so strong here. The people are very kind and make you feel at home. The pastor and his wife and such genuine. This church believes in the gifts and through prayer for me I was able too see so clearly. The Love of God is evident here, by the love, joy and spirit in this place. I went there 45 years ago when it was called Trinity Christian Center. It used to be a good church then but now a weird modern church. I miss the old days.

name: Gospel Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
I love Gospel Baptist Church.  Not only is everyone friendly but we are family!! Great truthful bible preaching. This church is truly amazing. The people here are deeply committed to reaching others for the Lord, and their passion is evident in every aspect of the ministry. I’ve been attending for over a year now, and I feel incredibly blessed to hear solid, biblical preaching straight from the King James Bible each and every Sunday.
The congregation is warm, friendly, and welcoming. They’ve shown such kindness to my family, and we’ve felt right at home from the very beginning. One of the ministries that stands out is the bus program, which brings young men and women from all over the city to church each week—what a powerful outreach!

I’m so thankful to have this church in my life. It has truly been a blessing to me and my family. Gospel Baptist Church is the best church in town! The preaching is biblical and deeply rooted in Scripture, with sermons carefully studied and delivered straight from the Word of God. The pastor is inspiring, the fellowship is warm and welcoming, and the gospel is shared with genuine love and friendliness. This church is a blessing in my life. The presence of God is felt in every service, and the pastor delivers messages that encourage, uplift, and challenge me to grow. The people here are so loving it’s rare to find a community this genuine. I recommend this church to anyone seeking real connection, truth, and a deeper walk with God. We started going to this church 5 yrs ago & have never looked back. Pastor Carlson's sermons are biblical based, real & suggestions are easy to put into your daily lives! We have all grown in our relationship with Christ since attending this church. Also the Sunday school classes that we all attend have taught us so much & we have met other families that have become our dear friends. Serving at this church is very rewarding! Highly recommend coming to this church!

name: Gospel City Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I gave my life to Jesus at Gospel City Church. Gospel City is more than just a casual church you go to for your Sunday service. At its core the makeup of Gospel City is a family of believers that do life together and are immersed in the Word of God!! If you’re looking for a local church that makes you feel at home and a part of a community of Christians that care for and love one another Gospel City is that place! I inquire you to come visit a Sunday gathering and experience the Living God at work! Love, love, love this church! We started attending GCC almost 3 years ago, and it is by far my favorite church I have ever attended. The  teaching is so good, the worship is wonderful and so glorifying to God, and the community of people who call it their home church are so great. This church takes the Bible seriously, wants the Holy Spirit's presence with it, lifts up the name of Jesus, and desires to see the Kingdom of God increase in our city. If you are looking for a local church community, you should definitely check out Gospel City! I can’t say enough good things about this church!  The teaching is deeply rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ and its presented in a way that is powerful and engaging.  Every message points back to Jesus’ love, grace and truth. You will leave feeling encouraged, challenged and refreshed.
This is a place where God is moving. There is physical, emotional and mental healing and people are finding real hope, restoration and freedom in a community that sacrificially serve one another.
The robust and growing kids ministry offers engaging lessons, helping kids learn to love and follow Jesus. It’s amazing to watch them build friendships while also growing in kindness and faith.
If you’re looking for a church where you can grow your faith, experience authentic community and truly encounter Jesus, we welcome you! Gospel City Church is the first church where I felt I belonged. And I’ve been to many! It’s small enough that you don’t get lost. The level of care and concern for others is above and beyond at this church. I suggest that you check out their website and look at any of the videos you’ll hear Pastor Nick talk about the church in general and you’ll see testimonies of the disciples there. A truly gospel-centered church that faithfully teaches the Word while being led by the Spirit. The community is very warm and hospitable—people are genuinely happy to see you from the moment you walk in. Whether you’ve been in church for years or you’re just visiting, you’ll feel completely welcome.

name: Gospel Community Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
Gospel Community Church is legit. Solid preaching, loving people, and great ministry.  If you want God to  work in your life, do yourself a favor and join this healthy and biblical church. Awesome church!! Gospel Community Church is great Christ Centered church that focuses on preaching God’s word clearly. The church values community and authentically getting to know all its attendees. The church serves the greater Santa Cruz community in so many meaningful ways, and gives members so many opportunities to help others. I would definitely recommend checking out this church!!! We are so thankful for GCC! Every week there is great Bible teaching from Pastor Brandon, great worship and wonderful fellowship from all the people that attend. We have found such wonderful community at this church! If you are looking for a church that preaches the Bible and puts a big emphasis on outreach and community then please join us here! GCC is an amazing church. Great leadership, extremely friendly members with a lot of young families, and incredible gospel-centered, expository preaching. Pastor Brandon and Elders Michael and Ben are fantastic and strong men of faith. The worship music is so great. Coffee and donuts every Sunday morning! Love this church! Started attending when I was a student at UCSC and now I continue to go after I have graduated. Its such a blessing to connect with all the different generations here and just so many new babies 🥲 There’s many opportunities to build community with others, whether it be community groups, women’s brunch, or just the various other events they host I find ways to nurture my relationships with the people I’ve met here.

Pastor Brandon is such a wonderful leader that knows his flock and keeps things gospel-centered. I’ve learned so much about God’s word through his preaching and regularly leave service convicted to carry out the gospel. Also, their Daily Gospel podcast has some great stuff that helps supplement my personal time reading the Bible, so 10/10 recommend.

You will literally find the gospel and community at this church.

name: Gospel Grace Church
reviewSummary:
I’ve had a terrible experience with this church. I’ve tried being forgiving and focusing on God but I want a community and after a year of attending this church I still know absolutely no one. Typical cliquey church Gospel grace is such a beautiful community of kind and welcoming believers who are followers of Jesus. The pastoral team remain true to the Bible, and in that, we are fortified by God‘s grace. During my first attendance, coming out of the Catholic Church, I felt like I had oxygen for the first time in my life. There ate no theatrics, but rather joyful worship of the triune God (father, son and Holy Spirit) and thoughtful, enriching, educational sermons based strictly on the Bible, God‘s Word, I was there 2017 for my internship from DC. Hopefully, looking to move back and join the church and maybe settled back in SLC for good. I attended this church today for the first time in four years and, to be honest, I left feeling disappointed. With everything going on in the world—and especially in light of the recent tragedy of Charlie Kirk’s assassination—I felt like there was a real opportunity to speak boldly about the importance of spreading Christianity now more than ever. Unfortunately, that message wasn’t there, and it felt like our congregation missed that moment.

I’m fairly certain that hundreds, if not thousands, of people probably stepped into a church for the first time today because of Charlie’s influence. That’s why I felt it could have been incorporated more into the sermon. It was such a unique opportunity to inspire and strengthen people’s faith, but instead, I left wishing I had felt more uplifted and encouraged.

The pastor also said, “let us pray for the people that are upset about the shooting,” which struck me as an odd way to phrase things given the circumstances.

I want to be clear: I don’t write this out of anger, and I don’t have any hate toward this church. But I also don’t feel spiritually filled or led to come back after today. God Bless. The music is wonderful and the sermons are great. My biggest issue was the community.  I went here for 2 years and only 2 people ever knew my name.  People leave as soon as the service is over and its hard to connect with anyone. They promote weekly small groups but with my schedule it would be hard to connect with anyone. Church leadership is very welcoming but the congregation was definitely in their cliques.

name: Gospel Hills Community Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is very welcoming for all types and is Bible based with a growing youth ministry Watch Pastor Dom online to get a taste of our messages that is easy to understand but fellowship in person is the best way to know us This is such a wonderful church feels like family when I have visited. My husband and I watch online and we love the Worship and sound Doctrinal teaching from Pastor Dom. Such a blessing to see someone who preaches the word of God with Passion and conviction. We always feel blessed by each message! If you live in the area of Glendora I highly recommend this church!! I have never been as baffled by a church as this one. This is a very cult - like church. I visited this church but was not accepted and not allowed to fit in. They offer classes and when you show up, they do not meet. I had this happen three times. I contacted the pastor to inquire about a class that was supposed to meet and didn't and asked for information about another zoom class and needed the information. I asked him to send it to me as a snapshot, and he did not follow through. I might also add, this pastor never greeted me a single time during the seven or eight visits that I made to this church. Never said hello, waved, or even looked my way. I realize that most churches have fallen asleep, and this church is no exception. andThis church does not have time for a visitors, unless you fit the mold. I am by far very disappointed in how this church works. Every single occasion, I was disappointed and their preaching is blah. I only visited for community, You will not find that here. They were not interested in anyone coming from the outside unless you already belong. Very closed and narrow "church."
This place has fallen asleep... It is stuffy and it's members have forgotten what a church is supposed to be and do. I haven't been a part of this ch since I left the area, but still an incredible group of people. Bible teaching Jesus loving and true disciples of Christ

name: Gospel Light Baptist Church
reviewSummary: A very loving local church. High-quality biblically solid teaching.

name: Gospel Light Baptist Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Best Church in Lake Forest Ca. Awesome church and incredible Sunday and Wednesday service!!! Absolutely love them!

name: Gospel Light Church
reviewSummary:
Although Cornerstone isn't my home church, I've enjoyed many fellowship opportunities with them over the years,  and enjoyed the benefit of their prayers. They're active in our community, reaching out and sharing love in constancy and heartfelt simplicity. Pastor James is a gentle, humble man of God who handles the Bible with reverence. I'd recommend this church to anyone who's  looking to know Christ better, or wants support in following him. Cornerstone Church is genuinely amazing!  Pastor James is authentic, compassionate, devoted & blessed.  Deacon ~ Louie is supportive, dedicated, sincere & blessed.  The entire Church body is like family.

We've been going to Cornerstone for several years & feel very blessed to join in worship whenever possible.  Thank you Cornerstone for all goodness you have brought into our lives.  Thank you Jesus!  God bless all!  🙏

Love, Dean Family Always rejoice when we can hear the word of God Awesome church. You should visit Great church spreading the good news of Jesus Christ in Salt Lake City. Its a loving community that teaches the Bible well and shares the kindness of Jesus with the community. If you’re in the area, stop by!

name: Gospel Movement Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary:
Gospel Movement Church embodies everything the local church should. It centers around teaching God’s Word and equipping the congregation to go out into the world and disciple fellow believers to become more like Christ. I’ve never been at a place that is more welcoming than this one. From the moment you walk in until you leave you will receive love and hospitality like you’ve never experienced. I can’t recommend a church more to anyone looking for a new church home. This church is truly something special.
It is filled with people who love Jesus deeply and genuinely desire to make Him known.

Since I began attending in 2022, I have watched it grow and continue shaping itself to reflect the body of Christ more faithfully. Through hardship and loss, this congregation has drawn closer together, becoming stronger and more steadfast in faith through it all.

I am proud to call GMC my home.

P.S. No church is perfect. For example, they only serve iced coffee in the spring and summer, which feels like a an error on leadership’s part but not quite heretical. And while I am not entirely convinced the bass player is fully locked in at all times, the band sounds incredible overall, so he gets a pass. I attended Gospel Movement Church (formerly The Movement Chruch) twice with my daughter and her fiancé. As a senior citizen and lifelong Christian, I have attended many churches over the years and came with sincere hope of finding a welcoming place of worship.

The service began with singing and a reading, which was familiar and appropriate. However, shortly afterward, there was a slideshow displaying Bible verses and statements about giving. The way these messages were presented made me feel like financial giving was being emphasized as a central focus. The quotes emphasized that your money is not truly your own, but belongs to Jesus, including statements to the effect of “your money is His.”

This experience was similar both times I attended. Seeing these messages presented so prominently, and in this way, felt morally wrong to me. It left me feeling deeply uncomfortable and unsettled rather than spiritually supported.

In my experience, church should emphasize prayer, humility, and spiritual reflection above all else. The emphasis on money did not align with the faith and values I have followed throughout my life.

Because of these experiences, I chose not to return. I am so thankful to be part of Gospel Movement Church. I’ve never belonged to a more loving, God-fearing, Biblically wise, and Jesus centered church body in my life. Pastor Daniel has a servant’s heart, always ready to help any member in our congregation and community. He also serves at the Hendersonville Samaritan Center. This is a church that is active and is growing God’s Kingdom. Child care, youth and kids ministry is fantastic! You know that as soon as you walk in the doors, you are greeted and treated as family! I could not recommend Gospel Movement Church enough! I’ve been attending Gospel Movement Church for six years now and I’m still blown away. I think the best word I could use to describe it is refreshing. I can let my guard down in every way. The teaching is doctrinally sound and nourishing. The community is vulnerable and warm. The shepherding is very real and felt. Not once have I felt the need to “put on a mask” and act like I’m doing better than I really am. I trust the Elders, I love the people, and I thank God for the church.

name: Gospel Nation Church - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I has had several visits at Gospel Nation Church. It  is a group of warm welcoming people. The hospitality there is so amazing. Pastor and Sis. Bailey make you feel like you are more then a visitor but family. Pastor Bailey shows has passion and desire to win souls for Christ and he teaches the bible in a way you can understand. We leave motivated and stronger every time we visit. Experience leadership, the people's really welcome you with open arm's, God is truly the center of this congregation. I want to thank Pastor Bailey and his beautiful wife First lady Stacey Bailey for  there unconditionally love and support. Pastor Bailey is Down to earth
Very approachable. The congregation is filled with loving people, I've been to many churches in Atlanta this is by far the best experience there's something for everyone at this church. Please visit and I guarantee you'll love it. Wonderful! Very inviting and friendly with awesome praise and worship and great word from the pastor! I absolutely love this church! The band and choir sounds great! The pastor and everyone else is great. They have a really awesome children's program. They make you feel welcomed and loved here.

name: Gospel Pillars Church, Missions House, Arlington, Tx - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary:
I am deeply grateful for the Apostle’s powerful teaching, his wife’s beautiful spirit, and the strong presence of God in this ministry. As I settle into this state and community, I want to share a constructive observation regarding our worship services. (I understand I have only been attending for almost two months and moved to Texas five months ago).

The Apostle has an incredible, undeniable anointing when he leads us in praise. However, Scripture reminds us that the body of Christ is made up of many members, each with unique gifts to share (1 Corinthians 12:12). Currently, it appears that only two people are permitted to lead the Choir.

I gently encourage the ministry to allow other choir members the opportunity to sing and use their God-given talents. Embracing a wider range of voices will not only uplift the choir but will also enrich the entire congregation as we worship together in unity (Colossians 3:16).

When the Apostle sings, you feel the Spirit all over him. AMEN. This is not to take away from the choir at all. However, from someone who has been in church my whole life. I would always look forward to Praise/Worship because it set the tone for the Holy Spirit. I just don't get that unless Apostle sings.

In all, I recommend coming to get the teaching of the Word. Apostle breaks down the Word line upon line, which is what I'm used to learning. The Holy Spirit is all over him and his lovely wife. HALLELUJAH! Hey everyone! It has been a fantastic start to an amazing week! God has been showing up everywhere I go, and I can see His hand in everything I do. To God be the glory!

This past weekend, I attended Gospel Pillars Church in Arlington, TX, and I was in awe of the miracles I witnessed. Although I usually attend Open Door Church, I felt led to visit this church after connecting with Audrey Dagadu on TikTok. Her media missionary work inspired me to courageously walk into their service, not knowing what to expect. To my surprise, the atmosphere was spirit-filled, overflowing with praise and adoration for Jesus, our King of Kings and Lord of Lords. People from all over the country came together in unity to hear the Word and sing praises to His name.

I felt like I was in the presence of royalty. It was my first time there, and I sat next to a beautiful woman from Africa named Daniella. We spoke life into each other, and I had the privilege of witnessing her deliverance from the apostle as we stepped to the front. I was greeted by the kindest man and woman. The message was clear: we should walk in the power and authority of Jesus Christ, moving with faith, power, and wisdom. The apostle emphasized the importance of being obedient to the Lord—asking Him first before we make decisions and seeking Him above all else. He shared insights on making better financial choices and sowing to the Spirit rather than the flesh. I left feeling joyful and prosperous, knowing there are many people from across the globe who share the same love for the Lord.
The Lord is rallying His people together, and we are united. Revival is about to spring forth. Are you all ready? Well, get ready!
This week, I definitely encourage you to dive back into the Word and prayer, seeking out communities where His voice and presence are felt.

This church hosts Bible studies on Wednesdays and has upcoming events, including a food bank. So if you have a need, please allow the people of God to serve you.

Overall, it was a great experience, and I would go back again. I felt welcomed and seen. Audrey was such a blessing and even inspired me to get the "Courts of Heaven" book so that I can continue to experience breakthrough and deliverance in my life.

To God forever be the glory! I can’t wait to share more testimonies! God is with us! I recently attended a night of worship here and it was nothing like I have ever experienced before. The presence of GOD was so evident! There was not a person in the room not wrecked by his presence that night. There were even many that testified of coming in heavily burdened that stated afterwards they felt complete freedom and were just so light. I can attest that the spirit of GOD is definitely in this church and I look forward to service! Truly a wonderful experience! Gospel pillars creates an atmosphere that allows you to encounter God EVERY TIME you enter the church! Definitely not church as usual but indeed a MOVEMENT of presence of God manifested in the earth in EVERY meeting!!! I’m grateful to The Lord Jesus for this ministry, for the vision of The Man of God, Prophet Isaiah MacWealth and to the one who has been sent to bring in the revival to America in our day, Apostle Michael Michaels!

This ministry helps to build our spirit, mind, business, careers, relationships etc! What we learn here people pay thousands to learn elsewhere! Truly this is a house of diligence and excellence! To be called a Gospel pillar is a great privilege! God did His BIG ONE with this ministry!!!! I HIGHLY encourage you to come visit ASAP!!! 🙌🏽 💯 God's presence was definitely in the church. Pastor spoke with such reverence and love for the word of God. The spirit confirmed some things in our lives. It was a blessing and I look forward to attending more services.

name: Gospel Temple Assemblies of God - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Great church for the family Great leadership for all kids. Bus Ministry… how much I miss it. Salutations to all. Awsome church!!! Pastor David Cadriel is Awsome. Please update Phone number and list time of your services so that people can attend. Good church sad I don't go there any more

name: GR.Church
reviewSummary:
Finally found my church! Pastor Cody is awesome and tells it like it is! God bless gr.church ❤️ I've been attending this church for a while now, and one thing that really stands out is the pastor's genuine care for everyone in the congregation. He goes out of his way to make sure we all feel loved and supported, which creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere. If you're looking for seminary-level dissertations on Sunday morning, you won't find that, but the messages are heartfelt and focus on a simple, encouraging message: Jesus is there to help us through life’s challenges. The pastor’s enthusiasm shows his dedication to lifting people up and pointing them toward faith in a practical way. It’s a great place for anyone looking for a supportive community and biblical guidance. I knew I was a child of God but this church was able to light the fire inside me! I now go here with my husband and it has truly been an encouragement to see this church family grow individually and as a whole. Cannot recommend more. If you are interested please give it a try. It only takes one moment to change your life! As Pastor Cody would say, let's gooooo! A decent Church. I was only there once because a friend invited me and to me it was your typical all-inclusive Church where they played a band and singing before and singing at the end with a pastor talking in the middle.

These are not the churches I grew up attending with my parents but what do I know. I'm used to singing out of a hymn book and then listening to a priest or a pastor dressed appropriately talking on the Bible not wearing jeans and rolled up shirt trying to look cute and cool for the Modern Age.

Maybe it was just me but the place also had a strange smell and it was so sickly sweet that I actually had to get up halfway through the service and hang out for the remainder of the time in the lounge area because I could not take the smell anymore.

The people seem nice and I'm not disparaging anyone I'm just giving my opinion that is all. Started watching online while caring for my elderly mother in August/Sept 2024. Started attending in October in person. Preaching is sound and biblical. Large homeschool presence with lots of opportunities to connect with other families. IE skating parties, birthday parties, Field trips, book clubs. Very diverse age group and backgrounds. We attend a Wednesday night bible study and my husband pointed out what an exceptional turnout they have for the various Wednesday night study groups.  It's very much a "we're all in" church body. If you are a visiting and fill out the visitor card someone from staff will reach out. We we able to meet people almost immediately and get plugged in.  Really enjoy the Sunday night study going through the bible recap and open discussion. Nursery is well organized and all ministries well structured. New youth pastor is great and highly engaging with youth group and young adults. Highly impressed with the transparency in money, vision, etc. They had several weeks where the leadership was available after church for any and all questions including budget etc. We officially joined a week ago and I'm very excited about that future and their plans for GR Church. Feels like home in a short time!

name: Grace & Glory Family Worship Church International - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: My first time visiting this church i became an member the atmosphere is anointed and filled with love the experience is so amazing from beginning to end there's no doubt about this church being a true church of God! Grace and Glory Family International Worship Center is truly a wonderful place to worship! From the moment you walk in, you can feel the love, warmth, and presence of God in the atmosphere. Pastor Eileen and the leaders are genuine, Spirit-led, and committed to serving the community. The worship is powerful, the Word is uplifting, and the fellowship makes you feel like family. If you’re looking for a place to grow spiritually and be surrounded by love, this is it! You better go to this church!!! If you are looking for a church home, look no further! This church held my auntie funeral and it was so organized and entertaining from beginning to end. I didn't want to look away. I live in Texas but I'm sure many friends of the family joined that day. RIP MICHELLE We had such a good day at church for my sister-in-law funeral service they did such a great job there the holy spirit is in this place thank you Lord Grace & Glory Family Worship Church International is the greatest church on this side of heaven; Pastor Eileen Johnson is anointed, appointed & authorized by GOD to lead HIS people into salvation, deliverance & freedom. The worship experiences are awesome & the TRUE LOVE GOD reins in every facet ;-))

name: Grace and Peace Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I came over from Las Flores to follow Pastor Nate and his team.  We love his fresh and real approach.  This is a very welcoming community and definitely not your typical chuch experience!  We get more deeply involved every day because it just feels right! Welcoming and mellow atmosphere - great authentic people leading, serving, and attending.  My 5 year old son really liked the children's program too. Our family love attending and serving with this community church. This is a great home for anyone who is jaded by past church experiences or is new in their faith. All are welcome! Friendly atmosphere and great message from Nate Wells, Definately recommend Grace and Peace and I look forward to coming on Sunday nights! I love the evening service. Good people, good message good vibes all around.

name: Grace and Truth Church Cincinnati - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Grace and Truth Church Cincinnati for the past year and am happy to call it my church home. It is a solid biblical church. The preaching is expository and the music is grounded in sound doctrine. The congregation loves the Word of God and that overflows into a love for one another. It’s also a praying church that acknowledges our dependence on God for everything. It’s a diverse body unified by the most important thing - Jesus Christ! I’ve attended Grace and Truth (formally Hyde Park) church for a number of years now. For years with our previous pastor Bill Rillo and for years with our current pastor Steve Ham, and they both esteem Christ and preach the gospel. One thing I appreciate was the way he had courage to acknowledge sin that other evangelical churches brushed under the rug or supported in their silence was the topic of social injustice. I can assure you biblical truths are freely spoken at this church without the unnecessary sociopolitical rhetoric that actually has nothing to do with Christ or the Bible. I want expository preaching and I get fed the word of God here. I also want the occasional topical preaching to help me grow in a particular area and I receive that here. I want a pastor that has a love and compassion for the lost and in the continued sanctification of his church attendees. Music style is a preference as long as it had a foundation for God’s truth. We have a mix of modern biblically sound music and hymns and I personally appreciate that fact. I have people that I love dearly that attend the church with me. I’m growing in Christ because I have found a church home I believe I can learn and thrive in and that’s all any Christian can ask. Grace and Truth Church Cincinnati cares about the details, without the pharisaical legalism. If there are three things that Grace and Truth Church cares about, they are:

1) Preaching the Gospel. Wow. What more is there to be said? Fulfilling the great commission through supporting missionaries and supporting the local body through weekly exegetical preaching. Truthfully speaking, this church shepherds its congregation with a level of intentionality and care that is true to the biblical charge to “shepherd the flock among you”, as said in 1 Peter 5.

2) Biblical Counseling. I can say this with full confidence, “Biblical Counseling saved my marriage”. To be in a church that highly values biblical counseling and has people who are well versed and trained in biblical counseling is a blessing. Applying the power and authority of God’s Word to any and all situations in life is just another testament to the faith and honor AND reverence this church has for the Word of God.

3) Community. Hebrews 10:25 says to not neglect the gathering of the saints. Grace and Truth Church takes this to heart and follows this command inside and outside of the church. I have gained lifelong friends here. My wife and I have met with numerous people inside the church on Sunday and outside the church during the week and it has been a breath of fresh air. If you are seeking Godly community that is genuine and loving, Grace and Truth is truly a place to check out.

All in all, GTCC is a church that loves deeply. It loves people deeply and it loves God and His Word deeply. I thank God for this church. I'm so grateful to the Lord for bringing us to Grace and Truth. It's a church that focuses on the main things first and foremost, keeping the gospel of Jesus Christ central and building up the body to his glory. We love our new church family! I've been attending this church ever since 2015, and met my wife here in 2017.  It's hard to be succinct about why I love this church, but here are some highlights.  The elders are all committed to the inerrancy and sufficiency of the Bible, while equally committed to being loving and gracious toward others.  They preach a Christ-centeredness in everything, from evangelism to discipleship to marriage to recreation.  The folks that attend here are not spectators: they introduce themselves, engage in outreach, help each other in times of need, and wait for an answer to the question, "How are you doing?"  This is the place to grow, stretch, learn, serve, praise, pray, and be edified!

name: Grace Anglican Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited San Diego on vacation and attend and ACNA church up in Seattle. The service here was lovely because it follows the book of common prayer like my liturgical service up in Seattle. The preaching is also strong. This is an amazing church! May God bless it I visited Grace Anglican online; there's a wonderful feeling of community here, and the liturgy is easily understood, even by newcomers. Fr. Bill offers clear insight of the readings in his sermon; he has a powerful singing voice that easily draws the congregation into singing along throughout the service. All-in-all, this is a place where you can feel even closer to Jesus! This was a welcoming congregation. We enjoyed the liturgical worship, the choir and the fellowship time following the service. It is set in an industrial complex.  Just is not for us. The Spanish church

reviewSummary: Moved to the area and visited several great churches in Reynoldsburg.   This church has been by far the kindest of all that I’ve visited in the area.   Good people, medium size congregation and great coffee. Great church!!!  feels like home!! Treat us all like family and made new friends 🩵 There is an awesome presence of the Lord at Grace Apostolic. It is a beautiful place to lift your voice in song & praise, a place that teaches the Word of God. The people are welcoming & friendly to all. This is where you  can find what your soul longs for, Jesus. Very welcoming! Will be coming back a lot more! An awesome place to feel Jesus!

name: Grace Assembly Of God - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I Love Grace!  I live a few blocks away and walked in over 10 years ago.  Pastor Earl and Melissa are loving and welcoming to all. The whole church is warm, welcoming and full of love. They not only teach you to live in God, they show you how to relish in the glory. They are a true community church, charitable and open to all. BLESS TO HAVE BEEN INTRODUCED TO THE HOME OF GOD AT GRACE ASSEMBLY, I WOULDN’T CHANGE IT FOR NO OTHER. I LOVE EVERYONE AT THE GRACE ASSEMBLY CHURCH. Our home church, no matter where we we came from or where go from now, we belong to this place and our hearts are bonded to this congregation.

We used to travel for work and in 2012, that brought us to CA, being new Christians, new marriage and living in another place wasn't easy, but Grace Assembly was the family we didn't have, the friends we made, and the congregation where we grew and served the Lord as a family. Pastor Earl and Pastors Melissa were mentors, and we feel them as family despite the time and space, but what is that for our Lord Jesus and the love of Christian brotherhood.

There are no strangers in this church, engaged with the world by the love of our Lord Jesus. There have never been other like this place, we still long for this family and pray for this ministry, the saved souls and the many more to reach for the kingdom in the name of Jesus. We love you all. Went to LA for the weekend had to get some word to maintain for my upcoming work week.
Felt the presence of the holy spirit for sure.
I'm from the central valley so I was far from home.
Thanks to Grace for filling my cup Grew up in this church. Got married at this church. I’ve met countless people here that have greatly influenced my life for the better. The leaders of this church are not only teaching Gods word but they are living it !!
