Love you guys Good morning I will be taking the time to visit this church this coming Sunday but I need to know can someone please tell me what time does this church doors open what time does church start at am a first-time visitor thank you God bless 🙏🙏 Nice Church,  Nice people, Wonderful Pastor, Good Word of the Bible Talked to pastor on phone.  Awesome 👍

name: Grace Baptist Church - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful fellowship of believers! Excellent worship services and staff leaders in all areas.  Great location and facilities.  A blessing to the community. Awesome church & people. Great place to worship Had a great talk with the preacher.! Felt better within myself! Didn’t really care for this church when I visited it. Just a rude church overall. Always such friendly and helpful people

name: Grace Baptist Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: This church is warm and friendly, and the pastor feeds the people the word of God. The premises are beautiful and there are classrooms and nurseries for children and younger ones. Visitors are kindly welcomed. Adults and small kids were friendly and inquisitive, but not too many teenagers were the same, which is fairly sad in a missions minded church. I've been coming here for awhile. If you want to mature as a follower of Christ, this is the place. The people here are personable, friendly and caring. Most importantly, the pastor is truly dedicated to serving the Lord and truly cares for the people. His messages are encouraging, strengthening and helpful in staying on the right path in living for God. They also have nice gatherings to fellowship as a church and get to know people. The missionary conference is amazing!  It is a wonderful time of learning and meeting the many missionaries this church supports. This church is blessed. I am curious why they are a Baptist Church, if they are teaching the dispensational grace message saved by grace through faith in Christ alone 1st Corinthians 15 3-4.. Hannibal to do baptism because will you accept Christ in your heart we are automatically baptized into the body of Christ, & at the cross he said it is finished there for we do not need to get baptized, only accept what he did at Calvary for the remission of our sins,its by his Blood,Amen!! This is my home church. The pastor is amazing as well as the staff treating you like family. They get involved with you and go above and beyond caring for each other and others.

name: Grace Baptist Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary:
When I joined Grace, I had gone through a major health issue.   I was a Pastor at the time and after missing a year in the pulpit the church asked me to step down so I did.   I had no idea what God was going to send me but it didn't take long before my family found is place at Grace.

The love that is shown is incredible, the services are phenomenal.  My thoughts and prayers were to find a pulpit to fill again but that didn't happen. Instead God gave me a place that has filled my heart immensely as I heal and serve in a different capacity.

There truly is a place called Grace. Glorious sermons here! Fantastic & relatable pastor. Love the congregation. Highly recommend. Friendly church, pastor preaches with Bible in hand and sticks to the Word of God. Choir sings beautifully and at some point, the music will make you cry. I have visited Grace Baptist and found them to be warm, loving and inviting. I even joined a bible study to further my understanding of God's unchanging word. The fellowship during the bible study is genuine. Very refreshing to the spirit and the soul. This is the best church ever! My husband and I are so blessed to be members of grace baptist church. The Pastor preaches the true word of God with no compromise. He know his flocks name and is truly a man that loves Jesus! The people are very loving. If your looking for a great church and want to grow in the knowledge of God this is it.

name: Grace Baptist Church - Mason Campus
reviewSummary: I love the mission statement of this church. "Encouraging believers to pursue a personal journey into the heart of God through sincere Bible study and prayer, resulting in a passion for God and compassion for others." The expository sermons are food for the souls of the believers. At this church scripture takes precedence over opinions, experiences and traditions. May the gospel be spread to the ends of the Earth. We will be here in the Mason area for at least three months so my husband and I have been searching for a church to attend on a consistent basis while we’re here in the area.  Pastor Jerry’s preaching is very sound and the members were so warm and welcoming....we felt right at home!   We’re looking forward to growing in Christ  and building new Christ centered friendships at GBC! Great programs for college, high school and elementary.  Important to teach from the Bible as Gods inspired word and they do.  Many opportunities for adults to grow in their relationship to Christ and to love one another. Grace Baptist Church is a Bible teaching, community and mission minded church that strives to encourage believers in their walk with Christ. If your looking for a great church family to grow in your faith with, Grace just might be what your looking for. A sweet spirit at this church.  True Bible teaching every week.  Women's, Men's and Children's activities to fellowship and grow in your walk with Christ.

name: Grace Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
No church is perfect, but Grace Baptist is fantastic. The people genuinely care for each other and are committed to showing Christ like love to one another. Their worship is contemporary, but the mix it up which I appreciate (they will do choir and orchestral stuff sometimes but sometimes just the normal band instruments). The pastors are committed to the following Gods word and are extremely approachable. Their Adult Bible Fellowships (Sunday Schools) are awesome and super enriching. I would recommend this church to anyone and everyone! Beautiful, large, flowing water, clearly marked restrooms, excellent place for a large or any sized conference. Beautiful facility with friendly and most helpful people. A place where the love and kindness of Christ shines brightly Strong Bible teaching, Christ Following church home for more than 27 years. Safe environment for children and wonderful kids programs are available, along with child care during services. Two Sunday services, Adult Choir every other Sunday and Worship Teams each week. Check out Grace Baptist Church soon…to find a solid church home and place to worship. Grace to you…and Peace. Great church, and an amazing experience. You can take place in many activities and groups they have for kids and adults almost any day of the week. Amazing summer programs that are great for kids. They have a cafe, even a recreational area. If you want a good song to sing to and great sound to go along with it. They have that. They even have a separate building for junior high / high school students going to Sunday school. This place is great and I have been going for 4 years. Amazing place, amazing people. Just
Great.

name: Grace Baptist Church of Queens - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
I prayed and Holy Spirit led me to this church, a small and cozy home in NY. This is a truly Bible driven church and I enjoy the fellowship with bro n sis from diverse countries. The Word of God is preached here faithfully. Our Lord Jesus is exalted. Church is activate in evangelism and sharing the Gospel with the community. Praise the Lord for this local church. I’m so glad and blessed to be a part of this church .Pastor Tim (humble and has servant attitude )and Sarah (pastor’s wife really shows the character in proverbs 31.This is not an entertainment church or feel good preaching .Also ,not prosperity gospel or health and wealth teachings . It’s Bible based . So ,if you’re looking for a church or seeking and you’re closer in this area in forest Hills please come and join us and be blessed! Was invited in by the pastors wife on our morning walk and was so happy to join. They also had a play later on in the day and I was pleasantly surprised by the talent of the youth. I enjoyed my visit and have gone back a couple times since. Very beautiful area and very welcoming people. I love coming here, it is a truly BIBLE based message, which I think is extremely important for all Christians.  In addition, the congregation, the pastors, and those in volunteer leadership positions all are extremely welcoming.  They do what they can to ensure you feel connected from the moment you walk in the door.

If you are searching for a place to call your congregational home, my suggestion is to look no further than Grace Baptist Church of Queens.

name: Grace Baptist Church Westlake - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary: Took two little people to Grace Baptist Church Westlake. They had an amazing, awesome, time! They painted, played a memory game and learned a lot! I am so very grateful we visited!! :-) Wonderful service Westlake Christian Academy field day. The kids had a wonderful day !!! Very nice folks! Excellent pastor and church

name: Grace Bible Chapel - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: A place to cote

name: Grace Bible Church
reviewSummary: A very caring and loving church. 10/10 would recommend. I felt the lords presence in that church! Also great things have been happening  for my daughter and I since we’ve been put on the prayer list! Thank you! I truly enjoy my time there when I go I love to feel the word of God in my spirit all over when I just go and listen and hear the singing if you need to fill a void within you then you need to come and try it I don't think you will be disappointed the pastor breaks the word down for you to understand just as God intended so yes when I go I do feel so much better a full Februaty 18th or 21st 2001 i got Baptized here. If you need God in your life, then this is where you need to be. Its all about the Lord and his love.

name: Grace Bible Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: Great church! Reformed, Christ-centered and Biblical teaching which is a blessing every week. The congregation is always very welcoming and friendly for first-time visitors and regular attenders alike. The preaching pastors Ryan Wentzel and Craig Marshall do an amazing job delivering the word each Sunday. I've been a member for almost 7 years and have loved every moment of it. Amazing small church. Very family centric church with a good mix of married couples (with children) in the mid-30s range. The leadership is great at keeping the essentials the essentials and having grace and liberty in the non-essentials. This place was nice the first time i went, but then some of the poeple are  judging you and if you not on there level, they look at you as a outsider and a outcast. I grew up going to church my whole life,and racing for church companys,  and this place was the only place to contact me saying I should try another church. Not welcoming me back. Funny I thought its gods church not yours, god forgives everyone if you are ready to turn your life around, Thats one of the first rules, and your not doing that there at church. So please if they keep doing this to people how are they going to get closer to god when your just turn them away. NOT COOL DONT GO HERE, YOU WONT BE WELCOME YOU WILL BE  JUDED. AKA FAKE PASTOR TOM MAXHAM IS A CON DONT TALK TO HIM. A WONDERFUL PLACE TO WORSHIP WHERE EVERYONE IS ALWAYS WELCOME!! Great community and God Centered church

name: Grace Bible Church - Hayward Campus
reviewSummary:
Been here the first time together with my wife. And Oh Boy was that a sermon! Only come here if you want LEGIT SOUND BIBLICAL TEACHING.

We were very blessed and not only by the pastor but rather by everyone there.

Truly grateful to have found this place. We don't need to look any further. Multi cultural community of true worshippers. "Every kindred, tribe, and tongue." Pastor Jesse is gifted at breaking  down and explaining scriptures. So blessed to have found Grace Bible Church! In the last 2 years I have been listening and going to Grace and Pastor Jessie, I've learned so much about the Gospel of the Lord than the 20 some years that I've was at a Catholic church.The teachings changed my life so much. Pastor Jessie is so blessed with wisdom and he has lots of knowledge about explaining the Bible. Been going to Grace bible church since located at San Leandro with my family of 5, 2 daughters, my son and my wife, my refuge and consolation during my distress and hard times.
I love the bible study Tuesday and Friday and Sunday church service..
Pastor Jessie when I need advice straight and honest answer.. may God bless him more. Pastor Jesse is one of the BEST teachers of the word of God i have ever heard......I first heard him on KFAX radio & when i found out that his church was local i went to hear & see for myself. Grace Bible Church does not entertain you or have frilly social "extras"......No money changer tables
& no political agenda.  You will find dedication, humility honesty & you will learn God's word in depth.

name: Grace Bible Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Open-spaced, elegant church with warm friendly people. Panoramic views reign supreme as God's reminds us of Christ's sacrifice for the world. I was honored and blessed to visit last Thursday for the very first time and experience Grace Bible Church where your greeted as you walk through the front doors with Smiles ear to ear.. not to mention, the LIGHT OF JESUS BEAMING THROUGH THE ENTIRE PEOPLE INSIDE AND OUTSIDE where folks are talking and laughing along with young children playing and having a ball before service!! You could see and feel  the enthusiasm in everyone filled with love, joy, peace and unconditional love like JESUS. On Thursday nights they serve dinner( your in for a treat too)  for all who come to worship and hear the message. I promise you , you will feel the vibrant energy of the HOLY SPIRIT and the message will hit home to all !!  My son  has been a member here for a few yrs and he invited  our family to come join him . I can only imagine what Sunday service is like. The church was packed!!  I was in AWE by how many young adults, families and people my age 50’s attend Grace Bible Church . I would like to say, after dinner is over  , everyone is literally running in the Church to find their seating and with a SMILE 😃, all are hungry to hear the WORD OF GOD!

I would recommend you to get there early for a parking spot because you may have to park down the street or in the near by subdivision. I’ve been searching for this church my whole life. I’ve never seen anything like it. The church is grounded in its biblical teaching, worship isn’t a concert here, the community is fruitful and alive. The vast majority of people I’ve met here are serious about being followers of Jesus, excited to share, and eager to disciple. Has less than 20 people on staff because people are so willing to serve. Preaching has always been good, and is sometimes challenging to our itching ears. Not perfect, but a great place. Come and see! Grace Bible Church provides heartfelt worship, clear biblical teaching, and a supportive community. It’s a great place to grow spiritually and build meaningful relationships. Felt very welcomed. Warm congregation and love that we can still hear the message if stepping out into the lobby. Jesus centric teaching 👌🏼Highly recommend.

name: Grace Bible Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: After 5 years of worshipping and serving this group, I can say with confidence to the uttermost: this is an absolutely brilliant Church with very deep roots in Biblical teaching and fellowship. Great worshipping, great fellowship, great kinship, and great brotherly and sisterly accountability, all of which must make up a strong Church, are met in spades within the God-given work of this community. We are looking for a new church. We are fairly new to the area. We tried to attend Easter service this morning at your church. Granted, we were running about 15 minutes late, but when we arrived and tried to walk in - the doors were locked and no one was around to let us in.  We could see you singing in the church. We walked to another door.  No one saw us???  Why were the doors locked down tighter than a drum? You are in a very nice area. On the other hand, if this church is so afraid it’s not the church for us in the first place. Very disappointing.  Also, you don’t have a website. You direct people to your FB page.  Then on FB you don’t give much information.  You don’t list times of worship. Thank goodness God gave me a brain and I zoomed in on the profile picture and tried to read what is on the front door (the apparent locked ones). We have been attending this church for 5 years. The current study of revelation has been a dream come true for me. Most churches avoid this book so I am pleased we are a church that studies the whole council of God! The people are very friendly and sociable.  The sermons are enjoyable, uplifting and per the word of the Bible. Solid worship based on Biblical teaching. A place for family and worship.

name: Grace Bible Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Think you need to pray extra hard on someone you have a bio on. He’s not a very nice guy for someone who claims to be a church guy. My family and I have benefited immensely from the preaching of the Word and the relationships and friendships the Lord has allowed us to forge here. We are grateful for the intentional approach to life and ministry! It is a blessing to be a part of a church family where I am confident that my wife and I and each of our children will constantly be pushed toward Jesus. GBC is a great place for Christians to gather on Sunday mornings. The Bible teaching is instructive and worship is meaningful. The fellowship at GBC is also warm and inviting. I especially like the comfortable theatre seats for my achy lower back. There's also a great ministry for kids, too! More importantly, If you are of the reformed Biblical perspective this is the place for you! We love this church. It’s biblical. They preach the word. These people will become your family. You will not feel like a number, you will be loved on and discipled. We are so grateful God brought us to GBC. God's word is preached here. Today was my first visit here, I was welcomed by several people who genuinely wanted me to feel like a part of this church family. looking forward to many more visits

name: Grace Bible Church - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary: Solid teaching from the Word with a leadership group trying their best to faithfully minister to a hurting world through the love and grace of the gospel. Awesome church and good sermon and good people Love the environment. Wonderful place to worship. Great group of believers Preacher is great

name: Grace Bible Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a family. Welcoming, Sound expository preaching, mixed worship / mostly traditional, great Sunday School based on CEF (Child Evangelism Fellowship), Nursery is clean and organized, Food pantry available, active in Good News Clubs. Wonderful Worship with the music not being overly Loud like a Rock Concert as many others do.  Solid Scriptural teaching and Every age group is represented from young families with infants to seniors enjoying their Fourth Quarter with a big lead!!! Been here my whole life.The pastor is funny and down to earth.We are all children of God and we have so much fun!We have prayer meeting and different games we play out through the week.We aren't perfect but we are home.💒 I don't have many friends outside of church. Great community church. serves the less fortunate in the community with outdoor showers & mobile charging stations

name: Grace Bible Church - Redwood City Campus
reviewSummary: Quiet a wonderful place to worship with God's children and be blessed. A place the word of God is been taught undiluted. may his grace continue to uphold and enable us to end. A wonderful church family where the Word of God is taught expositionally. Fantastic teaching of Biblical principles in a way that helps with practical applications in life. Love it here! A very knowledgeable church that uses the word of God to transform lives. If you’re looking for anything else except learning the truth about God and his word, please don’t bother to come. Good, Biblical teaching, loving servants of Christ, who is the Center of all that happens ar Grace Bible Church! The Lord is always lifted up! Always enjoy worshipping there when I'm in the Bay area

name: Grace Bible Church Anaheim - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary: Small town style church that has been here since the 50's. This church is part of the of the GFF (Grace Gospel Fellowship) network, which operates a college back in Grand Rapids, Michigan. They do not believe in water baptism, speaking in tongues (and the rest of the miracles that were cast away). They believe in one baptism; the baptism of the Holy Spirit. They a dispensational based church and focus heavily on the Apostle Paul messages and his mission to the Gentiles and the children of Israel. They are heed 2 Tim. 2:15 and pride themselves on being good stewards of rightly dividing the Word of God. They believe trinity and that the only way to obtain salvation is through Jesus Christ. They believe in traditional marriage and that you cannot lose your salvation. If you are actually looking to learn from your Bible then I would highly suggest giving this place a try! Sealed for the last 7! plagues. May the Lord have mercy on you. You forsook your true origin settling for the copy after being made by the original! Your choice your double portion is on it's way! Went here on a youth trip and the Sunday school class was more comprehensive than I expected which was a nice surprise and the worship service was delightful A good place to go to if you would like to fellowship with other christians I was baptized here when I was 10. Good memories!

name: Grace Bible Church Honolulu
reviewSummary:
My husband and I were visiting Hawaii for the first time and stayed in Honolulu. We were looking for a church to attend on Sunday and we thank God for bringing us to Grace Bible Church.

We felt welcomed as the members greeted us and showed kindness to us. I truly felt Gods presence in this church. I was encouraged in my faith! The worship and sermon were both very good! I felt God moving my heart through the message and I loved how the Pastor kept going back to scripture and helping the congregation understand what God was revealing to us that morning.

All in all, I am grateful that we got to worship at Grace Bible Church and if we ever come back to Honolulu we’ll be visiting again! Amazing place whether you are just visiting or looking for a Home church.... highly recommend.

Small and quaint!! Jesus directed us to an amazing group of Jesus loving friends¡! We are just visiting but from the moment of parking ..... to being walked across the street by Mark to introductions to the pastor. Then walked straight to you beautiful ladies waiting to greet and get you to the right place. To the amazing worship tram making you truly feel the presence of Jesus!! The message of the day "Getting to know Jesus"!! To the fellow patrons that were amazing with greeting us as well!!

Thank you Jesus!!🙏❤️ I thank God for leading me to Grace Bible Church! I was only on the island for a few days visiting from Texas, but when God has a word for you, you obey.
From the parking lot, to worship, to the message and even the kindness of the people I met after service-absolutely amazing! I love the visual illustrations with the lion preying on the buffalo, & the restoration of the car (1 Peter 5)!! They both hit home for me. I am grateful for this ministry & for God’s people & His word being a living word in my life!! Blessings to Grace Bible Church! From our first visit almost 3 years ago, my family and I have always felt welcomed and valued. When families brought their children to the playground to play with my children, we knew that we found a genuine church that truly does its best to live out God's love and kindness. We feel so blessed to be a part of this church family and pray that you will too! From the moment I walked into this church 5 and a half years ago, I knew it was the real deal. The people are so genuinely welcoming and gracious. Church leadership lives and leads with the utmost integrity. Grace Honolulu loves God and loves people in word and in deed. This is a place where truly anyone could feel like they belong.

name: Grace Bible Church International - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly Christian people thank you

name: Grace Bible Church of Boerne
reviewSummary:
It’s a Christ centered church.  For those who were in Christ, if you thirst for the word of God to be taught and exposited, this is the place for you. Currently, we’re in the book of John in the mornings and then the evenings were in the book of job.

There’s a lot of fellowship amongst the Saints.  Every Wednesday is adventure club for the young ones, and it’s scripture based  Our children love it  And for the adults, we are currently studying the book of Joel

In the mornings before service, we have a Bible study and the children have classes

If you’re not saved, you will be preaching the gospel, and it’s not the water down American lukewarm Christianity.  If you truly want to hear God, speak by listening to his word and submitting to his word, and if you thirst for a new life, come and listen Awesome church . If your looking to grow closer to God in a loving non judgmental environment this is the church you need to come to . The pastors make learning God's word where it's easy to understand and keeps pulling you back in. I love it Finding  a church with sound doctrine and trustworthy leadership can be difficult.

Grace Bible Church has both. The elders are loving, full of grace and patience, and truly care for the souls of the congregation. They are dedicated to preaching the truth and exalting Christ.
If you’re looking for a church that focuses on verse-by-verse expository preaching through the Bible, with faithful men devoted to study, prayer, and shepherding every soul who walks through the doors—Grace Bible Church is it. I have never loved a church community more! The church family was extremely inviting and we have found tremendous support and spiritual encouragement from the people and friends we have met. The preaching is exactly what we were looking for, we wanted expositional, theological preaching from Scripture. The worship is God-centered and well-thought through. The Bible studies during equipping hour and on Wednesday nights have been beyond helpful in spiritual growth. We are a military family and found lots of other military families there as well. We couldn't have asked for a better church family during our time in San Antonio. Grace Bible Church of Boerne is filled with warm and wonderful people. I love many aspects of this church, especially the time of praise and worship through singing of hymns and reading from the Bible. The sermons are not from the pastor’s experiences or watered down. It’s real scripture  from the  Bible, not life stories with a few scripture references.  If you want to learn about the Bible, learn to share the gospel with others, desire to be a part of a family serving each other, then you’ve found your new church home.

name: Grace Bible Church of Central Florida - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Gene is a great teacher of the Bible. His sermons break everything down beautifully. You walk away every Sunday with provided notes. If you're looking for a spiritual education, and a welcoming church family, this is your church. I love going to the church, they makes you feel like in home an they have different languages like Spanish, English and Creole. Is very good people should go is Sunday from 10 am to 12 pm What an awesome church! Pastor Gene is an amazing pastor! He preaches directly from the Bible! Plenty of diversity and different ministries even in different languages. It is a comfortable environment to praise and serve the Lord! There are weekly bible studies and a children ministry. This is the best church God wanted me to attend. The Word of God truly is preached in this church. Great church that preaches the word, friendly congregation and humble pastor.

name: Grace Bible Church of Phoenix - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: I been going to this church since I was a baby and it's the best and the most beautiful thing you hang out with friends and learn about God. I was looking to become part of a church local to me and I am thankful to have found this one. From the first time I entered, I experienced genuine connection from its members. They wanted to welcome my family and I and get to know us, inviting us into fellowship. The preaching is from the Bible every week and has been sound teaching. Having young children whom I have wanted to become more connected into church and the knowledge of Christ and the Bible, I have been pleased that they offer many kid programs and these opportunities. There is always a lot going on during the week for men, women, children, and families. I have witnessed this church's authentic care for their neighbors and their desire to serve others. The church is small enough to have a personal feel yet large enough to have a vibrant energy. If this church aligns with your biblical principles, I recommend giving it a try. You can feel the Lord at work this church!  God Bless you all!🙏❤️ Grace is a non-denominational Christian ✝️ church.  The music 🎶 🎵 is upbeat and the sermon keeps the Bible current. I really enjoyed it.  The people are VERY welcoming. A smaller church that is very friendly, encouraging and has something for everyone.  The youth program is exciting with programs for preschool all the way through college and is dedicated to educating youth to prepare to live God inspired lives, make lifelong friends, and have a lot of fun.  My family and I are very happy and fortunate to call this place our home.

name: Grace Bible Church: Anderson Campus - College Station Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. It's got great leadership and teaching, and you're always welcome there. It also has a place for everyone, and a small group fit for your needs. Bible teaching church, great praise and worship time, followed by great Bible teaching messages that always include the ways to connect what God says- to how we live. Excellent Sunday School program and weekday Bible study groups. We also love how this church is serious about Jesus's Great Commission.  They devote a lot of time and treasure to developing, sending, and supporting missionaries.

Matthew 28:19-20 NIV
[19] Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, [20] and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.” We’ve been attending for about 4 months now. Friendly staff, friendly members and a solid Biblical foundation. Pleased with the messages we’ve heard and the pastors who have delivered them. We are now in the process of becoming members. If you do not have a church home I suggest you visit any one of the three Grace campuses. The best church sitting right next to the best university in the entire universe (including all multiverses).

Ok for real, the best church is the one you go to (unless they worship cookie dough ice cream, but that’s a different problem).

As a readmit student this fall (I took a break from A&M due to finances), I’m looking forward more to getting back with Grace than finishing my degree (don’t tell A&M this).

Solid Biblical doctrine in both the music and teaching. Music is actually good. Ngl I thought Christian music was boring until I went here. I thought Christianity was boring until I went here. But NOPE, Christianity isn’t the boring religion I thought it was. It’s a Person. Like wow, who would’ve guessed.

*edit: the Person is Jesus Definitely one of the best churches I ever visited. I re-visited there last month. If you're an Aggie or a visitor in BCS, this is a must-go. Contemporary worship music, excellent sermon, and church's extra caring for visitors are more than an offset to huge crowd and heavy traffic on Sunday.

name: Grace Bible Church: Creekside Campus - College Station Campus
reviewSummary: Loved going to church here the past 4 years at Grace Bible - Creekside. If I had to sum it up in a few sentences why I love Grace: The teaching is in depth but easy to understand and the gospel (what Jesus did for us) is taught repeatedly, clearly, and comprehensively. In addition, so many people are loving, kind, and genuine. This church and its people have blessed my life abundantly. And it’s a great place for my kids to learn and grow!! I love my church. I love this new building. Outwardly, it looks so different, but the people, atmosphere, and goal of worship have not. Friendly place with engaging sermons and intelligent reasoning on current events. Great place to worship God and learn more about his word. Great place to get to know Jesus, your new body and the end times.

name: Grace Bible Church: Southwood Campus - College Station Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Grace Bible Church during my time In College Station and it was in all honestly one of the best parts of my experience in Aggieland.

There's many opportunities to get connected to the congregation and they communicate those.

It's a multi campus system, but you'll find an in person live sermon being preached. It's a great, Bible believing Christian Church in College Station. Wonderful, friendly, Bible teaching church.  Love it! We have been trying several churches in the areas since we moved here last summer, and we received the warmest welcome here. The interior has a simple, homey feel. Kids area was smaller than some of the other local churches but had great amenities and staff that my kids took to instantly. The worship was both modern songs with old familiar hymns which I personally enjoyed. And the pastor had a great sermon and was very knowledgeable on the topic. Local here. If you're looking for a church, please pray over Grace Southwood before reading my review. Trust where God may be leading you-which may not be to this location.

This is where my wife and I attend church.  It is a Non-denomination, biblical teaching focused, Gospel spreading fueled, giving-driven Christian Church. I've attended Grace since 2012. I've attended a few other churches in town since moving here for school in 2005 and I can say BCS has a great assortment of Kingdom-focused churches to call home. One of the big reasons I've stayed at Grace is because they are a college and international student friendly church.

I'm a big fan in the way Grace does church - they keep away from becoming a big mega-church site or celebrity-pastor lead body and instead pray when the church is full to start another church in the area. The advantage is, despite the busyness on Sunday, you get the feel of a more intimate church. This is the second campus in the Grace Network in the BCS area.  The preaching is biblically focused, heavily logos in rhetoric, and often presented in a min-series format. It is not uncommon to have the pastors in the Grace network  rotate out with each other for a 4 week mini series, which provides a nice change of pace from the Status Quo.

The church is contemporary in music and setting. One personal aspect I love about the Staff is how open and vulnerable they are willing to be. Like any church, I would recommend attending a few times and making a concerted effort to get plugged in with a Sunday School class or Homegroup before making a decision on staying or not. This location is a wonderfully welcoming community for all ages to learn, share and teach others to follow Jesus. Grace Bible Church is one church in four locations. They offer wonderful children & teen programs also. I love worshiping here! Please come visit this campus.

name: Grace Bible Fellowship Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Bible Fellowship Church has become such an important foundation in my life. I found this church during a very difficult season, and it gave me hope, direction, and light at the end of the tunnel when I truly needed it. Since then, my life has turned around in so many positive ways.

From the pastors to the men’s Bible study and everyone in the congregation, you are welcomed with genuine love and treated like family. It is a place where people care about you, pray with you, encourage you, and help you grow closer to God without making you feel judged or out of place.

I am incredibly grateful for what this church has meant to my life. Anyone looking for a welcoming church family, strong biblical teaching, and real encouragement should visit Grace Bible Fellowship Church. Wonderful Fellowship. Welcoming congregation - warm & inviting. Solid preaching. Great leadership. Highly recommended. A warm,  loving, and accepting church.

name: Grace Bible Fellowship of Antioch - Antioch Campus
reviewSummary:
There’s something quite special here. Generous, great worship and message, friendly, and abundance of ministries for all ages. Love watching praise dance and We Mime team. here’s something for everyone here. Not enough words to express how grateful I am to have found. I give this ministry a 3. I went here a few months back and wasn't impressed. For one the worship and praise was cut off way too quick. How do you expect the glory of God to come down and you only sing two songs and then pray for people and then the pastor comes up to preach? I didn't feel no spirit of God from when they first opened. I give 3 stars because the pastor word was really good but worshiped and praise sucked! I don't know if they know how to usher in the presence of the Lord but I was not impressed at all. How much does the praise team spend time in the presence of God? People need to be healed, delivered, made whole, miracles manifested, salvation etc...Go deeper in worship!!! You'll see a change! My brother had taken my children to their holy eves carnival one year.  He returned with magnets with the church's information printed on the magnets.  I placed the magnets on my refridgerator for 4 years they stayed there others had fallen off or broken but those remained.  The past year I decided to go check the service out.  I have never stop coming Grace will make you feel at home.  There are so many ministry's to get involved in.  The Pastor has an abundance of energy and a passion for the congregation.  The Word is alive there  it is also a daily 6am prayer meeting  that has enhanced my prayer time with the father.  I can go on and on about Grace, because it is really a wonderful place to come worship our Lord and Saviour. We have been blessed with a new location on Oakley road come out and visit>I promise you will feel the warmth of the saints. 3415 Oakley road Antioch Ca, I am not a religious person, but I do respect the positive effects faith can have. Grace Bible Fellowship exemplifies that.
I found myself without the means to provide my family with Thanksgiving dinner. Grace Bible Fellowship volunteered a free turkey and groceries, enough items to allow us to make 8 dishes.
The fellowship, in essence, gave us a thanksgiving we would not have had.
I cannot thank them enough. Whenever I visit Grace, I truly enjoy myself, there is always a "Rhema" word for me.  The Pastor teaches the word of God with such passion and conviction.  The members are very loving and friendly, always welcoming and inviting.  Such a pleasant experience!!

name: Grace Cathedral
reviewSummary: Historic French Gothic Episcopal cathedral atop Nob Hill celebrated for its world-renowned choral liturgy, sacred indoor and outdoor labyrinths, and inclusive urban mission.

name: Grace Cathedral - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: Historic French Gothic Episcopal cathedral atop Nob Hill celebrated for its world-renowned choral liturgy, sacred indoor and outdoor labyrinths, and inclusive urban mission.

name: Grace Chapel - Church Offices
reviewSummary: Simply the best! Ok Great hosts for my Keller Williams tech workshop. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Grace Chapel - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
We had our son's Archery birthday party there.  This is the second time we've had a party there.  John was our facilitator and he was absolutely incredible with the kids.  He made it a point to know all their names and really controlled the flow of the party.  He made sure all of the kids were involved, helped them get comfortable with archery, and made sure they all played and felt included.

This is a great facility and such a great value for a birthday party.  I'm not familiar with the church, but if this is any indication, I'd recommend it! Our family highly recommends Grace Chapel. We love the staff and our many friends at the church. Grace is very family-friendly, teaches the truth from the Bible, and reaches out to the local and global community with love and compassion. Come to Grace if you want a church where you can get involved, grow as a person, serve others, and help change the world. My family and I have attended Grace for 14 yrs now.  The teaching is Biblically based and will uplift and challenge you at the same time.  Pastor Jeff is a true servant leader, and the rest of the staff is great as well.  My kids love the children's program!   Come check out Grace if you're looking for a church to plug into. Grace Chapel is a great church.  They definitely care about our kids and the younger generation.  Pastor Jeff does a wonderful job of relaying the Word.  The worship team does a great job as well.  Praise Jesus! Nice pastors, great singers who assist us with the songs. Words on screens above the whole auditorium.

name: Grace Chapel at Scottsdale Bible Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: Decades of uncompromising verse-by-verse expository Bible teaching under Pastor Jamie Rasmussen. Widely praised for vibrant family ministries, compassionate outreach, and deeply welcoming hospitality at Shea and North Ridge campuses.

name: Grace Chapel Church of Christ - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: I love many things about GCC, but most important for me is that they teach what the Bible (Gods letter to us) has to say. The congregation is filled with the most loving people you’ll likely ever meet. There is no rock band to distract me from focusing on the word of God. We do have talented singers that sing from their seats in the congregation. We focus solely on the words of God, Jesus and the Holy Spirt. I love my church. Our family has been looking for a church for quite some time, where you just know and feel it is the right one. We are blessed as we found it here, our new church home and family. We love all that Grace Chapel stands for and stands up to do, help, love, and minister in this community and around the world. I can not imagine life without our family of over a year now. May God keep the grace in Grace Chapel for all years to come. First hour is service, second hour is Sunday school. Great group of people and excellent program for kids. We visited this church for a few months and the warmth and love of the people really won us over. We joined a short time later and are so happy with our decision. Grace Chapel is a great place to call home. My favorite church I have ever been to. They always make you feel welcome, they have amazing staff/programs for all the kids and the lessons are good. They have a newcomers lunch once a month to welcome anyone new.

name: Grace Chapel Community Church - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary:
I like that this is a traditional church building with pews and  beautiful stained glass windows. I was welcomed immediately by others in the congregation. They were all very friendly and inviting. I listened to the father preach and he put on a nice sermon and is funny too. There were a couple of hymns sung from the actual hymnals (so great to still see them in a church). Then there were a couple of contemporary songs sung off the projector screen while the head pastor played a guitar behind the podium. They sung the chorus/bridge over and over and over again. I don't care for this type of contemporary music.  Sadly there were only maybe 25 people tops in attendance (counting the pastor and the band), although the age group was spread out. One thing I don't get is the head pastor wearing jeans and a henly T shirt. I was raised that you respect the Lord and dress appropriately in His house. I understand parishioners that maybe don't have dress clothes, but to stand on stage as the pastor, is flabbergasting to me. Its not just here though. More and more churches are becoming too modern and casual. I might go back here from time to time, but it isn't what I'm looking for in a new permanent church home. Great Church
Pastor Doug Meacham
Come and Join us Great little car show. Good people. My church family. If you don't have a church home I invite you to join us. Spirit filled. Awesome Service.
At The Well Ministries Church.

name: Grace Chapel Lexington
reviewSummary:
My home church! The staff and volunteers are super kind. I love how I can linger freely, receive prayers in the prayer chapel or pray on my own no pressure. Everyone is always filled with the holy Spirit. This church saved me in so many ways. My daughter and I are eternally grateful for Grace! Went for Easter service (8am)
It felt they were more concerned collecting money and promoting ads. Within the first 10min they collected donations. I wasn't too happy with that

Also, instead of focusing on Jesus, they focused on Mary of magdalene for the majority of it. I get the logic that Jesus knows us (which was the message) and knows our name, but they barely mentioned Jesus :(

Barely mentioned his resurrection. They said it in bypassing, but that's it. Anyways, this was my first time there so hopefully they're better other days.

I think people should try this church to see how mesh with group, but this wasn't my cup of tea I was a committed member from 2018-2019. I was attracted by all their groups, events and worship nights. So I do not want to discourage any new or young believer. Although a majority of people there have good intentions unfortunately at the time there was not good leadership. I had a very disturbing and upsetting experience with members of the leadership team. After I spoke up about the incident, I was kicked out of the church. Shortly after that a friend of mine who still attended shared with me the person that kicked me out mystery moved and left the church abruptly. This was my experience. Not sure how it is nearly 8 years later but just remember go to church because of Jesus not His children cause His children will hurt you. You can believe! There no another better place! Incredible large comfortable place, I love praying God that place! This is one of the largest evangelical churches in New England.  It is non denominational -- and has the rare gift of being very welcoming to all: from those curious about God -- to those looking for in-depth fellowship and challenge.
What initially attracted us was the strength of the congregation when they were in transition from one senior pastor to another, something they are going through again in 2024.

It has numerous strong "ministries" -- from kids/teens, to special interest/needs, to a very strong mission outreach. Part of the benefit of a larger church is the breadth of support and opportunity for involvement -- as well as ways to give to others.  All the staff is gifted and clearly striving to do Gods work.  I highly recommend checking out this place of worship.

name: Grace Chicago Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary:
Bob is such a kind, humble, and faith led pastor. Love Grace’s community of come how you are, and that everyone is welcome!! The new building space is absolutely beautiful! Sunday morning services are rich with amazing music and liturgical traditions practiced in an accessible way. I never feel like I'm told what to think here - instead, I'm prompted to keep asking myself questions: namely how do I experience God's love for me and how does that change how I relate to the people in my life?

There are lots of opportunities here, too, to share meals, volunteer, celebrate happy occasions and get to know the people of this community on a deeper level. I'm new to Chicago and I attended Grace last week and really loved it. The people were really friendly and inviting. I'm glad I found a place to worship. This has been my church home for nearly 20 years. Both of my kids have been baptized here and I've found it to be a tremendous support and an extension of my family here in Chicago. Been going here for almost 15 years. Great music, great people and a thoughtful, liturgical service. Definitely recommend it!

name: Grace Christian Alliance Church - 137th Street 恩聯宣道會137街堂 - New York Campus
reviewSummary: One of the best Chinese churches in town. They are very welcoming and loving. There are many recreational activities to do here. I heard many great sermons here. They are providing only Mandarin services at the moment but are adding English services soon for English speakers need. They also serve delicious lunch after service. On the weekdays they have after school programs for children. A place that feels like home It feels like home. A loving church. good night.

name: Grace Christian Center - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly. Was greeted at front door with smiles and blessings. Then as I walked in the main area, I was greeted again and asked if I knew where I wanted to sit. When I said No. Lucy suggested I sit beside her! EVERYONE was so friendly and inviting. It was a wonderful time with Gods people. The absolute worst experience I’ve ever had at a church. When I walked in I thought I was at a Funeral home. It felt sad and heavy. It really gave me concern. The “lead” pastor is the wife and is somehow worshipped in that place. I was not impressed and felt a horrible spirit coming from her. I’m not judging. The Bible said you will know them by their fruits. She was bossy, spoke down to people , and elevated herself as Gods prophet… FALSE! I was a guest of a friend and was there for prayer at the urging of my friend. The pastor called me up on stage to pray for me ( cancer patient) and reprimanded me in front of everyone for responding to  the Holy Spirit yet she carried on like crazy and is the only one allowed to do that. So there is no freedom for anyone but her. She called out another gal in the congregation for crying and told her to dry it up. When I was walking out one of her staff ran after me and wouldn’t let me leave. They said the pastor wanted a word with me. I told them I was not interested and they kept insisting. I finally got away from them and knew I’d never be back. This was my daughter and I second Sunday attending this church. I was brought here by a friend. She was bragging so much on this church, I expected better. First, the pastor's wife who now is in charge because her husband died in September of 2024, started speaking about money. She bragged about paying $150,000 to this church. Then she single-handedly started pointing to her congregation and calling out different individuals about what they should have done with their money and seeded more into the church. She made us raise our hands and wiggle our fingers, after she made one lady put up her hands, who has deformed hands w/no fingers and used her as an example! 😱😱😱

She talked about a man's shoes and said, "they were hideous. And if you were to wear those shoes again.  I know you are not offended by what I said!"😱😱😱.. She called out a woman and spoke on her being deformed, and basically blamed her for being deformed as if it was her fault! She made the congregation stand up and was chastising us as if we were children and said; "we needed to give more! She bragged about not going to rooms To Go and buying her furniture as if she was better than us! Mind you everyone cannot afford expensive furniture. She bragged about selling her beach house and a big house, she once owned! 😱😱😱🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️

One guy was called out from the congregation about spending HIS amount of money for medical research. She chastised him about doing that, and responded with; "you could have spent this money on the carpet in the church here. She made some of the people in her congregation get up and say how much money they spent and told them they should have spent more!😱😱😱
Her son-in-law stood up and he talked about the way he lost. She made a black woman stand up, look at her and said, "I know you are not happy carrying around all that weight!" My mouth flew open! 😱😱😱😱

But i can rest assure, God sees what happens in your church, He knows the whole truth, He knows my prayers & He accepts us because i know for fact that Hes close to the sick & the broken, so Goodbye forever & God deal with you in His own way.
PS: try alittle Grace, kindness & empathy, im pretty sure thats what Jesus would do. For the multiple people calling Grace Church homophobic you need a reality check. The world and prosperity gospel that sinners love has you comfortable in your sins. God forbid a Pastor who ACTUALLY teaches the WORD of CHRIST and preaches repentance. News flash the Bible says homosexuality is a SIN. You will not inherit the Kingdom of God. That's God WORD period point blank. You can't twist the scriptures to fit your lifestyle. You need to change your lifestyle to fit the scriptures. You shouldn't feel offended you should feel convicted. If you're not convicted it's because your heart truly isn't with God. If you're looking for a Church that preaches the Word of God I encourage you to checkout a service. If you're looking for a prosperity gospel Pastor who will keep you comfortable in your sins, never tell you the truth about the Word, and repentance then Grace Church isn't for you. Definitely recommend this Church if you are visiting or new to the area .
We will be back soon !

reviewSummary:
This church has been amazing. Great kids programs, incredible pastoral team, but it’s the people you meet that will keep you coming back. Highly recommend checking it out if you’re in the area. I really do like the church but this is the second time of them kicking me out for my baby and she is only 6 months and she wasn’t even loud and I feel like that is disrespectful and rude. Even though they have a baby daycare, every baby doesn’t do well with going to the daycare and I feel like they should not kick people out of church just because of their baby, especially when the baby isn’t loud. Grace Church has truly changed my life. The messages are powerful, practical, and rooted in God’s Word. The pastors speak with such authenticity and love, and the worship is always filled with God’s presence. I’ve found a real sense of family and purpose here. If you’re looking for a place to grow in faith and feel God’s love, this is it! I am truly amazed—I've found my spiritual home. The emphasis on community and striving to be like Christ each day is inspiring. While nobody is perfect, Grace offers the tools to remind us to become the best version of ourselves that God intended. The sermons given by Pastor Kendrick open my mind and heart to a deeper understanding of the word of God.
Give this church a try, and you will not be disappointed. Grace Church is wonderful, a congregation full of loving, happy folks, amazing worship team, the Pastors are phenomenal, Pastor Adam Dawson is so kind, caring and knowledgeable on the word, Lead Pastor Kendrick is relatable with a kind spirit and breaks down the Bible in such a way that leaves you fulfilled like Olive Garden breadsticks but make it Bible-ey. Grace offers plenty of ways to serve in our community, including serving the entire congregation FREE coffee at EVERY service and sometimes FREE SNACKS 😁 too! The kids team is great, shout out to Pastor Ethan, our 5 yr old loves going to church on Sundays, plus there's a brand new HUGE playground out back that the kids are fully enjoying! The Christmas services will bring you to your knees worshipping our Lord and Savior and even to tears. My heart is full just writing about Grace church and I hope that if you are lost and looking for a home to try Grace, I am far from perfect, I have strayed in life and this church will welcome you back, like a lost sheep when it finds the herd again, guide me my shepherd, your will not mine.

Good fruit is free, be salt and light and lead others to God, all this not through me but through Him. I love each and everyone that reads this review, just as God loves you, may this find you and you find him.

name: Grace Church - Downtown - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
Founded as Greenville Baptist by 10 members in 1831, the Downtown Baptist Church’s original congregation has had several name changes over its more than 150-year history. Replacing an earlier church building on the banks of the Reedy River, the currently named Grace Church Downtown was built as the new home for Greenville Baptist in 1858. Listed in the National Register of Historic Places as Downtown Baptist Church, it was designed by acclaimed architect Samuel Sloan. Greenville Baptist officially changed its name to First Baptist Church in 1890.
A Sunday School building was added in 1914 beginning a flurry of construction the following year. In 1915, all three facades were altered. The sanctuary was extended by about seventeen feet and the floor was angled into a slope. Two rows of pews became three, and the pulpit area was expanded with an organ loft and choir gallery. The interior layout has remained largely unchanged since then. 2 front doors were added to each side of the original single door and the stairway was widened by another bay on each side. By 1930 the church had become the largest in Greenville County. In 1940 the church was remodeled, and an auxiliary building was constructed on the grounds. A three-story building was added in 1950. The congregation had more than 2,500 members in 1957 as another addition was completed.
A majority of congregation felt that a larger church was needed, and in the spring of 1974, they moved into a new building on Cleveland Street, taking the First Baptist name with them. A smaller group chose to stay in the older structure using the new name Downtown Baptist Church. The building was again renovated in 2011, removing the side galleries and balconies that were added in 1915.
Despite all these modifications the basic design, decorative elements, and structural integrity of the church remain intact as it continues to stand elegantly overlooking Greenville’s busy downtown. Grace Church, located on McBee Avenue in Downtown Greenville, South Carolina, is a Biblically sound church.  The teaching was refreshing and challenging.   The music was contemporary, yet not overwhelming.  I liked the scriptures attached to each song, pointing the song back to the Word.  They have multiple campuses, so the Pastor that spoke was at a different location and the sermon displayed on the big screen.  Nice experience! Wonderful location. They have excellent childcare, beautiful music, sound teaching and many supportive programs for an array of people in need. I highly recommend the church. reviewSummary: I have visited Grace Church for a total of 3 times, the main reason being for work as I am a sitter. Everybody is so kind and the kids are a delight. The parking is very spacious. I grew up in this church and its an amazing church because there's absolutely no drama no matter who you are you are always accepted and our church is not very big but we are one big family! If your looking for a church in Fayetteville I recommend Grace! Each encounter has been very warm and welcoming. They definitely make you want to return. I'm relocating soon and I'm already thinking about missing these kind people. Blessings always to Grace Church Fayetteville 🙏🏾💕 Amazing leadership and direction in this Church. reviewSummary: Rarely do you find a church that stresses the importance of Biblical truth yet while equally equipping and encouraging its members to live out the gospel. Healthy and full of all ages, races, and social-economic diversity. Don't let the building fool you... there is room for you and your family to be a part of this faith-family. LOVE my church! The teachings feel like Bible study paired with life application. Gospel is shared every service. Worship is Christ focused. Family oriented. My daughter loves GraceKids, the childcare program. She started participating at 1 year old and is 2 now— zero complaints. All volunteers are familiar faces as a lot of them are moms themselves and attend service too. Many community groups, classes, events, volunteer work, and mission trips available. God led me to this church 100%. We went here for Easter and absolutely loved the experience. Whenever we’re back in town, we will be there. A very strong bible-believing church that I call my church home.  Came from California looking for actual preaching of the gospel and they do not disappoint. It is like one big family and they are celebrating their 20th year anniversary and I couldn't be happier with it.  God bless this church and may we have many many more years together worshiping the Lord with all our heart. The first time we attended everyone was friendly and introduced themselves to us. Then one of the pastors found out where we lived and introduced us to another family who lives in our neighborhood. The music is contemporary and excellent. The preaching is relevant and generally preaching thru a book of the Bible

reviewSummary:
