And after I graduated I chose to stay in the area largely because I couldn’t imagine leaving these wonderful people. This church is not flashy and shiny like you’ll find at other churches. The worship is not a concert with fancy lights and props. But the faith here is genuine. They focus on the Gospel, loving God with all their hearts, and your neighbor as yourself. There have been ups and downs recently but the leaders take every chance to listen to every person who comes to them with a problem and makes effort to sit with you and talk through whatever may be on your heart.
A few verses that come to my mind when I think of describing this church are Ephesians 2:8-10 and 1 Timothy 1:5 (please do look those up it helps add to my review (: )
If you love God and want to be around people who believe in loving God, loving others, and following the teachings of Jesus, give Grace Church a try! Being new to purdue this church really helped me stay focused and aligned with God.

Everyone here has been kind and loving and is close in community with each other.

I'm glad I found Grace! Love this church! Laidback, comfortable, and they teach Biblical truth and believe in the gospel. They also serve free coffee which is a plus! Grateful for the caring people and loving attitude. So many people with servant hearts! As an international student I felt very welcome at this church. People are friendly and commited to serve God and serve people with the best that they can. Best church I have been in America! I became a Christian while attending this church and have received much love and support over the years as a member of the church. I feel welcomed into this family of believers.

name: Grace Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s been over 20 years since my dad introduced me to this treasure of a church, a true portion of the body of Christ… one that grows with you and you with it, in His grace.
“For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.”
“For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God, not a result of works, so that no one may boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.” A truth and God’s love teaching church with a beautiful church family of all ages! Truly the most inspiring and grounded church in this area.  I love the pastors and all the saints here as they are so knowledgeable and sweet ss well.  If you’re looking for a reformed church that seeks to serve the Lord in all the right ways you will be very blessed here. Come on over and worship with us! Pastor is great was there for Easter first time visit. The most important things for me about a church I attend is the faithfulness of the message, the character of the members and if the music is for worship, not entertainment. Grace church exceeds expectations. It is a reformed church, which adheres to a Calvinistic theology. If you're curious about what that means, pay this church a visit.  Here you'll feed on the meat of the gospel. I have attended since the church began back in 2000. What a wonderful body of believers. We grow each Sunday under the faithful teaching of the word.

name: Grace Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Episcopal Church is a wonderful Episcopal Church community to be a part of in Greenwich Village, Manhattan.      Very welcoming Episcopal Church community and very historic.       Grace Episcopal Church has been around at the current location since 1846.   God Bless Grace Episcopal Church. Such a nice and peaceful on Sunday late afternoon. I was on the way to get snack, when I saw this church, I had to stepped in and sit inside for a while. I love the architecture, arts and color glass around the church. I don't want to interrupt another people, so I just sit not to deep and listen to nice and wonderful music. Grace Church is Incredibly beautiful French Revival Gothic church, especially the courtyard is beautiful (looks like you can shoot a movie there). Feel free the wander withon the courtyard. The fences are made of gorhic speared shape iron, they don't make it like that anymore. The interior is also beautiful with gothic archways and wooden entrances. The walls are decorated with stain glass art. If ypu are in Union Square area, this is totally worth a visit. I highly highly recommend it 👌 😎👍👍👍 Absolutely divine and immensely beautiful with such intricate details in everything… be it enameled glass or the bench heads or the baptismal font.. it’s spellbinding… Absolutely beautiful church. The architecture is a great respite from the blandness of New York City. I'm not sure what era it it, but it reminds me of medieval times. Inside is a good place to go if you want to get away from the busyness of the city, and just want to sit and think.

name: Grace Church - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary:
i’m a freshman in merge currently, and ever since i first came to the church back in december 2023, everyone was super welcoming. i do online so i didn’t have many ways to socialize, in the months i’ve went here, i’ve made a lot of friends and have felt closer to God! i appreciate everyone at grace including staff, small group leaders, my friends, etc. i truly don’t believe i would be where i am today in my faith journey without grace and everyone associated with it! if you’re looking for a church home, this is a great place to go! This is by far one of my favorite places. My family and I love spending time here. We've been attending for about 9 years, and we started volunteering very soon after we started coming. I highly recommend getting plugged in quickly, both with a Rooted group or small group as well as volunteering. Those 2 things will very quickly make a big place feel much smaller and like family. The people here are great, the atmosphere is welcoming, and the teaching and worship are superb. My husband and I volunteer in multiple roles in Production Arts, and it is always the highlight of our month (and we love picking up extra weekends). I love the leadership here - they are great, committed people, who work hard,  who care a whole ton, and who are very good at what they do. I also love that Grace has a value for the arts, and especially theatre - we do a play or musical every year, usually alternating between very large productions and somewhat smaller ones. But the quality of them is just amazing - I don't think a single year goes by without somebody coming up and saying they've been to Broadway, and this is just as good. The staff in both Production and theatre related are just top-notch at what they do - highly trained and very skilled. My husband and I love helping with theatre as well. You can usually find us as backstage crew and helping build and paint the set. Our kids are still small, but they love Grace, and are already learning about volunteering and being a committed part of something bigger than just us. Making a high impact on helping the community. Many outreach programs and wonderful people! Stopped going here after 20 + years. They started talking about money every servic and started bringing politics into chur. Started to not feel like you are going to church.  Decided to try Grace again during covid, that was a mistake.  Brought 2 people with me that have never went to church before.  But they were both going through a rough time. So i Brought them to Grace church. The church was almost empty,  the closest person was 40 ft away from us, 5 minutes in after being there we were kicked out because we didn't have mask on and escorted out by police.... keep in mind this was both their 1st time going to church and both and iv invited them both way before this and after this. They have not been back. With that being said, when you are standing infront of God on Judgment day and he ask why these people are not in his kingdom, Id love to hear what you say!

Anyone reading this, go try a different church, lots of Great churches in the area. I attend Grace most Sundays. I was admittedly reluctant to attend church, as a child the church we went to was boring and slow and I never enjoyed it. When my parents divorced when I was a  young teen I felt the church made my family feel unloved and unwelcome in a way I didnt understand. I'm glad I gave going back to church a chance and for choosing Grace.
We may sit towards the back but that doesn't stop us from feeling the warm, welcoming embrace of the staff and congregation. I often get emotional during worship and hang on to every word of the message.
This church will make you feel at home, make you feel God's presence and will help brighten your week. Even those unsure of what they believe or those with many doubts (like myself) will leave here with a sense of faith and a sense of hope.
Great job Grace, I'm proud to be a tiny part of your story!

name: Grace Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church! The preaching is powerful, always Bible-centered, and easy to apply in everyday life. The worship is uplifting and full of heart, and the kids’ ministry is amazing—including a dedicated classroom for children with special needs, which makes me feel completely at ease leaving my little ones. It’s a place where families are welcomed, community is built, and spiritual growth is encouraged. I’m so grateful to be part of it! Too many mean ppl here...
a heads up, this church is not Mental Illness friendly but if you decide to visit with your loved one with a mental illness they are asking you to kindly disclose it to them prior to your visit( which is a highly protected right btw), i guess its easier for them to keep an eye on you, instead of praying for you to get healed. Pastor praises himself in fasting,prayer & continually pats himself in the back with how close he is with God. Well, what about us who've been praying for our loved ones for years & when they walk into a church for help & santuary, you become upset bc they dont act the way you want them too; you realize how hard it is to go out into this mean world to deal with ppl staring & commenting, then i go in church & theyre even worser that the world out there? Pastor & Grace church: just shut up & listen for once, i dont need your apologies or your explanations, just deal with the truth im giving you & remmember church is for healing & thats what i went for, but i guess it wasnt there, maybe Pastor was too distracted with cracking jokes than to see a broken person coming in from shelter of the world. You can start by getting your bodyguards trained in supporting loved ones with mental illness instead of you screaming at them from the podium, because im not the only one out here, theres alot of us. Also Pator, just letting you know my loved one would never hurt anyone in any way specially at your church because he loves you guys, he always has & hes the one who asked me to take him; he may not understand his illness but hes always had heart & love for ppl & you specially, he would always talk good about you & your family, youve met us before many times & your wife has prayed about him too specifically about his mental illness, his mind may not let him see the mean/cruel side of ppl but i do, & thats why i advocate for him in everyway. And dont say you didnt know us or about my loved ones illness bc we have been connected at your church including: Mental Health Coach/Pastoral Counceling from your church with an amazing woman of God, XO Conference, Small Group, Honey Huddles(which i also volunteered & helped with & spoke about my loved one) & i would continually go up for prayer at service & my prayer was always the same, prayer for my loved one with mental illness; so how much more do you want from me bc i did do my part, & many active/volunteer Godly men & women at your church knew my loved one & myself by name. NAMI is available to support anyone whos dealing with the same rejection & hurt from the world & churches like this one; ppl will never understand the pain we go through everyday. I cant deal with stuff like this anymore, dont worry Grace i wont return, i know you dont accept us, i know we're a bother to you & i know we dont fit in or that i cant see the future & anticipate what my loved one does every single minute of the day but i know he wouldnt hurt anyone, in any way. But i can rest assure, God sees what happens in your church, He knows the whole truth, He knows my prayers & He accepts us because i know for fact that Hes close to the sick & the broken, so Goodbye forever & God deal with you in His own way.
PS: try alittle Grace, kindness & empathy, im pretty sure thats what Jesus would do. For the multiple people calling Grace Church homophobic you need a reality check. The world and prosperity gospel that sinners love has you comfortable in your sins. God forbid a Pastor who ACTUALLY teaches the WORD of CHRIST and preaches repentance. News flash the Bible says homosexuality is a SIN. You will not inherit the Kingdom of God. That's God WORD period point blank. You can't twist the scriptures to fit your lifestyle. You need to change your lifestyle to fit the scriptures. You shouldn't feel offended you should feel convicted. If you're not convicted it's because your heart truly isn't with God. If you're looking for a Church that preaches the Word of God I encourage you to checkout a service. If you're looking for a prosperity gospel Pastor who will keep you comfortable in your sins, never tell you the truth about the Word, and repentance then Grace Church isn't for you. Great church that is very "Bible Based" point by point. They have a great kids ministry, small groups, and are friendly. It's always a little awkward walking into a church you don't know but we've met great people and are glad we stuck around. I highly recommend attending their "meet the pastors" to get a feel for the church and it's goals in the community. We came two weeks ago and we enjoyed ourselves. The kids went into the kids club and they enjoyed themselves. I was able to enter the sanctuary and the worship music was great and the sermon by the pastor was really good! Definitely recommend this Church if you are visiting or new to the area .
We will be back soon !

name: Grace Church - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
Blessed is a true understatement when it comes to finding my home with Grace. From the first moment I walked in I was welcomed in like family. With so many options for service times, there is truly a service time that fits everyone’s busy lifestyle. Pastor Mike leads such powerful, meaningful and purposeful services as well. Next steps really allows members to find their place at Grace and guide you in the right direction to your next steps with God. God gives everyone grace and so does Grace church so if you haven’t already come for a visit, now is better than any other time.  I can speak on behalf of all the Grace family that we CANNOT wait to meet you where you’re at on your journey. 🙌🏼 Grace Church is one of those special places that you will never forget. Grace focuses on the essence of what a church should be for us. For me, it was my first spiritual home. I was baptized there, I learned the scripture, the love of Jesus, and met a fantastic community.

Pastor Mike and the team there has truly created something special for us all. I recently relocated to Dallas and of all the things in Orlando, aside from my family, I wish I could bring Grace with me.

If you are considering a new church, do not hesitate to visit Grace. I promise you will be impressed and touched by the genuine mission of this church to know Jesus, love God, and align yourself and family with a higher calling in life.

God bless, Austin My first visit was so warming. I brought 3 other family members with me. From the parking lot staff, to my seat I had a great experience. I saw smiles everywhere and was greeted by many, and when I said it was our first visit….oh man they turned it up a notch. Amber escorted me to my son’s class, and the guy at “The Hub” was super excited for us! Coffee and donuts were offered, and communion is done weekly here. I’ve watched Pastor Mike on YouTube before, but in person was super nice. Hospitality went extremely well on Saturday. # 5:30 Service ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Thank you Grace Orlando, we will be back! I started going here in November and only a couple months later I already started serving. Bible based teaching and their desire to help you find community are 2 major aspects this church provides. Pastor Mike’s preaching gives great life lessons on ways to honor God even when going through tough battles. From the very first time we visited Grace Church Orlando, we felt like we were home. Pastor Mike teaches straight from the Bible, and his messages are engaging, relevant, and truly convicting. We leave challenged and encouraged every single time.

The worship music is powerful and uplifting, creating such a meaningful atmosphere to connect with God.

The people here are incredibly friendly and welcoming, and we found our spot to volunteer that we really look forward to every week—which has been such a blessing. Even with an hour drive, it is 100% worth it.

When you come, make sure to stop by the Hub to say hi and get any questions answered. We are so thankful God led us to Grace Church Orlando and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a Bible-centered, loving church community.

name: Grace Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: We've found challenging Bible teaching & a loving church family in the 16 months that we have been part of Grace Church.  The leaders live out God's grace and love with transparency, showing how God's forgiveness and justification gets applied in real life.  That has produced a culture of genuine care and concern for each other that makes it a joy in worship and live for Christ together!  God has given us opportunities to be part of churches in a number of cities over the years and Grace Church is tops!! Have felt nothing but love since we started 3 1/2 years ago. Gospel centered. Family oriented. Come a little early and enjoy a cup of coffee and meet the family. Grace Church is a welcoming and loving church that preaches pure Gospel truth. It is a wonderful place to worship the Lord with fellow believers. This church was our home away from home for many years. The people are welcoming and the pastors cared for us as if we were their own. The gospel of Jesus was unashamedly proclaimed every time we visited. Everyone is accepting and loving. For me Grace Church arent just members or friends. They have become family. The Pastors and their wives are really amazing also.

name: Grace Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: A blessed and blessing place to be on any Sunday morning. Welcoming and friendly,a true church of God,supportive staff, and members. If you are looking for a warm,loving, and inviting  church to attend, look no farther. Grace is the church for you. Second time attending this church - I’ve lived in Pompano Beach for over a year and I’m glad I found this local church - truly genuine people preaching the word of God. I missed church a lot.  I missed every chance I had when I use to go to church. But yet the devil put a stop Our children have gone to Highlands Christian Academy for 10 years. Because of the school, we became familiar with Grace Baptist church (of which the school is a ministry and outreach). The Pastor puts strong, practical, biblical teaching and leadership in everything they do. If you are looking for a church or school to partner with in your Christian walk, I recommend checking them out. The renovations are absolutely wonderful- AMAZING kids group! They offer alot of services to people, I personally went on a Wednesday night for Grief Share- this is a national group- the woman that volunteer to run it are so amazing and supportive!!

name: Grace Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: I just want to say thank you Grace Church for your outreach to the community for  winning souls for Christ. Thank you Pastor Todd being true to your word. One day if I ever make it to San Bernardino I will be visiting Grace church for sure. Growing faith community with friendly, welcoming people and atmosphere. Bible-centered teaching and good time of worship. Good place to worship. Family friendly atmosphere for spiritual worshipping and healing Wonderful place where people really care for each other!!! Family atmosphere nice loving people

name: Grace Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has a food bank to distribute to people every week. It is very nice of them,  but they have a priority to certain people. Therefore, they give first choices by first distributing food to only Mexican people on the Saturday.  Whatever is left, they will distribute on the next day (Sunday) to every one who wants.
If you are not Mexican, and shown up on the Saturday, they will yelled out loud "NO FOOD", and ask you to leave even though you can see Mexican people taking/carrying food to their cars in the parking lot.
I don't believe that the church has a GOOD practice of big discrimination in front of JESUS.  I went online, I see the logan, "GRACE CHURCH exists to bring JESUS to ESCONDIDO".
To me, it should be changed to ".....to bring JESUS to MEXICAN" based on what they are unfairly doing.
If I could I would rate no STAR because there should be no discrimination in any churches.  They are bad examples for people, and young kids who initially steps to the faith of believing in JESUS.

The church has a food bank program to share with every one. Most of voluntary people working in the food bank are very nice. Unfortunately, there are same families which have 2 volunteers ( either husband and wife / mother and daughter) so they take twice free foods they wanted to full loading in 2 cars for themselves, no sharing to community.

Below was my experience when I was there on a day in April 2026 to participate it. I came in at 9:20 AM. I left my rolling cart in line and went back in my car to sleep because the food bank would not open until 12PM. There was no one behind me at the time I left my cart there. I was the 4th one in line. I came out my car around 11:25AM to get ready  once the food bank opened. I saw a tall lady standing behind my rolling cart.

Around past noon, when the food bank opened, there was a voluntary lady whose name "Eve" (pronounced as EEVEE) came out. The tall lady who stood next and behind my cart told EVE that I was not here earlier, but only my cart. Eve immediately told me to step out of the line without asking me to verify what lady just said. It was unfair that EVE treated me as I was invisible, and did not respect me who is 66 and older than her a lot.

Therefore, EVE let the lady cut in, and came in first. I spoke up. I insisted telling Eve that I left my cart in line at 9:20 AM, and went back to sleep in my car. Eve smartly (in opposite way) told me that, " I was not here because she came here at 9:00AM."

I said, "You were here at 9:00 AM but you had been inside the whole time so you did not see anything to believe whatever that tall lady said, and you did not let me have my voice. Again, I got here around 9:20AM how could you see me here at 9:00AM?"

That was all, I did not say anything bad at all, but EVE told me AT ONCE that if I continued talking she would prohibit me to come inside the food bank  today and FOREVER."

She repeated again loudly that she wouldn't let me to come to the church forever if I did not stop talking to her. She made me so EMBARRASS with other people who were waiting in line at that time. She treated me as I was a committed crime person in the church that she caught.

I wondered that what did I do wrong, but telling her the correct story. Furthermore, THE GRACE CHURCH IS THE JESUS' HOUSE for any one who believes in JESUS to come praying/socializing. It is NOT her own place/house, and she is not one of pastors either to disallow me coming to the church. On whose behalf, Eve had a right to tell me that she could disallow me to come to the church when I have believed in JESUS, and  not done anything wrong. EVE even mentioned me that she is the church member.

EVE made me waiting forever until 12:45 to let me come inside the food bank.  From the 4th one in line, I was the 34th one to come inside. That was how discriminate EVE did to show her power as a church member there to  me.

Thanks for reading my post. First time there I went to see my daughter sing with the pastor's group. It was beautiful and felt the holy Spirit. The next time I went was for my grandbaby and grandson's dedication and it was beautiful. Really nice people and they have events for kids. This church calls the police on the homeless. Some churches are not driven by the principal of the very book they are supposed to be following. I would not recommend this for worship. This church is a well balanced church. The pastors have a heart after God and truly love the people. They are authentic, and practice what they preach. Lots of prayer warriors in this church pulling for revival. Family oriented. Emotionally and spiritually healthy church. We’ve been prospering in every area of our life since we started attending. Great find!

name: Grace Church - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Church is a wonderful example of true biblical teaching and fellowship. Pastor Roger’s sermons are intelligent, instructive and thought provoking. He leads us every week in growing our faith and becoming closer to God. I have been going there for over 7 years after a lifetime of looking for a church that truly taught from the Bible and was welcoming. Grace Church has refined for me what it is to be a true Christian. Very solid, Christ-focused church.  I have been attending since 2019, and me and my family are much more joyful and better servants of God for it.

My brother, also a pastor, recommended this church to me, and it has been a great blessing.  The pastor of this church is an exemplary person, as I can attest to from years of listening to his sermons, attending small groups, and having periodically asked his opinion or advice.  They say there's 'no frills,' and they're sincere about that, so don't expect validation for your sin.  Instead, this pastor and church have helped me see my sin and chase it away.  There is always more work to do as far as sanctification is concerned, but I feel like I am a much stronger Christian and a more joyful person for attending Grace. The leadership at this church is compromised. My family and I attended Grace Church of the Bay Area for over 8 years, were members and regular attendees. We made the difficult decision to leave because of repeated concerns with this church’s leadership.

We experienced a pattern of poor accountability, questionable decisions, and a lack of transparency when concerns were presented. These actions undermined our trust and created an environment we no longer felt was healthy, for us or other serious  Christian believer to be apart of.

In our view and firsthand experience, the leadership culture failed to demonstrate the humility and integrity that should be expected, and that ultimately made it impossible for us to remain.

Don’t trust the glowing Yelp reviews. The negative reviews get slowly removed by well crafted complaints and arguments of TOS violations by the Church and buried by Yelp. Another example of deceptive and manipulative tactics. It’s unfortunate that I find myself writing this but I feel convicted to share and caution others to the state of this church.

This is a church I’d have once given a good review for its commitment to preaching from and expositing God’s word - in fact, I thought I did so. I started attending as a new Christian about 7 years ago, becoming a member soon after. I left in April this year.

Though the word may be preached, there are serious flaws prospective congregants should know about. In my time there, the largest board of elders consisted of 2 men, including the pastor. This is admittedly a challenge for small churches, but sadly I saw how a prolonged period of too few elders can play out practically. In essence, there’s a concentration of power and a lack of checks. Accountability of leadship is, to me, the most glaring concern. I’ll leave it at that in an effort to caution prospective congregants/members but also not get my review deleted.

The remaining church body is in my regular prayers, but it’s no longer a church I can recommend. It is heartbreaking to have to write this, but I am doing so in hopes that the truth will be exposed. My husband and I attended GCBA for less than a year before we ended our membership and left.

In terms of polity, we found there to be little to no checks and balances within leadership. The pastor held all authority with one other elder and two deacons. Though we no longer attend, and to the best of my knowledge, it is worth noting that all these positions were recently vacated and the pastor is now the only one leading this church.

In terms of personal experience, we found there to be several issues including:

- Gossip about other congregants
- Inappropriate and needless communication/conversations
- Intrusion into our personal life and our families’ lives

We lovingly confronted the pastor and his wife but were met with excuses and gaslighting.

Instead of taking my word for it, I’d rather encourage you to understand that according to the Bible, this church and pastor are objectively disqualified without any anecdotal evidence. Ask your questions and see for yourself.

I pray the truth will be exposed for the glory of God, and also for the pastor’s repentance.

name: Grace Church - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking to grow and have fellowship I recommend this church. These group of believers were and are some of the most welcoming people I've met. You need prayer and they are there. I loved that they always point you to have a relationship with God and to read His word yourself.
If you are looking for groups, this place has amazing classes every Sunday and midweek ! I know these growth groups helped me in my worst. God knows when you are needing him most and I'm glad he heard me and sent me here. This church exemplifies what the early church was and is meant to be.
God sure is here and working through them. We need fellowship with other believers and you'll find that here. Approachable staff and pastors. Childcare for your children is amazing as well.
Thank you Grace for all you did for me and my family! God bless you all! Great service here at Grace Church for my Aunty Gail. 😇🙏🏼🙏🏼 I’ve been attending Grace for nearly four years, and from the very first moment I walked through the doors, I felt an overwhelming sense of warmth and welcome. Whether it’s the entrance doors,  lobby, the sanctuary, or upstairs, I’ve always been greeted with open arms. Grace has truly become a place of community for me, and through it, I’ve grown so much closer to God. I’ve met countless people who have now become like family to me. The worship services and the messages are consistently uplifting and impactful, reminding me of the God I serve. I’m so grateful to be a part of this church! Having recently returned to Tracy, we felt a strong desire to reconnect with our Christian faith.  From the moment we arrived at Grace Church, we were met with a warm and heartfelt welcome.  The kindness of the congregation, the inviting atmosphere of the worship space, and the overall sense of community immediately made us feel at home.  On our first visit, Pastor Chris delivered a powerful message that deeply resonated with us.  From that day forward, we knew that Grace Church was where we belonged.

It has been nearly two years since we made the decision to join Grace Church, and that choice has strengthened our faith even more.  As a testament to our commitment, we chose to be baptized last week, publicly affirming our dedication to Grace and our pride in being part of this community.

We are deeply grateful for the entire staff, the Elders, and the Pastors who have fostered an environment at Grace Church that is welcoming and free from any sense of coercion or exclusivity.  Their leadership ensures that the church remains a place of genuine faith, community, and spiritual growth, rather than one that imposes undue pressure.

We are especially grateful for Pastor Chris.  His sermons are truly remarkable, as he delivers the Message in a way that is both clear and deeply relevant to our daily lives.  His guidance and teachings have been, and continue to be, a significant reason why we are proud members and for that, we are forever THANKFUL, Grace! Grace Church is a welcoming place from the moment you pull into the parking lot. Greeters at the front doors and ushers inside make you feel like you belong.

The worship band typically opens with 2–3 songs, and you feel the Holy Spirit moving right away. Pastor Chris Lovelace brings the Word with energy and realness. He connects scripture to everyday life in a way that sticks with you.

You leave feeling encouraged and ready to take on the week.

Families are covered too. There’s child care for babies, ministry for K–5, and a Youth Group that meets Sundays and Tuesdays.

COVID reminded us that church isn’t about buildings- but the sense of community here makes all the difference.

Worth checking out.

Much Love,
Marvin & Michelle Toruno

name: Grace Church - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: Great church! Grace Church - Tuscaloosa was my church when I lived in Tuscaloosa, AL. The church's leadership is clear about their vision, and expectations for church members. Leaders and members at this church are respectful to people of all backgrounds. I met great friends and elders here, who helped me grow in my faith while having fun! I'd recommend Grace Church - Tuscaloosa to anyone!!!!! I love this church family. Grace Church encourages growth and service for all ages. The staff is great and our children's ministry is amazing.  100% recommend to people trying fo find a church home. I recently graduated from the University of Alabama and this is the church I was PROUD to call my home during my five years of school. This church is INCLUSIVE and LOVING and prioritising Christ's perspective over their own. I truly could not recommend Grace Church more for anyone seeking a church home that follows the two greatest commandments and cultivates biblical kindness in all their members. I've only been gone two months and I already miss them every single week. My faith home for eighteen years now. Connected community, Strong biblical teaching. A place where believers  of varied political and theological leanings come together to worship the one God and Savior.  And we are intergenerational too! Been here a long time, 10 plus years. People are happy here. Pastor Ben gives an honest, introspective message that is always Bible based and emphasizes that we all fall short. It so easy to point at others, but I've never seen it happen at Grace.

name: Grace Church At Town Center - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family has been attending this church for over a year and we really enjoy it and look forward to attending each week! Pastor David is on point and very down to earth! The music and singing is beautiful!
Our daughter loves the youth group and our son loves the kids club! We have been made to feel very welcome and we now consider Grace Church our home Church! Pastor David Black is amazing. Young, down to Earth and cares about each member. His sermons are incredible and informative. Sermons are always presented in understandable verbage. His wife is a valuable addition too. If you're looking for a Church, where you will feel welcome and included. Not sure who those two people are that wrote the negative reviews but I have been to this church before and have heard the pastor preach.  He is a humble man of God  who has an incredible gift of teaching the Word.  The people there are warm and welcoming. No weird vibe at all, as far as I'm concerned. Although this is not my home church, I would highly recommend this church for the teaching, worship, and great community! I'm so baffled by "Andrea Lopez"... I wonder if she is talking about another Grace church, there are a lot of them? Anyway I cannot say enough about the DEPTH of teaching. I also hear more references to other authors as well as "quotes" with author reference on actual slide notes, giving people credit.I love how the history is explained of the time period and context of scripture. I have grown so much in my knowledge and understanding of scripture here at this church. If you love expository teaching this is for you.  I just wish people who have something negative to say about a church and an amazing man of God, would choose to spend more time encouraging those in ministry instead of tearing them down. Maybe...  before you "bash" a man of God you know nothing about , maybe you should meet him and not just make judgments from a live stream . We have an amazing family of people who love God and others. A sweet fellowship of believers with an emphasis of embracing the international community.
Pastor David Black is an awesome pastor with great insights into God's Word and one-liners that  I  believe will be famous quotes one day in line with C.S. Lewis. Highly recommend.

name: Grace Church at Willow Valley - Main Campus
Grace Church Elk Grove - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Truly sound biblical teaching and genuine loving and friendly people.  Grace Church is an amazing place to fellowship, worship, and grow.  Great for families young and old regardless of background.  If you want to feel truly welcomed and at home then this is definitely a wonderful church for you. I love this church and it's people they are so friendly and kind and welcomed me with open arm.
The pastor helped my son in his time of need without even knowing him. He was great offering kindness and hope and guidance. My son gave his heart to the Lord that day. This is a great church!  Biblical teaching (new pastor), great worship led by youth pastor/associate pastor, very friendly and welcoming people.  Located next to Mel Dogs across from Panda Express plaza off waterman road (East Elk Grove). Loving, caring fellowship.  Dedicated to Biblical teaching. We love this Bible based Christian church. Solid biblical preaching and God centered worship.

name: Grace Church Escondido - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful Holy Spirit filled church.  There's not another church in my opinion that is more welcoming.  The truth preaching that comes from God through Pastor Rob has inspired me spiritually for over 12 years. I was invited to attend services by a really nice lady whose spirit is full of kindness and love. So I decided to go, because if you can see the light in someone, then I wanted to see where she was attending services.Just want to say this is not the kind of church you will fall asleep during service! It was like attending an old school southern church revival. From the songs being sung to the praise and the message. It was a very special uplifting service. If you’re looking for some inspirational spiritual uplifting, and healing this church will lift you up. Through the music and songs and the message. Get up out of your bed !! Sunday and go !! You’ll leave feeling invigorated and happy and full of the spirit. I attended Grace Church in San Marcos for three years until October of 2022 where Pastor Rob was executive Pastor. He and Becky have left such a positive impression on me and my husband that if we were to go back to San Diego County to live, we would be members of Grace Escondido ♥️ Rob Granger is a true man of God, and an one of the most dynamic pastors alive today preaching the Word of God. You feel the Spirit in his presence. I love this church!  They teach the power of Jesus, that Jesus defeated the devil and has NO hold on the people of the  Lord.  AMEN!

name: Grace Church Fremont - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary: Great church with friendly loving congregation. A church where the truth of God's word is preached live every week. The pastor and leadership team are very intentional about the mission of Grace Church. I am so grateful I found my new church 2 years ago. I love my new church. I really like the people here at Grace. I felt welcomed and a sence of community. The Pastors message was on point. He and his wife are friendly and for real people. The do have coffee/tea and donut holes 😋 yum. I was visiting from Sacramento. If I was living in this area I would be apart of Grace Church Fremont. 😄 I haven’t attended a Christian church since 1994 because no one really wanted to be friends with me.  So per my daughter’s request I decided to give this church a try and I am very pleased. I was looking for a new church here in Fremont,  some of my friends told me about this church, so my husband and I went to a service and we really enjoyed the service and liked the feeling we got from Pastor Josh, staff was friendly, we have been back several times and loved the services, we have found our new church. I love our Pastor Josh he is so compassionate and truthful. About everything. I found my church home!  Thank you Jesus

name: Grace Church Houston - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Grace Young Adults. Pastor Ray is not your typical pastor. He had a moment of ministration at the end of the service and told the prayer team to come up, except he got off the stage and joined the prayer team and prayed for so many people including myself.

- Intimacy with Jesus is a priority here
- I learn so much thought the teachings, well explained.
- Worship team is amazing
- Pastor Ray understands our generation without watering down the Gospel witch is rare.

Only thing BAD I would have to say is that its a massive church so you need to "find your church within a church" if that makes sense. Parking for graduation was atrocious coming in and exiting! If uts like this for church services I will never visit... Several of our guests did not witness the graduation ceremony! If your not sure where to start your journey for a relationship with Jesus, you should try this church. They are really open and welcoming from the time you walk in the door. Non-denominational and welcomes everyone. Music is contemporary and exciting. Services teach the doctrine of Jesus. Definitely enjoy worshipping here. I’m writing this with a heavy heart. My wife and I have been attending Grace Church in Southeast Houston for some time now. We’ve supported the church, given our tithes, and truly believed it was a place where everyone was welcome — a place where God’s love was shared without judgment.

Recently, my wife simply asked for a prayer request — for her wife. Instead of compassion, she was met with rudeness and rejection. The person she spoke to was extremely disrespectful and unkind because of our marriage. It was a moment that shattered something inside us.

We walked into Grace Church believing we were part of a family. We walked out feeling humiliated and heartbroken. God’s love is for everyone, no matter who they are or who they love. To be treated as less than in a place that preaches love and grace is devastating.

We’re not sharing this to attack anyone — we’re sharing it because we believe people deserve to know. Churches should be a safe place for all, especially for those seeking prayer, healing, and connection with God. No one should ever be made to feel unwelcome in His house

Our hearts are broken, but our faith remains. We still believe in a loving God who embraces all His children. We just hope this opens hearts and eyes within the church community — because love, not judgment, is what truly changes lives.

With deep sadness and hope for change,
Celeste Baldwin Please tell your people not to skip 3 lines to enter the highway at the very last minute! Put cones to prevent that!! Geez! God bless!

name: Grace Church Melbourne - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I started going to Grace in March of 2025. They welcomed us with open arms. We immediately got connected and started serving. We've become family. If you're looking for a church, give us a year. We'll change your way of things about life. We're transforming the space Coast with the radical love of Jesus! I have attended here 3 times now, with mixed reviews. I have been looking for a new church, but don't believe this one is the right fit for me.
The first time the worship music was way too loud, but the sermon was good though. Second time was perfect, the worship not too loud, and Pastor Olenski did a great job with the sermon.

However this past Sunday when we attended, it was the fullest it has been since we have gone for this particular service. Not only were there individuals that attended that were disrespectful in the service by talking, there were crying babies, and youth that were disrespectful. I usually don't have issues with children, but if they cannot sit through a service, they should be in a youth program or crying babies stepped out with. It wasnt just one or two, it was several within the area we sat. So it was difficult to concentrate on the sermon. Once again the worship and volume were also too loud.
It is probably just me, but I don't believe this is one for me. But is a very popular church for the crowd that does attend.
The pastors sermons are good and do focus on feeding the congregation. They seem to meet the spiritual needs of the ones that are members. Me and my family moved here in 2024 from Colorado. We went to Red Rocks church and loved it, so we were looking for something that gave us that same, “welcome home” feeling. Grace church not only made it welcome, it also gave me and my family a chance to encounter our Heavenly Father.

I’ll admit the first time we went, we didn’t really talk to anyone. But we kept going, and soon enough we got involved and the Lord changed our hearts through it! :)

There’s different connection groups you can join, I’ve been involved with sisterhood, a mom’s group, and the worship team! Each has taught me more about my relationship with the Lord. So thankful I took advantage of those opportunities! 🥰

I grew up non-denominational and have always had a personal relationship with Jesus, but had strayed away from him with a life of going to the clubs and getting into trouble! After having an encounter with Jesus, and trusting his good plan for me I rededicated my life to Him!

Let this year be the year you go to church and find a relationship with Jesus. If there’s something you don’t like, PRAY about it and listen. He will answer. Grace Church has been home for us for almost 13 years. If you’re looking for a church home that loves God, becomes family, loves your babies like their own, and has their heads on straight, this is it! We’ve seen Grace Church through many seasons and would not have stayed this long if the things above weren’t true. Aaron and Nicole lead SO well with integrity and hearts after God and His will. They are genuine and loving, and are living out God’s calling on their lives with excellence! The staff and volunteers are amazing and the culture is so healthy. We’re so blessed to have Grace Church in our lives! If I were reviewing this church based on its amazingly designed building, it would be 5 stars no doubt! If i were reviewing this church based on its worship team, again 5 stars.. The reason i must give this church only 2 stars is because the church was established for the “sick in spirit”, the prodigals, the lost, the mother with infants and small children. A church more focused on how they “appear” rather than the direct biblical teachings of our Christ.

Ive attended the church for a few months. As i work on the road my wife will go at times without me cuz im gone. The many services that i attended were mere watered down messages that seemed to hang in the balance between them “feel good” messages and solid word. Now this is not an attack on the people at all. Every single person we ever met was great! The pastors, great! But if im looking for a church home im looking for a church that follows the teachings of the bible. The bible doesnt mention a single thing about tithe being money but i felt that Grace pushed this almost obligation/necessity to give money. There are so many ways members of a church can be of service that doesnt involve money. But thats neither here nor there. I pray that GOD puts this message on the hearts of the pastors so they know this is not an attack merely my person opinions. Much love and GOD BLESS

name: Grace Church Miami - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Church has been my home for the past four years, and I’m incredibly grateful for this gospel-centered community. The preaching is expository, faithfully unpacking God’s Word each week, always pointing to Christ. The elders lead and serve with humility, shepherding the flock with love and care.

Beyond the preaching, the people of this church have made a lasting impact on my life. My wife and I have met some of our closest friends here, and we have truly become part of one big family—united by one thing that is everything: Christ, our only hope. Through this solid, gospel-centered, biblical church, I have grown tremendously in my faith—something I attribute not only to the teaching but also to the relationships, accountability, and love within the body.

Grace Church is a faithful witness in a city that desperately needs more churches like this—rooted in Scripture, committed to sound doctrine, and passionate about making disciples. If you’re looking for a Christ-centered community that will challenge, encourage, and equip you, I highly recommend this church. For those who want to drop in and see what Grace Church Miami is about, there is one service every Sunday. It starts at 10:30 AM, and attendees hang around the worship center to chat afterward! Then, we get lunch together at a nearby restaurant 🍽️

It’s easy to park in the lot on the southeast corner of NE 4th Ave and NE 96th St! We’ve been attending Grace Church for a little over six months and are so grateful to have found it. The teaching is biblically sound, the worship is deeply Christ-centered, and there’s a sincere, prayerful atmosphere throughout each service. Our child is well cared for in the children’s ministry, which gives us peace as we worship and grow in the Word. It’s clear that everything done here is rooted in a love for Jesus and a desire to honor Him. Awesome people, facilities and leadership. Most important, was that the teaching and worship were in line with biblical foundation and not concepts invented by modern man. iustus ex fide vivit.  Wow , what an awesome church, what an awesome expository preaching . My wife and I had been praying for such a church as this , and the Lord has provided . Beautiful people , anointed expository preaching, beautiful temple . This is an amazing building , multicultural. This pastor is preaching with unction . May the Lord continue to richly bless and keep His people .
If you come here, just as we did , you’ll love it and you will search no more . This is it🙏🏽

name: Grace Church Monterey Bay - Monterey Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a solid Bible teaching church, Grace Church Monterey Bay is it! The preaching each week is gospel centered, the worship and singing is beautiful with biblical truths, and the church community is so loving. It is a very family friendly church if you have children, and it’s so refreshing to see people from multi-generations worshipping together. Highly recommend this church! After Covid19 hit, we were desperate to find a good church who still met in person and who preached the Bible in a deep and meaningful way. We visited a few other churches but did not find what we were looking for. A friend mentioned Grace Church in Seaside. The first time we set foot in Grace Church, both my husband and I felt immediately at home. The folks were very welcoming, people of all ages,  lots of kids and the atmosphere was casual and very joyful. The sermon was totally bible based, convicting, yet so full of grace! We thought this might just be a first impression,  too good to be true. We came back the next Sunday and never left. Our only regret is that we didn't find Grace Church any sooner! If you are looking for a friendly, solid bible preaching church family, check it out! Incredible Bible teaching and family friendly church. You’ll encounter people from many different walks of life, which is what drew us in. The community we’ve found at GCMB has been life changing and we are so, so grateful for the body of believers who love on our family so well. If you’re looking to grow in your walk with Jesus and find community- this is the church for you. I'm so happy to have found this church. I wasn't feeling satisfied at my previous church and decided it was time for a change. I put in "non-denominational church near me" into Google Maps and here I am! If you believe in Jesus, I would recommend this church. If you are curious about God and are trying to figure out the truth, I would still recommend. We stand up and say a mission statement, the hymns are Biblical and sound beautiful with the whole church singing praises to God, and the sermons are hearty and truthful to the Bible. Also, there are other studies and activities aside from Sunday morning service. So far, I think this is a church that does a good job at magnifying our Lord Jesus Christ (Father, son and Holy Spirit). My family and I have attended GCMB for more than a year and we have been blessed by the love this church shows to all. GCMB holds the highest regard for exegetical verse-by-verse preaching of the Scriptures and Christ exalting worship. This church is unified around a single charge which is exemplified in its mission statement: We Exist To Glorify God by MAGNIFYING the Lord Jesus Christ, MINISTERING to His church, and MULTIPLYING His disciples. The church also has a wonderful children’s ministry and a number of individual discipleship opportunities. We highly recommend this church to all who seek to glorify God in an atmosphere of unity and love for one another.

name: Grace Church New Braunfels - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome!! Family, non judgmental, come as you are. Great pastor and ministers... The very best. God's presence is definitely here!! A great place to worship and be with friends. It's new Friendly people

name: Grace Church of Alameda - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary: As a member of this church, I really love and appreciate our community and gospel centered values. Great young church and full of life, sharing, and love.

name: Grace Church of Arvada - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary: This church saved my life. While I sometimes cringe at Rick Long's condemnation of other religions, I do believe this church's heart is in the right place. It is very mission-driven, meaning it's not just about teaching the bible, it's about living the example of Jesus. My child is growing as a Christian, I am no longer gripped by bad habits developed to mask trauma and I met the love of my life at this church. Highly recommend - say hi if you see me there! Celebrate Recovery is every Wednesday at 630. I love this place and I love the people even more. You will be welcomed and you will find a home here. I really enjoy going here. It’s so down to earth and I feel so accepted here and refreshed when I leave. The minister always has the right thing to say that I need to hear and I always feel like I got my spiritual food for the day and I’m excited  About being a part of this community! I’m bringing my family now too! : One of the best women's Bible study I've been to.  I'm new but they've made me feel right at home. Been my church for 2+ years. Big, but friendly. LOTS of small groups available. Worship music is contemporary and the band is great - but they don't make it a "rock concert" either. Pastor Rick is great, as have been the guest pastors.

name: Grace Church of Durham
reviewSummary:
5-Star Review for Grace Church Durham

I had the absolute pleasure of visiting Grace Church Durham for their RE-VIVE-ALL service on Wednesday, August 27, 2025, featuring guest speaker Pastor John Hannah. As someone who previously had the honor of volunteering in the VIP section at Bishop T.D. Jakes’ Leadership event in Charlotte some years ago, where I helped usher in Pastor Hannah to his section, it was truly a blessing to experience his ministry live.

From the moment I arrived, I was warmly greeted by the team, and I appreciated the presence of security at the entrance. In today’s world, that kind of attention to safety sends a powerful and reassuring message.

I had a special request that evening, as I was attending with an individual with autism, and I can’t thank the staff enough for their kindness and accommodation. One lady in particular stood out, I believe her name was Shameka. Please forgive me if I spelled the name wrong or got the name wrong. As a whole, the staff handled everything with care and compassion.

The energy in the room was electric and the spirit of God was present throughout the night. The choir was on fire, and the song selections were absolutely perfect—setting the tone for a powerful, spirit-filled message from Pastor Hannah.

A huge thank you to Pastor Dr. Kedrick Lowery for his leadership and vision in bringing such a timely word to the house. The spiritual warriors truly needed it—and we received it!

Grace Church Durham, thank you for creating such a welcoming, anointed space. I’ll definitely be back! It was very inviting super friendly members. The Pastor brought the word that a baby could understand it. The worship 🙌 experience you could feel the presents of the Lord it was very high.. No judgment at all very welcoming. ❤️ This just may be my new church home. I've only been twice, but I really enjoy the message and the atmosphere.  Everyone is very welcoming, and the Pastor knows his members and their names! That's something VERY important to me. Great teaching and preaching.  Sincere.  New remodel of entire church.  At least two festivals for the children every year and a five star dinner during Christmas and Thanksgiving to treat the poverty stricken with respect and dignity.  I've been to their "He Spoke So I Would Have Something To Say" worship service during Holy Week: awesome! Truly the Word of the Living God is there! I was dealing with a spirtual warfare and everytime I stepped foot on those Holy grounds the Word of God was just for me 😁 The Word is good and TRUE! It's a teaching church you never leave there the same way you come in. It's the Word of God that you remember throughout the day week month year it goes with you it's Not the type of sermon that is only good while it's being preached and forgotten once you leave the church! It goes and stays with you! Everyone makes you feel welcome it's definitely a church that is made with you in mind! The Pastor is Awesome he knows how to preach you don't have to worry about falling asleep while he's preaching because he keeps your attention...and this is coming from someone that will fall asleep at a drop of a dime...What else can I say I love love love Grace Church of Durham! I thank God for bringing me here!

name: Grace Church of Glendora - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
⚾️⚽️ Grace has a great sports program for kids. We’ve participated in baseball and soccer and it’s been a great experience. It’s not a huge commitment like other youth leagues I hear of in the area. The fees are reasonable and the program is well ran. My husband and I had been searching for the right church for quite some time. After nearly four years of visiting different congregations, we finally found what we were looking for. We've been attending for just a month, and already it feels like home.

Pastor Kevin is phenomenal. His messages are powerful, engaging, and easy to follow. He brings scripture to life in a way that’s both clear and meaningful, helping you truly understand God’s Word and how to apply it to everyday life.

The church community is diverse and welcoming, with people of all ages and backgrounds. There's no pressure—just genuine warmth, fellowship, and a shared love for Christ.

We're so thankful to have found this church, and we’re excited for what’s to come. I am raising my 7 grand kids alone.  It's me and the kids.  Two gentleman from Grace Church showed up at my doorstep here in North Pomona last month on or before November 20, 2023 and gave me and the kids a 15 lb Turkey and a box of fixings.  This included Potatoes, Gravy, Biscuits, Cranberry, Stuffing's, Etc.  We where elated by this, so grateful that they would do this for us. I just can't express my thanks, especially on Thanksgiving.  The hand of God is on all of this, Jesus is our Lord and Savior and nothing could every come between this for us.  I've been raising these kids for the past two years during which on 11-19-21 we had a house fire caused by an electrical short in where it destroyed my house that, me and my wife and kids lived in since 1975.  In the interim I took the kids and lived in motels until I was able to rent a house.  I rebuilt my house via my homeowners insurance, the process took a little over a year before we where able to move back. We just move in our newly rebuilt house January 2023.  God was with us the whole time, I prayed and gave it to the Lord everyday and am so thank for...   What Grace Church had done for us was a blessing from the get-go.  We enjoyed a great thanksgiving feast for our entire family! Thank You Grace Church and your entire Staff and all the Volunteers, donors that had made this possible... God Bless and Thank You So Very Much. "IN GOD WE TRUST" AND IN THE NAME OF JESUS' WE PRAY, AMEN...
Sincerely,
Terry Cotterman The church is welcoming and clear about their Mission and vision for the church. The pastors and staff are dedicated to Jesus and they genuinely go to great lengths to provide ample opportunities for members to join small groups, volunteer, and be active members. They have a traditional and contemporary service and their youth ministry is enormous and engaging. You will feel at home calling Grace Church of Glendora your church. 🏈⚽️ Great girls flag football and boys flag football program as well as soccer. If you are looking for a home church, you need to check this one out. It is great!

name: Grace Church of Napa Valley - Napa Campus
reviewSummary: We visited for the first time & felt warmly welcomed. The worship, missionaries testimonies & the guest Pastor’s message were Biblical & encouraging. I was very happy that my husband enjoyed his visit as well. Great services plus very friendly people. This church is definitely an authentic that preaches the Lord above all else! My late Grandma had gone here for many years and so I have been here when visiting over the years. I have many memories here! They gave her many opportunities to serve and she did so for over 50 years.  It's an outstanding church away from home. The messages will be ones you need to hear! The pastor spoke at my grandma’s memorial and did what she asked him to do for her in her last wishes, for the service to point right to Christ and go out on all guns firing to preach His greatness! The children’s ministries is top-noch! I and my family have attended Grace Church for years and believe following Jesus and teaching God’s Word is the foundation of this fellowship where anyone who wants to grow in their relationship with God can come and be fed.  Children’s church is also excellent.  Veritas Christian Academy Middle School meets there and is connected with First Christian where Pre-School thru Elementary School meets.  Great Community outreach. Was able to visit this church last Sunday. Came for a friend's wedding. They share the truth in love & fearlessly. Loved meeting the people here. So kind and welcoming. The pastor of this church knows how to deliver a eulogy and keep the atmosphere light. To me it was a time where we laughed more than we cried and instead of doing all the quintessential nonsense of a usual funeral he ran it his way and celebrated the life of our brother.

name: Grace Church of Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I began attending this church in 2020. After almost 2 years of looking for a home church what I found at Grace was this... Biblical preaching and a body of believers who loved Jesus and loved one another. I became a member shortly after attending my first time and have been a member for 6 years. God is with us and in this place. The Holy Spirit is among us and that is displayed by the powerful biblical reformed preaching that occurs on Sundays and in the incredible care and love demonstrated by our elders and our amazing head Pastor Mike Sciarra. Join us!!! This is the church you need I would not recommend this Church to anyone.  As said many times, long time members are not welcoming to new members.  The church leaders did not use safe practice during the pandemic which is very sad, and who knows how many elderly and young children became ill.  Some members were very rude to me because I was Jewish who had an open heart to many religions.  I thank Jesus for leading me to a loving church and Temple.  Grace Church leaders, don’t get defensive and do better. The best Church I've ever attended. Christ centered, gospel proclaiming, disciple making, sacrificially serving Jesus community!! You won't find a better church! If it wasn't for this place...I would have left this communist hell hole called California years ago. The love I have for the people at this church is the only reason I'm here This church has been a blessing for my family and myself! A Bible teaching church, with a congregation that loves God to their core.  If you are looking for growth founded on the word of God, this is the place to be

name: Grace Church of Rancho Cucamonga - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Been attending Grace for over a year now & my experience here has been like no other church I've been to! My first day here I was introduced to the head pastor, and immediately got plugged into young adults. Since then Grace has became a second home me & I have so many people who pour into me & who have helped me grow in my walk with the Lord! Highly recommend if you're looking for a place to not only have Christ centered community but to also be taught the word of God expository style. Absolutely love it here! Solid gospel centered church that preaches the bible, verse by verse. The saints have been well equipped by the shepherds and it is obvious! New believers who desire to grow and learn will be cared for by a loving congregation and more seasoned believers will be refreshed meeting with like-minded people. I love this church! Our family has been attending for over 6 months now. Everyone is very friendly and introduces themselves. If you are looking for a church that goes through the Bible verse by verse - this is it! This church is multigenerational with lots of kids and families and great childcare options up until kindergarten. I must say it’s welcoming if you want to do it their way. Never understand churches when they first meet you want to tell you how things are supposed to be. Like I’m a clueless follower. One of a small number that do this on your first time. It's a small congregation at am service and the same amount for the evening service. The songs they song during service are hymns and they're so beautiful. The junior pastors welcome as you come in before the services but it didn't have a homey feel. no on in the congregation said hi or welcome. I'll go back to both services again maybe that was just an off day for people. the service was very good and the pastor taught from th bible not from personal stories.

name: Grace Church Offices - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Jeff is 100% honest with his congregation about them and himself (extremely refreshing).  The people are friendly and the atmosphere is very laid back.  Awesome worship band! A group came here in West Virginia at our Bible camp to help they are wonderful Christian people.. Thank you for everything you all do ..The Gospel lighthouse church in sundial West Virginia Bless you all When i first came to the campus, the people were warm and friendly.  That has never changed!  If you want to be around a group of people looking to build you up, Look to call this place home! Great church. Stopped here for a marriage group based on relational needs.  It has helped or marriage and other relationships. Didn't make me feel comfortable... most people were standoffish

name: Grace Church Orlando
reviewSummary: Vibrant downtown Orlando congregation praised for authentic biblical exposition, multi-ethnic fellowship, and deep city-focused hospitality.

name: Grace Church Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: Grace has been my church home since 2019. I  attended Grace when it was a 20 minute drive and now a 45 minute drive. The diversity and love for community is what keeps me coming back. My husband and I met here while serving in their youth and young adults program. Now, my extended family also attends Grace and we can personally share how great it is for each generation. Praise God!! This is one of the best and anointing church in plano.  Excellence is one of their values.  Love the staff and pastor Gerald is unique. I’m no longer a Christian but as a child my mom took me and my siblings here and I remember it being the most welcoming, positive, uplifting churches I’ve ever been to. Grace has provided me some incredible childhood memories when I was a kid and I’m forever grateful. No words can describe how perfect this place is in every single way. I got luck, Gerald Brooks delivered the message thia morning.  Nice church and volunteers.  Can't wait until the Wednesday night service and options to volunteer. Just started attending not long ago after moving to the area. Everyone has been super welcoming and friendly. Feels like I’ve been attending for years already. The youth services, and how its not just babysitting, is the best I’ve seen. They love the kids and are passionate about growing them with Christ and educating them. Love it!

name: Grace Church San Diego - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Came here to visit for Easter Sunday as first time visit. I have been God serving for over 18 years now but I do have some feedback for the church staff. As a first comer I was not greeted at all when coming in. Rather I was stared at while walking in by a big group of members of the church. The pastors message was great. I decided to give the coffee a try and quickly experienced the same thing. I received another stare from a middle aged blonde lady working in the coffee shop. It was a very unfriendly stare and none of the church members spoke to me. It felt like a very unfriendly and “clique”ish atmosphere. If I was not a Christian I would never come back to church if this was my first time experience. One man greeted me on my way out but I say this out of love please the staff needs to do better. But the pastor message was great. Easter Sunday is an open door for people who don’t know God unbiased with no judgement for anyone to walk in and feel loved and we did not get that loving vibe. Coffee is not enough. There needs to be love. I recommend building and training a strong welcome team who goes the extra mile to greet people As military transitioning into the area, we tried attending this church for our first Sunday service in San Diego. First off parking is a nightmare. There are signs but there is no one from the dream team directing traffic. As a result we were very confused and couldn’t find parking for 10 minutes.
On top of that when we went to Grace Kids to check in our baby one of the volunteers working the kiosk left completely to help someone else and as a result we did not figure out how to check in our kids or where to take them so we ended up carrying our 5 month old to service. When we walked through the door we were not greeted with not even so much as a fake smile. When we walked into the main sanctuary we were just told to go to the balcony in an unfriendly manner where you can barely see the pastor and by the time we did that worship music was already done. Maybe this church is a good church for some people as they had many in attendance but we will not be back because we were not welcomed or helped at all. We ended up leaving 5 minutes into service to go somewhere else. The start of the message was very confusing and there was no back fill for first time guests. Everything about this church seems off balance and there is not a standard set on anything. If the church’s dream team cannot provide an easy, friendly, and welcoming experience it would give the perception that the church staff doesn’t care about how things are run. Not friendly and not welcoming and not considerate of first time guests. While visiting San Diego, we attended a Sunday service at this local church near our hotel. The streets were packed with cars, and we were worried about finding a spot for our rental, but luckily, they had a designated visitor parking area. We stopped by the welcome booth, where a friendly couple gave us a brief overview of the church and answered our questions with a smile. They even gave us coupons for free coffee! After the service, we enjoyed a delicious coffee (worth over $5) at the on-site cafe right next to the church. I have visited Grace 3 or 4 times.  Its a rather large church. It appears to have mostly young families and singles. I am not in that age group, but it is a very loving and friendly church. The preaching is scripturally accurate, loving and encoupppraging.  There seems to be something for everyone.  I will return! Parking is a bit of a challenge. I’ve been attending Grace Church for almost three years after moving here from Hermosa Beach. We were looking for a Spirit-led church that openly teaches the Trinity and the Holy Spirit, and Grace does that. The people are welcoming and it’s easy to build real friendships, and there are many ways to serve. The pastors are relatable, approachable, and easy to talk to, you can always find them after service. It’s not a huge church, but they offer multiple services with childcare. Their podcast (Deeper than Sunday) is also a great way to go deeper after the message. My husband especially loves the church’s heart for missions and sending people out to serve and teach. Like any group of imperfect people, everyone here is truly trying to love one another and build God’s kingdom together!
