name: Grace Church Tampa Palms - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I are so grateful to be a family of Grace, the fruits of the spirit is very evident at Grace ,especially love .We adore  this church ,may God continue to bless, strengthen and guide the leadership and all members of Grace. Thank you for your love               . Roderick and Elsie Shirley Grace Church has a warm and welcoming feeling.  From the moment you step through the doors, you can feel the love not only for the Lord but between the congregation.  It is a family.  When the service is through, you feel as though you have been spiritually awakened.  Our spiritual leader, Father Ben, as he is lovingly called, speaks from the heart during his sermons.  If you love music, then come listen to our choir at the 10:00 AM service.  You'll be amazed what this neighborhood church has to offer. It's filled with an atmosphere of faith; the music and sounds are wonderful. What a great place to worship.  My daughter loves it.  Their youth Sunday (last Sunday of the month) is fabulous; the children lead the church and even have a Youth Band.  Many Episcopal churches are stuffy; this one is not at all and has something for everyone.  Best kept secret in the area.  I hope to see others try it; I think they will be quite pleased. What I love about this church is that the pastor is a true man of God willing to speak the truth even if it is not what sounds good in man's ears.  How refreshing to have boldness in the pulpit, beautiful music from the choir (and the youth on youth Sunday) and a community of believers from many different backgrounds.  Solo deo Gloria!

name: Grace Church, Bath Campus (Ghent Location) - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Jeff’s account of his relative coming to finally accept Christ as his savior was amazing and moving.  It began a 2 day Bible search of questions with my 9 yr old granddaughter. That experience with her was amazing.
Thank you for sharing your deepest feelings with us. When I’m in the bath, ohio area I attend this church Pastor Jeff is a very down-to-earth. Pastor. children’s church is amazing. My boys have been to this church multiple times including vacation Bible studys and camps, festivals and more this church has a lot to offer I have been thinking about writing this review now for awhile but I wanted to find the right words first. I feel this needs to be said.
I want to start with that I have a close relationship with God and go about my life with Christian morals. I bring God into every conversation by planting that seed and hoping for the best. I love God❤️ I am a proud Christian woman💜🙏🏻💖
I have been raised in a religious family my entire life and I am thankful for that. I am blessed that my family's church in Arizona is welcoming, constantly growing, peaceful, no cliques, fun, learning and very much God involved. Absolutely blessed🙏🏻 I have been searching for a church close to it here in the area.
I have been attending here for over a year, I unfortunately do not feel welcome. I wouldn't have kept coming for a year if it wasn't for my boyfriend at the time. He and I are no longer together. Now that it is just I, I will not be attending here anymore as I feel uncomfortable here. There are definitely cliques here and I tried getting into the volleyball group and the lead lady was not pleasant, I've also tried getting into other groups, no help there, but my main concern is, at my family's church, all my life, I volunteered and helped in the children's ministry. I was also an Assistant Teacher and I'm currently a nanny. I love kids and I'm really good with them. I have expressed this to Grace and that I would like to volunteer in the children's ministry. I have reached out by email, phone and in-person several times. And nothing. Nobody has reached out to me. I have filled out their card in-person a couple of different times. And still nothing. Not only is it rude but this is not what Jesus would do. Jesus has a special love for children, as do I and I feel incredibly sad that nobody has reached back out to me to help out. I have tried and tried again. To the point where I am now uncomfortable here and will no longer be attending. I do hope this church does better with good genuine people wanting to help in the works of God and wanting to get involved. Because you will lose people. Our church in Arizona is a Megachurch and they still find a way to make sure everyone is connected and has been reached out to. I'll pray for this church's staff to have their eyes, minds and hearts open. Because I am truly sad that I have been ignored. From Sunday worship, to hiking, to Thursday (soon changing) Collective young adult ministries, I have never felt more welcomed by a church. I’ve gone to church my entire life and have explored other nondenom churches and was missing the community that Grace Church has to offer! The church play production team is truly outstanding. Many would easily compare their level of excellence and professionalism to that of Hollywood.

name: Grace Church, Bath Campus (Montrose Location) - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice place to hang out with like minded individuals. Went there for a LAN tournament for Forge gaming. Had a ton of fun. Religion is welcome but wasn't shoved down my throat and any time. Everyone was kind and welcoming, including some great opponents. I absolutely love this church. They make it so easy to understand the bible and use normal life issues most people go threw as examples to what the bible is saying. They joke and laugh while preaching. You can wear whatever you want. The children's church is so great people have there kids not wanting to leave church. Grace is my saving Grace. I really love your Church!!! Every time I walk through your doors everyone is so kind! Your Church and everything in it is so beautiful. I feel so welcome! I know God will continue to bless you all. Please continue the great work.
Sincerely, Deborah Shumway I liked the setup in the sanctuary. They have options of chairs next to tables and sitting areas with couches, cushy chairs and coffee tables. It's used as a gym during the week for their great sports ministry. My family love the people and message at this church and their other campus just down the street.  Each location offers a little different feel to their praise music with the same great message from their pastor.

name: Grace Church, Portland
reviewSummary: Welcoming community that knows how to minister to those whose lives are in transition.  This fellowship meets in a 150 year old castle like church with contemporary worship and erudite pastor who is keyed to the challenges faced by current day influences.  Meets at 10:30 am Sunday and offers SHARE a ministry to those who have experienced spiritual abuse. Went last Sunday for the first time! Very enjoyable & friendly people! Hope to go back when I’m in town, from Olympia. Moved here in late Jan., 2017 and searched for a Christ centered, bible teaching Church. Attended and felt welcomed and people were not pushy, which was appreciated. Pastor Ken is an excellent teacher with a big heart for the people he is sheparding, and for Portland.  Greatly appreciate the Praise music which is a nice mix of well known hymns and newer Christian songs. Very thankful to have been led to Grace Bible Church for the fellowship and friendships made with fellow believers in our Lord Jesus. I have been a part of this church off and on since 2005, and Pastor Ken Delivers the Lord's message right from the heart. I feel like I learn something about the Bible and Jesus Christ when I leave there, and can apply it to my daily life. Praise God!!! Feels like home. Not like, "This feels like back home." But rather, "This feels like a place to establish AS home."

name: Grace City Church
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a three-hour production with smoke machines and guilt trips, keep driving. This place is refreshingly down-to-earth. The sermons are punchy, the worship band actually knows their chords, and the community is busy trying to be decent humans rather than judging your outfit. I went to a Bible study and people were actually cracking jokes. Imagine that. Plus, the commute is easy, which is the ultimate blessing. Was in the greater Boston area on Easter Sunday and landed at Grace City Church's 9am service at the Temple Ohabei Shalom in Brookline. 🤔 It was a wonderful service. Great worship. Solid and Biblically rooted teaching - both intellectually & existentially - from the pulpit.
The proof though, was the number of cheeks in seats. The lower bowl of the synagogue was what I like to call "church full". Lots of young folks - singles and couples alike, young families, and a few folks in the 40+ category.
Keep up the work, GCC team. It's worth it. Grace City is an absolutely amazing church. Sunday gatherings are a highlight of the week—from the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with warmth and genuine friendliness. The people here make you feel right at home instantly.

The music is exceptional. The band features incredibly talented artists, and each week brings fresh arrangements and creative mashups of some of the best worship songs. The rotation of vocalists and musicians keeps things dynamic, yet the quality is consistently outstanding.

The sermons are relevant, practical, and deeply rooted in Scripture. Every message feels thoughtful, meaningful, and truly applicable to daily life.

What stands out even more is how much Grace City does for the community. The church offers numerous outreach opportunities throughout Boston—from supporting those experiencing homelessness to helping at a daycare serving refugee families. If there’s a need, this church steps up with compassion and a willingness to serve.

The children’s ministry is also fantastic. The volunteers are engaging, fun, and incredibly caring. Kids are excited to be there each week, and the teachers intentionally create a safe, joyful environment where children feel known and loved.

Grace City is filled with people who use their gifts to serve in meaningful ways, and it elevates the entire experience of being part of this community. For anyone seeking a welcoming, Christ-centered church with excellent worship, strong teaching, and a heart for the city, you need to check out Grace City Church. Grace City has been our home for about 4 years now. We came in not knowing anyone and felt so welcome from the start. Everyone was so warm and remembered my daughter’s name.

The worship music is amazing and I always feel the Holy Spirit in the space! The children’s programming has expanded and my kids love it there. They even set up a meal train for us when we had our second child.

Come to Grace City if you want to experience real community and feel the presence of God! So I want to be completely honest with my review but also not come to bash the church completely. I just hope this helps people who are looking for a church home and a place to belong with In the body of Christ.

So the preaching and worship are 10/10 amazing! Pastor Brian is a guy who knows the word and loves the Lord and I appreciate his heart.

The BIG downfalls for me are just the overall atmosphere and community. If you come with friends and have a community of people you come with its a wonderful church but if you come unsure, or anxious or feeling lonely this is not necessarily the best fit for you. People come off as very cold and after attending for a month or so my husband and I really hoped that feeling would go away. We really wanted to be all in there and just didnt ever feel we belonged. You can EASILY walk in and out the door and never feel like you belong or are wanted. I served as a greeter one sunday and that just further solidifies my feelings of this. I wanted so hard for my family to fit in a it just didnt happen. And if your a adult out of college, newly Wed or young family this unfortunately may not be the church for you. I truly hate to write this but want to be fully transparent with my review in hopes this can help people find a church that would suit there needs.

name: Grace City Church - Albany Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this Church. Everyone is so welcoming and kind! I volunteer for the Youth on Wednesdays and in kids on Sundays. It helped not just me grow, but the kids as well! Not to mention the services are great! Often times I feel like the pastor is talking to me. It’s like he knows what I have been thinking lol. It has really helped me find community and grow spiritually. I now call this church my home. I didn't know that the pastor and his wife preached here. I went with my best friend Jon rice and I'm glad I did. It was the best service I went to in a very long time. I didn't fall asleep one time. The preached the message and then brought it home with no cut. Grace City Church has truly been such a blessing in my life. I have been coming here since I was in middle school, and now at 23 I can honestly say it has played such a huge role in shaping my faith and who I am today. The services have consistently encouraged and challenged me, and the community is so genuine and welcoming. Getting involved in small groups and serving has helped me grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships, and find real purpose. There is just something so special about this place, and it is truly my home away from home 😊 Grace City has truly been life-changing for me. From the moment I became a part of this church, my relationship with God has grown deeper and more personal in ways I didn’t even expect. The teaching is powerful, relevant, and always points me back to truth, helping me not just hear the Word but actually live it out daily.

What has impacted me just as much is the opportunity to serve. Being part of the Sunday team and investing in the youth has been such a blessing. Serving hasn’t just been something I do—it’s become part of who I am. It’s helped me grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships, and see God work through me to impact others.

There’s something special about this church community. It’s genuine, welcoming, and full of people who truly love God and love others. I’ve found encouragement, purpose, and a place where I feel like I belong.

I’m so grateful to be part of Grace City. It’s more than a church to me—it’s family. The best church with the best pastors!!! Grace City has been my church for 15 years. It’s my home away from home! Not only are Sundays amazing, they have youth on Wednesdays, small groups, serve days, and encounter nights regularly. I highly recommend joining a small group and volunteering to get make new friends and get involved!

name: Grace City Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Had a great experience at this church when visiting the city. Welcoming, friendly, God-loving people. Biblically sound worship with just the right blend of reverence and come-as-you-are. Grace filled and gospel centered message. I’d come back for sure. Grace City Church is a place where the glory of God is felt in every service, bringing peace, hope, and transformation to all who enter. Through powerful worship, inspiring messages, and a strong sense of community, the church helps people grow in their faith. Whether you're seeking spiritual renewal or a welcoming place to connect, Grace City Church offers a space filled with God’s presence. With a heart for serving others and sharing His love, this church is a true home for believers. Wonderful church sharing the Gospel of Jesus Christ. The people here love God, love Denver, and love each other. I've been attending for over three years since moving to CO from NY and this church has become my family. If you're new to Denver, come check out this church and get connected. This is a place for everyone to come and feel welcomed. I had a very nice visit on sunday at the church during my recent travel to the city.

Everyone I spoke with was friendly but not overbearing.

The message was biblically sound and very practical.

This is a church focused on making a positive impact in the community.

If I lived in or around downtown Denver I would definitely consider making this my home Church. We finally found our community. Our people who understand that we too, are just humans who make mistakes and try to learn from them. We serve a God of GRACE and LOVE who will meet us where we’re at and remind us of the power of the cross. So grateful for this church where family and chaotic lives have been welcomed by people who are simply trying to find peace and serve our Creator… just like us.♥️

name: Grace City Church - Irvine (Woodbridge) Campus
reviewSummary:
Solid Church with relevant and practical teaching based on Bible, serving the community around it.
This is one of the legit and well balanced Christian churches in this area. They meet at Jeffrey Trail Middle School with a plan to acquire a building and move to a more permanent location near the Great Park in the near future. The Pastor's teaching is well grounded in the Bible and brings practical life applications. Members are mature Christians and are genuine. Ethnic make up of the congregation seems 60% Caucasians, 30% Asians, and 10% Others. I can recommend this church to anyone in this area looking for a rock solid, legitimate church that you can call a community church. I will post photos later. Absolutely love this church! From the moment we stepped on-site, people were so friendly, inviting, and welcoming. They live up to their name of creating an atmosphere of grace and life. We’ve easily gotten plugged in and serving on a team and love now getting to be a part of creating the same experience for guests. The teaching goes deep into the Bible and we feel like we leave each Sunday with a better understanding of God’s word and that Carrie’s throughout the week in our small groups. If you’re looking for a church that’s genuine, authentic, and relatable with an inviting and welcoming atmosphere, then this is the place where you belong! I have been recently attending Grace City Church, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of amazing. Pastor Stephen Kimbrell truly brings the Bible to life with his engaging and kind teaching style. He is incredibly approachable, making it easy to ask questions and delve deeper into the faith.

From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed. The community is warm and inviting, as if we were already friends. name: Grace City Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I am truly grateful God has provided me a place to grow in my love and understanding of Christ. Expository preaching and bible study. Filled with authentic people I can lean on and learn from. Church came first and was spread before a all 73 books were made canon! Am I articulating correctly?

You get to go to heaven if you are in a state of grace.

name: Grace City Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going to Grace City Church for a while now and it’s honestly become a place I look forward to every week. From the moment you walk in people are welcoming without being overwhelming. It feels genuine and comfortable.

The messages are really relatable and easy to apply to real life, which I appreciate. It is not just surface level. You actually leave thinking about things differently and wanting to grow. Worship is powerful but still feels real and grounded.

What stands out the most to me is the sense of community. It does not feel cliquey or exclusive. Whether you have been going for years or it is your first time you feel like you belong.

I am really grateful I found this church and the people here. Wow I loved my experience at Grace City!! I brought my 4 year old nephew and it was his first time being to the kids program and they were so welcoming to him!! He loved the kids worship and the crafts he got to make!!! I felt so comfortable leaving him with the teachers they were truly some of the best I’ve encountered! I’ve been going to this church for now 7 years. It has changed my life as a young adult. The community here has made me feel at home & supported. Every young adult that I have invited has loved it as well which speaks volumes for our age! From every single ministry, every volunteer pours their heart out being the hands & feet of Jesus. 10/10 would recommend if you are seeking for a home church 🕊️ Grace City is my church! From the moment I came in, I was welcomed and pleased by the community and foundation that is built there.

I can’t wait to continue my walk of faith at this church! To be in community with my church family and spread the gospel!

Pastor Mayra and Pastor Mario are so inspiring and their sermons are very impactful and life changing. Being transformed everyday!
Thank you Grace City! I love Grace City!! I love the culture, the vision the community! The worship and the word is amazing every single week. If you are looking for an amazing church family this is the place!! Your kids will enjoy it just as much or even more than you.

name: Grace City LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace City LA offers vibrant worship, heartfelt community, and practical teachings. It’s a welcoming church focused on authentic faith and real-life impact. Highly recommended! I visited Grace City LA and it was a blessing. Pastor Steve Cha is a faithful preacher of Gods Word. The worship service focuses on exalting and glorifying God based on Truth. If you are looking for a church that is faithful to worshipping God in accordance to His Word, then this is a great church. Grace City also strongly focuses on evangelism in Sharing the Gospel. It was a blessing hearing about their evangelism to the community. If you are looking to get plugged into a new and growing church and are seeking solid scripture-based teaching, I HIGHLY recommend that you check out Grace City LA. I've been a regular attendee of Grace City LA's weekly bible studies for the past three months, and it still surprises me to see how much I've learned and grown as a believer in this short period of time. There's a clarity and boldness in the presentation of the Gospel here that I've never really experienced elsewhere, and it makes a marked difference. It's truly remarkable.

Also, since Grace City LA is a new church, there's plenty of room for you to get involved and serve the growing ministry. Everyone is incredibly welcoming and down-to-earth, and their excitement and enthusiasm for the new ministry is really contagious and refreshing to see.

Lastly, the church is located at the western edge of downtown LA, which has recently been undergoing a lot of development and change, so I see a huge opportunity for Grace City LA to really make an impact on the immediate community--both the long-time residents and the newly arriving folks. There's a big passion on the part of the leadership team for local outreach and evangelism, so I'm really excited to see the transformation that Grace City LA will bring in the future. If you want to know the truth of God's Word, this is the place to be.  The pastor, Steve Cha is an excellent expositor of the Bible.  You will grow in your relationship with the Lord and be a brighter light for Christ.  The church loves evangelism!  I really enjoyed the service and the donuts!  If you live in the downtown area of Los Angeles, then Grace City LA is for you! I heard a wonderful message from Pastor Steve who was kind and very patient with my questions. I appreciate biblical and expository preaching, and thought it was amazing that Grace City LA does street evangelism open-air preaching as a church after each service. They are committed to the Great Commission of proclaiming the GOSPEL to the lost. I felt joy from Holy Spirit during worship so praise God for this new church!

name: Grace City Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace City Tampa is the real deal. If you’re looking for a church that’s firmly rooted in Scripture, this is it. Every message is biblically sound, and you can tell the leaders carry a deep honor and reverence for God’s Word. The culture here is incredibly welcoming—genuine, caring, and full of people who actually live out what they believe. The worship? Next level. Easily the best band I’ve ever heard, and it’s not about performance; it’s all about glorifying God. And I love how invested this church is in serving the community beyond its walls. So thankful to call this place home. Grace City is the best Church in Tampa. Great message the pastor puts his heart and soul into. Passionate worship and service. Welcoming entrance and friendly atmosphere. Plenty of teams to join, and baptisms on the regular. Best coffee so far in Tampa great single origin from Colombia to die for.
To everyone try Colombia single origin and the guys are absolutely fantastic Great young thriving church. We visited here when we were over from the UK this weekend and felt very welcomed as a family. Modern worship, great Bible based talk from the lead pastor, thoughtful kids church and a great venue. Would definitely recommend and attend again if we are in town. My first and last visit to GraceCity Tampa was on Mother's Day when my adult daughter, husband and myself visited. We have been in ministry ourselves for 26 years, and were away from home. While the word was good, the people were cold and indifferent to us as visitors. Not even one person spoke to us, welcomed us, or so much as said hello. I post this hoping that you will look into your hearts and ask yourselves if that is how you think Christ would treat visitors.

name: Grace Commons Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been visiting Brave Church in Westminster now for three Sundays in a row . The church is near by , the music is great but we especially love the sermons by pastor Jeff . The people are friendly and the greeters are very friendly too . Don’t take our word for it , We recommend people visit the church for themselves . This church GETS IT! The leadership promotes women in ministry. Their children’s program is incredible and their music department provides so many opportunities. They have a robust network of young families, a thriving population of people of every age and exciting opportunities to engage WITH SUPPORT! Expect everything you love about church at service and grow in God with people who genuinely care and take the time to get to know you and your family. Understanding, loving, inclusive and accepting they LIVE GODS word of love. This church has the word worth the drive! The older woman leading the line of cars at the Tuesday food distribution is very unempathetic and arrogant. I have no complaints about the other people because they're all very friendly. She always seems angry about giving out food boxes to people in need. I hope she changes her attitude. Helping comes from the heart, not with arrogance. First Pres is a wonderful church for youth ministry and beyond.  The directors and volunteers leaders are so dedicated to our young people.  They've been so instrumental in walking with my kids through tough times in middle and high school.  They really know how to demonstrate Jesus' love for your kids.

The contemporary worship service is so welcoming.  No pretenses, no frills, no pomp and circumstance.  Just come as you are and be filled.  Love this place! First Pres has been a mainstay of conservative, yet welcoming, compassionate Christ-centered faith in Boulder for more than 140 years. For those of us who live in the Boulder area, this church provides more than just a building and worship services - it is the people and community that enables significant support and engagement with the University, Boulder Public Schools, our county's homeless, tremendous youth programs, and those seeking support and caring across any demographic lines. No church is perfect, just like the people in it, but First Pres seeks to bring the knowledge and love of Jesus Christ to each other, to Boulder and to the World. Anyone is welcome to be a part of both the Sunday worship services as well as the hundreds of groups and services and events going on in the church and in the community each week. Check it out!

name: Grace Community Church
reviewSummary:
We’ve been attending Grace Community Church for about a year now, coming every Sunday as a family, and it’s truly become our church home. Our kids attend the Sunday children’s program and absolutely love it — it’s clear a lot of care goes into making it engaging and meaningful for them.

What stands out most is the preaching team. There are multiple pastors, and they work together in sync beautifully — one week a pastor will teach on a certain topic, and the following week another pastor picks up right where it left off and continues the series. It creates such a rich, connected teaching experience. Across all of them, the Bible is taught boldly and without apology, always grounded in Scripture and explained in a way that genuinely resonates, especially for those of us seeking to follow Jesus Christ as our personal Savior.

If you’re looking for a church home where your family can grow spiritually and your kids will love going every week, we highly recommend Grace Community Church in Fulton, MD. I enjoy everything about this church. The only downfall is its huge. Definitely don't know anybody that I didn't already know prior to going to this church. Its hard to meet people unless you join a community group. We aren't currently interested in joining a community group. Hello, Church. I love coming here, but I must say that the music volume is way too loud, as well as the microphone of some of the speakers. I have been using ear plugs for the past 6-7 months and the volume is still the same. Hope you can work on this. Best! I am thrilled to share my experience with this amazing multicultural church! It's an ideal place for families seeking a strong Bible-based foundation for their spiritual journey. The warm and welcoming atmosphere fosters a sense of belonging, making it incredibly easy to connect with the diverse and wonderful people who attend. The commitment to embracing different cultures creates a rich tapestry of perspectives and experiences. Whether you're a seasoned believer or new to the faith, this church offers something for everyone. The dedication to fostering connections and a shared love for God is truly inspiring. I've found a second family here and feel grateful for the opportunity to grow spiritually while forming lasting friendships. If you're looking for a place where faith, community, and diversity intersect beautifully, this multicultural church is the perfect fit. Excellent community and friendly church.  Plenty of Covid precautions in place and the children enjoyed their services as well.  The music was fantastic and the pastor spoke a very heartfelt, timely message.  Super convicting and eye-opening topic today.  I left feeling encouraged and empowered.

name: Grace Community Church - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary: Great church and good no frills sermons. always visit this church when I am in US Texas. friendly environment and felt the presence of God. This 'church' has some issues. For example, the pastor stated his sermons are not intended for non-believers.  Scripture states “It is not those who are healthy who need a physician, but those who are sick.' It is concerning that a 'pastor' does not want to lead the lost to Christ. This place also dismisses divorced people. A member that was cheated on by their spouse was ostracized by this place. You are looked down if you are divorced. I love my church , very lovely congregation .  Come visit us we will love to see you ♥️ Behold, the lamb of God. Tanks away our sin, takes away our sin. The robes were washed and made white as snow, full of sacrifice and submission. Globally efficient church with unique and wise board of elders. Beyond gifted church. A royal diadem indeed. We love our church, the community and family we have found here. Our pastor leads with wisdom and humility and is not afraid to preach Biblically on the hard topics. There are so many wonderful ministries for all ages and interests, yet you will find deep connection with a close group when you join a Life Group.

name: Grace Community Church - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly and welcoming church. Great Bible teaching and worship. Wow... All I can say is that my wife and I visited from out of town, and we were highly impressed with all of this congregation.

The outside, the building design and layout is gorgeous and the chapel looks great!
But, the inside is the important thing, and cosmetics were just as good there, but what matters most is the teaching, preaching, and hearts.

I was immediately confronted with good mornings and friendly smiling faces. The pastor, Scott, immediately came up to my wife and I upon noticing us and introduced himself to us and we had a warm greeting, and he gave us a free book he wrote!

If we ever come back, we will attend this church again. Hebrews 10 was preached expositionally, and Christ was honored and glorified by His people!

If you live in this area, please go to this church! It is biblically sound, and your soul needs this!! A true blessing each time we go! The church I had been going to in Bellevue closed (and relocated with a totally new mission and focus.) I needed to begin looking for a Christ-centered church with followers of Him. I found that here along with the most welcoming people from day one. Such amazing music, teaching of the Word, and ways to immediately get plugged in. Love it here already. We visited from NC and love this church. Great community and God centered service by a reverent congregation. The children's ministry was wonderful and the option of sunday School discipleship classes at 9:30 was a huge plus!

name: Grace Community Church - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Community is incredible across the board!! I’ve been attending for a little over two years and have only positive things to say.

Firstly, hands down the most welcoming church I’ve experienced. That’s the first thing anyone notices at a church and Grace will make you feel at home right away.

The pastors are outstanding. Their sermons are relatable and powerful. My husband and I have met with a couple of their pastors in private and we are so grateful for the Godly counsel and encouragement they shared with us. Truly anointed pastors at Grace.

Also hugely important, the worship is incredible! They mix it up with different worship leaders and have a church choir that sings every so often. The songs are consistent enough for you to learn them (if you don’t already know them from the radio) and they add a new one in every now and then.

Highly recommend! Also, they have three services and online sermons available so they are very accessible. Small groups are great too! The congregation is extremely friendly. The pastors are all awesome. Great fellowship. Friendly welcoming people. Lots to do to get involved or just come and enjoy the music and Bible teaching from 3different pastors who trade off weekly on the same subjects or books of the Bible. I love our church with home studies and lots of ways to connect. This is my favorite place to worship. You can really feel God's presence here. Kind people, and amazing Pastors. Great youth programs, perfect for families. Such a wonderful place to find friends alike and worship the Lord! It's not about the pastor, it's not about showboating, it's all about Jesus! Such an easy church to be apart of to love others and Jesus.

name: Grace Community Church - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary: My favorite church. They treat you like family. Worship at Grace Community always honors God and lifts up His people. Nothing but the word contained in the Bible is preached and taught. Come worship with us and connect with a great group of people who love God and love each other! My family and I really enjoyed our 2 visits at Grace Community Church. The people are so friendly and extremely accommodating. My two grandkids really enjoy going there. I called the pastor of the church to get some information about baptizing both of them, and I was very happy with his answers on the subject. We do want to join this church. Pastor Jess Cole is GOD'S man. Had my husband's service there last week. It was the BEST service I have ever been to. Sweet, caring, full of GOD, personal and peaceful. Jess I love you and Jackie. Thank you for giving me the BLESSINGS for a lifetime. A great experience. This pastor can take an ordinary Sunday and make it one of the most meaningful days of your life based on the teachings of Jesus.

name: Grace Community Church - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Great for the whole family - little ones to teens.  Worship is great, pastor sermos are real and relavent if you want to see the love of christ in all its glory you will find it here Knowledgeable bible centered teaching.  Great worship. I absolutely love and respect this church Love this church.

name: Grace Community Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
I loved Grace Community church so much on my first visit that I just keep coming back. I instantly felt welcomed and I love that the Word isn't just preached there but lived out in the community. Pastor Ben is a pastor in the truest sense of the word and is a humble teacher of the Bible and the ways of Jesus. I am so thankful for my church family. Pastors Ben & Crystal have walked with our family through multiple difficulties in such a caring and loving way looking to Jesus to guide them. People are able to walk with others in this fashion are able to do so because they, too, reply on the strength and wisdom of the Lord. This church and its leaders not only share the Word of God, they live it. I’m grateful to be a part of this church family. Grace Community Church is a fantastic church for anyone. My family and I have found our new home church after moving to Texas. We had been searching for a new home church for over a year. We've tried large and small churches all over the area and never felt that welcome or at home. After the first visit at Grace Community Church, my wife and I were trying to keep from getting ahead of ourselves, but we were so excited. We really felt like we found our new home church.

The church leadership are all solid, strong, accountable leaders of the faith that take "being held above reproach" to heart. We are thankful for their wise counsel and Biblical guidance on a weekly basis.

The volunteer staff is amazing too! From the first visit, we always felt welcome from the friendly greeters meeting us at the door to those inside at all stations greeting us with a smile and a hug. Even the non-staff, non-volunteer church members are friendly and welcoming.

There is no doubt in my mind that Grace Community Church has a heart of the Lord's people. The lost, sick, and hurting may find rest here.

Emma, I don't know what you experienced, but it certainly was not this church. At the time of this review, Grace doesn't hold church services on Saturday. My guess is you were delivering flowers to a funeral and encountered some grieving family. I know that if you came to visit Grace Community Church on a Sunday morning, you would experience the same as I have. I know for a fact you would be greeted and welcomed with kind, loving smiles and a handshake or hug. Please come experience the same church I know and love. Love our Grace Family!!!! Such a blessing! I had the pleasure of visiting Grace Community Church in Southlake and was completely overwhelmed by God's presence. It happened to be fathers day. The word and worship were good and my kids has an awesome time in the Children's ministry. I will definitely visit again and recommend this church to people in the area that maybe looking for a great church to attend.

name: Grace Community Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: I decided to go to this church and see if they are a good church. The church senior pastor walks up to me didn't look he was at all happy that I was there, started asking me all kinds of personal information about myself, I told him I did not feel welcome he did not care then as I was leaving began to gossip and talk bad about me behind my back. i have been looking for a good church for a while. I will not return to this one at all. Been there several times, enjoyed the service, l highly recommend that the local community would attend the services and invite your family and friends. We could use your support 😉 This church is for 3 different races, hispanics, vietnamese, and americans. Its a good church with loving people. I go to meetings there. It's great! Clean, well kept facility , and support group friendly

name: Grace Community Church - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recommend Grace Community Church for those who are seeking a church family devoted to nurturing disciples who live from the Truth of the Gospel, crossing ethnic and economic lines.

My family and I have been coming here since January 2021. The Lord lead us here for a number of reasons: We needed a teaching church who challenged us to grow in the full gifts of the Spirit. We wanted a thriving and active youth group who called our sons to a greater relationship with Jesus. We sought a place to worship God while serve others from all walks of life. And so much more…

Come check it out! We’d love to meet you! Very lovely community! All the people threat you with a lot of love, all the staff ready to help you at any time! Penny has been harrassing my mother, and the church is doing nothing to stop it. They claim they are here to help people but allow members to harrass others.

A shame
Been volunteering off and on since 2011 and my disabled mother volunteered way longer and they allow this. Told my mom she needs to stop going for her safety. I told her to switch churches to one who respects her, not one that enables discrimination and hate. Grace is the best place to worship in Greensboro everyone is nice and you have freedom to worship God in the way that is best for you, I have nothing negative to say about Grace I love this church Blessed rare time outing for Resurrection Sunday Service with Ladies on the Move of Greensboro, NC! ✨
The children skit was great.
The praise team/choir/and musicians (can not forget about the band) provided awesome adorations in song, whew they could sing!
The preached/taught Word "An Unexpected Resurrection" was excellent.
The leadership and congregation were so welcoming. My spirit was truly feed 🙌

name: Grace Community Church - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
I live in San Diego and I’m housesitting for my son and daughter-in-law who recently relocated here. I thought it would be a good idea to find a church nearby that we could attend when we come out to visit.  I looked up the service times online and I decided to go to the second service that starts at 11:15.  When I walked in a man opened the door for me and said good morning and then I walked by a information booth and someone was talking to the guy behind the booth and I went into the sanctuary and sat down.  I was seated in the fifth row on left, on the isle. No one sat close to me. In hindsight maybe I should have gone in to the church a little later and sat next to someone.   Not one person acknowledged me.  It was so strange.  There were people talking everywhere around me and I felt as though I was invisible.  Most churches that I have gone to have a minute to “say hello to someone around you” that did not happen here. I guess they think they know everyone.  Or that it wastes the service time by extending it 10 minutes or so.  The singing was ok- I don’t really consider their songs my style of worship at all.   As I was listening to them all I could think was that it could be so much better.  I wanted to ask the worship leader if he had ever listened to K love or the message on Xm radio. Or if he had ever gone to a really big church and experienced that kind of worship that he could bring to that church. I liked the Pastor and I thought his message was good. But I will not be going back. I love this church they do not water down scriptures and the elders are wise in all of there decision making. The youth group is wonderful and the community is great no clicks you will make friends very quickly in the youth group 10/10 recommending! This is a great church. No church is perfect due to sinful people, however, GCC is always seeking to line up as biblically as possible and live out their faith as instructed in the Bible and demonstrated through Christ's love for the church. They do not blindly follow modern Church or early church tradition for traditions sake. Neither do they follow the worlds pragmatic ways when it comes to the condition of the human heart and mind. They shepherd the flock and reach out to the Lost through the preaching of the Word, corporate worship, regular involvement with one another through community groups and service, local missions, training pastors by joining The Expositors Seminary, supporting missionaries in the field, exhorting and encouraging one another, and serving each other. Not recommended for Sunday Christians or those who want a watered-down gospel designed to stroke their ego or make them feel good. My family and I had to evacuate Florida during the last hurricane. It was a pretty scary experience. This church just wrapped their arms around us and really made us feel like we were with family. It was such a blessing to be around all of these people. It is a wonderful church and if were to ever move to the area it would be the church we would want to be members of. Cannot recommend highly enough!!!! I’m an atheist with ADHD. Here are my thoughts on a reformed Baptist (I think) church in rural Alabama called GraceCommunity Church I visited today.

It was a nice place with a heavy focus on substance compared to the Pentecostal church I saw last week which focused on inducing spiritual experiences above all else.

The music was minimalistic and a bit bland, but lyrically thought provoking, and the leaders interrupted the worship for several prayers and short speeches each with a specific focus on a broad concept like “prayer of thanksgiving” or “prayer of personal reflection”. The guest preacher picked apart a full chapter of Psalms and didn’t shy away from anything difficult or interesting. To say he answered all my questions would be dishonest, but he explained things very clearly and accessibly and left me not only wanting to do more research into the passage on my own but feeling empowered to do so.

I give GraceCommunity 3.2 stars

name: Grace Community Church - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: Nice friendly place to worship .

name: Grace Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the first and only church we attended since moving across the country. Someone my wife knew from her teen years invited us to attend when we were assembling a list of churches to visit. It was at top of our list and we gladly accepted. 4 years later and here we are. This Body is so welcoming and loving and Pastor Justin preaches amazing sermons! It is so refreshing to be in a church that actually opens God’s Word and teaches straight from it too.
We have been blessed in so many ways by our brothers and sisters here! Pros:

+ Friendly, although misguided, congregation and leadership

+ Opportunities for discipleship

+ Good children's ministry

+ Rich worship music

Cons:

- Sermons are at least 50 minutes. Many people struggle to pay attention for this duration. The senior pastor has said that he himself sometimes forgets the previous Sunday’s sermon outline.

- No real diversity in views. Every man who teaches has received his education/training from the church itself, The Master's Seminary, or The Expositors Seminary.

- Calvinism is taught as a fact based on the misinterpretation of a few passages like Romans 9 and Ephesians 1, and despite heaps of scriptural evidence to the contrary (John 3:16, 1 Timothy 2:3-6, 2 Peter 3:9, etc.). Not only does this seriously impugn God’s character, but it can cause a bizarre attitude in people. They’re the “chosen ones.” I once heard someone enthusiastically say “God could have predestined me for Hell, and it would be for His glory.”

- Dispensationalism and “Left Behind” rapture theology are taught as a fact.

- Dating environment is complicated, bordering on dysfunctional. Singles and relationships must be approved by leadership.

- Overall, I think it’s fair to say that this church flirts with the BITE Model of control. Grace Community Church is a Bible-believing church. Pastor Justin does an excellent job preaching the Bible verse by verse, also known as expository preaching. My family and I recently moved to this area, and the congregants have welcomed us with open arms. We feel at home. We feel loved and are very happy and grateful to God for having led us to this community of believers. At Grace Community Church, you will find a church that is filled with a deep love and fear of God that is joyful and beautiful.
However, what truly sets Grace Community Church apart is their unwavering commitment to biblical truth. The preaching here is expository, focused solely on what the Bible teaches without relying on religiosity or man's opinion. This calls us to stay grounded in the teachings of Scripture and to continually grow in our faith.

The people at Grace Community Church are what make it truly special. The love and fear of God is evident in every aspect of the church, from how members treat one another to the hospitality that is shown to visitors. The leadership models humility and genuine care, always making themselves available and approachable.

My family and I have been at Grace Community Church for 15 years & we highly recommend Grace Community Church to anyone seeking a Christ-centered, biblical church that is dedicated to truth and love. Come and join us to grow in the word of God in a body of believers that seeks to serve and glorify Him above all. Very welcoming group of believers! Traditional/acoustic worship service. Very nice facility with good children's ministry.

Notes on first visit:

Definitely a particular perspective on the place of evangelism in the modern Christian life - message focused
more on being a "stalwart defender of the Church" than a "Fisher of men". Signs/wonders are regarded as a misinterpretation of Scripture.

Overall a great group of Christians and a great choice!

name: Grace Community Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary: This church is the perfect example of a "community" church, filled with imperfect people, working together to be better servants of God, families and the community.  This church is filled with genuine people trying to journey together.  If you want to be comfortable living in your sin, this is not your church.  They preach the uncomfortable truth throughout the week, but there is real "grace" as the name on the sign proclaims.  If you are looking for a home, where you can grow, and are willing to learn, there is plenty of opportunity here.  We look forward to welcoming you home. Our family was weary of churches compromising on the truth of God's word and not holding to the sufficiency of scripture. Grace Community is like breathing clean air after living in pollution. So so grateful for the humble leadership of this church. Here it is Christ and Christ alone. Expository teaching where truth and grace collide. We praise for the Lord for this precious church who is orchestrating its function according to scripture. My home church since 2006--and for lots of good reasons. The Word is preached with authority and without apology. There is a huge emphasis on missions, both local and global. Lot's of community outreach/engagement.  Solid, godly, sober-minded leadership. Lots of opportunities for discipleship and authentic community. Lot's of ways to plug in and serve. Something for everyone. One of the most caring body of believers I have been a part of. A truly wonderful community of believers encouraging and exhorting one another. The pastors and elders are faithful to the Word of God and shepherd the congregation very well. Come visit and you’ll see what I mean! I've attended this church my whole life(2005 to now). The people here have helped me through a lot of hard times. Jesus has opened my eyes and my heart, and I will praise him forever.  The people here are like family  to me. I am so thankful to be attending this church.

name: Grace Community Church - Office - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary: Just moved here? Need a church home? Need to talk? Grace is here! 5 campuses, two languages. You will be blessed, changed, and renewed.

name: Grace Community Church - Old Jacksonville Campus - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE THIS CHURCH fellowship! I've never heard such powerful & effective PREACHING of God's Word. Nor experienced such awesome WORSHIP leading in a service. And that's saying a lot since I've been actively involved in many churches all over the country, listening to the best preachers online, & in God's Word my whole life.

I learn so much every time! Many times, I'm left speechless afterward. The pastors Brandon & Doug evidently put so much prayer, passion, & time into studying & preparing. I was told they even meet together with the other campus pastors to discuss the sermons & make sure their theology is well-grounded in scripture & thorough. I believe they really LIVE IT OUT every day.

It's also the best worship experience I've had led by the worshippers. The worship pastor Jon picks great songs, & many that I've never heard, that are very scriptural & deep & and hand-picked to go with the sermon. And he has a real deep heart of love & worship for the Lord, it's obvious. And the way he lets others lead different songs... It all just comes together SO powerfully.

I ALSO looked into the leadership & ACCOUNTABILITY structure of this fellowship & I think it's right on 🎯 That has become very important to me after experiencing other churches where there was elitism & power trips in leadership, cover-up culture going on, & abuse was tolerated & even protected when clearly discovered. Effective accountability is a MUST built into any church fellowship structure.

There are also many options for getting involved in small groups & Bible study, fellowship, activities, youth & children groups & events. I'm meeting with good women on Fridays twice a month for a quality Bible study.

I think this place has it all. I'm 4 months in & enjoying every minute of it!! "Thank you for being faithful to God's commission & loving Him & others well, Grace Community Church!" What great lessons can be learned through the scriptures.
Brandon is awesome at delivering God's word with passion, humility, and grace.  Every time he speaks he describes how we should question what is read in the story, what is the message, and where do you see yourself or Jesus in the passages.  God bless your people that honor you word, and have faith in the things not seen, but are written for us to learn. I attended church services for the first time last week and I loved it! Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. I plan on getting more involved in the church as I get settled here in Tyler. This is our place of worship and we absolutely love our church.  They have kept safety at the absolute forefront with recent events and adapted to include streaming services, which they have had, but also allowing corporate worship.  Doug, our pastor, is amazing and the worship team is phenomenal.  Could not be happier worshipping here. As a visitor, I was just so impressed with the service! It happened to be a special event that the children were leading the music, and done beautifully. The rest of the time was to witness 4 young people who had decided to be baptized. Each baptism was accompanied by a video of the child as he explained his decision to be baptized. I was moved when I saw that each child's father baptized their child. The youth pastor officiated and I could see that he was a dedicated teacher, totally committed to the youth. What a wonderful place for a family to thrive in their Christian walk.

name: Grace Community Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor does an excellent job taking the word directly from the bible and relating it in a way that anyone can understand. His passion behind what he is preaching is palpable, and the singers are second to no other church I have been to. I really mean it when I say, it feels like the Holy Spirit is in the room throughout the service. I highly recommend this church to anyone, whether you're a seasoned church goer just interested in somewhere new or it is your first time. Whatever you do don’t standup in the back! They hate when people stand up in the back during singing time. Have been told multiple times by a Rude Elder that I need to be in a seat and not standing in the back… don’t know why that matters so much to the church but it does. I then told a higher up about what happened his name was Johnathan and he then proceeded to ask for my full name. Which was very weird. also I don’t know why he would want that but then I felt even more offended than my last encounter with someone who represents the church. You know sometimes they say don’t meet your hero's you’ll be disappointed and unfortunately that’s been my experience with elders at Grace Community. I love the pastor and the word that they preach here. Along with a beautiful church. It’s a shame I am now feeling harassed by an Elder and looked at by others. I am scared to try and talk to the Pastor in fear that his attitude will be similar. Overall I want to give this Church 5 stars it’s beautiful the word is right . But i feel the groups are more for 18-24 years olds and the elders feel very Colty and have each others backs no matter what. Just sharing my overall experience and perspective of Grace Community Church. Came for Easter 2026. You can tell a lot about a church by their worship. Jesus is in this place. Anointed worship and challenging (both inspiring and convicting) message. Huge church. Bible believing, Gospel preaching. Lots of programs. You want to meet lots of Christians and lots of people? This is the place. So far so good. I like this church. Good music, free coffee and a pastor that preaches a good message with Bible verses to back it up. When I can't make it in person, I watch online. They have Bible study fellowship classes, small groups for extra study, and of course a well run children's ministry.

name: Grace Community Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Just absolutely loved it! Everyone very Welcoming, very approachable, friendly, kind, helpful, everyone just makes you feel at home, smiles everywhere.. I will come back when I return to Riverside.. A MUST!! Met some Amazing people. No matter if I was In Hesperia, Devore, Rialto, Fontana I would make sure I would make it to church on Sunday mornings. Love my church family. Service times Sundays at 9 am and 10:45 am, childcare from infant to 6th grade. Prime time on wednesdays ftom 7 pm to 8 pm for the whole family; infant to 6th grade, jr. High & High school classes, adults. I love my church family at Grace. It is a Bible teaching church and Pastor Nathan definitely has a gift to do just that. Teach us the Bible! You will constantly be learning from God’s word here. You will be encouraged, strengthened, and empowered to open up the word for yourself. When you join Grace, you are not just being spiritually fed (which is amazing), but because of that, you are also joining a group of people who love God, love his church, and want to see others thrive faithfully in a personal relationship with Christ. Worship is also awesome. It is lead with Christ in mind, Pastor John makes sure to prioritize the word and where our minds should be when we worship (centered on Jesus). Overall, all of our Pastors have a real love for the fold of God and shepherding His sheep. There are people here serving in children’s ministry, jr high and high school ministries, the young adult ministry AND even behind the scenes who lead with great joy for our Lord Jesus and make it a core value to keep pointing you to the gospel of Jesus who gave His life to give us ours. Awesome for all ages. I went to this church today to their 10AM service. Worship was only 15 minutes, which was disappointing. It was a beautiful service although I was not allowed to have my toddler and 9 month old in the sanctuary. They initially ushered me into the “nursing mother’s room which had a big screen in there. I didn’t want to be in there, so I was forced to take my littles into their kids’ ministry. The pastor seemed very friendly and young. He extended an invitation to anyone who wanted to meet him at the end of service at the altar which was nice. In my opinion, this church is just like Harvest, but way smaller, and without the free drinks, snacks, etc. Visited this church twice with my husband and sadly this church is not very friendly or welcoming to new guests. No one talked to us or welcomed us. We made sure to arrive 15min early too to hopefully connect with someone about this church but we sat there and people walked by us, they just stayed in there little groups talking amongst each other. Disappointing.

name: Grace Community Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
What can I say? This was where my roots were established. God led me here as a young Christian to sit under their faithful solid Biblical teaching that has shaped the trajectory of my life. Tim Conway took us young people under his wing and spent hours leading us through systematic theology for several years every Tuesday night. The saints on Wednesday night taught me to pray. The fellowship every Sunday went until we dropped. I still have faithful friends who care for my soul even after being gone for eight years due to moving away. If you want to sit under the word of God unfiltered and get help on your way to heaven and you live in the San Antonio area, I cannot commend to you a better place to be. I asked to go to small groups tonight for the first time of attending the church in the pastor denied me because he didn't know who I was even though they have the small groups listed on their website just because I was telling him I didn't understand why I wouldn't be welcomed at a church gathering even at somebody's home and he kept telling me because he doesn't know me and I said then why do you have the address and information about these groups listed on your web page for everybody to find and see because they're at people's houses and even their addresses are listed online and he told me I still was not welcome to go even though it was a church gathering for everybody. And I said why are you not treating me like Christ can you set a lot of it was because of my defending my position of why I should go instead of just showing up on Sunday and then he wanted to ask me all kinds of questions about my past and where I was from instead of trying to make sure that I got to hear the word of God. I'd rather argue with me for a half an hour instead of trying to find me a ride for tonight from somebody. "What shall it profit a man if he gains the whole world and yet looses his soul?" In fact, over my time, I am pleased to inform that the solid, Scriptural teaching at Grace is as important to the teaching team as to the "wheat." I am not seeing anything but goodness here. Thank the Lord El Shaddai. This is a truly biblical church! The people there love the Lord and one another! I spent 3 years here and then left. I have had 3 or 4 years now to think about the experience. I would say go here if you are in love with Pastor Tim and the regenerational teaching he is famous for and you just want to go have some fun there. There are a lot of strong men here to learn from.

I would say if you need help dont go here. Especially if your problems are related to demonic stuff. They just are not equipped theologically or spiritually to handle anything along those lines.

There is some love here. There really is. But overall I left grieved at the head knowledge that was way out of balance compared to the amount of love here. A few people here really cared but they were not even close to enough to meet the need. I would say if you need help just find a local church where the people actually care about you with genuine love and will have your back when things are down. You will be way happier in the long run doing that. And find a church where they deal in the supernatural. Dont rip those pages out of your bible. Lookup Tb Joshua.

name: Grace Community Church - University Blvd Campus - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary: We love the praise and worship (music), and they have solid bible-based teaching. They also support multiple missionaries. There are many small groups to join so that you can get plugged into the curch quickly! Enjoyed worshipping with our college student daughter! Grace is a great church with lots of opportunities to serve the Lord! The pastor is really down to earth and I can understand the message and apply it to my life. My spirit is fed and the worship is awesome not just a couple songs and done no they bring you into the presence of Jesus. I'm excited to make this my church family. Wonderful people who love the Lord. Their nursery has kind and  patient caregivers and their children's church engages the school age kids to learn about God. Looking for a church home? God's people are here! Pick your campus OJ, UB, Hispanic  Lindale!They are all. Great.

name: Grace Community Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful church were they explain scripture and how it applies to our life. If you want to learn a out God and Jesus and how to have a personal relationship with Jesus this is a place to learn and grow. Take time to go to the book store to, many Wonderful books and Bibles. praise the Lord for your service in the teachings of the Christ brother and you have a wonderful home. thank you especially for your passing of the messages that we so need in these uncertain financial times such as the camel and the eye of the needle, storing treasures in Heaven and not on earth, the serving of the two masters and the very sad story of the traveling rich man in search of the Kingdom of Heaven which i feel may have a very personal connection to us all. God bless you all and thank you for loving each other If there was ever a time I wish I could leave a 0 star review it would be for Grace Community Church. I attended this church for three years. There wasn’t a single time over the course of those three years that I felt that my soul was cared for. They preach hell, fire, and brimstone even to children. They use fear to hold people captive so that they will become church members who will adhere to unrealistic tithing standards. They have turned the message of salvation into a business. For those who attend, I would encourage you to reconsider the systems in place here. For those considering attending, I recommend keeping yourself and your children safe from manipulation and fear-based tactics. Grace Community Church is so ausome! I have followed this ministry for probably four decades. I love a church that holds strongly to the Word of God! Baptisms on Sunday evenings are so special and encouraging. The testimonies of each canidate show the depth of the word that is so well communicated from the pulpit. Brad Klassen is so in tune and compassionate with each one he baptizes. All the ministries of GCC honor God. GTY.org has over 6M messages from Gods Word on its app.
I live in Wisconsin and think about moving to California just to attend. This is NOT a non denomination church but a 5 points Calvinists church Alas, 3/4 of the people don't even know they are.

For example the fundamental of faith (which I took) never clearly tell you that they are a 5 point Calvinism church and that is too bad.

name: Grace Community Church – Montgomery, AL - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Community Church in Montgomery, AL, offers heartfelt worship, strong biblical teaching, and a warm community focused on faith, discipleship, and loving service. Truly uplifting. Great church and excellent teaching pastor. My family and met Pastor Collins years ago at another church and was moved by his teaching methods of the Bible. I have followed him to grace community church were he has continued to not disappoint. This is a wonderful place of worship. In no way is it affiliated with heyden tom ford. Pastor Marcus Collins is the shepherd and Man of God. I encourage everyone in the Montgomery area to come and be amazed . What terrible congregation. Stopped by for our first time last week and the rev threatened and forcibly removed us from the church because my son was of mixed race. Horrible place to worship, especially after hearing about the egregious and vile reverend, Tom Ford. Stay away, you are bound to end up with a lawsuit.

name: Grace Community Church (Arlington)
reviewSummary: Warm, gospel-centered community in Arlington praised for relational preaching, excellent kids ministry check-in, vibrant hospitality café, and welcoming community groups.

name: Grace Community Church Boca - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Today, a good friend picked me up to join her at Grace Community Church for an outstanding Easter celebration service. The congregation was warm and welcoming, and the Church grounds were decorated beautifully for the most important celebration of the year!!!

Pastor Jason gave an outstanding sermon, and the music was AMAZING!!! The singer's voices were straight from God!!! I hope to be back before I move out of Boca!!!

I highly recommend a service at Grace Community Church 🤍🤍🤍 - it's totally UPLIFTING !!! Such a great Church.  Pastor Jason is committed to Boca and really cares about this community!   I have had nothing but great interactions with the staff. If you are looking for a church near you where you can feel like you fit right in then
join me here at Grace Community Church Boca Raton. A super friendly group of family oriented, Jesus followers that worship in spirit and in truth.
(Located on Camino Real about a half mile west of Dixie.)
Pastor Jason teachers straight from the Bible, relevant life-changing topics every Sunday that provide a time of focusing on what the word of God the Bible, says about His love for us and what His will for our lives is for today in these challenging times.
The contemporary worship service is amazing. You are going to love the awesome music, songs and vocals in the time of worship with our church family in the sanctuary and the time of prayer because we all need that!
There is childcare provided, coffee & donuts, of course and an adult Sunday morning Bible study that starts at nine in the El Rio room, adjacent to the sanctuary.
Hope to see you here. Come and make it your home too. When you walk into Grace, you feel apart of the family. Such a nice community - Sundays here kick off the week with such joy! I found an American family here, where every Sunday I really have the opportunity to learn more about God.

It is a joy to see how the church is concerned about integrating young people and children so that we have a future generation of worshipers and people who love God with all their hearts.

I am a volunteer and with great pleasure to be part of this church that is concerned in doing everything beautiful and organized.

It's beautiful the way we are directed to God and the concern to reach more people from the local community to actually have an encounter with God.

I am very proud of the leaders of this church.  People who serve with love, humility and affection/care for everyone.
I really see the love of God in them!
Polite and capable people who bring us closer to God every day.
Definitely I love my church, I love this Grace family that God gave me.
#ilovemychurch

And if you have a child, be sure to visit this place!  Amazing people, worship, message and Sunday school.
Lots of events dedicated to the little ones and adults too. Visit the website and check it out.

I hope you can visit this place and have a good experience like I've been having in the last 2 years

name: Grace Community Church of Fort Mill - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary: I don't know where to start.... First I wanna thank pastor Brandon for a warm welcome. His staff is amazing his members were absolutely caring and very family oriented I felt so welcome my first day their just being able to meet  people for the first time and the hugs the hand shakes the conversation left me in tears and I needed to let out because my family had a storm that we don't ever wanna see again the singing the band and prayers gotten to me at service I will recommend GRACE METHODIST.  Pastor Brandon, Members and Staff we would to attend at this church. Thank you so much.....see you soon. When I attended the funeral of my friend Dewitt. I was fuming when the preacher started degrading Dewitt by saying he was uneducated living in a dilapidated trailer while working at the recycling facility.  He deserved better than that. There was no reason to do this . Dewitt was a successful individual who worked at Celanese and retired there. He then started working for Rockhill recycling and retired from there. That is being successful…. I’m sorry but your church is one that I couldn’t attend… I am not alone in my comments  numerous People had the same comment that I had , and that what you said was indeed out a line. Dewitt didn’t deserve that from you…. This place has been home to me and my family for almost 4 years. It is a place full of love, care, grace and fellowship! If you are looking for a church close to home and you live in the Fort Mill/Tega Cay area look no further come and be a part of what God is doing in the church! The BEST church ever! Great people, great pastor, non-judgmental, welcoming. Love it! God is present in this place.

name: Grace Community Church of Saddleback Valley - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. Pastor Michael is the most knowledgeable pastor I have ever known personally. Because of their strong dedication to the bible and God they are able to overcome any challenge that is placed in front of them, whether that challenge comes from within or without. People are fallible, God is not, which is why we all need a Savior. This is what the bible teaches and this is what Grace teaches. Love God and Love People. Pastor Stephen is amazing in his worship through sermons. He provides a clear message through scripture directly to my heart each week. Grace Community Church of Saddleback Valley is a great place of love and worship. This is a place where real people are worshipping and serving a real God. Jesus Christ is our Lord and Savior and His grace and mercy are shared through this body of believers. I love this church one they had a awana’s from my boys when they were little
I was a single mom of six, and they always take care of me! Even before I joined the church. Treated me like I was already family. New upbeat Pastor.  Great music.  Wonderful 1st message. I'm going back.

name: Grace Community Church of Willow Street - Main Campus
Grace Community Church South Bay - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Community Church South Bay is a biblically grounded church with faithful, Christ-centered teaching. I really appreciate their commitment to sound doctrine, expository preaching, and creating a welcoming community focused on growing in God’s Word. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a solid Reformed church. If you are looking for a church that preaches the Bible this is the church. Every Sunday and Wednesday they preach verse by verse! I would recommend you to visit to experience this type of preaching. Great church! Great preaching. Pastor takes you thru the Scriptures and makes it easy to understand. The church is very welcoming and has a big young adults group. Everyone is very friendly. The guy that does the announcements (I think his name is Luis) is hilarious! Overall 5/5. Great expository preaching and very convicting. Glad to have a church like this in the South Bay 10/10 Church. Amazing gospel presentation. This is a new South Bay church plant started in the home of Ulises Galvez. I've attended the Bible study nearly 2 years ago and have not looked back. This pastor is studying at The Masters Seminary so I know he's learning from top tier instructors. I am proud to serve at this church because we are being powered by Christ. I highly recommend this church service on Wednesday nights and Sunday mornings.
