name: Grace Community Fellowship - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary: We had been looking for an authentic non-denominational church that emphasizes tithing, serving, and fellowship - and we found it at Grace Community Fellowship.   Their preaching is Biblically solid, their members are overwhelmingly friendly, and we made an easy decision to make GCF our church. Incredible house of God! I was new to the area and looking for a church to call home. I tried out a separate church that just didn't feel like a fit for me. This church was different, early into the very first service I attended here I knew I had found home. Everyone is incredibly (and genuinely) welcoming, they meet you right where you're at spiritually, the worship music is amazing, and it's obvious the pastor is a man who genuinely and wholeheartedly loves God. Most important though, you can actually feel the presence of God resting in this place. 10/10 recommend. So enjoy this church and group of people. Sensitive Spirit led morning praise and worship done in a clear and biblical manner. Wednesday night Lifegroups are my absolute favorite get together with small groups getting "to do life together."  I've recently have been able to watch a young family that's been attending one of the family classes in training and rearing up Godly families/children. Spectacular! Come out for a visit, meet some new folks and enjoy a cup of the BEST CUP OF COFFEE in town. GCFNB is full of friendly, loving and genuine people. The worship is top notch. The service is led by the spirit, full of bible based truth and always life applicable. The classes are something my children always look forward to . They learn truths of the Bible and enjoy the fun atmosphere with their friends. This is my church family and I love doing life with them. This is an amazing church!!! The worship is great, the atmosphere is filled with God’s presence, the teachings are biblically based & practical, and the people are genuine & welcoming!! But don’t just take my word for it…come and check it out for yourself. Services are on Sunday mornings at 10:30 AM.  Bring your family and friends…Hope to see you soon!

name: Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Im only giv8ng a 2 star because nobody talked to me at this church when I visited with a member afew times like 6 years ago. She is black I am only 8 different nationalities and not black, my son is. I did recognize how they really lift up the young black chikdren and it is absolutely the only time I've ever seen this done, mind you I am from Oakland CA was raised by a black foster family and attended an all black baptist church. This is absolutely an amazing church, and these people got it right! Heck, they really emphasize education, abd repeatedly tell their young kids they are strong and black. I did not invite my son ofcpurse, because he would have noticed the shunning. I highly value education and my son did graduate from U.C.S.D.and is blessed to have a mother like me. Unfortunately nobody seemed to notice. That's o.k. cuz Hod does. I still recommend this church if you are black, though. God bless. I feel the Spirit of the Lord GOD every time I walk into the sanctuary!  The prayer time, the worship music, the testimonies, the preached WORD, the joy, the fellowship...I could go on and on! It all is firmly based in the Bible and inspires me to run harder and faster for JESUS!! When I first visited Grace Covenant I was in desperate need of a church home. I had just given my life to Jesus but needed somewhere special to serve him. I was attending The Rock but not connected to it. I missed the closeness of a real "Church Home" and real praise & worship. I immediately felt loved and welcomed when I stepped into Grace. The genuine love of everyone drew me in but the praise & worship kept me there. I found a place to plant my feet and grow my roots. It has been 7 years I came to Grace on a Tuesday night prayer, and I now am raising my children in this Holy Ghost filled, God fearing, praise & worship lifting Church Home. This is a spirit filled church! The worship was like no other. You will definitely feel the presence of the Lord! The Word is so rich. The senior Pastor breaks down the word of God so that it is simple to understand. I like how they have other Pastors that brings the word. They all have different ways but it is all powerful! This church spreads a lot of love and are very welcoming. I came out here to go to school and I was looking for a home away from home. I found it when I came here! Not only do the people here show you so much love, they also preach the truth and you can tell that the relationships that the people have here with God are genuine. It is what inspired me to develop my own close and personal relationship with God, and the teachings that I have received here are what has brought me to this point in my relationship with God today! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this church for anyone who truly wants to feel the presence of the LORD and grow in his/her walk with Him. I give Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest 5 stars all the way.

name: Grace Covenant Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I’m rarely in town in the weekends, but wanted to walk to a church nearby my new condo. The first Google review I read said “the Holy Spirit moves in this place” so I visited here for the first time 8/18/24. Beautiful traditional church where Billy Graham grew up! Young worship team, interim pastor preaches the straight-up word of God. Friendly group of welcoming people. I arrived at 9:00 to discover you enter through the side door and meet for an hour of Sunday School. The leader, Craig, discussed the tension between God’s sovereignty and man’s free-choice. My questions and comments were taken seriously and open discussion encouraged. Prayer requests were taken and then we all went to the sanctuary for the larger service. I didn’t plan on going to Sunday school, and thought the service began at nine. God works in mysterious ways though. I’m so glad I went! Good church full of real people who love Jesus and want to get better at being a Christian and help others. Adult Sunday School starts @ 9am...don't be late! Killer class Amazing Bible based church. The spirit of God fills the whole place . Very enjoyable church Faith, Hope and Love mentoring program for kids. This program is a breathe of fresh air for anyone willing to give of themselves You feel the presence  of the Lord  when you enter!

name: Grace Covenant Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a beautiful place to worship. The praise and worship was out of this world. I attended during the international celebration and it was amazing to see how many countries are represented at this church. They were very friendly. I truly enjoyed it. I went as a visitor, but if I lived in Charlotte, I would definitely make Grace covenant my home church. It’s a great church! Worship is amazing every time; love the pastor Zach.

My daughter also loves to go to her room during church. I’ve been attending this church for 8 years now. It’s a great Bible centered church. I love that this church truly cares about its community and helps however they can. I recommend this church for many reasons but these are two big ones for me. This is a church for all people been going for over twenty years. It is so nice to have an extended church family I highly recommend it. I love coming to this church, people here are all good people and friendly, they greeted you almost all of volunteers and make you feel welcome, Sunday time mass is 9 oclock in the morning, and it’s better than elevation, all the volunteers are all welcoming and very friendly and guided you to there parking lot with big smile and wave at you, also when the mass is over and everyone living they give space to anyone to get out without beeping. A bonus too. There is a police escort to guide all the church goers to get out the Statesville road. Very organized. I highly recommended this church.

name: Grace Covenant Church - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Covenant Church has been more than a church to me—it’s been a place of refuge.

I’ve walked through those doors in different seasons of my life… some strong, some completely broken. And every time, I was met with grace, not judgment.

There’s something special about a place where you don’t have to pretend. Where you can come as you are, with your past, your pain, your questions—and still feel seen and accepted.

Through everything I’ve been through, this church has always felt like somewhere I could return to and just breathe again.

It’s not just a building.
It’s not just Sunday mornings.

For me, it’s always been home. My wife and I just started attending Sunday services at Grace Covenant Church. It is a blessed place with amazing people in whom we see the love of Jesus Christ. I love the songs that we sing together, since I grew up singing them. I encourage anyone reading this to come join us to worship God, learn about Him and spread the gospel of Jesus Christ. "The love for the community and spreading the word is definitely something you can feel here. Even though it was my first time, everyone was so kind, loving, and generous that it felt like I'd been there forever." Really like and enjoy this church! First time visitor, looking for a home church as I recently moved to the area.  Pastor’s sermon was very good.  Worship music was ok, just not contemporary which I prefer.  Major disappointment was only one person greeted me.  Many others clearly noticed me but did not make any effort to connect.  It saddens me when the body of Christ aren't Christ-like.

name: Grace Covenant Church - South San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church, Great pastor with a good message/ sermon. People there were very friendly many people introduced them selves to me. Definitely will go back. I found this church through a Halloween event they hosted! Great church! The pastor has a heart for God and for the community! Both my young girls and I enjoy it! They treat you like family in this church. Good worship music and good sermons. Awesome church. People are friendly. This church community has become a part of my family.

name: Grace Creek Church - Longview Campus
reviewSummary: This is my church home, so of course I love it! But seriously, it's a great place. First of all, the people are fantastic. They always make you feel at home, and cared about as a person. There are many opportunities to volunteer on the weekends, which increases your engagement with the church. And very importantly, the teaching is always straight from the Bible, with love for all, but not compromising to try to please anyone. And I'm very biased because I serve on the worship team, but our band is KICKING good! Definitely the best coffee! Not only is the coffee great but it provides a peaceful place to come and enjoy a your coffee. Also, every cup of coffee sold feeds a child in East Texas! Can’t beat that! Huge church but feels like home,everybody is so friendly Such a great place! I got the Strawberry Açaí refresher and it was amazing. Plenty of seating and an outdoor space! The Cafe within the new Common space @ Grace Creek Church is a perfect new coffee place in our community!   I can see it will be a spot to hang when I want to have a moment of quiet time, read a book, catch up on emails or visit with friends. There are some fun light food items on the menu as well as great drink options, all of which make it a great place for a small group meeting or coffee date.  The space is beautiful, the cafe staff is very welcoming and for sure it’s a fresh new space in our community I know I’ll visit often!

name: Grace Episcopal Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful quaint little church with two services. Nice people and a caring pastor. Lovely little church. The people are amazing and friendly. Was very overwhelmed when my Mom passed and they helped me from beginning to end. I've never met such a nice community of people. The very best church that I have ever attended! Great people, family environment! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a place to worship. Wonderful congregation with warm and welcoming atmosphere This is a great small church with a friendly feel. If you like a church that is welcoming to all and teaches the love of Christ by example, then you've found the right place at Grace.

name: Grace Evangelical Free Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent teaching by head pastor.  Bible focused church. If you come on a day that the head pastor is not preaching make sure you come again before making a final decision on attending in the future. Great service, great people! Great camaraderie, I loved it 💖

name: Grace Evangelical Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: Grace has shown me the truth of the word of God and I am proud to be a recently confirmed Lutheran. The Divine Service is amazing and all of the Pastors are great. Was there for a wedding. The church is beautiful with awesome windows. The Pastor had an awesome message. Would gladly go back the next time I'm in town. Beautiful church, visited during Doors Open Milwaukee Beautiful church with amazing pastors. Great traditional liturgical worship. The sermons always pack a powerful message. I belonged to Grace when I lived in Milwaukee several years ago. I never miss am opportunity to come back when I'm in town. The beautiful church architecture pales to the fact that the gospel is preached in its truth and purity which is the most important part.

name: Grace Family Church
reviewSummary: Very welcoming, culturally diverse community with upbeat modern worship, relatable teaching, and an easy environment for newcomers.

name: Grace Family Church - Carrollwood
reviewSummary: Very welcoming, culturally diverse community with upbeat modern worship, relatable teaching, and an easy environment for newcomers.

name: Grace Family Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Family Church,Pleasanton/Dublin,is a church where the unadulterated and balanced words of God are preached and taught every Sunday.
Prayers and practical christian living are also uncompromised.
In addition to the aforementioned, the church Pastor lives an exemplary christian life for members to emulate.

name: Grace Family Church - Ybor - Tampa Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended Grace Family Church in Ybor during the Christmas Holiday. It was a pleasant experience. When I walked in there was a room to my left that was set up for Coffee and Tea Service and they also had popcorn that day. There will be another review on the Popcorn. It was very delicious. After grabbing some coffee I went to the next room across the hall where service was being held. They  had a greeter at the door who was very pleasant and warm welcoming yet not the one to show me to my seat. I sat on the end not too far from the stage per preference.
The music was great, which had me interested to know more about their music during a non Holiday service. Their music got you going. After the music a slide was presented with stories of inspiration then it was time for the pastor. Now truly I was expecting an in person message however this message was on screen that was being delivered from another campus of Grace Family Church. The message was received. Overall enjoyed the experience of Grace Family Church Ybor. Also on Tuesdays that location does host a Celebrate Recovery for the community. Truly we all have something in life we could celebrate and it is a warm welcoming atmosphere. Much Love GFC, Alakhai A contemporary church located in property shared with The Dream Center, a kid's STEN development center. This worship service is LOUD and alive. Very warm and welcoming staff &  congregation. If you are looking into a church, I recommend you visit. Part of Grace F.C. which is actually a huge church with multiple campuses in the greater area. They do a great job of making you feel at home despite being technically a mega church. Great place! The pastors and their family treat you like family .  The messages and worship music is wonderful! Very welcoming church everyone very nice. This is a true worship center. You will feel God's presence as soon as you walk through the doors. It doesn't matter what your color is, what your background was, or your culture....it's just one big family!!!! The music is also outstanding,  and you will be blessed by it for sure!!!

name: Grace Fellowship - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: A lovely old church with friendly young families. The inside architecture is  amazing! My husband and I call Grace Fellowship home! The church is incredibly welcoming and the presence of The Lord is certainly made known. The praise and worship is a good mix of traditional hymns as well as contemporary songs. The teaching is solid, theological and practical. We love it this church! non-denominational church with an emphasis on declaring the gospel. Mixes traditional and and contemporary worship. Excellent church and community.  Highly recommend it!

name: Grace Fellowship - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
A great place to hear the word of God proclaimed in a most relatable fashion. There is a Pastor there that give the most amazing hugs. Sometimes the background music and instruments overwhelm the voices of the most excellent chorus. 6/29/2022

Visited Grace Fellowship while I was here on vacation. I chose this one because it is similar to my home church. The Pastor was engaging and the Praise & Worship team were good. When I come back to Florida to visit family I'll visit this church again! I absolutely love this church it’s a honor to be a member they sing beautiful music for Jesus plus pastor Jeff never disappoints with his preaching he’s so amazing at what he does and he doesn’t preach a luke warm gospel I admire how he’s not afraid to say the hard things and that’s exactly what Jesus would want him too do! I ❤️ Grace Fellowship a church for all nations! Don’t look any further choose this church you won’t regret it !!! I attended as a visitor today.  Great Bible based teaching and people made me feel welcome from the parking lot to the greeters.   God Bless this church and all those who attended. I started attending Grace Fellowship this month and I have to say there is such a huge bunch of wonderful people. I love this church. Thank you to Pastor Frank for Baptizing me today. I feel so great words can’t express. I am so excited to start my new foundation at Grace Fellowship. I look forward to service and growing in my faith. Thank you Grace Fellowship

name: Grace Fellowship Church
reviewSummary: The church hosted a memorial service for a cousin today.  The also provided lunch for us afterwards.  This is not unusual for any good church to do.  What made this day extra special is the young man who is the new Pastor allowed the former Pastor to conduct the service.  Our cousin had attended the church for decades but the new Pastor came after her dementia had put her in a nursing home because she had serious issues.  I did not get his name but was very impressed with him doing this.  And all the church folks who came did a great job with the meal.  We feel really blessed by this huge show of love.  Thank you Grace Fellowship church for you true demonstration of Christ like love and service.  Your new young Pastor is a keeper. From their Worship, Youth Groups (AWANA clubs), Bible studies, vacation bible schools, concerts and other events; Grace’s Solid, grounded, bible centered focus on God and Jesus Christ as Savior are what makes this church and their leadership a great place to worship! We have been going here for almost 5 years. We are fed the word of God ( BIBLE ) in service and Sunday school class. Come and see , enjoy and learn of Christ our Lord. I love my church. The people here are like family even if you are brand new. Wonderful, bible believing, bible teaching church with sound doctrine

name: Grace Fellowship Church - Avon Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church for 20 years and do feel a strong connection. The teaching is expository rather than topical. Versus some trends in worship style, it is not loud and usually comprises a mixture of modern songs as well as theologically solid older songs and hymns.

The staff are mature believers and have been with the church for 5 to 40 years, with solid theological training.

The church, being smaller, does lack in ministry to younger, single adults or new married people, but they are very compassionate and caring. Been my church home since I was a kid. Very solid biblical teaching.  Great community. If you're looking for a church home, you'll feel very welcomed here. They preach the Word of God. They love people and they love Jesus.
What more could you ask for. Meh

name: Grace Fellowship Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
AMAZING pastor. Doctrinally sound teaching. Great children's ministry. Passionate worship. 1000% recommended. Home church.

Pretty great group of folks trying to love Jesus.

Mixed old timers, young families, and youth.

Good Orange County families and multi-generational attendance. Love this place because of the people - stellar leadership across the board. Grateful.

Amazing young children’s support as well. Pastor Dave is awesome,Christian church has traditional feel very friendly members, strong evangelical vibes Ill be back love this place, not overly smart with message words or harsh, one puts you on,”you might be “”not you are”, standpoint. I've been going to this church my whole entire life, I like it a lot they have two main services and 8:30 and a 10:30, and both services have child care and a youth group high school and junior high group that meets at 10:30. What a great church. I found it after going to many churches and this one was a perfect fit for me. I'm so glad I found it. I haven't been there in over 20 years but it really helped me out when I needed it most.

name: Grace Fellowship Church - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Fellowship is a wonderful church with a remarkable gift for teaching God’s Word in a clear, practical, and easy-to-understand way. I was especially impressed by how they explained the book of Lamentations. The humility of the leaders, the genuine love and care shown by the congregation, and the church’s strong commitment to evangelism, missions, and winning souls make it an exceptional place to grow in faith. I highly recommend Grace Fellowship to anyone seeking a Bible-centered, Christ-focused church. To be honest, this church is ok but sometimes it feels like the pastors or visiting pastors are addressing people who are nobodies. Please pastors or visiting pastors dress respectful to God and church body. Members look good, some  pastors come out in sandles , open shirt with Tshirt inside. Is it so hard to have a button shirt or dress pants for church really. Even priests in the Bible dressed amazing. I don’t mean have robes on but please be dressed for church not barbecue in your backyard or your soccer kids game. Honor God’s presence and his church body. The way the Christmas story was told and the teaching/preaching was so uplifting!
I enjoyed the hot chocolate and the snow area. Throwing snowballs at my family was so much fun! The sun was shining, and the ice was a cool activity to do in the sun.
The kids' church was amazing!
I am extremely glad I went with my sister and her family. Grace fellowship is known for being "the church that prays" and I love that!!! Each time one of their ministers has prayed for me, it's always been extremely accurate to the very thing I have been sharing with the Lord about! Additionally, Pastor Jim is a true Shepherd. He brings the word every Sunday, breaks it down, and explains it to us so well. We also receive sermon notes to fill in during the sermon and it helps me to actually remember what I've learned. He also makes sure people are invited to receive Christ as Savior at every sermon, which I love that!
This church truly prays, teaches the word and has numerous ministries doing the Lord's work locally and globally. If you are looking for a Great commission minded, Bible based church look no further! Grace Fellowship Church treats you like family starting on day one! It has been an amazing experience since my family and I started going to Grace Fellowship. I definitely recommend visiting!

name: Grace Fellowship Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
AMAZING pastor. Doctrinally sound teaching. Great children's ministry. Passionate worship. 1000% recommended. Home church.

Pretty great group of folks trying to love Jesus.

Mixed old timers, young families, and youth.

Good Orange County families and multi-generational attendance. Love this place because of the people - stellar leadership across the board. Grateful.

Amazing young children’s support as well. Pastor Dave is awesome,Christian church has traditional feel very friendly members, strong evangelical vibes Ill be back love this place, not overly smart with message words or harsh, one puts you on,”you might be “”not you are”, standpoint. I've been going to this church my whole entire life, I like it a lot they have two main services and 8:30 and a 10:30, and both services have child care and a youth group high school and junior high group that meets at 10:30. What a great church. I found it after going to many churches and this one was a perfect fit for me. I'm so glad I found it. I haven't been there in over 20 years but it really helped me out when I needed it most.

name: Grace Fellowship Church - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary:
Violet Elementary had a family fun day. It was awesome! First Glory to God! This was my first time in Grace Fellowship! It is a beautiful church. There was a lot of activities to do! Me & my granddaughter had a great time. They had food trucks rooster, Kona Ice & Tom’s Coffee! Of course; Kona Ice won the kids! Rooster was good I had grill chicken & honey barbecue sauce! This was a great adventure for the last day of school! It was held in a wonderful facility Gods house😇🙏🏽🙌🏽😁🥳🍗🍗🍧☕️🎨🏀♥️♥️♥️🎴🎥🧶🧵 We’ve visited the play area at Grace Fellowship two times and really appreciate having a free indoor space for kids to play. Unfortunately, our recent experiences have been stressful because there seems to be very little supervision from some parents.
On one visit, a group of older kids blocked the slide exit so younger children couldn’t get out safely. This last visit, a little girl was repeatedly pinching younger kids, including my child, who ended up crying pretty hard. Another child was pinched multiple times as well, and no parent stepped in or apologized.
I do think more parental attention and intervention would help keep the space safer and more enjoyable for everyone. Enjoy going on Thursdays so my husband & I can go together. Serices are excellent along with singing. This was our first visit since it recently opened. We were quite impressed with the amenities and the welcoming atmosphere. The staff at reception and the cafe were very friendly, and accommodating. Not only was the cafe very nice, there’s a great play land, and rock climbing wall If you are looking for a church that preaches the BIBLE And has the Spirit - than try Grace. I was always used to a small church - but Grace has it all - Very Friendly.

name: Grace Fellowship Church | North Katy Campus - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is our home. Being immigrants we struggled to find a church that felt like home, the moment we stepped into Grace Fellowship North Katy campus, we could feel it was where God wanted us to be. We have been here two years and not going anywhere.

Here are some key points that we love:
1. The truth is being preached
2. Everyone truly cares about you. If you miss church on a Sunday, you will have texts to ask of you are doing okay. Now that is community.
3. The kids and youth ministry is amazing!
4. Kids are allowed in church with parents and it is ENCOURAGED. Kids are the future.
5. The coffee and doughnuts are great!

Whoever is reading this, come to Grace and experience God and your future church family. You are already loved by the Lord. Now, come and connect with fellow believers, and come and grow with us. if you need to a place to feel the powerful presence of God this is the place for you ! The love of Jesus roams through this church heavily and Pastor Jeff is anointed by the Lord to preach truth straight Out of the word of God.  10/10 experience So blessed to be able to call this place home. Spanish and English service available! Thank you Lord for helping me find such a great church! My spiritual family is here. I love this church.

name: Grace Fellowship Church | The Chapel - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary: Visited in Jan- March 26'. On fire 🔥 preaching. Luke warm congregation. Not trying to be mean, but it's true. Staff and members, never felt genuine, it felt clickish. Kinda like people are just going thru the motions. Just disappointed. Beautiful Church. Sry didnt work out. I wish them the best. Great church to hear the Word and people are friendly. You get to know people at small groups and Bible studies. Many are sincere and not just a "club" to join. A group of people who clearly love Jesus.  ❤️ A wonderful extention of Grace Fellowship. Great children's ministry too!  I love the smaller crowd, milder music, and time of reflection.  Pastor Dan creates an atmosphere that allows you to truly connect to God during each service in your own way. I also love the slow pace and mild music. I love the down to earth sermons and our local Pastor Dan is a mild mannered humble man of God.

name: Grace Fellowship Church Of Westerville - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary: My parents go here and I visit every now and then. The people are friendly in a genuine way. They usually play 3-4 songs before the teaching. The teachings are intriguing, easy to follow, and last about 35-45 minutes. Wow was boring, quiet and the preacher read from a paper Good God based teachings. The pastor is kind and firm in his faith, but truly preaches God's word. Great place to worship! Everyone member greeted me and others including the Pastor, who gave a wonderful service. I was hoping the church had evening services on Sunday because I work in the mornings. On the Sundays I'm off, I will be attending this church. Such caring, genuine people! I had been praying that the Lord would lead me to a church where His Spirit would be in the services...and He did!

name: Grace Fellowship of Augusta - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: We fellowship during the painting class. I'm learning and practicing Acrylic Painting and appreciate the Prayer time before each class. Love this church! You hear the word of God and the people are so friendly and loving. You can’t ask for more sincere and humble leadership than Pastor Brian. Unlike what I assume is a sister Fellowship in North Augusta, I've actually been to this one, when I was younger. I was not impressed with it. My brother had been going there for some time, and I told him that he doesn't need to be going there, I explained to him my issues with it, not the least of which is the intentional misrepresentation of Catholics, which I wasn't even one at the time I went there, so that's an issue. Also, apparently them not knowing the etymology of the word religion, see my review on the one in North Augusta for that. Hint, it's not an insult. I also take issue with worship that says that it's worship, but it's actually praise, unless a sacrifice is taking place, it's technically not worship.  I'm not talking about animal sacrifice, so you figure it out.  What bothers me most about this place though, other than re baptizing people that have already been baptized, or at least they used to I don't know if they still do. Is that they have the audacity, to say that they're non-denominational. There's no such thing, even interdenominational is a misnomer, because there's some interpretation that they are giving people every Sunday, that is either going to be Calvinist, Arminist or something else.  I read one of the comments that said that the type of worship is how the Spirit moves them, no it's not, it's how they interpret the Spirit is moving them.  In spite of all these complaints that I have, and believe me I have more, like believing you should read incomplete Bibles (y'all are missing seven books),  they are introducing people to the word of God, that might not otherwise know it, even if I think their interpretation is wrong,  and they are my brothers and sisters in Christ, even if they don't accept my baptism as valid which it is. Schism begets schism. I think y'all should read John 17:21. Pastor has a way of delivering God's word that everyone can relate to! You will be touched. Love the diversity of the congregation. Dress formal or go in jeans. This church is for everyone. Thank you Grace❣🙏 I have moved alot during time grace first opened till present.  I've always felt welcomed n enjoyed the praise n worship n the original pastor wade n everyone who ever came as quest as well as the current . I've shown up with jeans n a black eye to dressed well and it's never been anything but welcoming ..I'm great ful for all god shows me when I attend his house n grace is like my home base ...thanks to all staff n family at grace who open up n give of thier selves ...your more than appreciated ...Teena Black Wiggins

name: Grace Fellowship of Lakewood - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary:
In 2019 I came to Colorado to beat the Tx heat. While hanging alone at a park a man invited me to come eat at their cookout.  After we ate he invited me to church. Living out of my black Pontiac g5 and obviously strung out. I later found out the man was the pastor. For the life of me I cannot recall his name from memory. I do however remember the welcoming feelings that came from the congregation. I remember that after every service I attended someone quietly handed me a $50 or $100 bill and said God told them I need some money.  And I remember the church asking if I wanted to use the parking lot and yard to camp so I am safer than on the streets. 7 years later I am on my way back with my wife and dog and for the same reason of trying to escape the deadly Texas summer heat that comes every  summer. If anyone from the congregation remembers me. Douglas Bailey. Please let me know I’ve got the right church. Thanks When I was looking for a church, I was able to walk in and out of several others without any kind of greeting. Grace Fellowship was the first place I was noticed and welcomed. The people really enjoy each other, and the teaching is good. All kinds of people are there, and I really think anybody would feel welcome. The children's and youth ministries are pretty active as well. Good place for families with kids. I was in the Denver area for a week of meetings for work, and I wanted to attend church service on Sunday which is Important.   I looked on line for a church in the area and found Grace Church.  The pastor had created a video for visitors describing what a first time visitor could expect.  I was intrigued that a pastor would be that interested in welcoming potential visitors to his church that way.
I decided to attend the Sunday morning service.  I found the church members thoughtful and friendly.  I met a college student who was doing an internship at the church as a worship leader.  I met two wonderful sisters in Christ who greeted members and visitors graciously;  they especially greeted the children and teenagers.  I met Lots of friendly members of the congregation.
The worship was good and focused on the Lord Jesus.    The Pastor preached so well.  He was prepared to preach Gods word clearly unapologetically with quiet power.  He preached from a passage in Revelations 13: 11 onward.  It’s a week later and I remember the message of his preaching.  I certainly felt at home at Grace Church Lakewood.   Today is Sunday and I’ll be at my Church in Bayonne New Jersey happy to be home;  I will be praying for my brothers and sisters at Grace Lakewood that wonderful church in Colorado, led by a great pastor. I have been going Grace Fellowship of Lakewood for about a month and a half. I was in the transition of leaving the Church I was in for 10 years. I was asked to play drums every other week and what a team and what a blessing. The friendliest welcoming ever.  "Come as you are.".  John's sermons are outstanding
Wouldn't want to go anywhere else. Thanks to all the staff members for such a wonderful place to worship God.
.. AMEN... Grace Fellowship of Lakewood is a friendly and inviting church. It's just big enough to have a great mix of ages and families, but not so big that you're lost in a crowd of people. The worship music is heartfelt and contemporary but it's not an overpowering rock concert. A great little church for new seekers or established Christians alike.

name: Grace Fellowship of South Forsyth - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I visited Grace Fellowship for the first time on August 3, 2025. We were warmly welcomed and appreciated how friendly everyone was. The service had the feel of a close-knit family gathering, with people of all ages in attendance. The music was pleasant—uplifting without being loud or overbearing—and the teaching was solid and grounded in Scripture. We truly appreciated our first visit. Straightforward Bible knowledge and worship.  Despite playing the guitar and in bands for years, this is not a rock concert.  Nor do I want to attend one when praising God and fostering a relationship with our Creator.   They hold fast to their core beliefs regardless of what would make them more popular on a secular basis.  Northpoint and the like are better suited for pop-gospel teachings.   You decide. Compared to the upbeat services that I am used to at First Baptist Atlanta, Woodstock First Baptist and North Point, I felt this service to be a bit bland. I couldn't feel much energy or the Holy Spirit in the room, and the songs the band performed were unfamiliar. In my humble opinion, there are better options for a Sunday service. I have attended this church for many years with my family. The church is God-centered,  the church family is loving and inviting, and the leadership loves God and teaches from the Word of God. I hope to find a church that strengthens my relationship with Christ and my relationships with others like this one has when I move to my new home in the next few months. If you don't have a church home, check out Grace Fellowship and feel free to find any of the pastors and ask any questions. They have children and youth programs as well as different study classes, including one that accommodates predominately Spanish speaking people. A terrific Christian church where all aspects are God-centered and people are cared for. Some of the other distinctives include teaching through books of the Bible (rather than topics), leadership by a group of elders (rather than a single pastor), encouragement to ask questions, and contemporary music with an appreciation hymns of old with deep meaning in the lyrics.

name: Grace First Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My fantastic church. I love it here. Grew up here, and will keep coming back. My wife and I have been members of Grace First for almost three years. We were attracted to the church by its friendliness and the sense of community among members of all ages. And we like the church's top-notch music programs and concerts. This church welcomes anyone with open arms! They have a website, gracefirst.org where you can watch their live stream 9AM services.  The music director composed a beautiful 5 movement Christmas Contada.  They cook and serve food and hold Third Street services to the homeless downtown.  They have Deacons that are there for you personally. They have on-campus concerts from various artists and groups who entertain the Long Beach jazz, country, etc aficionados.  They even went to help out in the Hurricane Katrina disaster, to the West Virginia backhills and even to Peru to help those in need. These folks really care! I've attended this church since I was a child. It's mission of connecting people of different age, ethnicity, and cultural backgrounds shines through. Amazing music program and events for every age and interest! This is a beautiful church with very welcoming members.  I love attending the 9:00 service with the choir.

name: Grace Fishers Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: I originally just gave a one star review but didn't want to do so without an explanation. My wife and I are looking for a church in the area and after listening to several sermons online the last few weeks,the Chasing the Wind series which I enjoyed, we decided to attend Sunday, July 13th.  After the music and playing a fun audience participation game, they proceeded to bring out a guest speaker. I was hoping for more of the aforementioned series or at the least a new series with Biblical excegetical teaching but instead had to listen to this guest speaker go on a political diatribe which I don't want to hear in church whichever side it's coming from. We sat through  five to ten minutes of his rant, hoping it would go a different direction. Seeing it wasn't and at the risk of embarrassing my wife I did something I've never done before and hope to never do again,we walked out. As we approached the doors a young couple with a couple of children who were regular attendees was also exiting and spoke up to inquire as to why we were leaving . Was it due to the speaker's subject matter?  It troubled them also.  We said yes and proceeded out to the parking lot where another young lady  I believe of Latino heritage was also bothered and leaving saying the church had pushed some of this junk, (my words),  before but not recently and she was  aggravated. We talked a few minutes and wished each other well as all of us are looking for  a new church. It's truly sad, please stick to the gospel and teach people the word of God! The coffee was on and ready. The people were amazing. And the Word of God was preached. What an excellent church and a body focused on reaching people for Christ. Our oldest (5 years old) has autism and felt really comfortable at kids church. Highly recommend. Grace Fishers has become family.  The church leadership is absolutely solid in their vision and efforts.  Not sure how you could have stronger sense of belonging anywhere else.  Wherever you are in your faith journey, Grace Fishers is encouraging, helpful and will be there along side you in times of triumph and defeat. I've been going to Grace since 2012 and I love it. The sermon topics are meaningful and applicable to real life for a wide breadth of life stages. The worship is such high quality. Their children's programming is amazing - my son came home from a semester of weekly care there spouting off the fruits of the spirit when he was only 2! I also love their Kids Camp in the summer and I'm so grateful for all the love and attention my whole family receives every single week from them. Medium sized church with small church feel. Music is usually pretty great. Weekly message excellent.

name: Grace Gospel Christian Church - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary: I am grateful to this faithful Chinese Reformed Church for allowing me to attend their in-person Sunday worship and fellowship while I was in the area on business. The preacher delivered his sermons with an exegetical approach, faithfully explaining the Bible. The elders were all humble and warmly caring. The Sunday worship service was held in the hotel, and the venue was very well arranged. I am very fortunate to have found and participated in this church.

name: Grace Grove Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Grove Church teaches the Grace of Jesus Christ in the New Covenant. This is the place to come in Southern California. Part of Network 220. Wonderful people. Rich in their traditions. Great programs for the children, Awanas club all during the school year and Vacation bible school in the summer. Love this place! Love My New hutch Family. Very Unified!!

name: Grace Harbor Church
reviewSummary:
I've been attending this church since February. The space is big enough for me to adore worshiping Jesus Christ with wonderful people there. I enjoy meeting new people who share my beliefs, and the music is always positive and encouraging. The church is also close to where I live, making it easy for me to attend. Every Sunday at 10 a.m., I come and leave feeling refreshed and inspired. Wonderful Christian Church. Wonderful leadership and full of loving Christian fellowship. Definitely worth your time to visit. My wife and I have been members here for 15+ years and consider Sunday mornings the highlight of our week's!  Faithful, humble pastors/elders (not perfect!) Who care for the sheep entrusted to them.  Music is beautiful and "non-showy".  Thankful to God for GHC! I have been seeking God on earth, figured that was only in heaven, after 35 years of seeking I found Him, this congregation is the real thing, true to God they represent Him by showing and sharing their love. The leadership and pastors are sincere about sharing the gospel in the pure way God intended. If you're a truth seeker look no further I’ve been trying to get in touch with someone at the church regarding an important matter, but I haven’t been able to reach anyone by phone or email. As I do not live in town, I’m unable to visit in person.

Could you please provide a valid phone number or email address where I can contact someone directly?

Thank you very much for your help.

name: Grace Harbor Church & School - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Harbor has been such a blessing for our family. It has truly been the best place for our son, Jackson. He is always excited to go to daycare and absolutely adores his teachers.

The teachers are incredibly caring and intentional—spending meaningful time with him as he learns, explores, and discovers new things each day. We also love that Grace Harbor incorporates Bible-based lessons and sends home the cutest artwork that we treasure.

Knowing our child is loved, supported, and growing in such a positive environment gives us complete peace of mind. I would highly recommend Grace Harbor to any parent looking for a nurturing and faith-centered daycare for their baby. My friends and I were at the Sunday 700PM AA meeting, and were kicked out for having a service dog and for an individual with Tourette’s Syndrome.  We were treated poorly and they were extremely rude.  Do not attend. This has been the worst school experience my family has ever had. I thought long and hard before writing this review, but I feel it’s important to share our experience. My child attended this school for one year. During that time, I received nearly 20 incident reports. My child was hit, bitten, and physically attacked multiple times. At first I assumed this was normal behavior for very young children and decided to wait and see. Unfortunately, the situation did not improve. After transferring to a new school, my child finally shared that he was being repeatedly bullied—the other child would hit and bite him, and when he tried to move away, the child would follow and continue. But teachers told us that the children involved were my kid’s “best buddies”. So ridiculous...  One incident was especially alarming. My child peed in his pants, and no one noticed for hours. By the time I picked him up, his pant had already dried, but his shoes and socks were still soaked in pee. No staff member informed us or addressed the situation. This was the final reason we decided to leave. The contrast after transferring schools was immediate. On the first day at his new school, my child came home singing songs—something he never did during the entire previous year. Now he goes to school happy every day, whereas drop-off at this school was a daily struggle. Called 5 times and left multiple messages to inquire about their preschool enrollment. The numbers for both school and church didn't go anywhere. We got frustrated and just signed up our daughter to another Tutor Time in Irvine. Beautiful facility. Great convenient parking. Watched a speaker and was impressed by the message of experience, strength, and hope. Fabulous break out room and great accoustics.

name: Grace Harvest Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Was invited by a friend n it was so good to go to a true Bible believing church, wonderful traditional worship and straight from Bible preaching, not to mention a few women who made their way to say hello to me, very kind!! Truly enjoyed the service!! I had a powerful holy spirit experience here. I will highly recommend this church to anyone that needs to hear a word from God Great church hidden in Los Angeles county Ppl here are truly family everyone here including the pastors are great group of ppl highly recommend this church You found your place in Grace Very pretty

name: Grace Hills Church
reviewSummary: Grace Hills is a warm, welcoming church home. Pastor Mike is wonderful.

name: Grace Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I attended here several times during my own ministry Sabbatical. It was a great group of genuine people from age groups and walks of life. I really can’t say enough good things about this church. It’s been many months since I’ve been and I still think of the love, kindness and spiritual care of the people there. My family has been so happy to have found Grace Hills! After living down the street for over 5 years and attending another church, we decided to check out Grace Hills. It is a smaller church than our previous one and we love that! It feels like coming 'home' to visit family every Sunday. Everyone is so warm and welcoming and there are many ways to get involved, from VBS, to Small Groups, to Womens monthly breakfasts, and much more. Not to mention the most important part, the sermons are solid Bible teaching from a wonderful and easy to relate to Pastor! My wife and I have been attending Grace Hills Church for about two years. We are so blessed by the teaching of God's word by our Pastor Mike. We love attending our weekly Life Group and our time of fellowship.  What a great place to attend and worship. I'Ve  been attending Grace Hills Church since 2009.I have my church home, somewhere I can worship with other believers, where I feel loved and accepted. CHRIST is taught and HIS WORD explained .  I feel comfortable with the contemporary service because it is a little more informal and casual.  Really enjoy the Life group where we learn to know each other and pray for one another,  and where the Sunday message  is discussed and questions are answered This has been our home church since 1995.  I love the teaching and my church family.  We have both contemporary worship in the 9:15am  service and traditional music at the 11am service, with a fellowship time in between with coffee, muffins and fruit.  We are a good size family church, not too small that everyone knows your business and not too big that you get swallowed up.  If you visit, stop by the kitchen and fellowship hall and say Hi to me.  I work in the kitchen pretty much every Sunday but I can take a few minutes to show you around and introduce to some friends.  :)

name: Grace Hills Church - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary:
GraceHills has been our home church since the summer of 2025. We spent a lot of time researching before attending and were so thankful to find clear theological statements that are lived out in action, not just words. During a very hard season for our family, the staff and members have shown us incredible love and support. We will always be grateful for the way GraceHills reflects God’s love so authentically. We love this church and are thankful to call it home. I can’t say enough good things about Grace Hills Church in Bentonville, Arkansas. I found this incredible community through dear friends of mine, and it’s been a life-changing experience for myself and my family. After searching for the right church in Northwest Arkansas for quite some time, I finally found a place that feels like home.

Grace Hills is a growing church with a heart for people. The congregation is full of some of the most genuine, salt-of-the-earth, humble individuals I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. The staff is incredible, the worship team leads with such passion and authenticity, and the volunteers are truly the hands and feet of Jesus.

What stands out most to me is the welcoming and supportive atmosphere. Grace Hills isn’t just a church; it’s a family—a community where you can grow spiritually and feel deeply connected. If you’re looking for a church where you’ll feel loved, inspired, and encouraged to grow in your faith, I highly recommend visiting Grace Hills. It’s been such a blessing in our lives, and I know it could be in yours too! From the first time we walked through the doors of Grace Hills Church, we experienced the love of Christ! Grace Hills is a church that meets you where you are and equips and encourages you to live out who God created you to be.

As someone older, I can say there is a sweet mix of ages and personalities and a beautiful sense of family and community where everyone belongs. I am especially thankful for the women’s ministry at Grace Hills! We laugh, learn, pray, encourage and grow together.

The whole truth of the Bible is preached and taught in a way that is both life-changing and practical for everyday living. Worship is heartfelt and authentic, and the messages always point us back to Jesus. The pastors and leaders genuinely care for people and create an environment where faith can grow deep roots.

We’re so thankful to be part of a church that loves God, loves people, and makes a real difference in our community! 💗 Grace Hills - such a great church blessed by God!  The first moment we visited we knew we were home. Everyone was so welcoming and that spirit has not dampened in 2 years. Hearing the Word each week has created such growth in our walk with Jesus and we feel strength in this community of believers. My husband and I are seniors (a growing group at Grace Hills) and yet we’ve been welcomed and our gifts put to work! So thankful to God for leading us here. 💜✝️ I love Grace Hills Church! I am in my 60’s and I can say we are well represented by every generation in our church. We do discipleship here. I have the beautiful opportunity to mentor and be mentored here. That is the beauty of our church. We meet you where you are. I came here because of our men’s ministry, and the investment our church puts into fellowship— and my wife found the same with our ladies. If you are looking for a church home- please come let us love on you with the sweetness of Jesus Christ.

I'Ve  been attending Grace Hills Church since 2009.I have my church home, somewhere I can worship with other believers, where I feel loved and accepted. CHRIST is taught and HIS WORD explained .  I feel comfortable with the contemporary service because it is a little more informal and casual.  Really enjoy the Life group where we learn to know each other and pray for one another,  and where the Sunday message  is discussed and questions are answered This has been our home church since 1995. name: Grace Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church! This is a church that glorifies God and benefits people, manifesting His grace and glory, while also revealing the dignity of humanity! Sincere, passionate, filled with God’s love and presence, I feel that Grace Irvine is the home of God, and a home for those like you and me who are seeking Him! I highly recommend Grace Irvine Church to anyone seeking a faithful, gospel-centered spiritual family.

The sermons here are deeply orthodox, firmly grounded in Scripture, and delivered with clarity and conviction. You can always count on receiving solid, uncompromised biblical truth every Sunday.

Furthermore, the staff and ministry team are incredibly dedicated and spiritually mature. They truly live out their faith, displaying a genuine love for Christ and a heart for serving others in everything they do.

Their regular Bible studies are also outstanding. They are deeply engaging, spiritually rich, and provide an excellent environment for anyone looking to grow seriously in their understanding of God's Word. Whether you are new to the area or looking for a healthy community to call home, this church is a wonderful place to grow. This is a small but growing church with a genuine love for God and people. The pastor’s messages are powerful, practical, and rooted in Scripture. I’m grateful to be part of this church family. I’ve really enjoyed being part of this church. The community is warm, the teaching is faithful to God’s Word, and I’ve found grace, peace, love and encouragement here. A small growing church that makes me feel like home. Pastor’s messages are powerful. I’ll keep going

name: Grace Korean United Methodist - Glendale Campus
Grace Life Church
reviewSummary:
From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt embraced by genuine love and kindness. The atmosphere was filled with warmth, and every smile, handshake, and word of encouragement reflected the heart of Christ. They offered solid biblical teaching, and are filled with genuinely caring people. A beautiful place to grow in faith and community. If you’re looking for a new church you’ll be met with caring people and a spirit of grace that makes you feel at home. We’ve been attending this Bible study for a few months now, and it has been such a blessing in our lives. The discussions are always meaningful and uplifting, and the community here is so warm and welcoming. We’ve built wonderful relationships and truly feel surrounded by love and support each week. If you’re looking for a place to grow in faith while being part of a caring, encouraging group, I would highly recommend joining! Absolutely love this church! The atmosphere is welcoming, the teaching is biblical and relevant, and the people are genuine. It’s a place where you can truly grow in your faith and feel part of a caring community. I was a new Christian when I found Grace Life and joined their Bible study. I found it to be a warm and welcoming environment with a focus on loving God and loving People. A great community to learn the Word of God as it is written. At first glance this group feels unbelievably warm, generous, and ‘loving’ — but that’s the hook. Over time it became clear the warmth was conditional and expected something in return, and the leadership operates in a way that feels more cult-like than Christian.

The local leaders here in New Hampshire act like gatekeepers, but they aren’t even fully in charge — they defer to an outside leadership team in Alabama who call the real shots. That means decisions about people’s spiritual lives are made by strangers hundreds of miles away. Add to that the intense, performative friendliness that flips to exclusion the moment you question anything, and the picture becomes very unhealthy.

It has the hallmarks of a controlling, insular group: love-bombing, scapegoating, silencing, and loyalty tests. They come across like unhinged Californians trying to run a church plant under the thumb of distant authority. It is not the grace, freedom, and accountability of genuine Christian fellowship.

Approach with extreme caution.

Get yourself and your loved ones connected to a ministry that is fulfilling and nurtures your faith. Check out Grace Life!! Enjoy the experience. Need to make it back there Where we meet for paint for fun class Awesome, caring and great staff. Family, where no one is perfect just forgiven

name: Grace Life Fellowship - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: Fantastic Church!! Arguably the best teaching on God's love and grace I've ever received. You will be encouraged and uplifted to understand the wonderful creation you truly are in Christ and to know His unconditional love for you. I no longer live in Baton Rouge, but I still keep up with the teaching online. This was probably the worst church I've ever been in in the 56 years I've been alive. We went in dressed in biker attire and not one person greeted us from the staff pasta walked right by us didn't say one word not one person that raised their hand while praising the music everybody stood there like they were robots. Then the preacher got up and God knows what he was saying because nothing really made too much sense he sounded like he was trying to make everything sound like he was in a bar trying to read a poem. I don't like to judge places on my first visit but while praying about it I asked the Lord if I should just go back and give it another try and my answer was why would you go there I don't Grace Life Fellowship is a place where you will feel welcome, from the time you get there, until the time you leave. The kids ministry is like no other. You will be refreshed and blessed with the truth of who you are in him. Blessed to listen online,  reverent and practical!!! Trucking can be a isolated life and its wonderful to feel so loved!! Paster Frank is the real deal, Paster Tim is also the real deal. God bless! Great teachers, Mrs. Heather and Ms. Megan, great school year. My kid will be back again next school year!

name: Grace Long Beach - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary:
Very nice people, contemporary service musically, teaches Bible My husband and I have been attending since we moved to Long Beach.  We were attracted to this community because of its sincere desire to follow Jesus and sacrificially live that out.  Additionally, the people are some of the most kind, interesting, and genuine people I know.

We have had a very easy time connecting with people through Life Groups, the mom’s group, and volunteer opportunities. Many of our closest friends have come from this community.

We really like all the pastors. Their sermons are smart, thoughtful, and Christ-centered.

Our children really enjoy the children’s ministry and their friends there.  The volunteers are passionate about loving them well and sharing the joy that comes from following Jesus.  I look forward to them growing and being part of the vibrant middle school and high school ministries. As someone who’s attended Grace for 20 years, I find Grace to be a lovely community of folks who love Jesus and people with breadth and depth. It’s people are generous and have an affection for the city of Long Beach and hope for newness and wholeness to break through in ALL corners of the city. Really good coffee. Nice people. Great mix of families and singles through all stages of life. Great childcare for all ages.

Main service usually starts at 9:30am on Sunday, but check the website around the holidays. Very nice

name: Grace Lutheran Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful high traditional Lutheran service. The organ is well-maintained and elegant with a skillful organist. Law and gospel in the sermon and a welcoming congregation. The pastor is well-spoken and a good orator, and is also skilled in chanting The chapel feels historic, with artful stained glass and excellent theological symbolism. If you are LCMS, I cannot recommend Grace Lutheran enough. The traditional Divine Service at Grace Lutheran Church provides a beautiful liturgical experience. The liturgy is conducted with great reverence, and the messages delivered by Pastor Thomas are insightful and inspiring. The pipe organ and beautiful Lutheran hymns add greatly to the worship service. There is a strong sense of community despite the “commuter aspect” of the congregation. People from all over the county attend and call Grace Lutheran home. The focus on Scripture, Law/Gospel, and the Lord’s Supper, combined with the congregation's warmth and love, provides an uplifting experience where one feels connected to Christ and spiritually fed. This is one of the most beautiful worship spaces on the west coast AND, one gets to receive God's free gifts of the forgiveness of sins and the strengthening of one's trust in Christ's promises via His words rightly preached and His sacraments rightly delivered!
Come and dine with the Savior, Jesus the Christ, and remember: He promises forgiveness of sins and eternal joys and pleasures forevermore to those who turn from their sins (breaking the Ten Commandment), who are baptized, and who trust the Savior, Jesus, to save them. However, He does not promise your tomorrow.
Come, sit in the back, and let the Divine Physician work on your head and your heart-- this is a 100%-free clinic for your hurting, guilty soul.  And remember, you don't have to be good, because you're not, you are the walking dead, just like the rest of us. But don't worry, Jesus will gladly make you alive by giving you a new heart, with new desires, and will trade His purity, perfection, and life for your impurities, imperfections, and death.  He accomplished this by dying a grusome death on a cross, because sin earns death, and God is just.  So, Jesus took it all into his body and into the grave; He got what you deserve so that, in the end, you get what He deserves.  He then rose from the dead like He said He would, proving that He defeated death, again, for you.  Everything He does is for you!
He is saving a place for you at His table. Won't you come? For the theology, worship, community, architecture, music, and art - 5 stars I liked the format of the website. I have attended intermittently for a long time. For the past three weeks, I have been fortunate to be able to attend every Sunday. This is especially a blessing now as I am experiencing a transitional period in my life.

name: Grace Marietta - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited Grace Church last Sunday and had a truly uplifting experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the people were incredibly friendly. The pastor delivered a powerful and inspiring sermon that really spoke to me. It was so impactful that I’m definitely planning to go back.
They also served communion, which added a meaningful touch to the service. My daughter had a great time in Sunday school, which speaks volumes about their children’s ministry.
What stood out the most was the diversity—Grace Church brings together people of different ages and cultures, creating a refreshing and inclusive community. It honestly felt like a glimpse of what heaven might look like. I hadn't really been attending a church regularly since Covid, and to be honest I wasn't doing to well on my own. The fire inside was down to an ember. A friend from my old church told me about Grace and so I went that Sunday. Well, something inside started to grow into a flame, enough that my 15 y.o. daughter saw, and asked if she could go with me. She quickly got involved as well, attending a week long retreat, then another weekend retreat, got involved with True North and told me last week after her D group that she never wants leave the area, that Kennesaw State is perfect because she never wants to stop coming to Grace.

If you're looking for a local church that will bring out the fire in you, I'd highly recommend... My family is blessed we found a very kid-friendly church community with a passion to build up the next generation and a heart for sharing God's love. I feel a little weird reviewing a church, but after coming here for a few Sundays I feel like I need to share how amazing worshiping is here. This church is a family, and very refreshing. The worship is spirit filled and the church leaders do an amazing job reaching out to the community. This church is the perfect church for people wanting to give religion a try, or for people hardened by a bad church experience, or for those who feel like church could be more than it is. I don't even know how to properly describe the amazingness that is this church. I think it's something you just have to experience yourself, and i can guarantee if you do go you'll know exactly what I'm talking about. The pure holiness of this place is like nothing I've ever experienced. Literally the best Pastor and congregation I've ever had the privilege of joining.

reviewSummary:
i've been attending this church for six years. Pastor Dave Wolf has a heart for the sheep that he leads. He is kind and he preaches right from the word of God. He has compassion for people while not mincing God's words. The other pastors have true hearts for their ministries and including missions that are near and far, young people, and making sure the message goes out clearly and is available to everyone online and personally. The staff is wonderful and kind. The worship is truly worship, led by a group that helps us praise God with song.  I recommend Grace Point for anyone who is looking for a good Bible based Christian church. Wonderful, modern and warm church.  Everyone are happy and friendly.
Lead Pastor Dave Wolf and his team work well together to personalize and connect with the audience.  Service and message are clear. This was our first time.  Will be coming back. I visited this church twice, And then the second time the senior pastor described the amount of olives discourse about the tribulation that Jesus the Lord  talks about, As” Not futuristic,” And that” The abomination of desolation is already happened in the days of the old temple.” Furthermore, The senior pastor denies that there is a literal tribulation, Or a future world government at which point in time The third temple will be rebuilt. I found this to be very disturbing, And it confused my children who were with me, Since they actually read the Bible and know that the Book of Revelation outside of certain imagery, Speaks of literal events that will happen before the second coming of christ Jesus, the Lord. And recommend that if anybody takes the Bible Literally, They not waste their time and visiting this church. Grace Point is a great place to hear God's word taught on Sunday mornings and to establish a church home. Worship is mostly contemporary and the teachings are solid. There are places for kids, teens, and adults to fit in, learn, and serve. Grace point has been our home church for 14 years.  They do a great job at making you feel like family.  A lot of activities for all age groups.

reviewSummary:
My family and I are so thankful to be a part this wonderful and loving church! We would love to have you join us. Great kids and youth programs and many groups for adults to connect. Sunday mornings include a very welcoming atmosphere, contemporary worship, and expository teaching of God's Word. We got a chance to visit this church on the occasion of Halloween event . We found that event on Facebook and went with our toddler . It was a little rain that evening and we have a huge queue for the entry . They are so nice that they are distributing popcorn while people are waiting in the queue. Once you are inside the church , kids will be amazed to see the games. Our toddler had a lot of fun. Will definitely go again if such event happens Love the atmosphere, but was their 2nd Christmas eve service, when the worship team crossed over from worship to performance. Our ears almost bled. Couldn't even hear the guy who finished up after the pastor. The drummer especially needs a glass cage! Not what you expect at a Christmas Eve service. Sorry, the rest of the service was fine. Bring  your musicians back to worship please. P.S. not an age thing as we had 2 18 year-olds with us and their ears hurt. Expository preaching, intentional worship, a family of God. This is a great place to learn about Jesus and serve others! We visit my brother's fam in NWA & love attending
GPC when we do! So grateful to see my nieces & nephew following Jesus! Thankful for this gospel centered Church!

name: Grace Point Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I walked into Grace Point Church in October, 2018, shortly after moving to Las Vegas and getting a divorce.  I was greeted by several people and felt so welcomed.  It has been my home ever since.  If you are looking for a church that leads, teaches and preaches from the Bible, loves God and loves people (and well), and that you can truly call home, this is the place to be. We are new to Las Vegas. We have been searching for a truthful church that speaks from the bible and not from a political stance or caters to the world. Jesus is the truth, the way and the life. I believe it takes some time to truly understand a church.

reviewSummary: Gracepoint captured my heart 10 years ago and has become like family in the past 3 years. I’ve created wonderful and supportive friendships and the youth program is great for my teens. Pastor Jeff and Pastor Levi have done a great job 👏 My husband and I have been members of Grace Point for 9 years. Bible-centric teaching and unique Sunday school program for kids 1st to 5th grade. My husband has been a Sunday school teacher for as long as we've been attending. The same Bible story is taught 6 different ways and the kids go through the rotation. Often I hear that the kids are the ones that bring the parents to church after attending Sunday school here. This Easter the church had the egg catapult as a unique way for kids to collect Easter eggs. Hot dogs and roasted corn were served for free. Recently the church had Kite day/Sunday funday where there were food and activities for kids including alpacas. When my son invited us to service at Grace Point we came that Sunday and have been coming ever since. It’s a beautiful place to worship and Pastor Jeff is amazing. The love everyone has for Jesus and one another is so moving and brings me to tears every service. You will not be disappointed by coming here. It is no longer a church we visit, it is OUR church and we are proud to be part of the Grace Point family. I was away from God for a few years. One day I took an invite to sit in and visit. The preaching had me feeling like my prayers were answered. A couple of years later,  2 of my daughters & I got baptized. Its been 6 years & we still attend Sunday. My 3rd daughter decided to get baptized when she was 12. Now, I'm just waiting for my 4 year old to decide for herself, hopefully she will. God has filled my life & heart with so many blessings. Nov. 2016- Nov. 2017 All My grandparents passed away... I was hanging by a thread and in that one year mix, I had a sister and 2 close friends pass.... I was in church crying but singing & praising & praying with the prayer teams at the end of each service.  A relationship with GOD is the BEST Gift. Please come.. Join us. May God bless you for so much kindness, it's incredible.’

name: Grace Point Church - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Point Church has been our home church for the past several years. Pastor Vince is a wonderful, engaging teacher of God's Word. He peels back Scripture line-by-line and verse-by-verse each week, speaking the truth with boldness, grace and genuine love. The Gospel is beautifully presented at each service to remind us that we are saved by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone, according to God's word alone, and for his glory alone.

We also really appreciate the newer, monthly "Encore" sessions that allow congregants to come with their questions on what has been taught the past few weeks. And the weekly community groups strengthen our faith walk as we experience life together in a more personal home setting.

We love Grace Point Church and the wonderful family members we gather with at least weekly. It's a true blessing to be able to navigate this life, whether celebrating or struggling, with like-minded people who just want to know, grow, experience and share the love of Jesus within the church and the community as a whole.

I invite anyone looking for a Bible believing, Jesus following church to check Grace Point out! You won't leave without feeling seen and loved. Warm welcome and wonderful worship experience. Gospel message is clearly communicated through insightful and gifted preaching of God's Word. I have been going to this church for one year now .. I was searching for a family friendly close community . This is it …Pastor Vince speaks Bible led messages in a way that is heartfelt and easy to understand. The worship team brings beautiful music to us each week . Community groups meet once a week for Bible study ,prayer and community. This church is growing with young families . Absolutely one of my greatest God led experiences in a church Family feel from the first step in, a wonderful place to meet  and worship our Lord and Savior Jesus. We love the expository preaching-verse by verse from the Bible, the Community Groups where it is open Bibles and open lives,  and the worship. God is on the move in this church plant in Surprise. It's  an amazing family at Grace Point! Always warm and inviting, with people who truly care. A great place to grow in a deeper relationship with Jesus in all the activities and services they have. It is great for all who seek a deeper relationship with Jesus. It is always very welcoming  to all.

name: Grace Point Church San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely place! My kids used to attend musical program, Awana& VBS here! Great people doing great things there! My wife and I and family have been members for 11 years and really love it here.  The teaching is solid, the children's program is well staffed and the people are friendly.  Great new campus with lots of parking.  It is not perfect but neither are we.  I wish we could find a worship leader who would stay for more than 2 years.  We highly recommend joining a small group.  In that way you are truly connected. You won’t regret visiting! We encourage you to come at least 4–5 times so you can truly learn, grow, and experience the amazing sermons and wonderful worship moments.
We also have a great children’s ministry and many dedicated leaders, including our faithful and inspiring Pastor Bob. I do not live in the area, but when I visited Grace point I was impressed with the preaching and the worship music. The people were very friendly and the children s program was great! Sounds like the guy who left one star has an agenda... Churches are not perfect, they all have issues. Where ever you go there will  be things that are not right. This is why we need a point to start at and find God's grace. The members are in incredibly loving and warm, and they have had a significant impact on my spiritual growth.
