name: Grace Point Community Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
Sad that I must start by saying this, but Grace Point hasn't had a member named John Lee since 1998, so I think the negative review is most likely a confused individual for whom I pray for and wish the best. I pray that God will heal his resentment and bitterness.

That being said, I have been attending Grace Point since its founding. I have traveled to Paraguay, China, Haiti, and countless inner cities for missions trips and charity work, all at the cost of the church members themselves. If that makes you lose love then you might be looking in the wrong areas.

Every visitor that comes in is welcomed personally and engaged and prayed for. I have been through so many ups and downs in my life, all of which Grace Point has been there to support me. I was married at this church, I was jobless at this church, I was hopeless at this church, and yet I found the encouragement and strength to move on because of this church. They are truly like family.

What sets Grace Point up differently than any church I've been to (and I have literally been across the globe), is their authenticity and commitment to the Lord's commission. They make it a point to stick to scripture. Their mission is to lead people into a growing love relationship with Jesus Christ, and create environments where the feel accepted as they are, and loved for who they are in their innate being. They follow it to the detail. They meet weekly to this end. They share their resources and earnings to help each other. I have not known a true church of Acts as of yet except for this church. I’m not the kind to write reviews much but for some reason I felt the urge to look at the reviews of this church the other day and I was shocked and sad to read John’s review. I’m not sure what happened back then and I didn’t really know him that well if I’m thinking of the right person, but that has not been my experience at all with GPCC and I’m sorry he had such a negative experience back then. I agree with Josh, my husband, that John’s review is not fair and truly reflective of GPCC, especially now.

I attended GPCC on and off while I was in college out of state and would visit during the holidays and then started attending more regularly after I graduated in 2017. Even back then I felt a sense of comfort and a collective hunger for the word that drew me to want to attend this church whenever I could on my breaks.

Counting those college days, GPCC has been my home church for the past 13 years and the reason why I wanted to become a part of this community in the first place was because of the great love and grace that they showed me even to the young and very immature me back then. Though I am still a work in progress, I thank GPCC for helping me grow and for being a big part of my spiritual journey. Despite my many shortcomings, Grace Point encouraged me and challenged me to be the kind of person and Christian I want to be.

I have seen God moving in GPCC and it is evident that He is at work and I have personally been touched by the love of Christ that the members have reflected on to me and my family. They were always there and willing to help and serve when it came to big life events (moving, marriage, pregnancy, baby shower, etc.). They have showered much love and joy over me and my son even before he was born. I have truly been blessed by this community and encouraged to see how God has been providing for and loving on this church. I loved serving in ministry with them, dabbling in many sports together, communing and fellowshipping in each other’s homes, and worshipping together.

To me they are like family. They are my dear brothers and sisters. I pray and hope that anyone who walks through Grace Point Community Church’s doors will be blessed and come to experience the same or even greater love that I experienced throughout my time here. God is in the midst of her. Atlanta New Life Baptist Church

name: Grace Point Fellowship - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Point Fellowship,located in the foothills community of Yucaipa,California is a Christian fellowship of believers desiring to learn more about God and His grace,mercy and hope for all people.
They have a terrific group of welcoming pastors and staff that teach Gods Word directly from The Bible.
The people who attend Grace Point Fellowship are friendly and welcoming and there are services and Bible studies to suit everyone-for youths,adult and senior adults as well.
Grace Point is terrific place to learn more about The Lord and His gift of redeeming salvation.Answers for life are waiting for you here at Grace Point!
.
.
.
.
#gracepointfellowship #yucaipacalifornia #yucaipablvd #yucaipachurches #god #jesus #holyspirit #thebible #christian #godisgood This place has changed my life. Everyone is so friendly and I love the way Pastor Randy delivers the word. It is truly like family here. When I started to attend Zumba Sculpt classes offered here at no charge, I did not expect that it would be life changing for me. I felt welcomed from the first visit and now, after a year, it feels like home to me. The instructors, Christine and Jamee, are amazing ladies whom I have privilege to know. They've been a perfect example of Christian  purity and devotion that made me into a believer. They are kind, supportive, attentive and real professionals. The music that they use is inspirational and fun, filling me with energy from top to bottom. It's never boring. It's always positive and uplifting. It's a free class with priceless benefits. It's almost too good to be true. I have been going to Zumba/sculpt with Christine and Jamie for almost a year now. I love attending this fun upbeat class where I am able to gather and fellowship with amazing ladies. I have also attended Grace Point Fellowship for the past 3 month and I feel at home listening to Pastor Randy teach us Gods word.  GPF is an amazing family to join! I grew up at the church from when the preschool was still there. I have seen this Church go through a lot, and I can tell you without a doubt that this church is amazing. Ever since Pastor Randy has come, the church has been growing. It’s amazing to see what God is doing in this church.

name: Grace Pointe Church
reviewSummary:
We were at a church for 30 years within Naperville. The very first message was a bit hard to take in.  The pastor gets very excited about teaching so extensively and so wants his congregation to know all Our Lord wants us to know. I had to get used to his excitement and quick speaking ability to fit in all he can. After this I thanked Our Lord for leading us to a church  that speaks God ‘s truth in love.  I teared up feeling as though I were at the feet of an apostle preaching his Lord’s words. I would highly recommend this if you want more. I would recommend if you are yearning to know more about Our Savior. We're considering moving to the Naperville area and choosing a new church is a huge deal for us. We visited Grace Pointe two times and we're so impressed with the friendly people we've met and the heart they have for teaching the Truths of Scripture. How wonderful to meet this part of the Body of Christ! We moved from Arizona and were in need of a new home church. From the moment we walked in the doors we knew this was home. Our children love it here and so do we. The worship and message are always so well thought out.  It’s a wonderful place to grow a new family in Christ and most important to grow in Gods word. Amazing friendly and music like no other ,outstanding church. The youth group here is incredible. I am a sophomore there, and I like it better than school I look forward to youth group every single day! The church is very semi formal and super modern. This is the church that I would bring my non--christian friends too I just love attending Grace Point Church with family. It is home away from home, I am always welcomed with open arms and love.

Pastor Derrick's services are so well taught, strong Biblically based, and with a personal delivery. He is so warmly approchable and I always walk out with new and fulfilling information to apply in my life ( even at 60 there is so much more to be learned)😊

The worship team, staff and members are so great and involved with all; including & making sure that everyone's spiritual needs are met from the infants to the seasoned.  I am always so excited to visit and look forward to new teaching.

The Lord's work is shining mightily in you Pastor Derrick. Thank you all for making me a part of your family.

I just Love you all!

name: Grace Pointe Community Church - Dacula / Hamilton Mill Campus
reviewSummary:
A truly welcoming congregation with sincere worship and expository teaching. I have felt enlightened and encouraged after every visit. Highly recommend! I’ve visited several times and have always had a member introduce themselves and engage me in conversation. The worship is well done and focused on God with modern songs and a few hymns at times. The preaching is spot on Biblical and Spirit filled. I always hear something to think about through the week. Very friendly church! We moved  to the area and we visited recently.
We are  looking for a church to call home.
Liked the vibe of a smaller church that is also a branch of a larger Church name. The minister was Awesome.
Liked the Bible reading, then turned it into our world we live in now.
Thank you for the advice on praying. Every single person I have met is full of the Holy Spirit. The church is welcoming and accepting of all people. It is a small church with a lot of potential to grow. I also love the life groups that are available during the week. Since I have began my walk with the Lord again my life has become significantly better. This church and the people and it have helped me to grow. I enjoyed my time at Grace Point Church. The Pastor they had loved the Lord. Had I not moved back to SC, I would still be attending.

They did something I thought was very special. We were asked to come down to the altar and leave your name on a piece of paper.

You then, pick-up a piece of paper from someone that left prior to you arrive arriving at the altar. The idea was, you could be praying for someone years. That was 2016 for me. I would stop, and start, again in 2017, then again in 2018, and know today, 07/28/2019.

Today, I started back after I arrived home from my own Church. Which is True North Church, in North Augusta, SC. For whatever reason, I felt I need to get on my knees again!

He is in control, I am not, and I'm good with that.

name: Grace Powell Church - Powell / Delaware South Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending since 2016. Pastoral staff - specifically Lead Pastor Jeff Stimpson -  are top notch.  Each provide a gospel-based sermon that's applicable to belief and faith in Jesus Christ. Grace Powell Sports and Grace Powell Kids are perfect programs to raise my children in the church.  All members of The Praise Team have exceptional talent. This is a great church that is really growing. Pastor Jeff delivers the Word in truth and love. We are long term members. We give all the glory to God. This church allows the Holy Spirit to take center stage. When this happens the Body starts to function as God designed it to and people hunger for it. Grace Powell Church is truly a blessing! From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed by the friendly congregation and warm atmosphere. The worship services are powerful, and the messages are always inspiring, rooted in Scripture and relevant to daily life. PastorJeff and the staff genuinely care about the community, and there are so many opportunities to get involved, whether through small groups, youth programs, or outreach efforts. Their childcare program is absolutely amazing, safe, well-organized, and filled with loving staff who genuinely care about the kids. If you're looking for a church that feels like family and helps you grow in your faith, Grace Powell is the place to be! Their teachings are true to the Bible and Pastor Jeff is extremely gifted at delivering God's word. That statement alone is enough to attend church here. In addition to Pastor Jeff, their whole staff is amazing! The production quality of the music is fantastic! It is obvious they put so much planning and detail into everything they do. This is my church for life!

name: Grace Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a solid church with solid, faithful preaching, and devout and kind congregants. This is largely the best church in the area for confessionally-Reformed Christians to visit and join. :)

For those interested: this is a conservative Presbyterian congregation subscribing to the Westminster Standards 1647, rev. 1788 and is a member of the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA); the pulpit has R2K and Amillennial leanings and has active ties to Westminster Seminary California, but also welcomes other conservative, Bible-believing Christians for worship and fellowship and the laity have a diversity of opinions. Lots of young growing families, too, and emphasize catechism and Sunday School attendance. Because Pastor Ben was so welcoming and showed me around his church. Danielle, was so friendly and outgoing, I loved her immediately, I'm looking forward to working with both of them, and especially meeting the children! Biblical in all aspects of worship. Christ centered, not focused on pleasing man. Beautiful biblical worship. The people are terrific - lots of kids. If you're looking for a church that's grounded in the Reformed tradition, look no further. This is the needle in the haystack.

name: Grace Presbyterian Church - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I love Grace Presbyterian Church! It gives us a sense of community, and I feel good raising my kids beside others who share our values of treating everyone with the kindness and equality we all deserve. Everyone is supportive, welcoming and caring. Since joining the church, I have grown in my faith and learned so much from so many different people. The music in the worship service is joyful and moving; the sermons leave me thinking about how to apply Jesus’ teachings to my life today; the kids programming is full of energy. I especially enjoy the discussion in our diversity/equity/inclusion/justice and immigration advocates groups - hearing perspectives from others challenges me to think about how to be a supportive ally to others who are different from me. I haven’t attended services at Grace Presbyterian in quite some time, but I do visit the campus for the annual yard sale, special events, and voting. Even from those interactions, I have not felt the warmth, steadiness, or welcoming atmosphere I look for in a spiritual community. I believe churches should reflect clarity, kindness, and integrity, and I did not experience that here. I hope the leadership will consider how their choices affect families and those seeking a peaceful place to worship. Grace is a place where I hear about the endless love of God, where I am instructed to love my neighbors (ALL my neighbors) and where I am presented with opportunities to serve those neighbors. In this crazy world, Grace is indeed  a beacon  of hope and a place full of love! We love Grace Preschool! The teachers are the sweetest! They treat the kids with so much kindness and love. My son loves it there so much! He’s so engaged and learning something new everyday! Highly recommended!!

name: Grace Presbyterian Church (PCA) - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Church has been such a refreshing change from the typical “concert-style” modern churches. The worship is reverent, the preaching is thoughtful and biblical, and there’s a real sense of history and depth to the place. It feels like church the way church is supposed to feel — focused on God, not production. We’re really grateful to have found it. Seven years ago, my husband and I came for an evening service at Grace PCA, and my heart was truly touched by the beautiful music and heart of the service. It left a huge impact on me. And now, seven years later, we are new members here. Pastor Rhett's preaching is so impactful every Sunday, as he expounds the scriptures to us in such a meaningful way. He truly is a shepherd to those of us in his congregation. He is full of empathy, kindness, and compassion. Each week a family is chosen to be prayed for from the pulpit. We have met many friendly people and have already been invited to someone 's house for a meal. (It helps to make yourself accessible by hanging out in the foyer after the services.) We love the music enhanced with piano and violins, and the choir. Grace is a wonderful church full of wonderful people.  The worship style and format is traditional, focusing on the word of God and on prayer.  The pastors are kind and compassionate men who treasure the word of God and care diligently for their people.  The expository preaching is the best I have ever had the privilege to sit under.  The pastor really has a way of taking passages that are sometimes obscure or difficult to understand and pointing them to Christ. Grace Presbyterian Church has been and continues to be a blessing to both my wife and myself.  The church is committed to the full inspiration and authority of Scripture as it applies to every area of life.  This is a body of God's people where the means of grace are observed including the faithful preaching and teaching of God's Word, the administration of the sacraments, and the exercise of biblical church discipline. The pastor, Rhett Dodson, is very passionate for seeing the Kingdom of God expand throughout the world, and he truly has a pastor's heart for others including this congregation of God's people whom he serves. Throughout the week there are also multiple opportunities for service and fellowship with other members of the congregation. My wife and I began to attend Grace Presbyterian Church in Hudson, a PCA church, in October of 2021. Just recently, we became members.
If you are seeking a church that is traditional in its adherence to scripture and biblical preaching and teaching, a church with intentionality to singing hymns and biblically-sound songs of worship, a church whose pastors have a shepherd's heart, a church that provides opportunities every Sunday following the morning worship service for fellowship, and a church that presents and honors Jesus Christ as Savior and King, then you should consider checking out Grace Presbyterian Church in Hudson.

name: Grace Presbyterian Church & Preschool - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and i love the people here. We have had our three year old here for just over 9 months. He's speech delayed and thus can be a little difficult due to his frustrations in communication but the staff have worked so hard and consistently with him and us to help him every day here's there. We have had him in speech therapy and the staff give us great feedback and work with us and the speech tharapist to make sure our son get's the most out of the work set by the therapist. We get consistent reminders and helpful notes for him and us. We get loads of info on how he's doing every day and at the end of the school year this year we got an entire binder of material to demonstrate the progress made from week one to now.
Frankie, the administrator is such a warm and helpful person, we really appreciate the support and acceptance he brings and manages to keeps us up to date with info and reminders (which for busy parents is a real bonus). Miriam is an incredibly intuitive person with our son, honestly she's just magical to watch work with him and makes drop offs so easy. Denise is our son's go to person, she brings a real sense of care and genuine love for him. Abby is one of the most warm and caring people i've ever met. You can just tell when people seem to be doing something they were put on earth to do and Grace has a few of them.
We could not be happier with the care our son gets here from these amazing people and as they grow i have full confidence they will add more and more absolute stars. We love this preschool. Our daughter has made a lovely group of friends, and the staff is incredible. They are very caring and share a lot of the same values that we have, including parenting and teaching style. I really appreciate how much the staff pays attention to things like daily health and sanitation practices. They are very conscious about this and will go above and beyond to clean and sanitize rooms, toys, equipment, and things regularly. The classrooms are always very clean and orderly, and we appreciate everything that they are teaching our child. Compared to other facilities in the area, Grace was by far our first choice. We are so grateful to have found Grace Presbyterian Preschool. Our son started at Grace about a year ago, and we have seen tremendous growth in him both developmentally and emotionally since then.

The entire staff is truly exceptional. They are experienced, attentive, and genuinely care about every single child and their families. It’s clear that they take the time to get to know each student individually and tailor their approach to meet each child where they are.

What we appreciate most is that they focus not only on academics, but also on helping the children build important values and social-emotional skills they will use in everyday life. The teachers and staff are also incredibly supportive of parents, always offering thoughtful feedback, guidance, and encouragement so we can better support our child’s growth and development at home as well.

We are incredibly thankful for everyone at Grace Preschool and all the love, patience, and dedication they show to the children every day. We feel very lucky to be part of such a caring community. Grace Preschool is a truly wonderful place for young children to learn and grow. The classrooms are bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully organized, creating an engaging environment that supports both learning and play. The teachers are incredibly caring, attentive, and dedicated to each child’s development, making every student feel valued and supported.
One of the things that stands out most is the strong sense of safety and comfort throughout the school. Parents can feel confident knowing their children are in a secure and nurturing environment every day. Most importantly, the children genuinely enjoy being there—you can see it in their smiles and excitement when they arrive.
Grace Preschool is a place where children feel happy, safe, and inspired, and it’s clear that both the staff and environment play a big role in that positive experience. Grace has been a blessing for us in so many ways. It is a friendly church that loves the LORD and serves Him in so many ways. We love how Grace has an after school tutoring program for the local elementary school. It offers food distribution on two mornings each week and a sack dinner once a week. We love seeing the children have fun, learn about Jesus and receive a Bible at Vacation Bible Camp. Frankie Zavala is our Preschool Director and has brought an exceptional Biblical Education to the sweet preschoolers. Love hearing their laughter and seeing their huge smiles on the playground when we are going to our Thursday Morning Bible Study.
Ken and Tricia Sanger

name: Grace United Methodist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
City of Pasadena Cultural Heritage Landmark - Architect: C.A. Dudley - 1905.
The church combines the Victorian Gothic style with the Mission Revival to create a religious structure which creates a visual focal point on this residential street. The design takes full advantage of the corner siting by placing the tower on the south west property edge and using the street as the open space by which to view the structure in total.
While the main body of the single story building has a cross-gabled roof, the two story tower has a tiled hipped roof with stepped projections on each corner. The gabled roof has overhanging eaves with prominent brackets. These brackets are also found under the tower. The triple lancet pointed Gothic windows are a prominent feature of the church and are found on both the southern and western facades of the building. The triple lancet Gothic windows are reinterpreted on the tower. Other windows around the building are rectangular, some divided across the top, and some with small diamond-shaped panes. Peaceful. Position partial to its pastor. History. I believe God led me here in 1983 for a future work I'm seeking now against discrimination.

name: Gracepoint Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are searching for a Church, or are thinking about changing, I would recommend checking GracePoint Church out in Chino. GracePoint has a friendly atmosphere, people are friendly and very welcoming.

We had searched for a Church and did not care for large or mega churches because we did not feel comfortable at those places and large crowds. Then we found GracePoint, which has been our home now for many years. The Church Family is very supportive and loving as one would expect from a Christian Church. Don't be surprised if someone offers you to bring you food if you're sick.

Pastor Steve's messages are not boring, but rather very informative and easy to understand. He includes jokes, stories and steps we can include in our daily lives to help and love on others. I try to be loving to people at work, but they make it hard sometimes ;-)

The worship songs are diverse and change frequently to accompany the sermon series and message. Common worship songs are part of the sets and hymns from time to time, but my favorites songs are the modern ones (written by David Crowder).

I would recommend checking GracePoint out to anyone (and have), come by at least two times, it grows on you the more often you come. You can watch online, but the live experience is always better, less distractions like pets, kids, neighbor. We drive 20 minutes to attend, but I think it's well worth it. Others come from even farther away and drive up to an hour. That should say something about this Church, right? At Gracepoint, I've found a true sense of home and belonging. Unlike past experiences, I feel accepted and free to be myself while growing closer to God. The caring community here has made all the difference in my spiritual journey. It truly is a place to know God, be known, and find belonging. My family and I started attending this church when I was little. Eventually, I grew up and I went away for college. When I was away, I struggled to find a church because I enjoyed so many aspects of GracePoint.

I missed:
•  the pastor, as he has relatable messages and encourages fun, even during sermons
(ie. during summer, sometimes we watch movie clips in service, called “Flicker of Faith”)
•  the upbeat worship, with mix of hymns
•  the (small) caring community
•  the weekly meetings / home church, where we catch up, pray for our week, and talk about God.
•  how easy it was to get involved / volunteer
•  the casual atmosphere

During the pandemic, GracePoint moved from an elementary school to a permanent building in Chino, making them farther from me. I still choose to drive the extra miles every Sunday because I miss so much, and nothing can replace the community’s love and support that they have for me.

I hope you come visit us for an event and see how accepting the people here are for yourself.
My favorite event is probably the Trunk-or-Treat on Halloween night (which has been going on since at least 2010!). I LOVE THIS PLACE!! Every Sunday I always learn something new. I love that Pastor Steve never shy away from important or typically taboo topics. He is always very intentional with everything he’s talks about. I love the time of fellowship and how personable everyone is, you can really get to know people. It feels safe and like home. I have never felt judged, only ever welcomed and invited. My family loves GracePoint!  It was my home church for 18+ years. The only reason we are not there today is because the leaders built us up so much that I am now serving in full-time ministry at another location. The relationships formed there are lifelong.

GracePoint lives up to its vision of being a place anyone “can know God, be known, and find belonging.” Pastor Steve teaches in a way that is relatable and easy to understand no matter where someone is in their walk with God. I always learned something or got a better perspective each Sunday. Community is a central part of GracePoint’s identity, so people really take the time to get to know you and pray for you. I always felt like I had a group of people in “my corner” who were rooting for me.

The church is not flashy, but the quality is there. The worship is genuine and the people are filled with joy. Again, I am ministering today, much in part because of my positive experience at GracePoint. I definitely recommend visiting a few times and considering joining permanently.

1 John 4:7-8 (NIV)

This is a progressive, diverse, and LGBTQ+ affirming congregation (approx. 40-50 folks by my estimate). If you lean traditional/conservative, GracePointe isn't likely to be your first choice. Conversely, if you lean left/progressive, you're likely to leave GracePointe finding it having been worth the visit! This church has become my family. I feel so blessed to have found this community, & truly have never felt more welcome in a church environment. They are doing something few churches are brave enough to do, which is stand for LOVE above all else. At GracePointe, everyone has a seat at the table. name: Greater Life Church - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary:
★★★★★
Greater Life is a welcoming church for everyone. It’s a diverse, multi-ethnic congregation made up of people from many backgrounds and ages. The atmosphere is modern, spacious, warm, and inviting from the moment you walk in. There’s a strong sense of community, and it’s clear that people genuinely care for one another - whether they’ve attended for years or are attending for the first time.

There are many things that make Greater Life special, but one thing that especially stands out is how the people of the church make free food available every Sunday, creating a welcoming space where people can gather, connect, and build community.

The pastor and leadership team are excellent and lead with authenticity and care. If you’re looking for a church where you can find community and feel welcomed, this is a great place to call home. My family and I have been attending Greater Life for almost 6 years and the experience has been absolutely life changing. Pastor Glick has taught me how to pray, love, and live as the man God created me to be. I owe everything good in my life today to the ministry, love, and care I've received at Greater Life. I simply would not know Jesus without Greater Life! If you want to know Jesus, there is not better place for you and your family to be! I stepped foot in this church about 3 years ago and never looked back. I can’t explain the peace, love, and joy that is poured into you once you step into this place. The peace, love, and joy I was so desperately searching for in all the wrong things and found in an instance by just being in the PRESENCE OF THE LORD. You truly just have to experience it yourself.

Pastor Jeffrey Glick and First Lady Kendra Glick along with the rest of the Elders are true to the Word and truly show what it means to live in humility, love, and serving others. This is not a place where you have no connection to the Elders and leadership that preaches on the stage. They care for you. They want to carry the burden with you. This review is an edit.
MIRACLE ON THE BAY!
I was invited by a friend on a Sunday, and needless to say, I never left! I never felt judged here, so many sweet like minded people. I see the power of prayer in the lovely flock. Pastor Glick is always on point and reads out of the Bible. I was actually baptized here and always will have a place in my heart. Thank you Greater Life, you made MY life a GREATER LIFE! The Pastor cares deeply about his flock. They have truly been blessed by God and called to the Bay Area to transform the peninsula with spreading the love and good news of Christ. There is no judgement here, only love flowing from this congregation. Come as you are. Be renewed in faith. See miracles and meet people hungry to know and grow in the Lord

Kids Sunday school and child care are awesome. We are so blessed to be part of the Family. We are praying to grow more in the Lord and his people.  To God be the Glory Amen I was invited to GLC 2weeks ago. From the time I walked into the building, I felt accepted. Honestly I was nervous, because I was a visitor. From the get go the members were very friendly and hospitable. While sitting there before the service, a man walked up to me and said, " who are you"?. My girlfriend turned to me and said, " that's Pastor Byrd". I don't know if God led him to walk over to me, but I'd like to think he did. The service was easy to follow, due to Pastor Byrd's ability to just be a normal guyThe message is straight from the Bible. I've had a lot of opinions about "church" in the past, but the invitation to this church was a blessing. This past Sunday, I sat with tears in my eyes as I watched the baptism ceremony. After the last sign up was baptized, Pastor Byrd said, " Don't wait and regret". At that moment, I kicked off my shoes, walked the aisle and was baptized myself. Though I live an hour away, I plan on being at GLC as much as I possibly can. Heck I've traveled across the country for a concert... Driving an hour for fellowship and the word of God is worth it. Grateful for the invitation and grateful for GLC.

While some may be going through the motions and stagnant in Christ, it's not likely they would remain there with regular attendance!
The works behind the scenes is quite the production and the message was direct and simple. Just what we need! I could tear down many other partial aspects like masking and whatnot is similar to the Hebrews in Samuel wanting a king, but it's very much understandable. That kinda faith is beyond most. Even the Hebrews that were witness to far greater!
The dynamic here is indeed sound and while the youth refers to places like this as karaoke and a Ted talk, last I checked Ted talks are in the $$$$$/seat range. Then again the youth, is known for its hasty stoooopid or at least I was😏!
Had a great time, felt very welcome though I spoke little Chinese, and hope to return if in in the area!
Tyvm for the church of this congregation for such a meaningful impact on my wife's first real He is risen celebration! Lots of parking. Free to go homemade lunch for 1st time visitors, $ 3.00 thereafter. Hot coffee and tea offered in the breeze way. 3 services on campus offered in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin. A.W.A.N.A. on Friday evening. The congregations  fellowship of hospitality and spiritual greetings blessed our walk with Christ. The Dave Ramsey financial study led us in our tithing and enriched our family through scripture. GPCC, offers Sunday afternoon  bilingual classes for a fee. Where we quickly registered our child. We departed GPCC with our souls, spirits, and bodies filled by the Holy Spirit. This campus has an amazing children's playground,  all fenced in and benches for guardians and fans! Tons of parking. name: Greater Trinity Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Google Maps had great pictures of my destination which were perfect landmarks to get me to my destination quickly and safely Warm and welcoming to everyone. To praise God in the house of the Lord. I love coming to Church services on Sunday and everyone is so polite and nice they also have services throughout the week. You can feel the love  and everyone is treated  like family. Come and join us. The church has been around for along time. And we welcome everyone. I  have recently accepted Jesus Christ as my personal Lord and savior and was Baptized here. I'm a member myself and enjoy my new church family. Come by and check us out and if you like to your welcome to join our church family and make this your new church home. This church is so friendly and loving. I highly recommend you attend. The Pastor and First Lady are very kind and genuine. This is in no doubt and God loving God fearing doctrine teaching church! This is where I grew up. At this church with my aunty connie I was there for a funeral,not a happy time

name: Greater Tulane Baptist Church - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church in Downtown New Orleans. Between Canal & Bienville, 214 N Johnson St. The host Pastor is well spoken and very versed in his biblical knowledge and language.

I personally know this church to be very active in the community, as I recently saw a toy drive for the youth... Gotta love a church that does it up for the youth.

Quite spacious in nature. Not sure of the year if it's construction, but it's an older building. There's even a stair chair to accommodate a person unable to climb the stairs to gain access to the main sanctuary.

On this occasion, my dad, Rev Wardell Brown was preaching a sermon entitled "I have a Lamb" on the Sunday before Christmas. I found the sermon to be very befitting; he did a GREAT JOB.

Friendly people at the church. Ample parking. Greater Tulane Missionary Baptist Church is great. where we share in the community. Rev. Hosia Gardner, Jr., Pastor Had a great Spiritual awaking on Sunday morning Testimonial service. Praise God for His Goodness and His everlasting love The Lord has provided. Great service

name: Greater Works Christian Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: There is no doubt God is in Greater Works Church. On my several visitations I have always felt at home.  If it were not for my membership at my first love, Second Baptist Church I would be a servant member under Pastor Clayton.  What a great group of loving people.  I say to you,"Keep your mind stayed on Jesus and he will see you through." Its a place of worship. You can go and learn about our Lord and savior. You can get your soul saved... I love my church its bout learning n having fun in Lord n they treat u lije family The Lord is great and mighty. Love it

name: Green Hill Church - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary:
Loved visiting this church while we were in town for Easter. The Congregation made our family feel welcomed and at home. The Pastor relayed a powerful message with scripture. All around great visit. Will definitely be back next time we are in Tennessee. Been a long time member, great church and amazing community! Greenhill Church is a wonderful experience to walk into. A community of warmth and genuine love and hope. A message thoughtful, relevant, and rooted in Scripture. Whether you're looking for a place to grow in your faith or simply need a space to reflect and recharge, this church offers something special. Highly recommend to anyone seeking a strong, supportive spiritual community. Always a welcome back feeling.  Great staff. Great groups. And services are fabulous Wonderful community in North Mt. Juliet. I've gotten to know this church through Green Hill Sports Association, a youth football program that the church allows to practice on their property.

This church is embraced by the community and truly demonstrates what Christianity is about.

name: Green Hills Community Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming. We really enjoyed speaking with Pastor Charles Moore. You see, he had married us almost 30 years ago. 'Chaz' as he was once known has not changed a bit. By that I mean; a man who closely knows Jesus and demonstrates it by his example. It was so good to reconnect. Friendly and welcoming. The message was encouraging and challenging. Great

name: Green Mountain Christian Church - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary: GMCC is a friendly group of Christians who love the Lord and each other.  Their sermons are Bible-based and their worship is genuine.  They are a small conservative congregation who are striving to grow spiritually and physically, and they welcome all who want to learn, worship and serve.  Even though this listing says they have a food box ministry, they do not have one now. This is a very friendly and super welcoming church. The Pastor always has a great message and they do a wonderful job catering to young adults. (Particularily college students) that want to get invloved. Live nearby.  So nice to have the church so close.  I went to elementary school here in the 70's when this was Sun Valley Elementary.  Lots of neighborhood history. I missed your building, I was a student from RMDS Nice atmosphere and people

name: Green Street Baptist Church - Main Campus
Green Valley Baptist Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
Going to church doesn't make you any better than those who don't go to church. You go to church simply because you want to. My Wife and I share our love for Green Valley Baptist Church in Henderson, Nevada. Not only do we cherish the Lead Pastor' Calvin Whittman's sermon every Sunday, but also the love and friendship you get from members and attendees. Pastor Jacob and his band and singers are the best! The Church Staff work so hard to bring it all together. THANK JESUS FOR THIS CHURCH. I had a very disappointing experience at this church's summer camp. During camp, I witnessed what I believed to be nonconsensual inappropriate sexual contact when I saw one camper touch another camper's genitals. I immediately reported what I had seen to a youth leader because I felt it was serious.

Later, a meeting was held with the people involved and church leaders. From my perspective, the situation was not handled appropriately. I felt the discussion was not private enough, and I left believing that my concerns were not taken seriously. Both the abused camper and I told the same story, but after talking for some time, I believed the person who was touched wrongly got embarrassed and said he probably touched me by accident, the same thing that horrible person said. After that, I was also told that I could be sent home if I continued "looking for bad" in the other camper, even though I believed I was simply reporting what I had witnessed. Everyone present was also instructed not to discuss the incident with others because the case was "Closed".

Because of this experience, I lost confidence in how the church handled a report involving possible inappropriate conduct between minors. I expected the situation to be taken seriously and handled with greater care. I also personally witnessed behavior by the same camper toward other girls that I considered inappropriate, which added to my concerns. Excellent Bible preaching and excellent teaching in Sunday school for both adults and children.  This church is a praying church and has many outreach programs for the community like AWANAS and the Living Nativity.  Come and see for yourself and God bless you.  🎶 I love the motherhood group. Even though this church is large,  we got connected with fellowship instantly. So much support for young families. Awesome music and very energetic guy on the stage. Parking was somewhat limited. Seats in the auditorium are comfortable and ample but bring your own water as there are no servers. Good vibes.

name: Green Valley Church - Hoover Campus
reviewSummary: Came here for Fortify 25 and the facility was awesome! Everything was clean and the sound in the worship center was on point! What time does church start I don’t want to miss worship Great experience with upward basketball... great program!!!! Big, beautiful church. They always make us feel so welcome. Great service and the things they do for needy people is truly remarkable. Thank you for sharing your beautiful facilities for my nephew's after rehearsal dinner. First class.

name: Green Valley Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Love the Mom to a mom group held by amazing Mrs. Kristy Dillon ! Her love and dedication to all of these mothers from all walks of life is amazing ! An honor to learn and share in this group full of wonderful loving mommy’s ! I drive from Escondido ca. because it’s a must ! Prayer and community is what God intends for us to be in ! Right? Isn’t that the goal! Retired Police officer recommends it !!! There is a childcare room that is clean and spacious and trusting ! Kudos to our kids daycare ladies 💜💜💜 This church is great whether your looking to find out about Jesus,  new in the faith or a long time believer. Friendly people from the get go, worship that stirs your heart for Him. Preaching from the Word by great communicator Pastor Doug Kyle.  You will grow like my family has at Green Valley 💚 Great contemporary worship music including some timeless hymns.  Messages are faithful to the Bible and applicable to our daily life.  I love the complete range of ages in the congregation and the active Children's and Youth Ministries.  I'm amazed at the high percentage of people that attend one of the many "Green House" (home group) meetings during the week. Been attending Green Valley for 7 years, we love the church, the messages and worship music, the friendly atmosphere and genuine connections that people make.  An evangelical church with bible-based sermons relevant to San Diego lives.  Several ways to grow in Christ and grow your faith and understanding. One word, THE BEST. If you really want to grow as a Christian, this is your church. The staff are down to earth, super friendly, and are only beat by the most genuine Passor's around who actually know their congregation

name: Green Valley Church of Christ - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: I am enjoying the fellowship and honored to be doing the Lord's work! This Church is amazing. I moved here a few years ago and this church has become a family to me. Paster Gary is a compassionate and caring Paster and he teaches straight from the Bible. I have seen them pray for me and my family and I have seem how God is working and changing lives in this church. I’m so glad and proud to be a member. This is a friendly congregation and the truth is taught here! I was welcomed in like family and was truly blessed. I enjoyed the service. May go back, I am currently searching for a home church.

name: Green Valley Evangelical Lutheran Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: We found GVELC a little over four years ago and couldn’t be happier.  We are a young family and sometimes it seems difficult to add things onto the calendar, but what we get from our Sundays at church goes beyond everything else.  Our two little Children also love attending the Sunday School program and the attached school to the church and seeing many of their teachers and classmates at services and events. We have finally found our church! After years of searching, we have finally found our home church. Our kids also go to the school and they absolutely love it! Pastor Rideger is wonderful! We are so happy to have him! The Gospel is indeed preached every Sunday with Jesus as the center of each worship service. It is at Green Valley Evangelical Lutheran Church my spiritual growth began in earnest and a close relationship with the Lord was established for the first time in my life. For which I am, and will be, forever grateful. My husband and and I have been attending GVLC for several months and plan to become members very soon. We like BOTH Pastors very much and feel very blessed to have found THIS CHURCH! My husband was raised Catholic, but really feels comfortable in THIS LUTHERAN Church, AND with BOTH Pastors Pieper, and Kolander. Thank you for this “Online Easter Service”! A church where everyone fits in. Jeans or your Sunday best,  it doesn't matter, Jesus just wants you there. Don't miss our Easter egg for kids at GVELC, April 20th, 9am-11:30am. Easter brunch will be served at 9am and 11:30am Easter morning. Come join us as we praise God's word. Happy Easter everyone. He is risen.

name: Green Valley Presbyterian Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
My first visit this week was very pleasant. I found the sanctuary to be set up in a welcoming manner. It has a full musical technical support system. Plenty of traditional seating. Programs were printed and provided.

People were welcoming and friendly. Parking was tight so a gravel overflow lot was available.

Observe the videos and pictures for more details. I was invited by a coworker to attend service and was pleasantly surprised at the VERY warm welcome that I received. Everyone is so nice, and a lot took the time to say hello to a new face. Pastor Doll is an amazing pastor who actually teaches from God's word. If you want a family type environment where you really learn about God and His teachings, Green Valley Presbyterian Church is a great place. THANK YOU for making me feel welcome!!!!! A friendly, traditional Presbyterian church. Pastors are informative and inspirational. Came here thinking it’s a Christian Church but found out the complete opposite. Within the first 10 minutes they had a Jewish woman who IS a Rabbi teaching the people/children Jewish customs. Rabbis do not believe in Christ, they are ANTI Christ. Apparently, she will also be teaching the children long-term! If you have children, please do not bring them here. If you are a true believer, do not come here.

I will redirect you to Las Vegas Reformed Presbyterian Church, very lovely people and SOUND DOCTRINE. 10/10 would recommend. This is not a Christian church, me and my wife attended and they had a woman Jewish rabbi teaching about Jewish customs to the Church and the children. My suggestion is to not attend if you are a true believer in Christ.

name: Greenbriar Church - Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Love it! Best youth programs and children's church I've ever seen! Great service! Highly recommend I love this church! Speak on biblical truth. The elders are wonderful. I am at home here. Thankful for this church and for what God has done. Come join us every sundays 10am-11:30am. The best church I have ever attended. The people are so welcoming. The preacher addresses issues that are facing us right now. The music is amazing.....I love it here. This was my voting Precinct. Although I have been to their church services before. It is a standard Baptist Church. But they do have awesome music! And a really cool  kitchen area, lol Great place to worship, great Christian fellowship. If you are looking for answers to life's questions Pastor Jim is a knowledgeable man who will help you find the answer and continue to walk life with you.

name: Greensboro Christian Church - Greensboro Campus
reviewSummary: This church is now Unity Christian Church. Pastor James Lacewell gave such an amazing word.  Very loving congregation.   If you're looking for a church home look no further than Unity Christian Church People there are so friendly. I don't have what would be a traditional family make up but people didn't care about our color, clothes etc. They were so welcoming Wonderful church to be a part of. I thank this church so much for all they did during my family's time of need. All my love to you all. Such a welcoming place from the moment you walk in! If you desire a caring faith family then Greensboro Christian Church is the place for you. great, close knit community where discipleship is central and serving others all for God's glory is evident

name: Greenville Christian Fellowship - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
The Greenville Christian Fellowship is not just a comfortable church building. It's a family of believers who love and care for one another as we learn to love our Lord Jesus Christ more daily. The messages encourage us to press to the mark of the high calling of Jesus Christ, and the music is beautifully traditional. Please come visit. I've appreciated this Church for the last 9 years. Strongly recommend it for anyone who wants a Church that still holds to the
authority, inerrancy, and sufficiency of Scripture, as well as substitutionary
atonement. Pastor Barret has a healthy emphasis on sound doctrine, love for God and others, and a life pattern of worship and holiness. Our family first attended GCF several years ago hoping to find a church that took the Gospel seriously and encouraged us to grow. We not only found that, but also a sincere and loving community of Christian believers who together are seeking to become more like Jesus.

If you are looking for a church home, or even if you're just curious about Christianity, we'd love to see you this Sunday. Very welcoming.  People are very friendly.  Sunday school classes for all ages. Excellent place for worshipping and fellowship. Thrive Youth  Group for teens. All are welcome. Please join us for a service and experience it for yourself! I have enjoyed a couple of their men's study group on Thursday nights.  The pastor is wise and insightful.
I am a visitor from another church.

Blessings,
John 20:29

name: Greenville Community Church - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church that feels like home the moment you walk in, Greenville Community Church is it. The people are genuinely friendly, not in a surface-level way, but in that “we care about your life” kind of way. Every message is deeply rooted in the Bible, delivered with clarity, humility, and purpose. You can tell they don’t just talk about faith, but they live it.

What makes this church stand out even more is how much they love the city. They support local families, serve in tangible ways, and rally behind organizations making a difference here and around the world. From caring for the homeless in Greenville to empowering ministries abroad, GCC is a place where faith meets action.

It’s not just a church. It’s a movement of love, truth, and hope. Go once, and you’ll want to stay :) I cannot say enough good things about this church family, because that's truly what it is to us. We have been challenged and encouraged in our faith, built relationships that will last a lifetime, and been pushed to serve and love others well. When our family felt led to go overseas for missions work, GCC supported us completely. Not only as a broad church family, but as individuals that we know and love. We would not be here in Taiwan without the support and prayers of our church. You will not meet pastors who love better and lead with more humbleness and intentionality than Michael and Mike do. If you go once, you will feel the love for each other and for God that radiates from the people there. It is a beautiful example of the bride of Christ. Greenville Community Church has truly become home for our family. I’ve seen firsthand how deeply this church loves Jesus, families, and our city. As someone who serves in Family Ministries, I’m continually encouraged by the way our people show up for one another and create a space where kids, parents, and volunteers can all grow in faith together. So grateful to be part of what God is doing here! My family has absolutely loved our time at GCC. If you’re looking for a Biblically sound teaching, a welcoming church community and a family friendly environment, Greenville Community Church is it. GCC also has a growing children’s ministry with staff and volunteers who are pouring into my kids weekly and showing them the love of Jesus. I couldn’t ask for a better church for my family to be involved in. The most wonderful community of believers I have ever been a part of. My children are learning about the Lord every week and my husband and I have grown closer to the Lord and each other through the teaching and community groups. We love GCC!

name: Greenwood Christian Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely amazing church! Have been going here since I was a kid! Just recently started going back and everyone that goes are awesome people! 😎 Wonderful church! Great people who love our Lord.
I've been a member of Greenwood since 2011 and love it so much. Look forward to each service, attend an awesome small group on Wednesday evening and have met some amazing people there who feel like family to me. Very friendly, accepting congregation...good singing and great preaching....great kids church and nursery. Everyone makes you feel welcome and included! The friendliest church ever .like family

name: Greenwood Christian Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Greenwood Christian Church is amazing! So welcoming to all - especially first-time guests and visitors.  It is easy to find what you need or a person to help answer your questions!  Getting plugged in through classes or small groups is encouraged to help you connect with others.  Serving at the church in student ministry and on the host team has brought me great joy.  Our family loves being part of the GCC family! Greenwood Christian Church is filled with friendly volunteers and staff who make it easy to feel at home from the moment you walk through the doors. I first found GCC while I was attending college in Indianapolis, and now my family drives more than an hour every Sunday to be part of this church family. It's been a place where we've found community, grown in our faith, and built meaningful relationships. Struggling to find a church for our family, they have welcomed us with open arms. My daughter loves their Sunday school and we love the service each and every week. Great singers and music production as well. Highly recommend to those struggling to find a church that fits a family Great food great people great place

Sorry this Willy I didn't mean to leave so quick Very welcoming and friendly environment. Enjoyed the sermon. GCC has a lot to offer to all that are wanting to grow and learn. Looking for to my next visit.

name: Greenwood Community Church - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to GCC now for 10 months and I have not skipped a Sunday!  If you are looking for a church with very high community inside and out this is your place.  Need to build a community? Friendships?  Single, married, divorced, men, women, w or w/o kids.  Want to get involved with volunteering?  Ready to really build an understanding of Gods love and who Jesus was through bible study, small groups, mission work in and out of the country?  Please join us.  The pastors are incredibly thought provoking. The band is incredible.  Come sing your heart out with us! Communion every Sunday, with your children.  Don’t get me going on all the things available for kids.  All walks of life please come.  We are all loved and deserve joy and peace. All ages!! I've been going here about 2 years now with my 10yo son and really enjoy it. My parents have also joined since. It had been 10 years since I had a regular church home, and I'm grateful I found this one. Strong community, a lot of discipleship, small groups, classes, strong middle school and high school program, childcare and sunday school always available for littles as well. Pastoral team is great, and the sermons are always excellent. A lot of spiritual growth opportunities, and great opportunities for connection with others on a similar path. This was my first time attending this church. This was one of the most welcoming churches I have been to in a long time. The lead pastor shared a great message in the church service. I will definitely be back! Thank you everyone for making me feel welcomed! We have been at Greenwood for many years. It's a great body of believers who support each other well. Great worship and solid Bible teaching. You will enjoy this church! Great church, awesome Sunday worship!!

name: Grove Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely amazing church and congregation. They make you feel completely welcome from jump and their outreach programs are completely selfless and tremendous.

John is the most down to earth, caring pastor I’ve ever met. We tried several churches after we left our church we were going to for 15 years. The moment we walked through the door we knew we were home. 🏠 If you are searching for for a real Christ loving, strong family this church is for you. Don’t delay, salvation and God’s love are manifested in this family. My sincere appreciation goes to the Hoffman’s and the community they’ve created. 🙏✝️🇺🇸 I've been attending The Grove church for 4.5years and I can honestly say, this church has such a beautiful heart for Jesus.  It's easy to come in and judge churches sometimes forgetting that everyone in the church is broken. We are all human.   We all make mistakes and no matter how hard you try, you can't please everyone.  I've been guilty of judging churches myself and God proved me wrong in every judgment I tried to have.

I can attest the leadership is incredible and authentic.  We are not there to play church, but to be the church.  There is so much love and support.  The church has grown a ton since I've been going and the way to get connected with people is to attend a Growth Group which they have 3x per year for a series of weeks.  It's a great way to get to know people on a deeper level and to dig into the Word even more.  I've also had the pleasure of serving on the worship team.  Not only have I grown SO much spiritually at this church, but I have grown in the gift that God has given me.  I'm so grateful for The Grove.  God is using this church in a huge way.   The very church I got baptized at. Every one is incredible and so friendly. Their focus on their youth ministry is so important. God bless. Very welcoming. After a few visits, we knew we found our church home. A few weeks later we felt like family. The grove church has the best bible-based teaching I have ever heard. I attend every Sunday and when I can't, I watch online so I don't miss anything. The people here are so welcoming and outgoing, it makes it so fun and easy to get connected and get involved. I have especially loved their children's ministry. I have three kids and they LOVE going to their classes and Cara, the director is so great! She communicates so well and is so caring about our kids and family! I would highly recommend this church to anyone looking to get connected and deepen their relationship with the Lord.

name: Guardian Angels Catholic Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting from Eastlake (Chula Vista) and when a choir member asked parishioners if anyone is visiting and I raised my hand and told them I’m from Eastlake, the whole church not only gave me a “warm welcome” but also applauded.

This parish are very welcoming and very kind, I plan to visit again soon on my next visit to Santee! Very welcoming every time we visit. My little ones love going to the family mass at 10am. This is a wonderful, caring church. I went to this church for a year and a half when I would come visit my mom in Santee when she was very sick. When my mom passed away last month everyone was so compassionate and they helped me plan my mom's funeral, it was a beautiful Mass. Father Andre, Patti in the office, Kathy the funeral director and the women's guild who provided the lunch were all so amazing, I could feel God's love through them during this difficult time. This will definitely be my church home when I come to visit family in Santee. Attended the Lokahi Festival 2024 - great food! Had the poke and ube cookies. Chula Vista hula troop had a wonderful performance, showed all ages could dance hula. Something for everyone with lei-making demonstrations and tattoo booth in air-conditioned hall, nice place to chill from the heat. Swap meet stalls had lots of local crafts and foods. A little bit of Hawaii in the middle of Santee. Priest is awesome with awesome sermons. The parishioners need a lot of work. They talk aloud in there with other parishioners, not taking into consideration when you are praying or meditating. I hate to say this, but they are not too friendly either. May God change their attitudes, especially in his house. You have my prayers.

name: Guide Church - North Campus - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary:
Was a relatively new attendee and one of the pastors took me out to dinner thinking it was just to get to know me. Over the course of the meal the pastor and his wife gave this pre-packaged message about me needing to be saved right now. I was pressured to pray this scripted prayer so I could leave that dinner knowing I would go to heaven. Little did they know, I have been a Christian my entire life, and have been saved since I was a teenager. This entire effort felt like staged evangelism where the church was more interested in adding to their “number of people saved this year” total. I fear this church is motivated by attendance counts and Sunday morning entertainment productions rather than sharing the gospel. Impassioned minister. Relatable staff and friendly people. I have attended here several times and everytime I am warmly welcomed. Guide Church is a great place to go to hear the truth of God's Word in practical ways.  The people there are real - they don't pretend to have it all together and it's refreshing! I don't feel like I have to be "good enough" to come and I can be myself.  There are so many opportunities the church provides to help me grow in my spiritual journey throughout the week.  The children's program teaching the kids in ways that they can understand and apply to their lives.  It doesn't matter if you've never been to church before, or if you grew up in church, Guide Church is a wonderful place to go to learn more about how to live for God in a practical way.  I encourage you to come on a Sunday to see for yourself! I love this church so much. I started going November of 2022 right before the move to the new location. The people you meet are all genuinely interested in accepting you to the church, making you feel welcome, and to become closer with God. I love the aspect of note taking and learning that Ben incorporates into each service. GKidz is wonderful for when you have a little one but want to pay attention in the service. It’s a wonderful place to be and grow your relationship with God. I found this church to be very good for both the young and old, singles and families.  After attending for a few Sundays it was apparent that this church teaches God's word and encourages the members to grow in their spiritual faith through small groups, serving, and fellowship.  The children seemed to have a great time in the kids area with the curriculum and the leaders.

If you are looking for your first church or for a new church, you owe it to yourself to stop in to one of the two services, and you can make it your forever church.

name: Gulf Coast Christian Church - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I had such a great time this past weekend being with our brothers and sisters! Fellowship camping at Lake Corpus Christi State Park and then an amazing Spirit lead service Sunday morning at the Mesquite Pavillion!
Nate & Waldina Bigbee are amazing leaders and can't wait to visit y'all at GC3 in the near future!
If you're looking for a church to worship God, you'll love it at GC3! My experience at Gulf Coast Christian Church has been life changing and amazing. I have met so many wonderful loving people and learned so much about Jesus and his love for me! Love, faith, conviction, and truth are the cornerstones of this awesome church. This church has helped with my relationship with God immensely. It feels like a family as everyone is so welcoming and friendly. Last weekend I got to meet the Gulf Coast Christian Church at a special park service. This is a church of people who love God and each other, and they take the Scriptures seriously. It’s a great church to go to to build your faith and to bring the whole family to! I've love this church! I first was invited to attend in Jan. 2018(I think), still attending in 2020 (virtually). I was baptized the end of February 2018, after studying the bible with a group of wonderful ladies who I call friends. God is so great y'all!

name: Gulf Coast Christian Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: Had a great visit with Gulf Coast Christian Church.  That visit turned into a new church home! Are you looking for a church that has a servant leadership heart? Come visit, I can't wait to meet you! I have been going to this Church for about 2 years. I am very close to the staff and they are very friendly to everyone. They are the people that helped me get closer to God. I will always go here for church until I die. This church welcomed me with opened arms when I needed my community the most. The spirit of God is truly alive and living in this church!! I have been going to Gulf Coast Christian church for over 5 years. I was rebaptisted by Scott , an elder of the church.God gave me a blessing of my not having to be on oxygen all the time. Thank God and. Jesus hold me in their arms. Amen. Gulf Coast made us feel like family from the moment we walked in. The teaching is easy to comprehend and apply. God blessed me to an amazing family in Gulf Coast and I am so thankful.

name: GV Christian Center - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church since 1992, when my sister first invited me. I was pregnant with my son at the time, and I’ve been here ever since. What started as an invitation became one of the greatest blessings of my life.

This church has given me a beautiful Christian family that has truly changed my life for the better. They have walked with me through life’s ups and downs—moments I cannot imagine navigating alone—and have also celebrated life’s victories right alongside me.

The messages always feel personal, like they are meant just for me. I’ve learned to understand the Bible in simple, meaningful ways, and the small groups have helped me connect with others who share my faith and values.

Most importantly, I’ve built a real relationship with Jesus here. It’s not about religion—it’s about relationship. You can come exactly as you are, with no pressure to be anything other than yourself, and you’ll be welcomed, accepted, and loved.

If you’re looking for a church where you can truly belong, grow, and feel at home… this is it.

Be yourself. Be accepted. Be welcome. Be HOME. My wife and I spent one Sunday going to four different churches GVChristian Church was the last church on our list at 5 PM. The second we walked in the door. It's like they already knew our names and we felt like we were already a part of the family, it was the welcoming and feeling that we were dreaming of not only did my wife run into a friend that she knew from her work. I ran into a childhood friend that I've known for 27 years, which came two more reason why we feel like we found hope faith and love in a place that accepted us at hello this church is my burning bush. God is real. God is everything and now because of this church God's active part in my day-to-day life. This is my church, and it is awesome. I’ve grown closer to the Lord here than I had anywhere else. We have amazing kids programs, a very active and close men’s group, a healing program called Celebrate Recovery, an incredible women’s group, and many other activities. But that’s not the heart of the church. The heartbeat of this church is to reach the lost, disciple believers, and preach the whole counsel of God. There’s also a private pre-K to 12 school that raises up strong Christians. From the moment you walk in, you will feel the love of Jesus Through some amazing people! I have grown tremendously in my walk with the Lord, side-by-side with awesome Pastors, brothers & sisters in Christ. GV Christian Center is really awesome. It's a family feel good kinda place, where everyone is so friendly and welcoming from day one, you feel right at home. Pastor Gary, Pete, and Steve with their uplifting sermons makes you look forward to each and every service.

name: Gwinnett Church - Buford Campus
reviewSummary:
Went today with my family for our first time and it was one of the best experiences we have ever had in a church. Our child loved the kids class and cant wait to go next week. We are so thankful, so blessed to call this home! Might as well go to 12 stone
They claim to be an outward facing church, that help bring people of all kinds closer to god, but that couldn't be further from the truth. (After a month of asking for money to expan this "outward facing church") my wife and I wanted to volunteer at the church but got turn away because of the way we looked! This is not an assumption, it was something that was told directly from the volunteer leader. So if you dont look like a Mormon you are not welcome to be part of the church. They will gladly take your money regardless of what you look like, they just will say that you're not part of the church. Thanks reassuring people who were opening up to the Christian religion that Christians really are superficial and judgemental. As a Christian, I believe God created people of every color with purpose and beauty.

So when we struggle with accepting others, it’s something worth reflecting on—not judging, but growing in love.

Not everyone is like this, but I think it’s an important conversation. Thank you waumba land team for a super fun touch a truck event! Very kind and positive community here! By far and away the best church I've ever attended. The music and the messages are above anything else you will hear. You do not need to be faith-based to enjoy coming here. The kids programs are well thought out and are curriculum based; they do not just babysit your kids. Happy to call this my church. Happy to call this our church. #foryou #forgwinnett

name: H2O Church Cincinnati - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are an incoming freshman, I would choose another church. This one clearly misses the point of raising up college students to be followers of Jesus in the real world. One of the lead pastors in a sermon to college students said “who cares about your test tomorrow? that’s not important in the kingdom.” They also say that men and women can’t really be friends; as if christians can’t be above lust. There are so many examples! The staff only cares about students when they’re freshmen and coming to know God initially. My friends and I felt so excluded and not poured into after.

Also, the entire leadership and probably 90% of the body is white and that’s because there have been no real efforts by leadership to care for people who don’t think or look exactly like them except for pretending to care about people from different countries to try to convert them.

The leadership cares about what they care about, not what the church or college body needs and it’s so clear to see the effects of that. H2O Church is an amazing college church! H2O Church is focused on seeking truth and the Lord in every way. The mission trips and other trips that are offered are amazing and focused solely on God, whole 100% recommend! This church has really pushed me to follow Christ! The community is so loving and feels like family 🙌 H2O Church loves Jesus! I love being apart of a community that follows Jesus, preaches His Word and spreads the gospel to the local community on and around campus. H2O Church is the best! It’s full of the most welcoming people that so apparently love Jesus! After first moving to college this church instantly became home and these people became family!

name: H2O Church Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
It is rare to meet a pastor like John who not only leads with wisdom and integrity, but who also becomes a true friend and steady presence in the lives of those around him. He is a pillar of strength and hope in our neighborhood, someone whose influence reaches far beyond the walls of the church.

John and Jim are the best. Lovely people who attend too. Get your worship on here. H2O is awesome. If you’re looking for a church in the Orlando metro area, this is it! Pastors Jim and John are led by the Holy Spirit and you can feel the love of Jesus here. Starting June 1st, 2014 we are moving!!! Join us at:

Don't miss out on this new phase of H2O Church!! This church lies to me regarding there's online church service. And also they don't have a live stream opportunity on there website. They have it on there YouTube channel and there Facebook

reviewSummary: My home church about 20 yrs... learned tai boxing gone on a few missions to mexico skated on half pipe in old parking lot trained proper techniques to handle and shoot guns and paint ball wars on mens retreat in big bear gone hiking 10 miles to tree line with all geat to survive w/out clean water n only food we brought.
