name: Hamilton Church - Place of Grace - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary:
Hamilton Church Place of Grace is truly a gem in our community, offering a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes everyone feel like family. From the moment you step through the doors, you are enveloped in a sense of belonging and acceptance. The friendly faces and genuine smiles set the tone for what has become a wonderful spiritual home for many.

One of the standout features of this church is the myriad of volunteer opportunities available. It's heartening to see such an array of options for members to get involved, whether through community outreach programs, assisting in various church activities, or participating in event planning. It's a fantastic way to connect with others while serving a greater purpose, and it fosters a strong sense of community among the congregation.

The weekly activities provided cater to both adults and children alike, ensuring that there’s something for everyone. From Bible studies and prayer groups to fun family events and fellowship gatherings, the church offers a calendar full of engaging options. The separate services for kids and young adults are particularly noteworthy, as they create spaces where younger generations can worship, learn, and grow in their faith in a way that resonates with them.

Worship at Hamilton Church Place of Grace is uplifting and genuinely moving. The music is led by talented musicians who create an atmosphere of praise and reflection. Pastor Alan and Family Pastor Brad deliver sermons that are relatable and impactful, making biblical teachings accessible and applicable to everyday life. His ability to connect with the congregation resonates deeply, prompting personal reflection and encouraging spiritual growth.

Overall, Hamilton Church Place of Grace stands out not just for its vibrant community and comprehensive programming, but also for its commitment to fostering faith in a nurturing environment. Whether you’re new to the area or searching for a church home, you will find a welcoming embrace and countless opportunities to engage. I wholeheartedly recommend visiting this wonderful church—it's more than just a place of worship; it’s a place of grace. I've attended this church for 20 years now. The majority of my life has been spent with many of the people who attend. If I could mark back the moments of change in my life, many of them would take place within these walls. But it's more than that. It's a place where people become family. Jesus moves and He is welcome in this church body. It is His. Is it ever messy? Sure. But, these people love well, forgive well, and walk with one another in all the things.

Plainly speaking, this church has a great staff of leaders who care about each person who enters. It's not about a putting on a show, it's walking life together. Now being part of that team myself, it's an honor to continue serving the place that walked beside me for so long.

5 stars from me. Pastor Alan is the most down to earth pastor I have had in my life. The church has wonderful services for kids from nursery to college. We have combined services a few times a year with our Hispanic church and it is so nice to worship all as one like we will in Heaven. If you are looking for a great church, come join us! The community event was a beautiful outcome. We enjoyed ourselves this church is welcoming and always giving back to the community. They have great staff as well. reviewSummary:
Hamilton Mill United Methodist church is a great church with  compationate ministers and staff.
At this church the ministers present the word of God in a loving way, yet keep the Lord in the message.

See you there 👍 As parents, we tend to think we have perfect kids. I cannot say anything less about my own child. I have a healthy, super active boy that no school wanted nor gave him the opportunity to come out of his shell. Often, we were told by his teachers that we should get him evaluated by specialists. This was brought up to his pediatrician on various occasions, in which he would always tell us that he was just a normal active boy and that we needed to give him some time to grow and develop. We took him to OT, and the therapist proceeded to tell us there was nothing wrong and that he was smarter than the average boy his age. He started to attend the preK at the  United Methodist Church at Hamilton Mill under Mrs Kristin. As expected, my child started to act up in her class. He didn’t last more than 2 months  before we had our first meeting where they told us that he was going to be kicked out of school if his behavior continued. As the semester came to a close, a meeting was called to let us know that my son would not be able to come back to school. Mrs Kristin decided that she wanted to act like a licensed psychologist practitioner and proceeded to tell my spouse that our child needed psychiatric support. In no shape or form she has the experience to make such statements as she is not a licensed psychologist to make that determination. Also, we had already started the IEP process with the county, and when we requested the questionnaire that was filled out by Mrs Kristin, she refused to give us such information, which that is a violation of  state law. We got the county to evaluate our child for IEP eligibility. Our child scored above average on everything with the exception of social skills. The county determined that he needs to be socialized. The only way for him to be socialized is by being at school, the same schools that have never given him the opportunity to learn these skills. Speaking to his pediatrician, he stated that we are not the only parents dealing with daycares kicking out active boys. These daycare centers do not want to deal with these boys, and they have unqualified personnel thinking that they are psychologists and putting intrusive thoughts into parents’ heads. This has caused so many sleepless nights because of the stress they place upon parents making them believe that there is something wrong with their children. When in reality, these boys are just being boys. A 5 year old boy has a level of testosterone of a teenager, and they expect them to stay still and not move. There is seriously something wrong here. Great food pantry! They have been operating this for over 10 years. It was a nice place to go to see choirs perform. Plenty of seating. Hamilton Mill United Methodist Church is a wonderful place to be in tune with your Creator. The atmosphere is warm, welcoming, and uplifting, making it a great space for worship and spiritual growth.

name: Hancock United Church Of Christ
reviewSummary:
The Hancock UCC is a wonderful church great for families with young children. It has music, worship and fellowship and education for all ages. Hancock United Church of Christ is a progressive Christian church. Their morning service is traditional. The evening service (September to May), is more organic.

At Hancock  belonging is as important as believing. What holds us together is  our covenant of membership: we all belong to one community together.

Worship, and the music therein, are central to our life together as a faith community.” At morning worship, our worship leaders open scripture in ways that are authentically Christian, but also radically inclusive, progressive, and relatable to your life. Our music directors choose songs that are new and life-giving, and those that are familiar and laden with good memories. But maybe most importantly, when you worship with us, you’ll meet the people with whom you’ll serve and grow spiritually, the people who will deliver you meals when tragedy strikes and pray for you when you’re ill, and the people whose children will learn and grow with yours, from Church School all the way through our thriving High School Youth Group.

Service to others and working to bring about a more just world are central to our life together at Hancock Church. Hancock members engage in a wide variety of service and justice activities. We volunteer at the local food pantry and provide fresh food for it from the Interfaith Garden; provide lunches and financial support to the Outdoor Church of Cambridge; send relief supplies and rebuilding help to communities  devastated by Hurricane natural disasters. We help build houses for those without decent shelter; and advocate and bear witness in support of just laws here in Lexington, at the Massachusetts State House, and in Washington. Every week we give our offering to a mission partner working to make the world a better place.

At evening worship, Worship at The Well,  the music director leads The River Rock Band, and they play widely eclectic variety of music from ancient spirituals, folk, jazz and blues, bluegrass, and some beloved old hymns updated with a folk, jazz or bluegrass feel. We do a LOT of communal singing.

Every worship service at The Well is different, but you can expect a  welcome, opening hymn, passing the peace, the message (which is usually some whet shorter than a morning sermon there or at most churches), voluntary collection of donations for one of our mission partners, all of whom do wonderful work for those in need. And then we share our joys, concerns, hopes, and grief by lighting candles. (One can come up to light a candle or ask the worship leader to, and speak their prayer aloud, or simply hold it in their heart after the lighting of the candle).

Our service ends with communion which is observed every Sunday, and is done by intinction. Folks come up to the alter and receive a piece of bread dipped in juice. (Due to covid concerns, the communion leader tears the bread and dips it, rather than every individual tearing the bread and dipping it. Should their be a spike again, we may go back to individually wrapped communion kits with wafers and cups of juice. But it will always be every week!

The morning service is a more "traditional" service with once a week communion (bread and a small cup of juice), standing to sing from a hymnal, and prayers prayed from the pulpit by the ministers or a seminarian. But the content and sermons are as progressive as the church!

Hancock has  many opportunities for service, from the local food pantry, our community garden, and much much more! Warm, welcoming, supportive, enriching worship community with programs for all ages - children, youth, and adults.  Staff are responsive, knowledgeable, innovative and also traditional.  A vibrant, exciting place. Easter sunrise service at the Belfry acknowledging those in our families who have gone before us as we share their names and share communion.  Beautiful.... Excellent community with a shared commitment to social justice.

name: Hanmaum Church - Durham Campus
reviewSummary:
“한마음” (“one heart”) is an ironic name for a church that pushed me out at 18 for attending both the English Ministry (EM) and Korean Ministry (KM). After a KM member told me I shouldn’t attend both (while she was giving me a ride back to my dorm), the pastor sought me out the next day while I was eating after service and told me I had to choose-- adding that “it seems like you like EM more.” I stopped attending soon after. I stayed silent because I knew good people there, but what happened was wrong, and I hope the system has changed. Grew up in this church under pastor Cho for 20+ years. My most formative years as a Christian under his leadership. If you're looking for a church to become your family, to serve and be served, to grow in Christ-- this is the place for you! Please do not be intimidated by poor ratings by the few who have been angered enough to rant on the Internet.

Shame on the people who have demonstrated anything other than love for Christ and ALL his children in the midst of some church struggles through nasty reviews. All churches have internal struggle from time to time, we see it in scripture. I am his daughter, and I support my father wholly in all he does. I truly believe he leads and seeks counsel in the Lord in what he does.

If you know the story of Hanmaum, you will know that my father did not do it alone but through the hand of God. Bash the pastor all you want, but God does not use the perfect to lead the other perfect people. He uses the weak to lead the strong. And I hope that anyone who is in search of a church will find strength in the love of Christ that is so richly demonstrated in the way the members serve one another at Hanmaum. Pastors are human too, they are our brothers in Christ, and I challenge the people below to love all pastors like such. In conclusion, I love Hanmaum Church! I grew up in one church for 25 years before I came to USA. Since I came to America, I have attended so many different churches under different denominations. I didn't like the fact that we had to jump one church to another so many times due to study, work, problem with fellow church leaders/members, etc. I now am very grateful for that because I had a chance to experience a lot of christians and leaders at church. I also heard and saw a lot. I can tell you that I found a church like home. Hanmaum Church. Even though I hear different stories, it does not really affect me. I know He is in control and I trust Him. I encourage everyone to come to Hanmaum church with an expectation and hope to see what God is doing in all. HanMaum should have known better and not host NCYC in December 2022.  Almost all kids came back and started to get sick and tested positive for COVID-19. So inconsiderate of kids and only want to pursue their business! Very Good Church, every member does their best for Jesus Christ.

name: Hanwoori Korean Presbyterian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church I would recommend it to any level of believers So welcoming and really dedicated to following the Bible. Awesome church highly recommended Good church Come down to worship God

name: Harbor Baptist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Non discrimination is what I like best. When they say come as you are, it's true. Just be respectful and you'll fit right in. Great church, helping those in need, with a wonderful hard-working staff!

I would recommend this church to everyone. Great church..very nice people...a lot of love 4 everyone.
Ron Kirchner nice people willing to help you with everything they can love it Great place to worship, find peace.

name: Harbor Christian Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I was--and still am a year later--so very very sad about the loss of one of my very oldest and closest friends. We grew up on Newport Beach (Carona del Mar and Balboa Island) and had, at that time, moved great distances from our early homes. harbor Christian Church provided a lovely context for holding a memorial for my beloved friend....Thank you. Great church community. Sunday service starts at 10! Awesome people. Very warm and welcoming! Good location. Environmentally aware, welcoming and inclusive community.

name: Harbor Christian Fellowship - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming to me as a poor Spanish-speaker. They translated the introduction just for me and then sent one of their members to help me find the passage in an English Bible. So welcoming!! Great church we spread the word of white power and celebrating the accomplishments of the white race we hold white power rallies every Monday in Laguna Beach. Spamming me with unwanted rude text messages
How can you call yourself Christians when you Harass people with unsolicited rude text messages disrespecting my country and those who serve it?

Just plain disrespectful. An excellent community church that actually serves the people in the community. Because they love you and everyone is there to help you.

name: Harbor Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary: Running and walking by Harbor Church for 2 years I finally begged my husband to attend morning service. We got the best impression from visiting this church. I felt the presence of the Holy Spirit and left filled with it. The people are so nice and friendly. This church is alive. I've never been to a more caring, non judgemental, FUN church. Leadership is not afraid to change when change is needed. They are in tune with the church body and are constantly seeking out God's will and challenging the church members to actively join in ministry. This is a church for everyone. My family really enjoyed service. The congregation was so friendly and inviting. I haven't had that good of a welcome in a while at a new church. We will definitely return. Community is the foundation of this church. Everyone looks out for one another. They love and praise God without judgement. A hug is often freely given. Couldn't ask for anything better. Great church, I used to eat the sugar packets from the coffee stand in concerning amounts and drink those little blue coffee creamers, DON'T drink those btw, they're not very good

name: Harbor Church Honolulu
reviewSummary: Amazing evangelical church with great worship, applicable messages and a large variety of community events such as weekly community groups around the island, hiking, golf, pickleball, running, boardgames, and many other church hosted "hangouts". Three services on Sunday, 8, 9:30, 11 with livestreamed youtube service at 9:30. Just search "harbor church honolulu" We love the community that exists at Harbor Honolulu! It’s a safe place to grow through hearing God’s Word be preached, living it out through participating in community groups, and sharing the Gospel with the community around the island and across the globe! Harbor Church has played such an impactful role in my family's life. Being in the military, finding a church can sometimes be a struggle, but God has truly placed Harbor in our lives at the perfect moment. The community and God-centered teaching is truly a blessing. If you are in the military, this is the church for you! Harbor has been such a blessing to me and my spiritual growth. The teaching is always grounded in Scripture, and every week you can tell that the leadership cares about what the Bible actually says and how it speaks into real life. But what I love most is the community. People here genuinely care about each other, not in a surface-level way, but in a “we’re actually doing life together” kind of way. If you’re looking for a church that’s biblically solid and full of people who make you feel welcomed and valued, this place really does feel like home. I’ve been attending Harbor Church for almost 2 yrs now and am so incredibly grateful to have found such a special place. There’s great worship and biblical teaching, but it’s their focus on gospel-centered community that has allowed me to develop such rich friendships. If you’re looking for a church to get connected with, come check us out!

name: Harbor Light Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Harbor Light is truly an awesome example of what loving Christ & loving people looks like! Sound biblical teaching, amazing worship & loving people! Watched the First Amendment audit you had with Nathaniel and was so happy to see the warm Christian welcome you gave them. You truly let your light shine! Very positive interaction with 1st amendment auditors. You showed the world how a church should treat strangers. View on the nasty nathaniel channel on YouTube great people over at Harbor Light Church, you can tell they really care. I’ve call Harbor light my church four over 20 years or more. I love the teaching and the worship and all my brother and sister their very loving and caring people.

name: Harbor Light Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Charles Tuck is a true man of God. He preaches from God's Word every week. The people are friendly. I moved to Santa Cruz from San Jose because I was commuting to go to this Spirit Filled Church. If you want to feel God's love, join us.
SUNDAY 9:30am Prayer 10am coffee fellowship 10:20 Service begins
WEDNESDAY 7pm Food and fellowship 7:20 service begins Pleasureable going  to Harbor Lights Chruch  such an Awesome Pastor whom Most Definitely Spreads the word of God which is  felt in the Soul every Sunday ! Now that's some Pastoring ! Always Feel  The Holy Spirit Here At Harbor Lights ! One Fine Chruch An  Pastor An Parishioners ! We Love Harbor Lights Chruch ! In Jesus Holy Name 🙏✝️🤍 Only been her 2 times but so far, I absolutely love this church and plan on attending as many Sundays as I can.  The music was amazing as well as the sermon.  I feel welcome here and look forward to being a part of the Harbor Light Church and Family.  Thank you !!!! I love this family oriented church. My family and I have made some of our best friends at this church and have grown so much over the years through the teachings, small groups, and various ministries offered. If you’re looking for an awesome community to be apart of where God presence is evident and lives are being transformed, come and worship with us! I was baptized there and even married there it is a good church for a beginner I moved on as to not grow stagnant from staying in one spot to long God wants us to flourish and spread the word. You can't do that if you don't move. Just like you can't grow if you don't experience new experiences it's a good place to call home but don't get stuck cause they won't tell you when it's time to go only you can figure that out for yourself! God bless!

name: Harbor Point Church
Harbor Point Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary: My family wanted me to join them for Easter service so found myself here.  There was literally nothing that I disliked; I’m not a normal churchgoer but didn’t feel out of place.  The experience was uplifting and wonderful!  Yes, it’s loud AKA they’ve got a really great band.  The message was delivered in a way that was easily understood, appreciated the occasional levity and the accompanying graphics (to read along) were greatly appreciated.  Right off 5 freeway, parking was easy and excellent traffic management for a quick exit.  I’m thankful that I went and actually want to go again. This is a review as somebody who was bringing in a band to perform at a Memorial service at this church. It was extremely difficult to get people to respond to multiple emails and messages to get information about what was being provided and what I would have to bring. Finally  I was told that certain instruments would be available to us. And later I was able to speak to a sound man the day before the event.  He confirmed the available instruments and even said that they would also provide a piano. That was great news.  And then later at 9:30 at night before an 8 AM call the following morning we were told that some promised instruments were no longer available to us. Not the way to treat people who are there to serve a widower and his family in mourning. Unprofessional and super disappointing. And so upsetting it made me leave this review. This is the second time I've attended this particular church today, on Mothers Day, and we had a great experience with the campus, preacher, and friendly congregants. We will definitely be headed back next Sunday!!! My experience on Dec 23, 2025. The Christmas service at this church was absolutely horrifying! As an ex-Christian, and one who has not stepped foot into a church in years this was a solidifying experience as to why. The music was sooo obnoxiously loud, my 82 yr old father had to remove his hearing aids, and then we both had to plug our ears! It's now the day after Christmas and my ears are still ringing from the damage. Then you have the distraction of the glaring light show and fog machines. But hey, it's all theater for baby Jesus's 🍿 bucket for "In God We Trust" fiat currency. The show was so annoying when the popcorn bucket was passed to me, I thought maybe my neighbor wanted me to get a refill from the concession stand. Was there a message at this church? Absolutely there was! We are completely intolerant to loving others, so much so that we will bash another church during our Christmas service to do it. One 🌟 is kind. I was excited to attend the Christmas Eve Eve service. You can never get enough of the Christmas story. I love hearing and learning about baby Jesus. However as a member of The Church Of JESUS CHRIST of Latter Day Saints, I was saddened that you would use the platform of Christmas to have a video from Brother Zundel belittle another Christian church. In a day where we need more kindness, more compassion, more Christianity, How sad that the member of your church had to grab my hand and apologize for her church saying unkind remarks about another church. That's not very Christlike. She also apologized for "The Popcorn Bucket" being passed at the beginning asking for donations. Wouldn't it be more appropriate to mention a family who may need a little help during the holidays and if we would like to contribute please see an usher after. The music selections were awesome. Merry Christmas Harbor Point Church.

name: Harbor Trinity Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Harbor Trinity Church is a "Welcoming Church".  Whether you are a youngster or a person who has been a believer for many years, this church is a place for you to feel at home in your faith and worship. I was welcomed here from the beginning! this is a family-community church which is always helping and reaching out to the community and people who needs support. Great kids and youth program also!! The preaching is very solid on the Bible and communicates well with all group of ages. Very very friendly environment, to not mention that there’s always good food!! 👌😊🙏 Both my 7 and 5 year old boys attended preschool at Harbor Trinity and they loved it. The staff is very friendly and caring. Sometimes they have guests bring animals to pet, they’ll have some bounce houses in the playground, tricycle racing, etc. I would recommend Harbor Trinity to anyone who is thinking about a good Christian preschool. I have been going to this church for almost a year. Great worship. Down to earth pastor (you will get his humor). The people are TRULY genuine. Make sure to say hi to Chris who meets you at the door. I highly recommend if you are looking for a great bible based (chapter by chapter) small friendly church. Love to listen to Justin talk about the Bible and
how what it says relates to my life.  Love to hear Shane worship Jesus.

name: Harborside Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I came to Harborside Christian Church for a BNI networking event and had a great experience. The facility is beautiful, clean, and very welcoming. It was a great place to bring local business leaders together to connect and build relationships. You can tell this church cares about the community and creates a great environment for people to gather. Grateful for the hospitality and for churches that open their doors to support the local business community. Great venue for hosting community and business events. I came for a BNI networking meeting and the space was clean, welcoming, and well organized. It’s great to see a church that opens its doors to support local businesses and bring people together. Appreciate the hospitality and the positive environment they’ve created for the community From the moment Harborside announced they were building the chapel, I was in awe. I watched the progress week after week, attended the groundbreaking ceremony, and fell more in love as the mission and heart behind it unfolded. I knew long before I was engaged that one day I would get married there.

Just under two years after it was completed, I got engaged—and there was no question. The chapel was my one non-negotiable. From the very beginning, the process was seamless. Our coordinator reached out almost immediately, we chose our date, and planning felt easy and intentional.

We were incredibly blessed to have Pastor Kurt officiate our wedding. The premarital equipping was truly priceless. We were matched with mentors who were a perfect fit—especially meaningful since the husband was a pilot like my own. Those honest, real conversations prepared us for marriage in ways we didn’t even know we needed.

Our wedding day was absolutely stunning and seamless. From the décor and timeline to the ceremony and music, everything was perfection. I would choose this chapel over and over again. You don’t just gain a beautiful venue—you gain mentors, support, and the love of the entire Harborside Church congregation. Forever grateful. Our home church is incredible.
Their childrens programs and youth conferences are amazing.

Some of their services are televised, meaning you watch on a projector after worship and between lead pastor.

Parking can be tricky but they have volunteers helping out and managing traffic depsite the weather ( thank you to all the volunteers).

We love Bayside.

Services are 8a, 1030a, and 1140a on Sundays.

High-schoolers sit with parents on sundays but meet on Wednesdays. Harborside has been such a welcoming place for me as a recent widow and new resident to the area.  The leadership is filled with genuine love for Jesus and for others.  The worship is heartfelt and the messages empowering and inspiring.  It is a place where families are supported and so many options to grow in small groups. I am so blessed to be a part of this Christian community.

name: Harbour Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
I found this church a few months ago and have now made it my home church. The atmosphere is so welcoming, and every sermon is intentional and relatable. I highly recommend those who are strong in their faith or just exploring it! I recently visited this church and loved the people and welcoming atmosphere but found the volume of worship to be uncomfortably loud. While I understand some enjoy a concert like worship experience, I had to leave early due to a headache from the sound levels.

A slight adjustment in sound levels could make a BIG difference for people who are more sensitive to volume. I’d love to come back again and possibly make this my home church if the sound levels were brought down a couple notches. It really seems like there is an amazing community here and a lot to offer! This is a great church. I used to listen to the sermons on their website. I live close to this church so I found it on Google maps.
I really liked that they pray for understanding before they even tell the message.
After a while listening to the sermons for a few months I had a chance to check it out and so I did.
This church is really big on actually doing community service and helping people and I am a big believer that I should be doing that. I like that this church challenges me to be a better Christian. To actually serve the people and make a difference and do God's will.
As I am not an elderly person I like that the church isn't this full of just elderly people as many churches that I've been to have been.
I have just started going to this church but from my impressions they seem to all have a very loving supportive community. A very closely connected church. A family. I had the pleasure of visiting this church in Sarasota over the weekend, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The worship was uplifting and filled with powerful, heartfelt music that truly drew me into the presence of God. The message was biblically sound, insightful, and deeply impactful. You can tell this is a church that values truth, community, and authentic worship. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a Christ-centered and welcoming place to grow in their faith! My favorite thing about Harbour Church is the value for God’s presence and the close runner up is the amazing community!

name: Harlem Church NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Harlem church NYC is a place where we love, serve, be the real you and be a disciple to everyone. Worship section great, message is awesome. We love on each other and learn together.

Join us on Sundays at 11am Awesome worshipping service
Awesome message from Pastor Johnson
Awesome connecting with new and old members
Come out to experience more about God and all the wonderful things that God continues to do in our lives 🙏🙏🙏🙏 I enjoy service each time I visited. It is short and on point. They are very interactive Church is amazing. Their breakout early morning session before service is awesome. Service short and inspiring The fellowship is real and amazing!  Great place to learn and hear the Word of God.

name: Harlem Church of Christ - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Min. Shabazz and the congregation are genuinely welcoming, respectful and responsible to the word and works of God. I really enjoy their services. You should come and see/hear for yourselves! Amen and Hallelujah!! PTL! Sis. Charlotte Harlem This has been my home congregation for 30 years, if you are seeking a church that teaches God's Word please come visit us. We are located at 338 West 127th Street (on the corner of Lenox Ave) Sunday Bible class starts at 10:00 am and Worship service starts at 11:00am. Bring your Bible along so you may be able to study with us. Hope to see you soon. 🙏🙌 I was an obvious visitor, and was disappointed that no one hardly spoke to me, except an elderly Hispanic gentleman. It did make me aware and more conscious of greeting visitors at my home congregation. We, as Christians need to do better, if we are going to influence the world for Christ. My first ever Minister was the late Doctor RC Wells who's were very well  known,Today's Preacher Doctor Olu Shabazz has the same reputation as well I grew up in this congregation from when they were on W. 130th Street and Lenox Avenue. If you want to hear the gospel truth, and you're in Harlem, you are always welcome to come and get the truth right here!

name: Harlem Community Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Loved my experience at Harlem Community Church this week! The Juneteenth celebration in the park was a blast and I’m so glad they held this event. Church on Sunday was also wonderful! The worship and sermon from pastor TJ made this experience stand out to me from other churches I’ve visited. Definitely check it out! Had the joy of visiting HCC this weekend and it was such a blessing. The people were amazing, the worship was beautiful, and God was present! Can’t wait to go back! Really great church! Everyone is so welcoming and friendly, and it's easy to feel at home. The worship is amazing, and the teaching is always encouraging. It's a great place to grow in your faith and build real relationships. I definitely recommend checking out Harlem Community Church if you're looking for a church in the area. I’ve been observing and visiting many churches ⛪️ and I choose Harlem Community Church for my birthday baptism because if you are looking for a church of acceptance, love and biblical teaching not preaching come to Harlem Community Church. You will visit and find your church home 🏠🎉🥳🙏🏾 This church is so loving and kind. This church preaches the gospel and the word of God. Totally recommend. They made me feel so welcome my first Sunday.

name: Harmony Church of Helena - Helena Campus
reviewSummary: This Church is what a Church should be: friendly, open, loving, caring, and Christ centered. The entire staff and pastor are incredible.  It is what a Church should be. Great place to store your stuff and they are friendly ! Friendly church great  church bazaar Love this church. Good place

name: Harmony Creek Church - Kettering / South Dayton Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful place. Today was my first time attending. I was very nervous, as I have not attended church in over 30 years. In less than 5 minutes I felt so welcome and safe, everyone is so kind and laid back. I didn't want service to end! Can't wait to come back next Sunday. I truly think I have found a home to worship and feel safe and welcome. I have three girls that attend Harmony Creek, their ages 6,3,&1 years.
My children love going here, and they love their teachers! Every day I know they are in good hands, learning new things, eating healthy, and having fun! I love the structure they have on a daily basis. I am very happy being apart of Harmony creek childcare! My daughter has been attending the daycare for nearly a year and a half. I have never had any type of issues with the staff, they have always been very considerate with our needs. They always call me when the situation is appropriate, and I greatly enjoy the programs the daycare provides for the children to sign up for. Keep up the great work! My kids have been attending Harmony creek child care for a little over a year now and they have taken excellent care of both of them. My kids enjoy going to day care everyday, they both love their teachers. Knowing my kids feel comfortable with them makes me feel confident that they are in good hands while they are there. Very friendly, loved how they dismissed the children, very precious and sweet singing them out with “this little light of mine”. It was a great sermon on acceptance and bridging gaps in relationships, with lots of connections to current events. Sadly, they stopped their communications when I wanted to be involved.

name: Harpeth Christian Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Harpeth is an incredible community of believers who want to trust and follow Jesus with their lives and not only on Sunday morning. My kids love the children’s ministry and learn so much about the Bible alongside practical applications for them to live out. Very welcoming with a lot of opportunities for service and growth for all ages. Great Church, I have been going here since I was a toddler until moving out to East TN. Moved back into my hometown and I have been attending again. In the past 16 years I have not ran into a church that I've felt more at home. Harpeth has been such a great place for our family. Our 13 & 17 year old daughters joined the youth program and have made so many great friendships. The youth leaders have been so encouraging and mentored them. They have grown and are happy at Harpeth.

My wife and I have loved the genuineness of the people who have welcomed us. We are a part of a small group that meets each week. They also have weekly Bible study classes that we have been able to join.

The messages are always great on Sundays. The worship team is so talented as well.

Our family has experienced real growth in ourselves and our relationship with God. Thanks be to God for Harpeth Christian Church and for leading us there. I am so grateful for this church.  We moved to TN from GA 9 years ago and looked for a church for years that would help me and my wife grow.  It wasn't fun or easy but Harpeth was exactly what my family needed.  This church is all about doing life together and their emphasis on being a part of a group has been more instrumental in my spiritual maturity that I can put into words.  No church is perfect, and Harpeth is no exception but the leaders of Harpeth preach and teach from the Bible (even the hard parts) and genuinely care for the members.  I'd love to meet you if you ever come visit. We’ve been going to Harpeth church for 9 years. We enjoy the community we have developed there. Our pastors teach from scripture every week from the stage focusing on how to relate it to current day. The intentional relationship building and scriptural teaching from youth leaders and children’s teachers with their students is wonderful!

name: Harrison United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Great blended worship. The contemporary service in Hammill Hall is fantastic.

name: Harvard Avenue Christian Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful community that welcomes all, so glad to go through life with such a loving group of folks. I went there for a funeral which was packed full. The staff and music was lovely and welcoming. The church has been enlarged and remodeled in the last few years. The preaching was wonderful and the people were very friendly. Pastor David called me up and discriminate against me about my past when he know nothing about me he is definitely hypocrite all of his staff I have been to services here several times and it has always been great. They have a nice concert series in their ampitheather. Very nice, casual and laid back. I would recommend bringing your own chairs for the concert series. The church provides chairs but they can fill up quickly. Lovely facility and beautiful church. Pastor and congregation were very friendly and helpful (at a family funeral). There are two lovely garden areas.

name: Harvest Bible Chapel
reviewSummary: High-energy modern worship, unapologetic biblical preaching, and tight-knit small group fellowship across Chicagoland.

name: Harvest Bible Chapel - Chicago Cathedral
reviewSummary: High-energy modern worship, unapologetic biblical preaching, and tight-knit small group fellowship across Chicagoland.

name: Harvest Bible Church - Cypress Campus
reviewSummary:
lovely church. Heavy on studying the Bible, key focus is reading and understanding scripture. Pastor Lance is highly educated, funny, and relatable. Nothing like a mega church. People are super friendly. If you want traditional worship and good Bible notes go here. We have been attending HBC for 3 yrs now. The teaching from Pastor Lance and the Bible studies Sunday morning are exceptional.  These are Godly men who prepare before presenting God's word.  We have learned and have grown in the knowledge of our Lord.  Thank you HBC staff.  All staff is genuine, humble, and loving 🌟 . Come see for yourself! I live in Sun City, CA and am blessed to be able to access Harvest Bible Church on my phone. Bible teaching from a Dispensational perspective is absolutely soul-searching, filled with hope and anticipation, and imparts true joy in coming to personally know and enjoy our relationship with Jesus Christ!!! My wife and I are huge fans of John MacArthur and his approach to 'verse by verse' expository preaching.  After looking into a number of churches, I thought I would never find a church or a pastor who would model the style and truth exemplified by  Grace Community Church / Grace to You (John MacArthur's Church in Sun Valley, CA).  Pastor Lance Waldie does an outstanding job of teaching the details and meanings behind every verse.  We both enjoy the services so much, we are both very happy to attend the Wednesday Night Bible Studies which are quite lively with questions and answers the entire time.

We also like their approach to the Sunday service.  The music consists of traditional hymns that are sung in a way that help you to focus on worship, instead of feeling like you are watching an American Idol performance.  Also, each service ends humbly in prayer with no dim lights, no altar calls, and no offering baskets are passed around for donations.

This is a church of believers for believers.  If you want to hear the truth, based on 100% focus on the Holy Scripture and nothing else, or "The Gospel according to Jesus," in 100% truth, this is your place.  This church will ensure you and your family travel the difficult path towards the narrow gate to an eternity with Christ.

Congratulations to Pastor Waldie (and his supporting cast, including his wife Cheryl), for creating a true church for Jesus followers (true believers) that is 100% grounded in the Holy Bible.  If you want to deepen your knowledge of Christ and the Bible, this is the church for you.  May God Bless this church with every advancing step.  BRAVO! We heard about Harvest Bible Church from some friends. We listened to some of the past sermons by Dr. Lance Waldie, then decided to visit in person in June of 2020. We loved the church and their focus on true historical Christianity and adherence to sound doctrine. We joined in August of 2020 and have been welcomed warmly into the flock. We attend the Wednesday night Bible study, adult Sunday School class and joined a small shepherd group. I attend the Women's Bible Study and my husband has been enjoying the Men's Bible Study since January 2021.

name: Harvest Bible Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Today is my 2nd Sunday service.  So far, so good. Nice people. Nice welcomers too. I was impressed with the pastor's ministering and actually focusing on the words ftom GOD and JESUS CHRIST. We love it here. We were looking for a new church when we found Harvest and both my wife and myself felt comfortable here the first time we came.  We go straight from the bible and through the Bible. The church is focused on Jesus. It is a bigger church which made me nervous but very friendly. They want you there and they want to be able to pray for you. People genuinely care at Harvest. This church has been my home and family for several years. The preaching is Biblical and the worship is Christ exalting. This church is a beautiful representation of God's love and grace. The people are very welcoming and inviting and really have a heart to see everyone come to see the Lord as their Savior without Bible thumping. All messages and sermons are spoken only from Scripture alone and nothing is added or taken away. Pastor Bill Borinstein and his wife Pam are the sweetest people and they've been blessed with a staff of elders, deacons, and other servant's heart volunteers who seek only to glorify the Lord in all that they do. I started attending Harvest Bible Chapel the Sunday after Easter and found everything I wanted in a church home.  Teaching/Preaching is Biblically sound.  Sermons are based on scripture.  Use of the ESV Bible makes scripture easier to understand without losing biblical authority.  The music ministry is awesome.  The small groups follow through with scripture study.  The people are warm, friendly, and welcoming.  I could not ask for more in a body of believers.

name: Harvest Bible Church - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary: This review is based on a past visit. I was invited here. I thought I was at a nightclub the way the women were dressed. After church, we went to a restaurant, and I was in a group of around 10 people. Everyone was drinking alcohol. That was my last visit. Best church in town. If you want truth this is the place to be! I have been attending HBC since 2010, with a couple visits dating back 2008. Our Pastor teaches from the Bible. And this is what draws me to Harvest Bible Church. Mens Breakfast free for everyone, 1st Saturday of every month. Pastor Mark is awesome!! Teaches and preaches truth from The Word. He preaches and let's you do your own thinking!! Looking for a no pressure, non intimidating place to worship? Come check it out. Let your expectation be Gods invitation to move by the Holy spirit in your life!!! The Spirit of God abides in this place. Pastor Mark and his wife, Pam truly display the fruits of the Holy Spirit according to Gal 5 and are humble servants of the Lord. The truth of the anointed word of God is ministered and above all His (the Lord’s) Agape love is shown by all. Praise God! Glory to the One and only living God!

name: Harvest Builders Worship Center INC. - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to fellowship, get to know God, and experience God's love through a truly friendly group of people. At this church everyone is family, they make everyone feel special. The pastor takes the time to really teach the Bible so it's easily understood. And on top of that, there's a piano/keyboard player that sings like a songbird. Please everyone stop by and show this great movement of God some love. I love this church paster is awesome and loveing it so warm and it feel like home  and if u need a church home harvest builders worship  center  is the place to be. This church bring me a long way the 3 years that I been going there I will be there until the end of my day..💜💙💜💖 Absolutely the friendliest congregation in Warner Robins. I haven't joined yet but I actively participate regularly and they always make me feel welcome and missed. The pastor is dynamic in delivering the word in easy to understand engaging language. No doubt this pastor is moving up to Bishop really really soon. I highly recommend checking them out. At this church they love God and love people! The atmosphere is warm and inviting. The pastor is dynamic and energetic. The worship experience is awesome. And the love you're shown is real. There is a balance of men, women, young, and old. Even my kids loved coming here! They do church for real! The people here are beyond friendly and the preacher makes the word easy to understand and relevant to today's world.  I highly recommend this place.

name: Harvest Church - Carmel Location - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church good message not sure if I will come back because the band sung a lot of songs. Most churches stop at 3, I lost count here. It was 25 minutes of singing. Also would keep more people if limit the whole worship time to 60 minutes. Biblical 'verse by verse' preaching (not topical and easy to skip over challenging stuff) by Pastor Brian and others, upbeat lively worship l, committed to discipleship and great commission plus nice new facilities for adults and children.

This is a place for solid spiritual meat-eaters yet sensitive to milk-drinkers too. Congregation for Christians who want to go deep not just wide and shallow. Lots of small groups and growth / service opportunities local and abroad. They are members of the Southern Baptist Convention (SBC) which is a very good thing.

They are committed to connecting people and getting people plugged in, Johnna does a great job. Nice interactive church app too. Excellent expository teaching from scripture.  Amazing worship teams. Very friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Great church with great people. Loved everything about it. Highly recommend if you live in this area to make this your church home. Solid Bible-teaching church.
The praise band is great, but can be very loud.

name: Harvest Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful church with friendly, welcoming people and faithful pastors. They preach God's Word (which centers on Christ and his sacrifice for sinners), and they humbly seek to live it out as a community by the power of the Holy Spirit. If you live in (or around) Cary, come and check it out for yourself and put this review to the test! Harvest has been an absolute godsend to our family! We visited here just after moving from a different state and haven’t been anywhere else since! The people are kind and the pastors are genuine and serious about the Word of God, which is an absolute breath of fresh air in a culture where it’s too common to find churches more interested in tickling ears. We’re grateful to now be a part of Harvest and plugged into a genuinely loving community group. Getting plugged into a community group anchored the relationships we were building and the work God has been doing in us. There’s no fanfare, light show or fog machine, yet an abundance of genuine worship that blesses the soul. No church is perfect as long as the Lord continues to use humans as it’s parts but it’s certainly evident the Lord is moving here ❤️ From the moment I walked into Harvest, I knew I was at home. The services are lively, yet intimate and the teaching is phenomenal. The pastors are extremely approachable and will know you by name. The members of this congregation too will welcome you into their homes and into their lives right away. Finally, the children's program is absolutely exceptional. My husband and I are beyond grateful to have found Harvest. This is the most authentic, gospel-centered church with a genuine community of believers that I’ve ever attended. Our family feels so loved and cared for. The sermons are scripture-ridden and life changing. We can’t say enough good things about our family at Harvest! Great church. We’ve been here almost a year and we’re enjoying it. The people are amazing. 😃

name: Harvest Church - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Jon and Elizabeth Smith are truly humble, Spirit-filled leaders who genuinely care about people and their walk with God. Their love for the Lord is evident in the way they serve, lead, and minister to others.

Pastor Jon preaches the truth of God’s Word with conviction, wisdom, and grace, never compromising biblical principles. Elizabeth is a wonderful example of faith, compassion, and servant leadership. Together, they create a welcoming and encouraging environment where people can grow spiritually and experience God’s presence.

What stands out most is their humility and authenticity. They lead by example, demonstrating integrity, kindness, and a sincere heart for ministry. If you’re looking for leaders who stand firmly for truth while showing the love of Christ, Pastor Jon and Elizabeth Smith are a blessing to their church and community.

We warmly welcome you to be a part of this life-changing experience. Whether you are seeking a deeper relationship with God, a church family, or a place to grow in your faith, you will find encouragement, truth, and genuine love here.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking strong biblical teaching, heartfelt worship, and caring leadership. God is clearly using Pastor Jon and Elizabeth Smith to impact lives and advance His kingdom. The Spirit of God truly rests in this place! Every time I come to Harvest Church, I can feel His presence in such a powerful way. I’ve witnessed so many miracles, healings, and lives transformed! If you’re longing for a real encounter with God that will change your life, Harvest Church is the place to be! A wonderful church led by Pastor Jon Smith and Dr. Elizabeth Garcia-Smith. Their wisdom, authenticity, and genuine love for people are evident in everything they do. If you're ever in the area, it's well worth attending a service and experiencing the impact of their ministry firsthand. Harvest Church is set apart. JESUS is the object of their affection. They have not strayed away from keeping the main thing the MAIN THING.
Most churches have a sincere desire to implement the command to "Go and make disciples" but fail for lack of strategy.
Pastors Jon and Elizabeth spent years in obscurity as shepherds in the field tending to and caring for new believers (often the most broken and marginalized) it was there that the Lord gave them divine wisdom to be able to raise their flock to maturity. Real lives being truly transformed. They understand that the Kingdom is built by building people- not by might nor by power but by His Spirit. They are not contending for a church full of programs and events - they are contending for a House FULL of His presence. If you're stagnant- there's a river, if you're thirsty-there's a well, if you're hungry- there is FRESH bread. You'll be empowered to live a victorious life in Christ! If you're looking for a church home- visit Harvest Church. You will never be the same! I love this church, the Pastor preaches the gospel the truth of God's word. The love for God's people you will find it here. There is order according to the word of God. They take time to pray for the broken and lost. It fills my heart to see people saved.

name: Harvest Church - Eureka Campus
reviewSummary: I have found Harvest church to be so open and welcoming. You really feel part of a loving family. Pastor Andy doesn't just preach from the pulpit, he is interactive in his discussions. No need to leave church wondering if you've understood the message! They also have a wonderful children's Sunday school. If this doesn't encourage you to check out Harvest church singing with the live band is a wonderful experience! You'll be filled with the Spirit. I feel it's the best church in Humboldt county! Check it out!! Such a great church. None like i ever have been to before. So loving and helpful Eureka's best kept secret.

name: Harvest Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: I visited harvest Church while I was in town for work, couldn’t help but wish I could make it my home church. Everyone was very welcoming and friendly and it made me feel like home Which was something I have been searching for and praying sometime. I encourage everyone to visit this church, I definitely will be back! The worship team is amazing and they allow the Holy Spirit to move, and the pastor is on point with his preaching, just an amazing family of God! May the Lord continue pouring out his blessings upon you all! This church is full with love! A true family church. Amazing kid ministry and small group. Come into God's presence when you enter through the front doors. A church just for non perfect people. This is my sister's church so I only go when she asks just because I am not a "church-going" individual and it's also distant from Pensacola. BUT whenever I do attend, service is always amazing!!!. The pastor is wonderful and preaches in a way that allows you to absorb the information, understand it, relate to it, and retain it. Everyone you meet is friendly! The kids center is wonderful. Just an all around great church to attend. Also, be prepared for Pastor to relay some Dad-jokes periodically during the sermon. Such a great guy! They also allow you to tithe in many different forms. Service can be viewed online if you are not able to make it physically. They have great cafe (try the cookies) and a good book store as well. Negatives: Not a fan of the music- personal preference due to what I am used to, not bc the music is bad. As a single woman without kids and not from the area, I found it hard to connect with others. I tried to lead a group but was told I had not been there long enough and they did not know me. I tried again months later and was told my walking group was not going to work.  The church did not fit my needs at the time in a new city. I was a regular in a small group but they never met outside the group. I think if you are a homebody, parent or a child the place is good. I have also emailed the church and never received a response back. I find this is normal in the south you are welcomed in but once you join there is not much else going on unless you  are like minded with other individuals. God bless the family of believers here Pastor Kevin and wife Adrienne are awesome 💜truly a great place to learn scripture grow in your relationship with Jesus 🙌🏽🙌🏽, and serve Gods people
