On Day 108 of our travels in New Orleans, we were to visit Harvest Church since it was a Sunday and check out the New Orleans attractions such as Bourbon Street and immerse ourselves in the local food and music scene – think poboys, gumbo and live jazz music!

Visiting Harvest Church New Orleans

2bearbear at Harvest Church New Orleans NOLA
2bearbear at Harvest Church New Orleans NOLA
As it was a Sunday, we had found a local church nearby – a 15 minutes walk from our Airbnb from St. Philip Street. Harvest Church is a Southern Baptist church and is located within Phillis Wheatley Community School. Services start at 10am and when we entered, we were warmly greeted by brothers and sisters here.

We were directed to the stairs that led to the gym on the second level where service was held. Everyone was really friendly and we were greeted by Madison and Aaron who directed us to the coffee area where we met Simeon and Justin – who turned out to be the one delivering the message this morning.

Connor then greeted us and told us more about the church being planted by Immanuel Church but saw that there was a need in the area and continued serving in Harvest. While seated, we also met Ethan and Katie as well as Naomi. Everyone was just so friendly. The songs were also familiar to us this morning, including “It is well with my soul” and “Blessed Assurance”.

The message this morning was from Justin and he expounded from the parable of the Great Banquet taken from Luke 14:15-24 as part of the sermon series on meals with Jesus. Love his delivery where he set the context about the dinner at the Pharisee’s place where it was just about getting awkward...

For the full sermon and details of our 5 months Round The World (RTW) travels, visit 2bearbear today!

name: Harvest Church - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary:
Not a true Christian church just a club house! There are some members their that are definitely after Christ heart but your better off with Mormons then here My wife and I came to try it out after hearing that our neighbors attend. The music worship had a good balance of praise and peaceful. The sermon was great; very thoughtful and inviting of the spirit of contemplation. I liked most everything but they really need to cool it with the smoke machines. My asthma was not happy and I ended up having to leave early. My favorite church to visit when I'm in the area! Their Pastor's are loving, kind & speak truth - what a rare thing these days! Their kids and youth programs are organized, well-staffed, area's are clean and I'd highly recommend for parents with kids. Definitely my favorite church in Vacaville and the surrounding areas! I was shopping at the market next door and had to use the restroom theirs was closed, since I am very pregnant I couldn’t hold it.

I knew of the church next door decided to go there because I saw they were open and assumed it be the cleanest option, I wasn’t sure if it was for a service or special event, but outside the door stood a man making tacos with a huge black cross on his neck, I asked him is there a restroom here? He replied with a stutter  “uhh I don’t know” .

How do you not know but clearly you’re apart of the event , you would have had to go inside the room plenty times before making the food unless you don’t wash your hands when prepping food . Took the not what goes in defiles a man  but what comes out literal? Washing hands is always good in this day and age. I pray he found the restroom too!

🙄.COMPLETE RED FLAG ,  the very basics of the Bible are the 10 commandments,  where one is about NOT lying. Maybe a refresher is needed.

I didn’t have time for the none sense so I walked in  to find some REAL Christians, don’t know if I found any but I saw a lot of people talking but they obviously weren’t very welcoming to whatever “event” this was they had going on, I got the attention of one lady asked her where the restroom was and she directed me….Long story short we all fall short of the glory of god but atleast put in a little effort to be an example of a Christlike individual otherwise your just a wolf in sheeps clothing. A Big black cross won’t save you. What’s faith without works? Acts of service are very important. Making tacos is great but it doesn’t stop there.

After that interaction definitely would give this building can’t call it a church 0/0 My family and I have been attending Harvest Church for the last 14 years, it is home for us. What I love most about Harvest is the hyper focus on reaching just one more. My Pastors, David & Patty, Jason & Brooke, are the same people Monday through Saturday as they are on Sundays, people with a passion for seeing God meet the needs of people through them. Over the last 14 years, my family was flourished as a result of our relationship with God and the direction and guidance of our Pastors There aren't too many things more beautiful than the church BEING the church! If you are looking for a place to call home, I would encourage you to come and check out Harvest, we'll save a seat for you!

name: Harvest Church Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
The Lord is in this house! Pastors Rich and Anita are amazing shepherds. Our family has been incredibly blessed to attend Harvest Church Broken Arrow. We live a little over two hours away. As often as we can, we love to be in person, online service has been a blessing as well. If you are looking for a Healthy Church a church to call Home for the whole family. Harvest is a house of relationship and family! A generational house that offers ministry for babies, children, youth, single and married families.

Harvest has an accredited Biblical School that's equipping the saints. Logos Training Center has been a blessing, I'm a student at this life changing college. Go check it out!

This is not a house of religion but a house of the Word & Spirit of God! This is a house of freedom and healing of the heart. Pastor Rich and his entire team are a blessing to be around.  They received and treated us like family and we were from another state and only visited for one day. This church is rare gem in a beautiful community. Harvest Church BA is truly a place where The Father’s Love is felt in every service. Pastor Rich and his team of Harvest Care Pastors lead with a genuine heart for people, creating an atmosphere where the presence of God moves powerfully. The Word is preached with boldness, and lives are transformed as signs, wonders, and healing follow. The people here don’t just attend church—they love Jesus and live it out. If I had to sum it up in two words: Spirit-Filled. Great church! Pastor Richi
Message plans and works was amazing! Will be returning! My husband, son and I have been attending HCBA since January 2021. This is the family of faith we prayed and looked diligently for.
It’s a smaller community feel, which makes much room for building real relationships and authentic fellowship.
Worship is powerful and the Pastors are *incredible*.. Pastor Rich and Anita care deeply about their congregation. They believe that shepherds should smell like the sheep, and their actions reflect that belief—which has been such a blessing and pleasant surprise to me and my family (and many many others). They really do pour their whole hearts into ministering to the people God has given them to protect and guide.
Their youth and children’s pastors have such genuine hearts and anointing for leading our kids into their own deep and authentic relationships with Jesus. It’s a beautiful thing to behold! :)
If you want to dig deeper into healing of the heart and grow in intimacy with the Lord, come and worship Jesus with us at Harvest Church BA!

name: Harvest Church, Downtown Turlock Campus - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary: First time visiting and brought my baby to the nursery. Unfortunately, the experience didn’t feel very welcoming. The initial interaction felt sarcastic rather than helpful, and within minutes my baby was left crying in a chair without much comfort. I understand kids need time to adjust, but I was hoping for a more attentive and reassuring environment—especially for a first visit. Just something for other parents to be aware of. Several things happened that went against my spirit. The biggest one being that my brother was asked not to come back. No good reason was given. Glad it happened the second time that my son and I attended so not much time wasted. I know there are true followers of Christ attending this church and they probably have no idea what is going on 😢 This church has changed so much, will be sad when Ron is no longer apart of it. Shannete is so camera aware. Only smiles when camera is on her. She’s gone up to families to ask them to remove their kids from the building. They push people to the center to appear fuller for camera. Disheartened and sad to see the decline. Holy spirit is here there worship is always on fire  ou could feel a strong  prayer atmosphere. Our friends invited us to come to church with them "Dave & Tina Johnson",  and we LOVE this church♥️  The pastor and everyone in this church are so welcoming, and you feel like family.  We always look forward to Sunday's now🌸. If you need peace in your life, and  people who will stand by you, this church is the place to be❤️

name: Harvest Church, North Turlock Campus - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary:
If this is the right church that is having a conference until Wednesday night!

Tonight I got there from Stockton California, I had macaroni and cheese from Popeyes that I gave to a guy for free because I already paid for the food, but I was full!

Let me start from the beginning:

We get to harvest church later than usual. My friend who drove me up here did not eat anything, so she stayed in the vehicle while I went to wait in line until she arrived. I got out of the vehicle and walked to the church, I was close enough to see the two children, teenagers, I'm 40, they're children to me. I saw one grab a few cold bottles of water and he was approaching my way. Before I could get to him two security guards, that didn't introduce themselves to me, so I didn't know exactly who they were. They approached me got close enough where they were almost in front of my face. They said that I can't go on stage, they never told me why, they spoke to me like I was a little child. I said okay or understood, because the guy spoke to me about it yesterday! I walked off.

I got a cold water from one of the children handing out cold waters to people. After I get my water bottle, I saw a man with two water bottles on the floor next to him, I walked up to him and asked him if he wanted it, he grabbed it and said yes and thank you! By that time the second time I was approached in less than 5 minutes by a security guard. Telling me not to cut in line, get in the back of the line. But before I could say something to him I turned around and he was gone.

Now I walked to the back of the line, and on my way there I saw the children handing out waters to people, and I asked them is everyone rude or evil like that to everyone, or are they just like that to me? I was offended by the security guards approaching me and talking to me like I am a child or something. So, after the children left and told whoever who told the older security guard who is in charge. I was feeling like they specifically had something against me personally, at one point or another I thought it was because they were racist or something?

So I was already offended, I know that I look very young, but I am old! So when the older white guy got all in my face, all three of them, the older white guy taking the lead, how he was talking to me was crazy, so I had already reached my threshold of how much I can take.

THE TRUTH:

Satan didn't want me there tonight! Satan used the demonic spirit of offense to get me caught up, because "I" was wrong in how I handled it, I definitely could have chosen to make better choices tonight, because that is not my house and I like to lay prostrate before Jesus, and I like to take my shoes off because it is Holy ground, and I like to praise and worship freely, though I couldn't last night because I am so tall!

Security guards, I was wrong, please forgive me? Such great people ❤️ We went to visit for Mother's Day while in Turlock. Loved how the presence of the Lord dwell in the people and in this place. 🙏🏽 Plan on visiting again when we return. I love this church I was first introduced to it through a close friend and the love and spirit that I felt while I was there was amazing. Amazing people that love God and their neighborhood that God has placed them in very caring and loving. My son goes to youth group on wednesdays he loves it CAnt wait to go to camp

name: Harvest Community Bible Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing people here at this church!  Highly recommended!

name: Harvest Community Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: Good people, great worship music and the Pastor is exceptionally educated on the history of the Bible. I enjoy listening to him about his research, insights and knowledge. He explains in detail so you can learn and go deeper in the word. I just recently started but when I first walked in the feeling was something I had Never felt before I have a big problem being around a lot of ppl but the feeling of love and God just permeates the air I don't know how to explain but I absolutely love it here everyone has been praying for me because of health and today I found out just how AMAZING GOD IS and because of THESE PEOPLE and THIS CHURCH I RECOMMEND ANYONE WHO FEELS LOST OR JUST WANTS TO BE CLOSER TO GOD the definitely knows this church 🙏🏻❣️🙏🏻 Thank you for excepting me . This church has been amazing. We felt welcomed and loved from the first visit. A great Bible teaching church. Worship experience is always good. We are so excited to be here. We have been here about 5 months now. Great worship, and the pastor is very thorough with scripture and very detailed! Excellent services, we've been to five now and considering joining after visiting multiple places. Great worship service.

name: Harvest Community Church - Huntersville Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I moved into Charlotte. We needed a new place to worship and learn about our Father in Heaven. We also recently lost a child through miscarriage. As a couple, we were struggling. We were far from family, with no friends near by.

My amazing wife saw the church and in her struggles, went to the Harvest Pavilion to seek a private place to pray and think.

Pastor Jerry and Ms. Heidi comforted my wife and asked that we both come together and discuss our trials. Our life as husband and wife was a struggle. Pastor Jerry helped us see a way to work together, gave great recommendations for a good Christian therapist and invited us into the fold of His congregation.

Harvest Community Church has many outreach programs. Couples bibles study, Fathers and Men’s programs, women’s luncheons, English as a Second Language (ESL), Croft Elementary school supply drives, youth outreach. The religious programs, under the direction of Pastors Jerry and Corey, study the Bible, teach Gods word and shows the love, compassion, and dedication of a true Christian Shepard. An amazing church, everyone was so nice and welcoming. The children's ministry was just what I was looking for my son. The gospel is straight from the Bible with expository style teaching. Im so excited I have a church I can call my "church home". We started going here almost a month ago. Harvest community has been so welcoming 🙏  Our oldest son really likes the youth group! Harvest is committed to following meaningful prayer, worship, and the study of God's Word.  Just as important, Harvest follows the Biblical example and command to create disciples by supporting missionaries. May Jesus keep His hand over this church! Very people friendly. Praising the Lord with guitars and drums.   It was definitely like making  a joyful noise unto the Lord.

name: Harvest Community Church - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Harvest Church since the beginning of the year, and from the very first visit, it felt like home. Everyone is so warm and welcoming, and encouraged me to get involved with the women’s Bible study, which has been such a blessing. Each week, I can genuinely feel the heart and passion for Jesus through the worship, the message, and the love poured out into the community. So blessed to be a part of this church family! Amazing People!  We were looking for a Home Church for over 5 years.  We tried all the BIG churches around Roseville and never really connected with anyone.  After 2 services we knew we had found the right place for our family.  The pastor and his staff are genuine real people and make you feel right at home.  The Praise & Worship Band is upbeat and talented and the Youth Programs are geared at training young people to make an impact in this broken world.  Also Harvest Community Church provides for the less fortunate in our community by operating a Food Closet every Tuesday to feed the people of Roseville and surrounding areas.  They also sponsor many missionaries around the globe.  If you are looking for a great Church to attend in Roseville, Harvest Community Church is the place to visit. Everyone has been such a blessing.
Wonderful Pastors', ministry and congregation. We love harvest! The staff and church is so friendly and welcoming. We absolutely love the kids program! We have made so many wonderful friends and built an amazing community here. :) Im new to area and im from Paradise fire 2018.  I havent gone to church since then.  I went last sunday and felti was home again.  I also love your 1100 a.m. service as im not an early bird...with love and gratitude.  Christine

name: Harvest Community Church - Spring Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited on a holiday weekend because it's where my grandkids participate in Paideia. Young adults and families seemed to be a fairly large proportion, but there was a broad age mix. The music and program were very well done -- definitely contemporary style, and the worship team player and sang well as they led the congregation with the music. VERY solid message, which is most important to me. Clear presentation of the gospel. I really enjoyed the pastor's communication style. Really, everyone with whom I had contact with was upbeat, positive, and joyful.

If I lived down there, it would absolutely be in my short list of churches to attend. This church, like so many others in the area, is eager to preach about the love of God and Christ—but that love seems to have limits when you’re gay or trans. I have been attending the church for more than 5 years my mom took me there after we left the church I was first brought into. We have loved the church ever since! The church is kept clean, the services are understandable and relate-able, the pastors and the staff get to know the people of the church. Come and visit and I promise you will fall in love! They are like many other churches sadly, all they care about is how much money you contribute to the church. Could care less about how to help you.
They absolutely are nice to your face, beware!
I would try anywhere else, I have been there more than once so it's not as if I didnt try to get to know this community of so called Christian's. When your in the greatest need, that's when they are around the least. Love one another is not at this church, they love you only if you have a big wallet. I love this church. The pastors' messages make more sense to me than any other messages have done in the past. Their ability to completely explain the Word and how to use all these ideas in our lives is simply priceless. This church community becomes more and more important to me, too, as time goes on. What a wonderful place to worship!

name: Harvest Community Church of Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
We were looking for a home church that reflects our community back in Hawai'i and we found it at Harvest Community Church of Irvine. Their role in biblical perspective is on point to what we were looking for, teach the Bible, Love God, and love people. Plenty of parking, friendly atmosphere (new building), we started off just church hopping but now, we found a home where we, as a family can serve Jesus together. THE church is very good n love the singing and the congregation everyone is very nice
Pastor n members are welcoming. Lovely place to be welcomed. A warm, happy, godly community.  Everyone so friendly and welcoming.  Feels like home. Really had a good time at took my family and my son there somewhere save he had fun definitely go back next year if they have it again Full of kind and warm inviting people

name: Harvest Evangelical Church of San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary: I have been there by the invite of Brother Enoch to attend the Chinese New Year Celebration party. He held a big plate of delicious food for me since I am right off the airplane and driving from SAN airport, when I arrived it is almost 2 pm. From parking lot, I started to see there were all the tables in the plaza, folks were enjoying the community talk, the fellowship and of course the food. Later events at the church hall were fabulous, I could feel the close relationship among church folks and the vibe is very friendly and showing love in Jesus. May God keep blessing these folks and the Harvest Evangelical church! Excellent parking and an overall prime location for a church in Del Mar. Nice, clean campus. Food got worse but great community. The people there are great and very friendly. Its Sunday service is marvelous.

name: Harvest Family Church - Cypress Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I love Harvest Family Church!! The people are super friendly and everyone treats you like family the minute you walk in. The Praise & Worship is anointed and you encounter the sweet presence of God every service! You get the full teaching and preaching of the Gospel at HFC and it will change your life, if you let it. My husband and I have been blessed to attend some wonderful churches in our lifetime in different states, so when we found HFC we knew we found an absolute GEM!! Pastors Paul and Brooke are the most loving, authentic, on fire, Jesus loving, soul winning people we’ve ever met… and that’s just the truth! If you want to grow in your walk with the Lord, experience His presence, learn how to win souls, and have a beautiful church family that loves you, just come! We searched for a church home off and on for many years. We first visited HFC on 7/28/2013. We are so blessed to still be members of a church family that we could not have picked any better ourselves. We love our Pastors and their beautiful family! Pastor Paul teaches the word of god straight off the pages of Gods Holy Bible! If you are searching  for your home church with an amazing, loving family, that is on fire for the Lord come, check us out. You will be welcomed with God’s amazing love. Great place of worship and encounter the Holy Spirit.
The pastors are wonderful. Humble and sincere, caring and genuine. I love Harvest Family Church and how they allow the Holy Spirit to move and have His way! It’s all in their name, they go after the harvest and minister the Gospel to win souls to Jesus! When you walk in the door you are welcomed and feel peace and joy in the room! It’s almost unexplainable, everyone is so kind and pleasant and always happy to see you! Pastor Paul and Pastor Brooke are genuine and all loving and always delighted to see everyone, EVERY TIME! HFC members are also a pleasure to serve with as they make you feel like family!  HFC ministries are wonderful, there is joy in the worship , joy in the sermon, joy in the Nursery, joy in their Kids Connect! God shows up and shows out every Sunday and the Holy Spirit moves as He wills! Me and my family love this church as it has truly changed our lives and continues to do so! This is a church alive and on Fire for God! One service could change your life! If you are looking for a church that welcomes you and treats you like you belong. They are the best Spirit filled church that aligns with the Bible. Awesome Kids Connect Church and loving nursery. You feel like family. Awesome ladies and men’s ministries. You definitely would not regret the awesome experience that awaits you.

reviewSummary: The very best!  God's word taught fully and we are family!  Come and experience the Love and Good News! Come let us share the LOVE with you today!  Great teaching of God's Word! BEST TEACHING FOR VICTORY Hear a Great word You will not get better teaching anywhere else. Pastor Bill is the best.

name: Harvest For Christ Church - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary: As a 15 year member of Harvest For Christ Church, I'd say the proof is in the fruit! Being apart of a local church that teachers and preaches the word of God is life changing! Honestly it gets better and better! Praise and worship is amazing! The community outreach ministry has increased so much! You couldn't pay me to gather anywhere else! 100% wheat 🌾 A place to worship God in spirit and in truth. Bishop Miller teaches directly from the Bible in a form that worshipers can understand and obtain knowledge to apply to the daily Christian walk. Pastor Robbi Miller (First Lady) has a loving spirit that makes the church experience very easy, delightful and comfortable at all times. This church is a place to call home where one can grow in the Word and there is a strong youth ministry that's amazing. If you're looking for growth in being a disciple for God, a loving community, and leadership that teaches with compassion come visit Harvest For Christ Church located in Douglasville, Ga. Have you attended church as routine but never quite felt at home or like something was missing? Here at Harvest for Christ Church located in Douglasville, Ga. you feel like you belong. It’s a sense of family & community helping you navigate your Christian walk. The word is brought forth weekly & classes are offered to help further your relationship in Christ!  If you are tired of searching- search no more. We’d love to have you join us for service where the BIBLE is the only source used to bring you a life changing word! Hope to meet you soon. I was first introduced to church by my best friends Aunt around the age of 10. I'd attend services, sing in the children's choir, VBS, was baptized, ext. But never really understood God's love, His words or what being a disciple was or what it truly inteled.. After years of unsteady church attendance,  Bishop Dr. Carlos and Pastor Robbi Miller started Harvest for Christ Church in Douglasville. As soon as you walk through the doors, you're welcomed with smiles love and maybe a few hugs. The singing, the fellowship, the word... Bishop Miller is an exceptional teacher of God's Word. Over the years, Harvest has helped me not only have a stroger faith and better understanding of God's love and words,  but knowing God's love for me, makes me want to share with others. Harvest has helped me open up to talking about His love. I've prayed with friends, something I've never done openly before. I'm happier now that my relationship with God has evovled into something amazing! One visit is all you need. Stop by and see for yourself. I hope to see you there. I've been coming to Harvest For Christ Church in Douglasville GA, for over 20 years. I have learned so much about leading a Godly life under the leadership of Bishop Carlos and Pastor Robbi Miller. Harvest for Christ Church ministry offers a great atmosphere for complete family growth in praise and worship, spiritual development, Christian living and growing your relationship with God. Come join us in our Sunday morning Corporate Prayer at 9:00 am, and our Sunday morning worship service at 10:00 o'clock am. You will be welcomed, feel very comfortable and want to come back for more of the good spiritual feeding.

Last night at Harvest OC was such a beautiful night of worship wish we could do this every night...spending time at the feet of Jesus is is something we need to do every single moment of our lives...Blessings to all of you in the mighty name of Jesus Amen 🙏 ❤️ God is so worthy of all our praise 👏 amen 🙏 ❤️ Great place great people great church to worship at lots of smiles and very welcoming no matter how I walked in always feel so awesome by the time I walk out

reviewSummary:

I am dressed nice I don't think I look suspicious but seemed a bit weird and I felt profiled. But oh well. Volunteers not very friendly towards me. name: Harvest Time Assembly of God Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
The first time I came to Harvest Time Assembly of God Church everything just felt right! The love, the kindness, the warmth they bring to your spirit! God lead me to this church and it was everything I was look for! I give God the glory! Praise God and all the love and work He is doing to this church and the people! Pastor Kurt and Pastor Valerie are so uplifting, gifted, and encouraging! Each service and ministry brings out the joy, the love, and the purpose of our Lord Savior Jesus Christ in our hearts growing each day here and learning more and more! What a wonderful blessing! Thank you Jesus! I stayed quiet for a long time, but I want to be honest about my experience at this church. I came here hoping for support, kindness, and understanding, especially during hard times in my life, but instead I often felt judged, ignored, and unwelcome.

Around 2020 when everything was difficult, I reached out for help while struggling with problems at home, but I felt dismissed and not believed. Instead of support, I felt alone. There were also situations where my concerns did not feel taken seriously, which made me feel even more uncomfortable and hurt.

The pastor’s family also made me feel unwelcome at times. I often felt ignored, judged, or treated coldly, especially by the daughter. There were moments where I felt so uncomfortable emotionally that I wanted to leave early after getting rides because I felt unwanted and embarrassed.

Over time, many people at the church made me feel worse emotionally. Some ignored me or gave rude looks even when I tried being friendly and respectful. More recently, I also felt like my boyfriend was unfairly judged during preaching, which hurt deeply.

I love Jesus Christ and believe church should be a place of compassion, kindness, and support, especially for people who are struggling. Sadly, my experience here became very painful and disappointing. I never thought I would say this because I used to like this church years ago, but I no longer felt welcomed or cared for. I wish I could give 0 stars. An absolutely wonderful church and such warm-hearted people! I always feel so welcomed walking through the doors. The songs are beautiful and the word of God shared by pastor Kurt and Valerie are so meaningful. I highly recommend being a part of this amazing group of Christ centered individuals! A loving and understanding church it doesn't matter how you come into church or where you're at or where you're coming from, they love and support us and guide us to salvation baptism. and most of all lead us to the cross where Jesus Christ died on the cross for since so that we may be saved in return with him 1 day and it's coming soon, so prepare yourselves and it's a beautiful loving church. Hope to see you soon. Such a lovely experience at Harvest Time Assembly of God. The pastors greeted me warmly, and you could feel our Lord’s presence in the church. Everyone was so nice and welcoming and the services are always so wonderful to hear. Thank you for sharing God’s word with everyone.

name: Harvest Time Christian Fellowship
reviewSummary:
My daughter and son started her in the beginning of August and for the first time since they have gone to daycare starting at 4 months old for both of them, they have actually enjoyed going to daycare and not scared every time I drop them off. They have been to two other places and Harvest Time is the first place that has kids with the right age group.

Management is willing to work with you and always take care of any concerns you may have. I would say this is the best environment for any kid and they care about the kids that come in and not about the money that does. I am so grateful for the staff and the management. They are truly amazing people. My sons have been at harvest time since 2019. My oldest started at 2 years, and my youngest started at 3 months.

As a working mom, I am so appreciative leaving my kids in a place I know they’re are happy and safe. Management had always been trustworthy, good at communicating and organized.

They are always working to improve their facility. They have a code locked front door, a digital app check in/out system so only approved parents/guardians can pick up your kids, a privately enclosed playground with turf and playground equipment.

They have small classes so ratios stay legally manageable, ranging from infants to preschool classes. My kids are in full time daycare, but they also offer before and after care for working parents with kids in the public school system.

If there’s ever been an issue that concerns me, they have been very accommodating at resolving any issues. I am so thankful for the staff and facility at Harvest Time!! I love this church. It's a very small and intimate church which is wonderful because we all have a chance to get to know each other. The pastor and his wife know everyone by name. There are a variety of small groups to join that's not only for church members but for the public if they would like to join in fellowship.

There is a variety of ages who attend. Mostly the older generation, but there are some young adults that attend. It definitely would be great to have more young adults attend.

Worship is mostly contemporary and usually lasts about 5 songs or so.

The church service starts at 1030 and ends between 12 and 12:15. If you come early at 10, they offer a little breakfast of fruit and donuts/pastries until 10:25 so we get some fellowship in before service.

They have a Just Youth ministry for kiddos 9 and up. The children's church service is for kiddos ages 3-8. They also have a church nursery for infants to ages 3. The volunteers that work in the nursery are trained in childcare and cpr/first aid certified. Very unprofessional staff who show little to no care for children that are not their own. They do not pay attention to allergies and majorly lack compassion. Have seen staff members become irritable and impatient with children on multiple occasions. A very Loving Welcoming and very Giving Church. I Love this church. The pastor gives some of the best msgs he breaks it down in a very real way. He is also very humerous at the same time. You can see and feel the love coming from hi

name: HarvestDowntown - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: I just had my wedding at Harvest Downtown last Saturday, and it was a fantastic experience, start to finish!  The church is beautiful, and the courtyard was so wonderful and convenient for photos, as well as our dinner service from a food truck.  The church had everything we needed for the ceremony and reception--a great little kitchen (including a fridge for the cake) and staging area, plenty of chairs and tables, and they let us decorate according to our theme.  Their incredible wedding coordinator, Brittany, was so prepared and thoughtful and helpful with suggestions, she made sure nothing could go wrong.  She went above and beyond and we are so grateful for her--she was a true blessing that weekend.  We were able to hold the rehearsal and decorate the day before, which was so helpful.  There were even separate staging areas for the grooms' and bridal parties, and playrooms for younger guests.  We felt so doted on--they made it such a smooth and special experience.  Could not recommend more for your special occasion--10 out of 5 stars! Bible centric Protestant church with services at 9 am and 10:40 am.  Solid preaching and informal atmosphere When my wife and I were looking for a local church, we attended HarvestDowntown for a service. The lead pastor got up on stage and said, "We don't take ourselves seriously, but we do take God seriously." And while I understand that the "Church" is comprised of its people and not of its building, this beautiful and historic church always amazes me Sunday after Sunday. If you're looking for a small, close-knit church family, then this is the place for you. Absolutely love this church. Pastor Kurt makes it his mission of knowing each member of his congregation. This church has done so much for me and my special needs daughter. Definitely have become a second family to us. People that truly care about you. You can instantly tell the members are not acting or being fake when they engage you in conversation. Give it a chance, speak to the Leaders, see for yourself. You will not regret it.

name: Hatcher Grove Christian Community - Cary Campus
Haven City Church
reviewSummary:
Great pastor. Great church. Truly serving the city.  And sermons are like a Bible study.  If you would like to learn scripture, you will like it here.  The pastor takes time to study.  He gives you history as well as helping you with understanding God’s word.  A rare find. I encountered this church this week. They are a newly planted church. They are focused on serving and loving their local communities in Fells Point. The staff have committed their life to serving Christ. It is infectious to even be around this church, even if you aren't Christian. Their heart for the city of Baltimore is refreshing and encouraging. While it can easy to stay in a bubble and accept things the way they are, this church is dedicated to seeing positive change in this city. Haven City church is committed to a multi cultural and economically diverse church. So don't expect comfortable Christianity. Expect to be challenged about what the Gospel actually teaches, and what it means to follow Christ. Highly recommend this church for anyone, no matter what their faith background is. Just to  see what active Christianity looks like. This is a church is led by a pastor who is passionate about Christ and genuinely cares about his congregation. The members of this church are welcoming, know each other's names, and make great conversation.

Unlike most churches, this church genuinely represents a true cross-section of Baltimore City. There who attend come from ALL walks of life.

This church is for the long-term Christian, the new believer, and the curious.

I would highly recommend this church. I had been searching for a Church since becoming born again. My husband came across this Church one night and we started our investigation. We didn't want to join just any church. The statement of faith lined up with our beliefs and they looked like they were really trying to be apart of the community.

After my first visit, my husband and I, fell in love with the Church. The sermons and community we have joined has helped us grow in our relationship with God.

The staff is very welcoming and while everyone is open and loving, its not overwhelming.

The worship leader on the piano is amazing, I think one day he will be playing in front of huge theaters!

Come this Sunday! God bless and guide you! Amazing new church in Fells Point! Pastor Josh and the rest of the leadership are warm and inviting. Its a small church that feels like Baltimore. They do outreach in Douglass homes and run the Compassion Center on Eastern Ave. Even though its a small Church its growing and active in the community. The breakfast in before Church Service is awesome, so come hungry.

name: Healing Grace Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: I just love this church. They preach the word of God and the gospel of the Lord Jesus Christ. I remember attending your back in 2010 Pastor Gregory and his wife Sherrie are just incredible. They really love people they have ministries for children teenagers the entire family. they are very evangelistic and outreach oriented, not only to Tulsa, but touching people all over the world —Plug into this church. If you are new to Tulsa or if you are looking for a new church home. Healing Grace is the best church ever! I came here eight years ago and have never regretted it! The people are loving and kind and the pastor Greg and his wife Sherry are amazing and you will never hear a message that does not include the love of God and his amazing grace. You will always leave church feeling uplifted and loved never beaten down or feeling less than. My husband Paul and I have been attending Healing Grace Church for several years and we love this place. Pastors Greg and Sherry Riether truly are pastors to us. We feel like part of a family and not like we are just numbers or statistics.  Each week Pastor Greg shares a new aspect of God’s love for us and the finished work of Jesus.  We no longer feel the pressure to perform in order to please God, but instead are enjoying the abundant life Jesus said he came to give us. Since we’ve been attending so many wonderful things have happened in our lives. Our finances have been blessed and prayers have been answered. Healing Grace is truly a wonderful place to experience the healing love of Jesus, through the word and in fellowship with others touched by His love! We love it here! Great welcoming church that people genuinely want to get to know you. Nice smaller congrigation. If you are looking for a Holy Spirit filled church that believes in the 5 fold ministry and learn about grace or go deeper, I'd invite you to check them out. I instantly felt at home in this very special family.  I was welcomed, loved, and accepted without conditions.  I have been going here for 3 years and never been to a church quite like this.  It is a very unique place that demonstrates everything it teaches, which is the solid Gospel of God's unconditional love, kindness and complete restoration.  The leadership is completely committed to empower people and fully believes in people, even when they don't believe in themselves.  I have never been to a place so incredibly encouraging, both from the pulpit and face-to-face.  This is a place that I can bring literally anyone, and know they will be fully welcomed, accepted, and loved.  Highly recommend.

name: Healing Place Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: My family visited the airline prairieVille location and all they talk about is the love that was shown and felt . Holy atmosphere. This is what this world needs true followers of Christ . Thanks for showing love to my family. We will definitely visit again I love this church. All the people here are so nice and all warming like family. They come up and talk to you and really seem to care that you're there. I love how engaging they are and send you reminders of all the events and services they have. I love the diverse culture. True unity. I love the way the pastor delivers the word very detailed, even a child would understand. I love woman's Bible study very nice set up. Very understandable. I love how secure the children are in their service. I love what they are doing in all the nations and in Africa and how they are driven to help all types of communities and people. They really make an impact and are not just saying they are. Lastly I love the praise and worship. Its awesome. Very good church to go to. I have been going to this church for some time. Almost every week the pastor brags about the great things done in the missions and how the church is a very giving church and loves to help those in need. However when you are in actual need, they will NOT help you. I feel like that is not right for the pastor to offer help he does not intend to follow through with. That is not what the Lord wants. You are using his name to look good but behind the closed doors you are not doing what you preach. Broke my heart to experience this first hand. This church is extremely beautiful and a friendly staff.  Great music.  Good message.  I’ve historically attended small a small church and prefer.  However others may enjoy larger gatherings. I am truly enjoying my experience here. The people are very kind and welcoming. I’ve bought my first Bible this year, I’ve attended women’s Bible studies, and I’ve started learning more Bible stories than  I realized existed. They’ve made learning about God more interesting for me and I appreciate it, and am excited to finish next steps and find a small group to join.

name: Heart City Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: Heart City is an incredible place where people truly have a heart to pursue Jesus together. I love worshipping God here, sermons draw me closer to God, my kids love to be at church, and I feel seen and known when I’m there.  I’m also thankful for the format of connect groups and how it allows for deeper connection & conversation. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home and is filled with the presence of the Holy Spirit, come to Heart City Church! The community here is warm, welcoming, and exactly what my husband and I have been searching for! I love this group of people and their heart for God! Join us, we would love to see you! Do you want to be loved well? Come to Heart City. Do you want authentic? Do you want to be heard and seen? Come to Heart City. How about heart felt worship? We do that. Do you desire relevant bible teachings? Come to Heart City. Do you want to know Jesus in an intimate way? For real? It's about a relationship. Not religion. We can introduce you to him. We are a group of normal people being naturally supernatural. Come as you are. You will be loved. Great place to find God's presence! Located close to Bridge Park.

name: Heart Cry Church - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
From what I have experienced, the church is extremely welcoming. No matter what walk of life you come from the doors are open, because none of us are good we are all sinners. Pastor Billy preaches about Jesus and what he did for us on the cross. Hard times are coming, don't be afraid and have faith. Just another church more focused on performance over reaching people outside of the church.
“Take heed,” the Lord cautioned, “that you do not your righteousness before men, to be seen of them: else you have no reward with your Father who is in heaven” (Matt. 6:1).
Your 2 female singers on mics couldnt make it more about themselves and their vocal "capabilities". You're leading a center of worship not putting on a concert. And what's with all of these new age churches using smoke machines???? I just dont get it.
I attended for a month and tried my best to love it here but just cant deal with performative Christians. I've been to Heart Cry three times.
I've been stopped by their security guys three times.

I appreciate that - particularly being stopped on my way to the kids check-in area.

My wife and I took different cars, so the kids were with her. When I came in, the security guy stopped me because I didn't have a kid and I was heading into the kid check-in area. Fair enough - that's a red flag.

I appreciate that they're less concerned with the possibility of offending me, and more concerned about making sure my kids are safe. Best Church I've ever been to!  Pastor Billy is real, down to earth, humble, and loves his congregation.   He and his wife built this Church from the ground up! We live in Snow Flake, I drive 3 hours to Hear pastor Billy, and visit my grandkids. The messages are always straight from the word and the church is filled with the Holy spirit. Such a blessing to be able to go. Thank you Jesus 🙏💕

name: Heart Lutheran - Temecula Campus
Heart of Christ Fellowship Church (주심교회) - Tustin Campus
Heart of the Bay Christian Center - Hayward Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this church. My wife and I came in from another country and were wondering whether we would find somewhere like our home church, we ended up finding one that exceeded our home church experience with Heart of the Bay. This is a church where people walk in love. So proud of the leaders of the church, this is a word and faith church where the pastoral staff put premium on helping you mature spiritually. A church that truly gives expression to the gifts of the spirit, in prayers, healing and the miraculous. Anytime I look back at when we came in here over 2 years ago, my heart just ends up being so filled with gratitude to God, for bringing us here and connecting us with such an awesome church family. Phenomenal church with wonderful pastors who genuinely care and with solid experience  in the Word, the things of God and in dealing with the issues of life. I really enjoy Heart of the Bay Christian Center. It's a bible based church and a great place to reconnect with your spiritual Christian growth. Pastors Mark and Brenda are  heartfelt and welcoming to all people and they are truly on fire for our Lord Jesus Christ. I've restarted my spiritual journey with the lord roughly a year and a half ago and I am so blessed to have made this church my home. Heart of the Bay is a family church. I feel  the real and tangible presence of God in this place. I’ve been attending for almost 3years and I’m ever grateful God led me to this church. There’s so much to say about HBCC.
From the genuine love and care of the pastoral staff and members, to the pure anointing of God and the intentional ministries- 4 children’s ministries ( babies,toddlers,preschool,k-12) OneEighty(youth group),Emerge(Young Adults), Coupled Together (married couples ministry),Second Wind(60y/o and Better) We Care( Free Food pantry open every Sunday after the 11am service and so on.
Every morning before the service, there’s a group that prays for all members of the church,for the sermon/message that the pastor will preach and for the people who attend. I believe this is one of the reasons why the church keeps getting better and better after over 35 years of existence. This church is a praying church! If you need faith or faith buddies,Heart of the Bay is the place for you. Heart of the Bay is also solid on the Bible and moving in the Holy Spirit which is essential for Christian living.
They mean it when they say their mission is to Reach the Lost,Heal the Hurting and Mature the Believer.
I see that in action all the time! Wonderful, Magnificant, Straight from the Word of God. Pastor Mark Thomas is right on the Mark!!! Truely called and carrying out that call upon his life. Pastor Brenda as well. This church being led by the Spirit of God has changed my whole families life. When hearing the Word of God and taking heed to carrying it out in our own personal lives. They teach you how to pray for and care for others through the Word of God as well. So empowering!!!

name: Heart of the Rockies Christian Church (Disciples of Christ) - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has changed my relationship with God and the Christian faith for the better. The people are genuinely interested in your story, the sermons are deeply moving, and the music is beautiful.

Better yet, this church truly puts its money where its mouth is--besides being involved with organizations like Faith Family Hospitality, ISAAC, and Kids at Heart, they donated a large portion of their lot for affordable housing and Habitat for Humanity and L'Arche homes to be built. They have donated fresh produce from their community garden to the food bank for years.

Questions are welcomed--they even encourage the youth to bring their hardest questions to a "stump the pastors" night. I've never seen a church create community quite like this, and because it is open and affirming, there is truly a place for everyone. Came back to update my review after a couple of years here! Heart of the Rockies is progressive, LGBTQ+ inclusive (open and affirming), and has great programs for kids including Sunday evening youth groups for kids from preschool to high school and a nursery during the service. My husband and I just had a baby and we can't imagine a better place to bring up our daughter where she feels loved by her community and by God. Our community has shown up for us by getting us everything we needed and bringing us meals when our baby girl showed up earlier than expected! We couldn't have done it without them.

Our church really has heart for serving the community - particularly those facing housing and food insecurity, refugees, immigrants, and families. When the world is in turmoil, giving back to the community helps to renew my spirit. I also love singing in the choir and we have such thoughtfully chosen music by the amazing Ruth. A church that actually follows Jesus’ message, which at its core is to love and accept all people regardless of race, orientation, background, etc. I wish there were more out there like Heart of the Rockies. Generous, authentic, and welcoming congregation that deeply cares about their members and community. Thanks HRCC for giving younger folks like me a reason to still have faith in a church. This progressive church has some of the kindest and most supportive people attending it. This church is open and affirming of all ethnicities, genders, and sexual orientations. They host many activities throughout the year for children and youth. And perhaps the most exciting of all, this church is extremely active in the community. The pastors and the people within the congregation work with non-profits like "Kids at Heart", "Faith, Family, Hospitality", "Habitat for Humanity", "Isaac" and more to help people in Fort Collins. All questions are welcome here; you don't have to conform to a list of acceptable beliefs to be embraced. The kind, loving people will welcome you. The pastors are insightful and warm. Every chance I get, I attend here. I'm "married" to my own church, but HRCC is my mistress. 😂

reviewSummary:
Went to visit this church recently this weekend and I thought it was very great. I went with some friends to a service and I thought the service was fantastic. Heart Revelation Church, thank you so much for having me this past weekend.

What's stopping you? Become a part of the body, and the kingdom of God today, because tomorrow is never promised. Too crowded.  They need to find a bigger place.  It's hard to breathe inside as it is over capacity, and parking is terrible.  If you come just on time, you'll be parking on the next block.  Better come in 30 minutes early on the first service if you want to get a parking close to the entrance. Love my church they're such welcoming members nothing but genuine love for everyone I went to this church back in December and the people are very friendly but it is a huge prosperity church, I sat down during a Christmas service and some others after where they passed the tithing bucket not once but twice. Not only that they own the coffee shop next to the church, the church is already running enough money but what about the contribution to the community? I use to hear a lot of good about this church but it’s obviously they just want money at the end of the day. Second I also attended one of the growth groups super sweet people but it can be troublesome when everyone gangs up on you.

name: Heartland Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary:
Every Blade of Grass Has a Purpose

Our family was introduced to Heartland Church through a mutual friend, and from the very first moment we stepped onto this campus, something felt different. I couldn’t put my finger on it right away - but it was real.

I’ve visited over 80 churches in my lifetime. Nothing quite prepared me for this.

The best way I can describe Heartland is this: every single blade of grass is intentional. Someone thought about it. Someone prayed over it. From the overflowing parking lots every Sunday and every morning during 21 Days of Prayer, to the small group leaders who genuinely want to be there and not because they have to, but because they’re called to be. From programs like God Owns It All that began to rewire how I think, to the sheer volume of people who flood the front in answer to the Lord’s call during baptism and every blade has a purpose.

Even the skyrocketing fountain. Even the beautiful green grass. Someone thought about that. And when you stand there and take it all in, the intentionality is almost overwhelming.

This is a megachurch where everyone feels mega important. Walking these halls, I’ve never once felt like anyone was checking a box. The people serving aren’t there to fulfill a checklist  they’re there because they love people. That agape love, the kind you read about but rarely experience, is woven into every single interaction at Heartland. It’s something my family had simply never felt anywhere else.

Being trusted to become a partner of this church has been one of the greatest honors of my life. To stand at those waters and witness my two biological children and our foster daughter be baptized, because they wanted to be, they felt called, to see them empowered in that moment is something I will carry forever.

Heartland has made me a better leader. A better father. A better leader of my team. It has given me a vision for my company and my family that I didn’t have before. The church is there for us. They are intentional. They want to serve others. And because of that, we are changed.

If you’re looking for a place where you truly belong, where every blade of grass was thought of and every person was made to feel that their life has purpose then Heartland is that place.

I’m not just grateful it exists. I’m grateful we were trusted enough to be part of it. I tried several churches before finding my place here. It feels like family when I go. People want to interact and are so kind and helpful. They have lots of small groups to be involved in. There are lots of young people who go here and get invoked. Love all the community projects. Pastor is awesome. Love the music/worship time. Words cannot describe how thankful I am for this house. The family is so welcoming and non-judgemental. There are people from all over from many sides of the spectrum (all of God's children). I have never been to a congregation such as this. You walk in and the happiness and gratefulness is so contagious. Thank you to everyone that has welcomed me with open arms. I am truly grateful to serve and cherish our Lord next to you all. We came from Arizona for a vacation to Indiana to see family. During our vacation in Indiana we lost our family member as they passed away. One of our family members who visited for vacation as well chose this non-denominational church. We absolutely loved it and was so beautiful going for mothers day. The music was amazing and worship was wonderful listening to the prayer. Truly blessed for Heartland Church. I moved here with my kiddos 6 years ago from CA and started my Godly-community journey immediately. My family and I walked into service and knew quickly…this was going to be our church home. The theology, the worship, the message, the leadership and the people…are amazing!

Although large, the church feels small and loving! This is our family! Embraced…seen…valued…we cannot say enough just how much Heartland is a light in a world of darkness…

Here…I have found God’s purpose for my life and my family is surrounded by a community that is the Godly village we needed to grow our faith and strengthen our walk with Him 🥰

The messages are of sound doctrine and relevant for life application.  If you are looking for a church to call home, then you should put Heartland at the top of your list of places to visit. Great church, very warm and friendly. Everyone is great and will become family I love my lord

reviewSummary:
We have had an enjoyable experience at both the church and the weekday preschool. Our daughter attended when she was 3 and 4 years old. The teachers were absolutely so incredibly sweet and kind. They prepared her for kindergarten well. The church is always so welcoming. Their events are also such a nice way to bring the community together. We love being a part of the Hebron family. Hebron Weekday Preschool has been a HUGE blessing to my family. I cannot say enough positive things about this preschool! From the directors to the classroom teachers every single person we have worked with have been absolutely amazing. Sending my child to this preschool was one of the best decisions!

My child started going to Hebron Weekday Preschool after we had a bad experience with another daycare and I was so hesitant on sending him to another preschool. Both of my oldest children had been in multiple other childcare settings and none of them compared to the love, care, and growth that my son made while attending Hebron Weekday Preschool. He has been there since he was 2 years old and will be going to kindergarten in the fall.

We have had amazing teachers year after year who have become some of our closest friends and part of our family now. Our first year we had Mrs. Kaylyn & Mrs. Biamyl,  year 2 we had Mrs. Kristen & Mrs. Izabela, and this year we had Mrs. Andrea & Mrs. Dion and every single year has been a true blessing! Not only have we had a great experience with my son’s classroom teachers, but every single teacher he has come in contact with has been so kind and nurturing and truly treat the kids with such care!

As a an educator for 10+ years, with multiple different school systems, I would recommend this preschool to ANYONE and EVERYONE! We have had such a wonderful experience and are going to miss this preschool so much in the Fall! We feel so incredibly grateful to have found this preschool! From the moment we started in 2023, it has felt like a warm, welcoming, and nurturing environment for our child. The staff goes above and beyond to create a safe, engaging, and positive space where children can truly thrive.

My daughter’s first teacher was Mrs. Kaylyn and I was so nervous about trusting someone else other than family with my first baby. After meeting her and starting the school year, all of those worries melted away. She was nothing short of amazing. She is patient, kind, and genuinely cares about each child’s growth and happiness. We’ve seen such wonderful progress over the years at Hebron—not just academically, but socially and spiritually as well. It’s clear how much love and dedication all the staff pour into the classroom every day. I felt so confident in their program that my both my daughter and son attend now.

Communication with parents is excellent, and we always feel informed and involved. It gives us such peace of mind knowing our children are in such capable and caring hands. The faith focused curriculum and photos throughout the day are a daily reminder that we made the best choice for a preschool for our kids.

We highly recommend this preschool to any family looking for a place where their child will be supported, encouraged, and truly cared for! Had the worst experience with this preschool. My son was 2 years old at the time and got kicked out because he was “running” in class and he had a speech delay; what do you expect a 2 year old to do besides running and playing? My child has great manners, doesn’t hit, doesn’t bite, he is just playful and he was only 2 years old at the time. They really made me think there was something wrong with my child until I finally excepted their decision. I spend a whole year panicking and thinking something was wrong with my son because of these people. Finally, my son is now almost 4 and he is making full sentences, writing, reading, making additions and knows all his numbers, thanks to real educators who took their time with my son and didn’t treat him like something was wrong with him. I now regret it so much that I forced my son to go into that school every morning because after the 2nd week, he started crying every time we were driving by the school, even if it wasn’t on a school day. It’s like the school reminded him of something so horrible but he couldn’t express himself yet. That school and the teachers need to be investigated. I even spoke to other parents who had their kids in that school and had to pull them out because they had a similar experience! If you want to enroll your child in that school, think twice before you do. Love the community at this church. Perfect place to grow with people in your stage of life. Life changing experiences that have affected me permanently for the best! Thankful for this body of believers!

name: Heights Church
reviewSummary: So, I went to this church for 3 years. At first, it was great. I thought for sure this was my church home. Turns out, I was wrong. They built the new church and it seems something shifted. All of a sudden, it was bigger and it seems to me some members thought they were getting "bigger" as well. I felt like there were people who were important in the church and than the little peons who just went to the church. I never once talked to Pastor Josh and considering he was right in front of me once, looked at me, and then walked away to talk to someone else, that tells me a lot. It's very cliqueish. No one reaches out to call and ask how you are if you haven't been there in awhile. I needed help moving in November, and not one person offered to help me. I know it's not an obligation, but last I checked if we're a church family as it's been stated over and over again, there is not much "family" happening. The Pastor has been in the news lately, and he apologized, but to me, he lied. He talks of being authentic and being a leader, but doing things like that, aren't being a leader I want to follow. And yes, there is a lot of talk of tithing. I understand the concept, but if you have an entire sermon in November about donating and money (EVERY November) I feel it's a red flag. I wouldn't want to go to church for my first time and hear that as the opening sermon. The building is nice, and the worship is decent, albeit loud. But, all in all, just use discernment if you go here. Watch yourself. I am just disappointed because I thought this was my church home. Somehow, at this point, I feel they are just putting on a good show. I live right beside this church.  I watched it grow from being in one of the shops empty spaces to a beautiful church.  So many times I looked over as I drove by, and felt a pull!  My son, and I had both attended another church in Richmond.  But, after COVID, and an uncomfortable youth group, my son didn’t want to attend church anymore, and I stuck to U Tube on Sundays.  We talked about this church for a few years.  I didn’t think he would ever change his mind, but I continued to pray.  After talking to a co worker about Heights on U Tube, I found out she was attending there.  I decided to go the very next Sunday with her, and I was so pleased!  I told my son about the experience, and fingers crossed, still praying, he decided to come with me.  He LOVED it!  So very thankful Heights church came to MY neighborhood!  God bless you Josh, Crystal, and all of your team! 🙏🏻 This is a typical mega-church. They refer to services as "experiences" and the production quality is excellent. Now, I have NOTHING against professionalism, and a high degree of that in service of God is great. Especially when the message is spot-on, which it really was. But, I would struggle with discerning God's presence from the glitz and glamour. I guess it would appeal to a younger generation, and I will not criticise, but I don't think this will become my spiritual home. I am looking for a simpler "experience" with the same community focus and sincerity. Hope that makes sense. 🤍🙃 The experience is amazing. The people are very friendly and inviting. It's like going to a family home and getting that incredible warm welcome. Would recommend to all who are looking to build relationship with God and community. Pretty bad taste in my mouth with this place, honestly. Just moved to the area and was looking for a home church. After reading reviews about poor communication and trying myself to find other's experiences were replicated with my own attempt, I decided to walk up there as I'm only a mile away. I have a bulging disk in my lower back and the walk took me out and the front doors were locked so I leaned in one of the barricades to catch my breath and allow my back to rest. There was a younger lady walking laps with a male so I asked them if they were members of the church and new of how I could get in touch with someone from the leadership team. The woman said she was with real attitude and was pretty snarky. They went into the kids academy and moments later this guy comes out and towards me and began addressing me from a distance with a show gait showing apprehension. I told him I was new to the area and was looking for a church and was also called by the Lord and was looking for mentorship and guidance on my new discipleship journey. He mocked me and said, "if you're looking for a platform you're in the wrong place. We started from the bottom and now we have this multi-million dollar church so you think you're going to just come in here after we did all the work......" I had to remind him of my words that at no point did I ask to preach or lead, rather I was looking for guidance. He again suggested I find another church. The pastor steals sermons as well. I can't say for sure that God has even visited this church or the "leadership" team. I'll find another one that is Spirit led.

name: Heights Church - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is welcome ! Such a friendly family of believers. The worship music is energetic and inspiring, the teaching team has a lot of different pastors to share and preach and there are activities for all ages.  Healthy church and proud to call it mu family and my church home now for over a decade. I attended this church years ago and recently decided to return, but unfortunately the experience was overwhelming. The worship portion is now about 30 minutes long and extremely loud—more like a concert than a service. Ear protection honestly feels necessary.
They’ve also added very bright backlighting behind the stage that remains on throughout the service. The lights were so intense that I couldn’t even see the speaker clearly, only blinding rectangular light panels. If you are sensory-sensitive, this environment may be very uncomfortable.

I was also disappointed that there are no high school services on Sundays anymore. Having students attend on Wednesdays while parents attend Sundays feels like it splits families rather than allowing them to worship together.
On top of that, there was a guest speaker rather than Craig today, and unfortunately the message felt very scripted. She read primarily from her iPad and rarely engaged with the audience.

Overall, the changes the church has made don’t align with what I loved about it before, and I don’t plan to return. Awesome church and friendly accepting people... Why not come? Plus you get to worship our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ!! This is an amazing House of God. Wonderful services by Pastor Craig and Pastor Tim which will inspire you and bring you closer to Christ. There are many ministries that you can join, and plenty of volunteer opportunities for individuals looking to be of service. God is good, always. Come by and check out a service, and come spend some time with Jesus. 🙏 This was my first time here, and  It was a welcoming environment . The layout of the building makes it simple to find your way around . I was welcomed as soon as I entered the church and then again at the sanctuary . The worship was beautiful and the Members  were engaged in worship .Before I even heard the Pastor speak, I knew this is the church for me and my family . I felt peace and joy . The message was well delivered , scripture soaked and the pastor is sincere . This is a large church but not a Mega  church . There is nothing wrong with mega , but I wanted a place where I can see familiar  faces every Sunday .
Lastly, I look forward for the relaunch of Celebrate Recovery . This is a wonderful program that will serve its members and our community .
