name: High Rock Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking to hear the simple, but profound Gospel of Jesus Christ, this church embodies that to the fullest. No flashy lights or smoke machines. No endless schedule of events that lead to burnout. Just a solid, Bible based church with heartfelt worship, fantastic teaching, and a beautiful community of believers and skeptics alike who reflect the diversity of Bloomington. High Rock encourages personal growth through a love for the Scriptures, deep friendship and relational healing, and a lifestyle marked by devotion, endurance, generosity, humility, and joy. It’s definitely worth checking out. 🤍 I've attended many churches over the years living in various cities. High Rock Church has been the place where I feel most at home with a community of believers.

The biggest thing you will notice that is different at High Rock Church compared to other churches, is the friendly feel. You cannot attend on a Sunday morning without making a friend. The people in this church are the friendliest.

If you're interested in learning more about Jesus from friendly educated people, then you might try out this church. The church mostly focuses on helping people follow Jesus, training disciples and outreaching to Indiana University students.

High Rock's vision is to be a diverse and intergenerational church and it is becoming more so. But currently it is comprised of mostly young adults and families with young children, with some of the elders a little older. There are also a lot of international students and people of all races, but it could use some more elderly wisdom and diversity of age.

My wife also loves this church and feels that although she has considered herself a Christian and attended churches her whole life, she has grown tremendously in what it means to experience God and follow Him in the last ~3 years that we have attended High Rock. I’ve been happily attending High Rock with my family for a few years and love it. I went here for 11 years. I stayed in Bloomington to be a part of this church after college, and with a sorrowful heart, I would strongly recommend you do not attend this church. I am not bitter, but I just put 2 stars to hopefully get more eyes on this, and I do believe it is an actual church still. The issues are deeply rooted; they are very ambitious to be a large network of churches, and they believe that what a church leader thinks is likely from God or at least better for you than your own thinking. When this ambition to grow and the truly horrible leadership philosophy  mix, it's a concoction worse than either issue on their own. They do all they can to make you "feel" welcomed, only to test you and test you into becoming a carbon copy of your leader. You start asking them what you should do for so many scenarios in your life. For example, what to do with disciplining your kids? I mostly agree with their view, but it'd be expected, for example, that you do the same as your leader does, which, if you follow that up the chain, you're just doing whatever the leader's leader's leader does, aka the leader of the network. You're not making your own decisions on your life. But it gets worse. Instead of enjoying the people God brings, it's an all out assault to get more new people and keep them forever. As I found out.

After 11 years, I wanted a break for a few months. Just to rest at a different church for a few months. I had led a small group, which is a big undertaking at High Rock, for 7 years, through two close together kids, a new marriage, and job uncertainty. Around year 8 or 9 I got out of that, but never again felt rested. I had previously felt "led" to leave pretty strongly once before, but the lead pastor said not to trust my leading from God through his telling multiple stories where people's leading from God had gone terribly wrong (specifically stories of network church planters, which was weird). He then said he felt led for us not to leave. When asked what that meant, he said that he didn't like it. Reread those last 2 sentences...
1. tell Christians in your congregation not to trust their own leading 2. tell them what your leading is 3. brainwashed, truly.

Later, when we tried to leave again, I had given the pastor the benefit of the doubt prior, there were some stressful things at that time for him, some families were leaving the church, whom likely contributed a lot of finances, so the second time I went I was open. However, the same thing happened but worse. This wasn't me angry; I literally said we'd like to take a few months break, and I said it gently. Then I didn't get a word in as he tore into me for about 20 straight minutes. I then went back to one thing he had said in what I would fairly call a tirade; he had said that "it is not biblical to leave a church unless you are moving" (which the first time we had felt led to leave we were considering moving closer to family, so by this logic, the first time he would have been fine with us leaving, but he wasn't). I asked him where it said that in the Bible, to "not leave a church unless you are moving." He physically picked up a bible he had and said, as he quickly flipped through the whole thing, that it was "in the whole Bible." Oddly, he later twice denied ever saying this, but I remember him saying it and don't believe his, what I would now call gaslighting, because I remember him quickly flipping through the whole Bible as he said it.

To my dear friends at High Rock, I love you, and I wish you the best, but I would suggest changing churches, even if it's just for a bit to get a better perspective about life. A church does not deserve your undying loyalty. You'll know what I mean when you are out for a year or so. You'll become a new person. It's amazing.

For a long time, I was a part of this system as much as any leaders above me, and I'm sorry to those of you in my small group. I'm sorry I was so arrogant and to push my own agenda for your life on you, truly. I'm sorry to those I asked not to leave the church. I'm sorry. I am very grateful for the wonderful church family at High Rock and the great love of the people for those who have yet to know Jesus in Bloomington! The worship team is wonderful in leading the church in lifting Him high and keeping the focus on the Lord! The small groups also allow you to be open to remind us that none of us are perfect, to connect outside of Sunday service, and receive prayer from others. They help guide you in walking out faith in Jesus and are always open to visitors no matter how little they may know about the Bible or God. There is a wonderful kids program, which hosts a Kids Summer Adventure each June where little ones can come together to learn more about God and worship Him! There is accountability in the children's program with two adults in the room at all times, and training provided for those who serve:)

name: High Street Bible Church (formerly Elevation Church) - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary: I visited HSBC on time change Sunday and had a great experience. The greeters were friendly and welcoming. The worship/music was great. Pastor Matt did a great job preaching straight from the Bible while being very applicable. I heard the gospel presented clearly. Good mix of ages present. Seems like a great church with healthy ministries. Love this church!! Whether you’re just checking out Christianity, new to the faith, or have been a believer for years, you’ll find solid, biblical teaching here every Sunday that really strengthens your faith. In a time when a lot of churches water things down, High Street Bible Church stays true to the Word. If you’re looking for a place that’s warm, friendly, and genuinely welcoming and teaches the Bible verse by verse, then it’s definitely worth coming by and seeing what High Street Bible is all about. I travel from Roseville just to hear Pastor Matt preach the gospel! I love the fellowship and how welcoming everyone is. I was baptized last year and it was a wonderful experience. When I can, I go to life group too. I am so thankful to have this church open their new building close to home. The teaching is spot on the Bible, following the literal word of God. The people are incredibly welcoming, and I look forward to each Sunday!🦋 New location and service time 10:30 @ Palm and 49.

name: High Street Christian Church - Akron Campus
High Street Community Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary: I have seen and experienced the love of Jesus and His Holy Spirit here among these people. And I have resonated with so much of their practice based upon scripture and living out the life of Christ Beautiful church in a quiet neighborhood Been a Member here over 30 years. Most uplifting comfortable caring church. EXTENDED FAMILY. Love the pastor and his family. Such a wonderful group of people. Caring, supportive church. Christ centered based on the 3 basic relationships..relationship with Christ, self, and others.

name: Higher Ground Calvary Chapel - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary: This is my favorite place to go in Riverside county and I'm not just saying that because it's the church I go to. It's more to me than just a church, it's like going to a family reunion every time I go - whether regular Sunday services or special events. God and my church family have made my recovery a miracle and I love all of them. I have been attending this church since 2019..this is one of the few churches today that remains Christ-centered and Christ-focused..everyone is welcomed like family; just as you are, you are invited to come, as we look to our Lord Jesus Christ, who alone is our hope and our Savior.. God used Higher Ground Calvery Chapel to get ahold of me. Turn me around and get me back on the right track. I had been watching on Facebook during Covid. I felt the warmth even then. But when I finally came to the church, it was like God had given me a drink of cool crystal clear water when I was desperately thirsty. I am very active in the church, I have made wonderful friends, attend classes to grow in love & knowledge with the Lord. I teach Sunday School. There is always something to do if you want to get involved. They are now my family. Give us a try, I don't think you will be disappointed Haven't attended a church for 30 + years. I've ben going every Sunday now for 2 + months. Have found resources that have helped myself and family and christ. I have been attending Higher Ground Calvary Chapel for a few years now.  Pastor Dr. Harold Anderson is a gifted teacher and pastor.  The church is filled with a diverse group of believers who pray and encourage one another and is welcoming to visitors.  The worship is contemporary.  Come out and give it a try; God will do the rest :-)

name: Higher Ground Empowerment Center - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I was done when the pastor said he ain't tryna pastor his whole life. I appreciate what they say he does in the community. wonderful church family close knit church Deception business practice.
They allow staff to stand near the entrance to premium parking areas for events and sell parking. AFTER they get your money they tell you parking is half a mile way. I enjoyed the guest speaker Pastor Alexis Brookins but the host pastor....oh nevermind... that's another story 💯💯 This Church Made Me The Woman I Am Today Along With My Grandfather Late Deacon Brooks ! This is the place to be on Sunday mornings!!

name: Higher Ground Sanctuary - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
This place sucks. I was trying to use their outlet to charge my mandated ankle monitor... I had been looking around for days and was just happy to finally find a place that I can charge and not have to worry about catching a violation and heading back to prison. Figured they would have a heart and let me charge. Well they turned the power off on me completely, in one of my most desperate moments that I actually needed help. Yeah this place and these people are something else. A TRUE place of worship. Real preaching without fear or favor. Preaching that speaks to your need not just what makes you feel good. Preaching that is straight from the WORD of GOD! You can truly feel the love and presence of GOD. The pastor and ministry team truly care about your soul! You will not find more genuine people of GOD! This is the first church that I have been to where they walk the walk and not just talk the talk. Their lives and lifestyle match what they say and what you see in church. Because they have truly had a LIFE-CHANGING experience with GOD. And everyone who walks through the doors can have that same experience! Higher Ground is not just my church… but it is my family! Awesome church! Such real people. God really moves here! They have Sunday School on Sunday morning for the kids. I just returned from a ladies retreat with the ladies in the mountains. The speaker did such a great job and really helped my walk with God. I also go to the Monday Funday and monthly events as much as possible. I am excited to go to service every week. I have a true relationship with God since I've attended this church. I attended this church for many years. But I became depressed and selfish and became the lamb that got lost. Last fall my wife was crying and praying and out of the blue, a missionary contacted her and said can I pray for you? January 01, 2021 my wife and I were baptized in the wonderful name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, as members of the Church of Jesus Christ of LDS. I'm once again loving Jesus and praying and doing all I can to please the Lord. If not for Higher Ground Sanctuary, then on Hanna St, I would probably still be lost. Miss you brother Jack!
Jimmy Hensley Message to Mark Cannon:

Greetings,

God has changed my life and he used this church and it's Pastor to do it. No gimmicks, no scams, no lies, just giving you the real life experience of a member of this church. My relationship with my son's mom (now my wife - thank God) was broken, my relationship with my son was going nowhere, I was drinking everyday in order to drown out the solitude of my own thoughts and that's when I decided to come back to Higher Ground Church. Yes, I said back to. I left the church when I was much younger, and just like you, I didn't like some of the stands this church made on things like television, inappropriate dress on women, and submission to spiritual authority. But, Mark Cannon (if that's your real name - I've attended this smaller sized church for a long time and have never meet or heard of anyone named Mark Cannon), those same standards that I wasn't happy about are the very things that brought me back. There is a church that is contending for the faith once delivered to the saints and I choose (not coerced or brainwashed) to stand with a church and Pastor Ted David who cared enough to help me when I couldn't help myself and who showed me the love of God through their own brokenness and selflessness. We can't argue against power that causes a man to change like this. Only God could do this, especially with a knuckle head like me. I now have 3 children, and one on the way, with my beautiful wife and we love our church.

Your comments sound like those of a hurting man, who needs God just as much as I do. If you're willing to reveal your real name, I would love to open God's Word with you to discuss your thoughts. The solitude of our own thoughts can be a very scary place, I've been there, but there is deliverance. Reach out and allow God to heal your heart.

Your comments can be hurtful to someone who is truly looking for God. Please remove your post, as you know it is not truthful. Again, I would like to make myself available to you for a bible study or simply a cup of coffee. God loves you and He is able.

Thank you for your consideration.

name: Higher Praise Oceanside - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Place to worship with an awesome music ministry. Lots of activities for everyone to get involved. Church is family oriented and reaches out to all ages. Preaching and teaching feeds your soul and spirit .  Great place to grow in Jesus or need restoration. I'm from Michigan.  I came to cali to visit a friend.  Looked up churches on Google and found this church.  It really felt like home the service and worship and speakers are very anointed they preach the work of God. Good church peaceful graceful place for worship God Bless the Pastor and, family as well. Awesome church...God bless brother Frank and his congregation.... Atahyeah I found something necji
church I'm 911xs

name: Higher Vision Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
The best church ! You feel the Lord presence! The worship is incredible! Excellent kids ministry! Love coming on Saturdays. You feel very welcomed ! The pastor is super welcoming! Ive seen him run off the stage just to say goodbye to everyone ! His super sweet ! Higher Vision Valencia has been a blessing to my family and I. We have grown exponentially in our Faith and now consider HV Valencia our home. Thank you Pastor Jared and all the other HV pastors for your Bible teaching, prayers, and love for the Lord. Our life has been exceedingly blessed because of you and everyone who showed us Agape love. Thank you. My child loves coming to higher vision cc. He motivates me to go to church , the church is very welcoming and they welcome you with open arms. Everybody’s energy makes you feel like you belong. They don’t belittle you, they help you. I love this church because it feels like family and the Pastor and his family are amazing people. This is a place where you will definitely find God’s presence Higher Vision Church has truly been life-changing for me and my family. From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt loved, welcomed, and challenged to grow deeper in our relationship with Jesus. This church doesn’t just preach the Word, they live it. The worship is powerful, the teaching is biblical and impactful, and the community feels like family.
God has used this church to strengthen our faith, transform our mindset, and remind us that we are never walking alone. We are beyond grateful for what God is doing through this house. All glory goes to God for the incredible work happening here. 🙏🔥 I can’t say enough good things about Higher Vision Church. From the very first time we walked through the doors, Pastor Jared, Pastor Dwayne, Pastor Chad, and the entire church staff have been incredibly warm, supportive, and genuine with my family and me.
This is the church where I truly found God and gave my life to Christ. I was baptized here in the name of Jesus, and I now attend every Saturday service with joy. I’ve also completed a discipleship class that deepened my faith and taught me so much.
If you’re searching for purpose, belonging, or a real relationship with God, I highly recommend Higher Vision. The community here is truly one of a kind—welcoming, authentic, and full of love.
Thank you so much, Higher Vision Church. I’m grateful to call this my church home.

James Janya

name: Highest Praise Apostolic Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Tim and his wife are so welcoming. They are true worshippers of Jesus Christ. The ambience of the church is also serene and calm The building is not the church, the people are. Very loving and inviting. If your looking for a church that does life together encourages each other and loves God Highest Praise Apostolic Church is the place to be. I truly can say I feel the Lord in this place.  I love when Pastor Tim Arroyo preach the Word.  I feel like God is talking to directly.  When they worship it's like angels singing from heaven. There is so much peace when you walk through the doors, and u can feel the presence of God there. My family goes there and bro. Rick plays the drums .

name: Highgrove United Methodist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
How fondly do I recall this church of my childhood. I see that the fire escape pole has been removed. I spent many a summer day running up to the 2nd floor and jumping to the pole in abject fear, but not wanting to be seen as chicken, and being so thrilled to make the slide down the pole.
I loved Vacation Bible school and Sunday school in the old 2 story parsonage.  Crafting God's Eyes made from popsicle sticks and yarn, memorizing Bibles verses, and reading about Jesus and the many wonderful things of the Bible.  I especially enjoyed and loved singing the children's songs.
The new parsonage was a wonderful experience and I played fort in the hall closet and read many books and comic books while curled on a few blankets and sheets and pillows.
My grandfather Armon Lathrop was pastor there in the early 70s. I loved the big, or seemingly big, back yard. He had a park sized, sturdy swing set put in that allowed my nosy sister and I to swing high enough to see if the next door neighbors were in their swimming pool. They were always so generous and kind to us and would invite us over to swim at times.
The last memory I have of the church was when my parents, my Aunt Char, my sister and I went there to see my Aunt Karen who had cancer. We attended church and later mom and Char played the piano and organ and sang with Aunt Karen and my sister joining in. Thanks to this church for sharing theirs building with us, to praise Our Heavenly Father GOD ALMIGHTY JESUS CHRIST AND THE HOLY SPIRIT....
The people are so nice, friendly.
Thank God for all of them. May our heavenly father bless them in spirit,financial and physical in jesus power name Amen.
God bless you all.... Great place to worship No comment

name: Highland Baptist Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
Highland Baptist Church is undergoing a remarkable transformation with the installation of a new HVAC "Geothermal" green energy system. The intricate details in the window panes enhance the overall beauty, creating a breathtaking atmosphere. I eagerly anticipate witnessing the finished result, as I can only imagine how splendid weddings will be held in this picturesque setting. Highland Baptist Church is a gorgeous old vintage style church! The old stone and blue door made for amazing photos for my wedding! Inside the sanctuary, the organ, the wood beams from the ceiling, and the beautiful stain glass windows were breathtaking! Highland Baptist church is literally a church from my dreams and I am honored to have gotten married in it! I worked with Norma throughout the entire process. She was great the day of and very organized! I would recommend this church to anyone! This church is a wonderful welcoming and loving place to all people. Most churches depend upon the congregation (through the grace of God) to continue to operate. We don't grow wheat and sheep anymore. We are to give what we reap because it all comes from God in the first place. I thank God for the leaders here that are after God's own heart in trying to serve others. What a beautiful church family! As someone within the LGBT community I was hesitant to attend any church, but my experiences have been only of love and acceptance. And for those who are thinking that inclusivity means a watered down gospel, I heard more about Jesus and more scripture in one service than in other non-inclusive churches. My mother was born into a Baptist home but when she married my dad, she became a member of the Disciples of Christ.  I was raised in that Christian Church setting and ordained as a minister in it.  I came to Highland on the invitation of Troy Burden.  It’s a beautiful place.  Not the building, although it is beautiful.  It is just an indescribable experience.  In the midst of Covid and living in Cincinnati, I once again worship with you every week and it is truly an experience of “The Holy”.
Thank you to all who work hard to do what Jesus would have us do for “The Other” and each other.

name: Highland Community Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up in this church. I have many fond memories from there. My family went there my entire growing up years. Loved it!! This church is *not* wheelchair accessible. When asked to install a ramp several years ago, they refused, because it would be, "an eyesore."
If they see this review and decide to install a ramp, I would be glad to update my review appropriately. Until then, not really showing their neighbors any love. As you can see from the photo, a wheelchair ramp is prominently missing. If you are looking for a small church that is still teaching biblical truth, this is it. There is also programming for the kids. Love this place!!

name: Highland Park Christian Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: I was loosely connected to this church several years ago and after a falling out, they utilized some of my trauma as inspiration for sermons which I found really hurtful and inconsiderate. I even tried to reach out to them for a better understanding and for guidance while I was struggling but they didn’t seem interested or maybe scared I presume. Brian is a great pastor but I fear he is not the best leader is terms of stewarding people through difficult times. It seems fear is more palpable in this church than love. Sad because it has so much potential. I was baptized here on Easter 2024! It is a very inclusive church (pastors, leaders and congregation) with modern worship and a wonderful food pantry (2:20 Center) on campus! I highly recommend giving this church a try! Service begins at 10:30 AM every Sunday. Love love love this church. Outstanding community of believers. Great leadership and elders. Come experience it for yourself. This place is the real deal folks! Very friendly caring people. They help people with food and other items. Every other Saturday between 9-11 am. Very welcoming. Diverse congregation. Great leadership. Great worship team.

name: Highland Park Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church!! I have never heard a word spoken from the pulpit that is not 100% in agreement with the Word of God.  Love the Sunday School, love the music, love the preaching!!  My Spirit is filled every time I enter these doors. After looking around Nashville for months, my family and I finally came across Highland Park Church. This has been our church home for 1 year now. We are so blessed each week by the messages Pastor Dale shares. His insight is truly a blessing to us. The music is like a weekly praise concert, the music team is so good! Led by Gene Cook, who is a very talented musician. We have 3 children ranging in age from 4-12 who all love attending the childrens ministry.  If you're looking for a church that teaches the gospel of Jesus Christ with a true awareness of Gods unbelievable goodness please come by. You won't regret it. We sure don't!
God is good, all the time!!! Preacher is excellent and the people in the church are extremely friendly. I'm covered with tattoos and have large gages in my ears. No one stared at me or looked down on me for this. You can wear shorts and a t-shirt with sandals or dress your Sunday best and every one accepts you just the way you are. Sermon was excellent and so was the live band that plays contemporary gospel music. No standing and sitting back and forth just good news, good people and good music. Far cry from the southern Baptist church I grew up in. Teaching as opposed to preaching; the way it should be! 17 years ago when I first walked into this place, I admired how they were built as the "church for the unchurched" . . Christians are what give most Christians a bad name, but I must say I did not encounter that at this church and I highly recommend checking this out if you've never attended a service. It doesn't feel like church as much it feels like a great place to be. Add to that the phenomenal music performed each week and you can't go wrong with highland Park Church! My husband and I call Highland our home church away from home. When we visit our Son, Daughter-in-law and Grandson we always look forward to going . Dale the Pastor is awesome and the music is amazing. People are so kind.

Highland Park United Methodist Church - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary: I was there for the Theology graduation. 05/26. It was very nice Amazing music department, and ministers who legitimately care about you. Outstanding community involvement across Dallas, and service projects are encouraged and celebrated. Blessed to be a part of this amazing church! Visiting this church has been an incredibly uplifting experience, primarily due to its authentic, humble, and loving leadership. The pastoral staff and church leaders are the epitome of what true guidance should embody—down-to-earth, genuine, and deeply committed to their faith and congregation. It's rare and profoundly assuring to encounter leaders who not only preach about love and humility but also live it every day. Their approachability and sincere dedication make every service feel personal and heartfelt, fostering a welcoming community atmosphere that encourages spiritual growth and connection. Whether you're looking for a place to find peace, deepen your faith, or just meet kind and genuine people, this church is a sanctuary for all those who enter. Maundy Thursday services were very Holy.  I will also go there on Easter Sunday. My wife and I were there for my granddaughter’s baptism.  My experience at that church was so much a blessing.

name: Highlands Church
reviewSummary: Warm, vibrant community in North Scottsdale known for uplifting contemporary worship, caring small groups, and engaging student ministries.

name: Highlands Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending Highlands Church for over 13 years and our experience has been absolutely wonderful. We married the vision of the church, planted ourselves and now have deep roots here. We, along with many other families, have the blessing of having three generations of our family represented at this church. This church is multigenerational and multicultural and is exactly what our family has needed to thrive.

The small groups are incredible and have been an important part of our family's life as that is where we have found the deepest friendships. We actually vacation with our friends from church, which is such a blessing when you have multiple kids!

The services are great and are geared for people who don't know Jesus as well as geared towards those who have been walking with Christ for decades. Regardless, we ensure that the focus of Sunday services is to reach those who need to hear the gospel.

The Dream Team includes some of the most gracious, kind and loving people you will ever meet. Their goal on Sunday mornings is to help people to feel comfortable and have an encounter with Jesus, no matter what. Serving is so fun and an important part of a believers life, as we are to serve the church as Christ served.

We love this body of believers and invite you to come join us! This church has changed my life, and I truly believe that it's because we married the vision and planted ourselves here over a decade ago. I love this church but more importantly I love God. My daughter and I was Baptist in this church. We stop going for a year due to work. I missed it and my family and I are happy to be back! Thank you Jesus for this church and thank you Pastor Hal for doing what you do! Keep up the good work! If you are looking for a new church for your family, and want to reconnect with Jesus Christ, please come to Highlands Church in Cumming. From the inspiring messages from Pastor Hal, the uplifting music and to the programs for the children, will have you coming back every Sunday. So blessed and thankful that I did. We have been going to Highlands for 10 years and we love it. The Pastors are relatable and kind. They teach the Bible with love and no judgement. Highlands was our family's first church home. Pastor Hal and everyone at Highlands is so welcoming and loving. My entire family loves Highlands..The very first time we walked in the doors we really felt like we were home. Pastor Hal's love for God and genuine care for people is felt in his messages and resonates through the entire Dream Team. We loved everything about this church, the leadership, the youth ministry, the community outreach, the small groups; with every opportunity to connect we found our church family. We miss Highlands very much and as we look for a new church home in our new state, Highlands is the gold standard.

name: Highlands Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Can't express my gratitude enough to God for leading me to Highlands.
Never imagined a church like this was out there...and I'm not talking about the building (even though that in and of itself is gorgeous with the stained glass in the morning and the lights out front at nighttime). The people, the church body, here are so united in love for Christ and each other. He provided such a heart for the gospel and a heart for hospitality here unlike any church I've ever attended.
Very much recommend at least visiting, if the Lord put it on your heart and mind to! This church is incredible. The husband and wife leading are kind, humble, smart, and full of integrity. The worship is sincere and the community is relatable and committed to building lasting friendships. Highly recommend, our family of 4 loves it and their kids program is amazing! Our family started attending FBCLC in 1967,so my fond memories are many and go way back in time.  We have always had a solid foundation in the Lord, our rock, and sermons accurately based on His Word.  We have always supported many missionaries, many of them having come from our own flock, so it is considered important to reach people in other lands as well as in our own community with the good news of Jesus Christ and His salvation.  We are a loving congregation who care and look after one another.  My "Christian Family" is a major part of my life.  We have groups and programs to meet most every need.  Our Pastor Bill spends much time preparing his good Bible-based sermons and is very active in our community.

Try us, I'm sure you will like us, as many of our newcomers have discovered! This church has been a very loving and community oriented Christ focused family church. My husband and I were looking for a church and were invited to join the worship team. Amazingly I was so moved by the pastor's message.  We were greeted by a warm and inviting group. FBCLC has a classes for young families, youth, men's group, women's groups and a place for anyone just needing a place to learn about the Bible and heal or just have a friend. They are very giving to people in need.  Plus my children have joined the youth group and actually lead several small youth  group meetings.  I highly recommend you just try our church if you are searching to hear God's message. Come find me! I'll show you around! We are a loving family of Christians whose mission is to bring the gospel of Christ to our community, country, and the world. Our time of worship has everything from contemporary Christian music to timeless hymns. Our services are biblically grounded and enlightening. Children and youth are engaged in Christ centered activities and programs like; Vacation Bible School, AWANA, Sunday School, and Summer/Winter Camp. We have ministries that range from local food programs to missionaries across the country and around the world. We would love to talk to you over coffee before or after our 10:45 Sunday service.

name: Highlands Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
As parents, we were deeply disappointed to learn that this church provided premarital counseling to two minors without informing or obtaining consent from either set of parents. Given that they were still minors, we believe parents should have been included in such a significant process.

Whether others agree or not, we feel churches have a responsibility to exercise wisdom and encourage family involvement when counseling minors about marriage. This experience left us feeling that parental guidance and communication were not given the consideration they deserved.

We encourage parents to ask questions about Highlands of Scottsdale’s policies regarding counseling for minors so they can make informed decisions. It makes us question this church’s foundation and beliefs as it contradicts what is portrayed on their website. We also hope the church reviews its policies to ensure parents are appropriately involved when providing such counseling to minors. Second time coming here for a concert and I can honestly tell you that it's simply the best! Wide comfortable seating, very reasonable concession prices and an amazing staff! It's not just a church, but also a performing arts theater! Can't wait to see next seasons line up! I went here for the Mary Poppins play put on by Shine Theatre Company .  It was an Excellent and mind blowing performance.  These are some extremely talented actors.

I am told they also have Shows That's All Special Needs cast/ actors too. Mary Poppins was an all inclusive show.

I can see why they have performances here at the Church  because it's got a great stage.  You can see every part of the stage from any seat.

It's a Lovely church. They have a large building site with facilities for different activities.

I highly recommend everyone to go and see Mary Poppins  and any other shows  that The Shine Theatre Company puts on.  My son and I really had a wonderful time. I don't go to church here but I use their playground that is brand new and for public use. It has its has amazing shade for kids and adults and the shaded area for the adults it has misters going all day long. The playground is very nice with astro turf and even a nice splash splash pad for the kiddos. This is a great playground for the summertime! Beautiful church, but not today.  Hosting AZ Music fest, the Evil Woman ELO tribute show was terrific! The church auditorium acoustics and sound system were top notch.

name: Highlands Ranch church of Christ - Highlands Ranch Campus
reviewSummary: It's a really great church👍. Highly recommended Best church in Colorado. Not a church

name: Highline Community Church - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary: Having a transmission go out on me after personally doing every possible big repair under the hood ‘myself’ (thanks to YouTube DIY… ) has been very crippling and needed an immediate hand-up in direction and Highline Community Church was right there for me and Biff was an amazing man who really stepped up and helped as leader and friend to me and made all the difference in my direction.. and feel much more confident and hopeful of finding someone to help me fix my transmission. “THANK YOU, BIFF for being there for me under such a trying and difficult time for me!  Brethren don’t come along like they used to in the 80’s and you definitely reminded me we still exist!’🙏🏼👍🏼 The church members are exceptionally welcoming and the teaching is biblically sound and relevant. A very warm and close-knit feeling to the church. Our children also felt welcomed in youth class. It was very nice to feel welcomed into such an environment close to home. We met great people and the Spirit of God here. The monthly brunch was a chance to get to know them in a deeper way. The women were starting a mentoring wave and I got to know more women as friends and fellow struggling believers trying to live out our faith. Pastor Bob Beltz was an amazing Bible teacher. And the fabulous Biff Gore led us in worship music. It was a great experience! We're going to stay! So blessed to have connected with such a sincere group of believers who are growing in faith in Christ.  Highline's talented worship team is focused on exalting the Lord with reverence and rejoicing.  The pastor consistently shares life-changing, biblical sermons that challenge and equip us to live out our faith in this world. This medium size church is a great place to belong. I love our church!  It is a place where a community of believers come together to worship and grow your relationship with Jesus Christ.  The music is wonderful under Biff Gore and our pastor, Brian Gawf is dynamic and thought provoking preacher.  I especially love the women’s programs with Jennifer McKee.  HCC is a welcoming place.  Join us!

name: Highmark Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: I first attended Highmark a few months ago when one of my coworkers invited me to join her. I absolutely love this church! I felt welcomed from the moment I walked through the doors. The pastors and staff are genuine and real. They care about every single person who walks through the door each Sunday. They also work to serve, better, and pray for the community. I have met so many great friends that are like family, and I couldn't be more grateful. We love Highmark Church! The Highmark family is so welcoming and will make you feel right at home. If you are in search of a loving church community, this is a great place! If you're looking for a place to call home, Highmark Church is it!  From the  moment you walk in the door, you will be greeted by the friendliest people you will ever meet!  Highmark Church is the complete package - from Kids' ministries to worship to relevant and on-point teaching!  The atmosphere is incredible and very uplifting! I look forward to every Sunday!  Come and see for yourself! Don and Jamie are great people. Highmark Church is a good place to worship the Lord if you are looking for a church to attend. Pastor Don is a good pastor. He preaches the word of God. I have the privilege of sitting and listening to his messages. I feel bless in been in their services.They have a good set up team is very nice friendly welcoming. I feel blessed working with the family Listen, if you want fake relationships and phony friends DO NOT go here. Highmark is the most authentic church I have attended since living in Indy. They are welcoming, with no pressure to send kids off to some strangers or feel called out for not being consistent in showing up. The pastor does not fake a celebrity status  and he will likely try and catch you before you leave just to say hi and say thanks for stopping in! If you are comfortable, the kids rooms are locked during service with security at the door. My 5 year old can't wait to go most Sunday and be with his friends and learn about this "Jesus" guy they talk about. Hands down, exactly what my family and I have been looking for.

name: Highpoint Church Aurora - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
We've only just started at Highpoint. We had been going to a church whose sermons were more like motivational speeches. Pastor Caleb preaches from the Bible and it's exactly what we were looking for. We were early to service and he came and introduced himself to our family, we appreciated that very much since we never met our last Pastor face to face after months of attending. It's important to us to have an accessible Pastor. We are looking forward to more services at Highpoint! We were invited by family members for a child dedication ceremony. Upon walking up you think it's a school or some type of theater. Once inside your greeted with warm inviting smiles as well as high vaulted ceiling. Lots of areas to engage people and communicate with others. Looks like they may have a coffee bar. Where you walk into the auditorium you feel like you're inside the newest theater, with surround sound and an enormous screen and sound. Kinda imagine being in Solomon's temple. The praise team does a good job of playing up to date worship songs. The senior pastor looks really young but when you hear his messages you can tell he's season and knows his Word. Unfortunately it's very far if you coming from up north but we did enjoy the atmosphere. I have been attending High Point Church for close to two years. Over the past year, the Lord has drawn me closer to Him, and I have begun to notice something important that I feel is missing in our church. Each Sunday I feel a heaviness in my spirit, and I believe the Lord is speaking to me about it.

Pastor Caleb, I want to respectfully ask why the coming of Christ is not being addressed in sermons. Why do we speak as though there is still plenty of time, when the Lord’s return is near?

I say this with respect, not as an attack. The Lord can use anyone He chooses to speak to His people. Please consider this seriously, as you shepherd many souls. If the truth is not preached clearly, souls could be lost.

May God bless you and give you discernment to speak on this and lead many to salvation. Awesome church! I go when I visit Colorado. Very uplifting music and very gifted speakers that speak God's word truthfully and how it applies in your every day life! We chose this church specifically because of their AWESOME childcare + children’s ministry. Background checks, police officer at the entrance of the building, strict parent pick up protocols, amazing staff. My children are SAFE!

Not to mention Pastor Caleb is so wonderful, I have a degree in Biblical Studies and still learn from all of his messages every single week. Spirit filled Assemblies of God church, with the kindest congregation I have ever been apart of. Thank you Highpoint for welcoming us home!

name: Highpoint Church- Naperville
reviewSummary:
My family genuinely loves this church. The teaching, atmosphere, and overall experience have been wonderful, which is why I would rate the church itself 5 stars.

However, I need to share a serious concern regarding the children’s childcare area for transparency.

During only our second time using the childcare, my son’s diaper was changed without anyone contacting us or asking for our consent beforehand. We had provided our names and phone numbers at check-in, and my expectation—based on other childcare environments we’ve used—was that if our child needed personal care during the relatively short church service, we would be notified and given the opportunity to handle it ourselves.

To be clear, this is not an accusation against the volunteers or their character. My concern is not about whether the staff are trustworthy. My concern is about communication, transparency, and parental consent when it comes to personal care decisions involving children.

What made the experience more concerning was that when I raised this issue, the response focused on reassuring me that volunteers are background checked and supervised, rather than directly addressing the lack of communication or acknowledging that expectations around diaper care should be clearly communicated to parents upfront.

I truly love this church, which is why I’m sharing this. My hope is simply that clearer childcare policies and parental communication are established so other families know exactly what to expect. Best place to hear the real message. People are very nice here. Pastors, prayer team 10 stars not 5. I don’t recommend this church. They don’t help my friend and went telling my family why I emailed them. Iam surprised how they care about their previous members. I was in Naperville this week and was looking for a church service to go to today. I had a wonderful experience at HighPoint Church. If I'm ever in Naperville again, I'd love to return! Very friendly atmosphere, great worship and an encouraging message! I always enjoy the service with Pastor Ron Zappier. The only problem I have is that I can't never reach anyone during the week for questions  . I left message and still no one called back. It's very frustrating.

name: Highpoint Evangelical Christian Church - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent translation ear piece from mandarin speakers to English.  Everyone is welcome. Very friendly and welcoming. God centered. Mission minded. A wonderful Christian family.

name: Highpoint Fellowship - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
𝚃𝚑𝚎 𝚢𝚘𝚞𝚝𝚑 𝚐𝚛𝚘𝚞𝚙 𝚐𝚘𝚎𝚜 𝚘𝚗 𝚜𝚘 𝚖𝚊𝚗𝚢 𝚏𝚞𝚗 𝚝𝚛𝚒𝚙𝚜 𝚊𝚕𝚕 𝚝𝚑𝚎 𝚝𝚒𝚖𝚎! I have been going to this church for almost 8 years now. I have seen it when spirits are high and when they are low. The beautiful thing about this community is the love they share when you get to know them. They speak with passion on revealing Gods' word even when it is uncomfortable to do so. Sometimes I may not agree but I enjoy being myself in this church. You should come and check it out! The first time I went, I got so many hugs to last me a lifetime. You feel genuinely loved here. And you can come as you are. Shorts and flipflops are the thing here. No matter what your past is, they accept you here. With my walk with God, I have gotten close to him again. Love this church. Also they have a great Teen program. I knew I was home the first day I walked in to Highpoint Fellowship. That was 5 years ago. It has been 5 years of being loved, blessed, and accepted for who I am. Five years of learning, healing, and facing life one day at a time. Five years of sharing, laughing, crying, and celebrating the Gift of Jesus Christ's Love for us. Five years of realizing we are works in progress and accepting what really defines us:
We are ALL God's children, and His Love for us knows no bounds!!
That was the last 5 years up until today.
I can't wait to see what God has in store for the future!!!! I love coming here! This is my family. The people here are so kind hearted. The youth program is amazing. We sing. Dance. Play games. Worship God. Pray. I recommend you to go to this church or at least try it out. ~Candice Lawless

name: HighRidge Church - Longview Campus
reviewSummary: Just moved back to Longview  and we're seeking a church home.  Decided to try the 10:30 service on 8/17/25.  Walked in and was greeted at the door with "hello".  Walked to the sanctuary and found many empty seats that were being saved by various cell phones and coffee cups. We then decided to leave due to no place to sit.  As we exited we were told "goodbye".  All the way in and out not one person introduced themselves or attempted to welcome us.  Not what we expected from what we read on the website. May God bless HighRidge. My husband & I love Highridge church, the worship music is hands down the best I've ever listened to. The people there are so friendly and warm they have a great kids program and also a great youth pastor. I give it 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I've been going here all my life, so I might be a bit biased, but I have heard many people say that the presence of the Lord is at highridge. The leaders at highridge are intentional and kind. They have accountability and make rest a major priority. I firmly believe that highridge church is a healthy church full of Godly people. I love this church so much. They are family! I love to hear PT preach, and praise and worship is amazing. I love being a teen at this church. Lots of love, encouragement, and support. New to HighRidge & we love it! Friendly, caring people that drew us in. They sincerely want to help improve people's lives & relationships with the LORD & other believers, it's contagious. A balanced church with accountable, healthy leaders, very relative & helpful sermons. They're not sugar coated but presented with encouragement, love & truth from the Bible. Good worship, focused on God, not on us & not a concert but contemporary, band style, no choir. The structure of the introductory class is awesome & easy to complete if you miss one, also very informative. Love the Freedom curriculum, Life Group & conference, it is life changing!!! Come, learn, get free & connected.

name: HighRidge Church - Rocklin - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Highridge Church Rocklin has become such a special place in my life. Since the very first Sunday I visited, everyone has been so warm and welcoming and I just feel so at ease to be myself. The community here is incredibly genuine, relational and encouraging.
One of the biggest blessings has been how much my relationship with Jesus has grown since being part of this church. Between the messages, worship, and the people who truly care, I’ve felt encouraged and challenged in so many ways as well with all the opportunities through HighRidge to serve the community has added a whole new level of purpose to my walk with Jesus. I have been so encouraged to step in, help others, and be part of something bigger than myself which has deepened my faith in such a meaningful way. Highridge Church Rocklin is such a blessing. Led by Pastor Levi and Pastor Monica, this church is full of genuine love, strong biblical teaching, and powerful life-change stories. From the moment you walk in, you feel truly welcomed and cared for.

The community here is purpose-driven and feels like a home away from home. If you’re looking for a church that preaches the Word of God and creates a place where you can belong, grow, and be supported, I highly recommend checking out Highridge Church Rocklin. You won’t regret it. Honestly….i have grown so much spiritually. The way Pastor Levi preaches is not in a way that makes you feel like it’s recycled. Each and every sermon is unique. Staff also doesn’t flood the new people. If you’re looking for growth with God this church is AT LEAST an amazing starting point as they will equip you with what you need. High Ridge is our church home! This church is spirit-filled and Christ-led. Pastor Levi shepherds the flock well and it shows. High Ridge is equipping us as Christians to preach the Gospel and point others to Christ! We are followers of Christ, not fans. I love Highridge, my forever home church!! This church has key values to find the lost and takes church family on a journey to know God, Find freedom, Discover Purpose, and make a Difference. They dive into small groups and knows the importance of community which I appreciate especially when it’s hard to find Godly community sometimes. I love how they strive throughout the week and especially Sundays to be the hands and feet of Jesus. Jesus is in this place!

name: Highview Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: I prayed and asked the Lord to lead me and my fiance to a church because we're new in the area. And we ended up here from driving around searching for a church. Everyone was very welcoming and kind. Good calm service and now we're going back today. 🙏 Highview Christian Church is an inner-city community church that has an average attendance for the size of the church building. The building is quite large that houses a sanctuary, fellowship hall, offices, and kids area. Parking lot is spacious too. The pastor, Dr. Doug Redford, is a man of knowledge and integrity. He is well-versed in the Bible, for he has taught Hebrew and the Old Testament at a Christian college. Apart from being a scholar of the Christian Scriptures, the pastor is a very kindhearted, compassionate, and morally upright person. Those noble traits of personality reflect on the congregation and thus translate into the improvement of the community's ethical standards. Friendly, welcoming, warm group of people. The minister gave a wonderful and moving sermon. It's a smaller size church so I didn't feel so overwhelmed or overlooked. Great location and good for practicing driving It's actually my voting place wwg1wga

name: Highway Christian Church
reviewSummary: Wonderful church with a great Pastor who teaches and preaches the Word of God! Friendly and loving environment. Pastor Carver preaching and teaching the Word of God. Friendly faces and people willing to give a helping hand when needed. A great church with great people... Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Highway Christian Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: Looking for a church home? The people here are family and generations of family . They are very warm and welcoming people. The has enough to offer about God. Come on in🙏🏾 Great to have a place to physically go for worship during this difficult time (Covid19 pandemic, 2019 - 2021)! Sunday morning services  @ 11:45 AM. Within walking distance of Howard University campus & hospital. I been going here since I was young and always been treated with love even though I left away from the church for awhile but I knew where to come back for love and that’s what I got love and now my mom is here with me and she joined so is my daughter Loved walk in and youth choir very fresh take on Light in Shaw community [object Object]

name: Highway Church - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary:
Highway is a very warm and loving community. You can come as you are and you will be welcomed and accepted. No pressure, no expectations.
There are so many things I love about this church – solid teaching, authentic and approachable leadership, transparency, etc.
If I had to choose one thing (among many) I resonate with it would be that they are not a church that is overly inward focused.  They care about the community and do a lot of outreach to those in need which is so important. We started attending Highway over 12 years ago as we were looking for a community where we could serve, be known, and grow in our faith. We came from a large church where we just felt like a number. After the first week at Highway, the pastors already knew our names, and my husband and I knew this was where we needed to land. Over the years, we've been able to serve in so many different ways - and start new groups as well. Our kids love attending and being a vital part of the community. When we started at Highway, our 3-year-old son made us sit in the front row so he could watch the drummer. Now, as a 15-year-old, our son is playing drums in the worship band. We're so thankful for the community here! Highway is a welcoming church with a warm community of people. I’ve been happy to connect with a growing group of young adults, while also appreciating the intergenerational connection between all ages. The pastors are also thoughtful and approachable, and take time to get to know you. No matter where you are in your faith journey, you’re welcome at Highway. I highly recommend visiting if you’re looking for a new church, coming back to church, or even just curious about Christianity. Small tight knit community of Christians. Very welcoming, authentic people, and good balance of theological teaching and community.  Pastors are warm and approachable.  Sermons starts at 10:30 AM on Sundays!  Highly recommend or encourage you to checkout if you’re checking out churches. An extremely welcoming, small community church where I feel very comfortable.  There is not a lot of religious pretentiousness here, which as a life long Christian and church goer, I deeply appreciate.  Also, the lead pastor, Adam, is a dear friend who is a great shepherding and pastoring leader.

name: Highway Word of Faith Family Worship Center
reviewSummary: Welcoming church that we visited unfortunately because of a death in our family. I wish there was a parking lot available but we managed. Be aware that the restrooms are older single rooms but I appreciate the fact that they were clean and well stocked. If you're looking for a great church Highway Word of Faith is the place to go. I love my Pastor and the church family is very friendly,loving , caring and always praying for everyone. Roomy sanctuary but only two restrooms not near vestibule. Inadequate parking in the inner city of Wilmington. The house of God is always a blessing to go to when God is the head.  God is in the house!!!!! Blessing, signs and miracles are there!!! Come out and join us as we praise and worship Jesus!!

name: Hikes Point Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly people. Nice atmosphere. I loved the service in Spanish/English. I learned a lot listening to the preacher’s sermon. The singing felt genuine. Thank you for the guest gift bags, they are thoughtful. Very inviting and kind people. Jeff, your message was great this morning. Thanks for sharing what the God says in his Word about the 8 points you made pertaining to government. We do indeed need to stay engaged in our changing world. I’m thankful you are my pastor. Very nice people at this church...

name: Hiland Park Baptist Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Red flags and we dont plan on coming back a second time.

Visited on Mother's day and although they looked solid on their website, the preaching was less than 10 minutes of the time the pastor spent up there. Rest of the time was telling jokes or stories that didn't really tie into the passage.
Hope this was a fluke but will not be coming back to this mega church.

The only person who greeted us was at the door despite having an entire welcome  desk fully staffed. First time here, fantastic service, genuine and kind people and atmosphere. The Pastor pulls you in with his words and makes your soul want more. I can't say enough good things! Praise GOD! Excellent place to worship. Wonderful children's ministry. The preaching is solid. So will definitely try this church again. But it’s massive and can feel overwhelming, from the parking to finding your way in and to the right areas, especially if it’s your first time and don’t know the layout. We followed crowds in the side doors and ended up in the youth area. Someone in youth asked if we were new, helped my son check in and then told me how to cut through to the waiting area so I could wait for the next service.
I sat in the foyer and observed from about 9:30-10:15 while I waited for the 9am service to get out and the 10:30 one to start.
I was never greeted, no one ever spoke a word to me as they passed by, but I stayed.
The service was really good, from the music to the preaching, which the message is what we came for. But if you’re late, you may not find a seat if you have 3 or more people and looking to sit together.
Our daughter is moving to PC for college and my son is in The Nutcracker, so we’re looking for somewhere we can go while visiting PC and a church our daughter can call home.
We’ll definitely try this church again.

The message was solid and biblical and there wasn’t any fluff to it and it was delivered well. 5/5 for the preaching. Never have I ever step foot inside of church I felt so quickly at home and at peace with the Lord

name: Hill Avenue Grace Lutheran Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: The people are welcoming and the message and music is excellent. My church home for many years. Good people, good programs, faith in action. Pictured is a group filling blessing bags for the homeless. A warm and welcoming place for anyone looking to explore and develop their spirituality. Wonderful people here. Fabulous congregation!

name: Hill City Church
reviewSummary:
I love this church! Pastor Josh is an amazing teacher. He is passionate about Jesus and about leading the church. The other pastors and speakers are also very good. They have amazing child care, children's church, and youth programs. They have life groups so you can get connected with other people in the church. This church encourages your personal relationship with Jesus and does everything they can to help facilitate that. There are men's and women's events as well as events for everyone. It was such a blessing to find this church after my previous church close down. This is the one Protestant Church in downtown Boise that REFUSES to fly the PRIDE flag.  I stand with Hill City, President TRUMP, and the BIBLE!!! welcoming members at the church but the seminary was less than subpar. there was no topic that was easy to follow and found that the pastor used more anecdotes than he did scripture which, to me, takes away from the validity of the teaching. out of the half hour sermon, there were 4 verses referenced and 7 stories which were hard to follow. I’m visiting from out of town and after looking at their doctrine online, thought that I would be attending a church that was Biblically based but now feel as though I attended a very poorly arranged TedTalk about making connections & going out into the world to share the Word. it’s hard to preach to people to go out into the world with only a few self reflection questions without providing Scripture to support.
just disappointed & hoping that in the future this church can be more Scripture based. My experience with this church has been awesome. Started going in December 2024 . They do such a awesome job it is easy for me to learn through them about the Lord  Jesus Christ My Savior . They have given me that confidence I needed to have a stronger relationship with God... Thank you Hills City Church What a great asset to the Treasure Valley I'm so blessed to be a part of this Church family  !!! My wife, Nadya, and I flew to Boise to look at house.  We randomly picked a church to visit on Sunday before meeting up with our realtor.  Happy we did.  Beautiful church, enjoyable sermon by Josh. My hunger has grown after this sermon  to dig into the Bible. I want to talk with Jesus.  Gods word is beautiful.  Thank you.

name: Hill Country Bible Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church ever! People are friendly and receptive, kind and generous. I love the pastors and the messages. This is a church where the word of God is preached without deviations or
distortions. I think if anyone is looking for a compassionate, welcome church with lots of friendly people, excellent kids and student ministry, a place to serve and help the community, Hill Country is the place to go. I have been a member for 13+ years and our family calls HC a second home. The teaching is from the Bible and real-to-life. The music is inspiring. If you want to get to know people, then joining a small group or serving on a volunteer team are the best ways.

And though we don’t personally utilize it, there is a strong ministry for special needs kids. I went for the Saturday Easter service as a first time visitor.  The message was dry and a bit disconnected. I can only recall one scripture quoted during the sermon portion and it was not 100% accurate, but more of a paraphrase which can mislead those that are unknowledgeable Christians and those that are nonChristian.  The singing portion of the service was ok...but I was hoping to be urshered into the presence of God.  Funny thing...I hope the person that mistakenly took my Bible enjoys it. It is possible the person(s) thought it was a purse however, they got more value since it was the Word if God.  So I am still searching for a unapologetic God pleasing, Christ believing congregation. It was my first time there. It was Easter Sunday and we were there for a family member's baptism. The singing, the music, the baptisms were so emotional and overwhelming! It was truly a blessed day! 🙏 Huge, genuine feeling church. Pastor is spot on- but way too big for us. Feels like you would just be lost in the crowd. I appreciated the humility of the pastor— don’t always experience that. Problem with big churches is that no one talks to you… you just feel you are one in a million. But how do you solve that? You don’t with a big church.

name: Hill Country Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
He paraphrases instead of reads scripture/ he only referenced one verse, and when his son taught using more scripture, he corrected him for doing so. I'm not trying to hear the belief of man, prove what you are saying through the Word of GOD. The worship team was nice though. I came here because I wanted a church while I went to TXST. What I have found is life-long friendships, incredible mentors, and a new purpose to my life. To say Holy Spirit is present would be an understatement. This church is filled with people dedicated to live every day life in close relationship with Christ. I always love the worship and sermon but most of all I love the community and the contagious hunger and passion of leaders and pastors of HHC. Because of it, I can say confidently I know the Father and I can hear his voice! They turned an area where endangered milkweed grows which species like monarchs and queen butterflies rely on for a host, stereotypical Christians

Mind you the amount of cars on that land can fit perfectly on their own property but they decide to turn public property with wild flowers as a parking lot Man this church is so awesome! The tangible presence of the Lord is definitely felt and experienced! Worship is awesome! Sermon is powerful! People are awesome! The atmosphere is purely full of Truth and Love! If you’ve been searching for the Truth then this is the place for you. This is a GREAT church! The Pastors are amazing and I have felt welcomed from the moment I’ve stepped in the door! I highly recommend this Church if you are needing one in the Central Texas region. Come on by and we would love a chance to love on you and worship Jesus together!

name: Hillcrest Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Choosing Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior was the best decision I made in my life and because of Hillcrest Baptist Church I've became a devout Christian, an ambassador of Jesus Christ. Me and my son love our church so much, we are a family, we are loved and most of all we are dedicated.
I saw an Easter flyer 5 years ago, during Covid and we had our service outside the community center's parking lot. I was just looking for something to do for Easter with my son, and ever since then we never stopped coming, and next thing you know, we became part of a beautiful church family. We don't judge or look down on people. We are here to lift you up and be a help in anyway possible.
We have bible studies on Thursdays and church service on Sundays. We have a beautiful worship crew, amazing nursery and children's ministry team and a phenomenal and energetic, hungry for the Lord teen ministry.  We also have women's bible study and men's ministry. And last but never the least, we love to eat!!
Come join us and start your journey with Jesus! I have been to many Churches in the Eastvale and surrounding area but I have found Hillcrest Baptist Church the most aligned with Biblical Teachings.  I was not looking motivational sermons or Churches that just want your money and give you feel good messages to keep you coming back and definitely not a Church like the Church of Laodicea which was Lukewarm.

Pastor Matt does a great job teaching God's Word through Scriptural Preaching as described in 2 Timothy 3:16-17.
I highly recommend for anyone who is looking for a Bible Teaching Church.

The Church Family Acts like the Body of Christ, always willing to help each other out or pray for each others needs. Everyone knows everyone and the Church is very welcoming to those who want to join the Church Family.

The Youth Pastor Jony does a great job with the teens, as a Worship Leader and very much involved in the Church functions.

If you are looking for a Church Family and to build your life in God's Scriptural Truths I highly recommend attending this Church.

All Glory to Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior. We have been attending Hillcrest Church since June 2025, and it has truly been a blessing for our family. We were recommended to this church by a family friend after feeling frustrated and discouraged from attending four different churches where the messages were not directly rooted in the Bible. We often felt like it was more about “itchy ears” than God’s Word.

From the moment we walked into Hillcrest, we were welcomed with genuine smiles and immediately felt a sense of belonging—like home. Pastor Matt’s message that first Sunday was for Father’s Day. It was encouraging and timely, and it made us want to come back. When we returned, we noticed something different: the message was biblical, direct, and spoke clearly about repentance. We walked out feeling convicted, and that’s when we knew this was the church we had been praying for.

We were looking for a church that speaks the truth of the Bible and challenges believers to live as true Christians, and Hillcrest does exactly that. After attending for a few months, we became church members for the first time, and we love the strong sense of community here.

We have four teenagers, and they are very engaged in the church. Hillcrest does an amazing job involving the youth, and because of this church, all of our kids have given their lives to Jesus. We’ve participated in many events and have built strong, meaningful relationships within the church.

If you are feeling the same way we were—looking for a Bible-guided church that speaks truth, calls for repentance, and truly feels like home—this is your church. Stop looking and give Hillcrest Church a try. I have been attending Hillcrest Baptist Church since its very first service. It has been a huge blessing in my life to be apart of such a loving and welcoming church family. If you are looking for a church to call home that teaches you straight from the bible...look no further...Hillcrest is your home. With programs for all ages, you will surely find what you are looking for here. The best church I’ve ever been . It helped me with my spiritual growth and knowing Jesus more everyday personally. Praise the Lord for leading us to Hillcrest Baptist Church where we can truly worship and serve God.

name: Hillcrest Christian Church - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary: This is a Bible teaching church where you can learn from the Word and get involved in various ministries, locally and globally. Hillcrest is the simply the best. My family and extended family has been attending for many years. This church has remained steadfast as a bible teaching church while many others have not. If you are looking for a new church here in Mckinney or the surrounding areas, please come worship with us on Sunday! I love Hillcrest..it teaches the pathway for the light of the world, Jesus Christ Wonderful church!  wonderful Sunday school!  recomend for everybody!!! A welcoming church community and great preaching from Paul!

name: Hillcrest Community Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Welcoming to people from any and every culture, language, background etc. If you need prayer, this is the place to go! This is a praying church where God is moving, and the truth and love of Jesus Christ is shared! My family and I have been attending this church for almost 2 years now. My daughter absolutely loves her class there. The music is contemporary and more upbeat than the old time hymns. There are 3 pastors that preach about how the Bible can be applied today. We have small groups throughout the week instead a Sunday school classroom. It's very diverse, too. Wow, what an amazing church. Very real people that are engaging and enjoy worshipping Christ. As with all churches you will find groups of people, friends that talk together but I found them to be open with newcomers. The small group I joined is awesome. It’s been great for my family to get involved and serve others! If you are looking for an authentic church in Central Arkansas then come to Oasis! Church is supposed to be about growing in your relation with God, where as this "Church" is a glorified social club. I only visited this Church a few times and everyone seemed very cold, one time two people greeted me, A GUEST, as all the other people were engaging in conversing with their groups, This Church is full of cliques and is very unwelcoming, every other Church I have ever been to has been very open and friendly.
In other words, only go here if you like snobs! Went there for doggie wash and grooming but they were closed due to the weather that I found out about after the fact

name: Hillcrest Community Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: A small church with a big heart!! I’ve really felt the spirit of the Lord moving here! Pastor Jay is a passionate man of God, the community is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the coffee shop attached is adorable. I would highly recommend this church to the young and old, to new Christians and lifetime Christians. The Lord is waiting for you here! Hillcrest is such a sweet church with so much heart! Pastor Jay is such an engaging and fun preacher who also gets to the heart of a passage, and makes it applicable to our lives as Christians. The whole community is so kind and they will introduce themselves and make you feel welcome! Absolutely love it here!!! Hillcrest is a wonderful church! Pastor Jay is knowledgeable and interesting. He truly loves the Lord and His people! I felt very welcomed by the warm congregation. I look forward to getting to visit Hillcrest every week! My 20 something daughter is new to town and went to hillcrest on her own. The sermon/ message was relevant, inspiring and easy to understand. She will definitely be going back. If you are looking for a new church home give it a try! I started going to Hillcrest almost 3 years ago and knew immediately that this was IT.  From the come as you are attitude to the messages from Pastor Jay Johnson.   Each week..his words seemed meant for me and the way he connected the dots between what was  written in the bible to being relative to today was what I was looking for.  A few months later I got baptized at Hillcrest.  This congregation isfamily. This Church and the leasons each Sunday have truly been life changing.   Come visit.  I think you will have the same experience.

name: Hilliard Christian Assembly - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary:
We stopped in as we were traveling across the state.
The worship was moving and the preaching edifying. It is encouraging to hear expository preaching straight from the Word of God. I hope to have an opportunity to stop by again in the future. A young, contemporary church comprised of welcoming and encouraging people.  They offer a variety of opportunities for spiritual growth, including small groups, women's/men's ministries, and discipleship programs.  They serve faithfully in their community, volunteering in various events and activities for Grandview city schools.  And boasts a fun atmosphere for the young ones in their Kids church.  Coffee and a smiling face will always greet you at the door! Want to grow in relationships with Christ and go deeper this assembly is awesome environment. It nurtures the Christian faith with solid bible truth . A tight-knit, Bible based community of believers dedicated to serving, discipleship, and giving God the glory. Wonderful church! The pastor is straight and to the point.

name: Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church, this family! ❤️ They welcomed me with open arms 2 1/2 years ago and have stood by me through thick and thin. I could not be more grateful to God for placing me here and for putting these wonderful people in my path. If you’re looking for a small church where you can grow, you have found it! I have experienced the most personal growth in the past 2 years. The whole pastoral team is awesome! #grateful #thankful 🙏🏼 It’s been a very long time that I have felt as welcomed as I felt at this church! Everyone was gracious and friendly ..I immediately felt comfortable and at home! So very down to earth!
Even though I live in  Lake Elsinore I may make the Ortega trip to attend because I felt the simplicity of Gods love w/out a lot of fal-da-Ral..and pretense! This is what Gods house should be❣️❣️❣️ Join us on Sunday morning and see (feel it) for yourself. Humble, honest, very human people there. Churchill's abundant bread, my encounter with God every Sunday

name: Hills Church - Laguna Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church, this family! ❤️ They welcomed me with open arms 2 1/2 years ago and have stood by me through thick and thin.
