name: Hillsboro Church of Christ - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
They had a guest speaker from Atlanta this sunday. I really enjoyed the service. It was uplifting. And it came straight from the bible. The people there were so friendly you could tell it was genuine. They also had coffee and donuts after Sunday School but, before church but you have to be quick LOL that was a nice surprise since it was raining and overcast outside the coffee came in handy.
Thank you so much for that.
And we also met the Candyman that's what we're calling him he gave us Rice Krispie treats there's one in every church lol and he was so friendly. Keep up the good work sir. Chandler and the maintenance team are top notch and the office personnel are there when you need them. Totally rude people and disorganized. I messaged them on Facebook yesterday to see if me and my service dog was allowed to come in for Bible study.the person responding to my message told me yes we were allowed and that two elders and the minister was to be expecting me around 6 pm. We walked all the way there and when we arrived everyone was confused as to why a hobo and his dog was there. I showed them the message and they said that there was snow one buy the names that was givin to me by the person who I messaged and then tolled me to leave as my dog was supposedly scaring the kids . Would never come back here again very confusing church In my time of need i called this church and let them know i was a church of christ member in Arkansas raised child in the church of christ. And asked the receptionist to speak to an elder she advise me that none were there. Then said they were all tied up and that i wouldnt receive any help there because they only help there own I was visiting Nashville and attended a very uplifting service on May 4, 2025. I hope to visit again some day.

name: Hillside Christian Church - Lubbock Campus - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm Team Brad Ingram! Most polite human being I have ever met. The way he brings people together, the way he unites people to feed the poor and needy is an amazing quality that is given from our Savior! Brad Ingram if you ever read this I'm rooting for you champ! This is very unfortunate and Tristin or myself will ever attend Hillside either here in Lubbock or Amarillo! Redeemer is the place to go for right now till you get your own chuch! Today at service it was said to build up your wealth in heaven by your works for Jesus here on earth and your will be rewarded in heaven with gold and jewels and big house and you'll be more rich by doing more here. Well I don't believe Jesus would agree with this as we live in a world of greed and corruption and do not think heaven will be this way and to say what was said in church today only said just this I may need to find a different church because I don't want my kids to think that because they don't do enough they will be poor in heaven and all the pastors will be richer and more powerful then them . Sorry it shouldn't have been said in this manner.  We all that put a faith in Jesus and are saved by Jesus will inherit heaven and will be blessed all the same. No will be greater then another. We all fall short of the glory of Jesus and God.
I will pray you correct this because it came across poorly!
Update!
It's now been at least three weeks since this happened and no CALL from anyone at the church also I have spoke with people at the desk on Sundays and been told a few times they will reach out to me.
I think it's time to look for a new church as they don't care for there people.
I pray God touches them to correct these ways. This was my first time attending this church, and the experience was deeply troubling. During the service, Pastor Tommy Politz described an island in Ethiopia as extremely dirty and then compared it to the likes of India to emphasize his point.

As an Indian person, I found this comment uneccesary, ignorant, and hurtful. Using an entire country and its people as a negative comparison is not only inaccurate, but demeaning. Hearing this in a church setting made the moment feel especially disturbing and inappropriate.

Regardless of intent, the impact of this remark was unacceptable. It reinforced harmful stereotypes in a space that should be safe and welcoming. For a first time visitor, this left a lasting and deeply negative impression, and it is something that deserves serious reflection and accountability. They take teaching the gospel of Jesus Christ seriously. I say TEACHING and not preaching because the sermons are teaching from the word of God and not just an individual standing at the front saying, "Here's what I think and what you should do." I can't say enough good things about how this church family wants everything to be Jesus-centered. I hope you give them a chance! Maybe I'll see you soon! Leadership (Amarillo/Greg & Lubbock/Brad) lacks a moral compass. Plain and simple. Someone told my attorney I threatened them with a lawsuit, when all I told them was I’d “go public” if they did something they shouldn’t do.

Also, I’m 99% certain they aren’t giving camp scholarships to kids east of I-27 while buying movie theaters. Sure don’t seem to give back to the local community. Very Hillsong like.

Never seen people wear baseball hats and flip flops to church, or a church put on a twenty minute concert to start their “show”. Took my kids to a real church on Easter, and my 13-year-old said “I’ve never seen a man wear a suit to church before”.

name: Hillside Christian Church - Napa Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful congregation ! Lots of Love and fellowship. Been worshiping there for several months now love every aspect of Hillside Christian Church. Many Bible study groups available. Great Ministry! I would like to share my testimony on the Brazilian Life Group (Portuguese Bible Study).

Have you ever been in a boring bible study where the leaders have no charisma?
Yeah, me too.
But this is not the case at all! Hehe

The leader Sidinaldo Silva brings the group together with love, kindness and happiness. With his sweet wife Juliana they make the perfect couple to conduct the meetings with true gospel and wisdom, which makes the whole group open up their hearts with trust and vulnerability, knowing that the Holy Spirit is with us, building a save place.

Thank you Lord Jesus Christ, to build this beautiful world where we can support each other in your name! Amen 🙏🏼 I dont go to this church. But very grateful to have Hillside to host a fun and safe CandyLand (Halloween). The security is weird. The students are gossiping. The cookies and coffee are good. My husband and I visted Hillside Christian this past Sunday for their 10:30 service. Pastor Eric warmly greated us and gave us a sweet Welcome Gift. The service was wonderful, everyone is very friendly & the campus is beautiful. We will be returning. Thank you!

name: Hillside Church
reviewSummary:
Pastor Rob is filled with the Holy Spirit and has been blessed with the ability to clearly interpret the Word in an intelligent manner.  He has helped me a GREAT deal in just a short time with my faith walk. Starlyn runs a great worship team, and the kids Sunday school program is great! My girls always have a good time when they go.  This church is much smaller than your average church, similar to what we were used to in NJ (check out CityLife if you’re ever in Jersey City), and that’s what we prefer. The congregation is very close-knit, kind, truly wants to know you and be your brothers & sisters in Christ. God bless Hillside Church! I was a first time visitor to this church and my experience was so very positive.
Wonderfully friendly people. Pastor Chris and all here are so kind and generous
Wonderful food distribution site run by the church. Alsome very helpful they have a child care center so when you are in church. They can watch the kids while you enjoy the church I go occasionally and have received warm receptions each time. It is a diverse crowd that approaches daily and societal issues in a Christian and modern way

name: Hillside Church - Antioch Campus
reviewSummary: Hillside is a church filled with genuinely friendly people who are loving followers of Jesus Christ!  The Word of God is honored here and preached faithfully each week.  If you're looking for a place to grow in Christ and connect with other believers, I heartily recommend Hillside Church.  Located in Antioch, it's conveniently close to Baypoint, Pittsburg, Oakley, Brentwood, Discovery Bay, as well as the other smaller adjoining communities in the area. Been going to this church since I started going to church almost 20 years ago. Pastor David is great. Such a fantastic teacher. The worship team for me, is the best around. Come by some Sunday morning. Service starts at 10:30 am and over around 12:00. Get yourself a coffee, come in and meet some great folks, worship, relax, laugh and listen to the sermon. Celebrate Jesus and Soothe your soul. See ya there I haven't felt this at home in a church for ten years. My spirit is on fire again. Love this church! It'll forever be our home. Pastor David Clift is like family. You really feel welcome here. Great church. They are growing, evangelizing, loving and learning...

name: Hillside Church - Chapel Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Rob is filled with the Holy Spirit and has been blessed with the ability to clearly interpret the Word in an intelligent manner.  He has helped me a GREAT deal in just a short time with my faith walk. Starlyn runs a great worship team, and the kids Sunday school program is great! My girls always have a good time when they go. name: Hillside Church - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary: This is a loving, kind group of believers that are human but trying to serve God! I have been blessed by their love and compassion! If you’re looking for a smaller group of believers to serve with come and check out Hillsides family! A beautiful Church set in the foothills of the Sonoma Mountain near Petaluma. They also hosts various public groups and Recovery groups. A beautiful setting I would think for a wedding or any event you might be thinking of Wonderful Church.  Celebrate Recovery is held there every Thursday @ 6pm. They also have AA meetings there too. Had our Mom's memorial. It was really beautiful. ❤❤❤❤❤

name: Hillside Church Of God - South San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
The people at Hillside church Of God in South San Francisco is such a diverse group of people, who are so welcoming and loving.
People who love to worship Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior. ❤️ My place of worship. I love coming to this church and gain many friends here. I love how peo0le l9ves each other and have no hate I like the idea of the bible facts 💯.  And the people are very friendly. My place of worship. The Hispanic congregation gathers at 2 pm on Sundays :)!

The Hispanic congregation meets on Sundays at 2 pm and Thursdays at 7 pm.

name: Hillside Church of Marin - Corte Madera - Mill Valley Campus
reviewSummary: This is exactly what I've been looking for, a secular church! Great music and pastors, and exceptionally welcoming. Love at first sight. I was looking for a group of Christians who cared about people, who enjoyed fellowship with one another, who sought God in worship, who welcomed others, who invited others to get involved, who loved the Lord and wanted to learn from His Word, and who believed in the movement of the Holy Spirit. I found them here! A family of God that I am glad to have found and become a part of. Comfortable atmosphere, sincere and friendly people. Biblically-based teaching and great programs for kids preschool through high school. Great music too! Wonderful people who love God, inviting, sincere and they really make you feel comfortable and special. Great church. Amazing church that teaches and welcomes! Come join.

name: Hillside Church San Jose - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary:
Sermon is powerfully done and the praise and worship is top notch.
I’ve filled out a guest form twice .
Maybe I was a bit too honest and open with my sins and struggles.
perhaps that has led to them not responding.
I still think it’s a great bible based church that preach the true word of God I would like to congratulate Jono Burlini for being a pastor. I used to be with him for 6th grade men’s’ choir with Mr. Finch from 2004-2005 and on 2006-2007, I used to be with him in concert choir with Mr. Finch for the last time in Castillero Middlr School. I’m hopeful that he’ll notified that I had attended a private Christian university. Hillside Church has the most amazing staff of pastors who study the Bible in depth and preach truth from the Scriptures without changing God's message to fit the trends of the current culture. More and more parents who want to walk honestly and humbly with God are bringing their young families to learn Biblical truth. This is an amazing church for people of all ages! Visit Hillside and you will agree! Biblical teaching. I don’t want a church that caters to our own desires. This church preaches biblical truth to help us grow closer to God and really learn who He is, It offers lots of ways to connect with other members. Wonderful place of worship! Biblical teaching & good worship music.  Very supportive community & Adult Fellowship  classes (Sunday School ) are wonderful with excellent teachers also.

Women's weekly bible study is a excellent way to study the bible with a large group of women which also breaks onto small groups. There are now Saturday women's bible study meetings too. I love this church after having been in a very large church for 37yrs.!

name: Hillside Community Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
First time guest, extremely disappointed in the lack of scriptures prominence here. The “podcast” variation of this church has left my spirit hungry after visiting. They played a short video with a narration of scripture, then completely work through their own understanding - as teaching. Not a single verse was presented after, unless being referenced by someone’s story. The beautiful people on stage had touching testimonies and Godly wisdom, but I arrived to hear the word of God. Not sit through what appeared to be a public small group conference.

Additionally, they have women pastor(s) who exercise teaching authority over men. It was very unsettling in my spirit to be a part of that. I say all this with love and respect, women have their necessary roles, but God created them with a divine purpose to help. The original Hebrew in Genesis calls Eve  “Ezer”, meaning “helper”. A body of flesh and spirit, meant to assist Adam, because he was deficient until God made Eve. This does not make women less, but equally important,  God refers to himself as “Ezer” in Psalm 115:9-11. The Lord is surely not less than man. With the authority and responsibility falling upon Adam’s shoulders as the first creation in Gods design; Paul writes what he did in 1st Timothy 2:12-15.

I say all this with love and respect. If you are inclined to this church behavior, then please continue attending. Yet if you read this and it unsettles you, attend and see for yourself without judgement. They deserve that right, but I pray for repentance here. After just one month, our family has found our church home at Hillside and we couldn't be more certain about that decision.

What stands out most about the pastor is his authenticity. He's not putting on a performance. He's genuinely himself on stage, breaking down scripture in a way that's accessible and meaningful. That kind of realness is rare and deeply refreshing.

But the moment that truly sealed it for us happened this past weekend. A kind mom I'd met reached out to let us know the kids would be performing. We had missed the email, and she even sent a link to the lyrics video with the motions. I played it for my kids to help them prepare, and immediately my children were singing along. My 2 year old, especially, looked like he'd been rehearsing for weeks (even though he wasn't even going on stage). That kind of response, that quickly, says everything about the love and intentionality poured into the children's ministry here. The fruit is already showing, and it melts my heart.

We also got to experience a more intimate worship setting with three people leading, and it was genuinely beautiful. You could feel that every person on that stage was there for the right reasons, not for a performance, but to point to God. That authenticity carries through everything here.

If you're visiting with kids, I'd encourage you to register online before you come. The process is simple and so worth it. From the moment we walked in we felt welcome, and the quick tour we received made all the difference. This was truly an answered prayer for our family. A church where Jesus is preached. Pastor Pete reads the word and explains what the bible is saying in a fabulous way. Easy to understand.  He does it as solid as ever. The church also expanded their childrens building, its amazing.  When we parked we were immediately greeted a d loved on.  Welcoming faces everywhere. One of the most welcoming churches I’ve ever been to. Everyone is so friendly and excited to meet you. My kids have never been more comfortable anywhere else which is such a great feeling. The preacher is a genius. The church is the perfect size. Small enough to get to know people, large enough to have classes and groups.  We love it
One thing is sadly, the woman who is singing who plays the violin should perhaps considering retiring from the singing part. I am sure she has had a wonderful career however the younger singers are amazing and the overall spirit of the moment is diminished by the contrast of her voice and the angelic qualities of the other singers. This is the way of the world at times and she should allow them to shine.
Besides that, we love it and will keep going.

name: Hillside Community Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
When I was around 8 or 9 years old attending the Hillside Arts Academy, I was placed with children a year below me in school during a summer camp, which made me extremely self-conscious at that age. These concerns were brought to Harmony Bathour, but I did not feel they were handled with the care, empathy, or understanding you would expect when dealing with a child.  Now that she has children of her own, I hope she can reflect on her actions with humility.

That said, things improved significantly in later years when different people took over directing the shows at the Arts Academy. The environment became much more supportive and encouraging after that change. I believe it’s important, especially within churches and leadership positions, to practice what we preach and treat vulnerable children with kindness, compassion, and care.

I understand no church is perfect, and one experience does not define an entire congregation. Still, I believe churches should be sanctuaries where children feel emotionally safe, supported, and encouraged. have been many churches across countries—first time experiencing racism, and notably, never in the secular world but here, in a place that supposed to be the house of Jesus. Monday Young Adults fellowship: a worship team member showed clear dismissiveness and arrogance from the start; she chuckled when I shared background mentioning I’m from Asia; and the most of time flirting with the guy next to her rather than respectful discussion of Bible study. I stayed and shared out of courtesy, though I wanted to leave.

I’d like to believe this was an isolated incident, but the reviews somehow show a pattern of bias against Asians. What kind of teaching leads to this? Are Jesus’ warnings to the Pharisees all in vain? I’ve been coming since March as a silent listener. I’m just trying to find my way..  this past Sunday I attended the 8:30 service. My intentions were to ask for prayers as I’m having a very hard time these days. I sat in the back as I usually do and my emotions took over. I cried like a baby, the usher was staring at me and I felt uncomfortable and left. (This was before church even started)I felt so alone in a house that shouldn’t make you feel that way. I feel the “clicks” everyone seems to know everyone. I’m quiet and shy so maybe that’s my fault. I will say Pastor Aaron does a great job with his words. I enjoy listening to him. I love my new church. I enjoy worship and fellowship after service. The welcome was very warm and inviting. Thank you Hillside for a new church to honor our father in heaven 🙏🙏🫶🏽🫶🏽 We are blessed to attend Hillside. The strong emphasis on youth programs, Bible exposition, Community, serving the church and others in practical ways drew us here and keeps us here.
Hal & Peg

name: Hillside Covenant Church - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary: Super generous people here, especially Michelle. When I was homeless, she'd let me launder my clothes whenever I called to ask. Plus when Hillside Covenant offered Christmas lunch, it was always delicious and ample. Miss those wonderful meals! Thee Bestest church family in the state. Pastor Jeff totally ROCKS the Word & the children’s programs are just so engaging for the tons of kids that go there. Warm & inviting at any of the 3 services. Check it out for yourselves. Peace. I went to this church as part of a Seminary assignment and was blown away by the friendliness of the congregation and the Pastor. This is a great family oriented church that truly has the spirit of God in them. We visited today from out of town.  Loved the Spirit filled service and the dear, welcoming people.  Wish I lived here - would join in a heartbeat. Best Bible study group I've attended and I'm 70!

name: Hillsong Church
reviewSummary: Synonymous with modern worship music. The vibe is creative, fashionable, and metropolitan. While controversies have occurred, the brand remains strong for those seeking a modern aesthetic.

name: Hillsong Church Boston
reviewSummary: Went with my husband for the first time today. We’re from Boston but just moved back from Florida this weekend. This is the first church we’ve tried out in the area, and we were blown away. Genuine, inviting, and so HOLY. The Holy Spirit was so evident there; it was beautiful. They had a guest speaker (can’t remember her name; she had a cute blonde bob), but she was incredible. The pastor and his wife started the service off by saying declarations in the name of Jesus. It was powerful. So happy to be at a church that isn’t afraid to be bold for the Lord. The sermon recited so much scripture!!!! No prosperity gospel!! This is church!! Definitely my type of place. Thank you, Hillsong, for opening a location in Boston!! And for the reviews that talk about parking being an issue— big deal. Park in the garage and pay $25— the Lord will give you 10 fold. It was our first time to Boston and we visited this church. We were welcomed by so many people! More than just the official greeters. Every part of worship directed us toward Jesus. So good! There were announcements about small groups for the many, many college students so if that's you, you'll certainly find a group to vibe with and grow with. 🙏🏾 You gotta visit this place to experience the work of holy spirit. It's very popular for its music and its def on point. The vibes are immaculate and heavenly. The entrance is a bit tricky.. it says next to doubletree but its actually inside Royal entrance. Loved the vibes, Music the message the community and the answer I got to my prayers. This place is amazing! Hillsong Church is a christian church that joins everyone who needs, prays, directions, love, and peace. In this place I find peace and the precious of God's words.

name: Hillsong Church LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church Pastor Sam breaks everything down so you can truly understand and the worship music is amazing. Everyone is so welcoming, you come as you are no special Sunday wardrobe. Welcome Home! It was my first time there, and it was truly touching. Such good energy and a beautiful service — I even got emotional a few times. The service lasted about an hour and a half, and I loved the message shared. Good music and atmosphere. Pastor Houston taught on the day we visited. My son said he'd like going there if he was in his 20s and lived there. Just visiting LA. So glad I picked this church for my Sunday morning. Very powerful sermon. Church was passionate and faith-filled. Walked out feeling renewed, uplifted and inspired. Hillsong Church LA offers energetic worship, uplifting messages, and a welcoming community. A modern, faith-filled environment where people connect, grow, and encounter God authentically.

name: Hillsong Church NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Hillsong Baptist Church is an inspiring and welcoming community where faith comes alive. The worship services are uplifting, filled with heartfelt music and meaningful messages that resonate with everyday life. The pastors are approachable and genuinely caring, making everyone feel included and supported. Whether you’re new to church or have been a lifelong believer, Hillsong Baptist provides a warm, spiritually enriching environment that encourages growth, fellowship, and service. Truly a place where faith and community come together beautifully. Lovely Church! We were in town for the weekend and  were looking for a church to attend. name: Hilltop Church
reviewSummary:
Hii everyone!!!
I always have such a great experience every Sunday! At Hilltop Church Cambridge. The service is really uplifting, and during the worship, you can really feel the presence of the Holy Spirit in overflow. I even teared up on my first visit! The message is great and very touching, and I always feel so satisfied after leaving church. Everyone is so welcoming. As someone who was a bit nervous about attending, I felt right at home. It's a great place to connect with God and meet some amazing people. If you're curious or hesitant about visiting, I highly recommend giving it a try. You might just find what you're looking for! I highly recommend Hilltop Church to Christians seeking a welcoming community for prayer and fellowship in Cambridge.

Hilltop is a remarkable Christian community in Cambridge that I joined 7 years ago, after being invited by a friend to attend an Easter Sunday service. Pastor Darell welcomed me warmly, like family, and I've been a member ever since.

For 6 years, I've volunteered on the tear-down team, helping to break down chairs after services. I've also served as an Alpha co-leader and participated in Bible study groups and met a lot of great friends who became part of my extended family today.

One of my favorite aspects of Hilltop Church is the Evening Worship every Wednesday from 7 PM to 9 PM. During this time, people come together to sing, pray, worship, and fellowship. The ambiance is always filled with the Holy Spirit and grace.

Hilltop Church offers valuable opportunities for young Christian leaders to train and develop their talents, whether it's singing in the choir, preaching during Sunday services, or leading grassroots events during Christmas, Easter and other holidays.

The children's Sunday service is perfect for families who want to nurture their children in the Christian faith.

I also thoroughly enjoy the beautiful songs and inspiring sermons during Sunday services. The pastor’s family and church leaders are wonderful.

When you visit, be sure to meet Amy Eifler, the church leader, and Pastor Bethany, the pastor’s wife. They are truly amazing.

I highly recommend Hilltop Church to Christians looking for a community to pray and worship God in Cambridge. Amen. I've been part of Hilltop Church for over a year and I love this community. It is a biblical church that is grounded on God's Word. I have grown so much in my faith and have found incredible godly friends here that encourage me to pursue Christ. The leaders of the church lead by example and there are numerous opportunities to serve. The church truly has a heart for prayer/worship and spreading the Gospel to the region. The demographics are predominantly young adults and young families. Hilltop has a lot to offer from two Sunday services, kids/youth ministry, prayer nights during the week, in-person & online community groups, and many more. If you're looking for a home church in the Boston area, please come. I've had an incredible experience at this church. It's a place where you can feel the presence of God. The worship services are powerful and uplifting. The sense of community is strong.  Whether you're looking for spiritual growth or just a place to connect with others, this church is a wonderful place to be. name: Historic Old Mission San Luis Rey Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I have visited about ten different California missions so far, but this was my very first time at the Historic Old Mission San Luis Rey, and it truly stands out. Unlike some of the smaller missions, this one features a remarkably large and exceptionally well-maintained community. The entire grounds are beautifully organized, pristine, and full of life. 🏛️✨
Because of its historical significance and beauty, the mission draws a lively crowd of both locals and tourists. Despite the high volume of visitors, the large parking lot makes the entire experience completely smooth and stress-free. There is so much history to absorb and plenty of beautiful sights to see throughout the property. 🌸⛪
It is an incredibly impressive and peaceful place, and if I have guests visiting from out of town in the future, this is absolutely a spot I would love to bring them to. Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience a beautiful piece of California history! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Such a beautiful Mission! It’s a huge mission and it also has a coffee shop, museum, gift shop and a cemetery all in the same lot. There’s plenty of parking. The mission is active and has masses in service. We went on a Sunday and mass was being held at 9am. As soon as the mass was over we were able to go inside to see the beautiful church! We had an awesome time learning about the history of the mission. We also grabbed some coffee and walked around the cemetery. First mission down,  20 to go in California! "The King of Missions" really nice couple of hours visit, started at the cemetery grounds looking at the old tombstones, then entered the main church a classical Franciscan novo-hispanic design similar to those found in Sonora and Chihuahua. Next we hit up the museum which is really nice and has some unique artifacts, finished walking the grounds down to the Lavandería. Recommend to visit this place. California history comes to life. Mission times, Mexican-American war, early 19th century. A nice and peaceful historic church located in Oceanside. This mission is very beautiful inside and is nicely maintained. I’ve had family members get married here and it was beautiful. Also go visit the museum that’s here as well! A beautiful old mission chapel restored and in use for weekly mass. I have been able to attend and find a seat. Normally seats are a premium at all masses held in the mission church 7 am English and 9 am or 7 pm misa en Español. The attendees are always friendly and the priests are very welcoming. The museum, gift shop, and cafe open later and close early, so plan accordingly. I recommend visiting the cemetery as it is beautiful, peaceful, and most the time has a cool ocean breeze passing through. The old priests pass through and have been known to greet and bless you and your loved ones.  🙏👍🏼❤️🌬️🌊

name: Hoboken Grace Community Church - Hoboken Campus
reviewSummary:
Hoboken Grace Community Church is truly one of the most welcoming and genuine communities we’ve experienced. From the moment you walk through the doors, people make an effort to make you feel comfortable, included, and cared for, whether it’s your first visit or you’ve been attending for years.

What stands out most is the warmth of the community. There’s a real sense of connection, support, and kindness among the people there, and it creates an environment that feels uplifting and authentic. The church does a wonderful job fostering meaningful relationships and making people feel like they belong.

We’re very grateful to have found such a positive and encouraging community in the area and would highly recommend Hoboken Grace to anyone looking for a welcoming church home. It’s a great church imho and the 2 pastors are incredibly dedicated and anointed or they would not have come this far. I have great respect for them. They are truly humbly leading many sheep, which is now desperately needed in a money driven, greed centered society like Hoboken has become unfortunately, where external is Everything. Hoboken is not NYC and not too long ago Hoboken used to be a traditional small blue collared town with  people who lived very simply, it’s no longer that same small town sadly, so I understand the need for a bigger place and more services because the need is much greater now, so I commend all that they are trying to do. It’s definitely no small feat and they need our prayers. The main issue I had was the sacrament of the Holy communion not being given the proper respect it requires. There are A lot of people yes, but it doesn’t mean you can’t logistically lead people into this sacred act the 1st Sunday of every month. It’s brushed to the side, while people and big screens are brought to the forefront. So are we focusing on the “people of Hoboken” more? or Christ and his sacrifice dying on the cross for us to save us from our sins? I didn’t like that, had never seen it before and  ultimately felt lost in the “new Hoboken” feel of it all. $$ I started attending Hoboken Grace about year ago and it has genuinely become a second home. I’ve never felt so welcomed and loved at a church before the way I do here. Amazing sermons, worship, and you can just tell how much love is put into everything they do. Being a non-christian, I really enjoyed the vibe and the energy!

Look and feel of this place is nothing less than a concert - 4 guitarist, 5 singers, pianist, and a drummer!

Also, got to experience people getting Baptized and celebrate their faith and believe in Christ!

They usually have performances every Sunday starting from 9:30am, 11:00am and 12:30pm. We're just occasional visitors from abroad, but we find Grace Community Chirch to be a...

Community members and staff are complaining of chargeable offenses such as harassment, immorality, crime, racism, and discrimination, just to name a few.

And the Bishop, Dottie Escobedo-Frank, spent months ignoring the complaints, letting the community fall apart at the hands of a person accused of numerous abuses.

This didn't have to happen. reviewSummary:
Father Gianni and the Holy Angels church is, in a word, wonderful. Father Gianni crafts thoughtful and pertinent sermons that help parishioners navigate through the world and through their challenges. His strong faith and dedication to the word of God shines brightly in the way he conducts his life and church.

Father Gianni's life story informs his sermons and is interesting in and of itself. If you meet him, hopefully he can share how he came to where he is. I first met Father Gianni as an officiant for my and my wife's wedding. Through that process I learned of Father Gianni's faith, his dedication to his congregation, and who he is as a person. I also count him as one of my and my wife's friends. He is a wonderful person and runs a wonderful church and I'm sure if you ever are to attend his sermons you will come away feeling similarly. This church is purely blissful! Father Gionni and the clergy has been nothing but kind, compassionate and full of love. The people who come to Holy Angels are wonderful and kind! It's the community I have been waiting to be a part of. I recommend Holy Angel's Church to everyone! The Church Community here is very warm and welcoming, with a clean and beautiful physical space. The events are really engaging and promote a sense of community and fellowship among the members. Overall, it's a very positive and enjoyable experience to be a part of this Catholic community. Since I came here I found a welcoming community and made me feel part of the family. I live in Texas but I come to Orange County twice and now I have a family church! Father Gianni is the perfect representative of God - he “gets it”, in the same way Jesus “got it”. He focuses on what is important and comes from the purest of God’s love. As much as I give thanks to God for many things, I also thank Him for messengers he sends such as this man. What a beautiful church 🙌🏼

name: Holy Assembly Church of God in Christ - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I loved the music even though it was too loud 😭😭😭 This is a true place of worship. A place where the Holy Spirit resides. A place where a individual who is lost, can find Jesus. The Bishop who is the overseer at the church is a man by the name of Bishop Christopher Milton and he is a true man of GOD who have a heart for the people. If you ever get the opportunity go and visit this church. I miss my church family. I grew up in this church as a child til a teenager with my grandmother sister Griffin my sister Jennifer and auntie Sister Linda Debose. Hey uncle Chris and Auntie Tonya.🥰🙋🏾‍♀️ The best pastor and Bishop the best first lady the best members it's a beautiful place to worship. Love my church. I second Faith Griffins post, I also miss this church so I’m going back today and hopefully will continue.

name: Holy Bible Orthodox Baptist Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: Great little Bible-believing church!! Where the truth is preached! The people are so kind and welcoming. Clean, old-fashioned building. Highly recommend! Good church highly recommend good preaching and nice friendly people Real bible believers church here, great preaching, sound doctrine Awesome church! Sound in doctrine,  traditional and inviting!

name: Holy Cross Episcopal Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: My family adores this congregation. The motto of Holy Cross is 'Open Minds, Open Arms'.  Very involved in the community and in outreach.  These outreach efforts include but are not limited to these areas: LGBTQ, the elderly, refugees and the homeless.  If you're looking for a welcoming, affirming church home, this is the real deal. Great place Like the parish

name: Holy Cross Melkite Catholic Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: This a wonderful parish for Catholics seeking a more traditional service (Divine Liturgy) in a eastern way. The Liturgy is celebrated on 11:00 in English, Arabic, and a little Greek. I also attend the BEST Youth Group here! I'm giving 1 star, how sad a church turns families away. Was given a flyer for tots for tots and I was rudely turned away. They call them selves a church they should read a bible. Some families cant afford to get anything for Christmas for their children however you think they are gonna help you and when you go they turn you away. That's not a church how sickening.  Thanks for turning me away and not being able to at least put 1 gift under the tree. Very traditional Christian Catholic Church that dates back to the time of the Apostles. If one is searching for faith that the Apostles believed and teached, then look no further. My church is amazing. The priest is great, the mass is beautiful and the people there are friendly and welcoming. This church really got me closer to the Lord. Beautiful church and wonderful, traditional, eastern Divine Liturgy. The priest also gives great, sophisticated homilies!

name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I am Catholic but this church did something very unpleasant

my first time to encounter a church that would not allow a small tiny dog that does not bark at all. Even the Pope himself has a dog and they even have murals of dog and have a welcome that says "all are welcome"

The parish is beautiful and the parishioners are all very friendly and inviting. We also love their priest, Father Prosper! He is amazing with his words and his kindness.

name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Money Hungry Scamming Church! Do not get your baptism/communion/confirmation here. They will make you pay, if you can make requirements to meet, they’ll make you pay again for another day. They’re very picky on those requirements too. Lots of parking, love the fact they have 7:00pm mass.Not many churches do so anymore. I absolutely love my church!. I've been going here overall for close to 25 years. The Fathers are the best. I love that they have a YouTube channel to watch the masses on especially during this difficult time. This place is beautiful it took me back to the church from the town I am from in El Salvador. Because it has the scary jesus that I was terrified of!! But that was when I was a kid. Anywho if you are a catholic you will feel the peace in this place. Have a blessed life my friends. The best church I ever been in and great service

name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I love how often the church offers masses daily. Priests are friendly and I love their homilies. The community is also warm and gentle. It is a very nice church to pray and strengthen relationship with Lord. Holy Family is a peaceful church to visit or attend mass.
The choirs are wonderful to hear during masses at 11:00. I feel in a very spiritual place during mass with the music & prayers.
Today it was a very special mass welcoming our Fr. Sy Nguyen. It was a blessing moment for my family to be part of this ceremony with all Holy Family Fathers. 💕🙏 I have grown in my Catholic Faith,  much in part having to do with Father Sy, the Pastor at Holy Family.  My husband and 4 kids have attended Holy Family since 1989, and they all received most of their sacraments there. It will always feel like my Catholic "home" to me. The Holy Mass is very reverent and traditional at Holy Family, which I appreciate.  It is very welcoming. There are many opportunities to be involved in Parish life. Over the years, my husband and I enjoyed helping with Cathecism classes, Jr. High Youth Ministry,  Parish Councel, Ushering, St. Vincent de Paul Society,  Choir member,  and volunteering at the Fiesta, and taking classes to further our understandingof Catholicism. I definitely suggest that you come to Mass any day of the week, and see for yourself what a wonderful place it is to Worship our Lord and be a part of this community of Faith. Good priests there

Spiritual connection for everyone..from quiet prayer time during Adoration..to many church groups to choose from..of course daily Holy mass said always with deep devotion. Many special celebrations during the year.

Wonderful inspiring music ministry

Full and caring community My initial impression of Holy Family was phenomenal. Previously gave the church a 5, updating to a 3 now. Overall, it is a good church. You cannot be too critical of our churches and priests, everyone does their best. The parking lot is big and it’s easy to park. The choir is good. I like that they let you take the Eucharist by tongue, the Michael archangel prayer is a nice touch at the end.

However, the church is incredibly hard to get a hold of. We’ve been attending for 4 months and still haven’t been able to contact anyone about becoming parishioners and the online portal doesn’t work. The Eucharist ministers repeatedly do not give our son the blessing when he carry him up during the Eucharist. Just because he is a baby or asleep doesn’t mean you shouldn’t give it to him - that very much bothers me and we’ve emailed the church about this and never got a response (2mo later).the lady that helps people find a seat during mass is very rude as well and comes off very judgemental to those arriving late.

name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Have wanted to come to mass here for a while and finally had the chance last night. Went to the 5:00 vigil mass and it was wonderful. Very welcoming parish and Father Mateo was so loving. He introduced himself to us afterward and even blessed some items we purchased at their bookstore and some medals we were wearing. Can’t wait to go back.

The church is beautiful. There is an amazing grotto of Our Lady outside and a very sweet depiction of Our Lord learning carpentry alongside St. Jospeh and Our Lady. We visited this church as they are celebrating Simbang Gabi mass. School children dressed up as angels, kings , Mary and Joseph. The children re enacted the nativity scene and sang for the parishioners Beautiful sanctuary and uplifting homily. Loved the experience...and the boy scout pancake breakfast. This church is absolutely beautiful. Wonderful clerg7 and parishioners. Wonderful place of worship. Went to see my friends baptism the day before Easter and it was quite an experience. It was my second time attending mass at holy family and I would definitely go back again. The members are very kind and genuine. The fathers are wise and speak very well during mass. The choir is very talented in fact they sing a lot, it's almost like a spiritual musical. The building is quite a sight to see as well, unique architecture.

Holy Innocents Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Reverent masses, both novus ordo and Latin. Holy priests. Vibrant congregation. Beautiful church. A treasure in the heart of Long Beach. Very nice church. Has a Traditional Latin Mass service at 9AM on Sundays. Parking is a little tight so get there early. Praise be to God! Beautiful, thriving, little parish just north of Downtown Long Beach.

I like that the altar is traditional and all the masses are ad orientem, that is, facing towards the tabernacle rather than away from it. And the fact that the tabernacle is front and center is a big plus; not to mention the communion rails and the more traditional method of giving communion. Good, good.

Fr Irving is a wonderful pastor, may the Lord grant him a long and spiritually fruitful life. All of your senses are captivated. The priests’ attention to detail during the Mass is spectacular. It’s so easy to pray. The best church in Long Beach. I love the Traditional Latin Mass. Father Peter & Father Robert both have great sermons. Ever since I started coming here, I have grew a lot more in my faith. Don’t sleep on the Latin Mass.

name: Holy Missionary Baptist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful message every Sunday,  a great place to praise, worship, and glorify God. Serving the community in many ways. hello you met me at a saturday event/when is the next one so i again thank you for the pray and hamburger and dresses in my size glory to god and now 2 other women want to come can i give you their numbers? This was a very friendly and welcoming church.  I would recommend it. An excellent place for worship and fellowship. Very friendly and welcoming

name: Holy Name of Jesus Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I absolutely love our Catholic Church. Every time we attend Mass, we feel God’s presence guiding our marriage, our home, and our spiritual journey. The priests share powerful, meaningful messages that stay with us throughout the week, and the community is warm, welcoming, and full of genuine faith.
This parish has strengthened not only our relationship with God, but also our relationship with each other. We are truly grateful to call this our church home. My wife and I love this Church and its community of faithful believers. We have been active parishoners here for many years. We are blessed to have a wonderful pastor leading us in Father Erik, as well as his trusted team in helping implement the many ministries and visions for our growth and our future. A very special shout out to all of the clergy currently asigned to our parish and especially to Father Thomas Davis for his tireless commitment to God and His people. We had our photo booth Desert Luna Photobooths here for a youth kickoff event and had such a blast! Thanks for having us and letting us be part of a fun celebration!! Very friendly and helpful people. We are visiting here from Cincinnati Ohio for health reasons. The deacon took time after mass to give me a special blessing. The priest was very nice and talked to us at the beginning of mass. The Boy Scout Troop 11 here is the best troop and I think the whole County. They help out all of Redlands and are very good citizens. I hope to see them as the 2018 bicycle classic. I saw these Scout putting up posters for the 2018 bicycle classic and they were very polite to all the people. When I saw people get baptized here at this church Holy Name of Jesus Parish Hall it was so good to see the boys helping out with the fire.

name: Holy Revival Non Denominational Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor James and Son are such amazing ppl. They are always trying to help anyone in need. They have FREE FOOD every Tuesday morning. Stop by every Tuesday and Sunday service with pastor James. I love attending Holy Revival's church service. The sanctuary is filled with the presence of the Holy Spirit, and Pastor James is a truly anointed, unique man of God. 🙏🏾 Pastor/Teacher James Thomas is a real man of God and deliver his sermons in alignment to the word. Holy Revival church has  an open door feeling as you enter the building. It is truly a blessing to have a real church in a city mostly known for poverty and crime. Holy Revival Non Denominational Church is a light in the city of Compton, Ca. Holy Revival Non Denominational Church is a welcoming and giving church. Constantly helping and serving the community through the vision and with the help of Pastor James Thomas; and volunteers. Thank you for the time, work, and dedication you have put into the Compton community. Holy Revival is a church where you can fell like a family and where you can learn the truth about the word God. Pastor James is a pastor that is so transparent in delivering the word it will have you researching and wanting to know more bout the word of God. Pastor James wants all his members to be blessed and to succeed. This church is for anybody who wants to hear the raw truth about the word of God. This church is for anybody seeking to be apart of a community and family.

name: Holy Spirit Anglican Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church that is welcoming and supportive of all who walk through their doors!  My wife and I have been going here for two years now and we are more than at home here! Friendly, outgoing, Christ- centered congregation. We were so glad to visit there on our SoCal vacation. Worshipping in a tradition that goes way back, but with an up to date feel, and people of all ages, praising and thanking God together! No pictures of the church.  Nothing about the nuns or priests who may be there. Great teaching and warm community!

name: Holy Spirit Catholic Church Campus
Holy Transfiguration Melkite Greek Catholic Church
reviewSummary: Wonderful services - join them for vespers or liturgy of presancitifed (if it’s lent). As a Ukrainian Greek Catholic, I really enjoy praying with a sister church of the Eastern Catholic tradition. Totally recommend the church and the community The Middle Eastern Food Festival 2024 did not disappoint. So many baklava choices!😋 The kitchen runs like a well-oiled machine. My family looks forward to this festival every Labor Day weekend. A huge thank you to the hardworking congregation who put in countless hours to make this beloved tradition a success.🙏 We visited for Palm Sunday from North Carolina.  Absolutely breathtaking liturgy, vibrant and jubilant community!  A true witness to the Christian faith from every aspect, communicating God’s love and desire for relationship through architecture, interpersonal relationships, respectful for liturgical emphasis, and more.  This church is Catholic, in that, it is in Union with the Bishop of Rome but expresses itself using the Eastern Byzantine Rite and Eastern cultural motifs.  This community will welcome you regardless of who you are!  Come as you are and you will leave as someone else. It's a beautiful parish and vibrant community. I was there for a few times and they were very open and friendly. Love the singing. I first visited Holy Transfiguration three years ago for the Middle Eastern Food Festival on Labor Day from a coworker's invite. I was totally blown away!!! Visited on and off for about two years before deciding I couldn't resist any longer and to join the Melkite Greek Catholic Church. This is my favorite parish ever - amazing liturgy, sermons, pursuit of holiness, and community. There is a relic of the True Cross in the parish!!!

name: Holy Trinity Anglican Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: This church is an oasis in the frenetic busyness of Orange County. It offers a calm, reflective, sacred space for entering into a worshipful experience and connecting with God in a personal, individual, and safe way.  It is not a typical OC church. If you are looking for a church with a light show, loud band, and fog machine, you won't find those things there. But if you are looking for a place with deep, thought-provoking, intelligent teaching; artistic and sacred worship; and authentic, accepting people, you will not be disappointed.   My spiritual life and understanding of god have deepened significantly since I started attending HTC. Great church ! Wonderful pastor! Great vibes !and  Nicest people that you can meet Beautiful church service, amazing & thoughtful sermons, very welcoming church body - very happy here at Holy Trinity! Really enjoyed the people and worship experience. The preaching was excellent. Very friendly community and committed to prayer, hospitality, and loving the outcast.

reviewSummary: A beautiful and highly reverent parish in Ladera Ranch. Phenomenal community and staff. Excellent family environment. Childrens programs and youth ministries are top-tier.

name: Holy Trinity Catholic Church - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
A very modern but beautiful chapel. Great views. Friendly parish. Good food served at events. The organ was a bit loud. Female singer was outstanding. Service much less formal than my youth but still in line. The members of this church are extremely inappropriate & disrespectful to new member that don’t look like them. My daughters went to church with their grandmother for the first time. A incident occurred during communion. Following the service was a event for anniversary of priest? Or maybe the church. & multiple members walked up to my children when their grandmother was away to questions where they are from? If they were even catholic. & whether or not they had any knowledge of what they were doing there.

Excuse me!?

I’m disappointed in this community of people that allowed this behavior & hope they learn how to represent God better. Oh, my dear friend, let me share with you the wonders of this divine worship service at the church! It is truly a blessed experience, filled with nourishment and a connection to the Catholic school. As I witness the children attending Mass, my heart is filled with joy, reminiscent of the precious moments when my own children were in school.

I assure you, dear soul, that attending this service will bring you immense grace and fulfillment. However, I must humbly inform you that there is a slight challenge when it comes to parking. The parking lot is a bit of a distance from the church, so if you have any physical limitations, I kindly suggest arriving early to secure a parking spot closer to the entrance. Otherwise, you may have to embark on a little hike, but fear not, for the rewards that await you are worth every step.

This church, my friend, is a treasure trove of blessings and offerings. From the sermons that touch your soul to the sense of community that envelops you, there is so much to embrace and cherish. And if you do decide to grace this sacred place with your presence, please do mention that Marylou sent you! 😊🙏🏻 Beautiful church situated on top of a hill with a beautiful view! You’re always greeted with a smile, a book with daily readings and songs. The community is warm and welcoming. Holy Trinity has some of the friendliest most helping people I have ever met . They are loving and caring and God fearing. The church itself is up on a hill with an awesome beautiful beautiful view of the entire area. If you're looking for her spot to sit a piece of mind have a chat with God this is definitely the place to go.

name: Holy Trinity Church
reviewSummary:
Love this church so much! One of the kindest and most welcoming communities, sermons that challenge and help grow you, and tangible love and grace 🤍 They practice what they preach 100%!! You will instantly feel like you are a part of the family. HTC is worth visiting if it’s just a one off, or to make it your church home ⭐️ Love the community and teaching. This church really prioritizes community with plenty of small groups, events for people of all walks, classes, and volunteer opportunities. This church is one it is easy to get involved with and feel connected to, which I feel is important as fellowship is a major part of the Christian walk.

There are also several different pastors with different preaching styles, but always biblically grounded. Very happy with this church. Holy Trinity Church is the most welcoming church I’ve even been to! I’ve been so blessed to be part of this community for the past few years. They balance the strengths of many church traditions faithfully— Biblical teaching, being led by the Holy Spirit, investing in multigenerational community and missions. Come and find community AND grow in your faith! Love this church! Sermons are uplifting, highly relevant and topical in this turbulent time. Playing on the worship team as someone raised in traditional classical style is stretching me to a new type of musicality. Been to this church a few times. Very lively with Great Spirit. However not once did I hear "open your Bible". I Love to have people learning directly from the Bible and not just someone's private interpretation of what the Bible said. If this is what you want, well this is the church for you. Praise God

name: Holy Trinity Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Very spacious for the quinceanera of which these pictures were of . It had a Harry Potter theme it was really nicely done the way they decorated it and I'm sure they rented out for anything kind of  occasion you need it for but it was nice and clean big kitchens there's a lot of space something I would recommend they had drinks they were serving cocktails but they also had soda for the kids, fruit veggies display with jumbo prawns, in the middle of charcuterie so many items to choose from. My only reason to go there to give them a gift. I like this church it's a great place to go and remember who create us. I talked to the person he take care of the guard he answered all my questions so he asked me can you help me clean up this area only I didn't say no because.its  Church . I am not catholic but I found everything about it beautiful. Comforting. Gracious. Spiritual. The decor was fascinating and amazingly beautiful. My kids and I attend the 10 am. mass. We sit at the entrance because sometimes my kids  can't stay put. It would be nice to have speakers at the entrance so we can hear the sermon.  The priest are so soft-spoken that its hard to hear what they are saying. Though we were here to celebrate the life of a much loved family member, and not all could attend due to health conscious concerns, the church's care, concern, & extremely thoughtful staff made a sad day the best it could be.  Any worries some might have in regards to the Church being able to take note of health and distancing while still supporting our sacred moments were dispelled.

name: Holy Trinity Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: You just walk in the door and you're Blown Away with the beautiful 40 ft painting of the crucifixion of Jesus Christ. You got a problem and you need God's help, just go and sit in there and you'll feel the presence of God This is my parish and I absolutely love Holy Trinity! Father Michael and Charles are very warm and inviting. They have also brought back many activities safely and cautiously.  Masses are very family friendly as are all of the ushers and fellow worshippers. Great church. I love the atmosphere. Nothing like a Catholic Church. I love father Michael. He's my priest away from home. Very humble and a good leader. best church i have ever been to. the community becomes family, i have made countless friendships because of this church. music is always great, super kid friendly, and beautiful. Great church they Communion classes and confirmation classes. The people that teach classes are volunteers. Volunteers are welcome, volunteers help teach students there prayers. They have English mass the Spanish is 1:30 pm on Sunday.

name: Holy Trinity Church Downtown Congregation - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting Holy Trinity downtown blessed me greatly!  The service was blended modern worship (Goodness of God) and hymns (Great is Thy Faithfulness), I was welcomed by a family to sit by them, the sermon was scripture-focused with note-taking encouraged, and the pastor referenced his PhD on koinonia (community). They are obviously focused on building community and devoted to prayer. We were so blessed by this congregation.

They have so many families and so many children there.

Many people greeted us and spoke with us.

They honored God and His Word. Reformed, compact service, traditional hymns set to more modern instruments.  Younger congregation but older liturgy The church is very welcoming, and it’s a great place to make friends! Worship is great and very solid Bible teaching. All are welcome. Very nice service. The pastors are right on point. It's the right place to bé to spend time with God. It's my second time going to the service. I will be going there every Sunday. There's no excuses. Amen

name: Holy Trinity Episcopal Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus

name: Holy Trinity Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
Our family is so thankful for this church! Christ is truly exalted here. Sinners are shown our need for a Savior and pointed to Him in every aspect of life. The gospel is both faithfully preached and lived out.

From the youngest children to the oldest adults, the call is the same: repent of your sin and trust in the Lord Jesus Christ. We are urged to cherish Christ, to exalt Him, and to be courageous for His honor.

The bonds of love and affection here span generations, cultures, and nationalities. The leaders know their own need for Christ and seek to submit to Him above all else, even when it comes at personal cost. They labor for the sake of the flock and genuinely care for our eternal souls. I have personally tasted the forgiveness and freedom of the gospel through the way our leaders have shepherded me, and I am so thankful.

This church cares not only for the growth of its members but also for welcoming others in and bringing more people to Christ. Please come visit. You will be warmly received and pointed to our great Savior Jesus Christ!!! Holy Trinity is living out the Reformation. The Lord is worshipped. The Bible is preached. The Gospel is proclaimed and its counterfeits are exposed. The elders shepherd the flock. And the congregants walk together in love. Christ is the cornerstone and you can feel it.

If you are looking for a place to worship in Tampa, look no more. My wife and I entered into marriage while attending Holy Trinity and it was such a blessing. We know it will be for you too. Indeed, it will change your life. Although we were called away for a season, we will be back. We hope to see you there. Our family was immensely blessed during our (too short) time at Holy Trinity Presbyterian in Tampa.  The environment is warm and welcoming, evincing the genuine Christian fellowship cultivated by its members.  The elders preach and teach from a solid, reformed perspective, demonstrating both deep knowledge and deep affection for the scripture.  We miss this congregation very much. Spiritually inspired and educated leadership. Array of ages in attendance. Humble and joyous community.

I have been going to this church consistently since December 2024. The pastor, Dustyn, and all of the elders are God fearing, Bible revering, kind and gentle people. Every move they make and position they take on events, order of worship, and worldly issues is measured by scripture. The Holy Spirit is alive in the congregation as well! I have nothing but wonderful things to say about this church, and I will continue my journey to membership. This church has been in visible turmoil for years, and sadly, what was once a healthy congregation is now a fraction of what it used to be. Over the past 5–6 years, nearly the entire membership has quietly departed—including families who were faithful, generous, and foundational to the life of the church. If you’re new and curious why so many seasoned saints have left, you’ll be hard-pressed to get a straight answer.

There is no denominational accountability. Though there have been periodic claims that the church is “seeking affiliation,” it remains entirely autonomous—and it shows. The absence of external oversight has allowed concerning patterns to take root.

While the pulpit has maintained a historically Reformed voice—bold, biblical, and doctrinally sound—good preaching does not equal good pastoring. The preaching may feed the mind, but shepherding feeds the soul. And tragically, the shepherding here has become colder, more institutional, and increasingly transactional.

The environment surrounding the senior leadership has grown toxic over time. The attention of the lead pastor often functions like a kind of currency. Certain members—especially those perceived as prestigious, connected, or beneficial to the church’s image—receive a disproportionate share of energy and warmth. There are even accounts of high-profile individuals being courted into membership with relentless focus, only to later move away. And yet, their names continue to appear in public updates, bolstering the impression of robust involvement. One must wonder: is the goal membership, or marketing?

Multiple family members of church leaders are employed on staff, but their salaries are not publicly disclosed. The senior pastor’s compensation package is not released to the congregation. Large financial decisions—some reportedly in the six-figure range—have been made without congregational input. Several sermons in recent years were focused almost entirely on giving, even as weekly attendance continued to dwindle.

Attempts have been made to install deacons, but candidates have reportedly been told—explicitly—that no one in office is permitted to publicly disagree with the elders. This is not biblical eldership; it is spiritual consolidation. What was once a plurality of leadership has morphed into a ring of agreement. A few of the most senior elders have direct historical and/or financial interest in the church property itself—an undeniably valuable piece of real estate situated at the bridge to Davis Islands. Whether the facility is a house of worship or an investment holding is unclear.

Members who ask questions or push for clarity are often labeled as divisive. Those who leave are not simply grieved—they are cut off. Contact with former members is not just discouraged, it is forbidden. Discipline is less about restoration and more about quarantine. And all of this is done under the language of “protecting the flock.”

There is no culture of confession. Only silence. No space for honest disagreement. Only compliance. No rejoicing over the repentance of prodigals. Only doors that quietly close behind them.

The social life of the church often reinforces a tight inner circle. New members are celebrated at first—but over time, the emphasis subtly shifts from shepherding their souls to measuring their usefulness. And once someone is no longer useful—or worse, asks the wrong questions—they are either marginalized or removed.

This is a church that now meets in a cavernous, multi-million-dollar facility with a congregation small enough to fit in a living room. The building is stunning. The optics are strong. The community? Treading water.

If you are considering attending, come with eyes wide open. Not everything is as it appears. Leadership is often polished, articulate, and persuasive—but beware the cost of disagreeing. Ask anyone who has tried.

May God have mercy on what still remains, and raise up true shepherds who bind wounds rather than inflict and neglect
.

It is a chinese church so there are many people who speak mandarin or other chinese dialects but most people are bilingual. There are english services as well as chinese services. You do not have to be ethnically chinese to attend this church! It is welcome to anyone, but if you do not feel comfortable in a Chinese cultural setting then this church might not be for you in the long term. Horrible greeting service. I took my mom to check out the location for her for the 1st time. After the service there was no correct instruction given for where the newcomers should go next and nobody bothered to come introduce. We got lost and then decided to ask someone/pastor’s wife for where to go. She sent us off with the deacon who invited us to a “newcomer’s greeting” 1 hour later yet he didn’t show up nor did anyone responsible for greeting service. We should’ve left as soon as we found out they really don’t need any newcomer, but instead we waited another hour to attend the so-called newcomer greeting and nobody talked to us. The only church people who showed us to “greet” was not pastor, deacon, or anybody responsible for greeting service, but several bible study leaders who asked every newcomer their availability of time throughout the week so they are eligible of joining whichever bible group - literally a job fair. We’ve been to different churches in the past and this is the only one we’ve been to that has no greeting aspect at all.... Very good church to fit all age people. There are a lot of good Children programs, including AWANA, Sunday school, and Chinese School. I have been practicing my Christian faith at HoC3 for 6 years. I really greatly appreciate this church, where I witnessed more than love, grace, and all mighty of God.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, where you can encounter God and be surrounded by authentic community, I highly recommend it. Just do it! That's not a common thing from my experience and what led to me attending consistently. So worth it! Very welcoming atmosphere. The speakers were very good and the attendees are very open and friendly which made me feel more welcomed. They offer Communion every Sunday and worship music words are on the screen. Highly recommended, come as you are. Love this church and Pastor Dennis. Wonderful family, great community, and my wife and I feel so much love.  Hope provides balance teaching, and for us, is an Ark of Safety.

reviewSummary: Wow what can I say! Hope Christian Church has absolutely changed my family’s life for the better. name: Hope Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm, caring people. Conservative Biblically based values consistently taught across the age groups. Comfortable environment. Very multi-generational family friendly church. I love Hope Church. It’s super friendly, so welcoming. I’ve gotten the chance to get to know people quickly. Sermons apply to our lives today. Small groups, meeting in homes during the week, have helped me get know others and helped me on my journey with Jesus Christ. l Thank God for allowing me the privilege to attend this Church home of God. It is a Blessing to have a wonderful church family and I truly appreciate Our Pastor Who Really Reach out to God . For God So Love The World That He Gave His Only Begotten Son. Praise God For his Love. This church has become a second home for our family. The people are genuinely kind, the building is beautiful, and the pastor’s preaching is always uplifting and easy to connect with. My kids look forward to Sunday school every week, which brings so much joy to my heart. We are truly grateful to be part of such a loving community. A Church More Concerned with Control Than Compassion

Hope Church presents itself as a welcoming, Christ-centered community, but my experience revealed something deeply concerning. This church cultivates a culture that is, frankly, cult-like in its rigidity and judgment. If you do not conform to their unwritten social and theological codes, you are quietly (and sometimes openly) marginalized. Their message of God’s grace comes with invisible asterisks—extended only to those who live and speak in alignment with leadership expectations.

Perhaps most troubling was the behavior of the former youth pastor, who enlisted young students to perform physical labor on his private farm under the guise of “ministry” and “servant leadership.” The work was often grueling, entirely unrelated to spiritual formation, and absolutely inappropriate for their age group. This was not about teaching values; it was exploitation masked as service. For many, this left emotional and spiritual scars. It’s damaging to a young person’s developing sense of worth to be told that backbreaking labor is God's will—especially when the primary beneficiary is not the church or the poor, but one individual’s personal property.

Also not a complete reflection of the church, but church members views on any type of difference physically or mentally is disturbing. Multiple members chided us on my brother’s Down syndrome being a direct result of my family’s lineage of sin. I thought we didn’t live under Old Testament law anymore?

The church has yet to meaningfully address these abuses, and the broader culture remains one of spiritual elitism and performance-based belonging. This is not what the Gospel teaches.

As Scripture reminds us:
“Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in people’s faces.”(Matthew 23:13)

I write this not to tear down faith, but to caution those seeking authentic spiritual community. Be discerning. Not all churches that preach grace practice it. Find somewhere else to plug in that’s grace isn’t limited.

name: Hope Church NYC - East Village - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been attending Hope for a few years now, and I am so grateful to have found such a fantastic community here in NYC. The Hope pastors deliver great sermons every Sunday, and we have had some amazing guest speakers visit us from all over as well. The people I've met here at church are not only people I see on Sundays for service, but I genuinely consider them great friends. We do plenty of things together throughout the week as well, including meeting for small groups / bible study and volunteer opportunities throughout the city to not make church a once-a-week, passive activity. I also appreciate the resources Hope provides everyone with, from bible study to financial literacy and marriage courses. I feel truly blessed to be a part of this church and highly recommend it to others. My first time at Hope was memorable. I left telling my hubby, “this is our soon to be church home”. Warmth and friendliness from the people, worship is amazing and I just fell in love with the flow of Hope Church EV! All my friends and family i invite, come back. ❤️ Humble, young, Bible-centered non-denominational church. Really love the community here and feels like home! I've been actively attending since Spring 2017. It's been my church home and community. We believe in the following and hope these values resonate with you as well. 🙂 Stopby and visit!

Living Deeply - We are committed to living out of the depth of our union and communion with Christ.

Living Neighborly - We are committed to joining God in loving and living intentionally for the well-being of our neighbors, both locally and globally.

Living Communally - We are committed to being shaped by, and living out, the gospel of Jesus Christ through life in authentic community.

Living Justly - We are committed to doing justice, living justly, and speaking prophetically for the sake of all who are oppressed in our neighborhood, in our city, and in our world.

Living Generously - We are committed to giving of all that we are and all that we have in response to God's abundant grace that has been poured out on us.

Living Restfully - We are committed to living lives of rest in the midst of a chaotic world.

Living Beautifully - We are committed to living lives that witness to the beauty of God by creatively generating beauty in our neighborhood.

Living Delightfully - We are committed to living lives full of celebration and joy. Friendly family feel church that takes the time to know your name and ask how you are doing. name: Hope Church NYC - Midtown - New York Campus
reviewSummary:

I've lived in many countries and been to many types of churches, and usually can see quickly if the doctrine is sound or not, and I feel this church keeps things to the basics and biblical, not too much glamour, or focus on a single pastor, just right. This church is a special place where genuine, deep community is being built. Some of the main values of the church that I could see off the bat (and I still see to be true two years later) include an emphasis on being a blessing to NYC by supporting non-profits that are making a local impact, an emphasis on emotionally healthy spirituality and discipleship, and an emphasis on sharing the gospel with those who are new to a church setting but want to grow in an understanding of God. The leaders are so humble, servant hearted, genuine, and welcoming. This church is also connected to two other churches in Manhattan - Hope West Side and Hope East Village, so if you are closer to one of those 2 neighborhoods, you can also consider visiting one of those locations as well! "It's not possible to be spiritually mature while being emotionally immature." I've been coming to Hope Midtown since 2017, and I can say that Pastor Drew's sermons, the courses offered, and the community have all helped me, a woman from Los Angeles, adjust to (and even love!) New York City and grow in faith in ways I couldn't even imagine. The church has seen me through a breakup, my "quarter life crisis" and career change, and seasons of healing. I'm excited to see what else is in store as the church continues to grow, and I'm so thankful for all the people I've met, including my soon-to-be husband! Really enjoyed the friendly atmosphere. Everyone made us feel like we worship together every week. Wonderful spirit of praising the Lord, and focus on Christ. Visiting the church was one of our highlights to our trip to NY. You will feel at home here and always welcomed !
