reviewSummary:
I’ve been incredibly blessed by my experience at Hope City Church. Ever since I met Steve and Julie, they’ve welcomed me with genuine love, kindness, and Christ-centered friendship. Their investment in my life has made a lasting impact.

Pastor Steve has been one of the greatest blessings in my walk with Christ. He has discipled me, challenged me to grow, encouraged me through difficult seasons, and always pointed me back to Jesus. His leadership is authentic, biblical, and full of grace and truth.

Hope City Church has truly helped me grow closer to Jesus. The teaching is rooted in God’s Word, the worship is awesome, and the church family is welcoming and cares deeply for people. This isn’t just a place to attend on Sundays—it’s a place where lives are transformed, relationships are built, and faith grows.

If you’re looking for a church that will love you, challenge you, and help you deepen your relationship with Christ, I can’t recommend Hope City Church enough. I’m so thankful for Steve, Julie, and the entire Hope City family. God has used this church to change my life, and I’ll always be grateful. I absolutely love going to Hope City Church! From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed with genuine love and kindness. The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and completely nonjudgmental—you can come exactly as you are and feel comfortable and appreciated.

Pastor Steve and his wife Julie are truly amazing. Their love for God and for people shines through in everything they do. They have created a place where lives are changed, faith is strengthened, and everyone feels like family.

If you’ve been looking for a church home or have been hesitant to step into one, I highly recommend attending Hope City Church. It has been such a blessing in my life, and I believe it can be in yours too. It just might change your life. Pastor Steve is the BEST pastor I've ever had and I'm 80 years old and I've had some good ones! I'm a committed Bible believing Christian and have studied scriptures for years, on my own with Logo's software, using Strong's a lot, and under some really good pastors. Yet every Sunday I learn something new, while at the same time a new believer or someone just checking out Jesus will be very comfortable with the teaching. It's amazing.
The worship is Spirit filled and worshipful.
The people are very welcoming.
We have small groups with great Bible study, discussions, prayer and delicious dessert.
You simply won't find a better church anywhere and we're BLESSED to have it locally.
Carolyn McCormick If I were to say anything about such a group of people to make up GOD'S CHURCH, i will say outstanding. Because that's what they are at HOPE CITY CHURCH in RockHill SC. I have been to many CHURCHES
, but never to one that makes everyone feels warm, welcome, appreciated,and Loved. And the Pastor who were my friend before he became my Pastor are so genuinely from the heart.If you were to visit HOPE CITY CHURCH you will find it as i have explained and more a place i know that you would take in consideration of making it your CHURCH family God Bless You all Minister Johnny Adams. Definitely recommend giving a try and show up even if you don’t know what your relationship with God is. Steve and Julie give warm welcomes to anyone and everyone and there are even snacks there for before or after service. They really break down a lot of what is said in the Bible so it is very easy to understand and apply to real life. This church is for anyone and that’s what I like about it!

name: Hope City United - Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church! My family has been going here for a year and a half. Don’t believe anything negative you hear about this amazing church. It is just evilness trying to keep you away from a good place! Look into how many salvations and baptisms happen at this church. When it’s all said and done, the most important  thing about being a Christian is to spread God’s word and get people to Jesus. Every one of the pastors here are awesome and they have the most amazing worship team! One of the best churches I have ever been to in my life. The most friendly family warm welcoming environment. If you want to feel Gods Presence It’s HERE! We were invited by friends to attend a Sunday service at Hope City United church. We have attended services a few times since then. Everyone always seem so friendly and nice. We are Always greeted with smiling faces. It's a non-denominational church. They welcome all race of life. Went to the new location this past Sunday. I love hearing Pastor Trent speak. I do have to wear my ear plugs because the music is way to loud for me. I can't stand long because I'm bone on bone in both knees. They stand a lot while singing. Not sure why but they do. I have to watch out for the lights too they might cause a vertigo attack. We can't attend all the time because we live hour and half away now. But we will start watching it from home. Thank you Tiffany Creshelle Hermann Lockett for the invite. What a place full of love and smiles. I always enjoy the services from Pastor Trent and the worship is always amazing. I have heard a lot of people talk about love in churches but I am glad to have found one that lives it. Highly Recommend for all ages. HCU is an amazing place! We have finally found our church family and our church home. I have never met a group of people more real, loving, and on fire to serve God and the community. I am so blessed for the leadership of Pastors Trent and Keisha Cory and the passion and motivation that they instill in us. You will leave every week hungry for more of Jesus! If you’re looking for a place to call home, come visit! You won’t regret it!

name: Hope City Woodlands - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Loved it! Me and my wife enjoyed it. Staff is friendly and feel like home. Will be back. Love neighborhood churches.  Jesus is Lord. If you’re looking for a church with the advantages and feel of a mega church but the family community feel of a small church, Hope City the Woodlands is for you! Been coming to this church for 8 years and I have attended and served at this campus since it opened. I’ve seen this church through its ups and downs and I can truly say it’s something special and the Spirit of God is still moving here. The Freedom groups are something that sets this church apart from other churches in the city and are an essential experience to going deeper in Christ. When I went through this 12 week group and conference I felt like a completely different person, truly able to understand how God intended me to live. I love the people and culture here and there is a warmth at this church that I just love. No church is perfect as we are all sick and need the Great Physician, so while other reviews may reveal certain shortcomings of this particular campus on a superficial level I thought I would give my insider view for those who are curious. Being a part of Hope City has changed my life in the most profound way. I pray anyone reading this review who is looking for a true encounter with Jesus would come and check it out and see what God may be speaking to their heart. 🙏

Jesus changed my life through this church. The picture attached says it all! That’s me, getting rebaptized at the Freedom Conference and giving my heart to the Lord. I love this church. After getting plugged into some groups like their Freedom study, I met so many great people and built community. I have grown in my faith more over the last couple of years here than I did with decades at other places.

If you want a church full of people seeking after The Lord and trying to grow each other, this is the place for you. The first Wednesday service with Pastor Tyler is always great, the worship nights, and men’s breakfast and other activities are amazing also. There are so many opportunities to grow and build community if you’re trying to do that.

I’ve seen the Holy Spirit move in so many ways since joining this church, and I am so thankful to pastor’s Daniel and Jacky and campus pastors Tyler and Nicole for how they are leading this church community. This is what church is supposed to look like. My family and I have been attending Hope City for years. We moved closer to this campus earlier this year and have fallen in love with this community. Our kids look forward to coming every week and they are so happy here. The community is so welcoming and feels like home. God is moving here in big ways, we are happy to be a part of it! Absolutely love Hope City – The Woodlands! You get an incredible service without the long drive to the main campus in Houston. From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt right at home. The welcome team is so warm and inviting, the kids' church is amazing, and the worship and message are truly God-led. This is exactly what I was looking for — a genuine community and a place to call home!

name: Hope Commons Church - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
I really like this church .
I have been going for almost a year and really enjoying the people.
The messages are great,  reading the Bible is always important for me.
the music is like going to a concert.
They have coffee and tea for people to drink while listening .
They have a children's area and a gym for events.
They have a men's group on Thursday mornings.  I don't make it to this very much because I own a service business and need to be at the office most mornings. I really enjoy going to the meetings when I have time.
I have not been going to church much before this but I really look forward to church now .
they have a six pm meeting on Saturday and two meetings on Sunday.
On sundays , They start at nine am and again at 11 am .
If you want to listen to a good Bible study and some great inspirational music.  Hope Commons Church might be a place for you.
God bless. This is the church for you!!! Walking in the front doors you feel nothing but love and acceptance. All of the many support groups offered here are amazing! Thank you, Hope Commons!!! it a great church everyone welcome and no judgement!! Such a great church and very nice people I have been looking for a place of worship that makes me feel comfortable and relaxed.  I have found my church.

name: Hope Community - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary:
The name embodies the church. A place that continues to build my hope in Jesus. A place that has given me a community to do life with.  I love their kids ministry and the community of families around my kiddos.  If you are looking for a local church that will encourage you on your walk with Jesus and build community then Hope Community church is that place. We’ve been attending for 2 years and it is an amazing community! Perfect for all stages of life. Our kids love it too. I been going for now 4y and I am i love with amazing family that preach the right gospel with love, service, humility. I have really grown in my relationship with my community and with God. Excellent for any stage of your life. Como your family is waiting, ready to serve like Jesus did. Amazing worship the Holy Spirit moving, care for nursery, pre-k and teens. Word can’t really describe all the love you will receive. Very friendly church, I felt like I belonged there.  Attended my 1st grandbabies Dedication Ceremony which was precided over by Pastor Nate, he's down to earth and his words resonated with me.  I look forward to hearing him again. Love the  Worship and  the  move  ov  God  in the Hispanic  services
1pm  +   6pm  Sunday night
Many people senving God 🙏 on Tuesday night  7 pm
Songs mostly played on  96.7  Santa Anna    music +
Vida Unida

name: Hope Community Church
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a church to call home, this is the one. I cannot begin to say enough good things about Hope Community Church. Going to church on Sundays is one of my favorite parts of the week. When you walk in the building you are always greeted by warm welcoming smiles. The environment is relaxing, inviting, intentional, and creates a space where you can really open up your heart to hear the inspiring words of the gospel. The children’s programming is stellar and my kids are actually sad on the weeks when we cannot make it in person and they have to miss it. Pastor Roman and Pastor Billy deliver sermons each week that will leave you laughing, crying, pondering so many aspects of everyday life- but most importantly, furthering your relationship with God and forcing you to think more about how you can live your life as a true Christian- loving thy neighbor,  putting others before yourself, helping those in need. Hope has opened my eyes to true Christianity. A loving, accepting, selfless environment that inspires me to be a better person, spouse, mother, and community member. They emphasize serving those around us that are not as privileged whether through service, events,  the food pantry, clothing pen, foster child kits, toy drives- you name it. I also host a small group bible study through Hope that has introduced me to some amazing women in my church community that I am so grateful to have as a part of my life. If I could give it 10 out of 5 stars, I would. If your life feels like it’s missing something and your looking for a community driven place to grow your faith and make you a better person- Hope is it. Still not the church im looking for. I do enjoy the services but In these times I dont need a rock and roll glamor church. I need my pastor to stand up to the demonic influences that are all around us. Its to much of love love love and not enough stand up and fight fight fight. Whatever you have to do to get people into the pews. Hope church is like my family. Pastor Roman teachings are lifestyle. His way of preaching are like the answers we desperately needed. Pastor George and his incredible work of service should deeply appreciated. Worship is so lively. Their kids zone is beautifully designed specially for kids. I have Never seen a separate space for autism and intellectually disabled kids and they provide a peaceful atmosphere for them. I am happy to be a part of this beautiful prayerful family. I have been attending Hope for several months. I started at Hope at a time when I was really looking for community and fellowship with other believers. Hope church has been a blessing to my life. I have met some great people and have gotten involved with some of the ministries that the church provides. It is a very welcoming and friendly church. Pastor Roman, others on staff, the worship team...everyone there has a heart for people, the community and sharing the love of Christ with others. I would highly recommend Hope Community Church for anyone looking for a church family. There is something for all ages. My family was invited to a Christmas Eve service in December 2019 at Hope Community Church and we have been actively attending since then. My husband and I chose to be baptized by Pastor Roman in November 2021 and had our two children dedicated to the church in December 2021. My daughter even got to participate in a summer camp with the church and volunteers with my husband at the Love Works food pantry as often as they can. It has felt like home since the first time we stepped inside. Everyone is so warm and welcoming and being actively engaged in the community has been so beneficial to my family. I encourage anyone seeking a church family to come to a service to experience it for themselves.

name: Hope Community Church
reviewSummary:
Pastors are down to earth and the church is small enough to get to talk to them and get to know them. They're very gospel focused and focused on helping ordinary people get to know an extraordinary God.

I've been here 13 years and have seen the church make a lot of really great choices over the years. Choices like planting several churches without any benefit back to the main church. There are two other church locations but they have autonomy to operate pretty independently. I love that selfless attitude to live out the mission called upon the church to plant new churches and to not worry about losing key members to new church plants which means a loss of culture and donations. It's a testament to the dedication and character of the leadership at Hope. I really enjoyed the services on Sundays! I love it how Hope CC goes through each verse and explains them, and gives context! My small groups were always nice and the people were friendly. It does take a while for you to feel like part of the community. Just give it time to develop and get involved and make the effort to get to know everyone. I don't go here anymore since my commute was a hassel since I moved. But I recommend if you have a car or you live near transportation or you live near by the church. Great community focused church known for its involvement in assisting local communities. A welcoming facility with one EPIC painted bus inspiring artists of all kind to pursue their dreams. #JustPaintIt #CreativeSouls I started attending Hope the very first Sunday of my freshman year of college. The first service that I attended, I knew this church was different, and just what I needed! Hope focuses on emphasizing the importance of scripture and how the Gospel is evident throughout the Bible. Now, almost 7 years in, Hope has become my home and I am so thankful for all that Hope has added to my life! At Hope I am blessed to be a part of a loving community - both in my small group and through the Young Adults Ministry (YAM)! Forever grateful for Hope and the way I have been pointed to Jesus! If you're looking for a church that is rooted in scripture and is based in theology, this is your place. All of the pastors are great preachers and are always dissecting the bible in ways I never thought to. I love it when preaching is based in strong theology so we have a clear understanding of the whole picture when looking at scripture.

The worship is amazing as well! It's basically all hymns, modernized by their worship leader Tim. It's extremely well done and a joy to worship to.

If you're looking for a new church, you need to come and try Hope Community Church. You won't regret it!

name: Hope Community Church
reviewSummary: Welcoming community for people at all stages of faith, featuring inspirational music, down-to-earth messages, and strong local community partnerships.

name: Hope Community Church - Apex Campus
reviewSummary: What a beautiful Church and what great community! The pastor's predicaments, the music, the facility... everything was innovative (to me) but so, so impressive. A great place to practice religious faith. Hope Community Church is a Christian church that brings hope to all who enter its doors. Pastor Jason Gore heads up the entire church. Hope has a campus in Apex & another one in Raleigh. Our family goes to the Apex campus. They have classes for all children all the way through high school. They even have a class for special needs kids  & adults. Hope Church is family for me and my family. We’re always welcome there and never judged. People come from all different backgrounds. No matter what’s on your heart, you’ll find strength and healing here. We went to this beautiful church to attend a special event. The grounds/building are gorgeous but the community members of the church are what make this place truly a stand out. The day of the special event was my daughter's birthday and the volunteers/church members made sure she felt loved and honored-she even had hundreds of people sing Happy Birthday to her. It was a night she will never, ever forget. Such a blessed and humbling experience. Thank you all so much! Amazing church, music and message always on point.  Love all of the pastors and online service is available if you miss a week due to family commitments. My first time at the Apex campus today. Nice people and a great message. Seems like a great place to get some work done and also a workout during the week, too.

name: Hope Community Church - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary: HCC is a warm and caring church family. Pastor Jim preaches the word of God and is a wonderful spiritual leader. After my first visit to HCC, I knew I had found my new church home! Our family joined Hope when our kids were young. From our very first visit, this church immediately felt like home. We have made wonderful friends and been involved in several ministries that have really helped us grow in our faith. Being in a smaller church helps you feel more connected to people and not just lost in the crowd. I would encourage anyone who visits our church to find a life group right away. Life groups are for all ages and help you meet new people. Our church also really cares about the community. We host several events during the year that are great for families, like our Easter Egg Hunt and Fall Festival. If you are looking for a friendly church, want to learn more about Christianity or grow in your relationship with Jesus, we'd love for you to join us! We love attending Hope! We have such an amazing community here. Having kids in elementary to high school is sometimes challenging to find a church that can meet all our needs, not at Hope! Our kids love the children's ministry and the youth group! My husband and I also love the "family" we have in our small group. If you're looking for a place to feel at home, like a family, Hope is the place to come visit! We love to see new faces! I began attending Hope Community Church 3 years ago after leaving a much larger church where I felt lost in the crowd and had a hard time making meaningful connections with people. I was welcomed into their church family immediately and quickly became involved in various activities and groups. The people at Hope are some of the most genuine and caring people I have ever met, and I have grown so much in my faith through attending this church. If you are a young adult looking to get plugged into a small group, whether that be to explore the Bible for the first time and ask questions, create new relationships, or grow in your faith and knowledge of the Bible, then you are welcome here! Hope is a multi-generational church that does a great job of engaging all ages in worship and offering opportunities to connect through fun activities. There always seem to be events for kids, teens, young adults, and the women's and men's groups. As a parent of two teenagers, I can't say enough great things about the youth pastor and all those who help ... my teens always have a great time at youth group while also continually growing in their faith. The preaching is also biblical, relevant, and applicable to our lives. I'd definitely recommend Hope Community Church whatever your age or wherever you are in your faith journey, whether just exploring, a new Christian, or spiritually mature.

name: Hope Community Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly people Bible focused message Djd here for Covenant Days senior prom 2019 and LOVED IT A wonderful to worship!  Great community of young families. Solid Biblically sound message. Mission oriented! Great church in Southend.  Very young and vibrant congregation. Gospel preaching. Heart for building community. Such a gift to be a part of this church!

name: Hope Community Church - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary: No church is perfect, but Hope Community Church has been a wonderful place for my family to grow spiritually and connect with others!  We feel so loved and supported by this incredible spiritual family.  The worship is powerful and the pastoral staff does an incredible joy to taking us deep into God's Word.  Though the church is physically located in an affluent suburb, everyone is so down to earth and willing to serve and love others with humility.  If you are looking for a great place to grow and feel loved, getting involved with Hope Community Church is a great option for you! Hope has always been a warm, loving, welcoming church. From day one we have felt the Love of Christ through this place and its people. Pastor Jerry has led the way as an example of a servants heart now Pastor Jeff leads with the same heartbeat and passion to love others and make Christ known. We are thankful for Hope Community Church. Great place to come worship. They have nursery and an incredibly good kids program as well as young adults. Sound doctrine and solid biblical teaching. The people are very welcoming. Clean restrooms. There is a small coffee shop were all proceeds are donated towards missions "community work". The coffee is great and they have a brief selection of drinks and muffins. Real life real stories of people who have been transformed by following Jesus. My family went there it was good while everything was “fine” soon as I got divorced the ex must of said something because no one ever called to see if my boys and I were ok…. So unless you get to someone first, good luck.. I felt “left behind” … sad I won’t go to any church again. Even my boys got no support they won’t go either… saddens me I really thought the church was supportive and empathetic Hope Community Church is a very balanced and loving Christian community.  You will be inspired and given many chances to serve and grow as a believer in Christ. I have been a member there for 15+ years.

name: Hope Community Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
The most welcoming church I have ever attended.

After a difficult experience at my previous church, someone suggested this new one. I arrived feeling anxious, but was immediately greeted by Gregg, which made me feel remembered and welcomed as we sat down for dinner on Wednesday night.

Sunday worship is a wonderful experience. The music is uplifting, and the pastor not only leads but also performs the worship songs. The sermons are engaging and far from dull, always providing entertainment.

Though the congregation is small, it's incredibly welcoming. As a shy introvert, I'm familiar with everyone, and I'm greeted immediately upon arrival, just like a true church family. They've supported me through a particularly tough summer, and I can't imagine where I'd be without Hope Community. Pastor Gregg's sermons are spiritually awesome!
There are other individuals who lead the service sometimes and their sermons are very enlightening as well.
The musicians are amazing!
Very positive and spiritually uplifting atmosphere and environment.
I absolutely thank God to have been invited to this wonderful church.
Best regards; Royal D.B. An amazing church with genuine community. Pastor Gregg has a true gift of being able to pastor and teach. If you love historical context, powerful messages, and true connections - this is a fantastic church. Hope Community have been our church and family for almost 6 years, as a family with two kids and no relatives in the country this is crucial.
Our spiritual growth and knowledge in the word has increased in an exponential way and the way the sermons are prepared (as study of full books of the Bible) has given us more understanding than ever before. They launched this Sunday and it was amazing! If you are looking a for a Christ centered Church, Hope Community will disciple you and make you feel like you are part of the Kingdom of God

name: Hope Community Church - Raleigh Campus - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
My negative interaction happened around the covid years.  I dropped by the church to leave a prayer request.  I thought I had seen a request box on a counter.  One of the men, who was one of the speakers at the time, stated the church had never had a prayer box.  His arrogant attitude towards me was surprising.  I definitely got the impression he thought I was there for a handout.   (In actuality, a family member had died from covid).

I decided to go back for a service.  The same man was speaking.  In my opinion, he carried  the same attitude while teaching God's word that he had during our interchange.  That was the day I made the decision to leave Hope.

My personal view is that every church needs a place you can drop off anomymous prayer requests.  As far as attitudes go, Jesus is clear on the equality of ALL. Truly a family that strives to Love God, follow Jesus, and Share Hope. If you are looking for a new home church I would strongly recommend visiting. If your not sure about all this church stuff I'd also recognize mend visiting, there's no pressure, no judgement, just people who would love to get to know you and answer your questions. This church deeply hurt me. They seemed nice until they were not anymore. They push un-Biblical Word of Faith ideas through both music and stances they take. The fact that people are so argumentative and insistent on their own points of view while not asking the right questions or looking at what the Bible says is a big problem to me. The Bible preaches love, humility, gentleness, kindness, and acceptance, and the experience I had here did not reflect that. If you are looking for a welcoming home church, Hope Community is great.  I have found it not only an amazing church but a great community of friends. We've been attending hope for over 20 years now. We have watched a couple of iterations of it, but one thing that hasn't changed is its mission to share God's love with the community. Hope, like God, loves you just where you are right now. If you're lost, confused, hurting, or in need, this is a wonderful place to go.

name: Hope Community Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
Bible based church honoring God and worshiping his son, Jesus Christ. As I was searching for a church for myself and children, I came to Hope and I felt immediately welcome.  I love the feeling of belonging to a church family and not being lost in the crowd.  Music is excellent and Pastor Cor Pool is amazing.  What has really impressed me the most - was the non judgement - come as you are acceptance of all.  As Christians, we do not go to church to marvel at ourselves- but attend because we have fallen short, we have sinned, ARE sinners, and rejoice in the blessing that though Jesus Christ our sins are forgiven and gather to praise God. Me and my family have been attending Hope since 1995. We were hurting and broken when showed up that morning. We were received with open arms and a lot of love. There is not another church I would rather attend than at Hope. Very sound doctrine is preached and taught there. I've been attending Hope for 15+ years. We are a small group, but we're mighty!

The goal is to "make God famous".

Come join us on Sunday mornings at 10:30am It was so awesome to meet the VBS team and receive decorations for my church to use. I hope we can share in projects for the next year. This is a great church family who loves God. They have a drive in service Sunday at 9 AM.

name: Hope Community Church of Anaheim (Hope CCA) - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church with genuine people. Everyone feels like family here. The worship team is truly the best of any church I’ve ever gone to: high production value without feeling superficial or forced. Definitely recommend Hope CCA! This is a small but powerful church.  They have a worship team that brings you closer to the spirit by song and faith, while the pastor (Greg) is witty with his words and is amazing at bringing the message home.  His love for his brothers and sisters of God is quite evident and welcoming all to his church.  His wife (Penny) is an amazing vessel of faith who is inspirational with her messages as well.  They do not pretend to be better than anyone else and make anyone feel part of their family, whether they are a pillar of society or someone fighting addiction or shelter.

We recently moved out of state and truly miss this church, and it's flock.  We only hope that we find half the church in our new surroundings.   This will always be home for us. Love the people, the dynamic preaching, and powerful worship!!  The free coffee’s good too :) You are definitely welcomed to the church always.If you listen to one of their sermons before you go to bed,you will definitely be reminded of God's love and and fall asleep very fast. We ❤ U Greg and Penny! Tge best church ive ever been too. No matter who you are or what you believe, you are welcomed

name: Hope Covenant Church
reviewSummary:
I can’t tell you what a relief it was to find a church like Hope.
After growing up and participating in larger churches I felt it was time to bring my family to a church that was more family and community focused.

The reason we decided to stay was every week my wife and I would walk away with so much to discuss about the sermon and what we learned. Pastor Jon is always trying his best to teach the word as accurately as he can manage, which I really respect. And his sermons always focus on compassion and empathy for the marginalized.

I finally feel like I have a church that cares about the world and the disenfranchised as much as I do!

Worship is much more intimate, usually just a guitar, piano and singers. So if you really connect with simplicity in worship this is your spot! If you like a big overproduced worship set, maybe not for you.

This is an awesome place to raise a family. There are even toys and activities at the back of the sanctuary if you prefer to be able to watch your child while you listen to the sermon.

If you are looking for a COMMUNITY, we would love for you to come join us, you have a place here and I’m beyond thankful God led me to this church! me & my children went here for a little while.
it seems people here (including the pastor) are really unaccepting and judgemental towards “new members”. especially young women with children. As soon as so walked into Hope, I noticed a table with crayons, dolls and cars in the back of the sanctuary. I was used to dropping my kids off in the kids room at other churches, and appreciated the idea that I could worship and learn WITH them, and truly model for the what Sunday participation looks like. I had two yr old at the time who played with the cars and made vroom noises. I would shush him in an effort to be polite in a new church, but I was told that it was fine. This concept was so new to me, but I really needed it. Motherhood is so much work and to go someplace where you don’t have to worry as much about your kids allowed me to relax on another level. After the service, Pastor Jon introduced himself and his response to my apologies about the vroom vrooms during his sermon. He immediately replied “Jesus said let the children come” and realized I was someplace special.
The community is small, you’ll recognize similar faces each week, and you’ll notice that it is a true community unlike some churches where there seems to be categories of people in charge, and people who attend. This is not like that at all. I don’t actually know the details and I’m not a full member but I can say that the handful of times we’ve been, it appears that the church is more like a very large family. It seems that everyone pitches in, maybe doing a reading, or bringing donuts for the cafe social hour after service, or helping in the kids rooms, or even playing music for worship.
It’s a very diverse population as well, as small as it is, it’s far from homogeneous and alll ages and all socioeconomic backgrounds. I’m unsure how they pull it off haha. But it’s beautiful and I appreciate that for my kids.
I felt the need to share my experience in case there’s another tired mama like me out there who wants to worship, and wants community, and misses their kids because they’re at daycare all week and appreciates the idea that church could be a place where you can spend more quality time with them in the company of so many welcoming people.
If you’re on a journey to find your church home, I’m praying for you and with you 🙏🏽 Your community is out there. Starting going to that church around 1960. My father and I use to take turns ringing the bells in the tower( no longer there I see) on Sunday's. Back then it was called The Methodist Church, then First United Methodist Church. I still remember Reverend Leatherman.Got married there in 1976 by Reverend Dripps. Just thinking of all the good times. Back when living in Orland was pretty much like watching episodes of Leave it to Beaver. Great time's, the best. I hope not much has changed. Got a little nostalgic, good for the heart and soul. A big hello goes out to all the Mr. Ed's IGA alumni. Bless us all. It is a good place where our pastors and members are focused on social justice and building community while allowing for, and working through, differences in theology.

name: Hope Covenant Church - Huntersville Campus
reviewSummary:
After hearing the Lord tell us we needed to move churches (we were driving to Matthews) and to connect with other families in our area we began visiting all of the churches close to our Huntersville home. We liked the churches but one thing was very evident, when you attend a church that has so many people there are 2-4 services you go in, sit and listen, and leave. There was no connection and it felt like being hurded in and out with a few quick hello's and smiles. My husband and I both were unsure and feeling a bit discouraged because we knew the Lord was moving us. We happened to come across Hope Covenant on a google search at 8:00 on a Sunday morning in March of 2025 and decided well lets give it a try. God is so good because the moment we walked through the doors with our 3 children we both felt like we were home. Everyone was so welcoming and genuinely interested in who we were and things about our family. Then worship begins and the anointing and presence of the Lord was amazing. I cried through the entire worship set. Pastor Adam gets up to preach and God just kept confirming this is where I have called you to be. My husband and I both knew it. I am naturally an introverted person so its unusual for me to immediately want to sign up for groups especially with new people but one of the youth pastors announced that His family would be hosting the family life group the next day. I knew we had to get connected and attend the life group so immediately after service I went straight to those pastors and got my family signed up. We have never gone to another church since that Sunday in March of 2025 and we are so thankful that God has brought us to this church family. We have created some wonderful friendships with other families and we love coming each week to Sunday service, discipleship classes, and life group. There is something powerful and special about a church that isn't on a tight schedule and allows the lord to speak and move and have encounters with his people. Worship is aways so beautiful, powerful and anointed. I always sense the Lords presence while singing praises to our Lord and the preaching isn't a tickle your ears message. God is dong amazing things here and he's calling others to come and experience his love and power through fellowship, worship and preaching. I hope you will come and experience the same pure and genuine love and fellowship of Gods children as we gather together to worship our savior. I have been attending this church for several months now. The worship and the Word of God that is preached is so impactful. The worship band is incredible.

The best way to describe it is the water is clean here. There is  fellowship with new friends and a community of people that truly love one another. We are growing and it’s wonderful to see all these new young families added to the church as well as all age believers. Truly a multi generational church. Friendly Welcoming Loving Kind  Church  Connect Groups 2 times a month Pray once a month Thursday night 7 Pm  Discipleship and Mentoring Classes Free Wednesday Nights 7 Pm  Sunday  Fellowship Starts at 10 Am 1030 AM Worship Starts Children s Church Pastor Adam And his wife Elizabeth Lead Worship Very Anointed Couple  Pastor Adam Allows the Holy Spirit to move in words of Knowledge and the Prophetic he is  heartfelt and sincere. If your looking for a Family Church and love to serve  and help in anyway in ministry    Hope Covenant is a people oriented church with the desire to see people free, filled, and flowing with God's Spirit, Power, and Vision.
This would be the Church for you Be Blessed Psalm 91 Pastors Adam and Liz are dynamic servants and worship leaders for the Kingdom. It has been a privilege to be along side them at various locations, and to now be a part of their ministry. Hope Covenant is a people oriented church with the desire to see people free, filled, and flowing with God's Spirit, Power, and Vision. What a lovely and friendly church! Come as you are to this small Church full of love and welcoming. The music is spirit filled and so inspiring, and the message from the pastor is heartfelt and sincere. I promise you will feel welcome here.

name: Hope Evangelical Covenant Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Hope has been my family's church since we moved to Indianapolis eight years ago. We've found community and lifelong friends. Pastor John preaches truth and encouragement from the Word of God. The contemporary music (mixed with occasional hymns) is worshipful and connects me to Jesus each week. Today we had a good time at Hope Evangelical Covenant Church for our pastors gathering. Pastor Johnny Aho did a great job of hosting us. It was a really nice environment. Smaller church where you can get to know people. Really good worship team and music. Very friendly and welcoming people. Pastor has very good messages and is a very down to earth guy. They also stream their services. Beautiful church.  Love the women's groups! Open for Sunday worship.  Still in the Saving business!!

name: Hope Fellowship
reviewSummary: Reviews consistently describe the vibe as 'relaxed' and 'come as you are.' The 'no dress code' culture is a major plus for new visitors. The 'Growth Track' and small groups are cited as easy on-ramps for community. Preaching is described as 'topical' and 'relatable' rather than deep theology. Great for those burnt out on traditional religion.

name: Hope Fellowship Church
reviewSummary:
Constantly spamming me with unsolicited mailings. If they were true followers of Christ, they'd take the money they waste on spam letters and spend it on feeding the hungry. Absolutely shameful behavior. Got connected to this church a couple of decades ago through my home church near Dallas, Tx and it continues to be my church home away from home whenever I can get up to the Boston area.  The church leadership makes a big effort to serve the community so it is not simply about coming to a sermon on a Sunday.  There are many who have come through Hope, serve, and gone on to start other churches or lead in other ways throughout the city.  That is the way it should be!  It is an outward focus about reaching as many with the Gospel as possible.

I always feel so welcomed there and if you are reading this and trying to find a Bible-believing, Bible-teaching church where you can be known and encouraged to you use own gifts and strengths to serve God and the community... I highly recommend giving them a try.  Just a short walk from Porter Square.  If that is too far for you depending on where you live in Boston, they can also gladly help you find somewhere closer to you.  I pray this little review helps you in your journey. Great experience from music and teaching to community activities and resources to help families attend and be a part of the main service Great Church I was invited there thank you, I enjoyed it because everything was very friend from the time you step in the door you could tell there was a lot of thought put into the service.  People greeting you coffee and snacks to give you energy for the service.  Wow and full band on stage to sing with and all the words on screen.  Last but not least the Pastor was great he explained the sermon so well I felt I learn so much it was great.  Thank You Hope Fellowship Church. One of my absolute favorite places on the whole entire earth. Wonderful, warm people that love Jesus. Messages are full of grace and truth and very comfortable.

name: Hope Fellowship Church - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary: The service was nice. The message was great and really spoke to my husband and I but to be honest, the church was not very welcoming. 1 person talked to us. A lot of people looked at us, a few people smiled but other than the kind older gentleman, no one made an effort to get to know us. We are actively looking for a home church as we are new to the area but sadly did not feel welcome. PLEASE consider having a different style of music - not everyone likes the kind that you offer... it's like a rock sound..... while I like Christian rock to a fault, i.e. contemporary music... a more praise and worship style like Hillsongs, for example, like seen in so many modern churches, also mixed with a bit of traditional hymns would be nice too.  My husband and I liked Hope Fellowship and went several times, but honestly the music was a big turn off, as it matters a lot in making a decision for a home church......... whoever is in charge of the music, with all due respect, please respect the fact that not everyone likes your rock style of music.. there needs to be more of a variety.... Really appreciate the church for watching my son while I go to Celebrate Recovery at The Pointe church.  Has really been a blessing and change my life and make me a better person and father The presence of God , that's the best way to put it in words. You can feeling all over that place  . Wonderful Church that is Experiencing God in a Powerful way

name: Hope International Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: I am so happy to meet up teachers and kids at New Hope international Church after pandemic. Teaching art class at Sunday school gives me a joy and happiness. I am so blessed, and I will treasure it for a long, long time. This church is amazing!My life has totally changed ,and I grow up from the Bible words.ITS like my second home.The elder Hank is amazing,the paster LI is so humourous.we all love him.Thank God.God is amazing. When I came here for the first time, the pastor's family was singing and everyone was very enthusiastic. Friendly A wonderful Chinese church! My happiest time of the week is coming to church to sing hymns and praises.

name: Hope is Alive Church
reviewSummary:
Hope Is Alive is not just a building in Pioneer Square; it's a community of brothers and sisters from all walks of life who have found everlasting hope in Jesus Christ. Please come and join on a Sunday morning, you'll encounter the presence of the Lord and receive a fresh Word of encouragement. This church has really helped me grow in my faith.  God's word flows out of the doors and on to the streets of Seattle.  The mustard seeds are planted.  We are all a big family just like God has made us to be.  I love Hope is Alive church. Small Church doing great things with their outreach providing

food for the homeless and community.  The pastor
is passionate about bringing people to Christ.  Everyone is very welcoming and the music is upbeat. If you are looking for a Holy Spirit filled church in Pioneer Square, then you’ve found the right place! I love Hope Is Alive church. I feel the presence of God tangibly in each service. The people are welcoming and you can truly just come as you are. Lots of churches say “come as you are” but this place really lives by that. I love this church and the people who attend.

name: Hope Jersey City - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary:
My family was warmly greeted when we visited, offered coffee and a bagel, and met some really nice people.

The music was well done and obviously heart-felt.  The message was Bible-based and spoke to me personally.

You will not go wrong visiting here. This church has been such a sweet blessing being new to the neighborhood. Pastor Craig and his wife Kaitlyn are dedicated to challenging us spiritually and thoughtful about building community among a diverse group of young professionals, couples, young families, and those across all walks of life. You see a lot of welcoming folks here and people who want to be part of kingdom work. I have known Craig (lead pastor) and his wife Kaitlyn for a couple of years now. They are a wonderful couple and have a heart for Jersey City. The teaching is doctrinally sound and the message of Jesus and renewal is clear. Pastor Craig and his wife Kaitlyn are two of the most genuine people we've met. They want to connect to the Jersey City community and will make a huge impact! A very positive place extremely supportive team great people and well thought out system to help and serve community.

name: Hope Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I moved to LA two years ago from India with my family. We came across GethsemaneLA on our first Sunday in US. We fell in love with the church and the people here. We have been attending this church since then. If you are looking for a Lutheran church who follow the Bible without compromises then you will love this church. People are awesome here and they are so friendly that you will not miss home. Pastor my wife and I want to thank you verry much for really being a blessing  to our lives in the time of need. Im grateful to see there is still men of God that step out and help families that are in need. Our light is shining back in our home. I know GOD will bless you in return. May you continue to be a," watch tower " to our community. God bless you.
Joe&Veronica Awesome church and congregation.  Pastor Steve is great and this is a wonderful Christian family.  I encourage anyone to stop in and check out Sunday worship. Beautiful church and the people are great! Highly recommend! Awesome and welcoming community!

name: Hope Lutheran Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going to this church for almost five years.  We were looking for an affirming church.  Even though this church is an Evangelical Lutheran Churches of America church it is far from affirming or progressive. During my time here they have never held a same sex marriage ceremony or celebrated Pride Week. You definitely won’t see a rainbow flag or poster either inside or out.
The pastor, Dan Cole, is progressive, but he is only an interim pastor and has received quite a bit of resistance to any moves to become more welcoming.
I am not saying Hope is a bad church.  It is certainly more ambivalent than most churches in the Temecula Valley, but ambivalence is not the same as welcoming, is it?
If you decide to attend Hope just know what you are getting into.  This is a don’t ask/don’t tell church, with a small intrenched core group of members that is very resistant to any changes that would make it more progressive. Hope Lutheran is a welcoming and friendly congregation.   You get what you put into your experience at HLC, and everyone is willing to walk with you along your journey.  Pastor Sandy is a great leader of our church that is devoted to her congregation.  All are Welcome and are appreciated along with encouraged to grow in there faith.  The facility is really beautiful and the church has a preschool and kindergarten.  Feel free to join us and worship on Sunday either at 8AM or 10:15AM. We are an RIC church and are welcoming to ALL! Excellent school, and excellent teachers!!! ❤️

name: Hope Lutheran Church-Hollywood - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Proud member of the church. We cook full meals almost every week for fellowship after service. Beautiful service with upbeat music(concert style). Amazing new Pastor. Come check us out. Yet another "affirming" church that's lukewarm on the teachings of Christ and the deposit of faith. As long as people aren't offended though, right? HOME Safe is currently utilizing this space as their home offices are being renovated. Hope a Lutheran is a lovely church with large childcare and rec facilities. My daughter loves the little playground and makes herself right at home when we visit. Wich is refreshing since she's picky about new people places things. Thank you HLC for sharing your space with us! 5Stars! Haven't been there in 30 years... Other folks I knew weren't there. Pastor HK passed away and his son, pastor Mark has retired. But the people I met were still warm and welcoming. Still a great church Love this place. The service is fun and informative. The lunch serviced after service is always delicious. The people are great. Come check us out Sunday music service starts at 10:30. Hope to see you there.

name: HOPE OF GLORY PRESBYTERIAN CHURCH - Brea Campus
Hope Protestant Reformed Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: The worship services here are solemn, respectful, and thoroughly grounded in scripture.  The preaching is Reformed, hailing back to the Protestant Reformation which was characterized by a return to scripture, and a focus on salvation by grace alone, faith alone, and in Christ alone.  Very God glorifying.  The members are welcoming and approachable, making it easy for a visitor to come and worship. Great preaching and wonderful congregation My place to go for worshipping my God I go there every Sunday, and it's a good experience. They are encouragers

name: Hope United Methodist Church - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church and it's support for the "Green Team" which works for racial, social, climate justice, and more.  We also have an awesome kids program!!! I live in the Midwest, but have visited annually because both parents and siblings lived in Aurora. I've always found this church both spiritual & friendly, & I recommend it. This is a great church. Today's sermon was on Persistence. A great message. -how God can change your life with persistence. Also a gym on Pokeman Go. I've gone to this church sense I was born and it has an amazing community ❤ I really don't know anything about the church. I am Catholic and there seems to be a huge difference.

name: Hope United Methodist Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Attended a funeral service. Very personable staff. Outatanding service. My friend, who is a congregate, really likes the pastor. Great children, youth, and high school programs. Meaningful Saturday night and Sunday morning services with amazing music. Friendly congregation. In the interest of complete transparency, I'm the Scoutmaster for the Troop affiliated with Hope United Methodist Church. That said, the Church has been a terrific sponsor, and has worked very hard with us to allow in person meetings now that the pandemic is easing up. Made our first visit tonight to see the Christmas performance. The church was full of happiness and beautiful music. A wonderful experience. Amazing place! The people here are really nice and open to races. They even have a 10:45 for pre-K through youth.

name: Hope United Methodist Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: He is genuine and compassionate approach instantly put me at ease. The love spell he cast brought harmony and passion back into my relationship. His accurate predictions and insightful guidance have helped me make crucial decisions. Ram ji psychic readings were outstanding, revealing details about my life that no one else could know. His love spell worked miraculously for me and reunited me with my soulmate. His love spell worked wonders for me and brought back my lost love.

name: Hope Unlimited Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this Church. I have been coming here for about a year and a half.
There are services at 10 am 11:30 am then a Spanish service at 2pm.  There are life groups. Children and youth services as well. Online or walk-in.. Our first visit was Resurrection Sunday 2018. It is my wife’s grandmothers home church. We LOVED IT!! We regularly attend a church in Pomona. Grandma had been to our church many times so we attended hers. The worship songs were great, the message was great, straight from scripture. I would highly recommend this church, VERY welcoming, God loving people. 🙂 The gospel of grace unadulterated. Amazing kids ministry. Lovely ushers. They even have a coffee shop and we tried the hazelnut cold brew and it was delish! 🔥✝️LOVE THIS CHURCH!✝️🔥

HOPE UC IS AMAZING!

If you live in the area and are looking for a new church to call home, come check out HOPE UC.

I originally was going to Hillsong LA for the past 2 years and while it was an awesome church and experience, it never really felt like home for me. It would be a 30+ minute drive and although I didn’t really mind, I wanted a place I could call HOME.

So I did some searching and low and behold I found HOPE UC! I’ve been coming here now for the past 6 months or so and I love it! It’s a newly renovated building and is truly epic when you walk in for the first time.

The worship team is also amazing! I love sitting as close as possible to enhance my worship and church experience. :D

Pastor Rob and Pastor Justin always bring the fire as well with incredible messages week in and week out.

If you’re still reading this and you’ve been searching for a church that you can truly call HOME, stop by this Sunday. As of writing this review... church is held Sunday’s @10am / @12pm in English and @2pm in Spanish.

See you on Sunday!🔥🙌🙏 Such a great place to worship. The pastors there are genuine and sincere. The services are an hour long. It's a place where all the needles stuff it left out and only the good stuff is left in. I love it.

name: Hope Valley Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
The people at Hope Valley are genuinely caring and sincere, and we are proud to call it our church home. Pastor Andrew and his family have shown our family and so many others true love and kindness.

We especially appreciate that the church remains firmly grounded in the Bible. The leadership consistently reflects the values they teach. Lead Pastor David Hermes has been a wonderful example of that. From the very beginning, he was welcoming and encouraging, and it is clear that the pastors here truly live out what they preach.

We feel very grateful to be part of this community. My family has been coming to Hope Valley for over a year. I truly appreciate the community and genuine care that everyone shows to each other. I appreciate leaderships openness to conversations about hard topics (biblical interpretation, personal lives, questions, support, etc) as well as discussing topics in sermons I haven’t normally heard in church before. For the size of the church, the children’s ministry has a lot of kids and the church prioritizes making sure children have the resources they need to thrive. When we first started attending, it was easy to get connected and involved. I appreciate our church and everyone who attends. Moving to Denver was a big transition for me, and finding Hope Valley Church has honestly been such a blessing! The people here have been kind, welcoming, and easy to connect with, which made getting plugged in feel a lot less intimidating.

I also really love the classes and midweek Bible studies. They’ve given me a space to cultivate community while continuing to grow in my walk with Christ.

You can tell this is a church that truly cares about people, faith, and serving the community. Really grateful I found this place, and it’s definitely worth checking out ❤️. A friend of mine had visited Hope Valley and said to me, Rhonda, I think I found a church that you would like. She said she thought it was “the place” I was looking for. I visited and I will tell you the first thing that touched, my heart, sincerely, was the diversity of the people in attendance, not just the people sitting in the congregation, but the staff. When you find a church that has a truly diverse staff, then you know that they truly celebrate all people and love them the way that God has asked us too. And then that was what was next, experiencing a group of people who truly love the Lord! And it shows in the way that they love each other and love those of us who were coming even for the first time. I have been part of the Hope Valley family for, I believe, five years now and that has not changed. If you want to be a part of a group of people who truly live the way that Daddy God wants us too, then Hope Valley is the place for you. No church is perfect. Please understand that. However, there are churches that strive to continually grow to be the best they can be and my experience leads me to say Hope Valley is one of them. My family and I have loved this church since the first day we set foot in the building over two years ago. From the enthusiastic youth pastor to the warm greeters and kind pastor and all the people we've met since—this place has felt like home since day 1. We are a diverse congregation filled with people who are willing to be real with each other even in our initial conversations, even in small pockets of time on Sunday mornings. A true answer to prayer!

name: Hopeland Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Shawn and his Wife, Crystal Gayle, care about their community and church members. This is a welcoming church. I appreciate their worship and prayer teams. Awesome Worship. Great Teaching of The Word Of The Lord. The Holy Spirit Is In This Place And All The People Within. Pastor Shawn Mandoli Knows The Lord's Scripture and Teaches it With A Pleasing And Spirit Filled Style That All Who Know Jesus Christ can Understand. His Wife and the Worship Team Prepare the room for The Word Of The Lord to Touch the Hearts and Minds of all who can see and hear. Blessed to be part of Hopeland Church and to be part of God's family. Pastor Shawn and pastor CG are one of a kind. Big hearted, Humble, loving and obedient to the holy spirit!!! Great church.  Just walking to it, I felt unsafe since 2 bull-dogs were not on a leash, so they scared me to death.  African American 7 ft man, was refusing to watch his dogs. It created a scary event for me, because I am deathly allergic to all dogs, and he was really rude to me calling me bad names. Hip, smart and kind pastors who  try to make everyone feel welcome. Outgoing members and serve team. Very giving to the surrounding community. Lovers and emulators of Jesus Christ.

One star off for not being strong in the prophetic (at least not when I was there).

name: Horizon Central CityWay Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: I just wanted to add a brief message. This was the church I grew up going to, and although I haven't been the most frequent visitor, I will always fondly remember it. I will always remember pastor Dave, and I will always remember Rick. Although I never remember his surname, Rick was the lead singer/guitarist for the church band back in the early 2000's, he was really my first exposure to rock music, and for that I'm grateful; that and he was just a really wholesome guy. I remember not wanting to go to Sunday School because I was a pretty shy kid, so I would sit in with my parents and the rest of the adults, I thought I was mature enough to listen to the scripture instead. Every Sunday after church there would be cookies and lemonade, like clockwork. It was a good environment, with a healthy sense of community. I'm thankful to have gone there. When I moved to Indianapolis to go to grad school wanted to get plugged in with the church soon as possible. I immediately felt like I fit in with the congregation (everyone was very friendly and genuine and they did a ton of outreach). I just loved Pastor Dave and the way he preached on God's word. I resonated with and really loved the music team and felt very connected with the praise and worship. I loved the church and certainly felt the church loving me back. I love the people here. Pastor Dave Kosowbucki is a wonderful teacher and his wife Ginger are sincere wonderful God loving folks. BIBLE is studied... chapter by chapter, verse by verse.  Kids Inc. is also a wonderful outreach for teenagers here too check it out!!. Praise Jesus for this place in Fountain Square !! These people will change your life. They've helped us time and time again. Literally a second home, except more comfortable and caring. Great people to be with.

reviewSummary: Picturesque North County church providing solid expository preaching, Christ-centered classical education, and an expansive global mission network.

reviewSummary: Picturesque North County church providing solid expository preaching, Christ-centered classical education, and an expansive global mission network.

name: Horizon Community Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: I have  been  there  two weeks  now,  and I  really  enjoyed it. I love the sermon  that  the pastor  preached,  love  the music. Still learning  more about God,  he will always be in my life. We came to Cincinnati to see my daughter for her birthday and went to church with her and her husband. Very nice church and their service was very enjoyable. Great church staff and ministers, great for kids, 2 types of services Equiping for believers and contemporary for new and beginning believers, awesome music A vibrant, non-denominational church focused on the glory of Jesus Christ. Sermons are thematically organized and skillfully intermingle scripture with contemporary, real-life experiences. Music can be cacophonous at times, but is well done. Church and grounds are well-maintained. All are welcomed, souls are lifted and God is praised! Best church that I have ever attended! Always feels like home. Great music, great people. Good solid Bible teaching for people well along their faith journey, no judgment for those beginning their journey. Quietly inclusive, is how I would describe it. Still a predominantly Caucasian congregation, with Hillsong United, or Jesus Culture style worship rather than Kirk Franklin style. Expository style preaching in the equipping service with good Moody Bible Institute trained pastor. Beautiful grounds and comfortable place to grow in your faith. If there's anything bad to say, it's probably that it's difficult to get engaged with people as small groups tend to be invitation only and crowds on Sundays are a bit "transient"...here for a service and then gone.

name: Horizon Community Church - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome band and music! Pastor presents great material and application! Everyone is very friendly and it’s always a great time! Horizon does a great job of celebrating Jesus and cultivating community in church and out in our workplaces, cities, etc. If you’re reading this review I would recommend this church to you. Horizon Community Church has helped me get connected and involved in community during my first year of college! They continue to be a consistent resource of support and seek to serve others in unique ways! Friendly people, great teaching and contemporary worship music.

name: Horizon Presbyterian Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a hidden gem! The people are warm and welcoming, and the messages are relevant. I love that they have five different teaching pastors, all of whom are excellent communicators. After attending a large church for many years, this is a breath of fresh air. Bonus: the music is really nice, and services are an hour from start to finish. Wonderful Church! We loved visiting Horizon Presbyterian Church today! Great church that loves God and loves its community. Great worship and incredible pastors that teach the Bible each Sunday in practical and interesting sermons. Exciting children’s and youth activities. Very welcoming. I recently moved to Phoenix with my wife and kids and was looking for a church to call home. This place is welcoming, loving and warm. My kids now go to youth group at horizon presbyterian Church and are having a blast! This is the most friendly, loving group of people you will ever meet. They are a growing community looking for people to join this exciting fellowship.

name: Hosea Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
Hosea started right before Covid. Up and downs trying to navigate and get their get under them.   Now,  it's a strong growing church that started with a college or young family focus that parlayed into a multi-generational church that has no racial divide. Great preaching,  great music,  and an inviting time of prayer.   If I was looking for a place to connect and find solid friends who love God, this is the place!  It's been 8 months and love it. I love Hosea Church! I recently moved to Raleigh and quickly found a home here. Hosea preaches truth from the Bible and the community truly lives it out! It has been a safe place for me to grow in my relationship with God, specifically in my small group— I have never felt more loved by a group of people before. I would recommend this church to anyone! Hosea has a very special place in my heart. I have experienced being loved immensely by the people here at Hosea, and I have also been deeply challenged. I came to Hosea thinking I was a follower of Jesus. Boy was I wrong.

If you want to sit in on a service, listen to feel-good preaching, slip out the back of the building after it's over and avoid talking to people just to check off your cultural Christian box so you can feel better about yourself and skirt accountability, Hosea is NOT the place for you. If you're curious about who God is, if you're hurting and need support, if you want to join others in worshipping Jesus, and if you actually want to grow by listening to convicting Bible-based teaching, then Hosea IS the place for you.

The people at this church love Jesus, and they're not afraid of showing it. I dare you to come on a Sunday; you won't look back. We also have free donuts and coffee! I’ve found Hosea to be a very loving and intentional community, who are all devoted to growing closer to Jesus! The teachings are Biblical, Gospel-centered, and applicable!
The most growth I’ve found is being in a Small Group - highly recommend, even though it may be uncomfortable at first.
10/10 After lots of searching, I can confidently say Hosea is hands down the most authentic, communal, and Jesus-driven church I have ever attended. If you're looking for a church to grow spiritually at with other sold-out believers, whose hearts are steadfast on the Lord, then get here Sunday. This House is special!

name: House Church Tulsa - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: A dear friend brought me today and I really enjoyed it! Solid preaching and great fellowship! We had a delicious pot luck meal also which a nice bonus! I really enjoyed the service and met some awesome people! I will be back! Amazing people here. The worship and the pastor's message is always great, but what makes this place so special is its heart of acceptance and its TRUE love for people no matter where they come from, or what they look like, or how much money they make, or, or, or... the real diversity that exists there is a screenshot of the truest of churches which we will all be a part of someday.  House Church is a home for all. My family and I feel so comfortable and spiritually fed. We love our church family Wonderful people, very friendly and inviting. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming

name: House of Faith Bay Area Church - Hayward Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been going House of faith for 10 years now and look forward to another 10 pastor Ray is a good man and cares for everybody in the church. Pastor is a man who cares for everybody We’ve known Pastor Ray for over 12 years and have been coming to House of Faith for over two years now. Ever since God placed us here we’ve witnessed nothing but blessings. My own marriage and family was restored! We’ve seen many other testimonies just pouring out their hearts and blessing others. Very thankful to God for placing an anointed shepherd to lead his sheep and hold them accountable when they go astray. I've been part of House of Faith church for about five years. Pastor Ray and Sis Mila have been a blessing not only in my life but also my marriage and my family. I was traveling from Tracy to church every Sunday until finally God opened a door for our family to move 2 minutes away from church. I will continue to attend HoF with my husband and children. It is a place where we receive love and support from our church family. If you're looking for a place to grow in relationship with Jesus and have a life long family that you can fellowship with you have found a home church with us!! I have nothing but gratitude towards House of Faith Church
I’ve been Knowing Pastor Ray for 25+ years. I have been attending church for about 3 years and got saved shortly after attending. Before coming to this church, I was an alcoholic, weed smoker, etc.. I’ve been clean & sober for Over 2 1/2 years. I couldn’t have done it if it wasn’t for my Little Big Brother Pastor reaching out to me, I regret not attending his church earlier. God definitely put him In my life for a reason! Since joining the church I became a Dad for a second time. Pastor Ray and his wife Mila has always been nothing but a wonderful blessing to my new family They have provided formulas, diapers, household items that we still used to this day! If you want a life-changing experience, please visit our church “House of Faith” and be ready to received the Spirit with open Arms!!! I am blessed to be part of house of faith and to be sober for 2 years, Faithfully serving in children's ministry and an usher . God delivered me from alcohol addiction. Pastor Ray and sister Mila have been a big blessing in my life. When God blessed me with a new home. They came over and blessed me with gifts for my new place and pray over my house. Pastor Ray and sister Mila are an amazing giving couple they always look out for other people in need. God has been good to me , I will continue to stay faithful and be greatful for everything he has done for me . I have known pastor Ray for many years. God has changed his life all around and is a man of God. I want to thank pastor Ray and sister Mila and the church for always been there by my side praise God and I give him all the glory thank you Jesus 🙏. I use to be in gangs and selling drugs been shot and stab in the heart twice and stab in the head. And in and out of jails, hospital's, and prison. But God changed my life around. If your living the lifestyle I use to live I encourage you to give God a try this is something you will never regret thank you House of faith.

name: House of Glory Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I are SO THANKFUL God led us to House of Glory! It’s truly been life-changing!! We encounter God’s love, power, and his tangible presence every service. We have received so much healing and freedom. I love that the Truth is preached without compromise and all is fully led by the Holy Spirit. Worship is incredible and we get to take our time to TRULY minister to the Lord and go DEEP into His glory. Apostle Cathy is such a gift from God! She exudes the love of Jesus and models what it is to walk in joyful holiness. She is excellent in her ability to teach and equip us in spiritual warfare and knowing our identity in Christ. EVERY service, miracles, healing, prophecy, and deliverance happen!🔥 We have been there for 4 years now and can’t wait to get to church each time. House of Glory is family and I love that we get to do life together! I hope you come join us too!🙏 💯💯💯💯House of Glory! Come encounter the Glory of God! A place where you find rest with like minded children of God! Come drink from the living water as Apostle Coppola teaches Sound Doctrine! Apostle teaches with love, compassion, joy biblical truth, and is no nonsense Woman of God! Filled with love for people! Apostle carries the FIRE of God in peace and strength! I thank Yahweh for Apostle Coppola, the House of Glory and the entire team that serve diligently. So come, find rest come be filled. You will receive and be touched by the living God in the name of Jesus! I love letting others know about what The Lord has done in my life, however I would like to tell a little something about where He has placed me. It's called The House of Glory and its owner is not only The Lord's but it's also Apostle Cathy Coppola's !! She is The most Incredible teacher of Our Father!! She is Anointed so much that it overflows.
The Lord our God has upgraded her to a bigger church. Yes, we will be moving, starting April 3rd, 2025. It's still in Lake Forest, just a different location.
Apostle has been in Ministry for 16 yrs in May. The Lord gave her a name for her church 8 years ago, and it was called The House of Glory. She will start her 9th year in a New church.
I am so blessed that God placed me in her church. I was accepted the moment I stepped in. It is so filled with Love and Joy, it is so contagious. It awesome. She loves children and she loves to all ages come in. We are a family, God has chosen each one of us. I serve The Lord first and foremost and I also serve Apostle.  I am truly honored to be part of her ministry. She loves Our Father God 1st.
I encourage all to come to The House of Glory. It is a Church that does Healing and Deliverance.  And alot of prayer. You can get hands on prayer or healing. Sometimes, you are just in your seat and still get touched by God.  You come in one way, but wow, you will never be the same when you walk out the door.  You can feel His presence as soon as you walk through that threshold.  And if you love to worship, we'll you have come to the right place. There is music and prayer, and most of all, you get to hear the word. Teaching is incredible, Apostle teaches you to actually feel like you are right there step by step with Jesus.  And shares the Truth of Jesus.
If you Believe and have Faith, The Mountains will move.  Jesus said He has not given you a spirit of fear, but of Power Love and a sound mind!! If you are reading this review, I ask that you come with an open heart with expectancy as you will see what God will do for you.
The love that Apostle has is so huge that  she has so much to give, and yes, she wants to share everything that God has given her.
So please come and receive and we here at The House of Glory would love to meet you. I know if you need prayer, Healing or Deliverance,  Apostle would love to pray for you!!
God Bless Everyone!! Thank you for reading this review.
Also, she has The Fired Up Conference in September. She also does Water Baptism's.
Once you are Touched by God, you will never be the same.
He loves you, cares for you. He will Never Leave You nor Forsake you!! He died on the Cross for not just our sins, but He shed His Blood for us so we could have everlasting life.  Amen and Amen!!
He is a Good and Gracious God!!
Apostle loves to worship Our Father God!! It's so beautiful to see. So the last picture is our Church Family, but not all could make it.
May The Lord  Bless Each one of you!! House of Glory with Apostle Cathy Coppola has blessed my life so much in this last year. I've experienced the healing power of God in my body and soul. I have felt the love of God strongly at every gathering. House of Glory is a place to be touched by the power and presence of God. Jesus is still doing miracles today through his believers and you will find true believers walking in the power of Christ at House of Glory. Apostle Cathy ministers so graciously and you will be touched and receive from the Lord. You will find fiery love, passion and devotion to Christ and beautiful, loving people who will embrace and welcome you. Apostle Cathy’s teaching will teach you to walk in the authority Jesus gives you when you surrender to Christ. The Holy Spirit is so beautifully present every time. Praise God! Be blessed! ✝️❤️‍🔥🕊️
