name: House of Glory Ministries, Minnesota
reviewSummary:
Congratulations on your 12 year anniversary!
It was such a wonderful experience today and the opportunity to praise God was beautiful!!!
The array of Pastors that were supporting the anniversary was exceptional!! We were very welcomed and then we had a delicious meal with wonderful fanfare and a very fun way to raise capital for an adventure!   Thank you again and we wish you many years of growth and success with the Lord!!! Amen 🙏🏻 This is a good place of worship. I joined the church in 2010 and I can testify, that there has been a lot of changes in my life. It's such a friendly environment and very welcoming. I will always recommend this place of worship for everyone. So, come and your life will never be the same. Amen!!! 🙏 Great place to worship.  Kind and loving Pastor I enjoy every time I visit this church, they have a really beautiful space for events! Place to worship ,we were there for Thanksgiving service for late Mr Lawrence Kwabi.

name: House of God Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: It is a house of salvation and deliverance. Pastor Vaughn loves his flock and he preaches and teaches the Word of God uncompromisingly. I haven't become a member of this church yet, but I am definitely considering joining the fold. I recommend anyone who is not saved to attend the Thursday night Bible study which usually begins at 6:15 PM with the children's music ministry. Pastor Vaughn, as I stated earlier, preaches the unadulterated Word, and he pulls no punches. If you want get a hold of God that's the place to do it Small church with a lot of spirit. Warm atmosphere and loving members. Some people are wonderful here. This is a amazing church

name: House of Grace San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful for the community we’ve  found at House of Grace. From the moment we stepped foot we were genuinely welcomed and loved. The pastor preachs the Word of God with truth, wisdom, and compassion, and every message encourages spiritual growth and a deeper relationship with Christ.

What makes this church so special is that it’s filled with regular people simply being humbled and willing to be used by God. There’s nothing performative or prideful — just authentic people pursuing Jesus together, loving one another, and serving with open hearts. It’s such an intimate and genuine atmosphere where you truly feel seen, supported, and cared for.

I’ve seen lives transformed, prayers answered, and people truly cared for both inside and outside the church walls.

House of Grace is more than a place to attend on Sundays — it’s a family like community that pours into people spiritually, emotionally, and practically. If you’re looking for a Bible-centered church where you can grow in faith, build meaningful relationships, and feel at home, I highly recommend House of Grace ! My husband toddler and I visited here from out of town. We felt very welcomed from the beginning! We were greeted by multiple people. The worship and sermon was centered on Bible teachings and Jesus Christ, just how it should be! When we come back to San Diego we will be coming back! I am beyond grateful that God led my family to this church, a place we now call home. From the moment we walked in, we felt the love, warmth, and presence of God. I am so thankful for pastors Abraham and Vanessa who genuinely care, pour into you, and walk with you through every season of your journey with Christ. The messages, the life groups, and the fellowship have all been such a blessing and have given me exactly what I had been praying for. This church has strengthened my faith, encouraged my heart, and reminded me of God's goodness in so many ways. I truly thank God for leading me here. House of grace has been nothing short of amazing 🤞🏽 The people, atmosphere, and love for god spreads beautifully!! House of Grace is my home. I serve on the Life Group ministry team here and I am so glad I said yes to God’s invitation here. The message, the people, and the community all make me feel welcome and bring new understanding of God’s grace in my life!

name: House of Joy Christian - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Bishop Todd Oneal led me to Christ years ago. I love his ministry and could not be happier to have been a part of it. In Florida now and still going to church but it will never be the house of joy. A church ministry of Cincinnati, which espouses the Word of God & teaches Christian Principles. The leaders are Bishop Todd O'Neal & wife Pastor Linda O'Neal. If you love music, this is the church: praise songs, gospels, hymns, spirituals, classical songs. A warm welcome atmosphere where know one is treated like a stranger. There are three services available. And young people look forward to being apart of the congregation, come as you are and feel the love with praise and worship 🙏🙏 You can tell the heart of God is there. Want to feel uplifted and inspired? House of Joy always lives up to its name. The new home of HOJ is beautiful. It is well worth the visit . The choir is phenomenal. You will always feel comfortable and welcomed in the House of Joy!

name: House of Praise Evangelical - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Our family has been warmly welcomed to this church since our first visit a few months ago. The main pastor, Ghee Ann Lim, is biblically knowledgeable and insightful and delivers his sermons in a clear, thorough, and engaging manner. He is humble, personable, and warm. My 88 yr old mother attended their Mandarin service today and was very impressed with Pastor Ghee Ann’s preaching and she is not a Christ-follower yet.  Our teenager has connected with peers and has enjoyed attending their Friday night youth ministry led by leaders Joe, Ronnie, and Andrea. We have appreciated experiencing God’s love from other members of this church and look forward to getting to know them better. there is a lot of food and snacks and the people are nice This is a fabulous group of people from 6th Grade through adult. They go on mission trips to Mexico. Bilingual Mandarin Chinese and English Sunday service, weekly fellowships, Bible studies and Prayer meetings

name: House of Prayer - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Cozy friendly church. It's compact but complete. Good place to worship God and hear His Word. I like this church they're very nice people. Great place of worship. Bible base teaching.

name: House of Prayer Lutheran Church, ELCA - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: We use this place for our scrollsaw meetings. Great place to meet. A church is just a church unless it's Grace Chapel Friday Night meetings are the BEST the Word is simple, yet rich and encouraging Nice friendly people.

name: Household of Faith Deliverance Worship Center - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: Bishop and the First Lady  are down to earth.  I am free to worship in this house of the Lord!  So, glad Deacon Roy invited me.  You will know this is the place where the Lord dwells. Thank you Lord! Bishop Michael is an awesome leader that is transparent in the delivery of his message and the demonstration of God's Word. The congregation is authentic in their efforts to embrace you with the love of Christ. It's been a very long time that I seen such a genuine love like that....the worship is off the hook! If you want an encounter with the true and living God then I highly recommend fellowshipping here. The Holy Spirit often takes over service and the congregates don't mind. If you're looking for Jesus and not religion and a true worhip experience then attend immediately. Most welcoming. When in Philadelphia I will definitely go there again. Awesome praise and worship. This is my first time being back and the church service since covid begin and it was a beautiful experience music was outstanding and the church was friendly.

name: Houston's First Baptist Church - Downtown - Houston Campus
reviewSummary: Today, I had the incredible privilege of attending this exceptional local church, and it was an absolute blessing! I was fortunate to witness the UBA Annual Celebration on 11/05/2023, and let me tell you, it was an unforgettable experience. Pastor Leon Brooks and his remarkable team extended a heartfelt, warm welcome that made us feel truly cherished. The entire facility was impeccably clean, reflecting their commitment to excellence. Their generous partnership with UBA showcased their dedication to making a positive impact in the community. If you're in search of a local church that embodies warmth, cleanliness, and generosity, look no further – I wholeheartedly recommend visiting this remarkable location! It's  been long time since been church very long time. This one was it and I will be going this Sunday. I love the service and how they used Bible and stayed on Bible. Excellent prayers as well lover it!! Well where should I begin. This past weekend I delivered pizza to an event held for kids. Every time I delivery here when they order pizza it's always a positive experience and they Very welcoming meaning someone or something that is highly friendly and hospitable, making others feel comfortable and at home. It implies a warmth and kindness that makes people feel accepted and valued. Fantastic church. The layout is pretty modern and inviting. Excited they invested so much money into this campus. I think an important highlight is the diversity of the campus. Its very multi cultural and seemingly inviting to all people which is cool. When Greg Matte preaches at the main campus off the loop then they show it through a screen here. This could be good or bad depending on your take but they have a very kind on campus pastor who is there. Gregg Matte is pretty solid about his preaching and consistent with it as well. To me its a plus we get to share together is listening to him. Overall great. Come join I've never felt so in peace until I came to this church, I feel blessed to have found this location thru a good friend. I absolutely love the sermons that are preach by pastors Greg and Leon, I've learned how to understand the Bible and I've found my true love, Jesus Christ my savior and the holy one who will judge me when my time comes.

name: Houston's First Baptist Church - The Loop - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family loves this church! The Kids Ministry is great for our family and the Special Needs Ministry is unlike anything we've ever experienced. There is so much love at Houston's First.  We appreciate the honesty in preaching and even though it's a large building, we have made deep friendships due to our Life Bible Study Class.  We could not recommend this church more. Oh, and the worship is great! Great place to come and meet very kind people
-worship God
- bring your kids for day preschool program
- visit fitness
- community center
- pick up coffee and Christian books
- and receive care in prayers, healings for your spirit Houston’s First Baptist Church is a wonderful place to worship and grow spiritually. The atmosphere is welcoming, the people are friendly, and the messages are encouraging and Bible-based.
You can really feel the passion for God and for serving the community. The church is organized, family-friendly, and offers great opportunities for people of all ages to connect and grow in faith.
Definitely recommend visiting if you are looking for a church home or a place to hear the Word of God. Went specifically to the library. They have an extensive collection of books and dvds. My son is into veggie tales and we find so many movies and books here! The staff is very friendly and helpful. Shame on you HFBC. I moved from Ohio to join the church because you partner with Living Hope in DFW, a ministry that disciples those who God saved and delivered from practicing any kind of immorality. You've done nothing to help me get settled in, but have only judged me for being homeless. I'm homeless because I moved here without knowing anyone and made the erroneous assumption that you would help me, it is a church after all. You make people busy in the church, and that gives them the illusion that they can wallow in sin and still be alright with the Lord. Not true. Here's what's true: 1 Corinthians 13:2-7 ESV
And if I have prophetic powers, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing. [3] If I give away all I have, and if I deliver up my body to be burned, but have not love, I gain nothing. [4] Love is patient and kind; love does not envy or boast; it is not arrogant [5] or rude. It does not insist on its own way; it is not irritable or resentful; [6] it does not rejoice at wrongdoing, but rejoices with the truth. [7] Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. John 13:34-35 NASB
I am giving you a new commandment, that you love one another; just as I have loved you, that you also love one another. [35] By this all people will know that you are My disciples: if you have love for one another.”

name: Hue.Church - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is welcoming and polite such a good place to be, makes you feel seen and loved, perfect place for worship, the pastor speaks with such confidence and love, makes you feel engaged and you leave inspired HUE Church is a warm and friendly church in Santa Clara, CA where they share the love of God and how God is bringing heaven upon earth (HUE). The church has young adults, seniors and families with kids and they have different activities and groups for all people. I have been blessed to meet the community at this church. The pastors and staff are very welcoming and caring. I would recommend anyone who is exploring faith, seeking peace, looking for spiritual growth and fellowship and wants to learn about the Truth to come visit Hue Church! Fantastic church. My wife and I felt like we belonged as soon as we walked in. Pastor Sam and Pastor Immanuel are phenomenal and stick to the true word of God. HUE Church has been such a blessing to our family! What stands out most is how they make deep spiritual teachings practical and applicable to everyday life. From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with genuine warmth and love - it truly feels like a community, not just a Sunday service.

I'm especially impressed with their children's ministry. My kid actually looks forward to going to church every Sunday, which says a lot! They've got a bouncy house that the kids absolutely love, and they've put so much thought and effort into making faith engaging and fun for the little ones.

What I really appreciate about HUE is that they are contributors and not consumers. This is more than just a place to worship - it's a place to grow, serve, and belong.

If you're searching for a church that focuses on practical teachings and godly upbringing for your children, HUE is the place to be. I highly recommend giving HUE a visit. You won't regret it! HUE Church has been very welcoming church! Both in terms of the environment including the worship, sermon, etc; but primarily in terms of the people whom attend and make it a community! Pastor Sam does a great job of providing insightful and meaningful sermons, while also building a community and hosting people from the church for game night, dinner, etc. If you're unsure about whether you belong, I recommend coming for just 1 sermon and I think you'll enjoy everyone you meet there!

name: Humanity Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary:
"Church shopping" can be difficult and if you're like me, you're looking at reviews to get an idea of what a church is about. So, I am going to do my best to evaluate the church in a way that will be helpful for others searching.

Humanity church is true to its name. There is an overwhelming sense of community here and genuine connection. I felt like I was at a house church in that aspect. My initial impressions upon arriving was to take in the beautiful church building, quaint but stunning. I arrived a couple of minutes late and was greeted warmly by two ladies. The church community is small enough that you could tell they recognize who the visitors are, but they don't put you on blast as some churches do.

The church is definitely charismatic in their worship, preaching, and friendliness. The worship felt like a concert and the sermons were delivered with charisma and conviction. The Holy Spirit is welcome here and the sermons are more "inspired" than a 1-2-3 point sermon. Pastor Nathan brings up a sweat towel to dab at his forehead as he excitedly shares his convictions and relates his message to personal stories to tie in his points. The sermons feel supplemental and appear to be intended to be in conjunction with their "Humanity groups" (life/small groups). It is not taught verse by verse like a Calvary Chapel, but felt more like listening to a speaker at a conference.

At the end of the service they push for you to get connected to a group, which I could tell is really a central part of where their community thrives.

In addition, prior to my visit, I did some internet investigation on the church and found they have a strong social media presence. Through their church website, I was able to click on a link to their Instagram where there were current and up to date postings, keeping people connected. They are a small church but clearly doing something right to have such an enthusiastic congregation.

The only negative comment I have to add is that the worship was not my favorite. There were fog machines and light beams, which really felt too showy to me and was distracting for me to worship. The singers were a bit pitchy, which was also distracting at times. While churches should be inclusive, I also believe that people should be placed where they are gifted and that there should be worship team auditions, as uncomfortable as that may be for some.

I would recommend this church to anyone who is comfortable in a charismatic church setting! I’ve been going since 2016. Simply put, it has been life changing. I am so grateful for this community! People here are very accepting. The talks are super thought-provoking. Nathan the lead pastor and his wife Marla are so creative, very hospitable, even to people who are very different, and yet it’s because of their love for God, his purposes, and their love for all people. People here are so generous and willing to help each other. Jesus is always preached. The Word is always taught. So many people here are not just church goers. They are part of a force that’s becoming unstoppable.  I have so so so so much more to say but it’s way better when you experience this church for yourself. Very good church awesome ppl my daughter is really liked it alot we can we friends with the pastors father Ralph and his wife Pam and we went with them our first time it's really awesome great setting good ppl I would recommend and I'm grateful I was invited also the pastors wife Marla was really inviting and just had the best vibes bouncing off her  she did a great job at connecting me to ppl there The pastor and his incredible team has an beautiful vision to serve the city of Pomona and its surrounding communities. Our family started going to this church about 10 years ago, and we love their mission and heart for the community. "You'll know them by their fruits.." - Jesus

Everyone is loving, kind and welcoming.
The worship is great and the messages always  encourage me to be more like Jesus.

Definitely check them out!

name: Hyde Park United Methodist Church
reviewSummary:
Today, I decided to leave my church.

I can't sit through another political sermon where the phrase "White Supremacy" is used again and again, and I'm told I'm not doing enough for the LGBTQ+++ crowd.

I want a church that has more crucifixes than rainbow flags and whose bishop doesn't send videos to play about how he protests at whatever the church's politics-du-jour is.

And thus, I am no longer a member of the United Methodist Church. I am attending a 3 week seminar with a catered dinner beforehand. Everything is well thought out. Clean and organized When my wife and I are in Tampa visiting her adult children, we always make time to worship at this loving church. If you are seeking a church home, this is a great congregation to consider. They minister to all with no judgement, in the footsteps of Jesus. A great church in Hyde Park with great available classes  . Especially like Reverends  Vicky Walker and Justin.
They have a wonderful outreach center downtown called Portico that offers a wide range of services, classes and a nice cafe.
Check them both out and you'll be very happy you did! Great church and friendly welcoming people. .we were just visiting and were greeted by a welcoming congregation. There are many services to suit all needs and styles of worship. The buildings and grounds were also immaculately kept.

name: Iglesia Bautista de Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
I live 60 miles away from this church but it's worth it,  100% bible based if you need the truth about JESUCRIST. this is the rigth place. Is great, the word of God is preached the right way. PREACH The people are so kind and  study 📖 all the time the Bible!! What a great blessing from God to have allowed them to form a Bible-based congregation, where the Church of the Lord Jesus Christ can gather to study the holy and powerful Word of God; to celebrate it with all their hearts, worshiping and loving the Triune God, the only true God, and His only begotten Son, the Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have redemption by His blood. 🩸🙌🏻🙇🏻‍♀️

He is worthy of all praise and worship! True God and true man. Let us worship and love Him with all our soul, with all our mind, with all our heart, and with all our strength, for the great love and immense mercy that God has shown us, granting us His grace to rescue and save us from our vain way of life, and adopting us as His children through the immense sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross of Calvary. 🙌🏻

It is by His blood 🩸 that we have been redeemed and chosen to be a holy people, pleasing to God, for the glory and honor of God the Father and His Son Jesus Christ. 👆🏻🙌🏻😭❤️🙇🏻‍♀️

Hallelujah! 👆🏻👏🏻

How I wish we had a place like this in Argentina, where CHRIST is truly THE CENTER; where Jesus Christ is truly exalted not only in Word but in spirit and in truth 🙌🏻 where His Word is proclaimed faithfully, without variation or fear; WHERE THE HOLY SPIRIT GOVERNS the life of the church; where HUMILITY, LOVE, and TRUTH can be seen in both the pastors and the entire congregation.

I know that in my country there are also churches and faithful servants of God, and I thank the Lord for them. However, in my personal experience, finding a congregation where these virtues remain has become increasingly difficult.

It is heartbreaking to see how, in many places, some of those called to serve and shepherd God's flock end up lording it over them, when the Scriptures call us precisely to be examples of humility, service, and love. Knowledge can come to take the place of humility, care for souls, and brotherly love, thus contradicting the true vocation to which we have been called: to live and sincerely practice the piety taught in the Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Therefore, those who have the privilege of gathering in a healthy church faithful to the Scriptures should give thanks to God. It doesn't matter if it is far away; there is no price or distance that can compare to the privilege of meeting with the Lord's saints.

“How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!” (Psalm 133:1)

“Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.” (1 Corinthians 8:1b)

My longing is to find a church where, upon entering, one immediately recognizes that CHRIST IS LORD; where spiritual authority is exercised not as dominion, but as service; where the Word reigns supreme over opinions; where the Holy Spirit holds first place; where love is more visible than knowledge; and where those who serve and shepherd are examples rather than protagonists.

Therefore, my words will always begin by worshiping and exalting God, for He is the King to whom I belong and whom I serve. This is also why I long for a church that honors Him in the way He Himself teaches us in His Word.

This is not a secondary matter, nor is it an option that each person can define according to their own judgment. We are all called to humbly submit to the will of our Lord, knowing that one day we will give an account before Him. Therefore, far from trusting in our own humanity or making excuses, we long to live in obedience, depending each day on His grace and the sanctifying work of the Holy Spirit.

Greetings from your sister in Christ Jesus, from Buenos Aires, Argentina. ❤️🙏🏻🕊️

P.S.: I started listening to your teachings on YouTube some time ago. Although I have been attending church for many years, over time I have seen changes that have caused me deep sadness. I continue to pray and seek a church where the Holy Spirit of God reigns and not the spirit of a man.

Iglesia Universal is truly a special place where faith, hope, and transformation come together. From the moment you step inside, you feel a sense of peace and genuine care from the pastors, volunteers, and members of the church. Everyone is welcoming, and you can tell right away that this is a community built on love, prayer, and the desire to help people draw closer to God.

Whether you are facing challenges, looking for spiritual growth, or simply seeking direction, the teachings here inspire you to trust in God and keep moving forward.

One of the things that makes Iglesia Universal so unique is its focus on helping people not only spiritually, but also emotionally and even in their everyday struggles. They have prayers for families, finances, health, and personal battles—reminding us that God cares about every area of our lives. The church truly lives up to its mission of being a place of hope and transformation.

I also appreciate the consistency and dedication of the team here. The church offers daily services, making it possible for anyone to come and receive guidance no matter their schedule. This shows how committed they are to helping the community.

If you are searching for a place where you can grow your faith, find healing, and experience the power of prayer, Iglesia Universal is a wonderful church to be part of. It’s more than just a building—it’s a family that walks with you on your spiritual journey. I am grateful for everything I’ve experienced here, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to strengthen their relationship with God. Amazing church! The Immaculate Conception Catholic Church in Old Town San Diego is a stunning piece of history and faith. Completed in 1917, the church was built on the site of California’s first Catholic parish, which dates back to the late 18th century when Father Junípero Serra established the Mission San Diego de Alcalá nearby. The church is a beautiful example of Spanish Revival architecture, with its whitewashed walls, red-tiled roof, and an iconic bell tower that stands as a beacon of San Diego’s Catholic heritage.

Inside, the church exudes a sense of peace and reverence, featuring stained-glass windows and intricate woodwork. As the spiritual heart of Old Town, it continues to serve as a place of worship and community gathering. It’s a quiet reminder of the city’s rich cultural and spiritual roots.

I’m sharing this only as my personal opinion and in the hope that it may be helpful to others reading reviews.

I recently moved to the area and was genuinely excited to attend this church while looking for a new church home. For me, attending church is about more than the quality of the music or the delivery of the sermon. It’s about feeling a sense of connection, community, and the presence of God and the Holy Spirit.

Unfortunately, I did not experience that here. The worship music was dominated by extremely loud bass, which I found distracting rather than uplifting. The message of the sermon itself was good, at least from what I was able to absorb, but the delivery felt overly dramatic and theatrical to me. At times, I felt more like I was watching a performance than participating in worship.

I understand that many people may enjoy this style of church, and it may be exactly what they are looking for. For me, however, church is not about entertainment, image, or production value. I am looking for a genuine, heartfelt love for Jesus, authentic community, and a place where people come together as they are to experience and grow in their faith.

Ultimately, I left feeling that the emphasis was more on presentation and production than the deeper spiritual connection I was hoping to find. Others may have a completely different experience, but this church was simply not the right fit for me.

If you want, I can also make this **slightly stronger and more emotionally impactful** while still keeping it fair and credible for a public Google review. I visited this church while I was on a business trip and I'm glad I was recommended here. They have great worship music with lots of energy. The message was really good and straight forward. In a time that many pastors are scared to preach truth and biblical principles, it was refreshing to hear the message and feel the revival their helping to build. It was great to see so many young believers hungry for Jesus. I have attended Impact for about 3 years.  I was scared to join another big church in Scottsdale. But the  day I went to my first service is feel in love with this church.  The children’s ministry do amazing work with my 2 grandchildren. They know my situation and have been so understanding and helpful.  I have joined all the women’s Bible study and joined celebrate recovery.  I have found my community and family in the church. Thank you Pastor Travis for always speaking to me in every service. Had my first visit and as beautiful as the church is, I'm looking to see if money is less of a priority and teaching the gospel is most important. This is the first time I've had my teens tell me their ears physically hurt from how loud the music is.  I've never had to wear ear plugs before. Please, Lord, let this be a church that is evangelistic, mission minded, gospel teaching with alter calls for salvation, and teaches biblical principles. 🙏 That's all I want.  The only thing I disagreed with so much is teaching about tithing.  Tithing is old covenant and giving is New Covenant. Not to give by a certain percentage and to give according to what you can afford.

name: Impact Church of The Woodlands - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Impact Church of The Woodlands is Christ centered and Bible focused. Preaching is anointed and clear. Ministry is priority. Caring for one another is how we fellowship.  I love the women's ministry, teaching, women's Bible study , retreat, mentoring, and fellowship. Discipleship is our mission.

Join us as we grow in Jesus Christ!
Dr. Cheryl Anderson. I always enjoy attending Impact when in town visiting my friends.  Dr. Coleman provides great insight to the word of God and explains it in such a way that make it easy to understand.  The worship team is spot on, but get there early as they start a little before actual service time.  They also have a great kids ministry for your little ones and have a little café to get some treats before service if you're early. I am a non denominational believer in christ.  I believe in the trinity , god , jesus & the holy spirit.  Although the music is not familiar to me , I find Dr. Roche Coleman  intelligent , inspiring , and educational. I believe not only does the hours of 8:00a.m. fit my twelve hour work schedule , I also believe God led me here to listen , learn.  & heal my heart.

Those that I have come in contact with have been helpful and kind , but most importantly Dr. Roche Coleman is in fact a Shepard among the flock. From what I have seen he walks the walk , and the talk is superb

1 Peter 5:2 This past weekend at the Women’s Conference was nothing short of incredible. From the moment I walked in, I could feel the presence of the Lord filling the room. There was such a sweet spirit of unity and joy as women from all walks of life came together, beautifully dressed in white, to worship and grow in faith.

The music was absolutely powerful—every song felt like it lifted our hearts higher and reminded us of God’s love and faithfulness. The teaching was equally impactful: real, transparent, and deeply rooted in God’s Word. It wasn’t just a message for our minds, but one that touched our hearts and called us to live with greater purpose and passion for Jesus.

I left feeling refreshed, encouraged, and inspired to continue walking boldly in faith. It was a beautiful reminder that God wastes nothing, and He is always present with us. I am so thankful for the leaders and volunteers who poured their hearts into making this event such a blessing.

If you ever get the chance to attend an event at Impact Church of the Woodlands, don’t miss it. You will encounter God’s presence, connect with amazing women, and leave with your heart full.💛 Woman Ministry event 1-21-26 awesome! The members are very friendly. The event was insightful, encouraging, God focused and informative. The exercise portion blew me away. I was blessed and It was invigorated. Praise God for the women of Impact. Thank you for the invite Cheryl Anderson through my dear friend Elizabeth Williams. Thanks for showing God off to all. Lets go forth and continue to share God word we have been fueled t do so. IN JESUS NAME!!!!!

name: Impact Church Reynoldsburg - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
Impact Church in Reynoldsburg, Ohio is truly an amazing place to call home. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed like family. The atmosphere is warm, genuine, and full of encouragement.
The messages are engaging, easy to understand, and really make you think about how to apply them in everyday life. Pastor Jeremy may even thow a joke or two in there. The worship music is powerful and uplifting—it’s clear that a lot of heart goes into every service. The children's church volunteers are amazing too! 😀
Whether you’ve been in church your whole life or are just curious and checking things out, Impact Church Reynoldsburg is a place where you can feel comfortable, grow, and belong. Highly recommend visiting—you won’t regret it! My family loves the atmosphere and teachings at Impact Church. The welcoming community and candid sermons are refreshing compared to a typical modern day church. Everything is Christ centered as it should be and we’re happy to be a part of the Impact family! I came to Impact Church alittle over a year ago. Everyone here was very welcoming. I truly enjoy each week's worship service. The message, songs and family feel. I love how they give back to the community. From volunteering at food banks, Angel tree at Christmas and working with homeless ministry. Very welcoming church!  Family friendly and goal oriented with tons of things you can be involved in a lot or a little or not at all.  Its totally up to you.  Worship is wonderful very informative and right at my level of understanding.   I highly recommend coming to check it out!  Great for first timers or folks who want a no pressure approach to learning the word. If you are looking for a non denominational small church in Reynoldsburg | Pataskala, Ohio  -  This is the place to go.

Scripturally Based.  Above and Beyond Love and Care from the Pastor and Wife to their congregation.  They have a genuine and authentic desire to teach and serve the community.

This also would be an ideal space to have a small gathering | outdoor or indoor church wedding.

If I didn't love my home church - this is where I would consider landing.

It is a must try and see kind of church.

name: Impact Houston Church of Christ - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
The service was good, the Bible study very interactive and engaging. I was a bit put off with the contemporary music aspect which actually caught me off guard for a church of Christ. That aside, this is an active congregation that is visible in the community. I will most likely return. I live nearby and have ongoing concerns about activity around this location.

On multiple occasions, it’s been observed behavior in the parking lot that felt inappropriate and concerning, particularly involving interactions between adults and minors. This has made the area feel unsafe and uncomfortable.

While I understand and appreciate efforts to provide food and support to those in need, there appears to be a lack of proper oversight and organization. After these events, trash and debris are frequently left behind in the surrounding streets, requiring repeated reports to the city to address cleanup.

Additionally, the presence of parked buses and loitering in the area has contributed to ongoing disturbances, including suspected drug-related activity. Overall, there seems to be insufficient supervision and accountability for what is happening on and around the property.

I hope leadership takes these concerns seriously and implements better management, security, and community responsibility moving forward. Been there a couple times, and usually I'm not picky for all the things been receiving for free, but rotten food...come on guys you never give something is rotten, with mold and not even ok to give to your dog, there we go 6 boxes of rotten strawberries going to trash. Impact and the Refuge are incredible blessings to the community which they serve. They look like Jesus to me! Really nice people very helpful. God Bless them all.

name: In Focus Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going to Infocus for a little over a year now. I must say I love my church. From them welcoming you from the visitors tent to just the amount of love they show. I’m glad I found Infocus. They also have different events for men, women and families throughout the year. I wouldn’t want to be anywhere else. This is a really special place. The people there are genuine and welcoming. I joined a woman’s connect group this last year and found the sweetest friends I could have ever asked for. The groups have deep and thorough discussions that leave you feeling more knowledgeable about the Bible and also wanting to learn more!
Very thankful for this church and community there. Here I found much more than just a place I found a family. I’ve always felt supported, guided, and surrounded by love in every stage of my life. I’m truly grateful for this special community. Thank you for welcoming us with open arms in a very easy going atmosphere.   Genuine connections and wanting to ensure we have all the information about ministries offered there. The service spoke to my husband and I both and it hit home with the season we are in currently .  Will definitely be back next week. Thank you! I am extremely disappointed with my experience at InFocus Church. I reached out during a very difficult and vulnerable time in my life, seeking prayer, guidance, and support from the Pastor, deacons, and elders. After initially connecting, my follow-up was met with silence. A rescheduled meeting never materialized, and I was left feeling completely overlooked.

Church leadership should be a source of care, accountability, and spiritual support; especially when someone is reaching out in need. Instead, I experienced what felt like neglect and a lack of genuine concern. It raised serious questions for me about how the church prioritizes its people. Their mission statement is to “Love God, Love People, Reach the World,” yet based on this experience, they have failed on all three accounts. That disconnect between what is preached and what is practiced is deeply concerning.

I have also heard concerning feedback from others about leadership within this church, and unfortunately, my personal experience aligned with those concerns. It is disheartening when a place that is supposed to represent compassion and community falls short in such a meaningful way.

I hope this feedback is used as an opportunity for reflection and improvement, because no one seeking help should feel ignored. The church should emphasize active care, willingness, and responsibility toward those who reach out. It reinforces that leadership is not just about preaching, but about showing up for people, especially in vulnerable moments.

name: In His Presence Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I love Foundations, it made me see a different side of me that I thought I never had. I have a holy spirit, got baptized and learn to be a disciple. I want to do it again. I want to lean God s wisdom again and again. I met a new family which I love and care for. New freinds, I recommend for anybody that's new or other people that haven't try it yet. You get to discuss the bible with a group of people that also bring food every week. There's alot of help if your just a beginner.  I just love it so much. I love my church! I've started coming here about 15 years ago. Things happened & I left about 4 years in. But Like Jesus, The people of the church never left me. They would call to Check on me, encourage me & to remind me that I was loved. That was exactly what I needed. God knows what we need. I came back home, but I haven't left. With the guidance of Pastor Mel and Desiree, my journey with the Lord got stronger. The lead pastors are anointed and loving. I've built wonderful like-minded friendships & a loving foundation here that I couldn't find anywhere else! Highly Recommend with all my heart! Christian, non-denomination, multicultural church with many options, to love, receive and give.! I’ve been attending this church off and on since 2009 back when they had a 1pm Service!!! I have solid connections I’ve made and see at the services. I recently attended the Foundations class and I learned a lot. I’m trying to make solid connections and make friends with other like minded women something that can be very hard these days. It use to be so much easier. I love that there are more activities to attend. Pastor Desiree is The Best Royal Queen for Christ and she cares about people. Pastor Mel and Desiree speak truth. I’ve gone to many churches on fire for Trump which is cool but this church is on fire for Jesus 100+%. ! I do wish they would talk more about Trump like other churches I’ve been to do. I miss that like I do the 1pm service. I was attending a church on the beach in Santa Monica and there was a Trump inferno that kept me going for a year. They even had a political text group and a member text group where we got together for birthdays and everyone was invited. Also Biblical and political event notifications and we went out to eat afterwards as a group. It’s a small church so that’s why. Back when I was attending another church, Sheila started a Bible verse group with ourselves and a few men on Facebook and these verses nursed me back to health when I attended other churches. I share these verses daily with my sons, another church group text and the group text developed in the Foundations class group I was in. This is a safe church I’m comfortable with bringing my sons to or people I’m close with.This is the longest I’ve ever attended.  The word is marvelous and the worship is fire!!!!! Their Worship Team makes you love Worship music. This is the church!!!!!! Ive attended several churches and always feel the holy spirit and very happy bonding with other Christians and honoring, worshiping GOD. Did not feel the holy spirit here. Did not like the sermon. Didnt even hear them say Jesus once. I got the feeling of wolves in sheep’s clothing, Didn’t even feel the holy spirit when they were praying for people. Felt off and not ok. Really sad feeling. I also had a friend that went here for years and she got super depressed and called the office one day asking for prayer!!! Their response was they DONT pray for people mid week. She was in a deep depression and got no help!!  I do not recommend going here. Even my other friend that went with me said it felt weird!! And she loves church. She said let’s go….. let’s sneak out. She said it was a weird feeling. BEST CHURCH EVER!!!!! It’s easy to pick apart and criticize but we are flawed people in a flawed world with an assignment and that’s to go out into all the world, preach the gospel, witness Jesus, win souls and make disciples. That’s what IHPC is all about! Loving Jesus and loving his people and getting them ready for His return! And most of all, allowing the presence of God to MOVE. It’s Holy ground where you can drop your walls, remove the over analyzing, and allow Holy Spirit to work. It’s life changing and transformational, and I can vouch for that. Blessings pour through IHPC. There is fruit, there is healing, there are so many testimonies of FAITH and MIRACLES. All Glory to King Jesus! Thank you Pastors Mel & Desiree for creating that space for Kingdom work for such a time as this! He’s coming back SOON people! Get ready get ready get ready!

name: Incarnation Catholic Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I am from Texas and visit this church when I am in the area. I feel very much at home here. The priests are wonderful. I also appreciate the strong church community at this parish. Homily's here vary from helpful to objectionable! Conservatives "patience will be challenged" here?! Yes a Great sound system with some joyful, helpful folks here!   Music Ministry is main draw for many busy exhausted catholics with kids It's beautiful. The priests and deacons are great pastors . The parishioners are wonderful.  It's an amazing faithful community. Easy walk from two Hilton properties I am blessed to be part of this community during my visits to Southern California.  I have been attending masses here since 1973.  The chapel is quiet and calming.  It is a beautiful Parish and community!

name: Incarnation Chapel - Village of Garden City Campus
reviewSummary:
I love the warm, welcoming, Christ-centered community of Incarnation Chapel. I attend most Saturday services, and I truly enjoy it. The light supper and fellowship after the service are a wonderful plus! I hope to see you there! A warm and welcoming community with Christ at the center.

Love (III) George Herbert
Love bade me welcome. Yet my soul drew back
Guilty of dust and sin.
But quick-eyed Love, observing me grow slack
From my first entrance in,
Drew nearer to me, sweetly questioning,
If I lacked any thing.
A guest, I answered, worthy to be here:
Love said, You shall be he.
I the unkind, ungrateful? Ah my dear,
I cannot look on thee.
Love took my hand, and smiling did reply,
Who made the eyes but I?
Truth Lord, but I have marred them: let my shame
Go where it doth deserve.
And know you not, says Love, who bore the blame?
My dear, then I will serve.
You must sit down, says Love, and taste my meat:
So I did sit and eat. Wonderful meditative, creative services in the round in the Episcopal/Anglican tradition. Warm and welcoming congregation. Light supper and fellowship after the service Friendly, welcoming place doing innovative liturgy.

name: Incarnation Lutheran Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: This church doesn't have the truth. I don't know what it is, but it's not correct. I know the church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is. But I would not recommend it! This beautiful church is in Poway. Paster Luther is a wonderful paster to all. Deacon Mindy has her own special way with people. This church also has services on-line. This has been our church for many years. Join our wonderful church family as we worship and serve God. Great church, friendly and welcoming congregation. Excellent choir and music program. Something for everyone. The minister,Luther, delivers a very clever, meaningful sermon I like him.

name: Independence Hill Baptist Church - Huntersville Campus
reviewSummary:
What truly sets this church apart is the love and support shown during my husband’s cancer fight. We were surrounded by prayers and encouragement in some of our hardest moments. The leadership and congregation walked alongside my family with genuine love and care, reminding us we were never alone.

It’s a place where people of all backgrounds are accepted, supported, and encouraged to grow in their faith. The leadership is caring and approachable, and the congregation feels like family. I’m deeply grateful to be part of this church! The people of Independence Hill are friendly, welcoming, and down to earth authentic. The church is multigenerational with lots of opportunities to connect and grow in faith. From the nursery to kid’s and student ministries to our JOY Group, there is a place for you. There’s a long history of this church building homes, for those in need, and constructing actual church buildings. IHBC even built Angels and Sparrows. You are always welcome! I have been part of the church family for 14 years now. I originally found them on Google after moving from out of state and, from my first visit, I felt like I was home. This is where I turned my life over to God and was baptized. These people have a heart for God and will welcome you in with open arms. They have a huge worship space and a lot of activities and missions going on. There is a family room where you can watch service if you need a space for privacy or with kids for a moment. There is a nursery with wonderful volunteers staffed in it if you have kids and they want to play during service. All kids are also more than welcome in the service if that’s where they want to be. They have amazing small groups and a place for everyone. Youth, children, young and old! Everyone loves on my family as if they are their own.

In addition to all of the great things, there is a wonderful preschool. Every teacher here is amazing and the structure they have as well as the group of kids is everything you could want in a preschool.

I cannot recommend this community of Jesus lovers more! As a lifetime member of IHBC, my husband & I recently returned after being away for about 5 years due to a move. I felt God calling us back - not only to support the church financially & through service , but also because I knew it would be a comforting place for my husband. He was diagnosed with Parkinson’s & Alzheimer’s in 2020 and when we came back, it was clear we were right where we needed to be. He was warmly welcomed by familiar faces & seeing his face light up as he returned “home” meant everything. IHBC truly welcomes ALL people and invites you to “come as you are”. It’s a wonderful place to raise your children, grow spiritually, and be encouraged by fellow believers.
We invite you to come visit and experience it for yourself! Love this church. Such caring and special staff and congregation. So welcoming and supportive. Could not be more supportive of their community

name: Independent Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: “This is an amazing congregation, filled with kind and welcoming people. Pastor Martinez,the leader, is truly exceptional , one of those rare preachers who faithfully share the true Gospel. I am continually blessed and uplifted by his preaching. May God continue to pour out His blessings upon this wonderful church family.” Just a beautiful small church rich in history since the late 1980's, who sing the good old hymns with piano and organ. The teaching and sermons from Pastor Martinez are of sound teaching and will leave you feeling full! I really enjoyed visiting here. It's small but the Bible teaching is excellent. I hope to visit again soon. Small church with a friendly atmosphere and good, Biblical teaching.

name: India Christian Assembly - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Very amazing Indian community. Very hospitable and loving church. Its non denominational but protestant church.

reviewSummary:
Nice meeting room separate from main building. Has kitchen and bathroom Awesome place.
Good people and pastor Very friendly congregation. God is at this church Good church to visit

name: Indonesian Presbyterian Church Fullerton - Fullerton Campus
Indy Vineyard Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Really wonderful Christmas Eve service with worshipful music.

Highly expressive Bible "readings" (virtually all "readers" had memorized their fairly lengthy Scripture passages) that captured the imagination and made me feel I was right there hearing the Biblical characters or authors speaking directly to me.

The Christmas Message was about finding true peace -- God's Peace -- something that somehow eludes all of us at times in the everyday, nonstop onslaught of work, family and social demands. Great message that has helped change my perspective. Very nice Spirit-filled church. Pastor Randy and his wife are really sweet. Great community. The worship is very 'Bethel' style. They have a commitment to prayer, and the prayer movement. Definitely worth a look! Indy Vineyard is a place that values the presence of God and the importance of connecting with Him. Our mission statement is to encounter the love and power of God and give it away to the world. Each week, there are practical ways to do just that. I am grateful to be a part of a church where we strive to live out this verse-John 13:35 By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another. Beautiful, broken church made up of broken, genuine people.  God is so present here.  I would be so lucky to be a part of this church and fed by God through the pastor, worship team, and congregation for rest of my life.  No fronting one thing while being another.  Thank you, Father. Love it here. We’re involved in a small group and a few ministries. Very healthy church that grows leaders.

name: Infinite Church - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Infinite Church truly feels like home! From the moment I walked through the doors, I was welcomed with so much love and kindness. The people are genuine, the worship is powerful, and the sermons always speak right to my heart. Pastor’s messages are inspiring and full of truth, and the entire community here truly lives out their faith. I’m so grateful to be part of such an uplifting and caring church family — Infinite Church has been such a blessing in my life! God is raising up people  that what  to sever  other people  if you  are tired  of the same  coffee  try  a different  brand .as a pastor  God  is doing  a new  thing  this year  for infinite church  don't  be a bench warmer  be active  tell someone  about  the love of Jesus christ  an what he has done for  you just  remember  God almighty will protect  you and bless you all the days of your life Some of the most loving, caring, gentle people attend this church.  Are they perfect? No.  But they are all trying to serve God and be the best version of themselves God has designed them to be.  If you are looking for a home church, come visit and see what I am talking about.  The church has people from all over the world.  The music is amazing.  The Word of God is spoken and lived and the Holy Spirit moves.  Come visit!! Wonderful place of worship.  True family of believers. The Pastor preaches directly from the word of God and follows what he preaches.  Praise and worship team is amazing.  There is always something to do there. Lots of groups to join. After a very few visits toI Church, my wife and I decided that this was our new church home. This is a place filled with authentic Christians (not perfect!), striving to build a very healthy spiritual community. We are very blessed to be members and looking forward to decades of participating and serving.

name: Influence Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
A True Home

I’ve been attending Influence Church Anaheim for a few years now.

The Sunday services are consistently excellent: the worship and music are absolutely amazing, lifting your spirit every time, and the teaching is solidly Bible-based, practical, and relevant.

The church community is incredibly friendly and welcoming — you truly feel seen and cared for the moment you walk in.

What makes Influence Church stand out even more is the way they love people practically. The prayer team is at the prayer wall, ready to pray with anyone in need, and every Sundaythe church distributes free food to those who need it.

That kind of genuine care means so much.
I’m especially grateful that three generations of my family are thriving and being blessed here. The growing and vibrant youth ministries serve all ages beautifully, and the Men of Valor and Women of Influence ministries are among the best men’s and women’s ministries I’ve seen anywhere.

If you’re interested in a church that teaches the Word, worships wholeheartedly, and truly loves and cares forget its community, Influence Church Anaheim is the place.

Highly recommended! My husband and I have been attending services here for the past few months, and we truly love it. We’ve started getting more plugged in, and everyone has been so welcoming and kind. Pastor Phil and Tammy are incredible, they’ve taken the time to mentor and guide us, and are so loving! We always leave encouraged, refreshed, and even more on fire for Jesus.

The Wednesday night women’s group and the Bible studies have also been such a gift, an amazing way to make new friends and really feel a part of the community. Had an amazing time at the Easter Egg hunt! My son had fun running and grabbing eggs with the littles at 10am. Had a couple photo shoot moments with the Easter bunny. Can’t wait to attend next year’s event :) Outstanding church! The music worship service is perhaps the best I’ve experienced. We’ve visited many times and everyone seems to be so friendly, regardless if I’m just walking down an aisle or if I strike up a conversation with the person sitting next to us. The men of this church seem to have a strong ministry and many of them are upfront during worship, backslapping and hugging, with very warm greetings. The Word of God is taught clearly, with humor and passion. Both Pastor Phil and his wife Tammy are very warm and outgoing personally and have a strong heart for God, and their community outreach emphasis again rivals any church I’ve attended. There are a dozen schools in Anaheim and Irvine where they host Jesus Clubs every week with pizza, donuts, etc., and I heard that over 5000 students have attended a Jesus Club this fall alone, 20% of which have led to salvations. This church is definitely producing fruit! We love visiting Influence when we are in town. The messages are great… biblically based , relevant. Pastor Phil and Tammy are so sweet and welcoming. Pastor Phil shares such relevant messages for our times. So glad we have a church to attend when we come visit CA.

name: Inn at the Mission San Juan Capistrano, Autograph Collection - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
We stayed for 2 nights to visit with relatives in the area.  Normally, we would have booked with an Ayres Inn as they provide much value and quality.  Thought we’d splurge for this visit and we were disappointed.  Overall, the property is pretty with a lovely location.  It’s within walking distance of most everything in San Juan Cap.  But we thought the room was exceptionally small.  It felt cramped and did NOT meet our expectations which aren’t unreasonable.  The dark, dated furniture made it worse.  And we found out at the last minute, there was a $55 mandatory valet parking fee??  If we had time, we would have cancelled and booked elsewhere.  There’s no ability to park elsewhere so guests are held hostage, so to speak.  Also, there’s a $45 daily destination fee.  Again it was unexpected.  We probably didn’t read the fine print somewhere.  The staff were courteous and professional.  But we felt the price of an almost $500 plus other fees per night room was way too much.  We won’t stay there ever again. Beautiful location, easy walk to plenty of restaurants in cute SJC - right next to the Mission. Gorgeous architecture, circular driveway and entrance, large lobby and restaurant area with beautiful dark beams and intricate architectural details.
I stayed for a nearby conference for work was there for 4 nights. The grand entrance and common areas got me excited to try out the elevated Autograph series for Marriott. The guy at check-in made a big deal of finding me a room that I'd be happy with for 4 nights. That actually continued my excitement.
That ended quickly when I got to my 'special' room, which ended up being on the first floor overlooking an empty parking lot (which they charge a mandatory $55 per night for valet) right across from the gym. So I shut the curtains and got to wake up at 5am when the gym enthusiasts started to work out.
Again the room inside was beautiful, small but adequate, with arched entries and old, dark wood accents. But I didn't want to open my window to remind me of the parking lot/ Bakersfield motel feel. And I couldn't tune out the noise of the gym door opening and closing. In the end, the actual rooms and (small) pool section of the hotel is not any better than a basic hotel/ motel. Not bad, but costs twice a much. Glad I was offsite working all day. We are local to the area and always wanted to check out this hotel because it looks so beautiful and is in walking distance to all of the great shops and restaurants in SJC. We just stayed there to celebrate my birthday and had the very best time. The room is decorated so nicely with a lot of attention to detail and style. The lobby and pool area are super pretty. But most importantly, the staff made our stay extra special. Daniel and Kevin were so friendly and took great care of my car and our luggage. They were such a warm and cool welcome to the property. Nick at the front desk went above and beyond. We were upgraded to a beautiful room, and he knew it was my birthday and after dinner, our room had balloons, gourmet snacks and chocolate with the sweetest personalized birthday note from Nick and the rest of the staff. It was over the top kind. And then my daughter accidentally left a phone charger and expensive retainers in the room and Nick immediately went to go check and called me back to let me know he found the items and was keeping them safe for me to pick up. It doesn’t get better than that for customer service! It was just one night but so special and we will for sure return. We had a wonderful stay at this hotel yesterday—truly the cleanest hotel I’ve ever experienced. Everything was spotless and well-maintained, which made our stay incredibly comfortable.

The staff were all friendly, professional, and welcoming, creating a great overall experience from start to finish. Although the hotel is petite, it thoughtfully offers everything we needed.

The fitness center was impressive—very clean and equipped with the newest workout machines. We also appreciated the $25 credit, which we used for coffee and breakfast at the hotel café. The coffee was excellent and a perfect way to start the day.

Overall, we had a fantastic time and really enjoyed the vibe of the hotel. We will definitely be coming back! We hail from San Diego and are returning for our second stay here. This time, we’re celebrating my wife’s birthday, and we’ve chosen to make it a memorable occasion.

A special shoutout to the front desk clerk, William. His exceptional customer service is truly commendable, and the overall experience at this establishment is nothing short of stellar.

Given our Southern California roots, this place has become our go-to vacation destination, or as we like to call it, our staycation spot. Thank you Marriott !!

name: Irving Bible Church - Irving Campus
reviewSummary:
non- denominational Church! Been attending for 3 years now! My home church people are very welcoming open all day for anyone to come and study 📚or play in the kids tube! When you visit don’t forgot to stop at the Cuppa Espresso Bar in the building for a cuppa or some pastries 🥮 *best Vietnamese Coffee ☕️bold I’ve been attending this church for a little over two years, and it has truly been a blessing to my family and me. From the moment we came, we felt welcomed and at peace.
As a mom of a young child, I’m not always able to sit through the full service. Sometimes I listen from home or spend time in the playground area instead of the sanctuary. What means so much to me is that no one ever makes me feel pressured, this church genuinely welcomes everyone with grace and understanding.
The pastor’s messages are always gentle, sincere, and deeply touching. I’m so thankful to be part of this community, and I look forward to the day when I can sit in the sanctuary again and worship freely. There are lot of sports activities are frequently conducted here. Indoor playground is well maintained and happy to bring our children.  It's a Holly place for peaceful prayers.  Big open place is there for sports activities and for free walking.  It has  a well maintained coffee shop with free WiFi facility. As a part of social welfare and community service they are adopting places and are maintaining the area at their service. Public concern: Irving Bible Church was given notice of an urgent hardship situation involving a medically vulnerable dialysis patient and still failed to provide meaningful help.

After a formal complaint, the response was that they had already helped others and could not help here. That answer raises a serious question: how does a church claiming to serve people in crisis justify turning away someone facing severe medical vulnerability and unsafe conditions?

This is exactly why public accountability matters. A church cannot market compassion, community care, and ministry values on one hand, then offer dismissal and excuses when a real emergency is placed in front of it.

We want a direct answer from Irving Bible Church:
Why was this case denied?
Who made that decision?
What emergency assistance process actually exists?
And why was a medically fragile person left without meaningful support?

This deserves more than silence. It deserves scrutiny. Hired a new children’s pastor from The Village who is toxic and engages in gossip with others. IBC is supposed to be a safe haven for folks recovering from spiritually abusive churches like The Village and instead allows people like this to infiltrate the church and influence members. How was the vetting process for her when you decided to bring her own board? Was she fully on board with how IBC does things or just wants to bring their toxic ways here? She has also engaged in gossip about me to people in my community group causing them to treat me differently.

I would encourage anyone thinking of bringing their family here to look up the Matt Tonne case from 2012 (as well as any other story that has come out of The Village). I haven’t heard or seen anyone from IBC publicly say anything about Julie’s views are different or condemns the way these things were handled. In fact, the community group I was a part of tried to make me feel like my experience was an isolated incident and “other people thrive” which tells me Julie did in fact talk to them.

This church walks the walk, and can back it up theologically. name: Jenks Bible Church - Jenks Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church, full of people who love Jesus and desire to spread the gospel. Pastors Ben and Matt are true servants of the Lord and I am so grateful for their teaching and leadership. This church has been my husbands and my family through some very hard times in our lives, and I praise God for their faithfulness! Besides solid teaching, the people are some of the friendliest in OK! If you want a solid expositional preaching, discipleship based church where Christ is exalted and the pastors really care for your soul, this is the place!  I've known Pastor Ben for almost two decades and had the privilege of serving with Matt when he was in seminary.  They are passionate about the transformative power of God's Word.  If I was to encourage anyone in the Tulsa area, it would be to come and give your life to the work going on here.  Don't be a spectator.  Come and grow, serve and replicate yourself.  There is no better way to spend the life God has given you! My wife and I moved from Tulsa in the beginning of 2017, but we continue to maintain our relationships with lead pastor Ben, associate pastor Matt and the rest of the congregation.  This last weekend (Oct. 7, 2018) was the first service for Jenks Bible Church in their new facility.  My wife and I love this church and the people within it so much that we made it a priority to fly to Oklahoma for the weekend and support them in this new and exciting transition!  This church has been and continues to be a blessing to us, demonstrating well how a true community of believers should live and act in accordance with God’s word.  If you attend a Sunday here, you won’t miss experiencing that.  Everyone demonstrated so much love and genuine interest our first few visits, it touched our hearts and made my wife and me WANT to be a part of this community of believers.  And it wasn’t just the first few visits, it was and is continually that way with this church family.  No matter how I try and articulate this, there is no way to explain it.  The love and fellowship is something you must experience yourself, which makes it evident the work the Lord is doing in this church.  This church has a large impact on its members and community.  For my wife and me personally this church came along side us when we needed them the most.  We were struggling in our marriage and personal walks with the Lord.  The Lord used this church body to minister to us, which brought growth in our personal relationships with the Lord and as a result restoration to our marriage.  The Lord uses Ben to clearly articulate the Word of God, balancing the true depth of the Scriptures while giving life application to the message.  Something I find few do exceptionally well, but I dare to say Ben is one of those few.  Through Ben’s preaching and my weekly meetings with Matt, this church provided my soul the encouragement it needed.  Ben’s preaching style is expositional, taking the congregation verse by verse through books of the bible.  Ben and Matt are two of the most genuine, sincere men of God I have ever met in my life and each is committed to their role of shepherding members and looking out for their personal growth in their relationships with the Lord.  So…if you are looking for a church that will love you well and you will love, look no further than here.  Teaching Biblical truth, rooted in strong Biblical values living the light of Christ, the essence of life! For the past five years prior to this new work of the Lord in Jenks I’ve had the privilege of serving alongside the lead pastor Ben Averitt. He is a man of integrity who has a deep love for his family and a steady commitment to the Lord’s church. What I love most about this church though is that it’s not about one man. It’s all about Jesus Christ! I highly recommend this church for you and your family, a place where the gospel is proclaimed and lived to the glory of God and for the good of his people. This is a church that teaches Biblically sound doctrine. I am a member and have been blessed to be under the leadership. Being a part of this church family has been a source of great encouragement and spiritual growth in my life.
