name: Jesus Church LA - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church you can call home, this is the one.
Since my wife and I’s first visit on Sunday, January 7, 2024, this church became home to us.
Not only we were welcomed with open arms, taken in, loved, but also the way we experienced the presence of God and have continued to do so since that day.

I give glory to the Lord for how he drew us to this church. And I’m thankful to be a part of a church that teaches true biblical principles, SEEKS the face of the Lord and is led by the Spirit of God.

We have grown in this community in the past 2 years, attended Bible school for 2 years, become servants of the Lord ministering in multiple different ministries by the grace of God.

Not to mention the care of this congregation for this city. The church is operating MULTIPLE different ministries daily. Monday’s men’s group, Tuesday’s rehabilitation and recovery meetings and prayers, Wednesday’s midweek prayer and intercession service, Thursday’s young adult meetings, Friday’s youth service, Saturday’s feeding and evangelizing to the homeless of the greater Los Angeles and Sunday 2 services, adding to it MULTIPLE home groups on each day of the week, adding to it elderly home visitation ministry which takes place Monday through Saturday, going to 8 different elderly homes.

God is moving in our midst and is moving through this church.

Come, taste and see that the Lord is good. Me and my family have been coming to this church for the past 6 months, and from the very first service we attended, we truly felt God’s presence. From the pastor’s messages to the worship team, everything is filled with love, encouragement, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. The members of the church are so welcoming and kind, and we love that they offer different services and programs for all ages throughout the week. It has truly been such a blessing finding a church community where we feel spiritually uplifted, supported, and at home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church family! This is an excellent church located in the heart of Glendale. It is a suitable place to join the family of God, worship Him, hear from Him, and serve Him.

It offers various ministries for women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. There are also numerous home groups, prayer groups, as well as ministries focused on prophecy and healing, along with many other services.

Additionally, the church has a great school called LASSM through which you will grow in the Lord, discover your calling, and put it into practice.
COME AND BE BLESSED 😊 I have been a believer for about 17 years, and during that time I attended two different churches. Even while I was attending those churches, I always knew about this church and would visit whenever I had the opportunity, whether it was for a service, conference, or special gathering. From the very beginning, there was always something different I could feel.
This is truly a Spirit filled church where you encounter God’s presence from the moment you walk in. There is a deep sense of peace, love, and warmth, and you immediately feel welcomed. It does not feel like a place you just attend. It feels like a true family.
The church is deeply focused on God and His Word. The teachings are strong, clear, and life transforming if you are truly seeking to grow. This is a place of true discipleship where you are encouraged to walk closely with God and grow deeper in your faith.
Pastor Ruben is a true servant, humble, caring, and anointed. You can see his heart for people in the way he leads and supports the church. The pastor and members are always available, praying for one another and supporting each other in every area of life, including education, personal growth, and spiritual needs.
They offer both Armenian and English services, with translators available, which makes it very welcoming for everyone. There are also many ministries for every age and stage, including women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. The church has home groups, prayer groups, and ministries that focus on prophecy, healing, and deeper spiritual growth.
Their Sunday school is excellent, with a strong curriculum that helps children grow in faith from a young age. You can see the care and intention behind it.
They also have a school called LASSM, where people can grow deeper in the Lord and discover their calling. I personally have not attended yet because I have two young children, but I truly cannot wait for the opportunity to go. I already feel such a strong desire and hunger to attend because I know it will help me grow deeper, be transformed, and be empowered in a new way.
If you are looking to grow spiritually, learn the Bible, be part of a true family, and build a close relationship with God, I truly recommend this church. If you want to go even deeper in your walk, I also highly recommend attending their school. Great church, IF you are Armenian. If you are not Armenian, the congregation can be a little hostile, disrespectful and very difficult to build God rutted friendships with as well. The English services are done mostly by the pastor’s wife, who bless her heart, doesn’t speak English. Therefore the sermons are done in Armenian, then translated to English. Which can be  frustrating if you don’t speak Armenian. And I understand the church is in Glendale… but Glendale is still in the U.S. , so a little more awareness, love and respect toward other cultures would speak volumes of their “love for Christ”.

name: Jesus Church LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church you can call home, this is the one.
Since my wife and I’s first visit on Sunday, January 7, 2024, this church became home to us.
Not only we were welcomed with open arms, taken in, loved, but also the way we experienced the presence of God and have continued to do so since that day.

I give glory to the Lord for how he drew us to this church. And I’m thankful to be a part of a church that teaches true biblical principles, SEEKS the face of the Lord and is led by the Spirit of God.

We have grown in this community in the past 2 years, attended Bible school for 2 years, become servants of the Lord ministering in multiple different ministries by the grace of God.

Not to mention the care of this congregation for this city. The church is operating MULTIPLE different ministries daily. Monday’s men’s group, Tuesday’s rehabilitation and recovery meetings and prayers, Wednesday’s midweek prayer and intercession service, Thursday’s young adult meetings, Friday’s youth service, Saturday’s feeding and evangelizing to the homeless of the greater Los Angeles and Sunday 2 services, adding to it MULTIPLE home groups on each day of the week, adding to it elderly home visitation ministry which takes place Monday through Saturday, going to 8 different elderly homes.

God is moving in our midst and is moving through this church.

Come, taste and see that the Lord is good. Me and my family have been coming to this church for the past 6 months, and from the very first service we attended, we truly felt God’s presence. From the pastor’s messages to the worship team, everything is filled with love, encouragement, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. The members of the church are so welcoming and kind, and we love that they offer different services and programs for all ages throughout the week. It has truly been such a blessing finding a church community where we feel spiritually uplifted, supported, and at home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church family! This is an excellent church located in the heart of Glendale. It is a suitable place to join the family of God, worship Him, hear from Him, and serve Him.

It offers various ministries for women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. There are also numerous home groups, prayer groups, as well as ministries focused on prophecy and healing, along with many other services.

Additionally, the church has a great school called LASSM through which you will grow in the Lord, discover your calling, and put it into practice.
COME AND BE BLESSED 😊 I have been a believer for about 17 years, and during that time I attended two different churches. Even while I was attending those churches, I always knew about this church and would visit whenever I had the opportunity, whether it was for a service, conference, or special gathering. From the very beginning, there was always something different I could feel.
This is truly a Spirit filled church where you encounter God’s presence from the moment you walk in. There is a deep sense of peace, love, and warmth, and you immediately feel welcomed. It does not feel like a place you just attend. It feels like a true family.
The church is deeply focused on God and His Word. The teachings are strong, clear, and life transforming if you are truly seeking to grow. This is a place of true discipleship where you are encouraged to walk closely with God and grow deeper in your faith.
Pastor Ruben is a true servant, humble, caring, and anointed. You can see his heart for people in the way he leads and supports the church. The pastor and members are always available, praying for one another and supporting each other in every area of life, including education, personal growth, and spiritual needs.
They offer both Armenian and English services, with translators available, which makes it very welcoming for everyone. There are also many ministries for every age and stage, including women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. The church has home groups, prayer groups, and ministries that focus on prophecy, healing, and deeper spiritual growth.
Their Sunday school is excellent, with a strong curriculum that helps children grow in faith from a young age. You can see the care and intention behind it.
They also have a school called LASSM, where people can grow deeper in the Lord and discover their calling. I personally have not attended yet because I have two young children, but I truly cannot wait for the opportunity to go. I already feel such a strong desire and hunger to attend because I know it will help me grow deeper, be transformed, and be empowered in a new way.
If you are looking to grow spiritually, learn the Bible, be part of a true family, and build a close relationship with God, I truly recommend this church. If you want to go even deeper in your walk, I also highly recommend attending their school. Great church, IF you are Armenian. If you are not Armenian, the congregation can be a little hostile, disrespectful and very difficult to build God rutted friendships with as well. The English services are done mostly by the pastor’s wife, who bless her heart, doesn’t speak English. Therefore the sermons are done in Armenian, then translated to English. Which can be  frustrating if you don’t speak Armenian. And I understand the church is in Glendale… but Glendale is still in the U.S. , so a little more awareness, love and respect toward other cultures would speak volumes of their “love for Christ”.

name: Jesus City Church - Downtown Campus - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: If You're Looking For True Word Of God Worship this is the place to be. Pastor Jason's delivery of Each Sermon is superb.with understanding from beginning to end. Not Boring and Not All over The Bible losing you half way.He Keep you Interested. And Wanting you to Study and Know your Word For yourself. The Whole Church Vibe is Warm and inviting from the Front Door To The sanctuary you See Smiles on People Face.He Has A Beautiful Wife And Family That Came to Montgomery To Start Jesus City Church. I Thank God For him Starting his Ministry Here. They just had their Grand Opening services with baseball legend Darryl Strawberry! I absolutely love this church! A breath of fresh air in Montgomery! If you’re looking for a church that you can really feel God’s presence and also feel like people genuinely care about you; go here! You will feel welcomed, wanted and loved. And most importantly, you will leave knowing how much God loves you! The Pastor teaches straight from the Bible and the worship is awesome! Services are every Sunday at 11:00am, at 120 Dexter Ave right next to Chris’ Hotdogs Great place of worship and an word from the Lord. Pastor Jason is always greeting as many people as he can coming in and after service. Him and and his wife are genuinely great people. Amazing time in the Lord through worship in song and in Word. I love that there was a diversity of races all were welcomed homeless was excepted. Definitely recommend this church for anyone that is visiting the city or who is looking for a church home. I love this church. My third time there and I just love the pastor and his lovely wife. He talks about the scriptures in a way that you can understand it!! My husband and I have found a new church!! Thanks Jesus City!!

name: Jesus House Birmingham: RCCG - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
A cool place to worship God Awesome worship experience
Life lessons sermon The preaching is wonderful, everything goes as planned, adoration time is my favorite. You don't believe me come and check it out. A great place to worship where the undiluted word of God is taught. 👍🏽 This is a true family and a great place of worship.

name: Jesus Is Amazing Church - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary: Thank you Jesus for this meeting place!! I've fallen in love with Jesus and in the process He gave me such an amazing family at Jesus is Amazing church! I've never met a body so in love with Jesus and that loves the neighborhood more than this place! We absolutely love coming every chance we get! My daughter loves the Wednesday night  bible study and the kid classes they have for Saturday service! I have freedom and my life is better because of Jesus and Jesus is in all the people here!! Thank you Jesus for the amazing people at Jesus is Amazing Church!  Jesus said the world will know you by your love for each other!  The people at this church love Jesus so much and are so grateful for his love that it shows in the way they love each other and the community!  A diverse group of believers who want the world to know Jesus Christ and the power of the cross and resurrection!  Walking this journey with Jesus and his  church has healed my heart and changed my life!  Come join us Saturday afternoon at 4:00 and experience the love of Jesus!!! My family will continue to pass 138 churches weekly to meet here for the rest of our days. Simply put, it’s home. This is where I heard the gospel of Jesus Christ in it’s entirety for the first time. Each sermon is packed with scripture, love, and truth. The love expressed here is genuine. Thank you Jesus for this family and this meeting place! Jesus is Amazing church does a wonderful job welcoming people and sharing the true love of Jesus! I met Jesus here! It’s been life changing the friends, family and support I’ve been blessed with in this body! I’ve learned so much from the pastor and the body is a true example of what the church is supposed to look like! Biblically sound! Great small groups! Highly recommend! Really great church! My son has been going for many years now! They have weekly church for kids with free dinners and gym time, and arts and crafts! They do baptism in church Saturday evenings and have weekly classes for different occasions such as recovery classes, weddings, fairs, outings, etc. They are really helpful for ppl in need. Very casual, and comfortable setting. A lot of music and fun! However they can be a little pushy at times and a little loud and can make you feel as if they are recruiting. If you are really religious you will really enjoy this church. Otherwise it may not be for you. Really personable and huggers. I guess it all depends on your personality and your background. They have morning and afternoon services!!! Very flexible!!!

name: Jesus Is Lord Church Henderson - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
The happiest people on the planet worship here. Be ready to receive the Holy Spirit! Bring your children because they bless and pray for them every service in the morning. Children are our future leaders so bring yours now. I have never seen a group of young people so strong and serious about our Lord Jesus Christ. I asked for prayer because of a situation that was really bothering me and it was literally solved the very next day. Now THAT, ladies and gentlemen, is true power!! Now, i ask for somethig special because i really need for my dreams to be fulfilled 😇. Be ye wise and make your way down to the alter to break every bond and stronghold in your life. Be blessed!! These are the hours:
Fri 8pm Young Adults Service
Sat 9am Intercessory Prayer
Sun 10am Worship Service
Sun 6pm Evening Service

This church is so awesome and fun! As a newcomer I felt very welcomed. May God continue to bless them and grow their ministry. Hello, our Christian brothers and sisters.
The lords blessing has our family moving into the area of Henderson.  In a search of a good Bible based church to rejoice and praise the goodness of God,  his destiny is our path . We look forward to finding a good foundational,positive teaching ministry.  We shall visit soon .
Have a blessed day and a blessed life always 🙏 Very welcoming congregation! Stirring worship and insightful bible based preaching/teaching. Altar call prayer for needs at the end of each sermon message. I believe that all are equal in God, please lord forgive me and keep me humble 🙏

name: Jesus Is Lord Church Las Vegas - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice church. Went in for first time and very welcoming people. I believe service starts at 10am and another one at 6:30pm. (It's not advertised anywhere so for those skipping around or searching) The main audience or ethnic group is Filipino but all are welcome if it wasnt already obvious from the flags. I thought I should mention this for some who may be looking for something specific but, of course, not a big deal as we are going for God not for the people. Would definitely revisit again. Only gripe is there is limited parking. I loved the welcoming spirit in this church. The worship & word definitely Holy Spirit inspired. The presence of the Lord reigned in the body of Christ. I will definitely be visiting again. Thank you keep doing what you doing keep fighting the good fight of faith🙏💕 They worship and praise with the whole heart. This is the best place to be if you are seeking Gods face. Experience the move of the Holy Spirit in the worship healing service. They were closed

name: Jesus La Roca - San Marcos Campus
Jesus Our Redeemer Church
reviewSummary:
I found this church through the 9Marks website, and I have never regretted it. The community groups and Bible studies are wonderful, and the people here are incredibly kind and welcoming.

If you’re looking for a church home, I highly recommend visiting and experiencing it for yourself! They offer Awana for kids, have talented musicians who lead beautiful worship that moves me to tears every time, and are filled with members who genuinely love Jesus Christ and their church.

This church is open to everyone. When I first came here, I wasn’t fully in Christ yet—I was in transition. Interestingly, the church has also been going through a transition. At first, I wasn’t sure what to think due to my lack of experience, but over time, I realized that this is a true, faithful church that continues to grow and serve God, no matter the season.

I want to express my gratitude to every person who contributes to the life of this church in any way. I’m so thankful to God for bringing me here! 🙏 The church has a new pastor and has been renovated recently. They love families and preach the Gospel faithfully. I was glad my niece told us about this church. We were visiting for the weekend and we're really glad to worship with you all. The music was great and the message from God's Word was extremely timely. This is a welcoming fellowship focused on their mission and I pray God's favor over them. Just stopped in, while on a layover. Everyone was supper friendly and inviting with a real love for those searching for truth. Worship starts at 1030 in a Beautiful old world church with modern lovers of Christ. Great experience.  Solid biblical teaching.

name: Jesus People Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment my husband and I walked through the doors, we were welcomed into such a warm and inviting church environment. Pastor Rowdy is a great shepherd who genuinely cares for and tends to his sheep. We haven’t experienced pastoral care like this before! Every member of the church makes you feel like family.

Our two-year-old, who has never been in care outside of family, transitioned so easily into the children’s ministry there. The leaders are very intentional about ensuring my little one feels safe, secure, and comfortable in their care.

If you’re searching for a new home church, I highly encourage you to visit Jesus People Church. This is a smaller church. Everyone is very friendly. You will meet people who will welcome you & remember your name. Sermons are sincere & awesome. Many activities & workshops during the week & weekends. Hope to meet you there & say hello. Incredible church!  My family attend here full time for 3 years when we were not traveling and we LOVED it.  Jesus/Joy filled church.  It’s like a family to do life with.  Jesus focussed and so encouraging! Rowdy and Ashli are the Best!   Have not been to there new building yet but I hear it’s amazing. I have been attending this church for a few years and I love it!  This church is a great place for families and offers programs for children and youth of all ages. The teachings are biblically sound, and the worship is truly joyous and heartfelt!  Pastor Rowdy has such a heart to impact people for Jesus and his joy is contagious!  I have found the pastors and staff to be incredibly authentic and I highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking for a place to grow in their faith and fellowship with other believers. Wonderful service.
Pastor teaches from the Bible.  He is filled with love for people.
He wants you to be set free through receiving Jesus Christ as your savior and the Lord.

name: Jews for Jesus - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
"Upside Down" is a wonderful coffee shop plus art and events space. New connections are warm and welcoming so, yes, check it out! The Tuesday night Bible study at 7 PM in Westwood, CA was wonderful, but unfortunately it has been cancelled while redevelopment is being done to the building until August 2016 sometime.  It would have been so nice if the Bible Study could have continued somewhere else while the building is under construction.
Also, I would like to suggest that Jews for Jesus starts another group called Jews for Christians so the Jewish leaders could teach Christians the many wonderful things covered in the Old Testament.  They could take Christians through the Feasts and their meanings and so many other Old Testament teachings.  This would allow Christians all over the world to better understand the Old Testament and God's special People, and to better support and finance the Jewish people.  I'm just saying, I think the Jews for Jesus group is missing an amazing opportunity for both Christians and the Jewish people. Incredible people with an incredible coffee shop downstairs! You should definitely visit some time! Love! Great organization!!

name: Johns Creek Christian Church - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary: The church is welcoming without being overbearing!  ALL are welcome really does mean ALL.  This is not just said, it is practiced. The church focuses on the message that Jesus loves us and that we are all worthy of that love.  The messages are up lifting.  You will leave a Sunday service feeling refreshed and ready to face the new week. Johns Creek CC is an open and welcoming community. Our family has been part of their church family for almost 10 years. We’re proud to be an Open & Affirming congregation that welcomes all people as they are with no conditions and honored to be part of the congregational vote that made it official. We have an active youth group and also strive to be a Green Chalice congregation to take great care of the beautiful world we’ve been given. JCCC is a welcoming place - a combination of traditional and modern with a message - all are welcome here. The sense of community and family are strong no matter if you are solo or part of a unit - genuine care that is needed and can be missing in these busy times. My kids look forward to Sunday every week. Mr. Patty at the nursery is the best! She has been very influential in teaching the kids manners and dealing with frustration. We love our church family! My niece and nephew go there for preschool. Nice and quiet place. Haven't attended service yet.

reviewSummary:
Great pastors, great people, a very loving community! Holy spirit is moving within. Great bible studies, great worship teams, awesome Sunday school and much more. So blessed to call this church my church🙏 I am a resident at St Marlo and it is amazing there are people praying every morning at this church. In the last five years of my father's life before he went to heaven he would go to morning prayers everyday. I now see the importance of early morning prayer in my personal walk with God. James Park You will love it here at JCKC!  It is a wonderful community and so much loving pastors and members! Always been in johns creek korean church. I love this place it’s like my 2nd home Very devoted church who focus on faith, fellowship, and serving the community.

name: Johns Creek Presbyterian Church - Johns Creek / Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
Very disappointing experience. The administration pushes conformity over individuality. Children who think or behave differently are quickly flagged for unnecessary therapies, seemingly due to management pressure on teachers. Beyond quick drop-offs and paid programs, there’s little value offered. Kids are expected to follow rigid rules rather than grow and thrive. Many positive reviews feel questionable. We’re relieved to be out, even though it cost us a few hundred dollars. I recommend looking for a better school nearby. We feel so grateful and blessed for our girls to be in school at JCP. The staff and teachers are so loving and make you feel like family. Our girls have flourished and grown here the last four years, and we recommend this terrific school to anyone searching for a safe, loving, and Christ-centered environment. I highly recommend JCP Preschool! My family loves it here and my kids are thriving in the fun, loving, and supportive environment. It is a wonderful place for your child to grow and learn in an encouraging and loving space. I couldn't be more happier to have my son here! Johns Creek Presbyterian preschool program excels in fostering a nurturing environment where the dedicated teachers prioritize individual attention for each child! Their commitment to evaluating kids' needs and offering on-site therapy resources showcases a commendable dedication to holistic child development. This program goes beyond education, ensuring the well-being and growth of every child in their care. This is a decent preschool….. if your child is a perfect little angel. I’m sure they love perfect angels that don’t have any challenges.

TL;DR. Don’t waste your time here. They are sweet and efficient but have no idea how to deal with less than perfect kids.

We put our 4 yr old kiddo in this preschool this year, hoping for a chance at some normalcy for this child who had already been through 9 surgeries, several of them open heart. Kiddo has been by all means a miracle child and has absolutely been through it. We discussed in depth with doctors, therapists, etc before making the decision to send him to school as the right decision.
However, as expected, kiddo got sick a bit more than the other kids as kiddos  immune system isn’t as strong. They have  strict sick policy, which we respect and understand.
At the end of October, we have our first conference. Nothing is mentioned except an issue with answering to kiddos name and acknowledging direction. Nothing new. Nothing mentioned about “educational value.” Fast forward to several weeks before Thanksgiving and sickness is going around. The normal kids are recovering in days, it’ takes our kiddo a week to consider sending him back. We try it, and end up having to come get kiddo. We are asked to keep kiddo home until the cough is completely gone. We finally send kiddo  back after Thanksgiving and 3 school days later, these people have the audacity to message and say kiddo is not getting “ any educational value” and would like us to remove kiddo from class.

Zero mention of this at the conference. Zero in the hundreds of messages they send weekly. They find a way to say “we can’t handle your kiddo , even though we said we could” They even tried to tell us how we should be parenting and thought we should “consider therapy.” Do you not listen? Doctors and therapists are who we consulted with to decide to send him to preschool!! Also, it’s your job to GIVE every child the educational value. Something every educator in your preschool should be able to do. Educational value is all on the teacher 🤷🏻‍♂️🤷🏻‍♂️We were thinking about sending our 2 year old next year. But thanks for saving us money and showing how bottom of the barrel your preschool is! Why did you say you would take kiddo on when we disclosed from the very first time we contacted your school that he had some health challenges. Why Lie?!?!

Stay away from this scam of a preschool. On the bright side their drop off is about as efficient as Chick Fil A …. So I guess 👍🏻⭐️⭐️

name: Johns Creek United Methodist Church - Johns Creek / Duluth Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been a part of this church for a while now but have never reviewed it. If you are looking for kind staff, friendly members, and an ‘ALL are welcome’ vibe, this is the church for you! They have a traditional and modern worship as well as small groups. The youth group is fantastic as well. Nice church space.  My son played in orchestra supporting North Gwinnett Woman's Choir. Old school pipe organ played pre concert was a nice touch. Enjoyed the first concert of the 2023-2024 season with family. The orchestra was top notch with a vibrant violin guest artist. The clarinet & flute players were exceptional. Beautiful sanctuary. Wooden bench seating wasn't a bother. Kindness & smiles everywhere. Worth a visit and more I went there last night to hear the Johns Creek Symphony.  I received a warm welcome. I was directed to a great seat and enjoyed great conversation before the concert and during the intermission with the most pleasant people to my right and left.  Everyone was very respectful exiting the parking lot.  Looking forward to the next concert. Webb Bridge Middle School sang the roof off on last night. Their combined 6th 7th and 8th graders did a wonderful job at the Fall Concert

name: Johnson Chapel AME Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: The FAMILY FRIENDLY ATMOSPHERE at this Church was very instrumental in helping me see ME!  I will always be Blessed by the experience. In winter, on Dec 23, 2022 this scene of church is great. Merry Christmas 2022. Amazing church... Everyone is welcoming. The choir is talented... The sermons are good.. Great atmosphere for praise, worship and healing. Excellent choir and preached word. Very nice church

name: Johnson Ferry Baptist Church
reviewSummary: A large Baptist church offering blended worship styles with strong family and children's ministry programs.

name: Joshua Generation Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wow!

If you’ve been searching for a place where the Holy Spirit is alive, where worship is passionate and authentic, and where the presence of God fills the room — Joshua Generation Church in San Clemente is truly something special.

The moment worship starts, you can feel heaven move. The musicians are gifted, but more importantly, they carry a genuine heart of worship. The atmosphere is joyful, reverent, and powerfully uplifting — it’s the kind of worship where people raise their hands not because they’re told to, but because they can’t help it.

The worship team is incredible. Kylie, one of the vocalists and worship leaders, has a beautiful, anointed voice — the kind that doesn’t just sound amazing, but shifts the atmosphere and invites the presence of God. Her worship is gentle, powerful, and full of love for Jesus. The band supporting her and the other singers is excellent — guitar, drums, keys — everything blends together to create a unified sound that lifts your spirit and reminds your heart who God is.

The preaching is Biblically strong, refreshing, and alive — real teaching that calls you deeper, but also comforts and strengthens you. It’s clear that this church is not just doing “services” — they are building disciples, community, and family.

As the founder of FaithFlow Records (a Christian worship and inspirational music label), I was truly moved. We are deeply interested in building relationships and possible future collaboration with the worship team here, because the heart, humility, and love for Jesus is REAL. This is the kind of worship that transforms lives.

If you are in San Clemente, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, or anywhere in South Orange County and you’re longing for a church where the presence of God is felt, the worship is anointed, and the people are genuine — Joshua Generation Church is a place to come and be renewed.

Praise God for what He’s doing here. Hallelujah. 🙏🔥 Spirit filled worship great teaching with biblical foundation. They really love you and treat you like family come here if you want you life to be turned upside down and begin a journey of growth. Love this place. From the second of walking in the front door, I felt family. There’s something special happening at Josh Gen San Clemente.  I’m so grateful for the growth that I and my family have made. Josh Gen San Clemente is an amazing place to experience the manifest Presence of God and truly encounter HIS love through others. If you want to experience  true joy in HIS Presence come and see that God is real, His son Jesus is preached and the Holy Spirit comes to heal, encourage and mature you in each and every gathering. I love this church body and I am thankful to be covered by this Elder lead leadership. Thank you Josh Gen SanC💕 I just love Josh Gen San Clemente. The people are welcoming and loving. It is a church family and people really care for each other. The children’s ministry is amazing and the worship always draws us into the presence of God.

name: Joshua Generation Church Newport Beach - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve tried this Church a couple times on a recommendation from a friend. Is it a small intimate congregation That is warm and welcoming. To me it’s a fresh breath air from the large churches. I highly recommend.

name: Journey Christian Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
The story of this young church is out of this world.  Their praise team is second to none (this side of heaven), their preacher's sermons are as engaging as he is and Biblically strong and solid, their youth minister is loved tremendously by the youth and their parents and provides them with great Bible knowledge...  This is a truly wonderful place to connect with our Lord and His people. This Church truly is a place where Christ dwells! This is the kind of church that remembers your name and how to pronounce it!

They care about the little things and some of the most generous people I have ever met.

The preaching is amazing and Jesus centered. Dusty the lead minister lives out the gospel and its so evident when you hear him speak. The youth group meets on Wednesdays @7 and the kids give it a glowing review. They seem to have a blast with one another while learning about who God says they are!

They have a children's program on Sundays during the service, new borns all the way up to 11 year olds!

I feel safe while at the church, the people are genuinely kind and care to get to know you. If you are on the fence, just give a try and see what happens. This is wonderful, non-denominational, Christian church. Every body here welcome new followers to "come as you are". The pastor preaches amazing sermon's, straight from the bible, and the children's/youth ministry is amazing as well. Journey Christian church is by far the best all-around church I have ever attended. I have been to many churches of all sizes from mega church two very small and many different denominations. The congregation at JCC is the friendliest I have seen and the preaching is directly out of the Bible, delivered in a way that allows you to understand the greatest book of all time.  If you want to learn how our creator’s message applies to your life, This is the perfect place for you. Awesome and welcoming congregation that will take you as you are. They will love you and encourage you through your journey with Christ. Giving back to the community is a priority and having fun is part of the deal. Love it here! ❤️

name: Journey Christian Church - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a great experience. The pastor was super friendly and seemed really humble and genuine in his words. Juan, who welcomed us, was also very kind.
May God bless and strengthen the church more and more each day. This review is LONG time OVERDUE as I wrestled with God for several years of constant praying! (Gen 32, 1 Thessalonians 5:14) I rarely write reviews on Churches.
But, for some reason I was compelled by the leading of the Holy Spirit in writing this one. I have attending this church on and off  for about 4-5 years because at that time I was new to the area and was looking for (in prayer) a home Church.
I left because I had Surgery and was unable to do anything for several months including driving so I swallowed my pride, took the advise of other godly people (Proverbs 11:14) with deep love & compassion reached out to Journey Church of which I have been attending at that time for help (Pastor Scott and then by Pastors direction Lisa) for Any help they could graciously offer would have been appreciated. (I live about 5 minutes from the church) When I first attended Lisa had no problem coming to my home and placing a Journey sign without asking permission in front of my home, which HOA later made me take down.
But, when I was in need (Because of surgery) for any help perhaps taking me to church since I could not drive, cooking a meal or any other need they were willing to provide (I was not picky or demanding in ANYWAY) There are several Bible verses that says we should Help each other especially in time of need with love (The Book of James 2:14-17; 1 John 3:17; Deuteronomy 15:7-11; Galatians 5:13; Micah 6:8; Zechariah 7:9 and the list goes on) But, instead of help in ANYWAY Pastor Scott sent me a message telling me to stop bothering it's members! First off, I wasn't bothering anybody and just following the churches direction and second where is the love and compassion? I was suffering in pain from a surgery I just had and needed a little help. Its not like I live far or asking for money or anything like that I just needed a little help, compassion, love, prayers, or anything they could do was all appreciated but, when I read his message my heart just sank and others I showed (I just wanted clarification If I was reading his message correctly) The Bible says seek the advise of others (Proverbs 11:14; 27:17; 12:15) Their eyes practically came out of their head. Needless to say I left.
In reading Ephesians 4:32 believing everyone deserves a second or more + chances to explain what they meant by their text, forgiveness, not to be offended, shake hands ETC.. I made appointment with Pastor Scott to talk about what happened when I had surgery and about that text message I received from him as I read too him the message for clarification. I had a lets move on mentality so I can perhaps be a part of their church family and see where I can fit in because my kids enjoyed going there and it was incredibly close to my home so I felt I could really help and be a part of the church family But, Instead when I made the appointment to talk with Pastor Scott in his office I was meet with an attitude of "I was bothering him" , "We don't help people" and "What do you/I want"? there were no miss-understanding, He meant what he said in his text message, I was unable to ask it's church members for anything and the look on his face was one of the "What do you need"? You're not a member of our church and we only help members! WOW! Needless to say I won't be back and for those considering Journey, remember this,  that everything is fine as long as you don't ask the church for any help or needs (Big or small) and you never see the True heart of the church, pastors or it's leaders until that need arises.
(Disclaimer: This is my opinion based on my personal experience.) Very blessed to be part of this community of God! It's impossible not to feel the Holy Spirit during worship, band and whole music ministry is amazing! To God be the Glory! The programs they do for their community, involvement and the pastors are blessed to relay the Word of God in a very engaging, relatable easier to digest way and very encouraging. 🙏 We love going here. Pastor Scott gives a great sermon. The worship is awesome and the staff is awesome. I love how they are involved with community service. God is great! I’ve been too many churches in this area, but I have to say this church is the most general genuinely welcoming

name: Journey Church - Avon Campus - Avon Campus
reviewSummary:
After many months and miles of searching for a home church, I am grateful and honored to say I’ve found it. I’ve been attending TJC for nearly a year (online for the first several weeks), and the Sunday I had the courage to walk through the doors, I immediately called my husband after the service and said “I don’t know what I was waiting for; this is the one.” The atmosphere is warm and inviting. The congregation and its pastors are humble and caring. The services are relevant, honest, and full of hope. The worship service is always on fire! From the incredible diversity of our people, to the partnership with Pathway of Hope to serve those in need in our community, to the feeling of belonging regardless of where you are on your faith journey, there’s no place like Journey Church. Thank you, TJC, all of its pastors and volunteers that make it a place to call home! ❤️
And reader, if you’re considering attending a service here and are feeling anxious about trying something new, message me. I’d be happy to save you a seat next to me ☺️ Absolutley the best church. I searched other churches with my two boys. Then we went to the journey and it felt like home . The ministry I can not really explain it but they are actually genuine you can just feel it . They are very Ivvolved with their church members . I LOVE worship and when I went the first time and was  at worship.. I was like this church is it . Amazing people and very welcoming . It's fun to go!! The Journey Church is a great place to meet new people. They are very welcoming and caring people. The love to worship The Lord and they care about the community. They have great small groups. The Journey Church is truly a family! Very diverse, welcoming, and loving church. I’ve truly never felt more welcomed at a church as I do here. Also, so many different small groups and ministries for every age group! The Journey Church is awesome!! Great worship, service, and community.
So many ways to get plugged in with groups and activities.
I came to TJC almost 2 years ago as an Agnostic. Since then I’ve been Baptized in the name of God and my faith journey has been exciting. Whenever I’m in need of advice, guidance and or support, I know that TJC family is there to help.
Check us out online and then come see us in person.
Have a blessed day!

name: Journey Church - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Mike is fabulous. He is accessible, engaging, self-deprecating, and speaks from the heart.  A great communicator.  And the congregation is a reflection of Mike… loving, warm and we have each others’ backs. Solid group here! The singing was very good and the sermon was meaty, challenging, and appropriate for application today. Jesus focused. Enough said We have been to many churches in Nashville/Franklin since moving here. But Journey is by far our favorite. Pastor Mike has been there about a year and he is so humble, and challenges people to think about the bible in the context in which it’s written. The church also believes in inviting everyone in for a discussion rather than preaching at you. We love it! Been going to Journey for over a decade. I’ve seen the church ebb and flow through many seasons of life. Different staff, different buildings, but the message and community has always impacted my soul. This is the place where I found true relationship with God and a real community. This is a church of authenticity, they value vulnerability and the word. Much of my healing was restored in and along side of this community. Couldn’t recommend enough. Amazing place.  Good people and practical messages.  They hold to scripture and deliver into the whole of the Trinity, not shying from one of the person's.  They emphasize Bible, history, science, and humor.  Several times there have been live question and answer services.  Sometimes the answer is "I don't know", and they aren't afraid to admit it.  Great place if you want personal relationships with the members, too.

name: Journey Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
If we didn’t move, we would have stayed at this church. What an amazing place with wonderful people. The Pastor and his Wife are so kind and genuine. It’s a smaller group that treats you like family the second you walk in the door. I absolutely loved it here. With all of the huge churches near Vegas that can be overwhelming, I would highly recommend this one to anyone wanting to get plugged in to a wonderful group of people. The Pastors lesson was excellent and it kept my attention. We felt truly welcomed here and will really miss this church. My husband and I have helped out a handful of churches over the last 9 years of ministry together. We can say with absolute confidence, that Journey church is by far one of the most amazing places you will ever step foot in. No judgment whatsoever..just come as you are… taste and see, trust me, you’ll leave wanting more! I tell all the first time guest that I bump into or any of the regular attendees, that it doesn’t get any more genuine that what you see at Journey. Pastors Jeremy and Erin are truly phenomenal people and have a heart for loving, serving and leading everyone and anyone to the Lord. My husband and I were on vacation and visited Journey Church last Sunday, June 13, 2021. We enjoyed service so very much. Worship was wonderful and the message from Pastor so encouraging. Everyone
was so friendly and kind. If you live in the Vegas area this is a welcoming place filled with the Spirit of God for you to find a home church. Blessings! We LOVE Journey Church! I felt like I was at home the minute I walked in the door. REAL people who genuinely care about every single person that walks through their doors. They have a wonderful children's ministry, too! You will learn true biblical teachings from Pastor Jeremy that you can apply to your 2021 life here! Highly recommend! I have visited here many times and usually found the worship service powerful and God centered. I found the message to be truthful and practical. Today Jeremy and Erin turned it up a couple of notches! Erin’s worship leadership led to a song about God pouring out his wonderful spirit on us. Of course that song was aimed right at me. Jeremy gave us a message about figuring out where you want to live: in God’s river or your own swamp. It is sad to say I have lived in a swamp of my own making for over 40 years. Jeremy, Erin, it’s time I discover God’s love in the river. Thank you

name: Journey Church - Huntersville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going to this church for over 20 years.  The staff are amazing, caring, helpful people.  My kids enjoy church, not just attend because we do.  We are all God's people, sharing and spreading his love and message of absolute hope through Him. We have been at Journey for 5 years and love it. We love the fact that our church does not sugar coat the Scriptures but teaches them clearly with humility and compassion and humor. Pastor Matt does a great job at keeping the congregation engaged, growing, and laughing with sermons that are applicable to our lives and filled with the Bible.
Questions and being anywhere on your faith journey are welcome & encouraged.

There is an amazing children’s & youth ministry where the leaders know families by name and love you.

When our family went through a hard time, the church surrounded us with meals, prayers, and encouragement!

I also love the church’s heart for outreach in the community and globally. The best way to get plugged in to our church is definitely through finding a place to serve and a small group to join.  We love our Journey family. I’ve called Journey Church “home” since 2010. I met my wife there. Got married there. And our now almost 5 year old daughter loves KidStreet (the small children programs) and cannot wait for Sunday to roll around.

I’ve had so many wonderful moments at Journey. I’ve met some of my best friends at this church. Over all, Journey Church’s heart is to humbly point everyone to absolute hope. That hope is Jesus. We’d love to have you at Journey. I had been searching for a church since I moved into the area. My first visit I was welcomed right in. Greeters are very friendly and welcoming, service is fantastic. This church is very grounded, biblical based. Worship is casual, come as you are. Pastor Matt is a great pastor and teacher. I've been very blessed to find this church and I look forward to going! Sorry I haven’t been to your church but I live in Newland and work at the Ingles’s up here in Newland and noticed that you guys sponsored for the SWEET T AND ROOSTER BBQ who came and set up in the parking lot

name: Journey Church - Placentia Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is doing an incredible job spreading the Gospel. Taking care of children during the summer break is truly no easy task, but the teachers are so friendly and represent the church wonderfully. It’s the best way for children and parents to encounter God. Journey Church is a community of individuals interconnected by God's grace!
Journey Church is a safe space for the broken and a launching pad for the strong!
Journey Church is where discipleship happens, where God's children are bold, and destines forged!
Journey Church is a breeding ground for God's divine vision to unfold.
Journey Church is the place I call home! Thank you for hosting an array of folks from all walks of life, in what was as welcoming an atmosphere as anyone could ever expect. At the end of the day, the biggest blessing was how seemingly effortless you brought us all together as though we were one. So sorry this only allows me to give Journey Church five stars for the awesome breakfast they held on Saturday, October 12, 2019!

Jeannine Maldonado
Representing Unite Here Local 11 As a disciple of Jesus for 28 years I cannot recommend this church. The leadership is filled with pride and refused to even meet with me when I first started attending the church. Their women dress immodestly which is just the tip of the iceberg. They are only 2 years old, but seriously need to clean up their act in my humble opinion. I grew up going to church, but never anything like Journey Church in Fullerton.  Real people, real community, real love.  Pastor Hector and Enoc are the real deal. Love their children's, youth and women's ministry. My husband has found his tribe with the men's ministry.  This is home.

name: Journey Church San Antonio - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
📣📣📣 Updated after attending

So.....
My daughter lives here in San Antonio; I'm from California.  I have been looking for aChurch that I could attend when I visit.  I was scrolling through the ones nearest to my daughters place and came across a One star review.  It had to do with his disapproval on tithing and the way the Pastor delivered it 🤔
And that was my deciding factor ...... this will be the one that I am choosing to go to tomorrow AND I am bringing my Grandson🙌🏻
It took me alooooong time to get comfortable with tithing and truly understanding the biblical practice.  The giving and understanding gifts we are given to live out the obedience of what God is asking of us.  Not only to thank him for the provisions he has provided us with but also proving that he can trust and bless us with more so that we are able to give more.
I've seen it time and time again when people are convicted and then get angry the church or the pastor giving a sermon on the topic.
Currently, my church back home in California, @shepherdchurch in Porter Ranch has been going over the same topic for weeks.... and I'm loving it! I welcome a church that convicts me and make me a little uncomfortable ..... we are supposed to have those conversations to be better.
SEE YOU TOMORROW!

And for the gentleman that left the one star ...... I'm going to pray for you so that your heart, ears, and mind are open to understanding and receiving the Glorious lives of the good Lord has in store for you when you listen to him and are obedient....... God bless you!
🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣🟣

📣 NEXT DAY… (continuing my review)

I returned the following day, and from the moment I arrived, the atmosphere was genuinely welcoming. The parking team, greeting team, and hospitality crew were all kind, attentive, and intentional—small details that truly set the tone. (And yes, the coffee was very appreciated ☕️)

Before service even began, I was blessed with a meaningful, heartfelt conversation with a woman who attends this Church that made the experience feel even more personal.

Worship was powerful and spirit-filled, and the message resonated deeply—one of those moments where you feel it was meant just for you. I also had the opportunity to personally thank the Pastor and Worship Team which meant a lot.

While visiting my daughter out of state, I was hoping to find a church that felt like home… and I absolutely did. My spirit was full, and my heart was grateful.
Journey Church was truly the right choice 🙌🏻

Thank you and God bless you all! I started attending Journey Church in late November 2025 after leaving a small church with an unhealthy, legalistic environment. I was looking for a church that was more established and organized, and Journey has exceeded my expectations.

The preaching is solid and practical. I feel like the pastors do an excellent job of combining humor with Biblical truth. For instance, Pastor Tre's recent message about how peace reigns in the middle of noise (not by removing it) was exactly what I needed to hear. The worship is authentic without feeling performance-driven.

What really stands out is the healthy leadership culture here. Pastor Mike called me within 24 hours of my first visit and actually remembered my name when I came back. They even cancel the last Sunday service of the year to give volunteers a break and let families spend time together - that's church-life balance done right.

Coming from a performance-based spiritual environment where burnout was almost a badge of honor, Journey's grace-based approach has been life-changing. I can receive without guilt, serve from overflow when ready, and say no without being guilt-tripped.

If you're in (or coming from) an unhealthy church environment where you're expected to put the church's needs above your own, I promise you'll find rest here at Journey. Grace instead of legalism. Health instead of burnout. Authentic community instead of performance pressure.

The 11:30am Sunday morning service works great for my irregular schedule. If you’re looking for a church where you can come as you are, you’ll enjoy your visit at Journey. The pastor delivered a messaged that did not align with New Testament doctrine. His message to tithe felt inauthentic and poorly delivered. Pastor Trey spoke at our winter retreat this weekend. He was great, and truly connected with our kids and parents. We saw some incredible life change. Pastor Trey mentioned we should check out Journey since we're in San Antonio for Christmas. We did, and we're so glad. The worship was amazing and the people were so hospitable. We wished we lived closer, because this would be our church. Pastor Trey is a great youth pastor and I know his students loved being there. Check out this church if you're looking for a great home to learn and grow. Love this church. A great start to a New Journey in life

name: Journey Church Tucson - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: Journey is extremely welcoming. We've only been for a few months, but they have been great. Its the most family friendly church I've ever been too. Plus, very welcoming for those with disabilities. We plan to continue and get even more involved. Exceptional church and teachings. I love their added discipleship and classes they offer. Recently, they offered “How we love” classes for marriage, friendship and  especially how we love God. How people love in general public also displayed by our own intentional living. My favorite was dealing with child hood triggers! (Painful wasn’t fun, but outcome was the best)  Pastor Jim and Stacey (husband and wife) were vulnerable to show real life situations with using their transparency of their own marriage, attachments of their true child hood traumas that trigger when in life causes those triggers. I can’t imagine a better place and people to create this trust circle to be vulnerable with, to create a “comfort circle” to heal. So now we can go home and do that with those we love. Last night was our last class, and I felt more free than I have ever felt. Weight lifted (had to check the scale thought I lost 50 pounds) yet the weight was in my mind and heart for too long. To be free is literally that, free the pain. Thanks Jim and Stacy. Incredible class! May more people be blessed to come from these teachings! The pastor was legit cool. "Armor of God all day homie!!" Roman Royal Red Tunic...Great sermon... We have been looking for a church home when after attending a few other, we found Journey.  I looked up their services and listened to a sermon. We went to their Mothers day service. Our son was welcomed in their very large and nice children's care. The ministries just for the children are huge. Small groups, groups for everyone. I could see getting connected really easy but let's get thru the 1st service. Since it was mothers day,  the service was different but perfect. It was more about the celebration outside. Catering, water slides for the kids, games everywhere, food, people, food trucks. For free to my surprise.  We felt already like part of the family. We have been back for the past few months and find their doctrine is all about Jesus and the Word. We have invited friends and neighbors.  Everyone is welcome here. All abilities. Not impressed with this Minister since the last time I attended... Noticed that most of the Black people / who are who are primarily Africans we're seated in  the back of the church... None in the choir... No acknowledgment from the minister for any visitors that were there ..only greeting I received was  was from the person at the door.. and someone sitting next to me and that was it...

name: Journey community church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful church. Friendly members wanting to grow the church. Pastor is warm and sensitive and extremely knowledgeable of the Bible and its history. Friendly, welcoming church. Going through growing pains. COME VISIT. Good and friendly people! It was fantastic. Like it

name: Journey Community Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
This chuch hosts a food pantry every week, in drive through style. I attended their Second Friday of the Month Food Pantry and was surprised with how much produce in great condition and quality I received.
It starts at 9 and I arrived at 8:30 and there was a long line already so something to keep in mind if you plan on attending.
I was also able to get diapers for my baby.
The staff is amazing and very kind, thank you Journey Community Church for all that you do for the community. Great worship, sermons, and people! Come get prayed for! Christmas Eve services: December 23 4pm & 6pm, December 24 2pm & 4pm! Regular services: Friday 6:30pm, Sunday 9am & 11am! Just moved to La Mesa from North County, where I had played at a few church's on worship. So, I was looking for a place with a friendly atmosphere, great message and powerful worship. After checking out a few others I decided on  Journey Community for my new home church. They actually play their music with some decent volume, which I love😁🙏 and they just have a great campus with lots of opportunities to get involved. Very friendly people and I really liked the pastor's message.I love it! I went here on a Friday night for church service. The worship was upbeat and very enjoyable. Paul Hicok was teaching about the case for Easter. He was great. He is a natural at public speaking and engaging the audience. I really enjoyed this service. We've been attending Journey for 11 years and love everything about it. Every pastor greets and gets to know every member, new or old, on a first-name basis. Ed is the most amazing and genuine man we've ever known and his wife, Linda, is incredible too. There is always something going on there on campus, seven days a week. From small groups, to youth ministry, to holiday events, and the summer camp our middle daughter has attended four years running. I've given other churches a try that are closer or have services on other days and nothing compares to the feeling of home at Journey. There's zero politics in the sermons, no agendas, no "give us your money to be saved" vibe you get at other churches. The worship is the best anywhere, the message series are meticulously picked and planned, and even the guest pastors are a perfect fit. We'll never find another spot that can compare!

name: Journey Community Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary:
Journey Community Church is a church for all people in any stage of your life . This church is about its community and loving people unconditionally. Pastor Bobby, Caleb, Alan , Keith , and Tracey are an amazing pastoral leadership team. Every week one of these leaders give you the dangerous message of Jesus Christ . We have been here for over 15 years and our children have grown up loving the lord and serving here at Journey . My aunt goes here And some of my other family and we actually really enjoy it and my little siblings. Enjoy the journeyland! They welcomed me into their youth group this year. I’m so glad I joined. I love, love, LOVE my church ❤️  I thank God that He led me to Journey! Sunday is my favorite day of the week because I get to come here!
If you prefer a less crowded service, opt for the 12 o'clock! So thankful for this place, Pastor Bobby, and the wonderful staff ❤️
I just wish there was a Wednesday night service! 🤞 Online service has many minutes of song, but cuts off in the middle of the final prayer because they've used up all the time. Either extend the online, or cut the music.

name: Journey Evangelical Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending Journey for several years now, and I can honestly say that this church really loves God! One of Journey's greatest strengths is the family atmosphere. The pastoral staff is strong, and the congregation is active in its community. There are lots of events for all ages! It's encouraging to see people from all stages of life serve meaningfully in various ministries. This is a great place for both individuals and families to check out while visiting the area, as well as those seeking to find a new family and home. Our family has been attending Journey for a long time, it is a family reunion church and very welcoming to vistors.  We encourage you to hang around and enjoy our weekly refreshments and get to know the other attendees.  We are a multi-cultural church, anglo pastor, hispanic children's minister and bi-cultural youth director.  We are located in Little Saigon, but reach out to many people that live throughout Orange County.  We have  single service at 10:30AM, but also a Family Bible Hour at 9:15AM.  We are mostly second third generation asian professionals, so you will fit right in!! Largely an Asian congregation. Very friendly, welcoming and kind to all who attend, no matter ethnicity nor socioeconomic status. Stopped by because of a post for food and such on CL. Not only did I get some tasty food but it felt more like a family BBQ and I have only been in California for a few months so I don't know anyone here. I will be back, very nice church. Thanks for the food and God Bless There are three Sunday services on the same campus, English, Cantonese, and Vietnamese.  Plenty of parking inside and outside the gate.

name: Journey of Faith Church - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband, 10 yr old daughter and I love it here. The pastors are gentle, warm and community oriented, and bring wisdom from biblical teachings. The format is action oriented and music based. Pastors Jason, Krista, Alex and Jill are gems and help you connect with the spirit. I forgot the name of the Care pastor as well and he is wonderful and kind too. Ushers seemed fake when we entered, they were a bit creepy as I walked in. I felt that it was a very awkward environment and the people there were only concerned with the people they already knew. It's like one big exclusivity club. Overall not a great church and wouldn't consider going back. Best Church I’ve been to in YEARS and it has absolutely brought me back to putting Jesus first in my life. The staff is friendly, the pastors are so full of love and support, and the sermons aren’t going to put you to sleep and are relatable. I found this church through a care group, and if that isn’t the work of God I don’t know what is!! I have been attending for about 9 years and have grown immensely in my walk with the Lord. My knowledge and understanding of the Bible has grown as well as my character.  Very friendly, not intimidating, plenty of activities for people of all ages to become a part of. I absolutely love this church! :-) If it was not for my Best Friend.  Randy and his wife Sharron from Mira Costa High School (Which is next door) Being so persistent in getting me to a service.  I would have missed out on this "Jewel 💎 of a place". As soon as Jason came on stage I felt at home.
I read some of the other reviews and feel sorry for one lady who complained about such a short service.  To her I would say give it another try.
I'm dying of A GBM Brain 🧠 Tumor grade IV.  I now know where I'm going after my debilitating horrible horrendous Pain I'm in.  Where I'm going for the next phase God has planned for me.

name: Journey of Faith Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: Love this place!! Great people, amazing services, and great love of God.  Would recommend either the Manhattan Beach or Torrence. Friendly — Greeters accommodate and engage in conversation.  You feel visible at Journey. A wonderfully welcoming church with great music and a terrific kids program. Great group of people. Friendly and helpful. A Good place: to know and grow in our Good God...

name: Journey South Bay Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I love the friendly people here. Pastors give out standing messages and sermons and really care about the people who go here.. This is a fabulous nondenominational church for all ages. Everyone can feel accepted, and have the ability to grow in their faith.  Pastor David brings the Bible to life and captures the scripture(s) with knowledge so individuals can apply to their life, and/or understanding the context in which it was written.  I recommend it to all. Love everything about this church!  The pastor does an amazing job making the Bible applicable to every day life. Highly recommended for spirtual growth and fellowship, with special praises to the Friends of Angels program for families with amazing kids with Autism. Very welcoming and casual home church. So glad I found Journey! Praise our Lord and savior Jesus Christ, Amen. Solid Bible teaching in a very grace-filled loving hospitable environment. A definite plus is their ministry to families affected by autism, Friends of Angels!

name: Joy Church - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary:
welcoming, friendly, loving, anointed people! im a teenager and the leadership and members of the body have played an extremely significant role in my walk with God! God has used this church to shape and mold me into the person i am today, and is still molding me into the person i will be tomorrow! The lead pastors are humble, on fire, and super passionate abt launching worshipers and evangelists and prophets into the world! The worship pastor has given me so many opportunities to grow in my musical gifts and leading worship! the youth pastor has literally changed my life in SO many ways! his passion for putting Jesus first has inspired all my friends into fully surrendering to the lord and putting him first! The spirit moves through the hunger of the congregation and leadership in the most incredible and powerful ways! i would 100% recommend visiting, and if you are looking for a church to settle, this is a very welcoming place. if u have kids, u will find the youth group on Wednesday’s a place where your children will grow and find positive influences as friends. Diverse body of worshipers. The teaching is solid Bible Based applicable instruction. Im not a member but I have attended regularly and my experience has been consistently good. There are two services on Sunday and a podcast is available on the church website if you want to hear the sermon. Just visiting the area for the Holidays. This is a lovely church body! I love that they have integrity when it comes to finances! The message was filled with the word of God. They also believe that the Gifts are for today! If I were staying in this area I would probably call this church my home church! You learn and grow spiritually!

My partner and I just moved from South Florida and we're seeking a new house to spirituality recieve and be challenged as disciples and children of God. We love worship, the kingdom of God, being equipped, churches that support community causes, and that is busy working for the Lord.

This church has been amazing and we have grown and hope to continue to grow more in God and loving others. Amazing Church full of God fearing people. Father and son that Lead and co-lead the ministry. Very authentic and Spirit filled, definitely In alignment with scripture. They also have a great youth ministry and kids church.

name: Joy Church - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary: We have been attending Joy Church for two years. Pastor Jim teaches the Word of God every service. He knows the Bible and can quote it better than any pastor I have known. My wife and I joined the church and were welcomed. I serve on the Connection Team and Joy to Mow. Kids and Youth ministries are awesome. Highly Recommend this church! Joy Church International is fantastic. We are just a face in the crowd, but I enjoy just being able to attend and enjoy the service after many years of working in a ministry setting. The hospitality is phenomenal, the parking is tight but they do a great job of staffing to move traffic flow in and out, and the facilities are great. The worship team is as good of quality of music and production as you would expect anywhere in Nashville. I visit Joy church today. The staff was so sweet and friendly the congregation just greeted me with a smile. The users was so sweet to me. And I really enjoyed the message for today. The church is growing rapidly and there were overcrowding problems this past year, but that has recently been addressed by moving from 1 to 2 services! Dismal hospitality, cliquey congregation.

Hospitality: Nobody at the welcoming table bats an eye at you when you enter, they dont try to help spot available seats in an already-overcrowded room, and there isnt even freaking water offered to congregants.

name: Jubilee Christian Center - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
Faithful and loving community. They prayed for me for years, since becoming a new mom I have a relationship with Jesus! I got baptized here and married the next day and had the privilege of getting marriage counseling. This is truly a wonderful church! I have been searching for a while now, to find a place that l can finally call my Christian Home. Jubilee Christian Center, checks all the boxes and so much more! The spirit of love, welcome, diversity, open worship with songs, study groups, biblical words of truth & encouragement, childcare & activities, outreach & overseas ministry & support. No need to search any where else! This is the place to be! Our family has been part of Jubilee for years, and we’re so grateful for this church. Every time we walk in, we’re greeted with warmth, sincerity, and a sense that this is a community that truly loves Jesus and one another. It’s a place where you’re not just welcomed—you’re known.

Now serving on staff, I’m even more convinced of the heart behind this church’s mission to develop Spirit-filled followers of Jesus across generations.

If you’re searching for a church home or visiting the area, I’d encourage you to come experience Jubilee for yourself. Attending Jubilee Christian Center, located at 4650 Shirley Gate Rd, Fairfax, VA 22030, offers numerous advantages that contribute to personal growth, community engagement, and spiritual enlightenment. The center is renowned for its commitment to fostering a welcoming environment where individuals from diverse backgrounds can explore and deepen their faith.

Firstly, Jubilee Christian Center places a strong emphasis on community. By participating in worship services, educational programs, and various outreach activities, attendees have the opportunity to connect with like-minded individuals who share their values and beliefs. This fosters a sense of belonging and support, which is integral for personal and spiritual development.

In addition to community engagement, the center provides a range of programs tailored to various age groups and interests. From Sunday school for children to Bible study groups for adults, there is something for everyone. These programs are designed not only to enhance biblical knowledge but also to encourage meaningful discussions that can lead to profound personal insights.

Furthermore, the center often hosts events that promote spiritual growth through thought-provoking sermons and teachings. These sermons are typically delivered by knowledgeable and experienced leaders who are dedicated to guiding attendees in their spiritual journey. This environment of learning and reflection is conducive to nurturing one’s faith and understanding of core Christian principles.

Moreover, Jubilee Christian Center actively engages in outreach initiatives, emphasizing service to the community and those in need. This commitment to helping others aligns with the teachings of compassion and charity found in the Christian faith, providing individuals with the chance to make a positive impact in the lives of others. Participating in these initiatives not only benefits the community but also cultivates a sense of purpose among attendees.

Lastly, attending services at a reputable establishment like Jubilee Christian Center can provide a space for personal reflection and renewal. The peaceful atmosphere and emphasis on worship allow individuals to step away from the chaos of daily life, fostering spiritual rejuvenation and introspection.

In conclusion, whether one is seeking spiritual growth, community connection, or opportunities for service, Jubilee Christian Center serves as an excellent choice. Its comprehensive range of programs, commitment to outreach, and fostering of a supportive community make it a valuable resource for those looking to deepen their faith and connect with others within their community. name: Just North UCC - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
As a long time member of North Congressional UCC I can't imagine going anywhere else for Sunday worship and for finding a "family of choice". The church is open and affirming. The congregation is small and mostly adults, and older adults. The pastor is vested in the opinion that church attendance is dwindling. I don't feel like a lot is going on there to attract new young families. The lectures are impersonable, more like a book study. More of a worship and praise sermon. I've started going to King Avenue Church instead. North Congregational UCC had been one of the earliest churches in central Ohio to fully welcome LGBT people. Now, North Congregational UCC is an extremely diverse congregation.

Though I have never been at North Congregational UCC on a Sunday morning, I attend several events there each year; in addition, there are several events at that church that I would like to be able to attend but am unable to.

One of my favorite events each year is the annual "Christmas Eve Family Service" that always includes a completely non-traditional reenactment of the Nativity story during which the many children who are present that evening are invited to portray any of the traditional characters who they wish --  without regard to gender or any other characteristic -- in a completely unique reenactment of the Nativity story.

On a Saturday evening close to the July 22 Mary Magdalene Feast Day, North Congregational UCC hosts an annual "Mary Magdalene Celebration" that typically includes either a worship service [in the sanctuary] or a presentation [in Fellowship Hall] that tells some of the story of Mary Magdalene, and, in the past [though not at present], has included a meal of Middle Eastern food.

During April 2018, North Congregational UCC had hosted and had sponsored a one-day conference, "Gen Silent: Giving Voice to LGBTQ Older Adults," that had been a forum for the discussion of the unique needs of LGBTQ seniors, some of whom find that they must "go back into the closet" when they are requesting the continuing care that they will need as they age.

If you are looking for a liberal and welcoming community, I strongly recommend North Congregational UCC. I love this church! I've been a member for over 20 years. Wonderful people, extravagant welcome, come as you are and all welcome. Really all. A warm extra extended family for me and my kids.  Strong social justice view.  Open and affirming.
