name: Katy Church of Christ - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
The members are extremely welcoming and never do anything offensive. Always make others feel at home. There's no judgement, just love. The church of Christ in Katy is a beautiful mix of diverse people who blend perfectly together in worship and in fellowship with common goals – to follow Christ with the bible as our ultimate authority, to grow together in knowledge and truth, and to bring others to Christ.  You can’t find a more loving, passionate and genuine group of believers anywhere.  If you seek to worship God in spirit and truth and to grow as a Christian and be surrounded by loving people, this would be a great place to visit. The church of Christ in Katy has truly been a blessing in my life. I was raised at this congregation and when I moved back to Katy after college I continued to attend. Currently I serve as a deacon and can not imagine a more loving and generous congregation.

The elders strive above all else to lead us in the truth of God's Word. The bible classes and sermons help everyone to grow in knowledge and understanding of the Bible. There are classes and activities for all age groups and an extremely active youth group for 6th-12th grade.

If you have any questions or would like any more information please reach out and let us know how we can help. My wife and I moved to the Katy area in 2001, after only being married for one year.  We specifically moved to this area because of the active youth group (6th-12th grades) and sound doctrine.  Funny thing - we didn't even have kids then!  However, both of us grew up going to churches with a small number of kids, and we both wanted our kids to experience the benefits of having a large youth group.

The elders are focused on teaching the doctrine found in the New Testament, and the members are active in many good works.  Average attendance on Sunday morning is 400-500, so large enough to be large, but small enough to recognize everyone.

We now have 3 kids, and I am excited that they are getting involved with the youth group. Katy Church of Christ follows the bible in all things.  Love is seen everywhere.  A very active church reaching out into the world to help
others.  Lots of ways to get involved.  Everyone is welcome.  I have worshipped there 9 years.  A bible versed church!

We moved to Northwest Arkansas concerned about finding a church home, as we loved our previous church prior to moving. Thankfully we were very pleased to connect at Keypoint and find a church were we can be involved and make a difference!

Keypoint has contemporary type music that's quite high energy, a very laid back atmosphere, coffee available at all services, and a lot of friendly people.

This church is very interesting. I've attended two services now and decided I'm probably not coming back. If you want to attend a Hillsong concert every Sunday and know how much Jesus loves you, this is the church for you. Its like some millennials we're like "let's make a church bro" and were given unlimited amounts of money. Fog machines, hipster clothing, exhilarating light show, world's loudest drummer and a worship band that looks like they just drank 3 monsters before they went on stage. It's okay to be pumped up about Jesus, but are you this way about Jesus everyday or just Sunday? This church is very worship experience driven, hence the long review over that piece. The sermons are decent, they're just too much "me" focused in my opinion. The website beliefs page is a little bit confusing because it says We are saved by grace through faith in Jesus Christ: His death, burial, and resurrection. Salvation is a gift from God, not a result of our good works or of any human efforts, yet they have two sacraments (meaning you have to do them or else you're not saved) that are water baptism and the Lord's supper. So I can't have faith without baptism and Lord's supper? On a good note, the traffic control is great and they welcome new comers decently. We just love Keypoint. Have been going on and off for 10 years now. It’s something we look forward to each week. They have a great location right in the Bentonville / Rogers area. They are very into helping the local community along with others over seas. You can come in and be yourself here.

name: King's Cross Church of San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Great new church. Casual atmosphere. Sort of a mix of Baptist and non-denominational.  Lots of young adults. Pastor is a good Bible teacher that adds in humor, stories and illustrations; I enjoy him!  Members worked together and gave the community a wonderful outdoor service and carnival. Where to begin!

My husband and I moved to San Diego August of 2020. It was nerve wracking to be moving to a new place amidst COVID and the isolation that it brings. We attended King’s Cross our first weekend here and fell in love! The hospitality of this church is amazing. We instantly felt connected and a part of a community. They do a wonderful job staying on top of COVID regulations and do what they can to keep people safe. The teachings are straight from scripture and Pastor Obed always provides historical context to help the church body understand the words more deeply. We spend time during service actually reading through chapters of the Bible as a church and not just skimming through verses here and there. The messages are so rich and biblically sound. We love that Pastor Obed always emphasizes that we are “a church family on mission with Jesus!”. We truly feel like we found family here in San Diego.

P.S. The views you get at this outdoor church aren’t too bad either! :-) I’ve been going to King’s Cross since 2018. I’m so grateful for the church’s commitment to put Christ first in all things, Pastor Obed’s faithful, expository teaching, and for the authenticity of this community. I was welcomed immediately and found a strong community that I can really do life with as we worship and build God’s kingdom together. I also met my husband here! Obed married us in 2020 and the community has supported us well during our first years of marriage. I’ve been very blessed to be a part of this church and to be on mission with them. I’m amazed at what God has done here in the past five years as so many have been turned to Christ. So many who were wounded by the church in the past have come home and found a place where they don’t need to perform or pretend. Come and see what God is doing in this community! Genuine Souls. Solid Biblical Teaching.

Moved to SD in Jan 2021 and started going here. I feel like I’ve found great community in this group of kind hearted people. They do a great job of respecting all State Guidelines during these times and even though everyone is socially distanced for now I’ve been able to join a Zoom group to learn more about the message from the Bible that was preached the Sunday before.
Also they have a group of people that go out to the beaches each Sunday, which I’ve enjoyed.

Beautiful views from the Mount Soledad Club.

I recommend this church to:
- Anyone new to SD
- Anyone looking for community
- Anyone looking to learn more about the Bible and Jesus Christ and King's Cross is a great church with a fantastic family feel to it. The people here really do care about one another and Pastor Obed is awesome. I appreciate that he does expository preaching as opposed to topical and has a heart for reaching the community with the Gospel of Christ. If you're looking for a church to plug into then come check it out......oh yeah, and the views of downtown San Diego and the beach and bay are not bad either. 😉

reviewSummary:
My kids (while in middle shcool) were blessed to experience the preaching of Pastor Mike during a church camp outing at Hume Lake. They raved about how he truly made the Bible come alive for them. Loved the message so eloquently put to take it and apply its principles, exceptional understanding of the preacher writing  in 5th chapter of Ecclesiastes..
my contentment is a rich blessing from God who gives to me and overwhelms me.. capacity to enjoy and the conviction to renounce- all at once.

name: Kingdom Christian Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church and leadership! I’ve known Pastor Pierre Cardenas since 2005 back when we used to attend Shoreline Church. He is a great leader and Pastor, God fearing person who is sensitive to God’s voice and calling. We used to attend a Spanish church and moved to Kingdom church about three years ago due to our kids not speaking Spanish. It’s been the best move for us as a family. We’ve enjoyed our time there and enjoy serving in the different area that we can! Couldn’t recommend this church more! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and it’s clear that the pastors and leaders genuinely care about the people who attend. From my very first visit at this church, I was treated with such kindness like I was a part of a family.

One thing I appreciate most is that the messages are preached straight from the Bible. The teaching is clear, biblical, and always points people back to God’s Word.

The youth program is also incredible!! The leaders truly invest in the kids, care about them personally, and create an environment where they can grow in their faith and build meaningful relationships with others their age.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like family, teaches the truth of Scripture, and genuinely cares for people of all ages, I highly recommend Kingdom Christian Church. An amazing church that accepts all walks of life. As a past atheist this church changed me and supported my walk with Christ. Youth leadership is strong and driven by the Holy Spirit. I grew up in youth and would recommend any youth to come to Kingdom to learn about Christ. Id recommend this church to anyone who wants to sense the Holy Spirit & learn about who Jesus truly is. Amazing church! My wife and I are grateful for the good parts of our time at Kingdom Christian Church. We grew in our faith, built relationships, and I was baptized there.

However, we recently left because of serious concerns with leadership. After we raised concerns involving youth leadership, we were not met with biblical care, humility, or accountability. We were met with accusations, personal attacks, intimidation, and harsh communication.

In our experience, the way leadership speaks to congregants who question them is not biblical and borders on verbally abusive. Concerns are treated as rebellion or division, rather than something to be heard with patience and discernment.

I believe many people in the congregation genuinely love Jesus, but based on how leadership handled this situation and how they spoke to us, we cannot recommend this church. My husband and I have been Christians our whole lives, but there was a long season where we were pretty lukewarm. We would occasionally attend church, pray before meals, and check the boxes, but we weren’t truly growing in our faith or developing the relationship with Jesus that we were missing.

Over 2 years ago when  we walked into Kingdom Christian Church, we knew something was different. The presence of the Holy Spirit is tangible here. The first time—and many times since—I walked through those doors, I got immediate goosebumps, and not because I was cold. The Lord is very evidently present in that place and in the hearts of the people there.

What stood out first was the people. We’ve attended a lot of churches over the years, and sometimes it can feel surface-level or transactional. At Kingdom, we immediately felt genuinely loved and cared for by people who barely knew us. There was an authenticity that is hard to describe unless you’ve experienced it yourself.

The messages consistently felt like God was speaking directly into our lives. The first service we attended was preached by Pastor Julissa, and what a powerful dynamic she and Pastor Pierre have. Julissa is unapologetically passionate about Jesus and has a way of challenging people to grow deeper in their faith while always pointing them back to God’s truth.

Julissa brings a bold passion for God’s Word, while Pastor Pierre carries a wisdom, gentleness, and peace that comes from years of faithfully walking with the Lord. He leads with humility, listens well, and consistently points people back to Scripture. In a world where many leaders seek attention for themselves, Pierre’s heart is clearly focused on serving others and glorifying Christ.

As we became more involved, we began serving in the youth ministry. What an incredible group of students and leaders. The youth team genuinely invests in these kids and helps them develop their own relationship with Christ. Pastor Devon has such a heart for the kids and a way of explaining things and relating to them that helps them truly understand rather than just go through the motions. She creates an environment where students feel welcomed, valued, safe, and challenged to grow in their faith. She has a unique ability to meet students where they are while always pointing them toward Jesus. And if you happen to catch her leading worship, wow. That voice is something special.

Kingdom Christian Church has changed our lives. It has challenged us, encouraged us, and helped us grow closer to Jesus than we ever have before. We are deeply grateful for the pastors, leaders, volunteers, and church family who continually point people back to Christ.

We have experienced leadership that genuinely loves people, teaches the Word faithfully, and points others toward Christ. We have consistently been met with encouragement, accountability, wisdom, and care, and we are grateful for the impact this church has had on our lives and our relationship with the Lord.

Thank you, Jesus, for leading us here. May You continue to move through and bless this church so that even more people can come to know You and be welcomed into Your Kingdom.

Over all great experience. I definitely recommend this fellowship/gathering if your new in the area All Nations Worship Assembly is the most AMAZING church I have been a part of. The worship experiences are great, the people are so loving and welcoming. It’s a come as you are church that has power! The pastors are great and touchable! They are real and always deliver messages that are bible based, but practical and relevant! All Nations is the place to be! I have been attending this church going on six years, and believe me when I tell you that this was the best decision I ever made. I came looking for community (check), growth (check), hearing God’s heart this the preaching/teaching (check and check)! If you are looking for a place that will stretch you and that is filled with people who love God then this is the place! This place of worship has been the gateway to a better life for me personally and professionally. The Apostles continue to push me forward and challenge me while breaking down biblical principals to apply to real life practically. I met my wife here and she gave me a beautiful family filled with blessings and we keep God in the center of all that we do right, wrong, or indifferent.

name: Kingdom Fellowship Christian Church - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary: What an awesome church full of loving people. The pastor is an incredible teacher, and delivers a Sunday sermon that is practical, relatable, and life changing. If you want to want to study and spend time in The Word, this is the church for you! Pastor Jefferson is anointed and he inspires us to lean on The Word and to know it and Him for ourselves! To God be the glory! The Pastor does a great job of explaining and relating the Bible to current issues in people lives. Beautiful Sermon Beautiful Singing Beautiful People...Lovely Service... Friendly people and very informative

name: Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses--Woodland Hills East & Woodland Hills West - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Everything is taught from the Bible. Super friendly loving atmosphere. People of all backgrounds are welcome & treated with love. No collections. Very clean & comfortable environment. If you desire to know, understand God's Word the Bible, Life and why are we here, what happens when we die. The real TRUTH. Ask one of Jehovahs Witnesses. Horrible place they tapped my families phone bullied me extorted me and used the bible and gods name to do it! I love Jehovah but these people have nothing to do with him.I make my self known. Im strong enough to stand up and tell the truth! If you Truly want to know about the Bible,  You will not be disappointed. Bible truths and the example of Jesus is taught and followed here. Such a diverse warm ans loving congregation. I will most definitely continue attending meetings here.

name: Kingdom Life Christian Fellowship - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited the Christmas giveaway and was there for the food, they also talked about a gift for adults and kids and me being between jobs it could help. They showed bikes, televisions and nice items donated from businesses and I sure membership
Times must be tough they hurried me through nothing like a TV or a Bike those were reserved for people they knew which is their right of course, but my box of food here's what I got.
1. Handful of greens I was good with that
2. 3 cans of fruit cocktail YIKES!
3. 1 bag of rice and a package of instant mashed potatoes.
2 hours in line for food that was boxed up just for non members.
The gift was a make up brush and small mirror Dollar Store !

I watched people get big boxes as they hurried me through the line.
I watch them hand out TVs and Bikes not to me I had not decided to go to this church yet.
Advice unless you go there just drive by this Xmas 🎁 bash is nothing more than give the public the leftovers.
Glad I was not homeless I could always eat some fruit cocktail.
Poor planning! Beautiful experience, awesome place to visit warm and Friendly environment. Peaceful and Relaxing enjoyable atmosphere. They have a Food Bank the 1st Saturday of the month and are very nice and even do prayer requests. As a new member of Kingdom Life Christian Fellowship Church, I am very pleased and excited about becoming a KL member.   Pastor and First Lady  Roberson are amazing, accessible, and very welcoming to everyone who attends the church. He's an excellent Bible teacher and preacher when he delivers the word of God,  each Sunday.  This is a wonderful, productive, and spirit-filled church. I am proud to be a member.✝️ Amazing church with a heart for people! Not only is the worship great, but you also develop a deeper relationship with God and grow in other areas of your lives personally.

name: Kings Chapel Antioch - Antioch Campus
reviewSummary:
I drove to this church for almost 2 hours but it was so worth it,  what a beautiful,  friendly and just so welcoming church ⛪️  We had our annual moms in prayer get together and this church was hosting it, it was such an amazing time,  full of laughter, prayer and fellowship. Great church to be ❤️

P.S. By the way, I loved the bathrooms 🚻 😁 remodeled,  clean, and fresh 👌 Amazing and BEAUTIFUL church. They had stars in the ceilings like whaaat?!! That’s so cool! The worship is beautiful and Pastor Aaron plays guitar and it’s so cool! Love the music and the preaching is beautiful! They always have the Bible open and the congregation would bring their well read old bibles from home. It’s a beautiful family here. They are so welcoming to new faces and they just love Jesus. Oh my goodness. There is Jesus love in this place. Hallelujah! May the Lord bless this church! The worship is so wonderful and brings me to tears because everyone is so close and sings with all their hearts! It ain’t no quiet whisper singing it’s just everyone is all out for the Lord! My goodness the Holy Spirit is here! The pastor prays for marriages and casts out demons and prays for healing and the lost. Must I mention… THE GOSPEL IS PREACHED HERE! Hallelujah! The gospel is preached all the time and people are hearing the message of salvation.

Year 2 of being here…

Wow! So much happened! It’s so amazing! They now have an LED wall and brand new sound system and the worship is incredible! They’ve really reached a new level of glory in worship!

The power conferences are BOMB and so powerful! The messages are so full of Scripture and really help you grow in the Lord! Amazing church! I’ve started serving in their kids ministry and it’s amazing! God bless everyone who's reading and viewing my pictures. I meet wonderful lady that pass me this church ⛪️ information at the hospital 🏥 and she thought I needed  some support from God. And I was looking for a church home myself. And I just wanted to tell everyone I love you and God bless, and I will be coming to your house of God  soon much Respect Pablo Travis Dean Stallings from Oakland California Phenomenal place of worship. Top-notch leaders and preaching. Great presence of God here. Strong emphasis on children’s ministry. Great place to check out if you live in the area. This church has newer pastors that are leading the church into a season of growth and impact. Wonderful church with amazing people. Pastor Aaron is hilarious he’s a natural born comedian and he’s anointed and he can prophesy , he’s a jack of all trades!! Worship is amazing the blonde girl singer has the voice of an Angel !!! Wonderful church

name: Kings' Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: My boyfriend and I visited here while in town and were greeted by so many incredibly warm and kind members, the pastor, and his wife. The worship was Spirit-led and not about performing. If you're wanting a place to feel welcome, receive Scripture-filled teaching, and some humor sprinkled into the message, I definitely recommend! Not a massive mega church, but full of big Christians.  Uncompromising & truly good soil.  I've told the lead Pastor that if it was not going to be called "kings Church", it should have been called "Good Soil Church",  since the spiritual maturity of the congregation is unmatched and a wonderful place to be planted in.  This church also afforded me the ability to do what ended up being the 2nd biggest highlight of my life so far (1st was getting born again), which was to do missions work in Kenya.  Highly recommend! Attended part of a King's Church service we stumbled upon in the subway while visiting NYC this weekend. Just the encouragement our family needed after such a hard week. Beautiful worship and thanks for sharing the truth of the gospel in an unexpected place. Thankful for this church community in New York City. If you want to grow and mature in Faith in Jesus Christ of Nazareth, come. This church is Holy Spirit led in Spirit and in Truth especially during the times we are living in. It isn't motivational or what's popular in the culture. This church is not afraid to speak truth in love and hold the lens to what does the word of God say about these matters -- this church's foundation is Biblical and is that shining light to point people to Jesus Christ in a dark world. Keep being faithful kings church in Jesus name  If you are looking to grow your relationship with God this is the place! Everyone is welcoming, I have four littles and everyone is always there to lend me a hand. I’m so grateful for this community, our pastors and all the things the Holy Spirit is doing in this place.

name: Kingsway Christian Church - Avon Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church. A great place to hear the Word of God taught by a pastor with a heart for God. Give us a try if you're searching for a church home! I don't think you will be disappointed. ❤️🙏 Help is available for everything - it’s easy for new people to take advantage of this!  The preaching is well thought out, planned in advance, and relevant today. Good for understanding who Jesus is.  Good for understanding purpose.  It’s just, good for you! It's a very big church. I love to hear the preacher tell stories about different parts about the Bible. Great sermon today and friendly folks. The music was extremely loud couldn’t really hear the singers and when they spoke couldn’t hear what she was saying. My watch even alerted me of noise over 90 decibels.   We attended again today. (10/26) and the music was very good and at a level we enjoyed very much. This is a second home! Seriously it is full of the best people you will ever meet. The community is what kept us coming back when we first started. When someone asks you, "How are you?", you can tell they genuinely care. It's not just a courtesy. The worship is top notch, they have free daycare on Sunday during Service for all age ranges, and the staff is just outright amazing. We are truly blessed to find a church like this. I can't stress enough how much everyone should come here!

name: Kingsway Church - Cherry Hill Township Campus
reviewSummary:
Great family church that preaches the Good news, the Truth about God. They have 3 services on Sundays and the people are so welcoming and friendly. There is great community not just for the kids and youth but for the young adults and adults of church. This is a great Church if you’re looking for a Sunday service and nothing more. Pastor Phillip is wonderful and teaches the Word of God. But if you’re looking for community or ways to serve I would recommend finding another church. This is a very closed off community and they do not welcome new people. We moved to New Jersey and found this church and felt moved to join groups and get involved only to be met with “Seat’s taken” attitude. My daughter and I filled connect cards, spoke to people, asked to join various groups that they have, practically begging. I was told I was one day late to join a group and even though I asked for an exception since I was brand new to the church and didn’t know i was met with awkward silence and still not allowed in. And my daughter tried multiple times to join a young adult group and they told her she missed some event although she was never informed of that.
Maybe someone else can penetrate through the very restrictive and selective process and have a better experience, or maybe they just didn’t like us, or maybe they’ll read this and decide to be more welcoming to new members but unfortunately this was our experience.
Again, Sunday service is great! And I hope they change their ways and open their hearts and stop turning their backs to people wanting to join the community. I took a leap and was called to Growth track for the first time, I learned more about myself and what I been missing. Pastor Phil is amazing and  The leaders Angie, Mel and Ariel where Awesome.. I been going to Kingsway Church in Cherry Hill nj and it is the most Fulfilling congregation! So welcoming. I been a Catholic all my life and didn't k ow about any other churches. God has called me to find a place to root. Another place to call Home. Friendly church, great worship service, great preaching.  Have not attended yet, but they have a session periodically that helps new members find the best place in the church to serve.  Looking forward to becoming a part of the church!
Update: I joined the church as a member.  God is definitely at work here, and I am so glad he led me to this wonderful group of people! I love this church. When you first enter you can't help but to feel very welcome and the volunteers make you feel very comfortable. They preach very good messages!

name: Kingswood Church - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary: My son has been here for 2 years. Thanks for very nice teachers and very fun/creative curriculum. Now he is in the young 4 year old class of Ms. Sharon & Ms. Saundra. He can count to over 100, do addition/subtraction,    read simple books, show respect, and love people. I appreciate his teachers. I like this place and it's right by our house. I remember going here when I was young, and I counted to over 400 just for fun; it was super cool. my wife and I got married there 35 years ago it's a very nice church in the Dunwoody area Thanks for taking my son in and for positively impacting my son's development. Friendly and competent staff.

name: Kingwood Church - Alabaster Campus
reviewSummary:
Loving people.  Community, spiritual growth, beautiful worship, The Word taught from the Bible, all are welcome, care and nature for the next generation!  Love my church! This has been my family's church home for many years. Music ministry is amazing and Pastor Jay is soo encouraging. The church is truly living its mission as "a movement of hope" in our community! Kingwood Church is great!  You can truly feel the Holy Spirit moving through the church. The music is top notch and the bible based message is always on point. Beautiful church and wonderful atmosphere
Very friendly they love our kids and their kid program is wonderful

Amazing people as well Friendly. The kid ministry is great. The Lead Pastor and pastors are amazing! The Word of God and the Holy Ghost is moving.

name: Knott Ave Christian Church - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary: This church was absolutely beautiful! I got married here recently and had the pleasure of working with Sarah who coordinates weddings here. From the very start Sarah was very helpful and available through text or call later in the day. My family and I visited the venue about four times in total before my actual wedding day to coordinate logistics. The sanctuary seats about 700 people which was way more seats than what we needed. Sarah worked with us to make sure our day was beautiful and perfect. I fell in love with the the modern and contemporary look of the sanctuary. Bathrooms were well kept. Brides can use the mother and baby room across from the restrooms while the groom uses a room located on the other side of the sanctuary (very convenient). Ample amount of parking in the general area. There are two areas to park, general parking area and a smaller parking lot where my wedding party and main guest parked at. Had an overall wonderful experience. Would definitely recommend this beautiful church. If you are looking for a church that will meet you right where you are, whether you are young or old, rich or poor, married or single. If you are looking for a church that will teach you about God and how to have a relationship with Jesus or how to experience the true forgiveness of God. If you are looking for a church that will come along beside you and encourage you to draw near to the only true God, you will find here at Knott Avenue Christian Church. Knott Avenue has a core value that’s so accurate as a description: “Real talk before small talk”. We raised our kids in this church and still attend now. We’ve seen pastors come and go and the Lord has been faithful to use each leader in their unique ways. We currently have a new pastor added to the teaching team, Pastor Joe. He’s the primary teacher and does an excellent job teaching us through the scriptures. The pulpit is shared by other gifted and Godly pastors. A few things have always been the same at our 20 years here; the Word of God will not be compromised, the congregation is beautifully diverse, the people and worship time are not pretentious, and you will grow if you get involved—they make it easy to do that. We love KACC!  Great Sunday services, Wednesday night women's bible study, kids Wednesday nights, and Thursday night Junior High groups.  God centered and focused. Great church if you are not a former Catholic. Even though we both believe in Jesus, you will be told how Catholics have done everything wrong. Pretty sure the intentions are good but not the best way to teach Christ, He loved everyone.

name: Knox Presbyterian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: "Inviting thoughtful seekers to intergenerational community and Christian discipleship in the world," Knox has been my church home since 2014. I prayed for a church where my gifts could be used to further the Kingdom of God. Knox has been an answer to that prayer. I've served on the Adult Education and Spiritual Formation Committee and the Sustainability Team; I've participated in a small group that studies the Bible and secondary literature about being a follower of Jesus in the world; I've greeted, run slides, read Scripture, and sung in the choir Sunday mornings; I've been in a Zoom daily prayer group since the pandemic; I've packed sandwiches for the hungry; I've visited the hurting; I've brought gifts to the needy; I've stood on street corners with posters; I've participated in City Council meetings; I've pulled weeds; I've planted California native plants; I've shared produce; I've listened to music, seen plays, and read novels with fellow thoughtful seekers; I've shared hugs, tears, and laughter with brothers and sisters in Christ; I have been fed with beautiful music and challenging preaching and teaching. I have walked with Jesus. Knox is a welcoming church where community and love abound. There is a wonderful mix of families with small children alongside all other ages and stages. Our Pastor is warm, relevant, pastoral and accessible. The sermons are thoughtful and interesting and the focus on caring for our community, the greater community and our world matters deeply. Justice and service and growing in faith with Christ is paramount. AND the children's director is a remarkable leader and lover of kiddos. Knox has been such a welcoming community with so many amazing small groups to join and family events throughout the year. Pastor Matt is such an inspiring pastor and has given some of the best sermons I’ve heard. The Young Adults group has been such a wonderful community with regular bible studies and fun seasonal events, thanks to Josiah for leading it. All around, Knox is a very supportive and welcoming community and I recommend it to everyone. Plus they have pizza every last Sunday of the month! I love this church. I spent a long time looking for a church in Pasadena and stumbled upon Knox. After attending my first Sunday, I knew it was the body I needed to be a part of. The preaching is rich, the worship is honoring (and varied, so you never know what kind of music you'll get to experience), and most importantly, the community is warm and inviting. The easiest way to describe it is that the Holy Spirit is working in this church and you can feel that life. The church members and the pastor are 'heart of gold' people. Deeply concerned about social justice issues in our community. Knox is also a welcoming church with clear-minded folks. I'm new here but have felt supported and have been able to support others.

name: Koin Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting Koin , here to see my grandson Johnathan Harper and Granddaughter in law Beautiful Amy, Ben and Chayanne, Naomi .
Awesome Pastor and very friendly congregation.  My daughter Venessa and son-in law Jeff invited me and loved their Worship. Also my grandson Jacob Harper 💙
Coreen Carlin Gonzalez. We attended the service because my son and daughter in law were baptized today. Even though this is not my wife and I regular church, we were very impressed with the loving welcome we received when arriving. We enjoyed the sermon that Pastor Sam offered. Very enriching and powerful message. The baptism was very meaningful and touching, my wife added that the ceremony felt very intimate and full of blessing. We wish nothing but the best to this small church, praying for the Pastor and his community of young people to achieve success in reaching more and more souls every day. Today's message did leave a profound impact in me, personality. My son invited me today and I really enjoyed it!! The worship was awesome;  pastor  Sam was awesome and the bonus was the coffee was really good. What a blessed Way to start my day!! I will be coming back! 🙏❤️ Koin Church is most welcoming.  I've been a member since 2017 and I know this Church community blesses me constantly.  Pastor Sam and Pastor Kellie are most welcoming with open arms, connectivity, and hospitality.  The age group varies so there is always someone who reaches out to new members.  If you are looking for a comfortable church to attend, please give Koin Church a try.  You can access their past messages and their current 11am Sunday services on YouTube.  Worship is fantastic. This church is so welcoming and loving!
They are very intentional and do community well.
The Pastor and his wife are great people! Very personable! If you’re looking for a church, this one is a must try! :))

name: Koinonia Christian Church - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary:
This is an Amazing place to worship at. A Great place to learn more about discipleship, and the word not only from Dr. Goines but the leadership as well. Koinonia means fellowship and you will find community in this place no matter what age you are. You will have a true encounter with love in this house of prayer. I joined KCC on my first visit because it was the church I had been seek the 27yrs that I've be in Texas.  Everyone is so welcoming and friendly.  Pastor Goines is an amazingly relatable pastor.  Ive only been attending almost 2 months and already feel closer to God.  I love the classes and learning how to reading the Bible correctly.  I now have added Bible reading into my daily life.  I am excited to attend church because my spirit is full each time I leave.  I love this church! I have been a part of this church for over 10 years, and I am truly proud to call it my church home. The sense of community here is something special, it feels like family in the truest sense. Pastor Goines has been such a blessing to both me and my children. His modern approach to preaching makes the Bible easy to understand and deeply relatable to everyday life. The fellowship and community activities only add to the love and connection you feel here. I highly recommend this church to anyone searching for a Bible-teaching church rooted in love, support, and genuine community.

We really do life together and I love it here. I thoroughly enjoyed the service. The worship was powerful and the pastor, Dr. Goines preached a truly impactful and relatable message. The people were incredibly friendly and welcoming. They have ministry and activities for all ages. It seems great for the whole family, as well as for individuals of all ages. The building is also very nice, spacious, and comfortable. I look forward to going again. I have always loved KCC but this review reflects the past 4-5 months. POWERFUL! PROFOUND! PURPOSEFUL! Services have really been providing life-affirming love and light. There has definitely been a divine shift in the house of the Lord at KCC and it has been beautiful to witness and experience! Whether you are new to the faith or mature in your walk with Christ, KCC is the Bible-based place you want to be if you are seeking empowerment, healing, restoration, and genuine worship.

name: Korean Baptist Church of Disciples - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: love love this church!!! ♡ A church filled with beautiful praise and overflowing with God's word... Disciple Church, where you can feel the energy of the pastor and his wife, and the young congregation, who are passionately leading the congregation to God. I am grateful and pray that you will always be there for me. An immigrant church with many young families. A church with great worship, great sermons, and never hesitating to embrace change.

name: Kountze Memorial Lutheran Main Campus
La Casa Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I have gone to this church for a few years now and I love the closeness and community that this church has to offer to our family. The community is unlike any church I have ever been to. The pastors and people that go to La Casa are truly amazing people and I know if my family ever had any type of need, these people would be right there to help. We love our pastors so much. We are also a part of a life group that has changed our lives! La Casa Church is a big part of our lives and we feel so blessed that God has allowed us to be connected to this amazing church. God is doing incredible things in this church and through this church and I’m excited to see what all is to come!! I moved from Texas to pursue graduate school in Nashville, and La Casa has become my family away from home ❤️ Not only that, but I feel like I’ve exponentially grown in my faith and have learned so much from the Pastors and leadership team. My husband and I have also made great friends here and have enjoyed finding community through various life groups (marriage, campus, etc.)! They really have been my rock through these past couple of years. Definitely recommend you check it out if you want to get deep into the word, learn from various cultures, and have intentional community! LaCasa Church is an amazing community of believers from 29 different nations! Our Life Groups allow people to gather in smaller groups during the week to connect and study the Word in a deeper way. The bilingual service is welcoming for all! La Casa is one of the most special churches I’ve ever been a part of. They use both languages (English & Spanish) to create a really inclusive environment, but they even take it a step further by taking every opportunity they can to celebrate where everyone is from. The people here have quickly become family to me, and I’m so so thankful. My family and I have been part of La Casa church for over three years. Our experience at La Casa a growing bilingual church, has been incredibly positive. The church excels in creating a welcoming atmosphere for a diverse congregation, offering services in English and Spanish that cater to everyone. The commitment of the pastoral team to deliver inspiring messages and support the community is remarkable. With a variety of programs for all ages and impactful community outreach, La Casa not only nurtures its members spiritually but also makes a tangible difference in the community. A truly inclusive and vibrant place of worship.

name: LA CHURCH - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Phenomenal, welcoming space, inclusive to all. Thankful for this kind of a church in Los Angeles. meets people where they are at and loves deeply. Amazing place. Awesome people the best church I've ever been to, grateful for how incredibly inclusive and amazing this church is!

name: La Crescenta Presbyterian Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Being born, raised, and accepted here I do love it. Ron I am sorry you had a bad experience if you come back there are many understanding people. The money they take goes back into the church so that we may have a better experience when worshiping the one and only God! Great fellowship dinner and classes on Wednesday night PEAK. Where else can you get a home cooked meal for $3 adults $2 kids. Wednesday night dinner 5:30 - 6:30PM. Various classes start at 6:30 end around 8:00PM. You can't do better than the genius, gentle, kind Pastor Andy Wilson.  His lovely wife Mary, the nonstop genius of one (assistant) Pastor Lee Cook.  Incredible Worship band/music etc.  Plenty of parking at all times.  A legend in the La Crescenta community.  Along with their sister church, La Canada Presbyterian Church.  Very scriptural, humble biblical church - bailed me out of a lot of fear/angst.  Oh - and never challenge their Pastor Andy Wilson - runs every day - you frequently see Andy on runs down Montrose Avenue leading towards Honolulu.  Always beep, I do. Beautiful church, extraordinary childcare, and wonderful people. I love this church, the pastor and the people. Very welcoming and there are so many ways to get involved and to grow as a person. Hope to see you there!

name: La Habra Hills Presbyterian - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I was there and noticed during the food pantry distribution a woman loading meats and other food into the trunk of a black sedan prior to the distribution time. Looks like they were taking the good stuff rather than giving it to those in need and those waited in line. Very sad to see...

In reply: It wasn't like the normal box they give. I bring my neighbor because she cannot drive anymore and she says sometimes she doesn't even get any kind of meat. It's rare, but on one of those days is when she saw several packs of meats in multiple trips going into that car, so you can imagine her frustration. This is my home church for and I love it. I highly recommend it for families with children, couples, single folks and the youth (teenage). You will feel at home. Nicest ppl on earth-great paster& music. They have handbell choir ! Super people. Great sermons. An enjoyable experiance. Very nice place

name: La Iglesia En El Camino - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Really mice philosopy which i read through book of Mormon. Oneshould  attend the teaching in english  every sunday start at 11.30 am . Grateful for your sermons, thank you pastor :) May God continue to use you, in Jesus name, Amen. God bless you God is good, He blessed my life
Our Pastor, is a Son of God, who used to bring a word of God to the whole family to visit us every Sunday. Where I found Spiritual fullness Worshipping and praying  to God 🙌🙏 I attend the English Service, this is an amazing church.  Pastor Angel Juarez is just so clear and easy to follow his preaching,  he's so Awesome! He is truly lead by the spirit.
Same with Pastor Frank, my family and I are happy and connected with God here.

name: La Jolla CA LDS Institute - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Great place for young adults (18-35) to come hang out and get to know other young adults in a wholesome Christian environment! The leaders are super friendly and helpful! down to earth people serving mostly the graduate students who went to Brigham Young. spent afternoons here with students. got referral to Mormon dentist. What can I say , they block the path to Torrey pine Rd. The short path connecting the community to main road you see on map is blocked. Great place to relax, study, socialize. Has physical, spiritual, and social/ emotional food.

name: La Jolla Christian Fellowship - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Really excited about church again!!
I have been a Christian for a number of years. I have had the privilege in that time of listening to a number of good communicators proclaim the gospel message. I have to say, Pastor Adam is among the top Christian communicators I have heard from over the years. He definitely does not preach a soft gospel message. Neither does Adam club us (Sunday morning attendees) over the head (so to speak) with messages that are everything but good news. Rather, I believe, in Adam’s teaching of the gospel there is an essential understanding of what the Bible is actually saying, as well as a general understanding of the many things parishioners are struggling through life with as God’s word calls them, on any given Sunday morning, to a more consistent walk of holiness. There is always much to learn from Adam, and he is truly talented at giving a substantive and strong message, but never in my personal experience, without an appropriate measure of God’s grace. I at times feel convicted to repent of some sinful behavior or thought process, but always with the assurance that God really loves me. Adam wants his congregation to know that God truly loves them, and that he is in the business of calling them (us) to repentance etc because of his great and holy love. I am super thankful for all that is going on at LJCF, all the staff and lay leaders etc. I am especially grateful that God has brought the true gospel message , both sides of the sword, back to LJ in pastor Adam’s preaching. Awesome multi generational family oriented church. Small, friendly, and welcoming. Worship is mix bag of old school w contemporary. While pastor Adam attempts to be culturally relative, his messages often lack acknowledgement of man's spiritual depravity, a call to confession of sin, a call to repentance, and our dire need to surrender to the lordship of Christ. Sadly the result is an incomplete message of the gospel. This is a church I often visit.. I like the message in its delivery I knew this church was my home from the first time I came in. 2 years later I cant imagine leaving. The amazing friends I have made here have helped me change the trajectory of my life. The Holy Spirit truly dwells here. The sweetest people who care for each other and love the Lord. The sermons are robust, the classes are rich and the Holy Spirit is so evident.  You will feel right a home with your first visit.

name: La Jolla Presbyterian Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: La Jolla Presbyterian is a wonderful church. It's very big and very welcoming and polite to guests. I recommend it for anyone who wants to visit or stay. It's a very friendly crowd and people are very supportive. It's clear that it's established itself from the top down as a family atmosphere as in one family for those who are there and who are members and who are not yet formally members. It's one big family. There are services at 8:45 10:00 and 11 a.m. on Sundays. I highly recommend this church. They also have delicious baked goods and coffee after each service and it's a beautiful building. Also they do enormous good in the world and the local community. Our pastors from Ebenezer we're being represented here I went to support and what a great bunch of people with a lot of resources for people in need Very nice Spanish style church/school. They were nice enough to offer me a vintage La Crosse 81 soda machine.  I drove down from the Inland Empire to pick it up.  They helped me load it and were just the nicest people. We love visiting this warm and welcoming congregation.  Come early and take a few minutes to enjoy the stained glass windows.  Sermons are biblically based, current, and always relevant. Try them both and see what works for you.  The programs for young kids, MS kids and HS youth are exceptional.

name: Laguna Beach United Methodist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a lovely church nestled in the picturesque hills of South Laguna Beach.  The God-given natural beauty of the hill, garden and Pacific Ocean views from the sanctuary is rivaled only by the caring, charismatic and vibrant minister (Pastor Lynn Francis), inclusive, affirmational culture (a UMC Reconciling Ministry), friendly people, incredible music program (including both traditional and contemporary offerings), professionally curated children's, youth and family ministry (including Sunday school for children and youth from four years old through Junior High, Nursery Care for infants to children three years of age, annual summer Vacation Bible School week for children four years old through fifth grade, Messy Church, a creative, interactive, intergenerational monthly gathering held on Sunday afternoon or evening - accompanied by a meal!), and the kind, helpful and efficient staff.  The Easter sunrise service at Main Beach is a stunning way to begin one of the holiest days of the Christian year, sometimes accompanied by dolphins and other local fauna.  Coffee and sweet delicacies on the patio after worship, and occasional festive lunches, provide enjoyable opportunities for additional fellowship.  The vibe is a warm, welcoming and uplifting blend of traditional Methodism meets Beach Cities casual.

LBUMC is active in outreach ministries both locally in Laguna Beach and its surrounding communities in south Orange County (annual Change the World Sunday, the Alternative Sleeping Location monthly dinner for the unhomed, the Friendship Shelter and the Illumination Foundation to name a few) and globally (UMCOR, the United Methodist Committee for Relief, Africa University in Tanzania, and Earthkeepers, a United Methodist Global Ministries Project supporting environmental initiatives in 45 countries).

Laguna Beach United Methodist Church colorfully lives out the core beliefs of the UMC as embraced by it's Open Hearts Open Minds Open Doors theological perspective, the LBUMC mission statement, "Our mission is to 'Bring God’s Love To Life' through worship, study and outreach to the community and the world", and the mantra "With Christ as our inspiration, worshipping together as one loving, inclusive body, we will bring God's love to life through prayers, presence, gifts, service and witness."

As a 26-year congregant, I am clearly not the most unbiased reviewer, but this tranquil refuge continues to keep me coming back for more, and excited to see what comes next.

Additional information may also be accessed via social media, on Facebook, Instagram and Twitter.  For your convenience, the service is live-streamed on-line at 10:00 a.m. every Sunday morning, as well as recorded and available on the website for subsequent viewing.  I highly recommend experiencing this unique place for yourself; who knows, it just may be life-changing. A progressive, diverse congregation, that also has an incredible 180-degree view of the ocean from the sanctuary. They're very active in social justice issues, including being a Reconciling Congregation, which means they believe in equality in society and in the church for LGBTQ people. Also active in poverty ministries like supporting the food bank and supporting homeless ministries. Their motto or slogan is "Bringing Love to Life", and "Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors", and they mean it. Best church I've ever been to! I love how inclusive and welcoming everyone is, which is the way it should be when searching for a church. This church really seems to live by the principles that are the most important. Plus, you get a view of a beautiful Pacific Ocean! 😎🙏 LBUMC is a wonderful church - a friendly, inclusive congregation, a kind and dynamic pastor, and an AMAZING view of the ocean from the sanctuary! The motto "Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors" really rings true - everyone will receive a hearty and genuine welcome no matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love. Laguna Beach United Methodist Church has been an all around great experience.  The church members are extremely welcoming and inviting and made me feel right at home after moving to the area from the east coast in 2012.  Pastor Mandy Flemming, who has been at LBUMC for just over a year now has been a breath of fresh air for the church and her faithful approach to ministry has filled the pews with new members and younger families.  I'd highly recommend LBUMC to anyone looking for a church to call home.

name: Laguna Presbyterian Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
I went here with the photography class from LCAD and the owner was nice enough to let us shoot inside! The church is beautiful and we got some stellar photos. God bless This community welcomed me when I was a young adult. It is a vibrant, faithful, gracious community of individuals seeking to grow up into Christ and encourage and extend grace to others who are just trying to figure out life and God. This community has a rich history in the roots of Laguna; its early formation as a city. Individual members rallied the call to action in the fire of 1993--and became a place of interfaith caring and compassion for those who lost everything. Laguna Pres was around 12 years be the city was incorporated, I hope it will be around for another 100 year. For 100 years LPC has been inviting everyone to come, just as you are. LPC is a warm, welcoming, deeply committed community of people of all ages and stages in life who seek to live a meaningful life of faith in this world we live in.  The worship services are extraordinarily rich in both the message delivered and the music which is excellent and heartfelt.  I love this church which has been my anchor for 33 years. People may go to church to find God but they stay because they find each other.
I'm an atheist, I went to an Alpha religious exploration meeting at Laguna Pres. It went as well as could be expected. They were friendly enough and the food was decent. I was trying not to be combative but I think I failed.
I'm not sure why I went. I don't think I found what I was looking for. I may go to another meeting if I can remember to put it on my calendar.

Also, I disagree with the Presbyterian values of faith over works but that's a larger issue. Wonderful candlelight Christmas Eve service.  Beautiful old church. Get there early because praise God it was a packed church

reviewSummary: Wonderful community bursting at the seams with Christ-like generosity and kindness. It’s so rare these days to see a church full of multigenerational serving. It was so nice to feel that sense of community and love. The spirit is in full-effect at Lake Bible Church. Although I’m not a member of this church, I highly recommend this church for the following reasons: 1. Pure teaching from the scripture; 2. Welcoming church body who truly live out the words of God; 3. Genuine community outreach and collaboration with other stakeholders with truly humble spirits; 4. They meet you at where you are with patience and respect. My child goes to a bilingual daycare here and attends Awana. She has nothing but wonderful comments for all the LBC staff members she sees. I am not a regular attendee here but I was amazed each time I went there. Such authentic, bold messages in todays divided world yet revealing, and caring. If I haven’t been involved with my current church, I would have picked this as my home church. Although this church is located in the major white upper class area, and the people there are well versed in their careers/very well educated, they are also probably the most down to earth and humbles ones I have met. What also strikes me is that they are so willing to share resources with others, and eager to empower smaller churches nearby. This is a church with great vision, leadership and body. Came to lake biblechurch to go swimming, but there was no lake. The people were nice though so five stars. I grew up in this church. It is great for families. It has some amazing youth pastors at a very age level.

reviewSummary:
The warmest, friendliest Church you will ever visit. An amazing spirit-filled staff who welcome all. Non denominational scripture based church. Very nice people. Bible based. This is a wonderful place to worship.  Love it!!

name: Lake Forest Church-Huntersville - Huntersville Campus
reviewSummary:
Recently decided to start the search for a home church. I’ll start with positives and say I appreciate how timely they are here, as well as the way their children’s program is set up. However, I went to this church for 4 weeks and no one ever took the time to speak with me or get to know me. No one ever even asked my name, not even leadership.  I did not feel welcomed and eventually made the decision to go elsewhere. I wouldn't really even give it one star. A church like many hurting in ways that no one can see or will admit to. My family and I really thought we had found family and home. We had some issues and requested some answers and were pretty much told maybe this wasn't a place for us. We were extremely involved, extremely let down. I am also a student in seminary. There's a lot to be said but even like the lead pastor advised us not to talk to anyone but an elder. We haven't heard from anyone since. Careful of churches that they are acquaintances and not family. We love LFC!

Initially looking to get plugged into a community? This is the place! We have had nothing shy of a great experience since we started attending in 2022. The staff are all awesome and inviting-- even started a meal train for us when we had our first child this June!

The sermons are biblically sound, but not super harsh or shaming like a super traditional church. They truly make any and everyone feel welcomed, and the coffee is good too! :) I visited this church several years ago. Visited again today as a guest of family. Nothings changed.  Don’t expect to leave with any conviction. Very watered-down message especially for Easter Sunday. Jesus is much more than just “wow”. Aside from a half doctrine message, the thing that stood out to me the most is that I didn’t see a single person carrying a Bible?. Not even the pastor when he came out to preach.  In this world that we live People need sound doctrine More than ever.  Super nice people, great coffee, great band if that’s your thing but if you’re looking for, but if you’re looking for a solid message that convicts you with the full weight of the gospel and not a watered down version of it you may want to continue looking. 2 Timothy 4:3-4 Searching a new church, attended this morning, music was good, pastor gave a good sermon, people are very nice.  But music was way too loud, vibrated in my chest.  My husband and I had to leave the sanctuary to watch the sermon on the tv in the other room.  We love the sermon but hard to put up the excessively loud music.

name: Lake Grove Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Beautiful building! Nice service, the keyboardist was amazing. This church was great! Musicians on violin, cello, flute, include members of renowned symphonies and choir and organ are great. Pastor gives a relatable, relevant meditation. I grew up in this church. A lot of history here. Come for church, stay for donuts and coffee. The organist is the best. The programs for kids through high school are fantastic and has been a beneficial to both my kids and many of their friends.  There is a supportive and lovely women’s ministry that supports women at all phases and lots of mission and outreach opportunities.  We enjoy this church family and the pastoral staff. I love this church.  I have been a member for many years and was on staff for a period of time.  The church is Christ-centered with a strong focus on mission.  It offers a broad Christian Education program in a modern, well equipped facility (an incredible preschool, Church School for school aged children, Youth programs, and Adult Ed).  Mission programs include local efforts, as well as international efforts in Africa, Honduras, and Bangladesh.  Worship is diverse with multiple music styles, including an amazing 100+ member Sanctuary Choir.  Congregational care is also a priority with dedicated programs and staff.  By keeping its focus on Christ and his Gospel, the church creates a loving environment where people with diverse viewpoints can feel welcome and grow in their discipleship.

Whenever I was in the hospital he would visit me whenever i have been ill he would call to see how I am and pray for me. name: Lake Hills Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: Highly recommend this church to people new to the area or seeking to know G-d better. We visited while in town and really felt welcomed by the staff and volunteers. They do so much to make your visit less stressful. The preaching was biblical and relevant to life today, the music was modern and very uplifting. You can tell that G-d has blessed the members of this church with staff and volunteers who really care about glorifying God in all they do. Lake Hills has been an incredible church home. I started attending when I was in college with my family, then when I moved back after college, I began volunteering in the nursery. Over ten years later, I’m now married with a child of my own and Lake Hills continues to be an incredible blessing. The kids program is wonderful, filled with people and student volunteers that love the children and teaching them the stories of the Bible. The weekly sermons are rooted in scripture, teaching God’s truth. Lake Hills doesn’t shy away from difficult topics, but rather engages them with biblical teachings rooted in love. I’ve been going to Lake Hills for over 15 years. I love the community of volunteering in the nursery and going to bible study. I enjoy being with our kids and grandkids who attend here. It’s such a welcoming atmosphere without being pushy (if you’re an introvert like me.) I’ve been attending LHC since 2003 and have truly enjoyed watching—and being part of—its growth. Through its events, music, and messages, the church has supported my family and me in our spiritual journeys and has made a significant impact on our local community and on the next generation of children. We are grateful to be part of such a wonderful church. As a long time member it would be easy to attend and not get involved.  However, I would be missing out on some of the most important connections in my life.  From my Usher Team to my Men's Bible Study to the LHC Men's Cook Team, I can't say enough about the difference they each make in my life and faith journey.  Looking for connection?  Come visit, grow your faith, and your relationship with Christ.

name: Lakeshore City Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I was visiting from out of state. I wish Lakeshore was in my town. What loving,  passionate pastors they have. I loved the prayer time they have with their prayer team at the end of the service, it's one on one, so personal.  I now watch the service on line. May God bless them as much as they have blessed others. TL;DR – 10/10 Would recommend! Family church!

I hadn’t been regularly attending church as I hadn’t found one that I felt truly represented what God’s word meant to me. I had become desensitized as I felt all had become materialistic and commercialized, and it was something I felt brought out an ugly, un-Godly side of me, so I stayed away. My sister had asked that we join her for her birthday, but I had chosen not to as I had assumed it was much like all the other churches I had attended. She respected my decision but encouraged me to reconsider. My dad had joined her, and he also had high recommendations for Lakeshore, encouraging me much the same, so I decided to give it a try. I honestly feel that saying that THIS church is life-changing is cliché, but I’m comfortable saying also that “life-changing” is an understatement. Everyone there is so sweet and welcoming, I instantly felt like family. I didn’t feel any of the phony, commercialized behaviors that had turned me away from so many churches in the past. I found my home, just at the first service. This is it. I’ve been attending Lakeshore since 01.01.2023 and have not missed a single Sunday service, and my family and I come from Orange and LA county to attend this church. THAT is how perfect this little church is. You skip the friendships and instantaneously gain new family members. There’s always someone to be there for you, no matter the ask. The Worship team is always on point and makes me feel like God really hears us, and the Prayer team is always there to help carry our burdens or help us pray for those extra helpings of grace. I couldn’t be more grateful that God led me to Lakeshore City Church! Pastor Charlie, Louise and staff are an authentic group of leaders, welcoming and faithful to the scriptures. If you're looking for a church that teaches in an expository manner (line by line, verse by verse) this might be your place. God bless Lakeshore City Church. I Absolutely love this church. They preach the word accurately and really "do life" with one another. The pastor has a heart for seeing  God's people grow in their faith. I love this Church and the people. Very welcoming & safe place to be.
Pastor Charlie & Louise are wonderful people! Please visit

name: Lakeside Bible Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Jared is a faithful Bible teacher who is gifted in the pulpit and genuinely cares for the people. Many places focus primarily on getting more people to come while sacrificing doctrinal teaching. At Lakeside Bible Church, that doesn't happen. There are real relationships and a focus on the gospel through verse-by-verse teaching. I recommend the church to everyone in and around Cornelius. One of the things I deeply appreciate about this church is its commitment to biblically sound theology.  The teachings are firmly rooted in Scripture, not swayed by cultural trends or popular opinion. It's refreshing to be part of a community that holds fast to the core truths of the Christian faith, like the authority of the Bible, the deity of Christ, and salvation by grace through faith.

The preaching is consistently expository, which means the pastor walks through books of the Bible line by line. This has deepened my understanding of Scripture in ways I never expected. Instead of hearing man centered advice, I’m fed God’s Word in its full context, which challenges and transforms my life week after week.
In a time when many churches are reshaping their beliefs to align with societal norms, this church stands firm on biblical truth. It doesn’t shy away from difficult topics, yet it does so with grace and clarity. You won’t hear political rants or cultural commentary for its own sake just faithful, compassionate teaching that calls people to follow Christ regardless of the cultural cost.
This is truly a family centered church.  From Sunday school to youth group to adult small groups, there’s a place for everyone. My children are taught the Bible in age appropriate ways, and I’ve seen their faith grow. The church fosters real relationships, families worshiping, serving, and growing together. It feels like a spiritual home, not just a weekly event.
The people here are genuine, no pretense, just grace. We’ve been welcomed, prayed for, and supported through tough times. It’s not perfect, but it’s a place where you can be real, grow in faith, and be part of a community that truly loves one another.

name: Lakeside Christian Church - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary: My son has been going to this church for years and this is my go to church when I am in town. The warship is sincere and uplifting, the word from the pulpit is true straight from God’s word the Bible, the people are extremely warm and friendly, I will be back every time. I’m in town. name: Lakeside Church - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming, the young adult group is growing and has fun events planned. Pastor Brian and all the other pastors have made an effort to really bring this church alive! I had a really positive experience and felt supported every step of the way. They take the time to listen, understand your situation, and help guide you in the right direction without making things overwhelming. You can tell they genuinely care and want to see you succeed.

Their financial aid came at a time when things had been especially difficult, and it truly made a meaningful difference. I’m very grateful for both the support and the guidance, and I would recommend them to anyone who may need help getting back on the right path. I just recently started attending Lakeside Church, and I already love it here! The atmosphere is so warm and welcoming. You can really feel a sense of community from the moment you walk in. The worship is uplifting, the messages are inspiring and relatable, and everyone I’ve met has been so genuine and kind.

It’s such a refreshing place to grow in faith and connect with others who truly care. I’m so grateful I found Lakeside and can’t wait to continue being part of this amazing church family. I love this place for a place of worship. The leadership continuously encourage members to volunteer for services to the city of Folsom. If you have a young family and you have just moved to Folsom l will encourage you to visit the Lakeside Church. There is a lot for your young family to learn from. My 12 year old is already volunteering here. I can’t put into a review how grateful I am for this church and the leaders/pastors here.

I tried this church last year when my bf decided to start attending, something I’ve hoped for the past few years.

This church is real and has real people teaching the word of God in such a way that my 3 youngest children prefer to sit in the sanctuary with us instead of the fun kid classes they have. This church has been a blessing in our lives, especially during one of the hardest times we’ve faced in our lives.   The support, faith and sharing of their own experiences, gave us the confidence and peace needed to feel we could get through this.  I’m so grateful for this church and its leaders, and the true care they have for the community.

My children also attended BLITZ summer camp here, something we tried to get a spot in for years but there was always a wait list.  The camp was the best experience for them, especially for my 6-year old who wanted to go back even after it ended.

name: Lakeside Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming, the young adult group is growing and has fun events planned. Pastor Brian and all the other pastors have made an effort to really bring this church alive! I had a really positive experience and felt supported every step of the way. They take the time to listen, understand your situation, and help guide you in the right direction without making things overwhelming. You can tell they genuinely care and want to see you succeed.

Their financial aid came at a time when things had been especially difficult, and it truly made a meaningful difference. I’m very grateful for both the support and the guidance, and I would recommend them to anyone who may need help getting back on the right path. The worship is uplifting, the messages are inspiring and relatable, and everyone I’ve met has been so genuine and kind.

It’s such a refreshing place to grow in faith and connect with others who truly care. I’m so grateful I found Lakeside and can’t wait to continue being part of this amazing church family. I love this place for a place of worship. The leadership continuously encourage members to volunteer for services to the city of Folsom. If you have a young family and you have just moved to Folsom l will encourage you to visit the Lakeside Church. There is a lot for your young family to learn from. My 12 year old is already volunteering here. I can’t put into a review how grateful I am for this church and the leaders/pastors here.

name: Lakeside Community Chapel
reviewSummary:
I really enjoy worshiping at this church.  The teaching is very very good.  Verse by verse and I am learning so much Pastor Steve delivers very good expository, Bible based, verse by verse preaching sermons every Sunday. It's a
fresh breath of air in comparison to other churches who only delivers sermons whose agenda is to tickle people's ears. I strongly advice you to check out Lakeside if you are seeking and longing to hear God's Word preach as what it says and not take it out of context. You will learn about the Bible in it's entirety from Genesis through Revelation. Great Place, wonderful church that teaches the ays of the bible and the truth found in God, no fallacies or false teachings are found there. They have classes of different subjects that are on a 15 week cycle at the school behind the church and then there is a service in the church itself that is taught by the pastor or occasionally by a guest speaker. Overall it teaches you how to live your life as a Christian without any changes made to the Bible and always offers help to those who are struggling in faith or financially (if member). This church loved me when I hated them and God. They prayed me into salvation by grace alone. What love is this that they cared for me a pill addict. What love is this that I am now free. What love is this that I am now called a child of God! Thank you Lakeside Church and continue glorifying our Father in heaven and the only name by which we must be saved - Jesus Christ - he is mighty to save! I have been attending Lakeside for a year now and the Lord has blessed me through their ministry profoundly. The teaching is nothing but the Word of God in context. Solid food is served every Sunday from the pulpit.
The people have counseled/discipled & edified me throughout my time. With any church one has to do their part to get involved and reach out but once you do they are faithful to come along side you in the race we all are running together for the glory of God.
