name: Lakeview Christian Center - Metairie Campus
reviewSummary:
For so long, I wanted to know the Lord and the Bible, and it was not until I attended Lakeview Christian Center that each of these happened. My husband and I have learned so many truths from the teachings of this Church, and those truths are found in the Bible. Moreover, this Church has become our family and has shared with us in the joys and challenges that life brings. My only hope is that so many more are blessed as we have been. Love this church! Love the people! Love the messages, worship, biblical teachings, fellowship, I love all of it. This church LOVES the LORD and it shows in every single attention to detail of growing together for the glory of God. We’ve been a part of the LCC family for over 22 years! If you are looking to grow in your knowledge and love of our Lord Jesus Christ, alongside grateful sinners who’ve been forgiven- come join us! We love to worship our Faithful Father together 🙌🏼 We started attending LCC in 2021. The leadership team is truly one of a kind. We have been to many churches over the decades, but LCC team challenges you to grow in faith and practice. There are also many community events and we have met several news friends. This is an active church and we are very happy with our experience. My family & I have been attending Lakeview Christian Center for over 6 years now. From
the very first Sunday we attended, we were greeted with the warmest welcome. That left such a lasting impression on my husband & I both, especially for a church of it’s size. It immediately felt like “home”.
Our family has plugged into the church in many ways, which has allowed us to find some of our best friends. It has truly blessed us in so many ways.
Solid biblical teaching, a vibrant kids & youth ministry, many local outreach programs. There’s so many ways to get plugged in to find community. Never enough words to express how thankful we are to be here.

If you’re looking for a bible teaching church in New Orleans, please don’t hesitate to visit!

name: Lakewood Baptist Church Gainesville, GA - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going here every Sunday for the past 3 months. I goto the 11am service and I love the music. And the preacher has a good message and good delivery. Its a big church but is definitely not as money based as the other big churches around. The bible is first. This is an awesome church!
I am 60 yrs old now and still can remember growing up in this church. Steve Palmer would bring us to church when our mother was sick. His mother Sylvia Palmer became one of my role models for life!! My sister and dad still attend  to this day. I can not even begin to share the list of Godly people that made an impact in my life. I will be forever grateful. Thank you for teaching me to read my Bible, and how to pray! Thank you Lakewood  for letting me be a part of your church family! God bless you all! Lakewood has got it together! Every age and stage of life can find great fellowship and community. Everyone is extremely friendly and welcoming. Best of all, they stand firm on the truth of God’s word. I’m very thankful to have such a wonderful place to worship! Lakewood Is a great church! They are not a perfect church but a healthy church! The pastor really teaches the word with both theological content as well as putting on a level that those without a theological background can comprehend it! They have a great kids ministry as well as a phenomenal student ministry! In simple terms - Lakewood is the place to be! They had a food ministry one day, that I needed, people were extremely nice. I will visit the church service soon as possible, as I feel I need to worship with other Christians. What a Blessing to me and so many others. Thank You Lakewood Church, YOU are making a difference by example,TLCasperBryan

name: Lakewood Christian Church - Lakewood Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been a long-time member for 22+years... like the tide, there are highs & lows, the congregation is always welcoming, caring,  & it's my comfort place.  Pastor Reggie's sermons are thought provoking, & like the song,  "It is well, with my soul".
Dorothy Wilmer I personally have meat so many great people at Lakewood Christian Church. I have experienced many great things there. All are welcome.Go join, in worshiping our Lord Jesus Christ! Sermons that will make you think, and hearing the word. Friendly, comfortable surroundings. Very welcoming people I enjoyed the down to earth service at this church. Everyone was very friendly and encouraging. God Bless Warm and beautiful church. Excellent sermon delivered with passion. Friendly and enthusiastic congregation.  Very welcoming to a first time visitor. Looking forward to visiting again next Sunday.

name: Lakewood Church
reviewSummary: The largest church in America. Reviews center on the 'encouraging' and 'uplifting' message of Joel Osteen. The facility (former Compaq Center) is massive. Critics cite lack of depth, but attendees love the positivity.

name: Lakewood Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I believe God lives here This was the only reason we were here. This is what I wanted for my anniversary was to go and visit Lakewood Church. Joel happened to not be ministering this Sunday but that was okay Lisa brought the word and I will be back There is plenty of seating and convenient parking. You feel the Anointing in the praise and worship, fellowship, and delivery of the Word. It was absolutely worth the trip to attend from Washington, D. C.! An amazing experience. Love and peace throughout the church. We stayed for two services and got to meet Joel. Felicia met us at the door and she is such a wonderful person! We were from out of town and she was such a blessing. Took us right up front and took our picture and seated us on the fifth row. Everyone there was just awesome and so nice. Thank you all. Incredible place. The Spirit of the Lord was there. Pastor Joel comes out after the Sunday service and meets people. I thought it was amazing that he does this. The worship was great. The message brought the house down. The building was gorgeous. The staff/volunteers tied everything together. Highly recommend visiting if you’re in town. 🌟 **Lakewood Church: A Spiritual Powerhouse!** 🌟

If you're looking for an electrifying worship experience, **Lakewood Church** is the place to be! 🙌✨ This **megachurch** is more than just a building it's a **beacon of hope** and inspiration, welcoming thousands of people each week with open arms.

🔥 **The Atmosphere:** From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with **uplifting music**, vibrant energy, and a congregation that radiates positivity. The **live worship band** sets the tone with powerful performances that make you want to sing along! 🎶🎤

💡 **The Message:** Led by **Joel and Victoria Osteen**, the sermons are **motivational, heartfelt, and deeply encouraging**. Whether you're seeking guidance, strength, or just a dose of positivity, their words resonate with people from all walks of life. 🕊️💖

🏛️ **The Venue:** Housed in the **former Compaq Center**, this **16,800-seat** auditorium is nothing short of impressive! The **state-of-the-art lighting and sound system** make every service feel like a grand event. 🎆🎥

🌍 **Inclusivity:** With **English and Spanish services**, Lakewood Church embraces diversity and ensures that everyone feels at home. 🤝🌎

💫 **Final Thoughts:** Whether you're a local or visiting Houston, **Lakewood Church is an experience you won’t forget!** It’s a place where faith, community, and inspiration come together in a spectacular way. **Highly recommended for anyone seeking a spiritual boost!** 🙏💙

I can't wait to comeback.  I do live in California

reviewSummary: Nice people. One service is at the Marina pavilion, which is nice to be near the water.  The other service is also outside behind the church near the fig tree. A true Christian Church, with NO mumbo-jumbo doctrines of men. This is the right place to be Very nice..people very pleasant

name: Lanier Hills Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church makes me feel so welcome. Especially with my past. Love taking my family here amazing youth program!!! I found this place in the hotel registry book in the room where I staying while here on business.  It stood out and and after checking out their web site, it has a nice contemporary progressive feel.  While is says baptist here, it didn't feel like most baptist churches I have have been to in the past.  I don't know this church's past, but perhaps it was one of those churches that gets "born again" and updates its model for the current generation.  i liked it's slogan; "a perfect church for people who aren't".  It seemed real and not just a shtick.

The people were nice and friendly and the Spirit of God seemed to be evident.  both of the pastors I talked to were very nice and approachable.  I had some pleasant discussions with them and one even offered to get together for lunch if I had time while I was here in town.  The message was relevant and it hit home on a couple of points.  Godly advice; what it is and is not and how to recognize it.  the campus is new and has any open layout as is the sanctuary.  It is all very inviting. I went to the 9am service and it was a smaller group w/ an intimate feel during the worship.  Definitely somewhere I would recommend and go if I lived here. This is an awesome church. Pastor Randall teaches the Bible without compromising scripture.  Messages are so good! I've been attending for a year after my church closed due to covid. This church never closed and setup services outside. The people are so friendly and very welcoming! Me and my husband have been going here since  August of 19. We were looking for a church That we could call home. Everyone has made us feel so welcomed and loved. If u are looking for a place to feel like u r welcomed and enjoy wonderful message and hear so amazing music. Come here Lanier Hills is the perfect place for unperfect people. I have been going here just over 2 years and quickly found my HOME! We love hard here! Very outgoing, caring church family!

name: Las Vegas Christian Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Wow, what a great church. I just relocated and have been to several churches and finally found a place to call home! I’ve been attending service for 4 weeks now. The church is very welcoming and diverse, when I attend a church I always look for messages that speak to me and I definitely felt a connection here. If you’re looking for a non mega church that feels like family and has a nice property, this is it. Visited this church with my fiancee yesterday + it was a beautiful church for having been in a storefront business center. The music is well done. I loved how when the pastor felt the Holy Spirit they continued to worship thru music + allowwed testimony time, prayer warriors present. Energetic congregation. Great speaker + sermon that hit hard with me. They are a children's church program. Complimentry coffee + pastry bar was a nice touch + an area to commune with others in the church. Nice. Respectful. Welcoming, looking forward to returning. I'm also excited to hear they have small group fellowship during the week. This is a BIBLE teaching church, many don't know there's a difference + they truly speak from the heart of God.

I recommend this church to anyone searching for a solid church for them and or their family. Its small enough to where you don't get lost in the crowd.

The pastoral team seems geniune + personable as well.

May God continue to bless their ministry in the church + community. Amazing place to worship and grow in faith. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with genuine love and kindness. The sermons are Bible-based, practical, and inspiring, and they really help you apply God’s Word to everyday life. The worship is uplifting, and the sense of community is strong—people truly care about one another. If you’re looking for a church in Las Vegas where you can build meaningful relationships and deepen your walk with God, I highly recommend Las Vegas Christian Church on Durango. Had a class there very warm welcome. If you love the Lord give them a try. Outstanding place to worship God wonderful music and a loving congregation. The church leaders and staff were very welcoming and made me feel like family. I found my church home here.

There is a wonderful group of young people and children that attend here whose parents are committed to seeing that they know the truth. There's nice and welcoming people there. And they being cautious about covid-19 situation. But it's kind of hard when you haven't been singing for a while and you have to catch up with the pace. I think that's the only thing I was kind of intimidating about. Striving to be the New Testament Christians as found in scripture. Rejecting denominationalism and the doctrines of man, to simply worship God according to His commands. Very nice church, kind Pastor and wife. Bible based
Love you

name: LAX Calvary Chapel - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We had been going to a mega church in South Bay for a few years. My son said the children’s ministry was so big it felt like he rarely saw the same people twice. To be honest it was easy to be lost. We prayed about a change and found LAX Calvary Chapel and decided to give it a try. We haven’t left and it’s because of the smaller congregation where we eventually get to meet (and like) everyone. And it’s also because Pastor Justin teaches simply and wholly word by word through the Bible. I appreciate how he digs in and weekly reveals grace in every sermon. We highly recommend this church. I am so blessed to have a family church like CCLAX.  I have been part of this family of Christ for about 7 years and I am praying that I will continue to be part of this amazing body of Christ for many more years to come.
The Pastors and their wives and children are just amazing. Always ready to pray with you and sit with you and hear your good and difficult moments. Love the solid teachings and the true love they have for everyone (Jesus heart).

I so encourage you to come visit this church and experience for yourself the love of Christ that flows through them here.
John 3:16 This church is more than just a building, it's a family. I have attended CCLAX for over 15 years, and I have continued to grow in my faith from day 1! They teach the Bible, the whole Bible, not just snippets to make you feel good. It is a church for people who love Jesus, have a desire to grow, and want to serve God. All of the Pastor's who teach here are gifted men of God, who truly desire for the church to grow in their understanding of who God is, and what the Bible teaches.  My children have also been blessed by the loving, devoted children's ministry and all their teachers. The worship is amazing! And I can honestly say that this body of believers are some of the most genuine, loving, caring people I have ever known. I could go on with great things to say, but this review is probably already too long. If you have a desire to draw near to God, and grow in your faith, then this is the place for you! Awesome God's church. Loved pastor Justin, Joel and Andrew. Very encouraging teaching and guidance from the Bible. People are so friendly and loving and kindness. Love to go to this church. Very good Sunday school and very good coffee shop. Yummy hot coco. I ❤️  this church. I love that they stick to God's word, not man's opinions so much. I do not miss topical sermons at all, and they are not afraid to preach the hard stuff many churches shy away from.  If your looking for a church that is not lukewarm this is the place for you.  God bless you and hope you find a christ centered church and community with us

reviewSummary:
LCC has been a great church for my wife and I to grow and mature, and serve in several ways. We welcome people to give LCC a try. When we first came here as a couple 5 or 6 years ago, we felt out of touch. We finally realized it wasn't someone else's job to get us involved. We decided to get involved in the couple's ministry, Re|Engage, and it has given us much growth in our marriage. We continue to serve in this ministry as co-facilitators and it's been great!
We've also gone on a missions trip to Mexico, helped with the Fall Festival, been involved in the Corn Hole tournament each year in May, helped replaced the sanctuary carpets, and other fun events.
If you want to grow in your Christian walk, this is a great place to get planted. The guy preaching in Revelation 11 nailed it today. Great job. If I’m ever back in Redding, I’ll come again.
The worship team was awesome as well. Welcoming atmosphere, great kids ministry, amazing pastor, and a fantastic worship team. I feel the Holy Spirit as I near the door.  Everthing a church should have. I have gone to LCC throughout my life since I was little. The pastors, people, and worship are great. I would highly recommend it to anyone who is looking for a church! Love Pastor Bryan! He's got an amazing sense of humor and teaches straight out of the bible. The pastoral staff goes through the bible with you chapter by chapter and verse by verse. This is a big church with a little church feel. They make you feel comfortable and loved the minute you walk through the door.

name: Leawood Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Ryan did the service for my brothers funeral yesterday. And although i had never met him prior to this tragic event i felt as though i had known him all my life. Based on the message he provided to our family it was as though he had known my brother. Ryan -Thank You ! You made a very tough day alot easier. Your message will be carried in my families heart forever. God Bless!!! Missy Leawood Pres is a warm, welcoming church, that proclaims the encouraging truth about Jesus Christ in a way that is engaging and relevant. There is a sense of joy there. I highly recommend Leawood Pres to anyone seeking to understand Christianity better or for those who want to grow in their faith. I'd like say again to Leawood Church family thanks for supporting Worship Wagon the Riverview Gardens community family through the years. Very kind warm and caring folk ❤️ being last was being first thank you from the bottom of our 💓. Took my sister to the food pantry

name: Leawood United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Very much appreciated the help and prayers 🙏 they were very helpful and polite 🙂 Beautiful service for my friends funeral.  Thank you. MARVELOUS music program, FRIENDLY people! Great church Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Legacy Bible Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: This was our second Sunday.  The sermon, choir and orchestra were so beautiful it brought tears to my eyes.  Very moving. I currently live in another state, but my wife and I are considering moving to fishers. I have watched their live streams for sometime and last week was my first visit. If we move, this will certainly be our church! I hope to hear the Associate Pastor preach more but overall a great church. One of my children was called a disrespectful name from an adult while  there for VBS. My child was just holding her brother’s hand, and a woman called her out of her name. I told the assistant pastor and he told me thanks for letting him know, instead of just not coming back. My Kids love coming whenever we are in town. The church is always super welcoming! I am grateful that my kids are always safe, taught well and cared for. Are you searching for traditional Christian worship and noticed your search is growing more challenging? As Christian leaders struggle with following trends and capturing the attention of the current American population, are they bowing too much to the culture? At Legacy Bible Church sermons are based on the Word of God - not on current affairs or self-help. We also recognize the powerful words in traditional hymns and the peace and beauty of their familiar melodies; thus, we are not in a rush to abandon them. Legacy Bible Church is a worshiping church, a caring church, a welcoming church, a biblical church, a salvation church, and a mission church - devoted to making Jesus Christ known to the world. Check us out. Legacy Bible Church may be where the Spirit inside you wants you to be.

name: Legacy Center Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the place I call “home”! What makes this church so special is the presence of God and the heart of the people. The worship is powerful, the teaching is grounded in truth, and the community truly lives life together. For many it’s not like you’ve experienced and don’t can be a process but with any good thing it takes intentionality!
. Even the little things from the attendants in the parking lot to the greeters at the door, how warmly people welcome you makes a difference. Watching the kids get excited too, to go to children’s church is not a little thing and worth seeing for yourself.
If you’re looking for a place to grow in your faith and belong, this is it. Legacy is truly the place to call home. The unadulterated, life-changing Gospel of Jesus Christ is taught and preached with clarity and truth. Spiritual family is not just talked about here it’s genuinely found. You’re seen, loved, and challenged to grow. This isn’t just a church you attend; it’s a community where faith is strengthened and lives are transformed. Highly recommend! I’ve been attending for about 5 months. We really enjoy our time here, everyone has been so welcoming. We love the worship and the preaching. Lots of friendly faces and the church is so incredibly organized. If you have children they have amazing staff for all ages from 1years old to teens. There are so many resources and events going on monthly. Legacy is truly a special place. The worship is on another level!
It’s a place that feels like home, where the Word is preached in its fullness and the leaders are genuine, loving, and relatable. The sermons are powerful, life-changing, encouraging, and practical—you can truly expect to grow. The community is priceless!
My life has not been the same. Legacy is an answered prayer! This is a church that teaches sound biblical doctrine with a clear focus on Jesus Christ. There is a strong emphasis on inner healing, deliverance, and allowing the Holy Spirit to lead every service.

Dr. Faith and Pastor Soboma don’t just preach the Word—they live it. Their commitment to walking in obedience to God is evident, and they continually create an atmosphere where the Holy Spirit is the center of everything.

I am truly blessed to be a part of this church. If you are seeking truth, spiritual growth, and a deeper relationship with Jesus, this is a place where you can learn and grow. The opportunity to grow is available to everyone who is willing to receive it.

name: Legacy Christian Church - Overland Park
reviewSummary:
Legacy Christian Church has been my church home for nearly six years now, and my wife's church for her entire life. We love this church, the community we've found here, the incredible intentionality of the staff and elders, and the great biblical teaching provided by the pastoral team.

The Overland Park campus is growing rapidly, with a lot of young married couples joining this location specifically, but it is a place that is welcoming to all people, and that keeps us accountable to God's commandments. Friendly folks and culturally diverse. Powerful Bible teaching for applying to today's life. Wonderful, contemporary worship music. I am blessed to have found this church! Legacy is a wonderful church because people care about one another.  Plus, I appreciate that the teaching is primarily Biblical based and not topical.  Also, the staff is amazing!  We’ve been attending Legacy for 20 years and hope to the next 20+ years! It was so amazing when me and my friend went there, what a great church Wonderful church teaching God's word. Loving, friendly people.

name: Legacy Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church! My family has been attending since it started in January and we feel at home here. It has a very welcoming and safe environment, a Pastor we can trust to teach the Bible, amazing kids program that our daughters love, and a talented worship team that makes it so easy to connect to the Holy Spirit in worship. We are so excited about the future of this church and thankful to God that it is here in Fayetteville! My family loves Legacy church! From the beginning they have been so welcoming and inviting. My children love the kids ministry and look forward to going every week. My husband and I enjoy the sound teaching and Christ centered community. Legacy has been such a blessing for our family. The staff is welcoming, our kids love the children’s program, and the messages are powerful. This is not a church for those who are satisfied with being complacent. Legacy is a home for those who yearn for more. We are very thankful for Pastor Jason Kimbrow and his wife Ashley. They have always made us feel welcome and they genuinely care about our family. Jason’s message always has something I can take away from it. He is very relatable and has a huge heart for God.  For this reason, we love attending and serving at Legacy. It is a great feeling to call it our church home! This church has been the perfect fit for our family. We look forward to every Sunday!  The atmosphere is welcoming, encouraging and supportive.

name: Legacy Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary: Legacy Church is such a welcoming and life giving place. From the moment you walk in, you’re met with open arms and genuine care. They truly value people and are intentional about pouring into everyone who attends. Everything they do stays centered on God, which you can feel in every part of the church. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a place to grow in your faith. You are truly seen here! I love Legacy Church! When I walked in the doors I had given up on people, but Legacy helped restore my faith in church and in people. The people are amazing, the music is fantastic, the preaching is top notch, and the atmosphere is full of faith. If you are looking for a church then go to Legacy! What a blessing to be a part of this church. I love the worship and Gods presence that you feel when you walk through the doors. The messages that we hear from Pastor Dereck just are so uplifting and I love the community that we have with one another. I have made new friends and friends that pray with me when I need it. Come join us and join a serve team! You won’t regret it! Legacy is more than a church, it's a home. If your honestly looking for a place where you can be seen and loved and valued and all about helping people get closer to Jesus then Legacy is the place to be. I'm so blessed to be lead to this church. Honestly it's been just an amazing experience to be around so many generous and caring and loving people. I relocated to Greenwood over a year ago. I prayed God would lead me to a church that the word was spoken from the Bible. My kids introduced me to Legacy Church. I was immediately felt welcomed into and surrounded by a church family.

name: Legacy Church - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church services where Holy Spirit is invited and is moving freely! Very family and community focused. Great group of hungry lovers of Jesus❤️🕊️ We have watched online for a few months and plan to attend when we move to New Braunfels/Northeast San Antonio. ​God's presence is truly real at this church. I love the flowing, Spirit-led worship that makes you feel the Holy Spirit's movement. The sermons are built on a strong, biblical foundation, providing a clear message that you can apply to your life. A specific prophetic message during one of the Encounter Sundays was incredibly strengthening and comforting me. This church isn't just a congregation; it's a family that builds each other up in God's love and word. I love to be here. This church is so amazing. It is a healthy church that knows how to love people and communicate well. Full gospel preaching with prophetic and apostolic services. Definitely worth visiting if you're looking for a 5 fold ministry. They play 5 songs every service and even have two service times available. The atmosphere is charged with prayer and Jesus' presence is in that place and you will definitely have an encounter with Him. If you'te in the area and need a home church or a church to visit while on vacation, I definitely give this place a 10/10 and highly recommend! My family and I have been on a search for a new church home for the past year. This is just our experiance visiting this church on that search. There are a total of 5 worship songs before they even get to general announcements. Main sermon does not start for at least an hour in and then it can go for another hour and change. I understand people like to worship with music but I personally don't go to church to see a concert. 3 songs should be the absolute max before the message starts. Also I don't know if it is normal but the sermon was done by people who stood at floor level despite there being a full stage behind them. It's a nit pick but it just threw the whole balance off for me. The sermon its self was more of a self help pitch on fitness, health and diet which is fine but I get that stuff from a multitude of other places already. It seriously lacked any real spiritual depth. The people were nice but this church really was not for me and my family. Watch some of the older services. You will find hate in those walls. A church whether it's a building or a person, should be gifting it's soul to all walks of people.

name: Legacy Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: We started going to church here in early 2018.  After just a few weeks, we decided to go to their new member class. We really loved the pastors they have on staff and the way they brought the message of Jesus and salvation down to an easy to understand level. We are now members and part of a life group. Legacy Church is awesome for families with young kids, single adults, or empty nesters.  The women's ministry has great programs and plenty of opportunities to get involved and plugged in. Great to be back in the HOUSE!!! Even though everyone had on masks you could see the smiles in their eyes. So glad we're meeting in person again. In fact, we're having to have an 8:30 service in addition to the 10:30!! Plus, LIVE ONLINE for those not quite ready to be in the building. I love my church!! As an introvert, it has always been a challenge for me to meet new people, especially at church. For this reason, I have always had a hard time finding a church where I feel like I belong. The moment I walked into Legacy Church, however, I was immediately welcomed by genuine, caring people. I felt like I truly belonged, and after 3 years, I still feel like I belong. The people in this church really CARE and have made a huge impact on my life, helping me to trust Jesus every step of the way. Very welcoming environment, friendly staff. Children’s ministry is the best I’ve seen. Sermons include direct bible reading, reasoning and helpful application ideas on real life topics. You hear and feel Love, Truth of the Word and the presence of God in this place. Highly recommend to beginners of faith, or someone looking for a church home near by. Legacy is very warm and welcoming place helping people learn about and follow Jesus. Legacy has a great kids ministry and other groups and programs to help us all grow and advance in our walk with Jesus. On your first visit you’ll feel like you’ve been attending for years! See you Sunday!

name: Legacy Church AZ - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing word of God is preached at this church. Filled with the Holy Spirit. The Lord is using Justin and Delicia to heal the brokenhearted and lead people to the cross of Jesus. It is wonderful to witness the truth being spoken with  such passion.  This church is for everyone, from the seasoned believers to new believers trying to find their way.

The Worship led by Donnie
Is powerfully and tastefully executed. I couldn’t recommend this church more. Gods love is here. God, through this church,will change your life!!! I visited Lagacy Church last Sundayv and absolutely loved it.  Went back today and now know this is the place God has been calling me to.  Bible-true, wholesome, and pure.  So thankful to have found my church home. This is a place that will change your life. There is really no way around it or another way to put it. From the ground up this church was built by Jesus through plenty of great people. The dedication that goes into the preparation of each experience weekly is just amazing.

The worship is consistently heartfelt and man do they have some pipes on them too. Very talented production team asembling this, especially considering the auditorium doubles as a Basketball court. (Not anymore, we got a building now baby! Praise Jesus!)

The message is founded in the Word of God and I just simply have not found any place around the valley or even back in California that I can honestly say represents the Love and Leadership of Jesus Christ quite like Legacy Church does.

I have learned so much coming here and recently started to serve and really get involved which has opened the door for my girlfriend (now fiancé, praise Jesus) and I, to actually get connected here. To become a part of the church not just a guest, which I had forgotten to do for many years. After going to Legacy around a year now I can confidently say this church is life changing and I am so grateful to be a part of Legacy Church. To be empowered to help others and to discover the power that already lies in my spoken word. I could go on forever about how much I care about this place and the people in it and this is no short term relationship, they are stuck with me now too.

Thank you for welcoming me in Legacy Family. My family and I attend. Younger & Older crowd  this experience is for you! PD & PJ help explain scriptures in a way that makes it easier to understand & grasp your attention! Also shout out to the parking team 🅿️🦺♿️ The best way to describe Legacy and the people is in one word....Genuine.

As soon as you pull up, and walk through those doors, you will feel welcomed by good people with kind hearts who represent God and the church well.

Then, as you grab a snack and a coffee, you walk down the hallway to tons more smiles and welcomed until you get to the main sanctuary (gym), where you are ushered to a seat amongst others there to learn and grow in faith too.

I guarantee you, the worship songs AND the sermon WILL resonate with you....EVERY SINGLE TIME.  It's like the message was tailored for you.

Afterwards, you can stop for a prayer over you and your life and then go to the Next Steps table to learn what your next steps in your walk in faith could be.

No matter what, it will be a joyful experience. Every Sunday is a blessing when you're surrounded by faith and love. You'll see why the goal is to love, live, and lead like Jesus.

name: Legacy Church Las Vegas - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love Legacy Church! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with open arms and genuine smiles. The atmosphere is full of love and warmth — it truly feels like home. The worship is powerful, and the messages always hit deep and leave me feeling uplifted and renewed. Every service is life-changing, and I’m so grateful to be part of such an amazing church family! LOVE THIS CHURCH. Amazing pastors. Loving culture. And almost importantly a heart for God with a wonderful praise and worship. My kids attend kids church here and the teachers are so loving and kind. We are legacy church for life! If you are looking for a Las Vegas Christian church. Look no further than Legacy Church Las Vegas. This is a wonderful church with wonderful people; they welcomed me into God’s house with open arms just as I was and it has been home since. Pastor David and Ms. Sherrie are very humble, kind hearted, God-fearing individuals that continuously water the seeds they plant in the lives of each and every single member. If you’re looking for a church that prioritizes love like Christ, this is the place to go! It's not just a place to worship but a place to grow spiritually and build lasting relationships. The church’s commitment to outreach and serving the local community speaks volumes about their dedication to living out their faith. I'm incredibly thankful for the role this church plays in my life and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a warm, welcoming place to grow in faith and fellowship! Looking for a church where you’re welcomed with open arms the moment you walk in? A place where worship is alive, the Word is powerful, and community feels like family? We’d love for you to come and experience it for yourself—you belong here!

name: Legacy Church O.C - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Legacy Church on Tustin Street in City of Orange 🍊 CA is located in old The Village 📽️ Movie Theater. Huge parking 🅿️ lot
Has several service types & times. Many in Espanol. Very well maintained inside and out. Great for the community! 🤙 Legacy Church is a BIG family! The moment you stepped in you feel like you've belonged there for ages. Glory of God, Great message and exceptional leaders. Pastor Uzziel and Julie  are amazing  and readily available. Join us and feel the presence of God! Your life won’t be the same. If your looking for a welcoming atmosphere and a place where you can truly make a connection with God. Definitely come to this church I started attending Legacy Church of Orange County since June 2023.  I was looking to go deeper into my walk with God. This is it! The Holy Spirit is a strong presence at every service!  If you need any healing and deliverance, this is the place. English 10 am and Spanish 12 pm and Weds Spanish 7:30 pm.  The worship is Spirit filled. Everyone here is so welcoming! I am learning so much. Excited to start attending Legacy University soon! Awesome church. Pastor Uzziel is amazing. A church where you feel like one of the family with tons of opportunities to serve. The Word is deep and powerful - worship is amazing they allow the move of the Holy Spirit to flow. I loved the cafe options as well.

name: Legacy Church Pensacola - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: This church has felt like home from the first time we walk through the doors. We are so grateful that God put legacy church from Pensacola in our paths and they have become nothing less than family. Even our children have grown so much mentally and in the Grace of this place of worship and amazing people. If you need a good place to worship and feel the Holy Spirit fill a room with people who are going to love you for exactly the person that you are, please I so encouraged you to visit our church. 🙌⛪ Good bless Legacy church stands out for its loving and supportive community. Following our move to Pensacola over a year ago, we visited multiple local churches without finding the warmth we experienced at Legacy. Pastor Ryan and Kim have a heart for the Pensacola community. If you are new to the area check out this awesome church. Warmest and most welcoming church I've ever been to. The people are so friendly and genuine. I think the church congregation itself is a direct reflection of the Pastoral Leadership there. Birds of a feather flock together. If you're looking for a place to call home where you'll be welcomed without judgement or condemnation, check out Legacy Church Pensacola. We feel blessed to belong. We absolutely LOVE Legacy Church! The atmosphere and the people are loving and welcoming. This church has everything from the great preaching, powerful moves of God, and incredible worship. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a church to call home! From the moment I walked in the door, I felt such love and acceptance from each person I encountered at RLC! The services are dynamic with in depth preaching from the Pastor, the worship is great, and the children’s department is top notch. There are so many opportunities to make friends and get involved- no matter what your demographic is. I look forward to church every week!

name: Legacy Church Salinas - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary: I have the best experience in Legacy church the first time I was in Legacy I feel like I was home with my family members. After that has been 7 years. I’ve been going to the church. As soon as you go to the church, you feel the spirit of God. They treat me like family. And the spirit of God fills the entire room.

name: Legacy City Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
There are some really awesome christians here, but the annoiniting has left. If you're looking for a TED talk about positivity, etc, this is the place for you. If a couple approaches you about a Bible study and serves wine or other drinks at that bible study, run.

7/22 - Alcoholic drinks are served at a specific bible study ran by a wealthy donor at their house, not at the church. I  brought it up the leadership and was told to confront him in person, and when I did, he said, "It doesn't bother my conscience..." I reported back to leadership, but nothing was done. I felt the nudging for a while to speak out about this, so I'm doing what's been bothering my conscience. Instead of defending the church, elders need to read the review properly and speak to the individual to stop him from serving drinks at a bible study. In 30 years our family has been active members of 3 churches. Legacy has something for everyone, great musical praise, responsible children’s church, women’s and men’s Bible study and a pastor and deacon team whose family and faith makes them a wonderful and wise resource. Please consider making Legacy, your legacy in a faithful walk with Jesus. Legacy is such a great church located in Studio City. Pastor Josh preaches directly from the word. His message reflects the teachings of Jesus. There’s great community and the members go out of their way to make you feel welcomed. There’s plenty of bible studies to get involved in throughout the week. Been coming for a few months and it already feels like home. I love this church! I always feel welcomed and loved. The people are loving and friendly and the worship is amazing. Pastor Josh teaches from the Bible verse by verse. We are encouraged to bring our bibles and read it for ourselves which I love because the word of God is the ultimate authority. Pastor Josh is humble and down to earth. He is also very friendly and wants to get to know each person that comes in so he encourages people to come meet him after the service or meet with him for coffee. Overall, I love this church and recommend it to anyone and everyone! My home church ❤️. I was looking for a church and found Legacy City Church. I was nervous at first about attending but when I did, I felt so welcomed. I love that people were so friendly and genuine. I feel the presence of the Lord here and I totally recommend Legacy for any one looking for a church in which they can call family. Legacy is family! 🥰

name: Legacy Community Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary: The moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with so much love.  Truly the love of God and his presence is felt as well as the warmth of the brethren.                    The Worship is phenomenal. The word is preach, and taught. The pastoral staff is there to guide you in your spiritual  growth and your relationship with God.       The brethren are helpful with information, to guide on any personal matter.                 Sunday school is truly a blessing.  You are welcome to share,your testimonies everyone listens.                                                               The church events throughout the year, leave no room for Boredom. This is truly a church filled with the presence of God,  love, care and teaching, as well leading, and helping you to fulfill the call of God in your life. I was welcomed at this church and loved it all the time I attended from 2015 to 2023 when I moved out of state. The people and pastors that serve are generous with their time and talents. The message from the pulpit is always spot on. I will visit every time I am in town. Legacy Church has been a moving experience 🙏 for myself Great people friendly and God lead.

name: Legacy House Church - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment you walk through the doors, you can feel the Holy Spirit in this place — and it's unlike anything I've ever experienced. There's a tangible presence that greets you, a warmth and peace that goes beyond the people, the music, or the message. It's real, it's alive, and it's undeniable. I've had the joy of bringing my teenage grandsons here, and watching them encounter that presence has been one of the greatest blessings of my life.

Pastor David consistently delivers sermons that are relevant, passionate, and rooted in truth. Every message feels like it was written just for where you are in life.

The praise and worship team is absolutely amazing — they create an atmosphere of genuine worship that invites the Holy Spirit in and moves your heart every single time.

The Curle family - where do I start - they are truly exceptional and reflect the heart of this church in everything they do. And the community of believers here are kind, warm, and genuinely real. No pretense — just people who love God and love each other.

Legacy House Church isn't just a church — it's a family. If you're looking for a place where the Holy Spirit moves freely and you truly belong, look no further. This is it. This Incredible Church Saved my life. Lead by The Loving and Compassionate Curle Family. Jesus is Here. Come say hi 👋🙏👍✌️ Hear a beautiful message from God. Meet and fellowship with like minded couples, families and singles too. All are welcome and they mean it too. An honest and transparent church. They truly value Christ and His legacy in our families and community.
Hallelujah Northview Community Church has helped me through some tough times. Thank you for your kindness and generosity.

name: Legacy Nashville (Church) - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Legacy while on a work trip. Let me tell you, I grew up in church, spent sometime time away and decided to give my life completely back to Christ a few months ago. There is no doubt in my mind the Holy Spirit fills this place. The worship team is the best I’ve ever seen and it’s so easy to see that they’re not doing it for show or for people to see their talent but just to praise the Lord our God. The sermon dove into parables in Matthew and Pastor Lyle did an amazing job of explaining in both today’s terms and what it meant back then!! I’ve made a plan to attend a service every three months even though I live 500 miles away. If you’relooking for a place to go, Legacy is it! GET THERE EARLY! My wife and I visited here Sunday for their middle service of 3. We have friends who attend here now that used to live where we do. We are the type of people who attend worship even on vacation. The service was great. The worship was awesome, the pastor's message was Biblical and challenging, the people were friendly. If you live in Nashville and are looking for a church home, I would definitely advise checking them out. Here are the few things that kept me from giving 5 stars. 1) Parking was a mess. I followed my GPS to get there and their parking is extremely limited. People were parking on the street blocks away and walking. I also had the feeling I came in from the "wrong way" as I drove down the street in the opposite direction they were sending everyone out from their earlier service. And with vehicles lining both sides, it was nearly impossible to get to the parking lot. The one "non-friendly" look we got was from the parking attendant that gave me the "what are you doing" look as if I should have known better. 2) Seating is limited and it will be packed. Thankfully this doesn't bother me and my wife as we attend a large church as well. But they had seats covered in the back forcing everyone down front. They uncovered rows to allow people to sit in them as the rows closer to the front filled in. From a visitor's (and I imagine if I were a seeker) perspective, I might want to come in and grab a seat in the back. But overall a positive experience and we will probably go back the next time we are visiting the Nashville area over a weekend. (And it doesn't hurt we already have friends there as well.) A super engaging church. Treated like family; we were greeted and people were conversational. Arrive early enough as parking and seating might be an issue. The last service is the easiest to navigate; less people and easier parking. First time going on Mother’s Day, this place is a joke, this 10am service was a “female pastor” who ever called her self the pastor mid sermon. She had zero depth to her message other than a “feel good” hype up. 0/0 stars. If you want quality and depths this is not the place. I searched for a church like this for years. There is real diversity here. There is real compassion here. This is a place where it's ok to be vulnerable and even broken. The people here don't look over others. Everybody matters, and no one is expendable.

I have experienced SO MUCH healing getting to know the people here, and letting them get to know me.

name: Legend Community Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
the drummer is one of the nicest people you will ever meet, really good lookin too This is a church that is honest & welcoming.

+ great team that is unified under Jesus’s teachings, the Bible & fostering real community with each other.
+ Super friendly! Everyone is the “welcome desk”. In two visits, maybe 7 people have introduced themselves to me which I appreciate & enjoy.
+ worship is great with talented musicians
+ free coffee & snacks before service
+ communion is real bread not wafers!
+ messages from pastors are relatable & challenging
+ large and fun youth group
+ just 18 min drive from Price Hill
+ people go to lunch together afterwards
- steep stairs up to the worship space may be challenging for some (maybe there is an elevator I didn’t see) Their drummer is fantastic. Sermons are fine.

name: Liberation Street Church
reviewSummary:
I've been going to this church off and on for at least 15-16 years. I no longer am going to attend this church on the account of being mistreated by the community.What I've noticed about this church is they're clicky and they talk the talk but definitely don't walk the walk. Today was my last day attending this church as I miss my ride from TriMet lift and I sat down to speak to the pastor before they close to see if the pastor could ether give me a ride or wait until my ride arrive because I'm disabled I'm unable to stand for long periods of the time and for some reason I noticed that the sisters of the church were rushing me out and I never had this experience before and I still don't understand why this happened but to make a long story short Once Upon a Time the pastor was patient enough to wait for my TriMet lift to pick me up when it was late which was nice and that was my goal to ask for a ride or to see if he had time to wait but I got sidetracked because I had a whole audience in my business so
I had words with the audience and I I spoke what I really felt and it kind of went sideways but to make a long story the two sister of the church and the pastor basically kicked out of the church left on the side of the road in front of the church. Other people in the community  have vehicles especially the sister of the church no one stepped up to do a good deed that needed to be done. They just locked up the church and left me on Burnside street which is also a very dangerous street. I would not recommend going to this church or being a member at any time and I see why now why this church is called Liberation Street Church because they sure treated me like we were in the streets and that is no way for anyone feel. I truly love this church. The people there are there to worship. It's not a fashion show with Christian's who think they are all righteous and too good to share a table with the homeless. I love them.  Most are the most humble.  We the homeless, less fortunate, indifferent, and the outcasts are the ones God predestined.   It's really shows in this church, and to the  presence of the Holy Spirit is felt. We had an awesome time serving hot meals to the homeless people in our community. Amazing place where volunteers gather here and then walk to under the bridge to feed, cloths, o help the people with other services like washing feet, haircuts, etc. Great worship services  back in day when Pastor Charles was alive.

name: Liberation United Church of Christ
reviewSummary: I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at Liberation! Absolutely unbiblical teaching Terrible Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Liberti Church
reviewSummary: Gospel-centered family of churches across Philadelphia living out Jesus' Great Commission through liturgical beauty, shared neighborhood meals, and mercy initiatives.

name: Liberti Church Main Line - Tredyffrin Township Campus
reviewSummary: Gospel-centered family of churches across Philadelphia living out Jesus' Great Commission through liturgical beauty, shared neighborhood meals, and mercy initiatives.

name: Liberty Baptist Church
reviewSummary: Outstanding expository Bible teaching and welcoming community.

name: Liberty Baptist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
We moved to the area, and had been searching for good churches and discovers Liberty Baptist. Because of my work schedule I hadn’t been able to check out the church but thank be to God that I was able to change my schedule to have Sundays off and today was our first time attending Liberty Church. My mother, brother and I really enjoyed it. The greeting lady gave a warm welcome making us feel right at home. The service was a perfect balance of Spirit filled, King James Bible preaching and traditional but also contemporary worship style. My brother and I connected right with leadership right away and they made us feel like we belong. We are definitely coming back next week. Everyone is really friendly. Definitely feel God's presence at this church. Pastor Ryan has very insightful  sermons that are easy to follow. Unfortunately I'm far and have looked at other churches and none have felt like Liberty. I came lost , then I was found , saved and I have a community , a family in Christ. It is a special place that is constantly reminding you of its foundation , the Bible, it doesn’t bend to the times . This church is a family church however Pastor never forgets to include the “times” in his preaching he shows you weekly not to be intimidated to open that Bible and Gods inspiration will flow on any topic of today . He rolls up his sleeves and tackles anything with the words from the Bible. You will leave always wishing everyday was Sunday ! You are a child of God you are safe you are important and you are loved.Pastor Ryan doesn’t let you leave without that in heart ever! The music is fabulous as well and is planned to go along with the scripture. It is not a passive experience. Fantastic church!  The worship/song leaders have phenomenal voices. When they lead the congregation in worship, I feel very focused on the Lord and His goodness... because they choose songs that are doctrinally rich.  I would describe their style as "blended worship" some modern and some traditional. The preaching is always applicable to my life and helps me to develop my walk with God in a richer way. I highly recommend this church.
***The youth group is very active and has a clear mission of discipling the teens.*** Community, it’s the first thing that comes to mind when I think of Liberty Baptist. I have personally experienced genuine relationships and spiritual growth by attending small groups and other events at this church. The things we study always point me to Jesus and my children are eager to be a part of the children’s ministry.
The pastors and staff notice you when you are there, reach out to you when you are going through life’s ups and downs and take loving care of their congregation.

name: Liberty Baptist Church of Eden Prairie
reviewSummary: For those needing to hear and grow -- you will find Biblical exegesis  (uncovering the exact meaning in its original context and application for Christian lives today).   The  Bible is not tangential -- it is God's revelation of Himself and ourselves. It was such a good play, Anne of Green Gables is one of the best A welcoming church that loves to teach and preach the Bible. No Happy Hour specials unfortunately This place is amazing!!

name: Liberty Church
reviewSummary: Such wonderful people! Everyone makes you feel so welcome. Love this church and the pastor is great Liberty Church is a welcoming environment that truly preaches the word. I call our parishioners a solid group. We are there for one another. Join us in worshipping our Lord. My kids LOVE it! So grateful to have found a church where they feel loved, excited, and eager to come back each week. Love this place! I really enjoy the sermons, Sunday school, and worship music at this church in Lexington. The teaching is grounded in the Bible and offers practical application for daily life. It's a small church, and the congregation is warm and sincere. Parking is easy, and they serve wonderful refreshments after the service. Whenever I'm in the area, I always make sure to visit.

name: Liberty Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: I’m disabled and I have no disability income. My daughter picked up food from the pantry. I’m not sure what I’m supposed to make with this. It’s kinda confusing at least the produce is fresh. Thank God it’s not rotten! The squash is pretty. It’s just I don’t know what to do with it. I feel bad bc I don’t know how to cook it. I survived 3 strokes it’s been a challenge obtaining resources. Thank you for the healthy food!! All I can say is that I’ve only been there once—not for me but 3 other families who are really hurting for food.  They asked me if I remembered the name—it was Grace Klein—so because we had a Dr.’s appt. in BHM, we stopped afterwards to pick up food for our friends & WOW!  There was even a semi truck being loaded with food  for individuals that probably didn’t live in BHM like us.   The volunteer staff were amazingly friendly and helpful that I wanted to get out of my car and start helping them to do this work!!!  Wish I lived closer as I would volunteer for this awesome ministry.  Monday through Thursday 1:00-4:00 every week and you just have to fill out an online form first so when you get to the front of the line they can take care of you quickly!!  There was all beautiful fresh produce in these boxes, no junk food—some items were not as fresh but still all natural healthy food for families who could not afford to buy this!!! Thank you Grace Klein and Liberty Church for your wonderful ministry of food distribution!!!  “ In as much as ye have done unto the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto Me!” I went for the food pantry which is offered every weekday between 1 pm and 4 pm. Got there just before 4 so options were limited as it was the end of the day, still, I was happy to get breads, fruits, and vegetables,  even some pumpkin spice cupcakes. Wonderful people who prayed with us and service with joyful hearts and smiles. God is definitely is this place! The kids love it and it has given me a breath of fresh air. I've made some great new friends. I love that it is a very diverse church as well. It has helped bring life back to me and renew my relationship with Jesus! I love this Place wonderful caring ppl who Pray for u an with You and da Food delivery an Pick up at drive thru is Awesome they deserve 10 Stars💫💫💫 for helping and  feedin so many ppl in Alabama

name: Liberty Church - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter and I went there for the first time and we really enjoyed the service. The people were very welcoming, the music was excellent. The preacher was great!! We are going back there next Sunday!! Great Church 🙏❤️🙏❤️🙏 If you prefer a watered down version of the gospel, without the supernatural joy, power and love, manifested by the presence of the Holy Spirit, then this is not the church for you. There is only sound, biblical, scripture based preaching here. Very welcoming and genuine people. Baptized as infant in a catholic church, as i got older I realized my deep conscious beliefs more aligned with Christianity, moved to the area in search of a home church, my 3yo encouraged me to visit here after passing by it for weeks…

Felt the Holy Spirit like no where else the moment services started, first time stepping in this body of Christ.

A place to come as you are, no feeling of obeying to be accepted - being accepted and naturally obeying in the word. I have visited this church a handful of times every time I come from Las Vegas, Nevada. I Refused to miss church when I’m away from home, but I also don’t want to be misled any church. The Holy Spirit is here! I always have a great time in fellowship and I’m grateful for this church. If you are local or just visiting you won’t be disappointed! May God continue to bless this foundation. Had to leave.  Very "hokey" feeling" going on.  Politics should stay out of the church and sermons.  Won't step foot in again.  What doesn't come out in the wash eventually comes out in the dry.

name: Liberty Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary:
Liberty Church is led by a remarkable pastor who cares deeply about everyone. Liberty teaches you not just to come to church to worship and hear the word of God; but how to experience God on your own by developing habits to create an intimate relationship with God. Come by and join us, you will be met with love. Great place of worship, learning, and growth! Yes, it is multicultural (like truly, and not just the worship team). Yes, it is kid-friendly (you can tell that the staff over the kids ministry are organized and trained). Yes, the schedule is flexible (multiple services throughout the day). The best part is that they preach from the Bible. We love this Church! We have been here for many years, my husband even longer. The atmosphere is so warm and inviting, this is like our extended family. Worship is amazing, the sermons always make you think and grow. The children's church is so amazing, my son asks to come! The youth program does a great job of raising the next generation to be Godly, servant-hearted teens. My family has been attending Liberty church for 15 years!
We love the Bible based teaching and  our church community! The worship is awesome and Holy  spirit filled. My personal walk with Christ has grown tremendously! Pastor John has an incredible passion for the word of God and wants nothing more than to help others learn the word of God, and grow in their walk with the Lord! Liberty Church is an extremely welcoming Church.

When they talk about Church being more than a Church, but family it really feels like it and shows.

I moved from Louisiana and was introduced to this Church by my fiancé and her immediate family.

I grew up Catholic, but Liberty really transformed me and my walk with the Lord. It has undoubtedly brought me closer to God and helped me grow more as a man in general.

If you are looking for a principled gathering you should come check this Church out.

name: Liberty Church Jersey City - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Liberty church! Whether I am attending in person or virtual service I feel loved and part of a greater community. Everyone is genuine, kind, and supportive. They have been there for me during lifes' toughest seasons.

The service and social gatherings are always heartfelt and grounded in the Word. Whether you're new or have been long committed to the faith this is a special place and beautiful committed people to do life and praise with. What truly makes Liberty Church special is the people. It’s a place where diverse individuals come together in faith — to support each other, to serve others, and to grow closer to God. From shared moments of worship to quiet moments of personal prayer, there’s something deeply powerful about being part of something bigger than myself.

Whether you're seeking hope, healing, guidance, or simply a deeper sense of purpose, church can be a sanctuary — not just in a spiritual sense, but in a very real, human way. I’m grateful for what I’ve found there, and I would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone searching for connection and meaning. A Spirit-filled home away from home!
Liberty Church JC is truly a place where God’s presence is felt. The Sunday service are powerful! From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed like family. The love of Christ is evident in how they serve the community and care for each other. If you’re looking for a church that nurtures both your faith and your spirit, this is it. Great atmosphere, very friendly  congreation pastor and first lady are very welcoming , love how ministry is base on life issues of the community first time visiting will return Incredible church, so welcoming and inviting. The pastor is wise and knowledgeable in the Word. Wish I could give 6 stars

name: Liberty Church New York City - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve had the opportunity to work with Liberty Church, and everyone has been welcoming and organized. The team is kind, and it’s clear they care about creating a positive environment for their community. Thank you for allowing me to be a part of your events. Crush ENT Amazing! Casual, Bible led, wonderful worship! Centered in Financial district. All welcome. Close for Pace students. Low key, genuine, no fuss Modern Christian community. Enjoyed visiting the 10am service. I'm yesterday me hospital
I'm going back tomorrow yes What an incredible place to be a part of. Pastor Stephen and David are remarkable human beings, I am so fortunate to be a part of this church.

name: Liberty Road Faith Fellowship - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: They had a fundraising yard sale. The staff was very friendly. Nice selection of donated items. I donated extra money towards for their fundraiser. This is one of the friendliest churches I ever attended.  I can't wait to meet the new pastor on February 4! Very friendly and welcoming.  The pastor is wonderful. Lovely worship space. Good daily use of non worship space. I felt like an outsider at this church🥲

name: Liberty Temple Christian Church - Stone Mountain Campus
reviewSummary: Love my Church. Pastor Hughley and associate ministers teach & preach the Word of God. We pray for all people. Interactive bible study on Wed./zoom  Praise & worship is awesome! Friendly atmosphere, mixture of age groups. Pastor really easy to talk to. Mens and womens groups that really are respectful and caring. You don't have to get all dressed up. Come as you are. Family friendly. Good message by Pastor. I really enjoy going to Liberty Temple Christian church where I have been a member for the past 16 years. They helped me when I didn't have any other help. I walked to the first church I saw and I am truly glad it was them💯 My son is the Minister of Music & I Love the worship Experience  The presence of the Lord is here

name: Life Apostolic Ministries (LAM) - Oceanside Campus
Life As One Church - Claremont, CA - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: We love Life As One - they truly are a caring family, who care about the glory of God and His presence, and the world whom they burn for. As an outside partnering ministry, we can see how God is using this small but mighty church to influence the atmosphere of the city. They are paving the way for the Ekklesia to go beyond Sundays and our institutionalized four walls! Bless this church and bless the churches of Claremont and Inland Empire region. A great way to get closer to our King Jesus Christ and learn how to have a relationship with him. Life changing experience. Discover the love in God’s heart for you here :) It is a very welcoming church

name: Life Baptist Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: This church is home with one of the best pastoral teams and congregations we have ever been a part of.  If you are seeking a church home to worship with, come check us out! Sundays 9am and 1045 am services, child care available with amazing care givers! Thank you for streaming your services. Our local churches here in Dallas/Fort Worth are closed this Sunday due to the winter storm, so I Googled for a church service to stream, and I landed on yours. Great service. If I am ever in the Las Vegas area, I will be sure to visit. My husband and I were raised in different faiths.  To be completely honest, we were hesitant to attend a Baptist church in Las Vegas because we had preconceived notions of what the service would be like.  After finally letting our guard down and attending our first service (almost a year and a half ago) we knew that this was a church we could call home.  The pastors have brought my relationship with Christ deeper than I thought possible.  The sermons are inspiring and straight from the Bible.  When I leave Life on Sunday I feel restored and eager to let Christ live through me.  My four young children are excited to learn about Jesus as well.  The Kids Life staff does an excellent job of teaching my children.  They look forward to going to church on Sunday.  The staff also has an organized check in/out system in place so I feel my children are cared for and safe.  My family has made friendships within the church that I look forward to lasting a lifetime. An absolutely incredible church! Gospel-centered, biblical preaching, outstanding worship, and a staff that truly cares for their people! We love Life as our church home and the amazing community of believers here! Thank you!!! The first time I walked through the front doors of this church, I was welcomed with open arms and immediately brought into the community. The drive in this church to know Christ and make Him known has been so beautiful to witness and I am continuously blown away week after week when I see what the wonderful staff have to offer. I can confidently say that the people at this church are Christ focused individuals and will not hesitate to show their love for you. Whether it be through prayer, worship, the message, Kids' Life, coffee, or even the immaculate clean nature of the building in and of itself, this church is eager to share the Lord with those around them. For these reasons and many others, I will always happily recommend this church to anyone that may be in search of one. 😊💚

name: Life Bible Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome teaching, awesome worship, awesome kids ministry, awesome community. Pretty much just all around awesome. This is a great Church where you can find teaching that aligns directly with the Bible. Everyone is very friendly, welcoming, and hospitable. The worship team is great, focusing on leading you into worship in Spirit and in Truth.
This church is one centered around prayer, every Wednesday night we have a time of coming together and just praying. Miracles happen and prayers are answered, all to the glory of God!
Have loved his place from the first time I came. If you are seeking to grow more and have a genuine relationship with the Lord and good relationships with other people, this is the place for you! I came to know Life Bible through online watching of Pastor Joel's sermons and devotionals. Upon visiting the church I was welcomed with genuine open arms and care. I quickly met many new friends and felt the love of Jesus. I was highly impressed by the well organized ministries from children, teens, to young adults and prayer meetings. I love that they do communion service once a month. Pastor Joel and Angela are true shepherds of the Lord. Come and see. Life Bible Church is a great place for anyone who want to live for Christ. The preaching is doctrinally sound and delivered in a way that anyone can understand. The leadership are friendly and welcoming, they are the reason I will continue to attend Life Bible Church. Christ Centered —Bible based —God Fearing —the same Spirit that rose Jesus from the dead lives and dwells in us believing church!

What a privilege to be part of this body of believers.

This church prioritizes prayer!

Teens show up in droves for their bi-weekly gatherings.

The church facilitates groups and has an amazing team that works alongside parents to minister to the children.

Our family has matured spiritually and grown immensely since attending Life Bible Church!!

Come and see… it is a big family at LBC :)

name: Life Bible Fellowship Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
My mentor was apart of this church and told me to check it out and I was very impressed with the service. Spoke on 1 Peter 4:10-11 and really went into a detail sermon on how this impacts not just the local church but how we are called as Disciples to use gifts because God gave those to us. The church was very beautiful and the community was very welcoming and friendly. Even as a first time visitor I was very impressed with how many were baptized but why they were being baptized. The studying for each person and time. From young to old, husbands, wives baptizing spouses, there kids and friends. Incredible. Worship team was also great. Anyways I highly recommend to check it out ill definitely be going again hopefully soon. Have been going to this church for several years now.  Had a bit of healing to do, and this church allowed that process for me and my family.   I love the real Biblical teaching, without the fluff added in, and the pastors are excellent in presenting the Word in a clear and concise manner.
My children are both grown, so I don't have much to say about that area - other than it appears to be run very well, and with a slew of volunteers.  Lots of young families in the church, so they must be doing something right.
The church focuses on small groups as well, which is a good thing if you have the time to be in one, but so far we have not found a match for our lifestyle.  Sunday school offerings are good - my parents really enjoy their group.  Parking can be a challenge - but only if you go to the 9ish service.  I try to go to the earlier service and do not find parking to be an issue then. I was just visiting today, but had a very good experience. They open the mic on the last Sun of the year and it was kind of a pot luck of sermons from the congregation. They were awesome. Modern worship music. Our family was surrounded by this amazing church when my Daughter and Son in Law lost their Sweet Baby Ellie. I am speechless and can not truly express what this church family did for us. Pastor Mat was at the hospital with us the entire day along with other pastors from the Church. They hosted a 300 + person memorial service for Ellie. Our family was supported in many wonderful ways.
This church does have a large congregation however, it feels very intimate and personable.
I am looking forward to the Grief study group starting this month.
Thank you to this wonderful church, staff and congregation.
Tess We visited this wonderful church for our granddaughter's baby dedication.  The people are warm and friendly.  The sermon was interesting and had life applications. There are a variety of programs for all ages. It would be easy to find your place in this church.
