Our family was surrounded by this amazing church when my Daughter and Son in Law lost their Sweet Baby Ellie. I am speechless and can not truly express what this church family did for us. Pastor Mat was at the hospital with us the entire day along with other pastors from the Church. They hosted a 300 + person memorial service for Ellie. Our family was supported in many wonderful ways.
This church does have a large congregation however, it feels very intimate and personable.
I am looking forward to the Grief study group starting this month.
Thank you to this wonderful church, staff and congregation.
Tess We visited this wonderful church for our granddaughter's baby dedication.  The people are warm and friendly.  The sermon was interesting and had life applications. There are a variety of programs for all ages. It would be easy to find your place in this church.

name: Life Center Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
The Life Center Church Charlotte has been our home since relocating to CLT. It is without a doubt the BEST decision we made for our family.

My children grew up in the children and youth ministry and are now adults. Great Worship, Amazing leadership and people and DYNAMIC teaching and preaching.

There is NOTHING like The Life Center Experience…don’t take my word for it, come see for yourself. Since being in Charlotte this is still one of the most inviting churches I have been to. It’s a place to come worship, fellowship, network, & vent. They help people and they genuinely seem like they care about you and what you are going through. About 7 years ago I came in and sat down at the back and after church a brother walked up shook my hand and told me how great it was to see me and we conversed everyday and he introduced me to a young man name Jamal (great creator) great energy and we have been friends since then. Spoke to the pastor and his energy was great I felt like everyone I spoke with was like family. This is by far one of the most recommended places I can recommend ANYONE. A place like no other. Highly Recommended My name is Erica Sutton. I have 3 kids ages 7, 11, 12.. I was in abusive relationships among ago. I had to flee for my life with my kids. I move to one state he found me and I had to move to another state. The shelter where Im at havent help me with bus pass or with housing. I have to be myon advocate. I apply for a job and I try to get my kids back and forth to school I sign them up to an afterschool program. The staff here will walk in your room while u are sleep and turn on the light an yell staff staff. I ask for the supervisor email they refuse to give it to u. Then had compliant about a.lady above me her and her kids be running and moving funiture they lied and said no one was above me this what the staff said all them. Then they come back o yes there is. We cant tell them to stop making noise they can do it. Then there where cigarettes in the hall staircase. I dont care if they kick me out I just have to let yall know whats going on... Please pray for me and my kids and if u have any resources please help us cause they are not. Im not from here. Love this church so put together and love worship they bless me Come Get A Great Taste Of God's Glory Rhema Word Good For Your Soul an Spirit

name: Life Center Ministries - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary:
On one of my visits to The Peach, I told my son I wanted to attend a Friday prayer service. I thought it was going to be at the church he attends, The Hunger Church, but to my surprise it was a different church. Upon entering you are warmly greeted. Praise and Worship was taking place. You could truly feel the peace of God in the sanctuary, especially when Kia (I hope I spelled her name correctly)led. Afterwards we remained for prophetic prayer. My son directed me to Trinity and Summer. These two young ladies were very pleasant and guided me through releasing all unforgiveness. They each prayed for me as far as my future and gave me great encouragement. If you're having spiritual issues, this is definitely a place of deliverance. I enjoy the word of GOD and the way Apostle Don Wales Ministers, it is very powerful and informative to help you grow as a Son and Daughter of GOD.  I am really Loving this Ministry, the People and the Prophetic Flow here.  They allow the Spirit Of GOD to have His Way.  I also really enjoyed it when Micah Stampley Came to Minister, ( I included a short video of Him Ministering in Song) it was Such a Powerful and Prophetic Night, and it's Always like that here at LCM.😇😍 I love this church! I was going through a really rough time in my life, and I visited this church with a friend and they literally breathe hope and life back into me with the word the Lord gave! It’s definitely a true, anointed, life giving ministry! Since I’ve been attending this church, I have seen growth within my life, my family, other believers and leaders. No church is perfect but growth is essential for this Christian journey. The service is filled with GOD spirit, love, glory, wisdom, breakthrough and rhema word.  A place where they speak life and hope to your spirit man through the Holy Spirit.  If you need strength and insight on how to navigate the spiritual and physical realm, The life Center is the place to be!  Matthew 18:20  KJV For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them. I gave 4 stars because no church is perfect. I have been a Christian for years. . I came to be hungry for more and pray for deep Godly understanding, then I found this Five fold ministry.  Jesus says those who believe will cast out demons, prophesy, love one another, heal the sick, teach others,  make disciples, worship in Spirit and Truth.  In this LifeCenter Dunwoody GA ministry, the core leaders desire to see the Kingdom of our Almighty  Father , the one True God  Yahweh, His son the Christ, Jesus and the Holy Spirit power manifested on earth,  and they actually make efforts to disciple others. If you are an intercessor reading. Pray for God's agenda to make manisfest at LC.
May God's Goodness flows in this ministry like never before,  today May 2025 and forward. AMEN

name: Life Changers International Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary: I haven't visited this church in a few years. I originally attended when they were at Whitney Young HS. Those were the best times. The spirit of the Lord was always there. I was expecting some of the same old WYHS vibes, not so. I anticipated the Pastors arrival disappointed that he didn't show. A lot has changed, will not be visiting again. Respect and love the Pastor but in this season, I'm needing more. I have been a beneficiary of Life Changers Ministry for quite some time now. Little that I know of P.G.D is that I am kind of fascinated each time I I am facing a lot of troubles and trials he always will email me on something... like his messages be like a solution to that, how to go about it I believe that God is using him to change lives across the globe. I am from Nigeria. Love you all I attended this place once with my girlfriend. I was Catholic, she Protestant. Thank you Pastor Grace for, after we were engaged, advising her we were "unequally yoked," causing her to break our engagement. When she came back to me later that December, and we conceived our first child, you then also had to Christianity to fire her for being pregnant. Apparently her pregnancy would have brought shame to your loving church, and you children who you were entrusting to her to educate them exclusively in your home. Even back then what did you and Greg drive, I believe the S  Class Mercedes sedans? Thank you and God Bless You and all the people who helped hurt and damage my loved one. Definitely the best church in America. The people are warm and friendly and the pastor is funny and allows God to truly speak through him. There's coffee and tea in the lobby. The praise and word team is truly amazing. The church is supportive and understanding. They welcome people of all ages and they have an AMAZINGLY fun, friendly kids ministry who are encouraged to grow in their faith and have opportunities to serve and help others. Please excuse my last post.  The pastors at both locations share the love of God with passion preach the word in plain truth and teach the word right out of the Bible word for word the way God intended it to be taught.   I have listened to the pastors over the years young and old ( well pastor Greg & Grace )  are always young and Beautiful !  The preaching is always with love and the promise of God ....

name: Life Christian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
As a Marine I was stationed here in 1995.  I searched all throughout this area for a place of worship I could call home.  I grew up in a non-denominational Church and wanted to find something similar.  Immediately upon entering Life Christian (then called His Church Christian Fellowship) we knew God had directed our path to these Pastors.  My wife had several bad experiences with other Churches in her past however not only did we love the Pastors we also loved the REAL people we meet.
Now in 2012, we are still here. I know many people only stay with a church for a couple years however each year just gets better and better.  So, much so that I had decided to work for the church now that I am retired.
Being here for these 17 years has been wonderful and a place where I can grow in God.  I love the fact my Pastor cares enough about me to make sure I understand God's perfect will for my life.  When my son graduated to heaven at the age of 19 it was my Pastor who was there to help my family through this most difficult time.  In fact it was my Pastor who helped my son stay connected to God and make it to heaven.
I challenge all who read this to stop by a pay us a visit here at Life Christian Church.  I know you to will find what I am talking about is true and real. Life is a great church. I dont go as I should. But I do realize God has saved me and given me talent. The day I walked into His church in 1998 mylife changed. I changed it took some more waisted time. But God was with me and showed me the way. And I'm alive unlike many I've known. I'm free because of God no possible way I could have done it on my own.   Jason D. Williams Nice people, a lot of good programs for members of all ages, and modern music before the sermon.  That's all great, but speaking in tongues freaked me out and I won't be back.  If that's your thing then go for it, but you won't see me there.  I'm also not a fan of paying to receive blessings.  Tithing is important but shouldn't be pushed for the purpose and intent of being rewarded, healed, or otherwise personally benefitted. I visited Life Christian Church for the first time today and was very upset over the statement made by the pastor that falsely alleged that Obama took his oath of office for the U.S. Senate by swearing on a Koran. The facts are that Obama is a Christian and took the oath of office on a Bible.
It's disturbing that the pastor did not check his facts and that he spread falsehood from the pulpit.
It's really a shame they used the opportunity to teach from scripture to preach politics and untruth. Christian Church ha! Just another paster that believes that there is a rapture. One question if you had to go out like the disciples did back in the days of Christ and not get paid would you still be out there witnessing to people about Christ and no pastor it is not your money it is God's. Revalations states that there is a seal of protection around God's people in the end times they were not raptured up so why would we.quit trying to take words out of a written prophecy.

name: Life Christian Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary: I've made so many great people. The pastor is great as well. It's an overall great church. You must at least visit. Pastor Shane speaks boldly from the Bible and provides in-depth study for those who want to grow their faith in Jesus

name: Life Christian Fellowship Anaheim ( Filipino-American Church ) - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary: Love everything about this church especially the Filipino culture. People here are nice and friendly, so if you are looking for a Filipino Christ-centered church around Orange County, I highly recommend this one.

name: Life Church - Brookfield Campus
reviewSummary: If you really want to know about why you exist,  seek for yourself a relationship with Jesus Christ.  Learn of his love for you.  Find peace and salvation in Christ Jesus.  Fellowship with God and his family at Life Church.  It's a personal decision with eternal outcomes.  Free will is one gift that God gives to everyone.  What we do with that Free will determines our eternal destiny. Victory is an AWESOME church to be a part of! Pastor Rory and Karen really care about the people in the church. It feels like home. The worship is awesome! The kids ministry is fantastic for children and the youth have an great opportunity to be a part of youth group. Definitely recommend checking out this church. I'm excited to go to back because I really feel so connected. My wife and I used to be members at what was once Brookfield Assembly of God then became victory international and now life church and to say something nice about it would be a lie. There was a group of greeters who didn’t greet us or even say hi when we first walked in through the doors, There was no welcome from those who regularly attend there, there was no information about what they offer as a church like life groups or anything for that matter, the worship team was okay but the sound was loud and their lights were annoying to say the least, it felt like going to a show and like a  fast food service start at 10:30 over by 11:30 and it felt very cold from those who are regular attendees. We will not visit this church again. We are from Fond du Lac, Wi and my parents were members there for a very long time. What’s sad is we are part of a church where we live and my brother in law and his wife are looking for a home church which is what prompted us to visit. Excellent welcoming Church. No dress code. Newly renovated. Kids gaming area. Free coffee. Large gymnasium for kids rec league basketball. Pastor Dylan is great! Great church with plenty of ministries for everyone. A great place to meet up with friends and family to grow in our relationships with Jesus. I have been blessed to be a part of the youth, young adults, tech crew and many music ministries over the years.

name: Life Church - Concord Campus
reviewSummary:
I felt welcomed the moment I stepped foot on the Life Church campus in Concord! From the uplifting atmosphere in the coffee shop to the genuine kindness of everyone I encountered, it was clear this is a church that leads with love.

Pastor Tim Owen delivered an inspirational message that stirred my heart and left me feeling ready to go out and be a light bearer for Christ. Today’s service honored both dads and grads, complete with fun dad games that brought lots of smiles and connection. The worship was moving and heartfelt—such a beautiful time of praise. I haven't been in person in over a year & I sure do miss it! The pastors, teachers & congregation are so welcoming. You really feel like you are visiting family. I went here for summer camp in.. 2018 or 2019? The volunteers (staff?) were really rude. I made one little mistake and this blonde chick starts gossiping about it to her other friends. I never returned after that, and I never will. :( Nice place visit if you are into that sort thing. I love this church. They are all friendly and supportive. I always count down to go back to them. God bless you all.

name: Life Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been searching for a church in Fort Myers, asking the Lord to lead me to where He wanted me to plant myself and take root. He led me to Life Church, and I am truly grateful.
I look forward to attending every week. The teachings from Pastor Ryan are inspiring, biblical, and relevant. I genuinely feel that the Lord speaks through him to deliver His message to the body of Christ.
If you want to experience His presence and be fed by the Word of God, this is the church for you. The worship is excellent—genuine, heartfelt, and moving. The presence of the Holy Spirit is present. The sermons are enlightening and challenging, firmly rooted in Scripture while still being accessible to all believers. I occasionally invite friends that are new believers and they have understanding of the messages as well.
The sense of community is strong, and from the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and encouraged in my walk with Christ. I am thankful that God led me here. If you want to feel the presence of Holy Spirit, and be fed by the word of God, this is the church for you. The contemporary worship is excellent, genuine and moving.  The sermons are enlightening and challenging, Bible based yet accessible for new believers.  The sense of community is strong. Trying to pick up our children from the daycare service was nothing short of just terrible….the experience was extremely disappointing. No one was willing to work with me or offer a solution, and no one apologized for the inconvenience. Instead, the security team was rude and dismissive, which made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

This was especially upsetting because just last week my husband accidentally lost our tag, and the experience was completely different. The staff was kind, patient, and helpful. They explained the policy clearly and worked with us to ensure our children were safely returned without any hostility or embarrassment.

Today, however, I was stopped in the entrance hallway even though my husband had walked in just two minutes before me (with our tag). I was only trying to meet him so we could pick up our children together. I have picked up my kids many times in the past without being stopped until reaching the classroom door, so this inconsistency was confusing and frustrating. I will also add I watched several people walk in without a tag (my mom included) so I’m not sure why they had this issue with me.

Instead of being offered a solution, I was followed out of the church by a staff member who continued to speak to me rudely. Not being understanding of my feelings at all and just kept trying to prove her point. It truly saddens me that we were treated this way, especially because we have loved attending services here. Until today, this church had felt welcoming and supportive. We were believing God to find a church in this area and He led us to Life Church. We were so impressed with everything there from the time we turned into the parking lot. Praise and Worship was outstanding and the preaching was wonderful as well. It was so refreshing to hear preaching that led to eight people to joining the family of God. We thank God for leading us to this church we can't wait to roll up our sleeves and join the Laborers bringing in the harvest.
Now we are believing God to find a home in this area, it is too far of a drive from Chicago. We loved everything there keep doing it saints! The worship service can be powerful for a protestant denomination church. The pastor seems to know his church history and bible and best of all, the congregation is amazing. I love coming here to hear the word of God and interact with magnificent people. What a blessing to have this church so close to home even though I am not a protestant. It is still very powerful to see how it moves the congregation and how the community can be involved with such a great mission. They seem to do a lot with the community and mission of the Lord. I hope they can remain active in the community and be a change for the better. The seats ate comfortable and the parking is plenty. The interior is pretty bland but what is lacking in decor is made up for in character. I love how the sermon is applicable to every day life and can be used as a tool for bettering you and everybody around you. I hope to attend this church again in the future.

name: Life Church - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you for hearing my concerns and then fixing it! Because of that I believe 5 stars is earned.
Looking forward to the new and improved sign. Life Church is a family church that preaches the gospel and shows the love of God to everyone. I love attending Life church. Blessed to be here and share the blessings in the spirit as well to find new friends. Thank you for the opportunity to share about our life and ministry! Church body is so kind, caring. It is a living church. Wonderful pastor Ive been attending this church for 2 months now. My family and I felt God’s love from the moment we walked in. Everyone is very kind and welcoming. If you’re looking for a place to listen to a powerful and uplifting message from God, and experience the presence of the Holy Spirit during worship, than this is the church to go to. We are so glad and feel so blessed to have found this church.

name: Life Church - League City Campus
reviewSummary: First time coming to this church on 12/28/2025 and no one said hello or good morning. There was a woman with long brownish blonde hair wearing a burgundy top by the front doors never said anything. Next to her was another woman with long dark hair wearing a green shirt that said leader and no greeting or acknowledgement. If they are both standing in front of the door with pamphlets you could at least say good morning. The members need to do better and maybe the new church being constructed across the road will be a friendlier church. I'll look for another church to attend. Can't wait to visit one Sunday, thank you for all you do on campuses, so much sacrifices in teaching, sharing the word of God and sharing basic needs,/items to all students. True followers is Christ The best part of Houston is Life Church. I first attended services here in 2010 and have grown tremendously in my faith since.  I love the pastoral team and all the staff as well as the Life Family. I moved in 2022 and still drive back almost every week for a year to attend church here. The first time I went to this church, I felt like the pastor was talking directly to me. The people are warm and kind, and they want to help you along your path with Jesus. Amazing experiences. The moment I visited Life Church over 15 years I felt the presence of God like never before. Since then, I have grown in my walk with Jesus and have the blessing of wonderful close friends and life long sisters and brothers in Christ.

name: Life Church - Mobile Campus - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary:
The most loving and spirit filled Church you will ever visit. Pastor Scott and his lovely wife are just amazing loving people! The music alone is a worship experience! Come as you are not fancy dress clothes required! You will experience God in a beautiful way! Friendly folks, standing room only probably because of Easter, church singers were impressive; projectors, lighting, sound, instruments, etc., all very up to date, really good sermon. I was invited to attend with some kind & very dear friends; glad that I joined them. Actually look forward for another visit. Not one church in Mobile is willing to worship God in song, like this church...ya know, standing...and worshiping, allowing God's Holy Spirit to lead....amazing musical leadership. Honest, fully surrendered musical team. Expected results follow very often. Really nice sanctuary for their Christmas concert, which was quite lovely. Enjoyed myself very much. Although I must say, they kids stand to instruct the kids to observe a bit more decorum in the lobby so that the public does not feel they are walking into a crazy n loud free-for-all. I experienced a friendly, warm, and caring Invironment. I also love the praise and worship, IT WAS TOTALLY AWESOME!!!!.
I Will DEFINITELY COME BACK AGAIN.
I Believe to make it my home church to praise and worship.

name: Life Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Have been going to this church for a very long time and have been a humbly blessed by the family like atmosphere, growth, maturity, and correction. Applying the biblical principles and great teaching! We drive 45 minutes to get to go to this church! My husband and I church hopped in our area, but did not find a life changing church. My husband knew the Pastors and suggested we go, when I finally agreed.....I was all in. The passion, the rousing of the Holy Spirit, the worship team, the power of the word being brought to life! It's an amazing experience...you walk out knowing the word and Jesus at a different level! I love this church!!!! It IS life changing!!!!! Best Pastor and group ever. Was my church in NC, through three locations. I'm in SWFL now but if I get back there, it will be my church again. Thanks for everything, Pastor Jesse. God Bless you all. Love this church and the pastors. If you're looking a church that makes you feel at home this is place. Pastor Jesse is awesome with his messages from the Bible. This is an upbeat church with contemporary music. Love the Pastor and his wife. They come to Pa to preach at our church.This congregation is really blessed to have them!!@

name: Life Church | Foursquare Church - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

**A Church That Restores Your Faith — Literally**

I began attending Life Church in December and was baptized just last month — and honestly, that journey says everything about what this place means to me. As someone who had nearly lost all faith in organized religion due to painful experiences in the past, finding a community like this feels nothing short of miraculous.

Pastor Jeff and Chris are the real deal — soulful, authentic, and genuinely gifted spiritual leaders. From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt supported and truly *seen*. Under their guidance, my relationship with God has grown in ways I didn't expect, and so has my love for myself and others. That kind of transformation doesn't happen just anywhere.

The atmosphere here is vibrant and welcoming. Live worship bands bring incredible energy to the services, and with three service times plus a live stream option, it's easy for anyone to find their fit. Whether you're a lifelong believer or someone coming in with doubts and wounds, there is a place for you here.

Life Church fills a void I didn't think could be filled. I'm now eager to serve, study the Gospel, and spread the love of Jesus throughout this community. If you're searching — look no further. 🙏 People are friendly and welcoming. I tried the church virtual before attending in person. The last two services have been nice. Lots of musical talent both in the adult and youth groups. Seems to be a family oriented place. I would recommend for young families especially. Friendly, likeable crowd, good service pastor Jeff a little long in the tooth but enthusiastic, great lateral movement. Great church, great people. Been to 15 churches in town so far and this in the top 3 if not top 1!! Very friendly, kinda felt like a Presbyterian Church got a little holy spirit. Seems like there big on community and life together which is normal for most Churches.

name: Life Church Assemblies of God
reviewSummary: It's not just a church but a community and a family. It's not just about service on Sunday. There are Bible Studies, Men's groups, Women's groups, Teen groups and other events with the church family. If you feel lost in the walk with the Lord, give Life Church a try. Their message is Lost --> Found --> Whole. We moved back to NH after being out of state for 3 years . We loved our church down in FL . When we came to this church it immediately felt like home . We did praying and research prior to coming to Life Church and felt led here . Thank you pastor Joe and Abi for providing this house of worship. Went to this church for a couple years till we relocated to another state. Pastor Joe and Abi are very honest down to earth godly people. Truly care about others 💖🙏 .The community, the ministry, and the presence of Christ is there! Absolutely spirit led church! Abi and Joe are centered with Christ and it’s very evident . The joy and love of Christ is apart of this church and we are happy to be welcomed here . 🙏 Connecting with Jesus and people! That’s what’s it’s all about! And Life! Church does it very well! Pastors Joe and Abi love Jesus and people! Atmosphere is welcoming, engaging and of course fun! Would recommend to anyone looking for a healthy church family! This church is for ALL generations, from the kids to the youth to the adults, you will find that everyone is welcomed and loved!

name: Life Church Assemblies of God - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I went here and a pastor never even greeted us he acted like he was not there the people over there acted like we were not there. He did preach good but as a first time guest I felt very unwelcomed Amazing services. If you're looking for a Bible believing/teaching/preaching church that doesn't cut corners... this is the place to be. Wonderful children's ministry and a life changing worship service. Very welcoming and loving church. A wonderful welcoming spirit of the LORD in that place and people THANK YOU SO NEEDED I enjoy the experience every time I go.  They make you feel so welcome This is my home church, and it's a great environment, full of great people and full of Jesus!

name: Life Church Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: We have been attending church here for several years now and absolutely love it! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming, the worship is great, and we appreciate the Bible-based teaching. Life Church has been our favorite part about moving to Charlotte! We immediately felt welcomed and seen when visiting this church, and we’re able to connect to other members and a Life Group easily. Life Church is Christ-centered and whole-heartedly passionate about the Gospel and the people in this city. We always learn from Pastor Ben’s teaching and appreciate how it is accessible and straight from scripture. We really enjoyed this service and the greeter, Andrew, was so friendly and helpful. The music was absolutely beautiful and the sermon was an excellent verse-by-verse study of the first chapter of Romans. Super organized and interesting! They also have childcare for children up to age 7. We hope to come back again! Great music, friendly welcoming party outside. The preacher seemed irritated asking "why are you here!?" Not exactly welcoming. We tried hard to connect and make eye contact, with the pastor and congregation but perhaps we weren't the target audience (largely 20's). So, that's why we're not there. I really love this church and community! People are intentional with getting to know you and leading you closer to Christ. I also love that they do communion every week for believers.

name: Life Church Eagle Creek Campus - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Great little church on the Northwest side of Indianapolis. They have a great youth and children’s program. The pastor is a great guy. His wife is also very kind and involved with the congregation. All in all, a great place to worship. LOVE this church and the warmth and friendliness I get every single time I come. If you are looking for a church where the word of God and the name of Jesus are preached boldly, this is it. Many of the churches that I've attended over the years are more akin to social clubs than a sanctuary for the lost and hurting. The people of Eagle Creek AG are more like the family I always wished I had. None are given to gossip and the detrimental judgements of others that plagues so many churches. Worship is awesome, followed by a preaching of the word that is always on time and helpful to today's Christian walk. They have a very nice food pantery,or bank,and Sunday service is wonderful too, and the people are very nice and friendly. Nice place to meet friendly people and freely worship God.

name: Life Church Fishers - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church. Pastor Derrick was very welcoming. My sister spoke for mothers day, thoroughly enjoyed it and meeting everyone there. Such a wonderful spirit-filled church! This is the best church I have ever been to.  It is not large; however, their Noblesville Campus is pretty spacious.  I love how the church talks about how they would rather pour their resources into people instead of buildings.  They are multi-cultural, all about mentoring the next generation, and teach the Bible verse by verse.  If you are a looking for a church that will feed you, this place offers a steak dinner every week! Life Church is a dynamic, diverse, inclusive body of believers.  Small groups abound for every age group and demographic--couples, teens, children, men, women, young moms, seniors, young adults, praise team, and more.  Opportunities abound for active involvement, ongoing personal growth, and making meaningful connections.  I have a great deal of respect for the leadership of this ministry and the heart of the church to father and mother sons and daughters into the kingdom.  I have personally seen the impact this ministry has had on my family and thank God for placing us there. Pastor Nathan brought a great message today.  Can't say enough about how awesome it is to attend a church where the Word is explained so well every week!  Love my church!!!😎 Great pastor and the congregation goes out of their way to make you feel welcome.  I highly recommend.

name: Life Church GO
reviewSummary: The best model and example of a loving  family, and to the degree of allowing all types, even the less fortunate to join in and take part becomming characters of this Christ centered congregation like members of an extension of this vessel. It’s a great Christian church Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Life Church Huntsville - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello: Pastor Massey, I want to  let you to know that I really enjoyed the services and I felt the spirit of the Lord moving within during service. I know that the lord was moving, because you're a message moved me to tears; "These were not Tears of Sadness". "They were Tears of Joy" and "I truly thank you for making me feel welcomed and we'll received. And it is my intention to participate in many more services is near the future!.
Im seeking Gods healing become and I'm becoming strong enough in my Faith and spirit to begin to repay it forward to others, as you have done for me. Please lift me and my family up in prayer and ask as God to secure our place in His Kingdom-Forever More. And while you're praying, I will also be praying as well and I know that God will be in the midst of our prayers, and whatever we ask of him, it shall be done on Earth and in Heaven.  Thank you so much for the Kindness that the Church Showed to me and "and how kind Your Wonderful Staff was towards me when they approached me. I Clearly witnessed the Spirit of Love on "Bright Display" throughout the whole Congregation.
And by witnessing these situations and actions, My faith was almost  instantaneously increased and when I saw kindness everywhere that I looked. I truly felt confident that I was in the right place on that day and that the peace of the  Living God was all around me and I truly felt blessed to be there so you to continue reaching out to others and making them feel like you made me feel. Be blessed and prosper and I return back to your Church to get some more strength from your services very soon. And thank you once again.

Kinnedy B Amazing church! Full of life, hospitality and SOLID WORD TEACHING! Wonderful anointed worship and full preaching and operation of the Gospel of Jesus! You will get spiritually fed here and make good friends from all over the Huntsville area and the world! Would not allow my autistic son to attend church anymore after having been going there for years with my child even appearing in pictures posted one year for Easter. They have a special needs room for kids but apparently our child was horrible. Singled out and kicked out  at 10 yrs old. They gave us chick fila cards and told us they would call us if my son could attend then never called us. Changed my perspective on church altogether. One of the most hurtful experiences I have experienced in my journey raising a child with autism. I do not think I will ever get over the hurt. I see now I am not the only person whom has been treated this way with a disabled child by this church. There’s probably more than just the other man on here I saw that left a review as well. My heart goes out to the children and their families that have been treated this way by this church. It truly does change your perspective on religion altogether and I was raised my entire life attending church. I came from Liberty church in Pensacola Florida four years ago. Having been raised up going to church with brother Buford and Josh Lipscomb as our pastors in Pensacola Florida I was looking for another church to call home and thought I had found it. I always thought church was a place to get away from horrible things in the world not to find horrible things in the world. I have been watching Life Church online for about 3 months awaiting a move from Florida to Alabama. There are many choices of churches in the area I had written down. When I heard the Worship team lead by David and the messages by Pastor Victor I new I had found something special. I moved in on Feb 26th and attended that first Sunday. Walking in and being welcomed is always expected but the Worship and message made me feel at home. I didn't have a need for God, Jesus or the Bible for 55 years. Come and be filled with the Gospel and find a new loving family. For those hurting, in addiction or just needing a friend, Come experience a special peace, healing and hope for the future. I’m new and I have attended 2 Sundays in a row, and it feels like I have been there for a while. The people are so welcoming, the pastors and kind and warm. Come and try it and trust me you, you’ll want to keep coming back.

name: Life Church McDonough - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary: Me and my family have been going to Life Church McDonough to worship the King of Kings for over a year. I’ve got 2 little girls and they’ve learned a lot about the Bible and their only 5 and 7 years old. I love the diversity of the congregation of age and ethnicity. I feel very loved and challenged to grow closer to Jesus. Sunday mornings are great and Wednesday nights are sneaky good! You really get to know people in the community on Wednesday nights and share in the breakthroughs people are having by hearing testimonies. Hope you can come out sometime and experience the presence of God and what’s going on over there! Much Love! My fiance and I have been attending this church with some extended since April of this year and we have been so blessed with a church that cares. These are the sweetest people who truly love the Lord with their mind, soul, body, and heart. Watching how they are expanding and growing to impact the community has been a wonderful experience. Thank you Pastor Jonathan and Jubilee for investing in us as individuals, as a couple, and working diligently to invest in this community. I can’t believe it’s going on a year that I’ve been going to life church and shortly after making it my home church.. My first day visiting I loved every moment and the love grows deeper and deeper with every service and fellowship. The youth pastors are amazing, and my kids love it there. Thank you life church for welcoming my family and myself with warm and embracing arms filled with love. We are forever grateful !! Life Church has been a blessing to me and my family since I joined almost six years ago. Their true love for God and our church families shined  when our son was diagnosed with cancer in January and passed in June. The whole church gathered around us with prayers , fellowship and showed the true meaning of a Godly and Christ filled church. Life Church is Phenomenal with great Leaders. We have a great Pastor, that pours out the Word of God in Us, Weeks after Weeks. Our Church is full of Love and if you’re looking for a place of Worship, Life Church Welcomes You with a open heart. ❤️

name: Life Church Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful place to worship and feel God’s presence. You become part of the family of Life Church as soon as you walk in the building. Bishop Bob King brings the word in a powerful way and very up lifting way. If you don’t have a home church or needing a change join us on Sunday mornings at 10:45 am. You won’t be sorry. Thank you very much for letting me be part of your outside service. I enjoyed it very very much. You guys should be proud to have a great singer like Corey Layne in your midst. ❤️ Hello good morning everyone. I just wanted to start off by saying I recently started to go to Life Church Nashville is an amazing great wait to worship God the people at Life Church Nashville are amazing nice and friendly and helpful the singing is wonderful the preacher at Life Church Nashville is amazing awesome preaching about the words of God and they do provide transportation if you need it so if you are looking for a new church to go to come to life church Nashville they will welcome you here with open arms and love i encourage you to come to life church Nashville God bless life church Nashville life journey 🙏✝️💜🪽🕊️ Don't answer the phone or call you back when they're open. You will not find a better church than Life Church. The people here are real, authentic, and love others with no strings attached. There’s something for everyone at Life, from the youngest to the oldest, you’ll find a class that will meet your needs. You will not regret coming to Life Church.

name: Life Church New Braunfels - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary:
Cannot recommend Life Church NB enough! We finally found the church we’ve been looking for, where we feel like we belong.  The staff, pastor, congregation are all so welcoming and friendly.  Pastor Randy always delivers a great message.   I thank God for leading us to this church.  ❤️ I’m so grateful to have found this church and this wonderful community. They welcomed us from the very first second. Feels like coming home! Randy is the absolute best! I love how he teaches the word and I love his humor. His wife is a wonderful person as well - she is so welcoming. Thanks for being family! Nice Church very rustic it's not for me I don't like a lot of attention and we bring kids to church and we have to wait in a line to get seated and I didn't feel the spirit there so I'm kind of a claustrophobic person maybe that's what caused it for me but I need to have space and feel comfortable in my own skin and I just didn't there.
This was for another church I went to I don't recognize this church so I am sorry for this review. We are really loving this church in NB! The first Sunday we arrived, we were greeted by many. So welcoming and kind. The children ministry is great as well! My kids tell me what they have learned with smiles and rehearsing verses while driving back home. The pastor is great and hilarious! He preaches from the Bible and speak nothing, but the truth. You may literally come as you are and not feel judge at all. The worship team is great, too! We love this church so much that we would travel 35 minutes just to be there and be blessed. Come as you are and be blessed. What a wonderful friendly group of people. The Praise and Worship was moving and the message was spot on.

My wife and I will be calling this place our new Church Home.

name: Life Church Noblesville - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been attending since August of 2020!  God has blessed us so much with not just a church but a family!? It doesn’t matter how you look or where you have been we love everyone as God does! Review of Life Church: I have been attending Life Church since 2020, this is when most churches shut their doors on their members and thought it would be a good idea to just do church virtually. I can confidently say it has transformed my spiritual journey in profound ways. This church embodies what it means to be a biblically sound community, and every service is a testament to the truth and love found in Scripture.

The expository teachings are nothing short of exceptional. Each sermon is carefully crafted, diving deep into the Word and bringing forth insights that challenge and inspire. The pastoral staff, led by Pastor Nathan & Pastor Micah, they truly have a gift for communicating God’s truth with clarity and passion. Their commitment to teaching the Bible in context ensures that we not only hear the Word but understand its application in our daily lives.

There’s a boldness in proclaiming the truth that resonates deeply with the congregation. It's evident that the leadership is filled with the Holy Spirit and genuinely loves The Father, which creates an environment where faith can flourish.

In a world that often feels chaotic and uncertain, Life Church stands as a beacon of hope and truth. If you’re looking for a place that prioritizes God’s Word, fosters a vibrant community, and encourages a deeper relationship with Christ, I wholeheartedly recommend LC. It has been a blessing to be part of such a vibrant and faithful community, and I look forward to what God has in store for us in the future! Our Family has been so blessed by Life Church Noblesville. From the pastors teaching of biblical truths, to the friendly people attending, powerful worship and the amazing children’s ministry. Everyone in our family looks forward to Sunday mornings and attending church. Gods Goodness is abundantly shown at LC Noblesville. Definitely come see for yourself. I’m so thankful we did! I recently visited Life Church (Noblesville) and was truly touched by the warm and welcoming atmosphere. From the moment I stepped in, I felt a genuine sense of community and belonging. The worship was uplifting and the message was inspiring. The church staff was attentive, taking time to connect with everyone. It's clear this is a place of strong faith, conviction, love, and fellowship. I look forward to returning and becoming more involved. Life Church has expository teaching of God's Word verse by verse.  The worship is powerful and the presence of the Holy Spirit is within the churches in IN. to touch, restore and grow your walk with Jesus.
The are many Life Groups to grow and find fellowship. Each campus has their own Pastor, not a video. There are 4 locations, but one Church.  Fishers, Noblesville, Pendleton and Eagle Creek.  Join us!  You will be blessed!

name: Life Church of Jackson - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary: A very welcoming atmosphere if you're looking for a Praise & Worship Church. I love to worship at the flowood location pastor Givins is a great man of God

name: Life Church of Longview - Longview Campus
reviewSummary: Thank You Lord Jesus Christ for this godly, loving, faithful church that truly teaches the True Word of the Living God. I have only worshipped here about 4 times and the Word of God, the Love of God, gets better and better.  This church right now is small in size, oh but is so large in teaching the Word of God and demonstrating the Love of God. Jesus said that the world would know His disciples (true followers) by the love that they show to one another. I want to commend the pastor for being a shepherd after God's heart by his love for God, God's Word, and God's church, and lost people.  I love the way this brother also Praise and Worship our Lord Jesus Christ, and truly get down on the keyboard.  God's children are represented here in all races, but more importantly,  I have only experienced the genuine Love of God. YOU GO LIFE CHURCH.  You are truly a blessing to Longview and the rest of the world. Awesome Church! love being apart of the services Love our church miss going with this weather n work. The best people and the best teaching and preaching This church is where we go when we come to town. It was our home church when we lived there. A loving congregation worships in a visually appealing church. The music and the message were amazing.

name: Life Church of Orange CA - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I believe that this church has lost it's way. For awhile they were really involved and caring about their community. Now it is typical of so many evangelical churches that have lost their way and followed after partisan ideologies rather than true Christian principles. They need to get back to their true roots and what they once were. Christ, Bible, and community centered church. Excellent Spirit-filled worship. Outstanding in every way

name: Life Church Peoria - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: Feels like home.  I have been looking for a church for a while, and my friends Mary Kaye and Larry asked me to come to this church. I was so impressed with the genuine love, friendly and welcoming nature that everyone has.  The worship was filled with great music and put me on the presence of the Lord,  the sermon was delivered by Derrick, the lead pastor, although I understand the teaching is rotated by the pastoral team and is exceptionally good.  I'll be back on Sunday and am pretty sure I've found my church home. We're going to miss you Paster Derek. I loved the service and worship. I'll be back! While visiting my parents I attended this fellowship again and once again left thanking God for leading my folks to make their church home with such wonderful people. I was inspired by Paster Derick's courageous and sincere preaching and comforted by the singing and friendly greetings from the members. A contemporary church where I sense people care and where the gospel is not left out. This place is family!  Always get a warm embrace, genuine smiles, and a truly Biblical-based sermon.  If you are looking for a place to call home please come and join us!  The people here are so nonjudgmental which I feel is rare in churches these days!

name: Life Church Queen Creek - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
What a tremendous church! First visited Life Church a while ago and was NOT disappointed - a warm friendly welcome, vibrant worship, powerful Word and a wonderful move of the Spirit.

If you’re in the Queen Creek or San Tan area and you’re looking for a great church - this is the spot to check out! We found LifeChurch a few years ago, and at a time when we needed physical, emotional, and spiritual healing in our lives. Through the truth based sermons, prayer, worship, and the people of QC LifeChurch,  we re-dedicated our lives back to God.  We love being part of something that will change those who come in or even the city the church is in. I am so happy there is now a campus in Queen Creek. Everyone is so nice, the music and worship are great and my kids love being a part and being included in the services. It is definitely a place to set roots and grow. You won't be sorry. LifeChurch Queen Creek is so inviting and welcomes everyone with love! My wife and I attend here and we both enjoy and appreciate the amazing ministry of the Jablonsky’s. God is doing great things at this church and we hope others can call LifeChurch Queen Creek “home” like we do! Thank you Pastor David and Sis Stephanie for answering the call God gave you years ago! Excellent Bible-based teaching and worship. I had been searching on Google for this church. Pastor David gave my husband an invitation to visit and I’m so glad that he did. I have been at Queen Creek life church several times and enjoyed every time I go. I would recommend it to anybody looking for a home church or at least check it out to visit.

name: Life Church Roseville - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church! The people are warm and welcoming, the children’s and student ministries are excellent. The worship is top quality as well. The pastor always brings a good message and has a sense of humor! Everyone is welcoming and friendly! Church family here truly cares about everyone that walks in the door. Pastor James’ messages are relatable and down to earth, and have inspired me to further develope and grow my relationship with the Lord! The music is awsome and my kids love to come every week. Also great coffee, muffins, and cookies!!! I've been to many churches all through out my life. This Church is the real deal and they love the word of God. Covid and the 2 hr round trip to the Church has slowed down our visits this year but we will be rearanging  a few things so we can come one or twice a month.

Miss you guys God bless.

Michael & Nikki I took my kids to their VBS week and the woman checking in names was extremely rude to us.  We were already told by the first lady to proceed inside to find the children’s groups after picking up their t-shirts.  Then the second woman (right next to first lady) starts screaming at us, “STOP!  YOU CAN’T GO TOO FAST!!  I HAVE TO CHECK EVERYBODY IN!!!  WHAT’S YOUR NAME?!”  It wasn’t like my kids and I were running in without giving them our names.  The other lady already told us to go ahead and go inside.  At first I thought the screaming was just done jauntily, but no.  She was angry at us through no fault of our own.  I did not feel very welcome.  No apology, nothing.  There were people in line after us so it was embarrassing to be yelled at for simply doing something we were told to do.  I saw her being nice to everybody else after us.  And we got there early so it wasn’t like everybody was scrambling to get in all at once so she got frustrated.  I’m very disappointed with the level of unfriendliness displayed towards us.  This was the second time I took my kids to their VBS but I’ll have to reconsider, considering they don’t care about making people feel welcome at their church. I can't say enough about this church and the people who serve and attend here. Nobody's  church is perfect but this one is perfect for me. We pick each other up and hold each other's hands when we need someone.  I love the family we've become as the love of Christ is here.

name: Life Church San Diego - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Unfortunately I was here only a few minutes but it was enough to cause hearing damage the music was so loud and uncomfortable. It looks nice and the people are nice but it's like not very well thought out. Our church is having phenomenal miracles!!! Best church in San Diego CA. I love it so much it's a big help to be there. it's having amazing things in it. People are very friendly and it's a very welcoming station. Try this Everyone!! You're going to love it and it will make your life better. This is a spirit filled God moving Church. It's full of the presence of God. Alot of joy and dancing and praising. Here everyone loves the Lord. Pastor is always on fire for the Lord First time there today Something felt off as soon as I arrived with my wife and daughter, as we were walking to the door I noticed a man outside sitting on a bench he looked uncomfortable like he didn’t want to be inside, as we walked in the door we did not feel welcomed, there was 2 women in the front and we greeted them but they seemed uninterested in greeting us, we went inside to everyone worshipping, once it was done, the pastor read a 1 verse about honoring the elders, they had a family up on the stage, like they were put on a pedestal which I assumed was a pastor and his family, the whole time they were praising them and exalting them, it was more about them than about God, this was very uncomfortable to watch because The word of God calls us to be humble and that we shouldn’t make it about us but about Jesus even pastors aren’t above Christ,  christ is the one that should be praised and exalted, not the pastors, and I believe they dedicated this service to do just that, as they were taking all the praise and glory for themselves my spirit could not take it anymore I told my wife let’s go this isn’t right as I said that I noticed the man that I saw outside get up and walk outside he too didn’t feel comfortable with what was happening, my family and I got up and left because I had seen enough, as we were walking out I heard the pastor say this is my church! Again instead of saying this is Gods church he is putting himself before God. I will not attend this ungodly church and I don’t recommend anyone going there, they seem money hungry I hope this review helps you find a real church that puts Jesus above themselves and where humbleness is found My Husband Billy and I were there today at the Sunday service,for the very first time,and we immediately felt welcome by the church staff,and also immediately felt the holy spirit as soon as we walked into the church! It felt like a family immediately❤And the senior Pastor Nik, is on 🔥 Fire for JESUS❤We definitely will be coming back❤😇🙏

name: Life Church Smyrna Assembly of God - Smyrna / Vinings Campus
reviewSummary:
Dr. Pastor Osbon and his wife, Missy, are approachable and genuine individuals who demonstrate profound compassion and a remarkable understanding of human nature.

We attend church primarily for his enlightening sermons. He serves as an exceptional mentor and educator with humor.

The Smyrna Assembly of God is an inclusive and welcoming community that fosters a sense of belonging and peace.

As private individuals, after my father’s passing, Dr. Pastor Osbon responded with empathy and sincere care, offering unwavering support during a difficult time. He embodies the qualities of a genuine and caring individual.

We wholeheartedly encourage anyone to join us at church, regardless of their background or circumstances. Through Dr. Pastor Osbon, individuals will find a place of acceptance and spiritual guidance.

When you visit, you will always feel at home. What can I say about my experience at Life Church?
RELATIONSHIP AND COVENANT!

The moment you walk into this amazing place of worship, you become part of family of believers that desire all to have an authentic experience in Christ.
Pastor Shell is such a great preacher and teacher. You won’t be disappointed!
I personally encourage anyone who is looking for a place to fellowship, and call home- Life Church is the place you wanna be. I have been attending Life Church for almost 2 years. The main reason I joined was the members were extremely friendly and the pastor did a very good job teaching the word of God. Adult Sunday school is awesome, church leaders are awesome, music ministry awesome, men's fellowship awesome, outreach ministry extra awesome. My wife said women's ministry is awesome led by the pastor's wife. And the most important fact is Jesus Christ gets all the praise!! I am beyond excited for this new beginning at Life Church Smyrna! From the moment you walk through the doors, it’s clear that the Spirit of the Lord flows freely here. This is a church that truly cares about the community, and it shows through the many ways they consistently step up to serve.
The Bible tells us in Proverbs that to have friends, one must first show themselves friendly—and this congregation embodies that spirit perfectly.
Pastor Osbon, his wife, and the entire team are incredibly enthusiastic and encouraging, making you feel right at home from day one.
If you’re looking for a place to grow in Jesus and build relationships. I recommend Life Church. Check out the website for service times and more information! #LifeChurchSmyrna. Come grow with us. I have been a member of Life Church Smyrna since November 2013 and it's more than a church to attend for Sunday Service. You are never just a face you are family and I have leaned on many and crated life memories here and always felt Gods love when we gather. I especially look forward to our monthly Ladies of Life Sisterhood 3rd Wednesday Theme Parties. Always amazing Food, Family, and Fun for all ages 6weeks old and up. The Paint Parties with my Sisters the past 2 years have definitely been anticipated and enjoyed.

name: Life City Church - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary:
Greeters were friendly, but happened to be the only people to acknowledge our presence in the church. Enjoyed the music and the head pastor's messages. Gave the church a real shot and attended 3 weeks. The church claims to be non-denominational, but is very Pentecostal. An associate pastor got on stage, spoke in tongues for an extensive period of time and asked everyone to do the same, while at the same time references scriptures in the website about parameters of gifts of the Holy Spirit that contradict this practice. If you're looking for a Pentecostal church, that has a passionate staff and extended services that drag on like you entered a revival, this church might be for you. I just wanted to leave a review so others can get a better idea of what you're walking into. I know the atmosphere is something that some people aren't looking for. It's definitely not like any non-denominational church I've ever visited! Every church isn't everyone's cup of tea. This one's not for me and did a middle of the road review (3 stars) for that reason. Also, due the fact it's seemingly described inaccurate on the website. This could be a great church for you. :) If you're looking for a new church home, I don't think that you could do much better than Life City Church outside of Pickerington, Ohio. The door greeters immediately make you feel welcome. The congregation is made up of a large range of ages and they are also eager to shake your hand to make you feel welcome. Praise & worship is upbeat and heartfelt, making it easy to enter enter into the throne of God. Pastor Matt does most of the preaching / teaching. He does more teaching than preaching, which I appreciate. His lessons are easy to follow and full of scripture but expect to go down the occasional rabbit hole. I usually don't leave reviews but this church has changed my life, my children and grandchildren's future.
This church accepts anybody and everybody and will love on you like you're family! I've never seen a church not have clicks. Every church I've ever went to there's always been groups or clicks of people and this church, when you walk in, everybody is loving on everybody and that's a fact.
Pastor Matt Rice is incredibly anointed and when he teaches I always feel like he is talking to me. He is a bible-based teacher who preaches directly out of the word. His wife Pastor Bryn is also incredibly anointed! The worship team is anointed. THE BEST worship team ever!! Im not kidding. This place is on fire for God and Revival is breaking out. Seeing people be healed, miracles... Miraculous miracles. I am excited even typing this out because I love this church so much!!! We're waiting on you...so come see us!!! ❤️ I love this church & taking the next steps to become a member.  I have been praying for years to find a church closer to me that is Spirit filled and not afraid to preach the truth. Pastor Matt is not afraid to preach the truth.  Since COVID-19 I have been attending via electronically and have found the services/messages just as powerful as if I was attending in person.  I have felt the Lord’s presence and mighty move of God in my life since I started attending.  What a beautiful, loving church.  You will not be disappointed if you are truly seeking God and a body of people who love the Lord.  You will find them friendly and loving. I highly recommend Life City Church and have told as many as I can about them.  Due to COVID I haven’t had as much contact with those I know but plan to spread the news as much as possible. My family has been apart of Life City for nearly 6 years. We knew right away this church was our home. Pastor Matt and Bryn Rice are true examples of Gods love and such great leaders to have in our lives. Life City is a place to experience God while building long lasting friendships and relationships. The environment is welcoming and services bring a safe place to experience God. We love love this church and would recommend to everyone !

name: Life Community Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: This church is so involved in the community and has had such a big impact on me and everyone who has been involved with them. The minute I walked in, I had people introducing themselves and I felt right at home. We were invited to the church picnic on our first day! This is forever my church family This church reminds me of a college....knowing God and and living God if you will, is not taught in church it's worshiped there...I don't think we need help....we are all on the same level here.....don't forget that oak street...... Awesome worship and the most heartfelt sermon.   Great experience and incredible preacher. A wonderful place to worship, the pastor is ok too. I visited Life Community Church last Sunday, 1/28/2024

name: Life Community Church - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary: I have only been to this church a few times but I am in love with it because i know God is there. The elders came to me and anointed me and prayed for me. It is working. Praise God. My legs are getting stronger. I will try to stand up tomorrow morning. If I can I may come to church tomorrow. If you see my post please pray for my healing. God bless you all always in all ways. Been attending regularly for seven years. Great modern church with a focus on smaller groups and scripture. Awesome worship team. Friendly atmosphere and people, free coffee/tea and hot chocolate, upbeat worship/music and come dressed casual or your Sunday best I am so grateful to be a part of this wonderful community!!! I love my church!!

name: Life Community Church - Nolensville Campus
reviewSummary:
Love the pastor and his heart for Jesus and others. Grateful for those that are pouring into my teenagers' lives with God's truth. I adore the women's ministry and how they are intentional about pointing us to Christ. I enjoy learning from the sermons, singing songs together, and meeting every other week with our community group to dig into God's Word! Love Jay's sermons from the text
Love the worship with great songs and emotion;  wish the lights would stay on, so there would be more audience participation and not feel like a concert
Have met some friendly people; wish there would be more folks coming over to us introducing themselves
We have been at LCC about 2 1/2 months
Having trouble establishing my data profile
All in all, feel like LCC is a good fit for us with people seeking God's will for their lives We've been attending Sunday services, events and community groups for 2+ years since moving to Nolensville. Life Community has been a healthy place for us to meet other families and volunteer. Pastor Jay Watson is a gem. We appreciate his transparent approach to leadership and have been personally touched by his attention to families in struggle. We love this church!  You'd have a hard time finding a more authentic group of people anywhere!  You don't need to know all the answers you just need to love Jesus.  It's a small-ish church but they're really increasing their efforts to reach out and help the local community plus it's probably the most friendly church I've ever attended.  If you're new to Nolensville I definitely recommend checking them out. From the first day I came, this has been home. The children's program is top notch and the music is moving!  This is the most authentic church I have ever been a part of!

name: Life Community Church - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this church. I recently moved to California from the East Coast. Before moving here, I was researching churches in the area of where I would be moving to. There were 4 churches listed. My Spirit told me to visit Life Community Church.

From the moment I walked in-I knew I was home. They are so loving and welcoming. The Pastors are true disciples of Christ. The entire congregation demonstrate LOVE, just the way Christ does.

I encourage anyone looking for a church home to visit Life Community Church. You will LOVE it. Great place to worship. Multi generational, multi-national. Young energetic pastor and full of LIFE!! I found this church nearly 6 years ago and it continues to serve the community richly. I love the staff, the congregation, the kids, and all the leaders!! Thank you LCC! This is a GREAT PLACE to LEARN ALL ABOUT JESUS!! Life Community Church serves as a bright beacon in the community of Roseville. There is a strong emphasis on Bible teaching, quality music presentations, active children and youth ministries, focus on local outreach and missions, dynamic fellowship, a broad band of people ages and welcoming hands. I joined this church right after Covid. Having relocated to Roseville, I'd not had a lot of friends. For over 4 years now, I've participated  in the first Women's Bible Study that is still going strong. I love this group of women who have supported me, and mentored me in my journey with Christ. If you're seeking fellowship you'll find it in this church. Wonderful sermon & friendly people
Worship was great. Kids programs are led by people who love them & truly care

name: Life Community Church Alexandria - Alexandria Campus
reviewSummary:
This is our first time going to a smaller church, and we love it!  The pastor, elders, and all the members are welcoming and friendly.  The Word of God is taken seriously here, and the hard stuff is not shied away from!  This church preaches a healthy mix of both Gospel hope and repentance.  We've gotten to know many of the members and leadership quickly, but they never pressured us to become members or made us feel guilty if we didn't attend for some weeks.  Definitely recommend if you want a more close church family that shares the Good News straight up.

Update 4/2023:
Been four years since my original review and we still attend this church! We recently had a Sunday school class where Pastor Ryan talked through evidence for the resurrection of Jesus. Fantastic! Pastor Ryan is really familiar with Christian apologetics (logical reasoning for the Christian faith), so both my husband and I have learned a lot from him about that topic which has strengthened our faith. 10/10 would recommend. I used to go to MBC and was apprehensive about trying a smaller church. These fears were totally unfounded—this is a solid church. The messages are biblical, the people are super friendly (even the non-greeters!), and it’s easy to get involved. Coming from a megachurch, I especially value that the pastors know who I am. We are so grateful for P’s time at Life Christian Church Preschool. She learned and grew so much during her time here and made so many wonderful friends. The teachers and staff have been absolutely amazing—caring, patient, and dedicated. P will especially miss Miss Anna, Randolph, and Ms. Burgos, who made such a lasting impact on her. Thank you for creating such a warm and nurturing environment. We’ll always remember this special chapter! I was visiting the area and found this church on the internet. I read a review that said it was a solid BIBLE teaching / preaching church with a mix of Hope and repentance and Grace. I really thought the service was CHRIST honoring and the Worship was very sincere and the TRIUNE GOD OF SCRIPTURE was exalted properly. The Pastors were mature in Christ and knew THE WORD and taught us and preaching was with Biblical integrity. I only went that morning 🌄 but it was very edifying and I gave my FATHER in heaven thanksgiving for allowing me to have been in HIS presence with HIS people under HIS WORD and growing in GRACE through the preaching and Worship which to HIS praise. As a military family we really enjoy the strong fellowship and friendliness here. Our first Sunday here we were approached by multiple people  saying hello and inviting us to small group. Pastor Ryan and Pastor Reed are knowledgeable  and compassionate  in the faith. I truly feel like God is working through Life Community in big ways and small ways. We are thankful to be apart of this church!

name: LIFE Fellowship Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
Come and feel welcomed. There are Pastors here who have Biblical teachings and guidance for us all. LifeFellowship's leadership is Welcoming, Relevant, and Worshipful! Not just 'doing' Church: a place for being the Church! Although they seem friendly and kind, after the four services I have attended about 3/4 of the sermon/message is always focused on sports.
I definitely understand the relatability and “comparison”, but as someone who knows literally nothing about sports, I’ve gotten lost on every single occasion and not been able to follow with the context.
Today during the Easter service I was very confused as well with what version they were reading from? It wasn’t KJV, NKJV, NIV, or NLT, so what I had access to wasn’t anything like what they were reading... very confusing... Solid biblical teaching.  Great children's and teen programs.  Caring pastors, staff and volunteers.  Good balance of ministry within and to the surrounding communities.  Two services with time in between to connect with each other. Joined Life Fellowship approximately a year ago with my (now) husband and it has completely transformed my walk with the Lord! The church and it's members are so welcoming and quick to help you get plugged in to a community. The Pastors are great and teach the bible as it is written in ways that are convicting. It's a growing church but has an intimate feel! A church should be a place of people of seriousness and witness who trace the Word of God with knowledge and wisdom.  Not that it is a motivational message to get you excited and ask for your money to buy in other churches.  Life is a great church.

Life Fellowship is a church committed to the Truth of Christ and a good way to administer the Word of God and with people of testimonials.  It has missionaries in different parts of the world.

The  Pastors go on missions and are theologically prepared to trace the Word so that your life is blessed and prospered in all aspects.  A church of Love and social work that impacts the community.

name: Life Fellowship Church - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary:
I have not been to church in a long time.  Been trying different ones around the area and decided to try this one. The parking was good and the people were friendly when I got there.  The preaching was a little tongue in cheek,  but that was part of the services theme at the time. Ended up liking it and now I have chosen this church to be my home church and hopefully will continue attending this church and getting more involved. Also joined a Bible group that the church has available. I attended this church recently and truly tried to give it a fair chance. Last week’s sermon focused on sex within marriage, and the message communicated to women was essentially that if they do not meet their husband’s sexual needs, he will find it elsewhere. That framing felt deeply troubling and inconsistent with the biblical teaching that we are first fulfilled in Christ and that each individual is responsible for their own actions.

After prayer and conversations with others, I decided to return one more time. Unfortunately, this Sunday reinforced my concerns. During the service, it was stated that the message was not for those who are single, widowed, or in a season of waiting. At the end, couples were asked to hold hands for prayer, leaving others sitting alone. In that moment, I felt unseen and out of place.

The Church should reflect the heart of Christ and make space for everyone, regardless of relationship status. I prayed before writing this because I never want to discourage anyone from seeking the Lord. However, I cannot recommend a place where people in certain seasons of life feel excluded.

I will not be returning. The pastor’s messaging promotes outdated gender-role ideology, uses contempt-based humor toward women, and demonstrates a serious lack of trauma-informed understanding of domestic violence. That is not Christ-like leadership and it is not responsible pastoral care.

I work in psychology and have academic training in domestic violence, trauma bonding, and coercive control. The research is clear. Healthy, stable relationships are built on mutual influence, shared power, emotional safety, and autonomy. They are not built on male-dominant authority models.

Suggesting women stay in abusive relationships because of poor judgment or denial is not just tone-deaf. It is dangerously misinformed. Survivors often remain due to trauma bonding, financial entrapment, isolation, child safety concerns, and increased lethality risk when attempting to leave. Messaging that ignores this reality reinforces shame and can discourage survivors from seeking help.

Using selective scripture to justify hierarchy is not strong theology. It is proof-texting. Song of Songs is widely understood in biblical scholarship as mutual poetic love literature, not a gender hierarchy manual.

Faith and trauma-informed, evidence-based relationship teaching can coexist. Minimizing abuse, reinforcing dependency, or mocking women is harmful, regardless of intent.

Impact matters more than intent. Messaging like this is irresponsible and just plain arrogant. The leadership and people at Life Fellowship are so welcoming, we felt at home right away. The worship has us tearing up and the word is right on point: “not church growth messages, church health messages”. If you want to get plugged in and grow with your family, this is the place to be! It has a perfect balance of kids, youth, young adults and adults with life groups and activities to serve and be served. Look forward to seeing you soon! While the pastor is clearly charismatic and skilled at public speaking (those with this personality type do), the sermons often resemble motivational talks more than sound biblical teaching. The messages rely on emotional appeal and personal anecdotes rather than thoughtful exegesis or doctrinal grounding.

There’s also a concerning tone of arrogance and subtle manipulation in the delivery - using fear-based language and guilt rather than grace or truth to inspire change. I made the mistake of listening to one of his podcasts with his wife and his condescending tone to her was shocking.

I truly hope the focus shifts toward authentic biblical scholarship for the sake of the members of this congregation -  but I doubt this pastor has the education or humility to truly do that.

name: Life in Christ Church - Brunswick / Golden Isles Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place to come and worship the Lord, Jesus Christ.  The Preacher is very compassionate and caring toward others. A warm, friendly and cozy little church... Thanking God for this church family. Everyone has been so welcoming, friendly, and open to sharing Jesus’ love and grace. If you’re nearby, come here, a God’s word, share in the joy and feel God’s love in this awesome place. The community and fellowship here is the best. They have men’s meetings, women’s meetings, lunches, dinners, Wednesday evening service, trips, and more. Thank you all for giving me a place to worship Jesus in fellowship. I love you all and I will stay in touch! This is my home church! 🥰❤️ I have never felt more at home like I do here. My family and I have known the pastor and his family for over 12 years, and each member there is just as loving and welcoming as the other, we love all the babies and have a children’s church and nursery, we have breakfast together (when I make it on time lol) and we do Wednesday’s and holidays together, it’s a family I’m so blessed to be a part of!
