Come see us and lift your praise during Sunday morning worship!😇 I started going to Life in Christ Church about a year ago. I knew Pastor Kirk and a couple folks by name only but a few months in they have all become family.
The worship is excellent, the teaching is truth presented in humility and the fellowship is excellent. Incredible church, very welcoming members, such a great experience to worship and have fellowship with other people. This is an uplifting worship experience - nothing fake, contrived, or stodgy/judge-y. Real people in a real world looking to worship Jesus and to help and support each other.

name: Life in Christ Church Community Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: This church has been my new family for a year now, and this is what it means to truly be part of your community. Homeless feedings 3 times a week: Tuesday 6pm, Thursday 6pm, Saturday 8am. Bible study Wednesday 6pm, Sunday 10am. Service 11:15am Sunday. Pastor John Benson and Pastor Derek Taylor and their praise and worship team are amazing leaders. Thank you for your service to God and your community!!!! This is MY Church!! I was baptized here & will be spending my 1yr clean celebration here next month! This church & the people in it have changed my life & I hope it does the same for at least 1 person who reads this!! Wednesday night from 6:30-8pm is Bible Study & Sunday Bible Study is from 10-11am, Worship 11-12pm & sermon 12-1pm. Come & join our flock🙌✨🙌 When I went to Job corps. I met a wonderful man named John Benson. He is the father of the pastor. He is so much like his father. He is very caring and understanding. I could tell by the way he treats others. I am very proud to say he is my pastor. I live near the church and walking by today it seems like the door was left open we tried to peek inside and see if anybody was there to find out nobody was inside tried to call the number provided online no answer if someone belonging to the church could send somebody out to lock up I'm sure it's needed. They really helped me out during the 9 or so months  was sleeping on concreat... They made me feel like a human being or never any less thank you🦋💖🥰💒⛪

name: Life In the River Worship Center - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: My experience here has been nothing but amazing each service I receive something. It’s a great place to be when you have people doing what you love to do. People of every nation and tongue is welcome here to serve God and to worship His Holy name. Great atmosphere! Awesome Praise and Worship! Apostolic Prophetic Church This is a Awesome House of Worship!! The Spirit of God is truly in this place!!!! i go here and it is litttt

name: Life Mission Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
I can say without a doubt that our family has been beyond blessed by Life Mission Church. I can't imagine what life would be like without this church. Sermons are always biblical and the pastors prioritize God's truth. Music is the same: full of talent, biblical truth, and always encouraging. The community of believers at LMC loves God and loves people. Small but mighty and always striving to glorify God with what's been given to them. We've been here for 10 years and hopefully for many more! Sermon’s are good. Music is great. But it’s not a family/community. I wanted to feel part of something, connecting with ppl but it’s definitely a see you on Sunday type of church.
Update: I’m willing to give it another try. Maybe just bring my own friends for community. Lol It's a family here.  A family though of sinners very thankful for the grace provided us by Christ, with preaching that will very much deepen knowledge of grace and the truth of our nature. I walked in one day and they basically won me over. I love the people and the gospel

name: Life Point Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
I'll get straight to the point.  If you're a conservative evangelical to the core, you'll be right at home.  Otherwise, if your version of Christianity includes:

- A balance of literal and contextual interpretation of Scripture
- An openness to interfaith dialogue
- Women in full leadership and clergy roles
- “Open and Affirming” congregations
- Couples who are welcome to baptism regardless of sexual orientation
- No hidden moral codes or covert observations
- No zealous, heavy-handed messaging about personal morality

...don't come here.  And don't let the "welcome booth" near the entrance fool you. My wife and I first went to Life Point towards the end of last year and we were welcomed into a new church family at once. The people are wonderful and the presence of The Holy Spirit is at work there. There is an excellent program for the kids and teens as well as many groups outside of church to further your walk with God. Come as you are!  Everyone is welcome!🙏🏼 I love LP and think the Growth Track experience to help people get connected at the church is G R E A T. If you're looking for a church, come join us here on Sunday!!! I just attended the Tuesday Morning Prayer and Worship Service.

What a BLESSING!

This was my first time visiting (we are volunteering at the State Natural Area nearby). It was still dark when i arrived, but the lot and approach to the building were very well lit.  Others entering greeted me as did the official "greeters".

There was coffee!

As i entered i could see the entrance to a very colorful, vibrant children's area.
The worship center/sanctuary was dimly lit, but i did have enough light to see my Bible.

When I arrived,a musician was leading worship (sounded really nice, and attendees were participating). The Pastor/ Lay Leader delivered a very good devotion. It was short but not at all rushed and was scripture based, while relating it to exactly where I am right now.

Then we were given the opportunity to pray; there were prayer cards (for if you wanted the church to pray for you), and a Prayer Guide,  "Pray First" .  I couldn't read it at the time, but brought it home

As we prayed, there was really good prayer- focused contemporary Christian music playing.

When I left,  a Greeter asked if I was new (yes) and provided me with information on volunteering at the church,  life groups, baptism...

I had a great experience at Life Point. I do plan to visit again and will invite other folks volunteering with me. I visited today and had a pleasant experience.  I have always felt out of place in large churches.  You get lost in the crowd. At times it can be to my advantage because you can go in and out without anyone looking for you and I admit this is okay for me at times.

Today I went and a black lady named Mary was really sweet to us. Talkative and kind. She showed us where we the main seating area was located and the restrooms.  She was also friendly to my teens.

Later on after service in that great sea of people, somehow Mary found us in the parking lot and asked how we enjoyed the service and invited us again. It was movie day (Wild Robot).
I thought that was really nice. To find us, make sure we had a good time before she went on her way.  This stood out because we had one of those white visitor bags and she was pretty much the one who came to find us.

I didnt feel like just a number added you know what I mean?

The message was concise,  and very relatable and scripture based.

Leaving the parking area was a bit hectic and I saw a sign that first time visitors could have flashed their lights for what I assumed would be easier parking. Bummer. We missed it.

However it would be hard to see that sign because there were several parking attendants right in the front which blocked the signs. So we followed the directives to go right.

Overall. We enjoyed the service and will visit again.

name: Life Pointe Church - Woodland Campus
reviewSummary:
Best fireworks stand the supports FFA! I love going there, it is loving, friendly, lots of stuff you can do. I would recommend going there. Very diverse person age and gender. Majority is young adult from college. There are something church need to work on but overall good. Grew up in the church when it was First Baptist and now its called Life Point Church. The Pastoral staff is outstanding. Kelsey in the office who does so much for all of the staff is amazing. I love that you can watch church at when when your sick. Can’t say enough great things about all of the people that attend. Come join us for service. Went there a few times - very welcoming. LOVE the community, just wish there was more. This is now my home church.
2 services on Sunday, great sermons, worship and a lot of friendly caring people.
Been looking for a good bible based Church and I finally found one.

name: Life Worth Living Church
reviewSummary: This is a place that will accept you as you are. One that want to see you moving in the plans that God has for you. A place that no matter what your hang ups are, there is someone there with 1st hand experience through it. A place where God is truly Love. For real for real. I love my church, I thank the Lord for this Church. the Holy spirit is there. the love is there. they have also been a blessing to that community. To God Be The Glory for the Storehouse he placed there. Such an awesome experience with the lord...authenticity at its finest! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Life-Changing Faith Christian Fellowship - Frisco Campus
reviewSummary:
I first visited LCFCF once in 2012, everyone was so welcoming. I visited again, once, in 2018, and in 2022. Each visited I felt at home. Afterwards a few people said, "Hello", and I left Spiritually feed. I would visit more, but I live over an hour away. We are inviting everyone to come and fellowship with us at Life Changing Faith Church! You will never leave the same way you came in.

Founding Sr. Pastor: Dono Pelham delivers a word like no other.  The family feeling I have when I am at this church makes me feel loved and cared about.

I'm starting soon to create the Angels of the Gospel Praise Dance Ministry in April.  Two groups of adults and youth. Be on the lookout for more information!! This church has been making me feel like family since I started going!!!! They embraced my kids and I like long lost relatives!!!! The pastor and ministerial staff are amazing and so are their wives!!!! If you want to see your life change, come in!!!! My first visit was a wonderful experience of their LOVE and FAITH as a part of the body of Christ.  It was a pleasure to be a part of their 11 year Anniversary celebration. The choir sounds like a 100 voice mass choir full of the spirit and charged for the cause of the cross. I wanted a place that I could call my spiritual home, a place where I could feed my soul with the word of God flowing from an eloquent and strong pastor. I "Believe" I've found such a place. I invite you to Come see for yourself......

name: Life.Church
reviewSummary: Pioneers of the multi-site video model and creators of the Bible App. High-tech, consistent experience across locations. Craig Groeschel's leadership teaching is a major draw.

name: Life.Church Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been in north austin for 8 years, and bounced around to at least 20 nondenominational churches. All were welcoming & uplifting with relevant and scripturally based teaching. But we would worship for a few months and realize we weren’t making friends. That’s the difference in life church - we were invited by neighbors and have attended every week since. We are actually building relationships and looking forward to serving together. To us, this is what Jesus’ ministry was and what church should be. As a pharmacy technician and immunizer who works 10 minutes away, I was failed and disrespected by church staff. They said they wouldn’t baptize me privately. Instead, they make a huge show out of it with filming and posting on social media for everyone to see, including potential patients. I do not want patients mentioning my faith at work. I also love to sing, and the worship pastor failed to come up with a way to help me stay safe when serving onstage.

Anyone in a licensed professional role should look elsewhere if they want their boundaries protected. Hello,

I work in the plaza nearby, and during lunch breaks, several of my coworkers and I often park under the trees near the church for shade, especially during the summer.

Recently, church security has approached our vehicles and told us we are not allowed to park there. We understand there may be parking guidelines, but the way we have been approached has felt unnecessarily rude and uncomfortable.

We are not loitering, leaving trash, or causing any issues. We are simply using the shaded parking area during our breaks, as many of us have done for a long time.

We respectfully ask that you review how this is being handled and speak with security about approaching people in a more professional and respectful manner. Clear communication is appreciated, but being treated harshly is not.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I thank Pastor Jacob for the invitation to Life.Church. We've been in search of a church that was warm, welcoming, not judgemental, and who genuinely loves to help one another. This is the church for us and for you! Come as you are, come as your dressed, all walks of life are invited.  Today was first visit and i believe we found our forever Church. ❤️ Looking for a home church here in Schertz has been difficult.  We have been watching Life Church with Pastor Craig for 5 years. So with over an hour drive to attend, I think we have found a home church I love!

name: Life.Church Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
I just moved here from South Dakota! I was looking for a church and everyone was super welcoming! The message was amazing and impactful! The pastors there have such a heart for people and community! I was so nervous coming and the people here made me feel welcomed and comfortable! Thank you so much! I will definitely be coming back! 🫶🏻 I absolutely love this church! I have visited many locations, and this is by far the best. The people are friendly; but not weird friendly. The music is wonderful and they have very talented musicians and singers. Their summer series, At the Movies, never disappoints. So much fun! I am so glad to call Life.Church Broken Arrow my home church! I love the combination of truth, wisdom and grace as taught by Senior Pastor Craig Groeschel, the love and care from our local Pastor, Bryan Hill and the many wonderful people who make up our church, as together, we follow the lead of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Come on in and join us!

Find God and find LIFE! Dogs, people eating snacks, music louder than you can bear, always about money, and an hour of marriage counseling. Very sad. They have lost the respect for the House Of God and what it’s meant for. Left early for the 2nd time in my life leaving Chruch early, the 1st was also here last year. Will never return. If you're looking for a great place to worship and grow closer to Christ, this is the place. I love it here.

name: Life.Church Colorado Springs - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We are new to Colorado Springs and decided to try our granddaughters church. She participates in there youth group. Everyone was very welcoming and the worship was great. Lots of energy but not over the top. The sermon was actually a movie interjected with pastoral comments. This fit the movie theme they were presenting which obviously had a lot of time, love and effort exerted. It was quite a bit larger than what I’m used to but they still managed to make you feel noticed and comfortable. We are going to go again next Sunday. Praise the Lord! I went to visit this church on a night that they hosted a light meal and information to those who were interested in becoming new members. It was seen on a movie screen where they explained their method and success.

We spent a few minutes talking to those at our table to get familiar with one another, and then the night was over

Afterwards, I asked a couple questions like do you baptize in Jesus name? Do you baptize at all? Do you believe in the Holy Ghost, speaking in other tongues? Is your praise and worship active and encourage the congregation to join in.

A lot of of these questions was met with confusion and I did not get clear answers. The people hosting the introduction night literally did not know anything about speaking in tongues, and they said that they would have to take my number and get back with me.

To be honest, that put a little fear in my heart because Church should be more like a hospital than a business. This is where people go when they are sick when they don’t feel good when they need help. The Holy Ghost is a comforter, a helper, and those who worked in ministry in the church was unfamiliar with it.

At least let me be fair and say those who attended this event.

Also, I was a little discouraged because I put in information to join about seven different smaller groups. I said to myself just give it a chance get to know the people first get involved become community. Hang out with people who are like minor and share the same interest. And sadly all I can report is not one of them contacted me. Not a single group, or group leader reached out to me. And I filled out the paperwork to every group I was interested and included my phone number and email. I did not get one person to contact me.

It was just not a good experience, and for myself that told me that this was not a church that I could join.

I pray that everyone finds a church family. This look like a place that others were happy. And so maybe it can be your home as well. Just because it’s not a perfect fit for me does not mean it’s not everything you’ve always been looking for. Our family is so grateful for the Life.Church community - we’ve made life long, wonderful friendships through worship, LifeGroups and serving! Fantastic leadership at every level - I love that LC meets in multiple locations so we can share the weekly messages with our family who attend locations like Wichita and KC! Even across many states, this is a local Church filled with neighbors who love Jesus, you can be known and find life together! Blessed to have one church in multiple locations that I can attend when traveling. Always welcoming. Great atmosphere. Powerful worship and sermon. Love seeing people serving wholeheartedly. The only thing missing was having congregations reading scriptures together with their Bible on their hands. This is an amazing church with a non-formal atmosphere.  Everybody is very welcoming and friendly, and everyone dress very casually (jeans/shorts depending on the time of year), you can truly come as you are. I don’t live in Colorado Springs but I attend every time I’m in the area.  This is truly an amazing church with a great pastor and great leadership team. I highly recommend visiting if you’re in the Colorado Springs area.

name: Life.Church Edmond - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I love Life.Church. After years of visiting this church when we come to visit our family here, we highly recommend trying it to see if it feels good for you! . When you come, you will be warmly welcomed. There are coffee and snacks for you to enjoy. They begin with worship (thanking and praising God through live (contemporary) worship music that we find beautiful and encouraging. Pastor Craig is the lead and founding pastor and is a strong, dear, authentic and obedient man of God;
if you come to the Saturday afternoon service you can hear the live message, if you attend on Sundays, you will often watch the message projected as it is streamed to many other church campuses. The pastors’ messages are consistently helpful (and I’m not exaggerating when I say life-changing). You will hear God speaking to your heart here. It is so important to find a church that will tell you what God wants you to know and this church does that!

I will say again we love this church and it is a great place to come and learn about Jesus! The kids’ programs are excellent as well! Life.Church can feel as big or small as you want it to, so if you just want to blend in or if you want to get involved, there will be a place for you. This church is incredibly generous; two examples of this are how they have created and give away the Bible app, because it is their mission to put the Word of God into the hands of every person in the world, in each person’s own language) so that everyone has a chance to connect to God.

Another example is Life.Church created free ministry materials that other churches use, so this church’s impact stretches far- far -beyond the building walls. I have used the YouVersion (Bible) app for many years so when I came to Oklahoma and saw this church I felt like it was a God wink and needed to go. The church is huge but you still felt that same spirit of a small town Church. The worship music was amazing. The preaching was awesome too and we were welcomed at every turn. So thankful we got to experience this church and hope to go back someday. My car broke down today, and by broke down I mean the tire blew on the interstate and I pulled into the Life Church campus to wait for help. Five people, one older gentlemen and four younger gentlemen, offered me help and helped me to change my tire and get back on the road. I can tell that there is a great community around LifeChurch. Those five guys were a huge help to me on a very stressful day. Visited twice while in town. Erica got my 10 year old stage 5 clinger to go to Kids Church where she not only stayed but made a friend. If I lived here this is where I’d go. Pastor Sam is amazing; he was a very compelling pastor, sharing his story, appreciating vets, and rooting for the world cup. We enjoyed worshipping at the place we normally watch at another location.  Loved seeing all dressed up for fall celebration and never seen a helicopter drop for a fall celebration. Before now only for a Easter celebration. I want to take the time to thank all those who only few not all I witnessed working behind the scenes to make worship time for us all so enjoyable. I felt like you all don't get recognized enough by us all but our experience wouldn't be as good as it is without your faithful service. From the bottom of my heart thank you. We normally watch from before Wichita now Derby Kansas. Or when we are over the road and working away from a life church on line watching the service provided. My husband travels the USA working on wind turbines we have always passed by this cross ✝️ and its normally a sign that we are almost home and almost done driving.  Today it means so much more thank you all for your dedication of service for us to enjoy.

name: Life.Church Fort Worth - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
A very welcoming environment… well organized staff and the Sunday services offer different times for worship. Impressive leadership and good learning experience for the youth. After uprooting my entire family and relocating us to Texas, it was important that we found a new home church that met the expectations set by our previous home church.

We stumbled upon Life.Church—Fort Worth when we first moved here and haven’t looked back! Pastor Craig is able to capture your attention and broaden your understanding of the Word as he preaches. Never a dull moment during service!

Right as you walk in, you’re greeted with smiles and good vibes. The interior usually always has themed displays and the colors only add at drawing you in.

My kids have thrived here! Everyone who works/serves in Life Kids brings such joy and warmth—you can truly feel God’s presence in this place. I feel so comfortable leaving my babies in the hands of the Life Kid leaders!

I’ve met some wonderful people within the short time I’ve been here. I felt so comfortable with this church that I actually decided to serve myself—which says something as I’m a more reserved, introverted person and would’ve never considered serving before.

I could go on and on… Wow such a wonderful and unique experience. This church is very different, but in a good way. If u want a new way to praise God, come here.

This church has a beautiful interior. They have beautiful decorations that add a pop of color. The rooms are beautiful . There is also complimentary popcorn, tea, coffee, and water server here. There is even a mini daycare to leave your kids in while you go to worship.

When you enter the church you are greeted with a smile. The service is very different from what I've experienced. They were having a movie sermon. Where they would play clips of the "Aretha" movie and a pastor would come and speak about them. The sermon was pre-recorded by the way. It was alright. The live music was awesome tho. The band did an amazing job.

Tldr: welcoming modern church with modern service and interior. 5/5⭐️ would recommend I love the service but watching the screen kind of defeats the purpose of going to church. I might as well watch it at home. Do you guys ever do services where the pastor is physically there doing the service? I love Life.Church, but I really miss the old pastors and the sense of family we used to have. Back then, you could truly feel the love and connection. Now, with so many new pastors and constant changes, it’s been harder for me to give my all or feel that same trust. Still, I continue to attend because I love the Word of God and Pastor Craig’s messages. I find myself watching online more often than going in person these days

name: Life.Church Hendersonville - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary: Life.Church has been the common thread in my life through college, marriage, and the birth of my first child. I have found such loving community here through the years, and love that Life.Church is a place where everyone is welcome. So grateful for Pastor Joel and the whole team! Wonderful place for kids and young families, as well. We made a special 2 hour trip from Athens, Alabama just to come visit At The Movies, and our visit did NOT disappoint! We're originally from Washington state, where we first heard from Pastor Craig Groeschel while he was speaking during a conference at our church. We've been listening to him for a decade now and love his honest, transparent delivery of the word. At The Movies is one of our favorite series each year, and this year made the trek to experience it in person. What a treat! The vibe at Life Church is warm, welcoming, and comfortable. We also had a chance to chat with Ps. Joel, who was so friendly and genuine. We highly recommend lide Church if you're someone seeking a church home. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Very welcoming church. Joel is knowledgeable and caring pastor. Him and his family are the nicest people I have ever met. Been attending for close to 15 years. Pastor is phenomenal. So much to offer, and so many opportunities to serve. Wonderful church home. Well, this church is highly rated, but I have been here twice and both sermons were about tithing. At least I know what their focus is! It was pretty much a repeat of last Sunday. I don't think I will be back for a third one. Maybe they are a little bit more welcoming for families, but not so much for an older, single female new to the area. I asked a group of ladies at a table about Sunday school classes last week, and I got looked at like I was crazy. The pastor-on a video- likes to brag about how much money he gives to charity. Being in real estate, I am sure he does very well in the Nashville area. Nothing close to what a retied school teacher like myself could afford. I beieve in tithing and have tithed in the past, but I don't think it sure be the main subject every sermon. Like the pastor quoted Jesus saying that "yes, we should tith, but focus about more important things." I come to church to learn more about our Savior.

name: Life.Church McKinney - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been looking forward to the day I will worship with this great community of believers. Just found out there was one not to far away from me on my visit from Nigeria.

True to their global impact, you can also feel the true freedom when you walk into the church and meet the people, join the worship, and be blessed by the Word.

Will definitely visit again. The music is unbelievably good, the staff and volunteers are always kind and welcoming. This church has changed my life and given me so much courage. I love serving with them and hosting my own Life Group - Holy Smocks art club- to better connect our communities. I like that the sermons along with countless other materials and resources are available online. Loved visiting this church while on a business trip. Wonderful people all around and the band is awesome. I came to lifechurch McKinney for the first time today and I loved it. Such a great atmosphere. Great music and amazing message. Pastors are very approachable. Passion to see people saved through faith in Christ Jesus. Sanctified, called from death to life, from the power of Satan to God as Paul witnessed to those in his day.

name: Life.Church Moore - Moore Campus
reviewSummary:
I had a very disappointing experience dealing with a couch listing connected to Life Church in Moore, Oklahoma on Facebook Marketplace. The communication felt extremely confusing and unorganized from the beginning. It constantly seemed like nobody knew what was going on, and I kept getting mixed signals about whether someone was actually available or not.

I tried to be respectful and patient, but the entire situation felt unnecessarily secretive and frustrating. Instead of clear answers, I was left feeling ignored and treated like I didn’t know what I was talking about. A simple free couch pickup should not turn into this much confusion and poor communication.

Very disappointed with how this was handled overall. I recently started exploring Life Church after moving on from a Catholic background, and I initially appreciated the warm welcome from Joey. It felt genuine, and I truly believed he cared about me and my family. However, my experience took a turn when I noticed some troubling behaviors.

I was disappointed when Joey did not show up for a longtime member undergoing serious surgery—someone who has contributed significantly to the church community. It made me question his commitment to those who need support during tough times.

I tried to switch things up by attending a sermon from the new youth pastor, only to discover that it was completely scripted. It felt like every pastor was just reiterating the same donation pitch without any personal touch. I expected more authenticity from my church experience.

What struck me the most was overhearing derogatory comments made by the church leader's son, who expressed disdain for the church's older members, implying he didn’t want his father’s church to look like that. He even made derogatory remarks toward my mother-in-law, who has dedicated her life to serving at Life Church and attends multiple services in her free time. It’s disheartening to see a church community fail to respect its dedicated members, especially those who have faithfully donated and contributed over the years.

Overall, I feel that Life Church has a long way to go in terms of honoring its elders and creating an environment where everyone feels valued. I hope they can reflect on these issues and strive for a more inclusive and compassionate community. Very friendly,  relaxing atmosphere  awesome classes for the age of the child!! And you can sing as loud as you want! And Craig is great to everyone is very helpful.  This church had helped me grow so much! Oh life groups for adults.  Switch for  teens awesome as well. Went with 4 generation from my family. Great volunteers that make you feel so welcome and great sermons. Kids love the childcare area. It's a great family church and everybody is so nice! It's clean too! Great restrooms! I'm from out of town / country.  I went here on Easter Sunday.  First time coming to this church, and last.  I was disappointed with the worship service.  The worship team had a lady wear black yoga pants with white boots and a hat.  Is she trying to get people to pay attention to her or bring people to God through Lust. I'm confused.  I believe a worship team should bring people to God through their worship, not themselves.  Have the worship team down dress and not be provocative.  We all are sinners and fallen short of the glory of God. Some people have problems with Lust and don't need to be at church.  Bring people to God not to yourselves.  The preaching was good on the other hand.  God bless you.  I hope your worship team correct themselves.

name: Life.Church Norman - Norman Campus
reviewSummary: Welcoming church with outstanding worship sets and even better sermons that are relevant and applicable. So odd. Went to their youth group with 3 friends because we have all been looking for a new youth group, the second we got there the place felt off. Not even 5 minutes into being there they started asking MIDDLE schoolers and high schoolers for 10% of their yearly income, as children?? So weird. We all felt extremely uncomfortable so we walked out. While we were leaving the speaker said something passive aggressive which is so uncomfortable especially in a holy setting. That's disgusting. On our way out a woman followed us and started to yell at us we couldn't leave. We are all almost adults with our own cars and she tried to tell us that our parents needed to check us out. Thankfully I made her leave us alone but the entire experience was horrible. I have been to multiple life churches and have NEVER had this sort of experience. 0/10 I would not recommend this place. The practice great physical distancing and safety at this church... from the sheriff's deputies to the parking lot crew to the Sunday schools for kids... safety appears to be a principle to these folks.. Kidz Enjoy always! KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK!!!! Special, Youth Orientation. Important. Fantastic, Religious Members. Odd experience here. There is no pastor on site, rather you watch the sermon on a big screen from a very feminine male pastor. There seems to be very little talk of Scripture and Jesus, and more talk on feelings. The pastor picked one verse to speak of the entire time, and the rest of it was basically word salad. I noticed they focus heavy on single moms and groups for women - which is great and is needed - however there were no groups for men at all. At least not spoken of.

name: Life.Church Oklahoma City - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Life.Church! I go to the 5 o'clock service on Saturday and it is really well done. It is very welcoming, and shout out to the host team! I help make the drinks and it is very fun. My favorite time is At the Movies because the whole campus is decorated like a specific movie! The messages are on point and overall is is so good. We had so much great experience there.
Nice pastor and associate pastors, good family trainings, coffee shops after church etc. love the calm and cool peaceful colors and atmosphere Have been a member for 20 plus years, Absolutely adore Craig and his passion for disciplining others. He’s honest, relatable, and always brings interesting perspectives.
Highest recommendation possible. I love my church home. Today was very special, my friend was baptized, she asked me to video it for her.
We met on the front row of this Life Church over 8 years ago. I would love for you to join us 🙏 We love going to Life Church. When we decided to get married we had no doubt that we wanted to get married here.  Everyone was welcoming and helpful. God has pointed us in the right direction.  If you have not been to Life Church you need to go and try it out. You wont be disappointed.
Also I wanted to point out that in November 2022 my husband was diagnosed with Kidney Cancer.  In February of 2023 we were baptized. What a wonderful day that was.

name: Life.Church Owasso - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary: Loved their praise songs . The pastor plugged his bookin the pulpit not too impressed with that . If you like a massive church maybe good fit for you My son and I went to the owasso Life Church and had an amazing experience. Everyone was extremely welcoming and inviting. The life kids for my son is amazing and he was reallt engaged. Worship music top notch and absolutely felt the presence of God. Service was great...the message was spot on for me and where I am at in my walk. All around excellent experience. Great Church and Amazing Staff!! The Youth Pastor Garrett Boring is one of a kind! He is a Great Pastor! Just had my first Leadership Lunch today with Richie and could not have been more impressed! The staff provides a truly welcoming experience and it's so encouraging to see someone actively bring together leaders in the community. I will absolutely be back and would highly encourage you to take the time to try their church and leadership sessions! They make you feel right at home. My daughter and her family were recently baptized , and to watch that and the fact that my daughter and her family have found their church family males.me.so.happy. I have thought about joining. I'm a member of Boston Avenue in Tulsa

name: Life.Church Rogers - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church for the entire family!!! If you are looking for a family friend / community church I would recommend you come out and give it a try. They have 3 different service times to go to live in person on Sundays and also if you can’t make it it’s very easy to watch from your home or anywhere wifi is available.
The song service and posters are great and very easy to talk with if you have any questions.
When attending you can feel free to come in your Sundays Best or I have shown up in jeans or ready to go golf right after service 😀. It has easy access right off the interstate with lots of parking. It’s the perfect size of church for our family. It could just be myself not son and wife or the entire gang of 12 of us shows up there is always room and open arms. This church is ALIVE!! Campus Pastor, Jake and everyone I’ve encountered are so friendly.  People say the music is loud and it is (love it) but it’s some of the best praise worship around the area. Check them out! We love this church.We actually moved an hour away and still drive the distance to make the 11:30 😂 The music is great, I don't care what anyone says💪 if it's to loud , grab some ear plugs at the front door..It's 2 modern? Maybe your just to old fashion 😂 "Come as you are" is a true statement from Life.Church. They are very welcoming and kind. Pastor Craig is incredible at speaking. The music is great! Love going here! I was raised Catholic and regularly attend Catholic Mass but ever so often will go to a Christian service.  My first time at Life Church Rogers and I almost walked out when the first song they sang was Taylor Swift’s Bad Blood.  Huh?  Taylor Swift has witchcraft in her shows??
I see comments below on how people were disgusted also with some songs being played.
Also, Christian churches need to start distributing communion every Sunday, and it should be the host and wine.  This is a huge part of our faith.
Very disappointing.
I did stay and did enjoy the rest of the service.
I gave 2 stars for the great sermon and the beautiful Christian songs sang, after Bad Blood.

name: Life.Church South Broken Arrow - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
I was invited to this church by a friend I met through a running group. Through that friendship, I was invited to attend, and I truly believe God puts people in your path for a reason. Whether they are meant to be in your life for a short time or a long time, I am grateful for the connections He places along the way.

I was a little nervous at first about attending a new church and not knowing what to expect. From the moment I walked in, though, I was warmly greeted, and everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming.
I attended a service during the “Love Killers” series, and the message was truly beautiful. I would highly recommend listening to the sermon if you haven’t already. Today was my third weekend attending, and I had the opportunity to meet even more people who were supportive, friendly, and genuinely inviting.

I’ve been searching for a community of like-minded people who share my values and beliefs, as well as a church that truly cares about its people. From day one, they welcomed me with open arms and made me feel right at home. I’m so grateful for the connections I’ve already made and for the way God has guided me here. I look forward to seeing what He has planned for me in this next chapter. We love everything Life Church has to bring and it is a great church for families. Call themselves a “church” but the pastor is never there, rarely even in the STATE. It’s honestly impressive how absent leadership can be while still pretending everything’s fine. They blast rave music for 30 minutes before the message like it’s a nightclub instead of a sanctuary, and the pastor doesn’t even cite Scripture, which is actually insane for someone supposedly teaching the Word.

Walking in, I got greeted with looks like I didn’t belong there. Not a single “hi,” not even a nod — just people acting like I was invisible. The whole atmosphere feels more like a social club with a dress code than a place welcoming anyone seeking God.

They are rude to they own staff and aren’t understanding or forgiving, which is crazy considering they preach about grace every week. The lack of compassion is unreal. THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE A PLACE OF GOD BUT HE AIN’T HERE. Everything about this place feels off, disconnected, and honestly just fake.

Absolute horror show from start to finish. This place is a CULT! Before even coming to this church today, i prayed for nearly an hour for wisdom, guidance, and discernment.

The spirit of God is not found here. Today was my first time going. 1 single person shook my hand and welcomed me in, told me good morning. That same man recognized me when I left, shook my hand again and wished me a blessed day, and I am so thankful for him.

That is about the only thing that was good about my experience here. For starters, the very first song the worship team sang was No One, by Alicia Keys. This is a secular song, by a secular artist, about her ex boyfriend. I was told "its to make people feel comfortable." As a church, and a community itself, if you have to deny the word of God and sing secular music in the house of God to make people feel "comfortable" then you are CLEARLY DOING SOMETHING VERY WRONG AS A COMMUNITY! The bible makes it very clear not to focus on Secular things. Then, they actually started playing worship music about Jesus. Myself, and maybe 7 other people in the congregation were worshipping and praising. After Alicia Keys ended, everyone in the congregation had stopped singing and dancing and stood silent like motionless zombies.

I did not see anyone, besides 1 other person who had actually brought a bible, and I realize now its because the Pastor of the church (who wasn't even there. His sermons are live streamed on a giant projector from Oklahoma City) DOES NOT CITE THE BIBLE! His sermons go "Jesus said...." "God said..." "Elisha said..." and he does not provide the scriptures, verses, or context when saying these things. He goes "this is in the bible" and does not show it....at all.

His sermon today, he showed 3 small tiny verses, completely out of context without any explanation. I had to pull out my bible and read surrounding verses to get an idea and understanding of what was going on in that book of the bible, and that made me realize that the pastor has no idea what hes talking about. I kid you not, in today's sermon the Pastor himself admitting to having lost his fire in God. Okay, so let's unpack that. If you claim you've lost your fire with God, then how do you know the message you are preaching is from God? How can I, as a member of this church, even trust your judgement?

It wasn't until 10 minutes before the sermon ended that the pastor FINALLY even spoke the name of Jesus and incorporated him into "lesson." Even then, his whole message was "God will do anything you ask him to because he cares abiut what you care about." Which is fundamentally and biblically inaccurate. God can and will do miracles, however that does not mean he WILL do miracles.

The way the pastor laid down this message implied that "God bows down to our will like a genie and gives us everything that we ask for." Which is not true. As Christians, we should be bowing down to GOD'S WILL, not our own. Talking about how "If you lost something, God will return it if you ask." Or maybe, that relationship or item is lost, because that was God's will and plan for your life.

To any new believer reading this, I urge you not to be a part of this church, or any other "Life Church." You will not find the love of God here. You will not find the message of God's word here.

Before my mother passed away last month, she warned me not to go to this church, and I should have listened. We have been attending life about a year and half now!  I love our worship songs and the sermons always touch my heart. I always leave with a “life lesson”.  It’s the best way to start your week!

name: Life.Church South Tulsa - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been attending for over 2 years. I knew this would become our home church from the minute we walked in. This was different, to be sure, but it was all on point, and my soul rejoiced. If you are searching and you have found this post, then maybe God is pointing you there as well. He may have been preparing you. Follow the prompting. There is a message there waiting to get to you as well.
Feel the joy and love as you are welcomed in.
There is care and teaching for children from birth on up. The teaching to the littles is great. The rooms are well decorated just for each age group. This place of worship is by far the most welcoming I have ever been in to attend a service! Super clean and the friendliest servants ever to shine with a glow from Jesus! From the Life Kids Staff to Pastor Tome to the Servants holding the doors open for us they made us feel so welcome and warm! The finest place to worship Christ Jesus ever! Life.Church is a mega church and has several locations. I don’t have anything negative to say about this church but the music is loud so you might want to wear ear silencers. Monday through Saturday the world drains my spirit, going to church here rejuvenates me to go on another week. The people are so nice and the pastors are inspiring, if you're looking for a church, try Life Church, it has changed my life. We attended this church and  did like it but it is too big for us. The music is like a concert , more like a show than worship. The pastor however is awesome and he delivered a great message. Like I stated, its too big for us and we will not be going but  there were no negatives that I could see. The greeters are very friendly too.

name: Life.Church West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church with very good sermons and good people. Music is a little loud for me but perhaps that’s because I’m 60.

They have several locations including one in Wellington or royal palm beach and another location in west palm beach.

The Bible app they created is very highly recommended. You get the Bible in any language or Bible version you want included the very popular and easy to understand New International Version. We love our church! Over two years strong at Life.Church WPB and wouldn’t trade it for anything. Love our church family 💜 if you’re looking for a place that you feel instantly welcome, come check it out. One service and you’ll see just how special this place is. Guaranteed. The entire LC WPB team is amazing. You can expect to feel comfortable and at home when you come to LC West Palm Beach. Josh, and his team, take such an active role in serving their community.  I have been a member of LC for about 5 years now and it has changed my life.  Thank You to the LC team for all they do. Love and miss going to this church every Sunday hopefully soon life church will open doors in Port Saint Lucie The best church  loving, caring, on fire for christ. .Whoever finds God Finds life.

name: Life.Church Yukon - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary:
Talk about feeling welcomed‼️🙌 ! Short of coming to your house, there is nothing that says *we are so joyful that you are here and you are special and you are important" more than pulling into that parking lot . If you want to feel *real* and not like a religious actor, BUT you also want to feel like there is reverence and honor for God and Jesus, swing by like I did. The music is off the charts and it goes straight to the heart so we can sing from our hearts and praise God for real, sincere and not just like a bored person. Just wait. Give it four Sundays . Or Saturdays , depending on your schedule. Just remember that some locations have Saturday services and some don't. Many do, and Yukon does at this time. Check the locations simply by googling lifechurch locations and you will go to their website. click LOCATIONS and it will show all of them and their service schedule!! It can change so keep an eye out occasionally especially coming up on Easter or Christmas Eve. Very eye opening seeing where their locations are and nice when you're traveling and want to keep a schedule because it keeps your encouragement up if you stop in at one traveling, blessing!! There's also a snack to take free if you're hungry and a bit of Tazo tea or comforting coffee. What a wonderful place to praise the Lord! They are very welcoming with a "come as you are" vibe. They have a lot of programs where they help the community and there are many volunteer opportunities available for those who feel called to serve. The music is phenomenal! The atmosphere is energetic and holy. I felt at ease my first time going and it "feels like home" to me, each time I go. They have great programs for children and teens as well. So, I attended this church for many years. Never missed a Sunday. Tithe every visit, even through the app during COVID. I fell on very hard times last year for a few reasons. I reached out to "my church" (I moved so I was in-between locations) for any help. I was given the run around and told "if you don't attend this church there's nothing we can do for you". So I can give you hundreds of dollars for years but can't get any help when times are hard?! I was then directed to the Norman location since they were closer.... (They wouldn't help either btw because I didn't attend there. Aren't all these mega churches connected?!) I saw my fair share of faithless attendees after services acting so ungodly to people. I saw a social experiment of a woman calling churches for help to see if they stood for what they said they did and my experience came to mind. I figured a review about it was long overdue. I stopped attending this church chain (aka mega church) immediately after that! I used to brag about my church but never will again. All that money you give, it builds new churches to add to the mega part but it doesn't help the people it should and could. I love the variety of times to attend so no matter what life throws at me, I can still make it to church (even online). The kids programs have been great for my friends and family's kids since I don't have any, and I actually serve in the 2&3 yr old class, so much fun! Come see what we're all about, it's only an hour! I have been hesitant to go because I have a 2 year old that is very loud and outgoing that is also a mommas boy. He hasn’t been babysat by hardly anyone. My 10 year old has been asking to go so today I took them both. We were welcomed and given headphones for the baby, everyone was completely warm and inviting. The music the baby enjoyed, however he started yelling and making lots of noises so I picked up my stuff and hurried out when the sermon began.

I was met outside in the lobby by Gavin, he asked if he could show me the kids church. I told him I didn’t think that my son would willingly go and he said that was okay but we could just try if I was willing. I was SO SO SO very hesitant. He and the ladies in the kids room assured me if he was upset they would call me. I barely was out to my seat before they text me a pic showing me how happy my kid was and that he was fine. It was amazing and wonderful!

I also REALLY appreciate the guys outside. It was pouring rain, and they still look excited and happy to see you!

name: Life150 Church - Burbank Campus

name: LifeBridge Christian Church - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
Just an amazing place, not because of the building, but because of the people who run it. I’m beyond grateful to be so blessed by God and have a welcoming community that makes me feel like family every time I walk in the front doors. Led by an incredibly educated, humble pastor. This is a church that I will never fail to recommend. CHIRCH CAN BE GREAT. DONT LOOK FIR NURTURING OTHER THAN SERVICE. THEY WILL SIT IN A CONFERENCE ROOM AND WATCH YOU STAND NEEDING HELP AT THE FRONT DESK Matt and Tim preach engaging and relatable sermons. Friendly faces and a casual culture feel welcoming. People will be available to pray for you, and the music sounds wonderful. Since recently moving to Longmont, my husband and I decided to visit as part of our search for a regular home church. My mother attended here about 15 years ago, so it felt like a no-brainer to give it a try for ourselves.

One of the first things that concerned us was that there were no Bibles available in the pews. We were told Bibles were available at the information desk, but we were surprised they weren’t readily accessible during service. There were many large screens, so we assumed relevant Scripture would be displayed as it was referenced. We were a little disapointed that these screens seemed to be focused more on getting 5 or 6 perfect camera angles on the church band, and less focus was given to any actual message. To be fair, there were a few quotes (historical and biblical) that were displayed on the bottom 3rd of the screen on occasion. We did not attend for a concert.

The first portion of the service was spent quoting historical figures. We all love a general history lesson, this is not what we attend church to learn about.

The sermon addressed a difficult and divisive topic (abortion) which we acknowledge takes courage to speak on. However, a statistic was presented stating that “43% of women of child-bearing age have had an abortion.” From publicly available data, that figure is significantly higher than most reported estimates (25-30% depending on your source) When addressing sensitive issues, especially to a large and trusting congregation, making sure statistics are accurate is incredibly important. Especially when you are encouraging your flock to spread the word. While the general message was fine, we do not agree with inflating these numbers which seemed to be given as a "shock" factor.

We believe church leadership has a responsibility to handle Scripture and factual information with care. Which does not seem to be a priority here unfortunately. That being said, if youre looking for an entertaining band, polished camera angles, camera men walking around throughout the service, we believe this is the church for you. This is just not what we are looking for. We were very disappointed. The Paster Matt gave a great sermon about Ecclesiastes. Very welcoming and fun people to talk with.

reviewSummary:
This place ran political ads during the 2024 election cycle in direct contradiction to the law. Gross.

Romans 13:1-2 – "Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established… Consequently, whoever rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted."

Uploaded proof even though the owner admitted it.

Churches, if they are tax-exempt under IRS code 501(c)(3), are legally prohibited from endorsing or opposing specific political candidates. This is part of the Johnson Amendment, which has been in place since 1954.

reviewSummary:

She was trying to get people to meet and socialize and spread the word. Nothing wrong with that, however to say to a crowd that if you have no friends you need to get out more was cruel. Jesus said he came for the sick, persecuted, the lonely. Isaiah 41:10, Psalm 68:5–6, Psalm 27:10, Matthew 28:20, Psalm 34:18, Deuteronomy 31:6. Church is for [All People] not just for the popular, rich, educated. I can’t stress this enough because our world is like this only exciting those with these titles. Love should always be first. John 3:16 Jesus did so let’s be the example that Christ is. If you want to hear the truth of the word, this is the church for you. Lifehouse is a place where you have opportunities to serve in multiple capacities, including mission trips to Colombia, where we partner with another four square church and their pastor. The youth program is great with small groups two Sundays a month and Invite Nights on the other two Sundays.

The unmanipulated word of God is taught and is not influenced by what the world says is "acceptable". Being a Christian today is not easy, but the people at Lifehouse, led by Pastor Ryan Coffey, walk alongside you through the process. We love it here! Amazing place to go and pray. They will make you feel very welcome. Everyone is so nice. Pastor Carlos is amazing, great place to go if you don't speak English. They have real-time translation. You won't regret visiting and getting to know them. It was actually very calming.   We appreciated the message and the "no pretenses" atmosphere. Many churches we've been to have a "we're better than you" attitude, but Lighthouse was down to earth, come as you are, we are all welcomed in GOD'S house environment.   We are going to be returning there. Our family felt at home the second we were greeted at the doors.

The worship is always so beautiful and real. There isn't a Sunday where the songs haven't made me cry or have chills. Pastor Ryan Coffey is a great pastor. He's so real, funny and a great teacher. The whole church are so loving and caring to everyone they meet.

We love and find it a really big deal how the Coffey's invite newcomers to their home to get to know the people in the church. Not a lot of pastor’s are willing to know their church family one on one like that. We are very thankful that God led us to this church and to the Coffey's.

- SunShine Smiles \o/ My husband and I stumbled upon their church yard sale. They couldn't have been more lovely and welcoming to us. Genuinely felt comfortable in a church setting, which does not happen too often. Good people. Visited one time a few months ago with my son. Was a great experience for the both of us. This church truly understands what, “love in action” means !” It is such a beautiful thing to see and experience. I look forward to visiting again, soon!

name: LifePath Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: The land where this beautiful church now stands was once used for wildlife habitat. Desert habitat is extremely fragile and displacing wildlife is not good. How many churches do we need? There’s a mega-church (CCV) literally down the street. You want a place to worship and pray, I get it, I am a Christian too, but at what cost? These developments are harming & destroying natural land and habitats. Enough is enough. Pastor Dave and his family are wonderful. He truly cares about people and their relationship with Jesus. He preaches straight out of God's  word! I prayed for along time to find a church where I belong and I finally found it! Come and join us Saturday at 5:30 pm. Hope to see you there! Enjoyed Listening to a guest speaker tonight JJ Powell. He delivered a great message. Everyone at the church were friendly towards others, welcoming and introducing themselfs to new people. Loved how  the preaching was straight from the bible with full context of the passage in the bible. Love my new home church and family! The Lord is working. Small and intimate congregation that experience biblically sound teaching for that strong foundation in Jesus Christ that we need. Thank you LifePath family. Very friendly church. Enjoyed the free event. Everyone was so nice . The assistant Pastor took time to welcome us and talk to us.

name: LifePoint Church - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I did our Church at home for many years, while our children were little. This year, however, we felt a deep calling to begin serving the Lord outside of our home and decided to take a leap of faith and branch out in order to find a church where we felt welcome, and where we felt we could grow in our faith while serving. We were very nervous about this decision and even felt a little uncomfortable putting ourselves out there.

After trying other churches, a neighbor recommended LifePoint to us, and with our first service we knew we had found our new home. From Pastor Phil and the Elders down to each and every member, we were welcomed with open arms. Since day 1 we have been made to feel like a part of this family, and we are so excited to grow in our faith moving forward with LifePoint!

If you are looking for a church with down-to-earth and welcoming people, where you can hear God's true gospel straight from the Bible, this is the spot! Great small family church atmosphere. we love coming here when we visit Greenville. Music is great but not loud. The church has a love for Christ and many out reaches. Pastors are very informed and filled with the Holy Spirit and their messages reflect it. We are so thankful for LifePoint! The staff and volunteers lead with Grace and Truth! The Biblical teaching challenges us to grow in our Faith. This body of believers we have come to know as family welcomed us with open arms - my wife and I, and our children, felt immediately connected and have since come to know Lifepoint as our home Church! When I moved to Greenville I thought it impossible to find a church family and pastor comparable to my previous church. Jesus led me to LifePoint where I found the impossible -- a congregation of thriving folks so beautifully connected and Pastor Phil Pike who is truly a messenger of Our Lord. His sermons take a place deep in my soul and resonate throughout the week … until the next.  I have found my church home and family at LifePoint church.  Thank you, Jesus. LifePoint Church welcomed our family when we visited 3 years ago and we quickly made if our church home.  We quickly saw that LifePoint doesn't just "do church" but the members and church leadership strive to live life together as a group of broken people who praise God for His love and grace and try to share that same love and grace to fellow believers and to all who visit.  Wherever you are on your spiritual journey..... whether as someone searching for answers about God, someone growing in their faith, or a long time believer, I would encourage you to visit LifePoint.  You will experience God's Word being taught and the Gospel being lived out.

name: Lifepoint Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I meet Pastor eva a few weeks ago in ocean beach area. She prayed for me and I was able to pass my exam. She is a blessing and always a pleasure to speak to. 🙏 Great church located near downtown La Mesa. It was recommended to me by a friend when I moved to San Diego a year and a half ago, and I've been attending ever since. Mom has been in town visiting for a few weeks and has also fallen in love with the church. Such a welcoming community. Pastor Tony always delivers excellent scripture based sermons. If you are in search of a caring church family i highly recommend Lifepoint Church! Lifepoint Church is all about the people, community and support. Pastor Tony has a youthful vibe and nurturing spirit. He rally cares about his church (people). I have attended a few churches around San Diego where the pastor never gets your name right let alone have a relationship with all the members. If you are looking for encouragement, inspiration and a great bunch of Christian brothers and sisters this is the place.

Worship is amazing, Pastor Tony always delivers a great message. He is the real deal. Great church, centrally located in La Mesa. Nice people, great pastor, awesome youth program. All around great house of worship. If you live nearby, you're gonna love it. bring your family  and friends,  great place to worship  together ❤️

name: LifePoint Church - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Lifepoint for over 2.5 years. LP is the first church in my entire life where I felt a strong community. I have made so many great connections with people. It has truly been a blessing to my family. My husband and kids also love it and look forward to Sundays.
It's the first place I was able to easily plug in and I've been attending church my entire life of 34 years. It's a Bible based church where we learn verse by verse and really get to dive in deep to Gods word. When I attend I feel like I'm home. I attended the same church for about 12 years actually little over 12 years.. after prayer and consideration of some new things going on there I left.. what I really wanted to find was a place where we were accountable as Christians to walk Christlike with his Holy Spirit to have correction and truth, and love for one another. In the quest to find a new church  family  because I felt like an orphan,  I visited several other churches. I just didn’t see the fit and I remember asking God to please lead me to a place that believed like I did where I could sit under the authority of leadership.  And trust the truth was taught,       I found LifePoint online. Read the statements of faith and prayed about going… I watched online sermons and found the word of God being preached and truth, and the pastors willing to stand up and preach that truth. I found Pastor Josh to be a humble man of God who didn’t hold back teaching God’s Word and also likes to have thoughts and ideas  bounced back-and-forth.. my only complaint is that even though the worship pastor and his wife are very passionate in their leading, the music is often old fashioned and more Baptist than non denominational lol also allot of the musicians and the team don’t really smile or lead with joy.. but  if you love the Lord deeply and know that you must be set apart, if you believe in speaking the truth in love in correction and exhortation and accountability in the body of Christ.. if you want a leadership who doesn’t think too highly of themselves, but know the calling that they have to preach the gospel and take care of the flock.. and love doing so.. .if you are ready to lean and make a difference, then you will enjoy life point and know that you are in safe hands to walk in Jesus and community! This church has been such a blessing! Initially I was worried when I started attending the church, I have differences theologically and worried i wouldn’t be accepted. Quite the opposite we were welcomed here and I knew my boundaries with having theological differences. Best advice I can give is don’t let your theology keep you from community. We need each other, this church and its leaders have strong faith in the Lord. They have a heart after God and that is what I love about this church. If you are looking for a place that seeks God with all their heart, this is the place! At LifePoint church they aim to teach and preach nothing but pure unfiltered gospel. What does the Bible say? Let's unpack it, verse by verse. That's how they do it! Pastor Josh teaches with an expository approach, which is what my husband and I looked for in a church every time we are on the hunt. We are a military family, moving every few years. If that weren't the case, we would have been happy to attend LifePoint forever. It takes time to build any community of friends, but the community we found and built over the course of 3 years at LifePoint was incredible and we will miss it for the rest of our lives.

They are a church that strives to share the true gospel and save the unsaved with nothing more than what God has truly said in His Word. I cannot recommend this church enough. I too discovered LifePoint as a result of a Google search, so if you're reading this I'd strongly encourage you to make your next Sunday a Sunday at LifePoint.

From the moment I first attended, I felt at home. The worship music is Christ centered and the preaching is straight from the Bible. I was able to quickly get connected with one of the assistant pastors and plugged into a life group. The people at LifePoint don't just talk about their mission, they live it.

Church is not a place you go but a people you belong to. I am proud to belong to a people that are fully committed to making disciples and multiplying churches.

name: Lifepoint Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Hello there my name is Colette Whitworth and I have lived in Middletown KY for 2.5 years now. I am from Breckenridge County KY. I am searching for a church to call home, guidance and love. I dream of a better today, because we need not wait for tomorrow, we must start with today. I believe I've been "searching" for true transformation and enlightenment in the wrong place, this place I feel in my heart a calling to. I was a Baptist growing up but I now know and understand that religion is not important at all to our father. I am a very spiritual woman, but I have no religion anymore, just one of the many layers that I have shed throughout my spiritual awakening process. I'm so ready for closeness and a true relationship with my Father, my God. For this is why we are here, also searching for my true purpose in life. I have a great feeling that Life Point will welcome me with open arms. Me and my boyfriend David Watson will be coming to visit very soon! Thankyou very much for a feeling of hope and enlightenment and love already. C you soon family. This is the place that blasted a video stream from the mother church in Virginia, but I was told they only do that about every 6 weeks. I could go back to see the in-person sermon. Problem is, it is too close to SE Christian so the traffic is a problem. I really look forwards to Sundays at Life Point. It's a smaller church with amazing worship and fantastic sermons. They make everyone feel seen and welcome. First timers, and senior citizens. No room to sit, very loud. People standing outside by the doors didn't acknowledge us and move so we could walk past. We just left and realized it was for younger people. We'll try to find a different church. LOVE this church! The worship and teaching are engaging, authentic, and impactful. The community within is like nothing I've ever seen. The environments are beautiful and thoughtful. The Kidspoint classroom's and volunteers are top notch -- my daughter loves being a part. There is a place for everyone here. I would highly recommend Lifepoint Church to anyone I know.
