name: Lifepoint Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Oh what a beautiful service. I enjoyed the word of God that was preached so much.

"Love God, love his word and love one another."
This is just great. And what a friendly, lovely group of Christians. I felt welcomed, comfortable and just blessed I  made the decision to worship with them. Try and visit LifePoint Church when you are in Rocho Cucamonga and you won't regret it. Lifepoint Church is truly a great Word-teaching ministry! The Elders and Assistant Pastors are extremely knowledgeable. The congregation quickly welcome you and soon you feel the love of the Family of God! There are superb ministries for children, women and men’s fellowships and classes which edify and take you closer to understanding and knowing the Word and Will of God and the Lord. This church will bless you as you grow in wisdom of God’s Word. Lifepoint is a verse by verse Bible teaching church. In a world that pulls us in all sorts of direction we need a place to be grounded in God’s love. Lifepoint is  friendly and welcoming others into their family. Always striving to share the love and knowledge that God has called us to share. It’s all about a Jesus and His saving grace 💕 Everyone here is very down to earth, friendly, and inviting.  They make you feel right at home.  The church itself has daycare during service for infants and children.  A church coffee shop has amazing drinks to keep you caffeinated in the early morning. The services put the the lessons of the Bible into easy to understand examples in today's life. Pastor Glen married us in 2000 and his teaching is very easy to understand with his explanations breaking down the big words some of us don't understand. Please come and feel the warmth and love of my church

name: Lifepoint Church RVA Campus
reviewSummary:
Wow! 🤩 As a guest a few years ago, and again these last two weeks, I am so excited to have found LIFEPOINT! I’m in the Richmond area, so glad we have multiple campuses. Our pastors are the reason I came to LIFEPOINT, and as they transition to something new, the Hand of God is definitely guiding it all. Our job is to stay involved, keep learning and growing and working on ourselves, and the pieces will all fall into place! Thank you, @lifepoint, for being so welcoming to newcomers! Come as you are- jeans are fine!- no dress code needed! There is a great website as well as a new app, and the app has all kinds of great info, including the schedules for each campus, and schedules for smaller groups and their activities. Love, health, and wellness! You feel as though you belong there, Very welcoming. Pastor Daniel delivers the word with a sense of humor and  relates it to everyday life. The music is very uplifting. You leave there with a sense of peace The Richmond campus now has 5:00 p.m. service with Pastor Daniel.  Attendance was large and the message fantastic.  Can't wait for next Sunday.
The gathering afterwards was nice.  The kids played with balloons and there were cupcakes 🧁.   YUM 😋 I love this church. I have met so many amazing people through this church. It has also taught me the true perspective of who God truly is. It has changed my life in so many ways! Love the atmosphere and freedom to worship. Everyone is always so welcoming and friendly.

name: LifePointe Christian Church - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended Lifepointe for years before moving away. The biblical teaching is solid, practical, and always points back to God's Word. The people are welcoming, and the church has a genuine heart for serving others. If you're looking for a church that teaches Scripture faithfully and helps you grow in your faith, I highly recommend LifePointe Church. Lifepointe is a place where you can go to church as you are. It's a place where all people are welcome. The Sunday morning worship and the Message are phenomenal. The children's ministry and youth group are amazing!  We often spend time at dinner talking with our kids about what they learned at Lifepointe. All of our children have made some incredible friends. My wife and I have made lifelong friends that continue to positivity influence our lives and supported our family in so many ways. There are so many things outside of Sunday mornings for singles, couples and families to be a part of. My wife and I have been attending LifePointe Christian Church since 2016, and from day one, we felt welcomed. This is a church that truly embraces people as they are while encouraging everyone to grow in their faith.

The atmosphere is warm, and the people are genuine. The messages are biblical, thought-provoking, and relevant to everyday life. Pastor Chris and the leadership team do an incredible job of challenging and encouraging us in our spiritual journey.

The worship music is uplifting, and the children's and youth ministries are fantastic—engaging, fun, and Christ-centered. LifePointe is a healthy, thriving church that is perfect for families, individuals, and anyone looking for a place to belong.

If you're searching for a church to call home, one that will help you grow spiritually and connect with a loving community, I highly encourage you to check out one of the three Sunday services. You can even sign up for a tour to get a feel for what LifePointe is all about.

We love this church, and we think you will too! Me and my 3 year old son came here for the first time. We got great front row parking and walked in excited to try a new church. Right when you walk in, it’s very overwhelming. Kids screaming, running around and everyone talking so loudly over eachother in the small room in the front. Parents weren’t paying attention at all to their kids. I noticed four kids maybe around 12 years old. 3 kids were white and one was African American. The African American kid said to the other kids, “Can you please stop making the racist jokes to me, they’re getting really old.” That made me honestly really sad that parents aren’t paying close enough attention to notice the kids were bullying the other kids. They all just atood in groups as the young teens ran around the place.

I wanted to bring my son to the daycare, i checked in him and we walked upstairs. Kids running up and down the stairs and down the hallways where the childcare was. My son was so overwhelmed he gripped me so tight and didn’t wanna join (even though later we got an email saying it was nice having him in the daycare which was a nice gesture,  but he didn’t go in)

Lastly, before service we walked downstairs and I saw the coffee, I walked over and more kids around 12 were all hanging out around the coffee machines. They offered a variety of syrups and the kids were just pumping all of them into their cups. A mom walked over and started to talk to them laughing saying she told them not to get coffee but it was too late and she didn’t really care, as I stood behind still waiting for my turn she looked at me and continued to talk to them. I asked if I could please get a cup, and they finally moved over and then two gentlemen walked right in front of me again. I felt invisible in this place. The people attending here were completely rude. Between the last of parenting, the bullying (racist jokes being said), the overwhelming feeling of kids running around, the rudeness of the adults that attend here, unfortunately we won’t be back. I want the church we attend to feel comfortable, the people attending to feel welcoming and nice, almost like a family. The two staff members I spoke to were very friendly but because of everything else is the reason for the low review. We joined Lifepointe 2 years ago and from day 1 it felt like home.  Pastor Derek took the time to show me around and made me feel  welcome and valued.  We really enjoy Pastor Chris's sermons and worship.  As parents of 5 with kids ranging at that time from 2 years old through 17 years old it was very important, if not the most important thing, that our kids loved the church as well.  Our kids love their classes and count the days until church each week.  There are many activities for all ages to get involved in which is a huge bonus.  Our family is glad to have found our forever church home.

name: Lifepointe Church - Kettering / South Dayton Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church I'm about to make it my home chuch I enjoy the pastor & the choir very friendly atmosphere always leave feeling uplifted with the word & my grandkids love it also that's a big Plus ❤️ My granddaughter and I visited Lifepointe Church today for the first time.  We enjoyed the lively music and service.  We definitely will attend again. My family and I have been attending Lifepointe church for over 2 years, and we knew immediately that we had found our family in Christ. This is a church full of REAL people with REAL lives, and we have not yet met a person who didn't exhibit the love and mercy of God. Every message is tailored to fit into your real life experience and we have walked away every week encouraged and empowered in Christ to go out and be the light of the world. If you can't say that about your church, come visit us at Lifepointe and EXPERIENCE LIFE.

One of the main reasons we love to worship here is Pastor Jeff Wilson. He delivers every message in such a way that we can all relate, and he does not sit on a pulpit preaching hellfire and brimstone. He teaches the Word of God in love and truth. Not only are his sermons humorous and easy to follow, but he's a real human who experiences the grace of God in the same exact way that the audience does. We love that our pastor walks this life like we do, flaws and all.

Our building is gorgeous, our worship band ROCKS, and our nurseries and youth program have been such an immeasurable blessing to our children. We meet every Sunday morning, a lot of Wednesday nights, and at various small groups throughout the year hosted by members of the congregation. We support multiple community outreach programs, and we don't stop there. Touches of Lifepointe ministry can be found all over the world.

If this sounds like the church you've been searching for, let me be the first to invite you! All souls welcome at Lifepointe. See you Sunday ♥️ They don't seem all that welcoming. I went here a few times and the people seemed a bit rude. My family and I went to visit here today and we were not there very long and the pastor started speaking and there was a child crying and the pastor stopped speaking and asked the usher to escort this family out to the lobby and then asked someone from his congregation to meet them out in their lobby to explain their policies.  How awful, I thought all were welcome in the house of the Lord especially children. The Lord even rebuked His  own disciples for doing something similar to this.

name: LifePointe Church - Sunday Worship Service 9:30am - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife, 3 kids, and I were looking for a loving and Bible-teaching church. We found that at LifePointe Church. Lots of events going on all throughout the week, and a beautiful backyard space with recent renovations.
LifePointe is a great church balancing the line of preaching truth in love while practicing what they preach. God and LifePointe church family, are the only reason I am who I am, and where I am with my life today. Thank you to each and every family member at LifePointe. I love you all I love how this church has people of all ages that gather together. There is much wisdom from the older members and fresh excitement from the young people and families. They encourage one another and recognize that we are all sinners that make mistakes and that Jesus is the only one that saves us. If you want a church family to grow with then this is a wonderful one. There are also many great Bible churches in the community to be a part of, you can’t go wrong. We came to Lifepointe after leaving a home church we had been in for 2 years.  We were seeking a Bible-centered church that offered a dynamic children's ministry and worship but yet still wanted opportunities to fellowship and make connections within a more intimate setting.

Needless to say our prayers for both have been answered.  Our boys thoroughly enjoy their Sunday School classes as do my wife and I.  We have appreciated the genuinely warm, friendly greetings we get every Sunday and enjoy the Lead Pastor's gospel-focused teaching and the abundant opportunities for service both in and out of the church.

If you're "church shopping" in the Fort Collins area put Lifepointe on your list of worship centers to visit. Ive been twice loved it both times an old fashioned family church type vibe

name: LifeSong Church - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary:
It was out side the church in parking lot
Volunteered for salvation team for Mario Murillo tent crusade.Awesome time thousands of souls four Jesus and healing!
Holy Spirit was moving tremendously!
I pray for the whole city of Stockton to find Jesus. Catherine Mullins absolutely a God gifted Holy Spirit filled singer!
God Bless and Stand Jesus Strong! One of my favorite churches and pastors.
The praise team is fantastic and preaching is dynamic.
Great moves of God and the presence of the lord is rich and the people hunger for God.

Always a great time at Life Song I’ve been going to the youth group as well as other events since December, and in such a short time since then I’ve met so many great people as well as made many friends. It’s really been a pleasure attending church here, and not only have gotten closer to god, but I’ve also gotten the strength to heal, to push my past aside and forget about all the trauma.

I truly believe that god lead me here, and for that I am eternally grateful.

Thank you so much LifeSong, not just for how much of an impact you’ve had on me but also for your never ending love and compassion.

Oh, and for all of you reading this:
This is hands down the best church in all of San Joaquin Valley, so I INSIST you go here. Trust me, it’ll be so worth it.

Jesus loves you! 🙏 Absolutely love this church . It is definitely on fire for the Lord. Friendly spirit filled members. My only suggestion is they change the phone system to where when someone calls they can reach a live person or they can leave a message and get a call back.  If you don't have the name and extension for who you are trying to reach you can't just call to speak to someone.  Next, they don't get back to
you when you fill out deliverance packets.  Finally, when they have special speakers etc., they should be a bit more hospitable in accomodating  visitors or guest who travel in from far. In house members save all the seats which leave guest in the overflow watching a big screen. They leave , purses , sweaters ,bibles etc on the seats to save them. I understand guest speakers bring family who need to be accommodated. However they need to consider that It doesn't make visitors feel very welcomed.
Over all this is an awsome church. I love going to visit. It's worth the drive from Richmond.  ☆☆☆☆☆🥰🙏🏼 Praise the Lord I absolutely love lifesong church. I just recently became a member after visiting for a few years, It officially became my church home. I love the pastors the staff and everyone who attends is always so friendly, loving and caring towards one another. They just welcomed me with open arms.

name: Lifesong Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely LOVE Lifesong! I came to this church after moving to Florida from Missouri and Florida was such a shock to me but Lifesong made me feel like I had found family.  No judgement, no whispers behind my back. They just loved me without question. The pastor teaches directly out of the Bible and is led by the Holy spirit. Here you will know God is love. Here you will find everything you need to know that God is real and that he loves you. Here you will know the Holy Spirit and here you will find the love your life needs to make the difference, find that comfort and hope that will change your life forever. Here you can find home and unconditional love. I am a retired transplant to Florida.  I came three years ago, alone.  I wanted a good spirit-filled, Word fed church where I could fit.  Lifesong opened their doors and hearts to me.  I have been attending for two years and one of the pastors said it perfectly to me yesterday when he commented that I served for two services even on my birthday.  I said that I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.  He said "Because it's home."  This is a wonderful church that is fed by the Word and Jesus shows up every time!  With all their hearts they truly do Love Out Loud! Lifesong is an intimate worship community who welcomed us from the moment we walked in. Members of the church "love out loud", consistently looking to connect with Christ and to bless others. As you can imagine, this attitude creates an atmosphere that is quite invigorating. Pastor Svend and his wife, Katy, are an endearing couple who I'm convinced can connect with just about anyone. They are confident, passionate, upbeat, and serve as excellent role models.

If you are looking for a new church family, give Lifesong a shot! This is the best church I have ever been to. I love pastor Svend because his words are so encouraging. He is also an amazing life coach. His wife is also an amazing example of a great Christian female. They accept all to come and worship our father. If you want to have a relationship with Jesus and you want to see him work miracles in your life, this is the church to learn how to do that. God bless you and may you find the Lord. Amen Lifesong Church is such an inviting and welcoming place! They have the best worship and the pastor brings an amazing message that can apply to everyone! They have great childcare and people of all ages who attend! This is the best church in Tampa and I recommend everyone check it out!

name: Lifesong Community Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: January 2021, a divine appointment was set up.  We were invited to visit a church and went to the wrong church, so I though. Needless to say, I have been attending Life Song every since that day.  The love of Jesus is shown from the parking lot to the pulpit. The church is very warm and friendly. You get a welcoming vibe. Message gets to you without sermons that take you to a deep sleep. My hubby and I have been searching for a home church after few months of look we found Lifesong. Service was good, everyone made us feel welcome. Great church community. Members are extremely friendly. Newcomers feel welcome. God bless. Reached out asked few questions been 2weeks no response lol 😂 testing waters

name: LifeSpring Assembly of God - Corona Campus

name: Lifespring Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Only gone once but we're very friendly people and I enjoyed the service I'm so happy to be a part of the church when my grandchildren were younger we would go every Sunday that would be a whole day and they were so happy they would remind me today Sunday now that they're all grown up I've come back to church feels like home again I have attended for a couple of years now.  I especially enjoy the Series concept. It's a welcoming place to worship the Lord.  The staff are wonderful, and the music and fellowship are fantastic.  If you've never been here, everyone is welcome. Come and experience worship here.  God Bless ... Found this church when I first got married and my husband and I were new to the city.  Never left.  It's been a good 20 years since then - many people there seeking to be more like Jesus! Every time I've attended this church I have been made welcome.  The teaching provokes me to think,  the worship lifts my spirit.

name: LifeSpring Church - Norman Campus
reviewSummary: It’s an amazing church everyone one is so nice church starts at 11:00 or if you wake up early there’s a service at 9:00 My grandson goes, love his teacher, and most definitely appreciate that it always smell so good. Absolutely love this place. People need to remember that if you have issues then you need to let the appropriate people know. The pastor doesn’t know what you don’t tell him and can’t correct those issues. I love everyone at this church. Pastor is awesome. His family is awesome. The whole congregation is awesome. It also takes time and an effort on your end to get to know people and make it a great experience. Don’t expect to walk in wearing your bitterness and it be an amazing experience. Trust me it doesn’t work that way. You have to open yourself up otherwise the experience will be awful. It is what you make it. My family and I have been attending this church since moving to Norman 8 years ago. We couldn't have found a better family to share life with. Youth and Children's ministry is awesome and the kid's get to join in a lot of worship. Bring your family and join us - I don't think you will be sorry, and you just may find your new home!! We looked around for a church for our growing family for a long time a couple years ago. We finally stopped at LifeSpring church and knew this church was what fit for our family. Our children LOVE children’s church and the amazing people who love on them and help grow them in God. Pastor Jeff  and his staff are the definition of love and service! We love it and definitely recommend this church!

name: LifeSpring Church of Brookfield
reviewSummary:
Was at this Church for the
First time this morning and Loved it the atmosphere in the sanctuary is Bathed in prayer when you first walk in you feel the anointing and The Holy Spirit before you even enter the sanctuary
Powerful message from Pastor Joe and a sweet presence of Jesus in worship
Will be back again Next Sunday
Felt at Rest and Peace Fresh Living Water is in This House!!!! If you are seeking Jesus and a Spirit-filled church, this is the place to be!!!!
You will feel welcomed and loved, genuinely! That has been my experience and I have been attending the church for almost a year.
I have been to other churches but never to a church like LifeSpring where people truly love you and see you for who you are and accept you for you, just like Jesus does! People here are transparent, vulnerable and loving!! How many can say they have experienced this? I don't believe many!!
This church is unlike any other, and the reason for that is 100%, people here have a strong relationship with Jesus and love the Lord especially ALL of the people in leadership! Their steadfastness and dedication to Jesus and the Word of God is what attributes to the strong presence of JESUS in every service!! It is an experience that I NEVER WANT TO MISS!! Sundays are my favorite day of the week for this same reason, it recharges my battery for the following week.
Here there are people that love you, encourage you, will walk right beside you as you walk and grow with Jesus. To me there is no better place to be than at LifeSpring Church of Brookfield!! Praise God for this church! Glory to God and may God continue to Bless this church in Jesus' Mighty and Holy Name!! Amen & Amen! GOD BLESS YOU!!❤️🙏 Joe the pastor there is not only an excellent shepherd to his flock but also an excellent friend! If you are looking to join a great church congregation , Lifespring is definitely worth a look into! Fantastic service, fantastic people, great message, wonderful!  Appreciate the sense of humor and relating to the contemporary environment we live in. Amazing worship and anointed preaching! Intimate loving church - highly recommended!

name: LifeWater Community Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: The three ladies who are there on Tuesday and Thursday evenings,   are heaven sent.These ladies are always pleasant, they always smile they are very knowledgeable as I have learned from them.They seem like they really enjoy helping people who are down on there luck . besides helping me we always pray before I leave and they give me a hug to:) thank-you Life water for being a blessing for me and my family. May God Bless And Continue to keep you.  LaWauna Grimes Been going now 9 months. Family is best word to describe the church. I am so blessed to be part of this family. Yep this place has it all! Wonderful people and pastor. This church cares! Such an amazing environment! Christ centered church! Been going for years. It's a great church!

name: LifeWay Bible Fellowship - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church great experience and you get to learn something new each sermon. Come out and join us Awesome worship experience!

name: LifeWay Church
reviewSummary: This church looks like a real nice church looks like they really have a good community going on I am sorry for the review that was posted prior it shouldn't have never been posted This church has lovingly lead me closer to Jesus. I’ve gained a deeper understanding of scripture and how much God loves us. I would highly recommended getting connected with Lifeway Church. Such a special group of people who genuinely love and seek Jesus with all their heart. I have grown in so many ways through the love and example of this church and the way God works through them for His glory. I thank God for bringing me to this family in Christ 🙏🏻❤️ LifeWay has been our home church for over 13 years -  God brought us to an amazing, on fire for God church family !  Through tough times, trials of great and small proportions but with the leading of the Holy Spirit through our Pastor Juan Saa we have been so blessed !  His mercies are new every morning and His Hope and Love carry all of us ! So grateful to God and my church family ! A true family committed to building healthy homes that live out an honest and passionate faith in Jesus.

name: Lifeway Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love Lifeway Church. From the moment we stepped inside the church for the very first service the congregation made us feel like we were family.  Always very enjoyable & educational sermons by Pastor Bell & his wife, Michelle.

Yvonne H. I love Lifeway Indy Church because the people are warm & friendly and feel like family to me. I love Pastor Bell & Michelle’s sermons because their teachings are straight from the scriptures.  You can feel the spirit in the church through their teachings & the congregation.  Pastor Bell & Michelle are personable, their sermons are fun but also very truthful & real. I love Lifeway Church! I have been attending for many years and have grown so much in the Lord. Pastor Bell preaches the unadulterated Word of God in a way you can understand and apply it in your life. I love all of the families that make up our church and have made eternal friendships with many of them. If you are looking for a family church, look no more. Lifeway Church is a family church!  Everyone feels like they're a part of the church family and there is something for each member of our family.  If you are looking for a church where God's Word is preached and you can get plugged in, then this is the place to be! If you are looking for a church where you can not only hear the Word of God, but become part of a family of believers that truly care for you. . .this is the place to go! From the moment you walk into the doors you are greeted with love.  Weekly I appreciate hearing the uncompromising Word of God brought forth in such a way that I am not only challenged but compelled to draw closer to God than ever before.
There are classes for every age and stage and each is done with excellence and passion!
If you haven't stopped by and checked out Lifeway Church for yourself.....you are missing out!
Hope to see you there!

name: Lifeway Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: The people were welcoming and the Pastor and first lady are very knowledgeable about the good God almighty gave a great service I will definitely invite others and go again. I was invited by a friend and his wife. I joined after hearing the message from Apostle Chris Esteves and I am blessed to be a member. New to California and the area. Love that the Pastor preach from the Bible and put up notes during service. If your in the Rancho cucamonga area I highly recommend 👌 My husband and have been members since 2008 we now live in Atlanta Georgia since November 2020 we really miss the word from Pastor Chris… we are now currently attending Pleasant Hill Baptist church in Lawrenceville Ga Pastor Chris and Lifeway have been in my life since I was a child. I'm 30 now and love the lord and my life God has provided me

name: Lifeway Church Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I love the worship music, the heartfelt sharing and the friendships that I have developed in this church. I appreciate how the messages often relate to my daily life. Definitely a place where I have the support to grow spiritually. It is an ethnically diverse fellowship with services in English and Spanish. Great local church in Glendale, CA, reaching the community. A real sense of family here! Love watching their services on youtube. Real genuine authentic worship. I recently became moved to the Lifeway Church to serves as a staff member in 2020. Lifeway Church is full of faithful members who are kind, loving and devoted. They wrapped their arms of my husband, children and I from the start. As a parent of young children, I am impressed by their children’s program. They have gone the extra mile to ensure a safe environment for all children to thrive. Teachers are throughly screened and background checked. Classrooms are cleaned and disinfected. The curriculum is A+ and catered to each age group of children. A loving and caring environment. very encouraging and welcoming church members!  Worship Ministry is awesome! I love the Disciple small group meetings, the Park services! Children, Preteens, teens, Millenials, singles,  and marriage Ministries, are very active to help and encourage each other. All ministries interact, living what the Bible teaches. Encourage one another! I love it! A good, Bible-based church. If you're looking for a place to call home that is all about the Gospel, this is a good option for you.

name: Light Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Light Church. Warm, welcoming and friendly group. Benji, the pastor, is really talented and the worship team that leads music is really good. It’s lovely to have a place like this in Encinitas! This is more of a request, my wife Elizabeth and I never been to California, we're from Tulsa, Oklahoma, I read on Wikipedia that Phil Wickham attends there at Light Church and we want to ask him something...
Brother Phil, I wanted to see if you can visit Tulsa sometime, my wife and I would love to see and hear you sing, if you're able it would be really nice if you can visit our church sometime called Real Church on 315 S Sheridan Rd, my pastor is Apostle Scott C Lovett, he's also a great pastor too, he wrote several books, one of them is Jesus In Your Skin and he also wrote several songs, we live stream on Rumble, look for "RealChurchTulsa"... If you're not able to visit our church then can you do like a concert here in Tulsa at the BOK Center or the Mabee Center? We also want a chance to meet you someday if that's also possible please, we love your music, God bless you for doing God's work, we love you brother! I'm very grateful for a humble community like Light to grow closer to God with. Pastor Benji has challenged my faith exponentially. I really enjoy all the open table options. God bless! rating a church is almost an awkward thing in-itself to rate. since all church's should in theory be doing the work of  God, The God of Love Peace and Mercy, and therefore should all have 5 star ratings. yet in my experience of attending different churches, I have realized there are places of worship that truly connect, preach and live in the humble loving way of Jesus Christ. The Light Church is one of the brightest Lighthouses of Jesus I have ever come across. The Music, community, and Preacher Benji has a gift from God of speaking the word and allowing space for Jesus to connect. Amazing Godly church. Completely heart driven and full of the Holy Spirit. It’s home!

name: Light Church Downtown - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church truly feels like family. The leadership is upstanding, thoughtful, and leads with integrity. The community is welcoming and supportive, and the genuine love shared here is evident from the moment you walk in. The messages are meaningful and uplifting, and there are numerous weekly opportunities to get plugged in, grow, and build lasting relationships. I’m incredibly grateful to be part of such a phenomenal church community. My experiences at Light church (San Diego) and it’s “PAY FOR PRAY” business model is feeding themselves from the naive young adults who seek prayer.
They will say they will “help pray for you” and ONLY if the price is right. Prayer from the beanie wearing pastor and his sidekick is like ordering a prayer from their brunch menu where if you buy 2 prayers for $200 and get a free side blessing.
They do not help those in search of Jesus, but claim to be like him and charge you with a bill from any “prayer-time” with you.
This is a profit style business model and not a church!
They feed off those searching for hope and will charge you for every prayer and cash in on any tax write off available including family members.
Pray for them because they need it and DO NOT ATTEND this PAY-for-PRAY organization. A lovely place to be. My coworker recommended this congregation to me and since I haven't attended any churches in awhile I decided to take a chance, and I'm so glad I did. What I love the most is the simplicity, the warm and welcoming people, the sense of community, and the love of the Word. The people I have met so far have really opened their homes and hearts. I look forward to attending more often. Just went for the 2nd time and love it. Really feels like our home church. Love the small atmosphere as it feels like a family. The singing is great and the pastor is AMAZING!! cried during service both time we went...God has truly blessed this man. younger crowd but a great place to be part of the down town , little Italy family.

name: Light of Christ Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church family - everyone is welcoming and truly cares about each other.  Excellent Pastor who teaches The Word.  You leave every Sunday feeling spiritually refreshed. My husband and I started attending with our adult kids and our grandkids in February 2022. Our grandkids both attended/attend preschool there as well. We love the preaching, the weekly bible studies for both men and women (a great way to get to know folks), worship and the welcoming atmosphere. There are many ways to serve those in need ...orphans, widows, the elderly, the homeless and hungry, and more. I love being a part of a church family where we get to love and serve like Jesus. Love this church! The Sunday sermons, daily devotionals,  and weekly bible studies help me to get closer to Jesus everyday.   Praise the Lord! This is a celebratory church that’s awesome for anyone who doesn’t like church. It’s very approachable with friendly members and an exuberant Pastor who keeps our focus on Christ. We absolutely love this place and all the people who are part of the church family!  We miss all of you!  Love y'all!

reviewSummary: They support stuff that is considered a sim in the Bible multiple times. The only reason I’ll give it a one star is because it’s modern and kind community but it’s not really good. If you don’t believe in God much and love hanging out this is prefect for you. Not even trying to be mean here. So far so good. We like the children's programs but my youngest is a little bored because there isn't enough movement for my 6 year old lightning racer. The service is direct and easily understood. The pastor uses real life to keep us engaged. Our first time here and we were happy. My granddaughter, Tarli, has attended the Easter Egg Hunts for 3 years.  She thoroughly enjoys them. name: Light of Life Church
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a church which is all about preaching the true Word of God from the Bible, and taking care of the community, this is it. Congregation is culturally and generationally diverse but definitely all close as family. You can be real, ask questions, and get involved. Pastors will make time to speak to you personally. You will be seen, heard, appreciated, supported and prayed over. This is definitely a church that shows the love of God in words and in deed. All are welcome. Best church ever, since day 1 it’s felt like I’m fellowshipping with true family. This church is a hidden gem, and I’m just so thankful I found it when I did! The leaders are so selfless, and the community is SO supportive, uplifting, and involved. The people in here really care about others, and genuinely want to see God move!! The preaching is extremely sound, the word of God is proclaimed each and every service. I love this church!! This Church is absolutely amazing! Do not be interested by our size because it is growing everyday! It is one of the most diverse churches I have ever been to. I just walked in and knew this was the place to be. It is beautiful seeing how God transforms people's lives in person and feel like I am truly part of a community, another family! Glad we found this church! We were looking for a like-minded bible church while visiting the area and only found this one. We were greeted by a friendly community, beautiful worship music and an encouraging message! Thank you for being hospitable Light of Life church. God bless your ministry! Pastor Gus Miragias's sermons are AMAZING! Wish he would preach more often. Worship team is the BEST.

name: Light of the World Christian Tabernacle International - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A Church That Truly Shines

I’ve been attending Light of the World since 2023, and I can confidently say it’s one of the most welcoming, spiritually grounded churches I’ve ever experienced. We are a Bible-believing church that teaches the love of God with sincerity and clarity. Worship is done in excellence—every service feels intentional, uplifting, and full of reverence.

Under the new leadership of Pastor O, the church has grown in warmth and vision. He genuinely cares for people and treats children with the same respect, kindness, and attentiveness he shows his own family. His heart for the community is evident in everything he does. Archbishop Ruth continues to oversee with grace and wisdom, and her presence is a true blessing.

The Youth Ministry is thriving—growing rapidly in numbers and depth. I’ve seen firsthand how our children and teens are learning about their faith, worshipping authentically, and being nurtured in a safe, loving environment. Let me be clear: there is absolutely no abuse taking place on our campus. As someone who’s deeply involved, I can promise you that our children are protected, valued, and uplifted.

Light of the World is an excellent place of worship, but don’t just take my word for it—come and see for yourself. Come into the Light at 5883 GA-155 N, Stockbridge, GA 30281. You’ll be glad you did. This is a 5 star church! The members was so welcoming and showed great hospitality. The pastor and his lovely wife were very nice. If you don't have a church home, this would be a great place to consider. My family and I joined this church 11 months ago. You can feel the love that is spread throughout the church. The pastor is awesome. Preaching the truth and feeding the sole. My children loves it here and is greeted with love and respect. They are a part of the youth ministry and cannot wait to get to church. I have found this church home in which I have been praying for. If you are seeking a place to worship come by. Saw videos of this church's leaders blatantly abusing a special needs child by restraining him. This is not the way Jesus treats kids, and leaders like this have no business in a church if they do not have tenderness needed for special needs kids!!!!! I am reading all these posts about how wonderful this church is, yet it is pretty clear that it is all for show if you tie up a 5 year old austic child to a chair!
My church has a special needs care for our kids with trained professionals who are able to handle our special needs kids. Thank You All for Your Generosity this Christmas Season ❤️🙏🙌

name: Light of the World Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Light of the World Church is exactly what I’ve been looking for in a church. The teaching is deeply rooted in the Bible—clear, straightforward, and always centered on truth rather than trends. Every message points you back to Scripture and challenges you to grow in your faith in a real, practical way.

Pastor Greg does a great job of teaching in a way that’s both understandable and impactful. You can tell his focus is on staying faithful to God’s Word, not just delivering a feel-good message.

On top of that, the atmosphere is genuinely welcoming. From the moment you walk in, people make you feel comfortable and included—like you belong there, no matter where you’re coming from.

If you’re looking for a church that’s Bible-based, authentic, and filled with kind, welcoming people, Light of the World Church is a great place to be I cannot say enough amazing things about Light of the World! I’ve had the absolute privilege of two of my children attending, and I am BEYOND grateful for this place.

From the moment you walk in, you feel the intentionality and care. Safety is clearly a top priority, which gives me such peace as a parent. But what truly sets them apart is the way they genuinely love and invest in each child. They don’t just “watch” your kids — they nurture them, pour into them, and partner with you in their growth.

My children are not only learning letters, numbers, colors, shapes, and so much more — they are learning about the Bible and the Fruit of the Spirit in a way that is woven into their everyday experiences. They are being shaped academically and spiritually at the same time, and that is priceless.

Light of the World is a blessing to our family, and I truly cannot recommend this school enough. 💛 Would very much caution sending your children to this church’s affiliated preschool program - they put my family through extreme anxiety and totally mishandled a situation with my 2 year old son with no remorse or actions to make it right. They insinuated my son had a severe behavior disorder and suggested on multiple occasions that I go get him tested - which is wildly inappropriate, especially at his young age.  They will avoid, deflect and never take responsibility. The expectations they have for a young toddler who was having his first experience in “school” were completely outrageous. Instead of trying to help they were more interested in blaming him as the problem and getting him to leave the program.

To make matters worse, when we reached out to the head pastor of this church, he has totally IGNORED our attempt at communication.

Shameful and disgusting behavior from a Christian organization.

UPDATE
After speaking privately with you Greg, in which you were dismissive and curt to me and my husband, I think it would be amiss not to take my time to update my review. I would have been ready to remove it all together, yet a genuine apology or effort to understand our side was not made.

Since you chose to reply to my initial review without having heard our story at all, in an attempt to discredit me to others reading this review, I will now clarify a couple points.

“Accommodations” to his schedule included switching the days he attended very early on, to a smaller class size. I also chose to pick him up early as he was not napping there. These changes are hardly burdensome and in fact were positive for everyone involved.

The refunds were requested by us and not given out of the kindness of your own hearts. We would not attend an entire semester, so yes the usual non refundable supply fee was refunded to us for the remaining year, to which we are grateful.

I am also grateful your director prayed for me. This occurred after she told me she believed my son needed special evaluating, and I became emotional. The majority of the problems occurred after this.

I did my due diligence and had him tested over winter break, to which he came back developmentally typical, and I shared this with the staff. Yet no real meeting was requested with us, no real action plan was discussed or put into writing. After only attending several days after break, negative notes were being sent home every day and your director was informing us they did not have the resources/staffing model to support him, and that she believed he needed a specialized program.

It was clear we were being pushed out.

The bottom line is what happened was completely inappropriate, very confusing, and ultimately really hurtful to our family.

After waiting days for a response from you and finally messaging you to tell you we look forward to hearing from you, we were ultimately dismissed again.

It is also interesting to note that after I left my review, staff at your church / school (of whom I know a few personally) was asked to leave positive reviews on google so as to push mine down and cover it up. I have been coming to LOTW for many years now. I attend service, I have participated in a mission trip, and have even gotten to know Pastor Greg and others who participate with this Church well. LOTW is truly one of a kind, and I’ll tell you why. Pastor Greg does not just read from the Bible to tell a message, but rather he speaks on a message in a way that either we can relate to, or even pertains to our own lives. I truly believe God speaks through Pastor Greg with every sermon he gives. Pastor Greg also has a podcast in which he speaks more on questions and concerns he feels are needing to be addressed to help today’s society. We all know we live in a crazy world, but Pastor Greg communicates God’s words through love and truly wants what is best for not just me or you, but us all. If you have never come to a service, I highly encourage you do so for you to experience the music, love, acceptance, culture, and hear the words of who I feel is one of the best, most honest and most humble Pastors there is. Our family is Catholic, yet over the years the Catholic faith has left its own teachings and has gone woke.   This church still follows scripture, the members are friendly, the choir is great, and the sermons always hit a chord within me.

name: Lighthouse Baptist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church, this church is my home. I grew up here. Pastor Greenwood was the first pastor I ever believed in.

name: Lighthouse Baptist Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church. Visited on business trip from Florida. Friendly congregation , great music and Bible sermon. Visited this church with my family a little while ago. I’ve been to two other churches in the area. Lighthouse would be my church home if I lived in the Las Vegas area. Good spirit, people were nice and the pastor’s preaching was tremendous. The pastor took us on a tour of the building after the church service. I will visit this church again when my wife and I are in the area on a vacation. This is a 5-star church.

I have some old friends in the area. I wish they would go to this church and serve the Lord there, but instead they go to a place that used to be like this church and became one of those nightclub-type places. My family and I visited this church while we were on vacation. I'm glad that this church preaches the Truth, uses the KJV, and has a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The pastor preached an excellent message on the Sunday morning we visited. I love this church! We felt very welcome from our first visit!  King James Bible, wonderful hymns, solid Bible preaching!  It’s exactly what we were looking for. Love this church!  The Word is spoken here. People are welcoming and Pastor teaches you how to live in the world w/faith.  Come by on Sundays @ 11am

name: Lighthouse Baptist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church, this church is my home. I grew up here. Pastor Greenwood was the first pastor I ever believed in.

name: Lighthouse Bible Church Orange County - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: It’s been a while since we’ve found a church to call our true home. The teaching here is a wonderful balance between truth and grace — not too legalistic and not too loose. The congregation feels like and is family to us. Outstanding in every way

name: Lighthouse Bible Church San Diego - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Wooooow! I was at the right place at the right time! Visiting San Diego, I found the church on google. Their head pastor, Patrick, was phenomenal. Jaw dropping with a DEEP bible study on Gen 34, Dinah's rape, titled "violence & vengeance". Paired with mention & prayer of Charlie Kirk's assassination 4 days ago and our mission as Christians. Thank you a well thought out, researched, well constructed sermon, expertly communicated, and connecting it to our reality today with heart. I appreciate being your guest. ❤️

P.S. Thank you for your website providing the change of address, so I didn't get lost. Services are 9 & 11am at University City High School. I visited with my sister, who is a member, yesterday.  Worship is focused on the Lord and the Bible is preached with clarity. Thank you Pastor Patrick for staying true to the Word of God! Truly, Christian fellowship at It’s best I attended Lighthouse Bible Church for six years. I'm so thankful for the leaders and the members for constantly holding fast to the truth of the gospel!

At the end of the six years, it was hard to leave the church. (I moved away to begin graduate school.) I definitely miss the teaching, fellowship, common heart for evangelism. I still look back with thankfulness and joy. Praise God for an awesome 6 years. I wouldn't have it any other way. I came to Lighthouse as an unbelieving college freshman who doubted God’s existence and dreaded going to church. Through listening to the Bible-focused Sunday sermons and interacting with other believers who truly love God and live for God, I learned what it means to be a follower of Christ, our Lord and Savior. Praise God for graciously saving me from my sins and transforming my unbelieving heart : )

name: Lighthouse Christian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I would be a member if I didn't live so far away in San Diego, CA.  They have a new pastor; however, the ambiance was the same with the previous pastor!  My niece and her husband are members of this wonderful church.  The people are serious about God's Truth, Love, and Righteousness so much so that you feel it on the grounds as well as in the sanctuary!
There is a vibrant youth group for middle school, high school and college levels.  They are serious about a focus on core Christian principles with a fellowship that gives them a family-like experience that is quite contagious and inspirational to all ages!
I highly-recommend the group of believers for singles, married, widows, and widower!  ✝️❣️💯🔥✔️😁

✔️🔥💯❣️✝️😁 I was at this church for awhile I left and came back. The people here are great. I feel as if the people are like a family here. They have a strong relationship with the Lord which you can see by meeting them. There are a few things though that make me want to find a different church. The worship team sounds "dead." I feel that this church only accommodates people who are elderly 1st and second service. They are set in the old fashion way of things. Their motto is to spread the gospel and make God known..which is awesome! I feel as if they are unwilling to do this though. Part of it seems as if they are not in the present time of accommodating a younger crowd. Perhaps they are not sure how to or they don't want to change. The atmosphere makes me want to fall asleep whether they are singing or speaking. I don't want to sound harsh but this is the simple truth. I was once a part of the children's ministry and it was the same way. I wanted to make it more fun and exciting for the younger crowd and they didn't want that. It was this is the way we wanted it ...but it was dull and boring!They need people for children's ministry but they are not willing to change and I'm not talking about God's word. The rooms in the children's ministry...elementary ages and up seem dull. I guess what I'm saying is that I want to grow and be a part of this church because the people are great and God is awesome but the leaders prevent you from doing this. It's sad😔. I love the traditional service with the choir. The pianists are so great and I love the special music by various artists. The Bible Studies are great with dedicated leaders. Its a church that fulfills its mission to know God and make Him known. The Pastor has great sermons every week and people are warm and inclusive. Come visit! We'd love to have you in Gods family. The best!! So inspirational from staff to congregation! You feel welcome from the time you walk up to the church. They have two services, traditional and contemporary. I enjoy the second service,  contemporary, and the praise and worship leader, Basilio is high energy which is so refreshing, even ending a few services here and there with music that gets us up in celebration! Donuts and coffee between first and second service and after second service. Great fellowship, programs,and Bible studies at church and in surrounding community. Attended a memorial here. It was lovely.  Facility is clean and church is comfortable. Seems like a lovely place to worship. I know some of the people that attend. They're faith is attractive.  This tells me this church teaches the word. If I wasn't already in a church close to home that teaches the Bible well, I'd try this church out.

name: Lighthouse Christian Church - Novato Campus
reviewSummary: God's authentic TRUTH preached in an atmosphere of love!  Today was my first time at Lighthouse Church and I came not knowing what to expect.  I was so pleasantly surprised by the experience.  Down to earth, non-judgemental people genuinely interested in following our Lord Jesus!  The pastor Jerry preaches a clean, biblically correct sermon with authentic examples on how to follow God's Word today :-) I’m not a church or a religious person due to negative experiences in my past; however this group of people have been welcoming,  open and very helpful in many ways to my both of my children and myself. Lovely group of people who are down to earth and not pushy by any means.  ❤️ A very loving Church that is devoted to preaching the Word of God and sharing the love and light of Jesus Christ with our community.  I cherish the fellowship, the hospitality and the opportunities to serve Christ together Awesome church! Starting attending here in April and has been a blessing for me and my family thank you pastor jerry pat and Julian! Awesome worsbip, great preaching. A congregation where the love of God is shared.

name: Lighthouse Christian Church North Bay Santa Rosa - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church! #1, I have a personal experience with the living God and they preach the truth, the gospel of Jesus Christ and the power of His Resurrection life! Wow. Great music, powerful message and a fun children's program. It is so hard to find all of this in one place and this is that! This is a Spirit Lead Church!! God comes and fills the room, worship is more than 20 mins, and by half way people are already at the altar, service hasn’t even started 😭🙌🏼  miracles happen! They take you in as family and loooord when all the lighthouse churches gather wowowow can’t wait to worship with my family in heaven 🙏🙌🏼🎚️ praise the LORD! Amazing church full of people that are walking with Jesus In loving everyone just as he did, healing the broken hearted, reaching the lost and sharing the gospel to a world hungry for hope and salvation. Amazing people and church. They’ve recently renovated it completely. So cool to hear the testimonies that come out of this place. God's doing big things here at Lighthouse Church! Holy Spirit is moving.

name: Lighthouse Christian Fellowship Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
You can  feel the anointing as soon as you  step  inside. The word, praise,and
worship  was on fire ! Apostle Mike ,and
1st lady Tara Wicker ,and the entire  congregation is welcoming,and  loving. I promised myself that I would go back as soon as I'm  able  ‼️ Lighthouse saved and changed the very course of my Life. Apostle Mike and Prophetess Tara along with the rest of Leadership are people who can help get you on the right path . Awesome experience, excellent atmosphere, service is truly memorable and can't miss. Great worship, word, and atmosphere. Wonderful place to go when I don't attend my regular place of worship For most I thank God for them
I met Pastor Mike in 2012
It was thru the vessel in the Man of the Lord Bro Jabar
Bro Jabar talked to me about Hour of Power to a school church on North Blvd
There was the one who does the will
There are those who don't
Pastor Mike is the one who does it
I felt it
Everything that you learned from the Bible can challenge your thoughts when you see that some talk about it but they do the opposite
I was misled like that with a trust but it was not real
I saw that he does what the Bible says
I have to say that if you just try you will be able to see why I go
For many CALLED but few are CHOSEN
Called is your everyday church members who do or don't do the will of God
Chosen is your T.D. JAKE'S, CREFLO DOLLAR , JOEL OSTEEN, BENNY HINN
PASTOR MIKE IS NOW APPROACHING THAT AS HE IS A CHOSEN ONE
Thanks for everything Pastor Mike I love this church it's my favorite place to be. When you come everyone welcomes you with open arms and there is always love there. If I could I would stay all day everyday.

name: Lighthouse Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Everyone is friendly and welcoming, willing to answer your questions and accommodate you as best as possible. The sermons are always relatable and backed up by scripture. They offer free refreshments after service and if you’re a newcomer, you get a free Starbucks gift card. Free stuff aside, this church feels like home, and knowing that all the pastors are genuinely good people makes it that much better to worship alongside them. Second time attending, everyone is very welcoming, non judgmental.  You can feel God's presence in the worship. The sole purpose of the preaching is God.
 I was raised in a pentecostal church, where they raised me to be afraid and forbid me to do most things. Where everything was the devil.....
So lighthouse church is a nice breath of fresh air where they tell you about God. Service was wonderful I kids really understand the preaching and free refreshments after the service also if your new they give you a 5$ Starbucks gift card This church has a food pantry every Thursday starting at 2:30pm. Very nice people and very helpful. I love Lighthouse Church!! From the moment you drive in the parking area there are beautiful friendly people greeting you. Pastor Sam will greet you in the main lobby .The worship is amazing. Everyone is friendly. And the music hits your soul !!
Thank you Pastor Sam!!!

name: Lighthouse Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary: If you’re travelling and visiting, I’d highly recommend. Came with the wife and we didn’t know what to expect, but we came out grateful and glad! It is very hard to find a place in South Beach where people worship the Lord with their heart, soul and mind...But do not lose hope...This church did not disappoint.... A young team in the worship, but with a lot of experience... Even during the service , people in need were helped with food etc...It's not the quantity but quality with this church... Lighthouse Church is a beautiful place to worship as it provides the opportunity to feel closer to God. Everybody is very kind and welcoming. I would recommend visiting when you are searching for a community of believers who regularly come together to express their faith. The church was an intimite setting with few faithfull members, yet to find a perminent residence for their worship service which runs during Sunday morning 11:00am and is in need of members to visit and attend morning service. Show your support and if in the area, bring an open mind. Great people! Music, coffee and encouragement from God's Word.

name: Lighthouse Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Five stars for Lighthouse Church. From the moment we walked in, everyone was genuinely friendly and welcoming. As a full-time RV family, we visit a lot of churches across the country, and feeling immediately at home is important for us. This one delivered.

Worship was moving and on point - heartfelt, engaging, and centered where it should be. The pastor was passionate and relatable, sharing truth in a way that felt both grounded and practical for real life.

Our kids loved the kids area, which is always a huge win for us. When the kids are excited to go back, you know you’ve found something special.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll be welcomed right away and hear solid, passionate preaching, Lighthouse Church is absolutely worth a visit. The picture below is some quotes I took from the so called “pastor” The whole service was about what you bring to the church and zero information about the gospel. I have never felt so terrible leaving a church service. Although I’m young I have been lucky enough to grow up in church but seeing all the young people at this church that might not have had that opportunity makes me sick to think they hear  that every Sunday. The fact he mentioned his bad emails that he receives says enough for me. In leadership you can’t make everyone happy but I have a feeling his negative emails are a little different. I don’t even want to call him a pastor but the pastor has put himself on such I high pedestal I hate to see the crash he has when he crumbles from the unrealistic pressure he puts on himself and others. Man you talk about a place where the Spirit is, and the Pastor always allows GOD to use him as a tool. As he always says "Let me fade to the back and you take center stage because I can't save them only you can GOD". You will feel so welcome here from the time you walk in, to the time you are getting to your car. Oh and Praise & Worship there WOW that's all I can say is WOW. Such a wonderful church. Just like me if you attend once , I promise you will attend again becoming a part of the church family. Truly blessed to have found my church home an family. I love this place so much I have never felt at home or so happy in a church since I was little. Especially one that doesn't judge that doesn't complain that is an incredible place to be especially when your going threw your own head when I come there on Monday nights I can't wait for Monday to roll around because Im able to dance and sing and go to the front of the stage and just let out all of my tears! This is a place to come to sit and make friends to learn about christ and enjoy your time!

name: Lighthouse Church Atlanta - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary:
Lighthouse church feels like a family, cosy, warm and supportive for me and my kids! We feel loved, accepted and needed in there. Very important for us as immigrants. Their mission of leading people Into intimate and growing relationship with Jesus Christ couldn’t be more simple and their results more effective , by their sincerity , personal example and devotion , openness, friendliness and commitment to Christ and His teachings. Steady consistent people here. Always there to count on.
Great sermons. And classes.  Can feel they are eager to grow in the lord! Wonderful church! Everyone feel welcomed here. This is family of God who loves  to serve to Jesus Christ! Very friendly church for the whole family :)

name: Lighthouse Church of Chicago
reviewSummary:
“We are a predominately African American LGBT-inclusive church that welcomes all people. That’s right – we welcome people of all sexual orientations, gender identities, races, ethnicities and class – not in spite of the gospel but because of the gospel.”

I love this church for so many reasons. As a member, I’ve seen these values lived out through a deep commitment to learning the Bible with attention to history, context, and justice-centered lenses like womanist, queer, and Black liberation theology, as well as mental health. That commitment shapes the kind of community being built here.

Lighthouse is truly a gem—not just in Chicago, but beyond. We are led by phenomenal pastors, supported by an amazing praise team and musicians, and grounded in a spirit-filled worship space where people can show up fully and authentically. I’m grateful to be part of this community and hope more people know that faith, love of God, and justice can be embraced together. Lighthouse is a shining example. A wonderful wonderful experience and an eye-opener to a different community in Chicago, me and my sister was visiting and needed a place to worship never knew we would end up here, it was a blessing in disguise the pastor was wonderful the service was wonderful the congregation is wonderful. May God always continue to cover all his people thank you for a wonderful experience. Lighthouse has been the best experience of church I have ever had.  The church community is  warm, welcoming and inclusive, the pastor is brilliant, the music is outstanding.  And it is a blast to be  part of such a young and vibrant church in Chicago. An amazing faith community which reminds us each and every week that we are all beloved. If you want a great community, music which will get you up out of your seat dancing, amazing messages, and an overall wonderful experience check out Lighthouse Church of Chicago. Welcome Home. Such an enjoyable service and uplifting sermon. Pastor J always deliver a sermon that helps positively set the tone for my week ahead. I am grateful for my church family at Lighthouse.

name: Lighthouse Community Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: I love the family atmosphere and the program's for kids.  This church believes in the teaching of the scriptures and follows God word in their preaching... Wonderful church  pastor Eric is awesome  the community  is beautiful  and loving. This is exactly the church I've prayed for. The Pastor's teach great messages on how to apply the Bible to our everyday lives,. They have beautiful worship and wonderful caring people. I've been at the church for about a year now and I love it. The people are super friendly and the messages are great too. (There are also free doughnuts on Sunday😁) This is a wonderful neighborhood church! Very friendly and welcoming. They have a wonderful highschool group with dedicated leaders. I highly recommend Lighthouse Community Church💛💛

name: Lighthouse Community Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I was asked to leave, because I didn’t want to wear a mask. I think it explains everything.

"And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with waves; but he was asleep. And his disciples came to him, and woke him, saying, "Lord, save us: we perish." And he said to them, "Why are you fearful, O you of little faith ?"

- Matthew 8:24-26 Always enjoying being here at lighthouse! Fantastic community with solid Biblical teaching. Services are on Sundays 9am, 11am, 5pm. They offer child care and a lot of small groups for continued growth. very welcoming for the first time visitors and the sermon is easy to understand and you can learn the bible here. I've been there 3 weeks and they are preaching thru the Bible, they have tons of ministries to plug in to, and are very warm and welcoming. I'm glad to be here.
