name: Lighthouse Landmark Missionary Baptist Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: If you’re looking for a small church with great community, genuine worship and relevant Bible teaching and preaching, give Lighthouse a shot! This is a scriptural New Testament Church that focuses in preaching the word of God, it has been doing it for more than 90 years in this community of La Habra. I visited this church once, and I stayed. This is a truly lighthouse for La Habra and surrounding area. Great place to worship and learn about God’s word. whenever you walk in, it feels just like home! If you are looking for a church to go to and hear the True Word of God make your way to Lighthouse Landmark Missionary Baptist Church in La Habra. You will be welcome with open arms....

name: Lighthouse of the Valley - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary: Service was AMAZING it was a convacation held there and God presence was in the place This is an Awesome Church. If you are looking for a church to attend, visit Lighthouse of the Valley and you will be truly blessed by God's wonderful people 🙏 End of the year Volunteers banquet “Chef James” cooking it up!!!! I highly recommend Lighthouse of the valley. As a young man facing suspected Fibromyalgia, this church and the people in it are the most outstanding people around. They are in the middle of saving my life, literally. If you need to SPEAK with someone, this church is your support. I can't say enough good things about this safe haven. Been going for just about a month and I'm so very happy I got a new church and a new family of brothers and sisters that believe the best is yet to come. Check it out! (You won't be disappointed!) The power of God flows regularly here. I absolutely love the diversity. It's not a black church, white church, it's a people church, with great teaching, great worship music and anointed pastoral leadership. Come, experience Real Hope.

name: LIIV HQ - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary:
DANGER!! DANGER!! This is not a church, this is a life coaching program to help you feel better about yourself. Jesus is not the head of this “church”, you are. The center of the messages are not the word, the center is whatever the pastor decides the collection of talks is. They will not teach you the true word of God and the severity of the Gospel. But they will tell you how to feel better about yourself. Think I’m crazy? Go watch their “Welcome to our YouTube Channel” video. I encourage you to have discernment when it comes to finding a church. We need to be serious about the spread of the Gospel, and this organization will not push you to do that. If you have got this far test it for yourself. I would tell you to find a church where the pastor actually teaches the word line by line verse by verse book by book. Not a church where they are playing movies in service to give you some heart felt experience that has little to do with the word. Praying for whoever finds this. This up-and-coming church in the Brookhaven area is a really nice addition to the neighborhood. They are conveniently located and have amazing staff and volunteers assisting with their service experiences. Their pastors are also very chill and their socials leaves you wanting more. They're doing a great thing in the community and have already garnered a lot of influences with both believers and non-believers alike. We were visiting because we were in Atlanta for the weekend. Pastor Mayo Sowell is amazing.  He has an incredible heart for God and for people. Those attending were very welcoming and went out of their way to make us feel at home. Definitely the place to be if you need an encounter with God, the pastors are teaching the true word of God. If you’re receptive, your spirit man will be fed. Service starts with praise and worship as the Holy Spirit moves through the congregation, preparing the hearts of those who are surrendered. I never leave the same way I came. I visited this church with my family hoping for a peaceful and spiritually grounded environment. Instead, we were met with disorganization, loud performance energy, and a lack of basic hospitality.

I am visibly pregnant and arrived with my child and husband. Not one volunteer greeted or guided us. We waited outside the children’s area without acknowledgment, and had to initiate our own request for direction. The energy in the building felt chaotic — not joyful or reverent, but performative and unsettling.

At one point, while speaking to someone, multiple people interrupted our conversation without so much as an ‘excuse me’ — and the person I was speaking to said nothing. The environment didn’t feel spiritually safe or sacred.

To make matters worse, someone quietly disrespected my husband, and he chose not to confront it. That moment finalized the truth for me: this wasn’t a place rooted in honor. It provoked an argument and I collapsed because how emotionally dangerous. It was emotionally noisy, spiritually shallow, and more concerned with spectacle than presence.

name: Lilburn Christian Church - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary: Today my son and I attended church service as well as Sunday school let me tell you, we absolutely loved it. Pastor Peter and his wife are beyond amazing, when I tell you you feel the love walking in the overwhelming feeling of joy, live music playing there's no painted windows with Darkness everything is open with light just shining through you're able to be apart and participate with everything the projections share everything that's going on every word to the songs every scripture to discernment. The whole congregation was so welcoming and loving as if they're known you forever. I absolutely enjoyed it they have a very structure children's area and children Church. We will be attending again. If you want to go word feel the love enjoy praise and worship with some good folks please attend this church Never had a church family and pastor who were so genuine interested and concerned in mine and my family's life from DAY ONE. They knew our names almost immediately, and the pastor always sends note cards checking in and praying for me when I've been having a hard time or haven't been able to come. Some of them took cookies to my mom when she first visited. As someone who generally dislikes organized religion, they are SINCERE and beautiful people. Wonderful church. Absolutely amazing church!! Not too big, but not too small. Love my new family here! Good family, great bible teaching, music and worship. Great people, good music, good preaching, good Sunday School Classes

name: Limitless Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been following Real Talk Kim on and off online for years from her Mohawk and tutu days. I haven’t officially been in a church in years. My sister-friend invited me and god led me to go. Scared, shaky & hesitant I entered the building. My life has been enhanced since then. The anointing on Pastor Kim’s life has up leveled me and has me walking even more in my god given anointing. If you want community, nourishment in god, fun, laughter and a church home, you can find that at Limitless. We visited today for the first time! We WILL be coming back! This is an absolute experience! U lost? U will leave here feeling god’s spirit and rejuvenated! Everyone is very welcoming! And Kim is a blessing! Thankful to have been able to make this journey! I found PK on Tik Tok, and I didn't know she was here in GA.  I was so excited to find that Limitless was only a 20 minute drive for me.
I went to my first live sermon this past Sunday, and felt like I belonged there.  Their worship team is incredible, and Pastor Kim has a way of reaching people in such a real, personal way.
I am looking forward to my next visit.  Thank you for getting me excited about church again! Me and girls traveled 4 hours to her Pastor Kim preach and she did not disappoint.  She knows the word of God and she knows how to deliver it as well. We felt welcome from the time we entered the doors until the time we left.  Highly recommend if you are in the area go get in the House of God and get the Word !!! I absolutely love being a part of Limitless Church. My church truly feels like home and family. The love, encouragement, and sense of community are genuine, and you can feel it the moment you walk through the doors.

Pastor Kim leads with authenticity, transparency, and love, and her messages are always powerful and relatable. “We exist to connect people, grow families, and change lives” is the church's vision, and it truly lives it out in everything it does. It’s more than just words; you can actually see and experience it here.

If you haven’t visited Limitless Church, you have to come. Limitless is a family-friendly church that loves people the way Christ does. There are so many amazing ministries, and one of the Sunday favorites is the Children’s and Youth Ministry. If you can’t make it in person, the online ministry is just as phenomenal; you can tune in from anywhere.

name: Limitless Church Assemblies of God - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary:
A few months ago I walked into Limitless Church feeling scared and alone, but from the very first day I was welcomed with genuine love as if I was family. Since then, this church has completely changed my life—giving me community, support, and helping me grow closer to God more than ever before. I highly recommend you to check this church out. Jesus loves you! If you’re looking for empowerment, peace, and love, look no further – God and community are truly here. From the moment I stepped through the doors, I felt God’s love and grace surrounding me. Everyone here is welcoming, kind, and filled with genuine love. This church has been a source of strength and comfort in my life and I am incredibly grateful to have found a place where faith and community thrive together My family and I LOVE this church!
I have gone to church all my live and I can honestly say that I have never experienced any thing like this church. It has AWESOME worship that you can really get involved in. I love the fact that they welcome everyone like family. Friendly smiles everywhere!!! Pastor Kevin preaches wisely with passion  and Wife Pastor Valerie preaches passionately too... in a fun way to give life to your soul. They are both amazing speakers, "ON FIRE"! TheIr preacing is outstanding and keeps you interested throughout the entire mesage. If you want to feel Gods presence...this is the church for you. It is alived and filled with the Holy Spirit. It motivates me to become the best person I can be. I feel the peace of God, his Hope, Joy and most of all the Love of Jesus! This church stands out more than an church I have been to in many many years. They have a super positive upbeat Woman's Group called Soul Sisters, Men's Group Called Band of Brothers, Kids Program, Worship and Prayer too! This is the type of church that is uplifting  working with Gifts of the Holy Spirit that you just can't help coming back! I truly feel Gods presence in my Spirit , mind, body and soul...and this gives Joy, healing ,peace and hope in this world. I love the community here and just every thing about it! I highly recommend Limitless Church. I hope you will come... its welcoming for every one! AWESOME !
I give it 5 stars Limitless Church is a dynamic charismatic vibrant community of Christ followers. Pastor Kevin Noonan is an excellent communicator, a visionary and Spirit-filled leader. Since becoming Pastor of Limitless Church on March 1, 2013, the size of the congregation has doubled.

If you are looking for a living thriving experience with not only the Savior but also those who have found purpose in life and are eager to worship together each week, please stop by at 10:30AM any Sunday. Limitless Church has been a place of healing for me. I came here broken with so many problems in my life and no where to turn  .
Lead Pastor Kevin and Pastor Valeri's sermons speak to my heart. Slowly I've learned to leave the past behind and find hope in my future with help from God.
Visit Limitless Church and receive the blessings and miracles God has planned for you!

name: Lincoln Avenue Christian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Extremely warm and friendly congregation. Pastor really teaches  the word of God. Great choir This is a great church where the Word of God is preached, taught and explained from the Word of God by a Man of God Excellent Biblical teaching. Warm and friendly congregation lovely service, started to volunteer😁💐 Great Place of Worship!

name: Lincoln Berean Church - Main Campus
Lincoln Glen Church - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary: As a pastor Tyler is a rare gem:  he preaches with depth in a way that connects to any age group, and he's also incredibly fun and easy to connect to.  Awesome church! Thankful to have found Lincoln Glen Church! Everyone is welcoming; I look forward to church next Sunday. And the Sunday after and so on. God is good! I was referred to Lincoln Glen by a friend earlier this year. My daughter and I started attending and we were immediately welcomed with open arms. Everyone in the congregation are incredibly sweet, loving, and we have felt like family from the moment we stepped in the doors. Pastor Tyler gives incredible sermons and is so relatable as a person, and with what he preaches. My daughter has even made great friends with his daughters and absolutely loves going to church every Sunday to see her friends. I would highly recommend Lincoln Glen to anyone. It has a very homey and intimate setting with a deep love of the gospel as well as spreading love to everyone. I’m so glad I found this church body to call my home. My wife and I love this church.  The people here are very welcoming and friendly but not pushy or obnoxious.  Sermons are Bible-focused and engaging.   The church leadership is very caring and willing to help you in time of need.  If you are looking for a new church then you won't be disappointed in Lincoln Glen! As I long-time member of Lincoln Glen Church, I continually find that it’s the people, their love for Jesus and each other that is a consistent factor and drawing card for new people. That feeling of family is very evident, and anyone who desires a sense of belonging is more than welcome to join with us.

name: Lincoln Heights Christian Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church with a huge desire to help those far from God find hope and faith in him. Super loving pastor who is willing to meet people where they are. If you want a great place to explore faith…this is it. This is an amazing place to come & be loved.
Being welcomed and received wherever you are in life, is an awesome blessing.
My wife & I have enjoyed amazing support from the staff & church family in our foster care journey & just in navigating lifes ups & downs. If you are looking for a small , friendly and welcoming church this is it . Pastor Chris weaves scripture into applying it in our daily lives . He puts a lot of time and effort into his weekly sermons . He is funny and caring and you walk away feeling loved by Jesus and with something to think about and focus on every week . To me , it feels like home . We've been attending Lincoln Heights for 3 years and definitely consider it home. There is a wonderful children's ministry and youth group as well as groups for the adults to get involved in. If you're looking for a church that loves Jesus and loves people, this is to church for you! All are welcome! What a blessing Lincoln Heights Church is to me. Everyone is so welcoming and friendly every time you enter this church. You truly feel Gods love and compassion at work here. Pastor Chris’s sermons are thought provoking, inspiring and delivered to his congregation with humor and I love the way Pastor Chris breaks down scripture and helps us understand meanings and relating it all to everyday life as a Christian. What a blessing this church is to the community it serves.

name: Lincoln Hill Community Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary:
Lincoln Hill Community Church is like home to me. Not only is the actual building itself so quaint & serene, but the congregation is a family. We take care of each other, love each other, help each other, we use what Jesus has taught us & we praise Him together, pray together, suffer together, & rejoice together.
God has also provided an amazing Pastor to lead us. Pastor Miguel is true to himself & always looks at the Word of God to guide him in his sermons. I have learned immensely from Pastor Miguel, he has the biggest heart, full of compassion, generosity, empathy & love for everyone. He’s extremely smart & humble, he is always prepared to help anyone in need, no matter what.
This church has been a blessing in my life, coming to it in my teens, I’ve grown up amongst this congregation, I have seen their struggles & I have seen their success. But the best thing I have seen is how great our God is, how much He loves us & cares for us, our church is beyond blessed & we have only God to thank for that. A warm and caring community church that loves God and exemplifies His amazing grace. The Pastor, his wife, and the Leadership Team are remarkable people with hearts of gold who strive to serve the Lord well. Bilingual services too. 5 stars! The faith is real in this congregation. This is a loving community that tries to live everyday by the examples of the Christ, people here take care of each other and the pastor is a passionate and dedicated leader that lives and leads us by the truth of the Bible. Services are bilingual English/Spanish! A warm, loving, caring and diverse congregation of believers in Christ. Spanish/English bilingual services at 11am on Sunday's (zoom accessible just contact the church.) A church that is not afraid to teach the Bible as God's word. I first came to Lincoln Hill about 6 years ago. It struck me how warm, loving, and sweet this church was and is. It is diverse, real and down to earth. Not to mention the Word is being spoken with love and conviction. Out of all the churches I've been to in Marin, this is truly the place I've felt most comfortable, and so does my son and daughter which is so important.

name: Lincoln Park Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A welcoming community of good-hearted and giving people. Pastor Beth is so relatable and we love to hear her preach. Not talking about a church but as a Auditorium. My kids had their annual Christmas recital there for 2 years. The acoustic is great and the atmosphere is very good. Parking is hard since it is at Lincoln Park. I also found there is a shelter in the basement. Very interesting! The most welcoming church I've ever attended. Their mission is to be a true community and to live that out in the world. Their decades-long commitment to LGBTQ rights made me check them out, and I've continued to be impressed by their deciding to be a sanctuary church for immigrants. I was extremely disappointed how an employee treated me. I stood outside to wait for a friend and because i said i wasnt a part of an event that was going on at the moment, the man opened the door and said to leave. Not an inviting treatment to a newcomer!!! It's a beautiful church on the outside yet kind of disappointing inside. I was a member there until 1973. On Session.

reviewSummary:
How wonderful young men and women gather together for the bible study and meet God and people of God!
Every Friday at 7 Pm Bible study time shows that USA will be blessed by these youngsters. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Linda Vista UMC - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: We love LVUMC and Pastor Kimberly Ports! Her compassionate, insightful ministry is the foundation of the church. This great leadership, and a loving congregation make Linda Vista a great worship experience! Nice people great place to worship Great place

Pastor Mike clarifies the readings of the NKTV Bible and applies them to life today, in a most intriguing manner.
Mike’s wife Patricia, is a welcoming, radiant glow of warmth.

Michael C de Baca If your looking for the Best teaching and understanding of the Bible, this is your

name: Linked UP Church - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome experience!  From the friendly parking staff, to the greeters st the doors;  then friendly folks all the way into the sanctuary!   The Pastor was articulate, to the point and straight from the Bible!  I will definitely go back and tell my friends about this church.  A breath of fresh air, and a feeling of caring throughout my entire experience! Pastor Joel and his staff are impacting the community in a GREAT! way through the inner working of the holy spirit lives are being changed  from the inside out. Without the anointing this particular ministry could not grow at the rate that it is growing Pastor Joel is inspired by divine inspiration. I Would like to see the church take a stand on some political issues that affect people of color as well.The mid term election is approaching its critical that members are educated on the importance of the elections and how we as a people  will be affected by the turnout. Thank You. Frank Collins Had been recommended to go to LinkedIn up for about 2 years before actually going. Its been the best decision I could have made for myself and my family. Pastor Gregory & Patricia are on fire for the Lord and every week you won't leave the same way you came! The volunteers and staff are amazing. Good & fertile ground, this house of God has any and every resource imaginable for your growth spiritually! My family and I drive about a hour every week to worship.. and we LOVE LOVE LOVE Linked Up Church! Couldn't ask for a better shepherd and church. Hello everyone, let me start by saying, this was my first time visiting this church. I felt welcomed and relaxed from the first person's smile to the request for the visitors please stand up! I will be back next week. Happy Mother's day! I feel Blessed and so will you! I am proud to say this is my church. Our pastors preach with authenticity and the real undisputed word of God. The messages are inspirational and so relevant to the world we currently live in. These messages will guide us now and to the future. Thank God for ordering my steps and leading my family to this ministry. It is life changing.

name: Linworth Road Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this Church when I was in Early Middle School to High School. When I was younger I was a very shy girl, and would follow my older sister everywhere, even to the High School Sunday service. Even though I was too young to be there, Craig and Scott the 2 youth pastors welcomed me with open arms and allowed me to stay. Shortly after I went to high school they both had left. The new Youth Pastor on the other hand was not very welcoming. He would ignore you if you weren’t one of the popular kids. The kids all went to school together whether public or home schooled, if you didn’t attend any of those with them they shunned you. I felt very Isolated while here, I tried to joint the Youth Band but was told No, I tried to go to there summer hangouts at the park but was ignored and left out of stuff. The only time anyone would acknowledge me was when I would bring my friends with me to the events. My best friend at the time turned against me once she started hanging out with these Kids. I left the church after that and turned from God. A few years later I went back to this church to attend a family members funeral. I had brought my Boyfriend (now Husband) with me. The youth pastor kept harassing my husband the whole time at the Dinner after the funeral. He never acknowledged me but wanted to bug my husband. Needless to say this church has a lot to be desired and if their goal is to bring people to Jesus they did a horrible job of it. It wasn’t until I had my son that I found my way back to God, and realized you donn’t need a church to have a relationship with him. There are so many different ways to hear Gods message now. I first discovered Jesus and Christianity in 2002 thanks to the youth ministry of Linworth Road Church. I had been to other churches before, but I had never before witnessed a group of people actually honestly, completely living it out. That summer my life was forever permanently changed, and I over more than 20 years since have experienced first hand the abundant life promised in John 10:10. There are a ton of great churches in Columbus but Linworth Road Church has a unique passion for the Great Commission which has impacted generations for Christ. Great Bible based teaching, great spirit filled worship and Bible study groups.
Life long relationships from babies to grandparents. I love my church family; been going for 15 years and plan to grow old here with my church family. I have been going to the Linworth Road Community Church (yes, they dropped the word Community) since 1996.  The music is uplifting and there isn't a week that a tune will stay with me all week long.

The preachers range in age from young to almost older, and each person brings a lot of insight to their message,  The members are of a range of ages, but mostly young professionals, and they are prolific.  The Sunday School program, "Cross Crew" gets raving reviews.  Come, and come again, and come again and then get engaged.  A Great Place to come and meet GOD and HIS Redeeming SON, JESUS. In my experience, the church leadership at Linworth will only help you if it's convenient or fashionable for them to do so. Otherwise, they're quite content to leave you twisting in the wind. They do not care about providing genuine spiritual guidance and support to those who need it.

The leadership is lazy, incompetent, unprofessional, disingenuous, and dangerously destructive. I do not say that lightly. I witnessed some absolutely appalling behavior from them. They should be embarrassed - and haunted - by what they did.

Update: In response to Linworth's comment, I would say that I tried multiple times - over multiple months - to get them to address this issue and they did absolutely nothing. In fact, they turned their backs on me. So, this whole "we recognize we missed out on meeting your needs and we're working to grow" thing just is not true.

name: Lirio del Valle Asambleas de Dios - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Love the friendly volunteers and my family enjoys the food pantry..it really helps with finances in a time of need. Although the lines are long, it is so worth the wait..the food is always fresh and never outdated.

I really appreciate her and the biblical teachings she supplies to the flock 😇 Beautiful memorial service was performed by Pastor Jane. I would encourage you to attend their regular services. Amazing church, very nice people and very good pastor

All Bible questions deserve Bible answers. Enough space for social distancing.  Good location.  Felt cozy and at home. Great careing group of sisters and brothers desiring to abide in the word of God whole heartily Friendly church, many classes for young kids and older teens and adults and Tuesday community study, Wednesday adult class.

name: Little Rock Community Church - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful place and wonderful people.

Highly suggest checking out this historical hidden gem for weddings! Its definitely the little country church downtown!

name: Little White Chapel Christian - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: They have all kinds of community functions here. I grew up around the corner and have always felt very fond of this friendly neighborhood church ☺️ I haven't made my way to attend this church as of this writing, but I did attend seminary with the pastor, and I can testify that this Pastor Davis is an extraordinary woman of God. Her love for all people, as her Creator has commanded, is beyond explanation.  She personifies the hymn lyric, "Lord prepare ME to be a sanctuary..."  If I were a brand new disciple, or a seasoned saint looking for a new church home, this wonderful, faithful powerful preaching woman's Little White Chapel, would be my first and last stop. Pastor Julie is a dear friend from school. Our teacher, and LWC’s prior leader, Pastor Bill, saw her talent and heart and mentored her. She is one of the smartest people I know and she always leads with compassion and love. I trust her with my own care, as someone in recovery and LGBT. I have been to the church a few times, and it’s a charming, intimate, caring community. I admire the efforts of LWC to help neighbors in need through the pantry, to support diversity and inclusion through participating in Pride, and to offer growth through readings of the Bible and other literature. If you are looking for a welcoming, progressive worship experience Little White Chapel is the place you want to be! Pastor Julie Davis leads our congregation with spiritual wisdom and kindness creating an inclusive environment where truly all are welcome. I am proud to call this church my home. name: Live Oak Community Church - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve had the pleasure of attending Live Oak Community Church since January 29, 2023, and it has been a blessing ever since. The messages delivered by Pastor Doug Halcomb are powerful and inspiring. His humility and dedication as a servant of God shines through in every word he shares.

Some of the highlights of my first service, that resonate still to this day, was the emphasis on building community through small groups. I love how the church encourages everyone to find a group to belong to, fostering connections and support among the body of Christ. The worship experience was uplifting, and I found myself knowing and loving every song with an atmosphere filled with heartfelt devotion. The legacy of faith, particularly highlighted through Hebrews 11:8 about Abraham, resonated deeply with me. It reminded me that faith is not just belief but also obedience and worship. I was moved by the idea of worshiping from a position of humility and the call to action in our faith journeys. The message about saying "yes" to God’s calling, even without knowing the "how," was a profound reminder of trusting in His plan. Pastor Doug's insights about not just following in others' footsteps but seeking our unique path from God were empowering.

I have found more and more reasons of why I call Live Oak my home church. The special needs care provided by dedicated volunteers shows the church's commitment to inclusivity for the whole family which allows respite for caretakers to fellowship knowing their loved ones are safe.

Live Oak is also passionate about the next generation & having a young son, I have seen that mission field in action. On a weekly basis, students are invested in by Christian leaders that become an extension of their families and resources for changes life brings.

Overall, Live Oak Community Church is a place where you can grow in faith, find community, and experience genuine worship. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming and spiritually enriching environment. I love this Church everybody’s kind and we’re all Friends, even if you don’t know each other highly recommend PROCEED WITH CAUTION!!!!!

I attended this church for two years consistently and was transparent and very open with pastor Doug and other elders at this church about my past and my struggles with addiction before I found Christ. I was approached by the college ministry to be a leader for freshman men and pastor Doug knew about my history of addiction (I’ve been sober for 2 years now Thank you Jesus for recovery). I had a full interview and background check completed by college ministry team and I was green lighted to start in the fall. Pastor Doug immediately pulled the plug on my involvement in serving in the college community and stated “I would do better working in a recovery group” I was immediately labeled as an addict and they weren’t able to look past that. Pastor Doug also proceeded to cussed me out in the parking lot of chuys restaurant using the f word multiple times when I called him out on being led by fear and not by the spirit of God. This is a not a church this is a business. A business led by Pharisees.
There are lots of better options in Lubbock if you are seeking the Holy Spirit. This was traumatic and absolutely disappointing for so many reasons. I pray they find their way in Jesus mighty name. I’ve gone twice and received long speech’s about how I need to give them money. The first time they talked for 15 minutes about how they’re growing and need money, and for someone that goes to church once a week I just want to learn about the lord. The second time was like an episode of richeous gemstones, I hope no one has to sit through a vision Sunday service. They pretty much pitched us for 50 minutes about how we need to give them more money and stuff and incorporated bible quotes to compel us to give them money. It was the most western thing I’ve ever experienced, they were saying they are trying to make 500,000 dollars this year. It left a terrible pit in my stomach and I know I’m never gonna go back again, and I know there’s gotta be people who feel the same. Really welcoming, was unsure about this church (I'm an incoming freshman) but something in my gut told me to volunteer here. They have a really good community and everyone seems to know each other (something I'm not used to). Sermons also focus on the full context of the Bible, and don't just cherry pick scripture. 11/10 if I could.

name: Live Oak United Church of Christ (formerly Brea Congregational Church) - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I love the inclusion of Live Oak. It feels great to walk into a sacred space and see so many different types of people. The music here is also wonderful. There’s a choir and a ukulele group as well as very talented keyboardists who keep the service varied and interesting. The messages I hear each week are always thought provoking and heart felt. Live Oak is everything I’ve hoped for in a church but the best part are the people in it. At the beginning of 2020 I had to navigate some extreme emotional trauma. With my social anxieties and a childhood full of disconnection in Christian churches I felt very overwhelmed about testing the waters as an adult with my own household, but I desperately needed a community.
I took the smallest step of reaching out on Facebook to ask questions that would help make my first visit a little less intimidating and I felt so much better after getting responses that made me feel some peace in bringing my family.
Over five years later and I have not once felt "othered" nor anything but welcomed to participate at any level I am comfortable, from celebrations to community volunteering to church meetings.
I feel it to my bones when I hear the pastor instill weekly, "No matter who you are or where you are on life's journey, ALL are welcome here." And I see that, every week, in the pews all around me. This church is so amazing! They are truly welcoming and loving. They sing to the lord with all their hearts and talk about Jesus miracles and love and spreading faith to the community. They welcome everyone with open arms and they are very knowledgeable of the Bible. I love it here Brea is a welcoming friendly church, encouraging people to  feel at right home.  This is a progressive church, promoting the inclusion of all people who love each other and interested in humane and environmental causes.  Adding to that comfortable feeling, people may bring along that special pet to the services and frequent potlucks.  Looking for God's home? Then, this is it. Wonderful Jazz Vesper with sensational Vocalist Rose Mallett and  the Ron Kobayashi Trio. Speakers were engaging and inspirational.

name: Living Faith Presbyterian Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Let me begin by saying that I live a nomadic existence. When asked, I like to say, “a Nomad, tethered to Christ.”

I have the unique privilege of Serving and Teaching in a variety of spaces, predominantly overseas, and during the in-between seasons, Los Angeles at times becomes my home base of sorts.

Roughly 3 years ago, like you and others, I found myself on Google Maps looking for a place to Worship and Fellowship. A place that Teaches the Bible clearly, somewhere steady, somewhere at the time, I could walk to. Haha, I know, clearly I'm not from LA but I don't have a car.

By God’s Grace and Favor, that search led me to Living Faith Presbyterian Church. People come here from near and far across LA and beyond. A wonderful quality I think.

Like someone has said before me, it feels a little strange to write a review of a church, but Gratitude asks to be spoken. So here it goes:

Living Faith is centered on the Word of God, not as a concept or a slogan, but as the living and trustworthy foundation for Faith and Life.

Things of Significant Note:
* This is a church that confesses the God who exists eternally as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
* Scripture is trusted as the inspired, infallible Word.
* Salvation is understood as entirely by God’s grace, given through Jesus Christ, who lived, died, and rose again for those who trust in HIM. HE is our Hope, our Savior, and our Mediator.
* Through the Holy Spirit, we are guided, strengthened, and slowly shaped to walk in a way that honors HIM.

What I found at Living Faith was not performance or spectacle, but reverent Worship, thoughtful teaching, and a steady, sincere community. I was not treated as someone passing through, but as a Brother/Sister in Christ. There is a gentleness here, subtle but clear.

If you’re reading this, you already know that finding a church can be challenging, to say the least. Churches are filled with us, sinful people, perfectly imperfect, broken and hurting and hurt people often inadvertently or purposely, hurt others. Living Faith is not an exception to that truth; no church is. But what you will find here is a community of people at various stages of life, learning to practice Repentance, Healing, Patience, and Love. A community growing in the Word and in Prayer. A place that equips you to do so daily.

It is a church that loves the Truth, Cares for People, and has a Heart for reaching Global Communities.

If you are seeking a place where the Bible is treasured, Christ is honored, and ordinary Believers walk together in Grace, you may find a home here, even if only for a season.

Be Encouraged and Remember to Pray over your decision to not only visit but possibly stay. God knows exactly where HE wants you.

Jeremiah 29:11 (ESV)
11 For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future. It feels odd to write a “review” for a church, so this won’t be that.  Instead, I wanted to share my experiences coming to Living Faith Presbyterian Church (LFPC), and things that I wish I knew when I first visited.  Please note that this information applies to LFPC.  There’s a Korean language church here called The Way Church, which is a separate church.  And there might be some reference to a Hebron Church, which I understand was a different church that used to meet here many years ago.

FINDING LFPC
Finding a church was difficult!  There’s no comprehensive directory so even knowing what’s out there was tough.  I tried Yelp/Google.  I tried churches that people recommended.  At the end of the day, for us, we found this church through the Presbyterian Church in America directory.  We first came about 2 years ago, and became members about a year later.  So please keep in mind that I’m writing this as a fairly new member, but a member nonetheless.

BIBLE TEACHING
We had a list of priorities when we were looking for a church, but in the end, we were drawn to LFPC due to their solid biblical teaching which we saw in their messages, their bible studies, and through the spiritual maturity of the members.  This is a church that is committed to teaching Reformed Theology.

SERVICE
Service starts at 1PM in the main sanctuary.  It’s covenantal worship style, meaning that children stay with adults during service.  However, there is a separate baby room in the back for the littlest ones and their parents as needed.   Service is fairly standard and they have communion every Sunday (praise, offering, prayer, message, communion, benediction, fellowship).  This is an English speaking church, but we share the space with a larger Korean speaking church (called The Way Church), so some of the building signs will be in Korean.  In terms of size, it’s large enough that if you’re new and want to sit in the back and leave right afterwards, you won’t stick out.  But it’s still small enough that someone may notice that you’re new, and will come by to say hello.  And the members are genuinely warm and friendly.  Of course, some people are shier than others, so not everybody will come over to say hello, but there were many who came over to welcome me on my first day, and I’ve seen that this is typical.  The congregation has a mix of children, college students, young adults, couples, and families with children.

BIBLE STUDY
There is a separate children’s ministry program at 11:15 and an adult bible study (or prayer meeting) at the same time.  This is on the third floor of this massive building.  And it’s only accessible via the stairs on the south side of the building, not the north side of the building.  To get there, you’ll need to either go through the metal gate/door across from Jay’s market, or if that’s closed, go through the main building doors, turn left and go down the corridor past the Korean-language service, and then you’ll see the stairs going up.  Lunch is served between bible study and the worship service.  However, there are some weeks when the church doesn’t have bible study, so I would encourage you to check out the website for the calendar, if you plan to stop by the Bible Study for your first visit.

PARKING
If you’re coming for the 1PM service, there’s a fenced parking lot south of Jay’s Market on Norton Ave.  If you’re coming for the 11:15AM bible study, then heaven help you!!!  Just kidding!!!  There are a few parking spaces on the north side of Pico, at the Union Club parking lot (4075 W. Pico Blvd).  If the club is busy, you just need to tell them that you’re parking for the church.  And there’s usually some street parking within a block or two of the church.  I haven’t had difficulty finding parking on 4th and 5th Avenues, north of Pico, or along Pico.

COMMUNITY GROUPS
As a commuter church, members come from as far away as Granada Hills, Glendale, Downey and the South Bay or as close as 1 block away.  CG info on website. This church has helped me and my family a lot and continues to help. The people are very responsive and kind, everyone is very friendly and eager to talk, even though I don't speak the language very well. Thank you all for being here.
As for parking, there is a fenced-in free parking lot for church parishioners.
I came from my country with prejudices against church, but people who truly call themselves believers gather here.

name: Living Grace Church
reviewSummary:
LIVING GRACE CHURCH. A feel welcome to all. No matter your station in life or self image deteriorating, get a free HOT MEAL Thursday noon, and same day food bank. Best part is the common approach to common overburdened persons. Prayer gatherings. Located on Pacific Ave and 28th, Left turn heading up Pacific Ave. Lots of parking. Please park and/or stay within church parking lot. Clothing bank and free haircuts. Sunday service. Call for Sunday service hours. Living grace is a a church that sticks to the Bible.  No altering the word of God.  The pastor is such a great guy and devoted to the people and the church! Have been part of this church since I was in grade school! I have been apart of living grace since I was in first grade! Now I'm 22, and still faithfully attending . This church is my family! I love love love this place! They are always so welcoming and full of love here. Great Biblical church!!!The Sunday service (10am) is amazing with the head pastor preaching from the Bible. They have a great kids department my son loves attending (he is 11). They offer Wednesday (7pm) night services for both adults and kids. I have been attending about 1 1/2 and definitely feel the presence of God among this church and the congregation. Come join us for service😊 A casual, Come As You Are ethnically and socially diverse growing Church community. Very warm and welcoming. Pastor Tom Powell is a seminary trained biblical scholar. His wisdom and knowledge of the Bible allows him to teach powerful,contemporary lessons with a positive Biblical relevance.
They have incredible Musical ability. Subdued live band with acoustic and electric guitars, drums and keyboards. Talented vocalist all. Leading worship with tight harmonies and catchy melodies.
I found myself humming tunes from church - hours later.

name: Living Grace Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary:
From at the entrance door to  the sanctuary I start to feel inviting mood.
I hardly see well dressed up people around, who  look like come from all different ages and ethnic backgrounds.

Music is somewhat loud, however I can read sincerity and passion from all singers' face and body movement. One of my dream is to see my daughter singing at the stage someday later.

Messages are based on the bible scriptures . Pastor speech is articulate and Sermon is fairly  well understood ; English is my 2nd language.

Pastors are handsome and look great. I am curious to know why they chose to become preachers. My experience with Living Grace Church has been incredible. You feel nothing but love and acceptance as soon as you walk in. The people there do not have that aura of perfection, they are just good people that you can relate to. I am not a perfect person and I have done a lot of wrong things, but I feel God's grace when I go to this church. God is doing amazing things here. A First Amendment Auditor has done a video on this church and the people of the church were FANTASTIC!!! Great, loving people who treated two strangers with respect and grace. Heartwarming video of great people. Nicely done, all the way around. the people at this church are very welcoming.  You will be greet and welcomed.  The service is only 1 hour and 10 minutes.  But the music is very lively, I look forward to the free lunch afterwards and the people are very friendly.  Child services are provided during the service. If you are looking for a bible based, Christ loving, and multi-ethnic church that loves God and it's congregation, this is the church to attend and join. And if you are hungry, for God's word or food, please attend Sunday worship at 11:15 am and stay for the food fellowship afterwards.

name: Living Hope at Ballantyne - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great place to come to find your way to Christ. Church is very diverse and growing. You can count on finding amazing people and deep dive to the meaning of Bible.
Christian preschool teachers are caring, other kids are nice and well behaved. The level of education challenging K level in a public school. My son absolutely loved going here. When walking dogs ON THE LEASH/ CROSSING the church field became a problem?! We were stopped today by a gentleman named  himself Tom and asked to leave the private property. Apparently the same man stopped another neighbor too (his wife with two babies walking at the same time told me. There are much more things that private “business” (private school/church) should worry about other than stop ppl that live in the community behind them.
Don’t you teach that the Lord welcomes everyone including animals. We can work as a community together supporting you guys and you guys should use at least some common sense!

* Dogs off leash or some others that makes a mess I fully understand asking them to leave but a lady crossing it with her dogs is bothering you… wow! If you are looking for a church that is Christ centered Bible focused this is a place for you. This church has become family to my family. This is how the Christian church is supposed to be. Awesome church filled with amazing people who are always eager to share the love of Christ with others. Love my church! 💕🙏🏼 Good place and people. Like a second family.

reviewSummary:
Caring more about “getting scammed” than providing for peoples’ needs. Mark Quick lays it all out there that he reads Matt 5 with his own asterisk “give to the one who asks of you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.”*
*unless your afraid they’re just scamming you.

This is not loving like Jesus.

Its very refreshing and uplifting. Revival is coming! Miracles are coming! A Fresh Outpouring is coming!

Don't miss what God has for you at this church!!! Wonderful church.  Everyone is very welcoming.  Great worship, sermon and prayer time.  Pastor is very concerned and attentive to the flock, and is also concerned about the local community. The Word of God is preached. Give it a try! Welcoming family oriented church. Spirit led awesome worship services. Solid scripture based, anointed sermons. Very welcoming congregation.  Excellent service and opportunity
for prayer.

name: Living Hope Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited Living Hope today and found it to be a welcoming, multi-generational, Bible teaching church. It was wonderful to see people of all ages, including many young families and children. The worship time was glorifying and Phil’s teaching was biblical and relevant. Wonderful church! Greeters were welcoming, people were friendly,  the worship was amazing! The pastor preached a relevant,  engaging message. We are new to Colorado Springs and believe we have found our new church home. I was only here in Colorado for a short time period for a trip and I needed a place to worship.  It was an awesome place and Pastor Phil gave a great sermon 😊 Good temporary home for me and everyone was very welcoming 🙏 No place has made me feel more welcomed and loved. Pastor Phil's sermons resonate so deeply with me, as he integrates the messages of the old with the relevance of today, teaching us how to be a modern day Christian in today's society through scripture.

Best of all.... He does all of this without shouting. Pastor Phil's message is delivered with an undeniable true love for our Father God and compassion for others. I am blessed to be a part of this congregation.

The praise and worship is ran by a group of God-gifted talented musicians (also played by the Pastors) from morning till afternoon, on Sunday, you can feel the Holy Spirit flowing all through Living Hope Church.

If you want to feel closer to our Father God, Living Hope Church is a place where He resides. I feel His presence so powerfully the moment I walk into His doors.

No drama... Just God! I came here this morning for Sunday worship but was an hour early.  I was kindly encouraged by John to leave since I was too early.  He said “there are coffee shops I can go to”.  I guess that means the Lord led me to Starbucks so no church today 😊.  The hardest part about being a Christian is seeingchurches not accept people when in my belief that is what Jesus taught 🙏

name: Living Hope Church - Woodland Campus
reviewSummary:
It doesn’t matter whether you’re religious or not, the Woodland Museum of Biblical Archaeology is a fascinating place to visit.

The main focus of the museum is to promote biblical teachings by displaying items of interest to the Bible and its authenticity. Anyone interested in learning about this history is invited to explore the exhibits that showcase more than 300 artefacts.

As you go through the museum, you’ll learn about major biblical events and the history, people and places surrounding these events. I feel alot happier and I am getting better support at living hope church they treat me with respect . Wonderful church folks.  They have a REALLY top notch archeological museum that has tons of ancient artifacts, lots of great information and is free of charge. You should check it out! Great lecture on the destruction of the city of Sodom by the dead sea. They also have a great archaeology
Museum. This is a great church! It's filled with wonderful people who love and serve Jesus with their lives.

name: Living Hope Church Assemblies of God
reviewSummary: I felt very welcomed this is going to All knew to me. And maybe God has a plan for me. Solid biblical teachings and community. Teaching coping without treason. I really like this church. My Church #1

name: Living Hope Church Columbus - Powell / Delaware South Campus
reviewSummary:
I really appreciate the teaching at Living Hope. The messages are always biblically sound but also practical for daily life—I always walk away with something to think about during the week. The worship is modern and heartfelt, and you can tell the leadership really pours their hearts into every service. It’s been a huge part of my personal growth. I listening to the messages every Sunday morning on the radio on my way to work and it gets me thru my day. I been looking for a church and just hearing these messages the pastor is always right and speaking the truth. I have been raised in church my whole life my grandpa Lester was a preacher and preached the word up till it was his time to go home and be with the Lord. I thank you so much for having your message be on the radio it's something I been needing. If you all can keep me in ur prayers I appreciate it my name is Niki! I hope to be able to visit your church soon. Thank you for doing God's work and ministering to the world. I couldn’t ask for a better church to call home! Living Hope Church  is set apart from any other church that I have experienced. Every sermon is preached straight from the Bible. Truth is so important!  The kids ministry is the best!!
And let’s not forget to mention the community outreach Living Hope does. Love seeing God’s work in the place!

Thank you, Pastor Aaron and Team, for doing all that you do! This church is made up of people who love the lord and love to serve him. I have only been a handful of time when visiting the area  on mission trips but every time there is a church packed with loving, friendly faces who love new visitors. Aaron and Joe do a great job leading and God is using them and this church in a mighty way in the Dublin/Powell area. So thankful for Living Hope! The congregation, Pastors Aaron and Joe are all just loving, supportive, passionate down to earth people! They teach the Bible messages in a way you can understand. I feel closer in my walk with Jesus Christ ❤️

name: Living Hope Community Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
At Living Hope they played a video called “American gospel“ which was a music video that was conservative propaganda. There was a line that said “blessed are the speech police and the rioters. They have empathy for everyone except for their enemies“. This is wildly inappropriate to play in church And I will never be returning to this church because of this video. What a nice church to worship God.  After searching and searching for a church to call home, God has lead us here.  Living Hope has an excellent children's gospel program.  My 4 year old especially looks forward to every last Sunday of the month when they have family worship (children and adults sing worship songs together before they are dismissed to their classes).  What a great way to bring the families together!

Tip:  Make sure you stay for Newcomer's Luncheon if you are new and meet the pastor and other staff. It's amazing church When I stepped in the door I didn't feel welcome and I get no hospitality when I went into the church area I know when you walk into church you should feel loved and hospitality in the people should make their problems go away and pay attention to yours I didn't have no problem but I just want people make you feel welcome when you walk into the church imma get more star because after I got in there and start talking to people is like I have to talk to them this is not my church is there church not mine when you come to my church will make the opportunity to come up and speak to you how you doing today do you need anything they didn't do that Our family LOVES Living Hope, and we are so happy to call it HOME!

name: Living Hope Fellowship
reviewSummary:
Great church community for the whole family. From the moment I walked in I was received with lots of love and grace. Love being at this Church. Services are on Sundays at 9 & 11 am, with kids ministry happening during both services and a high school ministry on Wednesday nights at 7 pm! Great place to build community and make friends! Amazing church!! One of my favorite places to spend time on. There’s always someone smiling and greeting you! Their youth group is just something different, everyone being so welcome to the new ones, no judging, just a safe place to talk and have fun!! Our family has called Living Hope our home, our family for many years. When we first came we were embraced with a beautiful love. Such a friendly people. We cannot think any where else we rather be on Sunday mornings. We have developed great friendships, friendships that are beyond Sunday, friendships that will last forever.
Pastor Jess and Brenda and their family are the most caring people we have met and that's one of the he biggest reasons we felt in love with Living Hope. The way they help us to build a relationship with God has been transformational. Our kids love this church, their best friends are Living Hope kids. If you want to be helped to build a relationship with Jesus, we would recommend Living Hope. A mature, spirit-filled church... Cannot express how grateful I am for every pastor here. This church seeks to lead others closer to Jesus and gives tools to do so! They provide a yearly church devotional book, women's group, men's group, and have a GREAT kids ministry... Everything here is done with great intentionality and aims to teach the whole family to lean into Jesus in their day-to-day lives. If you want to be a part of a church that encourages you to dive into the fidelity of God, lean into your Jesus community and create habits in your life that will draw you and your family closer to God, come here! Really great church. My husband and I have visited this church occasionally since 2011. We moved nearby in 2020 and have since been attending regularly, this is a comfort filled church, the family that pastors this church are so genuine so loving, and it’s a place we actually look forward to being for Sunday service. There early service is at 9:00 am and there second service is at 11:00 am. This place is anything but boring, it’s the most exciting church I’ve ever been to, and they really teach all about love and more love. Going here has changed my life and made me want to be better.

name: Living Hope Lutheran Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
I really like this church/congregation
. It isn't so big that you get lost in the crowd  The members are warm and welcoming. The sermons are well delivered and God's word is made relevant to our daily lives. If you are looking for a place to worship, to recieve biblical sermons and teaching, a place to belong to, I suggest you visit this church and give it a try. Our 97 year old father was a member of the Living Hope Lutheran Church in Wildomar until his death in September 2023.  He was encouraged to “give generously” each week.  He did so, even beyond his means.  He borrowed money in enormous amounts to donate to the church and high school.  His concerned family warned the pastor that the money he was donating was borrowed, that I am on disability due to a work injury and that he was not saving for his daily care and living expenses.  His large donations continued to be accepted despite the fact that the church was aware of the situation.  Our dad did not have the funds to give to the church in his last years and the INTEREST alone on this loan ranges from $1000 to $1400 a month!  We are now left with payments we cannot afford.  The church should be a safe place for the elderly, ill and vulnerable population.  We found Living Hope Lutheran Church to be willing to accept money at our father’s expense and are disappointed that his devotion to God was not enough in his declining years.  He was financially exploited by Living Hope Lutheran Church. This is a welcoming church that is true to scripture. It is a blessing to be able to be feed here every week. God's Word is taught. Jesus and his forgiveness shine forth. A wonderful group of forgiven sinners. God’s Word is faithfully taught. Thankful for the opportunity to worship and be fed with the Gospel.

name: Living Hope Neighborhood Church - Richmond Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for over 10 years and also volunteering here. Pastor Dave and his wife Josie are wonderful—they truly make everyone feel like family. I love Pastor Dave’s sermons and how he thoughtfully walks us through the Bible, taking our time to finish books gradually with sermons that resonate deeply.

This church is very kid-friendly. Plus it has an amazing Huge gym my kids love to play in before and after church. With  programs like Love Richmond on Tuesdays for the kids and on Wednesdays older kids group, as well as men’s and women’s groups. Pastor Zack and his lovely wife Andrina are wonderful leaders in these ministries along with their parents. Living Hope also host spring break and summer camps, holiday giveaways, grocery giveaways, and special events to serve our community, lone in the past doing free eye exams and glasses right at the church.

Everyone feels welcome here! They do not pass around a collection plate; instead, there’s a secure collection box in the back with gentle reminders giving can be done privately in the back. I absolutely love this church and so do my children. I wish I could give it 100 stars❤️ Living Hope Neighborhood Church is one of the best churches I have ever been to and it's a great place to meet great people. Pastor Dave gives a great sermon on Saturday mornings and there is free breakfast afterward which is cheesy scrambled eggs potatoes, and pancakes. I've been coming here for almost 3 years and I highly recommend it. Live across from this active church and it is always packed on the weekends. I have gone twice and the sermon was very good and the pew was very accepting of new comers. I would highly recommend anyone new to the nieghborhood. Although it is situated in a fully residential nighborhood, it accepts people from everywhere First time I have attended the breakfast on Saturday. It was a pleasant experience. The breakfast wasn't to bad either. Pretty good actually. Beautiful place to fellowship with others that r walking with the desire to do THAT which is pleasing in the eyes of the lord

name: Living Rock Christian Church - Sunnyvale Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly and inviting will enjoy if you come visit People who genuinely want to do good. Come check it out! Blessings from above are a great blessing to the life of a Christian.

reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Living Truth Christian Fellowship - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Always sound theology at service. I love that when I leave services I feel a better understanding of God’s Word.  I am so thankful that I found a church in Riverside/ Corona area that uses expository preaching that provides both clarity and depth of the Bible.
Friendly faces, very welcoming and great praise music.  Highly recommend if you’re looking for a church home check out Living Truth!  😊💖 Great Church!! Pastor Michael teaches from the Bible , Chapter and verse by verse.  There is a 7pm  mid week study on Wednesday nights with daycare and children ministry Tots - Youth groups .
Sundays 9am and 11:15am  Church service with  Sunday school. Come fellowship and learn the Bible I really like it here. They always got something going on so it's hard to miss out. The Spanish Ministry is also on par. Loving and kind. I see myself coming here for years. Best church I've ever been to! We moved here about 6 months ago and didn't know where to go. We prayed about it and couldn't be more happy with Living Truth. It's a wonderful place with a great message!! Love this great family church and Pastor Michael Lance.  Humble, compassionate, great relevant teacher and sense of humor. Great patriot.😇

name: Living Truth Church Carmel - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: My first time attending the church was amazing , the residing pastor was spot on and the whole congregation related just like a family. Apart from that, the premises was extremely clean, kudos to the workers A Spirit filled Church with amazing Teachings! Perfect to grow in your spiritual walk with God and the Holy Spirit! Truth is preached.  Great revelation in this place Great church, especially for the community Spirit filled church & phenomanal teaching. Highly recommend if you want to grow in Christ!

name: Living Water Church - Buford Campus
reviewSummary: My Wife, Lorraine, and the Twins visited today for the first time.  What a wonderful experience we had.  The people were so friendly and the helpful to us with getting the twins to thier class (2nd Grade).  The Worship and Preaching were both powerful. Pastor Emanuel is such an effective, and anointed communicator. Buford needs a dynamic church like this one.  My wife and I felt right at home there. The message, "Don't Miss the Moment." was stop on with where we are in our lives right now. The NRX event here was great!! I will definitely be making this place my home church. :) This is the best church in my opinion they are nice and very welcoming Great church for the entire family, with very friendly people, with an amazing Sunday school, women's ministry, men's ministry, and marriage ministry if you are looking for a place to call home this is the place! Amazing place to be in! 🙌🏻 Family,  friendly atmosphere!  Wonderful people!  ❤ Pastor Emanuel has father's heart and  everyone at the church congregation are so nice and open to meet new people and create unforgettable experiences ❤ We love to be a part of this amazing big family!!!

name: Living Water Church of the Nazarene - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
They have meetings here that help me stay clean. Mondays and Thursdays @ 4pm all are welcome. Open during all holidays. I went to the Sunday service for the first time and it was pretty good. I go there every Friday for the food donations and it is so very helpful since I am on a fixed, low income and virtually no food stamps. They open up for overnight temp. shelter during inclement weather. When I was homeless that service would have been very appreciated. I've frequented this place on Friday mornings - early afternoons as during that time slot, the Nazarene people are kind enough to let the "Voices of the City Choir" use it for choir practice, social activism meetings and always a nice free lunch served out of their small kitchen afterwards.  Genuinely nice and caring people who work with city government and planners, local law enforcement and the press as a sort of necessary ad hoc watchdog oversight committee, protecting the civil rights and civil liberties of the homeless, disenfranchised and/or indigent of our city.
Web:    www.voicesofourcity.org
Email:  info@voicesofourcity.org
Phone: (619) 738-1232 Ok this is a church that in the 'spot , ordained by God " they offer snacks s few days a week, a great place to go to connect with other like minded people. There's always a Amazing church service and they have at times" pop up medical team ". ☕👀🙏😀🖤 The church is amazing the pastor and his wife are so sweet and kind I'm so glad God gave me a home. They let u come as u are. And show sso much love to each person

name: Living Water Fellowship Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
They did a turkey giveaway today November 22nd 2025 we were in line about an hour and 45 minutes and it was so well worth it we got a beautiful turkey a big box full of food to cook with it and a meijer's $25 gift card. This church is definitely a blessing Thank you for being there for your community. This church will illegally place nasty stickers on your car for parking just off the road OUTSIDE the gate so you can go across the street and do as they preach and help push a man out of the massive snow bank he's stuck in. I was literally across the street trying to get this poor man unstuck from the snow and a car that was very clearly not official or police illegally obstructed my driver's side window with a nasty sticker about parking outside the gate and notably did not bother to look across the street or come up the people trying to do what Christ called for us to do and help others. The church has no legal official capacity to be placing these stickers either as I was outside the gates, there's no signs, and you're not parking enforcement or police. This is why people have a bad taste for Christians. Love thy neighbor is real strong with this church. Was there for Thanksgiving food box giveaway. The event was organized, the volunteers were helpful. The line of cars was moving quickly and efficiently. Was there today for Sunday Service and it was explosive. The power of the word came forth in a mighty and significant way.  Pastor Kim Outlaw gave way to her special speaker Pastor Sarah Barbour (Hyche) who was truly amazing.

Pastor Kim hosted a powerful Women's Empowerment event on Saturday and the Holy Spirit just overflowed into today.

Pastor Kim is very mindful of time and I truly appreciate worshipping on Sunday and getting out at a respectable time. We were out of service by 12 noon. Great Pastors who are so transparent about their own lives, so you overcome and succeed in yours. They  genuinely love   people and you feel that when you walk into the doors. from Teenagers to adults = so relatable.   Pastors that give to their community and if there is a need in the house they will meet it.. I could go on and on. Great church, the choir awesome Angela awesome!

name: Living Waters Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I just LOVE this sweet little church!! It feels like a good ol'-fashioned small "Country church," full of God-fearing, Jesus-loving, kind folks with a sense of humor!  The Worship time here is usually Spirit-filled &  Spirit-led, allowing plenty of freedom of physical movement, use of instruments, & sometimes flags &/or dancing.  I, personally, love the joyous freedom of being able to worship The LORD however The Spirit moves me!  :)

This church has a long history of Spirit-led Worship with dance and song, as well as one of biblical teaching in a practical, culture-current way.  The senior pastors are a married couple who have been at the helm of this church for decades, yet have never lost their zeal for The LORD or His WORD!  I love them both dearly, their delightful sense of humor, their intellect, and their sincere desire to help all of us grow in a deeper walk with GOD.  I love the freedom to laugh in church, to clap, to dance (when appropriate), and to pray with & for one another there.

In warmer months, we enjoy a nice lunch out on the patio after the service - always with friendly fellowship & even dessert!  At least twice a year, the youth entertain & inspire us by putting on plays, dance recitals, etc.  I love a church like this that values & LOVES the children & youth as much as the adults in its body!  We're always praying that The Lord will bring to us anyone whom He would graft into our Body, so please feel free to drop in and give our church a try!!  :) Best church of the Lord Jesus Christ bible base teaching.
Jesus is not a religion He is a relationship.  The church is where we all gather to worship the Lord Lord Jehovah! Great church and ministry. They are very strong in the arts ( dance,mime,worship..etc)very welcoming. Including biblical foundational teaching in the arts..I for miss them. my church us so awesome all about Jesus Christ.  not a religion it is a relationship with Jesus Christ forever My wife and I have been attending this church since moving to southern  California in 1991

name: Living Waters of Chino - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
My home church for 35 years. Love everyone here. Jesus is king. I haven't attended the church, but the review by Lori law is very unfair and has no validity. If you want to know what a church believes
ASK THEM 👁️👁️
Hey, they say what they believe in their website My husband and I  look for a church for months and a Facebook friend recommended us Living water we lived In LA and took the long drive but totally worth it!!! We meet amazing people the first day, my son received the baptism of The Holy Spirit at age of 12 after 2 weeks and then he got baptized in water. I can not express enough about this Church, bible doctrine and so balanced, we had to move out of state and honestly we miss this church so bad, pastor, and some members we had a chance to meet Like sister Judy and her husband, my goodness they make me feel like I born in that church in so short time. God bless the pastor and this congregation. To me and my family this is the perfect church to go. I just absolutely love it and I wish I had them all here in my new state. From South Carolina to California we bless this amazing church and may the Lord continue pouring his power his love and blessings upon all of you in Jesus name Amen! Thank you ❤️ For everything I love our pastors this is the only church I can say the speak the truth and from God. Our senior Pastor Duke Downs is the best pastor I've known. 17 years I go I remember so clearly you can feel God's spirit I was saved, delivered and filled with the holy ghost. Unfortunately 8 years ago I went through a rough patch and instead of staying in church I back slid now God's been dealing with me and it's time to go back home. I love Living Waters, the pastors, and the people. I gave my life back to the Lord here in August 2020, I was welcomed back with nothing but joy and love. Thank you Pastor Duke for being such a faithful man of God, thank you Living Waters for all you do.

name: Living Way Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Wow! Eating my dinner in the parking lot after a housecleaning job and was approached by a short little white guy and asked to leave and not park there. Is this Christ-like behavior? Asking for a friend. I thought people that go to church were supposed to have compassion, love thy neighbor , etc…etc.. Thank you Living Way Church!! For showing me EXACTLY why people DON’T want to go to church!! AMEN! Loving, serving church where the Word of God is the authority , the Holy Spirit is alive & Jesus is the way of salvation. Tes who volunteers with this church should not be anywhere near children and women!! Twice he has threatened me and yelled in my face where I could feel his spit on my face!! He uses vulgar language around the kids!! He has a hot head and a bad temper!! Livingway church you need to know your volunteers!! This man has no business being around ladies and children!!!! Dangerous man!!! Great place for worship, kids ministry & hearing God's word preached. Casual dress & family environment. Strong leaders. New Sr. Pastor, has a true heart for people. Not your normal doom and gloom, but a message of Love, Forgiveness and Christ!

name: Living Way Community Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
I tried connecting with one of the main pastors ~ pastor James. He couldn’t remember who I was and assumed some negativity (eg was puzzled by me saying I was married with kids and assumed I was otherwise single and living vicariously) when we had our one on one to assess me as a member. He seems to have a very narrow understanding of Biblical theology and you can tell by his language and how he speaks on things. I’ve been a believer since I was 13 years old, and I’ve experienced church judgment and he reminds me a lot of that. Now being a married person with kids I don’t have the patience for it. If you can’t and don’t agree with his points of view, he finds it offensive and almost as if you are beneath him. We are all sinners. Good theology doesn’t change that and make some
Pharisees while others innocent. I’m not a liberal by any sense, but the church also doesn’t leave room for any nuance when it comes to being a member. If you speak for abortion or even question pro life (God forbid) you are a heathen, even when it comes to accounting for all the people who medically need it. It can feel very clannish to attend this church. I can’t say I have anything negative to say about Pastor Ray. He is genuine, on fire and I feel humbled in his presence. He really pours out Jesus’ meekness and love. He has a very good theological understanding and can preach on end times without making you feel judgment. I only wish we stayed long enough to connect with more people but it felt very clicky at times and it felt unwelcoming enough to have that interaction with Pastor James, to decide on another church, that felt more like home. Having left, no one I actually had met at the time keeps in touch regardless of how close they acted at the time and it’s unfortunate. Our Pastor  closes our Church 1 Sunday every year and makes all of us go out to experience the whole Body of Christ and to take our tithes to that Church and bring back a bulletin so we can share our positive response and we pray over all the church's for wisdom , strength, healing, finances etc. Some of our congregation went to Texas and Louisiana. We went to Living Way and the messages were on point focusing on our youth amazing. Also there Worship is Fantastic. We will be going back in the future. Love this place!!! Pastors are on FIRE🔥🔥🔥for God and his word. Their heart for people and the Gospel is so evident- as well as embracing and preaching on diversity in the body of Christ from the pulpit. Really amazing place! I’ve learned and grow a lot here and have found family and community! If you want sound Biblical teaching from the pulpit, you're in the right place. Pastors James and Ray don't water it down, don't preach prosperity gospel and don't hold back. It is a church of sound doctrine and good people. Check it out for yourself! Absolutely love this church and this community - LivingWay has a deep love for Jesus, His Word, the His people. It really has been a joy to be a part of and can’t recommend it enough!
