name: Living Way Fellowship - Highlands Ranch Campus
reviewSummary: Went to a funeral here. I'm not religious but everyone here was welcoming. The Pastor that did the service was a nice guy but a little pushy about his religion. In my opinion you shouldn't be telling attendees at a funeral that the person that passed wants you to find the same God. Overall, it was a friendly loving time to connect with the other people. A breath of fresh air. After searching for a home church for a few years for our family,  it was such a relief to feel at home at literally the first service. So many churches feel like a concert with dark lighting/closed windows, but the service is bright and welcoming.  They have contemporary worship music, but still sing the classics. The pastor is an excellent preacher sound in biblical teachings with a fun sense if humor. Try it, you will love it! I attended LWF while I lived in Denver Co. Pastor Peter is one of the most down to earth and transparent people which to me gave his messages real depth. I never really found friends there, but I think that was probably on me.  They have live YouTube services so fortunately for me, I still get to tap into what I liked the most. Extremely friendly church with impeccable grounds keeping. I've never seen trash on the ground or cluttering up the main areas. Only thing they might improve on is the number of spaces but really it seems like they've filled all the land they have available. Absolutely the best pre school care we have ever seen. Focus on Jesus and a focus on things that matter most in a child's life and in the life of the parents of the child. Thank you for all your hard work and dedication to our little ones!

name: Living Word Ahwatukee - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I found my home church! Even though I live in Surprise, AZ, I make the trek over to Ahwatukee for my spiritual growth. Pastor Jeff style of teaching is incredible and simple! Yet as simple as it is, it is profound as well. I also attended and graduated from their Bible College. I love how welcoming everyone is there and you can tell they are genuine about how I am when attending. Thank you for always teaching God's Word and focusing on His Grace as the center to receive understanding from His Word. Everyone is so friendly. Willing to help and pray with you. Sermons are informative and feed your Spirit. Met the Pastors first visit and got a free bible and book. They even have a prayer text line. Definitely stop by if in the neighborhood. You'll feel right at home. This has become Home away from Home. A place where holy spirit hovers and live's are changed, simultaneously.
Warm, fun and inviting.
Pastor's Jeff and Tammy Zubecks in depth knowledge of God's word and thier teachings truly reaches the heart of who one is in Christ.
Living Word Ahwatukee keeps this  'wombed man' growing and flowing with the word of God and THAT'S  freedom. Freedom for me, my children and my children's children.
Getting to gather at any given moment is a gift.
A community in of itself.
I highly suggest stopping in on Sunday at 10am.  Check us out......

We WILL love you and Welcome home!

H. Murray I absolutely love Living Word Ahwatukee! Spirit filled, Friendly, and family focused environment with sermons teaching the truth of God's Word in ways relevant to daily life across all ages. Plenty of Church Family support when needed and various Bible studies throughout the week. My favorite place to be every Sunday! I’ve been part of this church ever since it opened, and it’s been a constant source of encouragement and growth. The people are genuine, the messages are uplifting, and it really feels like home. I’m grateful for everything this church has poured into me and my family. ❤️

name: Living Word Assembly - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Great and loving environment. Me and my family have been coming here for over 3 years. I will not go anywhere else. My son went to the parking lot on his skateboard by himself to practice and was told by one of the lovely church ladies to “Get the hell out”. I understand that he maybe shouldn’t practice there, and maybe you all have had troubles with other skaters, but it pretty much cemented our view of how horrible and self righteous church people can be. Thanks for helping to teach him the Word of God. Oh, and his response to this person was, “Okay. I’m sorry “. Nice going Church “Of Christ”. Way to bring ‘em in.

These people don’t care about their neighbors. I mean maybe some do, but mostly they’re loud. It gets old having to close our windows, or listen to their blaring music. I’ve never been to a church where the members weren’t entitled and mean. Living near this one has not been a good experience.

Between them cursing at my kid, and the indifference to the people living around them, I’m definitely not a fan.

Super loud music and announcer, weekend number two. This is the absolute worst church I've ever dealt with. Entitlement unhinged. We held a funeral service here. They were very caring and supportive and their grounds are lovely. I love the courtyard, it's very serene. Highly recommend them. Amazing people. Living word is a church with very loving members that cares about serving God. The pastor is very grounded on biblical principles and is big on not concentrating on topics that divides the body of Christ. The members are a reflection of his principles. Something that grabbed my attention when I first started to attend was how open they were with the budget.  At the end of the year the congregation gets to see how all the money was spent (including salary for the church staff). They are also very big on supporting missionaries and starting new churches overseas. That’s why my wife and I will continue to financially support Living Word even though we aren’t there anymore. Pretty hard to hate this place! Visited this church this morning, we are looking for a church to attend. I didn’t feel comfortable leaving my 5 year olds in nursing. Kids were out of control chucking balls at each other, they just put a movie on, and gave popcorn. We brought them to learn about God. In service we had communion first thing, at end of service most the people that took communion went up to get saved. That seems backwards to me, I thought you had to be saved before you partake. I was very disappointed I wonder out of all these churches is there any that fear God!😪

name: Living Word Christian Center
reviewSummary: Excellent worship/preaching!!! Give this church a try, you will not be disappointed. Will come again if passing through. Thank you! I can honestly feel the Spirit every service here. Please pay a visit. Very welcoming and caring people with awesome worship services and sermons This church is amazing. The people here truly love the Lord and love the move of God. Holy Spirit filled!! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Living Word Christian Center by CMB Ministries - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: I want to visit this place someday as soon as this pandemic is over 👏🏻👏🏻 Blessings to the LivingWCC family

name: Living Word Christian Church - Dalton Campus
Living Word Christian Fellowship - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary: From day 1 I felt like family. Husband and I have been attending for about 13- 14 years. Pastor Dyer married us😍 Come and feel the love that our congregation has to offer as well as it's a really positive experience in getting to know God and finding your purpose in Him A wonderful group of people that will embrace you just as you are! On my way now to rejoice... 100℅ Warm, friendly church.

name: Living Word Church - Burkhardt - Dayton Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing place to come and worship.  Come as you are.  Laid back dress code. Be ready to have great preaching. This is an awesome place to worship and enjoy being into the presence of God. The pastor preaches simple easy to understand sermons I recommend this to any and all looking for a church. This church is dedicated to the neighborhood. It is a spirit-filled church put there to help. God is bigger than addiction, bigger than poverty, and bigger than trafficking. Love what Living Word Church is doing in downtown Dayton! This is a great place to serve the community and to be a part of a great church! Great place for moral support

name: Living Word Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church.This is my home church. Pastor and tge congregation are very loving and kind Great service, friendly staff. Went there with Wounded Beach Retreat to celebrate the dinner and service that had for the Veterans, Thank you for all you do , Awesome worship experience along with some good solid teaching from the Bible. Faith building experience every visit. Was very thankful it was after we had my sister Donna's funeral Everyone is welcoming. Pastor Miller is great at making the Bible understandable.

name: Living Word Community
reviewSummary: It was a beautiful Church cozy for a mid size community of worshippers. Their focus is on worship and outreach to the poor. I was blessed to be given a tour by the wife of the pastor Dr. Seema Freer and Mr. Ted. May the Church be blessed abundantly. Moving to Philadelphia for my new job, I have visited many churches in order to find my new home church where the Holy Sprit of the Lord is leading. I visited big churches with good reviews. However, it was very difficult to connect with leaders and congregations in those mega churches. One day, I was introduced to the Living World Community located on Cherry and 17th during their outdoor biweekly workshop. I immediately knew that the Holy Spirit presence, God announted leadership, and fully devoted christ followers in this church. I highly recommend to any Christ followers who are looking for church with genuine love for Christ, and the brothers and sisters in church ...and the city of Philadelphia. Since day one I felt so welcome, the community here is the best thing that could ever happened in my life. Just moved from a different country and now I feel that I really belong. Is definitely a Community church,  folks are friendly like family and they are there to support one other.  The Word of God is preach and the love of God flows through the people in the community. A very welcoming congregation that meets the needs of their local community in so many ways!

name: Living Word Family Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
I was very pleased with my visit to Living Word Family Church today.
You are greeted with warm, and friendly faces as soon as you enter the parking lot. The presence of the fruits of God’s loving spirit is spread all across this church.

I was very impressed with the many opportunities that are in place to help with your spiritual practices, growth, relationships, and faith.  There are many ongoing classes and programs set up for all age groups from childhood to adulthood.

It was also a delight for me to be able to worship in a very diverse environment which is not easy to find.  Diversity is certainly in Heaven and it should be in God’s house of worship on this Earth.  Which is how God created his people.

Pastor Micah does an excellent job of explaining the scriptures and speaking on behalf of our Father in Heaven.  The music was perfect. Today was my first time visiting, I thoroughly enjoyed the service (11:30 AM)! I was met with such Grace, warmth, joy, & compassion! I enjoyed the praise & worship, the Word of GOD was right on time, thank you so much (Minister Charlene); she blessed me so! I am looking forward to continuing. Grateful that my steps were ordered today! ✝️📖🙏🏽❤️ I started coming here a few years ago. Just recent became re-aquainted with church. Did another church close by which grew from 600 followers at Sanderson High school to 16000 now at Milbrook campus. LWFC with Micah at the wheel is a church which today I join officially. This is the church home I attend.
3 services offered on Sunday, first Wednesday of the month we have communion, worship & prayer. My church is family focused, on parents, children, grandparents & any other adult figure in a child's life that is leading their family into a God centered life .
We have a welcoming team (in which I volunteer weekly) and several other church based teams so that our services run smoothly as possible. We offer nursery care, junior kid's church, kids church, and 24/7 (6th-12th grades). We have several small groups (group activities/study the Word) & are able to get to know one another in a smaller settings, encouraging great relationships being built here.
Join us on Sunday, at 8a, 9:45a (this service available online), and 11:30a.
Have a blessed day. 😊 If you're looking for a fun friendly family focused church check us out!
Bible based no judgement sound teaching

name: Living Word Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: A traditional Lutheran congregation in the Katy/west Houston area with a warm family community.

name: Living Word Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Living world Church took my family and I in a year ago. I was a non believer but my wife encouraged me to go to church. We have family members who are apart of this church and everyone here is very welcoming. Pastor Frey took the time to get to know us and spent every week outside of service to teach us about Lutheran Christianity. He covered all my questions I had and has helped me understand what it is to be a Christian. My daughters love the kids Sunday school where there are a lot of other kids ranging from 2 years old to teens. We love our church and the people in it. I read the 1 star review but did not find video they were talking about. It’s hard to believe since the members have been very kind to everyone who has come and gone. If you’re looking for a traditional Lutheran church or a church in general to help you under learn and understand the Gospel,  this is definitely a place to check out. I'm moving to Mission Viejo soon and was looking for a Lutheran Church to attend I googled/ YouTube your church and wow I was surprised by the actions of the members. How they handle the couple on the sidewalk by confronting them demanding they leave. Calling the sheriff department on them. That was very concerning, it could have been handled so much differently. In the beginning I thought it was going to be a great encounter turned out that the church members turned on the photographers shame on Living Word Lutheran Church Members. Plus having one of your church members follow them was very concerning also. I realize this is an old video maybe a few months ago hopefully the members have a change of heart but I cannot attend the church whose actions are not Christian like. Hopefully they prayed for forgiveness. I just downloaded the sermon of 1/17/16 to my smartphone. Now I can play it again anytime.

Pastor Frey records and posts his sermons on the church’s website. The Transfiguration Sermon really touched me. He talks about billions of Galaxies, Buddha, and of course Jesus.

We are privileged to have such a pastor. He is brilliant and faithful to the Word. Pastor Dave is an avid listener. Beautiful soul and a contented preacher. His Church is small enough to know you and big enough to  minister to your spiritual needs. Everyone should visit this Church. Pastor preaches the true word of God

reviewSummary: This church is so welcoming . Everytime I come I feel welcomed.

name: Living Word of Los Angeles - Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Had a very nice guy come by our business selling giant chocolate bars to raise money for the center.. He was great and I think this is a cause we should all support. Amazing worship and a Holy Spirit filled message really empowers and changes people from all places in life. God is good. Holy Spirit is alive in this church,and the worship team is amazing. The pastor and pastora are amazing love them Excellent church...great pastors... dedicated and look out for people Love it whent there and the people dont look at you like a stranger, they look at us like family.

name: Living Word Ontario Christian Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Living Word Ontario is a church that loves God and treats everyone like family. A must visit

name: Living Word Scottsdale - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: This is my home church. I started coming here with my family in junior high and a decade later I still attend on my own accord. The teaching is solid and uplifting. There is a variety of times to attend as well as types of teaching. Attend a few different services to get the feel of which service and pastor is best suited for you. I recommend my church to anyone looking for a new home church or just looking for a church for the first time. Get involved in the different classes and groups. That is the best way to get connected and like church. The people, on whole, are really nice and very accepting. Friendly congregation and lively praise music. Service gives praise to our Creator in an innovative, uplifting connection. No watered down message here. Come as you are. People of all races and nationalities feel at home. This Church is Amazing! Only God could build a church that loves like this. Living Word Scottsdale is AWESOME.  Come check it out. Absolutely love the pastors and the congregation.   Very friendly and open. ALL

name: Livingstone Christian Assembly, Columbia, MD
reviewSummary: This is a great church. Its family friendly.  The pastor is a wonderful man of God who inspired me to trust God. His word of knowledge always come to pass and I am grateful to God for using him to bless us through Jesus Christ the son of God. It is a perfect church, the people are so kind, and nice, I have been in this church for a long  time and I recommend this church for you guys who are seeing it. A friendly church, great sermon and so impacting.

name: livingStone Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
If you live here or you’re on vacation in the area and looking for an awesome Church to attend and be uplifted, then livingStone is the place!  From the the very first time my husband and I attended we felt welcomed and accepted.  The people here are so friendly, caring and have become family.  Pastor Chris does a phenomenal job sharing God's word and breaking it down in a way that is easy for everyone to understand. If you love worship music, we have a fabulous worship band.   We also have a wonderful youth ministry.  Come worship with us, you won’t be disappointed. This is a wonderful place! Folks are welcoming and friendly. Great music. Pastor is by the Word, very relatable and always gives ways to apply his message to your everyday life. We love it and consider Living Stone our home church whenever we're in St. Augustine. There's no need to feel shy. Give it a try. You won't be disappointed!! Pastor Chris has a way of teaching the Bible like no other! We were welcomed from the first steps in the door. The music is amazing. Lots of support and fellowship and the Youth Group is solid. Best church in St Augustine area! Livingstone church is a wonderful place to worship.  Chris, the pastor, communicates the word of God like very few can with a transparent, down to earth personality.
The music is worshipful and the people are very friendly and inviting.  Saint Augustine is fortunate to have  a Bible preaching church such as this one.  If you haven’t done so, do yourself a favor and check it out. We are in St. Augustine on vacation and attended service here. The sermon was thought-provoking and Biblically based. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. There are plenty of opportunities for the congregation to meet outside of Sundays.  This would make a lovely home church for anyone living in the area.

name: Local Christian Assembly - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Seven Thunder Message Foundation Real True Church Bride of Jesus Christ.... Jesus Christ the same yesterday,today and forever !!! The great word church!! apostolic church. I Love the true Church of God A wonderful place of worship.

name: Local Church Canton - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
It's always worth it to find a local church when traveling. We enjoyed wonderful worship and an amazingly timed message at Local Church Canton. We look forward to the continuing series online over the next few weeks.

Chris and Sarah Smith Local Church Canton is a very special place. Our family had looked for some time trying to find a place to plug in and hit the ground running. I cannot say enough good things about the atmosphere of the Church, but I will say that it has always felt like home. If you’re looking for a place to plug in; and to call home. Give local a chance to love on you like they have my family. I promise, you will not be disappointed. Local has been my home for 4 years, give or take &  it was the best decision I ever made. They made feel I found a family from the second I walked through that door the first time. We have 2 super awesome pastors who bring the word with passion & enthusiasm every week. Amazing worship band, great kids ministry, feel free to join us, it’ll be the best decision you ever made. We were in town and decided to check out a local church and found Local. We were greeted at the door and then received a first time bag with gifts, we were then given a personalized tour of the facility and shown exactly where everything was. Loved the openness of the space and the community connections. The associate pastor gave a great and challenging message. Worship was wonderful. My wife and I have been attending church for the past 25 years and it was time to start a new journey to find another church. We were tired of all the bells + whistles, and hype. We wanted something more organic, less presentation and more of  presence of God. Local Church of Canton checked that box. The vulnerability of the Pastors and people give us the space to slow down, reflect and pray . All this provides a direct benefit to strengthen our walk with Christ !!!!!

name: Local Church Forsyth - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: I love the church, but it seems too "Seeker Oriented". Easter service had people all around me saying, "what does he mean, everything will be all right"? I understand he meant for the believer who was facing certain death, but it came across more like a North Point, Andy Stanley service. It needed to be more clear what happens if you don't believe. I mean it's the day we celebrate Jesus resurrection to save us from hell. The saved seats and reserved seats really is a turn off and puts several people like me, sitting in the lobby because someone "saved half a row" in between empty reserved seats. I hate to say it but I feel the Lord is directing me to a true Bible teaching Church and not just the pastor's experiences relating to a small portion of a verse. I love Chris and pray for him, but I see yet another church where fame hurts the church and fosters watered down services to make anyone feel like they're just fine how they are now and nothing is said that might be uncomfortable. I can't imagine Peter giving a service like here, he would have spent time on Jesus' words, not his experiences from the previous week that had nothing to do with Jesus. I pray for churches to value their believers first. My husband and I went for the first time 3/22/26. The volunteers and greeters are nice. The church is beautiful and clean. Pastor  Chris does an amazing job and we appreciate all that he brings to his sermon - authenticity, historical context of scripture and relevancy and application for "today".  We appreciated the video of the couple sharing their life experience as well. As much as we appreciate the hard work that goes into the musical production and performances by talented musicians and vocalists, our main complaint is that the MUSIC IS WAY TOO LOUD. There are people with neurological conditions who suffer from migraines in which exposure to loud sounds is excruciating. Sounds at or above 85 dB can cause permanent damage to auditory nerve cells (leading to permanent hearing loss). I suppose that we can either watch sermons from home, wear ear plugs during music segment, or look for another church. Also, we would prefer some classical hymns mixed in there, less time on music overall, and more time on the sermon. This is truly a nice church but we are wondering if we are "too old" for this one, lol. There’s a reason they turned off the comments on their YouTube channel. It’s a good church if you want to punch you’re, “I went to church this week card”. But not much else. The pastor is kind of a coward, and does not deal with issues as they come up. People in leadership, randomly leave with no explanation all the time. The ladies that lead worship are constantly vying for attention, it’s more like a bad concert, than worship. We left after 8 years. And in two months we have 10x the community at our new church. It’s entertaining and they will get you in and out in an hour. But don’t expect anything more. The closest thing they have for community is their serve days. We’ve been attending this church since 2025. It’s great to see so many young people attending, and I think the local church does a great job attracting them. However, I’m concerned that Pastor Chris struggles to convey the Bible’s message to us, and we are having a difficult time connecting with the church. I believe Pastor Chris has good intentions, but ultimately, only God can confirm that. I have been attending Local for nearly two years. This past Sunday, I left feeling disappointed. I completely understand that the Church aims to grow and that funding does not appear out of thin air; however, the entire service on March 1st focused on the new expansion project intended to add more seating and amenities. I think that dedicating 10 to 15 minutes to this topic would have sufficed before transitioning to the word of God. If more time was necessary to discuss the project, it would be more suitable to schedule a separate day and time for that discussion. It is important to recognize that at every service, there may be individuals who have never attended your church and are in need of hearing the word of God. If I were to bring someone who is facing challenges in their life and is considering giving the Church a chance, attending your service on 3/1/26 might deter them from doing so. This review is not intended to criticize the Church; rather, it is meant to convey that a brief mention of the project followed by a focus on the true essence of the Church—learning and dedicating oneself to the Lord Jesus Christ—would be beneficial. Please keep in mind that there may be new attendees each week who need to hear their pastor speak about Jesus, rather than spending an entire hour discussing the Church expansion project.

name: Local Church St. Pete
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to Local Church St Pete for just about a year now. As a renewed follower of Christ, it is so impactful to be apart of a loving community where the Holy Spirit is present, and the gospel is proclaimed. Pastor Daryn does wonderful expository preaching, and his reliance on accurate biblical teaching is refreshing and inspiring. The community here is warm, kind, and hospitable. When I look for a church, I look for two things : accurate scripture teaching, and loving community. I believe you cannot live without those two things, and everything else is a bonus. Fortunately, those are present here and the worship is also amazing! Come check it out! Pastor Daryn has a passion for worship and expository Biblical teaching. It's a young church plant associated with Gulf Coast Community Church, Acts 29, and Leader's Collective. I had a great experience. I enjoyed the contemporary worship and practical teaching. I also like the fact that there are quite a number of young families and yet it is still generationally diverse Local Church St Pete is a true spiritual home in the heart and "heart" of St Petersburg.  It's a church truly and faithfully built on the word of God and is evident within the church in true discipleship of Christ Jesus.  Every Sunday is a sermon and a bible study in one. Worship moves through the congregation with the Holy Spirit with no smoke machine or drum shell but through truly gifted musicians and vocalists faithful to the Lord and you can actually hear the people around you singing along in praise.   Local is led by a team of humble, transparent and accountable vocational and non-vocational pastors and, while there are no "stars" at Local, Pastor Daryn is a faithful, inspired/inspiring and gifted lead pastor.  The leadership team is otherwise well integrated into the congregation through discipleship groups, house groups and a true heart of welcome and hospitality at each and every service. All generations and many walks of life are represented here and families with children are an ever growing segment with Local Kids and Local Youth ministries available to them each Sunday.  There is no time given to political, cultural or social platforms but only a devotion to discipleship in Christ and a heart of hospitality, fellowship, prayer and local and international missions work.   If you are seeking a church that is alive in Christ, where the power of the Holy Spirit is palpable, where your uniqueness and brokenness are not only welcomed but acknowledged and loved, where the supernatural, spiritual gifts and the power of prayer is acknowledged as part of a daily walk with Christ, not an idol, Local Church may be for you.  Difficult questions are encouraged and addressed lovingly and compassionately.  I started attending Local Church in 2023 after nearly 40 years of worldly spiritual practices and beliefs of all kinds.  When I began to share my back ground with the pastors I was heard, with sincere interest, and encouraged on my path and to share my experience with others.  We are all encouraged so that we may understand each other better with humility that puts us all, equally, at the foot of Jesus. Visited the church with my son.  I can see why many like to attend here. I was visiting St. Pete and went to Local Church for worship. I was warmly welcomed. It's a super chill and laid-back vibe at the church. Lots of families and kids. I appreciate it that the pastor and his wife noticed I was new there and introduced me to other people. They see everyone in their congregation and try to make everyone feel loved and taken care of. Everyone else at the church is super nice as well. I highly recommend this church.

name: Local City Church
reviewSummary: I've been attending this church since the very first day they launched and I can proudly say this is HOME. I've found a community here that has helped me feel accepted no matter where I stand in life. If you are looking for somewhere to grow you relationship with God, your Local community, and yourself, then I hope to see you on Sunday :) One of our major concerns we contemplated while considering a move to Tampa 3 years ago was finding a church HOME to continue worshiping, growing our faith and serving by doing. Local City provides all of that and more. We are so thankful. During our stay in Tampa we went to Local city church on the Sunday, before Tropical storm. I couldn’t stop crying! Thank you Holy Spirit for always showing up, when needed. Pastor was Amazing! We've been 2 times now.  Love having this church right in my neighborhood.  Love the reputation they have built with the school.  Heard great report from a friend who is an administrator at Hillsborough high school.  The music is well done,  preaching alive, interesting,  on the spot in doctrine and Jesus is presented and represented in a way I feel makes His heart happy and brings a smile to His face.  It's definitely worth a try if you are seeking answers to life's hard questions or just need something bigger than yourself. Local City Church is home to us. Everyone treats you as one of their own. When my 17 year old daughter told me she wanted to give it a try, I thought it was just going to be a temporary thing. To my surprise she has felt comfortable there since day one. Yes I say surprise because we all know how teenagers are very quick to change their minds. I have sat and have stood next to my daughter and seen how she has been touched by the power of God. When I saw her tears running down her face I felt joy and knew that she was comfortable at Local City Church. God is one in the same no matter where you worship him. I am glad that she has found it in her heart to allow us to call Local City Church home.

name: Log Cabin Community - Smyrna / Vinings Campus
reviewSummary: They love playing loud music for weddings and receptions knowing they have communities within walking distance. Invest in sound proofing your reception hall so people don’t have to hear bass all day on a Saturday. I just photographed a small intimate wedding here and It makes for a great backdrop for small events. It is a historic church and has plenty of charm. The windows are photogenic and the front of the chapel with the vibrant red door are also great backdrops. I was married here 10 years ago and it is an absolutely beautiful place. They were very accommodating and made everything so easy. This charming chapel is such a beautiful spot for a small and intimate wedding ceremony! The red door makes for the perfect spot for bride and groom portraits. Just had my wedding in this church and it was great. They were very accommodating and the church is beautiful. I highly recommend you use this church for any of your events.

name: Logos Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
They have excelled in creating a community. I've never felt so welcomed. The people are amazing in this church!
Pastor Andrea preaches in a way where everything is referenced and I love that. I do feel like I walk away having learned something every time. My wife and I love this church.  It's friendly and inviting with an emphasis on expository preaching.  They preach the Word of God. It's a great place to expand your knowledge of the scripture and grow in your faith. All ages are represented. I highly recommend this church. As a bonus, there are plenty of great places in the area to eat after the church service. Are you looking for a new church? Are you tired of a watered-down Gospel message? Look no further than Logos Church, a beacon of reformed theology and expositional teaching and preaching. Stepping into Logos Church feels like entering a family gathering rather than a consumer-driven event. But what truly sets Logos Church apart is how attending becomes a transformative journey, an unparalleled opportunity to grow your relationship with God like never before. Here, the depth of theology intertwines seamlessly with the warmth of a familial atmosphere, creating an extraordinary environment for spiritual enrichment and connection. A church that loves people, and puts the preaching of the Word of God first and foremost.  Big emphasis on family, and the church loving and serving one another.  A small congregation but not cliquey, they make everyone feel welcome. I love Logos church from the people that are creating a community of family, the worship music reaching to spirit and soul speaking directly to your heart, and the preaching. I have sat under many pastors and never learned a depth of teaching Pastor Andrea brings. Listen to Pastor Andrea encourages me to learn the Bible on my own.

name: Lone Hill Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary: Solid doctrine and a legit desire to please God. Pastor Gary preaches the whole counsel of God and didn't compromise even when most churches closed their doors so that we couldn't gather together for the glory of Christ Jesus. They preach verse by verse one book at a time and fellowship together after each service. We have been attending for about a year and have been very blessed. They even have a radio show called abounding grace. It’s a slower pace, but very focused on God and how to serve His world. Very loving people inside that truly care. It was a good place to pray 🙏. It was a very calm experience. Wonderful caring people

name: Long Beach Christian Fellowship - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church I've ever attended! People are friendly and welcoming, and the pastors, Danny, Mary, and Barb, are wonderful people. We've made lots of friends and really see the love of Christ in this space. My husband and I really believe we have found our home. I was pleasantly surprised.  The worship time was meaningful and the word was spot on.  There was a genuineness to the place.  A lot of good things going on here.  As a new person, I always see how welcoming the congregation is to the new person.  It's one of the things i look for when I am looking for a church.  Will check it out again, before I decide. Has been my church home for almost 20 years. So much love and healing in this place. LGBTQ, friendly, hoping one day they will be openly and fully affirming. The finest church in the LBC. Gentle, helpful and Godly people here. Dedicated to bettering themselves and the community in which they live. The Pastors are lively and willing to teach us in a basic way. For a person who has never really felt very comfortable in a church setting I feel very "at home" here. Try it out. In an odd area but you can find it. BEST CHURCH EVER! AND ITS AMAZING GO GO GO!
God bless! (he has blessed you if you look at this review because now you know about this church and are slightly intrigued. go to our sunday service. learn to live and love like Jesus.)

reviewSummary:
When is my end. Where is my sword. Where is my zord. And where is my ord.

My ord versus your bike. Your bic versus mejor. My best versus your bet.

My life.

En you're hans. The Sunday nights and Thursday morning services are very comforting. Pastor Brooks and Will have excellent prayers for comfort. All my brothers are awesome This church and its organization has always been there as an outreach for the broken and homeless individuals and family's,  Supplying breakfast on Thursday and dinner on Sundays evenings. There's always a church service before each meal. During these passed two plus years of the COVID-19 pandemic they have never faltered nor abandoned the homeless as other outreaches have. That in itself speaks volumes to me. I was able to enjoy a fine morning meal of scrambled eggs with meat stew and a slice of bread. Included, was a morning service with donuts and coffee. Some left a couple bucks the better. Love this place.They serve breakfast Thursday morning + give out money, serve dinner Friday noon time + give out money and serve lunch Sunday evening. Thank god.

name: Long Beach Lutheran Social Services - Food Distribution Center - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: It's amazing help in time of need...I'm so grateful for this place... Very nice people and caring. I told one of the guys "my fridge has never been so bare" he was kind enough to hook me up I haven't been yet but I've been but it has been referred by two different social services people that told me that they can help me with a few resources, housing, food, homeless and legal advice gteatful for this place for giving to the community.

name: Long Island Grace Christian Church - Village of Garden City Campus
Longmont Church of Christ - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
If you want a Christian community of Faith, with a healthy teaching of the Bible and with human and organic leadership, this is the perfect community for you and your family.  It is the best Christian Church in Longmont; come and check it out.  People of all generations, new, medium, and older.  Excellent programs for your children, youth, marriages, and much more.  Leaders committed to the flock that leaves the 99 to look for the lost sheep—leadership with a very clear vision of the future of the Church.  God is really working through his spirit mightily in this Church.  They are a group of Christians who want to practice and resemble the Church of the First Century as much as possible in the book of Acts of the Apostles in the contemporary context.  Best of all is a Church with a multiethnic, multiracial and multicultural vision.  All races, colors, and nationalities have a place in this great family.  There are worship services in English and also in Spanish.  The entire program of the Church is designed to bless English and Spanish speakers simultaneously as they worship God as a one Family in Christ. Scriptural (and bilingual) Bible study and praise worship! Beautiful acapella singing! Health clinic nearby, children's home (age 6 and up), community garden and chickens, benevolent and compassionate people! Amazing community ministries. 💞 My experience with this church is as a client of some of the non-profit enterprises who operate from their space. I am not a member of their congregation, but in the unlikely event I find myself looking for a different church home I would certainly take a look at this Church of Christ. The community endeavors they support include medical care, education, and mental health. They share their facility in a way which to my mind is exactly the way Christ wants us all to use the resources we have. I have been around this Nation of ours throughout my Life and I ended up in this little town Longmont,I have never met under one roof as many beautiful kind Souls and genuine humble and grateful who genuinely are the definition of ones who love life and do there part to make this world we live in a better place filled with love and care respect kindness and always willing to put there hand out and pick you up when your down and give you the strength to carry on through good or bad days, The medical staff is hands down better than any big hospital or other clinic, The care they put into your needs so that your well taken care of and well informed is a priority to them ensuring your at your most complete calm relaxed visit during your appointment, Today I will be walking over to spend my morning at service with everyone and starting my day with having my soul infused with the Lord's message.
I shall to do my part to carry on the same message and attitude to be a positive influence on my community.
God Bless They cool I guess

name: Longview Christian Church - Longview Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful place that we recently discovered of beautifully messy, Christ-seeking brothers and sisters whom we now call family.  If you are looking for the real deal of genuine, loving people of all ages and backgrounds, then come and find out for yourself.  You will be blessed, as will we in meeting you! The people of this church really step up to help strangers! They have excellent programs for addicted people, and are non judgemental! They are a true Christian community! This wonderful Church testifies that above all things  - God is Holy. Came here for a funeral and to take pictures. Had a wonderful time with close friends. Great sermon on John 18.

Grandsons baptism was a great experience for any grandparents to see very nice place Great place to worship

name: Lord Of Harvest - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Since I came in America year 2001, I've been attending here, Praise the Lord. I like their Vision. Passion for God, Empower Disciples & Reach people. I Thank God for directing  my steps in this Church. Lord of Harvest-LA. They are doing a great job. All for God's glory.
By the grace of God they have Filipino Worship, And English & Spanish. I am truly grateful to be part of Lord of Harvest LA. In a time when many people are searching for purpose, truth, and genuine relationships, I have found this church to be a place where Christ is not just talked about—He is genuinely lived out.

What has impacted me the most is the love of the people. From the pastors to the members, I have experienced sincere care, encouragement, and a desire to see one another grow in our walk with God. This is not a place where people simply attend a service and go home; it is a church family that prays together, serves together, and helps each other become more like Christ.

The preaching is rooted in God's Word and continually points us back to Jesus. I appreciate that the focus is not on entertainment or popularity, but on discipleship, spiritual growth, and living out our faith in everyday life.

Through Lord of Harvest, I have seen people transformed by God's grace, families strengthened, and believers challenged to deepen their relationship with Christ. The church has helped me grow spiritually and has reminded me what the body of Christ should look like—a community of imperfect people pursuing a perfect Savior.

No church is perfect, but I can honestly say that Lord of Harvest LA is a place where people genuinely love Jesus, love His Word, and strive to love others as He commanded. name: Los Altos United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: We used this church as the venue for our wedding ceremony in 2018. They were very accommodating and it was a beautiful venue. Traditional but still had a fresh modern feel. We used minimal florals and greenery, along with a string quartet and it was perfect. I love this church.. so many wonderful memories here. My family went here all through the 80s and early 90s. We moved away since, but would love to visit again when in the area.🥰 Looks big, but plays small; has great acoustics which serves the community by its affiliation with CSULB School Of Music, hosting choral competitions, brass & wind ensembles, etc.  They also make space available for local meetings of AA, etc. at reasonable rates. Located at Woodruff & Willow, with an onramp to NB fwy 405, it is a welcoming place Mon-Sun for God ttto hang His/Her, + Hat. One of our members is also a long-time church member so I don't believe we were charged for the use of it. Attended Chair Yoga 2x a week.  The class is held in a classroom on premise, and conducted by a licensed instructor.  The cost/recommended donation is $5 per session, and each session lasts 1 hr.

name: Los Angeles Reformed Presbyterian - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: We visited here during our honeymoon. We love this place so much. And we heard a Bible-worthy sermon, and the fantastic people here welcomed us like family in God. It was a place I would love to come back if I came to visit la next time. I was in California for the week and had the privilege of visiting this lovely church. I can’t speak to things long-term, of course, but the  preaching was biblically solid, the singing of psalms was beautiful, and the fellowship following the service was so warm and welcoming! If I was in the area, I would definitely go again! Great Preaching, sound doctrine, Christ centered, worship is beautiful! The voices singing the Psalms in this church made me feel like I was in the throne room of heaven! Sunday school classes for all ages, I really enjoyed the adult class. People are very kind and welcoming. Every week they have lunch together after the service. Good food, friendly people, excellent church. I highly recommend it Such a great place to worship with fellow brothers and sisters in Christ. The preaching is very biblical and Pastor Nathan provides a good amount of points of application towards the end of his sermons so that you're not left scratching your head asking, "How do I apply this sermon message to my life?". He genuinely loves and cares for the flock of Christ as well. Make sure to stay for the fellowship meal and afternoon service that follows! It is such a wonderful time to meet other brothers and sisters in the Lord. Thanks be to God for providing this ministry in the Los Angeles area. I have been to LA 5 times and everytime, I’ve come here.

name: Los Angeles Temple Visitors' Center - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
What a beautiful historic place!! Brought my mom here for Mother’s Day. We were greeted with kind smiles all around. We looked at all the displays and watched some interactive videos. It was awesome to learn about the history of the temple and how and when it was built. Highly recommend coming here if you’re an active member of the LDS. The landscape is stunning. Very serene and peaceful. Beautiful ground to explore. Easy parking,  the center itself is very modern with display and hands on experience. There is also a kids corner to do things.  Good for entire family.
Staff are super nice and knowledgeable of the church.
If it is a good weather,  take a stroll outside the visitor center.  The ground is so nice. A remarkable place to feel peace and learn about the temple! I have loved whenever I go, it's such a refuge. I didn’t get to see everything on 6/20/25 but I hadn’t been in many years and there are some amazing updates, including a tomb-like area with depictions of the life of Jesus Christ. There were friendly missionaries (sisters) that greeted my wife and me. I want to go on their tour next time. The pictures I took do not give July justice as I am not very good at taking them… Also there was a question on the review about tickets and I wanted to clarify that it is free. I suppose depending on the day or time it would be more busy but when I was there in the afternoon  just after 1:30 on a Friday there weren’t a lot of people. My group traveled from over 700 miles and we showed up 20 minutes before the visitor center closed. Even though we had showed up so late the senior missionaries were so welcoming and inviting. The hospitality they gave us and the way they made our group feel so comfortable was extremely nice. They even took the time and stayed late after shift to give us a full tour of all there exhibits and even explained an event they were having soon. That was such a selfless act of Christlike love. The LA Temple visitor center is a must see if you've ever been curious about LDS temples or religion.

name: Louisville Church of Christ - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is definitely not a traditional church of Christ. Classes start at 10:00 AM. 11:00 AM is the time they have worship services.

First, everyone is super friendly and kind and welcoming. The preacher is great and the teacher of the class was great as well.

Here is what is different:
They have a worship band with instruments.
They partake communion all as one - the bread and the grape juice at the same time. They have women participate in various aspects of worship.

If you are looking for a traditional Church of Christ to visit, you will have to look somewhere else.

If you want a warm, friendly, and welcoming environment that has some aspects of a traditional church of Christ, this church is perfect! This is a remarkable church of followers of Christ. Though not perfect they strive to follow, teach, live and love like the bible. Each visit I have visited Louisville i stayed with a family from the church and it was very inspiring. Thunder over Louisville and Valentine's Day are just two of the church's amazing annual must-see must-attend events. Sunday worship is pretty cool too. This church is a very diverse group of people who genuinely live the teachings of Jesus out. Five years ago I was invited out for the first time and they studied the Bible with me personally and helped me develop a real relationship with God living as Jesus’ disciple. I was so encouraged to see so many different kinds of people, it not something I was used to seeing in church growing up. 100 STARS! The Louisville Church has been like my Family since 1980. Whether you are just visiting from out of town  or are looking for a place to call your "Church Home", you will feel welcome. It's a very inclusive place where there is color, economic, educational, political, cultural, age, even fashion blindness. None of that stuff matters. Just come as you are and if you have a Bible, bring it because you will use it. If you don't have one, that's ok too, we have plenty there. The messages are all about learning to understand God's Word and how to APPLY it to our lives. Bring your kids and your voices to sing praises to God, and yes, we use instruments to praise him as King David did with his harp and lyre in the Old Testament.  You will soon want to get involved in one of our many local Family Groups which support each other and study the Bible together. It's great! Check us out! Went there for the first time last weekend for a retreat. The church was very hospitable and loving! Plus that lesson was fire!! Afterwards, we had fellowship time over lunch. It felt like family and will definitely be back!!

name: Love Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Love Church truly feels like home! From the moment I started attending, I felt so welcomed and loved by this community. The people here have shown up for me in such genuine ways and have honestly become like family.

There’s something really special about this church — the love, kindness, and sense of community are unlike anywhere else I’ve experienced. I always leave feeling encouraged, cared for, and closer to Jesus.

If you’re looking for a church in San Diego where you can truly belong, be known, and feel loved, I cannot recommend Love Church enough! Such a wonderful church! A growing and thriving community full of servant-hearted people in every season of life. Pastor Matt faithfully brings the word each and every week—every sermon is thoughtful and relevant to our lives. This is a new church plant and it’s so cool to see how God is already moving here! Come join us on Sunday mornings at 10am! There is a seat for you. So welcoming and supportive, whether you come from a Bible beating background or have never known God. These people are incredible and I would recommend this church to anyone in San Diego! This church redefined my definition of “church”. This is a place of discipleship , transparency & following Jesus in EVERY area of our lives. They’ve really impacted my family by not trying to be perfect but walking with us through some of the UGLIEST things you could’ve imagined & not sugar coating a thing. 10/10 recommend!! Not a perfect church but a real one that’s for sure . Oh and my kids love it ! Love Church is exactly what the name says everybody is very accepting. There’s no judgment and I enjoy that. we would love to see you at church on this Sunday

name: Love City Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: The message of this church brought me back to becoming a believer after straying so far away from Home.  God bless Vince and all the pastors, the music ministry, the childcare ministry and all of the people who volunteer their time - as well as the congregation and community that are so welcoming and inviting.  If you are lost and in need of a new Home, the doors are open. Great Fellowship. Three Churches sharing the Good Friday night. Better Together. Valley, Vineyard and Love City, the host. Blessed and Encouraged 🙏🙏🙏. Thank you 😊 One of the few places that truly preach the Gospel.  Very kind and caring people also.  Great place to call home. This Church was my vessel for life changing experiences and a love for the Members that will last forever. A bunch of people who really love Jesus, really love people and really love each other! So grateful for my LCC family!!

name: Love Lake Norman - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
I have attended Love Lake Norman for over 5 years and highly recommend. We learned about the church thru a mailer and were blown away by how genuine and real everyone was. The pastor and the staff are fantastic and you feel a real a sense of community from the first visit. What I love best is being able to meet new people every week and serve in our community together. Bonus is that we have a lot of fun at church too! So glad we found a church that engages individuals right where you are - everyone is welcome! Love Lake Norman's name is so fitting. This group strives to permeate every single aspect of this church -- from the hospitality, to the messages, the community outreach, to the music -- with true love and fellowship. Very welcoming to all, regardless of where they are in their individual journey of getting to know Christ.
We love calling this church home! I’ve been attending Love Lake Norman since September 2018 after moving to the area. I served with Phil Hamrick at a previous church and always respected his leadership and heart for God. Once I knew he serving at Love Lake Norman I knew where my new church home would be!
My first service I attended I walked in and immediately saw even MORE familiar faces… again… a God thing!

Jerel is an AMAZING leader as well as the rest of the staff, which I’ve come to be very close friends with.

So in short… once you attend a service at Love Lake Norman… you’re “home”. :) I’ve been attending Love Lake Norman since 2019. My favorite things about my church…warm greetings, amazing people, inspirational messages, absolutely incredible music, a cool relaxed atmosphere, opportunities to serve my community and opportunities to connect and learn more about God’s love with all of my new friends. Join us! My husband and I started attending during COVID when Love LKN was meeting in the parking lot. It is a welcoming and open church with a real message you can apply to daily living. The staff and all who serve make you feel right at home.

name: Love Story Church - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
All due respect… & it’s sad to say but this church is a joke. The morals and values aren’t there. It’s a show. It’s an ego boost. I’ll keep looking for a church.

I’m realizing now, anyone can call themselves a pastor. Only a few actually are. No hate. But wow. Can't be explained only experienced! The presence of the lord is definitely there! I love this place of worship! 😍 I have been watching Relentless on line for awhile so since I was in Greenville for the weekend, I just had to attend their New Years Eve service. My children and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The music, delcarations, prayers and sermon were Godled and right ontime! I will come back and visit when I am in Greenville again! Church is a strong reach..more like a tv show or concert with very little message. Don’t recommend if you want actual worship and learning. Very performative the pastor does not seem genuine. Bunch of praise breaks and jokes I became a member of Love Story Church last year & was recently baptized there this year. I knew this would be my home church because of my first visit. My family and I, were greeted with friendly faces, hugs, and handshakes. Every staff member makes you feel welcomed. Pastor John and his wife is so anointed. He always gives a good message and leave me in tears. Love Story Church is a no judgement zone & they’re always finding ways to give back to the community here in Greenville SC. They gave away tons of food water and clothes to the community during Hurricane Helene to members and nonmembers. I’ll always plant my seeds at Love Story. I even met an awesome therapist at the Women Relish Conference last year thanks to Pastor Aventer. I’m proud to finally be a member of a church who’s for the community and not just for taking up offerings.

name: Loving Savior of the Hills - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I have had three kids attend Loving Savior Preschool and the teachers and staff have become family. My kids wake up excited to go to school; to participate in the activities, see their friends and hug their teachers. Some of the specific reasons LS has such high value:  Diverse parents and peers who all value a Christian faith foundation.  On site security and secure check in/out. Communication with teachers is constant (in person and via app in real time, so I always know what's happening). Classrooms are well organized and not overwhelming, toys are cleaned, there' s ample outside time, and the kids are monitored for health changes. My kids' academic levels, friendship building and self-confidence have continued to grow exponentially each year. The staff is professional and loving and have created a community that pours into my children. I am appreciative of what they've built and am proud to be a part of it. I just have to share my experience with Loving Savior Preschool. After a tough time at a previous preschool, I was nervous about switching schools. But Loving Savior has been such a blessing! My child is thriving. She feels safe, she’s growing academically, and she’s even being nurtured spiritually. If you’re a parent, I truly hope you look at the full picture: academics, emotional, and spiritual well-being. Loving Savior Preschool exceeded all my expectations! This is a private school ranging from 1st grade to 8th grade. Wonderful front office staff and caring teachers. I have friends sending their kids here to receive excellent education and a myriad of school activities. Genuine people with Christian theme and a close knit community! Two thumbs up from me! My family has attended Loving Savior Church for 20 years. On the school side -our daughter started out at the preschool there and onto the elementary school. We had awesome teachers. After all these years (15) we still keep in touch with a few of them. We feel so close to all that attend the Sunday 9:30 am church service. It’s like one big family. We genuinely care about each other. A group of us go out for a quick lunch afterwards. (Arby, Wendy’s etc)  Some of my dear friendships have come from attending Loving Savior Church. I love Pastor Wu, he is so down to earth and caring. I love the smaller congregation. So many wonderful memories for me at this church. Everyone pretty much knows everyone. I have friends that attend the larger churches, they know no one, just leave knowing the next week they won’t know anyone again. I hope you give Loving Savior a try 🙏 I guess every school has good and bad teachers, judging from the reviews.  Some teacher are just not as friendly as other and they don't always great the parents or kids when they get dropped off in the morning.  Maybe it's just that class that my kid is in.  Also, I did not know that they let the kids watch TV everyday. I am not sure how long, but supposedly after their outside playtime for 45 min until they get transferred to another room for the pick up.  Another time is whenever it rains in the morning and every Friday morning before 8:30am. So, it you have a job that drops off early and pick up later, know that your kids will be watching TV possibly for over 1 hour each day.

reviewSummary:

name: Madison Church
reviewSummary:
Madison Church has been my church home for over a year, and in that time, I’ve experienced spiritual growth and the spiritual community I had been praying to be led to. From my very first visit, Pastor Stephen made an effort to personally connect by reaching out and offering to meet with me. Having experienced almost every Christian denomination, I was eager to explore this community, ask big faith questions, and see how it reflected Jesus’ teachings.

Madison Church became a place where I found room for deeper exploration. What stood out to me, and ultimately kept me here, was the church’s unique blend of being approachable, inclusive, intimate, and intellectually enriching.

Through the messages and engaging in the small groups, I’ve been challenged to grow spiritually in ways I’ve hoped for. This is a church where I’ve been seen and supported through my highs and lows. God brought me the friends I had been praying to find here at MC, serving both within and beyond the church walls with people who truly care.

If you’re seeking a faith community rooted in Jesus’ teachings and dedicated to living them out in all inclusive love, I recommend getting to know Madison Church. Its casual, welcoming atmosphere makes it easy to step into, whether church is a familiar part of your life, or something entirely new. I rarely write reviews and I’ve never reviewed a church before, but I feel compelled to write about Madison Church and its people. I came to Madison Church (MC) in 2023 a broken woman. I was grieving, lost, and carrying emotional trauma, some of which was from my deep distrust of religious institutions. As a bisexual woman, my previous church experience left me feeling unwelcome and rejected for who I am. The contrast between that experience and Madison Church is profound, which is why I immediately knew I was “home” the first Sunday I attended. From Pastor Stephen to the elders and attendees, I was welcomed with open arms. God meets us where we are, and so does Madison Church.
Since that first Sunday, I’ve joined small groups that have taught me invaluable lessons and helped me grow closer to both God and my community. I’ve volunteered to help our greater community of Madison, which is core to MC’s values, living out Jesus’s teachings in practical ways. Madison Church isn’t just about Sunday services, it’s about following Jesus daily and embodying His love. Pastor Stephen not only guides our congregation in understanding and living out Jesus’s teachings but also empowers us to be leaders as we journey forward with Jesus. The mission of Madison Church is simple yet powerful, connecting people with God, and each other. My spiritual and emotional growth continues each day through prayer, community, listening to Jesus’s teachings, and daily reading, all of which is encouraged at Madison Church. My life is forever changed since walking into Madison Church, and I thank God each day for leading me back home. Madison Church is truly a God-sent community of people who will love on you like crazy. As soon as your walk through those doors, be ready for your heart to be forever changed. As someone whose been living a nomadic lifestyle, I can confidently say this is the most welcomed I’ve felt in years by fellow believers. The pastor, Stephen, and recently ordained pastor, Kyle both made me feel super seen and belonged. I went to their summer worship night and felt God’s presence in my interactions with them. If you’re someone who is feeling lost or in need of people to fully see your worth in God, please go to this church. It’ll be the best decision you ever make in your life! Madison Church has a friendly environment.  I love the message, music, and people.  I have been going to Madison Church west campus since January 2017. I have finally found my forever church.   So come and check MC downtown out if your looking for a new church.  I also love how we give back to our community.  Either it from serving Thanksgiving meal to the neighborhood, or handing out Christmas gifts to families. Madison Church is a place for real people with real stories and from all backgrounds to come and belong. Each weekly message finds a way to encourage and uplift my daily life. I am so glad to be apart of the Madison Church family and even though miles separate us from physically being together, I am blessed with the knowledge that nothing can separate us from the love of God, in Christ Jesus our Lord. Sending our love from Kansas City!

name: Manhattan Beach Community Church - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church. We went there with my wife as first timers on Easter Sunday! We're considering becoming members.

“Ecce quam bonum et quam iucundum habitare fratres in unum!”
— Psalm 133:1

Much love,

G I was here for a dance company recital with my niece. Everything was amazing. Great place to host a play, dance recital, or event. We started attending mass at MBCC a few years ago after coming to some of the theater productions they host.   Now my kids are performing in them:)  This is a church but it's also a wonderful community.  It is small enough that you don't feel overwhelmed by the number of people.  There are many activities for the family including drive in movies, art nights, discussion groups, game nights and volunteer opportunities.  All of which were very important to us for making faith part of our children's life.  Especially the Sunday School offering which has been consistent even thru the challenges of Covid.  We really feel at home at MBCC.   As each mass starts we are reminded that no matter who you are, or where you are in life's journey you are welcome here!  And we really feel that way! I have attended MBCC for many years now, with young kids, teens and now as a soon to be empty nester. At all stages, I have found MBCC to be a safe and supportive church to explore faith, be of service and find community.  MBCC is an open and inclusive church with opportunities for all to feel connected. This church produces 2 theatrical productions each year as part of a 60 year old tradition. Noel Cowards Blithe Spirit just ended today. Cash and checks only. No reserved seating. About 75 seats. The set was very well done as well as costumes. Acting in this play was superb with crisp dialogue and deft stage blocking.

name: Manna Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
*BEWARE* Someone just asked if I’d ever seen the bad Google ratings for Manna, and I hadn’t until now. I have to say I wholeheartedly disagree with every bad rating on here. I’ve been attending Manna for 2 years and have never experienced the church they’re describing. Not even as a new member. In fact, the thing that kept me coming back was how welcome I felt. New to the area, they were the only church I tried out who actually made an effort to recognize my face as one they hadn’t seen before. They remembered my name, they remembered my family. When I started serving they made me feel like I was making a difference, and still do! Even after leaving one serve team for another, some people on the old team still genuinely care about how my life is going.

Small groups have made the biggest impact on my sense of community, and I love being able to find a group that fits the season of life I’m walking through. I’ve always been so grateful for Pastor Joe’s ability to deliver God’s message in a way that is easy to understand and easy to fact check the Bible for.

In reference to a review on here calling Manna homophobic; as Christians we are called to love everyone, so we do. But Pastor Joe will never compromise what God’s word says, in order to fit in with what culture says. For more on that, lookup his sermon series on YouTube “Manna Church Colorado Springs - Controversial Jesus”.

Someone on here complained that our congregants leave the high school a mess for them to cleanup after us, but I’m assuming that person doesn’t know about our Serve team members who stay hours after service ends, to clean up after those who might’ve left trash behind, and leave Harrison High School the way we found it.

Someone else complained that we annoy people at the dog park handing out dog treats, in the name of community service. It’s actually called Serve Saturday and we do something different once a month, to show the city of Colorado Springs a tangible expression of the love of Jesus. He told us to be the salt of the earth and the light of the world, this is a way we do that together as a church. He also told us to go and make disciples, and it’s actually because of someone in a red Manna Church shirt handing me a cold water on a hot day that I came to Manna for the first time.

I began my review with *BEWARE* because you always should beware of wolves in sheep’s clothing, especially when looking for a new church to call home. So if that’s you right now, I encourage you not to let all the bad reviews decide for you. But to come and see for yourself. Blessed morning here, visiting from out of town while on travel for work. Contemporary atmosphere with a serious dedication to Jesus...his grace, his truth. If you're looking for a church that avoids both judgmentalism and indulgence, who seem very intent on serving God as best they can, would highly recommend visiting. Very welcoming and friendly, too. Inconsiderate and can't be yourself. Shame shame shame on who I am as a women. Won't ever go back! Great messages and only felt welcome by the pastor. Everyone else seems to monitor people who are not of a normalcy! Shame as I haven't believed in God for months now. I feel mentally better for it too. A Heavenly Experience at Manna Church in Colorado Springs

During our visit to Colorado Springs in the winter of 2024, my family and I were blessed to attend Manna Church, and it was an experience we’ll never forget. From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt embraced by a community of love, warmth, and authentic faith.

The preaching was deeply biblical, delivered with both conviction and compassion. The pastor’s message was rooted in Scripture, yet practical and relevant, leaving us encouraged and spiritually uplifted. It was evident that the Word of God is central to everything they do at Manna Church.

The worship was truly heavenly—spirit-filled, vibrant, and heartfelt. The worship team led the congregation with humility and passion, creating an atmosphere where the presence of the Holy Spirit was palpable. It felt like a glimpse of heaven as voices lifted together in praise.

What stood out most to us was the genuine kindness and love of the people. From the greeters to the members, everyone welcomed us as though we were long-lost family. We felt seen and cared for, even as first-time visitors from Atlanta. Their hospitality and intentionality made it clear that this church lives out the love of Christ in every way.

Manna Church is more than a place of worship—it’s a thriving community of believers committed to serving God and others. If you’re looking for a church that preaches the Word, fosters meaningful worship, and embodies Christ’s love, we wholeheartedly recommend Manna Church. We left inspired, refreshed, and grateful for the opportunity to worship with such an amazing body of believers.

We can’t wait to return! Love the church. The pastor is really nice. The people seem friendly. The service we went to the message was spot on. When we are in the area again we will attend.
