name: Maranatha Chapel - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Before we left Maranatha Chapel, we spent over six months trying to meet with pastors, elders, and staff to gain understanding and address concerns we had. We didn’t walk away lightly. We made repeated, sincere attempts to have honest conversations, but those efforts went nowhere.

My family attended Maranatha Chapel for five years and served as small group leaders. Over time we saw a consistent pattern of poor accountability, unclear leadership, and very little transparency. Ray Bentley is still listed as the primary leader years after his passing, and although people say “Ray isn’t the church,” in reality his name and legacy still dominate everything. There is no published elder board, and even long time staff couldn’t name who the elders were. Internships also seem to go almost exclusively to staff children, which reinforces the insider only culture.

The weekend services follow a very producer–consumer model: you are told to “fellowship” for 30 seconds with the people next to you, and then you sit and watch a stage performance. Despite banners everywhere saying “Belong,” there is no membership process and no real path to actually belong.

Financial transparency was a major concern. We had been tithing and developed concerns around the total lack of financial transparency after searching and digging for any public information such as an annual report or budget. When I tried to get basic financial information, I was stonewalled at every step. Calls were screened, emails and messages ignored, and the Business Administrator, George Chial, never responded for a long time. When I finally did reach him, he told me it would take months before I could see a budget. Months — just to look at a budget? Attempts to speak with Senior Pastor Daniel Bentley about governance, finances, and how I had been treated were met with the same firewall.

Small groups and pastoral care were also disappointing. The Growth Groups Pastor, Martin Sanders, was warm every Sunday—shaking my hand, talking about our group, even visiting me in the hospital. But when I reached out during a family crisis, he told me he was leaving for vacation and would follow up afterward. He never did. My attempts to reach him afterward were met with call screening and silence. Nearly a year later he finally contacted me, but it became clear he mainly wanted feedback on a study we had done. When I shared that our group found it campy and shallow, he was visibly offended.

Despite the friendly surface and the “Belong” messaging, the culture feels closed, unaccountable, and resistant to honest questions. After five years—and over six months of trying to resolve concerns—we left because the internal culture simply didn’t reflect what we believe a healthy, transparent, Christ centered community should be. Found Maranatha online during COVID in Aug 2020. Have never looked back and decided to move to San Diego on Sept 2022 to be closer connected with Maranatha. The best church I’ve ever attended. The teachings are proud and filled with so much love and care.

It’s a big church with family vibes. Everyone I have encountered and met since attending weekly service and women’s weekly Bible studies have been so warm. My life has forever changed by learning from the late Pastor Ray via streamed services and his Step Into the Story series, which is now hosted by his son Pastor Daniel Bentley which is a pure joy.

The worship team is a delight. The music hits my soul and brings such joy to my life. Kayla and Jimmy who lead are outstanding in their talent. Kayla’s voice is heavenly.

If you’re looking for a new church, please come and visit Maranatha. It’s an extraordinary community with many events to feel closer connected to the Lord, each other and offers so much foundational support and strength for this day and age.

I have been forever transformed and found my home. God answered my prayers and can do the same for you.

All around 5+ stars and beyond. I have a twinkle in my eye after going through so much loss this year.

Thank you Maranatha and staff. Our family attended and served at Maranatha church for years, investing deeply in this community with our time and resources. However, through the lens of Dr. Henry Cloud’s teachings on organizational health, we have realized that the church is operating as a 'closed system' that avoids biblical accountability.
Despite our years of commitment, when we reached out for pastoral support during a significant crisis, we were met with silence. This is a profound failure of the Law of Responsibility. Scripture is clear that shepherds are to care for the flock (1 Peter 5:2) and 'bind up the broken' (Ezekiel 34:16). Instead, we felt like the 'scattered sheep' described in Jeremiah 23:2, who were not attended to by their leaders.
Furthermore, the church lacks the 'relational property lines' necessary for a safe community:
• No Formal Membership: This lacks the contractual clarity of who belongs to the body and who leaders are responsible for (Acts 2:41, 1 Corinthians 12:12-14).
• No Financial Transparency: Paul modeled transparency in 2 Corinthians 8:20-21 to 'avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.' Hidden finances prevent the trust necessary for true fellowship.
• No Public Elder Disclosure: Leaders must be 'above reproach' (1 Timothy 3:2), which is impossible if their identities and conduct are not visible to the congregation they serve.
Dr. Cloud teaches that 'transparency is a pillar of trust,' yet this leadership creates a culture of secrecy. We hope they will move toward the light of truth and accountability so that other families do not experience this same abandonment." Our family has loved and grown in this church for the past 7 years. Big church with a
tight-knit family feel. Lots of programs and ministries for every age. Faith building women's ministry. Amazing children's ministry. Awesome worship. Wonderful friendships. We are blessed and well fed on the Word here. You are going to LOVE this body of believers. A group of Christ-followers who gather to worship and praise, to fellowship through meaningful friendships and tight knit community, to give and serve generously, and to be transformed into the image of God's Son.

The worship isn't some showy performance, it's heart felt and genuine. The preaching has depth bur is also relatable and easy to digest. You don't need a degree in theology to understand the messages.

The pastor is young (mid-40's),so the sermons have a certain energy and enthusiasm to them.

The congregation has a heart for Israel and the Jewish people. They celebrate the Feasts of the Lord.

Come check out Maranatha Chapel, and experience the joy, healing, and presence of the Lord.

Found Maranatha online during COVID in Aug 2020. Have never looked back and decided to move to San Diego on Sept 2022 to be closer connected with Maranatha. The best church I’ve ever attended. The teachings are proud and filled with so much love and care.

It’s a big church with family vibes. Everyone I have encountered and met since attending weekly service and women’s weekly Bible studies have been so warm. My life has forever changed by learning from the late Pastor Ray via streamed services and his Step Into the Story series, which is now hosted by his son Pastor Daniel Bentley which is a pure joy.

The worship team is a delight. The music hits my soul and brings such joy to my life. Kayla and Jimmy who lead are outstanding in their talent. Kayla’s voice is heavenly.

If you’re looking for a new church, please come and visit Maranatha. It’s an extraordinary community with many events to feel closer connected to the Lord, each other and offers so much foundational support and strength for this day and age.

I have been forever transformed and found my home. God answered my prayers and can do the same for you.

All around 5+ stars and beyond. I have a twinkle in my eye after going through so much loss this year.

Thank you Maranatha and staff. Our family attended and served at Maranatha church for years, investing deeply in this community with our time and resources. However, through the lens of Dr. Henry Cloud’s teachings on organizational health, we have realized that the church is operating as a 'closed system' that avoids biblical accountability.
Despite our years of commitment, when we reached out for pastoral support during a significant crisis, we were met with silence. This is a profound failure of the Law of Responsibility. Scripture is clear that shepherds are to care for the flock (1 Peter 5:2) and 'bind up the broken' (Ezekiel 34:16). Instead, we felt like the 'scattered sheep' described in Jeremiah 23:2, who were not attended to by their leaders.
Furthermore, the church lacks the 'relational property lines' necessary for a safe community:
• No Formal Membership: This lacks the contractual clarity of who belongs to the body and who leaders are responsible for (Acts 2:41, 1 Corinthians 12:12-14).
• No Financial Transparency: Paul modeled transparency in 2 Corinthians 8:20-21 to 'avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.' Hidden finances prevent the trust necessary for true fellowship.
• No Public Elder Disclosure: Leaders must be 'above reproach' (1 Timothy 3:2), which is impossible if their identities and conduct are not visible to the congregation they serve.
Dr. Cloud teaches that 'transparency is a pillar of trust,' yet this leadership creates a culture of secrecy. We hope they will move toward the light of truth and accountability so that other families do not experience this same abandonment." Our family has loved and grown in this church for the past 7 years. Big church with a
tight-knit family feel. Lots of programs and ministries for every age. Faith building women's ministry. Amazing children's ministry. Awesome worship. Wonderful friendships. We are blessed and well fed on the Word here. You are going to LOVE this body of believers. A group of Christ-followers who gather to worship and praise, to fellowship through meaningful friendships and tight knit community, to give and serve generously, and to be transformed into the image of God's Son.

The worship isn't some showy performance, it's heart felt and genuine. The preaching has depth bur is also relatable and easy to digest. You don't need a degree in theology to understand the messages.

The pastor is young (mid-40's),so the sermons have a certain energy and enthusiasm to them.

The congregation has a heart for Israel and the Jewish people. They celebrate the Feasts of the Lord.

Come check out Maranatha Chapel, and experience the joy, healing, and presence of the Lord.

name: Maranatha Christian Church (Pompano) - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I love attending services at this church. The worship is beautiful, and the preaching is clear, straightforward, and always speaks to our hearts.

The church is very clean, and the people are incredibly welcoming, kind, and friendly. From the moment you walk in, you feel genuinely cared for and well received.

One of the things I admire most about this church is that they don’t constantly preach about prosperity or money, and they don’t spend the service asking people to give. Instead, their focus is on preaching salvation. They are not concerned with asking anyone for money—they are committed to sharing the Gospel.

They follow the example of Jesus, who never charged anyone to heal, save, or set people free. Instead, He paid the ultimate price by dying on the cross for our salvation.

That is the heart of this church: to preach salvation. That is what touched my heart and has kept me here faithfully for so many years.🙏🏼❤️ Can’t speak for the church itself but two believers who go to this church were amazing and following the foot steps of Christ.

I met them at a coffee shop but even then they stayed and listened to my story of my faith.

It’s funny how the world wants to keep us separated but we always find our way to other believers.

May Gods blessing be upon you all that read this. Amen. Many blessings Amazing People Eu amo a maranatha , os irmaos sao muito atenciosos , o culto e uma bencao sempre ... Batizei na maranata quando tinha 13 anos e irei ficar aqui ate a volta do Senhor!

name: Maranatha Christian Church of America
reviewSummary:
Come Visit and Worship the Lord Jesus Christ Together with us! Now is the time.
Matthew‬ ‭11:28-30
““Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.””‬ Great church to learn and walk on the Path, Jesus, and always have a Word of hope to you, always. This place is a great blessing, if you are looking for a Christ centric church which is true to the Word of God, this is the place to go. 🙏 God Bless

name: Maranatha Community Church - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary:
Finding this church really changed my life. My family has found a home here, made lifelong friends and we receive wonderful, loving, true teaching of the Bible. My kids love the community and friendship as well! God is good It’s hard to write words that actually reflect the love that I have for this church. Maranatha has been such a blessing to my family. From a person who has lots of “church experience,” this place is different. You will not find a church that points you more towards the deeply satisfying hope of the Gospel, and you will not find people who are more genuine or loving. This church has become our family. I feel very blessed to have Pastor Jeff Beisel as our leader!! He loves to talk about theology and I personally have grown so much since attending Marantha. Thank you Jeff!!
The people at the church are very friendly and welcoming. Great place for young families. Jen Beisel loves us mamas beautifully, and is a great role model for me as a parent. This is the first time that I have experienced The Church as God had originally intended it to be.

If you are looking for a family who will welcome you as you are and will teach and encourage you to live out the gospel this is the church for you. We are all sinners, saved by grace. All praise be given to our heavenly father Jesus Christ!!  Come worship with us as Jesus Christ is at the center of this church and the truth of the gospel is taught always. A very warm, inviting and non judgmental congregation that’s led by a young pastor who holds himself responsible for keeping the focus on written scripture (vs moral or personal opinion.) The atmosphere is light and welcoming, caring and friendly, with an ever growing number of children who are equally embraced.  There are strict policies for ensuring the children’s safety and community groups are encouraged to deepen connections and personal growth. I love Maranatha because there is no fluff.  It's  all about the bible.  Pastor Jeff, and David Apelt do amazing job of bringing the word and breaking it down to a place of understanding.   If you're looking for a great bible teaching, God seeking church, Maranatha is the place. Great fellowship and a church that has a heart for people and community.

name: Marin Bible Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: Horrible Experience at this place! Typical Dictatorship and Ownership portrayal. Jesus house never meant to be authoritarian! My Mom and I went here for the first time 2 weeks ago and we LOVED everything about this church. We were greeted at the door, told them we were first timers and guided to the front desk and given a gift bag!!They are the nicest people you’ll ever meet!! We will definitely be going back. Great place to meet friends and hear the Word of God . True to The Word. Awesome home fellowship during the week. Extra classes during the week and before church.. Amazing teachers and extremely friendly fellowship. We moved to San Rafael in October, 2015 and we wanted to find a church that preached the Bible and believes the Jesus Christ is the Son of God, That he died as the sacrifice for our sins, that he was raised by God from the dead, and that he reigns in Heaven with God and that we will join him at the appropriate time.  We found that at Valley Baptist Church.  It is a loving, warm, and friendly congregation for all ages, backgrounds  and races.  The preaching is both inspiring and educational and the love of God is readily apparent.   Kathy and Sam Goodwin.

name: Marin Covenant Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: I can honestly say I was not a fan/didn’t want to live in Marin until I started coming to MCC about 5 years ago. They have it all. I can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit in the sanctuary. I love the worship. They have an amazing children’s ministry, too. They are such a thoughtful and caring congregation that has really made me feel at home and part of the family of God. I am so grateful that I came to MCC. Can’t recommend it enough! When I asked the Lord to lead us to a church close to home, He brought us to MCC, and we have been so blessed ever since. From the very first visit, we felt welcomed and loved by everyone. We especially appreciate that they have a great youth ministry for our two teenage boys, and that my husband has been welcomed onto their fantastic worship team. The people here truly follow Jesus and live out His LOVE in such a genuine way. Every message, every worship, every moment reminds us of God’s goodness and faithfulness.🤗🙏🙌💕 It is a wonderful place called home for your spiritual life. People are warm and welcoming, kids program is second to noon. The most important, their leadership present the grace and wisdom from the Lord, bring the truth to the congregation with love and fun. The first day I showed up, my family was warmly greeted by a woman named Emily.  Since then, we have gotten to know her and the rest of the Marin Covenant Church ministry staff much better.  After a few years at the church and in this community, the Pastors, Ministry Staff, and community members walk the talk - they deeply love and follow Jesus. They love all who come through the front doors - those who are first-timers and those who have been coming to their church to hear the gospel for years.  The Church is very healthy and, honestly, the best intentionally built church community my family has ever joined.  Thank You, MCC team, for loving my family so freely!  We are grateful for you! Marin Covenant is second home for me. Between the community becoming my family, the Holy Spirit being felt in the building and all around, it is a true gift to have grown up in this community.

name: Mariners Church
reviewSummary: Known for high-quality production and a very strong 'Family' focus. The teaching is described as 'Practical' and relevant. The physical campus is often noted as beautiful and conducive to community hanging out. 'Rooted' is a key discipleship keyword often mentioned by members.

name: Mariners Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church for people looking to build community with other believers. My children love the kids and junior high ministries. The staff is friendly and serve happily. It is multicultural, so everyone feels like they fit in. They have a service for young adults on Thursdays too. We adults mostly view the sermon on a screen, and it is definitely worth the listen. I have learned so much in my year here so far. Sometimes our campus pastor teaches live too, which is also a great experience. The worship is awesome! My favorite thing has been the Rooted program which helped us make really great friends there. Mariners is a great bible based church with a huge heart and love for the community. Mariners Anaheim is a new campus, and it's definitely worth the visit if you are looking for a new home church. It is a growing congregation filled with friendly and loving people, volunteers, and staff. Everyone is welcome with zero judgment! They also have a great children and teen ministry, which means you can enjoy the service knowing your children are safe, and having a great time learning about God in a personalized way. If you are looking for a place to build a community, I encourage you to check out this church. It helped me to Believe again when I wasn't sure.
The only Church to go to if  you've lost, or feel you've lost,  your Faith in the Lord. It's where I want to be on a Sunday and if I could be every day.
Munyoki is The Best. Real and Honest.
Thank you for what you've done for me. Being a member and volunteer at Mariners Anaheim has truly blessed my life. This church doesn’t just teach God’s Word—it equips you to live it every day. The pastors and leaders genuinely care about helping us grow spiritually and give us the tools to serve with purpose. Volunteering here has helped me use my gifts to make a real difference, and I’m so grateful to be part of this loving, Christ-centered community. ❤️ I love Mariners Anaheim! The heart of my church is simple but powerful: to help people encounter the love of Jesus in everyday life and grow deeper as His disciples. The messages are “Rooted” in God’s Word and speak to real life. The Pastors, staff  and church community leave you feeling loved, encouraged, and inspired to live out your faith Monday through Sunday. If you want to be part of a community that passionately pursues God, cares deeply for people, and equips you to follow Jesus wholeheartedly, come visit Mariners Anaheim. It’s not just church — it’s family.

name: Mariners Church Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
So I’ve been going to mariners for a long time I love going to Thursday night or young adults worship night. We usually go to the Irvine location, but we’re very close to the Huntington Beach location so I decided to start going there and giving it a try because they have started having Thursday nights. I’m a single mom and I’ve brought my son with me before and I know that technically he’s not allowed in service and they don’t have childcare on that day either but at least at the Irvine location they’re still welcoming and they have a outdoor worship area. I’ve never felt more unwelcome at any church more than this location.  I’ve been to this Huntington Beach location several times I just signed up for a class there to help me with sobriety and I wanted to take my next step in my faith and start serving, but after what we went through tonight during service, they said something about us sitting in the middle or sitting up close because I had my son with me, we moved, and someone else came up to us while we were worshiping and told us to move further back. My son and I were just standing there worshiping he wasn’t disturbing anyone and I told them that I’m not wearing my glasses and I can’t see. And me and my son had already moved back a little bit and out of the center. We were just standing there worshiping, and another person came up to us and told us that we needed to move to the back and that kids aren’t allowed. I never felt more unwelcome at any church more than this one. As Christians, we are supposed to bring people closer to God and into the kingdom. I think it’s important that we raise kids within the faith and start them young, but instead they made me feel welcomed and pushed me away from God and now I don’t even want to go to the class or volunteer there after what happened—we just left after that. You never know what people are going through or what type of day they had. I was already emotionally overwhelmed today so after what happened I wasn’t really in the mood to worship anymore after being treated like that. Mariners itself is actually a really good church but if you do give it a try, I recommend the Irvine location or any other location besides this one. As Christians, we should be happy and welcome everyone and bring people close that our Christ not push them away. I was in praise and worship bands for 20 years or so at various churches. And we worked very hard to keep the worship focused on God and not on our performance. we should be perfuming not performing, perfuming the air with the incense of worship and praise.So what’s with all the Hollywood type search lights thing going on the stage?
Looks like a movie premiere or something.
A far cry from Sweet Hour of Prayer. My first time and it was wonderful. It was alive with happy music and an inspiring sermon. I agree with everyone's statements about this mega church. All they care about is making money. The Pastor in Irvine is so full of himself that he does every sermon and puts it on video so every mariners church has to watch him. He's not the only pastor each church has one but what is there role in anything. Also most importantly for a mega church they really don't help anybody physically or spiritually. We attended for over 5 years and when my daughter needed help they did help about 4 years ago. Now when she needs assistance she was told they only help once in a lifetime. Well thank you we won't need your help when we're in heaven. Jesus says help the poor and needy. Absolutely stay away from Mariners church they obviously do not believe in this. This church in HB has a unique ambiance of faithful, friendly people.

name: Mariners Church Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been going to Mariners Church in Irvine since 2021, and we really love it here. We tried a few other churches before, but this one just felt like home. Even though it’s a big church, it still feels personal. People are friendly, the volunteers are kind, and we always feel welcomed.

We love Pastor Eric (and the whole community around him). He’s faithful to the Word and his sermons are easy to understand and engaging. Every message points back to Jesus and challenges us to grow in our faith.

The church has all kinds of ways to connect. Bible studies, theology classes, men’s/women's gatherings, the Rooted program, marriage nights. We’ve made some great friends here and found our little community inside the bigger church.

Our two-year-old girl loves coming here too. The kids’ program is awesome, and it’s such a gift knowing she’s learning about Jesus from an early age.

Most of all, I can honestly say I’ve felt God’s presence here. The Spirit as at work. The preaching has shaped my walk with Christ, and I’ve seen real fruit in my life because of it. No church is perfect, but from what I've seen I believe Mariners is faithful to the Word, and that’s what matters most to me.

If you’re looking for a church or maybe just curious about God, come visit. You’ll be welcomed, encouraged, and reminded how real Jesus is. Mariners Church in Irvine is one of the most stunning wedding venues I’ve had the privilege of photographing. The campus is beautifully designed, with open spaces, modern architecture, and natural light that makes every moment feel timeless. The main sanctuary is spacious yet warm, creating an intimate setting even for larger gatherings. Couples also love the outdoor areas, which provide gorgeous backdrops for portraits and candid moments alike.

From a photography perspective, the layout of Mariners makes it easy to capture both grand ceremony shots and quiet, emotional details. The staff is welcoming and organized, which allows the day to run smoothly for everyone involved. It’s always a joy to work here, and every time I return I’m reminded why this church is so highly regarded in Orange County.

— Written as a professional photographer with PrinceWeddings.net, Orange County photographer. I spent some years searching for a church that felt like home. I was living in Huntington Beach and heard about the Rooted program at Mariners, along with the first “How to read the Bible” course. Christine Caine was speaking there one evening so I decided to go. She was absolute amazing! So o decided to sign up for Rooted and the Bible course. I started attending services every Sunday and actually looked forward to going to church! And still do to this day! I now live in Norwalk and my boyfriend and I make the drive! We even bring his two young sons and they enjoy the children’s program.

I am so grateful for Mariners. I understand the message that is being delivered, they are not judgmental, but real in they was they delver God’s word. I read a review (the only 1 star review on here) saying they were judgmental and I have never ever experienced that. I know the same goes for so many of the people I have met at this church. It truly feels like home. Like God has His full blessings over this community. Mariner's Irvine hosted Dadfest in honor of Father's Day. Such a wonderful event and sense of community and purpose.

Great food, music, and fun, too.

The church spreads across a park-like campus. A little disorienting at first for newcomers. Still, the staff and volunteers gave warm welcomes.

Returned for worship. Fantastic experience. Appreciated the message, in particular, and how Pastor Eric explained Romans 28:8 in a way never shared before and connected it to the series being taught on Genesis. Brilliant!

Two bonuses: a terrific bookstore and cafe. (Get the chorizo and egg burrito.) ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Every time we visit California, we make it a point to attend Mariners Church in Irvine, and it’s always such a blessing! This past Christmas was especially memorable. The energy, the warmth, and the presence of God were palpable throughout the entire experience.

The church grounds are beautiful and so inviting, creating the perfect setting to connect with the community and feel at peace. The Christmas show and sermon were nothing short of amazing—well thought out, deeply inspiring, and filled with the spirit of the season. The message truly resonated with us and left a lasting impression.

There’s something so special about Mariners Church. It’s a place where you can feel God’s love and the strong sense of unity among everyone there. We absolutely adore this church and look forward to attending every time we’re in California. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a meaningful and uplifting worship experience!

name: Mariners Church Mission Viejo - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: We're thrilled to have discovered this church conveniently located near our home. Their recent grand opening was truly divine; the warmth and hospitality we encountered felt like a gift from God. From the friendly faces we met to the welcoming demeanor of the pastor and his wife, every interaction filled us with the Holy Spirit. Now, through Mariners communications platform, we're constantly kept in the loop about church events and opportunities to get involved. Joining this vibrant, Jesus focused, community isn't just an invitation; it's a chance to be part of a movement dedicated to transforming the world in the name of Jesus Christ. Don't let this amazing opportunity pass you by. As a new person to this church I was quickly welcomed in, and approached by several women to make me feel at home. Before attending there I joined their small group called Rooted which was a great intro to get to know people and be involved. The church is great because it is smaller, which I like, because it delivers a more intimate setting and the pastor is very approachable and involved with everyone that attends. Such an awesome church. A place I now call home, have gotten rooted, grounded, love my new church. The worship, word, and fellowship are balanced and intentional. Love our Church Friendly Community Service. Mariners Mission Viejo Church is so welcoming and friendly.  They genuinely care about everyone who attends.  It makes you want to get involved.
