Such an awesome church. A place I now call home, have gotten rooted, grounded, love my new church. The worship, word, and fellowship are balanced and intentional. Love our Church Friendly Community Service. Mariners Mission Viejo Church is so welcoming and friendly.  They genuinely care about everyone who attends.  It makes you want to get involved.

name: Mariners Church Oceanside - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Love the services here. Everyone is nice and friendly and makes you feel welcome and right at home. Pastor and staff are very nice and friendly. They just launched their food pantry on Saturdays for those in need of assistance with groceries/household essentials. Mariners Church Oceanside is an inviting sanctuary that warmly welcomes everyone to be part of its vibrant community. Join us for our three uplifting services at 8:30, 10:00, and 11:30, where our incredible worship team and inspiring sermons from Pastor Eric Geiger create an atmosphere of joy and connection. Be sure to visit our charming Bookstore/Boutique, open on Sunday and Monday from 10:00 to 2:00, where every purchase contributes to meaningful Community Outreach. Experience the beauty of a diverse community rooted in the love of God, family, service, and outreach. We can’t wait to welcome you! Mariners Church has been such a blessing to my family and I. The worship and messages are clear and easy to understand. I really like the breakdown of the messages. The worship music is inspirational and has enabled me to love and play music again. Everyone is very kind and open. You truly feel the presence of the Lord. Mariners Church has pastors that are true shepherds of the church (the people) and partners who will remember you by name and face. If you are looking for a church that is willing to discuss sensitive issues and always remind us that we were all created in the image of God and learn about why Jesus, Come and See! Awesome Black artshow/gallery festival. Beautiful property's great people

name: Mariners Church Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Just seen video on Instagram about this place. Some very nice people in the video but some very sour people here aswell. Maybe the pastor needs to teach love and how to treat your neighbors, you dont just call the police on someone just because they have a camera. Will never attend this place. I’ve always loved Mariners Church and believe it is a great church overall, but I recently had an experience in the Mariners Kids section that left me uneasy and uncomfortable.

When I went to pick up my son, I was waiting for a volunteer to collect my pickup sticker. During that time, my son came out looking noticeably sad, which concerned me. When the volunteer, Leslie, came to get my badge, she called my son over and asked me how old he was. After I answered, she commented in a condescending tone that he had a hard time sitting down/ sitting still.

I responded that he is a kid and he’s excited to be here. While I can’t say for certain how my son was treated while in her care, the interaction made me uncomfortable. I’m not willing to risk my child being under the care of someone who appears to lack patience with excited children.

I still believe Mariners Church is a great place, but because of this experience, I no longer feel comfortable having my son attend the kids’ area upstairs, and I won’t be returning.

I hope this feedback helps bring awareness to how important tone and patience are when working with children. Mariners Santa Ana is an amazing church! Welcoming to everyone, great music, and the sermons are Bible based. I love that this church cares about community and helping people grow in their relationship with God. If you have a heart for Santa Ana and Jesus or Jesus and Santa Ana or whichever then this is a place you need to be.

They love the lost, tired, weak, weary and it's clear with what they do rather than just what they say that they're legit for Jesus here. Awesome Word of God and Spirit lead church. Welcoming, caring, and loving people of God loving on the community of Santa Ana and beyond. Bless to be apart of an amazing humble, God loving team! Btw Lead pastors Guillermo and Nidia Gonzalez are the most wonderful sincere people I have ever met! #ImHome #MarinersSantaAna

name: Mariners' Church
reviewSummary:
Such a joy to see this church!  It was built in 1849.  It has beautiful stain glass windows and the original wooden pews have been restored. The organ has been replaced twice,  the last time 2007 with 4100 pipes.
Gordon Lightfoot's iconic song is titled "The Wreck of the Edmund Fitzgerald". The 1976 folk-rock ballad memorializes the tragic sinking of the SS Edmund Fitzgerald bulk carrier and the loss of its 29 crew members in a severe Lake Superior storm on November 10, 1975.
The church has limited hours to visit, check the website.
Definitely worth a visit. Rustic.  Mariner’s Cathedral is a must visit for anyone interested in Detroit history.  Popularized in the Gordon Lightfoot song The Wreck of the Edmund Fitzgerald this small house of worship is more than a one hit wonder.  An Anglican Church that opens its doors to all faiths and has lovely acoustics for its choir and organ.  The current rector was kind and welcoming and even provided a good sermon.  I think my favorite thing about this place was the comfort and prayer it has provided over its 100 plus years of service to all people but especially the sailors of the Great Lakes. Very epic looking church in the downtown of Detroit, MI. What my American friend told me about it is this church was founded in 1842 and is the 2nd oldest church in Detroit. With this historical statue of George Washington located at the side of the church it looks even more monumental and epic. We were looking for a church that was different from our old one (recently retired).  We chose to go to the oldest church in the Detroit area, Mariners’ Church. What a history!  I’ve always loved ‘The Wreck of the Edmond Fitz Gerald’ (sp) and this church represents that exact song.  Although a very patriarchal church run by all older white gentlemen and full of male portraits in their stained glass windows, the SERMON, on Easter Sunday 2023 was about the first disciple, the first person to lay eyes on the risen Christ, Mary!!!!! God bless them for that!!!  Finally someone willing to speak truth to power. Thank you! Great old church. Pleasant people and a true engine of Detroit community

name: Mariposa Avenue Church of Christ - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary: Citrus heights  Fellowship  is the Church new name foe 3 years  now its great non denominational, Pastor, Members,, food program and 2nd and 4th Sunday  food boxes great photos are from Last Christmas  in the sanctuary Proud Member for 26 years If you're looking to worship the Lord according to the New Testament Scriptures, this is the place to go. Nice facility, and friendly people. I attended a dinner and evening of singing.  The members were welcoming and made everyone feel comfortable. Easy to find. Excellent parking. Friendly people and great Bible lessons!

name: Mars Hill Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary:
This church family is amazing. They are Christ centered and passionate about pointing people to Jesus. The thing that drew us and keeps us coming back is that the sermons are taught like an in depth bible study instead of topical sermons. We go verse by verse line by line never skipping anything and that really feels like the meat and potatoes of learning the Bible. Almost every lesson is coupled with extra information like why it was written a certain way and historical context of what other things were happening in the world. This type of teaching truely breathes life into the scriptures, helps you understand the context of the content, and let's them speak for themselves instead of cherry picking verses to prove a point you want to make. We love our church. Bible base teaching. Pastor Jack's sermons are the sermons we don't want to miss. Sometimes, we listen again and again. We too love sermons of Pastor Ryan.
Also Pastor Ryan and Mark Powell are very good pastors and caring for God's sheep. My family has been a part of this local body for nearly two years. I have said on multiple occasions that it has been the healthiest expression of the church we have been a part of. The pastors faithfully teach and proclaim God’s Word every Sunday through expositional preaching. Our community group has been an incredible blessing. We are loved and served by them weekly. We are encouraged to follow Jesus and teach our children about him. It is a simple church that majors on what’s most important. We love this body of believers. If you’re looking for a biblically faithful church, this is one. We love our Church... if you really want to learn about the Bible, come see us!  We go through each book,  line by line.   Very fascinating and makes you feel like you were there back in time. I was bullied, emotionally abused, dehumanized, and devalued by a handful of members and the only response they could give me is I don't care that you are a human being having feelings. You have no value as they completely disregarding my dignity and worth. What do you think? Do people like this represent the personality of Jesus or Satan?

name: Mars Hill Community Church - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We moved to GA in 2016. We "tried" 5 churches and didn't feel our needs were met. Then we went to Mars Hill Community Church and we felt we found a home. The teachings are all Bible based. The commaraderie and friendliness is top notch. Vintage Bible Study for us "older folks" is a wonderful opportunity to meet new people and provides great fellowship. We participated in a mission trip to Costa Rica and missions are so important to Mars Hill in spreading God's word. A church wide annual program will be next month where we sign up for 20 minute increments to continuously read the Bible from Wednesday night to Saturday night. What a heart warming experience  this is every year...a great way to start the New Year! We moved to Georgia 2 and a half years ago to be closer to family. Our Daughter and her family attended Mars Hill Community Church, so naturally it was the first church we visited after moving.  We loved it but because we moved 20 miles away, we decided to try other churches closer to our home.  After trying at 6 or 7 other churches closer to us we decided that the drive was worth it.  They have amazing programs for all ages.

We are part of an extremely active senior group at the church that has somewhere between 25 and 50 seniors who attend on a regular basis.  The men's ministry is always planning event and the women's ministry is very active and has at least 6 different Bible studies for you to choose from. Our grand kids are involved in an active youth group that has small discipleship groups.  They have at least 2 times a year big community outreach events that are fun for the whole family.

If you are looking to plug into a church that preaches the word without compromise, has great music and has programs for all ages then this is the church for you.  We are so glad made this our church home. I’ve been attending Mars Hill for a couple of years now. The music is fantastic! I love the women’s ministry events and that they are involved with the church, the community and growing closer as women. My absolute favorite thing is Vintage, a group of 50+ that meets on Wednesday nights at 6:00. The  teaching is spot on and the members are my prayer warriors and always willing to come alongside members of the group or their extended families anyway they can. The fellowship is wonderful! We have 30 to 40 members each week and share snacks, meals, games and trips. A perfect way for older adults to get plugged into a new church. Long before moving to this area we had driven past this church many times and were impressed by the level of activity. When we made the move from Blue Ridge to Dallas it was an easy choice to visit Mars Hill Community Church. We were welcomed warmly as soon as we got in the door. It was good to see the sanctuary full and we enjoyed the worship service and preaching and knew that we had found a new church home. Mars Hill Community Church is a wonderful Church. The preaching and teaching are practical, life related and thoroughly Scriptural. The people are amazing! We have made so many friends! There are ministries for all ages and the small groups (called Life Groups) enable you to connect with and share life with other people who are just like you! I have no hesitation in strongly recommending this church to you!

name: Martinez Bible Chapel - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: Very grounded in the Word. Very welcoming people and warm atmosphere. So grateful for the person who introduced me to this church which I can call my home church. Down to earth people who has excellent teaching and Awana classes with rewards for kids. Meals every Wed night and once a month buffet style:) I made this place my home church! The atmosphere, the humbleness of caring Christ-centered people is worth sharing! Enjoying the services till this day! Excellent church i always go with our friend is like a big sister to us there almost every Sunday They serve food before each Wednesday night service this past week we had chick-fil-A! Sound Bible teaching and loving people. Christ centered.

name: Martinez Church of Christ - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: I haven't visited there for a service but I did have to work on a car in the parking lot back there they were very very nice about it and I do appreciate it and I will be visiting they seem to have a nice crowd there My family and I were looking for a warm group of people who wanted to follow God's word. Our children enjoy their classes, and we have made several friends at the congregation. Place I when to to worship, was well welcome. I think a church like this need to reach out to more body of Christ. It will help both. The pastor Phil told me i cannot join the church because of my Previous identity and proceeded to mock me My family for 30 yes! Love to praise God with them!

name: Marvelous Light Christian - Lithia Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this Church.  Greeters are nice and helpful.  Music was easy to praise God.  Pastor was fabulous.  Understood what he said and used the Bible to prove anything he taught on.  No pushy at offering time.  Will go back often! Great music and preaching when I did attend before Covid hit.  I reached out recently multiple times and still had to call back to get any kind of response.  I feel the Pastor and members should be more engaged with the congregation and actually check on their well-being, it goes a long way.  We have a family of 10 and in need of a church that actually care about the small people. A great place to experience the very presence of God! The pastor and first lady were warm and welcoming. The praise, prayer and worship is blessed. The singing and music is awesome! I enjoyed myself, will definitely be returning! Short service, no longer than two hours including baptisms, communions, or baby dedications.
Moderately friendly congregation. No hymns sang here, popular gospel/Christan or original songs by the pastor. Monitors show the words to most songs, scriptures and announcements. I have been a member of Marvelous Light Christian Ministries since 2014. All I can say is everytime you step in the house of God there it is Impossible to come in seeking Spiritual healing to leave out the same way you came in. I mean the Praise and Worship Experience, the way the Word of God is disected there allows God to move on your behalf before you even realize it. Because God is such a gentleman that it happens so Sweet and Subtle. It's an Experience U will want to Experience for yourself. Because in this case the personal  Experience is the Ultimate Experience. Come in Expectancy and God will Deliver.

name: Mary, Star of the Sea Catholic Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
A peaceful, sacred gem by the Pacific.
Mary Star of the Sea is a beautiful, historic church with a serene presence overlooking the ocean. The architecture reflects timeless grace, and the gentle sea breeze adds to the sense of calm and reflection. Whether you’re attending Mass or simply stopping by, it’s a spiritually uplifting place to pause, pray, and take in the natural beauty around you. Mary, Star of the Sea is a visually impressive and spiritually nurturing landmark. Its mission-inspired architecture, intricate mosaics, and vibrant community life are emblematic of La Jolla’s coastal, cultural, and historical identity. Daily Masses are held at 8 AM (weekdays) and Saturday at 9 AM, with vigil and Sunday services offered in English and Spanish In my quest to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego county, I visited Mary, Star of the Sea. Loved how special this church is, just beautiful. Very welcoming in the 7:30 service.  Also, was near great breakfast places. Gorgeous church with one of my favorite Marian images. I've attended Mass and just stopped in to make a visit many times when visiting La Jolla. Beautiful  church.

name: Mater Christi Catholic Church/ St. Paul VI Parish - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: The location easy to find parking.  There were less than 500 people in attendance.  It sounded like an old Baldwin organ.  The music was really good.  Memories of when I was much younger.  30 years back. Where I played 35 years ago the church had a Baldwin organ.  I love the sound of the organ.  The music they used was the same as I did.  Familiar music for me. Beautiful small church, enhanced with wood sculptures and crucifix. The school and Franciscan convent have long closed, but the pews are still pretty full! Stunning Mother of Mothers statue outside between church and rectory. My Mom's favorite church , very nice priests , the church inside is cozy and pretty , just a warm welcoming place to share with fellow believers Women of Year Award Dinner for Sue Johnson. One great lady. This is my place of worship. Do not ask me for a review of my church ever again.

name: Mater Dei Catholic Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Mater Dei Catholic Parish Church in Chula Vista is where I go for my spiritual growth and spiritual awakening during service or mass. Cordial and friendly!  very good atmosphere to pray, reflect and thank our Lord for all the blessings received!🙏 My family has attended here a few times. It seems like it is mostly made up of cultural Catholics who lack reverence.  I usually leave feeling disappointed and wishing for a deeper experience with Jesus. Also, as soon as you walk in people greet you by handing you envelopes for offerings. Huge turn-off. Our family ended up making Santa Sophia in Spring Valley our home even though we live close to Mader Dei. I really enjoyed the holy mass. It’s a very spacious temple with lots of light and  two big screens to easily  follow the ritual. It was everything well organized.  Thank you. The concave design of the Church resembles an opera house or a Roman Theater, where all the parishioners have the altar right in front of their visual field.  The floor plan has an inclination of about 6 degrees where the altar is located at the bottom and the entrance is at the top.  This causes the rows to descend until the last row is at the same level as the altar. People in the row in front of yours, can't block your view of the altar. The floor plan helps the congregation to become one and the whole view is spectacular.  Add to this an experienced father who makes the ceremony a beautiful and inspiring experience and you have one of the best places to attend Sunday mass with your family.

name: Matheteuo Ministries - Cherry Hill Township Campus
reviewSummary: This is a warm, youthful, and genuinely friendly community that makes you feel welcome from the very first visit. I really appreciate that they don’t pass an offering plate. The church is strongly teaching focused and doctrinally solid. Overall, it’s a supportive group of people who aren’t afraid to be honest with one another, share emotional vulnerability, and hold each other accountable. Absolutely love this church. This is a real community. My very first visit, they greeted me like they knew me for years. The pastor actually preaches from the Bible. I couldn't recommend them more. Looking forward to seeing you! this church was truly so different from the rest i’ve been to. inspiring, captivating, and set in TRUTH!!! love the community and fellowship too. it’s like a real family Friendly, young, community that immediately welcomes people. And they don't pass an offering plate! Very teaching centric and doctrinally sound. Great group of supportive people who aren't afraid to be honest, emotionally vulnerable, and accountable to each other. Wonderful church filled with people who love God!

name: Matthews Church of God - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary: Great preaching!  People are genuine and very compassionate and kind.  They are very welcoming.  I would encourage anyone to check them out. Clean inside and outside area. Lots of seating. Parking structure. Great preaching! Pastor keeps it real. A lot of people may shy away but the truth hurts. Keep it up pastor! Check him out.... Words cannot describe how beautiful this Church is and the beautiful people that attend here! I will miss all of you dearly as I make my journey back to California! Pastor Rick I will never forget you!!! This is the church ⛪️ I worship at. I love my brothers and sisters. We're there for one another. I love my pastor because He preaches the word of GOD. The most loving church you will ever find! Multi-cultural. You will hear the truth and only the truth.

name: Mayfair Christian Church - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary: It's pretty good; a good pulpit and so many rooms Excellent

name: Mayflower Congregational Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
Mayflower Congregational Church - Lake Forest Campus
McDonough Christian Church - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary:
So so I'm sitting here in my car after the 11am service on 4/12, with this urge to write this review. And I hope the pastor reads this to reaffirm his faith, and know that God is working through him, and that new people understand my point of view.

I've not been to church in 15 years, and my life has spiraled into fleshly and worldly things. In the last few months I've decided to actually follow Jesus again for real. And Ive struggled from being an introvert, and a skeptic on which church I should go to on account of, that I want a church to actually learn and grow in Him, and I don't want a feel good service that is surface level.

I went to 2819 Atlanta, and I've looked at other churches, but  even if they had good messages they felt like a feel good church and I wasn't going to learn and grow the way I wanted. So on my ride up here I prayed the same prayer I did to those others, specifically for discernment or a sign in knowing if this is a church where he wants me to go, where I can grow in Him, or this is just another feel-good Church.

Then, as I slip into the back row, not 20 minutes later the pastor's talking and calling out feel good churches, and wanting this church to tell the hard truths, and grow in the spirit, and get to the meat of it even if it's uncomfortable. And calling out worldly desires and dying to your flesh which is the exact same issue I've been going through these couple months.

He didn't have to say either of those topics today, but both of them happen to be today when I show up after 15 years and praying that exact prayer. So I just wanted to say whether or not you think it's just coincidence. I believe this church has God at its center, and the pastor was guided by Him to speak that specific message on this day.

I will be coming back to grow, and I hope others who have the same skepticism as me on which church to find, will consider this one, since I had my revelation that this church has God at the center. The true Gospel is preached, the love of Christ is demonstrated and it is bearing much fruit for the glory of God! This is an OUTSTANDING church! This is one of the best churches in all of Henry County. I have attended this church for 23 years. I've seen it grow into a church which makes disciple makers. The children's ministry, youth ministry and adult community groups are second to none. Not to mention Trent is probably the best pastor you could ask for. It was a tall order to fill Paul's shoes but Trent certainly did! I live all the way in flovilla (roughly 45 minutes away) but it is well worth the drive to keep this as my home church. The Jesus Shed yard sale was fabulous.  All the proceeds go to missions. Ill definitely be back.  I decided to check out their website and plan to attend the women's functions when im able to go.

name: McKinney Bible Church - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary: We came because it said it was an expository teaching style. There was hardly any scription read or taught. It was only a speech by the pastor mentionjng a few versus. I know more about his personal life from his sermon then what he spoke about from the Bible. We have joined the body of Christ. Enjoy fellowshiping with this body of believers Good preachin! A church of sound doctrine where you can grow spiritually and find family.

name: McLean Bible Church
reviewSummary: Large regional church in Northern Virginia committed to passionate expository preaching, caring disability and special needs ministry, and profound global church planting.

name: McLean Bible Church - Arlington, VA
reviewSummary:
A great church with sound biblical preaching and loving community. I feel loved and known by the church and also constantly being convicted of my sins and challenged to grow more in my faith in Jesus. If you are looking for a community of people zealous for God’s glory or just exploring Christianity, this is a great church for that :) Great bible preaching church in the heart of Arlington. Provides childcare options, is wheelchair accessible, and is welcoming to everyone. We really love being part of this community and seeing it grow. Really enjoyed the song service, the way they have prayer and the sermon was outstanding. A lot of young people, which made it nice to talk with. If you're ever in the area and on Sunday, check them out. Great location. Folks are friendly. MBC Arlington is a Christ centered, gospel focused Church that exegetically walks through the inspired Word of God through Pastor David Platt, Eric Saunders, Mike Kelsey and Joe Carter.

If you want to be a part of a genuine, active community of faithful men and women that love and follow Jesus Christ, empowered by the Holy Spirit, to do the Will of the Father in DC metro Washington, this is the church for you.

name: McLean Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
Thankful to have call this church home for 4 years while in lived in DC area! MPC really lives out their mission “We exist to glorify and enjoy God by making disciples who make a difference through grace-filled worship, community, and missions.“ I am incredibly grateful for the wisdom, truth, and love that were shared with me during my time there! I have been a member at this church for over ten years. In the last few years, the church has expanded to two other locations at high schools in Fairfax and Herndon to accommodate growing membership with a static location footprint at McLean. Services three times at McLean (two morning and one evening) combine a mixed music style (contemporary in the evening), traditional Presbyterian liturgy, and sermon series largely on topical themes or books of the Bible. The church follows reformed theology consistent with their affiliation with the Presbyterian Church in America, so teaching may have differences with other presbyterian denominations such as the Presbyterian Church USA or the Orthodox Presbyterian Church. The church has had a few senior pastors in the time I have attended.

Various community groups exist for those in different areas in the region or different life stages. Care ministries offer support for people experiencing any kind of personal challenges. Missions work inspires not only sponsoring long-term missionaries but also short-term mission trips to a number of different places in the world.  Christian education for adults has been recently rebranded and themed through new classes offered at all three locations. All in all this church incorporates solid theology with an emphasis on community. I am from Annapolis, MD and visited the church for Easter service with my adult daughter. It was an excellent event with good preaching, great music and warm people.  It was an outstanding service. MPC has been my church home for 4+ years now. DC can feel pretty transient,  but this community is welcoming no matter how long you plan to stick around. I've learned so much about God's grace. And it's changing how I live my life and opening my eyes to God's work in the world. Grace does change everything. Nice church for a wedding. Very picturesque, especially for a more modern church. I especially enjoyed shooting in the courtyard and using the balcony.

name: Meadow Park Church - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church that is Christ centered, and has great worship music. My daughters absolutely love their after school time at Meadow park children's center. The staff and teachers are very friendly and supportive. In just a few months, my daughters have developed a great bond with the center. Thank you for your care and support. Great Church! Awesome Pastors, and the worship leaders are phenomenal. Huge children’s center, countless classes and events going on everyday of the week. Great cafe and library as well. Don’t miss out on this Gem. There is an amazing investment in children’s and youth programs. We felt the love and warmth from day one. My husband and I pulled into this church's parking lot to review a menu of a restaurant We were going to attend. A man in a orange vehicle greeted us with very harsh words telling us to move on. (because there was a daycare there) I'm not sure why that mattered but we stayed and finished reviewing the menu then went on about our day as he sat and watched us leave. I hate to say that it was mostly likely because we are African American. There wasn't any signage saying this was a private lot so we didn't see an issue.  We were not close to the church nor the daycare.  To think....this should be a church where all are welcomed. Sad I used to attend in the 90s but my family moved away. Just visited since moving back and it’s really sad to see how far this church has declined into the megachurch / mall church world.

The pastor and people seemed nice but it all felt like a stage show. While I’m looking for community, I don’t think I can look past the changes.

name: Meadowbrook Church
reviewSummary:
Even though all the previous reviews are from 2 to 10 years old, this is still a great body of believers and soon to be believers.  It has small study groups, a great kids' program (kids here are from age months to 20 years).  Men's group activities and Women's group activities as well as full congregation activities including dinners, picnics, The Deceeption Pass weekend campout (a reak experience you won't want to miss), an annual 100% discount store for our immigrant neighbors and much, much more.
We'd love to have you come and visit us on Sunday at 10:00 a.m. so we can get to know you.  We know we'll love you.
1/10/2026 We have been members of Meadowbrook Church for four years now. I have to say, it is the most welcoming and friendly of congregations, truly like "coming home"! Although it's small (100 in attendance on Sundays), it is mighty for God in its local missions (Avondale Park), global missions (many), and to kids and youth. (We've had kids in the youth group for over four years, and they love the sense of community.) Sound preaching straight from the Bible and sound Christian doctrine. Truly our home. Sermon - Well organized, theologically sound, and delivered with a pleasant conversational tone (eg no pressured speach and not super loud/excitable).

Music - Lovely, easy to sing along, lyrics on overhead.

Feel - Welcoming, relaxed/comfortable, loving.

We travel full time, so we go to a different church almost every week. If we were to stay in one place, I would hope for a church home just like this one. Lovely space for having large gatherings, like a concert. Unfortunately it is still built into an office park, so it's not especially attractive, inside or out. Still very cozy and comfortable. Meadowbrook is a welcoming, friendly and loving church - "a place where God provides" in all things.

name: Meadowlark Community Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Since daybreak has come in, my wife and i were positively optimistic of our yearly Easter service for 2026. Unfortunately we were wrong, no stain glass, no old Church hymns, no wooden pews, just modern. My wife i understand that things change. Well, that also means we need to change as well, to a classic old fashion church. If you have a family, this is for you. Not for myself or my wife Meadowlark Church feels like family. It's a God and Christ centered, Bible-based church with pastors and a staff who genuinely care about teaching God's word, the congregation and our community. Meadowlark is small enough to know your name, yet big enough to meet the diverse needs of individuals and families. Meadowlark offers both contemporary and traditional Services, programs for children and teens, background-checked nursery care, midweek Bible study small groups for youth and adults, and a midweek youth group led by an incredibly dedicated and motivating youth pastor. Meadowlark also offers Divorce Care for both adults and children. We are so blessed to have found this church and church family. A beautiful church. A great church to be a part of that is very community friendly. An old friend of mine AL Dovido went there for many years and love the place. him and his grandson build a gazebo there that is still there. The pastor is very nice and humble. A great local church! I Love our Meadowlark Church! A very friendly & loving family church with many wonderful faith based events for all. Inspiring Sermons and music at both the Contemporary and Traditional Services. When my husband and I found Meadowlark Church, we knew we were home!  The people are friendly and loving.  The teaching is from the Bible, the music is great, and Jesus Christ is Lord.  We love our church!

name: Media City Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: I love Media City Church! I have been a member for just over a year now and I cannot express the love I feel from this MCC family! The Lord has worked so many miracles already this year and I know it is due to our continuous fellowship and prayer! Thank you Pastor Billy and Pastor Kristen for leading such an amazing church! Thank you for all our leaders and community outreach families! May our Lord continue to bless Media City Church and all who serve within it! The worship, the message, the community, the youth program...all of it worth your time on a Sunday.  Pastor Billy has a special gift, and the youth program is a second home to my children.  I’m so thankful to have found a church home for my family. I love the community at the church.  The people make you feel warm and welcome during your time at the church.  Connect to a small group really helps with building lasting friendships. MCC is a great place to meet wonderful people, to hear inspiring sermons, and to feel God's presence. This is truly a special church. I loved my Church Family! Pastor Billy has a message for everyone he is truly  anointed by God!

name: Mega Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful service. The pastor preaching was excellent and I loved that she mixed song with her sermon she has a beautiful voice.

The choir sounded like angels, most importantly you felt the spirit moving.

The ushers were friendly, the atmosphere was very inviting and welcoming. It's a smaller black evangelical congregational church, just one service per week, very pretty red brick. The congregation is quite small and 99.99 percent elderly black, mostly women, not unexpected. I haven't seen many men there. The language is only English. Sometimes they'll have a concert with preaching on loudspeaker with windows open.
NOTE: the Pulpit is not a place to preach racial politics and discord. People seek a congregation to find peace and redemption, not a political rant. Always look for the annual financial disclosure report to track salaries and giving. Mega Church, a awesome church. I love the praise & worship it gets you in the presence of GOD. You can feel the love there, the presence of GOD is there. The people are loving and friendly there. Love Bishop & Pastor Lois M. Blackwell. I am glad they are my spiritual parents. Love them like my own. The resource center was sooo understanding and helpful and even gave me hope with food for thought that everything is going to be ok!💯❤️🍕🍔💪🍽️💯💯💯💯 I put stars to be able to post and ask a few ?s.im not rasest but im white is that a priblem.i dont care about coler or rac i care about goid prple good church and good preaching..? 2 is this a prapasrety church or is a church that tells the truth that maks some walk out becouse afended.becouse thats what i want is preChing thats tells the truth tells like it is.preaching that tells you to repent .teches about the good things as well as the bad if you dont obay jesus.do thay do deleverence becouse nouthing i do works i feel cursed.do thay do bathtizems.is the word told or is it watered down.i have been to church in 2 years atlast.my life is so bad i tryed a few churches.found a good 1 for a bit.i missed 1 week and next week was a agent of saten there in only 1 week this person was on stage,help in laying hands,playing in music and already settung woth congragtion.so the church has no decerment.becouse i pegged guy as soon as i meat him.took 5 sec, before church evean started or sat down.then to see were he sat.there were 3 agunents in church in the middle if services on stage to off stage between pastures.we were new crestens well birn again after my son dyed.me and her were going to get marred to not live in sin nomore.but thay tryed haveing her come to church without me 3 times before next weeks church.im the reasin we came there.its a frend of mines church.now she has lost her faith.we dont get along nomore.so im not marring her like this.life so bad i cant move to sparate.would rather have her back and marry.but not when shes like this.so i need a real church.is this 1 it.

name: Melbourne Church of Christ - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
My grandmother and I have had horrible experiences with their food pantry workers! A FEW of the women that help with their food pantry have just been SO rude to myself and my grandmother! They treat us like we're trying to steal from them, they are so nasty and quick to get onto you about any little thing they can! They are not helpful and they are just so quick to be so rude ! If they are volunteering, I have NO IDEA why! And if they ARE getting paid, then STOP paying them! Im not too worried about myself but I don't understand why they treated my elderly grandmother so poorly! They have terrible attitudes! Besides those few women, others have been great, helpful and nice and all the men have always been helpful gentlemen! Loved attending worship here while visiting friends in Melbourne this week. The pastor is awesome. He is a younger pastor with an excellent ability to reach the family. The song leader was absolutely wonderful. They were all so passionate about doing their part in worshipping Christ. The rest of the church family was incredibly welcoming and friendly. It is a large building so there is plenty of room for more people to join in a really wonderful church. I can't wait to bring my wife down hopefully after Christmas.
If any of you ever visit Washington PA area. We would love for you to join us in worship as a part of our family. Beautiful church . There is a food pantry on Tuesdays from 9-11 am . Anyone who is in need of a little bit of dry goods and clothes are welcome to come.  The volunteers are so cheerful and always have a smile on their face. My son has his boy scout meeting here. I haven't been to a church meeting here, but I  can tell you about the building. The church is very large, the meeting rooms are spacious, the bathrooms are nice and clean. As far as the main room, it's very large with plenty of seating. There's even tables in there for events. I went for the free food and toys they were giving out to members in the community. I was impressed with the care and help they provide but very disappointed in the people who were there taking advantage but acting rude instead of greatful for any help. Thanks to all the kind wonderful souls who donated there time and items so people in need can have. This place is a regular food bank for the needy. God bless all of you.

name: MELBOURNE COMMUNITY CHURCH - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I enjoyed my visit to Melbourne Community Church this morning! They are tucked in the strip mall at the corner of 192 and Wickham Road behind the Walgreens.

Great community of believers and great message about the purpose of prayer by Pastor Brandon Harris who joined as the church’s teaching pastor in 2022. The church was founded in 2002 and longtime worship pastor Walter Staub, ordained by MCC in 2003, still leads the congregation in worship today including some of his original songs.

Beautiful, faithful church here! Amazing church that absolutely lives up to their name. It really is centered around the community, and you'll feel so welcome if you stop in. Pastor Brandon is phenomenal and the worship team truly is next level.

If you're looking for a church experience that's personal and genuine, I highly recommend checking out MCC. I've been a member of this church for the last few years. One of the est things that ever happened to me. :-) Pastor Curt is a teaching pastor. . I'm learning so much from the Bible. The praise and worship team is awesome. And there's a lot of original songs. I could go on and on about how much I love this church. Come learn about Jesus. :-) Pastor Brandon delivers the Gospel message straight on.  Going through the Bible book by book... Brandon has insights I haven't considered due to translation from Greek or Hebrew. A message where Jesus is the focus as the Son of God, Savior and Redeemer of our sins. A wonderful experience in a small community Church. Great homey experience with a Pastor who reads scripture and compared them to current events. It is close net and an experience we look forward to each week

name: Memorial Church of Christ, Houston - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
Over my lifetime, I have attended various
churches of Christ, depending on where we lived. This is a very warm and friendly congregation with an excellent pulpit minister, teen program, children’s ministry and women’s ministry. There are so many ways to be involved and so many encouraging people.. I had the unfortunate experience of attending this church while I grew up here. They do not represent any christian ideals. Very elitist, classist, and unwelcoming. The counselors there are completely unprofessional and incompetent. Do not recommend. Any donations made will be wasted. Extremely rude and unwelcoming congregation. After a negative interaction with a woman named Melissa, my concerns were ignored when brought to the attention of the ministry team. Will not return. A church that immediately felt like HOME! Very welcoming and lots of young families and support. Sunday Assembly:
The singing is awesome here! There is a good mix of older and newer spiritual songs. There is genuine energy in the assembly. The sermons are upbeat and easy to follow. Thoughtful prayer.
Bible Classes:
Pleasantly surprised by Bible knowledge and insights expressed by Bible class participants. Not afraid to have some discussions either.

name: Memorial Church of God In Christ - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: An amazing church that I was able to sit under and learn from. Pastor Daren and Pastor Tasha Miller poured into me  and taught me what has helped to become the man of God I am today. This church is amazing and has amazing leaders and members. The Gathering Place is also loving welcoming peaceful spirit lead and filled and also teachable. Im so honored to have learned and grasp from pastor lady miller and miller family sister thomas elder thomas mother ruise evangelist miller deacon kenny miller deacon harold and mother miller. Evan malone. Thank you all Love the pantry of this place they have so much food to give to the people. All u need is ur Id and I think Social security card. Can’t remember. But wow the food u get to choose from is phenomenal things can get food from Whole Foods Wegmans giant all kinds of places the only issue I have is they take forever to get the people to come in they have a buzzer that you gotta get when you first arrive, but they are slow in calling people to come in that’s the only thing that I have an issue with other than that you get pre-cooked meals, frozen meat, a vegetable and fruit box bread a ton of dessert, canned goods and to tell you the truth half of this stuff is not expired. It’s fresh. I’ve never had a problem with that. They’re only open on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 10 to 4. I would suggest coming Thursday or Friday so it’s not so packed but you really do get great food here. Try it one time and see how you like it. The people here are also quite nice and you don’t have to go to church to receive pantry items. As much as I'd like to give this food pantry a good review, I can't. I went there today, got here a few minutes after 1pm, and I'm leaving empty-handed at 230pm. I'm sure it's a good pantry if you finally get served. It was not busy at all, either. There were a total of 8 vehicles in the parking lot and 1 person waiting outside. I've been to several pantries, and this one is by far the slowest moving.  I'm sure the church is OK with moving super slow because they're not the ones in need if food. For comparison,  I went to the Loaves and Fishes pantry in Prospect Park. I was 31st in line and was served 45 minutes later. Good evening Google family.  I visited today for the Pantry. My first-time visiting the Pantry, but I have visited this church before. I waited 3 hours for the food. They give you a beeper and then you sit  in your car and wait for them to call you. I received salads, meat, milk, vegetables and non perishable food. A win win experience. Open for business on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday from 10 am to 4 pm. But you can only go one day in the week. I was blessed by the outpouring of food. Everyone, the volunteers were so nice. They monitor people as they take the food. They place it in your bag for you. A good experience. Have a good night and don't forget to workout, be active and mobile, fit and Fabulous especially for people over the age of 50 years. Very helpful. Answered my question immediately.

name: Memorial Drive United Methodist
reviewSummary: A traditional Methodist church along Memorial Drive offering community-centered worship and family programming.

name: Memorial Road Church of Christ - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
This place has big Church capabilities and a small Church feel.
Lots of classes and excellent teaching for Children. With security drop off and pick up built for all young Children’s classes.
Adult classes are friendly and Bible based. Worship is a weekly highlight. Spirted singing and sermons that you can use that day as life guidance or to increase your Bible knowledge. This Church follows the Bible and only the Bible.  God’s love is felt here. Come join us,  you will be glad you did! It was my first visit there, only draw back no one introduced themselves to me. Friendly church with Bible based teaching.  The singing was beautiful. clean but there was not one to help me and or show me a class i could join. i came straight from work and got a lot of stares from being slightly dirty. This has been our church home for 12 years! I love this family! We're a church full of imperfect people seeking to love God and love others. I love our focus on missions, both local, and around the world. I love that we are an intergenerational church with family members of all ages. I love that our leadership is loving, caring, prayerful, and seeking to honor God above all else. I love this church! If you're looking for a church home...please come join us some Sunday soon!

name: Menlo Church
reviewSummary: Multi-campus Peninsula institution with a rich intellectual heritage, offering thoughtful expository preaching, premier youth discipleship, and active Silicon Valley outreach.

name: Menlo Church - Menlo Park - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary: Multi-campus Peninsula institution with a rich intellectual heritage, offering thoughtful expository preaching, premier youth discipleship, and active Silicon Valley outreach.

name: Menlo Church - Mountain View - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary: Great messages, worship and community to grow together. Beautiful building, friendly people, great message These are real followers of Jesus who made me feel more welcome than any church I've ever been to. Great support for parents with young children, and good teachings. Very accommodating and friendly. Caring people who love God gather there every Sunday and I’m glad I joined them!

name: Menlo Church | San Mateo - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary:
What a great church to be part of. The people are very welcoming, great place for the kids too. I had the opportunity to hang out in the nursery and the volunteers are so loving and caring to them kids. Parents can attend the service(s) without worry. If you want your kids to grow up with with morals, send your kids to Menlo.Church, San Mateo, CA. The sermons are great for the soul, and the coffee is quality and so... awesome with free donuts. YUM! Everyone needs a balance of mind, body and spirit. At Menlo Church, they take care of your spirit part to stay healthy and stable. What a great family to worship, heal, and learn more about how to live a Christ-focused life. Special mention to the Wednesday night youth night for the middle and high schoolers. 100+ of the next generation drawing closer to God in a safe and welcoming environment!! A warm fellowship, that combines modern technology (audio visual, lighting, effects etc) to carry a message by the founding pastor, John Ortberg,  who has evolved traditional values with the changing landscape of today's world. I attended a service in Menlo Park 18 years ago, and 2 recently in San Mateo, and it is refreshing to see that John does not pander to the genesis of values created by the social media generation, by rather, gives gentle corrections to those that seek approval by others, rather to have them look in their hearts, and to find the best in themselves.
The Congregation is mostly millennials-families, many gen x and older, all very warm; has a complementary coffee/latte bar with donuts, good music, and a solid message.
One thing to clarify: the Sermon is broadcast on large screens in all the locations except the Menlo Park location (I am assuming as such, as John can not be in several places at once, only one being has that capability...), while much of the service is attended personally by staff at the campuses locally. This had zero impact on my experience either way,
but some people might prefer to know that it is a live sermon. Wonderful, inspirational church with four services every Sunday. The youth ministry also meets on Wednesday evenings and is really popular as well. Chrck it out if your interested, you wont be disappointed!

name: Menlo Park Church of God - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Campbell, his Mom, and Lydia are the best! Very good people. Great place to heal ur pain Find a generation is Shabita lakhnau

name: Mercy Hill Church
reviewSummary:
Why is it that Jesus said to give everything you have to the poor, absolutely everything you have. Your house, your car, your bank account, your food, yet the pastoral leadership and members of this community still have earthly items and materials in their possession that they are not willing to give up? It’s 2019 America. Christianity should be wiped off our great country. Manchester Vineyard has been a safe place for me to learn and grow in my faith. I feel very comfortable and welcome there. There's no pretense of perfection, just an earnest, Bible-based desire to follow Jesus. This church is not only a place i got to connect and worship the glory of god. But it is the place i feel at home these people have taken me in an loved on me. while being part o this church i have realized a number of things. For example i have heard multiple times and thought and sat open why do people change when they start to allow and welcome the holy spirit. This church has thought we don not change because we have to impress or look good it just happen that conveniently those things come with changing through/ and with god.
Job 70:20
"Have I sinned? What have I done to You, O watcher of men? Why have You set me as Your target, So that I am a burden to myself?" Amazing people. They get what church should be. God's presence and love. Great place. I love this place it's so beautiful to be here my church my home my one and only

name: Mercy Hill Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Mercy Hill is a great church here in Cincinnati! Felt extremely welcomed ever since my first time visiting, and I found a great community immediately after moving to the city. The teaching is biblical, and the church obviously cares a lot about the city. Really glad to have found Mercy Hill! Mercy Hill is a great church here in Cincinnati. We love the people here and it has been a blessing to take our young family here on Sunday mornings. Most of all, I appreciate the clear teachings coming directly from the Bible! Love love love Mercy Hill! Cannot say enough good things about my home church! Biblical teaching, weekly small groups, & overall just a great community who loves Jesus wholeheartedly and wants to proclaim the gospel throughout the city! Mercy Hill Church has embodied all aspects of a church I could ask for! Mercy Hill has a great service at 10AM with worship and different sermon series! They also have a great kids ministry during service. If you are in college I would highly recommend checking out Mercy Hill's college ministry - Salt Company! WOW! Mercy Hill Church is my favorite church in Cincinnati. Sunday services are great with sermons that are focused on understanding the Bible but what I love most is the people at Mercy Hill care about you more than just when they see you on sunday mornings

name: Mercy Ministry Center (formerly Eastway Baptist Church) - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice pastor and experience! We came and visited with family on vacation. I attended service here in the summer of 2019 while on vacation in the US, it was a Sunday morning. I was welcomed in, I met Pastor Alan and I stayed for the whole service. They have a great band, I enjoyed the gospel music and the Bible stories from Pastor Alan. I never attended any more Baptist ceremonies when I returned home to Ireland but it’s still a fond memory that I tell people about from time to time. Only three times each time I was totally at peace and I enjoyed the choir's singing and the service. Nice play to chill Great.

name: Mercy Road Church - Carmel - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary:
We want your money to expand.  That was the entire service.  Seems like everybody that was so warm and inviting as I walked  in the door was just marketing at this point, whether that was their intent or not.  What's the point of expanding if your message is just to keep expanding.  God wants his word to expand... Not your brand.  He doesn't care how many mercy roads there are...  He wants people to know about Saul's transition to Paul.  The symbolism of the burning bush.  The impact of a father acknowledging his son and saying with whom I am well pleased.  Scripture.  Substance.  Message.  Focus on your success where you're at before moving on.  There's literally qr codes on the back of the chairs for you to scan while you're sitting there.  Put that effort into understanding your mission

Edit :  I came back months later...  Complete reversal and no talk of donations.  Good service on Galatians. I have been attending Mercy Road for over 13 years. One of the best things I like about this Church is the fact that almost 50% of all the money goes outside to the community, and to support other churches. That is very impressive. That percentage of giving outside the church is NOT common!
I also love the family feel of Mercy Road. I remember the first time I attended, I met the pastor, his wife, and was already given opportunities to get involved. I was truly treated as an equal.  I hadn’t felt that way at other churches. It’s easy to get lost in a midsize or a large church, but not Mercy Road!
I also respect the statement they make before every service. “A church should be a hospital for sinners, and not a museum for Saints, no one is too far from God to experience life change in Jesus Christ!”
I can tell you right now, in my experience, I’ve been to other churches that do not treat a church as a hospital for sinners. That type of humility is what the world needs. Mercy Road is wonderful, and I am blessed to be part of such a great church! Great Bible teaching teachers and great “ecosystem” to build community and encourage discipleship. Mercy Road has truly changed my life!

Each week they remind us “We are a hospital for sinners, not a museum for saints”. Mercy Road is a community that wants the best for you and meets people where they are. It’s a place you don’t have to fear judgement. You can feel the staff’s love for Jesus radiating in the way they serve and care for people!! 💛 Haven't been in years 😁 its a pleasure may God continue to bless this church and others who want to know him in Jesus name I pray.

name: Mercy Road Church - Northwest - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: This is truly a community driven church. There’s so many members were active in the community in so many ways. They don’t just say they love people, they do so with their actions as well. They are a great community to belong to. This place is home!!! Everyone is so friendly and makes you feel super welcome. The service was amazing and the the sermon hit home. Keep doing what your doing MR, you're changing lives through your obedience! Weird vibes. Some guy just lay down on the floor right in front of us. Another lady took her shoes off and was basically worshipping the cross. Dark as heck in there can't see anything. Boring sermon. Pastor kicked us out after for a secret members only meeting? Will not go back. Great church! Love the atmosphere & people! Best Christian family church. They care about souls. Loving, kind souls. Love all the wonderful souls that go to this church. Best experience.

name: Meridian Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Rolland and the church family at Meridian Baptist Church are wonderful. It’s a great church that truly feels like a family—welcoming, caring, and full of genuine faith. Grateful to be part of such a loving community. This church has the biggest heart. They have the first Amikas home. At 8x12’ with a 4x12 patio, it’s totally just what a small family could use to get back on their feet. There needs to be more of these all over San Diego. My kids and I struggled for YEARS in El Cajon and are still struggling nearby. We got no help, we got no shelter. Nice that this church selects certain people to be assisted but the others they leave stranded, struggling and to drown don't deserve it. Sad they only care about a few families here and there and leave other to be separated, harmed, or dying. We’ll laid out and supplied small transition homes for the homeless.  More churches and nonprofit organizations should look to this model to help the unhorsed in San Diego County. Great small church. Pastor Rolland is so approachable and gives a great message straight from the bible. All the people are so friendly and the music is always good.

name: Mesa Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Mesa.Church welcomes our community. You!!! Come enjoy Biblical preaching by Pastor Keith Robinson, explosive Christian Worship, holy communion, baptism, fellowship, small groups, missions, children’s ministry, out reach, men’s breakfast and women’s night out. A blessed, enjoyable, friendly local Christian church.
Worshiper for last 5 years.
Pastor Kieth is everything that Worshippers are looking for:
- comforting
- thought provoking
- caring
- educational
- positive effective leader
- humorous
- smart
- charismatic
- organized and well prepared
In short: Pastor Kieth charges-up ⚡️your feelings and awareness of being blessed by God.
The church is:
- very friendly
- family oriented and supportive
- excellent youth program
- bible school great!
- adult programs useful
- staff engages with worshippers but you don’t get pressured! This is a BIG plus. No pressure. Just relax and be there for the good words.
- volunteers and staff happy and healthy
I can go on and on with compliments.
Mesa Church is the best local small church in OC! Whether you're new to the faith or you've been walking with Jesus for a long time, this church is one of the best you'll find out there. This is my home away from home, for sure. How do you feel at home in mere moments? How do so many gather in 1 place that seem like they are a family? There is such honest to goodness Love in here. And the many generations of people who come here and have been here for years are wonderful.  It's precious and alive and true. From the  little ones, teens, young families, and seniors, they are all so inviting.
The pastor and his wife have such hearts for the Lord and for all these people here. And it is evident  they are truly adored back.  God is in the midst.
I'm Home.  If you need one, I highly recommend giving them a try...
you won't regret it.
They say here,  " There's always room at the table." And there is. Thankyou.. I'm pulling up a chair. ❤️ My 7 year old son loves this community. He has made friends here from attending Sunday mornings and Tuesday nights at the "Royal Rangers" program. He is able to retell Bible stories accurately, which I believe is credited to his time here. I even overheard him telling his friend that Jesus died on the cross for his sins during a car drive the other day as well. *****
There are no "fake OC" vibes here. Nothing but faithful people serving a faithful God. That might sound boring, but it's truly refreshing considering the location and time in which we live. ******

I have been able to join a small group at this church for a few years now. I have made friends through the group that have supported me during one of my most difficult seasons. ******

What I like most about this church is that you don't get lost in the crowd. People know that you are there and they genuinely want to know who you are as a person. They value input, and appreciate all volunteers on a consistent basis. ******

I LOVE that it's a multi generational church where you are able to glean love and wisdom from the older generations while learning from and cherishing the younger generations. *****

Mesa Church believes that "there is always room at the table." They make room for people from all walks of life. I believe that statement is true since I have experienced it first hand. I would encourage anyone looking for a place to belong, to come and experience it for themselves.

And the many generations of people who come here and have been here for years are wonderful.  It's precious and alive and true. From the  little ones, teens, young families, and seniors, they are all so inviting.
The pastor and his wife have such hearts for the Lord and for all these people here. And it is evident  they are truly adored back.  God is in the midst.
I'm Home.  If you need one, I highly recommend giving them a try...
you won't regret it.
They say here,  " There's always room at the table." And there is. Thankyou.. I'm pulling up a chair. ❤️ My 7 year old son loves this community. He has made friends here from attending Sunday mornings and Tuesday nights at the "Royal Rangers" program. He is able to retell Bible stories accurately, which I believe is credited to his time here. I even overheard him telling his friend that Jesus died on the cross for his sins during a car drive the other day as well. *****
There are no "fake OC" vibes here. Nothing but faithful people serving a faithful God. That might sound boring, but it's truly refreshing considering the location and time in which we live. ******

I have been able to join a small group at this church for a few years now. I have made friends through the group that have supported me during one of my most difficult seasons. ******

What I like most about this church is that you don't get lost in the crowd. People know that you are there and they genuinely want to know who you are as a person. They value input, and appreciate all volunteers on a consistent basis. ******

I LOVE that it's a multi generational church where you are able to glean love and wisdom from the older generations while learning from and cherishing the younger generations. *****

Mesa Church believes that "there is always room at the table." They make room for people from all walks of life. I believe that statement is true since I have experienced it first hand. I would encourage anyone looking for a place to belong, to come and experience it for themselves.

name: Mesa Church of Christ / Mesa Iglesia de Cristo - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking to worship God in spirit and in truth(John4:24) I implore you not to worship at this place.  They have a pattern of not taking worship seriously.  I have visited multiple times and have witnessed the same experience. Today their song leader was very rude and disrespectful.  He made a joke about being schizophrenic.  This is not humorous. They also designate worship time to learn and practice new songs and the song leader tried to justify it by saying that the congregation would become a “dying church” if they didn’t learn new songs.  Book chapter and verse for that statement please. There can be times outside of worship designated to learn new hymns but choosing to do so during worship is contradictory to worship being “properly and in an orderly manner” (1 Cor 14:40)The Lords Supper is often unfocused and unnecessarily distracting.  Multiple cell phones go off and there are often jokes told by the person presiding at the table.  There are many other examples of disorderly worship and hopefully the leadership here will take heed and make the necessary changes to create a respectful worship service as we worship our creator and maker.  Thanks This is a Bible loving and people loving church that reaches out to everyone!  I have been worshipping here for 4 years and every time I come home from worship I am so up-lifted and thanking God for my church home and family!  Plenty to do if you care to plug yourself into the Lord's service. Very welcoming church. They are a solid Bible-believing congregation that has not compromised the truth of scripture for cultural whims. I do not attend here but highly recommend this church if you live in the area. I'm happy that thos church is worshipping according to scripture. Instruments is not commended by God. God also said no deed to worship him with things made with man's hands. So whoever don't agree take that up with God at the judgment. But for the faithful in christ romans 16:16 churches of christ salute you. I have attended the women's Bible study group on Tuesday morning at 10 am and fell in love with it and the women God has brought into my life 🙌 ❤️

name: Mesa Church Office - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
"There is always room at the table" at Mesa Church. I have been attending Mesa for the last year with my family. It has been a great experience. The pastoral staff is kind, personable, and intentional. Pastor Pete, Jordan, and Matt really care a lot about the people in their congregation. In has been awesome being apart of this community! We have been attending for about 11/2 years.  From day one we felt welcomed and at home.  The church has many opportunities to connect with the church body.  Growth track happens every Sunday and has 4 components:  What it means to have a personal relation with Jesus Christ,
; What the church is about; What are your personal gifts; What are the ways you may apply/serve using your gifts.  We have found the Sunday service messages to be enlightening, inspirational and passionate and always based in the Bible.  Lead pastor and his young family is transparent as is the entire leadership team   if you want to grow relationally both vertically and horizontally this is the place for you as it is for us. Being part of Mesa Church has been a blessing for my family. For years I have been able to call this place my family and the place where countless times I have seen God work in my life. I call this place the place where I can feel God in everything. Best community Church ever. Passionate newer pastor a growing community of people proud to be part of the only church that has a program called Bravehearts! If your a new visitor you are invited to fill out a connect card so we can reach out to you and greet you personally No Thanksgiving dinner this year 2018, disappointing, though they had their reasons. On Sundays, I went three times, no one ever greeted me, makes me wonder about the love we should have for one another.

name: Mesa Verde United Methodist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: People there are very friendly. It is a service oriented church. Everyone is very kind and friendly and for a group of older people, they can be quite forward thinking. Pastor Matt has an old-fashioned style, but he has a modern understanding of theology and how to lead a church. As a queer person, I feel very safe going here. This church is friendly and welcoming. I have been a member since 2000. I would recommed this chuch to all ages. I’ve been with Mesa Verde UMC for 26 years. This is my church family. They’ve watched me grow, helped me raise my kids, loved us through many of life’s challenges and celebrated all of our accomplishments. We are a Reconciling Ministry Church and we look forward to seeing you on Sunday. This is a very friendly, welcoming church. The service is engaging. Pastor Brent has great insight into the bible and how Jesus' teachings apply to our personal lives. Missions and teaching Christian virtues to kids are priorities. We were members of this church back when Bill Steele was minister. We loved it. Very friendly and when we moved out of State we missed our church family very much. It was great to visit recently.

name: Mesa View Baptist Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a Saturday. It's a long story but my wife was taken to Pomorado emergency from a rehab facility across the street for chest pains, she was supposed to be discharged today and I had to fight for them to help her. I needed a quiet place to pray and try to gather myself so I pulled into the parking lot. After some time a gentleman pulled in a few spots from me and politely asked if I needed help. I quickly explained and with more compassion than I have gotten from anyone today he asked her name and said he would pray for her and for me to stay as long as I needed. Angles come in all forms  and at that moment just those few words meant more to me than I think he will ever know. Thank you. Wouldn’t serve me at the food bank, plus they were very rude Not sure how the church is as a church but they offered their parking lot for a function I attended and lot was large enough and  easy to navigate to from where I lived. So that's why I gave 5 stars. Husband, grandchildren, and I attended services here recently. We were warmly welcomed. Enjoyed music, praising, and preaching. Thanks for allowing us to worship the Lord with you. Please Come worship with us. We are a warm, and inclusive
flock, with exceptional leadership. This is the place, where, god gets the glory; despite the origin of the story.  Amen and amen.

reviewSummary:

What an amazing community and I absolutely love pastor Bob he is the best ever This is truly a wonderful place. Pastor Bob is a tremendous blessing. Also the entire staff.
I am so grateful for Messiah Lutheran! Warm caring environment. Pastors Bob & Jay are a gift to us all in these days of unrest in our country and lives. Love God Love One another is our message. All are welcome to join us on Sunday worship , 8:30 and 10:00 am. 4861 Liverpool st. Yorba Linda. It's a nice kindergarten.  My granddaughter attends there. It's safe, and the teacher is enthusiastic to teach the students. Amazing people here... we drive over 20 miles to come here and are involved in many aspects of the church. Highly recommended!!!
