reviewSummary: I love this place many fond memories with our Worship and Prayer Team Messiah pm is a place where prayers are answered ..I love this place Open Heaven 💥💥Amazing!!!

name: Meta Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Walking into this church, I was searching for Jesus, for forgiveness, for comfort, for a love without judgment. What I found was so much more than I ever expected. From my very first day, I felt a sense of peace, safety, and belonging that I hadn’t felt before. This is more than just a place of worship, it’s a community that truly opens its arms and its heart. Thank you to everyone here for your kindness, your warmth, and for welcoming both me and my son so wholeheartedly. What makes this place so special is that it’s not only about preaching or teaching, it’s about walking with you. It’s about standing beside you through the journey, through the changes, and through the process of truly accepting Jesus into your life. I am beyond grateful to have found a place where I feel seen, supported, and deeply loved. We found Meta in December of 2023, but really committed to attending weekly in 2025, and it has been such a blessing in both my life and my husband’s life. From the very beginning, the people have been so real, genuine, and relatable, which made it easy to feel at home.

We are incredibly thankful for our pastors, Ricky and Krista. Their leadership and hearts for God truly shine through everything they do. Ricky actually officiated our wedding recently, which made it even more special and meaningful for us.

We are so grateful for the friendships we’ve built at Meta and for being part of a church that is truly God- and Jesus-driven. This church feels like family, and we thank God for leading us here. Looking for a a place to belong begin or continue your journey to seek Jesus and all His Mighty Majesty presence,Go to Meta Pastor Ricky And his lovely wife Krista will receive you with opened arms and also all the wonderful disciples. Such wonderful people. When I come back to visit NYC will definitely go to worship and say Hola to everyone. Stay blessed and seek the kingdom because there’s nothing better than Gods love grace and mercy. Faith over Fear
2 Timothy 1:7 My Personal Experience,
Since attending Meta Church in a mere month, I have experienced a great sense of connection with God. The pastor’s weekly sermons, which present profound and meaningful passages, resonate deeply with me and motivate me to return regularly.

Ricky breaks down the passages in a way that hits home with me.  Attending Meta has encouraged to have Faith.

I am particularly impressed by the church’s welcoming and inclusive atmosphere, where everyone is welcomed with warmth and friendliness. Meta Church was a gem of a find. I felt so welcomed and at home upon arriving my first day (alone mind you). The messages are so powerful and I always walk away feeling like a better person or someone who can make a difference because of them. Going to Meta on Sundays have become something I look forward to each week as I know that no matter how I show up, I always leave with a sense of fulfillment, clarity, and happiness. Ricky and Krista are two of the most welcoming, thoughtful, and bright people i've encountered here in the city and owe it to them for all they do for our neighborhood and being there when I need it most. I highly recommend Meta to all!

name: Metairie Baptist Church - Metairie Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent Church. If only I can serve at one of the ministries it would be awesome due to my working experience and college degrees.  Pastor Thomas is a great leader. Thank you for letting my wife be baptized at your church. You are my family, I love you all.

Sincerely yours,

RUBEN KEMBAREN Anyone searching for a church to call home, I highly reccomend Metairie Baptist. 4 years ago I was Catholic and spirituality empty.  I wanted a change but I didn't know what to do or where to go. I came home one day and had a invitation on my door to attend services at Metairie Baptist.  I definitely took it as God's plan for me to go check it out. I didn't have a car at the time so I decided to take a chance and called the church office.  I explained to the church Secretary that I wanted to attend but I didn't have transportation to get there.  She took my phone number and within 5 minutes I received a call from one of the bible study teachers.  We spoke for a while and she picked me up on the next Sunday and every Sunday after that for over 2 1/2 years. When I walked in the door I couldn't believe how welcomed I felt. Everybody in the church came up to me and introduced themselves and hugged me  (the men shook my hand ). I was very surprised on the next Sunday everyone remembered my name. I have tried different churches and denominations over the years and none of them even came close to how I felt when I walked in Metairie Baptist.  When I'm in a new place with a lot of people I don't know I get very anxious and nervous thinking everyone is judging me.  Within 3 minutes of being there all of those feelings disappeared.  All I felt was love coming from everyone.  I knew at that moment that I was home. I quickly joined the adult women's bible study group and decided to get baptized and become a member. I will never forget the day I was baptized,  it was as if my eyes opened for the first time in my life. I have never felt that way before.  I have learned more about the bible and our Savior Jesus Christ in the past 4 years than I have my whole life and I have attended church most of my life. I didn't know what fellowship and service work was before Metairie Baptist.  I can't say enough wonderful things about our pastor Dr. Strong, he is a true man of God. It's as if God is speaking through him directly to you. I have never heard sermons like his before. His sermons are life changing. As the great gospel song says "I was lost but now I'm found, was blind but now I see ". If you want to attend a great church with spirituality full Christians, come join us on Sunday. I could  guarantee that you will love it and will want to come back. God is definitely in this place. His love is strong and shown before you walk through the doors. Most definitely a feel of peace. Gospel-centered church! Excellent!! Family friendly. Welcoming all who are seeking a Church home.

name: Metro Christian Church
reviewSummary:
Our family started coming here last August. It's been a great experience meeting new people and growing here! One of the better churches I’ve been to for sure! When I first came in a Sunday, the worship team was so powerful and talented, it made me dance, happy and joyful to praise and worship God. The community is so welcoming and people actually say hello and talk to you! There are so many groups you can join and different events they often have. reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Metro for a couple of years now, and it has been a place where I can find rest, grow in my faith, and have intentional, gospel-centered conversations. The teaching and worship are centered on the Gospel, and the community has helped us grow in our faith and walk with God.
We’ve also had a great experience with the kids ministry. Our 3 sons really enjoy it. I’ve been coming out to Metro Cherry Hill since it was planted here back in 2022 and it’s truly such a blessing to be able to call this place and community my home! Here, I have learned week after week what it means to live a life that is countercultural, shaped by the gospel, and how to do that with the people God has surrounded me with… and not just on Sundays but through our weekly gatherings in community groups, gospel academy classes, and friendships grown with fellow brothers and sisters! I really don’t know where I would be in my walk with God without the community here at Metro🥹 Found Metro Church after attending 2 other churches and really feel like this is home for me and my household. Preaching and teaching is gospel focused. I absolutely love the people and the community here. People truly care for your life and have helped us through all of the good and tough seasons! I found this church shortly after moving to New Jersey right out of college, and it quickly became a home for me. I didn’t have any friends or family in the Northeast and had relocated here for work, feeling pretty alone at first. But over the past 3 years, this church has been a steady rock in my faith — a true testament to God’s provision. It’s reminded me that no matter where you are, the body of Christ is one church, and you are never truly alone.

name: Metropolitan Community Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely engaging.  You can feel the love, acceptance, and the gladness that you have come as soon as you enter.   Rev. Elder Pat Bumgardner is a dynamic and gripping speaker, and her sermons reveal layers of practical and scholarlarly research to ponder and apply.  This is the real deal.  The music is out of this world! Love this church… it’s a place for all! Reverend Pat is amazing❣️ Worship the way God intended it to be, led by the humblest human being I have ever had the absolute honor of knowing.
Rev Pat Bumgardner is truly Christlike. They really took care of me. They offered me Slyvia's place which gave food and shelter in my time of need. Ill never forget Pat Bumgardner, or Lucky Michael's, for all they offered me. This is a great place and again really helped me out. They not only offered shelter and food but also a helping hand. Clothes, job resources, and life guidance. They also paid to reunite me with my family. You really should meet Bumgardner, she is a cool gal. Metropolitan Community Church of New York has been my spiritual home since 1996.  This church cares and also holds space for Sylvia's Place and the Sylvia Rivera Food Pantry, in honor of Sylvia.  God is present and moves through our space and our programs.

name: Metropolitan Community Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
For over a decade, The Met Church has been my spiritual home. Founded 54 years ago to serve the LGBTQ+ community, it remains a place of true inclusivity and acceptance. MCCSD goes beyond being open and affirming by remaining true to its roots. I have great pride to be an active part of such a strong community.

The sermons are a big part of what keeps me coming back. They're practical guidance I apply to my own life. The recent series on "The Four Agreements" was particularly impactful.

But The Met Church is more than great sermons. It's a vibrant community. Arriving early allows me to connect with friends, both new and old, and even strike up conversations with visitors.

The church also fosters a sense of community after the service. Hospitality always lays out a surprisingly tasty spread of coffee and snacks, providing a casual space to chat and get to know others. I usually stick around for about 10 minutes, enjoying the company and making new connections. It's a friendly place!

What truly resonates with me is The Met Church's approach to scripture. They take the Bible seriously, but not literally. This allows for open and honest discussions about faith, making it a welcoming space for people of all backgrounds and beliefs.

The attached pic is from our 2023 Church Planning Retreat. I have been attending Metropolitan Community Church in San Diego for over one year. I moved here from San Francisco (where I lived for 25+ years) and hoped to find a loving church community. Throughout my adult life, I have visited many churches but never really found anything that felt like a good fit. The moment I entered my first service at the Met, I immediately felt welcomed. Everyone is friendly, inviting, and non-pushy. The church's philosophy is "come as you are." You don't have to hold any specific religious beliefs. The outlook is that everyone is on their own spiritual journey. It's a very accepting church. Anyone that wants to may take communion. This gentle, loving approach is what draws me to the Met, and the people are truly loving, kind, and supportive. There is no pressure to believe or do anything. Another major upside is that the church is financially stable (for example, it owns its own building), so there is also no pressure to  contribute generously. I am confident you will find that this church will warmly welcome you and provide you the space, support and loving respect to nurture your deeply personal relationship with God, whatever it is meant to be for you. I am reflecting this morning on the blessing that is my home church, The Met.  I first found The Met online and was quickly drawn in by the weekly messages and the music.  I started attending in person a little over a year ago and leave service every Sunday feeling renewed and uplifted.  The last 3 months I had to go to Florida to help my sick parents so was grateful for the online ministry which allowed me to stay connected.  The services spoke to my heart from over 3000 miles away and sustained me during a difficult time.  I loved the opportunity to share the music and service with my mom and introduce her to the church I love.  Members of the church checked in with me regularly the entire time I was away.  If you are looking for an inclusive church that will meet you wherever you are in your spiritual journey, The Met is for you.  The people are fun loving, deeply committed to service and wonderfully diverse.  I was back in person this week and the welcome home touched my soul.  I thank God every day for this church. God guided me to the Metropolitan Community Church through their booth at the San Diego Pride Festival, and for that, I am deeply grateful. As a gay Christian, I spent many years feeling like an orphan, searching for a place of worship where I could praise God as my authentic self. From the moment I attended a service, I felt I had found that place. I experienced the love and presence of God in a way that resonated deeply with me. After two months of worship and connection, I joyfully decided to become a member and be baptized. Here, I can worship God fully, just as He created me, surrounded by love and acceptance. This Church is a place where you can be your authentic self.
From the very first day I stepped into MCCSD the presence of God was felt.
Now over 20 years later that feeling is still felt... especially on one unforgettable Sunday shortly after I was diagnosed with Stage 4 Lung Cancer. The physical presence of God touched my body; there was a warming sensation felt throughout. The message I received during this time was that I was not alone and everything would be OK.
Now almost 2 years later the cancer activity is undetectable through the treatment from my oncologist, the healing power of prayer from the Care Teams at MCCSD and the power of God.
I have a bright future ahead of my...Praise the Lord.

name: Metropolitan Community Church Of New Orleans - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderfully kind people! I came for a service on Ash Wednesday, and even though it was my first experience with this church, everybody was incredibly loving and friendly. The service was great, open communion, blessings, prayer and song. The atmosphere was beautiful, I could really feel the love and the true spirit within these people. Amazing experience! It's a small community, yet their passion and hope is strong. Great people, great church, and above all a great message to all children of God: a message of acceptance and peace. Wonderful!! I have attended many different churches and denominations. Everyone wants to find a place where they can feel wanted and valued. M.C.C. New Orleans is a place where you will be welcomed. Although it's a small church there are some people with big hearts. Rev. Allison Rowland's smile and open personality goes along way to make you feel and know you are welcomed I was there to see the Reverend William Barber of the Poor People's Campaign.A powerful speaker a powerful movement. Wonderful accepting loving congregation! Very warm and welcoming.

name: Metropolitan Community Church of Our Redeemer - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: One of the most loving and affirming churches in the Augusta Georgia area! They do a lot of work and outreach for the LGBTQIA community. Their yearly LGBTQIA+ Pride Community Service in June is an amazing service of healing and support. They support Augusta Pride and host 2 booths each year at the Pride Festival. They also participate in the yearly Pride Parade. They support the Progressive Religious Coalition of Augusta’s annual Why Dr King Still Matters service. They donate food, clothing, blankets, and money to help the poor and homeless in Augusta. Their annual blessing of the pets also supports local organizations geared toward helping our furry family members. Just an amazing church, following the teachings of Jesus! I love my church, Metropolitan Community Church of Our Redeemer(MCCOR). I don't go as often as I should but I'm glad I'm a member here! I have been attending this church off and on for about 8 years now. I didn't decide to make it official and become a member until about 3 years ago on June 20, 2010. I have nothing but great things to say about my church home and church family. They go above and beyond to see that you have a great experience during church service. Recently our pastor, the Rev. Jeff Pulliam, retired so there's a interim pastor, Rev. Lisa Heilig. Even though, that's a drastic change the message, whoever it's brought by, is always great. Every time I attend church I feel so at peace during the service and once I leave with the recent message my week goes by so smoothly. MCCOR is definitely my little retreat when my life seems be to going off course and it seems like there is nowhere to turn. My MCCOR family is always there to lift my spirits. The most amazing church I have ever attended. I grew up as a southern Baptist knowing how God made me. I was hurt in the Baptist church by the pastor and was out of church for almost 20 years until I discovered MCC. The first time I attended everyone welcomed me with so much love. The service made me cry as I knew I had finally found a church where I felt loved and accepted. I am so grateful for this church and the awesome pastor for giving me a safe place to worship God! I have been going to this church for three years now and I can earnestly say I have a true church family. They are the most welcoming group of people I have ever met. Ineffective and inefficient pastoral leadership. There is no empathy and no compassion here except for ingenuity. I do not recommend this  church as a safe space for any dei LGBT+ members of our community.

name: Miami Beach Baptist Church. - Miami Beach Campus

name: Miami Beach Community Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I was a member of this church since I was about 8 years old. I’m 28 now. I stopped attending at 17, when my mother came and told the church I have been being molested for the past few years by the head usher and the members of this church turned the cheek. Not sure why this morning I felt the need to share but anywho, choose your church wisely! My husband and I love visiting different churches when we are traveling. This was a great church with a strong sense of community. We were welcomed and treated like we had been coming to this church regularly for years. We have now been to three Services. And I just watched The Service from this am. It was very uplifting to me. Please stop in if You are in area. Thank Paster Cynthia.. The music Director, Jose, the fabulous choir, and the entire church team is outstanding.  Everyone from every walk of life is welcome and we are truly a family!

name: Miami Valley Church of Christ - Dayton Campus
reviewSummary:
This has been a very welcoming church me and my family since moving to the Dayton area. Sound biblical teaching, deep one another relationships, honest and loving conversations aimed to support and help each other grow closer to God, and they love to celebrate one another and have fun together, too! My kids love the children's classes and have built great friendships in the church. This is a very diverse group of people with the common goal to love the Lord our God with all our heart and love our neighbors as ourselves. I love being part of Miami Valley Church! It’s such a welcoming community where people of all ages and backgrounds truly come together. Even though we’re a smaller church, that’s part of what makes it so special—people genuinely know and care about each other.

One of the highlights every year is Ohio Valley Camp for rising 3rd–7th graders. The kids especially look forward to the legendary shaving cream fight—it’s such a fun tradition and creates amazing memories!

What I appreciate most is the focus on authentic discipleship and growing in faith together. They offer great Bible study series whether you’re brand new to the Bible or have been studying it for years. It’s truly a place where anyone can come, ask questions, build friendships, and grow spiritually.

If you’re looking for a diverse, welcoming church community in the Miami Valley, this is a wonderful place to connect. I have personally been part of this amazing church ministry group since 1991, it is like family, born and raised in Dayton, Oh. I am so grateful to have a local church family (who like any family is not perfect but committed) committed to not just know the bible/scriptures but live them out to the best of our ability, each of us loving God, loving and valuing others, to be seen and heard, the way God does, with biblical teachings, personal individualized bible studies, and fun times helping each other grow individually as well as communally, despite differences of background, season of life or race, we are multicultural and multigenerational group of real people, we all have a story. So if you are looking for something different, sometimes change and different can be scary but if this is what you’ve been searching for look no further, take the first step and come and see for yourself! We can’t wait to meet you! The fellowship is awesome, this is a church family that loves. Lessons are great and the relationships are wonderful. The heart of Jesus is here... I have a daughter that goes to Cedarville University and she has made this her home church. We attend church when we visit her and they are such a kind, hospitable and loving group. The teaching is biblical and  the leaders Bryan and Lauren are wonderful. I’m grateful for my brothers and sisters in the Miami Valley church of Christ!

name: Middletown Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Great church. Very welcoming.  My kids the the youth ministry. This church has brought so much redemption into my life. Being a person in the lgbtq+ community with religious trauma, I was very skeptical to come back to a church. The first service I went to spoke upon lgbtq inclusion trans rights, and most importantly: living like Jesus. Sermons topics range from disability rights, racial justice and equality, immigration, supporting women’s choice, and dismantling harmful evangelical teachings that have hurt so many communities. Middletown makes it clear what side of history they are on. To me they live out the love of  Christ. The mosaic ministry, helping to provide support to families of those with disabilities is another thing I love about this church. If you are skeptical of God’s love like I was, give this church a try. :) My husband and I started 6 weeks ago. Have very much enjoyed the services. Tonight 12/8/24. The musical was awesome. Very much enjoyed it. Do you all have lady Bible Studies once a month? My wife and I attended the 11;10 service on spring forward Sunday as we are looking for a House of Worship close to home.  We were greeted by Larry while seated as he knew we were first timers at MCC.  My wife enjoys church where there is lots of music that is a bit more upbeat and current.  This is not a criticism just an observation and a matter of personal opinion.  Senior Minister Brian Gerard did a great job in delivering his message with a few good jokes (which I really enjoyed).  I was disappointed in the attendance in that the worshippers were a little more seasoned.  Where have our younger generations gone?  I know MCC will keep up with Gods will as I really respect their view that their Church accepts everyone no matter where they are at. food pantry for Thanksgiving drive thru and lovely people wanting to help out even though it was cold. lovely people with hearts full of love! Thank you so much!

name: Midtown Bridge Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: This is a family. My husband and I have been attending this church for 10+ years, and we love it. I was baptized here, and both of our children were dedicated here. The pastor, elders, and members are Gospel-seeking believers! Love this family! Our family has been attending this church for a few years now and we love it! The members and visitors are so kind and loving. There is also a ministry for kids and teens. I would definitely recommend this church to anyone seeking a loving community of folks! This is the real deal. Pastor Milton preaches the Word of God with authority, wisdom, and love. Worship is authentic and spirit-led. It’s a come-as-you-are kind of church family who will notice if you aren’t there and wants to help you plug in and exercise your gifts for God’s glory. I absolutely love attending TMB Church!!! My favorite aspects include the diversity of people who attend the church, the preaching of Pastor Milton and the other members of the preaching team, and the opportunities to disciple others and to be discipled. A great church with a great sense of family, and a pastor who preaches the word and loves people. And no shortage of things to do and places to eat afterwards!

name: Midtown Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Midtown Church for five years since moving to Atlanta, and it’s truly a blessing. I love the Bible-centered sermons, the thoughtfully organized discipleship groups, and most of all, the loving community. The brothers and sisters here are serious in their faith and incredibly welcoming. Midtown church genuinely feels like family to me. I started attending Midtown after many years away from church and trying a couple of churches in the area that had too much of a mega church feel. What I've found here is a small group of believers who earnestly strive to follow Christ. Time and time again, I've seen sermons, discussions, and decisions made from a Biblical standpoint that seek to honor God.

The membership has been welcoming and kind. I'm excited to go to prayer and worship here. I look forward to it every Sunday. The friendships made here have been comforting and encouraging. I'm excited to become more involved and look forward to growing in my walk with Christ through the fellowship of Midtown. I’ve been attending this church for almost two years now and became a member last year. It’s truly a Bible preaching church with friendly and inviting people. It’s a small and tight knit community of people you can tell are following the Lord. I have truly come to love this church as my church home. I love Midtown Church because the sermons are preached straight from scripture one book of the Bible at a time. The people are very welcoming and friendly. There is a great sense of community and I am grateful for the various Bible studies and Life Groups that are available during the week. What we immediately found appealing was this church had a simple authenticity, focused on the Bible and it’s teaching. People were friendly and welcoming; we felt right at home. The preaching style takes a book of the Bible and starts at chapter 1 verse 1 and teaches to the end of the book. In our 2 years of attending, we have covered several books and it has been a tremendous education and blessing. Midtown Church is truly a blessing for anyone committed to learning God’s word and desiring to live out their faith with a body of similar believers.

name: Midtown Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
Passionate men and women of God. Loved their community & class development. Co pastor is an eloquent skilled preacher & so is the female pastor.
My kids have participated in youth ministry classes also.  One I saw 1 donuts for 5$ I was like ok. We poor. Can’t afford that fund raiser or not. No problem. Then I asked if it’s non denominational.  I was told it wasn’t. It was the evangelical church.
Ok. Looked it up. They were in the news a lot during Trump campaign. Polarized.
No problem. I’m looking for Jesus.
I want to serve also. Today I saw a live scan in the entrance. I asked why is that there. Man says if you want to volunteer you must be. I was like “WHAT?”
He says well if you with with the kids that matters. I TOTALLY AGREE.
I say but what if you want to just be an usher. He says, you have to ask someone else.
So I do ask someone else and they say yes everybody has to be live scan and I said well what if you’re an ex felling like me and they say well that someone will call you and we’ll find the best place for you.
I was on the dark side before I became a Jedi. I think that the very expensive donuts in the live scanning just was a turn off for me.
The pastor just said as I’m writing this, We have more donuts even though they’re expensive they’re expensive for a good cause. I think a good cause is also to not turn God‘s house into a money changers place in the name of any good deed, be it feeding the homeless, be it summer camp, clothing those without clothes or the young man outside seeking hotdogs with bacon wraps,
But that still doesn’t make me feel as uncomfortable as a live scan. Especially in these days of cell phone overreach, fb listening,  government overreach, and the New World order.
I just wanna serve Jesus. My back ground check to sweep or mop or greet is to much for me personally. But everyone else this may be terrific. Feels republican to me. Conservative. Evangelical I guess. I love the diversity at the church and messages from the pastors.  Everyone is very welcoming and they teach directly from the bible without the political messages so many other churches regularly incorporate in their message. I signed up for a Thanksgiving Food box at Midtown Church this year. I managed to get on the list, and was excited to get a little extra help for the holiday. I signed up for delivery, which was accepted and approved, and I confirmed my address a few days before. The box was due to be delivered last Tuesday 9am-2pm... except it never arrived. I have emailed the church 3x over the past week, and left a voicemail, but no one has responded. Makes me wonder if a volunteer just took my box home with them and are now ghosting me. Makes me feel sad and disappointed. It's hard for families nowadays, and I was really looking forward to this. If someone from the church sees this, please reply to my email. I'm sure my food box and $20 gift card to purchase a turkey are long gone by now, but accountability for this type of thing is important, for whoever was in charge of the charitable distribution, so this doesn't happen to other people. Visited from out of town and very much enjoyed the service at 8AM.  Worship was awesome, and Pastor Bob definitely has a gift to spread the gospel.  I'll absolutely plan on attending again if I'm ever back in Sacramento.  I also look forward to their new building opening up next month! Midtown Church is a Wonderful Church to go Worship, Praise, Socialize, and Fellowship with other Believers. The Pastors and Church Staff are very Friendly and supportive. You Feel The Love and Good Vibes from the moment you walk to the front door even before you walk in the building because you are Greeted by Church Staff and Members that will make you pfeel Very Welcome and Happy Too See You There!  I was Very Pleased and Happy I Visited Midtown Church on Easter Sunday! 🩷🌷🩷🥰

There is a bit of glitz in the stage worship, but the intent is to truly praise God. They also post praise and prayer requests along the half wall of the back raised seating. Reading the notes encourages members to praise or pray along with each other.

name: Milestone Church McKinney Campus - McKinney Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church twice — once for a Sunday service and once for a women’s event. Everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming! The worship team was extremely talented and I definitely felt the Holy Spirit presence moving in the room. A tiny glimpse of heaven! At times the loudness of the worship music was distracting to me, but they have earplugs for adults and headphones for babies if you need to soften the very loud noise levels. The sermon is live-streamed from their main campus in Keller. So you basically feel like you are at a movie theater watching church. But the messages are engaging and biblical — so I stayed present and definitely walked away with insight into more of God’s instruction and love of us. Also got to get prayer from the prayer team, which is always welcome and needed in my life. The  church seemed like a majority of 20-50s age demographic. And they sent me a nice gift in the mail after visiting. My only recommendation for the church to enhance their visitor’s experience would be to consider seating in the hallway and outdoor areas. Some people have disabilities and need places to sit down while chatting with friends. I couldn’t really find that easily. But the golf cart to assist you getting to and from your car was very helpful. This has been my church for a year. Though we have multiple campuses, what the main one being in keller. My home church is the McKinney campus; if you're looking for a new church I highly recommend this place. We have attended this church for several years now. From our very first visit, we felt very welcomed and easily made friendships. The children’s church is fun, engaging and meaningful. The youth group has so many neat ways to get teens engaged and my teens really enjoy it. If you’re looking for a church family, that’s what you’ll find here. The preaching is Bible led and referenced. The small groups meet weekly and I’ve made so many friendships this way. It is a smaller congregation but that is exactly what I love. You won’t be lost in a crowd, you’ll be welcomed like you’re coming home. Come and see! When i was there some years ago, the teaching was not very gospel focused. ... felt like a seeker friendly "church."
Messages were self-help,  5 steps to a better xyz and other humanistic messages. The local pastor did not preach often, as we watched a pastor I never got to meet preach most Sundays from a recording or live feed.

They acted more like a business/social club, with soft, non offensive, self-focused messages. I did not hear gospel centered messages and often they cherry picked verses. They need to spend more time in prayer and reading the word than trying to operate like a business and have worldly type "success". Love and embrace the poor, broken and needy and not cater to the wealthy and "healthy" and only those who follow the church program.

Many members were sweet and genuine. I didn't feel so with the leaders.
Hopefully this has changed Very friendly pastors and staff, involved in the community, and passion about Jesus. We love their summer VBS programs!

name: Mill City Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
There are different reasons why I love Mill City Church. First is the feeling of family when you enter the building. In 75 years I've been to other churches where you feel unseen. Here I was greeted and spoken to by so many people as I made my way to a seat. I've been a believer for over 45 years and I could feel the excitement of wanting to encounter Jesus. Young people bring a vibrancy to church and Mill City Church embraces and shows that. I've only been attending Mill City Church since June 2025 but love it. Easy to get involved and so many ways to help in reaching out to Fort Collins and surrounding needs.  I come away from every service with a deeper understanding of who and what Jesus wants me to become. A place where the Word is taught in truth and love.      J Julich A dawning Goliath in the Fort Collins church scene. From humble beginnings, Mill City has risen through the ranks to become the next big thing. Churches, when faced with dilemmas, used to ask "What would Jesus do?" Now they ask "What would Mill City do?" Since they have just moved into their new building, the future of Mill City rests on one all encompassing question: Do they have a gym?
The key to any thriving ministry is a gym. The ability to shoot hoops and chuck dodgeballs at pastors' faces is paramount in accessing the vitality of spiritual life. Without these necessary activities, faith softens, complacency drifts in, and souls are pushed closer to eternal hellfire. If they are indeed blessed with a gym, I have no doubt that Mill City will assume total control over the Fort Collins Faithful, and from there, potentially, the universe. But if not, I fear they are doomed. Mill City Church is full of joy and life. I enjoy my Sundays here, but also have found deep connection with other church members outside of the Sunday gathering. My young kids also look forward to going on Sunday, which is such a blessing. As we move into a new permanent home, I think there are many vibrant years ahead. Mill City Church is a great place to call home.

No matter what brought you and your family to Northern CO, you have been planted here for this season and for a reason. Come explore what He might be calling you towards here in your local community. You will definitely encounter His presence in this beautiful space 💕 I went to mills city church looking for a place to get involved.  They we're doing a month long thing called at the movies.  I walked in and didn't really get greeted by anyone. They were so busy handing out popcorn and soda to notice a new visitor at their church.  After the music the service was opened by a guy dressed up like Lego batman, then they played the lion king with the pastor coming on every 20 min or so to give a quick message about something in the movie.  I was 3 or 4 people in or I would have left.  The whole service felt really gimmicky with a very light milk style of message, almost no meat.  If you want to be entertained at church than this a place for you.  If you want to learn, grow, get some solid teaching and discipleship, keep looking, I dont think it is at mills city church.  I could have stayed home, watched a movie, and listened to a motivational you tube. I won't be coming back.

name: Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary: Fantastic place for a wedding. Rich history. I sing in the choir so a little bit biased. It's a wonderful church that I highly recommend. The basilica church is free to enter and is an active parish. We had such a delightful day at Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano! Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano, located at 31520 Camino Capistrano in San Juan Capistrano, California, is a remarkable testament to historical architecture and spiritual significance. Completed in 1986, the basilica was thoughtfully designed to mirror the original 1806 Great Stone Church, which suffered destruction in the 1812 earthquake. This modern reconstruction serves as a vibrant parish, offering regular Mass services and housing a parochial school. Its designation as a minor basilica in 2000 and a national shrine in 2003 underscores its importance as a pilgrimage site and a center for community worship. Visitors and parishioners alike are drawn to its serene ambiance, rich history, and the active role it plays in fostering faith and education within the community.

name: Mission Bible Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
This is long overdue! Mission Bible Church has been instrumental in my walk as a Christian. The Lord led me here as a new believer, hungry for the Word in 2020.

Pastor Tony, a graduate of The Master's Seminary where he studied under John MacArthur, faithfully teaches the Bible through expository, verse-by-verse preaching. The Bible truly reigns supreme here.

The worship music is rich in truth--before you even hear the sermon, you are already singing biblical truth and offering praise to our Holy God.

Church membership at MBC allows you to be more than an attendee; you become part of the church body. Membership provides:
a) Accountability, which is a pathway to holiness, and
b) The opportunity to serve the Lord by serving His church, using the gifts He has given you.

Discipleship groups offer a place to meet weekly and grow alongside a small group of believers. As Pastor Tony says, "Hard preaching softens hearts," and sitting under the faithful preaching of God's Word will deepen your love for God and for others.

MBC also offers a variety of classes to support your spiritual growth, including Fundamentals of the Faith, Family Foundations (parenting), Evangelism & Apologetics, and the Builders Class (equipping for discipleship).

If you are looking to grow in your spiritual walk, be fed by God's Word, be equipped to live as an effective Christian, and be led faithfully--this is the church for you! , Romans 12:2 is a call to spiritual maturity, urging believers to intentionally cultivate a mindset that is aligned with God's truth and purpose, rather than being shaped by the transient and often harmful patterns of the world. Great Bible Non Denominational Church. 2 Suunday Services 9:00 am & 11:00 am 11 am service today was life changing. Thank you all so much. It hit hard. My husband and I have been attending this church for nearly 10 years. The love and faithfulness of the pastors and lay leaders is palpable. If you are looking for sound doctrine, verse by verse teaching, the gospel without gimmicks, and to be surrounded by a church family striving to be like Christ, this is the place you’ve been looking for.

Pastor Tony, a graduate of The Master's Seminary where he studied under John MacArthur, faithfully teaches the Bible through expository, verse-by-verse preaching. The Bible truly reigns supreme here.

The worship music is rich in truth--before you even hear the sermon, you are already singing biblical truth and offering praise to our Holy God.

Church membership at MBC allows you to be more than an attendee; you become part of the church body. Membership provides:
a) Accountability, which is a pathway to holiness, and
b) The opportunity to serve the Lord by serving His church, using the gifts He has given you.

Discipleship groups offer a place to meet weekly and grow alongside a small group of believers. As Pastor Tony says, "Hard preaching softens hearts," and sitting under the faithful preaching of God's Word will deepen your love for God and for others.

MBC also offers a variety of classes to support your spiritual growth, including Fundamentals of the Faith, Family Foundations (parenting), Evangelism & Apologetics, and the Builders Class (equipping for discipleship).

If you are looking to grow in your spiritual walk, be fed by God's Word, be equipped to live as an effective Christian, and be led faithfully--this is the church for you! , Romans 12:2 is a call to spiritual maturity, urging believers to intentionally cultivate a mindset that is aligned with God's truth and purpose, rather than being shaped by the transient and often harmful patterns of the world. Great Bible Non Denominational Church. 2 Suunday Services 9:00 am & 11:00 am 11 am service today was life changing. Thank you all so much. It hit hard. My husband and I have been attending this church for nearly 10 years. The love and faithfulness of the pastors and lay leaders is palpable. If you are looking for sound doctrine, verse by verse teaching, the gospel without gimmicks, and to be surrounded by a church family striving to be like Christ, this is the place you’ve been looking for.

name: Mission Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
The teaching from this church is Bible-based. Pastor Landon is an incredible teacher, and his messages are always eye-opening, sprinkled with his dry humor.
The worship team is always inspiring and everyone can actually sing (on key). Their energy in infectious. Worship nights are incredible. We love the community they are building and loving on. Our children are happy and love talking about stories from the Bible. The music is amazing!! To top it off, Pastor Landon is on a different level with how he preaches the Word. The humor he brings is also another blessing in disguise especially when he talks about “Saucy Jesus”. We found our home church and community that we want to grow in. I have been going to this church for 3 months and really thought long and hard about this review. I love how the message is delivered here. They are in touch with the current and relevant when delivering the message. This church is a solid mixture of many generations and the culture reflects this in a positive way. I highly recommend this church This is a mega church but they have small church vibes. The ushers helped us find seats, the people were nice. The preaching was very informed and easy to understand. Besides trying to leave the parking lot this was a very amazing church. This church has the best men’s group I have ever seen and been too. I attended it multiple times and it was a great time every single time. They had great speakers and stories plus the men there were super chill.

However, the young adults group was completely lack luster. Shoutout to the pastors for being chill but barely anyone showed up and all we did was play board games for a whole hour then go through a slideshow for the remaining 10 minutes. No hate against the pastors but the group was boring and I left disappointed everytime, we barely ever in touched the Bible.

name: Mission Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary: My first time with Mission church was at the kids Summer camp. My kids loved it and I could tell they were learning. But once I stepped in on Sunday and heard the message and how it was delivered I was shocked at how  much I also enjoyed it. Felt very welcomed and have came across very nice individuals. Absolutely 💯 wonderful!! We can’t wait until Sunday. God bless! This is my son and his wife's church. Originally raised Catholic, my son invited us to attend. I feel a very strong presence of our Lord and Jesus here. I always leave with a strong feeling that our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ are with me after attending. I love this church!! See you in church today. 🙏 ⛪️ 🌟 ❤️ Our first time attending and it was fantastic! Immediately we were welcomed and Taylor stayed with us until everyone was settled in. I really like the fact that she took ownership of our first experience and made it fabulous! My two younger kids had a great time in the kids ministry. My husband and I love the fact that the kids get in the Word as well. Yes, they have fun and play games but it is all centered around the Word. We also have two older children and they have their own group that gets into the Word as well. I really felt like Mission Church took care of us and really valued the fact that we were there. Mission Church is an amazing place. The pastors love Jesus, preach the Word, and disciple their people. If you are looking for a solid, biblically based church, then Mission is where you need to be.

name: Mission Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
A couple of years ago, my family and I moved from Florida to Texas in search of a diverse home church. From the moment we walked into Mission Church, it felt like home. The worship team is amazing, and Pastor Ezra delivers sermons that are often illustrated, engaging, and biblically based. The people at Mission Church are some of the friendliest you’ll find in Texas. We also love the many opportunities available to serve and get involved in ministry. Where do I even begin? As a military family, we’ve moved often and know firsthand how challenging it can be to find a new church to call home. From the moment we walked through the doors of Mission Church, we were welcomed with open arms and knew this would be our new church home. The love and warmth we’ve experienced here have been pure, generous, and truly authentic.

This church has helped our family grow tremendously in our faith and relationship with God. Pastor Ezra and his family are absolutely wonderful. He is humble, genuine, and deeply compassionate. Each sermon reflects his heart for people and his commitment to preaching the Word of God, not what society wants to hear.

Mission Church has been such a blessing, and we couldn’t have asked for a better place to worship, grow, and serve. We moved from California and searched hard for a big church like our home church. We ended up at mission and it is not a big church an we never in a million years thought we’d en up at a smaller church but Jesus has other plans from the pastor and his sermons to the people this church has been come our home and family. Now my wife and i serve extensively (another thing we never thought we’d do) and we love it it’s more than fulfilling it’s our new way of life. Mission Church truly feels like home.
My husband brought me to Mission Church when I first moved to Texas, and I’m so grateful he did. From the very first visit, I felt a genuine sense of love and community. The worship is powerful, the messages are meaningful, and everyone is so welcoming. It’s been a blessing to grow in faith together and be part of such an uplifting environment. Mission Church is my family away from home. Mission Church is without question the most friendly church I’ve ever attended. The people are genuinely interested in everyone, and quickly made us feel welcome. Pastor Ezra is extremely motivational and has a style that engages everyone. Anyone looking to build sincere friendships and participating in fun events should give Mission a try!

name: Mission Church - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited Mission Church for a Sunday service. It's a large church, and it was very crowded, so hopefully their new building will provide more space for everyone.

The message was encouraging, and the worship music was beautiful. If you enjoy a modern worship experience that feels more like a concert, along with pastors who are polished public speakers and preach with a lot of emotion and energy, you'll probably enjoy Mission Church.

Those looking for a more down-to-earth, simple, and less performance-oriented worship experience may find that this church isn't the best fit. However, for those who enjoy a high-energy, polished worship service and engaging preaching, Mission Church offers that experience very well. If you are looking for a church to call home, I highly recommend Mission. Pastor Tyler, Staff and Volunteers are phenomenal. Whether it is your first time attending, or a long time attendee...they always treat you like you belong. This is one church where the amount of love is definitely perceivable.   The sermons are great! If you do not feel comfortable going into the services, they have speakers outside in the court yard so you can receive the word!

Miss you Mission Family!  Keep up the MISSION...Changing the World One Person at a Time! I've been attending Mission Church for over two years, and during that time my relationship with Jesus Christ has grown in a truly meaningful way. I’ve also connected with so many incredible people who now feel like family.
What I appreciate most about Mission Church is that everything they do keeps Jesus Christ at the center. Pastor Tyler is a strong and genuine leader, and it’s clear that he deeply loves the Lord. In every message he shares, he consistently grounds his teaching in Scripture and connects it to how we should live our daily lives according to the Word of God.
Even when the message is challenging, Pastor Tyler speaks truth with love and conviction. That authenticity is something I deeply respect. Mission Church is truly special. It’s a place that genuinely loves people and, most importantly, loves God. I originally found Mission Church through a Google search, I had been away from church for about 20+ years. So I hope this review helps you.

If you’re curious about Jesus, unsure about “church,” feeling lost, overwhelmed by the world, or just exhausted by your circumstances, visit Mission Church in Walnut Creek.

Worship is all heart!  The church genuinely loves people and deeply loves Jesus. If you don’t have the strength or faith to pray, they will pray and plead on your behalf.

Every week I’m learning something new, about repentance (which simply means making a U-turn when you’re headed toward a dead end), about grace, and God's love.
It’s about turning towards God who is already chasing you.
You are here, looking aren't you?

Hope to see you at Mission Church. Pastor Tyler fosters a sense of unity and purpose within the church. Under his leadership, I’ve seen the church grow not only in numbers but in depth—through prayer groups, Bible studies, and service projects that engage the heart of Mission Church. And to top it off he's pretty funny.

name: Mission Church Las Vegas - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: Visited on a road trip to California. Everything about this church in my visit makes me believe they firmly base their church in what the Bible believes the church should be. The preaching is based on verse by verse teaching of the Bible and hospitality is excellent. Fantastic church. Mission church is a great church. The lead Elder/Pastor, John Lee is a fantastic teacher with a strong gift and passion to faithfully present the Word of God. He specifically and intentionally preaches exegetically from the Bible and does so in a chapter by chapter manner, not skipping over tough portions of scripture for him as a teacher or me as a learner. John is a kind and considerate person who also does not waver from truth with his kindness. He won’t lie to you to make you feel good if what you’re doing is sinful and leading you away from obedience to God’s Word and God’s good will for your life. He’s challenged my position multiple times or flat out corrected me and does so as gently as possible but ensures I understand where I’m incorrect. He also listens to criticism and feedback and quickly humbles himself if he’s in the wrong, when he occasionally is (rarely, if ever, about Bible matters, but sometimes in interpersonal or technical topics). Mission church has a clearly defined statement of faith and intentionally seeks to be transparent about all aspects of what they believe so you will never feel duped or blindsided by one of their faith positions. Their new building is clean and well-maintained. They have a strong group of volunteers actively managing church activities and of course those attendees who follow Christ are encouraged to practice obedience and use their spiritual gifts for the building up of the body (per God’s Word). Overall, a great community, you will find few gossips or busybodies among the membership since they’re pretty quick to challenge one another on stuff like that and shut down unhealthy tearing down of others. Though of course they’re human and are in the process of being changed by Jesus so they still make mistakes and aren’t perfect. Overall, a healthy and growing group of believers to join with plenty of good Godly men among them who won’t shy away from leading and doing what’s right and Godly women who want to encourage one another and not form cliques or be “mean girls”. Come, grow with them, learn about God’s Word, be challenged, and grow in your faith. Mission is an oasis in the desert and a very much unexpectedly Biblically sound church in “sin city”. 10/10. Would recommend over most churches I’ve attended in the various states I’ve lived (including a stint in the “Bible belt”). Gospel preaching church community. First time I walked in, I was greeted warmly, sincerely, and enthusiastically by several people, including Pastor John Lee. The Gospel is preached every Sunday, which encourages my heart to believe Jesus and follow Him all the way. Pastor John makes great efforts to connect with the congregation and feed each of our spirits with the Word. Highly recommend attending and if you're lead to, make this your local body to be connected with. Appreciate Mission Church. Singing and Bible teaching. Especially appreciate communion every Sunday

name: Mission Church San Antonio - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been attending mission for 14 years, MANY different seasons of my life. The preaching and teaching is always Bible centered and focused on pointing to Christ. We love Jesus and His people. Everyone is welcome! I've had a pretty wild life with some crazy decisions and I've never been judged or turned away, only embraced and loved and guided towards the King. Love Mission ❤️ I’ve had the privilege to call Mission my church for the past four years. I did not go to church growing up and Mission is the first Church I’ve ever been a part of. The teaching is sound and our pastors are committed to teaching the word of God faithfully rather than sharing their own opinions and have always emphasized Jesus is the true lead pastor.The elders all share a deep commitment to caring for the members of the church. The members of Mission Church care for one another like their family. Several families in Mission have cared for me like I was their own son. The church prioritizes small same gender Bible studies and I have personally grown to be more like Jesus through these groups. I visited Mission during one of my first weeks in San Antonio, back when I didn't know anyone in the city, and have been blessed to be a part of this church ever since then (over six years!). It's a wonderful community filled with people from all different backgrounds and walks of life, who point each other to Christ and strive to honor Him as a church body. The teaching and worship are always Scripture-focused, and the groups and ministries are welcoming and genuine. I'm so grateful for the community I've found at Mission, and for the growth in my faith that I've experienced as a member here! Our family has been attending Mission Church for about 3 years. We still remember being welcomed as soon as we stepped out of the car. As we walked in there, there  were smiling faces greeting us and even had a member come and visit with us before the service started. We loved the sermon and we knew it was Bible focused.  We felt like it was home sweet home. Through the years we have experienced a community like never before. We are blessed to be part of the body of Christ at Mission. I've never posted a church review, but I wanted to do it for Pastors Daniel and Joseph Duce. I had the pleasure of attending this place for 7 months. The sermons are fully based on the Scriptures. Verse-by-verse analysis and context study. I learned so much from them, and since the first time I attended, I saw how they both are passionate about God and serving people.
I moved from TX to MN for Bible College, but had I stayed in town, I would have gladly become an active member of this congregation. I will continue listening to the sermons online because they are that good! I pray our paths cross again someday. It was so refreshing to meet a leadership team that adores God!

name: Mission Church Tucson - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
I was warmly welcomed by all. I appreciated the community meal after the service. The preaching is biblically informed and the worship is contemporary yet God-centered and thoughtful. Mission Church is a very welcoming gathering of believers. They loved on us, and made us feel at home. Plus, the coffee is excellent! They have a strong influence in our Tucson community.
They love, teach and remember the Lord, Jesus every week (as told in Luke 22:19-20). Great church.  New to town and checked it out and loved it.  Very friendly, welcoming people, great worship and a good message.  Plus everyone hung out afterwards and had dinner together.  A great group of people! If you want a fellowship of people that will care about you... and help you in your journey experiencing God, check them out. Wonderful fellowship, very welcoming. Best church in town. Hands down. Great community, solid teaching, and powerful music. If you want to be challenged in your faith, this place is for you.

name: Mission City Church - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary: Complete opposite of big screens, bright lights or loud music. Older culture, with a few younger congregants. Moments of quiet contemptation encouraged. Knowledgeable Pastor who is a baseball fan, Giants specifically,  so sermons are peppered with many stories relating to the game. Great church , great pastor , Family!!

name: Mission City Church - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary: My family is very new to this church. I must say the holy Spirit has touched my teenage daughter and make her feel so welcome here , thank you all 🙏 Pastor Doug and Amanda make up things about people they don't like unfortunately. The music and church service is very depressing and I am thankful I am no longer a member of the church Great Brothers and Sisters that welcome you and accept you. Pastuer Doug has so much love and passion for God the almighty!!  True blessing being  there on Sundays. I was Baptised here in 2019. My life has turned around ever since I surrendered. Less stress, at peace and loving on others. I’ve seriously never felt at home like I have at this church. The best org about this church is that you may have messed up in life, but they don’t hold it against you. I seriously love this place. God breathed church, feels so much like home

name: Mission City Church – Central - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve been attending this church for over three years, and it truly feels like home. We’re so thankful to serve in kids ministry and to be part of such a welcoming, loving church family. Through our life group, we’ve built amazing connections and have grown to love the people here deeply. Please come visit if you’ve been on the fence, you won’t be disappointed. Morning service every Sunday at 9 AM and the afternoon service starts at 11 AM. I visited this church while searching for a home church after moving to Texas last year. My husband and I believe we should go to church near where we live, as we are called to live in community with fellow believers. Mission City is less than 10 minutes from our house so I decided to give it a try!

I enjoyed the service and it reminded me of other churches I’ve attended in the past. I eventually brought my husband and kids here to see what they thought. After a few visits, my husband shared he thought this was the place we should make our home church.

The student program is fun! The leaders are super friendly and the female leader has gone out of her way to try to help our daughter feel welcome and connect.

I’ve helped with the Manna Ministry on Wednesday, which provides groceries to people in poverty and shares the Gospel with them during a service. I enjoyed that experience and plan to help out more!

Everyone has been very friendly but not overbearing. The set is nice and the messages are Biblically sound. The church has a focus on missions (which I love) and is seeker-friendly. The monthly women’s TueGather event is amazing! I’ve really enjoyed it. I plan to join a Bible study this January to get to know more people and dive deeper into the Word of God. I was previously a Jehovah's Witness, but as a child I knew in my heart something was wrong with the JW and the holy Spirit was calling me to Christ when I was 5 but it took time it was not until in 2012  I converted to Christianity. My search for a suitable church took time, but I eventually found one without trying to look for one I came here originally to find food but this church fed me spiritually as well and coming here listening to the gospel that resonated with me. I appreciate the church's emphasis on spreading the gospel and its diverse community, which includes programs for various age groups.my mother and I we got baptized here such a wonderful experience.

as I'm putting this it's 2025 November 9
Please pray for my dad I have faith that he will also convert. This church is amazing. Just remember there's no such thing as perfect only God is perfect keep your eyes on God not on people but without a doubt you'll find people with open arms at this church ;) Friendly people and great teen and children outreach. Casual atmosphere with God centered Bible studies and gatherings. Beautiful Church. Very welcoming people.   Excellent to visit even if from out of town. YBIC

name: Mission Community Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church! Sound doctrine, truly loving people who live the word. This church is very family oriented. Children are an inherent part of the church and loved here, not frowned upon. Praise and worship is amazing, you can feel the presence of God in this church every single Sunday. They have group studies with different leaders and a discipleship 5 part class called PRIME to help you grow as a Christian. The minute I stepped into this church I knew I had found my spiritual home. Visited this location a number of years ago and was impressed with their setup, friendly staff/pastor, music, and greetings. It's similar to Elevation Church in a lot of ways. Service often brings inspiration for the week ahead.
Sadly, due to more and more of my endeavors being out of Union County,
I no longer attend. However, if you are local to the area; I highly recommend you check this encouraging ministry out! Have never visited a church that was more joyful  and compassionate. They care about the community so much. Definitely a great place to worship, feel loved and be filled with hope! just a beautiful family of Christians.  you will be glad you came! Come experience God here. Great community, lots of groups and activities besides Sunday service.

name: Mission Ebenezer Family Church Assemblies of God - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter loves it here. They are very welcoming & sweet. They gave my daughter a beautiful loving community when she needed one. I dont really go to church, but im forever grateful for the support & love they have offered my daughter & im so glad she found this road for herself. 🩶 I have been a member since 2018 and I have to say this church has been a blessing with the family centered theme. From Pastor Issac, to whom Josh his son has taken leadership of to Coba and the Canales family. They have treated me like family. Good Church always felt welcome! Pastor Josh and the service is great... God bless them! Great unified Spanish and English services last Sunday morning. Wonderful worship experience. We had my Father in Law’s memorial service at Mission Ebenezer Family Church.
What a great decision that was. They are so well organized and it was a rainy day, so messy, but the staff was ever so helpful and understanding.
We gave them the information for the program and they had it printed and ready.
We held a pot luck afterwords in the dining area and they have a full professional kitchen.
All reasonably priced and Pastor Joe did a short eulogy. Very pleasant.
Some of our family attend and love this church.

name: Mission Ebenezer Family Church Assemblies of God - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:

name: Mission Hills Christian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
my son has been in the pre school for 2 yrs and we are so happy. the church has always created a caring and respectful space for the kids. On Saturdays the church lot hosts a local open market for the entire neighborhood to enjoy and gather. Mission Hills Christian church makes space for everyone in the area and truly builds community. I have been a member of this church over 2 years now and never have felt more accepted or at home within a church community, who is also my church family. I love the fact that we are so focused on making a positive impact to help improve the immediate and outer communities, by going green, helping the homeless, building a community garden and soo much more. It doesn't matter what walk of life you come from, you are welcomed and loved 💗 Small but growing congregation that welcomes everyone no matter how you self-identify. They have a community garden and community book exchange. The group’s love for God has led them to hold environmental responsibility in high regard. I am relatively new but their welcoming spirit has kept me returning. Most loving, inclusive, and genuine people on the planet. Warm and welcoming to anyone, from anywhere, from any walk of life. All it takes is one visit, to grab why this place, truly is, special. God bless! Love this church
Love the people 💕 ❤
Pastor and his family are genuine 🙌 🙏 .
Worship is awesome 👌 👏 🙌

name: Mission Hills Church
reviewSummary: Known for helping people take their next steps with God through clear verse-by-verse teaching, passionate worship, and vibrant family ministries.

name: Mission Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church and eternally grateful that God led me here 8+ years ago. God’s love and spirit is palpable from the moment you pull in to the lot. Every staff member I have met has exuded genuine care and kindness consistently. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a “home” church that focuses on scripture and Jesus’s life. My wife and I came to visit this church about six or seven months ago. We’ve lived in the area for over 20 years and have passed by this church many times. The first time we went people greeted us and were so friendly. The worship team is amazing and Pastor Bryan is an amazing teacher and humble man. We have made it our home church and feel part of the community. Our children and grandchildren visit and they love it too. They have something for everybody here from small groups to Programs assisting the community with A food pantry and a recovery program. I can’t say enough about Mission Hills Church Other than if you’re looking for a place to learn the Bible and feel the love of God this is it Hmnn, Hmnn. Brand new worship center. Pastor Bryan you do a great job and Pastor Karen, you make coming to Church a longing of the heart. . I have been here a couple of times. The worship sessions are always anointed and extravagant. The congregants are warm,  like everyone wants to love you and help you be a Great Christian! And the WORD? It comes from the throne of Grace seasoned with salt. marinated in mercy and served with grace! People, don't just take my word for it, even though you're busy, you should JUST COME. And you know what? There are two services every Sunday so you don't miss out by any means. So by all means, be there and come meet Jesus the King Exalted and Celebrated in His Body at the Mission Hills Church. I would gave given a 5-star rating, but Mission Hills Church is peopled by human beings still under construction, and still being molded by the Master Potter. I love.\nThis church , they make you feel like you're one of theirs , and they make you feel like family , that's why I continue to go back Truly authentic pastor and leadership team. This church demonstrates the heart of God every day with strong worship, tons of outreach both locally and globally and always looking for ways to do more. Moved out of the area a year ago, and we still drive over an hour every few months to attend.

name: Mission Hills Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church and eternally grateful that God led me here 8+ years ago. God’s love and spirit is palpable from the moment you pull in to the lot. Every staff member I have met has exuded genuine care and kindness consistently. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a “home” church that focuses on scripture and Jesus’s life. My wife and I came to visit this church about six or seven months ago. We’ve lived in the area for over 20 years and have passed by this church many times. The first time we went people greeted us and were so friendly. The worship team is amazing and Pastor Bryan is an amazing teacher and humble man. We have made it our home church and feel part of the community. Our children and grandchildren visit and they love it too. They have something for everybody here from small groups to Programs assisting the community with A food pantry and a recovery program. I can’t say enough about Mission Hills Church Other than if you’re looking for a place to learn the Bible and feel the love of God this is it Hmnn, Hmnn. Brand new worship center. Pastor Bryan you do a great job and Pastor Karen, you make coming to Church a longing of the heart. . I have been here a couple of times. The worship sessions are always anointed and extravagant. The congregants are warm,  like everyone wants to love you and help you be a Great Christian! And the WORD? It comes from the throne of Grace seasoned with salt. marinated in mercy and served with grace! People, don't just take my word for it, even though you're busy, you should JUST COME. And you know what? There are two services every Sunday so you don't miss out by any means. So by all means, be there and come meet Jesus the King Exalted and Celebrated in His Body at the Mission Hills Church. I would gave given a 5-star rating, but Mission Hills Church is peopled by human beings still under construction, and still being molded by the Master Potter. name: Mission Hills Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a place to worship come  to Mission Hills Church and experience the warmth and love of Jesus.  You will be welcomed with open arms regardless of your story or walk of life. Great church if you like medium-sized church atmosphere. Lots of friendly people and the congregation tries to get to know everyone. Lots of bible-study groups for all ages on different days. I personally enjoy the young adults group (age 19 - 29) Bible studies and church travel retreats. I have been a part of Mission Hills Church since I was in middle school. I truly know this place as a second home and the members as church family. I have been a child, student, graduate, young adult, intern, and employee here, and my experience just keeps getting better and my faith gets stronger and deeper. This church and its pastors are genuine, accessible, wise, and kind. They truly care about care. Going there to visit back in December 2022 as a person of color I have never felt so singled out and Discriminated. I felt completely ignored and Totally shunned for not being white. Avoid this racist "church" at all costs if you're a person of color ! I hesitated to write a "review" for Mission Hills because it's not just a business to me—it's deeply personal, like family. But I want to share my experience because if you're searching for something meaningful, I think you should visit.

Spirituality has always been important in my life. Raised in a Catholic family that valued a personal connection with God and exploring different churches, I found Mission Hills Church after years of seeking. What stood out to me was their sincere commitment to teaching from the Bible—it's genuine and firmly rooted in scripture. The staff's friendliness, warmth, and nonjudgmental attitude also made a significant impression on me.

Mission Hills goes beyond mere entertainment; it provides a peaceful environment focused on meaningful teaching that deepens your relationship with God. The children's ministry, in particular, has been enriching for my family. Overall, Mission Hills has given me a fresh perspective, prioritizing substance over superficiality. I'm grateful for the peace and insight I've gained there.

name: Mission Hills Church Littleton - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary: There's never been a time that I've attended service and not felt the Holy Spirits presence.  Sermons are delivered beautifully by Pastor Craig and I get so much out of the message as he always teaches me something new.  I absolutely love Mission Hills and the love they show the community. We had annual training here for work.  The children's learning area is really neat and so creative.   The church is well kept and good sized.  I really like the decor. Awesome experience! Felt very comfortable as someone who is new to the church. The music was enjoyable and Pastor Craig's message was easy to listen to and understand. I’m so grateful to have found this Bible-based church! The teaching is solid and rooted in Scripture — no fluff, just truth. The pastor is incredibly knowledgeable, clearly well-studied, and it shows that he’s taught at seminary. Every message is thoughtful, clear, and helps me grow in my understanding of God’s Word. On top of that, the worship music is amazing! Uplifting, heartfelt, and truly sets the tone for worship. This church is the real deal if you’re looking for biblical teaching and genuine community. It's a nice Church they always welcome everybody so don't be afraid to go there they're very friendly

name: Mission Hills Church North Littleton - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary: Super warm and inviting environment... the staff are super friendly and willing to help and answer any questions I had. Worship is more contemporary with some sets being acoustic and others having all the things. Teaching is excellent, student ministry is fun! Check it out! We have been attending this North Littleton church for about 18 months, and find it to be a very warm and welcoming place.  We love that it is a small church with 60 to 90 people, and that they have a children’s ministry for the kids. We also love the very unique bagel/donut wall, and all the great coffee.  We highly recommend it and invite you to join on any Sunday. I’ve visited a few times and especially loved the recent baptism service—such a powerful moment! Every time, I’ve been warmly welcomed (bonus: great coffee and donuts). The worship is engaging, the teaching is Bible-based and relatable. The Campus Pastor Tyler is approachable, funny, and genuinely cares for people. It’s amazing to see God moving in a church filled with people from all walks of life. Highly recommend checking it out! We attended the Easter Sunday service at the North Littleton campus and had a wonderful experience. The worship was powerful—both moving and motivating—and the music struck a great balance between being modern and deeply meaningful. We were also warmly welcomed; several people took the time to introduce themselves and chat with us, which made us feel right at home. The message was thoughtful and impactful, with just the right touch of lighthearted humor to make it feel personal and relatable. A truly uplifting experience! I have been attending the North Littleton campus for just over a year now and it has been such a blessing!! I can't thank God enough for leading me to this church! Everyone here is absolutely amazing and the community I've made here is more than I could ever ask for! They are very involved with the local community, serving in every way they possibly can. The campus pastor, his family, members and everyone you come in contact with are kind and welcoming to all!

name: Mission Hills United Methodist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome places to go to NA, and AA meetings, I highly recommend it. There's lots of sobriety and experience.
