name: Mission Road Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful, amazing, loving church! The building itself isn’t what makes it a church, it’s the community and people there that make it a church. Everyone is so kind. The sermons are always amazing. The worship is really fun (My dad plays guitar on the worship team). And they have a babies room, a preschool-kindergarten room (at least I’m pretty sure that it’s preschool-kindergarten), and an elementary room for the kids to go in during service. They also have their own little sermons in there. And every Wednesday, they have Students!!! It’s so fun! We get to pray, play games, hang with our homies, worship, listen to a sermon, it’s just so great. I love my church. I love praising God, especially when I’m at Mission Road Church. Peace and Love, y’all! ✝︎❤️
“The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me. You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows. Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.”-Psalms 23 i was made to feel special and welcome! such a laid back hip place to celebrate Jesus’ salvation! honestly i haven’t been to church in years besides tv church. very moving music! and the sermon was very motivational! i highly recommend anyone check out Genesis Church! There is no judgement, clothing, whatever! i didn’t run into a single negative vibe! the entire church was a overflow of positivity!  amazing! i feel charged up! ready to celebrate Easter! They have a ton of events please look into it! Love this Church and Pastor Scott! The church has changed quite a bit from when I first attended. At the beginning of service, the sing to praise the Lord. It used to be 3 songs and now it is four songs which reduces the time that  Pastor Scott preaches the word! I would rather here the word than a 30 minute gospel concert.
All chorus people on stage used to sing altogether. Now , they do not leaving only Pastor Stephanie to do the lead singing! We are praising the Lord and everyone should be singing not just Pastor Stephanie! I do love this church and love going to it! I just wish they would go back to the 3 songs and preach the word longer. Such a wonderful place to call home. I have became a member in October of 2017 and have loved it ever since. The first day I attended Genesis Church was when a hurricane knocked out most power in town. I was looking for a church to go to and the one I originally planned on going to was closed. Genesis had no power in its main building, but some how there was power in the small one. The service was so touching and the atmosphere was very welcoming. I felt comfortable there. Pastor Scott and his team do a great job of being available and making sure that everyone who comes into Genesis is talked to by someone. Genesis Church also does a lot of local events, trying to help our community. I appreciate the compassion there is at Genesis. Genesis Church is amazing! I'm beyond grateful to have found this church a few years ago! Being around people and a pastor who are so passionate about God's love and the importance of showing His love in our daily lives, has given me the support and inspiration to continually grow in my faith and relationship with God. I also enjoy working with the young children in Genesis Kids, connecting with the families and giving back is so rewarding!

name: Mission San Juan Capistrano - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
A visit to Mission San Juan Capistrano is truly special. The mission is incredibly well preserved, with so many fascinating artifacts and relics to explore—it really brings history to life.

The grounds are absolutely stunning. There are vibrant blooms everywhere, from succulents to rose bushes, creating a peaceful and colorful atmosphere. It also attracts a lot of wildlife, which adds to the charm and makes the experience feel even more serene.

They have a lovely little gift shop and even a vegetable garden, which adds a nice touch to the visit. This is a perfect spot for special occasion photography or even a meaningful school field trip. The Experience & History:
This is a perfect stop on the way to Laguna Beach.
​Historical Significance: This is a stunning historical building that has been around since 1776 (currently celebrating 250 years).
​Atmosphere: The mission buildings are historic and very well maintained. It is a very calm, family-friendly area that is great for walking around and taking photos.
​Tours: A great touch is that they provide a self-guide program in several languages, making the history very accessible to everyone.
​Logistics:
​Admission: I paid $18 per person, which is well worth it to explore and help preserve the grounds.
​Parking: Be aware that street parking is limited directly in front, but it is easily walkable to public parking lots nearby.
​Verdict:
A beautifully preserved piece of California history. I definitely recommend stopping by! Excellently preserved historical site, and very educational. I didnt partake in the audio tour option, but the fact that it was there, along with the many stations to use it on, show that it is used well. Got to see some students on site - glad to see the child education still goes strong, even after my personal elementary education visited here decades ago.

Somewhat related, the gift store on site could use more history books related to the mission, and the colonization period. Not a miss, for sure, but would have been a bonus for history enthusiasts such as myself. The historical place is a must visit. It was beautiful. They will give you some kind of remote control to listen the history of the people and places. The only thing we did not like is that they did not let us take pictures of my husband and I. The staff lady said it’s not allowed to take pictures with props and tripod. Otherwise we have to pay $200 dollars. We were just wearing white casual dress and long sleeves polo with my husband with his khaki pants and it was tucked out. It was a casual wear and it didn’t allow us to take pictures. We are not professional photographers. It was our first  time to visit. We were disappointed of not having taking pictures by ourselves. We didn’t have anybody else to take our pictures so we had to bring a phone stand. But it wasn’t allowed. We don’t want to bother asking anyone to take our picture. I thought it was the best place to take pictures of us for our anniversary. I just thought it would be memorable for us. The staff lady didn’t let us. So disappointing. Very beautiful Mission. They have free audio tour devices that went into much details. Staff was friendly. Price of admission is worth it with how much there was to see. I went at 2pm and closed at 5pm and within those 3 hours I still didn't see everything (I was listening to the audio guide so I took my time learning the history of the mission). Children might not appreciate all the historical information but its still beautiful to walk around and keep them engaged. The church inside the mission is beautiful. Heads up, weddings are not allowed but I did see 5 couples bring a photographer and in weddings attire, don't know if you have to ask permission for that.

name: Mission San Luis Rey - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
After exploring the main mission church, you can enter the museum right through the gift shop for an adult admission fee of $8. This seems to be the standard setup for most California Old Missions, making it very easy to find. I’ve visited about 5 to 6 missions so far, but this was only my third time checking out the actual museum, and I am so glad I did. 🏛️📜

The museum does a wonderful job explaining the history and conditions of the early missionary era. It feels very much like an anthropology and history museum, packed with rich historical evidence and fascinating artifacts. Walking through the exhibits and seeing the deep historical roots also gave me a beautiful moment of reflection on how my own faith has evolved over time, which left me feeling incredibly proud and fulfilled. 🙏✨

It takes about 30 minutes to thoroughly look through everything, making it a perfect, quick addition to your visit. If you want to dive deeper into the rich history behind the mission, I highly recommend stopping by! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I didn’t know what to expect going in, but it was absolutely beautiful. The architecture and the rich history of the mission made it a truly memorable experience. The staff were incredibly kind and helpful throughout my visit. I would highly recommend this place to anyone considering a pilgrimage. Very well maintained mission - free to enter, but with an entry fee for museum.  We enjoyed the chapel, met a friendly Franciscan brother, and lingered in the peaceful courtyard cafe over cold brew coffee.  Small gift shop. Its beautiful 🥰🙏🙏 I bought holy water and some saint charms. I saw a man praying the rosary outside & it broke my heart. Wish I would've asked him if he was ok....Still thinking about the situation.  Will pray for him We had a delightful evening at the Candlelight Concert at San Luis Rey Mission. The concert was professionally organized and the technology very convenient.
The staff were friendly and diligent, and the concert as promised. Beautiful setting and the musicians, young as they were, also very accomplished. We’ll gladly repeat the experience.

name: Mission San Luis Rey Parish - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
Which California Mission did you choose? If you know you know….A great place to visit, beautiful grounds, mission cemetery is peaceful, museum informative. During school days the parking lot is full of school buses. A great day trip. A must visit if you are in near Oceanside, California A very nice church with both an old mission and chapel. Both look very nice 😊 the sierra center is so big and is also nice! I’ve been coming here for years and appreciate it. My last visit was in October of 2016. My grandmother grew up in that mission and went to school there when she was a kid. Some of our family is buried there, and we are a part of the San Luis Rey Mission band of Natives.
Some pretty cool history I learned from her and from visiting there! Wonderful place to tour! Beautiful for photography and history. The architecture is impressive and the grounds are so peaceful. You can walk around the gardens and cemetery and be alone with your thoughts. Enjoy the Spanish architecture and the desert landscape. Both are incredibly impressive. Go walk around & explore. Good place to just slow down & relax. Found a cool Koi & turtle pond & prayer Chapel on east side by the Parish & offices & school.  Open to public & saw people bringing small kids to see fish, etc.

name: Mission San Rafael Arcángel - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary:
Vibrant, engaging, faith filled multicultural community. Historical landmark, many events. Street parking and lot parking. Plan ahead it can get unexpectedly busy and traffic can build up.

Beautiful new church next to the original Mission.

Helpful volunteers will answer questions and help you find what you need. Our visit to Mission San Rafael was brief. We knew the underlying history of this site being completely rebuilt, etc. There are plenty of other great reviews with interesting historic information previously posted.  Still were interested to visit and glad we stopped by. It is a small charming mission, and at sunset it was truly beautiful. Adjacent hilly streets were calm and quiet at that time, beautiful lush plants and blooming flowers surrounded the mission. It was a lovely stop on our way from Napa to Novato. Small replica but amazing experience. The  ladies that volunteer are amazingly helpful. We brought our son up from Los Angeles for his school project and it was a beautiful experience for the family A Serene Historic Haven: Tucked away just steps from the bustling center of San Rafael, this reconstructed Mission (a nod to the 1817 original) offers a tranquil and intimate glimpse into California's Spanish colonial past. It is not just a landmark, but a living, working Catholic mission that provides a peaceful escape for visitors and locals alike.
Intimate and Charming Architecture: The small, 1949-rebuilt chapel is a gorgeous, quaint replica with a warm interior that feels both historical and welcoming. It is a lovely place to sit, pray, or simply appreciate the quietude of its surroundings. Both churches or buildings are beautiful and they are interesting for learning the origins of the place. They are great for dramatic pictures as well.

name: Mission Store at Mission San Juan Capistrano - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary: Good gift shop within the San Juan Mission site. Has a lot of religious items like crosses, crucifixes, icons, rosary, Christian themed home decor and stationary items. Also sells some more general touristy items like snacks, locally made food items, and general souvenirs (shot glass, magnets, postcards, etc). Reasonable prices and a lot of options. Friendly staff members Such a historic place! I came here a couple times as a kid for field trips, but this was my first time visiting as an adult and I'm so glad I did! It's a lot bigger than I remembered, though it's not quite as big as, say, the Santa Barbara mission. Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area--loads of history and cool architecture and scenery to take in. Lots of goodies in the gift shop as well. this place is a hidden gem. we went looking for the gift shop and decided to pay to enter the mission and it was beautiful, It was like walking into the past. So many items, and lots that are actually relevant to the mission / state / religion.  You can enter the store without admission to the mission itself. Interesting history! Enjoyed touring the old mission as well as the Basilica.

name: Mission Viejo Christian Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I feel like I need to write a review to let people who may be searching know how much MVCC means to us. Years ago we found ourselves searching for a new home church for our family. We visited what we felt like was every church in the area-but the moment we landed at Mission Viejo Christian Church, we knew we were home.

The pastoral team is incredible! You can tell by how they’re out chatting with people before and after church how much they love and care deeply for every single person who attends. The worship music is powerful and uplifting, and the whole environment is centered on Christ while also being a fun place to be! I genuinely look forward to Sundays each week now! but the best thing about MVCC is that is isn’t just a “Sunday”place. There are various ministries, service projects, and so many other ways to be involved and connected in the church community which I feel is so important

If you have children, our daughters absolutely LOVE the children’s ministry—they literally RUN in which is a big deal for our usually clingy preschooler. It has been such a blessing to our family!! If you have been searching- give mission viejo Christian church a try. I cannot recommend it enough! We started going to church here 3 years ago. One of the best decisions we have made. It can feel awkward to go to a new church. People were so welcoming but not overbearing. Giving us just enough space to explore and get to know people in our time. I especially loved that the Pastor would walk us through the verse each week- giving historical context and setting the scene and then explaining and diving us deep in thought on how we apply this now. We love the missions the church supports and how involved they are in the local community. Giving us so many ways and options to be involved.

Kids ministry has a wonderful and loving team. Flexible to what each child and parent needs to feel comfortable. Bible stories and lesson plans appropriate for each age group. I always feel safe leaving my kiddos. Some of the same ladies who loved our kiddos when they were little and crying are still there to love our kiddos as they grow. Investing in them as they get older.

If you are looking for a church who has real people just looking to love the world how Jesus did this is a place for you. Hope to see you there! Very angry little church. They will claim it’s a harassment campaign when in fact it’s them trying to cause issues with people legally filming in public. This is a church, not a place of political beliefs.

Edit for the response: you cannot control how people film on public spaces, because it is protected under the first amendment MVCC has been my church home for over 3 years. My life is better because of the Biblical teaching and loving people. I love our women's Bible studies and life groups which helped me form new life-long friendships. MVCC offers engaging children and student ministries, MomCo, and so many ways to grow in your faith in Jesus. Come visit soon! We love MVCC! They have amazing childrens and youth programs. Our kids have been goign for years and have made some of their best friends there. All of the pastors are great as well.

We absolutely love this church! It is apparent that God fills this church with his love. Everyone is welcoming and the pastors are very personable. Our children also love Momentum which is very important to us as a family. The worship is great and the messages are easy to understand. Whether you’re searching for a church home or just passing through, please join us! We began visiting a few months ago and partnered shortly after. It didn't take our family long to know that Momentum was a place we wanted to call our church home.The Pastors and staff at Momentum are very welcoming and are truly authentic and honest in everything that they do.  Momentum gives to the community in so many different ways and there are so many opportunities for everyone of all ages to be a part of that. They also place a huge focus on the kids. Our 4 kids are always greeted by name when they walk in and they have fun and look forward to going each week. Always made to feel welcome
Love the coffee in the morning before service Early on Sunday mornings starting around 7am this church plays loud music with the bass level so high that the sound beats through our ENTIRE subdivision. Residents complain to the board, the board members have called the church, emailed, called the pastor directly to no avail. There is a family with a special needs child who is awaken every Sunday morning, a family with a newborn that's awaken every Sunday morning, there are essential workers working overnight that cant get any rest sunday mornings. Churches are for the community, why would this church not care how they are affecting the community? We aren't asking them to stop playing music, we are asking for the bass to be lowered. That is beyond reasonable, but not in their eyes clearly. It's sad and selfish. One of my neighbors said he is just gonna call the police. We should be able to work this out with our board and the church but they have chosen to ignore our board.

name: Momentum Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary:
I truly love being a part of Momentum Church! From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with warmth and kindness. Everyone is so welcoming and kind. Pastor Daniel encourages us to connect with one another and build meaningful relationships. His messages are always powerful, and he has a gift for breaking down scripture in a way that’s easy to understand and apply to everyday life.
Plus, the location in Sugar Land couldn’t be more perfect! If you’re looking for a church home, I highly recommend checking out Momentum Church. 💚 Wonderful community, preaching, and team. Everyone is so kind and welcoming. I have been attending for 2 months now and every week has been impactful. I have learned so much while being so welcomed. To put it simply, Momentum Church brought God back into my life. I never knew a place so full of love, community, generosity, and faithfulness to God until I discovered Momentum. Pastors Daniel and Ashley are so kind and passionate, and truly set the example of what humility looks like. I would absolutely recommend this church to anyone who feels alone, because Momentum proved to me that I wasn’t. I’m blessed to call Momentum Church my home. This is my home church. I love this place. The word and the team are amazing. Pastor is very involved and anointed. My entire life has changed from the day I stepped into this church. I am so happy to call it home! the best church ever, God is doing big things here. my life has changed dramatically since attending and being a part of the community. highly recommend.

name: Momentum Church - Woodstock - Woodstock Campus
reviewSummary:
Momentum is absolutely AMAZING! The positive, welcoming ENERGY is felt as soon as you walk through the door. The pastors  disseminate relatable teachings connected to daily life. The choir and the music 🎶 are impeccable!! The church walks the walk by the intentional connection to the community needs and issues!! A MAGNIFICENT gem in both Woodstock and Jasper!!! Incredible church with an extremely dedicated staff! The Pastors at this church are more accessible than any other church I have ever been to. Every sermon is done next to the Bible every step along the way. It’s more similar to a bible study every Sunday than it is a feel good message with 1 or 2 verses at the beginning. I absolutely love and appreciate this place so much and have learned so much.
Thanks Momentum! I've been attending Momentum for 5 years now and I'm so happy to be a part of a church that not only helps its members but gives back to the community!  All of the pastors deliver sermons that pertain to daily life and they truly care about people!  So glad we found our church home ❤️ By far the most welcoming and loving church I have ever attended. This place is a come as you are and leave changed kind of place. I feel so at home here and I have never felt a closer relationship with Jesus before attending Momentum. All of the pastors are amazing at speaking the Word and bringing you an important message while making you laugh and the worship is so authentic and real you shouldn’t be surprised to shed a few tears. This church is so diverse and loving. You won’t be disappointed. Stop by because we would love to have you!! My family and I have been attending Momentum Church for three years now. Coming from a completely different religious background, I must say, it was quite a change for me/us. We felt warmth and welcomed from day one and it has continued to grow from there. The walls and roof of the building are not the church--the people inside are. And, what you will find inside are some of the most genuine, loving, and gifted people who are doing their best to walk with Christ. The people of Momentum Church have become our mentors, our friends, and our family--we love doing life with them. Are we perfect? No! We are real. If you're looking for biblical teaching, wisdom, worship, and a place where you can come as you are and be encouraged as you grow on your journey--look no further. Pastor Ross Wiseman along with his team of pastors and organizational leaders provide just such a place. Hope to see you on Sunday!

name: Monroe Community Church
reviewSummary:
What a great place to worship! Wish I lived in the area. They have sectioned off various areas to accommodate all their congregation. Kids and babies have special areas and it appears they have child care services for working families. Staff was very kind and welcoming. Arrprize venue. What a friendly inviting and welcoming church to attend, my first time here was a very amazing experience, I wish I would have started coming sooner. The sermon, pastor, music and people were so uplifting, giving me the feeling of the Spirit inside me, something I've needed through these hard trials and tribulations that I've had to endure.
I will definitely be attending every Sunday and would recommend this church to anyone that is looking for a casual friendly and welcoming place to go. Amen 🙏 We have visited MCC at least 5 times to be with family who call it home. Everytime has been fresh and genuine: the worship, the messages, especially the people, have been a blessing to us. The building as well - the interior design, the art - contributes to an atmosphere where spiritually you feel like you can breathe. I often come here to see art pieces for ArtPrize and the venue is really nice and clean inside. The staff I have come in contact with have always been extra friendly!

name: Monte Vista Chapel - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary: Montevista Chapel is such a beautiful and well-maintained place. It’s not only a chapel — there is also a wonderful children’s center and a high school on the campus, with huge parking areas and a very welcoming environment. Everything at the children’s center is excellent. The staff members are very kind, helpful, and always greet everyone politely. Even the administration staff is amazing and supportive. Overall, everything here is organized, peaceful, and professional. Highly recommended! Fun christmas drive thru with free hot chocolate! I can tell it takes a lot of work! Much appreciated when so many things are closed! This is a wonderful church that focuses on spiritual formation and what it means to become more like Christ. The Bible is not studied like a textbook, but rather, as God's word that shows us how to become who he has created us to be. Very welcoming. If you want to feel convicted and encouraged, come! Very welcoming Church with tons of nice people!

name: Monte Vista Church of Christ - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Wednesday night service. It was singing night and song leaders were great. Nice to know their are others thousands of miles away trying to serve the Lord. Was encouraged by my visit. The Monte Vista church of Christ is a family of believers who meets regularly to worship God and encourage each other.

Our membership is diverse and we welcome people from all backgrounds.  We have people from different age groups, from different ethnicities and from different social-economic backgrounds.  By shedding ourselves of our differences and uniting ourselves in the purposes of God, we believe that we can be unified as God’s people.

We have no allegiance to any religious body except that of Christ’s.  We are not governed by any outside organization.  Following Biblical example, we are responsible for our own worship and work, striving for the unity of believers and looking to Biblical examples for our church practices.  Hence, we seek to worship God in the same manner as the early New Testament churches, teaching as they taught and being what they were -- followers of Christ committed to bringing His truth to the world.

It is our sincere hope that you will come and worship with us again.  We believe that you will find our practices consistent with the Bible and trust that you will find our church family a place where you are welcome and truly feel at home.

In Christian Love,
Jason Amalong, elder Very nice Church and very kind and loving people ... alot of toddlers in service though because they don't have an actual nursery where you have someone to watch over the kids although they do have a room for you and your baby if kids get fussy during the sermon Just visited for the day but so welcoming and an amazing sermon on death and how Christians have hope and Heaven waiting Wonderful place to worship our Lord. reviewSummary:

reviewSummary:

name: Moon Valley Bible Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: We love it here! We’re a late 30s/early 40s family with a 2nd grader, trying to survive the modern age of busyness, overconsumption, technology, and everything else that isn’t new under the sun. We found a respite here at Moon Valley Bible Church. They truly live up to their call of “relationally safe, biblically sound”and their mission to bring life! Every Sunday is like taking a pause from the chaos and noise around us and stepping into a calming and positive environment. Don’t misunderstand though, while the experience has been rejuvenating for us on a deep level, thoughtful and peaceful, the facility itself and the programs for our child, are current and fun! They have an amazing playplace and areas for the littles up to the teens! They have lots to offer as far as free family events, outreach, volunteer opportunities, bible study, etc. They even have free mentorship which has been life changing for both my husband and myself. Finally, the preaching is phenomenal. Not fluffy or misguided or lacking. It’s based on the Bible, it has substance that is actually applicable. I’ve personally never experienced anything like it. Have been attending here for a little over a year now.  Wonderful church.  The preacher preaches from the Bible with the perspective that it is 100% accurate and divinely inspired by the Holy Spirit.  His messages are very revealing and 'scholarly'.  His wonderful sense of humor comes through in his messages.  The worship band is rather contemporary, but hymns are heard as well.  The music is very uplifting.  Try this church out if you're looking for a church, or a different church.  We did, haven't looked back since.  Just come and visit.... sit in the back and observe and drink coffee... it's a very relaxed atmosphere. This church family is currently in the midst of a whole heap of change. New construction is on the way, but the biblical teaching and grace filled church family are the same as they always have been. To this day, have never found a more welcoming church home. My wife and I had wandered from church to church of various Christian faiths, searching for one that felt right and comfortable for us. I, for one, was always annoyed with over zealous greeters who seemed to pounce on new visitors like salesmen at a car dealer. Friends invited us to Moon Valley 6 years ago. We have been going there ever since and became members three years ago. We found that senior pastor, Bob Kerrey, had a welcoming spirit about him and delivered his sermons in a self deprecating and humorous manner while also explaining scripture in such lay man's terms that we actually learned more about the bible than we ever had before elsewhere. Listen and watch sermons at their website to find out for yourself. Not only the Pastor Bob Kerrey genuinely caring but also are the other members of the church.  Very warm & welcoming.

Loved the service, simple as it should be, awesome worship time, biblical preaching. I will definitely come back! WOW!  Morningside Baptist Church is home.  This church is a jewel for Morningside, Piedmont Heights, Ansley, and Midtown Atlanta.  The message is always spot on and completely supported by the bible.  Jonathan  is over the music. name: Morningside Presbyterian Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
After enrolling my son in Morningside's daycare for roughly 3 months, I had to withdraw him after being bullied on a regular basis in front of staff while they sat and did nothing. My son came home crying begging me not to send him back after being bullied by a van full of students while the driver did nothing to help him. He was even physically attacked by another child while the staff member admitted to "watching to see how far it would go" and did nothing to help him. name: Mosaic Christian Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary: I loved being able to be a part of Mosaic Christian Church. I felt safe when I left my children in the childcare. I knew Pastor Frank and his family personally. He officated our wedding. I have moved far away, but still enjoy watching Pastor Jeff online, and love hearing how God is moving in this place. No negative review could ever change my mind of what I know to be true about God, and the experience I have had at this location. Been a part of Mosaic for over 13 years; started coming in college with friends and loved the authenticity and community so much that I stayed. Even got married here :) Sunday sermons are not only encouraging but also thought and action-provoking as well. Tip--get involved at Mosaic and you'll gain some lovely friends! Thanks Pastor Jeff, Pastor Bob, Pastor Chris, Pastor Roenz and all the other staff for striving to make Mosaic a true reflection of Christ! Great church to call home. The pastors put an emphasis on being real and authentic and it really shows. They don't want to be a church that just talks the talk, they want to live it out. I've formed a lot of great friendships because of people I've met at this church. Looking for church that feels like home where you feel connected and grow lasting relationships with a variety of different peoples   definitely give yourself a break and visit Mosaic been baptized and attending for almost a year changed my life The Church of warmth, welcoming and fantastic energy. It was truly a blessing to walk into this church and to get the help I was looking for. Thank you Mosaic for your blessings. I truly hope to come and be a part of your Sunday service!!!

name: Mosaic Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: I do not recommend attending this church if you truly love and value your relationship with Christ. I made a request to meet with Pastor rod at the church to discuss some concerns with him he was very rude and aggressive and visibility agitated and triggered by the conversation. I don’t get a Christ like feel from the church nor the kids academy they definitely have some shady things going on I attended this church hoping to find a biblically grounded community that reflected the love, truth, and grace of Christ. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. The messages often felt watered down and focused more on personal opinions and motivational topics than the Gospel itself. While I understand the importance of making sermons relatable, I left feeling like biblical truth was being softened rather than faithfully preached. Additionally, I did not experience the warmth and friendliness that I would expect from church leadership and staff. Several interactions felt unwelcoming, making it difficult to feel connected or valued as a visitor. Every church has its strengths and weaknesses, but for those seeking strong biblical teaching and a Christ-centered atmosphere, this may not be the right fit. My hope is that the church places a greater emphasis on the Gospel and creates a more welcoming environment for everyone who walks through its doors. This is an amazing church. I have been going here since 2005. This church loves its congregation and community around it. We are a come as you are church family, we are better with you here. Our pastor preaches the Gospel. Our youth and children's programs are amazing. Please come check us out. Very saddening some of the things I recently found out about the church and kids academy. So many people left with church hurt because of places like this I do not recommend the church or kids academy Very welcoming, great kids programming, and Biblical teaching!

name: Mosaic Church - Provo
reviewSummary: We loved our time at Mosaic in Provo! This church is full of genuine community and authentic worship. Whether you’re curious about faith, looking for a place to belong, or already following Jesus, Mosaic meets you where you are and points you to the hope found in Him. From making new friends and praying together, to sharing in the Lord’s Supper, to experiencing Christ-centered worship and solid biblical teaching—Mosaic is a place worth visiting. They are helping make Jesus known in their city, and it’s exciting to see. What a beautiful church and so welcoming to a total stranger and just in town for the week… it had great worship and awesome message which was inspiring and encouraging… great church and if your in the area stop in and if are local come check it out… This is a church that truly and wholly loves the God that they preach. I’ve been going to Mosaic for about 3 years now. It’s been incredible to see how the Lord has used this place to bring people into his fold. The preaching? Solid, verse-by-verse, and expositional. The music? I may be biased since I play guitar from time to time, but it is amazing! The community? It reminds me of home, it’s a smaller church still and everyone knows your name. That can sound scary until you realize what a blessing it is to know the people in your church and to have them know you. Very welcoming to visitors as well! If you’ve never been to a Baptist church, looking for a new church, or are just trying out Christianity for the first time, come and see. Biblical God loving church. Has an amazing community of believers Mosaic Church has truly felt like home since my wife and I moved to Provo. We love the community and welcoming faces that Mosaic always has. Mosaic has many great things to offer but one of my favorite things has been the opportunity to get to meet up with people within the church and have fellowship and discipleship. We love Mosaic ❤️

name: Mosaic Church Evans - Evans Campus
reviewSummary: I'm at the pastor at Mosaic Church in he was the most wonderful fellow. I was there because they were hosting the Augusta prayer breakfast which is very unique thing that happens in augusta. An amazing church with a great community. I couldn't ask for more The most hateful 👹 Church ever, never even got in the front door, when I asked if they do outreach with community and have music the pastor told me I would be better off going to another church, and when I made a post about it the pastor told me to not make a post, he never apologized or explained his attitude. Anyone can have a bad day but that was so rude! I moved here six and a half years ago and was calling around trying to find a good church. Evidently he didn't like me because I'm female or because my last name which obviously indicates I'm white. I wanted to find a good church that does outreach that I can volunteer with, obviously that won't be the one. I'm never came across any pastor that didn't want to invite you into their church, the most bizarre experience ever. I feel so sorry for the people going there 5 stars doesn't do this place justice. I'm usually a very skeptical mama bear when it comes to my son because he has been through so much dealing with physical and behavioral special needs. I have wanted to find a church home for us for quite some time but was afraid after a couple of traumatic experiences in the past. I felt compelled to give Mosaic a try after reading about their mission and reaching out to Ms. Jenni from the KidCity program. From the time we walked in I just felt at ease, like I didn't need to worry about him there. They had so many things to accommodate him like a sensory room and a quiet space he could go if he needed to and they had people specially trained to help him. He told me he loved it and wants to go back often! That was enough right there to make me want to go back, but the icing on the cake was when I went into the worship area, I just started crying pretty much the whole service. It was tears of joy and the only reason I could think of as to why that happened was that God wanted me to be there. That place is powerful I'm telling you. That has never happened to me before. I am done looking for a church home for us. This is it. I hope you come and give it a try too. Friendly congregation.  Nice services.   Love the amazing pastor.  Bible and spiritual formation emphasized.  You can tell they love Jesus.  Go and worship.

name: Mosaic Community Church Seattle
reviewSummary:
This church has had very positive and very negative impacts on my life.

I have seen this church present oversimplified solutions to complex problems, which can be very attractive, but this review’s purpose is to think holistically about how Mosaic’s church culture warrants a closer look.

As it usually is, my story and Mosaic’s are complex. I’ll give some highlights here for brevity. My main goal is just that young people (especially college students) go into community here with their eyes open. I hope but do not expect leadership to change. I would not be surprised if there is a reply to this review that denies and over spiritualizes any shortcomings. I would also not be surprised if a reply passively paints me as a person who needs to grow… I do! But that is not what this post is about.

-Many MANY people have left this church over more than a decade, not just because Seattle is a transient city (as leadership may say). People have continued to leave because they did not feel cared for by the leadership of this church when they were hurting.
-There is a tendency to brush off problems and hurt in this church and ignore genuine concerns brought up by members.
-This church has a culture of empowering leaders with zeal, charisma, and spiritual gifting. While this isn’t inherently wrong, they promote these traits over strong character. People who are introverted, lead humbly, and don’t need the spotlight are often overlooked and disregarded.
-The movement this church is a part of, the Antioch Movement of Churches, puts great emphasis on learning the Antioch way of doing things. If you want to be brought in to the inner circle or just be fully included, you need to become more like them.
-This puts more emphasis on (I am going to use a scary word) INDOCTRINATION, then on being the unique person God created you to be, transformed by his love.
-In the Church, we should belong before we believe. This church has shown a tendency for the opposite. If you have disagreed with them on certain hot topics of our day, you may be told to leave and find another flock.
-The leaders at this church have a tendency to portray themselves as the tip of the spear in a very worldly city. If you want to be a part of what God is doing, they imply that you need to be at this church or attend one that is very similar.
-I am sure their leaders would vehemently deny this above claim. There is much feigned humbleness (maybe some genuine) but you’ll recognize it when you see it.
-There is more… classic stuff like lack of real accountability, lack of qualifications of pastors, unappreciated and under compensated staff, charismania, revivalism, lack of transparency, putting leaders on pedestals, bad theology taught in their training school, burn out culture, toxic expectations of college students to give everything, and the list goes on…

No church is perfect. We are all sinners 100%. Yet that does not mean we have to stay where we are.

All of what I have shared is based off my personal experience.

I do believe this church does do discipleship intentionally and effectively (yet some times heavy handed). They preach the Gospel, believe in the power of God for today, and most importantly they do love Jesus very much. Such wonderful staff and the minister is one of the best! The community involved is also welcoming with open arms and always wanting to bring you into the church family. I am from Alaska and while visiting Seattle I attended the 7:00pm Easter service. The atmosphere was radiant, the people were welcoming, and the songs were not only beautiful but powerful. The sermon was so moving, it touched my heart and left me in tears. The stories and testimonies shared were inspiring. This church community feels like a family, they treat everyone with love, compassion, grace, and tenderness- nomatter who you are or what you believe. They embody everything I could ever want in a church. I was privileged enough to witness and celebrate someone's baptism. The love, the joy, and the kindness in this church was something I had never felt before. Every interaction I had was sincere and felt personable. They truly made me feel at home.
Thank you Mosaic Community Church for this memorable and joyous experience. I will certainly return here the next time I visit Seattle. I love Mosaic Eastside!! They are so welcoming and I always feel at home when I’m here. Leadership is so friendly and they want to get to know you! And they have a warm cup of coffee and doughnuts when you walk in the door :) Their sermons are biblical and based on truth. i am pretty new to Seattle, moved here in September 2021 and began attending church at Mosaic in October. something i really love about this church is how they host the presence of The Lord in worship and prayer. if you are someone who is looking to grow in their relationship with Jesus in those ways, this is the place for you. since moving here and becoming more involved with the Mosaic church family, my relationship with Jesus has grown significantly. this family truly loves Jesus. they inspire me to keep my spirit sharp and to continuously seek God. i love being a part of this church family.

name: Mosaic Los Angeles
reviewSummary: Iconic creative church in Hollywood and Downtown LA founded by Erwin McManus, renowned for inspiring artistic expression, modern worship music, and innovative urban ministry.

name: Mosaic Silver Spring - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome church! This church body has been a great blessing to us as regulars for a few years now. We used to meet in downtown Silver Spring in the County Civic building, but moved to this new locale in Four Corners. There’s a warm community of friendly people and a strong love of God. The worship services are simple, sermons are relevant and most people dress casually. Great place to worship in the heart of Silver Spring (inside the Civic Center, just look for the signs).We were greeted warmly as newcomers and have been active members ever since. We love the diversity of the congregation and the community groups that have been set up to get you plugged into the church. They love Jesus and want to make Him known to all people which is reflected in how they love people from all walks of life! Wonderful place to worship in downtown Silver Spring (inside the Civic Center). I was warmly welcomed and have been part of this diverse community  ever since. They have a heart for the city and for the good news of Jesus to be known. FYI, this church regularly meets at the given address which is the Civic Center in downtown Silver Spring.  Because the Civic Center is used for a variety of events, however, the church often has to meet at an alternate location.
A frequent alternate location is the Sheraton Hotel located at 8777 Georgia Ave. Silver Spring, MD 20910 My wife and I felt like a part of the community since our first visit. They are a church who loves the city, and they faithfully preach the gospel faithfully week to week.  You'll find them usually in the Civic Building, but sometimes they meet at the Sheraton or Double Tree.

name: Mother of Divine Providence Church
reviewSummary:
I of all people know that NO religion is without it's bad apples & scandals. This church and school are my blessing from above. Attended Mass here while visiting the area.  Parking is convenient and it was easy to find using my GPS.
Being only a few miles from Villanova, it was neat being here the weekend that Pope Leo ascended to the papacy. The atmosphere was electric. Lovely church - enjoyed our visit to this parish at the 4pm Mass on a Saturday. So nice to see a string ensemble providing music along with the organ and Cantor! God bless their clergy and congregation. Great parish! Everyone on staff here is very good about making sure you have an opportunity to get involved and make friends. My husband and I received a lot of support as we validated our marriage and I entered the chhrch. Every thing a place of worship should be.. Attended a very solemn Sunday mass .. people maintained decorum were friendly and respectful.. felt rejuvenated..

name: Motor City Church
reviewSummary:
It's the first church I felt the holy Spirit at. The first church the pastor gave me money when I needed it. It's very welcoming. Very encouraging. And helps me have a relationship with Jesus Christ. I will always have a special place in my heart for motor City Church. If you have a true desire to grow in your relationship with God, this is an excellent community of believers. A younger man randomly asked if he could pray with me. The Lead Pastor preaches the word with precision and gives the application, reflective, and bold in every way.
The praise and worship is a throne room experience full of anointed ecclesia.. The risen Lord of all creation is worshipped, exalted, and lifted high. I love this extension of the body of Christ. I've actually been praying for this group for awhile. Every time I'm there I see believers from every tribe and nation and breaking barriers!!!
I highly recommend this church with all my heart. Instant love!! Feeling of " Home-MyBros.and Sisters",I belong and I'll grow In My Faith and Maturity.
Pastor Dhockey is truly Anointed For Service, for Teaching Glory Amen.
A sister in Christ Jesus... Did not make it beyond security. The greeter were welcoming, but at the entrance being greeted by police officers in uniform, going through your bags and purses then unto a metal detector/scanner is not welcoming.  If you are going to have such you should also invest in a lockbox so the law abiding citizens that are legally carrying can at least secure safely their CC. Also you might want to put up a sign that you are a gunfree zone. I was not going to walk back to my car which is in a garage block over, to secure my weapon and then walk back. Love this church! Pastor Josh and all the volunteers are so welcoming. But most of all, he brings the Word! Straight from the Bible! It’s never what he says, but always what the word of God says. No tickled ears here. Just love, grace, and truth. ✝️

name: Mount Juliet Life Church - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church!

name: Mount of Olives Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, active church in Mission Viejo. Kid City is amazing for children. Great blended services. The messages are highly relevant and practical.

name: Mount of Olives Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Looks nice on the outside and classic but too much to handle the pitfalls. Don't mind is ushers and volunteered security is present. Weird to have all doors shut & not written up front ahead before coming in like a stadium. It's a church not some professional sports game. We get the things going around the nation on safety even bag checks but can be better used properly for everyone from new to regulars. Got announcements to be part off out of service listed though.

Not welcomed in a nice way by anyone but a hostile, business mindset. One of the male ushers was pushing it on me and my friend during communion. Didn't like how they are closed-minded and jump quickly to conclusions. This church can improve spreading ushers and volunteers around instead in like a ball or group. Not a single usher was in main service area the whole time. Huge regret to come here. Preaching can be more scripture to refer & more time on sermon or least worship rather than focused on testimony based. Management on time use is a issue here. Staff on pastoral is good but can have more males leading. Wonderful church and people!  Down to earth with small church feel and big church offerings. Amazing church and wonderful people who truly care. Wonderful sense of community. Beautiful worship music by phenomenal musicians. Messages are touching and relatable. The kids program is also remarkable and our children look forward to church every Sunday. We love Mount of Olives! Mount of Olives (MOO) was recommended to me three years ago (2013). I'm glad I went.  If you're looking for a church where you're looking for a down to earth connection with the pastor, a pastor who regularly delivers messages that you can apply on your daily life,  this is a good place to try.  Come visit and listen to Pastor John Steward. Lots of good people there at MOO. Our mission is "To Know Christ and Make Him Known". Everyone is welcome to our church family. The service, worship and fellowship center around God's Amazing and Unconditional Grace. Come join us you will be glad you did!

name: Mount Olive Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
Mount Olive Lutheran Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Good people and environment.  Adult study is wonderful and the snacks after service rock my socks. Eh, it was dark.i just walked around. Nice place. Very nice church. Friendly people Exceptional place to worship. Wonderful service

name: Mount Paran Church
reviewSummary: A spirit-filled worship community in Atlanta with a diverse congregation and engaging worship experience.

name: Mount Paran Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church.  Dr Cooper is biblically solid and the music is fantastic.  Lots of opportunities for the whole family to grow in Christ. Excellent church. Went to their Christmas Music concert 🎄🎚️🎄
Beautiful choral performance.

Dr. Cooper is a wonderful preacher of God’s word. The experience here is a blessing to me every time. I highly recommend Mount Paran Church. This has been my church for many years under pastor Dr. David Cooper.  Each Sunday you hear an inspiring message based on the word and not a person’s beliefs. The music is very uplifting with an excellent orchestra and band.

The people are very warm, friendly and inviting.  They welcome everyone at this church.

Each Sunday you are greeted by multiple people saying “Welcome Home” Every time I have the opportunity to see my friends again, we meet at MP on Sunday morning. It's always an amazing experience. I invite you to come visit us. I visited this Church last year for the first time while in search of more of God. This has become my Church home and each time I go, I receive more and more of him. It's an amazing atmosphere to truly Worship and hear from God. Our church family is creatively coloured by the various ethnicities, but together we are one. You feel the loved and welcome everytime you visit Mount Paren in Atlanta. Feel free to join us in the Lord's House for 9am or 11 am worship.

name: Mount Pisgah Church - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary:
Went there 20 years ago. Present pastor gives great sermons. You will be blest Mt. Pisgah Church is an absolute gem, and I can't say enough good things about their vibrant Hispanic church community! From the moment you walk in, you're greeted with such warmth and genuine hospitality. It truly feels like a family, and everyone is so welcoming, whether you're a regular or visiting for the first time.
The services are filled with incredible energy. The music is uplifting and heartfelt, really setting a joyful tone for worship. And the messages are always inspiring and relevant, delivered with such passion and clarity. You leave feeling refreshed and encouraged, ready to tackle the week ahead.
What really stands out is the strong sense of community. There are so many opportunities to connect with others, from lively fellowship events to meaningful small groups. It's a place where friendships blossom and people genuinely care for one another. If you're looking for a church that feels like home, especially within a wonderful Hispanic community, Mt. Pisgah is definitely the place to be. It's a truly special church! ✝️✨This is a wonderful place✨Only having visited four times while in town every 11 AM service -The music is amazing and the message is so inspirational and thought-provoking. My friend who is a member of this church invited a friend and I to the 2018 Christmas Festival titled: JOY. This was a wonderful production put on by church members which included many children. It was very well done with a nice variety of music and dancing and the Christmas story acted out as well. We all really enjoyed it. The sanctuary is beautiful and the whole building is very nice and modern. We also enjoyed the Christmas decorations throughout. Great assembly to worship our living God

name: Mount Pleasant Christian Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful, Bible-based community with loving people serving Jesus, each other, and the community. The worship is focused on Jesus, and all the elders, pastors, staff are wise and excellent examples. The children’s and youth programs are amazing! The Impact Center is an incredible faith-based outreach center that helps hundreds of families. There are many opportunities to learn, grow, and serve alongside encouraging people. I cannot recommend it enough as it has been my family’s church home for over a decade! Be "content" with what you have & asking for a days worth of pay to remodel a kids area in the same sentence. As massive as this church is, you should be content with the size & come up with better suggestions. The LORD says YOU SHOULD BE TEACHING THE PEOPLE ABOUT JESUS' RETURN! GETTING PEOPLE RADICALLY SAVED FOR JESUS! He says THE CHURCH IS NOT AWAKE! JESUS' RETURN IS AT HAND & YOURE WORRIED ABOUT KIDS SPACE! KEEPING PEOPLE LUKEWARM IS GOING TO SEND A LOT OF THEM TO HELL! WAKE UP CHURCH! THE HARVEST IS PLENTY & THE WORKERS ARE FEW! 1 Corinthians 5:5 is coming for the church first; a CLEANSING the house! WAKE UP CHURCH!! My kids love this church! Incredible student ministry & staff team. Love their Impact Center Food Pantry! My wife and I love the music & message. The pastor and staff are truly authentic. We highly recommend. I am church “shopping” and yesterday I attended Mt Pleasant. What a great lesson by Matt!!!!  It truly spoke to me about grace. Thank you for a wonderful service Was excited to be back to visit! Wish I lived closer so I could come more often. I love the children's ministry. They make my daughter feel comfortable right away which is great! I always enjoy the service as well...the worship, the sermon, all of it is great!! Everyone I encounter there always makes me feel very welcome and they go out of their way to help my daughter and I.

name: Mount Soledad Presbyterian Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been a part of this church for nine years. I love it. It is my second family I feel welcomed as my authentic self every time I come. The Worship is amazing beyond words on Sundays and the sermons are relatable and introspective.  The small groups and events are meaningful and fun and creative.
This place is not over the top, nor preachy,  nor judgey. It’s just a group of welcoming people who aim to love their neighbors, become better versions of themselves, and grow in their faith with God. If you are curious, stop in.   If you want to screen an online sermon before you come, give Easter April 5 2026 a listen. What a committed membership for this congregation led church. Whether through music, prayer or sermons, the worship ministry fosters a spirit of inclusion. Many opportunities to grow in faith through a variety of ministries. My granddaughter and grandson always look forward to church and the children and youth programs. This has been such a wonderful place for our family. The worship is contemporary with occasional hymns mixed in and is SO good. Every message from Pastor Markus is put in context, and even when the passage is something I've heard preached on before, I come away with a new perspective on it and a way to apply it to my life. Our kids love Sunday school where they quickly came to know all of the kids. They are sad when the Thursday night bible study is on break because they can't wait to go play with their friends (and hear a Bible story from the ministry director :)).

The best part of this church is the welcoming congregation. After a few weeks of attending it felt like we were already a part of the church. There are people of all ages and we all love to fellowship with delicious snacks after service. When we began our church hunt in San Diego, we thought it was going to be a long string of months until we found our home -- but after visiting Mount Soledad one time, we immediately fell in love. Pastor Markus is knowledgeable, funny, and open-minded. Plus, he puts scripture into its proper historical context -- you'll learn an occasional Greek word, see an occasional map, and learn what was really going on in every passage. I feel like I learn something new every sermon.

Most importantly to us, this church feels like a real community -- people get to know each other, there is a small group and prayer group every week, and the Sunday school is small and unintimidating for our kids. (They LOVE it there. Where once our kids felt ho-hum about going to church, now they beg to go every Sunday -- if that doesn't sell you on Mount Soledad, I don't know what will!) Mount Soledad Presbyterian Church is a warm welcoming place of worship. My husband and I have been attending for years and absolutely love everything about it. The worship is amazing, I look forward to it every Sunday. Pastor John is a strong leader, he is very present and always makes time for our family. The sermons are relatable and really speak to your heart. The congregation is friendly and it makes you feel at home. Our two children thrive in the Sunday school program. I love how they leave so excited to tell us about what they leaned about the Bible that Sunday. Our family invites anyone looking for a church to call home to visit Mount Soledad Presbyterian Church. It is a wonderful church.

name: Mount Vernon Baptist Church
Mount Zion Christian Church
reviewSummary:
Great place to worship and hear the word! Pastor Fozard can preach it!
Great 👍 basketball program! The Coaches are very good! There post grad program is one of the top progion the country! This is truly the best place to be. I have been here for most of my life, and I have truly been blessed. This church teaches me the Word of GOD, and I get fed spiritually all the time. I have attended the school also, and I absolutely loved it. This is the house of GOD and my church, and i never want to leave. I graduated from their academy in 2000.  The pastor, the church employees, and the church members all contributed positivly to the lives of the students.  So I don't understand the negative comments about the church being rude. I was at church there Wednesdays, some Tuesdays, sometime twice on Sundays for almost two school years.  I never seen anyone being treated rude.  If you don't like what some of the "harsh" realities of a rebuke based on scripture consist of you need to let go and let God. If you think the Lord is condoning nonsense and blasphemy you are sadly mistaken. That's grace you are falling under, a saving grace.  So go back to the church and learn you a lesson, yelp mavericks. I have been attending this church with my family since 2013 and I must say that the Apostle is truly a man of God he and his wife are both delightful ! They are both great teachers and truly walk upright with God. If you want your life transformed and mind renewed this is the place to be ! I have learned so much in 5 years than what I have learned in a lifetime ! God bless Apostle Fozard and Prophetess Fozard ! I am retired from the military going through some things and I called this church yesterday asking about their food pantry and the lady was so rude to me. She explained that I needed to call back this morning. I did so she screamed at me in a annoying way that food pantry begins at 7am and I said yes ma’am . I don’t know who the pastor here is but he needs to choose someone who is more of God because God is not of hate or anger or annoyance. I felt very disrespected and hurt by the way she talked to me. I am also looking for a church home and knowing how she is makes me want to look elsewhere . Jesus didn’t treat people of need with hatred . She should humble herself
