reviewSummary: i ve been going here since i was little and its the best place in the world this is literally where i live Accurate.Thank You.

name: Mountain Bible Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great Bible based church with a friendly and welcoming congregation of all ages with some multiple generation families attending. They have two pastors who share duties, and both have wives and young children. I appreciate the variety in sermon styles and how having two pastors at a small community church allows for plenty of opportunities to ask questions and learn. Pastor John is the best, really enjoy talking to him. Very small gathering... with authentic people,.. 10 a.m. service Friendly people great music

name: Mountain Brook Community Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: If you’re looking for a church in the Birmingham/Mountain Brook area that offers a blend of worship, community engagement, and relational small groups, Mountain Brook Community Church is a strong candidate. With its focus on connection and growth, it fits well for those seeking both meaningful weekly worship and ongoing spiritual community. Enjoyed the music and service. People were friendly. MBCC is my church. Jesus is honored and worshipped. Members and visitors are encouraged in their walk with Him, and we're always encouraged to repent of our sin, be in His word, and live unto Him. Our son has several disabilities, but he had an absolutely wonderful time in February at Aaron's Staff at Mtn. Brook Comm. Church. The volunteers couldn't have been more caring, there were plenty of them, and he was so happy there and on the way home. Thank you so much for enabling us to have some time together and for helping him to have fun with others. This program is amazing, and we praise the Lord for it. So thankful for these sweet people. I brought my Operation Christmas Child boxes here yesterday, as they were collecting them. I was slightly worried since I'd never been here and had heard stories of people at other drop off locations across the country having to leave their boxes outside (even in the snow!)because there was no one to accept them. This was so not the case at this church. The place to bring them was around back but they had clear signs leading you to the drop off area and had the doors wide open so no worries that they'd already left. The people working there quickly told me where to place my boxes and even helped me carry them. They also prayed with me over my boxes and the children who will receive them. I'm thankful that they made it an easy and fun experience!

name: Mountain Park Church
reviewSummary:
What a blessing mountain park church is. Mary I appreciate you for listening, caring and sharing during our troubled times. I'm so thankful to the staff for coming up with a plan and sharing it with pastor Greg. I pray God keeps His anointing on you all. #1 church  that shows compassion & you can feel it  again thank you all in Jesus name amen 🙏 A few years ago I attended the Easter sermon at Mountain Park. I was planning to meet some family there, and I was running a little late, so by the time I entered the sanctuary the service had already started.

I was greeted by a friendly older lady at the front. I then walked over to one of the tables off to the side and sat by myself because the pews seemed to be full. The woman that greeted me at the front walked over and sat next to me. She then quietly asked me if this was my first time here, and I said yes. Then, she asked me if I was Jewish. It was such an odd question, it completely caught me by surprise. I said "No." I have been Christian all my life. It was such an odd and inappropriate thing to say to someone that you don't even know. I felt really uncomfortable and confused. After that, she said I was "very handsome". At this point I became so creeped out and upset that I stopped talking to her, hoping she would just leave.

I have never had a more inappropriate and more uncomfortable experience in  my life at a Church. It was my first and only time at Mountain Park Church. I wish I would have left this review right after it happened, but I wanted to let it go. Every Easter I have thought about this strange interaction, so I thought I should let everyone know. Fantastic gym space for volleyball! My brother was sickand dying  in
hospital, i asked the church to have the pastor come be with me at the hospital(i grew up in this church, PASTOR Westgate married us) when they took my brother off life support, he also attend this "church". NO ONE CAME TO BE BY HIS SIDE WHEN I ASKED FOR HELP.

CHRIST is not in this church. I suggest you find another one. One where Christ actually is. MPC is a warm, family centered church where we strive to love each other as Jesus taught and modeled.  Gregg, our pastor, is an outstanding teacher and friend.

name: Mountain Park Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church, great community, variety of small groups for people to get plugged in. The events this church puts on are top level! We love it! Everyone is so friendly . It's a breath of fresh air to just go someplace for an hour where you don't experience rudeness , brashness , road rage and just be in the presence of a holy place. Free to worship as you'd like. Christian Band and singers are fantastic. Plus $4 fresh made iced coffees and home made treats at the little commissary. I'm a little biased to the founding pastor we had become good friends especially in a time of need personally but still ,  a wonderful church. Wonderful church family! Attended a funeral and celebration of life service at this church. People are amazing! Facility is great! Looks to be an asset to the community around it. We would attend if we lived in the area. my fiance and I have searching for a church that we can call home and we went to MPC on Sunday and absolutely loved it! Great worship team, great pastor, speaks from the bible and he’s not on a screen, it’s live which we love. looking forward to more Sundays there. Went there with my family yesterday and we loved it! Hopefully this will be our home church. Looking forward to next service 😀

name: Mountain Springs Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We felt so welcomed at the church and we are so excited to have found it! We were so impressed by the children's ministry and all of the activities and camps they offer. The sermon was wonderful and very inspirational and made us reflect and think. Everyone was so kind and welcomed us and were happy to chat and get to know us. While my perspectives are anecdotal and not diagnostic, it is concerning that Christian leaders would dismiss their worship pastor with a soulless narrative email template.  I truly ponder the parallel between pastors and personality hires when the academic rigor of seminary is missing from pivotal leader’s resumes.  If you are searching for something real, please be aware that the executive pastor claims that his “beard is real” as a captivating character defining characteristic displayed on the church website.  I imagine Jesus to be quite different. I recently moved next door to this church and had been meaning to visit for a while, but honestly, I was nervous. I hadn’t been to church in quite some time, and walking into somewhere new can feel intimidating. I finally decided to attend a little over a month ago, and my first service ended up being the Christmas Eve service.

I expected it to be crowded (and it definitely was!), so I figured I’d just slip in quietly and probably not meet anyone. But as soon as my daughter and I walked in, a kind woman came right up and greeted us. I had no idea who she was at first, but it turned out to be Kara, the hospitality director. The fact that someone from the team personally welcomed us made me feel so seen and important.

Throughout the service, other staff members also came up just to say hello to my daughter and me. I don’t know if I looked brand new or what, but everyone was so intentional and genuinely warm.

From day one, we felt truly welcomed here, and that meant more than I can put into words. I’m so glad we found this church, especially right next door. It already feels like home. So... I had disagreed with what the pastor had said regarding the end times; the leader, Wendy did too. I have documentation of this. Yet, when I invited her to join me in a Good Friday service she told me she was greeting and it was best I find another church.  I had also signed up for a women's brunch and she was a leader but then informed me that I wouldn't be a good fit for this group since I disagreed with the pastor regarding end times. I called Kim, a pastor, at this church and she apologized for Wendy's comments to me and said I had every right to disagree with the pastor. She said she would follow up with Wendy. I heard nothing back so I sent her a message to see what disciplinary actions had been taken and this is the lame response I heard from Kim today.

"I have spoken with Wendy about the many interactions and text messages that the two of you had together.
I think we can leave it with the knowledge that you both have grown in the interactions you had with one another. Wendy is a valued leader and will remain leading her group.

In ministry, sometimes people just don't get along for many different reasons.
Usually, it is simple and just a different way of looking at the world and the different ideas and perspectives we bring to the table.
The body of Christ is one body, and we hope and pray for a fresh start for you at your new church.
Wendy and I spoke, and she is learning and growing from the interactions you all had and wishes you blessings and a bounty of peace from Christ our Lord and Savior."

Blessings,

Kimberly Parsons

Family Life Pastor

Thank God, I have found a church that actually lives out scripture along with treats others with the love of Christ. Wendy told me on two different occasions that I should find another church and that I wasn't a good fit for "her" women's brunch group. The fact that this "pastor" agreed with her says everything you need to know about this church. Do not go here. Such a great fun church! Went with my friend over our spring break trip and it was like a home away from home! Great values and phenomenal teaching! 10/10 would recommend!

name: Mountain View Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
Mountain View Chinese Christian Church - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Liu is the best, and I think someone here likes me. I'll be there every service:))).. Pretty good young adult fellowship I go to church here This year, it's become a senior citizens' activity center that doesn't pursue truth. Since that's the case, let me tell a mundane story:

Once upon a time, in a kindergarten, child Y was the class monitor, and child Z was the vice-monitor. A teacher who really liked Z wanted to promote him to class monitor. However, after observing and investigating, Y had some concerns about Z becoming class monitor. So Z played the victim, and many people around him sympathized with him and blamed Y. The teacher, seeing and hearing this, slapped Y in front of everyone, thinking this would quell the discord in the kindergarten.

Some children, wanting to know what happened, asked the teacher why Y was punished. The teacher said, "This isn't corporal punishment x3; this is the only way the teachers have painstakingly thought of for half a year to unify the kindergarten. You're being too harsh."

Afterwards, the teacher who liked Z said, "Y instigated those children to question them! We must expel him and make Z class monitor to unify the kindergarten." So child Y left…

The children who liked Z and the teacher continued to gently persuade everyone to unite…

Do you see the problem? This was my first time visiting Silicon Valley. I found it online. The environment was beautiful, and the brothers and sisters were friendly and enthusiastic. In particular, Pastor Liu's sermons were highly skilled and vivid. He is the first pastor from mainland China.

name: Mountain View Church of Christ - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited church in search of a spiritual connection. 10/06/2024
I was not greeted nor others walking in.
Worship and no band nor any music. Sang 3 songs from Hume on the wall of which everyone sat down except the third song.
Pastor shared about verse tossed like the waves.  Never asked if any first time visitors here. No alter call. Didn't mention the duty to vote in a critical election year. Didn't  Mention Israel one year since attacked by WEF Wicked Evil Forces.

Very sad so many of our churches have zero spirit of God.

I speak in tongues and practices all the gifts of the spirit. Clearly this church does not.

However the church had around 600+  people that day.
Non spiritual church. Plain, simple worship. Extremely friendly people. Welcome all visitors. Bible studies available. Focus on the Bible without all the frills. Don't twist your arm for a contribution. Have a general collection only on Sundays and make it clear guests are told they don't have to participate. I hope to go back. Wonderful group of just Christians trying to serve God as best they can. Very friendly and welcoming. Lots of kids and every other age group. A best place to talk relex and pray together with positivity seeking him I love hymes every one sing together

My first church to worship and second to visit in life love this place I've been here for 13 years and still going. This place is my second home!!!!!!!

name: Mountain View Community Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
So grateful for this church! Its culture is focused on Jesus, the Gospel, and community! I’ve been attending since last Summer and absolutely love being a member of this church family and am just so blessed by it! Couldn’t recommend more, you’ll feel known, loved, and seen before you know it! Mountain View is a very welcoming church that preaches the truth in love.  The teaching covers advanced topics, but in a way that is still accessible.  A large emphasis is placed on community, on building relationships with other members. My wife and I really like it here! I grew up going to several churches, but Mountain View is my favorite church family that I've been part of. The community is strong throughout - children's ministry, kids, HS, college ministry, young adults (of which I was a part for years), families with kids, and beyond. The pastoral staff is not aloof - they care for people and put a massive emphasis on the Word of God. They preach verse by verse through Scripture and are not afraid to tackle difficult Scriptural or cultural topics.

I've now attended for eight years and have grown significantly in my love for the Lord and others through hearing the Gospel on Sundays and being part of a community throughout the week that wants to see God work in their lives through His Spirit. Worship was phenomenal, brought me to tears. If you like a gospel centered sermon you will likely enjoy this sermon style. Bibles are available in the backs of all pews. Coffee and tea are served for guests at numerous stations. There is a short “hand shake” period and no official tithing time as you can give through their app instead. Mountain View Community Church is an incredible community of faith! God in his grace has granted them steady growth over the years, and they have now successfully sent out multiple church plants that are thriving. I've personally witnessed the investment, love, and care they give to literally hundreds upon hundreds of people. Couldn't advocate for the leadership more or speak more highly of its people. Amazing college student ministry as well

name: Mountain View Lutheran Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: I had been to this church a few times in the past. I have become closer to the Lord and have been looking for a place to call home. There are a lot of churches to go to and I personally believe you should find a good fit. If you don't try a church out either on YouTube or by going in person you won't  be able to know. This church is close to my home location. I first contacted MVLC on their website. I believe I just filled out the form. I was so surprised when Pastor Doug sent me a text to attend a special program. He was so kind and It was so nice to get a personal text from the head Pastor. I was really shocked to say the least that someone took the time to personally invite me. I was feeling pretty good and decided to go. I met Pastor Doug in person he was so friendly, he really made me feel at home.  After going to the program I decided to watch their YouTube Christmas Eve 10:30am program for me it was wonderful. So I decided to go to the church that evening at 7:00pm. Again, Pastor Doug made me feel welcome when I came into the church. The service to me was more than what I expected. Oh my did I have a treat just hearing everyone sing with the choir it was such a beautiful sound. The sound was so powerful. It felt like this strong straight heart connection to our Lord.  Pastor Doug's messages were from the bible. The program was a great mix of learning more about our Christ Savior being born and praising our Lord.  So to sum up this long review, for those of you that aren't sure, I would absolutely give Pastor Doug, the MVLC team and volunteers a try.  We are all His children and we are all here to love one another.  I have found my place of worship and I couldn't  be happier.  Maybe I will see you there. I been going to this church all my life. I was raised in Ahwatukee ' I was baptized here at this church back in 82. When I come for service I feel like I am home. The services are excellent here. It a beautiful church the pastor is very nice. I find great comfort when I am here . The congregation is probably the friendliest and warmhearted group I have felt. My wife and I have been going here for years.  They have always been there for my family in times of need. The congregation is warm and loving.  The doctrine is Lutheran, and the services are great, both contemporary with a modern guitar-lead band and a marvelous, medieval bell choir.  This is a treat me and my wife (from Germany) heartily enjoy when in Germany and are amazed to experience it at Holy Cross.   I've been to Churches where the request to give are overdone, and you feel very pressured.  I have never, ever felt anything but comfortable here. I am so happy to have a community at Holy Cross.  The Pastors are wondaful and caring and preach the true message of Christ, Love and Forgiveness, because to be human is to err, and we are all human. I have attended service at Mountain View since 1983. The pastors are great preaching from the Bible and experiences. Fellow worshippers are friendly and seen most every week. Many activities for local communities and Bible studies that open conversation to all who join. Very good for learning anything you gain knowledge for. I feel God's presence in this church and frequently I get great sensations such as the hair standing up on my body, feeling comfortable and happy sticking around after service enjoying others, snacks and coffee.

name: Mountain View Presbyterian Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
Very clean, neat, honest people
olde fashioned values, conservative
decent music, good musicians, live piano, violins
country music, banjo, guitars, pleasant singers
coffee, iced tea, lemonade before morning service
Sunday School for the kids A very inviting church. The message for the services is always fantastic. Far more inclusive and less judgemental, teaching love and forgiveness. One of the few churches around that still has a traditional choir. Lovely place. For over 30 years in Arizona I've belonged to a very, very large house of worship, but never really felt at home.  Just recently I joined a friend for a Sunday service at the Mountain View Presbyterian Church.  I immediately felt very welcomed and comfortable with the teachings of the Gospel. Consequently, while this church is not the denomination of my lifelong religion, I've found my new home. Such a living spirit in this church. Missions are a priority, fabulous choir, wonderful ministers, program for children and adults with special needs, and great programs for kids! Amazing place to worship. People are always welcome. Church provides many services for nearby communities and families. A pillar for the community of San Tan Valley.

name: Mountain West Church - Stone Mountain Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely wonderful place! MW Hope Team members are very inviting. This really is a church that Looks Like Hope and Feels Like Home. I love the teaching and the kids ministry. If you're ever looking for a church or in the area, come check it out. BEAUTIFUL CHURCH LOVING MEMBERS.  I love this church so much the people are so warm and loving here at this church. AVOID this “church”!! We are all called by God to love, respect and support each other, just as Christ would do. Yet, Walking into this place I was harshly judged from the minute I walked in by fellow “Christians” I’m a proud Christian, who just happens to be gay. The blatant glares, side eyeing, and hushed comments were in full effect. I am who I am and not ashamed to hide it. Based off how I was treated, I don’t think most of the congregates have ever been around and most certainly never Interacted with a gay person before. This “church” should take all the money they make, and instead of making themselves more Ostentatious, take that money and take many courses on what it is to be a true Christ follower. I left in middle of the service, as I didn’t feel welcomed. I recommend to anyone looking for a church, read this churches stances on various issues- you’ll be floored. I guess anyone these days can call themselves a Christian!? I will never go back I love it here! The staff,  the members everyone is just so nice and sweet that you really feel welcomed. My kids really enjoy their time here, and it's so wonderful to know that they are in great hands especially because both are ASD, and my daughter gets overstimulated which is then moved to the sensory room and it works out well. This is one of the main things that was impressive about MW all kids are welcome with open arms no matter what. Don't hesitate and make your way here folks!

name: Mountaintop Church

name: Mountaintop Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: Welcoming, modern atmosphere on Columbiana Road with casual dress, engaging life-application messages, and vibrant children's ministry.

name: Mountainview Christian Church - Highlands Ranch Campus
reviewSummary:
We recently moved to Highlands Ranch and we were in search of a new home church. From the first moment we walked in we felt right at home. We have a toddler and a new baby on the way and they have made us feel so welcome. We love the messages they preach and our son LOVES " church school" as he calls it. Mountain View has been the greatest blessing to our family and we are ever so grateful to them! GOD is SO good!!!! My family was looking for a church to host a funeral for my beloved aunt Julie. My aunt didn’t belong to any church so finding one was tough. My sister came across Mountainview Christian church and knew this was a great choice. The coordinator was very nice and helpful, we were able to have use of the church for free. This is a large and well maintained church, it has all the accommodations necessary to host a funeral and reception (of course the food and catering not included) The staff was very friendly, we didn’t have to worry about clean up either. I highly recommend this church for such services. Love this church and everyone is super friendly! I do wish info about nursery and childrens church would be posted with Christmas services info…we showed up last year with our toddler and the nursery wasnt open. Needless to say we didnt last long in the sanctuary! From our first visit, we felt welcomed and appreciated. Everyone was friendly and the worship was especially engaging. It's a place that felt like home right away. Love our family church home!  Ken was the best, and my heart skips a beat of happy when I see Phil is preaching!
He is WONDERFUL

name: Mountainview Faith Community Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Found Our Forever Church Home!

From the moment we walked through the doors, we were greeted with genuine warmth and smiles that made us feel truly welcomed. This church has become our forever church family– a place where everyone belongs and feels valued.

The childcare is outstanding: compassionate, attentive, and incredibly safe. My kids absolutely love going every week– they beg to come back! It's such a relief knowing they're in caring hands while we worship.

The pastors are phenomenal– they take real time to connect with people, remember names, and build meaningful relationships. We've also made wonderful friendships here with other families who share our values.

Most importantly, the messages are biblically accurate, deeply insightful, and delivered in a way that's life-changing. Every sermon feels relevant and Spirit-led.

The Holy Spirit is moving here at Mountainview! If you're looking for a church that feels like home, this is it. Highly recommend! Mountainview Church is a church filled with people who truly love the Lord and love people. My husband and I found this church after about a year of trying out churches and we have been so blessed to land here. After experiencing church hurt, we were in a place where we needed to be loved on. Pastor Steve, Pastor Dody, Pastor Juan, and Pastor Stephanie are truly special and have been so good to us. We are happy to call this church our home! 🙌🏽 Love this church! They are all about community, loving people, and most importantly loving God. Was brought by a friend when I was in middle school (2010) loved it and grew up through their youth group ministry. Pastor Damean is amazing and works hard to make sure every student who walks in feels like family and teaches scripture that meets students right where they are. Lead pastor, Pastor Steve, along with his wonderful wife, Pastor Dody have built up a great place to call home. Their teachings are scripture based and Holy Spirit filled. The music worship experience is so freeing! I feel like I have freedom to raise my hands, jump around, or get down on my knees. There is no judgement when worshiping with this congregation. So glad to call this place my home with my church family! Mountainview has been my home church for many years. Both my children grew up in this church. There are many good Christians at this church that truly love God and want to make a difference. No one to greet you when you walk in. One worker walks by me, she is young ,ignoring me. The phone rings, and another person picked up the phone, and I guess they hung up. She replied I don't want to talk to you either. So I unloaded items for them and raining and no help until she offered a cart.

This is on Ash Wednesday. Not very good people of god.

name: Mountview Christian Church - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: We started attending this church several months ago and haven’t looked back to our old church...  The pastors, volunteers and members have been warm, genuine and welcoming. The services are informative, scripture-based, inspiring and powerful.  Their kids program is organized and well run and they have done an amazing job at caring for our special needs son.  They put on Vacation Bible School, Discovery camp, drive through Christmas, parents night out and other fun events.  Our entire family loves it (our 3 kids range in age from 4-9) and look forward to each Sunday.  Our kids love the format of the class (small group and big group with music, skits, games) and it is also available year round. Wonderful church and very supportive of our children who attend youth services at the same time. Great independent Christian Church (formerly Baptist).  Great  fellowship.  Emphasis on the Christ, the Word, and the Body of Christ with a lot of small groups... These small groups,  the bible study and fellowship in those small groups really make it special! My wife and I love it. We always come at Christmas for the light show. One of our favourite traditions at Christmas and always such lovely, welcoming people there. Thank you for generously offering your church for the Alicia's Closet support group. It means a lot to the group that you open your doors without prejudice to this non-denominational group of foster and kinship parents!

name: Move Christian Church - Albany Campus
reviewSummary:
Fantastic church. Everyone super nice and genuinely friendly. Pastor and associates teach directly from the Bible. Church is involved with the community. Recommend highly. My wife and I have been members for about twelve years now.  Are we a perfect body of believers,  by no means!  There's no such thing,  that's why I gave this review only four stars.
It's quite a loving body of believers,  come and see for yourself I visited this church for their 2016 Christmas morning service and I truly enjoyed the down-to-earth environment. The children came dressed in their pajamas and there were a few different members that made a point to welcome me. The couple sitting behind me had two well behaved collies that the children were petting and playing with. It had the feeling of one big happy family. I plan to go back when I am in town. Amazing. Pastor Shane is Awesome Best church. Great leaders.

name: Movement Church - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary:
The building is semi new. Less is more I think is there thing. Not much for decorations. People seemed friendly enough even though no one talked to us In a conversation but holding the door, saying good morning,  have a good day. Overall I'd give them a 93% Movement is one of the most authentic churches I've been to; I've never felt more welcome in a church from day one. The pastor is a genuine person both on and off stage. The teachings range from solid, baseline truth to challenging truth based on scripture. The youth ministry is great - my kids have loved the leaders and how much they pour into the kids' lives. The best part is that there are SO MANY small groups - a place for everyone to connect outside of Sunday mornings. Our family has been happy to call Movement home for the entire time we've lived in the Columbus area. I've been a member of Movement for about 10 years, and it has been such a blessing to me and my family. From the moment you walk in, you feel genuinely welcomed. The kids ministry is fantastic—our children not only have fun but also learn about faith in ways that stick with them throughout the week.

I also love how committed the church is to outreach. Movement doesn’t just talk about making an impact; they actively serve the community through projects, events, and partnerships that really make a difference.

Small groups have been another highlight for me. They’re a great way to connect with others, build friendships, and grow spiritually in a more personal setting. It’s a place where people truly care for one another.

If you’re looking for a church that values authentic community, practical teaching, and living out faith both inside and outside the walls, I can’t recommend Movement Church enough! Been going here for years now! This is a great church for all ages. Friendly, welcoming casual atmosphere. They have kids ministry, youth programs, and small groups that meet from fall to spring for all walks of life. Teachings are straight from Scripture and the Bible is opened and read in service every single week. I also like that pastor makes a point to know and interact with all members of the church. This is the place for you :) After coming from a much larger church, Movement was the community we needed. It took us very little time to get plugged in and feel like we were part of a family. And our kids LOVE it more than any other church we have attended.

name: Movement Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been to churches all over the USA, & can honestly say this church has been my Family.  Pastor Nate speaks only the truth, directly from scripture.  His family is filled with the Holy Spirit & it shows in their teaching & singing.  Sunday is my best day of the week because I know I am welcomed & loved at Movement.  This church is what keeps me staying in this area.  I’ve met the most wonderful people there & feel blessed. I’ve held off on writing about this for a couple years now, but after long consideration I’ve finally decided to document it. There was a Sunday service I came to with some male pastor (I don’t remember his name), but it was the fourth part in a multi-week story about David. The topic of sex came up, and slightly homosexuality, and the pastor spoke in a manner of wanting to agitate the youth by reinforcing traditional, anti-progressive ideals. I understand, it’s a church, and they have certain traditions, but the manner in which this particular pastor seemed delighted in the offense of the youth completely turned me off from this church. I never stepped foot in it again, and while I was recently looking for churches to go to, as I would like to return to a weekly service, something told me to submit this review, as a warning and hopefully a lesson for the pastor. Work in God’s name, and don’t be a jerk. I love this church!!!! You feel the holy spirit here.  The staff is amazing.  I love Pastor Nate and his wife Michelle.  Tracy at the children’s ministry is wonderful.  I found my home here!! Thank you Jesus!! ❤️✝️ This is my church home! The moment you walk in, you feel the incredible energy and love. The messages are always relevant and powerful, the people are so welcoming, and the pastor is amazing. I also love that there are three different service times on Sunday, which makes it easy to attend. If you're looking for a church that feels like family, this is it! From the first time I went to Movement, I knew I had found my community. During service you feel the Spirit working through even the hearts of the hardest stone, and bringing about the most amazing life changes. 4 years into being a member of the church, and my daughter and I have grown to truly know the Lord and have been baptized with this church family. There is something for every walk of life, whether the coffee addicts with the best Frappes or macchiatos at the coffee shop, Bible Study for working parents, Young Adults, Student Ministries (which the leaders of are beyond phenomenal), or the many outreach programs that the church is partnered with. I truly cannot recommend a better community, and church family to anyone searching.

name: Movement Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
BEST GOD FEELING CHURCH. I drive from Escondido to San Marcos to attend the 9am service. Pastor Pat is an amazing leader. Pastor Jeff always giving us the word in ways that we can relate but God is first!! 10/10  finally a church that puts God before politics but prays over our Government no matter what side!  Love this church♥️ I love my church and I love spending Sunday mornings with my church friends and family!! Join us for service and prepare for a great service! The Movement Church is a refreshing and welcoming place for anyone seeking a genuine, family-focused community. One of the things that stands out to me is the church’s commitment to staying true to Biblical teachings, without veering into the prosperity gospel that many other churches might promote. The atmosphere is friendly and honest, making it easy to feel like you’re part of a larger family from the moment you walk in.

What truly sets this church apart is its dedication to outreach. They have an incredible program that supports local schools, helps feed the hungry, and provides much-needed assistance to those who are struggling. The church’s impact on the community is tangible, and it’s clear that they deeply care about making a difference in people’s lives. They’re also focused on uplifting all generations, investing in the youngest as future leaders and calling older generations to disciple them. Their youth and young adult programs are incredible!

The Movement Church doesn’t just focus on the spiritual aspect of its members but emphasizes health and well-being from the top down. It’s a place where personal growth, both spiritually and physically, is encouraged and supported. They truly focus on getting to know people, which makes it a special and unique environment for families and individuals alike.

If you're looking for a church that is dedicated to Biblical truth, community outreach, and overall well-being, The Movement Church is definitely worth checking out. It’s home away from home❤️ The Movement has always been — and will always be — a place of refuge for me. A place where the Bible is taught in a way that’s real, practical, and full of truth. Their heart is simple: love God, love people. And they live it. The leadership is solid, Spirit-led, and fully aligned with the Word of God. So deeply thankful for this church and the covering it’s been in my life when I lived in Cali. Normal people loving normal people. This Bible based church was pivotal in my life and my family's life. I love this church family! I'm a member of the military that was stationed in the SD area and stumbled (more like led) on this church in 2015 and knew this was the place I belonged! The Movement Church accepts EVERYONE! Come as you are and you will be fed with the Word with authentic, loving leadership and fellowship. They have a great kids center for children of all Ages led by caring staff. If you're new to church in general don't worry you will have genuine members that will guide you every step of the way. Join a group and get engaged! They have multiple ministries that you can connect with. The Men's ministry is great and led by guys that want the best from our men and hold each other accountable. I cannot praise our God enough for putting the senior leaders in the Movement Church to further Gods Word in North county!

name: MPChurch - South San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
MPChurch is a truly unique, multicultural family of Christians. You can feel the presence of God in this place, and it’s amazing to be part of a community where people from different backgrounds come together in unity to worship, grow, and serve. It’s not just a church—it’s a spiritual home. Message of Peace. There's a lot I could say, but we would be here forever if I did. In all honesty being someone whose just starting to slowly get into the spiritual world it's great to know that it's at a church who everyone cares about you and is willing to help and teach you everything you want or need to know. It's such a calming place for me, they touch my heart in every way possible. To open my mind, my soul. I feel at peace, and that's something I enjoy. Thank you everyone! =] Finding a new church can be stressful, and overwhelming. It is not easy to walk in blindly to a church and not know what they're going to be about, or what their history has been. Pastors Fernando and Teresa have been loyal to this church since day one 30 years ago, and to me that says a lot about the seriousness in which they care for the Message of Peace family and most importantly to God. Since my very first visit, I have always felt the presence of God, and I have not regretted my decision to become a member 6 years ago.

Message of Peace is an amazing church that I would highly recommend to anyone who is seeking the love and truth of the gospel of Jesus Christ. Message of Peace is the best Church that I ever see.
I been always very very blessed over there.
God is in this place, we can feel His presence.
Serious Church with very responsible and anointing leadership.
Thank you Jesus for Message of Peace. I attended a special service for Missions Conference and had such a
wonderful experience during worship time. The choir had so much
energy and beautiful anointed voices, they sang in different
languages which I really appreciate because I love diversity in music.

name: Mt Bethel Church - Marietta Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church. Was there for a memorial service. The church is well taken care of. It has an excellent choir and music. If I was in the area looking for churches to visit Mt Bethel would be on the top of my list. I felt very welcome there. My bro goes there and we just had his wife’s celebration of life service. He loves it. My niece and I visited this church and she was overwhelmed by the love she felt here. We did not feel like a new person. This church makes you feel welcomed into a family immediately. We haven't been to a church with a choir in a long time and this church has a choir!  It was awesome! Great service. It seemed more like a stage production, than a worship service. There were 2 teachers here that taught me how to knit, crochet Mrs gale and Mrs PJ taught sewing Joseph quilts for the homeless  in her quilting classes in sewing machine at 7 bridges to.recovery ministry in Atlanta GA from 2014 to 2016 I was there and participated in all of the classes.Im grateful that I learned how to do needlework skills, I successfully completed home economics classes in highschool .I deserve better God Almighty omnipotent knows 🙏🙏❤️❤️❤️❤️

name: Mt Calvary United Church of Christ - Durham Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been to this church more times than I’ve wanted to for funeral’s. It’s a nice church. I just have to many sad memories coming back every time I’ve had to come here😢death comes like a thief in the night. They’ve hosted so many funerals of family and friends lately, it’s heart breaking. Most of them so untimely, I was so unprepared…. This is a place where you will find fellowship with God and really nice people. Great preaching and teaching by Pastor Raymond Watkins and great singing by choirs  can be enjoyed here. Just heard a great word from Pastor Watkins at my church Union Chapel UCC for annual revival. Awesome word. The organist blew me away. Mt. Calvary UCC is a Real Church, for Real People because you will find Real talk of our Saviour Jesus Christ. We are a Loving people and Loving church, beccause we Love you and Jesus Christ who died for us all. Come see for yourself and be Converted through the word of God back to God and receive the Promises of God in Jesus name! Pastor Raymond S. Watkins preached a most powerful and rewarding message at service on Sunday, May 18th; " Let Go!"

Stop by and meet Pastor Watkins, you won't be disappointed!!!

name: Mt Moriah Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: This was my former church.  It will always hold a special place in my heart.  May God bless and keep you always 🙏 Great service, The Holy Sprit dwells in that place Its a help to people

name: Mt Olive Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Played organ there with some of the most heartfelt singers . This church has been there since 1964! Founded by Joseph Scott 60 years ago as of this writing in 2024. Wonder if we were related? The Best Church ⛪️ you can Visit Come on Out To the Mount ❤️ Pastor Johnson is the real deal! Great and inspired Shepherd. Church is inviting and comfortable. My Pastor Preaches a Fruitful Lesson. A beautiful service and the Pastor's message was a Blessing

name: Mt Olive Lutheran Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I've only been attending this church for a few months now but it feels like home!! Pastor Christie is wonderful and each and every member is so kind and welcoming. This church is also LGBTQ+-friendly which is a big reason why my fiancé and I decided to attend. I've been to many other churches but Mt. Olive just has that special something! This church is very kid-friendly and the music is so lovely. I've never been excited to go to church until I came to Mt. Olive!

P.S.
This church also offers the space for wedding ceremonies and it also has a pre-school. I ❤️ Mt. Olive! I hope my daughter gets to experience her entire school time like this. We have loved it here. One of the sweetest, most engaged and community friendly preschools we have ever come across. If you are looking for a neighborhood church with a beautiful sanctuary and a warm and welcoming congregation, this is the place to go. Reverend Christie is caring and kind. I feel God's peaceful presence when I attend Mt. Olive. Very inviting atmosphere.  Activities for children were provided in the sanctuary. People-friendly worship! Beautiful church. Worth attending

name: Mt Olive Lutheran Church LCMS - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church, great Pastor, traditional service! We started going here about 14 months ago after years of being agnostic and immediately felt at home. We were so proud to have our daughter baptized here! It was totally what we needed to rekindle our spirituality, it's small but warm and we have a lot of young families. The sermons will always give you perspective and something to think about, couldn't be happier, this is HOME. Plus, if you like Bach you'll love our talented organist. Mt Olive is a wonderful, cozy, and welcoming Lutheran Church and community. The church has a handful of young families and a very active social calendar for both children and adults alike. Pastor's mini children sermon is adorable and the kids love it. It's also very refreshing to have a traditional service with organ and a small choir.

Come check it out! There are several meetings a week at this location. Welcoming crowd. Nice building meetings held in the basement which is clean and we'll lit. The Wednesday night 7:30 meeting was a full house...good meeting. A small but welcoming congregation. The Pastor is a friendly guy and a gifted preacher of law and gospel. The liturgy is beautiful, traditional and full of gospel comfort. The church is affiliated with the Missouri Synod. Love it and the meetings as well

name: Mt Zion Baptist Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
I love worshiping every Sunday at Mount Zion! I love my church family! If you’re looking for a church home, this is the place to be! Wonderful place to worship! Awesome children’s ministry.  Great pastor that teaches the Word of God and a stellar music ministry! Parked here and paid. Whoever you had take the money out there last night for the drillers game was RUDE!! It was like pulling teeth to get answers out of him like where do I pay, is there any more parking left, is it cash or card?! These are simple answers and he seemed soo mad with a crazy angry face and soooo rude to even answer those questions. Honestly I felt uncomfortable even parking there after that. Ridiculous Mt. Zion is a wonderful place to worship.
The message is always good and the people are always friendly. Mt. Zion Baptist Church is a wonderful place to worship! The preaching and teaching are always powerful and easy to understand. Dr. Cole's messages feel real and speak to your life in a meaningful way.

The people at Mt. Zion are warm and welcoming. From the first time I visited, I felt like I was part of a big family. It’s a place where I feel loved and supported.

One thing that stands out is the growing Children’s Church. The kids are excited to be there, and the team does an amazing job teaching them about God in a fun and loving way. It’s great to see young lives being shaped for the better.

If you’re looking for a church home with great teaching, kind people, and a strong purpose, Mt. Zion is the place for you.

name: Mt Zion Baptist Church - Whitestown Campus
Mt Zion Church of Ontario - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Sitting here with tears in my eyes.  While I am not a religious person at all.
But seeing the effects that the Nelson Family had on the community,  in their church and if their lives, saddens me that they were taken  in such a manner.. Being role models  for kids, it's such a tragedy. I HOPE that they , with who they were , had an effect ofln other members to become like them...  May the rest in his peace and glory. The password is amazing. He's truly a godsend. He speaks from the Bible. And he teaches us also, the members of the church are very friendly and inviting. Just wanted to give a shout out to the lovely ushers during our friend’s memorial service. The lady and gentleman ushers were so kind, gentle, caring, and attentive. I was very touched by their hospitality- showing direction, passing out tissue, water, fans, and exuding such sweet energy. Thank you! I enjoyed the service at Mount Zion Church the word was brought and explained and I hope to go again 🙏🏾🩵 Thank you for your kindness and love shown to my family in the passing of our precious loved one. It was nice to hear the true wonderful remarks about our praying songbird... Dorothy Williams. My aunt touched many lives. Again thank you for the love, the prayers, and hospitality.

name: Mt Zion Fellowship - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary: My experience with Mt Zion was when I first met Mr.Rawls a Elder at Mt Zion fellowship. He blessed me with my first personal Bible on March 12,2026. And ever since that day I have been reading, learning, and understanding God's blessings and true purpose for my life 🙏 he has helped me and guided me to Walk and to talk with God everyday. I'm so thankful and blessed that I have taken that leap of faith, trust and belief of God 😊🙏. And the sermons and word's from God lift's me up everyday. I highly recommend that all who are lost or going through hard times in there lives turn everything over to GOD 🙏 he is always with us. IN JESUS NAME WE FOREVER PRAY AMEN 🙏❤️🙌🙏 never even been here but i love that the pastor had the guts to denounce trump. as jesus says, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter heaven, and that nasty man and his supporters have no place in a church of christ. It is disturbing that a Man of God can not show compassion to others. Obviously you may preach about Jesus but do not know the true meaning of the scriptures. Churches wonder why they are losing their memberships and based on what Fudge read, I can understand when people say "why go to church, when they act no different then the people in the streets". Pastor, you may had a moment of weakness and didn't expect her to read your letter to the world but now they see you and your church in a different light and it is not good. Church should welcome anybody regardless of their political views and not be classify as *dumb* bc they have a different opinion.  Churches should be a place of refuge and saving souls not wading into politics.  You had a perfect opportunity to show the love  of Christ but chose to show hate. Why are you preaching every Sunday? What is your purpose on this earth?  How do you want people to remember you and your church? As a church that loves everybody or a church that only loves people who vote Democrat? Jesus loved  those who abused him. President Trump and all our Government Leaders need prayer but I wouldn't want you praying bc you need to search your heart and ask for forgiveness. . What you do in the dark shall come to light. I am a registered Democrat and didnt vote for Trump in 2016 but DEFINITELY will in 2020. Hope your congregation doesn't  think & feel the same because almost 50% of Americans voted for Trump.

name: Mt Zion Missionary Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: New Pastor Dennis Anderson is fired up! He's doing great and wonderful things. New Programs for children and they have a vested interest in the continued growth of the surrounding community. This is a promising church, and I'm excited to see how this church family takes off! Beautiful church with amazing people! Love the Church and the brother are warm welcoming. God bless the Pastor. Enjoy being there evertime we can. This is my church. I grew up in this church. This is God's house and I am a child who loves to go home. Please, come and worship with us. My first time here add my Marine friend home going service it was amazing beautiful Church

name: Mt. Hermon Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church but nobody wants to help when you're in a crisis. Was there for a baby gender revealing. Everyone was very friendly. Awesome church serving anyone in the community. I love coming to Mount Hermon. They are very kind people

name: Mt. Juliet Church of Christ - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary:
I Miss My Church Family So MUCH!!!

I am So Looking Forward to the return Of my friend, David Shannon, returning to the pulpit at Mount Juliet church of Christ!!

All Glory to God. This truly is the perfect place to glorify our good Lord and grow in Christ while showing life and support for one another so we can all serve the one and only Jesus Christ, our Lord and savior! This place is compassionate and authentic. Going from one church to another for sense of belonging by the church and the community of people who attends it has been what feels like a life long journey! Finding this place was nothing less than His ding and an amazing experience! Thank you all for being so generous and kind church! My experience with Mt. Juliet Church of Christ has always been an uplifting one..I have been a member since 1990.. The word of God is preached straight from the Bible..  The elders do a wonderful job overseeing the congregation. Very friendly and in time of need it is always there...come see for yourself and I think you will agree. Haven’t had much time to get to know people (as I am very shy!) but this place is really amazing! The people are so kind, and they preach God’s word fully and wholly, and the singing and fellowship is great :•) can’t wait to come back soon! A community oriented Church that actually comes out to visit and share God's Word. ( on your level ) without speaking , down, to you or shaming you...we all make mistakes..) The meals on wheels program helps me. The words of encouragement flow freely..as..this is their nature. A true God send and I am a grateful recipient of their Godly ways and generosity...(not, one, but ..to ALL who SERVE in the graces of our heavenly father, Amen. Yours truly Christy Herron.

name: Mt. Tamalpais United Methodist Church - Mill Valley Campus
reviewSummary: A church that really "practices what it preaches." Genuine love and respect for the people who come through their doors. A place where a hurting spirit can find hope and relief, and where families are welcomed and cherished. Great Sermons and welcoming congregations Married in this pretty little church in 1969. Went to visit it today celebrating our 50th anniversary! 💕 Beautiful sanctuary! Sit

name: Mt. Zion Christian Ministries - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I had been watching your television program, however your program tonight  about the holy Spirit made me to know for a fact that I should no longer follow you on television. It was a spirit-filled atmosphere from the praise team to the ministry leaders and pastor. Very welcoming church family with Bible based ministry. I thoroughly enjoyed the 87th anniversary celebration!!

name: Mt. Zion Missionary Baptist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: This is a small Church family oriented. Very kind people. Obviously they were hit by the pandemic and lost some members. But God is working with them and he will provide. This is my church I proud to be part of the Mt Zion missionary Baptist Church here in Pomona come out and enjoy the service Pastor Grice and First Lady LaTanya Grice this my family and friends The best church in Pomona Loving parishioners!

name: MTN Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I am so grateful to have my good friends Sam and Jess!! All generations represented here. Allowing a well rounded perspective. May this church continue to be blessed in Jesus name! Love you all!! I love this small church. For some time, we searched for a home church. My husband was invited here. After attending a Mega church, this felt like home. They welcomed us in and loved us from the beginning.
I teach Sunday school twice a month here. I get to meet parents and kids alike. I do have a ministry degree and I am glad to be part of this church.
We have people of all ages and heritage. Many mix marriages & families. My husband and I are not the same race, that did not matter here. Nobody looked at us oddly. I love all the ladies night events with pastor's wife. The church has groups that meet through out the week. We also have celebrations at a park like Easter & America's Birthday. The youth will do fund raisers for camp. The bake sales are delicious.
We celebrated our daughter's Quinceañera here, the ceremony by pastor's wife and catered to us. The reception and music was also done here. It was beautiful. I feel blessed to be part of this church. Jesus, love, community and so much more is what flows from this church and the people here at the Mountain. These are three things this beautiful and amazing church stand firm on. I have never been in a community that’s so welcoming, intentional, genuine and loving like this one is. It’s filled with on fire for God, deep, raw, real and vulnerable people that are running after Jesus wholeheartedly and pursuing his presence daily. People that push you into your purpose God has for you and cultivate your calling. On top of all this they have AMAZING pastors that bring an on time word every week! There’s no place I’d rather be than here :) I love this church. Pastor Samuel and Jessica are the real deal. Great leadership team and good people. Excellent kids focus My experience was disappointing. Just doesn’t seem Christ-centered. Wouldn’t bring my family here. Leadership seems lacking in transparency.

name: Murdock Christian Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly people. Love the bible lessons! A small group  of Christian sinners worshipping and sharing the love of Jesus together Great ppl and you feel the love here Was a very nice bible study

name: Murfreesboro Community Church - Murfreesboro Campus
reviewSummary: I Love this church Pastpr Steven's a Great man of God will open his doors to the Public to have funerals Thank you for serving our Family on yesterday Great Friendly's Smiles soon as we entered Gary Sanders Darrious Jennings The body of believers at MCC are Bible believing, Holy Spirit lead, Jesus following people. Each person operates in their gifting and calling. Bonus...They Listen to the Holy Spirit and allow him to lead. Had a great time. The congregation was very welcoming and I'll be happy to attend again. Got a food box. Very nice people. A very nice church to attend

name: Murrieta Church of Christ - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have attended for many years.  This is a welcoming family of goodhearted Christians.  I love the fact that this is a diverse family of all ages races and backgrounds. The lessons are Biblically sound and delivered in a meaningful way.  There are classes for all ages  and the youth minister and his wife are an inspiration to the teens.  Last year, the new teen center was completed and provides a center of teen activities, study and growth.  We love it here. We first visited this church after moving to Murrieta a few years ago.  We are so happy we found it and eventually became members. I feel like I can come just as I am without being judged.  The youth minister and children's worship leaders really take the time to get to know and care about my kids.  Our kids look forward to getting together with the other teens/kids at the church and it is a place where they can let down their guard and just be themselves.  Personally, I've found that there are no "out of bounds" questions. If the leadership doesn't know an answer they admit it and encourage us to look for an answer together in the Bible.  Sometimes the answers are easily found and sometimes they take a long time, but I like that we try to figure it out together. Of course this is one of the best churches in the Murrieta area. It's warm and friendly. There is always someone there to greet you and talk to you if it is your first time or if you've been there many times. The preacher is outstanding. He keeps your attention with his biblical knowledge and examples of everyday Christian practices. Come join us, you will be glad you did. A very friendly bible based church. Minister is very knowledgeable and is always open to any questions or concerns that you might have. If you love singing, this church is the one for you. Great youth minister and active youth program. This is definitely a family oriented church that will make you feel welcome. My husband and I walked into the Murrieta Church of Christ, and we knew we had found our place of worship.  We visited several churches in our search. We were amazed by this congregation and its members - from the welcome at the front doors to the preaching and lessons learned during service.  We believe God led us to this church.

At MCoC we have found compassionate, caring, fellowship while pursuing our life with Christ.  We are thankful and blessed.

name: Murrieta Korean Presbyterian Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful congregation of very sweet and loving people.  I recently had cancer and the church supported me with prayers, visits and food.  I am cancer free now and I could not have done it without my church. I am one of the few non-Koreans in the church (my wife is Korean) but they all know me and know that inside I am very Korean!  I love them all! 😊💕🙏🏻 A really wonderful church! People are friendly and nice. They have both Korean and English services on Sunday mornings. Faithful, Full of love, Pastor's sermon is gracious It is a beautiful church where the pastor is filled with the Holy Spirit, the Word, and grace, and where the sincere love of the saints overflows.

name: Murrieta United Methodist Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Some of the people that hand out the food pantry items are very rude, condescending and just plain mean to the people who are in desperate need of food. Like the table with milk, and especially the women at the table with fruits and vegetables. Just because I’m disabled making it impossible to work doesn’t mean I should be treated like trash when I’m just trying not to starve. Thank goodness I found places to get help around here so I don’t have to come back in case I’m desperate enough to have to get help again. Thanks to you all helping Jesus Christ feed his family I'm grateful for your help, love and giving nature ❣️ thanks for your faith, hope and most of all your love to God through Jesus Christ Amen 🙏 A friend had taken me there last Friday
To be involved in their  food pantry and  my goodness  it was unbelievable, my EBT money hasn't been going as far as it had in the past and this was a way to make those ends meet! I try and never take more than I need  and leave  items for others. Went to see a children's  Christmas  program. People  were very friendly. The children  captured  the true  meaning of Christmas. Was a lot of fun. Thanks  to the youth  teachers,  job well done. Oh yes, Great food enjoyed it very much!!! Very friendly here and they help a lot of families with their food pantry every Friday

name: Music City Church - Nolensville Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor speaks the Bible based truth and is a great story teller. Singers/music is great. Love this diverse group of people that go out of their way to be welcoming and inviting. Small now but watch it grow. Getting ready to break ground on a new building in Nolensville. I started coming this year and have really enjoyed it. Everyone is friendly and welcoming as soon as you walk in and the pastor does a great job with sermons

name: Mvc Mountain View Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
This church feels like home. Never felt so welcomed and valued . They do a great job at keeping the focus on Jesus, they are Spirit filled, stick to the word, worship is so amazing and they do a great job at being in the community.  Don't get me started on how amazing the children's ministry is. My kids are developing such a strong relationship with God so young because of them! Wow, Mountain View Church is on fire!
From the worship team, to the new location, to pastor Todd, it’s quite an experience.

The worship team is led by Ryan Kirkland who’s toured with Switch Foot and Anberlin and has an amazing voice and high energy. The rest of the crew is equally talented and “all-in” making the worship high energy and inspiring. The songs are a great mix of some the latest worship songs, a few originals and some great hymns mixed in.

Pastor Todd is like the best friend you wish lived next door. His humility and scriptural knowledge are well balanced. His desire to share his best understanding of scriptures from his experiences, leading theologians and what God’s placed on his heart is refreshing and he’s got a great sense of humor as well. Our family has found that his teaching and practical application to today’s life has challenged us to reflect on how we represent Christ.

The children's, high school and college ministries are amazing. I have witnessed teens that have shown more maturity and selflessness than most adults. Their success in these programs are easy to see when you take into consideration that the number of kids in these programs are currently almost equal to the number of adults in church! (Wow)

Last but not least, the congregation has been so welcoming. The opportunities to truly get connected to people who love the Lord are endless. The smiles, warm welcomes and the helping hands I've witnesses brings to mind an “Acts Based Church”. This is a truly unique church and we feel blessed to call it home now.

Don't take my word for it. Come and check it out! Yesterday was our first time attending Mountain View. I felt god calling me to go there and I’m so glad I did. I wanted a place for my family to all feel welcomed. If we stay in California I think this will be the church we’ll call Home. Pastor Todd was very relatable and spoke truth to us. So glad God guided us here. Oh my goodness! What an amazing facility! So comfortable and welcoming and the ministry group is so friendly and knowledgeable and insightful. It must be wonderful to be a regular memder I was from out of town Are you looking for a church to call home?  If so, be sure to check out MVC - the friendly, family atmosphere you will find here cannot be beat.  Pastor Todd Rodarmel shares the message of God's love for us in such an authentic and relatable manner.  Worship music led by Ryan Kirkland is amazing and inspiring.  My family and I have loved every moment spent at our "home" church and my guess is that you will as well.
