name: Myers Park Baptist Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church. We’ve been members for 20+ years and made lifelong friendships there. From unique educational programs to beautiful worship services and heartwarming outreach opportunities-there’s something for everyone in this church community. My favorites are pickleball, book clubs, needlepoint time and recently - Mahjong! This is a great church!  It is welcoming and affirming to all people.  My wife and I were welcomed in over 20 years ago when gay people were not accepted at many churches.  They not only welcomed us but asked us to serve in leadership roles!  I am forever grateful to the people that make up MPBC! I have never attended the church but impressed with their progressive views and inclusive attitude.  I am also pleased the church has been renamed as to avoid any speculation it is a traditional Southern  Baptist Church.   Kudos to the members and staff for a bold challenging step.  I would like to visit someday and personally experience the membership Myers Park Baptist Church is such a welcoming and friendly church where everyone is truly accepted. They offer wonderful events throughout the year that help people connect, serve, and grow together.  The Spiritual growth classes are thoughtful and engaging. It’s a great place to grow in faith and feel part of a community. Myers Park Baptist is a progressive church that welcomes diversity and is open to all.  We have enjoyed that diversity and have been challenged from the pulpit.  The community aspects of Myers Park has been great for my family.

name: Myers Park Presbyterian Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful buildings and grounds, very well preserved. Parking is a challenge however. A beautiful historic church. Everything a faith family should be - uplifting, comforting, challenging, fun, and forgiving! And they love my children too! While I really enjoy how much they get kids into their service, what I do not enjoy is how political their sermons get. Not so much with Lisa. And we love John. But Joe tends to lean  left and makes it very well known in all of his messaging.we ended up leaving the church. Beautiful church, they allowed the Arts+ students to do their recital there. Great space!

name: Myers Park United Methodist Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
The music, message, atmosphere and staff will reflect the love of God. This place quickly felt like home when we were looking for a place while we relocated to Charlotte. Great cafe space in the Hope Center. I met an Angel from your church this morning. Her name is Stephanie and is a member. I was lost in Charlotte trying to get to Presby. GPS was taking me a long way and kept changing directions. Stephanie happened by and walked me all the way to the door of hospital. She is a true angel. Thank you Stephanie, you blessed me today. Love this Church
Remind it me so much of my Cathedral in France.
Love the people and the friendly atmosphere
Love at each visit 🙏🙏🙏 A very beautiful place, and very peaceful inside.😇🥰🙌🏻 Was here for a private event

name: Napa Valley Community Church - Napa Campus
reviewSummary: Very caring and loving church that teaches the love of Jesus Christ On vacation in Napa and visited the church. Very friendly gathering of God’s people with a thought provoking message based on God’s word that exalted our Saviour with good practical applications for every day life. This is a small friendly Bible based church.  Always true to the word with a nursery and Sunday school. If you love the God's word this is the church for you.  The Bible is explained but not watered down.

name: Naperville Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
I attended the baptism of my best friend/ex-husband now Bro Brian Walker. It was the most exciting event of my week. We (my mom and I) were greeted with such kindness. The gentleman consistently checked on us until all parties arrived. We are from the Lansing ILL COC. We look forward to visiting in the near future.....God Bless
Sis Sherron Walker and Sis Patricia Allen Wonderful church. I love it The sermon was down to Earth while the minister explained how God loves us and protects us if we love God and obey him.
The people are friendly and caring. Very friendly congregation. Welcomes all. Been going here for years. Enjoy the multicultural experience and ministry services. Great community of believers

name: Naperville Covenant Church
reviewSummary:
This church is a place of sincere love. They are continually reaching outside of their four walls to be relevant in a diverse and complex world. If your tired of “playing church” and you want something more real — I would check them out.  I am not a member (because I live in Chicago) but have greatly enjoyed each time I have gone. To Fellowship, Gather, & Praise God with other Christ-Families are indeed TRUE Blessings to not be taken for granted!
Inspiring message given by Pastor “X,”!
*The Ties that Bind* -Mark 3:23-30
I really enjoyed this Service today!
May God Continue to Keep & Bless their Ordained Pastor “X”, All Ministries, & the Congregation  to Prosper thru Christ Jesus in God Amen. This isn't really a rating for the Church, but rather for the "garage sale" they have there every year.  There is a very random selection of goods and the purchase goes to help various charities.  They even have a "fill a bag" sale where you can fill a paper bag with whatever treasures you find for only $10.  I go every year. A great church that works on growing as well as confronting injustice. They work in the community and also in the larger world. Caring and committed. Wonderful Wonderful Church family and Community!!

name: Naples Christian Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: I had the pleasure of attending Naples Christian Church this morning and was warmly welcomed by Jamie.  Was able to witness their delightful Christmas play that truly brought the joy of the season to life! As Proverbs says, “A cheerful heart is good medicine” and this church delivered! :) Great sermon, singing and community. Naples Christian Church is my home and it's people are my family.  My faith and connection with God grew when I walked through its doors, got involved, and invested in its people.  As a family we have experienced great highs and challenging lows - and surprise, we are not perfect - but through it all we strive to love, follow the Spirit and do what we can to help Christ radically change lives. Above all, I learned at NCC that it really isn't all about me - but about worshiping and working for the God who orchestrates it all.  I am proud to call NCC home. My church family  home for 33 years. A special place to worship, be accepted and feel the love and unity of believers. You feel like family from your first visit. Most caring and kind people I’ve ever met !!!

name: Naples Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: We attended service only which started at 9 AM,  Good sermon. The worship was uplifting. The sermon and worship were bible based.  God wants us to be loving, kind and generous to others. This Church exhibits the spirit of love. That is a wonderful place to workshop with God and Jesus it is a big congregation and very friendly and helpful and loving people. Bible study is first at 10 am then church services is at 11 to 12 at night is at 6 PM on Wednesday night it starts ai 6: 30pm.we enjoy it there. Great service worshipping God! They are very liberal, like a denomination.

name: Naples Community Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
I found Naples Community Church online recently.  I feel I was led there by to Lord and my experience has been wonderful. The people there are very warm and friendly. The music and worship are inspiring and the worship leader's singing can bring tears to your eyes. I always watch for a Gospel message from the pastor and he has delivered it every time.  His messages are not long but short and sweet and you can tell he truly loves the Lord. I know I found a church home for my winters in Florida. Naples Community Church is an amazing gathering of warm and friendly people who welcome all attendees. The music and song component is inspirational and Pastor Kirt shares his remarkable gifts as a speaker with insights in the Old and New Testament and how they relate to the human condition grappling with today’s issues. So thankful to have found this  gem! Mariann Wilson & Gary Helms I'm up North now and can't wait together back to Naples and NCC.           There are a lot of churches here in CT but nothing compares to NCC.           The first time we attended we were treated like a long lost friend returning home. And love those old soul piercing hymns.                                     See you soon. Visited Naples Community church in April 2021 when we were vacationing in the area.  A wonderful and very hospitable congregation.  I felt like I was at my hone church in Delaware.  Just about every week since my visit I try to watch Pastor Kirk’s sermon online.  If you are in the Naples area pay them a visit - you will not regret it!

Jim
Bridgeville DE Every service reaches into my soul… I feel God’s arms around me in this church! No strangers… clearly he lives within its walls! Music takes you away to a spot we all belong in our world today; we are one in this lovely place.

name: Naples United Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: The benefit concert by world-renowned organist, Andre Knevel was well received. I was invited to give my personal recovery testimony from alcoholism for St. Matthew's House during the benefit. There were approximately 150 attending donors. A very memorable night that raised money for a great cause. A delightful evening of operatic musical pieces and Queen presented in a totally different way. We loved the string quartet’s rendering of their hits! The venue, the staff, the music, and most of all, the musicians were excellent, extraordinary! We loved every minute. Love the concert w the 4 Orchestra i instruments.  Wonderful amazing would go again in a heart beat. The venue was beautifully lit by hundreds of candles. Our talented string quartet brought Vivaldi to life. They talked about the pieces and we took away new knowledge. A wonderful experience overall. Wonderful event.  The musicians were excellent and the insightful commentary was very helpful.

name: Nashville Church of Christ - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: What a lovely congregation of the Lord's people. Everyone was friendly & helpful during our visit. Will definitely feel privileged to worship here again. My name is Sheila Hunt and I grew up in this church. Rode the bus twice a week. Bill Martin was our bus driver. Excellent memories I've recently placed membership with NCC. What a wonderful group of people who are serving God's kingdom! So thankful for this body of believers! We attempted to attend Worship here on 27 Jan 2019.  However, there was no gathering in contrast to the website & phone message.  😞 🙏 Lead worship there. Praise God!

name: Nashville First Baptist Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
I was really impressed how organized and how sensitive the pastor was to make clear “church culture” to outsiders. The message was very clear and organized and even in the midst of a medical emergency of a participant during the church service, everything was handled in a professional and loving way. I am also thankful the pastor gave a clear invitation for salvation at the end of the sermon. He was also available for us to meet at the end of the service .

A fun bonus on Sunday before Christmas, a live nativity and petting zoo! Pastor Thomas West has nearly ruined this church. He lied to the choir when he asked them to get rid of choir robes for a season, then never allowed them back at the date he said they would be brought back. He has destroyed the great choir this church has and the traditional music with a loving choir family that helped me decide to join this church along with the loving Pastor we had at the time Frank Lewis. Blended services can work but not the way they are doing it at this church. The contemporary style service should have been a priority to keep going. They simply could have been held at 2 different times. You only need one worship leader in a service now you are combining 2 people. This is not even a good blended type style. People came from the suburbs to be able to have a musical worship style of traditional and with an amazing premiere organist, Ken Varner that you let go last fall. Pastor West came to this church with a clear agenda to shake everything up and has succeeded, I understand sometimes some changes need to be make for growth but combining the 2 services was a HUGE mistake. You have lost numerous people from both areas that were growing it’s now wonder the budget of the church is so reliant on the profit of their downtown parking lot. I pray whatever powers that be see the destruction Pastor Thomas as made and the poor decisions are obvious. It’s heartbreaking. Loved the recital of six grand pianos. Got the whole family in the Christmas spirit. We felt very welcome and will be sure to try out a Sunday service. This is a hard one. I used to love it here. Then a group of people ran off a great pastor and brought in a guy I will never listen to again. He immediately made a lot of changes I hate and I keep running into people who say "we quit going to the main service, we only go to Sunday school now". So a handful of people destroyed a great thing and we had no say. I can't find a church anywhere. At this point I'm looking entirely outside of my religion just for some kind of fellowship. I promised the Catholics not to nail anything to their doors. Not changing my beliefs, just the new guy is visibly...not full of the Spirit. I will be ending my membership. Hello Nashville!
Thomas the PhD, likened to the Energizer Bunny, The Baptist Congregation Loves Him, Very Sanguine, The Life of the Party,  Very Healthy Kids!
Wonderful Live Orchestra on Sunday Mornings, Real Music, Hymns
Memorable Wednesday Night Dinners
Excellent Teaching

name: Nashville Life Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my experience here first time going to church in over three years and I have to say it was very welcoming. I met a young lady by the name of Monay as I was entering into the church and I think she should be a part of the welcoming committee because she allowed me to follow her in. She allowed me to sit next to her. Talk to her ask questions if I had questions and she did not have the answers. She was willing to help me find the answers so all in all great experience visiting this church. I went to this church today. And I’mma say it’s an absolute no for me… I felt very very unwelcome and Uncomfortable.

This upset me the most because I’m looking for a church home in Nashville. I’ve been in Nashville for a month and I haven’t found a church yet.

And I really thought this would be the church for me, but it’s just not.. and it’s not the pastor… He’s older. He’s an OK person… It’s actually his church staff that are rude and lifeless .. Attending a Sunday worship service at this church was, by far, the highlight of our trip to Nashville. We came from NH to attend a Ce Ce Winans concert at the Grand Ole Opry House.  Nashville Life Church was warm, welcoming, and alive. Outstanding in both music and preaching of the Word!  We will be back to worship here again! My husband, my daughter, and I have been watching online from NC for awhile. My husband was baptized in the Holy Spirit while watching. We are so blessed to have found a church family far away. Praying to visit soon. 🙏🏾❤️ Worship is great here. Sermon was decent, my only suggestion would be make sure that Jesus is the focus. IMO. He came to give us Life everlasting! Praise Him!

name: National City Christian Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: The 90's Hip Hop Strings Candlelight Concert by Fever was an excellent way for my wife and I to celebrate our 7th wedding Anniversary! The atmosphere and Superb musical performance using strings brought every song to life! Renditions of countless artist really made me feel nostalgic socially since I'm a GenXer! Keep on bringing the smiles to the community! Thank you for an amazing night! Fantastic experience. The candlelit church was beautiful and the quartet was perfect. We loved Queen vs ABBA. The attendants were super courteous and professional. The neighborhood was great too with many cute places to get a bite afterwards. Candelight event featuring Vivaldi's Four Seasons and others, yesterday at 6:45 pm at the National City Christian Church at 5 Thomas Cir was beautiful.  You need to find parking in the area, I did it with Spotify. I was given Section A seats which were perfect. You can enter by going up the stairs facing the circle or go through the side entrance at 5 Thomas Circ. NW, Washington, DC. We went for a candlelight concert, all ushers and staff were kind and helpful. I’m thankful for the experience! It was a beautiful time, and I would love to hear a choral performance here, too 🎻🎶 Absolutely amazing experience! Hearing this in person hits so hard words cannot explain. I cannot wait to experience another candlelight performance in this space. Stunning rotunda and stained glass with high ceilings was an awe moment

name: National Community Church
reviewSummary: Multi-site Christian congregation meeting in historic theaters across the DC metro. Renowned for Mark Batterson's teaching, community coffeehouse ministries (Ebenezers), and practical kingdom impact.

name: National Hills Baptist Church - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor's sermons are consistently well-researched and thought provoking. The congregation is warm & welcoming, with a heart for service & community outreach. Genuinely friendly pastor and his family and congregation. I grew up in this church they have children's church and awanas for kids and big church as well It was an amazing experience in the US!

name: National Shrine Cathedral of Our Lady of Guadalupe - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
Very beautiful church. Went here for a good period of time, but I felt the priest for the English masses was drifting too far off the main homily for my taste. That being said, this cathedral will always hold a place in my heart as it was one of the first churches I consistently went to.

Gift shop is often very full of people after mass. Ladies that run it are nice and they have a decent selection of items for how small the room is. Parking is free and easy to find though as they have their own garage. This is a really beautiful place to just come and be still for a moment. The music is playing but it's not distracting; the scriptures are on huge plaques and you can kind of wander and read until one catches your attention. Then sit by the water and think on that one... Appreciate the really beautiful little statues around the building... Thank God for bringing you to this beautiful place and leave refreshed and mind and spirit. Situated amid the cultural institutions of Dallas’s Arts District, the shrine stands out both for its historic architecture and its living role in the local faith community at the heart of downtown. The inside of the cathedral is just jaw dropping gorgeous! You walk in and you’re hit with the presence of God. My family attended daily mass while we were visiting, and while it was very hard to fully understand everything due to the echo, it was still a beautiful service. Such an amazing homily that I must share a brief summary. There are three factors that will corrupt your soul. The devil because he tries to convince you God doesn't love you. The flesh because it tries to convince you that you dont have a spiritual needs. The world because it tries to convince you that there is no heaven.

name: Nations Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent Christmas Display! Really glad that we came out on Christmas evening to see a few displays like this around town. Really tops off the Christmas Cheer! Thank you for taking the effort to put on this display. Very well done! Love, love, love Nations Church. We have only been going for a couple of months but have seen such a difference in this church from so many. You do feel as if you belong here. It’s small enough that you can get to know everyone but large enough so there is always someone new to meet. The diversity is amazing. People don’t hate you because you believe or look or vote differently from them. This is a church of real people seeking after a real savior for hope, joy, peace and guidance. If you love dynamic worship and preaching that touches your spirit and helps you be more like Christ then consider Nations Church. Been attending here for over 3 years. Awesome from top to bottom.
I love the parents' room, where you can go and still watch service if you have a child who isn't ready for or can't go in the nursery. There's a nursing room also.
The children's programs are amazing, and Mega Sports Camp in the summer is SO MUCH FUN as a way to get active for "vacation Bible school".
The ages 5+ "Kid Nation" group is so beyond just "Sunday school", it is a real service with worship and teaching on the kids' level.

The adults' classes are always extremely informative, thought-provoking, challenging, and uplifting.
I love that the church schedules breaks between the Wednesday night studies so you can have a Wednesday night or two of family time. The studies also usually start and/or end with a Wednesday night of just hanging out with food, games, prayer, and just getting to know each other.

There are churchwide opportunities to serve in the community at least quarterly, and many individuals are involved with outreach on a regular basis, so it's easy to get connected and make an impact.

This is a multi-cultural church with members of all ages and backgrounds! You might sit next to a Nigerian member during service while hearing from a missionary to India, pick up your kid from a Chinese nursery assistant, and play basketball with the Filipino fellowship after church. It is SO cool. I LOVE being in worship on Sundays and being able to imagine that this is what heaven really might look like! I love my church! Truth, Love, and Diversity - these are our pillars! Truth: the Word of God is preached with bold faith. Love: we come alongside one another and encourage each other in our pilgrimages with God! We love God and love people! Diversity: I always brag on our church for this. You will see and be friends with people of all colors and all nations. I eat often after church with the Philippino Fellowship and the African fellowship! I love the unity in diversity - this is what heaven will be like! Come, you are welcome here! A multiethnic, multigenerational, family-friendly community that loves Jesus and the people of Athens. After recently moving to Athens and journeying with this community, I have been challenged and equipped to have a more intimate relationship with God, have found a great support network for parents of young kids, and have found friends who are genuinely interested in my life and have my back.

name: Nations Church Los Angeles - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Nations church has been a pillar in the community for over 20 years. Pastor Phil and his team have been there for my family on multiple occasions, from hosting my dads funeral, to visiting my mom and providing meals while she went through cancer treatments along with tons of free events and giveaways for the neighborhood. Love seeing that it’s starting to grow more. Highly recommend! Amazing church. Great Pastor and very friendly people that you can tell care about one another and the surrounding community. They are a Bible believing, Holy Spirit, faith-filled church and it’s definitely worth coming to check it out. Great Coffee bar too! My family and I have been attending this church for some time now. I can honestly recommend and encourage anyone to come visit for the first time or pick up right where you left off. I had been looking for a place to get back into my relationship with God. As a kid, my family always attended pentecostal Church, so that's what I had been looking for. I had visited some surrounding churches in the Northridge area as well as the Granada Hills area. I wanted to attend somewhere in my neighborhood to have a sense of community. My wife and kids were  invited to a service here and shortly after I came.
The staff was friendly and welcoming. The congregation itself is very diverse in race, culture, and age range. I like the small town feel to it. But most importantly, the teaching and theology is 100% Bible based, served in an everyday real-life way. Pastor Phil is unapologetic about loving people and making disciples of all nations. The church is pentecostal, like I was raised in. It's a great place to lay down some roots and be part of the family of God. This church is a warm and welcoming place for all peoples. This is witnessed  by the multi cultural congregation who attend on Sunday.

I discovered over time the pastor, staff and congregation truly reflect the love of Christ to all who attend. The pastor is easy to talk to and genuinely interested in people no mater where you are in life.

The worship is not only professional but Spirit led in that you can sense the presence of God as the congregation worships. If your looking for a place to serve God with others you found the place.

Scott R. This church is amazing! Friendly people, super welcoming, awesome staff, great live worship music, great environment and an awesome pastor! I'm so grateful and thank God to have found a church like this. I feel accepted and wanted here. Also feel God in this place every time. I've been recommending this chuch to all of my friends, family and coworkers. There is also a coffee bar inside the church which I was very happily surprised about.

name: Nations for Christ Church / Iglesia Naciones Para Cristo - McAllen Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a place for true transformation and joy, this is it. This has been my home church since 2017, where I became born again, and my life has never been the same. I truly encountered Christ here—where the Word of God is faithfully preached, the presence of God is honored and reverenced, and the Body of Christ comes together to worship, grow, and be discipled. I am forever grateful for this church and the transformation God has done in my life through it. Come expecting to encounter the love of God! If you are single or married with a family, there’s a place for you here. They offer class for the little ones, community for the youth, Monthly marriage gatherings, Women have service twice a month. The presence of God moves and is EVIDENT in every service!
If you are ready to encounter a true relationship with God this church is for you. The Pastors can preach and have the heart of a shepherd!! Great full gospel church ⛪️ It's the best Christian church I know! It's a house of prayer where the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit reign. 🙏🏽🙌🏻👏🏼 Come and have a true encounter with God our Lord Jesus Christ. Nations for Christ is my spiritual home ❣️ I've been attending for 6 years, and my life has changed. My marriage and my children have grown up in this place. I rejoice that my children are being instructed in the Word ❤️ My Pastors ❣️ are exceptional people; they love God with all their hearts ❤️ and that inspires us to continue seeking the Lord with greater passion ❤️‍🔥 and fervor ✨❤️‍🔥

name: Nations Ford Community Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing!
Dr. Figgers always has a "right now" Word! The service was wonderful. It just spoke to my heart and comforted me.  The fellowship afterwards was nice too.  It was great meeting the Deacons and members of the reception committee.
I will be recommending my family and friends visit here.
I will also go back. A place to worship God and find peace.
Pastor Kevin is awesome and all his deacons and every member of the team. The worship leaders are great. You will find God in this place.
Word, Worship and Warfare... I  am always blessed when I attend Nations Ford Community Church..I can make it through the week with the word of God preached by the pastor. The choirs are awesome,  make you want to shout, stand to your feet or clap your hands while praising God. I love Nations Ford. Though it's no longer my home church, some of my closest friends are still members and I love coming back to visit. It's a small, close knit family and a great place to worship and fellowship. You can just feel the love in the air!

Today was family and friends day and it was also the first Sunday of NFL football so the attire was #JerseyCasual. We also had to take a selfie with a  person who was wearing a jersey from another team. Just a great time and a great way to bring people together in worship while leveraging the love of sports.

The music is also awesome. So great in fact that my wife and I bought their new album today. Can't wait for my next trip back to the community! #NFCC.

name: Native American United Methodist Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful sacred space and grounds! I was welcomed, along with my partner and a close friend, at a recent powwow hosted at the church.

As a non-indigenous individual attending her first powwow proper, I was a little nervous about offending anyone or doing something uncouth... but fret not! Everyone was warm and welcoming, and giving and informative in their own way. The grounds are well-kept by a *very* small team. The Sanctuary is historic and breathtaking. Parking is easy.

I particularly appreciated the powerful sounds and movement, the participatory nature of the event, the gorgeous landscaping and central courtyard, the open design of the main hall, the inclusivity, and the fry bread, the savory and the sweet! (¡Claro que sí!)

But my favorite was exploring the Sanctuary. Burning sage was so therapeutic and grounding. Be sure to visit the upper level, if you can. It's inspiring that the (sizeable and "old") property is sustained not only by the Native American Methodist congregation but is also supported by the Catholic church that meets there 3 times a week, as well as by Inspire Arts organization. Especially as an artist and arts educator, I found immense joy in seeing the photos of the happy artists in the main hall.

Services open to all every Sunday at 10:30am. Plus, check out Pastor Greg (Gregory Douglass) on YouTube! Everyone is welcome!
Come and worship with us!
Diversify congregation coming together to fellowship with one another and share his Good News! This minister (Greg) shares powerful, spiritual insights which I haven't learned prior to meeting him. A great congregation with a strong sense of the gospel of Jesus the Christ. Great church to go to iam a member here

name: Nativity Catholic Church Torrance - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: It's a nice church to attend but I would not recommend you do any important services there because their administrative office is unreliable A beautiful place to worship with faithful thanksgiving and hope. Prayers for Peace on Earth 🌎 💕 🕊 What a beautiful church, 100 years old in 2024. Now, I understand why so many people are away from church, I called to ask if they could mention my grandmother’s name on the petition prayer  on Sunday mass because is her 2 year death anniversary and they told me no because the list was full. God forgive them because they don’t know what are they doing. Very nice church but super dirty :/ posted some pictures of the bathroom that has urine on the floor that seems to be molding, also has a lack of Spanish mass missals even though the church is super full during Spanish service with a ration of 1/4 books being in Spanish

name: Nativity Confraternity-Christian - Torrance Campus
Nativity of Christ Greek Orthodox Church - Novato Campus
reviewSummary:
One of my classmates and fellow Eagle Scouts from San Marin High School class of 2010, Alex Madias, was mugged in Emeryville on 2/11/2018 and left with a serious gunshot wound to the head and as of writing is currently in critical but stable condition in one of the best gunshot hospitals in the country. His brother Theo organized a paraklesis service for him at this house of worship.

I hadn't spoken to either one of them in years; after I moved to Santa Rosa in 2011 I would occasionally see them at the fairgrounds in Bennett Valley, and while I did run into Alex at the Lagunitas Taproom back in 2015, it felt awkward attending the service, but it also felt absolutely necessary.

As someone who does not attend church I cannot deny I felt a sensation of comfort here. I don't know if it was the crowd of people, the familiar faces, or the location itself, but even a secular individual can find purpose and fulfillment in a house of worship like this. Beautiful Greek Orthodox Church.  Lovely grounds on top of the hill.  Very nice people.  A great young Priest, Fr. John. Beautiful artworks, delicious authentic foods wonderful culture and people. 💗 My girlfriend and i were out for a walk and found this awesome Church Beautiful church super nice priest!

name: NCC-Safe Harbor - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: The Holy Spirit is in this place!!! We brought 33 of our middle and high schoolers from FL - the presence of Jesus took over every single one of them. What a powerful service!! These young men will never forget this experience. Thank you church for your love and being the hands and feet of Jesus. Great place of worship. My daughter cried because we weren't going to bible study one night. That says a lot about the children's service that my 4,5 and 7 year olds love church. They also can tel me so much about what they learn. I love Safe Harbor! I’m such a fan of going to church and being able to LEARN! I’ve been in Texas for over a year now, and I still tune in online This is a Bible based church and you will really learn the word of God in this place. You'll get foundational teachings here and I'm absolutely positive that you will grow by The Word of God that's taught here Incredible atmosphere to be around every visit. I Lovvvve my NCC-Safe Harbor family!!!

name: Neartown Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I can't say enough wonderful things about Neartown. The people are just amazing, and we've made some of our best friends here. This is also the church I was baptized in a few years ago, and now the one where we are raising our sweet boys to know and love God. If you're looking for a church that is warm, inviting, has great music, believes in fostering strong community inside and outside the church walks, and will help you strengthen your faith, come check us out! We will save you a seat! My husband and I started attending Neartown Church in January 2019 while we were dating. We had been searching for a church where we could find genuine community after feeling disconnected at our previous church. From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and quickly found meaningful relationships with other families and members of the church.
That same year, we became Mission Partners, and Neartown quickly became much more than just a place we attended on Sundays—it became our church family. Since then, we've been married, welcomed two children, and have continued to grow in our faith through the incredible leadership, biblically grounded sermons, and authentic community that Neartown provides.
What has meant the most to us is how faithfully our church family has walked alongside us through both joyful and difficult seasons. They supported us through the loss of my father, celebrated and prayed for us during both of my pregnancies, and lovingly organized meal trains after the birth of each of our children. Their care, generosity, and willingness to show up in practical ways have been a tangible reflection of Christ's love in our lives.
One of the things we love most about Neartown is the way people truly do life together. The relationships we've built and the support we've received over the years have been invaluable. We are deeply grateful for this church and would wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a church that faithfully teaches God's Word, invests in its people, and fosters genuine community. I’ve been attending Neartown for a little over a year now, and it has been a tremendous blessing in my life. The teaching is Bible-focused and always points back to Scripture. Pastor Russell is engaging, welcoming, and has a way of making each week’s teaching both understandable and applicable to everyday life. As a young professional with a busy schedule, it’s easy to get caught up in work and the demands of life, but attending church here helps keep me grounded and focused on what truly matters.

One of the things I’ve appreciated most is the community. I’ve made some great friends and have had meaningful opportunities to serve both within the church and in the local community. It’s encouraging to be part of a church that not only teaches the Bible faithfully but also puts its faith into action.

If you’re looking for a welcoming church with strong biblical teaching and a genuine sense of community, I highly recommend giving it a visit. As a husband, dad, and business owner, I was looking for a church that actually teaches the Bible and feels more like a community. Neartown was totally that.

From day one, everyone was extremely friendly and real. The teaching is solid, practical, and actually from the Bible. It’s more like a family than just a place to show up on Sundays.

One of the top reasons I greatly value Neartown Church, is the Pastor (and I’m honored to also call him a friend) Russell Cravens. He’s a strong leader BOTH inside and outside the church, and it’s obvious his priorities serving people and helping other churches in metabolized Houston neighborhoods find faith WOTH Godly leadership. He doesn’t just focus on numbers or building some huge church organization. Neartown keeps that personal vibe where everyone’s known, cared for, and can easily find help (rather you think you need it or not), which is very rare these days.

If you want a church with solid Bible teaching, real relationships, and leaders who actually care about people, I’d definitely say check out Neartown Church. I’ve been attending Neartown Church for over a year now, and it has been an incredible experience. From day one, I felt welcomed and valued by the people here. The church does a great job of creating an environment where everyone feels comfortable, whether you’ve been walking with Christ for years or you’re simply curious and exploring faith.

One of the things that stands out most is the leadership. The pastor is a man of strong character, genuine faith, and a true heart for people. I’ve had the opportunity to get to know him personally, and his leadership, humility, and commitment to teaching God’s Word have made a lasting impact on me.

If you’re looking for a church that is biblically grounded, friendly, authentic, and focused on helping people grow in their relationship with Jesus, I highly recommend Neartown Church.

name: Nehemiah Bible Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Definition of Acts 2 body of believers. Christ, His Word, His works are supreme at NBC. If you are looking for a church home where you can feel comfortable and welcomed, this is definitely a place worth visiting. Nice wedding celebration. Inside the church the architecture is amazing! There is no gray area here the word of God is spoken at Nehemiah The person i met during my visit there was pretty rude, he even told me to leave as he gently pushed me to the door.

name: Neighborhood Church Of Chico - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church! My son had his Lineman College graduation here. It was a beautiful church, inside & out with plenty of seating! Neighborhood Church in Chico provides a welcoming spiritual community. The friendly congregation and inclusive atmosphere make it an inviting place for individuals and families seeking a place of worship. The church's commitment to community outreach and involvement is evident in various programs and events. The sermons are thought-provoking and relatable, offering guidance in a modern context. The facility is well-maintained, and the staff is approachable. Whether you're a long-time member or a first-time visitor, Neighborhood Church in Chico fosters a sense of belonging and a positive spiritual experience. Incredible place where the Word is Preached, your heart is encouraged and challenged!

Love this place!

Like any church, don’t just visit for one service. Give it a few months to see if it’s a great for or not! I have a teen that attends Core Butte High school and I was informed by my child that they were no longer allowed to walk in the churches parking lot, mind you there is no side walk or other way to the school off the main besides walking next to cars driving at a speed of 25 miles per hour, I think that is utterly ridiculous. Is this what my taxes are paying for? How could a church tell children they should possibly endanger themselves rather than walking through a parking lot which is much safer, mind you I've never seen more than 5 cars in the parking lot on a given school day. I love neighborhood church and Gaylord ends my family

name: Neighborhood Congregational Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
This church hosted one of the most peaceful and moving candlelight nights I’ve ever attended. The setting was breathtaking hundreds of candles, beautiful live string music, and a calm, reverent atmosphere that truly touched the soul.

Everything was thoughtfully organized, from the music to the lighting, creating a moment of reflection, peace, and connection. It felt intimate, welcoming, and spiritually uplifting.

A truly special evening and a wonderful experience for the Laguna Beach community. Highly recommended to anyone looking for something meaningful and memorable. Enchanting, intimate venue, phenomenal musicians, and  very well run. Showcasing Hans Zimmer is no simple feat, but this string quartet translated Zimmers iconic work brilliantly. This was our first Candlelight Music experience & we look forward to many, many more! BRAVO!!! So enjoyed last night’s Candlelight Concert featuring Queen music. Church pews were very comfortable and ambiance was wonderful. I'm a local Laguna Beach wedding photographer and I would like to share that this church is absolutely amazing!  The design and architecture and the reception hall is truly a artful creation, and with plenty of parking.  This is really a gem being so close to the beach as well.  I can't say enough about the "bridal getting ready room" - it was light and airy and had plenty of space.  Cheers to a wonderful experience... Took hubby to Hans Zimmer show in Laguna for his bday. Heard great things about these candlelight events and it did not disappoint. Only critic is the seating & price, but had a great experience overall.

name: Neighbors Pantry - Anaheim United Methodist Church - Food Distribution Center - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I have never needed to visit a food pantry until now, but beyond thankful for this one. They treat you kindly with respect and without judgement. They have healthy food and fresh vegetables and fruit. Sandie, Lee and the rest of the staff were so nice and helpful as a first time recipient. God bless you for doing the Lord’s work. 🤍 Things will get better for my family this coming year. 🙏🏼 I have been going with my mom for at least  6 months now and very clean and organized food distribution to those that are struggling to put food on table as I had to stop working due to stage 1 ovarian tumors and bone tumors on femur bone and were able to get help through this church whom has treated us very well with getting us appointments every month for healthy food and have met very friendly and supportive staff here. And was referred by city of hope Seacliff after my oncology appointment for a resource of food. May God continue to bless the stores that donate to this food pantry and God bless your steadfast ministry Anaheim Methodist church. I volunteer in the food Pantry but this isn't my home church. I know nothing about their services or church leaders. My review is strictly based on what I've observed being in and around the property. This property is very well kept. The pantry is clean and well kept. The cafeterias area is very clean and so is the kitchen. It is a all around nice place. I'm sure the church itself is just as nice. they are very nice and godly very helpful may God bless these people that work there ❤️❤️❤️ You are amazing human beings thank you I’m on dialysis and so are my family members it’s hard at times and you make a difference thank you Jesus and I thank you aswell

name: Nestor United Methodist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I visited here this morning, and I felt very much as if I had finally found my way home.  Wonderfully kind and friendly people. And then I went during Thanksgiving and they gave you lots of food and addition $15 gift card for turkey and all the fixings. People are openly friendly and I’ve always gotten nothing but smiles when I come around! Came here several times on the weekend to check it out while eating with my family. That's not a house of worship... That's not what Jesus taught us. This is a sinful excuse for a church and I'm ashamed to admit I'm a Methodist after coming here. 1 star. My journey has been amazing and I'll have my own place in April

name: New Age Bible & Philosophy Center - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Long-established, Rosicrucian-oriented spiritual group. Based on the teachings of Corinne Heline, herself a student of Rosicrucian Fellowship founder Max Heindel. Regular programs and Sunday services with an esoteric-Christian focus, as well as input from other paths and traditions. Small flock, but very welcoming atmosphere. Worth checking out for anyone interested in more Western-oriented New Age spiritual pursuits.

name: New Albany Presbyterian Church - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: New Albany Presbyterian church is a welcoming community that cares about each other. I have grown in my knowledge of the Bible and my faith in Jesus Christ since attending the women’s discipleship group and worship services. I love the home that I found in this church body 11 years ago. This church has been our church home for many years. We love the Bible-centered preaching and teaching, the warmth of being surrounded by brothers and sisters in Christ, and the welcome that is extended to everyone. Because of my job, I've moved quite a bit in the past 15 years. With each new city I canvassed 5 to 10 churches, sometime hitting the 9 at one church and the 11 at another. Didn't matter if it was Catholic, Baptist, Lutheran, etc. I was just looking for a pastor or priest that had something to say that could keep my interest without wondering off.  The pastor at NAPC, David Milroy, is unequivocally the best. Want to go from "Do I have to go to Church" to "I can't wait to go to Church!" then this is where you want to be. I've been active at NAPC for 19 years now, and I can confidently say NAPC lives up to its mission statement: "NAPC exists to glorify God through lives changed by Jesus Christ." It's full of people who love the Lord and want to serve Him, serve sacrificially, get involved, and dive deep into their faith. Getting involved in the small groups are an amazing way to learn the Word of God together and form deep friendships with other families. Sunday messages are engaging, thought-provoking, and appropriately confront the things we deal with throughout the week. It's just a Christ-exalting place. I love this church! They faithfully preach the Gospel every week, and  it's very Scripture based rather than a TED-talk style sermon. The community is also very welcoming.

name: New Albany United Methodist - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: So helpful and kind and they help the people who need help. They go out of their way to help the needy. God bless this church!!! The members of NAUMC are a family.  If you need anything all you have to do is let someone know, help is not far away.  The love in our church is always there. Wonderful church family and wonderful community outreach!!!!  Real and relevant. Beautiful church & beautiful Christmas music celebration that included Hilliard Darby's Chamber Choir. Warm friendly awesome people, a minister who preaches God's word.  Leaves you feeling good.

name: New Antioch Christian Fellowship at Aliante - North Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to this church for five years now.  New Antioch Christian fellowship is a place that puts God first,  teaches you to build a  deep passionate relationship with the Lord  through prayer, this is a praying church!! Plus the word is deep. Wonderful music Ministry. The word definitely being taught. Dr. Naida Parson is a spirit filled powerful Woman of God. I am inviting two guest to join me for the service today. Blessed place to be. Please visit as it will positively change your perspective! If you're looking for a church home this is the place they're there to save Souls I need to get you on the right track and get closer to God. Find out what your purpose is.

name: New Beginnings Christian Church - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Exceptional  Christian Church, with a phenomenal Pastor. Thank you Pastor Miller, for your  dedication to Christ & His Kingdom. I had the opportunity to visit this church several times during my brief stay in Arizona. The sermons and bible study were concise, practical, and helpful for daily application. I loved that Sunday service was later in the day so I felt like I still had a day to relax, and unlike some other churches I have been to, this church's Sunday service is only hour. The pastor consistently puts effort into offering actionable ways to integrate Biblical teachings into daily life. I hope these messages help others as much as they’ve helped me. My family and I have found our church home here in Mesa, AZ. Praise God!!! 🙏🏽

Pastor Andre Miller is amazing and I'm thankful for his leadership. The church family and fellowshipping is wonderful. It reminds of my church when I was growing up.

Pastor Miller sermons resonates and encourages my dedication to the Lord. Building relationships,  reconnecting, and learning. I am blessed, fulfilled, and thankful.

Please join us here for a visit or if you're looking for a church home!

I'm telling you we rejoice in the Lord EVERY Sunday! 🙏🏽 This church is a real church! The pastor cares about people and is very down to earth. The moment I walked into the church the energy was amazing! More churches should operate like this! Awesome anointed church and atmosphere! Pastor Andre Miller always provides his congregation with an incredible uplifting message and word from God. I love attending Church services and so does my teenage sons. I am so glad God led me to this awesome foundation to praise and worship!!! Thank you Pastor Andre Miller for always being so warm and welcoming!

name: New Beginnings Christian Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a Godly, Jesus loving church. My husband and I have been overwhelmed by the amount of love and acceptance we feel from the people here. Genuine, Jesus seeking people. It was easy for us to get involved, there’s always something to do or get involved with.

The preacher is always spot on and has such a gift for teaching the Bible. He never sugar coats but always preaches through love.

They got a new worship leader recently and he is amazing. Always spot on!

We send our baby to the nursery and when we pick her up she’s always happy, fed, well napped and changed. And I’ve never seen a cleaner nursery! That Sunday school teacher is a miracle worker!

We felt very safe sending our child to Sunday school. They have a check in system and everybody seems to know everybody. All the families are very friendly and opening to us. You’ll get invited to lunch by 5 different people before you leave.

Overall I think we’ve found a “home” here. The church is growing so fast and we just feel so blessed to be apart of it. Great church made up of real people. Pastor Steve is phenomenal and does a great job of articulating the message in an easy to digest manner that enables real world application. I absolutely love this church. We recently started coming here after leaving our regular church we had been at for years. It just got to big and just didn't fit us anymore. New beginnings has made us feel at home from day one! I am naturally a very anxious person but literally every person here I've met is so genuine and real. Steve keeps it real and is not scared to preach it like it is and I appreciate that. Also there is a great women's group and a men's group my husband and I attend which is awesome plus the child care staff is amazing... so basically if you are thinking about trying this church out do it!! Trying to find a church home after military displacement is always difficult! However, New Beginnings has been such a God sent! The motto of this church precedes it! Real People living Real lives! Only the Bible truths given with nothing left out! Warm and friendly environment! And just love calling this my new church home! Attended the drive up service for the first time a few weeks ago.  There is such a sweet spirit there.  The singing, and the message were much of a blessing to those of us in the drive up congregation.  Blessings to Pastor Steve and all who were there.
Matthew 18:20 - For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

name: New Beginnings Christian Counseling - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recommend New Beginnings Christian Counseling￼. Mayra creates a safe, compassionate environment where people can truly feel seen, heard, and supported. Her approach thoughtfully integrates clinical counseling tools with Biblical truth, which brings a depth of healing that speaks to both the heart and mind.

Mayra has a special gift for helping people work through anxiety, trauma, and difficult life experiences while restoring hope and identity. Her care is genuine, her insight is thoughtful, and she walks alongside clients with patience and encouragement.

If you are looking for a therapist who combines professional expertise with faith-centered guidance, I would absolutely recommend Mayra and the team at New Beginnings. Mayra is truly gifted in her work—grounded in faith, compassionate, and deeply caring toward her clients. She genuinely wants to see people grow and heal. She’s always professional, prompt, and responsible, creating a space that feels safe and encouraging. Her insight, wisdom, and skill make each session meaningful and productive. I highly recommend her to anyone seeking therapy that combines both excellence and a strong sense of faith and purpose. Mayra is a thoughtful and compassionate therapist who is deeply attuned to her clients’ needs. She provides a warm, supportive environment where clients feel seen, heard, and understood. As a colleague, I feel fully confident referring clients her way, knowing they will be met with care, professionalism, and genuine empathy. I highly recommend Mayra and her associates at New  Beginnings Christian Counseling. They are dedicated to helping others by integrating, both spiritual and therapeutic interventions in a warm, safe and compassionate setting. Mayra is a solid person and therapist! We met at a Christian conference for therapists and I would feel very comfortable referring clients to her!

name: New Beginnings Christian Ministries Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church today 10/13/2024 my family and I officially joined after 4 months. It feels like home, so it is home for us! I visited this church what a blessing they are. My first time as a visitor today and it won’t be the last. I loved the entire service!! A lovely place to worship friendly environment you are invited anytime we will love to have you Always warm and welcoming.

name: New Beginnings Community Church - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been a member of New Beginnings since 2009. After moving to Charlotte in 1999, I was ready to find a new church home--after spending more than ten years at my previous church. On the very first Sunday of my “new church” search, I visited New Beginnings. The worship and the Word were so powerful that I kept coming back. I never made it to any other churches, and that’s perfectly fine. I know God led me exactly where I needed to be.

I’m grateful for my Pastor, Bishop Michael Henderson, and First Lady Rev. Dr. Twanna Henderson. Their leadership has truly shaped my spiritual growth, and they’ve spoken wisdom into my life at pivotal moments—words I know were divinely sent by God. My first visit, I didn't go for a church service.  2/21/2026  But I was invited to see Sarah's Oil.  It was a free event, in which they provided snacks/drinks.  The atmosphere was friendly.   Plenty of parking.  The movie was a 5☆.  Thank you. Church is growing and keeping the young adults and children in mind. It was sad that a lot of activities and events that were established before Covid had not taken root, restarted or as impactful. I certainly enjoy the service. The people were friendly as they greeted us. We recently moved to NC and happy to attend this church.  New Beginning Church is  not far removed from the  church we attended in  Virginia. We will gladly return. Loved it! Excellent pastor and church family.The true word of God is being preached and taught here at New Beginnings. I loved the loving spirit from the church staff. I would advise anyone to attend. God is there, and the atmosphere is loving. I thank God for everyone integrity and love. Beautiful service and church! May God continue to bless New Beginnings.

name: New Beginnings Community Church - Redwood City Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Hurman’s teachings are very entertaining and approachable. This is the kind of church you can bring people attending for their first time, including high school / college age. Service is 1:15 start to finish. I wish the music were longer (usually only 3 songs upfront) and the community updates / messages (after music, before teaching) were shorter. But it’s pretty efficient. People are diverse, kind. I grew up going to Grace Community in So Cal, and since 2012 had been going to Menlo Church, but I have found my home at NBCC now for 2 years. I attended NBCC after the Menlo Park Presbyterian Church (menlo.church) choir sang. Two of my choir buddies went with me.

Now, I live in Arlington, VA, close to my son. Family is important. Be kind to all, because they're your larger family!

Five stars for NBCC!     😃 Definitely would recommend. Pastor Herman is very inviting. Very compassionate. Very good service and brings every day life to Scripture. This is a great congregation! I Miss my Pastor Hurmon Hamilton. I wish I never moved from the bay. 🥹🥹🥹 I was helping in the children's ministry, I was doing so well spiritually. Now I just can't find a church where I can say its home. Its so 😔 sad. This church feels like home. The community is so warm and genuine (many church goers know that church people can be judgy—they’re not here). Also Pastor Hurmon preaches fantastic sermons! God’s love is definitely in this place.

name: New Beginnings Community Church - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: Church on Sundays, Celebrate Recovery (CR) on Tuesdays with a light supper beforehand if you choose, and Bible study on Wednesdays with youth groups meeting during the same time. Childcare for all activities if necessary. The best  are the pastors and the music. It's like every Sunday and Tuesday you are attending a mini concert (the music is that good), followed by the pastors bringing The Bible to life so that we may go and apply the truth in our lives, and share it with others. We are all God's creation and this church will definitely make a difference in your life. You'll see! Excellent pastoral staff, music, and spirituality of services. Highly recommend this church for those looking for a meaningful message, fellowship, and a break from traditional, rote services. Great Pastors, amazing Awana, and great family-focused events. We love it. Compassionate and spiritually lead on many levels and the teen outreach is phenomenal.  You feel the love and peace! A great place to grow in your walk with Jesus . Unity and small group community provide for personal enrichment in a comfortable environment.

name: New Beginnings Community Church - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is very welcoming to people from all walks of life. The sermons are engaging, edifying, and full of Bible scripture. There are also many opportunities to get involved and make an impact for God’s Kingdom. I love NBCC and am thankful for their ministry! Good morning everyone! God bless you all! name: New Circle Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm not sure what the below person is talking about but let me tell you - this church is more than a "church." It's a family and it's the truth. If you're used to services that you can't decipher if it's church or a funeral, then no, this place may not feel right to you. Pastor Kyle teaches straight out of the Bible and is so easy to know and understand. He puts his own life as an example of what God can and does do. He's very humble and LOVES people and God so much. I came from Shreveport, LA where my church was Word of God Ministries with Pastor James preaching. That place was heaven on earth, and I find it a little strange that people said the same about that DIVERSE church that worshipped. New Circle Church is my new church home, and I have full faith that it is the real thing. This coming from a pastor's kid raised in religion. We don't do religion at New Circle - we do God and the relationship with Him. Religion is what put Jesus on the Cross. I know that God will bless us with a building soon so that this church and people can keep "loving people back to life." Ok, I'm gonna be so blunt in this review its not even funny. As a highly confused teenager, I finally feel somewhat understood with the youth group they have. Genuinely, the community is so awesome and so welcoming and accepting. I could go on for HOURS telling you how much this church has done for me, and I haven't even been here for half a freaking year yet. I've been bullied by everyone I know for nearly a year without end, and that still hasn't really stopped, but New Circle has showed me that you actually CAN trust people and God DOES hear you. To be completely frank, I probably wouldn't even be writing this review if I didn't find New Circle. Genuinely, while I was at Arise, my other church, I never felt seen or heard, let alone loved or understood. Then God sent me a dream. The dream went something like this---I was in some dark alley in the pouring rain at night, hoodie soaking wet and sticking to my skin. I could physically feel depression and anxiety gnawing at my conscience and my heart, and a voice from behind the cloud said, "Look up, child. Look past this darkness, squint at the shadows of what's on the other side." I tilted my head up, slowly rotated it to the left---and there, at the end of this alley, in the light of a streetlight, were Kyle and his wife; Jaron, the youth leader; those people who greet you at the doors every morning; teenagers like me...it all seemed so surreal, but one of them threw a paper airplane of notebook paper towards me, and I picked it up. There were smudged words scrawled on the damp paper: "step into the light". And while I had no idea who those people were at the time (I'd never seen them before), turns out that those were actual people who were waiting for me at the church. I apologize for the length of this review, but New Circle is all this and more. If you wanna come, come as you are. You don't need to fix yourself, you don't need to dress up in fancy-shmancy church clothes, and you certainly don't need to feel ashamed because of your race or ethnicity.

We all feel lost at some point in our relationship with God. Come to New Circle and Potato will be here waiting for you.

If you've read this far, you should probably get off your device and go be productive.

God loves you!!!!!!!!

reviewSummary:
Love this church after looking for the best fit for my all family! (Different ages) we are so happy to find New City Church. People friendly and caring. Great sermón based in the Word of God. Very active church for all ages! Like many people, I grew up in the Christian faith. But then for nearly 15 years, I stopped believing and, if I'm honest, I became resentful toward Christianity.

A few years ago, I found myself tumbling down a rabbit hole of Christian apologetics and the historical evidence surrounding the Bible. What began as an intellectual pursuit became something far more personal. Little did I know God had a plan that would completely change the course of my life, He wrapped his loving arms around me and gave me a whole new level of understanding that I couldn't see before.

The next step was finding a church. I approached it with caution. I even questioned whether modern church institutions were truly biblical. Over the course of 8 months, I went to three different churches. Then I came across New City in a reddit forum, and I've now been attending for about a year. Without exaggeration, it is the best church I've ever been part of. I've come to realize just how essential a Bible based church is, especially in a time when many are reshaping Scripture to fit the culture or rejecting the Gospel altogether.

The Pastor(s) teach directly out of The Bible, they do it in series format that allow you to dive deeper into the text instead of just skimming the surface. They also do an excellent job of acknowledging cultural challenges without allowing it to overshadow the Gospel.

If you're looking for a church that is honest, authentic, and firmly rooted in the Bible, I wholeheartedly recommend New City. It has been an incredible blessing in my life, and I'm deeply grateful God led me here! So many churches I have been to water down God’s word trying to be socially correct and not upset or lose any members.  However in Revelation 3.16…it says if you are lukewarm God will spit you out of his mouth.  The Pastor at this church refuses to pull his punches.  He tells it like it is.  It is why I keep coming back.   Listen, Learn, Live.  Life is forever.  You choose where it will be. We have come to this church sporadically mainly due to concerns about certain yellow flags that previous sermons have given us and the sermon today confirmed these concerns.  Today the pastor showed a picture of a pride parade as an example of “desires of the flesh” basically presenting the LGBTQ community as an example of moral failing. In the photo people were marching and holding signs reinforcing that LGBTQ folks are worthy and loved, messages which from my understanding are core to the teachings of Jesus but clearly not everyone in the church feels that way. Its really disappointing to hear someone with as much influence as the pastor say Jesus is love and then turn around and have large components of their message being hateful/condemning/not welcoming that community, who from my experience often reflect the kindness and love Jesus’s message more than some Christians that I know.
From my understanding of the gospel, casting stones is more aligned with the beliefs of the pharisees rather than those of Jesus but unfortunately I think a lot of churches nowadays seem to be more keen to follow the pharisees than Jesus.  I pray that at some point churches like this will become privy to their hypocrisy however I fear that these views are becoming more pervasive in American Christian culture. Its also unfortunate because I feel like components of the pastors message were really good and parts challenged my personal views but his presentation of examples of "moral failings" were openly divisive and Pharisaical to the point where I will not be back.  I wasn’t planning on writing anything but figured it would be worth it to warn those looking for a church that focuses on preaching Jesus’ love rather than the “culture wars” and this neoevangelical victim complex that is pervasive in these newer churches. The music was too loud, mainly because the bass is turned all the way up.
Even during your 15th anniversary video, the base was clipping and thumping while other work was being done on the stage.
I'll be back when you rent the place out for a rave.
I know you're going to tell me I'm in the minority and everyone else enjoys it like that.. whatever.
I go back to simpler days, and churches that had pipe organ music, it was very beautiful.
And because other churches have a similar type of production, it makes me sick and tired of trying to find a church that I can enjoy, so I'm not going to bother looking anymore.
