They made me feel like I was part of the group and I felt so connected!!! Love New City! Keith the pastor is amazing. He is deep and relational. I always leave refreshed and renewed and convicted- as one should! New City is blessed with amazing partners and families. Felt so welcomed here the moment I stepped in and they have great community outside of Sunday too- join one of their Missional Communities and you’ll quickly feel the love everyone has here! New City is a church who wholeheartedly and unashamedly centers itself profoundly around The truth, The Gospel and the wholeness of Jesus Christ. New City’s primary focus is to spread truth, pure love and Jesus Christ at all cost— this is evident in the fruit it bears within the people of the congregation and the mission they all personally carry to pursue Jesus in every moment of their lives. Never have I entered a church and felt the kind of warmth I feel when I walk through those doors. In my opinion I believe New City carries a beacon of light to our city, to its people and to new and old Christians everywhere. I am honored to be apart of a church who carries such a burden, it is refreshing.

name: New City Church Oakland - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited with my husband and toddler daughter. Such a sweet warm welcome from everyone. Coffee and muffins were a treat before church where I met other members.

The children’s programs were amazing. The word was just what I needed.

Check it out if you’re in the Oakland area I've been attending since the almost the beginning, and the church hasn't lost its focus even as it's grown: to love Oakland as God has loved us. It's so heartwarming to be part of church that makes an effort to not only welcome all into the church to get to know this amazing God we follow but to purposefully, wholeheartedly, and unreservedly take God to Oakland. So update review. I found this church Jan this year. I can say I now found my Church home, I help serve on the Worship Team, First Time help serving in the kids Ministry 11/13/24. This place I have witnessed God move. When I first started going I never seen a church who service was at 4pm in the evening and they had to faithfully set up and tear down because the space where service was rented. I always then knew this place was different. Fast Forward several months they now will be having a bigger space with service being in the am. This is only the beginning for newness for NCC. I’m happy to be apart of this journey. I highly encourage anyone and everyone who loves and wants to follow Jesus to come check out this church. God Loves Oakland and he certainly loves you. God bless. I truly Enjoyed this beautiful place, space full of Gods presence and lovely people. First Visit was such a pleasure. We all part taked in communion it was really a well put together service as well as needed word for me. Im thankful for meeting new people and being blessed like I was. #GodLovesOakland. I definitely recommend stopping by on a Sunday @4pm for Gods Word. Me, Hubby & daughter visited this church on Sunday 12/1/24 it was really nice, service was awesome, worship on point and the people so loving and caring. We met Frank and his wife, Vanessa & Bryan
Awesome people. Thank You. 🙌❤️

name: New City Church of Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited our friend Pastor Phyllis and really like the family feel with the couches. The kids stayed in service this week. They are intentional with group discussion and I appreciate that as someone who promotes active learning. All the staff goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome. Very diverse. I love seeing the #Christian #brothers #sisters  their #children #family & #friends. It is an amazing place to #connect with the #Bible in a #non #denominational #setting. The building was an #old#bank #transformed into a #theatre where one can enjoy #olays throughout the week weekend & #nights. The building is surrended by #eateries, #entertainment #businesses #Starbucks #CVSPharmacy & after Sunday #Service #foodies #crafts &#groceries at the #Historical #Core #Farmers #Market.
It's my best day of the #entire #week! . I just moved to the area and have been on the church hunt. Maybe I've just gone to too many mega churches with that commercial feel, you know how some churches just try too hard, no offense because hey, different strokes for different folks, right? Well, this church to me, just has that It Factor. If you're looking for a real gem with unique music, a thought provoking sermon and where you can get involved in the community, this is it. Also Phil the greeter is the sweetest guy ever ! I've been going to New City for almost a year now and LOVE IT!  It is the most racially diverse and economically diverse church I have been to.  The first time I went I was immediately noticed and welcomed warmly...It's not like other churches where you walk in and no one talks to you except for a good morning from the person handing you the bulletin.  I was not only greeted but welcomed immediately.  From the very first day, I loved Kevin's message of grace.  He captures the heart of the Bible; God's heart for people.  He doesn't bog down his messages with rules and regulations and religiosity, but teaches from the Bible, God's love, truth and all consuming grace.  When I hear one of Kevin's messages I learn more about the historical time period each verse is coming from and I learn more and more about the heart of God.  Not only does it help me in my walk today, but also teaches me more about the origins of the Bible.  Not may pastors can do both as Kevin does.  Jonathan, the associate pastor, is also a wonderful speaker and is an exceptional leader in the church.  Being apart of a grow and serve group is what really cemented my connection and love for the church.  That's where I created and foster lasting friendships with people that have become like family to me.  We get  deep in the word and in each others lives and it's powerful.  All groups also have a serve portion where we reach out, volunteer and serve our community.  New City has forever changed my life and I feel incredibly blessed to be apart of such an incredible, loving, open, innovative, diverse, cutting edge, non religious, Bible based, community centered, church! My husband and I have been attending New City Church for about six years ever since it was in the beginning days. As a bi-racial woman I appreciated the diversity of ethnicity and socioeconomic, but more important than that the gospel is presented in sermon, action and presence. New City has offered me community in a way that I have never experienced and I have seen this church go from 20 people to about 400. I told my husband when it reached 100 I would be ready to leave. Ok. I'm still there and not planning to leave anytime soon.

No church will offer you 100% satisfaction, but New City offers sermons based on the Word, the gospel upheld and a dose of reality to bring you to your knees. This is my home.

name: New Community Bible Fellowship - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
New Community Bible Fellowship is a beautiful and welcoming place to grow in faith. The teaching is solid, rooted in Scripture, and always relevant. The worship experience is powerful and heartfelt, and the community is diverse, warm, and genuine.

Pastor Kevin has done an amazing job building up men to lead well, both in their homes and in the church. The other pastors also provide sound, thoughtful teaching that stays true to the Word. I especially appreciate the emphasis on small groups—Bible study communities where you can build real relationships and do life together.

Whether you’re new to church or looking to go deeper in your walk with Christ, this is a great place to be planted. 8/8/2021: I visited the church for the first time and it was pretty cool. Chill, friendly, bible teaching atmosphere that let warm and inviting. The sermon was delivered by a guest pastor, Kevin McIntyre, of Cleveland Hts.

Pros:
* Warm, inviting church. I was greeted upon entry by several members.
* Come as you are. I wore street clothes (shorts and a tee shirt) and nobody seemed to judge my appearance. Actually, several members had also dressed comfortably.
* Bible teaching church. The sermon was backed by scripture.
* A very good, invigorating choir. The songs were simple and easy to sing along.
* Age-diverse congregation. Many people, young and old were in attendance. The were the older ladies in there with the church hats as well as younger couples there. Many children there which bodes well for the growth of the church.
* Service started promptly at 11am and lasted for only 1 hour and some change.
* Nobody forced or repeatedly asked for donations. They asked only once and that was it.
* Technologically advanced church with televised/streamed services.

Cons:
* Some on the babies were loud during the service and caused some distraction. This is Bible study. Friendly Church. Who Believes in God the Father God the Son and God the Holy Spirit. They are one.  Baptism, discipleship,fellowship and doing life together. Families are welcome. Daycare provided. Pastor James is anointed and his sermons are practical and life changing. He exhibits truth and grace in his deliverance when speaking the word. Spirit filled, bible-based, friendly & active church with authentic, caring Pastors, Officers, servant leaders & volunteers.

There are scores of ministries and life groups for children, teens, young adults, marrieds, men, women, and more.  We invite you to visit and worship with us.

name: New Community Brethren in Christ - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a small Christian church where everyone knows your name, New Community BIC is the church for you. This is a small church with a very loving congregation that is very supportive of each other in prayer and friendly fellowship. We meet every Sunday at 9 am in a room rented from the Upward Call Nazarene church in Chino. We have a Men's Breakfast on the first Saturday of the month at 7:30 am at the Corner Bakery in Chino Hills. The retired, or currently not working, meet on the third Monday of every month at the Patio Grill and Cantina on Central Avenue in Chino. A mid week bible study is held every Wednesday at 7 pm in Chino Hills. The church women have monthly outings to a variety of fun places. Come and join us if you are looking for something different and ready for a change. You are welcome to join our Sunday service or any of our activities listed above. Pastor Mike is no Mickey Mouse of a pastor. He is the real deal. He's a good man with Deep Thoughts. Word to the wise, don't challenge him to a drag race. Love you, brother. Friendly. Welcoming.

name: New Community Church
reviewSummary:
This church exists to bring glory to God, to make disciples and to share God’s love with the community. Our family has been so blessed by the focus of this church on the clear teaching of the Bible. The fellowship with others here is intentional. Come here to hear how to be reconciled with God enjoying fellowship with God and others in this life and eternal fellowship in heaven for all eternity. I visited New Community Church for the first time on 1/19/25. My soul rejoiced to hear the truth! I am definitely going back. I was deeply impressed by the Pastor's message to speak the truth without the fear of offending anyone. It was wonderfully refreshing to hear the truth spoken unabashedly in a World full of lies. Jesus is the Truth! The Whole Truth! This community did not survive their split from a few years ago.

Make no mistake: Pastor Rich, Pastor Jerry, and the rest of the faculty present a very biblical environment.

But no pastor or church faculty can prevent cliques, factions, divisions or conflicts of personality at the congregational level, and no other congregation have I seen overlooks the plank in their eye for the splinter in others.

Acts 15: 7 And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
8 And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
9 And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
10 Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? A true Bible based church with fantastic preaching and a friendly welcoming congregation.  You will be inspired, and their services will help draw you closer to Christ and give meaning, purpose, and hope for your life. My family has attended NCC since 2004. We are blessed to still have teaching classes our founding pastor and his wonderful wife plus our new dynamic pastor,his outgoing wife, and growing family. It’s a great place to be!

name: New Community Church - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary: Such a welcoming place. Former pastors from Menlo Church (Formerly MPPC) re-started this church hoping to build a community and big family instead of just a Sunday Show with no community. So far so good. We're just getting involved with that community recently and everyone I've met has been so welcoming, warm and inviting. I'm looking forward to deepening our connection here in the coming months. Solid, warm, small church with excellent preaching. We visit two to three times a year (we don't live in California) and always feel like we fit right in. Is it SUNDAY, AUGUST 19, 2018 YET?!!!  Please come join us at New Community Church's 1st church service at 10 AM, Sunday AUGUST 19th!!! GO GOD! Beautiful church, wonderful community! So excited for this new experience.

name: New Community Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary: Inviting, peaceful, and joy-filled church.  It's easy to understand the draw.  Pastor David leads with humility, humor, and a well-prepared lesson.  He includes a wrap up of his message with a group discussion. I love this church! The messages really speak to me, I always feel welcome, it’s not overwhelming like a lot of big name places. The people here are so kind and open hearted. Pastor David teaches you from the Bible lessons applicable to real life. I've been coming to this church for almost a year and I thoroughly enjoy. It is the most non-judgmental church that I have experienced. Didn't know what I was missing until I found this church.  Everyone is welcome, you don't have to pretend to be accepted.  Practical advice for learning to live and love better.

name: New Covenant Athens - Athens Campus
reviewSummary:
Finding a church home can be a journey, and I’m so grateful that mine led me here. For over a year now, this church has been more than just a place of worship it’s become a true home, a family, and a constant source of joy and purpose in my life.
From the very beginning, I was welcomed with open arms. The warmth of the community, the sincerity of the leadership, and the presence of God that fills every service made it easy to get connected. Over time, I found myself stepping into new roles like serving as a youth leader, singing in the choir, and helping with events and I can honestly say I’ve loved every minute of it.
This church isn’t just about Sunday mornings. It’s about people doing life together, encouraging each other, growing in faith, and being the hands and feet of Jesus in the community. It’s a place where I’ve been challenged, supported, and inspired and I’ve grown so much, both spiritually and personally.
If you're looking for a place where you can worship freely, serve joyfully, and belong deeply, I can’t recommend this church enough. It has truly changed my life. I’ve been a Christian my whole life and have never felt more AT HOME than at this house! My whole family is embraced and loved, there are groups, activities and roles for every one of us! We all feel loved and that we fit right in! God has done so many miracles in our lives through what we’ve received in this church - it’s just beyond words!
I love our church ❤️ We have been attending New Covenant Worship Center since 2011 and we love it! The atmosphere is great and I love the diversity of the congregation. "It's a snapshot of what Heaven will look like!"
The word is taught in a way that encourages not condemns. Also, my son really enjoys being a part of the Covenant Kids ministry at New Covenant. He has so much fun and most importantly he is learning about the word of God! If you are looking for a church home, come visit! A little over a year ago God moved my family and I from our previous church to our now home church. New Covenant's members have big hearts and they are very welcoming. From day one we felt God's presence in a mighty way and being able to worship however, is not something you see in many churches these days, but is encouraged here. People serving people and all loving God. If anyone is looking for a place of worship that you can grow with and have an excellent spiritual family in the process, this place is it. I was weary of joining another church before we visited this one because of all the encounters I'd had with people just putting you down. All we have received here is love and commitment to never give up on you. People tend to forget we are all human and I'm so happy God sent us to the exact place where we needed to be. Get here, get involved and watch God show out in your lives.  Be prepared to meet the most down to earth people and awesome kids ministries if you have children. I am blown away at how much truth I've learned here and having a pastor that preaches on everything in the Bible is a rare find! I love NCWC, Pastor David always has a good message to bring before the church, he is a understanding person and has time to listen to what you have to say, or what you're going through . Pastor David the whole church family loves you, keep bringing the word for those that are thirsty for the word. Great job

name: New Covenant Baptist Church of Maryland
reviewSummary: A wonderful experience every time I attend! The people there are so intentional, friendly, loving and kind to all who are seeking a church home or simply just visiting. The sermons are solid and delivered with such passion and intentionality. The hymn's are beautiful and always are a joy to hear and the vibes are all around really lovely so it is a place that is highly recommended to any Christian out there seeking to reconnect to the Lord and the Gospel. And if you are not a Christian, don’t be discouraged you will be welcomed with open arms and people wanting to meet you where you are at! Warm and welcoming church environment. Wonderful worship music and solid and faithful Gospel preaching. Please visit and see for yourself! Great place to be to be seen and to be ministered to. Church is affiliated with Capitol Hill Baptist Church, another solid and faithful church in the DC area. New Covenant Baptism Church has been instrumental in my spiritual growth. The strong sense of community there, resembling a supportive family, has been immensely valuable, especially since I don't have family nearby. I've been a member for two years, and I'm genuinely grateful for the profound impact this church has had on my life and my journey of faith. So thankful to learn and grow in this Gospel-centered, multi-ethnic and multi-generational church! We are grateful that our college freshman learned first hand the importance of worshipping and belonging to a healthy evangelical church grounded in the Word, and uses New Covenant Baptist Church as her model when visiting prospective churches on her own in college. This church is rich in diversity, faithfully preaches the gospel, and has beautiful worship amongst its loving members. I feel very fortunate and cared for here. :)

name: New Covenant Christian Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Good morning service and good people to meet They are the best community church I've been to in a long time A welcoming community where all means all.

name: New Covenant Christian Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
I've never stepped foot in this church, but doesn't stop me from believing this is a really nice community to be a part of. 🫶

Thank you for all that you do. 🙏 First time visiting. I'm from out of town. Went with a friend.  Very friendly! They focus on Christlike love for ALL! It was lovely! I'm a member of New Covenant Christian Church. I've been to a lot of Churches in a lot of different places and New Covenant Christian Church is the most genuinely welcoming Church I've ever been to. When you come in the doors, you won't be judged for what you believe or what you don't believe. You are simply welcomed into a community. In April of 2024, we voted unanimously to become an open and affirming Church. Our open and affirming statement:

We are an OPEN AND AFFIRMING community. We acknowledge that the universal Church has not always been a safe place for ALL people. Hearing the call of Jesus to love God and love our neighbor, we welcome everyone into a safe and respectful faith community. We welcome you into full participation and leadership as we worship and serve God together. We welcome all people without regard to sexual orientation, gender identity, race, ethnicity, mental or physical ability, socioeconomic status, marital standing, family structure or religious background. We invite you, whatever "you" looks like, on a journey together to better align our words and actions with Love.

We believe this statement is what Church should look like and we are working to make that a reality. We believe in practicing social justice. We believe that is what Jesus modeled and taught us to do. Music is great. Message is great. Friendly people. Accepting of every person wherever you come from. Loving members and they're there for the community to get extra food when needed on Thursdays. I do plan to worship with them during Sunday service.

name: New Covenant Church
reviewSummary: Finally found a church that’s traditional and focuses on the Lord’s Word. Pastor Chris is very knowledgeable, you feel like you are in a college seminar with the amount of knowledge. The people are all very friendly, only been 3x and I feel so welcomed What an amazing church! This is the real deal - a congregation that truly cares for one another & made us feel so welcome & cared for from our first visit. I’ve seen genuine love & care for the hurting & people in need like never before! The teaching is incredible - Pastors Chris & Daniel teach right through the Scripture - no skipping around to create a clever theme. This feels like drinking from the purest source of fresh water!  There’s even an in-depth Sunday School class at 9am, followed by the 10:30 service. I feel like I’m learning so much & a place where I feel our family is cared about. My high school son even loves coming to church!  Check out New Covenant & look for my family sitting on the left side about 5-6th row from the front. We’d love to meet you!! Very good traditional church with excellent expository teaching Friendly, yet reverent and traditional. The old soul in me appreciated the music. Choir, piano, horns... Grown-up stuff. No rock concert here. The preaching was biblically sound. They gather for coffee and fellowship afterwards, which is nice. The only serious reservation I had was the big stained glass with an image of Christ. If you don't see that as a 2nd Commandment violation, you may find this to be an excellent place to worship. A wonderful worship experience. The service is reverent but accessible with a strong focus on Bible teaching. The people are friendly and genuine. It’s a community that can very quickly feel like home.

name: New Covenant Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
New Covenant Church – A Place of Faith, Family, and Growth

New Covenant Church is truly a blessing to be part of. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re greeted with genuine warmth and a sense of belonging. The atmosphere is filled with joy, encouragement, and the kind of love that makes you feel like family.

The worship experience is powerful and inspiring, filled with heartfelt music that lifts your spirit and brings the congregation together in unity. The messages are grounded in Scripture, practical for everyday life, and delivered with clarity and passion. Each sermon leaves you feeling encouraged, challenged, and spiritually refreshed.

The church also shines in its sense of community. Whether it’s small groups, outreach programs, or youth and children’s ministries, New Covenant Church truly invests in people of all ages and walks of life. It’s more than just a place to attend on Sundays—it’s a home where faith grows and lives are changed.

If you’re looking for a church that combines strong biblical teaching with a welcoming, family-like environment, New Covenant Church is the perfect place to connect, grow, and experience God’s love in action. Me and my fiancee went to visit on Sunday and I can say we really enjoyed the service and the people that are in church. It's a friendly church and the topic the pastor was talking about are really true. Like " What would God Do, if he was me?" We been looking for a church home. Thank you for welcoming us. We went for trunk or treat, the congregation is so nice.  One offered prayers if we needed one, even though she had just met us.  I said yes, my aunt who is 45 has breast, bone and brain cancer and received 4-7 months to live about 6 months ago.  She is a fighter and a fire captain in California so just having a stranger seem to care meant a lot.  I am Catholic but really appreciate they treated me and my kids so well The best Christ Centered and Bible based Church with many friends that help me get close to Jesus!!! Grandkids really enjoy visiting their great-gma's church; people, Sunday school teachers very welcoming & listened well concerning one child who has signif sensory overload issues.  Summer (Jul) one 10am serv & Sun school 11a.                               Early service more traditional & 2nd one @ 11am has more modern feel, praise/worship band (Kyle does great job!). Preaching 100% biblical based, not "woke" but not judgy.  Not trendy but traditional practices. Honestly do not enjoy new theatre style seating - benches were more comfortable but other updates made to auditorium are nice. Have free hot coffee too & a refreshment area for purchases, near kids classes.

name: New Covenant Church - North Campus - Longview Campus
reviewSummary:
This is our church home. We have been here for several years now and it is The friendliest Church with great messages every week from our gifted pastors. This church is family to all who are in need. The praise and worship music is awesome and amazing. Friendly atmosphere, great contemporary music very gifted worship group. Pastors are energetic and give excellent sermons and studies. We are never bored studying the word and they make it fun with delightful humor. They focus on a healthy relationship with God, Marriage, family and church community. They have a lot for the kids too.

I checked out their website and decided to attend one Sunday. This is a spirit filled, life-giving church! If you’re looking for a church, please come for a visit. You won’t be disappointed! My family and I absolutely love this church! We started going about 2 months ago. Everyone is so welcoming! The music, Pastor Stephen, and services are awesome! We look forward to going every Sunday to worship the Lord! This is such a fantastic church! Such a warm welcome coming in, people love on you, lots of smiles and friendly. God fearing, people loving church with an amazing word from Pastor every time!!

name: New Covenant Church - Pompano Beach Campus

Our pastor Mike wells is a great man and God has provided our church with a great pastor and great leaders in the church. I love this Church. They offer a place for the Holy Spirit to Move without restraints. Be it on your feet, in your seat, on your knees or waving a flag.  Come as you are, praise the most High King! I am proud to call New Covenant my church and my family. I love the Biblical teaching and how very applicable and essential the learning of it is to my daily life and that of my children. My spiritual growth is vital for my present and my future as well as that of my children. New Covenant supplies me with the knowledge I need, the prayer and support we all  need and I just love it there. I highly recommend my church family to anyone who loves the Lord and craves spiritual growth and development to join us on any given Sunday and experience it for yourself.

name: New Covenant Church of Orange County - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Because it's the best place to fellowship with other Christians. We have our Sunday Service  @ 10:00 am / Bible study Wednesday evening @ 7:00pm .Come & bring a friend, YOU will not be disappointed.....U can also see us on Facebook.U will see a picture of our Pastor Sagel A Simon Just look for New Covenant Church of Orange county..
Best little church in Orange county come and bring a friend you will not be disappointed. 🙏🏽✝️🙏🏽 I was invited to the online service, about 5-6 years ago. I was very impressed with the service. After a few services I joined. And my life has very been the same. The service is at 10:00am est on Sunday morning. Excellent preaching and teaching. Bible based. Warm congregation Perfect message lovely people am so blessed to be a member...and our pastor and the wife are perfect example of true disciples of Jesus This is my place of worship. I believe we're heading the direction the Lord would have us go.

name: New Covenant Church of StL
reviewSummary:
I went to a food pantry at the Church. It was very organized with lots of volunteers glad to help everyone. The line was very long and we stayed in out cars. People came around asking if we wanted prayer, or did we need anything! They were wonderful! I had such a warm welcome! Others readily befriended me! I was invited to sit down and eat and I only knew them for 3 minutes!

I came to drop off a gift for a friend and then walked away to get to know others!

However there was a strange woman active in the church who shouted at me “I will kick you out of the church I will call 911. Get your own friends, go find a church around you and go there instead. You can’t be friends with my friends. I need my space.” If you need space then why did you come up to me and the people I was finished talking to whisper something to them? The other attendants said “oh no, she is a nice lady” in response to what you and your husband whispered. What did I do to you two?

I was suffering from depression from bereavement and woooooow that just made it worse. Someone over thirty acting like this. It doesn’t seem like others share her views since they were welcoming to me. I asked her what I even did and she said I “barged into her church.” I asked if she owned the property or had authority in the church. She said no. Pretty sure you can’t enforce anything.

I still apologized that I offended her, that I didn’t see what was wrong with dropping off a gift for a friend.

This is why church attendance rates are falling. Churches are a place for inclusiveness. We seek attention for god there, not ourselves. I’m definitely praying for that woman.

I feel really really sad someone at that age would ever act like that and I’m glad the church is helping her be a better person. This just makes me wonder how many other people she did this to. It was so jarring she was all love and light but when we were alone, and no one was looking, she was shouting and even said a profanity. Complete opposite of how others described her.

I don’t think you’re usually like this. I know you don’t deserve to feel this way and I’m so sorry you are hurting so much. I want to be your friend too. Hoping you just had a bad day

Please do not tell me to get a move on in life due to my income. I was dealing with an illness and I don’t understand why a Christian would not care  about that.

Please do not be ableist and assume I’m fine just because I look fine, or then compare me to your engineer son and fashion industry daughter. That’s very hurtful

She does not represent the church so still come but report any bullying to the administrators please. Absolutely Amazing!  These are truly God's people, so welcoming, so full of love and kindness!!  The sermons are life giving. You will definitely feel the presence of Christ here!

💖✝️🤗 Blessed that this sermon was recorded, listened for first time, I have not yet attended, but plan to do that soon, even though I am a member of another church that does not record & post the sermons for people who miss church due to illness or whatever. let me tell y'all, everyone here is the nicest people you will EVER meet! Free food,tea, coffee, and prayers! Come here every Sunday! I hope that I see you!

name: New Covenant Tabernacle - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: While I haven’t been there in about 18 years I miss this church. Last time I visited Pastor John Sr. did a baby dedication for my son Levi. He’s 19 years old now that’s how I know it’s been 18 years. I miss going to the orphanage in Tijuana and working with my brother Mario. I miss Wednesday night services. I miss Thursday night prayer. I just miss it! From time to time I look on YouTube to see what’s happening at NCT and my heart is glad. I’m still serving God up in the Pacific Northwest but I just wanted to say thank you, I am a life that was changed by your ministry. My family and I are so thankful for our NCT church family. My husband and I have been attending since our parents brought us as kids. Now we serve in this church and we are raising our family here. Our 10 year old is learning about Jesus through our wonderful children’s ministry. She is growing in the word of God and is having fun as she learns. She especially enjoys singing in the kids choir. New covenant tabernacle is more than a church.We are family. We pray together,look out for one another. So blessed and honored to be part of this body of believers, Jesus Christ saved me here and my family. I pray you seek Jesus and find true meaning to life.🙏🏽 I have been a cameraman here since pretty much I got there which was over a year ago and God has moved in my life. Glory be to God because it’s not just the church it’s Him. All the pastors all my brothas and sisters in Christ here at NCT are a blessing to my life they look out for you, pray for you, and provide help truly if you need it. The Spirit of God is in this place and it’s people. My husband and I attended NCT this year in support of a good friend and we haven’t left since! This is now our Church. If you’re ready to be filled with the Spirit of Jesus Christ, you will find that here. The Worship Team moves my heart, the people and Pastors are filled with love and anointing. Pastor John Jr is filled with passion and knowledge of the Word. I am learning so much! Thank You Jesus for leading us to New Covenant Tabernacle 🙏🏻

name: NEW CREATION CENTER - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
A truly blessed and vibrant church!
New Creation is a modern and Spirit-filled community with a fresh and welcoming atmosphere. The pastors and leaders are wonderful, and Pastor Alex is truly exceptional - passionate, sincere, and wholeheartedly devoted. Sunday service was powerful and touched the heart deeply. The sermons are delivered in both English and Russian, which is such a thoughtful touch. Kids have a great time too! I’m so grateful to have found this place and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a church home. NEW CREATION CENTER This is where:

children teachers are amazing too🙌🏻 It is very good peaceful and friendly place with a great people! It is very important to support each other! Thank you guys for doing such important job! Wonderful church and people.

name: New Creation Church - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
You really feel the love of Christ in this church. We feel welcomed every time. We have been coming here for 2 months and you really feel the Spirit of love. God is good. The service is not rushed and really is led by God. VERY much a prosperity gospel church with attempts to push some charismatic worship as evidence of the divine (think, speaking in tongues). If you "donate big" to this church, God will assuredly reward you.

Suggestion - Stay away if you have any understanding of grace-based theology. I love this church the whole church is super supportive and kind. I especially love the youth ministry, the youth pastor and his wife are amazing I love being a part of New Creation Church.  Every Sunday I am challenged, enlightened, and encouraged.  Worship is great.  People are friendly.  There are many ways to be involved and to be strengthened all through the rest of the week too.  I don't even like to be gone on a weekend because I know the services will be so good at New Creation! My husband & I started attending this church when we moved to Longmont in 2000. Not only have we raised our 3 children there, we, too, have grown up spiritually at New Creation Church! What a great place for you & your family to get connected & grow in your relationship with Jesus Christ. Come check it out!

name: New Creation L.A. Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve never been to a church that cares this much about fostering a loving, Christ centered community. Whether your new to the faith, wondering what Christianity is all about, or have been burned by other churches before, New Creation loves on you and walks with you through questions and hurt.

Plus, I love that NC loves the arts. Musicians, animators, actors, and more all belong here. It’s rare to find a church that values beauty and the creative method and NC does that in spades. As an animator in training, I can’t imagine worshipping Christ anywhere else. Very welcoming church that preaches the word the God! Great to see that the congregation has renovated an old church building. Very artistic congregation with the renovated space and jazzy music! What I enjoy most about New Creation is that there is a genuine intention of building community, both as a congregation, and through Community Groups weekly and the Olive Crest care communities.  It’s great to serve Jesus with amazing new friends. Pastor Dan did my mother in law funeral this past Thursday and it was so beautiful- the best services I have ever seen. He is a blessing and absolutely love him the whole family did. He forever will be in our hearts.
Thank you Pastor Dan.

name: New Creation Outreach Ministries - North Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited the church for the first time last Sunday after finding it on Facebook, and I’m so grateful I decided to come.

Before my visit, Minister Kim stayed in communication with me and made me feel welcomed even before I stepped through the doors. When my boys and I arrived, she found us and sat with us during the service. That meant so much because we didn’t know anyone, and her kindness immediately made us feel comfortable and included. She truly represents the church so well and is such an incredible asset to the ministry.

From the moment we walked in, everyone was so welcoming. A sweet lady greeted my boys and me with warm smiles and hugs, making us feel like we belonged from the very beginning.

Pastor D delivered an amazing message, and the choir was absolutely wonderful. When they sang “As I Look Back Over My Life,” it brought back so many beautiful memories from my time in Reno and nearly brought tears to my eyes. It was such a special moment.

Overall, this was a truly uplifting and heartfelt experience. My boys and I left feeling encouraged, loved, and welcomed. Thank you to everyone who made our first visit so memorable. We will definitely be back soon! I really enjoyed the service felt very welcomed when we got there, and decided me and my son will renew our membership. We actually joined right before the Covid Pandemic. I feel like that word from the sister who spoke was confirmation for me for so many things❤️🙏🏾 This is a church where you truly feel like family. If you like learning about God, this is the place for you! There is a ministry for all ages. The teaching/preaching is on fire!!! I would highly recommend this place!!! This is not really a review, I would love to come visit you guys maybe even become a member.
But I live on Centennial, on the other side of Losee but there's no buses that come down Centennial after Losee. My car was stolen and destroyed, so I can't even drive. I don't suppose you guys have a Van that assists and helps pick up people from the immediate neighborhoods around here who can't make it they're on their own? It would be great if you did. Hope to see you all soon. Excellent Bible Teaching Church! Shows genuine love from the parking lot to the seats!

name: New Culture Church
reviewSummary: I've been going to New Culture since moving to Madison in June of 2020, and it has been an incredible experience. Sunday services are awesome: worship is great, Pastors Abbie and Nermalis preach the word of God, and it's a very welcoming environment. New Culture also has Community Groups (small groups that meet every Tuesday evening) that have been so helpful for not just getting plugged in, but for my personal walk as well. Highly recommend checking New Culture out, regardless of where you're at with your faith--it's a place where you can belong before you believe! I’m so grateful to call New Culture my church home! The community is friendly and supportive and the pastors are solidly rooted in the Word of God. Pastor Abbie has done a wonderful job creating a welcoming space for new comers. Good preaching, friendly people, and perfect location downtown WITH a parking lot! What a group of amazing people! New culture is a place where all are welcome and loved. Got to experience a service and communities during the week and everyone was super friendly. I’ve been going to New Culture for a little over a year now and I love it! Everyone is so welcoming and kind!

name: New Day Christian Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: Blessed to be able to call this church HOME my entire life. So much love in this family! 🥰 I, have known Pastor Leroy and Gail for many years. They are the best described by Gal. 5, always bearing much fruit. The church with any Pastor reflects the personality and integrity of that Pàstor, and so it is with New Day. Their atmosphere is as easy going and friendly, I would just say loveable as you will find anywhere. wonderful body of believers, truly blessed to call these people family, bible teaching at a down to earth level  in the language used by todays belivers lots of LOVE

name: New Day Christian Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
We were planning on attending a church while on vacation, after watching their online sermons for two weeks, we decided to visit New Day Church in person. We were immediately greeted at the door by someone who
noticed we were first-time visitors and made us feel right at home. We absolutely loved the service, especially how the pastor preached directly from the Bible as the ultimate Word of God. A truly welcoming and biblically-grounded church! ✅ Good worship

✅ Great sermon

✅ Welcoming atmosphere

We’re just visiting on vacation, but I’d stay in this church if I’d live in the area. Pastor is honest and God fearing person. His message is solid straightforward and fundamental. I’m grateful for visiting. Imagine your sole purpose being to bring people closer to God and you use Mother's Day as your opportunity to alienate a very specific group of people and to tell thousands of people children are better off in orphanages and foster care than to be adopted by two loving men. Sorry, single dads, too. You're against this pastor's (not God's) plan for your life. God took your wife? Against God. Wearing a kilt? Against God's plan.

Good thing I was called by name by GOD and not as an anonymous recipient of this pastor's blasphemous opinion, otherwise I'd be truly lost. New Day is a great Christian Church that preaches what the Bible teaches. Great up beat worship, messages that are from Gods word that you can apply to your life no matter where you are. Highly recommend and they have a great youth group for younger children too. 2/22/26- very big church! Loved the sermon- even though it was a guest speaker vs. the actual pastor. The music was too loud-especially the bass to hear the words of the songs the worship team was singing since I didn't know the song. People were friendly.

name: New Day Christian Fellowship - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
My cousins Desiree and Patrick invited me, and I joined the very first day. I was welcomed with open arms and immediately felt comfortable and at home.

After completing new membership classes, I became an usher and greeter. I truly appreciate that they assess you and help place you where you serve best, so you are not in a department that does not fit you. That allows you to give your absolute best.

Bishop teaches directly from the Bible and from his heart. You can genuinely feel that he cares and wants all of us to grow spiritually and be where God has called us to be.

I am always excited and happy to invite anyone I know who does not have a church home. If you are looking for a church in Corona, California, this is definitely the place to be. Excellent word! Friendly atmosphere and you’re made to feel comfortable right away. I truly appreciate Bishop Tony Dunn and one of the main reasons why is because he DOESN’T ask for money. Bishop always takes the time to share with us how our tithes and offerings benefits communities  both locally and globally. I LOVE MY CHURCH FAMILY! 💗🙏🏾 The Spirit of the Lord shows up every Sunday at New Day. The Bishop is a God-fearing humble leader with a genuine mission of bringing everyone to Jesus Christ. He is developing mature believers and ambassadors for Jesus Christ. Since I’ve been attending this church for the past three years, I have learned so much about the character of Christ and how to walk in purpose with Christ.  I really appreciate the work New Day is doing globally and locally to expand the kingdom of Christ. My family and I have been so blessed by the leadership and teachings of this church. Thank you Bishop and the New Day team! Money Money Money. The pastor is always asking for money. Money to buy the church. Then more money to pay off the church. Money for his trips over seas but no trips domestically. Money for missionaries that didn’t save for retirement so they want to buy him a house. Stay with me, then after six months, asked for more money for the missionary for the house again! Pastor didn’t say thank you, we saved this amount so far, he simply repeated the same story about buying a house for a missionary that didn’t save for retirement. I personally gave to help the missionary but felt as though I got scammed after hearing the same story without an update on all of our offerings the first time he mentioned collecting money for the missionary. Currently looking for a church that is focused on the Lord. I loved that they had space for everyone and what I mean by that is that inclusivity all age groups for children even children with special needs that really warn my heart the most

name: New Day Church at Southlake - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary:
This is an incredible church. When you walk in it is very modern & nice. We have a two year old and she loved the nursery ministry. The staff was very friendly. The service started at 10:15 am and was done by noon. The time flew by though it did not feel long. I    came and encountered God's presence. My life was changed. We will be back again next week. If you read this and come to New Day ask for Joe and come say hi. You will be so glad you came to church this Sunday. A great place to find friendly, caring people who very quickly become family.
Ministries for babies, kids, youth and adult.
Bible based teaching.  Great fit for any age group.  Looking for a new church home - come become a part of our family. Pastor Ricky is a wonderful pastor. Very loving and inspiring. Always feel fulfilled spiritually after attending Sunday service. New Day Church is conveniently located at White chapel road and Highland Street in Southlake. I highly recommend. Not a "mega" church that is just interested in pleasing people and growing numbers.  Pastor is both intellectual and very spiritual.  It is a extremely missions minded church.  People are warm and friendly. Great Pastor and family! Very giving and loving, we Couldn’t have made the last month without them! Thanks Pastors!

name: New Denver Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary: The warmth and openness of New Denver church impressed my husband and myself on our very first visit. The church is accepting of wherever you are on your faith journey and offers numerous opportunities for growth in our relationships with Jesus and others. Sermons are thought provoking and there are discipleship groups, fellowship opportunities, annual women's and men's retreats, local and international mission experiences, children and teen activities. We have been extremely happy with our decision to be part of New Denver's church family and quickly knew this would be our church home without searchingly further after moving to Denver 3 years ago. New Denver Church is exactly the type of faith community my husband and I were seeking.  We felt welcomed and accepted from our first visit and continue to value the relationships we’ve developed at NDC. The leadership offers practical messages and options to engage in small group settings. For anyone seeking a faith community with practical application of traditional biblical values, New Denver Church is a great option! My wife and I have been going to New Denver for about a year and a half now, and we feel very fortunate to have found it. We felt very welcomed from our first visit, and it is steadily feeling more like home. Their mission, like much about the church, is simple but compelling: to lead people into a growing relationship with Jesus Christ. One thing that I have been impressed with is that the church accomplishes this mission well for people in many different stages and walks of life. New Denver has been a foundation in our lives for a little over a year. The most unpretentious, welcoming and genuine environment we have found. We look forward to each week's message and always find them relevant. The congregation is warm and helpful, encouraging us to participate more deeply in different ways throughout the year. NDC offers a variety of resources such as D-groups (Bible studies), mens' and womens' retreats, a thriving kids ministry during services and events, mission trips and much more. It is a thriving community and an excellent example of people living out God's will in the world. We have been attending this church for 18 months. The teaching is thoughtful and biblical...truly outstanding. The atmosphere is welcoming and loving. With two services and the congregation split between them, it can feel a bit on the small side but I'm not in to mega churches anyway. As with any church I have been a part of, it is important to participate in the small groups. Small group sign-ups are offered twice a year and go a long way in helping you to connect with the others who are a part of this church body.

name: New Destiny Fellowship
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church ! Very welcoming people .  They also have a children's program for parents wanting to worship without disruption.  They also have a teen room as well for our young adults. I love this church!! I was just there in October 2019 for the Prayer Gathering sponsored by Pastor Aziza. It was awesome in God!! The Lord really used Prophet Brian Carn!! Apostle Weeks was there also. He is a very humble anointed Man of God. I will fellowship here every time I can. This is my church!!! I've beeb attending for 23 years now. I'm still being fed every Sunday. My Pastor is so forward-thinking. He remembers teens and millenials too. Come out for a visit and receive some love. Don’t lose anything important at service it will not be returned will never return your calls or respond to Vm but happy to ask for money 5 times a service smh. This is my church i would like to invite you to the servicr where God is alive and doing well if you need healing deliverance peace encouragement salvation. God will meet you there and meet your needs.

name: New Faith Christian Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary: I have been in the Atlanta area for 7 years now.  In the beginning, I traveled an hour and sometime more south to attend church services that I was familiar with because I could not find an inviting worship atmosphere in the area.  After being invited to this church for Family and Friends Day, I have never ceased going.  The Bishop and First Lady are personable and friendly.  They make sure they acknowledge and speak to every person that attends the service.  The congregation is family oriented and inclusive. There are options for children's church, dress down days and bible study.  I have enjoyed each service I've attended and plan to continue my spiritual path and worship with this church. Awesome church very nice on the inside the pastor and his wife are very friendly people it seems like a very loving congregation and the fantastic thing about this church is they have their own personal nursery and daycare for children No place like New Faith! Come get in the word with us, you won't be disappointed! Im in town, and want to go in the morning. Hope I have transportation. Such a warm and inviting place to be! No place like New Faith!

New Gate Presbyterian Church - Glendale Campus
New Generation Ministry in Christ - Las Vegas Campus

name: New Gideon Baptist Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Collins is a phenomenal leader. My husband and I really enjoy his preaching. His wife is beautiful and very loving ❤️ Awesome place to worship and feel like you’re home, like you are family not a visitor Love it many blessings an praises, Hallelujah, will be glad when services began again so i can hear the word Funeral!😥 what else can I say🤷! It was a beautiful home going, astronomical amount of ppl there. Co-worker! She'll be missed I have been going to this church since I was a kid. I love it there. It's home!!

name: New Harvest Christian Fellowship - Pearland Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi! 👋😊
A wonderful church we call family.
If your looking to meet Jesus, looking for prayer, looking for a family of friends, wanting to learn from GOD's word, then come on and join us! We'd love to have you! Show up early to be a part of prayer before service and stick around after service for some coffee and great conversations. See you soon!👋😊 I love my church family. Everyone is so welcoming. My babies are taken care of by wonderful loving people. Had a funeral service here last Friday and everything was going good until the end, while we all gathered in the lobby after the service I saw the head pastor rudely, yelling at one of the funeral home workers. The young lady was just trying to do her job and was stopped abruptly and instantly he started shouting at her about how “disrespectful” she was being and he shouted multiple times that “he is the head pastor and this is his church and she will listen only to him” I’m not too sure what it was over but I felt the only thing disrespectful in that moment was how he approached her and continued to make a scene in front of my grieving family. Whether he was in the right or wrong there is a way to handle situations and a proper way to speak to people to get your point across.He could’ve easily pulled her to the side privately and discreetly. I truly did not appreciate the way he handled the whole situation and how he repeated multiple times “he is the head pastor and this is his church.” Very rude, disrespectful and unprofessional and I will not be returning to this church thanks to the “head pastor” and now I’ll always remember that moment from my uncles service. A very diverse, welcoming place of worship. It's truly a family here. There's lots of different groups and events you can be a part of. They're building a new, larger building on-site, and it will be very exciting to see it when it's finished. This is not just a "young people's church" or an "old people's church", as I've heard other places described. This is a place for everyone of every age and every background. You will never feel unwelcome at New Harvest. It’s a very welcoming family oriented  church to go and get your Soul and Spirit Feed 👏👏👏⛪️ The pastor there and the leaders are very genuine,  truly it is a must come and see type of church family🙏 I love the Atmosphere

name: New Harvest Community Worship Center - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: BEST CHURCH EVER!! Compared to the two Mega Churches I attended in Atlanta Ga. Thanks for living the life you preach about! Love this place, I have been going there for a while now and look forward to the service every Sunday. The pastor is authentic, transparent and very funny. The atmosphere is always holy ghost filled. The presence of the Lord is always felt in this place. People here are friendly and very welcoming. Join us on Sundays at 8am or at 10:45am. Come with an expectation in your heart to be blessed and I promise you won't regret it. Wonderful Pastor and spirit filled atmosphere. Church family make you feel really welcome. Grew in my faith so much here. Come as you are, learn as you go, and grow as you learn This church is a great church home for anybody I love this church the pastor is very good at what he do a thts preach

name: New Heart Church - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
The way these pastors flaunt their money on social media is wild and unbelievably tone deaf in today’s climate. Wake up, pilates, tennis, shop and dinner! Probably in brand new matching outfits!!!!
So cringe for most of us watching while the world burns.
I’m curious what their tithing looks like compared to their med spa bills. 🧐 This has been heavy on my heart to share recently. We had gone to this church for around 8 months and at first we loved it. After a while I noticed somethings that didn’t sit well with me. This church is VERY clicky and if you aren’t a pretty blonde you won’t ever fit it. It also started to feel like they worshipped each other more than Christ. We stopped going and not a single person ever reached out. New Heart Church is home!! Literally from the second I walked in - I’ve never felt more loved, seen, and valued! I met my husband here, got married here, and now we’re raising our daughter in this life giving community!!! It’s a dream come true!! There’s no better place to meet amazing people & grow in your relationship with God. This is an amazing church! My husband and I had been looking for a church home for our family for a couple years. We had visited New Heart to just try it out, and when our two kids asked if we were coming back the next Sunday because they loved it so much, we knew we had found our church home! They truly care for every person no matter the age! There is literally something for everyone! First of all, wow. In just one short month of attending New Heart Church my husband and I have seen a change in ourselves, spiritually and mentally. Our marriage has never been so Christ centered since Feb 4th 24. We don’t have to pretend here. We don’t feel less than here. We don’t feel like we’re on the back burner here. We feel welcomed. Our kids feel welcomed. We feel at home at New Heart Church and we cannot wait to see what God has in store for us. Thank you.

name: New Heights Bentonville - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary:
There’s just some weird vibes I got from this place. First off you’re greeted by a fully uniformed Benton county sheriffs officer who if anybody who’s lived here long enough knows of their perpetual civil rights violations as well as their cooperation with ICE. It was not a welcome I would expect from a church especially with the large immigrant population as ours. Second, the  pastor was as cold and aloof of a person I’ve ever met. There were some nice people I met on staff but overall the place just gave me the ick. Just another “church” that adds nothing to the pantheon of self-serving, self-righteous churches in America today. It did well in helping me deconstruct my faith, though. Perhaps if we had more churches like this there would be far fewer christians. Love our church! The community is super loving and giving Spirit filled church just like the body of Christ should be. Wonderful pastor and leadership pastors! Great kids ministry! Huge gym for the older kids to run out their energies in. Very welcoming volunteers! None judgmental church home! Highly recommend this body of Christ! New Heights was so inviting to us when we first visited 2 years ago. Now we feel like we have been there forever and it is our "home"! The teaching pastors are so authentic and teach from the Bible, which is so refreshing. Our community group is like an extension of our family. You can truly feel God and his Holy Spirit move in this church! My husband and are from this area and were seeking to find a new home church. We came to New Heights Bentonville for the verse-by-verse teaching through the Bible but found much more than that!
We found a great community of believers, a body that prays together and seeks the Lord together. We found a Church that pours goodness and fruitfulness into the community for Jesus.
And since we meet in the cafeteria in an elementary school,  we get to bless the school staff with an upcoming breakfast and provide school supplies for the students. I am so glad God brought us to New Heights Bentonville!

name: New Heights Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has truly been a blessing in my family’s life! From the moment you walk thru the doors, you’re welcomed with genuine love, kindness, and a sense of belonging. The messages are powerful, biblical, and practical — they speak to real life and leave you encouraged and challenged in the best way. The worship is heartfelt and uplifting, and you can feel the presence of God throughout the service. Beyond Sundays, this church really cares about people and the community, and it shows in everything they do. If you’re looking for a church that feels like family and helps you grow in your faith, this is the place! I’m so grateful to be apart of it! I love this place. My wifey and I,(Wifey being with Jesus-911), went to a similar place in lower Manhattan.
My sister and I were looking for a new church, and having very little luck. I love this place; the pastor is a great pastor and has very informative lectures. He keeps it light and jokey. He's a Bible filled spiritual man, who cares of people. There are several people from the base, who are very outreaching, very friendly, and are easy to get along with and really care. We don’t have a life group, and some of the other things we require are not provided by the church. However, some of the other church members have the same issues that I do. So it’s not uncommon to talk after church. If you’re looking for a good Bible based church, friendly and sincere then I suggest you try this place. I thank God that I found it. We loved this church until our 8 year old adopted son misbehaved and we were told he couldn’t be in the children’s service any longer.  We attempted to propose other options such as volunteering in the children’s ministry to help with him and other options, but were denied.

This has been several years, however, it pushed us away from the church and from Christ for many years. We are just now looking at returning. Love my church family! This place feels like home, everyone always has a smile on their face & they provide a warm welcome. My family attends New Heights church and always leaves each service feeling so much love and encouragement. It is a life giving atmosphere ! The pastor brings truth with love and the worship always makes me feel so much lighter than when I walked in.

Our daughter is 3 and she has been in the Kids program since she was in nursery. I’ve always felt she was safe and cared for and she comes home teaching me all about the Bible stories she learns! She even came home one Sunday and taught me a scripture !

It’s our home and we love it !

name: New Heights Church - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm and friendly atmosphere, where one can really feel accepted, and wanted. Great music. And you can always count on a message that encourages, challenges, and helps equip ones walk with God. A great church where each member is eager to serve the community.  Outside ministries include an Alzheimer's/Dementia Caregiver support group on the fourth Thursday of each month, 6 to 7 pm.  Check it out on Facebook. New Heights - Owasso Alzheimer's/Dementia Support Group Great church for the whole
Family! A Bible driven church full of love and support!  It truly has a heart for God and His people. Great church striving to be the hands and feet of Jesus by serving the community with a clothes closet and an annual mission to help kids get ready to go back to school. What a wonderful group of people at this church and the pastor is definitely one of a kind!!! Come one time and see what I mean.

name: New Home Ministries - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church on this side of heaven! This church has something for everyone,  regardless of race,and age. There are ministries to meet the needs of people in this day and age. This family of churches are lead by two brothers,  who stand on the shoulders of their late father ,yet blessed to have their mother propel us into the future with her beautiful wisdom, style, and grace. Services are at maximum capacity every Sunday.  Do get there early to have one of the best genuine worship experiences in the city of New Orleans. New Home Ministry is a great church if you're not able to attend  services in person Please follow them on all social media platforms. They are definitely a church that feels like family, because they are family. New Home Ministries has been a steady source of wisdom, truth, and spiritual growth in my life for over a decade. I’ve been a faithful virtual member for the past few years and have followed R.C. Blakes, Jr. since the very beginning of his ministry. His teaching has consistently been powerful, intentional, and deeply rooted in Scripture.

His books are phenomenal and life-changing. I especially love The Father Daughter Talk, and I’m currently reading Queenology—a work so impactful that I’m now leading a group study on it at my local church. His teaching has moved countless women, raised the standard, and led many hearts back to Christ.

What makes this ministry even more special is the heart behind it. In 2023, both Pastor Blakes and his wife took time to personally engage, answer questions, and pour into others through Zoom calls—something I will always be grateful for. They are a phenomenal couple who truly shepherd God’s daughters and sons, reminding us that we are children of the King—seen, valued, and called higher.

I am deeply thankful for this ministry and for Pastor Blakes, whom I genuinely honor as a spiritual father. Our family experienced tragedy and requested the pastor Samuel Blakes for the funeral. I was asked do I pay tithes and when was the last time. I didn't think nothing of the question and told her the month prior. Days past by and no answer so I called back and was asked under what name I paid, when, where and how. Being devastated from my tragedy my answers weren't accurate but I did say how I pay tithes. After days of calling and being talked down to by Angel and her assistant. I finally had the receipts but by then my calls stopped being answered. I was hurt by this because I actually been going to the church and even was a part of their Turkey giveaway with Cash Money and tithing. For so long I didn't want to call it like it was because I felt somehow I shouldn't talk about my church. But how I was treated was real and it came from my church. I will never go there again and because of this I have stopped attending church and I still love God and believe in him. I watch it on TV and give tithes to a needy situation. Great Baptist Church for praise and worship! If you're visiting New Orleans you should definitely attend one of the services that are held throughout the week!

name: New Hope Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
I joined this church about 8 years ago before it moved to its new location in Burbank and I have been blessed beyond belief ever since!

The members of New Hope Church are some of the sweetest, friendliest people you will ever meet. Every Sunday, the atmosphere is so warm and welcoming. I've invited family and friends over the years to attend the Sunday celebration service and by the end of it, they always tell me how much they enjoyed the experience and the people.

Pastor Roge's teachings are always so relatable and he really strives to make the Word of God accessible for everyone, whatever stage you are in your Christianity! Pastor Diane is phenomenal as well, and her teachings just take your relationship with God to the next level.

All I can say is if you're on the fence about coming to the Sunday service, just try it out once so you can experience it for yourself! New Hope Church recently started to hold two services on Sunday: 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM. There is child care available for both services, and there is coffee and donuts served before and after service. My wife and I first found New Hope Church in 2009. Back then they were located in Van Nuys. We immediately fell in love with the sense of community, and the friendly, relational sermons. Unfortunately we had a change of life circumstances and fell out of contact with the church for many years. After the pandemic we realized we needed spiritual fellowship, and found out that the church has moved to their new location in Burbank. We showed up and it was like we never left. What a friendly, supportive, and biblically grounded group of people! Pastor Rogé consistently delivers the word of God with clarity and a refreshing sense of humor. We're now active members and feel the blessings every day. Our relationship with God is growing stronger. Give it a try; you won't be disappointed. I have been attending NHC for over 10 years as a 16 year old. It has changed mine and my family's life. We have been restored and are continuing to be blessed in every way through the powerful teaching of grace, the love and support of this church family, and the wonderful counseling that is readily available to all members. I met my lifelong friends who pour into my life in every season and trial, and am now attending with my husband and infant son. Every week there is a powerful and anointed Word from Pastor Roge that is so easily applicable to my week, and I have seen a change in my life and relationships with others and the Lord as I did. There are also wonderful programs and classes available to help with every spiritual need, including a recovery program that has transformed my life! If you have children, there is a wonderful Children's church that I also grew up in with amazing teachers that teach the gospel and love on your kids. (I cannot wait for my son to experience this as well!) Don't even get me started on the worship!! Always a powerful and anointed time. I also love that they have a series of classes (Next Steps) that helped me discover my God-given gifting which connected me to serving in the Media department. I love being able to serve and using my gifts which leave me so fulfilled and on purpose every single time! I love this church and cannot recommend it enough!!

If you are looking for a community to grow with and love on you,
If you are looking for somewhere to be a part of,
If you are looking to grow in your relationship with God and the Holy Spirit,
Then this is the church for you! Great church! Was only visiting town so only can base off one service but if you’re looking for a more modern non-denominational church, I highly recommend! People there were very friendly and gave out donuts and coffee before service. They had an AWESOME worship team. The pastor was funny and the sermon was objectively good. But if you go be prepared to be greeted by a lot of people. New Hope has been such a blessing in my life.  This was my first church experience , and everyone was warm, friendly and encouraging.  The teaching is uplifting and relatable, and it’s helped me overcome the anxiety and stress in my life. If you’re looking for hope and community, this is the place.

name: New Hope Church - Concord Campus

This is a wonderful church filled with love, faith, and genuine care for people. From the first visit, you can feel a welcoming and peaceful atmosphere. We started in February and have been going every week. The sermons are easy to follow and each has a great message that I think about sometimes throughout the week. The church has a robust program with different activities and events happening throughout the week. They have a variety of causes they engage in, including grocery giveaways, homeless outreach and family reunification.

We're really glad we found this church and are honored to be members of the congregation. The people are super friendly and welcoming! The service was awesome and I immediately felt at home! I also love how community involved New Hope is. I will definitely be back next Sunday! ❤️ This church is a family, it is welcoming and loving as well as generous to it's congregation, offering hot and cold coffee in the morning, and host many community events. It is a recovery based church that fills a community need as well as spiritual needs. They have plenty of parking in two lots as well as street parking at the park across the street which had a lovely playground and sports field. There's childcare and Bible study as well as meetings and advocates. You'll feel safe here in this non prejudice and accepts all orientations and backgrounds. You don't have to worry about racial or prejudice of any kind. I feel so at home here. There’s love everywhere and community and unity. Praise Jesus. Pastor Joe and pastor Teena are amazing at what they do and so is the rest of the team!

name: New Hope Church / 새소망교회
reviewSummary:
I've been coming to this church for exactly a year now. June, 2025. Love the people here. They all treated me like family from day one! If I missed service people would call me if I was okay and offer their concern they missed me that day.  This church is big but not too big and not small. If you're looking for a church, definitely check this church out! God bless! Awesome praise, Bible based messages, passionate members, God's grace is evident throughout every corner of this church! Great for all ages, children, youth, teens, young professionals and old. Community focused, family oriented, grace filled, you cannot help but to grow spiritually at this church. It's been a bit over a year since attending New Hope Church and it has been absolutely life changing. This was my first time going to church and everyone made it so comfortable and welcoming for me - there literally is nothing to worry about if it's your first time going.
It feels like family and you can see the holy spirit working in our church - from the sermon, to the worship, the different missions, volunteering, and fellowship. The pastors, the sermons, the worship, the prayers, and everything here has deepened my faith, gave me direction when I felt lost, supported me, and filled me with love, joy and passion for Jesus.
I loved the sermons so much that I started attending both the English service and Korean service (there's always an interpreter). They also have early morning service, which is amazing. Attend that, and your life will change.
I am also grateful to be surrounded by such warm and loving brothers and sisters, including a lot of young people, and I think it speaks to the passion and fire that's evident at New Hope Church.
It really feels like God has guided me here and I have found my home. ♥︎ If you also are wanting that and are wanting God's guidance, His presence, and a church that truly lives out His Word, this is the place. New Hope Church has truly transformed my life and our entire family. My sister and I have both attended for more than a year, and every time I go to church, I feel nourished, supported, and truly nurtured by the church members, leaders, and pastors. I remember the first time I came—I had never attended church regularly, nor did I read the Bible or pray regularly. At first, I felt hesitant to attend the Sunday service as a newcomer, feeling nervous about stepping out of my comfort zone, but they were so welcoming and genuinely friendly.

At that time, I struggled with high anxiety levels and a lot of resistance to opening up to people in social situations. However, through God's grace and the continual support of our church, I was able to gradually heal and embark on a transformative journey that continues to be supported unconditionally by the loving presence of our community. There is so much love in our church and an open heart with a willingness to serve and volunteer for others, a generosity that goes above and beyond. This is especially present during fellowship times and gatherings, which are so valuable for spiritual growth.

Finally, the dawn service has been a tremendous support. Whenever I struggled internally for the next breakthrough, the sermons I received always brought clarity, renewed faith, and a greater focus on loving Jesus.

Look no further if you are looking for a church filled with love and built upon the word of God! 💗 The presence of God and His love is so evident here! Awesome worship and community! I always am challenged to love Jesus deeply and to live more like Him. A great church to be a part of.

name: New Hope Church of Christ - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love this church. There is a sense of family from the moment you walk in the door and if you arrive early enough, you can have coffee and donuts with everyone you meet. Its very laid back, It is a great place for family children, the older generation married couples.  Singles, and  babies, all are welcome including support animals🥰  *love that part*.
