name: New Hope Community Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello!  My husband and I have been attending New Hope Community Church for a little over a year now and we absolutely love being part of this wonderful community.  They also have a great Children's Ministry. My kids love going to their classrooms where they learn about Jesus, all while having fun and meeting other kids their age.

Pastor Ken speaks to us in such a way where can really bring what he is preaching about back to each of our own lives and really apply it to our own personal stories and walks with God.

I really enjoy the way he delivers each week's message.  The Bible can be very intimating when you don't understand what you are reading.  He really breaks it down well week to week and you don't leave the sermon confused or scratching your head wondering what we just talked about.  He breaks down verses and really drives each point home.  He is truly passionate about Jesus and it really shows!

I really do enjoy those my family and I have met there and the community we are getting to know there.  We continue to grow daily in our walks with God and I look forward to our Sundays at New Hope! Very friendly, Bible teaching pastor/church. All ages were welcomed, plus the music was great! Today will be my second time coming here to NHCC. The band sings and plays very well. The pastor is very passionate about the community and bringing us all closer to God. He is very engaging and I like that. If your local and decide one day to come in. I bet you'll enjoy it!!! Peace and love ❤️ My family and I visited New Hope Community Church this morning and really enjoyed the experience.  The pastor had just returned from a 2-month sabbatical, so it was nice to get to hear from him how well this local body functioned in his absence.  (SIDE NOTE:  I think that is amazing!  Even Jesus took his time in the wilderness and I think those in ministry need to take time away occasionally as well.  Kudos to New Hope for enabling that to happen for Pastor Ken!)

We were warmly welcomed by a greeter outside of the building and once inside a member of the board and praise and worship team introduced himself to our family and recognized that we were visitors.  We really appreciated the warm greetings; the first greeter even made a point to follow up with us as we left the service.  It was nice to be noticed as new and welcomed without it being overdone.

The praise and worship was really nice, the members of the team are very talented.  We enjoyed the song selection and the sincerity of the team in helping usher the congregation into the presence of the Lord.  It was refreshing to see a congregation fully engaged and active in the worship.

The message was in the book of Acts covering the encounter of Phillip and the Ethiopian Eunuch.  One of the main takeaways for our family was that sometimes God asks you to take a path, even when you do not know where that path may lead.  We are called to act in obedience and just go, trusting in the Lord.  In this case, Phillip’s obedience was an answered prayer for the Ethiopian Eunuch.  We know that this encounter helped enable the Good News to spread from Jerusalem to the continent of Africa.  This passage led wonderfully into a time of baptism for four individuals.  Being as there were baptisms, the message was short, powerful and left us wanting even more!

As the service moved into the baptisms, we heard the testimony of the four individuals that were being baptized and were truly blessed to hear how Jesus had changed their lives.  There is power in testimonies and there is no greater miracle than the transformed life through an encounter with the risen Jesus!  I commend New Hope for not rushing through the baptisms and allowing us all to hear from each of those being baptized and to be able to deeply share that experience with them, their family and friends.

Overall, our experience today was outstanding and we pray that God will continue to use this local body to reach the Gilbert community.  We whole heartedly agreed with a quote from the pastor “Found people, find people!” and we are confident that New Hope will continue to do that very thing! My children and I have been attending for 2 years now. I found this church by searching you tube sermons of local Pastors. Pastor Ken's honesty,  directness and heart for Jesus and his people brought us here. The people that attend are of all ages and welcome you with open arms. We love our Church Family

reviewSummary:

Pastor Lao and Pastor Da, the leaders of New Hope International Church in Seattle, WA, are my spiritual parents whom I love with all my heart. Their lives are faithful, righteous, honorable, and worthy of the highest respect. They are exceptional role models for a new believer like me, who made the decision to accept Jesus less than two years ago. They care for, nurture, and teach me just like family. Their profound care and concern for their members is truly beyond words; they truly possess the heart of Jesus.

I got to know other members of New Hope International Church when I attended the Revival Camp in August 2025, and they were incredibly welcoming, loving, and caring.

I also had the opportunity to visit the church and join a Bible study before my flight back to Florida. The church was nice, clean, and filled with a deep sense of peace.

Since committing to this church, my life has never been the same, thanks to the blessings that flow from God through both of them. Even though I live in Fort Myers, Florida, I consider myself their spiritual child. I join the church services online every Sunday to listen to the sermons, which are always filled with a powerful, tangible presence of God that inspires me to become a better person every single day. These blessings do not stop with me but overflow to my husband and my entire family. Praise God for this church and for the Pastors, who have transformed the lives of millions and guided them toward heaven. I truly love the Word of God shared through their sermons—it is so easy to understand and practical for daily use, filling my life with abundant joy. Thank you worshiping teams and everyone, you are done wonderful job!

Pastor Lao and Pastor Da carry a powerful anointing. Listening to their teachings has completely healed me from the chronic illnesses that once plagued my body. My husband was also completely healed from his severe back pain and insomnia. Furthermore, our marital relationship has been beautifully restored and continues to grow stronger and better every single day.

Thank God for bringing New Hope International Church into our lives through Pastor Lao and Pastor Da. We love you. I am incredibly thankful to God for New Hope International Church, and I am deeply grateful to Ps. Lao and Ps. Da for being such a tremendous blessing in my life.

I came from a Muslim background. While I was living in Arizona, I encountered the fire of the Holy Spirit at Desert Revival Church, which was under the spiritual leadership of Ps. Lao and Ps. Da. There, they became my spiritual father and mother, faithfully teaching, discipling, and helping me grow in my relationship with Jesus Christ.

Through their love, guidance, and faithful teaching of God’s Word, I received salvation and came to know the truth of God. My life has never been the same. God completely transformed my heart, giving me a deep love for Jesus and a passion to share the Gospel so that many others can come to know Him as their Lord and Savior.

Today, I live in Florida. By God’s grace, my family, our brothers and sisters in Christ, and I have started a church here under the spiritual covering and mentorship of Ps. Lao and Ps. Da. We are so thankful to God for the countless blessings we have received through New Hope International Church and their ministry.

All glory and praise belong to God. If you are looking for a church where the Holy Spirit is moving, where the Word of God is faithfully taught, and where lives are truly transformed, I wholeheartedly recommend New Hope International Church. New Hope International Church has completely transformed my life and changed my heart. Pastor Lao and Pastor Da have been an incredible blessing, and I have more testimonies than I could ever fit into one review. If you ever have the opportunity to spend time at this church, do it—you won’t regret it.

Pastor Lao is one of the most genuine Christians I’ve ever met. He faithfully teaches God’s Word, lives according to the Bible, and leads by example every single day. He is the reason I found Jesus Christ, and that decision has changed every part of my life.

I feel genuine love, kindness, and humility from everyone I meet who is part of this church. The people here don’t just talk about their faith—they live it.

If you’re looking for a church where the Bible is taught faithfully, where people truly care about one another, and where the pastor practices what he preaches, I highly recommend New Hope International Church. Pastor Lao is the kind of man you can look up to because he lives what he teaches. His humility, integrity, and love for Jesus are evident in the way he leads. That’s why my family and I trust him, and that’s why we call New Hope our church home.

Matthew Miller An Incredible, Welcoming Community!

name: New King Church
reviewSummary: New King Church is filled with wonderful people that love the Lord and love the city of Burlington. My family visited this church for a mission trip to help the church put on their 2026 VBS. It was an amazing week to see this church pouring into kids and sharing the good news of the Gospel. If you are looking for community and church that preaches the full Word of God then look no other place. The pastor and the staff are filled with the Holy Spirit and are a shining light in Burlington. Refreshing to visit a church preaching from the Bible and not cherry picking verses to suit their agenda. Nice place, seems grounded in the Word of God. New King has helped me, personally, find and start to really follow Jesus! From the day I “happened to” meet one of our pastors on a plane and he invited me to check the church out, to today over one year later, my life is totally different-in the best way! This church community is so cool and there are lots of ways to get involved and make new friends from all walks of life. I really feel at home at New King and I hope you will to - come visit on a Sunday! I know everybody here can’t wait to meet you! This is a small but growing, Christian church community that I think makes a point to place God and His Word above anything else. Since I began coming to New King, I have been blessed by its solid biblical teaching, its welcoming members and their passion to live the faith together, both truthfully and lovingly. For anyone looking for a good place to grow spiritually or just to explore who God is, this church is one you definitely need to visit! I love New King Church!! I had never been a member at a church, and didn’t understand the value of the local church until coming here. I have been attending for about a year now, and I’ve never grown so much in my intimacy with God, knowledge of His word, and in relationships with community. I’m challenged every Sunday sermon (which is a good thing!) and also love the accountability and growth that community groups foster. New King Church has also given me opportunities to do ministry and lead others to Jesus, allowing me to live out the great commission which Jesus gave his disciples. You should most definitely come check out our church and get involved in our community, we would love to have you and grow alongside you towards Christlikeness!

name: New Life Assembly of God - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Good church the messages are very good, so is the music its not to loud or a dark concert stage style like the big mega churches down the street from here are, even when you haven't been here in a while the people are always happy to see you. This is a  nice church it has so much potential to grow more. It’s sad more people have left than joined for long term. The pastor’s messages and the music is amazing at least it’s not to loud like the mega church concert style music.I would have liked to hear more of both of these two things. I think some people are use to the regular routine of how some Christian churches do things. This church does things a little differently. I had wished there were bible study groups to get involved in during the week for more connection which usually happens once a church grows with more people in it. Some of the people that left this church told me they didn’t really like the way things were ran organized here. But the messages were great so is the music. Amazing church atmosphere, everyone is very welcoming! 1st time there to see Pastor Vlad from Hungry Gen. It was an awesome experience. I would definitely go again.

name: New Life Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
We were very saddened to hear the news that the Gaskill family was leaving our church family to relocate and start a church of their own! However, Pastor Brandon and Esther are a wonderful couple who live to serve the Lord! Brandon's preaching is relatable and down to earth! Brandon would preach from various books of the bible and use analogies to things like sports, current events, and other relatable stories from his personal life. He will be a blessing for you and your family. Esther is musically gifted, and will bring joy to your worship through song. The Gaskill's have a wonderful family of children who are very sweet and well-behaved. They would often host gatherings for children of the church and welcome other children as their own! Brandon enjoys a variety of ministries including: Senior Saints, discipleship, vacation bible school, and bus ministries! Brandon and Esther enjoy spending time with couples who are new to the church to teach them about Jesus and how he can help heal families! Vermont is lucky to have them! If you are looking for a way to become part of a church family, not just a place to worship, then New Life Baptist Church is the place for you! My wife Megan and I were looking for a church while on vacation in Burlington in June of 2024.

New Life Baptist was a wonderful place to honor the Lord’s day and spend a Sunday.

Prayer, singing, scripture reading and preaching were done in a way that glorified God and Brandon demonstrated a giftedness in sharing his biblical knowledge faithfully while practically applying God’s word to 21st century America in a friendly environment.

If you are a resident of the greater Burlington region I would highly recommend this church for you and your family. I know Pastor Brandon and Esther from Lighthouse Baptist Church.  They have a heart for People. Brandon preaches great messages and Esther teaches great Bible studies. You will always learn from there messages. New Life will be a wonderful place to attend every Sunday! I have known Pastor Brandon and Esther for many years now from Lighthouse baptist church and lighthouse Christian school. Never heard a sermon from pastor Brandon that I didn’t like. They are some of the best people I know and I believe New Life is in the best hands. Brandon and Esther care about people and want to make a difference in the lives of those they serve.  They are real and down to earth, and it has been my pleasure to be part of ministries they have been involved with. I am very excited about this new church they are starting. I know it will be a blessing to the South Burlington area.

name: New Life Bible Church - Norman Campus
reviewSummary: New Life is a great church! It is relevant, relaxed, and fun. There is a great children's ministry, too. The services don't feel over produced, the pastor is engaging, and the people are real. I LOVE IT! My wife and i had been praying and searching for a church where we felt welcome, comfortable, and a pastor that taught directly from the word of God. Most importantly where we felt the very presence of our lord and savior Jesus Christ. After months of searching we were invited to nlbc and from the very first service we immediately we felt all of these things. The pastor is absolutely amazing as is his wife who preaches from time to time, they remembered our names from day one and were so welcoming we felt at home. My wife even chose to be baptized here. If you are searching for a spirit filled church to call home come by I’m so thankful that God showed me a church that was exactly I needed and close enough. Their praise and worship is exactly what God wants. You can tell that none of their pastors or leaders are serving for selfish reasons. They all want do whatever they can to share their faith with others. Attended this church with my mom, and we really enjoyed the services. I recommend this church if you're looking for fellowship, encouragement, the teaching of God's word and beautiful worship with other believers, this is the place♡♡♡ I LOVE NLBC! Jayson delivers the BEST talks, breaking down the Bible to include historical context, applicability  in today's world, and relatability. Jason rocks the service production making it an honor to serve with him!  And the band keeps the message and emotion on my mind long after the service with their awesome worship music!  My teens enjoy hanging with their friends at church and helping out with the younger kids in class. We are definitely getting spiritual nourishment at NLBC!

name: New Life Chapel - Madison Campus
reviewSummary: What a great church!  They love people and care about the community!  If you are looking for a church in Madison, AL … this is it!!! I visited here with my family on “Resurrection Day” and let me tell you how amazing it was. The worship was powerful 💥. The voices praising God in this place ushered in the presence of Holy Spirit. Btw, it was not too loud like other places I have visited. You can feel the sweetness and❤️ love of our Lord Jesus Christ as we all gathered to praise Him for the greatest gift that He has given us…and that’s eternal life.The message the Pastor shared with us was impacting and so important to hear. What a hope that our Father God gave us by giving His Son to save us. What a gift like no other gift…that Jesus gave His life for us. Do you realize what comes with that? We can live abundantly, share that light and good news with others and we can be completely set free! (Free of addictions, anxiety, sickness, depression…etc) I was happy to see that this chapel has a youth group and families on 🔥 fire for God. They hire a sheriff who is parked outside and present for everyone’s protection. It felt like home as soon as I walked in and was greeted with people sharing their smiles & joy. As my family and I left this place and walked towards our car we realized that we had just found a place where we can gather with other believers who love Jesus too! But…it’s not just a “place”…it’s a “very special place” with wonderful people who are genuine and passionate for their Lord and Savior! 🙌🏼 This is a family as well as a church!   We love our Pastors and look forward to every Sunday message!!   God bless NLC!!! Incredible church and church family. Awesome worship experience and preaching from Pastor Mike. You’ve got to check it out if you’re looking for a church in North Alabama! Awesome and friendly church, if you are in the area or live locally go check them out! Worship and preaching was amazing!

name: New Life Chapel - West Chester Campus
reviewSummary:
From the first time we walked into New Life Chapel back in 2023 , we were treated like family and felt at home.  Everyone is so warm and welcoming.  You can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit throughout NLC.

Pastor Lonnie is the real deal!!  He preaches straight out of the Bible and holds nothing back.  His messages are relatable to everyday life.  His wisdom and faith that he shares every week with the church community is phenomenal.   It’s nice to see a Pastor that loves Jesus, loves his family, loves the church, and hold the church community accountable to living the gospel out in their daily lives.  That’s almost unheard of in this day and age.  As a family, our relationship with God has grown and strengthened so much because of NLC.

NLC also offers a great Student Life every Wednesday night.  Pastor Sterling is leading the younger generation with the same fire his dad, Pastor Lonnie leads the church with.  They are truly anointed by God!

I hope you consider attending a service and checking out NLC for yourself.  Services are Sundays at 8:30am, 10:15am, and 11:45am. I grew up in church. After leaving my childhood home I ventured out to MANY churches. New Life Chapel has been the best church that I have ever been a part of. The first Sunday that I attended, I was captured by the pastor, Lonnie. He is on fire for the Lord and he brings it to the pulpit. I have now been a part of NLC for three years now. I have grown so much in the Word of God. I am no longer skeptical with “church” because I found a church that is filled with real people who love Jesus and love people. The kids program is amazing! The youth is also on fire. I’ve never seen so many young people hungry for God in a church. I serve at NLC and I absolutely love it! The staff at NLC are genuine people and so loving. I absolutely LOVE this church! Ive been in church all my life.  Ive worked in Christian radio for over 30 years.  So I know a little about church culture.  I have good relationships with leaders in the Tri-State area.  Im so grateful I was introduced to NLC.  The Word is rich.  The worship is intentional & the people treat you like family.   That's what church is all about.  I❤️NLC I’ve been attending New Life Chapel for about 8 years, and it has truly become like home. I serve in the kids ministry on Sundays, and it’s been such a rewarding experience being part of a church that invests in the next generation. The pastor does a great job of clearly teaching the Bible in a way that’s both meaningful and applicable, and the worship is always amazing and engaging. I’m really grateful to be part of this community! Our family loves New Life Chapel! We have been attending for 4 years now and cannot say enough positive things about NLC. Since attending, our daughter has given her life to Christ, we have deepened relationships that have been pivotal in our life, and we have grown so much in our personal walks with the Lord. You will always be welcomed to NLC with a smile and open arms! There is a community there for everyone in all walks of life!

Dom and Tina Vasquez I've been attending New Life Christian Center for over 20 years. Pastor Dave and his staff are the real deal. He has consistently been authentic, humble, and kind. His teachings, in addition to those of the other teachers, are always relevant, poignant, and thought-provoking. I raised my kids in this church and have been actively involved in worship ministry, as well as their faith-based recovery program, Celebrate Recovery, for years. If you are looking for a friendly church for yourself, your family, and/or your children that teaches Jesus unapologetically, I invite you to check them out! 😊 The church is nice. Parking is hard for handicap, there just isn’t enough.

We ended up sitting upstairs in the lounge. The music is so loud it literally shook the walls upstairs.

It’s hard to find a church that sings and is calm instead of screaming and having it so loud you can’t even understand what they are saying.

name: New Life Christian Church - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary: Great church, very welcoming. Our choir visited them and they even fed us after service with amazing food! Easy to spot from the street because it's on the corner. Love this church with friendly wonderful people, this is multy languaged church, when you decide to visitsit this church, you can request a radio earpiece, to hear the sermon in English language. Great church. English speakers can request translating device. The church is welcoming to visitors. God bless this Church 🙏🙏🙏🙋‍♂️ A quaint little church, with Ukranian / Russian speaking members.

name: New Life Christian Church - Newtown Township Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church! The spiritual message is based on God’s word, and the Spirit is strong here. Wonderful people are a bonus. My family and I have been attending this church for over 20 years, and I would like to clear the air based on the 1 poor review written (out of 2 other 5 star reviews). New Life Christian Church has been nothing but honest and supportive. Pastor Norm and the faculty make it a point to be invested in each attendee and are always giving of their time, love, and funds. After attending this church, it's hard to find any other congregation as personal and uplifting. I can say with pride that this place has changed my life. Pastor Norm's services leave you with a clear understanding of the scripture and personally touched. Because of this church I have a deeper understanding and closer relationship with God. The church is so kind and welcoming that they become your second family. I always leave service feeling positive and having the desire to make a difference in Jesus's name. They're re-enactment dramas give you a different and personal view of the scripture and are widely attended. I have never felt or heard of any negativity going on within the church. I would highly recommend this amazing congregation to anyone who is looking for a new place of worship. By just attending one service, you will want to come back again and again. I miss going to New Life. My memories of going there are great ones. Pastor Norm is a great pastor. I hope he's doing well. My daughter went to preschool there and it was a great experience for her. I haven't been to church in years and actually thinking of going back. God Bless! Wonderful Church, Pastor & staff; just so kind & loving. Those in the pews are pretty great too! Go! Go and hear the truth of the Gospel & be blessed. They also hold many outside functions, ie, day trips, picnics & so on. Such loving people that were there for me on a most horrible day & they'll be there for you too! I was baptised there many years ago and the members and pastor were GREAT. now I live in SC. God bless you all. Roy Murphy

name: New Life Christian Fellowship - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church. Pastor Zink preaches good messages. He just doesn’t offer for anyone to come and get saved, healed or baptized in the Holy Spirit with evidence of speaking in tongues. This is a spectacular Christian church that offers services in English with Spanish translation. The people are very kind and welcoming, and there are many activities for the whole family. It’s a wonderful place to grow in faith and community. A very warm and welcoming church. Pastor is spot on. We visit every time we're in Jacksonville. Go east on Beach Blvd, turn left at light. Destination on right. Main entry leads to sanctuary. Signage for office and school clearly marked. New life is a phenomenal place to fellowship. Learning levels for all ages. The people are always welcoming. The unadulterated Word is taught, and worship is genuine!

name: New Life Christian Fellowship - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary: We were new in town and felt the love of Christ in this church on our first Sunday there and it has continued. We love that they also show God's love in the community through different ministries. They live out the two greatest commandments - to love God and love people. From day one, I've had an abundance of support. Counseling, medical help, food, clothing, hygiene, bedding and toiletries. Everyone is amazing and caring. The love is felt upon arrival. The emotional support is awesome. Thank you New Life Christian Fellowship Church. God bless you! I am from South Africa and had moved to Petaluma in 2018. The very first thing I knew I needed, in very different culture, was a spiritual home. I had come from an extremely religious Christian upbringing and was so deeply involved with my church ministries back home, that I believed the only way I'd navigate an entirely new country was with a strong support system around me and a spiritual family. I found my fellow brothers and sisters at New Life. They welcomed me with open arms, spoke with me at every service, took me on a tour of the church and introduced me to more people. This might not seem like much now, but to a young Indian woman alone in a new country, it meant everything. Other people from church my age would text me during the week just to check up on me. I felt the love. I felt home, even though I was thousands of miles away from my family. I am back in my home country now, but I think about the kindness and love of the people at New Life. I will visit again, just to thank them for what they did for my happiness and for welcoming me with so much love. #Godswork This church is amazing. My family and I just went here last Sunday and I already feel like I'm at home. The people are so nice and so warm and welcoming. I gave this 10 Stars.  the pastor's preaching is amazing👍😊 Church just doesn’t get better than this!! Best message, comfortable and an incredible church family that always goes out of their way to make you feel welcome.  Bring your coffee and join in!

name: New Life Church
reviewSummary:
If you feel empty and need spiritual healing  this is your church.  Everyone is very friendly and they don’t push.  You walk at your pace and help is always available My experience at New Life was great even before I walked in the door. I was greeted with smiling faces and was politely escorted to a seat. The worship was electrifying you could tell they were filled with the Holy Spirit. The sermon was engaging and just about everything they preach could be found in the Bible. All in all a great way to spend your Sunday morning. We LOVE New Life Church!!! This has been our church home for over 15 years. NLC is a non- denominational multicultural and multi-generational church.
We were first drawn to NLC because of how Pastor Mark and Dee Mckinney teach the word. Being a interracial family we loved how every culture is welcomed and celebrated. During our last Nations Day we had over  27 counties represented!
If you have children or teens we have classes where our youth ministry teach your children the bible and the love of God on their level during Sunday morning services 9am and 11am and Wednesday evening bible study.
Our NLC family have been there at each stage of our life over the years including Pastors coming to the hospital to sit with my family when I had surgery. If your wondering there is no dress code here.  There are people who wear suits & dresses and people who wear jeans and t-shirts. What ever your style is come comfortable with an open heart, ready to recieve the Word explained in a real life application.  If you are looking for a new church please come visit we will make you feel right at home. My husband and I recently started attending this church. I really enjoy the Biblical teaching As part of their outreach to the community they host a AARP Tax-Aide site.

name: New Life Church
reviewSummary:
My home church since I moved to s.f. Great people who love Jesus and believe in preaching and living according to what the Bible says. Come and visit us and have a coffee and conversation with someone in our amazing café. Been going to New Life Church for about 8 years. It doesn't feel like church, it feels like family. Pastor Alex speaks the truth (from the Bible) in love. They have a great Kids program. And they have several kinds of Small groups. I sat there watching and listening as he spoke harshly about local shelters and down upon homeless, phrasing it "full of addicts, chaos and no peace" - as if ALL homeless are bad, mentally ill low-lifes.
He offered NOTHING positive to say about the SERVICE the shelters provide to shelter and feed people in need.
Many of the women WHERE I LIVE IN A HOMELESS SHELTER are there to ESCAPE the "chaos and no peace" of homes - homes that you PREACH are so much better than the drug addled shelters.
I sat there hoping he'd turn it around and recognize some good, nope...
I sat there listening to his entire critical, judgemental, condescending, belittling sermon about homeless shelters WHERE I LIVE, - a non-addict who happened to end up in the shelter by a serious of unfortunate events.
I have no criminal nor drug background, as same for many other homeless.
As a matter of fact, I am a Substitute Teacher here in Sioux Falls. - Thank God the school district didn't look down upon me during the hiring process. In fact, they were HAPPY TO EMPLOY THIS HOMELESS PERSON

The shelter where I live, in FACT, is not full of "chaos". While there are occasional moments of drama, for the most part it is peaceful.  I dare say, this shelter may be more clean, less chaotic  and more peaceful than some of the homes of your congregation.

The audacity of a man to preach such declarative broad-sweeping negative statements. Not very Jesus-like. Praise God and Hallelujah you're not living in a homeless shelter, hm? - Maybe passive-aggressive or gossipy of me to post this here instead of talking to you directly. But a. I was upset And b. It's apparent your closed-minded judgement wouldn't magically be swayed by anything I say. - That's between you and God to be enlightened.

ps)Guess who parks his cybertruck smack at the front door ea Sun. hint: he ain't Jesus I’ve been attending this church for about 2 months. After the very first service I went to I realized I found what I’ve been looking for. I really enjoy this church because Pastor Alex makes the sermons easy to follow, and he always keeps things interesting. His teachings feel very true and meaningful to me, and I appreciate that he teaches in a way that helps me learn. For me, church is about learning and Pastor Alex excels at communicating and sharing the word of God in a way that is easy to understand and there’s no sugar coating. He says it how it is!! I look forward to learning something new every Sunday and his passion is contagious!
The church itself feels warm and is full of nice, welcoming people.

I also want to add that I read previous reviews about this church and people had concerns about the fog machine/strobe lights and they no longer use those since I’ve been attending. Which I think is great that the church listened to those comments. Love this church!! The atmosphere here is so amazing! The leaders and pastors are amazing! The preaching is on point! Such a great church to be apart of!! Anytime I walk into new life church I greeted with a smile! 🙌🏻🤍

name: New Life Church
reviewSummary: Flagship northern Colorado Springs campus on Voyager Parkway. Internationally recognized for vibrant worship music (New Life Worship), passionate biblical teaching, and extensive NextGen ministries.

name: New Life Church - Alamo Campus - Danville Campus
reviewSummary:
I can’t say enough great things about New Life Church. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with genuine warmth and a sense of community that’s hard to find. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed, whether you’ve been going to church your whole life or you’re just checking it out for the first time.
The teaching is engaging, practical, and rooted in truth—you can tell there’s a real desire to help people grow in their faith and apply it to everyday life. The worship is uplifting and creates a meaningful space to connect with God.
One of the things that stands out most is how intentional the church is about relationships. There are great opportunities to get connected, and it truly feels like a place where people care about each other beyond just Sunday mornings.
If you’re looking for a church that is authentic, encouraging, and focused on helping people take their next step, New Life Church is an amazing place to be. Highly recommend! Right from the first day my family and I stepped into the church, it has been a wonderful experience. The pastors and staff are friendly and the volunteers take their time to make everyone feel welcome.

There is a ministry dedicated for a variety of uses, children's ministry, young adults, youth, Celebrate Recovery just to mention a few. There are small groups for different age or group dynamics so there is really something for everyone. The worship atmosphere is Heaven and God focused, and the teaching is always on life applications.

This is definitely a place to visit and belong. New Life Church in Alamo has been an incredible blessing for our entire family. From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed and right at home. This church truly embodies strong family values, with a Christ-centered foundation built on biblical principles.

The children’s ministry and daycare are amazing — not only are they safe and well-organized, but the kids are genuinely learning about Jesus in a fun and engaging way. It gives us so much peace knowing our children are growing spiritually in such a loving environment. Renee has been an inspiration in children ministry and women’s bible studies, Gina is a sweetheart and also Carrie.
Our family went through a horrible time a couple of years ago, having a child sick and spent 40+ days in the hospital, our church family was there from day one, they visited us at the hospital and prayed with us. The whole team even did video zoom with us to pray for us, and even they prepared a meal train for us. Jazmin in the children ministry became a good friend since we found New Life and was so kind to call me as soon as she found out and regularly after that  and a lot of people checked on us and prayed.
Personally, I’ve found so much encouragement and growth through the women’s group and Bible studies. It’s been powerful to connect with other women who are passionate about their faith and lifting each other up. Even my husband, who was once more reserved spiritually, has grown so much through the men’s group and connection with our pastors especially with Pastor Ben and many friends he’s made there. Seeing him draw closer to God has been such a blessing to our marriage and family.

New Life Church isn’t just a place we go to on Sundays — it’s truly become our home. We’re so grateful to be part of this amazing community! New Life is great the greeters and all the staff that run this place every Sunday are so wholesome and nice and welcoming. My family and I love this church and come every Sunday, we encourage people to come here and celebrate Jesus Christ because he is definitely here at this church guiding me and my family through life. 🙏🏼🙏🏼❤️ God is with you here! I met Jim last year. He invited me and I didn't go. I'm still searching for God. He picked me up at 1am and invited me again. IM GOING TOMORROW

name: New Life Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been a believer since I was 4 years old.  I am now 58.   For most of that time I believed in, had a “relationship” with a God who I believed I would never be good enough for, kind of the “whack a mole game” God where He was ready to whack me in the head as it were, when I consistently didn’t follow the game plan He set out in the Bible.   God has led me through the loss of important people in my life to question that mind set, then with the birth and growth of my son, to help me understand what the father/child concept could look like.   As a very faulty father, I am grateful to have a Father who is perfect, unlike me, dependable always, unlike me, strong and powerful always, unlike me, BUT, who understands me and doesn’t complain about not having a child specific guidebook on raising children because He is the guide.

I write all of this as foundation to where New Life fits in.   For the first time since Junior High/highschool, when I came to New Life (started at New Life Friday Night),   I felt challenged to explore who God wanted me to understand Him to be without a preconceived set of preset parameters for God to fit in. I feel God challenging me to find ways (due to my irregular and overactive work schedule) to come back because of their challenge to learn to worship in new ways and their allowing God to present His message in new clear ways through them.   I have been touched by the personable ways they are willing to communicate with the “common” worshipper.   Is this a perfect church?  No, but they allow themselves to use the heartaches and life lessons they encounter as warnings and life lessons so they will continually move to become His family in the ways He wants them to be.   If you are looking for a perfect church, as soon as you walk in it will be imperfect.

That being said, if you are looking for a place to learn what family relationship with God means from the Bible and how that will impact your life, IF you allow it to…..start your journey here…..as soon as possible!!!

I expectantly look forward to spending time with the only Father I have left on this earth every time I enter the doors of one of the service options at New Life Church… because I feel safe to do that here. Praise and worship is excellent.  Sermons are on point except for the attempted comedy during the messages.  Definitely feel the Holy Spirit at work in the church at times.

The church congregation
is rather clicky, feels like high school. Other than the greeting of people during the service, most people stick to and only speak with the people they know.  Almost looking through you to get to the one they know.  It’s just not a welcoming church …. I’ve attended for years and literally still feel isolated in church.  Thank God, He is all I need This place is absolutely unbelievable. I actually had to file a complaint with the city because the noise on Tuesday night was completely out of control. My kids couldn't even sleep, and for some context—we live several miles away and could still hear the music from inside our house. There is a difference between hosting an event and having absolutely no consideration for the surrounding community. If people living miles away are being kept awake, you've clearly gone way too far. Putting this review here so it is dated.  We loved this church when it was lead by Brady.  The children’s program is amazing, the worship was amazing and the preaching was humble and God inspired.

Since he was kicked out by those he called friends, the worship continues to skew more and more towards full on Pentecostal, many guest speakers have been brought in to praise the new lead pastor and direct the church towards a what I see being a forced and man lead “revival”.

The new lead pastor was already our least favorite of all the pastors available and is showy, uses God and crosses himself for humor.  Changes the ending of “And all Gods people said:” from “Amen” to “Wow!” “Oh My Gosh!” and other phrases that don’t feel God honoring.  He cries on cue at least 1 x on Friday and 2 x every Sunday, brags about his holiness, seems to have never made a lunch for his wife and we are thankful and look forward to any Sunday there is a guest speaker.  We also know the guest speaker will have a few PR phrases like: “I love your pastor!”  “You have such an amazing pastor!” “Your church is blessed to be lead by this pastor”, etc!  It’s almost like it is written into the guest speaker contract: “Be sure to praise our lead pastor during your sermon and assure everyone about him.”

This church is 0/2 on handling lead pastor transitions well.  The first was a tough one, but the second one feels a lot more like a purposeful and spiteful betrayal of someone they all called friend and who thought they were friends.  Only time will tell how the transition from lead pastor #3 to #4 will go. I am hopeful it will happen sooner rather than later. Good people who are severely misguided as to what Christianity is. This is all a performance and a show, every weekend. Keep the folks entertained and make sure they feel good about themselves.

This is a concert venue with Christian semantics. I believe there are good people here as I said, but I don’t believe union with our God is found here.

As with all “non denom” churches they make communion a mockery and a joke, they make the focus the music, they have a massive stage, the cross is in the corner, they have “worship” rock concerts, and it’s never about Christ. The sermons have more to do with the pastors stories than how we can seek union with the Lord.

I never heard the topic of humility preached here a single time. That is the single most important trait of a Christian.

God works in mysterious ways and I’m blessed to have gone here for a good amount of time when I was severely confused in my faith and diving back into it, but I couldn’t recommend it less if you are searching for a church.

The people have pretense and are loving and welcoming only for show. There’s gossip, drama, and constant issues at this church. Their doctrine is flawed and missing the majority of the religion that Christ founded through the apostles.

They also covered up some seriously questionable scandals and seemingly have no remorse, just coverups. Virtue signaling is their superpower.

God bless you and all reading this, but please consider coming to visit Christ’s true Church (Orthodoxy) ☦️ at least read into the history and decide for yourself before you indulge in such a mockery of the faith at New Life “church”!

name: New Life Church - Conway Campus
reviewSummary: SOLO is something I was invited to by Jacque Coleman.  I enjoyed myself the food fellowship and the Word keeps bringing me back each month!! The director  I forget her name has a heart of gold. Also the pastor and his wife are outstanding.  Hospitality is above and beyond I have so many great things to say about this church! I’ll start off by saying I had moved to Arkansas and decided it was time to reconnect with the Lord. It had been more than a decade since I’ve been to church so I was a little nervous on how my experience would go. I went one day alone and I knew this is where I wanted to keep going. The most incredible life-giving church I’ve ever seen. The college degrees they offer there are pretty dope too.

name: New Life Church - Corona Campus
New Life Church - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary: New life church is a spiritual home for me. Brothers and sisters are so supportive and connect with each other closely. It is always the best time to worship in church every Sunday and have other gathering during the week. May God bless more people to find a spiritual home here! We love this church! From the first moment we came here, we were delighted by the warm atmosphere, the amazing people and the diversity of the congregation. What we like about New Life Church is that it's a community of genuine people and compassionate Christians who do not put on a show, but are authentic believers. The facilities are very beautiful, both indoors and outdoors, especially when decorated for events. New Life Church is welcoming and diverse community. The uplifting sermons and heartfelt worship create a warm, inspiring atmosphere. It's a wonderful place for spiritual growth and to meet great people. Loving Environment. name: New Life Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I were going to this church for a couple years. Sometimes On and off due to work but we loved it. Pastor Bret, pastor Ron and the prayer team are amazing. My youngest has autism and the childcare was very supportive of him, he wasn’t disruptive. To our knowledge the care team didn’t have any issues with him unless he needed diaper change, but one day came where our son didn’t want to go to the 6year old and up room. He was 6 at the time, he was just uncomfortable with the idea and having a meltdown. A beautiful lady up front told us it was fine for him to go in the 5 year old room and it should be fine. Well, my wife asked the teachers if she could stay there for a little while to observe him and make sure he does ok. They said it was up to Emily and they didn’t see anything wrong with it since it was just a few mins. After a few minutes, Emily came in and told my wife he could not be there and she wasn’t amused that they were in that room. My wife explained it was hard for him and she didn’t understand. She does know his condition by the way and had for a few years up to that point.I wasn’t present at the moment this happened I was in the dome. She expressed discomfort and waited in the car with until service was over. I thought this could be a misunderstanding so I thought maybe I could wait this out. After about a week or two of going another member who saw my family go came and told me “ hey where is your wife and kids? I haven’t seen them in awhile!” I told her the situation and said that everyone’s welcomed at new life church. This brought joy to me because well maybe we could bridge this misunderstanding and we could be part of the church again. After a week of that encounter I was very motivated to go back, there was interaction with the audience in which I took part in speaking and everyone clapped, it really made me feel great. There was interactions, they were about to clear out this misunderstanding and everything would go back to normal. After that Wednesdays sermon she had came back applauding the interaction but apologizing saying “ I’m sorry I thought Emely said your son COULD come, but she said he COULDNT” my heart was shattered. I had gotten an answer, not the one I wanted but it was the answer. I’ll repeat, the church is amazing. Without a doubt pastor Bret and pastor Ron are anointed, their messages are always so on point. I will miss it along with the members that I talked to and the interactions we’ve had my family and the church. But I just sincerely do not feel welcomed. I direct individuals without children here but to those with and especially any with special needs just a heads up with this experience. God bless you all, thank you for the support when I went there. I really truly do love you guys but I did feel I needed to share this. I will add prior to this there was no issues but unfortunately this happened. I barely could discipline myself to get to church today and when I did the lady at the door forbade me of bringing a Diet Pepsi bottle with a cap. Never in all my years of attending church have I had a single problem bringing in a bottled drink.

Ironically, they were doing a message about the law today (after the offering message they do to use the scriptures to coerce people to tithe…. Like if God moves people to give does He need a coercive message?) and I found that funny: thou shalt not bring a sealed bottle of Diet Pepsi to church).

I can bring it into banks, other churches, police stations, government offices, but lo and behold a lady actually wouldn’t let me into church because I had it. It’s not rocket science, you shouldn’t turn people away from church for having a Diet Pepsi… you should welcome them. She literally said, “it’s because they don’t want to get the carpet stained… like seriously? They even offer candy in the restrooms (that can also stain and get stuck to their precious carpet!) I am unhappy about my church outing to get interrupted over a Diet Pepsi.

How can one think that Satan isn’t hanging out at the very doors of this church through some of its members who manufacture irrelevant issues that could not possibly be as  important as someone getting to church. They were even doing communion.

Anyway, whether you enjoy Diet Pepsi or not, do take note of their “offering messages”… listen to them from week to week and make sure you GIVE…. You will reap that harvest for sure! So get that wallet out NOW and sow that SEED…. I went there for 10 years. Life changing experience. I miss Dusty Kemp and will never forget him and his family and the church..I'm praying to come back and visit. I love you all. God bless you. My fiance Luis and I love this place... The spirit of the Lord is here! There is a strong sense of family here. The leaders put a good accent on our spiritual growth, with Christian foundation teachings. The services are always Spirit led and that's awesome. I love the ethnic mixture here as well.

Pastors are very thoughtful, caring, and gospel-centered. Highly recommend! Sweet worship and warmest folks will beckon you into this place

name: New Life Church - Kearney Campus
New Life Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
There's a couple of things you need to watch out for at this church one is at the head of big major youth event at this church but there was so many unbilical things going on there for one the person who was preaching was just screaming and yelling the entire time. And then some crazy lady started speaking in gibberish and said she calls upon the spirit of tongues which we all know is unbiblical and wrong. They also have some person who pretends to speak in tongues but it's always right after worship and it's always the same person who so-called translates for him.

Another thing is they have a missionary organization called youth with a mission that is stationed at the church. And I just recently found out there was an arrangement between the pastor and the director of this organization. This arrangement was completely unbiblical and goes against everything that God has taught us to do. They've decided to completely closed any opportunity for God to move with the church and this missionary organization together. The director of the base and the pastor of this church decided that nobody from the organization can ever come up in the church and preach or share their testimony. They completely cut off any tie with the church and the organization whose sole purpose is to disciple the Nations. Why the church and the director of that organization would do such a thing I will never fully understand but I know it goes against the will of God. This is a very real church focused on Biblical teachings and relationship development with one another. It’s the closest church environment I have seen that represents a first century church as established by Jesus and the Apostles. It’s a very encouraging and uplifting place to be around. We attended The Secret Keeper Girl event here. The church had converted both restrooms to female restrooms for the event which was so smart! Clean facility with very welcoming staff. This is a super awesome place to get your worship on and hear/learn the Word of God! The way that Pastor Tim and the Pastoral staff deliver messages week in and week out is truly a blessing. I love how they don't sugarcoat anything, they are down to earth people, and love the congregation! Our Life Group is also amazing! My family drive almost an hour to this church because it is awesome and where we are supposed to be. If you are in the Louisville area and want to experience church as it is supposed to be, check out New Life Church of Louisville! I walked into this place as a skeptic in church and religion altogether. In the years I’ve spent here, I’ve been given the tools to truly connect with God, I’m continuing to learn who he is, and heal of things I thought were hopelessly stuck to me forever.

It’s not about theatrics and religious/political correctness here. It’s about seeking truth, learning how to do that for yourself, and living out the freedom that comes with those things. I can’t appreciate the beautiful people in this building more❤️

Also I really appreciate the scientific and historic support that’s offered in almost every message🙌

name: New Life Church - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary: Great I loved the people and the service great warm environment and facility A church that fosters meaningful, lasting personal connections, with inspiring sermons and powerful prayer services. -Edith We were so delighted to meet this wonderful Church and left the service with a great and we were positively and optimistically inspired. Thank you so much Pastor Debi. We definitely want to come back thanks of your amazing energy and spiritual messages. 🙏 The Saturday prayer service and the empathy of Pastor Debi helped me tremendously during the time my brother was in Hospice. name: New Life Church - Novato Campus
reviewSummary:
New Life Church has been a really welcoming place for our family. The teaching is thoughtful and rooted in Scripture, and the messages are practical for everyday life, not just theoretical. We’ve appreciated how the sermons challenge you to grow while still pointing back to grace and the heart of the Gospel.

The community has been warm and genuine, and it feels like a church that is focused on both spiritual growth and healthy relationships. If you’re looking for a place where you can engage with the Bible and also feel part of a caring community, this is definitely worth visiting. I love the teaching, discipleship, worship, and diversity at NLC. I still remember walking into a small group and being met with warm welcomes and a community that soon became a second family to me. So thankful for an amazing church in Marin & Sonoma County. The live stream is also AMAZING. Highly recommended! In my opinion, from my experience and involvement a few of the leadership talk a good talk but the walk doesn’t match the talk. The Bible clearly states how as Christians we are to conduct ourselves,  treat/love all people and how we are to treat our brothers in Christ.

Reply to Pastor Caleb,

Thank you for responding.

name: New Life Church - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I began attending New Life Church in July 2016 and the second we were introduced to this church family, our lives were forever changed! We felt welcomed by everybody we met, instantly like we belonged. The connections pastor visited our house to introduce himself in person and invite us to a Connect Lunch to get to know the rest of the church staff. The message each week is both biblical and easy to relate to. Our daughters love going to church on Sundays and Wednesdays to participate in the youth classes and activities! As someone who didn’t grow up regularly attending church, I didn’t know what to expect when we walked through those doors - but I can undoubtedly say it was the best decision we ever made to attend Sunday service that Sunday in July; we’ve been there every Sunday since and will continue to going forward! Thank you New Life for welcoming us with open arms and being a part of not only my life, but my families lives as well!! We are forever grateful! We love New Life. They have done a great job of welcoming our family, and the worship music is awesome. Always moving around with the military makes it difficult to find a church, but we have always felt at home. They have connect lunches where we got a chance to meet the pastor and staff, and there are many opportunities to get involved. The pastor has always checked in on us and made us feel welcomed. Definitely would recommend New Life!! We are so thankful for New Life! Since the first Sunday we visited the church it has been a wonderful fit for our family! Pastoral team are caring, welcoming, and make an effort to get to know you and your family. Again, we are thankful and blessed to be a part of New Life’s family! Amazing young adult group! Everyone is extremely welcoming, they’re passionate about the Lord, and they do alot of fun stuff together :) Sermons on Sundays appear very bibically based. Kudos to the minister he apparently does some research and delivers concrete material. As far as the internal mechanics of the workings of the church, it is very apparent that it's driven by the "minister/ wife" team, more emphasis on the wife. I have gone to this church on several occasions and still have not met the "pastor" one on one. He tends to sermonize and that's it. The wife appears to be the star of the show. There is a very strong arm against outsiders. So, with that said. is this really a church where a community of believers can come together to share and grow. Not so sure.

name: New Life Church, Gahanna Campus - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary:
i love new life! i’ve gone here for pretty much my entire life and im so blessed to have been here. i love leading worship both on the high school team and the adult worship team! i also love how many different ways you can serve here! my favorite part of new life is the high school youth group. i’ve met so many wonderful friends of mine through renew and i love the youth pastor as well! this year i also went to Costa Rica with the students group and that was such a good experience! new life is truly such a great church and everyone i’ve connected with has been such a blessing When I first moved to Columbus, I was searching for a Pentecostal church but struggled to find one nearby. A friend invited me to New Life Church in Gahanna, and from my very first visit I felt something different. I was immediately welcomed and treated like family. My first experience there was filled with genuine love, warmth, and acceptance.

After attending the New Life Class, I was able to learn more about the church’s mission and heart for the community. That experience helped me decide to officially join the church. Since then, I’ve been baptized there and later even married there, which makes New Life incredibly special to me.

The pastors are engaging, fun, and deeply compassionate. They are passionate about teaching the Word while still being relatable and approachable.

Today, I serve in New Life’s Café and regularly attend a small group, which has helped me build meaningful relationships and grow spiritually. The sense of community here is truly what made me stay. I’ve never experienced a church community quite like this one before.

If you’re looking for a church where you feel welcomed, supported, and connected, New Life is a wonderful place to be. Great church. The people are warm and friendly. We have been committed to New Life Church for 5 years now, and for a number of reasons.  We grow closer to Jesus here. We encounter the gospel every single week in both the preaching and in the community.  People and staff are not too busy for you either.  I highly recommend! Great church. Love the messages. The pastor impressed me only come when I am visiting my sister he remembers me what I had been through the past year. Only have talked to him a couple of times. This is a church home that cares about people.

name: New Life Community Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been coming here since September. Pastor Tom preaches from a biblical perspective in a way that is easy to follow and understand. We have grown a lot in our walk with the Lord since we started coming here. My wife and I have both been baptized here and we are excited to come every Sunday to continue our journey! Every time I have attended a Sunday service at this church, I have left more frustrated than when I arrived. After multiple visits over the years, my concerns haven’t changed, they’ve only become clearer. The Pulpit here feels more like a feel good ego booster than a place of Biblical Authority and Accountability.

Topical preaching, as it is consistently delivered here, feels shallow and misaligned with what people truly need in this season. We are living in a time where the world is loud, chaotic, and spiritually heavy. Scripture makes it clear that we are in a battle, not against flesh and blood (Ephesians 6:12) and people are walking into church desperate for truth, clarity, and spiritual equipping. Instead, the messages often revolve around surface-level topics like saving money, managing anxiety, or even personal anecdotes that feel disconnected from the weight of what believers are facing.

There is a real hunger right now for solid, biblical teaching. People are not just looking for encouragement, they are looking for transformation through The Word of God. With biblical literacy at an all-time low, the responsibility of a pastor is not to entertain or lightly motivate, but to teach, correct, and equip (2 Timothy 3:16–17). I have yet to hear a message here from Pastor Tom that reflects the depth, authority, or conviction that pastoral leadership requires.

1 Timothy 3 lays out clear qualifications for church leaders: self-controlled, respectable, able to teach, and above reproach. Leadership in the church is not a platform for personal preferences or casual storytelling, it is a calling that demands humility and accountability. John 3:30 reminds us, “He must increase, but I must decrease.” When that posture is missing, it shows.

At any given moment, someone can walk through those doors completely broken, searching for something real, something eternal. That is not a small responsibility. That is a weight pastors are called to carry with reverence and seriousness. Messages should point people to Christ, confront sin, strengthen faith, and prepare believers to stand firm in a spiritually dark world, not simply offer life tips or light encouragement.

After giving this church chance after chance since 2021, I can confidently say this is not a place where I have found that kind of leadership or teaching. It often feels like there is more emphasis on comfort than conviction, and more desire for agreement than accountability.

My prayer is that leadership takes a step back, examines Scripture honestly, and realigns with what biblical shepherding is truly meant to be. The church is too important, and the times we are living in are too serious, for anything less. The people of this Church should become familiar with James 2:2-4
"For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment; and ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool: are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?"

You should treat strangers that walk into your Church with kindness and humility. Not like we're criminals for being delivery workers with Brown Skin. I'm disappointed in you brothers and sisters. I'll pray that Christ gives you grace to love your neighbors as you love yourselves. Church Leaders should reflect the laws of God and especially the Royal Law. You have much to learn before you attempt to teach others. Take that log out brothers your time to do so is running short. God be with you Been going here for many years. The lead Pastor is one of the best. Biblically accurate and his sermons are not boring. Very inviting environment and filled with loving and very welcoming people. They have a clear message when preaching and very good songs of worship. They are a medium sized church with no mega church vibe. Never left a review on a church before but this experience was worth giving to someone else who may be reading this and wondering if they should attend. Highly recommend, especially if you are looking for a new church to attend or seek the word of God.

reviewSummary: Great group of people. Enjoyed the meet and greet with Texas Senatorial candidate Beto O'rourke. Super intelligent and dynamic preacher. The staff is exceptionally nice. name: New Life Community Church (NLCC) - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been going to NLCC for about 2 months now and I consider this my church. I've connected with such friendly people. Pastor Luis really breaks down each passage of scripture which helps me personally understand the word more and I appreciate that. Thank you! A pastor that's down to earth.....such a blessing. He's approachable. This is a Bible Church that has a great Sunday school class, (Pastor Mark is awesome) They don't push tithing either, which is good. It helps me to be able to give  when and how much I can. I'm just so grateful that I found a church that is so welcoming and loving, plus it's bilingual! Everyone is welcome! It was so pretty to see the flowers bloomed today. 🌼 Quaint and devout Church. Very welcoming and Pastor Brian is tremendous. They also don't push tithing like many other churches do. A collection Dropbox stays at the front and you can just give as you want/are able. Take notes Impact Church!

Besides this, the message from Pastor Brian is consistently biblical and wise.  More Sermon in the "Sermon-to-Song" ratio than many Churches, if you prefer that (as I do). Thorough biblical teaching and the leaders have humble hearts. The community is open and very inclusive- you become a member of this family quickly. The bible studies will change your life! I personally moved to Arizona two years ago without knowing anyone and found this church accidentally- I am so thankful that I did. I have a family here that challenges me and supports me. I could not be more grateful for this church. I haven't been to church in a long time and I felt so welcomed when I arrived with my wife The pastor has no faith/belief in what he preaches. He's in it for the money.

reviewSummary:
Wonderful church! Awesome kids ministry and they do an outstanding job of offering the best Vacation Bible School & Harvest Festival for kids. Nice, welcoming people with a heart for sharing the gospel and proclaiming Jesus Christ as Savior. Highly recommend this church if you live in the South Bay and want to develop a more intimate relationship with Jesus! Come as you are all is welcome and you can feel it. Pastor Mays all you have to do is call and he there.  God is taking us at NLCCSOCAL to a higher level am ready. name: New Life Community Church East Humboldt Park - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary: I moved to Chicago in July of 2019 and honestly the best church I have attended. From day one, I was welcomed as family and plugged into a small group right away. The people in my small group have become my closest friends and family. Also, pastor Danny is amazing! One of the kindest, most passionate and caring people I know. You will not regret coming to service I've been attending this church a month after they first opened here in the Logan Square area and my life has not been the same since. My family and I were welcomed in by everyone including the pastor, Danny Lopez and his wife Cyrene. I consider everyone here more like family because that's what it feels like, it feels like home. Members are warm and genuine and you can definitely feel the love and presence of Christ in their hugs prayers and service. Pastor Danny Lopez has such passion and love for God and His people. You can see the evidence of this in the way he shares the Gospel and the awesome way he teaches us through the Word  and prayer, that we can have a more intimate relationship with Jesus. His strong conviction and intentionality challenges me and my family to  apply the Word of God to our everyday lives. He is the real deal and I praise God for him and this church. I have been attending,  New Life Community Church, Logan  Square campus for a while and since day one,  this powerful group of people (starting with Pastor Danny,  his wife,  the Hospitality Team, The Worship Team, The Greeters, to the congregation) not only made me feel welcomed but loved and genuinely cared for! For 3 years prior to coming to Logan Square campus, I belonged to another well known, Christian church on the Northside. Never really seen nor heard. No one knew my name. This was not  the case in Logan Square. The presence  of the Lord is clearly felt in this place.  Pastor Danny is a true vessel used by God. I highly reccomend this place of worship to anyone looking for a church. You  will walk away knowing you were in the right place. Bible believing church teaching how to develop a strong relationship with Christ. I visited this church and kept coming back. I joined Spring of 2019 and it's like home. Family atmosphere, friendly and welcoming members and a dynamic Pastor.  The Pastor and his wife show genuine interest and compassion for all who come through the doors. After visiting a few churches for a few months last year we found New Life Logan Sq and immediately felt at home. I’ve never felt so seen and heard in a church the way I do here. The first moment I walked In I was greeted with a warm hug and a friendly smile. It felt as if we’ve been attending for years. We immediately joined a Small Group with a group of amazing talented people, they’ve become such a huge part of our lives and we haven’t even made a full year at NL yet! We had a hard holiday season with a loss in the family and Pastor Danny reached out to us via a phone call and led us in prayer, that was such an eye opening experience for us, to really see the Holy Spirit move in and throughout the church. I can’t wait to see all that New Life Logan Square will do for our community!

reviewSummary:
This church was home for me in Chicago for 3 years and I never found more genuinely loving kind and compassionate followers of Jesus. Those who model what it truly means to serve and be the hands and feet of Christ in Humboldt Park. I was blessed to be surrounded by people of all ages and gender worshipping our Savior and spurred on to follow Christ! A great place to fellowship and call home 🤍 Attended this church last Sunday , & God knew this was my calling. I fell more than in love with this church. I also enjoy that the church is diverse - there are different individuals of race,

A wonderful and genuine community. The love this church has for people is so obvious and infectious. If you are looking for wise teaching, inspiring worship, and a place to be seen and welcomed in, you would be hard-pressed to find a better place to call home.
