Fantastic, spirit filled meetings I'm quite biased but, I love NLE.

name: New Life Family Church - McAllen Campus
reviewSummary:
Finding a church home can be a journey, but from the moment you step through the doors of New Life Family Church, you experience the tangible presence of the Holy Spirit. This isn't just a building where people gather on Sundays; it is a vibrant, Christ-centered community where the Word of God is preached with uncompromised truth and deep love.

​The leadership and congregation embody the hands and feet of Jesus, welcoming everyone with open arms and authentic kindness. The worship is powerful and spirit-led, creating an atmosphere where you can truly connect with God and renew your mind. What stands out most is their commitment to family, discipling the next generation while providing solid biblical foundation and mentorship for adults at every stage of life.

​If you are seeking a church where your faith will be challenged to grow, where prayer is prioritized, and where you can find genuine godly community, New Life Family Church is a true beacon of light. It has been an absolute blessing to our spiritual walk. New life family church is one of the most embracing communities I’ve ever been a part of. There’a always a clear message that comes directly from the Bible. The church has its doors open everyday of the week and serves the needs of the community. Recommend if you are looking for a home church. Great church! A friend invited me here and I felt at home. The pastor greeted me and told me this was my home. I attend by myself but now I have made friends in fellowship. I chose this church because it is a bible based church, has accountability,always feel welcomed and the people treat me with respect. Good diversity as well from all ages. There is bible study for kids and a beautiful coffee bar where you can grab a latte! Being a millennial is hard finding the right church but so far my friends are also really liking New Life! And we stream online as well when we can’t make it! I would definitely recommend coming here if your looking for a home church or are visiting from out of town 😊 I absolutely love this church. Let me tell you about my experience: My husband and I started attending 3 months ago, and we immediately felt the Holy Spirit touch us while we sang worship music. Then I started bringing my parents to the Wednesday Spanish mass, and as I was singing along to worship music one day with my eyes closed, I felt a huge figure next to me putting his arm around me…like a protector. My mind still cannot believe I was able to witness this, I know God walks with this church because of all the things I’ve felt here (I know a lot has to do with my personal faith, however, they have been much help as far how far I’ve gotten here faith wise).

Other things to note: they have a great child care system, my 2 year old loves it. Everyone is helpful and non judgemental to new comers. My family and I have all felt very welcomed. 🙌🩷 This morning I attempted to take my 7-year-old autistic son to my favorite church, New Life Family Church. This is a church I have been part of since 2015 when it was simply a Thursday night Bible study at a borrowed space. We came to church this morning expecting worship, community, and belonging.

My son relies on a small bag of sensory items to help him regulate. These are not toys; they are accommodations that allow him to stay calm, focused, and present. The church does not provide sensory supports.

When we arrived, Lisa, who identified herself as the leader of the children’s ministry at New Life Family Church, repeatedly told me that my son could not remain in the children’s class with his accommodation bag, and that because I did not give advance notice that he would be attending, there was nothing she could do. While my son was not physically removed, it was made clear that he could not stay unless his supports were taken away.

During this same conversation, another child with disabilities arrived holding a Pooh Bear stuffed animal and wearing her own backpack. Lisa paused the conversation with me to ensure that this child’s comfort items were also removed. Seeing this happen to another family made it clear that this was not an isolated misunderstanding.

Because of this experience, my son became dysregulated and deeply sad. For hours afterward, he continued asking me, “Why couldn’t I stay in the church class if I love Jesus?”

That question is why I’m sharing this.

Children with disabilities already face barriers in schools, public spaces, and social settings. Church should not be one of them. Inclusion is not special treatment. It is removing unnecessary barriers so all children can worship, learn, and belong.

Scripture tells us, “Therefore go and make disciples of all nations” (Matthew 28:19). There is a nation of special-needs children who love and honor God. When churches are not prepared to receive them as they are, families are left without a church home, not because they lack faith, but because they are excluded.
This experience highlights the urgent need in the RGV for accessible and inclusive children’s ministries.

*UPDATE!!*

After I posted my original review, a pastor from New Life Family Church found my personal Facebook within minutes and messaged me privately, attempting to encourage me to remove my review due to potential misunderstanding and negative commentary. He promised we would have a meeting to address what happened and talk about making the children’s ministry more inclusive.
I made it clear I wasn’t comfortable removing my review, but I was willing to meet. He agreed to set a day after he was back from his Christmas travels. Obviously, That meeting never happened. After asking me to take my concerns out of the public eye and promising a conversation, he completely stopped responding. I was ghosted.

This is the church I extended my offerings and tides to for years. & they swept us under the rug.

Families of children with special needs deserve better than this, both in how they are treated and how concerns are handled afterward. Experiences like this don’t just hurt families, they discourage them from returning at all.

name: New Life Fellowship - Galveston Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is not it to the disabled or broken seeking the lord , in my opinion. I hate to grade a church, but as a first impression , taking a disabled vets seat “ due to it only being for workers “ and being rude after while he goes outside to grief his many loses, is not cool. I arrived early to the Spanish service, my same seat, no problem, they let me sit and even said hey ! Loved it ! as soon as I get up to cry privately outside and return before the English service even starts , my stuff placed and the seat is gone. I choose to sit in the back because of my loses, I’m emotional. and I have to be close to a bathroom due to medical issues, and I don’t want to sit next to family’s and ruin there peace on a Sunday , especially after I just lost mine. And to be sassy about it ? Why are we being hostile and the opposite of welcoming in a church ? I did nothing wrong , I heard an usher comparing the Spanish service to the English service, and the numbers in them, and I can tell you, Spanish service was loving and made me want to stay the tail end of the service I saw, after this encounter,I don’t even wanna go to a church I’m so tired of the fake faith people. I just wanted Gods word delivered in a church after I just moved here this week. I needed a place to grief. I don’t know how that is an issue for a new visitor. You would not do that with Jesus in the room nor in front of the very nice pastors. that made you and the church look immature and unprofessional. I would watch how you treat new people or atleast ask them how they’re doing before you use your self entitlement to take away the only peace I tried to find today, a place to feel safe and comfortable in a church to help with my mental health. I had a bad first time experience at new life in Galveston, that is the truth and I hope the workers needed the one seat tucked against a wall next to a whole stack of other identical chairs, made me feel unworthy and valueless to even be there , that was my experience at new life church and worship didn’t even start yet 👍🏼 I love and forgive , I will end this with a compliment , those hope shirts on pre sale where so nice. And the Spanish service was the nicest. This also was the cleanest church I’ve ever been to !  Really is well invested in and the aesthetic of the church, is quality. Even the bathrooms were spotless. I wish I could of said those things in a five star review. if your coming solo, I wouldn’t go This is such a great church! My husband grew up in this church and now our kids! It's has a great children's ministry and devoted volunteers ! Our Pastors are not perfect but devoted to growing and the church! I came here three years ago when I was in nursing school and I am thankful I did. The beautiful people and their spirit instill the missing piece in my life and enhanced my relationship with God stronger.

I don’t live here anymore but I still will watch online the services to hear the wonderful messages and the Word.

Everyone still in their journey should come here because you will never regret it.

Many blessings and much love to this place. My family and I have been attending NewLife since 2000, and now that I have a wife and two little ones. I cannot think of a better place church to be connected too. I love that its in Galveston, Tx, it make getting lunch after church a dream, with all the great places on island.

The worship is great and the Pastor always gives a great Bible lead message. Plus, when we are not in town we can join online.

Love my church. Give it a try. Many people go to this church but I had bad experience this is a cult controlling environment if you don't fit then your there enemie they have people workers who watch you. Obey or get out. No reviews because???

name: New Life Fellowship Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I had a chance to experience the church. We really enjoyed ourselves. Being from out of town. We were greeted warmly. We loved the message that was delivered by Pastor John Pee Key. Thanks for an awesome day. Praise God! Love The Rev John P. Kee. He has truly been blessed with the gift of music. 🎶 I’ve always had a good time at his church 🙏🏽🥰 I visited this church twice with my group for the VIP conference and was determined to go back to experience a Sunday service. Pastor Kee's music solidified my walk with Christ back in the mid to late nineties. If I had a car, I'd drive to Charlotte at least twice a month for service. I'm trying to get my credit right so when I buy another car, it won't get repossessed like last time was able to buy one. I've had 9 cars since coming to GA in 2001 and to date still don't have a running vehicle. Yet, He has consistently sent people into my life to help me get around GA all these years. Even to school 30 minutes away back in 2004. I've got testimonies. I just believe God is trying to get another testimony out of these challenges. Anyway, I met a woman at work who used to be a member at NLCF named Dana. She said she was known as "the pie lady" and we had been planning for a couple of years to travel together, but time and money and both our transportation issues just wouldnt permit us to, until the weekend of April 8, 2019. Service truly was an experience and I even got to hug Pastor Kee's neck and thank him. We had a chance to go out and eat and even sit by the water which has always been my place of  peace in this busy world. I pray the Lord will allow me to come more often, not because it's Pastor Kee but because I know the ministry is real and is still a blessing to me! Love you! My first visit was everything thing. I was not a disappointed!
Song service was excellent. Pastor John P. Kee delivered a great sermon!

"My Worship Won't Be Compromised"
2 Samuel 12:19

*Pure
*Steadfast
*Undiluted

You preached to me, sir! My absolute favorite place to worship.   Pastor Kee's music has boosted my relationship with Jesus, helped me through my divorce, and changed my life for the better.  He and his team have a way of making you feel connected as a believer.  Open your heart, welcome Jesus in,  and begin to walk in the spirit of the Lord.  Start here.

name: New Life Gulf Coast - Biloxi Campus
reviewSummary: Newlife church is a great place to come worship the Lord. Love God, love people and change the world I have never felt so loved then I do being a member of this amazing church. New Life Family Church is a Love filled giving church full of smiles and happy greetings when you walk through the doors.  Come and experience God's love here. You will definitely be glad you did😊🙏💖😊🙏💖 Great Messages Given by New Life  Family Church Pastor “JeremyUlmer”. Filled with great friendly and loving People who make you feel welcome and greet you with appreciation for joining in to hear the Messages with them. This Church has changed me permanently, my wife also. We love the friendly vibe as well as the welcoming fellowship members who have explained so much so well. We've found our Church home, and it's at New Life where we feel new life. Thanks Pastor Jeff and Jeremy. Go Saints, and the football team too. God is Great and this place helps us to feel the Almightys greatness, around humane humanity and good spirits. God Bless All While visiting my parents, my daughter and I attended a service at New Life Gulf Coast—and we were blown away. The worship was powerful, and the message was inspiring and grounded in truth. What really stood out, though, was the experience my daughter had in Kids Church. She was shy walking in, but the staff and volunteers went above and beyond to make her feel welcomed and comfortable. By the time I picked her up, she was smiling and chatting like she had been part of the group for weeks, not just a visitor. It meant so much to see her feel that connected. Now, whenever our family comes to town from Texas, we know we have a church home away from home. Thank you, New Life Gulf Coast, for your hospitality and heart!

name: New Life Lincoln Park
reviewSummary:
Warm neighborhood congregation, talented praise and worship band, impactful,  scripture-based messages. I have been a part of New Life Lincoln Park since it opened its doors, and I can honestly say that it is the thing that has kept my family and I rooted here in Chicago despite jobs changes and the like.  The teaching is spot-on, and doesn't shy away from tough stuff.  The community is really open, and I can assure you that you will make great connections whether you are in the city for a few weeks or for years. I've been going here for five years now, almost ever since I moved to the city.  The people here are my family now too.  This is a great place to meet people and a great place to meet God. If you're willing to put in the time and effort, you won't leave without something extra. Amazing friendly people. Biblically based teaching. True community heart.

If you are looking to be a part of a smaller church, where people actually notice you, this is it. It is a smaller church with a beautiful classic building. All ages attend, with many young professionals and local students.

Dress however you normally dress. Child care is available.

About a 5min walk from the Fullerton Brown or Red line stop Been attending this church for over two years now. The preaching is solid and biblical. The community is amazing as well. I have absolutely loved my time at this church!

name: New Life Midtown - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve gone here about a year and a half, and it feels like we finally have a church that feels like home. After trying out many churches, new life midtown is one that feels more welcoming than any other church we’ve gone to around here! It’s small enough where you can get to know people, and it’s a church with  a culture of hospitality. We’ve loved being a part of table groups too. The presence of God is always so evident to me in worship times, and I always leave feeling so encouraged by the sermons too. Love this place & would highly recommend! We are grateful that we found New Life Midtown 18 months ago. The pastors are genuine, and passionate about sharing God’s Word, in a way that is both meaningful and practical for everyday life. The messages are inspiring, the worship is uplifting, and the community is incredibly welcoming. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow in your faith, we highly recommend New Life Midtown. My family and I have been attending for over 3 years now.  At New Life Midtown, Pastors Jayde, Jonathan and all the staff have  an authentic love for the Lord, this church, and our community. They have a genuine heart for people and getting to know you and helping you to know our savior. A church you can call home and feel welcome, whoever you are, whatever your story. My husband & I "church hopped" for about a year & a half after moving to COS... then we found (aka: the Lord led us) to Midtown & the rest is history. We felt instantly SO at home here: welcoming community, awesome worship, and teaching centered around the WORD!!! At first, I would think to myself "wow that was such a powerful sermon...the best I've ever heard" but then that just kept happening EVERY week. That's just how the Lord is movin' in this church & through our pastors. Midtown is just everything we were praying to find in a church family & home. It's been about 3 years now: my husband & I serve in kid's ministry together, have been in a table group for a few years, and just LOVE our church family so much. THANKFUL THANKFUL THANKFUL!!!! We are just visiting here. We just moved here, so we have been just visiting churches. I hope one day we will find the church that we can call home. 🙏 Today, greeters were very friendly and took me to the kids section for my kids. They were very helpful with my kids. I really like the sermon today. I could listen to his preaching all day.
I would like to hear praise & worship led by the man who led us to communion today. The announcer lady even remembered our names. Smart! Thank you to each one of them who helped us and welcomed us, which made me feel welcome! Thank you to all who help with my kids in the kids' room, too.
Just one thing, the music is a bit too loud for this small building. Especially the drum!!

name: New Life Mission Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: My church.  Not perfect but good place to worship one and only.  Come visit. this church is great the youth group is even better Lovely community and loving elders Love my church! Great!!!!!!

name: New Life North
New Life Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: In my opinion, New Life is a great church for those who are looking for a korean-american church with solid leadership and gospel centered mission. Offers a more intentional and liturgical worship service, but still stays somewhat contemporary. They have a more older and family-oriented service at 10:00, and a younger aged service at 12 for mostly young adults. College and youth ministries also thrive here. Very friendly people. Somewhat strange how under-the-radar it appears on google maps though. People here are so kind ! The best church ever 😁

name: New Life Presbyterian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Disrespectful to surrounding neighborhood. Gardeners starting well before city ordinance. Unacceptable. A rare jewel of a congregation! Authentically welcoming.  A place for everyone: kids, teens, adults, seniors.  Compassionate and smart teaching.  Sincere worship singing.  Group and program opportunities.    Come and see ! I rate it 5 stars partly because I'm biased... But also because the theology and gospel centered teaching is very awesome, and if you feel like getting plugged into a church in Escondido, new life has lots of ministries nursery, elementary, middle high school college and career, and beyond. Also, sign up (your kids) for the annual VBS--literally so much fun😄 God choose this church for me.  Thank the good Lord I obeyed him.
What can I say?  Where do I start?I have been so blessed since coming
First of all our pastor is a man who with his lovely wife walk the walk. His preaching style is that of one of my former pastors, Lloyd Olgive.  Lloyd left Hollywood Presbyterian to become the Chaplain of the US senate.  The first time I heard Pastor Ted preach. I said to myself, that sounds like Lloyd Olgivie.
The entire congregation made me feel welcome
Wednesday night is Bible study.  What a blessing that has been.  Then I decided to go to the Wednesday. Bible study and got blessed that much more.
I was in my late 20's when I attended Hollywood Presbyterian.  New life id like Hollywood only smaller. If you want a church where the word of God is preached, those who come on
a regular basis are do friendly.
I have made many dear friends since coming about 2 and 1/2 years ago.  Have been a member
since last February thanks to good old Mr. Covid.
New life has a phenomenal youth program. For children in elementary school age (fifth grade) or younger, AND if you fill out the bulletin after the benediction you can come to the kid's booth on the patio to exchange your filled out bulletin for some prizes. There will be volunteers at the booth who will stamp your bulletin and check to see you completed it, and there are various prizes for trying to complete it!  How cool is that?
It is New Life's hope that this will be a way for your child to stay engaged during the worship service, to be encouraged by. God's word, and to love God for what he has done for us in Christ
more and more.

name: New Life Redlands Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
absolutely LOVE this church. The message, the worship team, the church community. everyone and everything is very welcoming. My Husband and I attended church maybe 5 months ago. I was expecting at the time, now everyone knows my babies name and blesses her. They are all super sweet and caring and always friendly. Newlife Redlands is a warm welcoming church to everyone!  Pastor Dennis shares God's word and love in practical, understandable words and actions.  Stephanie the Children's ministry director brings  inspiring encouragement and creativity to teaching and guiding the youth and teachers.  If your looking for a perfect church this is not it.  However if  your looking for  a church who accepts you as you are and strives together to love, honor and trust God, one another and build family then you have found it!   The praise and worship is contemporary and lead by the Holy spirit.  The church is careful to observe safety precautions. There is both indoor and outdoor seating available. I remember our first visit we expected to go "visit" and automatically felt at home. Everyone was so welcoming and inviting and made us feel like we belonged right away! Thank you to Pastor Dennis & Julie for your kindness and love. God placed us right where we needed to be at the best time! Pastor Diane and Pastor Steeve, you 2 are Godsent! Awesome job with Kids Connection and your dedication to the community! New Life Foursquare Church is a place where the love of Christ is shared with one another as well as with those in the surrounding community.  The pastoral staff has a passion for preaching and teaching the Word of God and seeing others grow in their Christian faith and apply His truth in every area of life. The praise and worship leader and his team lead the congregation in worship that brings glory and honor to the Lord.  I strongly recommend New Life Foursquare Church to anyone looking for a church family that truly reflects the love of God and his heart for serving and loving one another. Due to a recent transition, I was in search of a good Gospel Preaching  Church in the Redlands area. It was by chance that I came across the path of Pastor Diane Arseneault at a secular business meeting. However, I was struck by her passion, compassion, and love as she spoke regarding her position as Program Director of Kids Connection. Her message stayed with me for weeks after she shared with us that Thursday evening. As a result, a few months later  Pastor Diane asked me to be  a part of the Kids Connection Team on Friday evenings. To sum it up quickly. I have been blessed and my life has been changed. Furthermore, I did not realize this was a divine appointment until Diane invited me to visit the Sunday Church service. I was immediately struck by how welcomed everyone made me feel from the time I stepped through the front door where I received a warm, loving welcome by Kay,
followed by an awesome message by Pastor Dennis along with Praise Prayer and Worship.The Ministry Team that I have personally come in contact with: Nela, Janet, and Pastor Steve have been an added blessing. New Life Foursquare Church Redlands Is definitely
One of the best Ministries I have attended in my 31 years as a Christian.
I would give it 10 Stars if that were possible.

name: New Life Tabernacle @ Carrollwood
reviewSummary: Such a sweet presence of the Lord. Friendly folks greet you. Truth is preached here. Come and experience Truth and Love! very warm welcome. friendly people, great music and great fellowship. If you haven't visited,what are you waiting for? You will not be disappointed for this is a tabernacle where God dwells. People don't care about how much you know until they know about how much you care and that's what you will experience there, a very caring family of believers. Come see and experience it for yourself Awesome place of worship if you're seeking true Christ like transformation and awesome worship experience that will help you grow in your saintly walk this is the place to be. Lots of friendly and caring personalities that are sold out for God and the building of his kingdom that will make you continuously be inspired to love and work in God. There's a lot of churches in Tampa but very few are preaching TRUTH! If you're looking to experience a move of God in life like never before then go visit Abundant Life UPC. The Pastor truly cares about the lost in the city of Tampa and the people are souled out to winning the city for God. New Life Tabernacle @Carrolwood is a family church that welcomes you with open arms, and makes you  feel at home.  A holy ghost fill church where you will feel rejuvenated  and reconnected with Jesus Christ each time you walk in.

name: New Life Valley Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: This place is fabulous, I invite all who want to hear the word of God to come and visit with confidence.

name: New Life Vineyard Church - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary:
They have great pantry service.  They will pray with/for you if you inquire/accept Ive been attending this church ever since i was born and this is my home. Ive grown up here. Ive met some of the best people ever here. When I joined the youth group I realized it has some of the best teens and they’re the most welcoming and loving teens ever. The children’s ministry is also amazing, i grew up with the same people who do it to this day and i’ve learned a-lot. This isn’t the perfect church nor is anyone perfect here but we strive to be more like Jesus and here is where i’ve found home, these are the people i trust most. They welcome you here and treat you like family. We have one of the best pastors ever and the people overall are just amazing here. I couldn’t wish for a better place to call home like this. Attended for my first time last Sunday. J truly enjoyed it. The music was great, and the sermon hit home with me. I'll definitely be back! Tremendous worship music, great message, friendly people. What? "no guns allowed on premises" sign is an open invitation for the bad guys to come in.  Solution:  take the signs down and allow law-abiding, conceal-carry, gun owners to carry -- they may save your very life if a nut job decides to come in and shoot up the place.

Let Americans be Americans -- we're not here to cater to the world, rather to set a stern example of faith and strength.  God bless America!

name: New Life Worship Center-Fort Myers, FL - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I used to think this church was like family until I begin to question my walk while attending this church.  They are very money hungry!!! My kids, my kids father & I have been attending here for nearly 8 years I recently stopped maybe 4 months ago, I reached out to Denise Johnson as well as Bishop Johnson on Several occasions for therapy about the turmoil I have been dealing with in my household with my spouse they haven’t PUSHED us for therapy or pushed us for marriage the ENTIRE time we attended this place, I was living a life of sin they accepted thousands of dollars from me knowing the struggles and life I was living for their “new building” that still hasn’t manifested.  Denise has also called me on several occasions asking me for money/donations for their building after I gave a huge donation from my heart the first time, but she never prayed or worked or helped towards pronouncing the blood of Jesus over my house and my family and kids, I went crying several times to her about my situation and having 3 kids by this man I was with for 10 years I begged pleaded they never helped just always turned it into a situation for their self gain.  This church has ruined my family but thankfully I didn’t loose my faith in God.  I pray God touch the heart of all the members of this center.  Be careful. I love this church. I feel that they are super sincere in their worship and committed to the cause. God bless this ministry. I pray they expand and grow to become a staple in the community and the city at large I joined Newlife Worship Center 6 years ago and truly my life has NEVER been the same !  I came in, not really knowing what to expect because I'd only been to church for funerals.  When I left, I left  filled with so much excitement, the experience of encountering the presence of God, the love of God and a hunger to know him more. New life is a teaching ministry,  and that's what I needed, I needed to be taught. They taught me how to seek God and get to know him personally for myself. I thank God for my church and my Passionate Leaders, Bishop Eric Johnson & First Lady Denise Johnson. They are truly great leaders after the heart of God, wanting to see God's children fulfill their purpose in him. Because of this ministry, I divorced my past and married my future and I'm determined to never go back ! I love New Life Worship Center December will make 3years that I have been going to this church.  Since being at  New Life Worship Center I been totally set free from drugs,clubbing and sleeping around with different men.Bishop Johnson and First Lady Denise Johnson are awesome spiritual leaders they break the Bible down so you can have a understanding so you can grow in God.  If you ever walk through them doors that's exactly what you will receive a new life.. I thank the lord for placing me in a ministry where I can grow and learn how to pray and read the Bible and do daily devotions and build my personal relationship with God. New Life Worship Center is definitely a place where God is glorified and the people of God is edified and the Devil is terrified. My family and I attended New Life for the first time on New Years Eve. Service started at 9:30p and concluded at midnight. One word: Phenomenal! The  pastor spoke a powerful, moving word for 2020, the year of vision, clarity and living in your divine purpose. I was changed after that service and now I’m ready to allow the Lord to work through me.

I must also add that the congregation is filled with young, talented members with voices that will give you chills, and words that will bring tears of joy to your eyes.

I definitely felt the presence of the Lord in the place. Thanks Google for helping me find this church. We will be back!

name: New Macedonia Missionary Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Im going back

name: New Mercies Christian Church - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary:
10/10 Must visit for an authentic worship experience… try it out you won’t be disappointed… some of the best things I can highlight is that Pastor Curney III will not dilute the word he will give you the full strength as it is written biblically.. the praise team is another favorite.. they are engaging and invite others to join in .. I can go on and on but as the word says: “taste and see that he is Good( psalms 34:8)…🫶🏽🙏🏾✝️💕 I started going to New Mercies In 2005   or 06 while living in Georgia,one of the greatest spiritual moves I have ever made.
You feel welcome from the time you walk in and Pastor Curney truly  is a  Pastor Teacher

if you don't get it you are not paying attention.

I left Georgia in 2020,but I am online every week . God is definitely moving in New Mercies.
Myra Reed Pastor gave an inspiring service about look and taste the word. Wonderful and friendly members. 😊 I Love the atmosphere. I volunteered here once years ago and I just never wrote a review because it wasn’t a thought. I still think about this experience I had when I volunteered at this church’s food drive, so this is the reason for posting this now.

The person I was reporting to was very nice. It was the church goers who came out to volunteer gave me a hard time. When I was helping set up the tables and giving food to people in need, some women were gossiping about how I was trying to get attention and calling me Miss America, because I was helping while they just stood there doing nothing.

I remember the pastor coming out and said “I guess today brought everyone out”, he was referring to me because he never seen me before. He introduced himself, and I tried to shake his hand, but he said they hug at that church, so he gave me a hug. (I wasn’t a church goer at this church; I just saw a posting for needing volunteers, hence why I was there).

There was a lady, I guess she is a regular church goer, who was being ignorant; I remember an Asian man pulled up and I guess he didn’t understand what she was instructing, so he pulled up to get some food, the lady said “somebody go help the Chinese man, he’s doesn’t understand English” she looked at me and people laughed at me.

There was a specific woman who was just rude to me, like she would stare at me and roll her eyes. I guess she got mad that I was helping people sort the vegetables from the large boxes; I assume one of the person’s in the group was her husband. I went to use the bathroom and that lady was staring me down, while she was sitting at a table with her husband and kids. While I was using the bathroom, the door handle jiggled. I stated someone is in here; the person didn’t stop jiggling the door handle and continue to force the door open. I, again, screamed someone is in here. The door handle still being jiggled and the door opened, wide opened, while I was on the toilet. I hurried to pull my pants up, washed my hands and go back outside. I didn’t see who did it, but I can speculate who.

I went home and cried to my dad, because I didn’t expect to have a bad experience volunteering and helping people, especially at a church. I felt singled out and unwelcome. I wish I mentioned something to someone, at that time, but I was in shock with the overall experience; I couldn’t fathom it. An amazing church where God’s Word is preached with truth. The praise and worship are powerful and uplifting, and the atmosphere is so welcoming. The pastor genuinely cares he encourages unity, prayer, and personally greets everyone after service. Truly feels like home!

name: New Revelation Missionary Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I am proud to come from a lineage of true civil rights activists in Pasadena, California. My grandfather, John Henry English, served as a leader among the Pasadena civil rights activists, and as a little girl I remember sitting on his shoulders during rallies at New Revelation Baptist Church – 855 N Orange Grove Blvd, Pasadena, California.

I remember my grandfather standing alongside Reverend Jesse Jackson as the movement for justice and equality continued to grow across this nation. I remember listening to the speeches, watching the people gather in faith and unity, and I remember those big “Keep Hope Alive” buttons that I loved so much as a child.

Those moments shaped generations of us and taught us that faith and action must walk hand in hand if we truly want to change our communities.

The Rainbow Coalition movement Reverend Jesse Jackson helped build.

Rest in peace Uncle Jesse.
Your courage, your voice, and the doors you opened will never be forgotten. Your legacy lives on through those of us who continue to serve our communities today. ✊🏾 My mom been a member  for 10+ plus years she loves her pastor. name: New Song Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:

I made the worship team and then when my husband decided to abandon the marriage, I was told I would not be on the worship team anymore. I called the “care line” mistakenly thinking I would receive some “care”. But the pastor’s dad answered and said in a rude tone “what are you hoping to get out of this?” He was acting like I was calling asking for money. I said, shocked “I don’t know,,maybe some prayer? Some caring support?” He put his wife on the line. She told me to pray for my husband in tongues. That’s the “care” I received. But heaven forbid you are divorcing an abusive man. (Covert and he most likely said whatever lies he wanted to say to our homegroup people) You promptly get kicked off worship team and accused of trying to get something out of a useless care line. I told the pastor and his wife and his response was to ignore me and put his face in his hands. Wife was trying to be understanding. Beware. Only their type of people allowed. I have a similar concern to being distracted during the service. Where some ladies were cackling and laughing during every comment the Pastor said along with amen and Aha and yeah, I wish they would understand I need to concentrate what's being said. And if they're doing it to encourage the pastor well sit in the front row and smile, and do all your amens up there. But when you're in the sermon, you are really distracting, the rest of us. I honestly never do this, but I really hope that the staff read this and understand that what happened to us here was not appropriate and we will not be coming back because of it. We brought our baby with us into the sanctuary during the afternoon service. We sat toward the back and close to the exit. A staff member came and talked to us TWICE about our baby being a distraction. The second time she was just gooing kind of loud and she had dropped my wife’s phone on the floor. I noticed a staff member came and kneeled next to my wife. My wife looked at me and told me she was taking the baby out. I honestly was in shock because our baby was just sitting there quietly in my wife’s arms. When my wife got to the lobby she text me and told me that the staff member had asked her to take our baby out. I was completely shocked by this. Up until that point we had been enjoying the service. Good non domination Christians. Worship is amazing but the word is pretty good too. So try it I went once with a date... Sadly catfished but I was fully there for the msg. And yeah. Officer is placed and lots of people to meet there. This church has everything we have ever wanted. Powerful worship, biblically sound preaching, and a community of authentic followers chasing The Lord with all their hearts!

So encouraged to attend each week and beyond blessed to call it our “home”!

As a member of New Testament Church in Irving, Texas, I am beyond grateful for the welcoming environment, spiritual growth opportunities, and vibrant community that this church offers. Here's my glowing 10-star review:

From the moment I stepped through its doors, I was embraced by a warm and friendly congregation that radiates love and acceptance. The leadership team and fellow members have created a nurturing environment where individuals can grow in their faith and establish meaningful connections.

You can tell you're a loving church with a heart for people.  God bless you as God continues to use you in the city of Manchester.  I'm originally from
Milford, NH, I live out of state now. Great Church with really nice people.  When my wife gave birth to all my kids and when I had surgery the church members rallied and brought us meals every day for 2 weeks and they have done it for everyone.  One of the leaders of the church would call me every Saturday to see how my family and I are doing.  The church is full of seasoned Christians who want nothing more than to serve God.  There is on average 30 -40 people every week and at least half of them volunteer to serve at the church all the time.  This is a great fellowship to meet people to do life with.  I highly recommend this church to anyone who wants to worship God and hear solid teachings. The best time I've ever had at a church. Now this does not mean it's for everyone. They for the first half of the Service, sung songs...
(To me it was music to my ears.)
Second half the have several speakers and one main speaker.
(It was like they were speaking like they already knew who I was)
It's about an hour and a half or so.
They have service every Sunday at 10am Sharp.
I walked in looking pretty Hood, and no one discriminated against the way I appeared.
(At least on the surface)
one of the speakers said "...raise your hand if you want to be prayed for..."
I reluctantly Rose my hand.
A bunch of the people in the church gathered around me... They touched me, it's cool, then they held my arms up... Then I guess the main guy shook my hand and called me a Brother.
Wonderful I tell you. Services are lead by the Holy Spirit through the congregation, and when necessary are throttled by a group of elders who keep each other accountable. The out-of-service inter-connectivity of this local church both with each other and the Holy Spirit work together when they meet to create an atmosphere where His manifest presence is evident.

>>>Services at first can be difficult to follow if not familiar with "tracking" where the Holy Spirit is leading throughout the congregation. With a little bit of note-taking becomes easy, second nature, and totally awesome.Personal time for morning prayer in auditorium: 30 minutes
>Worship: about 45 minutes
(In between worship songs, the Holy Spirit will lead different people in the congregation to give a word or say a scripture. Throughout this part of the morning, if one is attentive, a streamlined message can be seen with these words and the meaning to the worship songs. It usually ends up being reinforced by the lesson :D)
>Lesson: about 45 minutes
>Brief taking of tithes and offerings
>Monthly: about 10 minutes for communion
>Announcements up to 7-15 minutes
>Free snacks and fellowship indefinitely (gets cleaned up and put away around 30-45 minutes after start) downstairs
>Monthly: fellowship meal replaces snacks and gets cleaned up about 1.5hr after start.

name: New Tribe Church - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary:
Such an amazing church at every level and in every area! The pastors, the church staff, the serve teams, the worship, the people!

We love the staff and volunteers who take time out of their day to sing, laugh, and play with our kids, and I love that my 2 yr old is so excited to go to church every week and to tell me about what she learned in class.

My husband and I have also found such a strong sense of community through this church. We’ve never met so many kind, genuine people, and we’ve also found our friend group here, which has been the biggest blessing!

Something that might surprise you if you haven’t been here before is that people here are on fire for the Lord! It might be a little intimidating at first, but lean into it and you’ll be wowed at the way the Holy Spirit moves in the room and through these people.

And lastly, the teachings from Pastor Jarod and the rest of the pastoral team have completely transformed my husband and I’s lives. It’s brought us so much closer to God than we’ve ever been in our lives, helped our marriage and our parenting, and we’ve seen God working in our lives like never before.

If you want to grow closer to God, for your kids to love Jesus, or for a breakthrough in your life, I seriously can’t encourage you more to check out this church! It truly is such a special place, and I hope this helps you find your church home too!❤️ You are guaranteed a family and the presence of God in this house. I first attended New Tribe back in October of 2022 as a fresh young adult trying to navigate my purpose and my identity as the Lord stumbled me upon NewTribe where I learned both of those things through the irrefutable presence of God and his love for the church and it’s people that you experience at New Tribe. The pastors are not only there to shepherd the sheep with their Sunday morning sermons, but they are very intentionally involved in the community of the church from personal prayer to counseling to greeting you and sharing a delightful conversation with you because they care to. NewTribe has an amazing network of connections to foster nurturing, long lasting relationships with others through their tribe groups as well as life changing events put together by the church staff and volunteers with such hard work, intentional planning, and devotion of time all for their steadfast determination to deeply root and reinforce relationships with the Lord. And I have to mention the exceptional worship team that summons the Holy Spirit to pour out through the house in waves that crash over you that you can’t deny that’s exactly what it is. God has called upon amazing people who have done amazing work to make NewTribe a home for everyone! New Tribe felt like home instantly when we moved to Mount Juliet! We have never attended a more Holy Spirit filled church that has challenged us & encouraged us more in our faith with God. The leaders have so much wisdom to share & the community you will find here is like family. God is doing amazing things in this "strip-mall church"! Can't wait to see what the future holds for our church & the new church building over the next few years! I've been looking for a church, a tribe, an anything for decades after some negative experiences in churches of my youth. I've been to most all denominations, a buddhist temple, you name it. After about 30 years I was thinking there wasn't a place that existed for me and maybe I had unrealistic expectations. A good friend found this place online and shared with me. Since then, she and I and our families watch the sermons online and have even gone in person to the church. The people were genuine and non judgemental in person and the message and music is always fire. I can feel the Spirit in this place even through the screen. My search has ended and I am forever grateful for this group. I look forward to Sundays with these folks. I sing the songs throughout the week and try to apply the message to my life. There's something for everyone here, groups, community, family; they have thought of everything to make a church work! Best church ever! Great messages and just fills my glass every Sunday. If your looking for a place to start come one Sunday and I promise you will feel part of the Tribe.

name: New Vintage Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: Historic downtown Raleigh church bringing together historical liturgy and modern relevance, thoughtful theology, and neighborhood connection.

name: New Vintage Church - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church, I have been going to this church for the last two ish years and I really love the community there. I service which has been an amazing experience, learning coffee skills and production skills. I attend the youth group also which is amazing also with the youth pastor! Would recommend to come see what we are all about My daughter absolutely loves this church. Special Thanks for the Dad Daughter Dance your church put on. Thank you for the pre-Kindergarten school. Wonderful tea and coffee shop with flavored syrups so I can wake up and drive straight to church to worship. Saves time. Special thanks. The best community is at New Vintage... You feel welcomed, loved, and Gods presence when you walk in the door every time! Very friendly people there. And the message was a wrap up of a series on relationships/marriage. Very good message, although I never heard a reference of any of God's Word about anything that was said. Sad. Kids absolutely had a blast! We’ve found our new church. Thank you New Vintage for welcoming us!

name: New Vision Baptist Church - Murfreesboro Campus
reviewSummary: I am just be a middle schooler but i LOVE new vision. The staff is all so kind and welcoming and I know i haven’t met everyone who goes to new vision, but everyone i’ve met that does go there is so kind. Inside the church is super nice and i love the services and worship. I went to their summer camp for 6th-12th grade and it was definitely my favorite thing ever. I’ve been to both sunday mornings, wednesday nights, and events like christmas, easter, etc. For students, New Vision keeps it about jesus, but relates to real life issues, does fun engaging activities, and makes people listen. I've been attending New Vision for over 15 years and the church is truly a blessing to me and my family.  The pastors, staff and church family have hearts for serving God and loving people. I think this church would be a great church to be a part of but according to the pastor, unless you are planing or committed to be in a small group, he doesn’t want you to join/be a part of their church. I can’t commit to that yet in my walk with the Lord so this isn’t my church. Sad but rules are rules. He said even his wife was against that decision but he’s the pastor and he makes the rules. Thankfully my first day visiting the church was also their “find out about the church and meet the pastor” luncheon. Can you imagine if I didn’t take the class how devastated I’d be after falling in love with the church and the people. For some who are able to meet the requirements to join a small group, this is a lovely church and they have lots of programs that you’d definitely be excited about and enjoy for all ages. If you are ready to jump into a small group take a chance with this church. I’m sure it’s pretty fantastic. Was blessed to get to be in attendance at the IMB sending service in November of 2024. The staff, pastor, and worship team were incredible. I felt right at home even though it was a larger setting. Thank you for your dedication to the Gospel and to missions around the world! Was a member for years until the pastor openly stated that we should support Israel, despite verses saying otherwise. If you support a church that supports a genocide then you’re indirectly supporting a genocide.

name: New Vision Christian Church - Helena Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing service! When I tell you if you are in the area this is the place to be for worship. It was so welcoming. Pastor Van Houser spoke on this day & it was wonderful. Thank you for the warm welcome! The Word was encouraging, comforting and preached with compassion. An equipping ministry for all ages.
The Church building is beautiful and spacious. It was an awesome experience.  The praise and worship was uplifting.  The preached word was life changing! Pastor Houser is an Awesome, compassionate Man of GOD, friendly congregation, and variety of youth programs and activities The teachers was nice, I enjoy  interaction with them.My grandson will be attending there.

name: New Vision Fellowship - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I love being members at New Vision Fellowship. We have experienced exponential growth in multiple areas of our lives since joining.  Our children enjoy children’s church and actively participating in the worship service. The Pastors not only teach the uncut Word of God, they live it!!  NVF has truly been a blessing to our family! I visit each time I travel to Mississippi. I enjoyed the service and pictures. They make you feel at home. It's about God's word not man's word. Amen Marriage ministry is biblically based.  The fellowship, teaching and support is wonderful.  I recommend this ministry if you are interested in a place to  grow spiritually in your marriage. Pastor Juan and Robin lead by example. Seeking the real Word of God, real people, real love, real kindness and presence of God...come visit. This church changed my life. I thank God for the leadership of this church. Be blessed. This is my church home and my  Pastor and Mrs. Pastor are great people

name: New York City Church of Christ - Harlem - New York Campus
reviewSummary: The sermons were insightful, and the atmosphere was uplifting. The dedication to building a safe and comfortable community shows a genuine commitment to making a positive impact. I highly recommend this church for those seeking a supportive spiritual home. This church is a true family where people seek God’s Word and live by it. You’ll feel welcomed, supported, and encouraged to grow spiritually and in life. AONYC! Love this group of God-lovers who are compelled by their experience of God’s love to love others around them. My relationship with God keeps growing because of the active Bible studies and friendships I have in this group Always have awesome time!! Amazing people and of course inspiring lesson spiritually! Everyone should come!! Love being part of this community! Has helped me so much in my life and Faith.

name: New Zion Christian Church - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church great Teaching by Apostle Love being able to watch online due taking care of my mentally ill Mother Love the Fact that the teachings are from the Bible and Apostle does not Sugarcoat anything he gives you the real Deal from the Bible Peroid. We deeply appreciated the teachings of Apostle and First Lady Kim, and their messages resonated with both me and my kids. We joined the church with great hope and faith, believing it would be a place of spiritual growth and healing, especially as we were overcoming personal challenges.

However, after being assigned someone to connect with, we only had one interaction with them. Since then, we’ve felt judged and excluded because of the personal crises we’ve faced. It’s disheartening because, isn’t the church supposed to be a place where individuals find love, support, and understanding rather than judgment? You don’t cut people off, but work with them in the areas they need help with.

We know no one is perfect, and every church faces challenges, but as members, we came seeking community, acceptance, and grace. We still value the messages and ministry, but this experience has left us feeling distant and unsure of where we belong. No one ever suggested counseling for us or followed through with their advice. You DO NOT throw people away when they’re hurting. Unfortunately, this has made a major impact on me and my kids. Churches don’t seem to care about people anymore. I Absolutely love this place! More churches need to follow the model of Apostle Pleasant. I've been a member since 1999. Dr. Jamie T. Pleasant and His Wife, First Lady Kimberly Pleasant have covered me during my absence, even counseled and cared for me when I was on assignment with other ministries. He is a True Father of the Gospel; He rightfully divides the Word...Leads by example..tempered with much love and teaches that wisdom is the supreme thing. Such a wonderful church! I am a lifer!   An amazing display of God and the love of Christ on another level.  The teaching and preaching ministry is transformative.  The youth ministry is amazing and proven to be foundational in the raising up of young disciples of Christ.  If you want genuine fellowship, a deeper walk with Jesus and to experience the presence of God in every area of life... please come visit or become a part of! I've been a member here for 13 years and I love being a part of the NZCC family! I came to this church knowing very little about Christianity. I was seeking an understanding of God and the bible. My understanding of scripture, understanding of the mind of Christ, spiritual maturity and overall relationship with God has grown tremendously since becoming a member here.

name: Newbreak Church Ocean Beach Assemblies of God - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We were in town on vacation and absolutely loved our experience attending Newbreak OB for Easter Sunday! From the moment we walked in we felt welcomed with open arms. Our kids too. The people, the worship, and the sermon all made our visit a 10/10. Wish we lived here and got to experience this every week. The pastor hit the nail on the head with me. I was in tears for part of the preaching/ teaching because the Holy Sprit was touching my soul. Thank you pastor for listening to the Holy Spirit and touching mine and many others souls. I love the multigenerational, multiethnic community here. The pastors are friendly, and the worship and kid’s ministry teams pour God’s truth and love into us. Wonderful home fellowships help you get and stay connected. Gotta check this place out! You’ll love it! My family & I started coming here when our first child was born as it was within walking distance for us. We are transplants to SD & have felt so at home here! Such a wonderful atmosphere & people are loved on just as they are without fear of being rejected. Everyone I met was very welcoming.  The service was awesome. The pastor really connects with all the members who were really sincere and helpful.  I wanna go everyday.!
.

name: Newbreak Church Scripps Ranch Assemblies of God - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: This is the place to be if you’re looking for authentic people trying to be a light in their community and make a positive impact on Scripps Ranch neighbors and beyond. Pastor Jared teaches the Word of God with boldness, clarity, and humility. The kids and students ministries are such a blessing as a parent, and their variety of life groups helped us find a home away from home as SD transplants. Great church that really loves God and people. They do so much to serve the community, and really live what they teach. My family has been attending for many years and we appreciate the leadership, great messages and music, and engaging programs for kids and teens. Nice friendly Church.  Pastors Jared and Ashley do a great job teaching the Bible.  Great singers with uplifting music. Absolutely fantastic church. They love the community with their actions, the team is very close, and the pastor is a great Spirit filled teacher, one of the best I've heard. Good people, and I think Pastor Jared does an excellent job of teaching in a positive manner out of the Bible.

kindness.
It was sweet.💯🥰❤️ I love to listen to the music and to the meaning of the message. Thank you lord for your pastor that conveys your message 🙏 🙌. I have only come for their Men's breakfasts, but I can tell that the teaching is solid! Safe trip 🙏

name: NewHope Church - Durham Campus
reviewSummary:
Superb church ! Always great message ! Brings all races for one ultimate Purpose , great people,  well organize , children activities   , fall festivals , Christmas festivals !!! and a superb support, Of the local community. Non de denomination church everyone is welcome here . Such of great positive attitude , you won’t be disappointed that’s for sure ..  Non smoking facility , super welcoming worship facility , if you are  out of town or in town, this is the place to Be !!! The worship music  team is out of this world , you can feel the energy vibration trough the building with the positivity… Come on now !! This is the place to be for worship ! God is great !! I went to a church service today, and I’ve been there before, but this time the entire service felt like a sales pitch. The preacher kept asking for money and saying people should donate anywhere from $100 to $10,000 a month. The message was supposed to be about giving, but the verse he used was really about helping others and serving those in need — not funding the church. I’ve never felt so uncomfortable in a church before. I was so excited to join this church as I’ve been to multiple services. Please do not fund this church! They are missing the whole point of giving. Great atmosphere, excellent care, and the children’s space was great for the parent conference! Thank you! This is truly a church with a lot of outreach.
They hosted a Compassion Experience. We visited this church for my brother's baptism. It was such a joy to be so welcomed by the staff. The music team was absolutely incredible. They blended well, I loved the song selection and they really had a heart of worship. They did a great job preparing you for the sermon. I really enjoyed the sermon the pastor gave. He had a great way of keeping your mind fully focused without making you feel exhausted.

name: NEWLIFE Alexandria - Alexandria Campus
reviewSummary:
I can’t say enough good things about this church. It’s such a great small, local community where you genuinely feel welcomed from the moment you walk in. Pastor Jordan DeMerchant is truly incredible. He has a way of making every single person feel like they’re his best friend. He’s not only deeply knowledgeable, but also incredibly approachable, down-to-earth, and genuinely invested in the people around him.

What really stands out is how involved he and his entire family are. You can tell this isn’t just something they do - it’s who they are. That level of care and authenticity carries throughout the whole church. Everyone is kind, supportive, and always willing to pray with you or step in to help however they can.

The church also does an amazing job supporting its members through difficult times. There’s a real sense of community here. People show up for each other in meaningful ways.

Sunday services are consistently excellent. Pastor Jordan keeps things casual and engaging, while staying grounded in teaching Scripture and delivering practical, meaningful lessons from the Bible. And it definitely doesn’t hurt that he’s extremely funny. Jordan brings a lot of joy and energy to every message.

If you’re looking for a small local northern Virginia church where you’ll feel known, supported, and spiritually encouraged, this is truly a special place. I am truly blessed to have found this church with my fiancé and we are so lucky to be apart of this strong community! We love the pastor and his family, and the focus of the church, “Love God and Love People!”
From the worship to the preaching to the kids’ ministry to the small groups, we’ve found our community! The focus is on growing in our dependence on God and on looking for a way to serve others with the love of Christ.
Great community - you’ll find a home here! I came to New Life and wow has it been a change in our lives.  We have found a beautiful community that has welcomed us and surround us with so much love. Lots of small groups to learn about God's word and meet new people.  Activities and programs for kids. Sisterhood etc.  Our Pastor Jordan is super welcoming , approachable and friendly and a big part on why NEW LIFE feels like home. I visited with my kids while we were in town and loved this place. Everyone was super welcoming, and I didn’t feel judged being on my own with 2 kids. The pastor Jordan seemed really down to earth too. The kids enjoyed their time, and I loved seeing a huge representation of different age groups and cultures. Wish I had a church like this back home This is an incredibly welcoming church community with many opportunities to get connected to other believers. I have also enjoyed the biblical sermons and focused worship music. Their mission is clear and lived out well: Love God. Love People.

name: Newman Center Catholic Community at UC San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: My home away from home while I was in college! Forever grateful for this community. I've been going here for years. Good community and location. Very welcoming church Mass Sundays 12:30pm and 6:30pm. (Fall 2012) Woo

name: Newnan City Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
Love the people, staff,and pastor's at this church
Great music and message every Sunday
Love the tent! Absolutely LOVE Newnan City Church and pastor Jimmy Ellison!  100% Bible based and all about spreading Jesus' word through working in the community. The church is the body and these people are some of the best! Pastor Jimmy, Darrin, Cedric and all of the pastoral team know what it means to truly shepherd (care) for their congregation. The truth is preached every Sunday with encouragement and conviction.  Worship is very authentic and is lead in a way to experience God's presence and glorify him. NCC truly practices what it means to be the hands and feet of Christ in their community.  If you've been looking for a church home in the Newnan area, look no further. I couldn't recommend NCC enough! Thank you Dr. Jim Ellison and NCC for your support and guidance. End times teaching. A lot of churches stay away from end times teachings. It should be discussed a lot more everywhere.

name: Newpath Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
A people filled with the Holy Spirit! This is a very friendly and welcoming church. The moment you walk in the door you feel God’s presence and an out pouring of His love. I highly recommend NewPath Church. They have a wonderful kids and youth program! Welcoming church people were very friendly! The pastor had a great word. A Great Spirit filled church in North Raleigh! Awesome biblical teaching, very kind friendly congregation. We from WakeMed North would like to thank you for your generosity,  thinking about us at this time of the Christmas year and providing with lunch and heartfelt cards of appreciation. God bless you all from us at WakeMed North and all other WakeMed hospitals 🏥. 😇🙏❤ Newpath is a great church that meets at this location. Pine Hollow Middle School
5365 Bartram Pl,
Raleigh, NC 27617

name: NewPointe Community Church - Canton - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
NewPointe is such a great place to grow your faith! From the friendly greeters at the door to the campus pastors that truly care about you, you will feel welcomed from the moment you walk in! More importantly, the messages are always straight from the Bible. Dwight (the lead pastor) is a great teacher and I feel like his messages resonate with me every Sunday. Since coming to NewPointe, I have been challenged in my faith and have grown to have a deeper faith and deeper understanding of the Bible. Small groups are also encouraged so you can have a true, supportive, community surrounding you and your family. I am grateful to call NewPointe my church and highly recommend joining us on Sundays! This church at first was good, but the people aren't welcoming or friendly. Also have had people of the church judge my friends and family for the way they live their life. We have young adult's coming and bashing us for the way we do things in our personal life, what makes that ok, did they even talk to the main pastor about if this was ok to do so?
I don't think it's fair or right that you preach about kindness and we accept all and love all but yet you judge I thought we weren't supposed to judge and that God loves us for us but nope not in this church they only care about their image and what they can get out of people. We love going to New Pointe and the connections we have made with people there! It’s so easy to get involved if you wish and they always have lots of events for adults and kids to make new friends and support each other in our walks of faith. The messages are hard hitting and so real! My kids love going too! The first day I walked into New Pointe many moons ago I was greeted warmly! It was like arriving at my best friends home, so much warmth, love and hugging. We have family in Christ and it's a no judgement zone. There are so many wonderful things to say about NewPointe! Large church with a small-town feel. Everyone is welcoming. The wide selection of groups to join is outstanding. They have something for everyone... baby Christians and beyond! Child-care and middle / high school services. Very involved with the communities throughout Stark County. Wonderful service with heart-felt music! Can't wait to see you there!!

name: Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Deeply liturgical Anglo-Catholic sung Mass. Outstanding pastoral care.

name: Newport Center United Methodist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: This is a new church I joined recently after attending over an 8 year period of time. Dynamic minister and a welcoming, talented and warm congregation! We found this church because our child went to the pre-school attached to it and boy, we found our forever home here. The community around the church is vibrant, people are extremely welcoming and come from a variety of walks of life. It's a beautiful place that I would recommend for anyone to try out looking for a church home. I visited many preschools and I thought this one was one of the nicest as far as the facilities were concerned.  I showed up at the school and the administrators in the office (excluding the helpful young lady sitting at the front desk) seemed to be snotty and rude.  Peggy (Older Brunette Lady) gave me a tour and let me know that scheduled tours were given at an earlier date.  She appeared to be annoyed that she had to take time out of her day to show me around.  I needed to find a preschool soon, so I put my feelings aside in regards to the office staff.  I went ahead and filled out the paperwork at the end of March 2012 and the front office put a lot of urgency on collecting our money to hold our spot, so I turned in my payment the following day.  Anyhow, our financial circumstances changed in May and NCUMP does not offer any kind of flexible child before/after care for working parents, so we attempted to cancel our registration under the assumption they would keep our $125.00 registration fee and prorate the remainder of what we paid.  Keep this in mind it is 4 months before school even starts.  According to their rules they kept 50% of what we paid plus the $125.00 registration plus the $50.00 for the Family number.  (Shame on us for not reading the "contract" carefully.)  They basically received about $900.00 for no services rendered.  Now I know why their facilities look so great.  What kind of Christian Organization feels they are entiled to keeping so much money for doing absolutely nothing?  What does this do to the family who is struggling with their finances while NCUMP keeps more than 1/2 of your money for doing absolutely nothing!!!  I believe everything happens for a reason and out of this bad situation we found a good preschool for a much more reasonable price with flexible hours depending on what you need (7:30 am - 6:00 pm) with "real Christian values" and they are open 12 months out of the year.  Orange Tree Preschool on Bison & Jamboree right next to Newport Christian School.

name: Newport Harbor Lutheran Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We have had three children attend this preschool over the past five years, and we could not be more grateful for our experience. The director and teachers  are compassionate and kind, and they truly care about each child. Communication with parents is excellent, and they work hard to create a strong, supportive community. This preschool has been such a special part of our family’s early years. Nice place. Has big parking lot and is adjacent to a path that leads to a beautiful view of the newport beach balboa peninsula back bay. Can walk over a mile along a Cliffside waterfront overlooking all of Ocean and south Orange county with lots of airplanes landing and taking off just north of path. Great church , Christmas service was beautiful. The concert prior to the service was outstanding, the acoustics are phenomenal. Very welcoming community. Wonderful school and great environment for their students.
Terrific teachers; very caring. Love this school. Everyone is so nice and they have lots of fun activities for the children.

name: Newport Harbor Lutheran Church and School
reviewSummary: Beautiful traditional Lutheran service. Organ and choir are top tier.

name: NewSong Church
reviewSummary:
NewSong Church is truly a remarkable church. From the first visit, it was clear that this is a place where people are genuinely loved, welcomed, and encouraged. The worship is powerful and uplifting, the teaching is biblically grounded and relevant, and the sense of community is unlike anything I've experienced elsewhere. I’m so grateful to have found New Song Church! It’s a wonderful place to learn more about God and grow in faith. The community is incredibly welcoming and supportive—you immediately feel like part of a family. I’ve met such fantastic people here. On top of that, they serve the best coffee, which makes fellowship even sweeter. Highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a place to belong! I am so thankful for this church. I went during a very difficult time in my
life and  they embraced me and cared for me like family.  It is a spirit filled church and God speaks here! The worship is is such a blessing and you can see people here are seeking God. They have an incrediable moms ministry, as well as a tightnit welcoming family oriented community. I unfortunately moved away, but miss this community so much! I absolutely love this church! When we first visited we knew that these are the kind of people we wanted to do life with. The Pastors and staff are very approachable and down to earth. It is like family.
Everyone is so kind and inviting. We were looking for a place to live, as we were new to the area, and people were giving us great house leads, several people would call or text to let me know they were praying for me and my family. There’s not much more you could ask for. Highly recommend NewSong church.
If you do stop in on Sunday, please say hello. If you're looking for a Family Enriched Church that cares about the Community and each Person. I highly recommend this Church, because the Values that they stand by, demonstrates that they (Community, Members, & Staff) actually care about you, regardless if you are a One-Time Visitor or a Regular Attender. It also makes you feel like you are not just part of a Place of Worship, but that you actually are embraced into a New Family that looks out for each other and your interests. It's a great Church that helps to steward inclusion and empathy. Compassion is what defines their agendas. I really appreciate who they are and what they set out to demonstrate in the Body of Christ. It's also known to be a Multi-Generational, Multi-Cultural Church!  So Come as you are and feel empowered to move in Freedom!

name: Newsong Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary:
We spent several years visiting different churches before finally finding our home at Newsong. For the past six years, it has been a place where we’ve grown both spiritually and personally. Our kids love their classes—they come out excited, telling us stories about Jesus and proudly showing the art they made that day.
The staff, leaders, and deacons are Spirit‑led and deeply committed to the truth of God’s Word and how it shapes everyday life. This isn’t a “talk at you” church. It’s a “teach you something meaningful and invite you to respond” church.
Sunday mornings are just the beginning. There truly is something for every age and every member of our family. After going through a challenging journey, we found ourselves back in NC 8 years ago looking for a church home to just be a part of and heal. Newsong was the 2nd church we visited, and we've been attending ever since. No church is perfect, but the heart of the founding pastors to love Jesus and love people was amazing. This focus on Jesus and people continues as the church has had an amazing and healthy transition in the past year to our current pastor as the founding pastors retired. Something that really speaks volumes, my oldest son misses Newsong now that he's away at college. This is a great place to see what God wants to do in your life. Phenomenal church! From my very first visit, I was impressed by how many multi-generational families attend—grandparents, adult children, and little ones all worshiping together. That alone says so much about the heart of this church: a place for everyone. They have a strong focus on prayer, the Word, worship, and community. Loved it from day one, been coming ever since! When we first moved to North Carolina we found NewSong in Cornelius and found more than a church, we found a community who loves Jesus and is inspired to love others. From the very first time my family walked through the doors of Newsong Church, it felt like home.  There was a different atmosphere in the room, one of genuine love and it came from the top down.  These Pastors truly care for their people and want to help guide everyone into their gifts and callings.  The worship is sweet, spirit led and Jesus centered.  Here at Newsong Church, they preach the Word.  It can be tough to try to cram a deep life changing message into a Sunday morning, but I find myself week after week, thinking and meditating on what was taught and find that it leads me back to my Bible yearning for more.  I would encourage anyone to come check it out for themselves.
