name: Newsong Church 10ten - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Loved visiting Newsong. Love their mission, “Love God, love people.”  And their work with the community speaks to their mission. They are living it out. The pews and stain glass gives it a special touch to the worship experience. This is a great balance of modern with traditional. The band is great and the Dave Gibbons, the lead pastor is amazing! They have a coffee bar with baristas actually prepping pour overs for their attendees as part of their hospitality team. Overall a great place to worship, hear and be challenged by great bible messages and to build community. “The church of the misfits” where you’re accepted, encouraged, equipped, and redeemed as you are for whom you are. This is more than a church of diverse multicultural individuals; this is a place you can call home! When I got here over a decade ago I felt so lost and broken beyond repair. Through the years and through this journey with Newsong I sought out and found Christs unwavering love in the faces of this love built community. The connections built and the tools provided have taught me that not only am I a beloved child of God but I am also a representation of many like me who’s trials and tribulations serve as a testimony of the triumphs through HE who refines and strengthens us. At Newsong they don’t just preach, they teach through action. Wether you connect through the mix, kings table, seeds &sparks, moms ministry, kaleidoscope, live, conneXion, havens, casa hogar,  or any of the multitude of affiliates that enrich what it’s like to live out unwavering love through service. If you’re searching to discover true faith and uncover the divine essence of your story… then I invite you to come visit and maybe even discover what it feels like to finally be welcomed home. 🫶🏽 This community does not judge, and treats you like family. They meet everyone with love like Jesus would. No judgment, come as you are. This community has forever impacted my life and I will never forget how God moved in my life through New Song Church. My daughter invited me to this church and I absolutely love it. Great family church and the gospel is preached according to God’s word. Love this place and love the fellow members! Full of love and that's what we all need in the world right now. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a place of worship. Can't say enough about Newsong.

name: NewSpring Church - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary: Visited this morning for the 2nd service. It was nice that they have a special place for guests to park. Appreciated the free coffee. The worship was amazing and the message was equally well delivered and heartfelt. I have to admit I wasn't sure how I would receive the word from a live feed, and not in person....but it is high resolution, and didn't seem distant. We were visiting family from out of town, so will not be returning....but was very blessed. multiple boxes checked for a serious Christian. Many figs on their fig tree! God's goodness. NewSpring is truly a life-giving church, meeting you wherever you are in your relationship with Jesus, and helping you grow in your faith. Sunday services are always top-notch. Amazing worship experience from the music to the preaching. I always leave feeling closer to God than when I arrived. There are always ways to get involved with a community group and/or to volunteer/serve. NewSpring partners with and supports many local and international ministries. I love being part of a church that prioritizes the kingdom of God from inside the walls of the church all the way out to the ends of the earth. Last but certainly not least, the children's ministry (KidSpring) is truly amazing. Such a good job of teaching the Bible in a fun way that kids can understand. If you want a church, whose heart beat is to see everybody everywhere have an everyday relationship with Jesus, this is your church. They preached the Bible, they lift up Jesus, they encourage their members, and they served the community. They worship with heart and soul! Best church experience I've had in Greenville so far. Awesome contemporary music, relevant message, friendly unassuming people and incredible kid's programs. New Spring is the total package and is really committed to helping the community. Look for their new Greenville location to be public soon. If you are looking for a church home, this is a great place to visit.

name: Newspring Family Church - Jenks Campus
reviewSummary:
Denied me and my wife and 2 and ah half year old a few bucks in gas cause we’re sleeping in a car and I just needed AC! It’s over 100 heat index! He said for every group he denies another group can be helped. I guess a baby doesn’t deserve help from this church. Freaking gross. Have some empathy. The guy was too scared to tell me his name but he’s a real weak person. The youth pastor is doing what he's supposed to do.Thank you for going out your way to help my family Newspring is the friendliest most non-judgmental church !!!
Our pastors are very compassionate and knowledgeable of God’s word! Nice facility Great worship, Word being taught, a caring church, very friendly  and great fellowship

name: NewStory Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Everybody here is like a family. It is a great church for people with kids. My kids hang out Outside of church with people they met at church. In particular, a young man named Alistair, his friends with my child, And he’s such a good role model. He taught him about biblical principles, The golden rule, And a concept called scat. Some say a church Is made by its people, If that is true, this church deserves a five Great preaching, and great pastor. They have ways to get plugged in almost immediately and it helps people feel welcome and get to know others as soon as possible. There are many opportunities to volunteer, to fellowship, to get involved and to be part of the greater purpose of God for our lives. My church is incredible....and every worship service is like going to a Christian rock concert. We are a family....not just people that go to the same church. New Story is the real deal when it comes to partnership with other ministries and serving God joyfully.

The congregation and staff at New Story are incredible people who are willing to go the extra mile to help. We hosted a ministry fundraising event for Cru, a college ministry, here about a week ago. They helped coordinate the facilities, audio/visual, and everything we needed to make the event go smoothly.

After the event, we needed some extra help cleaning up and getting things back to how they were. At 10:30 at night Pastor Blake was still working hard to help us out after being there for hours and then two of the young adults who had finished up a missions meeting came and helped us clean up. I felt so cared for and served. It was a sweet picture of the body of Christ coming around each other. First time in this NewStory church and it was a welcoming experience and really good service and and good pastor. I definitely recommend you check it out and I will be back.

reviewSummary: I've been at this church 7 years and I really enjoy it. The Sunday sermon is deep and relevant. The people are truly kind and friendly. There are young singles, couples, families with little kids, and elderly folks, so you feel like a family. This community of believers has blessed me in so many ways.The staff and people involved are loving and compassionate to people's needs and will pray for you.  Please join us for Zoom worship on Sunday mornings at 10:15 am Eastern time. God has blessed us with many great people who love the LORD! I am thankful for our time together on Sunday - quality musical worship, prayer, and teaching through the Bible. I enjoy growing with God and sharing life with this wonderful community on Sundays, and through the rest of the week, too! I am from Namibia visiting Garrett Nicole and my grandchildren and visited your church several times during Summer Break. I was very blessed by anointed worship, good sermons and friendly NCC family. May God’s favour be poured out over your church. The NCC community is one that I always look forward to gathering with. Through worship of God, despite our differences, we have rich fellowship. Whether it’s on Zoom or in person, the service is always great.

name: Newton Presbyterian Church

reviewSummary: This is a nice local church. So glad they share their facilities with other organizations in the community. Great local church in newtown, with a nice community. Pastor Sam is awesome! Beautiful church and wonderful congregation of people..

reviewSummary: If you're thinking on sending your little ones to Miss Maryanne's little school she is moving to Yardley.  What a great way for you and your child to spend an hour together.  We loved it, think you will too.  Thank you for giving us a head start. Awesome place!  Pastor Ben is Amazing!  The cobgregation is very welcoming and friendly.  Fundamental teaching, small church..but growing fast! Doesnt matter how you dress, what religion you are..all are welcome! Great place to worship and a great praise band. reviewSummary: The congregation is so warm and welcoming that it feels like you've been there all your life! Highly recommend going to this church for a visit, such a lovely location, and the people are wonderful as well. There is certainly something for everyone at this church! The congregation is so loving and friendly. I look forward to renewing my spirit each Sunday. Pastor Rodney is energized and loves helping us understand and grow our faith. The congregation is so friendly. I feel welcome and not overwhelmed. So glad services and activities have reopened. Beautiful church, AA meetings are great and clean bathrooms! Wonderful Bazaar and chicken salad luncheon!! Thank you!

name: Next Chapter Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: It’s so wonderful to be back to a church that I attended back years ago and due to medical emergencies, I’ve had to tend to family members coming back and knowing that we have the same Pastor the same message our church is about, loving God and making you feel like your home:  thank you Pastor Shawn🙏🪽 I enjoy this wonderful church. I’m blessed to surrounded my self with such great people. Pastors Shawn and his team continue to deliver the word every week and never lets me down. I have grown so much in this last year with the guidance of NCC. Thank you and God Bless you Next Chapter Church.

name: Next Level Ministries - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm and welcoming atmosphere, followed by an exuberant worship experience with the man of God, Pastor Charles E. Jacobs! Non-denominational, but definitely  bible based teaching! I LOVE MY CHURCH!!!! Next Level Ministries is an AWESOME place of worship and an AWESOME refuge.  My pastor, Charles Jacobs, first lady, Tracie Jacobs, and their beautiful daughter, Myla-Joi Jacobs are "The First Family" of Next Level Ministries and we truly love them.  Come worship with us every Sunday for worship or every Tuesday @ 6:00pm for Bible study @ 1212 Commercial Ave.  Charlotte NC A Very Loving, Encouraging & Holy Spirit Spirit Filled Church, Where Everybody is Somebody & Jesus Christ is All. Great Service every time
Must check out Pastor Jacobs Spectacular Church, has a great community of believers and an amazing ministry!

name: nineteen:ten church
reviewSummary: Great place to worship the lord best church in borne paster Jason brown is the best so is staff and prais team looking forward to being there every time the doors open An amazing church I will go back! Great atmosphere very friendly people We are so grateful my Uncle introduced us to this church! We had a ROCKING great time. We learned so much from the sermon, and the Pastor gave us clear Biblical teachings, with lots of love and humor. We loved it so much that we are already looking forward to next week. God bless you all- thank you for being so welcoming,  and treating us like you've known us for years! Oh, and the worship is so amazing! This was our first time attending this church. We moved here from Kerrville back in December. I'm very careful with where I take my kids because I don't want to push them away from the truth by taking them somewhere misleading. As soon as we walked through the doors we felt the presence of the Holy Spirit. Worship and message was awesome. Definitely the right place to pick for our home church. This is perhaps the most welcome I’ve ever felt anywhere before! The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and fun. The head pastor and his wife legitimately care for the people in their community, and welcome first time guests with open arms. They are also truly relatable and very funny! I would recommend this church to anyone looking for outstanding, caring people to call friends and a church to call home!

name: No More Walls Church - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
Nolen Hills Church of Christ - Nolensville Campus
reviewSummary:
Nolen Hills is meeting at Nolensville High School,  but they are in the process of building a church building just down the road. They meet at the high school at 9am, then in home life groups on Sunday and Wednesday nights. All the members are so kind and welcoming!  They even have a time of fellowship between church and class. We are followers of Jesus but we welcome those who are not yet ready to make this commitment. We gather to worship each Sunday morning and our Life Groups meet in homes throughout the week to study, praise God, and fellowship. Our community is economically and racially diverse. There are young people and elderly. Some are married and some are single. Some have children and some do not. We welcome and want to love and serve this whole community. and good Christmas brother's

reviewSummary: Pastor and his family were very nice.  My children visited here for Vacation Bible School this year and loved it. I have been a member of this church for several years. I like the fact that we still have a traditional service. The love of Christ.

name: NoLimits Church - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary: LOVE your billboard sign I saw online, "..Where JESUS ain't WOKE!" Would love to stop in if we're ever in the neighborhood! " May God’s 🔥 continue to fall on your congregation.....to help wake up the nation! I truly do appreciate and love NoLimits church! You are welcomed with open arms and find out quickly, just like in Gods word He tells us we are not suppose to do life alone, well you don’t have to here, people are more than willing to come along side you to help and encourage you. Pastor speaks truth and love. He lives by example which helps you want to thrive and be a better version of yourself than the day before! The teachers love those kids and you don’t question if they enjoy teaching and sharing Gods word and love with the kids. Every Christian has a significant place in the Kingdom--in  the Body of Christ. Following Jesus isn't about going to church and going home. It's about finding your role in building the Kingdom. At No Limits, we attend service in order to be "sent out" into the marketplace to minister. I love the strong leadership here, and the courage to share the truth of the Word of God. The gifts are in operation here. The Holy Spirit is welcome. And "Jesus ain't woke."  Not sure what that means? Come and discover! The eyes of your understanding will be enlightened! I’ve only been going for about a month and a half now and I love no limits church, everyone is so sweet and so friendly. I have found God again with them and none of it is this “woke” crap it’s real and raw, No limits church has become a safe place for and a place I am excited to raise my daughter in, where no one is going to lie to her and she will hear his truth! If you're looking for a church family, then you needn't look any further!  No Limits Church is a church that has you in mind.  They are welcoming and show the love of God to others in the church family but also the community.  I have experienced this first hand by the members and the leadership who follow the Holy Spirit in all things.  Stop in and find out for yourself!

name: Normal Heights United Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
1st "In-House" service today! June 20th, with post Church June Teenth recognition! Sometimes service in Park across street, or hosting of bands in sanctuary for Adams Ave Music Festivals. One block south of Adams Ave,& west of Library. On bus route(s). Reverend Ross[Brent] has great messages and Asst Reverend Molly helps to keep Social and Coffee flowing!😃😇🥰🤗🎵🪕🎸🎺🥁🎻🎶🎹🎼

~~
Put up a series of Cross ✝️🌈 Art 🖼For belated Pride & Art @PrideSanDiego colors events. Here OUR stations of the Cross are modern pieces of Art.
At the last one is the children's art desk and in sanctuary creative space.
Join us NEXT week Aug.1st, 2021 to MEET the staff and more of the Church. Take tours, have coffee/tea.
Each Sunday for next few weeks we have Disability Justice series at 6pm, ask Tutam...available via Zoom also.
WELCOME Home in Love, Reverand Brent[Ross] and Assitant Pastor Molly to teach, Lo💞e YOU! Peace🕊 I discovered this wonderful church just a few years ago. I immediately felt the warmth. The love. When they say they are “actively welcoming” they actually mean it. It wasn’t just something they said, it was what they did. Actively. I loved looking around during the service. Every age and gender were there. All were welcome. Ahhh. I found my peeps. I have loved being a part of this church for the past 4 years! It is such a welcoming and supportive community, where everyone can be authentically themselves, no matter their identity or background. I especially appreciate NHU’s commitment to caring for the children in the congregation and for consistent outreach in the neighborhood. Also 10/10 recommend for anyone who has struggled with reconciling their faith after leaving evangelical spaces. Amazingly welcoming and low-pressure church environment for people looking for a community who is trying to follow Jesus together toward justice. This church really cares about its neighbors locally and across the county with hands-on opportunities to help without any ego involved. Love this place. Incredible church!! Queer affirming and teachings rooted in the Bible. Spectacular, loving and engaged community. My wife and I were able to restore our faith thanks to the great community and teachings here.

name: Norman Church of Christ - Norman Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a group of people who genuinely care about not just people's souls, but also their physical wellbeing for our time here on Earth - then look no further.

I visited the Norman area recently and about 30 minutes outside of Tulsa (1.5 hours out of Norman) my car broke down and my battery and alternator were both shot. Together with help from the congregation (its Elder and members alike), I was able to get these issues resolved, continue my trip, and be kept out of a really rough and upsetting situation. They worked with me while I was attending the local New Years meeting and didn't just tell me I was loved - they proved it and helped me fully feel it. They weren't just welcoming of me as a person, they let me know a deep level of love and kindness for their fellow man through their actions.

The meeting was also phenomenal, and I can say with complete confidence that while this is an incredible congregation, they are also a full on God-centered community that proves the follower's of Christ are more than like-minded friends; they're family.

They are exemplifying being lights of the world and salt of the earth. Not to mention the preaching at the meeting ! It was uplifting and edifying and really helped get me back into a passionate and dedicated mindset to start the New Year off right for the Lord.

As someone who was, at a point, considering just shelling out all my travel money on whatever was available and finding a way to drive home (due to being discouraged with my car and situation), I cannot thank them enough for their love and support. I also applaud them for their teaching and doctrine - which is Biblically based on direct scripture and Biblical example. They do not take liberties of exerting any of their own authority and follow God's directions to successfully produce much good fruit for Him (that He is so deserving of).

Thank you for everything, Norman Congregation. Staying for the meeting and getting to know you better was one of the best things that happened in my 2025 ! May God bless you all and your work for Him in the New Year and those to follow.

If you're in the area or looking to visit - 10/10 and would highly recommend you stop by this wonderful group of Christians ! God bless ! I have felt completely welcome from the first time I worshipped here over five years ago. The leadership is great. I feel totally confident that our services follow the commands from God's word. Anyone would benefit from worshipping here. It was wonderful to gathering with Christians last night. The groups singing is amazing! I am so thankful for the Norman church of Christ for organizing this year's meeting! We truly enjoyed this year’s New Year’s meeting and are so grateful for the work everyone put into making it a success. The facility was amazing, and being able to stay on site was such a bonus. The lobby provided a perfect space to gather, connect, and spend time together. We also appreciated the ample restroom facilities and how well everything was stocked—we never once ran out of tissues, soap, or other essentials. The hotel staff was gracious, professional, and a pleasure to work with throughout our stay. Most of all, the congregational leadership did an outstanding job coordinating every aspect of the event, making it a truly meaningful and well-run experience for everyone involved. I moved to Norman for OU and needed a church to help me grow spiritually during that time, too. I found family here, as cliche as that sounds. It's a group of people focused on glorifying God and showing love, and I couldn't ask for better. I've been a member here for like ten years, and I hope if people come to visit that I'm part of that welcoming, kind atmosphere.

name: North Atlanta Church of Christ - Dunwoody Campus
reviewSummary:
One of the more welcoming Church's in the area. A little over a month ago I first visited in my search for a Church in my area. This one out of the 5 I visited stood out.

First, the Preacher saw me on entering and made a point of welcoming me, the other 5 I felt like no one even knew I was even there.

Second, every Sunday including that one some of the members stopped to say hi and welcome me.

If your looking for a Church give this one a try, it may not be for everyone but you may find like me that it feels more like a family than others have. Great church and a great kids' program. They are big on giving back to the community in other countries. They're going to Panama in June, and that is just one of the places they've been to in the past year.This establishment is highly regarded for its wonderful church community and excellent children's programs. They demonstrate a strong commitment to charitable work by supporting international communities. Their dedication to outreach is truly commendable and inspiring. It is evident that they strive to make a positive impact beyond their immediate surroundings. Their efforts in contributing to global well-being are greatly appreciated. This Church isn't just a church. It is family. Pastor Don's messages are powerful and fulfilling, Missy is full of grace and knowledge, Jasmine and Christa are wonderful recovery ministers that put there ALL into the recovery ministry! And the children's ministry is out of this world!  This place has helped transform me. They truly care. Come and find out for yourself! You and your family will feel so so welcome. Best church I've ever went too, learn about God especially the starting point class, baptism, and the class after the baptism is amazing, I am so grateful to have met so many woman there full of love and grace to give to addicts and the no matter what squad is so understanding and with knowledge of there own experience and what God has truly did for them also I call the North Atlanta Church of Christ, home.
A place where Love is extended beyond all that my mind can fathom. My 7yr old loves the place as well.

name: North Austin Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: I have many great memories at this church. I've seen hundreds of low income families receive food and help through their faithfulness toward Christ. I have only one encouragement. I heard a message that was inspired by the teachings of David Platt who claimed that God hates the sin AND the sinner. My wife to be challenged the pastor on this and he asked where in the bible does it say that God loves the sinner and hates the sin. Read Romans 5:8. i visited for a while to realize that this church is a cult. they are incredibly intense, very emotion driven. the pastor was very manipulative and physical with me and my friends. everyone in the church follows blindly to anything pastor rick says. there is no one keeping him accountable. when i left some of the members wouldn't stop calling my phone and leaving voice mails but pastor rick completely dropped me. the pastor is unsettling. and the church has no windows. i asked one of the members of the church if they wanted to grab lunch with our group and they said they would have to check with pastor rick. and the pastor said no. this is after knowing one of the members for a while too. the ladies in the sparrow house can't leave the church without his approval. this church made me feel uncomfortable, mentally and spiritually I literally once walked past and they had the sidewalks full of people barbequeing, having loud stereos blasting, and being a obnoxious nuisance to people just trying to walk past without hassle, such as me. I've walked in the area other times and they won't give you one minute of peace without bothering you. As someone kind of autistic who hates blasting music and people bothering you for no reason whatsoever, it's torture. No staff on site during the week Very Blessed Church With God Working Miracles Through It. Pastor Rick Truly Knows The Word Of God. Highly Recommend To Attend This Blessed House Of God.

name: North Avenue Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary: This church features strong Gospel expositional preaching, confessional devotionals with emphasis on repentance, and brotherly love to one another in small group and large group fellowship. It's doctrinally solid, led by loving and mature elders. The preaching is thrilling because it adheres to closely to the word of God exalted and explained. I highly recommend this church! 3:00 p.m. worship is lively and engaging. The church is conservative and mildly reformed. Sermons are detailed and thought provoking. 10/10 would attend again. The most Biblically sound church I have ever attended. This is a very rare gem to find nowadays in America. Such a blessing. 10/10 would recommend. Excellent gospel centered teaching! Not a Sunday goes by I don't learn or understand something more than I knew before. Awesome place to worship god and pastor George is great people were friendly and welcoming

name: North Bay Community Church
reviewSummary: The beauty of the stained glass window is surpassed only by the warmth and joy of the congregation.  I missed it terribly while I was voluntarily sequestered during this pandemic.  After getting both doses of the COVID-19 vaccine, I deemed it safe to attend Sunday services again.  It was wonderful! We started visiting North Bay in May and joined as members in July.  Pastor Anthony has been such a "bright star" at the Church and is loved by many.  We searched for years for a church like North Bay and have finally found a Home. My husband John and I used to attend North Bay when we lived in Clearwater. We moved to northern Georgia 3 years ago and have not found a church as much as we liked North Bay. Pastor Danny is awesome and very friendly parishioners. Miss you all. We saw a Christmas concert at the Church, it' has a beautiful stain glass window that covers an entire wall. I was a speaker for Practical Grace in Alzheimer's Care at North Bay. Pastor Danny was welcoming, accommodating and down-to-earth; the sanctuary was beautiful. This is a church whose demeanor calls for further participation.

name: North Bethesda United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: My wife and l have been members here for 27 years. The people are kind, warm and welcoming. I saw your marquee on social media. Thank you, it means so much to be recognized. Kindness is free and can change so many lives. I have experienced the love and welcome here for several decades. They ars fun, intelligent, and innovative. All children of God are welcomed, loved and cherished here. Notices that United Methodist Church is a lovely church I love the people of the minister

name: North Bible Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
After much Prayer the Lord lead me to North Bible church. I walked through the doors not only new to the church community, but new to Arizona as a whole and I was absolutely blown away and overwhelmed with the amount of Love I received from total strangers who would quickly become my God given family. From offering to help me move into my new home to suggestions to prayers it was endless support and love and the definition of family meeting you where you are. Pastor Chad not only speaks Truth seasoned with grace but Loves like Jesus and leads with integrity in such an amazing way . Thank you North Bible Church for everything you have been for me! Moving to Phoenix, Arizona about a year and a half ago, we visited several churches before finding North, and once we did, we knew this was home. We have been here ever since. North Bible Church is extremely intentional about fellowship and community, which has made it easy to truly get plugged in. We’ve been able to get plugged in through men’s, women’s, and adult Bible studies, regular life groups, and meaningful opportunities to serve on Sundays. The church also offers ministries for youth and young adults. Worship is excellent, and the sermons are thoughtful, biblically grounded, and engaging. The pastors are genuine in their faith, faithfully sharing the Word of God and consistently challenging us to grow closer to the Lord. We are so thankful for this church, its leadership, and the Christ-centered community we have found here. I would highly recommend this church to both new and seasoned believers!! My wife and I have enjoyed our experience at North Bible Church. Everyone is incredibly intentional and welcoming, and it truly feels like a community. The teaching is rooted in the Word of God and encourages us to grow in our faith and follow Christ more closely.

Thank you North Bible Chruch! A Wonderful and Welcoming Church!

This church truly feels like family. From the moment you walk in, everyone greets you with warmth and kindness. The atmosphere is full of joy, and people are so friendly and social — you can really feel the sense of community here. The services are uplifting, and it’s easy to connect with others and feel included. Whether you’re new to the area or just looking for a place to grow spiritually and meet great people, this church is a beautiful place to be! My family and I have been attending North Bible Church for many years. Our children (13 & 9) have grown up in this church and I can honestly say that this community has been such a blessing to us. The pastors and leaders genuinely care about spiritual growth, and there’s a real sense of belonging. The community here is warm, welcoming, and supportive, and the messages are always relevant, encouraging, and filled with grace. North feels like home, and I am so grateful to be part of such a loving and Christ-centered community. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a church home!

name: North Brandon Church of Christ - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary: We have been members here at North Brandon for around 20+ years. We love the members that we know. This congregation is growing so fast which is wonderful but we as older members don't know all of the younger ones yet. Our two ministers are wonderful and both are very knowledgeable and you can tell both really love the Lord Jesus  🙏💖 North Brandon follows the gospel and striving to do God’s will. We have worshiped here for nearly 10years. We love the church family, elders and deacons. If you are reading this, come and worship with us. Not only to be filled with God’s word but being with like minded Christians who build each other up.  Matthew 7:24-25 “Therefore whoever hears these sayings of Mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock: and the rain descended, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it did not fall, for it was founded on the rock. Good biblical teachings last Sunday for my first visit. The minister spoke on being virtuous and based sermon on the book of Ruth. I enjoyed it and will return. I enjoyed my experience of visiting this church which has a welcoming pastor and congregation. Loved the service. Very friendly people!! If ever in the area again, will definitely visit again!

name: North Brunswick Christian Church - Brunswick / Golden Isles Campus
reviewSummary: Good church to worship friendly congregation and a heartfelt service Nice homily atmosphere, great people, and a real god loving place Friendly church This church is the friendliest you will find. The Word of God is preached, and the worship music is awesome!

name: North Campus
North Canton Church of Christ - Canton Campus
reviewSummary: Out of all the churches in and around Stark county, there are only two that stand out to me and really go above and beyond for their community as a whole in North Canton Church of Christ is one of them. They really make their members feel like they truly care and they also take great care of their non-members that need additional help with food and clothing. Everyone who volunteers there is super nice and all the clothes and products and food that are given out are great quality good wholesome stuff. The guy who controls the parking for the food pantry is not friendly at all. He was very rude and controlling. We ending up leaving empty handed. The food pantries in Akron are nicer than these people. Best clothes give away ever. My friend had just had her baby & I was able to get a 18gal tub full for her in one visit. Truly a blessing 🙏🤲🙌. They also have a food giveaway. Giveaway days, times, & registration is on their site or just come in on the last day if all slots are filled. There is definitely enough for everybody. I went to this church for both a food & a clothing donation, & came away with a couple weeks supply of food & a whole new wardrobe of clothing. They get a warehouse full of clothing, nicely donated by Clothes Mentor and Plato's Closet, from stuff that they don't purchase from their sellers, if the sellers choose the option to donate what is left over. The staff were genuinely loving people, & truly helpful. This place is a blessing! Thank you. They are absolutely wonderful at this church they show a true love and caring for people of all ages and nationality they do a lot to help in need

name: North Central Church of Christ - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: pretty chill ngl Great people, easy to get plugged into community, wonderful children's programs for all ages, adult classes of various types, leadership is always open to questions with one on one discussion, small groups. You can check out sermons on website. We love Steve Kenny preacher great teaching & very down to earth guy that's very approachable. Great day with daughter and her family they had a beautiful wedding shower for Trista and Jacob the ladies did a wonderful job Pretty chill ngl Been a member for all my life

name: North Christian Church
reviewSummary: What a wonderful experience! We studied from the Bible with a moving sermon from Matt. The people are very friendly and make you feel like family. Turned me away. Salvation Army closed for 2 weeks. I just need fuel and food I voted here and what a professional set up hope they do the same for the general election I go to a Wednesday Bible study, don't know anything about the church. It made a nice place to vote.

name: North Christian Church (Disciples of Christ) - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: Always a relaxed, welcoming group of inclusive people who invite you to come as you are and to be who you are. Communion is celebrated each week in a relaxed God loving atmosphere. Sermons are on social when you cannot attend. Lot's of fun ways to be involved, to serve others, and to grow in Christ. North Christian shares space with Destiny Fellowship Church. Some of the most dedicated and courageous people you can know.

name: North City Presbyterian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
My son goes to prek at this school. Great staff and good classroom settings to prepare him for kindergarten. Very good 👍 Today was our third week visiting. We were not disappointed. Great preaching, very friendly people. Talented teachers
Lots of options for kids to play
My son loves this preschool This church goes out of it's way to give back to local families, offering a food distribution site once a month.

name: North Coast Calvary Chapel - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church for the first time today, and I was truly impressed. From the moment I arrived, the community was incredibly welcoming, making me feel right at home. The pastor’s message was captivating and inspiring. It really held my attention and gave me a lot to reflect on. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I’m looking forward to attending again and getting more involved. The day I sat down in this church, my life changed. I encountered God in a real way and everything shifted for me. I found not just a place to worship, but a place where I truly belong. This church became my family, my support, and my tribe. This church has been such a blessing in my life. The sermons stay rooted in Jesus and His teachings, with no political agenda—just faith, love, and truth. The church itself is beautiful, and the people who attend are some of the best souls you’ll meet. Ryan’s messages always leave me feeling hopeful. I’m so grateful for this church. It’s refreshing to hear messages that focus purely on Jesus and His teachings, free from political influence. I feel at home here every week. ❤️ So went here for the first time tonight. Looking for a home church while I live in Carlsbad.

On my drive here there was a white Honda that kept cutting people off and wouldn't let me over when I had my blinker on for 2 blocks and low and behold they were coming to the church as well. Hmmm.

The pastor was great, the message right on , no checks in my spirit. The worship was very good. The campus is beautiful. (the reason for my 4 star rating)

But no one talked to me, or said hi, except during the time the pastor said to say hi to those around you. Everyone took off as soon as the service was over. Didn't look like there are a lot of close relationships here.

I will probably give it another try next week to see if it remains the same. This place rocks they have so many programs for every age level... coffee house for Fellowship afterwards lots of classes for Seekers during the week people that are not clear on their faith and the Sunday service is always educational love the compass and the people here. It's a great welcoming Church

reviewSummary: OK, so I have been on a journey.trying to find a church that truly felt like home. I was raised Catholic, but for a while there I was only showing up at Christmas and Easter, and I knew in my heart I needed something more. Something that would light me up inside and that I'd actually be excited to bring my whole family to. And then I found North Coast Church, and honestly? It changed everything. What I love most is that they offer so many different types of services , a Latin service, a more contemporary rock music service, a live music service, an outside service,  so even though it's a large church, it never feels overwhelming or impersonal. No one is forcing anything on you, which I deeply appreciate. And Pastor Chris Brown? He is just so wonderful. North Coast is a church on a mission, and you can feel that the moment you walk in. If you are searching for a church home, please do yourself a favor and check them out. Go to a Brownie with Browns event, it's a great way to get to know the mission and the heart behind everything they do. I'm so, so glad I found them. North Coast Church has been such a blessing to me and my family. From the moment we walked in, everyone made us feel genuinely welcome. The messages are practical, biblical, and encouraging, and the worship is uplifting every week. I also appreciate the wonderful programs for children and the strong sense of community. Whether you’re new to church or looking for a place to grow in your faith, I highly recommend North Coast Church. It’s a place where you can truly feel at home. Im 14 and have been going to north coast church since i was almost 2! This is my favorite place ever! I always get greeted with smiles! This church is incredible . The church itself is awesome. Not a fan of the head pastor though. During certain presidencies he encourages people to follow the law and during other presidencies, he encourages them to break the law. There are quite a few other inconsistencies and actual issues he seemingly supports that goes against the Bible. I’m not the only person that has left this church because of him. I’ve met a surprising amount in my hunt to find a new church. Until I find that church, I’m listening to Lakepointe and Live Free with Josh Howerton. Give it a listen - it’s really good. If I could, I’d attend that church. I’ve never met a pastor that could make people so excited about the Bible as he does. I love ❤️ North Coast Church. It's a very welcoming Church that is active in giving back to the community with volunteer projects and the like. It's a come as you are Church, no need to feel like you have to dress up. Just come share God's love and teachings. 👣

name: North Coast Church Carlsbad - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
North Coast Church – Carlsbad Campus (not North Coast Calvary Chapel)
North Coast Church has been such a blessing for my husband and me. The Carlsbad campus has a relaxed, friendly vibe and feels like home. It’s a smaller campus where many people already know each other, so you may need to take a little initiative to get plugged in (volunteering is a great start, and life group)—but I've been going here for three years and everyone I’ve met has been kind, genuine, and welcoming.
The teaching is exceptional—biblically grounded, insightful, and refreshingly apolitical. I love that the focus stays on Scripture and spiritual growth, not politics. Chris Brown and Larry are both incredible teachers who bring the Bible to life with humor, depth, and historical context.
North Coast staff make a real effort to create a safe, accepting environment for everyone, regardless of background.
The Carlsbad campus has a great Saturday night service with dinner afterward, bounce house and games for kids, and live music—perfect for families. Plus, the church is incredibly active in community service and outreach, including the annual “Serve Your City” weekend when services pause so everyone can volunteer across San Diego County.
It’s a church that truly lives out its faith, and I’m so grateful to call it home. Love North Coast Church. I've attended various campuses for the majority of my life. The church does a great job at being an easy to attend welcoming environment that stays true to Biblical teachings. There are multiple services and different areas to attend depending on your comfort and preferences on environment. Amazing Biblical teachings. Especially by lead pastor, Chris Brown! This campus is VERY clicky and unfriendly. It's been shocking really. Even the staff won't make eye contact and smile at you. Pretty tough for new folks. Especially for someone that has to attend church alone.Tried a Life Group so maybe I would know a couple of people on campus and after attending and running small groups for decades the group at this campus turned out to be the most WORLDLY and hateful group of folks I have ever met at church  with the leaders being the worst of them all Modern day Christian church. College like Bible focused teachings. Great youth classes/groups. Its all about the kids! They have different venues for different worship styles. The main campus is in Vista, this Carlsbad campus has the sermon streamed on a large screen. I like that the attire is casual, and no worries if you are running late, no judgment. Christ-focused and Bible teaching church. Amazing leaders who serve their church, lead by example, and teach the Bible no matter what. Best kids program around too. Come check it out and be amazed with how God changes your life. Grace alone by faith alone through Christ alone revealed in Scripture alone.

name: North Coast Church El Dorado Hills - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Incredible church full of incredible people! The teaching is amazing and I love how people stick around and chat after service every Sunday. Easy to make great connections, get to know others, and get involved. North Coast is passionate about loving on and impacting the community. If you’re looking for a church to call home, definitely check this one out! North Coast EDH is great.  The campus pastor Erich is a great guy.  The community is really inviting.  What I appreciate is that I feel like people care when I am not there which is a welcome feeling.  The preaching is great, biblical and engaging.  Some people get hung up on the medium but I have never had that issue.  Pastor Chris and team are great and I leave each week wrestling with new concepts and fresh understanding on eternal truths.  Please come, join the fam! We love the community we have found at north coast. Our kiddos have also grown in their faith in the amazing children’s ministry. We are so grateful we found an amazing home church with awesome people.

name: North Coast Church Rancho Bernardo Office - San Diego (Rancho Bernardo) Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a family friendly, God-focused, welcoming community, I recommend North Coast Church. There isn't a lot of fluff to what they do, just organic relational ministry. The focus of the community is to grow each person's individual relationship with God and with each other. After checking out the main service on Sundays, I recommend connecting to a Life Group. name: North Coast Church San Marcos/Escondido - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: Best church in all of North county!! Great people and great teaching Pastors!! 🫶🏽🫶🏽🫶🏽 if you are looking for a community to get plugged into to serve, please his is the place!! reviewSummary:
The church itself pressured its members for loyalty above family and told me that while it was great that I was attending the church on Sunday mornings, and the church's school (Attached to the same building basically) mon-Friday with evening services on Wed. and Door knocking on Saturday - that it was unacceptable that my family wanted to have their 15 year old son home for Sunday dinners and that if I couldn't attend that i would need to consider other schooling options because "we cant bend the rules for some and not others"

name: North County Church of Christ - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
A Welcoming Easter Service at North County Church of Christ (San Marcos)
My son and I recently had the opportunity to attend an Easter service at North County Church of Christ in San Marcos, thanks to an invitation from his friend. While I'm not typically a church-going person, I was pleasantly surprised by the experience and we both had a really decent time, even participating in the fun Easter egg hunt afterwards.
The service itself was engaging. The hymns and songs they sang were quite good, and the pastor delivered his message with what seemed like genuine care and passion. You could tell he believed in what he was saying, which made it more impactful.
What struck me most was the sense of community within the congregation. Everyone seemed to know each other and get along well, suggesting a strong and established fellowship. As visitors, my son and I were met with nothing but inviting and friendly attitudes. There was absolutely no sense of judgment, which made us feel comfortable and welcome.
If you are someone who regularly attends church or are looking for a welcoming faith community in the San Marcos area, based on my experience, North County Church of Christ seems like a good place to consider. The service was meaningful, the music was enjoyable, and the people were genuinely kind. Not here but this review is for the school. My sister don’t like it. I hear the school don’t have support more challenging I have only visited a couple of churches in San Diego and did not get what I was looking for. After reading NCCC website, they had a lot of great information that was confirmed during my visit. They were friendly, warm, and welcoming. Many church of Christ are strictly biblical, but I love that NCCC incorporates practical life lessons. Also, their adult classes are very practical as well, which is awesome. We have only attended once, but they seems to have a really great children's program and I love that they have bible class as well as a children's bible hours during adult worship. I am looking forward to attending again and possibly placing membership. NCCC is a wonderful ministry-oriented fellowship that strives to stay focused on Christ and his bride the church. You will definitely enjoy the living atmosphere and you will grow in your walk with the Lord A nice and welcoming church. I've been going here for like 8 years and everyone is really welcoming.

name: North Decatur Presbyterian Church - North Decatur / Emory Campus
reviewSummary: Ive never been inside the actual church but they do have a small food pantry that is easily accessible from the street. A refrigerator (that could use a fixing) with food and some female personal items to take as you please. I'm grateful for the items though I have to say be mindful that some of the items have reached their expiration and aren't labeled properly. I found out the hard way. Still a big thank you to the folks doing a good work in the community. A God sent other religions and places of worship should do the same thing. The community refrigerator. Need bigger colder refrigerator. And it's hot out flavor liquids are needed, ice-cream too. I dig it but I'm a current member. We certainly take stands on social issues but the only "side" we pick is that of Christ.  Our motto "We Welcome All" is a guiding principle and unfortunately politics is everywhere and unavoidable. An amazing, smart, progressive, and committed faith community. Incredible worship with a strong focus on spiritual formation and activism. Great place for the kiddos and the old alike! I went to deliver food to their food pantry. Parking was very easy and convenient to pantry and a young man helped to carry my food boxes.

A real family church where you are noticed and feel like you belong Love my church family.  Pastor Carey is very heartfelt and well studied in his messages.  My Bible study classmates are more like brothers to me.  For someone seeking the true message, Jesus is trying to convey to us ... A close knit church family is as good as it gets Great church in Gwinnett. They have a wonderful, caring day care for kids. They have a Toastmasters Club there that meets from noon-1:00 pm. They are called the Suwanee Power Hour Toastmasters Club.

No motivational speaking here, the sermons are to help make you a better person instead of just making you feel better. I am happy to have found my new church home. I have been a member for 24 years and love this church. I love the diversity of my church. We’re all God’s children. The connect groups are awesome. One of the biggest youth groups I’ve ever seen in a church. Faith Builders Sunday school class is awesome. Come join us, you’ll be glad you did. From the time I was a girl I was drug to church, ive been to MANY. I used to be scared of bigger churches. Man from the first visit to NH, being greeted by the same big smile who still greets us each Sunday to the worship to the message it felt like home. I know your on here looking for a sign, to be honest with you I was bound and determined you know what it’s gonna just be me and GOD, no church.. I was HURT. This church is community at its finest, they have a group for everyone and everything!! They have a connection for you. They have diversity here. YOU CAN MEET JESUS HERE ‼️ I absolutely love my church. I visit other churches ever now and then and none of them even come close to Home. Church is never church as usual. Pastor Lacy and the Pastoral staff always teach the Word in a manner that keeps you wanting to hear more. I love the diversity of the congregation and everyone is so friendly. name: North Hills Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church!  I have always felt welcomed and comfortable.  The pastor personally greeted us the first day we attended and then actually remembered us when we returned!  The sermons are Bible based, encouraging, and challenging.  My kids love all their sunday school classes and activities like free, top-notch Vacation Bible School.  There are lots of groups for adults as well.  A great family atmosphere and overall fabulous church! I have been attending North Hills Church for 5... almost 6 years.  I want to share that this church is unlike any other church I have attended for several reasons.  First, the people are real, which means that they have made mistakes and can relate to where you might be; but they have been forgiven and strive to reflect God's Love.  Secondly, our pastors are down to earth, not acting like they have everything perfectly together in their lives, making it easier to relate with them.  Thirdly, this church will become a great support system, if you let them; meaning you have to get involved, active and become vulnerable yourself.  I remember the first time we came, we waited awkwardly, all alone for service to start and the most genuine man came to welcome us... come to find out later that was Pastor Jim.  I have had the pleasure of getting to know Pastor Jim better through taking classes, premarital counseling and going on a mission trip with him.  He cares so much for his church family, he is passionate about our church making a difference in the community and world wide.  Our other pastors are also excellent!  Pastor Lori is on fire for the Lord!  Pastor Jeff is very entertaining but is very serious about teaching the word and helping people find their purpose!  And honestly, I do not know much about the newest pastor, the youth pastor, but from hearing his sermon, he is committed to helping make disciples for Christ.  The office staff incredible and the volunteers alike.  I know that it is hard to figure out what reviews to believe but after reading my churches reviews I was appalled that anyone would post such untrue, unkind things.  If you try our church out and have a problem, it is only fair that you would bring up your concerns, NOT TRASH TALK..... it is an individuals responsibility to resolve a conflict, not gossip about it!!!! This is a really great community church! People really come together and help one another at this church the way the early church is described in the Bible! They set a good tone for how Christians should behave. 🥰❤️ This is a wonderful church filled with grace-giving people.  The mission of the church is to help people find freedom, so you'll find a diverse cross-section of people from all different walks of life and with all different backgrounds and experiences.  Come as you are but expect to be stretched and encouraged to better yourself and the lives of those around you.  Many of the regular attendees have amazing redemption stories, where they've turned their lives around completely and found grace and forgiveness from their past mistakes.  I find that inspiring... I mean, isn't that the big idea behind Jesus' whole purpose on earth?!  The church has also made an enormous effort to be a part of the community and to care for those who are struggling.  There are many free events for local families, a food program, and a large number of foster kiddos that participate in activities organized for them by church members.  I have 4 kids who have attended all ages/stages of the children's ministry, after having gotten to know the teachers/leaders in each classroom, I am confident that my children are in good hands while they are on the campus.  I really appreciate the children's ministry leaders since my kiddos are my #1 priority in finding and attending a great church. I am a 23 year old army veteran and I will say this church saved my life. I work with the kids often voluntarily. As far as financially they do the best they can. This church has a food bank and does many many events for the community. Every Sunday is amazing as is every Wednesday and monday and every other day I get to spend with these disciples. In a time my regular family left me the north hills family saved me. God bless.

name: North Las Vegas Baptist Church - North Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: This is a lovely church!  The people (who are the church, not the building) are warm and genuine.  My husband and I were welcomed right away, and have felt like part of the family.  A church is part of the family of God, after all!  We are finding where we can be helpful: Sunday School for adults, nursery care for the small ones, lunch outings after Sunday morning service, potlucks once a month (it's not a Baptist church without potlucks!), Midweek Bible study for men and women, supporting missionaries...come see for yourself.  You'll be glad you did. The members and leaders treat me and care for me as if I was their own family.  In this church we a committed to study the word of God and worship our lord and savior Jesus Christ.  Sermons are provided in Spanish and English. My family and i were members for about 5yrs. I saw alot of people get saved at this church. It was refreshing. Pastor Kevin teaches straight from the bible. So if you are lookin for answers and want to answer that call from the Lord, Visit. The people were welcoming and the message preached was straight from the Bible. I recommend this Church to everyone! The most welcoming church, great sermons.

name: North Long Beach Christian Church - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has an amazing congregation!  They are as diverse as it gets, no one is judged and everyone is welcome.  They say "Here you are loved" and they mean it.  If you are looking for casual, come as you are kind of worship - this is the place.  Comfortable enough to come alone or bring the whole family, they have Sunday School for the kids and a broad assortment of really nice folks for the adults to meet.  If you are looking for classrooms to rent, a place to have a wedding, a gym for sports groups, they have a large campus and can hook you up.  Check out their website and then check out their church! A great place to attend, especially if you just want to start fresh without any of the old "religious" baggage. Everyone is given room to grow at their own pace without judgement. Their motto is true: "Here, you are loved." This church is wonderful ❤️
They welcome everyone, so don’t be shy or nervous. Everyone Is so kind and respectful
I love this church so much ❤️ God bless this church 🙏🏻 I went there for preschool the teachers were so kind and taught me a lot I had Mrs.   Sonia she was amazing My familias & I truly appreciate the time & space given 2 US as WE mourned A GREAT loss in R Familias! WE THANK U SOO MUCH🙏

name: North Naples Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: The congregation is very friendly & sermons are always with meaning. The music, choir, concerts & light shows are beyond fanaminal! At times I haven’t been able to attend the Church svcs, but I’ve been fortunate that they offer a website to listen to the sermons while being at home! 🙏 So nice we can enjoy big bands concert often just for a modest donation,  the acoustic in the big concert hall was really good, big audience , parking lot very big, many availability and wheelchair accessible to the hall location Enjoyed music from 20 Harps playing all familiar pieces. The church recorded the hour and a half and sent it to each of us via email.  Additions to the program were Celtic dancers and a soloist. Show was excellent. North Naples Church was a beautiful place to worship this Sunday! The congregation was full of passion, and Pastor Mark Caldwell’s sermon, Afraid to Give, was powerful. He reminded us, "Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also." What a great way to start the week! :) My husband and I are so happy to have discovered North Naples Church! Friendly/warm atmosphere  and an outstanding Pastor.  We are home.

name: North Orange Christian Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: NOCC has been my church home for the past 10 years, and I cannot think of going anywhere else. I love serving alongside my fellow sisters and brothers in Christ. We truly are a community that loves to serve The LORD and others. As a mother of three and family of six ,I am super grateful for the support the church offers with their weekly food banks .I do want to say that it took me alot to go and ask for help .I've always had to much pride to do it .But I did and am so thankful for everything they offer without asking for anything in return .I do want to say that there is one woman there that makes me feel uncomfortable and almost I am a burden to her .It is burning hot out,I am pregnant and I stood in the shade just as the others did in front of me but she asked me to move so I did and apologized as I was feeling faint due to the heat and waiting .Then I get inside the older Asian woman asks me how many people are in my family and what their ages are .I told her no problem and proceeded .The same woman that told me to stand in the sun then proceeds to keep staring at me and when I approach the counter where they hand out dairy and frozen items she hands me a couple of bags rather then letting me choose two items as they normally would .I then asked if they had any dairy (Milk,eggs,yogurt etc)She then asked how many are in my family I again told her even though I already said it when I entered and had not received any dairy items even though there was several on the counter behind her .I then ask if I may have one container of the guacamole she has behind her as there was 10 .She seemed really annoyed and said oh my lord there is some on the wall over there can't you see ?I said I'm sorry I didn't .Then hands me the guacamole.I then asked if there was any milk .She says no they didn't receive any this week .I said ok and left .I don't want to complain .I understand this is free and nothing is guaranteed.I also am very grateful but it just made me feel down and like I was a bother or maybe she thinks I don't need the help .Coming down here after being able to support myself my whole life so far and now struggling was a huge thing for me to accept I needed to do .I would never take more then what my family needs nor take from others.I just thought this needed to be said so that hopefully others don't feel the same way when they come looking for help and are made to feel like they are stealing or are a bother. But thank you to all the people that volunteer and make this possible you are truly God's warriors. Seems like this place will turn away anyone that they don't see fit to be there. Church is meant to be a place of gathering and love and I felt neither here. I moved here recently and loved to use my old church as a safe place to worship and skateboard when we weren't in service. Do not come here seeking comfort, safety, or family. They will turn you away. Instead of pushing your community away you should invite them in and make them feel welcome in your community. "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you" We moved to the area in 2021 and started church shopping.  North Orange Christian Church was the first church we checked out.  We wanted a church with solid bible teaching, worship that helped you draw closer to God, a good Life Group / Small Group program, a Children's ministry and a Youth ministry, and NOCC  checked all the boxes.  It felt like home immediately, and the people we met made us feel welcome.  We never left.  If you are looking for such a church, come check it out.   You'll be blessed that you did. Went into the church office with a fellow brother in Christ to inquire about getting him some help. After he received a bag of groceries, we went over to a bench in front of the Chappell to pray, and I answered some of his questions regarding the sabbath. Less than 10 minutes after sitting there, Andrew, who helped us in the office, came out and told us we needed to leave immediately. When I asked why, he said there have been stabbings there, and the police don't want anyone hanging around. I told him we were fine that we trust in the Holy Spirit to protect us. Then he said it's the law and we have to leave! He couldn't tell me which penal code we were breaking, but to avoid confrontation, we left. It makes me wonder if God is working in this church when I experience actions such as this? Needless to say, I will not be returning to this church and I will tell everyone about my unbelievable encounter with one of many demons that do attend here!

name: North Park Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
We have never been more GENUINELY welcomed anywhere than at North Park Baptist Church in San Diego  from DAY 1!!
The Choir sings so very beautifully. Come listen to Pastor Glenn he captures our attention with meaning, knowledge of the Bible, humor and genuine love for us you will not want it to end!
Bring your family and be blessed!! This Church is welcome to all. I believe it's main purpose is to spread the simple fact of great importance which is. Jesus Christ died for ALL to go heaven through His sacrifice. This church is centered on this. All are welcome, no dress code , wonderful chior. These people really love each other. Was so blessed to hear great music and heart-praise. Great praise and worship of all ethnicities. I am not sure but this is no longer north Baptist church.

name: North Park Presbyterian Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
North Park Presbyterian Church is an amazing place to call our “home church.” My family have been members for nearly 9 years and I highly recommend it to anyone seeking to learn about Jesus Christ, the Bible and how we fit into God’s amazing story of redemption and love. Pastor Adriel and the devoted leadership team serve the church very well. Praise God for NPP. It's actually firstly known as OUR SAVIOUR LUTHERAN CHURCH.
And now shares God's Temple with The Presbyterian Church.
Our Saviour have Bilingual Services(Spanish & English) on Sundays at 9:30. And offers lots more of activities like: Bible Studies and Chorus Practice on Wednesdays at 5 pm.
Crochet classes, Youth group, feeding the homeless on First and Third Saturday of every month etc.

name: North Point Community Church
reviewSummary: Andy Stanley's 'practical application' teaching style is the defining feature. The environment is designed to be accessible to the unchurched. High focus on small groups ('Circles are better than rows').

name: North Point Community Church - Alpharetta Campus
reviewSummary:
We love this church and the pastor Andy is just the best!! He is funny and makes the Bible relevant to today's life. Great groups and people are so welcoming!! Music is top notch can't help but feel the worship music!! I visited this church a few times over the course of a year, and a pattern became hard to ignore. Each visit felt less like spiritual guidance and more like emotional pressure.

The pastor, Andy, often cried from the stage — first encouraging people to attend regularly and bring their kids, then crying for money to support various overseas missions, and later pleading for volunteers. The emotional intensity wasn’t inspiring; it felt manipulative.

The moment that truly crossed a line for me was during one sermon when he said, “If you don’t want to be a volunteer, we need your seat.” Maybe he intended it as a joke or something he’d heard elsewhere, but it came across as rude, insensitive, and completely disconnected from the reality of why many people come to church. Some people attend because they’re hurting, seeking refuge, or simply trying to reconnect spiritually. Not everyone is ready — or able — to volunteer.

A pastor should be mindful of the weight their words carry. Hearing statements like that made me feel the focus was more on filling roles and funding projects than offering genuine guidance or compassion. It’s not the kind of leadership I look for in a church. My faith has grown tremendously since we started coming to North Point. While a large church, getting involved in small group or one of the numerous groups like Starting Point, make a large church close. I am grateful for the community and limitless opportunities that have renewed my relationship with Christ and strengthened our family in every positive way. Beautiful repeating Christmas tree show with music every evening after dark, which can be watched from the comfort of your vehicle in the vast parking lot. Also take lovely pictures of your family in front of other lit up trees, which are automatically emailed or SMS to you immediately. Absolutely awesome church with incredible leadership. Pastor Andy Stanley is my favorite communicator. I had 15 members of my staff there for the DRIVE Conference. It was phenomenal!!!
