name: North Raleigh Chapel - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: I really enjoy going here. The people are very friendly. A great Church where the truth of the Word of God is taught Pure Gospel message preached Prompt and amazing

name: North Raleigh Christian Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a new church home, this a great place to worship. Small and intimate congregation. Point Church North Raleigh is a great place to worship and be a part of a spiritual family. If you’re not yet attending any church or have been “dechurched,” you can try to attend for 5 Sundays and decide for yourself. I was invited to NRCC almost 2 years ago and I truly enjoy the fellowship of this church and leadership. I have attended services, congregation community events and a few of the youth events as well. Growing up, church was very much apart of my daily life, however, as I have aged, my adult responsibilities have consumed most of my free time. My daughter is now a preteen and has always felt welcomed and has a sense of belonging with the Youth Ministry. She is always excited to attend and eager to bring friends to youth group on Wednesdays. Sam & Wally work so well with the students. I love that they feel comfortable to be themselves in a safe space where they can grow their faith and pour into each other. They make faith fun !

Pastor Justin is very sincere and down to earth. I'm always excited to see what pair of sneakers he is wearing during Sunday service. His sermons keep you engaged, entertained and I have appreciated the teaching at this church.  The praise and worship team is so talented here. Truly gifted. If you are a foodie, you'll fit right in. This is a church that loves food ! I volunteered during the new year for their charcuterie themed gathering. Everything was delicious ! The congregation is very warm, genuine and they always make you feel right at home. I look forward to returning this season. Visited multiple times and no one even noticed. I attended for over 6 months and the same people kept introducing themselves to me over and over. They talk a lot about being an open, loving, inclusive community but that’s not at all the reality. Decided to join my kids for Easter Service. Members were friendly and the service didn't put me to sleep so that is always a positive...lol. Hope to visit again next time I am with my kids.

name: North Raleigh Church of Christ
reviewSummary: Amazing people.  Great place to hear truth preached every Sunday.   I love that it is a come as you are place . I felt welcomed for their Bible study and the teacher used some great scriptures and illustrations A great time was had at church this morning it was very uplifting and the singing was wonderful Great folks who are friendly and loving! I like going to church here because I like to worship at church.

name: North Raleigh United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: I find this church to be warm and welcoming.  It has many ministries to enjoy including worship and music; group studies to attend including Sunday School classes, Bible studies, etc; and missions to share.  We are very open to people who are new in the area and interested in children and youth ministries.  In fact, we just added an additional minister for children and youth.   All in all, I seem to find my best friends at church.  Come join us.  You will love it here!  PS. New childrens ministry is taking place! I have been regularly attending North Raleigh United Methodist Church (NRUMC) for about 8 months now.  I consistently find this congregation and their leadership full of warmth, love, and a welcoming spirit.  There are so many diverse opportunities here to grow in Christian faith and to fellowship with other people of all ages (young children through older adults).  I’m currently vested in their powerful music programs and will soon be expanding my participation here as being apart of this congregation is so meaningful and special to me.  I invite others to please come join me in this lovely and enriching faith community. My favorite ministry here is the mission work that is both local as well as internationally. Our involvement in the organizations we support means the world to me. I get more out of going and sharing the love of Christ than the actual mission work itself. I am involved in our international missions (Peru and Mexico) and it is a great opportunity to see the world and develop friendships with other believers. I see God working at NRUMC through the faces of the people of the church.  We're growing.  We have new and old faces.  We have awesome worship services and one of the best music programs I've ever seen, but there is truly opportunity to build community and serve.  Christ calls us to make disciples of all the world and the best place to start is right here in your own backyard.  We have so many missional service opportunities that utilize the gifts God has given us and shares the love of Christ throughout the greater community.  Come check us out - we have families of all ages and fantastic ways to engage, be fed and to share the love of Christ! North Raleigh United Methodist Church has been a wonderful fit for my family over the last 17 years.  We have loved the preschool, kids, and youth programs for our daughter!  As parents, we have found a Sunday School class that is welcome all who are interested and appreciates various viewpoints and questions.  There are so many ways to get connected and serve!

name: North Ridge Bible Chapel
reviewSummary:
My wife grew up in this chapel and insisted that when we moved here we would continue going there. I was hesitant at first but after the first few times of attending it became obvious that the people here really love and care about everybody who walks in the door. As much as I enjoy the relationships I have made since coming to North Ridge, I appreciate that here the gospel is not compromised, and everything they do is guided by the Bible. They are a firm Bible believing church who seeks to show the love of God to all who walk through their doors. We are looking forward to raising our children in this community and hopefully watching as their children are raised here as well. Wonderful family of servant believers. Great bible-anchored God-centered foundational teachings, worship and study. Consistent prayer and attentiveness for the needs of the body. Purposeful local community and Worldwide outreach- great programs for the children too. Not ashamed to preach truth in a confused world. Excellent fellowship opportunities and lots of love! A great church to check out if you are looking for a new church in the area. Everyone is super friendly and shows the love of Christ to everyone who shows up. It’s a New Testament church which does the Lord’s supper each week, is elder lead, and tries to emulate the apostles teachings on how to do church biblically. The people at NRBC are the kindest, most loving group that I have ever been around.  It is truly a Jesus-inspired church family--a diverse family with individuals and families from about 14 different countries.
For years there has been an active outreach into the immigrant community, which has brought many to salvation.  NRBC supports members who are missionaries in Tanzania, Myanmar, and soon Abu Dhabi, to actively advance the Great Commission (see pictures).
If you are looking for a Christ-centered church family, with Bible based teaching, you should check out NRBC.  Come feel the love! Great place to worship, very friendly atmosphere.

name: North Ridge Church
reviewSummary: This family feeling at this church immediately rang out to my wife and I and we have been members now for over 10years. I still feel the same now as I did before, and with a direction to focus on Christ first the leadership team is driven to n the right direction. I had the privilege to attend Monday Evening's Bible Study Fellowship.  I'm, still, relishing the 'faith-filled' experience!   #raleighchristian   #northraleighchurch   #biblestudyfellowship Very friendly! They make you feel at home. I was touched by they way they welcome new people. Great pastors and leadership. Loving church atmosphere. Great Church. Great People and you will hear the full council of scripture!

name: North River Church - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: North River Church is my safe place, my family, a place where I can worship and praise God. I cannot imagine what my life would be like without NRC. Truth is taught. God is honored. Lives are healed. Everyone was friendly. The church is involved in missions internationally. The pastor teaches the truth from God's Word. I drove down from Birmingham to attend a men's group meeting with a friend that goes here. Everyone was very friendly. If I lived closer it would definitely be a church to check out for me and my family. I've attended this church for over 10 years. I started as a youth and have been a member ever since. This is a church that accepts you as you are but loves you enough to challenge you to be more like Jesus. There are some great people there just a little far from my house.

name: North Rock Hill Church - Rock Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
The preaching was great, the music was okay. We were apart if this church h for 18 months. We got filtered into a d group shortly after coming. We had an autistic daughter with ADHD and could make alot of the D group events because we didn't have sitters or my daughter being autistic would have melt downs.

Our d group told us not to come back, church leadership back them up and accused us of not being "on mission for Jesus" because we couldn't find a sitter or our child was having trouble and couldn't come.

Looking at it some years past, children should be our first mission and leadership over looked that, and there apparently isn't room to taking care of you family first when yound group takes priority.

So as long as you have normal kids, or stay for the preaching and not community you should be okay. We've only been here 3 times but every time we are met with warmth and love. The worship and sermons are very Biblically based which is exactly what we've been looking for. If you're looking for a place to fellowship with other believers or want to learn more about what it means to follow Jesus, this is a great place to start. We moved to Rock Hill approximately 20 months ago and one of our first goals was to find a church. We visited several that we found to be great but North Rock Hill Church really grabbed us. The preaching is totally bible-based and there are several excellent pastors preaching. The music is amazing sound quality is outstanding and people are just very friendly. I highly recommend North Rock Hill Church. Love this church great place to come worship. The people are super friendly. There is a great place for your kids to go. They have a great youth ministry just come by and give us a visit. You won’t be sorry. I love North Rock Hill church and the way that Gods word touches me in every sermon that I’ve heard. Their environment is so encouraging and uplifting, and displays the community of God in a beautiful way. My heart and relationship has grown so much through my college years by attending this church, and even now as I’m out of school, I feel as though this is a comforting and safe place where God never fails to reach me in any season of life I am in. Thank you, North Rock Hill, for deepening my love and understanding of our great God!

name: North Rome Church of God - Rome Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church! North Rome Church of God is warm and feels like home. There is something for everybody, and everyone is welcome.

The Pastor is great, and he teaches the Word. All of the various ministries are wonderful and seek to pour into you - no matter where you are in your journey with Christ.

If you're looking for a place to grow in the Lord, try this church. You won't be disappointed! Oh my, there are no words that can truely express how amazing North Rome is. I started church seeking in February and decided to try out this church and I tell you it is the best church I have ever attended. I absolutely love this church. So much love and welcome here. The pastors are absolutely amazing. If you are looking for a wonderful church home this is a place where you can make yourself at home. God is good all the time! If you are looking for a church who loves Jesus, a Pastor that preaches the truth in love, and a place to call family, look no further!  Worship is Jesus centered with a choir that knows how to open heaven and minister to Abba Father! We love our church!  Best part they are not afraid of the Holy Ghost!❤️❤️❤️❤️ Last Saturday OF EVERY month has a big feeding fit everyone homeless the needy or the not so needy and a pantry to take home to the kids or family in the NEED. Great people awesome dancers and singers. The pastor is a riot and loves to please everyone even if you don't believe but will show you what believing can bring to the table of hunger. Keep the great work up!! I thoroughly enjoyed seeing The Rome Passion Play last night. Joey Powers was exceptional as Jesus. I hope he 'rises' to the opportunity to do so again next year. Although I had a less than perfect seat, it was tolerable simply by the fact that I was able to be close to the spectacular singing voice of Ahmed Hall. His performance was phenomenal!  This was my very first time seeing this play. I urge everyone to plan on seeing it next year. Fair warning: arrive early and bring tissues. And be prepared. As stated: "This performance will change your life." ( or at least your outlook on it).

name: North Side Christian Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church. Just the right size to be able to meet and make friends within my first visit. They are a spirit filled body of Christ and they were friendly and hospitable during my visit. I was very moved by how much they prayed for and cared for each other as a church family. My visit left me encouraged and excited for what God is doing through this small body of believers. When I went to inquire about getting involved with their church using their Facebook messenger. Some person who runs their Facebook page made up a conspiracy theory told me that whoever that was would love to converse with me but since I didn't have a profile then that person couldn't tell whether it was legitimate. In other words the person literally said that my account was fake and if its fake then the said person couldn't talk to me. After showing whoever that was the person told me that it was 9PM and I needed to show my profile page to the person. I really feel like that was one way of him making me feel like an outsider and unwelcomed. I really also think that the person felt kind of inconvenienced and didn't like being bothered. I told the person that I was going to put that chat on here to expose just how the church treats new people. After I told him what he needed to hear he blocked me from their page as a way of getting back at me for bruising his ego. A great church that loves Jesus and cares deeply about the lives of others. I recommend this church to anyone looking for a church home. What a sweet group of Christians! The people here are so kind and Pastor Terry and his wife are caring. They truly love their neighbors!

name: North Tampa Church of Christ - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: My family started attending this church 2 years ago, and I immediately knew this was the church we'd call home. Everyone is so genuinely warm, loving and welcoming. I love that we sing traditional hymns! The children's programs are phenomenal. Everyone in the church has a chance to serve others in one way or another. It's life giving! The most important thing about this church is that they're Bible believing, and they go by the Book! I can't say enough good things about the preacher, Neal Pharr. Come check it out! Love one another, for love is from God ❤️ I visited this church for a service and was so impressed by Neal Pharr's authenticity, empathy, social awareness and kindness that I think I will make this my new church home. Very sweet little church with a good vibe. No crazy musical acts. No silliness. Just good people helping and loving others. Very welcoming, loving, and Spirit-filled church. The minister, Neal delivers engaging and heart felt sermons. I love the singing and communion devotionals! So glad our family found this church! Highly recommend it to anyone searching for a church to join. Genuine loving church!! Great people who strive to be active followers of Christ. Good children’s ministry with the sweetest teachers and plenty of events for families to be involved. Great leadership for their dynamic youth (teens) I have been encouraged in my Christian walk by attending here! This is a very loving and caring church family. We came here 3 years ago and knew immediately we were in the right place! All age groups are well represented, and classes are available for all. The Holy Spirit is working in our lives to help us be passionate followers of Jesus.

name: North Tuscaloosa Church of Christ - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: People welcomed us like we were family-which we are through the blood. Very accommodating. Comfortable, non stressful environment, with main focus on God and doing things according to His word. Look forward to going back anytime we travel through the area. We visited the church there and found it to be a very friendly loving church . Very knowledgeable of the Bible and everything done according to his Word . This place is filled with the spirit and influence of God. No better place to worship wonderful environment for the kids, countless smiling faces I visit there most Sundays and it truly feels like home for me considering being a member Awesome place to worship! Very family oriented.

name: North Valley Baptist Church - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is the real deal! You have to visit and see for yourself! Experience what is going on here! Pastor Trieber and all of the staff are a delight to listen to and then interact with. You will be helped when attending church here!  Good people that love and serve the Lord all around!
Photos are from a conference I attended there! Quality and first class!! Fantastic church family and pastor. You don’t have to see all the reviews to know that this is a God-loving, soul-winning church I visited while traveling through San Francisco, definitely one of the friendliest churches I’ve ever visited. Loved hearing a full choir which is rare to experience in a church. They have front parking for first time visitors, I was greeted by multiple people, and they even wanted to give me a Starbucks gift card just for visiting. I told them to just give it to next visitor but thanks. From a first time visitor perspective , this churches people  were as beautiful and kind as the building they meet in. I thoroughly enjoyed the services I attended at the North Valley Baptist Church. The music was amazing, the preaching was fantastic. I'm thankful that the preaching was from the Bible. Many in other churches like to say a verse out of courtesy, then proceed to give some speech about loving everybody. I'm glad there is a place that will tell you from the Bible things that you can implement in your life to be a better Christian. Visited NVBC a couple months ago and thoroughly enjoyed every moment of it! Dr. Trieber has the genuine heart of a true pastor and it is very evident in his preaching and his spirit. The preaching, music, and kindness of the people far exceeded my expectations. Enjoyed visiting Bro. Alvin Martinez’ Sunday School class, and greatly appreciated his kindness and hospitality!

name: North Wake Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
I love North Wake! I always feel welcomed by other members, the pastors and leaders are always willing to talk, and the Sunday services are always biblical and Christ centered. I would highly recommend you visit this church! North Wake has been our home church for a decade and we absolutely love it! There is a warmth, generosity, and humility at this church that is above and beyond what I’ve seen in most church contexts. We would love to have you join us sometime soon! North Wake is a church that is centered around Discipleship. As a member you are required to be part of a Small group which they have over 20 to chose from that work around any schedule. Each small group is centered around discipleship and accountability, which is done intentionally.
"The mission of North Wake Church is to reach the lost and equip them to join with us in becoming mature and ministering worshipers of God." This mission statement emulates what they teach and believe superbly.
If you are looking for a church to be challenged at, one that will make you dig into your heart and figure out the plan that God has for your life then you can not choose a better church in the North Raleigh area. By the way, the corporate preaching on Sunday is amazing. I have been attending North Wake for over 15 years and it is a church that is committed to sound teachings of the Bible and loving people well. I am so glad the Lord brought us here, we love it and plan to never leave! When I first visited, I was welcomed at the door by a local businessman. The folks providing childcare during the service were friendly and took time to chat. My teenager always asks to go to the Sunday evening events, and for adults the regular meetings and dinners of small groups are a highlight of my week.

name: NORTH.CHURCH - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: North churches been my home on and off since 2012 pastor Rodney fouts is amazing he preaches directly out the Holy Bible I love the ministry and what they stand fo Love Jesus Love People Follow Jesus. 🙏 It's on the service road on Memorial next to the main event center they have four services on Sundays 8: 00am 9: 30am 11: O0am they even added a fourth service at 12:30 a.m. in on Thursdays you get the same experience a few days earlier if you can't make Sundays and you work that service is at 7: 00 p.m. Thursday evenings come join one of our amazing experiences Seriously the greatest church I’ve ever come across!! my very first day i felt soooo welcome and immediately felt at home!! we have left okc a few years ago but i still think about this church all the time and the impact it made on me and my marriage, forever grateful for this community This is a wonderful place to be. Its a church established on the word of God. The atmosphere, praise and worship is amazing, and you can definitely feel the presence of the Lord. There are groups for all ages because they believe that no one should live life alone, and they invest in the children who will be our future leaders. They are currently renevating to make room for you. So come and see for yourself. You may decide that its the place for you and your family. A true church HOME! Yes, the worship is INCREDIBLE! Yes, the pastors preach some of the best messages I have ever heard. But what really makes this church home is the people. This church is full of people who genuinely just love and care about everyone. They are welcoming and kind. They are honest and vulnerable. They are my family. If you’re looking for a place to belong and be loved, this is it. I didn’t know anybody when I came to this church 10+ years ago. Now it’s become such a familiar and loved place- feels like home! The relationships and connections I’ve made have literally changed my life. My kiddos love Northkids, (1 and 3 years) and the app is super handy to stay informed about upcoming events and our Bible Reading plan. If you’re new to the area a visit to North is a MUST.

name: NorthCreek Church - Walnut Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful, Biblically-solid church! You won't get a flashy concert here- no dark rooms & flashing lights during the praise/worship songs, and we're thankful for that. We love the expository preaching; we've learned so much going verse-by-verse through God's Word. The church is really well organized and offers so many classes and programs for all ages, it's easy to get connected and plugged in. It's clear that they focus on teaching, and enhancing Biblical literacy- so important!! We've felt welcomed and at-home since the beginning. Our children have learned so much in their children's classes! This church does not compromise on Truth, and they are faithful to Biblical teachings. The bookstore has been a blessing, we know we can find trustworthy doctrinally-sound books & devotionals there. And the coffee shop is a sweet spot to encourage fellowship. We love it here. Long overdue review. I started coming here in February, and it is the one church that truly has me coming back every Sunday.

I came in with very little knowledge of the Bible, and from day one I felt genuinely welcomed. I am here to learn, and this church provides that and so much more. The teachings are clear, thoughtful, and easy to follow, which has made a huge difference for me. For the first time in my life, I am actually reading the Bible and understanding it.

I also really appreciate how organized everything is. From the services to the resources, it all feels intentional and well thought out. The app helps me stay connected, the podcast offers another way to stay engaged, and the live YouTube services make it possible to stay connected even when I cannot attend in person.

It truly feels like being in school, in the best way, learning, growing, and feeling supported. I am so grateful I found this place. Since day one, people have been welcoming, and the teaching has been genuine and relevant. The kids loved it from the moment we arrived. It’s a church that truly cares for families in a personal and meaningful way at every stage of life. How happy we are to have found this place! Our children enjoy themselves and learn with their new friends, and we feel encouraged and challenged to keep growing in God and His Word—both on Sundays and throughout the week in our home groups. WOW! What an amazing experience this church was! It's big and needs to be with the amount of members that attend. The pastor's breakdown of the message allowed me to completely understand God's word. The welcoming and friendliness reminded me of a small congregation. The Bible study left me eager to dive into more scriptures. I will definitely be returning and am looking forward to next week's message.

name: NorthCross Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary: Northcross is a fantastic family of people who love the Lord and each other.  It's place where you can feel like you belong from your very first visit.  If you're looking for church "Home" please come visit us. I love coming here every Sunday to worship with these amazing folks. Great community outside of Sunday morning as well! A very welcoming and supportive community. Blessed to worship with these people every week. This church is extremely welcoming and a great place to worship. Great place full of great people!

name: Northeast Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Most of everyone was amazing sweet and calm, food selection was amazing best I have seen. But at one point a older man with the church was raising his voice at my deaf brother in law I tried to tell him that he was deaf and instead of listening to me walked passed and continued to raise his voice until he reached him. I understand no one was supposed to be standing on that side of the hall but it's very disrespectful to raise your voice at a deaf person as if they will magically hear you. Also after that he went back to his chair than around 10 minutes later calmly walked over to other hearing people and politely told them to move over and get out of the hall. Other than that was amazing please don't let this post deter you church was great that just soured our time there. I felt that there must have been a better way to distribute the food, especially to the elderly and physically challenged people. Great place to come realize that the cracks in your mirror are not crevices but the roots that tie us all together into the family of God. They have the best pantry in town but they're rude to people. They have no organization to how they hand out numbers for pantry they don't care if you work or if you were at the church to get a number at 1am but went home bc your a human and tired and disabled wkth disabled children at home. Apparently you should just sit outside the church all night if that's what it takes to get a reasonable number. So even after going through all that I had to wait and be number 88. They don't not welcome comment or opinion on bettering the process. For those reason I have no confidence in the churches ability to deliver anything in an.organized or respectful manner and I wont be attending any services. Doing these things correctly are part of doing God's work. I am way too sick to sit outside in the heat and wait for someone to show up at a different te every week. I love this church!  It is exciting to see God grow his people here.  There is compassion for others.  And the Bible is taught as infallible word of God - absolute truth.  Worship is powerful.  This is a place that accepts you as you are, cares for your needs, and then teaches you what it means to know and trust God and his Word.  I am definitely fed here.

name: Northeast Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I were in Kentucky to visit the Ark Encounter in Williamstown on Saturday. We are members of The Crossing Church in Hannibal, MO and we seen Tyler preach at our church a few weeks ago. We decided that day, that when we came to Kentucky to visit, we knew exactly where we would be attending church service on Sunday. What an amazing weekend,  the ark on Saturday and NECC on Sunday. My wife and I enjoyed listening to Tyler's message....again. Thank You! God Bless Northeast Christian Church! Love the Ville!  So glad we found this church a few years ago, would highly recommend to anybody looking for a church family. North East Christian Church is a very good place to go worship. No, don't go back.  Two very short and shallow messages interspersed between songs. The traffic is total crap. Someone on stage draws a picture during the whole service - why? To be hip? Communion at the very end. When I moved to Louisville in 2019 I looked hard to find a church home.
This is a Bible based church. It's a non-demoninational church.
I'm a 62 lady. I love how they are not afraid to touch hard topics. They do not sugar coat God's message.
The music is amazing,  I love how they serve the community.  It's called Love the Ville.
The pastor is young, but his preaching is amazing for all generations to learn from.
Highly recommend.

name: Northeast Christian Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary: Small, personable church. Very welcoming!

name: Northeast Christian Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
I watch the Sunday Service frequently although I attend my own church now back in person. There is so much love in this church community by Pastor Newman and his wife, Ruth and members. His sermons are wonderful and based on scripture. The selections of praise songs are uplifting and comforting. Thankful for being part of this group even if it is online. Praise God for making it all possible. I grew up in this church. I have fond memories here, as we did Christmas programs and VBS. I can't say that it was the most exciting church i've ever been to, but it did leave it's mark in my life. Now I am a pastor and have been for 18 years. When I think about my spiritual journey, I always remember this Church. Thank you for sharing Christ with me and loving me as your own. May Jesus be glorified through you still. Me and my family attended today's services, and what a relief it was to walk into a REAL church! #GodIsGreat Hi, if you are looking to attend church to hear God's Word and be touched, NE Baptist Church is awesome!
I usually attend non-denominational - very thankful for the services!  Best Church ever, Pastor Gary and his congregation are the best. GOD IS GREAT!!!!!!

name: Northern Hills Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Have been attending Northern Hills Christian Church since 2007. Member since 2008. I was a single mom, dirt poor, and feeling sad and unloved. Northern Hills really is family! They took us in, were a good extended family when my own family were many miles away, and good example for my sons especially. So much love and comfort. Great Bible-based theology and teaches apologetics strongly. Helped me find jobs, helped my kids so much...then in 2015 for two years helped when I was diagnosed with Stage IV Colon Cancer. Helped us move, brought us food, took care of my kids and comforted them. Visited me in the hospital. These folks are the hands and feet of Jesus, as disciples and servants of Christ ought to be!  I am so grateful and thrilled when I can pray and my kids who are strong physically can help others with the church ministries in the community! Northern Hills is a great place to serve with fantastic Scriptural teaching and uplifting music! I moved to the area recently and got connected with this church. I have been very fortunate. Such amazing people. They have made you feel like family. I am also so very grateful for the two families that help me get from and to church. I'm really glad to have been welcomed. Such nice people. Friendly and caring church. Make you feel welcome but do not push you to join. I attribute almost all of the spiritual maturity I have today to this family. with a heavy focus on relationships and discipleship, this group is great at growing disciples of Christ in today's world. This church may be non-denominational, but they hold strongly to the Bible and what it says. Clean bathrooms, friendly faces, and good coffee!

name: Northgate Christian Church - North Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I can not say enough good things about this church they are loving non judgmental and welcome you with open arms and very outgoing I loved my first day so much that I knew that this is the church God wants me to serve at and I went to new members class same day I truly feel blessed I found a home so soon please if your looking for a family church look no further and come home thank you Northgate for being biker friendly lol ❤️ So welcoming such a great perfect size for wanting a new home for sundays morning worship this place will make you feel like you belong You go to warn those who need to get it right God is always wanting to correct us but are we willing to repent and do what God tells us is the question,visited and was glad I was obedient to what God was saying and went out to my next assignment, Jesus is Lord! Can't get into God unless you receive His Son Jesus Christ as your Lord and Savior. John 3:16 This church feels like home and I love the way the pastor preaches. I'm proud to call Northgate Christian Church my church. The sermon was great, everyday needs backed by the word of the Bible.
Praise team needs learn to lead and not put on a concert as well as changes the beat from song to song !!!

name: Northkirk Presbyterian Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been wonderful.  I am so glad my family and I decided to start attending.  My two toddlers get so much love and attention here and I am thoroughly enjoying participating in the music program, especially the bell choir.  Pastor Claire is one of my favorite people and the church community has been so welcoming. 😊 We’ve been searching for a church for a long time, and it looks like we’ve finally found our home. ❤️ Great church, I just wished they would get a little more creative with the signs out front. I have so many funny ideas My husband and I have found Northkirk and it's members to be very warm, friendly and inclusive.
I'm often blessed by Pastor Martin's sermons which are always interesting, inspiring and Biblical.
The music here sets your heart to praise and joy!
The choir director is truly gifted and we enjoy her selections so very much as she inspiringly leads the choir.
The bell choir, and gifted musical individuals really lift your hearts in praise to our Heavenly Father when up front praising the lord.
It's a small church with a big heart for the Lord and others! My home church and I love it here. The people are friendly and it does not take long to feel like family. If you love music, this is the place for you! Our music director embraces people with all kinds of musical talent and has a knack of bringing out the best in people. Even if you are not sure you can sing or play very well, he will still let you participate and soon you will blossom. I have seen it over and over again with many members. We have had to use your Church twice for family funeral services and out was like were at home I loving arms.
Thank You All

name: Northkirk Presbyterian Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been wonderful.  I am so glad my family and I decided to start attending.  My two toddlers get so much love and attention here and I am thoroughly enjoying participating in the music program, especially the bell choir.  Pastor Claire is one of my favorite people and the church community has been so welcoming. 😊 We’ve been searching for a church for a long time, and it looks like we’ve finally found our home. ❤️ Great church, I just wished they would get a little more creative with the signs out front. The choir director is truly gifted and we enjoy her selections so very much as she inspiringly leads the choir.
