Thank You All

name: Northlake Church of Christ - Tucker Campus
reviewSummary: I was a member there many years ago for about a year while my family and I were going through many traumas; the main one being that my daughter was fighting in Iraq. The people there are helpful, and just as friendly as I remembered. This is a predominantly White, mixed congregation.😊 If you like acapella music, They are a home run.  My home church has keyboards, guitars, drums and a host of other musical offerings that while most of the time touches my spirit, can sometimes overwhelm the message of the songs... This was a delightful change. To hear very decent vocalists leading the congregation who were actually worshiping with thier voices, songs in 4 part harmonies.  It was a pure musical delight that moved my spirit toward the divine.  The congregation has a fair amount of diversity and all are encouraged to participate as they are comfortable.  I  felt at home right away. So nice to visit a Church of Christ that made me feel quite welcome. The Minister showed me again what fellowship is all about, since my last church let me down and set me up for failure. I still care for the members of my last church, but leadership needs to communicate better to retain members and assist those who really need help. Church was great. The songs were beautiful. I enjoyed the word delivered on this particular Sunday. They made me feel right at home. Thank you I look forward to another visit indeed. Are you looking for a church that will welcome you with unconditional love and open arms ? Look no further this has been my church home for over 13 years . We REALLY do welcome everyone even imagrants and refugee family's. Their are classes from 1year olds to those who are senior citizens. In worship service we don't use any musical instruments not even a piano we use our voices to praise God. If you like my review come visit my wonderful church family I promise you won't regret it . Hope to see you soon.

name: Northlands Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary: I cannot describe how ecstatic my family I are to have found a church home in Northlands. Northlands is a Spirit led church that deeply grows your relationship with Christ and also teaches you the importance of community and having a 'healthy home.' Thank you to our elders, leaders, and every member of Northlands for being the hands and feet of Christ. I love being a member here at Northlands! I am proud to have this church as a home if you will. Everyone is so down to earth. You will be welcomed with kind hearts and gentle spirits. We really are one big family here at Northlands 🤍 If you haven't already joined us, come check us out! You will love it here 😁 We recently moved to Northlands from a larger church and couldn’t be happier! While we loved our previous church, we were craving a smaller environment, a tight-knit community, and sound biblical teaching. Every one of those desires has been met—and then some. If you’re looking to go deeper with Christ and connect with a community that genuinely cares, this is the church for you. NorthLands message of Grace and Discipleship have changed my life. I have been attending services and small groups there for a few months now. Just resecently took the leap of Faith and joined the body. I am a greatful and proud member of the NorthLands community.  They make me feel so welcome and have opened my eyes to the possibilities that are in my near future.  Thank You, to all the people who love on me. You are truly special! Love We love Northlands! Aside from the great community, we most appreciate the thoughtful, honest, and spirit-led leadership. Our kids (middle and elementary aged) love it, and we've enjoyed both Sunday morning and small groups throughout the week. We have seen the church show up again and again for friends in need, care for us through my husband's deployment, and really listen when we had ideas or questions. We are so grateful for this church!

name: Northminster Presbyterian Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Thank you for a great place for voting. It was good  to be there Very welcoming  Worship and Praise

name: Northpark Baptist Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: This church has been a Lifeline for me. Every member feels special and recognized. This is where my Dad's Memorial Service was held.  Beautiful church and the Pastor was very helpful and caring with my family. Pastor Sal clearly teaches the Bible. We have been blessed attending this church.

name: NorthPark Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: This church is our home and it feels great to walk in the door every week and say hi to people we love and care about. Pastor Robert is a Phd and it shows in his sermons, as they reflect a lot of time and effort. Highly recommend. We enjoyed worshipping with North Park Community Church today. We felt the move of the Spirit from the wonderful Greeters, the Praise and Worship singing and the God filled message which was the highlight of the service. I used to attend church here a while back and loved it! I see a new pastor though, what happened to Dave White?

name: Northpoint Evangelical Free Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: Northpoint EVFree has been my second family and they have been like my backbone, when I needed a shoulder to cry on I knew that I had plenty of sisters to call and they were at my side. I have been attending this Church over 30 years and I have loved it. The verse that has been in my heart is John3:16. This church is wonderful.  It also hosts the concerts for Corona Synphony,  yes our city of Corona has a synphony and they are great.  The church also hosts concerts from Cal Baptist University, one of the greatest university choirs and orchestra and ensembles.  The pastor is a well versed pastor. I'm a guy who keeps to himself, yet I've managed to make friends with several great guys who love the Lord. I look forward to Monday night bible study all week and Sunday morning teaching is the best I've found. The kids programs are really good to. Beautiful church, plenty of parking Went there to hear the CBU orchestra and choir, the music was amazing. Notthpoint is a beautiful church,

name: NorthRock Church
reviewSummary:
My favorite church in San Antonio, so organized, everybody is so friendly, great sermons,  the lead pastor is so unique, the anointment is huge, in a down earth way , simple , powerful full of grace.. the way it should be....every time I get the chance to be in town, this is the place  that I'm looking for. The holy Spirit has always something for me  in here.... God bless I’ve been attending NorthRock Church for a year now and I love it so much! Everyone is so friendly and I love the NR community. I’m from Buda so I drive about a little over an hour to get there, but it is worth the drive every weekend! All of the speakers (lead pastors, other campus pastors, guest speakers, etc) are outstanding. They do amazing services every time, and they do a great job blending the scripture with the message. I’m also thankful for the note pages they hand out before service starts because it helps me follow along with the sermon, and it gives me something tangible to share the sermon with others. And the worship is phenomenal! I could go on and on about NRW because the worship team is amazing. I’m super happy that they started releasing original music because the songs are moving, they are written from scripture, and I listen to them all of the time (they have stayed in my top three artists on Apple Music each month of 2026 so far).
More importantly, even though I’ve been a Christian my whole life, NorthRock has deepened my faith and helped me grow in my relationship with Jesus. I truly believe that He was speaking through Pastor Jonathan’s messages, and I’ve felt His presence so much that I was moved to get baptized during baptism weekend this April. Now I’m serving on the production team (I just did my first weekend) and I love it! Overall, I’m so grateful for everything He has done for me through NorthRock Church, and I’m blessed to call NorthRock Church home. I couldn’t tell you how grateful I am for this church, and my now church family. It almost brings me to tears. For years I was so far from God, but started to attend every Sunday and NorthRock really helped me find my way into relationship with him again. I’d never truly surrendered and lifted my hands in worship ever before until I finally felt the presence of the Holy Spirit here at NorthRock. Everything completely changed for me. Wonderful pastors, wonderful church, and absolutely wonderful community. Please feel welcomed here because you are! ❤️ I learned about your church through  Britton Moore from the voice and since then i follow you on line every Sunday. I love very much how oastor Jonathan does the sermons and especially  can't wait to listen to worship team singing beautifully worship songs especially  Britt, he's very talented and faithful i love him so much and is always a blessing and a pleasure to hear him sing. Love your church. I visited this church for the first time and it was pretty nice. I enjoyed the worship and sermon and I thought the atmosphere was good. My only thing was that when leaving i saw they had a person dressed up like Spiderman taking pictures with the kids. Which i mean i understand maybe its fun for the kids but i just personally dont believe that is something that should be brought into church. I believe all those worldly things should be left at the door when your stepping into the house of God and we shouldn't treat Gods house like an amusement park. I understand that non denominational churchs try to make going to church fun but theres a different between making church fun and disobeying Jesus words when he said to not make his fathers house a den of robbers. Its a bit contradictory because the pastors message was about the fear of God and how we shouldn't be to casual when it comes to our relationship with God and not forgetting that He is holy therefore His home is holy and im sorry but Spiderman doesn't belong in a holy place. Leave all that stuff at the door. The greatest superhero is Jesus anyways.

name: Northshore Bible Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Very beautiful experience. The church was welcoming and warm, the building was nice too! Been a member of this church for years.  Love it!! One of the most comfortable places to be with Jesus. Our home church for the last 35 years! Love the environment

name: Northshore Vineyard Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up in a Vineyard in Louisiana and I started listening to this branch online after I moved to Tennessee.  My husband and I like visit the church when we make trips to La.  I love the people at this church.  I've known some of them for a very long time and every time I see them it's as if no time has passed at all.  I'm always welcomed with open arms.  Vineyard is the most comfortable and welcoming church I have ever been too.  I absolutely recommend visiting if you are looking for a church that will feel like a home and a family. This is the most beautiful Christian family experience. I've found at any church. Every Sunday, i learn more about the bible and my faith. Opportunities to volunteer in the community and women's events are abundant. Very nice group of people attend this church.  The pastor is very personable, the music is good and overall the church members are very friendly.  Enjoy visiting this church when I visit my sister and brother-in-law who are  members. Very casual and laid back. Pastor Chrispin is truthful and funny as well. He draws you in. Ms Judy is truly hospitable. Will definitely go back. Great church to belong to non denominational church they just put the word of GOD out there for you to come and hear the message from GOD that HE loves you
So you are invited to come and join us for worship on Sunday 1030 a.m. on Wednesday night they have the women's night and Thursday night it's celebrate recovery for the Men
We also have different functions like concerts at the park and the landing in Covington
It's a small church but we welcome everyone to come and join us
We look forward to seeing you

name: Northside Baptist Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary: A Baptist church that preaches the gospel and has a wonderful choir that sings contemporary music, and on one occasion Pastor Robbie sang lead and it was positively inspiring. We LOVE NBC! Pastor Robby speaks the word and makes you feel like he is talking straight to you. The church as a whole makes you feel welcome and included. There’s a group for everyone. This is the most welcoming church I have ever been to; pastor Dr Robby Foster teaches about Christ in a way that brings Him home to our lives. Plenty of activities for seniors as well as young people. Very happy and joyful place. Went as a guest to the student group led by youth pastor.  I'm a 51 year old full time student.  Extremely active youth group and they were all so nice, polite, active and respectful.  Something I truly find lacking in much of Today's youth but not here. Also one of the adult Sunday school classes brought Thanksgiving dinner to the sober house where I reside shared God's message and took time to make sure we all ate well. Very impressed by all I saw from this congregation. The people at this church are very friendly and welcoming. The Pastor, Dr. Robby Foster, is wonderful,  teaching Bible based lessons that are not only informative but very interesting.  The choir is fantastic. You can feel God's presence here and feel the love that the staff and congregation shares for anyone who enters. I am so glad I came to this church after moving to Valdosta. I was welcomed with opened arms and have a great Sunday School class as well. Come visit us, you'll love it, too!

name: Northside Campus
Northside Christian Church - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary:
The wife and I are transplants to the area and we've been looking to find a Church home. We think this is the place! The service was engaging and overall excellent. The staff and people in the congregation were all very friendly and inviting! We will return for sure!! Good and clean place
They allow you to rent the place My son was in the mothers day out program and he came home with a busted lip. I called and asked what happened and no one knew. I brushed it off and took him the next week and when I picked him up his cup was still full of pedialyte meaning they didn't give him a drink from 9a.m. - 2p.m. They refused to give me my $80 enrolment fee back for the next month and also donated our $50 nap mat wothout calling to let us know. (They did call and ask me to pick up but my husband forgot.) Still could've at least gave me a courtousy call! Excellent Christian Community and brotherhood, I am feeling like big family Friendly people. Nice service. Loved it.

name: Northside Christian Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been attending Northside for a year now and really enjoy the people. Recently became members. Music is good. Modern but not too crazy. Good mix. Sermons are great and you always get a warm welcoming feeling from those who attend. I've been going to Northside Christian Church for 14 years now, All I can is ""**THIS IS AN AWESOME AMAZING WONDERFUL 💓 FRIENDLY CHURCH**""!! Sunday School classes range from Little Ones on up to Seniors, We also have A Babies Nursery, Toddlers, and alitte older ones, And The Youth Have An Awesome Time With Our Youth Minister Sophie. Our Pastor is Aaron & His Beautiful Wife Michelle, and their two Teens. Sunday School starts @ 9:45am, and Fellowship in the Dining Hall is @ 10:30am, and Our Church Service is @ 11:00am..
Our Motto is...
""**COME & SEE**""!!
HOPE TO SEE YOU SOON.. We attended this church while we were stationed at Fort Benning for nine months. Despite the fact that we were going to only be there a short time, the church enfolded us into their community and we could not have felt more loved, welcomed, or taken care of. We learned a lot during our time at Northside about how the body of Christ is supposed to work. It was an incredibly refreshing time for our family, and we will go back in a heart beat if we ever move back. Visit often. Love the atmosphere and fellowship. Great way to start your Sunday! Caring group of people. The minister and his wife are very sweet people.

name: Northside Christian Church - Macon Campus
reviewSummary: I am here as a parent of a Springdale elementary school student to say thanks to the folks at Northside Christian Church for redoing their parking lot to accommodate us springdale parents and our cars looping through their parking lot every morning and afternoon.  I think it says a lot about the leadership at this church and their hearts when they do such a kind act for their neighbors and community. Thank you so much for all you do! 💗 Looks like a great place to go and worship but we were there to vote I was there for an event not associated with Northside Christian church. It was clean. They staff of the church were very helpful. Neighbor helping neighbor! New minister is a sweet person and the members are wonderful. Very light warm atmosphere...love it!

name: Northside Christian Church - Spring Campus
reviewSummary:
I want to shout out my church for allowing my new wife and I to use the grounds and Volunteer Central for our wedding. Our church is amazing and Pastor Dave performed an amazing ceremony. Numerous people told me they felt the Holy Spirit at our wedding. Thanks for being kind and allowing members to share a special day in their lives.

Kenneth and Delaine Kinkel I’ve been a regular at Northside for a long time. I left during the COVID pandemic but returned my sixth grade year. The high school ministry is incredibly welcoming, with D-group leaders who genuinely strive to help you grow in your faith with God. I also enjoy serving in the children’s ministry and making many new friends. 💖💖💖💖 Such a great place to worship + serve God! Solid biblical teachings + a heart for the community. This is my first real Church home. Everyone is very kind and made us feel right at home immediately. Attended a Celebration of Life of a dear friend at NCC. So soothing and rememberable by the pastor and family who touched everyone.

name: Northside Church - Athens Campus
reviewSummary: Biblical preaching and great fellowship! I’ll never attend a different church in Athens, GA! Good solid Bible teaching. The Youth group is fun, and they get a lot of God's Word. It is a very comfortable atmosphere. Would recommend this church to anyone. This church has sound preaching that is biblically accurate and practical in application. Most of all, they share the gospel with clarity. Excellent church! Great place to go to church. Preaching God's word. Very welcoming. Once you visit, you gain a "family." Want to hear God’s word and feel welcomed? This is the church!

name: Northside Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly and welcoming, Pastor Tony is down to earth and has a heart for the community and serving others. It is apparent in all that the church does for the community and the world. It is a place you can truly encounter God, both through the Spirit and the people that call this home church. Had a great visit. I got to see my Granddaughter baptisted. If you don't have a church that you can home let me invite you to Northside Worship Center. Brother Tony and the church family will definitely welcome you I love this church! They're like a giant extended family to me. If you need prayer for anything, they're all over it. Plus they have awesome kids programs and worship. They're also really active with the community and benevolence needs. Visited while on vacation 😊 I was blown away by the atmosphere here. Genuine people, music that is irresistibly uplifting and a message given by Pastor Tony that spoke right to my heart
🙌🏻 Great Worship and praise music. We love Pastor and wife. They are family centered and Bible based.

name: Northside Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary:
Northside is a sweet church. They teach straight through the Bible. (For example, they studied the book of Matthew for almost a whole year.)
I would say closest denomination would be Baptist. They do baptize.
A lot of their structure is similar to North Point Church in that they do small groups in homes, the Sunday Morning set up, how they do Bible studies for men and women and the kids area is also similar to NP too.
Twice a year they do men’s group (early mornings for Bible study durng a week day) and they do women’s Bible study twice a year (spring and fall). These are anywhere from 6 to 12 weeks.
The security for the kids is very good in my opinion. I did feel like my kids were very safe there and they had good lessons for them and the volunteers were engaging.  (They do not need to use hired help for the kids. It comes all from people volunteering.) People rotate in and out, so your child does not have the same teacher each week. They have usually four different teachers that rotate.
We really enjoyed both the sermons and the worship music and felt like it was Bible based and good theology.

Our family personally has had a hard time connecting anything beyond forming shallow community ties, but I think lots of people love this church and thrive there. We have been very active in everything but the community groups.
It is a very family focused church. They have a few big events for the whole church each year including a big waterslide event for the whole family and Christmas and Easter events.

The church has recently become debt-free and done a large renovation on the chapel, which is really beautiful and has given a space for more events.

The church has also experienced tremendous growth in the last couple of years. Since moving to Atlanta in 2021, I've searched for a church home. Northside truly stands out. It's incredibly welcoming and immediately felt like family. The sermons, which walk through books of the Bible, offer practical life application. The women's Bible study is an excellent addition, essentially providing a second weekly sermon. The community is so welcoming and easy to connect with, and there are multiple opportunities to get involved.  Highly recommended! Our family searched ￼for several years for a new church home and visited so many great churches in the Roswell area,  but  when we were first visited Northside Church over two years ago, we left smiling because we highly suspected we had found “it”. At Northside, we found the perfect combination of Biblically sound teaching, where we would certainly grow in our faith and knowledge of the scriptures, but also where we felt the amazing joy of Jesus, a lot of laughter, and so very welcome from day one. It's a church large enough to have engaging activities for our whole family, but small enough to easily plug in, find real community and mentors, and even get to personally know your pastors. We now host / greet on Sundays and meet visitors whom we hope we help make feel as welcome as we did. Thankful for Northside Church Roswell and God’s many blessings in bringing us into this church family… Come see us there! This is a Bible based church (no skipping the hard parts). The vocalists and those playing instruments are truly worshipping (not performing), and kiddos are discipled at every age(not babysat).
Community Groups are considered essential for building relationships, and there are always resources to grow deeper in the knowledge and faith, no matter how long you have followed Jesus.
Northside Church is for ordinary people (come as you are) so so so welcoming. i currently serve i. their kids program and just have never felt more comfortable in students group. shout out to andrew kistler and my teacher amanda in students!! also the directors of kidside you are AWESOME!

thanks for reading my review!!

name: NorthStar Church - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is awesome!! Although we are not members (we visited a few years ago and then found our current church body at Community Bible Church), this campus is stunning! we take a family walk every single evening and enjoy the beautiful landscape!! NorthStar is very active in their community from hosting some school events (like a social and plays for us at Northwest Classical Academy). The Kennesaw and Acworth community feel the light of NorthStar Church’s presence, and we are very grateful for them!!! I absolutely love NorthStar Church.

From the moment you walk in you can feel the warmth and authenticity of the community. It is welcoming, genuine, and just feels real.

Mike Linch has such a powerful way of sharing the message in a way that actually connects to everyday life. You leave encouraged, challenged, and thinking about how to live it out during the week.

As someone who runs Lumina of Hope Foundation, I spend a lot of my time pouring into others. Places like this remind me that leaders need to be poured into sometimes too.

The worship, the people, the atmosphere all make it a place where you truly feel like you belong. I am so grateful to have a church like this right here in Kennesaw. 💛 I came here to get some help with housing. They literally stopped me right at the door. Wouldn’t even let me inside the church. There were other people that were going in who didn’t look like me. They asked me what was I there for, and I explained to them that someone had referred me there for assistance. She mentioned that they had nothing for me and that they were more focused on building the building next-door. It was an extremely discouraging experience and to know that a church will turn its back is disappointing No matter the color of your skin, I feel like all people should be treated the same. Best church ever!! Mike gives the best sermons I’ve ever heard. Their Kids area is so nice and spacious. The front of the building is all glass- so beautiful! They even have a coffee bar with hot and iced coffee! I want to send a huge thank you to Night to Shine, Tim Tebow, and North Star Church for hosting such an unforgettable event for the special needs community.
My son had an absolutely amazing night-dancing, riding in a limousine, walking the red carpet, and feeling like a true VIP. The entire staff and all of the volunteers were incredible-so kind, attentive, and genuinely caring toward everyone there. Events like this mean more than words can express, I truly wish we had something like this in Rome, once a year, it would be such a blessing to so many families.
Thank You again for making such beautiful memories for our children/adult in Kennesaw community ❤️

name: Northstar Church - Panama City - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
We instantly felt at home and as a military family that was extremely important to us. Pastor Marty and his wife Angela are so kind, as well as my husband connected very well with Pastor Ivan’s Men’s Group. Military- make sure and try out Military Assistance Support Hub- MASH (Ask Guy about it) Kori and Zach Smith are the most welcoming people. Very supportive and loving church, amazing people. I thought I was going to Cornerstone but realized after spending 15-20 minutes that I was at Northstar. It may have been an omen since the service met my needs. There was a good mix of seniors which I relate with and the younger people offer a needed vibrancy. Wendell's music selections were contemporary without being over powering. Most importantly, Pastor Roy's sermon was on point. Biblical teaching made relevant to modern times with just the right amount of humor. I may have found a church home Came for the coffee stayed for the service. It was about self-care and unplugging.
These people were welcoming folk. I did not perceive any political bias here. Went there for utility assistance and my 1st thought was God must be happy this place is gorgeous and even has its own coffee shop and kids indoor playground (like ones in McDonald's), and friendly faces every where you look! I'm thinking of attending just off my experience here. Lovely place and people! God is great all the time! Amen! I have been going there for the past 7 years. Intermittent as I left the area for 3 years and then the pandemic began. I attended online during the pandemic, finally retired and returned to Northstar when I returned to Florida. I can honestly say that I have never been been happier than than to be back. Pastor Marty is like none that I have ever known. He's genuine, honest, transparent but mostly kind with the greatest love for God and his members. It's an honor and a privilege to be a member of this home. Not church, but home because that's what it is. Pastor Roy is my hero and he met a need for me when my brother passed away. Please, if you are looking for a church home , come celebrate Jesus with us. You will not be disappointed. God bless and Merry Christmas 👩‍🍼✨🎄

name: Northview Church
reviewSummary: High-impact family church in Carmel with stellar kids check-in, creative modern production, and engaging life groups across Central Indiana.

name: Northview Church - Binford Campus - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE going to church here! Everyone welcomed me with open arms, when was scared to go….scared of being judged, scared of going alone and feeling so insecure, but by the time I left, I was so full spiritually! Everyone was so kind, they made me feel like I was part of their family, asked me to come back, offered any help I might be in need of and they even had a nice coffee shop and it was free! I got a welcome pack, which included a really nice cup and tee-shirt! They have a food pantry and all kinds of small groups as well. I can’t wait to go back and hear the next message! The band and the minister were amazing! I’m so blessed to have found Northview! Today I was a first time visitor .Was greeted in the parking lot with smiles. Everyone was awesome felt like I was part of the church family. Can't wait to come back This is an AMAZING church.

The staff/volunteers are so welcoming, kind, and engaging. Pulling into the parking lot they have people out there to greet you and guide you especially for first time visitors. Outside the building, they have people welcoming you inside and holding doors open for you. You walk in and warm smiles greet you and help navigate you through their facility.

The choir is amazing and the spiritual leaders really care about your spiritual growth and offer a fresh perspective and take on stories we have heard many, many times.

The facility is clean, nice, new, and most importantly, safe.

Come to Northview Church Binford Campus for connections and warm welcomes. This church has given my wandering heart a safe place to call home ❤️ As someone who didn't go to church for years, I was so scared to go to church alone. You know the classic, will I sit in someone's spot? Would they hold my beliefs? Will I feel like a fish out of water? Is the dress in your sunday best church?

I was so nervous, but as soon as I got into the parking lot, people showed me where to park, where to go, how to sign in. I was greeted and smiled at by atleast 10 people before the service began. I loved the music, I loved the message (though it was Father's day and it was a guest pastor), it felt like it was a messages I need to hear.

I got a cup and I signed my son up to go to the Sunday school. Oh! And they were giving away socks and rootbeer! I didn't feel out of place, in fact even on the first visit, it felt like my home church.

Last week it was dollar day video, where they show us how the dollar we gave the week before helps family on the local level. The service has always touched on what I care about. They also have a motto to Live Generously which I live my life by too.

All and all, definitely check this church! Sad that this place doesn’t practice being a good neighbor. Sadly kicked a family farmer put of their parking lot after years of having permission to be there on Saturday morning. Not exhibiting Christianity where it matters.

name: Northview Church - Carmel Campus - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice church.  Went to see the Gaither Vocal Band. We have been to 4 events here in the last 6-8 months at Northview Church-Carmel, & all 4 times it has been wonderful! Great events, great atmosphere inside, & I love the coffee shop/book store they have inside. The parking is easy and there are always officers that keep the traffic moving to help you get out of the parking lot pretty quickly. The people at Northview have been welcoming each time & we will continue to attend their special events & concerts! Thanks Northview-Carmel! The church would be wise to openly and publicly discuss in detail what happened with Pastor CJ and why they felt the need to let him go. Trying to keep a monumental decision like this one behind closed doors only allows speculation to run wild and your judgment to be called into question. Rather than letting people draw wild conclusions in both directions, the precise reasoning needs to be aired out as publicly and as quickly as possible. There ought not be any secrets in the church... I tried so many churches, and Northview is the only one that felt like home. Immediately upon entering, you will meet some of the best most kind people in the world. They are genuinely so happy to see you, and do everything possible to welcome you. The music is FANTASTIC (and the music they write is insanely good). The sermon is ALWAYS Bible based and leaves my heart feeling so full. The people at this church genuinely care for your soul, and they are a true community. We are incredibly blessed to have found Northview. 🩷 This church's is very clear in their mission not only to their congregation but they're community and efforts aboard in the teachings of Jesus and living it in your daily lives.

name: Northview Church - Fishers Campus - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone I personally encountered was terrific, very friendly, personable, eager to make me feel welcome, genuinely interested in me & my reason for visiting.  They offer three different service times from early morning to even a service afternoon.  Praise & worship was very good.  All that being said, I prefer that my pastor be live & in person.  At this location, the message is pre-recorded on Saturday nights & then broadcast Sundays. There wasn't any interaction with the sermon, didn't hear anyone calling out Amen, during the message, I'm assuming because he isn't live so they don't feel the need to acknowledge his points.  The message was very good but my personal preference is a live in-person pastor. WE LOVE LOVE LOVE Our church!!!! Northview Fishers is our church  home and is warm, welcoming and focused on all the aspects of our faith in which we value; spiritual growth, outreach, children & families. The pastors are amazing, they love you as you are and our kids LOVE IT too!!! Visit us, we'd love to have you!!!! :) This is our church and we are very happy there.  Northview has a main campus in Carmel and 12 other locations. Live campus pastor and worship team with simulcast message each week. We attend the Fishers campus. All are invited. You need to tes drive this church if you are looking for a great home. Great place to cast a vote

name: Northview Church - Greater Lafayette Campus - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
The folks were very friendly, and I'm all for a good praise band & contemporary services, however it was more like attending a rock concert. It was way too loud and between that, the darkened sanctuary, flashing lights, and the almost smokey effect, I had a horrible headache even before the praise & worship service was over, and as a result, we left. As I said, I love praise music, but this was much too loud and concert-ish. Awesome church....all ages attend. From shorts & tees to suits & ties. Modern live Christian music. Huge tv screens. Free coffee. Feels like home. No judgment zone. Was baptized shortly after attending. Daughter in law baptized there. Sermons r heart feeled and I always learn something and take with me to get back on focus. Truly a church that invites you in with open arms and means it. I love my church!!!! Don’t be shy and give it a try. I bet you love it too!!! Most amazing church I’ve been too of all my life. The focus in straight from the breath of God, not an opinion based. The music is like going to a worship concert that connects my spirit to the Holy Spirit and fills my soul with peace.

Praise the Lord! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens! Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his excellent greatness! Praise him with trumpet sound; praise him with lute and harp! Praise him with tambourine and dance; praise him with strings and pipe! Praise him with sounding cymbals; praise him with loud clashing cymbals! ...

John 4:23 ESV Love love love my church! Pastor Dave is so humble and nurturing! The youth pastor teaches by example. Look up the story on WLFI about the pizza delivery woman who got a very large tip. This is what we do. Pay it forward with no expectations of return. Every person who walks in those doors is immediately family. My wife and I started attending Northview in 2009 when it was still in the warehouse in West Lafayette. NVGL has helped us in our spiritual journey with sermons, worship, & life groups. The people @ NVGL are some of the most friendly folks we have ever encountered!! I ❤ My Church!!

name: Northview Church - Noblesville Campus - Noblesville Campus
reviewSummary: I just joined The Noblesville Campus today with my mom and really enjoyed the church, it seemed similar to where I was originally going but I feel that Northview seemed different in a good way, people were friendlier and outgoing and same thing with the pastors and staff, will definitely keep going and I'm hoping this will be my permanent church this time. I love this church and I'm now a member they are so kind and welcoming it's really a wonderful church I quit going to church for a while because of the judgmental eyes, but walking through these doors you ever felt welcome from the get-go and it's a relaxed, caring atmosphere Very nice facility. Great experience for families. New location in Noblesville (inside The Farm offices). Grand opening Nov. 13th, 2022.

name: Northview Church - Westfield Campus - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary:
I enjoyed being there with my family and watching him be baptized and pray he grows in the Lord and Led by the Holy Spirit. I prayed for him and his family to find a church and serve.
Forgive me for not expressing myself in a godly manner. I'm old fashioned hymn music and still trying to understand how different we are all. One God,One Jesus and Holy Spirit. May we all worship Spirit and truth.
We sincerely love you each one of you Very nice and friendly campus the Movie 🎥🎥🎥🎥🎥 was excellent and brought tears to my eyes and what my family goes through Extremely welcoming to first time guest! I was impressed that they had special front row parking, a welcome tent outside to meet you, a welcome desk inside with more helpers, and more information than I knew what to do with. The messages I've heard so far have been excellent, with challenging applications of the Bible. Try it out and maybe I'll see you there! Tremendous church, welcome everyone.  Was my church home until I moved. Northview is a great church. They welcome all and have a great children ministry that allows us to be able to enjoy service as well.

name: Northway Christian Church - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary: Northway Christian Church is a beloved community of believers and seekers who work hard to follow Jesus and his teachings. As one of the friends of the church says, "All are welcome, male and female, black and white, gay and straight, trans and cis, broken and whole, Republican, Democrat, citizen, non citizen and everyone beyond and between." Winter Wonder🌹 this show was amazing! ❤️ Like most fundamental churchs it doesn't have large congregation. People are friendly and concerned for each other. I'm a recent new member of Northway.  I love the Spirit of the people.  Preaching and worship are amazing and include communion every Sunday.  The choir is excellent.  The church is committed to reaching out to its neighbors I'm glad I found Northway 6 years ago when I moved to Dallas.  The ministers are amazing and focused on creating a body of believers who really are "doers" and not just listeners on Sunday mornings.  Traditional and alternative worship experiences, educational events, service opportunities, and moments of fellowship are the core.  There are even opportunities for open dialog with members of other faith traditions.

name: Northway Church - Macon Campus
reviewSummary: I don't go here, but have to drive by every day and see a "christian" church trying to push people to vote republican, meaning they're trying to push people into voting for the very people who are destroying our country, ripping families apart, and trying to tell women how they should feel, what to wear, how to "just shut up and be a good wife." Its disgusting and Jesus himself would cry if he knew a church was being used as a voting place. Wasn't that why he turned tables over in the temple, because it was being used for evil instead of good? Just a thought. Hope y'all have the day you deserve ✌️ Cathedral Coffee is my go-to place when I want to get away.  The employees are super friendly and the atmosphere is special with Christian music that soothes the soul. Great place to have a good cup of coffee peacefully. The ambience is just right. My husband and I stopped by as we were driving through for coffee & breakfast. It was absolutely delicious! The drive thru was so convenient. Definitely recommend!! Be careful with your family here. They have a staff member who likes to peek in the bathroom stall while you’re using it. Not sure if it’s related to the church but definitely the bathroom at cathedral coffee which is connected to the church.

name: Northwest Bible Church - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
Great service! Solid Word! Beautiful community!

I will definitely post new reviews after this.
I attended it because I met a lovely and blessed couple playing volleyball and they invited me, they truly live the gospel and community, as it is values from the Northwest Bible Church. Thanks Christina!

The pastor preached a hard and deep sermon, very needed to nowadays. After the sermon I joined to Welcome Lunch, were new people and I were able to get to know the values, foundation, people, teams, make questions, get answers, be open about listen to each other and also a great time having nice conversations and food, plus a quiz about the community - which was very fun! Everyone should go to the welcome lunch to know the guidelines and get to know deeper how the church see the Word, People and values. They really have this sense of community, it seems to me a small church in big one.
Thank you for all love, ai felt really welcomed!

“Unexpected joy and desperately dependency on Jesus!” I love the people here. I’m encouraged to walk with Jesus more deeply and study God’s Word. I visited while I was in town from out of state.  Everyone was friendly and helpful.  The message was great!  Thank you for being so welcoming 🙂 Northern the photos of the two people by similar faces but how about they are friends but they been friends for years ago before you go to the photos that all the photos have been taken years ago but it was just enough of the photos This place is special. I’m kind of bias because I made a lot of friends and met my wife here :) but if you are looking for a Bible based church where you could find Jesus loving community, I highly recommend!

Has a nice mix of being a decent sized church with a small church feel. Plenty of opportunities to join a small group, serve, connect with people from different backgrounds and ages.

The church theology is strong and based solely on the Bible. For church there are series that walk us through whole books of the Bible. Our church is very passionate about sharing the Gospel with others also. From my time at being at Northwest, I have learned how to be interdependent with other believers and submit to the Lord more.

name: Northwest Bible Church - Hilliard Campus
reviewSummary: One of the best experiences we have had of a God filled, God centered, biblically led church’s that we have ever been to! If you local to Hilliard this needs to be on your radar as far as a church to visit and see if it meets your needs! All the way from the 22 beautiful acres it sits on, to the greeting team, to the worship in the sanctuary and most importantly the word every week straight from the Bible! To top it all off their kids program is over the top and also their children’s programs! I have been attending Northwest Bible Church for many years. It is an amazing church! Everyone is so welcoming and kind. The praise and worship team is unbelievably talented. Pastor Harrell's messages are clear, relevant, and easy to follow. Everything that is preached at Northwest comes straight from the Bible. The church provides so many wonderful programs for children of all ages. I can't say enough great things about Northwest Bible Church! My husband and I started coming to this church about a year ago and couldn’t be more thankful for such a strong bible believing church, led by Pastors who truly love the Lord and live out the gospel. We love that the church has so many ministries, like a wonderful children’s, Men’s and Women’s ministries. We’ve also gotten plugged into a life group with other couples which has made our community within the church that much richer. We are proud to be part of such a wonderful body of believers and would love to have you join us some Sunday to worship our Lord and Savior. You won’t regret it! My husband and I are so blessed to be a part of Northwest Bible! We look forward to Sunday morning every week to worship with other believers and grow spiritually. We always are disappointed if we can’t be there. Being involved in a life group has made such a difference and we have established such wonderful friendships. We love Northwest Bible! We started attending this church about two years ago.  We were invited by friends after Church Surfing for a few years.  We feel so at home here, finally a church that gives us the opportunity to feel like we are well rested and have a renewed energy after the service.  We are involved in other programs offered by the church and they have amazing women's groups and children's programs.  If I could only give one 5star review, this would be it.

name: Northwest Bible Church - Spring Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended the Between Jobs Ministry at the church, Wednesday mornings, great place to meet great people to find a job
job. Wonderful encouragement and supportive people, many classes to learn how to adapt to the new ways of finding jobs. If you are looking for work, start here 8am Wednesday mornings. I went to a program they offer for people who are job seeking called Between Jobs Ministries. It is awesome! If you are looking for a job you need to go to this. It is every Wednesday from 9 am to 1 or 2 pm. Your first visit will start at 8 am. Their between jobs ministry is top notch, wonderful ministry.  Dr Roy Farmer, his associates,  counselors, program, process all excellent!  They've been doing this some 20 years, helping folks inspiring to understand transferrable skills, inspiring how valuable people are to God, helping you hone your skills, teaching you things, improving world.  Businesses like them and coordinate needs/ openings. My wife and my children came for the first time today and the staff was phenomenal! Very warm greetings, great smiles, and extraordinarily welcoming. Met with the pastor, even though I didn’t know he was the pastor, during the meet and greet time. The worship time was great and I recognized some of the music which helped. They are going through the book of Revelation, Word by word, which is the kind of teaching I much appreciate and love! Got to speak to the pastor after service for a few minutes and he appears to be very knowledgeable and has a true care for people. If you're looking for a church community instead of just listening to a sermon once a week, this is the church for you. They do potlucks, men's events, women's events, events for people in their 30's and 40's, date nights (church provides low-cost childcare), a homeschool group, Awanas, and even a ministry to help people find jobs (that you don't have to be a Christian to use). Plus, there are groups that meet Sunday morning, so even if a sermon isn't your thing, you can still come and grow. The head pastor is also very approachable.

name: Northwest Chapel - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
Northwest Chapel is a church that teaches God’s Word. The preaching is expository and centered on the Gospel. The people here genuinely pursue Christ. It’s a welcoming place if you’re looking to grow spiritually and be part of a Christ-centered community. I love Northwest Chapel!! I have been going there for over 3 years!! Everyone is so welcoming and it had amazing youth programs for kids and teens. The lead pastor dives deep into God’s word and points out things I never saw before. There is also so many ministry opportunities whether inside the church or out. I have grown so much in my faith and it wouldn’t have happened without my church. Northwest Chapel is a great church and community of mature believers. If you are looking for the real Truth about life, death, or really anything here is a great place for you to start. The community is amazing. Northwest Chapel has helped me grow in my faith. I highly recommend Northwest Chapel to everyone. We moved to Ohio late January 2023 from Texas and placed membership at Northwest Chapel a few months later. We came here because we have family already here but even if we didn’t, we still would have called Northwest Chapel home for many reasons. They do expository preaching (preaching verse by verse instead of by topics), welcome newcomers well, are there like family when sick or struggling, stand with what scripture says unapologetically, respond with grace and truth when there are troubles, and have a wonderful children and youth ministry. They have great opportunities to use your spiritual gifts- cooking meals for the homeless, greeting newcomers with a friendly face, sharing the gospel intentionally in public places, mission trips, a team that wraps around families who are sick or had a baby with meals, etc.

There is also a sports ministry (indoor pickleball, on-site frisbee golf course), ministry for widows, bi-monthly gathering for moms of young kids to fellowship over coffee while the kids play, weekly youth gatherings and many opportunities they do year-round (youth Sunday (they lead the service) and serving neighbors by raking their leaves and ask how they can pray for them among others). We also really appreciate the “One Night Out” ministry for marrieds with kids. There is also a monthly men’s breakfast, and bible studies, and quarterly 3 Fold Communion. There is so much more we do but wanted to mention just a few of the things we do as a church family.

This is a church that doesn’t just hear the Word, but by God’s grace and not perfectly by any means, are doers of the Word. Come sit with us, we have a seat for you! I've been going here since late 2018. It's a very welcoming and friendly church, with a heart for serving the community. You can tell they really read the Bible, and trust it above all else. Love my church!

name: Northwest Christian Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary: If you're looking for a new church or just wanna come by one Sunday to check out the service, everyone is always welcome at Northwest Christian! My wife and I found a new home in NWCC after trying several other options. Instantly felt at home when I came for my first Sunday and it's been my home ever since! The music and band are amazing, the families and friendships are everlasting and Pastor Jay Rice is guaranteed to touch your soul every week with his incredible sermon! I welcome every person reading this to join us on Sunday morning, first service starts at 9:30 and second service starts at 11! Look forward to seeing you there! This is my second sunday that I have been there. The greatest experience have I ever had at church, just a great experience.The pastor was great. And everyone there was so kind the music was so amazing that's perfect. I'll be there again this sunday They allow us to have our 4x4 club meetings there. Great people. We had my grandson’s graduation, everything was beautiful. My boys recently attended VBS here & absolutely fell in love! Everyone was so welcoming every single day & my oldest can’t stop bragging about Pastor Stacy.  He is only 11 but is even considering getting baptized! I would definitely recommend this church to others & I can’t wait to actually attend a service with my entire family.

name: Northwest Christian Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: The administration is so kind! My pet takes rest under the shades of the church when he goes for a walk with me. Today, they have kept water bowls at the front door so that the pets can drink water when they are thirsty. This is very thoughtful. This gesture of empathy and love has a deep effect on me. They let the cops sit in the parking lot and pull people over. Separation of church and state! No taxation without representation! What would Jesus do??? Oh yeah he’d probably be the one getting pulled over in “this part of town” 😏 Good Christian Education for everyone.  Outreach opportunities abound. Meaningful worship. Open to everyone. Music is varied and impressive. Friendly, caring and sharing.  Coffee and tea available. Sharing the love and grace of our Lord vicariously through the UA Police department traffic detail Beautiful church,  great sales 👏

name: Northwest Christian Church - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: The administration is so kind! My pet takes rest under the shades of the church when he goes for a walk with me. Today, they have kept water bowls at the front door so that the pets can drink water when they are thirsty. This is very thoughtful. This gesture of empathy and love has a deep effect on me. They let the cops sit in the parking lot and pull people over. Separation of church and state! No taxation without representation! What would Jesus do???
