Sharing the love and grace of our Lord vicariously through the UA Police department traffic detail Beautiful church,  great sales 👏

name: Northwest Church - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary: My friend and I have been looking for a church and that's how we found Northwest Church .Oh my goodness you feel the Lord we unfortunately got to the church I believe 10 minutes late but I instantly chills it was unbelievable and I will tell you that I will definitely be returning as will my friend. They are the most welcoming Church members I have ever met in my life and if you're reading this I hope you attend too God bless If I lived in NW Arkansas, I would definitely attend here. I visit every year at Easter to attend church with my brother. Everyone is super friendly. Bible believing and teaching church. I love this church. I’ve been attending for about 6 years, so it’s been like a second home! I love that the preaching is word-based, the worship is authentic and the community is awesome!! Having come in here for about a month. Services are awesome! Worship is great. The speaking is well done and biblical. And everyone greeting n the foyer is a pleasure. Pastor Joe is incredible and the entire staff pours so much love into every one of their services. Whenever I need God most, Joe is always there to encourage, uplift and remind us that we are worthy and that God is so worthy of praise and glory. Not only that, he shakes hands with and knows the names of the people in our congregation. I’ve never felt more comfortable or more welcomed into any community as I have with Northwest. Thank you for your truth, grace, love, and support. Such a wonderful place of worship.

name: Northwest Church - Springdale Campus - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I personally want to invite you to come and experience Northwest Church Springdale. If you are looking for a home church or a place to get plugged into, this is the place for you. Pastor Chase has a heart for the community of Springdale and has poured so much into this church. Not to mention he brings a powerful and timely word each week. The kids ministry is awesome and my kids never want to miss a Sunday experience……….Come be a part and see all that God is doing at Northwest Church Springdale. Visited here quite awhile ago. This church added to my reasons for not attending church anymore. A Christian Clique. I think one, maybe 2 people greeted us. Not the type of Christian fellowship I want - and I’ve been an AoG member in several churches/cities.
I’ve come to realize manmade church is nothing but a group therapy session where you pay before your session starts. Pastor John and his wife are amazing. My husband and I have been attending for a few months now and we've learned so much about Scripture and who God is calling us to
be. The people are incredible and I can't say I've met a single person that wasn't happy to be there. Truly a family. So much empathy and compassion and love is in this place. Please try it one time and you'll see. Our first visit a man told us his son had struggled with addiction in his past, but that this church was the one church around here
where there was no judgement, only love. I can confirm that this is true. I am so thankful the Spirit led me here. Praise God! Clean and well kept building. People are friendly and welcoming. My daughter loves the kids church! My husband and I enjoy the main service. Great worship team and always a timely message. This is an awesome church! They are welcoming & have something for everyone. The pastor is amazing & preaches under God’s anointing. Come try it, you won’t be disappointed!

name: Northwest Church of Christ - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church, you should come if you want to meet good people, hear good music, to hear a good message , to get the greeting given in loving care and a needed hug. Come and join the fun guaranty to make your day better , if not your life. ( TRY IT YOU MAY LIKE IT.) My family and I have been going to this church for over 13 years. And I was baptized 12/2019. We love it here the preacher (josh lopez) and wife (Jamie lopez) are amazing.  The people are great, no judging like you can get from some churches. Please come and enjoy services, it starts at 930am. With classes for all, newborn to adults. Church starts at 1030am. The fact that this Church is forcing a family to remove their memorial site for Tucker Colby is honestly bs. As a family friend of this young man, I’m honestly heartbroken that anyone could be so heartless to take this one thing we have for him away. Was my 1st time there. I was welcome by a couple of great people. I'm always a little shy at first. But I will be returning this upcoming Lord's Day. Great people and a Bible based church.
But the sound system really needs work... It's difficult to hear the service...

name: Northwest Presbyterian Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: Love the warm congregation and the fireplaces! Small town feel in the big city. The music is fantastic! Our choir is the best 💜 Gray is an excellent Preacher!

name: Northwest United Methodist Church - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: Proud to call this church our home. So inviting, I always feel comfortable, and the community is incredible. Known as the chapel on the hill, this place sure has the light of christ shining down on it! Beautiful church with a lovely chapel in the woods. Friendly staff and an enjoyable place to visit. A kind & welcoming congregation, beautiful outdoor church services & gardens. Chapel in the woods is great. I remember nice sermons linking a couple verses of Scripture to current events and culture. Attended the Good Friday service.  Beautifully prepared event that shares the church's views with great speakers, music, choir and video

name: Northwood Church | Gulfport Community - Gulfport Campus
reviewSummary:
We have been going here for a little over 6 months now & couldn't be happier. Pastor Jordan has a great sense of humor but is also not afraid to talk about "hard" topics that other pastors may not talk about out of fear but it's all biblical. Everyone at the church is friendly and we felt welcomed with open arms by the church.  Childcare is absolutely outstanding. Worship is very powerful. The sermon is always amazing. Best church I've ever attended by far. We can't wait to become members & serve. Thank you Northwood! Grounded, Biblical teaching. Great community groups. Opportunities to serve within the church, community, & abroad. Classes for all ages. Northwood has been a wonderful place for me to connect with God, fellow believers, & grow in my faith. Northwood is our home! We have visited many other churches, but NC really made us feel home the moment we walked in as visitors. The pastors here are by far the best that we have seen. I love the events, the serving, the appreciation,  worship, absolutely everything.  I have heard that everything has a small negative, however I have not seen one at NC. I will continue attending and sharing NC ❤️ I have been church hopping for a few weeks now after leaving my church, hoping to find something that felt like home. When I walked into this church it was okay, I checked my kids in to the children’s program and it was okay. But then I walked into the auditorium, I immediately gasped and started crying. I felt Gods spirit and it was amazing. The worship music was amazing and the sermon was amazing as well and the pastor was funny and made everything relatable. My 4 year old loved it and my 8 year old said the kids service was boring, but overall, we loved it. The other churches I went to were okay but this is the church I will continue to go to. I loved it ❤️ Great church with awesome music program. There is child care for newborns up during service as well as a day care for working parents. There are numerous small groups for both women, men, and couples. This is one of three campuses.

The church is both welcoming and actively involved in the community. The pastors rotate around the three campuses so you get some diversity there as well with varying message deliveries.

Another great thing is the complete diversity in people that attend. You'll find pretty much every type of race which is sometimes hard to find.

name: Norwalk Assembly of God Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Such a lovely congregation of God's people. So welcoming and caring! And the praise is old school, but so upbeat and enthusiastic. Well grounded in God's Truth. Love these people of God, who love to praise the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, in spirit and true!

name: Norwalk Assembly of God Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: Such a lovely congregation of God's people. So welcoming and caring! And the praise is old school, but so upbeat and enthusiastic. Well grounded in God's Truth. Love these people of God, who love to praise the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, in spirit and true!

name: Norwood Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church. Beautiful inside. They have a free food pantry for anyone in need. It's on Saturday's 10am to 2pm. Lovely flowers out front. Lovely group of people. Dr. Bill is a wonderful leader. Very welcoming and kind, Christian family.

name: Nova Community Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming and friendly. Contemporary service
Front yard hospitality. Children's playground. Japanese ministry. I only went to one service. I really enjoyed the music and also the message the pastor presented. I was welcomed by a couple people but I guess I was expecting a little more interaction for a first time visit. I filled out a card and was hoping someone would contact me but did not hear anything.
I need to find a church where I can feel connected.  This church is so close to my home it would be great if it worked out. I also would love to be a part of the music ministry since I have been a singer all my life and have been a soloist in many churches throughout my life.
Well I might try one more visit and see what happens.  It’s been several months since the one visit.  I don’t know if anyone will read this review. I hope so. I don't go to church here but I take my dog here cus they have a big field for them to run around. Other neighbor dogs comes here too and they seems nice and well mannered, same for the owners. Very friendly & warm members. Several people came up & introduced themselves, we're eager to tell us about the church & made us feel very comfortable.  We will be going back, it felt like home! My first time going, I was welcomed by many people and the sermon spoke right to my heart. It required some intentionally on my part to get plugged in, but now it's been my home church for years.

name: NSPIRE Church - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary:
I have always appreciated Nspire's presence in Westfield. They prioritize making a tangible difference in the community over their own ministries and building. Their new facility is pretty awesome and cost less to build than some people spend on their own homes. I attend the 3pm Spanish service. What a fantastic group of people. The pastors are phenomenal people. Absolutely love it Best church I've ever been to!!! I'm a P.K. and spent my whole life in church. But NSPIRE is by far my favorite! I feel like I leave having learned, not just preached to. There's a real sense of family, along with open minds. Anyone could walk in their doors and be 100% welcome. Thank you, NSPIRE! We LOVE the friendships we’ve developed with the people at NSPIRE! So many opportunities to get to know people, great kids program, down-to-earth pastors who talk in language I can understand and encourage my faith in Jesus. It’s a place I can be real instead of having to “have it all together”. My whole family loves this church and calls it “home”. We look forward to the engaging, bible-centered messages every Sunday from the two amazing pastors. Our kids are always so excited to play and learn in the children’s ministry run completely by volunteers and strongly supported by the church leadership. We lead a life group filled with a diverse group of wonderful people who we consider family.
This church ascribes to the motto of “You Belong Here” and they truly mean it. This world becomes more and more polarizing by the day, but NSPIRE Church welcomes every single person with open arms. No matter how excluded you’ve felt in life or at a church, you can find a sense of belonging here!
Our favorite part of NSPIRE Church is their commitment to service of the community. The church has been named Westfield Partner of the Year multiple times for their service through events like the Westfield Easter Egg Drop, Westfield Rocks the 4th, Westfield in Lights, and Movies in the Park. All this on top of the partnership with a church and school in Nairobi, Africa and other important ministries!
I’ve never been a part of a group of people so committed to service above self. If you are service minded, this is the place to be!

name: Nuvo Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been attending Nuvo and serving on the worship team for over 2 years. These past 2 years I've learned things about Godly community that I have never experienced anywhere else. The messages are convicting and moving every single week. Patrick and Emily, the wonderful couple who started the church, are two incredibly creative people driven to spread the gospel. And the teams, THE TEAMS, are groups of the most amazing Jesus-loving people I have ever met. So welcoming, a true family. 12/10!! We’ve attended Nuvo for over four years, and it has become a place our whole family loves. There’s an incredible focus on creating fun, meaningful experiences for kids and they  look forward to coming every single week.

So thankful for this place. Nuvo is a place where the people are genuine and God is truly moving.  A true blessing for my husband and myself.  We highly recommend Nuvo Church for families of any age!  This is a Church for everyone!!❤💯👍 Our kids love the kids program - the volunteers are loving, dedicated and first class! We’re grateful our kids have a fun and welcoming place to learn about Jesus and spend time with friends every Sunday. The church has a genuine “come as you are” atmosphere where people are encouraged to ask deep questions, think critically, and love one another on our spiritual journeys. We’ve been part of the NUVO family for 3.5 years. It was a soft place to land after a season of searching & uncertainty. Faith without doubt and questions is blind faith, and NUVO invited us to bring our questions and doubts and truly experience Jesus in the midst.

Patrick’s lessons are engaging and applicable. He is so approachable & doesn’t use “churchy words”. I love that the church is welcoming of people who haven’t experienced church before, or have left and are coming back, etc.

Our kids always have fun in class, they love the teachers & have made friends and learned foundational truths about God’s love for them.

name: NY Promise Church | Promise International Fellowship (PIF-NY) - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church and community. They have great programs for school and summer camp. Very clean and easy parking Yes programs for kids are amazing .
Problem is if you dont fit in bullies exist and its more intense then elsewhere . Parents are more of an issue they are called Christians but does not care how their kids act to other kids or take action. ALOT HAS CHANGED.
Because the church do programs like afterschool and EVENTS ALL THESE RUDE OUTSIDERS WITH absolute no respect
Blast music and smoke cig the church hasn't seem so like a church
So many people has left this church
And they always in their " Clicks " unwelcomming practice .

Its became more of a place to PR YOUR BUSINESS
NOT A place to meet with God.
Very disappointed 😞 I went to the summer program for children back in the late 90's when it used to be known as Full Gospel Church. Nothing but fond memories and one of the most fun, best times I had as a kid. Glad to see how much the church has grown and evolved over time. i love this my kids loved it too One of The best place for Korean worship Services.

name: O.C. Christian Center - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: One of the most loving and spirit lead fellowships I've been a part of. You can feel the presence of God when you walk in the room. The pastor is extremely knowledgeable and lead by the holy Spirit. He encourages seeking God for yourself through reading the Bible, praying, worshipping together and intimate time with God. He also leads us with the freedom for everyone to recognize their God-given gifts. Come and experience Christ for yourself. I'm so thankful for the family this church has been to me. Very authentic lovers of Christ; it's beautiful.  The Holy Spirit is very present here. This church family of mine has made it their mission to let my young children exercise the gifts Christ placed in them. I LOVE them for that. Love you OC Christian center Family ❣️. Bible teaching church! True Jesus followers in this church!  Their prayer nights are life changing.  The presence of the Holy Spirit is palpable in this place.  The members are genuine and the leaders have the heart of service.  I felt very welcomed here and attending Wednesday night bible studies is really helping me grow as a student of the word of God 😊 Finally a church where there is sincere love for all people, God is the focus at all times in all ways, the Pastors are genuinely pouring into your life to help you grow and succeed.  I am so pleased God lead me to this church.  A bit of heaven on earth.  I would highly recommend you visit and experience it for yourself.  The love you will experience is healing and moves you to share with others. Absolutely love O.C. Christian Center! The family and relationships you built with everyone is amazing! I love my Becca and Pastor Sam! The Occc family is a very united family and is there whenever you need anything. You all make me happy 💕 thank you!

name: Oak City Baptist Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Just used their food pantry service(third Saturday of each month) and was very blessed by them! Attended Service Here Several Times. Each Visit, Still Feels Very Welcoming & Inviting. Personally, I’m Still In Search Of A Church Home. However, I Love To Visit w/ My Aunt. The Pastor Is An Excellent Speaker. Love How He Teaches & Deliver His Sermons For The Entire Congregation To Enjoy. Including The Younger Generation. Great Service! Welcoming Atmosphere! Been going here since a teenager and when I lived locally for college. Sad Pastor Newkirk leaving in February; but I still plan to visit here as this is my family church! Nice church. I visited a few time but when it comes to their assistance they only help their members. Not for the community. I’ve asked for marriage counseling. After 10 years with my husband we hit a rough path and they wouldn’t help. I’ve called and asked if they do rental assistance for low income families. The lady told me they only help their members and hung up on me. I would never expect this coming from a Baptist church. My home church we help all people. Been awhile since I been to this church but everyone was very nice. Pastor is a Bible teacher not someone teaching what the World wants to hear to make them good

name: Oak Gardens Church
Oak Hills Church - Crownridge Campus - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
Went on a day a Guest Speaker preached. Now the preaching was amazing! However, she was a guest speaker, so not sure how regular service is there. Would I be back, no. Unfortunately, it's too big that you just feel your going to a church and leaving. No human interaction to greet us, no one to direct us where to go to check in a toddler, just lots of signs on where to go. No one asked if we needed help. Just felt like we had to figure everything on our own. As a new visitor I didn't feel welcomed. I remember hearing some of the sermons here, and they weren’t really personally moving. They sounded more like self help speeches, actually. I felt the staff was rude, and didn’t like interacting with them. The crowd here definitely wasn’t for me. There are so many  good things about this church. I have always loved the preaching and i have attended for over a decade  with some breaks as once i tried getting information about volunteering and was told since i was a single mom at the time i probably would not have time . After that i never inquired again as i have been very hurt in ministry at another church in my past . Currently, our son has been participating in Kids Praise last year he was in the play and Palm Sunday and other activities as well . This year during the play we ran into some conflict aside from road closures causing a longer commute and my son was having issues with his mild Autism and having a lot of homework and with the demand of rehearsals twice a week and getting home late . We are  living across town i felt it was a little much for our situation but also my son still wanted to participate so  I reached out to Kids Praise  in an email explaining our situation and wondering if maybe he can participate in half the rehearsals even if it meant not being in the entire play as he was only a choir member not an actor   . I felt his mild Autism was ignored as if i diagnosed him with this myself and there was just no compassion for anything i explained was just told every one was dealing with traffic and i was told more less there was no flexibility when even at school my son has 504 accommodations. I was patient and understanding and let them know he could not participate this time  and i asked to stay updated and continue receiving  emails and i noticed I hadn’t seen any after that my son had been asking about Palm Sunday this year and i realized I was not receiving emails so I emailed today  to ask and was told very last minute rehearsals were tonight and I can only have the information  for Kids Praise Palm Sunday only at rehearsals.knowing i was not receiving emails for some reason .  This is just disheartening treatment .I want to know who i can talk to about this . Oak Hills Church has truly been a blessing in my life. From the moment you walk in, you feel genuinely welcomed by the people. There is a real sense of community and love that makes it easy to feel at home.

The worship is beautiful and uplifting, creating an atmosphere where you can truly focus on God and feel His presence. It’s meaningful, heartfelt, and inspiring every time.

The pastors are another reason this church stands out. Max Lucado and Travis Eades teach with clarity, humility, and a deep love for God’s Word. Their messages are encouraging, practical, and grounded in Scripture, helping you grow in your faith and apply biblical truths to everyday life.

Oak Hills Church is a place where faith, worship, and community come together in a powerful way. I’m grateful to be part of this church and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a Christ-centered church with loving people and strong, biblical teaching. Hi everyone I have been walking Jesus Christ again for 7 years and have been a member for 5 years at Oak Hill with Max Lucado . It is my home members are so special and helpful with one another. Thank you excepting me with open arms and hearts.

name: Oak Hills Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
Community church in Edmond. Various activities for different age groups. I attend their GriefShare meetings weekly. A wonderful place to meet, great people and such a helpful group after my Mom passed away. I love this church!  Everyone is friendly!  There are many family/community event year round!  The worship team and youth program are top notch!  The lessons are great and applicable to my own life. This is the most welcoming church. Greeted like old friends and they have an Amazing kids and youth ministry. The pastor is really nice too. A nice family oriented small church. They recently updated the facilities and they look great.

They let our business group meet there so we are very appreciative. Very community oriented. Very friendly and welcoming congregation. Pastor Matt always preaches the word of God. Vibrant small church.

name: Oak Hills Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the best church I've ever been to in my life.. I want to say the people are so Genuine, Real, Friendly, Kind and Loving when you walk through that front door their testimony SHINES BRIGHT in all of them.. The Praise team (worship singers and musicians) are outstanding you really feel the holy Spirit every Sunday morning I can't say enough about the music.. also Pastor Mike is one of the best Preachers I've heard in a long time I'm looking forward for that day when I become a member of Oak Hill Church in Folsom To be able to call him my Pastor as well.. And lastly I cannot wait for the following Sunday after service is over longing to be there once again for the next service, That's how much this church REALLY SHINES BRIGHTLY in the word of God ..Amen! This has been my church since 1991. Solid bible-based church with great staff and leadership. Great teaching that is relevant to today’s issues. Very welcoming Great Christmas Eve candlelight service last night.  Really helped me connect with the power and mystery of the gospel, through God's word and traditional Christmas hymns, ending in sharing in the Lord's supper to remember how Christ came to die for my sins.  Thank you Oak Hills!
I was invited out to youth group at Oak Hills ~28 years ago which reignited my search for God, and eventually led to my receiving the gift of Jesus' forgiveness and salvation in college.  I'm so thankful that I can come back when visiting my parents and still connect with God through the authentic time of connecting with His story. Good church families and kids.
Easy park.
Children’s room.
Good service.
Handicap parking and accessible. I don’t go to the church but I do Christian youth theater there and it’s pretty fun, cool stages and really cool curtain

name: Oak Life Church - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary: Oak Life Church, is a true beacon of inclusivity, creating a warm and welcoming space where everyone feels valued. A church that remains faithful in the face of trials, and will pray and stand with you through your personal trials. I love Oak life church! It meets in the New Parkway theater at 10a. It’s an affirming church and a welcoming, safe space for everyone. If you’re feeling discouraged by organized religion and defeated in life, I know you’ll feel right at home at oak life ! They are a church of second chances. I have felt so welcomed, believed and nurtured here. The community is amazing! Oaklife was the church I never knew I needed. It is the most inclusive representation of the christian faith I have ever encountered or heard of. Oaklife has positively improved my notion of faith, love and community. I greatly recommend it! OAKLIFE CHURCH GIVES YOU A SENSE OF BELONGING. A GOOD PLACE TO HEAR FROM GOD, AND FROM OTHERS. A NON-JUDGMENTAL GROUP OF BELIEVERS...AWESOME PASTORS. Solid, progressive, welcoming church for young professionals and others!

name: Oakhouse Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church. The pastors and staff are all loving, available, and relatable. Oakhouse is small, but it has a mighty impact on the city of Mission Viejo, serving at the NPM Senior center, driving Meals on Wheels, supporting foster families, volunteering at city events, etc. I want to add to the 5-five star reviews for Rockharbor Mission Viejo. Pastor Chad Halliburton is a great guy and a great teacher, who truly knows and walks with Jesus. This campus of Rockharbor is great community to be a part of, if you are looking for fellowship in the Mission Viejo area. Great church . You can truly feel the holy spirit . They have access to prayer every day during worship towards the end of service . I love that , the pastor Chad has a great understanding of the Bible and does a great job of explaining. Rock Harbor Mission Viejo is a great, small church looking to serve the Lord and reach the lost. You are most welcome here and God will definitely meet you where you're at in this place. Grateful to be back on community that feels like home.

name: Oaks Church Brooklyn - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Always look into churches when I travel.  Great community and the message was so real and true. Pastor was great and spoke truth. Praise the our Lord Jesus Christ. The best church in NYC! Very practical sermons, good music, and a congregation of people that care about one another! Went to the morning service and had a great nursery experience!

name: Oakwood Community Church
reviewSummary: This is where we call home. Such a warm invitation from 1st day and on. We can call the people here some of our closest friends. Loved this church! My granddaughter was Baptized! This is my home church. I've looked far and wide and this is the closest I've found to what a church should be. The north American church model can be found on almost any street corner and that's not what I was looking for. The same old thing doesn't challenge me, help me to grow, and make an impact in the community as it's primary role. This place does all those things and does them well. The Sunday message is given by a rotating group as well as guest speakers. In my opinion this is necessary so that no one gets a big head and has a great fall like we've seen so many times before. Most churches are churches WITH small groups, Oakwood is a church OF small groups. They're focus is outward, growing the universal body of Christ. Not inward, growing the number of attendees. When was the last time you heard a pastor more concerned with spreading the gospel and making disciples (who then go and make other disciples who start their own church) than growing their own numbers?? That's why I'm here. Oakwood is a wonderful family-centered Church that is inclusive and friendly. We felt right away at home and we're welcomed into their congregation. We visited other churches but none of them felt as warm and friendly as oakwood. There are lots of programs including small groups and programs for kids. They have a soccer Clinic twice a year for children, an easter event and Holiday events. They teach ESL to students for free, and offer many other opportunities including Bible studies women's meetings men's meetings and more. They also have a robust youth group and children's ministry. If you're looking for a place to call home for your family, this is a great place to be Such an amazing church they open their doors to so many! Even our homeschooling kiddos! Teach is such an amazing opportunity for us as parents trying to spice up our kids learning!!

name: Oasis Atlanta Campus - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: The realest pastor in Atlanta!!! He doesn’t sugarcoat the truth!! Thoroughly enjoyed him and the Praise and Worship Team! So anointed!! Awesome worship experience and powerful word. The Pastor is so real and relevant to entire congregation. Looking forward to how GOD will bless Oasis Atlanta Church. Definitely an amazing experience. I truly enjoy myself every time. Thanks pastor for going out on faith to bring your message to Atlanta #unforgettable First time there Great Awesome Powerful Man of God. And the WORD OMG that was truly a WORD from God. I thank God for Ms. Wood inviting me. I will surely be back. Because I am about Gods Kingdom. The holy spirit lives here! Ever since i started coming here,  i have experience an increased in all  areas of my life! Anthony Murray is changing life's!

name: Oasis Baptist Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary: Been coming to this church for a year. Small but they make you feel very welcome and treat you like family. Pastor Price and his Andrea are down to earth and make you feel  very comfortable no matter if it's your 1st time at church or you have been coming for years. No judgements here from Pastor to Patrons alike. Everyone has a story and a past and all our welcome with love. Daycare provided for little ones and youth groups for all ages. Check it out,  you will leave feeling HIS word I promise you! Welcome and come all.....🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥❤️❤️!  Enjoy and You are Cordially Invited! A welcoming embrace from wonderful people. The sermon about family was spot on. A lot of children and fun activities for the whole family to enjoy. It is a really great place. Every one was so nice, friendly and inviting. Pastor Aaron Flanagan did a fantastic job delivering the message. He has so much passion. They have the words on the screen but encourage you to bring your Bible so you can read along and study yourself. Great place. A church filled with loving, welcoming, and wonderful people that love Jesus. This church family opened up their arms to us during a rough season in our life. The Pastors have a genuine love for Christ and for serving their community. We are so glad God led us here!

name: Oasis Christian Church - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
If I could give -0 stars I would went to a workshop here with my Pastor in Baton Rouge. Pastor Wallace bragged so much about the food they served us at the workshop, “saying”..You won’t go another church and get fed as good as I fed y’all. I was put off right there. They passed collection around 3 difference times with 10 collection bags, saying dig deeper in your pockets. First of all the workshop was paid for so why do I have to give you all this extra money. Run from this church. All about MONEY. We got lost it was our first time there Pastor Wallace was very rude with me and my children because we got lost. He was shouting asking who we were and I was trying to say we were lost but I had to wait till he finished hollowing. I told my Pastor I would never go there again . Don’t know how to treat guest. I also saw a lady I knew from another church as usher there she acted like she was scared to speak.   I have never went to a church where the Pastor acted like that and I was using a cane at the time because I had just graduated from a walker had been in a wheelchair for 2 years. I told my Pastor everything that happened when me and my kids found our way out. We never went back to continue the workshop. I will never go to this so called church again. Oasis Christian church 4524 East Brookstown Dr. Baton Rouge La. 70805 Pastor Charles Wallace Love me some Pastor Wallace. The word is made plain with simplistic application everytime I visit. I suggest you wear some protective shoes when you attend because your toes will be stepped on.😊 Bishop Charles Wallace, is an awesome teacher... when he teaches you, he makes sure he breaks his sermons down for you so, that you would understand what thus saids the Lord.
It's about him and MASTER💃 A warm loving welcome and an inviting spirit leading into a sanctuary filled with truth and a wonderful and anointed  interpretation of God's word given with clarity and accuracy. You will get the True Word of God!!! We love Bishop Charles E Wallace❤ a true Man of God!!!

name: oasis christian ministries, Inc - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary:
Oasis is my home church because God made it evident to me to plant myself there. I love this church and my church family are truly Holy Ghost filled people who definitely love the Lord and follow Him. My spiritual walk with Jesus has accelerated so much and it’s crazy I don’t even recognize myself anymore. I want to be continually transformed into the image of Christ. I’m never going to look back at my past but I’m
moving forward with Jesus holding my hand.  I want more of Him and less of me. Thank you Jesus for everything. You are truly enough and all that I need in my life. Come check this church out for yourself. You will not be disappointed. Hallelujah! Amen❤️‍🔥🙏🏾 I have known both Pastor Joel and Georgia since moving to Sacramento in 2011. Oasis is not my home church however I must state that Pastor Joel is the greatest spiritual Dad  I have met since moving here. He is kind, generous and as another reviewer wrote he really does put everyone before himself, he is a perfect example of un-selfish. The church is very free and the congregation is extremely loving and kind towards new members. I am a worship leader throughout the cities and this is my favorite church to lead worship at due to the anointing that flows within this church, there are over 12 different churches our team plays at and again this one is my absolute favorite to lead at. There is so much freedom here, so much love that the minute you walk into the doors you can feel an overwhelming presence of the Holy Spirit. If you are looking for a church to get filled this one is for you. Not only is the Spirit evident in this church but I can't say enough about the lead Pastor Joel Pappas,  he is somebody that will accept you and love you and never hesitate to give you the time of day to help you in times of need.  He again is just a beautiful man of God and it shows all over in the way he treats others and the members of his church.  This church is amazing and the warmth and welcome that you will receive when attending here is far above a majority of the churches around today.  There is not enough good things I can say about Oasis, just a beautiful spirit filled church with a beautiful hearted spirit filled pastor!  Thanks Oasis for everything and all the blessings your ministry has given not only myself but the thousands of others I have seen touched throughout the years at this church. 5 stars all the way Although I haven't gone in sometime now, I can tell you that Oasis Christian Mission Center do not follow another Christ, but the only true and Living God Jesus Christ! The Word of God From Genesis to Revelations is believed and preached from with the guidance of the Holy Spirit and the Pastors truly Love God and Love His People. The Body Of Christ As A Whole has not completely arrived and has it's issues that needs to be worked on, unfortunately when people have a bad situation with someone in any one of the churches they may attend, they will demonize that particular church or churches.  The only thing we can do is continue to love them and pray for them agape4life I attended this church off and on for almost a year. The pastor of this church is a saint, he seems to always put others before himself from what I have seen. This congregation is definitely going after God. This is not a hands in your pocket church. Very anointed and the presence of the Holy Spirit is obvious at this church. I have started to seek other churches however recently because the worship music does not have any variety anymore. There used to be a few really good worship teams that would play here when I first started to attend  but over the past few months now that I have gone it has been the same worship leader everytime and he and his backups are just ok,  Overall a really warm and welcoming church. I am unable to drive but if I could I would go back to Oasis in a heartbeat!  I love Pastor Joel and Pastor Georgia Papas💝They are transparent and pure of heart. It was my honor to serve at Oasis. I loved using flags and dancing in worship.  If someone is biblically wrong, they are lovingly corrected.  May God continue to reside in the hearts of His children who reside at Oasis in purity and in truth.  Amen.

name: Oasis Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I worship at this church any time I visit LA, about once every three months. The atmosphere is welcoming, the people are very friendly and accepting, the worship is God-glorifying, the anointed messages are inspiring and faith-building/faith-enhancing. I always look forward to attending the services. Oasis Church offers a refreshing take on spirituality, far from your average church experience. Initially attending to support a friend, I was pleasantly surprised by the profoundly uplifting message and the vibrant, welcoming congregation. The atmosphere is charged with positivity, fostering a sense of community and belonging. It's a place where fun and faith intertwine seamlessly, making every service not just a ritual, but a truly joyful gathering. Whether you're there for support or seeking a spiritual home, Oasis Church stands out as a beacon of hope and togetherness. I started going to Oasis a few months ago after attending Fearless LA for the past 7 years. I enjoy Pastor Julian's message and they are always on point. The worship band is incredible but most importantly, Pastor believes in the individual God given talents of the members and I admire that. Not Sure What to Think, a Place of Contrasts. Old church, covered stained glass windows, cross dwarfed by moving neon lights, a little too Las Vegas but full of energy. Some Bible verses and motivational stories, but too much performance and talk about money. Would Jesus, homeless and in sandals--humble--be welcomed here? Yet God sends His Spirit to those who seek . . . I live out of state but I love attending their online services which are always so inspiring.

name: Oasis Family Life Church - Lithia Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Initially, I liked it and even joined! However, I’m a PK born and raised in a Pentecostal church. I chose this church bc it was small and thought it would be more personable, but after joining, I never spoke to anyone personally as I have in any other church I’ve ever joined. I paid tithes and gave what I had to give but when I reached out to the pastor for guidance, I was ignored. Most of the sermons, the prayers and conversations were about money! There was a prayer event with visiting Pastor Angelic Simmons that I attended, that was by far the best and most anointing experience I had at Oasis. Another evening prayer was attempted and the anointing was not in the building. As a “member” I didn’t feel welcome or part of the congregation especially not being able to receive not even acknowledgement from my pastor during a very difficult time in my life. It may have not been of  importance to him but detrimental to me! If I wasn’t strong in my faith and my relationship with God, I would have been a soul lost that God would have held “Pastor” accountable for! You never know what ppl are going through and you should be mindful of how you treat ppl . God Don’t Play About Me!! Needless to say, I haven’t been back! Focus more on saving souls not how deep you can dig in their pockets! Good Bless…. I have attended this church for 4 years and I love it! Pastor Murray is sincere and love people and most of all God! What I love the most is that this church does some much for the community! whatever you give you see it immediately turn someone life around in the local community! So many testimonies and good deeds! i feel  honored to attend and see people lives change including my own! I really enjoy this church. The atmosphere along with the teaching is amazing. I just wish that the 11am service for the Paulding campus was not rushed due to service starting at 12:30 for the Atlanta campus. When Pastor Murray is teaching you can feel the spirit in the atmosphere and then often times it has to be cut short bc of time. It would be great if the time was a little different. However it's an awesome place to worship and the expansion is an absolute blessing! I love this church. I feel so connected when I'm there. Pastor Murray has always allowed god to lead him and brings a great message. Since it's about a 2 hr drive from me I watch online every Sunday. Online streaming works great for when I'm out of town as well. I'm in the process of getting back to Cobb County so that I can attend services every Sunday. My first time there, he preached about tithing and I understood the message. I had a wonderful time. Pastor Murray is a down to earth. He treats well ask treat you with warm welcome and like a member not a number. Love it. The Men Ministry has men of honor, respect and dignity amongst the members who get together to make sure all men are doing what the Bible is design to show men for their family and selves. There is not one dull moment in the church. Pastor Carlos and Pastor Jeremy made me comfortable to be in their presents and in the church. I was confined to my home with my disability and PTSD and when I went there I become instantly loved and comfortable. Go and worship with a great group of worshipers.

name: OB One Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
If you catch the evening sunset's within the cliffs or close to the O.B. pier,
Come catch the "SON"rise with your peers Sunday mornings.
Everyone's Welcome
2 Corinthians 4:6: "For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ." Overall a very blessed 5 stars out of 5 stars. Awesome location. Great service, was our first time here visiting with a friend who attends. We loved the message, What's the Greatest gift God provided? Answer - Grace, without it we can not have anything else! It was WONDERFUL!

You won't walk out without at LEAST one person saying hello.

Free coffee and donuts!

Great worship team!

Awesome pastor!!!

Great location and hours!

You should go.

name: OC Singles For Christ Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I had such a meaningful and uplifting experience at OC Single for Christ.
The atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and genuinely Christ-centered. What stood out the most to me was how friendly and open everyone was — it truly felt like a safe space to meet other believers who share similar values and life goals.

The organizers were caring and intentional, making sure people felt included rather than awkward. The group attracts mature, sincere Christians who are looking for real connection, not superficial small talk. I left feeling encouraged, refreshed, and grateful to have discovered this community.

Highly recommend it to anyone in Orange County who wants fellowship, growth, and the chance to build Christ-honoring relationships. The only church anywhere just for Singles!

They believe in all the fundamental doctrines of the evangelical Protestant church. For example, they believe in the inerrancy of Scripture, from the Bible, Old and New Testaments, is the inspired, infallible Word of God. This is most definitely a senior citizen singles get together.  OTOH  it is so not a place for the spiritually mature   The Bible study is appropriate for a 1rst grade Sunday school.

The median age is 65-75.   You will probably run out of there if you don't fall in this category.  If you're looking to meet someone of the opposite sex, and you are not in this age range, I'll save you some time, you will not feel comfortable here

Something that was really egregious to me was the begging for $.

My pastor NEVER asks for $, he says "If God guides God provides"

OCSFC will spend an inordinate amount of time on instructing you to give (so cringe for a first time visitor)  which made me write them off right off the bat

They are at best a source of entertainment on Friday night for the over 65 crowd, it is FR not a church.   It is similar to an activities event at a skilled nursing facility.

Look no further if that's what you are after

After the "message" was karaoke.   99% of the participants were completely off key, singing their hearts out

The "performances" were so laughable, yet no one was laughing.  Maybe they were great vocalists, but the sound system was against them ?   That is the one positive thing I can say about this organization, that no one was mocking them, which is a plus as far as I'm concerned

Anyways, if a deep spiritual message or meaningful fellowship with seasoned believers does not matter to you, if you don't mind the leadership pleading with you to part with your $, and you are extremely elderly and single this may be the perfect place for you It is way better than public clubs. The pastor keeps it God centered. The people are great. OC Singles pros-cons
pros
1.	Nice friendly people, safe environment, ping pong, karaoke, low cost dinner, big on dancing events. Friday nights are free to attend. Teaching and worship music are adequate.
Cons
2.	Older crowd, 55plus, hardly any young folks, OC Singles would like to be a church, but it more a place to meet for fellowship and hangout. People come for the fellowship and to meet new people, almost everyone attends church elsewhere. It’s one of the very few single Christian weekly gatherings in Orange County.

name: OC Summit Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: My church home and I love it.

name: Ocean City Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Sunday service while vacationing, It was one block from my hotel.
I was warmly welcomed at the door & had a great cup of coffee. The worship was powerful, the message biblical & inspiring. It’s a very homey atmosphere with a memorable message. I enjoyed the service & if I lived in Jax I definitely would come back. 15 years ago I was put in Foster Care by the youth pastor. Today I let that go with the push & welcome of my friends to attend this church. I don't know what my attendance will be for this church or in general but I am eternally grateful. This church is our family. We love it because it has a nice smaller amount of people so it makes it easier to form meaningful relationships. There's a lot of opportunities to come together and grow together socially through weekly city groups and monthly meet ups. My favorite part of this church is the people, worship, and of course the weekly messages. Whoever is up front to deliver a message definitely leaves you feeling spiritually fed. This was my second time visiting this Church I was very disappointed the Pastor did not even mention what happened yesterday at the Trump rally. Someone lost their life and President Trump was nearly killed the Pastor didn't even mention it extremely strange we should have prayed for the family that lost a loved one as well as prayed for the President and our Country overall. It's not about politics it's a spiritual issue going on but the Pastor chose to ignore and crack jokes and talk about waterfalls. OCC just feels like home. I have been in churches my whole life and this one is such a gem. I never feel like I have to be perfect or have my stuff together before I walk in to worship and grow. From the teachings to the worship to the community groups to the lessons our children learn, there is always a focus on God's rescuing grace. So grateful for the constant reminder to choose freedom!

name: Ocean Hills Church
reviewSummary: A warm and inviting non-denominational community. Excellent contemporary worship team.

name: Ocean View Church | Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
wonderful atmosphere, pastor Logan delivered a great sermon,  my mother-in-law had a great time to. and I thought she would Never enter. nor let alone enjoy the service. but she did,
, hope we can attend again soon. This church has been serving the community for over 70 years. Relaunched in October of 2021 you will find a welcoming multi-generational congregation who, are not ashamed of the gospel of Jesus. Our pastor is warm and authentic. The worship invites the presence of the Holy Spirit. Open to all, 10:15am on Sundays, enjoy a casual service and dare to make connections.  There are kids and senior ministries and more. - and as a bonus the farmers market and many 3rd avenue eateries are open after church 😊✝️💕 Excellent place to worship. Close to community and lots of different things happening in the week. A great place for kids, adults, families, everyone! Based solidly on Scripture and overflowing with care and welcome, Ocean View Church Chula Vista has been our home church for years! Every time you are there with Pastor Steve, you will be filled with Christ! He is so knowledgeable about our Holy Father and the Bible you will just want for more. Thank you Jesus for him.

name: Oceans Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful to be a part of a church that is full of the Holy Spirit, and that preaches the truth. I have seen it grow from the beginning! Sunday services are always powerful. Each week people get saved and healed - miracles are always happening! Sundays are a place you can be equipped as a Christian but they are also a space where people who don’t know Jesus can encounter Him.

I love the spaces created beyond Sunday as well to go deeper, like weekly prayer, small groups, and Wave Night. People are being discipled, and that’s a process that takes time, but we have countless leaders committed to building up the people in this house.

My life has been deeply impacted by Pastors Mark and Rachelle Francey over many years, and I love getting to be a part of this church family! God restored and changed my life through this church. I have been here for 2 years and am currently in the Oceans College, and the wisdom and care I have received here has surpassed any other church I have gone to. I've seen the shift in my life, my marriage, my intimacy with God, and even the spill over effect on to my family. I'm so grateful for Pastor Mark and Rachelle Francey, Pastor Joel and Melanie Foust, and all of the lead pastors and staff of Oceans. God bringing me to Oceans Church has changed my life in ways I can’t articulate. This church has such amazing pastors and staff; everyone embodies the heart of Jesus. I’ve met my best friends, I’ve encountered most importantly the presence of God like never before. I thank Oceans Church for the fruit they’ve reaped that pours out to each person that walks into this church. God is truly doing such a mighty work and I thank the pastors for their obedience, stewardship and humble authority that is so inspiring and encouraging. I love oceans church and I will forever be grateful for the ways God has blessed me with such an amazing church and community I get to call home💕💕 I am so grateful for this church! The pastors are the same on and off the stage and they pour so much into the people of this house. I have found some of my best friends, got plugged into small groups, and have been taught sound biblical teaching each week. The kids team does such an amazing job teaching the kids and giving them a space to learn and grow and each team serving does so with a smile on their face. Been attending oceans since 2020 and for the past 6 years Oceans church has been a church that puts Jesus First. No Church is perfect it has its flaws, but that's the whole body of Christ. This church does a very good job on holding each other accountable and sharpening each other. It's Holy Spirit filled and the faith at Oceans is abundant. Definitely an amazing church!

name: Oceans Church (SJC) - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
What stands out most is the genuine connection among the people. Whether it’s your first visit or your fiftieth, you’re treated like family. The smiles are real. The prayers are sincere. And the love of Christ is everywhere! The worship is powerful and spirit-led, with music that lifts your soul and messages that speak straight to the heart. The pastors are authentic, passionate, and deeply rooted in Scripture. Every sermon leaves you feeling both challenged and encouraged to grow in your walk with God.
You’re Invited to Oceans Church – Come Experience the Difference! The Spirit of God is in this place.

Super good praise and worship
Super good preaching

If you want to go to real authentic church, look no further. This is the place to be in Southern California, Orange County.

They are meeting outside under tent covering due to covid. Nevertheless this place is real. Come one, come all and experience God the maker of Heaven and Earth This is a amazing church no holding back from the word of God here. If you're looking for a home church and want to know all that God has for you check it out. My daughter and her family attend here and I got to visit and witness my grandchildren be dedicated to the Lord. Thank You Jesus!! We’ve been church-goers our whole lives but have never experienced the transformation and communion with God like we have through Oceans Church. The Spirit of the Lord is here! This is a church that honors the Lord above all else, prays faithfully and teaches the full Gospel. The lead pastors are true shepherds, devoted to seeking God’s will and living Romans 12:1-2 lives. Refreshing! Our kids love the youth programs and have and have made great friendships. Exceedingly and eternally (literally) grateful for Oceans! I mean wow what a powerful service!
This is an amazing amazing church. Just excellence from the moment you walk in to the moment you walk out. The worship was so anointed! The preaching with so anointed and appointed with a timely message. The worship was so anointed! The preaching with so anointed and appointed with a timely message. They had baptisms after service and it was son fun and high energy!
This was my first time from Jersey and can't wait to get back. Great job Oceans Team!

name: Oceanside Christian Fellowship - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter just performed in her first play here. They have a great theater program for kids. My family and I don't attend Church since we're not religious so i can't tell you what mass is like but the people who work for the church are very friendly and seem to be great people. I highly recommend signing your kids up here if they enjoy theater. My daughter is just 3 and she loved every moment. 🗣️For anyone reading, please don’t let an experience like this discourage your personal relationship with God. ✝️

I was looking forward to attending a women’s retreat and connecting with a new community during a challenging time in my life. Unfortunately, my experience trying to sign up was disappointing and left me feeling discouraged. 😔

I was told (by Nicole) I needed to attend a Sunday service before receiving the retreat signup link, which felt more like a barrier than an invitation. 🥹While I understand churches have processes, the way the conversation was handled left me feeling overwhelmed, uncomfortable, and unwelcome especially after I had openly shared that I was going through a lot.

I shared with Nicole how I was feeling in the moment, but didn’t receive any follow up or encouragement afterward.😭

I personally host women’s events, and I would NEVER interact with someone this way, especially when they are coming in vulnerable and seeking community. 🤍

My hope is that churches remember how important it is to lead with warmth and compassion, especially when someone is reaching out in need. I’m grateful my faith is strong, but I can imagine how an experience like this could impact someone who is new or searching. 🙏🏽

I’ve prayed about sharing this and ultimately chose to speak up, not to tear anyone down, but to advocate for myself and for others who may be seeking support and community. Wonderful worship. Great message. Amazing people. I was very welcomed and embraced. Fellowship for all ages and stages of life! If you're looking for a church near Westchester, playa del Rey, or beach city area, I highly recommend you visit OCF! Holy Spirit is present here! Visiting our Daughter and Son in Law we got to go to their awesome church. People were friendly, awesome music, and relevant Bible based message.
If you want to hear God's word in the crazy world we live in, this church will be a great choice We go here when we're in town to visit family. The people are welcoming and the message is Bible-based. They have "plurality of leadership," so there's a different preacher each Sunday, and they've all been good. The music is current (think KLOVE) but not too loud or showy. They're not giving a concert; they're worshipful.

name: Oceanside Community Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
The most welcoming and loving church I have ever been a part of! From the very first day I showed up we were treated like family. Love Oceanside Community Church!!! OCC is a special church!   Genuine people doing life together and loving each other well.  If you are looking for a great church community, this is worth a visit! Such a great church! Visited this church during our vacation and felt like if we were to move from North California, this would be our home church! Pastor did a great job on preaching about Saul’s life and purpose. Deep and practical message. Two points stood out to me: 1. Worship God by dedicating your whole life. 2. Partial obedience is full disobedience.
So powerful! And the kids church left my 3 babies all overjoyed. God bless you all beautiful people of Oceanside Community Church! Visits like this remind me how fun it will be to be together in Heaven. Amen! Love OCC!  An authentic church family that truly cares about the individual and preaching the word of God verse by verse. I visit Known Church at 5PM Sundays. Oceanside community Church is lovely.

name: Oceanside First Presbyterian Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I absolutely love Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and preschool. From the moment we walked in, people were incredibly welcoming and genuine. It truly feels like a church family.

The Sunday service is meaningful and encouraging with great worship music, choir, and band, and Pastor Mike’s biblical teaching is thoughtful, practical, and centered on Jesus. The atmosphere is joyful and relaxed, and the free coffee and courtyard fellowship make it easy to connect with people.

One of the things we appreciate most is how much this church cares about the Oceanside community. They are actively involved in outreach programs and service projects that make a real difference.

If you are looking for a welcoming Christian church in Oceanside where people are authentic, friendly, and serious about growing in faith, I highly recommend visiting Oceanside First Presbyterian church and preschool. Oceanside First Presbyterian Church is such a warm and welcoming space to Reach, Teach, and Serve each other, those in our community, and across the globe. The first time I attended, I immediately felt at home and accepted.
The church is politics free space, accepting all people and family, regardless of prior experiences, beliefs,race, Marital status, and sexual orientation.
I joined the choir, have attended the Wednesday Women’s fellowship, the monthly seniors activities, and special services, concerts, and community events.
Adult , teens, and children’s ministries are offered, as well as presentations such as the Parkinson’s and Cancer support groups.
I hope you will come and experience Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and find out for yourself! We’ve had such a wonderful experience with this preschool. From day one, the environment has been incredibly welcoming, making both my daughter and our family feel comfortable and supported.

This was my daughter’s first time in a school environment, and I was naturally a bit nervous. The teachers (Mrs. Marks and Mrs. Saldaña) took the time to walk me through what to expect and gave helpful guidance on how to navigate those first couple of weeks. They reassured me that the transition period was normal and they were absolutely right. With their support and encouragement, my daughter adjusted beautifully. By week three, she was excited, happy, and eager to go to school each day.

The teachers are attentive, caring, and truly invested in the children. I really appreciate how they take the time to provide daily summaries at pickup, so I always know how my daughter’s day went. It gives me so much peace of mind.

The school also does a great job of keeping parents informed about upcoming events and activities, which helps us stay involved and better support our daughter’s growth and development.

Overall, I’m so grateful for the positive, nurturing environment they’ve created. It’s clear they genuinely care about the children and their families. The church members are very friendly and welcoming. The music is a great mix of classic hymns and contemporary. The Pastor is personally welcoming and his messages truly hit home. The church offers many activities and worthy causes. I truly enjoy coming! Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and Preschool has been a wonderful community for my children and family. The preschool, community, staff and teachers are so amazing. I could not be happier with the experience here Church and preschool both.

name: Oceanside Sanctuary - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Oceanside Sanctuary Church for about 6 years. I was looking for a deeper spiritual life and happily found this amazing church. First, I love the beautiful, stained glass historic building. But the real gems are the co-pastors, Jason and Jenell Coker and all the wonderful people that are a part of this church. It is a rare space where all are welcome, where we are asked to think and live deeply in our faith. It is a rare space of inclusion, love, diversity, while embracing the word of God and the life of Jesus. It is a rare space of welcoming atheists, agnostics, and those who aren’t sure what they believe. And we find so many ways to be of service to our community.
This loving community has restored my faith, given me a new home, and connected me to the wonders of God. I am so grateful to have found my home in this church and now finally feel close to God again thanks to the leaders here & the community. I am extremely grateful for the loving, inclusive community of OSC & their focus on justice, joy & inclusion in the name of jesus! Love this Church and all the wonderful people who attend here!! Very Gay friendly and a loving community.  🙏 It's already humiliating enough to have to go to a pantry to be treated without a spirit of love. It hurts when you need help and your talked down to.Sarah wouldn't approve. My wife and I have been going to this church for several weeks now and it is by far the best church we have ever been members of. The staff is friendly and genuine. Jason and his wife Jenelle are cornerstones of the community. The church is inclusive and LGBTQ+ friendly. We found our home here for sure.

UPDATE

We have now been members for almost two years and there is a reason this church is growing. The community here is unparalleled. The staff, the volunteers, and of course Jason and Janelle are our home away from home. If you’re looking for a church that actually acts like one and doesn’t just talk about it, come to OSC.

name: Oceanside United Reformed Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Oceanside URC is one of the most welcoming churches I have ever been to. This church was my introduction to any reformed church and I absolutely loved it. Duncan, and elder at this church, made sure me and my family were greeted, and he made us feel like family the second we met him. The preaching was biblical, the Gospel was proclaimed, and we sung songs straight from the Bible. As a visitor to the Southern California area anytime someone I know is in Carlsbad or Oceanside I always recommend they spend their sundays here. A wonderful, welcoming, and warm church. They seek first and foremost to glorify God, and show how to enjoy Him forever by grace through faith in His Son, Christ Jesus. I love this congregation so much. I was a visitor, and I was welcomed in not as an outsider, but as a brother in Christ. Their Biblical hospitality was matched by sound, and faithful teaching of God’s Word, unapologetically. I thank God that in a world marked by compromise, that God sustains congregations like this one to spread the Light to the world. My family attended Oceanside URC in the recent past—our second son was baptized here. This congregation is genuinely unique in that you will find solid scriptural preaching, hospitality, and a tight-knit community which takes the Lord's worship AND loving one another seriously. If you become a member here you WILL make friends who will look after you. You WILL have a pastor and elders who are regularly involved in caring for your family's spiritual welfare. You WILL break bread with your congregation every Sunday. You WILL experience historic protestant catholicity in word, sacrament, and worship. You WILL hear the Word preached faithfully and the Gospel clearly proclaimed.

The Rev. Dr. Danny Hyde is a gem who is uniquely gifted as both a pastor and a scholar, which is a very rare combination to find in a local church today. If you are looking to grow in Christ you need to give this church your first visit. My church fam at Oceanside URC, where the gospel of our King is faithfully preached in love! Christ-centered teaching from the Scriptures, and worship of our Triune God in song and prayer, in word and sacrament. "In Him, we have redemption through His blood, and the forgiveness of our sins, all according to the riches of His grace" (Eph 1:7).

We enjoy learning of and sharing in the richness of our historic Christian faith through the ages, and as confessed in the Three Forms of Unity. A warm, welcoming congregation, serving our merciful God; we look forward to meeting you soon! Oceanside United Reformed Church its an oasis in the mids of desert of shallow Christianity. It was an answer to our prayers  for our family to find a solid Reformed and Confessional church. Committed to historicity of the church, confessing the catholic and ecumenical Creeds of Christianity (Nicene Creed, Athanasian Creed, Apostles creed ). We partake of the Lord's Supper every Lord's Day. Wonderful Church family, very hospitable. If you are seeking a faithful Gospel centered church, that takes the gospel and scripture seriously, you will be gladly welcome!

name: Oceanside Worship Center, CLGI - Oceanside Campus
