name: OCGrace Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
OCGrace Church is a wonderful place to worship, grow in faith, and experience a welcoming community. From the moment you walk in, everyone is friendly, kind, and genuinely caring. The messages are inspiring, Bible-centered, and easy to apply to everyday life.

The worship is uplifting, and the atmosphere is warm, peaceful, and filled with God’s presence. Whether you’re new to church or have been attending for years, you’ll feel accepted and encouraged here.

I’m grateful for this church and the amazing people who make it such a special place. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships, and feel at home, I highly recommend OCGrace Church. God is truly at work here. 🙏❤️✝️ If you want a nice comfortable place to worship, this is the place to be. God's word is shared here. And the congregation is incredibly loving and caring. I see people walking in and someone greets them and ask them their name and learn a little bit about them if there's time. This is a bible-believing Christian Church where the Bible is absolute word of God. Today is Paster Day! We all thankful of your teaching everyday we received wisdom and Love of GOD through you guys!!! THANK YOU! Nice people and best place to worship in OC. Let's make this clear: I am not a Seventh Day Adventist. I grew up in a traditional Buddhist family. However, I've always been open-minded and curious about other religions. I started going to this church because my girlfriend is an SDA. I must say, the experience has been transformative and enlightening. Everyone at this church has been super friendly and extremely welcoming. They do not push their religion down your throat, yet they focus on change and action through devotion, service, and community. They have a new pastor, Pastor Jonny, who has been doing wondrous work for the church and the community. His sermons are so insightful, empowering, and reflective. This church is made even more special by all the members. They are so devoted to the church to making each Sabbath a special service - to the Audio/Visual team, to the Lights/Sound team, to the Praise/Worship team - they all put their heart and soul to spread their faith and love for God. If you are an SDA family visiting in town nearby, or just a non-denominational religious person,  or even a curious non-religious person/family who is missing something in their life/lives, come check out one Saturday service. You will be renewed and rejuvenated!

name: Offices of Christ Community Church - Little Rock - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
A great fellowship of followers of Jesus. Michael Loudermilk and staff are the best.

Timothy A Howell
Castle Hills Texas Truly warm and inviting church. Excellent Bible based  teaching that is applicable to everyday life. Meh My church! Love it!

name: OKC Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: OKC Church is a warm, caring group of people who love deeply, share freely, and fight hard to follow Jesus' example daily. The church is made of imperfect humans, true, but I feel like 99% of the family here is doing God's work. Really like this church the people are very friendly  enjoy everything about it Great people serving our lord I love this place! The people are great! Service isn't always the same routine which is awesome. I highly recommend checking this church out. Come for the people. Stay for Jesus. A great family friendly church that you can grow spiritually in. If you are looking to grow in the Lord this is the Church dirt you.

name: OKC Community Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
OKC Community is truly a community. I've been attending on and off since 2024. The people I have met and befriended are some of my closest friends and mentors and I can only accredit my growth in my faith to this community of true believers and God. PTL! Feels like family as soon as you walk in.
A community of people who love God and love the city. Friendly loving welcoming. Loving God and Bringing life to our city by being the best church we know how. High faith God can do anything people. I've called OKC Community Church home for a long time! That's exactly how it feels, like home. Everyone is welcoming, kind, and loving. We have something for all ages from babies to seniors. Spirit lead services where worship is amazing and sermons are focused on the Truth of the gospel and always point you to Jesus. We are real people doing life together.  I LOVE my church! OKC Community Church is a wonderful church with a deep teaching from all of the pastors, a Holy Spirit invited worship that will soften any heart and a staff that makes you feel part of the family. It’s a “Come as You Are” church. They have blessed all three of my daughters with their Youth Group or the many classes that they offer. It’s a hidden gem! This has been my church home since I moved back to OKC in 2021. This church is led by a team of people who are really living out the Gospel, focusing on caring for the community and sharing the love and truth of Christ. The community is unmatched and I genuinely believe there is something for everyone here!

name: OKC First Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: We have been here for three years, and this church, these people, have been a balm to our weary, disillusioned hearts. If you're looking for an inclusive fellowship of Jesus-loving people who welcome, love, and involve you and preach, know, and practice what the Kingdom is actually about, this is the place. God's mind about you is made up, and the news is good. Come see! They stand for the truth and fully love others. This church genuinely loves EVERYONE. OKC First doesn’t care where you are from, your sexual orientation, your gender identity, YOU ARE LOVED AND WELCOME. Full stop. No caveats. No conditions. This is HOME and FAMILY to me! I love this church and these people so much! I made made my church home here for almost 2 years. I moved to Paris Texas but when I come to back to OKC I make an opportunity to visit this family of faith. They accept me and love me as I am and even save me a seat :) this is a church that lives our Love Your Neighbor and Love One Another to the fullest extent. The music in the services is so amazing and the Preaching is always applicable to my life no matter who preaches. I'm so thankful they have a podcast where I can listen in Texas especially when I am homesick for these people and this place. OKC 1st has had such a profound and deep impact on my life. Love this church!  We don’t live in OKC but this would be our church home if we did. Great pastor and staff with a wonderful message of God and his love for you. I went for help and received it.  I did not like disclosing my private information and or my families either by filling out the forms I hope I am not becoming a member of the church  but I loved how I was able to receive the help when I needed it with no other inconvenience. I will donate back when I am more stable. Thank you. I really appreciate the help.

name: Old Saint Patrick's Church
reviewSummary: Oldest Catholic church in Pittsburgh (1808) and a beautiful outdoor garden for reflection and prayer. Little slice of heaven in a busy crowded city. Worth a visit! This is Pittsburgh’s oldest church. It is a calm, quiet, and peaceful oasis amidst the hustle and bustle of the Strip District and nearby uptown Pittsburgh. It is positively beautiful at Christmastime and deserves a visit. Do NOT use the main stairs as visitors are to ascend them on their knees while praying the rosary. Instead, use the stairs on either side of the entrance to make your way to the main chapel. This is a small church, but it’s humble appearance belies its spiritual power. If you’re visiting The Strip, it’s worth dropping in to see Pittsburgh’s oldest Church, their beautiful guardians, and the sacred stairs. Went there for mass at around noon. It's a nice church with a lot of history. A very lovely and serene house of love and worship. The courtyard is a magical little place to sit and reflect. The holy stairs are very interesting to see.

name: Old St. Mary's Catholic Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful historic church with truly impressive architecture. The interior is breathtaking, featuring intricate details, elegant design, and a style that feels reminiscent of classic European churches. It’s a peaceful place to visit and admire the craftsmanship, history, and artistic details that make this church a special landmark in Detroit. Historic church. Beautiful inside.  Attended a wedding, pretty hot inside, but a huge church would be impossible to cool when it's so hot outside. Beautiful church and love attending mass there! Great choir and Father John is Awesome!! Highly Recommend attending mass here 💗 I have gone to several Catholic Churches in the downtown Detroit area. This is the one by far that I am most happy with. I always feel welcome, the entrance chant, the organ, the choir, the homilies, and most especially the church itself all so very beautiful. Always the best midnight mass, this year was the greatest service I've attended. The Father was relatable , humorous and I wish I lived back in the area, I'd attend more often.

name: Old Stone Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
What cool architecture! The inside is beautiful, from the huge stained glass windows to the arched all wooden ceiling. Very cool site to visit! We have been a members since 2019💘
Honesty Ive grown so much in my Faith since my first visit.😇
Yes The Church has many Beautiful & Wonderful aspects about it.
Plus its Amazing History  👏
My Favorite Aspects Just also happen to be The Most Beautiful Part of Old Stone Church................  The Members💖 Old Stone Church in Cleveland is a breathtaking architectural marvel that truly captures the spirit of community and worship. The stunning stone exterior and intricate stained glass windows create a warm, inviting atmosphere that draws you in. Upon entering, the beauty of the interior continues to impress, with high ceilings and a sense of history that enriches every service.

The sense of community here is palpable, and the friendliness of the congregation is remarkable. Everyone is welcoming, making it easy to feel at home, whether you’re a first-time visitor or a long-time member. The messages delivered during the services are both inspiring and thought-provoking, offering a refreshing perspective on faith and life. The music, led by talented musicians, enhances the experience, with hymns and contemporary pieces that resonate deeply and uplift the spirit.

However, one noticeable aspect is the demographic of the congregation. While the church is rich in history and tradition, it seems to attract a more mature crowd, and there aren’t many young people present. This could be an opportunity for outreach and growth, as the messages and community spirit here have so much to offer to all ages.

Overall, Old Stone Church is a beautiful place of worship with a strong sense of community and uplifting messages, making it a worthwhile visit for anyone in Cleveland. An integral part of Cleveland's Public Square, Old Stone Church is hosting an interesting sculpture on the stairs of their right front door at the Corner of Ontario and Rockwell.
The plaque by the sculpture reads:
"Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me."
"Les aseguro que todo lo que hicieron por uno de mis hermanos, aun por el mas pequeño, lo hicieron por mi."
Matthew 25:40
Hank & Barb Waters
Sculptor:  Timothy Schmalz
In October 2023, another Timothy Schmalz sculpture was installed in Public Square across from the Old Stone Church (near the statue of Tom Johnson) titled:  "Let The Oppressed Go Free".  Representing victims of human Trafficking being liberated by St. Giuseppina Bakhita  1869-1947 Sudanese Canossian sister canonized in 2000.  She is the patroness of victims of Human trafficking.  The installation will be on display until March of 2024. Beautiful architecture and noted as the oldest building on the square! Went during the day to go inside, posted open but no admittance at door (locked). No clear directions how to enter the building! Worth seeing

name: Old Town Community Church - Alexandria Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Brian is a very kind, polite, and compassionate person. He has a strong sense of humanity and always treats others with understanding and respect. It has been almost six months since I met him, and during this time I have come to know him as one of the kindest people I have ever met in my life. He is truly full of kindness and understanding. Pastor Brian is awesome and such a positive person with great vibes and he lights up positivity! Pastor Phil is very kind and preaching is out of the Bible which we 💙❤️💜 Went here w/ family for the Christmas Eve service. Very nice, no--a lovely-- event. Welcomed at the door & greeted kindly as we exited later.
Young people led much of the music, the message was delivered by the pastor in a clear, pleasant voice (and not too long, either!).
It would have been nice to see the sanctuary w/ less overhead light & more candle light, even if briefly.
We hope to return to Downtown Baptist & plan to make a small donation to their civic activities. Friendly folks. My dad used to take me here when I was a little girl me and my sisters always loved it! I was looking for a new church and decided to go here since I haven't been in so long! They welcome to me as family and made me feel right at home! This place is going to be my new church so I hope if you're looking for a church in the area you come on in on Sundays because they will make you feel right at home! We used to be members here almost 30 years ago and loved it! We were very involved in the various ministries. We visited today while visiting Old Town Alexandria and while it has changed a lot, it remains a loving faithful Church. They have a very active children's program and that is always important to revitalizing a Church. It was great to be back here after all these years.

name: Old Town Community Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a good food bank; they give out food, including lots of fruits and vegetables. Went there, couple months ago, it was a basic food distribution place, nothing special about it, no different than the Salvation Army or other food banks in other places.
What really surprised me is that you see nothing but Filipinos!.. why is that???... Is this a Filipino Church???... I mean it's in the heart of Classic Western themes, culture and heritage, such as Old Town, which is American, Mexican and Native American culture.
All of the people giving out the food were all Pingoys!

Why is that??... Where is the diversity???

I didn't see any White, no Black,no Hispanics, no Middle Eastern, no Asian people, except for the 100 % Filipino presence.

It seemed strange. I guess I would like to see more diversity.

2025 update, Came back again recently, and the Filipinos take all the best food for themselves!...

As soon as you see 1 or more Filipinos, you know that they are taking all of the good stuff, all the best meat and cheese and fruits and vegetables. I have seen how they park separately and away from public eyes, and earlier that most and they get food carts full of the best food, and when Black, Hispanics and Whites compe over to get food, all of the best food is gone because they take it!...

Please make it a more diverse atmosphere, not just Filipino, it's Old Town, it's mainly Spanish, Mexican, Anglo and Native American place and Historical park. Why are there so many Filipinos involved!..

Is it a Filipino church or something?? Pastor had a great message. Christ is King! Food Distribution is Open Wednesdays.

From 9:00am thru 3:00pm. Nice small community church in Old Town. They have food distribution Mon-Wed. 12-3. They members are so nice

reviewSummary: Amazing contemporary worship and practical sermons. Outstanding support for families.

name: Olive Branch Central Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: I attended & participated in this church as an adult, with my mom in (1991-2014), non-denominational. Bible Study, Church School, and Youth Ministry. Pic- Church Trip to Chicago,IL. Wonderful loving place to worship.  It’s been my church home for years and will be until God calls me home.  If you’re looking for a place where the presence of God dwells and your spirit is fed according to God’s word, you’ve found the place. Thought provoking message on Church growth and the responsibilities of the lay members. Acts 1:1-8

name: Olive Branch Church & School - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I have two kids one in fourth and one in sixth grade. and I’m currently a teachers aid for the kindergarten class. I thank God every day for a safe place for my kids to learn I never have to worry about what’s being taught, not only in academics but also in learning about Gods love for us. Olive branch has so many nice and loving staff to help  the kiddos learn to love live and share christ! They offer after school daycare, new enrichment classes being offered to homeschool families, competitive sports, kindergarten just got a brand new playground, I could literally go on and on! I am so grateful to have Olive Branch, they are like a family to us! Olive Branch Christian School is truly a gem! The school provides a well-rounded education that nurtures students academically, spiritually, and socially. The strong church partnership with creates a Christ-centered environment where students grow in both faith and knowledge. The academics are rigorous yet engaging, with dedicated teachers who challenge and support students to reach their full potential. Beyond the classroom, the school offers enriching extracurricular activities, a caring community, and a culture that fosters both character and leadership. We are beyond grateful to be part of such a loving and inspiring school family! Olive Branch School has been a home away from home for my three children over the last eight years, with my son graduating from 8th grade last year. The teachers and staff care deeply—not just about academics, but about the whole child. They create a nurturing environment where students feel seen, supported, and encouraged to grow both intellectually and personally.

The small class sizes allow for individualized attention, and the dedication of the faculty is evident in the way they pour into each student. Beyond academics, the school fosters strong values, character development, and a true sense of community. It’s a place where my children have not only thrived in their education but have also built meaningful friendships and lasting memories.

If you’re looking for a school that prioritizes both excellence in education and the heart of a child, Olive Branch is truly something special. We are so grateful to be part of this community! My family and I moved to Corona from OC and we tried a few churches in the area and we fell in love with Olive Branch Church it was warm and everyone was so welcoming. We especially liked that it was verse by verse teaching straight from the bible, it was exactly what our hearts needed. Our littles loved coming every Sunday.
When we learned that they had a school we were really excited to help give our kids a solid foundation all while building a community here at our home church.
My kids have been coming here for the last 3 years, I love watching them grow in their knowledge but even more so in their love for Jesus. All the teachers here are incredible and pour God's love into every child daily. So grateful for Olive Branch Church & School. My son Noah loves Olive Branch Christian School. Everyday he attends school he runs up to his classroom and is so excited to be there. All of the teachers and staff are outstanding! They are so compassionate, committed and truly caring to all of the students and parents. We are truly thankful to be apart of the school. Noah is sad to be graduating preschool because he has had such a phenomenal experience but excited to be apart of the school age group. I highly recommend Olive Branch School. I love how dedicated everyone is. It’s amazing how the kids can learn and grow to be close to the Lord too. We serve a good God. Blessings, The Biggs Family

name: Olympic Presbyterian Church (올림픽장로교회) - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a Korean church. Good pastor and good people who love God and purple. This is a Spirit-filled church focused on knowing Jesus Christ. Good pastors The session musicians and three female vocalists began the service with a preparatory hymn for the second service. It was impressive to see the choir build harmonies from the middle of the opening hymn after the preparatory hymn, creating a rich sound.

Afterward, the Senior Pastor led the service. The way the congregation moved around the sanctuary to fellowship, rather than conducting the fellowship time merely as a formality, was a symbolic aspect of this church's worship. The order of service that followed followed a traditional format.

The Pastor delivered his message by interpreting the Bible and incorporating anecdotes about his own spiritual parents.

There seemed to be fewer instances of the congregation empathizing and responding with "Amen" than expected. I did not find anything particularly special in the sermon. After the message, a prayer of commitment was offered aloud, but the congregation's prayers did not seem as earnest as the sound of the Pastor's prayer. Although it appeared that the message of the day's scripture, 1 Samuel Chapter 1, was not conveyed effectively, the overall atmosphere of the church was one of welcoming and embracing the congregation. During the offering time, a special piano performance was followed by the presentation of gifts. It felt different from other churches that the praise team and choir accompanist were men. A place where excellent ministers equipped with the Word and spirituality, and saints who always serve with the labor of love and joy, are building and dreaming of a beautiful community of Christ. I highly recommend it.

name: Omega Seven Ministries/Long Beach Christian Center - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have a deep affection for my church and have been an active member for many years. Pastor Price is a true vessel of God's word; his sermons always resonate with me. Since my grandmother was alive, I have been following his teachings and found his messages to be both enlightening and empowering. He has a unique ability to communicate God's truth in a relatable and applicable way to our daily lives. God leads me to fellowship and bring love to others,Plus the household of faith needs to continue to be about God business enjoyed my fellowship with the members and the body of Christ. Wonderful group of people who loves the Lord 1165 E. San Antonio Drive, Suite A/A-1
Long Beach, CA 90807 Bummer

reviewSummary:
I'm usually in Robinwood's neighborhood once or twice a year and when I am I make every effort to join them for worship. This church is a rare gem: engaging worship, first-rate teaching, and a congregation filled with people who are authentic with each other and passionate about God.

So if you have the chance to do so, I'd strongly encourage you to check it out yourself. Me an my wife love this church. It's an orange county spirit filled church with high end teaching and in depth bible study and lecture. The teaching is fresh and the environment is relaxed and informal. Great church to be a part of! I don't mind traveling quite a distance to catch one of Hous' messages on a Sunday at Robinwood. Always make a point of being there when I'm in town and in the area. Pastor Hous, Dives Deep in the Word...

name: One Chapel Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: We checked out a lot of churches around Austin when we first moved here but none made us feel at home like one chapel Austin. Ross and Aimee Parsley are amazing leaders and their staff does an amazing job bringing the congregation and community together. We feel so blessed to have been a part of this church for the chapter in our lives that brought us to Texas. This church is a big reason that it is so hard to leave. Wherever your stage in life, you will feel welcomed here. Priest spoke to me about some very private matters. Helped me once again forgive my husband. Thanky ou! I LOVE JESUS and One Chapel has been my church for a bit over two years now. I find myself so connected with my Lord when we are in praise and worship. One Chapel welcomes people and helps them get connected with groups and other events that happen there. This church does not push religion on anyone. Come visit and find out for yourself. God loves you and we do too at One Chapel! I’ve been attending this church for a little over one year now and I love it so much. The pastors truly prioritize discipleship here and I really enjoy that they preach about things that can be hard to talk about. This church, the members and the pastors have really helped me navigate the Christian lifestyle. I appreciate the love and care they pour back into people. Genuine group of people. When I moved from out of state, finding this church made me feel like I wasn't alone. Like I had a family. Lots of broken, hurt and lost people here. Not a "judge-y" church in the least. We're all here trying to lean on each other to figure life out. It's refreshing. Pastor Ross is an incredible person. I really believe his leadership and authenticity makes all the difference. He doesn't skirt the uncomfortable topics about the Bible, but presents every week with great care and love for the community. He wants to make sure we hear everything we need to go out into the world.

name: One Christian Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary:
A church to call home with great people that becomes family. Always a great welcome in on Sunday's & a understandable lesson from Pastor Jerry.
Amazing youth group on Sunday & Wednesday. Summer VBS is awesome too! We were invited by our daughter. We were so surprised how inviting everyone was. Immediately felt like home. They offer so many opportunities to volunteer. Im glad they offer online link so we can watch when we are not able to attend. Our grands enjoy childrens church and talk about what they have learned with excitement. My wife and I were invited to visit One Christian Church. We new after just one visit that we wanted to become members. If you are looking to find a new church . We highly recommend. 🙏 Breakfast with Santa was fantastic 😊 kiddos had lots of fun and everyone was so nice.  The church was very inviting and very clean.  Happy Holidays ⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄⛄ Love this church. Everyone is so friendly.  The church is about Jesus and not about religion.

name: One Church - Cornelius Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent house of worship!! Great church

name: ONE Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for a while now and absolutely love it! I attend students as well and they do such an amazing job at making everyone feel welcomed. Pastor Blake and Luke have opened my eyes to things in the Bible I wasn’t aware were there. The church family is such a blessing to be apart of and I’m so thankful God has brought us to this church! Great church, friendly, well organized.  With a great band and a pastor delivering a relevant engaging message. They have a lot of activities and kids programs. Being away from the church for so many years never altered my faith.
So thankful for Pastor Blake, and One Church. My fiance and I enjoy and look forward to each and every service. Always a great message and things to reflect on every week.
❤️🙏 One Church in Fayetteville is a 5-star congregation. Pastor Blake's authenticity and transparency shine through in every sermon, which are all deeply rooted in the Bible. The sense of community and fellowship within the church is palpable. I highly recommend One Church to anyone seeking a welcoming and enriching place of worship. The picture is of the Sunday morning sunrise service Easter 2024 (a special occasion of worship by the lake…. Beautiful!) I've been to several churches throughout my life, but can't say I ever really fell in love with one until now. One Church is a place where you can feel the Holy Spirit in the building. It's not a show up and be seen church , it's a place where you can see the love of JESUS. Pastor Blake not only preaches the word, he also lives it. He and his staff are regular guys like me. Down to earth and genuine in living out the love of Christ and His grace.

name: One Church - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary:
While it is complicated to find convenient parking, the attendees and pastors are really nice individuals!! The sermons make a beautiful point. While you are not guaranteed room where the main session is held, there is another room you can watch that session live and still get prayer when needed!

I'm looking forward to their renovations being completed and seeing if the church has spread out more acres. While this means their coffee counter is closed, this allowed a Sunny Sips truck to come by! Overall, my experience has been positive. I am not implying that there is anything wrong, but I am not accustomed to their methods of church membership. The spirit of God is always present. The people are so welcoming and friendly. I love every time I visit One Church. Love this church! It changed my whole view when it came to community. The members here genuinely display God's love and kindness! The pastor is very down to earth and honest and the worship team definitely knows how to blaze the way for the word  🙌🏽 I’ve been going here since Easter 2025, I met Pastor Greg,his wife,daughter and son,such nice people. name: One Church - Manchester Outpost
reviewSummary:
Paul would definitely write a letter to this church.

This chain of churches seemed to be more progressive with the pastor telling us to “pray to our God” at the end of his sermon and then walked off the stage. Traditionally I’m used to the pastor saying a prayer and closing with that, so I was shocked to hear him pass it off and to say “your God.” I think that can be very misleading and suggests that the Lord Jesus Christ is not the only God which would be false.

The setup for the stage was very expensive, with three massive screens, light show, and many guitarists on the stage. Music was okay. Sermon was okay. It felt to be very surface level and didn’t hit deep. Almost like a nice reminder that Jesus came to die for our sins. The pastor was also using very modern slang to describe the situations Jesus was in. Blasphemous if I must say.

I won’t go back since this church did seem superficial and suggested we pray to God to give us courage to give money. Sad. Great spiritual community. Very welcoming! The music is fabulous and the pastor is "real". Highly recommend! I used to come here and was moved. I lost my way for a while, but recently came back into a season of growth, learning and building. I came back to this church 3 times and although the music is amazing, the pastor had no Bible, but a book of financial freedom written by pastor Bo.
I didn't learn anything, I didn't feel connected, I felt pushed to donate and support.
After the 3rd day of giving it a chance (all 3 days i felt the same) i walked out after 3 min of the pastor speaking about money. I pray this church changes things and invites the word of God. Not financial preachings. "One Church" A Great Church for the whole family. Praise and worship team. Is Awesome, uplifting and inspirational Sing and feel the presence of the Holy spirit. It's a Joyful experience. Great messages from the pastor's. I like how they Read the Bible scripture's and explain what happened in the bible at that time. Then explained what happened in their life and explain how the scripture verse help them learn something new. Use that experience to Apply message to your daily life. The message Grow closer to the father, son and holy spirit. Nice church. Great people here. I'm told the Children's church is fun. I hope you come and visit . Everyone is Welcomed here. God bless you.and keep you close. Quick service, not like the old style churches. I went their once with my fiance who has never attended any church growing up and he was just as delighted and surprised like I was at how wonderful it was. It was uplifting, inspirational, fun, musical, NOTHING at all like any cult, in no way shape or form was it ever any cult-like, it was the opposite, it was purely just good people wanting to do good deeds and we felt so free to be among happy nice people who seemed genuine.

If you believe in biblical values that bring unison and not division and the teaching of loving one another as Christ loves us, this is the church for you! For the ONE is our motto! Their children’s ministry goes above and beyond caring for our little one, building a real connection with her, and teaching her skills to develop her own relationship with Christ. This church allows us to be genuine - baggage and all - and makes us feel like we truly belong. I am SO thankful I found such a welcoming and relational community at One Church! They felt like family right away. Everyone so authentically loves Jesus and each other. They will welcome you just as you are! Love my family at One Church! From the moment you walk in you feel at home. The love and grace from the OC community is so authentic. Pastor Andy is such an amazing leader and friend!

The true church is holiness pentecostal in the united states.
Evangelical churches in the United States are not just one; there are more than 100 different denominations! Within them, Pentecostal churches form an important group with around 50 denominations. The oldest of all is the Church of God (Cleveland, Tennessee), founded in 1886, which emerged from the Holiness movement. The first official Pentecostal church after the Azusa Street Revival was the Church of God in Christ (COGIC), established in 1897, which adopted practices such as baptism in the Holy Spirit and speaking in tongues.

name: onechurch
reviewSummary:
This past Sunday while visiting Seattle (traveling from Georgia) with my two teenage children, we attended the 6:30 service at OneChurch.  While it’s easy to be a prisoner of the moment, especially when emotions are involved, I don’t think it’s hyperbole for me to say that I can’t recall attending a better Sunday worship service.  Multiple members of the welcome team came to us both before and after the service and had authentic, meaningful conversations with us.  They genuinely seemed interested in why we were in Seattle and in what we had to say.

Throughout the visit, it was refreshing to see a diverse group of people worshiping God and interacting with each other as one family.  Everyone seemed to know everyone else and enjoyed each other’s company.  While it was mentioned that you’re looking for a new building, I think the size of the current location is perfect, as it lends to an intimate atmosphere in which everyone feels totally immersed into the experience.

The worship music was excellent!  While I’m guessing copyright laws preclude you from posting the musical portion of the service on youtube, if by some chance I’m wrong, it would be awesome if it were posted, or if I could receive it via email, so that I could watch and listen again (and show my wife, who wasn’t able to make the trip), because it was that good.  Finally, the message delivered by Olivia Smith, “God’s Love is Offensive,” was phenomenal.  I had just had a conversation with my daughter earlier in the day about the value in forgiving others, even when it seems that they don’t deserve it or don’t realize they had done anything wrong.  For Olivia to hit on these same points was perfect timing, and I’m sure it resonated with my daughter better than hearing it from me!

Thank you so much for an incredible worship experience.  I don’t know when we’ll be able to make it back to Seattle again, but in the meantime, please keep doing what you are doing.  Our family will be praying for you! OneChurch in Seattle is more than just a place of worship — it’s the real genuine definition of community. Pastors Fil and Caitlyn lead with deep care, intentionality, and a heart for connection — both with God and with one another. From the very first time I attended, I felt welcomed, seen, and invited into something meaningful.

What I love most is the intentional focus on community. Whether it's sharing meals at Dinner Parties, gathering for fun and connection at Summer Socials at greenlake, or encountering God deeply during Worship Nights, every event is designed to bring people closer to each other and to Jesus.

This isn’t just a place to attend on Sundays; it’s a church that genuinely values doing life together. If you're looking for a faith community that’s warm, authentic, and rooted in purpose, I can’t recommend OneChurch enough!🌟 I’m begging for you guys to turn down your music and the bass. I can hear it through my windows and it goes for almost all day. Sunday’s are my only day off and I can’t even enjoy them cause the constant loud music. I understand it’s a church but there shouldn’t be any reason for a large loud speaker outside when there are apartments right next door and across the street. this is my home, my safe space.
a place of people who LOVE the Lord, bearing the fruits of the spirit.
Every message has brought guidance, wisdom, compassion, and correction towards my life. My family in Christ  Onechurch is my home! I have prayed for this type of community, and God brought it at the perfect time. It’s crazy to believe this is in Seattle, a city I’ve always known to be opposed to faith. But here we learn together, grow together and experience the presence of God together, with Joy at the center. I’ve been a member since day one, and I’m honored to be a witness to the things the Lord has done in His house.

name: OneChurch - Conway Campus
reviewSummary: Great worship, loving church family, awesome and GENUINE pastors!! This  church is built on prayer, Scripture, and most of all, love for all!! We can't say enough about this amazing church!! They have made our family feel like family! Their kids program and youth program is out of this world. They truly care about every single person who attends! Such a blessing for so many!! We are happy to have our "church home!" Best group of believers you'll ever encounter. They love people (towards Jesus) like it matters. Music is great, preaching is led by the Spirit of God, and the discipleship (of young and old) is spot on. It's not just a church. It's a family. I hope you visit. This church is amazing. The diversity here is unparalleled to any other Bible - believing, Christ-Following, body of believers I have ever encountered. In this church God is God and His Word is Truth. Those two things are the foundation. Everything else is unapologetically secondary. Just like any church, it is made up of a group of imperfect people who mess up and must make it right with their Savior and anyone else involved. The difference is that there is an almost tangible feeling of love and being truly welcomed when you walk in the door. Here, it does not matter if you are dressed to the nines or are in shorts and flip-flops, you are welcome. This is the closest thing to what a church should be according to the scriptures that I have ever seen. It is a hospital for those who are spiritually sick and in need of help, and praying for each other is one of our top priorities. I love that there is no judgement of your past, but that there are people that come alongside you to love you and help you become all that God wants you to be. Not pushing, overbearing people, just normal people who want to help, who want to show God’s love because someone else did that for them at one point in their lives. These body of believers have definitely been placed together by the hand of God as He saw fit and ,oh, how good it is to see the handiwork of God. From attending the first Sunday it has felt like family. The principles of this church are what it should be like at other churches as well. You can tell that One Church does not measure their success by how many or the kind of people that attend or how big the facility is, but by life change and how they can love people. I’m a recently retired Marine, and it means a lot to my family and I to move here and be able to have a connection with people in the church that are genuine and being able to feel like it is home!

name: Ontario United Reformed Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this church after searching for faithful, reverent worship and clear, uncompromising gospel preaching. I didn’t want politics from the pulpit I wanted to be taught the Word of God with depth, care, and conviction.

From my very first visit, it was clear this church takes Scripture seriously. The preaching is careful, consistent, and deeply rooted in the text. Over the past four years, I’ve grown more here both intellectually and spiritually than anywhere else I’ve been.

The men of this church, both the pastors and the congregation, have personally invested in me. There’s a real sense of brotherhood, accountability, and Christ-like love that is rare today.

By God’s grace, I’ve now been accepted into seminary, and I can truly say this church played a major role in that. I wasn’t just attending I was being shaped and discipled.

If you’re looking for a church that prioritizes reverence in worship, serious biblical teaching, and genuine Christian community, this is the place. They love Christ, and you see it clearly in how they love one another.
Highly recommended. Love this church! Awesome leadership and body of loving, welcoming members. Great fellowship opportunities, various events and seminars for individuals seeking an involved, passionate community of believers.
I highly recommend this to become your church home! Come let your faith be strengthened by pure biblical preaching, where you can partake in the pure administration of the sacraments with reverent worship and edifying fellowship. Pastors Taylor and Daniel are faithful servants of God who faithfully preach the whole counsel of God. I am incredibly thankful for the expository, Christ-centered proclamation of the gospel which lifts my eyes to Christ Jesus. After years of feeling spiritually restless at a large non-denominational church—plenty of energy, not enough roots—I found Ontario United Reformed Church in Ontario, CA and, over time, became a member.

The difference was immediate. Worship is ordered and unhurried, shaped entirely by Scripture. The preaching is expository—the text sets the agenda, and the pastor follows it. The congregation sings from the Psalter, which took some getting used to but now feels natural and deeply spiritually fitting.

Membership isn’t a formality. The membership class,  walks through church history, church government, and Reformed doctrine—you come to membership knowing what you believe, why you believe it, and what you’re committing to.

With Sunday morning and evening services, a Spanish service after the morning worship, and Sunday school, there are consistent opportunities to grow week after week.

No performance. No padding. Just God’s Word, faithfully preached and sung by a congregation that means it.

If you’re looking for a Reformed church in Ontario, CA that is grounded in Scripture and focused on Christ, come visit and experience a traditional service for yourself. Biblical preaching
Confessionally reformed
Strong community of believers.

name: Orange Hills Assembly - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Idk what they are worshipping in there but it's not God, I'll tell you that much. A homeless guy in a semi truck and another in an SUV parked in their little side lot for a night and we're planning on sending the pastor a letter asking permission to be able to park there since the lot is always empty, but they were never given the chance. Not even 24 hours later this church had Orange Police rolling up threatening to tow their vehicles and kicked them out. This church kicked them out faster than the police could kick them out off of city property. There is no God in this church, only greed and the unending "we're better than you" attitude.

PS; they also have a Black Widow infestation. One of the homeless people was going around the building at night trying to help the church out by exterminating a lot of the Black Widow spiders so no one gets bit, and they still treat them like that. Absolutely pathetic. Great church... the worship is excellent... and the pastor preaches from Bible... the people are friendly and welcoming.  You will enjoy the presence of God at this church. Great church.   Thank you for hosting JBQ 1-25-20!   It's great to see the kids learning the Bible so we'll. LOVE this church! Most friendly and loving church family you will find! Nice people good message

name: Orangethorpe United Methodist Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is small but it has a lot of heart. and soul, and Pastor Bob, and all the church members are amazing. Every Monday night at 6:00 pm they serve the homeless ( anyone who's hungry welcome) a very delicious homemade dinner. God Bless them. Orangethorpe United Methodist Church has a new Pastor - Pastor Rey Guevara.  Wasn’t very impressed with the former Pastor.

Pastor Rey is a phenomenal Preacher that speaks from the heart (not from a written script), on scripture that relates to real life issues.

The bilingual congregation is welcoming and inviting - our first visit was a feeling of friendship and not at all that awkward first visit you get at many churches.

The church has a lot going on so if you’re in the area I would highly recommend you stop by and check it out for yourself. I’m glad we did. As an entertainer I Was clearly taken advantage of by “God’s Gypsy Christian Church” they did not pay the agreed amount and where rude to me by making empty promises of tip, they also made me start and hour later then planned and even sending me the wrong address. Clearly not a professional church, Ruby was the person who hired me and not once helped me with the party, ruby even paid me 2/3 of the price we agreed on. I’m a kind person for church organizations but being clearly taken advantage of hurts. Was grateful they were able to accept a donation of mac and cheese and mashed potatoes. Thank you, Jan Friendly, Quick and easy place where we got our vaccines.

name: Orangewood Avenue Baptist Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
An amazing group folks!!! The feel of genuine concern and supportive people uplifting each other. I was invited and I couldn't have felt more welcome. That first day was a blessing! It's a nice chuch to visit and nice people that attend the church also but transportation is difficult considering the location. Been coming here since I was a kid got introduced to the church through their vacation Bible school events in the summer grew up then began attending the youth group and then began attending the services and began involving myself in events and activities at this church and I gotta say there is a reason why I stuck so long here because it's like you are welcomed into a whole other family everybody is so kind and understanding they have always shown me nothing but love and the pastor and his family are so loving, fun, understanding, and helpful especially when you are in need of guidance or simply a place to call home. This is a safe space where they preach the word of God they teach but without the extreme measures and rules that some churches along the years have made which push followers away so if any of the things I mentioned caught your attention definitely come visit sometime. It says I visited this place today oh my. I visit this place every Sunday and Wednesday they have a good Bible study Friday we have family fun night if you want to come closer with your walk with the Lord talk to pastor ty we're always willing to take that person that's lost and help them find good direction. God bless and have a wonderful evening Great family atmosphere great pastor and teachers. Come and worship here they have activities all week long Friday is family game night so bring the kids and have fun with us.
See y'all there

name: Orchard Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Jim is so amazing. He really helps me understand the word of God and I love his personality when he preaches . You feel very welcomed and at home. Been to many churches but never been to one that I loved going to as much as this one. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The Orchard Church is the real deal.
From the moment you walk in, you feel like familia. The worship is heartfelt, the teaching is grounded and clear, and the community wraps around you like a warm tortilla. Whether you’re new to faith or seasoned in the Word, there’s something here for you… truth, grace, and a whole lot of love.‼️ We've made Orchard our home church for a year now... Pastor Jim is a pastor you want for your family, especially our younger generation. If you are looking for a place you can call home I highly recommend Orchard they are not only a church they are a family. They have an amazing Celebrate Recovery meeting every Friday night. They offer dinner before hand starting at 6. It's free your first time & $5 every other night. It's a great place for like minded people to celebrate their milestones, meet new people, make new friends & hopefully find a new community that feels like home. Highly recommend checking it out. It works if you work it & you're worth it! Looking for a Church that is focused on Love, Hope, and Serving others ??

Pastor Jim Jackson delivers the word straight from our Bible. Not afraid to discuss difficult topics that we struggle with on a daily basis. No sugarcoating.
Structured and organized place to worship. Excellent Discipleship.
A must visit for All.

Tons of ministries to serve :
OUTREACH, KNOTTED COUPLES, CORE MENS, BLOOM WOMANS, MUSIC, Childrens, HIGH AND MIDDLE SCHOOL, HEARTWOOD SENIOR CITIZENS, CELEBRATE RECOVERY, GRIEF, AND MUCH MUCH MORE.

Come as you are and find your home membership here to serve as FAMILY.

name: Orchard Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: We love this church! Orchard has been our home church for a few years - there is great bible-based teaching from Pastor Assad every Sunday and fun kids and youth programs on Sundays and throughout the week too. Great AWANA program on Thursday nights. We have found a strong sense of community here. This is the friendliest church I have ever been to.  Dr. Asaad, Pastor and his wife, Summer, are so welcoming all the time setting the tone.  You can relax and be yourself, wearing whatever you like.    The children from age birth through high school have a great time too.  There are groups to join for everyone if you want to get involved.  I drive miles and mile just to heard the word of God from my pastor who loves us all. The Orchard Church is not just a wonderful church to worship, its home. A place that is welcoming & embracing of who you are & meets you where you are, committed to teaching & walking along side you by doing life with you in fellowship & discipleship. The Orchard church Pastor & Church Family has been a blessing to my entire family & I pray you come to check it out. The most welcoming, friendly, diverse church where there is always something for someone (kids, youth, women, men, and families). I just moved to the area in July and this was the first church I attended and didn’t need to attend another church. I knew I could call this place home. This church is so warm and welcoming. Great kids programs Sunday mornings and youth programs Sundays & Wednesdays. The pastor is committed to Bible teaching and he cares deeply for his church family. This church is all about sharing the love of Jesus. They are serving the community through weekly food distribution and various fun events like Trunk or Treat and the Christmas Tree lighting!

name: Orchard Hill Church - Strip District
reviewSummary:
I've been "Born Again" since I was 12.
Been to see dozens of  preachers.
Best message  by "Dan Irvin". About the Holy Gost. Good music and nice people. Disappointed that the pastor was political in his sermon on Easter morning. Poor taste especially with a lot of guests/visitors. Great church to bring your family and kids. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. They have childcare called “Kids Burgh” during the service so that you can watch the sermon. Great message that’s easy to understand and a space where you can learn more about Jesus. Great teaching and sound doctrine. Visited on our way home from a graduation. Welcoming and kind without being obnoxious in any way. Was able to worship in a beautiful setting. Enjoyed the newly renovated old church.  The music was ok, people are friendly.  Not a huge fan watching the sermon on a giant screen piped in from the home church honestly, not sure why.  Not when they do have a pastor who is a capable sermon giver that I’ve heard before.  Just my humble opinion but I’ll be back for sure while I look for a place where I can be around leaders who are real.

name: Orchard Valley Christian Church - Sunnyvale Campus
reviewSummary: I felt Holly spirit presence right away Nice family type environment

name: Orland Park Christian Reformed Church
reviewSummary: Gospel-centered, Bible-believing, faithful church, preaching the word of God, with an emphasis on community and discipleship. OPCRC lives the values of Christ with a mission centered mindset. Truly an amazing church. Such God honoring Pastors and congregation. Incredible love shown during the recent passing of my father. It is so hard to find churches like this that keep Jesus at the center of worship! I am grateful to have found OPCRC. The pastors have compassion for the congregation and are true laborers for Christ and the truth in the gospel! Expository preaching, sound doctrine, and excellent worship. Amazing, best biblical church in know!! I walked into this church and I felt nothing but love and compassion and love for Jesus and love for me! How they were so eager to help me and pray with me was so amazing and I now call this church my home!!! Becky you're truly God's Angel.

name: Orlando Christian Church - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
OCC and its community has been a huge blessing for me. The first time I attended was in August 2025. I felt welcome from the moment I walked in, I could feel the love of Christ radiating through each member. This church breaths love, hugs and hanshakes. Pastor Eugene, Mrs. Denise and family are a blessing from above. Their love and dedication toward the congregation reflects their love and obedience toward the Lord. I love the Bible studies on Wednesday night. I got baptised on December 14th 2025. I am blessed to be a part of this beautiful congregation.❤️ I love my home church so much! I love how organized and timely every activity is planned out for our Lord and Savior. I enjoy how welcoming every single individual at this church is. No matter where you’re from you feel like you belong here. Worship time is amazing and the Pastor always brings a refreshing word to the congregation that helps us feel ready to conquer the week ahead. God really uses every individual in ministry here. Attending ICP Orlando will never disappoint. I absolutely love the growth I have experienced here and the way this church serves the community!! This church truly believes in the power of prayer! Additionally, this church is bilingual and offers amazing Christ centered childcare on certain event days, like a valentine’s couple dinner, and children have the privilege of having their own ministry amongst other children their age and receive the word of God in different classrooms! God is great! ❤️ I am truly blessed to be a part of this church! From the first moment my family and I walked in, we felt welcomed. The worship is great, the messages are  inspiring and rooted in the Word which was really important to us. And there's so many ways to get involved.
If you’re looking for a place to grow spiritually and connect with a supportive faith community, this is the place to be! The sense of community is unmatched. They will notice your absence and reach out to check up on you to make sure you are okay. such an amazing church! I started going here when I was 17, but ended up leaving the church until I was 24. When I decided to truly begin my walk with God this church was the first thing that I thought of. The pastor is led by the Holy Spirit, he will not sugar coat anything that God places in his heart. He will speak with love, but by the authority of God’s word (which is needed in churches especially in this age). Everyone that goes here is very loving and welcoming. I was so surprised that people remembered me when I came back! (I was very quiet my time being there). The pastor, his wife, and their daughter are admirable, they really mean it when they say they’re there for you and want to see everyone succeed in their walk with Jesus! I was baptized here Easter of 2024, I’ve been given the opportunity to serve the church and they are always looking for more people to join the family! I can’t say I’ve been to a better church and if you’re looking for a home that will love you, encourage you, hold you accountable, disciple you, and much more, this is the perfect place for you to go. (I’m serious come find out for yourself!) I am so grateful to be part of this church! The community, worship, and services are always so amazing, you never leave this place without experiencing the presence of God. The Pastor is spirit lead and the entire pastoral family are incredible people who are very loving and encouraging!

The plus side of this church is that it’s bilingual, so everyone can receive the word of God! Not only that but there’s a women, men, youth, and young adult ministry so it’s for everyone!! If you’re looking for a church, this is definitely the one!

name: Osage Hills Christian Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: Great staff and church members. They like to help out the poor when they can as well. I was baptised there when I was12 and I'm 53 now my best friend wss Ronny Hinson You are a blessing to me and my family! Thank you for all you do in the community. Helped me and my fiance get a bus ticket back home when no one else would very good Christian people thank you guys sooo much Great place to go vote!

name: Osborne Neighborhood Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
To see the Israeli flag flying outside a place of worship, a place meant to offer refuge, peace, and moral clarity intentionally or not, it signals a blind eye to the immense suffering of oppressed Palestinian people. For many, it feels like a betrayal of the very values the church is meant to stand for: justice, compassion, and the sacredness of human life.

Right now, we are witnessing a humanitarian catastrophe, the destruction of entire families, neighborhoods, and lives. Over 30,000 plus Palestinians, many of them children, have been killed. Homes, hospitals, and places of worship have been reduced to rubble. For those of us watching this unfold, the pain is indescribable.

The trauma spans generations.

I hope you will reflect deeply on whether this is truly the message you want to send not only to your congregation, but to those crying out for dignity, justice, and the basic right to live. Osborne Church showed me true Christ’s love. I was on my way to a mission trip alone from VA to Mexico, however Osborne Church had one empty seat, and without even knowing me welcomed me to join them. The trip down there and back in their van, being at the orphanage and staying with their group, and doing ministry with them was spiritually uplifting and healing - it was VERY encouraging to find and spend time with true Christ followers who loved so well. Pastor Ryan and his family demonstrate the Lords love very well- along with the congregation- so many to mention! They touched my life. They are what we need more of in this world. If I lived in CA, I would attend, but I definitely recommend to anyone and everyone in that area! These people really love the Lord! They are concerned about their fellow man/woman and delve into prayer for each other quickly. Pastor Ryan has a passion for God and an incredible knowledge of the Bible. He has a wife and 4 kids which makes his perspective valid, fun, and interesting. If you are looking for a church for you and your family, I would highly recommend you attend on Sunday. You will find people that care about you and you will gain insight into the Bible. They have sunday school for all ages and a large remodeled nursery and toddler room. Each summer they have an INCREDIBLE vacation bible school. One of the workers takes her vacation time each year to participate because she loves it so much. The church is perfect in size. It's not too big to be lost in the crowd. It is not a small church either. It's just large enough for you to participate in a variety of activities. I would recommend this church. This is a great place to meet friendly and lively people. Everyone is so welcoming and the minute you walk in you feel like family. They really know how to love people well. They have ministries for all ages like young adult, youth group, and children’s and adult groups. They take missions trips and support missionaries around the world. If you’re looking for a place to feel like you’re home, check out Osborne! This church is extremely family oriented. The young adult leaders are totally personal and the meeting time on Monday nights is really good. Great worship, amazing teaching, and the people there are very welcoming. They even go out afterwards to hang out and eat to get to know everyone better! Super awesome.

name: Otter Creek Church - Brentwood Campus
reviewSummary: Are your pastors condemning the abuse of human rights on our streets? If they're not ask yourself why. I'll give you the answer- they do not care about human rights only about collecting your money Second Otter Creek Unites Baptist Church is located on Kingstown road right near the Kentucky/Tennessee state line just a little ways from highway 27. I have never attended my regular church services here but I have been to a couple funerals that were held inside the church before burial in the Kingtown Cemetery that is located on the lot adjacent from the church. They have a nice shelter behind the church that they use for church events and family sometimes use for family reunions. Cordial, REAL Christians with great worship and awesome teaching.  Cole Young and Savannah Smith, music, are amazing. Josh Graves, preacher, is prepared, scriptural, relevant, and challenging, every service. Huge active youth program.  Extensive outreach to all groups is priority; community service and recovery groups are constant. WHY WHY WHY does every church think a SMOKE MACHINE equals relevance? Good grief Charlie Brown! Just stop. Instant headache: like hanging with friends who vape. Yet, wonderful people and teaching… hopefully everyone halts the temptations to go emergent. Definitely greeted in a welcoming fashion. BUT since we didnt bring our phones in, the song service was completely unavailable to us.     This is MOST DEFINITELY NOT a church of Christ in the traditional sense! The Lords supper was prayed over in a video, by a woman, with no reference to the why at all. As a matter of fact, her video about exceptance and love covered both the bread and the juice.  The service/preachers 'sermon' was concluded with a 'go in peace' rather than an invitation. What if someone wants to be baptized for the remission of their sins?!?!?   The service was obviously geared for kids under 30, and im not knocking that, i personally, am just looking for something more! There were NO old ppl! Who are the leaders in this church?!?! 22 yr olds?

reviewSummary:

There were some aspects of the service that were more progressive than what I'm used to, but overall it was good. I may return to visit, again, in the future. name: Our Lady of Angels Catholic Church - Burlingame Campus
reviewSummary: I had a wonderful experience learning and feeling at peace. Not apart of this faith but attended for a family event. Clean and beautiful. Peaceful Beautiful church! Super friendly parish. We were spotted and welcomed as visitors! The priest is amazing, his homily was uplifting and spot on with the Gospel reading. name: Our Lady of Angels Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In my ongoing journey to experience all the Catholic churches in San Diego County, Our Lady of Angels stole the show. Ample, well-lit parking made the arrival stress-free, and the wide doorways and readily available ramps ensured everyone felt welcome. But it was the heart of the church that truly impressed me. The warm sunlight cascading through stained glass windows illuminated a serene sanctuary, and the air buzzed with a gentle hum of quiet prayers. Father's homily wasn't just informative, it was a tapestry woven with personal anecdotes and profound wisdom that resonated deep within me. I left feeling uplifted and connected, like I had found a hidden gem in the heart of San Diego. Thank you, Our Lady of Angels, for reminding me of the beauty of faith and community. Our Lady of Angels Church, in San Diego's Sherman Heights neighborhood, is a beautiful example of Gothic Revival architecture. Established as San Diego's second Catholic parish, the church has been a spiritual center for the community since its founding. The building's distinctive design features pointed arches and intricate detailing, characteristic of the Gothic Revival style. A beautiful building! Love this parish. I grew up in this community, and in the Catholic faith. There are many good and friendly people here. Looking forward to the twice a year Kermes food festival. The man and women near him told me " there is no help for you here.  Go to the jack n the box find help there.  Evil godless non fearing catholics. reviewSummary:
Visited my sister and attended Mass at this beautiful church. View of elevated alter is accessible from all sides of church. Huge pool of water for baptism was amazing. I loved the architect and layout of church, suspended crucifix above alter, stained glass and statues in and around church.  Prayer garden available, too.  Beautiful designed church. I love going to this church beautiful music great masses & friendly people attending mass always look forward to the priests sermons & doing communion with my mom before she passed away 💔 great memories. May she rest in peace 🙏 and always in our hearts 💕 Third week of Advent at Our Lady of Grace, wonderful service.
Plenty of parking and a friendly Parshis. This is a friendly, comfortable, modern, suburban parish.

The music is a touch dated, being primarily 1960s-1990s focused, but that is all secondary. Anyone seeking out a pleasant church home would not be disappointed by this parish community.

name: Our Lady of Grace Roman Catholic Church - Hoboken Campus
reviewSummary:
My family has been a part of this parish for about 100 years. My grand parents attended Our Lady of Grace school as well as my father, uncle, myself and my six brothers and sisters. My grandmother and parents were heavily involved in preventing the church from falling apart when it was in need of great repair. Hence, donating alot of monies and  their time and effort.

On Thursday (09/07/23), we sadly said goodbye to my brother and celebrated his life there. Father Phillip gave a great sermon and was very accommodating, even promising that we could park at the church parking lot while we attended my brothers repass at Leo's Restaurant , a few blocks away. If your not aware,, parking is horrible in Hoboken, and we were very relieved to hear this.

Soon after mass was over, my husband approached Pastor Andrew to verify that it was ok to park in the churches lot, the Pastor was very short and kurt, he informed my husband that we couldn't park in the lot and insisted we move our vehicles immediately, of course we did what was asked of us. Meanwhile, as we vacated the lot in our automobiles, the organist, gave us ugly scowling stares in the parking lot.

I and my family where highly disappointed and insulted. Needless to say, it took us 45 minutes to park elsewhere in the city. Not nice, considering it cost us 500.00 for a 45 minute service.

Very unacceptable, to say the least. I was looking for a Church in Hoboken to start returning to Mass for the first time in 10 years after a traumatic event in life. When I arrived, I saw Church-sponsored fair/carnival was occurring outside on their front lawn. I noticed a "male modeling" tent next to a "pride" tent catering to children and thought to myself, that's strange... upon entering in my humble khakis and short sleeve button down shirt I was the most appropriately dressed person in the mass... To cap it off, the priest gave a homily that was totally political and secular - against being "a bigot" (in the political sense) - and at the end of the mass a second priest came out and gave a neurotically impassioned pitch to the congregation on donating to his charity for Gaza and slammed Israel's war policy. Whatever your politics are, using the Catholic Mass as a surrogate for preaching them is shameful. I'd be just as annoyed if the priest started railing against illegal immigration.

Needless to say, I was severely disappointed and won't be going back. If you're looking for a serious mass, this church is not for you. Our Lady of Grace brought me back into the faith. I am beyond grateful I experienced many Sundays here with my parents for a couple of years. My dad so appreciated Fr Alex. When my dad passed away in August 2024, it felt comforting to have his funeral Mass here. It was reverent and brought peace to my family, with special thanks to Fr Phil. OLG welcomes and loves all. It will remain one of my favorite churches. Went here on a trip from out of town. The pastor was welcoming and delivered and excellent homily. Thank you Father for your encouragement to my friends and I! My husband and I have been parishoners for several years. It is the most welcoming environments of any church we have ever attended. The building itself is beautiful and historical (built by Irish immigrants over a 100 years ago) and the pastor (Fr. Santora) preaches the true word of God and Jesus. Love thy neighbor. If you want to hear a bigoted, hateful, fire and brimstone homily/sermon, then don't come here. If you want to feel hope, love and community, then this is the place for you.

name: Our Lady of Guadalupe (Belltown) - Riverside Campus

reviewSummary:

I Thank You for excepting me to your home as I am

name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: Our wedding was the best day ever , specially, to have gotten the blessing of our Lord. And a special thanks to our priest Father Francisco. We wear truly blessed. I like this Church because all my kids were baptized in there and I got married in there too. Nice, clean and peaceful, everyone is willing to help you out with any questions or concerns. Beautiful church and mother Mary looks like the original in Mexico Basílica I grew up going to this church with my family since the 80s. It's home for me. My children were baptized here, my mom and brother had their funeral services here. My mom and dad were arrived here. My other brother wad married here. Now I take my son with me and he loves it as well. It's beautiful and amazing. It will always be our church. And home I just recently got married here. First of all the "donation" they ask for when getting married here is $500 which I thought was okay at first. I asked about music choices and they advised I couldn't choose my own music and if I wanted to play any music I would have to hire a chorus which was another $250 otherwise there would be no music. I asked if we could just play music on a speaker and the front office lady said no. I had to continuously call to ask when my rehearsal was going to be. I was married May 18th and they called me and told me on May 14th that my rehearsal was May 16th. That only gave me two days to rally my whole bridal party to make it there. I think we should've been given more time to make sure everyone was able to make it. The lady that gave the rehearsal was RUDE not only at the rehearsal but the day of my wedding as well. name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Church & International Shrine of St. Jude - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary:
Our Lady of Guadalupe Chapel is a deeply spiritual and peaceful refuge right in the heart of New Orleans. It’s the oldest surviving church building in the city and carries centuries of history within its walls. The moment you step inside, you feel the weight of time, prayer, and reverence.

What makes this chapel truly special is the Shrine to St. Jude, where locals and visitors alike come to light candles and leave petitions. The atmosphere is sacred, warm, and welcoming—no matter your background or beliefs.

The quiet beauty of the chapel, combined with the powerful sense of hope and devotion, makes it a must-visit spot if you’re looking to reconnect spiritually or just take a break from the energy of the city.

Whether you’re Catholic, spiritual, or just appreciate history, this little chapel is one of New Orleans’ best-kept treasures. I am sure to get push back on this one. Father spent more time giving shout out to parishioners and clapping than on the homily (I am serious on this no sarcasm).  Jazz music does not add to the mass. But is distracting.  Bottom line, if you are used to a respectful and reverent mass this is not the place that will live up to that expectation. Found by accident while vacationing in New Orleans. name: Our Lady of Lourdes Catholic Church - Main Campus
Our Lady of Lourdes Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m not writing this lightly.

I was an altar server here between roughly 2003 to 2005 when Sister Angela and Father Bob were still part of the parish. Back then, this church was thriving. There were a ton of altar servers, strong community involvement, and it genuinely felt like a place people belonged.

Father Bob, from my direct experience, was someone I respected and trusted. He was present, approachable, and played a meaningful role in my life growing up. Being an altar server here was one of the highlights of my childhood.

Years later, I ran into former members and was told that Father Bob had been removed under allegations of misconduct. I can only speak from my own experience, but I never witnessed anything inappropriate during my time serving. Hearing that, and then later finding out he passed away, was honestly upsetting.

Over time, and after reconnecting with people who were around back then, I have come to question how everything unfolded and who was involved. Certain names, like Alicia, kept coming up in conversations about that period and the direction the parish took afterward. I will not claim to know every detail, but it is hard to ignore the patterns people describe.

Fast forward to now, my experience with the current parish has been completely different.

I recently reached out to get a form signed so I could baptize my daughter at the church we attend now. My entire family has roots here, baptisms, communions, years of involvement, so I did not expect any issues. Instead, I was told Father Clarence was too busy, and the process was essentially stalled. At the same time, I was encouraged to just do the baptism there instead.

That did not sit right with me.

On top of that, there are already public concerns out there about Father Clarence’s leadership. There is a Change.org petition titled “Remove Father Clarence Saldua from Our Lady of Lourdes” that outlines complaints from parents and members of the school community regarding his involvement, communication, and relationship with the school. Anyone can look it up and read it for themselves.

Between my own experience and seeing concerns like that publicly shared by others, it paints a very different picture of what this church used to be.

The overall atmosphere now feels closed off. It no longer feels like a community. It feels like unless you are already part of a certain circle, you are on the outside.

That is not the church I grew up in.

What used to be a welcoming, community driven place now feels like something very different. And for those of us who remember what it was, that is honestly hard to see.

Instead I feel doctrine and judgment.  I like to stretch outside to help me concentrate on hearing the word of the Lord. They told me today to go to the park to do that instead (away from the Statue of our Lady). I was stretching in front of a bench orienting myself away from view so as to be discrete. The guard asked me if I was doing Yoga? LOL, I was just stretching for the love of god. Fair, I understand it's a place of worship, but I still found it very strange and unloving. The church is a one-stop shop: a Gothic Revival complex of stolid, elegant grey stone structures defined by steep, sloping roofs. It is a production that includes a rectory—perhaps a sanctuary for confession and forgiveness in these times of anxiety—alongside the main sanctuary for mass. You can seek absolution and offer prayers, then retreat to Austin Street to eat and drink. Now you see what I mean by one stop shop?

Entering from the side, I am struck by the stained-glass rose window. Its intricate circular pattern evokes a Spirograph, glowing with iridescent blues that center on the Maker.

At the rear, a triptych of panels features a watchful, protective Virgin Mary. She stands as a high priestess, flanked by her son bearing the cross. The front is dominated by a carved wood altarpiece—which feels somewhat ungainly to my eye—and, rising above it, a circular window depicting the Sun King.

The bells toll as I sit with my coffee at a nearby French café; the church never lets me forget its presence.
