name: Our Savior Lutheran Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
They opened it up to host a ministry's semi-annual meeting, great hospitality, great folks I just participated in a Taize service via Zoom.  This is a beautiful devotional service for Advent.  It was a peaceful retreat from our crazy world, and a reminder that we should "be still and know that I am God."

I find the Bible centered services important to my faith.  There are many opportunities to participate and serve, and a real warmth and love from many people.  Not everyone is super warm and loving all the time (like me) because I am a super introvert.  But I love Our Savior Lutheran Church. Our Savior Lutheran Church, through Pastor Demel, delivers sermons that are educational and good points for daily living.  The congregation is friendly and involved with others and the community as well as responsive to those in need.  It is an organized church with many relevant programs.  It has a beautiful, clean, newly updated campus with areas to commune inside and out under gorgeous large trees.  People of all demographics and nationalities are always welcome! Church Review

I have been a member of OSLC for over fifty years. I look forward to attending every Sunday and learning how God wants me to live and how He forgives me when I don’t. Each Sunday has a theme woven into the sermon, prayers and music. I get a good lesson that is based in the Bible and is presented in a way that I can understand. It is a friendly church and we have several member get togethers each year as well as the usual celebrations such as Christmas and Easter. Got married here and my parents have been coming here since I was 3 so definitely was a honor to get married here and to watch how the new pastor has a made a difference as he is very kindhearted and cares deeply about his congregation. This church community is like a family, so if you are looking for somewhere to go to church I highly recommend coming here as you will be welcomed with open arms 👍

reviewSummary:

I am grateful for the community of Lafayette,

name: Overcomers Christian Fellowship - Lithonia - Lithonia Campus

name: Overflow City Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: This church has played a huge role in my transformation. I didn’t just find a church home—I found a family. A place where I’m always growing, healing, and becoming who God created me to be. If you’re searching for a place that’s real, welcoming, and full of life, I can’t recommend this church enough. What a blessing this church has been to my life! From the second you step foot into Overflow you will be greeted with a smile and hug. Overflow is full of genuine and authentic people who go above and beyond to make folks feel seen and loved. I didn’t just find a church at Overflow, I’ve found life long friends and family. I am so blessed that God led me to this church. If you are looking to join a church who truly lives out “love your neighbor” this is the church for you! From the moment I walked in, I felt right at home. Everyone was so welcoming and genuine, and the atmosphere was full of love and peace. The message really spoke to me, and the worship felt authentic and heartfelt. It’s rare to find a place that makes you feel instantly connected. I’m so grateful I visited and look forward to coming back! If you want to grow in your faith, I strongly recommend this church. From the moment you step in to the time you leave, you feel the presence of God. These people make you want to know God more in a safe and non judgmental environment. There are connections to be made at every age group and it goes beyond Sunday service. Pastor Paul and Christina keep it real and rooted in the word of God. This church is definitely moving downtown Silver Spring and the wider area! The greeters are absolutely delightful! They truly make the experience warm & inviting. I re-visited the church this morning, and it was a great service from start to finish. I would recommend The Overflow to anyone looking for a local church home - even though it's not my local church home. Give it a visit, and remember to bring a friend.  :-)

Pacific Avenue Methodist Church - Glendale Campus
Pacific Baptist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I have never had the opportunity to visit here, but throughout the years I continuously hear good things about this church from many different people. If I were in Long Beach, I would love to visit this church My family and I attended this church for about a year, and overall, we loved it. I gave my life to the Lord in May of 2014, but I found this church in 2018. It wasn’t until the beginning of 2024 that I committed to attending regularly. I felt God tugging at my heart and calling me to make this commitment, so I started attending, and soon after, my wife and son joined me.

This church has a very tight-knit community where most members seem to have grown up together. While that creates a sense of familiarity and unity, it can make it difficult for newcomers to build relationships. There were a few individuals who really went out of their way to connect with us, and one standout was Joseph, the assistant pastor. Joseph genuinely cared about building a relationship with my family and made an effort to make us feel welcome. I also attended Joseph’s class, which was a great opportunity to engage and grow spiritually.

However, I had a different experience with one of the leaders. On more than one occasion, I tried to start a conversation, but the leader often walked away or didn’t seem interested in connecting. To clarify, I wasn’t looking for validation from men, but I believe it’s important to build a relationship with those we choose to have a significant influence in our lives.

One thing to note is that being a part of this family of believers requires baptism. Despite the challenges in connecting with that leader, I still grew tremendously in my personal relationship with God during my time at this church. A major transformation happened in my life because I really zoned in on what God was calling me to have faith in.

To anyone joining this church, or any church for that matter, I encourage you to take your relationship with God seriously. Don’t make it about you and man, but about you and God. Take every step in faith and involve God in all your decision-making. Most importantly, make sure you are spending more time in the Word of God than with anyone or anywhere else to ensure you’re grounded in the truth.

This church has been a blessing, and while there’s room for improvement in some areas, I’m thankful for the growth I experienced during my time here. I been going here off and on since i was in 5th grade. I am 28 now and i experienced a lot of heart ache. O felt like i stood out like a sore thumb made me very uncomfortable. Especially some of the unfruitful and unfriendly people and deacons. I mean i get it no one here is perfect. But it seems like they are out for me sometimes. And i just try to stay to myself. name: Pacific Beach Christian Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending Pacific Beach Christian Church since 2019, and it has truly been one of the greatest blessings we’ve found. From the very first Sunday, we were welcomed with open arms by a warm, loving, and genuinely inclusive community. “All are welcome” isn’t just something they say here—it’s something they live.
We’ve watched our kids grow up in this church, supported by a wonderful youth ministry that gives them guidance, friendship, and a sense of belonging. The facility is beautiful and well-kept, making it a comfortable and uplifting place to worship every week.
We absolutely love Pastor Brian. His messages, kindness, and leadership make PB Christian Church feel like family to us.
If you’re looking for a church home where you’ll be truly welcomed and supported, this is it. Highly recommend! 🙏💙 Pacific Beach Christian Church is a truly special place. Many many years ago I visited several churches with my daughter while searching for a community that felt genuine, and we recently returned here again. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed. The people are kind, the location is beautiful, and the sense of community is real. It genuinely feels like a family. The teachings stay true to what Jesus taught, and what I appreciate most is that there’s no hierarchy or “first-class section” here—just real people gathering together in faith. A real church with a real heart. Pacific Beach Christian Church has a truly warm, family-like atmosphere that makes everyone feel welcome from the moment they walk in. The congregation is friendly, supportive, and genuinely cares about one another, creating a strong sense of community that’s hard to find. Whether you’re attending a Sunday service, participating in a small group, or bringing your children to activities, there is a clear focus on faith, kindness, and connection. It’s a place where people of all ages can grow spiritually while building meaningful relationships, and many who attend quickly feel like they’ve found a second family. My time at Pacific Beach Christian Church began when my parents started attending before I was born.  Growing up in the church, I always had a sense that the congregation was my extended family, which makes Pacific Beach Christian Church so meaningful to me; it’s family.  Having a family that can bond around faith, and project that faith to serve the wider community has resonated with me as far back as I can remember.  From the uplifting Sunday worship service, to the community outreach, children and youth ministries, along with being an open and affirming church to all, my family and I are proud to be apart of and to serve with Pacific Beach Christian Church. For the first time in my life I look forward to going to church…walking in the door I feel good energy…genuine caring people…diversity…and the pastor is amazing!

No judgement and everyone always makes you feel like your apart of the family! We were looking for a local church where we could make good friends after moving to PB from europe, and we weren't even in the door before we were warmly greeted and made to feel welcome. A greatly diverse group of people, and active towards being a part of the PB community. The warmth I felt when I arrived was refreshing. I was looking for a place with a strong sense of family & community & I found it here. We love this church and our family is so thankful to be apart of it! Been coming to Coastal for a few months & absolutely love it! Was welcomed like family!

name: Pacific Beach Presbyterian Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: This is for the preschool! We started our daughter at 3 months old and it has been hands down the best decision. The teachers are loving, caring and attentive. Our daughter is excited to get dropped off every morning. They go above and beyond to care for our baby!!! The entire environment of the school is warm, clean and welcoming. I love it! I am so grateful we found the perfect fit. Had a an amazing time. Bill is a gifted and energetic pastor who loves his Church. This is a great church. The congregation was welcoming and the community outreach was lovely to see The community is very welcoming and enthusiastic to worship. Live band with a choir is a definite plus. If you are looking for a quick service on Sundays and are in the neighborhood,  check PB Pres out if you have yet to. This is such a friendly and loving church.  Two church services. 10am and Roots service for young adults at 7pm.   Come and celebrate life.

name: Pacific Beach United Methodist - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful people let us host our anonymous meeting there!!! Dirty church physically and spiritually I've never felt so unwelcome at a chruch before worst church in pb Extremely inconsiderate, will play music loudly at 5 AM and wake up the whole neighborhood. name: Pacific Church of Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary: The most kid friendly church in Orange County! In addition to Sunday school, they have kids involved in many ministries on Sundays serving alongside adults who love and teach them about Jesus. It's a very special place! The sound booth photo is of my husband and my son on a Sunday morning. If you are looking for a family friendly church and place to belong, come to PCI! We love pastor Seth’s teaching and small church feel. My family has attended Pacific Church for over 10 years, and the best way that I can describe this church is as extension of our family.  This church is not a church for the "have-it-all-together" people.  This church is a church for real people that have regular issues and every-day problems.  Pastor Seth is so down to earth and teaches from real life experience with wisdom and humility. You feel at home right away, plus you learn and grow so much through shared experiences and struggles.  This is a small church and everyone is friendly, outgoing and inviting. Folks are invested in each other's lives. We have built lasting life-long relationships here and are blessed to call this church home! I am blessed to have been part of this church community since I moved to Orange County as a college student in 1988. What I love most about Pacific is that it's a place where I can be honest about my struggles and brokenness, and experience the grace and unconditional love of Jesus as demonstrated through His people. Bible-centered teaching by our pastors will encourage and challenge you to grow and apply God's Word to your everyday life. Sunday worship will empower you to walk faithfully throughout the week. The relationships I have with my multi-generational PCI family have benefited me, my husband, my marriage and my children. I cannot say enough good things about how God has used this church in my life. I hope you will join us and discover for yourself what I have already experienced! We've been going here for about 15 years, and our growth has been awesome.  Great family atmostphere, with a humble pastor, awesome worship, and a youth ministry that has encouraged our son to follow God.  This is not a place to get lost in the crowd, but rather, a place to belong, fellowship, and learn your purpose in God's Master Plan.

name: Pacific City Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Pacific City Church has been a really important place for me and my family to connect with God and amazing people.

name: Pacific Coast Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: Such a warm and welcoming place of worship. The pastor has do be an excellent job involving his church with the community, the marine base and supporting missions. The staff here is amazing. The food and kitchen staff too notch. Bought my ticket to go to the 'Mens Summit' w/ Michael Franzese, but the representation of that and of the Church is just Atrocious.  Wish I could somehow take the $22 and donate it to another organization. You do not need to go far in San Clemente to find the right church.   Messages are topical and on point with biblical principles. Many opportunities to connect with an active adult ministry (especially womens) through child care. Faith in the real world is what Pastor Mark teaches and it is so refreshing... Absolutely love the staff. Family comes to mind when writing this review. I have to credit ours friends for introducing this church to us. As a military retiree family we have found our church home. Love Tuesday morning mens prayer group at Panera Bread in Talega with FREE COFFEE thanks to Scott the manager. Pastor Mark is Absolutely an Amazing Pastor at this Church! Highly Recommend this place! Absolutely a Great Service to go in person and watch online as well.

name: Pacific Crossroads Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderfully kind, welcoming and enthusiastic group of people.  The music was well-done, but not over-the-top.  They had new members join the Sunday we were there, and one of them was baptized, which was sweet and moving.  Diverse group of people.  The sermon was biblical and proclaimed the Gospel.  If we lived in the area, we would be be regular attenders or members. As a first-time visitor to Santa Monica while on vacation, I absolutely loved my visit to Pacific Crossroads Church! The church was warm and welcoming to me, and they definitely seem to have a heart for Jesus and for their community of Santa Monica and the greater Los Angeles area, doing service projects to serve those in need. I loved the opportunity to worship Jesus with a family of believers from many diverse cultures, taking Communion together, worshiping the Lord together, being edified by God’s Word, and lifting up the name of Jesus! Was deeply impacted by both the worship and outstanding message when visiting family in the area in February 2026 — incredible, moving, Christ-  centered experience I love this church! I’ve been attending for about a month  and a half now. I’m very reserved and I always attend by myself. I was welcomed by so many people they are so kind and so caring. I always feel welcomed even if I’m a bit more quiet. The message feels super to the point and we all share a love for the community in the church and as well as around us 🫶❤️ I'm in my 40's.  The way I'd describe this church is like my parent's church or maybe even my parent's parent's church.  And not because it's lacking any hipster coolness or relevance in that modern sense.

But it's very much a studious, in-the-box Christianity from the 80-90's era.  Things are sterile here.  The worship is very technical (like get things right) but lacking heart and Spirit.  I know, I know, it's Presbyterian.  But yeah, it's very much that.  Frozen chosen cringe.

But I think that's why those who attend, remain.  There may be a bit of nostalgia from past-time or perhaps comfort.  It just feels like something these Christians are used to.  It makes sense since the leadership picked a new pastor that aligns with this.  The sermon was lots of logos, bereft of ethos and pathos.

The redeeming part about this church, and I think why so many families are here, is that the children's and youth program are the true heart and soul of the church.  I have friends here where Gloria has taken the time to become inclusive.  P. Joe is also very  down to earth and relevant.  The youth enjoy being around him.

This church is so out-of-place and out-of-time in 2023 post-covid, post-evangelical mileu.  And no, I don't mean timeless.

From an ops standpoint, they also need more signs, more people to welcome and direct new people.  It feels very much like a "you should just know" culture for people who already show up there.  The kids check-in system also seemed to utilize outdated software which was confusing for those running it.

Overall faith is intellectualized here instead of embodied.

name: Pacific Hills Calvary Chapel - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: What's not to say...I've been here for decades...Dave's biblical -book by book- teachings are great. The good and the "hard to hear" commentary..."the feel good" and the convicting. Strictly bible based teaching; the teaching that encourages YOU to read your bible. The worship is top notch...understated. It's about the Lord...not them...spirit led. Always feel welcomed...Nancy is so warm and friendly at the door...Mike (usher) and others are  great. Special events are the norm...outreaches...volunteering too....and the coffee is good and hot! Two thumbs way up 👍👍 If you're looking for a church to tell you the Truth, teach you, challenge you in your walk, and hold you accountable, this is your church. I came several years ago for the men's morning study, and found a congregation of men with decades of service and endless knowledge of the Bible and of God. Then there's the lead pastor David, you won't find a more sound teacher. Through the Bible from a historical, and personal perspective from a lifetime of devotion to ministry of others. There are many sound churches in Orange County, but this one stands out. Eric, Jim, Jerry, and Ken are some of the pastors and retired pastors available at every service. I'm now on the other side of the continent, but feel this needed to be posted to help direct anyone searching for a church. Was invited for their Easter service.  Very well organized, welcoming, immaculate and has a very relaxed vibe. I want to go here but haven't I live right inside gate 3 about two blocks away. I'm sure it's awesome inside. I’ve never been there in person to Pacific Hills in South Orange County. However, I do like listening to Dave Rolf, the senior pastor, as his Bible teaching style is very unique. Dave is a brilliant man and has a very interesting take on so many scripture passages. I think he’s probably getting ready to retire, so he’s not teaching every week, unfortunately. He follows in the footsteps of our spiritual father, Chuck Smith of Calvary Chapel, Costa Mesa. Dave also is still on K wave radio 107.9 FM.

name: Pacific Hope Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: If your looking for a church that is centered on the most important thing you need to know. Pastor John teaches the cross centered life that every Christian needs to know “ Jesus died on the cross for your sin to bring you back into fellowship with God” Pacific Hope Church changed my life. God is good. My husband and I have been looking for a Church like this! Small and family oriented. A great place to worship. Pastor John Leeder is a wonderful pastor and we love the way he conveys the Word!! Love this place of worship. Sound doctrine, right Theology. Many ministries for the body to grow and serve. Christ exalting church with great biblical teaching, and wonderful fellowship. Excellent place of prayer for the nations! Reformed theology.  Christ centered theology.  You'll be hard pressed to find a church that preaches the Gospel as faithfully as you'll find here.

name: Pacific Life Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending services here for about 10 years (even before it was called PLC) and absolutely love it! Once you’ve heard one of Pastor Steve’s messages you will want to hear more! Come as you are. Everyone is super chill. Pacific life church is a “come as you are” church with great worship music and a great community. The messages are powerful and relevant to our everyday lives. I highly recommend checking out PLC! Pacific Life Church has become our family’s new home over the past couple of years. Its warm community of people have made us feel welcomed and genuinely cared for. They provide a great youth group for our teen, and a fun Sunday school program for our 9 yr old. The worship music is great and Pastor Steve and his staff deliver uplifting scripture filled messages every Sunday.  We love the casual-come as you are vibe, the laughter, love and friendships we have through Pacific Life Church. Great messages, small church, so you can get to know people. Great music. Great small friendly church. Come as you are, wear flip flops and shorts and fit right in! Pastor Steve is a great speaker and the messages are relevant for today. You won't feel lost, definitely NOT a "megachurch".

name: Pacific Lighthouse Christian Fellowship - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: So welcoming and the pastor spoke of amazing life experience and the Lord’s miracle in his own life!!! Awesome Everyone really nice! They treat me like family :D! Great people, low key. Very nice and friendly congregation! I found my home  here...

name: Pacific Point Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Just standard church to go with good sermon. Wish it uses less sarcasm though. Alright welcome to get through as could just be more than saying hi. Looks nicely open yet lack enough groups during the week. If you want to connect with people and keep it Biblical, this is your church! We're "Salty" not "Churchy" and we'd love to see you there!

I've been attending over 14 years, and we are a family at PPC!  Come, the way you are, worship with us, visit us, grow with us!

There is child care, kids church, worship, donuts-we got you! Life groups and events are great ways to connect!

Love to see you, we have young couples to connect with, and every other age in between, diverse and welcoming! Hope to see you!🙏❤️ Pastor John Blue is inspirational and humorous. His family are there and everyone is friendly. It is an educational and a rewarding social experience. Thanks to the Lord.

name: Pacific Southwest District-LCMS - Irvine Campus

name: Pacifica Synod of the Evangelical Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: I really appreciate the work of the Synod.  They want every church to succeed and are looking for unconventional ways to make that happen. name: Packinghouse Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I like pastor Ed, he didn't speak on Father's Day me and my family that went on Father's Day thought it was so weird to talk about a eunuch on Father's Day Teaching God's Word through many ministries and excellent pastors,teachers and staff! The Packinghouse Church also has a very welcoming and comfortable feeling and those that attend are very nice people and family friendly! .
.
#packinghouse #packinghousechurch #godsword #biblestudy #jesussaves #packinghousechurchredlands #ilovejesus
#beblessed #readgodsword #jesus #calvarychapel #seetheusa #pureword Paster Ed has a great way of making things understandable and relatable.  People have tried to greet and speak with me but I'm adhd with tourettes so I try to avoid being too social as I'm not good with carrying conversations.  I wish that wasn't so. But I digressed.

Is a great church. Stars?
I snuck in and sat where I used to sit last Sunday: I didn't see Eve, I didn't see Kelley and I barely saw myself.
I love this church, I really do and I apologize for not being emotionally mature enough to approach leadership when it might have made a difference.
Feeling like I am one of the original kids from the Costa Mesa movement all those years ago affords me a special spot on the telephone wire. All the popular "mega-church" campuses are waning. It's not the buildings fault either.
I would love to help but honestly, after having done relatively nothing while feeling like I gave it all I had, what's left?
I'b he happy to come sweep the parking lot. I mean that in the most sincere and loving way, metaphorically AND literally.
I did find out one of my students from long ago, a student I loved and taught is now a ballerina and that warmed my soul. Michael was going to be a pastor and Alex was my little discerner that wanted his dad to do better. I miss it so much and I love you all. Took our youth group to the youth led youth rally and it was such a blessing.  Can't wait for the next years rally.

name: Palisades Church of Christ - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly atmosphere.  They have the songbook up on the screen for those who may not want to handle the physical book. They also have two screens. One in English and one in Spanish. Communion is individually as well for hygiene. You will pick up a prepacked set in the rear of the auditorium, then you enter. Mrs Jan is really awesome. She was really kind and outgoing and she was really cool. Great lady
Daniel Currington is the pulpit Minister there and if you are aware of any of the Church of Christ around the area then you know his dad, David Currington.

I've had the fun pleasure of meeting David, and me and David and Charles shepherd, another member of Decatur highway Church of christ, we all three went to mountain view golf course I got to play together. David preaches full-time as well and Daniel is here at palisades. Y'all need to come visit Palisades and say hello to Daniel and his wonderful assistant, she does a tremendous job and her name is Jan Beautiful people, warm and friendly. Solid bible teaching but simplified for your learning and comprehension. I also think it's awesome that they have Spanish translation during the worship, and even for baptisms. The preaching is wonderful, I just like better song's. Not a men singing with high pitch. Can't keep up. I still bless them for being nice folks. Love the word. Amen please visit. God bless. Overall love this church! Welcoming and loving people! Definitely worth a visit! :)

name: Palisades Community Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing music, welcoming congregation, absolutely gorgeous indoor space and outdoor tea garden. Services are moving, interactive, make the bible come alive. The congregation is mission- and community-driven to incorporate social justice and community service activities into weekly programming.

Perfect space for weddings, funerals, concerts, recitals, book events. I grew up at this church in the early 90’s. My great grandfather was a pastor at this church. My grandmother and grandfather were very active with oyster dinners and a number of other functions they held. My family would host our thanksgivings here for years. I visited this church before and each time I went the pastor lead a sermon that was moving and provided stimulating lessons for contemplation.  The church sanctuary is lined with big windows to allow the light in, I was greeted by a friendly church congregation, and a comfortable atmosphere to connect with God. There was religious tolerance, other members of the congregation came from different Christian denominations.  Last time I went they had just begun a project to increase community involvement and increase charitable engagement to aid the greater DMV area I grew up at this church during my junior and senior high school years in the late ‘50s to mid-60’s. Hope the local community is still providing support. Too far away in CA now to attend. Last visited at Easter about 10 years ago and was impressed with the pastor and the family atmosphere. My family loves this church because of it's small town feel and the warmth of its community. The church is also progressive and we like that the sermons connect listeners to the world and current events.   They have a small but sweet program for children - we also like that they are very forgiving of our small children moving about the pews!

name: Palisades United Methodist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: We loved this church when we lived there. They are very loving and really care about their community. We still haven't found our home church since we moved and it's been years.

name: Palm City Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been at Palm City for almost 3 years now and we have truly found a home here. God has drastically changed our lives through the people of Palm City in which I am forever grateful for. My husband and I along with our middle schooler serve on the best grow team and our youngest two children attend an awesome and purpose filled children’s ministry. You won’t regret visiting Palm City and your life just might change in the best way possible! Palm city has been such a special place for our family! We love the Bagwells. We love to serve here. Myself, my husband and our oldest daughter have all been baptized at Palm city. We’ve made so many friends and connected with lots of families 💚 Palm City has been my family’s church for about 3 years. It is a Bible-based church with a pastor whose messages are direct yet tempered with humor. The church family is friendly and welcoming and there are ample opportunities to serve- whether in-house or outreach to the community. At last count there were about 30 different City Groups to join. These cover a gamut of interests; whether you are a wanting to learn more about the Bible, or just looking for friends to meet for lunch. Either way, you will meet friends who will quickly become your church family! My wife and I have had an overwhelmingly positive experience at Palm city church. I am very grateful for the impact it has had on my entire family’s life and spiritual growth. From the very first visit, We felt a genuine sense of belonging, a feeling that I have never experienced in prior churches. My wife and I can truly say we found a true church family. You will feel the strong sense of community with amazing people.

One of the greatest values of Palm city church is its commitment to helping people become followers of Jesus Christ. The message is consistently grounded in Scripture, offering clear, thoughtful, and practical guidance for renewing the mind and applying biblical truth to everyday life. Each message enhances a deeper understanding of the Bible and strengthens personal faith.

The worship experience is another highlight. The music is uplifting, heartfelt, and Christ-centered, creating an atmosphere that draws people into authentic praise and worship. It’s both inspiring and refreshing each week.

Families with children will especially appreciate the excellent palm city kid’s area. It is well organized, safe, and led by caring people who are genuinely invested in helping children learn about God in a fun and meaningful way.

Palm city church has a wonderful safety team that makes parents feel at ease during the message.

Overall, this church has provided me with community, spiritual growth, and a sense of purpose. I highly recommend palm city church to anyone who is seeking a place to connect, grow, and strengthen their walk with Christ.

If you are looking for a home church this Easter, look no further and strengthen your relationship with Jesus Christ at Palm city church! I LOVE PALM CITY. It only took one visit at Palm City for me to realize this church was where I belonged. It has become so much more than just a church to me- at palm city i have found true community, confidence & a new love for life that I never expected. Pastor Brian challenges you to grow beyond being a lukewarm, Sunday-only Christian, all while bringing humor and authenticity to every message. There is no judgment here, just encouragement to spiritually grow into the best version of yourself. I can’t thank Palm City enough for the opportunities they’ve given me & the growth they have inspired in every aspect of my life.

name: Palm Harvest Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
This place has caused my family only suffering with the way too loud music blaring into the night on weekdays and through the weekends. There’s no number to call to ask them to turn down the amps, stop the drumming, and to quiet the absolute worst singing of all time into the mic. Worst church. Oh man, the BLASTING live band is killing me!
Tonight they've got the amps and base full force and the infrasound is legit vibrating my chest and skull.
I want to barf it hurts!!
WED NIGHT 8:45 PM
JULY 8, 2025 Not sure which church uses this facility on Wednesday nights, but it is a man straight up yelling into a mic in the evenings and it's extremely aggressive and loud (even with my windows shut).

If you're looking at apartments near here, don't do it. Most ANNOYING part of this neighborhood, it's not peaceful by any means. Every day there is a different service going on, and children play there after school so there really isn't a time for quietness. I attended this past Sunday and as a Costa Mesa native you will be right at home. Super chill place to grow and fellowship. What can I say about this church? I've been a member since the first time I met it. I knew I was in the perfect place, but I won't say much more than to recommend it. See for yourselves if you have any doubts.

name: Palm Valley Church (Goodyear Campus) - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
A Church That Truly Welcomes You As You Are

We’ve been attending Palm Valley Church since the days of Pastor Greg Rohlinger, who started this incredible journey with just 12 people in his living room. From the beginning, this church has always felt real, raw, and rooted in genuine faith.

Palm Valley focuses on the loving Word of God while providing support for every stage of life. Whether it’s kids' classes, teen and young adult ministries, marriage support, or small groups – there’s truly something for everyone.

What stands out the most is how welcoming this church is. No matter where you’re coming from or what your story is, Palm Valley Church encourages you to come just as you are. It’s a place of acceptance, hope, and community – and we’re grateful to call it home. My family & I have been attending Palm Valley for about a year and it's been a blessing. The days we can't physically attend the kids are bummed ( I never thought I'd see the day). If you watch online for the first time you should check it out in person it's a different feeling in-person. The photos are from 3 different events. My Family and I love coming to Palm Valley! We have been coming here for 3 years. Our whole family serves Saturday evenings and Pastor Mark is an outstanding Pastor! We've been attending PVC since 2011. Love our church, the friends that we've made, PVC Kids is AWESOME, and we've grown so much in our walk with Christ at PVC. So thankful! This is an excellent bible based church.
The pastoral staff, and campus staff and volunteers are welcoming. We have a 10 year old, and the kids service is age appropriate and engaging. PVC has embraced the community and continues to serve God and bring the word and works of God. We attend regularly and suggest to any all all to try it out.

name: Palo Alto Christian Reformed Church - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

A peaceful and welcoming church with a warm sense of community. The congregation is friendly, and the services are thoughtful and centered on faith and scripture. The church grounds are well maintained, creating a calm atmosphere that's great for quiet reflection. Whether you're visiting for worship or simply looking for a peaceful place to spend some time, Palo Alto Christian Reformed Church is worth a visit. Amazing church for those who are thirsty and need the everlasting water. Very hospitable . thanks Nice church A church in Palo Alto, followers of Jesus Christ.

name: Palo Alto First Christian Church - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary: Christmas service was inspiring and beautiful. Great pastor That Paster Dan Rocks! I like it, it's very beautiful.

name: Palo Alto Vineyard Church - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary: I've been positively impressed with the Palo Alto Vineyard since I first visited in July 2025. I discovered the church by accident.  I was on Google Maps street view looking for something else and happened to scroll across it at the corner of Middlefield Road and East Meadow in Palo Alto.  It struck me as an energetic and spiritually thriving place,  and that has turned out to be the case.  Their first and foremost desire is to connect deeply with God in spiritual things and then to let that connection play out wisely and naturally.  They expend a larger fraction of their resources than any church group I know of supporting over a dozen organizations that work with the disadvantaged in the area.  In keeping with the Vineyard "everyone gets to play" idea, almost everyone who participates regularly volunteers in one or more ministry efforts or programs.  It is a fun and welcoming place, people are very friendly, and there is much to do if you are looking for a place to contribute.  I am so glad I ran across PAVC. Very warm and friendly gathering. I felt comfortable as a new person. Worship was good with a sense of the Holy Spirt. I’d guess there was almost 200 people there. They teach out of the Bible and it was relevant. The week I was there they had a baby dedication and it was super sweet how they did it. Very diverse congregation. If I lived in the area I’d definitely go back I’ve found Palo Alto Vineyard to be a refreshing and authentic place. It’s a grounded, God-focused, 'come-as-you-are' environment. The teaching is practical and deep, making it a great place for anyone looking to strengthen their relationship with God. Highly recommend it. My family has been attending the Palo Alto Vineyard church for the past 17 years. Although there has been changes over the years (two different pastors, new location, etc) one thing has remained constant; the amazing community and supportive, loving environment. All three of my children (now ages 14, 11 and 6) have been mentored in their faith through the hard working volunteers and pastoral staff at PAVC! Additionally, the musical worship always helps fill me with His spirit, even on difficult days. Thank you Lord for this community who loves You and desires to serve You so faithfully! Palo Alto Vineyard Church is a beautiful, multicultural community filled with love and warmth. From day one, it has felt like family. The leadership is inspiring and genuine, and there’s a strong sense of connection and care throughout the church. It’s a place where everyone is welcome and valued!

name: Palomar Japanese Baptist Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: There are very kind pastor and saints, and the Word is good. This church has a warm atmosphere and welcomes even non-Christians like me. It's relatively small, but there are university students (many of whom are international students), young people, singles, married people, and families. The pastor is cheerful, friendly, bright, and kind. There's ample parking.

name: Palos Verdes Baptist Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary: Warm, friendly, Bible centered, multi-generational church woth contemporary praise music & very good, down-to-earth, practical sermons.

name: Panama City Church of Christ - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful group of Christians. Very friendly. Bible class was interesting with good discussion. We will go back. Welcoming group of sound believers. Enjoyed the class and sermon...both based in New Testament teaching. It's so nice to find a church when traveling, and it's always the first thing we look for! Thanks for having us! Wonderful experience friendly Bible teaching adherence to new testament church in worship singing the Lords supper .
Will definitely worship here again when in the area. Visited here while driving through the area. Impressed with the teaching, using the Bible as their guide. It’s obvious they love God and studying the Bible. Really friendly people! The church of Christ here at Panama is a very good and sound congregation. I really recommend worshiping and studing the bible with them there. Very friendly and loving Christians that want to do Gods will.

name: Panorama Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
The food pantry event was delayed and was poorly organized in terms of managing the line. A lot of old people had to go down the porch cause its not suitable for disabled people. Also, the food selection was pretty poor too - barely no veggies, no beverages, the variety was not good.
BUT the big plus is they were trying their best to make it work. And unlike other pantries the food here was actually fresh and not expired. Cant complain that much - solid 4 stars. Keep up the work you are doing for the community 👍 I attended back in 1974 - 1984.  I was Baptized and had my Daughter dedicated by Pastor Wilcox and was married to my husband by Pastor DeAutry Jones.  Spent those years in the choir where Directing Students from CSUN were our Intern choir directors. We once performed Handel's The Messiah.  To this day, the word GLORY runs through my brain as GLOW-RY.  Pastor Wilcox's Daughter Libby had an absolutely angelic voice. Good food pantry Place to  word ship Good people

name: Pantano Christian Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
I just had my baptism here. My fiancé and I have been attending for a few months.

It was truly such a wonderful experience. When I went backstage, I was in tears (excited, nervous, happy, all the emotions). These sweet people embraced me with hugs and words of affirmation. Everyone I met had a genuine excitement about my baptism. I cannot describe how loved I felt in that moment. All of the staff and volunteers explained what I should expect, so I could just solely focus on my baptism instead of wondering how the whole process would go. I am really grateful. This church and these people have shown me the love of Jesus like never before and I am so thankful to be a part of the Pantano family now :) It has been years since I've felt comfortable going into a house of worship. Listening to "teaching" rather than being pounded by hell fire and brimstone. Makes you want to be there every Sunday. Thank you PCC. My wife and I feel very welcome. I had a wonderful time at praise and worship here Sunday with my mom on Mother's day! There is a lot of seats. There is free beverages like coffee, tea, and lemonade. They also have an inexpensive cafe of breakfast food. We arrived early and had eggs, bacon and potatoes. Yum! They have breakfast burritos and several other choices. There is a large covered seating area too. The music and the sermon, by the pastor's wife, were inspiring. I would recommend this church to anyone looking for a home church. Their goal is to equip Christians for services in the community. Pantano has many ways that you can become an active Christian. They have 2  campuses, I believe. If you arrive late you will have to sit in the bleachers. They have 3 ? services Sunday morning and all are crowded. They have a presence on FB. Go check ✔️ it out. Amazing experience and atmosphere here. I just moved to Tucson from the Phoenix area and needed a new place to call home. Really loved what I got from today's message and looking forward to the next service!!!! Great friendly church. Pastor Trevor DeVage is so wonderful. Has great children and adult Bible studies.
A very low cost Cafe with great homecooked style dining.
Always have a custom coffee truck on campus during services for Starbucks styled drinks.

name: Paradise Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm tired of this so-called church. They have a damn mess in the mornings. They don't direct traffic to their school. They call themselves Christians and drive like animals. I live here and I can't get through. Now, on February 27, 2026, they had a pagan party and even parked in my garage on Castlesands Way. We demand that they have someone watching the entrance to the private neighborhood so they don't come in here.
All those 15 people who gave it 5 stars are the old folks who hang out there, but the truth is that I, as a neighbor, am fed up with the mess they make and the noise they make in the parking lot. Love this church. I always feel so welcomed. Pastor Mike is awesome. I love this church everybody’s so friendly especially Pastor Mike. They only preach full gospel bible Verse. I learned a lot from this church. Come bring your family and friends and be blessed as well. God bless us all I have been a member of Paradise Church for many years. Here, the bible is preached in its entirety with no sugar-coating. This is a church that honors God. The people are friendly and supportive, and I consider them my family. This is an Amazing Church if you want to hear the true gospel ! Great preacher great people and amazing discipleship

name: Paradise Springs Community Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I felt at a home the minute we entered the church. The congregation is welcoming and supportive.  Pastor Rich a wonderful teacher.  We have learned more about God,Christ and the Holy Ghost as well as the teachings on the Bible from Pastor Rich and truly enjoy Sunday services. Typical small, close-knit church with a congregation of like-minded people mainly told what to do by male leadership.

Questioning authority/leadership at this church is a big no-no, despite their family centered and accepting presentation.

If you are going to attend this church be sure to have a good idea of who you are or else they will tell you EXACTLY who you’re supposed to be, what you’re doing wrong, and how far away from God you are if you’re not following what they say.

Appears to care more about having you attend their congregation and believe what they do than help you find your own personal journey with God. I am forever thankful for this church comprised of incredibly loving and supportive members and a pastor who deeply cares about his congregation. If you are in need of a church that will love you as you are while helping to teach you the word of God, this is the place for you. Has a fabulous service. The congregation is very kind and welcoming. As well as a lot of younger kids if you have younger children. As well as they have all ages . This church is very accepting too. I needed something in my life .I was told about the little community Church.I feel in love with it first time.The feeling of God and Love was overwhelming. The Paster and members of the Church really care about you.

name: Paradox Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve never attended a church more loving, welcoming, and committed to community than Paradox. I love raising my kids in this church, and I feel safe in this community as a queer woman. I have really enjoyed reading and learning about each and every book of the Bible over the last decade. We always have interesting discussions about the sermon after church. I can say this church consistently challenges me to be a better, more loving person. Paradox has been a refreshing and healing church experience for my husband and I after our journey through religious deconstruction. They follow through on their belief statements about supporting LGBTQ+ rights, women’s empowerment, and anti-racism. The sermons are centered around becoming a more loving person and the core belief that it is good to be alive. For anyone looking for something different from the mainstream, we could not recommend Paradox enough! I have never attended a church like this before. They focus on being a more loving person and accept everyone for who they are. I love this place and call it my spiritual home. The people are warm and friendly and the music is amazing! Saturday service for post modern Christian.
Very scholarly discussion of biblical teaching. Provided good food for thought without any pressure to comply with a specific view. The pastor stayed after the service and interacted with many people. A friend invited me and I plan to return.

Coffee and donuts at the door, nice welcome.  Greeters made me feel welcome too...

When you stop by tell them Joe sent you...they will say Joe Who...that's me. This place was friendly, atmospheric, and makes you feel at home with it's service. I must let you know, they don't follow EVERYTHING in the Bible strictly, they believe that it is unhealthy because it separates communities. They are open to people of all kinds.

name: Park Avenue Christian Church
reviewSummary: I went to Park Avenue Christian Church for the first time seven years ago and instantly knew that this was going to be my permanent church! I you feel like family right away and everyone only makes you feel more welcome the more you show up! No second thought needed, P.A.C.C. deserves a 100/10 rating for sure! 💜✝️ I stopped by the church because they have a "clothes give away" on most Tuesdays from 11:30 am to 1:30 pm. I picked up a couple of things, a Fall Jacket and a couple of hair ties. There is plenty of parking and it downstairs laid out nicely : ) If you're looking to join a church that makes you feel instantly like family, Park Ave Church is it! Love it! Best AA meeting on Saturdays at 7:00 pm Kind and Generous Folks.  Very helpful to people needing clothes.

name: Park Avenue Christian Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: So I did a private party there for New Year’s Eve and it was amazing. Great church and great venue. Everyone was so nice and the service was fabulous. My fiancé and I are from Texas and visited NYC this week. It’s hard to find churches like this in Texas. I was overwhelmed by the beauty of their principles and their chapel. I had to go inside— the doorman was so kind, they let us explore the chapel, let’s just say, I left in tears, happy tears. This is church is amazing, their staff is amazing and I was able to find a sister church in Texas. Thank you Park Avenue Christian Church. Diana Mahrach 2025 Fashion Show Park Avenue Christian  Church is welcomed oasis of spirituality.  The choir and music is so uplifting; the architecture  mesmerizing and the Pastor, Kaji Douša is a beacon of light to her congregation and extended community. She has dedicated her life to uplifting souls and that really shines through. This is my church home, a place where I am loved, supported, and nurtured in faith and in faith in action. I do not have to leave my mind at home, because Park Avenue Christian Church is a place for progressive people of all faiths, a place that welcomes all.

name: Park Avenue Missionary Baptist - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I been looking for my friend andrina avery cambell Was so impressed by the men's group singing last Sunday! They were wonderful! Thanking God for Rev. L.E Campbell, our Pastor who teaches and preaches the word of God in and out of season. During the pandemic followed the cities guidelines and never stopped doing what thus says the Lord! This is our families Church. I have a great love for this church. Kinda stuck in the old school of beliefs but there's something to be said for that. It will have trouble growing if it's not able to speak to the youth. Attended the HomeGoing Service of my best friends husband. Park Ave is a beautiful church and the members are very friendly

name: Park Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Great warm inviting church. Always feel welcome. Also great music and sermons! I have been attending Park Church for over 4 years and have found it to be a gospel centered and Godly environment that boldly preaches the Word.  We strive to be a diverse community where everyone is welcome- all races, ages, and backgrounds.  This is also a safe place for those examining the claims of Christianity to come and learn.  Please join us on Sunday at 9, 11, or 5pm. Park church is awesome. Gary is an awesome preacher and continually surprises and impressed me with his teaching, knowledge and down to earth understanding. The church itself is beautiful. The music is a great mix of hymns and contemporary worship and the people are very friendly. really good church for Sunday visit. The people were friendly, the music was decently good, and it was great to celebrate communion with this church – since it does so every Sunday. The preaching was just okay, a little unengaging – but it was not their normal speaker (whom I hear is very good). also, I'm 37 and I was probably in the oldest 20% of the church. When people say it's a young crowd – it's a very young crowd.

I would absolutely recommend this church for someone visiting Denver, or for someone looking for a church in Denver, or for someone looking into Christ or the Christian faith. No church is perfect, but this one is really good. Park church is definitely a younger crowd when I attended and the worship seems more along the lines of some of the reformed (hymns) with contemp praise and worship.  For those looking at churches in Denver, I highly recommend this church if you want to go where the Bible is taught every week and you like a more traditional church.  Probably wouldn't recommend it for someone looking for "all beliefs are equally valid" teaching.  People will be awesome to you, but the insistence on one way to God may rub you the wrong way.  Hope this helps seekers.  Good church, good people, you can get to make a lot of good friends here.

name: Park Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: I am so blessed to have found Park Church 4 years ago.  It is like a family to me.  Both Nicole and Andrew are true shepherds, diligently caring for the people who attend.  I have found integrity to be a strong virtue in these pastors.  Although small compared to larger churches, Park reflects the relaxed culture of the community of Poway.  The preaching is Biblically-based and the Holy Spirit is free to move in a balanced way without extremism or denial of the spiritual gifts. When are you going to give a response to the actions of your church members? They are unhinged and far from Christians. It was sickening to see how they reacted to a man filming on a public sidewalk exercising our American rights just as you guys were exercising your rights in church. Your church should be ashamed of their actions and hopefully more people will share the video to show the world how that congregation acts when they arent happy. So very sad. They made all Christians look bad on that day. Awesome church! Full of the life of Christ with the pastor's hearts filled with Holy Spirit and living a life in accordance with the will of God. Great fellowship and a place for all. The head pastor is a good friend of mine. If you're looking for a group of people to share life with, these guys are it. Life can get lonely or rough sometimes. These guys will go through the ups and downs of life's roller coaster with you. Plus, this is a great place for your young kids to connect with other kids. I encourage you to check out Park Church if you haven't already. Assaulted and battered a gentlemen on the sidewalk for recording, their security detail is unhinged.

name: Park Cities Baptist Church
reviewSummary: A heritage Baptist church in the Park Cities area with strong family ministry and a welcoming community.

name: Park Cities Presbyterian Church - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
I would give absolutely anything to be able to go to this church.    I am a half continent away, retired and have little money so I am immensely grateful to be able to listen to their service (as well as a couple others) every week.   Solid.  Solid. Solid.   And the music I SOOOOO love and cannot find in the Midwest. Absolutely gorgeous venue. Great host and great seating Beautiful sanctuary with 9:30a and 11a services. PCA church with head pastor Mark Davis. Gospel centered biblical teaching.  Wonderful church body.  Great programs for members and for the community. The women’s ministry team is incredible.  The shear number of hours these women devote to young mothers, week after week, is commendable!  The ladies who run the nursery are amazing, as well.  Love my time there each week! I came for the Christmas concert and was shocked at the quality of the production and how much effort they put in to it. Very well done and the conductor was fun to watch!

The staff are also very kind and considerate to the guests and answered all of my questions.

name: Park Community Church - Lincoln Park
reviewSummary: Once upon a time I stumbled across Park via a “churches near me” search and it quickly became one of the biggest blessing in my life. The sound gospel preaching, vibrant community, mentorship, service opportunities, and ways in which you can grow as a follower of Christ are endless! The Lord is moving through this church & has undoubtedly transformed my heart over the past 3.5 years of attendance. I promise you will not regret showing up one Sunday at 10am to try it out. Hope to see you there! I did not have a great experience here. It was all about the “culture” and expectations they had, rather than centering God. My experience almost ruined my relationship with God, but nothing can separate us from the love of God. I love God more now than ever. Park has by my church home for the last 5.5 years! I love that this is a Bible based church, and sermons are preached verse by verse. Park desires for each person to grow in their faith and offers many ministry opportunities to help facilitate  mthat! I have found amazing community at Park, lifelong friends & most importantly have seen my life transformed by the gospel! I have been an attendee and member here for 6 years and love the church family I have gained! A great community and great people. We also have a great children’s program! I’ve been going to Park Community Church LP for 11 years, and I have found great encouragement in getting to know Jesus and follow him. Regardless of where you are at in your faith this is a great place to learn and grow. I hope to see you next Sunday!

name: Park Community Church - Near North - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Park Community Church (Near North) for about 1.5 years and I am very grateful for this community. This church preaches Christ crucified and does so clearly, faithfully and biblically. The sermons are exceptional — pastors preach the Gospel verse by verse, explaining the Scriptures with clarity, depth and conviction. One of the most powerful sermon themes during my time there was “Humanity’s Return Home,” built on Genesis and Revelation. It was rich, theological and deeply moving.

The services are well structured and thoughtfully organized. The worship team gathers every Sunday at 7 AM to prepare, and the music is consistently excellent — heartfelt, skillful and reverent. Week after week, I noticed growth and refinement in every part of their ministry.

The evening service at 5:00 PM was also a real blessing. It created space for those who couldn’t attend in the morning and helped build a broader sense of community. The staff, pastors and volunteers serve with joy, humility and professionalism.

If you are looking for a Christ-centered, Bible-preaching church with strong teaching, quality worship and a welcoming environment, I highly recommend visiting. I’m deeply thankful to the pastors and the entire team for their dedication and faithfulness. May God richly bless this church.

1001 N Crosby St, Chicago, IL 60610 Good message. Nice worship. But man did I feel unseen. They said they had deacons to pray with after the service. I stuck around and couldn’t find anyone. I was told there was a connection desk right outside the service auditorium when I came in. In the sea of people, I couldn’t find it. If you’re visiting a church for the first time, maybe go somewhere else or wait to be invited to come here. I just felt so invisible. 1001 N Crosby St, Chicago, IL 60610 Wonderful church! Preaching is solid, worship is sincere, and people are friendly. The inside of the church building is beautiful and spacious. There is a parking garage available for people to park their cars. The elevator is accessible from inside the parking garage. I went to the Faith and Work Movement Gathering at one of the church's meeting rooms and it was a great experience.

name: Park Community Church - South Loop - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church ! Welcoming environment, to new comers, trustworthy pastor with a zeal for the word !  Bible based sermons , multi cultural , multi ethnic . Feel blessed to be a part of this Park community South loop family ! A true Bible based church, where the word is not Sugar coated. There are many church small groups sessions  for everyone from womens, to youth, to mens, even for christians in medicine! The pastor is a humble servant of God and overall a great experience, a great assembly of the brethren especially when I need that recharge before starting my week. Pastor Raef is on fire for the Lord! Thriving church that makes all new comers feel welcome! They stay true to the gospel. Music is multi generational and multi ethnic. Whew that Joshua Fried, what a firestarter! Get him on a fast track to leadership for sure.

name: Park Hill Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Necessary ending after hearing the pastor announce plans to expand staffing hires despite quarterly report of significant budget shortfalls with church budget.

July 12, 2026 TL;DR this church saved my faith. In 2020, discouraged by the lack of pastors preaching unity from the pulpit in the midst of racial tensions, I left the church altogether. I spent 2021 deconstructing a faith I’d been born into. After realizing that life without God in community is no better, I decided to dip my toe in church life again, and was led to Park Hill. By the grace of God, I entered a community group where the topics I was struggling with were directly addressed, and was even invited into the racial reconciliation cohort. Here, I had a safe space to wrestle through the issues that pushed me away from church in the first place. The lead pastors were even part of that cohort, not to speak and be heard but simply hear what the vulnerable members of their congregation had to say. I can tell you from experience, that this willingness to hear how the Church had done the vulnerable, wrong, is not a commitment I have seen at other places. The leadership leaning in and making change from the pulpit, preaching against division in this country and emphasizing God’s heart for unity through sound scripture, helped heal my heart for the church. I got to know the lead pastors from a few interactions over the years, and I can tell you that their heart is truly burdened for their flock and for sound biblical teaching in an increasingly divided landscape. To those who put down leadership behind the scenes: it’s true, they’re not perfect, and running any size church is hard. To the person who said the pastors walked right past you: have grace. New people come in all the time, and if you introduce yourself they will welcome you warmly. From my experience and that of many I had met there — genuine Christ followers trying to grow and learn and do better — Park Hill fosters environments that challenges us to put our flesh aside and grow as a body. We need more of this now, Christians unafraid to stand on scripture FOR people, not against them, than ever. Been going here for 6 years and it is truly our church home for life! I strongly disagree with the positive reviews. As someone who has had personal interactions with the leadership and specifically Evan, it is not a welcoming place or one of good community. There are many challenges behind the scenes and a lot of turnover in attendance. The cliques are strong and leadership is a mess. The Sunday sermons are fine, but the church itself is one to avoid due to the organizational trouble and failure to provide access to community. I’ve been at this church multiple years, it has solid biblical teaching and worship with a great community of those seeking to know God in a deeper way. Many of the less than 5 star reviews here are from people who like the idea of Christianity but don’t believe all of the teachings of the Bible are relevant. This church teaches directly from the Bible without skirting past controversial topics.

Park Road Baptist Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful welcoming church in a great location.

We love the daycare! They have been a pleasure to work with. Been attending Park Road Baptist Church for 2 years and realized few things here to share with others so you don't waste your time if you come from a different background.
1. This is a church in is South Park. More attendants are comfortable retirees and "comfortable" South Park people (or at least look like). If you don't fit it to this background, it will be really hard to find a community here. If you don't speak like or look like them, yes they said all are welcome but not all are accepted and treated equally. You may feel you are always an outsider unless you speak structurally like them or look like them.
2. There is a strong culture here and people are very comfortable with it and don't like any changes, differences or being challenged. They are not interested knowing your difference or understanding where it came from so it's better to hide it and just pretend there is no difference so we can all maintain this "comfortable" feeling so you don't make them feel uncomfortable.
3.  This church did a good job on trying to be open to everyone and saying that all are welcome but they don't have the training on how to manage and treat the differences respectfully in personal way. It's good they are trying but they just don't know how to do it. Don't feel being mistreated or take it personal. My child participated in the Charlotte youth orchestra here. It was challenging during the Covid time due to limited interaction. I felt the staff took appropriate precautions. The location and proximity to other activities made it bearable. Receptionist is very rude. I just called to get information on a specific topic , she quickly said something then hung up. I had to call back to hear what she said. A different lady answered who was more kind . I was interested in joining as well, but after being hung up on and dismissed I change my mind . Great way to represent the Lord! Park Road Baptist Church: An inclusive church where ALL are welcomed. I have found this place to be a sanctuary of free and honest inquiry, sound theological scholarship, warm and caring congregation, social missions, and great music.  They have gifted child and youth leaders and a campus that is open all week to various community programs.  But the preaching is my favorite.

name: Park Slope Christian Center - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Park slope Christian Center is a wonderful church a gift to have a spiritual home where you feel you belong and can serve  others alongside people who share your values ✨️ ❤️ 🙏 Nice place, great people & awesome pastor I was warmly welcomed by the people and Pastor of this church during my travels. Strongly recommend to people looking for a home church in this area. The Holy Spirit was present here. Very Welcome ,  Strong , Friendly .

BLESSED  SERMONS  ,  and  Ppl. !
