reviewSummary:
I read awesome reviews of your church as I seek a ministry in which to fellowship. I tried to send an email several times to no prevail. It is okay, as I'll put myself out there for a good cause on here. So, I recently moved back to BK after years away and was wondering if your ministry does the "Blue💙candle" service in which provides those with that time to remember and pray for those we have lost or thinking of that someone/s. Surely do appreciate your efforts in replying to me somehow as I did to ask👍. Thank you for your time and God bless. Sincerely, Juan Guzmán aka New to Park slope. Glory Hallelujah I had a beautiful time at the park slope Christian Tabernacle Church the singing the praising on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ when he risen it was beautiful I actually was there for two and a half hours and they gave me a little gift and a little bag that was so awesome thank you for praising my Lord God our Father Hallelujah the lady pastor and her husband they both were awesome God bless their Unity hallelujah amen Close nit community of people who embrace fellowship with one another as well as visitors.
The Gospel Music touched my heart.
Go there and get in the presence of the Lord Jesus Christ. I grew my faith here.and the family I have and love here.they dont judge anyone.they show you so much love and respect.they have been there for me threw my up's and down.they where they when I most needed them when I lost my mother and it was and is still the most hardest for me and there still there with me. I love them so much. I will be honest. I am a member here for many years. If you want to experience the love of God and are searching for answers . I suggest you give this church a try. You will be blessed.

name: Park Slope Community Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Informal modern worship experience in a beautiful historic church building. The congregation is international, multiculteral and diverse, comprised of mostly 20 and 30 somethings. Sunday school for children. Welcoming to newcomers like me. The pastor is young and enthusiastic about preaching the gospel, reading the scriptures and applying God's Word to your life. Highly recommend. Currently meeting in person inside, with coffee and bagels outside afterward. You can also stream the Sunday morning service online from their website. Highly recommend! Just wow.  The world needs more places of worship like this church.  From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed.  Truly, God's presence is felt here: through the church team and their warmth, kindness, genuine interest in individuals; through the engaging sermons based in Biblical truths, through the wonderful, moving worship team and their music, and through the church's desire to impact and work to serve the needs of the surrounding community - giving of themselves as Jesus would do.  The atmosphere radiates God's love and compassion.  I love that there are tangible ways to get involved beyond the Sunday service.  I love that the church body/family is diverse - all backgrounds and ages and walks of life.  I love this church so much and would love to see more people experience God's love in action....in this complicated, disillusioned and messy world we live in, we desperately need God's love and the message of redemption and salvation and forgiveness.  We need more of this. Authentic, Genuine & Caring leadership and congregation with solid biblical teaching of scripture combined with compassionate application of the Word of God to our "neighbors", the community around the church. They model brotherly love, rather than commanding it. We were visiting for a friend's baptism, but we would join this church if we moved to Brooklyn. Our friends, said, "This is what I imagined church is supposed to be like" This has been my church home for over a year now, and it is a wonderful church that truly has a heart for Jesus! The people are very welcoming, the music and sermons are just what I'm looking for, and they've done a great job keeping people healthy and safe during Covid (closed at first with virtual services, and currently doing both virtual and in-person with masks required and socially distant seating). LOVE this church and my church family. We have a multi cultural congregation from infants to senior citizens. Lots of opportunities to meet people and have fun.

Pastors Logan and Rob are very caring and teach the Holy Bible in ways to understand the Word, and how to apply it to our life journeys and personal development as Christian disciples.

name: Park Street Church
reviewSummary: Historic evangelical pillar on Boston Common with over 200 years of biblical orthodoxy, deep global missions commitments, and rich intergenerational fellowship.

name: Parkside Bible Church - Brownsburg Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve got to say, I’ve met some of the worst humans in this town and they all have one thing in common, Jesus.  The pastor of this church just beat on my door (8:30) PM to tell me that my vehicle was “encroaching on his parking lot” and he needed me not to park there any more (photo of my encroachment below and no, it wasn’t there during service).  Honestly, I just can’t believe the attitudes of people these days.  I sure hope you visited all the surrounding homes who also use your EMPTY parking lot for overflow parking at times just the same as we do and I hope you were as rude to them as you were to me.  I sure hope you talk to all those soccer moms who clog up the whole place every weekend…oh wait, someone is probably paying you for that huh?  Ask yourself, is that what Jesus would have done? Honestly, is it?  We have actually thought about attending this church at one point but I can promise you, after tonight that will never happen.  Thank you for showing us exactly who you are before we wasted our time. We are so grateful for the community of believers who welcomed us into this church, for the biblical truths taught, for strong leadership, and for the amazing children’s programming. Also love the park next door for the community! Cultish. They don't want you to visit other churches. What are you hiding? Taking classes to become a member? Showing up to the church makes you a member. Once a member you're not supposed to visit another church?? Even if a family member invites you to there's for 1 day?? Also, members there talk about pre arranging marriages for their young kids?? (not gossip either, actually was said) I seriously can't wait for my family member to hit 18 so they can leave the church. They tell me constantly how much they don't agree with the views of this church and thinks they are sometimes concerning and scary. They cry when I tell them have to go, because I can't get their bio parent to listen. They've been to our "normal" Christian church and has said they like it much better and it's not as scary. After going once, all of the sudden they're told to never go again. Just beware of this church if you're thinking this may be the one for your family. Great place of expositor y teaching and worship warm and friendly people Big fancy easy to get to church. Does Jesus like this fancy?

name: Parkside Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: LOVE being a part of this community. It's a wonderful place full of loving, caring people! Highly recommend visiting. This place is amazing. Ive been going for over 40 years and love the culture there. They’ve helped me many times and I enjoy giving back as they do. Matt and Randy are amazing. God sure blessed this place My college campus ministry is staying here for the 2018 Unhindered ICOM. Wow. All i can say is wow, huge thanks to the church and pastor Matt for staying up late to welcome us and show us around this gorgeous campus. Definitely felt well received and warmly welcomed. God bless the ministry they do here. Very welcoming, many opportunities to dig deeper into your faith, grow supportive relationships, and to yet involved in being God's hands and feet to the world! I visited here once while in town... very pretty, clean, modern church. A nice church for families.

name: Parkside Church - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely church with beautiful grounds and friendly people! The Word of God is faithfully preached. We always enjoy visiting when in Chagrin Falls. Make sure you stop by the book store and coffee shop—so many wonderful books and delicious coffee and pastries. Take your time and browse. Sad for us that Alistair Begg retired and is no longer preaching most Sundays! But there are still faithful ministers who love the Lord and God’s people. The teaching is biblical and Christ centered as most people know from Begg's radio ministry. The Basics Conference is phenomenal, very local Church oriented, and I can tell from observing their staff and helpers that the Church overflows with kindness, love & service. The host family that I'm staying with is so gracious and very giving as well. It's a Church family of hospitality, truly. My wife and I have attended Parkside Church since moving to Ohio in 2018. We chose Parkside deliberately because of the pastor, Alistair Begg, whom I had listened to on the radio while living in another state. Pastor Begg retired this year and the current senior pastor, Danny Schillero, is also a very qualified Bible expositor and teacher. Due to health issues my wife and I haven’t been able to attend services in person for a while now but we do attend remotely via the live-stream every Sunday. Even on our vacation to South Dakota we were able to attend remotely, which was a comfort to us. And I love how community sensitive they are. When a local school was forced to shut down for a time due to the discovery of asbestos, Parkside stepped up and offered their facility as an alternative location so the children and school staff could continue in the educational process. I don’t know what “denomination” Parkside is a part of, but that doesn’t matter to me because they preach the Word as it was meant to be read … expositorily, with the context of who, what, why, when and where the scripture was written always being considered in order to make it applicable to our relationship with Christ today. We enjoyed the service! 7/4/21 and appreciate the teachings. The bookstore is also fantastic for books, literature and/or a snack from the cafe! Sermons are all focused around the gospel, Jesus is being thought in this church. The people are welcoming, the church is clean and has something for everyone! Highly recommend!

name: Parkside Church - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary:
I missed this — a church grounded in preaching the Gospel and biblical teaching. A place not focused on programs or perfect lighting, but on truth, community, and Jesus.

A children’s ministry where kids are actually learning, praying, and having fun. This is church. This is community. This is love.

Thank you Parkside for choosing not to follow the status quo. ❤️

If you’re looking for a church family and a place to call home, this is it. I've never experienced a church like Parkside! Such a welcoming environment that makes you feel at home from the moment you walk in. Jesus is at the center of everything and that is what gives the church its purpose and life. The Pastor is an amazing teacher and communicator. The people genuinely care for each other and create a true family atmosphere. The community is diverse and ranges in age. If you're looking for a church to call home, I'd highly suggest checking out Parkside Church! I recently started attending parkside church a little over a month ago. From the second I entered the service, I was greeted warmly and treated like family. There is such a vibrant community of genuine believers hungry to hear the word of God and show his love to anyone who walks through the doors! I am so happy to be a new addition to the Parkside family! All are welcome 😊 Amazing church. Coming from a small town, I wanted a church with a close-knit community and Parkside Church is more than I could have ever imagined. From day one, I have consistently been greeted with the friendliest and most loving church community. Parkside not only places Lord Jesus as THE centerpoint, but they also focus on the development of each member and guest in their relationship with Him. After a 6 year hiatus from church my fiancé and I were guided to Parkside when we needed it most. We had just gotten engaged and knew it was time to grow our relationship in ways we hadn’t before. Parkside has allowed us to grow our patience, understanding, and love for each other exponentially. Pastor Jason, John Baughman, and Nii Abrahams (as well as each individuals significant other) have made the transitional process incredibly easy, you’re brought in with warm smiles and a sense of community; and if you’re like me, new environments are often scary and acclimating to a different environment is often very difficult, but not here. We love Parkside and will always recommend anyone come join!

name: Parkside Community Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
I love being a part of the Parkside family. Parkside is a special place where my kids can grow up knowing they are loved by God no matter what, surrounded by a diverse and loving congregation that truly lives out its progressive Christian mission, deeply rooted in social justice. All truly are welcome here. 🏳️‍🌈🏳️‍⚧️✝️☮️💟💒 Parkside Community Church is an inviting, progressive and justice-minded place of worship. It is truly a great and welcoming experience no matter who you are or where you come from!

Even though we moved out of the Sacramento area recently, we can still enjoy their sermons online and remain connected to the community.

I highly recommend Parkside Community Church! I can’t say I know much about this church however what I can say is everyone I have met that is apart of it, are some of the nicest people I have ever come across and very kind as well! It’s a inviting feeling to be treated with such kindness in just a normal conversation now n days!! A progressive, social justice, oriented congregation, where all are welcome. A great place for evangelical refugees to free themselves of the evangelical box and renew their faith in a open loving of all God. Parkside is an open, welcoming, loving community where everyone is supported in their own spiritual journey, even when the way feels dark and hard.

name: Parkview Christian Church - Orland Park
reviewSummary: Great, great non-denominational Christian Church where I both serve and attend.  From the moment you walk in,  you feel good inside and welcome.  The Music, Sermons, Staff and Volunteers are all wonderful.  The Lord is working here and it feels just right... My wife and I have been going to Parkview for well over 15 years now and so grateful that a close friend invited us to attend. We’ve never felt more connected to GOD in our lives and our (now)adult children feel the same way. Still one of the best churches I’ve ever been to even though I did move away used to be a member of the Lockport campus when Pastor Brian was there he left however and then we moved out of town so have not been able to find a Church home that I’ve been comfortable with since I left Parkview Orland Park and Lockport. If I could drive, I would take the trip to Orland Park every week lol it really is a great place. Can’t go wrong. Come here to hear about Jesus and be comfortable. Some people say “church shouldn’t make you be happy.” Parkview disagrees. We have a lot to celebrate and for which to be thankful. I like sitting in the cafe and listening to the message. They treat it like being in the service, they’ll pass you the Eucharist and lots of TVs and sound up loud enough. Church in the cafe for the win. Pastor Tim for the win. Pastor Todd, Casey for the win. See you later. Welcoming people and plenty of seating. Lively Christian music and awesome sermons by both campus and visiting pastors.

name: Parkview Church - Lawrenceville Campus
reviewSummary: Warm and welcoming church. They are open to the community and always have lots going on. Church members are so kind and supportive to the Girl & Boy Scout Troops that use the facility! Beautiful school and lovely classrooms. It was a wonderful staple in the Lilburn community. A close-knit family of Believers, dedicated to the truths of Scripture and passionate about the good news of the Gospel! We came because of friends and stayed because of the authenticity. I am so thankful that my children have the opportunity to grow up in this church. I attended this church for the first time last Sunday and left wishing I could return (I belong to and attend a different church in north Atlanta).  Parkview places a high importance on the Bible and value the supremacy of Christ.  The people there were friendly and loving.  It can always be awkward visiting a church for the first time but it wasn't so here at all.  We felt right at home with the emphasis on grace, the gospel,  and teaching the truth of the Bible. Via announcement it was also encouraging to see the church involved in their own community and around the globe. The church is also easy to find. The Bible is preached here! Nice, grace-filled worship. No politics. Lots of love.

name: Parkview United Church of Christ
reviewSummary:
Our family started attending Parkview in 1985 when our first child was a year old. This was a great place to raise a family, and now that we are retired, we continue to love this church. I’m so proud of our welcoming and inclusive congregation … we don’t just SAY we are inclusive, we PRACTICE it. We are a progressive Christian church. My journey with Christianity has gone through phases, but my love for this church and its people has never faltered. If you are looking for a place where all are welcome and where we “practice what we preach,” this is the place for you. Also, if you’re looking for a great church choir, we’d love to have you … no auditions required. For a relatively small church, our music program is awesome! I like Parkview UCC for the Sunday worship service that is thought-provoking and meaningful to my life, the wonderful music program, and the many opportunities to do good works in the surrounding community and beyond. My first visit to Parkview was in 1980 when I was invited by a friend. I felt welcomed by everyone immediately and made friends quickly. My husband and I were married at Parkview and we’ve held a combined 28 volunteer positions over the years.

I have always felt that Parkview is my extended family and I have been very grateful to be part of this welcoming and positive congregation. I have enjoyed all the new programs, new members, and ways that we can show others how much we have to offer and how we worship God together! We are so thankful to have found a church that we can openly be who we are and truly feel wanted, welcomed, and loved by everyone there. Unfortunately there are so many in the LGBT community that have not been able to find acceptance. My family joined Parkview Church in 2018 after looking at several other churches in the area.  We decided to stay at Parkview after our first visit because of the warm welcome we received.  We love the relatable sermons, the outreach opportunities available and the kids programming.  This church feels like an extended family to us.  They consistently show acceptance and support for one another and the community.

name: Parkway Community Church - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful church. A warm and friendly atmosphere. Great worship, sound teaching and loving people. It feels like family. My family attends here.
In many years, I have been two or 3 times.  Good mix of ages.
There were late retirees to young kids in attendance.  Plenty of room to sit, but pretty full at the same tune.
A good sign of a healthy church was that it took more than 30 minutes for the sanctuary to clear out.
The Bible was taught accurately. The
message this time was topical according to a study theme, but remained primarily rooted in one source while referring to other scripture.
Good music. Young and old alike could enjoy.
If I were local, I would probably be a regular here.
Loved the community feel. Wow visited this church on Sunday January 5th 2025…beautiful church welcoming, clean, and safe…the music highest quality … Pastor Adam prepped the hot water greeting warmly in lobby prior to 11:00 service what a beautiful expression of servant love AMEN!!!  Pastor Adam gave an amazing sermon - so relatable the journey of David to the throne, while under pursuit of Saul with support from Saul’s son Jonathan, providing support in the name of God For David from whom ultimately our savior Jesus Christ was conceived and born…POWERFUL excellent experience highly recommend the Holy Spirit is at work AMEN most highly recommend Bible based and so relatable to our lives now and how we are indeed in His grip in all circumstances…alpha and omega..the way the truth and life AMEN What a FANTASTIC PLACE!  Welcoming, genuine, sincere, caring, and completely Christ centered.  Parkway Community Church enables people to grow closer to God at their own pace and has numerous resources available to help you in your own walk.  Dan, the Teaching Pastor, is a remarkable communicator who is able to make such a complicated book seem so simple.  He's a magnificent story teller.  You're gonna love it there!  Come and join us. If you are like me, you like a church that speaks the name of Jesus but doesn't come off pretentious.  If you like a church that can laugh at itself and at the same time make much of Jesus then you have found the right place.

Good sound doctrine and a community that cares for others.

name: Parkway Fellowship - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family loves the community of believers that God has assembled at the North Campus! Pastor Adam always brings a powerful message that is relevant & applicable for us where we are in life.

Our kids greatly enjoy the AWESOME students ministry led by Pastor Rusty Pregeant & the kids ministry led by our Childrens Pastor, Pam Day.

There’s always a smile, handshake or hug to greet you & the treats (donuts & coffee) are AMAZING!

Our family loves doing life at this church! Pastor Adam always delivers an amazing message.  He's always ready to meet and greet everyone making you feel welcomed.  The worship team is unbelievably talented 🙌 The team here give a great service and bring the Bible to life for us. We leave here feeling guided and loved. Parkway Fellowship North Katy has been our church home for the last 3 years. From the first time we visited after being invited by friends, we knew it was the place for us! Everyone is so welcoming, they make you feel like they already knew you before you even walked in the door. It has been easy to plug in and get involved, which was something that was super important to us. Every message preached resonates with each of us in some way. I love the way Pastor Adam is able to preach the bible in a relatable way. If you have kiddos, the kids and student ministry is INCREDIBLE. Both of our children plugged in right away and actually enjoy going to church. It could be the free donuts... but I think it's mostly the friends they have made, and the amazing staff that leads them. If you are looking for a church home in Katy, come check it out! Hot coffee, free donuts, warm welcomes and smiles every Sunday. I joined PF Nov 2011 & rarely missed a Sunday until we moved to Florida in 2018.  I still attend online every Sunday.  Pastor Mike & his wife Amy are the most kind & loving people ever.  The weekly message will truly speak to your heart & give you a blueprint on living a better Christ-filled life throughout the week.  The contemporary Christian music team is the best and will lift you up.

name: Parroquia Nta.Sra.De La Esperanza - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: Whatever event they have going on with the loud music is excessive! I live blocks away and have to be up very early and their music is still blaring at after 11pm! How is this being a good neighbor..or even legal? Great place to pray, Baptized, Communion, Confirmation.... Very beautiful churches, very friendly and organized staff, and a very nice choir. I love going every Sunday and enjoying the very well-organized mass; with live music, there's a lot of harmony. We need more information about the times for Masses in Spanish. Thank you.

name: Pasadena Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful church with beautiful morals and people. Very diverse, friendly, and open to many. The head pastor Kerwin Manning is such a force in the community. Reaches out in any way that is needed and is personable. Please visit and see for yourself. A review system for a church shouldn’t be where you get your answers for “best church”. Evil literally can tell you not to go to the right church for you. See if this is your tribe! I arrived at Pasadena Church few years ago, suffering from alcoholism/pill addiction and all kinds of negative feelings towards life
To my pleasant surprise, l found a JEWEL  of a Church    in Pasadena,
I was WELCOME with open arms (prior to covid)
Found a LOVING Congregation that is very much involved
in serving our community.
At Pasadena Church (404 E. Washinton Blvd)                                                  From Pastors Kerwing & Pastor Madelyn Manning,
I learned about a loving & caring God, l matter to him because: "l am a child of God"                                         Today with God in my life, l have peace of mind and     JOY in my heart. Thanks to Pasadena Church🙏💗

Il I Love and miss this church Everyone is awesome  And true loving kind people Pastor's Kerwin and Madeline Manning are very awesome people The most loving church I have been, real people doing real things. Wonderful teaching and a warm congregation!

name: Pasadena Church East Campus - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been a member of this church since 2017. This is also when I moved back to Dena. When I came back, I got involved with a housing justice group. The workshop for this housing justice group took place at the West campus of this church. That was my first experience with Pasadena Church, social justice. The church was hosting this workshop. “Interesting,” I thought.

When I became a member of the housing justice group, which wasn’t connected to the church, we would go to City Council meetings to fight for more ADUs, affordable and permanent supportive housing in our community. Pastor Kerwin and members of Pasadena Church would be there. “Interesting,” I thought.

When our group would meet with the Dept of Housing, again, members of Pasadena Church would be there.

I finally decided to visit this church that was so active in community matters. When I did, I learned that Pastors Kerwin and Madelyn just recently lost their precious daughter, Morgan.

They were transparent with their grief. It was a beautiful service with so much love it made sense that the same love I felt, would be overflowing to their community.

I was shook witnessing the amount of faith these pastors would have to be able to continue worshiping, serving their community, receiving support and giving through what had to be one of the darkest seasons of their lives.

I walked away from that service convinced that this was a church that didn’t just preach the gospel but lived it. While there is no such thing as a “perfect” church, this church had been perfect for me. Really disappointed that this Church in Pasadena is afraid of people standing in the public area with cameras. They will violate your rights and call the police on you! Be careful… I have nothing but positive things to say about the leadership and membership of Pasadena Church. I'm not sure what happened with the other 1-star reviewers and the photogate incident. But I can say  that as a complete stranger to this congregation, I have been welcomed hospitably by leaders and attenders alike for the 3 times that I visited. More importantly, the Words of Jesus are in focus, and Holy Spirit moves freely. Oh, and this church is more active serving the local community than most. Having attended a wide range of congregations my entire life, I highly recommend this one. Friendly,welcoming atmosphere my Daughter-in-law and I attended Easter service here it was a packed out service! We were given a special gift bag for being a first time guest 🫶🏼They have a wonderful play area for kids and had cotton candy and a scrumptious strawberry 🍓 desert This church is full of hypocrites. They get to practice freedom of religion under the constitution but when someone is practicing the same amendment to take pictures in public on a public sidewalk they call the cops, lie and try and get the people taking pictures put in jail. Total hypocrites. Shameful and disgusting hypocrites.

name: Pasadena Covenant Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I've been a member of this Church for over five years now, the longest I've ever been at any house of worship, and it's now my home. This place is on fire for the Lord!!!  Thank you so much for all that you do.  We really appreciate your efforts and the amazing results that follow.  You exhibit an undying faith and spread it like wildfire.  God bless all of you. Selah Gospel Choir concerts are held here twice a year! This church is fantastic! Great community and always very welcoming. Volunteer here.

name: Pasadena Methodist Foundation - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church! And very animated and friendly people.👍

name: Pasadena Orthodox Presbyterian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Grateful to be part of a church that stays grounded in truth. The teaching is deeply biblical, the pastor leads with clarity and humility, and the congregation is genuinely warm and welcoming.

A place where faith is not just felt, but rooted in God’s Word. If you are looking for a faithful church in the tradition of Reformed Christianity with an historically-grounded Protestant liturgy, a Christ-centered pulpit ministry, weekly celebration of the Lord's Supper, and a faithful community of believers, look no further than Pasadena Orthodox Presebterian Church. Pastor Cotta is wonderful teacher who breaks down the Word of God. The congregation was welcoming and I'm glad we visited the church We visit this church whenever we are in the Pasadena area. Solid reformed worship, teaching and preaching. Hymns and psalms are sung. The facility is nicely situated in a quiet residential area with convenient access to the interstate. Loving congregation and well prepared sermons.  The most hard working pastor I have ever seen.

name: Pasadena Presbyterian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Enjoy Free Noon Concerts on Wednesdays 🎈 Sacred place. It is always clean outside. Great location. Beautiful architecture. The church has signs that say “no sleeping on church property.” What is the point of a church, if not to help those in need? Take the signs down and practice what you preach. It's a beautiful church with amazing musicians and music programs.  Children's choir will melt your heart and the pipe organ stir your soul.
It can be a bit elitist and judgmental, very old school, however, and sermons a bit too safe and dry.  Needs more presence of the Holy Spirit with the ministry for new generations to attend. John 4:23-24
There's not enough Jesus' love.  I served here and only mail/contacts I got is after making donation.  Not the type of church where people will visit you at the hospital. They are also labeled Presbyterian but they do not follow some of the guidelines for it. I won't get into details here and hope God leads them to the right path.
Ephesians 2:8-10
Exodus 20:16 An absolutely beautiful church with some great Music at Noon on Wednesdays 😉

name: Paseo del Rey Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: One of the congregants made a threat against my mother when he asked about my parent's marital status; he wanted to harassed my mother when she discovered she divorced my dad.  This church requires that its members not come from divorced couples.  That congregants threatened to find out where my mom lived and get the truth out of her. We are so grateful to Paseo del Rey Church and to Pastor Shelton Markham and his amazing team.  Our grandmother was a member of the church before she passed and couldn't say enough good things about the programming and leadership.  We hosted her celebration of life service at the church this past weekend and from start to finish the church staff and leaders were wonderful and accommodating.  We are lucky to have a church like this in our community. Been trying out different churches with my family in search of a church home. Will never come back to this church. First impression walking in was somewhat welcome. Two women engaged in conversation seemed taken aback at our presence and barely responded when I said good morning. Another man was very kind, inquiring if I needed to check my younger kids into Sunday school which I politely declined. The biggest problem was in service. We arrived a little late and upon entering realized the sermon had not yet started and was relieved because I didn’t want to miss anything instead they were recounting a recent trip they had taken. Both pastors while retelling  their experience during an African mission trip made several very offensive and microagressive comments. The most notable ones pertaining to a photo of some of the African pastors and whether they were holding up gang signs, which the entire congregation thought was funny, and other comments regarding the intellectual abilities of the African pastors and how “surprised”  and they were that “they were bright they had just never been taught.” In the current climate of the United States it’s imperative that we as Christian help end the divide. I come from a very diverse background I’ve been to many different churches diverse and non- diverse I have never experienced something like this in a church. I sat with my children and felt so hurt and offended while my husband is away serving his country that these are issues still facing our country. Especially, in a church setting where people are supposed to come and feel welcome. Both of these pastors need to have some training on microaggression. We will never return to this church. Thank you Lucy and John for introducing yourself to my family, but the damage was already done by then. One of our favorite places to visit when we are in town! So grateful for the welcome everyone receives when they come. It’s Jesus’ love! My brothers and sisters in Christ worship here. Is any church perfect? No. However, I believe this community intentionally pursues relationship with the Lord and service to each other and the community. We have been attending here for a decade - relevant, bible-based sermons, music from a gifted husband and wife team, and a warm, inviting congregation. There are lots of ways to get involved, both with small groups, and with service opportunities. This church has really made a difference in our faith and with our relationships.

name: Passage Church - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary:
Passage Church is a place you can truly call home. It is a Spirit-led church that dives deep into the Word of God and is passionate about seeing lives transformed as people discover and walk in the purpose God has planned for each one of them. Passage Church is a welcoming group of people of all ages and backgrounds. If you are looking for a place where you matter, this is it. The worship is inspiring and the presence of God is palpable, come and experience it. I am so grateful to have found a place where people are focused in their relationship with God, and this translates into kindness towards each other. There is also a fantastic youth ministry with a lot of middle and high schoolers that are not following the crowd, but instead are leading others to do better. Its very cool. I was saddened to hear Pastor Bridgett sermon.   I missed her sermon because she has a demon of speaking so fast her message doesn't get to the people.     When I watched at home., she can out speak the closed caption.   Leaving people to not hear her sermon.            I am not wanting to be mean.
She needs to go to a speech therapist to learn to slow down for us listening.   I know the Holy Spirit can be exciting.   I have felt the Holy Spirit.         But how can Pastor Bridgett feed the sheep if they can't follow her?        May Jesus guide your decision.   I truly would like to hear what is in your heart about Jesus. Love this church!
Great singles ministry and community.
Come join us! I Love Passage Church. I don't live in Fort Worth Texas anymore. I live in Tucson, Arizona. So grateful I can watch it online. I love pastor James and Bridgett! Worship is excellent! Praise The Lord! When I get back to Texas, I definitely will be attending in person! Bless you All!!!!

name: PASSAGE Family Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor George Dix preaches from the God's Holy Bible only, nothing added and nothing taken away.  Nothing sugar coated, pure gospel teaching, study the word of God people. Great Kingdom Man of GOD. Great Kingdom Family foundation. Get on board & let’s ALL Slay demons until Jesus comes back. 🙏🏾 Amen I have never physically attended but listen often on the radio ministry and I can testify by the word I am hearing that it is Holy Spirit led. I have been blessed significantly each and every time I listen. Not only is the word of God incredibly powerful but hearing it taught, explained and broken down reminds you of Hebrews 4:13 “For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double edged sword, it penetrates even dividing soul and spirit and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart. Listening to this radio ministry every single time is an uplifter, and encouragement, a faith reminder and supporter. I would love to come visit one day. I’m a listener on the Gulf Coast and I send blessings to your church and your ministry. May God continue to grow your ministry and have favor on all that your body of believers touches in Jesus Name! Love Love Love... Purely God's Love and Purpose in this Sanctuary! The Holy Spirit dwells here. Pastor George Dix and Lady Michele are Awesome at taking and sharing the love of God in Spirit and Truth. Also It's so Beautiful and Clean. Make sure you visit, you'll leave forever changed! A great place to worship! The spirit of the Lord dwells there and the people are friendly.

name: Passion Bread of Life Christian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve only started first time coming recently by recommendation of my friend who had always prayed for me upon my emergency requests when she came to my working place, a dental office. The first night I came here I received revelation regarding my own family! I am continuously being fueled with hope, joy(!) , AND peace because of the daily morning online scripture memorization + reading prayers. I come because it’s in Bilingual Chinese AND English, because there are SO MANY CHINESE people across the world who still needs to find hope, peace AND JOY(!) I LOVE THE WORD TAUGHT TO ME DAILY!!! I wish all Chinese Mandarin speakers would be here to find what I find: HOPE, peace AND JOY! I experience Blessings every time when I come in here! Worship team is awesome! I come here to receive healings! Thank you Jesus 🙏🙏🙏 Friendly, mainly Chinese Mandarin speaking English service is for youngsters Great Church according to my friend Felix. Would love to go here sometime Great Chinese church with lively worship and English children and youth program.

name: Passion Church - Montgomery - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: I do feel the preacher preaches great sermons however we all have had salty experience even with the best churches I need to share mine to heal n move on. This church was somehow my final straw with churches I've attended this church for 7+ years n someway I just couldn't get it right so I reached out to several of the so call got it together members n got my heart spirit n soul destroyed.i reached out for spiritual help n I felt robbed with out a gun.this church made me feel if u wasn't a Christian with money u wasn't good enough for this church I was lied to n deceived. N when I reached out to pastor Kim I felt like a joke to their congregations so I gave up on church but god didn't give up on me..I gave up on me i got weiry with my walk. Not a lot passion for the broken or broke😂seriously tho god is now showing me to put my trust in him not a building or the servants in it that's y I believe I didn't have such a great experience cause I was looking for help in the wrong direction...I was angry disappointed n even questioned was my belief fact or fiction now I just know better that I was seeking help from flesh n blood like myself instead of the Almighty power of Jesus.. although I'm not where I want to be (in the valley) I'm where I need to be this season so thank God for grace n mercy as well as revelation.. The Word of God is taught here. Prayer for God's Will to be done in the lives of all according to His Word. Family of believers who love God, seek His face and Will and serve in whatever way He asks. A body of believers that truly worship God. A pastor that brings the Word in plan talk .We have a "passion" for reaching the lost and helping those seeking answers in finding Jesus and the Father ! Awesome  praise and worship, a place were you can get connected and grow spiritually. The people are genuine, loving, and compassionate. I have attended for my years and love it.

name: Passion Church Tucson - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
Lots of parking in the front and back and side. Plenty of room in the church and they served coffee and donuts so it's a win- win. the song service was really really good the pastor taught and it was not very long it was just right This is a church with solid teaching with a very balanced Biblical perspective. I have been going to it for several months, and am enjoying getting to know others - older and younger - through Bible studies and chatting after service. The new worship leader is enthusiastic, and encourages everyone to enter into the presence of God with their whole heart. Definitely worth a visit, if you’re in the area! Mr.Narcia&Mr.Narcia
Have been ina dedicated relationship since 11/14/2024
During that time we were harrased , targeted ,
Sons Nathan ayon was & Biological brother were kidnapped from their own apartment shot at missing Fbi report was made .. From the moment I stepped into the Church, I was greeted, and welcomed! I highly recommend this Church to anyone looking for a new Church home; especially for young families looking to grow in their relationship with Jesus Passion church is where we laugh, worship and hug our amazing extended family every week while the presence of God saturates our hearts and heals our souls and bodies again and again... come check it out  ;-)

name: Passion City Church
reviewSummary: Founded by Louie Giglio, known for the Passion Conference. The vibe is 'Intellectual' yet deeply 'Passionate'. Worship is world-class. Attracts a massive young adult and professional demographic in Atlanta.

name: Passion City Church - 515
Passion City Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: Passion City Church has been a place where I’ve genuinely encountered God, not just in moments, but in a way that carries into everyday life. The worship is powerful yet authentic, and the messages don’t just inspire, they challenge you to grow and live with intention. There’s a real sense of purpose in the room, where faith becomes something active, not passive. It’s more than attending a service; it’s stepping into a community that calls you forward to live for Jesus every day. A wonderful and welcoming place. The community is incredibly kind, and the atmosphere is filled with peace and love. 😌 Highly recommend if you are looking for a spiritual home.☺️ My favorite church is a place where people of all races can attend comfortably. The teachings focus solely on Jesus, and there are many opportunities for Bible study. It also offers various programs tailored to different age groups. This is the church I love the most.❤️ Their worship and gathering was a blessing to me while traveling in Atlanta twice. I look forward to returning when I'm in town again! Their children/kids ministry and security is top-notch, too. The traffic and parking are definitely worth it! I love Passion so much and I’ve been attending their service every Sunday!!! The worship is absolutely uplifting, the preaches from Pastor Louie are inspiring and they have very diverse program such as Bloom, Grove etc. I encourage everyone to check it out!

name: Passion City Church Cumberland - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I enjoyed the services for the most part & my daughter loves attending kids’ church here, but a big part of the reason I decided to go back to church is for community. I attended services regularly for 2 months & didn’t meet a single person. Email responses are very slow if you get one at all. And finally - if I wanted to watch a service on a screen, I would stay home. This church came highly recommended, but is not quite what I’m looking for unfortunately :/
I attended one service at a smaller church in Smyrna, and spent an hour after getting to meet all the church leaders & learn more about their beliefs (because they came & introduced themselves & took a genuine interest in new members). My first experience was September 30, 2025. They had a new event called day of prayer. A buddy of mine and I decided to go and check it out. It was a very ethereal experience. Even the lighting was perfect. I may come back for actual services just with the positiveaspects of my first experience. Every detail of the service reflects a high level of intentionality. The lobby is welcoming and the coffee is a nice touch, but the depth of the biblical teaching is what keeps us coming back. It’s a wonderful place for anyone seeking a God-focused community. Great place to hear Gods word! Came here due to work training in Atlanta! It’s a great atmosphere and great message. The church was everything I needed and now I have extended family! Passion City is already a wonderful church, but the Cumberland location is beautiful and welcoming. Our daughter goes to the bloom program while we attend regular services, and we always feel so happy and safe dropping her off. All the pastors, and all the staff and volunteers are wonderful and make you feel welcome from the moment you arrive.

name: Passion City Church D.C. - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: In DC for spring break, decided to attend Passion City DC because Ben Stuart has been a guest preacher at our home church, SECC in Louisville, KY.   The Easter service was tremendous, I could feel the Spirit in the room from the moment we arrived.  Worship music was awesome, sermon was awesome, all the people were friendly.   I am thankful for GODs Kingdom and how GOD made a way.  Happy Easter It was a great service, but the pastor could have went much deeper into the Word of God and not just speaking the basics of the Gospel. People need to hear about sin and the seriousness of God's judgment on people who won't repent but continue to live in their sinful lifestyle. I have been coming here for over a year now. I had tried to find a new church once I moved here from SC, but couldn’t find the right fit until Passion City. Everyone is so friendly and I love the music. It’s very similar to my church back home. I also enjoy listening to Pastor Ben and his teachings. I’ve also had the opportunity to attend some neighborhood nights. This church is highly involved in the community and I feel welcomed. Going to church here is like attending an awesome rock concert for Jesus! It has the feel of a Mega Church. It’s a lot of age 35 and younger, but being 45+ we felt welcomed too! Pastor Ben has a relatable message about the Bible and real life, he’s a little funny too! Lots of small groups and opportunities to worship, community service and connect! They make it a point to invite and not just post in bulletin. Parking is city streets. Very vibrant, large congregation that trends younger, (though not exclusively); the majority of attendees are probably in the 18-35 demographic. This church helped me reconnect with my faith after many years away. It is a non-denominational church that avoids many of the pitfalls and criticisms that other non-denominational churches may fall into. The preaching (from multiple members of staff) is all-around superior. The preaching is a good mix of intellectual and emotional. It's accessible to those who may come in with questions or a lack of familiarity with a church setting. Music is good.

name: Passion City Church Trilith - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
Really? No coffee in the morning? Coffee is a highly affordable beverage. Also no morning snacks of ANY kind. Don't come here if you're hungry, or need a hold of caffeine, prior to church service. This is the South. We are supposed to have stellar hospitality. Aside from that, the music here for praise and worship is one of the best! It's right next to Restoration Church Alpharetta, GA in terms of praise and worship quality (The Well young adult service). There's one major downside though. It's that the music in here is sooooooo loud. My internal organs are shaking and I'm sitting in the very back right corner of the place. The people are friendly and the sermons are always relevant. Very welcoming and Jesus centered church. Although it’s big it feels like a family.
Amazing church! This isn’t church — it’s theater in a warehouse. Passion City Trilith is just another satellite pushing the same glossy production: fog machines, countdown clocks, trendy lights, and motivational soundbites that stir emotions for a night but never transform hearts.

They tout global missions while the brokenness right down the street goes untouched. They align with whatever is culturally “cool” in the moment to stay safe, even if it means softening truth and silencing conviction.

Jesus already removed the middlemen. Through His resurrection we have direct access to God. Real power, real freedom. You don’t need stage lights and self-help sermons when the Gospel itself is alive.

Scripture warned of false prophets who draw numbers but don’t build disciples. This is exactly that: a production team with a Bible as a prop. Numbers are not discipleship, and performance is not the Gospel.

---Apex Wow. The Spirit is moving at Passion Trilith. So thankful we came to a service yesterday during our weekend visit from Ohio. My kids(8 & 6) loved their time in Passion Kids, especially the tents and worship band coming in to sing. We all can’t wait to return. Thank you for welcoming us to experience Jesus with y’all🤍 A wonderful Church tied to a great organization Passion City Church!
The senior pastor Louie Giglio has so much love and willingness to teach us the Word. Pastor Dan Watson is so committed to his faith and he shares it with us very richly.

name: Passion Life Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Is true when I say that the presence of our Lord Jesus is in every single inch of this church no way that anyone could fall asleep at this church honestly left me wanting more . I will definitely go back, the coffee shop is excellent 👌 top notch. Praise the Lord . Hope to see you there. I had been looking for a church to call home for the past 11 years since I moved to California and stumbled across Passion Life Church on Easter in 2023. I immediately felt welcomed and a sense of community. My kids really enjoyed the kids ministry as well, so we kept coming back.

Pastor Phil is very relatable and delivers God's word in a way that people can understand it in today's day and age. His wife Val and Ms Elsa are amazing with the kiddos and I have seen my kids grow in their faith as well since we have been attending!

If you haven't given Passion Life a try you definitely should! Passion Life Church is a great church and is Spirit-filled.  Pastor Phil preaches the Word in a manner that is relevant and always true to God's Word.  I recommend this church for new believers and those that have been walking with the Lord for years you will always continue to learn here. Passion Life Church is the kind of church that helps one grow in their faith in God! Pastor Phil is very consistent when it comes to making one laugh and feel loved all at the same time when preaching to the congregation. If I could go every Sunday, I would, but I live out of town! I am so Blessed to be part of Passion Life Church.
I've been attending since the week after they opened
their doors in January 2013.

I love my church because the presence of the
Holy Spirit is always felt there. It is a faith
filled and Bible based church. You can't ask for
a better preaching pastor than Pastor Phil. When
I first went to Passion Life Church It was like enrolling
at a Bible School, he explains the word of God in a way
that it's easy to understand. Also he has a great sense
of humor.

The church is very welcoming, and the people
are very loving and caring. I felt right at home
the first day and through the years I have met so many
awesome friends. I have enjoyed the life groups, their
outdoor events, and many other events.

Pastor Phil's Wife Valerie is involved with the children's
classes. She is awesome and on Sundays you can see the
children are excited to attend her bible teaching class,
especially my granddaughter when she is visiting me.

There are Volunteers like Ines and Maggie, who
enjoy watching the babies while their parents are
enjoying the worship service and the awesome sermon.

I am praying that the pandemic will be over as soon as
possible.  Please be safe everyone. God Bless You.

name: Passion-Life Church McDonough - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary: Since I relocated to Georgia and rededicated my life back to Christ, I had been looking for a church that has sound biblical teaching and that would stretch me. For I am not satisfied with motivational messages but I desire to hear the unadulterated truth accompanied by demonstration. In other words, I want to attend a church that does what Jesus did so I can be strengthened to do the same. One night, I was strolling Facebook and saw Pastor Brandy opening a service at Passion Life. The love of God was beaming off of her through the phone. I continued to listen to Pastor Terrell preach God’s Word with power, clarity & truth. I visit that following Sunday and I was not disappointed! I got confirmation for what God was speaking to me in my secret place which was and is important to me. Passion Life Church is a body of believers who are passionate about God and people. I am grateful to be apart!! My faith has never been stronger since discovering this church. True lovers of Christ and followers of the Bible. God bless! Passion life church is a Holy Ghost filled church.  If you want the word and the truth, Passion life church is the answer. Best church EVER! True followers of the Way. They DO what Jesus did. Come on over and let the man of god cast out demons from your life that’s holding you back in Jesus mighty name amen and amen..

name: Pastor Jack Hibbs - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m leaving this review to share a serious concern for anyone considering attending this church or engaging with this pastor’s ministry.

In a recent Instagram video, the pastor said the following:

“God wants His people to be unmoved by the headlines of the news....If you don’t get rooted and grounded in understanding through a Biblical worldview, prophetic worldview, lens of the news that’s around you, if you don’t get that down, you’re going to turn into a crazy lunatic that’s out on the streets in Minnesota crying.”

Hearing a pastor speak this way, mocking and dismissing people who are genuinely scared, was deeply disturbing. Many people in Minnesota are experiencing real fear and trauma related to the current immigration climate. These are not just “headlines” to them; these are their lives, families, and communities.

Faith in God does not stop bad things from happening, and it does not justify belittling people who are afraid or grieving. What stood out to me was not compassion or spiritual leadership, but a lack of empathy toward people who are suffering.

I believe people deserve to know the tone, values, and character they may encounter before placing their trust in a pastor or church. My wife and I  love Pastor Jack! We watch him live on youtube Sunday mornings and Wednesday nights. The Bible is taught line by line in an interesting way that is understandable to regular people. Keep up the good work Jack Hibbs. Love, Pastor Jack Hibbs. I tell everybody about him. He makes learning about the Bible so interesting and easy to understand and how having a personal relationship with Jesus is the most important thing in your life you can do and have.  Thank you for spreading God's word. Cindy from Michigan I listened to a radio show and was dis-hearted that he would twist Bible verse to put control on women, Mary Magdalene was the first person that Jesus went to when he was resurrected and to show we are all equal in his eyes, but then centuries later all but a handful of apostles are credited and used in the New Testament the hypocrisy and Jesus knows this.. As an outsider to this great church, I watch on YouTube and other media outlets and I am very pleased with what seems to be correct teaching/preaching. I hope I have the opportunity to visit some day (as I live in Shepparton, Victoria, Australia). As a christian historian I value the accuracy in "Spiritual Information." Thank you to all the staff at Calvary Chapel and all those who support this great Ministry.

name: Pathway Christian Church - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a friendly bible based Christian Church with a casual, relaxed, and family atmosphere.
They offer two  Sunday morning services and Wednesday night service. In addition they have Celebrate  Recovery program every Friday night. I’ve already heard very upsetting and disappointing things about this church. My lovely mom who is the most wonderful and sweetest person in the world. Decided to try out this church for the first time today and not one person spoke to her or said anything to her when she walked in. She showed up early because she wanted to see how the woman’s group was and no one directed her in the way of that. They walked past her like she wasn’t even there. She went in her car waited to see if maybe she was too early went back in there and still no one spoke to her. Church is supposed to be a welcoming place where everyone feels welcome and free and this place was the total opposite and made her feel very uncomfortable and unwanted. Edited years later: I'm still learning 47 years into faith in Christ. One of many good things about Pathway are they don't teach the nonsense of dispensationalism.  Also,
maybe we do need to be water baptized for salvation. Why would someone who is following Christ refuse to get baptized ? Old post: I went to Pathway for about 17 years. A lot of fond memories. I love the people there but I didn't know that their doctrine included a belief that we must be water baptized to be saved. That's why I stopped going to the Sunday morning service and their Wednesday evening Bible study. They do have a great Celebrate Recovery on Friday evening that I've been going to since 2006. This church was so welcoming and friendly even before we entered the doors.  They are eager to welcome you to their church.  The worship service was wonderful.  We went to the 10:45 service and the music and message were great.  We were just visiting for the day since we live in Washington, but our teenage girls all commented that if we ever moved to California, they would want to attend this church.  Keep doing what you're doing and I pray that the Spirit of God continues to move through your church and you continue to grow the Kingdom through your ministries. This church is amazing!!! I love attending CR on Friday nights and Worship Service on Sundays. They offer different services during the week like Zoom-hosted Bible study on Tuesday nights and in-person Bible study on Wednesdays, along with times available for people who want to just come and pray!! All of the staff are caring and kind people!!

name: Pathway Church - Churches In Redding CA - Redding Campus
reviewSummary:
The best expository preaching (from God word- verse by verse) with illuminating exegesis, that you will find, perhaps in the entire continent United States or Online. And I only say that because of visible and tangible fruit, of the Church families work of their hands, and faithful preaching of the Good News to hurting people in a “morally broken pain-machine” of a world (as I learned from attending). I have ALWAYS been blessed by attending; literally. Blessed to hear the Gospel that saves, preached. Blessed to be seen, at one of the best Men’s Bible studies I have ever attended (and I loved attending BSF International for years). Blessed to see and hear, many more than I could count, be saved and baptized into Gods family. Blessed to learn and believe that I am “richly, blessed, highly favored and deeply loved”, in Christ Jesus. And blessed before I leave, EVERY-TIME, that “as you go through your week, Remember, that you have a great God, the joy of the Lord IS your strength, and He is with you every step that you take!” Amen.

Thank you Church, Pastor and Family; you truly are “comely, perfect and without spot or blemish”. Thank you for blessing my hometown that has blessed me so richly. The Lord bless you and keep you! Great seating beautiful worship enjoyable Pastors informative lessons, coffee shop on site, beautiful decor great for taking photos, child care available, lots of other events and activities throughout the month and week besides just Sunday morning, such as Celebrate Recovery, great lighting, the Christmas service was wonderful I'd recommend them to all of my friends and family. Polite and welcoming staff always greeting you with a smile. Great for all ages. Spread the word. Have you heard the good news? It takes a LOT for me to leave bad reviews.  My heart broke today when I found out this church turned away my friend and her beautiful family on Easter Sunday, stating that they were “too full” which was simply not true.  They racially profiled her family and turned them away.  I have so many things to say but I’ll just leave this here. I would want to know if my church did this. So far so good. We (Husband and I) attended online for a few weeks to make sure our beliefs lined up with what was being taught. This is our 3rd week attending in person with a TK age child and a young adult. Christmas concert, way over loud electric music enough to damage children’s ears, no baby Jesus but soldiers, cowboys and line dancing. Givi funeral Dontesk Ukraine are who those soldiers are fighting. Not sure why the cognitive dissonance is so strong to have soldiers and line dancing to country music and bonfire set up instead of telling the story of Christmas. Or traditional songs all the way through instead of 30 second break aparts of the songs reflecting the doom scroll or YouTube shorts attention span. Also text messages constantly part of the theme on the tv on the stage. Lots of holiday market set up with shopping, presents and travel bags too for their songs on stage. It’s so far off base. My 5yr old said wow they are worshiping themselves not the lord and I said yes I know, we will look for a better Christmas service, that was not right. Your phone is a black scrying mirror. The theme of the text for the Christmas show was aimed at conjuring feelings of sympathy for people choosing to go kill others in their home countries. Specifically for example the people singing the anthem of Russia in Crimea 2015 easily found videos on YouTube. How to say your church is a government entity without saying it is.

name: Pathway Church - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
The Holy Spirit defenitly dwells in Pathway!
Out of my own testimony moving from Houston this place continues to bring me the opportunies to not just grow but build relationships within the community that I never thought I would have had.

I will forver be greatful for the leadership. And welcoming crew

Thank You for everything Jesus❤️✝️ After a family member spoke so highly of this church, I decided to attend one Sunday. The first amazing message I heard from Pastor Ben assured me I was at the right place, and I have been attending ever since. The messages are consistently good and rooted in scripture. Pastor Ben and the greeters will greet you by name and go out of their way to make you feel welcomed. Can't forget the worship team - so full of talent. So thankful for Pathway!
Edit: Even after moving nearly an hour away, I still make the drive to Pathway each Sunday! I’ve been blessed with a church family and relationships with women of all ages. Connections and feeling supported means everything! Great place great people, and best of all I consider them family !!! Pastor Ben and Marc deliver such meaningful and spiritually-filling sermons that come right from God’s good word.  I’ve never come across a church as friendly and welcoming as this one.  I can’t wait to see what all God has in store for this place! I love the friendly atmosphere at Pathway. The people and Pastor Ben are very welcoming. I thoroughly enjoyed the message and the biblical foundation of this church. Will certainly be back!!!

name: Pathway Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: I've been visiting on and off for a couple months. Worship leaders are always  a sweet time praising the Lord. The teachings by Pastor Josh are exegitically sound. The church is kind, loving and mature. Great church with amazing pastors and staff! The wife and I visited for Easter Service. The worship service was amazing. The church building was very welcoming, and the congregation was very welcoming. I'll definitely be back looking for a new church. I am so thrilled we found this church. I had been going to a different one for years that was not a good fit. My husband, child and I were welcomed. The pastor was dynamic and the worship team rocked. The youth program is awesome. So happy to be joining this amazing church. Excellent place for worship and for  hearing the word of God.  Great worship music, playing songs by all the latest Christian contemporary artists.  The true word of God is preached here weekly and there are also small groups for anyone and everyone to get to know others more closely and get to know God more closely..  Check out Pathway Church, you'll be very glad that you did...  Services are 9:00 & 10:45 am each Sunday !

name: Pathway Church - Strongsville Campus
reviewSummary: Today was my first time visiting Pathway Church.  I was greeted immediately upon entering the front door!  I've never felt so welcomed at a church.  Everyone was extremely friendly.  I was invited to Wednesday night bible study.  The pastor's message was absolutely on point and biblically sound.  The worship music was beautiful.  At the end, the pastor led a prayer for all the prayer requests they had received from the church members.  They even handed me a welcome mug and pen on my way out.  INCREDIBLE EXPERIENCE. I am proud to call this my home church for 7 years now. The pastor is very accommodating and most importantly, non judgmental. He understands that people come from all walks of life and he is always there to help you. He is very rooted in the word and goes through the bible in a way that you can understand. We love Pathway Church. Super friendly place, good sound preaching. We are always glad we went and we come every time we are in town to visit family. Awesome pastor and people are welcoming great place to worship I had a very fun time helping out with VBS, the kids especially enjoyed the fun themes and learning about God. It was a fun and welcoming experience.

name: Pathway Church San Diego Assemblies of God - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone is very friendly and seems like one big family! Everything is very casual and has a comfortable feeling. The lighting and sound equipment is insane and worth a visit to see. They have great kids' classes that go on during the adult service which gives the parents a break for a little while. And the kids aren't just being babysat, but they are actually getting a Bible lesson made just for them and they get to play really fun games which is really cool. The pastor has new series every few weeks/months and helps the people there understand deeper concepts in the Bible while relating it to our everyday lives at the same time! And for the icing on the cake, this church focuses on reaching its community and offers free events all the time just for them! So to wrap up this review, this place is awesome and you should really check it out! So thankful for this place and all that they do not just for those in the church (as a place to belong, be encouraged & be challenged to grow in your relationship with Christ), but also for all that they do in and for the community! Community events from this church are the best! 🙌🏼 Pastor Bart & leadership serve behind the scenes more than any other leaders I’ve known... 10/10. 😊 Lester Aguilar

name: Pathway Community Church - Pleasanton Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place, wonderful people, inspiring preachings. A place where you can truly feel the Lord among you.

If you are looking for a place where people are people genuinely seeking and following Jesus, then search no more!

Come and make a visit, and be ready to be transformed deeply from the inside out. You won't regret it.

I am wholeheartedly looking forward to meet you there! Lively Community. Welcoming.
I wish service times were easier to find in the website. The community here is amazing and so inviting. Everyone is very friendly

name: Patria Church - Generosity Center - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
You can feel the love and the spirit of God before you even receive the blessing of the food. If you are in need please get there with your head held high they don't judge they support in Jesus name 🙌🏼 It's closed? 1st Saturday of January 2026 and there's no one here!? We don't get holidays and we are sorry we are forced to rely on the help but, please! Not all of us can afford the gas for exercises in futility.  If you post being open, please be open! Just because it takes 11 days to starve to death doesn't mean we can wait 10. By day 5 an non-suicidal person would be contemplating theft! Help the community. Not everyone is taking advantage of the system. Some of us are truly in need A BLESSING FOR MANY OF US THAT NEED THE FOOD ASSISTANCE!🙏
I AM IN THE BORDER LINE WHERE I DO NOT QUALIFY FOR FOOD STAMPS!!! 😞
AND GOD TOOK ME TO THIS CHURCH,.
WHERE THERE'S LOTS OF HARD WORKING PEOPLE!
PARENTS WITH THEIR KIDS HELPING OUT.
PACKING AND LOADING LONG LINES OF CARS.
EVERY SATURDAY RAIN  🌧️ OR SHINE! 🌞
FAST AND FRIENDLY!!!  🥰
I LOOK FORWARD TO GO BECAUSE THEY  PRAY FOR ME!!! 🙏
AND I GET MY FOOD, THAT I SHARE WITH MY PARENTS, MY FRIEND AND GRANDKIDS
THEY ENJOY THE STARBUCKS ITEMS.
BLESSINGS!!! 🙏
FROM: JURUPA VALLEY CALIFORNIA, USA Came here twice to pick up food for myself and my elderly neighbor. I received severely expired food that was not frozen and salads that were puffed up and warm . I thought maybe it was just that time. I tried again last weekend they gave me only juice and 1 bag of expired broccoli with 6 magazines for their church. The people are nice and doing a good thing but everyone should get equal items and food should be quality checked. I don’t want my kids sick because we’re hungry. My husband and I are so grateful for the generosity and caring that we receive from Patria Church.  We have been going through immense hardship and the generosity center has helped us out tremendously.  All the volunteers are very polite and friendly and always welcome me with a smile.  Patria truly does mean FAMILY.
May the Lord continue blessing this amazing Church.

name: Patria Church Alameda - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:
Every time I enter, it feels like walking into a family reunion! I've never imagined that I'd be a part of a church community that will walk alongside me every step of the way in my faith! I'm so grateful for my family here at Patria! I found this church when I needed it most, and I truly believe God led me here. After 15 years of not having a church to call home, I finally found one.🥹

This is where I dedicated my life to God and was baptized, something I’ll forever be thankful for. “Patria” means family in Greek, and that’s exactly what this church is becoming to me. Everyone is so welcoming, genuine, and real. From the moment I walked in, I felt loved and accepted.

It’s led by an amazing husband and wife pastoral team who love God and care deeply for people. If you’re searching for a church where you can belong, grow, and feel like family, this is it. This is a great church to come to very great Hospitality they will definitely treat you like family just like what the Churches name and you will get a 🔥🔥🔥 word from a Pastor that calls himself Fuego which means fire 🔥 me and my family enjoy serving in this church and great community to grow your Relationship with Christ I attended this Church close to 2 years ago. We were doing services in the Theatre at the time. The community welcomed me and I formed some great relationships. Through that I joined team, I got saved, and I faithfully serve the Lord now! I've attended twice already and I really enjoy the service and the people, very friendly. I would recommend this place especially if you are looking to learn and need a community to help you.

name: Patria Church Pomona - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Come join us for service 9am or 11am on Sunday we also have children's classes it a great church and great community 🙏 Wonderful place to fellowship. Everyone gets treated like family. Excellent church! So loving and God focused! Warm and inviting, awesome volunteers Very friendly staff and warm environment. Messages are always uplifting and insightful

name: Patria Church Rancho Cucamonga - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Mega abundant worship great music. A complete church. As Calvinists, we’ve always loved this church, but ever since the Patria rebrand, when they went fully Calvinist, we’ve loved it even more. They brought in an exceptional pastoral staff with the highest level of education from TMS/TMU, one of the most prominent training grounds for understanding the Bible from a Calvinist lens. They even have cool merch swaggert and vibes. Christ is King. I only been here one time I love the vibe I was looking into getting my children into school as well but not sure if it's public?? Very clean including the bathrooms we sat outside in the patio very clean at a church and when I went inside I was amazed how clean and nice it love the way everyone is like a family I'm giving it a five-star from the one-day experience I’ve always gone to this church and loved it, even before they changed their name to patria and when Adam’s dad was preaching and I always loved it but I was recently diagnosed with leukemia (AML) October 25th 2025 and of course with my diagnosis I decided to try get closer to God so I started reading my bible while in the hospital doing chemo. I was told on February 17th my cancer came back stronger and church was on my mind specially sitting in the front row to hopefully get some prayer so I (24 years old) decided to bring my wife and son to church Wednesday February 18th 2026 even asked my wife to sit in the front even tho we’ve never done that before and it was out of our comfort zone. We ended up sitting a couple rows back from the front because I seen most of the chairs had reserved signs but then I seen way some front row seats probably about 8 of them that don’t have a reserved sign on them so I brought my family to the front and was happy to be able to sit in the front which was exactly what I was hoping for but then a church worker came up and said that if my son will be fine in the front and I said yes and they left. Then another man came up and ask if we were ok and I said yes and he mentioned the seats are usually for the elders and they forgot to put reserved signs on the chairs and then said if we would be ok here and I said yes then another guy came and said if we are ok again and at this point I just said plainly “do you want us to move?” And he said “yes please” church was already about to start at that point so when we got up to move all the chairs were filled and we had to sit all the way in back. I firmly believe there shouldn’t be reserved seats in a church not matter who you are because everyone deserves to listen to the word where they want. Personally if I was the worker and seen people sitting already comfortable I’d just let them sit there. I guess elders have more right to sit in the front more than everyone else. Been my church over 15 years..plus now..love every moment!!! God is moving always and is here in this place! HALLELUJUAH!!
