name: Peace Apostolic Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: I started going to peace in 2009, I left to attend another church, I knew in my spirit I needed to go back to peace where the teaching isn’t watered down. This is my third Sunday coming back enjoying the pure truth of God and the Holy Scriptures. If you wanna know how to stay saved, be saved please go to peace bishop Swancy isn’t gonna water down the word of God he’s gonna tell you just the way we’re supposed to live if we wanna see and be with the Lord on that great and awesome day. Bishop Swancy is truly missed   In attending the peace again after the pandemic was a True Blessing. To have the door opened again a place of worship   Thank you Jesus. However as I began too attend more and more I’ve noticed   The friendliness wasn’t as it was in the beginning and  Want to  give this church Romans. 12 :3~8 and hopefully they work at it so they then can really be winner of souls  In Jesus Mighty Name Church today 10/3 was a holy ghost filled blessing. My first time since the pandemic. I was overjoyed with the  reopened Church. Although I truly miss Pastor Swancy. His son in law Mr. Prince did an exceptional job of getting the Message out, everyone was moved by his message and at least 10 souls maybe more gave their souls to Christ. Pastor Swancy is smiling in Heaven. The Church will go on.  GLORY BE TO GOD. The truth is preached here and my soul is always feed.  I've grown so much since attending this church.  The Pastor is really concerned about people's soul and teaching what the Bible says.  If you want to hear and learn what thus said the Lord, this is the place to come.  Hope to fellowship with you; God Bless Then 15 years ago a longer can't remember but this was the church that God led me to When he saved my life I was in the drug rehab center and this church would come and pick us up  I'm bringing us to the church my experience with the Holy Spirit and the reading of my Bible came alive   In this church  Bishop Swansea Character was like a breath of fresh air And the members or like family ...Strict but I appreciate it appreciate the sternness

name: Peace Lutheran Church - Danville Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church with unique offerings. The parish members are friendly. The design and architecture of the sanctuary is splendid. There is a continual array of local artists' works displayed. This is a beautiful church-designed by a world known architect.  The interiors are open, etherial and filled with light, plants and beautiful art-The spirit of this Church is welcoming of all and inclusive of race, denomination and faith. It was awesome - mostly because I was there for a concert unrelated to church ;) I have been to this church and love it, the pastor and other members are wonderful. The Sunday worship service is at 12:30 p.m.

name: Peace Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Peace is a ‘family’ church .. all are welcome .. young and old alike. It has been a joy attending since 2021. So many different ways to get involved and their website has all sorts of helpful info from service times to what to expect when you attend. These folks are clearly doing God’s work!! They keep their service times a secret. I just walked on campus trying to get information. Apparently the harvest is over for this church as everyone just looked at me like I didn't belong. Not one person said a word to me. For sure not an inviting church. I'll have to look further from home now. This church has really grown in the last few years.. The pastor is genuine. The people are really friendly and vibrant. If you're looking for a place to meet the real Jesus and walk with him, this is it! Great local church that is thriving and growing. Wonderful vibe in worship, multigenerational, great preaching. You need to check out this great church with intentional leadership and kind congregants! Such an amazing place and congregation! It would be so great if everyone could join us!

name: Peace Lutheran Church ELCA - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: A small church with a focus on relationships.  It has a community garden and a 2-K school on site.  You won't be told how to vote and everyone is welcome. I go to this church's rec room for pill addiction anonymous on Monday nights at 530. Highly recommend beautiful grounds to be on They have special meetings here for people looking to elevate their sense of spirituality through faith. The rating is only for the Community Garden.  $50.00 for the year and free water and they also remove pests 😊 Bought compost worms from the gardens behind the church.

name: Peace Lutheran Church Garden - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Peace United Church of Christ - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
A very inspiring visit. I wish I lived closer and could visit more often. The choir was absolutely beautiful, the best church choir I have ever heard. It is worth going just to hear them. This church is very welcoming and warm. The music is great and the preaching is top notch. They have vibrant education and service  programs and the congregation walks the talk. There are lots of kids and people from every walk of life.  Very progressive and inclusive. Beautiful church
Beautiful choir performance
Which my daughter was one of the singers in rhr Cabrillo College Choir Excellent place for events! Kudos for hosting our homeless neighbors once a week during winter!! I went to my friends choir thing there and it was pretty good :D

name: Peace Way Christian Center - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor David is a faithful servant—God truly uses him to bless our family through his message. We came here 12 years ago, and even as the church has gotten smaller, Pastor David continues to serve God with devotion. It’s a true blessing.

Everyone here is friendly and welcoming—they smile and genuinely talk to you.

Child care is thoughtful: they serve fresh fruits like apples, bananas, cherries, and more. Parents also get snacks—cookies, donuts, and coffee.

This church is truly a gift from God. A whole novel wouldn’t be enough to communicate how incredible this church has been to me and my family over the decades. The pastor is committed to sound doctrine and preaches with the convicting power of the Holy Spirit. He leads his congregation in wisdom and love and challenges people to ever increasing maturity. This is a great place to grow in faith as a family. There is also a daycare, preschool, and private school connected to the church so that your kids can grow up firmly rooted in the Gospel of Jesus and surrounded by people who love and care for them everyday. If there was ever a time in the world to find a faithful church family that will encourage you, love you, comfort you, and challenge you to holiness, it is now. If you’re in need of a church, please don’t hesitate to stop by for a service! You may gain a family :) I know I did. The church has installed gates to keep parents from using the church lot as a drop off zone for the elementary school next door. They have gone as far as guarding it morning and afternoon. Its made it less safe for kids.  If a new blacktop is more important than the safety of small children then they should probably reflect on their values. Destiny Church at 9.30am is fantastic. The preaching is so amazing and inspiring the holy Spirit is moving and they have a heart to reach the community. We enjoyed the service. People definitely love Lord.

name: Peachtree Christian Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Peachtree Christian Church was the perfect venue for my wedding ceremony! The church is stunning, reverent, and needed very little decoration on our part. There is much history in this church. It was such an honor to be wed here.

Sylvie, the wedding coordinator, made everything go so smoothly that my wedding planner didn’t even need to be there and could focus on setting up my reception. She and her team have done many, many weddings and have it down to a science. They are so kind and were a pleasure to work with!

The organ and talented organist is something I will never forget. Just fantastic beyond words.

If you want a classic, traditional, timeless wedding, Peachtree Christian Church is the place! The Legacy Club Respite Ministry is by far the best support for people with dementia, and also for seniors to just have a great time. Every Tuesday and Thursday from 10 to 2. My parents look forward to it Every week. The activities are amazing, the food is delicious. The volunteers are wonderful, such a fun loving group of people.❤️ I have had the honor of photographing several weddings at the HISTORIC Peachtree Christian Church and it is simply breathtaking!  The staff and clergy are so very kind and it is a stunning church for a wedding ceremony.  Understanding and abiding by the Church's decorum is a must. As a pastor, I have the opportunity to do funerals all over the state of Georgia. Peachtree Christian Church is one of the most beautiful sanctuaries to host, and in my case, officiate a wedding. The pastors and staff at the church are very kind and organized people. I highly recommend anyone considering getting married in Atlanta and looking at venuesto go tour Peachtree Christian Church. An absolutely wonderful place. photographed a wedding here and it was gorgeous! great staff as well!

name: Peachtree City Christian Church - Peachtree City Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended the women’s breakfast and also visited the Sunday service. The church itself seems like a nice place for worship, and I appreciated being allowed to attend.
I came hoping for a fresh start in my faith journey. Like many people, I have made mistakes in my past, but those things happened years ago and I have worked hard to learn from them and grow. Churches can be very important places for people who are trying to seek God and move forward in life.
While I personally left feeling a bit discouraged, I still believe this is a place where many people may find community and support. My hope is that anyone who walks through the doors seeking God will be given the opportunity to feel seen and welcomed.
God will revive my faith after doubt, and He will restore what feels lost or broken in my life. Lord, please help me. Amen. Wonderful place to worship Jesus. My kids love the children’s ministry. Very welcoming and comforting environment Me and my family have attended this church since 2019. Great message, caring pastor, and lots of prayer warriors. One time my car broke down and they let me park in their parking lot over night. That was nice! Everyone here is so authentic and sweet. The pastor speaks directly from The Word, and the sermons are impactful. My whole family enjoys coming here!

name: Peachtree City Church of Christ - Peachtree City Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending for the past nine months and am so grateful to be part of this congregation. From the very beginning, everyone has been incredibly welcoming, warm, and kind.

The worship services and sermons are thoughtfully organized, grounded in scripture, and offer meaningful, practical application and the singing is beautiful.

The youth group has been phenomenal for my kids, and I really appreciate all the opportunities available to connect and build relationships outside of regular services.

My daughters and I are so blessed to be here! I joined Peachtree City in May 2020. It was the best decision I could have ever made. The Elders, ministers, and the congregation as a whole welcomed me with open arms. There are several ministries that one can become a part of, which provides opportunities to build relationships, fellowship one with another, and get involved with community outreach.  If anyone is looking for a church home, I highly recommend Peachtree City! If you're looking for a church that is Bible-based, welcoming to all, and involved in the community, this is the church for you! From engaging, scripture-filled Sunday School classes, an active youth group where visitors are always welcome, to outreach and evangelism programs designed to impact the community and spread the gospel, you won't find a better church home! My family and I have attended the PTC CoC for years and love it.  The people are welcoming, the classes are great, and the church does amazing things for the community. I've been going to this church for many years. I have always enjoyed the sermons, lessons, and scriptures used. The class are phenomenal and the church is always filled with love and support from others. Amen.

name: Peachtree Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A historic Presbyterian congregation in Buckhead offering traditional worship in a beautiful campus setting.

name: Peak City Church - Apex Campus
reviewSummary: This is a living, active Christian church, and I feel God's presence when I am with this community. Pastor Nate's messages are powerful, relatable, and speak directly to each listener's heart while appealing to the mind as well. The worship music is modern with a stage band, which I had to adjust to, but it is moving and invites Jesus into every heart. So grateful to have found Peak City Church. Our entire family has learned so much since we started attending. Love how Pastor Nate breaks down the Bible verse by verse. Everyone is so kind and welcoming and the Kids Ministry is very engaging. Our kids are always able to tell us what they learned. Felt the peace of God when I left. Had a very nice experience. Can't wait to go back 😁 thank you for being so welcoming. We love this church! We moved to Apex from Maine and knew that the most important thing to do in our transition to a new area was to find a solid, Bible believing, Gospel preaching church where all were welcome. Pastor Nate and the team made us feel like family on Day 1 and we are so blessed to call Peak City our new church home! This is a place that loves and cares for its community and prioritizes outreach while delivering truth and love through the Gospel. Highly recommended!! Just the best!! Amazing church family. Pastor Nate preaches the Bible and the love of God. Also, an amazing kids ministry on Sunday mornings and youth group on Wednesdays!

name: Peak City Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to this church for a half year or so and was sure it would be our church home until…
The positives: worship was fabulous. Sermons biblically based and good for beginners. Has groups to get involved in for more in depth learning. Children and youth programs were a hit.
But…
While the church is audited once a year, they “ do not make full financial statements or detailed budget breakdowns available for individual or public review” in any form. For our family (who does not have strong opinions on amounts or percentages where things should be spent; and has moved all over and been a part of much smaller and much larger churches), it is important to know where our tithe back to God is being used. We were shocked PCC is so secretive about their spending. And after months of talking thinking praying about it, we realized if we can’t trust this church with finances, how could we trust them with our family’s spirituality.
ETA: I now see another review from three months ago that says the same thing (and it was about five months ago when we learned their view on financial openness). So to answer the question asked on Frankie’s review, I had a bsck and forth with the Guest Experience Pastor on staff who told me repeatedly the church has made the “deliberate decision” to not share budget breakdowns in any form for individual or public review.
Second edit after response from church:
I hear you. During my email conversation with the guest experience pastor where I offered to set up a meeting to see numbers or percentages in person so we had any idea where the church was spending money, I was told naw My husband and I first attended Peak City Church (formerly Red Rock Church) in the summer of 2017 when we first arrived in Colorado. We spent a few weeks searching for a church home. By our second visit to Peak City, we both felt a clear sense that God was saying, “This is where I’m planting you, and this is where you will grow.”

Over the years, we’ve witnessed God’s faithfulness to this church firsthand. We’ve seen seasons of change, with people coming and going, yet the work of the Lord here has never wavered or stopped. Since then, our family has grown. We’ve been blessed with two children (and a dog!), and our commitment to serving in ministry at our church continues to grow right along with it.

We truly value the strong sense of belonging, the welcoming faces, and the spirit of community and unity. There’s also a real sense of security here that means a lot to us. Our kids especially love being part of Peak City Kids. This church is great! Felt invited the minute I walked in. Loved getting free coffee and hearing great worship and a great message! Was then able to conveniently pick up some wine at the liquor store next door afterwards, grab an app at Sprouts, AND a lovely gift for my wife at Fascinations a few doors down… Talk about a blessed Sunday!! Can’t wait to be back next week! Maybe I’ll get my tires rotated Im giving 5 stars because  to me, this is more than a church. Its a home for confused and a home for the ones looking for spiritual belonging. I've been baptized here and I've even informed the Pastor if anything we're to happen to me while I was away. He would be informed amd without any hesitation, he said "okay, we'll bring here waiting for your return". The pastor is incredible and the location is where it is meant to be. I really do love this place ! Love this church! They welcome you in! They show you that our God is a loving God! I’m so thankful for Pastor Petie and the whole Peak City crew for making me feel like family! Highly recommended

name: Peak Community Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary: Weather tonight January 29th I remember the past to being there before and it's a good place to be to get warm shelter and to even pick up a book to read but always remember to bring back. Great place, very good caring individuals who not only care but love their valuable volunteer community.🤗 Great people helping the community They run something called the warming place for homeless and it is such a blessing to see their hearts of service and care for the poor. Great volunteers for the warming shelter on these cold nights

name: Pearl Church
reviewSummary: Pearl Church is an inclusive, affirming church that truly represents what Jesus taught- to fight for the most marginalized, to feed the hungry, to welcome the stranger and to live radically! As a member of the church for almost a decade I truly love how everyone (especially children) are taught that the Divine’s love is with you always! You don’t have to do anything or recruit anyone, the Divine loves every part of you just as it is! As a LGBT+ POC, I didn't feel welcome. They were nice enough, but it didn't feel inclusive as a new person. I really tried to meet and talk to people at several events. I mean the pastor didn't even greet me. 🤷‍♂️ Very inclusive and loving. This has been a wonderful, safe, and affirming community to be a part of. I've been attending nearly 10 years and it's always been home. For those seeking a community after evangelicalism, this just might be the place for you. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Pearl St. Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
I had the blessing and honor to attend Pearl Street Church today.  Amazing worship! I got to witness a few out of many Baptisms in one day.  Great message and preaching of the word of God. If you're in the San Antonio area, consider this your home. 💚 Last weekend we attended the service.The whole service was about tithes.

DO NOT FORGET & not mislead, Every person who received Jesus is a representative of Jesus, of God, not only you. It is biblical supported.

Galatians 5:4

Instead, based on the Bible, based on the grace to have received Jesus, ask for support to have the wages for the laborer, the “laborer deserves his wages”.

Are you aware that you may have and are limiting to 10% the full Grace of God to growth in the fruits & Gifts of the Holy Spirit ?
There is,at least, left 90% of Gods plan for your congregation not possible to be fulfilled because you have set your own limits taking parts of the law that does not work with Gods’ Grace. It is sad I go to church here and I really like the messages delivered. The Pastor always is approachable and consistently ready to engage with other members. Thank you for everything you're doing for our community! I especially need to thank Julio on the prayer team. He's credible and delivers prayer in a respectful and professional manner. The lives being changed in this church are too many to begin to count. I found Jesus and was baptized here and my life has changed forever. Not only am I living for Jesus, I get to now contribute to bringing others along to experience the joy of the Lord. I joined a community in the church and we are all following Jesus together. I get to serve in this church with the most selfless, loving people I’ve ever encountered in my life. I found a spiritual family I didn’t have and didn’t know I needed. The Holy Spirit is moving in this church. You can feel it instantly especially through the incredible worship team! Thank you Pastor Brent for carrying out your mission so well. I cannot thank God enough for this church and the people in it! The worship is beautiful . So many good things but , i feel some of the messages come across a little harsh and judgmental and suddenly tale a condescending tone . My daughter had an unexpected teen pregnancy and we love our grandson .It has ben quite a journey of growth in love and faith  for our family .We are so glad she did not want an abortion despite her situation but i was prepared for any outcome as it wasn’t my choice . I even offered to adopt him since she was young  but thankfully she is a good responsible  mom . The greatest lesson i learned was you never know how it is until your in that situation and that’s even being a good Christian family .
Majority of the time i have respect for peoples opinions but i did not care for how the subject of abortion in a recent preaching came across as placing  blame and shame on women .  Some men  force women to  get abortions or try to . Never been through it but i know it’s a reality . Pregnancy is also a males responsibility not just a woman’s . Empathy is putting ourselves in someone else’s shoes which is what we should do as followers  of Christ so we can better understand and reach people . Something I had to do to understand my daughter’s situation and possible choices.Toxic empathy is completely different . Brushing rape off as if it rarely happens is very insensitive. We should have compassion for women that have this choice to make after being assaulted. We could never understand how that must feel to say that’s toxic empathy is just cold . If someone that went through that were sitting there hearing that imagine how awful and shameful they would feel . We all have sin and singling gay people out for having a hard time changing or not wanting to is just wrong if you hear their stories of abuse and struggles.. We all had to change or still need changes and need to grow in Gods love and still are growing.I work in an industry with people from all walks of life.   By having empathy and showing the love of Christ i have reached many and not once have compromised who I am in Christ . To say it’s toxic empathy seems  harsh . After years of visiting this church off and on and hearing a few messages turn like this . Its just disheartening and why after all i’ve been through in ministry i wont join a church anymore . at times but i also understand no church is perfect and many churches still don’t understand when they are singling gay people out in the preaching is the reason they won’t come to church majority i ask will not come even though they love Jesus they feel condemned . We are all sinners and compassionate Christians are still not many .I’ve heard messages about these same topics  given in love and not judgement  while still speaking truth .It was very contradictory to what i’ve heard from this church and its vision .

reviewSummary:
What an extremely beautiful church and church campus. I recently attended a memorial service there, and met a strong and supportive community of great people, who have been continuous for over 3 decades (including a prior location), with camaraderie and support down to the small group level, just in every possible way for all members. I highly recommend this church to anyone looking for something new in 2020. PBC Cupertino, as it's called, is a perfect fit for us.

People were not welcoming, especially as a newcomer. All faithful seniors are friendly supportive people who are willing to help each other and wise and intelligent beings🌈👑💜 Incredible spiritual community. name: Pentecostal Missionary Church of Christ (4th Watch) South Bay - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
This church really gives you that heartfelt tug when it comes to God. You feel HIS presence during the service. They preach deeply the words of God and relate it to our everyday life. I have been holding off on this review for quite some time now. The reason is that I felt that it would be biased since I used to be a member of this church.

However, I think it's fair to speak about my opinions and point of view about the church now since I am no longer active.

I'll tell you this; there are ups and downs -- just like any other Church.

This is not a perfect church. Instead, it is a church that is being perfected and prepared for His Arrival.

Below you will see incredibly remarkable pictures. The image of me in the purple setting next to the guy in the black suit believe it or not we used to be enemies. We used to be from rival gangs when we were younger. Sometimes the human instinct goes back to default and tends to remember the past too much. However, when I saw him and when he saw me we made this peace treaty amongst our fellow friends and cities.

The picture with me wearing blue. I'm next to my friend who used to be in business with me. Let's say that... It's not the kind of business that you would want to talk about ever. However, I can't believe that I was able to convince them to come to church and to accept God and to leave our old business behind.

Moreover, to this day we remain friends; we are closer than ever and have both grown so much. We are so thankful to the church, to the leaders, to the Bible students, and the members.

Overall once you become a member of this church, it will feel like you are a lifetime member. Even though you're inactive or active, you will always have a place here. I have done so many things that should have me band probably from this church. However, to this day I still keep in contact with many of them. They always invite me to come back, but it's something within that stopping me.

The next pictures show my one friend and sister who has never given up on me. Moreover, I got to tell you I have made some dumb decisions that have affected many people and hurt them.

Moreover, they still accept me for who I am and even would like me to return.

Maybe one day I will, but for now, I believe it's best.

It's best that I grow up. I would become mature, and the next time, if there is a next time, I'll be way more prepared and ready to serve God.

If you are someone who struggles with depression, anxiety, loneliness, confusion, and existential stress, this is the place to go.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I highly recommend this church as a local guide of Google. Also, if you are in the area as a traveler and you are looking for a place of worship. This is the place to go.

Come As You Are and be ready to worship. Also, be ready to eat, there's a lot of food!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
cheers! I hadn't been a church goer in a number of years when I first set in the church a number of years ago.  I found the church at random while searching Google, and decided to pay them a visit.  I didn't stay then, but I would occasionally visit the church over the years, during their big events.
Eventually, I found myself in a situation where became open to the support of a group of believers in order to strengthen and maintain myself.  After about 9 days of praying, I was again invited to another church anniversary.  I went, earnestly praying for and looking specifically for a word from God, and He certainly did not disappoint.  The first words out of Bishop Jonathan Ferriol's mouth were exactly what I needed to hear. (1st Peter 2:9 if anyone is interested)

It would take a few weeks of meticulous scrutiny before I would join the church.  In those weeks, however, I saw so much.  I continued to discern the move of the Holy Spirit within the preaching.  Though initially not an extroverted person, I found that a number of members already knew who I was, even though I didn't know their names (to be fair, remembering names hasn't always been my strong point).  I even saw the zeal and dedication of the young people who were prepping for their ministries.

Since joining the church, every single point of potential doctrinal contention I could have had, any questions about whether I am a valued member or just another number, or any doubts if I had made the right decision have all been answered.  Keep in mind, no church, no pastor, no one group of people are absolutely perfect, but if I had to find myself another church of highly motivated, and truly dedicated people; it might not be an easy task.  I give this church 5 stars because they have continued to serve my needs, and are very supportive as I begin to realize my own God-given abilities in service to Him.  I hope this "testimony" reaches and encourages many people.
God Bless I have been with this church for almost 2 years. I've always been skeptical of any religious group...I was born into a Catholic faith and I felt that anyother religion outside catholisism is a joke. And I felt that I am ok as far as my faith is concern. Although there are times some areas in the faith I do not understand because I do read the bible and some of the things we do as catholic is kind of unique from what is in the bible. Praying the rosary, novena, feast day and praying to different saints for different reasons....it's not in the Bible? Until a friend of mine introduced me to this church and they were very kind, warm. They offered to conduct a bible study at our house which we did and they gave me answers to some of the questions I have and refered all to the Bible.  The Pastor was very kind and sincere to what he was saying and I was that convinced with the truth they have that I did not hesistate to receive Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior and I got baptized that night. I felt there was a heavy weight lifted from me. After that night I began attending their bible studies, they do personal ones and they even have bible studies as a congregation. I began attending their Sunday Services as well. I have never been so sure of my faith since that day of my baptism. Other people will say this church is a cult? I say otherwise, because as I grew on my faith I have witnessed how the leaders in the church models true worship and service to God. They are not salaried. Sure, they get love gifts/offerings for when they conduct speakerships and they're basic needs like food, clothing and transportation are provided by the church but compared to other church leaders they do not own any property and they are the ones who actually give the most in their offerings! One Bishop even gave $25K as their church anniversary thanksgiving offering! And that is only here in the US! This was unheard of for me. Oh! And the pastors in this church gives their tithes as well!  In fact, they are one of the top tithers! Typically, other leaders gets salaries from the congregation and some even have pensions from when they retire not to mention owning acres and acres of properties and even luxurios lfestyles.....not the leaders of the PMCC 4th watch! They are down right for real and you can even check it out for yourselves! They have a transparency policy...mind you!

I don't know about you but this church is as Legit as it can be....I invite you to see for yourselves!

Praise the Lord! If your not Filipino it's kind of awkward. Plus they do an altar call if your a first time visitor. There is no personal one on one asking you if your a believer or not. They only encourage church bible study and not Individual bible study. It seems like a cult.

name: People's Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Felt very comfortable as a first- time attendee compared to other churches that tend to feel pretentious After 1 year at this church, I can truly say it feels like family. Pastor Chris knew my family by name the 2nd week we attended. The most diverse and welcoming congregation in all of Indy. The youth pastor Andrew is incredible. Both pastors’ wives are the friendliest women you’ll ever meet, and are extremely involved.

The sermons cover a very wide range of topics, and are scripture-focused. The gospel choir is electric. They are transparent about their finances. The kids ministry is well-staffed and well-organized. Can’t say enough great things. So thankful we found our church home here. The parishioners at The Peoples Church are very friendly, welcoming and kind.  I had not been to church in quite some time and had heard good things about this church. It is very well organized in sharing information and each person on staff very informative. The music was mostly contemporary Gospel however being a musician that's not why I attended. I could see it being a bit of a concert for youth in the opening and the turn out was fairly good. I mentioned that the sound in the mix was a bit loud and they were very receptive to my critique in order to improve. I believe there are several different times one can attend through Sunday and they foster a youth group as well of which I really appreciate!  I really liked that there were all types of different people in attendance with a common love for God. That's the most important takeaway. Although I was raised differently under other circumstances that followed specific religious doctrine, it was actually really nice to be in a place that was more casual and comfortable to hear the message of our Lord and I am so thankful that children and teens have a place to go and commune. I shall return and praise God. People's Church is wonderful. Pastor Chris preaches that we are family. I truly feel that and I feel the love of others from the congregation. If you dont have a church home you should definitely come check it out. Love our church. We are all like family there. No matter who u are they welcome u with open arms and make u feel right at home. They have a great place for the kids while the adults have church. They always have events for the family and kids on holidays. The pastor and his wife are a great couple and do a great job preaching. Can't praise this church and the congregation enough.

name: People's Church OKC - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing Church. Made it my home church and got baptized. This place ABSOLUTELY has God's presence and LOVE their. Paster Cooper and Pastor Rob are wonderful. The worship team is amazing and the members are just as amazing. If you want to feel like family with the shared love of who Jesus Christ is. Definitely recommend stopping by for a service. Amazing 😍 AMEN I love it here! It definitely feels like home! The pastor and his team are extremely welcoming! In my 41 years of life, and across the five states and two countries I’ve lived in, this is the first church I have consistently visited every single Sunday for over a year! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! The church has old school values with modern day incentives to visit! They have welcome T-shirts for newcomers lol just like a good concert! We are visiting from out of town. Friendly, great worship and wonderful message. Makes you feel excepted Great Church! You will receive the message from Pastor Cooper deep in your soul, even days later.

There’s a really cool coffee shop that serves great coffee and drinks. There’s an outdoor shaded space with a screen  where you can sit with your friends watch the live stream from the main building. It’s also got a multi generation demographic. There’s a great kids program and youth group (that meets on Friday nights). They’re invested and regularly have community outreach programs. People are very warm. This church is my home. I love this place. This is my safe place. It's where I'm able to just be myself and be vulnerable. This church family has supported me and my family through thick and thin. There's no judgment and everyone loves Jesus and their mission is to connect people to Jesus and help them become more christ like. Not to mention all of their holiday events are the best and safe and fun for everyone especially the kids. It’s a Great Diverse Community of People and everyone is so welcoming and accepting just as you are.. It's a place where you're accepted, loved and led to the One who loves you the most. Wonderful, Energized in the Spirit of our Lord and Savior, A Great Place to Reconnect and Create a New Beginning... Randy Morton

name: Peoples Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Welcoming, great worship. Diverse. Urban setting. Convenient parking. Good message. I attended there before the name change, so mid-oughts thru about 2013. Nice enough people but a way way Left social agenda and extremely cliquey. $$ talks there, as well. Loved attending here. Very diverse and they care about issues of social justice. Biblically sound. I have been attending Peoples Church for 7 years & it has changed my life. The church focuses on racial reconciliation & represents over 30 different nationalities! It is a loving community of people who desire to Love God, & Love People & is a great place to get connected & meet people. My mother passed away and wanted to do a celebration of life for her. They turned us away due to not giving recently these past years due to covid we went astray. I grew up here my family tide every week no matter what. Now that we needed them they say sorry can't help. This is very sad for us. I loved this place sence I was a kid with pastor Miller, and tom Baxter who our great people. Everyone here is great, but sad that they wouldn't help my family even after all that I and we have done for then through God. Such a shame that this is how it ended for me and my family after 30 plus Years of service.  God bless.

name: Peoples Inter-Cities Fellowship - Mill Valley Campus
reviewSummary:
I guess I should preface this by saying that I am not religious and do not attend church here. I do, however, wake up every Sunday and listen to the music out on my deck and find comfort in the exultation and harmony of the community. It fills me with immense joy and a feeling of comfort. Since you’ve been outside the echo of music through the canyon is a highlight of my week. Thank you! Eye has not seen nor ear heard nor entered into the heart of man,  the things that God has prepared for those who love Him. 😍

Maranatha ✨️⏳️ Pastor Small is wonderful. And they have a food Bank on Sundays and Thursdays. This is my church where we have our service.This place of service is a good  place to have Sunday Service.
THANKS TO PASTOR!! Great place to worship..positive energy couple with great music..

name: Perimeter Church
reviewSummary: A cornerstone of the PCA in Atlanta. Known for 'Expository' preaching and a unified focus on 'Kingdom Discipleship'. The campus is a regional hub.

name: Perimeter Church - Johns Creek / Duluth Campus
reviewSummary: Great mind refreshing place.. lots of open space, multiples grouds,kids park in the heart of Johns Creek..love this place. While I can't vouch for any of the spiritual kool aid they may proffer since we are non religious, I can thank them for the marvelous outdoor resources they offer from nature trails to the track to the pond to the playground to the obstacle course and community garden. Their lush beautifully landscaped grounds are open to the public so they can be enjoyed by all. Beautiful church and I have seen this place change completely over the last 10 years. Wonderful park as well The preaching is absolutely wonderful. It’s solidly reformed and Presbyterian. The church’s teaching as to how to go into the world to be Bible believing Christians is excellent. They offer so many classes and equip you to go into the world knowing scripture and sharing it with others. The people are so kind and inviting. They have a great children’s and women’s ministry. My only deep concern is that the music is not respecting our bodies as God’s temples. It is above the safe decibel level every service. This is an issue for people with neurodivergent challenges and is contributing to hearing loss. The church has bought into the lie that the music must be loud to appeal to the masses. I hope they will consider that praising God can be done at a safer decibel level. It's almost as big as a mall. The pics I took are mostly the children's classrooms and hallways. Attended a needlework crafters stitch-in and meeting. Very nice, clean and modern facility.

name: Perissos Church Milwaukee
reviewSummary:
This church has been the perfect fit for me and my husband in our late 20’s. The congregation is genuinely warm, welcoming, and has the “Jesus glow.” Pastor Jake leads the church on the right path and we so appreciate his guidance. You’ll meet amazing people if you attend! ⛪️ MIX Church - Milwaukee🔔

🏡 LOCATION - They meet right outside of the university of Wisconsin (Milwaukee) in a GORGEOUS university building. It’s huge and has very comfortable seats.

🤝 HOSPITALITY - The people seem extremely nice but not one person tried to speak to my wife or I. We sat alone, arrived alone and left alone. I’m sure they’re great, but as a new person, I’d love to have been approached at least once.

🎸 WORSHIP - Worship was authentic and full of talented college age people really bringing the ‘ship’ - contemporary Christian music worship style. (There was probably way too much reverb on their mics - the room is already so open, they don’t need synthetic verb - just a thought.)

📖 WORD - Preached directly from the word the whole sermon - along with story telling and humor!!

❤️ AUTHENTICITY - Very authentic and honest - all the way around!

🤔Overall Thoughts - 4 ⭐️’s would definitely go again :)
It’s tough as first time guests to introduce yourself to people, this might be something they could work on! This church has been phenomenal for me so far. I've been attending for roughly 6 months. The pastor is extremely passionate about the church's mission, and you can tell that the rest of the church members are the same. It's a "young" church in a sense that most of the attendees are under 30 years old if I had to guess. I'm excited to start volunteering soon so I can contribute and get to know the members more. This family is great!!! When I was attending it was still called “CornerStone Church.. They welcomed me and my kids, and All my family members that wanted to come! They treated us with love and hugs and always presented themselves as a reflection of our savior, which says a lot about a their church and their faith!  I’m a single mother who was pregnant at the time and they did not discriminate but they helped me all through out my struggles and invited my family and I to different events and group studies. They really made us feel right at home and I adore that! Recently my family and I moved to Phoenix so I don’t see the church fam anymore but I do speak to a few of them when I can catch up.
If your someone who just wants a true relationship with Jesus and I mean a true intimate bond with Jesus one that’s unbreakable... someone Who wants to feel welcome and loved for who they are and as they are. Someone who wants someone to meet them where they’re at and not judge, but walk along side and encourage, speak life and Just be with them through out their journey... This is the home for you....🙏❤️ Cornerstone Milwaukee started in the apartment building below me.It is nondenominational and evangelical. I became a member there after attending for 1 year and it has been 4 years now! I love the people, worship, and leadership. I am very thankful for how God has used this church in my life. They are truly a group of people 100% surrendered to God. Jesus is the focus.

The worship is modern christian rock and hymns.

They have a children ministry and child care during worship and the service. The church is a mix of college students, young families, old families, and all around people who just love Jesus.

They originate from Oconamowac (the smiley face church)  and Spring Green. They also have branched out and started Haitian and Romanian Ministries. If you are in either of those countries you can visit church there too.

Free coffee and sometimes treats are provided as well.

name: Perpetual Life Church
reviewSummary: Excellent teaching-biblically sound -loving environment . A place to be rooted and grounded in the WORD ! Visited today and everyone seems pretty close and friendly. His sermon was pretty solid and it was based on actual scripture. I find no issues with this church on a first visit. However, I do wish people would contain their kids in the sanctuary...that can be really distracting. Words cannot accurately describe how amazing the Bingham family and their community is. My family came here under unusual conditions and they offered nothing but support, love, faith, and immediate friendship, despite us being outsiders. I will always have a special place in my heart for this church and all it’s members for their generosity, kindness, and genuine love for others. Much love always, Gloria 2.0, Xochitl, Gloria 3.0, and “Deja Vu” Rodriguez I love God church and the holy ghost spirit is really here!. 🙌 This is an awesome house God. The worship and teaching is incredible.  Come and experience a great time in the Lord.

name: Persian Christian Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has truly changed my life. The messages are filled with love, truth, and hope. Every time I attend, I feel the presence of God and the warmth of a beautiful community. I’m so thankful for this place and the people who serve with such a pure heart. I am truly grateful for being part of this wonderful church. The sermons are uplifting, the community is warm and welcoming, and the spiritual atmosphere is a true blessing. Thank you to all who serve so faithfully.
God bless you🙏 Persian Christian church where you can meet the Lord Jesus Christ. Such a wonderful community this church has. Thank you Lord to bring me here. Praise God !!!
The church is "planting and watering seeds of faith", in the name of Jesus Christ. I recommend this church for anyone who is thirsty for the  the truth and seeking for God.
