name: Persian Worshipers of Christ Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I have been serving and learning so much at PWOC. This church has truly helped me grow in my faith and my walk with God. Pastor Rasoul has been my greatest mentor, guiding and encouraging me with wisdom and love. Their modern worship and videos are so fun and make the experience even more engaging. I am so thankful for this community and the opportunity to be a part of it. God is here!! Amazing church!! Persian Los Angeles church, for sure check them out 🔥🔥!! One of the best Persian churches in Los Angeles area. Lovely church and pastor ❤️❤️❤️ Amen

name: Petaluma Christian Church
reviewSummary: Amazing non-denominational community. Very friendly people and solid bible teaching.

name: Petaluma Christian Church - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary:
Its a warm and friendly group of believers. You can apply  the sermons to everyday living as it's based on the Bible. The worship service offers praise to God our Father and our Savior Jesus  Christ. It is uplifting and encouraging. I leave each Sunday preparedv for the week ahead. The people in this congregation are very welcoming and friendly. My first visit there, several people came and introduced themselves. The pastor’s messages are very full of content, referencing Bible verses as he speaks.  There is coffee fellowship after service which is a great time to get to know people. It’s a great all around experience. Petaluma Christian Church (PCC) is a welcoming and friendly west side community church with a 150+ year history. Bible based sermons reveal Gods love and the good news of Christ's Gospel.
Pastor Ryan breaks down the word into a message with modern day applications. His sermons are thorough, articulate, and engaging. PCC is not a mega church. It's a bit on the small side which suits me just fine.  The worship is excellent and the sermon was great. Beautiful people a very loving church that cares about people's

name: Petaluma United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: A very friendly and inclusive Methodist congregation. Highly recommend.

name: Petaluma Valley Baptist Church - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church located in lovely East Petaluma. Welcoming all to visit. Beautiful Holiday Concerts and vocal performances! Hosts 'The Petaluma Chorale' twice annual community concerts. Lovely campus with shade trees. Convenient handicap access parking. What a friendly church.  During our pandemic, they meet together under the large outdoor permanent pavilion structure so that we can see each other.  Chairs are set out in pairs; 6 feet between pairs; wear masks and name tags; and plenty of fresh air.  Come join the group at 9:00 a.m. and a different service at 11:00 a.m. each Sunday. Awesome! Biblical doctrine and fantastic Sunday school.  2 services, 9am (most popular for kids) and 11am most popular for traditional hymnal worship.
Church involved in many ministries and supports evangelists both nationally and internationally. Great people, very inviting Have never been there,but my sister Just started going there sounds like a great church.

name: Philadelphia Episcopal Cathedral - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church was built in 1855, renovated in 1898. In 1902 was under fire, rebuilt in the year 1906. This cathedral is U S. National Register of Historic Places. Beautiful and kind-hearted people. As welcoming as I remember it being, fifteen years ago when I last visited, just as a church should be. I was delighted to see old friends there.

Worship at Philadelphia Cathedral is open in style, and with a freer form than you would find in any other Cathedral I know of. There is lots of moving around the space during the service.

Emphasis is placed on the equal status of everyone around the table, and on the fact that ministers, including the musical leaders, arise from among the people, not being separated from them by sitting in a different place.

There is also fellowship after Sunday Eucharist in the form of coffee served in the Cathedral itself. Amazing, beautiful, acoustics is next to none. A beautiful edifice inside. Some paid street parking We loved the show. They had a very nice reception after.  They could use better signs though. Kept yelling at us to redirect us.

name: Phillips Chapel Christian Methodist Episcopal Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I love that they reach out to the homeless and provide a ministry to them every second and third Saturday. After the service, they actually feed a small meal. Because of the people who worship there started attending when they were young and didn't desert the church for the mega churches that sprouted up all of a sudden. I'm certain if anyone came to our services they would want to come back again. I was the soloist for the Mother's Day service and we had a great time! I love this place.
Feels like home. Peaceful God is Good

name: Phoenix Bible Church
reviewSummary: Beloved young, growing congregation committed to verse-by-verse exposition, warm relational community, and gospel mission in Central Phoenix.

name: Phoenix Bible Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Beloved young, growing congregation committed to verse-by-verse exposition, warm relational community, and gospel mission in Central Phoenix.

name: Phoenix Christian Assembly - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
PCA is my church home and family. Pastor Gus is truly a doer of the word and not only has welcomed my family with open arms but has went out of his way to help and minister to me through very difficult times. Thank you for helping me with my car, I don’t know what I would have done otherwise.
Also thank you Pastor Randy for unapologetically sharing the gospel and giving Jesus all the honor and glory every sermon, powered by the Holy Spirit.
Jesus bless PCA as we continue to grow and shine your light to the way, truth and life! Love this church, some of the kindest people I've known. Lots of people of various ages and ethnicities, beautiful. They always have lots of events they host for men, women, couples, young adults, teens, and kids! This church is alive and well. They have Sunday school for the kiddos, a huge playground, a gymnasium, and huge beautiful field they utilize like for Easter! It was fun. Definitely come visit next time you're on this side of town! the people there are very toxic to you if youve never been there, my dad and i went there twice, i just to sit down and waited for my dad outside and they told me i needed to leave both times even tho i explained to them what i was there for an my dad is in there. my dad told me they just talk nonsense in there anyways. an after what they told me he never went back...very negative experience You must come and visit this church I love how people are so friendly and welcoming Pastor Randy is so awesome straightforward and  he's down to earth funny and very loving. What great, relevant, applicable, helpful teaching from Pastor Randy!  I love that he shares the church’s mission as “Taking you from where you are, to where God wants you to be.”
Beautiful

name: Phoenix Christian Reformed Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: We’ve been members of PCRC for 16 years. We are part of a bigger family here. The kindness, thoughtfulness and all prayers over years are priceless. This church is a true neighborhood gem and welcoming to all. Very friendly, inviting, and warm congregation.  They make you feel as if you’re home!  I know I am in my new home, so thrilled tohave found this church Wonderful at welcoming new people. Meaning worship and message. Plan time to stick around and mingle after the service. Sad to see they’re not very helpful Wonderful community of believers! The gospel is clearly preached here, and everyone is welcome!

name: Pickerington Church of Christ - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited the Pickerington Church of Christ in late May of 2023. I'm from Oklahoma and I was in the area on vacation.

When I entered the building on that Sunday morning, I was immediately greeted and welcomed by many nice people who recognized I was new. The two people doing the greeting outside the entrance to the auditorium were especially pleasant to speak with. Very warm and kind people who were legitimately interested in getting to know me. They gave me a little bag with some cool items inside including a Pickerington Church of Christ mug! (which I keep on my shelf now 😁)

The service was well put together and led by people who know what they are doing and clearly put effort into their work. I especially appreciated the younger guy leading the singing with a pitch pipe. He did a great job and made the singing a very pleasant experience.

The sermon was interesting. If I remember correctly, it was mostly about the more controversial topics in the church that we tend to avoid. I overall agreed with a lot of the things he said, but I also feel like a lot of what he stated as fact is actually something that is debatable. From what I understand though, this was not the normal sermon experience. I highly doubt that every week has a sermon about a divisive topic such as that, so I won't hold that against them.

Overall I very much enjoyed myself and felt spiritually uplifted from the experience. If I'm ever in the area again I will definitely visit again. I attend a bible study there on Thurs led by their Pastor. The group is approximately 60+ in age. The conversation is lovely.Everyone has input and we laugh. A great bunch of people. Traditional service with friendly people just worshipping God together. As with most churches of Christ, there are no instruments. Lessons are very interesting and applicable to your daily life. Very warm & friendly, great singing & speakers. Great experience!

name: Pikes Peak Christian Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my husband are apart of the CR family - so blessed to have been invited to this church to be with some of our forever family through CR and Christ. The church is beautiful, we were very impressed with the hospitality and worship portion of our visit. Thank You All who made this possible, we love you. Omg I was invited by a friend to work as a volunteer on “Night to Shine” (Tim Tebow foundation) and had an absolute blast 💥 it was so well organized and people were really helpful and friendly! The night is a special “prom/red carpet” night for handicap children and adults and was a night to remember !!! It's more than a church, a family, a home. You are welcomed here with open arms, open doors, smiling faces. The people here have been so good to my family and I. This church genuinely cares about their community. They care about their youth, the future. They have a group for everyone. Just go, get connected. Their homeschool group is amazing!! Their youth groups are amazing!! The pastors all work together, like family, and they each have an anointing. My kids love their Sunday school classes, the children's worship team, The Next Gen youth, and have even joined me in the adult service. The people here are genuine, they care. They want you to know that you are loved. Sincerely Loved. They create a safe space for that. They walk in Truth of that. It's been an incredible blessing for my family and I. I've met the most amazing people here!!! We will forever be grateful for PPCC 🥰🌟 Great people great fellowship was glad to be able to make it down and visit I wish I could give more stars, I’m so happy to have found a church like the Peak! The church’s mission, “helping more people more often say yes to God” aligns with what followers of Christ are called to do. There are so many programs and support groups that welcome and benefit the community, from small groups to the care center.
The atmosphere on Sundays is warm and welcoming. The band is great and plays modern worship, and the pastors always find a way to relate the Bible and Jesus’s teachings from scripture into our lives.
If you’re looking for a church home, I highly suggest coming and checking this church out!

name: Pikes Peak Church of Christ - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
One of the friendliest bodies of Christ I have ever visited.  We were in town on vacation but the family at Northside embraced us as family.  The service was great and scripturally based.  It was great to see the young youth getting involved at the end of the service by picking up visitor cards and passing out fresh bread loaves to those who were visiting.
I wish we could have spent a little more time getting to know them but it will definitely give us something to look forward to when we visit that way again. While traveling, I'm finding congregations that haven't advertised Covid revised times. Just wanted to mention that the Pikes Peak worship time, for now, is 10:00 A.M. Sundays. Everyone is welcome, but wearing a mask is required. A vibrant and friendly family of believers. The fellowship and food were second only to the preaching! Diversity of all sorts: age, ethnicity, backgrounds... a pleasant experience! It's a great small church and everyone is friendly and they speak thoughtfully about the bible and what happens in the stories. I have two teenagers. There was no youth group for them. They're at that critical age where they need good teen christian friends. I guess I'll go somewhere else.

name: Pikes Peak MCC - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Kind, open, safe and liberal LGBTQAI+ community & congregation. We've enjoyed visiting and being around these lovely folks. Pikes Peak Metropolitan Church is open to ALL. Very Kind,Friendly, Loving environment. And pastor Alycia is Kind and Captivating. I think  this place of worship  is  u nlike any other because it takes me as I am and welcomes me. LGBTQ  friendly.diverse community  beautiful. Everyone is welcome and all are loved. People are friendly and very inviting. Very small congregation although quaint. Needs a choir

name: Pilgrim Congregational Church UCC
reviewSummary:
Our family has been attending this wonderful church for many years. Very inclusive. You are welcome just as you are. Music and sermons are inspiring. Sunday worship at Pilgrims helps us remember how to be a community - how to live as a caring, loving community in a world that disparately needs it. October 23, 2014

Thank you, Pilgrim Church.  You are a gem.  In our lives of church involvement, we cannot remember a more welcoming congregation.  Though we are not yet “members,” you greet and include us as if we had rooted here – as some of you have – since Mayflower days.  Surely such warmth and inclusion are what church at its best is supposed to include.

Thank you for calling Lauren Lorincz to minister with you.  Her profound wisdom and her generous spirit and her remarkable authenticity are rare ...  beyond rare. Lauren’s willingness to lead Bible studies and book studies is giving us chances to learn and stretch – and to know her and others in the congregation in ways that create space for trust and friendship.

Thank you, Pilgrim Church, for being who you are.  We feel blessed to have found you and your loving ways.

Jim and Judy Moffitt I have attended this Church on a few holidays and traditional services, and it has been consistently engaging and welcoming. If I loved closer to Lexington, I would attend regularly. A great, affirming congregation! I have always found Pilgrim Church to be a warm and welcoming environment and am happy to have Pilgrim as my church "home." Church service was very inspiring!  Had a great time and felt very welcomed by the members and reverend!

name: Pilgrim Lutheran Christian Church
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Pilgrim since I was married here in 2012. Both of my children have been baptized here as well. Pilgrim has always been a warm and inviting community steeped in rich Lutheran (LCMS) doctrine that adheres to the teachings of Martin Luther and the Reformation. Sunday school classes are on point with rich biblical lessons. Kids programs ie. children’s church and activities are wonderful. Pilgrim has a beautiful organ, piano and praise team. There is a multitude of social events throughout the year such as pot lucks, chili cook off and the like.
I recommend Pilgrim if you’re looking for a warm and inviting Christian community. The people are friendly and the school is excellent. I wasn't a Lutheran before Pilgrim, not sure if I had even heard of Luther. Evangelical churches as a youngster, and 20 years of being unchurched before I found the Pilgrim family. This place feeds my soul: saved by grace alone, the inerrant word of God, and conservative principles. Come and visit. I feel at home here.  The members are so warm and welcoming.  Pastor Koczman has a caring and loving heart.  I can feel God's  love in this plcce! Hi - dissappointed today by a church.  Why is the church not open at 3pm - noone in the office etc.?
What is the church for - a place to say a prayer, socialize etc.  Why is it not open?

name: Pilgrim Lutheran Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Best Private High school is located here. Hidden gem in Santa Monica. A church where people truly love Christ and each other. Nice church.

name: Pilgrim Progressive Baptist - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband & I attend our beloved family member homegoing it was a glorious time in the Lord, the pastor preached a good word and the choirs sung until heaven got the news we had a beautiful home going for her and at the end of the server's the doves was released to say that her Spirit was now free she is free at last thank God Almighty she's free at last the church is large very much accommodating to a large crowd the parking lot is humongous the location was great right off the freeway I enjoyed everything Attended this fellowship in 1993 when I lived in San Diego with my daughter. Born and grew up in Raleigh NC...was seeking to join a Missionary Baptist church when as a child I grew up attending a Baptist church. The HOLY SPIRIT flows from heart to heart. at Pilgrim Progressive beginning at Elder Foxworth, the deacons/deconesses; music ministry; Sister Gladney( awesome woman of purpose); ministering ushers....I returned to NC after my father had stroke...but I let all my bulletins/programs from Pilgrim Progressive...the praise/faith building Bible studies/powerful teaching-preaching of Elder Foxworth remain within my heart....there is a WORD from the Lord!! To anyone coming into the area and looking for a place of worship, I can't recommend Pilgrim Progressive enough. You'll walk in a stranger, and walk out of service family. Take a moment and drop in for a service. I promise, you won't forget it. Beautiful ministry amazing Pastor & family 🙏🏻 Great Service both congregations Showed up
and Showed out.

name: Pilgrim United Church-Christ - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Just the nicest congregation EVER. It took me a long time to find this wonderful inclusive church.   I have been going over the last month and I will join soon as a member.  This church and their loving thoughtful ways must indeed make Christ smile. Have attended this church since childhood, incredible people with an inclusive and affirming community. This is a wonderful church. It may be smaller than some but it is mightier in many ways. I see it as a hub where we all come together teaching, learning, and living in fellowship with one another so we can go out into the world in many directions spreading the news of God’s love through Jesus Christ and JEDI, Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion. Pilgrim UCC is unique in the San Diego region.  A community dedicated to an honest exploration of the meaning and significance of Jesus and how that understanding manifests in spirituality and service to others.  The community has a passion for social justice action and a genuine concern for each other.  And Rev. Madison Shockley, as the (only?) black pastor of a predominately white church in San Diego, brings a "tell it like it is" perspective to both theological and current issues which is concurrently challenging and non-condescending (like "Wow, I haven't looked at it that way before."). Although I live in downtown San Diego, I have yet to find a spiritual community that compares to Pilgrim.  Suggest you give it a try some Sunday at 10:00 in person or 10:30 on Facebook and see if it resonates with you. Progressive church with great messages every week.

Active fellowship based on serving others in need and learning how to actively help.

name: Pillar Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been such a welcoming and uplifting place. From the moment you walk in, everyone is kind and genuinely cares about making you feel at home. The messages are inspiring, biblically grounded, and applicable to everyday life. There's a strong sense of community, and it's clear that the church is passionate about serving others and helping people grow in their faith. I'm grateful to have found this church and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to worship and connect. Great biblical teaching, beautiful worship, and I'm excited to get plugged into serving at this church. God has called Preston and the other pastors to fast and pray, and it's great to see the leadership implementing Holy habits. Love this church and am so thankful to be planted here. The most authentic church I’ve ever been to. If you’re deeper in your faith Pillar is perfect My first time visiting Pillar Church today, and I loved it. I’m from out of state and honestly not a fan of mega churches but this church isn’t one of those. It’s authentic, not over the top, and focused on the Word. The pastors aren’t flashy or political, and they don’t spend 30 minutes asking for donations. It’s just genuine teaching and amazing worship. They have everything you need and make you feel right at home. I’ll definitely be back I absolutely love this church. For a while I had been on the hunt for a good church home and I can say that God has led me to Pillar for a reason. The Holy Spirit is truly present here and I’ve already been able to connect with other brothers and sisters in Christ. I will continue coming as it’s been so edifying to me and has helped me to mature in my faith.

My only complaint is that they keep the sanctuary A/C set to Arctic lol so I hope they change that. It’s way too cold sometimes, and my elderly grandmother can’t really handle that. I hope they can recalibrate that.

name: Pillar Church of Oceanside - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
Faithful, God-fearing, Gospel-minded church. I’ve been attending this church since May 2022, and it has been a tremendous blessing. The elders are well-equipped and faithful in their role of shepherding the church. The congregation is faithful and united with the same goal in mind: to know Jesus and make Him known. If you’re in the Oceanside area, I encourage you to come and join us for a service. Pillar Church of Oceanside is a really great group of Christian worshipers in the Valley in Northeast Oceanside. Saturday service is presently held in an older church building on Stallion Road off North River Road. The church building is shared with a smaller but separate church group. For over ten years Pillar Church services used to be held in the spacious multi-purpose room at nearby Del Rio Elementary School next to Melba Bishop Park.

The main two pastors are Marine and Air Force veterans who are also talented musicians. A third pastor is an active-duty Naval chaplain. The pastors rotate and focus on various religious themes throughout the year and reference verses from the New and Old Testaments. All references to scripture are clearly visible on the overhead screen. During my two years there, politics was never included in their sermons. They DO NOT try to sway members to think or vote a certain way.

Their focus is for everyone “to know Jesus Christ and to make Him known.”

All of the congregants are active duty military personnel, retired military, veterans, and their families. However, everyone in the community is welcomed. Pillar Church also provides Bible study and various support groups with lots of food and uplifting spiritual songs and prayer.

Finally, Pillar Church has a growing number of churches next to military bases throughout the country and a few around the world. Everyone is welcomed. I attend service at Pillar Church of Oceanside from January 2018 to June 2020. Prior to this I attended church at Pillar Church in Dumfries, VA and Pillar Church in Jacksonville, NC.  I have never felt more at home than I have at a Pillar Church.

I recently returned for a weekend after moving out of town and felt like I was right back with my family.  I love this church and cannot express how much they have helped me to grow in my walk with Christ. Visited while on vacation, great community, service, and worship. Love the service and message

name: Pillar of Fire Church San Diego - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely loved this church! The message is clear and more importantly extremely powerful! There is a very welcoming crowd and I felt at home! I strongly recommend checking this place out! 12:30 Sunday! Be there and your week will be much more fulfilled! Don't take my word for it go see for yourself!! Pillar of Fire is one of the most loving, welcoming, accepting churches in San Diego.  The intimacy of the community there, their commitment to teaching the Bible, their practice of weekly intercessory prayer, their Celebrate Recovery, their TUMI class, their authentic expressions of musical worship, their outreach to their community and more are all very clear evidences that God's Spirit and present is alive and active there! I like a bible referred message and contemporary worship. Pastor Danny does just that. I've been to last Sunday's service and mid-week service on Wednesday's. Friday I plan to go to the Celebrate Recovery mtgs..... Pillar Of Fire Church of San Diego is where I attend, ots my church.  I recommend for anyone looking for a church and to get fed with the Word Of God and be satisfied I was having a hard time and I came across the book pillar of fire and wanted to say thank you for our talks and your counsel. God has given me hope when I felt like my world was falling apart. The love I get from God is so personal and on a whole nother level its unexplainable. Thank You Pastor Dan.
-Robert Oson

name: Pima Canyon Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Had large meeting here.  Parking was too small for our numbers.  Inside of Church is very nice. Haven't been yet, but sounds nice Sound biblical teaching every week.  A great church for young families and people of all ages! I've been attending since 2005. Very friendly people and Bible-based messages. Solid teaching, friendly people. Easy access and parking.

name: Pinecrest Presbyterian Church - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely service by fine people. Warmly received. Beautiful interior. Excellent teachers and staff. ;) Pastor Jackie is awesome! Awesome church and staff!!!

name: Pinelake Church Oxford Campus - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary:
If uplifting music and leaving church feeling good about yourself are your top priorities, then this church may be exactly what you’re looking for. That appears to be its primary focus. The environment is highly personable, from the pastor at another location streamed in on a screen to the enthusiastic greeters at the door, the vocalist that looks like she's convulsing on stage because she is supposedly "feelin' the Spirit"  and the friendly congregation of mostly college kids that refuse to let you in the car line to leave after service (yes, this is sarcasm). BUT hey...they have a nice looking campus.

However, if you’re searching for a church that delivers biblical truth with weight; that is truth that convicts, challenges, and occasionally makes you uncomfortable, this may not be the place. While encouraging, feel-good messages certainly have their place, relying on them most of the time does a disservice to a congregation’s spiritual growth. Christianity is not meant to be a constant self-affirmation exercise. Sometimes the message should hit like a ton of bricks, prompting real self-examination and a deeper commitment to growth in one’s relationship with Christ.

You may not always leave feeling uplifted and that’s okay. In fact, that discomfort is often necessary. To suggest that faith should never challenge or confront is to misunderstand Christianity altogether. And in a community like Oxford, where many could benefit from hearing hard truths rather than comfortable ones, that distinction matters. Chip Henderson inspires me with his commonsense approach to applying & practicing biblical truths & disciplines to our daily lives.   1 of the great things about Oxford is there's a church on almost every corner. So, if this isn't the place for you ~ there's another place just around the corner.  Love worshipping here! Jody is awesome.  Pinelake Oxford has it going on.  Go to early service if you want a seat. Big beautiful church. Very welcoming to everyone. Sunday morning has 3 services. Lots of activities as well. Awesome church!! I've visited twice while visiting with my daughter (attending Ole Miss Law) who attends regularly. Perfect for all ages, but directed at the college crowd. Worship team and pastor are amazing. Everyone is welcome. Parking is a bit crazy, as well as leaving. But there is plenty of room inside. Usually offer coffee and donuts before services. People are super friendly and helpful.

name: Pinewood Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
I moved to Boulder and was immediately welcomed into this community. They're friendly, open, the worship is great, its small enough that you can actually get to know people and the pastors are so friendly and happy to talk to you. 10/10 God shows up at Pinewood Church! This is an excellent community of caring, loving people who are all about meeting people where they are and pointing them to Jesus.

I'm so grateful to have found Pinewood. I was cautiously optimistic after attending my first Sunday service at Casey Middle School. Everyone was so kind and welcoming, but I wasn't sure what exactly Pinewood believed. I came to find out that Pinewood believes in the Bible, showing up to serve others, building a church on love and faith, and giving the glory to God.

Pinewood is home for me and my family. Come as you are and experience the Lord's healing, loving gentleness in your life with a community of wonderful believers! Pinewood has been such a blessing to me. We moved to Boulder knowing absolutely no one, but we made a home very quickly at Pinewood! We love these people, the community they have developed, how much they love and care for us, and we love our Riverside location! I cannot recommend this church enough 💖 In a city that can tend to be more isolated, this place is home. My first time visiting here I knew no one and I left with so many phone numbers and people reaching out to me later in the week inviting me to more! Ever since being here I’ve been encouraged and challenged in my faith through Biblical teaching, or the valuable mentors I’ve been honored to sit under. I’ve found accountability, abilities and skills I never thought possible, and most importantly, a strengthened faith.

A group of imperfect people who are serious about making Jesus Lord over every part of their life.

If for some reason I had to leave Boulder tomorrow, I know I would leave better than I came through being a part of Pinewood Church and their Jesus centered mission. It feels like home! I love Pinewood, I love Pinewood, I love Pinewood. Such a Spirit-filled place and atmosphere to be when you find yourself in Boulder. I feel everyone who gets connected is as a result of the move of God. God’s hand is upon this church and the Pastors are welcoming and filled with passion. I enjoy being part of a crew, we get to read the Word, Pray and Worship. I also love everyone in the church because they make you feel a sense of belonging. The teachings are solid backed with signs and miracles, this can only be GOD!!!! I was glad when they said unto me let us go to the house of God.

name: Pinnacle Church of Christ - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: We were in Little Rock for work and decided to visit the Pinnacle congregation not knowing what to expect. We were kindly welcomed and made to feel special for being there. The Bible class and worship were both biblically based and spiritually uplifting. We hope to be able to visit again. I highly recommend you visit them when in Little Rock. Brother Chuck’s sermons always speak to me in what I’m going through weekly. It’s really Soul Food. This congregation is amazing and a beautiful image of what a Church of Christ should be like. Pinnacle is an awesome congregation to be a part of. We speak where the Bible speaks and silent where the Bible is silent! You will definitely learn about the Bible! Do you want a closer relationship with God? Do you want to be of service to others? We are involved in the community. Everyone is welcome! As the children’s song says, “Red or yellow, black or white”…you are welcome! Pinnacle is a loving church family and a blessing to our community. My father-in-law goes to church here.  We attend with him when we visit Little Rock on the weekends.  The congregation is very warm and friendly.  The song service is a capella, which I prefer.  The preaching is engaging on a solid Bibllical foundation to spread the Gospel.

name: Pinnacle Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Architecturally stunning North Scottsdale sanctuary featuring liturgical beauty, renowned pipe organ and choral music, and thoughtful theological reflection.

name: Pinnacle Presbyterian Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: Architecturally stunning North Scottsdale sanctuary featuring liturgical beauty, renowned pipe organ and choral music, and thoughtful theological reflection.

name: Pioneer Ocean View United Church of Christ - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment I stepped foot into Pioneer Ocean View UCC about 2 years ago, it felt like home. Yes, it's located in a beautiful spot near Point Loma, but there's more to it. It only gets better after you walk through the doors.
The congregation is so genuine, kind, and welcoming! So many people immediately came up to greet me the first time I attended. They took the time to get to know me and make me feel welcome. The church merged two congregations nearly 20 years ago, but you wouldn't know it. Everyone is so open, warm, and kind! You can tell they all care about each other.
Pastor Mary Sue Brookshire is incredible! Her sermons are relevant and applicable to every day life. She is passionate and compassionate. She practices what she preaches. After I became a member, she took the time outside of church to get to know me better.
The congregation cares about the San Diego community - dedicating themselves to important causes, such as climate change, homelessness, immigration, and equality. Just as the pastor practices what she preaches - so does the congregation. There are always opportunities to serve - no matter how small or big.
My favorite part is the lunch fellowship after service. Because everyone is so welcoming, it's always a great time to catch up with people who have become my friends and to get to know other members better. It's all a team effort with different groups taking turns each week to make lunch - which makes it more fun.
Being part of POVUCC has been great and enriching. I definitely recommend visiting and giving it a chance - even if you aren't a churchgoer. We attended Pioneer Ocean View United Church of Christ online last week and in person this week. We experienced an extravagant welcome! We were invited to introduce ourselves or not as we wished. We were treated to a great UCC service. And then we were invited to lunch after worship. Everyone was so friendly! Very welcoming Church with equally amazing view. As a newcomer to Church & religion, I found PioneerChurch to be a friendly, warm & welcoming, place of worship. Pastor Mary Sue has great energy in her presentation & message! She makes Sundays a treat. I attended Yone Shiwotsuka's memorial service and made my first visit to the new physical site for the Church.  I absolutely love the view and location of our new Church.  I also enjoyed meeting and listening to our new pastor during the wonderful service for a wonderful person, Yone.

name: Pipeline Avenue Baptist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Lloyd & Julie & Ken ...love you guys ...God Bless Found it with no problem. Have a blessed day. If you're looking for a good pastor and Bible teacher in a healthy church, this is the place!
Pastor Ernesto and Pastor Lloyd are a blessing!

name: Placentia Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly, sociable. My mo-in-law was choir director for 20 years, back in the 1960's - 80 's. A few remembered her, so I enjoyed some nostalgia. Worship music is modern, upbeat. To be honest, I’ve never attended church here, however this church hosts Music In The Parks choir competition every year. They are excellent hosts, they make a very good hamburger for the kids for a very reasonable price. They provide clean restrooms, dressing rooms and practice rooms for us. I appreciate them very much and am always excited when I see they will again be our competition venue. If their compassion is the same in their congregation, I assume they are a great group if people with whom to worship. Fresh new outlook if you're looking for a progressive and contemporary Place To Worship. Plenty of loving people there and an excellent choir Plus a separate children's ministry. Lots of fun activities for the kids and a modern vibe to the singing with electric guitar, drums, the band Etc. This church loves to reach out to the community and really get involved in this wonderful little city of Placentia. You will definitely feel God's love all around you there. My only negative is how much I miss singing a traditional one or two hymns every week. A genuine family of caring Christian friends to guide you in your walk with God. Inspirational sermons and caring interaction from Pastor Ryan. Great place to build a solid Christian foundation with many opportunities for discipleship. We’re small in numbers, large in fellowship. This establishment was so kind, optimistic, and helpful during a difficult situation and one of the better church services Ive experienced.

name: Placerita Bible Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I went here for a D-now event and this church was awesome. It’s very big and spacious, and we were able to sleep in the nursery and the toddler room. For one of our night activities, this church offered lots of space for us to run. Wow. This church was beautiful. There was live music when doing gospel songs with bass, guitar, singers, drummers, everything else like that. I loved this church. The bathrooms were big and I liked that they offered stalls and were close to where everyone else would be. Worship service in the new building is great. Pastor Adam always talks about the Gospel which is encouraging, uplifting and convicting. The Bible is central and Jesus is always the topic of discussion. The people are friendly, inviting, and the church small groups is where life on life Christian living actually plays out. I love this Church! I often remember how much of God's love was shown to me by this Church. Especially through my Senior Pastor, Pastor Severence. If you are reading this, please pass him this message. You are dearly loved Pastor Severence. I miss you so much, and sometimes this is my only way of contacting you. God will keep watch over your souls, and I will continue to pray for you. And show the love of Christ, like you you showed me. May God bless you, and keep you. May He make His face to shine upon you and give you peace. Shabbat Shalom, and a peaceful Sabbath to you all. Amen! :) Awesome teaching from The Word. Great pastor who reached out with a personal call 2 days after visiting! Worship was wonderful and members were so hospitable! Great Bible Believing and teaching church with large college group.

name: Plainfield Bible Church - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: It has been some time since I last visited this church. The pastor and the congregation  are extremely friendly and make your visit there enjoyable. The church is a bible believing church and worship our Lord Jesus Christ. Biblical preaching, great music, and friendly people. I enjoyed the worship service and the sermon. Expository preaching. Awesome ministers loving people

name: Plainfield Christ Fellowship - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: We have visited this church a several times in person when in the area - we found instant acceptance and we enjoyed the worship; it is a group of loving people. I felt genuinely welcomed, was shown around, and was comfortable the whole time. If I lived nearby, I would definitely want to become a member.  It is a good mix of traditional and contemporary - not a "religious" church by any means, which is good for me because I dislike stuffy churches.  The messages seem to hit home every time so I watch online almost every Sunday - inspirational, Bible-based, uplifting. When I started attending this church at 14, I knew that it would become a staple in my spiritual life. Now, almost seven years later, I am still so grateful for the day that God opened the door for me to come here. We have had many doors as a church, for we are yet awaiting God's provision for a building of our own. Nonetheless, the fellowship has miraculously grown stronger, even with COVID-19 on the loose. If you are seeking to live biblically and serve in a loving community, Plainfield Christ Fellowship is a great place to start. I was 15, and I didn’t know what to do with myself and all my struggles . I was truly wanting to know God more . And I decided to find a church .... well many years later , I am here to tell you that I have never been so radically loved and so practically taught. It’s not about having a church with people - it’s about having a God who can help a church . I am so thankful that I have a place to worship and to learn about the Bible. A loving and honest group of believers. Rooted and grounded in the Word of God. Felt welcomed and like family, with all who were there. I would highly recommend this church to anyone who asks. I look forward to being with them when the Lord allows. I became a member in 2012 and from the moment I entered the doors I felt home.  For me this is a place of peace, a place of worship and most of all a wonderful family in Christ.

name: Plainfield Christian Church - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: We drove by this Church so many times and my son would always say he wanted to visit. We visited for the first time a few weeks ago and loved it! We were greeted and there was one lady who walked us where we needed to go, she was so sweet. The childcare staff was incredible, the praise and worship was excellent, and the service was exactly what I needed. We will be going back! Plainfield Christian Church is outstanding Pastor Luke is amazing and has awesome messages, the presence of Jesus and God are definitely felt here. Everyone is very friendly. If I could give you guys a 0 star I would. We are looking for a new Church because we just moved here. You guys literally talked about giving for a full hour. NOTHING else. You mentioned your goal of 20 million several times. Then the lady gave her "Testimony" and how God told her a number to give and her husband was told a different number. God told her to give both numbers because her assets were not included. She Literally didnt mention Jesus once. You know in the Bible where Jesus flipped tables because his Father's house was turned into a "den of thieves" that's you. The 2 scriptures you shared in an hour were totally taken out of context and you twisted it to make it about giving. One of those scriptures was "Love your neighbor as yourself" that passage has absolutely NOTHING to do with giving. Your message was literally if you dont give your not being loving towards your neighbor. Thats disgusting and very manipulative. Any Church that doesn't hyper focus on the LIFE death and Resurrection of JESUS. RUN FAST. This was so sad. And on the way out I shared my concers with someone at the front. She looked at me like I had 10 heads and didn't even attempt to explain anything about the church or correct me if I was wrong. WHY? because im not and that is what you guys stand for 20 million on a building that needs no upgrades. If I were a new Christian, unbeliever, or wasn't knowledgeable in scripture I would literally never go to Church again after that. But I do know scripture and I will tell you this..you are literally doing the opposite of what the Bible says to do. I love this church, if you love to listen practical teaching then this is the right place. Pastor Luke and other pastors are wonderful! The Thanksgiving dinner was delicious and well-prepared. The people were friendly and very courteous. When the weather warms up, I may be able to attend services.

name: Plainfield Church of Christ - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: I just got baptized to day here May 17 2026. God is to great he died for my sins.  Thanks for the support ladies and new church family. If you are looking for a church that preaches and studies to seek the truth about what God wants this is the place. This church teaches from the Bible and aligns its self with what the Bible says. The people here truly love Christ and strive to embody his presence in their day to day lives. If you’re looking for a loving group of people that are disciples of Christ look no further! After moving from out of state, my family was looking for a church home.  They are very warm and welcoming here.  People of all ages and sound Biblical truths studied and taught here. Wonderful people trying to serve God. Solid bible based teaching and preaching. Loved getting to spend time in the company of the Lord's people. Its always good to see old friends

name: Plainfield Friends Meeting - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary: This is where they have the Plainfield Farmers Market every Wednesday. My grandkids always look forward to going because they can get Italian ice or ice cream, free popsicles and water and this time they had a bounce house. There was a guy singing up on the steps, he sounded great! There was a long line at the Neier tent because they were selling fresh corn, tomatoes, potatoes, zucchini,... The only bad thing about the farmers market is that it is not year round. Plainfield Friends is very welcoming of ALL people. My first day visiting after the service I was welcomed by many of the congregation (FRIENDS). I have been attending for 3 years and grown so much in my faith & know that Jesus Christ is my savior & died for me & YOU! I hope to meet you at a service and be that friend that greets you. God Bless You & keep you safe. Warm friendly people. Take the time to check it out and see if we can help you to meet your spiritual needs. We went to the farmers market. Had fun visiting with the vendors and the people who brought their dogs to the market! A great community program by the Indiana Room employees of the Plainfield Library about historic buildings and people of the town.

name: Plaza Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I want to say that I'm captured by the music. And Pastor Brian's sermons aren't always a Kiss From Christ. Sometimes they bite. What a wonderful community to stumble into. ❤️‍🔥 The best most welcoming church i have ever been to. The service is spectacular. Hard to summarize all that God is doing through this church right now. My family calls Plaza “home” as we continue to see Him move through the people here. From practical Bible teaching on Sunday to a real sense of community throughout the week, Plaza has brought life and added depth to my faith in Christ — something I’ll always be grateful for. I was looking for a church with sound biblical teaching for when I was in town visiting family. I found it here. I enjoyed the contemporary worship music, and the people were very welcoming. When I am in Charlotte , I will be worshiping here. I’ve visited this church twice now, and the service has been immaculate both times. David the Elder is very personable. Thank you.

name: Pleasant Grove Baptist Church - Main Campus
Pleasant Grove Church
reviewSummary: Just started visiting and my experience here has been amazing from the beginning of service until the end. I feel comfortable here and everyone is so welcoming. Pleasant Grove is the warmest and most welcoming church I've attended since being in NC.  The newly installed pastor was also very welcoming and anointed.  I enjoyed my first visit and plan to fellowship there again.  I am looking for a church home where I can attend and not do virtual services, and as the Holy Spirit directs, Pleasant Grove may be my place of fellowship. What a awesome message this pass Sunday from Pastor Perry.  The one. Do you just go to church to say I went or are you the one that praise God and follows him. I was also in a skit  I thought was meaningful. PGC is a loving and  GREAT place to worship. The children and older youths have so much to do. Coming from NYC and DC area my husband and I feel right at home. PGC is the best thing North Carolina has offered us. PGC has ALWAYS been an open, Loving & caring place to worship.  It is truly a church home and there is no doubt that anyone who visits will feel welcomes and loved!

name: Pleasant Grove Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary: Pleasant Grove is the warmest and most welcoming church I've attended since being in NC.  The newly installed pastor was also very welcoming and anointed.  I enjoyed my first visit and plan to fellowship there again. Jesus spoke to the Pharisees and called them "white washed tombs" because from the outside they looked like amazing followers of God, but beautiful tombs are just containers for dead bones. If your outside is perfect, but your heart is wrong there is a problem. This church understands that faith has action and that everything belongs to God and should be used for his glory. It is not our job to pile it up and show it off, we are to use what he provides. I woke up early yesterday morning determined to find me an early morning service. name: Plymouth Congregational Church
reviewSummary:
Unfortunately Sunday March 15th I had one of the most uncompassionate and uncaring experiences I've had in longer than I can remember! My motivation to leave this review is not for my own benefit or my own grievance... But for the 20 to 30 or so people who rely each Sunday on the community meals that rotate between three... Or I should say two fine churches! There happened to be a snowstorm this day, and almost every other amenity of which those who are unhoused are able to avail themselves was closed leaving the vast majority of the population with few or no options other than to just be outside in the wind and the snow and the frigid cold!
Leaving hungry and homeless people who are already suffering with no indication that they are standing and waiting in the ice cold for nothing, without even taking the simple step of changing the marquee board, is something those who consider themselves elite and entitled would do!!!
Yusuf I came here to see 'Saint Joan'. Great place.handicap accessible,long corridors make it feel like the church could go on and on forever. Vibrant staff and diverse community. name: Presbyterian Church of The Master - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Been here a few times to listen to a friend who is part of Festival Singers. This is a very spacious church with couple levels of seating, and the acoustics are great. Can even hear the singers and the audience's claps clearly from the restroom stalls. Great church with fantastic teaching. Very loving. Not too big but big enough it’s great for kids and youth. Love all the youth leaders especially.  Contemporary service has great music/worship with a mix of contemplative and fun songs. My late husband and I attended here for 25 wonderful years, from Pastor Jack Loo through Pastor Jackson!  We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of singing in the choir under the great direction of John Elg!  A need to move out-of-state is the only reason I’m not still there, and, aside from people, the only thing we miss from ÇA is PCOM! ❤️🙏 An excellent evangelical Church. I attend when visiting the area because my children and grandchildren are there, but I would likely choose it in any case, if we lived nearby because of the traditional service with magnificent music and solid Biblical preaching. The pipe organ is excellent, the main musicians truly gifted, the choir is fine, and because there are so few churches today with choirs it's nice to see one continuing that tradition. It's one of the few churches remaining today where you want to stay after the benediction to hear the postlude. The pastors are warm and approachable. They have been remarkably supportive of my children and their family during difficult times. For those preferring a contemporary-style, there is a contemporary worship service and the young pastor leading this service is personally known to me and also excellent. Christ centered and a caring congregation! Tremendous children and youth programs and missional outreach! Beautiful facilities and great biblical teaching by three highly regarded pastors. We've raised our family starting with preschool into adulthood! No regrets! A church at its best!

name: Presence Church - Midland Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this city for work for just a month, during a really heavy season of my life. While looking for churches nearby, I felt a strong pull toward this one. I ended up attending all four of their weekly services multiple times — Wednesday night, Friday night, and both Sunday services (including the Spanish service). Every single one was powerful. I wish I could elaborate even more but I can’t even find the word for how powerful this church is.

God’s presence is so real in this place. Some nights, worship would go longer than expected, and you could just feel the Spirit moving. I learned so much just by observing how people carried themselves and how the fruit of the Spirit was evident in their lives.

One night, a woman prayed over me at a moment when I desperately needed it. God used her in such a powerful way — I truly believe healing came through that prayer. The people here carry a joy that can only come from the Lord.

This church became a place of peace for me when I felt completely alone. I’ve never left a review for a church before — I’ve never even felt prompted to — but I couldn’t stay silent about this experience. The worship team, the pastors, the community… everything about this church reflects God’s heart.

They don’t conform to the patterns of the world, and they don’t operate like any other church I’ve been to. Honestly, I’d move here just to be a part of this house. The Lord dwells here — and if you’re searching for real, Spirit-filled community, this is it.

So I say to you, Thank you presence church and all the poeple in it.  I can’t express my gratitude enough. Keep it up🤍 Great energy, good staff, and fantastic sermons👍👍 I felt at home at this church.. I’m from out of town and I just work here so I’m looking for a church away from home and this one was amazing. I learned something about our precious lord and savior and u can feel the spirit here. I will be going back. Thank you lord! Finding the right church when your travelling can be a difficult choice because you want it to be like your home church. Pray and trust God! This church was awesome! Great message, uplifting songs the deepen my worship experience. Since we were in town for 2 weeks,  we went back a second time! Love coming to church here and worshiping the Lord.  Great people from all different parts of the world seem to come here and it is very wonderful since you can get a very diverse God fearing people here that just want the best for you.
We now have a new pastor here from Australia and they are doing a wonderful job so far for leading our church to new levels.
Come check us out and enjoy the service and the people.

name: Presence City Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
Such an inviting and Bible based church!

From entrance you’re greeted at the door by the sweetest people moving onto their coffee (which is needed in the morning) which they brew Cat & Cloud high quality beans no Folgers here!

Entering there’s a thriving kids ministry with caring attentive staff & volunteers , nursing room for moms and a family room all with couches and TVs to hear the sermon.

Into the sanctuary it’s a warehouse so there are comfy seats in a semi circle to hear modern worship for the first 20 mins & then a Bible based applicable sermon from one of the rotating pastors teaching.

The head Pastor Dan has great biblical knowledge and he makes it a point to meet you after service and talk

Cant say enough about this church

I’ve made the best friends here while attending one of the Bible study groups and we now often cook together and share meals/events outside of church too which is exactly what my life needed.

Come join this coming Sunday!
We have a seat saved for you I love this church, my wife and I have been knowing the Pastors for years now. They have a sincere and genuine heart to love the people God has put under their care to shepherd . They are committed to the call of God on their lives and so is the community of believers that call Presence City Church their home. If you are looking for a place to feel comfortable and at home, stop by, you won’t be disappointed. Big beautiful church. Great Place to Worship The Lord with Family and Friends in Jesus Christ 🙏🙏😊. Momentum was Awesome, and Spirit Filled. I love the community at New Life! There are so many ways to get connected. Small groups, bible studies and so amazing people who are ready to walk with you through any season of life. No matter who you are, New Life makes sure you know that you are loved and that you belong. I absolutely love this church. The people here are genuine and truly are a family. The worship is so anointed and Holy Spirit is moving here! The messages on Sundays always send me off into the week provoked and hungry for more of Jesus.  We also love the Kids Ministry, our kids love the teachers and the fun they have learning about Jesus! Lastly, you can definitely tell that the leadership here is intentional with creating a space for God to move.

name: Preston Road Church of Christ - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
Praise God for a truly blessed and encouraging time of worshipping and fellowshipping with Preston Road Church of Christ. We are deeply encouraged by the warmth, kindness, and genuine love shown to us.

Such a joy to worship alongside believers of all ages, spend quality time in conversation, grow together through the teaching of God’s Word, and share meaningful moments of fellowship as one body in Christ. From the youngest to the oldest, we experienced the beauty of a church family united in faith, love, and service to the Lord.

Thank you for opening your hearts and lives to us, and for receiving us so graciously as family in Christ. Your hospitality, encouragement, and Christ-centered fellowship have been a tremendous blessing to us, and we are grateful for the opportunity to share in what God is doing through your church community.

May the Lord continue to strengthen, guide, and bless Preston Road Church of Christ as you faithfully shine His light and love to others. Wonderful church home. Stick around after service to chat & you will be welcomed! No instruments is new for me, but I’m getting used to it. Very family forward. Bible-believing church dedicated to spreading the gospel. So thankful for God working through the members of this church for 86 years! I came here last weekend with my daughter and her kids. They were very welcoming to guests like me.  Got to hear the President of SMU who is an elder there deliver a wonderful sermon since the usual pastor was out that day.  He gave an amazing speech about science and the faith that I truly enjoyed, as well as a discussion on the power of words and the importance of The Word.  Hadn't been here before but I'd definitely go back when I'm visiting the family.  Thanks y'all for showing such hospitality to an older woman just visiting.  Did my soul good. I just witnessed something this morning that really bother me. There was homeless man knocking at the door asking for some coffee and he was told to leave. It is very sad that we say we love God but can't show love to people's. If you all call this a church. ThanI would like to see what they're teaching. Because Jesus said to those on his right hand when you feed the homeless you done it to me. But the ones in his left is the goats that went to hell. Understand what love is and not just religion.

name: Prestonwood Baptist Church
reviewSummary: Sentiment heavily favors the 'uncompromising biblical teaching' and 'verse-by-verse' expository style. Families are the primary demographic, with the 'KIDZ' ministry and 'Indoor Playground' frequently mentioned as best-in-class. The 'Powerpoint' Christmas spectacular is a regional draw. Parking logistics at the Plano campus are a common minor grievance.

name: Prestonwood Baptist Church - Plano Campus - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
The pastor is not afraid to speak the truth, and his sermons are powerful. The kids ministry is safe and secure, but the little kid ministry (pre-k) videos are too long and there are always teachers talking through the videos so it’s very distracting (and a tiny bit rude- it’s hard enough to focus.) However, they do big lesson cards that reiterate the lesson back in the classrooms so I love that. And I will say all the teachers and volunteers (including me) are SO sweet and love kids. They truly seem to have a passion for Christ and children.

Also, if you have to use the restroom during the adult service you get locked out!!! I have health issues and had to use the restroom and tried to go back. A security guy told me I can’t go back to my seat unless I’m on the back row. He was pretty rude about it and I told him I was on the back row (only by coincidence and God’s grace,) and he did let me in (probably because I was starting to panic and start crying) but he gave a stern warning that once the service starts… if you leave… you can’t get back in. I 100% understand churches needing security, but if you have health issues or are older— this is an issue! Don’t forget your cell to text your husband that you’re not allowed back in.

Also, my mom tried to join this church with us, and they wouldn’t let her be a member unless she got BAPTIZED AGAIN because she wasn’t baptized into a Baptist church. She was baptized at 14 yrs old by being dunked in a tub of water at a non-denominational church. I understand asking people be baptized again if they were sprinkled as babies or never baptized (as those aren’t biblical baptisms,) but my mom was of age, accepted Christ, and dunked in water as a public proclamation; if you’re baptized legit then you’re baptized. I think it’s ethically wrong to demand someone be baptized again.

Don’t get me wrong, this is a Bible-based Spirit-filled church. The sermons and worship are AMAZING. They are so loving and there’s always something going on. Get involved and it’s a wonderful place to be. I just don’t agree with everything they do, and my health makes their security rules hard. Prestonwood Baptist Church is a phenomenal place of worship, and our family is incredibly grateful for the impact it has made in our lives. This summer, our kids attended the Vacation Bible School (VBS), and they had an absolute blast learning about God in a fun, high-energy environment. The entire experience was exceptional, largely thanks to the wonderful staff and volunteers who were incredibly friendly, approachable, and truly dedicated to the children.
The facilities here are absolutely amazing—modern, safe, beautifully maintained, and perfectly equipped for families. If you love the energy, resources, and dynamic worship of a mega-church, this is absolutely the place to be. While the scale of the campus is massive, the church has a beautiful way of making the community feel tightly knit and deeply personal. To experience that close fellowship, you just need to be intentional about plugging in, whether that is through small groups, volunteer ministries, or family events. Prestonwood excels at providing a welcoming sanctuary where families can anchor themselves in a strong, biblical worldview. It is a true blessing to have such a vibrant, Christ-centered community right here to help us grow together in faith. NOT a welcoming or open community for outside families.

I am writing this to warn other parents who are considering sending their children to Prestonwood's youth programs or Vacation Bible School (VBS). We chose to send our 8-year-old daughter here thinking it was a kind, welcoming, Christian environment. Instead, it proved to be an incredibly rigid, exclusionary, and hurtful space.
During a discussion about baptism at camp, my daughter mentioned that she had been baptized as a baby (in our Episcopal tradition). An adult instructor literally told an 8-year-old child that hers "wasn't a real baptism."

To say something so deeply invalidating and disrespectful to a young child is completely unacceptable. We have raised our daughter to respect other people's religious backgrounds, yet she was met with judgment by an adult leader who decided her family’s faith traditions weren't legitimate.

If this church community cannot handle questions, differences, or basic respect for other Christian backgrounds, they need to limit their programs strictly to their own congregation. What my child experienced here was not Christian. Look elsewhere if you want an actual welcoming environment for your kids. We were visiting Dallas and wanted to try a negachurch. Giant churches can tend to get a bad rap. We wanted to decide for ourselves (we went to several on our journey from Canada). This one was very Spirit-led. It was so evident. Far more than we expected. We expected amazing production and professionalism but got so much more.

We were hugely blessed at this church. Treated like royalty when we told them our was our first time. We had front row seats! Pastor Graham came and spoke to us and we didn't even know he was the pastor until he preached. He preached truth unabashedly. You won't get a watered down gospel here. The message was powerful and I couldn't take notes fast enough. Great quote from pastor Jack in the photos.

Worship was quite the production but I don't mean that in a negative way. They are giving their best for God and it was beautiful. Orchestra, huge choir, incredible worship leaders.

After the service we visited the guest center where we were given free passes for lunch (available weekly), a book by Pastor Jack and free kids Bibles for our kids.

The free lunch was fantastic! So much variety. Menu posted. It allows for fellowship. There were hundreds there.

We checked out the gift shop and it was very unique. Not just your typical Christian bookstore wares. A lot of beautiful art especially. We bought an adorable animated kids Bible.

Fantastic experience here in every way. Our kids didn't attend the Sunday school as they wanted to stay with us so I can't speak to that. Such a beautiful sanctuary. Loving staff was very helpful and got everything rolling right away to transfer my membership from my former church. Looking forward to making this my new home church.

name: Prince of Peace Abbey - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s an experience that you have to live through the twists and turns. A modern catholic approach church and cemetery. Then there is the little hike and the coyote land below. Don’t leave plants on the walking path, the monk will toss every flower offering you leave.
He also wants the prayer garden clean, no flowers! My family loves the Prince of Peace Abbey. We attend mass every year during Holy Week. It is so peaceful. Plus, their gift shop is amazing. They also have a retreat center. Their Eucharistic Chapel is really special. I visited the Prince of Peace Abbey for a personal day retreat of prayer. I was greeted by their Monk Andrew, who kindly welcomed me. I'm of the Protestant affiliation and he assured me they welcome visitors of different denominations/religions. I wanted to make sure I was respectful of their Abbey. I enjoyed using their Prayer Walk path for my own time of prayer. It's an endearing little walk that winds to a little gazebo, where you can see the hills on one side and a glimpse of the ocean on the other. The grounds were beautifully laid out. Inside their sanctuary, the open spacing is warmly decorated and inviting for reflection. I didn't attend any of their services, so I'm unable to speak to them. Overall, a beautiful place to visit for a personal retreat! I wanted to start 2026 with a visit to this church, and it turned out to be a really peaceful experience. The atmosphere was serene, the architecture beautiful, and the stained glass especially stood out and it created such a calm, reflective feeling. We spent a few minutes meditating, and it was definitely worth the visit.
The surroundings are lovely as well. There’s a short hike around, but since it had rained, the trail was very wet, so we skipped it this time. We’ll save that for another visit.

name: Prince of Peace Episcopal Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Great and beautiful community, and wonderful service. Wonderful people living their faith in action. True angels on earth. Very serene, place people there that work here are angels sent from heaven. Volunteer their time and energy. Lord shepherds. I love this church, everyone made you feel welcomed, from the time you walked through the door until the time left. The energy and spirit was awesome. I've been there a few times and enjoyed every visit. I left feeling refreshed, and what a great feeling to have. By the way, my kids and other family members loved it to. I recommend this church. name: Pritchard Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Clean youth facilities. Numerous amenities for participants. Easy access for entry into sports activities.
