name: Progressive Baptist Church - Gulfport Campus
reviewSummary: I went to see my cousin Dr. B.W. Parks speak and was pleasantly surprised. The congregation was friendly and welcoming. You could feel the love through their smiles and song! I definitely felt good after church with them! Only being in Mississippi a short while I met this young pastor at a funeral I really liked what he had to say. I seen some fire for Jesus in him. I also seen him reaching out to are younger people Wich is a much needed thing here in Mississippi. I come from a church with over 2000 members not in this area and am doing some missionary work in are community. This young pastor has the fire to move this community. Look forward to seeing more of this church. God Bless Go fellowship if your in Gulfport, Ms. Pastor Braxton is a true deliver of the WORD of GOD. I'm not sure how they are worshipping due to Covid-19  so please check on line first. 7 Stars Very friendly and kind people and the pastor is the nicest man u well meet I LOVE THE CHURCH. THE MESSAGE WERE RIGHT ON TIME. THE MEMBERS AND PASTOR ARE VERY FRIENDLY.

name: Progressive Community Church - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary:
Been going to this church since it was started. The pastor breaks down the Bible so we'll that my 8 year old God daughter rather sit and listen to pastor than go to children's church. The people are very loving and welcoming. We have a mixed race congregation and even have Spanish services after the English service. If you want to learn the Bible for yourself, then this is your church! They have an awesome children's ministry as well. Come visit one Sunday and see for yourself. We're a large yet loving church!!! I was there to see my son-in-law’s mother being honored for her services of over 30 years. And it was a very, very beautiful service. The atmosphere was very welcoming. If I lived in Stockton, I would definitely go to that church.. God has placed me where He is moving in my Life
And I Love everything about Progressive Community Church 💯💕🙏🏾 I love this church. I love the praise and the worship. I am definitely on full every time I leave pastor Shield and his wife and family, beautiful, beautiful people. Beautiful people. I plan to join and I want to get more involved. Especially, I would love to be a greeter. I would love to sing, but I cannot sing so I'm hoping that one day I can be a greeter. My name  is sister Antoinette Gamble And I do tide's an offering. Friendly, welcoming congregation.   The pastor does not 'preach'. Which is my preference.  No made-up rituals.  No begging for money.  Just lessons from the Bible and fellowship. I grew up in church with a wonderful 'preacher', and I still love a good down-home sermon. But I have gained more knowledge as I continue to develop my relationship with God from those who teach.  Pastor is a wonderful  teacher of the Bible.  He seems a humble man and is a fascinating storyteller.  The church supports the community and offers various life enhancing ministries/groups to become a part of.   I've been visiting for months now, and I am just about ready to become a member.

It's been 3 months since I wrote the above.  I am so happy to report that I am now a member!  I can hardly wait to see which ministry I am drawn to.

name: Project Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary: I wasn’t even looking for a church or God but I got invited by a Baptist family member who stumbled across the church in downtown. I started coming back in 2015. My first impression was why was everyone so happy I couldn’t understand how and why but I kept on coming with a cynical, skeptical, & prideful mindset. Every single service I always came with a humble heart that I might not know it all but this Jesus guy might. And sure enough I had an encounter with God at the church in 2019. Which led me to want to reach out to Pastor Caleb. I always thought he was a difficult person to reach but he’s always around in the lobby in between services talking to church members and guests. I slowly started applying the practical steps Pastor Caleb recommended in my life and I couldn’t be happier with all the difference it’s made in life in terms of community, faith, & most importantly family. No one made me or forced me to ever do anything it was always done out gratitude and love for all that the Church has done for me. I say church because it wasn’t just Pastor Caleb that helped me in my life it was the countless other church members that I have met here that led community groups, events, worship nights, Bible studies, & countless other services. My relationship to God has never been this strong and I’m grateful to say that anyone can experience this through this ministry. I’ve learned that God welcomes our questions and skepticism, just ask any of the pastoral staff and they’ll get you the answered or connected with the right person. Would highly recommend you and/or your loved ones to plan a visit if you’re looking to be encouraged in your faith journey. I have attended Christian churches for decades and heard many preachers. I went to Project Church for the first time today and was blown away! I was immediately drawn to Pastor Caleb's dynamic heartfelt preaching on Philippians. His style of preaching is so incredibly dynamic truly powerful and uplifting--resonated with me on a deep level. I am so happy I attended service there with my family today and I feel like I found the church that I have been looking for. It's not a mega church like the church that I have been attending the past decade. The people were very welcoming and I can see myself worshipping here for a long time if I can find fellowship with people of senior age. Most of the people who attended services were young. Good worship and good preaching. My kids love it! Amazing church!! Pastor is on fire for God, and doesn’t sugar coat or water down anything! Feels like a big family! I'm biased because I'm a church partner, but love what the leadership is all about. This place is legit about their spirituality.

name: Promise Christian Church - LCMS - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Our Familys Church for over 10 years! We love Promise ❤️ We love this church so much!!!

name: Promise Church Chico - Chico Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely LOVE this church ! As soon as we walked into the building this feeling of “home” came over us and the rest is history! My family has been going for six years and our lives have been filled with more joy, love and peace than we have ever thought possible. Our pastors are amazing and the people are the most genuine and loving humans I’ve ever had the privilege of knowing. If you are looking for your new home, check it out you won’t be disappointed!! Love Promise Church so much! Pastor Jose is a wonderful pastor with a true love for God. His sermons are scripturally soaked, well spoken, and provide you with true application for your life. The entire Promise Church family are so loving and are always there to pray, laugh, and share with you in life's ups and downs. There is also amazing worship at every service and a focus on glorifying God.  They even have groups for kids, young adults, marriages, men and women, and more. You truly feel like a part of a larger family here! My family LOVES Promise Church. The worship experience is awesome! I always feel Gods presents in it. Their kids church is so relevant to todays day and age but focuses on learning about God, being safe and having fun. The message is always very impacting. Pastor Jose has a true gift in ministering and teaching. I love how many families go to promise.

This church has become my family away from home. My husband and I love going here.

Sometimes my family will visit from 5 hours away and they always want to go to Promise Church when they come visit my husband and I. I absolutely love this church.  My family and I have been attending for almost six years now.  This church has become more like family through the years.

I love the authentic messages Pastor Jose brings each week and the ability to stay connected throughout the week with  small groups.

I also love that I can trust the volunteers in the back of Kids Church with my children.   As a mom of two littles , it’s important for me to feel like I trust people with my children who I know will care for them and teach them about Jesus !! We went for the backpack drive and it was a success. Cute options and prizes for the kids. We don't attend services here but we're treated as though we did.

name: Promise Community Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: Place where you can find a peace and tranquility. A church that preaches the true gospel! I have found a church where the Word is alive! Thank you for guiding me to a church that preaches only the true Jesus Christ amidst the countless words pouring out! A community of life that becomes disciples of Jesus through the Word and the Holy Spirit and achieves the ‘3/30/300 World Vision’ A church with true love and the word of grace A church that does what is in the Bible, and does not do what is not in the Bible, even if it is inconvenient!

name: PromiseLand Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
Just moved here from Louisiana. My first time visiting Promisedland and I will  be calling this place home. The  congregants were exceptionally friendly, the atmosphere was beautiful, the praise team was phenomenal and the pastor was  a great orator. Gods presence was definitely felt. PromiseLand Church is a large congregation with a diverse crowd of attendees and members who are generally welcoming.

PROS:  The contemporary music and worship team are absolutely amazing! I've felt very moved every service and love how into it the crowd gets. You can also feel a lot of unity here when everyone prays together. Pastor Robin is genuine and his sermons always hit home. My child loves attending PromiseKids during service and I trust the adults there.

CONS:  While I'd say most of the staff/members here are friendly, especially the greeters and the folks at PromiseKids, I've felt very judged by some of the other people here. Sometimes I feel like it's a club I want to join but don't have access to. And because PromiseLand attracts so many people each service it is easy to get lost in the crowd, so to speak. I honestly feel like just another number here. These things have made me wary and prevented me from becoming further engaged with the church community. I most likely will not pursue an official membership unless some of the attitudes here change. In the meantime I've been visiting other local churches and hoping to find a better sense of belonging elsewhere. I have been attending this church for 11 months now. I was initially interested because of one of their podcast sermons I heard while at work. I was just reclaiming my walk with the Lord after 13 years of not walking with Him. So I needed a welcoming place where I felt I could worship freely, get into community, and truly learn about the gospel. God is doing something pure at PromiseLand. I instantly fell into tears during worship feeling the Holy Spirit moving through the room. I have always been welcomed with a warm smile and greeting. Additionally, the small groups at the church have been a great way to get involved and feel real support from God's church. This church is so wonderful my husband also reclaimed his walk with the Lord and rejoiced when he found out he'd be able to spend his birthday (which landed on a Sunday) in this church. Further, getting involved through serving has blessed me in more ways than I thought initially. I have been serving in the toddler room for over 8 months now and continue to fill with joy when I hear a little one's voice say "Jesus loves me" or "Amen". Finally, this is the first church I have felt genuinely comfortable to tithe at. I know my money is going towards world-wide missionary trips, feeding my local community, fellowshipping with the youth and the elderly, hosting fun nights for the church body, and even as simple as providing communion every First Wednesday (which is a moving experience all in and of itself). From the bottom of my heart, I recommend PromiseLand to anyone who is either just starting, reclaiming, or seasoned in their walk with the Lord. This church accepts everyone. I was at a low point in my search for God when PromiseLand San Marcos was doing their first ever church service in our town.  They were preaching the word at Jackson Chapel and I had seen an advertisement posted somewhere in town.  I was not a church goer in those days and felt as if I wasn’t worthy enough to even be in the same room as those “holy people”…..lol, a friend saw me walking away to leave and he encouraged me to come in….needless to say I’m glad I did!  That was over 20 years ago and I’m so thankful for their commitment to teaching and spreading the gospel.  Join us if you are searching for a home church! When we moved to Texas a few years ago, I never could have imagined finding such a wonderful church home. The people of Promiseland are incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming. We have felt supported and encouraged in every step of our Christian journey! The church leadership are so real and approachable. I genuinely miss it so much when I can’t make it on Sunday.

name: Propel Church - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary: Evan is a wonderful preacher and even better person. I use to play high school basketball with Evan and knew him as a friend. He is the truth, a Man of God that lives and preaches the gospel. He has a wonderful family and I believe in his purpose! Thank you Evan for everything you do I will always follow you. The church is truly diverse (a lot of churches promote that when “you” are the diversity). A relaxed, Bible-based place of worship. A gem in Acworth! Great worship and very kind and welcoming congregation!  Pastor is very knowledgeable and broke the sermon down in a way that was personable and easy to digest. What a wonderful experience! Pastor Evan really knows how to relay God's Word and bring people together. The world needs more people like him. I’m thankful to call Pastor Evan a friend and trusted advisor. The messages he delivers at Propel are always thought provoking, insightful and full of positivity. Can’t wait to attend live next time I’m in town.

name: Providence Baptist Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Joining PBC has been such a blessing for our family! It’s truly a breath of fresh air and an uplifting place to grow in faith. Our kids absolutely love the children’s ministry, especially Ms. Elizabeth and the choir teams. Wednesday night dinners have become a staple for fellowship, and we’re so grateful for the welcoming community. We can’t wait to get even more involved in outreach and development. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, this is it! Providence Baptist is a place where your faith will  thrive. Whether you’re a parent, grandparent, or single, you’ll find a supportive community and a vibrant kids’ ministry. I highly recommend checking it out!

If you have children, you’re in for a treat, PBC has an outstanding kids’ ministry.

Engaging Lessons: The children’s program offers age-appropriate lessons that are both fun and educational. They use creative methods to teach biblical principles.

Caring Volunteers: The volunteers genuinely care about the kids. They take the time to connect with each child, making them feel valued and loved.

Safe Environment: Safety is a top priority. The check-in process is efficient, and the facilities are secure. Providence is a caring, active community of believers!  We have so many programs for people of all ages.  Our  children can participate in choirs, a wonderful Vacation Bible School, a special Christmas Eve service just for them, sports programs and RA's/GA's on Wednesday nights to name a few.  Teenagers have similar programs and an educational, but fun event on Sunday nights.  Adults can play basketball or pickleball, attend classes on Wednesday nights such as book club or prayer discussions, or volunteer for our Room In The Inn program or missions projects.  The best part of Providence is the welcoming atmosphere provided by members.  I love my church! Having grown up in this fantastic church, I am bias. However, after living throughout the Charlotte area for the past decade, our family has visited and attended other churches that were closer to our home.

We are back at Providence Baptist Church because it is home. The people are engaged, friendly and there are no expectations. Come as you are.  I was never great at bible drills so I also appreciate that I will not get called out to read bible versus!

The children's programming is incredible. As new parents, my wife and I were excited to have a few minutes to go to a traditional feeling worship service and know that our babies were looked after by loving church members.

Come check out why Providence Baptist is so special! We have been members since 1978. Our church family is very important to us. We have great Sunday morning faith formation classes for all ages and meaningful worship experiences. Our church is mission minded. Join us if you want to make a difference in our community.

name: Providence Bible Fellowship - West Chester Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a Reformed Southern Baptist church with powerful expository Biblical teaching from Pastor Greg. It is refreshingly Gospel-centric in all aspects.

People are polite and courteous.

Strong Biblical Counseling ministry which remarkably rejects psychology and even so-called, “Christian psychology”.   This includes pastorally trained members who actively participate in counseling those in need.   All is Biblical leading to a deeper walk with the Lord. My wife and I became members of Providence Bible Fellowship a few months back and we’ve been exceedingly blessed by the church family that we’ve found. Everyone here is very loving and exemplifies what it means to live like Christ. The elders take great care of the church and that shows at every level. If you’re looking for a church that unashamedly preaches the Word of God and nothing else, then this it. Bible teaching, people, and everything else about this church are all so amazing. This place truly lives up to what it says it is: God-Centered, Bible-Focused, Gospel-Driven..... PRAISE THE LORD!! I am surrounded by the best people I have met in my life every week. I learn the truth that is Bible-centered. Life-changing. A biblical church with a wonderful love for Christ and his church.

name: Providence Church - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to Prov Church since 2019. I absolutely love it! The Pastors stay true to the word of God and often preach about love and respect to all. I always appreciate the historical context Pastor Jacob provides along with reading the scripture. They’re also very committed to giving back to the community & helping people. God has spoken to me through their sermons on multiple occasions and every time it happened, He fulfilled His promise. Providence Church is such a welcoming environment, it really was easy to become a member here after having some struggles with past churches. All the pastors preach with immense humility and grace, the focus is always on Jesus from start to finish, and the music is wonderful! I didn’t feel welcome at all. I wasn’t greeted by anyone when I stepped in the Church. A lady placed a phone on the seat next to her to make sure I didn’t sit beside her. Then after Church I went to the section where new people should go when the gentleman, not sure if he was the pastor ask me with a weird expression on his face if I was from the area. I will not be going back. I don’t know if my complexion has something to do with it. I drove down to Mt. Juliet, from Indiana, to spend Easter weekend with our daughter, who had moved to the area in November 2024.  She was excited to take me to the church her and her friends had found... Providence.  So we went to Easter service and I was impressed.  Such a beautiful church.  But more important than anything, I could feel the presence of Holy Spirit.  I'm glad our daughter and her friends have found a Bible teaching church with a priority of building a personal relationship with Jesus Christ.  Pastor Jacob even emailed me and welcomed me to return anytime we're in the area.  Thank you Providence Church! May God continue to bless your church. Great community church. A place for anyone who wants to worship Jesus. Great praise band, inspiring messages. Come and see for yourself!

name: Providence Church Murrieta - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Grand Oak Realty have been attending Providence Church Tenaja since it’s opening day. We have finally found our church home. Great teaching and worship.
These people really love God.
You'll feel welcome here. 5 stars all the way. The preaching was just what we were looking for, the people and leadership were extremely welcoming to our family. It was also a very clean environment. We can not wait to come back next week and start getting involved. This is why MVC is AWESOME: Loving shepherds who truly care for you and your walk with the Lord, multi-generational family, faithful biblical preaching, solid sound doctrine, AMAZING worship, and discipleship opportunities. I have found my forever church home! :) First time visitor. I felt very welcomed. There were a lot of smiles. Great preaching and congregational singing.

I've been to a lot of churches, and this one has definitely fostered the most welcoming atmosphere Had such a pleasant time here! Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. reviewSummary:

What I can speak to are the five (yes, five) mosquito bites that I have on my neck and forehead. It would have been more if I did not kill the mosquito that was biting me.

I would consider taking down this review if they addressed their stagnant spawning ground. Thank you. Extremely welcoming and friendly people.  Sharon and I enjoyed spending Easter Sunday with your church. We hope to see you again very soon. God bless. The New pianist @ pulski heights church in Little Rock is fantastic 💯 ~THE PIANO MAN~❣️💜👍 Only one star because the church is closed indefinitely.

name: Pulse Church - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary: I've always had a hard time in churches that I've been to. Learning about god and the Bible has always been difficult, but paster Todd describes the Bible in a way that I understand it makes me more positive in what I'm learning. One of the things I love about him is that he admits and knows he is human and that he is looking for God just as much as all of us. I love this church because everyone there is like family to me. I especially love the videos they make it makes me laugh every time The best place to go and start your week learning about the word of God. Great Place to find Jesus, Peace and Friends! Great Worship and Message. This church is like a second home. Love it, 10/10

name: Purpose Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I showed up here almost by accident. We were on our way to church and realized we had left too late. We almost went back home but decided we would pivot and let God guide us and ended up here as we could check our kids in and get to service on time.
We were welcomed many times, there seems to be a great community, my 8 yo was so excited about everything she learned, so they actually had her engaged instead of just playing!
My husband and I loved the hard truths, brutal honesty and conviction. Everything he spoke of really matched what we want for our families and aligned with our values. There is such a realness in Pastor Josh’s message that is relatable and honorable. Went to this church today after watching last weeks service online. It is exactly what people who are inspired to go to church need at this time. Loved the message, the approach, the simplicity and the sense of community. Pastor Josh and his wife Jess were very welcoming. They also have security measures for kids area, and different groups for kids based on age. Already looking fwd to the next service. Walking up to church for the first time and having the senior pastor come up to me out of the blue and introduce himself was an amazing experience that I hadn’t had in other churches I attended in the valley.
The spirit of God is definitely in this place. It is in no small part, because the Word of God is preached here. It is the foundation and the emphasis. What the Bible says is without a doubt taught here. I will definitely be coming back and looking for an opportunity to serve God as He sees fit. We are new to Goodyear Az and we needed to find a church to be involved with…so I prayed before doing a search asking God to lead us to a Christ centered Bible believing church!  I checked the list of core values and beliefs of Purpose Church and attending today confirmed we were led to the right place!  Thank you Pastor Josh for a fantastic God inspired message!🙏🏼 I attended Purpose Church for the first time today and had such a great experience! I felt completely comfortable leaving my child in the kids’ center. The team there was welcoming and made it easy to trust that my little one was in good hands.

The sermon was both funny and powerful. The pastor had a great sense of humor but also delivered a meaningful message that stuck with me. Worship is always my favorite part of church, and I absolutely loved the worship team here! The music was heartfelt and uplifting.

Overall, it felt like a warm, genuine community, and I’m already looking forward to coming back!

name: Purpose Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Usually when you are new and walk in to a 155 years old mega church, you hardly get noticed there. However, their entire staff was very friendly and helpful, a nice gentleman even gave me a hug when I was looking for a place to sit and I had never met him before. It turned out to be the lead pastor, Eric Holmstrom who gave me a hug and was genuinely passionate about serving Jesus Christ. This is a place where you feel like home and brothers and sisters welcome you with open arms no matter what. Their choir and band are really good too! I absolutely love this place. Their "Journey To Bethlehem" in December is absolutely amazing. I found this church by a flyer that they put in my daughters private schools office. They were advertising their event and I went one year and I will forever share about this church. It's in a ... what you would call, "bad location" but their church is modern and looks brand new. It's very beautiful. You wouldn't think this church belonged there. Try them out, their people are very friendly too. We had the blessing  of being able to attend Purpose Church Services on Easter Sunday. Pastor Eric is amazing and has the gift of reaching hearts for the Lord. Very awesome church. Only wish I was closer so we could attend regularly. There are churches that you don't feel like going back, but not this one. The atmosphere, the service, the worship songs,   are full of heavenly energy. I just wanted to find a church for a memorial service for my husband. This place not very Godly. So sad for a so called church

name: Purpose World Church - Snellville Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming, inviting environment.  The spirit of God is evident upon entry and the entire congregation,  especially the pastor, is sensitive to and allows the Holy Spirit to free flow but in decency and in order. He wasn't on his own agenda stil, trying to preach his sermon after The Holy Spirit wanted worship.  We were not in all day either!! Still had time for family after. My teenage son engaged in worship and wants to return 🙌🏽🙏🏽❤️ Great place and always help feed the public on wensday.s on special dates only What a great church that caters to the hungry and people’s needs.... Me and my fiance had the beautiful opportunity to get to know Pastor Jimmy and his wife Lashawn, Ms. Libby, Terrell. And for us it's been like getting to know family. They all pour their hearts out for the community, truly. It's truly beautiful to see people give with a giving heart and do it with genuine LOVE. I appreciate what this church does for everyone. But nothing I've appreciated more is just the genuine compassion and kindness and friendliness that's always given when we come for help for food. The fellowship here is far beyond any I’ve ever experienced. You can feel the holy spirit when you walk in. I am so thankful that I’ve found my church family!

name: Pursuit Christian Church - Stockbridge Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing Pastor great people

name: Quail Springs Baptist Church - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary:
VBS at Quail Springs Baptist Church was top tier! Our family has participated in VBS for decades both as volunteers and by simply sending their children for discipleship and growth. The drop off and pick up of children was both quick and felt it safe. The process was definitely thought through and I was actually very impressed with how smoothly it went. Also, the content and teaching aspect was well done. Also, kiddos to whomever had the idea to save the arts/crafts projects until the last day and sent it all home in a bag! Nice work, we loved going through it with our child and hearing him talk about each items and what he learned about the gospel through creating each little project. Also, just the excitement of just seeing his projects days later was really fun for him. If I were to make any recommendation it would be evening VBS because we both have daytime jobs and getting our son there for drop off and pick up wasn't always easy with jobs. Daytime/morning VBS makes it to where we as prents are unable to serve. But we know that morning/daytime VBS fits well for other family dynamics. We would attend either VBS offering because we value the ultimate goal of VBS and believe the minor inconvenience a small price to pay for the opportunity VBS gives to spread the gospel. Great job QSBC staff and volunteers!! I have attended Quail Springs Baptist Church almost ever since I moved back to Oklahoma. It is a loving and welcoming congregation. The church services are always uplifting and meaningful. The class that I attended is wonderful. The teaching in that class and the songs of praise are most inspirational. I highly recommend the experience I have had each and every Sunday at Quail Springs Baptist Church!
Sincerely written by Mary L. Andersen I come from a smaaaaaall town, so my church growing up was maybe 100-150 people. To me that made it feel like family! I was definitely a little skeptical of going to a mega church AKA QSBC, BUT!! It might be a mega church in size, but it’s a small church at heart. I joined a connect group and we quickly found our church “family.” For a large church quail does an excellent job of making you feel connected. We are very grateful for our church.

Most importantly our pastor shares the gospel every service. I attended Easter Service with my sister and her family. I very much enjoyed the praise and worship but even more the pastor and the message that he shared was very biblical and a beautiful message. I don't live in Oklahoma City but I will visit again when I visit my sister I have began watching his messages online. QSBC is a welcoming place with many types of accommodations for newcomers. Whether you’re young or old, Man or Woman, single or family, there’re plenty of ways to fit in. And, bottom line, the Gospel, which is why the church exists in the first place, is preached weekly. They care whether or not you have a personal relationship with Jesus. That’s the most important part of any soul in this world.

name: Queen City Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Queen City Church since 2019 and God has truly changed my life through this church community.

Pastor Brian is so intentional with his teachings from scripture and guides the congregation through biblical messages that encourage AND challenge my faith to get better and better.

This church and its leadership does not shy away from hard things, but walks with you through them, always pointing you back to Jesus, and for that I am so so grateful! Genuinely the best church ever! I have been going here since August 2024, and I have never questioned leaving! I started going to the Young Adults services and found individuals who were seeking Jesus fully, and not when it was convenient.

This church has truly changed my relationship with Jesus. The leadership team will equip you with life long strengths.

I did not know how good life could get, until the pastors and team taught me how good of a God we serve!

If you are looking for a church! Everyone here is so welcoming and they truly want to get to know you! I’ve been to a lot of churches in the Cincinnati area throughout the past 10 years of my life, but always came back to Queen City. I was drawn to the Spirit led sermons and authenticity of the people there. When I decided to get rooted in a life group and serve within the church, the people there started to feel like family to me! I went from a lukewarm Christian with one foot still in the world, to a fully devoted follower of Christ! I give Jesus all the credit for the work He did in my heart, but I know He used this wonderful church to help me get to where I am today. If you’re looking for a church home, you’ll find it here!

I have called this church home for many years now and have never been a part of a community so eager to build up and point me to the Cross of Jesus every single time we meet. Now I have the pleasure of raising my 9 month old child in this house and could not be more encouraged or hopeful for the future of our family growing with other families at Queen City Church! I absolutely love this church! The services are uplifting, and the community is so welcoming. I also appreciate that they offer three Sunday services—and that each one has the pastor and worship team live, not just on a screen. It truly makes every service feel personal and meaningful. What I love most is that each message is centered on the Word of God and deeply rooted in Scripture.

name: Queen Creek Bible Church - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary: What a great place with awesome people and elders that revere Gods word and unapologetically preach the truth of His word. Very thankful for this Body of believers ! Really love this church... Everything you could want in a family church... Warm and friendly, awesome worship, and outstanding bible teaching. Our grandkids loved the sunday school as well. If you like a smaller church where you can actually get to know people and be known yourself, give this one a try.  You'll get strong Biblical preaching from the pastor and the love of Jesus from the welcoming staff & congregation. LOVE this church!! Everyone is so kind and welcoming, the sermons are biblically based, & I always love the worship and being surrounded by a congregation eager to worship and serve. So thankful we found our church home here after moving. Could not recommend this church enough if you’re looking for one in the Queen Creek area! Just started going to Queen Creek Bible Church a few months ago. Each sermon digs deep into the word. Everyone at the church is super friendly. They have plenty of small groups and other ways to get plugged in.

name: Queen Creek Family Christian Church - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Don brings God's Word to life!  He teaches through the whole counsel of God illustrating it in common sense, modern terms so that God's Word may infuse you and change you forever! We read from new king James version. Have worship then sermon. No crazy theatre. If you looking for real ministry qcfcc is best bible based church Great church with a great pastor with a small but growing and great congragations as well as services. I highly recommend this church to any near by Christians. Down to earth, very welcoming community! 😊

name: Queen of Angels Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
Queen of Angels in western Riverside area is a beautiful church located between residencies.

Although I am not a regular parishioner here, I have attended Mass as a visiting guest musician for my friend’s wedding, various rehearsals, and another special event Mass held by the diocese.

The layout of the church is circular and the font is at the back. Entering the church, you have a view of the beautiful altar and large crucifix, and the choir section off to the left.

Being so spacious, the acoustics can sound a bit sloppy but given the right sound system settings, it can sound beautiful.

There are plenty of parking spaces here.

Overall, very beautiful church for prayer and worship. Really nice church but never in my life have I experienced a churches getting closed during mass it is the house of god no church should be closed specially if there’s enough space to sit the people that help the priest are very rude my sister and I wanted to get our blessing from the priest and he wanted us to get it from one of the priest helper and we respectfully said no and he kept on insisting for us to go with the helper my apologies but once again no one should be denied from going to gods home the first couple to marry at Queen of Angels Catholic Church """ Israel Gonzalez y kary Avila September 17 2016
La primera boda celebrada en la iglecia Queen angels Catholic Church septiembre 17 2016 My most recent review here of a wedding photographed in July 2025 I'm sorry but I try to give zero stars to any church, regardless of religion that doesn't have nor take time to answer a phone call. By this I mean any call.  On several occasions I've tried calling in to check on mass times for family members and all that I get is either a pick up and quick hang up. Sometimes I've gotten a phone pick up with no answer. The reason why this makes me very upset, is that the churches donot hesitate on asking for money before mass is over, to help with any given reason, " for the churches benefit,  of course ". Quite frankly this is one of many, many reasons why I donot  attend church. It's always about money and their benefits.  If the church is going to have offices where you can go and join and ask questions on their time, and not be there when someone needs to get a hold of someone there, then the church and by church I mean whoever is in charge  . Maybe the Vatican.  The Vatican is so filthy rich  that they cannot afford a clerical associate to pick up the darn phone. It's very concerning.

name: Queen of Angels Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I watch your live Masses and hope to attend in personal some day, God willing. Since I started visiting this church in August of 2017, I have become a regular parishioner.  It just feels so good to attend the Tridentine Latin mass here. Very solemn, peaceful and heavenly...never going back to the modern mass. This church does not compare to the 2 Catholic churches in scv. It its the one church we compare to every other church. The only...only draw back is the size. It is overwhelming when its packed. My son did his first communion here a few years back. I am glad I was able to share the traditional mass with him Wonderful to be able to attend and assist at the true Latin mass. We travel a total of 5 hours round trip to Queen of Angels. Father Redecki is wonderful and the parishioners are all so kind and welcoming. I thank God for Queen of Angels. This is the True Catholic Church, the True Religion, the Bride of Christ, with faithful shepherds.  Do not accept any erroneous imitations nor those who have fallen along the way, calling themselves Catholic, but, practicing a new and false religion. Here, you may worship God in Spirit and in Truth, as It remains and will remain throughout the ages, until He returns. God bless you.

name: Queens Christian Alliance Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Hey folks. For those who are seeking a home church, seek no more. Come and join us in seeking and worshipping the Lord Jesus. This is one of those churches that you will not only call my home church but a place where you will stay for life. For those who are seeking for a "Christian church" come and join us on Sunday mornings @ 11a. For the English service. Come and give a chanc. See you there. Very welcoming and kind people. You can feel the love of Jesus as soon as you walk through the doors. Such a rich and multicultural community. I highly recommend. Large church, nice space. Sister had her wedding here.
Friendly people, good environment. Google needs to provide a link to report bad information. This photograph and the linked to address is WRONG! It needs to be corrected to the correct address.  135-20 35th Avenue, Flushing NY 11354 is the correct address. The telephone phone number is correct along with the URL. God is truly at work in this Church, you feel the presence of God here and feel right at home.

name: Quench Life Christian Fellowship - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: The Bible-based teaching is great! I love our growing church. It has a “small group” feel and is definitely a “Community of Kindness” as it’s described. Nice folks, live music, non-denominational. Great for leaders or those who want to be. Warm, welcoming environment that makes you feel like you are among friends! Definitely a place where you can grow. Quench Life is a place of love, community and spiritual growth I love the community we are building and how God has shown us His favor!

name: Quest Church | Clairemont Campus - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I am visiting from out of town and did some research before deciding on a church. I am so glad I chose to visit Quest, it was a huge blessing to be here this sunday! There were volunteers greeting people outside, a friendly atmosphere among everyone inside, meaningful worship service, and a biblically accurate sermon. The pastor did a great job referencing SO many scriptures and teaching about them all in just one hour! I would definitely make this my home church if i lived in california again! We are locals in the neighborhood and went to their annual Christmas event. It was very well organized with caring and informed volunteers. The 1 star rating is for the live animals they paid to have at this event - they were all terrified, the goat looked absolutely miserable and out of it being unable to even lay down comfortably. I felt sooo bad for them. The bunnies and guinea pigs were terrified with all the loud noises and rough handling by the kids. They all arrived in metal cages without any blankets. It felt wrong to be in a church witnessing animal exploitation that they paid for. I love it, this church have English service, set free for people who want to reliability , they make you feel like a family.
For Hispanic families they have a service. If you looking for a church this is the right place.

name: Quest Church | El Cajon Campus - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been to this church twice and I won’t go back. I didn’t feel welcomed at this church at all. This church has been there for seven years and they don’t have a welcoming committee that is supposed to be there to welcome the all the people. It also helps people to feel comfortable. I had a couple of email conversations with the second Pastor, The first one sounded like he really cared. The second one sounded like he was making it about himself. If you want a temporary church because you’re visiting and are there just for the sermons, and you don’t need the welcoming, this is a good church to go to. The sermons are good. I would pick this one for you. But if you want a welcoming church, this isn’t the one for you because it isn’t a very welcoming church. At least not for me, it wasn’t. And I base this on the last four churches that I’ve been to. They all had a welcoming center and made me feel welcome and comfortable. The people at this church acted like they didn’t even want me there. Anyways, that’s all I have to say about this. You can decide for yourself. I do hope that quest church reads this and takes what I say into consideration and things change, soon. Every year for Halloween, this church throws the biggest bash. Pony rides, games, tricker trunk, live music, and even a hay ride. We love coming and bringing the kids. The staff and volunteers for the event are always so happy and kind. Tons of candy is given out with game participation, There's nothing like it. So much safer than going house to house. I was really shy to come here, and man im so glad i did. My kids enjoyed every SECOND, the staff and people were really friendly. I loved it. WISH there was a church like this in my new hometown I've only been a few times and I have fallen in love with this church. Everyone was very welcoming. The pastor walks around before and after service to talk with everyone. Great place to worship our Creator. Great music director,
I also love the teachings of Pastor Sherwood, he teaches from the word of God!
The people there are very friendly and inviting!
The kiddos have great teachings and can tell the teachers really love the kids of all ages! I know because I am one of them!
I am so blessed to call Quest my home church!

name: Radiance Christian Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church for people who want to listen to the word of God, I found their messages to be very biblical centered; however, it was hard to connect with people, especially if you're not asian. Moreover, if you are looking for a place where you can get close to the pastor for guidance, you may find it difficult as they seem busy and will need to wait for a month to schedule an appointment. A great church to be a part of with biblically sound preaching. Lots of cool ongoing activities, ministries, social events, sports groups, and outreach in the Fillmore. Cell groups are spread throughout the city with varieties including married, single coed, men's, and women's!

Average age is young, with the congregation mostly sitting in the 20s and 30s. Medium church of around 200 people! Wait on second thought, I want to go to Westminster. Looking forward to Radiance Sunday Service! I want to go into seminary now (specifically Gordon-Conwell). I love Radiance.

name: Radiant Bible Church - Avon Campus
reviewSummary:
I love calling Radiant my church home! My first Sunday attending was at the 1 year anniversary of the church back in 2009. I attended the youth group as a teen, and now get to serve in the youth group as a Student Leader!

I have had the joy of witnessing first hand the ministry work Radiant has with their middle school and high school students! From summer camps to fall retreats, I can attest that Radiant makes it a priority to have leaders who pour into their students and point them directly back to gospel centered truth. Radiant Students changed my life as a teen, and now getting to walk along side others as I had someone else do for me, priceless! Today, we visited this Church before heading back to Georgia. Amazing church, reminding me a church we have back home. Like it says, the Word of God never changes neither does the environment! I'm happy to see God is working everywhere in the United States & hope it continues to grow there at this church. God bless everyone! I attended this church from the Regal Cinemas days up until 2017. I have many stories, but I will share two to keep my review succinct.

While a member here, I came for counseling concerning traumatic flashbacks I was having during intimacy with my husband at the time (due to an assault in college). I was encouraged to bite my lip and just push through the trauma so my husband could “finish” and learn to let it go, a path that caused more harm to my spirit in the end. I was also encouraged to look at what I did to enable the violent assault.

In my small group, while suffering with a horrific pregnancy complication that caused me to vomit so much I lost a significant amount of weight and was hospitalized over a dozen times, I was “chastised” for not meeting my husband’s sexual needs. I was told that I could still use my hand by my small group leader. I was beyond appalled and disheartened. I nearly died during my pregnancy, but sure, I needed to make sure my husband was sexually satisfied.

I fully recognize that my issues with believers of the abrahamaic mythology exist throughout the whole, and are not limited to this one church. But I would be remiss if I did not point out the harm that was done to myself, and my family, through reckless unbiblical counseling at this particular institute. Compassion, empathy and human decency were in short supply.

In the end, you’ll attend this church or you won’t, not based on a review but on your own convictions. In some ways, I’m grateful to this church for making me realize how false its god is. I am grateful to be free of the shackles of western christianity, legalism, fake smiles, constant shame and purity culture, and my only regret is that I did not embrace who I truly am sooner. I am the happiest, freest and most at peace I have ever felt, and I have a community who loves me and supports me in a way no church of supposed jesus followers ever did. Today was our first time attending, and we went to the 9:45am session.

The kids’ church immediately won me over.

This is a Biblical church—people had their Bibles out, and it felt like a spiritual gathering with purpose, not a theatrical production.

I do wish the 9:45am service felt a bit more diverse, but… hmm… okay. Preached directly from the Bible!  The entire congregation sang, even the teens.  People came to church with notebooks, Bibles, and ready to worship.  Needless to say, the entire congregation was engaged.

name: Radiant Christian Life - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary:
I recently moved to the area and had the good fortune of finding this church. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. The people there have become my family. You don’t have to look far to find a friend.
The ministry are Christ centered, intentional and focused on growing in Gods word. This church is filled with the Holy Spirit! Come and join us, there is room for more. Radiant Christian Life has always felt like home; from the first time I visited until now, almost 25 years later. The people are warm, friendly and caring. The message of the gospel is central in Pastor Jerome's sermons.
I am so grateful for my brothers and sisters at Radiant Christian Life and for the prayers that they have poured over me and my family throughout the years. Radiant is a truly multigenerational community of faith where families of all ages worship and grow together. It’s family‑minded and welcoming, creating a warm atmosphere that feels like home from the moment you walk in. With a strong focus on service and missions, Radiant lives out Christian faith both locally and globally. Most importantly, the teaching is rooted in sound biblical truth, guiding us to grow deeper in Christ. My husband Karl passed away this year and Pastor Jerome and Jordan did an awesome job ministering to family and friends during the memorial service. I can't imagine attending anywhere else. This church is a real church, and I don't just say that because it has a building and people to go inside and worship. Radiant has real folks, ones that are imperfect and trying to find their place in this temporary world. I grew up going to church and when I had a family of my own, we church hopped around the community - i-town, grace, heartland. Each of these churches have their own good qualities, but to me, it always felt like just a place people came to "look the part of a Christian"; one that raises their hands in worship, places a $20 in the tithing basket, bows their heads during prayer, and pulls out their devices for Bible reading. At Radiant, you can find that, yes, but you ALSO find struggle, and pain, and healing, and forgiveness, and acceptance.

I'm a woman of faith for over 20 years and I had a kid out of wedlock. Some churches would say you're not welcome, some would just have a judge-y congregation. Radiant took my family in with Love that only God can help pour out in His followers that are obedient in the command to Love. Jesus is present in this church, you feel His warmth in a handshake from a stranger when we transition to the sermon. You see Him in the eyes of the children as they are excited to be with friends and learn something new about their heavenly Father. Does Radiant have worldly aspects to it like people not seeing eye to eye or shortcomings that come with humanity, sure. But didn't the disciples of Jesus Christ also struggle with these? Church isn't supposed to be perfect, it's supposed to be humbling and an outreach of Love; you'll find that at Radiant ❤️ Hope to see you there! My husband & I have been attending Radiant over 6 years. The atmosphere is welcoming & the people are very caring.
Their community outreach programs, including Dinners On Us, are wonderful.
We look forward to Pastor Jerome's messages.
Radiant is a GREAT church!

name: Radiant Church
reviewSummary: Fast-growing high-energy worship community led by Pastor Aaron Burke, celebrated for youthful passion, missional outreach, and vibrant small groups.

name: Radiant Church - Central Campus - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Fast-growing high-energy worship community led by Pastor Aaron Burke, celebrated for youthful passion, missional outreach, and vibrant small groups.

name: Radiant Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Relaxed atmosphere, friendly people, pastor is relatable and funny, teaching was bible-focused and applicable. Will return. Our new home for our church. Thank you raise my church for letting us in your church.  The fathers house oc Good church with a good shepherd. My favorite place Oh, good resurrection grass

name: Radiant Church - Lexington, KY - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
I truly believe the Lord led me by the hand to this church, and has become home. As a newcomer, I was met by such warmth and the unmistakable light of Christ from each and every person. Worship is always 🔥 and PK, Pastor Cameron and Pastor Scott are always ready with the meat of the Word and the milk and honey of the Gospel—and there’s always room for some good humor for dessert.

This church has become my family, and is where I heard the Holy Spirit call my name and break off every shackle I had been placed in.

Come see us, meet Him and Be Radiant! ✝️❤️‍🔥 If you're looking for a church in Lexington, I cannot recommend Radiant enough. From my very first visit, I felt genuinely welcomed. The person greeting at the door didn't just point me toward the sanctuary, but walked me there, took the time to find people my age, and introduced me so I wouldn't have to be alone. That small act made such a huge difference and showed me what this church is all about.

The sermons are always biblical, practical, and incredibly relatable. The pastors have a way of teaching God's Word that is easy to understand while still challenging you to grow in your faith. They're also some of the kindest, most personable people you'll meet, and they truly care about every person who walks through the doors.

The worship is powerful every single week. Radiant is a non-denominational church where people are free to worship and pray in whatever way they feel led. Whether that's raising your hands, praying at the altar, or quietly spending time with God, there's so much freedom to encounter Him without judgment. Every service creates space for people to pursue Jesus wholeheartedly.

More than anything, God's presence is so evident here. You can truly see His hand at work in the lives of the people, the leadership, and the church as a whole. It's a place where lives are being transformed, people are finding hope, and relationships with Jesus are growing.

The community has completely changed my life. People are friendly, welcoming, and intentional about helping you find connection. Whether it's through Sunday services, serving, or small groups, it's easy to find a place to belong.

If you're searching for a church in Lexington, KY that teaches the Bible, has authentic worship, caring pastors, and an incredible community, Radiant Church is truly a special place. I'm so thankful God led me here. What a great church God lead me to this morning! You can truly feel the presence of God in this place. The worship team is fantastic. Pastor Kevin's "PK" message was spot on! With a warm welcome and friendly faces this church blesses all who enter. It seems like a wonderful church with nice preaching music  and atmosphere. I went to this church a few months ago and it is not a welcoming church. The worship is good. However this is a very conservative, ultra right-wing church, and the pastor made multiple political statements which were not professional. He is cherry-picking verses out of context to fit a political agenda and it truly takes away from the heart of God. I am a believer of the Gospel and was considering a new home church, as I am new to the area, and I left there feeling repulsed..

name: Radiant Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Earlier this year, my family and I moved to the Round Rock area. We’ve moved states several times over the years, but this was the first time we’ve all landed in one place together. We hadn’t had a church family in a while, but we had been praying and asking the Lord to lead us to people we could do life with when we arrived. I found Radiant’s statement of faith and saw it was solid, so I started watching some of their past sermons. Pastor Andy and the other elders preached straight from the Bible, and it was clear they were united behind the core beliefs they hold to.

When we visited in person, we were in awe. The Spirit of God was so present in worship. People around us were singing and shouting praises to the Lord. The voices of the people were louder than the speakers—it was incredible. Pastor Andy preached a message on the promises of the Lord, and for the first time in a long time, we were able to sit and receive. He spoke with such care for the Word that the message really resonated. The Holy Spirit was working—each of us experienced it differently, but we all felt it.

Week after week, we just kept coming. We each got connected to our own life groups so we could do life with others in a way that fit the season we were in. What stood out the most was how welcomed we felt. After all the places we’ve lived, Radiant was the first place where we truly felt safe and at home—together.

Whether you’re visiting or the Lord is calling you to join a family, I hope to see you here. I’d love to share testimonies of what God is doing in our lives and walk alongside you in faith. A church with a true heart and Biblical expository preaching. Part of the Gospel Coalition, the elders and leadership teach & follow the word of God, and are genuine in their service to the community. They serve as unto the Lord. Me and my family of 4 have been going there for 5 years, ever since we moved in the neighborhood. We've made life-long friends with others who we've served with and been through real things with. The lead pastor Andy, has masters and doctoral degrees in systematic theology from The Master’s Seminary, where he also served as a professor for 11 years. The hearts are real, the coffee is artisanal and preaching is sound and challenging from the word of God. The message delivered during today's 10:45 service was truly inspiring. Youth Pastor Derrick presented a message that was exceptionally easy to understand. Moreover, the atmosphere was incredibly welcoming. The pastoral staff and leadership at Radiant Church are incredible. Every elder, ministry leader, and volunteer truly strives to shepherd the people and use the resources and gifts available to them in a biblical way. Their devotion to faithful preaching and living out of the Word pervades the entire church culture at Radiant. The worship is thoughtful and excellent. The expository teaching is deep but accessible. Members and attendees are truly kind, open, humble and invested in one another. If you're looking for a wonderful church family to learn and grow with, I can't recommend Radiant enough. What a blessing Radiant has been to my family. This church is saturated in biblical truth. The pastoral staff have been such a blessing to our family. Fellow believers at Radiant Church have become our family and community. The church holds to their mission....Lost people saved, Saved people matured, Mature people multiplied, All to the glory of God!

name: Radiant Church - Surprise Location - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary:
I used to love going there on Wednesdays...it felt like a short concert series with positive vibes. But there is a young man who preaches after the "concert" that does not appeal to me, in fact I feel like he kills the whole vibe. One sermon in particular, I remember he said "...if you believe that God and Jesus are separate entities, then you are dumb..." I get where he was going with it so don't want to take it out of context, but his poor word choice stuck with me! I & possibly many other people go there for the uplifting vibes & to feel closer to God. I don't feel comfortable listening to any preaching that takes me further from that, therefore I will not return & am looking for better options. We were in Surprise visiting my cousin Donda & Jim. We had the honor of going to church on Sunday with them. This is an amazing church. Their worship team is awesome. Those vocals. Definitely chills and goosebumps from the Holy Spirit. The pastor is very relatable and down to earth. Very welcoming church. This church has become our second home.  We have met wonderful people and the leaders and Pastors are amazing. Worship is beautiful you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit.
Come check it out! I attended a women's conference there.  I loved the church grounds and  the sanctuary.  The lobby of the church and the little coffee shop inside were clean and very welcoming.  Pastor Kade and Pastor Hope were awesome; very friendly and kind.  If I didn't already attend a different church, I would definitely attend this one. Men’s ministry is thriving. Their annual wild game dinner was epic. Pastor Caden is an engaging speaker and a man of integrity. Love this church.

name: Radiant Church — Clearwater - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
A welcoming and solid bible based church. The people are friendly, the music and worship is very good. It’s part of a larger collection of churches around the Tampa Bay Area. They’re a blessing to the community.

The Clearwater location is building a new larger auditorium to accommodate the growth. I have been looking for a church just like this one, I feel that God answered my prayers by planting this new location within 2 blocks of my home. What a blessing. Incredible people! Kindness, worship and amazing scripture shared each weekend. They have an awesome kids service on Sundays at 10am too! Thank you Pastor Aaron for bringing a radiant Church to Clearwater and thank you Pastor Jose and Nicholle for leading this new congregation! I can't wait to see what the Lord does now that we have such a life giving church here in the community! I am praying for you all! I love this amazing church!!  I have finally found my home church! Everyone is so friendly and Real,  no fake smiles anywhere! Love you all God is present in this place. Amazing service..
Love the preacher.
Felt loved and accepted This church is a Bible-beleiving blessing. I visited this church as my friend attends it. The messages are spot on, the leaders warm and welcoming, the worship is divine and the word is God-inspired. If I lived in Clearwater,  this would be my church. Pastor José and team are doing the work of God.

name: Radiant Church — New Tampa - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is the reason why we stopped going to church. I've been wanting to make this post because of our experience here when they 1st opened and finally have the courage to do so. We as a family were so excited because this location was new and we wanted to start from the beginning. Let me tell you. If you're looking for a church family, this place isn't it. You will be judged. Compassion goes a long way & if your heart isn't in ministry then please step down. I'm so thankful that God sees every heart and intent. Character will outlast performance any day. We started attending Radiant NT when they first opened after moving to the Wesley Chapel area and immediately felt at home. We have two little ones and our kids (that are under six years old) love the children’s ministry. Community is strong here🤍 We are new to this church and we really like the people, environment and the weekly sermons. It is a very welcoming community and there are many opportunities for church community connections. The lead pastor is great and I love the messages he puts out. My only complaint is how loud it is. The folks running the sound at my location always have it very loud to the point where they feel the need to offer ear plugs at the front door. We are going to keep going, but I wish they would make it a little more accessible by lowering the volume. Absolutely love this church! Great church if you have a family with kids! Started on their inauguration day.
It's been wonderful every Sunday!
Absolutely love it💜💜

name: Radiant Life Church Dublin - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I attended service while visiting the Columbus area from out of town. We so glad they were having in-person service during COVID with masks recommended. The service was great. Everyone was welcoming and the building is beautiful. The worship was Christ-centered and truly glorified God. Pastor Chris preached an encouraging word filled with the Truth of the Gospel. By the end of the message I felt grateful, compelled to serve the Lord, excited to learn more about the word of God. Loved it! Thank you all!!! I love Radiant Life Church so much because they put an amazing amount of effort on making your experience as best as possible. The worship is always set to lead you in a special one on one time with God. The message hits home just about every time and makes you take a step back and realize how you could do better at being who God wants you to be. The fellowship is a plus with plenty of Life Groups to attend and many people to talk to. When you walk into the church you can feel the love and the Lord. This is not just another church. This is a family. The youth group is composed of 6th through 12th grade that all meet together. What a sixth grader needs to hear vs. what a Junior/Senior needs to hear is night and day. Western culture has infiltrated the church and youth group so much that the older girls are controlling the atmosphere to very dark and very grey areas. Youth pastor met with as our child was being bullied and standing up for right and wrong; the pastors refused to meet with us. It was mentioned that there are a lot of issues going on with the culture of the group and it will take time to get it resolved.  The behavior was worse that what is found at a public school and for whatever reason the pastors feel that the youth minister needs to resolve their daughters behavior instead of them resolving the issues themselves.

We left the culture so our young adult could take control of their life, to choose a different path than the one they had while at the youth group, and to leave painful memories and darkness behind. We all have the power to make our own destiny, and to push through tough times and keep moving forward towards the light and those that love and accept us unconditionally.  Too many strings were attached with being part of the “Rad Family.”  With any church if you are not welcomed and accepted immediately (by all) go to a different church.

They also ask for a lot of money for missions’ trips in which each youth would have to promise to raise a noted amount of money within the year that would not go towards the youth group and its activities, but for the entire church; which is very odd.

Do your research anytime you want to visit any church and, in this case, google AOG and the information online is spot on and accurate. Time Apart was well organized and facilitated. The Church was beautiful, easy to find, the staff was so welcoming and friendly. Being handicapped,  a ramp and an elevator on each end would be awesome; otherwise, perfect !! I love this place it makes you fill like your at home! I went there for the teen girl conference and it was so much fun me and my friends had a wonderful and amazing visit. They always made some type of joke or they always made the boring things to learn into fun things!

name: Radius Church
reviewSummary: I’ve been attending for a little over 2 years and it’s truly changed my life. Being able to come into a church that’s nonjudgmental and welcoming from all aspects, made me feel comfortable quickly. The relationship I’ve built with God is nothing I’ve ever had in my life. Blake and Amanda truly care about community and take time with anyone who has questions, needs prayer or just the best hugs. There is free spiritual yoga every week, small groups throughout the year, Rad Students during the school year, student retreats and camps, and life changing mission trips. If that wasn’t enough, we have a pie contest, a chili contest, special things for Mothers and Fathers Day and more! Radius is our forever home and I’m forever grateful for God leading me this way❤️ Words can’t express what Radius Church means to me. They’ve been more than just a place of worship, they are family. From the moment I walked through the doors, I was welcomed with open arms and genuine hearts. They have walked with me through my seasons of struggle and healing, and have rejoiced with me in my growth. They didn’t just witness my journey, they have been a part of it. Their love and support have helped shape who I am today in Christ. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, that truly lives out what it means to be the body of Christ, Radius is that place. I’m beyond grateful for them - especially Pastors Blake and Amanda, and I thank God often for placing me here! My heart has found HOME. I have been attending RADIUS since my visit first of the year. I attended their HEAL conference and have never looked back. The community and the outreach within the St petersburg community are unlike any other i have experienced. I had the honor of being a part of a mission trip to the Dominican Republic, have helped in several service projects, and there’s even a weekly YOGA- Refuge Yoga on Weds evenings. A very well rounded Church with LOVE and MORE at the CORE.  If you are looking for a diverse welcoming non judgmental church that exemplifies the Real Love of Christ being walked out in real time,  then come visit us at RADIUS. I love this church. It's the first church where I've felt like I belong- which is why I still drive 40 min to attend rather than finding a new church closer to home. The heart Radius has for serving others is amazing, especially for such a small church. A small church with huge hearts and great accomplishments! Do many things I like about this church! The feeling of being wanted, you can feel the love. The Word taught straight from the Bible and it's comprehensible.  The worship is outstanding.  But mostly their love for the community and the services it provides.

name: Ranch View Baptist Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a church that is serious about worshipping the Lord Jesus Christ without all the fluff and seeker-friendly tactics, then this is your place. You're going to feel truly welcomed and loved. The preaching is expository (verse-by-verse), and singing is from the hymnal. The fellowship is genuine, and there is a true sense among the congregation that people want to really grow in their love and knowledge of God, His Word, and each other. Pastor Roman is a humble servant of the Lord, and he is truly dedicated to shepherding the flock. My family and I are relatively new to Ranch View Baptist Church, and we are loving it. It has truly been answer to prayer. I love the word of God being preached weekly. I enjoy the friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Excellent service

Traditional Baptist service

name: Rancho Bernardo Community Presbyterian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: Went there and saw some lady and man outside confronting someone with a camera…last time I checked that was legal and what the lady was doing boarderline illegal actually. Seems like this lady needs to get right with god. Best church I've ever been to. The congregation is warm and very friendly.  My husband had a medical incident during services in November 2024. The outreach and support we received and continue to receive has definitely been above and beyond. We have without question found our forever church. RBCPC is the BEST. This is a massive church. So, if you appreciate anonymity, this is a good place for you. However, the people will not go out of their way to welcome you. The music is pretty good, but it lands toward contemporary church music. I'm classically trained, so the lack of sheet music and hymnal use is a little annoying (I understand that it is highly subjective). Pastor Kohler gives thoughtful and meaningful sermons. The associate pastor is warm and jovial. My family and I have been going for a few years.  We really like this church (settled here after "shopping around" a bit)!  The pastor's sermons are centered in the Bible, the music is amazing at both the traditional and contemporary services, and the people are very kind and welcoming. A very beautiful church, with great acoustics to hear the San Diego philharmonic perform. Everyone that I encountered here was very friendly and helpful. Its also a nice newer campus with a large well lit covered parking area, with easy access from the street.
