name: Rancho Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recommend Rancho Church in Temecula. It’s a multicultural church with services in Spanish, English, and Korean, making everyone feel welcome.

I attend the Spanish service, and it keeps growing with a great atmosphere, positive energy, and motivating messages. The English community is also large and hosts great events.

The facilities are clean and spacious, located on a Christian school campus, and the staff is always friendly.

Overall, it’s a great place for a healthy, family-oriented environment. It truly feels like one big family. Let’s bow our heads and pray is not something I have heard from any of the pastors at Rancho, in recent history, yes, even on Christmas Eve. Instead we heard “I pray that you have a good night “or something to that effect.The power of prayer in a group setting  is something that cannot be denied. When people go to church are they not looking for that unity in prayer? Like praying before we eat or praying before we receive the gift of a sermon? I invited a friend of mine who had invited me to their church, to come to Rancho; thats when it was first brought to my attention. She said “oh yeah, I’ve been there 4 times, my best friend goes there, the pastor doesn’t pray, which I find really weird.” I thought about what they said and sure enough praying as a congregation before and or after sermon is not something I’ve seen done there, by any of the pastors. “Open your Bible’s and turn to” is also something I do not hear at Rancho. “Open your Bible app” would suffice but that doesn’t happen either and the pastor holding an actual Bible is lacking too.  RAncho has Christ followers for sure, but where is the fear of God? Where are the Ten Commandments and the fear of God as the congregation works to hold themselves accountable to the basic instructions before leaving earth?  Anyhow, it’s taken me a long time to write this and I haven’t said it to the pastors because I’m someone who has anxiety with confrontation. I really hope a pastor at Rancho sees this and replies or better yet, includes congregational prayer and sights the Bible during their next sermon. We have been coming to Rancho Church for almost a year now, and we’re so glad we found it!  The messages are so good and have enhanced our spiritual journey!  Despite attending various churches over the years, my husband and I both agree that Rancho Church is the best church we have been to.  The messages are great, and Scott, Steve, and Karissa do an incredible job of sharing them with the congregation every Sunday.  The worship music is great, and we love the before-service music.  We are RV’ers, so we can’t always make it to church in person, but we listen to the service online.  We really appreciate all the hard work that the whole team at Rancho Church does to make every Sunday so special! Visited while we were visiting from out of state. Great worship and message. Troop 384 meets here nearly every Monday night. 7-8:30pm.  Stop by and see us if you are interested in Scouting BSA.

name: Rancho Cucamonga Anglican - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
Rancho Life Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly welcoming modern community in RSM. The cafe has great coffee!

name: Rapha Church Sandy Springs - Sandy Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We were recommended to this church and attended their Easter service. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with such a warm embrace. It was truly special that everyone, including the pastors, took the time to get to know us personally.

​The sermon was wonderful and really spoke to us. We have been searching for a church home for over six years, and we have finally found it! Our children absolutely love the children’s ministry—they had such a great time that they asked to come back again and immediately asked, 'Can this be our church?' Everyone at Rapha has such a great spirit, and it is truly a wonderful community. Rapha Church. My first visit last Sunday. You are greeted whit fearless greeting and love you not as a stranger. I really enjoyed the praise and worship. It wasn't to entertain; it was beautiful, joyful worship and praising God. Then came the teaching of the Word of God. All the same: Trinity, God invites, fellowship, God presents through His words. I am looking forward to this Sunday coming. My first visit was absolutely amazing. But the connection started prior to that. having one of the pastors reach out to me and invite me personally to the church was amazing and they worked with me to ensure that I was able to get there. The people were very welcoming and I felt like I was walking into a place where I was seen and known. the message was amazing. I am truly interested in the nevertheless series and plan on listening to the entire series. I truly look forward to coming back. My family and I have been looking for a church in the area. We finally made it to Rapha Church and we’re glad we did. The Sunday we went, 2/22, we were told was not a typical Sunday service as we broke off into our life group. Typical or not it was a very good first impression and I look forward to going back. From the initial communication via text, to walking in and seeing happy friendly faces, I can’t wait to see how I learn, grow, and work on my healing at Rapha Church. Let me start by saying I'm a p.k. ( iykyk) I've been to too many churches, I've sang at alot too. BUT NEVER EVER HAVE I FELT THE PRESENCE OF THE LORD AS SOON AS I ENTERED THE BUILDING like i did at Rapha.   It was a truly, come as you are. And i love a church like that!!!! The congregation was the most welcoming I've ever met. Not only that,  but it didn't feel like you had to make a reservation to speak to the pastor or any of the leadership there.  GOD GOT HIS HAND ON THiS PLACE AND I FOR SURE WANT TO BE PART OF THE MOVEMENT.    LASTLY,  THE PASTOR spoke to us. He didn't just throw bible verses and nod at the organ guy to hit a high note.  He taught,  he revealed, he healed.. God bless him.  God bless them all. Ohh and last but not least, THE MUSIC... the PRAISE AND WORSHIP TEAM..  👋🏿👋🏿👋🏿👋🏿👋🏿👋🏿👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾..     it was all fueled by God.  No egos.. just people worshipping and sounding great!!!!! I Def. Want to be part of that!!!  Come visit this church.   It's Def. Worth the visit!!!!

name: RCCG Grace Sanctuary Cincinnati - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: God's presence is in this place! No doubt. Surely the Lord is in this place!

name: RCCG Kings Assembly - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: If you're a Nigerian and you love worshipping with people from Nigeria, this is certainly the place you should be. Other races and ethnicities are equally welcomed. This church is amazing!!! OMG the presence of God is mighty in here! Such loving and welcoming people right when you step in! RCCG is a wonderful place to serve and worship Jesus. The people are kind and helpful. This place can really influence you. This is a family church,with powerful words of God Lovely family's to worship with

name: Reach Church | CO - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: We're new to the area. So my family and I decided to check out this church since it's only 5 minutes away. The greeters outside were friendly. But, no one else acknowledged us. The worship was good. The teaching was on point. But, not friendly or welcoming at all. What happened to "God is love?" Not a diverse church. Saw only one Hispanic family,  and one Asian guy in the worship band. Rest where all White. We did not feel welcomed at all. Best church community I have ever been a part of.  It's not so big that you don't know anyone's name and the congregation is very friendly.  We tried out several churches when we moved to Colorado and this one is perfect. A good mix of military, retired military, and rural/city members. I love the modern worship music and the childcare services are fantastic. This church has become a family and home to us over the last 3 years. Sound and solid Biblical teachings from the pastoral team, amazing musical worship, discipleship oriented with options for everyone to get connected. Not pretentious but very inclusive. I researched the church through their website to see what they believed and it was close to home so I checked it out. I prayed prior to coming because I am a bass player and wanted to use my gifts for God....I found out that they were looking for a bass player so God opened that door! Gateway has sound Biblical preaching and their Spirit glorifies God. There is not a perfect church on the planet but Gateway is always seeking to become more Christ like in what they do, so check them out and go with an open heart ! Our whole family was at Gateway Church this past weekend and all I have to say is "Wow!"  Uplifting and powerful worship and a super encouraging Word!  It is so good to be among people who are excited about God's Word and love to worship!

name: Reach Church Palos Verdes - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a church that feels like family from the moment you walk in? This church, located at Crestwood Elementary in Rancho Palos Verdes, is exactly that! The people are warm, welcoming, and genuinely excited to meet new faces. It’s the kind of place where strangers quickly become friends.

Pastor Luke and Shatera are incredible leaders with huge hearts for both people and the Palos Verdes community. Their passion, authenticity, and love for serving others shine through in everything they do.

The messages are biblically sound, relevant, and encouraging, while the worship is heartfelt, uplifting, and centered on God. Whether you’re searching for a church home, curious about faith, or just looking for a community to belong to, this is a great place to visit. Come see what God is doing here you might just find exactly what you’ve been looking for! January 2026 my daughters and I decided we needed to start going to church. I grew up going to Spanish speaking churches but wanted to find and English-speaking church so my daughters can fully understand the word of God. We went online and a few churches showed up in our area, Reach Church PV had one review on Yelp and it was good, so we decided to visit them that weekend. Pastor Luke, Shatera and the rest of the congregation were so welcoming. Everyone is so nice and make you feel like family. We have been attending for 3 months and we have felt so much love from everyone. I am proud to say I am part of such a great congregation! This is a great church! I know God placed us at the right place! A warm and welcoming Christian church with a heart for Jesus and the community. Pastors Luke and Shatera Duperron faithfully teach God’s Word and make everyone feel like family. ReachPV is a wonderful place to grow in faith, build relationships, and worship together. Looking for a church that feels like family? Reach Church Palos Verdes is full of welcoming people, uplifting worship, and biblical teaching. Pastors Luke and Shatera have a true heart for serving others and helping people grow in their faith. We’d love to see you there! 🙏🏽✝️❤️ This is my STORY

I'm Jacob I always knew I had to answer to a higher calling in my life if I did bad or wrong but I never had a "relationship" with Jesus christ fast forward a couple years down the road my grandma died at home she was like a mom to me because my mom was working all the time I grew up in a single parent home so my grandma technically was my mom per say. When my grandma died I was there to be a comfort to her during her lasts breathes and sometime after that I got exposed to pornography and found that as an outlet for my grief but little did I know that it would bring anxiety,depression, fear and insecurities.
And during my middle and high school years it made a huge negative impact on my performance in school. Fast forward 2025 I lost my job, fiance and was stripped from everything I idolized I had plans to kill myself in my truck but I ran into Luke and shatera at Sam’s club and invited me to they’re church anytime and I felt so welcomed and just genuinely felt concerned about and loved ever since then I have been coming getting connected and met some great men and women in the church that I call family…

name: Reach Orlando Church - Winter Park Campus
reviewSummary: We visited here while on vacation. We have known Pastor Greg and his wife Janelle for years. They are amazing people who love Jesus. If you are looking for a Bible teaching church, this is a great place to plug in. Reach Orlando is a wonderful church with solid, bible based teaching. The congregation focuses on fellowship and building relationships. There are weekly bible studies, along with frequent game nights and potlucks. You would be hard pressed to find a more genuine and caring group of people. If you are in the Orlando/Winter Park area, check it out! A welcoming community of people learning and growing together. The pastor does a wonderful job of teaching straight from the Bible, providing both the historic and cultural setting and then how it applies in present life. The lack of pretense is refreshing while the desire to  grow in faith is real Visited here for the first time and within 10 minutes, I had to leave.  No inviting atmosphere, and everyone ignored me. That's how you treat a church visitor?  Well I don't recommend this church. I just started going 2 weeks now.. I've met Greg &Janelle& enjoy their energy&love&Excitement for Jesus/God like i do!!

name: Real Church - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary: Great leadership, word based preaching congregation on fire for Jesus! From the littles (new preschool open enrollment now), youth ministry, young adults ministry and seasoned, something for everyone, in a safe environment with guardrails in place.  Check out Real Church. Real is an acronym, 🤣 but the fellowship is real! WOW!!! Me and my boyfriend have been struggling to find a church that suits both of us but decided to try real church out for the first time on sunday and it was such a good experience. I’ve always had such a hard time following along in church but it was completely different here. We will be coming back 100%! also, loved how funny the pastor was. 100/10 experience We're on a 52 week = 52 church visit mission.  This was our week #28.  Real Church took first place in our hearts.  Praise and worship was wonderful,  been singing those songs all week.  The message was very practical for everyday living; focusing on today and being in the present.  Highly recommend, church family very welcoming and friendly.   Pastor available to pray with us after the service.  A great experience. Great worship music and sermon It is always good to go into the house of the Lord and to have the FREEDOM to worship. Today we were reminded of the "Great commission". To go ye into all the world and tell others of the "Good news". Evangelism is what Jesus was all about; drawing people of every nation and tongue into His marvelous light...kingdom. A saving knowledge of Jesus Christ.

name: Real Church Midland - Midland Campus
reviewSummary: What a blessing to find Real Church, and to see where God is moving not just in the building, but out in the community through their service.  Pastor Carlos throwing darts (metaphorically of course) straight to my heart, every week, making a difference, and challenging me to make a difference.  Thank you, God, for Pastor Carlos and his ministry.  Biblically grounded and service oriented, we've been looking for a church just like this.    God Bless. Made the best decision to try Real Church over a year ago. My family and I felt welcomed from the moment we stepped into the parking lot. I guarantee you will not make it far into the building without being greeted and feel welcomed! So thankful to feel at home at Real Church. My family started attending this church around September and it has been great for all of us. As a church going family, it can be hard to fund something that suits everyone but when my daughter who has been in church her whole life came out and had memorized her 1st scripture and was able to recite all of what she learned we knew they were doing something right. My son who is very anti social runs through the corridor waving and smiling and fighting us to go sit in the sanctuary to stay for the Spanish service.  Knowing that both my kids are being fed is so comforting to me. But we also love the word and the overall welcoming atmosphere each week. I would definitely recommend anyone looking for a home church give it a try. My family made the best decision 6 months ago to try Real Church and the moment we set foot in the building we were met with warm welcoming people. They made us feel like we were finally home.My kids love kids church and couldn't ask for better leaders and Pastors and church community. Real church is an amazing church. They have helped me encounter Jesus a numerous amount of times. They are so welcoming and loving. As soon as you walk through the doors of Realchurch you will feel at home, welcomed, supported, loved and so much more. Pastor Carlos is amazing. The first day I walked into Realchurch he made sure I felt welcomed. Realchurch is amazing ! And it’s a great church for anyone looking for a church!

name: Real Life Christian Church - Woodstock Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Real Life Christian Church. They are absolutely wonderful with the kids. When my husband and I got married we struggled to find a church that was a good medium between Presbyterian and Baptist church and that's when we found Real Life Christian Church that we now call family. This church means so much to me for so many different reasons. BIG LOVE!!! ❤️
Fellowship, friendship, family….the most welcoming church I have ever attended.
Pastor Kirby and his wife Leslie are true believers and easily approachable. Their love for Jesus is evident and remarkable.
My Mom and Dad have attended RLCC for about 30 years, and after losing my Dad last February, I have found my home.
A proud member of this warm and welcoming family.❤️ A great church and with great people. I love this church very much RLCC is a Bible believing, Bible preaching church. We have a wonderful children’s ministry, many adult Bible studies and Sunday school classes. We have community outreach ministries such as a food pantry and a clothing ministry that serve those in need. We have been absolutely blessed and supported attending Woodstock Christian Church!
Pastor Kirby & his wife Leslie are precious people who love the Lord & show Christ’s  love.
Amazing Sunday school program! We love it!

reviewSummary: Pastor Greg does a phenomenal job preaching! Worship is also outstanding. Very nice church with friendly people. The message by the lead pastor, felt easy to listen to and follow along, it was like a conversation and not someone preaching at you. It brought me back from a distant/backsliding lifestyle to one that is involved and invested in His kingdom.

name: Real Life Church - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary:
I went in to check out and been going faithfully for 6-7 months. Very uplifting Pastor Jason does an amazing job every Sunday making you feel the message he is delivering. Everyone there makes you feel like family. Very giving church. Love it God is Good God is Great After moving here from Youngstown Ohio me and my fiance settled on this church because it actually preaches about real life and spiritual warfare!Pastor Jason is one of the best I’ve ever listened to and makes it easy to understand!!! I am so thankful that my family was able to find this church. When you walk in the door, you will immediately be greeted by genuine, down-to-earth people who love the Lord with all their heart. They'll ask how your day is going, they'll pray for you, and they genuinely care about what is going on in your life. Some of my greatest friendships have come out of this church. You will truly feel at home when you walk into a Real Life Church service.

The teaching is also incredible. Pastor Jason's teaching is powerful, straightforward, and easy to understand. My biggest breakthrough moments have occurred while listening to the sermons. Whether it's how to be a great husband, dad, or navigate through the constantly changing seasons of life, hearing the Word of God preached in this way has helped me grow dramatically.

Lastly, you'll be greatly moved by the praise and worship. It's hard to fully put into words, but these moments of worship have brought me closer to God in so many ways.

I could go on and on about the tremendous life change that has occurred with me, my wife, and the impact that RLC is having on our children. We're very blessed to be a part of such a strong community. This place is so welcoming from you first step in. You can truly feel Gods love moving through all. Pastor Jason is a great pastor and we love to listen to what God has delivered to him weekly. Truly I tell you that this is the place for you and your family. My family and I have been attending here for almost 10 years now.  Pastor Jason and Jennifer are the most genuine and generous people I’ve ever met.  If you’re looking for a church where you don’t feel pressured but loved then this is your place.

reviewSummary: I've been coming to Real Life church for a few years now and as a raised Catholic, I really enjoy it. I love seeing my friends and family as volunteers and running into familiar faces as well. Even those i don't know are super friendly and inviting. If you are looking for a local Church for you or your family, this place is worth a look! Hear me Real Life Church. Make God the main character always. We are not main characters, but rather side characters in this grand story. Who cares if 90% of the congregation leaves, a biblically sound church is best, not a lukewarm church that the Lord will spit out of his mouth. reviewSummary: My fiancé and I are visiting Sacramento from New York and I just googled Christian church near me and few popped up but RLC look like a nice place to be so we gave it a chance. Multi ethnic fantastic worship very welcoming great message I feel so blessed to have found such an amazing place. I love the diversity and unity this church is composed of. Immediately I felt at home. In addition to the incredible worship they also offer a children’s program and exciting events. I am so proud to be a part of RLC.

name: Reality Church Miami - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I attend Sunday morning services here when I am visiting Miami. Wonderful music, bible-based preaching, and exceptionally friendly people. Regardless of your background, you will feel welcome and loved here. Reality Church Miami has been a great place for my family and I to grow closer to God. Every week, we come together with friendly people who have been welcoming to our family. Whether you're new to Miami, or have lived here for years, this is a great place for you to learn what it means to follow Jesus and make friends along the way. My teenagers are volunteering and loving it. In my experience, the people in the congregation were judgmental, and ironically, remind me of the Pharisees from the bible. They judged me according to their moral ethic, many did not communicate with me in an honest straightforward way, I did not feel welcome at all over the months of being there. It was during a transition part of my life where I was looking for healing and community.

They would encourage you from the stage to get involved and volunteer, but whenever I ask how I can get involved in volunteer, they would never let me and kept on telling me to talk to the pastor, I don’t know why. It may be because we had differing beliefs or doctrine about the scripture. In my view, I just wanted to help them do good things in the community, but they kept on creating a rift because of their perceived difference in our doctrine. They never really explained it.

but I feel like the people were not able to resolve this agreement and instead my intuition tells me that they kept it to themselves and discuss Only behind my back. It was a strange experience, I felt like there were always looking at me judgmentally but they would not communicate it. I’ve been to many churches, and none of them have ever treated me like this.

Somebody also lied about my conduct and accused me of doing something that I was warned not to do, which is not true. I stepped into the Sunday school room to say hi to somebody that I knew and they accused me of violating safety protocols that supposedly somebody told me not to go in there, which was not true at all.

It makes me wonder where this kind of behavior and perception comes from, it’s still a mystery to me that I pray about.

I pray that we can all move forward and grow from this experience. I do feel like the people are good people and maybe I am a teaching lesson to them and they are teaching lesson for me . All the best. I can’t recommend this church enough. It’s a beautiful community that truly lives out its love for the gospel, the people, and the city of Miami. If you’re searching for a church home, you really need to come by and experience it firsthand. Reality Church of Miami is a wonderful place to come, where they will welcome you with open arms. From the wonderful worship music, to the great teachings of the word, and everyone involved that volunteer every Sunday. It all has such a community atmosphere that welcomes you in if it’s your very first time at church or if you’ve been going your whole life. God has a lot in store for them for the future!

name: Reclaim Church - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: One of the best churches in Arizona. The teaching is solid, the worship is genuine, and there’s a real sense of family here. Pastor John and Pastor Lindsay have hearts of gold and are on fire for the things of God! What stands out most is the heart of this church. They truly care for people. I’ve heard from a lot of people that they don’t go to church anymore because the church just wants your money… This church actually encourages anyone in need to take from the offering bucket as it’s passed or come talk to leadership if you need help, which shows real compassion and trust in God’s provision. Sounds like Jesus to me… Grateful to be part of a church like this. Been coming to this church for a couple months and let me just say- the feeling you walk into this church is unlike where I’ve been. Pastor John has such a way with words that the messages actually stay with me. If you get a chance- a must do is having coffee with the pastors to get to know them what they are about. I’ve never been felt relief when coming to church. I think I finally found a church community for me and I hope you do too. Growing up being forced to go to church was tough. Fast forward 25 years, I met pastor John and Lindsay. The family feeling and atmosphere is unlike I have experienced. The staff are amazing and John is one of the most honest and caring guys I’ve ever met. I look forward to seeing them. The are passionate about what they do and I love so much the amount that they pour into the community. If you are not plugged in, I highly recommend doing so. They changed my perspective deeply! Reclaim church has given me something I’ve never had in a church. It’s given me a place to come as I am before God. A place to open my heart up completely and allow Him to repair the deepest parts of me that I would have normally kept closed. Pastors John and Lindsay are REAL. They don’t preach from a pedestal. They preach from a place of experience knowing what it’s like to allow God to come in and transform your life. The kids ministry is amazing! All of our kids have given their hearts to Jesus at 2 different baptisms that have taken place this year. There’s small groups for families with children, young adults, men, and women. There’s so many opportunities to get to know God and the amazing people here. I go on and on about the amazing blessings God has given our family through going to Reclaim, or you could come and experience His goodness first hand! If you’re looking for a place to come as you are, to grow in Jesus and network with believers, this IS the place! Services are 9, 10:30, and 12 every Sunday! This church is amazing. Great missions, great pastors, great worship, great youth program, great people.

name: Reconcile Church Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
The Holy Spirit truly fills this church, and sometimes, you can’t help but be moved to tears of rejoice. If you’re looking for a church that truly delves into the Word, Pastor Daryl and Pastor Mike both take their time to truly break down Scripture, verse by verse in each sermon series and their passion to share the goodness of God is truly exhibited. The members, the body of this church, are so welcoming and the heart of Christ really pours out of them. The church offers fellowship, accompanied with some snacks and drinks, afterwards and the conversations that occur are always so uplifting. God has beautifully talented the worship team at Reconcile with various musicians who lead the church in joining along with heaven as we all worship King Jesus. Reconcile Church is a wonderful church located in Mid-Wilshire/Park La Brea truly serving God’s mission to reconcile people to each other and back to God. Definitely a great experience! Awesome church plant! Located at one of the best places in LA, across the La Brea Tarpits. Beautiful location. Worship on the second floor. Small and intimate church. Church starts at 10am. Pastor Mike and Pastor Daryl are so welcoming and easy going. Very easy to talk to. Amazing church for anyone. I grew up going to church my whole life but never seemed to find one that really encouraged & inspired me to grow spiritually and in community until I found Reconcile LA.

I’m forever grateful to have stumbled upon this church after my fiancé at the time stumbled upon Pastor Daryl who did our premarital counseling. Pastor Daryl is a gift from God who’s words really touch in a way that I haven’t experienced from others. One of this church’s mission and goals is to provide a safe space and community for ALL Individuals regardless of background, race, history, etc. all are truly welcomed here! If I were to describe my time at Reconcile LA in a few words, it would be: authentic, loving, inclusive, and growth. I came across this church when I was looking for a biblically sound church (which is not easy to find) that is multicultural, and focused on disciplining and authentic connection with God through Jesus and interconnection between the body (us). It’s a very small church and i thought I wanted a big church but i stayed because the preaching, the love of Jesus from the body there, and also the workship music ministry really touched my soul. Rarely do you have a church that you can contribute to since it’s so small and help determine how it’s shaped and be a part of moving it forward. Being a servant is part of this walk and also fellowshiping together which comes and feels really natural there. I thank the Lord for bringing me there! There are not many churches in mid city but look no further this is the one! There are kids teenagers young adults, older adults it’s a great place! And I believe it it’s just gonna keep going bigger and better. Awesome word. Best teaching I've listened to in a long time. Nice music ministry.

name: Red Hill Lutheran Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: Our family is loving this place. 💞 After many years, I found out that the Walker family whom we met at City of Hope attends here. Kevin Walker beat Stage 4 Pancreatic cancer and it's what gave my late husband hope that he could get 5 years with his terminal stage 4 stomach cancer, and Ryan, my late husband, did. Little did we know that when we met Kevin in the elevator with our first little baby girl that his family and his church would be some of the miracles that would allow us to be together, because they prayed for us. Kevin's father, the late Donald Walker was a special choir director here for many years, and he and his wonderful widow were married almost 70 years!! Now the amazing Harney family is blessing Red Hill Lutheran Church with musical gifts from each and every one of their family members who is still local. The Lord directed us here and I will, Lord willing, never stop finding ways for me, as a young widow, to show gratitude for the awesome Pastor Seth and his beautiful wife Julie Britton, and their church congregation!! A welcoming place for people who want to know Jesus personally, love deeply, and serve humbly. God's Blessings to you and your family ✝️ I've gone here for 12 years now and I've loved every minute of it.  There are wonderful sermons, activities, and the people are kind and loving.  We're like one big happy family! Redhill Lutheran is small but beautiful church, in so many ways. The sanctuary is filled with  all the traditional artifacts of an historical Christian church. The liturgical prayers and hymns are all biblical and historical. Truly an environment of respectful and joyful worship. The communion of saints is visible and palpable. No way does the sneaky snap reflect the church or the man. Shame on you for the snarky commentary. We were here for the Foothill High School Fall Choir Concert. The church is beautiful and the acoustics are great. Sometimes the parking is a bit challenging. The parking lot is also very dark and after the concert we nearly got hit by a car backing out. Be careful! Our family started coming here when our Son was in third Grade. The Spirit Filled Worship, true biblical teaching and family loving feeling have made it  source of strength for our spirits. Be Blessed :)
