reviewSummary: The pastor and First Lady were so welcoming.The congregation is also friendly and treat you like family 💯💯💯😍😍🙏🙏💪💪 I visited this church a few weeks ago and I truly felt the Holy Spirit. The church members are kind and welcoming the pastor and First Lady have beautiful spirits, I would highly recommend this church and I’ll definitely be back to visit again. If you are looking for a  bible based and welcoming place to worship, look no further than the Redeemed Church of Christ!  This church has it all!  Wonderful music ministry and powerful preaching and teaching by an annointed man of God (Pastor Joshua Bullock). The spirit of the Lord is in this place!!! If you are looking for a great place to Worship, look no further!! I guarantee you will be Blessed by the Word and Worship. Pastor Bullock is an anointed Man of God who brings forth the Word of God with power and anointing!! Redeemed Church of Christ is the place to be for your Spiritual food! Pastor Bullock feeds the flock with the unadulterated Word of God. If your hungry for the Word, join us in house or on line at noon…You don’t want to miss our energized service!

name: Redeemer Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This is such a welcoming, loving Christ like congregation. I was visiting with my son and his wife as this is where their church home. The worship svc was a bit more toned down musically than im used to, but that's not a bad thing, just a different  thing. The posture of the heart during worship is what brings us into the presence of God, not the musicality and instruments. The elders at Redeemer care about their flock. They strive to make much of Christ in everything they do. Every sermon points to Christ. The members are friendly and really seek to have a community that magnifies God! I recommend this church to anyone who is looking for a church in Riverside! I love this church and a lot CBU student goes there, a lot my friend goes there as well, CBU the best, same as the church lol. Gospel loving church with a beautiful, diverse community that loves Jesus and the world 💚 Very loving people. They get what it means to follow Jesus

name: Redeemer Bible Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
I cannot recommend Matt Heller as a family counselor at Redeemer Bible Church. In my personal experience, he has been unreliable and very difficult to reach. On multiple occasions, I attempted to communicate with him, but he frequently failed to answer the phone or reply to my messages. Even after promising to call me back, he did not return my phone calls. Because of these communication and reliability issues, I advise others to exercise caution before putting their trust in this counselor. It is refreshing to find a church that speaks the truth and does not bend the knee to “cultural norms”. We have been very impressed with all of the pastors and guest speakers. Our toddler son loves his children’s ministry class. We have finally found our church home. Looks like they have $10.15 million for a nice facility, yet these tax -free churches don't seem to be helping the homeless situation.  Let's hope they take a little of that 61,753-square-foot and house some people who are in need. Love this church!! The truth is spoken here!! The teaching and opportunities to take classes are many and in depth.  I love that I’m surrounded by other believers looking to grow and mature in the Word! It can be intimidating to find a church - if you are looking for any old church, there is one on every street corner, but like the cereal box, is it half empty w good content inside? While no church is perfect, my wife & I have gone here now 3 yrs. Pastor Jon, Dale and the now 11 pastor staff (was 13 less 2 after church plant) care that one, you are welcome and wanted here.

When we came here there were 3 pastors & Darryl was a 4th. Each humble, well schooled, well talented men. There were about 600 then, now it is nearly triple that in staff and attendance, as God when He speaks - people gather and listen. So if you are looking for a place to serve, this is it, we always need help from all walks of life, cultures, and age experience. It is casual yet also formal. If you come expecting nothing, you often leave unchanged not remembering much to share. But if you bring a notebook, you will come to know Jesus, you will know He loves you, and that we will not be happy until we live out the blue print for our life and design which is serving Him.

We can't clean up our acts. We are all sinners, in need of a savior. Until you know Him (become born again) He cannot live in you, and if He is not present, nor will change be long lasting. It is Jesus thru the guidance of the Holy Spirit drawing us to Him, that leads us to a life worth living and defending; Salvation is key here as is prayer.

These men are not afraid to call sin - what it is sin. These know the difference in who is a man, and who is a woman. In these times of turbulence, you need an anchor. Good solid preaching from infallible & inerrant Word of God every week, every service & resource.

These men value the Bible and have a high view of God and Scripture. Each day we have seen transformation and growth in ourselves and those around us in fellowship, so what are you waiting for, come, and find out for yourself.

name: Redeemer Bible Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: This is a very Christ centered church that will help you grow in the Lord. In addition to Sunday service, they also have mid week small group bible studies throughout North County.  They also focus on discipleship. And they have an awesome preschool ministry, and a youth ministry that my kids are a part of. Awesomeness

name: Redeemer Bible Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: We really love this church. The gospel is clear, the Bible preached, the music is rich, and it all points to Jesus. We have formed such deep friendships with others here, and I am thankful that my family is in good hands through the ministry of RBC. Amazing location, you won't miss it! Solid preaching and fun bible studies and programs. The members are kind and welcoming, the community is uplifting, and it is a great truth-promoting environment. Very convenient Sugar Land location. The pastor is very well educated, devoted and always open to discussions. It's a small church that very accommodating and very welcoming. The location is really great! Right off of Hwy 6 and Lexington, next to the skating rink. The building is newly renovated and modern. The community is warm and welcoming. We have been attending Redeemer Bible Church for almost two years now, and have been very grateful to have found it. This is a small church with a good community and strong expositional preaching.

name: Redeemer Bible Church - Temecula Campus
Redeemer by the Sea Lutheran Church, Kindergarten & Preschool - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Redeemer by the Sea creates the most welcoming environment for these kids! The warm smiles and happy enthusiastic greetings literally do not change from the start to the end of the school year. The directors Ms. Malloy & Ms. Rhonda both greet the kids every morning and afternoon by name. You can tell all of the teachers are genuinely excited to be there, they are all so friendly and engaging.

Our son had Ms. Stephanie and Ms. Violetta. They are the sweetest and energetic duo with a ton of experience. They make the kids feel so special and loved. They are respectful and take the time to really get to know the kids. They make learning fun (my personal fav - they even taught them about dental health and why brushing teeth is so important, amazing!) it's play based learning and they do the cutest crafts too. They have a pumpkin patch event, Mother's Day/Father's Day parties, a Christmas + Easter performance, and even a jog-a-thon! Our son also has a food allergy, which they take very seriously and we greatly appreciate. We feel totally at ease when we drop him off.

This is was our first experience choosing a preschool with our first child so we toured.. several.. schools!! After we toured Redeemer we knew hands down, it was the one. We couldn't be more pleased with our decision. We are now on his second year here - our son still gets so excited and truly looks forward to going to preschool every day. They get to go to chapel once a month and Pastor D makes it so much fun! The campus is new, clean, has a spacious playground and is extremely safe/secure! A growing and vibrant church. This is the place where we come together to celebrate and serve our God. Outstanding preschool and Kindergarten - there are a lot of families with young children. There is a great mix of traditional Lutheran liturgy and values and also forward leaning contemporary services with great live music from a praise band. There is a home here where any race, economic or family background will find friends and support. Give this place a try... we did 6 years ago and have been part of the Redeemer family ever since. We had a pretty awful experience with Redeemer. We signed up our daughter after being on the waitlist, and paid a non-refundable deposit for tuition, supplies and registration fee. You have no choice but to sign this as you sign up. A couple months later, we got a diagnosis our daughter had a special need and needed therapy, but the only time to do that was during the time we had class at Redeemer. The other option Redeemer gave us was in the afternoon sessions which didn't work for us, since we work. We withdrew 2+ months before school began and they replaced her spot but refused to give us back our deposit, even after we laid out the circumstance to them.

We had to take them to court to try to recover it. The judge ruled that even though it's bad business for them to do this and a bad way to treat families of those you're supposed to be helping, they could keep the nearly $500 because they offered us an option B (an option which didn't work for us).  This, also despite the fact that the CA Supreme Court has ruled non-refundable deposits ARE refundable if a replacement "buyer" (student) is found. They can't legally enrich themselves over our unfortunate circumstance, but they--a church preschool--opted to do that.

We are very frustrated, and not the first family to deal with this. Be wary of what you sign, and the fact that Redeemer's people don't necessarily have your best interests in mind, even when it comes to an unforeseen circumstance surrounding a 3-year-old. Worst Easter experience at any church.  First time at this church.  Some major photo production out front (poor timing on the second busiest time of the year). Greeted at door by old guys wearing white holy robes (like episcopalians and Catholics wear), and elders who gave me a printed packet.  I stepped out front to read while waiting for my children and grandchildren in their van. Photographer immediately approached me to push me aside, out of view because of my Hawaiian shirt in background (I forgot my Armani and tie).  Sorry, I don't attend churches where the type of car you arrive in, and what you're wearing make the poison inside of the cup seem clean (Isn't that what the Sanhedrin were criticized for by Jesus?).  Yikes.  Me thinks not.  I think I will stick with Bible-based non-denominational churches and leave all this religiosity for those who expect our appearance is what makes us holy enough to meet Jesus.  By the way, a professional photographer (like me) would have arranged his venue timing so that crowds of people (like on Easter Sunday) don't cramp his style or backgrounds.  Never coming back.  Stick to KWave (107.9) and your bible if you want to meet God.  Oh, I'm pretty sure he wears a white tunic with gold sash and gold boots (Yep, that's what it says in Daniel 10:5), sans tie and jacket, and the pearl white Lexus (or worse:  Black Beemer, Satan's car). Very friendly nice people

name: Redeemer Christian Church - Amarillo Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church on Sunday, July 6th, and from every song to the scripture and communion it all centered on Jesus! The people were super friendly, the staff was kind, and the church was alive and active. I'd recommend it to anyone in the Amarillo area! My wife and I drive 50 miles with our kids to Church on Sundays. We love Redeemer and what it has meant for our family.

Here you will find humble Christ-centered teachings and worship deeply rooted in the primacy of scripture. The leadership and elders are ones who love and serve the Lord.

The children's program is gospel-centered and thriving.

Redeemer is a church that is growing both organically through families with children, and through outreach in the community.

Part of the Acts 29 network. We were travelling through Amarillo and this church was 7 minutes from the campground where we were staying. We’re so glad we went. Lots of friendly people and the sermon was so impactful!! Music was great. Felt Jesus in that place.♥️ Since the day I started going to Redeemer I felt welcomed. They teach the word of God, not their “opinions”. I can feel that the pastors are humble men of God. I also Love Ramona Coffman, the Operations Manager! She’s such a wonderful selfless woman of God! Thank y’all for serving in this way! Redeemer is all about Jesus! I love this church family. The people are friendly, welcoming and Christ centered.

name: Redeemer Church - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a church to go to in Lubbock, I can't recommend Redeemer enough! I instantly felt very welcome, and everyone I've come in contact with has been so loving and helpful. I can honestly say that Redeemer played a key role in my return to faith and integration into the community. I can't imagine going anywhere else! It's a such a nice community with excellent fellowship!! The pastor is young, a good preacher and loves the Lord. It's a good place for  families with excellent doctrine!! Redeemer Lubbock is a church that I will forever regard as the healthiest and safest church I’ve been apart of. They teach truth straight from the Bible and help explain what it means and how it should inform our thoughts, words, actions, relationships, etc. God used Redeemer in my life to gift me deep community of individuals also chasing after God. My time in the city of Lubbock was one of the most mentally, emotionally, and spiritually tumultuous times in my life and I cannot count the number of times I was met with abounding grace, love, and truth by the body at Redeemer. I’m teary just thinking about it. They have so many opportunities to learn more through conferences and equipping classes. They also have so many opportunities to build community through serving, gospel communities, grow groups, member meetings, hang outs, etc. At Redeemer, I learned more about who God is and how he sees me more than anywhere else. I am forever grateful. No matter where you are spiritually, Redeemer is a safe place for you. I think that is the most special part of it. Redeemer has been an incredible gift to me and my family. The sermons are grounded in the gospel and the people have a deep desire to be more like Jesus. I am incredibly thankful for our Gospel Community (small group) that is more like family than friends.

Redeemer did a “Worth It” serious that grew me in so many ways. The bottom line was, if Jesus is worth our complete love and adoration, it should be reflected in every area of our lives. It really has changed the way I think, make decisions, and strive to have Jesus reflected in all areas of my life.

I am so thankful for Redeemer! Redeemer has been such a blessing in my life since I moved to Lubbock 5 years ago.  I desired a church that offers biblical community, is firmly rooted in scripture, and encourages their members to not just attend on Sunday but actually live our their faith every day of the week - and that is what I found at this church.  If you desire a closer relationship to Christ and his people then you should come and see what God is doing and has been doing at Redeemer.

name: Redeemer Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary:
Gotta say this place does a great job of creating an illusion of “ministry” by being a “cool church”, kind of tiptoeing around the edge of actual preaching so as not to become unpopular, as if we aren’t unpopular enough as christians to just own it and be his hands and feet, not try and meld with pop culture..
Best part of it was one friendly guy who apologized that his kid (he probably had 8 or 9 of them poor guy) kept making funny faces at me during the service. He honestly had me chuckling and helped me stay the rest of the service which probably had about 1 good point made, the rest was asking for money, announcements, more announcements, telling us how good of people they are yadda yadda,  talking about a book they wrote, music performances (not even worship), and pastor wife giving what seemed to be business pitches. Very odd There used to be really good sermons and pastors here until about 5-10 years ago it started to go downhill and everything started to change..worship and everything now it seems it is all for show and a fake to get people to come in and donate. Especially with a female worship director they sometimes use as an extra pastor when the two male pastors are too tired apparently to produce a sermon once every other week week?- not being sexist she just does not get anywhere with any of the things she says. We want the word, not to be rambled and long pauses and weird moody lights and music in the background for distractions because you can’t make sermons anymore. Suprise, Well, even my kid does not enjoy being in a barnyard room full of 50+ crazy kids older and younger than him for “Sunday school” which is pool tables and eating chips and soda for breakfast? he wants to be in a room of a small group of kids his age being taught, not playing games and watching shows. You guys have gone downhill. So sad. I just pulled around the back of this church to hook up a battery system (power for travelling).

Some members of the church walked out and asked me what I was doing. I wasn't trying to be disruptive as there isn't usually anyone out back there, and churches will typically allow you to use their parking lot for a few hours for various things, so I did even bother to ask them if it was ok given it was a Tuesday afternoon/evening.

So these two women approached me, and I politely explained I was just hooking up a battery system for my car (you know for doing that traveling).

I told them I was just hanging out a bit to do that, and they said: Ok. We were just wondering yada yada. They didn't ask me to leave, so I went back to work and thought nothing of it.

Then a really nice police officer shows up. Just asks a few questions. Runs my plate ID exceterra. They ask if I wouldn't mind leaving to which I said no problem. I wish the church had said something so we didn't have to waste the polices' time. They get a bad rap, but TPD has always been cool to me.

I get it. I look like a crazy person who was doing God knows what, but don't you think the more "Christian thing to do" would have been to ask me politely to leave? There is some sort of Bible quote I could throw here, but we know that they aren't truly believers in doing the right and neighborly thing. This Church & the people (especially those who embraced me) with such love and kindness will forever hold a special place in my heart and prayers! Rev. Adam is truly a Pastor after God's own heart for the people! I have been truly blessed and inspired by this ministry to continue running my race in Christ Jesus! I encourage you to come with an open heart & spirit; God will do the rest! #livingwitness Community is so important and I am grateful for the community and my many experiences here! Until next time! Blessings 🙏🏽‼️✝️❤️ We visited for the first time today and it was wonderful!  The worship, sermon, friendliness,  even the coffee was exceptional.  They even have a prayer room!  You don't see that very often these days.  We will be back!

name: Redeemer Church (PCA) - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming church.  Great preaching and much to learn from Sunday school programs.  Also appreciate weekly communion. Very family-oriented church. I visited there recently. It's weird to give a church a star rating, I just did 3 stars because that was my experience, but I don't have kids. This church is very kid-friendly in the sanctuary so there were a lot of kids bored out of their minds, fidgeting, crying, talking, wandering in and out of the sanctuary and it was distracting for me. I'm not saying it was a bad thing and it says right in the bulletin that they welcome noisy children in worship. The church reminded me of what I imagine old school churches were like. It was packed to the rafters with families. Everybody looked happy and healthy. Everything was professionally done. The pianist was amazing. The music was good and there was a lot of it. Some people actually sang parts in the hymns which I don't think I've ever heard in my life from the congregation but which was a very welcome surprise. I studied music and people don't understand how important music is as a form of actual worship. The minister is clearly a pro. The congregation again was a positive, healthy bunch which may sound obvious but you'd be surprised. Fortunately I didn't see a lot of this Covid idolatry you get in some churches. The pianist was wearing a mask which I'll just leave that there. The vibe was kind of like "Hey I just work here."  All in all it was a good experience. I think finding a church home is harder than finding a life partner in some ways. They serve communion twice a month which is nice. Again, people don't take communion seriously enough in general. I didn't. Had to learn the hard way. I had visited across the street and somebody said, "If this place isn't conservative enough for you you could try across the street" so I did. I don't mean politically conservative but this is a Bible believing church as all churches should be. I forgot to mention and I was delighted to see they do NOT have a TV screen in the sanctuary, they do NOT have any kind of band playing as so many churches do, they just have the pianist, who again was amazing. Come for Jesus, stay to hang with Presbyterians This is a wonderful Church. Faithful to the scriptures and very rich fellowship! Great solid reformed church.

name: Redeemer Church Jersey City - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary: The good people are here. I like it and recommend. Stay good, take it easy... I've visited Redeemed a couple of times, and it was always a good experience. The people there are warm and welcoming. Warm welcoming atmosphere. Everyone was so friendly and the energy was warm and welcoming. This is a small conservative church., Presbyterian, meeting in a school, where mostly everyone knows your name.

name: Redeemer Church OC
reviewSummary: Excellent PCA congregation. Expository preaching and highly welcoming.

name: Redeemer City Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a place where you can freely worship God? This is the place! No pretenses with this Pastor. His messages are down to earth and apply to today's life problems. Fantastic contemporary music! Two services 9:15 and 11:00 am Sundays with weekly City Group (small group) meeting throughout the Tampa area during the week. All ages are welcome and represented. A great place for children to learn the word of God. This is a very welcoming church with a great kids ministry and Bible teaching from the lead pastor Mitch. This is a church to call home and find community. Words cannot adequately express how much I love this church. The sound biblical teaching from Pastor Mitch is second to none. This church is my family, and I couldn't imagine doing life anywhere else. If you're looking for a fantastic church home, and live anywhere near Tampa, I highly recommend Redeemer City Church! If you are looking to be a part of a church community in a meaningful way and are unhappy with typical sermons that are simply self-promoting or filled with platitudes, then you should come check out Redeemer City Church.  This is an incredible new church with a warm and welcoming community. My family hunted all over South Tampa looking for a church community; we found an authentic and biblical one here at Redeemer. The teachings challenge (not just help us feel better about ourselves) us all to be more Christlike, emphasizing the point that we are not "better" than others because we call ourselves Christians - we struggle to live out our faith every day and try to be more faithful through life with our community. I would describe the preaching to be of a similar vein as Tim Keller (unapologetic, yet approachable, Christian teachings meant for everyone without ridicule). The church is also committed to having a demonstrable impact on the community of Tampa Heights through frequent service opportunities by partnering with local charities. The building is easy to miss, but don't let that fool you. Being a military family, we’ve been to a myriad of churches everywhere we’ve moved. This move to Tampa was the hardest for us to find a place where we could belong as grace-needy, in-process, don’t-have-it-all-together people until we stumbled into Redeemer City Church. Since then, we’re still those same grace-needy people, but we’re having those daily needs met with solid gospel preaching and shepherding, meaningful membership, a place to use our gifts and serve others, and a people to call our own. It’s truly a place where you can come as you are, consistently hear the good news about Jesus, and leave better than you were.

Our four kids are excited about the children’s and youth ministry (a first in the last several churches we’ve been a part of) and my husband and I are nourished by our weekly City Group where we can go deeper in Scripture and relationships as we break bread and open our bibles together.

We only wish we had stumbled into Redeemer sooner!

name: Redeemer Community Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: We really enjoyed the service at this church on Easter Sunday 2026. I would recommend that the staff provide guidance through the website or social media page(s) on how to reserve seating in the sanctuary. Our family (of 6) was not aware of this requirement, and we were redirected to an overflow building across the street in front of other members of the congregation, although we were 10 minutes early for the service starting time. I would consider allowing guests in the church during services that are full, and allowing your staff and/or congregation to participate in attendance in the overflow service across the street. The message, testament, and word(s) that were shared during this service were invaluable, our family is very grateful to have been in attendance while visiting Birmingham from out of town. We are so thankful to have found Redeemer.   Genuine Christian family where you can be real with your struggles and find encouragement.  God’s word is so clearly taught here.   Our faith is stronger and we are finding soul nourishing healing from our past.  A work in progress.  I pray God continues to bless this church family and guide our Pastors. Great service today This church believes the Bible, preaches it, lives it, and fosters true discipleship. The gospel is central in the life of this group of believers, and love abounds. The members here don’t believe they’re good because they do good things; they know they’re sinners counted as righteous because of the shed blood of Jesus Christ. This attitude enables them to be a huge blessing to the city they live in. Solid, Biblical teaching. Fun, hipster sort of music. Casual, come-as-you-are dress. Strong desire to serve and love the city. I was a member here for a year or two until I got married and moved to my wife's church since she had deep roots there. I was definitely blessed by Redeemer, especially the depth of the teaching.

name: Redeemer Community Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary: The best! Love the spirit in this church.  Lot's of young families with children.  Father's are very involved with teaching and helping with children.  The Pastors are awesome!  Great outreach programs.  Music ministry is also outstanding. Pastor Taylor is such a caring and wonderful person A++ nothing but great things to say They are friendly open minded extremely caring so far have not judged me or been condescending. They always ask sincerely how we are and if they can pray for us.  I do feel like the lord Jesus is in that place and in their hearts. Been attending church here since my family moved back to Bloomington after trying a couple of other churches. Immediately felt welcomed and at home. A gospel-centered church on a mission! Love the pastors and the entire congregation! Very welcoming and super amazing people...

name: Redeemer Lutheran Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending Redeemer Lutheran Church in March 2025, went through confirmation classes with Pastor Ernst Jeong, and officially became a member in October—and my boyfriend and I have absolutely loved it.

It truly reminds me of the church I grew up in: a small, family-oriented community that teaches the Truth and stays grounded in the Gospel. There’s a more traditional feel to the services, which I really appreciate, and it creates a meaningful, reverent environment.

What has stood out most is how personally invested this church has been in me. From the very beginning, people have been incredibly welcoming, and it genuinely feels like a place where you’re known and cared for. Many families have been attending for decades, which speaks so much to the strength of the community.

They also host such fun and thoughtful events—we joined for preschool Trunk or Treat (dressed as Romans!) and have loved things like soup suppers and pie contests. There’s also a small, intentional preschool and a growing young adult community, which has been really special to be part of.

If you’re looking for a church that is rooted in truth, centered on the Gospel, and has a strong sense of community, I can’t recommend this church enough. With Easter coming up, it’s the perfect time to visit! When I moved to the area I began looking for a church that espoused the true word of God while keeping to the traditional Lutheran confessions. This church not only met my expectations, but exceeded them.

The community is incredibly sincere and welcoming, including generations of families that have been raised through this church. The young adult group is small, but still new and growing.

The traditional service structure provides the attention and reverance that the Word deserves. The sacraments are carried out weekly, providing the healing gifts that only the Lord can provide.

Let the Spirit bring you here and you will not be disappointed. Great church. Friendly congregation. Teachs the pure word of God. I did chair massage for teacher appreciation. Really great staff! Traditional Christian values are important to me.

name: Redeemer Lutheran Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Redeemer OC - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been attending here with my wife for two years and we are grateful. Would definitely recommend to anyone. We have a great mix of cultures, races, and the service currently takes place in a Jewish temple, pretty cool! Also, there are many young families/Individuals here compared to other presbyterian churches I’ve visited.Come, check it out for yourself and say hello. God bless My family has been worshipping at Redeemer OC for about six years and love the order of worship and the teaching on Sunday mornings. We drive all the way down from north Orange County and have found a great Redeemer OC community up in our area that meets regularly together for meals and bible studies. We have been members at Redeemer for nearly 17 years and love this community of people! We are fed spiritually and grateful to be a part of an established, gospel-centered church. Redeemer is a wonderful place to worship. At Redeemer you find gospel centered teaching and a community of faith that seeks to live out that teaching in daily life. I love being a member and elder at Redeemer. It's a place where the Bible is taught faithfully, and people are known, loved, and cared for well.

name: Redeemer Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Pioneering urban congregation founded by Tim Keller. Celebrated for intellectual rigor, compassionate city mercy ministries (Hope for New York), and cultural integration.

name: Redeemer Presbyterian Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is truly a blessing! It is filled with kind, humble and Christ centered people. Even though it’s a large church, it has an incredible sense of community where you really feel like you belong.

The children’s program is phenomenal—biblically grounded, engaging, and full of love for the kids. The young adult community is equally vibrant, offering great fellowship, encouragement, and opportunities to grow together in Christ.

Every sermon is deeply rooted in Scripture, and it’s clear Redeemer is a true Bible-preaching church that faithfully adheres to God’s Word. Pastor Paul is a gifted preacher and wise shepherd who leads with humility and vision. He is passionate about making disciples who make disciples, faithfully fulfilling the Great Commission. His stewardship of the church is both inspiring and encouraging.

The community groups are a great way to meet people and there are plenty of welcome events and volunteer opportunities.  My wife and I were plugged in quickly and soon hosted a community group. I am glad I found this church! Like every church (lowercase c) it has it's pluses and minuses but my experience was best when I first attended and had some young adult friendships from 2018-2019. Pastor Paul sermons are probably the best reason to keep going, along with the diversity and the modern style worship in a nice space.
However, the biggest negatives of the church now are 2nd and 3rd services are totally crowded packed with parking challenging, and that the current "young adults" is very lacking on substance in terms of theological study and co-ed life maturity. As a 35 year old single male, I do feel I've had trouble connecting here and engaging faith in a meaningful way with people my life stage and the CG (community groups). We tried a few churches in San Diego and we found a real home here at Redeemer. The pastors are humble and inspiring. The congregation is friendly. It is multi generational, multi cultural and truly an inspiration. I highly recommend trying out this church.  If you’re further east or south you could try our church plant Trinity, another wonderful group Great church, very inviting atmosphere, and great engaging speakers!  They have a very contemporary worship environment with people of all backgrounds.  I would highly recommend a visit to check it out. After many years reasons for leaving best summed up here.
Look for people who are "real" about who they are, not trying to appear perfect.  Those are trustworthy people, and God is on their side.

God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble James 4:6

name: Redeemer Presbyterian Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Great PCA church with amazing people to go through life with! The church meets at 1:30pm at Baycities - Lomita (2043 Lomita Blvd, Lomita, CA 90717) and would love to have you visit.

name: Redeeming Love Church
reviewSummary:
I attended this church for a few years before leaving due to several serious concerns. One major issue was encountering racism—on one occasion, a parishioner openly displayed Confederate flag memorabilia in their home and then shared stories about how they felt “violated” by Black people during their childhood. I am not their therapist, and I found this deeply inappropriate and disturbing. This wasn’t in the church- but this member was a long-term and well-known member of the congregation.

In addition, leadership appears more focused on nepotism than on discerning and appointing leaders with true spiritual gifts (I believe Pastor James is Pastor Mike’s son-in-law, with one of Pastor James’ son leading youth group). There is a clear dynamic of in-groups and out-groups, and leadership is resistant to feedback or meaningful self-reflection. For example, when accessibility needs (such as ensuring written materials are in accessible formats) were raised about their children’s brochures/wayfinding, they dismissed and resisted making improvements.

Some church attendees in a prayer group I attended a few years back  even prayed for a particular presidential candidate to win an election, which is inappropriate in a church setting. This seeded some division there and made me not want to come back. Families within the church often appear resistant to change, and “diversity” is treated more as a marketing or fundraising point rather than a true value.

Finally, missionary work seems more focused on creating travel opportunities and photo-ops for church insiders than on uplifting the people they claim to serve. These issues combined led me to leave, and I could not recommend this church as a spiritually healthy or inclusive place.

Edited 9/25/25: Case in point. So the gentleman who just left a 5 start review, John Robert, appears to be from a John Tolo who runs the Godtown ministries and is essentially getting RLC church dollars. Not sure if it is actually him posting, but if it is, of course  this person will rate the church well. And of course it feels like home to them. They are supported by RLC and get donations from parishioners. The pastor here is a really awesome person. He was willing to help me out with a tough situation without judgment Love the cultural diverse ethnic church family here. Great teaching , worship, and community outreach events. I  come here a lot from out of town to attend various conferences too, which they host (IHOP Regional Conference from Kansas City one year)! They talk about being a welcoming community but have nothing but cliques. There is a false sense of welcome here. If you're not part of a clique you're basically invisible and no one wants to engage with you. If you don't know someone in the church you will be an outcast. Similarly there is a lot of annoying fear mongering and political rhetoric. And finally, one of the higher ups who I trusted and asked to pray for my Dad flat out said to expect God not to heal my Dad. I do not know the reason for that person telling me that but it seriously wounded me. I will not name the person but want others to be aware. Suffice to say I refuse to attend this place any further. Hello I have been visiting redeeming love since July 2023!  and the pastors there are very nice and caring and the church is a loving atmosphere for those that need nurturing! I have visited many churches in my lifetime, but I believe that Redeeming loves for exceeds the love that I never experienced before. God bless you all and if anyone needs encouragement, Redeeming love would be the church for you! They are truly the Hands & feet of Jesus! This ministry is focused on Winning souls salvation is available to all who are willing to say yes to Jesus! The hospitality that I and my Daughter have experience visiting Redeeming Love is such a inspiration of God’s love I will definitely be coming back to attend church there. Hopefully I can become a member.

name: Redeeming Word Church - Lithonia Campus
reviewSummary:
In 2023 I was new to the  Lithonia area and was looking for a church home. I said I was going to visit multiple churches till I found the one I liked. So I googled churches in the area and found Redeeming Word Church. When I tell you the moment I walk through their doors, the presence of the Lord was in that place. The more I came the better it got. Pastor Randle breaks the word down so that it can be understood. First Lady Randle is sweet, compassionate and will usher in praise like nobody’s business. The vision pastor has for this church is reachable and encouraging.
This church is youthful with all ages in attendance. I couldn’t have found a better church for such times. I highly recommend Redeeming Word Church. It must be experienced.
Love love love this church…..!!!!! Redeeming Word Church is a wonderful place to worship. From the moment I stepped foot in the door I felt welcomed. From the opening prayer to the benediction, I enjoyed myself immensely,  the songs that were sung, and the word that was preached , I definitely would recommend this church to anyone! I have been attending Redeeming Word Church for two years now, and I am continually impressed by the welcoming atmosphere and sense of community here. The sermons are thought-provoking and uplifting, and the music during worship services is truly inspirational. The leadership and members of this church are truly dedicated to serving others and spreading love and compassion. I feel blessed to be a part of such a wonderful church family. I highly recommend Redeeming Word Church to anyone seeking spiritual growth and connection!! We visited Redeeming Word a couple of Sundays last year and we were throughly impressed! We made the decision to join this February and have been blessed by the preaching, teaching, genuine love and excellence that is offered here. Our 17 year old daughter LOVES this church and that says a mouthful. She has been involved since day one and for this we give God all the praise! I would give more ⭐️ but we are only allowed 5. If you want to be blessed and strengthened Redeeming Word is the place for you! Listennn, if you’re looking for a church that truly feels like family, Redeeming Word Church is IT! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth, love, and real people who genuinely care about you..not just on Sundays, but every day of the week.
The worship? OH BABY ITS Powerful. The Word? Our Pastor does his BIGGEST ONE! & it’s ALWAYS on point. And the youth ministry?? We’re out here thriving! It’s not one of those churches where young adults feel out of place… nah, we’re active, we’re seen, and we’re growing in our faith together. Whether you’re new to church or just looking for a fresh start, this is the place to be. God is moving, and trust me, you wanna be in the room!

name: Redemption Arcadia - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
The church and community is kind and welcoming, the staff and pastors are positive and caring. I look forward to Sunday and coming here. They have Bible study groups, youth group, and on Sundays they provide childcare from infants up to sixth grade. The pastors are always available. They do community gatherings such as all church lunch. They order in from Pita Jungle,  Chick-fil-A etc and it’s a great way to connect and get to know other people in the church in a way that you ordinarily wouldn’t. They’re very welcoming to all ages and families. I got baptized here last year. They are Bible based- their tagline is all of life is all for Jesus! This is a neighborhood church in the Biltmore and they have 7 or 8 in the valley. What a great scripture based church
Our family really enjoyed our visit the last few times Such a great Church with great Pastoral staff who love people, and spread and teach the Gospel like it’s their only mission in life!  10/10 recommend for anyone looking for a good Bible believing and preaching Church. This is hands down the best church I've ever been to. Pastor Frank makes church exciting and relatable. I'm always happy to hear him preach! He's also really funny and makes a lot of references. I would suggest you check it out! ☺ Also...with communion there is an opportunity for you to talk to the pastor or other leaders of the church and they will pray with you one on one. Just go, you'll love it!! Went to Church last Sunday with my 2 sons,  Brian and Larry. From there, we went to lunch at the Sicilian Butcher.

name: Redemption Church
reviewSummary:
Our son took us here during our visit.
Excellent place for worship.
The seating capacity is probably around 200. It is completely full with small children being held by parents.
Great sermon with penetrating application.
We praise the Lord that this church is here to glorify His name. The whole word of God preached. Sin, knowing forgiveness is available to all who were called. He'll and eternal damnation for the non-believers. For wide is the road that leads eternal torment. But narrow is the way that leads to eternal life, and is only found in Christ Jesus ALONE
!!!
Both roads say this way to HEAVEN yet few will there be that enter by the narrow way. Just as the flood swept away all but a few in the days of Noah. True believers  saved by God's Grace. The rest,  Non-believers and  to eternal Hell. damnatiom A loving community, with sound doctrine, seeking truth together in the gospel of Jesus Christ. Awesome church. Very welcoming to all who attend! Mostly white people and not willing to answer the tough questions.

name: Redemption Church - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: My family went to this church for 9 years. We did everything we could to stay local almost entirely because we did not want to leave this family. This church will always be our home, no matter where else we go. A warm, welcoming place where you can relax and truly enjoy church. Excellent music, good teaching, friendly people of all ages,  and no pressure.I have truly enjoyed my visits to this church. Now that I have moved here, I plan to make it my regular church. A smaller church that is looking to reach out to the community that surrounds it. Worship is contemporary but with hymns as well. Its a great church where everybody knows everybody else. Loved our time here. So genuine and friendly. Will be back.

name: Redemption Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Love the authenticity and engagement of people in the church. It is a small church environment that allows you to wrestle with your faith. Sincearity, simplicity in front of God

name: Redemption Church - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
Attending church service at Redemption Church at Nigh Centre in Edmond, Oklahoma. Its really different experience attending worship service in the US as most of their song of praise are very Americanised which you hardly heard of them in churches in Asia or Oceania where Hillsong dominates. Met a long of Christian brothers and sisters amd had a wonderful time of worship with my daughter here. As an Acts 29 church, I knew that Redemption would be theologically sound and biblically astute, but what sets Redemption apart is the authenticity of its pastors, staff, and congregants. If you are new, you WILL be greeted at the door and welcomed with a warm and genuine smile... probably several. You will experience a heart-felt musical worship service and a Bible-based sermon. If you are seeking good Bible teaching and authentic Christ-centered relationships, look no further.

Since first attending Redemption over a year ago, my wife and I have joined a small group and serve regularly in the children’s ministry. We haven’t looked back. Our small group is amazing, and we simply love our church. The preaching is Gospel with no smoke and mirrors.  Children hear The word and The Lord's Supper is celebrated every week.  The members walk with each other through good and tough life events and all are cared for. Gospel centered church that beautifully communicates God's love, grace and character. The worship is fantastic, sincere, and does a great job of creating a tone and environment for preparing your hearts to receive the word of God. The people who attend, as well as the staff, are all warm and welcoming and very accessible. Highly recommend. I originally came here because I needed some hours for community service. No where else was offering it, but here at Redemption, they went out of their way to make it wiork.
Where I have always been close with God but had not been to church in a while. That first Sunday I went and I just loved their service it was like none I had experienced before. No matter your background, everyone makes you feel so very welcome and no pressure with the best uplifting music during service.

name: Redemption Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary: Redemption church has been such a blessing to our family.  Our merciful Father is active and present in this group. Bible-based teaching through simple truths, heartfelt worship through song, and intentional discipleship in small round table discussions. A genuine group of people who readily confess their faults, yet rejoice in the grace and mercy given us through Christ. To know Christ and make Him known to others is the goal. I would encourage any to come as you are. My husband and I are so thankful God has led us to Redemption Church. I was nervous the first time we visited, but the people at Redemption are so incredibly genuine that it felt like home right away! It is such a blessing to now have a church family that we can share struggles with and encourage throughout the week.This church is completely focused on making Christ known and teaching truth. I  am challenged to grow in my faith every week. Come join the Redemption Church family! Our family loves Redemption church! We have 2 children under the age of 2 and have enjoyed getting to know many other families in the church, and our children love the kids discipleship. Not only that, but Redemption church has members of all ages and walks of life who are truly seeking the Lord, and living out their mission to know Jesus and make Him known! We were relatively new to the area and had tried several churches prior to Redemption church’s official “launch” in 2020, but the first Sunday we attended we immediately knew- this was it - we felt at home. We learn so many new things about scripture and are challenged to grow every Sunday (and Wednesday evening!). Would highly highly recommend Redemption church to any and everyone! Whether you’ve never been to church before or are looking to get plugged back in, etc. I would highly recommend Redemption! I am a member of redemption church. There is something special about this place. We share our struggles and joys. Every family member or friend that has visited have loved it. Very friendly and loving group. Our pastor, Steve Gee, is special… That’s just the truth.  Every time he teaches I learn something new and beautiful about our Lord. He has an amazing heart and insight to scripture.  If you are looking for a church - or wondering why you’ve drifted away from your faith, come to Redemption. We are just a bunch of human beings trying to glorify God but missing the mark every day… Would love for you to be a part of it. A warm and kind welcome that makes you feel comfortable and at rest. Beautiful worship and sound, biblical preaching that both blesses and challenges. So glad to have finally found a church home where we feel cared for and prepared to go and share the Gospel.

name: Redemption Church - Rome Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been coming to this church ever since we moved from Colorado. We moved to Rome because of my husband’s work but I truly feel that we were brought here not because of his work, but to find Redemption church. To be honest, I have been jaded with Christianity for most of my life due to past experiences, but recently (in the past 3 years) felt the call to try and go to church again.

We have been searching for a church to call home - in Colorado and in North Carolina and we have never felt closer to Jesus while being embraced by such a warm and welcoming family than here at redemption. It could bring me to tears. Nick Jones is the absolute best pastor. Every sermon and every message he shares opens our hearts even more to this astounding faith. My husband struggled with depression most of his life and I see the change this church is making in him. I’ve never believed more in miracles than I do now. Nick Jones, Redemption church, and redemption family have been the biggest blessing in our lives. Thank you for everything. Truly.

Malia, Matthew, and Penelope 🤍 B3st church that I have been to in years. Very caring people at Redemption Church. The worship music is off 5he charts Pastor Nick is a awesome man preaching God's word. Very great place to be on a Sunday morning I wouldn't have it any other way. Love Redemption Church of Rome GA My family and I came there once last year by mistake cause we didn't know the church we were looking for changed their name and moved. My husband and I are interracial couple my daughter and granddaughter are my race. We felt so unwelcome soon as we walked through the door didn't even get a greeting from them or when we left. We thought it was a interracial church unfortunately it wasnt Love to hear the word of the Lord taught. Worship was awesome. We can see how God is working in and out side of the church. In our families. Working together as team for God is the way to go. We are one in Christ Jesus. Y'all I seriously LOVE my church!! When I check in on Sundays and put that hashtag is not bc I'm told to or bc it's something the church does it is bc I truly love my church! Everything and everyone is so welcoming and friendly all the time. We are growing more and more each sunday! All the pastors and their spouses are friendly and take time to actually speak to you before and after church not just a handshake and have a good day type deal. Worship is amazing every week as well as the message! Pastor Nick knows how to bring forth an amazing word but keep it funny and entertaining at the same time. We have awesome life groups every Sunday morning and our kids and youth programs are great and always doing something fun and teaching our young ones about Christ. We also have men and women's groups on Wednesday that are so close knit and really allows you to open up with one another. It is so refreshing to look forward to church on Sundays and Wednesday! If you are looking for a church to visit or to call home please come join us at Redemption Church!!! We would love to see you and get the chance to worship with you. Can't wait to see what all God has in store for us!! #RedemptionChurch #ILoveMyChurch

name: Redemption Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: They are so loving you come up there and dressed in any way in any mood and when you leave you leave edified, gratified and loved almost like a different and happier you wonderful loving Church all cultures makes numerous ages from babies to ancient wisdom aged seniors Nice church. Great songs. Wonderful and diverse people. My only comment is the gluten free option of Communion. Seriously? Do all gluten free or don't. This is strange. My very first service will be Sunday  and I love the fact that there are careing people who love and serve one another great bible preaching and teaching  and wonderful music For some people Gluten-free diet is medically necessary. For many it's not a choice. Celiac is serious disease. Love the church. Pastor Chris is easy to follow and delivers the word in a way that is very engaging.

name: Redemption Church [ Sundays ]
reviewSummary:
Pastor Alex, along with the other pastors, are all truly wonderful people. Above all, you can genuinely feel the presence and power of the Holy Spirit during the sermons, which makes this church a very special place.

Parking can be a bit challenging, but there are many families with children, and the church is lively with people of all ages. It’s a great environment where you can grow together with the church community.

There are also monthly events, so I would highly recommend it to anyone who wants to get more involved and build meaningful connections. Everybody is GENUINELY friendly here! I felt welcomed from the moment I walked through the door! The church is next to Green Lake, so I got there early and went for a walk with my kiddo. The kids check in is really easy! The head of the children’s ministry Ben.. walked me through it from start to finished. Very friendly and chill. Pastor Alex was super dope too. Has a genuine passion for people. The people here come across like they’re NOT afraid of people from various or gritty backgrounds. They want you to feel welcomed. This church was so unpretentious and set up to accommodate and support families! Im a Single Parent and felt like I had hands on help with knowing what to do without being or feeling overwhelmed. The messages are on point too! I listened to several messages from their website before coming. There’s parking in the neighborhoods too! Check this place out. I left feeling so welcomed! My wife and I have been attending here for almost a year now.  When we moved to Seattle this was the first and last church we visited because we felt that God wanted us to be here.  Redemption is a young church plant, reformed in theology, big on the Gospel and Jesus, focused on life groups and discipleship,and is growing together in some great ways.  It is  lead by two pastors on staff and 1 (soon to be 2) lay elders.

Finding a church can be really challenging as we all come with different backgrounds, experiences, and preferences.  Redemption isn't perfect (just like all other churches), but it is being lead well and I believe God is doing some great things here.  My wife and are are about a medium on the outgoing scale, and Redemption has done a great job of welcoming us, getting us plugged in to a life group, and giving us opportunities to serve the church body and the community around us.

I think Redemption offers some great things as far as churches go, but the main reason I would recommend you visit this place is so that you can be a part of a body of believers who are seeking to follow Jesus in all of life, not just certain segments.  I see this happening at Redemption and it is refreshing and exciting! Welcome home!
Friendly, caring people, beautiful church and top notch teaching of solid theology by gifted pastors.
You must come check it out for yourself. Most welcoming church I've been to.

name: Redemption Church North County - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: My 3 Sunday experience is that of a Biblical Christ centered worship service including Christ exalting music, a humbling call to confession, an abundance of scripture, prayer, and direction, and the Lord's supper reminding of the only truths that matter, who and what He Is, has done and will do. This new congregation restores my hope for the Church here is San Diego. The Holy Spirit is at work here. I am grateful. Christ centered preaching! The Lord’s grace is working mightily at this church. Amazing to be apart of a congregation that’s foundation is their faith in the finished work of Christ. The dedication to evangelism is on going and fruitful. Thankful for God’s work in this Church The sovereignty and grace of Christ is exalted through the teaching and worship while the fruit of love, joy and  gratitude is evident among the body of believers doing life together in unity. Christ is preached weekly by expositional preaching book by book. Communion weekly. Reformed. Baptist. Law/Gospel distinction. Couldn't ask for more! Christ-Centered biblical teaching!

name: Redemption City Church
reviewSummary:
Today being Good Samaritan Day made me reflect on this church. I visited a few times before moving across the country, and the impact they had on my life is something I will never forget.
During a very difficult season, they blessed me in a huge way by helping me receive a car. That blessing meant everything and helped me take care of my family when I truly needed it. They didn’t just talk about faith—they lived it. They also offer an amazing laundry service that helps people in the community with real everyday needs.
This church truly showed me what God calls His people to be—loving, generous, and willing to help others without judgment. They are truly everything a church is supposed to be, and I’m grateful I experienced that kind of kindness before I moved away.
“Do not forget to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.” — Hebrews 13:16 🙏 #Sharingwithscripture Redemption City Church is a vibrant community that I've had the pleasure of being a part of for over 10 years. From the moment you step through the doors, you will feel welcomed and accepted no matter where you are at in your walk with God.Whether you're a long-time member or a first-time visitor, there's a sense of belonging that you can feel throughout the entire congregation.

The worship services are powerful and engaging.The speakers convey a message of hope, love, and redemption, inviting and challenging the congregation to find their place in the story of the gospel.

Redemption City Church also places a strong emphasis on community outreach and service. It's evident that the church is not just a place for Sunday worship but a hub for making a positive impact in the local and global community. The various outreach programs and volunteer opportunities provide members with meaningful ways to contribute to the well-being of others.

The leadership team at Redemption City Church is approachable and genuinely cares about the spiritual growth and well-being of the congregation. There is transparency and humility that the leadership team embodies, creating an environment where individuals feel comfortable seeking guidance and support.

This church offers a welcoming and enriching experience, and will walk with you to a stronger relationship with Jesus. I’ve been a member here for over a decade and love what God is doing in our church. It was easy to get connected I initially and we have become like family to other members. The teaching is biblical and focused on the good news of Jesus being applied to our daily lives. Redemption City lives what they preach, bring the compassion and restoration to the city through Laundry Love and other city partnerships (read more on the website). We also have supported other church plants locally and globally, and support several church and parachurch missionaries globally! Pretty outsized impact for a church that is small enough to still feel like family! Redemption City is what church is supposed to be. The Gospel is preached here every week.

We love community

Members of the church are most of our community. We have Bible studies, membership classes, play date groups, weekly dinner groups. At many churches, the “passing of the peace” or “greeting time” feels forced or obligatory. Mike and Sebastian often have to cut us off. :D

We love actively

We support each other with childcare, loaned items, and cooking for those who are sick or postpartum or grieving. I was attracted to this church because of how the church parents. Children here are respected and not belittled.

We Rest

I have been here for almost three years because it is healthy. We have boundaries - people take breaks in leadership roles, we rest from most planned activities during the summer. We don’t work to burnout, we help each other.

We are transparent

The church is also displays our finances and makes them accessible to congregants - as it should be.

‌

God is worshipped here. We repent, grow, and rest. There are many ways to help, to ask for help here - to promote the Kingdom of God and to experience it. This is only the second church in GR that we visited when we moved 2 years ago, and we were so immediately welcomed into the family-like, community-minded congregation that we joined (with no regrets)! RCC includes our children in authentic worship followed by age-appropriate teaching while we as parents receive Biblical teaching and fellowship with like-minded believers. This is a church that prays together, supports each other in practical ways, and truly desires cultivating deeper relationships with God.

name: Redemption City Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the most welcoming loving Church I’ve ever been to. I’ve been with them since the beginning, and I can say they live by there Motto:  It’s not about nickels and noses. It’s about life-change in Christ. Fire and brimstone? Not here… There all about the love and GRACE of GOD and discernment.❤️✝️ This is home.
We find this church 3 years ago and we got plugged in very easily. Now it feels like family. The teaching is always clear, church staff is friendly and kind. There's kids care, students ministry, life groups during the week so there's plenty ways to participate and connect with others.
Check services time to visit 😊 So thankful God brought our family to Redemption City! God’s word is faithfully preached, the Gospel proclaimed, and people are known and loved. It took me a long time to find a new home church when I moved back home to Ormond Beach, and a great friend invited me to Redemption City Church and after my first visit I knew this would be my home church, period!
Thank you Jesus for bringing me here! A great place to attend; to follow Jesus.

name: Redemption Hill Bible Church
reviewSummary:
Redemption Hill Bible Church is a wonderful church home for anyone seeking solid, biblically based teaching and genuine Christian fellowship. The sermons are faithful to Scripture, practical, and encouraging, helping believers grow in their walk with Christ. The members are warm, welcoming, and sincerely care about building relationships and supporting one another. From the moment you walk through the doors, you feel valued and included. If you’re looking for a church that is committed to God’s Word and has a loving church family, I highly recommend Redemption Hill Bible Church. Redemption hill is a Bible believing church, we’ve attended for a few years now and are apart of small groups and Bible study’s and children’s ministry. We are grateful for the teaching of Gods word each week and the humbleness of the leadership here. Bible based teaching.  My husband and I have been attending for almost two years now and are so grateful to have community and support grounded in the teachings of the Bible.  There are many options for connection and growth.  I especially enjoy the women’s Bible studies as they have encouraged my faith to deepen in ways I have yet to experience at other churches in the past. Solid expository preaching verse by verse they uphold the word of God as the most important thing along with the gospel and they love for Jesus Christ I recommend this church to anybody that is truly seeking a relationship with Christ you cannot go wrong here There was some light snow on the road there but nothing dangerous, and they had super cool outdoor heaters with a coffee station and some pretty appealing looking doughnut holes.  I opted for just the coffee plain, and it was just the kind of mid grade church coffee I love. We were given a color map of Paul's travels and knowing full well that the front rows would be empty we made our way up to get our own row in the second row, with a largely empty first row for the band.  Looking behind myself most of the rest of the church looked pretty full.  The screen was prompting us to get our Bible ready, so I was excited to get a message

The music was sort of modern but more theologically sound than radio fare so that was pleasing, and people seemed pleasant.  The guy in charge of the teleprompter was a little better than average and minus a technical difficulty at the end I noticed that it was pretty easy to follow.  When the pastor prompted a scripture I noticed the sounds of Bibles turning throughout the room, implying there was a pretty dedicated congregation.  So far so good.

Fellowship time came up, and because there was no one else in the front of the church, the pastor approached us to chat.  I had noticed on the website that they had a particularly harsh stance on the gift of tongues, and I asked the pastor if there had been an incident.  He said that no there hadn't but he didn't teach that.  I said of course not, you can't teach a gift of God. He seemed a little irritated, so I tried to comfort him by saying I did not speak in tongues, so don't worry.  I pondered later if he meant that they didn't teach about it?

You in google reading land this don't know, but I -hate- when people change the scripture to fit a narrative.  I don't like when people add material, and I hate it when people change the meaning.

So we're in Acts 16, and he's talking about Lydia first and then the fortune telling slave girl.  He mentions how Lydia was so awesome, that after she was baptized, she started by giving the gospel to her whole family, and went on at length about how awesome she was for this.  It never says this happens like that in the Bible.  While I suppose it's possible that there's some clarifying material that he had read in seminary, it wasn't made clear in any sort of Bible I've heard of.

That said it was made clear in the Bible why the fortune telling slave girl stopped telling fortunes.  In acts 16:18 Paul rebukes the spirit she used to divine, and she could no longer divine. The preacher went on about how she could no longer tell fortunes because she had heard the gospel.  I guarantee every remotely legitimate version of the Bible says that it was because of the rebuke against the spirit of divination within her, not because of the gospel, including the version of the scripture he had up on screen. The scripture he -just- read to us.

Nothing about this church seemed like it was the doctrine of demons, but they played a little too fast and loose with the Bible for my liking.  Three red flags in one service is a bit much for me.

name: Redlands Christian Center - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: I have learned so much from the teachings of the pastors at Redlands Christian Center. It has impacted how I view myself and others in the light of the Gospel. This is truly a church that cares about its congregation! This is my Church filled with children families, worship and love.  PERIOD! Love it Good Service!

name: Redlands United Church of Christ - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I never thought I would feel comfortable in a Christian church. If you had told me two years ago that I would not only become a member but that I would be part of the church choir, I would have laughed in your face. Yet here I am. 🙂 This has been our church home for more than two decades. It's open and affirming (meaning all are welcome - lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ+).) My wife and I raised our kids in this church and enjoy volunteering. RUCC is justice-oriented following the teachings of Jesus Christ. There are lots of opportunities to serve and be served. I love my Church, we are welcomed by all who attends.
The sermons are so meaningful and you know that The Lord is with you. The music is amazing and there is a quiet peace. If you are looking for a place to worship all are welcome. It is becoming embarrassingly difficult to find a church that embodies the love and compassion that Christ called us to show - too many would rather dwell on imagined attacks and hatred.  Fortunately, RUCC not only offers that love with open arms, but the sermons are in easy-listening layman's terms and often accompanied by brilliant visual aides.  Truly a brilliant church for the restless listener and learner, with a congregation that's never short on welcome! We're member of this church. Our church is open and affirming. If other church rejects you, our church accepts all the walk of life including the LGBTQ. Members are really nice. Pastor Jill is awesome!

name: Redmond Assembly of God Church
reviewSummary:
Redmond Assembly of God Church is a warm and welcoming home church that truly stands out. Lead Pastor Russ Tappero brings incredible energy and passion to his sermons, inspiring the congregation with his vibrant leadership. Pastor Lori is a caring individual who connects with everyone on a personal level, making each member feel valued. Together with entire congregations, they foster a strong sense of community and spiritual growth, creating an enriching environment for all. We are grateful to be part of this loving church family! I apologize for parking in your church lot. I naïvely assumed that, since there are no evening services, my small car would not inconvenience anyone. After all, everyone is welcome in the Lord—just not, it seems, in His parking lot.
To the elderly gentleman who asked me to leave: I apologize for disturbing your Friday evening. Rest assured, I will not be coming near your church again. Hello!
We came to get a Christmas tree on December 25, didn’t find anyone there, so we took it and sent the payment to you as a donation.
Thank you very much!
Merry Christmas! 🎄 Redmond Tamil AG is a multicultural group of people united in a single cause to follow Jesus. Church will definitely draw a connection to your hometown childhood church, devotional life, relationships, job and especially your local community. Its a great blessing for me and my family to worship and grow in faith in our mother tongue. Above all my son is able to speak, read and write Tamil through Redmond Tamil AG Tamil classes is fortunate. Our family moved to Redmond a year ago and found RAG to be a warm and friendly church. We have enjoyed growing in our walk with God through the inspiring services, and have made life-long friends in the members. If you are new to the area - come and give the church a visit.

name: Redondo Beach Center for Spiritual Living - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful, loving, welcoming community. i'm so glad I went to the service on sunday because it was very inspirational.  And Rev. Gregory was an encouraging, positive, and uplifting speaker. Everyone was kind and welcoming. Thank you ❤️ An inspiring, accepting place in the South Bay for everyone!  This Center helped me recognize the spirit in me and in everyone around me. You can tell by the way people stay after and visit with each other that lifelong bonds are created here.  Taking one of their classes helped me not only grow, but make connections and deep, caring friendships💖. Their kids mindfulness program is amazing and the adult classes like meditation, sound healing, and foundational spiritual classes will change your life💫✨⭐️! Simply put...life changing!!  This is the first place I truly feel at home.  Through the Center,  I've gained tools on how to be a better me and learn the steps to my current, abundant prosperity in my vocation and relationships.  I continue to evolve every day and love this community of like minded, welcoming and talented individuals! So many friends, feels like family, everybody's welcome.  Easy-going, peaceful. Lots of fun activities. People really care about you. I feel like I can leave my troubles at the door. I found my spiritual home. The first time I walked into this church, I was 16. Now I’m 40, and it has been a beautiful part of my life ever since. My oldest child grew up here, and the memories we’ve made will always stay with me.
I will always hold dear the love and guidance of Dr. Moira and Rev. Martha Topel, who led the Spanish ministry with so much grace.
Today, our church continues to grow and thrive under the leadership of Rev. Gregory. He has been a true blessing, helping guide our community through the challenges after Covid and bringing new life to our church.
The youth program is especially amazing. It’s led by Robyn and a former teen from the church who now serves as the teen advisor, which makes it even more special. Seeing that growth and continuity is truly inspiring. My kids and teen are now part of it, and it means so much to me.
This church truly feels like home. 💛
