name: Renewed Life Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Renewed Life Church is our family’s recharging station. We rebuild our souls weekly, as we forge through life’s up and downs. We are constantly surrounded with people that love and support us. Been here for 15 yrs and plan on being here for the next 15. This is my home church.  After years of attending large mega-churches in San Diego, it is wonderful to be a part of a tight community of Christians serving each other and the community.  This warm, welcoming congregation is free of the politics and cliques we saw at larger churches.  Our pastor and staff keep us focused on the Bible and its application - not on side issues and popular, experiential-based distractions.  There's a strong small group ministry, and it's easy to get plugged into even more intimate fellowship.  There's a lot of history here, and you'll be warmly welcomed into it! We’ve been attending OBCF since December 2020. Olive Branch Christian Fellowship is a wonderful, multigenerational community of Jesus loving Christians really living out Jesus’ teachings. We love being part of a home group at this church where we can practice showing Jesus’ love to other families in our lives and have really grown and benefited from all of the relationships we’ve developed at this church.

I would recommend this church to anyone looking for a church of Christians looking to live real lives with each other, to be fully known and still fully loved, just as Jesus loves us. We've been at Olive Branch since the start of 2021. It was a breath of fresh air after attending a giant, monolithic church in RB prior. My family and I noticed immediately that the members of this sweet church deeply care about God and about others. Watching folks during the "greet each other" moments, I saw genuine interactions, smiles, tears and hugs, laughter---all from folks who span ages 14 to 94.

I have my guard up when exploring new churches or ministries, watching for bad teaching and theology or disingenuous people who just want to love-bomb you into staying in their fold. Well, we're still here and happy because none of that exists at Olive Branch. The recently-retired Pastor Scott taught his congregation to love well, even and especially in spite of differences of opinion/walks of life/stages of life; and the recently initiated Pastors Trevor and Danny teach the Bible faithfully and completely, in context (verse-by-verse), applying it to life only as far as can be done without adding one's own opinions.

The multigenerational nature of the church has only grown, but to date, the Sunday gathering is still small enough for people who remember each other and engage with one another. Plus, during the week, our home groups are another touch point for care and doing life together. My own home group has widows/widowers, young families, and everything in between. We discuss Christian teaching, challenge each other, edify each other, and grow in Christ together.

Last word: this church puts hands and treasure to service. Funds from congregational giving are dispatched as needs arise in the community far and wide, from partnering with other local ministries, to serving lunch and notes of encouragement to the staff of the school where we gather, to fulfilling tangible needs for Ukrainian churches and rescue/ministry efforts during the current crisis (buying a sprinter van, funding the building of shower stalls for refugees staying on-site, etc.).

We'd love for you to join us, and if what I've described doesn't hold up, you should find a church that honors God this way; but first, find a pastor, elder, or home group leader, and give them your honest feedback. Thanks for reading! Digging into the Bible every Sunday, relaxed fellowship over coffee,  building deeper relationships in weekly home groups - Olive Branch has been a place of renewal and blessing, with meaningful opportunities to serve, both locally and around the world.

name: Renovation Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I was introduced to Renovation Church about a year ago through a friend. I absolutely love it here. From the moment you walk in, you are greeted by fellow parishioners. Make you feel at home. Pastor Curt is an amazing, kind and humble soul. His ability to understand and communicate the word of God is unsurpassed (relatable). I feel blessed to have this Church in close proximity but for those of you that don't, I would encourage you watch the weekly sermons online. You will not be disappointed. From the moment I've stepped  inside, I was shown so much love. I love each and every Pastor there. Each one has a unique was of delivering their message. I love attention Renovation, they really renovated my faith and heart. After December 29th 2024  I was very  disappointed  No Gathering ..the last Sunday of the year.the problem most important  Sunday to have a service  to pray for the new year.
The advent season  was done poorly..
Good luck Renovation  church, this is why phoenix  and arizona  is losing their faith of hope..
Places like yours decide to close..
Wake up This review is based on the renting of their gym. Truly it shouldn’t not be rented out in the summer for sport use. It had no Ac and the gym floors need to be redone. There was talk of remodel last year… AC should have been done. Good atmosphere, pastor is passionate and genuine. Music is outstanding for a smaller church.

name: Reservoir Church
reviewSummary:
Contemporary, non-denominational church that fully embraced my family for 3 years in Cambridge. The Senior Pastor, Steve Watson, and others from the ministry team consistently prepared a thoughtful and challenging message of faith. We enjoyed the many people and families that became part of our lives. Our kids loved the children's ministry and looked forward to church. My family's faith grew tremendously at Reservoir! We truly miss the folks there. I’ve had an amazing experience at this church. Fantastic music, beautiful building, warm and welcoming people, and meaningful messages — truly a gem! My faith has grown immensely here. The Sunday services are user-friendly for a newcomer and also offer a lot for someone with more knowledge of the Bible. The community groups and virtual services are wonderful, as well! This church became my new home after I moved up to Cambridge for law school.  I come from an evangelical (charismatic) background and my work is in social justice (currently refugee/immigration law).  Every time I move to a new city, it's difficult to find a new church.  Social justice churches tend to lack a passion for the Holy Spirit.  Holy Spirit-filled churches tend to lack a passion for Social Justice.  I always feel spiritually homeless.  Reservoir does both really well.  They have a passion for prayer, worship, healing (mystical side of God) and they are active players in justice work in Boston & the world.  More important than anything, they are an extremely loving, welcoming, and authentic community.  I've been in churches that do both justice and worship well, but not community.  No fun.  Reservoir is a family of quirky amazing friends you can't get enough of.  Everyone really, truly (I say from experience) cares about you.  Come here! Church community is hard to do well, and Reservoir accomplishes a deft balancing act of being welcoming, helpful, and growth-inspiring to folks with longtime church experiences and those with none.

My wife and I have been coming here for 8 years and we're sold-out for Reservoir's positive engagement with secular culture, diversity, and welcoming stance to many who may feel out of place at traditional churches in the area (ourselves included).

Disclosure: My wife liked being a part of Reservoir so much, she left teaching to go on pastoral staff almost three years ago! But if this church sucked, I would tell you even if my wife worked there.

Most importantly, free bagels and coffee. WOW! The senior pastor here, STEVEN WATSON, is SO TALENTED! Such a cutie, and his WIFE, GRACE? Don't even get me started. She is so beautiful and is really the main reason that I have attended each Sunday for so many years.

name: Reservoir Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Authentic Relationships.
Genuine kindness & concern.
Worthwhile friendship that allows for TRUST to be built not in a vacuum but on a foundation of rock.

Atmosphere that casts out fear
...while building an understanding that undergirds faith with thoughtful reason.

Contemplative community life
Provocative Messages
Worship Worthy of a King

AND TRUTH spoken in honest, realistic terms
....gives one HOPE to come up from out of the ‘banquet in the grave’ that is so common in today’s culture and to embrace the grace of LIFE
.  .  .with those whom you feel privileged to call friends in a fellowship that is for real. Great intimate church with people who genuinely want to love the Lord and each other. Christ-centered and biblical teaching! Reservoir is a church that honestly is full of love. You feel cared for here and known. So thankful for what Jesus is doing.

name: Resonate Church - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary:
I was able to visit Resonate this morning (10:45 AM service) and was very happy to see a Biblically focused church (in the Decatur area, which is not easy) aimed at expository preaching and exegeting Scripture well. The head pastor didn't teach this morning, but Trey, one of the elders filled in. (I always appreciate lead pastors willing to allow others to stand behind the pulpit). This church loves to worship as well! I really loved the order of service, how you gave a moment between the initial worship and the announcements to turn around and meet some people, which did (hi to Seth and Sarah)!

While I live too far from here to be involved in this community, which seems great, for anyone seeking a Gospel-centered church that is not twisting or rewriting Scripture to fit their feelings or their own narrative, I definitely recommend this as a solid church home. They desire to be disciples and impact their community for Jesus, while allowing the Gospel to change their hearts and not the other way around. And, while I have only visited once, anyone looking for a church home should visit multiple times to ensure it's the best fit for you and your family.

Thank you Trey for a great service and I will keep Resonate in my prayers as you all continue to pursue Kingdom growth. Love you all! This church was filled with loving people. From the moment we walked through the doors we felt welcomed and seen. Our van broke down after service and they allowed us to hang out until our tow truck came...3 hours later...gave us snacks and engaged us. This was the church being the church. We are encouraged by how the Lord is moving here. Visited for Christmas Eve service. They had a family photo booth set up with some great pictures. The people were welcoming and the worship was glorifying. Difficult to get a read on the sermon because they did a reading of the story of Jesus (really all of redemptive history), but it was very kid-friendly as a result. They say they can't help people in Sundays but the people can give tides on Sunday and they say they mainly help refugees and give the people in the community 5 dollar dollar tree cards so you just getting three things a guy told me he give his donation for everyone not just a specific group We love this church. They love Jesus, love people and look out for the good of all!

name: Resonate Church - Fremont - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting from Seattle for a work trip and decided to check out Resonate Church in Fremont. Best decision I made this whole trip, period. As soon as I stepped through the door Steve Mills greeted me with the biggest smile and gave me the warmest welcome, told me where everything was, and right off the bat I knew I picked the right church.

Worship started and Roberto Bruno has a voice of an angel, I was singing my heart out and you could just feel the Holy Spirit in that room. Listening to how Passionate pastor Edward and Scott preach was honestly one of the best services I've been to in years, and it's sad I don't even live near here because I'd be back every week🙏🏾

After service Edward, Roberto and a few others came up and introduced themselves and actually asked about me, not just small talk. One of the best experiences I've had in a long time. If you're anywhere near Fremont, this church is a no brainer, the service, the environment, the atmosphere all of it was beyond gorgeous. They are doing it right over there. What an amazing church! I loved the preaching and the worship team! Thank you so much! It is a nice church and people are friendly This is my home Church for 8 years until I moved to Monterey Ca. I wish they can have resonate here even though I go to Church here. It’s very different the teaching and friendliness of people in resonate but I know my focus is God not People. God Bless Resonate I’m always Grateful Pastor Ryan your the Best thank you.May God Continue to Bless you and use you to Change people life ♥️ Literally one of the best churches I’ve ever attended. Having visited 2 of their services, it’s clear that the direction that Resonate is headed is on the right path. The worship portion of the service was modern but not too loud/hype. But what’s better were the sermons. The pastors were down to earth and did not sugar coat the message. This church is truly one that loves believers and non believers alike and will make anyone feel welcome.

name: Response Church Downtown Campus
Restoration Abbey - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: An absolute gem of a church! A warm, thoughtful, and inclusive community that clearly practices the way of Jesus and reflects his love outwardly. It's difficult to summarize everything this church gets right in a review, so I'd invite you to come and see for yourself. You're sure to make some new friends! The Abbey is so special to our family! We have felt more connected and cared for here than we ever imagined we could be at a smaller church. So thankful for what God is doing in and through this church. Amazing small church filled with caring people. Best decision of my life to try it out. Now we’ll be here for life. For those looking for a church that not only preaches the love of Jesus but practices it, I’d encourage you to come and visit this beautiful community. Very welcoming! An amazing church community.

name: Restoration Church - Alpharetta / Milton Campus
reviewSummary:
This church feels like coming home. The church leadership is very engaging and speaks straight to your spirit.  Not a huge congregation stuffed into a huge venue, it is a more personable gathering of believers coming together to praise God. Great message, fun and uplifting family atmosphere. We’ve found our church home.
After searching for over five years in the North Atlanta suburbs, the Lord has faithfully led us to Restoration Church. So many churches miss the mark when it comes to truly facilitating the body of Christ—but this church gets it. Pastor Chuck isn’t just a preacher; he’s a shepherd who knows his flock by name and stewards them well.

There are so many ways to plug in: men’s and women’s groups, children’s ministries we love for our kids, Wednesday night family dinners followed by worship and teaching, student ministries, missions, and more. I feel like I’m at church every day now—and I wouldn’t have it any other way.
Grateful the Lord planted us here. This church has been such a blessing in my life! The sermons are meaningful and Bible-based, the worship is powerful, and the congregation is incredibly welcoming. If you're looking for a church where you can grow in your faith, this is the place! God is Good. I met a member of this church a few days ago, she is an angel. She prayed for me and my family and we had a great conversation. Thank you and may God continue to bless this church and you. (P***a)  :) Incomparable experience!  God is in the house!  So grateful for this ministry and the Christian love that pours forth.  The Holy Spirit fills the worship services - it is electrifying - and it is not suprising that healings occur. Pastor Chuck is initially entertaining and, almost without realizing it, you find you are deep into the Word and revelation.  He brilliantly ties together the old and new testaments in a way I have never experienced. He is not politically correct... he is not afraid to call balls and strikes on either side, but always with love for one another. We are loved, nurtured and educated here.  Praise God for Restoration Church❤️

name: Restoration Church - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary:
I have yet to go to services here (but plan to soon!)- but I DID get to utilize their food bank last night… And let me tell y’all- the energy of this place is PHENOMENAL. Hannah-Lorie (I truly hope I spelled your name right!), is absolutely SO KIND! (Everyone was extremely kind, but I spent most of my time there with her)… Abby walked me out to my car and we had an awesome conversation- the food bank was efficient and smooth, and not only did I get to get dog food (🤗), there was practice upstairs for the church band and it was BEAUTIFUL- so, we got an impromptu concert!!

Thank you so very much for your love, time, generosity, and energy! This church does so much for the community. I’ve never been to this church, but every time my dog walks by their red door she wants to go up and sniff it, so it must be a nice place. Appreciated getting to know the pastor. The mixture of architectural styles were beautifully co-mingled. Nice food pantry -- includes free dinner on 3rd Thursdays of month, depending on holiday conflicts.

name: Restoration Church - San Diego (Rancho Bernardo) Campus
reviewSummary: Today you are baptizing people at Moon light Beach!! So wonderful when we get to witness people allowing our Lord into their lives. However the gentleman and I use that word lightly setting the area up for the baptizing was very short ride and not very Godly. He really missed a great opportunity to possibly bring more people the Lord and the Lady was not pleasant either but was politer than the man. Shame too cause the beach is pretty crawled could of maybe brought in new people. This is an amazing church! The band is all time, the Pastor‘s are genuine and a great leaders. If you’re looking for real relationships they are here, there isn’t a better place to call home. Empowering all people to love and follow Jesus! so thankful for the way this church is caring for those who have faced so much hurt I love this church.  There was another I was going to for 8 years but things started changing,  including the message and the holy spirit that leads.  Pastors Kurt and Katie are great at creating a place that is friendly and welcoming. Authentic, genuine community looking to learn from each other, trying to love and live like Jesus. It was in this place that I rediscovered my faith and love that they care for my kids and appreciate me just as I am. This is what the church was meant to be.

name: Restoration Church - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church! It's so hard to find a church that truly preaches the word of God. If you're looking for a church come here A fantastic church family, biblically minded and warm and friendly. Nice friendly people. A great place to be. Great kids staff and volunteers. The preaching is solid. If you are on the fence you should give it a try. Love this church! Pastor Chandler spits straight fire every Sunday. Pastor Rex loves his congregation. Awesome place for gospel centered worship and community.  Jesus is the focus here.

name: Restoration Church - Washington Campus
reviewSummary: While visiting from out of town, we wanted to attend a biblically based, conservative service that was not “woke”. So happy we found this church; it was just what we were looking for! Great message, friendly people, very welcoming, worship, sermon, and communion. Highly recommend! I love the church so much just been busy working on Sundays  The Church is awesome the people are all loving and caring The Pastor is awesome and his wife also Met and married my wife here. Would highly recommend both the church and marriage. This church is horrible. My girlfriend and I went for a couple weeks and they have outdoor service. This church and the pastor lets kids run around and families talk throughout the whole service and you can't even hear anything. They act like its a family picnic time than a church service. I have hearing loss and it makes it harder for me to hear and families with crying babies and kids talk to the point you can't even hear. And the pastors showed no concern at all for the distraction.  If you actually want to a church that you can hear and not be constantly distracted please go elsewhere. They don't care about people hearing the word. Holy Spirit led. Sound doctrine, and teaching straight from the Bible. Amazing, welcoming community & discipleship. Also super family oriented!

name: Restoration Community Church - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary:
When we first visited Restoration Community Church, we were looking for a faith community and we were immediately welcomed by genuine warmth, a strong emphasis on Jesus’ transformative renewal of all things, and the unexpected joy of a disco ball in the worship space. This church has become a true family, where members actively support one another through life’s challenges and celebrations. Restoration Community Church is committed to fostering real faith growth to advance Jesus’ mission of renewal. We are deeply grateful for this community and highly recommend it to anyone seeking meaningful spiritual development and genuine connection. I am so glad we found this little church, our church! Pastor Rob, Macie and everyone on the serve team have been so welcoming and wonderful. Just good, genuine people. We have been wanting to get baptized for years and finally felt so at home at Restoration Community Church that we finally did it. I look forward to attending service every Sunday! My First Visit was Today!
Pastor Rob was Outside Greeting people. Very Intimate setting in North Star Theater
In Mandeville.
PURE Worship Singing. Strings and Vocals w some keyboard.
Very Reverent. Christ Centered as was the Word brought from Collosians .
We are Nothing without Christ and Need Nothing Else if we Have Him.
Very Informative and Uplifting message.
Very Welcoming Group of Folks here. I’ll be Back ✝️ My wife and I attended the church’s Easter egg hunt with our son, and I’ve had a chance to talk with the pastor a lot about his incredible vision for ministry. The people of this church are very kind and friendly, there’s something for your kids, they are grounded in the Bible, and they’re on a mission to lead people to Jesus. I 10/10 recommend Restoration Mandeville! This church is wholeheartedly focussed on treasuring Gospel. The dedication to loving community, evangelistic service, and Biblical truth is paramount in every aspect of the their lives.

name: Restoration Fellowship
reviewSummary:
Restoration Fellowship is a wonderful community of all ages and from all over the world who deeply love God and one another. We welcome those who have no experience with faith or church, those who have questions or hurts related to faith or church, and/or those who are looking for a spiritual home to grow in knowing God, knowing ourselves, and in knowing belonging to one another. We are broken and imperfect, but we trust in Jesus
to bring our restoration and for the power of the Holy Spirit to work through us, even especially in our weakness. We trust God to work mighty things in and through us as he calls and enables us to lovingly serve our neighborhoods and institutions across the Boston area and the whole world!! Felt welcomed. Everyone was very nice. Pretty view from the 15th floor at the Wyndam hotel. Phenomenal sermon that was relative. The worship, the sound Bible message and hanging out with welcoming and friendly folks make RF a community I want to very much be part of. Restoration Fellowship has been a great encouragement to me and my family. I am so glad to be part of it. I've been blessed to attend RF for 2 years. A great group of people who people who love and follow Jesus. Non-denominational, sound Biblical teaching, a fantastic kids program, and a heart for supporting missions work.

name: Restore Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
I cannot say enough good things about Restore Austin. This church has truly changed my life and completely transformed the way I view church and my faith. I had almost given up on finding a place that felt genuine, welcoming, and truly reflective of what I believe it means to follow Christ - but Restore Austin has been exactly that.

What I love most about Restore is its authentic commitment to living out the teachings of Jesus: loving all people, serving your neighbor, and supporting the community both inside and outside the church walls. Every sermon is thoughtful and applicable to real life, and Pastor Zach - and the entire pastoral team - are incredible leaders whose hearts for the congregation and the broader community shine through in everything they do.

I wholeheartedly recommend this church to anyone seeking a welcoming faith community that embraces all people - wherever you are in your journey and of any race, gender, or background - and genuinely cares for and supports its members. I joined restore almost a year ago through a friend. I have visited several churches in Austin and though I felt welcomed I found myself being fed teachings that were not in alignment with how I believe we should treat, care and love one another. This community is truly a blessing in Austin and I appreciate their dedication and love for the city. If you are looking for a church that is authentic and has a true “heart” devoted to Christ, I cannot recommend Restore enough. The best church experience I have ever had. A place of inclusion, justice but also of teaching the word. Understanding how to read the Bible with context. We attend through the online church and we will never go to any other church, my only wish is there was a location in Houston Texas! Cannot recommend more! On my first day, it was so clear that I’d be both welcomed with open arms *and* be challenged by the way of Jesus and the truths of Scripture each week. I’ve been inspired by how different congregants are working for justice and mercy in the city, and how easy it is to get involved with good boots-on-the-ground love of neighbor. I’ve also received great comfort - not just from church leaders, but also from peers who in my estimation understand the love of Jesus.

There are people of all ages in this church, but my favorite moments have been in the young adults small groups. I’ve discovered healing for wounds that I didn’t even realize were there by reading Scripture and talking about God with these groups.

I don’t think this church has all the answers, but that’s not the point anyway: weekly you will be pointed to the One who *is* Truth, encouraged to walk in His way, and the result that im seeing so far is Life.

If you want to go somewhere where people will know your name and where you can take what you learn on Sunday and put it into action on Monday, get involved with this church. It’s too good to gatekeep :) As a low income neurodivergent woman of color who is the first in my family to attend college and has a father in prison, and experience so much hardship, I always appreciate the messages as they feel very empowering. The community is amazing and really makes you feel loved. I love their commitment to making people like me feel seen and heard. As a diverse person with many identities and diverse background Restore Austin makes me feel included and celebrated. The words of Jesus brings about healing and empowerment to take action towards restoration for the betterment of our society for the sake of equity and equality. I love how they make sure to include diverse people preaching as well because representation matters to me. Love is always at the heart of their message. If you are going through a rough time, or need some empowerment or wonder what to do in such a chaotic and overwhelming world I think there is so much wisdom and great stories shared from the Bible that we can take away and out into the world as we try to be more like Jesus.

name: Resurrection Anglican Fellowship - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary: Resurrection Anglican Fellowship is a true fellowship of brothers and sisters in Christ. We love Him, and want to live our lives as His hands and feet in the world. The best way we can love Him, is by loving those he sends our way. Come and be blessed! A great church! Definitely God is there. The Anglican liturgy is meaningful. The music is fantastic! The people are lovely! Thank you for the support !! A beautiful church with a majestic view. The church resonates the beauty of Jesus and the majestic God created world Great place, thank you for letting Ark Identity use it for worship and Fellowship

name: Resurrection Brookside
reviewSummary: Been there so many times people there are so caring and helpful. Has a little gathering every Friday night. Great Church leads hip and people. Great place to worship. Very welcoming. Had not been to church regularly for years and found our spiritual home here. Pastor Wendy is great! Such a welcoming and beautiful community with a powerful message. Wonderful Sunday school for kids during service. A beautiful church built in the 1800s that is accepting of ALL, stewards in the community, and home to a wonderful pastor who brings history and true meaning to stories in the bible!

name: Resurrection Catholic Church Escondido - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: I first visited the church on Palm Sunday, during the 5:00 PM Mass. The church was quite full, and the service was led by an excellent priest. What particularly caught my attention was the seating arrangement, which was set up in a semi-circular pattern facing the altar. There are beautiful stained-glass windows throughout the church, and high above, there is an emblematic image of the Holy Spirit. A Roman Catholic Church. Its our first time to visit this Church and it was a great experience. Very welcoming community, nice choir and a very clean and organized Church. Thank you to the community of Resurrection Catholic Church 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 Very upset with the experience I encountered today. After a busy long day of work I head over to receive my ash for Ash Wednesday. I made it into the doors and greeted the priest, I asked if I still made it on time (as there was still many people inside). Right away he turned me down and told me I was too late and he just wanted to go home because he was tired and that I should’ve came in the morning instead, I totally understand his point but just the way he approached me was very upsetting as I was still making the effort to be there, if I didn’t have to work all day I would have made the effort to be there earlier. His attitude and response was very upsetting. The Stations of the Cross are made of glass and are really captivating! Beautiful church, welcoming parish. Beautiful gorgeous grand Catholic Church

name: Resurrection Church
reviewSummary:
Unfortunately, if you were not invited by anyone and just decided to visit this church on a whim, no one will say hi to you… I was honestly really bummed that people just looked at us and kind of half heatedly smiled… but out of the entire congregation only two people walked up to us, one being the pastor. Just seems like a ton of people obsessed with coffee and their social circles. Always enjoy service at Resurrection Church. Friendly people, coffee tea and water refreshments.
We had a members meeting my last visit, and also enjoyed a potluck style lunch.
Beautiful building, such an amazing location. Awesome church ! Great teachings, verse by verse, how it should be. And great people there. They encourage to be a part of the church and serve as we should do in the body of Christ. Unity among believers in Christ. If your looking for that type of Church this one is for you then. Church leadership hasn’t changed since it used to be Mars Hill Tacoma and the playbook of abuse remains the same.
Our family began to shun and slander us in 2015. We tried to go through a reconciliation process that was recommended BY RESURRECTION CHURCH. Our family simply refused over and over again, yet they were never held to any kind of discipline, even though the husband was leading a bible study at the time, and they still continued to slander and shun us. Eventually Resurrection essentially laid blame fully on us, called us liars and began to shun us themselves. I believe this is because the we criticized them for their failures to us and they didn’ like hearing the truth about themselves.

The facts always remained clear, we sought out the church’s help when our family shunned us and specifically tried to keep it secret within the family. We willingly sought and paid (a lot) reconciliation counseling and with 3rd party conciliators. Our family specifically refused multiple times over the course of a year and Resurrection did nothing about that even though they recommended these 3rd party conciliators we paid for to us.  We somehow received the blame and were called liars even though we have the paper trail for all of this.

Do not go to this church. There are other obvious reasons why not to (Bubba paid for the church with money from the Mars Hill global fund, a fund specifically described for use to fund churches outside the US). It is all about Jesus. People here present the Bible in its historical context. This group of people will care for your soul and help you connect to God and experience freedom from sin. The music is loud but earplugs are provided. Pastor Bubba is a clear and authentic speaker who promotes truth.

name: Resurrection Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I’m a previous member of Resurrection but it was resurrection Lutheran church back then.   I started going to Rez when pastor Mirly was senior pastor. Then Pastor Dave came along and Mike Bailey would do occasionally Wednesday nite services. The newer part of the church wasn’t even built yet so that tells you it was back in early 70s. I think 1974 was the first time I visited there. From the first visit I knew I wanted to be a part of the church and in a permanent way. I wanted what everyone else there had.  I stayed there at Resurrection until 2014 when my wife went home to be with the Lord. Honestly I miss the greatest church of my life. I was a member of the singing group with Dr Daley. Being part of the group helped me so much  and I gained so much inner strength being part of that body. I want to come back and i hope to in the next couple weeks. There is no place like home. This church was my home church. When someone that has been a member leaves they always remember their roots. This church was the reason I grew in Christ. I’ve made my share of mistakes and  have always bounced back thanks to my elder my deacon and the Monday night cell groups we had. They were vital in my growth. I can never forget the people i became friends with and the wonderful atmosphere this church exudes with the freshness of love and honesty in people. Yeah I miss this church.  I miss the fellowship God bless Resurrection Church and all of the people that go there. When anyone visits  if only one time they leave with the experience of knowing that they want to come back Beautiful church with very warm and welcoming congregation. Highly recommended. This is a God place. Truth without apologizing.  True ambassadors.  A wonderful mix of liturgical and modern service.  If you are traveling thru or living in the area, well worth the experience. I loved this church been here before I will be back it was amazing and there is some loving people ❤️ Wonderful place to worship the Lord!! Love my church family!

name: Resurrection Church - Daphne Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing people, amazing worship! Great church. Solid preaching. Great worship (music and preaching) and friendly people who love the Lord! We were visiting and felt right at home! Great church great people.  I look forward to going here every Wednesday night. Music is beautiful, pianist is wonderful. The best I’ve ever heard. God is at work here....changes coming...purpose built

name: Resurrection Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Real bible based teachings to apply to your life.friendly good people.

name: Resurrection Leawood
reviewSummary:
I started going there back in 2001 and never looked back. I live in Dallas now and worship with them online. Pastor Adam is the best and his preachers are amazing as well. I call Pastor Adam my pulpit professor because you'll learn something new every Sunday. The best experience.All denominations are welcome, no discrimination. They speak the Word of God as it should be spoken. They don't attack any other denomination; we are all one. I feel very comfortable there and attend regularly, even though I belong to another religion, because they make me feel like I belong to them. Absolutely love this church. Pastor Adam's sermons are life changing and inspire us to do good in our community and share the love of Christ with the world. The music is also great, whether it's the Tradition service or the Modern Worship, you will love it. The Church of the Resurrection is such a wonderful church.  The sanctuary is comfortable with great views of the breathtakingly beautiful stained glass window.  Adam Hamilton and staff are kind and loving providing warm welcomes to guests.  Adam’s sermon is always thought provoking and relevant to today.  My husband and I renewed our faith by attending this amazing church community.  We are now and forever, children of God.
We moved to Oklahoma 2 years ago. We love this church so much that we attend church online every week. I enjoy their various accomodations and options for services each Sunday. It is a very accepting place and their traditional worship service is impeccable, they have a full orchestra and choir.

name: Resurrection Lutheran Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Is not Lutheran anymore, it is a Catolic church now and they have two services on Sunday at 8:00 am and noon. The service is great all in Spanish. Great little church but could use some younger members. Very welcoming and no pressure to donate all your riches. It is beautiful

name: Resurrection Lutheran Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: RLC is a wonderful church with the preaching and community. The location of church can’t be beat. A wonderful group of people.  They ask nothing from you but seem very willing to give you what you truly need. Love the people, Love the music, Love the message, Love the mission to love people like Jesus does💕

name: Resurrection Lutheran Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: RLC is a wonderful church with the preaching and community. The location of church can’t be beat. A wonderful group of people. name: Resurrection Oakland Church - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary: Very poor experience at this church. My boyfriend invited me to Sunday service one day. I was very saddened to find that this church is very cliquey and has a judgmental atmosphere for people who don’t go there. There’s a lot of performativeness, but no real sense of community. Huge disappointment and I do not recommend. Wonderful church that has made Oakland feel like home for my family! The church is committed to serving oakland. Very welcoming community and incredible staff, children’s ministry and sermons. A wonderful church to be a part of! A very welcoming and caring body of people from many backgrounds that has made Oakland feel more like home. Additionally, the church has been active in engaging with local non-profits to continue to make Oakland a better place to work and live. Very diverse church that preached the Gospel. This church does a fantastic job of welcoming everyone...believers, non-believers, people of different faiths, etc. The congregation is filled with families with small children, single adults, college students, seniors, etc. This fairly new church aims to serve the city of Oakland in any way it can and continue to learn how to best do that through its ministry. I personally attend this church and feel supported, challenged and mentored by the community I have found here at ResOakland.

name: Resurrection Philadelphia
reviewSummary:
Went there to serve lunch to the marginalised  on a Saturday as a Volunteer on behalf of the ‘Small Things’ . Tables and Chairs are laid out and after lunch we put back the chairs for the Sunday Service Sean Higgins briefed us spoke to the people from Mathew Gospel and prayed before the meal. They have a small pantry too where people can buy some items for free!
Good use of a Church Building during the week! My family moved to Philly a few years ago and we started looking for a church that aligned with our values in what a church should be. Unfortunately, a lot of churches we visited had a very consumerist approach to church where they assumed attendees were looking to be entertained or enlightened. We didn't really care for churches that wanted to put on a show for us. We were also not interested in attending a church that focused too much on defining who they were through a lengthy and detailed statement of beliefs.

We were glad to have stumbled upon Resurrection Church. They focus more on shared practices as opposed to dogma. You won't hear much, if any, "politics" from the pulpit or even being discussed by the pastors or congregation--not because they don't care or don't see how faith is relevant, but I think it's a healthy recognition that we should be captivated by the person of Jesus as opposed to some political figure or party.

Resurrection has a liturgical service. You can dress however you want--some people wear dress clothes every week, others wear t-shirts and shorts. Coffee and donuts after service every week to meet people. Highly recommend visiting if you're looking for a church! Beautiful older church with cool stonework! The people are warm and friendly, and they strive to live and present the gospel of Christ thru programs and events designed to reach out to their neighbors, regardless of who they are.  The church has just celebrated ten years of ministry, and are currently worshipping in the historic First Baptist Church of Philadelphia on 17th and Sansom.  Check them out! Very good Church service, welcoming staff and they provide many amazing services to the community

name: Resurrection Presbyterian Church (OPC) - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Mark Jenkins is the most motivated and hard-working pastor I've ever met. I grew up in Calvary chapels in Southern California and got to know pastor Mark at a time when I found myself homeless living at the Salvation Army emergency shelter. Pastor Mark was relentless to show up 2 times a week at the shelter teaching through the word verse by verse on Fridays at 10: 00am and a digging deeper study on Tuesdays at 6:00 p.m. pastor Mark's laser focus on the gospel the nature of God and what it means to be holy is so reliable for me it has been tremendously faith building. Pastor Mark keeps the main thing the main thing and that is Jesus and his work on the cross for us.

name: Resurrection Presbyterian Church San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is truly a special place that feels like home. From the moment I walked in, I was met with genuine warmth and kindness. The community here is filled with loving, caring people who have supported me in my journey. If you are looking for a place that feels less like a building and more like family, this is it. ResPres has profoundly touched my heart and changed my life in a permanent way. The sermons are always relevant, Biblically sound, and clear, helping me apply God's word to my daily life. It is a place that truly encourages you to grow closer to God.

Also, the worship music is amazing! I went to this church while in town for work. One of the best churches I’ve been to in a very long time. Music is great people are super friendly. And the sermons are some of the greatest I’ve heard in a very long time. I almost want to move to San Diego just to keep going to this church. Whenever I’m back I’ll be attending for sure. What a pleasure to visit Resurrection SD.  This church blessed my spirit immensely.  This congregation seeks a vibrant orthodoxy, recognizing that the gospel of Jesus is to be shared with others in their community.  Loved meeting these brothers and sisters in the Lord. I will say the worship here is definitely one that is christ-centered and beautiful based on beauty of Christ there preaching is phenomenal Christ centered gospel driven. It is a Christ Center church you can tell right away definitely one of my favorite things it is a place that do call my home you're in town and are looking for church based on Christ Center truth place to come visit love this place and its people What an overwhelming wonderful Church Pastor Rob is elephant down to earth and gives you a message that you can go home and think about and he teaches you a lot there's a lot of work that he does with the homeless there and he's just an excellent Pastor the worship team is really wonderful and you leave full of the Holy Spirit love love love them

name: Reunion Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
We were looking for a church when I moved to New York with my wife, and we feel so blessed to have found this community. This non-denominational church is always thinking about how Jesus would serve and love the community, and they do a wonderful job of making everyone feel welcome! The people here have been my core group that's helped me to stay grounded in the chaos that is NYC. I started stepping into faith and got my first Bible in 2018, yet I still consider myself a relatively new Christian. I’ve now attended many church services all around the world, and I must say that Reunion offers something special. Intelligent and relevant sermons rooted in Jesus and Scripture, kind staff, various opportunities to serve within NYC, a willingness to pray for anyone/anytime, talented musicians, childcare during service, fun celebrations and more. I like the way they do things. I have made many friendships, deepened my faith and understanding, discovered lots of great music and I got baptized with Russel/Reunion, at the beach! My wife and I have been coming in for more than a year and we love it. Love this community church. I’ve been going for about 2.5 years now and fall in love with it more and more. The pastor Russel is genuine and honest, really focusing on cultural context of the texts, who Jesus is, and the importance of love. People who are genuinely seeking to love others without the icky baggage of other church human legalism and hierarchy etc. Def majority younger audience (20s, 30s) but all welcome. They have kids church too and great events to get to know people. Before coming to Reunion, I wanted a community so badly. I thought NYC was just a lonely city and I had to be okay with that. Winter of 2023, I watched one of Reunions sermon on YouTube and thought “they seem cool”. The next week, I walked into Reunion and it changed my life. My very first day, I met the kindest people who opened their home to me and my partner — cozy dinner parties, movie nights, volunteering opportunities, Bible studies focused on community (called Community Groups), Lent services before the work day. Within in the year, I couldn’t believe how many incredible people had come into my life from this church. I’ve never experienced anything like Reunion but it can’t be attributed to anything than the kind pretense of Jesus every time we all gather. I feel included, loved, and spiritually kindled. I am motivated to learn about Jesus with space to come to community groups with my question and doubts and imperfections.

What’s even more incredible is the pastor and his family have brought me and my partner into their circle and are there when we need them. I’m telling you right now. If you are crying out for incredible community that motivates you to persue faith in Jesus, you will love Reunion. I’m so thankful for every single person at Reunion. I moved to NYC last August from the deep south where I attended what could probably be considered a mega church. When I moved, I started going to Reunion with the intent to try out different churches in the city. On my very first day at Reunion, I started to rush out of service when the pastor, Russel, stopped me and said "You're new. I want to talk to you." After that, something just kept bringing me back to Reunion and I've now been going there for 8 months.

Reunion for me is a place that truly embodies the biblical definition of a church: it's not a building, it's not a platform - it's people. I realized I kept coming back over and over because of how kind, genuine, and caring the people were. I've been able to connect with people all over the city through Reunion. I also feel like Reunion has been so healthy for me on my spiritual journey and has given me space to deconstruct many of the legalistic viewpoints I had. I would encourage anyone looking for a church home to come and give Reunion a try!

name: Revelation - Christ Centered Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: May God bless his words and all those who hear God's words and those who keep them, May the Most High God bless and add grace upon grace to those who speak His word directly, in this case the pastor of this church, I consider brother Vardan, who is the pastor of this church and accept him as my leader and my  pastor, despite him, I live in Belgium, knowing the word of the Lord, I see to some extent the sincerity, uprightness and Christianity of this man, people, God-loving people, listen to this blessed brother. for me, a brother in Jesus Christ... name: Reverence Bible Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church lives up to its name - "Reverence".  This is a small gospel-centered church showcasing the Bible through verse-by-verse expository preaching. The pastors here are true shepherds helping disciples grow in knowledge and sanctification. They are ALWAYS available to talk and answer questions. The worship music is carefully curated to be both reverent and rich in theology. If you are looking for a church family that will be there for you in your Christian walk, then this is the church for you. Reverence is one of the most Christ-centered churches that I have had the privilege to attend and become part of the body of Christ.  The Word of God is preached by faithful, God honoring pastors who love Jesus and model Christ's love to their congregation.  Our church is full of wonderful servants who delight in serving their Savior by serving each other.  God Bless the Lord for no church is perfect, only Christ is perfect.  He molds us for our good, that good being better image bearers of Christ in modeling His love that only the Holy Spirit can fulfill in His servants.  To God be the glory! Christ centered & Gospel centered expository biblical teaching! Amazing church body with the goal to make disciples, stir up one another in "Love and Good works" & exhort in truth (Heb 10:24-25)! Leaf blowers at 6AM for 4 hours. Screaming customers in the parking lot all day from sun up to 9PM. Dozens of cars parked all over the place since they have no room for their customers. Stadium lights on until midnight with cleaning crews. Zero respect for their neighbors and the neighborhood. Worst neighbor you could ever imagine. Not one single day of peace in your home. Imagine that!!! There is not another church like this one
They not only preach the love Of God they live it out every day
I am so blessed and thankful to be a part. Of these Godly people.

name: Revival Center - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are looking for a church home look no further! I have been going here my whole life. This is a Christian non denominational congregation that is truly under the anointing. Photographed is Pastor Ricky Nutt who baptized me years ago, he is highly intelligent, witty, and kind. All the pastors here are extremely approachable and down to earth, and most importantly they live for the Lord. I look forward to fellowshipping with my church family on Sundays (at 10AM). What I like most about this church is the people and how they make you feel, nobody judges you on your past and the vibe is laid back. The spirit is always present at this church so come see for yourself! I love this church. I have searched for a spiritual place where I fit in. This church is welcoming, kind, loving and giving. From the Pastors to volunteers, greeters to the Congregation, the spirit of the Lord is present. Revival Center is a family. This church is real. They tell you like it is and are very transparent. You do not feel like you are the only imperfect person. Everyone is a work in progress and they really focus on community and helping one another grow. When you go you won’t feel alone.

Everyone is so welcoming and actually cares about you. You can freely express yourself and praise our Lord and not feel judged. If you want to shout, shout. If you want to do a victory lap, do a victory lap! You get the idea.

The Revival Center wants you to grow and not just stay complacent as a baby Christian. Many people have been going since the church first opened and a lot actually grew up in the church, which is amazing! The church has a good balance of long time members and new. They have many groups you can join and our Pastors really are involved. I first messaged the church before I attended and was pleasantly surprised at how quickly Pastor Ricky J. wrote back to me and got me into contact with someone from the church.

They know you on a first name basis and actually care and make you feel very comfortable. They have zoom teachings as well. The worship is amazing and you can’t help but dance and sing. Prophetic words/testimonies, teach THE WORD! It’s just a really great environment and I like that they have one service that everyone attends together.

I highly recommend this church. I have grown a lot and learned so much in these past few months of attending. My friend invited me to Revival Center almost a couple years ago and I decided to join the church. I spent many years traveling and never made a commitment, but I realized I needed to join a church and use my gifts in the church. I always made excuses as to why I didn't want to join a church.  I decided to join Revival Center due to the Pastor humility, love for God and his people, focus on discipleship, and desire to see all of grow in Christ! Pastor Ricky J. is super down to earth and he makes time to educate us on the bible. I also like that he encouraged me to attend his discipleship meetings even though I lived in another state. He was simply focused on me growing . I have never experienced such anointed worship in my life! It’s extremely difficult to find a spirit led church who isn’t worried about God interrupting service, but speaks what they hear Him saying! Along with that the community is extremely welcoming, and they have a lot of ways to get involved. They actually preach the Bible without watering it down…no church is perfect, but I wholeheartedly believe that Revival Center is a place to grow in and call home.

name: Revival Christian Fellowship - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
We left the non-denominational church world almost 3 years ago because of many serious concerns I had with it. We've been members of a PCA church for quite some time now. However, while visiting California, we planned to attend Revival Christian Fellowship in Menifee, a non-denominational church, just to try it out. When we arrived, I was already bothered that the first thing you see is a merch area outside leading into a bookstore. But what happened next genuinely shocked me.

As we walked toward the sanctuary, the greeter stepped in front of us, put his arm out, and stopped us from entering because we had Caroline with us. He told us children were not allowed in the sanctuary and said we could either put her in the kids ministry or watch the service online. I am absolutely mindblown that this happened. I cannot comprehend how a church can justify something so unbiblical.

Scripture commands parents to bring up their children in the discipline and instruction of the Lord. We are to teach them diligently throughout the day. Our children should be sitting with us under the preaching of God's Word, learning to worship alongside the covenant community—not being sent away to childcare while the adults worship. This modern trend of segregating children from the corporate gathering has always deeply concerned me. But refusing to even allow children into the sanctuary takes it to another level entirely.

I pray that God would bring true revival—pun intended—to the American church. We desperately need to return to biblical worship, biblical preaching, and a biblical view of the family in the life of the church.

This is truly heartbreaking and unacceptable! Always biblically based!
My husband and I are so happy to find Revival church.. Pastor John
does an exceptional job teaching God's word!!
Even talks about the rapture which a lot of Pastors don't. Great service, great church. Bible teaching during the service. Pastor John Miller is amazing teaching Gods word. They have great men's and woman's groups, children ministry through High School. A very strong Bible based teaching an excellent church explaining Bible scripture and a good worship band. Not to loud and very good choice for believers I attended Revival Church again this past week and overall I enjoyed my experience, but not with a few hesitancies. I appreciated that Pastor John spoke from The Word and didn't shy away from corrective topics. The sermon was encouraging and compelled me to practice what was being preached.  I loved that they had security walking around during service, and the childrens check-in/check out process was very secure. I felt safe leaving my young kids with them.
A few cons were that the sermon, while solid biblically, was a bit short. Even my daughter, upon checking her out of her class, commented on how quick I was done. Secondly, I tend to lean more towards spirit filled churches who operate in the gifts but aren't overly pentecostal or charismatic. While it seems that Revival is ultimately doing the great commission of making disciples, baptizing, and  teaching the word. I question how many people out of all who are attending display the signs of those who believe; which are casting out demons, raising the dead, healing the sick, and speaking in tongues. I don't doubt that Revival is a place to get good solid teaching, but unfortunately,  it seems to be lacking in spiritual depth that I long for in a church. The kind that brings people (myself included) out of a habit of lukewarm Christianity and into a place of walking in power and authority over the devil.
All of this to say, its a good church but maybe not for me.

name: Revival Church - Pleasanton Campus

My Family Loves it Here

I would recommend anyone to come.

We worship God,  the holy spirit moves in the church . So many testimonials here . You will never regret coming here . This Church is amazing! We’ve know him for 20 yrs., moved out of state & found nothing comparable to R. C. I. or pastor Gary. name: Revival Culture Church - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary:
The BEATIFUL tangible presence through us as vessels gets revealed in this place by faith, just His presence as a spirit is like fire of so much joy we can’t out it to words.
Only by the blood of Jesus Christ we have access to be saturated by the love of God!! Amazing church highly recommend if you actually want to experience truth ! name: Revive Church
reviewSummary:
Amazing church community! I love the way they praise and worship. Great teachings. I get something every time I go. I wish I lived closer to attend more frequently. Everyone is so welcoming and you can really feel the spirit here. They also offer something for all ages. I feel the presence of God . Very loving Congregation. Pastor Todd is Amazing. I have my friend Mark here 🕵️‍♂️ It might be weird to call a church a “find,” but I’ve been hopping around Bellevue/Redmond/Seattle for 9 years, and I think I can say with some accuracy that what God is doing here is truly unique to this area. It’s on my “best kept Washington Secrets list” because I’ve caught myself thinking many times, “how do people not know about this??”

Some highlights:

1. Services are structured, but it’s not uncommon for things to be “put on hold” in the agenda because God is moving in a moment. This sense of freedom is unique, doesn’t feel like a whim of whoever is holding the microphone, and it gives you the confidence that God could truly move there if he wanted to.

2. The staff here are incredibly gifted in their roles, and that’s especially evident with the preaching. Todd’s style bridges the gap between the head and the heart, reinforcing the truth with conpassionate, but uncompromising conviction, and exploring the scripture with wonder, reverence and a hunger for knowledge.

3. The worship is non-flashy, and yet (as a worship leader myself) I can say it’s truly unique. It’s actually changed my life. If you’re not thrilled by "singing Christian songs to Jesus," 👀 then Revive’s worship culture is probably for you. My wife and I visited the church today and we really enjoyed it. The preaching was really good and engaging. The worship and worshippers were full of life. The church really takes time to allow God into the service with some extended worship at the end. After the service closes, a ministry team is up at the front to pray directly with people one on one. Lots of people went up for prayer during this time and it was really beautiful to see the community supporting each other. We will be back again! An awesome church that has an amazing gift.  Warm and welcoming people.  A passionate pastor and leadership.  Solid foundation in the bible.  And an anointing of the Holy Spirit.

name: Revive Church - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary: Wow wow wow I can’t believe my mom talk to me about this place! This place has blessed me so much the people became like family. I thank God I found the food pantry! The lady that runs it Ms Katy is the best! Ms seglenda is best she really showed us so much love! Listen everyone there is an amazing! When I come two years ago we were getting lot of food, but now there so many people so we get less which is ok. Because I am glad people found this place. Thank you so much revive food pantry continue the good work. I have to be honest, There's really nice people that run the food bank program, but they let the volunteers take the best stuff first and then they yell at you the whole time to keep moving and to hurry up,  and not give you time to pick choices. Also, they do it as a lineup first come for service,  so they have really old people getting there as early as 5 in the morning to lineup, and then they have big bullies shove and push their way through the door so  It could be ran a lot more friendly for these older people. But again, the folks that run it themselves are super nice and maybe just need some suggestions on what might be better for the seniors. There's also some big bully guys that lineup out there and push and shove their way to the front, hoping to get the best pieces of meat or whatever.  I don't know. If you work there, you can't even get food there so that everybody stays honest, I don't know what the answer is, but I'm not going back there. It was too upsetting to have people yell at me when I see them shoving all the best stuff under-the-table for themselves.  But I wish them well and i'm happy that they're helping people even if it's not ideal. I might be biased as I recently became a member. Good Bible based church. They preach what you need to hear, not just what you want to hear. The pastor is a serious pastor but can be funny also. Truly God loving, community supporting, sincerely caring people are here. 1 John 4:11 I went to a service at Revive and it was an amazing experience. I felt comfortable amongst all these new people as we worshiped together. This church gives so much back to the community in so many ways. I would like to mention Cam, Stephen and Michael all of which have made such an effort for me. God has blessed us with Revive church and wish them many years of success.

name: Revive Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church to listen the word of GOD and the praise and worship band amazing Good people worshiping a great God! Upscale church on eastern edge of El Cajon. There is a Pokemon gym here. Have not attended here yet. Lovely,friendly, small church. Pastor very good preacher Beautiful church. Beautiful environment.  Polite kind and considerate staff

name: Revive Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is authentic and the congregation is passionate. The pastoral staff and worship team will lift you up from your heavy burdens and lift your spirit.
The building reminds me of an old village in Europe with market lights before you walk in to the main auditorium.
The church pews and organ pipes tell a history and makes you feel like you’re in a traditional setting. But there’s nothing traditional about this church and the message of Jesus.

My only wish was the service was longer. It was a little over an hour.

Coffee and donuts provided before and after.

Great church! Revive church is not like any other church that I’ve been to,  It’s more like a home to many of us. Full with people who truly love God and people who understand the importance of not doing life alone.
I’ve been attending Revive Church for the past 12 years and I’ve grown in my walk with Jesus in a way that I could have never imagined. Come worship with us and you will see it for yourself. God is so good 🙏 Wonderful place to embrace the Word of God and live in community, both in the English and Spanish services. A great place for all ages. A great neighborhood church with lots of diversity! People here are very kind and down to earth, but most importantly you feel the Holy Spirit moving during sermons, and you see God working through the people this church. Revive has a heart for the community and encourages us all to lead lives that reflect Jesus 🙌🙏❤️ My cousin and I (26 years old) are both newer to the area and we’ve been going together for a handful of times. Words cannot express how much gratitude I have for this church and its message!! It’s incredible and the community is of all ages, of all backgrounds, and there’s a lightness in the air — just like you feel when you’re with family.

name: REVIVE Church of Tampa
reviewSummary: We recently started attending Revive Church, and the awesomeness that radiates from this place is amazing! Senior pastors Doug and Erica, and the entire pastoral staff are genuine, down to earth people. Not only do they talk the talk, but they walk the walk. Revive Church of Tampa is now our home! No matter your nationality, race, etc. they welcome people from all walks of life. If you're looking for a church to call home, give Revive Church of Tampa a try! I am so thankful that I have Revive Church of Tampa in my life! I made friends there that have become family. It’s such an amazing service that includes worship, lots of prayer, and an inspiring message. Please come and join us on Sundays at 11:00! Love this church with all my heart! It’s freeing, empowering and loving! Truly a place of community and Jesus! I'm not the one who's judgemental Great people, incredible worship team, authentic preaching, and fantastic kids and youth programs.
