name: Revive City Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
Felt the presence of the Spirit in this beautiful church. It was amazing! It was my first time attending their Sunday service. I AM DEFINITELY GOING BACK FOR MORE!!! Very welcoming environment and very friendly people. May God bless your ministry to do great and mighty things, in Jesus name,
With lots of LOVE,
Amen,Amen,AMEN🙏🤗❤️‍🔥🫶 It’s hard to describe the way you feel when you walk into an environment and experience the truth in the word of God. Where you come as you are and Gods love covers you like a warm blanket. His mercy flows all around and washes away all that’s old and makes you new! Church is not like a family Church Is A Family! Revive city church is a church that really stands behind family. The worship there fills the room and the Holy Spirit presence is always in the room. Pastor Kirk not only reads directly from the bible, but also breaks down scripture in a way that encourages me to want to be more Christ like. Every member of newcomer is alike. I personally always felt welcomed and wanted in service and in bible study groups. The 2025 woman’s bible study group has been such an eye opening experience for me. From new friends to being god centered and full of faith. I never felt more at home at any other church. Revive has been our home for the past year and we have enjoyed being a part of such a diverse community. The worship is powerful and engaging! 😉 Revive is an amazing church. I stumbled upon it one day while driving by, did some research, and was immediately drawn to it. One of the things that stood out most to me was their heart for ALL people and a ministry for people with disabilities. As a SPED teacher, seeing such a genuine commitment to inclusion meant so much to me. I decided to visit and almost three years later, I haven’t stopped coming. This church has truly become a family. Revive and Pastor Kirk teach the Bible in a way that is easy to understand while also encouraging you to think deeper and grow in your faith. Everyone is incredibly welcoming, and there is a real heart for the community here. If you’re searching for a church that values people, inclusion, and meaningful teaching, I highly recommend checking out Revive!

name: Revolution Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
A wonderful group of people from Revolution church came to help me and my disabled son move. We never could have done it with their help. They loaded two 26 ft moving trucks for me and my son. Their family even brought donuts for everyone. We are no longer in Canton, but if we were, then this would the church I would want to attend. They are community service-oriented. The preacher is doing something very right with this congregation and I appreciate him. 🙏  I am not even sure how they found out I needed help and I am not sure they knew either. They were an absolute miracle from God!!! I asked them to pray for us and glad they did. We drove two defective trucks [one with no tail lights, we later found out, and one with Service Advanve Trac and a plethora of other lights lit up the dashboard, an immediate service issue]. Point being, we made it 4.5 hours to our destination safely, and I believe their prayers for us caused that to happen. They never complained and just kept saying they were there to serve us and glad they could help. It is worthy of mentioning that after they left us that evening, they went to serve food for some other people. Just wow! The world needs more people like this in it. Jennifer Rasmussen, Renato Giusto, and I forgot the other guy's name from Nicaragua.  Bless all of you and your outreach ministries. Bible based non-denominational church. Phenomenal teaching and church family. Ample opportunities to become involved. The children's programs are top notch. Community outreach throughout our area. I want to begin by saying, that Pastor Jason is absolutely wonderful! His messages have been heartfelt, genuine, and often the highlight of my family’s week! For the first time, even my husband truly enjoyed going to church and that meant a lot to me!

Unfortunately, my recent experience with the church’s music ministry has been deeply disappointing, to say the least! I auditioned with the sincere intention of serving through song, something I’ve done for many years in both church and school settings! But, I was told that I might be “better suited” to play an instrument instead of singing. The interaction felt dismissive and surprisingly elitist, especially from a church that preaches openness and community!

It has become clear that this church functions more like a “mega church” in its approach, selective about who is allowed to participate, rather than welcoming volunteers who simply want to use their gifts to serve! That’s not what worship should be about!

I say this with confidence and respect: I know the talent, and heart I bring when I sing, and I genuinely believe I could hold my own beside anyone currently performing on that stage!  It’s unfortunate that the opportunity to serve was overshadowed by unnecessary gatekeeping!

Because of this experience, my family and I will be moving on to a place that values sincerity and inclusivity over image!  I wish the church well, but I hope they’ll reflect on how their process discourages people with a genuine desire to serve! I'm giving 3 stars only because the "church", as Pastor Jason will often preach on, "...is not a building, it's the people". Not everyone associated with Revolution was questionable. I've met some truly lovely people there over the years. But what it became, for myself & my family, the more we became involved serving & leading, left us running for the doors & we will never return. In fact, we have completely disassociated ourselves with all forms of "organized religion" because of our direct experiences with Rev & affiliated Rev persons.
I first discovered Revolution church long before the building was built off Union Hill Rd, back when it was meeting inside the movie theater off Riverstone Pkway. Didn't stay long at the movie theater church, it felt disingenuous. Came back after Rev opened it's doors where it is today & it felt like "coming home". That feeling, sadly, didn't last long. There's just way too much to share here with what we have experienced but we finally had enough of the church hypocrisy by 2018. When you witness staff members leaving, en masse, that's a big red flag. When leadership runs quarterback for Pastor Jason like he's the walking Holy of Holies, that's a big red flag. When sermon after sermon is about tithing & sacrifical tithing...& then pastor wives solicit you at the same time to buy their MLM products & openly post across social media personal trip after trip after trip while we're being asked to sacrifice to tithe more is just wild. Are buying from their MLMs or their trips inherently "bad"? Absolutely not. But the timing was questionable & looked really bad. Several former staff have even told me about the constant lunch ordering/catering for office staff during the week & what was being spent on it. Doesn't sound like "sacrifical tithing" to me. Long time staff finally seen & heard enough that the proverbial exodus began.
To be fair, there were good memories made at Rev over those years. It wasn't all bad. The worship music was good, the kids program was enjoyed, and to be honest, I personally enjoyed Pastor Jason's sermons. He's definitely got a gift. But after a while, when you step back, you'll start to really see what was going on & it just becomes too hard to swallow what's being preached vs what's actually happening behind the scenes. Really hard. When/if you choose to *officially* "join the church", you sign a contract "...giving the church the authority to speak into your life". Those exact words were flung at me one day after I'd been called to the carpet as a leader. Seems 'OK' up front just so long as you don't attempt to "speak into" leadership's choices. That's a big no-no. We initially questioned ourselves for our choice of leaving Rev, (& subsequently all forms of organized religion), too many times to count. I've personally spent the majority of my life IN church & doing all the "Christian" things. I even spoke "Christian-ese", fluently. 😉 But the more we were "in" the more we saw. One time Pastor Jason even preached on the very thing I'm doing now: "Who does a Google Review on a church?!" Folks that did so were mocked. Well, whatever. Mock away. We've seen, heard & experienced a lot over the years & cannot unsee or unexperience what we have and keep "pretending" every Sunday. Reached a point that we were no longer still in our soul with what we experienced. The more we served, the more we were known by the pastoral staff, we were familiars. And yet when we abruptly stopped attending, not one person contacted us to ask why. Not one. That spoke volumes. What I know is this: our personal experiences at Revolution church magnified church hypocrisy. Great sermons & good worship music don't make a "great church". The real church is what's going on when Sunday service ends. We saw it & it ultimately drove us to walk away from Revolution, & any other form of church or religion, in is entirety. For good. My personal spiritual walk continues but NOT within the confines of man-made walls lead by rampant church hypocrisy. I will not follow that type of leadership. Not anymore. Revolution Church is incredible! Pastor Jason’s messages are so genuine, powerful, and easy to connect with — you can tell he truly cares about people. Every week his words hit home and leave you encouraged. The worship is amazing too — full of energy and authenticity. It’s such an uplifting place to be!

name: Revolve Bible Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church. The people care about one another and pray for one another. The women’s ministry is great. The preaching is verse by verse, meaning sticking to explaining everything in the Bible verse.  The small groups ( like Sunday school) are at night, different nights to accommodate ages, usually with dinner (yay) and you learn so much. Youth group and children’s ministry are amazing.  Try it. You’ll grow here. I have been going to Revolve Bible Church since they first started the church plant in June 2016. How can I even put into words what it means to me to be part of this church body. Not only do you get expository preaching and as others have said it’s verse by verse and the teaching so sanctifies me in my life. On top of all of that the love that the body of Christ has for one another at this church is exemplary. The care and concern that they have showed to me by being the hands and feet of Jesus to me in times of sickness or if I’m troubled they’ve been there right alongside me with my dear Savior Jesus to help me in my life. I have felt encouraged and loved on by the ladies at the church how they’ve encouraged me to attend the Women’s Retreat this past year and I was so blessed in going there. How can I explain that they’re my family there,  I can’t imagine not being at this church. Pastor Ryan has shown Christ’s love to me, he truly cares about me and just like Jesus says that he’s our Shepherd and we are his sheep, Pastor Ryan truly cares deeply from his heart not only for me but everyone that attends our church. Also all the other elders deeply care about me.  I love the way that our worship songs glorify our Savior, and how prayer is so important at our church. If you want to grow in Christ and be taught in His word and know what it is to be truly loved by the body of Christ please come to Revolve Bible Church and you’ll know what I’m talking about. Revolve Bible Church has definitely been a huge blessing in my life. From the welcoming community and expository teaching to the Christ centered leadership and intentional discipleship, this church has motivated me in my walk with the Lord. Pastor Ryan preaches straight from the Bible and doesn’t insert his own interpretation. Having attended for 5-6 years, I have been challenged, encouraged, and convicted. If you are looking for a church that goes deeper than the “feel-good” sermons, look no further. Revolve Bible Church has been the biggest blessing in my life, and I’m certain that will be the case for those who visit as well. A wonderful church founded by wonderful families! This church truly loves the Lord and seeks to serve him. It is a church that will push you in your relationship with the Lord. The teaching is biblical and the word is taken seriously. If you're looking to grow in your relationship with the Lord, this is a great church community to do that with. I appreciate Pastor Ryan's leadership. Revolve Bible Church has been a huge blessing in my life. Pastor Ryan's expository teaching is amazing and he teaches straight from the Bible. He won't teach anything without showing us where it's at in the Bible. RBC has opened my eyes to so many sins in my life, I have felt convicted and with conviction there's spiritual growth, making my walk with God stronger. If you want to grow in your walk with the Lord to be a strong disciple of Christ, I highly recommend Revolve Bible Church! May God keep blessing this church.

name: Reynoldsburg Church of Christ - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
Reynoldsburg Church of Christ has been such a blessing to our family. Pastor Dion is wonderful, and everyone there is warm and welcoming. They were especially supportive and caring during difficult times, which meant so much to us. It truly feels like a church family, and we're grateful to be part of it. My wife and I wanted to find some place to go during the holidays to worship oh, and checked out this church and have no regrets. The congregation was very opening to meeting us as new people but we're not overwhelming to where we felt like we were targeted and asked a million questions. They are a very tight-knit church congregation and not only preach but live what they preach and teach and help each other through trouble times. I am very impressed with your dedication to each other and to God. Looking forward to spending more time getting to know this church and its people. The church facilities are large and they have a few social programs two were the healthy local community which includes a picnic style dinner during the summer times, a once-a-month dinner indoors with a free box of food for those in need, and I'm certain other programs to help those in the community. From a visitor of Memphis, TN I Love the love that was shown to me as I entered into the doors. I love their outreach​ ministry I was over joyed to hear the things that they were doing in and for the community. I have something to go home with and share with our congregation to do to up lift the Lord Jesus Christ!

Thanks for making my visit a pleasant one.

Sis. Johnson I love going to this church the people very friendly i go to Bible study here. Wonderful people to fellowship with. Thanks for having us

name: Reynoldsburg Community Church - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
My church, I go here all the time. It has a great kids i dont know how to put it so teaching or school, and you may even see me volunteering in the kids because teenagers can help out with a great community and recognize all age groups. Every grade is separated until 5-8th (the hub), and 9-12th (The Forge). Also does Wednesday. I've gone here for 11 years. I have been part of this church family for almost 20 years.  I can't imagine life without this church.  Bible-based teachings.  Friendly people.   Wednesday night bible study will teach you how to read the bible.  Children's and youth programs are outstanding.  Wednesday night dinner is a great value and awesome food.  I could go on and on. Love the staff here I have taken two kids to their preschool and the love they show the kids is unmatched. Plus the things the kids learn from Jesus to being able to be ready for kindergarten. The staff there really do go the extra mile to make you feel welcome. Me and my family are really thinking about joining the church because of the family feel that they present  even though it's a big church. Very nice spacious church.
Great Christmas eve mass Finally, a place to call home.  Excellent balance of grace and truth.  The pastoral staff are some of the best I've ever known.  Wonderful children's ministry.  A worship service for every taste.  Traditional or contemporary, come and see...and be blessed.

name: Rhema International Ministries - Albany Campus
reviewSummary: Rhema International Ministries is home to anyone who loves God and lives a life totally surrender to the Holy Spirit. We are a real family that loves one another and committed to love Gods people. As a young person seeking after God’s heart, Rhema has been a wonderful place where I’m able to call home! Connecting to Rhema has changed my life physically and spiritually. Since being at Rhema my relationship with God has gone to a higher level. If you’re ready to give your life to Christ and be saved for real Rhema International Ministries is definitely the place to be! My experience with Rhema began many years ahead of connecting as an e-member of RhemaNation from Snellville, Georgia. Initially during the pandemic I joined the STS Bible Institute now Manifest Bible College and I completed the 2-year course. 6 months into the course I became a member of RhemaNation in February 2021 and the rest is history. I have never been this excited about joining any organization but what I found at Rhema is my Kingdom assignment and I am securely connected with my Abraham and Sarah and supporting this vision at Rhema. God has blessed me tremendously to attend each of the weekly services, special services and trainings online or in-person as I can. I am excited to tell you there is really something supernatural happening down in the Southern Region of Georgia especially in Albany, Georgia at Rhema where the power of God is moving, lives are being transformed, the spirit of poverty is being destroyed and so much more. Rhema International Ministries is an anointed ministry. Pastor Scott Sanders and Co Pastor Cynthia Sanders are truly led by God and the word is awesome and life changing. Pastor and the members of Rhema are truly good hearted people. Being apart of Rhema has changed my life in an amazing way. If anyone is looking to be spiritually fed and want to be apart of a genuine house of God then Rhema is the place to be🙏🏽 I have gone to this church ministry a few times and each visit was just amazing and powerful. My children even enjoyed the service. I moved out of the state of Georgia  and have not found a church like this one.pastor Sanders and his wife are Powerful man and woman of God.

name: Rhythm Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful, faith based teaching!  Multiple venues and the nicest people. Wherher you are just window shopping or wanting to get plugged in - it is a great place to be a part of. Absolutely amazing church. Very welcoming. Kind and awesome staff. Nice pastor. Great word.  Fellowship before or after the service with coffee, cornhole and bounce house for the kids. Children's church ages K-5th, 3y-5y, and infants. For family with infants and nursing babies you will love this church. They have an infant room if you would like to be at church with full focus on worship. They also have a baby lounge in case you don't want to be inside the temple and prefer a more cozy environment but still be at church and see the service in a screen. In an adjacent room to the baby lounge they also have a nursing room in case you're not comfortable nursing in the temple or baby lounge area. They also have an outdoor sitting option with the service playing in a screen. . Visited the first time this weekend. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. They had a guest speaker and he preached the Word. The church was clearly focused on reach more people for the Kingdom Wonderful church !! Warms my heart to see the youth come together here for the Lord ! Lead Pastor Jeff really dives deep into his sermons so we are able to learn and grow closer to the Lord . Def recommend! What a beautiful spirit filled church !The teaching from Pastor Jeff and Pastor James is biblically right on point.
My pen can't keep up with the amount of notes I want to take during the service ...it's that good!!
Worship is beautiful, so transparent.
The Wednesday morning prayer and worship has been amazing.
Thank you Rhythm church for being such an authentic place to attend service .

name: Rialto First Assembly of God - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: We absolutely love this church! My 5yr old loves going to church. The people are warm and friendly, very inviting! This church is really welcoming especially the people. The pastor of the church is pastor Tom McMahon. Also they have a great children’s ministry. Amazing church so helpful really make you feel like family , just all around beautiful church family . They went above  and beyond  for my family the pastors genuinely care and want to teach the Bible  & help you build  a relationship  with god. Great place to bring the family to learn more about the Word. The pastor is an old friend of mine and a great mentor. The team that work there are always looking forward to helping the community and helping the soul get what it needs! An incredible church that I've attended for many years

name: Rich Pond Baptist Church Main Campus
Richfield Community Church - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: Ricfield Community Church is in the heart of Yorba Linda. This is a good family church. Everyone there is friendly. They have a children section so their can learn. They have a game room for th kids. They had a gingerbread house contest which was very fun. I have only attended RCC for 5 months, but it feels like home already.  You can feel the love of the Lord in everyone you meet there.  Pastor Ward gives a Bible based sermon every single time and I have grown so much in the short time I've attended.  Between an awesome Pastor that is truly a gift from God and the amazing congregation this church is real gem. My wife and I had the privilege to visit this church Sunday morning. This was the first opportunity we had to attend in person from Tennessee since Pastor Chris Ward became the Senior Pastor. We studied under Pastor Ward for many years across town and loved his teaching. He does not stray from scripture and is always well prepared to share God’s word. From the moment we pulled into the parking lot we felt welcome.  There was an amazing energy on the campus amongst those in attendance. There is a healthy blend of seasoned folks as well as young people. The message was powerful and inspiring. Most importantly it was solid teaching as opposed to topical and “light”. If we lived here we would certainly call RCC home. If you are looking for consistent teaching and a place where you will be valued, I encourage you to visit RCC. This church is a home away from home. The community is full of love and the joy of knowing Christ. The staff is serious about spreading the truth of the gospel with love and honesty. The services are approachable in length and each message is clearly crafted around the theme of that weeks passage. The whole church from top to bottom is also serious about teaching people how to read the Bible themselves and getting people excited about the on going transformation God does in our lives. I can not suggest this church enough for anyone looking to see what a church should be like. Talk to any of the staff or get into a life group, a bible study, and you will quickly see the evidence of their faith. God bless anyone of you on your life and your journey with Christ. My family and I are so thankful for this fellowship, for the solid teaching every week and  most of all---my son gets to grow up in community with others that are sharing the joy found in God with him.  I have called this church home for many years & am so grateful to do so!  I was dedicated here as a baby & was blessed to dedicate my own son here as well.

name: Richland Creek Community Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Today, at this beautiful & loving ministry, I experienced truly the hands of feet of Jesus with some wonderful servants that not only provided various families with their needs being met, but also with prayer, and such compassion! This is not just a Church; it's the representation of the Kingdom of God! I would like to first say thank you to Amanda; who was extremely pleasant, understanding, and very encouraging "over the phone"; then, when I met her in person, it sealed the deal for me! Secondly, thank you for every volunteer that served us today; may the Lord remember you and yours in Jesus' name! I look forward to the Sunday fellowship! Blessings! What a FUN and visually creative children’s playground area! The nicest church playground I think I’ve ever seen! How neat they layed down the fake grass turf and then also for the water area to mimic a stream! Fun different playgrounds elements here as well! Really really nice and professional looking! Wonderful! My church stands (preaches) from the Bible, the Word of God as it is written & unfiltered. Come & hear the good message, all are welcomed at Richland Creek Community Church!😊 My family and I started attending about 2 years ago (2016)- we were invited because of the special needs ministry.  Our family plugged in right away and our two middle school daughters felt right at home since day one.  I appreciate the way the pastors preach the Word of God boldly and clearly. This is a great church with a warm and welcoming church family. Lots of activities for all ages, great worship and teaching! You should definitely come visit!

name: Richmond Hill Church of Christ - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary: Sound congregation of the saints. Warm greeting upon entering the building.  I attended on a Sunday evening worship service following. Sound Biblically based worship service with acapella singing, prayers, Lord's supper, preaching, and contribution. Friendly conversation after the service. I would definitely recommend this congregation to locals and travelers. Sad treatment of longtime members when they get ill and are home bound and can’t tithe anymore. Don’t expect a “pastor” in tough times. You’re on your own if you’re unable to be of service to the church anymore. We worshipped here quite often while living in Savannah. It is only about 20 minutes (without traffic) from Southside Savannah. We still keep up with some of the members here. Sound in the faith, wonderful congregation. They've been giving away disaster relief supplies for free to those in need. What a blessing!

name: Ridge Christian - Broken Arrow Campus
reviewSummary: There are Church's and then there is Ridge Christian Church. Everybody there treats you like family. For me its home. The love that everyone shows is just unbelievable. If you are looking for a "home" Church.  Come and check out Ridge Christian. We love Ridge and paster greg and his wife andrea we recently started going there and we feel like family now 🙏 Love this church. The pastor and his wife (Greg & Andrea) are amazing people. This church is laid back and we will comfortable there. Broken Arrow soccer club holds the award ceremony there every year it's a very nice Auditorium to hold their event very clean very nice thank you Cedar Ridge Church or letting Broken Arrow soccer club use your Auditorium We go here every Sunday. The people are very kind and the sermons are wonderful!

name: Ridgeview Hope Church - Pleasanton Campus
reviewSummary:
I noticed a difference in this church within a few minutes of entering.  I'd been to many other churches, but something stood out in Ridgeview Hope--right away people were welcoming, friendly, and genuine.  Nothing hyped up.  Just a calm, real atmosphere.  The pastors are the nicest guys you'll ever meet. Sermons are biblical and Jesus-centered. If I had to narrow down what makes this place special, it's the fact that here people really care about each other.  It's real.  When people ask how you are, they mean it.  When people say they will pray, they do.  This is a place for lifelong friends and growing closer to God. We started attending here when during covid other churches decided to only meeting online. Ridgeview continued to meet; first outside, and then when allowed, to meet inside under the required restrictions.
Love the group here. They may be small, but are very friendly and you will feel like family. First time in we were welcomed by several people. This isn't a church you will "get lost" in. They take the Bible seriously and the pastors go through an entire book verse by verse. They also have weekly Bible study and prayer meetings.  The church community also reaches out to support others, both in the local area and globally through various activities. Would encourage you to come on a Sunday and check it out. Had a blessed combined resurrection Sunday service with four churches. Jesus is Lord of all....!  > Kind people sharing the words and love of Jesus Christ. I felt welcomed.

name: Ridgewood Church
reviewSummary: Ridgewood Baptist Church congregation, and Pastor Kent are Truely a Blessing. The way that they reached out with kindness, and such genuine warmth to comfort my family when we recently suffered a loss. It's hard to find words to express our gratitude. For this small body of believers to come together to give of there time to help others in time of sorrow, you have certainly giving us a Large Blessing. Thank you Ridgewood Baptist Church thank you Pastor Kent. Beautiful Christmas Eve candlelight service. Friendly and welcoming. Gym is used by peace360 initiative for badminton 🏸 Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Ridglea Christian Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary: This church welcomes all believers and includes everyone in a safe space.  The preaching is encouraging and the communion table is open to all believers.  Thank you Ridglea for being my safe haven in this unsettled world. The Turtle Creek Chorale Chamber Chorus was simply amazing as they shed light and love. Thank you Ridglea for hosting this event and for your graciousness. Be cautious about the teachings of this religious organization. They place politics above their own beliefs Attended funeral with military honors. Excellent service.  Very supportive church members. Very nice church to attend super friendly people n a great pastor.

name: Right Way Christian Center Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary:
My church! Awesome Pastors. We provide a loving welcoming experience. Non-denominational, non judgemental, community and family oriented, true Word teaching. All ages and ethic backgrounds welcome. Come as you are. I really enjoy this church. Attending Right Way Christian Center gives you a sense of freedom from the traditional religion that most people were brought up on. The people are so friendly and welcoming. The praise team always sets the atmosphere for the glory of God to come in and the pastor and his wife Dr. V and Pastor M are real and genuine people. The pastor’s teachings are relevant to our everyday lives and is scripture based. He speaks and teaches the unadulterated truth of the gospel of Jesus Christ.
Dr. Vincent equips us to know, to learn and to grow in the word the “Right Way!!” We really enjoyed the praise and worship.  The assistant pastor  brought a powerful word on praying and listening to hear from God after you have prayed. Members were friendly.  When in Mobile we will visit this church again!  They also called to follow up to see how we enjoyed the services and how we are doing. A place that I love to call my church home. Pastor Vincent truly has a heart for God's people. His leadership is unsurpassed as by his teachings he points us to God. I have grown spiritually, financially, and mentally. The ground is good and rich!! This is some of the nicest people I have ever encountered.  They don't know half of the people they are helping but you are always greeted with a smile and a prayer.  Young people and the adults. Always a kind word.  And if you come often they never forget you and you are treated like family.. Which is what we actually are.  One family of One God!! Striving to go home to the same place.

name: Rightly Dividing the Word Church - Mobile Campus
reviewSummary: Revelation and wisdom flows every Tuesday and Sunday.  Apostle Kyser is a great spiritual father who teaches his sons and daughters wisdom on life principles to be able to apply to their life!!! Pastor Kyser is a blessed man of God great teacher. You ever find yourself off of broad st stop in and hear the word on Sundays🙌🏽 Prepare for a life changing experience. A place where you can fellowship with God Almighty & His people. Jesus Christ is Lord! Really love this church! It's a real church for real people. The word of God is taught there. God is moving in this place. The Word of God is alive. The Word Ministered is rightly divided.

name: Rise Church
reviewSummary:
What could I say about this church? It's a family of families from all over America and all over the world all settled in calling this place home. It's a cozy congregation in Portland where people feel safe to be real and raw while sincerely pursuing the healing and transformation of Jesus. There are some seriously bright, loving, and caring people here. You couldn't ask for a better place to bring young kids. It's a safe place for moms to catch their breath, for dads to actually find good male friends, and for everyone to not only learn Biblical truth but engage in real historical Christian tradition (holidays are a blast especially for the kids), join in genuine heartfelt and creative worship (many songs written by our own worship leaders), and for everyone to share great coffee and conversation. My family kind of stumbled in to this place and 3 years later I couldn't be more grateful to call this place my home.

If you've read this far and are looking for a church, come check it out. Caring leaders and congregation. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Rise Church Of Edmond - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
My friend went to church here and was gossiped about by the congregation instead of offering them support or help as jesus would have done. Great Word and Great Worship! The people are really nice too. Truly an oasis where the presence of the lord can be felt every service! This church has changed mine and my families life forever.

Come grow with us and take your walk with God the the Next Level! God has changed my life through the Whalens and church family here at New life! I thank God for them every single day! God bless and keep you! IN ALMIGHTY JESUS NAME!!! We went here for a bible quiz. The pastor is Awesome. If you are looking for a welcoming and loveing church this is a great place to go.

name: Rise Church San Marcos - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
I don’t live in San Diego, but I have relatives who do; whenever I’m in town I make it a point to visit Pastor Greg and this amazing fellowship. I just can’t say enough about this wonderful church family. Pastor delivers the Word so passionately. Anyone looking for a true bible based and healthy fear of God church, this is definitely the place! Cannot say enough great things about this special church. Sound Biblical teaching - literally line by line expository teaching. And worship is just beautiful, no flashing lights and overpowering drums. Just you and the Lord. Pastor Greg and his family are wonderful people who are grounded in the absolute truth of the Bible. They love Jesus and they do not chase money. I gladly drive an hour from East County each Sunday to soak in the atmosphere of true reverence. Rise Church was my home church for almost 5 years. It has been such a joy and incredible seeing God work through Pastor Greg and all the other people here! When I first started attending in late 2019, Rise was a church of 30-some people. And now? They’ve grown enough that there’s two services.

Rise is often at the forefront of all the leading issues of the day and doesn’t back down from their beliefs. l appreciate Greg’s conviction to take a stand for his beliefs.

I decided to leave Rise for a few personal reasons, but I still love the family of God here wholeheartedly, and I would encourage you to visit on a Sunday and see what makes this a special place. God is working here. We’ve been attending this church for about nine months now and we immediately felt connected.  The church family and leadership are very loving and genuinely care about everyone.  With Pastor Greg’s great teaching, special events, and mid-week Bible studies, we are able to go deeper into God’s word as it relates to the context of our times.  The worship music is always phenomenal and passionate.  We feel extremely grateful that God led us to such a wonderful church where we could learn, grow, get active in our community, and encourage, pray, and support one another. Pastor Greg has done a great job cultivating a warm welcoming home for GOD's people. He has a genuine love &  passion for Jesus & family values that you feel when he delivers his sermons. Plus he does so without watering down & compromising the gospel when addressing current issues facing the world today which is important to me. Definitely would recommend Rise Church

name: Rise City Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're sick of all the mega churches that also like to push "Christian Nationalism" and political machinations, this is a good church that simply focuses on Jesus. This is a amazing church that's been around since I was a kid.... The staff are generous and friendly. Not to mention how well kept i Honest, effective, relatable sermons. There is a mix of Pastors, so surely you'll connect with one of them/their sermons. They are Bible teaching, by effectively leading and learning together as a community. They are hugely mission oriented. God orders us to take care of the widows and orphans, to care for our neighbors, they do this collectively. It's been an honor to worship with them and have the opportunity to build relationships and love others like Christ! Great place to worship and learn lessons from the Bible.  Communion given out about twice a month at random.  Music is very top-notch and recent.  You will hardly ever hear an old hymn.  Wonderful pastors, staff, and people there!

John 3:17
God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him. Loving and life giving until your family faces adversity and nobody realizes you haven't been there months on end... not  a huge church, but if you aren't in the core, you are ignored. Nobody in life groups, no care pastor or women's ministry. Good job guys! This is not what a church is supposed to do.

name: Rise City Church Assemblies of God - Redwood City Campus
reviewSummary:
By far the best church in the Bay Area, the hospitality is 10/10 with amazing staff to make sure you're always feeling welcome. This church also does a lot of annual activities, pouring back into the community. The best church in the Bay Area; you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit when you walk in. Pastor Sarah has the most beautiful voice I have ever heard. Amazing choir!!!! Everyone can sing so incredibly well.  The choir moves your soul.  It’s soulful and gospel!  The pastor is amazing, I was truly moved by the word he preached.  I will be coming back every week with my 2 year old daughter.  They also have a nursery for young children.  They took care of my daughter really well.  I truly enjoyed myself.  It was important for me to find a new church after my move to Redwood City. Rise City Church had not only a great pastor, amazing choir, but a nursery for my young daughter. This Church is full of the Holy Spirit , it Ministers to one and all. They give back to the community in every way possible. It is a pleasure to attend there. It has great fellowship, everyone is friendly. My very first time attending. Wasn't sure what to expect. I WAS AMAZED AND OVERCOME WITH THE FELLOWSHIP.
I am homeless and come from So. Calif..I stay at a homeless shelter not to far away
I'm glad I made the walk. THANKS FOR THE FREE CUP of COFFEE
GOD BLESS YOU
I will try and make it back. I am awaiting a bed at the VA Menlo Park for homeless vets with substance abuse. GOD WILLING

name: Rise OC church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church.  The ppl are so sweet and kind.  The pastoral team is amazing and welcoming.  I am blessed that my family and I found this church. Friendly pastors, great people. Atmosphere is welcoming. Bible based church. Friendly and welcoming if you are open and seeking. Amazingly hospitable and warm church!!! Great people, great church

name: Risen Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Great family and community oriented church. Everyone here makes you feel very welcome.

Pastor Martin does a great job Biblically preaching the Word of God and the wonderful message of Jesus.

Excited to see how this church will grow and make further impact in 2018. Awesome down to earth ppl of God. They have been a blessing to me and my family from day one. Good and great people

name: Risen Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I church-hopped for a year before landing at Risen Church Westside. I've now been there for four years! The people here genuinely love Jesus, and its reflected in the way they love and serve their community. It's on the smaller side, which for me has been refreshing when living in a city that's so big. It's easy to get involved here (community groups, serving, etc.) if that's something you're looking for. Regardless, if you're looking for a place to belong, you're welcome here! The people here are incredibly warm, welcoming and genuinely like to do life together. It's a great non-denominational church for families, single people, and everyone in-between.

The pastors do a great job of preaching the gospel each week and there is a lot of importance placed on attending community groups during the week.

Parking on Sunday mornings can be tricky, but there are typically some visitor spots or street parking in the neighborhood available. If you come for a visit, expect a handshake or a hug, and stick around for donuts after! Within the past couple of years the younger aged group at Risen Church merged with the established slightly older group of Jesus Lovers at Westside Church to create what now is Risen Westside Church in Santa Monica. The church is on the smaller side, but recently add 2 services to their Sunday! After going to huge churches in Los Angeles, I never had a sense of community. At Risen you will quickly be greeted by caring people who truly want to get to know you, help you, and get you involved if you wish to! EVERYONE is welcome here. P.S. If you are from Texas...this is the church for you. haha A solid worshipping community, that loves God and others as Christ commanded: The Gospel lived out.

Sunday services offer solid biblical preaching, creative children’s ministries, and singing that combines hymns and contemporary worship all-of-which  spur living out Christ centered lives during the week. I am so grateful for this church family! From the minute I stepped in the doors I was welcomed. They teach from scripture and truly strive to bring God’s kingdom to LA. There’s a 90% chance someone will invite you to Bondi Harvest before or after service.

name: Risen City Church
reviewSummary:
I picked up some kids there one evening and they were so good to me!  They fed me while I waited.  😊 This is a great church.  They do a lot of good in their community, and are truly trying to live out the Gospel. Great Church, Good Folk, Doing God's Work.

Doesn't get better. Can't say enough positive things! Wonderful people! Excellent community based with emphasis on faith and children..

name: Risen Savior Lutheran Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking  for a church, go no further  best bible  study on Sunday morning, simple but   learn so much  about the bible. Pastor schulz is a true man of God. Church  teaches  the word of God according to the bible. The church is  welcoming, and the doors are open to all who seek the word of God. I and my wife  were lost until I found this church and pastor Schultz and his family  and family  of Risen Savior Lutheran church If you are looking for a church that teaches Gods word in its truth and purity, you will find it here! the congregation is like family!

name: RISING Church - Buford Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended a Christian School graduation 4 my granddaughter.. not a ton of parking, however the offer a steady running shuttle bus from the Buford parking garage 2 the church & back 2 the parking garage, free of charge, plus the parking garage is also free parking. Facility was clean, safe, & well equipped & faculty were friendly, professional, and very helpful! I visited there and plan on visiting again! There was something “more” there. There was so much passion and depth in the worship.The people were so nice- it was a breath of fresh air. The best church in the area for believers who love to grow deeply in the knowledge of Word of God!
And great children ministry!!!!!! Listen to worship service on You tube!  Excellent congregation.   Great Pastors! Great worship service 🙌 awesome 👌  . Friendly people,  kind ...

name: Rising Star Missionary Baptist Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice and accommodating Fellowship with other men and women of God! I Love my church home, to God be the glory.

name: River Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary:
The people at River Church are like your best friends! Pastor Ben Robinson is truly a very gifted speaker especially considering his young age. You will hear God's true word spoken in his gospel messages. First time there we were openly welcome, and we have returned many times and will still continued to join. Have spread the word to other people about this CHURCH. My daughter and I attended to dance there and everybody was very friendly. If you are looking for the true  God?
Come here you will find the King that can transform your life. And a good teaching of the word of God. Apart of that you will find real people like you and me no fake or trying to impress some one! You will find the real gospel of Jesus!
And the truth will make you free. Very helpful with allowing me to return at the airport location due to travel change.

name: River Church Norman - Norman Campus
reviewSummary: I love River! I have grown so much and found the sweetest college faith community here. The pastors are wonderful, honest, and dedicated leaders and it’s a great church home. It’s been an answered prayer for me!!! I’m a college student who has been going to River for 2.5 years now. River church is a Bible believing church whose members live out the love of Jesus. I’m not from Norman, but immediately got plugged in with River students and family, so I feel like I’ve grown up here! I'm not from this town my real name is Alex Holton I slept under a tree in the between the parking lots at this church is I was riding around and I helped the lady that had a broken hip clear her yard stuff from the storm damage and I was too tired to go anywhere else I had rode my bike to make it to my probation office here in Norman I don't know the area after I help the lady clear her yard I was so tired I couldn't ride my bike any further and going through the neighborhood this church came into view River Church I slept under a tree in between the two parking lots I noticed they also were clearing trees because they're stacked up in the parking lot I'm driving some water and I was able to charge my phone so that I can use my maps to know my direction not knowing where I'm at I want to thank River Church for for not bother me and allow me to charge my phone and stuff God bless this church the families that are involved the people that are involved in the community that is involved God bless this community as well thank you River Church and I did not leave a mess I threw all my trash away LOL thank you again River Church I visited river church my freshman year of college when looking for a church. When I visited river church I felt welcome as soon as walking in their doors. I was looking for a place to grow in my faith with god, and find community and river has given me that and more. I am so thankful for river church and the community that I am surrounded by. My daughter is going to OU but far away from her home in California, as well as her church family. I am so happy Hannah found her church home while attending college in Oklahoma. This Mama is comforted to know she will be surrounded by supportive Christian friends/church family at River and given firm biblical teachings rooted in Scripture.

name: River Church West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I am with the person who stated if they weren’t a Christian they would sue them. I also had a horrible experience here. Went to a back to school event that they dragged on for over 4 hours. We were hungry and thirsty. My child and I went up for prayer- which is normally fine. They started speaking in tongues which really freaked us out. They were touching all over us. One person even blew in our face. Where I come from you don’t blow or put your air in someone’s face. The one lady who spoke tongues over me and my child had the creepiest eyes-I was so freaked out I looked away. I feel wronged but should have known better when I saw Pentecostal. If you were not raised in a similar church do yourself a favor and stay away. Excellent Church, we have been attending for about 5 months now & WOW! God has done some great things indeed. My husband & I just recently began members as well as join in their bible school. My husband also received the Holy Ghost at this ministry. (I’m proud of him) 👏🏽 .

This church stand straight forward on the word of God. ( I love that) and they have a true heart ♥️ for the things of God, they're about the father’s business. Fantastic Pastor & great people.

Come check them out if you’re looking for a place to worship or call home. I highly recommend the River Church especially if you’re serious about being everything, God has called you to be. I want to Thank you to pastor Corey and pastor rose for coming to west palm beach with the anointing  I am forever grateful for your Obedience to the lord. Coming to this church has changed my life the power of God and the presence of God has completely healed my soul. And I have experienced Gods love and joy like I’ve ever known. Joy that bubbles up and comes out as laughter I laughed the loudest I’ve ever have in my life and felt the holy presence of the lord. Laughter is medicine and the joy of the lord is my strength. I’ve been delivered set free from fear trauma depression and am the happiest and freest I’ve ever felt in my life since coming here and deciding to plug in come consistently and started serving and eventually joined the Bible college. I have seen the fruit and best outcomes in my life. I have testimonies after testimony every single service How God shows up and touches me in a powerful way. Come and press in expecting a touch from God and you will experience God in a beautiful, powerful, life changing way. I cannot express enough in words how amazing this church is!! Praise God! Holy Spirit led and filled services. Different than your "traditional" Churches. Had a great time with the people at the men's BBQ cook out..we had burgers, lamb and coleslaw+ dessert after. The presence of God is so strong every time I walk into River Church WPB! The worship is powerful, the Word is alive, and the pastors preach truth with fire and love. Lives are being changed, people are being set free, and you can feel the anointing from the moment you walk in. This is a church that’s full of revival, family, and the power of the Holy Ghost! So grateful to be a part of what God is doing here! 🔥

name: River City Christian Church - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been regularly attending this church for about 10 months. We have attended other churches but what is happening at this church is beautiful! We love the worship and the Bible teaching is sound and unwavering. This church teaches truth. We are blessed to have found such a gem of a church! They also have so many programs and outreach. If you go here you will be fed the Word of God and find the support you need no matter your background or current life experience. I could go on and on with how happy we are. God bless this amazing church! 🙏 As someone who has been attending this church for the past 6 and a half years, I can safely say it is the best bible teaching and community based church within the area. Pastor J is awesome, and the smaller based ministries are great for young and avid followers who strive to strengthen their faith. Update:  My sister, Aurora, and brother-in-law, John, were visiting us (from Last Vegas, NV) after my son, Daniel, got married, Sat. 09/06/2025.  I believe they enjoyed the Sunday service and wonderful hymns, 09/07/2025.  I enjoyed the sense of community.  I bought my T-shirt and ordered a black River City Christian Church hoodie, too.

Older post:  I enjoyed the Christian music, met a newby, Mary, who sat next to my husband, Greg, and I which was our first time, 06/29/2025, in attendance.  We each were handed a Compass Magazine which had some good articles in it.  I texted the number as the bulletin board stated and received a small parting gift box with goodies.  I hope my husband loved it as much as I did so we can return.  Pastor, Jesse Smith was funny at times as he went over the Book of Proverbs.  It's a very nice, welcoming and comfy church. My husband and I LOVE this church! We attended our premarital counseling here and just loved the community and people! We also loved the fact that it’s a Bible believing Bible teaching church! We did have to move out of state and leaving River City was probably one of the hardest parts about moving. We’re trying to find a church like River City, but it’s hard to say goodbye. We will miss you River City!! I'm not one to do a review like this and it took 2 years to do it but I truly feel compelled to. This church ghosted me in one of my greatest times of need and if it wasn't for my deeply held faith and the Lord's presence in my life then I would have struggled continuing on and given up completely.

name: River City Church
reviewSummary: We've been attending River City Church for about a year and really enjoy it. The people are incredibly kind and welcoming, making us feel right at home since we’ve recently relocated to the Grand Rapids area. The children's services are engaging and enjoyable for our kids. We also appreciate the preaching and service. We're grateful to be part of this wonderful community. Greatly appreciate this church body! Their love for Christ and love for others is very evident. The solid preaching and thoughtful worship each week have been a haven for me through my last few years of attending. Love love love this church! Felt so welcomed and embraced when I first started going and haven’t thought of leaving since. If you’re looking for support and a church that truly loves the Lord, this is the place for you! Been a part of this church for almost 2 years now. Was immediately impressed with the community - welcoming, kind, and genuine. We've appreciated the Biblical teaching and the genuine friendships we've built here. River City understands and preaches the Gospel. It is a Church where you can be seen and loved no matter where you are at. From the beginning it was easy to feel known and get connected.

name: River City Church
reviewSummary:
When I moved to Fargo I was eager to become a part of River City Church. There I have been taught well, cared for, grown, and heard. This is a place where new people are welcomed. Also where I have had the experience of feeling valued as a part of the church as a woman. I appreciate and agree with the emphasis River City puts on the Bible as true and also the weight and trust given to the work of Christ. I would recommend this church to anyone interested in growing in their love for, knowledge of, or service to the Lord. What takes place at River City does not stay on Sunday. It is life changing and moves, the way it should, from the church on Sunday into homes throughout the week and outward to the community. I really love this place. Pastor Jake is amazing in his ability to take a Bible reading and then explain what was read at length. I cherish my time there and every week church is directly taken from the Bible particularly the New Testament.
A young vibrant crowd as well River City Church exists to make disciples of Jesus who make disciples of Jesus.  It does this by gathering together for Sunday morning worship and by gathering together in Missional Communities.  Sunday morning worship centers on the Christ-Centered preaching of the Word of God, while the Missional Communities focus on living the Word in life-on-life community through sermon based discussion and through a lifestyle of missions.  I highly recommend River City Church to anyone who wants to grow closer to Christ and lead people closer to Christ through community. Fantastic congregation! The pastors are incredibly talented, offering inspiring messages that are the perfect start to your day. Their guidance truly motivates you to serve and uplift others all week. A great church filled with people that love Jesus! I have been going to River City for close to four years and have loved it since my first time attending. Great biblical teaching and the relationships that you build with people are very special!

name: River City Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
Within the walls of this church miracles happen and hearts are changed  from the first day I came here there has never been a time that I haven't left a better person then when I entered. anyone and all are welcome to experience this as well my friend come as you are and find what you're missing I love this church and they are family. Not only is the pastor so full of integrity and God’s wisdom, him and his wife and so fun and relatable. The church is multi-cultural 🤩. The entire pastoral staff is trustworthy and wise. The teachings are biblically sound and the Holy Spirit is so present in this community. If you’re looking for these things, this is the place for you! I have been going here for close to one year. I find the Pastors of the church are very genuine and real people. Pastor Joe and Pastor K’s love for God and for people are very evident. I had longed for a church like this for many years and was invited by a family member. If you are looking for a Spirit filled church that operate in the gifts of the Spirit, this is the place for you. I find this place to be a place of order and balance, but at the same time are sensitive to the Holy Spirit being lead by Gods Spirit. I find that the Pastors protect the relational atmosphere as well as the spiritual atmosphere. I also find that this church helps you to grow and develop your God given gifts, providing many volunteer opportunities available for those who desire to serve. Excellent place for individuals and families to find God, grow in their faith, and  build relationships. I highly recommend. Nice place and even nicer people! I visited this church for the first time today(while traveling). I could absolutely feel the love the church has for each other and Jesus.

They worship wholeheartedly, encourage relationship and laugh. Thank you for a great time this Sunday, a River City Church! This is for anyone who is thinking about joining this Church or visiting for the first time. I hope this helps you.

Like many others, I wrestled with the decision of which church to attend and often struggled to motivate myself to attend services. I’m a single mom of two and had every reason not to. But coming to church really isn’t about the church itself. It’s about standing in the presence of God. It’s about when two or more are gathered in his name God is there Matthew 18:20 .
Let me be the first to tell you God is here at River City. I soon realized that the essence of church extends far beyond the physical building—it is about standing in the presence of God, about gathering in His name and feeling His presence among us.
Even if the physical church were to disappear, I am confident that I could still stand here and receive God's grace, for His spirit permeates this place. This is where my faith found its roots.. This is where God reached out and saved me in ways I never imagined possible. It wasn't an instant transformation; it took time and dedication, and it undeniably happened.

I am immensely grateful for the supportive and inspiring pastors at River City Church, but above all, I am thankful for how God has worked through every message, Sunday Service, and Mid week group I have heard/attended within these walls to touch my life and draw me closer to Him. If you are seeking a place to connect with Jesus Christ and be filled with the Holy Spirit, I encourage you to step into a church, you can start here. Take that first step on your spiritual journey. Whether it is River City Church or another, the important thing is to start.

I admit that I resisted for longer than I should have and stumbled along the way more times than I care to count, but God's grace and love never wavered. He restored me, and it happened right here. I believe that the same restoration can happen for you too. I pray that you begin your own process of seeking and connecting with God, wherever that may lead you. Embrace the journey, make a commitment to attend church regularly, and serve the Lord with all your heart. The journey may be challenging, but the rewards are immeasurable. May you find the same sense of peace, purpose, and renewal that I have found at River City Church.

name: River City Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been going to another church in the area and I loved it- my kids hated it.
My friend asked me if I wanted to go to church with her one Sunday and I said yes. My kids LOVED it.
They have so much activity for the kids and it’s not too overwhelming for my ADHD son.
I can’t describe the denomination or what to expect to outsiders because it’s a perfect blend of tradition with communion every week, but has so many other aspects of blended faiths: great worship, a good break to meet new people, testimonial stories, a variety of sermons, prayer and spirit centered healing.
We worship in the round which Id never seen and the main pastor is able to bring things down to the bottom shelf for those learning about Christ and following the way.

One thing to remember is that all churches are built and made up of weak sinners.
No one is perfect and strong- except Jesus Christ.
This church helps you to know this and there is no judgement here except for your own guilt you bring in with you.. so if you’re looking for a place that has judgement, exclusion, or perfection: this isn’t the place for you. This is a place for all people and that’s why God brought me here. One of the greatest blessings in my life has been finding a church family that encourages me, prays for me, and helps me grow closer to Christ. If you’re looking for a church, I’d love to invite you to visit with me. I think you’ll find a loving community and meaningful opportunities to connect with God and others.” Went here a few times with my wife and decided this wasn't the place for us. Very surface level preaching and the lead pastor doesn't seem to know how to stick the landing with his sermons, comes off very insecure and insincere. What a comfortable place. No hype, no fake huggers, no elaborate decor. Relaxed friendly genuine people and a modern simply stylish Church. The message is the word of the Bible brought to everyday life for everyone. So honest and true. This is a Church where anyone and all ages would feel welcome. I’ve checked out many in the area and this is it. Jesus is In this place. This was the most unfriendly church I've ever been to. The lady where you feel out your information was great. Once inside nobody said hi to me. It's been three weeks since I've been there and I haven't heard from anyone at the church. There definitely not worth the drive or my time.
