name: River City Church - Waco Campus
reviewSummary: The kindest people! They are friendly, inviting, compassionate, and empathetic. Like wow. Such an amazing place to worship and fellowship. River City is the most friendly church I have ever attended.  I’ve been so blessed by the joy that seems to flow from the moment I walk into the doors.  There is so much happiness and unity in this church, and I’ve been in a lot of churches, I know the real from the fake.  River City is not perfect, became we are all imperfect people seeking a true relationship with a perfect God.  River City Worship is cutting edge and exuberant, lots of lights and fog, but it adds  to the worship experience, it does not diminish it in any way.  You will feel Jesus! A spirit filled church with great passion. Their strength is in their pure power and triumphant devotion. They offer earplugs here due to the sheer volume of their worshio. My family and I felt very welcome! Friendly people of God. Worship was awesome, you will feel the Holy Spirit thru word of GOD, worship and prayer. We are glad we gave this church a try will definitely visit again. If you looking for a touch of the Holy Spirit this is the church. Give it a try you will like it! God bless! I know I'm not as accepted as I would like to be but River City felt like home. I hope one day I can contribute and be a valuable part of the community! Hopefully I can be blessed where I can bless others as of right now I have lost my wife in about to be evicted. I'm a good worker just fell short but I love the Lord Jesus Christ and would love it another chance to do the Lord's work. Thank you River City for being just what I needed. I'll be at recovery group tonight if I'm allowed for 6:00 to 7:00. Honestly it was a breath of fresh air I believe that gentleman's name is Brad he prayed with me both Sundays and I went and was more than I deserved. I forgot there's still people like that in the world, I have cut myself off and hermit it so long I lost my wife and lost myself. I fall short daily cuz I'm a sinner but I am on the uprise and I do want to be used in a mighty and powerful way. River City if you allow me I will be an awesome contribution to the church in any which way is needed and one day I could tell my story you can overcome addiction You have to have your feet to the fire but it can be done. I would like pastor Chris to know that his message always speaks straight to me like he's talking to me only it's weird how that works. Honest to God being here in Waco and going through the situation I'm in I've seen dark side but it's wonderful because I know that Jesus Christ is real and came to the cross to suffer for us that we may be cleansed of our sins. What a wonderful gift God gave is only begotten son for us. I need to be reminded of the things I take for granted daily fresh air lots of food and a beautiful wife that no longer wants to be with me cuz I'm a bully and a manipulator. I'll spend the rest of my life even if I can't win her back letting her know she was worth it and she will always be my beautiful angel. Honestly I miss people and I miss my family. I'm not in a good place right now because I'm all alone My health is coming back even though I have slipped and even lied a few times lately but I was on the up and up and just fell short cuz I did not let somebody know that I was tempted. I'm still strong and I'm still worthy of giving the chance to do the right thing All you have to do is ask of me and most of the time when I'm not drinking and drugging I'll be more than happy to do that just by nature. I'm not supposed to say if the things that I do for people but as of lately I have given to the poor and I have helped the elderly not to say that makes up for my sins but I do try. I just need a little bit more time to get my spiritual muscles as well as my physical health back and I'll be able to be a mighty force that the Lord can use as a vessel to speak to his people or anyone that wants to turn their lives around and not just act like a Christian but walk like a Christian. I'm so sad and I've cried so much there's no more tears to cry my wife left me that's the lowest that you can get I'm so terribly heartbroken this last 6 months to a year have been like my own living hell. I actually believe that I saw demons in the devil that sounds crazy but if it happened to you you would know it. It's not a fun place to be but also it let me know that God has already won this battle there is none higher than him that's what I kept on telling myself in bed watching my wife as I thought that she was being taken over by some kind of sleep demon. It's a horrible way to think of your wife especially for me cuz I do love my queen. That's all I got for now. I'm very transparent open and will not lie anybody can ask me anything and I'll be more than happy to tell him If anybody wants to know my story of trials and tribulations and the way not to live just ask me but I do have hope and inspiration today and I'm so grateful for what has happened. I just hope and pray I can get a job and be used for the glory of God and not myself and I'll be more than happy. Me and my wife don't have any children and that could be due to me not holding down a job so we could have insurance and go to the fertility clinic. Thank you

name: River Hills Church of Christ - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary: Listen to the message and not the messenger.   Allow God to speak to you through his word. Great services not too long My Church. Friendly welcoming church

name: River Oaks Christian Church - Jenks Campus
reviewSummary: Heart warming place with great people.

name: River of Life Christian Church - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary: My home church in the Bay Area! If you are a seeker expect to be filled with the presence of the Lord! Praying and worship in the Shekinah Glory sanctuary experience transformation in love with Jesus and moved by the Holy Spirit. It is a great Christian Church! The largest Chinese Church in US. The love for God and people, the passion for gospel, the beautiful worship, the great message! When you get in, you can feel the Holy Spirit. It is great Sunday programs and many other groups. Great team and body in Christ! With newly built hall. It so so great. Come and visit it! To get encouragement, get refresh and come to join us. I am new to this church too, but I feel at home very quick. Every one is so loving and caring. Very nice Xmas Eve performance with decent and beautiful story about god The best church! I’m a Chinese and I love all the pastors speech about Bible. It’s all about Father, Son, Holy Spirit and everything base on Bible (what God said). It’s a developed church, so we have all the resources we need to be closer to God and understand what God wants us to know. I love this Church. It's my spiritual home. Pastors are super nice, and the church ministry is very well organized. This church welcome the work of Holy Spirit. I received healing from the healing crusade. I also love the worship in the church. Jesus is the center for sure. Recommend to any Chinese and Cantonese speaking Asians.

name: River of Life Christian Church in New York - New York Campus
reviewSummary: a little prejudiced against people from other places，not a diversity place to go Great place to preach gospel to the young people from China, A church filled with the Holy Spirit and loving. Customer service was disgusting, a lady answered the phone & was very rude & disrespectful! Please do not go to this church or participate in anything that has to do with them. By far the worst experience I ever had ! Really friendly place, devoted brothers and sisters. God love you

name: River of Life Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: While I was in the service I couldn't wait to come back next week. God is good. Just this weekend I was able to go to a church service and the River of Life flowed my way. Thank you Jesus, I think Stephanie and I found a home. I'm grateful for this Church 🙏 thank you for today I'm looking forward to being apart of this community good ppl good vibes ❤️ Today my daughter and I visited ROL for our first time and I must say it was everything opposite of what I was expecting! Meaning, I was afraid it wouldn't go good because I've had bad experiences in the past at other church congregations but as soon as we opened the door we were welcomed with warmth and love from Tierra, her husband and mother as well as another man I didnt get his name!!!! Just what we came for! I'm a single mother trying to keep the faith and plant the seed in my daughter and it's not always easy. Doing it all on my own and having no support and always looking to God daily for strength. Anywho, the people were all very kind and welcoming! The music was AMAZINGGGGG and the word given today was what I NEEDED!  Mr. Robs prayer over my circumstances was very heart felt and I was very grateful for that! We will definitely be back and I just pray God continues to keep us coming and that God given relationships can form by the blood of Jesus. I need community and my daughter needs friends in Christ so thankful I visited and looking forward to growing with others who also love Jesus as we do! Thank you all! 🤞🏾💪🏾🙌🏾🙏🏽❤️ I love River of Life. It is small, diverse, and genuine. People are warm and friendly. Real friendship is formed and fostered. There is a strong commitment that people live lives together in Christ. If you are looking for an intimate place to worship, meet friends, and serve, check this place out. up on the Word!💯 AND THEY BRING THE MESSAGE EVERY WEEK😃 plus they help folks in need of groceries😌

name: River of Life Community Church - Hudson Campus
reviewSummary: We are so thankful to be at River of Life and under the teaching of Pastor Joe.  He is a man who I have watched for 12 years pour into the lives of others and creates a large network of discipleship across the world. The  Freedom class that is taught will teach you things that will help you more than any psychologist, In other words, one who attends this class will learn how to really live life to the fullest!  The house church design follows Acts, So amazing for fellowship and furthering the kingdom. Pastor Joe Daltorio has the ability to deliver the Word in a way that we can effectively use it in today's world.  He has a wonderful teaching ability, a great big heart and the priorities of the church follow the proper guidelines. His accountability is unsurpassed in what I've seen.  This church is growing yet the family welcomes us into the fold.  The perfect size church for us! I had throughly enjoyed the leadership of Pastor Joe and now Pastor Steave's unique new ideas for River of Life will be just as spiritually profitable for anyone seaking an experiance with our creator. if you are looking for the true Word of God then you have come to the right church.  The people are friendly but they are also true.  Looking to do what is right under God in many ways around the community as well as across the Country.  But expect to be told the truth about what God wants in our life.  Easy to understand teaches. We love this kind, Spirit filled community, that has welcomed us with open arms. Could not recommend enough!!

name: River Ridge Church - Charleston Campus
reviewSummary:
River Ridge is a church like no other. Very laid back. Come as you are. No judges simply plain great people. Since I have started at River Ridge my life seems more content and in control. The sermons are with humor and much wealth. The pastors all have a great sense of humor and put it in a way you fully understand. My whole way of life seems to have been lifted due to the messages that really hit home. Matt has a way he explains the scriptures to our understanding.
Then you have a safe place you can take your children  for their own learning of the Bible in a way they can understand and not be bored. There are all kinds of different areas for all age groups with amazing volunteers whom dedicate their selves to teach the word of God in a way they can understand. This is from babies to college! They think of everything! I am very proud to be a part of River Ridge and so very glad I joined!  If you have an emptiness in your heart come join up on Sunday morning with an early one starting at 9:45 and also at 11:15 every Sunday mornings. Plenty of free parking with coffee and donuts also. So come join up. You will be glad you did! My family and I have been attending River Ridge for a few years now. We love this church. It is a come-as-you-are church that cares more about your soul than your clothes. It is a very welcoming church focused on spreading God's word and love to the Charleston area, and worldwide. The music is live and contemporary. The sermons are more teaching than preaching. There is also a church for children, as well as a strong youth program. I highly recommend this church if you want a relaxed atmosphere in which to hear God's word and fellowship with other like-minded Christians. Great, friendly, super kid friendly, you'll grow in ways you never realized here and so will your kids and teens..lots of hands on outside ministries, mission trips, Bible studies, men's breakfasts, women's gatherings and retreats. Give them a try, I think you'll be pleased!! I attended riverRIDGE until they invited a lying judge who violates the United States Constitution and state rules, as a guest speaker. Pastor Santen refused to allow a counter-presentation to let people know about the judge's misconduct. We loved his preaching and the small groups. However, churches should NEVER allow documented liars to use the platform! Warm and welcoming! Friendly volunteers from the parking lot to the coffee maker!

name: River Rock Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary:
I wasn't even looking for a church and went one Sunday and felt so welcomed. I decided to check it out again and now I'm attending on a regular basis. Everyone is so kind and friendly as can be. It feels so natural. The pastors, Josiah and Noel, are great communicators of the Bible and have a deep love for Jesus. Come check it out! River Rock Church is a warm, welcoming, friendly place. Teachings are from the Bible and are always enlightening. It’s a small congregation, which makes it easy to get to know and connect with others. I’m so glad we found this church. It is exactly what we’d been looking for! River Rock Church is home for me.

Jesus focused, Bible based teachings, family atmosphere, and the pastor Noel knows you by name. Very welcoming  and a great message.

name: River Valley Church
reviewSummary: Fast-growing high-impact church with vibrant youthful atmosphere, inspirational worship music, and a massive heart for global church planting.

name: River Valley Church - City Campus
reviewSummary: Visited one Sunday, great worship team and sermon.  I love the space it is well equipped and met friendly staff. Highly recommended We have been going here for 4.5 years. We love the staff, leaders and pastors of this campus. The congregation has a lot of young attendees, and we have observed this is most likely due to its location (close proximity to a lot of colleges, etc). There are also a lot of families. I encourage you to come and check out more than one service to see if this is a place you can see yourself plugging in to! Amazing local church body, full of Christ followers that truly care about each other, from the lead pastor, all the way down to the people serving anonymously in children’s rooms.  Many people groups and different countries represented, each and every time we get together. Let me address some of these reviews, Google does nobody any service by allowing someone to give a one star review of a church, because one time, they encountered temporarily un-shoveled sidewalks, without a review of the actual church service, itself. Others complain that money was spoken about when they visited, again, one visit review where giving to missions (over $100M given the past few years to local and global missions!!!) and to our church by core attendees, to keep our lights on, is criticized?! Show me one church, anywhere, that gives more to charity than River Valley Church. Any complaints about the avoidable urban blight of never finished construction and unoccupied store fronts up and down the street? Also, the one star complaint about the church about people not stopping to help you with your sticker issue when the garage is full of apartment building residents, cars and drivers that don’t go to our church? Google should also strike all these ridiculous, drive by, one star reviews driven by constant political grievances because a local church chooses to support law and order, and wants to find some middle ground between left and right? Also, there is not one “antisemitic” bone in our pastors. Theological diversity is welcome, and if you plug in, some wonderful conversations about the nuances of Christianity, will take place. It’s disappointing that a church located in one of the most expensive parts of Minneapolis can ask the community for financial support yet can’t manage to keep its sidewalks properly cleared. For an organization that relies so heavily on the neighborhood, you’d expect them to take basic responsibility for keeping the area safe and accessible. For reference they are the only building on the street currently with snow and ice on the sidewalks, 24 hours after snow has stopped falling. This church is amazing and the pastor preaches very encouragingly also graceful messages. The volunteers are so passionate about god and so much support. Though I have been visiting this church for the past three weeks, I'm so much loved to hang in there for worship for all the services, especially the worshiping and the drummer guy is so talented. Everyone in this church is humble and youth pastor prayers are heart touching through the holy spirit. Internship students are becoming so grateful like ambassadors of Christ. If you are new to this area or visiting for the first time, This is one of the best churches in the city. This church makes you feel at home right here😍✝️

name: River West Church
reviewSummary: Gospel-centered congregation in Lake Oswego known for systematic verse-by-verse exposition, dedicated children's ministries, and active local benevolence.

name: River's Edge Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary: Rivers Edge Church in Pocket/Greenhaven puts on top notch community events. Check out the pics from the 2019 Easter Egg Hunt. They also host an awesome, fun & safe free Halloween event. Lots of family fun. I was ill in 2018. I came to the church for Bible study and prayer.  I was embarrassed.  I had bad edema. They help me locate a change of clothes to manage the fluid. We were looking for a new church last year, and are so thankful we found REC!  Love the amazing worship, inspiring messages, friendly people, women’s ministry events and wonderful outreach to community!  Come check us out! People that love Jesus and serve their community. This is an awesome church to attend. The Pastors and staff are so kind and helpful. I hope that if your looking for a multi-cultural spirit filled church, this is the place to be...be safe and blessed!

name: Riverbend Church
reviewSummary: Stunning hill country campus along Lake Austin known for inspiring messages, uplifting blended worship, and compassionate outreach.

name: Riverbend Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: Stunning hill country campus along Lake Austin known for inspiring messages, uplifting blended worship, and compassionate outreach.

name: Riverbend Church Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: This church and the people in it are such a blessing. It is a great place to worship, congregate, fellowship and volunteer. They have small groups and outreach programs for every walk of path. Our family is grateful for the staff and all Riverbend does for the community. Wonderful Church! Glad to call this place home. They preach the truth and they have great environments to connect and find community for all ages An amazing church filled with spirit led people. A great place for me and my wife to call our home church. The first thing we noticed upon arriving was how welcoming and loving these people are to us. Great place for Sunday worship and a message on truth and Jesus! I've been a member of Riverbend for a year now; and I'm loving it. The pastor is very friendly to everyone, and is a great speaker, always telling the truth according to God's word when he speaks. The people are very friendly and welcoming there too; I've made some true friends at Riverbend in the past year. Come try it out, and see for yourself!

name: Riverchase Church of Christ - Hoover Campus
reviewSummary: The church is really beautiful. I don't quite know who's the preacher these days, I know it's changed since I have visited there, but everybody there was extremely nice it was a great congregation and beautiful building. One of their old members, one of the men that used to be an elder there for many years, Mr Don Genry passed away and today we went to his funeral that was held there... It was a beautiful building, right now they have vacation Bible School going on so we had to use the fellowship hall. Mr Don was a faithful member for many years and really love the church there at Riverchase. Beautiful area beautiful congregation amazing people and this church is really doing amazing things in the Lord's kingdom. The Riverchase congregation is a loving and welcoming group. More than that, these grand folks take the Word of God as inspired and authorative. I visit these wonderful people whenever I get the chance. May the Lord continually bless these folks and their work in this area. A wonderful group of people who are full of God's love for everybody. Wonderful church family, striving to Love God, Love People and Make Disciples for Christ. It is a wonderful family of God. Everyone was so welcoming and I love the Wednesday break out groups.

name: Riverchase Community Church - Hoover Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful church family. They are so welcoming here and truly love the Lord. They have a great kids program, with a fun playground. I have recently visited Bible study  Worship service and the Women's  Brunch. All were a great time of fellowship. It is always a pleasure  to be in the missed of fellow Christians.  I can not say enough about how welcoming they all are. I smiled so long and hard my cheeks hurt. Praise God!! I visited last week because I was staying in the area for work. I was recognized as a new person, and at least 6-8 people came up to me and introduced themselves and thanked me for coming. It didn't seem forced. They had no "welcoming committee" whose job it is to notice new people. These were just people within the Church who came up to me and shook my hand, looked me in the eye.
The pastor (who was the first person to notice me) is genuine and clearly loves his job. He loves sharing Jesus with others in the least lame way: true, authentic life with Jesus can be incredible. And he isn't afraid to share it!

I got moved to another city before I could go back, but it was a big blessing to visit their Church that day. More than wonderful to me. I met the love of life there as lightning struck the under-construction sanctuary.  We were married there the next year, and after over three decades, we are still there. Praises to our Lord. we have a school in the church and there is a day care as well. very nice people working here

name: RiverPoint Church - Pelham Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice Spirit filled church. We have visited many churches in the area, and I think we’ve found our home while we’re in Alabama! Everyone is super welcoming and kind, it definitely embodies what we’ve felt about the kindness and hospitality of the people in the Bham area ❤️❤️ We went there for a Christmas program and wasn't disappointed. There was fun activities for the grandkids. If we didn't already have a home church, we would consider this one. Something about the warm atmosphere and the service just seemed so comfortable.Its also a little far from our house to attend. But if your looking for a church, I fully recommend it. Love this church. Great people. Great pastor.  Very welcoming church. Highly recommend Attended for a baby dedication.   Very welcoming atmosphere.   The people were very nice. First time I visit  was Palm Sunday.I feel at home.

name: Rivers Church Assemblies of God - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary: Rivers Church was a Amazing experience. It's filled with the Holy Spirit, the Pastor Tony and His wife were friendly and greeted me. On Baptism Sunday with BBQ! Great. Small Holy Spirit Lead Church! The most phenomenal people you will ever meet very warm and inviting they treated us not like visitors but like we were family I will be returning thank you so much to everyone First time visiting today and was very impressed with how welcoming and friendly everyone is at the church. Love that the pastor takes time to speak with you as you are leaving. Small church but doing big things!! :) I will definitely be coming back. My kids enjoyed their service and even requested to come back. Couldn't stop talking about what they learned and can't wait for next Sunday. I attended Rivers church today for the first time,it was awesome. Today mothers day is a rough day for me. 3 babies in heaven. I have been mad at God since the 90s and am sick of it. So i decided to let him in my heart so he can soften it from the inside. Everyone was welcoming and supportive of each other. I will definitely be back next Sunday.  Its going to take a while for him to soften my hard heart. Thank you for being there and all the great work you are doing. I attend this church for about 2 months lovely sermons, but I never felt so alone I tried to get information through those connect cards on any bible groups never got a response. Attend a special Friday worship service less than 10 attended that's including the worship team. They announced go groups saw that there was a women's group Tuesday at 7 nothing. I don't even know who to ask about the groups in person. You need to know someone there already to connect with this church I feel.

name: Rivers Crossing Church - Mason Campus
reviewSummary:
The best church!!! So amazing worship!! Lots of service times! & programs for every season of life. Preaches the word!! Pastors are amazing!! Anyone is welcome. Sept. 1, 2024

So 1st I want to say that I already have a home church. I'm not looking for another one BUT because my daughter had to work this morning (kings island) I decided to visit this church. I've been wanting to visit since before the reconstruction but she never worked Sunday mornings. Secondly I will try not to compare this church to my church. I attended the 10:15 a.m. service. Today they had baptisms and that was awesome. Parking was a real challenge as ALL of the 1st Time Visitors parking spots were still full at 9:50 a.m. AND all the handicap spots were also full. There is a whole yellow stripped section across from the handicap parking that could be used for handicapped parking....but it's just an open wasted space. With that being said.....the Greeters were friendly and welcoming. The lobby was very busy, bustling and crowded....in a good way. Folks were there to here the Word and there's nothing wrong with that. It was a little traffic jam trying to get into the sanctuary. When I got inside 1. I was greeted and welcomed again (a plus), 2. I noticed folks putting ALOT of 'reserved' cards on alot of seats....especially up front. Now I don't know if it was for the ones that got baptized or not BUT one would think there would be some spots towards the front for the First Time Visitors. 3. The seats in the Main Sanctuary were like the old movie theater seats with double arms that hold cups/bottles. THAT I did not like and had to ask if I could sit in the Wheelchair Companion Seat as it seemed like one of the greeters didn't want me to sit in it otherwise. I told her that these seats were not WIDE HIP FRIENDLY. She said it was okay to sit there. 4. Had she told me that there were armless chairs in the CHAPEL (which I didn't know there was one....you know 1st Time Visitor and all) I would've sat in there. 5. The praise and worship team was LOUD....and to be fair I'm used to that at my church as I am on the Praise & Worship Team too.....the only difference is... they were so loud that I couldn't hear ANYBODY ELSE sitting in the sanctuary singing.....that included the folks sitting around me. I also noticed that the team didn't dial back the fullness of their voices in any of the songs so that the CHURCH could raise up their praise. 6. The pastor was engaging and finished out the 5 week sermon in Ecclesiastes; but I felt that he cut away to too many videos throughout the sermon. 6. The VIP room was open but only one person was in that area so 1st Time Visitors filled out cards in the lobby. You will either get a bible if you've accepted Christ that day OR a free shirt from their little store. 7. FREE COFFEE (nuf said 😁) 8. Layout of the church is lovely....upstairs (balcony) is their when the Main Sanctuary fills up as well as space in the Chapel. Lots of comfortable seats in the lobby, swing seats outside, benches/table. 9. Like my church (at least ours direct traffic to get us out of the parking lot) Rivers Crossing had 2 sheriffs on the premises. Where I sat one was inside in the corner for the entire service! Y'all are gonna be safe!🙂 10. If you decide to go upstairs for the service...know that there are NO restrooms UPSTAIRS! 11. TOILET SEATS ARE LOW....you better have strong legs to get back up! 12. And this should've been 1st...the church IS DIVERSE! All in all....now that I know that there is SIZE INCLUSIVE  seating in the Chapel, the next time my daughter has to work.... I'll stop by again!
-Dawn- I have only been to 1 service but I really enjoyed myself and learned a lot. I am excited to go back. Definitely a great group of people. I am so happy that I was invited Giant, engaging service with fun kids church spaces and community groups for many ages and interests. A little too big for our family’s needs. Tribes for the teens on Wednesday nights has been a hit. Thanks be to God for the blessing of the staff and church congregation here!

We were VERY blessed by your generous gifts of prayer, love, meals, and encouragement.

I can't help but tear up with joyful thanks when I think of how wonderful you all are, and how much we felt your live towards us!

These are photos from us in the gathering area. Such beautiful muriels and artwork throughout this worship building!! Awesome design work, colors, and again, I can't find enough words to express our thanks to God for the support and caring of the staff while we were here.

name: Riverside Avenue Christian Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Great congregation, a family oriented community church of like minded Christians. 1 visit and we found our place of worship in Jax. People travel from all over the city to come here, fortunately we live in the neighborhood. We don't go to this church but love nearby and they do so much for the community! We go to their playground a few days a week and get fresh herbs from their garden! We also love their programs during luminaria! This is a warm and welcoming place to be — they accept you as you are and invite you to seek the Lord both in service and during fun groups and activities. Their secular Arts and Music programs are incredibly helpful for homeschooling families and those on a budget. Great staff. We love the community here. They truly treat us as family 💙

name: Riverside Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I was looking for a church near me and I found a Christian church by my house on Magnolia Ave in Riverside. This Babtist church in Riverside had all of the church ministry components I was looking for in a church.

The sermons are expository preaching and keep in line with sound doctrine. This is the same way that John MacArthur preaches at Grace Community Church In Los Angeles, that's why I love it so much.

The fellowship comes through genuine and sincere relationships through Christians who serve others using their gifts and talents for the glory of God.

There are many churches in Riverside that I could go to but, this one just checks all of the boxes in what I was looking for in a church.

I highly recommend this church as it's the best church in Riverside, California. If you want to learn what the Bible says.. why the Bible says this based on the history and support of other references IN scripture and the context behind it. It is at this church. Pastor Christian Torres has dedicated his life to God. Come see and hear for yourself. :) they evangelize to our neighbors in love and support missionaries from all over the world. Seriously sounds too good to be true. 1998 I met my friend Reggie Sr and he was in this church. I went with him and I liked this church. I told the church of Reggie's hardship and they helped him. 2004 I left Riverside California and I asked the church to take care of him. 2006 I have cancer and I left him and California. 2024 the church is still there for Reggie Sr. Fantastic  Bible teaching, challenge your Bible knowledge. Pastor is energetic and welcoming to all . Congregation are very friendly. I really like the Pastor. He is a solid Bible teacher. They do hymnals. Only problem was with discernment. They brought in a prosperity teacher.

name: Riverside Christian Assembly - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary: The first time I went there, I knew this was going to be my home. CHURCH Pastor Drew is very knowledgeable and preachers the word. He also has a very great sense of humor. If you’re looking for a church that is spirit filled. Pastor teaches directly from the Bible, this is the place for you if you’re not sure just come try it out once. There's no place like home sweet home. Come visit this church in a little corner of West Riverside where great things are happening, and you will never be sorry. In fact, you'll be running back the next week. A message from the intellect speaks only to the intellect, but Pastor Drew preaches from his heart, and into our hearts go his messages! And the congregation is a beautiful mix of people from all walks of life, loving God and His Son on one accord. Such is the Kingdom of Heaven. RCA is a wonderful church.  The Pastor preaches the uncompromising word of god with integrity and wisdom.  You will be loved, welcomed, and accepted for who you are just the way you are.  Pastor Drew has a heart for youth and there are many free sporting events and social activities that help draw young people to Christ. It is an amazing church filled with love and compassion for the lost.  I love my church home😊👍 Me and my family love this church we have been members for 4 years and love inviting new people every chance we can. come check it out great programs for kids of all ages even have celebrate recovery for the adults every wensday night.pastor Drew is such a great pastor he teaches and preaches all from the bible he is so on fire for the Lord . This is one of the most amazing little churches I have ever attended Pastor Drew is a youth pastor and he loves his church and the children and his parishioners he is there for you anytime for anything his door is always open. The message he gives is from the heart. Him and his entire family are totally involved in this little church and making it what it is today what a great job Pastor Drew you offer so much to the youth and the community the world in general is a better place because of you thank you for all you do

name: Riverside Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Riverside Church for Love & Light Concert W/Jordan Feliz and Colton Dixon. Easy access from Interstate 25 and plenty of parking. The facility is very nice and the concert was great. This church is great.  Pastor Chris has an incredible way of distilling the word in an approachable, yet impactful, way.  The entire team is full of exceptional people who are eager to make deep connections with the church members.  Shout out to Adam who is the leader of the young adults group and a truly great guy.  If you need a church home in Denver, make it Riverside, you won't regret it! Great church family.   I've only been going there a few months and I already feel at home.  The small groups and bible studies are great, too My husband and I were in town for the weekend and googled and found this church.  The sermon was awesome, the music was amazing and the people were so friendly.  I really enjoyed the pastor’s fun and engaging attitude.  We will definately come back with our kids!!!  Loved it!!!! I have been a member at Riverside for 5+ years. And while no church will ever be perfect, because we are all sinners. This church is great. You feel welcomed from the moment you walk in the door. You are greeted by other members of the church who immediately make you feel welcome.

The worship team is amazingly talented, and really wants you to have a worship experience with God. Not just sing.

The pastors at Riverside truly care about you and your growth. This is a church that preaches the bible. The motto we have become familiar with is that "we have nothing good to say here aside from what the bible has already said."This is a huge comfort to me.

This is a church that believes baptism is a step of obedience, that we are called to as believers. My husband and I were baptized here several years ago. What a celebration. It's wonderful to see people young and old getting baptized on a regular basis. As a profession of their faith.

The Riverside members truly feel like our family.  God is moving in this church. You will feel it immediately.

name: Riverside Church - Jersey City Campus
reviewSummary: Riverside is home!  The people are loving, the worship is authentic and the messages are encouraging and challenging.  Kids ministry is awesome, full of volunteers who genuinely care for and love the kids who come through the doors. Great church, great people, great pastor, Awesome God! :) If you want to find a place to worship and feel like you belong in a church family, come to Riverside Church!  Amazing church with a home-like environment! The place we most dearly miss when we travel! If you are looking for somewhere to grow in your relationship with God this is the place! Commonality is the norm, given the strong Latino presence. Standard pastor sermon,  however, the music needs more life to it. Jesus loved music. I was a new person in this church they were celebrating and having a wedding it was good it was fun I enjoyed it if you are interested in coming over you can come over and visit thank you.

name: Riverside Church - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: Tell your congregation to not park in the business parking lot right next to your place. The business parking lot is very small. Yet I saw 2 families park in it and walk into your building. We had to wait to park to walk into Third Coast. Boo. This isn’t just a church, it’s my church family. Riverside offers real authentic fellowship with one another. I am able to be truthful and honest about my mess and they accept me just the way I am. Having people walk with you and guide you in your faith is so important. I promise you that once you hear Andrew’s gift for preaching, you will keep coming back. Hope to see you there. A church focused on finding your purpose, sharing your story, and serving your city.  Mission-minded and keeps 1st things first.  Has had a major impact on my life and has been a blessing for me and my family during difficult times.  A great place to worship without being judged. This church was very recepted. I liked the layout of the church. You can see it from the road. There is plenty of parking space and it is handicapped accessible inside and out. I was at a funeral and most of the people were from out of town. They made everyone feel at home and invited all denominations to come back and worship with them at any time. Love it! Minister speaks very well and talks to you in normal, everyday terms so that you can understand and relate and apply to your daily life. Really gets you thinking. Very diverse group as well! We'll definitely be going back.

name: Riverside Community Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
A great church with sermons that will knock your socks off!  I'm here from Florida, and although the music is a bit loud for my old-lady taste, the heart it is presented with makes me "turn down my hearing aides" and join in.

Pastor Michael is fabulous.  His sermons are on the money (not that he asks for $$) and gives me things to think about during the week.

The church is supporting 22 missionaries and has a refrigerator for the community to come share.  Pastor Michael stands at the front door and greets people leaving church who want to talk to him.  The line goes forever, but he talks to each family or person, and amazingly enough, he seems to remember who you are!  (Don't worry, there are other doors to get out if you don't feel like waiting!)

All in all, the Spirit of the Living God is alive and well at Riverside.  It is my new Illinois church while I'm here I just like to say, I visit Riverside Community Church 3yrs ago and I really enjoyed the friendly people.  They showed me love and the preaching was good Being here  is like going to a family reunion  to meet new / old members each week. The MORE you KNOW, more OFTEN you GO. This is our Home church since 2016. Great friendly people that love & serve all with open arms. Great kids program/  Youth is on FIRE for God & Worship.  The pastor is True & Threw on & off the pole pit. Amazing childcare. But beware, you may fall in love with the Move of God & stay!!! I've been to riverside for a year and I love it! Its gotten me closer to Jesus and i have met wonderful people that love Jesus. this community is very determined in getting the gospel to everyone and very kind to strangers. They are there to build community not just to be there but build relationships with people. I've been to many church but none like riverside. I highly recommend

name: Riverside Mandarin Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This church truly welcomes people warmly.  It has a nice atmosphere that is not intimidating  to go to.  There are children's classes for kids of all ages.  They have services in Mandarin and English.  Go there and check it out, I know you will be glad you did. Good church good people Chinese people are really good people Nice service We welcome all Chinese friends to come to church to listen to the Lord's word, to be rooted and built up, and we look forward to meeting you there!

name: Riverside Peacemakers Ministry - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: There were several pastors & church officials from 2 sister churches one sponsors youths.  The group was very friendly & welcoming. They celebrated the opening of a community garden & a mural. They made sure everyone was welcomed & included in the festivities.  They had food & gave away vegetables grown in the garden & they had music.  Being someone who didn't know anyone didn't matter because of how much everyone was welcomed. Some city & UCR officials came, the mural artist was there also. If you are looking for a church that will make you feel welcome, the members will definitely do that as well as the pastors I just started going there but I'm very warm feeling there and God is in my life If you are looking for a good church this is the place the biggest Lil church is Riverside very powerful every one there is nice they calle daily to see how I am doing Bible study on Wednesday is very good A must visit. Pastor Ruben and his Church are on fire for God.🔥📖✝️ I loved the message, very blessed environment

name: Riverstone Chapel of Chatsworth Assemblies of God - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
When you come to Riverstone chapel, you feel at home, everybody is family. Pastor Joe teaches you, and you will have a clear understanding of the
gospel with limited laughter, he makes you feel glad you came every Sunday. Check them out. You won't be disappointed.Service starts at 11 a m Went there to buy some of their used solar panels that are very nice and the maintenance man was very helpful! Great neighborhood church, good people and bible study. Thank you for being there! I love 💕 my church!! Always giving & helping people. Really good people. The worship and sermon were excellent.

name: RiverStone Church - Kennesaw Campus
reviewSummary:
The most spirit filled church I’ve ever had the wonderful chance of visiting. Holy Spirit led my family to this church through their ministering and now our family considers this our home! We love Riverstone and here’s why:

-Missions oriented church. They partner with churches all over the world and send out missionaries quite often to evangelize and share the gospel.

- Foster friendly church. There are many foster & adopted families that attend the church. The church has a series about adoption and foster programs and invites the congregation to help support or become foster parents and ties that in to how we are adopted into Christs family. They also open up the church as a safe place for fostered children to meet up with their birth parents during visitations.

-Children’s program is amazing. Ms. Becky the children’s pastor is on fire for the Lord and really loves and teaches the children biblical truths at their level. From the front desk greeters to the volunteers and staff you can sense they are all excited about the children being there and learning about the Lord.

- Very friendly church! I remember the first time I visited for a women’s worship program, people greeted me like they already knew me. I didn’t feel awkward being there. Everyone was very genuine and happy for me to be there.

- There are four pastors that preach in the main church. Tom, Sam, Savannah, Matt, and Becky.
Tom-Sr. Pastor
Sam- Pastor
Savannah- Missions Pastor
Matt- Youth Pastor
I love that they all have very different styles of preaching and teaching which can help bring out different aspects of the word. Tom’s style is full of wisdom and story telling that ties into scripture beautifully. Sam’s style feels scholastic and bookish in a good way. Students of the word like myself will really enjoy his style. He presents with PowerPoint slides and usually ends with thoughtful questions of reflections to rhetorically digest throughout your upcoming week. Savannah’s preaching style feels like she’s shooting from the hip, again in a good way, I know she is well prepared. She gets on stage and her tone is as if she’s talking to a friend. Matt’s style is a mixture between Tom and Savannah’s and I really enjoy hearing a word from him. Every time I think I have a favorite to hear preach, it quickly changes. I don’t even attempt to compare anymore because they’re all Holy Spirit filled pastors that genuinely love the Lord and present his word and truths in powerful thought provoking messages.

-There are also several Elders that I believe are in a three year cycle. My husband and I really liked that there is so much leadership, we believe it helps to hold one another accountable. I also like that the Elders are cycled. I believe it allows fresh perspective about whatever they deal with on their back end.

-There are also many outreach ministries such as the local college outreach program and Thursday Healing Night of prayer. The church opens their doors once a month on Thursday evenings to the community for whomever needs prayer or for people who want a believer to help them pray for a family or friend. There is live soaking music when you enter the sanctuary and you wait on your number to be called. While you wait, there are in the sanctuary to pray over you. They will come behind you and just put their hands on your should and whisper prayers over you. It’s the most beautiful thing to experience. If you chose a number when you walked in, it will be called and then you’ll transition  to another section of the church to meet a prayer team that will prayer with you or for you. Also, on Sunday service there are a host of prayer teams that come to the front to pray over and with people.

-A husband/wife duo lead the worship team. There are no words to express the song in worship here, but I’ll try: I feel like I’m in heaven before the throne of God glorifying HIM in song and dance with my brothers and sisters.

I hope this note helps someone to make an informed decision when choosing a church to visit and/or lay roots.

See you at Riverstone! Great church! Great folks! Make you feel comfortable. Need a church home Riverstone might be the place for you! I was looking for exactly what I receive Prayer, Worship, Teach the Bible, and Missions to the community and abroad. The small groups really has helped me be more open and my learning curve is a lot more tolerable. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and FULL of the Holy Spirit. As long as you come in with an OPEN HEART to RECEIVE YOU will DEFINITELY get what you pray for. My wife and are from San Diego and a lot of our circles of faith are from the Jesus movement, Awaken the Dawn, and Bethel Church in Redding. Since moving to Atlanta, it’s been hard to find communities that let go. We missed being around communities where generations were together (older, younger, babies). For me, what makes a place desirable is having my elders around me, those who walk in the spirit and walk in wisdom. Riverstone brings us back to our communities on the West Coast and we couldn’t be more grateful to find this place after a lot of searching in Atlanta. Location is excellent + I felt very warm and welcomed + Pastor connects quite well + it was obvious the staff works hard and enjoys  serving and helping people get closer to the  Lord!

name: Riverview Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary: This church is built on God’s words from the Bible.  The pastor explains them in detail, so anyone can comprehend what it is saying and what it means.  The congregation welcomes you with open arms.  we truly look forward to going on Sunday mornings. Wonderful place to attend worship service. Very friendly, makes you feel like your home. Great sermons very knowledgeable pastor. The perfect place to call your church. Very welcoming small church. Enjoyed the service, we will return

name: Riverwood Bible Church - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary:
They preach directly from the Bible and the pastor is super authentic and well learned. We have been at Riverwood for over 2 years now. We were at a much larger church in the area where we got lost and were simply a face in the crowd. At Riverwood, people are friendly and truly are interested in you.
But as great as the atmosphere and people are, that is not what church is all about. Here, the Bible is taught. Not opinion; not self help; not the latest Christian fads.  The Bible, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Love the people there it's where I go to church!! This my home church away from home. It is a wonderful place for fellowship and worshiping the LORD!!!😁 RBC is a solid church where Jesus and His Word are honored and people are loved.

name: Riviera United Methodist Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Riviera United Methodist has been our church home for 28 years. Throughout that time, we have attended weekly services and become very involved in its many vibrant ministries, from worship to fellowship, education, outreach, music and the arts. One of Riviera's amazing programs is the Rejoice in Art! Fine Art Fair and Exhibition, which is presented to the public each October. Riviera also has a long history of excellence in music, with outstanding worship music and free monthly concerts for the community in varying musical styles. The church has been instrumental in the Christian formation of our children, beginning with Baptism and continuing through Sunday school, children's choirs, Vacation Bible School, junior and senior high youth groups and mission trips, and even youth music ensembles. They are now grown, and they still often visit and attend with us. I have no doubt in the future they will look to Riviera United Methodist to help nurture their own children if they still live in the area! Our church is housed in a spacious, beautiful facility overlooking the Pacific Ocean, and it is a wonderful place to visit and feel at home. Our lives have been profoundly impacted by this welcoming church, which truly radiates love, hope and peace. Church waz comfy, plenty of room, great temperature, large parking lot.  The program waz warming, acoustics outstanding,  restroom immaculate 👍 Riviera is a welcoming church with a fantastic music program. My family chose Riviera because the congregation was so open to young families participating in worship. Pastor Amy's sermons make you think but lift you up for the week ahead. I look forward to church every week because of the uplifting service but also because the church is one big family, and everyone is loved and cared for. I became a member of the church on December 2016 after singing in the Chancel Chorus since 2014. I am so blessed to see a church with a warm feeling every time I walk in. The community who frequently attend the church are of open minds, open hearts, and leave open doors for anyone of any race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, etc. The RUMC also promotes music and arts for all ages. Come take a look at the events this church holds! I haven’t been to the church. This review is for the architecture. It’s outstanding. A rare beauty.

The community who frequently attend the church are of open minds, open hearts, and leave open doors for anyone of any race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, etc. The RUMC also promotes music and arts for all ages. Come take a look at the events this church holds! I haven’t been to the church. This review is for the architecture. It’s outstanding. A rare beauty.

name: Robbins Street Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: I always enjoy myself at Robbins Street Christian Church. Love the messages and their choir. Wonderful Church and the Pastor and First Lady are so sweet. Love It I come here every year and it never disappoints Wholesome

name: Robinson Ave Church of Christ - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful family, full of love and grace. Lots of imperfect people, sinners, saved by God's grace and mercy worshipping here, come join us! :) Wonderful, uplifting  spiritual messages. Singing that stirred my soul. I  was warmly welcomed and felt comfortable during the 3 worship services I attended. Will definitely return whenever visiting family in the area. My friend & I went to your clothing giveaway on the 4th....by the time we got inside nothing was left....we saw people leave with 3 or more sacks full of clothing. All I got was an empty trash bag that doesn't even fit my trash can....I was very very disappointed. It wasn't well organized....should of set a limit of how many bags per family....nice church though...loved the big cross...really nice church....i was impressed on that part...... I've always loved this place. When I 1st attended (7 years ago) I met some kind people, and got involved. I moved away for a bit and haven't had the chance to attend church service, but I do attend their celebrate recovery on Thursdays sometimes. We’ve been pretty much lifelong members of the CoC, so when we moved to town that’s pretty much what we were looking for. At the same time, we are relatively “young and hip” and didn’t want to land somewhere that seemed dull and dying, so we did “shop around” some. Long-story-short, we were hesitant to visit this place because it looks from the outside to be rather stuffy, but when we finally did give it a try, we were very pleasantly surprised. The teaching and preaching are, in fact, very “modern” and gracious while adhering to the sort of standards that CoC folks will recognize and appreciate. Also, the elders here are amazingly good and sincere. Really good people. Plus, they have several ministries like Celebrate Recovery and Divorce Care that, to me, show they are really trying to be open-minded and big-hearted and offer resources to those in need.

name: Rock Bible Church - Pleasanton Campus
reviewSummary: Common Sense down to earth serving with compassion and heart Good place to learn about the lord! YEEHAW

name: Rock Bridge Community Church - Dalton Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church. Rock Bridge is absolutely my spiritual refuge and sanctuary. The staff is great and the pastors are admirable mentors and leaders. Very thankful for pastor Matt Evans' teaching ability and how the Holy Spirit uses him to spread the truth of the Gospel. Very welcome and everyone was so loving an most of all was pastor Matt knows the Bible and speaks it very well! I came to rock bridge about e months ago and was very impressed with Matt that it has helped me out a whole lot! Keep up the good work Matt! God bless 🙏! If you are looking for a welcoming and loving place to worship, this is the place! This church has been life changing for my family and I. I feel blessed to have such a loving church family. Pastor Paul has a true gift for preaching. (Spanish worship), he has been there when I've needed it most. 🥰 So welcoming! We had a great first time experience, met extremely kind people, and had such an easy time checking our kids in. The message was biblical and life-giving! I have been attending this church since 2014
Learned so much how to live my life as a Christian....Matt Evans is one of the most God gifted pastors that I have ever listened too....home church for me♥️

name: Rock Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I would say it was very much needed to attend the Rock Church. It almost felt like the first time. I want to thank pastor Miles for sharing the gospel. Loving the way God moves in your life. Sometimes we may not understand why we have to go threw difficulties in life, it's to strengthen us. He will never gives us nothing that we can't handle. He deserves all the glory praise to our heavenly father Miles and co (love the other pastor also in his fly clothing that saw John Legend) I have yet to attend when the message has not spoke directly to my soul. "Refined sugar is that if the devil" couldn't agree more!! Without a vehicle it is hard for me to get there luckily I have PacLife nextdoor but started my journey at the Rock when I lived in Old Town!! Soo much love and appreciation for Miles message and my sister's name is PETRA!!!(; One of the best churches in San Diego, great vibes overall. Sermons preached from the Bible and centered on Jesus. Great team of Pastors and great seating. Church is a bit big so you’ll need to join a life group to really get connected. I wish there were more staff to greet you or help with connecting with the community, didn’t feel like there was a lot of that. Otherwise, highly recommend to visit at least once! First time visitor experience:
- Very loud music. Sitting in the back helped for someone not used to it.
- Love the family children dedications!
- Lots of Padres clothing. Didn't expect so much. Loved it!
- Biblical preaching, but too much humor. Yes, the audience was entertained, but in my opinion, a tad bit more serious approach to the sermon would make it much more powerful and allow for more audience control.
- Seems like a healthy church from first glance. Definitely weak in terms of fellowship (many people came and immediately left), but strong in many other points. Was recommended this church by a good friend. Definitely felt the holt spirit in that building! Thank you for making my wife and I feel home. What an amazing worship and sermon by this organization. Wishing this community nothing but love for the great works you are doing here. Happy trails from Arizona!!

name: Rock Church Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Love this place. Always great messages. The environment is welcoming to all. Everyone is a part of The Rock Church family regardless if you're a member or not. With so many ways to connect with God and keep the relationship growing it's no wonder they have grown so rapidly. Come join and see what's it's like to know God. My first time at this church, my fist time back in a church since the pandemic hit, when I  moved away from Hawaii..and I feel like it’s God’s divine timing. Been looking for a church, and had a niece visited mr from up north and we wanted to go to church, but didn’t know where to go. So we were searching that 3 Sundays ago, and we saw this place and wanted to check it out. Oh let me tell you, it reminded me so much of my church back in Hawaii (New Hope) I love it!! The service,the messages, the staffs, the church ppl, i am home 🏡.. I feel like home at this church and I’m staying now till God says otherwise 🙌🏼🙌🏼🥰. And I can’t wait till Sundays (beside our 1 on 1 daily) time with God to get fed again along side my fellow brothers and sisters in Christ spiritually, Thank you Jesus for finding me a church to plug-in to 🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼. Very welcoming, I attended a Sunday evening service, Worship Leaders were really good, spiritually expressing their love for our Lord Jesus, they sang well & I really felt the emotion they conveyed, the speaker was an excellent stand-in for the regular Pastor. I plan to attend again. very nice staff i cant say good enough things about the staff. great sermons relevant to today.  the words of last sunday were woo and prepare but the sermon did not seem prepared.  the time used to fill in the spaces felt like a morning tv show compared to a church. but i give the staff 5.5 stars Two amazing gentlemen came to pray over me while i was at work. Felt nothing but the Love of Jesus! Definitely looking forward to visiting the church!!

name: Rock Church City Heights - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: The Rock Church office no community help they told me to dial 211 I presented all documentation of a moving lease a move out lease a verification of income my ID my case manager telephone number from the family health centers of San Diego San Diego housing commission my closing is being held back for 3 months now due to closing issues I needed a two-way temporary hotel motel voucher something of that nature they told me to call 211 and here's a hygiene pack can you be on your way the armed receptionist with standoffish look at me like I had two heads or do damage to him or the building or something  there's a police substation in the building they offer no help at all for community people how much for 3 months not even the 2E voucher that can offer me nothing unbelievable miles McPherson it was more a show than any type of church very sad for churches around the world Focus is Jesus!  Bible based, diverse, all are welcome.  Awesome worship 🙌🏼 Impersonal kind of cultish people keep in groups not welcoming. Was kind of last and didn't know how to go about kids getting registered only talk to ppl they know. So not family.bad representation and its not the rick we worship or the area its God. Not very loving welcoming just fake and yhe church will go back to normal day and not touch the bible sadly. Welcoming and congregation really mixed.. and great sermons, friendly. name: Rock Church El Cajon - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: I attended the food drive last week 6/16 and I am very pleased with how organized everything is ran. You get a number according to your arrival; the earlier the closer you are to the line and the sooner you get to leave. I arrived about an hour and a half early but didnt leave until about an hour and a half later than the starting time so do what you will with that information. The food provided was a good selection and I am very greatful for that. I did ask for diapers but they only give out one packet of 25 count. Its still good, I was happy with my diapers but also something to keep in mind if you are driving a long distance specifically for the diapers. Overall it was a good experience and I am very thankful. 🙏💕 Great experience i agree to alot of what the pastors talk about. It's a great church. I took my boyfriend to it when he first got to this state and he doesnt think any bad upon it. It's relaxing and takes away some of my problems when I go and have prayer I came to The Rock Church El Cajon a few years ago when I needed God to meet me again because we were not in the place that we should have been with each other, and He did. The praise and worship are always outstanding and I can praise with everyone there in our own ways and it is fulfilling for me. Pastor Zeb is a very good receptive pastor. I still attend even though I don't live close to there anymore because Pastor Miles McPherson preaches closest to the word of God and what's going on in these end times that I know of. I don't always agree with how the word is being preached by other pastors of the church, but I believe that's just because I have surpassed the information that is being preached on. I have joined a women's Community because I learned that we are not supposed to do this walk alone and it has been really good for me, and I have met some amazing women. I believe it is necessary to grow even more in Christ and to be able to witness more in Christ. I visited this church at a 10 am service. I was greeted by no one. I introduced myself as a visitor at the visitor's booth. It was pretty much a help yourself situation. I wasn't even greeted by the greeters. Found my way into the sanctuary, but decided it wasn't a good sign. As I left, one friendly man wished me a good day I miss coming to the Rock, I haven't been back since covid. I look forward to coming back to church

name: Rock Church Fargo North Dakota
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been members at the Rock Church for almost ten years and we love this church. The church makes every effort to welcome new people.
At the Rock Church we believe in doing church a bit differently. The service is about an hour long and the pastors are great! We love to laugh and have fun but Rock Church is a Bible believing Gospel based church and we take the Great Commission seriously. God has put the things of eternal value in our hearts. Rock Church is the church for everyone. I feel like family there. Everyone is so friendly. The coffee is great, they have doughnuts that are HUGH, and also fresh made popcorn.  Come check it out. Also first time visitors get a free movie ticket.  :) Lots of fun with the Kruz family! They speak our language so we can understand the message better. Love the music that's very upbeat and drawn to your heart! It is also listed as an Evangelical Free Church if that helps. Great services! And they treat you like family! Thanks Church Family This place truly is rocking! Not just with some of the songs. Also, the overall feel of the place is so welcoming to everyone from all walks of life. Don't expect to see a lot of suits, ties, and dresses here. Come as you are. They do have Sunday school for kids. Thank You 😊

You made our first Church experience as a married couple beautiful.

The easy-to-follow message, friendly members, and environment made this 10/10.

name: Rock Church Oahu
reviewSummary:
This is an extension of Rock Church San Diego (Pastor Miles McPherson).

Led by Pastor Mark Richardson, Rock Church Oahu is a growing church that welcomes you with open arms. They teach the gospel and ways you can help strength your relationship with Jesus. Beautiful experience today at Rock Church. The pastor and volunteers are phenomenal and they made me feel right at home. Cast ALL your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you (Psalm 55;22). Thank you Jesus. Was in Oahu for vacation with my sister and we were warmly greeted with a hug, hand shake, and smiles all around. I love how they made us feel at home right away, without being too much.

After service we were walking out and they gave us a candy Lei! It’s the little extras of hospitality that make us want to come back for more. Next time I’m in Oahu, I know where I’m going again! The church is located in a cool spot. The walls outside are amazingly painted with various local artists. The people seem to be warm and welcoming. The message from the pastor is really good. You have to come check it out for yourself. My sister and neice brought me to my first service as soon as I got on island. Everyone is so genuinely kind and welcoming! This is a place that truly cares for it's members and community!

name: Rock Church San Marcos - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church. Good positive people. Great church family. Family friendly. Awesome worship music. Highly Recommended. Wonderful live worship, friendly people, and great messages weekly from Miles McPherson (streamed live from main Point Loma campus).  There is a campus pastor at each service to tie it all together. Also, there are 4 different service times to choose from on Sunday. You can find Healing , family support and receive the word of GOD and grow in so many ways with GOD.
Awesome worship!
Loving crowd! Genuine pastors and staff. I love Rock Church!! It's so warm and welcoming!! We could be used as the example of how people FROM EVERY NATION, every race and ethnicity, come together in fellowship and love. WE ARE THE WORLD! My first time attending. I did not stand up or anything. I really appreciated the message. The pastor was really good and I wanted to thank him. I enjoyed the service and music when normally I’m wishing the music would end. I liked they don’t do the donation thing During the service. I’m looking forward to connecting and returning with this wonderful group of people.
