name: Sacred City Church
reviewSummary:
We had such a wonderful experience at Sacred City Church. From the moment we walked in,  we felt genuinely welcomed. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and it was clear that this is a community that truly cares about people.

The worship was heartfelt and the music was wonderful. The message was both encouraging and grounded in Scripture, offering practical insight that we could apply to our daily lives. We especially appreciated how authentic and relatable everything felt.

What stood out most to us was the sense of community. People were friendly, approachable, and intentional about making newcomers feel included. It didn’t feel like just attending a service it felt like being part of something meaningful.

We will definitely be back. I have been very blessed to find this community here in down town Providence while I go to school at Johnson and Wales University. They really care about having a strong community and have done so much for me. They have very Bible centered messages and the worship is always powerfully deep and encouraging. I would highly recommend coming for a visit. A wonderful gospel preaching, bible believing church in Providence!  Sacred City Church is one of the most loving, welcoming community's I have ever had the pleasure of being a part of. The church seeks to honor and glorify God in everything they do! When I first moved to Providence, I didn't know a single person in the city. I started attending Sacred City Church in January 2025, and from the moment I walked through the doors, I was welcomed in and truly felt like I belonged. The people here are genuinely kind, intentional, and eager to know you.

One of the things I love most about this church is that the preaching and services are accessible to everyone, whether you've been walking with Christ for decades, you're a brand-new believer, or you're simply curious about Christianity and looking for answers. The gospel is preached faithfully, and there's a clear passion for God's Word.

Sacred City Church also places a huge emphasis on community. It's incredibly easy to get connected through community groups and serving opportunities, and you'll quickly find yourself surrounded by people who genuinely care for one another and want to help each other grow in their faith.

If you're looking for a church in Providence that is rooted in Scripture, passionate about Jesus, and committed to building authentic community, I can't recommend Sacred City Church enough. It has truly become family to me, and I'm so grateful that the Lord led me here! This church is full of God-loving and kind people. They welcomed me into their community while I was in undergrad. Their services were simple yet powerful. The sermons spoke to many challenges I faced as a young adult, and Pastor Van Sickle was always willing to answer questions and offer advice. Apart from their services, their weekly events helped forge community. I met several young adults that marked my life for the better. I thank God for this church in Providence.

name: Sacred Heart Catholic Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: The church is huge and beautiful. We enjoy going to the 7:30 pm mass. This is the last mass on Sundays. There are food vendors in front of the church before mass. There is plenty of parking behind the religious education center. The homilies are great, understandable and clear, to the point and the truth. The priests are friendly and open to conversation after the mass. Nice, quiet church. Not too many parishioners when I attended the Saturday evening mass there. Pastor was quite friendly and the preaching was very good. Will definitely go back there for another mass when I'm in the area. Elias is horrible. The classes my children attended are badly taught and keeping all the kids together instead of separating them. This has been horrible ever since father Albert left honestly Elias has really let everything fell. Priest turned my uncle away from confession because he was unwed. Never in my life have I heard that a man cannot receive forgiveness from god simply because he isn’t married. Shame on this church for turning a religious man away from god. Called cops on a peace walk? Hello?? A pastor named Father Manual Sanchez Sa a person at the church. Filthy.

name: Sacred Heart Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: A warm and inviting historic Parish that understands the importance of connecting the Gospel to the community.  The structure is beautiful with some of the most impressive and detailed stained glass you will find in a local church. The people are rooted in their faith and neighborhood which lifts the spirit and soothes the soul. A holy day for Judith and Jesus at this beautiful catholic church. Do not host your 15era here ..  They charge $600, (200 more than the church we were looking at) ....we chose this place because flowers were part of the "package " The flowers were horrible and were recycled through out the day. The father tends to scol you about not going to church. Save your money and go to another church that charges less for such special occasions. name: Sacred Heart Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I love everything about this church! I've attended for several years and got married here. The people are so welcoming and I love Fr. Gilbert! This is the first church that has felt like home in the LA area for me. The building is beautiful! Truly a shining light in Altadena after the fires. Beautiful Church from the outside, didn’t get a chance to go inside to pray this visit. Paster Gilbert Guzman is so inspirational, and caters to both Spanish speaking and English speaking parishioners, easily transitioning from one language to the other during his homily. We all feel included by him. He is so animated and really brings God and Jesus into his examples of his experiences in life. Going to Sacred Heart Church feels like we have finally found our religious home. I think of Sacred Heart as my home church. Last time I checked, they had Masses in four different languages for the benefit of their diverse congregation. Fr. Gilbert Guzman is a lively and kind pastor. There's usually food for sale outside after Sunday Mass. I really like the tacos. Beautiful small church i grew up in , just wish the staff there was friendly and helpful like it used to be.

Sorry, but i dont wish to disclose my reasons to the whole church.

Clergy is welcoming as well as the congregation.  Just make sure to show up early for good parking and seats.

name: Sacred Heart Church - Ocean Beach - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I attended mass at Sacred Heart Catholic Church on a Sunday morning. The church was not packed with people, the atmosphere was very welcoming. The mass was celebrated in English, and the priest gave a very inspiring homily. I was impressed by the beauty of the church and the warmth of the parish community. I would definitely recommend attending mass at this Church if you are near Ocean Beach and looking for a beautiful and welcoming church to worship in. Attended a close friends memorial service here, The experience was as good as it could be considering the circumstances. There’s a great little meditation garden specifically dedicated to passed loved ones in the back of the courtyard between the church and the gathering hall. Observed the church providing free food to hundreds in the community with looks ofjoy on their faces. Truly lovely to know that kindness thrives in such a cruel world. Hours posted out front, daily mass, fantastic community dinner on alternating Tuesdays, and a sturdy frame for prayer and meditation. I love this church. Fr. Billy is excellent, loves sports, and believes the people in the seats are the church. He does not stand behind a podium and reads a homily at you. Instead, he comes down to the congregation and talks to us and with us. He is what the church needs more of.

name: Sacred Heart Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful Church, we loved our first visit and are happy to experience mass here.  This church has a great choir and nice projectors to follow along with the order, prayers, and hymns of the mass.  Father here is very warm and kind, we look forward to returning one day in the future as we are visitors from Ventura County.

name: Saddleback Church
reviewSummary: The 'Purpose Driven' flagship. Reviews highlight the extremely welcoming culture for new believers and the 'Practical' nature of the teaching (currently Andy Wood). 'Celebrate Recovery' is a major draw. While the campus is massive, the small group system is frequently cited as the way to actually connect.

name: Saddleback Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a large but oh so welcoming church. We drive over and hour to go. The grounds are so lovely also. Facilities are very clean. Wonderful place to worship. Great church to be at.  Pastor Andi teaches biblical truths. One of the reasons I am coming to this church is because the church is not obsessed with escology which other church's gets concentrated supporting the state of Israel not  the biblical Israel which is the church. I like the volunteers there which makes it more welcoming. Coffee and tea before and after church shows that the church is welcoming people.  The activities for the kids after the service are great way to make it fun for the kids plus also their classes  are great . The game rooms are good after the kid's classes are over. I will keep coming to this church until I see that this church will become non biblical which I don't think this is the case. Ten years of wandering into churches across the country, from tiny wooden chapels to mega-congregations, and nothing’s hit me like Saddleback Church in Lake Forest. Seriously, stepping onto this campus feels like walking into hope itself-fifty acres of palm trees, open spaces, and this warm glow that just wraps around you. The main worship center’s massive but not intimidating; it’s like a big family gathering spot where everyone fits, voices blending in worship that lifts your soul right off the ground. And the vibe? Pure joy. No stuffiness, no judgment-just real people chasing real faith. My kid’s been going to their little school programs here, and honestly, it’s magic for him. He bounces out every week happier, talking about Jesus in a way that’s excited, not forced-like he’s found his own adventure. The middle and high school spots are killer too, full of energy without the chaos. Location-wise, it’s perfection: tucked in Lake Forest but feels like a retreat, easy to get to off the 5, with that California sunshine streaming in. If you’re looking for a place where faith feels alive, where kids thrive, and your heart gets fuller every Sunday-get here. Saddleback’s changed everything for us. Can’t wait to see you there. Since day 1 we felt at home.
The amazing staff with a big smile welcomed our family, the delicious cold
Coffee, the donuts, the beautiful welcome gift (saddleback mug) and the love of Christ that we have felt and seen first hand by our Saddleback family is beyond belief.
Saddleback has done so much for our family.
We love the campus, so beautiful, clean, family/pet friendly and Pastor Andy is always on point.
We love it here and definitely recommend Saddleback church to everyone. Love this church! So welcoming and their messages always move me. The music is amazing and you really feel good being here. You leave feeling different, moved by the messages and feeling welcomed. I love the diversity of the church and how they offer so many opportunities to get involved and be apart of the church.

name: Saddleback Church Anaheim - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I came to Saddleback Church 10 years ago severely broken and found a loving community of followers of Christ who love us and don't judge. My wife recently passed away and my Saddleback family stepped in and has filled a void in my soul with so much love that it is truly hard to explain. In fact while my wife was in final stages of hospice so many saddleback loved ones visited her hospice board and care that their love for me and my wife had an amazing effect on the hospice owner.

This love shown by my Saddleback family also began to fill a deep dark hole of sorrow that she had.

Over 10 years our serving involvement has lead to as many as 250 loving souls that I know and love.

My wife's Celebration of Life included almost 150 loved one's from Saddleback Anaheim Church.

Saddleback Church offers the Grace of Jesus and the fellowship in Christ. The most happiest people on earth. Full of Divine peace and presence. God’s hand is on this church! Pastor Andy Wood’s sermons are very relatable, personal, and biblically accurate. It’s not about self care or self help but more about how to trust God. The worship musics hype! And the Fall/ Christmas decorations are great! No Halloween celebrations here but they did trick or treating with kid friendly non scary costumes. Christmas is the best here! All of the volunteers pull their hearts out on Christmas. The children ministry/ nursery is great! The volunteers are amazing. They have a nursing room tucked away in the corner of the church building, for infants and moms with changing table, crib, nursing chair…and a Tv livestream to the service so you can worship with your baby, you just need to ask! Fantastic church with weekly biblical sermons.  We have strong Children services and Jr and High school services.  If you are looking for building solid foundation for you and your family.  This could be your home church. This place makes me feel safe and at peace , the people who work here are so friendly, kind and loving  they offer different classes like AA programs for free! people who work and volunteer here seem so genuine and caring they offer free coffee for every service,  they have child care for all ages so u can attend church  they have programs and classes for teens and young adults

name: Saddleback Church Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Are you looking for a church you can belong to?

Saddleback Brea is built on a foundation of love…love for Jesus, community, service, discipleship and evangelism.

I started going to Saddleback Brea about a year ago and it has made my life so much better. I was struck by how warm and friendly the people were. They really do care! And, I have been here ever since.

We are a church that supports each other and has the biggest heart for service, not only on Sundays but with our different ministries and community outreach.

But, most of all, we have fun together!

If you’ve haven’t found a church to plug in and get connected to community, then Saddleback Brea may just be the place for you. I love this church so much! I started coming to Saddleback about 8 or 9 years ago. Rick Warren‘s preaching just really grabbed my attention. He just has a way about him that encouraged me to go to church again and again. Even though I’m sad that he’s not our senior pastor anymore, I really like Andy and look forward to his teachings.

Saddleback Brea church has really made my husband and I super welcome. When I first came here, my husband and I were just dating and once we thought of marriage, I wanted to connect with a pastor who could do pre-marital counseling. That’s how we met Pastor AJ! From the moment we met him and until now, Pastor AJ has such a warm heart that is so genuinely loving. This same energy makes us want to continue going because we feel the love this church brings and we want to be a part of that. Not only Pastor AJ, but the staff, community, and church family as a whole has been just so welcoming, sweet, and judge free. Everyone is so friendly and they have classes that you can take to become an official member of Saddleback church that includes lunch :) They always have little goodies or food after church service which makes a good opportunity to get the church family connected and make new friendships/relationships. It’s really nice and I wouldn’t even think to go anywhere else! Saddleback Yorba Linda is unlike most established churches where you attend but don't necessarily feel like you belong.  Having church hopped much of my life the congregation here feels warm and welcoming and the Pastor takes a genuine interest in you as an individual.  Its fun with food and laughter after services and always a great message during services without feeling over the top.   It's a great way to be part of the community with out all the big church politics.... Come check it out. We’ve been members at Saddleback Brea for almost five years. This is a place where you can make friends, find groups to serve with and study with, and bring your kids! Love the worship music and the people🫶🏻 Easy and friendly people. Nice location and setting for service. People are warm and open to talking with you. Best way to get plugged is to join a small group for closer relationships. Diverse in age and background. Wife and I, been here for four years. Love wearing shorts to church.

name: Saddleback Church Corona - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I use to love going to this church but this past year I have been through it. I am grateful my Bible study group originally came through with a gift to help me out and still to this day I am appreciative but as the year progressed my life continued to fall apart out of my control and it was sad to see no one really checked in. Or stopped by to offer any help or food when I was unemployed. Or when I was moving out the other day which is a sad story in itself though I had one friend offer it was too late I ran out of time I ended up struggling on my own. Now I am not perfect by any means and no longer even call myself Christian but from my understanding I thought it meant showing up when it really matters. I know religion is separate from God but this is how people feel God. I do a better job than most Christians I’ve ever come across. My job helped me move out and none of them are Christians. Again I love a lot of you there and I know people do their best but the fundamental stuff that matters the most has failed time and time again and so as much as I loved and was connected here I never truly felt supported when it mattered the most. During the death of my brother, my job loss, my home, my surgery. If you show up without pushing God you might be able to reach more people. I have been going to Saddleback Church Lake Forest oft and on for 30 years. I now live in Riverside and decided to really dedicate my life to my Lord Jesus my savior and these people open their arms and open their hearts to me immediately I am already in a small group and I love this place Please come join us you will love it the music is amazing!

Rock on Saddleback Church Eastvale!

G God’s hand is really on this church. Love saddleback kids just what I was looking for. They are very attentive and actually teach the children. Bible led church, was a bit nervous but they are inviting and make you feel at home. The people here are awesome and they truly do make you feel at home. They don't just give you a friendly greeting and go on their merry way, but they reach out without being pushy. Their teachings are from the Bible and their are a number of different ministries to get involved in.
Pastor Aaron is approachable and is out there mingling with everyone after service, which is something not  always done in a larger church for various reasons. It is growing, but not too large where you get lost amongst the other faces. I've attended another quite popular church for several years now and have been coming to Saddleback for about a month. My heart is torn, but I just might make this my home church.
The children are attended to, as well with their own classes to attend at their own level. There are various functions throughout the year for them to attend. I truly get blessed when the high schoolers lead worship once a month in the main sanctuary. You can see they have a heart after God !
Blessings... Wonderful campus with amazingly welcoming staff. They have worship for kids of all ages. They also provide note sheets, coffee, donuts, and a very peaceful environment. We have found our home for worship!

name: Saddleback Church Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Really amazing church! I’ve met so many great people here. We are local and used to drive to Lake Forest campus, so nice to have a local campus closer by. Plus it’s great to be part of a smaller community than the giant main church. So many resources and they do so many great things in the community! Definitely recommend checking it out!! Have yet to experience Saddleback church, was door dashing in the area running a delivery when I had a chance to take a quick photo. God willing I'll come visit soon 🙏🏻 This church is a loving, warm, fun and involved!
This is us on a Woman’s Prayer Walk. This is my favorite church. They don't shout at you 😂 they don't preach that much to you 🙃 but you still come out wiser and with greater love for the world. I am not a big church visitor so I come just from time to time, but I always like to go to Saddleback. I've been in Berlin several times and it's as good as here. Thank you so much for such good job! 💕 No prayer before or after worship.  The music was slick &  "professional" , lively but devoid of
heart. The church as entertainment. There was lots if promotion of programs & books. The message was very interesting, but more in the manner of a self help lecture. And not much about God. The preaching was a remote feed from somewhere else. Rick Warren ended with a prayer something along the lines of "God you've told us what to do, now help us do it." No alter call or message about how to be saved. Is Rick Warren now teaching a message of salvation by works? The people were friendly in a disinterested way, typical of Californians.(I grew up here so I know)
It was not a very inspiring experience

name: Saddleback Church San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary:
By came from L.A.
Thankfully that Saddleback a church is located in SD County. Pastor Rick Warren is the head pastor based out of Lake Forest, CA in Orange county. There are 20 campuses in southern California and internationally. This is a satellite campus that projects the message on a screen. There is a local campus pastor who welcomes, prays, and gives guidance at the end of each sermon. The worship team is live and unique to each campus. This is the only location in San Diego so far, and has about 400 people each week. Services are 9am and 11am every Sunday. Great for all walks of life. They have children's care and student ministries for the teens. They provide TV screen outside with seating for those who choose to participate there instead of inside. There is usually something fun and extra after the service like kettle corn, bounce house, baptisms, and anything else to encourage people to hang out and fellowship. They encourage everyone to get involved in a small group so that as the church grows bigger, everyone can stay intimately connected. I had come here for the past 1.5 years and, it’s better than nothing.  If you’re not finding what you want at this location for praise, worship and education about God, Christ and the Holy Spirit and how to apply such knowledge to your life …. within walking distance of this location is a Grace Point Church that is an authentic spot and a different option for you at:

13340 Hayford Way, just down the street.
🙏🏻❤️ I was in San Diego on vacation and looked forward to experiencing Saddleback Church.  Warm people, talented worship leaders, a welcome environment for you to experience God and worship him without obstacles.

It was easy to find a parking place, great signage and direction from the parking lot crew.
“Welcome Back” statements by several people when walking in was a little strange, as I was a new visitor, but maybe I look like someone who’s been there before.  *shrug*

It appears that the church is new and growing (or maybe it’s a summer vacancy) as there were quite a few empty seats.

Welcome team was genuine and not invasive.

A lot of the message today was, “You can’t allow your feelings to…”.  Best two moments were scriptures read from Malachi about God hating divorce but not divorcees.  And experiencing God’s forgiveness as a means of forgiving others.

There is freedom in admitting that we fall short, that we don’t have it all together, and that God is forgiving us daily.  Book-study message today communicated forgiving the faults of others, which is hard to do when we don’t soak in God’s grace over our own shortcomings.

Thanks, Church, for providing me a place to worship and experience the presence of God today.

Warmly,
Ryan We became familiar with Saddleback after attending a Celebrate Recovery Summit at their main Lake Forest campus years ago. We love everything about Saddleback, their love, and focus on serving God and the community. The sermons are always SOO instructional and inspirational. And we always meet someone who genuinely seems to care (this time it was Joseph, his son Grant and two young visiting Asian women who were there for the 1st time and delighted us by asking LOTS of questions.)

name: Saddleback Church San Juan Capistrano - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful property and church experience. Very friendly and welcoming. Lots of parking and service times. And they always have coffee and donuts, excellent Sunday school and child care for the littlest. Lots of sweet events for holidays etc. What a wonderful place. The people working here are so kind and friendly. The facility was phenomenal for our meeting of about 150. The rooms are very comfortable. I was there for meetings during two days. It is a very nice casual place. It is a good place to walk and talk. I am going every Sunday and my life is changed. Love this church very good massage and great environment . Beautiful huge campus!
Amazing wildlife and views.
Lake with ducks too.
Lots of parking.

name: Saddleback Church South Bay - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Excited to announce that the Bay Church will join the family of Saddleback Church. Becoming Saddleback South Bay. Lomita campus. Will start painting and clean up December 1st. Hope to have first service as Saddleback South Bay Church beginning of January. #Saddlebackchurchsouthbay Amazing loving Pastor's and Christ loving Church family. Come visit soon to hear encouraging messages from the bible:) Beautiful prayer team, worship and kids of all ages will love it! Come and visit on Sunday.  You will find a group of people who are welcoming, and loving.  You will be encouraged to grow in your faith.  If you have kids, the kiddos will be cared for by awesome people - while you attend service.  The campus pastor has a phrase, "We are not about religion, but relationship" - You will see this lived out here. I have been attending Saddleback for several years and this church is so welcoming and fun. We are all about relationships and helping each other through this journey of faith a very welcoming environment. Such a great church! Everyone is so welcoming and I feel safe when I am around the campus. Saddleback Church is a big church but you can know others and be known in this campus. Pastors and staff are all very caring. I don’t have kids, but kids around the church are all smiling so I know they are having good times too. Highly recommend this church.

name: Saddleback Covenant Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Love this community of people!  Strong, vibrant, and caring group of faithful followers of Jesus that strive to live out His character in everyday life. Honestly, the best church community I have ever been apart of. SCC is the best place in Orange County to worship and fellowship!

name: Saguaro Canyon Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: Very personable Pastors, beautiful campus, and park that is open 24x7 to the public. Great music, solid Bible based teaching. Pastors are kind, knowledgeable, and approachable. Small, family atmospheric church, friendly fellow parishioners. Started coming in July of 2023 and quickly became a member, My daughter was baptized here and goes to the youth group. What I really liked about this Church is that everything is actually Bible-centric. The preacher is a level headed man that has a good sense of humor and is easy to talk to. I happened to visit this church when Revelation was being studied, word for word. It was very interesting to hear it read out loud, viewable on a large screen, and discussed openly in a Q&A session. So far this is the best church I've been to in Tucson. they're welcoming and very helpful people here they, don't judge you on appearances! they also have the greatest Sunday school for kids and a great Nursery. the pastor he is amazing and very kind he wants to help with everything he can as long as you are willing to put in the effort as well. I was very disappointed with this church. During my initial visits, it appeared promising. But then the pastor delivered a sermon on ‘woke’ culture and how it is un-Christian, I changed my mind. I prefer a church that follows Jesus’ teachings, is less political and more embracing of a diverse array of people..

name: Saguaro Christian Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a wonderful blessing this morning. A lovely message and a very friendly and kind congregation. I needed this great medicine today and I will absolutely be returning. Thank you for welcoming me. A wonderful home where all are truly welcome. As a lesbian couple we have not felt welcome in some churches, but we have felt totally welcomed into the fold here, loved as Jesus taught us to love all. Here at Saguaro Christian Church, Jesus' teachings are truly lived out, both in word and in action. I am continually struck by the love and grace of this community, and the focus on service for the greater community.
The ministers are outstanding. The best I've ever experienced, after being in a number of churches over many years. They love and engage with their congregants, and care deeply. They share Gods love and truth in a gentle and graceful way. They are creative in their focus on caring for and serving the community. We are home here. I always enjoy visits to Saguaro Christian Church. The congregation and staff are so warm and inviting to all. Messages are always so timely and meaningful as well. I am very impressed with the SICP daycare/pre school. It is very well maintained. The classrooms are stimulating to the learning process. All three of my grandchildren have attended the school and all were very well prepared for Kindergarten and beyond both cognitively and socially. Saguaro Christian Church really walks the talk of Jesus' message to love your neighbor as yourself and as an Open And Affirming Community mean it when they say "ALL Are Welcome Here". They actively reach out to each other, to newcomers, to the community as well as the world at large. A beautiful example of 'the hands and feet of Christ ' in action. It's great to have found a church to call home!! I have visited SCC on many occasions. Each time I have found the staff and congregation very warm and welcoming.  The ministerial staff is excellent and offers inspiring messages while sharing the love of God. I have also noticed that SCC has a number of ministries such as the food bank, the backpack ministry, the mental health support group along with numerous others. One of their most important ministries is the SICP daycare/pre school program where dedicated teachers work diligently to prepare the children for their future years of education.

name: Sailors Union Grace Church
reviewSummary:
I've been a few times and really like this church. Every sermon has been incredibly biblical with lots of verse references throughout and correctly interpreted. I don't feel like they have any agenda besides they love Jesus and want more people to know him. Pastor and guest pastors have been really good. They also include some hymns into their worship which is really nice. People have been inclusive and the age variance has a nice spread. Just leaving a review because I know how hard it is to find a new church and want people to have non bias reviews to read! Sailors Union Grace Church feels like home, and I know God placed me here. The community is genuine, and the pastor teaches solid, biblical truth that challenges and encourages me. I’m so grateful for this Christ-centered church! We have been attending SUGC for a few years now and have loved every moment. Pastor Justin’s messages are easy to understand and always leave us encouraged. Even if you’ve never been to church before, this is a great place to start. Smaller crowd, friendly people, beautiful music, powerful messages. EVERYONE is welcome and the church members go out of their way to make you feel so. Come join us! Absolutely incredible church in beautiful Federal Hill. Pastor Justin’s sermons are amazing and filled with the saving grace of the teachings of Jesus. The live music here is the best I have heard from any church, and everyone is so welcoming. Sailors Union Grace Church. I can’t express how amazing it has been to be apart of this church and to see so many new faces and new friendships create are created in this ministry. The Outreach team is incredible, how dedicated they are to love and share the gospel with our fellow neighbors. The amazing Worship Team that’s there and the amazing messages from Pastor Justin Schaller. Always on my heart and having an expectation from what God’s going to do this year.

If you’re looking for a church, we would

reviewSummary: MY MOST FAVORTIE FOOD PANTRY Super nice people, but the food is mostly food you must cook so if you’re unable to cook I’d recommend a different food bank Friendly, caring staff.  Provides basic foods to help those in need. Perhaps the most beautiful church in Southern California Donation for church helps the poor

name: Saint Andrew Catholic Church - Newtown Township Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church. Great congregation. Helpful people. Beautiful building inside and out with outstanding Leadership team. Mass was nicely paced and didn't feel rushed. Fellow churchgoers were very warm and friendly as well, an excellent sense of friendship. Also they have tons of events and activities throughout the year. Despite its size, St Andrew is the most welcoming and inclusive community with  joyous celebration of mass and spectacular music. Priests are all excellent orators and very actively involved in getting to know the parishioners and attending school, CYO sports and scouts activities. We love how family oriented St Andrew is—Monsignor actively encourages children in the church despite the cry room availability. There is also a weekly children’s liturgy. It is a very active church with a great variety of volunteer opportunities to be involved in lay ministry. The church is always beautifully decorated and clean. St Andrew is a prayerful, generous and supportive community. This is a beautiful, generous and welcoming church. Well run and has many ministries  to join and participate in parish life. It is a big parish so it can be overwhelming at first. Feel blessed to be here. St. Andrew's is a wonderful catholic parish to be a part of. Even though it is quite large it doesn't feel that way. Even after I moved out of my parents house and technically don't live in St. Andrew's, I still meet them for church early Sunday mornings. I love the community feel it has and we all know each other so it doesn't feel like a big parish, it feels cozy. Plus they always have it looking so wonderful with their decorations especially at Christmas.

name: Saint Andrew Christian Church - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary:
A "church music" friend and I attended an absolutely wonderful organ concert earlier today [4-13-2019] at St. Andrew Christian Church. This one-hour-long concert had been performed by 20-year old organist Richard Gregory, who has been the organist of that church since age 17.

My friend and I arrived at the church about twenty minutes early because our travel there from downtown Columbus had been far faster than expected.

I had been somewhat confused when first entering the church's parking lot because the building -- a cluster of similar one-story gable-roofed buildings connected by hallways -- looks more like a condominium or a retirement community than it looks like a church.

However, Google Maps had convinced both me and my "church music" friend that we had been in the correct parking lot so we decided to look for the main entrance.

When we entered the front door of the building, I had been able to see the familiar "Christian Church (Disciples of Christ)" logo carved into the glass of that door and thereby confirmed that we were indeed in the correct location for what turned out to be an extremely-high-quality organ concert. Great church, very good people and they support the local neighborhood amazingly. A most wonderful friendly church family. Come join the community. A very open and friendly church.  They include everyone and all are welcome to worship here. Great vision and desire for one united church

name: Saint Andrews Church of Oxford - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary: Friendliest people in town. Welcoming to all. Inspiring message Warm and inviting people. Love that they support the local scouts. Very friendly & active church. I really love it. Good NA meetings

I had the pleasure of being part of my couples wedding in this church. The way the sun hit them during their ceremony was just beautiful. The whole look of this church is absolutely beautiful. I have lived in Brea for only 20 years of my 80.

name: Saint Anne Catholic Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: This is my favorite church in Orange County. The building has stained glass windows with beautiful holy images.The sermons from the priests and deacons are positive and inspirational. The music service in English and Spanish is amazing. The singers have beautiful voices and the people who play the instruments are very devoted and talented. Sometimes they have mariachi for special occasions and that just makes the Mass even more spectacular. If you're lucky you may even experience a few miracles here. During the Mass of the Virgen Mary on December 12, there was a mystical scent of fresh roses at the beginning of Mass. During the Christmas Mass on December 25,there was a bright ray of sunshine coming through the window and shining onto the alter. When you walk out of Mass you feel so much peace and calmness from the grace of God. I absolutely love this Church. This parish has been my home for many years. The community is friendly and the staff in the adult faith formation (Efrain and Silvia) are very good at their job. They guide and help so well. I love this church. I feel really close to God when I go in there. I feel his presence. 🙏 This church has a great environment the lighting is not that great for photography and they don't allow Flash when you're having events like a baptism quinceaneras or weddings I've also seen that they have a lot of funeral services this Catholic Church also provides classes for catechism I've also been here to take classes on how to be a Godfather so you can get certified and be a Godfather in this church or any other Catholic Church affiliated once I took a class here so I could be a Godfather in a church in Mexico I have had nothing but good experiences in this church. It is such a shame that parishioners are so openly racist. As a Vietnamese woman myself, I am so embarrassed

name: Saint Anne Church & Shrine - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: I love the many different times they offer services, both in English and Spanish, and the different special celebrations frequently taking place. A very close-to-heart kind of place, very peaceful. The Shrine is an amazing place to meditate and pray. I already gave a rave review of this church under my other Google email. It’s a nice church I haven’t had a chance to get there in awhile, as I Lyft/Uber everywhere. The pastor had great sermons. Outside Grotto to  Our Lady is very beautiful.. I attend the morning mass at 10 am for the first time. I was very delighted Excellent service priest was awesome very kind and marvelous sermon. I want to keep on going to this service. I enjoy the homolies and messages behind  every mass that I attend and the community members are very kind and friendly

name: Saint Anne's Church - Village of Garden City Campus
reviewSummary:
Family parish is filled with love & faith.  Beautiful service ❤ performed as we say good bye to a family member.
RIP Ian Suskevich 🙏 I have been going to this church for 25 years. We have the best church choir and I actually remember Tim and Gloria singing and getting ready for communion back in 2001. The music is so wonderful and I love the social events and for 25 years I have met the best friends here. I could not find a better church. Beautiful place and I was happy to find warmth people who welcomed us while our stay in LI. A special thank you for the ladies who pray the rosary on weekdays after 9am mass. We have a praying group in our church in Brazil and we were happy to find this community here on Long Island. Nice large church with great stane glass windows. Many mass times to choose from for Sunday Mass and a very accessible friendly church. It's a beautiful church and well kept. The staine glass windows make a place to visit and see.
God house is good house

name: Saint Barbara Catholic Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
It is really upsetting to see someone who works at a church treating people with disrespect, especially by yelling at them. A church is supposed to be a place where people feel welcomed, safe, and supported, not judged or intimidated. When a staff member raises their voice or speaks harshly, it creates an uncomfortable and even hostile environment, which goes completely against the values that a church is meant to represent, kindness, patience, and compassion. People come to church for peace, guidance, and sometimes during difficult moments in their lives, so being yelled at can be discouraging and hurtful. It reflects poorly not only on that individual but also on the entire community. Those in positions of responsibility should set an example of respect and understanding, and it’s disappointing when they fail to do so. This place is honestly a disgrace to what a church is supposed to represent. Instead of kindness, you’re met with arrogance and disrespect. The way people are treated here completely contradicts any message of compassion or humility. It’s disturbing to see a space that claims moral authority act with such hostility and lack of basic decency. If this is how they treat others, then they seriously need to question what they actually stand for. It was my first visit to this Catholic Church. It was nice and there was ample parking. I got there a little after the 9am Mass and was able to find time to sit and pray. I would go again. Its parishioners were so friendly. My mother-in-law's Vietnamese funeral service was superbly done. I am Irish and was not familiar with the full traditional funeral ceremony. I also don't understand Vietnamese. The choir is very good and moved me without knowing the words. For me, it was the most healing funeral I've ever participated in

The church is beautiful inside and out. School on the property. Seems very involved with the Santa Ana area community The church offers several masses on Saturday for Sunday masses. And more masses for Sunday. Some masses are tailored for the Vietnamese community.

name: Saint Brides Celtic Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I’m seeing reviews here denouncing this church as “illegitimate.” Well, illegitimate according to whom? The Church makes no claims to Roman Catholicism, and one quick read of the church’s name makes that clear. So what exactly is the problem? Many religious groups follow the Catholic tradition. Do you walk into an Orthodox or Anglican Church and review negatively for their lack of communion with Rome? Well, you shouldn’t; that’s silly. They have a different history within Catholicism than the Roman church. Rather, it seems that some Roman Catholics are getting confused about what this church is and seek to punish it for their own lack of due diligence. That seems to reflect more poorly on the Roman Catholic than this community. Not a legitimate Catholic Church approved by the diocese of San Bernardino. Don't attend this if you take your Catholic faith seriously. If your catholic do not attend. Their are lots of Catholic churches in the area.

name: Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church and Academy - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In my quest to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego county, I recently attended a Sunday Mass at Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church in San Diego. The 10 AM service was well-attended but not crowded, and the atmosphere was welcoming and inviting. The Mass was celebrated in English, and the priest gave an inspiring homily. I was impressed by the cool vibe of the community, and I would definitely recommend attending Mass at this church if you are near Liberty Station and looking for a lovely and welcoming place to worship. Bad experience with Nextdoor. They suspended me for showcasing our Farmers Market vendors on Saturdays 9-1. Great church and school I love there community and the students there are very kind and polite My wife and I had never been to this place before though The neighborhood has a very comfortable feeling to it where it is. Stopped by to attend mass on Mother's Day and really enjoyed the service. This is a Catholic Church, so if you are Catholic you made enjoy the experience here. Sometimes it's great to have different places to go to. Even if you are not Catholic you just might like it here. It would be my hope that you gain a most heart fulfilled experience here. I certainly would not be surprised. My 3 kids have been going to this school for 4 years now.  I know of a handful of great catholic schools in the area, but this one happens to fit our family well.  We've gone through 2 Priests and 2 Principles since we've been here.  The current Priest, Father John is so down to earth and really loves the academy.  As for the new Principle, she is a loving and kind person with kids of her own that go here.  Please ignore the negative reviews and visit the school yourself to make your own judgement.

name: Saint Clement Church
reviewSummary:
We were in the city for an event and wanted to attend Mass somewhere close to our destination, so we ended up at Saint Clement Parish. I'm really glad we did because it turned out to be a wonderful church.

The architecture is absolutely beautiful and has a majestic feel to it. It even reminded me a bit of an Orthodox church with its unique design and atmosphere. The parish community was incredibly warm and welcoming. After the morning Mass, they offered free coffee, muffins, and bread, which was a very thoughtful touch and gave everyone a chance to socialize.

Overall, it was a great experience. The church is beautiful, the people are friendly, and it felt like a very welcoming place to worship. I would definitely love to come back again sometime in the future. We always love photographing weddings at St. Clement Church in Chicago.
The church has such a beautiful and timeless feel, with incredible architecture, soft light, and a very elegant atmosphere for wedding ceremonies. It photographs so well in every season and creates a classic Chicago wedding look that couples love. If you are planning a wedding ceremony here, St. Clement is truly a wonderful place for meaningful and beautiful photos. St. Clement was our final stop during our Maundy Thursday Visita Iglesia, and it was a meaningful and peaceful way to end the journey. The church had a calm and reflective atmosphere that encouraged prayer and gratitude after a night of visiting several parishes. It felt simple yet spiritual, making it a fitting closing point for the tradition. Amazing spiritual experience! Must visit in your visit to Chicago ! Beautiful church and great service Beautiful, peaceful, historical church. Such a calm feeling when you walk in. We were welcomed in mid afternoon. The frescoes are very detailed and not to be missed!

name: Saint Columban Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: This church has some major issues with its servers whatever you call them.  Their attitude, manner and behaviors just rub the wrong way, as they don’t belong in a worshipping place.  Maybe they need to change their religion. It’s not easy to be Catholic because the rules are very strict.  If they cannot follow Canon laws maybe consider joining other Christian dominations where they can pick and choose the rules they like or open their own church to worship themselves. St. Columban is my hometown Church where I grew up going for over 30 years. Even if I moved I still come back and attend mass when i can on the weekends or special holidays mass. I come to Duc Me La Vang to pray and our family is blessed. I take my kids here to pray all the time. There is a new restroom and the church is always super clean. Gorgeous church and beautiful Christmas decorations. What the janitor giving the evil eye? Been a while since I turned to God. But as soon as I got there the Hispanic janitor giving me the evil stare like saying get out of here. 😠 He used to never be there. And it was a perfect adorable time to adore Jesus. So sad 😢 Horrible experience at the 7pm Vietnamese mass. The priest gave me two body of Christ. I didn’t realize this until I was halfway to my seat since I normally pray and do the sign of the cross as I’m walking away. Wasn’t sure if you can consume both or not, so I held onto one and planned to give it to the priest after. After mass I went up to him and gave him the extra I had. He looked at me like I stole it and freaked out. I told him he accidentally gave me two. He then scolded me and told me I should have given it back right away (there was no time, they had already started putting the body of christ away) or consumed both. I told him I didn’t know that I could do that, and he then continued to tell me I was in the wrong. Literally the worst experience ever and has honestly turned me off from this church and religion. Disgusting.

name: Saint David's Anglican Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Great to welcoming church that embraced me and our family. Got connected to people and was able to serve. It’s been a Blessing. Everyone is so warm and caring. The Bible studies and meeting have really helped me understand scripture better and it has given me the tools to have better knowledge of scripture as well . Best church I ever attended. Intelligent and orthodox Biblical teaching and preaching. The congregation is diverse and very loving. So are the lay and ordained staff with leaders of both genders. Welcoming and friendly place to worship.  Congregation is loving and kind, pastor is convicted and speaks God's word in a way we can all understand.  Service was spirit filled and beautiful. I love st. David Church. They are very helpful. As well as I have seen many miracles there.
People very friendly, in a peaceful environment and always God’s massages spoken. Also, when Fr. José was there many miracles happened to me 🙏 St.David's is a place of compassion and love in action. Our family has been supported and encouraged for years.   We've met lifelong friends here. Stop by if you're seeking a place to grow in faith, life, and fun.

name: Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
The best Catholic church in Irvine. It is not big nor crowded. But a close community of christians. They have excellent Children ministry and Choir. Father Paul and Father Brandon are taking it to the next level A welcoming congregation with parishioners from elderly to infants, families, students from UCI, singles. Numerous ministries available for volunteering, including the area’s most active Knights of Columbus men’s group. Lovely church with the friendliest community. Haven't lived in Irvine for many years but I still visit the church on occasion. Beautiful Mass Holy Thursday.
English, Spanish and Chinese combined . I believe there was even a song sang in Philipino.
Beautiful church and All priests are very welcoming.
Love to go to mass here. 🙏❤️ Adoration on Tuesdays where one feels the presence of the Lord. Sacred place of worship.

name: Saint Finbar Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: This Parrish is my Home! For the last 4 years it has been a Blessing to count myself as a member of Saint Finbars wonderful Family! A great community where I can Praise and Worship Our loving God. May God bless our Father Francis Always. Beautiful community and church. Band is okay, nothing compared to a Christian church with the more modernized music vibe. Nonetheless, if you are a catholic like me, this church is a go-to, and the pastors are my favorite. Kind and understanding messages that you can comprehend and understand (clear voices). The church has a lot of space and speakers all around. Can get crowded around holidays. Great small church, good pastor, vibrant community, English, Spanish, And Vietnamese masses. I grew up with St Finbar as my parish. I was so excited to get married there since my parents also got married there however my wedding day was a disaster. Father did the entire mass out of order, made us kiss before we even exchanged rings and then didn’t even say the vows we chose, which threw us off completely and for that reason I didn’t get the “I do” moment I waited my entire life for. Just really made me so sad on my wedding day, a moment I dreamt of for the longest time just completely botched and I never got my I do moment. This was also because they never set up a proper rehearsal for my husband and I. I was baptized here in 1959 my holy safe place

name: Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Was eating my lunch out front got told from the pastor him self we was not allowed to eat out front and kicked us out. I thought a church was nice friendly and caring not mean and aggressive. Thank you pastor for the warm and kind words you gave us. This Catholic church is a heavenly place in Miami Beach. The priest who serves this Parish is extremely blessed and he is indeed guided by the Holy Spirit when he talks. I have confessed here twice and both times I felt as if Jesus Himself was there listening to me and talking to me. The decoration here is beautiful. The helpers are caring and loving. When in South Beach, I recommend: cone and pray at Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church. It’s a fine church if you are bilingual but can be hard to understand the priest. It was fine until the priest on a Sunday said to please ENJOY the refreshments in the back of the church after mass, that ended up being a horrible time. We went to be nice and be part of the community but once we went to the table to grab a cookie they didn’t say a word to us, we were in that room talking and two men come up to me and my sister telling us that we stole, we thought he was joking but they all started giving us horrible faces. Now my boyfriend was talking with someone else and finished his muffin and stepped out and they all started shouting that he was a thief and he didn’t pay to go grab him that he needs to pay. Mind you, they didn’t say “that would be $3.50” or anything so how would we know? Then proceeded to make an entire scene about it. That is not how a church operates.
Then we come back to pay them in cash and they say they aren’t even part of the church. We thought that was weird.
Very disrespectful and disappointing experience. This is a place needed every Sunday. I am from NY and I make sure to find a church I can attend my weekly mass. The place where we all are 1, 1 in the father, we are all family. If you are having a ruff day or week this is the place to feel better and ask for forgiveness, which both will be bestowed upon you. I felt like I was at home with  my family. All praise given to the Alpha and Omega. If you are reading this review, may all the blessings be with you and all your loved ones. AMEN! Always 5⭐️ Great spirit within this church. Loved attending mass on my vacation.

name: Saint Francis Xavier Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church and school. Warm and friendly. A great place to worship. We were there for mass and a celebration. Witnessed some pretty severe liturgical abuse during Mass while traveling here last spring. Not only were they singing alleluias during Lent, but they also had laypeople reading the gospel, interrupting it repeatedly to sing songs. A truly disturbing experience. I would advise finding a Catholic Church that actually treats the Mass with the solemnity and respect that is warranted. I haven't been to church in a very long time. I'm talking decades. Given my history I never expected to be accepted this way into a church. I'll be here every Sunday regardless of what else is going on in my life. Because it seems to me to be a genuine place. The kind of place where I can come to terms with my past and finally connect with God. Signed up for their baptism workshop and we were pretty much picked on because we wouldn't go to church every Sunday. Our God mother to be was embarrassed by the priest cause she had her daughter at a young age. When we finally survived that workshop we had to make another appointment to meet with the priest before the baptism. We called for a month and heard nothing back. Finally we made an appointment and on the day of the priest cancelled on us and said he would call us back to make another appointment. Never happened. We called two more times and nothing. So, in the end we just gave up. I felt like I was judged from people who are supposed to inspire faith and much more. A lot more happened at the workshop but i won't mention any more Was a lay minister here, and I have to confess I knew next to nothing about the Holy Faith. But this is the Novus Ordo Church, completely and purposely disconnected from Tradition. Thankfully now, I am a sedevacantist and wait for the day when the Latin Mass and the Dogmas of the Church may be reestablished.
Pax Christi.

name: Saint James Catholic Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This place feels deeply blessed and touched by God’s presence. The solemn and peaceful atmosphere brings comfort to the heart and soul. It is a beautiful sanctuary where you can pray, reflect, and feel spiritually renewed. Being here reminds you of God’s love and grace. I never expected one of the most painful phone calls of my life to be to a church.

I called St. James Catholic Church because I am facing a financial crisis and desperately needed help with rent. I understand that not every parish offers financial assistance. That was never my biggest disappointment.

It was the lack of compassion.

When I asked whether they offered rental assistance, the receptionist, Katie Concklin, responded in an annoyed tone, “Who is saying that we offer that?” I was shocked. I replied that I simply thought a church would understand why someone in need might call asking for mercy and help. She hung up on me. When I called back to explain how hurtful the interaction had been, she hung up on me again.

I later spoke with Fr. Matt Murphy, hoping he would at least listen. Instead, he defended the interaction and told me, in a condescending voice, “You are not acting like someone who needs help.”

That sentence broke my heart.

I have lived with severe mental illness for more than 30 years and Complex PTSD. I have spent decades trying therapy, medications, treatment programs, and doing everything I can to heal. It is not my fault that our mental health system is so broken or that so many people fall through the cracks. When someone has been drowning for years, they may sound desperate. Desperation is not a character flaw.

What shocked me most is that even if the church could not help financially, no one stopped to ask if I was okay, offer a prayer, or refer me to another organization that might help. Compassion costs nothing.

Sadly, this is not my first experience like this. In my personal experience, some of the least compassionate responses I have received during my darkest moments have come from people within the Catholic Church. That is one of the reasons I am no longer Catholic.

Jesus met suffering with compassion. Pope Leo XIV has repeatedly called on Christians to accompany the vulnerable with mercy, tenderness, and love. That is what I hoped to find when I called a church.

I am sharing this because I believe the Church can do better. The next person who calls may be suicidal, homeless, or experiencing the worst day of their life. A few moments of kindness could change everything.

I also cannot ignore that, as a Latina, I left wondering whether bias played a role in how I was spoken to. I cannot say that it did, but I know I felt dismissed and spoken to as though I were unintelligent.

This isn’t about money anymore.

It’s about compassion.

I pray so that God can touch the hearts of Fr Matt Murphy and Katie Conklin so that He can touch their hearts and they can be nicer to people in need no matter their background, sex, religion or race 🙏🏽. Amen. My favorite Church in Southern California  in which I feel peace and tranquility especially during the most challenging times! It is sad that this is a place of worship that has placed a sign on their grass that excludes so many individuals. No Ball Games, No Dogs, No Skateboards, No Scooters, No Bicycles etc. etc. etc. No Trespassing. I've never known a Catholic Church to be private and only include "authorized persons". I guess "all are welcome" is not the message here. This is my local church. Everyone here is friendly and welcoming. Check the website for all the coming events.

name: Saint Joachim Catholic Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I were visiting this parish while in Newport Beach, and we had a very difficult experience during Communion. My wife has been receiving the Eucharist kneeling for several years as a personal act of reverence, which is permitted in the Catholic Church.

When she approached to receive kneeling, the priest (Fr. Capone) instructed her to stand and would not give her Communion until she did. It was uncomfortable to witness and clearly distressing for her, especially in what should be a deeply sacred and peaceful moment.

I’m sharing this so that others who feel strongly about receiving kneeling are aware that, in our experience, it was not permitted here.” You should have a choice whether you want to stand or Neil. No one should force you if you want to be extra reverent to Jesus, our Lord and Savior.  What will the priest do the day they see him? Will they kneel or will they stand every knee shall bow down to our Lord.  Let’s not be lukewarm let’s be hot for Christ. San Joachim holds a special place in my heart and I’ve only been there once! Beautiful church and atmosphere! Thank you for all that you do! Amen! St Joachim is a lovely church, gets full, many activities, photo is during Night Adoration of Blessed Sacrament. St. Joachim Catholic School protects children who bully others. Bullies will always exist. Our Catholic belief that all are beautiful children of God, necessarily supports that Catholic school staff are obligated to keep our children safe from bullies. But the principal, pastor and staff at St Joachim school don’t believe this. Wondering if this school is still Catholic. Beautiful church music is amazing.

name: Saint John Lutheran Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: Dedicated congregation . Excellent service and attention; you can feel the warmth of family. Each celebration is a wonderful experience of living and feeling our faith. Pastor María Paiva, with her message from the Word of God, leads us to reflect on our daily commitment to living the Christian faith. It is a beautiful experience of unity, prayer, and respect as a community. Good service, the people are nice. 🙂

name: Saint John Paul II Polish Center - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church for a prayer with good Polish community and very welcoming pastor. They have a small Polish festival every September, which we attend. Easy parking, nice entertainment. The crepes and pierogi are delicious. Sometimes it's difficult to find a place to sit to eat and the line is always long for the desserts. It's all a good time, though. Thank you! I love The Polish Festival they have here every year. I never miss it! Everybody is always having a great time. There's music and great food. I love the stuffed cabbage! Visit their Dozynki Harvest Festival each September. Small Catholic Church that offers services in English, Polish (and Latin - Tridentine Mass). The Center is also a home to Polish School (for children but there are also classes for English speakers who want to learn Polish). The Center hosts many events, including a music concert that recently raised thousands of dollars for Ukrainian refugees. A wonderful place to worship and practice our Catholic Faith. The Polish Language Mass is warm and moving and all are invited.  If you are looking for a traditional Spiritual Mass, this is the place to be.  I especially enjoy the lovely courtyard and the wonderful tributes to Saint John Paul II, our former Pope, who has blessed so many through his intercession. Viva il Papa, Pope Saint John Paul II!  Chwała Ojcu!!

name: Saint John the Baptist Catholic Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I really like the Norbertine religious. The mass was very nice and the homily clear and pertinent to today. I’m here visiting the area from Salt Lake City for daily mass. Great church and great school. Families here are so welcoming from the school and church. They hold a summer festival each year my kids love going to. Jackson is a great security there. Highly recommend this parish as the community here is very tight group and very welcoming. Offer church services on Saturday evenings and all day Sundays My childhood church.  The inside is gorgeous. Norbertine priests so very traditional . Lots of parking also a school so very community based.  Fish fry during lent is the best!!! Beautiful church to get married at! Staff was helpful and friendly.  The ceremony was incredibly moving and meaningful.  There is ample parking, too.

Bonus point: this church features one of my favorite stained glass windows (photo attached). St John the Baptist parish and the Norbertine fathers saved my life. Thank God. There is no other parish in Orange County like this one besides the St Michael’s Abbey. The Saints and Early Church Fathers are indeed smiling down on SJB.

name: Saint John the Baptist Catholic School - Costa Mesa Campus
Saint John the Evangelist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
horrible experience, my daughter was in a class here and the teachers are so mean towards the kids. Teacher was consistently unprofessional and so was the main coordinator of the church in the office. Horrible place to pay for any class. You would expect kinder hearts from a church. I attend the Spanish masses and Father has the most clear explanation during the homily (sermon). Throughout the mass he includes comments and explanations 2 fully understand each part of the mass. I also see that everyone in the church and ministries are very friendly and helpful. I enjoy coming to mass every week! Called several times for a Catholic priest to go and administer sacraments to a bed bound person, but nothing!
Left messages, details, phone numbers, addresses, and directions to the secretary and nothing!
They simply don't care about their people. Went to a service celebrating someone’s life. If the point is to bring people closer to god this man did the opposite of that. You want to save people but you’re turning them further away. You should be ashamed. I thought god is love but apparently it’s more important to push your conservative patriarchal agenda. This is one of the churches of my youth. My grandmother sang in the choir at st. John when I was a little girl. It sure did brought back some great memories for me. I just wanted to see what it look like and if it still brought memories of my childhood. It is on Opal Street a quaint little Street in Rubidoux.

name: Saint John's Episcopal Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: A joyous and welcoming experience. It was a celebration of 50 years of service by the organist. Amazing music, both keyboards (organ and piano) and voice. I'm not a member of the congregation, but I understand why many happy people are! Beautiful grounds and nice parishioners and staff. If you are looking for a Rite service, this one is done well. If you're more high church with Rite one, incense and sacred music this is not the place for you. Whatever your choice, you will find respectful and Godly worship This is a wonderful church. After many years of searching for a church where we would be welcomed, we finally lighted on St. Johns. It felt right from the very beginning. Fr. Marshall is wonderful and friendly and everyone welcomed us with open arms. I love this church!!! It was today and I did a tai chi class,and I will be going back Great staff n early head start for little kids n school

name: Saint Joseph Catholic Church Campus
Saint Joseph Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: The Cardinal is a  local in the Orange County Diocese.  He has conducted Mass, in English at Saint Barbara's, on Euclid. The believing families are, truly Christian here. The decor is prestigious and well kept. Clean and Tidy.  There were Avocado farmers offering  deals on Avocado fruit, outside of the cathedral,  for some type of fundraising to benefit the churches involvement in local city affairs.  Plenty of comfortable seating, and a musically inspired precession.  Nice place to have a church "Sunday ", morning... St. Joseph’s church is absolutely beautiful. I had been in the past a few times. I now live in San Diego and came to Santa Ana to go to mass with family for Easter. So I chose St. Joseph’s Church remembering how beautiful. Just wanted others to be aware it has changed a lot. I went to the 9 am English mass and it wasn’t a traditional mass. They had a lot of Samoan traditions incorporated in the mass. It really took my mind off of Jesus and the resurrection on this most special day. Also almost all songs were in a different language and sounded very islandie and sung in a very load volume. After I received communion I could not hear my own thoughts let alone focus on praying. It was very theatrical. All traditions are beautiful and I respect them, I would have wanted to know what I was in for and have the option to choose a more traditional Catholic Church where the focus is purely on God, our lord and savior Jesus Christ and the gospel. The mass should be labeled English/Samoan mass. Gods bless everyone and always keep your focus on Jesus especially in Church. July 22nd 2023 - My 2nd time Capturing a wedding ceremony here and the Architecture is beautiful outside! Congratulations to Stephanie & Francisco. Nice little church in Downtown Santa Ana. Near the County Civic Center. Mass in English on Holy Days of Obligation at 12.15 pm. Plenty of seats and music and normally a good sermon. Parking is available close to the church. Beautiful church . Priests are helpful in family values and spiritual growth ❤️🙏
