name: San Secondo d'Asti Catholic Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended one of the three daily Masses at this beautiful, quaint church today. Our first time here.The reverence was striking — many of the women parishioners wore veils, and the priest faced the altar throughout the Mass (ad orientem). It felt peaceful, traditional, and deeply sacred. It was very reverent, traditional experience. I'll definitely go back whenever I will be in the area. 🙏🧡✝️☦️ Latin Mass absolutely stunning, reverent, a must go for my fellow Catholics. Such a deep sense of peace. I’m very grateful to have found this extraordinary gem of a church. ❤️‍🔥 Been going a lot here lately for 2:30 and sometimes 5:00 masses. The church itself is beautiful and reverent, but the temperature inside is honestly unbearable. It is ridiculously hot!!!!!!!!! not just uncomfortable, but distracting to the point where it’s hard to focus on prayer or the liturgy. What’s most concerning is that this it feels stifling even if we are supposed to be in the cold season currently. The heat builds quickly once people are inside, and there is very little airflow. Sitting through a full service feels like being in a closed, overheated room. it was not like this before.

I hope the staff  can address the ventilation or cooling system soon, because the environment inside the church should support worship, not make it physically exhausting. At least fix the air so that there is airflow inside. We have children too and I don't think this kind of stagnant air is healthy at all. I thought it was just me, I was not surprised to see other reviews saying the church is uncomfortably hot and so long lately. My husband and I decided to go to Our Lady of Guadalupe in Sultana for 5:00 PM. More comfortable and closer to my husband's work. Beautiful parish community, filled with reverence & love, & close to work for first Friday observance.  Their spirit of hospitality fills me with gratitude.🙏🏼

name: Sanctuary Berkeley [Sunday Service] - Berkeley Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome local church. Pastor David and his family are doing the Lord’s work. The community is an ever changing body of undergraduates, transfer students, grad students, recent grads, and various locals. If you are seeking a small church community focused on preaching directly from the Word, small enough where you learn each other’s names, this is a great Church to spend some time with. Not to mention the excellent gourmet light roast coffee and pastries everybody Sunday. If you like good church and/or good coffee, stop by one Sunday morning and say hi! Expository teaching (verse by verse through the bible) is great! After a lifetime of "topical" preaching that failed to give me the big picture, this small church delivers the goods. I love this church. Clearly preaching the gospel
of Jesus Christ and loving Him and people well. Good music, teaching, and talking with warm people.Peace, love, and Jesus in Berkeley CA! So good!

name: Sanctuary Church
reviewSummary:
From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with warmth and genuine kindness. The people here reflect the LOVE of Jesus in a way I have never experienced before. Whether you’ve been in church your whole life or you’re exploring faith for the first time, this community creates space for you to belong and grow.

Sanctuary clearly and faithfully teaches the Bible every Sunday. The messages are rooted in Scripture, and are also incredibly relevant and accessible, pointing us toward the way of Jesus.

There are also so many opportunities to get involved—from young adult, youth, and kids’ ministries to local outreach and creative teams. It’s a beautiful, authentic community that’s truly living out the love of Jesus in both word and action.

If you’re looking for a church home where you can feel known, grow in faith, and be part of something so much bigger than yourself, I can’t recommend Sanctuary Church enough. Last night I visited your Tuesday night (Heart Night) and it was very encouraging and uplifting.💕

We met in the upstairs floor of an office and business building and the space had a very relaxed vibe with lights and a chapter in the psalms was printed out for people to pick up and read. 💡

The worship and open prayer time was spontaneous and inviting. 🎶

Sydney, a friendly and caring young woman offered to pray for me. It was a blessing to chat with her and meet her husband and baby. Her prayer strengthened and encouraged my heart. 🙏 Beautiful And Wonderful Church. The congregation is so welcoming. They make you feel right at home. The pastor is an Amazing person. The way he presents every message is beyond words. Anyone of any age will relate to something he preaches about. Amen to That! Sincere and authentic community of loving people.
Free parking in the mall garage across the street!

They have a nursery for babies and a fun kids program. Come a little early to sign-in your child. Friendly, welcoming, and non-judgemental church family that accepts you as you are.  Whether you're a lifelong believer or simply curious about Christianity, this is a church passionate about infusing our faith with action to make a positive difference in Providence.

name: Sanctuary Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
The most wonderful and welcoming church I've ever attended. Been attending on and off for 5 years and I feel at home every time I walk in the doors . I feel God presence all around me. Warm and friendly.  Empathic. Communion shared. Prayer for those seeking support. Sanctuary Church and Pastor Robert will always have my gratitude. The Jesus Fire in this Church is very strong and welcoming to everyone. This church is very active in the community and Robert preaches sermons that always resonate with me. I recommend Sanctuary to anyone new in their relationship with Jesus or a veteran. 💪🙌❤️ Love going to this church. Very welcoming... Come as you are you will be greeted warmly. Everyone is happy to see me anytime I go. I really love the messages from the pastor, Robert. Every message I can relate it to my life in some way. They also have an amazing kids area... They have an indoor jungle gym as well as do crafts and fun activities and learning every visit. My kids LOVE it there. The volunteers are so helpful and patient. They helped me find many items that I definitely needed for my new job, plus they have so many nice and in-style clothes to choose from. I absolutely recommend that if you know of anyone needing clothes to go check them out and if you have any unwanted items, from clothing to household items, this is the place to donate them to...
God blessed me with finding the Sanctuary Church!

name: Sanctuary Church - Main Campus
Sandals Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor moi and his staff are the best. They are there for you when times are good and bad. If your struggling or just curious about Jesus I definitely reccomend this church. Kids team is World class and the childcare they offer during church is wonderful. Great to the community of Anaheim and Orange County! I’ve been a member of Sandals Church for more than 20 years. I’ve witnessed so many changes and I’m proud of our journey, which has included a lot of growth. I have been attending the Anaheim campus since it opened during the pandemic. A warm, welcoming environment that knows how to worship through song, prayer, baptism, taco Tuesdays, and so much more to reach the community of Anaheim & share the love of Jesus. I would recommend that anyone looking for a place to be authentic and to be lifted up come and check it out. Excellent kids ministry too. :) This is my favorite church. They have such a great community and are super open and nice to newcomers. Highly recommend!! When picking a church, I was looking for a few things; leadership, a mission/vision for the future of the church, and a place that felt authentic and transparent. What I found at sandals was leaders that I could buy into and trust, with a mission and vision of impacting not only members of the church but playing a major role in the community. And as for authenticity and transparency, the leaders of this church are open books and are the definition of servant leaders. You can’t describe an experience, so you’ll just have to come in and see for yourself. Met Pastor Brandon tonight at Katella Deli, amazingly God Loving Soul that gave me God Goose Bumps as we spoke About Faith in Our Walk through life with The Lord! Get yourself to services you’ll see what I’m talking about, have your heart touched and grow in your Faith

name: Sandals Church Corona - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: I'm so glad that Sandals Church finally has a location in Corona!!  The campus pastor is AMAZING!!  One of my favorites.

name: Sandals Church Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
In this amazing town of Redlands, CA a place of worship has opened recently. Come on out and be a part of Sandals Church Redlands. Pastor Brian and the entire staff create a place to be real with ourselves, God and others. I wasn't looking for a new church but after meeting the people I decided this would be my church home.  The pastors are easy to talk to and extremely accessible. The youth pastor is equally great. I wish I would've known him when I was a youth.
It's small now, but I expect it to grow once word gets around.
No fancy facade. No "Sugar coated, everything always wonderful all the time" vibe,  just real people living out their faith with each other.
Life is beautiful and hard.  We all face struggles. We're all human. But there is a God who loves us and will always be there for us and promises abundant life. Come check it out. Sandals Church is warm, welcoming, and feels like family! The messages are inspiring and relatable, and there are plenty of opportunities to grow spiritually and connect with others. Whether you’re new to the area or looking for a church home, this is the perfect place to feel supported and part of a meaningful community. Highly recommend! I go to an evening meeting. It is not necessarily connected to Sandals' church and their biblical teaching. I would suggest to attend several services and or Bible teachings. Of course it's my responsibility to be a berean of the Word of God. Verse by verse, chapter by chapter: In the Bible, a Berean is someone who examines new teachings by comparing them to the Scriptures. The term comes from Acts 17:11.
With that said, the folks in the meeting connected to SC seem amicable! This place is very immaculate and I always enjoy the company of the people I also think the youth group is styling so definitely go check it out

name: Sandals Church San Bernardino - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: We all need God, and if youre ready to be real with making Christ the core & center of your life...  This is THE PLACE! The phrase we pattern our lives after? ROGO! Real with Ourselves, God & Others. Come celebrate and praise with me. Service times: Sundays | 9:30am | 11am | 6pm. 3701 N Sierra Way San Bernardino. I feel welcomed as soon as I step on the campus. The pastor is down to earth and easy to listen to. He makes going to church almost fun. There is a quad area with various types of seating and speakers so you can listen to the sermon while enjoying the fresh air if you like. There's a coffee bar where you can purchase coffee and light snacks. There is a well organized child care center,  but children are welcome to sit in on the sermon with their parents. I love it and I’m so glad that I was able to find a home church here after so many years of being in one that didn’t really fit me. The church is so supportive and welcoming in people’s spiritual journeys and growth in a way that feels comforting rather than suffocating and awkward. There’s real genuine people here of all ages that all come together for the sake of the one true savior. In the beginning I was a little on edge by the idea of watching a sermon on a big screen rather than hearing sermons in person but 1, it’s something that I’ve grown to move past as I focused more on the words of the pastor and less on the presentation, and 2, if it was really that big of a problem I could always just come to the 6pm service where the pastor for this campus does live sermons. I know not everyone will feel this same pull by The Spirit to this church because God has different plans for different people but I was instilled with so much confidence in my place here that I decided to start volunteering here only weeks into joining the Church and it was a wonderful decision. I will admit I did feel a little out of place when going to youth that they host on Wednesday, however since it is “youth” and young minds are still growing and maturing spiritually, it is to be expected. While i personally did not feel as drawn to the youth groups that were hosted, while there I did notice that others that had been there for longer had developed deep connections and friendships with one another so I have no doubt that for many it is a wonderful opportunity for seeking out fellowship. This is my church and the mission here is to be real with ourselves, God and others and incredibly amazing of how this church is is because everyone here has been the realest people I've ever met in my entire life. I recommend this church 100% because we're all children of God We love the sermon at Sandals church ,but its kind of disappointed me about youth ministry, my daughter attend Youth ministry every Wednesday, when her and her friend got into some argument (typical teenager) my daughter stop attending because she felt that she never “Welcome”in youth ministry anymore because her friend grew up there and she just new in that ministry.I told her just go and attend to connect with God but she refuse for couples if month she miss the ministry so last Wednesday she attend ,but instead of “Welcoming Her” the leader of youth ministry I believe her name is Miss Jen  pull her in the conner and told her that” I don’t want you to create drama or make a dirty look ,I just want you to come to connect with GOD”  now she don’t want to attend anymore because she felt the way she address to her is not very unwelcome instead its like judging her to attend the ministry.In my opinion people who serve in church need to be open minded and always open their  arms and heart and not judging people .

reviewSummary:

My grandfather has a doctrine in history and biblical studies, and my uncle was the minister who started and built holiday island community church, I am utterly astounded at the way I was treated when coming to your church asking for assistance, especially considering I had just been hit by a car a block away, while riding me bike to get to your food pantry, that according to your website should have been open, but was not. name: Sandy Springs Christian Church - Sandy Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
We love our church! We felt welcomed the moment we walked through the doors! We joined back in the Fall of 2020 when they were only having outdoor service but now are able to safely worship in the sanctuary again! They truly welcome all people and we have a very diverse congregation who is always willing to lend a helping hand. They are always putting together fun events and make every holiday season special. I highly recommend checking out the live stream on YouTube or coming in person for the 10:15am service, Rev Nathan is the best! Love this church and joined in January 2019.  It is made up of many fabulous and caring people.  Truly, all are welcome and encouraged to participate in communion offered every Sunday, regardless of where you are on your faith journey.   Our minister, Pastor Nathan Brown is a tremendous leader, passionate, inspirational and incredibly welcoming. Friendly but they are not all over U.
Serious about worshipping but open minded. Great music and awesome choir.  Bible readings and exchanges in which everyone can express their opinions and questions, and get feedback from smart folks who will respect your views.
Frequent community assistance activities. Not large but not very small
congregation (90-100 ppl).
IMPORTANT:  they explore different ways to approach Christian practice and understanding, so they are not closed in their own ideas & ways.
Good for ppl who have questions about religion and are trying to find their own approach to it. This church has made my spiritual life made so meaningful. Rev. Dr. Nathan Brown, Senior Minister, and the entire staff of ministers from music to youth are incredibly smart and talented. Visit us and hopefully join our inclusive, open and affirming church... only if you want to be a name and not a number! Sandy Springs Christian Church is a loving safe place to worship, hear the Word of God preached in a gentle voice and take Communion weekly without judgement. They are LGBTQ+ affirming. The environment is calm and welcoming. The people are genuine and serve the community well. It is a Lighthouse for anyone looking for a new church home.

This review is for the Nativity Production!

God Bless their works! Such a welcoming community of international people!! I felt very much at home all the times I went there.. It's a great place to be in the presence of our brothers and sisters and worship our Lord together!! I'm a newcomer and yet they've always treated me like I've been there forever.. Totally recommend it!! One of the most warming experiences I've had ever since I arrived in America about a month ago :) Had awesome day yesterday, God bless you 🙏🙏🙏 all. I am talking about the event :''the nativity scene' that takes place during 4 nights in December. An entire village of Jesus' s time is built on the parking lot of the church, it's impressive. reviewSummary: Man son is a member and he recommended checking out the service on the live stream. I did and Wow! The music is amazing. Dr. Plew is awesome. I can feel his love for the Lord when he sings. Awesome choir. The messages and style of preaching are right up my alley. I actually learn something. His knowledge of the Bible is impressive. name: Santa Clarita Christian Fellowship Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: God led me to this Church.  They welcomed me with open arms.  I was blessed enough to meet them 1 week before Easter Sunday.  It was literally like walking in and meeting the family you never knew you had.  Although from outerly attire and looks we had nothing in common we had the same beliefs, the same spirit.  I went back yesterday on a Thursday for a prayer meeting I dressed better but inside my soul was broken.  I told the pastor I would not be able to make it on Easter Sunday to be baptised within 30 minutes after the prayer meeting they resceduled everything for me.  They filled the baptism pool, gave me baptism attire.  The entire prayer meeting attendees stayed and witnessed me being baptised and saved my soul.  To say I am literally eternally grateful to them is an understatement.  Today I go out armed with Jesus by my side to enter the plague of homelessness effecting our country.  If you are ever in the neighborhood you should definately stop in and say hello.  It might be the best thing you have ever done.  I will pray for them everyday.  You should too.  May God Bless them and keep them safe.  They are truly doing God's work.  🙏 Wonderful church.  The  singing to the Lord is anointed, and the congregation is so loving toward each other and especially toward visitors. They make you feel at home.  I love that the Pastors always guide you to the Bible when giving a sermon.  I'd attend again. How Wonderful it was to be back in the Sanctuary. Thank God for our Shepherd Pastor Harper and Sis Cecile who allow us to have our Women's Conference in the Sanctuary. Thank God for All those giving there lives to service. They were so united. It was overwhelming just to be in the Sanctuary amongst People of God. What a Blessing to Fellowship with Daughters of the Most High God.  The Message from our Beautiful Speakers was so needed at this time. To Remember Our Fist Love and Not Get Distracted from Our Ultimate Goals. I visited this church one Sunday trying to fellowship without my usual 1.5 hour commute to my home church, and right away felt at home. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly. But, more than that the word was extra ripe for the picking. Pastor Harper delivered. I also appreciated the personal touch of small group prayer, it made the experience more personable and intimate as you connect with fellow believers. The choir and Corus that usher you into praise and worship. I highly recommend this church for everyone looking for a church home, or even a visit to kick the tires and check under the hood for one. The videos and streaming are helpful during these days of separation. Thank you SCCF for being there. and keeping in touch over the months. That personal touch mean a lot to me. I was looking for a home church since moving from the San Fernando Valley so I stopped in to see what SCCF was all about. I met amazing, outgoing, friendly people who genuinely cared about me and my well-being. I continued to attend and every week had the same result-good, honest Christian people who cared about me. I continue to attend (online because of COVID) and interact with several members of the congregation and those interactions are ALWAYS positive. Pastor Harper is always there when I have a question, a concern or a prayer request. I am very happy with my association with SCCF and expect it to continue for a very long time to come.

name: Santa Clarita United Reformed Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Solid, Bible-believing church with clear and deep preaching as well as reverent worship focusing on singing the 3,000-year old Psalms, substantive hymns, & celebration of the Lord’s Supper! How unique in our day!! Highly recommended for those in and near Santa Clarita. I found refuge in this church after attending several mega "non-denominational" churches with questionable eschatology. This church in contrast is small as it is a satellite church of the URC in Chino. The people are warm, welcoming, and passionate about scripture. I get the feeling that most members are not there by default but have chosen to be there specifically to grow in Christ. Traditional hymns are sung - no large choirs, orchestras or rock bands. The bible and the church are the focus. I thank the Lord for Rev Lee Irons who God blessed with a passion for the Word. His sermons are scripturally sound and edifying due to his years of study and a heart filled with the Holy Spirit. He holds an adult Sunday school after the morning service which allows us to delve more into how to apply the sermon to our daily lives. It reminds me of what the early church must have been like. I feel blessed to have found this church. After consuming reformed resources over many years from theologians like Luther, Calvin, Owen, Machen, Sproul, Fesko, Godfrey, etc, I was thrilled to finally discover a wonderful, Biblically solid, confessional, reformation church here in Santa Clarita! This friendly and warm congregation is committed to sound theology and caring for each person that walks through the door.

The minister, a brilliant and approachable graduate of Westminster Seminary (not to mention an expert in Greek and Biblical Theology), faithfully preaches from the Bible, proclaims the Gospel in every service, cares for each person in church, and can answer in an understandable way the most difficult challenges/questions.

There’s a large group of children ranging from infant to teenagers that are also extremely welcoming and kind - one of the coolest things was seeing teenagers and older kids being so kind to my young daughter. There’s also regular men’s and women’s Bible studies, frequent gatherings, and LOTS of excellent food.

I love bringing my family to hear the truth, be ministered to by the Word and sacraments, and enjoy the fellowship. More importantly, in an era of great compromise, error, and novel doctrine, I trust SCURC to be steadfast to their Biblical, confessionally reformed, historical, orthodox, sound convictions.

Wherever you are in your life; whether you’re wondering about, new to, struggling, or strong in your faith; whether you’re curious about or committed to reformed theology (or somewhere in between); whether you’re a student, single, married with a family, younger, or older… and just simply want to have rest, peace, and assurance in Christ - this is the place to come! I really enjoy the Christ centered expository preaching where the good news of the gospel is always present. There is a wonderful spirit of hospitality and warmth in the close knit community of believers there that makes everyone feel welcome. Great new church in the area, faithful to God's Word.

name: Santa Clarita Valley Church of Christ - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Hear me people! I attended this ICOC for 3 years from 2019-2022. This is a cult that does not preach the true gospel. Rather this place preaches water baptism is a requirement for salvation. I doubt this “church” has changed. Run! I love my church! This group of believers is my second family! They are loving, serving and really strive to share Jesus and his message thru Bible study and the lives they lead.
The music program is the best! 'Kids Kingdom' is our Sunday school program and the kids love it!
Our church donates time, money, food and new clothing (like socks, gloves, underwear) to several places for children/adults as well as supporting a local family welfare center each holiday season.
This is a loving group of believers who love sharing their lives with new friends and visitors too.
Please join us! Everyone is welcome ! Such a beautiful group of people different cultures different countries and everybody is so kind and caring. I love going to church. And I never thought that I would be feeling this way about any place full of people I don’t know for a time. However, this church makes you feel welcome makes you feel like you matter. I think everybody should be made to feel special because we are all part of God’s creation and we are his children. Lovely church that loves the Bible. Have visited a few times. Like any church it's not perfect, but I can attest to the fact that the people here love God, love people and preach the Gospel. This is a great place to be if you live nearby. Amazing worship and fellowship!
I appreciate all the spiritual support I get from this church.

name: Santa Cruz Bible Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to this church before and during its existence as a megachurch. My one-star rating is not based on its current, smaller size; it is based on the fact that it no longer appears to be a church that is faithful to preaching the word of God. The message I heard was a vague God-wants-you-to-be-happy bowl of mush. The statements of belief and vision focus more on making sure that nobody's feelings are hurt than calling out sin. It was sad to see a church that I loved reduced to a dead husk. Matt keeps it real, teaching how to follow Christ first Santa Cruz Bible has been my church home for decades. We’ve been Blessed by the addition of Pastor Matt. I love how relatable he is and how he is able to connect with people. Our church loves having fun inviting all to attend! Love our Church!! Santa Cruz Bible is a welcoming church for everyone who is searching for hope ,faith, And a sense of belonging through Jesus Christ ✝️ pastor Matt and Scott dynamically delivers Gods’ words you can relate with💕 I love it here🙏🏼 Very glad Santa Cruz Bible Church has Pastor Matt. I am certain that great things are happening at SCBC.  For those who don’t know Matt, he was our lead pastor here in Tampa, but God had other plans for him.  Pastor Matt is the kindest, non- judgmental and most welcoming person.

God, speaks directly to me through him and he always has.  Each message Matt shares feels like it was tailored just for me and is delivered with a levity that is refreshing.  I believe the culture of SCBC is one of HOPE…for ALL.
Thank you for continuing to post  the messages on YouTube.

name: Santa Cruz Community Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a smaller Christian community, where you can build friendships with other believers, hear sound biblical teaching and get involved, this is a loving church. There are several ways to get involved in serving the community through Operation Christmas Child and other outreach events. They also partner with Iglesia Bautista Nueva Vida, which is a gospel teaching Spanish congregation that meets each week at 1pm. There are a lot of wonderful things happening at this church and is it growing. They will welcome you warmly. Very exciting things are happening at this church! They recently welcomed a new pastor who brings fresh energy and vision to the congregation. In addition, there’s a vibrant Hispanic church that meets on Sunday afternoons, creating a diverse and welcoming community. A great place to connect, grow, and be part of something special. Absolutely love being part of Santa Cruz Community Church. The Word of God is preached. The people are loving. And the food!!! Come at 10:45 early for food before the 11AM service. This is an amazing Bible believing, Bible teaching loving and accepting church.  Everyone is treated as family.  If you’re looking for a home church where you fit in and are accepted.  Come home to Santa Cruz community church. An amazing group of people, a beautiful building, and, most importantly, a church that will bring you closer to God!

name: Santa Maria De Guadalupe - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: A very warm and welcoming environment. The staff is kind, friendly and supportive o everyone.  Our first visit was just epic! Thanks to Padre Lupe and Padre Alejandro for your hospitality. Since day one of attending to Santa Maria De Guadalupe and listening to the words of god, every mass I attend I feel the love and guidance and the joy I feel in my heart is beautiful, Thank you Padre Lupe and Staff. Is this a Roman Catholic church? Thank you so much for everything you do for families

reviewSummary: Sound scary???.. WOW! are there any members of the church that could give actual testimony of this place? DO NOT USE PENTECOSTAL IN THE NAME OF YOUR MONEY LAUNDERING!!!! GORGEOUS CHURCH WITH THE KINDEST FOLK I HAVE FOUND IN Santa Monica God bless Relaxing place

name: Santa Rosa Bible Church - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary:
The elders here are really friendly. However, I met a fair share of very rude churchgoers at this church. The elders are dedicated to their job but they also happen to be too busy to deal with rude fellow church goers. Had so much fun watching the opener baseball game of the VCA Eagles on the gorgeous fields.  This church is known for its hospitality, beautiful grounds, and solid Bible teaching. SRBC is a wonderful church with ministers the truly study and preach and teach the gospel. I've been going to church all of my life, but since my husband and I started going there 15 years ago, I have learned so much more and become so much closer to my Lord Jesus Christ. It is a large church, so it is hard to learn to know everyone. But there are many groups to join. By doing that, a person can get to know some people very well. There are many areas where a person can help. I could never say enough positive things about SRBC.
If you want to know more, you can call me at 539-0742. Such a great place for fellowship and they have so many fun things going on around the campus! They have a very nice campus and church. They hosted our sons basketball leagues aooreciatuon ceremony. Very nice people.

name: Santa Rosa Christian Church - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I attended SRCC yesterday and found the worship to be a mixture of contemporized hymns and newer choruses. The addition of a violin brought a resonant sweetness to the total sound of praise. The sermon was expositional with a topical focus/theme found within the Biblical passage. Several people greeted us but were not too pushy. Presently this is a smaller church with about 125-150 in attendance that has a family feel to it--but that may quickly change. If looking for a church home as a young family or older adult I believe you would be served well at SRCC. Im a 29yo married mom with 3 kids and only became a Christian 3 years ago. I have been going to Santa Rosa Christian Church ever since, but I still remember the first day I walked in the doors.

I'd never been to church before and had no idea what to expect. And to say self-conscious would be an understatement. But from the second I walked in I felt like I was already home. Many greeted me, genuinely, and their love radiated out. SRCC's community is authentic and welcoming.

The Spirit moves in this place and the people practice the love we are called to act in. Colossians 3:12 says "Therefore, as God's chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience" (NIV). I feel nothing less from this church and look forward to Sunday morning eagerly. I believe it is this attitude that makes my daughters say that church is their favorite place and Sunday is their favorite day.

On Mondays I run a Mothers Group.
On Tuesdays I attend the weekly Food Giveaway.
On Wednesdays I have dinner with my Life Group and one day my children will attend Youth Group.

This church has many ministries to serve in and opportunities for fellowship, as well as a body that feels like family. I am grateful that God placed me here and think anyone else who was looking for a church would feel the same. Very welcoming family like church. I love the pastors, the members, the messages, and the worship team is absolutely amazing. The Sunday school is a place my children look forward to attending. Very, Very, lonely. I dint know anyone ,and it is Christmas time. They were having a group of people who were making Christmas cookies  for some soldiers that were not going to be home for Christmas. They asked that if anyone would like to help out that they would be making cookies at the church  . I showed up and right away felt in the way. This was a church small home group , but the bulletin said all welcome. One lady would push me with her weight and arms to get me out of her way.The words excuse me would have been understood with out the push. I felt out of place. when they said they needed something from the store I volunteered to go. I even offered  to buy what was needed, after all I wanted to do my part for our soldiers. When I got back they asked what took me so long. I stood for a few minutes ,before I knew I was a outsider.
Tonight I went to their Christmas party. Tree lighting , Christmas Carols ,and cookies. sounded fun.I made rice crispy squares with chocolate on top to share.  When a church says Church family that is really what they mean. I was a outsider even at this Christ celebration . I smiled and tried to talk to a few people, but I was not part of their enter circle. (some were the cookie makers) .
Well, it seems that when they say church family they do mean their church family.
I don't have family and am alone this great holiday season . My friends all have children and grandchildren and even the ones my children and I spent holidays with are now off being grandparents. My daughter spends Christmas with her boyfriends family. She says Churches are cults and God is not real. Boy friends family has $$ . Son ,well he is my protocol child.  Being part of this  church was al the Christmas I was going to have.  I was thinking how nice this was going to be. I couldn't wait for these events. I was looking forward to Christmas eve. That was the best part of Christmas with my children when they were young. All I was looking for was the spirit of Christmas.
not one person said as much as hello.
I am for the most  part a out going person. I volunteer with the sick and the elderly in and out side conversant homes . Have volunteered with the homeless a few times and yesterday I spent the morning volunteering with others to clean up the Greenway at the Santa Rosa creek.  All of these things I enjoy working with others who share the same passions as I do.
I really would like to help with the homeless night at the church. In the summer I hand out frozen water bottles of water  to the homeless or anyone who may be thirsty at a park I enjoy visiting.
Christmas when my children was always fun because we open our home to people who had no were to go for holidays. These were people from churches, the elderly in my neighborhood to people who were volunteering at various Christmas organization because they could not make it hope for some reason. Like Charlie Brown asks "Does anyone know the real meaning of Christmas?"

I doubt that anyone will read this, but marry Christmas anyway. Love it there

reviewSummary:
It is a spiritual sanctuary. I had my first communion here as well as baptizing my 2 children .They  also had their first communion here too. My mother’s funeral mass also here in April 2019. I have had a lot of beautiful memories in this sanctuary. No matter who is the pastor, this church will always feel home to me for those reasons. Keep up the blessed work here at Santa Sophia. My prayers to the clergy and all that keep this church holy and beautiful.❤️ God Bless. Beautiful, classic cathedral style church supporting the local Catholic school and dioces. Beautifully landscaped. An anchor and pillar in the community for decades. Very nice parish church ⛪️ I'm pretty sure this is going to be the new place for my wife and myself. This was my great-grandmother’s, grandmother’s, godparent’s, and great-aunts and uncle’s church. My parents were married here. I was baptized here. My childhood Sundays began here. And it’s the reason I am no longer a Catholic.

The greed of their pastor is incredible. He tried to tell my family that my aunt told him on her death bed that she wanted the church to have enough money for their roof. She never woke up in the hospital to tell anyone anything. He was there for less than 5 minutes while double parked behind the handicapped space. After years of my aunts taking him on trips to Vegas! None of our family have returned to this church after her funeral. He could have just asked for the money without the lies. We knew how devoted she was.

reviewSummary:
The utmost professionalism of any service facility that I have ever witnessed.  These people are very knowledgeable and treat the customer with respect and add some Godliness to their performance
Second to none in greeting and service
Dick Beitel FC Great church with biblical teaching, terrific music team, solid wise leadership, great children & youth programs in a nice building with tea, coffee and light breakfast before service. During a recent soccer trip to Sarasota, we attended Sarasota Christian Church. We arrived 9 minutes late, and the greeters talked to us as if we were early. I was baptized at Sarasota Christian Church in 2013.  Both of my children love going to Sunday school and attended the little preschool here when they were younger.  The staff and members are all so welcoming and kind, you will never feel out of place.  Todd Allen has such great enthusiasm when he delivers his sermons.  This is a great church for anyone at any stage in their life.

reviewSummary: 22 years ago after my dad died, my mom started coming here. She was devastated from that and I had to try to tell her that they were in Heaven. reviewSummary:
Worship very electrifying - awesome presence of God created. Friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Message - relevant, profound and impactful scriptural based. Awesome ambiance. Pastor Wale is super awesome and the members show love. Isn't that what its all about???😍😍😍

Fast forward to 2024- We just enjoyed the Great Gatsby Themed night with RCCG YAYA USA here! God is in this place! Thank you for your labor of love🙏

If you are looking for a local church in the Schaumburg community area, look no further! This is home▶️ I have been blessed to find SCC, by visiting with a friend back in September 2021. And when I tell you I have been blessed. I have been blessed. SCC LOVES GOD FIRST, they teach out of the KJV, Bible, there are departments for the youth, teens & Young adult’s. The CHILDREN & family are Key.

I have how to trust God, & I have learned to Calm down & be patient.  learned so much here. I have never had so much Nigerian food in My life. But one thing ABOUT SCC, we are going to eat in the spirit and natural. WE HAVE THE BEST PASTORS EVER 🙏🏽Apostle Wale & Pastor FOLUKE. Thank You SCC for all You all do the our church & church families & community. Schaumburg Community Church is located in Schaumburg.
It's a nice friendly place to worship. The members are very respectful and receptive irrespective of your race, culture, and  background.
You can worship with them every Sunday.
Ist service commences at 9am-11am, while 2nd service commences at 11am-1pm.
There is usually one service every 1st Sunday of the month which commences at 11am-1pm. Schaumburg Community Church has been an incredible place of spiritual growth and community for me. From the welcoming and inclusive atmosphere to the inspiring sermons and engaging programs, this church has truly enriched my faith journey.

The congregation is warm and friendly, and I've made wonderful friendships here. The leadership is dedicated and passionate about serving the community, and it's evident in their outreach efforts and support for those in need.

Schaumburg Community Church is not just a place of worship; it's a place of belonging and making a positive impact. I'm grateful for the sense of purpose and connection I've found here, and I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a vibrant and welcoming church community.

name: Scottsdale Bible Church at North Ridge - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I've never felt a deeper connection to a church in my life. The way Pastor Jamie Rasmussen & Rustin Rossello resonate with me is unlike anyone I've ever met. It truly is a cathartic experience. I think Sheila below missed the sermon last week about cooperative santification! I'll pray for her. A great place if your ears are itching for a feel good sermon.
Last Sunday’s sermon was about how you don’t have to worry about death because you’re going to heaven. Sadly, the whole part about how to spend your lives here on earth was missing. Nothing about how to walk out the good works set before you, or advice to dive into scripture to maintain a relationship with God, or to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
He says that Paul (the apostle who devoted his life to evangelism!) wasn’t scared of death, so neither should we be. He did say that our bodies are only tents, so not to spend so much time worrying about our bodies - but didn’t get to what should have been the bulk of the message - Focus on God’s kingdom and eternal matters.

Also, this satellite of a mega church does not even offer coffee. You have to buy it - over $5 for a latte!

But, if you want to hear a full orchestra, pay Starbucks prices for a bad cup of coffee, then hear a sermon that mashes you feel good - by all means. This is your church. Great community to get involved in. When I moved to Arizona I felt a part of a great community. I especially felt at home with a great group of young adults that meet regularly which is often hard to find in churches today. Can’t say enough good about this church. You feel at home at the first visit and fall in love with the warmth and kindness of the people and the atmosphere. Attended my friend's celebration of Life and it was a very nice place. Very welcoming and we'll kept.

name: Scottsdale Congregational United Church of Christ - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
Incredibly grateful to find a church that fully stands rooted in Jesus’s principals and what he believes in. Grateful to have found this church and its welcoming congregation.

Mathew 22:35-40
35 One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question: 36 “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”

37 Jesus replied: “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’[c] 38 This is the first and greatest commandment. 39 And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’[d] 40 All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.” Don’t ever reserve the sanctuary here. I called and left messages, nothing! If you stand for everything you'll fall for anything. There are not "many ways up the mountain"
He is the way the truth and the life. Coming to Arizona, I was nervous I wouldn't find a church that was welcoming to me and my identity. But SCUCC has been more friendly and accepting than ever and I feel completely safe there. Shout out to the members there for making me feel like I can be myself in a place of worship when so many places make me feel like I can't be both queer and belong in a church. Truthfully, I've been to one service here many, many, many moons ago. I understand it's a very inclusive place. What it is more known for is hosting jazz concerts EVERY Thursday night in their large community room! For a $6 entry fee, come listen and gyrate to a wide variety of jazz artists, some nationally recognized, some regional, and some local. ALL types of jazz have performed here on a small elevated stage.

Coffee and small deserts are available for low cost. You may also bring in your dinner! Seating is at large round tables for 8-10. Overflow seating is on chairs around the edges of the room. Plan on getting there at least 30 minutes prior to start for a seat...more for really popular groups.  Tonight, We3 is playing, a popular local group, so I'm going early.

Another thing this church is noted for is that it is home to the Scottsdale Neighborhood Arts Place (S.N.A.P.). Run by Lisa, the former classroom wing next to the church houses 6 classrooms that are rented out to dance classes, language learning, artists, energy healers, drumming groups, and a whole range of people and events. I used to teach drawing classes here. I also used it for a one-time introductory event for our trip to Cuba. If you are interested in renting a room for a reasonable fee, contact Lisa on the S.N.A.P. website or the link to it from the church website.

name: Seabreeze Church - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
I had a great time and met people from where I was raised out of state I believe the pastor himself. I was supporting California will be saved leader Ross Johnston last year at the Huntington Beach pier prior Saturday so thought I'd extend my stay as I enjoyed the beach after service the rememberance as the reasons I live. Jesus is Lord. My family has been attending Seabreeze Church for nearly 27 years and we love it.  The pastors are excellent teachers, sharing Biblical truths and how to apply God's word to your life. I look back over these past 27 years and am so grateful for the role Seabreeze has played in leading us closer to God and in following Jesus.

It is warm and welcoming to newcomers and I highly recommend checking it out in person (plus free donuts and coffee on Sundays ). Our family has loved this church for 28 years. When I first  came here, I hadn’t  been a regular part of a church and I had little experience reading the Bible: My family and I felt very welcome from our our first visit. The Sunday messages were so helpful with explaining God’s word, and learning how to apply it to my life. Our children have made great lasting friendships over the years and have had caring, Christ following leaders  in the children's ministry,and later the Youth group.

28 years later, the Sunday messages and weekly growth groups continue to help us to grow in our relationship with Jesus and apply God's word to our lives. We have a great community of people who Love God and love one another . Our grandkids are now a part of the kid's ministry too!
I highly recommend Seabreeze Church I have been going here for a few months now and I absolutely have found my church. From someone who comes from some religious trauma , the message of this church always is to not force anything onto anyone it even says so on their site! The pastors have some very intelligent things to say in the way they interpret gods word and it makes you want to hear more. I’ve been to a few churches but god ultimately called me to this one and I will be here and bring all my kids as well. Love their purpose and message(s). A friendly atmosphere which starts as soon as you turn onto the campus! I told the valets it was my first time and they were glad and welcomed me!
Lance the assistant pastor gave an excellent sermon, the 9am service. I met Andrew the worship leader and his wife Sarah. It was a beautiful service and I am considering membership and will be back next week.

name: Seacoast Community Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Ever since I started coming here a few months ago, Seacoast has felt like home. I love the engaging messages, genuine people, and care whenever I am here, whether that's for regular services on Sunday, or events throughout the week, especially the Young Adults group. If you're looking for an authentic church fellowship which doesn't take itself too seriously, you've found the right place! Anyone who's been to a typical nondenom/Calvary Chapel-type church will really like it here. Most welcoming church community I've ever met. Past Ryan's sermons are inspiring, relatable and always sprinkled with humor. There is always a positive take-home message and concepts to think about. There's volunteer opportunities and many group activities. A great community, can't say enough! Wonderful group of people. So positive, thoughtful and engaged in our community Very welcoming church. The community is strong and the people are friendly! Great ~20 min worship and a nice long sermon to think on. :) Free coffee & tea too! Great smaller community church. My husband and I feel strongly connected here, it’s a family and you don’t just feel like a number. Great church congregation of quality people!

name: Searchlight Ministries - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a one of a kind church.  It has been my home and family for 18 years.  Pastor Mark is a true blue Lutheran pastor who preaches Law and Gospel every sermon, and emphasizes the message that Christ loves you.

-Outreach opportunities
-Group nights for different ages
-Contemporary worship with some liturgy Love my church family! Everyone is welcoming and loves each other. The pastor preaches verse by verse straight from the Bible while offering historical and cultural insights. The Gospel is preached in every sermon because it all points to Jesus! The worship is contemporary with some hymns sprinkled in, and communion is served weekly. Come check it out! I've been attending this church for over 20 years. First, come for the teaching. The pastor, Mark, is not going to pull any punches. He preaches Christ, through the Bible, and his teaching is detailed (he'll even throw in some dad jokes for you to groan, or chuckle at, depending on your age). If you've got questions, Mark loves to talk about them, and, typically, will suggest resources that will discuss several different points of view so that you can dig a little deeper into, what can be, difficult areas of study. Apart from the education, and guidance, the church genuinely cares for you. Drop your preconceptions, bring your questions, and join the family. 😊 If you are looking for a church of friendly people, one that makes you feel good after you leave, Searchlight Ministries is the place you want to attend.  Pastor Mark is not just a preacher, he is a teacher.  You will not leave one of his sermons without learning something about Jesus or the Bible that you didn't know when you walked in. Searchlight is one of Orange County's hidden church gems. I visited this church in partnership with a college ministry, and my impression is that this is a community that feels like a family. People are genuinely very kind and are seeking to reach out to the community and show Jesus' love to people. Welcoming to new people whether you've never encountered God before and are curious or walked with God for a long time.

Jean Johnson I grew up in an extremely religious home but the teachings did not settle in my heart and soul, I always felt like an outsider.  So once I became an adult I struggled to find my spiritual fit.  Then, in 2009 I walked into Seaside and I was HOME.  I am so very grateful for my Seaside family! Open your heart and allow anything to be positively possible If you're a middle-aged divorced woman that thinks crystals can heal you this is the place for you if you're an old dirty hippie you'll be welcome here if you're a emasculated empty shell of a man they'll let you sit in the back. This so-called spiritual center hosted James Arthur ray junior he's the guy that killed those people in the sweat lodge in Arizona. This place like all other religious institutions is just a scam . name: Seaside Community Church UCC - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
How the presence of God in our Lives is the greatest gift of Life was the theme of our sermon by Scott Winters. I love this church: the members, clergy, musicians and visitors who make attending church so engaging and memorable. Seaside Community  Church is a wonderful place to worship.  It is geared towards families and the size of the congregation is small and welcoming.  The sermon's by Pastor Ben are not the fire and brimstone type rather his sermons are engaging and the messages are timely.  The church is highly active in the community with many outreach programs.  Would highly recommend this church. I've been a member of Seaside Community for almost 30 years. The congregation really is a family, so supportive and welcoming to all. They participate in many outreach events both at the church and in the community. Pastor Ben is excellent! His unique perspectives offer great insight to help find direction and navigate life's hurdles. Highly recommend checking out a service... you will be glad you did! My family and I have been members at Seaside for over 20 years.  What a great community to have a family grow up in!  People are supportive and interested in our family's activities outside of church also.  Since we moved to Torrance from other parts of the country, our families are dispersed.  Having Seaside members treat us like family is  very important, especially as our kids were growing up.  If someone in the church, or outside of the church,  has a need, Seaside tries to help.  The Outreach program is outstanding and makes me feel that we are making a difference.  It's casual and an easy place to feel part of! I have been a member of Seaside Community Church for over 43 Years. The members have helped me raise over $200,000 through my benefit piano jazz concerts.  Their support has been invaluable.

Seaside is an open and affirming church and all are welcomed. New comers are consistently greeted with a hug and a handshake.  The church makes music part of the Sunday services and participation is welcomed.

reviewSummary:
Are you kidding me? Been around the entire world and this pastor, Pastor Josh I believe was his name. Incredible, incredible human, incredible preacher, incredible friend to anyone. Whether you are a local of a guest to the island I strongly encourage you to visit this church. Small vibes but growing you can tell at a quick pace. Worship is incredible and the singers have the best vocals on the island arguably. Great message, great vibes, anyone and everyone is welcome and that’s the environment they strive for you can tell. I will be back and I hope some of you do the same! My husband and I just attended a service here before our cruise. We are so glad we did. We loved the sermon by Pastor Josh. He had excellent insight into scripture I never thought about. 2 Kings 13. Striking the arrows into the ground makes no sense, but when we obey God and do what doesn't make sense, there will be a purpose for it.

The worship was also excellent. Really prepared our hearts to receive the Word. Loved everything about this church. I haven't joined the church physically but really enjoy watching it online. It feels as if I'm present every time! I really enjoy the worship and the pastors word. It's a breathe of fresh air each time and if I miss it, which it's only been once, I go back and watch it on YouTube.

I thank God for Seawal Church. For the pastors. But most importantly, I thank God for His endless Peace Mercy and Grace. If you join, I know you will not be disappointed. TITHING AND SOWING IN FERTILE GROUND I KNOW. Throughout my life, I've attended numerous churches, but Seawall Church stands out as truly incomparable. From the moment I enter to the moment I leave, the warmth and kindness of everyone present is remarkable. The services are consistently uplifting, featuring messages that not only resonate deeply but are also delivered with a passion and uniqueness that make them easily understandable. Seawall Church has a special way of making every visit memorable. Thanks pastor Josh and Kat- May God bless you 🙏 Amazing experience!! I visited this church while out of town and I was so happy I did! The church is very diverse, which is important to me. I loved how they encouraged the congregation to greet one another, and it felt very home-like. So sad to say I don’t live near this church, because it would definitely because my home church if I did. Great preaching, all biblical, and passionate. Thank you seawall

name: Second Baptist Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: I visited on January 18, 2026. I enjoyed the service. The choir really sang & the pastor brought the word. I got just what I needed! It was a blessing for me! Thank God & thank you for having me. If I could give less than 1star, I would. I called to ask for help and I got hung up on immediately!!! I became a member of Second Baptist Church and was baptised in 2017. I love worshiping and praising God every Sunday and have been going here ever since. We are new to Las Vegas and reached out to this church to possibly become members. However, I called to simply ask if there was a Men's Ministry and Women's Ministry and was told by administration "I can have someone reach out to you." She didn't seem to know if they had these ministries. This was a simple yes or no question she couldn't answer. I want to give them the benefit of the doubt that she may be is new and just didn't know but I would think knowing what ministries are available at your church is pretty important. I did go to the website to see if I could find them but for some reason I couldn't get the link to open. The person who answered the phone wasn't very warm or friendly so I hope she isn't an example of what to expect if we decide to visit. I won't count them out on our search for a church but I will say I'm reluctant to even visit but I believe in second chances. Hopefully others that call will have a better experience. MY CHURCH HOME. MY RECENT VISIT WAS ON THE 79 YEARS ANNIVERSARY! THIS WAS AN AWESOME DAY WITH THE FAMILY OF GOD!

name: Second Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In March 1968, parishoners shouted "Amen!" from the church pews after Reverend Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. proclaimed that racism was still a glaring reality and that it was "time for somebody in Washington to say we made a mistake in Vietnam." Just weeks later, he was assassinated in Memphis, Tennessee. King received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1964 for his efforts to end segregation and racial discrimination through civil disobedience and other nonviolent means. I learned this recently: “The [Second Baptist] church has been an important force in the Civil Rights Movement, hosting national conventions of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored Persons ("NAACP") in 1928, 1942, and 1949, and also serving as the site of important speeches by Martin Luther King Jr., Malcolm X, and others.” We went here with our high school choir in March 2015 to sing for their congregation. It was an incredibly moving experience, and their entire congregation was so welcoming and kind to us. After the meeting, they served us lunch in the basement of the church, and wouldn't even let us help clean up. These are some of the kindest and most Christ-like people I've ever met. I highly recommend visiting this historic building where Martin Luther King Jr. spoke just three weeks prior to his death. You'll be sure to have a wonderful experience. The rich history, incredible spirit, and caring leaders make this a wonderful Church to attend. Ample seating for large event. Every seat a great seat. Dynamic pastor.  Parking lots near by. Someone I met said that they had a great experience. The choir was so  spirituality uplifting. You feel that CHRIST was in the present

I spent several years deeply involved with Congress WBN events and small groups, so I feel responsible to share what I eventually came to see clearly.

Leadership, centered on Dr. Noel Woodroffe, teaches that he carries a unique “apostolic mandate” and higher spiritual authority than ordinary believers, closer to God than the rest of us. Questioning his direction or teachings was regularly presented as rebellion against God Himself. Over time, many of us were strongly encouraged to limit or end contact with family and friends who didn’t fully support the ministry. Personal decisions, dating, career, finances, even where we lived increasingly required leadership approval. Local churches that partnered with Congress WBN often found themselves expected to hand over significant control and transparency.

The early years felt exhilarating with breakthrough, constant encouragement, and a deep sense of purpose. Later, that same intensity turned into fear; fear of being labeled a backslider, fear of spiritual curses, fear that leaving would mean losing God’s plan for your life. That shift from love to fear is something many former members only recognized after they stepped away.

If any of this sounds familiar, if you feel exhausted from proving your loyalty, watched in your relationships, or afraid to trust your own thoughts, please know those feelings make sense. A genuine spiritual home should give you more freedom, not less. It’s okay to quietly talk with someone completely outside the circle, read stories from others who have left, and decide for yourself what is true.

You deserve peace that doesn’t depend on never disappointing leadership. Wishing everyone reading this real clarity and courage. A place that is lead by the spirit and operates according to biblical principles and patterns. They help build and edify men, women, marriages, and youth to be SENT out to their place of employment, schools, and society to be successful contributors and representatives of Christ. I'm wyatt

name: Seventeenth Church of Christ Scientist
reviewSummary: Designed by Harry Weese, the concrete structure is one of the most unique in downtown Chicago. It also has a one of a kind of worship space that I’ve never seen anything else like before. Definitely worth a peek inside as you walk up Wacker Drive. Attended a Dame Myra Hess Wednesday concert in this beautiful Mid Century Modern Brutalist style sanctuary. Great acoustics, comfortable seating. The members of this church today consider it a privilege and a responsibility to honor the vision of the earlier members and their acclaimed modern architect, Harry Weese, and his team. They are currently making strides to refurbish the space in both large ways (new roof, new lighting, paint, outdoor plaza) and small (removing dings, smudges and stains). The members invite the public to see this well-known building. (Check our website for hours.) All are welcome! First time inside with the architectural tour. A nice building. Visited Chicago for a Rolling Stones concert and was doing some sightseeing. Had seen this church a few times on previous visits and decided to stop in with my dad and look around. Firstly, Debra at the front desk made sure to clarify that it is NOT a church of Scientology. She then gave us a brief tour and history lesson, shared with us her experience in the church, and showed us the incredible organ they have. Incredibly loud and sounds amazing. Not something I usually would have done, but am very glad I did. Even if you are not religious, definitely a place you should visit simply for the architecture. It’s like a trip back in time.

name: Shadow Hills Church - North - North Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Great little facility. If you're not a member and just trying to find a new church home it might not be the best option though. They aren't the most welcoming to anyone new no matter how many Sundays you attend. Full of sinners, like me! Real, beautifully broken people that have been redeemed by our powerful Savior, Jesus Christ. The Pastors humbly and powerfully preach the Word of God, lead us to grow in our intimacy with God, and challenge us to show God's love and kindness to others. The staff and members serve cheerfully, welcome newcomers, and pray for each other. The youth programs are the best in Las Vegas with exceptional leadership. Worship is genuine, mellifluous, remarkably professional, and focused on glorifying God. This has been my church family for over a decade and I'm honored to support and participate in all the church planting, community outreach, and missions (local and oversees) that God has orchestrated through Shadow Hills. God is moving mightily in Las Vegas through this church people! Finding community in a world plagued by loneliness is hard; but it’s here. Authentic community that pushes you to the cross and walks with you in every season; we found that here.
It has been our greatest joy to strengthen our marriage and raise our children here.*

We knew it was home the first week we walked inside.
Gospel centered, humble leadership, genuine connections.
If you’re looking for a home, there’s room for you here.

* As a special needs family, a safe and wholly inclusive environment for disciplining little hearts is a MUST. We found that here too. Having just moved to Vegas I tried several churches before finding Shadow Hills North. The warmth I felt walking in to this church is hard to describe. Everyone was so welcoming.  Worship is amazing! I highly recommend this church that has become my family ! Church 'shopping' is hard and sometime emotionally overwhelming. I went through this process twice, once when my church I called home for many years closed its doors and again when my (now) husband and I were looking for a church to attend together. The first time was so emotional, I was desperately looking for everything to fill this void that had been left after what felt like losing a family member. The second time was a little easier emotionally but trickier because the church we were looking for as a couple needed to meet a few requirements for our family - Strong Biblical Teaching for him; worship that I could get lost in to prepare my heart and connect with God before hearing the word; and a church body that we didn't feel lost in (not too big, not too small). This church has definitely become home for us. The community we found within these walls have become family that we welcome into our home throughout the month. Strong, welcoming community groups/Lyfe Groups/small groups/bible studies, whatever you'd like to call it have cultivated amazingly strong friendships and accountability groups within the church body - we serve our community together, learn together, laugh together, cry together, and (my personal favorite) play games together.

Our youth group that meets weekly rocks - its so amazing to watch these kids love people as we are called to do in the Bible.
The word that Pastor Nathan preaches on Sundays is solid, honest, real, relatable and from the word of God.
The worship is powerful, you can feel God's presence when the whole body of the church is praising Him.
The congregation size is perfect for us - we know almost everybody and we still keep growing!

It's absolutely worth checking out - but keep this in mind, just like trying new food:

Your first bite you there is an expectation and it may seem a little weird.
Your second bite you have a different perspective now that you've had a taste.
By the third bite you should know if you like it - unless there is a surprise ingredient in that bite (i.e. a guest speaker).
The fourth bite will tell you if this is your new favorite meal or not.

We look forward to meeting you and getting to know you!

name: Shadow Mountain Community Church - Encinitas - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church in Encinitas great worship. The people are really friendly. And the pastor is doing a good job running the services! We felt very welcomed. If you’re looking for a church to come this Sunday, please come! If you love Pastor David Jeremiah's solid Biblical teaching, but you prefer a smaller congregation, this is your place. This body of believers will welcome you and you will love them. It is a place to plug in and belong.  There are weekly activities to be part of.  The worship style is a mixture of both classic hymns and new songs.  Plus, you can see the ocean from the parking lot! Reverend Adam greeted us at the entryway even before I finished my coffee and donut. Lots of smiley and friendly people will welcome you and make you feel at home. This place has such a sweet, sincere spirit; warm welcoming atmosphere & truly caring people! Nice to have the benefits of both a large church and a small church at the same time without the general challenges normally based on church size...The best of both worlds! Under the leadership of Dr. David Jeremiah and the campus Pastor Robert Pedroza this is a great choice for a place to grow & go to enjoy worship each week! I hope to see you there soon...Look for me & say, "Hi"! Arrive by 10:15 or so on Sundays to mingle & enjoy well known local treats from VG Doughnuts and Bird Rock Coffee! I’ve been going to this church recently and it’s been such a refreshing experience. It’s a satellite location of Shadow Mountain Community Church, which has its main campus in El Cajon — a solid 30-minute drive from where I live in Del Mar. So having this Encinitas location makes it a lot more accessible, and I’m really grateful for it.

The environment is incredibly peaceful. They don’t use bright overhead lights — instead, natural sunlight fills the main room, giving the space a calm, relaxed atmosphere. Every Sunday, Pastor David Jeremiah appears on the screen with a sermon that’s clear, powerful, and easy to connect with. His ability to break down and communicate God’s word in such a simple, yet profound way is something I really appreciate. They also provide printed notes each week, which makes it easier to follow along and reflect afterward.

Everyone at this location is welcoming and kind — including the local pastor, who brings a warm and positive energy to the space. There’s fresh coffee and donuts available every time I go, which just adds to the comfort and sense of community. It’s a great place to show up just as you are, relax, and spend time growing in your faith.

name: Shadow Mountain Community Church South Bay - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I loved that my son was in VBS this summer.

It’s the third year we’ve been going and they always have an incredible time! All the leaders are very friendly and do everything thinking that the children have fun and besides everything is about Jesus!
Es gratis, es para todas las personas seas o no parte de esa iglesia. Learn about the Bible in the most simple way. The pastor stays within the context and never leans to their own understanding. Great place for the children, they actually learn and have fun at the same time. My friend goes here and invited me to go so I'll be attending one of these Sundays . I picked this church and i'm glad I did!! The church members are very friendly and nice! The sermon is always fantastic,  interesting
and meaningful! Our pastors are great!
The band playing the music and our singer is wonderful!! What more can I say!!🤗🌿🙏🕊🌿 I love my church and everyone is genuinely friendly , Kind and caring.
Pastor Fausto is very personable and always stops to say hello.
The message from Dr. Jeremiah is the best.  He breaks down the Word so anyone can understand and he has a sense of humor.
If your looking for a church to call your home -- check out Shadow Mountain in the South Bay.

name: Shadowbrook Church | Suwanee, GA - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary:
Shadowbrook Church is a Bible-believing, faithful, expositional, verse-by-verse Gospel-centered Church.  It consistently seeks to exalt Christ as the Hero of the Scriptures in every text preached.  Plurality of eldership creates a good and healthy diversity in pastoral teaming.  Warm, friendly members greet you and life groups on/off campus are authentic and growing.  Many young families will also find wisdom from senior saints.
Worship is excellent, creative and Bible-saturated.  I recommend a visit. Incredible community, and so many great opportunities for equipping. I have been going to this church since my first weekend I lived here and never went anywhere else. Highly recommend you try it out if you are looking for a church home in Suwanee We have been attending Shadowbrook since August 2016.  From our very first visit we have felt welcomed.  We truly enjoy Pastor Jerrod's preaching style and our children are thriving in their youth groups.  Shadowbrook sponsors 4 Good News Clubs at local elementary schools.  My son attends one of them and loves that he gets to see the ladies from Good News Club at church on Sundays.  They are all so loving and caring and have such big hearts for Jesus.

If you are looking for a church to visit you won't be disappointed with Shadowbrook.  We absolutely love it there. This is a church that I am so blessed to call my church family. With a strong emphasis on being Gospel-Driven & Gospel-Proclaiming, this is a church that loves bringing the Bible to the heart of its people as we grow in community with each other. The Pastors and Elders do a wonderful job in making sure its people including young children, students, young adults, and adults alike are well equipped in Gospel-centered teaching in both teaching on Sunday mornings and in Life Groups. If you are looking for a church that holds to the truth of the Bible and love being part of a community that seeks to grow alongside one another, I would love to extend an invitation to check this church out! Our family has been attending Shadowbrook church for over 18 years. Our church peaches the gospel verse by verse in the Bible. When you walked in to the church, you will immediately experience the friendly hospitality. We have a great children Sunday school and youth program. Both of our kids attend the Sunday school when they were younger.  We love Shadowbrook church.

name: Shaker Heights Community Church, Inc. - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful church where the Pastor and staff exemplify the teachings of Jesus Christ.  They feed the hungry, and are welcoming to all.  They love their neighbors and the neighborhood.  I had a need and they took care of me and my family.  Truly grateful.  Church is beautiful on the inside and such a wonderful historic pillar in the Shaker Community. Shaker Heights Community Church is my home away from home. Congratulations to Pastor Jackson on his installation.! To God Be All The Glory as this dynamic body of Christ work together faithfully for God's  Divine Purpose ! Sending love and continued prayers  family! Shaker Heights Community Church a wonderful place to be. It's wonderful because this is a place where you are able to come and be accepted, appreciated, and affirmed. The people are warm and the Pastors of this church operate together as a husband and wife team. Because of this dynamic, everyone has access to the best of both worlds. This is a growing church and a good place to be rooted and grounded. I like the atmosphere of this church so far. Its not a big congregation and it feels homely. The people there are warm and welcoming and the preaching is uplifting and relevant to the time we live in. Considering to make it my home church. Great church to make your church home.
Good sound bible based teaching.
Wonderful for families they offer children's church and they also have a women's ministry.

reviewSummary: This church just feels like home! The size is perfect...not too big and not too small.  Everyone is so very welcoming, kind, and non-judgemental.  Staff are all VERY committed to leading others into a life changing relationship with Jesus, while being transparent about their own struggles.  We are so grateful to have this be our family's church home for the past 10 years. Shelter Church is a welcoming community. Shelter church has made such a difference in my life!!! Everyone is so welcoming and down to earth!!! Pastors, sermons and music are great!!! Great church with a really sweet, loving spirit. reviewSummary: Brenda Denise is awesome to work with, what a great event Modern nondenominational church is very welcoming to all. Sanctuary is roomy  with cushioned chairs. They had a wonderful Christmas light show. I was a wonderful presentation for the Modesto community. Thanks for great holiday production!!
