name: Shepherd Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
07/04/2026

I always miss the fireworks show here every 4th of july for 3 years now due to my work but this year I managed to attend. This church seem to be a good one and many people seem to like it.

They had people parachuting, military air planes flying by and beautiful fireworks. The whole Rinaldi street was packed with people. I absolutely love it here! From the first day I came I felt the Holy Spirit. The energy is always So vibrant and I love the preacher. His message always resonates with me. I love that I get to bring my daughter here too because they have a children’s area to the side with TVs in there as well. Great church, always a great service. I highly recommend. If you are looking for a church that remains deeply rooted in scripture, this is a fantastic church to visit. The pastor is excellent, delivering messages that are consistently Bible-based and Jesus-centered. It is refreshing to attend a service where the focus stays so clearly on the Gospel. For me, the person worship is not long enough. There's only two songs with a break and then one more song. Also, there is no prayer offered for up at the end for healing and or Deliverance. However, the atmosphere is very loving and it seems they have a good children and youth center. They also have classes for grief. This is the kind of California church that I had been used to. Honestly it’s been years from stepping back into a church. And this time I was really going with a broken heart. I showed up with my 8 month old daughter. Walking in no one told me about the stroller being an issue, going inside to sit down they stated they’re not allowed in there, which is fine the man took the stroller and put it else where.
My daughter got excited because of the praising music they started with and after I was calming her down by breast feeding her and I’m covered. The man who took the stroller comes to me and tells me “if your kid doesn’t quiet down they will ask you to leave” which I understand yet the way he said it and approached me made me upset. My daughter is already falling asleep breast feeding and makes one more noise and he comes to me again and tells me to leave. Brings my stroller and grabs my diaper bag not giving me a moment to grab my things if not rushed me out. And honestly I am never stepping back into this church. My sister mentioned me regarding the baby care center they have there yet since it was my first time I did not want to just leave her there. She was already getting quiet and I felt like it didn’t matter. She wasn’t even crying she was just grunting. If having children there is an issue then they should state that before entry, just like the stroller. And speak to the people on the floor to be more compassionate before removing someone because the way I was treated did not feel right especially coming from a church.

name: Shepherd Church Simi Valley - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Caleb is so chill and laid back. He keeps it real and when he speaks to you directly..you get the sense of him being honest and you realize he is just like us with everyday issues..but he explains how God has helped him through difficult times and there is hope and salvation for us all..He has helped change my life with a Bible study and teaching at every service that Pastor Caleb makes fun, interesting, and easy to understand. My son Shane and myself have been attending simi shepard for over 2 years now. I was baptized in june 2024 and I am so grateful.. we attend every Sunday at 11:30 and sit in the front row. we love church.. Caleb has made church great again..! thank you and God Bless You All . Patrick Reilly 🙏 Pastor Caleb and the staff here are amazing. I love Shepherd Church because of the structured Bible teaching highly recommend this church. And another thing I love is a sermon notes that keeps me engaged. I truly love this church and am deeply grateful for the community, teaching, kindness, and genuine love for people here. It has been a place of growth, healing, and encouragement for me, and I can honestly say so much good is happening through this church.

One small piece of feedback I wanted to share thoughtfully is regarding the secular music played before and after service. While I understand the intention may be to create a welcoming and upbeat atmosphere, I believe worship music can accomplish the same thing while also keeping hearts and minds centered on God from the moment people walk in until they leave.

There is so much modern worship music today that is uplifting, joyful, musically excellent, and just as engaging or “catchy” as secular music — without pulling our attention back toward the world’s themes, emotions, or atmosphere. Music affects people deeply, often more than we realize, and church feels uniquely special when the environment remains fully focused on Christ throughout the entire experience.

This isn’t coming from a place of criticism at all, but from love and appreciation for what this church already does so well. I’d personally love to see the atmosphere continue moving toward worship, reverence, peace, and spiritual focus from beginning to end.

Thank you for all you do for this community. Awesome church ⛪️ 🙏 🙌  Pastor Caleb is the best. Diverse with great music and message for all. Kids section is also lovely and helpful for parents. Get there early as parking can be a challenge otherwise. A wonderful place, nice people, a very spiritual praise team and excellent worshipers, they really preach only the word of God. Pastor Caleb is young but he is knowledgeable and very committed to the Word of God.

name: Shepherd Church Westwood - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Shepherd Church Westwood is a friendly and welcoming church where you can truly sense the Holy Spirit moving. The teaching and dedication to God’s Word have been a real inspiration to me. I’m grateful to witness what God is doing here, and I look forward to seeing how this church continues to serve His will. Looking for a Bible-sharing and Holy Spirit-filled Christian community of believers who care right by UCLA? Well, look no further, come and experience the love of JESUS at this place. Make sure to say hello to the dynamic and anointed Pastor Daniel Cracium, who’d gladly welcome you, and get you connected with the family of believers, if you’re seeking for one. One of the friendliest churches I have found in Los Angeles! Amazing people. Great worship. Biblical teaching!! An amazing church! Biblical teaching, worship, and fellowship. Convenient for UCLA students too! Great church. Solid biblical teaching. Really good coffee too

name: Shepherd of the Hills - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Our family has been attending Shepherd of the HIlls in Rancho Cucamonga since we moved to the area 35 years ago.  It is a welcoming place with a lot of friendly people.  It's easy to feel at home here.  It is a great place to worship, to learn more about how the word of God speaks to you in your everyday life, to be inspired by God's love for you, and to have fellowship with others. Come join us! I cannot say enough of this beautiful church, and everyone involved. I have been attending for around 3 years. This past year has been tough, and I have not been in person. But the GREAT thing is I can attend online. Not the same as fellowshipping which is so important in my book. I invite all to come and enjoy this beautiful church. As you listen to the gospel you overlook the beautiful mountains, and when a beautiful bird fly's by I feel angels are above.  I truly love it. You will be very happy. Shepherd of the Hills is a WONDERFUL welcoming, Bible teaching, family oriented beautiful Church!!  Our Pastor is an amazing & relatable speaker! Great programs for all ages!! You’ll feel at home & closer to our Lord here at SOTH!! I’m blessed to be part of such an amazing church with such wonderful people. I’m proud to call my family. We are also very blessed to have a pastor whose sermons go beyond words, touching hearts, and inspiring us to live out in God‘s truth. Please come and visit our church and listen to Pastor C‘s sermon. You will not be disappointed. SOTH is the right place to worship, fellowship, and study the Word of God. ✝️

name: Shepherd of the Hills Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
We had our wedding ceremony at this church and it was beautiful! Very spacious for all our guests and a great space for a nearby church to our location. The staff was helpful and worked with us closely to help us make this day great! We are very thankful for this church and being able to use their space for our big day. Lovely place of worship. Very open, welcoming, supportive and spiritual. Preacher Greg rocks! And we love the more laid back culture that still exudes love, inclusion, grace and a heartfelt approach to religion. In addition, aesthetically, it's a beautiful church and serene setting in the woods and nature, which lends itself to reflection and prayer. This is a lovely place to have a wedding and I would highly recommend to anyone looking to have their wedding ceremony in Austin. We had a great experience working with the staff and would come back again in a heartbeat! I came for a bible study and wound up staying for the sermon and having fantastic and meaningful conversations. Jeff is a natural story teller and understands how to make folks feel connected to one another through Christ and through the words of his sermon. Everyone is seeking the same good here and you can feel it bouncing off the walls!

I am moving out of state, but hope that I can find a congregation as amazing as this one with that move. I would recommend to any person looking for genuine good without a single pretense, Shepherd of the Hills will fulfill you on Sunday and help connect you to the peace that God grants through this wonderful community. First and foremost, this church is incredibly welcoming and inclusive. They will embrace you with open arms regardless of your personal beliefs, sexual orientation, creed, color, gender identity, etc. This is not the type of church that will judge you. They also aren't there to indoctrinate you or try to convince you to convert. They aren't trying to fill a quota; they're just happy you're there.

**Brief update: Since lockdown, they have made services available to stream live on Facebook. It's 2022 so the church is open again, but now you also have the option to watch (& even participate to a certain extent) from home.**

My parents started taking me here almost 30 years ago, and now I can't wait to take my own child. The community is so open & welcoming that I truly didn't realize people used religion as a means to judge and tear others down until I was older.
The ministers give amazing sermons, and as the new wave of younger ministers come in I see that same approachability that makes each sermon interesting & easily understandable. You'll be totally involved & rapt in their message (no pun intended). And you won't have to worry that anyone will notice you nodding off because you'll truly be interested in what the minister has to say.
The congregation is so kind, warm, and will welcome you with open arms.

I've attended many difference churches, synagogues, mosques, etc with friends, in other cities, & for religious studies courses in college, and very few rival the warmth and inclusivity of Shepherd of the Hills Christian Church.

name: Shepherd of the Hills United Methodist - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor is warm and earnest and the congregation, welcoming. There is a feeling of fellowship and many opportunities for all ages to get involved. Both Sunday services (traditional and modern) are relaxed. I am comforted and blessed by the worship. I was a member of this church as a youth and have come home as an adult with young children. Our family loves SOTH for its inclusiveness, close-family-like feeling and amazing desire to love everyone. If you're looking for an inclusive environment with a strong history of community involvement this church is for you. I love this church and this church family. They are really caring people and walk the walk. Since I have had to be home bound more, even before Covid, they always check on us and send cards. Our Pastor Karl Stuckenberg is warm, sincere and very approachable. We are blessed to have him as our spiritual leader. If you are looking for a home church, this is the place to be.~Nancy SOTH UMC in Mission Viejo is a beautiful church campus with such features as a peaceful atrium in the main sanctuary, memorial garden, prayer garden and more. And as with all churches, it's really the people that make this a great worship experience. The congregation at SOTH is focused on connecting with Christ and each other and is very committed to outreach in both the local community and beyond. From missions to small groups, Bible studies, music and special events there are endless opportunities to connect and get involved. Nice newer building with all the standard Methodist dogma.  Nice pre-school.  Very closed minded congregation.  They are slow to warm up to newcomers.  If you only want to see your church friends for 45 minutes in church and 15 minutes for coffee, this UMC is for you!

Our Pastor Karl Stuckenberg is warm, sincere and very approachable. We are blessed to have him as our spiritual leader. If you are looking for a home church, this is the place to be.~Nancy SOTH UMC in Mission Viejo is a beautiful church campus with such features as a peaceful atrium in the main sanctuary, memorial garden, prayer garden and more. And as with all churches, it's really the people that make this a great worship experience. The congregation at SOTH is focused on connecting with Christ and each other and is very committed to outreach in both the local community and beyond. From missions to small groups, Bible studies, music and special events there are endless opportunities to connect and get involved. Nice newer building with all the standard Methodist dogma.  Nice pre-school.  Very closed minded congregation.  They are slow to warm up to newcomers.  If you only want to see your church friends for 45 minutes in church and 15 minutes for coffee, this UMC is for you!

name: Shepherd of the Valley Lutheran Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a fine church with a conservative, traditional Missouri Synod Lutheran church message, mixing God's law versus gospel in a very Christian, fair way.  Berating a church and it's Pastor based on a farm that is, to this day, still welcome to grow food and help people, but voluntarily ended it's unbelieveably affordable lease because of the beliefs of the person running the farm, is very unfair to the congregation and to it's leaders.
Before pre-judging the Shepherd of the Valley's message, which is primarily to love one another as Christ loves you, you are entirely welcome to visit and hear and experience God's message  every Sunday at 10am, led by our beloved Pastor Joel Luckemeier.  We will love to see you there! Wow just found out because of this church's pastor a pesticide free farm had to close down.  Imagine an organization showing love to all the people vs this tax free church who only loves it's direct members...wow what a message to share not of live but hate. Guess I'm not surprised it is a church after all Not the kind of Christians I'd like to know- closed down Community Roots Farm because of their closed mindedness. What a shame, totally missing the point of the entire religion and focusing on the wrong things. Pastor Luckemeyer and the congregation are so very thoughtful and welcoming.  A true church home where the Word of God is taught and lived. Pastor Joel is great!   A small, caring, friendly, ,supporting church dedicated to growing in love and faith.

name: Shepherd's House Bible Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending Shepherd’s House Bible Church since the start, and what a blessing that has been for us! Even with rapid church growth, every member remains a priority to our pastors and elders in the shepherding of your soul (2 Timothy 3:16-17, ESV). We are truly known by church leadership, and are forever thankful for their biblical counsel along the way in our personal walk with Christ, marriage, parenting, etc. We also love their Kids’ Ministry, our children truly look forward to going and we feel confident dropping them off knowing what they’re being taught is true, not a watered down program.

If you are looking for a home church, our family cannot recommend Shepherd’s House Bible Church enough! -Team Bryan Super Sweet congregation/ welcome team! We were visiting AZ from TX and were thankful this one was recommended to us by some dear friends! I enjoyed being able to utilize the cry/nursing room with my little one! I also really enjoyed the fact that even though Costi is more of a “celebrity pastor” in the fact that he’s very popular he’s very down to earth and makes himself available to chat with after service! My husband & our 2 adult sons really enjoy this church & it's Pastor, Costi Hinn. He is a sincere teaching Pastor & came out of "Word of Faith/Prosperity Gospel" like we did. He has a powerful testimony you can find on YouTube from about 7 years ago at Redeemer Church. This is it!!
Been coming since December and I wanted to say, for those objective parts in the negative reviews those issues have been adressed. Costi met us and shook everyone’s hand while they served us food at the membership meeting. And after that he took our questions, when I asked him about preaching on Penal Substitutionary Atonement he said he did and two months later on Good Friday he followed through .

He sticks around after every service and I’ve talked to him several times.
Listen to his book to understand what he’s been through and where he’s coming from. This is a guy who left all earthly possessions to sleep on the floor and become a real pastor. He had all the material stuff but cared more about his soul , his relationship with God and the wellbeing of his wife than he did about status and wealth. Something that every maturing Christian should consider familiar when it comes to priorities.

After every sermon you are publicly invited to:
A-approach Costi and the staff to ask questions.
B- go to the prayer team and describe your situation and literally fellowship right then and there.
C-go to the welcome center and talk to someone about the church, the fellowship programs and what it is all about.

In fact , we asked for help about two things right away:
Bringing chairs, they accommodate us every Sunday for 5 months straight.
Meet right away with pastor Brett about a pressing issue without ever being members, it is not members only vibe.

Johnny Mac pushed really hard against the mental health and drug pushing industry to the point he went overboard by denying that mental health issues exist. That is not the case with Costi, he’s in record on his “For the gospel” podcast acknowledging that mental health is real and it should be treated with care and compassion. Something that the negative reviewer didn’t do by using John MacArthur statements to make Shepperds guilty by association. That is a pattern that mimics the spirit of the accuser ( look for the translation of that in Greek in the Bible).

None of the negative reviews are accurate enough and they don’t understand two things.
1. Going to church is not about them. It’s about worshipping God and recognizing who we are. Not about God making you feel better about yourself but about growing to Love God more and that requires maturity and vulnerability. So yes, the Chanti by Shane and Shane “our sins they are many his Mercy is more” is about Gods mercy upon deadly sinners who are destroying His creation, including themselves. If you don’t have the humility to accept that you don’t understand the magnitude of the danger you were in and have not accepted the seriousness of your sin.
2.-Spiritual Maturity looks like pride to those who haven’t been prepared to eat spiritual meat but still require milk, like it says in the book of Hebrews. They find true love repulsive because they have been catered to their whole lives. It’s the customer is always right seeker sensitive mentality. Costi and the Church staff does not have to answer to them. They have to answer to God. And Costi, unlike many pastors actually recalls that he knows he has to meet God to hear what God has to say about whether he did what God commanded and was faithful to shepherd Gods own Bride, the Church. These people don’t understand that the Church belongs to God , not to them and that they are not customers, but they belong to God. A true friend calls you out on your b.s. instead of telling you what you want to hear , and there’s a word for that, sanctification or pruning instead of tickling your ears like it says in Romans 1.

If you are a struggling with the consequences of your sin and to recognize it for what it is, why do you blame a church for your life decisions and expect it to bend to its consequences ? Remember what Jesus says in Mathew 7:13-14: Enter through the narrow gate and the compressed way. For narrow is the gate and narrow is the way that leads to salvation. Christianity is not supposed to be a picnic. Christ reminds us of that, we’re to pick up our cross and follow Him. If you want to learn about the Bible this church it's a great place to start and learn very beautiful people

name: Sherman Oaks Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Members of the congregation where harassing some poor lady on the street who was just filming, made me very uncomfortable bad the church members didn't respect this poor ladies first amendment Amazing pastor and amazing people! I have been going to the 11am service for about a year and half and would recommend this church to anyone looking for a church. I go here for a men's meeting on Monday nights in the fellowship hall and it is a nice facility. That's all I can tell you.... Great warm church love everyone that attends, the pastor is great!! Love this church. Feels like home. PREACH love, PREACH compassion!

name: Sherman Street Christian Church
reviewSummary: We love how welcoming and real Sherman Street is! 💕It is such an incredible place to grow in faith and community. We are so grateful for this Christian community with a heart for justice. Friendliest church I've ever been to in my life.   They have welcomed me like a member of the family. Friendly people Went for a wedding. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Sherwood Oaks Christian Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary:
Good church. Go with my grandparents. They are energetic and entertaining. They don't really do much welcoming for new people though. I feel like you can go in and go out without getting talked to once. They preach a good message, and you always know timing because the sermons are consistently one hour. Yet another church in Bloomington where you're invisible if you're a single middle aged guy. Great sermon on healing and inclusion, but no one spoke to me when I walked up to the "welcome" tables after the service.

Update: The lead pastor Shawn got in touch with me. He didn't make excuses and owned up to areas where they'd dropped the ball. I gave SOCC a 2nd chance and they were more welcoming. The best church with the best people, I was so welcome as an exchange studant there and I will never forget how amazing it was!! Not bad. I typically attend a Unitarian church, but my son’s good friend goes here, so we decided to check out their services.

Cons:
Today’s sermon was based on Dave Matthews Band lyrics and how they relate to scripture. I found it a bit boring and was hoping for something deeper and more inspirational.

Pros:
The pastor’s heart is in the right place, and he’s an excellent public speaker.

A major highlight was seeing how diverse the congregation is. Ironically, more liberal churches often aren’t as diverse. I loved seeing people from all walks of life come together to celebrate shared values.

The musicians are excellent, definitely more fun than singing traditional hymns.

There were a lot of young people, families, and children of all ages. The best staff anywhere!  Worship is top notch and sermons are presented in a relatable, non-condescending way that will touch your heart for sure. Best children's program around as well!

name: Shield of Faith Christian Center - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm and welcoming congregation.  Not too many people in church the day I went. A great place to learn about the Lord Jesus Christ Wonderful, great Christian teaching,small group

Still having great service in the parking lot And on Facebook! You feel the love of the people here. A place that makes you smile. God's presence is there. I love Shield of Faith Pasadena, CA. This church invests in people!

name: Shiloh Baptist Church
reviewSummary: Nice church!! The best church ever. Wonderful house to grow spiritually. This is the best church Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Shiloh Church of God In Christ - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: I have been a member of Shiloh Church of God since 2017. Shiloh is a spirit filled Bible teaching church. We are blessed to have a church that keeps their members active and engaged in their walk with the lord. We have Bible study, Sunday morning service, discipleship, intercessory prayer, children flag worship ministry, Women’s ministry men’s ministry, silver saints Ministry, children’s ministry, marriage enrichment ministry, Food distribution, community outreach, international outreach, Nursing home outreach,  bible drive, blanket drive, socks drive, toys for tot, and Monday night Spanish ministry and coffee with the pastor. Shiloh is a family  oriented environment. We have church picnic, bowling day, movie night, bible family feud time,  and day in an Amusement Boomers. As a member I thank the lord for Pastor Bailey and the leadership. They are led by God to shepherd us with sound doctrine and a humble spirit. Please come and visit us. We are eager to meet you with a warm welcome into the house of the lord. Shiloh COGIC, is an amazing church! The people make you feel at home, and it's like family when you walk in the door. The Pastor is an amazing speaker, leader, father and husband. I have a family of 5 and we've been members since 2011. Great Church Highly recommend. The Pastor & First Lady were very nice. The congregation was very welcoming. HIGHLY RECOMMEND Definitely a Rhema Word.  It's nice to come back to Shiloh Church and see that the spirit of a God remains even with the face lift.  Preach Pastor preach.  Wow.  Amazing The Love and smiling faces. The love...the warmth....the kindness is the presence of God!!

name: Shorelife Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Shorelife isn’t perfect, but no church is. It’s genuine and passionate about Jesus Christ. As someone who’s been welcomed and supported through Shorelife, I can confidently say it’s a Good Church. If you’re looking for a church this is a place full of people who will welcome you every Sunday, you just have to show up! This church and the leaders will always take the initiative to invite you to Bible studies or opportunities to learn more about the Gospel. God bless to those God is inviting to Shorelife! A wonderful community church with a culture of Biblical teaching, discipleship, and missions. We love that it's a community size where you can get to know everyone, be served and have the opportunity to serve others.

Highly recommended for those who are looking for a healthy church and be part of a serving community. Good looking church but weak to follow up after. Wish they can improve on fellowship. Service is ok through the whole time. A lot more action can help but got furniture around near the entrance. This is a wonderful church and our family has called it our home for over 5 years now. The community and fellowship are among my many favorite things about ShoreLife. The preaching is also outstanding, very solid and biblically sound. I love the music and worship time especially. The youth programs are amazing and our kids felt right at home so quickly when we first attended and still to this day. The pastors and their families really care about every single person that comes through the doors and we quickly found ourselves getting plugged into this wonderful community. Great church! People are very warm and welcoming! They teach the gospel message most importantly. Jesus is the way, the truth and the life! We moved to CA almost three years ago and needed to find a home church. After much online research we found Shorelife and wanted to try there first. We as a family loved it so much we never tried anywhere else. They have programs for every age group in the family to meet a families needs. If you are looking for a church to feel a part of and to help you grow in your walk with Christ, I highly recommend Shorelife Huntington Beach.

name: Shoreline Baptist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: A great preschool that's filled with loving and caring teachers. They have a great program that nurtures the kids academically as well as personal growth wise. You get pictures, videos, and message updates of your kid's daily activities. We're very glad to see this preschool has grown in size and hope for it to continue to grow. The word is out on this great preschool! We highly recommend it! The pastor is great, kind, smart and amazing. The people are super awesome. Went for a school choir concert. Handicapped parking was difficult. Their sports program for kids is such a great outlet for kids to learn a new sport, learn how to play in a team and a bit about God at the same time. A great way to let kids break into sports. It might not be for everyone,  but is certainly a safe way to enter into sports and get an introduction to how God wants to know you as an individual. This is a wonderful church, serving Christ by serving the local community. I sent my kids for VBS last month and they loved it. Whenever I saw the staffs, dropping off my kids, everyone looks happy. I guess that's why my kids wanted to go on Sunday as well. (But I can't let them go because we already to go our church:)) Thank you so much for all the hard works for VBS!

name: Shoreline Church - Monterey Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church in the area. They have great service. Great facility. Lots of rooms for the kids and various programs. They host many, many programs and support services. It ls so refreshing to see a local church have so much involvement in the community, positive influence and tangible benefits for community members in need. From their food pantry, clothing and blanket service, school, study groups, grief counseling, recovery services, guidance counseling, events, military focused groups, marriage support, out of church programs, etc. etc. you just have to look at their website for their many services and events. The outdoor seating option on nice days is a wonderful way to experience church. The children’s rooms where parents can sit with children and allow them to play quietly while experiencing service was genius! This on top of the traditional Sunday school child check in option. There are so many programs and activities for the kids that are wonderful. The people are so very friendly from the volunteers, staff and community members and guests. People seem to be happy to be here, find a peace. I moved here from San Jose about 25 years ago.  I was blessed to find Shoreline when they were located out of York School. I have seen all the amazing changes the LORD has done for Shoreline.  I can say I have never felt so at home in a church ever. All the pastors are incredible.  ( starting with Pastor Howie the founding pastor).  The music is beautiful!  The holy spirit speaks to me while I am listening to a sermon.... so this is why I know I found my church. :) So awesome. Attending for 2+ years-just exactly what a church should be! This pastor was so great when we visited,  we tune in weekly via youtube. Music was uplifting.  Very clean. A friend gifted a Christmas Eve Service invite and I really enjoyed it. I found a seat in between two very accommodating ladies It was a no pressure visit. I liked the sermon and also the singer had an amazingly beautiful voice
Parking was pretty but I found a spot.

name: Shoreline Community Church - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Scott and his team always make me feel welcomed Quaint community church in mountain view Great sermons

name: Shorepoint Church
reviewSummary:
Shorepoint church has been our home for 3 years now and has pointed us to a deeper relationship with Jesus, given us an amazing church family, and provided us & our children with biblical truths to stand on and carry out in this world. Pastor Brian and the whole staff at Shorepoint are welcoming, give all the glory to Jesus & stand on the truths of the Bible. There is no doubt the Holy Spirit is alive and flowing in and around the people at Shorepoint. We love our church because they point us to Jesus. The only thing that truly matters. We love Shorepoint!! We started attending in 2021 after our son was born, and from the very beginning we felt genuinely welcomed. Pastor Brian and Bethany are incredibly personable, kind, and approachable—you can truly tell they care about people. Our very first Sunday attending in person, Pastor Brian came up and introduced himself to us, which meant so much.

The church is made up of people from all different faith backgrounds and generations, which creates a really healthy and welcoming environment. The preaching is thoughtful and rooted in Scripture, with great cultural and historical context that helps the Bible come alive. Shorepoint is a Spirit-filled church with a non-denominational feel while aligning with Assemblies of God beliefs, which we’ve really appreciated.

There are so many opportunities to get connected through groups that fit different stages of life and interests, and that sense of community is what really helped us decide to call Shorepoint home. We’ve seen so much growth in the church over the past few years and are excited about what’s ahead, including plans for a future church building. Love this church! I leave there on Sundays feeling so full of love, peace and so thankful! Ive participated in a few small groups and got so much out of them. Everyone is so welcoming. My husband and I come from 2 different backgrounds with our faith, both very rooted in religion. We were looking for a church that emphasized relationship with God and TRUE Biblical teachings that bring freedom. We were sick of the churches that we weren’t growing in.

Shorepoint’s mission and teachings have kept us coming back because we haven’t found anything out there quite like it.  We have exponentially grown in our faith, finding so much joy in freedom in our lives. This is the first church that I have attended that is as close to me as family.

Pastor Brian and Bethany are truly the best pastors I have ever had in my 40+ years in the faith. His teachings are always spot on, and he keeps my attention and my ADHD from getting the best of me! I’ve become a note taker because his messages are so rich and enlightening… a perfect amount of conviction AND oh so freeing!!

Pastor Brian’s love, energy, and passion for people and the Lord is SO genuine and palpable! My biggest advice, GET INVOLVED! This church is amazing!! This is a church you can call home!! My family moved back to the area in 2021 and after visiting a couple of churches, we started attending Shorepoint.

A couple of things we love:

1. Biblical teaching - There is nothing the enemy wants more, than for the body of Christ to shy away from Biblical truth. In a time where it would be easy to water down what the Bible says, or reduce sermons to advice on how to have a good life, I'm grateful for the conviction leadership has around teaching from the Bible (with context).

2. Missional values - Every week I hear "we exist to lead people into an authentic and life changing relationship with Jesus Christ". That's great, but what I really love is that every week I see the church living out that mission. From the pastor giving the sermon to the Sunday school volunteer, there is an alignment in seeing people reached for Jesus.

3. Community - It's always hard stepping into a new environment where people seem to know each other. My wife and I prayed, and took steps (initially out of our comfort zone) of joining small groups and volunteer teams full of unfamiliar faces. Before long we found ourselves surrounded by friends that we know and love.

4. Multi-generational - I love that this church has diverse age representation. There are so many times over the past few years that I've needed guidance (work, family etc.) and been able to connect with someone that's already stepped through the season I'm in. It's one of those things that I didn't really think about until I needed it, and now looking back it's been a huge blessing.

In short, this church has provided a great space for me to learn, grow, and build relationships that I will cherish for the rest of my life.

name: Short North Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Everything was as advertised. The venue snd music were top notch. We had a great time! Absolutely beautiful experience! The Candlelight concert created such a magical and intimate atmosphere — the venue filled with soft candlelight made everything feel calm, elegant, and unforgettable.

The musicians were incredibly talented and played with so much emotion and precision. Every piece sounded amazing, and you could really feel the passion behind the performance.

It was the perfect combination of music, ambiance, and overall vibe. Whether you go alone, with friends, or for a romantic evening, it’s definitely worth it.

Highly recommend — I will 100% be coming back again! The candlelight was such a wonderful atmosphere for the great concert.  We enjoyed it all immensely! Fever was wonderful as always!! We look forward to another concert! From the venue, to the amazing layout of the candles inside the venue, to the exceptional musicians in the string Quartet, tonight's program was absolutely amazing. Five stars hardly does it justice. I would highly recommend this concert to anyone giving it some thought. My daughter is an accomplished celloist, and she enjoyed every note that was played! It was an evening featuring a quartet of talented musicians playing an eclectic selection of 90s hits in the beautiful venue of the Short North Church candlelit with hundreds of candles.

name: Shrine of the Presentation - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
The first ray of dawn in the morning is beautiful at the gate of the church Beautiful liturgy and hymns.
This is a wonderful Parish. No mass times anyplace!
Please let us all know.
Thank you! Nice little church in corona.. went for a funeral for a family member Best church ! Parking is great !

name: Sierra Grace Fellowship - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary: Solid Bible teaching Church!  I highly recommend! Great church, love people and most of all love Jesus. My kids love going to AWANA Club on Sunday evenings. They are very welcoming, friendly and warm hearted. They reflect love and light to those who come here. We are blessed to have friends in this church. The slides are wonderful, whoever does slides the 4th Sunday of the month is really talented Parked here at the parking lot at 8:50 pm trying to find directions and a staff member came yelling at me to get off “private” property. He started to call names, flip me off, and threatens to call the cops. Small, friendly, Christ-focused church. Two Sunday services, 9 and 10:45. Other activities for youth and fellowship throughout the week.

name: Sierra Vista Baptist Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Love it I've ben going there since I was a kid and they have a kid area where they can learn the basics of God Small church, friendly people, God's Word and that alone - Love it!

name: Silicon Valley Christian Assembly - Santa Clara Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been at SVCA for a long time. In the beginning, I came simply to attend church, but over time I grew to love this home with all my heart. The reason is simple—I know that God’s presence is here. I have felt it, and I have experienced it.

I thank the Lord for the many brothers and sisters here who love Him deeply, and for the faithful teaching of God’s Word that nourishes His people. At this church, we can come before the Lord with sincerity and devotion, and we can truly experience His work in our lives.

My hope is that those in the Bay Area who are still searching—those who feel lost or wandering—will be able to find the Lord’s home here. Nice place to worship God with the presence of Holy Spirit. People can find small groups to connect even if you are not a believer. Love this church!!! All welcome!!! You will find Jesus here. SVCA is the place where I was baptized and reborn, it is a place full of blessings and peace, a place full of people who are willing to serve the God, a place God prepared and guarding. No matter you're young or old, happy or sorrowful, Christian or non-Christian, please come to this church, there is always a place for you in this family.

Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.                                                  --------------  Matthew 7:7

name: Siloam Christian Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a beautiful church so uplifting. The music is great. Everyone is friendly, kind and considerate.
It's a great place for families to attend. There's something for.  Every age every race is a very. Welcome in church. The pastor when he does. A sermon's, it is so good. I was visiting from another local Church to support a Brother who was speaking that morning.  Siloam's Pastor Brown,  Staff & Members were all a joy to be around.  The worship was heartfelt,  praise was exuberant and it was a very welcoming, friendly and Spirit filled atmosphere. For those with safety/health concerns, Siloam did seat using social distancing guidelines & does ask that if you choose to sit in the main sanctuary, that you wear a mask,  but does offer alternative seating for those that choose not to wear one.  They accommodated everyone!!
If you are looking for a solid place of worship,  with a firm and unapologetic stand for the Gospel,  then you'll love Siloam Christian Church! Went to witness a friends baptism and what a friendly happy bunch non judgemental and welcoming. Pastor Mr Ottis Brown did a great sermon i will happily visit this church again Attended a wedding at Siloam Christian Church. A wonderful celebration of Love for each. I knew the groom. A man of God, as is the members. A spirit filled Church. There is no better place to call my religious home- people who  attend here all know Pastor Brown is impressive- the neighbors are always in awe; his sermons resonate deeply for  every one

name: Silver Lake Community Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love this church! It’s such a warm and welcoming place. Pastor Kyle has a great way of making the readings engaging and never boring. I really appreciate that they offer a baby/kids area, so little ones have a place to go while parents can fully enjoy the service. It makes the whole experience so much more comfortable for families. A wonderful church in Silver Lake. Very welcoming community with a strong spirit of volunteering and support. They truly care and help people in need. Grateful to be part of this place. Awesome place: mobile showers and hot meals and donated clothes on Saturday starting at 10 am til 2 pm and in the circle steps area an AA meeting from 11 am to 12:30~1 pm, Hot food also on Wednesday along with a food bank out of the back that offers taking it to your drive-up vehicle, as well as other services I don't actively use, but I know they have. It is the greatest place on Earth. If you're an individua who's in need of a little to get you back on your feet. I recommend going. Don't expect a great transformation . It only happens to those who do something about it. No this place is for peace of mind and people who are there  to  give you peace of mind. So big shout out to those who wake up everyday and help. Much Luv ya. PEACE Really enjoyed Catholic religious service very peaceful tight-knit community

name: Silverado United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up at this church. Loved every minute spent there. One day I will return to my home church. Church falling apart

name: Silverlake Church - Pearland Campus
reviewSummary:
Attended Services for a great friend Curtis Bernard Wilson, June 27, 1959-May 21, 2026. A great friend and walked his faith journey to the end. It was a Great Celebration of Life. First time attending service. Let the usher know ow when I entered. She guided me through the process smoothly. I will be back for a Sunday visit. My friend always bragged on the fact that his Pastor Devaugh Sr. was a Man of God, and also a close friend that dispensed invaluable advice throughout his tenure on this side. Well done my faithful friend.. Rest Into Paradise. First impression to be very honest the greater did not smile or seem friendly not at the door but the ones in the sanctuary entrance I was surprised at that. Pastor Vaughn was excellent as usual. Since then I noticed the greeters smile much more. I’m very interested in joining. I truly love this church as a child I'm 37 now I went to this church three days out of the week Bible study, youth choir etc. There is even video of me at church service in the choir the year of 2006. Jared Greed and I had a duo dance routine. I would cry when I couldn't attend. I have been a member for over 20 yrs.  I really enjoy the way my pastor teaches and breaks down the word to us.  He is truly a man of god. I enjoy my Silverlake family. I’m a member of Silverlake Church and recently returned after taking a four-year break due to raising my young children. This morning 6/1/2025, I attended the 8 AM service with my oldest, who is four years old. I truly enjoyed the service, although I had to leave a little early.

Before leaving, I stopped by the Kids Center to ask about enrolling my children so I can fully participate in future services. I was warmly welcomed by Mrs. Tasha, who was incredibly kind and helpful. She answered all of my questions and made me feel very comfortable with the idea of placing my children there during service. I also inquired about the Christian Academy, and she recommended I stop by the INFO Desk for more details.

At around 9:20 AM, my daughter and I went to the INFO Desk, where three women were standing. When I reached the front, one of them directed another to assist me. She looked up and asked how she could help. I explained I was looking for more information about the Christian Academy. Her response was, “Do you have internet?” I said I do, but that I was told to come here for more information. She replied that she didn’t know anything about the program and asked who told me to come. When I mentioned Mrs. Tasha, she picked up a phone and said she would be speaking with her to ensure people are given the correct information.

She reiterated that I’d need to look online, as all the information is there, but what stood out most was her dismissive and rude tone. It was disheartening, especially with my daughter watching—this being her very first experience at church. Unfortunately, the interaction left such a negative impression that I knew I wouldn’t feel comfortable leaving my children in a place where someone with that kind of attitude represents the church.

I had hoped to receive helpful and welcoming guidance about the academy, but instead left feeling upset and discouraged. I won’t ever be approaching the INFO Desk again for assistance, and I sincerely hope no other visitors have to experience what my daughter and I experienced.

name: Simple Church - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Aaron brings an inspired, Spirit filled Word that's colored with one of a kind humor and passion for his Savior.  The people are respectful, generous and kind.  Whether you're new in your faith walk or a seasoned believer, Simple Church is a wonderful place to call home. My very first church home. I love all of the people so much! The worship is great and the messages are always on time. Best part, short and sweet! I love that Simple Church is VERY active in the community! More than just a building at Simple Church :) Church used to mean dressing up, showing up and getting out of there. It used to mean no one invested in anyone else. It used to mean no one really cared. Simple Church changed all that. It now means come as you are, bring in all your sins, feel safe to open up your soul, and fill up your heart. People ask how you are doing and really want to know. They recognize that people are unique and are open to help you explore your heart and spiritual gifts. It has become an additional family and is full of love! I’ve been to a lot of different churches over the years and I can honestly say this is the first church where I’ve felt a true sense of community and belonging. I asked the community for church recommendations and it was actually the creative pastor that reached out to me and personally invited me to attend. The first few weeks my family went, the people sitting around us were genuinely invested in us, asking and remembering our names, getting to know us, seeing how our week went. It’s really a welcoming feeling when you know the people you’re doing church with are also people that are willing to do life with you too. Not to mention the heart and love the leadership has for the community. When they see a need they find ways to fill that need, especially during this pandemic. I also should mention this is the first church where my oldest has been comfortable going and tells me he is excited to go and learn and participate. And for a very introverted 2nd grader, this is huge for him. I have loved watching the growth of Simple Church.  The one thing that has remained in their growth is the love for their community.  Pastor Aaron not only helps his church and community, he helps others around the country.  We are truly blessed to by the example Simple Church shows through their love.

name: Skybreak Church - College Station Campus
reviewSummary:
A severe safety hazard that leadership is completely ignoring.

​I can no longer attend Skybreak Church due to dangerously high decibel levels during worship. Even sitting far back close to the exit doors, the volume is incredibly loud. From that distance, I have personally witnessed people walk through the doors and immediately turn around and leave as soon as the music starts, multiple times.
​After going to the front for prayer, the extreme volume caused me to experience a loss of hearing in my left ear. It was a terrifying medical scare.
​The music is routinely mixed so loud that the bleachers literally vibrate, and you can see the vocalists on stage visibly straining and shouting just to be heard over the instruments. This is a massive liability and a direct threat to the health of the congregation especially the infants and small children sitting in the front rows exposed to these damaging noise levels.
​Members have brought this to the pastor's attention multiple times, and other public reviews have warned them about this exact issue for over six months, yet leadership treats it lightly and refuses to make changes. Because of this, many long-time members are actively leaving. Worship should be a refreshing experience to praise God, not a health hazard. I have found a new church home where worship is beautiful, safe, and respectful of the congregation’s well being. Walking into a church for the first time you expect to feel welcomed and comfortable. Unfortunately that was not my experience here.

The moment you arrive everything feels very controlled. There is a specific way they want you to park and a specific place they want you to sit. As a visitor it made me feel more like I was following a rulebook than attending a worship service. A little warmth and flexibility would go a long way toward making new people feel like they actually belong there.

The music was also really difficult to get through. The volume is cranked up so high that it becomes more of a distraction than anything else. Instead of feeling moved by worship I was mostly just focused on how uncomfortable it was. There is a big difference between powerful and overwhelming, and unfortunately this leaned way too far in the wrong direction.

What is also worth mentioning is that they never respond to any of the reviews left here. That says a lot. If a church truly cares about its congregation and the people walking through its doors, it would at least acknowledge the concerns being raised. The silence makes it seem like the feedback just does not matter to them.

Church is supposed to be a place where people feel free to come as they are. This experience felt like the opposite of that. I hope the leadership takes visitor feedback seriously because there is definitely room to grow in how they welcome people through the doors. I’ve never felt more at home. The energy is top tier!! You feel welcomed, loved, seen and included!!

I found my forever church home!! I feel conflicted about leaving a two-star review for the church overall, but I think someone from the staff should know about this. The music in this church is very loud, and while I'm not against loud music in general, I believe the volume takes away from the true worship experience.
I'm not the only person who feels this way, and I truly think someone more professional should be behind the sound booth. You can tell that the singers on stage are straining to shout over the loud music. Even during quieter parts, such as when announcements are made, you can barely hear the speaker.
If you listen to the live broadcast on YouTube, you'll hear the difference: the music is overwhelmingly loud, but then the preacher is so quiet that you have to turn the volume up several notches.
I've been to Skybreak many times, and I like the preaching, but worshiping, for me and some other people I spoke with has been a struggle. You should be able to hear yourself sing, because your mind needs to engage with the words coming out of your mouth as an act of glorifying God. People should be more engaged during worship, and when connecting with others, they should be able to talk freely in a normal voice.
The first time I came, the bleachers were literally shaking, and I thought my ears were going to bleed.
Really, someone should review the decibel levels and better balance them with the voices. As it stands, it creates an unpleasant worship experience. We love Skybreak! This church has blessed our family so much and we look forward to service and going to our small group! If you're looking for a great worship experience, a church that is focused on family, serving, discovering your purpose and looking for ways you can make a difference in the lives of others around you - this is the place to go!

reviewSummary:
Skycrest Community Church is a Family Friendly place for all ages. They often have events to bring us together 💗 SUCH things as Student Camp June 22 to 26th this 2026. Easter Egg 🥚 Hunt March 28th 12:30pm - 2:30pm 2026; Good Friday Special Event on April 3rd at 12pm and Easter Sunday with Two Services 8:30am and 10:30am The worship service is a meaningful and uplifting time with a community of believers. Meeting in Connection Groups (Bible Study) on Sunday morning is a great opportunity to share insights and learn from others. Everyone is so friendly and the Pastoral staff are very encouraging!

If you are looking for a church, come and visit and experience being a part of the family of God! Skycrest Community Church is a truly special place! The worship is powerful, the teaching is inspiring, and the community is warm and welcoming. My family loves being part of this church—our kids have an amazing time, and we all continue to grow in faith.

Skycrest is committed to Making Friends, Meeting Needs, and Making Disciples, and it shows in everything they do. If you're looking for a church that feels like home, this is the place!

#SkycrestCommunity #FaithFamily #GreatWorship Pastor Chris has never failed to give a thought-provoking sermon. I have found the members of this church to be authentic, loving, kind people. If you are looking for a church home, definitely visit here. You will feel welcomed and glad you came. A warm, bible teaching and believing church.  Authentic people - if you're looking for a local church - visit Skycrest a few times.  The current pastor, Pastor Chris Stephens, has a brilliant way of teaching and equipping that will never leave you bored.  There are plenty of small group studies to choose from as well.  If you see me in the pews Sunday morning, don't hesitate to stop by and say hi.  :- )

reviewSummary: A loving congregation for locals and visitors alike. We were in town for a festival and decided to worship there on Sunday morning before driving nearly 4 hours home. Pastor was uplifting and church members made us feel welcome. They also have an impressive Hispanic ministry and services in Spanish. I love Skyland! It's a loving, Holy Spirit-filled church that I'm blessed to say is part of my family. I've grown so much in my relationship with God here - the ministry is powerful and life-changing! This is my church home! I love the pastor, the church family and the entire environment! Very Holy Spirit filled and loving! The best place to be...for praise, worship and fellowship!!! Sweet little neighborhood church with enormous Love and great delivery ❤️ Good service and bleed of people

name: Skyline Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Ask yourself this. Does your church right now give warmth and a welcomed feeling? If not come here they have plenty to go around for you and for your family. It's really fun for all ages and they have kids service, a youth service, and a service for the adults with a family room for people with little ones. ❤️❤️ Absolutely love this church! Been going here since it was 7SD in lakeside and Jeremy is definitely one of the most influential motivating pastors I’ve experienced. Lots of scripture in his sermons and every week is just amazing. My sister now works for the school and I volunteer as much as I can. This church is such a blessing for the community. Today was a sermon on greed and the pastor assumed people can live off 50% of their income and pushed tithing as they often do. If this church wasn’t in such a wealthy area I doubt people would be fine with them pushing for you to empty your pockets. They also push their app on you often multiple during the prayer I prefer prayer and speaking to congregations to be separate as it makes the prayer feel less sacred. This is a mega church not very down to earth in my eyes more focused on a big show, advertising, and money extraction. A wonderful church I have been attending for 5 years. You will feel welcomed and enjoy the atmosphere. Pastor Jeremy is a great preacher. We love our Skyline family!   Good people that are here to serve the Lord and our community.  We have never felt so connected to Jesus as we do at Skyline.  Saved people serve people, and that is exactly what we do here everyday.  If you want teaching based on the Scriptures, this is may very well be your home.

name: Skyway Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you for giving us food this Christmas 2025! We were in such need. The line of cars here reminded me of those pictures of the Great Depression, in the 40s. I guess with the War in Ukraine, and Gaza, we suffer here at home. Merry Christmas! God bless. 🙏 I work very hard . On the weekends I am able to take my clients to church as I work in a group home . Skyway isn't exactly a mega church , but it is rather moderate in size and have a security team . I have to keep eyes on my clients every few minutes and the security team assists me in this endeavor , so that I can actually  enjoy the services . It has made my life so much easier on Sundays .
My clients are able to worship the way they need to, and sit where they feel comfortable .  I have one less concern for that one hour out of the week that helps keep me spiritually fit.
It is very much a family environment . A father and son team .
They have embraced our situation without judgement . We have visited other churches and did not receive such a warm welcome.
Depending on your spiritual views , wants and/or needs , Skyway Church might be the breath of fresh air that you need.

On a side note

For those that are comfortable raising their hand ,  they give a little gift bag for first time visitors. That meant the world to one of my clients. Come as you are , dress how you need to dress , just show up . You will likely be grateful that you did . Everyone is so welcoming, especially at the door. Great church to serve our lord The parishioners here are amazing. They love on you, they pray for you and genuinely wish you well. They serve with a joyful heart and giving spirit. I've been searching for a church home and I am eager to go back to visit and worship with them. The minute you walk into Skyway Church you’re welcomed and greeted like you’re family. You immediately sense the presence of God in the sanctuary. The music and praise team is pretty amazing. The atmosphere is lively and people are friendly. Pastor Greg is a great leader and teacher of the Word. His messages both edify and encourage; I truly appreciate his humor. Several classes are offered for you to grow spiritually.  There's a place for everyone.

name: Smithfield United Church of Christ
reviewSummary: As a preteen and adult, i have felt and witnessed nothing but kindness, love, and scripture acted out. These church is historical and compassionate. I feel honored to say that this was where i chose to be baptized in my youth, and i know that i learned from people who truly honored Jesus’ teachings. I’m very excited to make room in my schedule to attend again soon. Always food for thought. A loving Christ and a spiritual way of looking at life Nice church but very poor winter shelter for the homeless. There's more space for the men than the women. And I know that this is a low barrier place, but they even allow people soaked and caked in fecal matter and urine inside and don't make them wash. Everyone else just has to breathe in those toxic chemicals and they wonder why people are sick. So if you're homeless and need a place to stay, come here but be prepared to smell and breathe in feces and urine and staff tell you they can't do anything else. Wonderful, thought provoking sermons that manage to entertain yet pull no punches. Pastor Doug is a gifted speaker. Truly welcoming community. Half of the choir are members of the Pittsburgh opera. That alone is worth an hour of your time on Sunday. If you haven't visited with Jesus for awhile, Smithfield is the perfect place to become reacquainted and get inspired. I miss worshiping at the church. Pastor Doug Patterson is an inspiring speaker and person. Rev Cherian is also inspiring. The music is beautiful and the church is gorgeous. I find great peace and solace there. Rev Doug is inclusive and welcomes all. It is a wonderful experience. This is a true Pittsburgh treasure.

Non-denominational church, Bible only taught, very friendly congregation! Very welcoming congregation.

name: Smoky Hill Vineyard Church - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been coming to Smoky Hill Vineyard for about two years now, and I love it. Sunday mornings are so much more than just a service, they are an experience with God. The worship is always beautiful and moving. Greg (the pastor) has a way of speaking God's message in a way that everyone can understand and relate to. What I find most powerful is that at the end of each service there are people to pray for you and whatever you may be going through. Sundays are just the beginning of what Smoky Hill Vineyard has to offer. There are so many different community groups and classes to get involved in. SHV does a great job at providing a place for people to connect and walk in faith together. I highly recommend that you come check out Smoky Hill Vineyard! My family has been going to Smoky Hill Vineyard for almost a year now and we love it. The worship is moving and the message is relevant. We have a 13 yr old who is enjoying  and learning a lot in the vibrant youth group. The children's program is organized, safe and fun for our 8 yr old too. The leaders are down to earth and approachable. Everyone is super welcoming and they have so many ways to get involved and meet new people. Smoky Hill Vineyard is a church of action!  Great and trustworthy leaders.  I have seen 1st hand how they help the community.  This church is changing lives :) Marriages are being saved, broken people are being put back together, people are getting fed spiritually and physically through one of the largest on sight food banks!  They keep it simple.  It is all about following Jesus! I have been going to the Vineyard for about 10 yrs now. My husband and I had moved to the area and decided we wanted our young daughter to know Jesus. I myself did not grow up going to church. I had read the book Purpose Driven Live and decided it was time I see what this is all about. Church was new to me and it was important we as a family feel a connection. After attending the first time, I knew I had found the place I want to call "my church".

The Vineyard is contemporary and offers something for everyone. They have a great youth group, tons of small groups that cater to everything you can think of. What I love the most is they focus on our community as a whole. The Food Bank has become a resource that has grown in abundance over the years.

Nobody is unwelcome here. My wife and I, have attended Smoky Hill Vineyard for over 11 years now and am impressed with the Pastors and the Volunteers.  The church community are welcoming and inviting, my wife and I have three children who also love the church.  The teaching, small groups, classes and youth program are all top notch.

name: Smyrna Christian Church - Smyrna / Vinings Campus
reviewSummary: New preacher and hearts for the Lord! If you are looking for a place to serve alongside of other followers of Jesus and to be loved as Jesus loves you this is the right place for you! A congregation of Christ followers, seeking to share their love for Christ with their community. ✝️ Very friendly people and wonderful message on who Jesus is. Great preaching LeaveMeAlone 1🧿🧿🧿🧿🧿🧿🧿🧿1

name: Snellville Christian Church - Snellville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love SCC. For 7 years, we have been blessed to be a part of this community filled with unique perspectives and journeys. A main message is to follow Christ and love others. The youth and children’s spaces are inviting, and we love to see so many different people worshipping God and living life together. Great small church that is focused more on impact than politics. Offers a lot to the community, including clothing closet, access to event space, and produce giveaways. Efficient and relevant service structure, pastor is very down to earth and among the congregation. Highly recommend visiting on a Sunday at 10:30. This place is awesome! Strong biblically based teaching and great people. If you haven't gone, you should. Music is great too. Snellville Christian Church is a loving, Humble, Caring Family!
Pastor Dale does not only Preach but Teaches us how to be Desciples 💗 This is the Best Church I have ever been to.
Thank you so much, Snellville Christian Church, for being so kind and welcoming.
You just have to be there to feel it for yourself.
Thanks be to God!!! Thank you everyone for welcoming me to the church. I enjoy the Sunday morning service,  it’s given me a good start for the week ahead. The church it’s like a big warm family embraces you with hugs. It  is an honor  and pleasure to see you all every Sunday morning. . Again 🙏

name: Snellville Community Church - Snellville Campus
reviewSummary:
Had a FANTASTIC experience at their Vacation Bible School! All of the volunteers were so kind and made my son feel welcome. As a parent I never was worried about my 5 year Olds safety or if he had fun. The biggest bonus is that they included dinner! (Pizza, chickfila and subway sandwiches were some examples!) Highly recommend for kids programs. I have attended this church from time to time over 25 years. It has many good ministries and classes, and is consistently involved with the community. The traditional service is liturgy-heavy, and the sanctuary is dark wood, with a cloistered feeling. It seems ancient, and reminds me that folks have been worshiping like this for centuries, which I regard with awe. There are many classes, ministries and groups to join here. I'm glad that it is an active part of the community all week long. The Dec 18, 2017 at 9:30 was absolutely awesome!! May have been the best service I ever attended, ever! Pator James is wonderful and the worship team is awesome.  It took us a long time and many churches to call this one home. Our twins are going to this school for a year now  and we all love it. The teachers truly love the kids. I feel very safe sending my twins over there. They are all amazing. From the teachers to Ms Debbie the director, to Ms Jackie... they are always welcoming you with a smile, always answering to any of your concern.
And the girls learned so much in a year, they were always coming back home with something new that they did.
The twins were excited to go there, every time.
I would like to thank everybody, especially Ms Christina and Ms Courtnie. Community engagement and youth enrichment is here

name: SoCal Assembly of God Network Office - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: If you want to go deeper and study the Word of God with amazing instructors and Pastors this is the place.  Whether you want to get credentialed or simply desire to know more about the Old and New Testaments, the SoCal School of Ministry is an excellent choice and a wonderful experience that is offered through the SoCal A/G Network👍✝️ Pastor Rich came to Higher Vision Church. Good message on evangelism. He was very funny too! I had a great LOL! We need more funny pastors like him! A profoundly different and impressive experience meeting with John and Tom this morning regarding church outreach. This is the beginning of a new day! Great set of leaders for a wonderful group of churches. A/G is full of competent and Godly leadership. Amazing, spirit-filled and great leaders and teachers. Best education given.
