name: Society Church - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
I had such a great experience at Society Church. From the moment I walked in, everyone was so welcoming and friendly, which made me feel comfortable right away. The atmosphere felt warm, uplifting, and genuinely inviting. The message really resonated with me, and the worship was inspiring. You can tell this is a place where people truly care and want you to feel included. I left feeling encouraged and already looking forward to coming back. We have been going to Society since 2019 and cannot say enough about this church, the people in it, and most importantly, how clearly God is at work here. The leadership is exceptional in both character and the way they teach/model Christ’s love. This church represents the diversity of Sacramento so well and is a safe and welcoming space for all including those who aren’t yet believers! Love this new church out here in Elk Grove! The pastor and his wife are such great people! The worship is fantastic, very modern music and my wife and I loved ever part of this great church! I can’t wait to see what the future holds for the new church!

Also, very covid safe, masks are worn, temperature checks. And they have an online service, and honestly it’s good to check it, because that’s how we decided to come and check the church in person, because the message was legit. Sean is killing it!! Feels so good to see church like this here in the Sacremento Area. I didn't get to hear the pastor preach.  He had a member speak and/or witness their personal experience.  The music was okay.  I have physical issues and found the sitting situation unbearable because the seats were very uncomfortable for me.  To be fair, I'd need to attend again to hope to hear the pastor preach and bring a chair cushion. Society church is an incredible place to safely explore your faith and get into community. I have been attending for over a year since moving to Sac and the people have been so welcoming and fun. They do awesome kids camps and kids programs. It is a great place for families, couples, and anyone at any stage of life. I love that Tim and Josh preach the Bible and really get into the Word of God! The church has such a heart to seek the welfare of Sacramento and you see that happen every week. So happy to call Society Church my church!

name: Sojourn Church Midtown - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
The Spirit dwells powerfully in this communion of Christ's disciples.

I was visiting town and spent a service here. It was such a beautiful experience that I wished I lived nearby so I could attend regularly.

The people were warm and genuine in their fellowship. I saw Brothers and Sisters praying together for each other before the service. People clearly knew each other and about each other's lives and were happy to connect.

The music was spectacular - seriously - the team there is blessed with incredible gifts from God and they very obviously are glorifying Him in their worship.  Relevant scripture was pronounced between songs, which made it all feel connected.

The preaching was biblical, convicting, inspiring, and also relatable.

The sanctuary is beautifully renovated and maintained while preserving the older character.

Communion was taken in a lovely and meaningful way.

I didn't get to experience the groups and ministries but - from what I saw in that service - I'm sure they would be very worthwhile to check out.

Well done, Sojourners. Keep doing what you're doing for your community.

Thank you for welcoming me for a moment. It felt like a visit home with family in our Father's house. Very nice Church building,always Clean, Good people and the Preaching is Biblical. The Praise Team rotates Weekly,but, that never changes their love for Jesus,or their Worship. Plan to attend a 9a.m. or 11 a.m. Service, now,for Next Week,you'll be Glad you did!  I'll save You a seat up Front! Great place for attending worship service and building spiritual community. Attendees are of mix race and it does give vibes of heaven with multi race, language and ages diversity. Message is focused and doctrinated from the Bible, no personal opinion and ideas, but preached from Divine's revelation. I love the servanthood attitude and character of leaders including the main pastor. I Love everyone and I love the service and different events they have got throughout the year. They got two services 9 am to 10:30s and 11 am to 12:30s. Don't worry, if English is your main excuse of not joining the service, we all learn and grow. And if you don't have peers and company to attend service, then come and visit and make one. Just come, see and taste it. Went there to vote. Plenty of parking. Easy in and out. First time visiting. Everyone was very friendly. They did have complimentary coffee. I liked how they did the communion at the end of the service.

name: Sojourn East Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has helped me but made me feel like I was being super judged and looked down upon every time I asked! They made me feel like I was an inconvenience to them I have 9 children and 2 more that I have custody of because their mother just passed away well long story short im in a really bad place in my life this last few years had been challenging I have a son with cancer and a child with autism also 2 grieving children and I have my hands full just caring for all of them making appointments I am barley keeping my lights on and I chose between my water and dinner this week! And I was sent a form for Christmas assistance and I feel these people singled my family out and told me they could not offer any services to help me any more! Probably the most needy family they have ever helped it's really sad that YOu rich people sit and treat a mother thats really struggling g that way ! You are making my children suffer more than anything shame on you! Julie was the best person that your church has ever had!! And since she  has left yall are just not the same! I go to church here so I may be biased, but this is the best church I've been to. The services are God-focused and we'll put together, but not too show. The sermons are the best part, getting to hear God's word like I haven't before. I also volunteer with childcare which is always a blessing. Come check us out! Great atmosphere. Awesome caring people. Went to the eyeglass clinic they had last Saturday. Someone from the congregation helped me thru the whole process. She even helped me with my 9 month old while i was having my eye exam. I wouldnt have been able to have the exam without her help. Very nice and caring people at Sojourn East. Solid church, preaching Truth, while also focusing on being a light to the community and celebrating the beauty of God's creation through creative expression.  Great children's ministry, as well! This community church has no idea what community means.
I have never dealt with any organization who has such disregard for the people in their ‘community’.
They are completely disorganized.
They do not care how their actions effect the ‘community’ around them.
To say they do not ‘practice what they preach’
is an understatement.

name: Sojourner Church, PCA Jackson, MS - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church and the pastor Nate Stevenson. They really believe in God and love people very much. Its not forced it's just their nature. So if your looking for a well rounded church home sojouner church is the the home you need. Stay blessed and keep God first. Really enjoined pastor and Monday bible study.

name: Sola Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a hidden gem!!!  They’ve just started this church and it meets in the Joslyn Park Auditorium-adjacent to the dog park.  The teaching is world class-biblically solid, insightful, with lots of application.  The worship is excellent!  Don’t judge by its small beginnings, this church is going to grow!   It’s welcoming to ALL, and the people are so warm and friendly.  They even have an area for people to enjoy the service outside, with their dogs, under a canopy.  The children’s ministry is adorable.  Parking is plentiful on 7th street, between Kensington and Strand. Sola Church is a MUST visit, you won’t be disappointed!!! SoLA Church, a place where anyone can believe and everyone belongs. Pastor Allen and his wife Miranda are very welcoming and non-judgmental. Pastor Allen’s ministry is very enlightening. He explains the Bible teachings in ways we can understand. Miranda, with her wonderful singing ability, leads worship. You leave church feeling uplifted and feeling you are not alone; you have someone who cares and will walk with you through any issues you may have. Give it a try!! I love everything about SoLA church. The church where everyone can believe and everyone belongs. I love the people, the fellowship, the teaching of the Word of God and last but certainly not least praise and worship. The music is absolutely heavenly. It definitely takes you to a place of spiritual ecstasy. Pastor Allen’s wife, Mirand has been blessed with a beautiful voice. I look forward to hearing her sing every Sunday. On our first visit we were blown away by how welcoming the members are. We love that the teachings each Sunday are truly Bible driven and for real world application. I thank God for SoLA because in every service I know we will hear Gods Words no matter what’s going on in the world. I know Gods love, His Word and His people are in this place. It’s amazing that Pastor Allen and his wife does so much and give back so much to the community. I love that. You can feel the Spirit of God moving in this place. I told Pastor Allen that on my very first visit. There is peace, love and harmony here. The thing I love most about this church is the evidence I find abundantly testifying is the fact that this is where God’s will is for my husband and I. The peace that comes from the confidence and assurance of being where God wants us to is extraordinarily comforting. SoLA has been an amazing place to worship on Sunday mornings. I had been unchurched for over 10 years looking for a place that would accept ME and my wife. Sola was just that place. They welcomed us with open arms and an open heart. They don’t focus on our “lifestyle” but help me focus on my relationship with God! The teaching is outstanding! My knowledge has grown leaps and bounds as well as my relationship with Jesus. This doesn’t feel churchy but more like a warm hug full of loving people, who love God. We are small now, but HUGE in love, support and acceptance. Check it out! Coming to SOLA means getting to enjoy true fellowship as well as solid Bible teaching week after week.  We have been attending for about a year now and have made some very positive friendships and creative Bible studies.    If you are looking to get involved in a small church context, SOLA is the place for you and your family.

name: Solid Rock Christian Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Real Church. My  Journey starts  in the  year of 2000 . Meeting Pastor  Joe And his Wife  Kathy , has been  won of the greatest  things  to happen in my  life . Being  a recovered drug addict with many times of falling back into my addiction, they have been there for me, always only wanting the best and God's best. They love me when I was unlovable. Spoke the truth in love.
When I didn't want to hear it here. Without solid rock pastor Joe and kathy and most of all Jesus christ I would  be Dead, spiritually definitely physically .Are church ⛪️  preaches the word of God as the bible speaks it 🙏  it's a Family  Church. We share are joys trials.
And experiences with each other.
And we do all overcome. If you're reading this i hope you can join us to experience
What I am living in my life.The power of Jesus christ .Thank you Pastor  Joe ,Kathy with your a Faithfulness  to The LORDS  calling  to Ministry and  Solid  Rock. See  ya Sunday 😊 🙏🙌👏 Solid Rock Christian Church is truly a place where faith comes alive. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re greeted with warmth, love, and a genuine sense of family. The worship is uplifting and Spirit-filled, creating an atmosphere where you can truly connect with God. The teaching is powerful, rooted in Scripture, and full of practical wisdom that helps you grow deeper in your walk with Christ. Every service leaves you encouraged, challenged, and inspired to live out God’s Word in your daily life. Solid Rock isn’t just a church—it’s a community where lives are transformed, and where you can truly experience God’s presence and purpose. I love to attend the service after.  I learn a lot and the worship time is sooo amazing. I love pastor Joe and Kathy, his wife, they are the sweetest people in town. 💕 Great church! Pastor Joe teaches the Bible very well and in a way that is easy to understand. I love Solid Rock. Is my family for years. Thank you for all guys, all the blessing, all the support, all the prayers. I love you guys 💛

name: Solid Rock Church
reviewSummary: Multi-generational westside church family characterized by passionate spirit-led worship, compassionate local outreach, and thriving youth and children programs.

name: Son Light Christian Center - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Passive aggressive vibe to get here. Not much welcome to get till after service. Unstable to walk through the church. Helps to upgrade overall on spacing. Some events offered here though. I have loved Son Light and Pastor Joe and Nancy for at least 45 yrs now!! Son Light is always my home Church even though I live in Palm Springs now. I view Sunday Services and daily devotions online almost daily!! I’ve never been able to find a Pastors Sermons that compare with Pastor Joe!!
The Church was built by Cecil B Demille many years ago and of course was a Theater then. It’s so Historic and beautiful and a must see if you are in Orange , Orange County CA!! I attended Son Light starting at the age of 5. I am almost 41 and life has moved me to the other side of the country. But I can say, I still have friends there, I still have contact with some of my childhood youth group friends and I have yet to find a place of worship like Son Light. The ministry is right on. Pastor Joe Magliato is the exact same man off stage as he is on stage. His wife and their children all live their lives with what they preach. this is a solid ministry. I miss them greatly. This is the ministry that is truly unconditionally unconditional. Come as you are, you are valid, you are valuable, you are desired, you are deeply loved. I was truly saved in Son Light. I got saved in June 1989. I had been in California for one day I got saved playing the board game Risk that was on a Friday  on that Sunday I got baptised. That Sunday by Pastor Joe. I love this church. I went to church everytime it was open. I volunteered for everything. Went for at least a year became a salesman for a Christian company. I was a minimum wage worker prior to God giving me a life and a career. I have recruited trained and managed over 2000 sales people between 2003 and 2010.
I traveled home to Chicago for my grand mother's funeral. I desided to move back to Chicago to marry my ex girl friend. I realized after that first year I had to get married well I moved back and 7 months later I married a completely different lady I was 21 and she was 33 from the outside it didn't look like a good fit.z Her husband died several years before.  Well she got saved in her kitchen with me and she was a friend of my aunts. God had a plan I needed to get married because temptation was unbelievable. We have been married for 32 years. We had 2 kids. My life has been better a miracle I had an 8 the grade education.
I built a company in 47 months I employed about  79 people I started the company with six thousand dollars I sold the business for over a million dollars 47 months later.Hiw only God could have doith e is unbelievable. Pastor Joe gave me a good foundation and a code to live by with rules and making decisions based on right and wrong. God put Pastor Joe in Son light to changed my thinking and to be an example of  how 8 am supposed to carry myself. He didn't know it but I studied him from a distant.  He knew what he knew and that was the deal God is  not open for debate. I returned about 7 or 8 years ago and went to a mens Bible study. I talked to pastor Joe and he didn't remember me. I look so much different if I had a picture from 1989 he would have said i remember. It's great that everyone always loud and brash. So the fact I was so well behaved I never made a scene. My name is George Dodson
If you are looking for a new way of life. You never have to feel the way you may feel right now.  All the best to you on. Your journey. Love sonlight raised all my kids here now there grown & have fond memories of the love & kindness they received here, infact they dont want to go to any other church, i had moved away & stopped going for a good 6 years but the good lord brought me & my kids back as for the commentor that its a rasist church so not true im of mixed race & never got that indication. One bad person or experience doesnt make it a racist church infact all different races go to son light. Family based & owned church with lots of history, what a blessing!

name: Sonrise Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: I had the wonderful privilege of speaking at this year’s Brave and Bold men’s retreat hosted by Andrew Talamantez and the wonderful Staff at the beautiful Sonrise church. My family and I have been coming here for over a year now and members of the church have taken time to get to know us. We love coming to the 930 service and staying after to talk to other members and let the kiddos have some cookies (: I've always felt moved by the messages and they make it relatable I've gotten to really love this church. I have attended Sonrise Church for 11 years.  I love it and find the messages and music are ways to renew and grow my faith each week. Although Sonrise is a big church we try to make it friendly and personal, a place where new visitors are welcome. Been coming here for the past few weekends it's a nice church with friendly people Love the message, the parishioners, the music, and the beliefs of the church. We are a warm and welcoming church home.

name: Soul City Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m writing this review because Google searches and other reviews can leave the impression that Soul City Church is an LGBTQ+ affirming church. It is not. Unless you’re asking direct questions about church policy or digging deeper, you may never know that.

According to the church’s stated policies, which can be verified through Church Clarity, LGBTQ+ people cannot participate on equal terms. They cannot be employed in certain roles, have their marriages recognized, or fully participate in all aspects of church life. Everyone is welcome to attend and give financially, but that is not the same as being fully affirmed.

If you’re specifically looking for an affirming church, I hope this review helps you make an informed decision before you visit. I’m writing this review as a warning for those who are actually looking for the true God not the “God” of the world. First time going to this church and I was instantly appalled in the first few minutes of the sermon which was all about wealth and finances. I left the church knowing more about finances than I did about the word of God. This “church” is more focused on serving the people of the world than actually preaching the word of God. As mentioned in Mathew 15:8-9. It is important as believers to be mindful of these churches that claim to be doing Gods work because the enemy knows scripture too and will twist and turn the truth to fit their agenda. 1 John 4:1-6. I have specific preferences for a sermon. I want the pastor to read the Bible verse, tell what it meant to people in the day and finally tell parishioners what it means today and how to follow.  Simple, they nailed it (no pun intended). And they wrapped up service in an hour. Really welcoming atmosphere. I found a church home! What a really nice church! I was in the city with my brother celebrating his and my sister birthday. After brunch, I was going to drop him off at his church then go home. I decided to walk in with him to check it out. I wasn’t planning on staying but the worship, the sermon, and atmosphere really kept me interested. It was a very diverse crowd (a big PLUS) and very hipster. The people were chill. I would go again. As a biracial american, I find it hard at times to find community within non denominational churches. But, Soul City truly shows diversity and love towards ALL Image bearers. I am so grateful to have found Soul City and have been serving/attending for almost a year now. They have programs like Alpha which helps create a safe space and conversation for non believers that have questions about Christianity. They have the house of hope to help the homeless. They have many friendly staff that interacts with you if you have questions. If you are looking for a new church, I would strongly recommend Soul City for inclusion, biblical teaching, and a church that truly loves on his community.

name: Sound House Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I began attending Sound House Church about 3 years ago. What a blessing it has been!! Shortly after my first attendance I made it my home church. I love that it's not just a church on Sunday. They have outreaches, bible studies, community groups, and a great program for kids! Pastor Ryan teaches from the Bible and delivers God's word in a way that is understandable and relatable. Associate Pastor Chad does the same. For me Sunday service would not be complete without some praise and worship. You should see (or maybe hear) the amazing Worship team!! If you're looking for a good church with solid values and a friendly congregation you should give Sound House a try. We love Sound House Church.   We don’t live in Southern California, but visit there 4-5 times a year and never miss a Sunday when we are there!  Everyone is very friendly and welcoming.  Ryan’s message always resonates.  We drive away after service and my husband and I always say that if we lived in Southern California, Sound House would be our home church. My husband and I have been attending Soundhouse for years and now our kids love attending! There has always been and continues to be the most welcoming community that I immediately felt from our first Sunday visiting. From the worship and message to the kids programs and women's ministry, I love every aspect of this church. I've gotten to know so many friends through the community groups they host throughout the year in a more casual setting and I can't tell you how blessed I've been by the new mom group, MomCo, and the various women's events and retreats. My kids love VBS every summer and there are so many other fun events throughout the year that we look forward to. If you're looking for a church in Long Beach for your family, definitely give this one a try! Our family has been involved at Sound House for almost four years. We've been so grateful for this community. It's been so exciting to be a part of a growing church. We love the worship, message, and kids ministry. Coffee and donuts every Sunday, yes please! My husband and I visited Sound House when we first moved to Long Beach. We felt welcome from the moment we arrived and we soon made Sound House our church home. We love the community here!

name: South Austin Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming! And I thank Mr Melvin Banks for speaking at my mother's funeral. Listening to the word of God is where I need to be!!! Greatest place on earth

name: South Baton Rouge Church of Christ - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
What a community. I was welcomed into the youth group in August, 2020. A short 16 months later, I have met the greatest and closest people in my life. If you’re looking for a Protestant Sunday morning home, this is that house that looks like all the others, but the inside is purely golden. Extremely loving people. When I moved into town they helped me get situated, and set up a meal train delivereing my family dinners for 2 weeks. I've never experienced anything like this and I've been to quite a few churches.

Sermons are biblically deep and strong in application. Worship is passionate and spirit filled. The children's ministry (which has two incredible children's ministers) is getting a revamp and full reconstruction/renovation. Great trustworthy youth programs all around.

Love South and am happy to call it my home! This has been my church home for thirty years and I love the way we have followed God’s leading through the years. This is my family! I always go to services and this is a very caring and loving family of Jesus. Such a loving  group of Christian brothers and sisters!

name: South Bay Bible Chapel - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: South Bay Celebration Assembly - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: This church is family... 💕 Been with Pastor Woody for years since they were in Lynwood... When I say family, I mean they are there for you and your family when no one else is... 🙏🏽 I pray everyone has this at their own church and if you don't have a church family come by and get to know us. 😊 The emotional and mental support is great here. You will always leave here spiritually fed. Sometimes physically fed too...😂  Food bank available after the 11 o'clock service... Come by! Great place to pray and worship the Lord Friendly Pastors and deacons living a life filled with the Holy Spirit. I loooooooooooooove💞💞💞💞💞 that they always help everyone in their community. They cater to the kids. They install positive morals and values to make the right decisions as our kids go through life. Pastor Phil and Pastor teach you about the Bible on an level you can understand. Thank you Pastor Phil and Pastor Janie for welcoming me and my family in to you home and treating us like were part of your family. This is a very comfortable place Pastor Phil and wife Janie are both very nice people, they are always inviting people to the Sunday Service at 11:00 and they have a class for the kids. They so Celebrations of Life with lots of love and food. Great place. My family and I love pastor Woody I've been going to his church for years. If you want to know what loving others looks like come here 🥰🥰🥰

name: South Bay Christian Alliance - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m a FTM, and for Mother’s Day, I decided to attend and check out South Bay Christian Alliance Church alongside my friend and her son — she’s also a FTM like me. Before coming to this church, I had been longing to find a church family, and I truly felt like God was leading me here.

Everyone was so welcoming from the moment we arrived. I especially loved that they have a baby nursery room because, as a breastfeeding mom, I was able to feed my son and let him nap comfortably while still listening to the sermon.

The ladies there were so kind, loving, and caring. After church, they had lunch, and they even made me a plate 🥹 Their kindness truly touched my heart.

I LOVE this church and the people here, and I look forward to continuing to attend. Thank You, Jesus 🤍 Wonderful church and welcoming environment. I love how community focused SBCA is and how rooted they are in the truth of the Bible. Our kids love the Sunday school program, and it's nice they have a large nursery for our baby. The worship team is always full of joy and Pastor Jeff's sermons are both informative and interesting. Couldn't recommend enough. the quality of the sermons here is top-notch, engaging, and truly impactful. the welcoming community and genuine atmosphere make every visit special. Incredible experience, great community, wonderful worship. Will definitely be coming back. Thanks Jeff for making me feel so welcome!

name: South Bay Christian Community - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
"A Place to Belong"

Very friendly church.  Messages each week are timely, from the heart, and true to the word of God.  Down to earth membership here, as well.   A comfortable and caring place. An Awesome place to worship. The music is good, the people are friendly and the message was honest and applicable for today.

name: South Bay Church of God - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
We have a NEW Pastor, his name is Len & his wife is Beth, they are beautiful, kind, and caring people💕this Church is small, but we care and welcome new guests. Please come join us & see for yourself ❣️ Spanish service starts at 9 am & end with coffee ☕️ & pastry🍩🍪🍮
English service begins at 11 am. This is a wonderful church contributes a lot to the neighborhood everybody is invited to all of their events Halloween is fun they set their parking lot up for the kids to play and give out candy and toys as well as hotdogs and beverages it has been there for quite a while Sundays are a little bit crowded due to many weddings plenty of parking located on a small residential street. Beautiful, loving people.  They show the love of Jesus all the time.  Fun loving and giving.  I recommend South Bay Church of God. 2 thumbs up. Wonderful people, great atmosphere, Christ center church, and biblical doctrine, great contemporary worship. I am so glad to be a part of this awesome chuch. Watch out for your elderly the woman in the Spanish speaking service will take advantage of them and take there money.they took someone I knew for 80,000 in about 9 months before I found out and put a stop to it.

name: South Bay Church of the Brethren - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Blessings to them and there help with the homeless

name: South Bay Community Church - Fremont Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been looking for a church home since relocating from Delaware when I could be spiritually mentally and physically nourished and found it the first visit which was not a service but a Harvest event. Walking in the door greeted by the members speaking to the members but above all I felt Gods presence in this building and this is where God has guided me. I was deployed to the Bay Area to cover for a colleague whose spouse was going to have surgery in the subsequent week. It turned out that I was asked to stay through the weekend and the first half of the following week. So on Sunday 11/25/19 I googled "churches near me" and SBCC was among those on my search results and after reading the website I knew the Lord had me on the right path (as usual). At the entrance of the building I was greeted at the door by a gentleman with a warm handshake and a friendly smile. I was greeted at the Sanctuary door by an equally friendly younglady and an even friendlier smile if there is such a thing. I was seated in the far left of the stage but had a good line of sight to the people on the stage. The Praise and Worship Team were amazing, singing spirit lifting songs that gave glory to the most High God and I felt my spirit being uplifted and filled with joy! I was feeling a little homesick for my wife and children and this service was just what the Doctor ordered! Service was filled with BIBLE teachings  and thats what I enjoyed most of all about the message that was filled with truth, delivered by an anointed man of God. After service I was greeted by several members who recognized me as a visitor and I appreciated the members of this house of God. I recieved a very nice gift and a pleasant conversation from the two ladies at the Welcome center in the main foyer. And then unexpectedly and an added bonus nontheless I was treated to a delicious culinary delight courtesy of Darryl and Dave! There was Baked and Fried Chicken(of which was the Bomb because when I came through the line it was all gone😫 lol) its ok though everything else on the menu changed my diappointment to a joyous celebration sans coq frite. I carried my weighty plate of Baked chicken, Green beans, Mac n Cheese, and dressing with the most delicious and flavorful Holiday gravy I have ever tasted in my life (no offense mom) to a table and fellowshiped with more of the nice people of SBCC. Overall this was a wonderful experience that has set my week off to a great start. Like Pastor said "There are no accidents!" A wonderful church with very friendly and giving members. I really enjoyed the company of Karen she went Way Beyond my expectations in making me feel welcomed. Very enlightening and I enjoy the sermons. I have learned and still learning the word and being a doer of the word. I still struggle but I keep pressing on. Thanks to this church
Sincerely yours
Lashanda Owens Thoroughly enjoyed the Church, meeting some of its Congregation, and the Awesome Play put on by Jeanette Wills & Company!

name: South Bay Community Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
SBCC is a growing church, now with four services. The blessed thing about it is that they aren't chasing growth in people numbers, they are focused on growing each individual's knowledge of scripture and personal faith in Christ. They primarily teach through books of the Bible (rather than have constant "themed" messages). This is critical in teaching because going verse-by-verse forces the teacher to address the full beauty of God's word, from the good to the uncomfortable, from the basic truths to the challenging sections.

The pastoral staff and the overall staff are very friendly, approachable, and most importantly, prayerful. This is not a high-pressure church at all, it's Spirit-lead, organic maybe. They accept each person as they come and are dedicated to teaching each person in a way that is simple but with outstanding depth. I have never felt shamed or condemned by the messages, just convicted in way that points to my shortcomings but fills with hope in my future, strength in my walk, and the joy promises of God's love, mercy, and patience with us. First time visiting this church today and it was amazing. Found it on Google. The folks were very nice, lots of attendees, children's church is available and snacks and refreshments are available.  They do have life groups that you can connect to during the week. I will be back next week. SBCC is a great place to find God and Salvation through Faith in Jesus Christ.  SBCC provides an loving and supportive community of people dedicated to living and serving our lives to show the existence of the Holy Spirit working through us to help the world 🌎 find God! ! Amen! PTL! Hallelujah!! Glory be to God!

It’s an Awesome Place to Be! I just attended a celebration of life for a friend and the pastor was amazing I wish I lived closer to this church this is a community of love and friendship. The best church in the South Bay. All of the pastors do a great job of tying everything in scripture to our daily lives as well as making you feel welcome and appreciated.

Highly recommend if you are either new to the area or are choosing to follow Christ in a larger church setting!

name: South Bay Mission Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m biased because I’ve been attending this church for 13-14 years (since it was first planted). We’ve moved locations several times, but the mission has always remained the same: building and growing gospel-centered community.

The preaching is solid where each sermon ties back to what Jesus did for us on the cross. Our pastors often go through entire books (both OT and NT) for each sermon series.

We’re far from perfect, so apologies if you visited and didn’t feel welcomed. There’s plenty of other great churches in the area as well :) Amazing place with great vibes! Everyone is so cool and they totally hook you up! highly recommend and they also have ping pong Of course the church members are going to 5 star the church. It's run down. Service didn't call out to me.

name: South Bay Pentecostal Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Tremendous Pentecostal church in the San Diego Bay area - great worship, powerful preaching, very friendly folks - God is doing great things at South Bay!! A very good church wirh a very good pastor and congregation.  Most of the people have the gift of speaking in tongues. Awesome leadership. Welcoming and wonderful church. So glad we were able to visit while we were in town. Great church. Great people. Truly the one church where I've felt loved the minute I walked in. The pastor of the church has been pastoring there for over forty years.

The people are friendly and treat you well. They will try to go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and welcome.

The singing and worship services are great. The worship is genuine and there is a sweet presence of the Lord that can be felt.

The congregation really knows how to worship and you can feel the presence of the Lord in a mighty way.

The pastor is friendly and makes you feel welcome. He is very likable and you can feel a genuine  anointing as he is preaching. He loves and cares about people and you can see that and feel that from him.

I highly recommend this church and I will definitely visit again  when I am in that area.

name: South Bay Presbyterian Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful service, congregation very friendly and you won't leave hungry (in body or spirit)! Hope to visit again someday. Good church....  good  pastor..
Lovely people. Super friendly congregation

name: South Bay United Pentecostal - Food Distribution Center - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful church loving and giving faithful  people of God also spirit filled pastor Amado Hauzar thank you God. I love this church I go there I feel the holy spirt very friendly pastors are nice u can feel the love of Jesus crist go try it see it feel it Have been Blessed to find southbay pentecostal church a family church that loves God and preaches the truth pastor Art -Hodgeslll  a  great mam of God.

name: South Bend City Church - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary: I get being progressive but when you start changing God's pronouns to fit some agenda its beyond blasphemous. I would have recommended this place a month ago but the true colors and messaging finally showed through. This is no longer a church of God but of self serving and pride. This is the first church in a very long time that I've actually been able to call home. Pastor Jay and all the staff are amazing people. Everybody can belong here. This place is open, honest, and welcoming of many. This community focuses on positive changes in the community, and growth from within, not trying to change you and who you are. They will love you, and let you live, and conviction can come from positive conversations, not from preaching fire and brimstone. This place is going to become a great resource for this city. Wonderful place to recharge your life. No guilting and other noise so popular in stereotypical services. Come here if you need a break from life's hectic pace and pressures. It will be well worth your time. Five star experience. Visited this church for the first time ever today.  Was very impressed by Jason the pastor.  Also the congregation were very friendly.  Lots of youth and adults similar in age to me (36).  I am looking forward to many more visits to this wonderful church.

name: South Broadway Christian Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
My name is Donna
I kind of live in the neighborhood I am by Broadway and Alameda
Anyway I been thinking about stopping by one of these Sundays I use to go to
to open door fellowship what time does your services start on Sunday mornings and what is your dress code? If you're looking for a place where your questions will be welcomed and accepted instead of dogmatically answered, then this is the place to be!

Open and accepting of all people, all perspectives, all walks of life - this church embraces the mysteries of life alongside Jesus' radical call to be love in this world.

The sermons have a depth that disrupts the status quo through challenging the church to live more fully into creating God's kingdom here on earth through justice for ALL.

As a recent college graduate, I've found this church to be very welcoming and there's a growing group of young and young-ish adults who are authentic and down-to-earth. Also this church is LIVING it through awesome, holistic work in the community.

I'd definitely suggest giving it a try. No matter if you've never stepped foot in a church, have post-evangelical trauma or are just looking for a community to explore life with. Great sermon last Easter. Very nice people & community in Jesus. Stunning outside!! I love this Church!, I hope that I can visit again 💗💓

name: South Burlington Church of Christ
reviewSummary: Some are friendly,Preacher not so friendly,I have never been to service before and the preacher, Didn't greet you with a hand shake or a hello..Felt really cold,Thank God they did have 2 people there,That was friendly and made me feel welcome..Glad I was able to hear the word of God.. Best church I've ever been in Great place to seek God's truth and family Great people. Great Service. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: South CLT Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A life-giving, gospel-centered community meeting on Sunday afternoons. Highly recommend.

name: South Coast Christian Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary: Made me feel at home from my very first visit. Pastor Tom gives the best sermons. The worship band is phenomenal. Everyone is so kind and welcoming. Lucky to have found such a wonderful group of people. My daughter attends South Coast Christian for Bible study Tuesdays, and she simply loves the campus and her mentors.  What better way to raise your child than in this lovely house of the Lord! Thanks a bunch South Coast Christian church for your support in prayer and faith! My family has been members of SCC since Fall 2019 and we enjoy attending church each Sunday since everyone is so friendly and really cares about us. SCC is a special place since it's motto is "creating environments to see what God can do through you." This means that as a church, they provide opportunities to serve, grow & lead in our church and community. If you are looking for a true church "family", I highly recommend you joining us on Sundays at 10am! God bless you! Just LOVE our church!!  It's a church for the community, state and world!!  With all our outreaches and events, you can see that our hearts are for people!!  Our Sunday services are pretty amazing as well.  Lively but spirit filled worship and a relevant message every Sunday!!  Lots of families who love hanging out together!!! The first time I walked into South Coast Christian, I knew I was home. We were looking for a church that teaches from the Bible, good worship, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. We found that and so much more, including lifelong friends. We have attended South Coast for 2.5 years now. Pastor Tom did our premarital counseling,  married us, and genuinely cares about every member of the congregation. I look forward to going to church every week!

name: South Coast Church Assemblies of God - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Stopped in while on vacation. Received the warmest most genuine welcome ever. They truly wanted us to stay for the lunch after and took a genuine interest in our family . Sermon and music were also very well done. Wish this was my home church! My church is Awesome! Has a great pastor staff. The small church feel is sweet and warm every time we meet. 10:45am Sunday, 6:30pm Wednesday and Tuesday 10am prayer. All are welcome Awesome church!!! Lively worship small but intimate. Everyone's soo friendly and you feel the overwhelming presence of the Holy Spirit. Pastor Kruise is down to earth and the Lord works through him. Come in and see for yourself, witness the miracles God does in this place. A place I feel comfortable and no judgement here. Loving and family connection..been at this church since 2012. Spirit filled church, incredibly friendly people and a great Pastor. I love this church!

name: South Daytona Christian Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I love worshipping with our church family! We also love the opportunities to bless South Daytona! If you are looking for a church home, visit SDCC. You’ll be glad you did! Love this church! Beyond the Sunday service (which is awesome!), they do so much for the community, from weekly meals for those in need to free community parties and celebrations throughout the year. congregation is full of warm, joyful, down-to-earth people, including the staff. It’s truly a special place! My family's church for over 20 years.  Gospel based with sound Biblical teaching.  Community oriented "In the heart of the Community with the Community at heart".  Loving pastors and members who care. Thank you for a wonderful service this morning. I haven't attended church in years, and with recent tragic events, something said to me to go worship. I'm so glad I did. The moment I walked in the doors I heard in my heart, it's good to see you. Thank you again and I will be attending regularly!!! Love this church defiantly for the kiddos my grands both went there for pre VPK and VPK. Love Trevor and Ms Fricke and Tori Fricke and Ms Ford when she was there and defiantly Ms Bradshaw and of coarse Ms Ville! But I truly have to say the front office staff Ms Sandy needs to be a little more cheerful at her job cause she is the first place of the church! Not a very happy lady which is sad being in Gods house 🥺

name: South Durham Church - Durham Campus
South Elkhorn Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Open, friendly, and caring congregation with excellent pastoral leadership. Excellent children's program. What a breath of fresh air. One of If not the most welcoming church In Lexington. We drive a hour and a half every Sunday just to attend. Amazing sale today and tomorrow.  Tons of great kids' clothes, toys, equipment.  Great prices and friendly people. As a member of the congregation I can attest that we strive to be welcoming, friendly, and open to all that attend and visit. So nice to sponsor voting and other denominations that do not have a building. Historic church in Lexington area

name: South Fellowship Church - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife, kids and I LOVE being a part of the community at South Fellowship. Not only does the church have great music, preaching, and kids ministry, but it’s also very active in helping those in need in the city of Littleton. This is a great Christ centered church that values visable faith, gospel transformation, and engaging in life giving community. The people are friendly, the staff is intentional and the lead pastor is a gifted, transparent teacher who challenges the congregation to live Biblically with the power of Christ. This is one of the best church experiences I've had. Friendly people and authentic. And the service was great and that catered to everybody. I recommend this church it's a welcoming the atmosphere and it's just wonderful. We love South Fellowship and our new Pastor Alex so much! It's a great way to start the week feeling confident, at peace and filled with the Holy Spirit.
The praise singing makes me cry every time. The musicians are amazing and Aaron has an extra special gift of connecting people through music.
Elders and greeters are great as well! Thank you so much! Such a sincere and genuine body of believers! Worship is great (combo of older and newer songs with focus on quality content--so refreshing), staff and congregation are warm and welcoming,  and Jesus is absolutely at the heart of everything, even during a pastoral transition. Sermons are scripture-based, and pastors are not afraid to address tough questions. My family has been attending for about 2.5 years and continue to learn and get connected. Highly recommend.

name: South Hills Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm honored to have JR Carmichael as my pastor. His staff truly elevated our church. We now are more involved and love the message that SHB brings to the community of Burbank. This congregation does not judge and gives back 100%. We are blessed to call this establishment our family. Plus, Miss Maria is the children's director and couldn't ask for a better role model for our daughter ❤️ Very different vibe since it was passed on to another pastor years back. Was a very fun, lively & packed church and now it just has a different atmosphere. But the important thing is spreading the word of the Lord 💞 Best Church I have had the privilege to attend. I visit numerous congregations throughout Southern California & by far South Hills is at the top of my list. It’s obviously not as crowded as one of the mega stadium seating churches but that allows you to actually be acknowledged and greeted. They have multiple people greet you and that allows you to feel welcomed and I appreciate the diversity and hospitality. Very unique experience. The worship team is very intimate and you feel easily connected to worship and the message is communicated effectively and in a respectful amount of time. Here I found family and friends. So grab a friend, checkout Sunday Service.
8 AM Service 10 AM ServIce  1130 AM. I found my congregation. I've met a lot of amazing people please. Please come join and feel at home I hadn't gone back to a church since the pandemic and it felt ok. The music was nice but it had more sound of the instruments than the voice of the singers I could barely hear them.  I'm pretty sure they sing beautifully so let there be more voices of the singers. The pastor there has a name that you would never forget "JR" Pretty easy huh? His preaching was good so I guess I will go back and check it out again. Oh and this church has like a little coffee shop but the coffee is free and you can grab some coffee and go listen to the service or get coffee after the service. They also give you donuts which I don't eat donuts, But that's very nice for the people that do. The only thing not nice that I have to say is that when I was grabbing some coffee after the service, this lady behind me that I guess wanted to grab some coffee too. She looked at me like I didn't belong I guess she just wanted her coffee. I did see she knew people there because she was calling them by their names. But no worries, she's not going to stop me from going back Because I like the service.

name: South Hills Church - Costa Mesa Campus - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
We were just passing through and decided to stop at this church. Very kind and welcoming. They had a separate place for our 7 year old daughter to go to. Music was great and the sermon was fantastic. Highly recommended. Worship music is amazing everyone is welcomed and the sermon is always touching I love the warm intimate environment of this church feels like family South Hills Church is an incredible place to experience God’s presence.

From the moment you walk in, you can feel God is with us. 🙌 The worship is powerful 🎶 and touches your heart in ways words can’t describe.

Worship twice a day—when you feel like it and when you don’t—because God deserves our praise in every season. 🙏✨

They’ve got an awesome kids' section 🎉 and a growing teens' group too! 👧🧑‍🎓 Perfect for the whole family. ❤️

If you’re looking for faith, connection, and community, South Hills Church is the place to be! ⛪🌟 My family and I have been coming to this church since 2018 (that was when we were meeting at Ensign Jr. High) and then we moved away in 2019 and after that the pandemic hit.  We tried several churches in our area (Irvine) and nothing compared.  We started coming back in person in September of 2022 and lo and behold the church moved WAY closer to us!  So now instead of schlepping down the fwy and all the way across Costa Mesa, it's now a matter of a few fwy exits!  When we came back I was really looking for a sense of community, so I joined a small group and it was (and still is) an instant family vibe.  We still walk out life together and we are all family.  We recently went through a lot because there was a shift in leadership, but for me, as long as I have an opportunity to learn, grow and praise the Lord on Sunday and do life with my group and as long as there continues to be amazing childcare I'M IN!!!! This is a GREAT church for many reasons.  First, they follow the word of God, they are a nondenominational church - no religion.  They truly care about everyone that walk through their doors.
One if the most exciting things about this church is we are committed to tithe, as the Bible says. For 90 days. Pastor Moses says if anyone's life isn't blessed, that HE WILL PERSONALLY PAY YOU BACK EVERY PENNY YOU TITHED!!
THERE ARE SO MANY FUN EVENTS HAPPENING THERE.
I AM happy to say that I fit at South Hills Church- Costa Mesa.
Pamela Lafferman

name: South Hills Church - San Clemente Campus - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a blessing to be a part of a church family with people who truly care about each other. South Hills San Clemente is my church family. I look forward to seeing smiling faces every Sunday. We are blessed to have 2 wonderful men of God, Pastor James and Pastor Eric,  lead us in service. If you're looking for a welcoming church, this is the church for you. If you have to see it to believe it, come see for yourself, Sunday mornings at 10am.
- Christina Wonderful, welcoming church with accessible, practical messages. Pastor James is engaging and fun! Great music, too, as well as a Kids and Students Ministries…and donuts & coffee. 🙂 Awesome small church in San Clemente ! Reverent but not plagued by dogma. A place to do life with people who wanna know God and spread heaven al ‘round these parts. South Hills San Clemente is authentic and family oriented. If you’re looking to actually know people in the church and be connected with a community, this is the place!

name: South Hills Community Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: We have found our new home in SHCC!  Pastor Smith always delivers a great message and our 9 year old loves the children’s ministry, which means so much to us! Very thankful we found South Hills! The perfect church for imperfect people. Pastor Adam enriches each sermon with insightful reflections and relatable real-life stories. I hadn’t been to church in a long time and didn’t intend to go regularly. After one event, I have been hooked. Going for just under 4 months now. I find myself attending as often as I can make the drive. When I’m not there in person, I usually watch from home. Thank you, South Hills community. I've been going to South Hills Corona campus for a little under a year now, and there is nothing to say better than amazing! Pastor Adam and his wife Gretchen are amazing people who have handpicked a wonderful staff. Our business recently was able to perform charitable detailing services for someone of the local churchgoers, and South Hills facilitated it all with ease and great compassion. I would recommend for any and all! My family loves Pastor Adam.  My husband and I have searched long,  hard and intensely for someone who has the right perspective, faith, and guidance to lead our family especially our 3 daughters.  Not only is Pastor very relatable, grounded and firm in his faith but funny and approaches lives’ adversities with less stress and more understanding. South Hills church is another place to call home. Pastor Adam and Gretchen are wonderful people. South Hills has a way of expressing God so uniquely that bring such a range of people together. It is such a loving and embracing community.

name: South Hills Manhattan Beach - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Before you even walk in the door you will be warmly greeted. There is always hot or iced coffee and Randy's donuts waiting for you every Sunday. The service is an hour long and consists of worship, announcements, and a practical teaching/sermon. Children's church and nursery are also available during service. After service they encourage fellowship and provide lunch on the patio every week.

Pastor Bryon and Pastor Mike are humble, teach biblically sound teaching and have great hearts.

There are weekly women's or men's groups, a co-ed Bible Study, youth group, and prayer groups.

There is no lack of community at this church. The church truly is family. Come give South Hills Church a visit. BEST CHRISTIAN CHURCH IN MANHATTAN BEACH AND THE SOUTH BAY!!  The people and leadership are welcoming and kind, and the pastor is on point in the Scripture and  Word!!

They offer many programs for people of any age or need!!

Come on by

They also offer food for all and it's good!! Jesus King! Beautiful people beautiful place!
You are more than welcome to visit and join family! Pastor Bryon is the most "humble" GOD loving man. He is so down to earth , admits his difficulties in having doubt, like us all.  He's the best!! Try a service. You won't be disappointed.   Food suggests before & after services. Pastor Brian is so relatable in the way he presents his message of God and faith, Thankful I found this place to refresh my Belief in the Christian way of life. Blessed to have found such a wonderful place to Worship. Thank You 🙏

name: South Hills Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: This church is awesome. Pastor Efren’s message really hit home with me. Church is very friendly and welcoming. You feel like family. I visited today for the first time and I will be back. One of the most amazing Church's I have ever attended. Pastor Efren makes you feel important and like you are part of the family. I was never an every Sunday kind of person but now I can't wait til Sunday. It is a place that makes you feel good about yourself rather than guilty about yourself.  It has changed my life for the better for sure!!!!🙏 This Church is amazing, we recently attended one Sunday. The people were so nice and the Pastor was on point, real and delivered the message powerfully!!! I love bringing my family here. Great people and great east to understand sermons/message. The kids service is absolutely amazing and wonderful. Beautiful church with sermons that truly touches the heart!

name: South Mecklenburg Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Vibrant and inclusive Presbyterian church. Beautiful traditional services.

name: South Mountain Community Church - Draper Campus
reviewSummary: This is not a church, it is a ministry. Communion is rare (Christmas, Easter), and there is no baptism here. The Sunday service feels irreverent, more like what a weekday service should be, not the Sabbath. Everyone here is very nice, but this is not what I'm looking for. I've gone several times, and they have this saying: " be long before you believe" that makes me feel comfortable there. We've also gone 21 of their bible study groups many times and we love the people there. Sometimes we have brought our kids to the midweek events, and they seem to have a good time, although they serve lots of sugar so if that's not your thing, beware! Just moved to Utah and thankful to have a theologically sound church local to the area. Great teaching, quality worship and overall friendly and inviting environment. I love SMCC! They say "belong before you believe" and I truly feel that they provide this type of environment for people to grow, learn and ask questions along the way. The messages are 100% Bible based and are taught in a way to help you apply them to your daily life. Incredibly friendly people here with messages of Christian faith shared during sermons. The live music is loud, but touching and powerful.

name: South Park Christian Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I love that this is such a welcoming spiritual place that embraces diversity and inclusivity.  What a gift to our community! 🙏🏼☮️💖 A wonderful church to attend!

name: South Pasadena Chinese Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: English spoken here as well

name: South Pasadena Christian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
My life used to be filled with sadness and sorrow until I opened my heart and let God into my life, and then I found this church on Google. I truly love going here; everyone welcomes me with warmth and kindness. Pastor Darrell’s teachings from the Bible inspire me deeply. The church also provides a nursery for the little ones and a Bible class for the children. At the center of this multi-ethnic, multi-cultural church lies a warm, compassionate congregation. Preaching is straightforward and effective, with class offerings a great chance to learn. This church also provides many volunteer opportunities for community services. All of this explains why I have been here for over 20 years. I love this church! It’s a warm and welcoming multi-ethnic community that truly focuses on teaching and living out the Word of God. The church is very friendly to Chinese people, and there are Chinese members serving in the leadership team as well.

Every Friday evening, there’s a Chinese Bible study group where we can learn the Bible and know God in our own language. At the same time, the youth also have their own fellowship gatherings.

On Sundays, the pastor’s messages are clear, practical, and deeply rooted in Scripture. They always help me apply my faith in daily life. I’m thankful to be part of a community where we can grow together in Christ and build up the church as one family. I have been attending for a couple years now. I keep coming because The pastor has a biblical message every week and bible study Thursday night (English), and Chinese Friday night. Also like being in a multicultural Church Family. Also they serve the community in a half a dozen ways I felt welcomed from the first moment I entered the church three years ago. It’s a wonderfully diverse church family with an online Tuesday night prayer meeting, service outreach in the community on Wednesdays, an English Bible study on Thursdays, a Chinese Bible study and youth group on Fridays, solid biblical teaching and a wonderful lunch after every service. The Sunday services are in English with simultaneous Mandarin translation (using headsets).

name: South Sacramento Christian Center - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary:
People here are awesome. Run very well clean and organized. Food was fresh lots of fruit. I am from Texas stuck here and they made it better for me. Thank you all. Sacramento christen center and food bank they're so awesome been going to they're bank they help everyone so very nice It a amazing place to worship God,I love it here First I am not a believer and worship no deity.
The reason I went to SSCC was for Covid-19 testing. The volunteers were very efficient and quit nice and did not turn me away because I was not wearing a mask. I am on and need supplemental oxygen, the cannula goes over my ears and doesn't play well with the straps from a mask. I arrived early for my appointment, filled out a short form, was swabbed, in the nose and inside the mouth and on my way, all toll, less than 15 minutes. I got emailed the results that same day.
Confucius is credited with saying THIS about god and religion, THE HARDEST  THING TO DO IS FIND A BLACK CAT IN A DARK ROOM, ESPECIALLY IF THERE IS NO CAT. A great place to worship and build your inner man up. This Holy Spirit is prevalent and I grow when I'm worshipping there. I've left only to return there's no place like home. Praise God for leading me there. Come and be blessed by God.😇🙏🏾

name: South Shore Christian Church - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church. The people are the most welcoming people I've ever met and Pastor Banks is, without a doubt, the best spiritual leader/Pastor that I have ever known. I leave on Sundays feeling refreshed in the Spirit and alive for Christ. This is a place to connect with other brothers and sisters in Christ, and then take His light out into our world. Love this church for my son and I.  my 3 year old is really good with the nursery as well as the person watching over the kiddos. As for the paster, amazing. There is just something about him that makes you feel like you've known him for a really long time. The members are all very welcoming and open you with open arms.  I highly recommend this church to anyone, old or young. I loved this church and the people in it since I walked in the door! Pastor Oscar is amazing with his messages and his love for people. My daughter leaned over on our first visit and whispered in my ear, "I've never been hugged by so many people!" Southshore Christian church is one of the first churches I visited when looking for a new church home in Corpus Christi a few years ago. The members were all very friendly and inviting and Pastor Oscar Banks always brought a message that was meaningful and relevant. I'd highly recommend anyone looking for a new church home or anyone looking to rekindle their relationship with God to stop by. You'll be glad you did. This isn't a church. It's a community! Of men and women exactly like yourself. We are here to praise him, and then undergo some spiritual formation as well! Southshore's motto is "welcome home". Are you ready to come on home? The cows already have.

name: South Shore Community Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
This is one of the most amazing groups of people I’ve ever been associated with all loving and kind the service from Pastor Nick and all the other pastors that lean in and spread the word of Jesus is nothing short of spectacular. If you haven’t been to a high energy service in the past or judgment and condemning is not part of the preach then come and enjoy the music and the energy and love that spread in this room. If you haven’t found Jesus yet I recommend you visit and receive eternal life. I grew up in southern baptist and non-denominational churches across Sarasota and Manatee County. Eventually the clickiness, weird vibes, creepy things going on under the surface at so many places I experienced ran me off from attending church all together. I spent 18yrs walking alone in my faith. Relocated for much of that time up north (unrelated).

Then I moved back to FL and decided it was time to search until I found a real, genuine church to call home for my family. It took 3yrs. I looked everywhere. Tried several. Finally we found Southshore Community Church and I knew I was home. SCC is a center of Godly principles, Biblical study and real people with heart and deep roots in community enrichment. A congregation genuinely dedicated to including others in all directions and healing those who have been burned by other experiences. A place to TRULY come as you are. No judgement. No weird clicky vibes. Roll outta bed and walk in if you want. Or spend 2hrs getting ready and show up in your finest. Either way you're getting coffee, donuts and a warm smile at the door. Every message I've witnessed over the last year and a half (attending most every weekend) has been full of everything I've hoped for in a church for over 20yrs. I'm so thankful for SCC 💙🤍. We are the church!! After 25 years of practicing Judaism my husband I visited South Shore. I have been inspired at every service. The pastor is special. God gave me a pastor who speaks to me every Sunday! Every service ends with the pastor asking "Who is the church?" And the congregation replies "We are the church!" I'd love us to join this church soon. At Southshore community church attendees dont go to church they are the Church... They are believers and defenders of the Word of God.. Jesus Christ.. Dr . Pastor Nic Williams is also a acclaimed  christian author and Amazon. Best seller.. South Shore is a great family church and also focuses on recovery as well for decades now.. Their celebrate Recovery has a positive track record with alot of community envolvement. Like other churches in our area Southshore is rooted in community. Great Bible based church. Pastor Nick is down to earth and inspiring. 3 Sunday services and now Thursday nights too! "At South Shore we don't just go to Church, we are the the Church, Go be the Church!"

name: South Shores Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly biblically solid community. The ocean views are stunning and the people are very friendly. Great blended worship. The contemporary music is very professional.

name: South Shores Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE this church. They have so many wonderful things to do with you personally and they have wonderful people to teach your children.  They also have a recovery meeting on Tuesdays that will help anyone struggling with addiction.  God is truly there I love this church!!!
From the second we walked into this church we were welcomed and treated like family ❤
The music is amazing the church is simply beautiful and the Pastor is engaging, funny and informative.
If you are looking for a church to call home,... look no further than this place. I looked at 3 other churches before I came here. I walked in and I knew this was my place and I felt God everywhere.🙏 This church is located on a hill and was the perfect viewing point to watch August’s Sturgeon moon. Seeing the halo of light from the moon shimmering high above the city was heavenly, so to speak. My husband and I attended a funeral held at South Shores. The staff was incredible to all of the guests. Also, those that served in the Ocean Room for the reception afterwards were stellar. The view off the Ocean Room is impeccable! I am not a member of this church and today was my first time visiting. I find the music easy to follow and well performed. The teaching was practical with clear teaching from the Bible not just self help. I found everyone warm and welcoming. My children enjoyed their classes and were welcomed and names remembered even after leaving their classes. They have all kinds of upcoming events for all ages. This church is definitely multigenerational which is very rare. Three generations could attend this church and all call it home. The campus is beautiful and the parking was easy. We look forward to coming back again soon.

name: South Sub Church - Littleton Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I starting going here when they launched a new evening service on Easter Sunday. We love it. The teaching is great, the music rocks and we've found a great community of people to connect with. The church has been around a long time and has a deeply rooted community and I think that's what made it so easy for us to get connected and even join a small group. South Suburban has been my church home for nearly 20 years and I'm very grateful to have had the blessing of learning and growing in a Christ-centered community with a strong Biblical foundation. Senior pastor Deral welcomed my family with open arms when we first started, and his Bible-focused messages have always been a highlight of my week and a source for continued growth in my faith. The current staff is truly the best I have ever seen and their joy, passion, and commitment to Christ has created a new, exciting energy for sharing the good news of Jesus and serving in His name. The 9:30am Sunday service has been a perfect fit for me with contemporary music from the incredibly talented praise band, communion time and a Scripture-centered message. I'm proud that we have strong ministry groups for all ages with many worship options to fit the different needs of our community - 4 worship services, ministry for seniors, men, women, young adults, youth, and children, along with small groups, studies, and offerings for couples, parents, teens, young kids, families, mission trips, community outreach, grief share, music and more. I love being a part of this wonderful group of believers. My son went to VBS here and I was thoroughly impressed with the incredible job South Sub did. His teachers were so kind, the staff was all extremely helpful and friendly, everything was very well organized, and my son had a wonderful time! Very welcoming and friendly church!! I love my church family. We are not a bunch of cookie cutter Christians but rather folks that are seeking the Word of God in a messy and broken world. Come join us. Check out one of our wonderful Sunday school classes for children or adults, set in on a sermon or two, have a cup of coffee, and let us love you. If you have little ones you will love our children's department. This is what was offered to me and my family and this is why we stay. I love my church family at South Sub. It is a very warm church. “Love Lives Here”has been the sermon series this year. And it is really true. Love does live here.

name: South Tampa Fellowship
reviewSummary: I’ve been coming to STF for the past three years, and it’s been an incredible blessing. If you’re looking for a church that puts Jesus first, encourages you to live more like Him, and has developed a thriving community, I hope to see you this Sunday! My wife and I have been attending STF’s Davis Island campus for over three years now and can’t say enough about how much we love this church and community. Great music, beautiful sanctuary, friendly and active community, and most importantly the church is very scripture oriented with thoughtful sermons delivered by a great pastor in person every Sunday. We are so grateful for how much our faith has mutually deepened and grown since we started attending this church. This has been my home church since my second day being in Tampa when I came for college in 2019. Been coming here ever since! Love this church! This is such a great community church.   Over the years we had been  going on and off  it just didn’t  pull us in completely.  However the last  go around  it has changed for the better where it really is like a community support place for families  and students and young adults. 💗 Went to a baby shower here for a friend and it was delightful. So glad we could make it. Thanks for the invite. It was in a recreation hall they have very nice.
