Great music, beautiful sanctuary, friendly and active community, and most importantly the church is very scripture oriented with thoughtful sermons delivered by a great pastor in person every Sunday. We are so grateful for how much our faith has mutually deepened and grown since we started attending this church. This has been my home church since my second day being in Tampa when I came for college in 2019. Been coming here ever since! Love this church! This is such a great community church.   Over the years we had been  going on and off  it just didn’t  pull us in completely.  However the last  go around  it has changed for the better where it really is like a community support place for families  and students and young adults. 💗 Went to a baby shower here for a friend and it was delightful. So glad we could make it. Thanks for the invite. It was in a recreation hall they have very nice.

name: South Yukon Church Of Christ - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary: Worship here is done right and though they are a large group, you do not get overlooked,  so much fun and such a nice service! They welcomed me in about 3 years ago and made me feel like family.  My family and I have attended ever since.  It is Bible based, so much to do, and great fellowship. I haven’t attended here but I did drop off food as the last job of the day. The staff was so kind to me on a visibly rough day, I began to cry. They were the only ones that hadn’t yelled at me due to an issue with the same restaurant. A little kindness goes a long way. I was embarrassed but the kindness was amazing. I just couldn’t hold it in. It’s as if they could tell I was sad. I had been to one medical office and one other church in the area prior and I wasn’t treated with nearly the respect. Thank you all. Years of doing this and it was the first time I ever came close to crying in the job. Great church family that seeks God's will in all they do. Awesome ministry staff top to bottom!  They youth group is an awesome group of teens that love Jesus and love each other! Great place to worship! Posted pictures is from our fall trunk or treat! Good times

name: Southbridge Church
reviewSummary: The court required me to complete 15 hours of volunteer service. Today I tried asking at seven church offices, but no one helped me or needed me. I was very disappointed! In my sadness, I called them, and a very gentlemanly and kind dean gave me the opportunity! I am very grateful to Don and the dean! Many churches look grand and impressive, but they only serve themselves and don't want to help others! I don't want to criticize anyone! I only know that I felt God's love and the Gospel here! Thank you again to the dean and Don! Great family friendly church. Very friendly congregation. Even though we live an hour away now we still consider this church home. We had our wedding here and our first sons dedication. If you haven't been to south bridge yet and you are looking for your new home church then this is the place for you and your family. Very nice neighborhood church. They are very welcoming. Very nice Christ honoring congregation.  Uplifting message and music. Friendly people, programs for children and adults. Great place to worship God !!

name: Southcoast Church International - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: This church is passionate about pursuing the presence of God, making it the perfect place to build lasting relationships and be encouraged to dive deep into your faith. Great people. Good place to fellowship. I like that they meet in a community center. Refreshing community! One of the few churches left that has altar calls..... and God is moving in a big way!! Awesome...Spirit filled...Christ centered...Bible loving fellowship

name: SouthCrest Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary: My daughter and I went for the first time last night to Good Friday service. The worship was authentic. Jesus is present at the church. You could feel His presence. The Pastor allows the Lord to use him. He is a humble man of God. Christ centered church with awesome people.  Made lots of friends for life.  As iron sharpens iron, my brothers hold me accountable and share in the good and tough times.  If you are looking for a body of believers to worship and grow with, come give us a try and see if we are your kind of people. 1st time visitors today and we really enjoyed it. Everyone was friendly and the music and message were great. We may have just found our new church home. I stood in the lobby 10 minutes before I was even acknowledged by one of the four ladies standing in the lobby laughing and drinking coffee. I will never step foot in there again , once i was acknowledged it was a bother.  The sanctuary is cold amd as uninviting as their members. If you want to go to a rock concert go to this church. As usual and what i cane from FAKE PEOPLE! This place wad the final decision to convert to Catholicism . The only thing they are good for is their very big, money hungry building and members. This is the most inconsiderate church. My family was on vacation at the same time at the same hotel. While at the pool there were kids unsupervised, breaking several rules,  spitting water at people, splashing people with water, jumping and diving which is against the rules, and screaming and yelling. Even throwing footballs and hitting us twice without apologizing. Their large group was very disorganized and ruined other’s vacation, even after I got security since none of their leaders were there to stop it or even thought it was and issue. They made it impossible for our family and several other’s to enjoy the pools the entire time while on our trip.

name: Southeast Christian Church
reviewSummary: Great place! Free snacks, coffee and wifi every Tuesday Wednesday and Thursday from 5:30p to 9. Excellent for studying Great church!  Friendly welcoming folks. Love the place I fill god there Very nice church Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Southeast Christian Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
Ever since my family and I started going we’ve felt welcomed and have learned just as would have at our other Church before it closed and we started coming here. We are really thankful and give thanks to God. Incredible place of worship!  Southeast is as large as you want it to be and as small as you need it to be.

Sermons are always biblically based and delivered with such genuine love.  The pastors present the message with remarkable skill and effectiveness.

If you're thinking this church is too large, it's not...just give it a few weeks to see for yourself.  Join a group and find your crew!  There are a whole lot of groups...you're sure to find one that fits you.

God has certainly blessed this church...come find out why. An amazing church with amazing people. This church has helped me I times of depression and growth. I would not be there I am today if it wasn’t for this church. It’s large, that’s no question, but it feels a lot smaller when your inside and start getting to know the people. Grateful for this church. The people here are wonderful. The wide variety of groups make it accessible and welcoming to all walks of life. I never expected to leave a one-star review for my own church, but after my experience tonight I feel it’s important to share honestly.

During the service, the church openly shamed transgender people while simultaneously preaching that there is no shame before God. The sermon referenced Genesis to justify this message, while ignoring other parts of scripture such as Galatians 3:28: “There is neither male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.” The contradiction between the message of unconditional love and the tone used toward a marginalized group was deeply troubling.

I had been seriously considering becoming a member of this church and volunteering my time through community service. Unfortunately, after hearing that message tonight, I can no longer feel comfortable doing so.

Church communities are meant to reflect compassion, humility, and care for all people. When the message preached does not match those values, it pushes people away rather than bringing them closer.

This kind of contradiction is also why many younger generations are leaving churches. When a community claims that God’s love is open to all, but speaks in ways that exclude or shame others, people notice.

I sincerely hope the leadership reflects on how their words affect the people listening.

name: Southeast Christian Church Franklin Campus - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church! I feel welcomed the moment I walk through the doors until I take my seat. The nursery always makes my daughter feel comfortable, and she loves attending when she does. I’ve made many friends since joining Southeast Christian Church a year ago, and there are so many ways to get involved. I’m happy to be a part of it! Welcoming, kind, and authentic people right when you walk in the door. I love the worship, messages, and the kids spaces for my kids. I like knowing their learning and growing their faith while I can do so at the same time. A great place to learn about Jesus and the Gospel, where Biblical teaching is sound, and not shied away from. A church that goes after people who need love, hope, and compassion. The people at this church are kind and welcoming. They help us learn more about Jesus in a way that is easy to understand and applicable to real life. The activities are fun and engaging, and the music is uplifting and meaningful. It would be my suggestion to not attend any SCC.
Have a blessed day. I absolutely love coming here to this church. This is actually the church I went to ever since I was 3 months old. I've got an amazing church family! This is a church I refuse to leave. Would highly recommend coming and checking out our church family!

name: Southeast Church of Christ - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary:
The best church ⛪️, do friendly))) you feel a positive and family atmosphere 🙏
Also they has Ukrainian church services too, every Sunday at 2:30pm for all Slavic community 🙏✅
God Bless you my brothers and sisters 😃🙌✅🙏✔️ Most welcoming,  friendly group I've ever had at a church.  Also offers a food bank on Wednesday  at 4pm. The food bank that was here is now closed for good. However the Pastor and the people here are amazing. My GodBless them they help out people so much I thank them .
GodBless us all A family of people from many walks of life drawn together by one savior.

name: Southeast Valley Bible Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary: Great church on the corner of Williams Field and Lindsay. Its a traditional type church with modern & traditional music. I like what its not - concert like, with strobe lights music. The sermons are Biblically sound. The congregation is a nice mix of all ages. Its a small thriving congregation. The  senior pastor is friendly and welcoming. The associate pastors are also friendly. They also have Sunday School classes. I love this Church so much! If you are looking to attend a Church where you can actually know your bothers and sisters in Christ, this is the place for you. This is a smaller Church with outstanding Pastors. They truly love each and every attendee, not to mention their ability to help you understand the word of our Lord. I highly recommend. If you're a Christian and you want to get into the meat of the Bible, this is where you need to be. Other churches feel like a salad, this place feels like chicken and vegetables. The worship is meaningful and powerful, the sermons are deep and 100% biblical all the time, the lead pastor has multiple graduate/doctoral degrees in theology and stuff and is pretty much always taking courses. I've been going here for like 15 years, nothing repetitive or unsatisfactorily in any way. Very good community, friendly people, groups for all ages, couldn't be better. If you're reading this, go here. I have now found a new church home Miss Jennifer was the most welcoming and pastor Troy Ms Leslie everyone in the church you could fill the fellowship and the welcoming the choir is amazing the energy and the church is real I will definitely be back I found my new forever Church home I came in and needed some help and they didn't even hesitate to help me with my need thank you Southeast valley Bible Church! God is good 👍😊💞🔐 This is a wonderful, spirit filled church. The pastoral staff are caring, wonderful men. Highly recommend for anybody but they are particularly loving and wonderful here for people who are hurting. Deep, theological sermons based on sound doctrine and very fulfilling music. May God continue to work in this church.

name: Southern Hills Christian Church (Disciples Of Christ) - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary: What a great church! Very welcoming, friendly and open to all! There are a LOT of service and mission-type activities.  There are several activities to do in general, from traditional Sunday school, a bell choir, children's Wednesday evening activities, to even a relaxed group of adults who gather for brews and conversation.  There is a place for any age here. Southern Hills is a true Christian Church. And tho they be small they are mighty in their works: committed to stewardship, community weekend breakfast, open to all who have an interest in loving thy neighbor. A very close friend passed away and that is where her funeral was held. All the members were gracious and wanted to know how they could help. Sponsors BSA Troop 79 (boys) and 6079 (girls). Went for trunk or treat and everyone was so kind and friendly

name: Southern Hills Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
Southern Hills Church will always hold such a special place in our hearts. It was the very first church we attended together in Las Vegas, and truly the starting point where our faith was deeply rooted and began to grow in a whole new way.
We were part of this community for a full year and had the opportunity to go through three incredible programs—Alpha, Rooted, and The Art of Marriage—all of which impacted us in meaningful and lasting ways. We also were Baptized in 2025!  Each experience helped strengthen not only our relationship with God, but also with each other.
The pastors here are exceptional leaders who clearly take their calling seriously. They speak with such elegance, clarity, and conviction—you can feel their heart for the Lord in every message. Josh Teis, the lead pastor, in particular, is absolutely spectacular with his sermon series.
The worship team is great, the sermons are powerful, shoutout to all the teams working behind the scenes to create seamless experiences and the sense of community is something we will always appreciated. We built genuine friendships here that we’ll carry with us.
Although the Lord has called us to relocate, Southern Hills has truly set the bar so high as we search for our next church home. We will always consider SH our home church. We still tune into the LIVE service :) , and whenever we’re back in Vegas, visiting will be a must & scheduling a Coffee and Chat with the pastors.

We are beyond grateful for this church and the role it has played in our lives. Love you all ❤️ As someone who shys away from becoming apart of the church and just attends, I had my first true spirtual experience through one of the whom I assumed is a leader of the church, I had seen this young woman worshipping Jesus onstage and it was an experience like no other, you can tell she moved with our Fathers spirit. After service, I caught her for a moment as she was clustered between greeting a bunch of church goers, and stopped to ask her about how she was able to have the Lord move so thourougly through her, after I had asked the question, she stopped before answering and asked me my name, she introduced herself and then went into answering, something about that is just so much like our Father. I had asked her what was it about Southernhills that made her start leading here. She told me "Calling me a leader is such an honor, but I am simply just a servant of God." wow. As weeks went on, I don't come as often as I should, but when I do, i've begun dropping my little ones off at the kids group for them to learn about God while I am in the main service. My child came up to me after church and told me "The princess with the red hair streak sung for us today!" and asked me if she had personally known Jesus. While I may be only speaking upon one person, I believe it is important that people like that are at the gates of coming to the church, as that experience created a place for me to start making real time to attend, real time to spend with God, and now my child thinks that Southern Hills has a disney princess/one of Jesus's close friends not only pouring into the adults of the church, but to the children too. What a beautiful Church, with an incredible Pastor, and an incredible team. Thank you to Mckenzie and to the many ministries you serve in, as you opened a door to my family finding a home at SouthernHills. Pastor Josh, Pastor Caleb are so personable and wonderful to talk to. The members really make you feel at home. I have gone to many different churches, the Deacons were coming up to me and introducing themselves and shaking my hand which is a first in my book. We were in Vegas for trade shows and well Sunday came and we were missing our Church back home in Louisiana. So we took to Google and Southern Hills popped up. All I can say is this Church is AMAZING!! Super high energy from everyone and the preaching was AWESOME!! Thanks so much for making us feel like we were part of your community! We will definitely be back next year and when ever we are in town! I wish I could give you more stars but it only goes to 5!! I love this church. Pastor is so funny & engaging you dont even notice the time when you're here.  Best Church I have ever been to!

name: Southern Hills Church of Christ - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church. Everyone is nice n the sermon is great! They have a room for the kids and the kids really like it. Wonderful Church! Welcoming and giving to all. name: Southlake Baptist Church - Southlake Campus

Southlake Baptist Church in Southlake, Texas

Audrey
Keller, Texas Southlake Baptist Church is a great church where you will get SOLID, straight-forward Christ-centered teaching. Pastor Reed delivers his messages with sincere heart and grace to all in attendance. I have found myself thinking about his messages during the week and how God's Word is true, alive, and impacting! Highly recommended. Have been a member almost since the beginning.  Great worship experience.  A pastor who bases his sermons in scripture and uses it to share Truth.  Join us on Sunday if you live in the area or may just be in town for a while. If you're looking for a Jesus following, Bible teaching, walk with you through it church family, look no further.  Great, truth-filled messages, excellent youth program, & wonderful adult Sunday school classes! If your thinking about a church but not sure , just come and I’ll save you seat

name: Southlake Christian Counseling - Southlake Campus
reviewSummary: If I lived in the Southlake area seeing Shannon Thomas and her team would be my first choice! I've read Shannon's book "Healing from Hidden Abuse" and it was LIFE CHANGING.  I've given the book to friends as gifts and they've had the same experience.  I also follow their facebook posts which are helpful bits of information on a daily basis. I have found Shannon's work to be life affirming, boundary driven and healthy. I fully believe her practice to be the same. Shannon Thomas’s  book “Healing from Hidden Abuse” resonated so much with me that I began seeing her for counseling. In the past 2+ years my life has changed completely. Shannon has helped navigate me through some very difficult times with toxic family members and acquaintances. She has given me the tools and support I needed to find peace in my life. I am so thankful for her and her knowledge and her direct approach. She truly was a game changer for me! SCC has been an outstanding asset to my family for many years.  Shannon is a women of utmost honesty, integrity & transparency which has lead her to be tremendously successful in the fruits of her labor.  Like many others, I continue to be Blessed by her wisdom & humility as she continues to lead people to find health. I've been a follower of Shannon's social media platform in raising the hidden abuse of domestic violence for years.  Her books are fabulous reading to my recovery I have no doubts of saying visit Shannon and her team, stay safe, blessed be I will just say that the therapist working in this place, Shannon Thomas, literally saved my life. Her example and her wisdom and dedication have been an inspiration, and through her an entire movement of healing has started. I have not enough words to thank her and Southlake Christian counseling.

name: SouthLake Church
reviewSummary:
The Christmas service was filled with pure joy, resembling a lively carols concert. We attended because we were visiting the state, and it turned out to be a pretty good church. It offered comfortable seating and free coffee. Interestingly, the service wasn’t crowded but still quite full on Christmas Eve. If we visit  Portland again, we would definitely return there. Awesome family friendly church! Lots of programs for all ages . Caring, nurturing nursery up to active teen programs !
They also run a preschool during the week. Lots of action and activities for the kids. My granddaughters attend the preschool and they love it! I remember I think it was 2009, 2010, and 2011 I attended services here sometimes and they used to have a day of service at Roosevelt high School where they would get like school buses that would come to the church's parking lot and then take you to Roosevelt high School where we would paint the school some people would clean the school, I thought that was a really good way of meeting people, as far as the church goes and I was just looking at their website I was actually shocked to see that they just have one service now because if I'm not mistaken they had like three on Sunday mornings one on Sunday night and one on Saturday night back in like 2009, also I noticed Pastor KIP is still the pastor? Nothing against him whatsoever but wow what is he 72 or 74 years old now? I think he's been that like only pastor that the church has had in their multiple locations since like the 1980s. I wonder why he hasn't retired? Just one last two cents, if you're somebody that comes from a traditional background like Lutheran, Catholic, Presbyterian or something like that, you're probably going to find the style of service a little odd, music a little loud, I also remember there was like some pretty famous people well somewhat famous that went there like a couple Portland trail blazers a guy that used to play in the NFL goes there, several people like very high up in Nike's leadership. I love when I am asked to review churches by Google. I mean, what are you going to say. "I don't know about you, but the spirit really moved me here." Here's the thing, the people were nice, the building was nice. So over all - it was nice. About what you would expect, really. The building and facilities are top tier if not the finest in the Portland area. The parishioners are kind, gentle, welcoming, and invested. The childrens programs are amazing and would highly recommend it if not for the only issue with this church.

Anytime you see a pastor at one church for over 30 years, you’re seeing something unusual, but not necessarily always bad. When someone is nearly a decade past retirement and still pastoring after those 30 years, it’s noticed. When the pastoral team all appear to be related to the lead pastor, kip, then it raises some eyebrows. It creates what’s called an echo-chamber. Regardless of the implied dictatorship, the sermons are where true colors are seen. Let’s start with the positives:
* Jeff (Kip’s son) is a good pastor and is very approachable, and seems to have the reigns on him keeping him from being great. He could use mentoring by other four square church leaders.
* Music worship is elite quality as is the sound and tech programs.
* The amazing childrens programs are probably the one thing keeping the church alive.
* Event coordination is fantastic and the lower ranks seem cohesive.

The problem is when Kip takes the stage in his grey overly casual vest that he’s always wearing. Kip can best be described as a history professor or librarian at an old world Christian university. The man is well read and intelligent to be sure, if not undiagnosed with ADD. However, his sermons are scattered, chaotic, and dry. His illustrations are filled with self proclaimed righteousness and are very unrelateable. The average age of the audience are millennials/Gen X and he’s a boomer using boomer examples and trying to connect in a boomer way. Some of the turn offs also include uncomfortable demands for tithing including praying, “Fill these folks with grace so that they may give to the church…”. So if I use what little cash I have for groceries and gas and can’t tithe, does that exclude me from God’s grace or that I have no grace?

The sermons feel more like a history lesson of the Bible, but exclude the nugget that the author, as blessed by God, intended for the reader. Instead we get dates and reformation training and rabbit holes about Martin Luther or Calvinism and stories of Christians killed by drowning in hot wax and then lit aflame by evildoers mocking the light of God.

I hope Kip decides to retire and allows the church to morph and grow naturally. He would flourish as a religious studies professor. Instead I imagine criticism is argued and wrestled with rather than honored as David describes in Psalms.

name: Southland Christian Church - Lexington Campus - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
This church holds such a special place in my heart because it’s where I begin and continue to grow in my walk with God. It’s where my Christian life truly takes root, and even now, I carry the foundation it gives me every single day.
The teachings are grounded in the Word and fully aligned with the teachings of Jesus. Every service speaks directly to my spirit, challenges me to grow, and reminds me who I am in Christ. The messages aren’t just words — they are truth, guidance, and life.
Southland doesn’t just talk about faith — they live it. They serve wholeheartedly, love genuinely, and create a space where people can encounter God in a real and personal way.
I am deeply grateful for this church. It is where my faith grows, where I am mentored, and where I continue becoming who God is calling me to be. Visited my 2023 college graduate daughter's Christian church for Mother's Day. Her steady boyfriend volunteers working for the church on the tech & cameras. Very mellow rock music. The pastor seemed down to earth while teaching. Nothing too eccentric & no pressure. I did take communion & it was clean & safe.  If I lived there in that state, I would probably be a regular attendee. At first glance the church was intimidating.  Upon seeing first time Parkers spot and a welcome crew as you walk in they quickly dispelled any stress. The church is indescribably beautiful.  The seats are cushy and the people are friendly. The worship amd praise team and singing was amazing. You can definitely tell this church was filled with the holy spirit and God ever present.  Highly recommended for nervous or first timers very comfortable. Many groups to join as well for Sunday school study before church or on off days. A++ We have visited Lexington twice in the last 3 months and have attended this church. To be at church so large it amazes me how personal they are and you can tell that they love their community. I love the relevancy and the truth of their sermons and their worship. I have been going to the church since I was a baby, I absolutely love this church. The pastors are so nice and welcoming to every new person. They have new hair response for anyone who has never been to the church so that they can get to know you. Anyways, just wanted to share that this was an amazing church and I think you should join!!!!✝️

name: Southland Community Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor steve and pastor Kerry  have been family to me,Unfortunately a bit dramatic with security.The security thinks they are real police and profiles those seeking help
I considered joining after receiving help but I could see how paranoid security was around me and that made me afraid for my own safety I absolutely love this church. I first came 5 years ago, so broken by hard life circumstances - and I was welcomed with such a fierce love. The young and elder population alike along with all of the pastoral staff - they all showed biblical love to me in action not just words. The senior pastor preaches the Word of God without compromise or avoiding the more controversial issues in our culture. People from various denominations have found a community here, centered on Christ. It’s so refreshing! I only attended for a funeral, so I cannot speak to the worship service or other church services.

This was a very newly remodeled facility with ample parking.  There is a large sanctuary with theater seating and was adequately cooled during the hot summertime when we visited.

We only met Pastor Kerry.  He is a genuinely caring man who regularly visited my grandfather during his entire church membership and especially during his last days.  Not only did Pastor Kerry care about my grandfather's well-being before he passed, but Pastor Kerry also created a special sermon for the family he left behind.  My grandfather outlived (2) wives and therefore had (2) families - that did not get along.  It was just as important for Pastor Kerry to speak life to my grandfather as it was for him to speak life into both families left behind.
It was comforting and placed a FOCUS on our family goals moving forward to be relationship and eternity focused.  Though my family does not live in the area or attend this church, it will hold a special place in our hearts because of the labor of love from Pastor Kerry.  THANK YOU!  Many blessings to you and this church due to your mission work. Wow. First timer. 32 pcs orchestra. Nice! Great people who love God and each other. I have felt God's presence and anointing many times in my attending there. If I lived in Indy I would worship there.

name: Southlands Church Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Worship was as good as Bethel. Wow. Teaching was solid. I'd make this my home church if I wasn't living overseas. They have an outstanding pastoral staff of Bible teachers, just excellent!
The worship is good, although you may want ear protection as it's on the loud side but very passionate. The sanctuary is a bit dark, take your reading glasses. My wife and I first visited Southlands four years ago and are so thankful to have found this church and community. We love the gospel centered preaching, their willingness to listen to the Holy Spirit, and their multiplying culture of creating communities on mission all for the gospel. This is a church that truly loves their city and the people around them. If you live in the Brea area and are looking for a church, a family, or to learn more about Jesus. I highly recommend Southlands Church. I love this church. I've been to so many churches and never felt so connected like I do here. It's a great church family that balances it's size very well with small groups and many community events. The preaching is always biblically sound and easy to understand not to mention the worship is fantastic. I have been going to Southlands for over two years. When I first started coming, I had just moved from Studio City. I didn't know anyone in the area. I joined a lifegroup right away and met some amazing people who have become some of my best friends. I have been blessed to serve on the worship team and joined the church shortly after my first time coming. I love the focus on mission, prayer, biblical teaching, and worship. I encourage everyone to try it out and stick with it for a few weeks.

name: Southlands Church Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome church! They clearly have a love for Jesus and the truth of the Bible. They meet in person with safety measures. Jon is a terrific person.  He is kind, wise, and able to lend a hand where he sees a need. I feel he is a wonderful person to lead this congregation into the future. Thanks Jon and best wishes. Southlands Santa Ana is HOME! I love this church so much! The people are truly like family and the preaching is GOSPEL centered! Hallelujah! Teachings are straight from the Bible and most services often have a time of response to the message. Definitely a smaller church, which means you won’t get lost on a crowd. 🤗 We joined Southlands Santa Ana in spring 2021 and have enjoyed being a part of the church (which is a smaller plant from a church in Brea). The community is small enough for us to actually connect with other people and also allows us to engage with serving in the church. Most importantly the pastor and pastoral team really care about teaching people to love and obey Jesus and to know the Bible.

The church meets outdoors which is nice for COVID considerations-- FYI no masks are worn but there's respect if you're like me and choose to wear one anyways.

There's also lots of opportunities to serve and do outreach, such as prayer/evangelism, serving those in foster care, etc. Definitely check it out and see if Southlands Santa Ana could be your church home. We have visited several times when in town and have been warmly welcomed; from the coffee and donuts to the warm hugs and offer for prayer. Each time we’ve attended, communion was part of the service, which I appreciate. The pastor, Jon, is not only knowledgeable in the Word, but also relatable, funny and kind. We will be back.

name: SouthPark Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
I would not reccomend this church to anyone. I started coming here and was invited to the "womens group" which was basically a group of women who have shallow conversations about their lives, with no significant biblical sense. Then I had a conversation with the pastor Tom who agreed with me that the womens group was bland and expressed that they were going to put together a Bible study. They never did and after numerous called to Pastor Tom, I realized that they didnt care about fellowships, discipleship or new comers. Would not reccomend to anyone. I love SouthPark Church and my church family.  It is such a welcoming and friendly congregation and  the entire staff is awesome.  Pastors Kyle and Lindsay deliver such meaningful messages that are inspiring yet challenging and relevant to today's issues.  There are many opportunities to get involved in small groups, outreach ministries, children and youth programs and more.   I have seen many changes over the years but  our recent rebuild of the church campus has been the most exciting yet.  We can not wait til we can worship in our new building! We love love love our church! If you are needing a connection, a community or simply want to try out something new, I encourage you to try this church. The messages are so powerful and something you can relate to in your life. The pastors always back everything they say up with versus and stories from the Bible and I learn so much each Sunday. We recently baptized our daughter here and look forward when the doors officially open (after covid) and we can all be together! Friendly members who took the initiative to welcome visitors to the church. I particularly liked Ps Kyle's sermons where he focused on God's word and practical living points. Attended both the traditional and contemporary services on different Sundays.
Visitors should go to the 2F hall after the service for donuts and coffee and fellowship with the members.
May God's blessings be upon this church always. Pastor Kyle and Pastor Lindsey are such a blessing. Their sermons are teaching and relating the Scripture to life (or visa versa) and they have a greeat sense of humor.  I always learn something new about Jesus!  The music offerings, both traditional and contemporary are professional and inspiring! The graphics and flow of the services are on point, thanks to Kevin! Very friendly congregation, like family!

name: Southpoint Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family visited Jacksonville for the weekend and we wanted to go to a church in the area, the reviews were decent so we gave Southpoint a try. At the beginning it was ok, the music was ok, and the initial opening was ok, but then the old bald pastor (i don't remember his name) started going off topic and it never stopped, but the part where I had to walk out was when he started going off about how young people are immature and ungrateful and compared to the old days we have it easy because of (medicine being so advanced). I couldn't take it, we had to leave, with us being a young family and currently struggling because inflation has been insane and everything has quadrupled in price I've had enough. I'm not gonna be preached to by some old dude that prolly owns a 4 bedroom house and has been retired for 10+ years about how young people should be grateful for this system that his generation created and threw us into. I'm happy to announce that we will never be coming back and I will never forget about this experience, but go ahead and tithe to these people yall, so they can pay for another pastor vacation for their lead retirees. As much as my Husband liked being in church on Sundays but this Church does  not take into consideration of Kids with special needs. Something as simple as language delay in a child, there was nothing like inclusion for such child.  I believe this church can do better especially if you are teaching about Jesus christ the saviour of the world. My greatest disappointment with this church was simply that the service could have been impactful, but the pastor so overwhelmed the message with his personal biases, opinions, and politics that the depth of Christ’s teaching was completely lost.

Firstly, the screen clearly projected that the topic was Luke 3-9, yet we never read a single verse from said book. Instead, we opened to Matthew and discussed the instructions of Jesus to His disciples on how to address the public on their own. The core of the message was to “wipe the dust from your feet” or in other words to not allow the past to follow you into your present/future.

Secondly, this sentiment alone is incredibly moving and applicable to endless aspects of life. And yet, the pastor managed to make the entire conversation about how black people deserve better treatment in the form of free education and special privilege by employers (which is inherently racist despite his desperation to appear as a white ally), how young people are ignorant to the struggles of past generations and the easy way of life they provided us, and honestly I left shortly after the hour mark and he had moved on to talking about his golf game.

Thirdly, I would like to briefly dissect things he shared that are unbiblical and entirely his personal philosophies:
(1) “We are a ‘white-ish’ church and need to better understand and serve people of color since we could never understand their lament.” Paul very beautifully described how to combat racism as members of God’s Kingdom in ‭‭Galatians‬ ‭3‬:‭28‬ — “There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.”
Recognizing there are cultures and peoples that are treated worse than others is nothing new and Jesus simply calls us to love our neighbors (all people) as we love ourselves. No need for evening acknowledging skin color.
(2)”Young people are living in the easiest time in history.”
Aside from this being blatantly false due to the state of the economy, the downfall of morality in our country, and the satanic pedophilic horrors plaguing our society as well as inexcusably dismissive of the difficulties that come with living in a sinful world in any generation, this is also unbiblical. I will list a few scriptures that I recommend reading — 2 Timothy 3:1,13; Ecclesiastes 7:10; Matthew 24:6.

Overall, the doctrine of this pastor was abhorrent. The church building is beautiful and the people were welcoming, compassionate, and respectful. But as Jesus said to the Pharisees, “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.”
‭‭(Matthew‬ ‭23‬:‭27‬) First of all the people were very nice, they held the doors and smiled at you. The place is also incredibly clean with comfortable chairs. The sermon was really bad though. The pastor constantly kept going off topic, giving stories about golfing, childhood church, and even going to the bathroom at his grandma's house. He would say something so basic and then give an example for it which would make him think of a story and then he would give the story... The sermon could've easily been 20 mins based off what he was talking about, but he just kept talking about something else which drew it out to almost an hour before I walked out and he still had 2 more points on the board. He would also give examples with language that made me think of Ai. I will say that he doesn't seem like the main pastor. He did say that he gets sent to other churches which makes me think that the church thinks he actually does a good job. I didn't learn anything and he made fun of his own church music, young people, and called the church full of every race "white-ish" after going on a rant where he tried to seem inclusive, but was just racist. Big church with a big diverse community and wonderful pastors. The Holy Spirit is definitely present :)

name: Southpointe Community Church - Nolensville Campus
reviewSummary: The level and care of the ministry of this community is exceptional. When a member is in challenging times, support is extensive and amazing. Thank you so much for all you do - it's what the world needs more of. I love SPCC. The focus is on Jesus and the message is consistently about God's grace.  Southpointe is a PCA church and they currently have two Sunday services,  with childcare/ Sunday school offered at both.  The sermons are posted online,  check them out. southpointe community church is an awesome church to attend and to be part of in this day and age. people with a variety of life experiences congregate to fellowship and share their own testimonies. they worship in a very natural christain way, and that way is all about sacrifice and showing love for fellow mandkind. i know, they hugged me over the loss of my dear son kenneth j. luchetz jr.by allowing me to hold his final memorial service at southpointe. god almighty is amazing, amen! im not a regular parishoner, but im at home when im there.my family, the browns are members there. ya' know shayla, kayla, and layla,my granddaughters, are my precious gifts from the lord to us.southpointe and its whole staff are always at the forefront when it comes to helping someone.sacrificing is their mission to christ, amen. praise jesus. thank you lord for southpointe, its you who deserves all the praise and glory.kenneth j luchetz sr. R.I.P. son. We love this church! The pastor is amazing, the people were friendly and it all felt very genuine. Pastor Matt Ballard is excellent,  message always great. Thank you for today's message on tithing.

name: Southside Christian Church - Bloomington Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to worship. The people are very welcoming and loving. Come as you are, we just want to share Gods love with you... everyone there is so nice. youth leaders for my children where just so nice i would totally recommend if you are looking for a church in bloomington indiana Installed a sports floor great place Lived it and their new young exciting Pastor Wisely. Great time Amazing people and will welcome anyone with open arms

name: Southside Christian Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary: Bible centered preaching, come as you are atmosphere! No smoke machines. Today at Southside Christian Church, a warm welcome from Scott set the tone. Met Pastor Mike and Val, and heard inspiring stories.  Real people with real transformations. The message resonated: 'The closer to God, the better life gets.' A pleasant service with a positive vibe. Enjoyed every moment! :) We visited your church this past Sunday. We loved it. The music was fabulous and the pastor was great. We loved his message “Jesus is Lord”. It was the highlight of our vacation. We’re back in jersey and everyday I pray Jesus is Lord. Thank you pastor and everyone for a delightful worship service. Wonderful concert tonight. It was a fundraiser for a good cause. They did an excellent job.Next concert Jan. 17, 2025 I don't consider myself a super religious person, but I do know Pastor Reed cares about people and there walk in Faith.

name: Southside Christian Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: The most lovely people following Christs teaching. A beautiful, peaceful location. A small congregation but so friendly. Highly recommend you join them 10:30 Sunday. This is a great congregation. I like the sermons Pastor Jenna gives. And I hope the congregation finds a blessing in the music I bring there. A lots of loving people there. Always reaching out to you, Sunday Service is 10:30am come and see. Adventist. We have food pantry. Pathfinders activities, family activities and much more. Come and join us What time is Sunday Service? I would like to come check it out tomorrow?

name: Southside Christian Church - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a blessing, for her generosity on purchasing a baby bed, highchair for my granddaughters babydolls, and a wooden rocking chair it was amazing to find the exact same kind of baby bed I bought for my daughter 35 years earlier was out of the kindness of her heart she agreed to meet me that sunday..Thank you so much This is a great small Church that is very welcoming with a very diverse congregation. They are intentionally welcoming of diversity. Their music is great and their setting in the round makes for more intimate worship. The message was a very creative dialogue message that morning. My only suggestions are that they need to make it more obvious on Facebook and their website what time they start. Their sign is also hard to read about service times.

A great church, great music, great preaching, and meaningful worship. This is a loving inclusive church.  Everyone is welcomed with open arms. Very friendly church. A place to focus on your grsce and the Lord. Great Drum circle, Monday nights

name: Southside Church - Warner Robins Campus - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary: I was saved and baptized in this church. Got into high school ministry, serving with some of the best men I’ve ever known and that lead to my own small men’s ministry a few years later. Absolutely love Pastor Matt, and the Walls family! 10/10 recommend for anyone looking for a church family. And the donuts on the start of a new series are pretty good too! This is the home location of a great church that also has five satellite locations in the region. Our family's membership was here for nearly 25 years before God called us out of the area.  Go wherever God leads YOU, but it could very well be THIS church. I love this church! Very welcoming and I love how the messages are taught. I love this church! My family has attended there for awhile now and we couldn't feel more at home. Everyone I've spoken to there has been so friendly and bro Jerry is a great preacher! Sometimes the music is a bit too loud in the sanctuary but it's always a fantastic worship service! I would encourage anyone and everyone to visit there. My daughter started church here when she moved into the area and when I moved here, I started going. Pretty much I hadn't been to a church for 20 years.  Walking in I didn't know what to expect, but everyone was so nice.  The Worship music was "OFF THE CHAIN" absolutely wonderful! You could feel the power of the Lord moving throughout the congregation. Bro. Jerry is phenomenal and he gives it the personal touch so I it always motivating and definitely a Godsend. If I could give it 10 Stars, I would! Love Southside.

name: Southside Church of Christ - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Jeremy, the youth minister at South Side Church of Christ, is an outstanding leader. He creates engaging programs that make Bible study fun and meaningful, and his events foster a strong sense of community. Jeramy's genuine care for each youth is evident, making him a trusted mentor and friend. Both parents and youths appreciate his approachable and supportive nature. We are grateful for his dedication and the positive impact he has on our church community. A little too slow of a crowd for me, I'm a little more rowdy but the people were nice enough, the pastor put me to sleep I like going here for a good AA meeting here on Thursday night from 8-9pm Never A boring day in the southside youth group. A community of believers striving to keep the Bible as the focus.

name: Southside Church of Christ - Richmond Campus
reviewSummary:
As a 41-year-old educated black man, I have had the pleasure of experiencing the warmth and inclusivity of this expansive church community firsthand. From the moment you step through its doors, you are greeted by a multitude of kind-hearted and compassionate individuals who embody the essence of genuine hospitality.

The grandeur of the church's architecture is matched only by the enormity of its spirit, as evidenced by the congregation's unwavering dedication to uplifting one another. Service commences promptly at 10:45 am on Sundays, offering a structured yet inviting atmosphere for worship and fellowship.

Throughout the service, the air resonates with the soul-stirring melodies of gospel songs, each verse serving as a testament to the enduring power of faith and praise. These uplifting musical interludes seamlessly complement the inspiring sermons delivered by the church's esteemed clergy, imparting wisdom and encouragement to all in attendance.

Beyond its spiritual offerings, this church serves as a beacon of community and camaraderie, fostering an environment of belonging and acceptance. Within its walls, individuals from all walks of life converge, united by a shared commitment to love, compassion, and service to others.

In essence, this church is more than a place of worship; it is a sanctuary of love and fellowship, where good people come together to celebrate life's blessings and support one another through life's challenges. I am honored to be a part of this vibrant community and look forward to continuing my journey of faith alongside its wonderful members. I use to attend Southside Church of Christ, your church I recall Mom saying, its heavily doctrinated. My Dad, likewise so encouraged me. I do miss their hospitality; uplift, it gave. Southside Church of Christ is an excellent place for true Children of God to worship Him in Spirit and in Truth! Always a good place to be to really learn about God and what you mean to Him and what God does for you DAILY. The speaker was excellent for family and friends day.

name: Southside Church, Newnan - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary:
I have a good friend that works there so my family decided to join. My husband has been a believer his whole life, but I wasn't raised like that and I am new to the way church is here.
They are great with the kids, amazing actually. They do ask for donations, which is fine since they all go to helping those in need and the community. We supported every time, we also were more than happy to set up automatic monthly donation to show our appreciation and support. We were very satisfied until I asked them for something (it wasn't even for me) they ignored for months, I had to keep trying to find ways to reach out to someone. Well i heard back from them via my friend. The answer basically was "go somewhere else". Nobody tried to talk with me.
They call you "family" as long as you keep giving, but not even the courtesy of a phone call when you reach out for help. They didn't have to help, that wouldn't have been an issue, but could have talked to me at least.
Very disappointed and now I question many things they said. DO NOT RECOMMEND FOR TEENS. I started attending South side when I was in 2nd or third grade until I was a freshman. I'm now a senior but I've had it on my heart to write about my experience to keep other youth from going through what I did. when I was in elementary I loved it I learned about God and his love for me, but there was nothing deeper to it, which is fine for little kids but as I reached middle school I started going through issues in my life the middleschool youth pastor at the time was Eric. He was the only reason I stayed, he was very kind and made it his mission to connect with the kids. I will say he handled some situations inappropriately, and he got so busy he started to not connect with the kids as much, or maybe it was just me. I started going through some really hard things and tried to  reach out yet I wasn't helped, it felt like the church was turning its back on me, and that made me feel like God was turning his back on me as well. This made me walk away from Christianity. I had also been serving in wamba land for 3 years and switched to up street when i was old enough I served with 4th grade girls. i pray I made a difference in their lives  but i know my kids loved me as their leader, they told me every week. At this point I was in highschool and had a new preacher/pastor. He was not it. For one the sermons were so watered down, they didnt really teach anything. I also asked the pastor to sit down with me one day as Id been struggling with wanting to date girls (Im a girl) and he gave me nothing. I asked him to keep it between us and he did not. He told the leader of upstreet and they handled it in a disgustingly inappropriately. They pulled me out of teaching small group and basically said that I cannot serve anymore because I was having "impure thoughts" even though I wasnt dating a girl, I NEVER would mention anything like that in my small group because it was something I was struggling with. After that I fell deeper in a depression I was already struggling with. I tried to reachout a few months later because I was struggling with a drug issue and at that point the youth pastor wouldnt even talk to me and I felt uncomfortable reaching out to my smallgroup leader because she seemed very judgmental as i had asked her some things before that. Lastly, the members in my smallgroup that i had known for an upward of 6 years turned their back on me because i had "gotten angry at the world" which i agree but it was because i was going through things. No one helped me. There were obvious signs I was really struggling, and my youth pastor, small group leader, or friends there even tried to help me. All in all my experience with Southside was horrendous. I wouldn't recommend southside to anyone but especially teenagers. We came here almost every Sunday for the services. I was in Transit which was a sermon themed for high schoolers with some games at the start and a lesson from the Bible to be taught at the end. They did talk about romance once but I didn't focus on it. In the high school service, they rounded up the kids and talked about a lesson then sent them into small groups with leaders depending on grade. I was in the 9th grade group and are small group leader, Vernon, was very kind and had alot of stories to tell. Sometimes, our group had an assistance who was nice, it was always the same guy too. I forgot his name however. Then I moved from Transit into the adult service but I was never fond of some of the lessons because they made me feel gloomy, but they did have some nice lessons like for Easter or Christmas, and sometimes, I would donate some money in a small metal box on the wall before entering. Later, my dad found out about an afternoon service called Inside Out. My brother and I went there on most Sundays and met our small group leaders: Clint, Josh, and Brian. They're very nice people. Inside Out is a pretty great service for high schoolers and have events like Summer Games and a Halloween party where you dress up as a non-spooky character. They also served food after the service as well. Sometimes, we would travel somewhere to help out someone with their lawn. Overall, I had a great experience with this place, I didn’t really fit in with the high schoolers, but I did feel that the Lord was in this place. I would recommend coming here! Good times! Love it. Wish there were more live services as opposed to the movie screen. Special guest, Andy should visiting person more often. We still love them though! I am  currently exploring faith and the teachings of, Christ. I have been to two Sunday services so far and it was not at all what I would have expected. Very modern, up beat and welcomes all, from many different walks of life and beliefs. I felt very comfortable walking in. I wasnt harrased or made to feel lesser. Being greeted by smiling faces,hand shakes and welcoming words by the guest service staff. The live music and the messages can be enjoyed by any and all Christian or non Christian. Southside was suggested to my wife and I by our friends who have been coming here for about a year. I plan to go as long as my wife seems interested and who knows I may finally see my path.

name: Southside Church, Peachtree City - Peachtree City Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I recently moved from Texas to GA and finding a new church to call home is always the hardest in my opinion. We decided to check out Southside and I am glad we did. From the moment we walked in the door, we were all met with kindness. From the pastor, to guest services and the people who take care of our kiddos, every encounter was warm and genuine. To top it all off, this church has a huge heart for community outreach in a big hands-on way. I am grateful to call Southside home. If you are searching for a church, come check it out... they have several locations. =) It's an Andy Stanley strategic partner church. The message is broadcast from North Point Church in Alpharetta. They follow the same model with the kids Sunday activities and small groups for adults. We go for the service only. We used to attend North Point where we saw the speakers live, but you easily get used to the big screen here. The music is good and the message is usually good too. The atmosphere is very friendly,  but laid back. They pretty much accept you for who you are. Very large church but still family focused. Small groups help bring the size of the church down to a home level. Sermons are in incredible depth and delivery is phenomenal! I love Andy Stanley! Love this church!! Everyone is welcomed with open arms. I have to take this down to a four star because I believe the messages can be improved and aligned more closely to the word of God. I have yet to hear about hell or eternal consequences, about how tough Christian life truly is, about deception and how demonic influences are real every day. How we are to deny ourselves daily and pick up our cross. So bottom line, great uplifting messages, but to continue growing in faith, I believe there should be more. For instance, offer church like a college, for freshmen and others that want to stay as is, give the services you normally give, but for others who want to grow, offer a different service. We love Southside! As relatively new community members from out of state, we were looking for a nom-denominational church in our area that felt very open and receptive to transplants. Southside is so warm, welcoming and goes above and beyond to make it feel like the home church you have always had growing up.

Southside is one of many churches partnered with North Point church in Buckhead with Andy Stanley as the head pastor. The service is filmed live at North Point, and projected for the congregation at all the partner churches throughout the greater Atlanta area. Andy's sermons and style of teaching is relevant to all age groups and he puts his message in easy applications to every day life.

Initially, it seemed odd to watch a sermon on a projector, but its actually a really cool way to be apart of a small church (with getting to know your community, neighbors and volunteer locally) as well as opportunities a large church provides that smaller churches just don't have the capability to provide.

We were fortunate to come to the church in time to witness the Be Rich campaign. All the churches unified together as one visible, giant body, poured love (volunteer time and money) into the community (locally and greater Atlanta area) making a massive impact on our city. It was such a cool thing to be apart of and to see the network of churches doing beautiful things to make our area a little bit better.

I hope you come to visit and fall in love like we did!

name: Southview Church - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary: When we moved to Columbia,TN nearly 3 years ago we were looking for a church similar to the one we helped start in Minnesota over 30 years ago. Within a few months we found Southview Church and joined a couple months later. The ministry and worship is Jesus focused. Pastor Mark has a heart to connect with other pastors and support our cities. We love ❤️ our Southview Church family. My experience at South View Church was amazing! The people were beautiful and welcoming, making me feel right at home. I could truly relate to the worship songs and the sermon—it was both funny and realistic, but most importantly, it fed my soul. The children’s ministry was very well organized, and the overall environment felt family-friendly and unified. You can definitely tell this church is Holy Spirit-led. I love it and will definitely be coming back! Our family has been attending Southview for a few years now and we absolutely love it!  The services are always full of amazing worship and powerful biblically based messages.  The church is very Kingdom focused and is a blessing to the community.  We're so grateful for our church family at Southview! This was my first visit and I was greeted with smiling faces and genuine kindness. The presence of God was in this place and I can't wait to go back. If you are looking for a solid place to worship and make kingdom connections I definitely recommend. Love this church! The preaching is straight from the Word and spirit-filled, just like their worship. People are super friendly and welcoming. It’s not a mega church, which makes it easier to get involved with their many ministries. They have an awesome men’s group, youth group and singles group.

name: Southwest Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
Really nice church! Great facility and even better people! I love attending this church when I am down visiting my boyfriend. Everyone is so friendly! The messages are always really good. They have a great group of staff members and the praise band is filled with talented people. The whole congregation is so welcoming. They make me feel at home. I can't wait to go back. (: Love Southwest Christian Church!  The staff is absolutely amazing, the members will make anyone feel welcomed.  The minister Paul Diaz will never make you feel like he is better than you, he is loving, very giving and so full of biblical knowledge.  I always look forward to another Sunday morning message. Thanks Southwest for making me feel the ❤️ I love the staff and elders at SWCC!  They truly care about everyone and really do make decisions that are bathed in prayer.

Great church for your family.  There are lots of different activities for all ages and fun things for the whole family as well! My kids are very happy with the kids program, my young daughter is so exited with the volunteer opportunities that help her to show her commitment to serve. The pastor and the church family is very friendly and welcoming. Beautiful place and so much room

name: Southwest Christian Church - Newnan Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly, welcoming staff and members. Made you feel at home. My toddler was able to easily register only m and be placed in his class. Thank you for the good service and welcoming hands. While I was in town for work I decided to drop in on their Sunday night adult group. Craig, Jeff and everyone else were very kind and welcoming. Great material was covered and Christ was the main focus. Glad I went (: Easter Cantata on Palm Sunday was outstanding!!! I cannot say enough about this church my daughter is in the preschool program and I absolutely love every part of this church! Staff is super nice and my daughter loves going to school. Thank you guys for all you do ! Simple relaxed Bible driven real. There are no perfect churches or perfect people only people striving to be better. That’s why I joined

name: Southwest Christian Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: We have been so blessed by this church. We started attending 6 months ago and have seen more growth in our walk with God than we have in a very long time. The pastor preaches exegetically (line by line through the bible) and makes sure to share the gospel in every message. No topical, self help, prosperity gospel here. Just a whole lot of humility. Been refreshing and transformational and it’s only the beginning! Makes you realize what a difference a solid church (with an elder board) can do for a congregation. My husband and Me are new to the area and sent an email and voicemail to this church to ask about their services and pastor.  Never received a call back or email.  Very poor communication.  It’s a very small church, not a mega church.  Someone could have returned an email or phone call.  Very disappointed. Nice church

name: Southwinds Church of Christ - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary:
We love our church home! We visited several churches of Christ around the area and felt like this one was home from the moment we walked in. Sadly, we'll be moving soon but we would recommend this church to anyone looking to visit or find a church to place membership. Great, challenging lessons on Sunday mornings and the friendliest people you'll meet! Been going there for about seven months.

I like it.

The word is delivered so I can digest it.

Different from churches I've been to before.

And the service is a little over an hour.

And the members are friendly Good people, friendly. Pastor Nathan preaches the Word of God, the bible. Sound is not the best, but improvements are coming. Went to vote.  Walked in, signed in, voted.  In and out In 5 minutes.  Everyone was friendly & helpful. Great church pastor Nathan preaches the word where it is very understandable to all

name: Sovereign Grace Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent Reformed Baptist Church with reformed theology and Baptist distinctives. This is a confessional Church following the 1689 London Baptist confession of faith. Straightforward worship and expository preaching. This has been my family's home church for over 25 years. Pastor Steve has been the pastor there since before we were attending. He has a love for both the Word of God and the people of God and preaches faithfully. The church is small enough that it feels like family and is very welcoming to visitors. I live near door to this church and park in the church parking on occasion due to only having two available spots per house and no guess or extra parking. the church has stated even on days when services aren't being held and that the parking lot is empty the lot can not be used due to it not being a public lot. the church and Pastor Steve Marquedant stated that its not a public parking area even though there's plenty of space for the parking for all parties even when services are being held. they put orders to vacate the parking lot or be towed. simply stating that is not very neighborly of them or of Pastor Steve Marquedant. Lovely people. Biblical preaching. A true confessional baptist church. There's a second service on Sundays at 5 PM. Amazing church ! The sermons are spoken right from scripture 😊 such a blessing.
