name: Sovereign Grace Bible Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is a huge blessing in my life because the people are sincere, godly believers, and the worship services feed Christ's sheep. Christ Jesus is the only one this flock strives to glorify. This is a true church being blessed by the Lord Jesus Christ! This church is anything but Christian. Last Thursday morning, in order to avoid getting a ticket from the street sweeper team, I parked in this church’s parking lot. It was raining and I was the only car there.

It’s been known in the neighborhood that the church doesn’t mind so long as no action is on, and there was no church activity whatsoever. When I returned to the car an hour later, my car is gone. I thought it’s stolen because no way someone from the church called in my car. Right? Wrong!

According to Nathan’s Towing Service, they can’t tow unless someone from the property calls it in. So, why did someone at the church need to call my car in when nobody else was in the lot? Cost me $375.

Well, I plan to attend church on Sundays from now on, and if I do, I will be secretly making small withdrawals from the tithe basket until I’m made whole. I also saved a young lady, the following day, from getting her car towed. Eye for an eye. You know, Christian values. Nice friendly people, sound doctrine, bible based messages. Straight preaching from the Bible. Family friendly. Great message always !

name: Sovereign Grace Church - Louisville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is incredibly warm and welcoming. The pastors take time to pray with people after the service. They are kind, approachable, and remember your name. The congregation is enthusiastic in worship and the lyrics and sermons are saturated in Scripture. If you need somewhere to worship temporarily, a permanent church, or you have questions about spirituality and your relationship with God, this is a safe place. -Gospel centered teaching
-Expository preaching
-Grace filled community
-Christ exalting and doctrinally rich music with abundant singing
-excellent Sunday school classes
-vibrant children’s ministry

Come and visit! You will be encouraged, edified, and pointed to the beauty of the gospel every week! That has been my experience for 12 years! SGCL is a wonderful place. This church has Christ exalting worship, generous community, and excellent preaching.  My family has been very welcomed here. This is a place where people pray passionately and exult in Jesus. The church is serious about teaching solid biblical doctrine. Highly recommend. I LOVE this church family. It is a genuine, gospel-centered, Bible based community that practices humility and genuine love. I have  been transformed and set free to know Gods love more than ever before. We have amazing elders who care deeply and biblically, always pointing you to the Gospel! Christ centered local church with caring people, highly talented and nationally respected worship team, and excellent gospel centered teaching and preaching from several gifted pastors and elders.

name: Sovereign Grace Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: We attended the Christmas Eve service at Sovereign Grace Church of Orange in December of 2020.  We have been attending regularly ever since!  We love the excellent biblical teaching, the welcoming atmosphere, the fabulous worship, and the way our church family takes care of each other.   If you need a church home, we recommend to try Sovereign Grace.  The picture I included was taken at the Christmas Eve service 12/24/2025. I met some of the w people before I attended my first service and everyone was just the same... kind, welcoming and genuine. Love these people. This is a wonderful and faithful church! My husband and I were members here in the past, moved away, and became members again when we returned. This church is gospel centered, loving, and active. They have very clear, thorough, and biblical church government and policies which protect and guide the individuals who attend here. They have been very accommodating and caring towards my husband and I who suffer with disabilities. Wonderful, wonderful gathering of believers. Absolutely love this Church! My family attended a service five years ago and never looked back. The men and women here are full of the grace and mercy of Jesus Christ, always exalting the name and glory of Jesus. Our family has been incredibly blessed by the love and generosity of this local church. There is nowhere we would rather be on a Sunday! Were so thankful for the work God is doing through this church in Old Town Orange. My husband and I recently moved to Orange, and we tried many local churches before we stumbled upon Sovereign Grace OC. The people are amazing, loving, accepting, and wonderfully welcoming. From the moment we walked in, we have felt a part of the community. If you are looking for a church to call home, this church is passionate about community, and most of all Jesus Christ and teaching the gospel message.

name: Sovereign Grace Church - Pearland Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I love this church. We started on Easter/Resurrection Day and we have been involved not only on Sunday but getting involved with other classes and study and recently groups that meet.
The people, the leadership exemplify the love of Christ. The people in the body have been very warm & welcoming to newcomers. This place feels like home. I love that they keep the lights on. Worship is great. Sermons are varied from different elders. The leadership is easy to talk to before and after service with any biblical questions. Sound teaching and Biblical structure. This is a place I can learn and grow. My husband is excited about his walk with Jesus again. If you want a loving and balanced church home where you can learn and grow and see the mercy and grace of God working in your life and through His people, this is a great place to come visit and consider joining. The most bible-based teaching church I've been to. The truth is preached, and they sing gospel songs & fellowship is rich. Felt like I was home the moment I walked through the doors! There's no other church I'd rather worship and raise my kids within. Truly blessed to have this church family. ❤️ A great church! Had the chance to visit them twice during my business trip. They were welcoming from the beginning. The sermon was true to the gospel, and you could feel the "sovereign grace" of God, being all inclusive, while remaining all exclusive! In this day and age, to see an active church, full of families, youngsters and elderly alike was a true blessing. This server who I believed was named Michelle, provided great service and was absolutely fantastic to speak with. You'll truly feel the presence of the Lord here. Through the worship, the words preached and the fellowship. I'm so glad to call SGCP my home this side of heaven. I've grown so much here and am constantly challenged to grow even more!

name: Sovereign Grace Church of Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I first joined this church in 2017, and I am so grateful for their faithful love and service. They have sound exegetical teaching, Christ-focused worship, and a community focused on fellowship, accountability, and care for one another. Our family has been going to this church for 12 years and it has been such a blessing to us.  We are very thankful for the solid Biblical teaching, the beautiful worship and the warm fellowship. Solid evangelical church that believes the Bible is true, Jesus is alive, and that our mission here is to love God and people. It's a very sweet community of people trying to live for God the best we can. Not a place to go. There are reason they are tiny. They attack your character and personhood if they do not like you. Pack of wolves. This comment is not for their good but good of the community. Gospel-centered music, sound biblical teaching. A very caring, loving church

name: Sovereign Grace Community Church (Main Office) - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary: The Holy God of the Bible is proclaimed; Jesus Messiah, God in the flesh, Son of God, Son of Man, Savior from sin, Redeemer from the coming wrath of Almighty God the Father and dearest friend. There is sweet fellowship with others who believe this very truth in this place. The word is preached

name: Sovereign Grace OPC - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Where the word of God is preached. Great group of Christians! Great service. Kind people.

name: Spectrum Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Loved it..Great people and Pastor preaches a great word from the Bible. I’ve been going to Spectrum Church for approx 14 years.  It amazing. Friendly. Loving. Great worship. Pastor Gary and Kimberly are wonderful. Pastor has meanful messages weekly based on the Word.  If you want to grow this is the place to be. The pure Word is preach here. Especially great was the Word preached on having compassion for the Lost and for helping a suffering world! The message of GOOOOOOOOOOOOO was excellent! Wish it was preached every week. Best church I've been to.  Pastor Gary's teachings are amazing and the Praise and Worship is off the hook!! I finally found my home church!! My son went to this preschool from 2-5 years old and he loved it! I loved it, He learned so much about the bible and Jesus. The staff was awesome and very patient with the children.

name: Spectrum Church Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for a few years, and it has been a really meaningful place for me. The preaching is one of the biggest reasons I stay—it’s consistently Bible-centered, thoughtful, and actually challenges me while still pointing clearly back to the gospel each week.
The music is contemporary, but it feels genuine rather than performative, which makes it easier to focus on worship instead of just the experience.
It’s a smaller church, and that’s honestly something I’ve come to value a lot. It’s easier to get to know people and feel like you’re part of a real community instead of just showing up on Sundays. I’ve felt welcomed and encouraged here. When I first moved from Utah to Irvine for my job, I felt pretty lost and was craving a church home where I could actually serve, feel apart of, and gain genuine friends that have a connection to Jesus. I stumbled on Spectrum Church  through a quick Google search one Sunday morning, and man, it changed everything. From the second I walked in, the people greeted me like family, with  genuine hugs and “we’re so glad you’re here!”
What really hooked me were the service events they have lined up. You can just sign up with members of the church with whatever fits your schedule, and it’s been the perfect way for me to roll up my sleeves and work for the Lord like I’d been praying about. Their young adults group is awesome too, super fun hangouts, real conversations, and friends who actually check in on you.
This church is soaked in the Holy Spirit, and the folks here are hands down some of the most loving, kind people I’ve ever met. It’s been such a blessing in my new chapter. If you’re in the area, check it out! You’ll feel right at home. Feel free to say hi to me as well! Spectrum Church Irvine is and has been such a blessing to our family. From Pastor Gabe’s sermons, to wonderful worship music, and Sunday School, it has gone beyond meeting our families needs.
The relationships and love I feel from and for the congregation is a treasure to me. Every week I look forward to being there with “family”. Thank you, Lord for directing us to Your church! I moved to Irvine from Los Angeles not really wanting to be here and not knowing anyone.
I found Spectrum Church online and decided to give it a try. From my very first Sunday, people actually took the time to get to know me not just small talk, but real connection.
A month later, I had surgery and didn’t have family nearby, and this church prayed for me, checked in, and remembered my name.
That meant so much.

Spectrum isn’t just a place to go on Sundays it’s a community that truly loves God and cares for people.
I’m really thankful I found this church. I have faithfully attended several great churches in my life. Spectrum Church Irvine is the one I attend now and absolutely love!
Our pastor, Gabe Fung, is not only extremely knowledgeable, he is also an excellent writer and speaker!
Our congregation, board, musicians, tech team, are just like our welcome team, whom are always caring, warm, and welcoming!
Please join us and you’ll see what I mean!

name: Spirit & Truth Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church. Amazing staff. Amazing people. The congregation is multicultural, and there are groups for all stages of life and affinities. The Sunday worship experience is powerful and life changing! From the time you walk through the doors, you feel like you are home. What I appreciate about this church is the emphasis given to providing a biblical foundation, building relationships, and training disciples to serve. I truly love my church! What an amazing presence of God in this house of worship! There is no place I'd rather be than under the leadership of such anointed Pastor Tom Copple preaching the true word of God. He preaches with so much compassion. The worship is real and genuine a place where you can belong and grow and serve and live a life sold out unto the Lord! And build true family relationships! This is an amazing house of worship you belong here. This has been my Church for 29 years. My life has changed for the better through my connection to this congregation of people. I feel closer to God and a wonderful, loving community of believers. This church is multicultural, multigenerational, and truly has something for everyone. If you are looking for a church, this is it! We would love to welcome you in! I have been in this church for the past 5 years. The friendships I've made here will last a lifetime! The members treat you like family even if you've never met before. Every Sunday we have quality worship, exemplary & convicting preaching, and wholesome community. If you're looking for a place to call home, this is it! This church is GREAT! They are incredibly inviting and have great worship. Pastor Tom's preaching is profound and he has a genuine love for people! They make sure you are noticed and are very welcoming, make sure to stick around for their Spanish speaking service afterwards!

name: Spirit & Truth Lighthouse - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is full of demonstrations of the power of God. Literal miracles, signs and wonders. The people in this church are full of hope, faith, and have the love of God flowing through them. This is not a church that you come to and has you check off the list to appease your conscience that you went to church, but this is a church that teaches you about having a true relationship with God. To where now I’m more aware of God being in everything both good and bad. You can leave here filled with His spirit and knowing for a fact it is Him. Pastor Lachica and family are super friendly and nice! They teach and preach the actual Scriptures in Truth! There is Powerful Presence of God in the services! You gotta go here if you are hungry for God! Kingdom Blessings! Come come! Be saved and born again in Jesus Name! ✅🔥✅🔥✅🔥 Spirit and Truth Lighthouse is so much more than just a church gathering, but it is a place where you can truly grow your relationship with God and know Him more. It is where I have grown closer to God through His Spirit and His word, and I have felt so much love and community from the church family. If you are looking for a church, you owe it to yourself to visit! This is a wonderful church the spirit of God moves through the service every time. The anointing on the Pastor is awesome. Most
Christians are given watered down version
of the gospel. Here you are given the whole truth as it reads in the Bible. Love this church!
🙏❤️🙌 In Jesus powerful name! A great fam church! If you want a real born again experience, healing, and true liberation in worship. And every service is a Holy Ghost encounter, that will change your life in Jesus name. Come and visit!

name: Spirit and Truth Sanctuary - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome church great pastor preaching the truth. Fantastic praise and worship, everybody should visit soon This is not any church of God. Justifying sin does not make you right in God's eyes. You don't read sound doctrine and this Pastor is leading you to the gates of destruction. If not for COVID-19 I may not have been exposed to this ministry. I thoroughly enjoy the streaming services and relate totally to the teachings. They teach and live the same message that the historical Jesus reportedly taught and lived. I had the opportunity to attend the Conference in October 2024 and was completely blown away by the love of Christ in demonstration. A total acceptance without judgement for all humanity: a true walk of love. My prayer is that the religious organizations in my community would follow suit and portray the Christ nature in both words and deeds. Peace Is Possible. I have been going to this hidden Heavenly gem since New Year’s Eve ( my birthday ) . My sister invited me and I absolutely love this place of peace, solace worship. Bishop D . E. and  his lovely sweet wife Brandy… his mom is just awesome on the piano…. Her spirit is just pure and genuine. So sweet. I enjoy being a part of Spirit and Truth. I love the idea of Inclusion. For All to worship together no matter color/ race/ gender etc…. I have been going almost every Sunday. I tune in Tuesday morning and Friday morning. And I tune in with Pastor LaDonna. I love her as well. I love the Paulk family as a whole. The music is amazing. The message enlightens me and wakes my spirit up. I lost my 31 year old son Brandon and I went through an extremely dark time in my life. Losing a child of any age is like no other Loss. I am slowly trying to come back to life and Bishop D. E and Brandy through song and messages have lifted me inside and out. And I’m grateful and thankful that I am slowly coming back to life after the tragedy of losing my son . I LOVE this church!  I am not a member, but I have visited many times and I watch their television program every Sunday. If you are looking for a non-traditional worship experience, and a place of unconditional love and acceptance then I would say look no further!  The music is always powerful and uplifting, and the message is very inspiring, inclusive of everyone, and challenges how you may have traditionally understood scripture and the true meaning of spirituality.

name: Spirit Harbor Lutheran Church - Carlsbad Campus
Spirit Life Church - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Spirit Life Church.  Amazing, loving people who make you feel right at home.  Lot's to do and get involved in as well. It starts at the front door where you are warmly welcomed with open arms of love. Then the Pastor preaching and teaching from the word of God. People from all walks of life and ALL are very loving and welcoming. An experience like non other!!! You must come see for yourself!!!! Learning about Jesus through the Word of God is such an amazing experience at Spirit Life Church in Powder Springs GA. Love this pastor and his wonderful wife! Pastor John and Nakita are light wrapped in love in this dark world! I have known them for over 25 years and the love they have for God and eachother just can't help but spill into everyone around them! There heart for God is just beautiful! This experience ensures  more visits. Pastor, staff and congregation was both informative, warm, friendly and welcoming.
It is definitely on my list for a possible permanent place  of worship 🙌 This place is my church home.  I walked in there a sad girl I've now become a blessed woman . The pastor the first lady the community.  So glad to be apart of this congregation... Thank yall fir everything

name: Spirit of Brotherhood Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: One of the best churches. Pastors and leaders are amazing but what I love the most is that you feel the presence of God the minute you walk in. I stumbled upon this church on a Sunday afternoon and heard worship music from across the street on the sidewalk. It was late, like 1p so I felt a little confused, but I saw people entering the doors. I walked in and for the next 2 hours I listened to worship and Pastor Anthony. It was a very spiritual experience for me. The pastor mentioned just the day prior that they had prayed for 8 (?) hours yesterday (on a Saturday) by letting people come in and go. And that we could feel the power of the Spirit in that worship room today (Sunday). I felt it. I cried. I ended up speaking to the pastor and his wife afterwards and they prayed for me. This is a special place. I was just visiting NY. But I’ll be back. Great environment!  A Bible-based church, and a blessed community. You should definitely pass by, you'll love it. The church service was terrific.  The people are spirit-filled with love. Amazing Place to fellowship, worship and to grow in the Spirit. No judgment. The house is full of Joy.

name: Spirit of God Christian Church - Roswell Campus
reviewSummary: My first time visiting this amazing church! Spirit filled indeed!  Everyone were so welcoming and make me feel like family.  The Word today was ALL for me.  I really enjoy Pastor Knighton sermon.  Hoping to return again. The first time I went to this church,  I felt the love, Pastor Knighton preach a great sermon,  he was truly lead by the holy spirit,  Praise and worship was so awesome,  I definitely had to make this church my home. Was there for Easter Sunday it was fabulous to be away from home but still feel like you were with family.  The kids singing was amazing. Awesome church! The Pastor is very caring and compassionate. You will feel the love of God here! I will definitely join! Awesome Church services, great praise and worship, and a powerful preacher Pastor Knighton! Recommended!!

name: Spirit Of Life Bible Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: This guy and his wife want to start a mental health ministry but they kicked me out their church and cut off contact with me because of my mental health issues and even had the never to yell me God told him not to help me any. Of i didn't already have strong faith that could have made me feel like God had given up on me. Sad really nice guy just should not be ministering. Especially of he going to make people feel like God is giving up on them Great place to worship. Pastor Knott is excellent. This is the best church all are welcome to join Amen

name: Spirit of Love Christian Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: My first time visiting here, I went to an Event with family and friends. Had a wonderful time everyone is very friendly, God bless you all 🙏🏾🥰 I have been at Spirit of Love Christian Church for 25 years. The word is taught there. Praise and Worship is great. We have Out reach where we go into the community,. Our children are taught valuable lessons that they are able to use going into their teen years and young adulthood. The Spirit of the Lord is definitely in this place of worship. The Pastor and 1st Lady is always available. Come out join us and have an experience of a lifetime.I  tell you that you won't regret it. Since I have been at Spirit of Love, I have grown spiritually and I have seen my relationship with God growing as well. Bishop Wells breaks down the Word so it’s easy to understand which makes it easier to apply to my life. Bishop and Lady Wells are welcoming and created a warm, family environment at the church as well. Becoming a member of Spirit of Love has been one of the best decision I have ever made. My family of five attend. This church has been such a blessing in me and my family’s lives for the past 14 1/2 years. From the worship , to the Bible study, Sunday school, couples ministry, women’s ministry, children’s church, and most importantly THE WORD! I can’t find a worship and word experience like this anywhere ✨ Praise and worship today was off the chain! The spirit of God showed up and did His thing. Praise and worship left me shook! It was highly anointed. The spirit swept through the place. The word was rich. Let God stretch you was what I took away. The people were so friendly.  I am definitely going back. I may even join.

name: Spirit of Our Savior Lutheran Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
As a new Christian /member here I have been welcomed and made many good friends here.
Wished Id had found this church years ago.
I know the meaning of being Blessed now,
People are super cool here, Its awesome!! I love my church, Pastor, and church family! Come & visit...Sunday service at 10 :30 am. Pastor Scottie and the church family there always welcome you with love and always ho above and beyond to help others in need. Thank you so much,
Brian Anita and Malachi Carter My friend fonzie passed away his services were held there. I like it was diffrent than others ive been to Worked the poll at this church for the election, very nice people at this church.

name: Spring Hill Church of Christ - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
People are very nice.  Lots of children, young families, and  a good mix of middle-aged and retired people.
Great Bible classes and serman. We went to their trunk or treat event last Halloween and we really had a good time. We are looking forward to going to this year's event. They have a great group of people handing out candy to the kids. I was baptized here! I'd recommend this church to anyone. It's accepting and welcoming. Absolutely what a church should be. I've been visiting here for a while and find it to be a friendly and loving church. Super friendly. Christ minded congregation. Scriptural eldership.

name: Spring Road Church of Christ - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary: Love this family! I've always felt this place was like a second home. Very welcoming and open. Great space, welcoming people. Great  place  to worship  ,friendly  people Great Place. Great People

name: Spring Street Christian Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Spring Street Christian Church offers a family atmosphere where the Word of God is preached...members embrace you and truly care about your well being and your spiritual growth.  If you are seeking a Church family...ready to walk this faith journey... come worship and grow with us! I can say I enjoyed every section, and learned alot about life,people and the church.

name: Spring Valley Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary: Chris and the rest of the team are amazing. Worship is great. The message, even better. Great fellowship and humans. Trunk or Treat was great. Very creative trunks. Everything was complementary. This Church was very welcoming and fun worth checking out if you need a church home Very friendly and welcoming people and ministry leaders Phenomenal

name: SpringCreek Fellowship - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a wonderful small church. The people are really friendly and welcoming. The worship is to notch! Great church to visit! Kind and welcoming! A great church that is small but easy to get connected! Beautiful church and wonderful people Great church loved the service

name: Springdale Christian Church - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I have visited a few times. The people are very friendly and concerned for each other. Their prayer times are filled with expressions of concern and are actually prayed over.
We have used their Cup ministry several times and have been overwhelmed with the amount of food they give. The pastor is a very nice guy. They are great, they feed a lot of people on Mondays. From 9-1 People there are very very nice I've been going there for years. Love this place, very welcoming, I visit everytime I am in NWA. Christ centered, and assisting other nonprofits
May they always be blessed...

name: Springdale First Assembly - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: Springdale First Assembly is one of the best churches I have ever attended. The people are extremely friendly, welcoming, and loving. This church has a fantastic kids and youth program. They also have a great women's class on Wednesday night. We asked nicely if we could run with our dogs in their empty baseball field we offered to clean the mess people made to allow us to use it man in a blue mustang working with church said yes security even came and brought us water .than later a man in a white Chevy came out told us to leave they didn’t want their kids getting hit! We’re supposed to love one an other idc what color skin I am or you are but were equal to God .because of people like him my faith in churches has plummeted they don’t care about other humans it’s just who contributes to the church that are welcome I’ve never felt more broken than watching a man come from a church and bully you and your dogs out of the way .We all have to face him at some point and I forgive you God bless I stopped here to meet a friend and pick something up for my wife. I accidentally locked my keys in my car.  As my friend and I are setting in there truck trying to figure out how to get back in my car 2 different people came out and told use to move as they thought we where blocking there drive was. We were NOT. Never asked if we were ok or needed help...... Just told us to move as we were in there way.   I have never meet a more rude church...... I love my church and they are family oriented, fun loving people, and a big part of my heart ❤️ Great place so far.

name: Springs Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church, all elders and pastors are very active with the community in and out of church.. god bless you all! Great worship, excellent sermons, kindhearted community. Preach the truth of the Word - strong Biblical teaching. Pastor Michael Petillo is THE best pastor! I love his genuine passion for Christ and his love for our Lord! He is so knowledgeable! I love listening to his sermons every Sunday - he speaks from his heart and his sermons are the best, and are so truthful and inspiring! Amazing church and we are so blessed to attend. Pastor Michael is the best preacher ever! He is truly used by God! Amazing church! I feel the presence of God every time. The messages are very sound. The worship team is phenomenal. The pastors and congregation are welcoming the moment you enter through the doors.

I had not attended church in months but had a question that baffled me for some time. I reached out to the church and Pastor Dave reached out and talked with me. He was very kind, attentive and informative in his response based on God's word.

My son loves attending as well. The children's area is amazing and definitely teaches the children in a fun atmosphere.

Thank you Springs Church for being so amazing. God bless!

name: Springs Community Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: I cannot speak to the church experience, but I'm leaving a glowing review for the preschool. We have had a great experience here with our daughter. She has opened up socially, grew in her learning and is beginning to understand her faith. I was cautiously optimistic when we came to orientation but they have proven their care and love over and over again. Ms. Lindsey, Lisa, and Rebekah have been gifts from God and we are so grateful for their guidance for our little girl. Thank you, Springs Community Church Preschool. If you are looking for a solid preschool that supports kids of all levels and abilities, I think this is a preschool worth checking out. Don't miss it! Tried this place twice, each time they were talking about nothing of substance and it appeared to be more of a rant more than any talk of morality. As well as that, it is clear that personal relations between the elderly churchgoers and the worship staff create a contentious space and play into the rants spoken on stage. Not only that, but when me and my buddy were leaving early because of said rant one of the church staff followed us out and took videos of our license plates. Would not recommend at all, they should be ashamed of how they portray the church. Pastor is a phenomenal teacher. The Holy Spirit is always Speaking through him because He Teaches the truth out of the word & has real world application. All the people are amazing and very kind.  This is a very safe place. Pastor Eric is a phenomenal speaker, and I always leave there feeling like I’ve gotten so much from his sermons. SCC is a warm and loving community, and the worship music is fantastic!  This is a wonderful church to attend!!! We do not attend church here but our children attend the preschool program. I cannot say enough about the wonderful, Christian education that our children experience each week. Our kids tell us about the amazing things they are learning and understanding. Thank you for this wonderful program!

name: Springs Community Church - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary:
This is an amazing church. My husband and I visited several churches in the area before deciding to become members at Springs. One of the biggest reasons we chose this church is its commitment to teaching the Bible in a meaningful and practical way.

Right now, we're studying the book of Genesis. Each week, we work through the next section, learning its context, interpretation, and how it applies to our lives today. Since attending Springs, I have gained a much deeper understanding of God's Word.

The church is also intentional about building genuine community. My husband and I joined a community group that meets every other week, and it has been such a meaningful addition to our lives. We've built great relationships, grown in our faith, and truly feel connected here. Amazing church that speaks the word of God and only the word of God. It’s also a very friendly location and very welcoming (especially since I serve there (jk)). John is very energetic and fun My husband and I were in New Braunfels for a few months and attended this church. We loved it here!  Pastor John delivers scripture in a clear and engaging way, making it relevant to everyday life.  The church itself offers a variety of groups for all ages, there seems to be a strong sense of connection.  Their commitment to their congregation was beautifully evident when they rallied around a family facing a difficult situation. Overall, Community Springs Church is a great option. You will feel welcome here. We love Springs Community Church! If you are looking for solid biblical teaching, an awesome kids/students ministry, and a caring community then this is the best place. Since attending Springs community, I have been encouraged and poured into by so many. I grew in my faith & was able to deal with some past hurts & poor habits by attending Re:Generations (a 12 step recovery program for past hurts, habits, and hangups). I also love that their kids ministry is so safe for kids while also teaching them biblical truth. The leaders in kids ministry go through rigorous training to make sure that the kids are kept safe from harm while in the care of the Springs. If you're looking to be encouraged in your faith, cared for by an awesome community, and to develop some new friends then this is the place for you! My family and I have have been attending and members of The Springs for almost 4 years. We were immediately drawn to the church because of the passion and commitment of the volunteers. It was clear that everyone was 'on mission' in this body, passionate about loving God and sharing Jesus with the community, and also committed to raising their family to love and serve God. We jumped at the opportunity to be discipled by and do life with these families. This isn't a church where you passively attend, you can, but God wants so much more for you. This is a church where God will use the people around you to encourage and challenge you. He will use the body of Christ at The Springs to change your heart and your life to be more like His, if you only let Him.

name: Ss. Peter & Paul Jesuit Church
reviewSummary:
After 18 years of wedding photography, I think I have photographed every church in Detroit.  Sts. Peter & Paul has always been my favorite.  So much so, that when it came time for my wife and I to get married, we happily joined the parish and chose it to be our church as well.  From a photographic standpoint, the church is beautiful.  Long aisle, balcony, large windows, grandiose altar...something about the church creates a humble, quiet reflection when you are there.  We love photographing weddings here because the bride and groom actually face the congregation!  This is so nice because the ceremony feels more intimate as you can see their reactions and witness their experience.  The music!  Julie does and INCREDIBLE job with the music.  Many times I find myself tearing up during the ceremony, moved by the sentimental background of music.  Fr. Gary is truly a humble servant and leader.  His homilies are always heartfelt and catered to the couple.  Even the marriage classes were insightful and helpful.  Lastly, the outreach programs that Sts. Peter & Paul have to help the local unhoused truly shows the core nature of the church: to serve.  Coming to mass here is like going to grandma's house - an always warm and welcoming event.  I can't say enough about how wonderful this church is.  Whether you decide to get married here or are looking for a new parish, strongly consider Sts. Peter & Paul. Beautiful church on Jefferson in downtown Detroit.  Classic pipe organ amazing altars and ceiling.   Absolutely gorgeous.   We are visiting for a wedding.  Very special church and venue. Plenty of parking behind the church.  Huge windows. Haven’t gone to service but visited during a candle 🕯️ light concert- it’s gorgeous Beautiful candle light quartet playing disney movie songs. Just what we needed.  Jesus and Disney. Doesn't get any better. This church has given me a nice Clean place to shower. Washed the filthy clothes I was wearing, and fed me some really good food until I was full.
The volenteers are always smiling and friendly.
The staff members do a great job assisting everyone who comes. At least 100 people a day. And they do this every day but Sunday. Thanks Benny. We need more people like You!

name: St Adelaide Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
Its a large medium size Catholic Church. I have been coming here for over 2 years.
Fr Anthony Buey. Is a Vietnamese  Priest who loves visitors. One hour mass. Keep your Sabbath day Holy join us for mass on Sunday at 9 am or 11 am Pray Pray Pray. This pix was from last week w the Elect.
GV from California Beautiful quaint little church. Very clean and nice people. I grew up in this Church. I was disheartened when they added two big screens and took away the books for mass. Beautiful church. I usually attend sacred heart rancho or Saint Joseph upland. Both are also very beautiful. This past weekend I was at the soccer complex and knew I wouldn't make it back for Mass on time. I looked for a local church and found Saint Adelaide. I attended and loved it. The community was welcoming and the choir was extra special as well! Not sure how hard it is to get married here, but they never called me back. I told the girl at the front desk about it and she just keeps saying, ok ill remind my supervisor. I also had a family member that  kept insisting, until she went directly to the father and told him.

name: St Agnes Catholic Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderfully built and charming Church, good Priest, and welcoming congregation!

My Dad and I came from out of town on Divine Mercy Mass on a Saturday, and we got to do Confessions before Mass! A great and memorable blessing. Stopped by when in the area for a Saturday evening mass. The priest was welcoming and delivered a solid homily. Church was well attended by friendly parishioners. Even if you aren’t Roman Catholic, the service may stir your spiritual side. Nice Church. Nice people. And ... they don't beat you into the ground with God! They're just nice. 🤗😁 Beautiful, peaceful, humble and small traditional Catholic Church. In my quest to attend Catholic Mass in all of San Diego's Catholic Churches, I attended mass here. Very welcoming community at Sunday mass, 8 AM service. Nothing better than a Catholic Mass any day of the week. Weekday Mass is reverent but speedy which is nice if you need to go to work.

name: St Alban's Episcopal Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: The word of God , presence of God and Communion!!!! Great Pastor! Enjoy the 9 am service. Very friendly community. This church is very God centered and they truly love people. They will meet you just where you are without judgment,  just love. I so love  this church  all the servants in the church are very friendly especially  father David is very kind and a great  God  bless them 🙏 They are the best Pastor Dave and his church helped my son and I too be able to get a roof over our heads for a week at a motel other wise we live in the car my park evicted us on May 3rd this month because I am in a lawsuit against them for six years now and it will be over at the end of the year and I will be laughing at them!!!! Wonderful preaching, beautiful atmosphere, friendly and welcoming. Involved in many great community humanitarian efforts.

name: St Aloysius Parish
reviewSummary:
Father Mario has really turned this church around. Listening to his live streams and Facebook and attending his mass have been fantastic. The church is tucked in between a building that you may miss. However it does not disappoint. Downtown church wedged tightly between two other buildings. They have a food pantry and a big ministry to the poor. Very interesting interior with 3 different levels. Went to Sunday morning mass. Interesting architecture with community outreach. Great service. Beautiful church, I was in a hurry and snapped what I could, it was extremely hard to find a parking spot. I wish I could have stayed longer. Enjoy Disclsimer: I am not a parishioner of this church only a one time visitor. I also rate churches based on how well the parish and participants follow the General Instructions of the Roman Missal (GIRM) and my own observations.

The church like another review stated is rather unique in that it has three levels with two having alters. It's in a horse shoe layout.
Something to note: the Tabernacle was in the center - yeah!
Because of the limited space there they did not celebrate on the original alter but instead closer in front of the railing.

1. When I entered the church it was like entering a community Hall. People talking and chit chatting - since the layout of this church is rather unique in that there is no foyer it is understandable that people use the church to talk to each other. I personally would rather the church be silent for those who wish to pray before mass.
2. Everyone followed the correct gestures and posture positions - they do kneel at concecration (they get a star for that alone).
3. They loose a star for these three reasons. One because they held hands during the our father which I believe goes against the GIRM and two the kiss of peace was exceptionally long with people leave their pews to give kiss's of peace. Third, at the end the song Happy birthday to all those whose birthday it was that week. I dont think that is appropriate after mass.

Overall the church itself is very beautiful.

name: St Ambrose Episcopal Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
The people at St. Ambrose have a God loving heart they do a lot for the homeless community such as open there shower so homeless could go to there appointments be clean and feel good about themselves the church has been feeding the homeless for over 30 yrs and do a lot to help the community they have a great service on Sunday and midweek Prayer meeting and Bible study. Because of the showers there has been several homeless people that have been able to get out of the situation of homelessness and get jobs and back into homes again and alot of other fund raisers they do and activities the church is doing for the community. Loving parish !  Good people. Beautiful Communion service !    And a great rector !!! All churches and pastors need to be like them. I have never been here, however, the article about this Pastor helping a homeless man is EXACTLY  what should be happening. God wants us to be compassionate and understanding, and this church has absolutely demonstrated that. Amazing church. beautiful and thought-provoking sermons. The congregation is super friendly. The church does lots of charity work for the local community Matthew 25:35-40 NIV
For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in, I needed clothes and you clothed me...
Thank you St. Ambrose
When I was homeless and needed to shower and eat I'd go to this church. Every Tuesday and Thursday they offer showers, free clothing, and breakfast for those in need. I am grateful for the Christ like services this church and staff provided me in my time of need.

name: St Ambrose of Milan Anglican - Escondido Campus
St Andrew Christian Church - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: St. Andrew Church truly worship God I had an awesome time at church on Sunday. The Praise Team was a blessing. The Mass Choir was powerful. And the young lady that sang Great is The Faithfulness was truly anointed. Pastor Judge Bailey was amazing in his declaration of the word. He is so on fire regarding his vision for our church in a quest in obedience to the word to evangelize and to help our community and doing that through his sermon series. I have been out due to illness, but being able to make it this week and the Sunday before was so great. I have missed this wonderful fellowship. We also had a young lady join our family during the invitation to discipleship... Praise God. We then had Communion together. How beautiful. To God be the glory.🙌🏾 I was at this location.  The St.  Andrew's Baptist Church and I was working there for The Voters Administration  Polls.  I really enjoyed this experience from 6:20 a m to 7:20 pm. 😁 Friendly place. I was invited to block party but person who invited me didn’t show. The were celebrating the opening of the St. Anthony Playground. I am blessed have this church help me with my bills when I'm in a tight spot..

name: St Andrew Newman Center - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
GOD is glorified here. Amazing Church that honors Christ Jesus always as in all Catholic Churches. Every time, in every Catholic Church you will always see a candle burning 24/7, covered by a red glass; this shows that His physical presence in the Holy Tabernacle under the appearance of bread is always there. HE is always waiting for you to visit him. HE is always waiting for us. Holy priests and beautiful community, for all ages, and a special focus on local college students. Peace, love, and prayers, to and for all, for you and yours. YOU ARE WELCOME HERE!:) I love how welcoming and accommodating staff and the priests are here! I’ve been able to arrange last minute confessions on a couple of occasions.

Thank God for the Newman Center.
And Thank You to everyone there who work to serve the faith community. You are truly appreciated. 😊 I love seeing how this community has a focus for UCR and RCC students. If you are an undergrad, this is the church you definitely have to go to. They have such a tight knit loving community, and have lots of fun events, including retreats, parties, fundraisers and weekly fellowship. I go every week because they have two AWESOME, loving priests. They give great homilies and they really care. They also have a late 7PM mass ;D Best Catholic parish for students. Father Ogu is an intellectual and Father Gino is full of thoughtful experiences. Enjoy attending services celebrated by both of them. Masses available throughout the week especially in the evenings MWThFSS. Tuesday's in the morning. I love the priests the community our young adult ministry Come Alive! I feel home! My heart is full of joy! I belong! Amen

name: St Andrew's By the Sea UMC - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love this church! It is very welcoming to everyone, and we have brought numerous friends and family members here. Our kids have participated in their youth programs since they were infants and toddlers, and it has been a loving, nurturing, and kind place for them to grow. There is a nice variety of music each Sunday. Pastor Karl’s sermons are focused, engaging, and relevant to my day to day life. I truly feel like I am learning and growing spiritually. We’ve laughed and cried (in a good way 😊) in church, and I’m always glad we attended. I have been attending this church for almost three years now and have truly found my church home. I started there just after the passing of my husband of 53 years. My first impression was very good. I was greeted by friendly people including Pastor Karl, all of whom wanted to know a little about me. I  went back the following week and was impressed by the fact that they remembered my name and why I initially came.
Most of all I have enjoyed Pastor Karl’s sermons and his time with the kids.
It is a place where you can get involved as much or as little as you wish knowing everyone is so supportive in whatever you decide to do. Getting involved has been a blessing to me as I now have many more friends and am still meeting more. I have watched the church grow considerably in the almost three years I have attended. I have even brought along some of my friends who have all joined the church family.
So if you are looking for a good church home with great music and very interesting sermons by a great pastor, this is the place to come. This is the finest church I have ever attended. The music is superb. The organist/pianist is the best I have ever heard. The musical selections are always varying, interesting and supportive of the sermon of the day. The minister is young and energetic. The sermons are always delivering a message I can relate to and hopefully make me a better Christian.  The location has a superb view of the Pacific Ocean. Either before or after the service take the time to enjoy the wonderful view provided by God. St Andrew’s By the Sea is a Michelin Church. They also having amazing potlucks. Pastor Karl is amazing. I always leave church learning something new and feeling my spiritual soul lifted. His Sermons are never boring I especially love Finding God in the movies and the Tuesday Matinee. The Band, Choir and Bells music augment the Sermons  The Music Director often educates in the origins of the music. Great fun. It is truly the church of connecting - there is so much to participate in if you want. Come Connect and
Grow.
Dee member side 1988. Raised my children and now my grandchildren who recently became members at age 15 and 19
They drive up from San Diego to be with the church and Youth which is outstanding  Hope to see you soon. 🙏 Went here for preschool in ‘97. Ruined my life as an introvert child. I remember that pointed building not knowing it had anything to do with religiousness. Here I am in my 30s, addict and hating life remembering the lower level where they had two rooms to separate the children that played and the ones that didn’t. Then came Lobo elementary. Then in the 2nd grade I was put in a mixed class portable at the end of the property in a 2/3 grade combo. Can’t forget the YMCA a couple portables down.

name: St Andrew's Episcopal Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
So this is a nice place to feel closer to God. The congregation is very accepting. The staff is kind. I felt welcomed and even though it was my first time they invited me to a lunch function after Sunday services, which was nice. What could be more Christian! Sincere, welcoming services with an excellent choir. The church provides a lot of services for the community.

name: St Andrews Presbyterian Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Having gone for the 1st time thru a friends invite i was so happy that i accepted the invite. The church itself is nice and welcoming and the ushers at the door are so pleasant and friendly. The singing is nice and it helps that the song words are on a big screen so you can join in the chorus. Very uplifting preaching and singing. I love this new church.  I’ve been absent for years trying to find something that spoke to me and St Andrew’s has been the best answer to my prayers. Blessings to all at this church. Our family has been attending St. Andrews Presbyterian Church for over 15 years. The church is a charming, neighborhood church that really cares about its community and each other. The church encourages authentic discipleship, relationship with Jesus, and each other. The church has a heart and genuine compassion for its homeless ministry. In a time where church is not as relevant, our family is so blessed to have this community. The sign outside says "Welcome home"...and they really mean it.  It is the warmest, most welcoming church I have ever attended.  Pastor Peter Dunn is an accessible, loving man of God an I am honored and extremely grateful to worship at St. Andrew's. Their children's and youth department are exceptional, led by a phenomenal teaching staff. Come join us so you, too, can experience the absolute genuine joy it is to be a part of it all. A community church that also, has many events throughout the  year. I  find it has a few clicks that occassionally makes for a bad experience,  however  most people are loving and have a warm spirit, it offers two services one at 8:30 , the traditional one, usually with organ and the choir and a 10:00 service with a rock band and contemporary Christian rock music. The Pastor  has a current upbeat message and is usually very interesting.  The church caters to the homeless on Tuesdays and Thursdays,  a hot lunch is served at 11:30 . The  church has missionaries working in  other parts of the world. I'm sure it's a great place to worship, I hear it is so, but I come on Tuesdays and Thursdays for lunch. They serve great Italian dishes to those in need, and then also offer services and clothing. 11am to 1pm.

name: St Augustine By-The-Sea Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
What a marvelous event this was! I found out about this event last minute, Baroque Collegium Meditations , at this church in Santa Monica. I didn't even notice the denomination of the church. It turned out it's a sister church of mine, All Saints Episcopal church in Pasadena.
The ambience was perfect for meditation. The lighting , the beautiful glass windows of the church. I had never been here before . The people working in the event were very helpful guiding guests to the restrooms and those with mobility issues were properly guided through an accessible restroom. The restrooms are so clean and well maintained.
I am not surprised at their courtesy , inclusion and friendliness.  I am proud to be part of the episcopal family.
The event it self was a world class act. The music was simply delightful! The musicians and singers are quite  experienced and well known in their field. I didn't want to be disrespectful so I didn't do a video  of it.  It was a very moving experience. I am very grateful to this community led by Reverend Nate and Katie. They welcomed me and my kids early in our spiritual journey back to God. I've really had to think about how to express my reason for leaving St Augustine's 2-1/2 years ago.

I'm Jewish by birth and converted 26 years ago. I chose to become Episcopalian. So it was disappointing and painful to sit through a 70-minute service on October 8, 2023, listen to a sermon about "love, love, love" and not hear a single word of compassion ~ or any mention at all ~ about the worst attack on Jews since the Holocaust.

The following week, that omission was justified by saying "We didn't know how bad it was." That felt like a dagger to the heart because it was that priest in whom I placed my trust to teach me, to hear my confessions during Lent and receive counseling. From my perspective, this was an individual who "walked the walk" more authentically than anyone I'd encountered in my then-23 years as an Episcopalian.

There was wall-to-wall graphic coverage from early morning on October 7,  it was all over the internet, and it was in the papers. It strains credulity to believe neither person on the alter heard or read anything. What hurt most is the voices on the alter expressed what felt like sincere empathy each time a horror was inflicted on marginalized groups, for natural disasters, for humanity. It sadly didn't happen in October 2023.

My faith was broken in those 2 weeks and I haven't been able to bring myself to set foot in any church since then. I have spoken with 2 trusted friends since childhood about what wasn't acknowledged at a church I'd loved so much. One is a prominent Deacon in the Catholic church who said, among other things, "today I am a Jew"; the other is a pastor with the UCC Church because my heart ached, still does, and needs to be fed.

I understand now that Jesus and God never hurt me ~ it was the humans on the alter. Humans make mistakes. It's not unreasonable to expect better from those who teach and preach. Warm and inclusive community of people St. Augustine by-the-Sea Episcopal Church has become a place where I feel genuinely welcomed, seen, and supported. What I appreciate most is the sense of inclusivity you feel the moment you walk through the doors—everyone is embraced exactly as they are, without judgment, pressure, or dogma. We attended a small service and had our dog blessed, there was music and a short sermon and it was a lovely special day, we drove from Lg Beach and really enjoyed this church.

name: St Augustine Church of Christ - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
I am truly grateful for this church and the boldness with which it speaks the truth. In a time when it's easy to water down the message, this church remains grounded in Scripture and committed to preaching the Word without compromise. The sermons are not just inspiring—they’re convicting, challenging, and rooted in biblical truth.

You can feel the presence of God here, not only in the worship but in the way the leadership speaks honestly about sin, grace, repentance, and hope. It’s not always the easiest message to hear, but it’s the one we need—and that’s what makes this church so powerful and authentic.

If you’re searching for a place that doesn’t shy away from the truth but speaks it in love, this is it. You’ll leave encouraged, but also transformed. I have recently started attending services and not only has everyone been extremely welcoming, but the services are easy to follow along with and completely backed with scripture. I have been to several churches growing up, and I had not found one that fit before now.

Update: I have been attending services for about 5 months now and my original review still stands. This is a wonderful establishment of God, and I am so thrilled to have found it! Very friendly and sound congregation Very unique and engaging service....my son loved it and actually paid close attention to the teaching of the Lord's word. I recommend this warm and friendly congregation Beautiful congregation,  very friendly.  The service was lovely. Bro Burkert preached a good sermon on Christian Influence

name: St Bartholomew Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the perfect intimate church where it is small enough that you really create a community of Belmont Shore - Long Beach feel. Open & accepting church to all. They offer bible study classes for kids that I am proud to be part of . You really get a warm feeling from everyone here. Helping children learn about Jesus is what we do. Love Saint Bartholomew Church. Make sure that you are there on time for mass because parking could be tricky. #GODisGREAT Im a member of this parish and have been for over 15 years. The parish is open  to all and i became part of it because i felt its a warm and accepting parish.  You will feel welcomed with open arms from both the priests and community.  The masses are traditional but the homily s are related to modern lifestyles. The parish offers alot of extra activities in faith formation,  neighborhood out reach,  activities for all ages from elementary school thru parishioners in golden years.  They have annual book sales, fashion shows, art shows, some with artist from international locals, cont ed for religious growth,  giving trees to help make Christmas brighter for the children who would otherwise not have one.   I could keep.going on but suffice it to say they offer alot to the neighborhood,  and the neighborhood gives back.  You will have a sense of belonging to a bigger community....life.
Plus i just love the Irish priests....i could listen to their musical accents forever. Beautiful Catholic Church! Great stained glass windows and pews, and they even have a childrens chapel for noisy kids!

Only downside is the parking, gotta park on the street. Advent/Christmas season at St. Bartholomew's was beautiful despite the pandemic environment. Thanks to all who made it so. I would recommend finding a different church. The people coming to service are not the type of people you want to bring your family around. They may put on a smile but that means nothing. God bless.

name: St Catherine of Alexandria Church Temecula - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
With all due respect for the parishioners but this Church architecture is very modern for me, the main Christ in the church that is hanging is one of the most scariest figure I ever seen, and the environment feels kind of protestan. God bless the people that goes to  this Church! 🙏 Beautiful Church, priest, workers, and volunteers. I have been attending this church since 2020. My daughter start attending the first communion classes and I go to pray the rosary and to mass. I really love this community and church and staff. Thanks for all you do. You're doing great. I highly recommend visiting St Catherine of Alexandria Very nice church , only problem is too much traffic , to get in & out of the parking lot. We've been parishioners here since 2012 and Fr. Tim is making it a more cohesive parish. Thanks be to God for our current pastor. After two months of debating whether to write this, I feel a responsibility to warn other couples considering getting married here. Another reviewer mentioned that working with this parish was the hardest part of her wedding planning, and I couldn’t agree more. Communication was extremely slow, and the entire process felt confusing and unclear.

At no point did anyone mention that our marriage file needed approval from both their archdiocese and my home parish’s archdiocese, since we were marrying outside of our parish. I found this out one week before my wedding when they called to say that without a completed file, the wedding could not move forward. It was the first time they had ever brought it up.

The coordinator also reversed her prior approval of our ceremony music, informing us the day before, at the rehearsal, that the songs could no longer be used. While the priest who married us was wonderful and made the ceremony truly special, several guests shared with us afterward that staff members had been rude to them.

The cost was also unexpected. It was over a thousand dollars to marry here, with additional required deposits for music, altar servers, and even the priest. While I understand higher fees for non parishioners, these add-ons (pianist, cleaning deposit, alter server, etc.) felt unusual, especially since many of these are typically voluntary offerings decided by the couple.

I would encourage the head priest to consider whether his staff is representing the parish in the way he would hope. Despite the beauty of the ceremony itself, the experience leading up to it was unnecessarily stressful and disappointing

name: St Dominic Church - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
I love how vibrant and energetic your church is every Sunday. The music is wonderful.
I always watch it when I don’t feel well enough to go to Mass at my church. I am 81 and cannot always make it to church because of my health. An amazing community!  Fabulous congregation, music and priest.  A great place for families as well as couples and singles.  Endless opportunities to volunteer and be involved in the community far outside the church walls!  This is a really special community! I had a terrible experience with Fr. Tom Fanta, who is the priest of this Church. Initially, he seemed like a very nice guy. When I first moved to the area I found out about St. Dominic's and asked for a private appointment with Fr. Tom. I explained to him that I have a gastrointestinal condition that makes it difficult for me to sit through a mass, but that I wanted to receive the Eucharist, and asked if he would be able to give it to me at his office on a bi-weekly basis because I believe receiving the Eucharist is very important, and he agreed.

I've investigated and practiced many religions and faith traditions in my life. A little bit after this initial meeting, I felt drawn to Hinduism, a faith tradition I've practiced in the past, specifically Gaudiya-Vaishnavism. After a time, I felt called home to Catholicism, and wanted to talk to Fr. Tom about my conflicting beliefs, so that I could work them out in my head and receive guidance from him about how to unify my thoughts and theological understanding of god to focus on the Trinity. As someone who is autistic, my mind goes from thing, to thing, to thing, and I was hoping he could help me come back to Christ in a strong and positive way, instead of continuing to stray.

After explaining how I personally view the Trinity - which is a bit unconventional - I was hoping he could reorient my brain toward the correct view. Instead he gave me a borderline disgusted look and said, "I'm not a Hindu priest. It's not my job to sit here and philosophize with you," and I was in complete and total shock. I have never in my entire life had a priest speak to me that way, or look at me, a seeker, with such disdain.

He then told me I had to go to three in-person Masses - which I'm not able to do very often because of my condition - and told me to call three people and do nothing but listen to how they are doing, and what is going on in their life, without talking about myself. That's insane to me because if he knew me in real life he'd know that's exactly what I do nearly every day. I live in a group home and most of my days are spent talking on the phone with friends, asking about their lives, and helping them with whatever issues they may have that I feel qualified to assist with.

I wrote him an e-mail following this encounter expressing my hurt in a polite way, and he never responded. I decided to call the Archdiocese and file a formal complaint. I believe that the priest I spoke to was named Fr. John, but I can't remember. He told me he would look into it, and got back to me a few weeks later and said Fr. Tom Fanta stated he did not feel the need to respond to the e-mail, and furthermore, Fr. Tom said he had seen me out at Van Aiken with friends several times, so clearly if I'm able to go out to Van Aiken and hang out, I am not as impaired and unable to go to Mass as I said.

Again, I was shocked. This was an outright, boldfaced lie. I don't ever go to Van Aiken. I loathe crowds and shopping centers. I don't even have any in-person friends to go to Van Aiken with if I wanted to! All my friends are virtual, I'm a very reclusive person. Fr. Tom may have seen someone who looks similar to me at Van Aiken, and mistook them for me, or he was literally lying through his teeth to justify not giving me private communion, when I could easily have my gastroenterologist at Cleveland Clinic write an official doctors note confirming my medical claim. Fr. Tom was either mistaken, or blatantly lied. I have no clue.

This man is a wolf in sheep's clothing. Is he charismatic? Can he deliver a good homily? Absolutely - I've been to their Mass on one of my "good days" regarding the GI stuff and seen him speak. Then again, Satan is also charismatic and eloquent, so I'd be curious to see what Fr. Tom Fanta is like in his private life, or what skeletons may be in his closet. Wonderful welcoming Parish and an important part of our community of greater Shaker Heights. This church community is amazing. Having visited on a trip to Cleveland, this place has everything. Great homilies. Great music. Great atmosphere. I tune in to the weekly Sunday livestreams after going to my own home parish. I only wish this was in my hometown and not hours away!

name: St Dunstan's Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Attended a chili cook off the church held recently that was open to the community.  Everyone was very welcoming and friendly. My husband, daughter and I went and had a wonderful time. Thank you for hosting this event and opening up to the surrounding neighborhood 😀. The place for toy train swap meet I was attending a Al-Anon workshop and Round Table on a Saturday morning. The facility is fantastic and all the church staff were very very helpful in making sure that our event went well. The parking lot is adequate I was attending a Al-Anon workshop and round table on a Saturday morning. The facility is fantastic and all the church staff were very very helpful and making sure that our event went well. The parking lot is adequate and everything is very organized and clean. We have a young family of four with kids that are three and 18 months.  We were married at St. Dunstan's, had our reception here and both of our kids are baptized here.  This is a great church and we have a family group that meets regularly.  Join us!! This location was the AGTTA (All Gauge Toy Train) site for members to showcase their trains, etc. for sale to the public.  Clean place and convenient.

name: St Elisabeth Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
ASH WEDNESDAY 12:00 MASS
Arrived at 12:10, doors locked. Mass in going on inside. Man in black suit blocking door says cannot come in. I left work to get my ashes.  Big crowd outside asking why church is locking us out. I left. Will never go to this church again!! Ugh :( My hometown Church Lovett been coming here since I was a kid . They have two annual carnivals one in May the other in September My go to church if the first Friday n Saturday of the  month comes by... no other churches around me offers such St. Elisabeth and St'Jane are unmatched ... St. Elizabeth used to be my church while growing up in Van Nuys...! My sister got married there! and the rules were not as bad as they are now... for photographers/videographers that is! It used to be that we were allowed to move from one side to the other, walking BEHIND the church goers of course... but that changed a few years ago! we were to stay on one side of the altar, and shoot our images/video from there... which gave us a good angle! and we usually were able place a camera on the other side, out of the way, so we could capture the Bible readings... but now! we can't even do that!!! We are forced to stay on the handicaped ramp to the right side of the altar, and were told to "not move from there" until it is time to go to the other side for the offering of flowers to the Virgin Mary... which is hidden away in the very far part of the altar... which you can NOT get to, unless you get to walk there BEFORE the flower time! and to make matters worse... because of the Pope's passing, they had a shrine built to the right of our location, so we could not get a shot of the altar!!! I was told that I could NOT place a camera in the far side of sanctuary, because "those were the rules", so I asked "who makes the rules?" and Miguel said that each church has its own rules... I asked why not let me place a camera out of the way? it wasn't on anybody's way! again... "those are the rules"... So I asked him.. "why do they allow so many cameras during mass at the Vatican? they must have a hundred cameras! he said that they were "unmanned"... so I said I could do that! I can put up to 5 unmanned cameras! He said "No, you can not! those are the rules!" The church lady...(I didn't catch her name) told me I could come back to the altar for a few pictures after the service... but when I brought the girl back, she screamed at me that no more pictures were allowed! that they had another quinceañera coming in! I said "I was told I could get a few" she yelled "who told you that?" I said "YOU DID!" and then she said okay! only one! I did a test shot, she said "that is enough!" REALLY?! it was a test shot! I took 3 pictures of the same pose and walked out! Hoping I will never have to come back to this church!!! and I will tell everyone of my clients to change their mind about having their event there... it seems like they are in the "business" of faith... because the service is NOT free... like the Pope said, but they get around that with the technicality of calling it an "offering"... which should be called a "bribe" if we're being honest.
I have been doing professional photography and video for over 3 decades! and I have often asked my clients, if they knew their house was going to flood in a few minutes, what items would they rescue from it? the answer is almost always their pictures and videos... but not the clients from St. Elizabeth! since they don't have any of those! because "those are the rules". I am not a regular church goer to this place.But I do know that they go out of their way to serve their community.I'm there with my dance group to perform every year for their festivals. A lot of planning that goes into that time and effort from everyone that is involved

name: St Elizabeth Ann Seton Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice and convenient location with plenty of parking. The church itself was welcoming; however, it was difficult at times to fully understand the mass due to the priest having a very strong accent. Came by today for Mass and Rosary.

Can't say enough good things about this community.

Parishioners were really nice and welcoming. Pastor was out front on my way in talking and laughing with everybody.

Church is beautiful. Great layout. It felt like a comfortable Holy space.

Had projectors showing the text for the readings and songs on the walls on either side of the altar. Have never seen this before. Loved it.

Sound and Music were great. The big choir was A plus.  Catholicism done very well IMHO. ❤️ Pretty reliable for confession times; however, the Priest can sometimes be a bit snappy at you depending on your sin so watch out for that.

They have pretty good Adoration etiquette too which is nice. This beautiful church has inviting individuals and members. I highly recommend finding your faith in this church as they have groups for children, teens, and couples. Finding your faith may not be easy, but it’s 100% worth it. I did it on line, was not sure if I could get to mass on Sunday, but I did.
I really enjoyed this mass and will probably do it most Saturdays and do my church Sunday. You know us die hard cradle Catholics we need our Eucharist.

name: St Elizabeth Seton Catholic - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful and peaceful church.
Father Michael is a kind pastor like his homily. Great community I attended Easter Mass here for the first time in about 21 years. There were some genuinely beautiful parts of the experience, especially Communion, which was deeply meaningful to me. The church itself was welcoming enough, and I was able to have a real spiritual experience in spite of my concerns.

Unfortunately, the priest’s message was deeply disappointing and spiritually troubling to me. He repeatedly emphasized identity, cumulative personal experience, and the idea that there is no real transformation, which to me completely misses the heart of resurrection. I also found the repeated emphasis on Satan, the devil, and prayers framed around first responders and “our troops” to feel more political and fear-based than Christ-centered or universal. For me, the message felt narrow, backward, and out of alignment with love, transformation, and the deeper spiritual truth Easter is supposed to represent.

So while there was real beauty in the sacramental part of the Mass, the homily and overall framing left me disturbed rather than uplifted. Your mileage may vary. This Church has a reputation…Yes indeed! The most active church I have ever been a part of! The priest is literally a Holy Man… Father Michael heads his flock. Great group of MOSES men gather at 6:30 am Saturdays for coffee and doughnuts and study… what a wonderful group of humble men… check it out yourself! Beautiful Church. Took my grandma to their Sunday Mass while I was visiting. The priest gave some lovely homilies that he put a lot of heart into. The churchgoers were all pretty friendly. Hope I get to go again, someday! Beautiful Catholic Church. There’s a wonderful statue outside in the plaza. A good place to go pray. The service was wonderful and the people inviting
