name: Stonegate Fellowship - Midland Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church, they truly preach God’s Word to all, non judgmental of race color or cread, we are all God’s Children and not one without Sin.  I invite all to come hear God’s Word 🙏
Sincerely,
Rusty. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Stonegate Fellowship in Midland, Texas truly an incredible place to grow in faith and community. I’m grateful for the foundation laid by past leaders like Dustin Peirce and Patrick Payton, and it’s inspiring to see how the new leadership has continued to build on that legacy. The direction, vision, and authenticity they bring have the congregation thriving more than ever. Stonegate is a church that genuinely feels alive, welcoming, and grounded in purpose. I couldn’t be more thankful to have previously called it home. Great church and very friendly people there.  They have a lot of great programs for kids and adults.  They have counseling for those in need of help to better themselves.  I have a lot of friends that attend here. Fabulous, Warm, Welcoming & Truly Shows the Love of CHRIST. I didn't just see and hear IT. I felt IT. GOD Bless y'all bunches. The music is wonderful too! Beautiful place, people are so welcoming & they have a positive attitude that is contagious. They have so many programs for all people, any age. Pastor is funny & always give beautiful speeches. Their band is the best part of the service. And their child services go beyond needs, my child loves it.

name: StonePoint Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been searching for a church for along time and when I started coming to StonePoint it felt like where God wanted me to be. The people are so friendly and Pastor Todd’s teachings are understandable and relate to many things I’ve experienced.  I’m so happy to call StonePoint my home! My husband and I started going to StonePoint in October. The members and pastoral staff are all warm and welcoming. Each Sunday's message is on a point and I always walk away with something to reflect upon or a better way to live my life.  They have children's youth and young adult ministries as well as life groups for everyone else. They encourage participation and community without being overwhelming or overbearing.   If you are looking for a small church with a big heart, this is a place for you! I love StonePoint.  I have not felt more genuine love, acceptance,and friendship anywhere. This world can be tough, and as we say, "There are no perfect people. " but it's nice to have a spiritual home that feels safe.
Thanks to Pastor Todd  Cox and his lovely wife Tina for stearing the ship.❤️ We have been going to StonePoint for 2.5 years and it is like home to us. The people are loving, generous, and warm. Our worship is contemporary and we have an awesome sound. This church is about the people's hearts for each other and learning to understand God's word and live it out.  We are growing and have opportunities for people who want to pour in as volunteers in all areas. Hope to see you Sunday morning at 10am! StonePoint has been my home for 3 years now. Paster Todd is down to earth and really preaches the word of God unlike anyone else. They have a nursery and play area for my daughter, and they really make sure every person is valued and included. Great environment for families looking to find a local church!

name: Stones Crossing Church - Greenwood Campus
reviewSummary:
This was my first visit. I did some research before attending.

I was well welcomed. The first person (greeter), made me feel welcomed. I went up to the desk to introduce myself and get more information,  very friendly. Ushers were friendly. The pastor took time to speak with me for a few minutes before service. The service itself was great.

I was so impressed I asked about membership and ways to serve at my first visit. I live roughly 25-30 minutes away and will gladly drive here. A very welcoming church and Pastor Scott preaches from the Word of God. We love Stones Crossing!  My husband and I didn't go to church growing up and we feel so welcome here.  Pastor Scott is truly blessed and captivating (I'm never checking my watch - it's more like 'wow, it's already over?!').  And the band before and after is like being at a concert - all the musicians are so talented.  I'm so grateful for good neighbors who invited us to this church, which just feels like home! You will experience Real Worship and Fellowship here at Stones Crossing Church! We are going on our 6th Sunday now and we have experienced the Holy Spirits presence during the Music and throughout the Pastors Message! Friendly and out going People who reach out to you as you come through the doors. Come out to Worship with us, we would love to see and get to know you! I've been a member of Stones Crossing Church since 2004 and I continue to hear God's Word presented in relevant and attention getting messages every Sunday.  Our lead pastor and our entire leadership are fully committed to helping people grow stronger in their faith so they can share the gospel's good news with others.

name: Stonybrook Church - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful pastors, congregation very welcoming.Have been attending 8 years and active in several areas of church support. This is a great place to worship God, and we invite anyone who's not a member of this church for communion it's an open table so now I'm inviting anyone who wants to hear some good christian music & sing this church is located at 485 cherry bottom rd, Gahanna Ohio 43230 I just visited this place a couple times while I was temporarily living close. Everybody is so friendly and welcoming. They have many great programs for kids and they are very professional and responsible when working with kids Have been a member over 30 years, a great friendly place with many offerings and caring staff. Stonybrook Church is very welcoming.

name: Story Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family loves Story Church and our church community! We’ve had the privilege of being members of the church since the beginning and seeing our kids grow up in this church has been such a blessing! The children’s ministry is amazing! Our boys have grown so much in their faith and I know that Story has played a huge part in this. We’re forever grateful for the hardworking staff and volunteers that make it a priority to teach our kids the truth of the gospel week after week! We've been attending Story Church for more than 5 years now and love it. It has been amazing to see this new church plant grow and reach so many people in the community with the gospel. They have a great children's program for kids ages 1 til 5th grade, and a youth program for students in 6th-12th grade. There's "home groups" that meet throughout the week, making it easy to get connected well with different people. And now that they're in a new building that they have access to all week, they now offer various programs like women's Bible study, men's discipleship groups, classes, prayer meetings, and more. We love Story Church and have been so blessed by the Bible-based preaching, the people, the worship teams, our home group, the kids' programs, serving in various roles, and more! We started attending Story after my friend prompted us to. I kept telling her I didn't want to come to some new "hipster church." Our first service was a Christmas Eve service right before the pandemic hit and I was instantly drawn in.

Solid, Bible based preaching, a warm and welcoming community for our kids (and a kids ministry that really focuses on teaching our kids, not just babysitting), godly leadership, and a desire to really see one another grow in our faith.

We recently attended the membership class and I'm very grateful for the checks and balances that are in place to hold those who are shepherding us accountable.

I've grown up in church my whole life and I've been in churches where 10% of the people do all the work to keep things going. Story church also has protocols in place for those who serve so that they are not just always serving but are also in service getting fed as well.

Our community group is extremely diverse when it comes to age, marital status, having kids, etc but it has been so wonderful to have that small group community to dig deeper into life with.

I'm thankful to be a part of this body of believers. We love Story Church!  It’s a place where the gospel is preached, the Bible is taught, and the Spirit is active.   It’s a place where the broken find forgiveness and transformation and people from all backgrounds find a home in the family of God. Solid Gospel-centered preaching church. We’ve called it home for the past 6 years👍🏼

name: Story City Church Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: I was invited to Story City Church in 2020 ( Pandemic time) by my neighbors, a very nice couple who also had a wonderful spirit. When I visited Story City for the 1st time, I understood where and how my neighbors got their beautiful spirit. From the Pastor to All the congregation, they are beautiful, loving, kind hearted, welcoming, friendly, caring Christian. This church is a Home. They Pray, they have Bible study small groups, they have church events, The preached word is the truth, uplifting, spirit moving, Hallelujah Amen fulfilling. The songs they sang every Sunday create a room for spiritual praise and honor to God welcoming God’s presence. I’ve never, not one Sunday gone to Story City Church and Not been feed a Good word, greeted by welcoming friendly people, felt Gods presence, not enjoyed the songs and the service. The love you get and feel at this church is beautiful and Godly. They invite you in as family regardless of race. The neighbors who invited me were white, the people who invited me to their birthday parties, baby showers, house, dinner, book writers group, were white and black. The 1st day I visited as I was walking out a lady ran after me to greet me, welcome me,  introduced herself, talked to me,  prayed for me right then and there and gave me her number. I left that day so happy, oh and yes she was a white lady who is actually a celebrity still doing movies today. I can’t began to name the amazing people there because there’s not enough space here but just know this church has learned how to live as true Godly people with the love of God in their hearts.  They welcome everyone regardless of your race. I made friends and found them to be like family in and outside of my race and learned more about how God is while going to Story City. They are not a religious church they are a Godly Church. Preaching and teaching the true word of God. The Pastor Jarred is amazing. He studies the word and preaches it from the spirit of God, the anointing of the Holy Spirit. I don’t praise man, I praise God so I’m thankful for the good word that the pastor preached but Pastor didn’t just preach a good word. He prayed and taught and lived a good word. He didn’t act Holier than thou. He never claimed to be perfect, he preached Gods Word and always showed Godly love. I asked him for prayer and not only did he pray but he’s set up meetings to talk. It was easier for me to do zoom so we met on zoom. He listened. Then explained and he prayed for me. Amen. I joined the morning pray team that prays early before the service starts. Even they prayers blessed me. They didn’t Preach/ Pray, they prayed to Gods ears from their heart as ambassadors of Christ for the church for the Pastor for the service for the block for the city The praise praised team etc. AMEN.  I moved and I’m no longer there but I tell you I haven’t found another church like  Story City yet But I am still friends with a lot of people that I’ve connected with there because they are beautiful people from their soul and the spirit. If you’re Anywhere near Burbank, California Story City is a church to call home. Incredible gathering of people who deeply care about the community & sharing God's love! The sermons are Gospel-centered & the donuts are delicious. Kids have a fun, safe place to play, learn, & be known individually by passionate, fun-loving teachers. SCC thrives on welcoming newcomers & offers a life of joy through Jesus Christ! 😊🤗 I love this church. I love the Bible centered messages. I love the heart felt amazing worship lead by a variety of very talented people. My husband and I work with the elementary aged children at least twice a month and alternate with another couple who are amazing. My husband is diligent to study the scripture/story being taught and prepare the lessons in advance, and we plan fun activities to reinforce the lessons. It is a joy getting to know the kids and their parents, and sharing the truths of God's words with them. Stopped in from out of town and very much appreciated the kindness, friendliness, and sincere adherence to a scripture-based teaching.  Great church, I hope to stop back sometime. I just moved from Arizona to California and it’s been really hard for me to find a place where I don’t feel overwhelmed or to much judgement. I came here and I was welcomed and greeted with so many smiles even if I sit in the corner by myself someone always comes to speak to me. I feel welcomed and it’s really my safe space. The pastor and his wife are amazing people. The whole worship team is AMAZING I honestly feel like I’m at a concert every time which makes my experience more heartfelt I cry every time because god is amazing and I love it so much I can’t wait until it’s Sunday. The pastor makes it so easy and fun to learn about the word and I can relate. This place honestly makes moving to a diffrrent state with no friends or family super comforting and I can’t wait to meet and learn about everyone! I love love love love this church !

name: StoryHeights Church
reviewSummary:
I have been coming to this church off and on for almost 5 years and I feel like I’m home every time I’m there. If you are looking for a church in the Greater Boston/MetroWest area that is Bible preaching, Jesus proclaiming and full of the Holy Spirit, I would 1000% recommend StoryHeights. The pastors are so gifted in their calling and are ready to welcome you with open arms! Im so honored to be a member of this mighty family of faith! From the moment you walk into StoryHeights Church, the worship experience is powerful, genuine, and full of God’s presence. The worship team leads with so much passion and authenticity — it never feels like a performance, but a true atmosphere of encountering Jesus. The music is excellent, the energy is uplifting, and the presence of God is tangible every single week.

What I love most is how the worship creates space for everyone, whether you’ve followed Jesus for years or are just beginning your faith journey. Every service leaves me encouraged, refreshed, and closer to God. Story Heights has become more than a church to our family — it’s home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church where worship is heartfelt, spirit-filled, and life-giving! If you are new to the area (or looking for a church home) START HERE! :) We moved to MA Aug 2024 and did not know anyone, the area or the churches. We have lived in many states and know finding a church is difficult. This is the first time in 15years of moving we found the right church the first time. The theology is sound, the congregation is diverse, the people are kind and the pastors are invested in the PEOPLE. If you’re still not sure- here is what you will find - people of different races, backgrounds, styles and professions. A team of volunteers that ensure that every one that walks to the doors feels welcome. That Jesus is the center of all they do. Whether you’re single, married, young or old- you will find you fit in at  StoryHeights. We are moving states again, will be leaving this church so my only motivation in posting this is hoping the next person like me who is searching Google for a church home, doesn’t have to search as far. Truly, start here. Great church , great community and great pastors my family and I we are very happy to find this church . I have been coming to this church for 2 years now. This church is not just a church, it is my home, my family, my present, and my future. I have felt so loved by so many members of the church and have built relationships with so many people I could never put it in words. If you are lost, hopeless, alone, scared, or even sick this is the hospital to bring your needs to and surrender to Jesus.

name: Storyline Church - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church while out of town and was enjoying the service. But then when it was time to take communion, the pastor made the most outrageous statement that one could only partake if they were a member of that church or in good standing with another church. That was so disturbing!   First of all, our "worthiness" to take of the bread and the cup is ALL about our personal relationship with Christ and NOTHING about belonging to a particular church! It seemed so pharisaical for a pastor to say that. The church should not be a club that you have to belong to or be considered in good standing with in order to obey God's commands. That is clearly self-serving and totally missing the deep and personal meaning of the solemn sacrement. I hope that is not your church policy. If it is, please, please rethink it before it becomes a stumbling block to your spiritual growth. I love Storyline! I've been a member for a little over a year, and I continue to learn something new with every sermon. The leadership team is dedicated to sharing the Gospel clearly and helping us apply biblical truth in everyday life. From my very first visit, I felt welcomed and at home. The worship team is incredibly talented and draws us into meaningful praise. Everything at this church points to King Jesus and the saving relationship He offers to everyone. Highly recommend! Having moved to Denver for school, I was looking for a church, but I wasn't entirely sure what I was looking for. I started attending a smaller church at first, but something just wasn't sitting right.

One Sunday, I joined some of my school peers for a service at Storyline. I really liked how both the worship and sermon intertwined the Gospel with its message. Then I kept coming, and the Gospel was passionately described in every worship time and sermon, consistently, every week. That's how I knew Storyline was the right church.

As Christians we can get so caught up in going through the motions that we begin to lose our "first love" (Rev. 2:4-5). What I love about Storyline most is that they keep the Gospel real and fresh for everyone, and it reminds me every time why I love and follow Jesus.

The Storyline of Scripture is all about Jesus and how He invites us to join Him in the mission of building His Kingdom on earth until He returns. Storyline reminds and helps us understand our purpose in this story, and the emphasis on really studying and digging into God's Word at both a communal and individual level brings that story and purpose to life for all involved.

Come and take your next step in following Jesus at Storyline! You'll be amazed at how much joy and meaning you'll find in the journey! I am new to Colorado and was looking for a modern Bible teaching church to visit and hopefully call home, I was a part of salt company in Iowa before and remember when this church joined the ministry. Storyline has been nothing short of amazing! Fantastic worship, and in depth yet practical biblical teaching each Sunday is what you can expect. They have children’s ministry so if you have kids they can check into that for the service. We got plugged into a community group which has been great as well. Fantastic church to check out if you’re interested during the holiday season, new in town, or looking for a church home! It's too bad there is no discussion of biblical scripture as it applies to current events in this Nation (for I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in, I needed clothes and you clothed me.  Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me.  Love your neighbor as yourself.  Christ is for People all across the Earth.  Why is there no discussion of the current cruelty?

name: Storyline Church - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary:
Storyline is the best church I have ever been to. The energy and the structure of the service are amazing. I love how this church prioritizes scripture and the teachings of Jesus Christ. The way the preacher delivers the message is beautiful. Sunday is my favorite day because I not only look forward to spending time with Jesus, but also attending the service because I leave with learning something new that I am able to apply to my life and reflect on. I highly recommend joining our community because you won't be disappointed. I passed through here a couple weeks ago and loved it! It was probably the most welcoming church I’ve ever been to (even on my walk in from the parking lot, I was accompanied by some very friendly church goers!). If you’re in this area and looking for a good community and impactful sermons, I’d highly suggest Storyline! I absolutely love Storyline!! This was the first church I visited when I first moved to the Bay and it has been my home church since! Each serve team is lead by incredible leaders who are intentional in walking alongside every member of the team, and the church does such a great job of getting people in plugged in to their connect groups! The community here is amazing, everybody is extremely loving and welcoming, and you can tell that people are really passionate about their faith! I also super appreciate Pastor Akeem in his humility, the depth and context he brings to his sermons, and the ways he connects topics explored in Bible with every day life. You can tell he really cares about each person that walks through the doors and that he practices what he preaches. Wish I could take this church with me when I move back home! 🫶🏻 Storyline church came into my life at the perfect time when I was going through a lot of inner healing and growth in my relationship with God. There is a lot of warmth when you step into the walls of Storyline, one that I certainly wasn't used to from a previous church I went to for years. I prayed about finding a church like this and it almost seemed too good to be true to find it, but God was listening to my prayers and he delivered like He always does. The community is amazing and the church is continuously growing. Pastor Akeem loves to connect with each person who walks through the doors (which is hard to come by with other churches), and the leadership team goes above and beyond in how they connect with all the congregants. It's exciting to see where Storyline is headed this year and I'm so thankful to be here! This is the first church that’s ever felt like home for me. The pastors and the Community they’ve built of loving people have been amazing.

If you’re looking for a local church, I 10 out of 10 recommend storyline.

I’m newer to church and have often felt wishy-washy with my faith. That changed at Storyline for me. I now feel like I have a firm foundation to build my life on. Storyline truly changed my life and helped me build a relationship with Jesus.

I will be forever grateful🙏✝️

name: Street Light Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary: Great people to be welcomed. Wish they had more events. Preaching is nice and unique here coming in Westminster area. Fairly small but easy to find. Music is nice to worship. The people here are dedicated and this church loves to outreach. People are always blessed with food and the love overflows in this place. The youth leaders are always coming up with new activities for teens and highly recommend this church if you have been looking for a humble church. Praise the Lord for He is in this place!! Great church, small community that is doing big things to help the community, I praise the lord that I met pastor Santos chances are I would be suffering still if it wasn't for the caring suport that this church & kind loving members have provided . Pastor Santos and pastor bonito are both highly respected men that have inspired many to do good Things , since I've been in there restoration programs I've learned a lot , and ultimately what we've done only god can judge us. This church is a blessing to the community and they offer service in both English and Spanish Love coming here this our 2nd year we have been invited.my daughter and grandkids love it ..thank you pastor Santos love the way you preech your testimony..I feel peace hearing your speech.. godbless you always Every time I come I feel like Pastor Santos speaks to me. Everyone here is so welcoming and friendly. I always leave feeling whole.

name: Stronghold Christian Church - Lithonia Campus
reviewSummary: Many years ago over 14 years I visited the church for Bible study it was like a midday Bible study,  it was a lot of older people there. And I was there with a newborn baby. And those people gave me the worst look ever.  I don't stay for the entire Bible study. It was only one person who spoke to me and that was just to get general information. So I am there,   I was a single mom with a newborn baby and I was in the worst place ever in my life , and on top of that I was homeless and I was staying with a friend that lived by the church. Just wanted to be restored in my faith because I know I had sinned. And because the people like them I would never step foot in the church again.  The most important thing I do have is  a relationship with the Lord Jesus Christ and it have nothing to do with a building and snobbish people  "who have never sinned."  And I bet if the covers could come off of a lot of those people that was in that room that day I was there , and things could be revealed from their past they would not have been any better than I was at the time. It's called Mercy and Grace. From the moment my family walked in it was an amazing loving atmosphere. The service was phenomenal and to see Holy Spirit show up and show out was a beautiful experience. Even though the the Sr. Pastor or his wife didn't preach, their presence was definitely felt throughout the service. Thank you Lord for allowing me to have witness such a move of God when I thought it wasn't possible. The kids absolutely loved it as well and that they were in the main Sanctuary not even Children's Church. We will be returning! God bless Stronghold ministries! I was overcome by the friendliness and kindness of the leaders and congregation.  It felt like I was in a safe place to call my spiritual home.  Recently relocating from Florida, I felt compelled to join at my first service. The outreach is incredible and seeing so many men in ministry made me feel covered and comforted. Great ministry. I brought my sister the next Sunday and she was extremely blessed by the entire service.  The senior pastor is on point and preaching the word with great revelation . Even though the church has gone through a transformation in leadership it’s still standing. Dr Ben has been transparent and accountable for his actions but continues to do the lords work and teach not preach. A place of healing. This church is amazing!!  You can feel the Lord's presence in this place.. Dr Ben & Dr G are phenomenal. They truly are being lead by God.  I have had so many miraculous and amazing things to happen in my life since I became a member here. Prayers are being answered for me that I have prayed for years. Thank You Lord for leading me to SCC.  I know I have  found my earthly home.

name: Strongsville Bible Fellowship - Strongsville Campus
reviewSummary: I was genuinely shocked with how awesome this church is. Verse by verse expository teaching, very friendly congregation and solid mix of hymns and modern music. There's nothing super flashy, but that's what I like. The teaching is great, the people are friendly and for being such a small church there's is a lot of young families . Give it a shot ! You are your family will gladly be welcomed Can't make a fair assessment on just one visit. Regardless, they were welcoming they were warm they were friendly and you are aware the Spirit of the Lord is within the place Went to Strongsville Bible fellowship December 5th for the first time I think I found my church very friendly people I was greeted with a smile from many of the members enjoyed the music very inspiring so was the sermon looking forward to next Sunday Very friendly pastor and congregation. name: Strongsville Christian Church - Strongsville Campus
reviewSummary:
Strongsville Christian Church is an incredible place to worship! From the moment you walk through the doors, you're greeted with a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel right at home.

The worship is uplifting and heartfelt, the preaching is powerful, biblical, and relevant, and the children's ministry is absolutely terrific. It's a church where every member of the family can grow in their relationship with God.

If you're looking for a church home or simply visiting the area, I highly recommend Strongsville Christian Church. Be sure to meet Pastor Colini and his wife—they are genuine, caring people who love God and love others. You won't be disappointed! 5 stars 🌟 isnt enough for this church. When my Pastor mentioned Pastor Colini's name, everyone around me smiled and shook their head in approval. I knew this was a church I had to visit. Once I opened the doors to the church, the air felt light as this peace came over me. I felt so warm and welcomed when everyone hugged, shook my hand or just smiled. I love that their is such a wide variety of people from age, race and different lifestyles. They all came together for one thing. The sermons are the BEST! They are filled with the word of God. It is educational, empowering and uplifting. This church has helped me stay encouraged to follow Christ and save souls. They are truly a home away from home. I definitely recommend coming for a visit or making it your home church. This is an amazing full gospel church.   I absolutely love this church!! The Pastors are friendly and kind and full of the spirit of God!
At this church you will find the word preached uncompromised. If youre looking for a church to attend or visit while you’re in the area you should go check it out!  You’ll be encouraged and feel the love of God! Strongsville Christian Church! Wow I can't say enough things about this amazing ministry. Diversity, great leadership, great fellowship and REAL people.!!
The pastor has an awesome testimony of deliverance!
Many miracles have been experienced in this place. My wife and I were new members that had been going for the last month or so to both morning and sometimes evening service. But had a situation that I just cannot turn a blind eye to and have no intention of going back! Sometimes the true colors of a man comes out when there's no cameras rolling and no congregation to impress.

I have no problems with the main pastor. But the assistant pastor Frederick Futrell cannot possibly be a man of God! They had a Father's Day service with a barbecue after but I was totally sick with a stomach virus and was throwing up nonstop but did not want my wife to miss service so I brought her.

I stayed in the van for a couple hours if not longer just waiting for her to enjoy herself while I was throwing up and feeling miserable. When it was all over and everything was done and the church was locked up, Frederick came out and knocked on the passenger window. Why I have no idea he's just sticking his nose where it doesn't belong!

He wanted to know who we were as if we were homeless vagrants. But then he says oh I recognize you all. I explained to him the situation. That we had a long 30 minute drive and I was feeling way too sick to risk driving.

He then sarcastically says well can't your wife drive??? Oh wow that's just brilliant Pastor, why didn't either of us think of that!!! You're not the sharpest tool in the tool shed are you? He should've picked up on that when I said I had to bring my wife because I didn't want her to miss out. But then again that would only apply if you were actually listening to what I said. Not to mention I just told him I'm sick and throwing up so why bother me with a Q&A?

So after spending a few minutes by the window, he says well we're all locked up soooooooo. I said so what? Are you telling me I have to vacate after just telling you I'm too sick to drive! YES!

It's not like I was laying down on a pew sleeping inside the church! I'm sitting in my own van in the parking lot minding my own business! Bothering nobody but you evidently!!!

So basically he walked out like deputy dawg to tell me to move the van??? Are you kidding me? You're literally running off two NEW members of your own congregation??? And let's face it, it's a very small congregation to begin with so I don't really think they can afford to offend 2 new members...

NO offer to pray over me to cure my sickness, NO offer to pray over me for safe passage home, oh no, oops, you NEED a real man of God to offer such things!

It left a horrible taste in my mouth and why would I want someone to be my spiritual leader when their actions are like that! And even though I love the main pastor he obviously does not have a great choice in discernment over who his assistant is...

name: Substance Church - Downtown Campus

Fun inclusive atmosphere and family friendly.  A great place to explore or expand your faith.  Mondays is when they do Alpha among other small groups. Love this Church. name: Sugar Land Baptist Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary:
A Magical Evening at the Sugar Land Baptist Church Christmas Concert

On December 13, I attended a Christmas musical concert at the Sugar Land Baptist Church, and it was truly a magical evening that captured the essence of the season. The production beautifully retold the Nativity story through song, drama, and heartfelt performances, reminding everyone in the audience of the joy and hope that Christmas brings.

The standout elements were undoubtedly the exceptional orchestra, choir, ballet, and cast. The orchestra delivered rich, professional arrangements that filled the sanctuary with warmth and grandeur—every string, brass, and percussion note was perfectly balanced and evocative. The choir’s harmonies were stunning, blending powerful crescendos with tender, angelic moments that gave me chills during classics like "O Holy Night" and "Silent Night." The actors brought genuine emotion to their roles, portraying Mary, Joseph, the shepherds, and the wise men with a sincerity and passion that made the timeless story feel fresh and personal.

What elevated the experience even further was the superb stage audio and lighting. The sound was crystal clear, ensuring every lyric and line of dialogue reached the back rows without distortion. Meanwhile, the lighting design was masterful—using soft glows for the stable scenes, dramatic spotlights for the angelic announcements, and colorful washes that enhanced the festive mood without overwhelming the stage.

Overall, this was a polished, uplifting production that not only entertained but deeply touched the spirit. It is a perfect family tradition and a beautiful celebration of Christ’s birth. Highly recommended—5 stars!

One minor note for future improvement: At the conclusion, the pastor invited everyone to stand and sing a hymn. However, the screen indicated that the lyrics were in the program, even though only about a third of the audience had one in hand. Since the lyrics for the opening hymns were projected so effectively, it would have been wonderful to have them on the screen for the final song as well!

Here are some pictures and videos that capture the spirit of this high-quality production. Love out new church!!  Theree is a wonderful orchestra, with a largest choir I have ever seen in person.  Would prefer to give this welcoming dynamic church10 stars!! Not a parishioner, but was there to watch one of the best comedians in Tim Hawkins! He was amazing as always and so funny! The church support staff there were extremely kind and helpful! Seems like a great place to worship and meet new people! We enjoy this church so much. The pastor speaks extremely well, sermons are interesting and biblical. The orchestra and choir is phenomenal. Beautiful sanctuary and plenty of small groups to join. Very good Church, nice brothers and sisters. Good nursery and more diverse ministry. Our whole family love here. God Blessing

name: Sugar Land Bible Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: I haven't been there, but feel like I know that church well. Have been listening to Andy Woods preach and teach online since July 2023, when my wife was battling cancer. We listened every evening for an hour to his teaching about Revelation in the Bible. Have been listening ever since.......Went thru Revelation, Acts, Genesis, Exodus, and now listening to the series, The Rapture. Andy goes deep into the Bible and teaches verse by verse. He is a wonderful pastor. We still go to church where we live in Northwest Florida, but still listen to him every evening. I listen online as I live in the UK. Really good teacher ... has helped me understand the Bible and scripture better than I did before. Has a great way of explaining things. Praise God for using Pastor Andy to teach us the true word of God.🙏🏻 Sugar Land Bible Church is a wonderful group of believers with a God-fearing leadership that truly cares about equipping the body of Christ with God's Word. Pastor Andy is a faithful and non-compromising teacher that seeks to guide the believer's understanding of the totality of the Scriptures. My family and I have thoroughly grown spiritually during our time here. We have been blessed by the fellowship as well. We love SLBC! I have been an avid listener of Dr. Andy Woods on YouTube for 5 years. We live on the east coast.  My husband and I love the Word we hear and have shared our experience with friends that listen in as well. Pastor Andy is a gifted Pastor Teacher and our walk with God has changed so much bc we came out of a church that had almost no teaching to speak of.  We are understanding many biblical truths that were either taught wrong or not at all from the church we left.  Thank you isn’t enough to express what these wonderful studies have done in our lives. Great church, very welcoming, excellent Bible teaching. No fluff.

name: Sugar Land Church of Christ - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: My sister is new in town and is looking for a church home. Me, her and my 4year old nephew came to visit this Sunday.  My nephew was taken to the kids class and started crying. A woman when into the class and brought him out  and asked my sister if he has a disability… That is extremely rude to ask someone! How does my nephew have a disability just because he was crying?? We end up leaving early. Can’t believe my sister had to experience that. Thank you for my Church home it has brought me peace and has taught me so much when it comes to learning bout God and lo the saints ect…. I’ve learned to be a better man this is a great place to worship!!! Oh no.. I'm not able to post pictures 😕 First time visitor with a friend from louisiana. Service started at 10am and were very late but right on time! Lots of parking and not crowded.  I like how they use bible scripture to craft sermon, not counseling for sermon.  They offered first time visiting gift , announced new visitors and served communion.  Service ended before noon.  The congregation was so very welcoming.  I like and may visit again Great friendly loving church family🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽So inviting Great place to come to hear the Word

name: Sugar Land Family Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly people and awesome music, but not truly inclusive.

The people at Sugarland Family Church were very friendly, and the music was absolutely awesome — truly uplifting and heartfelt. I really wanted to love this church and return regularly.

However, today’s sermon focused on the idea that because God created man in His image, there are only two genders, and that only a man and woman can marry. That message felt exclusionary and left out many other teachings of sin from the Bible that are not often preached today. Homosexuality isn’t even mentioned in the Ten Commandments, yet it was treated as a major sin.

The church says that “everyone is welcome,” but that doesn’t seem to include LGBTQ+ people. Sure, it was said LGBTQ people would be “respected”, but not following the Bible. That position doesn’t reflect true inclusivity or the love I believe faith should represent, nor everything in the Bible. And for a small church, I think this might hinder building a congregation. Me, my 7 straight friends, and our families will not be attending in the future.

If it weren’t for this sermon and the church’s stance on gay marriage and trans people,  I would gladly return — because the music was truly wonderful! The true word of God here is not watered down. All teachings come strait from truth in love. The people, Pastor, worship, and message were all amazing. It was refreshing to see a church who will stand true to the word of God, and with absolutely zero hate or exclusion. They say all are welcome here and they truly mean that. It’s reflected with their words, actions, and teachings. I’m glad to know I don’t have to worry about if what I’m hearing is actual truth or not.

And as a bonus, the worship here too has been my favorite from all of the places I have been. The Holy Spirit’s presence is strong through the building, and you can tell that people are there to worship God. The spirit is alive at SLFC. From entering the building😊, wonderful may need a kleenex worship ,to the message Pastor Nate speaks which always seems to be for me.Truth is it is a family and you and I are all welcomed!A family like no other💖 Loved, loved, loved this church! Pastor Nate is amazing; his message is always encouraging. Music team comprised of talented and faithful individuals serving each week with incredible music! Church is extremely welcoming and diverse. Children's program although small, but I can tell the church puts in lots of effort to run a good children program, including the youth. Sadly we moved out of SL area and had to leave this church. May God continue to do great work and expand His kingdom through this body of Christ. This is a really good church. If your looking for a positive place to bring your family on Sundays and to be encouraged, I would recommend this church. My husband and I do not really go to church but decided to try this church out b/c it is so close to our house. We have been here only a few times but we always leave feeling better than we came in! The worship is so nice and the pastor is very kind, encouraging and positive. You can tell that he really loves and cares for the people in his church. There is a good amount of young families here. Also people aren't weird around you b/c your new...I've been to some churches where there so weird around you b/c your new and that makes me feel so awkward and scared to go back lol. The entire service is about an hour long and the preacher does not try to guilt you with a lengthy tithe message like some churches. Over all I would definitely say to give this church a try. So far it's been a very positive addition in our lives.

name: Summerlin Church, Las Vegas - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I was looking for a solid Bible teaching/preaching (expository) church in Las Vegas and when I visited Summerlin Community Church and sat through that first service, I knew I had found a special place. Pastor Dave and his wife Gayle genuinely & deeply love the Lord and care about His people. I've been to many churches in my life but SCC truly walks the talk of caring, loving and nurturing people into God's Kingdom. The friends I've made are prayer warriors who encourage,  uplift and are there for you whenever you need prayer. I consider this church my new family (as I have none) and feel so blessed that God led me here.  I know you will too! God bless! I’ve been attending Summerlin Church for about 5 months now and it’s truly been a blessing. This was my 5th or 6th church I had visited when I first moved to Vegas. I was initially drawn - and stayed - because Pastor Dave preaches from the Bible, verse by verse. This makes every week biblical, theologically rich with scriptural references  and always points us back to Christ.

The community here is warm and welcoming. The pastor himself greeted me personally on Day 1 and we went out for coffee a few weeks after that. You don’t have to be a stranger here.

There are opportunities to be involved here too. We have prayer nights on Tuesday, Bible studies before church service, and ministries for every age.

This church has helped me learn how to glorify God and put Christ at the center of my life. We are so glad we found Summerlin Church. After just a couple visits we knew this is where our family belonged. Such a warm and welcoming community with biblical sermons that have applicability to how we live today. I’m so thankful for this Church family. We were visiting from NZ and felt at home at this church. Great worship and message on Matthew 5 with the gospel at the heart of the message. Thanks We were stopping through Las Vegas as a family. Wow... Can this Church rock the hospitality! Also, amazing teachers for the children and lovely outdoor grounds. We found plenty of thought provoking perspectives in the sermon, and the live stream was so easy to use... Appreciated the coordinated worship. That was really a blessing to us too. Thank you members of the Summerlin Church! Blessings upon you.

name: Summit Christian Church - Akron Campus
reviewSummary: We were here for the WABL Parade, very friendly church community though... They open up the Church/ building to let the kids use the bathroom and offered water (because it was so hot outside). 😊 This is my home church and I go to AA meetings there I love this church people are super awesome A nice place to worship and here the word from the Bible and associate it to today's life Heart warming people. Great meetings here.

name: Summit Christian Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
A few of my friends and I attended the craft night this evening and we had a wonderful time.
The ladies there are all very warm and welcoming, it made our first visit very enjoyable.
I will be returning for Sunday service.  🙏👍 Wonderful family friendly church. We've been a part of this church for about 4 years now. Fun events and study groups for youth to adult. Highly recommend. The people are very kind and Welcoming 🩷My husband and I have been going to Summit 17 years. Love everyone there. Very warm and welcoming. PLEASE COME AND CHECK US OUT. I promise you. You will receive a very wonderful welcoming 🤗🤗 Not too overwhelming of a place. Not too small not too big. Good sermon. Great worship band. Wish the worship was longer though. Friendly enough people, but if you want to connect you will have to make a real effort. Or if that's not what you're looking for and you just come and then duck out. Spent three weeks attending this small group. The pastors first message had to do with being better as a church group. Welcoming and loving as christ would. Yet in three weeks after each message he made no effort to reach out to us. Friendly people but not much of a leader. Church Just isn't big enough for that attitude by its pastor!

name: Summit Church - Greenwood Village Campus
reviewSummary:
They had 1st time visitor parking. Plus plenty of other parking. We were greeted by many. It was easy to find our way into the worship area. There were plenty of places to stop and visit and learn about the church. We were guided to comfortable seats. They had online note taking and scripture for the service. The worship music was loud but not excessive. May not be the place for sensitive ears. Words were easy to understand and were on the screen in big letters. Afterwards, we were given free drink coupons and plenty of people willing to talk. Didn't feel overwhelming. More friendly and interested than anything else. We were engaged by young and old and helped by young and old. Some were assigned greeted. Most seemed to be just interested members. The message delivered was theologically correct, personal, and positive. The only thing I noticed was a bit of conflating of old and new testaments. But that's not unusual for a Christian pastor to see the OT through New Testament eyes. I would come back if I lived in the area. I went to Summit Church for the first time today and will definitely be back! I’ve been church shopping for awhile and I can say I was impressed with the amount of people who said hello, introduced themselves, and made me feel seen. The sermon was great and my son loved the children’s program as well. Can’t wait to go back! Would love to go to the young adult group if childcare ever comes available! Summit Church is warm and welcoming from the moment you walk in. The teaching comes straight from the Bible, and I genuinely feel at home with this church family. Love this place. We found it while visiting, but would love to make it our permanent home Lord Willing. 🩷 this church is small but everyone here is so lovely. they greet you w smiling faces + ACTUALLY ask how you're doing or say good morning or have a good day. you can tell everyone who is involved here really cares about their congregation. also, the main pastor is an AMAZING speaker, definitely his God given talent.

UPDATE: everything above is true ! but since it is such a small, tight knit church, it's easy to feel left out. also, the congregation doesn't really fit my demographic (young adult). still, amazing church!

name: Summit Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
We love the people here so much. Feels like home. Feels like family. So many wonderful programs and excellent teaching but still has the atmosphere of a very close knit community. There are so many groups for whatever season youre in. My kids love it and we are all growing closer and closer to the Lord. I highly recommend for anyone who is looking for a place to belong. Rick Godwin is an AWESOME teacher of God's word. Real, Raw, and Relevant! Great Praise and Worship! Everyone is welcome! Great church!!! My favorite place to end each week. Pastor Rick is awesome, and his wife Cindy AMAZING.
I attend church as well as the yearly "Chosen" Women's conference and that is phenomenal. If you don't go to church, you may want to join us for the Chosen bc the Testimonies are life-changing.
If you are looking for a church- Summit is it, they are so excited to see you every week. They are all so inviting and loving. I've been to my share of church's but there isn't one like Summit. You aren't just a body, you are SOMEBODY here.
The little girls up front in one of my pictures just melted my heart, seeing her worship was breathtaking ❤️ Bible focused place of worship and fellowship. Can't say enough about the Godwins and their heart for service. Pastor Rick is a great example of a pastor that will tell you like it is. Sometimes his subjects are tough to hear...but necessary because you need to hear it.

Added some pics of the Chris Tomlin concert  Also, we are proud to say we have the PULP Coffee Café represented here I have never attended a service but just wanted to express how amazin two gentlemen from this church came thru for me on my worst days! Stranded, out of gas and phone decided to not work! After an hour, a KAREN pulled up to pick up her kid and YELL AT ME, to get out of there the kids are comin out of school and clearly I don’t belong there. Tried to explain, but she said she don’t care but get off the property “WE DON’T WANT ANYONE LIKE YOU ON THIS PROPERTY WHEN KIDS ARE COMIN OUT OF SCHOOL”. That hurt me to my core… but I prayed to stay calm and to make sense of it. Why people on this side of town are so mean… AT A CHURCH, I still get treated like trash by an entitled female that hides in a beautiful church. Review your members! And God Bless your employees! They gave me a small glimpse of hope and I knew God heard my prayers because he sent me two on earth blessings 5 mins later!

name: Summit Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely cherish and love coming to Summit Church. This body of believers is remarkable! And, the head pastors have such a heart for every person who attends this church. The preaching is awesome! The worship is off-the-charts! The prayer time is the most anointed prayer time we have ever experienced! The Holy Spirit moves mightily and people are healed and set free weekly! The presence of God is tangible and we are so thankful for our pastors and this exceptional church. God is alive and real at Summit SanMarcos. There is creativity, power, love and sound teaching. The Spirit is welcome to show up and show off! (: They have a christian school of the arts, dance programs, acting and so much more. They build up and send out strong leaders. They are mission minded as well. I love this church and am so glad God brought us here.
God is good, he is real and he is here. Blessings I absolutely love this church. From the 1st day I walked in for the college group (now young adults), I felt welcomed, seen and heard. I found Jesus going to this church. I love the pastors, they are welcoming, friendly and love the Lord. I highly recommend this chruch to anyone looking to get closer with the Lord and meet other Christians on fire for the Lord. Great community, connect groups, services and worship. This church is very biblically sound and has a great worship team. Summit Church is one of the best small but mighty local non-denominational churches in North County San Diego with a loving and welcoming community of people including Pastors Daniel and Theresa Jones. The gifts of the Spirit are active in this ministry and I have seen healing miracles. I love ❤️ Summit Church! Summit is the most welcoming church ever! We walked through the doors of summit 4 years ago, came back the following Sunday and Pastor Therese greeted us by name! The fact that she remembered us kept our attention on the church, the overwhelming feeling of love and hospitality kept us focused on Jesus during some of the most difficult times of our lives! The family of summit is a reflection of Jesus Christ! The worship is awesome, the preached word is awesome, and their kids ministry is amazing! If you want to grow in. Heist check out summit!

name: Summit Church NYC - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Throughout my walk with Christ I have searched for a place to call home where I can feel free to worship, share and connect with others on their spiritual journey and have finally found it. Summit Church has ALWAYS welcomed my family and I even when we aren't consistent, with open arms. I once mentioned to the pastor that we were his Easter family and he reassuringly reminded me that we were ALWAYS family and the doors were always open no matter how many times we walked through it. I am beyond thankful that we have such an amazing, strong, loving, supportive  church behind us❤️ Victory Outreach North Brooklyn is one of the friendliest churches I have ever attended.  The members are people from all walks of life who have managed to foster a strong sense of a true Christ-centered community and who display genuine love and concern for one another.  Pastor Ed is an intelligent, relevent, bible-teaching, HILARIOUS preacher.  The leadership team is approachable, humble and committed to helping people discover the difference Jesus can make in their lives.  The church definitely leaves an impression on you even after just one visit.  I love VONB! I love Victory Outreach North Brooklyn! Pastor Ed and Ana have been mentors to my wife and I since we were teenagers. They are smart, understanding, patient (especially with us), caring, and motivators. The leadership staff there is filled with seasoned men and woman of God who have many years of walking with the Lord, putting their hands to the plow and not looking back. I live in Florida now but I still get to listen to his awesome preachings on iTunes or Soundcloud. If you are looking for a church where you can come just as you are, meet great people, and hear a powerful message then Victory Outreach North Brooklyn is the place. Awesome church! The pastor, Ed and his wife Ana are great. What I like most about this place is that it's family oriented. I never feel judged because Pastor Ed is so in- tune with culture and what's going on in this day and age! The man is intelligent, hold a conversation with this guy and your mind will be blown away! His two boys Ethan and Eddie are not stuck up bratty church kids but super humble and respectful. I recommend going to a bible study when possible, because his wife Ana throws down in the kitchen and you will never leave that house hungry! Overall such a great church and great people! When you walk into the church you are greeted by loving, friendly people that want you to discover for yourself the difference Jesus can make in your life.  The pastor is very down to earth, and always preaches a word that you know is from God.  He is dedicated to helping others discover their purpose and fulfill their destiny in Christ.  The church is loving and becomes your family quickly.  You will never be frowned upon or turned away, but received with arms wide open as Christ has accepted us.

name: Summit Church of Loganville - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I just joined Summit Church and we are thrilled to see the new vision this church has for the great community of Walton County! We love the NEW Sunday Night service at 5pm! Very modern and excellent music! Great family oriented church! The pastor is very friendly and wants the bests for people's walk with Christ! Great church, we go here when were visiting my grandma or cousin, they do a great job preaching and its a bery pretty church I’ve been a member of Summit Church for 10 years now. We have had our share of ups and downs but we are growing stronger each and every day!  We have an amazing pastor now and we meet Sunday at 10:30 AM for our service and Wednesday at 6:30 for a Bible study group. Our kids have Team Kids in the 200 building and they have awesome teachers. There’s something for all ages. Come visit us next Sunday! Summit Church has been blessed with a new Pastor, Jesse Williver,  and is doing exciting ministry work in Loganville. New members are coming each week as Summit reaches the community for Christ.  I found the people there very welcoming and friendly. I have been a member of Summit for many years.  Love how ministry focused they are.  We especially love our new pastor!  Come check us out!

name: Summit Church Orlando
reviewSummary: Creative modern church known for honest, authentic teaching, excellent modern worship, and thriving young adult small groups.

name: Summit Church: Orlando - Orlando Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful community, Christ-centered teaching, solid community groups, fantastic kids’ care & student programs. Very welcoming to families with babies (photo of the mothers’ room attached). Would totally recommend! A place where love can be felt, met in the eyes of community. A place of imperfect people that are looking at Jesus for hope and mercy. Been apart of this church for over 25 years, amazing love and ministry opportunities! Very welcoming church family without pressuring the attendees to tithe/donate. Tried it out this Sunday and I don't think I'll be back. The worship music was phenomenal and the sanctuary was all glitzy for sure... but not one single person went out of their way to welcome my family and me. Usually, I would not find that a big deal (I'm not thinking I'm so important that people should talk to me or anything) but I did find it a little off putting in this instance for two reasons. a) I went up to the connection table where two ladies were just talking to themselves. When I looked at a pamphlet for a beat too long one just said "Do you have any questions?" making me feel like I was inconveniencing them and 2) the whole sermon was put on by their connection director that day and it was about connecting with the community... which, in my opinion, it felt like they were failing at that.
It just seemed very unfriendly to new people. This church and the experience I had going there gave me sense of joy I haven't had in years.  I'll definitely be coming back next Sunday.  I have finally found a church that felt like I have found what I was looking for. Wonderful music, inspiring sermon, and super nice people.  I wish I had known about this church early.  Thank you Summit church, you're the best!

name: Summit City Church - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church! We've been attending here regularly for 5 years now. We love the worship, the preaching, the children's program for our kids, as well as the young adults ministry they have! If you need a church, look no further! Very kind, friendly, welcoming people.  I enjoyed their Christmas Orchestra.  The music was beautiful and the dinner afterwards was unbelievable.  The auditorium was decorated like an elaborate Christmas Wedding Reception. I've never seen so many food and desert choices. Wonderful church with the friendliest people! Pastor was spot on with his message and worship pastor, Sarah, is truly passionate about the music and worship experience. Love this church! This is a church where you are welcomed like family. Lovely sanctuary, solid Bible teaching, and great people. Highly recommended! Had vaccine shot here. Was setup very safely and was very quick and painless.

name: Summit Crossing Community Church - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary: The teaching is excellent. The music is somewhat loud, so if you’re not used to that, it can be jarring. Summit is a place for worship and community. But has some things that I believe are contrary to the Bible. And it’s a very large church and that makes it hard to connect with people but the youth program is amazing. Even though I don’t attend the Sunday service I do love the Wednesday night youth group. My husband and I have been going here since 2009 and have never felt anything other than a part of a family. Much prayer and thought has gone into every aspect of this church, from the teaching, to the music, the children's program, youth group, the mission, the building, and even parking. I was so impressed that during the service, the parking attendant volunteers walk the parking lot to make sure no children are accidentally left in vehicles. It is not a building that makes a church, it is the people, and Summit Crossing has wonderful people working together as the body of Christ to glory God. Welcoming, plenty of parking, great quality music that aligned with the message, nice atmosphere, good preaching, sermon points with Bible verses and music on several screens, gluten free communion available! Even coffee was inviting as you come into the foyer. Announcements were to the point and easy to follow and for more info you go to the foyer tables that are well labeled. Workers are in matching t-shirts so easy to find. My DD just moved there and they've been inviting to her!! Much appreciated. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because I walked in and out without anyone introducing themselves. No one got my name or checked in with me to see how I was doing. Some people may like that but I am looking for community off the bat. The word of God is taught and the congregation is genuinely nice!!They are well organized and not flashy! I truly appreciate my family finding this church. My teen is establishing friends who I pray will stay with him through the years and grow with him TOWARDS Christ

name: Sun River Church - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary: we go there almost every  Sunday and every event there kids ministry is great and there spring plays are lovely ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great and welcoming atmosphere! 10:30am service is great and they don’t compromise. The church is gospel centered. Many of the other programs and groups outside of the main service are great as well and offer a good opportunity to get plugged in. We have been coming to Sun River Church for over 10 years. The people have become like family, and our faith has grown. Our children love going, and they are each valued and cared for. Join us! Never felt as unwelcomed as the first couple of times I've tried to attend this church. They (well one particular person was) were also extremely rude when I asked if I could do a wake for my daughter, whom passed away from cancer,  there. For multiple other reasons, they are one of the reasons of why I don't attend any churches at all anymore. Wish I could give negative stars. I called for help to see if i can get help with my Smud bill and the lady that answered was beyond very rude and kinda mocked the less fortunate god bless people these days I do not recommend seeking this church for no help god sees all that we do in being nasty is not of his work

name: Sun Valley Community Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Sun Valley Community Church has been an absolute blessing in my life. From the moment I stepped through their doors, I felt welcomed and welcomed  by the pastorJan  and his wife, who greet everyone with genuine smiles and warmth. The community of attendees is incredibly friendly and inviting, making every visit feel like coming home.

I've had the pleasure of attending their Bible studies, which have enriched my spiritual journey tremendously. The two services offered provide ample opportunity to worship and delve deeper into the teachings. Pastor Jan's sermons are not only insightful but also very well-spoken, leaving a lasting impact on all who listen.

I highly recommend Sun Valley Community Church to anyone seeking a supportive community, engaging worship, and profound spiritual growth. It's truly a five-star experience that leaves you feeling uplifted and inspired. I started coming here a year and a half ago to support a family member one day. I was a new age/ gnostic type raised JW but when I heard the preacher on this fateful day I was made a believer. No church ever made me want to open a bible but this one did. I have since become a member of the church as it stokes my fire for our Lord Jesus Christ.

I highly recommend this church for new believers seeking answers and experienced Christians who enjoy sound doctrine. All are welcome!

Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Matthew 11:28 Was in LA for the weekend. Sound biblical teaching with a compassionate congregation. Highly recommend if you passing through or live in the area and are in need of a church that feeds the flock instead of entertaining them, you’ll be hard pressed to  find better I pray that I make it to this church and get closer to God's salvation. I open myself to receive the Holy Spirit. Praise Jesus Christ, I accept you and believe in you. Amen Pastor, l am from Cadiz, ky. I went through all your teachings on Spirit, Soul and Body. Excellent! I believe God put a desire in me to learn more on this subject. After searching through many youtube videos on this subject, your explanation was so insightful.  Thank you.
God Bless you and your Church

name: Sun Valley Community Church - Chandler - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the place to feel welcomed and loved for who you are. I love everything about this church. The people, The vibe, The church itself, and the way the pastors teach everyone about god. Let me explain why I love these things about the church... The leaders and pastors are SO kind and welcoming to everyone at the church. The vibe of the church is welcoming, friendly, non-judgemental, and meets you where you are at in your walk with god! And the pastors teach everyone why walking with god is great, and they have groups for all ages! I would recommend coming here if you are new to going to church! A huge thank you to Pastor Raymond, Chad, Sammy, Joey, Ryan, Ariel, Pat, Zeke, Jacob, Brandon, And everyone else!!! God bless your day! 🙏❤️ Sun Valley Church is a place where you can belong before you believe. What I appreciate most is that you don’t have to have everything figured out to feel welcome. Pastor Chad does an incredible job connecting biblical principles to real life, everyday struggles, relationships, challenges, and personal growth. His messages are practical, relatable, and encouraging, no matter where you are in your faith journey. If you’re looking for a church that feels genuine, welcoming, and relevant to daily life, I highly recommend Sun Valley Church. We LOVE Sun Valley Community Church!
Solid, practical Bible teaching with great teaching pastors!! Warm welcome! Refreshments, need a Bible? Great band!!!! WARM & WELCOMING PLACE. You will receive a message that can actually be applied to your week and daily life. Jeans are ok :) Amazing church, powerful sermons, with wonderful people. Thank you Sun Valley

name: Sun Valley Community Church - Gilbert - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a warm and engaging church. The sermons are focused on the Bible, with amazing messages,  focused on improving understanding in the Christian walk and encouraging growth. The pastors excel at understanding the realities of life and they don’t shy away from tough issues. Their sermons are relatable every single week to regular people. Humor is a strength and belly laughs happen (not the focus, but helps with retention). Every week the messages speak to your heart about loving God and  loving people. I continue to mature in my faith and grow and this leadership helps immensely. Jesus, when handed a scroll, read aloud then, expounded on it, explaining the meaning. That’s similar to how Sun Valley Community Church teaches and preaches. They don’t just reference a scripture and talk. They open the scriptures, read them aloud, often time many scriptures, then expound on them, explain how it relates to your life today.
They show how certain scriptures, compound with others to clarify, the message. They’re brave enough to have their biblical worldview beliefs on their website, and they stand firmly on the Father, the Son, the Holy Spirit, and the Bible as the foundation. Also they don’t just teach, they serve and challenge the people to serve, the memorize, and challenge the people to memorize the Scripture. Ultimately they teach how Jesus Christ is the Messiah, the Word of God, and how he’s the way, the truth, and the Life.
I’m so impressed. My wife and I have been attending Sun Valley Church for several years now. The pastor Chad Moore is extremely humble and gives a great sermon. There are many volunteers when you come on Sundays happy to give you a hello with a smile or help you to a lemonade or coffee. The kids absolutely love it! They are preteen age and this is the first church we’ve attended where they are excited to go. They’ve attended the summer camps as well, and are excited to go back this summer. Our home church isn’t Sun Valley but I wanted to share how personable & caring the pastor and staff were for me recently. My 13-year old daughter wanted to go to THEIR camp because that’s where her best friend was going right after I unexpectedly get laid off from my awesome job along with half the company. They went above & beyond for non-members to help to ensure my daughter got to experience the Holy Spirit with her best friend at camp this summer! I had the pastor and two others reach out to make sure we got things squared away. Kaitlyn was especially on top of things the whole time. We are going to have to visit once in a while. Thank you all for your selfless work! This is not a Bible-preaching church. This is a church that uses scripture references to make a popular culture psychology speech to have everyone feel good about their life.

It's extremely sad to see so many people without discernment listening to the incredibly bad "preaching".

Mat 7
"15Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves. 16Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles? 17Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit. 18A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. 19Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. 20Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

21Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven. 22Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? 23And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity."

I was a new age/ gnostic type raised JW but when I heard the preacher on this fateful day I was made a believer. No church ever made me want to open a bible but this one did. name: Sun Valley Community Church - Queen Creek - Queen Creek Campus
reviewSummary:
Worship was loud. So loud nobody sits in the front few rows lol. A little too dark in there during the sermon, makes it difficult to write notes. Message was good though, he made sure to reference Scripture for all his points. And I appreciate him making it clear that it is all about Jesus! So happy they have a campus in Queen Creek now! The building is amazing inside and out. The audio and video was a perfect compliment to the wonderful teaching! A wonderful church to check out. If you're curious about the Christian faith, you owe it to yourself to come for a service. I was always against "organized religion" for the certain views and RULES that they make you follow or shun you for not following. Sun Valley teaches the truth about Christianity, which is so blindly portrayed by other religions as something else entirely. It doesn't matter your views on politics or worldly things, at the end of the day we are all the same. No matter how BAD you've been or how much you've "sinned", you are welcome here.

I've got tattoos and piercings, as does my wife. By most organized religions standards, we are non-conforming. However, I've never felt more at home in a church than I do in Sun Valley. Not saying that everyone is tattooed up and down with piercings everywhere, but that there are people just like us that attend these services.

Sun Valley has opened my eyes to show me that WE are the same group that Jesus would've gone after. He didn't go after those that were perfect or following the right path by the eyes of the church. He went after the sinners, the tax collectors, the ones the church had shunned. People just like you and I. You should NEVER feel out of place when you step into a church, you should always feel welcome.

Kids services are EXCELLENT and both of our daughters really enjoy and look forward to them. Small groups and recovery groups are offered. If you need healing in any way, Sun Valley has something to offer.

Now, keep in mind... You may be surprised that there isn't a live pastor standing in front of you and shouting at you on Sunday. This is a multi-campus church that broadcasts the same message to all church campuses on Sunday. The live service is at the main Gilbert Campus on Saturday evenings at I believe 4:00pm. That said, it isn't about a live pastor yelling at you, it's about the worship. The band is incredible and for the first time in my life, I've felt the Holy Spirit enter the room as everyone starts singing along to up-beat music. It's not your typical hymnal music, it's modern, upbeat and encouraging music.

I had always heard people in religion talk about the Holy Spirit, but never really knew what they were talking about... like some kind of foolish make believe. Sun Valley finally showed me and for the first time in my life, I really felt the presence of the Holy Spirit. What an incredible way to heal. If you are looking for a place where you could be accepted for whatever or whoever you are and treats you like a family member, then come and join this church. They are cordial, friendly and gospel driven church! Wasn’t really moved by the service, the welcome team and members aren’t very friendly, no one says hello, or smile, they just stare. I’m brand new to the state and trying to find a home church but Sun valley isn’t for me, I also signed my son up for the summer camp and each day they ladies just stared as I walked in, no greeting. I playfully asked “no hello?” “No smile” and I got a dirty look as if I shouldn’t be asking. My son’s camp leaders were nice though!

name: Sun Valley Community Church - South Gilbert - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary: One of my favorite local churches. We've gone here since 2019 and both my daughter and I got baptized here. The worship, message, staff are all amazing! The message hits home every week! Sun Valley is great. Solid messages all the time.  Just doing their best to help people meet, know, and follow Jesus. A truly amazing church-doing all the right things. Somehow managing the big church, small community feeling! The Sunday services you attend have a recorded service. Personally I prefer a pastor standing in front of me and preaching for a more personal experience. The worship is live and awesome. Hospitality volunteers are really welcoming and friendly. It’s just the first recorded service I’ve ever attended and I didn’t feel that connection because I prefer a live service. Sun Valley is a great church, I love what they believe which is the Bible. Pastor Chad is a phenomenal speaker/preacher. I have been attending there for the last four years and every single time I listen to Pastor Chad & Robert messages, it reminds me why I serve God and appreciate all that has God has done for me.
