name: Suncoast Community Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are seeking well produced with a very up beat professional band making you feel that you just attended a world class Christian concert this is for you.
If you want a church that welcomes all just like Jesus did this is for you.
If you are looking for a Bible based church with clear teaching from Jesus this is for you.
No membership required, no demands of you required and no shame put on you.
No this community church is not going to put a label on you.
No everyone is perfect, only Jesus.
Come in and feel welcomed.

Blessings Before you go, Please be aware this is NOT a church based on Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior and the Way, the Truth, and the Life. They changed their doctrine, and I have found they are not sharing this change publicly, so people don't know.  I just want people to be informed before they open their hearts and families to it who are looking for a Christian Church! I love this Church. Pastor and people are down-to-earth.  The message is love-filled. The music is  Awesome! I have moved to the other side of town and stopped going. I need to go back. This place is hands down the best church I've ever gone to. It's been 15 years since I committed to a church, and I won't be leaving any time soon! I love it so much I offered to volunteer, and I never volunteer for anything! A church that truly lives out grace.

This past Sunday was my first time attending Suncoast Community Church, and I was genuinely moved by the experience. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed—not judged, not sized up—just welcomed.

The message was rooted in the story of the prodigal son, and the takeaway was powerful: You are not too broken. You are not too different. And it’s never too late.

Pastor Larry emphasized that the church is a hospital, not a courtroom—a place for healing, not condemnation. And that’s exactly what it felt like. The message was honest, heartfelt, and deeply grounded in grace.

Oh—and the band? Phenomenal. Seriously talented musicians who don’t just perform—they lead with soul. The music set the tone beautifully and made the whole experience even more powerful.

I’ve been looking for a place where I could reconnect spiritually without pressure or pretense, and I found that at Suncoast. Whether you’re curious, hurting, questioning, or simply searching for a church that leads with love, this is a beautiful place to begin again.

Highly recommend visiting—just as you are.

name: Sunday Assembly Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: The Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy was a unique and enjoyable evening.  The performers were talented and engaging.  And the cocktails were fun... Cheers 🥂 Really enjoyed my time, and the drinks were really good and the show I’m a lit teacher and this was an awesome experience. The readers improvised cleverly time’s sake and the drinks were on point! I would love to experience more speak easies with various authors!! What a fantastic experience! They should have charged even more than $55! Four amazing performances and four stiff drinks—sign me up again! Great show!  We really enjoyed it.  The Actors were amazing and the drinks were good.

name: Sunday Services for Christ Community Church - Little Rock - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary: I think that the Lord is using C3 in amazing ways! The Sunday morning community stretches well past the bounds of 2hours that you are at the service. While the sermons have impacted my life by convicting me and encouraging me to grow, the community has impacted me more. Whether it is the Bible studies or hanging out with the people I meet there in other activities, the Lord has used the people here to grow me spiritually and make me reconsider what I thought I knew about the church family in very positive, and encouraging, ways. I am happy to call C3 my church home and the members my church family and would encourage anyone else considering to visit to come in and see what it’s about, as I did several years ago. C3 is home for us, and we've felt like family since the very first time we walked through the doors.  The sermons are real and applicable to daily life to equip us to live according to the Word.  The leadership thoughtfully approaches all decisions and communicates well to all of the partners.  It really is a partnership, and the people are what make C3 so special. Our family loves being part of Christ Community Church in Little Rock.  The preaching, worship, and classes line up with the Bible and have been so refreshing to our family.  The people are what truly makes this church a community.  It is full of men and women who love Jesus and seek to make Him known and glorified throughout the world and within the Little Rock community. We have called Christ Community our church home since the doors opened!  We love the teaching and emphasis on community and missions!  The partners (members) are of all ages and walks of life and everyone is welcoming. If you're looking for a relational, inviting, biblically focused church body to be a part of, this is the place for you! C3 is all about being relational, becoming more like Jesus together, and helping us all realize how we can be on mission in our daily lives for Christ.

name: Sunny Hills Church of Christ - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary: Its a welcome place with people that love helping others. Myself  my wife and our four kids have thrived here making life time friends and learning how to be part of a  community that cares about its community.We also greatly benifit from the teaching which grabbed  my attention from the very begging and look forward to every week. The people are very nice and welcoming without putting any pressure.  They make me want to return.  Recommend.

name: Sunridge Community Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Sunridge is an incredible church with a welcoming, genuine community. From the moment you walk in, you can feel that this is a place where people truly care about one another.

The teaching is biblically grounded, clear, and applicable to everyday life, and the worship is engaging and heartfelt. The church does an excellent job creating an environment that’s friendly for families while still being relevant and impactful for individuals at every stage of life.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like home, encourages growth, and values authentic relationships, Sunridge is absolutely worth visiting. Good honest church that follows God's word, which is rare to find these days. We moved back home & will miss these guys. Highly recommend this church. I started attending here in December 2024, and from day one, I felt warmly welcomed. I was blessed to connect with people right away, and my kids did too! I have six children, ranging from 13 years old to 18 months, and we’ve all felt at home here.

We absolutely LOVE the youth nights on Tuesdays at 6 PM—such a great time for our family! And, of course, music at 5:30 is a highlight.

I’ve truly been enjoying the pastors and other teachers. They’ve been doing a wonderful job sharing God’s Word in a clear, biblical way. I'm so grateful to be part of this community! We are so grateful to have found this church! From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt welcomed and embraced. The community here is incredibly humble and genuine, with a strong focus on building meaningful relationships and supporting one another. The atmosphere is warm, and we truly feel like we're a part of something special.

Our kids love the children's ministry. They’re always excited to go and come home with big smiles, eager to share what they learned. The crafts they make are creative and thoughtful. It's so comforting to know that our children are not only having fun but are also growing in their faith in such a nurturing environment.

We feel blessed to be a part of this church and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a supportive and welcoming church community. I’ve been going to Sunridge for about 15 months now. I felt welcomed right away. I trust in Brittt and Jed.  They are real in their beliefs and Britt’s sermons are understandable. I like to see his sense of humor. He makes the Bible understandable. I am impressed that many of the staff including Bob Sante knows my name.
The only negative is that the band is way to loud.

name: Sunrise Bible Church - Henderson Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I are beyond blessed to be part of this congregation, they welcome me and my family with open arms, we have found a real family here, they care about people and they are willing to help, they teach the bible very clear and will not compromise God's Word.  They have bible church for children from all ages, they also have a youth group that meets on Thursday at 6:30pm, Wednesday bible study for everybody, Sundays services at 9:00am and 10:45am.
May the Lord continue to bless this congregation, we are so very happy here!❤ This church is truly a blessing all around. The Lord provides anointed Pastors especially the main Pastor, Pastor Billy Crone to truly speak the truth through the Bible of the world and the knowledge that we must know that most churches don’t speak about. Come see it for yourself because it’s not an exaggeration. Pastor is down to earth and internationally known. He preaches the Bible and only the Bible, not his opinion or interpretation, just Bible truth. Thoroughly enjoyed our visit there and the people are friendly and my wife, who listens to him through youtube was thrilled to be able to meet him in person. I "discovered" Pastor Billy Crone on Jan Markel's radio 📻 program Understanding the Times. I download his  teachings from his website. Very informative to say the least. I never been to his congregation so I cannot comment. Most Independent Baptist "churches" are only interested in constructing new "church" buildings and increasing the membership. More members = more donations/offerings. Many of these Independent Baptist "church" members are not even born again. I been to one such "church" when I was living in WisConSIN. It was filled with unregenerate lost people. Such as the Wrucks. So hopefully Sun 🌞 rise Bible Church would be an improvement over the "religion as usual" Independent Baptist churches. Excellent church and GREAT preaching. We were just traveling through but I wish this was my home church! It's rare to find truth.

name: Sunrise Christian Fellowship - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a wonderful church, gives good information about Jesus and how he's our Lord and Savior. The leadership says one thing at the pulpit and live completely opposite. Most of the congregation is so loving in spite of the leadership. If you don’t care about growing in the Lord you my attend for a minute. Rude people. Talked me into having an abortion and sacrificing it to god??? Not very Christian and they don’t like children, obviously. Just saw one of your members stick his hand out his window and flip someone the bird. It's funny and not funny because if that person saw that gesture, and the sticker to your church on the back of his car, that possibly unsaved person will turn further away from Jesus Christ because of a terrible example of Christian mercy.
If it's that easy to lose your testimony, don't display his name so openly. 🤷 Sunrise Christian Fellowship has, and still is, the most incredible family church we have ever been to. If your hospitalized they are there with you and bring food to your home for however long you need it. The love is something we never encountered before and we are 74 & 78 years old. It is absolutely awesome. We love them with all our hearts.

name: Sunrise Church of Rancho Cordova - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary: Great church that does so much for the community!  Pastor Tim Maynard always has a great messages and story's that are relevant to my everyday life. Pastor tim is a great speaker, and preaching the word of God.

name: Sunrise Community Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: They did everything for me and got me off the streets and got me my birth certificate and SS card and into my own apartment I was homeless on the streets for 8 years. I am blessed and they did above and beyond for me. You just have to stay in touch with ur case manager there and regularly follow up with them. Cause they deal with huge number of homeless and helping others in whatever needs they might have. Just make sure to show up around 8am before they open to get ahead in the huge line that will form quickly putting you further back in the time you'll be there before they can see you. The earlier your there the better your odds are to being seen and helped and placed in the wait list for housing. As it not always a fast process depending on the availability of how many others they have limited funding for. But they are willing to help everyone that wants the help and follows threw and stays in contact regularly with there case manager that's appointed to them. Just be patient and don't give up hope as many do that's on the streets. The streets are not a nice place and it never is easy. But this place is a place that homeless can turn to and get the right ball on the road toward getting off the streets. And also help with low income individuals needing help with keeping there housing if at risk of losing it. God bless sunrise church⛪ and the ppl that make this place possible, y'all are real heros, and life savers💘 Amazing people and services for the homeless and not the homeless. They provide food Monday through Friday from 8am to 1 pm. Have helped me with a lot of things when I had to get back on my feet January 15th 2025, having to restart all over on everything I had 4 months before. Everyone needs help sometime. Sunrise Church does so much to help those in need. If you need clothes you can go there, they'll help you with Map insurance as well as a oordinated assessment that can lead to getting you houses when you're homeless. They have computers you can use,they have outside portable showers as well. They feed hot meals every weekday. They have a charging station for electronics, and they have hygiene items if you're in need. I believe they start at 9:00 am and close at 1:00 pm. This church is amazing they blessed me on April 3rd 2026. I was so happy and thankful 😌! I have been homeless for three years and finally going to be back on my feet again 🙌🏾! I love it here. Met my good friend AJ here. Everyday hot food and help with housing

name: Sunrise Community Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus

I even laughed at one of the preacher’s jokes. :-) Grateful for a group of brothers and sisters in Christ trying to love God and neighbors here in Jacksonville. Great place of worship, people are friendly and outgoing. Great children's program. Highly recommended. Great service and very welcoming to visitors. They use the Bible, read from the Bible, and their sermons help relate what you read to our life today. This church fills A large part of my heart. It is a wonderful place to worship Jesus Christ our Savior; and find like spirited Christians Such as my wife and I are!

Asian Americans (predominately Chinese), and recent immigrants.

Cantonese and English church established back in the late 70s This place is welcoming and has great gospel centered teaching! Gospel-centered, missions-minded, Christ-exalting church!

name: Sunset Ridge Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary: Our group meeting took place at Sunset Ridge Church of Christ, where the parishioners greeted us warmly and made sure we felt at home. During our visit, we had the chance to explore the park they built on the site of their former parking lot—a wonderful transformation. Since it was Saturday, the picturesque setting was bustling with a lively farmers market, adding to the charm of the experience. I love this church! Everyone is so welcoming and kind! The sermons are always insightful. Should you ever have the chance to visit the original chapel, you will not be disappointed. This gorgeously. crafted building from the 1920's, with it's stone arches, oak beams, and stunning stained glass windows is a rare jewel in the United States. It truly looks like a fairytale chapel straight from the middle ages.  It's also one of the few places in the US where you can see an actual Tiffany, stained glass window. Absolutely worth the visit. And please be NICE to the lovely ladies from the church. They are very sweet and gracious. Since the Chapel is not freely open to the public, they take time out of their day to open the chapel to visitors. So very disappointing not the church of Christ as mentioned in the new testament that Jesus established. A decent size congregation that should have men that can lead singing. The bible clearly states that women are to be silent in the worship service I Cor. 14:34. Where are prayer teams mentioned in the bible?  Do not be conformed to the world. We are different. Pray for the leaders of this congregation. Do  not let your soul be lead astray. Congregation is small enough for visitors be be noticed and welcomed. Leadership is humble and willing to admit faults to congregation when they screw up. Singing is a capella, which may catch you off guard if you didn't grow up with it. If you did grow up with it you might be caught off guard by the intentional inclusion of women in the worship service. All are on equal footing regardless of gender or tenure. Real people who believe in a real God and remind one another they are each loved. The old chapel nearest the street is rarely used. Primary entrances are to the newer building from the parking lot on the north end of the property.

reviewSummary: We do demo all this place!!🤷 Surf City has a new pastor, BJ Beu. Please join us on Sundays at 10:00 a.m. in person or online via Zoom for Christian worship and fellowship with each other. Refreshments in Gisler Hall. Love this church! They actually go by the name "Surf City Church" now. It's still Methodist though. Pastor Anthony is the best pastor too! Great music & wonderful sermons! Occasionally make deliveries here, their always pleasant, friend and it's very clean! Fantastic, gutsy church with unbelievably deep roots in Huntington Beach.

name: Surprise Christian Church - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church when I could get there.this past winter.I found the pastor to be one who cares deeply about the truth in Gods word. And could preach a sermon that was easy to understand and filled with biblical truths. I snowbird from Montana and am looking forward to my next stay in AZ. I will pray for this church that it does not change. And the truth preached there will continue to grow God’s church… Ron Decker I enjoyed service very much this past Sunday with my spouse. We decided to try a new church and we ended up here versus The Gathering. We were originally going to go there however they were closed and we ended up at Surprise Christian Church. I believe God wanted us to come here instead because the message felt like it was directly for us. I believe everything happens for a reason and we were meant to experience this wonderful church. I love how small and intimate it is. Unfortunately it is a bit of a travel for us but we will be coming back! Giving this church 5 stars just isn’t enough. Pastor Drew, Pastor Brad, Pastor Bryan are all of the greatest Bible teachers that I have heard in over 30 years! This is not your typical day church. This is a church of knowledgable leaders preaching straight from the word. Since my first visit EVERY message has given me, my husband, our grown children, substance. Not just something we can carry through the week but growth with Christ we crave to hear/learn more of.
I will admit the worship is a bit fad being so loud with up to date songs. That is my only downfall. I come from an upbringing of deep, calm worship with the lights down, no drums, calm lyrics in worship.
Regardless the loud music, the messages are worth everything. Just come and take a listen, it will be worth your time. Exceptional pastoral staff, & the worship service was a great blessing as Christ our Savior was exalted. The most amazing church we’ve ever been to. Pastor Drew preaches right from the book. He speaks so eloquently and is so genuine with his words. Pastor Brian and his wife are the most amazing people. The whole staff. We love the worship music. The messages are always spot on.

name: Surprise Church of Christ - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary: We ALWAYS feel like this is our "home away from home" every time we come from Cincinnati to visit our son, John and our daughter-in-law, Beth Oehler. Thank-you soooo much for ALL your cards and words of encouragement and prayers as we went through our recent surgeries. God bless you all. This church has become family to my family and me. The leadership is so caring, giving, and compassionate, and so many of the members are so friendly and kind. I'm very thankful God has led us to this church. Certainly coming back! Great welcome brothers And sisters in christ 😊... ❤ Their tagline is  'Where strangers become friends and friends become family'.They truly emulate this. Great congregation with true Bible based teaching. What a Christian church should be.  A family deep into the Word.

name: Suwanee Family Life Church - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome. Very friendly. Loving caring people. Awesome music and you can feel Gods presense when you walk thru the doors. A wonderful worship experience for adults and children.  Congregation and staff are very welcoming.  Great music and service. I love this church. Wonderful Godly people. You ca feel the presence of the Holy Spirit in this church. Where Love Abounds! I went there for a wedding, it was nice! A Lovely Family of Folk really on fire for God!

name: Sweet Home Ministries - South Bend Campus
reviewSummary: Sweet   Home   Ministries ,  is my church  family   and I love   them   very much. If they represent the spirit of this church, then I have to believe it would be a good place to attend. The church feels like home. The people are nice and not judgmental. They feed your spirit. Sweet Home Ministries LIFT Meetings has helped me a lot with my drug recovery. Plus they have a wonderful church service. The first lady and pastor are very supportive and have good sermons.

name: Sweetwater Christian Church - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: This has been my Church home for almost 2 decades. There is an openness here that I feel is unique - a genuine effort to know Christ through experience, study, and community. There are deep conversations that show a willingness to evaluate theology, serious discussions that probe current revelations of scholarship, and a fresh evolving approach to faith. This church is not afraid to consider challenges to long held traditional positions, always with an eye towards being Christ's people. It's a familiar place, a safe place, and a place of acceptance. If you're looking for a church experience that is rooted in scripture and love you should check it out. Sweetwater Christian Church is a great place to find belonging. I have been here for a long time, and it has helped shaped me into a more informed and faithful Christian. The pastor does a great job of explaining scripture with the aim of the people listening to love others more and seek God more. They have kid's ministry in the second service, and my son loves going. Sweetwater Christian Church is what a church should be!  We love God, and we love each other! We genuinely meet people where they are in their relationship with God and help them grow closer to God. Zane Goggans is a great pastor - both in teaching and caring for the church. I am so grateful to be part of a church family that loves me and helps me continue to grow! This was our church home for the past 3 years until we recently moved. There is a surplus of genuine people here (too many to name) to welcome and invite you to a place at the table. Church is not afraid to address a variety of topics that may be taboo at other places and approach with a Christlike mindset, do not sleep on this hidden gem if you are seeking a new church home. We love this church!  The first thing that gets ya is the fantastic praise music!  It always helps me reconnect and clears my head and softens my heart so I'm ready to worship.  Add to that the outstanding biblical based teachings and the friendly people.  We always come away with a new understanding, thought or perspective. The church is so good about being the hands of God too so there are always ways to give back to the community if your interested.  They are very welcoming to visitors but don't put pressure on you like some churches.  Come check it out!

name: Swope Parkway United Christian Church
reviewSummary: It was a blessing to be in service today. God always has a way of working on me through Pastor Williams Nice Church we used it for a Home Going Celebration since our Church is under going a renovation Meaningful word delivered by Rev Dr. Rodney E. Williams Great church!!!  Get your Praise on here🙏🙏 Easy to get to.

name: Tabernacle Baptist Church - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting Augusta and attended church this morning at Tabernacle Baptist. I had a wonderful time. Everyone was very welcoming and both the music and message were on point. I could definitely see myself joining this congregation if I lived locally. I really enjoyed my experience here. The Pastor is an excellent Teacher and Orator, & his messages are relevant, applicable, and heart felt. I'm looking forward to my next visit. Once I move closer to the area, I'm strongly considering attending regularly! I would want to simply say I enjoy the uplifting spiritual message that came to life through God delivered from Pastor Goodwin during our Revival at Sunshine Baptist Church in Blackville, SC.July 15-16. I loved the warmth and hospitality shared through Pastor Goodwin and his members who shared with us. Thanks for the T-Shirt. 🥰Hope to fellowship with you again soon.
Adelle Edwards Wonderful church service with the best Pastor who gives faith based Bible teaching with examples that relates to our daily experiences.
4 services on Sunday, in 2 different locations. I’m visiting from Seattle, WA and everyone is friendly and have a sweet spirit. The choir is spirit filled and God’s message is giving at each service with the Spirit of God‘s in every word. I love it 🙌🏾🔥❤️

name: Tabernacle of Praise Church International- Main Campus - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary:
I am somewhat new to Georgia and stay near this church. I haven’t been yet, but I am In need of a church that’s welcoming to a new comer. I would love to come and join in as soon as possible. I’m not sure how to go about that, but I need a place of worship and to be around other brothers and sisters of Christ. Is there anyone I should ask for or do I just come? Excellent &   anointed leadership of Bishop TJ & Pastor Shunnae McBride. Caring & loving leadership team. Awesome worship experience. Top love God & people of God My husband and I relocated from Phoenix AZ two years ago. I'm from the Bronx, he's from Chicago and we visited several churches seeking a church home. When we came to T.O.P  McDonough Campus, my husband said we don't need to go anywhere else! This church is on FIRE EVERY SUNDAY! Bishop McBride and Pastor Shunnae McBride are from California and they BRING IT every time they hit the pulpit! They keep it real and are anointed and appointed. There are so many ministries where you can find your place and seek  the 'assignment' God has for you. The praise dance ministry is awesome and the praise and worship team will have you doing laps around the church ... Literally! I THANK GOD for MY Church Tabernacle of Praise Church International and  they get 5 STARS! Come out and visit and Experience worship on a different level!
#elevate
#TOP
#ILOVEMYCHURCH I’ve been a member for almost two years looking back on all my photos and progress. If your looking for a spirit bond an action want to see and hear true testimony, then go to this church. They have events( My sons first Easter at church ), a multitude of different themes for weeks, and Bishop TJ McBride is literally a walking angel. He has prayed over me and my son’s life twice, also has given a helping hand. Pastor Shunnae McBride is a unicorn of a woman, they are a powerful duo. What started out to be the roughest two weeks of my life turned into just being patient, and the support of my church family & home.I’m forever grateful for Sonia may her life be forever blessed. My family and I have been faithful active members of TOP for 13 years. My husband and I are two of several leaders serving faithfully for the ministry. We are one church with three locations.  Locations consist of McDonough which is the main campus, Jonesboro, and Griffin areas. We are a welcoming church. We praise and worship like no other. We serve the community in so many areas. We have an awesome Early Learning Daycare Center Facility and Tabernacle of Praise Christian Academy for children grades K-5th. We do provide youth services for ages 2-18 years of age, at all three locations where they are taught the word of God on their level. We have a young adult ministry ages 18 through 35. We have other ministries to offer as well. I promise you the first time you come to worship with us you are not going anywhere else. If you are in any of the 3 surrounding areas please come worship with us, God will meet you there!!!!

name: Tabernacle United Church - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary: This church is both welcoming and spiritually filling. I have felt welcome here from my first visit, and now a year later I count this church as home. The church is dedicated to Jesus'  Gospel message of care for the outcast and is often at the forefront of social justice issues in the Philly-area. This the church where I have chosen to raise my family. I want them to know a God whose love is big and for all. Tabernacle is a community rooted in following the way of Jesus-- radically-inclusive and justice-seeking. Worship is meaningful, children are welcomed and nurtured, all are celebrated just as God made them. The fellowship of folks is warm and loving. Amazing people, amazing pastor, amazing worship, amazing building, amazing 2 months unforgettable, it's actually a home for building a hope on father Lord . Thank you I walked into this service by accident and thoroughly enjoyed it. I'll visit again. Beautiful Church in the Name of Jesus Christ Amen

name: Table Rock Church
reviewSummary: Great preaching and warm welcoming members. Small enough to get plugged into real relational community. TR is church where humility is practiced frequently from the pulpit. Great praise team, and their Youth Group program is just outstanding. They are not a huge church, so there's really a sense of community like everybody knows everybody. Whenever new people show up, someone will always make it a point to talk to you and get to know you a little more. If you value a tight-knit church community, this one is the one for you. Table Rock is a Bethlehem church plant, and the theology is absolutely airtight. That is not to say they are without faults, but God is always willing to forgive those whom He loves. If you're in the area, I would highly recommend checking it out. Table Rock church has solid biblical teaching by pastors who are God fearing men. Small enough to be able to get to know people but big enough to fill the building. They are reformed in their theology and is one of the most welcoming churches we've experienced in the Valley. Deeply insightful, theologically sound and Biblically orthodox teaching. Christian's dedicated to discipleship in small groups and careful study of the Scriptures. Worship is simple and meaningful, not intent on following latest Christian radio hits or be flashy. Relatively new congregation (5 years) that wants to have a presence in downtown Boise. The gospel message is preached here and it is absolutely refreshing to my soul. Our family has found their new home church. May the Lord continue to bless Table Rock Church.

name: Tables Church - Lake Forest Campus
Taft Avenue Community Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
An amazing Bible teaching Church.   Pastor Craig and his wife are a couple that genuinely care for others and reflect Jesus. Great Sunday School class.  Wonderful Church service.  Fantastic Tuesday morning men's bible study.
The Word of God is read and taught here.  Come worship and fellowship with us. In depth non political academic sermons which are intriguing and packed with a punch and conclusion that expertly weaves Gods word recorded by Gods inspired authors from ancient times to our modern lives and experiences.  Excellent Dr Craig Hill!  I look forward to sharing every Sunday morning now that you stream live!  Thank you and your devoted staff. Great community oriented church that teaches from the Bible! Excellent children's and youth's ministries in addition to adult small groups. Love Taft, definitely recommend! My family has been going to Taft Avenue Community Church for more than 10 years. It is our church family. The people are wonderful and really care about each other.

name: Tammany Oaks Church of Christ - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary:
Had a great Bible study and made to feel very welcomed.
We were a bit hesitant about going there as someone stated on a comment that there were musical instruments, but that was just on the song prior to worship starting. I have to admit, though, I’ve never been to a worship service where we only sang a total three songs, but nonetheless, it was beautiful to be able to worship God with  forever, family. Wonderful people that genuinely love God and love others. If you are in the area looking for a place to worship and be encouraged to grow in a relationship with Jesus Christ this is a great place. Very welcoming people who introduce themselves to me and appreciate visitors. Warning!
Not a biblical service! Instrumental music in the service. We had to walk out and worship at our trailer.
Must say as we have traveled all through the southern states and never come across this problem.
Will pray for you Tammany Oaks! I tried so hard to fit in and for a time I loved this place.I was so excited to go to church. Some didn't like me and you could feel it.  Others I won over and we became the best of friends. I once heard a story about a man who went to church and his phone went off.  He was so embarrassed and apologized.  Still he was ridiculed about the phone. He left the church and went to a bar. In the bar he dropped his drink. Multiple people went to help.  Who do you think got him? Many years ago I also left the church. Did anyone come after me? He left the sheep to go after the one. Best church in the world sweeties people I ever met.

name: Tampa Covenant Church
reviewSummary:
A church is not a building, but its people and the people at TCC truly live their faith. It doesn't feel full of pretentious, social club members and instead feels vibrant and authentic with the spirit of love, hope, and committed faith in being Christ-like. I've attended this church off and on since I was a child. It has sound doctrine and teaching that is Bible based. There are a lot of families that attend. Great children's ministry! I'm proud to say it is my permanent church now and I am involved in it personally.  It has it's faults like all churches but the main goal is loving God and loving others. My wife and our three children have been attending Tampa Covenant for about three years. We have found the members welcoming and friendly, the service traditional but not stuffy, and the use of the liturgy inspiring. For kids and teens, there are great activities and very caring staff. We could not be happier! My favourite place on earth. A modern cathedral. Beautiful symbolism, lovely architecture, and surprisingly good sound for a church.

Beyond the building, the music is above par, rich words balanced with new and old songs & a skilled group of musicians.

There are coral readings of scripture, literature, & creeds.

The messages are rooted in scripture with supporting quotes from just about anyone. Additionally, the sermons are given in such a way that you can actually believe the speakers passed public speaking 101.

Further, and possibly most surprising of all, the congregation seems to share a "we all are broken travellers trying to help each other" mindset. Sure, there are exceptions. Still, for the most part they seem to genuinely care "how are you?" And are will to actually listen for an answer instead of a greeting.

In a world full of churches filled with people playing church, these people are more interested in being real. This is the Church I felt the presence of God Almighty! This where you can get a real sense of belonging as a family! In the church everyone connects as a family! There is a genuine Christianity practiced band real love demonstrated!

name: Tampa Life Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited Tampa Life and it's a wonderful church. They truly praise the Holy spirit in this place. The only issue is this church is mislabeled because it is truly a full Pestecostal church, not a Non-denominational. So seek the Holy spirit, but be ready for a rich experience on Pentesocal rituals and approach. This should not be classified as a Non-denominational church. Visited 3 times, this ministry is big on baptism (every Sunday), dedicating babies to Jesus, being filled with the Holy Spirit, and praying for your neighbors.
Not sure if they have small groups, that would be nice to build community.
Huge church, so no ushers to seat people (but they're there during altar call), no tissues if you cry during worship...lol, so pack your own Kleenex.
Blacks and whites worship together and that's beautiful. A flex.
If you're at the back of the church you might feel a little left out of the action, but participate anyway.
Some speakers at the back of the church could enhance surround sound.
The service is broadcasted so it may feel like a front stage show to people who are not used to in-person, online synchronously.
*Disclaimer: 3rd-time Visitor review, not my church home per relocating.
**Possibly a higher rating, but only if I'd been attending much longer. Tampa Life Church is truly a place where you can feel the presence of God. From the moment you walk in, there is an energy that is warm, welcoming, and full of life. You do not just attend a service there, you experience a move of the Holy Spirit.

The worship is powerful, the atmosphere is uplifting, and the message is always delivered with purpose, truth, and love. There is a genuine sense that God is working through the people, the leadership, and the entire church family.
Pastor Tisdale and the Tampa Life team have created an environment where people can feel encouraged, strengthened, and spiritually refreshed.

What stands out most is the sincerity. Tampa Life Church does not feel like a performance. It feels like a family gathered in faith, worship, and expectation. The energy in the room is inspiring, but even more importantly, the presence of the Holy Spirit is evident. You leave feeling renewed, challenged, and reminded that God is moving.

I am grateful for Tampa Life Church and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a church home where faith is alive, people are loved, and the presence of God is truly felt. What a great place to go and feel the presence of God.  From the moment you step on the grounds of Tampa Life Church, you can feel an expectancy in the atmosphere,  like God is about to do something.  From the beginning to the ending of service, there is a real connection to God.  Pastor Tisdale is the real deal.  He preaches the true word of God in such an incredible way... its easy to understand, receive, and apply.
If you are looking to have a relationship with God, or want to have a greater relationship and grow in grace and knowledge of God, Look no further.  This is the place! Such an awesome place to connect spiritually. Bible focused, spirit filled, seeking truth. Every time we visit Florida we go there. Its a blessing every time.

name: Tapestry LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is for GenZ, young people. The church has so many members, about 400-500 people per each service.  But it's spiritual place and welcoming place. Many service volunteers are so happy and so bright. This church makes a welcoming and gathering evironment by proving donuts and coffee.  I can eat donuts and coffee every Sunday. I love this church. Praying team is awesome and spiritual.
Everyone is speaking English.
I noticed that more and more young people are attending this church and this church is getting culturally diversed.
There is free street parking on Sundays. i go to another church nearby but had heard great things about tapestry so i checked it out.

if you are looking for a congregation is largely younger (high school, college, and a big demographic in the 20s and 30s), then you will probably like tapestry.  no church can be all things to all people but i found the people welcoming.  the church is definitely on the modern side with modern worship, big production and a modern space.

if i had any criticisms or concerns for people who are looking to check it out, it would be the following.  bear in mind that these are preference issues and fundamentally i think very highly of the church, but these may be dealbreakers for you.

1.  pastor tends to speak very long...frequently over 60 minutes.  i didn't find the pastor to be very dynamic, but again, this is a preference issue.  as far as theology and content, the messages are very much on point.

2.  congregation is on the young side, and the demographic is largely asian.

3.  parking can be a little difficult in this part of DTLA and it's a little more run-down but then again, so is my church's area (i go to newstory LA).

if this appeals to you, check out their services on youtube for a sense of what they are like.  their channel is "tapestry LA church." This is the perfect church if you are looking for:

1. Experience. The main worship area is very dark to set the right mood. No lights for you to read your Bible. In fact, I was the only one with my Bible (paper kind) and I could not read it because it was so dark. I should have traded down my Bible for an iPad since that seems to be what everyone else had or their phones. Actually there was no need for your Bible since every passage was displayed on the big screen. Also right when you walk in, you're greeted by a huge coffee area giving you the feel that you're not at stuffy/traditional church but a hip coffee shop with cool merch. But hey, the proceeds go towards missions so it's all good.

2. Emotion. This church charges you up with great emotion. From the moment you enter their building music is blaring and you can't hear anyone singing. There is also skits and dancing before the sermon comes. An emotionally charged ballet dancer weeps off the stage as they try to visibly display the Philippians 4 passage about not being anxious. People around me were crying from watching the ballet performance. The crowd also got into the break dancing moves by the male ballet dancer. I just love it when there is break dancing at church!  Nothing gets me close with God like break dancing! Woot, woot!

The songs were also very emotionally driven by talented singers and band members. The songs were very generic about God and feeling. It could have been songs about any god since no mention of Christ or his atoning work for sin is mentioned. In fact, the songs seem to be vetted and carefully chosen to give you an emotional experience. Perfect for those who are looking for a pure emotional experience.

3. Eloquence. The pastor, Aaron Kim, was incredibly eloquent. He quoted Andrew Sullivan and Henri Nouwen, two openly homosexual Roman Catholics, waxing eloquent on their views about being still and quiet. The pastor spent more time quoting theologians and philosophers instead of explaining the meaning of the biblical text. Very impressive!

If you are looking for a place which will preach the Word of God, the gospel as the remedy for sin through faith in Christ alone according to the Word of God alone to the glory of God alone, look elsewhere. If you want the Bible with context, exegesis, and biblical exposition you will not like this church. Instead the sermon drips with worldly eloquence!

But if you're looking for emotionally charged, experientially inviting, and eloquent speakers - this is the church for you! They are very open and do not want you to be offended. They will make you feel very welcome and feel great. They are such a great church!, I thought I Will be out of place but the people at this church are very friendly and loving. I love rooted group and I will join cell group soon. They are a good community. Amazing Church in the Los Angeles area! The people are very welcoming and loving. Pastor Charles is a great man of God

name: Tates Creek Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
Tates Creek Christian Church is the most welcoming, loving, Gospel centered church I’ve ever been to. I’ve been going to Tates Creek for 6 months now and have never felt so loved. God is doing wonderful things through the people here! The music is outstanding, the sermons are always so impactful that I listen to them two or three times online throughout the week, and it’s very easy to get involved here and make friends because everyone is so kind and excited to welcome new people. 10/10 recommend no matter what age you are, but I would especially recommend this church to someone with kids because the youth ministry is amazing❤️ Victory for Life Ministry!! Thanks to Mr Larry, and Mr Don and Sharon!! Thank you to those who prepare and serve the food! Thanks for the revival of faith that I have lost! Anyone knows that a lot of churches say " Come as you are" ! Most lock the door when they see your homeless! This little program I only just today learned of ! What a welcoming group of people!! I pray that God blesses each of you for the open door you provide for those who are trodden and troubled!! Absolutely the best church I have ever been apart of. They minister to all the generations with their Traditional and Contemporary Services. Their Youth and Children's Ministers are all in and truly love my kids. The Senior Minister is approachable and friendly. They are currently remodeling the church to better prepare for the future. They are doing great things for the community. I mean they are hitting on all cylinders.  I would highly recommend coming and checking out this Church Family! For about 6 months we visited several churches in Lexington.  During our search, we would visit each church for about 6 weeks to get a feel about the church, the minister and if we felt it was a good match for our family.  Luckily, our search lead us to Tates Creek Christian Church.  We love the minister, Tommy Simpson.  We love the youth ministry.  We love the "feel" of the church and how nice and inviting the members were to us!

Tates Creek Christian Church offers two services, the 1st is a traditional format starting at 9:30 am and the second is a more contemporary/blended format starting at 11:00am.  Sunday school classes are available at either hour and there are a lot to choose from.

If you are looking for a church to call home, I would suggest you come visit Tates Creek Christian Church. You will be glad you did! I have been a member of this congregation since 1997 and have been blessed above and beyond all expectations. The love of the  people and their dedication to service to others make it a shining example of Jesus Christ. The church is dedicated to being a light and home to those searching for a warm welcome and a place to serve.

name: TCF - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Without a doubt one of the best churches I've been to in a long time. Pastor Sixto and Pastor Susan are truly doing God's work. They welcomed my family with open arms. Everyone made us feel truly blessed. Pastor helped us the first day we walked in the church. He even gave my husband a job on the spot. I am so glad we found our new home church! God bless them and the wonderful work that they are doing! TCF is our Church family. I can vividly remember the moment when my husband and I entered through their front door for the first time a year ago, we instantly sensed the powerful and tangible presence of God in there. We sensed the LOVE ❤️ of our ABBA FATHER through our pastors and everyone else. We love being a part of Jesus Christ believers who are Spirit-filled and continues to grow in Christ even beyond the Church walls. Loving God, loving His people. Serving God, serving His people. That is the heart of the Father. That is the TCF Church. ❤️ I didnt know about the church until I went to see John Ramirez there and the annointing is so tangible . You feel the 🔥🔥🔥🔥 on the atmosphere from Pastor Sixto , Susan John and all his team . Was beyond words
God bless
Carlos ( Saint Augustine) They are truly God sent and appointed! A Wonderful community of believers who believe in practical applications of showing God’s love. Their heart for the community is phenomenal, but focused one heart at a time rather than building a mega church.

name: Team Church - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary:
Strictly a Holy Bible only Church and meets the highest standard and requirements for God's Word and teachings. All are welcome! Love Share Serve and Give. We live the Book of Acts in this Christian Church! We moved to the area from Virginia a few months ago and were on the lookout for a home church. We discovered Team Church through Google, and I’m so thankful we did! The love of Jesus truly resonates throughout this entire congregation. Our first Sunday was amazing from the moment we arrived in the parking lot.

Every interaction—from the greeters and children's ministry to the ushers, pastors, and home team leaders—was filled with the warmth and love of Christ. This church exemplifies excellent discipleship, which is something we deeply value. I appreciate how accessible the pastor is, as building a relationship with the shepherd of the church has been important to us. My home team leaders consistently point us toward Christ, and the teachings are firmly rooted in Scripture.

I’m incredibly excited about continuing my spiritual growth here. I’ve also had the privilege of witnessing their middle and high school youth ministry, "Pursuit," in action on Wednesday nights. It’s inspiring to see how they invest in the youth, and I truly feel a sense of revival happening! It's evident that everyone at Team Church is operating in the gifts the Lord has placed in their hearts. I love this church! although I have never bean it soutnd amazing!I love the name team church we are all a team in Christ! We have been going to TC for a few months now and love it. A good bible based church, easy to understand teachings, and life groups for anyone! Amazing childrens ministry. My son has been learning so much here! Its changed our lives What a great place to learn and fellowship with other Christian believers. Biblically sound and there is a place for everyone to connect and serve.

name: Tega Cay Baptist Church - Fort Mill / Tega Cay Campus
reviewSummary:
The church still preached that you have to be saved and the only way to be saved is by Jesus Christ. The people are really friendly, the pastors are also very friendly. I went last year (2nd time trying, first time didn't have pastor, so I thought I'd give it another shot).  People not very friendly.  Only a man and his wife spoke to me and she did contact me afterwards. Pastor wasn't very friendly when the lady introduced me to him. Tega Cay Baptist is grounded is scripture and prayer.  They have a good mixture of contemporary music and hymns.  The people truly care about your personal relationship with the Lord. I looooove the preaching of the Word. It's  solid.(I am a Christian for many years). It's a family church.  I was not invited by anyone but when I went there I felt at home
Being new to the area I did not have to look for another church. The people are very welcoming. Pastor Vaughn is very engaging and personable.

name: Telugu Christian Fellowship Church Virginia (TCFCVA)
reviewSummary:
We have been attending this church for the past 7 years, and it has truly been a place where our spiritual lives have flourished. It is a wonderful church for families, especially those seeking to grow spiritually while raising children in a culture away from home. The Sunday School ministry provides a nurturing environment where our kids can learn about the Lord and connect with their cultural roots. The church offers various ministries that cater to every age group. The Women’s Ministry gathers monthly, offering a time of fellowship, growth in the Word, and support. Similarly, the Men’s Ministry also meets monthly, and it’s a great time for the men to bond, grow spiritually, and encourage one another. As a family, we appreciate the monthly All-Night Prayer meetings, where we experience spirit-filled worship and powerful apostolic teachings. The church is also home to a dedicated prayer ministry that intercedes daily for countless prayer requests, with early morning prayers every day at 5:30 AM. It’s truly a place where the power of prayer is evident. This church is not only a place of worship, but it’s also a community where we can grow, serve, and be equipped to be useful vessels for the Lord. The spirit of encouragement and spiritual growth is evident here, and it has been a blessing to see our entire family grow in faith.

For anyone looking for a Telugu-speaking church, a place of strong fellowship, and a community that feels like home—even for visiting parents from India—this church is highly recommended. It’s a place where you can truly grow in the Lord, and also encourage others to do the same! Been attending this church for over 10 years now. This is the church where I have grown closer to God along with my family members. The undiluted word of God is preached here. Has been a place of tremendous support system not just to me but to many who attend. Pastor Rufus is exceptional and committed to serve the people in this area with correct doctrines and shine the love of God through his spiritual counseling and spreading the faith. The church offers various ministry teams tailored specifically for men, women , kids and youth. Worship is amazing and we are spiritually renewed every single Sunday. Look no further if you are hunting for a good telugu church to attend in the NOVA area. Great fellowship and engaging word spoken by Pastor Rufus. Best Indian telugu church in VA. Went there for New Year service and almost felt like home church. Will certainly return when back in town. It’s always good time here at TCFVA to come together as a family of followers of Christ and worship our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. The spiritual manna we receive from Pastor Rufus is always encouraging in building our Faith in our Lord and strengthen us in our spiritual growth.  We have many opportunities here at TCFVA to grow spiritually in serving God and be a living testimony unto our God in our communities. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Telugu Christian Fellowship of Charlotte - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a truly blessed Good Friday, featuring the Passion of Christ play and the nourishing soul food of God’s word.
TCF did an amazing job hosting the Chicago team and 400+ audience.
The venue, music, food, and hospitality were truly amazing, as always like Christmas, TCF anniversary, and as a matter of fact even monthly fellowship. TCF of Charlotte is truly a vibrant Christian fellowship!
The Passion Play, organised in collaboration with ICCCNA–Chicago, was profoundly moving and executed with remarkable excellence. It was inspiring to witness children and young adults unite as a talented cast and crew, demonstrating both artistic skill and deep commitment.

Every dimension of the production was thoughtfully curated, capturing the theological depth and transformative essence of Christ’s love with clarity and reverence. The portrayal was both compelling and spiritually edifying, leaving a meaningful and lasting impression on the audience. Kudos to the administration and organisers for their visionary leadership, meticulous planning, and unwavering dedication in presenting such a significant and glorifying event. Truly an exceptional and uplifting experience. The Passion Play performed during the Easter service was a deeply moving and spiritually enriching experience. Through heartfelt music, expressive storytelling, and a reverent atmosphere, the cast and crew beautifully conveyed Christ’s sacrifice, suffering, and resurrection. The performance was a meaningful act of worship that inspired reflection, gratitude, and renewed faith, leaving a lasting impression of hope and redemption. Great efforts by the TCF fellowship leadership team and church members. Truly blessed by the Easter service. We’ve been part of the Telugu Christian fellowship (TCF) for few years, and it has truly become our spiritual home. From the very beginning, we were welcomed like family, and that sense of love and belonging has only grown stronger over time.

The fellowship provides a beautiful balance of meaningful worship, sound biblical teaching, and genuine community. The messages are always rooted in God’s Word and are both encouraging and challenging in the right ways. It’s been a blessing to see not only our own spiritual growth but also the growth of our children, who are learning strong Christian values in a nurturing environment.

What makes this fellowship especially special is the unity among members. There is a deep sense of care, support, and prayer for one another, whether in times of joy or difficulty. The leadership is humble, dedicated, and truly committed to serving God and the community.

We are incredibly grateful to be part of this fellowship and would wholeheartedly recommend it to any family looking for a place to grow in faith, build lasting relationships, and experience God’s love in action. TCF is a vibrant fellowship that blends spiritual depth with genuine community. The leadership is thoughtful and dedicated. The worship experience is inspiring while the congregation radiates warmth. Whether you’re new to the city or seeking a meaningful place to grow in faith, TCF offers an environment that is both enriching and spiritually grounding. I recently had the privilege of attending “The Passion Play of Jesus” for the first time in the States and it was nothing short of extraordinary. The combined cast from TCF and ICCCNA delivered a powerful yet moving performance and the leadership along with the dedicated volunteers organized the event with remarkable excellence. It was an experience that touched all of our hearts deeply.
To me personally, this Christian fellowship feels close to home.

name: Temecula Hills Christian Fellowship - God-centered, Bible-saturated - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Such a wonderful church with pastors who teach the Word of God with such humility and reverence for the Lord. They lead the congregation with such care always pointing to what the Word of God says. Thankful for a smaller God-centered, bible-based church where we can fellowship before and after service. Great home groups and children's ministry. They have 5 main rotating pastor/elders who all have a gift for teaching the word of God. This is my new church. I haven't been going here long but after going to the rock church I knew I had some searching to do. After visiting only once I knew right away this place is were I will stay. They teach from the Bible, contextual, biblical perspective, and there are multiple people involved in feeding the sheep. The children's ministry seems pretty cool too. I don't know what was going on but my son was dancing around like a crazy person when I got there. Welcoming medium sized fellowship with strong emphasis on the relevance and power of the Bible as the Word of God. Pastors/Teachers, deacons, and volunteers are all personable, helpful, and kind. Strong, Bible-based congregation that I'm happy to be a part of. Great Bible based church that emphasizes the Word of God.  Friendly pastors and people who help you grow in your faith and knowledge of God.

name: Temecula United Methodist Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and concerns about Temecula United Methodist Church. We value each voice in our community, and it’s important to us to engage in open and loving dialogue.

At our church, we believe that all individuals, including our LGBTQIA+ friends, are embraced by God’s love and are integral members of our spiritual family. Our affirming stance reflects our commitment to inclusivity, recognizing that everyone is created in the image of God and deserving of love and respect.

We understand that our celebration of diversity and our support for the LGBTQIA+ community may raise questions for some. However, we firmly believe that love and acceptance are at the heart of Christ’s message. Celebrating our LGBTQIA+ friends is not about condoning sin; rather, it is about acknowledging the beautiful diversity of God’s creation and the inherent worth of every person. I actually enjoyed the service and church. Can not give 5 stars due to my feelings on the "pride" celebration. All sin is sin but the open celebration of sin is a mocking of Gods word in my opinion. Not judging in condemnation, just an opinion. Love is not a sin, but openly celebrating what we do in private that is sin, is a mockery. The most welcoming and inclusive church in the area. All who seek are welcome; "seek and ye shall find. " TUMC is a warm and welcoming environment! They have two services each Sunday, at 9am and at 10:30am. Everyone is so friendly and we love the "children's chats" with the Pastor. He relates to the kids so well and they love this time as well! We've been attending for three years and love it here at our "church home"!
Debi & Ken Friendly and welcoming congregation!

name: Temecula Valley Church of Christ in Temecula - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I love a church who follows the Bible and encourages everyone to be in small family groups to help follow believers in their daily lives to be holy. This church has new leaders who are highly qualified and very encouraging. They are big on prayer and following God's doctrine. They are good at preaching and teaching the word of God and follow Christ's example in their lives, while encouraging the congregation to be Bereans and examine scripture for themselves (Acts 17:11). This church worships to praise God and give Him glory. There is an emphasis here on fellowship and unity. If you are looking for a church I wholeheartedly recommended you check this one out. Great biblical teachings, strong fellowship and international community reach.  Very diverse with strong emphasis on missions outreach worldwide! Best church ever .
AMAZING COMUNITY.
The Pastor Mike and Shelly Pope are all about God and HIS people It's a great place to worship for the whole family.

reviewSummary:

Not spiritually, scripturally or mentally mature. Go here. Brethren please beware of wolves in sheep’s clothing. Read the word and be stead fast and unmovable in the word, steer away from here.

True saints

name: Templo Calvario Church Assemblies of God - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Went there as a kid, and never forgot Templo Calvario. As I grew older I always knew TC would be my church. Always felt it HOME. Felt God there even as a kid…. And I am back now with a beautiful wife and kids of my own…. And makes me happy that my kids also feel it home. And not just on Sunday, Thursday Royal Rangers for the kids, and couple group for us💕 I go to the logos building. What I like is you don't get a pastor's opinion on the teaching. You keep the word of God. Unadulterated explain in a way that even a child can understand T.C. is my Church, my Family and many of the are my friends. Brothers and sisters serving our community with all their talents. God gives us love and we share that love with others. We're blessed to bless you. God love you first never forget that! I love my church. I was born into this place and no other church could ever replace it. We have a great structural system that goes by age group. From nursery care to young adults services and even have bilangual services. God has blessed us incredibly. Templo Calvario is a place of worship and most importantly a place where the word of God is the rule to follow. Pastor Daniel De Leon has been a beacon of light in my life. I live my life by a set of eternal spiritual values this church has thought me through the years.
