name: TerraNova Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going TerraNova about 8 years and its a great church to be part of, the leaders are awesome and every week the message is new and fulfilling. I’ve made some great friends there and never feel judged or out of place. They are always offering new Life Groups to join and there are so many to choose from.  There is a little something for everyone at this church.   The Worship music is fabulous. We have been privileged to call Terra Nova our church home for the past 6 years. It is truly a come as you are experience. The worship band is incredible, and we learn something new in the message every week. There is something for every age if you are looking for a small group, the children’s ministry is amazing, and the women’s ministry is very active with so many fun activities to take part in. I have met such special women here.  The best part is knowing how well TN supports the community, local schools,  and many needs worldwide. A very generous, loving group to be a part of! Come check it out! We love TerraNova Church.  We had been searching for a new Church and tried several before going to TerraNova.  We new right away we had found our place. Pastor John's sermons feel like they speak directly to you and his passion and energy is sincere and inspiring. I started going to TerraNova when I moved down to Southern California, and it has been an awesome first experience as a newer follower of Christ! The small groups are all welcoming and becoming a part of serving the within TerraNova and the community is so easy. The sermons are in depth and give context, scripture, and perspective into changing habits to better align with Jesus’s teachings, and I have been able to share them with family members who are non-believers, and they are always interested! The pastors are very friendly and work hard to support, teach, and guide everyone who attends.
The youth ministry is also super epic, and I’ve gotten to work with the Junior Highers with their leader ( shout out to Doah!) who is probably one of the coolest dudes. He keeps the middle schoolers engaged and interested in the lessons and supports them into growing into their own faith and being able to defend difficult topics.
The band is also phenomenal and are very down to earth. When I first attended I was brought to tears by the music and was shocked to learn that some of the songs are originals from the worship singer!
Very good stuff. Basically if your thinking of going to a church with strong community, and your a parent, a single parent, a young adult, an older individual, or are a first timer like I was, this is the place to be! TerraNova is a community filled with genuine and friendly people who are very welcoming and committed to making a difference. After visiting several different types of churches in the area, TN stood out the most and remembered my name after 1 visit! Plenty of small group options available and opportunities to give back to the community. If you are still searching for a place to belong, it's worth the visit.

name: TerraNova Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going TerraNova about 8 years and its a great church to be part of, the leaders are awesome and every week the message is new and fulfilling. I’ve made some great friends there and never feel judged or out of place. They are always offering new Life Groups to join and there are so many to choose from.  There is a little something for everyone at this church.   The Worship music is fabulous. We have been privileged to call Terra Nova our church home for the past 6 years. It is truly a come as you are experience. The worship band is incredible, and we learn something new in the message every week. There is something for every age if you are looking for a small group, the children’s ministry is amazing, and the women’s ministry is very active with so many fun activities to take part in. I have met such special women here.  The best part is knowing how well TN supports the community, local schools,  and many needs worldwide. A very generous, loving group to be a part of! Come check it out! We love TerraNova Church.  We had been searching for a new Church and tried several before going to TerraNova.  We new right away we had found our place. Pastor John's sermons feel like they speak directly to you and his passion and energy is sincere and inspiring. I started going to TerraNova when I moved down to Southern California, and it has been an awesome first experience as a newer follower of Christ! The small groups are all welcoming and becoming a part of serving the within TerraNova and the community is so easy. The sermons are in depth and give context, scripture, and perspective into changing habits to better align with Jesus’s teachings, and I have been able to share them with family members who are non-believers, and they are always interested! The pastors are very friendly and work hard to support, teach, and guide everyone who attends.
The youth ministry is also super epic, and I’ve gotten to work with the Junior Highers with their leader ( shout out to Doah!) who is probably one of the coolest dudes. He keeps the middle schoolers engaged and interested in the lessons and supports them into growing into their own faith and being able to defend difficult topics.
The band is also phenomenal and are very down to earth. When I first attended I was brought to tears by the music and was shocked to learn that some of the songs are originals from the worship singer!
Very good stuff. Basically if your thinking of going to a church with strong community, and your a parent, a single parent, a young adult, an older individual, or are a first timer like I was, this is the place to be! TerraNova is a community filled with genuine and friendly people who are very welcoming and committed to making a difference. After visiting several different types of churches in the area, TN stood out the most and remembered my name after 1 visit! Plenty of small group options available and opportunities to give back to the community. If you are still searching for a place to belong, it's worth the visit.

name: Thanh Le Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has both Vietnamese and English-speaking congregations, which creates a welcoming and diverse community. It became my home church after I married my husband, and I feel incredibly blessed to be part of it. The love, biblical truth, and genuine care demonstrated by the pastors, elders, and members are evident in every interaction, regardless of age or stage of life.

The church offers many small groups for Bible study and fellowship, as well as opportunities to participate in local and international mission trips. One thing that I don't often see at other churches is the SALT program (1:1 discipleship), which has been beneficial for my spiritual growth and walk with God. A church that preaches the truth of God’s Word with love. The community is welcoming, genuine, and truly feels like family. A place to grow in faith and fellowship! Great place for gathering for worship.

name: Thanksgiving Church Lifepoint Ministry - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Been a member at this church for nearly 8 years! Community can be a little exclusive in the high school and college ministries,  but I always loved the pastors and teachers growing up! Lifepoint (the adult ministry) on the hand is wonderful. Very friendly from the beginning to now :) Pastor James has also been an amazing speaker! Loved all his messages since EPIC ministry! If you are looking for a church, I'd recommend you try a visit I've been a member of this church for 13ish years. I started in the high school ministry back when Pastor James Myoung was leading it and was also a part of the college ministry in the last year with Pastor Scott Oh and then a year with Pastor Tom Taylor. Now I've been with lifepoint with my husband for about 3 good years. I think all the years leading up to the recent last two years I was able to find a good community of strong believers where we could uplift and speak God's truth into the lives of each other. People were so much more active back then with outreach, bible studies, hangouts outside church, etc. Unfortunately now, I can say it's not the same as what it used to be. Seems like a lot of the good pastors within the English speaking part of the church are leaving because of low pay or because of disagreements with the Korean congregational part of the church. As a whole, the church feels a lot more divided. Much of the members seem also very comfortable hanging out more with the people they know than willing to be around new members or those within the church they haven't gotten to get to know yet. Many are also very reluctant with excuses to why they can't come out to events, hangouts, lifegroups, volunteer, etc. I'm guilty of that sometimes as well. Lifepoint (the English adult ministry) preaches about being one body, but the community doesn't feel like one body. Anyone reading this, whether you were visiting or once came here and felt this way, you weren't alone in that feeling. I can only hope the community in this church changes for the better in the future. Very good church good for both Korean and English and very together especially in youth groups Great church full of holy people.      Caring and do food donations Great church and amazing people. I really like this church

name: The Abyssinian Baptist Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
3/21/26. Abyssinian Baptist Church had a family Heath day! Many organizations provides information from banking to mental health and on site blood pressure and breast exams. They had health pannels    and meditation and a DJ. Lunch was provided and I signed up a few studies! This is not a music show; it is a Mass—a deeply spiritual experience. The most meaningful part was being able to share it with the local community, who graciously welcome visitors to join their celebration if there is space and you arrive early.

I feel truly grateful and blessed to have been part of it. It’s also a place with more than a century of history, where faith, tradition, and community come together in a very special way. An authentic and unforgettable experience. Date of Visit: 7/12/2026

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I genuinely wish someone had prepared me for what this church service would actually be like. I would’ve selected somewhere else to worship if I had known. I came seeking God and this is how I experienced it.

If you're looking for a church where you can actively worship, hear substantial biblical teaching, pray with the congregation, and leave spiritually nourished, this may not be the place for you to visit. It was not that experience for me.

The overwhelming majority of the service was spent listening to the choir and sitting through announcements. As a visitor, I felt more like an audience member watching a performance than someone participating in worship. There were no lyrics displayed, so unless you already knew the songs, there was no real opportunity to join in. The choir is beautiful, but that’s just it. It’s like watching a concert. Not an active worship and praise that shifts the atmosphere to bring Holy Spirit down towards you.

The sermon itself was surprisingly short compared to everything else, and very little Scripture was actually read during the service. The only word read the day I visited was Isaiah 40: 1-5, that’s it. There was no closing prayer, no pastoral benediction, and no sense of being sent out encouraged in the Lord. The lack of an altar call for prayers was so jarring.  The service simply ended with more singing by the choir.

Service lasted about 2 1/2 hours. About an hour and a half or more was spent mostly on announcements. The sermon was approximately 30 to 40 minutes. What made this even more disappointing was that there were multiple requests for offerings throughout the service. I have absolutely no issue giving financially to a church. I believe in tithing and generosity!  But personally, it felt strange to be asked repeatedly to give when I left feeling like I had received very little spiritual nourishment in return.

The atmosphere also wasn't what I expected. In my experience, several of the ushers were more aggressive than welcoming, and I did not feel warmly received as a first-time visitor. After the service, I specifically asked an usher whether this was an unusual Sunday or if this was how the church normally operates. I was told this is their normal format.

Personally, I did not feel the presence of the Lord in this service. I left spiritually empty, confused, and honestly disappointed. I came expecting to encounter God through worship, prayer, and the preaching of His Word. Instead, I felt like I had watched a program. It felt more like a spectacle. I had to go home to worship and praise on my own in order to recharge my spirit.

I'm not saying this church is for no one. Clearly, many people love it. But if you're visiting because you're looking for a Christ-centered service with active congregational worship, meaningful prayer, strong biblical preaching, and a welcoming atmosphere, be mindful. I think it's important to know what to expect if you come here. An unforgettable experience. The Sunday service at Abyssinian Baptist Church is truly inspiring—filled with powerful gospel music, heartfelt preaching, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The congregation made us feel like honored guests. A beautiful expression of faith and Harlem’s vibrant community spirit. I've was a follower of Abyssinian online for several months before I joined in December of 2025. I now attend services in person and it is life changing! The choirs are amazing and uplifting. The sermons are life affirming socially relevant and applicable to all ages. There's a very specific attention to ALL ages, as well as, regular interracial attendees. Quite a number of visitors are regularly from other countries cultures and religious experiences. Of course Abyssinian is known for pastors Reverend Adam Clayton Powell, Sr., and his son the Reverend Adam Clayton Powell, Jr. This history of the establishment of Abyssinian goes back 218 years. While there is much reverence and respect for its history, there are exciting advancements being made for consistent investment in the future of the church the community and the world. Abyssinian Baptist Church is simply amazing; being among the membership is the best thing I've experienced in quite a long time. I'm humble and grateful to be here. Visitors are always very welcome! There is also a very active online membership. This church is top-notch in service. community,  and spreading God's word.

name: The Allen Chapel AME Church of Riverside - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Mt. Rubidoux trail has the most beautiful sights. A gorgeous peaceful stroll that leads you to the top of the peak where a beautiful cross stands tall. Lovely service. name: The Anchor: Calvary Chapel San Pedro - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: About the praise music: Psalm 33:2,3 Psalm 98:4-6 Psalm 150:3-5 tells what one expect when you show up Sunday mornings.  Music fit for a King! (NKJV)  Free parking on 7th St Excellent church. Bible-based and Pastor Jerry is a great pastor. Teaches from the Bible line-by-line. Also other great ministries to be in like Women's Bible Study and other groups. If you want or need Jesus in your life, try Calvary Chapel San Pedro out. You'll be glad you did. This church is awesome. Pastor Jerry is a really good teacher. The woman's ministry is doing great things. They have a awesome worship team too. I highly recommend going to one of there services. The women's ministry is great ,we have a bible study twice a week. The children's ministry actually teaches your kids and doesn't just baby sit them.  The mid week study gets in depth. reviewSummary: God is truly in this place. Prayer house and a warm and loving family. If you love prayers, then be part of us.

name: The Ark Church and Child Care - Dublin Campus
reviewSummary: After trying multiple daycares, The Ark Child care has been such a blessing in our family’s life! For the first time we have a total peace of mind knowing our child is safe, understood, and receiving Christ-centered learning. All of the teachers are so compassionate and knowledgable about managing child developments and behaviors. One of my favorite things is receiving daily updates and pictures which definitely helps soothe my working mom heart! 10/10 daycare!! The Ark Child Care has been nothing but great to our family! As first time parents, trusting someone else with our daughter was nerve wracking, but the staff has been great, supportive, and patient. They truly care about the kids and have the best interest for the children. Their communication is excellent! They provide multiple updates throughout the day. We highly recommend The Ark Child Care to anyone! Was here for an after funeral meal.  Pastor and members from the church went out of their way to make things as pleasant and welcoming as possible.  Very clean and inviting environment.  Plenty of parking and restrooms. The members at The Ark Church genuinely care for how you are doing. When someone is sick or going through a difficult time, other members offer to provide a meal or a tangible way to help you. Faith Community Church is a very friendly group of people.  The Pastor, Nick Cannell, is "Excellent" from the pulpit.  He has strong bible knowledge from his seminary training at Trinity International University where he studied under Norm Geisler, David Hesselgrave, Donald Carson and others.  Nick is a kind-hearted, christian man who has devoted 30+ years to planting, establishing and leading this church.  I would highly recommend visiting and joining this church on Sunday!

name: The Ark Church Gulf Coast - League City Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is full of life, love and the word of God. From teachings directly from the bible, to the children’s ministry, Dgroups, weekly devotionals truly the Ark is focused only on the word of God. They take you just as you are, just as God does, just as God teaches us. The preaching of the pastors are focused directly from the bible so there is no straying from God and all he has planned for you. I highly recommend attending at least one service to see if God calls you to make it your home church, and if he doesn’t the hope is it gets you in the mindset to find a home church that is right for you!  There’s three services to choose from with a wonderful children’s ministry so the only thing really stopping you, is you. The Ark is one of the best at being open and welcoming you’ll see that from the street with the welcoming committee standing by the road!!! Don’t wait another weekend! Sunday is almost here, join in online or in person and experience the word of God, fellowship and community for yourself!

Can’t forget praise and worship before and after service, truly this church has it all! From the very first day I walked through the doors, this church felt like home. After moving four hours away from everyone and everything I knew, I was praying to find a place where I belonged, and that’s exactly what I found here. The love, kindness, and genuine welcome I received made such a difference during a season of big change.

This isn’t just a church—it’s a family. The people here truly care about one another, encourage you, and challenge you to grow into the person God has called you to be. Every service leaves me feeling encouraged, supported, and closer to my faith.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll be welcomed with open arms, surrounded by authentic community, and encouraged to grow spiritually, I can’t recommend this church enough. I am so grateful God led me here I love worshiping at Ark Church! At a time in my life where I felt spiritually suffocated, I prayed and searched for a church that ministered to the whole family dynamic, was grounded in the Word of God (hallelujah!), and offered opportunities for everyone in my family to either serve and/or be a part of a ministry group. I love that all age groups are represented, which, in my opinion, can also be a sign of a healthy church. The first time I visited, the hospitality overflowed and felt genuine. I did not feel like members greeted me because they felt obligated. This is not a church for folks who want to stay the same in their walk with God. If you're like me and want spiritual "fresh air," then prayerfully come visit Ark Church and I pray that you feel the same love that I felt on day one, but more importantly that you plug into the church body the God has for you. BUT, don't sleep on Ark Church! Before you know it, you WILL grow be blessed at Ark Gulf Coast, so beware! It's small, but mighty in the Lord. Lol! See ya soon!

-written in love and gratitude My wife and I visited this church a few months ago and we really enjoyed it.  The congregation is happy, friendly, and they treat each other like members of a big family, with Jesus Christ at the center.  We have been going to church here regularly for a few months now and we really enjoy it.  If you’re looking for a church, the Ark in League City is a great one to check out. This church has truly helped me experience the love of God. I had been praying for a church, and I believe God led me here. Every message is rooted in God’s Word and points to Jesus. The people are welcoming, and the church genuinely helps you grow in your relationship with Christ. I’m so grateful God brought me here.

name: The Ascent Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: We have attended The Ascent for over 30 years and have participated in most every aspect of the ministry.  We love the community and friendships we've formed and have been blessed by the teaching, worship, bible studies and service.  What a generous church!  The Ascent ministers to the families that attend and have contributed greatly to the community through fundraising for suicide prevention in the schools and utilizing their building for other organizations. My husband and I have been attending The Ascent for a little over a year since moving to the area from out of state. We were looking for a church that actually teaches expository. We found it at The Ascent. Everyone is so warm and welcoming too. The Ascent Church is a Bible‑based community with excellent teaching centered on hope, healing, and the freedom we have in Christ. We wholeheartedly recommend this church for its strong biblical teaching and the many opportunities it offers for fellowship with other believers. It also provides a meaningful pathway for those seeking to know God more intimately and find answers to life’s deepest questions. I have been attending here for 18 years, and it is such a great community. I am thankful for the relationships that I’ve made at The Ascent and for the sound and Biblically based teaching that I receive each week. I have been in a few Base Camps (Small Groups) throughout the 18 years here, and these are really special (eternal) friendships that I’ve made. We love the children’s programs for our 8 year old and we are very thankful to call The Ascent our home church. Great friendly local church in Monument! My wife and I love the expository sermons that help us grow in our faith and understanding of the Bible and how God wants us to live. We have an awesome base camp (small group) that we meet with monthly. Our kids enjoy the children’s church and activities that they plan for them. My whole family loves being a part of The Ascent Church!

name: The Assembly @ Warner Robins - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary:
I must say that I’ve adopted this church as if everyone that attended here were my own personal family!
I love the message that the pastor delivers every Sunday
Some days I feel as if he’s speaking too me directly!
The staff members are such loving and supportive people!
My son and I have been attending this church for about 5 years now and my son has brought forth about 6-7 of his peers to their children’s church and they are always asking me if I can pick them up every Sunday, their always speaking about how nice everyone were to them as well!!
Please come out and feel Gods presence inside of assembly!! The one church that has everything for kids and adults of all ages. Always a good sermon and a sense of community. I came a few times to attend sunday service and it was just awkward how hard that harp on tithing. Then one Sunday the pastor said and I quote “If you’re not going to give don’t be a member we don’t want a non giver”. I just quit going.

A little history and bible knowledge: Tithing is in the book of leviticus- God was giving law to the Israelites. Well Good people I am not an Israelite and most people in the United States are not Israelites. Additionally, Jesus died for our sins and led us away from this. Fast forward to New Testament Jesus says give with a good heart as you see fit. This does not describe money. Giving could be giving time, money, clothes, donations, etc… So therefore please give with a good heart as you see fit. Don’t buy a million dollar church and then shame your members to give and minister scripture out of context. First off, there aren't nearly enough volunteers in the kids/nursery department for a church that size, meaning there is no reason to have that big of a congregation and not enough volunteers. Red flag to me. There was a sweet older lady in the room who didn't look like she needed to be much on her feet for the entirety of a service chasing around 4 year olds but we were told that they have a shortage of volunteers, also the reasoning for the different room my 2 year old would be in.

The next red flag was the cafe/coffee area. So very hectic and the girl I needed to remind about my lemonade order after 15 minutes of waiting was not very polite when I mentioned it and she said I needed to just wait a little longer. I told her many have gotten this drink who ordered after me, she said they're behind and I told her okay well church is starting now, so can I just get a refund? She asked me how much the drink was (there were no prices on the sign & we also got a couple of hot chocolates and donuts) so I told her I have no idea, so she opened the register and gave me a $5.. I was like okay, so that was a great encounter.

We sat through worship and it just felt.. off. The alarms were going off in my head. Me and my husband decided it was time to go almost as soon as the pastor started speaking about announcements.

The Lord will show you where you're meant to be, and that just wasn't our home. I didn't feel the Holy Spirit there like I've felt other places here. Had to try it though! My church is awesome! Love my pastor and family at the assembly.

name: The Assembly in Christ in New York - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a church filled with God's love, the love of its members, and the presence of the Holy Spirit, a church that reveals the truth of the cross! Those who thirst for true grace will surely be satisfied when they come here! Christ in New York is a relatively simple church with uncomplicated relationships. The brothers and sisters are united and loving towards one another, walking together on the path to the Holy Spirit. The pastor and his wife are kind and approachable, possessing an accurate understanding of God's truth. If you are also searching for that unchanging truth, if you are at a crossroads in your life, hesitating, why not set aside your worries and come to our church to see and listen? We believe you will gain a completely new understanding. Thanks be to the Lord for His mercy! Hearing God's servants explain biblical truth and shepherd the flock, thank you, Pastor! Thank you, Pastor and Pastor's wife, for your dedicated teaching of us to put off the old creation and enter into the new self. Thank you, Pastor's wife, for your daily hymns of praise and spiritual guidance. Hallelujah! Praise be to God the Father! Glory to God! Amen!

Unfortunately, I am listening to your recordings, Pastor. I live in Taiwan. Thank you for the Holy Spirit's guidance. It's a simple and harmonious church. The pastor and his wife are very nice. Everyone in New York is so busy, it's great to have time to come to church. I recommend it! A church that solely proclaims Christ, loves Christ, and manifests Christ.

name: The Bay Church - Concord Campus - Concord Campus
reviewSummary:

You can’t expect people to step into a place and expect so much out of them when you’re they’re not given the tools. They have a great outreach for the community and always helping others. Don’t expect to be mentored here, with that being said, if you’re looking to meet other families and join a small group then this is the place for  If you’re looking to go deeper in your faith and get discipleship, this is not the place for you. Absolutely amazing Church! I love it here. I went to this church several years ago, but they changed their name. I found it again and it truly is a special place. I love the worship and sound word.  PASTOR John is so solid and down to earth. His wife is so sweet and kind. I met her one day after church with her mother.  She introduced me to their daughter. I didn't even know she was the pastors wife. They were also so kind and loving towards my kids and I. You can also volunteer to set up (10 a.m. to 12:30 pm) or serve the participants who come select from various sections: produce 🥕 🍇 🌽, dry goods 🥣 🥜, meats & eggs 🥚 🍖, bread 🍞, desserts 🍰 🍪, flowers 💐,  berries 🍒 🍓 🫐, potatoes/onions,🥔 🍠 🧅 and chilled/frozen foods 🥛 🧀📺 🍽️ (12:30-3:30 pm). Please 🙏 bring your own bags 🛍️. Carts 🛒 are supplied as is help loading up 🚗 your groceries 🛍️.
Come 🫴 and get blessed 🙏 either way: volunteer or get something to eat. You can't beat fellowship 🤗 like this! I remember going to this church every other Friday, when they used to host this event called the spot

name: The Bay Community Church
reviewSummary: Pastor Craig Cerrito was excellent! He explained things better than any Pastor I have heard at any church. The congregation was very nice and welcoming.  I would definitely recommend this church to anyone who is interested in understanding the Bible better. Great sermon. Small but super friendly congregation. You'll be welcomed with open arms Great small community church.  Pastor Washington is a very knowledgeable and caring man of God Small friendly and caring for others 😊👍 place. Very friendly. Welcoming to all.

name: The Bayou Church - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: Welcoming place, numerous baptisms recently.  If its a big church you want with load worship this place could be a good fit for you.  Numerous armed sheriffs provide security. Best Church every everyone is friendly and down to earth not judgemental.  And very spirit filled church It's a big, beautiful, brand new church. Inside is a large concessions area serving fresh coffee and beignets. During the service, there was live music, a water baptism, and testimonials from people who's lives have been positively impacted by living addiction-free lives. It was a good experience. 5-stars I’ve never left a review for a church… but I wanted to give props real quick. My family and I have only been coming a month, as we are transitioning from another church we have been at for several years. Transitions are never easy but I wanted to S/O Mrs. Lori as she has made it a point to “see us”, acknowledge us, and simply check in to ensure our experience/time was as pleasant as possible. Kudos to her! We feel seen, valued and appreciated. Haven't been here in a while, but will grace him with his grace soon. Will be back to attend The Hope Church soon.

name: The Beat Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
I have experienced buckets of legitimate church hurt throughout my life, heart breaking betrayal from close family relationships, and my own many failures to just do life well. I have been part of The Beat for almost 3 years and I am experiencing genuine healing and success in life. Of course , not everything has been perfect all the time- it’s not supposed to be, but I am enjoying more and more what healthy family looks like. I have been loved unconditionally. I am finally beginning to have a sentiment like the apostle Paul, “If you see me, you see Christ”, not because of what I have done in my strength, but because of the off the charts work that Jesus is doing within me. I LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS CHURCH. I have never felt more loved and apart of something then I do at this church. When I came to The Beat, I was in active addition and struggling to find my place. The pastors and the people at this church truly live out their mission statement: Loving God, loving people and living like they mean it. Since joining this church, I have found purpose in life and serve on the worship team. Both my children decided to get baptized and have found great connections through this community as well. 5 out of 5, I recommend! This church has been such a amazing church. Pastor Andy and Pastor Kyle have been such great friends for over years. The influence of this church was able to open the door in my mind and heart to follow Jesus Christ And allow God to work in my mind and heart. I believe if you’re looking for a friend, a church that love God, love Jesus and live life like we mean it. You’re in the right place. Church service was really great. The songs, band and singers are really good. The sermon was also one of the best I can remember, we also watched a few online. Was a little uncomfortable with the prayer circle being new and not knowing anyone.
Update the website with what you offer the kids. They had a great time playing the games they said. Teachers were very kind and fun.

We dropped off things for the foster closet. Staff of very friendly and helpful. Nice to have a place to donate great stuff to. Good cause ❤️ "Love God. Love people. Live like you mean it." This church exemplifies building community through Christ Yeshua. Folks here meet people where they are without judgment and love them where they are unconditionally.  I'm so thankful we found our church family!

name: The Becoming Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I visited as we are relocating to the area and we are an interracial family. We have a 1 year old as well. Not only did our baby take a whole nap in kids church, but multiple kids volunteers went out of their way to say hello to us, meet us and there were many others that noticed we were new and spoke to us.

People were so welcoming and warm, there was also a mix of the congregation that we really appreciated.

Word is solid 🔥🔥🔥 and so was worship. Highly recommend. This is a Spirit Filled Church! My Bishop Kenneth C. Ulmer taught us every good sermon has a three point message. He also talked about the importance of the horizontal representation of the cross (people and community) relationships. I have visited this church three weekends in a row. They are Bible based, friendly, with hearts to serve God and communities. The presence of God is there. All are welcomed! Well worth attending if you want to grow in your relationship with the Lord.

Hebrews 11:1 Faith is the substance for things hoped for and not seen…. Faith in Greek is Pistis (to be won over), Hope in Greek is Elpis (to anticipate), Evidence in Greek is elenchos (to bring to light)”. Great sermon today! I may be a little bias lol but this is the best church on this side of heaven. From Day 1 of attending this church, I knew I was at home. The teachings, the serve team, the pastor and family, EVERYTHING about this place, I believe, was apart of God's will for my life! I absolutely LOVE this church, the pastoral family, and the congregation. 5 STARS, DO RECOMMEND! On the younger side when it comes to members (which I love), but inclusive to ALL ages and races. You will not feel ashamed or out of place here. Great church, better than any one I’ve been too! The pastor has good messages.

name: The Bethel Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a great first time experience. And you can tell the spirit, was there. I would definitely return. My cousins homegoing celebration was held here recently, as well as my late Aunts over a year ago. All I can say is "Won't he do it! Amen
Great place to worship with a warm loving and friendly atmosphere from beginning to end. You will definitely get biblical teachings and a powerful word from God, every time. And that's the Bethel Experience. I love so much your preaching and teaching the words of God. It's helpful for all congregation. Great service! The word of God is preached. Large sanctuary with a balcony. Ushers are available to assist you in finding a seat. The parking area is large,  Children church is available.  A separate teen service is also available.  Many ministries are available, from outreach to grief.

name: The Branch Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
This is my home church and I just love it. It is small but the people are so warm and welcoming. They don't care your color, race or what language you speak, they will welcome you with open arms. The service is done in English and praise and worship are also in english. The music is amazing and I have been blessed every week. From the first day I walked in the doors I was welcomed with open arms and I felt like the people there were already my family. Everyone I have met has been very kind. This church already feels like home! The music is possibly my favorite part! The band is great and leads us through a worship experience. I really like the fellowship time afterwards too. The preaching every week is engaging and heartfelt. The message is Biblically based, applicable to daily life, and encouraging. This is such an awesome church and I'm excited to be a part of this church as it grows! Amazing community of young people that praise and worship God. Its a non denominational church that welcomes everyone 💗 it's not your ordinary boring fellowship place, you will be greeted by Groot from guardian of the galaxy at entrance then feel free to get your caffeine fix ☕
If you want to experience the presence of God and being renew in your spiritual needs just stopby for their sunday service at 10.30am. Trust me not, you will enjoy the praise and worship, got your spiritual stamina refilled for the week, meet bunch of talented people and as bonus: fun and friendly fellowship with yummy lunch afterwards 👍🏼
Follow the signage to get to the parking lot at the back and or there's plenty of street parking. Come and hangout with us 👍🏼💗 Praise the Lord we have The Branch Church for our family. Love the humble and hospitality leader. A very welcoming church. Great for for all ages 🙂

name: The Bridge - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
The Bridge Church has truly become our second home. My family and I have been attending since the fall of 2020, and it has been life-changing. We’ve grown closer to Jesus and developed a deeper relationship with Him, thanks to the amazing community and family we’ve gained by being a part of this church. It’s a place where we feel welcomed, supported, and spiritually renewed.

Pastors Mark and Rachel are incredible stewards and examples of faith, love, and leadership. We’re so grateful for their guidance and for the way they reflect Christ’s love in all they do. The Bridge Church in Chino has been an incredible blessing for me and my family. The minute you walk in, you feel genuine love and warmth from everyone around. The worship experience is powerful, and the messages are always insightful, relatable and grounded in scripture. There’s a strong sense of community. The Bridge truly makes you feel like family, where everyone is welcomed with open arms. The Bridge has genuinely helped in the transformation of my life. My experience at the bridge has been nothing short of amazing and has strengthened my walk with Jesus. I am truly blessed to call The Bridge my safe place, and home. Thank you to Pastor Mark and everyone at The Bridge Chino. The Bridge Church is truly a blessing to the Chino community from the moment you walk through the doors. We were welcomed into a warm and inviting atmosphere. Everyone feels valued and seen no matter where they’re coming from or what season of life they’re in.
The pastoral team is fantastic with teaching that is biblically sound and relevant. The children’s ministry is vibrant and inclusive.

One of the things I appreciate most is the Bridge’s commitment to truly building a community and creating personal relationships. Through missions, small groups, youth programs, courses, trainings, and service opportunities, they prioritize plugging in and making an impact.

If you’re looking for a church in the Chino Valley that combines solid teaching with genuine community, I highly recommend joining us at The Bridge Church.  It’s more than a place of worship. It’s a place to personally connect and equip our purpose. If you’re looking for a Christ centered, fun and friendly church with an awesome diverse community of loving people, The Bridge is the church for you. My wife, two daughters and I have been attending for over 2 years and we love the Pastors, amazing worship, kids ministry and the people! What we love the most is how the Holy Spirit moves in every service. Pastor Mark and Pastor Brock are wonderful teachers and are so intentional about allowing the Holy Spirit to guide their sermons. We are beyond grateful for The Bridge! Blessings.

Edgar Sorelo We use to attend Calvary Chapel Diamond Bar and decided to leave when the Pastor started discussing politics. We then went to The Bridge and from the moment you step in you feel welcomed and loved. The Bridge is an amazing place where all the sermons are biblical. Every sermon, class or activity is intentional. We have been attending for over 2 years now and definitely will not be going anywhere else. The Bridge is home for our spiritual needs. You will not regret joining.

name: The Bridge - Sugar Land Campus
reviewSummary: Love Jesus, love people, love music ? Casual, open,friendly great kids area, perfect for young families and those who love them. If your perfect find a different place.....;) I’m proud to call The Bridge my family. Pastor Kenny and Pastor Kirk deliver each message with such conviction and relevance to today. I have felt this change, transformation that I didn’t know was possible. Best of all, my children love Bridge Kids and Takeover, asking every week to go to church where they experience God through song, dance and fun! Anyone and everyone who feels far or near to God should come and see. Went today for a visit and to see my friend Jimmy and his wife get baptized it was nice. The worship was good and the actual teachings from the word were on point. The Holy Spirit was definitely felt I really enjoyed it and was so excited for my friends giving their life's to the King of Kings. God bless everyone Jesus Lives 💯 Kenny the pastor has a very unique delivery of Gods Word! You will truly understand if you hear his sermons! Love this church. So much and feel very Blessed to have found it! We go to the satellite campus and we absolutely love it!  The kids look forward to going each Sunday, so that speaks volumes about the youth ministry. The sermons are great for everyone, even if you have never gone to church before. It just feels comfortable, like you are home with family and friends.  The music is powerful, and the sermon is always entertaining, yet biblical and informative.  I highly suggest this church for all ages and every person, believer or not...you will find a home here.

name: The Bridge Bible Fellowship - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
As a privious Muslim who has been
saved by Jesus my origional Church in West covina was a training tour to prepare me for home at The Bridge Bible Fellow ship Church. I wake up every day asking myself
IS IT SUNDAY YET? This church publically shames innocent people without getting their facts straight. How can this church say someone is not saved without giving both sides?  I thought if you have accepted Jesus as your Lord and Savior you are saved.  How can this church say you are not?  When did they become God?  Only Jesus knows a person’s heart!  To publicly shame someone knowing only one side is despicable! I've attended this church since 2001 with my family. This is a practical, Bible-teaching church full of genuine people who care about each other and desire to grow in their love for Jesus together!!

Our worship pastor does a great job with the music as well!! Always a good mix of contemporary and classic hymns, something for everybody, Great church!   Awesome expository preaching and teaching.. plenty of opportunities to serve Christ!   We have Bible counseling, teaching,  youth services and much more!!              Come worship with us and learn more about our precious Savior!! I just started doing online and following.  Christian and bible based.  New pastors there  enjoying the teaching  revelation.
Great local church.  Encouraged by it already.

name: The Bridge Christian Church East - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
I first visited The Bridge East Years ago. I saw the advertisements and was drawn to the Bible-based teaching and practical Christian life ministries. Although I was raised in church and a Christian most of my life, This was during a time in my life where there was a lot of upheaval. I began attending The Bridge and another large church simultaneously. What stood out to me was how the church family reached out to me in a very genuine and non-superficial way. I was able to relate to their real life experiences in contrast to the other church I had been attending where I could walk in and walk out unnoticed. Since this time, my life has drastically changed for the better. Even though I have been a Christian and served on ministerial staffs and in lay ministry for many years, I have found a home here in an opportunity to serve in a way that I hadn’t before. The Bible based teaching and ministry and accountability provides the environment I need to grow and flourish and make a difference with the kingdom of God during my time in my generation. Our free will allows us to choose what we believe.  One need not work for NASA to understand what GOD says about LGBTQ beliefs.
Romans 1:26-27: "For this reason God gave them up to degrading passions. Their women exchanged natural intercourse for unnatural, and in the same way also the men, giving up natural intercourse with women, were consumed with passion for one another. Men committed shameless acts with men and received in their own persons the due penalty for their error".  And this example is just one of MANY.
ANY church that has the courage to stand for what God's word clearly teaches is a church worth supporting.

Again, it's very clear what God says vs. what "Man" says:

Genesis 1:27 (NIV): "So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them."
Genesis 5:2 (ESV): "Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them Man when they were created."
Mark 10:6 (NIV): "But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’"
Matthew 19:4 (NIV): "Haven’t you read,” he replied, “that at the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’"
"Ephesians 5:31,
New American Standard Bible,31 For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh. Church makes their own music. Small family home church feel. Very welcoming and firm in their beliefs of the bible. This is a wonderful church to attend, where you will get the TRUTH, about what GOD tells us about life.  They don't sugar coat everything to try and pull you in.  They tell you exactly what God says about things, like, love the sinner, hate the sin.  If you want a church that is just going  to tell you all the good stuff, and leave out all the stuff we should stay away from, this isn't the church for you.  Here you get the truth!  If a church is telling you its not a sin to be a homosexual,  then they are not telling you how GOD feels about that , because God is very clear about how he feels about that.  Everyone is welcome here, but only what is in the Bible is taught here. I had such a blessing of following God’s lead to attend this church while I was working on the Reservation as a travel RN while in Tucson for my 13 week assignment.  This became from church home and community from the first service I attended.  It was bittersweet to leave to return home to West Texas because as much as I was excited to return home with family and my home church,  I loved this community and why God was teaching me while being there on assignment.  I learned so much as well by attending the Patriot Academy Classes.  I will definitely return if I am back in town.  I would love to be able to tune in via a podcast or online to still be able to be involved.  Such a bonus to have all original music performed from this church during worship.  Straight Bible teaching and truth with nothing held back here!

name: The Bridge Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: Great church, Pastor Scott is 100% dedicated to God and to serving the community of Corona and beyond. If you’re looking for a church, bible study or just wanna stop by and visit with your extended family in Christ you should definitely come and visit. I feel the Holy Spirit here. Solid fact checking truths from the bible delivered to you in a simple yet effective way to give feet to your faith. I love the Pastor he helps his church in all that we need. Everyone is so loving and kind and has helped me overcome many battles and also helps me to know God for who He really is and how great His love is for us! Great place to worship. Pastor Scott always has a great message and the worship team is amazing. Very friendly family of believers. Great Wordhip and right on teaching of the word. We have come 4 weeks, loved the pastor & so many friendly people, young & older.  ❤️🙏☝️

name: The Bridge Church - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary:
Good people and community. Solid Bible teaching. This church is a Christ-centered, Bible believing church that made me feel both welcomed and appreciated. Not hung up on money, looks or fame, just regular people learning to make a positive impact on our community, and to love each other as family.
They really work hard at youth ministry, all the way from toddlers to teens. The coffee is pretty good too! This is a church that reflects the community in which it resides. An open and friendly environment that embraces people from all backgrounds and cultures.  Just good people worshipping Jesus together. Lots of opportunities to serve others and grow in the Faith. Every Sunday is something different with a rotating worship team and speaker schedule. Really on point l, genuine  and heart felt. Really good speakers/pastors. Crys and others always have a meaningful message. Very good worship experience as well. The lead minister is very inteligent and seems kind.  But the services are not timeley. Expect 1.5 hour services with alot of singing. Nice congregation. Good experience

name: The Bridge Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely The Best Church on the Planet!! Pastors Gary, Zach Martin, and youth Pastor Cory are such Wonderful Pastors. They now have 3 Church services every Sunday and the Praise and Worship at the Beginning is Awesome!. I've been attending The Bridge Church Murrieta for 16yrs now and It's My home. I highly encourage all who are looking for a Great home to worship. You'll absolutely Love it This church is an absolutely amazing place! Very welcoming and the pastors do a great job of helping everyone stay connected and closer to God. Thank you Zach, Gary and Cory for helping me on my journey in life! You guys have truly made a huge impact on my family and I’s life. Wonderful people, Pastor Ryan brings the Bible to life and the worship music is fantastic.  Absolutely incredible children's classes and infant care. Such a welcoming and awesome church. We had been looking for awhile when we came across The Bridge. Our kids love it and so do we. The Pastor and his Wife are amazing people as well as the staff. The kids rooms are super cute and they have so much for them to do. The Pastor also recognizes Military personnel and their families which is very cool. I’ve been there in the church for many years. I moved out of Temecula and I always remember the friendly people who help me through my first years of Christianity.. so grateful Pastor Gary is amazing also Pastor Ann, very loving and kind people🙌🏻

name: The Bridge Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: As a single mom and disabled veteran I've gone back and forth with churches and what I believe...That being said The Bridge is hands down a 5 star place to celebrate and love God and the bible! I've had my struggles and before ever setting foot at a service Pastor Greg and the church were there for my children and myself! I love these guys and appreciate they truly love the lord play awesome music (Dylan and Bobby kill it together), and the fact this church is there for the right reason and not for the $$$$!!!!! Check them out I promise you wont br disappointed I just wish I hadn't moved away Pastor Greg teaches us the word of God.  The music is fantastic and great people attend! Very caring people. Bible oriented sermons & I like spending Sunday mornings hee. Caring. Inclusive. God loving ppl who share the works of the Bible.

name: The Bridge Church Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church!!! Such a family feel, super welcoming and feels like home the first time you walk in. Have been attending for about 6 months now and I am so glad we found this little gem!! If you’re looking for a smaller church that feels like a tight knit community this would be a great place for you! Also, the pastor is very intentional about leading the congregation to grow deeper, so this is a great place for spiritual growth if you’re looking for something more than the average surface level Christianity. I was at Bridges Church on Christmas Eve, and I LOVED being there. The whole service was so uplifting and the people were so soul-soothing. Pastor Dennis gave us valuable things to consider daily, and there was a dynamic lady doing an awesome spoken Word. I thoroughly appreciated all the ministry staff and their offerings. I do plan to go back.😍 Pihop Monthly Meetings are here and loved the lay out of the church.... Nice people. Great visit while in town. Community here is amazing.

name: The Bridge Church Spring Hill - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome message every Sunday and wonderful worship set. Pastor Ian delivers such a wonderful sermon. One of the best sermons in middle Tennessee and it took two years to find the message pastor at The Bridge Church. My husband and I were first time visitors with my son and daughter in law who live in the area. The greeters were exceptionally welcoming. Praise and worship were amazing, and the sermon was life giving. We can’t wait to come again. Making this right to the point.
Pros
1. Worship is great
2. Pastor's teachings ARE Biblical
3. Nice/free coffee bar with a variety of syrups
Cons
1. Cliques
2. Welcome team horrible
3. Fend for yourself if you're new - you're on your own. No directions, signs, etc once you're in the lobby...swarmed by 100s of people.
No one says hello to you, unless you're in one of the "cliques"
4. Some staff are arrogant

Part of going to church is to feel welcomed, connected. I did not feel that here after attending many times. Still looking. This church started off great. I was there for 2 years and volunteered, participated in everything, went every Sunday, joined groups etc… So I was very involved. I was starting to ponder why I still felt the same as I did before baptism. I felt like there was so much more Christ meant by picking up their cross and walking with him. I saw gossip happening in groups, mocking other religions (especially the Mormons), your typical Sunday Christians everywhere. Realized I needed more and was not in the right spot anymore after I spent my whole Easter volunteering in the children’s room then when it was my turn for my family to go sit in service I was treated so so horribly by the volunteers that ushered people in. Because I was there so early I got to go up to my seats early. They had not yet shut down everything so they looked to be open. Well the volunteers came and closed it off without saying a peep and we didn’t notice until it was time to take kids to the nursery and I was met with glaring and gossip. When I asked if the upstairs was going to be closed I was met with a soul piercing glare and snotty “YES.” I just started crying and they were so rude when they showed us where to sit. I was there way before they even put the blockers up. I did not know. What I did know is if I wasn’t there early I wouldn’t get a seat like the previous Easter and all the other services it was open. Anyways, Christlike behavior would of been walking up to us and letting us know kindly that the section is closed for the service and we would of gladly moved. However I was met with an experience that made me cry all service and I ended up leaving early. It was great though because upon a lot of scripture study I realized a lot of things happening in this church aren’t biblical and I found a church that I can feel Gods presence daily, I have the opportunity to act on my faith in the way the Bible shows us. We don’t turn a sacred covenant into a concert (sacrament). We don’t show all the little good deeds we did all over social. We love each other and are kind to everyone that walks in the door. I think Ian and the staff are wonderful kind people. I just think that this church got so big so fast that it brought in a lot of ugly. I would just advise to ponder these things and hold a staff meeting with volunteers/leaders. I want to see more Jesus and feel him in our communities. I think it’s a wonderful opportunity here for that with how many people you teach. My wife and I have come about 5 times over the past two years, when traveling for work, and a built in excuse to see our Kids and grand kids, who moved here. Our Children  found the Bridge Church—and they call it their Church Home…❤️
☝🏼When we walked in we felt the love of God the very minute. 😇….The Holy Spirit is at work big time changing peoples lives here, and we will eventually call this our Church Home—when we finally get to move here permanently. 🙏🏼👍🏻

name: The Bridge College Ministry - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome south OC Christian college group. These people love Jesus and love one another!

name: The Bridge Community Church - Athens Campus
The Bridge Community Church - Cary Campus
reviewSummary:
A really small church, about 50 people. Biblically sound! The people were really friendly & Pastor even invited us to go to lunch with the group when church was over. He invited us to sit at his table  so we did and talked missions and Theological Training. A really nice Pastor and his family too. He knew we were just visiting once to attend a wedding, but we were treated really well despite that. If you're looking for a Biblically sound & really friendly but small church with child care this is it.
They meet in a child daycare, but it's a great starter church, so go anyways. Super excited about a Saturday evening service but no one was there. Met a couple of other 1st timers outside the front door but no luck. If anyone sees this and knows of a Saturday evening service please post. :( Great place to go and worship GOD and followship with your friends and neighbors. Very friendly and inviting place!!

name: The Bridge Community Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary:
So, I stumbled upon this rummage sale, and let me tell you, it was a wild ride! Picture this: prices higher than a giraffe's eye on eBay, a pastor who seemed to think he was running a high-end boutique, and purses that cost more than a fancy dinner. It was like a comedy show, with the pastor playing the role of clueless shopkeeper to perfection.

I waltzed in on the last day, expecting some killer deals at 75% off. But oh no, the pastor and his sidekick were there, trying to sell me the idea that their prices were a steal. Spoiler alert: they were still highway robbery, even at 75% off! I did manage to snag a vase for $15, which should have been a fiver, but hey, the pastor's gotta eat, right?

As I was making my escape, the pastor hit me with the classic "Do you want to know about God?" line. I politely informed him that I was already tight with Jesus, but he wasn't having it. He went on about his own journey from Catholicism and started dropping scripture like it was hot gossip. Needless to say, I wasn't vibing with his spiel.

I can't vouch for how the church is run, but maybe they should stick to Sunday service and leave the rummage sales to the pros. They had a ton of stuff left over, probably because they were charging an arm and a leg for it! And to top it all off, on a freezing morning, they didn't even have coffee or tea for sale. Missed opportunity for some extra cash, am I right? This is a warm, friendly, and family orientated church.  If you've been looking for God you will find the path to him here! A family atmosphere. The pastor is passionate about preaching God’s word and diligent about following the leading of the spirit. The service begins at 10 AM. Love abounds. Spirituality is the discovery of the fundamental connection that exists between us and God. Felt the presence of the HOLY SPIRIT the first time we attended this church & still feeling GOD'S HOLY SPIRIT.

name: The Bridge Fellowship Church - at Herff Elementary School
reviewSummary:
Our experience at The Bridge Fellowship has been so positive.  Our son, who is 9, has enjoyed the "Bridge Kids" classes the most out of any church we have attended.  He was baptized here and they make that experience so special.  This is the first church that offered us a "small group" experience and through this, we have made lifelong friends that extend way beyond Sundays.  We are so grateful to have found The Bridge and hope you and your family will make your way here too. We are so happy that we found the Bridge, and we now call it our church home.  It is amazing and growing Bible-centered church welcoming people of all ages regardless of where they may be in their spiritual journey.  The weekly messages are educational, inspirational and offer application to daily living.  The staff is talented and committed, and the congregation is welcoming and friendly.  Our grandkids love taking part in the children's ministry whenever they visit. We love The Bridge Fellowship!  The sense of community here is incredible, and everyone is so welcoming and supportive. There are also plenty of opportunities for fellowship and involvement, from small groups to volunteer activities. I highly recommend The Bridge to anyone looking for a warm, inviting, and Biblical based church. The preaching is really teaching — simply about the Word of God.  We believe that the Bible is the authoritative word of God.  Jared and Jared are gifted pastors and deliver wonderful sermons.  I love the simple mission of The Bridge.  To bring the good news of Jesus Christ to every person in the Texas Hill Country! What a blessing I feel to be a part of this amazing church family. Scripture is delivered every sermon and delivered in a very
engaging way. Lots of prayer and planning takes place in  everything and it shows. You will be loved and feel loved  at The Bridge Fellowship.

name: The Brook - Madison Campus
reviewSummary:
The worship music was heavenly this past Sunday.  Violin w Madolin, w guitars, drums etc...angelic voices.  Thankyou!  Praise the Lord for such talent.  The worship service was straight from the Bible as it should be.  The Pastor teaches, as the scriptures are reviewed.  Last week the Pastor stated John the Baptist's father was "mute and deaf"...my wife and I looked and never saw that he was deaf.  But this Sunday the scripture was reviewed and stated that that the people had to make "signs" to communicate....  meaning he was deaf also.  Always something to learn and this place of worship has it going on.  My 6 year old grandson wakes up Sunday morning and is ready to go!  Enough said.  Merry Christmas After processing my experience here I needed to write it down. This church is corrupt and filled with judgmental people. When I was struggling with serious mental health issues, I confided in a leader at a youth event, hoping for guidance or support. Instead, I was pressured into disclosing my struggles to my parents on a strict deadline, which only worsened my mental state. What made it even worse was that my personal situation was clearly shared beyond the people I confided in, as I was suddenly treated differently by others.

Rather than offering real support, the environment relied heavily on emotional manipulation, especially during services and events. If you’re looking for a place that genuinely cares about mental health in a compassionate and private way, this is not it. Great Worship Team!
Where the True Word of God is Preached.
God's Candle is in this Church.
Many mega-churches out there, this one is a shining light on a hill. I pray God will bless you and this church with your attendance. I am not a member but I
Love this Church. This is my favorite church in the Huntsville area.  Brian Mayfield is an annointed minister & the Praise & Worship team is wonderful.  If we lived closer than 45 minutes away this would be our church. Wonderful place of worship! Great people that are so loving, caring, and helpful in your journey!

name: The Brooklyn Tabernacle
reviewSummary: Historic multicultural congregation in Downtown Brooklyn renowned for its Grammy-winning choir, passionate prayer culture, and life-changing community outreach.

name: The Brooklyn Tabernacle - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Historic multicultural congregation in Downtown Brooklyn renowned for its Grammy-winning choir, passionate prayer culture, and life-changing community outreach.

name: The Burbank Church of Christ - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: We traveled to Hollywood on vacation and wanted to attend church before heading back home. We are members of a Church of Christ church in our town, so we search for a CoC in Hollywood and came across this one. It's a small congregation, but worth attending. Everyone was so welcoming and nice.  They made us feel at home. Definitely will be back when visiting Hollywood again. Visited LA and delighted to find a faithful church of Christ which worshipped God in spirit and in truth. 5 acts of worship including acapella singing. We were thrilled to find the Lord's church near Hollywood as we were on vacation.  These Christians follow God's will for His new testament church. Godly people doing the Lord's work. Great church to develop a personal relationship with Christ. This is a place blessed by God. And It is where my soul can live.

name: The Calling Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Went to Christmas Eve or candlelight service. Really nice. The people right off the bat we're welcoming. Before the service started, they had a hot coco station. Awesome,  I love hot coco! It was just the right amount of water to coco, too. Made my day, even had marshmallows, the tiny ones! What way to start candlelight service. I felt so good. The production was cute. Had the kids in it. Great music, sincere heart for the people. I enjoyed myself, but the best was the smiling kindness! I love it! Morning worship is fantastic. I love their songs. You can feel that God is there. Pastor Michael Alfaro is a real down to earth guy that you can relate to. I love the way he preaches. He is not boring. I relate to his messages. Very welcoming, makes you feel good and acknowledge besides friendly. Great church nice people. Enthusiastic yet knowledgeable pastor. Emphasizes learning the Bible, what it means and how to apply it to our lives. I like that politics are in no way involved. Neither side is emphasized die to the fact that it's the Bible and the word that are important not politics. Highly recommend . They have services broadcased on you tube as well. Amazing church!!  Pastor Mike with his wife, Corine lead a phenomenal church community with wisdom,  knowledge,  and passion!!  They are personable and keep church fun.   It is a smaller,  yet very supportive community. One of the best churches in Southern California. The people here are so genuine and Jesus centered. It's totally worth a try. I totally recommend this church

name: The Campus Community Church (C3) - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a church that inspires you to be the best version that God has intended for you to be. Being a part of this church for 4 years, I have seen myself transformed mentally, and spiritually in ways that only God can receive glory for.

As a man, finding community can be difficult, and even more so as a married man. But, this church makes space for me and the community of men here are excellent in their own right. The pastor preaches from the heart, the culture of the church pushes for discipline and growth, and an air of accountability and love is concentrated here!

If you're interested, and want to take the next step in your faith or simply interested in what we do. Please  swing by our church and we would love to get to know you!!! I first heard about this church through a friend who invited me to Bible study, and I was learning so much that it eventually just made sense for me to make the switch. Coming to this church is truly one of the best decisions I've ever made.

Pastor Bullus and Pastor Vebiang Gago are true "do as I do" leaders, the Spirit of God is alive at C3, and the people are so warm and welcoming. There's a sincerity here and a real hunger to know God more deeply that you can feel. There's no other church for me. I genuinely love it here, and my deepest desire is that more people get the chance to be reintroduced to Jesus through this community. I love my church! If you are looking for a church where you can encounter God, grow spiritually, and build community. The Campus Community Church (C3) is the place to be. Attending C3 has been life-changing and I look forward to going to church every Sunday! This isn't church as usual. If you're looking for a place that teaches the actual word of God with sound doctrine, a place you will grow in your spiritual giftings, a place with great worship and genuine people, then look no further. C3 welcomes you!! Best way to explain C3….it’s a place where heaven meets earth.  The worship and the word are 🔥 and the people are SO friendly.  Proud to say this is my church.

name: The Cathedral of Christ the Light - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary:
What a beautiful cathedral! It's a must-visit when in Oakland. Both the interior and the exterior are beautiful. I was able to attend the 12:10pm mass. It was a solemn mass. I'm glad that i did 🙏. Parking was free. A surreal experience as we had our rite of election of this year at the Cathedral and this was my first time visiting. I was in love with the interior and exterior of the cathedral. The architecture is overall breathtaking.
The ceremony was so beautifully uplifting and touching. The mausoleum underneath is also very beautiful. A very holy space 🤍 So beautiful. An employee took me on a tour. I had no idea there was a mausoleum under the cathedral. Really, really well-maintained and impressive place. Awe inspiring and hospitable to visit. We brought our kids in the afternoon while in town visiting family. There was a steward to greet us and the restrooms were accessible and clean for our two small children to use and get changed. We lit two candles and it was a memorable experience for all. What are the most thoughtful cathedrals I've ever been in. It reminds me in a tiny way of goudy's familia in Barcelona. It's like a ship design and it has some beautiful support facilities as well. It was open when I went by so easy access.

name: The Cathedral of Saint Paul
reviewSummary: Mother Church of the Catholic Diocese of Birmingham. Magnificent Gothic architecture, reverent Latin and English Mass, and exceptional choral liturgy.
