name: The Cathedral of the Assumption - Main Campus
The Cause Church | Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
VERY charismatic church. I’ve watched someone allegedly pray in tongues on the stage (with no interpretation), and I’ve heard phrases like “we release the Spirit (which seems very much like the tail is trying to wag the dog). If you’re trying to get the “feels,” then this is your spot. I sincerely pray that those who really care about the Lord and His people will consider what it is that they are doing, and examine whether these things are what He wants. Pastor Jenny delivered an amazing message today. I felt God really spoke to me and my family. God bless my home church and my pastors. 🙏 Wonderful place! Great in every way!! So grateful for the Cause!

Wonderful Easter service! Loved the Cause Kingdom Business Dinner! My best friend invited me and Was awesome. Spent few good hours self development and gaining valuable information! The cause church is such a blessing to Brea, La Habra and surrounding communities. This church is a great one! Keep up the good work family!

name: The Chapel - Akron Campus
reviewSummary:
We love attending church at the Chapel. It is so refreshing to hear the Bible preached every Sunday no matter what the subject line is. The presence of the Holy Spirit is alive and well in this place, and we are grateful that Christ is preached.
Our 6 year old really enjoys attending church class as well.
Christ centered, Bible based, and Family focused, thank you Lord for the Chapel and the people you have leading in your church Love this church.  I've met with pastor many times.  He's definitely made it clear he loves his flock.  He gives great messages from the Holy Ghost & genuinely cares for God's children.  It's one of my favorite churches.  They give rides for people who are in wheelchairs & can't get out without help.  I love this place. Sundays at the Chapel are wonderfully joyful. Full of friendly people and a pastor who delivers a meaningful sermon everytime! This church is amazing. Full of people who genuinely care for one another and want to see you grow in Christ. The pastors can be different depending on when you go, but they are always challenging in their sermons and want to see their people become more like Christ and learn how to live a set apart life. Can't recommend enough. This is a great family like church. We have a Chinese church in it.

name: THE CHAPEL at Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been such a great fit for me. I recently moved to Pasadena from NY, and the community is great. Above this though, the pastor faithfully preaches God’s word, and they make a great effort to explain and apply the Bible for our lives. This is the first church I’ve chosen to go to for myself since moving away from my parents, and I couldn’t be happier here! Each service biblically addresses a passage of scripture and how it applies to our lives, rather than the alternative picking-and-choosing scriptures that fit what we want to hear. I have been genuinely welcomed with smiles and meaningful conversations every Sunday, and grown in deep relationships with peers and mentors ever since my first time coming. I am so happy to call The Chapel at Pasadena not just my home church, but my home! I'm a single dad with two kids age 7 1/2 and 6.  It took me a long time to find a church where my kids felt comfortable and enjoyed going AND where I had the community and solid teaching that I needed as well.  When I heard that my friend of 17 years and my girlfriend just so happened to be going to the same small church in Pasadena, I had to check it out.

I personally needed a church that was theologically solid, preaching from the text and not jumping around scripture to make people feel comfortable.  I also needed a place that had transparent and authentic community where I could be imperfect and flawed and still feel like I fit in.  This church fulfills both needs wonderfully.

My kids also very quickly found friends there and often don't want to leave.  It's the first church we've been to out of half a dozen where the kids are excited when I tell them it's a Sunday and we're going to church!

As you can imagine from being a single father, I have a rough and messy past and that has never ever been a problem when connecting with people here.  Even though it's a reformed, sola scriptura church, there is no judgment for those that come in with some scars and baggage.  That's incredibly refreshing.  Come visit the church this Sunday.  It may just be the (imperfect but genuine) community you've needed for a long time. Very welcoming and loving church that teaches the gospel and tries to live it in everything they do.  Being a part of this church has changed my life for the better. Love the openess and sincerity of fellow worshippers and pastor of this church. A Bible-focused message and strong emphasis on community groups to grow in our walk with the Lord.

name: The Chapel Baton Rouge - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church right in the heart of LSU campus! We love attending services when visiting our daughter at LSU. I enjoy this place it is very inviting and looks wonderful I went to one of their services call the refuge and while I enjoyed the service I just felt as if it was missing a stronger connection to God and a authority. This is a great place of community and to start and or pick ones faith back up. Excellent. The pastors preach  Christ Jesus was crucified for our sake and we need to accept Jesus to be our Lord and Savior.  Invite Jesus in your heart today, for the day of his return is near. It has very kind and friendly teachers and staff, with a very quiet and clean place, they provide valuable and blessed services. GOD bless them💖🙏 God works through His people at the Chapel. Everyone should come be a part of the wonderful community there and see what God will do if you trust Him with your life.

name: The Chapel Baton Rouge - Siegen Ln - Baton Rouge Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful community of Bible believers striving to live faithfully to Christ according to the scriptures. Gospel centered, missions oriented, sending many laborers into the harvest while never losing sight of the community where they serve. This body recently celebrated its 50th anniversary and is going strong!

This is one church in two locations (Siegen and LSU) with a contemporary worship style (the early service is quieter than second service); a non-denominational church with traditional, evangelical beliefs. Always lots going on. Having attended for a year now, I’ve seen the heart of the body to serve all ages. It is a wonderful place to raise a family, and to meet and grow with others in a community striving to know and follow Christ.

The church motto is “Helping people meet, know, and follow Jesus,” and they practice it.

If those things appeal to you, this is definitely a church worth checking out! Such a welcoming church that makes you immediately feel like family. From the moment you arrive in the parking lot, you are greeted with open arms and happy smiles. Make sure to stop by the New Here Tent to get a gift and a rundown of where to go and help with signing your kids in. My fiancé and I have found the perfect church home to help us start the rest of our lives together. The volume of the worship band is so loud that any joy I may have experienced praising and worshiping my Lord is lost and I am left grieving.  Messages are hit and miss.  There's no teaching like I experienced under Pastors Donald Tabb or Dennis Eeingenberg. This a great family church. We have been going there for almost 2 years and have grown to like it more each time that we go. Friendly folks, no pressure about anything, just great kind people. Give it a try. Everyone that I have met at The Chapel on Siegen has been genuine and friendly. Their faith shows through their kindness to others.

name: The Christ Experience - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: A friendly, diverse congregation with a loving, knowledgeable & inspiring pastor! They even have children's church. And what a beautiful edifice! I’ve done every room here and have thoroughly enjoyed all of them! The staff are great and make the experience all the more fun! The church were you are loved and not judged. Come on out and visit with us, and see the love we have to share for everyone. The experience of family in the building was heart warming. A Christian community where you are loved, not judged.

No one tries to pressure you into believing but there are offerings of contemplation to talk and ask questions after church service.  Usually there is coffee and tea and light snacks and always welcoming new people. Very, very quiet and peaceful service with thoughtful intentions. Sundays at 10:30am adults, 10:00am children & Wednesdays 9:00am adults. Music on Sundays Beautiful building. Nice celebration. It was very musical. Lovely Wonderful people! I truly feel welcome here. reviewSummary: I've found that the Christian Worship Center is lead by a God fearing, God loving pastor, who enjoys spreading the Word of God. He not only preaches the Word, but more importantly, he teaches the Word. And when you need him, he is there for you. Come visit and worship with us and see for yourself. You may want to come back for more. In fact,you may want to join our family permanently. Either way, we would love to have you. Stay blessed, and keep safe. The messages from the sermons come across clear, and very understandable from the Pastor. I find myself not always understanding some of the passages from the Bible, but with the Pastor's Bible knowledge explains it clearly. Come out and experience it for yourself. You feel the presence  of love, family and God. If you want to grow  and grow with a church and be involve this is the church for you. Sometimes you want to go where everybody knows your name. If you want to really be a part of a church family, this is the place to be. Amazing worship family. Loving church family. A warm and welcoming environment.

name: The Church - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary: I’m a member of this beautiful community! 2 1/2 years ago I waked in and the tangible presence of the LORD touched me in a place of worship and forever changed me. If you’re looking for a group of people who just love Jesus and keep Him at the center this is the community for you. We are a church family and live life together!! Spirit Lead , Jesus Loving Kingdom Warriors. Such an amazing church that truly Honors Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

name: The Church at 1548 Heights - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I drive almost 30 miles to be part of this church because the community here encourages and challenges my walk with God. You can expect a warm welcome if you visit, but we hope you'll stay and find a home among us. One of the friendliest places we have attended. It's a place that is very easy to feel welcomed and have a real sense of community. After looking for 5 years this is the first church that felt like home. It's also a great place for young adults as that age range is strong here. Great place if you are tired/burned out from church and looking for something fresh and real. Went there for the annual Christmas Celebration and it was great to see all the kids and families having a night free of worry and problems.
The congregation there was fantastic and I had a wonderful time. I am a member and currently serving as a Steward on the leadership team and leading a Sunday morning Bible class.  If you are looking for a church to actively serve our God then come check us out….we believe in actively working to live a Christ like life and serving our community, the world and our spiritual family at 1548. After visiting various churches in Houston, my fiancé and I finally found what we were looking for at 1548 Heights. The loving, welcoming community is why we picked it & why we stay.

name: The Church At Acworth - Acworth Campus
reviewSummary:
Update: Been here 14 years now. My three children are growing in the Lord and we add new family members to the Body yearly!

Update: Been here over 11 years. Still loving it and these people are truly my family.

Been here for 7 years. Love the people and the presence of God is evident here. From the age of 5 (when my parents were born again in the mid-1970's), I have experienced Church life in MANY different denominations and with varying groups of believers, from mega-congregations to the smallest (meeting in homes), but I am now so thankful & feel so blessed to be celebrating 20 years of being in this family at TCA. Love these brothers and sisters! My 10-year experience at this church is too elaborate to capture all the details so I intend to only highlight the main theological points which I learned. I was not a casual attender during my time at this church but a home group leader and a very involved and committed attender. Below are the fundamental doctrines that I took away form my experience at this church. My aim is to empower you (the reader) to evaluate these affirmations in light of the Scriptures, church history, and other credible sources.
•	The knowledge of Jesus Christ as your personal Savior and Lord is insufficient for salvation. This is only one aspect of being saved and additional things are necessary for final salvation. This understanding originates from the idea that after the new birth a believer is left with dual natures. If a born again Christian dies with dual natures, then they are eternally separated from God. These two natures found within a born again Christian must be forever separated in order to be finally saved. The first nature is the “I,” “self,” “personality,” or “nature” which you are born with. That “nature” is unredeemable because of its connection to the first man, Adam. Jesus, the Second Adam, seeks to kill the very “I," "self,” "personality," "nature" which all persons are born with. The belief is that God hates this "I," “self,” "personality," "nature" originating from Adam. Therefore, a new “self” or "nature"  must be provided in place of the one you where born with. The “self"  which comes to the knowledge of God is not saved but replaced. Sorry for the redundancy of the terms associated with the “self,” but I wanted to be as clear as possible regarding the ideas surrounding human nature.
•	Baptismal salvation. That is, the literal immersion in water actually kills the very “I" or “self" you were born with and only the new creature born from heaven comes up out of the water. The self you were born with is constituted as a child of wrath. This nature is unredeemable and therefore disposed of in baptism.
•	A replacement Gospel rather than a redemptive Gospel. That is, God does not recover or “redeem” the individual person but “replaces” the person with a new nature which has no affiliation with a person’s self they were born with. The born again nature is viewed as entirely separate from the self/nature you were born with. To such an extent that the person is “replaced” rather than redeemed. Humanity is of the first Adamic race and is not savable in any way shape or form.
•	Baptized believers have no more need to bear a cross. The command of Jesus found in Matt. 16:24-26 is no longer applicable for a believer. Because baptism has done away with the old man there is no longer a need for a daily bearing of a cross. A cross is only useful for a fallen damned Adamic nature. The twelve disciples had an old heart and needed this portion of the gospel. But after Jesus' death, this command no longer applies to Christians because the sinful heart/nature is gone after baptism. The baptized believer no longer has a sinful nature and is free of cross bearing. The only denial left is in putting to death the sin lodged within the vile body of the believer.
•	Unbaptized babies go to hell. Because baptism is necessary for salvation, every unbaptized person—regardless of age—is damned to hell.  Every baby which dies is only of the flesh and the first Adamic nature and is therefore unsavable.

In my closing remarks, I would like to reiterate my intent to empower you (the reader) to better understand the doctrine this church holds so that you can discern for yourself how to ask questions and seek further understanding regarding these matters. Also, these theological teachings originate from an encounter with the direct audible voice of God or an angel. Therefore, it’s important to validate such claims and seek other credible sources within the larger Body of Christ. My one star review reflects the inflexibility of this church's finalities and lack of acceptance of different perspectives. Love this place and these people. Was there for 12 years. I left for 4 years due to moving and couldn’t find another place like it. So I came back almost 8 years ago and wouldn’t wanna be anywhere else. 💕 I have never been to a place where you can have so many different people gather and live life together as family and be in such love and unity with one another. Love this body of believers and what they stand for. The pastors and the people can not be compared to anyone else on earth.

name: The Church At Arrowhead - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I enjoy when sermons are applicable to real life problems. It is great to see so many young couples with children. I Have been attending Tcaa since 2018 with all 6 of my children and spouse we have had a fantastic journey with this amazing community of believers!   They really have made us feel more like family than my very own. We go here for Thrive education. No complaints so far. A wonderful place of worship. My church when visiting Glendale Arizona. Congregation is caring and friendly. Accepting of others outside their church family. Pastor Randy is approachable and sincere. I havent been there since May of 2018. Looking forward to visiting these fellowship in February 2019. unfortunately, i had to stop coming here bc one of the teachers for the student class put hands on my brother she grabbed his arm really hard and he was scared to tell anyone, but i really love this church sm i grew up coming here and even put my friends on, brooklyn is my bestie and we met through this church and pastor luke is my favorite hes so nice and funny.

name: The Church at Avenue South - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Vibrant and modern worship.  Strong biblical preaching.  The church is welcoming and inviting.  It is a great place for college and single adults as well as families.  Love worship hear. My wife and I have made this beautiful church and congregation our home over the past 5 years. They really focus on Jesus Christ and the word and for that, I am so grateful, especially because they don't try to change it. I feel as though my wife and I are on the right path towards eternal salvation and we are walking with Christ through the help and guidance of Ave South. There is still so much we need to work on, but at least we feel like we have found a church home. inspiring, theological, spiritually sound, influential teaching, and amazing community!  Love this church.  Jesus Christ has a desire to have a deep personal relationship with everyone, and this is a wonderful place to grow in your relationship and learn more about our heavenly Father Ave South is the best place to hear the good news of Jesus!  while our amazing Pastor teacher Aaron Bryant teaches us how to love one another  where we live, work, and play and love our community, and love your neighbor and volunteer your time, and talents. You can plug in  and meet amazing people there. Come join us 💜❤️ I went to a service one Sunday where the pastor spoke about how to deal with disappointment in life. He explained it very well using the example of a ferrous wheel. I learnt a lot that day. Imo, sermons like this one are helpful for the youth because they teach them how to deal with problems they might have never faced before.

name: The Church at Brook Hills
reviewSummary: World-renowned for serious gospel commitment, verse-by-verse expository preaching, and radical sacrificial investment in unreached global peoples.

name: The Church at Brook Hills - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary: World-renowned for serious gospel commitment, verse-by-verse expository preaching, and radical sacrificial investment in unreached global peoples.

name: The Church at Channelside
reviewSummary: What a special experience  I had at this place last Sunday. HOLY SPIRIT filled Church  no doubt. Preaching straight out the Bible word for word and from the heart. Couldnt have asked for a better home Church to be apart of. Don't get me started with the outreach work in the community their doing too . A Spirit filled woman named Lily is a big part in uplifting the needing in the area. I can't wait to roll up my sleeves and make a difference with them . Made me feel a piece of Heaven and the Worship 🎶 Music got me pulled closer to our Heavenly FATHER. Can't wait to go again next Sunday !! What a beautiful Church!! We were in Tampa during Easter (Did not realize it was so early this year - we are from Ohio) and we were looking for a Christian (Christ) based church.  Holy Cow!  We found the Church at Channelside in the Embassy Suites across from our hotel.  What a welcoming group of Christian brothers and sisters - young, mid-life, and old.  The message was all about Christ, in this case, about Peter and his take on the resurrection before and after.  What was really great was how at the start, a young woman explained to everyone, in simple terms what Easter and the resurrection as about.  The pastor gave a great sermon that really showed, through the eyes of Peter, how we are forgiven.  I cannot say enough about this wonderful group of believers and the Holy Spirit working through them to deliver the message.  Thank you, Church of Channelside, for delivering God's word on this day of our Savior's rising. Your praise team sang the song "Jesus paid it all" and I will finish with these lyrics that they sang:  "Oh praise the one who paid my debt. And praise this life up from the dead".  May God continue to bless this community of believers. When I moved to Tampa a few months ago, I really wanted to find a church that was easy to connect with and passionate about serving the community in impactful ways. From the start, this church welcomed me beyond what I expected. It was an instant genuine sense of home. Building relationships here has never felt like work, because everyone is actively and selflessly investing in each others’ lives. Growing with this church has been an incredible blessing. This is an amazing new church right in the heart of Channelside. I've had the opportunity to sit down with the pastor and leadership team of this church and they are an incredibly genuine and welcoming bunch. In addition to being a church that is focused on biblical values and teaching, I've also admired the many ways that I've seen members of this church out and about serving the community - from street cleanups to port support for tired and weary crew members, and everything in-between, this church really cares about our city and it shows! The Church at Channelside is truly such a special part of Tampa for me. Pastor John, his wife Shea, and all of the members at TCAC do a phenomenal job of fostering community. One thing I really love about the church is how they truly meet everyone where they are at. From the Alpha class that is geared towards new believers or non-believers with questions about faith to church membership and the CORE team for devoted Christian members who want to volunteer their time serving the community and the church family. I have found so much love and peach at the Church at Channelside! It is also right in the heart of the channelside area/Downtown Tampa, making it very easily accessible and walkable.

We found the Church at Channelside in the Embassy Suites across from our hotel.  What a welcoming group of Christian brothers and sisters - young, mid-life, and old.  The message was all about Christ, in this case, about Peter and his take on the resurrection before and after.  What was really great was how at the start, a young woman explained to everyone, in simple terms what Easter and the resurrection as about.  The pastor gave a great sermon that really showed, through the eyes of Peter, how we are forgiven.  I cannot say enough about this wonderful group of believers and the Holy Spirit working through them to deliver the message.  Thank you, Church of Channelside, for delivering God's word on this day of our Savior's rising. Your praise team sang the song "Jesus paid it all" and I will finish with these lyrics that they sang:  "Oh praise the one who paid my debt. And praise this life up from the dead".  May God continue to bless this community of believers. When I moved to Tampa a few months ago, I really wanted to find a church that was easy to connect with and passionate about serving the community in impactful ways. From the start, this church welcomed me beyond what I expected. It was an instant genuine sense of home. Building relationships here has never felt like work, because everyone is actively and selflessly investing in each others’ lives. Growing with this church has been an incredible blessing. This is an amazing new church right in the heart of Channelside. I've had the opportunity to sit down with the pastor and leadership team of this church and they are an incredibly genuine and welcoming bunch. In addition to being a church that is focused on biblical values and teaching, I've also admired the many ways that I've seen members of this church out and about serving the community - from street cleanups to port support for tired and weary crew members, and everything in-between, this church really cares about our city and it shows! The Church at Channelside is truly such a special part of Tampa for me. Pastor John, his wife Shea, and all of the members at TCAC do a phenomenal job of fostering community. One thing I really love about the church is how they truly meet everyone where they are at. From the Alpha class that is geared towards new believers or non-believers with questions about faith to church membership and the CORE team for devoted Christian members who want to volunteer their time serving the community and the church family. I have found so much love and peach at the Church at Channelside! It is also right in the heart of the channelside area/Downtown Tampa, making it very easily accessible and walkable.

name: The Church at Clarendon
reviewSummary: Pastor Danielle is truly a warm and God-inspired leader; however, the communication of events, opportunities to participate etc. are not updated on the website as reported during church. She clearly could use staff that understands the importance of management and accountability of the administrative functions of this church. Lastly, but very importantly, the praise and worship (as well intended and faithful as the praise team might be) is the biggest let down. The choice of songs is just the beginning of the issues, but the singing talent is utterly disruptive to connecting to God through music. It would be a recommendation to consider what appeals to people who are seeking God but are immature in their spiritual walk.....bad music is not a good start. God bless. Nice comfortable with everyone enjoying the service. Attended the Faith Media's 3rd video on Women Pastors...No. 3 Danielle Bridgeforth..close friend/family member was chosen for this. To others Pastoring can seem easy for those who are called but we received true inspiration into the direction her private life has and is now taking her.. A true believer.. Attended one Sunday recently. Nice facilities, but the community is cliquish and unwelcoming to newcomers. Amazing people amazing place I have been going to this church my whole life and they are still teaching me new lessons of life.

name: The Church at Estrella - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I were moving across country to be closer to our grandchildren. We looked at 5-6 different developments across the valley and were really excited to see a church within walking distance from a house we were interested in. We decided to visit the next day before flying back East. We were met by a gentleman standing in front of the doors; who informed us Church wasn't meeting that day because the floors in the Gym were being resurfaced. We asked what seemed like 100 questions ranging anywhere from kids ministries to what the Church believes. We were coming from a Church back East that was very much a huge part of our lives and the local community and it was killing us to give that up; We didn't know if we would ever be able to find a replacement. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted and made to feel welcomed. Everyone was extremely friendly and glad to see us and have us visit. I was even shocked when the Pastor came over and introduced himself and stood there for a while and got to know us; He didn't just do a drive by... Glad you're here the offering box is over there; yadda yadda ya!! We visited the Church several more times over the next few weeks and even purchased our home based on the fact We felt like we found a new home Church! We LOVE the messages; they are centered around where you are in life and every week it seems like the Pastor is speaking directly to me.
We have had several of our friends from back home who have come here to visit us and are amazed at how the message is presented and how involved the Church is in the community.
The biggest thing we love about this Church is, we can come and worship just as we are!!! Made friends with a few families that went to this church but was shunned when I kept turning down their invites to services, events, the preschool etc. Some people aren't religious.  Accept that!!!  Shunned!  No more park dates etc.  Also, people who pull in and out of their park lot consistently pull out in front of folks.  It's aggravating.  If I were religious, I wouldnt go here. I’ve been attending this church about a year and half and absolutely love it here! I have churched hopped a lot over the last few years and finally feel at home here. So much so that me and my daughters got  baptized and volunteer with kids church!!! I love how this church is community oriented and encourages growth! We have definitely made a lot of new friends and have a church family we belong to now! I recently started attending / participating in the weekly service at this church and I must say, everybody is LOVELY! This is a fantastic place to call home and anybody looking for a group of warm, friendly people to attend church with every Sunday should look no further. I came to this liberal church two weeks ago and this was my experience. MUST READ!

1. How is anybody supposed to know this is a "Christian" church? After all, the name of Christ isn't even put on the congregation.. That is like buying a new car, working night and day to pay it off, you get the title and it has somebody else's name on it. Jesus the Christ deserves to have his name upon HIS church. Don't you think? (Matthew 16:18)

2. I walk in and they're serving popcorn, snacks, drinks, etc.. Is this church, where we gather to worship our Lord and savior Jesus Christ or is this a block party?

3. There was a woman leading the musical group, which is a women participating in worship, which is a woman having authority over man. Which is not biblical according to (1 TIMOTHY 2:11-13)

4. The use of musical instruments during worship service, no biblical example in the New Testament giving us authority to do so in the church.

5. Whatever happened to the church having a dress code? I noticed a lot of women in short shorts, men in short shorts lol, and a lack of modesty overall. According to (1 TIMOTHY 2:9-10), women are to dress modestly, we ALL know what modesty looks like... Lets dress to meet Jesus, after all, he is there amongst us, right?

6. Preacher led the closing prayer, stopped mid prayer to keep preaching, kept on praying and DIDN'T end the prayer with "In the name of Jesus Christ, AMEN" soooo, how exactly was that prayer supposed to reach the Father if not through Jesus? (JOHN 14:6)

7.  I noticed this church tailors more to entertaining the congregation rather than actually teaching and discerning.

8. Apparently they weren't doing the Lords supper that day because "The Pastor has it set up differently so its not just a tradition and more a memorial" OK? So are we just going to defy the biblical example in (ACTS 20:7) of doing it EVERY 1st day of the week?

9. The person leading the Offering, never gave an explanation as to WHY we need to give offering. All he said was "so we can keep doing what we're doing" OK? So its not for the SAINTS in need? (1 CORINTHIANS 16:1-2)

10. If there is one thing I did notice its the lack of hard copy Bibles in peoples hands. Either everybody has it memorized OR everybody is taking the preachers word. Study to show thyself approved unto God.

If you are looking for a church that is ferociously jealous of Gods word, that protects and preserves doctrine, that doesn't deliberately disobey the instructions Jesus has left HIS church, then this is NOT the one you're looking for. The nearest church with these qualities is the GOODYEAR CHURCH OF CHRIST.

(no, I am not sponsored or biased, its God word, not mine)

God bless you all !

name: The Church at Kettering - A Campus of First Baptist Kettering - Kettering / South Dayton Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment you walk through the doors, you feel genuinely welcomed, loved, and appreciated. The atmosphere is warm, and everyone makes you feel like family.

One of the things I love most is the heart this church has for children. They take such great care of my babies and pour into them by teaching them about Jesus in a way they can understand and enjoy. It gives me so much peace knowing they’re not just being watched—they’re growing in their faith.

The messages are rooted in God’s Word, the worship is uplifting, and you can truly see God at work in this church. If you’re looking for a place where you can grow in your relationship with Christ, build meaningful relationships, and feel at home from your very first visit, I highly recommend The Church at Kettering. This church is the most friendly, loving group of people. The pastor obviously loves the members and guests. A very diverse membership includes people of all races and backgrounds. Just a wonderful experience. Phenomenal church with amazing music and great biblical preaching! I felt very welcomed as a first time visitor and pastor Ralph took the time to visit with me after! This is a GREAT church I love this Church! I can’t recommend coming here enough. Friendly people and biblical preaching… what else is there to say🙂 My husband and I were married in this church, before it was The Church at Kettering.  The building holds special memories for us but so do the people!  This an extremely welcoming church where everyone is invited to attend.  There are plenty of ways to be involved or if you prefer to just attend Sunday mornings and enjoy Pastor Ralph's sermons, I guarantee you will not be disappointed.  Our family is growing.  Won't you come and be a part of it?  We'd love to have you.

name: The Church at Lockeland Springs - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Please come and share the love! A very warm place. One of the best churches!

name: The Church at Nolensville - Nolensville Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly folks, solid Bible-based preaching, and a powerful worship service. All age groups with a hoppin' youth and kids ministry! And plenty of varied ministries during the week. This place is gonna outgrow their building ... And soon. That's a great thing!! A great local church implemented to adhere to the needs of the people of Nolensville area. The Pastor is a great Teacher, and Leader. Womens Ministry, Children's, and Adult Ministries prevail. Great people and, friendly, warm and welcoming. I love this church! Very well rooted in the Word. This Church family has been a huge blessing to our family already. just what we were looking for when we moved to Nolensville. A family, friends, support... people to do life with. Looking forward to the new building opening later this year but don't let that stop you from diving in and being part of what God is doing now! Fantastic Church family! Come see what Jesus is doing in and around Nolensville.

name: The Church at Old Town - Helena Campus
reviewSummary: The Church at Old Town is such a wonderful church community! The people are family-oriented, welcoming, and kind. Pastor Josh is awesome, and I have grown so much in my faith since moving here. They host lots of events that are fun for all ages, and there are many opportunities to get involved! Couldn’t recommend this church enough :) The Church at Old Town has been such a blessing to our family! The pastor has a way of giving real life instruction based on truths found in scripture. It is a very welcoming community that seeks to serve God and others first and foremost. We love our new church home! We love this church and Pastor Josh. This is a great church for families. They have a wonderful children's ministry. Helena is so lucky to have such a wonderful place to worship and we look forward to seeing what God has in store for this newly replanted church. We LOVE The Church at Old Town! Great place for families. Lots of youth/children ministries and involvement. Great preaching, lots of welcoming faces each week. We are so happy to call this place home! We love the Church at Old Town. It is truly a place of worship. My kids beg me to go to church every week. We love the community at The Church at Old Town and Pastor Josh’s Christ centered sermons.

name: The Church at Rancho Bernardo - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church that treats everyone like family. Pastor Jared's messages are biblically based and have challenged and convicted me and really caused me to grow in my faith. He and the rest of the team on staff are amazing! This church has truly blessed my life in good times and hard times. The men's Bible study groups are awesome here as well! CRB truly feels like home. From the moment you walk in, you are welcomed with genuine kindness and a sense of community that is hard to find. The messages are meaningful, the worship is uplifting, and there is a strong focus on faith, family, and serving others. It’s a place where you feel supported, encouraged, and spiritually refreshed every week. We are so grateful to be part of such a wonderful church family. My family and I have been attending CRB for almost 4 years now. Although it was a little intimidating at first attending a bigger church than we were previously used to, we immediately found a home in CRB. The scriptural messages from Pastor Jared and the rest of the pastoral staff spoke to all of us personally. So relevant and current. We look forward every Sunday to hearing from them. There are also so many ways to quickly and naturally get involved in the church. From Men’s Ministries, Bible studies, cooking circles, and even a pickleball group, opportunities are everywhere to surround yourself with like-minded people all seeking a closer relationship with Jesus. Jesus is truly the center of this church, everything from the worship to the message, always points to his love and grace. Pastor Jared has a true go first heart for seeking Jesus and always leads the church with passion, true faith in Jesus, and grace.  The worship team is unlike any other church I’ve been to, every Sunday you cannot help but feel the presence of God in the room. This is a welcoming church, a spirit filled place to grow in your faith, and a true community of God. Love calling Church at Rancho Bernardo my home! Since first day I attended a broken man, the Worship, the messages from Pastor Jared and Pastor Josh, and being a Go First Church have allowed me to grow and experience the love that Christ has poured over me!

name: The Church at Rock Creek - Little Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Did some "charity" work their a few years back. I didn't get a spiritual worship vibe. More like a mega church mall style vibe.  I could see how people would get the feel good endorphin vibe... to me that is just all flash, no substance.

But to each their own I guess. We absolutely love this church and have been several times.  There is no pressure to join and we are seriously thinking of joining and calling this our new church home.   The pastors are amazing and everyone is so friendly. I love when artists come here. So much more affordable.
Happy to see the 2022 K-Love Christmas concert. Visited for a Renewal Ranch program and a Jeremy Camp concert. Great facilities. We've attended the Christmas at the Creek event a few times, and our kids have enjoyed the tubes. Great facilities and staff.

The main reason we've never called this our church home is because of the senior pastor. IYKYK.

name: The Church at Rocky Peak - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a GREAT church for people to hear the good news and messages of Jesus!!!  The Pastor Michael Yearley is so incredibly caring and loving with his attendees... and has a beautiful way of explaining Christianity and what is required of a true servant of God.

The location and the church itself are beautiful too... but that is not the reason for going there... it's the community!!!  The people who attend this church are the BEST people!!!  They have both Saturday evening services and two Sunday morning services.

Coffee, tea, water donuts and bananas are made available for attendees.  Come by... join the community of people who are committed to Jesus!!!  Come meet the pastor who makes himself available... along with so many other resources to those who need it.

I myself was Baptized on 2/21/26

#MakeHeavenCrowded
🙌🕊🩸✝️🙏❤️🥹 My father passed away recently, and our family asked to hold his funeral at this church — the church his family has attended for generations. We've tithed for years, paid preschool tuition here, and have personal relationships with the executive pastors.

The financial administrative assistant refused us. We weren't "members."

Then we mentioned we'd be making a donation. The refusal vanished immediately, and suddenly she was happy to help.

That's the whole story. Our family's decades of faithfulness meant nothing, but a check changed everything in a single conversation. We had to buy compassion from a church, during the worst week of our lives.

The funeral will happen, and I'm glad my father will be honored where he belongs. But if you're considering this church for your family — especially for the moments when you'll be at your most vulnerable — know how we were treated when we came to their door in grief. I worked very hard to find a church that truly felt like home. I previously was a Catholic, but after having many questions about my faith, I stepped away and began reading the Bible daily for myself. I visited several churches in my area, but I never felt completely at home or as though I was clearly understanding the messages. That changed when I walked into Rocky Peak. Pastor Michael and the other pastors and speakers deliver messages that are clear, educational, and easy to understand. Each sermon has helped me grow deeper in my faith, better understand the Bible, and strengthen my relationship with God. The music is also beautiful. The musicians are talented, experienced, and you can tell they play from the heart. What I appreciate most is that the worship is not overly flashy, too loud, or in your face. The volume and lighting feel just right. The music, visuals, and overall atmosphere blend together beautifully, creating a peaceful, calming, and at home feeling that allows you to focus on worship and the message. The church is located in a beautiful area overlooking the valley, and the property is always clean and well maintained. The staff and volunteers are friendly, welcoming, and willing to listen. Before each service, they offer coffee and donuts, along with healthier options such as bananas and fruit bars. Donations are accepted, but there is never any pressure. Each service includes a helpful pamphlet that allows you to follow along, take notes, learn about upcoming events, and request prayer. After the sermon, there are also frequently people available to pray with you. I especially appreciate how everything at Rocky Peak remains focused on God, the truth of His Word, and how to build and continue a genuine relationship with Him.
I recently began serving at the church and immediately felt welcomed, encouraged, and supported. The sermons are also available online, making it easy to watch and follow along when you cannot attend in person. I love everything about this church. After searching for so long, I feel incredibly blessed and excited to have finally found my church home. God has truly blessed this church abundantly! The Word of God is preached boldly and faithfully—never sugar-coated—yet always without condemnation or judgment. In every service, Jesus is the only name exalted, and I love how the pastors consistently call Him “King Jesus”—a practice I’ve now adopted in my own prayers.

The pastors are humble, knowledgeable, and their genuine love for God and the church shines through in both their preaching and the programs they lead.

The RPK children’s ministry has been such a blessing for my sons—well-organized, thoughtful, and Christ-centered. Since we joined in February 2025, I’ve noticed a refreshing focus here: no Easter egg hunts, no man-made traditions, no compromise, no wokeness—just pure biblical truth in the worship, teaching, and programs. They even host kids’ camps, and I can only hope one day they’ll open a school as well.

Rocky Peak also offers so much for spiritual growth—apologetics seminars, encounter worship nights, singles services, and more. The Life Groups are wonderful, and the weekly study guides are a great tool for going deeper into the Word.

This is truly a church for everyone. If you want to grow in your faith, be encouraged in your walk with God, and experience a community where Jesus is at the center, Rocky Peak is home! Mike Yearly is the real deal, he seems to be extremely down to earth, a genuine human being with a gift for sharing God’s Word. He’s factual, interesting & his presentation is direct & relates to today. (I’m able to retain the message applying it to my week! which is huge for me.. 😉lol)
It doesn’t hurt that the church is in one of the Valley’s highest areas where one can sit & read or chat at any of several tables & chairs set up in front of the chapel & take in the breathtaking views of the entire Valley & more. My husband & I have been attending Rocky Peak almost 3 years on & off now & we love going!

name: the Church at Rome - Rome Campus
reviewSummary:
From real nice people to humble people. It's truly is a good church and some of the most nicest people in the world.
They make you feel u at home when u don't have a home I'm blessed to have talked and meet.
God is good I love my church! The community there is so welcoming. I’m so thankful to be part of such an incredible church family! Caring people that are all about helping one another through the word of God. Great place to worship- they love Jesus Love my chirch come visit look us up on facebook

name: The Church at Spring Hill - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Bible preaching church. Extremely friendly and welcoming. Great worship. One of the best Bible-preaching Christian churches in Spring Hill. I highly recommend it. A vision to impact every home in Spring Hill with the life changing Word of God. Pastor Rainer is top notch! We attended The Church at Spring Hill as new transplants to Spring Hill. We were so hopeful that we'd chosen a good church (out of the many there are to pick from) and were eager to meet people and create a church family.

We got past some little things, such as no one saying hello (other than a greeter) and the very loud air conditioning system that made it hard to comprehend the message. We get that things happen.

We were encouraged to fill out a communication card, and did so in a detailed way. We requested a call or even a visit from someone on the staff to help us acclimate to the area. We left phone number, email, and address. A week later, we got a canned email intended for new guests of the church. Extremely impersonal.

We emailed back and said that we were a little upset and that we'd asked for something more (at least a personal email). We felt unwelcome, and said so very politely.

Nothing. Weeks later, no acknowledgment of our communication card, follow-up email, nothing.

Do better Church at Spring Hill. You dropped the ball and that is incredibly disappointing. I’ve been going to The Church At Spring Hill for over 5 years now I and I have loved watching as not only the people within the church grow in their walks with Christ, but it’s also been a joy to
watch as God uses the leadership within the Church to build something that positively impacts the city of Spring Hill... especially in these trying times. The pastor is amazing, despite Roll Tide, the worship is incredible, and the ministries within the church have changed the lives as many. I can’t wait to see where God leads this church, and I am even more
Excited to be a part of it We felt so welcomed when we first visited. It's a young church, but very healthy and has great preaching and leadership. We love our church family! So thankful to have found it!

name: The Church at Station Hill - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
Most of the worship songs were completely unfamiliar and not very singable. I noticed most of the congregation was nodding along but not signing at all. Felt like worship was more about the band making a show It is a amazing church it helps me learn about god so it helps me get close to him I visited for the first time Sunday morning. After recently losing my wife I was looking for a ‘place’. The worship and the sermon were great.

What struck me is that not one single person greeted me or offered to shake my hand. Isn’t the greatest of these love? We went this morning for a visit, searching for a home church. Music was great. the sermon was very good. Wouldn't rule out going back to find out more about opportunities there to serve, and lifegroups. The Church at Station Hill is a vibrant and welcoming community of believers who are passionate about following Jesus Christ. The worship services are engaging and inspiring, and the teaching is sound and biblical. I highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a place to belong and grow in their faith.

name: The Church at Tuscaloosa (TCAT) - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary: The Church at Tuscaloosa is an incredibly warm and welcoming place. From the moment you walk in, you feel a genuine sense of community and belonging. It’s a church that truly opens its doors to people from all walks of life, meeting everyone where they are in their journey. The focus on fostering a deeper relationship with Christ is evident in every aspect—from the heartfelt worship to the encouraging messages. If you’re looking for a place to grow spiritually and connect with others in a meaningful way, this is the church for you. This church is important to a lot of people. They are affiliated with Genesis Bible Mission Training Center and Celebrate Recovery. God bless this church Visited for our niece's wedding reception. The facility is very nice and the youth pastor is the best. Attended their fall festival tonight for a short 10 minutes, till it was just rude person after rude person. The most unfriendly church thing I’ve ever been to. One man was so rude to my son for wanting to play his game, twice at the trunk n treat. Very unwelcoming experience. Immediately left. Will not ever return for anything. If you are looking for a new church home or just passing through and need a dose of fellowship with other believers, don't overlook TCAT! Excellent children's programs and friendly and welcoming members.

name: The Church By The Sea - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
My sister and I parked here for Tortuga 2024 all weekend, this is truly an amazing group. Firstly, I called in advance and they were extremely accommodating in allowing me to book parking in advance. Pastor Marie was very responsive & super helpful. The group working the parking lot all weekend was super cheerful & just a pleasure to be around. On our final day, there was a gentleman in the parking lot (I can’t remember his name, so bad with names I’m sorry) who was informing people who were departing that their bathrooms were open for us. This was such a kind and thoughtful gesture. On our way out, my sister asked that he pray with us for a safe drive back home (we’re from out of town). We prayed together & he wished us well. For context, Tortuga is a music festival notorious for good drinks, great food & an even better party. That being said, they could’ve easily been judgy and stuffy with us, as I know many other churches would have been. Our experience here was impactful in a such a positive way and I just wanted to share. If I’m ever in the area I would absolutely attend service. They made us feel like family & we will return every year. These are the kind of people you want to spend your money with as I just know they are the glue in their community. Thank you all & God Bless ❤️🙏🏻 Our family came to this area 3.5 years ago and did not have to go far to find a home at Church by the sea. This church is beyond welcoming, they are a ‘yes’ to anything this community needs.  Their involvement in outside projects exceeds the capacity we have in volunteers but it never stops them from getting involved, rallying whoever they can and they come through in full force.

Our personal experience has been so good I recommend it to anyone I know looking for a church family. The Pastor is such a good person and his love for all of us shines from the pulpit - he has an incredible sense of humor and brings light to a one hour sermon. His wife is an incredible leader, full of life, ready to serve, always listening to the needs of others and her smile,  kindness and generosity is boundless. The people are warm, welcoming and even if you happen to be one of those that wants to be under the radar - you can be! But moreover, if you are looking for a place to participate, volunteer, and lead - this is an incredible find. Most of all they receive everyone with openness and genuineness. This is a Christ- centered church that welcomes all denominations and lifestyles and their slogan — ‘where the less than perfect are more than welcome’ is tried and true to the culture.

Things to think about : church starts promptly at 10am. Parking can be tough when the snow birds are in town so get there early to find a space. There are two chapels and my favorite is not the main chapel but the side chapel on the right side of the main door. If you get there after 10, use the side chapel - not the main entrance so you can quietly come in and no one will notice 😉. There is a kids Sunday school and your child WILL make friends. Stay after church for a few minutes to fellowship in the courtyard- someone is always signed up to bring coffee and sweets and this is a great time to network or reconnect. We have been a part of this church for >6 years. We followed the pastor (who married us) here after he left the prior church we were affiliated with. Let me just tell you, it was best decision ever. Not only is this church like a family to us but it is truly a place to make you feel like "the less than perfect are more than welcome" (the church motto). Our children have grown up here. We are centered around God, children of God but supporters of each other. No judgment. No drama. Just wonderful people praising our Lord together. Uplifting eachother.  So happy to be part of this church. Wonderful church , people friendly, lovely and accepting of everyone.
The staff is stellar, inspirational and full of love, wisdom, kindness and compassion. They are also filled with the spirit and are very smart🙏🏻👍 You are more welcome than anywhere else

reviewSummary: Awesome church. Thank you for letting me participate Oct 28th We were so welcomed. Everyone greeted us, and it was a wonderful experience. Highly recommend the church. reviewSummary: I really enjoys the church life. In the church, we have no distinction between different races, age groups, or social status. We may come from different countries and speak different languages, but through Christ, we are in union. I appreciate that we meet according to the Bible. We also actively study the Bible and fellowship with one another. Many practices here are different but according to the Word which can't be found in other places. More importantly I gain healthy and steady spiritual growth here! Through ministry of the Word and the fellowship of the Body of Christ, I love the Lord Jesus more every day. Praise the Lord!

name: The Church in Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: The church in Chula Vista is amazing! The brothers and sisters are all like a big family who love and live the Lord. Christ is really seen in them.❤️ Every morning, I love how they have a concert. The problem is I work graveyard. I hate that I can't get any sleep because of it. Guys please! Seriously you're not the only people around. You're in the middle of a neighborhood!. 😭 A small group who is pursuing Christ for the sake of His body the church.

reviewSummary: I moved to Columbus one year ago and joined this church. It helped me grow spiritually and love the Lord more! I got to know and experience the Lord Jesus with other seeking Christians and would recommend to someone looking to develop my personal relationship with the Lord and pursue to gain Christ with others! Been a member for 10 years, great people and experience. Advanced my relationship with the Lord, and learned many truths from the Bible. Would recommend. Healthy teaching, growing church, warm and open attitude, loving atmosphere, high esteem for the Bible, church meetings in homes almost every night of the week, I could go on! I recommend the church in Columbus! I’ve been with this church for 5 years. I’ve stayed so long because of the love each one of them has for one another. I couldn’t recommend a better church!! ❤️😁 It is a real blessing to fellowship with these precious believers ☺️. They share and enjoy the same Christ!

name: the church in Madison
reviewSummary: I moved to Madison over a couple of years ago and have been meeting here ever since! I love these dear believers and it’s truly been a privilege to get to know everyone here. They encourage me to understand the Bible and love the Lord daily. Young, vibrant faces. Very healthy and wholesome teachings basic to a Christian life. This is a church of brotherly love. I always feel warm and welcomed. I love how I don't see people only on Sunday but we visit and support one another daily! Plus I understand the bible like never before. No longer is it so mysterious. I have met with the believers here for several years now. I have never known ones who love the Lord, love His word, and love people as much as those in the church in Madison. This has become my real home! Came to Madison few years ago from California. I did not know anyone, but the people here made me feel like home after few meetings. I am glad that I found this great community! Still meeting here regularly.

reviewSummary: Wonderful Lord's table in both English and Chinese! Wonderful! Praise the Lord ❤️ Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord!

name: The Church In Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church to worship God and to meet and blend with the church family. All members are encouraged to give their portion and to grow in the Lord together. I visited the church for the first time last week by attending the prayer meeting.  The Lord was surely present among the 15 or so that were there.  It felt very easy to simply enter in to the prayer of the brothers and sisters that were there.

The prayer was not just from a few, but all were free to enter in.  There were simple prayers of some who were younger in the Lord but very real and genuine, and there were prayers that seemed to me to touch something of the height, the depth, the breadth and the length of the knowledge-surpassing love of Christ.

I was glad to have been a part of this meeting and plan to attend as many additional meetings as I can whenever I travel to the Nashville area.  This gathering of His called ones is a genuine testimony of the oneness of the body of Christ.

Great grace by with you all! Great fellowship and praise This Church  gives you  the truth and the  reality. That God wants to grow in us all. That is so awesome.  Praise  Him  !  I'm  Home !!! Wonderful experience! It was very sweet to spent time with other lovers of the Lord Jesus.

name: The Church in Palo Alto - Palo Alto Campus
reviewSummary:
My experience going to this church has been nothing but pleasant. I started coming here as a young couple with my husband and quickly found a sweet community that feels just like family. Now we have a kid and we get to watch her grow with all the other children in an environment filled with people who love God.

I also really enjoy their “All Believers Speaking” meeting. They conduct this meeting based on 1 Corinthians 14:26, " What then shall we say, brothers and sisters? When you come together, each of you has a hymn, or a word of instruction, a revelation, a tongue or an interpretation. Everything must be done so that the church may be built up” (NIV). After we sing hymns, each believer gets to share something they’ve enjoyed of the Lord from the week. Whether it was from their personal Bible reading, or an experience of the Lord, we’re all encouraged to participate and share. Love the church here! I recently moved to Palo Alto 4 months ago, and got in contact with these believers in the city. They are so friendly and welcoming! I love participating in the all-believers speaking meeting on Sundays, which is according to what the apostle Paul wrote in 1 Corinthians 14! Here are brothers and sisters who love our Lord Christ Jesus and cherish the Word. Our family started meeting here 3 years ago when we moved from East Bay. The brothers and sisters were warm welcoming. I notice they are genuine Christ lovers and practice a Body life, caring one another in small group.

In Bay Area when people all busy with work, school and family life and is stressful and make people feel isolated; the church life her is very different. I always be refreshed and find true rest meeting with the saints here and be strengthened to go on in my life.

My husband and I are first immigrants in the States with no families nearby. My two kids(and their classmates) enjoy going to the children meeting here and build up spiritual habits-love singing chidren hymns and reading the Bible. The church saints are like our big family here. I am thankful for the spiritual companions we have in the church. Thank you Lord. I joined this church during 2020 and have been meeting here ever since. I appreciate the fellowship on Sundays and small groups on Friday nights. Each week a section of the Bible is expounded and I feel like I am progressing on my christian walk. I am happy to have found community with the saints here. I started meeting with this church when I moved to Stanford for graduate school. I really appreciated the care from the brothers and sisters there. They plugged me in with a Friday night group and I received much care and prayerful support through all the ups and downs.

name: The Church in San Diego - San Diego (UTC / La Jolla) Campus
reviewSummary:
I was in San Diego for a short business trip in 2022. I am so glad that I could attend this church which was very closeby my hotel. The people of God welcomed me and I could see the eagerness and thirst for God's word and His ways in everyone there. Praise God for this church. Great place with sound doctrine of the Bible , also very friendly to guests and newcomers .
Visiting San Diego from Ontario CA Each church out there focuses on different things. This one focuses on two:

1. Scriptural truth. They are very serious on helping everybody understand as many verses in the Bible as possible. They do it in a nice and mutual way by providing all kinds of materials and programs. If you’re interested in understanding the Bible, look no further.

2. Small groups. Have you heard of a church that doesn’t want to get big? This church is so committed in small groups, they actually spin out groups when they get big. (By big I mean about 100 people.) Some church goers may want to walk in and go out of a service talking to nobody. Then this church won’t work for you, but I personally love the warmth and friendship I built up with people who believe in the same thing through the small groups here. A church community based on the principle of mutuality, the Church in San Diego welcomes people of all backgrounds. They are non-denominational, but this is merely a technical matter. The church that meets here is lovely and family oriented - the members open their homes to meet "house to house". A truly sweet and lovely place! A practice of the church life on the ground of oneness according to the biblical way with the functioning of all the members of the Body of Christ for the growth unto maturity to fulfill God's eternal purpose.

name: The Church in San Jose - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary:
I had such a wonderful experience meeting with the Church in San Jose since I moved here 2 years ago. There are genuine Christians believers who both love the Lord and seek to pursue a deeper understanding of the bible. This is also the place where I found a home and family, and made some of the closest companionships since moving to San Jose. I would highly recommending getting connected and joining this group!

Bonus: The food here is also SO DELICIOUS! The church recently hosted a church wide picnic and the chuck roast was *chef's kiss*. The church i grew up in. Humble elders, brotherly love . Best of all the humble unknown the king of kings the light of light Jesus and his being prepared bride. So much love, I'm swept away in spirit each week when we remember the Lord by eating unlevened bread and sharing the cup of blessing. Hope to see you there bring your portion. A song or hymn or spiritual song. Each one has. I’m in awe. After every difficult week, thinking that there is no way I could possibly be filled with joy... consistently, this is my story... I was hungry and was fed. I was thirsty and was satisfied. I was empty but was filled to overflowing. The Lord’s presence is here. And the level of maturity in Christ among all the members, I’ve never seen anywhere. The deep biblical understanding of the word is not held by one or a few but by most of the members. The Lord is so rich here and His headship over the members of His body is so real! Since we moved out of CA, we miss our church friends terribly. We have 2 kids and they grew up making tons of priceless memories with their church friends. It was really a blessing for our family to be a part of this church for 10 years. The Friday night small gathering was so sweet...We are so thankful for them. I've been at this church for more than ten years.  I've grown more in my Christian life during this period of time than during any other time of my Christian life.  This church is people-oriented, yet is pure toward the truth, and there is a welcome family atmosphere.

reviewSummary:

If your flesh dislikes the church, you attack it and its brothers and sisters, which is to say, you are attacking God, trampling on God, and showing no reverence for Him. The consequences of offending God are severe; be mindful of your actions.

Original: I wrote this comment specifically to address the malicious comment below from Satan. God wants us to speak words of building up humanity, yet Satan is constantly trying to destroy the unity of the body of Christ. I have been in the Lord's recovery for 20 years, and due to life's changes, I have lived in over a dozen churches. I have never felt that elders have any sense of official rank. Expanding the enduring fruit is inherently difficult work; it requires much prayer, allowing God to pave the way, rather than using human notions and simply focusing on quantity, which is not what pleases God. This is a church unblessed by God. It is deeply entrenched in bureaucratic hierarchy; elders serve for life, thus the system cannot expand, change, or be renewed. The elders' positions are equivalent to "officials," and they are unwilling to step down or become new members.

When Li Changshou was alive, they were about forty years old; now they are eighty, even ninety, yet they still insist on not retiring and have not mentored younger co-workers. The generation that Li Changshou nurtured back then has now become the root cause of the system's stagnation.

Because this is a church unblessed by God, it has been unable to expand or truly move forward over the years.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
reviewSummary:
Best Church to go to nice people and care to hear what you have to say I love this church I have experienced a whole lot about the Gospel of Jesus Christ and the Holy Ghost. The missionaries are the best people I ever meet. I want to continue to study the gospel of Jesus Christ. That being said, I want to say some of my favorite things about this place were the close sense of community I felt.  The services were insightful and intelligent.  They were inspiring as well.  Also, there were always fun things for kids and families to do.  We would have get togethers every few weeks that some would attend.  It felt like a big family.  The building is very nice and relatively new.  The activities were usually a lot of fun and I felt safe there, like I belonged.  I guess that is why I go to church, to feel peaceful and safe.

I recommend you give it a try.  Life is pretty tough.  Going to this church helped me feel like there was something really substantial and strong to hold onto.  Good people. A happy place :) Late night prayers and thinking about some of the people who have helped me on my journey to accepting Christ. Grateful for the missionaries who called my phone years ago

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Aurora Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve had a wonderful experience with The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The community is welcoming, the teachings are uplifting, and there is a strong emphasis on faith, service, and family. Every time I’ve attended, I’ve felt a sense of peace and purpose. The focus on Jesus Christ and His teachings has helped me grow spiritually and strengthen my relationship with God. If you’re looking for a place to find meaning, support, and a deeper connection with Christ, I highly recommend visiting! I love worshiping here. Inviting atmosphere with genuine people who love Jesus and each other. The services are lead by the members and messages shared by the members of the congregation. Great Sunday classes for adults and children alike. No better place for families to spend Sundays together worshiping God. The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is the kingdom of God on the earth. Want to get closer to Christ? Come and learn more about the Savior and His gospel. A wonderful community of believers. Love this place. It is full of believers who live the gospel of Jesus Christ and give Christ like service every day of the week. I feel home here. I feel peace here. Grateful to have such a good place for my family where we can feel the love of God. For any who may be looking, come and see! All are welcome. This is more than a place of worship.  It is a community of individuals that support eachother in working to become more Christlike through serving one another. Everyone has opportunities to serve, teach, and learn.  The programs for children and teenagers are outstanding with many wholesome and fun activities to participate in.  I appreciate that the Bishop is not a paid position... he is a volunteer who serves because he loves and cares about people.  He does this in addition to his full-time job and caring for his family.  I do not doubt his sincerity.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful experience attending church here. I was welcomed with open arms and sincerity. I love the focus on Jesus Christ in the worship services. Sort of an interesting religion. If you fit into the culture, it can bring a great sense of community. The structure is setup such that if you are an active member of the community, they will be there to help you when you are ill, need to move, or a person to talk to.

Tribalism is employed in much of the dogma, which creates a narrative where if one doesn't agree with doctrine, or finds the truth claims to be false, leaving the tribe creates an end to most "friendships." It can be painful to follow truth, and it's harder when the members are taught to shun those who leave. The shunning is real, but not nearly as drastic as one might find among the Scientologists or Jehova's Witnesses.

Lastly, the truth claims don't align with reality or history. There's constant whitewashing of history to deal with this.  The doctrine will change to reflect societies reflection of the world, but it is always behind the times, always reacting never predicting. The leaders are never ahead of the curve, on the side of right. African-Americans, for example, were not allowed to be exalted in the theistic teachings until well after the USA had shifted its stance on equality. We find a similar shift happening with regard to the homosexual stance. This church is not a safe-space for any LGBTQ, and if you don't know where your children fit on that spectrum, I'd advice not bringing them here to hear the less-than loving dogma. I was baptized a member of the Church or Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints at this building; it holds many fond memories for me as a teenager who was seeking the truth and found it.  It is in a wonderful location and the people who go there are wonderful as well. Truly wonderful church and community with so much of God's love. I love the people there and their love for Christ and others is incredibly apparent! Very unique when it comes to LDS chapels. I love attending church here when I go back to visit my family.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Worshipped Jesus Christ at 10:30am Sunday Sacrament Meeting. Friendly group; insightful scriptural discussions. We visited this church today from Arizona. It was a great experience. The speakers were genuine and shared their life experiences and testimonies of Jesus Christ. The music was delightful. I attended the youth class with my teenage son and daughter which was insightful and engaging. AND, while it’s not the most important part of attending church, they had homemade rolls and cookies after. :) A very fun touch. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. What a great community of Christians they have here in Carlsbad! The community is welcoming, uplifting, and focused on strengthening families and building faith in Jesus Christ. Services are Christ-centered, with talks and lessons given by everyday members, which makes it very personal and inspiring.

I also appreciate the emphasis on service—whether it’s helping neighbors, supporting those in need, or creating a strong sense of unity. The teachings encourage living with integrity, kindness, and purpose.

Whether you’re a lifelong member, new to faith, or simply curious, you’ll find genuine warmth and a strong sense of belonging here. I went to church here and I was overwhelmed by the friendliness of the people here and could feel the spirit during the service. I attended an amazing church service on August 10th. The music was amazing. There was a violin/piano duet that brought tears to my eyes because it was so beautiful. Thank you for such a wonderful experience.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone is always super welcoming and kind. A truly Christ centered church full of love. There are mandarin, spanish, and english services with visitors of all ages and backgrounds always welcomed. One of my favorite places to worship. I'm at college now, but the amount of genuine care and acceptance was key during my growing-up times. I felt like I learned a lot about how to treat other people and a lot of truth about Jesus Christ and the power he can hold in our lives. Not only are the grounds beautiful, but there is a genuine warmth inside.  The people are welcoming and friendly.  During the worship service, you will meet families of all kind; single people, older couples (empty-nesters), young families, etc.  Though their backgrounds differ, their level of kindness and willingness to help you have a great experience is the same, and it is unmatched.  You will have a great experience while learning about the Savior, Jesus Christ and interacting with others who believe in Him. There's a weekly service for anyone 18-30 and it's awesome. I love going to church and worshipping with people in my age group. We go bowling together, play pool together, we have activities and a small scripture study every Monday. It's just awesome. The doctrines of Jesus Christ were taught weekly during sacrament meeting, Sunday school, and other meetings.  Great building.  Many basketball games played there as well.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Citrus Heights Campus
reviewSummary: Nice place, friendly people, genuinely authentic welcoming and interested in helpful in getting  answers to questions. They will invite you back, even if someone has to pick you up. Very willing to serve, membership not required, and they can come to you for service. Services are held 2-3 times a day on Sunday depending on how many congregations are sharing a building (9am, 12, 3pm, etc). Anyone looking for answers to Where they came from, Where they are going after this life, and What their purpose is on the earth will find answers if they come with an honest heart. I grew up going here and loved the people, the teachings of Jesus Christ, and everything good that I learned here! This place, what I learned here and the people I associated with, have blessed my life forever. It made me a better person!
