name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this church today hoping to find a little support, but I left disappointed. I believe that when God tests a church, He sends people in need to see how much compassion and love there really is.

I hope that God has seen what happened today and will give you more wisdom and strength to help those in need. A church should be a place of love, compassion, and support for those in need. Unfortunately, my experience today was very different and I left deeply disappointed. I love this church! I come to worship Jesus Christ and learn about him, and I see the fruits of that in the people that attend this church! They show love, kindness, friendship, and knowledge of Jesus Christ. I also love that there are free youth and children’s classes on Sundays as well as many activities throughout the year. Very nice church. There are lots of young families and other children to welcome mine in Sunday school. Good people. I was raised in El Dorado Hills, and I grew up going to church here and I loved it.  There are so many good people there who are so kind.  Nobody is perfect, and everyone there is trying to become a better person, but that's the reason I go to church in the first place - to learn how I can apply God's teachings in my life and with my family.  There is no paid ministry there, and everyone volunteers to fulfill Sunday responsibilities.  Church meetings are very well organized, and classes are both instructive and inspiring.  Teachers are well prepared and encourage both questions and participation.  But most importantly, I feel peace as I seek forgiveness from God during the sacrament meeting (the meeting where we take the bread and water in remembrance of Christ's sacrifice for us).  I know this church is true and has strengthened my family tremendously.  But don't just take my word for it - come and see for yourself! This church has made such a positive difference in my life. The people are always kind and welcoming. The spiritual messages about Jesus Christ are uplifting, inspiring and comforting. If you’re looking for a church that will help you feel the Holy Spirit and leave you feeling happier than when you came, this is it.

The building is clean and fresh. Feels like home when I attend Sunday meetings here to learn about Christ.  If you're looking for a new congregation, you are welcome here. I'm grateful for the wonderful people in our congregation who have become like a second family to me. I'm grateful for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, which adds much to my understanding of what this life is all about and helps strengthen my faith in Jesus Christ. This place feels like home! I've been coming here for years and it constantly amazes me about how much they willingly contribute to the community and individuals. We attend the 8:30am meeting but their are meetings at 10:30am and noon as well. I love the community we have formed with our fellow friends and neighbors in Christ. A great place to meet with other believers in Jesus Christ and to feel his peace together. Enhance your spirituality on your own and with others. I attend this church with my young family. Attending here we have been able to learn more about the teachings of Jesus Christ, partake of the sacrament, and be uplifted and strengthened by others. Here I find Christ and Christ minded people I can turn to in peace and comfort. Here in this place I can pray and receive answers from my Heavenly Father. I feel special here, I feel love here, and I know I am a child of God here. The light of our Savior Jesus Christ shines within these walls as we learn of His ministry and grace! Come join me this Sunday and I'll help you feel all of these wonderful things too! We have been attending this church building for several years now since moving here for school. The members have been so welcoming and have shown us Christlike love. We love coming every Sunday and learning more about Jesus Christ. I love being apart of this church family! Everyone is so kind and willing to help others. My husband works at the hospital and often is unable to attend with me. They have taken me in as family and have helped me with my kids, offered to help me with other things. My kids LOVE the friends they have made and enjoy nursery (18mos to 3yrs) and primary (3-11)!  Come join us!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Madison Campus
reviewSummary:
I go here every Sunday.  Everyone is so welcoming, it's very family oriented and they have great programs throughout the weeks as well.  I feel closer to Jesus Christ when I go here. Favorite place. If you have not checked out the services they hold here on Sundays, come and see. They start @ 10 am on Sundays.
You’ll meet the most friendly people at this church. And their services certainly help me to feel the Spirit of the Lord and be inspired to follow Him. You know I have mix feelings about this religion but I guess it depends on which stake you go to but I was at the thompson station stake and I moved and I was in the madison stake thompson station stake I was in was better than the madison stake I went to here long story short my opinion despite other people's opinions not all of the people were that great same goes for the franklin stake lds help me open a door to a whole new experience I think I haven't experience before they're not different from any other church some of them are friendly and some of them are close off and not friendly I think it's like that with any other religion or culture no matter how smart you are because they're use to their ways and culture so they don't seem very open minded like other churches and not sympathetic like other churches they don't seem to emotionally care and seem open to understanding how we feel and respecting our emotions and us honestly I think it's like that with some of humanity so this religion or people who worship this religion not all of them are that great including all other churches and some people in general that's my experience but if you're interested you should go and experience it for yourself You know I think it's rare and special if a true and real compatible companion comes into your life and no one decides who's a perfect companion for you only you and the other person decide that for themselves by exploring together and also it's not important and the most important thing to have a companion what's important and the most important thing is building a life that makes you happy people can't make you happy only you can do that for yourself I felt like too this religions or the people in the reglion had social clicks like other religions and societies like schools You can really feel the Spirit of God here. The people are so kind and so welcoming, and have really opened my heart in ways they don’t know Great place to learn about Our Savior, Jesus Christ, Our Father in heaven, and the Holy Ghost.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. This place has been around since I was a child and even before my birth and I have attended it off and on. I have moved away but now I'm back.

This church is for EVERYONE and ANYONE who is interested in learning more about the gospel.

I invite you, if you are reading this review and you have a family or you are single, come for a session on a Sunday in your "Sunday Best" or not. It is a place of worship where families go and so every one comes dressed some what in modest attire.

They also have a fun games night and youth activity days. My kids love this place and I love this place as well. God bless and I wish you well on your path if you are reading this. 🙏🏽 No better place to be on a Sunday morning. People are very welcome here I grew up in Los Altos and attended church services in this beautiful and peaceful building. It was here that I felt the influence of the Spirit of the Lord Jesus Christ and where I began my personal journey of faith in Jesus Christ that has endured my entire life. All people searching for the meaning of life and the fullness of truth are welcomed here. It was in this building where I was interviewed to be found worthy by my church leader to receive a mission call to serve a 2 year mission to Germany. I was also interviewed here by my church leader to be found worthy to be married to my bride (now of over 40 years), in the Oakland LDS Temple. Wonderful, life-changing memories abound here in the Valparaiso church building. Grew up in this ward and could not have been around a greater group of faithful individuals. Definitely come to church here and invite friends! **Update** The congregations are now English- and Tongan- speaking. The Spanish-speaking congregation now meets in Menlo Park.**  Nice people, English- and Spanish-speaking congregations. Building is nicely kept up. The teachings bring peace to me and harmony to my family.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I always feel welcomed here.  It's so good to have meetings again -even with masks, hand sanitizers and social distancing.  Don't be shy!  "Come and see!  Come and stay.  Come and serve."   This is such a great church. The people here are so friendly and willing to help others. You really feel like you are coming home when you are with the people here, they even have a sign out front that says 'visitors welcome'! I love my Church in Mission Viejo. While there we learn about our Savior Jesus Christ. There are classes for every age and lots of friendly people. As a Catholic convert I laugh at myself sometimes thinking of how much I love going to church now that I have the Gospel of Jesus Christ in my life come join us If you want to learn what you can do to return home to God after this life, stop by.❤️

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - New Albany Campus
reviewSummary: The young adults who meet at 1:00 pm every Sunday are such amazing young people!  It's wonderful hearing their insights and testimonies of Jesus Christ.  They uplift me and inspire me to strengthen my own relationship with Christ.  And, I love seeing how they strengthen one another with relatable experiences and open, honest sharing of their struggles, successes and witnesses of how the Lord is working in their lives through it all. I love being a Mormon. I love being around people who love and care about me because it makes me feel happy. No one has ever been hostile or mean to me at church and I'm comforted that I'm around nice people every Sunday. I feel the Savior's love every time I come and I love Him too. I will rejoice and be glad! We attended church here for several years and loved it. Lots of down to earth people. A great place to raise a family. The building is new and nice. Wild blackberries grow along the edge of the property. Beautiful place to worship Jesus the living Christ. The people who we worship our Savior with every week become like family. We love to meet visitors and look forward to making friends with you!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - New Orleans Campus
reviewSummary: My family and I had the opportunity to visit this church this week. I felt so welcomed and loved. The relief society sisters had made some Mardi Gras pins and gave them to us. The feeling of warmth and welcome was very evident and I am so grateful we decided to attend. Very welcoming congregation. As a visitor they gave me a small pin with purple, gold, and green fleur de lys. They start at 10 am and there is only 1 congregation. I would attend again. I have to say, my sis, her mother as well as others in Utah who are of the LDS Church has been a blessing in my time of need. I am a member who has some rough challenges with health as well as the health care system amongst other issues. They are what the love of Christ is supposed to be to one another! Angela York, thank you for everything! My sis in Christ.... Friendly. Easy going. Relaxing people. Beautiful I am a member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. A couple summers ago, I was on vacation in New Orleans, and that Sunday we came to this chapel for church. I have to say, that this building is probably the cleanest place in New Orleans. The members of the congregation were extremely friendly, and we were greeted by one the nicest women I have ever had the privilege to meet. It was the first, and probably last time we would ever see her, and she treated us like the closest of family. The congregation was diverse and, as we came on fast and testimony Sunday, many gave wonderfully sincere testimonies of the gospel. The spirit was very present during the meeting. I highly recommend this meeting house to anyone in the area.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
People were so nice and inviting! If you are looking for a church to go to this is definitely the place. The LDS church has helped me through some hard times recently with my dog of 5 years died, was really hard for me to lose her considering I got her after I beat lung cancer. Bug over all great place to go to feel welcome and to feel Christ! I spent a month in the city and this congregation was a home away from home. I quickly felt welcomed and the things I learned lifted me up. While I lived in Manhattan for six years, this was the chapel I worshipped in most Sundays. So when I came back to visit with some friends, I wanted to go back to this place that feels like home.

Just as when I lived here, this is a place open to members and visitors alike. Stop in any Sunday to learn more about our Savior Jesus Christ and to feel the peace that drawing closer to Him brings.

There are stairs and an elevator that will take you to the second floor where the main worship service takes place. In this hour long service we pray, listen to messages prepared by and given by members of the congregation, sing hymns, and partake of the sacrament (bread and water blessed and passed in remembrance of our Savior's atoning sacrifice on our behalf).

Second hour services vary from week to week and include classes for children, youth and adults on the upper floors of the building. The lessons shared here are also prepared and given by members of the congregation.

Throughout the week you may also find missionaries and members at the building teaching lessons and having mid-week activities. Discover the peaceful spirit and inspiring message of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints—a place of faith, reflection, and community. name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’m here visiting with my wife, and it is such a beautiful place to feel the holy spirit and to feel closer to my Savior, Jesus Christ! The Newport Beach California Temple is a place of peace, reflection, and spiritual renewal. As I approached its magnificent spires, I immediately felt the Spirit confirming the holiness of this sacred building. The carefully maintained gardens and serene surroundings create an environment perfect for prayer and meditation. Inside the temple, the Spirit was strong, confirming my personal testimony and the importance of temple covenants. Every ordinance I participated in strengthened my faith and deepened my understanding of the Savior’s love. Leaving the temple, I felt my heart full of gratitude and my spirit uplifted, knowing that I had been in a place of holiness where God’s guidance is palpable. The Newport Beach Temple is not just a building; it is a refuge where souls are strengthened, hearts are healed, and eternal truths are felt personally. Wonderful service, starts at 9am. There are hymnals on every bench so that anyone can look up the number and sing along! It brings a beautiful spirit to the meeting. After the beginning service there are individual classes for sunday school based on age groups, really nice to find friends of the same age looking for the same values When my wife and I moved to Newport we started to attend this congregation and were instantly welcomed. We have loved it ever since! The principles they teach here are digestible, yet invoke a deeper understanding of Christ and how we can be more like Him. All are welcomed to come and see. I would highly recommend attending. I have visited this Church every summer for 6-7 years now. As a visitor I always feel very welcome. Members of the congregation are very kind and inclusive. Meetings are very inspiring and Christ-centered. Great place for families with a nursery, primary classes, youth classes, and adult Sunday School.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m late to church almost every week because I’m still learning how to get kids out the door on time. X) Yet coming to this chapel is still one of my favorite parts of my week. The people here are so loving and reflect the love of God with how they treat each other.

The children’s classes are so filled with songs and lessons that strengthen their faith in Jesus Christ (my kids are sad anytime we have to stay home due to sickness because they miss going to their classes). The adult discussions are focused on the Savior and I always learn so much from everyone’s unique perspectives and testimonies of God’s dealings in their lives.

I cherish this church and the way I’ve been able to grow closer to my Heavenly Father, the Savior, and the Holy Ghost because of the beautiful teachings of scripture and prophets, both ancient and modern. I visited this LDS church with an open heart and hoped of learning more about its teachings, but I left with deep concerns. The doctrine here diverges from the true gospel found in the Bible. According to Scripture, there is only one God, and Jesus is fully God (Isaiah 43:10-11, John 1:1, John 10:30). However, the teachings of Joseph Smith and the Book of Mormon seem to undermine this truth, presenting ideas that often contradict the Bible.

The concept of an apostasy and the need for 'new' scripture is not supported by the Bible. Galatians 1:6-9 warns against accepting a different gospel, which I feel the Book of Mormon promotes by leading believers away from Jesus as the sole way to salvation. Ephesians 2:8-9 emphasizes that we are saved by grace through faith alone, yet LDS teachings seem to add layers of works and requirements beyond what Jesus taught.

If you are seeking a relationship with God, I encourage you to look solely to the Bible for the true gospel. Jesus' teachings are complete and trustworthy as they are, without the need for additional prophets or scriptures. My hope is that everyone will come to know the simplicity and truth of Jesus’ gospel found in the Bible alone.

I spoke at their podium sharing my testimony of love and was confronted by their state bishop and he gave me a very passive aggressive look and handshake along with grabbing my arm in a manner that was physically altercating and off putting. Such a great congregation. Happy, friendly, welcoming people worshipping Jesus Christ. Really cool building built BY the members years ago--somewhat unlike other Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saint chapels. Our family attended this chapel last year while we were on vacation, and it was a fantastic experience! Our little 2 year-old was having a tough time that day, yet she did well in the Nursery class that was available. (There were plenty of kind teachers, fun toys, activities, and even a play-yard outside.) Everyone was so kind and welcoming whether we were in a classroom, or in the chapel getting ready for the sacrament meeting. We have been members of the this congregation since 1991.  All are welcome to attend.  It is a place of refuge in a time when the world needs the peace that can come from focusing on Jesus Christ.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve had a truly uplifting experience at The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. From the moment I walked in, people were warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. The messages shared each week focus on Jesus Christ, faith, family, service, and finding peace in a difficult world.

One spiritual experience that really stayed with me happened during a Sunday service when the congregation sang “I Know That My Redeemer Lives.” I came in carrying a lot of stress and uncertainty, but during the hymn and the talks that followed, I felt an overwhelming sense of calm and reassurance that God was aware of me personally. It’s hard to fully describe, but it felt peaceful, hopeful, and deeply spiritual.

I also appreciate the strong sense of community and the encouragement to serve others. Whether you’re curious about faith, looking for direction, or simply searching for a positive environment centered on Christ, this is a wonderful place to visit. From the moment you walk through the doors, you feel genuinely welcomed and at home. Members go out of their way to greet you, answer questions and make you feel welcome. The congregation is incredibly warm and friendly. The worship service consists of beautiful songs and talks shared from members of the congregation. God’s Spirit was felt so strongly throughout the service.
If you are searching for a loving community where you can grow closer to God with kind, caring individuals at a church that welcomes all to their services and many activities, I highly recommended The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints. We have attended worship services here for 17 years and have grown in love and fellowship with people here.  Worship is centered on Christ and his teachings. Families are welcome to attend together and be fed by the word of God together. This is home to us. We’ve had too many wonderful experiences here to count. So many great activities for our kids. Great fellowship among the adults. Most importantly, the principles taught here have allowed me to build a foundation on the Savior. Wonderful experience, very inviting environment for all looking for a place to attend church. Family centered, highly recommend

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place for 18 to 35 year old single adults to connect, have fun, worship, and to learn about Jesus Christ. I would like to know the schedule of available services and when the brothers are available; I would like to attend. My family has attended church here for over 10 years. We felt welcomed when we first came and have continued to feel loved as we attend. I have had my belief in Christ strengthened and have seen the same for my children as they have attended many youth activities. There are two congregations meeting here at 9 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. to worship. Visitors are always welcome to attend and members are always willing to answer any questions. I moved to Poway in 2007 with my family and joined the local "Green Valley Ward" that meets at 1 pm at this location.  I've been Mormon my whole life and wondered what type of a church we would find in Poway.  The experience has been wonderful.  We have met so many kind and committed Christians who welcome everyone into their church family.

I've grown so much in my relationship with God and been given great opportunities to work side by side with others - both in and out of the church.  All are welcomed and loved.   I love this church.  If you drop in, feel free to ask for me -  Marc Davis. I have lived in Poway for 20 years and have attended this church for the entire time that my family and I have lived in Poway.  This LDS church has a congregation that is very friendly and outgoing to any person who would like to visit the meetings held in this building.  My association with the LDS members has been a great asset to both my wife and I in raising our 4 children.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary: I love walking into church each Sunday and knowing that I have an instant family,  because the people are so loving and kind they ARE family. I also love that you can visit any church building for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints around the world,  and you will receive the same lessons in Sunday school. There is consistency in the gospel taught here and it fills me with peace. If you want find peace in Jesus Christ go here!! This is God's Kingdom restored to the earth.  This is not a flashy religious service meant to please men--it is a reverent atmosphere where families and individuals will be able to feel and appreciate the influence of the Holy Spirit.  Services begin at 9:00 a.m.; 11:10 for single adults (18-30); and 12:30.  Visitors Welcome. Love this church. The presence of God is here. Good place for family and to gain an understanding of God, Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit. Teaches how to live life that is pleasing to God. This Church has a family history room for people who want to search for their ancestors

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Powell / Delaware South Campus
reviewSummary: We absolutely LOVE this Church! Our family has found so much of God's truth here and we love the focus on Jesus Christ as our Savior. It is a great place for anyone to come who loves Jesus Christ or wants to know more about Him. ALL ARE WELCOME!!  Two congregations meet here, one at 9:00am and one at 10:30am every Sunday. Come!!! Great congregation and feeling of family.  There are 3 congregations that meet at this building at different times so come and enjoy this family atmosphere and friendly fellowship.  Everyone was super welcoming and loving and genuinely wanted to get to know our family.  We have been here 3 years now.  If you are looking for a place to worship our Savior Jesus Christ with friends and family or are new to the area like we were come and check it out! This place is amazing! The members of the congregation are so kind and incredible. This church is a perfect place for my family and I to worship the Lord and feel His peace. Wonderful people and a very welcoming atmosphere. The missionaries are great! Moved across the country 10 years ago and was welcomed into the congregation with open arms. I SO appreciate the opportunity to gather with fellow saints every week and feel the Spirit. So glad we've found a way to keep meetings going with Zoom during the pandemic.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Walking into our church building each Sunday makes me feel happy.  I love worshipping my Savior, Jesus Christ, with the unity of friends and neighbors that surround me and my family.  We help one another, serve one another, and strengthen one another just as Christ would do.  My husband and I are so grateful for the volunteer leaders that teach our children through example, music and scripture reading. It takes a village to raise children and I wouldn't want to be apart of any other community than right here. Through my experiences at this church, my faith in Christ has grown significantly.  Myself, my husband, and my children have been blessed by the service of the members of this church, and by the Christ-based doctrine taught at the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.  The members there are very friendly and welcoming, and really want the best for all.  The activities for the youth help them to stand strong with good morals.  The youth there are very impressive, and a great influence.  My children are fortunate to spend time with other youth who have high standards. My friend was moving out of his place just off Capital Boulevard today and two very nice young gentlemen saw us moving a couch off the second floor and offered to help. They were so kind to help us move for half an hour or so and really showed what a Christian should act like. Honestly I would give more than five stars if I could. I don't remember their last names but I asked for their first names and I believe they said Hunter and Christian. Outstanding young gentlemen. I love this place! A reverent community centered on Jesus Christ. Family friendly. All are welcome. Typically, multiple worship services on Sundays, but almost always one at 9am. Come and experience for yourself. While i was on vacation, they left a flier on my door - flattened on the door and slid between the crack. Some rains came and stuck the flier to my door. When i got home I had to clean and touch up the door to undo the damage.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
All of the people are so welcoming and kind! The BEST place tobe on Sunday between 9-11am I visit this Church a few weeks ago as I was invited.
I found it to be warm, very nice Folks.
Some folks welcome me with good morning, some with just smiles I can't say I seen one person that wasn't smiling.
It was a different  atlas for me yet I enjoyed the class .
I'm glad I got to experience a different  denomination and it was several different nationality which I thought was Awesome.
THANKS FOR THE WARM WELCOMES BY SO MANY.

A.HENDERSON My favorite place to be on the lords day, a wonderful community of believers and true disciples of christ. The lords spirit rests here abundantly. My family and I have been worshiping here for years. I’m grateful for the messages shared and the good people who are part of my village raising my children. Probably the greatest place to be on a Sunday from 11:30 to 1:30

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: This building is gorgeous! And more importantly the people are so nice and welcoming. The feeling when you walk in is one in a million. Definitely should join us! Have felt so welcomed ever since we arrived in 2020.  So thankful that my faith (and my family’s faith) in Christ has grown here. Such a Christ centered church with an amazing group of people. Everyone was so kind and I learned so much here. I love this church so much!! I felt so welcomed and appreciated and it was the perfect way to start my week. The congregation here is very friendly. I really felt at home, even though I don't live here. Also, the view from this church is to amazing, and the the building is very beautiful as well. The pastor was very kind, and does it all without getting paid. I would definitely go back. It is a great place on sundays to feel peace from my troubles and learn about Jesus Christ! The people here are great!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Diego (Rancho Bernardo) Campus
reviewSummary:
There are two Wards (congregations) that meet in this building.
One at 9 am, and the other at 10:30. Each Ward in the church is under the same global leadership. Hence, they are very much the same anywhere in the world. No paid clergy, no fancy outfits, just plain people like the rest of us. No paid choir; every member, young and old, gets to sing and worship through song. Check it out: "all are welcome." I love it here!  It is a truly sacred, warm and welcoming place where they worship Jesus as the living Christ.  I feel the Holy Ghost during the services which include the holy sacrament, traditional and new Christian hymns, inspiring talks prepared by members, all with a strong focus on Jesus Christ. It’s a lay ministry—no paid preacher—and donations are private, with a monthly worldwide fast to support those in need.

I love the two-hour Sunday format: the first hour is for family worship and sacrament, and the second for uplifting classes, a robust youth group and a vibrant primary. The Bible and Book of Mormon are both honored as sacred scripture, and the global church is led by a living prophet and apostles.

The Relief Society (the world’s oldest women’s organization), the youth speakers, and the beautiful artwork of Christ throughout the building make this a place of faith, love, and growth. I truly look forward to coming each week. I love coming to Church here. As a single and foreign person, I know sometimes it can be intimidating going to a new Church. I have found so much kindness coming here, and I feel closer to God's love. I feel better coming here than doing any other activities on a Sunday morning. I love this church. It is very welcoming and my kids love attending every week. They have a great youth group. They teach from the Bible and teach of Jesus Christ’s life. This Church believes in Christ and testifies of Him everytime I come. We believe that Jesus died on the cross and rose again on the 3rd day. He is our Savior. I love the spirit I feel here. Come! All are welcome! I feel close to God when I attend church here. The congregation is so friendly and embraces everyone. You will quickly recognize the love Jesus has for you through the people in this building. Jesus is real and loves us. He suffered and died so that we can repent and live with Heavenly parents again. The doctrine taught in this church will help you recognize the spirit of God in your life.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary: This is an amazing place to come learn of Jesus Christ and His restored gospel. Without a doubt the second you step into the building you will feel of His Spirit and be surrounded by the most incredible people. This place is awesome! I love going to church and feeling the love of our Heavenly Father! This is the place to learn about Jesus Christ and His beautiful gospel. The people strive to live Christs teachings and serve one another. However, just come and see for yourself. Come with an open mind and heart. Seek to meet new people and push outside of your comfort zone to make new friends. We get out of life what we put into it. We recently moved into the area, I was surprised by the number of young families in the congregation! Despite COVID, we've really felt welcomed. We're meeting virtually and all the speakers have been great. I have been impressed with the youth speakers in particular. The Bishop is kind and earnest, and the focus of all our learning is Jesus Christ and His doctrine. Highly recommend. This church is more than just a church, the food here is great with excellent service. Like seriously my waiter was great and they were super well dressed. I believe it is the only other place besides McDonalds to offer the Travis Scott Burger©, which is honestly really cool. Besides being just restaurant, the dentist here is absolutely phenomenal from what i've seen so far. I haven't gotten my teeth done from him yet, but so far he looks to be a really friendly guy. Another thing here I still have to try but I recommend to others would be their PC building program. One of family members got their PC fixed and modified there a few months ago and now it works better than it ever had before. It looks like they also got the best deals around too. Another thing i've heard about here is something about wormholes too, but I guess i'll have to look into that more. Like who wouldn't want to go to another dimension, that sounds so cool. Apparently there's other stuff this church also has to offer, but I guess I'll find out more about the other amenities the next time I visit. this place is very easily 5/5, i'd love to come by another time for all the stuff offered

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful congregation that went out of their way to help us feel welcome. We experienced a worshipful Sacrament service followed by a Sunday School lesson that was well prepared and informative. We felt the love of the Savior Jesus Christ while there. While stationed at the Presidio of San Francisco about 1972, I helped cut firewood for building fund for this chapel. Elder Parker is giving a report from his mission, serving for a time in San Rafael, returning to Augusta, GA, area (Aiken, SC). Is the LDS church getting larger, or smaller? I think the Church is getting larger, the world smaller. Has been a special place for my family and I to meet wonderful people while learning about and following Jesus Christ. Very friendly congregations--one English; one Spanish. This is a good crowd to associate with. Check it out.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Loved that there was parking. Nice church building, friendly atmosphere and great sunday message of staying true to your values and living a Christ centered life. The children sang beautifully in their class. Would highly recommend! This historic meetinghouse was built in 1923. It stands as one of the oldest buildings in Santa Monica.The congregation still holds worship services every Sunday at 10am. All visitors are welcome. Big yes. Christ lives in our community and it so happens I know. Believe me a real church with real Saints for the new space our world is traveling'* lies with in these doors. The church is accommodating to all. Very nice members and family oriented This church is a great place to bring family and friends.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful place of worship where families or individuals can come and feel the love of Jesus Christ. The members who attend are amazing, friendly, and genuine people. I love coming each Sunday and learning with devoted Christians. Bishop Marsh and his counselors are are Great.  Lakeside Ward Brother and Sisters are Great. . Fabulous to go to leave the world behind and feel safe.
Come on by for a visit! !! Very nice church building of the Church of Jesus Christ of latter-day saints, services are at 9am and 11am, everyone is friendly and anyone can come. The services last 3 hours. Very friendly group, very welcoming. A great place to learn of Jesus and feel His peace. Wonderful people, worth it to check it out but be sure to dig deep into the church. Sometimes wolves are in sheep’s clothing...

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: This is absolutely amazing Christian church in the Tustin area. the members are so friendly and caring. I remember when I first time look for a Christian church while I first come to this country. Some member from Utah connect me with the local members and they immediately get contacted with me that time and invited me to go to their BBQ activity. that was an amazing experience. I met wonderful people in that activity. They have so many different activities held for youth for women and man. Sunday sacrament meeting are so spiritual. after the meeting, always feel so full at my heart. They have so many different branches which speaks different languages. Definitely check it out if you are interested learning Jesus Christ. My church is the truest Church ever . I love Sunday school and relief society both to day is fast and testomony day . I really wanted to maybe because I didn't fast .  Overall one good day .....bless our fast we 🙏 pray . I have been attending the Red Hill Ward (congregation) since 1996!  We have raised our kids here & now are close to retiring!  We were welcomed in & enjoy doing the same for others.  Church starts at 9am every Sunday.  The meetings are Christ centered & we strive to live a Christ centered life.    We overlap meetings in our building with the Chinese branch so the children (18 months up to 11 yrs old) & youth (12-18 yrs old) can attend in English.  Tustin Meadows Ward currently meets at 1pm.  We have many friends in each of the congregations & hope you will come & join us! I have been meeting in this building for Christ-centered Sunday church services for over 20 years.  We also have fun youth activities during the week in this building.  The people are friendly and very welcoming. I love the Red Hill Ward congregation. I’ve been attending this congregation for more than 25 years. It feels like family—the functional kind 😃. I always leave this place feeling better than when I entered. Today’s Sacrament Meeting was powerful. A woman leader gave an amazing talk about our Savior’s love, grace and healing power!  Then we sang the Hymn, I Know My Redeemer Lives. Really a soul-stirring way to close the meeting!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary:

I would enjoy seeing everyone.  Amy Franklin, Alex,Max,Diana Storm,Roger Storm. Amazing church! The services held at the Westlake congregation are wonderful. The music is always beautiful and the lessons given are always uplifting. They encourage me to be a better person. The people are so friendly there. I have attended church in this building since I was a child. I would strongly encourage you to attend the Westlake ward of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saints. The lords'house is my home away from home. Where i can receive gods message that will carry me through the week. Until the next sunday, when i can renew my covenant with the lord again, receive his new message and share this blessings with the brothets and sister in the church, aswell as with the beautyfull children's that i teach in the nursery on sunday.
I invite everyone that would like to hear the lords message and feel renewed, to come and visit us on sundays at 9:30 am. At the Church of Jesuschrist of Latter Day Saints.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: By going to this church I have found peace and direction in my life.  I'm so excited to go here every week and learn more about Jesus Christ and his restored church.  I promise you that by attending church here you will have a happier and more meaningful life.  Come and see!  We love visitors and everyone is welcome. I hope to meet you soon. Awesome youth ages 4 through 18 and adults all ages in Woodland Hills -  If you want make friends and feel uplifted and enrich your life while going through struggles, this is the place. You can join a Childrens Chorus, Youth Chorus, or Adult Choir at this church, too. All are welcome. This building has been there for probably over 50 years as a church building. Very clear and well kept. The landscaping is beautiful. There are special programs throughout to year but especially during the holidays! Enjoy!! These are the most un-welcoming and most judgmental people I’ve ever encountered. This is not Christ’s church or people. I came here right after I went through my divorce and they were aggressively judgmental and would not let me be part of the ward. What a unified church!  These people are so friendly and loving.  It is a great church for anyone who wants to be somewhere where they feel loved.  They have great meetings and activities.

name: The Church Of Our Saviour and The Holy Apostles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely community, very friendly and welcoming. Without Google, it is impossible to find. There is no sign outside mentioning that inside the Anglican church is also a Romanian church. We will be back. We live over 50 miles away and would still go almost every Sunday. The warm friendly faces, the pure love of humanity, and the feeling of God's presence are within the walls. I love learning and visiting other churches throughout my life, but Church Of Our Saviour and The Holy Apostles will be where I picture myself when I pray. Much Love to all the parishioners and priests! *Hugs DMA+* Amazing atmosphere, great energy and good people! Beautiful Christian Orthodox ceremonies 11.30 am- 1.30 pm on Sundays ( Romanian and English languages).
Thank you for the food too! The ladies who cook for everyone and bring food every Sunday are angels!!! NOTE this is not an episcopal church, it is something more traditional, more historic, it is the Anglican Provence of Christ the King, but still a fantastic and welcoming church and religion! Blessing to all The people of the church are very nice.  Ambiance is lovely.

name: The Church of The Apostles - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. They speak the truth and stick to the principles in the Bible. You can feel the holy spirit during worship and the pastors love for Jesus. It is a warm and inviting place and I appreciate everyone at this church thst give their time and service. I, my wife and my family have been tremendously blessed by Dr. Youssef, Paul Reeves, Connie Musselman, Bruce Cerbone, Slate Fluker - Cross currents staff, leaders and volunteers and countless other staff and members. Thank God for COTA Honestly, this church was a little cultish. I did enjoy the female male Bible study I was in about 2 years ago for 30 something’s, but I was disheartened when it broke up. They wanted to split it to all age groups within a particular gender, because the pastor felt “called” to do so.” Before it did, the pastor made some sermon about a woman who left her husband and became a literal Jewish universal Unitarian lesbian as some metaphor to being a godly woman. I also read the book he wrote about Peter and felt it was also cringey “God doesn’t want you to be yourself, he wants you to be better” (actual words) kind of Evangelical shaming. It was alarming and weird. I miss the people that I met, and the food but I’m glad I left it. One of those big small churches because of all the wonderful small groups and supports they hold. I enjoy their Wednesday $5 dinner then hour of power prayer from 6:15 to 7:15 pm. With Christians no longer being safe in this country, they hire police to protect that church and cameras everywhere. I have had more prayers answered by attending and participating in that church than I have anywhere else during my adult years. This is my Church, from far away New Jersey I feel part of this Church community.  I highly appreciate the love  this beautiful congregation have for the King Jesus Christ!!
They honor our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ with their heart!   God bless and protect every member of this Church.

reviewSummary:
Pastor John and his wife are the sweetest Christians. They are kind and very thoughtful. Bethesda is also associated with them. Tuesday's are karaoke days. Pick a song and show out! This church compliments the square well. The windows are amazing. This historically significant church is definitely worth a visit. Tours are available. Check the website. The stain glass windows are spectacular.  The Christmas carol, "O Little Town of Bethlehem," was composed here by a former pastor. You can see the score in the office in the rear. Love this church! A beautiful, historic building with great stories: Phillips Brooks, an early rector, wrote "O Little Town of Bethlehem," and also preached the sermon when President Lincoln's funeral train came to Philadelphia. Today, the church is known for its welcoming community, great music and good works. Google Open Hearts Cafe as an example. Great people.

reviewSummary:

I don’t know why you would treat someone with such disrespect when you try to pretend like you follow God, you’re not living by the words you preach, highly recommend finding a different church than this one. Excellent Service. I feel the presence of the Holy Spirit. Beautiful atmosphere and decoration.  Very welcoming brothers and sisters. I love my family in God. Hallelujah! Amen!. What a wonderful first time experience. I sat close to the front middle and I’m glad I did. The worship lasts 30 minutes and I enjoyed every bit of it. The sermon was very well put together and I enjoy the pastor. I would like to have a sheet of the notes. A 1 page fill in the blank sheet for notes on each sermon would help a lot :) Well, I am a lot biased, as i have grown up with this church in my neighborhood since I was 8. It probably was a church member who had me accept Christ as an 8 year old on the corner of Van Nuys and Vose ( I'm 60 now)
So T.C.O.T.W. has been a part of my now matured faith for many seasons on and off.

I visited today from my home in Las Vegas. And I was sentimentally struck by the memories. But I was made more aware of the love of God over my life by the message which just happened to be pin point accurate to the circumstances of this week.
This reminded me of of all the supernatural things that have happened to me over the years in direct correlation to the activities of this church.

What can person review of a church? It's staff, it's services, it everything.  It is a church. They act like a church.

But here..for me, it's God's Church.  I i experienced God yet once again.

That's what we all need.

name: The Circle Community Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been attending this church for about a year now, and we love it so much! The people are so welcoming, and it is truly the first time I have wanted to be actively involved in a church congregation. This church has so much potential, and I am so excited to see it keep growing and flourishing into an even larger community.
I am particularly a fan of their clay conversations. I love that they have a space after service to dig deeper into scripture together, and have an open floor to hear each other’s thoughts about it. I truly am so happy we came here, we have developed so many wonderful friendships and relationships here! Please come visit, there will always be someone to welcome you with open arms here! This is an incredible church full of the best people! They have a deep love for the heart of Jesus and strive to live into the invitation he extends to follow him! They meet you where you are, love you as you are, and invite you along for the journey. Incredible worship each week, great messages from the pulpit, and opportunities throughout the month to sit with others and chat about what stirred your heart - where you felt God move you. The best Sunday to visit them is the very next Sunday available! I hope you'll drop by and check it out! If you're looking for a new church home, The Circle Community Church is a good place to start. Not only is it a new beginning for the church but it is a church full of life, energy, love and respect.  You would be welcomed as you are and no matter where your journey of faith has taken you. Come worship here and help build a new community of faith.  Remember, come as you are and be blessed. I’ve never met such a welcoming and kind-hearted church community! I tend to feel like an outsider at most churches I’ve attended. Like there’s the church in group, and most new people aren’t welcome. Here the church members make a real effort to make you feel included. The Circle Community church is a home away from home for me, with members who are willing to embrace you and show you God’s love no matter who you are. Their worship music and sermon series are inspiring and thoughtful created, being here always fills my cup for the rest of the week!

name: The City Church - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love The City! It’s a great place to call home and build community with people who love Jesus! Thank you for all you do for us!🤍 The City Church Lubbock is nothing short of amazing! From the moment you step through the doors, you can feel the warmth and welcoming spirit that defines this congregation. God is genuinely moving in this church, and it’s evident in the lives that are being transformed each week.

The preaching at City Church is exceptional—each message is thoughtfully crafted and delivered with passion and clarity. The sermons are not only relevant to our daily lives but also deeply rooted in scripture, providing valuable insights that inspire both believers and those who are curious about faith. The pastors and leaders are not just speakers; they are teachers who genuinely care about the spiritual growth of their congregation.

What truly sets City Church apart is the heart of the community. This is a place where everyone feels like family. The church offers a range of opportunities for fellowship, service, and personal growth, making it easy to connect with others and build lasting relationships. Whether it's through small groups, community events, or service projects, there’s a place for everyone to belong and contribute.

Moreover, the worship experience is uplifting and filled with genuine worship that moves the spirit. The music is vibrant and powerful, drawing you into a deeper connection with God. It creates an atmosphere where you can freely express your faith and experience the presence of the Holy Spirit.

For anyone seeking a community that embodies love, support, and faith, City Church Lubbock is the perfect place. Whether you're a long-time believer or just exploring your faith, this church offers everything you could ask for: deep teaching, a caring community, and a place to grow spiritually. I wholeheartedly recommend The City Church to anyone looking for a church home. It's not just a place to attend on Sunday; it's a family that supports you throughout your journey in faith! My family and I are proud to call The City Church of Lubbock our home for Sunday worship! The city church is a amazing place for family and the people are the best. If you love truth, the Bible, and drawing close to God in truth and His Word, you’ll love this church.

reviewSummary: The service and the messages are straightforward and to the point, it's a no judgement zone and come as you are Had a funeral to attend. Very nice cozy church. Hard to get back on the main street,traffic somewhat heavy.

name: The City Church NWA - Springdale Campus
reviewSummary: I don’t think I can find the exact words to say how much I love this church but I will try. In this church, I am a person that is seen, heard, understood, accepted, driven, and helped. I am not lost in the pews and forgotten after the goodbye on a Sunday. Members of this congregation care about you and truly love you with the love a church should show to all people. This church has a passion for reaching all souls in our community and make it there mission to connect with others. The children’s church is a program that my kids love and are proud to be a part of. Please give this church a chance if you’re looking for a place to worship, a place to connect, a place to serve, and a place to belong. I met my brothers and sisters in Christ at Murphys park during the free food truck ministry. I have growed in my faith and have been being discipled and have been growing into discipleship to share Jesus words with others. I would recommend city church for anyone looking to grow in their faith. Such a welcoming and down to earth group of people. Joined after attending a few of the City Church Free Food Truck nights and have been so happy! Love growing in faith along this congregation. My daughter absolutely loves it too 🥰 We're new to the town of Springdale and new to the state of Arkansas we moved here at the end of January 2019. And at the moment we are church shopping and hoping. And I have to say y''all this Church is a hidden Gem. The Pastor seems very kind, sweet, humble and geniune. And say this because I have come across some pastors here in the surrounding areas that don't seem to friendly or don't even attempted to introduce themselves to you. But this Pastor did and I really appreciate that. So thank you Pastor Rathbone. On a side note his voice remind me of the actor Edward Norton. But All in All great service, great people, lovely church and outstanding Pastor. Hands down to them and everything they do for their community. I pray that this church continues to grow and expand. Please for those of you that are reading this review, take the time to visit this chruch and add it to your list of church's to check out. City Church  NWC, I applaud you and God Bless you. Loved visiting The City Church NWA this past Sunday! The family service with the kiddos in the service was so fun, and in my opinion should happen in churches everywhere! The people were so friendly & welcoming. Loved the message, down to earth but rooted in the Word of God, paired with an incredible worship set. We will definitely return when we travel through again!!!

name: The City Gates Church - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: We have made this home church as we moved to east coast last year. Since the beginning we have felt welcome and part of a big family. Everybody keeps a friendly attitude and you can feel a family atmosphere. Pastors are great and deliver sound doctrine in every Sunday sermon. They have activities for all family members and each month you may find additional events to participate in. They also have home groups, Bible study groups during the week from September to May. If you live in the Fairfax area or surrounding cities, feel free to visit this church anytime, you may find your new family Christ here! This church has felt like home since we first attended. The teaching is thoughtful and engaging. Our whole family enjoys fellowship and my time at the Thursday morning women's Bible study has helped me build relationships. We love our church family! I'm so thankful my family found City Gates Church. We attended another Calvary Chapel from our previous state and loved it. Since we moved to Virginia, I wanted to find our church family and who has the same morals and values that we believe in, especially for our little ones. When I attended my first service in June, I knew that this place is truly special. We have attended regularly and if we can't attend the church provides the audio and we sit and listen to never miss the week's message. Everyone has been so welcoming and we truly can feel the presence of Christ during worship. The City Gates Church in Fairfax is a wonderful place to worship, fellowship, and praise God. The community is warm and welcoming, and the worship services are truly uplifting. Pastor Jeff is an amazing pastor and teacher, delivering insightful and inspiring messages each week. I always leave feeling spiritually nourished and closer to God. Highly recommend! This is a Bible believing church. The Word is taught book by book, chapter by chapter, verse by verse. Pastor Jeff doesn’t shy away from the hard issues or culturally difficult implications of the verses in God’s Word. Rather, he thoughtfully and (obviously) prayerfully presents the Word with accuracy and doesn’t try to cover up or tread lightly on the cultural divisions of our day. The worship team leads you into worship with humble heart attitude and doesn’t sing ambiguous songs of love to no one. The worship is sound doctrinally and the song choice is divers with hymns, contemporary and even a little blue grassy from time to time. Pastor Stephen heads the City Gates Youth Group that is vibrant and growing, where the Word of God is taught with clarity and power. Over all, this church is FIRE!!

name: The Commons LA Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
great church in the heart of westwood ❤️ first attended this church as an undergrad student at ucla and can’t emphasize enough what a blessing this church is from the sermons to community! highly recommmend checking out The Commons LA Church

alsoooo, we have a great kids ministry! If you’re looking for a place to call home and don’t want to follow Jesus alone, TCLA is the church for you. Besides the free lunch on Sundays, this church is dedicated to thinking Biblically, loving sacrificially, and living Jesus-centered. Committing to this family is worth it! The Commons LA Church offers a welcoming community with inspiring sermons and uplifting worship. A great place to grow spiritually and connect with others. This is the first church I really got plugged into since moving away from home for college. I'm now a part of this church on a level that I didn't expect from any church.

I feel like the community at this church are like family. I love that we always have free lunch on Sundays because it lets me hang out with such great people and talk about anything from God to random memes.

I think that it is 100% worth your time!

Edited to update review:

It's been over 5 years since I wrote my last review and I am deeply grateful for all of the experiences I have had with this church family. The people and rhythms have changed a lot over the years, but I think that is to be expected in a church that is pursuing God in such a transient city. Committing to be a part of this community has been a joy. They draw me deeper into relationship with God and tangibly reflect the love that he has for me.

All that to say, you should definitely check it out and see if it is the community that God wants you to meet you in. Worst case scenario, we still provide free lunches every Sunday! (which is actually extra awesome because it allows us to get to know you!) TCLA is a Christ-centered, biblically-grounded, and Spirit-filled church. It’s a smallish community (~100 people) which really allows us to live like family!

On Sundays, we gather at Upside Down for a weekly gathering and we all share (free!) lunch together as well after. We also have small groups (DGs) and community groups (MCs) throughout the week which allows folks to go deeper and build more meaningful relationships.

On Sundays, we often pray aloud together during the service, (which may surprise people so is worth knowing beforehand!) which is an awesome opportunity to learn how to pray by hearing others.

name: The Compass Church - Naperville Campus
reviewSummary:
I really really love this church. The lead pastor Jeff is incredible in his storytelling and his knowledge. I love how he gives local history. Biblical history. And preaches straight out of the Bible. It's a Christian church so no extra rules attached to things. Just the Bible. Messages are awesome. Missions are awesome.  People are awesome. The staff is helpful and friendly for first time guests. It was sad to see a church so out of touch with the Holy Spirit for their Christmas service. Wake up church you've fallen asleep. I feel blessed to have found a truly great group of churches so close to my home.

Thank you Compass for welcoming me into your families.
Sincerely Mark Chamberlain

name: The Connect Church - Cherry Hill Township Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor John Campagna ran the church that he was the pastor campus in Randolph, N.J into the ground. The only reason he’s a campus pastor was nepotism. In the least, he’s completely incompetent and doesn’t have the spiritual fruits to be a pastor. At worst, he is spiritually abusive after publicly humiliating in the middle of the death of a family member and us ending our journey with infertility in involuntary childlessness. He made the Randolph Campus hostile to our struggles with infertility and alienated the poor committed volunteers to the point that they quit and went to other churches. He benefited from donations from the church members to help repair his home in Sparta , but didn’t create an atmosphere where the church carried the burdens of all members. Other church members recommend he go to Bible school or get some kind of training, but he’s afraid to go anywhere else where he needs to meet certain qualifications because he knows he won’t be able to meet them and only has his job because of nepotism. He also has this history of publicly declaring that he can’t reach out to women from the church because of notions of impropriety, but then privately spent a lot of time alone with other peoples wives at the church in Randolph. They had a women’s prayer there and the girl who was there since she was young. Could tell she made sure her opinion was the only that mattered, but being black as well, you’re not the only one who has encouragements to say to God’s ppl. The light is this.. God. The light shines brighter when He sees His ppl come together as One. Not for tittles.. but give a chance to others who have gifts too. The day I walked through these doors is the day I realized I found my church home. 15 years later and my love for this house has only increased. My life has been changed due to the teaching and living out of the Word. This place is as real as it gets, meets you wherever your at, welcomes everyone, and is ever growing and reshaping themselves to be more aligned with God’s Word. If your looking for a place to call home. Come here! You’ll be forever changed. My family attended for 2 years. If your only need is entertainment, great, this is the place. But that's all there is. I believe Jesus has been removed because of the following:
The campus pastor and the senior pastor had a disagreement and the campus pastor was let go of which I did not agree with.
This was not all, my family needed a small financial assistance lesson for my 22 year old drug addicted son so we filled out a benevolence form. I received no response. I call and left messages to remind them a few times with no response. We would have understood and accepted a response of no but we got nothing. Ungodly and not biblical. Be careful putting your money into this place. I was going weekly, giving money  to the Sunday services when one day I felt the need to speak to the senior Pastor about his opinion on a  problem. He was gathered with his wife and staff and apparently does not like to mingle with his attendees much. He said, " instead of trying to "connect" with ME, you should speak to the other members and they might help you"  I have never went back there since. He only wants your money.

reviewSummary: This is our church!! Man oh man oh man at the movements happening here!!!! Please come join us. MY CHUR, MY HOME!  That's what we stand by. ANY and EVERYONE is welcome. The church members are welcoming and truly love the Lord and each other, and the pastor’s messages are filled with wisdom and even humor.
