Great community feel and wonderful people, amazing and inspiring messages with a truly outstanding pastor who makes everyone feel welcome and loved.

name: The Connection Church San Marcos - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing pastors! Congregation is next level and so friendly. This is exactly what the house of GOD should feel like. I LOVE this church. It's a new place that I went to, but I am Catholic and I wanted to go check it out. The people seem really nice real courteous and friendly, but I just didn't feel connected. Were used to praying to the Saints and there was no praying on the Saints so I just kinda came out feeling the same way when I came in. We absolutely love Connection Church. They have a very inviting culture and love everyone that walks through the door. Their worship team is so powerful, the message is always relatable and biblical. They have a phenomenal kids and youth ministry. I wish I had one like this when I was growing up. There is always something to do and events to help you grow closer to God. I have never been to a more accepting church than this one right here. If you haven’t joined a Sunday service, you need to. You will NOT regret it. I visited The Connection Church last Sunday for the first time and loved it. I am just passing through town while traveling and found this church that was near my airbnb. I vetted them on their website to ensure we had the same beliefs and was encouraged from what I saw on their website. Quickly into worship, I knew I was happy I found this church for that day. The entire congregation was active in worshipping, not just the people on the stage. The sermon was also Biblically based and thought provoking. My soul was very refreshed after not being able to attend church in a few weeks. I would happily return if in the area again! My entire family loves our church!  Our 5 and 9 year old enjoy Konnection Kidz where they learn about our Lord’s plan for them in an age appropriate way, our teenager actively serves each week along with her “tribe” that she also attends school with and my husband and I both are actively plugged in.  My favorite thing is knowing that I am apart of a body of believers that are connected by our call to fulfill the great commission and preach the gospel to all man-kind.  I know that I can invite anyone and they are genuinely welcome.  The Lord is calling all of us with His arms open wide and that is the message that is preached.

name: The Cross Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: The Cross Church has excellent teaching and sound doctrine provided by the pastors. Very theologically rich music absorbed in Biblical truth. Family integration is also key in The Cross Church as the elders encourage families to practice family worship weekly. There are also parenting seminars, men’s internships, men’s and boys gatherings, women’s prayer groups, women’s Bible studies, and youth events. For youth events, the goal is for the entire church to be bringing up the youth in the ways of the Lord and is not merely for the youth to have “fun” though that does happen as well. There are “city group” Bible studies most evenings throughout the week which are dispersed around the city. City group leaders conduct a gospel catechism with the rest of the group and then discuss in-depth the sermon preached from that Sunday. If you are looking to grow as a Christian and become more like Christ, please give The Cross Church a chance! Reformed baptistic, the pastors/elders are John-Mark and Kent, and both are good teachers. The layout and content of the service is very purposeful and gospel centered, and the preaching of the word is well laid out and central to the service. We take the Lord's Supper every week as a good reminder and good accountability. They have catechism for children, nursery for young ones, and early prayer for adults. Very sound teaching, and a great place to bring unbelievers who are in need of the gospel message, which is shared each week. My family moved to Pensacola specifically to attend The Cross. We had listened to the sermons online for over a year before deciding it was the right church for us. The preaching is unashamedly Bible truth and spoken with grace and a true love for the body; the doctrine is solid reformed theology; the pastors strive for excellence, are approachable, genuine, and loving members of the body; the people genuinely care for one another and are welcoming; the music is biblically based; the Lord’s Supper is taken weekly; small groups place an emphasis on sound teaching and Christian fellowship; membership is taken seriously; the atmosphere is one of true family worship. We have grown exponentially since coming to The Cross and are so thankful for it! At The Cross, there’s a genuine love for The Lord. There is right teaching, worship, and love for one another rooted in scripture. The pastors and people are genuine and intentional in your life and truly want to experience God in greater ways, and live out the gospel together. Even going through challenging or difficult times, the love shown towards me and countless others through the years was incredible. The Cross Church is a body of believers whose utmost desire is to glorify Christ. Christ and his gospel are preeminent in every service and small group meeting, and the members spur one another on to love and good works. This church has pastoral elders who shepherd their sheep well and expound with excellence the word of God.

name: The Cross Loganville - Loganville Campus
reviewSummary:
After years of church floating (nowhere ever feeling like home) I came to The Cross in September of 2025 still seeking our place that would inspire growth within us and feel more like a community that we were a part of. Not just familiar faces you smile and nod at on Sundays. The partners at this church welcomed us with open arms and immediately began introducing us to others and making sure we had whatever support we were looking for and I have watched them do the same for countless others since I began coming. The Pastor, Staff and congregation is by far the most welcoming community I have ever experienced. It makes it easy to plug in and learn what we are really here for, God’s word and his will over our lives. Nice open field! We were there for flag football and the field was well-maintained and level. The playground could be better maintained and seems to retain water and moisture from the rain. Be sure to bring an umbrella or tent if you will be on the field for a few hours as there are limited trees in the middle of the field for shade.

We didn't use the facility aside from the bathrooms, which were in fair condition. Just visited this church last Sunday, and I can sum it up with one word AMAZING! The partners at this church wasted no time getting to know me and introducing me to others while I was there. Pastor Tim Cash, great word straight out of the gospel, great leadership, great place. My story seemed to matter.... I will return for sure. Always a great message! If you need a place to feel connected to the Holy Spirit come and open your heart and soul. This is such an amazing church! Everyone treats you like family and the atmosphere is warm and inviting. Worship is great and Pastor Tim is a great leader and teacher who truly preaches authentic and biblicly based sermons. They have great small groups and other ministries. They are great with outreach in the community and beyond.

name: The Cross Walk Church - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary: Our name has changed to The Cross Walk Church.  We have also welcomed an Eritrean congregation to use our facility.  We have a very loving church & welcome those who are seeking a better life through Jesus Christ.  The Cross Walk service starts at 10:30 on Sunday morning.🎶🎼⛪️ Great Church, the members are so loving with open arms, bible based indeed. Pastor John Ennis is down to earth, but preaches the clear Word of God. Also, they have a special ministry for the homeless and the unfortunate. A must visit church! The most important church to visit, and becoming a member, feeling very welcomed and everyone is so loving, plus learning how to be a true Christian. I must visit church indeed. Find the love that is missing in some churches, but found at Cross Walk Church. Emily goes there every Sunday cause they are a church and we're Christian that they speak english and Ethiopia and I love to church one time when my mom went there she went so exactly my mom she loved it cause ever since she caused ever since she went there she loved it cause it was air chicken and Ethiopia that my mom was born in Ethiopia This my home church, and Pastor John Ennis is a gem. This church is God based. They have all types of things going on. You have to come and visit. I'm a member at Crosswalk Church.

name: The Crossing at Chesterfield
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love this church experience. Pastor Greg does a wonderful job of explaining the Word and teaching right out of the Bible. The worship music is concert level! Absolutely outstanding worship music. I used to attend a Catholic Church so I was nervous to go into something different than what I was used to but honestly this has been a wonderful experience. This has been my church home for 14 years or so?  I'm not good with dates.  Let's just say I was a mess in many ways and I expected them to work some kind of magic or make Jesus fix me and if they didn't then this was obviously a game.  But somehow I always walked out feeling better than I came in.  They very well could have said ya know....you're too much.  But they didn't and stuck with me with encouragement to get my act together and finally surrender to Jesus and let go because I wasn't doing a great job at controlling my life...at all.  It took many years of struggling, asking questions, denying, rolling my eyes, arguing but I kept coming back and finally surrendered and allowed Jesus to have control.  Even though some knew that I wasn't fully in, I was still welcomed every week.  Finally something just clicked.  The sermons are always rooted in scripture and explained in a way that applies to today's world.  I got baptized here and even though I phase in and out of attending I will always call The Crossing my church home.  I'm not perfect, but I am on a MUCH better path thanks to what I've learned here.  Thanks to everyone who stuck by me thru the dramatic darkness and helped guide me to the light.  I was a mess on a road to complete destruction....but God.

Edit:  Before my husband and I got married, I told him that I attend The Crossing sometimes and his response was "dont ever invite me because I dont believe in it and I'm never going".  I finally convinced him after telling him I dont like sitting alone but I also am not great at socializing. Now? He comes with me when I do attend and he's on his 2nd round of reading the Bible and doing daily Bible reflections all thanks to The Crossing. The Crossing does teaching well.

What was disappointing for me and my family was how difficult it was to *actually* connect with people. Despite regularly attending, joining classes, going to events and making an effort to talk to others, we could go a whole Sunday for weeks without having a conversation with anyone. Attempts to talk to leadership with questions or needs you get passed to various staff or told you should try a class.

People generally seem focused on their existing friend groups. Pastor Greg frequently pauses to tell people talk to each other about a quick question during the sermon but in our experience 99% of the time people are sitting there talking to nobody or to their spouse. Same thing with greeting time.

There are lots of opportunities to sign up for things, but programming alone doesn’t necessarily lead to connection here. For a church this large and organized, the social culture felt surprisingly closed off and impersonal.

Not a bad church, but not the easiest place to find connection if you’re hoping to build relationships and have biblical community. We love attending here! They give a beautiful service filled with the Holy Spirit. The music is very empowering and the message is right in line with God’s word! Thank you, Jesus, for giving us The Crossing! This can be a one star or a five star depending on your personal tastes as far as churches go. Some neutral words to describe it that can be taken one way or another - very theatrical, jokes, timing, tone inflection, often follows a distinct pattern. Music is bombastic and draws much attention to the artists. Sometimes takes 47 minutes before you hear one piece of scripture. Feels anonymous. Hard to get involved - Many barriers to even volunteering. Hard to find anyone to talk to - like really talk to - kind of get passed from person to person and then they feed you into their class system. None of these are inherently good or bad. Robust kids area, one of the best.

22 year old me gives it five stars. 44 year old me prefers more discipleship and scripture.

name: The Crossing Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Bro, my friends (of color) and I stopped attending. We felt like the "majority" wasn't INCLUSIVE enough. Nor did they try to be. Seems like just more of the same bland potato salad WITH Raisins. I will never go back! Great music, good sermon. Loved it. Check out their webpage. Made message applicable to everyday. This place is HOME🖤from the minute I stepped foot at The Crossing I knew my heart found peace, my soul found a safe resting home. After being submerged in a dark storm in Jan of 2018 and being introduced to this wonderful loving place around May 2018 I knew I had found my safe haven. Growing up Catholic, I had never encountered God the way I have now. I’ve been to other Christian church’s and let me say, none have felt as welcoming as The Crossing, everyone welcomes you with open arms. You are treated as family, you are not being judged🖤 For anyone who comes across this review, I would like to personally ask you for one favor, to give The Crossing a chance. You will not leave disappointed. I can’t believe it took me so many years to finally find a place where I feel accepted and treated with so much love. I started attending this church several months ago and it immediately felt like home. The pastors and volunteers make you feel so welcome and at home. Now both my wife and I are volunteers as well, serving with our spiritual gifts! We love this Church so much that we commute from Fullerton! Been coming here off and on for years and it's still a great place to worship. A kids room for different age groups is available to drop off your children, services aren't too long, and it's fun... water fun days are my kids favorite

name: The Crossing Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
From nearly dying and losing my girlfriend to joining this church 8 days later, this is the first thing I will give thanks to the Lord for once I meet him in heaven. This church body has turned my life around and is steadfast in their faith complete with a remarkable community of people that genuinely exemplify the qualities of Jesus Christ. Truly I say to you, from one person who was once lost and suffering in this world to another who might be looking for direction and a renewed joy in all the Lord has given and taken, come to the crossing and experience for yourself what I have in my first 7 months here. There is something so encouraging about walking into The Crossing on a Sunday morning and feeling warmly welcomed and embraced by everyone there. I haven't attended a church that welcomes people as well as The Crossing does, I love how the body of this church takes ownership in welcoming new faces and are genuinely interested in getting to know one another. The way this church loves and serves one another is testimony to their passionate and devoted hearts to Jesus.

This passion is illustrated through Life Groups.Throughout the week and throughout the city there are numerous different Life Groups to attend. A Life Group is an intentional way of living life together and being on mission for Jesus in a smaller setting. This is a way for the church body to grow together through studying The Word of God, and learning how to best serve each other and the community. A mission Life Groups strives for are to display the love of God to others and demonstrate the power and beauty of Christian community. I would recommend checking out a Life Group when visiting this Church!

One last note is that the teaching of The Crossing is very biblical. Generally, The Crossing will walk verse by verse through a book of the Bible and this allows for the full context of scripture to be taught. This type of teaching has led me to know more about Jesus, His character, and His redemptive story. Through The Crossing's teaching and emphasis on community I have grown immensely in my relationship with The Lord and desire more and more to glorify Him in every aspect of my life. This church has been incredible for my wife and I. We've been with The Crossing for over 3 years and have experienced Jesus with these people. Learning how to apply the gospel to our daily lives and sharing our lives as a community of believers has us forever grateful. The Life Groups are a major part of this church that teach us how to be on mission for Jesus. Discipleship and leadership training are in the fabric of this church. I've been a part of this community for about 4.5 years, and it is just excellent. The community aspect is incredible, the teaching is really solid, and the love for Christ and desire to live out his mission is nearly tangible.

I love how they've tried to capture the (I believe) very biblical idea of the church being far more than a building or a group of people that get together on a Sunday morning, but they have sought to be a gospel-centered community on mission together. That means a lot of life being lived together as a community/family. This also means things can get messy sometimes (as things do in families), but if you stick around during and after the clean up, it is so worth it!

I never thought I'd grow to the point I am in my faith, and I can say with certainty that The Crossing has been the instrument of God's choice to push me way beyond where I thought I'd ever be and moved me closer to beholding the wonders and majesty of his Son. If you're looking for a church, I cannot recommend this one highly enough. Are you looking for a bible based, Christ centered community of REAL people? Then The Crossing is for you. I love that the messages are straight from the word of God and the people really do want to know you and how you are doing. No fake fronts here just real people loving Jesus and doing life together.

name: The Crossing Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love being part of The Crossing Church. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, seen, and genuinely cared for. The atmosphere is warm and uplifting, and the messages are always powerful, practical, and rooted in truth.

What stands out most is the sense of community. This isn’t just a place you attend—it’s a place you belong. The people are kind, authentic, and committed to growing together in faith and purpose. Whether it’s through worship, small groups, or simply connecting with others, there’s something really special happening here.

Our family has grown so much spiritually since being here, and we’re incredibly grateful for the leadership, the vision, and the heart behind this church. If you’re looking for a place that feels like home and helps you grow in your relationship with God, this is it. I feel truly alive at this welcoming church. The members are nice and very friendly, and the pastors are amazing. Sure today was great the lead singer and all the singers did a great job. I would love to see her more often.  The pastor as usual, always has a great message a great teacher.  6/7 The Crossing Church off Windmill in Las Vegas is awesome! Super welcoming vibe, inspiring messages, and killer worship music. Feels like family-highly recommend! The Crossing Church is an amazing place to worship and grow. The messages are uplifting and practical, the worship is powerful, and the community is welcoming and genuine. You truly feel encouraged and supported every time you attend. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great church home in Las Vegas.

name: The Crossing Church - Sacramento - Sacramento Campus
reviewSummary: Came here to watch a kids play, it was really nice. The welcoming is really modern and welcoming. Really open hearted and welcoming community of Christians. Great place to go with your family for Sunday service. Pastor Kyle, Pastor Zeke, and the crossing community truly changed my life. I cannot recommend this church family enough . The Lord’s word is so beautifully conveyed here and the services are engaging and meaningful. You will definitely feel the love at The Crossing Church. I've made some great connections there. The sermons are biblical and meaningful. My kids enjoy the children's program and youth group. The life groups have something for every stage of life and are a good opportunity to connect with people. I'm blessed to have this loving church family.

name: The Crossing Hayward - Hayward Campus
reviewSummary: Very dynamic pastors. Many talented music artists lead the worship. Messages are full of spiritual dynamics. Great free events for the community, like the halloween event at Burbank elementary and today's free community bbq, with awesome free food, foam fun for kids, jump house obstacle course, cotton candy and more.  Thank you to all the hard working volunteers!! Epic church

name: The Danish Church and Cultural Center - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: This is a cute church, we look forward to going to the Christmas craft fair every year. The people are so nice and you can tell they are a tight knit family. The craft fair isn't real big, but is always busy. They also sell danish pastries and food. I'm half danish, and I really enjoy and look forward to going every year. Its a treat to visit here. Wonderful church lovely people snd awesome pastor Really sweet group of people. I enjoyed being part of their entertainment for the night. I had my wedding here in 2016 & I don’t think there could’ve been a better location. The couple running the church were so down to earth. It was a great experience. Historic small fully function parish church.

name: The District Church
reviewSummary: Multi-site urban congregation across Washington DC committed to Christ's kingdom, racial reconciliation, neighborhood hospitality, and biblical exposition.

name: The Door Christian Center - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: The holy Spirit is most definitely here and the pastor is great and preach the word of God 🙏 Awesome church. I gave my life to Christ here and I've never been the same. It's been such amazing to see all that he has done in my life the last three years. It's a blessing to be in a church that preaches the TRUTH and shares a vision for masses amount of souls to get saved! If you don't know Jesus this is a place where you can meet him and grow in a relationship with him. amazing! The power of God will change your life, you will never be the same. Down to earth,  friendly great praise and worship,  with wonderful pray warriors. I cried when I had to leave this church. But I will be back someday

name: The Door Christian Church - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I highly recommend this church. Very good preaching and atmosphere!

name: The Door Christian Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I love this place. Atmosphere is great. Everyone is friendly. I love the music and the talented voices from all the wonderful women!!! I have been looking for a church home since after the pandemic, I finally asked my brother in-law’s girlfriend where do she go to worship God? She invited me to the Door church. I must say it was crowded but it was Father’s Day, and I didn’t think the church would attract a large following. So I came back the next Sunday and I was totally surprised as to how many more people attended the Sunday after Father’s Day. Pastor Stacy and First Lady, Daphne Dillard , are two of the most Genuine people that I have ever met. Pastor Stacy knows how to keep his congregation coming back Sunday after Sunday. His messages are ALWAYS right on time. I have found my church home. Great church, family oriented and very carring people go here. I went once and now go every Sunday. I have no family in San Diego and now the church is my family. Very prejudice, it's a black thing.  They kicked out my husband  after 3 yrs because he wanted to lead someone to the Lord. They don't do that.  So I left with him. Still looking for another church. Do you do baptisms? And deliverances?

name: The Door Christian Church - Modesto Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church very close to home! It's within walking distance. The pastor is very welcoming as well as the entire church. I didn't feel jusged at all when I first attended this church. And now, I attend regularly. It is a great place to worship. Friendly environment and all are welcome. You should attend a service! Sundays 11 A.M & 6:30 P.M Wednesdays 7:30 P.M. Amazing Church! Very hospitable and great people to be around that love God! Intimate and inviting atmosphere Are you tired or heart broken or going through a hard  time come here Jesus will meet you here Sharing the word and love of God!

name: The Door Christian Fellowship - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
It's not my kind of place.
Middle of last prayer, a servant walked up, sat next to me, and tapped on my shoulder and asked if i was saved ( not cool )
Also, im not comfortable with the pastor speaking in tongues at the last worship song without an interpreter.
No saying this is bad. it's just not for me The pastor and many of the congregants have a heart for Jesus and a passion for His mission of saving souls. The sermons are anointed and they have many guest preachers with the same heart and passion. If you want definitive change in your life give your heart, mind, and soul to Jesus. And if you want to also cultivate that change and make it your  lifestyle, attend this church. I love this church!  The Door of Redlands is a very friendly and welcoming church. I have been attending this church for some time now and have grown in my spiritual walk tremendously. The pastor is down to earth and encourages the congregation to develop a personal relationship with Christ through personal devotions. One of the churches best attributes is the willingness to accept and reach out to every soul that comes through the doors. It is encouraging to be a part of a church that walks in Christ footsteps. I finally found what I was looking for in a church! The best part of the Sunday morning service is the adult interactive Bible study. Had a chance to meet Pastor Rich after the service. Most pastors don't make themselves available to the members outside of an appointment, however, Pastor Rich is easily accessible plus he teaches an uncompromised word. The mission here is clear. Help sinners learn about Jesus, repent, convert, disciple them, and give everyone this opportunity.

If you’re serious about changing your life and serving others, this place fits the bill. Prayer every morning from 6-8. Saturday Outreach from 10am-12pm. Sunday School and New Believers Class @10am, Sunday Service @ 11am, and Sunday Evening Service @ 7pm. Monday Evening Follow-Up. Tuesday evening band, puppets, and drama practices (hours vary). Wednesday Midweek Service @ 7:30pm. Thursday Outreach 7/7:30pm. Friday bible studies (various times and locations). Spanish Ministry Service 7:30pm Friday.

You get what you put into it.

name: The Door Christian Fellowship Church
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this fellowship for a year now, and I am truly grateful! I thank God for leading me here. When I moved to Fargo on my own, this church became my family. God placed me in an environment where I could grow in my walk with Him, while also blessing me with meaningful friendships and a loving spiritual family. The Spirit of the Lord is truly here, and God is doing amazing things in this church! I am forever thankful for the impact it has on my life.

If you’re looking for a church that will point you toward Christ, encourage you to walk in a Christlike way, and surround you with genuine community, this is the place for you. Come through! This church has been such a blessing in my life. During one of the hardest times I’ve ever faced, they prayed with me, supported me, and truly made me feel seen and loved. Even after I moved to another state, they reached out and connected me with sister churches in my new area. I’m so thankful for all the kind, genuine people I met here—their love and faith reminded me that I’m never alone. God is truly working through this church. I knew about Jesus all my life but I never had a true relationship with Him. When me and my wife (girlfriend at the time) came to this church, God clearly spoke into our lives, I repented and God restored everything in my life, He restored my relationship and we got married, and He set me free from my addictions. The church is meant to become your family and help you live for God, the Door CFM is the place where God is STILL saving and changing lives!!! We came to church Sunday night expecting a service. And found ourselves invited to a thanksgiving dinner with no expense spared. The people were amazingly friendly and welcoming. So encouraging to know there are still people like this who love people as much as they love GOD! If your in Fargo, ND and are looking for a church that’s foundation is bible based and believes in salvation through Jesus Christ to wash your past, and every sin away by confessing and proclaiming him as your lord and savior. Then this is where you want to be! Everyone is welcome. The most Powerful Church I've ever served, I gave my life to Jesus here in our Church in 2007 I fell away and I fell sick n dying and in 2016 I gave my life back to Christ and he saved me here, He also saved my marriage , I can testify that his Holy Spirit Reigns in our Church, My Life has truly been changed Restored revived, Come be a walking Testimony! God bless everyone! In Jesus Holy name Amen

name: The Door Christian Fellowship Church - Amarillo Campus
reviewSummary: If I could give a 0 rating I would. The hypocrites just shamed my sister for having an "illegitimate" child and prayed the "curse of illegitimacy" away from him.... If you looking for change in your life come and expirence the power of God. I love this church so much. They have truly changed my life.

If you want to feel the presence of the Holy Spirit then come worship with us. The people there are so nice and welcomed me with open arms my first visit.

name: The Door Christian Fellowship Church Corpus Christi - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary:
Holy spirit definitely adored and glorified. Mens fellowship is genuine. Pastor is intelligent & i believe has the spirit upon him , passion to lead wisely carefully with conviction This church sends out people in the community in the evening when it’s dark to participate in solicitation at private properties in the area.

Even after it was brought to the groups attention, they remained going door to door. No one should be approaching anyone’s door when it’s dark. And I have learned alot here especially with Adult Sunday School on Sunday mornings. Come and see what God is doing here and what he can do in your life as well!😁 Enjoyed a fruitful service and my wife, Belén and I certainly plan to attend again.  My wife getting baptized this Sunday and my 22 YO son, Roel Alfonso and I are recommitting, but more of having been damned!  Never good to do that to anyone!  This church was on time, in order and very well presented Word of God! Excellent church with bible based preaching! I have been serving God in this church for the past 18 years. name: The Faith Center - Tucker Campus
reviewSummary:
After leaving my previous church I visited TFC in the beginning of 2025, and started visiting another church. For some reason my spirit kept pulling me back to TFC and months later I began “dating the church”. I’ve grown up in church but as an adult I was at a spiritually vulnerable point where as an older Gen Z my way of understanding the Bible needed to be taught in a way with logical thinking/reasoning and not just for memorizing scripture. I really was rebuilding my relationship with God based on my experiences and without the influence of others. And Pastor Campbell has a way of teaching the Word that not only “moves” you but pushes you to apply the principles in your daily life. The tools and resources to live a better life and not just hear a sermon on Sunday is amazing.

Before I officially joined, I joined a group and gained some wonderful sisters in Christ. I had an emergency situation where I almost died and had to have surgery. I spent days in the hospital and I shared with one of my sisters in Christ, next thing you know the First Lady (Lady C) personally called to pray and check on me. Even with all of this, I never got any pressure to join the church until I was ready which I appreciated.

All in all, this is a wonderful church. From the ambience to the members, TFC really means it when they say we do life together. They are very transparent, welcoming and genuinely want to see souls wins. Gorgeous facility. I loved the Pastor and Pastor's wife. If I lived close enough, I'd attend their church. It was a privilege to meet them both. The Pastor is very down to earth! Although The Faith Center has thousands of members the Pastor is accessible and approachable. Although he is available, he's never alone! He has a very rich spiritual connection with other denominations. An all around Great Man Of God! Loved the performance but the venue itself wasn’t ideal. They make you throw away your water then they sell you water right outside the performance hall, only for a guy to tell you that you can’t bring drinks in. Would’ve been nice to know that prior to buying more water. On top of that, they overbook. There was about 100 people with nowhere to sit. ​A House of God or a House of Business? (Beware the Performance)⚠️

​Rating: 1/5 Stars

​It deeply grieves my spirit to see a 4.9-star rating for this establishment.   Let the reader understand: those stars are for the music and the marketing,NOT for the ministry.

I am frankly disturbed by how this organization prioritizes its public image while neglecting the actual sheep in its flock.

​The Fruits of This Ministry or LACK there of:

​A Shepherd Who Won't Tend the Flock:   When my fiancé, our three children, and I were facing the trial of homelessness, I went to Pastor Campbell privately. Instead of offering prayer or a helping hand, he told me he "doesn't handle those matters" and sent me to a financial office.

He never reached back out to see if my children had a roof over their heads.

​Closed Doors and Business Pages:

I tried to reach my brother in Christ on Facebook, only to find he had converted his page to a "Business/Public Figure" account.

I was no longer a friend, just a "follower." 😡.  The door to the Pastor Campbell was locked behind a brand.

​The $800 Trial:

My rent was $800 at that time in 2022 . Even though this church has owned their building outright for two years, they refused to help a family in a storm.

​​Selfless Service Met with Cold Math:

I served this church for 5 years out of a genuine heart for God.
IN 2011  I helped move and set up this very building. I spent 10-hour days—from 5:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.—handing out 10,000 lbs of food to strangers because I believed in the mission. I NEVER asked for anything in return for that service nor did I ever want to or think I need it.

However, when my family faced a TRUE EMERGENCY of Homelessness IN 2022, the church didn't see a brother; they saw a "delinquent account."

They told me over the phone I wasn't "eligible" for help because I hadn't tithed in 3 years.   They were happy to take my labor for free, but they treated my family's survival like a business transaction.

The Money Changers:

This same church tracked down my phone number and called my place of work over a failed $10 donation.   They have the resources to hunt you down for a dime, but no compassion to help you when you’re drowning.

THE DAMAGE DONE💥💥:

I have been a church-goer my entire life. I have attended many different churches, but this experience was so heartless that it has destroyed my trust in organized religion entirely.

Because of how this "business" treated me and my children, I honestly never want to step foot in a church again. They didn't just fail to help with rent; they failed to represent the heart of God.

​A WARNING TO SEEKERS:⚠️⚠️⚠️

They have a beautiful temple and a loud choir, but they are SPIRITUALLY BANKRUPT.  DO NOT be deceived by the 4.9 stars.

DO NOT labor to build an empire for a "brand" that will turn its back on you and your children for the sake of $800.

​NOTE TO THE CHURCH:  ABSOLUTELY DO NOT TRY and respond with the regular generic response saying, "We are sorry you feel this way, please reach out so we can make it right." You had your chance to "make it right" when a family with three children was facing the street.

I was there, I asked, and YOU TURNED US AWAY.

Anything you say now is just for the sake of the reviewers watching.

BE AWARE that while you may manage your reputation here, your actions toward the least of these WILL be reviewed by God.

YOUR SILENCE will be your ONLY HONEST response.

DISCLAIMER: I've been waiting since 2022 the last day I sat foot in that "Church" Business to wrIte this review for anyone wondering

One of the first things I got involved in was the Young Adults group, which has been an incredible place to grow in faith and meet people from many different church backgrounds. Everyone brings their own unique testimony and perspective, which makes the conversations meaningful and encouraging.

One of the most impactful moments in my journey here was making the decision to get baptized as an adult on World Baptism Day. It was truly one of the best decisions I’ve made in my life, and the church community was incredibly supportive during that step of faith.

I also attend Pursuit Nights, which are typically held on Thursday evenings. The worship is powerful, and the atmosphere encourages both personal prayer and praying for others through testimony and intercession.

A sermon I attended in August 2025 spoke about the importance of getting plugged into serving when you call TFH your home. That message really resonated with me, and I felt God calling me to serve in Kids Ministry. Helping young people understand God’s love and faithfulness at such an important stage of their lives is incredibly meaningful. I also have a background working in youth recreation, so it felt like a natural fit. The Kids Ministry team has been amazing to serve alongside.

I strongly encourage anyone who attends to get plugged in, whether through serving, small groups, or young adults. There are so many opportunities for everyone to grow and be part of the community. This church truly uplifts people in their faith and helps build a strong foundation.

If you’re looking for a church where you can grow, serve, and be part of a welcoming community, I highly recommend The Father’s House East Bay. This Church makes you feel so welcome and like you’ve found your home filled with the Holy Spirit and family. They have an awesome new believers and new to the church program called essentials. They help you get connected to a small Bible study group. They have marriage classes and anything else you could need to grow your relationship with the Lord. They have a great kids area so you can enjoy services while your little ones play and learn about Jesus. This church has the best true to the gospel messages and you’ll want to make this your home church right away. Wow! After attending the location in Vacaville for some time, the commute was weighing heavily. I found this location and was met by such a friendly community. The worship is solid, the Holy Spirit is present, and the small nature really promoted a more welcoming atmosphere than the bigger location in Vacaville. I could explain the life changing events and go into my testimony, but I think I would encourage you to experience it for yourself. No pressure. So if you are searching for a new church, or are in town visiting, come on down to the Father's House and tell em Ricky sent ya! I hope to see you there soon. My wife and I came here post covid because they were one of the few churches willing to open up at that time.
We never left. The people are friendly, and the church location is perfect for us. Pastor Dave Patterson is articulate and does an amazing job teaching, preaching, with transparency, and a bit of humor mixed in.
The church has amazing worship teams, fast growing youth group, and great children's ministry.
There is also a good balance of youth, young adults, married families, and "seasoned saints".
We have met more adult friends in the last couple of years here, than in any of the other churches we've attended previously.
If you want a relationship based church, with dynamic worship and fantastic teaching/preaching, you couldn't find a better place than TFH East Bay! This church is on mission and on point.
Been with these folks nearly ten years,
New people are constanyly coming, and finding new life in Christ, new friends, and a place where they feel like they belong.
Come and make TFH East Bay your church home, too.

name: The Father’s House - Main Campus
The Father's House - Napa - Napa Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is very welcoming and teaches the Word of God in a relatable way in a comfortable setting.  The attendees were really diverse, including singles, young families, teens and seniors.  I attended a Christmas service on 12/20.   They had a festive candy area for kids of all ages, coffee bar, and a spacious sanctuary.  The size was ample but not overwhelming, so you didn’t feel lost in the crowd.  I appreciated all the volunteers’ friendly smiles and direction.  The worship service was lively and uplifting, and the message was relatable and focused on the gospel.  I will be back the next time I’m visiting the Napa area! This place is transforming people's lives a day at a time. Blessed and highly favored not because of money but the power that solves all my problems. 🙏. Never allow anyone or anything to steal your joy.

Church isn't a country club for saints but a Hospital for sinners. As you approach the church you will be welcomed by people with giant welcome signs jumping up and down. It’s a shame  you won’t be welcome once you’re inside if you use a guide dog. If you are blind and require a guide dog they will NOT let you in the sanctuary.  You will be forced to stay in the lobby like a second class citizen. I was escorted out of the sanctuary like I had broken the law. It was incredibly embarrassing.  I traveled 3 hours to be present for my niece’s baby dedication and they would not let me be in the sanctuary.

I politely asked the man who escorted me out ‘what would Jesus do’ and he snickered at me.  So if you’re blind and require a guide dog for your mobility I recommend finding a different church. It’s probably for the best.  If a church is more concerned about getting dog hair on the carpet or the incredible inconvenience of a guide dog sleeping at the feet of a blind person rather than allowing people to hear God’s word maybe they need to follow Jesus’s teaching a little more closely.  Guide dogs are NOT “service dogs.” They are Guide Dogs for the Blind. @The Father’s House- it’s time to change your policy. This church has changed my life for the better! We couldn’t be any luckier as a community to have the fathers house. Over the last three years I have been able to grow closer to God and have found my closest friends here! Many of the leaders and pastors at the fathers house have helped me through some of the hardest and best times of my life and I couldn’t be more grateful! I only pray that more and more people can experience the love and grace of this church! I love this church. The preaching always has something that touches me personally no matter where I'm at in my walk with the Lord. I love the worship, it always turns my heart to God and focuses my heart, preparing me for the message from the pastor. I feel welcome here. I look forward to growing in my walk here with my brothers and sisters in Christ.

name: The Father's House - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
The Father’s House is a very biblically sound Church with amazing people and even more amazing Pastor and his family. It feels like a small family even though there are many in attendance. I highly recommend this church!! Took my family to visit The Fathers House Church today. It was an incredible experience the worship was 🔥🙌🏻🔥🙌🏻🔥🙌🏻, the message was engaging, challenging and encouraging 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼! After not being able to gather for a church service for the past several months, we heard TFH were opening doors on Fathers day. We showed up early got a good seat and man we really needed it.. God is Awesome and this church community is Great. I really enjoyed listening to Pastor John and Pastor Cyndi when they were at New Hope Oahu and I was pretty stoked when I got to watch a service online at The Father's House. They are really a true gem to the word of God and for those who don't understand the Bible but are trying to keep up with it Pastor John is really awesome at helping you understand the parables. His delivery and how he can make it relatable to a situation. love this church! I felt right at home when I walked into the doors. Really connected to the worship, which is so important because it brings you into the presence God! Also loved the teaching from Pastor Dan. Relatable, funny, real and also brought so much scripture to his message. This will be my home church!

- Sarah Wimberly I just found my church Victory Outreach at The Father's House. Very nice place thire children's Chapel is very nice my granddaughter loves it. My grandkids really like thier new church.

name: The Father's House - Vacaville - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary:
Big thank you for the newcomer connect team this morning. I spoke with the lady and I let her know that I’m visiting from out of town. She prayed with me and I’m just so grateful I came to this church this morning.

Been up all night at the hospital with my son. He fell 100 feet while rock climbing and I needed the encouragement that was given.

I’m glad God led me to this church this morning. God bless the body of Christ here ❤️‍🩹🙏🏼☺️ The Father’s House in Vacaville is a welcoming and uplifting place to attend church. From the moment you walk in, people are friendly and make you feel comfortable whether it’s your first visit or you’ve been coming for a while.
The messages are practical, encouraging, and easy to connect with in everyday life. Worship is well done and creates a positive, meaningful atmosphere without feeling overwhelming. You can tell a lot of care goes into the experience.
The campus is clean and organized, and they do a great job with parking and flow, even on busy Sundays. There are also good programs for kids and families, which makes it easier for parents to be present and engaged.
Overall, it’s a great community if you’re looking for a church that feels welcoming, modern, and grounded in faith. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in the area. Raised Catholic, I spent years going through the motions—never really feeling connected, more out of duty than anything else.

Then I visited The Father’s House… and everything changed. From the moment I walked in, I felt something real. Even my younger boys loved it and couldn’t stop talking about how much they enjoyed being there.

The atmosphere is deeply spiritual yet warm and welcoming—like coming home. The space is clean, the people are kind, supportive, and genuinely there to help guide you without judgment.

The worship band? Absolutely soul-stirring. And the preacher speaks in a way that reminds me of that one guidance counselor who truly cares—someone who helps you find clarity and direction when you need it most.

If you’ve ever felt disconnected or just been searching for something more, I can’t recommend this place enough. Today was my first time attending service at The Fathers House in Vacaville, and it was truly a blessing. As the preacher taught from Philippians, a member of the congregation needed medical attention. I'm grateful to report that the church's security staff sprang into action, swiftly and compassionately assisting the member. But what really stood out was the selfless response of two off-duty EMTs in the congregation.

A young lady with black hair, around 5'2", immediately jumped into action, announcing she was an EMT and offering help.  She and church staff assisted her to her feet and began walking her to the stairs. She was joined by a male EMT, about 5'9" with black hair, wearing a gray vest. Together, Staff and off-duty, EMT’s  expertly assisted the member until paramedics arrived.

I'm inspired by the kindness and skill of these individuals. They truly demonstrated the love of Christ in action. I'd be grateful if the pastor could give them a shout out. Thank you, The Fathers House, for being a shining example of community and compassion.
I’ve never really said anything like this and meant it but thank you Jesus for everyone involved and prayers up to the member.. I love this church so very much! The pastors give amazing sermons, the worship music is the best. So soulful it makes you so connected to each other into God. I could not ask for better people and a better church. The Bible studies and small groups are amazing. My daughter loves the children’s program. This place is amazing. I’m so happy I found a church home when I moved to Vacaville in 2021 from the Bay Area. You will not regret making this your home church. It has so much to offer and will bring you closer to Jesus Christ than you have ever been before.

name: The Father’s House Oakland - Oakland Campus
reviewSummary:
The Father’s House Oakland is an amazing church with a welcoming, diverse community and a powerful message. The pastors and leaders genuinely care, and there are so many ways to get involved—from small groups to family events like baby dedications.

Since being there, I’ve been baptized, participated in a women’s leadership small group, and dedicated my baby to be raised with the teachings of the Bible. I’m also looking forward to enrolling in the Discover and Essentials classes.

If you’re looking for a church home in the Bay Area, I highly recommend it. 🙏🏾 And I can’t forget the band and singers!  Always a vibe!! The Father’s House is incredible—real people, real faith, and a real sense of belonging. Pastor Jules (MG!) brings powerful messages that connect on every level. The worship is alive, the kids' program is excellent, and the whole team—from service to security—operates with love and purpose.

What stands out most is the community. The members are genuinely welcoming, grounded, and filled with joy. You don’t just attend here—you become part of something bigger.

If you’re looking for a church that’s alive in spirit and rich in connection, The Father’s House is the place. Yes this church was great experience for me grandson and my daughter invited me to attend i always do the online church in the bay area but this in person here was so awesome and I definitely want to attend more of this church...many blessings! And always stay prayed up!! 🙏 My first time attending. I loved the vibe upon entering the doors. I like the set up as well. The praise and worship was on point! Looking forward to attending more often.

Update (This is over a year later)
I went back at least 3 times afterward and decided it wasnt for me. The praise and worship was still great, but on one occasion the pastor was away and the person preaching was more like a comedian at a stand up show. I don't know if it was his wife in the front row, but she was cracking up and unfortunately,  I brought a guest with me. She waa annoyed, and the person on my left was asleep. We left before the service was over. I went back for my 4th visit to hear the pastor preach again, and he has too many jokes peppered into the sermon. I'm not interested in someone trying to make me laugh. The Word is enough for me. Some people may like that, but not me. Very welcoming place, very receptive people, great words, great music with a lot of unction. A good place to come with the family. I also liked the parking, try to arrive at least 15 minutes early and you will get a good spot. Because I noticed that those who arrived later already had fewer spots.

name: The Father's House OC - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
You can feel Gods presence here. The volunteers are the best & Pastor B let’s the Holy Spirit guide her EVEN WHEN it isn’t easy. I visited TFHOC this morning all the way from WV. We were complete strangers walking in that made friends with 4 people in an hour. From being welcomed into seats, given coffee, asked intentionally about our stories, being hugged, cared for and prayed over while we were there. Every person was welcoming and compassionate. The presence and character of God is there!
Pastor Bianca even made time to talk with us one on one and pray over us. If you are new to church, looking for a safe place with authentic people or nervous to try a new one…you will be met with God’s love here. The happiest most warmest welcome me and my kids have ever felt! The word was powerful made me cry, my kids church class awesome! Whole experience amazing. It's all church should be. Also looks modern so clean so cozy. Worship singers amazing too. I love this church. I remember going to the theatre and watching movies. Now I am watching God's movie and watching people change, for his GLORY. THANK YOU, Matt and Bianca for being our shepherd (director). May you always be abundantly blessed. We came to visit this church while on our Disneyland vacation and loved the atmosphere. We've watched many times online but to be in the presence of such an amazing team was a delight. The way in which Matt and Bianca preach true moves me. Thank you TFHOC!!

name: The Father's House Roseville - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
Our first time there today, everyone was very welcoming. Worship was amazing, just what my spirit needed this morning.  What a wonderful prophetic word that was brought  from the sister church. We will definitely be going back. I Love this church! I am so glad I was told about the Roseville Campus. I have made it my "home" Pastor Jake has so much passion for the Lord. He loves people and it shows... If you are looking for a church where you can feel the Holy Spirit....This is the  church for you!! Come join us, you won't be disappointed! Very welcoming church. Atmosphere is just like at the family gathering-positive. Great worship. Dedication of the pastor amaze me. Church team helps everyone to feel just like home.
I recommend to visit this church and experience real Fathers house. This is my home church where I worship serve and do life with family. The Spirit is alive and at work on Sunday mornings. The presence of the Lord is tangible in worship. The word of God is effectively preached and lives are being transformed. Come join us. And welcome home. Loving and caring church. Very friendly members. Felt very warm when I was there.

name: The Feast Church
reviewSummary: Nice church, good pastor. You feel like part of the family as soon as you get here. They are casual and comfortable. This church is very involved with the community! I recommend it to people who are both new and old. You can ask any questions you may have about the faith. I know Caleb. His sermons are relevant and down to earth. Check them out online or in person. Congregation is very family friendly. Awesome community church! Great place to be ❤ Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: The Feast Church Alpharetta - Alpharetta / Milton Campus
reviewSummary:
Feast Church is a remarkable and diverse community where faith, compassion, and genuine connection unite.

Pastor Matt Ashogbon is a man truly ignited and called to serve. His passion for spiritual truth is unmatched, and his gifted and enthusiastic teachings are deeply relevant to real life.  He has a rare heartfelt ability to connect with people from all backgrounds, speaking truth with humility, gentleness, and conviction. Matt understands that the greatest battle we face is for our hearts and souls, and he is profoundly committed to helping people find healing, renewal, and a closer walk with Christ.

Pastor Yinka Ashogbon shares the same unwavering faith, wisdom, and love for people. Together, they lead with authenticity and a sincere desire to see others flourish. They have created a church culture where people feel seen, valued, and encouraged in their own unique position of Faith.

If you are searching for a church where you can genuinely secure lasting spiritual growth and/or restoration, I cannot recommend Feast Church highly enough. Be courageous.  Come as you are. Your soul is worth it. The most intimate & family oriented church you’ll find in Georgia! I love the Feast Church, everyone’s welcoming & you really do feel the presence of God once you step in! I truly love this church and their congregation. The service is truly moving and strongly focuses on prayer. I feel so welcomed whenever I come in on Sunday mornings. The Feast Church has been an amazing experience! Was recommended to this church by my best friend and it did not disappoint. You can feel God’s presence through not only Pastor Matthew, but also the members. All Glory to God!! If you're looking for a welcoming and down-to-earth church, The Feast Church is the place to be. The community here is diverse and friendly, making it easy to feel like you belong from the moment you walk in. The worship is full of energy and a great way to connect with God.

The teaching is practical and easy to understand, but still deep enough to make you think and grow. You’ll walk away feeling encouraged and ready for the week ahead.

If you’re looking for a church where you can be yourself, meet great people, and grow in your faith, come check out The Feast Church. You’ll love it!

name: The Fellowship - Katy Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church! The Fellowship is a place where you’ll truly experience Jesus’ love through community, family, and friendships. From the moment you walk in, you’ll feel welcomed, valued, and at home. It’s for all ages, where the whole family can grow in faith. The worship and sermons are centered on God’s Word. Come visit us this Sunday! Highly recommend! I love The Fellowship! We tried it because my sister goes there, and since we were looking for a Church home, I thought it would be fun to attend church as a family like when we were little!😊 Right off the bat, we were welcomed by genuine people! There were no fake smiles, no judgemental nodding of heads, no suspicious glances. It was so comforting. It immediately felt like "home" (which VERY pleasantly surprised my husband and myself!). Even my husband instantly felt pulled to The Fellowship as though it was "home", and where we were meant to be. Everyone was very open and authentic! The band and music were so great that you could almost say we came for the music and stayed for the eye opening message! (Which was also awesome!)😆 Even my daughter has enjoyed attending service with the youth (teens) (Although every once in a while, she's still attends the main service with us! LOL) The Pastors are ALL very sweet and welcoming and very genuine and immediately swapped numbers to get to know us! And the nicest part of meeting everyone was that no one gave us any kind of uncomfortable (or creepy stalker) vibe! 😂
Since that time, my husband and I have realized that we are ready to start serving again. We have just begun and I'm so excited to see what God has in store for us in our blessed journey with The Fellowship, which I'm so grateful for!!! My wife and I have been coming to The Fellowship  for over a year now and from day one they made us feel like family! The messages are real, the people are loving and we have a brand new church family thank you so much Jesus for the Fellowship Church! I love this church the ppl or friendly n godly I've never been more comfortable than this church while attending church it's like I can feel God's presence as soon as I enter the grounds. I understand the true meaning of fellowship when we did mulching never even knee what mulch was until I enrolled in serve fest n seen the smiles on ppl faces when we transformed the yards into manicured yards brought life to their beautiful homes n allowed the team to pray for them.. Visited for a memorial service. I really enjoyed how you presented the gospel at the end. Only complaint i have is when I tried to compliment you you just ignored me.  Not cool for a pastor to do

name: The Fellowship Church Round Rock - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary: We love The Fellowship! Donnie is a wonderful pastor! His sermons are informative and engaging with humor mixed in. I love how thorough he is in his biblical teaching. I enjoy how he uses maps, and really goes into detail about the history of the regions and people that he is discussing. Maybe it’s just because I’m a history nerd, but it’s one of the things that really sets this church apart from others. I also really like that he goes book by book and chapter by chapter. Being part of this church has really been a wonderful learning experience. They also have a great children’s and student ministry. My daughter is on the spectrum. So finding someplace that could meet her needs was very important to us. No matter where you are in life there is someplace for you at this church. I love 💕 this church ⛪️… Donnie is engaging, intelligent in the books of the Bible, and truly fun and interesting to listen to…. I will be moving away in a year and pray that I will be able to find a church like this one… I understand that people call to try to get assistance and it’s understandable that some churches aren’t able to help but what’s not understandable is a Preacher, man, being so judgmental and so negative and so rude to someone that’s in a hard situation that was only asking help for gas. I have never experienced such a rude manner trying to get someone help. Pastor Donny is the best preacher I’ve seen in the greater Austin area. He sticks to the Word. Teaches the Bible book by book, but includes many cross references to other parts of the Bible to give cultural and geographical context so you’re actually learning. And it all points to Jesus. I wish I found this church sooner. I first came to a Saturday night service and then a Sunday morning service. Both are great experiences. It has taken me a long time to find a church home where my kids and I have truly felt welcomed and wanted. Pastor Jessie is the best and he has brought me closer to wanting to know more about Jesus. My kids love their Sunday School classy and cant wait to go back each week.

name: The Fellowship Ministries - Mt. Juliet / Wilson County Campus
reviewSummary: My kids love attending and have made many friendships here. The men's group is an answer to prayer and my wife and I feel at home. Scott, Steve, Rob and Aaron are welcoming, personal and care about the community. Love this Church. Everyone is welcome. Come check it out. This is a great church. As a 1st time visitor we felt very comfortable and at home. The worship the people were very inviting and authentic. The children's ministry is very organized and my 10 year daughter seems to be very happy. Fellowship is the most wonderful church experience I have ever had. The music is incredible and Rob is the most inspirational minister I have ever heard. This church has changed my life! The Fellowship Mount Juliet is more than just a place to love and worship Jesus.  Its a place where people love each other, and love to share the love of Christ in their community and across the globe.  There's a sense of belonging to something bigger than yourself when you walk in these doors.

name: The Fellowship of Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful church family, warm and welcoming to share the love of Jesus with! Come early for Sunday School (all ages welcomed)  for an intimate setting to learn and ask questions, along with age appropriate teaching for the children. Wonderful Pastor, wonderful church people and wonderful teaching of Gods word and presence of God! Think the Westborough Baptist church but a bit less extreme when it comes to public image, but don't let that fool you, deep down this place is just as bad.

name: The Fellowship of San Antonio
reviewSummary:
Absolutely wonderful church! We’ve been attending for a while and truly love it! Pastor Royce is excellent about preaching the Bible and he is so welcoming. The church is so family friendly. Ms Brenna is absolutely wonderful with her kids programming and opportunities. There are volunteer events and donation opportunities that are very do-able! We especially enjoy baking for the first responders monthly and donation opportunities to help different ministries across the city. We are truly grateful and blessed to have found the Fellowship! Fellowship of San Antonio is a warm welcoming place to worship. Pastor Royce gives biblical based teachings and is a very friendly pastor.
If you’re looking for a wonderful place to worship, visit Fellowship of San Antonio.
You will definitely feel the love of the Holy Spirit filling the church.
Watch Pastor Royce on U Tube to see what we experience every week.  ✝️♥️ Such a welcoming, diverse, humble place. Walking the property, seeing the deer feeders, the trees, the iron kiosk,   the simple but intentional architecture, brings me peace, as soon as I get here.This is the type of congregation that is the perfect size, not too big to isolate you and not so small that there aren't enough activities to choose from.  Pastor Royce is without a doubt a gift and a blessing to all. Under his direction,  Ministries help locally and internationally.  Volunteers are consistent, disciplined, they truly give it their best effort. Many of them even bring happiness to do chores playfully.  I personally attend a couple of places for spiritual reasons because I  travel for work. I can honestly say this is one of my favorite spots to recharge mentally, spiritually and to gain a humble perspective to face life's challenges as a blessing.  Thank you FOSA The Fellowship of San Antonio is by far the kindest, most caring, and loving church. Pastor Royce and O’Brien are amazing. Pastor Royce welcomed my family and I the first time we visited. It is such a privilege to hear and learn more about the Word of God taught by these pastors. They are humble, honest, and teach straight from the Bible. I absolutely fell in love with everything about this church. I love the Fellowship Church. It is just what I feel like the Church of the New Testament was meant to be. Pastor Royce preaches the written Word of God. He takes the time to personally meet & greet all the members of the congregation every Sunday. The people are warm & friendly. Our Sunday school teacher is outstanding. It is truly like being a part of a community of Faith.
