name: The Field Church - Mandeville Campus
reviewSummary:
John 14:6.... My family and I love this church and have grown and our knowledge by consistent expository preaching. The best church to bring to bring your young children. There are signs at The Field Church of strong doctrinal conviction, high expectations for behavior, emphasis on obedience, holiness, submission. These can lean toward what some perceive as legalism if not balanced by grace, humility, mercy. I came to this church as a result of their evangelism team visiting my neighborhood. I was visited by two young men I believe to be in their early twenties. They were collecting a spiritual survey on their phones that I agreed to participate in. I was open about my church history and church trauma but told them I would be there to check it out. I also told them I didn’t know how long I would stay as I have to follow my peace and where God leads me. I checked out their website ahead of time and didn’t want to go after seeing the section under The Gospel. I believe the Gospel to be the Good News of Jesus’ love. The section was focused more on the law rather than love. I went anyway because I had given my word to these two men to try it. I got to the church about 15 minutes early and was greeted outside by a man and a lady. The man shook my hand and the lady was ready with a name tag letting me know that everyone in church wears a name tag. (She could sense my apprehension) She asked if I was new and when I said yes, she added a smiley face to my tag. I asked to have one without the smiley since she confirmed it meant I was new. It’s important for me to see how people treat others without the label. She gave me a name tag with just my name. The man showed me around and was very kind. Coffee is available and everyone is able to move around freely which I was happy to see. Kids were also welcomed and allowed to be kids. One other lady told me hello, I could see she didn’t recognize me and looked to my tag and smiled politely. The pastor was not out greeting people and didn’t come out until it was time for someone to mic him up and begin. Demographics were all white presenting except for one black gentlemen. When I left (I left early during the “giving basket”) another family of color was coming into church. I asked them if the church was inclusive and the man asked “in what regard.”  I read the bulletin and noticed the section where a board of 7 Elders were listed. All of the board members were men. During announcements, a man spoke about church membership and said after submitting an application, membership would be “considered.”  It was at this point that I made the decision to leave early. I give two stars for kindness and kid-friendly. If you are looking for traditional religion that isn’t Catholicism, this could be for you. If you are craving expositional teaching, this is the place for you. No fluff just straight teaching of God's word. Really like the open architecture of the building. Many large windows which provide a spacious and bright view the outside.

The worship was unlike most of the non denominational churches of today in that the volume was not so loud that ear plugs are needed.  I did not see many hands raised in worship. The message was more “Bible College” oriented as opposed to one where the speaker was inspired to preach a message they felt in their spirit, however I learned a lot of interesting facts and an perspective on the implications behind the author of the book being covered (in this case Paul the apostle) and how it affected the Roman political system in place. The reception from the congregants was overwhelming in their kindness and love.

name: The Fields Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church to call home. I started going to the fields 8 years ago when I moved to the area and it has been such a blessing to be a part of the community and family there. The teaching is great and centered on the Bible and the community is very friendly, welcoming, and supportive. If you are looking for a church in the area I couldn't recommend the Fields enough We’ve been at this church about 6 years now and it really does feel more like family than just a place we go on Sundays. It didn’t take long to get connected either, it just kind of happened naturally, no pressure or weirdness, just real relationships forming over time. The pastors are humble and genuinely care about people, and even though no church is perfect, this one is real and we’re really grateful to call it home. The Fields has been my church for about 10 years now. This is a great church where the gospel is preached every week, people are pointed to Christ, and the Bible is faithfully taught. The community here is genuinely welcoming and Christ-centered. I started going to this church March of last year. As someone who struggles to understand the word completely I love how this church has been taking the time to break down what is being taught in the word. They also have some solid opportunity to build relationship in community throughout the week which has added positively in my life. The fields church truly is a church that emulates what it looks like to show Christ like love to everyone. If you’re interested in a new church I found this one and it’s absolutely great! The community is amazing the people within the church community make you feel welcomed. They will seek out new faces to ensure you find your new church home!

name: The Firehouse Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary: I am so thankful that they let our group meet in their wonderful facility on Sunday evenings!  By doing so you literally saved my life! A place where family and friends come together to share and encourage each other in the Hope we have through the Power of the Gospel of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ! Great place. Keep up the hard work I went there with sister. Peaceful place. Great experience. Nice and cool atmosphere. I enjoyed it a lot.

name: The Flipside Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: We love The Flipside, Pastor Kev and all the staff and volunteers. We’ve been a part of a really big church, but Flipside feels like home. Every week the message is Biblical and aligned with the teaching of Jesus. There’s plenty of opportunities to serve and grow your faith. We highly recommend I started attending this church as my home church in January 2025. I was despondent, just destroyed when my beautiful wife passed away on October 26,2024. The care ministry was a game changer! Jaymee in particular was incredibly kind, understanding and extremely helpful! It did not take long for me to reach a plateau that I could function in again. They have a very dynamic children's ministry, all kinds of outreach opportunities, and the teaching! Straight up Biblical truth! Pastor Kev is a very astute, kind, personable and dynamic teacher. You will not be falling asleep here!  The Worship music is incredible (and historically, I have never been a big fan of modern Worship music!) But, after being a Christian for almost 40 years. I finally feel that I am at the right place at the right time. Come to Flipside Church in Rancho Cucamonga! I can be found in the audiovisual room at the third service each Sunday! Ask for Phil! Pastor Kev, is awesome. However,  pastor Jimmy is a great as well. It's a safe place for kids of all ages. People are so warm and welcoming. The atmosphere along with the teachings, transcends into piece. You feel the love and power God has.. This church is refreshing! They love Jesus and each other! The ministry leaders go out of their way to find ways to serve God's people well! The lead pastor is a humble and powerful man of God, He loves the sheep and preaches the truth! My wife and I love this place! A truly amazing Church! If you are looking for a place you will be truly welcomed no matter what, this is the place for you. A true Church family. Every week pastor Kevin's sermons speak to your heart and mind. There are growth groups offered as well to help strengthen your bond with God and his followers.

name: THE FORGIVING CHURCH - Beachwood / Shaker Heights Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for some where to fellowship?
Look no further...wonderful place to talk with God😇 It ok, but they want money all the time. I love 💘 my Church

name: The Foundry Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
This community oriented church is wonderful. They dont just talk the talk, but walk the walk here. Not only are their services, they are engaging, and heart felt. They have several programs to help the community out with strengthening your Christian walk, recovery and food. I am so blessed to have found the Foundry. What a horrible experience we just had here with Alex at your food pantry.  We drove all the way from Vista to get food and when we arrived had to park at the bottom of a hill, get out the wagon (we were instructed to bring a cart) and walk up to where the food is distributed.  I am disabled, do not have the spare gas money to spend getting here and back home (empty-handed), and this was not easy.  We arrived at 1:00, but after the extra walking up the hill and wagon ordeal, it took us until 1:03 to get to the top.  Once there, I was informed they're closed and told to speak with the supervisor when I inquired further. I walked over to the area where Alex, the supervisor was and waited for her to be available, then spoke with her.  She pointed to the clock on her wall which read 1:05 and said she is closed, has handed out all the numbers, and doesn't have anymore food.  I explained my situation and she repeated herself. I am completely APPALLED and DISGUSTED at this treatment!  There are people walking away with carts FULL of food....they are NOT out of food!  (I wonder if she just gave 1 can, 1 bag of beans, 1 box, or 1 vegetable, etc less per person.... this would by far make enough to accommodate an entire "order".).  I can not conceive, however, how your church would completely turn us away for food, and so rudely. We specifically went to The Foundry because we previously had a positive experience there at a church service.  THIS is NOT the same Christ-like people that The Foundry is remembered for.
What a shame to deny food to God's children. Shame on Alex and shame on The Foundry! I grew up attending church, listening to the Gospel, but not really. Being part of The Foundry Community Church reminded me of what a disciple should be like. It's a true blessing to serve God and serve others. Everyone I've spoken to about this church is spoken very highly of it with pure shear gratitude and I am going to go for the first time today I will let you know how my experiences afterwards but I'm more so sure that it will be lovely and joyous I came to The Foundry Commity Church through it's Recovery program, and then I felt totally welcomed to the new family I found here. Definitely a place that loves this community.

name: The Fountain Church - Suwanee Campus
reviewSummary: If you're looking for a church home, THIS IS IT!  My wife and two young boys found The Fountain and haven't looked back.  GREAT children's team, phenomenal people, and a Bible-centered church that is approaching everything differently and making it relevant for this generation.  You can view all the messages on the website to see what I mean, and make sure to stop in to experience a service.  You WILL NOT be disappointed! Very open and welcoming staff and church members! My kids love to attend because they have a blast learning in the preschool classrooms! Very nice community, the pastor and his family are welcoming and childcare is great! A friendly Bible-based church for people of all ages!  It has an awesome worship service and fantastic children's program! Very welcoming, friendly, and Christ-centered.

name: The Fountain Church International - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has changed my life and allowed me to grow in my relationship with God and seek him daily! From living in sin daily, coming to church weekly over time God helped me through bishop to grow and realize what I needed to change and my life has been filled with God ever since! My life has changed since joining Fountain of Love. Pastor and all the leadership are Spirit led. Everything is done in excellence.. a loving environment.. you will most definitely experience the power of God. You will grow strong in the Spirit , in wisdom, and in every area of your life. It's up to you how far you go. Come see for yourself. A man of God truly in love with the heart of God,  his wife and family, and serving God's people! A church with awesome word and unbelievable worship experience and atmosphere. I have yet to find another church like this since I've been. Trust me, if you go your life will never be the same! 😎🙏🏾🙌🏾 Great word and good teaching love this church I love this church. GOD is in this place, over Bishop Jarron O'Neal & his beautiful wife Lady C. The choir and the band are truly anointed. It's a friendly loving, caring atmosphere, and always a wonderful greeting every Sunday. ALWAYS A POWERFUL WORD SPOKEN THROUGH BISHOP JARRON WHEN HE IS DELIVERING GOD'S MESSAGE.
Thank you, GOD, for sending me here.

name: The Garden Community Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
The Garden is a breath of fresh air!  It is very different from a traditional church, featuring a great band, current music, and an uplifting message.  The people at this church are very welcoming and non-judgmental. If ever you find yourself in pursuit of a loving , understanding, welcoming group of diverse beliefs and lifestyles...come to The Garden!!!  On Sundays at 9:15, we enjoy music, a message, and coffee and donuts with friends and family.  You won't be disappointed...I assure you. This church fills my spiritual tank! The people are warm and inviting. The minister Carolyn is amazing, down to earth, and so engaging. Plus hey you can eat bagels during the service! Are you church shopping???
Come to The Garden—-music, videos and a short message that you will think about all week long. Come as you are and enjoy donuts and coffee. 9:15 at Beef and Boards Just like the mission statement of The Garden states, an open and inclusive place.  A very welcoming church with a unique atmosphere.

Annette Hutchison

name: The Gate Christian Bible Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A great Bible based friendly church that will welcome everyone
Come check us out next Sunday at 9:00 AM. Developing fully devoted followers of Christ. The only living that matters is living by God's design. In God we trust!

name: The Gate Church - Franklin Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent congregation of the most friendly people you'll ever meet. The salt of the earth. Music is fantastic, not the loud, brash, hard rock as you hear in some churches (although I do enjoy it sometimes being a musician) but of a soft, easy listening music that allows the Holy Spirit to appear and make the congregation sing and praise GOD. The Pastor will anoint you with The Word of God, make his perils of wisdom known, and will be relentless in energy in speaking to the congregation. Truly an enjoyable experience regardless of your denomination. Please visit, I guarantee you'll experience the same thing I have. A breath of fresh air in the right direction for anyone tired of the business of church. Ancient Wisdom spills out to anyone ready to learn.  Love pours into anyone ready to receive. Direction to those seeking a map. Welcoming and not fake.. genuine...if you don't know how a real relationship with God will change your life you won't have to wait long in their presence to understand. It's good to still see what real living with hope looks like. . Awesome place to experience talented Spirit lead worship. This smaller community sized fellowship is worth a visit. Very much enjoyed people, message and service. Went here to vote, at least that was a nice experince 👍

name: The Gateway Church
reviewSummary: My family & I worshiped with Gateway for a handful of months during a temporary, in-between season of life. What love we did experience in that short season from the Gateway community was wonderful. And I could just gush about Pastor Kyle, who's big brain is only outdone by his even bigger heart. (Also the best preaching I've probably ever sat under, to boot.) Grateful for this church. This is the first church in Des Moines that I've truly felt like I've belonged. I absolutely love the pastor and congregation here and consider it my home. Great for families with or without children. The gateway church ROCKS. A church that truly cares about the community and the people too. I look forward to seeing what God does with the gateway in the future. Clarity of Biblical teaching relevant to today, friendly folks, beautiful music. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: The Gathering at Corona - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a church this is the place.  This church is a family oriented environment.  Offering awesome praise and worship.  Pastor Seymour has recently taken the position as lead pastor. He is an awesome man of God who is encouraging and fill of the word of God.  So it and visit.  Hey connected.  See your life changed. Great family church.  They teach truth.  They really love people here and pray when they say they are going to pray.  I am amazed at how supportive this church is, not clicky at all. There are alot of good churches but this one I will love forever.  Such amazing people to fellowship with. The presence of the Holy Spirit was very evident and worship and the message were both excellent. Love this church!

name: The Gathering Church
reviewSummary: Good church. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: The Gathering Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary: The is no longer Keypointe.  This is now The Gathering Church.  It's a great small town church.  Everyone is friendly, and the pastor is a very realistic man.  I love it. Awesome Chruch! Great community and people,  as soon as your in the door you are family. Love this building! Had great times here Love going to church there. It's the true spirit of the LORD JESUS CHRIST AMEN

name: The Gathering Church - Surprise Campus
reviewSummary:
The Gathering has become so much more than just a church to me—it’s home.
As a musician and singer, worship is a huge part of my relationship with God, and the praise and worship here is absolutely incredible. Every week, the worship team leads with excellence, authenticity, and a heart fully focused on Jesus. You can truly feel the presence of the Holy Spirit, and I leave every service feeling refreshed, encouraged, and on fire for the Lord.
One of the greatest blessings has been getting to know Pastor Jon. He’s the real deal—genuine, humble, and deeply invested in the people God has entrusted to him. No matter how busy he is, he takes the time to connect with people, and that personal touch means more than words can express.
The biblical teaching is solid, the people are welcoming and loving, and there’s an authenticity here that’s hard to find. This isn’t about putting on a show—it’s about creating a place where people can encounter Jesus and grow in their faith.
If you’re looking for a church where the Holy Spirit is welcomed, the worship is powerful, and you’ll be loved from the moment you walk in, I can’t recommend The Gathering enough. I moved to Arizona from NWI this past year. I was conflicted about seeking a church here due to many reasons so I watched my home church online. In recent months I realized my family was often distracted including myself Wednesday and Sunday mornings.

So I decided to seek out churches in the neighborhood. I met two moms at the park one day. Both told me about their experiences with different churches in the area and recommended the church they were attending Gathering was one. My daughter attended a few services of another big church but didn't feel the connection due to the Pastor being televised instead of in person. Which is no problem it's not to shame any church. Another local church I watched the service on YouTube at first and felt a nodge to attend. I was greeted outside but once instead it felt like a cold room with everyone giving me weird looks. Honestly I've never had that experience. At first I thought it was due to race but seeing ppl my race I just took it as everyone isn't welcoming. Even when the Pastor mentioned shake your neighbors hand, no one turned towards me. I never went back.

So I decided to take a month before going to another one. I felt discouraged but not defeated. I thought about the mom who told me to try The Gathering Church.

We decided to attend Sunday service three weeks ago. Honestly it was the best experience I've ever had with church. I was welcomed by everyone at the door. A young lady named Heather greeted me and show me to the area for sitting, even after service she approached me to see how I enjoyed service bought some gear.

The Pastor is awesome! He connects bible scriptures with experiences we face in life with great notes to look back on and reflect. He's funny but serious about making sure we get the word clearly. I pick up on everything, I've never felt anything negative from him or the church. The youth Pastor was awesome as well. My children have attended the group sessions for young adults and middle school age. All good things. My children enjoy services as well. By the third week I was comfortable bringing my entire family. My son was cared for and happy after picking him up from childcare. That's a plus! I was able to hear the word and not worry.

Thank you Gathering. I'm happy God has placed you all with a building to continue pouring into the community.

Not to mention, when I have my Gathering gear on I'm approached by members in excitement to share their experience with the church. All positive. First-Time Visitor

I visited this church for the first time this past Sunday. While the church promotes lively, family-friendly programming during the holiday season, my personal experience left me uncertain about returning.

I was greeted and shown where to go, which I appreciated. However, when I approached the pastor after the service to introduce myself and my family, the interaction felt brief, distant, and unwelcoming. A tap on the shoulder felt more like a signal to move along than an invitation to connect, which set the tone for me as a first-time visitor.

I am intentionally seeking a church that focuses on biblical teaching and the Word of God—without political messaging—and that models unity and genuine inclusiveness from its leadership. While the environment may appear welcoming on the surface, I did not personally experience the warmth or sense of belonging that would encourage me to return. Love this place!  Just started going and plan to join some ministries. Highly recommend! A church my family and I call "home". We love this church and the biblical teachings that come with the Sunday sermons as well as the amazing youth ministries!

name: The Gathering Church In Centerville - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary:
Six months ago I searched churches in Google and the Gathering really stuck out to me. Best google search I ever made!

My first visit I was so shocked to find a church so awesome in my backyard. The gathering is so welcoming when you walk in and it’s easy to walk straight to the worship center where you will experience great corporate worship and a gospel packed message that’s delivered in such a clear way.

I have been every Sunday since that first visit and still experience the same great experience. Plus I continue to discover more and more about this church that makes it a great place for the community being a church that preaches Gods Word and lives it out! Went here with my three year for the Dayton Fall Festival.. Directions took me right to they building fine and we had a wonderful time together. Very wonderful staff ❤️ Great teaching, awesome people, many opportunities to get connected. My teenage daughter and son are asking to go to church just to hear Pastor David preach (if we have a busy weekend, they do not mind to wake up earlier to go to 9:30 service). My whole family loves this church! Wonderful church!   The senior pastor Dave Rudd delivers an absolutely fantastic message each and every week.  I leave each sermon more enthused about the my relationship with God, then when I came. Steve Nuzzo is the connections pastor, and also does a fantastic job!   He had put together a team that always makes new visitors feel so comfortable, and his videos (top 3) are hilarious. The Worship team does a very good job each week with the music.  I've been at this church now for 20+ years, and I would never consider going anywhere else!   You only have to come one time, and you'll want to stay for a lifetime! I started attending the Gathering with my wife Susan about 4 years ago.  From the very first visit we felt welcomed.  We were invited by very close friends of ours Steve and Bari Stasko.  We came back because we liked the music and especially the messages from Pastor David.  He has a way of incorporating his own family experiences to make messages from the Bible become clearer and easier to understand.
My wife passed away and went to be with the Lord on October 10, 2020.  David came to our house and prayed with Susan just a few weeks earlier.  The Gathering truly has compassionate people as there were 500 people who attended a huge tent Memorial service 1 week later.

I would like to invite whoever is reading this to attend either the 9:30AM or the 11:00AM service on any Sunday.  It will be a decision which could change your present circumstances.

name: The Gathering OKC - Oklahoma City Campus
reviewSummary: I love coming to the gathering every Tuesday. It’s somewhere I truly feel that I belong and has helped me grow so much in my faith. The community is so fun loving and I love getting to come and worship the Lord every week along side of these fellow believers! I definitely recommend if you want somewhere to belong and be known and grow more like Christ! The Gathering isn’t just a place to worship or grow in your faith, it’s a faith filled home. The people invite you in, pursue you, equip you, and empower you to become more like Christ. Best decision I have made was to take a leap of faith and find the community that turned into family! I have felt a safe space and community in OKC because of the Gathering. I love the worship and the meaningful lyrics in each song, and each message is based in Scripture and filled with the Holy Spirit. I started coming because of Sunday night sand volleyball, and I’m forever grateful for the impact this ministry has had on my life!! The gathering has been a place of love and acceptance for me and has lead me to my best friends and support system. The gathering is such a light in my week and full of love, encouragement, and fun! I could not recommend it more for all young adults in the okc area! The Gathering is an amazing experience for young adults in their 20’s and 30’s and gives them many opportunities to get connected with other people their age. Everyone is very warm and welcoming to everyone. Great place if you are looking for a godly community!

name: The Gathering Place - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
For over 20 years I've called TGP a "Gideon's army Church"... Leaders and Core are a  wonderful group of Mature believers. Services are led by the Holy Spirit, with meaningful worship, anointed sharing of the WORD, a healthy integration of the Prophetic, faith for His Healing...
TGP has an emphasis on powerful Intercession (for the city of LA & our nation)! Pastors Rick and Pam truly care about their people & can also pastor the mature in Christ so well! (So rare/hard to find.) I love this Community of /in Christ! As a relatively new convert, I was on the lookout for a welcoming space. I'm coming out of a long relationship with another faith and lost a lot of my old innocence. I'd worshipped the old beasts, electrical rats, sexy bunnies, Professors. But I was left with an emptiness. No matter how much energy I accumulated, how much I evolved, I still felt the emptiness.
But at The Gathering Place, I learned about Magic. While I'd previously walked the plains, I could now overcome my summoning sickness and tap that thang. No longer was I a follower of the sparky rodent, I now had ... aura. Great Pastors, leadership & fellowship with like-minded believers !!! You are getting fed the meat of the word ...such a safe place with rock solid teaching from the true word of God ! TGP is the real deal , Generals of intercession reside here so much love also 🩷 and because of that, THE HOLY SPIRIT moves powerfully 🩷 The Lord is at The Gathering Place! I received the Baptism of The Holy Spirit with the gift of speaking in tongues there. Pastors Jim and Pam are such wonderful servants of God. They yield to the flow of the Holy Spirit and teach His word soundly. If I hadn't moved to Arizona I would still be there. :) God bless TGP! The clear world of God and what God is doing in the world today....a amazing mixing of the truth of the word and power and gifts of the spirit! Wonderful place where Kingdom reigns. Highly recommend!

name: The Gathering Place Atlanta - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: I have found a great place to worship and feel at home, no one to judge, just a warm and welcoming and energetic atmosphere. Incredibly inclusive and diverse non-denominational Christian church. LGBTQ+ affirming. Lively worship music and welcoming crowd. Try it out if you're looking for a church that accepts you just as you are. Great place to worship, in the spirit... The pastor does well with meshing so many talented backgrounds to just worship his son Jesus Christ This church is amazing! So warm and welcoming! The pastor is so knowledgeable and kind. Awesome and super welcoming friendly church! Contemporary style! LGBT community are most welcome!!!

name: The Gathering Place Church - Folsom Campus
reviewSummary: I attended there about 3 years ago and wasn't impressed at all. Only had 1 service on Sunday and absolutely nothing else during the  week. I had a friend approach the pastor about a men's ministry and the pastor said he should start it. Quite honestly the pastor was completely unqualified and lazy to run the church. He had no desire for Bible study during the week or any other ministry except to preach 1 sermon on Sunday The Gathering Place in Folsom is a beautiful place to be on Sunday mornings.  The people are very welcoming and friendly.  Pastor Bobby always seems to have a great message that's so applicable for daily, meaningful, and spiritual living.  His sense of humor and perspective are enjoyable.  They also have great play areas and activities for children of all ages.  My family feels at peace and closer to God every time we visit.  We have been coming to this church for almost 3 months now and plan on making this special weekly service a very important part of our lives.  Amen God! From the moment you step inside the lobby, you are greeted with a friendly smile, cup of coffee, and a delicious pastry. Such a warm and loving environment. You really feel the presence of God’s love. The worship music is contemporary and lyrics are displayed on large screens so you can sing along. Pastor Bobby Key gives a Bible teaching that is enlightening and thoughtful with bits of humor.  He teaches directly from the Bible and cites scripture references throughout.  I would highly recommend this church for anyone seeking a deeper understanding of the Bible and a place that makes you feel part of the family of God. If you're looking for a place to feel welcomed in just as you are, remembered when you come back, and loved in spite of your shortcomings, this is the place to be! I love this church. I've been attending for over a year and half, and the family feel I have had here is astounding. I have yet to be a part of a church where I've felt so loved; people truly care about my life and desire to see me fall more deeply in love with Jesus. The teaching here by Pastor Bobby is always dead on with scripture and God's heart for the church. They have a great kids program for families with young children. You can feel the heart of Jesus behind this church, that each person might come to know the love of Christ and encounter His purpose for their life. It's also a great place to get plugged in for ministry. From growth groups to helping greet on Sunday mornings. I love this church! Starts with excellent worship, then Pastor delivers God's message. The congregation is small enough to get to know people but large enough to avoid if that is prefered.

name: The Good Fight Church - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Josh has a very defined spirit about him. He may look young, but he has very, very strong spirit and attitude. Very biblically, correct and accurate. When it comes to only Bible teachings, he is biblically accurate, and it only comes out of his mouth. If it's in the Bible so he is very devout to the word. And he only speaks from the word, and I appreciate his honesty. I do enjoy this church and his leadership skills This church has been such a blessing in my life! It’s a place where I’ve been able to truly grow in my relationship with God while being encouraged to be my authentic self. The loving community has supported me in every season, helping me deepen my faith and understand what it means to walk with Christ daily. The teaching is grounded in truth, and the worship is spirit-filled, creating an atmosphere where God’s presence is felt. The Good Fight Church is full of authentic, loving people who love God and love others just as the Bible tells us too. I always love walking in and hearing “welcome home” every time I entered. It’s one of the greatest things to hear every week. This is a great church filled with great people who love God and their community. Would recommend to anyone thinking about going! This church has been a huge blessing to my family. It is a church that is about the community and restoration for those who feel broken (we are all broken) and where anyone and everyone is welcome.

It has had an impact in my personal and spiritual life from the service as well as seeing how friendly and genuinely the pastor and all leadership and members care about individuals and serving others. It is a church that is about building to serve.

If you are reading this I encourage and invite you to come and see why I call it home. The people are great very nice. The pastor does an excellent job preaching the word of God. One of the better churches I have gone to in a long time. You can feel the Holy Spirit working when you walk in. Definitely recommend if you are in the area I drive an hour to go when I can.

name: The Grove Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: The community within The Grove is amazing, it's easy to find someone to connect with & you can tell people actually care for one another. Guests are always welcome here, come to have a delicious cup of free coffee and stay for the welcoming people, moving worship  and encouraging messages. Used to go here, during covid people would mostly wear masks UNTIL worship began, then almost everybody would take them off? Not smart. Great community!  We love the Grove. My experience is so wonderful I am joining this church.

name: The Grove Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you inviting the community to your Easter Egg hunt event. Having at Midtown Elementary was lovely. My daughter and her friends enjoyed the playground, getting the surprises in the eggs, the face painting, and all the other activities. Thanks for the snacks and kids story time and the prayer. You all were warm and genuinely inviting and kind. I have been attending the Grove since April of 2011. In that time I have made so many good friends and I have been able to take part in several of the ministry's that the church offers. I highly suggest visiting, the church is full of loving people, pastor Ross knows his stuff, and there is more than enough room for you... No matter what the parking lot looks like!
When you visit feel free to search the room for me and introduce yourself I'll either sit with you so you don't get that weird sitting alone feeling, or I can introduce someone to you if I am helping in a ministry that morning. We have a lot to offer. Life Groups and Ministries for all age groups. 2 services. We are a large church but we are like family. Love this church. Programs for all your needs with caring and compassionate staff. Makes you feel like part of a large extended family. Not pushy or overbearing just very welcoming. Teaching truth straight from the Bible. My husband and I love this church.  We felt welcome from the first day we came to visit in 2017.  This is a fellowship where you don't feel like you are judged by what you wear... come as you are!  The worship is awesome... my type of worship.  The messages definitely speak to me each weeks.  The nursery, toddlers, children and youth ministries are wonderful, a great place for littles to learn about Jesus.  Come visit!

name: The Grove Community Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church off and on for a few years, while my parents were active members of this church, as well.  I applied to dedicate my son to the Lord at this church when he was about 8 months old. I had to make an appointment with the youth pastor and was on a waiting list for about a month or two. When it was finally time for our appointment, we arrived at the church offices, had to check in at the front desk (very corporate style), waited for the youth pastor, and went into his office where we were interviewed/ interrogated. Long story short, we were turned down. (Never knew that was even possible) The youth pastor said that he didn't think that we were ready to dedicate my child. (Side note: I have been going to church my entire life) He gave us his business card and told us we could call him in a few weeks if we had questions. This church never checked back in with us, never asked how they could support us, never asked if we were still interested, nothing.

Nevertheless, we were able to find another church that welcomed us with open arms, they loved us, lead us, taught us, and offered support if needed. We dedicated our baby boy shortly after. It was beautiful. I contemplated on writing this review for some time, but decided this needed to be known. I was very disappointed in this negative experience by The Grove Community Church, and I have not been back since. (I am a Black-American for context) Visited for sunrise Easter service last week, and really enjoyed it! I live in HTX but was in the area for a wellness retreat. The church was about a mile walk away, which was super pleasant! I would definitely again if I were in the area! My host said she attends weekly midweek women's Bible study. Attended an event at their community center. Beautiful grounds, clean and welcoming. In the book of Luke 4:18-19 it talks about preaching the Gospel. This church needs to preach the gospel at every sermon so that Jesus Christ can save his people. I pray may the Lord bless this church and put it in their hearts to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ. What happens if a person goes to this church and they're not preaching the Gospel then the next day that person takes their life? PREACH GOD, PREACH JESUS. Visited from out of town for Easter and really enjoyed it! Seems like the people are very friendly and the pastor preached in a way that was easy to understand and keep me engaged. Its a big church but seems like when you get plugged in you'll find community there!

name: The Harvest - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I were ready to give up on church altogether when we stumbled upon Harvest a little over a year ago. This isn't even really a church. It is a ministry and a family, with a church attached. You know that your tithe money is going to be used to love and help the community rather than on expensive lighting rigs or something like that. And Pastor Dan's messages are challenging and new. NEVER "listen to me 'cause I am the pastor" and ALWAYS "here is a new and different way to think about this topic, decide if it is right for you." Questions are welcome! Broken people are welcome! And DIVERSITY is welcomed including LGBTQ+! If you are sick and tired of the typical toxic evangelical church presentation, then please visit Harvest. I think you will find it to be a breath of fresh air just like we did. Harvest House provides supportive community services to the homeless, veterans and families in need of housing support. Church service on Sunday at 10. I went two Sundays in a row while on vacation and it was a wonderful experience. Dan's sermons were spirited and genuine, and the church is very loud about loving people the way Jesus would (and does) --- something that made us feel welcome immediately. The music here is beautiful and powerful, too! I was moved to tears each weekend. Great job to those singers and musicians! Thanks for the expired food it was a waste of time waiting in line I threw it all in the trash seems like all you guys are trying to do is poison people with expired food instead of trying and help them I hope the wrath of God comes down on your church This church is not like any other you will ever attend. The minute you walk in, you feel a warm welcome. Pastor Dan is amazing. Not only does he play guitar with the awesome band of many, (and he can sing), but his messages are heartfelt, real, and thought provoking. This church helps our community right here in Sarasota! There are many opportunities to meet nice caring people with several weekly functions/outings throughout each month. Come with an open mind and experience this for yourself, this just could be your church home as it unexpectedly became mine!

name: The Harvest Center Christian Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
Love 💖 💕 love my pasture and his wife, ALWAYS a comfort to join them for Services. Looking forward to seeing and joining in prayer's 🙏.God is Great 👑🌹💯 This is my new home church I was welcome with open arms and love Harvest Center Church was my very first church . When my mom entered the Gospel Rescue Mission I was a child and only knew hate and hurt . I trusted no one and I couldn’t even imagine loving someone . Pastors not only took my family to church every Wednesday and Sunday but invested time and love into us . From helping us learn the word to showing us Gods light in themselves.I was able to learn about God and know what it means to be loved in a real way . I have devoted many hours here at this church and nothing goes un appreciated . Every need the community has the Pastor’s take to heart, they fight everyday for what’s right and fair . Harvest Center Christian Church is involved in a number of things from prison ministry to feeding  those in need . This last August they gave backpacks to those in need and not only that clothing and hair cuts . They go above and beyond for anyone . God leads their life and this church . As a member I know first hand this church moves and does what God has for us to do . I am so blessed God called these amazing people to be the Pastors over this church . My brothers were saved through this ministry. That is a miracle.
They loved me when I spit in their faces. Anyone who can endure me, really walks in love. I have a lot to walk through in life. I wish I had been more patient and mature before I left Arizona. The things the church pastors have gone through have made them stronger and it shows. I’m sorry for the chaos I caused. This has been my church for 16 years! Pastor Barrera's have been so loving,encouraging and they preach the Gospel. They  teach, preach and walk the Word of God. I fully support therm and have seen the church grow into what it is today. Come down and be saved, filled and anointed by The Holy Spirit. I thank God for all they have done to make my life better.
Capt. Noel Evans
Las Cruces Corps

name: The Heart Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary: Life-giving, Spirit-filled & Spirit-led. Bible based, even providing bible reading plans and teaching how to partner with God in bringing His purpose forward in our lives, His promises to fruition. Jesus-focused, and so many of their faces shine with the radiance of His peace and joy! Can't find my family. I have so many excuses in life bring me to see that some people get in the way of what life is. The Heart Church has been such a blessing to our family. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed with genuine kindness and love. The messages are biblically grounded, inspiring, and easy to apply to everyday life.

name: The Heart of Worship Church - Canton Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church. ❤️I have never felt more welcome to a church family as I have here. Both pastors have a clear and personal love for Jesus, a unique ability to understand and explain Gods word and a lot of wisdom and discernment into life and its struggles. Really glad to be a part of this church family. I believe they teach the word and only the word here without worrying how it’s going to make people “feel”.  I am thrilled to see a church that runs this way. I have had such a great experience at The Heart of Worship Church here in Canton, GA. The worship is anointed, the sermons are Biblically sound, and my family has enjoyed the genuine fellowship. This is not a huge church where you feel like a number-- everyone is valued. I have grown so much in my relationship with God in a very short amount of time since coming to this church. Highly recommended if you want to go deeper in your Christian walk! We'd love to have you visit. I have attended many churches of different denominations trying to find a church in Canton or surrounding areas that would teach or preach the true Word of God!!!                        One day I met a woman that worked in a clothing store in Canton, Georgia and told me about her church there by the name of Heart of Worship Church, I attended the very next Sunday. We were blessed to be there, I was welcome by Pastors and Professors Lance and Debi Halick. My husband Cap and I felt right at home and felt we were already a part of the church family, they all greeted us with open arms!!!!!!                                            The service was full of God’s Word and we felt the presence of the Holy Spirit so strong!!!!!!!!                                                               I didn’t realize it at the time they also were a credited college, a satellite of Life Christian University, the church named their collage, Heart of Worship Bible collage. Cap and I started classes at collage just after a few months, we gained such knowledge and drew closer to God!!!!! Pastor Lance has a way of teaching that makes it clear what the Bible is teaching us!!!!!                                      Unfortunately our finances changed and we were forced to move to Florida. My husband is very sick now and even with distance apart from church, Pastors Debi and Lance still continue to reach out and encourage us to God’s Holy Word,  it would be very hard to cope with what’s going on without there continues support of God’s Word!!!!!                                 I am praying I can return to my church someday and continue with my studies and do full time ministries helping others to know Jesus!!!                                     I want to thank my Pastors for changing my life by teaching the true Word of God!!!!!! Love you with all my heart!!!!!🙏❤️💁 What I love about this church is that although small in number, Pastors are greatly concerned about Illuminating the hearts of people to truth the  of God's Word and living a life of worship. I have gained much understanding and have been given much opportunity to draw closer to God. The people are loving and caring and make you feel at home. What a wonderful gathering of believers!  If you like "Word of Faith" teaching and a message that is simply the powerful Word of God then you will love The Heart of Worship Church.  You feel the genuine love from the members as you enter the building and the worship leads you into the heart of God to receive His Word.  This is a place that walks the talk and trains up powerful followers of Christ.

name: The Heights Church Denver - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Worst church experience I have ever had.

Quick edit: this is a direct quote from the sermon “… the main critique. They did not love God. It was an exercise in missing the point. Now listen, we have a name for that in 2026. Here's the name. The name is nominal Christianity.” So for the church’s response to my review, I heard the pastor loud and clear. He said the main criticism of Jesus towards people is those who go to church but do not fully go for the love of god. Demanding total devotion from the jump while shaming those who are still seeking, those who would be “Nominal Christians”, is a hallmark of high-control groups. This 'believe-or-else' mentality doesn't foster faith; it enforces a performance of blind obedience.

End of edit

I grew up catholic, went through all the sacraments (except marriage), did Sunday school my whole childhood, picked religious electives in high school and college because I was interested, but eventually I decided to take a break from religion. I considered myself agnostic for a while because I did not think I could definitely say the high power was God. Then I found out about Taoism because it taught that you don’t need to name anything, you can just be happy the world is beautiful without trying to find higher answers. Around 2 years ago I decided to start going back to church because I thought there might be signs pulling me back into it and I was looking to better my life.

Time after time, I got hit with resistance from members of the church members when I said I’m still questioning my religious beliefs. I kept trying to dig deeper though and trying to connect more on my own terms by myself, because I felt like an outcast and didn’t want to give the same hostility back to the people who gave it to me.

I decided to check out The Heights for the first time today and the lead pastor’s sermon made me realize I am done with church. His sermon focused on the angry Jesus, “the Jesus with a whip.” It was about how Jesus will stand up for what is right in the church. About how angry is a good thing, it’s how things get done when you’re truly passionate about something. I actually liked that message and agreed to a point. What I despised was how he finalized his message. He said the people that Jesus hates the most and would whip, are the people who go to church and are not full believers, even those ones who are trying to believe, aka me. He talked about how we are the worst type of people and we need to be punished. I had to walk out.

This is the reason I stepped away from religion in the first place. For one, how are you supposed to get new followers? You want people to start believing but you also don’t want people who are looking for religion to be in your church? That makes no sense, especially when he stated that he wants to baptize 365 people in 365 days, you just told everyone who is considering baptism that Jesus hates them more than anyone else. Secondly, how do you think it’s forgiving and understanding to outcast everyone who has different beliefs? That’s the reason I stepped away from religion. The hatred towards people with other beliefs, or questioning beliefs. You preach love thy neighbor to the world, then when you’re by yourselves you teach all others should be punished and not allowed to be in your community. I do not and will not ever have that mindset. I will accept everyone who is trying to be better no matter their beliefs or non beliefs. As long as you have good intentions, you’re good in my eyes. This church doesn’t have good intentions towards those who have differing beliefs and it honestly sickens me.

I am honestly done with Catholicism as a whole now. His single minded thinking and telling everyone that he expects everyone who attends that church to think the same is deplorable. If you want to find “salvation,” or to better yourself, but you’re not a full believer, I implore you to look elsewhere as you will be considered to be the most despisable type of person there is, according to the leader of The Heights. You will encounter God here as the Heights is a radically new testament church. Strong teaching, deep community, and missions focused. Not focused on the seating capacity but the sending capacity with church plants and local and global missions. Leadership is so clearly following what the Lord would have for this church. Come and be a part of what God is doing in Denver through the Heights. I have attended The heights for over a year I was baptized on March 22 2026 I love this church the service is so great.I never wanna leave the church.Please join us Went today for the first time so my review is based on just one visit, but MAN... how exciting to see what God is doing in Denver, just blocks from us. Totally packed, sound teaching, good music, pastor was actually funny too at times, but quite serious at others, perfect balance. A vibrant congregation from high schools to 50s and 60s and beyond. Really enjoyed it. Looking for a great group of people to connect with and do life with? Check out the Heights. They are the real deal and the church at it's best!

name: The Hill Church - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
It is a precious community building up the church, the body of the Lord.

It is a community I would highly recommend to those looking for a church community. A passionate church, a church sincere in worship

A church I want to keep to myself, yet one that simply cannot be hidden

You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden. / Matthew 5:14 It was a church full of grace.

name: The Hills Church
reviewSummary: Praise for its 'Mission' focus and 'Practical' application series. Originating from a Church of Christ heritage, it strikes a balance that appeals to a broad non-denominational audience. 'Inclusive' and 'Community' are top keywords.

name: The Hills Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: Great support and super friendly church group. Short yet powerful message. Great Biblical teaching, real brothers and sisters in Christ who not only support each other, but do outreaches to the community and beyond. A great church to be part of...your church home!!! How can i put this well im part of the praise team ive been at this church for a few years now it was good paster walter and his wife took over in 2015 they theach and preach the word of god in a powerful way steven james worship leader im thankful to be apart of the team if your  looking for a movement of spirit i strive for it you know when the spirit is on the move you can see it in the people and you can feel it i love this church steven james the spirit of god is in him you can feel a strong presence in his music he is on utube give a listen thank you for letting me be a part of it god bless to all. Kind and loving Spirit-filled people! Love being a  part of this fellowship! Really nice people there and the pastor is really good and preaches good 👍

name: The Hills Church - Novato Campus
reviewSummary: An exciting church revitalizing as a church not just in the community, but FOR the community! Join us and make a difference! Awesome church. Good preaching and bible studies offered weekly. Good place to take a family, involve your kids in Awanis bible club or minister to your teens. A very friendly church with kind people!  Great messages! A true community church! Come visit! This venue offers an excellent opportunity for hosting gatherings, as they provide an event space for rental. Really cool innovative church! I love coming here when I visit Novato 😎

name: The Hills Community Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church!! Coming to church is like coming home because it’s honestly family. My family has been coming to The Hills since August 2020, and from the very first encounter with Pastor Brian and his wife, Amy, we felt loved, supported, and prayed over.

My son loves the kids ministry. Holli, who oversees the kids ministry, is someone truly special. Trust me when I say your family will be hugely blessed to know Miss Holli.

The Hills is a special place. It’s a light shining in North County. My family has been a part of The Hills for over three years and the people in this community have truly become our family! Everyone is welcoming and warm and it’s a great environment for our kids to grow up in. I would highly recommend The Hills to anyone looking for a Christ centered church in North County! My family is beyond blessed to have found this church. I have never felt the sense of community like I feel at The Hills. I have formed so many friendships that I know will last a lifetime. From the moment we first attended we felt welcomed and at home. God is so good and so faithful, we prayed and He brought us here. Moved from Indiana and was in search for my church home. San Diego offers awesome churches but many were too big for me when I was trying to find a community. Checked out this church and loved how many different ages of people I saw - kids, college students, young adults, newly married, families, etc. The best part of this church are the community groups that meet 1x week to build genuine relationships while deepening our faith in Christ! I’ve been attending this Church for about 18 months and am happy to call it home! My wife and daughters love it as well. It feels nice to be a part of a church where the members are genuine and there is a strong sense of community. If you’re looking for a family church with solid teaching and fellowship I recommend popping in at 10 on a Sunday morning.

name: The Hills Dallas
The Holy Name of Jesus Parish - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful Easter services. My family and I spent our first Easter here. I love small churches like this. It reminds me of being a kid growing up in a small church. I highly recommend this church to anyone seeking God. God bless everyone. Catholics Come home…. The pastor is Amazing.   Christianity descended from Jesus.

Merry Christmas to all ! I’m Arab and me n my family love Abuna and the all our friends n family come here. Wonderful church please who ever reads this plz join us as we pray 🙏 every Sunday @ 1pm for Arabic and English sermons. Here I went to a reception after attending a funeral,with the family. This church they tell me was brought to this site in two pieces and later put in place where it now sits. Lots of parking and ground it layed out to accommodate large groups of people. Thank you for the lovely prayer at the passing of my brother.  The kindness by the staff will always be remembered.

name: The Home of Christ Church in Cupertino 基督之家第五家 - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary: Came here while growing up and they have nice facilities and good people. There is a nice playground for children to play and a youth program and adult program for all ages. Number 5 of 7 Churches in the Bay Area. They have separate buildings for English and Chinese service. Great facilities. However the pastor preached exclusion for LGBT community and not inclusivity and love. Extremely disappointed. A solid Chinese American immigrant church with strong biblical teaching and family-like community! There are two congregations: one English speaking and one Mandarin speaking. Very welcoming. Good worship experience. Solid sermon. Loving people, great places. Worth visiting often with your kids.

name: The House - Rogers Campus
reviewSummary:
This has become our home church. We love it here! From the first time walking in to now being somewhat acclimated, the atmosphere hasn't changed. The House from the top down allows for the Holy Spirit to work. They make God fun...because you know, God isn't always a serious, hard core God. He's just & He's righteous, but He is to be enjoyed as well. God is NOT boring. The House definitely brings the fun...when you see youth excited to be at church on the front row, with hands raised &/or jumping & into the music, that says a ton! Pastor Steven & Katie are amazing teachers that bring so much wisdom when they preach. Like you just wanna be better after listening to them share God's Word. 🙌🏻 It is amazing I will call you for the rest of my life it is the best church ever in my opinion we might have a Different opinion It was great our past who’s the best and the kids Ministry and if you go there, it’s the best church on Wednesdays. We have church for youth and which has 9 and 10-year-olds and worship for grown-ups and life groups We had a great experience visiting this church! Everyone was welcoming and friendly. We especially loved how families grouped together to pray during service. I had went to this church in like 2023 and I was praising God, and I was told by one of the guys in the back, I believe it was an usherman, to keep it down because I am being to loud for the infants. I was like whoaaa, this definitely isn't the Holy Spirit telling me to keep it down. The pastor Steve is a funny guy, but it seems to me like he is just trying to get the praise of man than actually of my God. Wonderful community, and very welcoming. Great place to make connections.

This House does life, and gives life.  Awesome preaching by all preachers.

name: The Hub Community Church - Matthews Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to gather with a group. Our group meets there for weekly discussion s centered around the kingdom of God. There is a nice cafe available as well as a larger room for bigger events. Very interactive. Caring church. Bible based. lackluster spot.

name: The Hudson Church - Hoboken Campus
reviewSummary:
The Hudson Church is truly a blessing. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed and embraced like family. The worship is uplifting, the message ny Pastor Renee and members is powerful and inspiring, and the atmosphere is filled with positivity and faith.
The leadership and volunteers go above and beyond to make everyone feel included. Whether you’re visiting for the first time or have been attending for years, you can feel the genuine love and sense of community, they even have it live on social media. I
Highly recommend The Hudson Church to anyone looking for a place to grow spiritually and connect with amazing people. 🙏 I am truly a different person since I walked into the doors of Hudson church. I started there straight out of prison in a homeless shelter to now opening my own business in less than two years. I am on the Outreach team and Media team as well. With the Holy Spirit guiding the Pastors, Leaders, and Ministers to guide me along my journey I don’t know where I would be. From the moment I met them I felt the love and support. The teachings have helped me me grow exponentially as a Christian. I am not new to Christianity and attended many of churches- the huge difference is they are her to help you grow in your walk every step of the way. And I actually have the most amazing relationships with the Pastors, you don’t have that at many churches. There is an importance to this relationship in one’s growth. I love you Hudson Church and I am truly grateful. And the glory is to our God Almighty  in Jesus Mighty Name🙏🏻 From the moment I walked through the doors, I felt incredibly welcomed and loved at Hudson Church. This is truly a Holy Spirit-led, Bible-based church where you're embraced exactly as you are. The warmth and genuine care are palpable. Highly recommend for anyone seeking a loving and Holy Spirit-filled community! Hudson church has been my home church for over 10 years now and it has truly guided my walk with the Lord. This church is completely and transparently Bible based. It does not sugarcoat the gospel, it is the truth from the word of God. Pastor Rene is truly a father figure to all of us, taking time out of his everyday life to guide us, love us, and help us. This church believes in the power of miracles, healing, provision from God, and the power of the Holy Spirit with the evidence of speaking in tongues! It is a power house church and I am so blessed to be a part of it. They have a ministry every night of the week, something for everyone! It is by far the friendliest community I have ever witnessed in a church, and it is financially blessed because it adheres to all the principles of the Bible when it comes to finances and tithing! This church is incredible and blessed!! I have been blessed in many ways by God through Hudson Church. With fellowship, teachings and corrections and I have experienced healing, deliverance and breakthroughs in areas of my life. I have been blessed to also receive help and love through receiving food from Hudson Church's food outreach/giveaway in Guttenberg (Most Fridays). I have helped to prepare bags of food for the food outreach/giveaway in Newark (Every Saturday)
I became a member of Hudson Church JULY 2024. There are many opportunities to serve and teachings to attend during the week.
Please visit us any Sunday for church service. 9:00am English and 12:00pm in Spanish.

name: The Immaculata Catholic Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Stunning church with an amazing amount of seating. Was there for my brother's wedding. Good acoustics and lighting. Mass has a good choir using organ, piano, and trumpet player. It is so beautiful inside, and Fr. gives sermons concise and on point. They serve donuts and coffee after outside. Attended Easter mass and had no problems with parking or seating. It's a warm and welcoming parish where all were greeted warmly. The cruciform architecture is on proud display with stunning stained glass filling the clerestory in every section. The church has incredible attention to detail everywhere you look without seeming gawdy. It is  beautifully maintained. But that is just a building. The true beauty of a church is better measured by its members and it's culture which comes from parish leadership. Everyone we met and saw interacted with genuinely welcoming hearts and were very gracious, all while being inundated with newcomers and nonparish members. If you have the chance, add this to your list of places to visit whether you wish to attend mass or seek a quiet moment of reflection. Immaculata Parish at the University of San Diego is a majestic Spanish‑Revival church, dedicated in 1959. With its iconic blue mosaic dome, red tile roof, cruciform layout, and soaring bell tower, it seats about 900. Adorned with Italian chapels, stained glass, and marble, it serves both students and the community. On my quest to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego county, I attended mass here on a Sunday morning. The atmosphere was very welcoming. The mass was celebrated in English, and the priest gave a very inspiring homily. I was mostly impressed by the beauty of the church and the warmth of the parish community. I recommend attending mass at this Church... Just such a beautiful and welcoming church to worship in!

name: The Independent Presbyterian Church of Savannah - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary: Independent Presbyterian Church is one of Savannah’s architectural showpieces, rising over Bull Street with a stately, classical presence that feels both Southern and Old World. The original 1819 church was destroyed in the great fire of 1889, and the present building was completed in 1891 as a faithful reconstruction under architect William Gibbons Preston. Its tall steeple, grand portico, balanced proportions, and refined classical detailing give it the look of a landmark church from a London street, while its setting among Savannah’s live oaks makes it unmistakably local. Long admired as one of the city’s most beautiful sacred buildings, it remains a defining feature of Savannah’s historic skyline. Was very impressed by the personal feel at this historic Church! There were probably more than 500 people there this Sunday morning and we got a personal invitation for sunday lunch by one of the families! Bless them!! We really appreciate it but were disappointed because we had to catch a flight and couldn’t fit it in our schedule, hopefully next time 🙏 Free sanctuary tours on Tuesdays during tourism season. Church volunteers are very kind and excited to share the history and current events of the church. Very beautiful building! Stopped in for a beautiful view and quick tour. Great place for a Presbyterian wedding.

name: The Indianola Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: Great place to worship, very friendly people. I grew up in this Church. Considering going back now that I am back in town and looking for a new Church. They have a great coffee shop in the basement. Nice, safe place to study and fellowship. They have a lot of activities for the college kids. Indianola is the first church that I’ve been to that genuinely wants to talk about the difficult topics and it’s the only church that I’ve been to where everyone and anyone is 100% accepted no strings attached. It’s full of very nice people and hard working individuals involved in the community and various volunteer programs throughout Columbus and OSU campus. Found this church when I was in college and can say it has truly been a family to me over the years, providing peers and Grandparent/Parent figures, that point me to The Lord. Also nice that it has a coffee shop in the basement (Coffee Underground). I love this place for the environment, staff, and best, the coffee. I love who they also host a board game night. My ukulele group is allowed to meet there twice a month free of charge and the staff is always wonderful to us!

name: The Intentional Church - Powder Springs, Ga - Powder Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
I didn’t know what to expect when I arrived at Intentional Church, but the moment I pulled into the parking lot, I felt something special. The warm welcome from the members reached me before I even stepped inside, and that same spirit of love and hospitality carried throughout the entire worship service. The pastor’s message was heartfelt, sincere, and delivered with a passion that truly touched me.

I left feeling uplifted and grateful — not only for my own experience, but because I can see why my friends love this church so much. It brings me joy to know they’ve found a church home where they feel connected, supported, and spiritually fed.

Although I live far away and remain committed to my own church, I want the Intentional Church family to know how much their kindness and authenticity meant to me. My visit left a lasting impression, and I’m truly thankful for the way you embraced me with such intentional love.

With a smile,

Cynthia My family and I love Intentional Church! Everyone has been so welcoming, and we truly feel at home here. The children's ministry is amazing, our child loves it! We're so thankful to now be members and excited to continue growing in faith with this church family. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Intentional Church is more than a church—it's family. From day one, I felt welcomed, loved, and like I truly belonged. The relationships here are genuine, the people care about one another, and prayer isn't just something we talk about—it's a part of who we are.

One of my favorite things about Intentional Church is our pastor. He's authentic, down-to-earth, and teaches God's Word in a way that connects with everyday life. He reminds us that life's challenges are real, but we should never forget the One who gives us breath, purpose, and the strength to keep going. Every message leaves me encouraged, challenged, and inspired to grow closer to God.

If you're looking for a church where you'll be loved, prayed for, and encouraged while growing in your relationship with Christ, I highly recommend Intentional Church. It truly feels like home. I've really enjoyed being part of this church. Everyone is welcoming, and it's easy to feel comfortable here, even if it's your first time visiting. The messages are meaningful, and you can tell the people genuinely care about each other. It's a great place to grow in your faith and be part of a supportive community. Definitely recommend checking it out if you're looking for a church. I had a great time during my visit at The Intentional Church. I truly enjoyed the worship, the message, and the warm welcome. Thank you so much for your hospitality. God bless!🙏🏿

reviewSummary: I went to visit this church for with a friend and I cannot express how welcoming, kind and authentic the people of this church are. The presence of the Holy Spirit is so present and alive here. If I didn’t have my own church that I love, I would definitely call this place home church. Lots of people in love with Jesus. Lots of the prophetic. Great worship. I was very impressed with their volunteers teams and how they made the ministry time run very smoothly. Highly recommend. I love our pastors, our ministers, the worship team and my brothers and sisters in Christ! His presence is so tangible during worship!  I love how they equip and encourage us to use our spiritual gifts to serve! I was so blessed with this ministry forget the day that I attended church with a hard day. I was very very blessed prayers have been answered Spirit-filled Fellowship was very much appreciate. If you are looking for a place of worship, hearing God's word oh, and just being overwhelmed by the Holy Spirit lifting your heart mind and soul this is the place to go blessings everyone thank you again attacking my heart God bless your ministry asks you reach others for Jesus Christ Hands down the best church in town! name: The Journey Church
reviewSummary:
Although I don't attend this church every Sunday, I have participated in their hosted events, Wednesday nights, Friday prayer nights, and various sermons. Pastor Jeremy is incredibly kind and graceful. He truly lives the Lord's teachings, and his honesty and transparency are unmatched. His last sermon at their previous waterfront location moved me to tears, especially with its relevance to current world issues, both locally and globally. Seattle has long been known for its skepticism towards faith. However, at The Journey, you will learn together, grow together, transform together, and experience the presence of God with complete peace, joy, compassion, and understanding. Christ's love is at the center of everything The Journey does. You should definitely give this Church a try, especially if you're in Seattle (Green Lake area) and wish to feel warmly welcomed and intentionally included. Every event has been enjoyed, and I appreciate their core values and priorities. Naveen's voice is also so soothing and emotionally impactful. He's truly been gifted a voice from God. I haven't been yet but I know the pastors, and they are AMAZING people! I can only imagine the life and joy that is in a house that they're leading together under God! Oh Journey Church, I hope you're thriving! I've moved out of the area and won't be attending Journey Church anymore, but if I was staying, I would definitely attend this church. Pastor Jeremy and his wife are just flat out fantastic and are truly trying to successfully impact non-believers lives as well as believers, wherever they can make a difference. I hope to find a good bible-based church where I land 🙏 God is good!
Previous review:
I just came back from the Christmas party at Journey Church. I had so much fun! I felt instantly included, participated in interesting conversations, played fun games, had an Ugly Sweater contest as well as judging ugly desserts which were highly creative. I've only attended service here once, but the sense of community I felt tonight will have me attending Sunday's service! And who knows, maybe the Sunday after that or a Wednesday Bible Study, who knows? I'm looking forward to more peace and joy in my life. I LOVE this church! I can honestly say that I have never experienced a community so welcoming. The worship is powerful and the teaching is transformative. I have grown so much in my walk with Jesus and always feel loved at The Journey. This ministry is deeply committed to seeing lives and the city of Seattle transformed by the gospel! The presence of God is in this place! The leaders have an anointing and are fulfilling their call to minister, love and disciple the people of their community. If you are seeking more in your spiritual walk, needing guidance, or have never walked into a church - come to this one.

reviewSummary:
A great church, filled with amazing people. I have been coming to the journey church for about a year and took the membership class today. The pastor is great, easy to listen to and interesting when he talks about the Bible. Update: Church just moved to a permanent building right on Boca Raton Blvd, beautiful sanctuary and kids space.

I could go on and on about how great this church is and how much they care about your spiritual growth but I'll just let my five star review speak for itself.  The clergy and the members all seem to really care.  You'll never feel awkward or unwelcome.  Dress casual.  Come with an open heart.  Great kids program too.

Update: was at the grand opening of their new patio and outdoor baptistry. Witnessed 10+ adults baptized with incredible stories and a brief message from the pastor. The outdoor cross and space is calming and inspirational.

Update: just attended Christmas Eve candlelight and it was excellent. Packed house but ushers and greeters made it easy and comfortable. Easy parking. Clean bathrooms. Hot chocolate. Great music and message. See pics. I absolutely love the journey church. Very welcoming and it has helped me deepen my relationship with God. Always a resonating message I can relate to that helps me become a better Christian. Amazing place and just what we needed. My wife was raised Orthodox and I was raised Catholic, so having this Church to learn and grow our Faith together is amazing.  The was our first experience with a true Bible teaching Church and we love it.  Thanks to the whole team at Journey Chrich! Called this church and spoke to a man about wanting to find people who are looking for work and he hung up on me. What kind of Christian’s do that to people without hearing what they have to say.
