reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending The Journey for about a year and a half. I can genuinely say that Pastor Kerrick and the staff truly do their best to represent Jesus and teach His word. This is the most I’ve grown spiritually within a church. I have also dedicated my child to The Journey. If Jesus Christ is your Savior & you wanna serve him comfortably surrounded by a balanced mixture of brothers & sisters. Then I highly recommend The Journey. Young adults singing & praising from their hearts. Followed by pastor Kerrie message is so fulfilling💙 🙏🏼 My NYC friends—this one’s for you! 🗽❤️

If you’ve been searching for a church that truly feels like home, I highly recommend The Journey Church NYC. When we lived in New York, we couldn’t find that connection and ended up traveling to NJ to attend Liquid Church, which became our home church.

But now—my cousin, who lives in NY, finally found a place that feels like family. We visited Journey, and from day one, they went out of their way to make us feel welcomed. We even shared how far the trip was for us, and guess what? They surprised us with a MetroCard so we could come back and serve alongside our cousin. 🥹🙌

That’s the kind of love and intentional care that makes this church so special. 💒✨ If you’re looking for a church that feels like home—and people who feel like family—I highly recommend Journey Church NYC. ❤️ From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with open arms. It’s a place where you can grow in your faith and feel truly connected. Don’t just take my word for it—come and experience it for yourself! This is a special place. We visited on a vacation and found such a warm welcome! In a city where people don’t talk to strangers, The Journey Church stands out as a vibrant, Christ-centered, outward-focused community. The music is great, the preaching is great, and they have Starbucks for you. We enjoyed that so much! The best church in NYC hands down ~ HOLY SPIRIT FILLED ; TJC is all about GOD — sermons are Bible based using scripture (sound doctrine) including our professional breakfast (always inspirational leadership; men and women of God / authors like Henry & Richard Blackaby) , growth groups , servant evangelism groups, feeding the homeless, visiting prisons providing clothing..(Rikers Island), 🎶WORSHIP🎶, last but definitely not least BAPTISM & JOURNEY KIDS (what a delight) during each Sunday service you get to experience God in a way that will make you desire to come back again and again. Here at the Journey Church we are taught practical lessons to help us find grit/ passion in order to achieve all that God has planned for our lives !! You are not alone here, this church is a home away from home “ a place to be yourself (come as you are) and because of the welcome team ; you just know in your heart of hearts GOD IS HERE!!! Pastor Kerrick, his wife Lorie & their three children and staff are great examples of mini Christ, truly set apart, they make it their business to always be of good service to everyone who enters TJC!! I have been attending TJC since 2014 became a member in 2015 with a burning desire to continue to grow and be more like Christ I will continue to serve and join every way possible; gimper for God!! The Journey Church has a servant spirit and allows you to pick and choose this day which path you will take … TRUE “ CHRISTIANS! I pray to see God’s living WORD , GRACE, hope , love and forgiveness expand and reach the world via THE JOURNEY ~ PS. This is a praying Church, prayer meetings are on Wednesday’s at noon, Sunday morning before service and via email (our pastors are always ready and willing to pray) #INJESUSNAMEAMEN📖❤️‍🔥🎶🤲🏼🙌🏼🪽🔥🩸🎶😇🫶🏻☀️🎁💪😇 🌎

name: The King's Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I can’t say enough good things about Kings Church. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with kindness and genuine love. The messages are biblically grounded, encouraging, and always point people to Jesus Christ. The worship is heartfelt, and there’s a real sense of God’s presence.

If you’re looking for a church where you can grow in your faith, build meaningful relationships, and serve the Lord alongside a caring community, I highly recommend Kings Church. I’m grateful to be part of a church family that truly seeks to honor God and love others. Five stars! I LOVE this church. I’ve been going there for over 3 months now and they are consistently so welcoming, gospel centered, and a place where I have found community. I don’t have children of my own, the the kids ministry is well organized, focuses on Jesus, and FUN. It’s refreshing to see young kids get excited about Jesus. If you are looking for a smaller church where you don’t get lost in the crowd, or looking for a church that preaches from the Bible every week, you should definitely give it a visit. Fantastic community church that has a great pastor with a nice and friendly congregation.  Services are about an hour long, but they fly by quickly with a solid reading and doctrinal based teachings. My kids love the King's Club kid service (they stay for the worship before moving into their age group classes), except for the last Sunday of the month when all but the tots stay for the whole service. They have coffee and donuts available before church starts, where you can fellowship and get to know church staff and other members. What an amazing community filled with God-loving individuals of all ages, races, and backgrounds who are truly passionate about Jesus! If you're seeking a welcoming place to grow in your faith, this is the church for you! A big thank you to Daniel for the awesome “Jesus is King” t-shirt given to all first-time visitors! You're going to love it here! My family and I love this church! Everyone is so kind and welcoming. My kids love the children’s ministry and I feel so comfortable leaving them there during church service. They both get so excited to come to church! My oldest is really learning so much about the Bible and it makes my heart so happy. Worship is great, the sermons are biblical and awesome. It really feels like a family.

Worship Family

Pastor Kevin Hope is an awesome teacher.

Jesus Christ is LORD ,

New Church for it was nice to see friends I have not seen in years all I say God is good and The Life Center church is Awesome Pastor Nati was great he gave a great message on restoration I will be back

name: The Life Church - Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: First time visiting The Life Church Nashville.  I used to attend The Life Church when I lived in Memphis (Hi Pastor John!!).  Such a wonderful praise and worship ministry.  The sermon was short but substantial (Pastor Shashton and his wife did great).  A bit of a drive for me but will definitely visit when I can!! The Life Church Nashville is the place to go if you’re seeking a welcoming, diverse community who seeks to love The Lord and love one another. The messages are engaging and biblically sound, the worship is top-notch, and the people are warm and inviting. The children’s ministry is also an incredible place for kids to learn God’s heart and His Word, and is FUN! Would definitely recommend visiting one Sunday morning! I went to this church a few weeks ago. I have never felt so connected to a church as when I walked in to this one. The Pastor greeted me, shook my hand and welcomed me to church. I do not believe I have seen many pastors greeting people when they walk in. Then the sermon was great! It focused on trusting Gods timing and felt like just what I needed at the time. They had games set up for children after the service that day and grilled Hamburgers and Hot dogs for everyone. Pastor Kendal came over to meet me as I was eating. Pastor Shaston and Pastor Kendal do a great job of making guests feel welcome. Looking forward to going back here soon. I am so excited that the Life Church has a location in Nashville. Since I started attending a year ago, I have met the nicest people. They truly have a heart for God. Good people. Comfortable Atmosphere. Strong faith with a lot of love. They stick to the Bible, using Inciteful sermons. It's fairly new & growing steady. Pastor Shastin is down to Earth & easy to get to know. My experience has been positive and learned. Centrally located in Bellevue it's very easy to find. Thoughtful children's activities .A great Church, come love God & grow with us.

name: The Life Church of Arlington - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary:
I must say, I REALLY love this church and everyone is amazing. Truly one of the best churches I've been to because I love how wonderful everyone is and especially listening to the pastor preach the way he does is so beautiful how he delivers the message.
However I do feel the need to write this review since I have been quite in conflict with how I feel about it and noticed other people reacting a certain way about it. (I'll explain in a second why)
The worship team is not quite... there yet.  And I only say it because of the lady that sings which I believe is the pastor's wife...
She is very lovely don't get me wrong but I'm afraid she is really out of tune, kinda yells when she wants to reach those high notes and its quite distracting... I noticed other people mention it just by looking whoever is in front of me. I notice faces of disapproval and it hurts me to see that, it truly does. I just felt that it was important to address that since I notice some peoples reactions only when she is singing. Nonetheless I love how everyone is so united and it's such and beautiful vibe every time I go  I first visited the Life Church approximately 2 years ago I believe?
I knew I was home almost as soon as I stepped through the doors. From the Worship to the Sermon, from the prayers to the people, this church is everything I want and need in my life at this moment. God is constantly calling us to different places at different times and right now I am grateful He led me here for this time. Love this place! My wife and I feel so welcome here, and we're thrilled to have such a tight nit community in a big city. Very friendly people and staff, easy to get involved. Very family friendly church. The people here are very accepting and non judgemental and very humble. You will feel right at home! 1950 NE Green Oaks Blvd Arlington TX 76006 is updated address for the church!

name: The Lifehouse Church - Rocklin Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending The Lifehouse Church since 2019. They have a solid biblical foundation, they love Jesus, and they love their community.

Theirs is not a works-based or guilt-based faith, but a growth based faith.

Jesus will work in our hearts to make us more like Him, and the pastoral team here does an amazing job of beautifully guiding its members to follow His directions.

If you are looking for a church that isn’t “all talk and no walk”, check them out.

You will find a community who will welcome you in with open arms and a generous heart. Are you looking for a church that feels like home? Look no further. Lifehouse Church in Rocklin is a warm, welcoming place – a safe place to explore your faith in God. Whether you just started your relationship with Jesus or you’ve walked with him for many years, our pastors and teaching staff will meet you where you are.

Powerful, Bible – centered lessons, contemporary worship music, numerous activities for children, youth and adults – all in a warm, accepting environment. I hope to see you soon! Welcome home. When looking for a church I  wanted three things– Bible Based, Christ Centered and small. Lifehouse is all of these and also a very warn, welcoming and loving church. This is a safe place to worship with 3 excellent teaching pastors. I highly recommend that you give Lifehouse a try and hopefully you will find it a fulfilling as I did. I have been attending Lifehouse Church for the last 27 years and, if I had 10 thumbs, I would give it a 10-thumbs up!  So many things to like about it:  friendly, caring, accepting people; relaxed atmosphere; a love for Jesus Christ and His word; and a heart to serve others.  Yes, the building is a bit dated, but it disguises the full life within it.  If you are ready to take another step in your faith journey, give Lifehouse a try. I have been attending The LifeHouse Church for over 28 years and I am grateful that they are a solid biblical teaching church.  I love that they are a community-oriented, missional focused church, who are all about Jesus, Jesus is in the center of everything they stand for.  The pastors are genuine, energetic, and passionate about their sermons and their sermons are relevant to everyday life situations.   Worship is powerful and uplifting.  They are a multi-generational church.  You are greeted with a comfortable family feeling of coming home from a long journey with a friendly smile and greeting.  Children’s/Youth ministries are great, fun and 100 percent Christ centered.  Coffee is available before and after services in their Coffeehouse.  The LifeHouse Church is a  great place to worship and grow in a relationship with Christ.  Hope to see you there some day!!

name: The Light of the World Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
The Church of the Living God, Pillar and Ground of the Truth, The Light of the World is the restoration of the Church Christ founded in the first century of our current era with the goal of announcing the good news of salvation to everyone. Its restoration began in the city of Monterrey, Nuevo Leon in Mexico on April 6, 1926 with the calling of teacher Aaron Joaquin Gonzalez to Apostleship. The Church remains in unwavering faithfulness to God, the hierarchy, doctrine, sacred acts, as well as the celestial promises, established and given by Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior. A very good place to meet god Sacred and Beautiful church for God's gender diversity children. Beautiful  place to Thank God for all his blessings.
You are all invited. Very spiritual and friendly

name: The Light of the World Pentecostal Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: A loving place to worship and praise Jesus Christ our Savior. 🙏 This bilingual church welcomes everyone warmly. The pastor is a devoted servant of the Lord who delivers inspiring messages. There's an amazing choir of singers, and it's a great environment for your kids to make friends and learn about God. I was raised in this church and still attend it. Amazing church and Pastor. One of the greatest life changing experience remember the first time God spoke to me about staying in this in A time when I said I was going to serve God my own way  an then boom boom I get to see this pastor and his family an the members  wow wouldn't be half the men I am if it wasn't for his ministry highly recommend GOD BLESSED EVERY ONE, YEARS BACK I USE TO ASSIST TO THAT CHURCH GREAT PASTOR AND MEMBERS. GOD BLESSED THEM ALL. Born and rise in this Church ; great church for any and everybody. Amazing Pastors in this church !

name: The Lighthouse Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is beautiful!! Picking Blueberry and Mulberry is an amazing adventure.
They have honey, peach jam, Blueberries 🫐, Mulberry and blackberry for sale.
Jam is delicious 😋
A giant tree house and a playground for kids.
Everyone is so nice. Great place, awesome people, organic avocados, oranges and seasonal blueberries. A true gem. Great experience for kids. The treehouse was perfect. Picking berries was also a favorite. Such a cool hang out area with playground, tree house and area for kids to pick fruits. Our favorite was the mulberries. The Best organic fruit in the county for sure. !! They pick it daily. Soo good.

name: The Lighthouse Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
The word from Pastor Josh on Wednesday was beautifully delivered. You can tell it is a supportive and close congregation. The only suggestion I would have if the church aims to grow is to possibly have a greeter for newcomers as folks come in to help them feel welcomed because as a new face, no one said hello or even smiled. Thank goodness for Tina, who then introduced me to Pastor Josh when we were greeting each other during service when you “turn to your neighbor and say hello”. I will remember her kindness and warmth. Bless you all! My favorite church in LA! Family friendly atmosphere and real preaching only from the bible. Awesome Godly church! Evry other Tuesday night there has meeting for protecting our children health and rights.
God bless this church and pastors. I am so thankful for the Lighthouse Church! This church has given me so many opportunities. In just three years, I have rededicated my life to God, gained a new church family, and been on two medical mission trips to Guatemala. Lighthouse is so welcoming and has so much to offer. I am beyond blessed to be growing in the Lighthouse Church, it's amazing to think that one small school (Lighthouse Christian Academy) led me to a church full of love and blessings. I went to this church for over a year. I had just moved across the country and I knew no one. I tried my best to be friendly, come regularly and involve myself in activities (morning prayer, after service fellowships outside, youth group) but despite my efforts, I went over looked. I craved a church family and instead I was met with a scene from high school. The church is categorized into cliques. You have the "I've been here 20 years +" crowd, the "I am related to the Pastor" crowd, the "I am in my twenties with ten babies" crowd and so on. Unless you are born into this church or have an "in" with a member, I'd recommend looking elsewhere.

name: The Living Gospel Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: This church is one of the best. This church let's us know that there is hope. The Pastor & his family are wonderful, our church family are just as wonderful, everyone cares about one another. Alot of churches the people don't make you feel welcomed but this church does. Everyone is welcome & will feel loved. Thank you for all the love & the presence of God is always there too. God bless all who comes Hmm everyone was nice enough but a few were judgmental. They are a small congregation just a few, a couple were so sure of my reason for being there they automatically come to conclusions about anybody just off the bat. One young lady was so sure I was just after woman she even stated it openly in front of everyone even though not once did I speak with her, the message the pastor was trying to convey I really have no idea he kept jumping from point to point to point not sticking to one subject, after the service people began leaving immediately and the pastor then began to get annoyed because I was trying to say hello to everyone he was so annoyed he began banging a open knife on the wall and the offering box as if he was expecting offering then approached me with the same knife not in a threatening manner but just made me feel real uncomfortable I am a disabled United States Army veteran that suffers from severe anxiety disorder and ptsd I informed of that but he really has no idea what that even means. He is not trained in scripture as he showed in his message to where he jumped from king herod, to Christs crucifixion, to peter in prison, to paul back to peter in prison then how peter was set free by GOD back to peter in prison then no altar call. I am looking for a church of GOD fearing people. For now not sure on this one. My message to the pastor if you want to reach the lost its not about what you feel or think its how you present GOD's love including people like me be safe and I will think and pray This is one of the best churches I've gone to & everyone is Very personable, very kind and very loving, teaches the word verse by verse, as we should learn gods word.  The pastor's great is wonderful the congregation is great.If you wanna hear the real word from god , go to this church , everybody's welcome. God bless you. I would give 10 stars if i could or more, he is the best Pastor i've ever met. Keep up the good work Pastor Steve. God bless you & yours I just wanna say this is the best church I've ever been to.Since I changed from being Catholic to Christian.The pastor is wonderful.His family is wonderful.His kids, all the members of the church are just wonderful.The best place to go, where the pastor reads verse by verse from the Bible.God bless you pastor steve

name: The Loft - Westwood Campus
The Lord's Church of Georgia - Duluth Campus
reviewSummary: They are the real deal. They are on fire and they truly worship God without time limits or a preacher looking at his  watch..They allow the Holy Spirit to do what he wants to do. You will experience the fire of God which is Holy Fire as you give yourself completely to him. Nice Awesome worship

name: The Lutheran Church of the Good Shepherd - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
I was there 28 years ago. After 12 years, I am back in the same church. I met many old timers. I enjoyed and received the heart filled sermon. I am back LCGS. Kind people. They have helped me and my kids a lot, especially through the prayers. Call or email them to be in their prayers. Lots of special community events for everyone to attend. Usually, there are 2 different service times on Sundays except for on special days.  There are small groups to be a part of.
There is a food bank for those who need non-perishables. When my family and me left the Catholic church for our own personal reasons, our kids began volunteering at VBS over the summer. We fell in love with this church right away. It’s something you can’t explain but the community and the services feel like you are walking with Jesus. You leave feeling a true sense of what Christ has called you to be and do in life. I found Lutheran Church of the Good Shepherd 20 years ago.  I love the size of this church - makes it easy to build friendships through bible study, dinner clubs, and gatherings after the service. And there is an amazing new pastor, Dr. Ebassa Berhanu. Powerful sermons and worship. Truly a Holy Spirit driven church.  Members are very inviting and involved in the church.

name: The Main Place Christian Fellowship - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I was raised at this church from 1962till 1976 when it was called Lincoln Ave Baptist Church. I moved away and went back around late 80’s to visit with my mom who hadn’t been there in decades. The people were lovely but it was sad to see the church had not grown and was actually dying. It broke my heart! So glad to see this church thriving and bringing people to Christ! This is a good church for families youth and old people who is looking forward to attend a church Parked in the parking lot because I work at a building near by and was just enjoying my lunch not making ANY noise or causing disturbance and the owner and her daughter came at me HOSTILE, raising their voices saying it’s private property. This is the people who run a church? A simple “This is private property sorry you can’t park here “ would have been nice. Been attending Main Place since I was a little child. I love my Pastors, the worship team, and all the Sunday school teachers. Everyone cares about one another and prays for each other. I love my church! Real friendly atmosphere. Everyone is loving and polite. I enjoyed the Men's Home, In recovery the staff taught me essential Bible necessaries. Very loving and caring.

name: The Met Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Their outreach program is awesome. The people are so loving and kind. I love going they always putting a smile on our face and vice versa. I really appreciate what they do for me and my family. Words can't express how thankful we are❤️❤️❤️ My wife has been going here for a while. We recently got back together and I told her I wanted to go to a good church. Upon entering no one greeted us, didn't feel welcomed at all, I am desperately seeking a good group of men to be around and to study God's word with but I didn't feel welcomed. I was the only one raising my hands and worshipping in the whole auditorium. The pastor was practical with good head knowledge but I just didn't feel the holy Spirit moving at all...I went to AA after and felt wayyyyy more welcomed and loved there.
I will be going back again today and I'm going to make it a point to speak to someone and see if they are worth my families time.. we need a church that Loves people! This is a very awesome church! I go there for the food pantry which helps out a lot! They are very kind and supportive! Thank you Met church for helping me through tough times. I have been going to the MET for 2.5 years now and love it. Pastor Bill always has a great message and has a way of making you feel like he’s preaching directly to you without actually doing so. All of the staff members, volunteers, and members of the church are very friendly and helpful. My favorite aspect of the MET is that their goal isn’t to build a bunch of different METs, but to help the community by utilizing the Cindy Ramsey Center to provide food and resources to those in need. My husband and I have been attending Met Church for eight years. After making the decision to leave another local church and visit The Met, we were immediately welcomed and felt a part of their family environment. It's been our privilege over the years to see so many individuals and families be welcomed with open arms who may have never considered attending church. I have many friends who have children that have grown up in Met Kids and are now serving and participating in Met Youth. Our staff connects with many different types people from all walks of life and find ways to uniquely serve every need. This church Is such a blessing to us and we are so grateful to get to be a part of it!

name: The Methodist Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
First off, let it be said that any information about any certain incidents that have occurred in the past are now outdated; they no longer attend the church as far as I’m aware, and the community that is there is certainly welcoming.

How do I know this?

I’ve been attending BUMC since 2013-2014, back when I first lived in Brea; I’ve seen multiple pastors come and go throughout the years, changing per the Methodist conferences that transpire… each and every pastor I’ve met and spoken with allowed me to keep up the faith, of pursuing something better in life.

That pursuit (besides happiness)? The search for a family… a community to lean on when you have nowhere else to go, a family to be a part of, express yourself when times are dark… a place of worship where one can get their start in career and their life.

BUMC will always hold a special place in my heart for all of these things above, as they helped guide me through the pandemic, for providing a place of acceptance for the love of my life, for providing a place of service when I had no other sources of income.

Now, as I move eastward towards new horizons, I can only hope that this church may evolve for the better, perhaps leave behind a legacy in music, in outreach, in spreading the word that God is indeed good.

I wish you all the best, and have a blessed day/week.

—signed, A former A/V Technician. Brea United Methodist Church is a warm and welcoming congregation dedicated to sharing God’s love so that all lives may be enriched.

The church fosters an inviting atmosphere where people can gather for worship, fellowship, and service.

With a strong focus on inclusivity, compassion, and outreach, visitors will find a caring church family committed to faith, connection, and living out Christ’s message of love for all. You people are disgusting!!! This church will judge you, expect you to donate and will not hesitate to show you aggression! The church itself is poorly maintained and if i was you id look on another place to worship then given this place any of your time This is for the pumpkin patch that they operate on the lot. Giant bouncers, slides, foods, drinks, petting zoo and of course plenty of pumpkins! Great for the kids and great photo-ops. BTW they change to a Christmas Tree farm afterwards. Check it out 👍 Some of the nicest and most kind-hearted and generous people I have ever met were members of a congregation, the are however outliers and this church certainly contains one of them. I saw a member of this church physically assault a 1st amendment patriot for exercising his first amendment right. I think his behavior was unbecoming of the ideals preached in the church he attends. Shame on him

name: The Mission Church Carlsbad - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
First, I'll start by saying that we are truly thankful to the Lord for leading us to The Mission Church! We truly appreciate our brothers, Pastor David and Pastor JC!  Both are excellent teachers of God's Word! After reading your "statement of faith" on the church's website, and following our 1st visit, (3 months ago)  we became clear that we would be staying, and are hoping to get involved in serving/helping out as needed.
We moved to this area almost a year ago from Idaho, and until we found this wonderful body of sweet believers in Jesus, we had to do a bit.. (OK, ..more than a bit..) of "church hopping", which is not fun! Can any of you relate?! Anyhow, just want to let y'all know that we love you ALL, our brothers and sisters in Christ! So,...you're "stuck with us".......the good kind of "stuck". Ha! Love everything and everyone at this church!  David & JC preach and teach God's word, bringing it to you in a way that you walk out excited and inspired...every week.  Everyone is so nice...lots of young people... My wife and I have lived next to this church for 9 years. They are terrible neighbors. I work hard during the week, I’m up at 4:30 am Monday - Friday overseeing a construction crew. My weekends are critical for catching up on sleep, but this morning I was woken by them ringing their church bell probably 30 consecutive times at 7:45 am. Every Sunday I wake up to Sunday school kids emitting blood curdling screams with seemingly no adult supervision right outside my window.
Not to mention their patrons ‘s parking overflows beyond the designated parking lot into our street, taking over the neighborhood on weekends. On rare occasions we will hear young adults on weeknights screaming and yelling within the church late at night. They are probably just goofing off… it looks like a youth group or something, but still, bothersome to the neighbors. They act like they own the community, not to mention they have never once reached out to us in any welcoming way, despite them being direct disruptive neighbors.

Over nine years… not one reach out, just issues, thanks. The Mission Church is a second home to me! I have been attending for a couple years now. After exploring many churches in Carlsbad, The Mission Church stands out for many reasons. Pastor David and JC have a strong reverence for the Bible and teach it very well. They clearly study the Word very deeply and teach the Word with a strong reverence. I have learned so much while attending this church. I was saved before I started attending, but the teaching I have received from The Mission has reignited my faith and strengthened my relationship with the Lord exponentially. Pastor David preaches the Bible in a way that illuminates how deeply God loves us. Pastor David also strongly encourages the congregation to study The Word for themselves and that has helped me make my faith my own. Another reason why I respect The Mission so much is they practice what they preach. Although there are complaints about The Mission being too political, I believe the Church should be speaking out against injustices and Pastor David and JC are very brave to speak truth despite making some people feel uncomfortable. I met my husband there, I have made life-long friendships there, and gained mentors there as well. The staff is clearly devoted to serving the Lord and care deeply for the congregation. Pastor JC leads an amazing Young Adults program that has changed the lives of many Young Adults, including myself. Their Women’s Ministry is extremely edifying and special as well. This is a Holy Spirit filled church and I am so grateful to have found The Mission! So happy our neighbors told us about this church; it has been such a positive influence on my family. My husband and I were looking for a Christian church that aligned with our values and was true to the word of God. The first service we attended was so welcoming. They give you a coffee mug and connection cards for Fellowship on your first visit. The church has multiple events throughout the year including park Olympics, BBQs, hikes, surf lessons, etc. My husband was even Baptized at Moonlight Beach with 45 other members. The Pastors and Youth ministry leaders are such a blessing! We are approaching our 1 year mark and it warms my heart to know we have finally found our people.

name: The Mission Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: This church is my family! Nothing compares to the feeling of being in the presence of God while being with family. This church is excellent! There is such a sense of welcome when you first arrive and a sense of community when you stay. This is the first church my husband and I tried when we moved out to Redlands and we were very pleased! My whole family loved this church. We only went for a short time, the moved. We've been looking for something similar but can't quite find it. Ther pastor and all the staff are great. Easy to find inspiration and great biblical teaching here. My wife and I have been looking for a loving church for such a long time and we finally found it. The people here are so authentic and filled with joy and love. It is great to see such an amazing family of believers. Small, growing Church with people who are friendly and a pastor who preaches from God's word, with a heart for people, we believe in radically serving all God's people and doing it with the  Love of Jesus.

name: THE MIX Church
reviewSummary: Incredible Sunday experiences without a disconnected “mega church” vibe. I visited many churches in three neighboring cities before finding the Mix. The sermons, people, and worship here have deeply impacted me. Forever grateful for the healing found through the word and for the bolder walk in faith that I have developed. Small groups and community opportunities are plenty, and connections are there if you’re open to them. Scripture focused and relatable to all who walk in the door, hence “the Mix”. Pastor Marcus does not miss — include The Mix in your search if you’re looking for a church to call home or just want to hear who God is. If you want to encounter Jesus, visit The Mix Church. I’ve attended three times, and each experience has been excellent. The greeters, kids check-in process, baptism celebrations, and welcome team all create a warm and inviting atmosphere. I deeply appreciate Pastor Marcus and his intentional focus on teaching scripture throughout his sermons. He offers a balanced message, centered more on the Word than on people, which I need, look for, and deem necessary. I'm thankful Baltimore has The Mix Church, it is truly a gem! Came to the church one Sunday a little over a month ago and haven't left since!!! God personally showed me and my spirit that he loved, and heard my prayers when he blessed me to come across The Mix Church..Especially the timing!! From day one, my first encounter was with one of our Groups,  (others in the church we do life with outside of Sunday Service) and  I knew and felt like I was home!! I might be a little biased, but my church, The Mix is the best church in Baltimore!!! It is full of God's love and his presence!! Our pastor,. Pastor Marcus ,gives out that word now!! Pull out you note pads, because it is a bible teaching church!! He, his beautiful wife, and the ministry team reflect God's love and passion for us through their commitment and detailed efforts to creating a church atmosphere like no other!! As for the other members, family members is what I like to call them, so welcoming, warm, and inviting. I have a ball when I go week after week. Who knew God could create an atmosphere of church and fun, full of his word, and true community to do life with all in one place. The Mix was more than I prayed for in a church, and I am so glad to call this my church home!! Come out and visit us! Almost a 5 star. Until I was told by the pastors wife I was off putting and she isn’t gonna be interrogated. Context I’m neurodivergent, and have CPTSD which makes crowds and loud noises extremely hard for me to cope with. I asked a very important question that no one can really answer “how do you know you’re called to do this” because where I am at in my own journey of wanted insight. I rushed out after being told by her I’m off putting and am still crying in my car. name: The Movement Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I wrote the below review in July on Yelp and wanted to share here as well:

I've been part of this church community for a little bit and have appreciated the warmth and spiritual grounding it provides. However, I'm deeply disheartened by the silence around the humanitarian crisis caused by recent ICE activity in the Los Angeles area. As people of faith, I believe we are called to stand with the vulnerable and speak truth in love--and right now, many of our neighbors are scared and suffering. I had hoped for acknowledgment, prayer, or support from leadership, but it feels like this issue has been overlooked. I share this not out of anger, but out of longing for a church that truly reflects the compassion of Christ in both word and action.

I also wrote this review prior to seeing Pastor Carey's Instagram posts on the topic. To say I'm disheartened by the posts would be an understatement. If you're planning on visiting the church and want to gain understanding on where they stand on these issues, I encourage you to look at the pastors' posts and responses yourself. If you can't feel the Holy Spirit here during worship, you need to check your pulse. This place has an amazing anointing on it. Great message delivered by a very charismatic and knowledgeable staff.  Highly recommend  with today's climate. If your looking for a church to call "Home" this is it!!
My family is forever Changed by The Movement Church.
From the moment you get out of your car your greeted with smiling faces and people who intentionally want to get to know you. Our kids love the kids program and look forward to church every weekend. My Husband and I have made some amazing friendships here and love ALL the powerful life changing messages from the Pastors. If you are looking for a great connection, a meaningful message and the opportunity to build authentic relationships with amazing people, The Movement Church is the right church! The pastors,  Carey and Meghan, co-lead the church and bring a great message every week. For those that have kids, of any age from baby through high school, they have a wonderful kids ministry with great teachers and mentors. My kids look forward to going every week and have made great friends, something that we had searched for many years to find. We call The Movement Church home and truly value their mission to know the people that attend and to find the one and bring them closer to God. If you are looking for a church, come visit and try out The Movement Church OC!

If you haven't been to church since COVID, are looking for a new church, or simply up for trying something out, give The Movement Church a shot this coming Saturday night at 5pm. 32382 Del Obispo St, San Juan Capistrano, CA 92675 (It says Mountain View Church on the outside) you are in the right place. Movement Church hosts an amazing service at this location every Saturday night. After COVID-19 I was looking for a smaller and more personal church. I have been an active member of a couple mega churches in Orange County, CA over the past years. Each of them carried a great message but made it hard to feel connected to your church, pastors, and the message they bring. The Movement Church I now call home and it is for good reasons. Pastor Carey and Meghan are a husband & wife team co-leading the church. They make it clear their mission is to know the members of their church and you certainly feel like family when you walk in the doors.

Movement Church hosts an amazing service at this location every Saturday night.

name: The Neighborhood Church - Bentonville Campus
reviewSummary: We absolutely love TNC from the moment you walk in, it feels warm and inviting, and everyone truly makes you feel welcome. It’s very kid- and family-friendly, which means so much to us. It’s easy to feel comfortable, connected, and it makes a great church home. We have a lot of great memories from here over there the years. The main Pastor is Joe, and Joe has lots of energy, lots, and he puts this energy into his sermons, which makes them feel engaging and fun, the community here is also fun with many people having good energy as well, very open to new people, and has a "Jesus loves everyone and so we Love Everyone" approach to their community and people who are interested in joining. This church has energy and love and we are so thankful for the community we’ve found and are getting plugged into here. They are service oriented and combine liturgical practices with a welcoming environment. Pastor Joe is great. The kids love their Sunday school. The sense of community and welcome is great. Come and visit! Our family has been coming to The Neighborhood Church for a couple of years now, and we have loved every bit of it. Watching it grow, the people and the building itself and everything that surrounds it. We have been blessed to have been given the chance to call it home.

name: The Neighborhood Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Our wedding was beyond what could have imagined thanks in part to the beautiful Neighborhood Church, I can't thank Setta enough for helping us book our wedding ceremony. I was in search of a Church to hold our ceremony and this location does not disappoint. The views are extraordinary, I was visiting the area and suddenly came across the Church and was taken aback, it was exactly what we were looking for. Not only is this location stunning but the Pastor Mary was kind enough to include verses/readings from the Quran as my family is of both muslim and catholic diversity. They were all so helpful and inclusive. I loved everything about it. A special thanks also to Dr. Hyunju Hwang the organist, who was exceptional !! She was able to include unique pieces that my husband and I both love. I attended a wedding here, and it was absolutely gorgeous. There was a private trail leading to the ocean and a fascinating cave. They allowed us to rehearse the ceremony the day before, which was very convenient. However, the experience was marred by random visitors dropping by and walking through our photos, as the venue seemed to be open to the public without any signs indicating a wedding was in progress. It would have been much better if they had blocked off certain areas during the ceremony to prevent tourists in flip-flops from walking by and talking near the open windows while vows were being exchanged. I understand that people want to visit the church, and they have every right to do so, but when such a significant amount of money is paid, there should be signs or specific hours posted to inform visitors to avoid certain areas during private events. This is a very beautiful church with breathtaking views. It reminds me a lot of the Hearst Castle. But more importantly, Pastor Rick and the church staff, especially the Director of Communications, Anne Smith are all so amazing!

Pastor Rick’s sermons resonate within you and has a unique way of delivering the teachings/readings in the Bible very well. I love how much he includes and engages the kids during worship. I can’t wait when my baby grows old enough to understand and really participate in the kids’ activities. His sense of humor is a bonus too! My family and I look forward to Sundays to attend service!

The Director of Communications, Anne Smith has been such a reliable, efficient and thoughtful person to connect and work with! She makes sure your questions and concerns are addressed while still accommodating if there’s anything more that she can assist you with up to the last minute.

We also met with the Sunday school teachers Ms. Allie and Ms. Shannon who are both so kind, approachable and great with kids!

This church is a sanctuary, a peaceful and serene place of worship. It’s a sacred place to get connected with Christ, re-connect or start, “ wherever you are on your journey of faith”, as they say. 🤍

Thank you Pastor Rick, Anne, and the rest of the church staff who make sure the church is working like a well-oiled machine. 🙏🏼 Summer concerts resumed in 2023. We attended the first one in June 2023. It was beautiful.

Older reviews: Sunday Summer Concert Series - awesome performance on June 23, 2019. Sarah Fantappie impressed with her voice and her talent as the MC for this concert.
Thank you! I have been a member since 1977.
My two daughters have been baptized and grew up in the church.
Our present minister was selected by groups who filled out forms on what they wanted in a minister.  I said I wanted a minister with a sense of humor.  And I got my wish.  Linda
