name: The OAK Church - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary:
Hands down the best church i have ever been a part of. Kyle & Nina, Claude & Andrea, David & Rhonda, Craig & Iricel, and any of the leaders i am missing (Apologies if i am) as well as this Body as a whole are truly seekers of God. They seek to exemplify Christ in all that they do. They are beacons of light in a world rampant with darkness. This Body will welcome you with open arms regardless of where you come from and/or where you’ve been. Even if you seek time alone with God you will always be welcomed with open arms. This ain’t a social club. This is a Family! i have heard stories as well as seen it with my own eyes from covering people’s rent/mortgages, covering tuition, providing transportation (including providing vehicles), helping people relocate, getting people off the streets and into a home, getting them back to work, helping the ostracized find belonging, supporting missions abroad, you name it, it’s been done. All in the Name of Jesus and for the furthering of His Kingdom. From coming together to pray to going out and putting boots on the ground in neighboring counties to walk about and pray. Speaking of boots on the ground, i have never seen such a strong military presence in a church. Safety will never be a concern here. i declare it in Jesus name. Anyone thinking of trying would be hit so hard with the Holy Spirit upon entering the door that it’s not even a concern.  However, (bearing in mind that’s not our portion) if someone were to do so, just know they would be dealt with expeditiously. There is freedom in this House especially when it comes to praise and worship. This Church is for everyone, but it is especially for the peculiar, the outcasts, the overlooked, the downtrodden, the second class citizens, the differently abled, the worldly nonconformists, the rejectors of vanity, the seekers of ancient fire. If you’re tired of the western church, if you’re tired of its rigidity, if you’re tired of its religious tenets, then come to The Overcomer’s Anointed Kingdom. Remember the future… Christ shall revive Augusta!!! I have never experienced “church” like this before. The Oak is so much more. We are a family devoted to following Jesus Christ. My relationship with the Lord has grown in ways I could’ve never imagined under the spiritual leadership of pastor Kyle and Nina. I am new in my walk with the Lord and being in His Word. There are many things I don’t understand, or just don’t know about the Bible. Kyle and Nina are always patient and eager to teach all things related to the Word of God. Holy Spirit is always the honored guest at the Oak. When I tell you He always shows up and shows out, you can see it, feel it and almost touch His tangible presence every time the body of the Oak comes together to be unified in Christ Jesus!
My teenage daughters have been transformed into daughters of the Most High King, and one of the amazing parts is, they know it. That is an amazing feat and testimony coming from a mother that used to be a lost drug addict just a few years ago. I was always encouraged and guided to seek the Lord and His word. The Oak is my church!!! I thank the Lord everyday for bringing my family to the The Oak and for putting in place such amazing spiritual leaders! Pastor Kyle and Nina are an amazing example to all of us of a Godly couple who point everything back to the Lord and His word! Their obedience to Lord is amazing! I haven’t ever attended a church where there is such FREEDOM to worship the Lord and where you can quite literally feel the Tangible Presence of the Lord! They allow the Holy Spirit to move and don’t hinder what He is doing. I knew the moment that we walked into service for the first time that we had found our new church! Both of my boys and even my husband absolutely feel at home there and
we have all grown in our walk with the Lord! The OAK is so much like the church of Acts! Thank you Jesus! The oak ministry is a church that believes in the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. At the Oak, foundational truths are strongly emphasized and the gospel is preached and demonstrated in power. There are often testimonies of miracles, visions, and the presence of our all mighty King doesn’t visit the church, He lives there. This church loves God so much and so passionate to lead others to experience the love of the Father in ways that are unexplainable. The heart of this church is Christ, the worship is filled with the Holy Spirit as He works in the hearts of the believers, and we experience often how His working gives lasting impact to the one receiving from Him. This church is God’s tabernacle. God promotes family there and you will feel as if you been in the fam for years simply by walking through the door. We are not a church family, only, we are family moving in unity because we share the same Father.

Don’t give us a try, give the Father a try and allow this church to be your family as we all aspire to enhance the kingdom as one. I came once and never left. The intimacy between the body and the Father is rarely seen in uniform like this. This is the church of Acts! Come worship God the Father, Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit with this family of God. You ever have the nagging sense that there is more to the Christian life? If so you are not alone. I always had to at feeling too. Going to Oak Church not only proved my suspicions, it showed me that God could be experienced on on a real tangible level and on a consistent basis. Oak Church is marked by passion and presence with its emphasis on the union of Word and Spirit. There are no superstar leaders, only humble servants passionate about raising up and equipping a generation of spiritual warriors. Even the youth carry the presence of God at this church. It’s truly amazing

name: The Oasis Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary: There are no words to express my joy in this church!  The Lord clearly placed me here and I am forever grateful to call it my home.  Pastor Jeff is an incredible Bible teacher and I have grown deeper in my walk with Jesus since attending.  The Oasis is all about Jesus and you will hear His name and word spoken every week just as it should be.  He is magnified and lifted high week after week with no fluff.  I highly recommend The Oasis in Gilbert for anyone looking for a smaller Bible based church. The Lord brought me to this Church.  I am amazed every Sunday at what an incredible lesson I just heard and the worship music!  I look forward to every Sunday Service! Bible Studies and the overall fellowship there is like a big family with the common goal ❤️  the Pastor is passionate about his teachings all led thru the Holy Spirit and completely right out of the Bible.  God's Word.  Please visit this watering hole, it is my oasis.  Praise Jesus! Nice little church in a nice little spot in the heart of Gilbert.  They follow what appears to be the new church standard - meet early for coffee, sing the latest popular "worship" songs for 20 minutes, listen to a pastor for 40 minutes, close in prayer, sing another popular song, visit after and go home.  The overall service is a little light on depth and substance but Pastor Royce is a booming preacher who delivers a powerful message that's accurate to God's Word and never once looked at a note.  Best sermon on James 2 and the dynamics of faith and works I've ever heard! Comfortable, contemporary, cordial.  A very safe, nice little worship experience.  I'll come anytime. Loved everything listed on the website looked promising until I saw on social media they celebrate holidays. Egg hunts don't need to mix with Resurrection Sunday more churches need to wake up. Pastor Jeff, the wonderful worship team, and the whole church family that makes up the body of Christ, has been most wonderful. I’m praising the Lord for placing me in this church.

name: The Offer Christian Fellowship
The Olive Branch Christian Fellowship - Waco Campus
reviewSummary: Love my church family. It's nice to have a place where I can just be me, and they still love me back. I'm very blessed to have found this place where worship is free and inviting and REAL. This is a awesome place if you want to experience the holy spirit ,this is the place to come. Amen 🙏 Experienced God's presence.  Worship was beautiful.  The message was right out of Marks Gospel. There is always a wonderful presence of The Holy Spirit. It is a place to feel loved. Pastor Rick and First Lady Martha are annointed Shepherds of God and teach the truth of God's word.

name: The Olive Branch Church Campus - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: This church helped me through some very difficult times. Such loving people! I appreciate the Love and support throughout the years! I highly highly recommend attending one of the services in person or online. You will not be disappointed. God Bless 🙏🏼 Pastor Martinez is an awesome teacher of the gospel!! We will miss coming here but watching on u tube! We moved to bullhead Arizona… hope to find an awesome church like this one. Lynda and Tommy A true family atmosphere. Everyone I’ve met and talked to has been the sweetest. I never thought I’d go to church ever again in my life but this place made me think twice. The Olive Branch Church was a blessing for my friend and I when we visited- we recommend to go- the people are kind and happy.  The pastor and wife greeted us and they have morning coffee, tea , continental breakfast.  The Word of God is preached and prayer is offered. What a blessing to the city of Hemet and San Jacinto area.  May the LORD bless.  Amen. Sis. Jenny. God is alive in this church I love my lord and my family in Christ .And the Pastor teaches his people right from the Bible. Pastor Anthony & his Wife God has blessed  Amen starts at 10 am on Sundays God has called me there for a reason..

name: The Open Door Church - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: I have been going to open door now for 1 year and I absolutely loved this church. It's biblically based and you will be surrounded by loving people. When I went through my divorce I needed good teaching and loving people to help me through my tough time. My kids and I feel welcomed and I know God spirit is moving in this church. The Open Door is a wonderful Bible-following church, with the most amazing passionate and wise Pastor I’ve ever met. It feels like being home with a loving family every time I’m there. Been going for over 2 years and I absolutely love it. Prayerful and earnest congregation as well! The most welcoming congregation ever!  My first visit to The Open Door felt like “home” to me. I love the teaching and the preaching. The music touches my soul every Sunday. Love is in abundance here! I've been attending this church for about 1.5 years.  I felt welcomed from the first day I attended.  These people are now like family to me in many ways.  The pastor is very insightful.  His sermons are more like a conversation at the family table as opposed to someone just standing up and talking AT me for a hour. I love this church! The primary focus on the Word, worship, teaching, and community has allowed me to be in fellowship with wonderful members of the body of Christ and grow in my faith while doing so.

name: The Orchard - Oxford Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm not normally one to leave a review for anything, but I had to make an exception for this wonderful church. The Orchard was such a great place for my family and I. The people were authentic, genuine and truly caring. Pastor Eric and Pastor Alex give outstanding, heartfelt sermons. The worship is great as well. Unfortunately life circumstances caused us to move out of state and we were only at the Orchard for about 10 months. Those 10 months however felt about 5 years (in a good way!) with all the love, support and connection we experienced. To anyone looking for a church in the Oxford area we can't recommend the Orchard enough! This church teaches truth. The worship music is very moving. The pastors are wonderful! Acoustic set for worship.  Friendly to visitors.  Recommended. I have been a part of The Orchard community since the beginning. One of my favorite things about the church is the dangerous willingness of the leadership to follow God's Call. The worship experience is purposefully simple and attractive to those who have been away from church, but at the heart of the church there is a yearning to be jolted from safety and into God's Kingdom work.

If you are looking for a place to sit, be seen, and stay the same, you can probably do better. But if you are hopeful that there could be more to God's Call for you--within a supportive and dynamic community--then I can't imagine a better place to start your journey. I've been a part of The Orchard now for over four years. My family believes that we have found a great church to be a part of that both challenges us to grow in our faith while helping us live out the Gospel of Christ in both our neighborhoods and city and beyond. The truths that are taught are deep while the atmosphere is casual. The congregation consists of folks from college aged to retirees and everyone in between (plus children).

And the bald headed Australian worship leader makes me laugh sometimes too!

name: The Orchard Church - Owasso Campus
reviewSummary:
I really love this place! They teach through the Bible and have lots of community group options. Their kids program is really sweet also. Great church with people who really care about you personally and want you to succeed
There’s lots of opportunities for community
If you’re looking for a new church home, the Orchard is here! Very friendly, intimate church. Message is clear verse by verse teaching.  Easy to understand and pull out real life application.  We were traveling and came but we would attend regularly if we lived local. It was my first visit and I didn’t know many people there, but the moment I stepped foot inside the door - I was greeted with big smiles and immediately felt welcome! From the Worship to the Pastor’s applicable sermon… to even walking out the doors, the members of this church are genuine and I felt God’s love & peace! I’ll definitely be back again! This is a great church and I highly recommend it. The pastor is a great communicator of Gods Word, the people are friendly and God is moving among the people!

name: The Outlet Community Church - Brookhaven Campus
reviewSummary:
Outlet has been the amazing church home I’ve been looking for. They are a strong, passionate house of prayer. Each service is led with prevalent compassion and sound doctrine and I truly have been elevating in my faith in brand new ways. As someone who has been a sheep my whole life; it’s been difficult to find a church home that has been helpful in my individualized struggles with faith, discipline, and my devotion. This church and congregation have given me fresh eyes to see The Lord in amazing, brand new ways. I am forever grateful and forever a member. The Outlet Community Church is truly something special. I love their heart for the community and their commitment to investing in local schools. Their support for students, teachers, and families is sincere, consistent, and impactful. It’s refreshing to see a church so dedicated to serving beyond its walls. I’ve carried this story on my heart for over five years, and I finally want to share it.
This perfectly illustrates the heart of this church and its leadership.
About 5/6 years ago, I was struggling with significant mental health challenges, bipolar disorder and severe anxiety (but look at God).
One day while driving my wife and two children to a service, I had a minor accident at the parking structure that triggered a major episode. Overwhelmed, I left the car and took off on foot leaving children and wife heading toward home that was 35 miles away.
When my wife informed Pastor Vinnie, he didn't hesitate. He actually stepped away from a pending service to come look for me. Not knowing how long he spent driving around, but I was AWOL for about 30 minutes.
The fact that a leader would pause everything to care for one member of his flock in a moment of crisis says everything you need to know about The Outlet Community Church. Pastor Vinnie is an excellent leader who truly lives out the compassion he preaches. This is a place of real support and genuine care.
Thank you,
And congratulations Pastor Vinnie I am a member of this church. I can honestly say that becoming plugged in with this community has truly transformed my life.  This a community of love, acknowledgment and blessings.  I am forever grateful to Pastors Vince and Ashley Thomas for teaching me how to be a great stewardess of Christ Very welcoming and open church. Monthly grocery give away is a blessing to many. Teen and kids church is fun and educational.

name: The Paradox Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
Super sweet and welcoming church. Young adult demographic, (lot of TCU students/alumni) with a health balance of other ages to blend in well. Parking is a little hard through. Plenty of street parking and lots of spots up front, but they fill QUICKLY. Plus there’s an extra lot behind panther pavilion when needed.  I really great church though, website will give a lot of better information. At a service in May, I was horrified when the minister said it was okay to hate things or people that you are against. This church says it centers around Jesus. This church is a paradox- Jesus never thought okay to hate anything.  Also the minister said one of the worst sins is being gay.  This place is straight out of the middle ages. If you go to this place, do you really believe this? This was my first time here. Feels Anglican ish in terms of a few things, baptist in terms of others. Which I've grown to appreciate in more recent years (I grew up charismatic).

If I lived in Fortworth area, I'd definitely want to come back and learn more. Praise be! This is a wonderful church with great people and also id like to add how CLEAN their building was. Cleanliness is close to godliness as we all know. Via con Dios ♥️ Excellent experience!  Great staff!  Also on line services!  Will return.  Young, hip congregation!

name: The Park Church of Christ - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: Used a room for a 1 year old birthday party. It was very clean. Meet many very sweet Christian people there. I love this church and I love their people they have helped me out a few times after I had a car wreck their Pastor is amazing Miss Lori is amazing their staff there is amazing just went to the ladies Christmas party and brought my mom if you haven't been here I would suggest going and checking out and making it your new home you will not be disappointed Everyone was very welcoming. It is a large church, and I was surprised at how small it felt. I enjoy a core strength class in their gym 2-3 times a week! What a great place to go to church! They just moved to the 96th and Memorial location from 51st and Sheridan. Same wonderful people, but so much more room to serve others. And best of all, there's room for you! If you're looking for a church home where people love Jesus and love others, look no further. This church family is just waiting for you!

name: The Pearl Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment we first walked through the doors of Pearl Church, we felt genuinely welcomed—not only by a beautiful community of sisters and brothers, but by Jesus Himself.

Through worship, thoughtful sermons, meaningful community, and a deep culture of prayer, this church has been a place of encouragement and growth. The guidance in spiritual practices has been especially impactful, helping us navigate both the joys and challenges of life while walking with Jesus.

From Pastors Doug and Donna Lassit to the many dedicated leaders and teams, this is a truly special community. We are deeply grateful.

Come and see—your heart will be met, lifted, and set ablaze in the very best way. ✨ My mom and friend went church in 1977 and nice inside cool place and wonderful church community great job you have done God Bless I absolutely love this church and community, would recommend, they also have snacks after services which is lit. Absolutely love this church. My husband and I travel for work and try to find a church in each city we go to. We stumbled on this one and still talk about how much we loved it. The passion and love is genuine from the lobby to the worship and sermon. The community here is so kind and welcoming. I’ve never been to a church where I felt like I had friends immediately. People connected with us intentionally on day one and remembered us when we returned. It was such a shock as an east coaster but so endearing and heartwarming. The music was powerful and the message was as well. My heart leapt every service. I only went three times and miss it already. Highly recommend this church!! We were so blessed to be welcomed for our conference. The little interaction we had with the few members that were present to facilitate the conference were such kind and attentive individuals. Thank You for your heart of Service and the vision for the community.

name: The People's Church of Colorado Springs - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
The most Christ-centered church in town. The entire church and their homeless ministry is run by volunteers. Even the pastor is not paid. Every cent goes to the ministry. Top that off with the Pastor and members taking a meal and necessities out on the trails weekly to provide for the less fortunate and a large meal after church on Saturday afternoons. They teach strictly from the Bible and the congregation is welcoming. You can come as you are and there is no judgement. A truly beautiful group of worshipers here. I was entrapped by the pastor and assistant pastor. the pastor said he needed to talk to a friend about their recovery, never said they were going come with other people, then they kicked me and him out of the church. They said our relationship doesn't look good to the church because he has a home and I live on the streets, but their name is THE PEOPLES CHURCH A CHURCH FOR THE HOMELESS COMMUNITY. I’ve been going to church since I was 6 years old. I’ve been member of at least 8 different churches throughout my life and visited many others. By now, I know how to tell if church leadership is fake or not.

Since BEFORE the People’s church opened its doors, they have been routing all of their resources, donations and unpaid time towards creating a safe space for EVERYONE in the community to be able to hear God’s unfiltered Word without judgment of any kind. They are not only focused on people’s relationships with their creator, Jesus, but they also aim to provide physical assistance to everyone who needs it such as food, supplies, visitation in hard times, counseling and prayer. The Holy Spirit directs the stewardship of the resources they receive and I feel 100% comfortable giving my time, money and effort to the mission of the church because we are all imperfect people serving a perfect God, and even though we are bound to fail, He never has. Throughout the years I have watched the leadership grow in Spiritual maturity, love and discernment which only happens when you are truly filled with God’s Holy Spirit. I myself have experienced much Spiritual growth from where I was when the church began to now.

At the end of the day, if you want a church to go sit at and warm a pew, this is not the place; however if you want a church where you will allow God to transform you as you yourself change the life of others by being His hands and feet, then look no further. May the Lord bless and keep any person with the attention span to read this entire rant! 😅♥️ This church is the litetal hands and feet of Jesus in Colorado Springs. This is the most caring, accepting, God-centered church in town.  Not one person gets paid including the pastor.  Every cent goes toward feeding and providing supplies for the homeless in the community.  Each and every person is welcome here and you feel the presence of God at each service,  Saturdays at 3pm. The pastor and other members walk the trails each week handing out food to the homeless. This church is amazing and has impacted many lives in beautiful ways. The people are always so willing to help in any way they can. I am very impressed with the authenticity and genuine kindness everyone has. It's amazing how there is no judgment but full acceptance of everyone who shows up. No one is paid and is all volunteers who show up every Saturday, and to include volunteers to walk the street and hand out food, and be there for those who are struggling. Can see/feel the Holy Spirit Moving in this Place. God bless you 🔥🔥🔥

name: The Phoenix International Christian Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
To sum up how much I love this church, this FAMILY, in just a couple of sentences is incredibly difficult. I have been a member for the last two years, and my life has completely changed in so many amazing ways! I’ve never been a part of something quite like this before. The love is REAL. The devotion to God and the focus on His Word is REAL. I have learned so much about who God really is and what it really means to follow Jesus Christ. These people are my brothers and sisters, my spiritual parents, my best friends. We actually DO life together; we worship together, we pray together, we laugh and play together, we work together, we LOVE together, we hurt TOGETHER. And we do it all for God’s glory. I wanted to find God, and He brought me here. No words can fully express how eternally grateful I am! If I knew of a more loving, academically sound, intellectually fluid, spiritually driven, fiscally responsible, evangelization prioritizing organization of Christ believing people,  I would be there.  My only regret, is how long I waited to become a sold-out Disciple of Christ. If you want true family (not just on Sunday’s) genuine friendship (people who actually know you/love you and you know them completely) the truth from the Bible (using the whole bible and in context) loving accountability (always called to be your best “you” and ultimately striving together to be like Jesus) help with life’s challenges (incredible mentoring and personal bible studies) and much more then this is the church to be!  It’s truly added so much my husband and I’s life and we’re excited to raise our son in such a wonderful church family that truly imitates God’s Word! I met one person in the campus ministry and within a week I could have a comfortable conversation with at least 30 church members.

There's nothing like family that cares deeply about your relationship with God! Church friends as far as the Sydney, Australia church will ask me how I'm doing with God.

The individual Bible studies changed my life. I have formed biblical convictions of my own. I know what questions to ask about church practices because they expect and motivate me to read the Bible (outside of church, especially!) as part of my walk!!

I have people who care about my life and character challenges. I don't have to feel guilty about neglecting my time with God, because I have people supporting me and pushing me to seek Him 100%. If you believe that the Bible is the inspired Word of God and that the doctrine and practice of the church should be based on that alone, you need to check out this church! It is awesome because God is blessing it because they are teaching the true gospel of Jesus Christ based on the Bible! That's why I go there and have for many years.

name: The Place City of Miracles Cathedral - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Today I was blessed to meet a few amazing members of the congregation, walking down my street praying for all of us who live here. We shared a couple of stories, they all prayed over me and we even shared some laughs!  Lovely men and women of God spreading the word, caring for others and being His disciples!  Keep up your beauty, your love for Christ and others, you are the light He talks about! See you soon!

name: The Point Church - Centerville / Washington Township Campus
reviewSummary: Loving people and a pastor, teacher filled with the Holy Spirit. Love this place and the people ❤️ Such a welcoming atmosphere and beautiful worship.  We started attending The Point last December and we already feel so at home here.   Steve and Sam are amazing Pastors with a true gift of spreading God’s Word. We are so thankful for this church community! This is an Amazing church, the Pastor and every member there are very warm and welcoming.  This church is what God is all about and you can't help but feel the Holy Spirits presence there.  I enjoy the sermons every Sunday, they have helped me in my every day life.  The Bible studies on wednesday nights are amazing.  I know without a doubt the Lord led me here to this church. Welcoming contemporary church, focused on following God and serving his children. Great music, kids programs and service opportunities. I am so grateful for my church family that focuses on building our relationship with God through fellowship and service in our community.

name: The Point Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited the church twice last year, felt a bit overwhelmed with the many questions about where I am from(I guess because of my accent they wanted to know my ethnicity or is i was really American). I don't mind talking about who I am and what I do but it didn't felt organic, it felt more like an interrogation. There was no followup or attempt for me to keep coming or same my life.

I ended up finding another church where they immediately welcomed me and didn't pry too much about me. They even came to my home to save my soul, I felt much more appreciated. Sad that I couldn't be part of an apostolic Christian church like i was raised. The Point Church has been a great fit for my family. The people are kind and loving. Pastor Mike is amazing! I love my church! I came to The Point about 8 years ago looking for a good church to raise kids in and haven't left since. The people were all so warm and welcoming and I have made many lifelong friends here. The Pastor and Pastor's wife are some of the greatest people I know. Pastor is an amazing teacher of the Bible, is a great leader, and funny too, so services are always engaging and allow me to take something and implement it in my every day life. The worship in the services is awesome. You can really feel God's spirit. And I never feel self-conscience about how I worship here. My kids (8 months, 2 years, and 4 years) all love Sunday school and their teachers. They have learned many Bible stories to give them a good foundation in the Word. If you want a church that feels more like a family and has a real sense of community, come to The Point. I'm looking for a church where the pastor is himself when preaching and not performing, I'm  looking for a church without legalism. I came to this church by way of my son while I was in a very dark place.  I was  welcomed with open arms and such love that is given a family member.  I received the Holy Spirit who taught me to speak in tongues and got baptized soon after.  I am thankful for this most awesome spiritual gift that God has seen fit to give me.  It is through the guidance and teachings of Pastor Sargent that I have learned and grown so much in Faith.

name: The Pointe Church - Brandon / Reservoir Campus
reviewSummary:
Atmosphere is different but to be honest and fair some people there have very rude attitudes God says come as you are when I went with my friend for a food box sum where rude and very impolite some where ok. Best place to grow spiritually !  Spirit-led family of Followers of Jesus. An honor to worship and serve there. Many ministries both adults and children/youth with several small groups that meet regularly. Encounter nights are powerful! Get to The Pointe! I love this place!! They are a great family full of love Very friendly and outgoing people Very nice church We love The Pointe Church! The people are very warm and welcoming, they have child care services, great music, fellowship, activities, etc. PLUS, the Pastor is amazing and teaches straight from the Bible. 💕
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: The Pointe Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church!! I've been attending for 10+ years and every year, I feel like I'm learning and growing.  The people are welcoming and warm.  The sermons are relevant and powerful.  The gospel is the highest priority - and the worship is amazing!! I've raised my kids here... 10 outta 10 church! I'm so thankful. My family and I have been looking for a church for over ten years (tried several but never felt like we found a home). We went through a very devestating loss of a beloved family member and I believe we were lead to the Pointe Church. Since then we have been going on a regular basis, I even got baptised and my children love the care pointe academy (we are even looking into starting our son at full time child care). My wife and I have become so much closer with extra activities at the Church like the Pointe Academy where we to Financial Freedom and the Marriage You Always wanted. Last but not least, the band, oh my goodness they are amazing (I actually started taking guitar lessons with Nick Bowcott and it was so nice to meet another member of the church). Truly a wonderful place and we are always inviting others! Thank you! I have been attending The Pointe off and on for 8 years and regularly now for 2 years. I am happy to call this church my home. The Pointe turns sound Doctrine into engaging, exciting and relevant sermons. I have built lifelong friendships and grown immensely through the small groups I have attended. The church staff genuinely care about each person that comes through the door. I definitely recommend trying out our church and seeing if you feel called to make it your church home too. My family and I have had the privilege of attending The Pointe Church for over seven years. I can still vividly remember our first day walking through the doors and how everything we had been seeking and praying for was right there in front of us. From the warm, welcoming smiles at the door to the aroma of fresh coffee, the inviting and relaxed atmosphere, and the vibrant worship energy—everything felt like a perfect fit. We were immediately struck by the beautiful diversity—across age, race, and life experiences—and the messages that are both practical and inspiring, ready to be put into action right away. Our daughter especially loves the kids’ area, and there’s so much more to love about this place. What stands out most is how much our faith has grown being part of this incredible community. If you’re looking for a church home, we wholeheartedly invite you to give The Pointe a try—there’s always room for more here! I was broken and with the help of some great people. Through God I'm on the mend. They don't care if you're messy. God wants you as you are.

name: The Porch Community Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary: We went a few weeks back to share time with son and fiancee. They have a coffee/bites ministry to start. The worship was the best I've been to in twenty years. Balanced in sound and amazingly gifted worship team to get you in the mindset to be in the Word.  The word was too short. I'm not sure if a guest speaker or actual fulltime spoke but it was direct and short. Lots of ministry teams to be a part of. This church must have an admin team that comes from spirit filled training. We look forward to going back. This is a tight knit group.   The minister is very good.  She doesn't talk over your head and makes the subject matter interesting. The kids group is second to none.  They are very active in children outreach. The church also gives back to the community in many ways. This place is a rock band that focuses on making concerts highlighted with female pastors. I would recommend going to another place. Love it! Awesome church

name: The Potter's House
reviewSummary: An iconic global ministry led by Bishop T.D. Jakes. Reviews consistently mention the 'powerful' worship and 'life-changing' preaching. It is celebrated as a model of diversity.

name: The Potter’s House
reviewSummary: An iconic global ministry led by Bishop T.D. Jakes. Reviews consistently mention the 'powerful' worship and 'life-changing' preaching. It is celebrated as a model of diversity.

name: The Potter's House - Reynoldsburg Campus
reviewSummary:
From the first day I steped in Potter's house Reynoldsburg, Every Sunday I experienced God's presence the most.
Most welcoming place for everyone with love and caring. I will never forget this experience in my life.❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤ This is a wonderful church and people are very welcoming here. I just came from service and really enjoyed the worship, preaching, and prayer! If you live nearby, you should certainly visit here. Building is fine, closest thing to God you'll find here. Hateful rhetoric, when called out on it the wife of the pastor quite literally plugged her ears and didn't defend her beliefs. So either, they know they're wrong, or they aren't pious enough to defend their beliefs. I have grown so much in my relationship with christ i love my family in christ here at the potters house being the hands and feet of christ i have been able to be a part of The outreach with so many beautiful sisters and brothers in Christ. Love the pastor and his loving wife . The word is always right on time.
How can one be taught Lest he has a teacher pastor Kyle's Teaches and I love it the word of God. My late wife years ago wanted to attend church there and she was Baptized by Pastor Tim Oldfield. We always enjoyed every service. Today, since her passing, I now attend a different church. If you are looking for a church who preaches the gospel this would be a church for you.

name: The Potter's House - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly faces, exciting events during the holidays!

name: The Potter's House (Orange) - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary: Tremendous presence of God. I feel at home when I visit this church. Everyone is friendly. Great Place to Worship Jesus Christ, uninhibited. God is 😊! Great place to worship God !

name: The Potter's House Christian Church
reviewSummary:
Awesome church, Pastor Fernando & his wife Jerusalem are a blessing!!😁 If you are looking for a real life changing experience this is the place to go. Pastor Medina is an awesome preacher who preaches the truth straight out of the word of God.  I gave my life to Jesus 9 years ago and I was broken and ran out of options. I was tired of the lies from this world and appreciated the truth being told to me. It has changed my life and my kids life for the better. Pastor Medina and his wife have a heart for souls. Their only goal is to see people make it for Jesus! The song service is so beautiful great church The pastor was judgmental and full of gossip,  all the reviews he got is because of his hypocrisy people didn't know that he gossip over them behind their back after smiling to their face.
He didn't have the minimum of qualifications to become a pastor, that why the church is closed. I love the dedication and wisdom Pastor Anthony and his wife Alexis have. It's evident they have a genuine love for people and it's truly admired by many.

name: The Potter's House Christian Church - Hendersonville / Sumner Campus
reviewSummary: Do not leave things in people's doors. It signals to criminals that someone isn't home. If you want send things out to get more traffic use the US Postal Service. Brand new church very nice and welcoming people, no judgement. Pastor is very easy going and passionate about spreading the word. I enjoyed my experience. Come and bring some friends to help this place grow :) I get that you’re trying to spread the word about your church but BANGING for minutes on my front door while I have Covid isn’t the way to go. People that want to go to church have Facebook groups you guys can post on. The last thing I needed on my Saturday morning was jumping awake from cop-like knocking after coughing myself up all night. The pamphlet thing is funny though, it’s going on my fridge. An extra star for the Jesus calling phone screen. This church is welcoming and they preach the word of God! A great place to see lives changed. Great place to praise God, welcomed by the pastor and his family, never been to a more Holy Ghost church every, and the drummer is amazing

name: The Potter's House Christian Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a REAL Bible believing church. Here’s what’s true: if you look hard enough
for something negative about a church, you will find it no matter where you go. But, if you’re looking for a positive, uplifting place to go to develop a relationship with Christ and like minded individuals, this is the place to go! God has transformed my life and showed me what it means to love and be loved, how to live as a Christian (not in name only), and how to forgive as I have been forgiven! Come see for yourself what God’s plan for your life is and let Jesus transform your life!! Hospitable, faithful and kind believers in Jesus!
We visit annually for a marriage retreat weekend and are always blessed. I grew up a religious person thinking that I was going to heaven because I was a “good person” and no one told me that I was so wrong. I was invited to this church and the first day I went I felt a strong conviction for my sinful ways and realized that I needed Jesus. If it wasn’t for churches like this one , that preaches the true gospel , I would’ve continued to be lost in this world. No one is perfect but you can feel a genuine love for Christ and a desire to see true miracle so in peoples lives in this church. The pastor has always been a strong leader and I am so thankful that God lead me here. There are rare places in life that shape not just who you are but who you become, and for me, this place is one of them. It’s not just where I raised my family—it’s where I grew into the person I am today. In a world where many miss the mark due to a lack of reverence for Godly authority, this place has stood as a guiding light, grounding me in faith and purpose in Jesus Christ name, not religion. With that being said, I’ve launched my children from my shoulders, not my feet, giving them a foundation of strength, faith, and love to carry forward. #OSIDECFM In October 2012, one day before finalizing my divorce, I stumbled upon the Oceanside Potter’s House Christian Fellowship Church. A chance encounter near a Navy Federal Credit Union ATM led me to this church, just 20 feet away. At rock bottom, their Sunday morning worship song drew me in. Pastor Tim Moynihan, through scripture, showed me the path to unity under God. I was saved, and miraculously, my wife followed suit three days later. The day we were supposed to finalize our divorce at the Vista Courthouse, my wife and I showed up and tore the divorce papers. Since then, with gratitude to Pastor Tim and, above all, to our Lord Jesus Christ, we’ve been together with our three beautiful children to this day. All glory to Jesus Christ, our Lord and Savior!

name: The Potter's House Christian Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Love this Church. The pastor and his wife are dynamic, approachable and down to earth. The congregation is small but growing every service. This church is not afraid to preach the truth and to move in the gifts of the spirit! If you are looking for a church that is on the move, visit the Potter's House in San Marcos, CA! Nice little church great message and great worship music . Visiting from Texas I will be back. Great church with great people running it The Potter’s House of San Marcos is a welcoming, Bible-believing church with a strong focus on discipleship, evangelism, and spreading the Gospel. The Word of God is taken seriously, and there’s a genuine desire to see lives transformed through Jesus Christ. If you’re looking for a church that will encourage you to grow in your faith and reach others with the Gospel, I highly recommend visiting! Outstanding Word of God and really nice songs

name: The Potter's House Christian Fellowship Church
reviewSummary:
This beautiful church has lead me to Christ and changed my destiny! I have met so many great people over the years here and we even got married here!

The church is following the Bible and is not swayed by the ever changing culture. This is the best way to help Portland, to lead the people to Jesus and stay strong in Him! May the Lord richly bless this church and their people! Galatians message today, was excellent today. The warm reception as a new attendee was heartfelt- we will be back.
Thank you, Sandy I praise God every day that he led an outreach team from this church to my apartment door a couple years ago. Attending this church has truly been life changing. The teaching is biblically sound and Gospel centered, and the congregation feels like family. This is how church is supposed to be. 😍 The pastor is very wise and knowledgeable. You will always be in his prayers even if you leave. Very family like church with lots of events and closeness Great church, great people! I’m blessed to come in today! Thank you Lord for your message this morning. Thank you for the pastors, the body, and the Holy Spirit that I felt in this church. God bless this church in Jesus mighty name Amen

name: The Potter's House Christian Fellowship Church - Glendale, AZ - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Rens, Rhonda and the congregation are amazing and welcomed our family with open arms.

We are so glad we have a place where our girls can serve God and live for him, especially in this generation. This church is amazing I have been here for 10 years now. Grew up in this church and was saved in this church. Holy Ghost preaching and amazing church family people who really care about you. God has blessed this church greatly, because Pastor Rens and his Wife Rhonda truly love God and serve him. Great church to come to if you want to here some real preaching not all the soft preaching that these new churches are doing. Great fellowship church to be apart of that love People And preach the truth ..this is a family that was broken and Thank god for churches like the Potter house Christian fellowship… Pastor JR Stewart great Man and God I was raised in THIS church. I fell away from it when I became bitter over my parent's divorce. I was a Satanist. Because of Jesus, not only am I a Christian, but I have a better relationship with my family now. (John 3:3) I love this church, Pastor Rence and his wife Rhonda are great people the word of God is minister with wisdom and keeping in mind the spiritual needs of the church.  The congregation is awesome you will feel welcome and you will want to continue to come,  I've been here for 6 years and would not want to be anywhere else.

name: The Potters House Christian Fellowship Church - Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Great service😇

name: The Potters House Christian Fellowship Church - San Francisco Campus
reviewSummary: I was invited to a concert here in San Francisco. The Potter’s House  Christian church is a local church, so I decided to attend. They provide live entertainment, and  people preach about Jesus Christ and the good news of salvation! The people were nice, and I encourage you to attend Lovely welcoming place. Wonderful church! We are into planting churches all over the world. The bible tells us to go into all the world and preach the gospel. The best church in the world. It will change your life forever

name: The Potters House Christian Fellowship Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: This Church is Genuine and all about Jesus Christ. They speak 100% truth about the Gospel. It changed my life forever. Praise God, our Lord Jesus Christ. Encouraging ... Life Changing preaching. The Lord is lifted up. It was great Gets the best out of you .

name: The Presbyterian Church of Bowling Green Campus
The Promise Center - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been to a lot of churches in my walk with Christ and I can tell you God is doing something special here. The Holy Spirit is on the move at The Promise Center. Community is being built, and Love is abound. Thankful for Pastors who are obedient to the call and don’t shy away from who God is, and what He wants to do. His presence is always felt. I love love love The Promise Center. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I love going to the promise Center. I was baptized there in 2022 around Christmas time. So nice that they offer so many services.  Pastor Chad and Heidi are really good people. The praise and worship team is fabulous and all the many events and classes they have are top notch. Everyone is so friendly and welcome you with open arms. I definitely recommend coming here. Jesus is Lord. My boyfriend brought me here for the first time. I enjoyed the music, and the people. I began coming more often as the sermons are awesome. Speaks to life now, and ways to navigate our lives. The use of the big screen and multi-media is engaging and entertaining. The wisdom is a treat. I leave each Sunday with one message that helps me stay a good person and live a good life. I have begun volunteering with the kids in the daycare. Very kind people and progressive environment. This is the place to be, church family if you are looking for a safe place to worship Jesus with songs and the word come here Sundays 9:30a 11:30am you eyes will be opened. Great Bible Centered Teaching. The Pastor is so genuine, energetic, real, alive for Jesus Christ. The staff extraordinarily  welcoming. Truly, a Jesus Christ centric church. I felt so welcomed and appreciated. I received a welcoming phone call and 2 texts with a personal prayer. All this interest and kindness after my first visit.

name: The Promise Center Fairfield - Fairfield Campus
reviewSummary: Such a blessing we have to welcome such an amazing church into our Fairfield community! The people are unlike anyone I've come across. So genuinely caring and welcoming. No judgments, just a safe space. You feel like you're going to a family reunion every weekend ❤️ can't wait to see how God moves through this church into this community. The people are amazing! I’ve gone to many churches and this one was so welcoming. They are diverse but feel so unified in their service to the community. We went for the first time and met some people that we can hang out with outside of church. Great place for community and to make some new friends. Their kids zone is next level. My kids had a blast! They asked me if this could be our new church. If you’re looking for a church, Promise Center Fairfield needs to be at the top of your list to check out! The people and environment is warm & welcoming!  I'm so blessed to have been invited to this church campus.  My family and I all attend regularly and we are SO expectant to see what God is doing through this incredible ministry and throughout Solano County!  God is moving and the Holy Spirit is leading!  Come check it out with us!! An amazing place to find community and purpose! If you are looking for a church in Solano County your search ends here! If you have kids, they will love it here. The volunteers are all background checked and vetted prior to being able to serve with anyone under 18, plus they have an awesome space. Your kids are able to learn more about God while having fun in a safe space. Promise Center @ Fairfield is a great place to meet good people and develop a relationship with Jesus Christ.  I've been in this fellowship for a number of years and wouldn't trade this life experience for anything, if I had it to do all over again I would tweak a few decisions but arrive at the same goal where I'm at today.  Fairfield is a great city, the people, the proximity to major cities and attractions couldn't be better.  To quote a famous coach from the area "Who got it better than us... Nobody".  So I entreat you to come visit, take off your shoes, relax and stay awhile, you will enjoy your time with the people of the Promise Center @ Fairfield.

name: The Promise Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Not reviewing based on the service, but for their parking situation and how inconsiderate it is. I have lived right next to this church before it was the Promise Church. The previous establishment was not as inconsiderate with parking and the residents who live around the area. With how popular this church has become, there's been an influx of people who have been going to this church which is great, but not so great for the residents that live nearby. The church has its own parking lot in which 95% of the time is empty, or barely utilized; for cars atleast. This is an ongoing issue as parking on the street is a hassle due to the church having so many events and not utilizing their lot. To whom this concerns, all we ask is that the church please utilize the parking lot before having people park on the street where residents park their cars, or at least spread awareness of the people attending to try to park in the designated parking lot. Thank you. You can truly feel the presence of the Holy Spirit and as part of the family. Bishop Alas and his family are always attentive to everyone. The members  of the church are all very welcoming and helpful. I felt right at home.  Thank you Jesus❤🙏🏻 Blessed to have found this place, most genuinely caring people to pray for U & help U. The diaper bank & food distribution is weekly. Resources for housing available. Thank U God, for blessing me w these wonderful people whom welcome me w open arms giving me faith w the strength of their prayer. I have not attended their worship service and came here only with a friend to pick up free food that they are giving away 3 times a week and I think the days are Mondays, Wednesdays,  and Thursdays.

Be prepared to wait in line for at least an hour or so. They have two lines for vehicles that is alternating and three staff working: An elderly woman who directs the two Male staff or volunteers. And this is the reason for the long wait because  out of the 2 volunteers, only one is really working or doing the work because the other just stands there and directs the other what to do. But hey, free food is always worth the wait, right? A warm and heart-felted place to visit. Better yet, to be part of: is a welcoming family of people. They have an English and Spanish service on Sundays.

name: The Promise Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
The Promise Church is a vibrant, Spirit-filled community where the truth of God's Word is boldly preached, the Holy Spirit is powerfully at work, and the love of Jesus is felt in every moment. Worship is deeply rooted in Scripture, and it's a place where miracles, signs, and wonders are not just believed in—they happen.

With an incredible pastoral team, heartfelt worship, and a welcoming, supportive congregation, this church truly feels like family. If you're looking for a place where you can grow in your faith, experience God’s presence, and be surrounded by people who genuinely care, this is the place to be. The children's ministry is phenomenal, the Bible college is life-changing, and every service is filled with the power and presence of God. I’m beyond thankful that God led me and my family here—The Promise Church is home. The Promise Church has transformed my life in many ways.   They teach the word of God and dive deep into scriptures.  They are not afraid to share the gifts and promises available to all of us.  I continue to learn and grow because of the Promise Church.  Although I live in Hawaii, I am blessed with a Life Group, which I consider an extension of the Promise and meet to discuss Sunday’s service together.  If you are in the area or have access online I highly recommend attending and you will be blessed beyond measure. This church is nothing like I've ever experienced. First class teachings with a true family-like environment. Everyone is so approachable, friendly, and genuine from all walks of life. I have never been to a church with such a diverse and loving group of people. I love how Pastor Henry backs up everything he preaches with the Word. I've learned more about the Bible and grown in my relationship with God more in these past two years at the Promise than I ever have before anywhere else. This is the place where I got saved and even met my husband! So thankful for The Promise Church! Great Spirit filled Church. You feel the presence of God at every service. Pastor are Awesome and Supportive. Very friendly congregation. Pastor Henry and Pastor Cindy preach the Truth Very Good Bible Based Church. Worship is Awesome. Unbelievable children ministry ♡ Bible College Amazing ♡ Love My Promise Family This is the most amazing loving church! I feel like right away I had a family that took me in.
The young adult is really growing and we always have so much fun! (Not cliquey)
And I am so lucky to be taught by our one and only Pastor Henry! He is not shallow in his teaching, it does get challenging, but I know it is what God wants him to teach to us so we can increase, and the testimonies prove it!!!!

name: The Quest - Novato Campus
reviewSummary:
Be yourself. You're cool. And we love you, and your pup.

🙌🏽 I've been a member of The Quest since 2004.
Many times I questioned why I keep coming back. I'd visited other places,  but for biblical teachings of Christ and lessons about how to embrace a Christian mindset and life, this is the place to be.  There's no fake Christianity taught here. I wish they'd engage with our youth in a more warm way, and include them on Sunday, and have a room for them to meet in that was warm and inviting. The Quest is a wonderful church. Everyone is welcome, even gay people like me, to be fully loved members of this community. We are all on a journey together, exploring our faith, studying the Scriptures and working out what it means to be followers of the Christ. Wonderful church and community gathering center. They also host recovery meetings. Full kitchen. Great people. Video equipment available. Awesome new ministers Matt and Tony! Great Teens program on Tuesday nights my kids love! A  "non-churchy" church  that is so inclusive. A jewel in Novato.

name: The Refinery at Saddleback Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing part of Saddleback Church! This is honestly one of my favorite sections of Saddleback Church. We have
Adults (Main Worship Center)
College Students (Tent 1)
HSM (High School Ministry)
JHM (Junior High Ministry)
SK (Saddleback Kids)
And so much more!

I am a Sophomore in highschool so this is my second year in HSM, the leaders there are so welcoming and caring for each and one of us. The message the pastor brings each weekend has always had a positive impact with my relationship with Jesus and the messages also fit the mindset of ANY high schooler which I find incredible!

God bless! Beautiful space inside and out and great volunteer staff. If you like badminton, you can play here on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Make sure you give your email address so they can notify you when there's no game. People here are very friendly, 🙂. Great refuge for kids, family, friends, meetings.  Great decor, some games available.  This is not a restaurant.  It is one of the worship centers at Saddleback Church. The Refinery looks like a giant 5 🌟 living room  2 floors , elevator, different rooms for meetings, amazing comfortable sofas , chairs and
tables for groups and individuals
Pool tables
Karate
Basketball room
Badminton
Music room

Internet
Bending machines
Junior and High School programs

The Refinery was constructed using as much recycled materials to protect our environment.
The Refinery has been designed with an optimum indoor air quality.
The Refinery use 25 percent less energy than other code_compluing buildings.
Open to the public

Monday 9 AM to 9 PM
Tues To Friday s 9 AM to 7 PM

Love the green building designed that received a LEED Gold rating.

name: The Refinery Christian Church - Goodyear / Estrella Campus
reviewSummary: I'm visiting from South Carolina. I headed to the Refinery Church today for the 11AM service with my dad and stepmom who live in Goodyear. It was a beautiful church with lots of friendly people and staff. Powerful message and fantastic music. Blessings Refinery Church! My family and I visited on 12/07/25. Music and word were amazing but yes the greeting coming in and after the service were not present. We approached the New Comers booth and spoke to Steve and Amanda and they were so nice and welcoming, but other than that not one single person said hi (and believe me, you can see us lol). Absolutely love this church... awesome services and cheerful, spiritual celebrations! Been looking.   Found one that works for me.  Great worship, and great sermons about our everyday  challenges.  Went to a 55 plus dinner, and will visit the pastor's home for dinner next month.  There are lots of groups you can join.  People are sincerely  friendly and care about one another.  You can sign  up for a trip to the Holy Land, or serve in the nursery.  You can volunteer  to clean toilets, even. After moving here 3 years ago and looking for the right church for me, I found it!!! Three years ago, I was driving down 303 watching this building being built. After a few months, I saw the banner with Refinery Christian Church.  I went to visit it and felt like home. The worship music is amazing and the leaders right in the center if the Lord's spirit.  Then the lead pastor sermon was told with humility,  using the scripture out of the Bible, and I felt the congregation was so alive and filled with God's word. I have had many friends visit and they always come back. The kids ministries are lead with God's love and kids love the programs. Our community outreach, missions, women's and men's fellowship are awesome. The integrity, authenticity and a solid ground of the Word of God is what you get here, as well as 1 Big family. Love my church family❤

name: The Refinery Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I consider it a blessing and a privilege to have become a part of this family of believers. My wife grew up in this church and it's a lovely place to call home... the location is home to many groups who use the facilities and the people here are very active serving the surrounding community. I'm enjoying building friendships with pastor Jon and the rest of the staff. When you feel like you're alone and you sit in darkness, the light of heaven will give you everlasting light Message is well preached.  So nice to hear the gospel the way was preached also. This is very come as you are church. Don't need to be dressed up. Music is fantastic. I would definitely give this a try. Speaking as an outside observer. I am not a member here. Was just visiting. First time here. Feel connected spiritually and the message was good. If you want to be surrounded by genuine, Jesus-loving people, the Refinery is the place to go.  Everyone is very friendly and open.  The church has a very inviting, welcoming atmosphere.  The worship is amazing and the preaching is transformative.  I highly recommend this church!

name: The Refuge Church - Spring Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
When I first came to The Refuge Church as a college student, I immediately felt at home. The people were genuine, welcoming, and made a lasting impact on me. Years later, when I moved back to the area and was looking for a church home for my family, The Refuge was the first place that came to mind.

Walking back through those doors felt like no time had passed. I was welcomed with open arms, and that same sense of belonging was still there. For the past 7+ years, The Refuge has been a place where my family has grown in faith, built meaningful relationships, and found opportunities to serve.

I am so grateful for a church that is warm, inviting, and deeply committed to teaching God’s Word. It brings me so much joy knowing my children are growing up in an environment where they are loved, encouraged, and taught the Bible. The Refuge isn’t just a church we attend it’s our church family, and I am incredibly thankful for all it has meant to us. Great church to call home with a family of believers that lift up the name of Jesus toghther, you can tangibly feel the presence of God in this place. We noticed it right away along with the faith of the children, as they sing and worship they inspire you to leave nothing bottled up and to lay it at the feet of the savior as well. Great group of people who genuinely care for one another's well being, highly reccomend you see for yourself. Felt like part of the church family as soon as I walked in.  The Refuge church folks welcome you with their kindness, love and warmth.  No one is a stranger.  I have been there for five years!  Messages are powerful!  Music, singing is awesome!  Great groups to be a part of.  Looking forward to our September 2026 Women’s Retreat!  Oh yeah!  And sports camp this month!  So many activities! Excellent family oriented church that is passionate about Jesus and sharing the love of Christ!  Come join us!  You won't regret it! My favorite things about this church is how friendly they are, meeting you at the door and you're welcomed in right from the start! The worship is AMAZING! Love that they sing the very songs I listen to on the radio! Pastor Tony is without a doubt an incredible Shepherd to his flock.  We love the family bond this church shares.  I can not say enough good things about it! Service starts at 10:00 a.m.! Come! Experience the goodness of God through this body of Christ, and welcome home!!! “From the moment you walk through the doors, you feel like family. This is a church where people genuinely care about one another and where the love of Jesus is evident in everything they do. The worship is heartfelt, the teaching is biblically grounded and relevant, and there are opportunities for every age to grow in their faith and build meaningful relationships.

Whether you’re new to church, returning after some time away, or searching for a place to call home, you’ll be welcomed with open arms. The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and filled with people who are passionate about loving God and loving others. We are so grateful to call The Refuge-Spring Hill our church home.”

name: The Remedy Church - Akron Campus
reviewSummary: The most amazing church. When I tell you every sermon has spoken to  me. I leave out feeling refreshed and filled with the holy spirit. A ministry who cares about people and willing to support with no question. Attend you won’t be disappointed. Friendly and kind. The sermon was great! It was baby dedication,  communion and baptism day. The Word of God was preached and shown by the members.  I was visiting to see my granddaughter get baptised and felt right at home. Found this church while still on Britain road, the first preaching I heard had me mesmerized; so greatful for Pastor Lav and Pastor Lesa, very great leaders and a family unit. Glad to say God is in this church Beautiful place to fellowship!!! The Pastor, First Lady, and Church members were all more than polite and welcoming! Beautiful service, welcoming environment and most importantly the presence of God.

name: The Revelation Universal Evangelical Ministries ( Revelation Church) - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary: The Lord is doing great and mighty things at the Revelation Church! Here, you will find God’s manifest presence, praise and worship, teachings rooted in the Word of God, hope, a family and a community of believers fervently seeking to grow in faith and walk with the Lord. Come join us! I am so happy I have a church home and a family.  Revelation Church has the best teachings; true solid food.  I am growing closer to God with the word.  The praise and worship are awesome!!  The Holy Spirit is present in this church.  Always welcoming, come by and visit. This is a place where your faith can't go wrong. True love and worship happen here. Every teaching revolves your faith. This house of God is a place where you don't leave the same way you came at any givens step. I am thankful, grateful, and highly favored to have found Revelation Universal Church. Always it's been a pleasure to come back to this place of restoration Love this community.. so much love , peace and worship is true.. The word is deep and speak about Jesus Christ my savior. Love this church

name: The Ridge Church - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary: This is an awesome Church.  Pastor Danny teaches us not to just know "about" Christ, but instead to develop a friendship with Christ.  Great place to feel welcome and make great friends.  Very Inclusive Church that reaches out to introduce folks to God. Worship Pastor ushers in the presence of God.  Pastor Danny always has a gold nugget in every sermon to take home.  Pastor Brandi has a gentle spirit that shows the love of God.  Small groups are amazing.  Congregation is welcoming.  Outreach Pastor has a heart for God's people.  Come see what the Lord is doing here.  Welcome to The Ridge! Come experience authentic Christian connection here! The pastor teaches the Word as well as everyday practical advice on how to embody Jesus in our lives. Great church with a welcoming congregation. We love it here!  The sermons really speak to my family and the youth group is wonderful. Great church, great people.

name: The Rise Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Love, love, love this church and the family feeling. Pastor and First Lady are very awesome...the music is really awesome as well as the singer's. If you haven't been to this church, make it a point to go..you'll be so blessed. Great teaching of the Word, outstanding family experiences and fellowship in the Word of God!! Was a member for over 30 years until we moved to Oklahoma 5 years ago. Fantastic!!!!  The best ever I love it . I felt like it never left Praise and Worship is Amazing with Biblical Doctrine going forth.

name: The Rising Church - Arvada Campus
reviewSummary: I help feed the homeless every other week. They have a good program for those willing to expend the effort to get well. They train for jobs, set up in apartments, give counseling, etc. Treat the whole person. The pastor is a graduate of their homeless outreach. Helped me get my life back!               Thank You to to staff and volunteers! Yours truly! Dempsey I was new to the Arvada community and discovered The Rising Church's weekly, Saturday morning food pantry when I was in need. I truly felt Spirit amongst all the volunteers coordinating and executing this public service to my new community and it was Gratefully appreciated! Mission Arvada outreach program is outstanding! Serving their Community is a passion! This church brought my 59-year search for the God of my childhood to a joyful close. Their day center is an exceptional example of compassion, treating everyone in need with profound respect and dignity, recognizing them as people, not statistics. Witnessing this incredible work, I felt called to be baptized by Pastor Jarod this Easter, after 59 years.

reviewSummary:
Such an amazing church that really gives European church/cathedral vibes. We went to a concert by Christopher Houlihan and the organ is amazing. Also they had a book that explained the different stained glass and statues in the church- super cool! The Riverside Church is an absolutely stunning Neo-Gothic Church conceived by John D. Rockefeller Jr. along with Harry Emerson Fosdick. The church was constructed between 1927-1930. Allen & Collens and Henry C. Peyton were the primary architects. The church is very impressive in size and design. The stained glass is beautiful and the church isn't at a lack of lighting. From across the river it looks beautiful alongside Grant's Tomb. There are places you visit—and then there are places that move you deeply the moment you arrive. The Riverside Church is undeniably the latter.

Rising majestically over Manhattan’s Morningside Heights, this awe-inspiring Neo-Gothic masterpiece has stood as both a spiritual sanctuary and a cultural beacon since its opening in 1930. Commissioned by John D. Rockefeller Jr. and inspired by the grandeur of France’s Chartres Cathedral, the church’s 392-foot tower still reigns as the tallest church tower in the United States—a breathtaking symbol of faith reaching toward heaven.

But what truly sets Riverside apart isn’t just its architecture—it’s its living legacy of purpose.

From its earliest days, Riverside was envisioned as more than a place of worship. It has been a center for social change, inclusion, and courageous dialogue, hosting world-shaping voices like Martin Luther King Jr., who delivered his powerful “Beyond Vietnam” speech from its pulpit.  The church has also welcomed global leaders such as Nelson Mandela and Desmond Tutu—cementing its role as a moral crossroads of justice and faith.

Walking inside, you are enveloped by stunning stained glass, intricate carvings, and a sacred stillness that somehow coexists with the building’s vibrant community life. Beyond Sunday services, Riverside has long been a powerhouse of outreach, offering food programs, prison ministry, immigrant support, and advocacy for the marginalized—living out a faith that is both deeply compassionate and boldly active.

What makes Riverside truly exceptional is its heart: an interdenominational, interracial, and radically welcoming community where people from all walks of life are embraced and valued.

In every sense, The Riverside Church is not just a building—it’s a movement, a voice, and a sanctuary for both the soul and society. Whether you come seeking beauty, history, or a deeper connection to purpose, you will leave inspired. There are many jumbo-sized ornate churches in Manhattan, but Riverside Church has been my favorite so far. There’s so many levels, and each is fully dressed with statues and flair. I grew up in India in a Sikh family and lived most of my life without a personal relationship with God. I went through many hardships, heartbreaks, health issues, and seasons of deep depression. Although I occasionally visited the Sikh temple, I never felt a true connection. Pride also played a big role in my life, and like many Sikhs, I believed strongly in my own understanding and that there were many paths to God.

Years later, I owned an auto repair shop and hired a shop manager who happened to be a Christian. He never forced his faith on me, but he shared his testimony and spoke openly about Jesus. Around the same time, I reconnected with a childhood friend who was also Christian. She shared her testimony and asked me to pray with her to invite Jesus into my heart. At the time, I did it more to satisfy her, as I believed there were many ways to God and strongly disagreed that Jesus was the only way.

I went back and forth for a long time. Eventually, I told my shop manager that I believed it was up to God to choose whatever path He wanted for me. He continued to speak about Jesus and shared John 3:16 with me, encouraging me to sincerely ask God to reveal the true path. So I prayed—not knowing what to expect—and asked God to show me the way.

A day or two later, I had a vivid dream that I remember clearly. I saw myself standing in a dark valley at night. There was no moonlight, yet it was beautiful. I saw a light in the sky, at first thinking it was an airplane, but it kept growing larger and began to descend. Slowly, it took the form of a glowing being. Then I saw a man dressed in white descend and stand on a large rock bed. I recognized Him immediately—it was Jesus of Nazareth.

He did not speak out loud, yet He answered my thoughts. When I realized who He was, He said, “I am glad that you recognize Me.” I tried to wake myself, thinking it was just a dream, but His presence was overwhelming. I fell at His feet and noticed there was so much blood. Without speaking, He answered my thoughts again and said, “I did this for you.” I began to weep.

He lifted me up, pulled me onto the rock where He stood, and embraced me. I felt completely unworthy to be that close to Him, yet He still held me. Again, without words, He said that I had doubted. In that moment, I replied from my heart, “Not anymore, my King.” For the first time in my life, I called Him my King and my Lord.

I woke up with tears in my eyes.

The next morning, I went to work filled with joy and excitement to share what had happened. Before I could say anything, my shop manager told me he needed to speak with me first. He explained that a new customer had come in that morning and specifically asked him to tell me to go to The Rock Church in Danville, California.

That Sunday, I went to The Rock Church by myself. From that moment on, I knew Jesus Himself had led me there. My family did not understand at first, but over time my wife and both of my daughters began attending The Rock Church regularly as well.

The Rock Church has been a place of healing, truth, and spiritual growth for me and my family. I am forever grateful for this church and for the way Jesus completely transformed my life.
