I don’t say this lightly. I’ve been in church my entire life. I know the Word. I know what healthy leadership looks like. I know what real community feels like… and I also know when something is missing.

After trauma and divorce, I needed more than a place to sit on Sundays. I needed a place that would meet me in the middle of the mess and help put me back together with truth, grace, and with consistency.

That’s what I found at The Rock Church.

Pastor Eb is one of the most gifted teachers I’ve sat under. He doesn’t just preach, he teaches in a way that reaches both the newest believer and those who have walked with God for years. There is depth, clarity, and truth in every message.

But what truly sets this church apart is how they love.

They love the addict.
They love the homeless.
They love the broken, the overlooked, the ones trying to hold it together for their kids.
They love people who are struggling, people who are rebuilding, and people who are looking for a church home.  They love everyone and it’s not surface-level. They love hard. They show up. They stay.

In a season where I needed both truth and healing, this church became a place of restoration for me. Not perfect people, but a real body of believers living out what it means to be the Church.

If you’re looking for a place where you can grow, be seen, and be loved while you do… this is it 💗 I have been attending The Rock Church for a year now, and it has truly become my spiritual home. The community here is incredibly welcoming, and I have grown so much in my faith over the past 12 months. The worship is powerful, and the biblical teaching is always clear and practical. If you are looking for a genuine, loving church family in Columbus, this is it! I’m writing this review with conviction in my heart to warn others about this place.

I want to first state to the reader that the positive reviews are indeed from people who are well involved in the church, but several of them are from those who are either related to leadership- or are in leadership themselves.
So as expected, they’ll have overwhelmingly positive things to say about their own church. However, the reality is that this church is run more akin a cult than a healthy church.

They have mastered pulling people in.
Their worship music is amazing, there are smiling faces at the door, and when you enter, it seems like they’ve been waiting for you to come. They make a stellar first impression on people but it is simply just that- an impression.

This is a church that pretends to be in order. All the while, entertaining and promoting unchecked prophecies & “words” from congregation members who believe they are prophetic, traveling “prophets” such as Kevin Leal- who desecrated a Bible during a conference at their headquarters in Parkersburg, and entertaining outbursts of tongues from congregants and having unvetted people interpret them. This behavior is completely normalized.

There is a large focus on their social media and how they are perceived. Leadership often seeks to emulate large organizations (belonging co., elevation worship, etc). This sounds harmless, but the media team as well as almost all other teams are often under a lot of pressure to perform. It’s often the responsibility of a small group of people to do the work of 10-20. They also hyperanalyze their social media analytics to curate a polished image and gain more followers at any cost- and even have discouraged the team from using direct Bible scripture under captions because it does not boost engagement nor prompt followers to comment. It is easy to fall into pride serving under them. I am guilty of it as well.

When you bring your concerns about anything to leadership you are met with immediate attention that sounds promising at first. But in many meetings, there is a lot of deflection and blame-shifting. Any legitimate concern that is not in their favor is labeled as “a lie of the enemy” or blamed on your “spiritual immaturity.”Over the years you will be brainwashed to believing that there is no better church than The Rock. Attending events or visiting other churches is seriously frowned upon.

After a couple of years, you start to notice the behaviors listed above. You’ll want to leave at this point and if you’re someone who stayed in the background, you probably can just stop going without others noticing. But if you’re someone who has been offering up your talent in service, in leadership or plain just well known, you cannot leave without without going through what seems like literal hell trying to get out. The Rock expects 100% loyalty even if you have already left the church.

If you are known to speak out against the church in anyway, leadership will discourage the congregation from speaking to you or about you. They will blame it on “protecting the sheep”. But in most recent cases starting around 2024, it seems that it’s because they’re angry that the person is speaking out against them.

I have had to hear my husband say that The Rock organization ruined his life. I’ve had to get him therapy. He’s developed medical conditions he hadn’t had beforehand due to the stress and heartbreak he experienced after leaving and being ostracized. There are times where I think back over the years and wonder if anything was real or if anyone genuinely loved us. I’ve tried to keep the peace the best I knew how. We left in late 2025, but to this day- my husband is harassed by members of The Rock organization if he speaks out against them and their major errors in the church. If not being harassed, he is completely ignored as if they never knew him at all.

If you join, this could be you and your family. I wouldn’t wish this on my worst enemy.

I pray that the reader heeds this warning. Rock Church Columbus has truly been a life-changing place for me. The presence of Jesus is so evident here — His love and power are manifested in every service and every interaction. Pastor and the leadership team are truly amazing, guiding with wisdom, compassion, and authenticity.

The church community is filled with love and support, making it feel like family from day one. Because of the encouragement and teaching here, I was inspired to purchase my very first hard copy Bible, and it has deepened my walk with God in ways I never imagined.

I’ve now been a member for over 3 years, and I am so thankful for how this church continues to nurture my faith and surround me with people who genuinely care. If you are searching for a place where Jesus is alive and the community is strong, Rock Church Columbus is it! The Spirit of the Lord is in this place! I had a vision that happened for two Sunday’s and it confirmed what I discerned every time I step into The Rock Church! Those visions have changed and taken my worship higher in the Lord!! Ascension

name: The Rock Church - Sunnyvale Campus
reviewSummary: Haven't been to the church personally but my review is actually based on their "corner pantry" I arrived at noon exactly and had to wait 2-1/2 to get in... It wasn't really a big deal until I reached the pantry and everything was pretty much given except the pasta and canned food... Seems like the person who was helping me didn't really want me to take more then one item each ( 1 can food) for my family of 3! However there did give me a half gallon milk and eggs plus a bag of the yellow/red bagged chicken. My first time here.. assuming you get here at 11 am then you'll get the good stuff before it's gone! Appreciate your services🙏 The Pastor and his lovely wife are the greatest examples of Jesus Christ, I have ever come across. The genuinely love people the way hat God loves us, unconditionally. There heart is after God and it shows in how they serve all who walk through their doors. Fire of God there. Pastor listens to the moving of the Holy Spirit. A bit old fashioned with suits & dresses but they wont ask you to put 1 on. POWERFUL worship too. What an AWESOME AWESOME CHURCH 🙌🏾the people, the Worship you feel as you walk through those doors! The Pastor and First Lady are very kind hearted you can feel thepassion! This This is an awesome church that focusses on love and grace towards everyone. Great music and friendly people! I'll be back.

name: The Rock Church and World Outreach Center - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I came here for the food drive. It was my 2nd time here and I wasn't aware that dependents could use my card. We had moved from the general lines to the 1st timer/no ID line. I had my family member apply as a 1st timer since it was their 1st time there, and as I was unaware they could use my card as a dependent. We'd been there since 6am, and we were finally seen at around 8:40, where we were told that they could use my card. Instead of being let thru with a badge and a warning, we were sent to the back of the line. It was 8:56 by then. We did as we were told, excited at the prospect of finally getting food when we were stopped by a guy at the end. He had told us that he'd seen us leave the back of the 1st timer line when we'd clearly come from the tables. He'd been very hard headed, refusing to understand our situation. He begun to mock and ridicule us as we kept trying to explain, so frustrated, we went to go get another volunteer who'd seen us in line since 6. He refused to listen to both us and the volunteer, and would not let us thru despite having been there for hours, so ultimately, we went home empty handed.

A little empathy, none of the mockery/ridicule and some understanding would have gone a long way. I have been in church my entire life and attended many churches of different denominations and have never experienced such hospitality, care for the community, and reverence for God as I do at The Rock. The house of God is truly taken care of and the Spirit of God leads everything they do. The church and Pastors truly love people to life, which is the mission of the church. Thank you, Rock Church, for being the hands and feet of Jesus. Thank you to all the Pastors for equipping us with biblical truth every service. You are so appreciated! Awesome experience.
I was just visiting from Northern California, and this was the closest place to my hotel. What a wonderful house of prayer and worship?! Makes me want to move! How many angels must be in an establishment of this caliper? My schedule and health changed so I went looking for an evening service. Regulars were very welcoming and the evening service is smaller. I was even invited to their salt group which meets after morning Sunday service for lunch for older folk every two weeks. The service is only an hour which makes it even easier to attend. The campus is beautiful and sprawling. Definitely will be going again! Very inspirational message. Speaker was Pastor Jeff T Osborne from Patria Church (ALFC) who spoke on unseen advantages, rest and give it to God. This was my first time and I will visit again.

name: The Rock Church Bay Area - Antioch Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is next level!! God is moving on the Pastor and First Lady and their staff always make you feel welcome. I have personally been blessed tremendously, spiritually, financially, physically, and emotionally since I’ve been going. Stop by and experience a truly loving place full of people who have a passion and heart for people! When I'm able to vist Mrs. Foster I'm most definitely coming back to visit this church community.
Welcoming plus the way their Pastor breaks down an sermon with such passion, power, and simplicity. You most definitely will take home something that only God can put in you to work on or encourage within.

Thank You it was most definitely a pleasure to meet y'all. Service was great You gotta come, the ministry here is next level. If you’re ready for your History to meet your Destiny, this is where you need to be.  Every Sunday 10am sharp at the Maya Cinemas we have a 90min worship experience like no other.  I promise you, your life will never be the same. Teaching the Words of God . Start on time and everyone is welcome., you can come as you are. God looks at the heart ❤️ and man look at the outer apperiance

name: The Rock Church Fort Myers - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I remember the first time I walked through the doors, from the moment I arrived, I felt the presence of God. Everyone was welcoming, genuine, and inviting.
Eight years later, that feeling remains the same. There is a sweet presence of God here, and it truly feels like home. There is no place I would rather be.
I have built lifelong friendships and experienced tremendous spiritual growth in this wonderful church. The pastor and his wife are truly exceptional people whose love, leadership, and dedication are a blessing to so many.
I am deeply humbled and grateful that God led my family and me here. This church has been an incredible part of our journey, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to grow in faith and be part of a loving church family. I attended this church for over 3 years and initially loved the music and energy, but over time my experience changed. I began to feel that acceptance depended on conforming to leadership rules, giving money through tithes, and giving money for special leadership lavish gifts, overworking in ministry, and never questioning anything or showing tiredness.

While volunteering in a particular ministry, everything felt last minute and if it didn't fit my schedule then I was told I was not being flexible enough. When I decided to stop volunteering in that ministry, it was demanded that I have a meeting to get permission to stop volunteering. When I started setting healthy boundaries and asking questions, it felt I was labeled as having a “rebellious spirit” and it felt I was treated as if I was "backsliding". If I missed one service, I received texts from leadership and other nosey folks asking why I was not there.

The preaching often felt aggressive with yelling and felt very repetitive, and services seemed very production-driven with a strong focus on emotional reactions manipulated by music. My kids and I also experienced judgment and elitism, where it felt like certain families or people in the “inner circle” were treated very differently, like royalty. I felt judged constantly, whether it was something I was wearing, something I was doing or not doing, something my kids were doing or not doing, or when I'd speak up, etc.

What troubled me most was seeing leadership living very lavish lifestyles while some members, including myself, were struggling financially to support the family. I appreciate transparency with where tithes are allocated but I never seen this once while attending/giving here.

Unfortunately, I never felt the genuine love, support, or healthy community that a church environment should provide. My experience here was disappointing, hurtful, and ultimately led me to leave. I went to the rock for the first time these past Sunday with my 11-year-old daughter who almost lost her life last week. No doubt about it she was saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. I had so many proof of it. At the church, I had an experience like no other, kids running happily, the beautiful choir, making everybody jump and down in absolute joy, and the pastor was something else! I’m going back and then back and then back some more. I’m going to get baptized in this church and will baptize my daughter. The energy at this holy place is extraordinary. The people are beyond friendly and welcoming. A life changing experience! Such an amazing church. This has been my church for the last 6 years. I moved across the country and found a place that I know I could truly call home. So thankful for the Godly atmosphere and love that is in this place. Raising a family here is such a blessing, knowing my children will be surrounded by good Godly people is a huge deal. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a home church for you and/or your family. This is the place to come and be apart! What a church. TRC is truly a blessing and I thank God for the Bishop and the members. When I first came to the church in 2020. My mother and I were in a dark place. Our family had been trying to survive the devastating murder of my brother so we moved from Broward county to Lee County. God brought me to TRC using a instagram reel of the choir singing and I had ran to so my mom. She saw her coworker up in the choir and said that’s the church my coworker told me about. We immediately loved the church in our first visit. people tend to go to church to meet their own expectations or experience. But when I tell you that the spirit of the Lord is in this church I mean it. My story and testimony is long for this section. But I would compel anyone to visit just once and leave your expectations and what you think church should be and come with an open heart and trust me you will see God move like never before. Come experience the difference.

name: The Rock Church of Elk Grove - Elk Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Been eyeing this church on the outside for a long time. Finally decided to go and I'm upset I didn't go much sooner! It's Pentecostal, with absolutely beautiful people. Received a good Word and there was an excellent choir! A beautiful welcoming nursery, children's church and just all around welcoming. I love God's people! If you are looking for a church in the Sacramento/ Elk Grove area you absolutely have to go here! You WILL feel a move of God!

They have programs and ministries for all ages and their kids program is fantastic. You owe yourself the favor of making this your home church. If say you tired everything in life and gotten nowhere.... YOU HAVEN'T TRIED JESUS!!!!!! come to the Rock church at elk Grove for a warm welcoming and great people! There is also an awesome coffee shop inside!!!??? My wife and I came to visit this church for Sunday night service. It was are first time. Everyone was praying at the front of the church.we got invited to go down and pray. All the sudden a man in a blue pin stripped suit and bald told me to move as he walked past me he grabbed my wife's arm and put his hand on her head and started yelling in what they call tongues. My wife said she was catching spit from his yelling. I went and put my hand on her arm for support and he told me not to touch her. She's my wife!!! I was so uncomfortable. I will never return. Men should pray for men and women pray for the women not single out my wife and tell me to leave basically. I will never return. Very uncomfortable experience. The Rock always have an inspirational service. I have my church home but I do visit them from time to time and events. They are near my house. The People are always warm and welcoming. I love talking w their Pastor he's a great Southern guy very down to earth ❤️

name: The Rock Church Peoria - Peoria Campus
reviewSummary: This is Home!  home is where you feel God is present,  feeling of love, joy, peace and  happiness and God is here to meet you where ever you are in life just open your mind and heart and Ask and he will show you the way.  This is the Church that cares where you going not where you been. I'm proud to call this my House. Best church in Phoenix! Awesome, loving, caring pastors and everyone there is like one large family! They took me in and loved me where I was at and encouraged me to get plugged in and grow in my relationship with the Lord! Thank you Jesus for this group and for my pastors!! I had an AMAZING experience at The Rock  Church this morning! The praise and worship was beautiful and Pastor Goff was inspirational! Being a PK,   I understand what a church should feel like and this checks all the boxes!!! AMEN 🙏 Just moved here from out of state so I was looking for a new home church, much to my surprise not a single person said hello or welcomed me to the church. So I definitely will continue my search for a new home church Great  church people very friendly.

name: The Rock Church Temecula Valley - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church! It has a great community and an overall loving atmosphere. I’m having to find another church since I’m moving soon, and I’m hoping to find one just like this! All the pastors are really good at their jobs and there’s many different ways you can volunteer if you want to get involved. We absolutely love the rock church and highly recommend it. Pastor Henny is so passionate about the word and he preaches truth! If you want the word of god if you wanna grow and learn give it a try. We absolutely love it every their is so passionate about the lord and the word Landen is also great.
Be blessed I simply wanted to go into the parking lot. Pull up, cones? Okay no problem I’m good at listening to cones. Then I get forced to take a right? Into a giant church line that will take 30+ mins? Crazy, but I’ll turn out. I can’t turn out because you blocked EVERY AISLE? Okay nah, imma turn around and leave. *I pulled into a parking spot for my dr office, turned around, and drove 30 feet back the way I came to the ONLY exit*. THEY TRIED TO KEEP ME FROM THE EXIT. Homeboy in a vest got a whole attitude and started walking to the front of my car so I laid my horn and kept driving. I will leave a PUBLIC parking lot if I wanna leave. They also blocked 1,000ft of the right lane of Sky Canyon Dr. Better hope yall have a permit for this, blocking a *disabled x2* car from leaving a parking lot you crowded takeover style. I am an absolute devout Christian, you can check my social media for that. NOTHING about this was Holy. I’m all for keeping church attendants safe and minimizing traffic, but that is NOT how you accomplish that. Reading these other 1 star comments, turning away a disabled child after not listening to the guidance given to you on how to help him learn best of our Lord and Savior?? What happened to what Jesus spoke!! - “Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.””
‭‭Matthew‬ ‭19‬:‭14‬ ‭NIV‬‬. Reserved seating by race, are we discriminating in church now??!! I guess His Word doesn’t mean anything because they ignore this - ““ ‘Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.”
‭‭Leviticus‬ ‭19‬:‭15‬ ‭NIV‬‬. What are yall doin?? Please PLEASE REPENT from these EGO TRIPS!! “Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.”
‭‭Proverbs‬ ‭16‬:‭18‬ ‭NIV‬‬ Sorry but this is not a church they only care about money I called 2 or 3 hours ago to see if i can do work to get help home from Temecula to adelanto possibly à ride or a Uber I messed up didn't take my vehicle with me and a so called friend left me stranded now homeless on the streets till I can get back home thanks thought you could turn to church for help but guess not. We just moved into the area and found this church. They have a very diverse congregation, great youth program, couples classes, and much more. The pastor and his team are amazing and truly God focused. If you're looking for somewhere fellowship or a new church home,  give The Rock Church a try.

name: The Rock Community Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Most amazing place to worship with fellow Christians. Line by line Biblical teaching, gracious, loving and amazing staff and entire church family. Great kids programs, Sunday School, taught by patient, wise, kind and fun people... I am at home when I am at TRCC. I drive a long way just to attend and I will tell you, I've NEVER left church feeling empty or confused or lacking something. It's fulfilling and motivating and REAL. Real Jesus loving, God fearing people... who love to laugh and love to give hugs and a smile. God Bless TRCC! I love this church. The pastors and people are welcoming and they preach line upon line, word upon word in the bible. The music and sermons are amazing. This is an amazing place to worship good sermons and free breakfast every Sunday morning. name: The Rock Family Worship Center - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary:
I really wanted to like this church and gave it two attempts. It’s really hard to rate a sermon that starts at 11:30, an hour and a half after arriving and the service is supposed to begin. Both times I went they had zero consideration for time and rambled through passages, the pastor stayed on topic, just hammered the dead horse until it was seriously painful to listen. I think the pastor could really use a class on effective public speaking.

I noticed here that a lot of people seemed to know each other and they have a good strong community, which is why I gave it an extra star. That was nice to see people were talking during the worship at the beginning, not necessarily focusing on the songs. My grandbaby was baptized on Sunday.  This church is very organized and staff very friendly and accommodating.  I love how they used testimonies intertwined into the baptismal service.

My daughter enjoyed how contemporary the service was and asked me to come back to hear the Pastor preach.

We had to leave right as he was getting ready to preach.

I was surprised they did not put up a QR code or list cash app, zelle, vendors or PayPal as a mean to collect tithes and or an offering. Amazing Church! Took 5 months to find my home church and I found it in The Rock! Not just the Primary Pastor, but ALL the staff I have met and gotten to know have been wonderful people and examples of Christ Jesus!

My faith and walk with Jesus has grown leaps and bounds! (As long as you put in the work)

Thank you God for leading me to this Church ⛪️! Do not recommend visiting this church. Had high hopes for my visit and expected that with the founding pastor speaking, I would walk away with something. Unfortunately, a lot of the message was him making strange jokes and misinterpreting scriptures. Definitely do not plan to return. Wonder church I love it. but I do not recommend sending your baby to the child care my baby is 6 months she drinks 6oz bottles and they fed her 2 bottles within one hour because she was crying and she had to go to the hospital the way she was throwing up afterwards and haven’t had a wet diaper since. If they don’t know what they doing or know how to handle babies yall need to find someone else to work there. Thank you.

name: The Rock House Church - Placentia Campus
reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: The Rock of Greater Burlington
reviewSummary: Amazing church!  Warm and inviting people and wonderful atmosphere.  Worship is awesome and easy to enter into.  I have been in churches all my life, most of them denominational.  What is nice about a non-denominational church like The Rock is it's NOT about doctrine, it's about getting to know God.  They are setup according to Ephesians 4:11-12 and the structure it specifies for church authority.  I would recommend to anyone but with the prerequisite that you have to go more than once to truly understand it.  If you want to know God, this is your place! I heard wonderful things about the Rock   (  no, not alcatraz )  of South Burlington. The pastor is awsome and I miss him. Good wordship there. I feel like I turned around here once! Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: The Rock of Roseville - Roseville Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended this church for a couple of years but unfortunately never felt welcomed. The environment feels very cliquey, with established groups that don’t make much effort to include others.

What ultimately led us to leave was a personal experience involving a church member who reached out for help. I contacted the church regarding the situation and never received a response. Being completely ignored in a moment like that was extremely disappointing and not what we expected from a church community.

There are many other churches in the area that are far more welcoming and compassionate. An excellent church. Been going here about 6.5 years now and we are getting ready for a move of God in the church. You can feel it building. Home Sweet Home,

The leadership and Rock family are people that have changed my life, not with their words but actions and move of love.

This church was led for so many years by Pastor Francis Anfuso and he was and always will be the greatest pastor I've had the pleasure of knowing.

His humble heart for Jesus and obedience has been an example and baseline for living a supernatural life.

The church is now led by an extraordinary and warm pastor Brandon Naramore and his awesome wife Rachel.

They have been loyal servants to the church and the community for a very long time. Few people are as pure and devoted than those two.

Pastor Mark Tawlks and Bob Hasty are two remarkable men who are a shining example of what being on mission, and living an authentic life. Both have amazing passion and unique personalities that make them incredibly important to the foundation of the church.

They truly live it out, and the people we do life with at this church have forever changed the trajectory of my families life in many ways.

If you want less religion,  less bondage, condemnation, then the Rock can be that for you.

More importantly if you want to be set free, encounter the holy spirit in worship, live a life you deserve, and do life with a community of Givers then then the Rock of Roseville is a great place to call home.

The childrens ministry if also fantastic led by Julie who is an amazing leader a challenging job and big responsibility.

If you ever want to visit and want to know someone there when you go, then drop me a message I'd be happy to meet you at the front door with a smile or hug.

God bless,

Adrian Boysel The Rock is a great place for worship, and a break from the worlds insanities. Everyone I've met is super courteous and helpful. And, they make a decent cup of Joe. Grateful a place like this exists. I am reviewing Rock of Roseville to help others consider if this is the right place for them to worship.  I have not gone recently, but went when their previous pastor, Francis Anfuso, was there.  Francis was charismatic and intelligent. He had many programs, like Pizza with the Pastor.  He used different media, and sold copies of his messages.  After attending for a year, I noticed he recycled his messages.  He told some unusual stories, like that he had been demon possessed in Hawaii.  He reminded me of Benny Hinn, and it seemed like Francis supported people who were part of the prosperity gospel.

One for the money:  I remember Francis complaining to the congregation about not receiving enough money in the offerings, and how he had deserved more.  This seemed confusing to me, as well as when he would say that we should not set boundaries of what God has for our lives, but then in another message, he would say that there were things that were not God's will for "his life."  He favored and taught tithing for the church.  I felt guilted to tithe.  I think the high contributors were given better attention.

Two for the show:  I remember the Sunday morning presentations were compelling.  I so wanted to believe this was where I needed to be among other Christians.  Over time, it seemed like the presentations were only on the surface.  They would say, "join a small group," but then the small groups would be full.  So, I would message them in the offering, and they would not respond, so I would message again, and they would say "sorry.'  Francis would say he did "not have anything better to do than to love people," but I did not find this to be true.  He seemed more concerned if he could wear earrings as pastor, and drive a sportscar.  His role as pastor seemed to overrule any elders that were there.

Three to get ready:  There was a sense of expectation, but over time, it ended in disappointment, so I had to leave.  He would say that there are seasons, affirming the change of leaving, and then later saying "breezing by the Holy Spirit," once again bringing confusion.

I met some wonderful people at this church, but I learned to avoid celebrity preachers.  I hope it is better now.  Do not allow preachers to tell you anything not supported by the Bible, and make sure the interpretation is correct.  Grace and peace to you.

name: The Sanctuary
reviewSummary:
One guy there who is part of the staff was rude to my sister telling her she had to go in the lobby because she went back inside into the church area to try to find the guy to thank him for trying to find her a ride home and tell him it was nice meeting him. Because of her getting thrown out into the lobby she didn’t get that chance to thank him. Some people were phony to my sister. My sister won’t be going back here again. My sister found a new church to go to in the hood. It’s the same type of Christian church but it’s in a rough area and worship is on Wednesday nights. Anytime you want to join a church and you cannot find a phone number or contact,  be careful.   Anytime you see pictures of the leader "healing" people, be very careful.   And, when your loved ones start judging everyone who doesn't follow this church,  RED FLAG.     What would you call this? I absolutely love attending The Sanctuary! From the moment you walk in, you can feel God’s presence, and you will not leave the same. Your life will be transformed by the power of the Holy Spirit working within you.

Before coming here, I never truly understood what godly friendships looked like. Last year, I began serving in the kids ministry, and through that, I’ve gained the most amazing, Christ-centered friendships—people who pray with me, encourage me, and walk through life with me.

If you’re looking for a place where the Word is preached boldly, worship is powerful, and the love of Jesus is lived out in real community, The Sanctuary is it. If your looking for a place filled with the holey spirit alive with energy and enthusiasm for God and truth. Show up one period. Excellent place of worship. Worshiping is between you and God, and this place creates that atmosphere to get into that deep moment with the Lord.

name: The Sanctuary - Evans Campus
reviewSummary: I've met some of the other people in the recovery sessions here who were nice but I was on a walk and they don't care if you need a bathroom. I get asked who am I instead. Don't worry I won't be stepping foot in your church. Btw churches don't need cafes I've only experienced the mother's day out program. The people and atmosphere are wonderful. I feel the presence of the Lord when the pastor preaches. His style of preaching is how I can imagine Christ speaking to the multitudes of people; humble, sincere love for Christ. There is no elaborate show that takes the glory off the reason we are there in the first place; and that is to be focused on Jesus. I love this pastor and his wife. I don’t know them well personally, but I can see the great love they have for Christ. No hollering no jumping no dressing out elaborately to bring attention to themselves, but all glory to the king of kings! Amazing place to worship and fellowship! This is definitely a place where you can worship and also feel loved. Leaders and staff are very caring. I love that there are many different small groups for different stages in life: children, youth, young adults, adults, etc. We only attended this church a couple times, and we probably won't attend regularly, because it just isn't for us (we prefer traditional service with hymnals and Bibles in the pew). However, it really is a wonderful Church if you are happy with contemporary services. The praise team sounds great, religious leaders are passionate, and the congregation is extremely welcoming! The sanctuary is a good size (up to 800 people)  but small enough to not feel overwhelming or "megachurch". Great opportunities for kids (and adults) during the service and throughout the week. We were also impressed by the cafe inside the building!

name: The Sanctuary - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
I spoke out about a presence at work that was not the Holy Spirit, and was told never to come back and if I did I would be trespassing. Then the ‘pastor’ Micha directly lied to me in a conversation about why I wasn’t allowed back. Attended for about 6 weeks. They are very well organized and a good meaning community of people. I appreciate the vision of permeating the world and not buying into the mega church “super seeker sensitive” model, but perhaps they swung a little too far back in the other direction.

My wife and I spent 6 weeks there and weren’t ever really welcomed in, but weren’t pushed out. Once we decided we were ready to join into the “participating in community” we were informed they only allow people into those groups once every 6 months. This is a miss for a young church and a lack of wisdom when it is a big portion of your values.

In addition to their “circles”, they are neighborhood based—which is part of their vision. But this does make it a bit difficult if you connect with people in the church or unchurched people and then want them to be a part of your spiritual life inside of the church constructs. It is just clunky and needs some wisdom to it. This is ultimately what pushed my wife and I to look elsewhere.

Overall, you’ll like this church if you value teachings—as they are typically about 50 minutes or so and packed with a lot of content. They are very well organized and know what they want and stick to it. They communicate well. And they are up to date with just enough technology, but aren’t trying to be trendy—the perfect blend in my opinion. The church is youthful and energetic and that is refreshing.

The only reason I posted this was for people to know on the front end that you might not be welcomed into the spaces you feel like you need for your spiritual life—and they are very rigid in this aspect of the church. We are so thankful for The Sanctuary - it is truly the faith community my husband and I needed in this cultural moment and in our own personal relationships with God. The Sanctuary models a church community that values authenticity, curiosity, solidarity, honesty, proximity, integrity, etc. with an emphasis on both Scripture/shepherding and on local justice initiatives. It strikes a difficult balance between being safe for those exploring their spirituality and being challenging/encouraging to those who call Jesus Lord. I could go on and on about the beautiful work that The Lord is doing in and through this church, “In Indianapolis as it is in Heaven.” They truly are the people of presence they claim to be. We are so proud to call The Sanctuary our church home. You know it’s a great church when it takes you only 2 visits to join! Honestly; I’m so thankful to God that He sent our family to this church. They are culture changers for sure! They “ see” you and are about God’s heart. It’s refreshing! Excited to be apart of the Lord using  the Sanctuary to bring the kingdom of God to the city of Indianapolis!!!! If you are looking for a community that is modeled after the way of Jesus and the early church, this place is for you. Our weekend worship gatherings are theologically sound, formative, and enriching. Our small groups are devoted to love for neighbor and friend, committed to the work of becoming tightly knit through presence and sacrifice. You won’t regret checking this church out!

name: The Sanctuary Church - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
The preachers are excellent with wisdom and grace. The service and sanctuary have  many lovely to participate.

And the music is skillful with talented musicians ….
But the long length of seemingly all meditative songs. Are they appealing mostly to people that want to go into a trance with songs with very few words and concepts. There are 10’s of thousands of praise and worship songs ( even some graceful inclusive hymns ) that are not being taken of advantage of different rhythms  , different speeds, varied  concepts.
I would enjoy meditative songs mixed with more would help me, some of my friends, and even some members that don’t appreciate the lack of variety of music.  We come late or not at all due to the limited selection.
If you are  interested in going into a 20-30 minute drugged  like trance with  sluggish limited variety of music . This is for you.

You have so much potential with your skills and hearts. Amazing ⛪️ church doing GODs work! Feel safe here and the SPIRIT moving. Tasha singing is angelic like! Drew is awesome! The children’s director Annalise is absolutely inspiring beautiful person. Sanctuary is place I feel the presence of GOD powerfully! This community greeted me with humanity!! I’m Grateful for the support offered in my time of need. On Sundays they offer breakfast to feed the community and they offer showers. Thank you so much!!!! I called numerous times asking for a call back from a pastor due to numerous losses. The community outreach female that was my second point of contact had a dismissive tone while conversing with her. Mind you, my calls have been over a two week period with no call back. The first time I called I was told all pastoral staff was on break. The second week, I was also told that the pastoral staff was again on break. Do not attend a church where staff is either not working or couldn't return a call. Attended today being Sunday and perticipated in the Communion of the Eucharist as Jesus wanted the Apostles to do in remembrance of his Life, Love and his Sacrifice for them and for us...

The Sanctuary Church is the very Best non denominational Church I have ever attended...
They are doing the work of God here ..
Please visit and attend and become involved .!!!

name: The Sanctuary Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: Great service, super friendly and amazing music ministry. Kids ministry is excellent and clearly reflects their dedication to the next generation. Main sanctuary has been completely renovated and is state of the art. Perfect acoustics! My family and I were looking for a church home, and chose this church. It has great pastors, an amazing sunday school (childcare for kids up to 6th Grade), and an amazing hospitable quality  that makes you feel loved. The people of the church are extremely friendly, the teachers and pastors are great, and the church feels like home. Come and see for yourself! The Sanctuary is a wonderful, loving Church. My family loves it there and we easily invite friends to come because we know it is a safe place to grow your relationship with God, friends and family. Pastor Marty is the BEST Pastor in the Santa Clarita Valley! I was so happy to find this church. My husband loves going to church now. Thank you Pastor Marty. Pastor Marty is knowledgeable & funny. He keeps people engaged by sharing his own experiences. Having a children's ministry is important to me as well.

name: The Sanctuary Church - Savannah Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I love everything about this church!

We switched from a large church and we love how this Church is so welcoming. We have felt at home since the first time we attended. The sermons are always challenging and help us grow. Amazing worship too!!

All around 10/10 🔥❣️ After relocating to Savannah, my church-hunting journey was filled with moments of feeling unnoticed and disconnected. However, the instant I stepped into the Sanctuary on that first Sunday, a sense of belonging washed over me, and I knew I had found my home. The warmth and passion for the Lord in this church are unparalleled. In just two months, I've seamlessly become a part of this vibrant community, serving and growing in ways I hadn't imagined. It's truly special to be in a church where you're not just a number, but seen as the hands and feet of the kingdom of God. If you're seeking a place where you're valued as Christ values you, I think this might be just the place for you. Come sit with me this Sunday – I’ll save you a seat :) I absolutely adore this church! Since joining the Sanctuary last July, my spiritual growth has been remarkable. I prayed for a supportive community of believers, and the Holy Spirit guided me here. The attendees radiate Jesus' joy, and the Pastoral Staff exemplify humility and strong leadership. Connecting with this church is effortless, and I've been fortunate to be mentored by incredible, godly women. The young adults ministry is incredibly welcoming, and I've found lifelong friends. I encourage you to experience firsthand the amazing work of the Lord in this church because the Spirit of God is truly at work in the Sanctuary! There is such a powerful and fresh flow of the Holy Spirit in this church, and I can hardly wait for the next service. This church is full of praise, and when praise goes up, the presents comes down. This place is so warm and inviting. You feel  loved and accepted as soon as you walk in the door. The worship draws you to a place of repentance and prayer. The pastor is on fire. Great staff and team!

name: The Sanctuary Church FTL - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
An enchanted experience🧡The music was exquisitely presented. The musicians excellent. The atmosphere and acoustics of this mid-century church were superb. The brief introduction by each one of the musicians of each movement gave insight, which gave personal engagement with each musician. So grateful! Excellent! This was a date night for my husband and I, was a bit nervous since I planned it, BUT was pleasantly surprised and excited to walk into the venue. We both had Tito's and cran and enjoyed the ambiance of the moment. Would we do it again...absolutely!!! The atmosphere was magical, the candlelight created a deep sense of peace, and the music of Juan Gabriel was simply beautiful and full of soul. His songs felt timeless, emotional, and deeply moving in this setting. An intimate and unforgettable evening that touched the heart. Highly recommended. I saw the Bridgerton candlelight string Quartet, concert here, and what a stunning venue. They really have a beautiful team for decorations, including fresh florals, the music was incredible, and the ambience is fabulous here. The ambiance was so beautiful.
The overall atmosphere and performance by the Collin’s quartet was amazing. Can’t wait to go to another event.
Not trying to start another east coast west coast beef but 3 Tupac songs and 5 biggies songs.  One on. lol.

name: The Sanctuary Denver - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful church with wonderful people. This is a universal reconciliationist church which means they don't believe in eternal torment. Very welcoming. Incredible pastor also. I can't say enough wonderful things about this place. Churches were once the center of our communities and held the highest Principles and Meaning in the Universe. The teaching that God is Relentless Love holds us in unquestionable certainty of our life. The best and most honest and truthful Christian Church i have found. I've been a member since May and  I love it.
Peter is the most inspiring pastor I have ever met. Wonderful Christian Church with great people and accepting to everyone.
We had our wedding here 5 years ago with an amazing ceremony from Peter. I've been listening to the sermons through "youtube" since last year during my recovering period. The messages God using Paster Peter to preach is super profound, which easily make my head spinning dramatically. Honestly, i have to listen to the same sermon 3-5 times to get the point. What impressed me mostly is all the personal struggling and trials Pastor Peter shared boldly, which convinced me that only through God's Spirit this can be done. As we human always tend to hide and run away from God with our secretive shames and guilts deceived by the lies and bondage of the dark side, somebody like Pastor Peter keeps sharing his bloody side with us, truly is like Jesus Christ is exposing His Heart to us into the darkness where we are slaved and sleeping. Plus, Pastor Peter speaks like human, a real human! I love such blunt opening honest but real talking style!

name: The Sanctuary of Cedar Park - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary:
When i first attended I was greeted with warmth and love. The word of God is preached mightly with power. This is my church now. I have been healed of sickness during one Wednesday service when Pastor laid his hand on me and whispered a simple prayer! Praise God! Jesus knows.
Faith Without Works Is Dead
14 What does it profit, my brethren, if someone says he has faith but does not have works? Can faith save him? 15 If a brother or sister is naked and destitute of daily food, 16 and one of you says to them, “Depart in peace, be warmed and filled,” but you do not give them the things which are needed for the body, what does it profit? 17 Thus also faith by itself, if it does not have works, is dead. 18 But someone will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without [f]your works, and I will show you my faith by my works. 19 You believe that there is one God. You do well. Even the demons believe—and tremble! 20 But do you want to know, O foolish man, that faith without works is [h]dead? 21 Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he offered Isaac his son on the altar? 22 Do you see that faith was working together with his works, and by works faith was made perfect? 23 And the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.” And he was called the friend of God. 24 You see then that a man is justified by works, and not by faith only.
John 13:34-35 A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another. By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
Matthew 7:12 Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
Matthew 11: 28 “Come to Me, all of you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. 29 All of you, take up My yoke and learn from Me, because I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for yourselves. 30 For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
Psalms 60: 11Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man. 12 Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies. I love The Sanctuary Church. If you are looking for a Bible believing, Spirit filled church you have found it. The Pastors are real people and you can see how genuine they are after a three minute conversation. You will feel a sincere welcoming the minute you walk in. The Sanctuary Kids church has great teachers that teach real bible stories and your infants will be in great hands in the Sanctuary Nursery. They also teach appropriate age lessons. I know if you try it, you will agree. I hope to see you soon. Great place to worship!! The people there are very friendly and welcoming. The Sanctuary is a spirit-filled Bible believing church that always invites and welcomes a move of God in every service. The Lead Pastor, Melvin Reddy and the Associate Pastor, Lisa Reddy are genuine people with a love and a burden for the lost. We made the Sanctuary our home 17 years ago and have been very happy to be there ever since. Give the Sanctuary a visit and I’m sure you will be happy you went there as well!! The Sanctuary Church is such a special place filled with God's loving people. If you're looking for a church where you can learn God's Word in a safe and welcoming atmosphere, worship God freely and experience His holy presence, and find a community to help you grown in your faith then The Sanctuary Church is the place for you!

name: The Santa Anita Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church space inside lots of windows and natural light. The stained glass backdrop is also lovely. The church service itself felt very traditional, even though the messaging of the church seemed more contemporary. Even though the music was more contemporary the way that it was performed, felt more hymnal. Absolutely the best church of all time. We sing Beatles songs. They are very non judgemental. This is how every church should be. An amazing LGBTQ
+ Community 😘💖🐶💖🏳️‍🌈💖🙏🪩‼️ We were married there in 1981. Still married. Church is perfect setting for a wedding. Our daughter is going to be married there this Saturday. We recently had our daughter's wedding and reception at the Church.  It was fantastic. The Church Wedding planner was friendly and wonderful to work with. Terry conducted a beautiful ceremony and added a perfect touch to it by adding a rose exchange and American Indian prayer.  The entire day was perfect! Would recommend this Church for upcoming Weddings.

name: The Shoreline Church
reviewSummary: Incredible 'sandy feet friendly' church. Extremely welcoming and solid bible teaching. The Saturday night service with the inflatables and dinner is a wonderful idea for kids.

name: The Shoreline Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: You will know the leadership by their love. There are many at Shoreline that are sincere Christians and amazing people. Unfortunately, I can’t say that about some of the “pastoral staff”. It’s all about appearance there, but when it gets to the core of integrity of maintaining the name of Christianity… Very disappointing. My Daughter introduced my wife and I to The Shoreline.  We have since made it our home.    Really enjoy the message and the Christian community here at The Shoreline The shoreline church is a come as you are congregation with arms wide open. I found this church through a fried and it has just been a fit for me because I’m a surfer, love the ocean and love Jesus but not a big fan of some traditional churches that lack passion, energy and life. You’ll find inspiring and inspirational sermons along with great music.  A little over 2 years ago, I began attending Monday night Celebrate Recovery held at the shoreline church, including taking the step study last year and that has been ever life-changing. I highly encourage you to go as you are with an open heart and be healed of life’s hurts, hang-ups and habits!! I have attended Shoreline Church of San Clemente since it's opening.  I love the community of caring people. I love the teaching, which is Biblically right-on! The worship music is superb - a nice variety of the stand up and clap-type to the mellow, soulful get close to God stuff. What I like the best has to be the many generations represented.  We started as a young church with young families.  Those families have grown up over the past 13 years, which is so much fun to watch. I would encourage anyone who is searching for just the right church to call home to come visit us. I live in the south bay and I attended the Mother's Day service as my wife and I were looking for a new house to rent in San Clemente.  I was so happy to hear the gospel of our Lord proclaimed from the pulpit. I went back the following week to pick up some furniture in the area and stopped by again, and I gave God all the glory once again as they faithfully delivered the gospel again. I pray that the pastors that are called to preach  will not be afraid of the people or look to please board members but are faithful to the our Lord who called them out for service. It was a great experience.

name: The SoCalDistrict The Pentecostal Church - Santa Clarita Campus
The Spoken Word Christian Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Attending 10+ years.  The church has a wonderful heart and great personality with truly caring and active people. The lead pastor Bob is thoughtful and a really strong leader and teacher but most of all his strength lies in his heart as a shepherd.  Pastor John is a deep thinker and extraordinary teacher.  I often leave the service contemplating the message.

When we initially attended, after shopping around, we never felt pushed to join but felt noticed and that was from the love of Christ these people have.

My wife and I were seeking a Christ center church family where we could get connected and we found it at the Spoken Word Church.

Be blessed!

Rick Rutecki 10-years ago my wife and I were looking for a smaller church with with a pastor who teaches directly from the bible.  This church also had to have a true family feel.  Less than 5 minutes inside the door we knew we found our church home/family.  Since then our faith and our understanding of the word has made an immeasurable impact on not just us but, by extension, our closest friends and family. Thank you, Pastor Bob, for allowing God to lead you and our church. Angie and I were drawn to the Spoken Word church in January of 2018 because of our young granddaughter's weekly experience at the church's program for young children.  Since that time, we have been blessed to not only experience a true sense of community with everyone that attends / participates in the Sunday services, but the leadership of both Pastors Bob Cote and John Chipman have been instrumental in the expansion of our biblical knowledge.
If you are longing for a church that literally "walks the walk" when applying Christian principles, fellowship, education, and the ability to grow your faith, then I would encourage you to attend a Sunday service as soon as possible.  You will definitely not be disappointed. This is a great, small church where you will always be greeted and welcomed!  The sermons are informative, bible-based and help me grow in my knowledge.  The Bible studies are excellent and prayer and fellowship are very strong with every encounter. Personal relationships, availability, and feelings of belonging are what comes to mind when describing the Spoken Word Christian Church. It filters down from Pastor Bob Cote .He genuinely invests in everyone. And it is his nature. This beautiful trait cannot be faked. And it seems to be contagious as it brings out the same in others at church. As Bob often reminds us, it all comes as a gift from Jesus. We just have to accept it. And Him.

name: The Springs Church - Chandler Campus
reviewSummary: Have always felt welcomed, they have different ministries for helping while still working together overall for everyone. They do have children, teen, and young adult ministries as well as prayer teams available after every service ❤️🙏 It’s been just over three years now since my first Sunday at The Springs, and I don’t think I’ve missed once since that day! The sense of community and the astounding welcome I received set the stage for this to become my home church right from the start. The teachings and messages are outstanding, the staff have a true passion for their work and a deep love for Jesus that shines through everything they do. They have plenty of opportunities to serve (which is something I absolutely love!) and numerous activities and groups to be a part of. Come check it out just one time, and I’m sure you’ll be just as amazed as I have been these last few years. The Springs has been my church family for almost 5 years now and can't express how much generosity they show in each and every member! The teachings are right on point and the different opportunities they offer to strength your relationship with Christ is endless! As a single parent in my late 20's, I definitely feel that there are multiple ways to get involved. Whether it be working out, quad bible studies, or like me get involved with Financial Peace University, there is a way to get connected with this church family! Try it for yourself, give it just one Sunday and see what we are all talking about! We'd love to meet you and have you get involved! You won't regret it! Come as you are, this is a friendly church with biblical preaching and Spirit-filled worship. We started attending after enrolling our daughter in a daycare that meets at the same location and does a great job. I haven't gotten involved in the CrossFit gym that meets during the week but had a friend who did years ago and always spoke highly of the people there. Every week I enter The Throne room of God through praise & worship. Such an anointing on the music. The teachings by Pastor Nickl  give me a sense that I have been with Jesus. I drink from a deeper well when he teaches. We are blessed by the love this church brings to the sheep of Gods pasture. Every pastor there is in LOVE with Christ. I travel an hour to be at The Springs Church & it is worth it.

name: The Springs Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending the Springs since 2016 and I can’t believe I haven’t left a review yet.

The Springs is like a second home. Sure the worship, sermons, small groups, and programs/ministries are great, but the best part is that it’s Spirit led. Jesus is the center of everything and Jesus is the reason we serve, fellowship, and disciple. Pastor Erik and Holly have done an incredible job leading and truly have a heart for Jesus, number one, and people. It shows in every interaction, sermon, song sung, and plan made. Im truly grateful I get to come here and so grateful for the leaders and members that have become family. My family and I have been attending The Springs Church for over two years.  We instantly felt welcome by all and we loved Pastor Brian's sermons from the start. One of the other main reasons we love the church was their children's ministry program. We have three young boys and it's so important to us that they are hearing strong biblical principles Sunday mornings and learning valuable lessons. I've been amazed at the things my 6 year old comes home talking about. It's amazing to me what an organized and exciting children's ministry they have for this size church. We are also a part of a small group with people that have become family. I love The Springs! We were looking for a church that did more than get people in the door and tell them God loves them. We were also looking for a church community where you really get to know people and it's not just tons of people that show up on Sunday morning and you don't see the rest of the week. This church really digs deep into the word and is a great environment for both new believers and those who have been walking in the faith for awhile. The fellowship is amazing because it's a good size to get to know people and the people really make you feel welcome and at home.  This church was an answer to prayer. We had a great Easter surrounded by other like minded people, it was a great time. I'm not a member of any specific church but I've been to a few different churches such as Discovery Church and Destiny Church here in town but wanted something new. I was very happy to visit The Springs Church along with my in-laws and my 16 Month old son. Upon arriving everyone was joyful and pleasant. We checked my son in quickly and got him settled into the 0-2 aged room for care.(they provided 2 tags 1 for him and 1for me to show upon pickup for safety, nice!) It was his first time being cared for by anyone who wasn't family, it was tough to leave him upset in there but I was assured that he would be cared for and within 5 minutes they had calmed him down and he was happily playing with a few other youngsters. I was so happy that the woman who was in there with him seemed so nurturing, she was able to keep him occupied for the hour I needed. They even gave me a beginners Bible book to take home.♥️ The service was to the point and had a wonderful singer for any songs they played. I like when the service is focused on the writing of the Bible and not stories the pastor wants to tell or jokes. I enjoyed it and all the other visitors were very uplifting during the songs it just felt good. The pastors wife was just a doll! After the service we spoke a bit while I picked up my son and unfortunately they'll be moving soon but the new pastor introduced himself to us and seems great! We had plans for breakfast after but the church did have some doughnuts and other items. 🙏  Absolutely no one made us feel uncomfortable and no one was over barring or pushy, just kind like minded people all under gods roof enjoying the feeling of community. They also had the weekly Tithing printed on the pamphlet they handed out which was actually so refreshing to me! The other churches I've been to would never do that and that says something about them that I can't even explain. So thank you for that also. Best wishes to the pastor and his family on their new adventures. God bless! Have you been searching for a home church? If so the Springs is for you! You will not meet a bunch of nicer people who understand we are all broken and love on one another! It's truly refreshing to find genuine people who care about one another and truly are a reflection of Jesus! Pastor Brian speaks from the Bible and challenges us weekly to grow in our walk with the Lord. The children's ministry is amazing and understands that these children are our future leaders and that it is important to raise them up in the Word in a fun and interactive way that they are excited to come back each week! This church is a life changing!

name: The Springs Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
What a beautiful group of people who are very welcoming, musical, and sharing of the joy of the Holy Spirit!  Thank you for connecting me with Jessica, I hope my daughter visits here soon. It is great that you have a 9 AM and 11 AM worship service; so that if you are in a hotel, you have a couple of options before checkout. My gratitude is meeting a few of you. Clearly lovers of Christ, lovers of His infallible Word. Alberto is a soft-spoken, earnest man of God. There was nothing contentious, here, but also no pandering to this fallen world. Beautiful balance. Loved my visit. I will be moving quite a ways a way soon, but will certainly visit this church anytime I’m in San Marcos! The Springs is a church that will surprise you. From the parking lot, you will see a church building that is simple and unassuming, but upon walking through the front doors, you'll experience a church that's bursting at the seams with life.

Immediately, you notice the passion, the diversity, and the joy. With a little more time with this family of people, you'll see the depth, leadership, and character that is being produced. Ultimately, in many ways, The Springs is a picture of the hope of victory, reconciliation, and love we can have and experience in Jesus.

Come visit, you wont meet people more excited to get to know you. Great community of believers filled with the Holy Spirit. Pastor Alberto is such a wonderful man of God and I encourage you to join the church if you are in San Marcos and its environs. Love this place! Speaking is solid and biblically based. The church is filled with love and a lot of diversity. My kids also love their time!

If you’re in SM area, go check it out Sundays at 10

name: The Springs Church of Christ - Edmond Campus
reviewSummary:
My friend invited me to come to the women's Sunday school class for the 7 week class on the topic HEAVEN.
Wow everyone was so welcoming and helpful. The class was great and the ladies in the class were so nice and made me feel comfortable and welcome.
I will definitely be going back to this church. And I could feel the love for the Lord here. This is the church we attend when in the OKC area. A great family, wonderful services with a mix of contemporary and traditional music, and a welcoming environment. If you are looking for healing, for love, for community, for kindness, and for Jesus...this is the place. Are they perfect...no.  Not a single church in this world is. However, this is a group of gracious people who strive to be the image of Jesus. The Springs Church of Christ is made up of a Body of Spirit Filled Believers!  If you are looking for a Church home., The Springs may be the place you belong.  This I can promise; you will never feel like a stranger and at the end of the Service you will leave knowing you have just been in the presence of the Holy Spirit!    God bless all that are looking for a Body of Christ to worship with! This is a group of very loving and gracious humans. Truly striving to be transformed daily into the image of Christ. I bless the day I found them. This has been an amazing church family to grow up in. They made me who I am. The words that I think define this church are hospitality, kindness, and wisdom.

name: The Station Church, Carlsbad CA - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
The Station Church is very welcoming and the people are very kind. Feels like family right from the start. Beautiful worship and I find the teachings to be timely, 100% biblical, and relevant to everyday life. I believe Pastor Josh has an anointing to preach. I feel the presence of God and am blessed every time I hear him. I highly recommend visiting here. You may find you never want to go anywhere else.😍
Thank you Lord for what You’re doing at the Station Church!! Our family Loves the station church !! We love the kids program- our kids have so much fun, are safe and learn about Jesus. Worship is on fire and Pastor Josh does such a wonderful job with sermons.  He breaks down verses and how it relates to our real life- and even throws in a joke or two make sure you’re paying attention. And Cant wait till Sunday 9 or 10:30 for our free coffee and donuts !!!! Love this church!! Friendly people, welcoming environment, great Christian community. The preacher has such a modern preaching style, makes The Bible so easy to understand. Iv been going here for 8 years and have grown to love this church more and more 🤍 I’m a pretty picky person when it comes to people and places, but this church stands out.

The pastor has a way of bringing lightness to the Word of God, making it feel approachable without losing its depth. And the worship? I haven’t experienced anything like it anywhere else—it’s truly powerful.

Honestly, more people should come and experience this place for themselves. It’s weird to think that the first day I walked into The Station Church, it felt like home without knowing anyone. That’s what The Station has been… home. A place for my family to grow, for our kids to be loved and learn who God is in a real way, and for my husband and I to be encouraged and supported in every season.

reviewSummary:
Loved hearing testimonies of how God is changing people.

The volume during worship hurts my ears and my kid is unable to tolerate it. Will try headphones. This church is full of amazing people with wonderful pastors. The messages they deliver are really life changing.   Thank you stirring family for everything! Adding to this review: they make Disciples!!!!!!
My walk with God and Relationship with him has radically improved due to this place and the friendships it has established me in. I have been going to this church on and off for about 5 years, I have really buckled down the last year and a half, this place is so focused on community if you get plugged in, they teach discipleship, have life groups and it’s awesome to know almost everyone at the church, I have developed life long friendships here and I can say the leadership are outstanding people. Great church! Pastor Nate is full of vision and profound applicable insights. The church is very discipleship centered and focused on sending people out to witness in the community. So much goodness here, and genuine people want8ng to build relationships woth christ

reviewSummary: One of the most influential sending churches in North America. Known for theological clarity, engaging preaching by J.D. Greear, and relentless focus on church planting.

name: The Summit Church - Brier Creek Campus - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: I’m not religious but my mom has been wanting to attend this church. We went on a Sunday and drove about 40 minutes to get to the location. Neither of us live in the area so we weren’t sure what to expect but the experience was wonderful. Incredibly helpful and kind people who guide newcomers in and make them feel welcome. My mom absolutely loved the service and overall experience so I’m happy she’s happy. Despite not being religious myself, if I were or if I was new to Christianity, this would be a great church to get involved with. Sadly, just like Greedy Elevation Church (no cross displayed?) Ps Donny has repeatedly turned me and others away when in NEED. I lost my job, facing financial challenges including eviction… I received a pathetic phone call, whimpy prayer and hung up. This is NOT the Book of ACTS church. God sees… he/they will give an account! If you want to Love Your Neighbor? Take your millions and PREVENT Homelessness not feed them PBJ afterwards! Don’t refer me to a local ministry that excludes my zip code or only helps w/food. Where is the Accountability? What are they doing with the TITHE? Building another satellite church for the fleecing of the flock? Fantastic church!! Biblically sound teaching and the worship is reverent. I’ve attended many services over the last year and never seen anyone separated out as the one negative post above stated. High school aged usually sit up front. College students attend and sit up front as well. The congregation is diverse and everyone is very friendly and welcoming. I've been attending service at this Summit campus since February 2021. It is a wonderful church home. It offers access to Christ-centered community for households of all shapes and sizes as well as a place for individuals to grow in their personal relationship with God. They are a passionate organization devoted to challenging cultural and social issues with the power of the gospel and their mission to produce disciple-making disciples. I absolutely love this church.  It’s very friendly and you will hear the Gospel as it should be taught.  I’ve been attending this church for 4+ years with no regrets.

name: The Summit Church - Chapel Hill Campus - Chapel Hill Campus
reviewSummary: A true Baptist church located at east chapel hill high. They always make new comers feel welcome. They offer child care and it is a truely bible based sunday school. If y o u have kids talk to blair he is a person here on earth to serve and will do just about anything for you. Eric and aj are also two amazing people that will always welcome anybody with open arms. All in all a great place to worship on your sunday morning. Great Church with the mission of God.  Love God. Love people. Multiple reasons Awesome! The environment is beautiful and quiet!

name: The Summit Church - Denver Campus
reviewSummary:
My experience at The Summit Church was incredibly disappointing. From the outside, the church presents itself as a welcoming, Christ-centered community, but my experience did not reflect those values. I found the environment to be cliquish and unwelcoming, especially toward newcomers who weren't already part of established social circles.
Rather than demonstrating humility, compassion, and genuine fellowship, I encountered what felt like superficial interactions and a lack of authentic care. Concerns I raised were either dismissed or ignored, leaving me with the impression that appearances mattered more than people.
A church should strive to reflect Christ's love, grace, and servant leadership. Instead, I left feeling judged, overlooked, and deeply discouraged. While no church is perfect, accountability, transparency, and a willingness to listen are essential qualities that I did not experience here.
I cannot recommend The Summit Church based on my experience. I sincerely hope the leadership takes honest feedback seriously and works toward creating a community where every person feels genuinely valued rather than simply attending another Sunday service. I am from the Bible Belt and was visiting Denver for work.  I found the Summit - Denver on Google.  Upon arrival, I felt very welcomed.  It was refreshing to see so many cultures together in one church.  Pastor Andy noticed me and spent a great deal of time chatting before service.  The people were active participants in worship and not merely spectators.  The message by Pastor Andy was on-point, truth with love.  So much wisdom in a half hour.  If you are searching for a church, this is a Must Try. We absolutely love this church! I’m honestly surprised by the negative reviews mentioning cliques, because our experience was the complete opposite. We moved from a large church in Denver to The Summit specifically looking for genuine community, and from our very first service we felt welcomed. People came up to introduce themselves. The first two services we even had members of the church come up and ask us about getting coffee or breakfast afterwards.  We quickly got plugged into a wonderful city group, and it was clear this wasn’t a “sit, worship, listen, and leave” kind of church. Summit is all about doing life together in community. Beyond that, Pastor Andy is deeply grounded in Scripture. His sermons aren’t about feelings or cultural trends; they’re about faithfully teaching the word of God. Although we recently moved to another state, we’re hopeful to find a church like Summit again. We can’t say enough good things about our time there! It truly shaped our lives and faith in such a positive way Great place to be, love the diversity ! Andy is a very honest and open individual . Very refreshing to hear the word from this man . I'm leaving this review on past experiences here, talking like 10 years ago past. We came to this church after our home church folded. It was hard to go from somewhere where the congregation was like family to a place where we knew nobody. However, I made friends quickly and joined 2 groups, one was the younger single crowd, the other older (30-50s) with kids (I had a daughter). I never felt unwelcome or unwanted either. Granted, I put effort into meeting people, didn't just sit there and do nothing. Sometimes it takes work people.....
Seeing the reviews here though for the time since then,  makes me wonder if I'd have the same experience if I showed up again.

name: The Summit Church - Downtown Durham Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church! The music is great and uplifting and inspiring. My kids just love it and have a good time! The pastors always give a great message.  All the people who attend this church are so friendly! Its a great way to start my Sunday off and my whole week! Went here today with my girlfriend to check out a new church and had a pretty bad experience there. Not one single person greeted us or made us feel welcome. We had to say hello to the greeters to even make them respond. We were very interested in the summit church but if this is how all of their campuses are, we were very disappointed and don't plan on coming back. This is a southern baptist church. They won't talk about it and try to hide it. That tells you all you need to know. Be careful brothers. I am so thankful for the Summit family, and Pastor JD.
God Bless You Mighty. The few remaining churches that take the bitterness of the bible and interpret it without fear, favor, or personal opinions.
