name: The Summit Church | Conway - Conway Campus
reviewSummary: Not only did we find a new Church family at summit, but this place has a different feel to it. They are organized, they have people that are willing to speak with you about what your having struggles with AT THAT TIME. My family and I have been trying to find a church for over a year, and we believe we have found a place to let our roots spread in Summit. God is good all the time! Visited this church today. The pastor was really engaging. My teens were captivated by his message which was lined with laughter and stories. They even remembered the message afterwards, which is rare. We will come back again. They hosted the Toys 4 Tots Christmas mall. Every one was so nice and excited to help. Truly in the Christmas spirit. The marines and other military branches were there helping all the people. God is truly good. We were greeted when we entered the lobby. The service was great. The worship and teaching was excellent. We loved it. Making nonsense traffic in small places in Conway

name: The Summit Lighthouse of Los Angeles - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: Not here to judge. A very interesting in place. Their headquarters is in the Rocky Mountains of Montana and this site is their Los Angeles church. Very intelligent and interesting place

name: The Tabernacle Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Such a great church, it’s a body of people that loves worshiping Jesus, and connecting with people in Love. You can feel God’s presence within this ministry. This is a sweet church with a heart for Jesus, reaching the world with the Gospel one soul at a time. I was welcomed there by so many brothers and sisters in Christ, each one with a unique testimony and a true love for others. If you want a genuine group of people to worship with or you are looking to know Jesus, Tabernacle will welcome you with open arms. Thank you Pastors David and Lori. This is the first time in my Christian journey I feel connected to the church community and a part of something greater than myself. Thank you, Jesus for leading me here. I've been blessed to be part of this ministry now for the last 9 years, it is the church I call home. The pastors are amazing, there is no denying how strong the love of Jesus is in them. The very first Sunday there I felt the love and presence of God in such a strong way that I knew I would stay. As a single father of a 10 year old boy, it is important to me what kind of teaching my son will receive, the children's ministry is amazing, and this is obvious by the joy the children always carry, they are in great hands. Spirit filled and Jesus centered. I’ve been a member of the Tabernacle church for 7 months now. I’ve seen the Holy Ghost dancing in worship and taking what the enemy meant for evil (Us) and turning our hearts for good. Pastor David and Lee have led the men’s ministry to prosper and grow in faith in so many ways!  Pastor Lori and Rachel have been doing excellent in the women’s ministry as well!! The church is great for kids. Very home feeling church with awesome people and strong faith! Pastors David & Lori Lukinovich have a deep love for God & for people! Their heart is to serve the Covington community especially Covington High School. Sharing the message of faith in Jesus is at the core of this church. When you enter this church you feel the love of God through these people!

name: The Table at First Christian Church - Warner Robins Campus
reviewSummary:
I was probably 5 years old the first time I went to this church. At the time, all the boy scout troops met there. But that was a long time ago.
So I stopped by the other day to see how it's held up.  Not much is changed. It's still a well kept, well designed, and dearly loved building. The people in it were so nice to show me around.
There is a lot of history in this church. You should visit if you can. Great place to worship.  Loved the older hymns and message.  Very relaxed and comfortable experience. Amazing staff. Very passionate and kind. 🙂✝️

name: The Town Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent church, a good home for both natives and internationals.
Teaching here is conservative and bible based.

A great place to bring kids. Family oriented. God focused.
Two great services every Sunday and several welcoming small groups fellowship

This church is wheelchair navigable from packing to accessing the auditorium. Ever since my family joined this church family, we have enjoyed the community, their Sunday services, the youth group, and the townships. The leadership provides great discipleship, the worship songs point back to God, and the general atmosphere/vision is gospel-centered. I'm always excited to meet here. I am originally from Philadelphia visiting Fort Collins for Massage training. I visited The Town Church and I truly loved the preaching Of God's Word, the worship, and very friendly people. I will continue to visit until I return home in late May 2016. I'm a cycling for over 30 years and seeing the bikes on the church  website also got my attention. Every Sunday, I bike for 35-40 minutes each way. Its a blessing to visit Colorado.
Grace and Peace! I moved to Fort Collins from Nashville, TN where I had attended much larger churches.  Longing for a smaller community of believers God lead me to The Town Church.  Located in the heart of Old Town Fort Collins this community of believers has a passion for the culture of Old Town and the people therein. Made up of locals and transplants alike this younger community of families and singles are warm and welcoming.  If you live here or are passing through I highly recommend visiting The Town Church.  The lead pastor teaches the Word of God with great devotion and humility.  And sometimes he's funny. The Town Church has been my home for a part in my life. Going to other churches around the city and keep coming back here. The pastor and his words are of truth and humility. Being humble, he speaks from his heart. I will keep coming back here.

The United Methodist Church - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus

name: The Valley Cathedral Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Christian folks there were very nice and welcoming! Their pastor did a great job preaching about Jesus! Great family church, small in size but powerful in faith Well was there visiting had a friend bring and is differant I was use my old preacher was kinda like a old country church and sang old hymns  and not these 5 to 15 minutes  songs and don't why they need the music so loud I wasn't hard of hearing and was nice inside Pastor Price, is very God fearing pastor and deicated to giving the Word directly from the Bible and also deicated to his members to reach out to showing the true Love of the Holy Spirit, that is peace and comfort to welcome you. This is my home church.  I love attendin here where I can receive the love and kindness from friends. Along with feel the Holy Spirit and have the chance to be prayed for.

name: The Valley Vineyard Christian Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming, feels like family 💕 This church is such a wonderful light in the valley. I only attended for a matter of months, but this place still feels like family over a year after leaving the area. The Lord really met me in this place where and when I needed help in my life most.

I always had a belief and fear of God throughout my life, but here I found Christ (again) and He delivered me back on my feet in one piece.  I met lifelong friends and found a path to healing. The pastor(s) and leaders are such God-loving and humble people--it is such a refreshing and encouraging experience in today's world.

I pray if you are reading this you will also find the connection with Christ and community here to encourage you on your walk.  This church is so worth your visit! I was a member of the church for over 10 years and really enjoyed it. Pastor Bill is great; we went on a mission trip together, attended his weekly home group, and he came to the hospital when my son was born. Thanks, Bill. I love this church. I'm biased because I've been here for 30 years but I love the people so much, I can't go anywhere else and find that kind of acceptance and love. We want to take Jesus out of the church and into the street where people are. I feel safe here and encouraged to be genuine in my love for Jesus. The Holy Spirit is active in that place.

name: The Victory Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary: I enjoyed myself.  The word was on point the worship was phenomenal the atmosphere in the church was awesome. Love this church, truly spirit-filled. Amazing choir. Highly recommend.  More than five stars. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Good time @ church. This is where i worship Great Pastor and loving church family where everybody is somebody, where their unity their victory!!! Enjoy visiting this church members very friendly.

name: The Village Chapel - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church. I attended for five years until I moved. Each message is deeply rooted in the word as they read through books of the Bible. The music is sweet and beautiful. Highly recommend if you are looking for a new church! A collection of individuals sincerely working to serve God and others, as they help each other become better followers of Christ. Check out their well curated electronic and print resource pages along with online streaming and recordings if you cannot make it in person. Thank you for being part of the Nashville community and beyond! We enjoyed visiting this church with our daughter who just moved to town. The worship was SO beautiful. I wish I could experience it every week. I didn’t know any of the songs (some Getty, some Townend), but they were all meaningful and beautiful. The sermon was excellent; they are really teaching the Word. It wasn’t too large and not too small. If we lived here, I would choose this church. I can’t say enough good things about The Village Chapel—this place has completely changed the way I experience church! I’ve been attending for almost a year now, and every single week I leave feeling encouraged, challenged, and more rooted in the Word of God.

If you’re tired of churches that feel like a performance, this is your place. The Village Chapel teaches straight from the Bible, book by book, with no fluff and no gimmicks—just powerful, Spirit-filled truth. Pastor Jim brings the heat every week with wisdom, humility, and authenticity, and the entire teaching team—Tommy, Ryan, and others—do an amazing job connecting with the congregation.

Worship is beautifully simple. No fog machines, no light shows—just sincere, uplifting music that points you straight to Jesus. The layout and timing of the service is spot-on and intentionally designed to make the Word the main focus.

There are two Sunday services—9:00 a.m. and 11:00 a.m.—and both include full baby and children’s ministry, which is a huge blessing for families. The church is suitable for a wide range of ages and appeals to anyone who is interested is hearing directly from the books of the Bible.

This church is big enough that you can blend in if you want, but intimate enough that you’ll quickly find community. I’ve jumped in with the men’s retreat, Second Saturday service, the Christmas Village, a chili contest (yes, it was awesome), a baseball game fellowship night, and I attend the Tuesday morning men’s prayer group weekly—it’s been life-giving.

The pastors and staff are present, welcoming, and truly care. The staff is omnipresent and all a pleasure to engage with! You’ll be greeted with a smile and feel right at home, whether it’s your first visit or your hundredth.

If you’re hungry for real truth, deep teaching, and authentic community, The Village Chapel is exactly where you want to be. I’m so grateful to have found this church! They read/preach through books of the Bible. Enough said. Our first Sunday at TVC, the church was working its way through Ecclesiastes. Awesome! Also, the childcare teams are wonderful with our son. We are so blessed to have come across this community.

name: The Village Church
reviewSummary: Best known for Matt Chandler's deep, theological preaching. The culture is serious about discipleship and covenant membership. 'Home Groups' are the engine of the church.

name: The Village Church (Sundays: 9AM & 10:45AM) - Hamilton Campus
reviewSummary: Solid biblical teaching with a community that legitimately loves each other.  We are so grateful that the Lord brought us to this part of his church. Love God, love your neighbor and move to engage the culture with the gospel of Jesus. That's what this local church strives to do and it's a joy to be apart of what God is doing here in little Hamilton. Great church, great people. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church. Love this church and it's commitment to the Gospel and the City it serves! A great message and good worship! If circumstances allow, I will be back!

name: The Village Church Denton - Denton Campus
reviewSummary:
So thankful for the opportunity to worship while out of town🙌 There were so many special things about this The Village Church Denton, from the beautiful worship style , to the powerful sermon from the preacher, to the kindness and friendliness of the volunteers.

Love the way they made family worship a priority and had leaders arrive after worship to gather the kiddos and go off to their age appropriate rooms.

Love how we stood for the reading of God's Word and the sermon notes they handed out before service. The time spent as a congregation intentionally preparing our heart before hand to recieve the Word.

Everyone was so welcoming and we truly felt at home, even if just for a Sunday ❤️ If you like contemporary worship, identify with Baptist traditions, crave emotionally charged sermons, and believe in multiple baptisms you will really enjoy this church. However, if you are looking for a church that is open-minded/open-hearted/no judgement this “may” not be a good fit. I attended for 3 years before pursuing covenant membership. I ended up making the personal decision to withdraw after learning their core values. In a nutshell they believe: elder positions are restricted to men, inner culture is exclusive, and the church is a member of the Southern Baptist Convention. During this covenant process I felt alienated and excluded. I was being asked to jump over a series of hurdles in order to become a member. It just didn't feel right. The culture was also materialistic in both Denton and Flower Mound. I’ve grown up in small Methodist churches. Leaving the village brought me to a different village where I found a unified, inclusive church that accepted me with open arms and embraced the believer that I have been. No baptism needed. Matt, please speak gently, with a still small voice so that everyone can hear. i’ve gone to this church since i was a little kid. i thought it was a welcoming environment until i realized i’m queer. my dad was a deacon, everybody knew us in the church. i was a sweet little church girl. but when i realized i was queer everything changed. my dad went behind my back to talk to the church after i came out to him and my mom and they encouraged him to kick me out and have nothing to do with me. this is not the Love of Christ. this is not unconditional love. if you want a church that truly loves, go to the methodist church off the square. they care. these people don’t. This place is terrible. I’ve been going to church all of my life, but I stopped going because of all of the rude, ignorant, and arrogant people that surround the culture. I tried to go again, but I left because of the same issue! I attend UNT and do not have a lot of money to be spending on paid parking. I parked here thinking they are a church and they are not in session, and I didn’t realize there was no parking allowed. I walked out to my car to grab my laptop charger so that I could finish my homework on time and saw my car was gone. 188 dollars to get it out of impound. This is absolutely a disgrace to the Denton community. A church, which is not a business according to the Bible, should not be towing broke college students’ cars without any sort of warning or friendly notice. I am just trying to get an education, was running late for class, and parked here without knowing. I want to be productive contribution to society. This is not what a church is supposed to be about, your policies and rules contradict your own faith. What happened to forgiveness, mercy? What would Jesus do? Ask yourself that! A Christian does not get upset if people are using some parking spots at the church. The church was built TO HELP PEOPLE. Just not comfortable with the motives and direction of this church. Explosive growth has led to lots of variables, loss of controls, and teachings infused with tone that is not appropriate. Matt has a gift at deconstructing the bible, but it's not always what you say...but how you say it. Jesus raised his voice on rare occasions for dramatic effect.

name: The Village Church of Irvine - Main Campus
The Village Community Presbyterian Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church! I’ve been attending weekly for over 6 months now. Pastor Jack and Pastor Jan truly care about the congregation, the church, and the community as a whole. But most importantly, this church puts God first. The traditional service has one of the most beautiful choirs I’ve ever heard. The service has such a nice structure: prayer, benediction, and hymns accompanied by a lovely organ. I would 10/10 recommend this church to anyone! Even if you’re Catholic, Orthodox, or any denomination of Protestant. This church welcomes everyone to the table of Christ. This church is so welcoming. The traditional service is nicely structured with vivid prayers, nourishing sermons and the most stunning choir. The sanctuary is gorgeous and the church really teaches you to walk with Christ, through the service and all the events they do. It is the perfect mix of praising God, fellowship, serving others and fun. So glad I found The Village Community Presbyterian Church. I love it! Wonderful choir, meaningful sermons that you are drawn to discuss after the service with one another, great attention paid to tweens with a robust Confirmation program lead by devoted pastors. Church hosts many community building events. We heard the Sea Chanters in concert at this church last night. The Sea Chanters are part of The United States Navy Band. They were absolutely awesome. If you get a chance to hear them, I highly recommend it. Great concert. Excellent venue!

name: The Village SBC - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Truly blessed and anointed people of God led by a man and woman of God who have served the Lord all their lives! I have been a musician here since I was in high school and I have been truly blessed in how God has used me and guided me while at this ministry. This is a church that is all about family, prayer, worship, and the true word of God. You won't leave without receiving an importation from God. The Village SBC has met the spiritual needs of my family.  The church is spiritually sound, biblically based, and you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit.  A great Chuch for family worship! Bishop Jackie Green is a Master Teacher, if you want to learn the Bible, I highly recommend to come and enjoy the services, also she has a Bible university, you will learn so much!! Called RDU register today! Your life will never be the same!! The Village is a great place for seeking Worship and the hearing a NOW Word. Awesome atmosphere were you can truly feel the Holy Spirit and knowing Jesus is welcomed.

name: The Vine - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I deeply cherish the Vine community. We have experienced genuine worship laced with meaningful conversations. The Vine, from what we have witnessed, is a safe place for all. This community has created an open welcoming environment for people in all phases of their individual faith journeys.  We've experienced genuine true love and have forged authentic friendships, as we strive to follow Jesus together. We have been attending for 10 weeks now and have felt like part of the church since day 1! Love the contemporary style worship and the messages brought every week are practical and can be applied to our daily lives! Very diverse and affirming. Jesus is the main focus and love is abundantly given. We have been to all the events from BBQ, trunk or treat, bowling night and soon to come community chili cook off! You will not be disappointed if you are looking for a place to call home! A wonderful place to worship, make new friends and feel good and contemplate lifes journey. ALL are welcome. The Vine has been a refuge for me in a season of healing. After leaving a spiritually abusive church, I wasn't sure a safe church existed. But The Vine community continues to prove that it is.

It's ok with my wounds, my doubts, and my questions. In fact, it welcomes them. I don't feel pressured to be any other version of myself but the authentic one.

There's no cult of personality, no leader building his or her platform, no fog machine, stage, or light displays. Just humble people following Jesus together.

It's been over a year, and now I can't imagine ever leaving. If you've been a part of a church that misrepresented Jesus and left you damaged in some way, The Vine might be the place that restores your hope that the church can actually be a safe, healthy place. I'm glad my friend invited me to The Vine.  I've only been attending 3 months now but when invited to the Newcomers Dinner, I almost didn't go as I don't feel new at all.  Everyone has been so welcoming and the sense of community is very evident.  What a wonderful place to worship and be in His family.  Even though I live in North Austin, it's well worth the trip!  I've definitely found my home at The Vine.

name: The Vine Church
reviewSummary: I have been going to The Vine for almost four year now. I started coming because it was less than a mile for my apartment but after the first service I knew this would be my church home as long as I was in Madison. The preaching is sound, biblical, relevant, easy to understand. The pastors are transparent, approachable, and kind. The people are friendly and genuinely want to get to know you. But beyond all of that this is a church with a vision and mission that resonate with my heart. You will hear it every week: gospel, community, mission. This is a community of people that truly want to live out the gospel and be on mission for Jesus in their city. Been attending for a year now and been members (wife and I) for a few months and I’m very thankful for the blessing of getting to be a part of this local body. Sound theology, great people who genuinely serve their local community throughout Dane County, and people who are fixed on God’s word and making sure it is preached and acted out locally and globally. I love being part of the Vine. A Gospel centered, Bible preaching church. The Vine doesn't add anything to the Word of God and operates according to the calling from the Gospels and the mission that Jesus appointed the Church to. The pillars of the church are Gospel, Community and Mission. Everything driven from the Word of the Gospels, living it out in community in small groups and fellowship outside of Sunday mornings and also following the call of making disciples of all nations, including neighbors and nations in Madison. Very easy to relate to the pastoral staff and very impactfull teaching each Sunday Stopped in while traveling and thought it was great.  Welcoming congregation and based on one week, good teaching! The vine has a very welcoming atmosphere. The Bible is preached in a way that is clear and applicable to everday life. Childcare is available during service and there is a seperate family section where you can participate in service and little ones can run around and make noise as necessary.

name: The Vine Church - Daytona Beach - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: We love Christ church. The message is easy to understand. The people are friendly and welcoming. We love that Christchurch has come to Daytona Beach. Perfect for families and those who are seeking God. Nice  remodel place  God bless this building  in Jesus name Amen 🙏 Love my church trend setting and ground breaking the new  Daytona Beach Location is absolutely beautiful and very inviting come see for yourself and experience Awesome people and great preaching and ministering of the word of God I look forward to Sunday Evenings. Great Energy, Very Welcoming, Beautiful People!!! Pastor Jesse is amazing. I love his sermons.

name: The Vine Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I went to this church for worship and prayer, it was amazing. They Have Celebrate Recovery on Thursdays. The people are very friendly. Stopped by for their 11am Sunday service last weekend on a referral of a  friend, had an pleasant experience. Ivan did a great job sharing the word he has become so stronger, grounded and walking in faith. One of my favorite congregations I would say this is my family of God had been going there for over 10 years. I moved so I’m not able to go as much anymore, but the pastor is amazing and everybody in the church we’re just like a family we have our ups and downs, but we love each each other at the end of the day and we love God just the same. I can't speak highly enough. Every day of the week and especially Sunday services are filled with the holy spirit. I participate in Celebrate Recovery on Thursdays, will be starting a step study on Friday for women. Men are waiting for more participants to start step study. And various small groups each day of the week.

name: The Vine Church Of Rancho Cucamonga - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Been going to this church for little over a year.  Pastor Jeff has been such an amazing blessing.  He truly has a heart for people and provides the Word.  The people are "real" and coming together with the body of Christ each week to worship is great!!!  Just give it a try.  You won't be disappointed. I have been going here for about 3 years and I love it. The people are friendly and inviting and Pastor Jeff has a heart after Jesus. You will never ever find a perfect church so don't expect to. What you will find is God's word being taught and that's what you need. Pastor Jeff is amazing.  His messages, besides my own father's, are amazing!  The childrens ministry is over the top fun.
The women's bible studies amd mom 2 mom group are fun to be apart of. The overall thing I love about this church is that it is a giving church. The only thing I’d recommend to my brothers in Christ, is to update their phone number. I’m a truck driver and needed to park and wanted to call and ask for authorization to do it; wrong number listed so I parked on the other side, at Walmart, risking that they probably would give me a ticket. Knowing WALMART!!! Blessings brothers and keep rejoicing in our Great Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. One of the most loving churches in Cucamonga. People are down to earth and family oriented while loving and trusting God . The Vine Church is a great place to worship Jesus Christ.

name: The Vine Community Church - Cumming Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church. Everyone is so friendly and it truly feels like home. Youth program has been wonderful for my son and he will miss it since he is graduating. Pastors are wonderful and know everyone by name. If you are looking for a great bible believing local church then this is it. I just started attending New Year’s Day and there’s definitely something special happening here. You can feel it. So far it’s been super welcoming and no one runs you over in the parking lot as soon as church is over. There’s a bit of lingering which means people want to stay in the glow. Also there are all ages here which is not happening everywhere. Love this church. My parents and brother and his family go here and it’s always a joy to visit. The preach the Gospel and our need for Christ every Sunday, regardless of what scripture we’re in. Wonderful community as well! I love my home church. Since moving I do miss it. I would definitely recommend visiting at least once if you're looking for a home church and you're in the area. Pastor John is an awesome man of God and everyone I've ever made relationships with there are just wonderful. We went to The Vine from 2005-2007 and then we moved away from there. We really loved it. It is such a new congregation and it is easy to get to know so many people there. The worship is just great and Pastor Jon is too.

name: The Vineyard Church in Arlington - Arlington Campus
reviewSummary:
Was a wonderful feeling being back in a congregation setting for the first time in over 15 months! Praise and worship was beautiful and moving. The word was presented with great humbleness and authority. I know the pastors of this church truly care about their community! My son loves attending weekly youth services here as well. Very diverse group. Diverse in ethnicity, age and economic status.
These people genuinely care about all Gods children whether they are "churched" or not. No pretenions here and intimate worship and involved in each others lives, but room for more. Attended Vineyard San Dimas in California. Pastor Jon is awesome. Everyone is one big family. Going too miss them all! I pray that I will make Vineyard Arlington my new home❣️ I host a CP R class  here about 3 to 4 times a month and the staff is really nice and I appreciate them allowing me to use their space to teach others how to save lives. Thank you Nathan. This church is not as good of an experience walking in at the door, but then just walk past the door and actually sit and listen and they are passionately trying to get all they can out of their lifetime walking and listening to God and enjoying him.

name: The Vineyard Church in Zionsville - Zionsville Campus
reviewSummary: I am thankful to have been attending this church for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say it’s a wonderful place to experience God and the presence of His Holy Spirit. The sense of authentic Christian community is strong — people genuinely care for one another. Additionally, the teaching is solid and Biblical for all ages, from adults to children, even babies. The kids’ ministry is both safe and engaging; I see how they help kids grow in their faith and really know their Bibles. Worship is spirit-filled, passionate, heartfelt, and uplifting. If you’re looking for a church, community, healing, and more, this is a place where you can grow, connect, worship and experience the love of Jesus. I really enjoyed visiting this church-it's engaging, Bible-based, and full of life. I experienced both God's presence and a strong sense of community. The teaching is grounded in Scripture and practical for everyday life. The worship is live, passionate, and heartfelt. It's a place where people genuinely connect with one another while growing in their faith. If we lived in the area it would be our church home. We look forward to when we can visit again! This is a warm and welcoming church family! They have a firm foundation in biblical truth. The worship is passionately and beautifully led; the Word of God is compassionately and boldly preached! Not to mention, the space is absolutely lovely. The gorgeous stained-glass windows pale in comparison to the Holy Spirit-filled atmosphere, every time this family of believers meet together! The Vineyard in Zionsville is a church of loving individuals that feel like home. God's spirit is rich during service and the sermon is full of teachings from the Bible as it should be. Worship music is beautiful and often comes with a sense of peace. The kids ministry is also focused of biblical teachings. I pray those that come feel the sense of community that I did and you help others feel that love when you come ❤️ What an excellent community of believers! The messages are biblical and exceptionally impactful; the worship draws you in so that you are giving your all to the Lord; the leadership and attendees are welcoming and inclusive. This church is relatively new, so you won't want to miss your chance to be a part of something that I know will have a huge impact for the kingdom of God!

name: The Vision Church - Valdosta Campus
reviewSummary: Love attending The Vision Church. The atmosphere is so warming and you feel God's presence and the church body makes you feel so welcome. Pastor Walden really be used by God and the Holy Spirit. The real deal! I've been going for over a year now and literally every single Sunday, I have left sharpened, encouraged, challenged, and built up in my faith and walk with the Lord. The worship is anointed and the presence of the Lord is honored there. Pastor Frankie is solid. His preaching and teaching is grounded in the Word and full of the Holy Spirit. He's not worried about the status quo or the next trending thing. He's concerned with the things of the Kingdom and raising up Kingdom men and women. A small church with a big heart. Great authentic worship center I went to Sunday School & later to the church service. I felt welcome and the presence of God was felt, immensely. I felt welcome and at home, the first time I attended. I believe I have found my new church home! I will continue to attend. The Vision Church has a beautiful new look.  Pastor Frankie surpasses himself every week.

name: The Warehouse - Dwell Community Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
Allows their students to abuse animals in the parking lot , no repercussions. One of the students got upset that they were told multiple times to leave the bird alone after scaring it and trying to handle it. Student preceded to call someone to come “beat us up” because they were told to quit abusing animals. Staff made us leave and didn’t reprimand the animal abusing students. Don’t bring ur kids here! Kind folks who are genuinely interested in community and understanding the Bible. Great coffee! Always raising the bar. Love the industrial style setting, it's perfect for a chill study date or to enjoy a good book to read! Great church for studying, Nice pastors

I can say this is better then Marcus Theater at least... (Sorry Marcus theater)

5 Star for peace and quiet, and for gaurded.

Great place to listen to God.

knows I need then Marcus theater.

💪🙏 Quiet place to work on stuff during non-teaching nights. Great prices for food and drink as well! Hours can vary tho

name: The Waterfront Church - Richmond Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is generous and loves to give back to the community! They have gone above and beyond to help us in a time of need. Pastor Adam is truly a gift and we have been so very blessed by his kindness.

Thank you Waterfront Church! Such an amazing church community. I live the intimate setting, awesome worship team and God inspired messages preached by pastors Adam and Rebecca. Thankful every day for such a wonderful Spiritual Home and Family. Great worship experience in a Christ centered group of amazing pastors, musicians & avid prayer warriors. 🙏 Everyone is welcomed as an answered prayer!🙏 Our family has been attending Waterfront for over 2 years now.  Pastor Adam is so passionate.  Love how he brings the Bible to real life every week. Scripture based preaching and teaching. This is a true Christian community.  Kind openhearted people welcomed me with genuine smiles.

name: The Way - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: I Love The Way! It’s a church made with God’s special design.  This is not only church but a multi-cultural family that is filled with love, support and led by God!❤️ I visited one time with a friend and it was such a good message. I also love how the people there are so nice and welcoming. I did notice that with my friend she was struggling with relationships within the church but would never tell me for the sake of her church's reputation and I found that a bit weird. Other than that I enjoyed it. When joining this church I was a little hesitant (because I was raised catholic) but I decided to go and give it a chance and I am so glad I did. Everyone was so welcoming and 10 years (I think) they have become a family. The pastors are amazing. Some of my family members are also apart of the church. If you are looking for a new church you should definitely check out The Way in Brea. 🥰🥰🥰 The Way has opened my eyes to a different way of life. The very first time, the day I walked in the door. I started to experience something different. I have lots to say but I’ll let it out a little at a time. I’ve been catholic for most of my life. What I’ve learned is amazing. I feel like a changed man. You should try it one day🙏🏻 You can feel the sense of community in this place that most giant churches are now lacking. At least that's my humble opinion.

name: The Way Christian Center - Berkeley Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing inclusive and interactive service with an authentic pastor and great worship songs. Pastor Mike is humble yet expertly translated scripture for current day application while also demonstrating a commitment and passion to building strong community inside and outside the church walls. 🙌🏾 Pastor Mike & Pastor T are honorable people  doing God’s work! The congregation have a heart for Jesus, are welcoming like He is, and desire to know and do His will. If you want to experience the love and presence of God. Go to The Way! Every time I think of my Pastor Mike, my McBride family and my The Way family I am reminded of this scripture
“Long ago the LORD said to Israel: “I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love. With unfailing love I have drawn you to myself.” Jeremiah 31:3 I thoroughly enjoyed the service yesterday and plan on returning next Sunday and bringing my mom! I just told her I feel like this is what church should be. This felt like such a welcoming, inclusive space and I’m so here for it! My husband and I have visited a few times and have had such great experiences. Everyone is very welcoming. The church is very diverse and has a lot of young adult members. The current pastor Michael McBride has a great sense of humor and uses that to make the Word easy to understand and relatable. We will becoming permanent members very soon

name: The Way Church
reviewSummary:
Bilingual service is at 10am on Sunday. Bilingual bible studys on Tuesdays at 7pm. Friendly people and ample parking. We have been attending The Way Church for 2 years now. Our Lord Jesus is definitely in this place. The love the pastors have for the people is genuine. The services, teachings and fellowship we have experienced with the brethren have been a true blessing for me and my family.

Hebrews 10:24-25
24 And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds,
25 not giving up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another—and all the more as you see the Day approaching. I’ve probably been to (English) services at The Way 10-15x.  The music is beautiful and truly invites the spirit. The sermons are powerful and relevant to today. Each time I’ve left feeling closer to Christ. The Way Church is wonderful! The Pastor loves and cares about people! You can truly feel free to worship and praise and yell, "Hallelujah! To God be the Glory!" I attend Sunday services there at 11am. We have been going there for years. We love the Pastors...it service in Spanish with English translation. It fits our families needs.

name: The Way Family Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I attended this church hoping to hear solid biblical teaching, and while the pastor did teach God’s Word, his preaching style was overwhelmingly loud and emotional. Instead of drawing our attention to Scripture, the constant yelling and dramatic delivery made it difficult to concentrate on the actual message.

Passion is one thing, but this felt excessive and distracting. To us, it came across as disingenuous and more like an emotional performance than thoughtful preaching. We left feeling that the delivery overshadowed the message itself. We were looking for a church where the focus was on clearly teaching God’s Word in a way that encouraged reflection, and unfortunately, this wasn’t that experience for us. AMAZING CHURCH!! The Bible is preached boldly, worship is powerful, and the tangible presence of God is at this church! Everyone treats you like family and is so friendly! The Pastors are the REAL DEAL and are so loving/genuine! They also have great ministries for children, youth, and young adults! I am so blessed to have found this place! Thank you Jesus! If you are looking for a Holy Spirit filled church, you have to visit here! There’s truly no place like The Way!
The Spirit of God is so evident here—every time I walk in, I feel His presence. The preaching is passionate, Spirit-led, and most importantly, grounded in the Word of God. If you’re looking to encounter Jesus in a real and powerful way, this is the place. I love it here!! I’ve never felt so at home! Walking through the doors and stepping into the sanctuary I’m filled with such joy and peace. This church is so special! From the amazing Pastors to the wonderful people who serve here. Worship and the word of God is so anointed! Please go and check it out yourself. My mom, my sister, and I have been impacted by this church in more ways than I can describe. I found this church on Instagram after just recently moving to Murrieta. My family was dealing with the sudden loss of my father and we were looking for a new church to call home. When we first came to a Sunday service, we knew that this is where we were supposed to be. The powerful worship, the passionate biblical preaching, and the loving community is a breath of fresh air. I’ve experienced the power of God in a way I never had before. I am so thankful for The Way and know that God is doing something AMAZING here! If you’re looking for a great Holy Spirit filled church, come visit!

name: The Way of Life Church - Rancho Cordova Campus
reviewSummary:
The Lord sent us to this church and when I tell you beloved that the Lord, was moving like wild fire in there. This body of believers are so amazing, kind, warm, welcoming and loving. They truly let the Lord, have his way and the preach word was so on point. I loved it !!! We felt right at home. If you are looking for a church home were you can feel God's presence and hear the true word of God so you can grow. This will help change your life, so  gone go in and allow the Lord, to do bigger and greater things with you, to you, for you and in you. Until next time church. Be blessed. M4M Life💃🏿🎉🥰🔥✌🏿 Bless these people they are amazing providing community with excellent food What a wonderful place to worship. Amazing that God walks beside you in the pews
Highly recommended First time there last night. Missed the sermon but heard it packed a punch. Participated in the dinner which was superb! Tons of turkey, stuffing, beans, rice stuff, the works. I shouldn't have skipped the pie. Awesome people new to me. Mike, Dave, Linda, Pete and his lady I think was named Cathryn, and many I didn't get to meet but seemed nice enough. I was told to come back and I think I will... We love our pastor and this church.
They truly have a labor of love here.
All are welcome!
Come as you are and receive His spirit!

name: The Well - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
This is truly a house of the Lord! To walk through the doors of The Well is to feel loved!. We love the pastors, we love the congregation and yes… we are Jewish! We have had meals in their beautiful  Succah, we have joined the wonderful Passover Seders and we are honored to have attended the most memorable Yom Ha’Shoah services. The Well is a family treasure in Poway. Soooo what can I say about The Well... I'm am biased, so I'll just put that out there!!❤ My husband and I are the Pastors, so why am I giving it 5 stars 🌟 you may ask? I'm giving it the highest rating because of the people!!! The folk at the Well are kind and genuine!❤ We come from very different backgrounds and ethnic groups but we love one another!❤ We translate into Spanish for our Spanish speakers and even though I'm African American and my husband is white,  we have folk from South Korea, Philippines 🇵🇭, China, Mexico 🇲🇽, Netherlands 🇳🇱 and America 🇺🇸 we are one! name: The Well Church - Boulder Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Chase and Pastor Matt are faithful men of God. I regularly listen to their teaching and deeply appreciate their commitment to equipping men to reclaim the culture for Christ. Boulder needs godly leaders who boldly preach and faithfully teach the gospel, and these pastors do exactly that with clarity and conviction.

If you are a young man or woman looking for solid biblical leadership, I strongly encourage you to attend The Well Church. Pastors Chase and Matt will guide you in sound doctrine, biblical order within the household, and Christ-centered headship. Most importantly, they will faithfully lead you in the Way—Jesus Christ Himself. The Well is a friendly and warm church that has modern music and well delivered sermons. I’ve attended three services here with my children and will likely return after we go see a few more churches in the area.

The only reason that I did not give it five stars was that I think they could do a little more to welcome new folks by having some prepared talking points or handouts. This is not a major issue but just something that could be improved. I’m an outgoing guy and there are folks standing on the steps that greet you so that is great.  However, when I asked questions about the kids program and core church beliefs, the answers seemed somewhat off the cuff. Not dishonest in any way, just not thought out in advance.

If folks are church shopping (like me), it is nice to get concise and consistent responses when asking questions vs feeling like you are getting one persons honest take.

That said, everyone was very friendly and I even found folks that were willing to have open minded and respectful discussions about a particular area where I disagree with their take on who can serve in leadership. For me, it is critical to be able to talk with folks openly about things we disagree on without being disagreeable.

Diversity: Some other reviews stated that there was not a lot of diversity in the congregation. I did not find this to be the case. There were young and old, including many young kids, and people of all different skin colours. Personally, I don’t care about how diverse a group of people is. I only care that all are welcome and no one is discriminated against based on their immutable characteristics. I have seen no signs of discrimination at The Well.

The music: wonderful modern music with guitar, keyboard, and sometimes other instruments. This is very different from the traditional pipe organ and choir that I was raised on, and I love it. It feels wonderful to sing praise songs with the rest of the congregation that have contemporary style melodies and rhythms.

Sermons: I have kids so I’ll lead with: the sermons are not overly long. This might sound minor, but the way we develop future generations in their love of the Lord is to make church an enjoyable experience. 1 hour sermons just don’t work for kids. The sermons at The Well are 20-30 minutes in length and thus far have gone through specific chapters in the Bible. They then touch how those teachings relate to modern life. TBH this is exactly what I want from my sermons. Translating the scripture into living in the modern world.

Politics: Despite what other reviewers have written, I have not seen any specific calls for political action of a partisan nature. The closest thing was embracing previously established national days of prayer. I’ve met folks from all political affiliations there and none have been aggressive or argumentative about particular issues. I’d say all are welcome is the bottom line here.

The building: bright and clean. It is great to see what they have done with the church that used to be there. The main hall is big and bright and the lower level is very nicely laid out. They are a bit sparse on decorations. Not as many crosses or scripture quotes on the wall as I would expect, but overall it feels good to be there.

Overall, I really like this place and look forward to coming back. The Well is one of the best churches in the Boulder, CO area. How do I define what makes a great church?
1. Preaches the gospel, truth, and grace
2. Desires for people to know and glorify Christ
3. Smaller community groups that meet regularly, and upfront/easy ways to get connected
4. Pastors that genuinely care about you as a person, your growth, lavishing you in truth and grace, and spurring you on in your faith
5. AMAZING musical worship on Sundays
6. Connection points throughout the week
7. Welcoming atmosphere for believers + non-believers
8. People have FUN together
9. "Church" happens not just on Saturday mornings
10. People desire to see other people know God - a church that is missional in it's area
.... I guess that's what I mean when I say that The Well is a great church. If you’re looking for a biblically sound church with caring leadership and good preaching this is the church for you. The most loving pastors are those who faithfully deliver the whole counsel of God including the difficult parts! You will grow and be blessed being apart of this family of believers. Not very welcoming or friendly. Insular. In doing more research, I wonder if it’s because they are not liked by the community. Maybe that has led them to be paranoid and distrustful of new people. Or maybe it’s just the personality of the church community. Regardless, it’s not a pleasant. Went to Calvary and felt very welcomed.They seem like part of the larger Boulder community, as well, so maybe that’s why.

reviewSummary: I think we found our church I haven't been to church in over 10 years and my brother is pastor so that should tell you alot i guess i've been looking for the right church and I think I found it we we're invited to a Halloween party here and it was so much fun Everybody was so nice and sweet It really moved me so much so that I had to come say hi today for the first time our car broke down so we didn't have a car for 3 weeks but I said the minute that I do we are going to church it was such a pleasant time today everybody we talked to is so nice and the service was amazing this pastor is good 👍  we loved his message today it resonated with both of us and our son had so much fun everything was beautiful organized they had such a good system We love it the youth volunteers get the biggest praise from me today 🙌  they watched my son for me for the entire service it was a blessing the ladies were so nice I'll definitely be coming back next week because of how amazing they treated my son and I really appreciate who ever stoped by our house from church and left us note welcoming us to the church that was amazing i've never had a church ever come to my house that meant a lot to us see so we'll definitely be seeing you all next Sunday it was a 10 /10 experience i recommend this church to everybody in las vegas it is truly magical ✨️ I've been praying for 4 years for a new church home and church family and today I found it! name: The Well Church - Rock Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
I didn't hate it but I wished for more.
I wished Jesus truly had the heart of his people. I wish people lived the way they behave in Church. It's different when you can see through or into people and things. The presence of God is felt, not dramatized. The presence of God transforms. It is not  just a feel -good feeling.
God wishes for more for this church.
I pray that God strengthens whoever the intercessor for this church is ,because this church could change the city if God gets to have His way in the secret lives of his people. The well church failed to add another post stating the toy give away would be at 8, but instead kept the old post up stating that they would be open 10am-2pm. When me and my best friend arrived we saw a note on the door stating that they started at 8 because of the cold weather. Now mind you it is Dec.  and it is the upstate of SC. and we arrived at 9:35 am . People should have received nothing
until the time that was posted. This was so sad cause we were truly in need, along with others who came on time This experience truly broke my heart. A specific time was posted for this toy giveaway, and many families including myself planned our entire day and work schedules around it. To arrive and find out the doors were opened two hours early without any announcement was incredibly upsetting.

I had to change my work schedule to make it, only to possibly miss out because of poor communication. I even saw someone sitting in their car crying, and that moment alone says everything about how this was handled.

This wasn’t just “poor planning.” It was careless and hurtful. When you’re dealing with families who are already struggling, communication matters. People were counting on this

When I tried to respectfully express how wrong this was and how it affected people, the response I received from the young black man was, “tell me how.” There was no empathy, no understanding just dismissal.

This was supposed to be a moment of giving, compassion, and community. Instead, it left people feeling unseen and hurt. I truly hope this church reflects on this and does better, because situations like this matter more than some may realize. My first experience with this church was not a pleasant one.. and unfortunately this was some people's first experience with a church at all. Despite advertising publicly about a Christmas giveaway, dozens of people showed up at the posted time only to find out they decided to open early and there was nothing left. Many people spent money on rideshare, others gas, all of us spent time. Only for it to be wasted. The church needs to do better. I've been a member since late 2016, and I wouldn't have it any other way! Pastor Mo and Pastor K are THE SAME!! Meaning they're consistent!! They care about and love on their members like no other. reviewSummary: This was my very 1st time going here & this place IS NICE! I love the play area for the kids!! It’s hard to find a church that doesn’t fall into a norm of what every other church is doing and The Well definitely set apart! The sermons are very indepth and the worship before and after the sermon are always very deep. The close knit community and one on oneness at The Well is a plus as well. If you're looking for a more mature church to deepen your walk with Christ and not just a hobby on the weekend, this is the one.

My family and I have been connected through a Community Group and Discipleship Group and we feel right at home! Christ-centered teaching, Spirit lead singing, and Missionary-minded individuals is what describes this church best! We have had a great experience at this church! Everyone has been so welcoming, they preach through the bible which is important to us, and the kids program is a great blend of fun for the kids and solid bible teaching. Definitely recommend checking it out! The Well has honestly been an answer to prayer for me. That might seem small, but for someone like me who tends to stay in the background, it has made me feel genuinely seen and welcome.

One of the things I appreciate most is how Pastor Al and Pastor Alex walk through the Bible book by book and verse by verse. The teaching is clear, faithful, and easy to follow, and it has helped me understand scripture in a much deeper way. This church truly feels like home to me now. I feel comfortable, cared for, and part of a real family, even as a quieter person. I genuinely look forward to Sundays, they’ve honestly become the highlight of my week. If you’re looking for a Christ-centered church that teaches the Bible clearly and welcomes you with open arms, I highly recommend it here.

name: The Well SGV - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
I am so glad to have visited The Well SGV today. For the record, I have no history or personal affiliation with this church. I walked through the doors this morning as a completely random first time visitor who only found this church through Yelp...

But what I found surprised me.

I found a new church plant that started merely 3 months ago. I found smiling faces and heart for Jesus and new visitors like me. Very little effort was needed on my part as I was immediately greeted by Peggie at the Greeters Table. Introductions and laughter were shared. Then directly after service, Peggie led Pastor David right to my wife and I so we could meet and shake hands with him... I had great conversations with Pastor David and Pastor Rick. And another shout out to Wilson and Annie for your warm welcome.

While this is a new church plant and might lack a few of the bells and whistles of more established churches. They preach the gospel in a real and approachable way here. The Well SGV has all the heart without all the pretense. They care, without caring who you are, or where you come from. And I appreciate that.

This church aims to be multi-ethnic and multi-generational and I hope that will come to fruition. But as it stands right now, most of the congregation seem to be of Asian descent. I really only point that out so anyone visiting can get a glimpse of what to expect on your visit.

Wrapping up, I understand that this is less of a review and more of a recounting of my first time visit. But I hope this recounting takes away any anxiousness you might feel walking into a new church for the first time. And I hope this helps you on your journey to find a body of believers you can call home.

I absolutely plan to visit again. And you should too... Started going here since August 2023 and it’s crazy how time flies! Everyone here is so welcoming and I feel like I’ve found my family.

There’s free lunches every Sunday which has been great to get to meet individuals. There’s also plenty of parking!

The preaching is very theologically sound and pastor David is extremely kind and humble. I love going to Well because everyone is so warm and loving. I felt the brotherly love. The atmosphere is very joyful. Pastor David ‘s sermon is so rewarding and powerful and he is very humble and gentle and always preaching the truth of god’s word. It is a very blessing place to learn and get to know Jesus! This is a new church plant in the SGV area. It's a multi-ethnic, multi-generational, gospel-centered church. We meet on Sundays at 10 AM at the Arcadia Community Center. Come join us for worship. All are welcome! Every member at The Well SGV is so nice and welcoming! Even though the community just started, it really feels like a family. We welcome all to checking us out :)
