name: The Woodlands Christian Church - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary: Definitely don't recommend if you are actually a Christian. The pastor is not. She already closed down another church before this one and it's looking like she's  doing the same to this one. Very sad. Heart felt worship, love my christian brothers&sisters in Christ Jesus. Great job pastor. Our quilt ministry led me to make this quilt for the Youth Mission Fund.  I hope it goes well at the Auction this weekend Best place to go for NA meetings at 6:30pm on Tuesdays and 8pm Friday's They allow us to use the meeting room for scout events without charging us.

name: The Word Center - Jackson Campus
reviewSummary: I cannot say enough about The Word Center. Pastor Rich delivered the word in such a way where my 16-year-old and 5-year-old daughters were fully engaged the entire time. The choir was amazing and had us continuously singing along! This was my family's first visit, but it definitely won't be our last. We've been searching for a new church home and may have found it. Again, thank you Pastor Rich for such as amazing experience. You will soon outgrow this location and God have a new location with more space with your name on it. Until then, continue to give us the word as you were directed by our God to do! I love this church ! I joined it over 5 years ago after dating them for 3 years . I wanted to make sure this was the right church home for me and it's the BEST decision I've made spiritually . They are very active in the community and with the public . Their youth is always involved and they serve anywhere need be . Wise leadership coupled with the kindest folks you ever met. The first lady is so sweet! Service is always great.  The greeters make you feel so welcomed. Great place to worship. Bible based teaching and real life learning.

name: The Word Church, Ashburn, VA
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming atmosphere. Bible study and Sunday Worship services are interactive with easy to understand teaching. I love how the word was delivered. Wonderful praise & worship team. Very friendly & loving team.
I felt at home here. The holy spirit is here. Thank youto all. One of the best places of worship in the N.VA area. Friendly, welcoming and loving people. I would suggest this ministry to anyone in the area. Always enjoy the Word, Praise & Worship and Fellowship My church home

name: The Worldwide Christian Center Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I joined the Worldwide Christian Center Church Jan. 1, 2020. I joined because Dr. Pastor O'Neil Dozier is teaching the Holy uncompromising words of God. The Pastor and the assistant Pastors are all on one accord with the teachings of God's Holy Words. The church meets Wednesdays at 7:30pm and Sundays at 11am, the scriptures are broken down into its simplest form for understanding and translated back into Hebrew for the Old Testament and Greek for the New Testament. The church Minister of music is a awesome brother who loves the Lord,  you can feel the love in his heart as he sing God's anorting songs each week. If you want Soul Food for your Spirit and you're ready to fall in love with your Saviour Jesus Christ than this is the house you need to be in! Amen There are not many Pastors that teach uncompromising Word of God . Dr Dozier teach the truth lead by Holy Spirit . If you're ready to grow spiritually this church is a open Bible teaching. Truly a bible based church where everyone is like family. This is a great place to fellowship and hear the word of God. Here there is "Preaching for reaching " the least and the lost.

name: theeffect church - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
I just wanted to tell all at  theeffect how much I love all of you. So many of us have been given hope from despair and delivered from  desperation and set free through your faith ministry  and finding God and our savior Jesus.  You gave us a place to be at peace and find love and share love with all of you.

I am so blessed, as many other before me and now are, that you share your love with us.

God was thinking of you when he created us.  LOVE you foever

John The Effect is a very warm ,  friendly and genuine place.  Dave is an amazing pastor portraying a loving God.  You learn more on what Jesus really said and how he was understood in by 1st century Hebrews.  The atmosphere is very accepting and it is all about how we can continue to transform. Leaving someone better than when you first met them.  Learning to live in the moment rather than regretting the past or worrying about the future. The effect church has become an integral part of my life. I love the welcoming and warm atmosphere, the exceptional live music, and Pastor Dave’s inspiring and thought provoking messages. It’s a place of peace, love, and friendship. My relationship with the Lord has grown and matured. The effect has proven to be a one of a kind experience that I cherish. We have been attending this church regularly for a few years now. Our kids love it, and get disappointed if we're not able to go.  The music is amazing and the feeling that everyone is accepted just as they are is something that can't be beat. I love Dave's style of teaching instead of preaching, he presents information and invites you to take your own spiritual journey, by striping away the things you thought you knew about God and Jesus, bringing it back to the core, and starting new by finding purpose and new way of living life. It's never a bottled message. After attending a mega church for 27 years, this was a refreshing and needed change. The homey, "come as you are" atmosphere immediately put my soul at ease. After 5 years of attending theeffect, I can truly say that personal transformation has occurred in a way I never experienced before or ever dreamed possible. The message Pastor Dave delivers never fails to resonate in a deep heart-felt way and the worship team consistently rocks! Love this place!

name: Theophilus Orthodox Presbyterian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: coming from India, I wanted to find a church that is biblical and multi-cultural.  I found that church with Theophilus.  The wonderful diversity of brothers and sisters in the Lord reminds me of heaven, every time I am in worship. I like everything about this body of Christ-Church Theophilus. Worship every lord's day with the Christ centered sermon, hymns and fellowship with all the church member, Grateful to God for this church. Very welcoming local church rooted in reformed theology - always a blessing to worship here! People there are friendly and easy to talk to. I like the sermons especially because they are Christ centered Reformed and Christ-centered worship.  Friendly and welcoming fellowship.

name: Third Church of Christ, Scientist - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
People are friendly but they just read everything from a pamphlet including the sermon in a very slow monotonous way.

However the Plus point is they read only verses from the Bible even for the sermon. Lovely and kind people to worship with! Consider joining this church for your personal relationship development with God. Beautiful Church, beautiful people. These people really take Christianity seriously. they understand how prayer works. Very friendly loving people, who care about their neighbors, and love the Bible's relevancy in their lives. As a Christian Scientist I must praise this church for being a pretty  good venue for a particular Christmas musical concert  some time ago!

name: Third Coast Church - Corpus Christi Campus
reviewSummary:
Went for Easter Sunday at the 10:30 am service. Has a great worship team, I loved the music. I also liked the message during the actual service. But nobody spoke to me or my mom at all. The social aspect isn't the best. The building is beautiful and I love the stained glass cross. It is a smaller church but has the feel of a megachurch, especially socially. My mom and I did not feel welcome. My wife and I found this church through a friend and it's been great! The community is welcoming and feels like a big family. Pastor Joe is awesome and preaches straight from the Bible, explaining the context of a passage before diving into it and teaching. We've been going here for over a year now and have found deep fellowship with one of the many community groups within the church. Love getting to walk through life with people who are down to earth and want to know Jesus! Awesome place for worship.
My family (wife a 3 kids) has been going since Sept 2017. The people are very welcoming and there’s always great coffee and pastries!
Messages from Pastor Joe.... always on point. We absolutely LOVE visiting TCC! Very family atmosphere. Pastor Joe is compassionate about teaching God's Word. Secure location. Can't wait to go back! What happened to the steeple?? IS  it being repaired?.. I live behind the football field..love it.. I hope it's going back on..

name: Three Creeks Church - Gahanna Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for about a year and a half, and I can’t say enough good things. The gospel is faithfully preached, the community is well-supported, and there’s a clear focus on helping people get connected. If you’re searching for a new church, I highly recommend giving this one a try! We love Three Creeks Church for the caring community, engaging kids program and Bible-based teaching. My entire family loves this community! What a joy it is to walk through life with people who really care about you and your walk with Jesus. We also love the worship experience we get to have each Sunday with beautiful music that help us praise our God! I can’t believe how much my kids love attending this church. Could not recommend Three Creeks church enough! We’ve been here a year and found such great community. Something we looked for in a church for a long time! The most wholesome human beings who just want to support you and your family well. Joel teaches straight from the Bible. The church is a great size and perfect for young families! First time I went to Three Creeks, I was immediately grabbed by 1-2 other people and introduced around after service. This was the first time at any church this has happened and made me immediately feel comfortable and connected.

Joel is the best combination of pastor and teacher. Him and his family go out of their way to check in on you and pour into you.

The congregation are all down to earth people who love God and want to serve others.

Highly recommend you check it out! This has been my church for almost 7 years and I love it so much! I have seen it grow through good times and challenging times , and the Lord finds a way to make His path clear for Three Creeks Church. Every team does their best to make newcomers feel welcome and our kids ministry is AMAZING. I love Three Creeks and wouldn’t go anywhere else :)

name: Thrive Christian Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: This church does have a welcoming atmosphere in that they don't judge, but they are also not too friendly in a cult-like sort of way. They allow you to be as open as you'd want to be. They observe the Lord's communion every Sunday. The teachings are, for the most part, pretty standard for conservative churches. Music is a bit loud, but the minister here is very practical and down to earth. Overall, a pretty decent church. I attended one Sunday just to appease the person that invited me, and I slowly begin falling in love with the church. The people are genuine, down to earth, and have become like family to me after a year, and I truly look forward to attending each Sunday. It's a great place for those looking for a church that isn't massive, where you can get to know most of the people that attend, and that makes you feel inclusive with opportunities to connect during services and social gatherings.

name: Thrive Christian Church - Westfield Campus
reviewSummary: Great place for kids school. It is great service! God bless you. Great people and love the new building. Great, honest people with good hearts! Couldn't feel more at home than at Thrive Christian Church.

name: Thrive Church - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing place to feel welcomed and hear the word of God ..I leave with the holy Spirit every time Pastor Steve and DJ really help deepen your connection with God's word and His Son Lovely church. Positive friendly people. Great experience Such a welcoming and inviting church. A beautiful blend of what heaven looks like. Pastor Steve and Mrs. Maureen are the most loving and caring people I’ve ever met.🥹 I love this church! It’s an awesome mix of people, amazing youth program and non-denominational. They have great outreach to get involved in like prison ministry, they’ve been helping Asheville nc from the hurricane and there’s a lot of other ministries to get involved in. The Pastors are awesome and very kind! Definitely a blessing and definitely recommend it! Beautiful Holy Spirit led  worship too and fun life groups!

name: Thrive Church - Santa Rosa Campus
reviewSummary:
I love being here lisening to the word of God, serving here and worshipping the Lord together as one. If you are looking for a place to know the Lord, fellowship and find some wonderful people, look no further. You will feel welcome and like you belong.
Located in the old House of Rock, building off of Industrial. But transformed into an amazing place. As DJ Rockalot I performed for a super cute Daddy Daughter dance here, my photo booth was a hit and they killed it with the decor! Christ Tabernacle is a wonderful, family church, where everyone who enters it feels loved and part of the family on the first visit. The worship is powerful, modern, and relevant. The word hits dead on every Sunday, speaking to the new Christians, and the seasoned believers.  Our family have been members there for 14 years. We were engaged, baptized, married, and have had all three of our kids there.  We have a personal relationship with the pastoral family, and know when we have an illness, tragedy, or a victory, they will be with us praying and celebrating.  Our church family is truly a family. There seems to be more and more younger families joining our congregation, which is fun to see and be a part of since we are still a growing family ourselves.  We love Christ Tabernacle, affectionetly termed CT. CT is full of wonderful people who love Jesus. The church has been so kind, encouraging, and supportive of my wife, kids, and I. I am especially grateful for their willingness to let us jump in and help serve our community. Pastor Nick and Dana are terrific leaders who continue their family's legacy of love for Santa Rosa. I always look forward to hearing sermons and what my kids did in Sunday School. Look forward to building more relationships and walking with God with CT! Such a good community and family. Wonderful music and people. Love the Pastor and his wife, the father who founded the church, and the loving and welcoming spirit. I am super new, shopped around, and feel like I found a home.

name: Thrive Church CA - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church! Everyone is so nice and welcoming. Our first day attending one of the pastors introduced himself, gave us a tour, and introduced us to several other people.  We got connected instantly. Everyone was open, genuine, and Christ-like.

The pastors are very approachable and friendly. They’re always out in the lobby talking to people and not hidden and “untouchable”. They preach biblical truths. Nothing else. Just the Gospel in a fun and simple way. I’ve personally grown so much since attending. And my marriage and relationship with my kids has improved.

Their Kids Ministry doesn’t get enough credit. It’s amazing and the pastors and congregation care DEEPLY about the next generation. My two kids love attending every week. My kids were upset about going on a weekend beach trip recently because they didn’t want to miss church.

I recommend giving it a try. This place is special! Thrive is one of those churches you walk into and are immediately welcomed and loved on by multiple people. My experience, so far has been nothing but preaching of the Bible, genuine interactions, and deep, meaningful connections with other christian believers,  that want nothing but the best for me. This church is home, and more than that it’s a place I grow closer to Jesus. The Holy Spirit lives here. It shows up here. And makes itself known. This church is something special.

The people here are real, welcoming, and just full of joy. There’s a strong sense of community, and it all feels genuine from the moment you walk in.

The worship is powerful—it moves you deeply. I’ve teared up more than once (in the best way). The messages are thoughtful, honest, and always seem to speak directly to what I need that week.

And okay—have you ever yelled "WOO HOO" in church? Because we do! We cheer for the reading of the Word every Sunday. It’s alive, exciting, and full of celebration.

This place is full of joy, depth, and authenticity. I’m so grateful I found it. So much LIFE at this church. Biblical teaching. Lot's of encouragement to grow and be spurred on (without just making it about guilting everyone for every area they fall short). Friendly people from all walks of life.
Definitely recommend Amazing Church with  a simple approach to being a Christian; Simple-Fun-Real. We have been attending for almost 2 years now and absolutely have fallen in love with Thrive. Great Pastor/Leaders, and the Church Family is great. Music is solid, the Kids program is strong and we love attending. Worth checking out.

name: Thrive LA Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Thrive offers a very open, caring and welcome atmosphere. If you're looking for a place to connect and thrive, I recommend checking out one of the services. Thrive is such an inclusive & wonderful place to fellowship and learn about having a relationship with Christ. So much LOVE ❣️ It's hard to find family in LA.

name: Timberlake Church
reviewSummary:
Love this Church. Lance and Dave are the BEST! I’m so grateful to have found this place. I feel like it’s extremely easy to connect with so many great people. My kids love to serve during the service with the younger kids. Does not teach from the word of God, promotes positive feel good messages at the sake of the biblical gospel, and gutting all aspects of repentance, denial of self, and submitting to Christ. Matthew 10:34-39, parable of the sower, parable of the rich young ruler, and the entirety of 1 John are in direct opposition to the comfortable and superficial faith taught at this church. When you remove the offense of the gospel for the sake of seeker sensitive pragmatism, you end up winning people by appealing to their flesh and apart from the true reality of Christ 2 Timothy 4:3-4. Our family has been attending Timberlake for a long time. We find the church welcoming and warm, with a wide range of offerings for all ages and stages of life, while remaining biblically sound. When they were at that age, both our kids liked the junior high and high school programs, and my wife is especially fond of the music. The teaching is lively and delivers timely and important messages without being preachy or condemning. Give it a try! The picture below is from a student ministry's production of "The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe." My family and I have been attending and joining online for the past five years. We truly appreciate and support all that Timberlake does for the community and neighboring countries. We will continue to listen to God’s Word alongside like-minded brothers and sisters. Thank you, Timberlake, for always making everyone feel welcome, safe, and included. Timberlake church has been a blessing to me and my little tribe ( my 3 kids) since day 1. Every message seems to be written especially for us. I have 3 teens under same roof, and through Timberlake Church Gd guides me and inspires my children and I.  My two girls (17 &16 ) and my boy (13) love to listen to pastor Dave. The way he teaches is amazing and young and no so young can relate to the messages. So every time we have attended from the last 2 years have been a great experience.
But let me tell you about today,  today,  the service for " Empty Chairs" was a message straight to my heart. Over 10 years of having lost my father, I never felt so understood. The fact they planned and purposely acknowledge the lost, and the grief so many of us are going through during the holidays,  is just Gd showing up. We need to open our eyes and heart, and receive Gd. Thank you Timberlake Church, THANK YOU Pastor Dave. May Gd continue to bless you and guard you in company of your family and loved ones. ❤️🙏

name: Timberline Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
When pastor Derry retired, I thought it would be hard to replace him. He had been there so long and so many people went there to hear his sermons. I believe they made a great choice in picking Pastor Aaron. The type of energy he brings and the message he shares is priceless. Some people pay to gain that type of knowledge. Timberline church is giving liberally to all who are willing to listen and learn. Open our ears, our minds and our hearts to the beautiful message. Peace happiness and good will to all mankind. May we continue to learn and grow spiritually in Jesus' mighty name Amen In 1974 my family moved to Colorado.  Our kids were 10 years, 5 years, and 5 weeks. Our first Sunday was July 28th,  1974, on Oak and Whitman. First Assembly/Timberline.  Our church has always been there for us.  I am a part timer now as I live in Oklahoma part of the time.   It's the best all around church you can find. God is faithful!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We cannot say enough about Timberline Church and their incredible staff and volunteers. They helped us plan and host a Celebration of Life for over 700 people, and the entire experience was seamless, compassionate, and exceptionally well-run from start to finish.

In the midst of grief, having a team that is calm, organized, and genuinely caring makes all the difference—and Timberline was exactly that. Every detail was handled with professionalism and heart, allowing our family to focus on honoring our loved one rather than worrying about logistics.

They truly are who you want in your corner when planning a funeral or Celebration of Life—whether it’s an intimate gathering or a very large event. The fact that they have a dedicated team and a thoughtfully designed space specifically for these services speaks volumes about their experience and care for families during some of life’s hardest moments.

We are deeply grateful to the entire Timberline team and volunteers for helping us create such a meaningful, beautiful, and smooth event. We felt supported every step of the way, and we will never forget the compassion they showed our family.

Highly recommend without hesitation. This was our second visit here for a funeral of a dear relative.   The pastor is very well spoken and allows the family to arrange the service as they wish. This place is home to me! This is where my life was saved. Mighty Men of Valor men's group is a must attend for all men who are look for a great support and change into true masculinity!

name: Times Square Church
reviewSummary: Vibrant, intergenerational church meeting in the Mark Hellinger Theatre on Broadway, bringing together believers from over 100 nationalities with bold biblical preaching.

name: Times Square Church - New York Campus
reviewSummary: Vibrant, intergenerational church meeting in the Mark Hellinger Theatre on Broadway, bringing together believers from over 100 nationalities with bold biblical preaching.

name: TL Church - Alameda Campus
reviewSummary:
The most AMAZING Christian church where you encounter the Holy Spirit move so POWERFULLY!
If you want to be treated like family, have a positive and powerful message that will uplift your spirit and enhance your relationship with God, then this is the place you want to visit and very likely decide this is a Church you want to call yours. Pastor Adriano is amazing and always speaks truth. Pastor Adriano messages delivers incredible value that will improve your life and the lives of others through the power of the Holy Spirit. The entire staff is a group of beautiful souls ready to serve you with a smile. The worship music is incredible as well! Very blessed to call this my church home! This is a place where true transformation and salvation happens as you encounter God in a way like no other. These people are my kind of people who have a true passion for Christ and will welcome you in love with open arms. Cozy environment and wonderful people.
TLC a place that goes beyond teaching the word of God, but a place where you can finds help into deliverance and transformation through the love of Jesus Christ. Great church I recommend it the people are so welcoming. They are real and genuine.

name: Together Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary: The people at this church are so friendly and authentic.  From walking through the doors to the cafe area to the worship center.  No pretentious attitudes.  Just real people worshipping a real God! Came to visit this church had a very nice individual his name is David W I want to put his full last name in here I believe they call him Big d that's his nickname very nice guy made me feel very welcome the safety team seem to be very nice make me feel very safe only thing I didn't like which is two things the parking was a little challenging due to several businesses on the property and the greeters team to be a little pushy with wanting us to fill out a newcomer card and giving personal information right from the get-go if I go to a church I kind of like to go for a timer to you before I get out a bunch of information don't know if churches or businesses sell my information LOL other than that was a very good experience would be nice if they had automatic openers on some of their doors to make it easier when you're in a mobility device but overall it was a very good experience and David went above and beyond but making sure that we got everything we needed and he doesn't walk that well himself LOL I was looking for a place of worship and found this nice homy church with beautiful people inside. I spoke with a brother there and ask him to pray for me and he was so nice and took his time to pray for me. God bless you Tim. I also met Tom outside and we had a wonderful conversation in the Lord. God bless you all as the body of Christ. Greetings from Texas. I really enjoyed my experience attending Rock Church for the first time, and listening to Pastor Dale share the word. His delivery was passionate and easy to follow and understand. The other members of the church were kind and welcoming. During the service, they had some great musical entertainment which came across as heartfelt and inspiring. I really enjoyed how it felt like a family atmosphere and I am looking forward to the next service. I also attended the Wednesday night bible study, and that was a great experience as well. If you like an easy going church, without all the "extra" commentary, this is the place to hear the word. See you Sunday! Rock Church has been a welcoming place for us to attend church. We have found the people to be friendly and genuine. The sermons challenge us to seek God in our daily lives. We always leave with conversation points for the drive home.  In addition to the Sunday service, we have become involved in the men's and women's ministries. It's wonderful to be loved by our church family.

name: Torrance Community Church of Christ - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
A True Blessing and a Welcoming Family! Joining this church community about a month ago has been such a wonderful blessing in my life. From day one, the pastor and his wife have been unbelievably kind and welcoming, and the entire congregation feels like a real, caring family. I was recently baptized here, and I cannot express how grateful I am to have found this home.
I look forward to coming every single week, whether it's diving deeper into the Word during Friday night Bible study or worshipping together on Sunday morning. If you are looking for a place filled with love, warmth, and genuine faith, I can't recommend this church enough. I am so happy and deeply grateful to be a part of this community! 🥰🥰🥰 Lovely welcoming church with kind people, great sermons and their eyes  fixated on God. I have been searching for a local church where I would feel comfortable and be able to have fellowship with a mixed congregation - there are people from all races, states and backgrounds which I love. I'm from the UK so for me, it was crucial I found a place that was multicultural and accepting. Nobody make comments about my accent and I wasnt questioned about what i was doing there etc etc.

The leader Marcus and his wife are extremely personable and friendly, Marcus delivers sermons with ease and passion. His desire to know God is reflected through his teachings and it comes from a pure heart. He is even inspiring me in that he urges me to want to know the lord more not just turn up to church on sundays.

There is a bible study on wednesdays at 4.30 pm which lasts an hour and a half and another one at 9 am before church service on sundays. After church service finishes there is a room at the back where people go to share a coffee or piece of cake. Some people bring homemade cakes and it's a fantastic opportunity to naturally meet and get to know members of the congregation.

I recommend this church for all ages. It's a good place to go if you are starting out your journey with the lord or want to know more or follow a calling you have. Excellent service. Everyone is so friendly and the worship is lovely, looking forward to visiting again when i’m in town. Me and my family love coming to church every Sunday and for mid week bible study. The minister brother Marcus Lyons has simplified the LORDS word in his sermons and brought much more understanding of the scriptures to me and my family. He has taught us to handle everything with love and patience. The congregation has shown us a lot of love and has shared their wisdom. They have started a children's worship class, and the teacher has made the experience fun for my daughter well learning at the same time. Thank you Torrance Church of Christ for helping me and my family grow Spiritually. Church of Christ is a place with good people who have kind hearts!
LATELY they have put a lot of prayer & effort into making the place welcoming for new attendees & you can really feel the love flowing through there. The residents are down to earth and very kind, they make you feel like part of the family from the get go. Highly Recommend.

name: Torrance First Baptist Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to a very nice concert here yesterday and it was really good I grew up with the senior pastor, a real solid good guy who loves God’s word, easy to talk to and has 20+ years of ministry experience. His wife and daughters are stellar!! People who are friendly and available to others. I only visited once bc I live an hour away but everyone there was very friendly to me. My teenagers went to the youth group and I have to say, it was their first time really feeling welcomed at a youth group. They said other youth groups are nice to you it seems out of it being the right thing to do, with this youth group it felt more genuine. Both the JR High pastor and the HS pastor and staff were quick to introduce themselves and invite the teens in. I heard the Jr High pastor saying that he was excited my daughter had came, then per her afterwards, worked quick to include her, she was on the verge of backing out and leaving even though she knew someone there already, but afterwards she went on about her time. The HS group hangs out after the actual meeting time, they like being together. Neither group is real big, many were on vacation I think when I viste also.
The buildings are old and beautiful, people are the church but the sanctuary is something to see- has a big pipe organ.
There are open and meeting while trying to do what they feel the Lord would want during this pandemic time. If you don’t have a mask, they will give you one, but people also come first if you know what I mean. I haven’t attended their adult services but I would like to and I’m thinking my teens are worth driving an hour so to get good Bible teaching and like minded peer interaction. Tfb is my new home church and I love it. Everyone is so warm and friendly and welcomed me with open arms. Pastor Charlie's sermons are timely and thought-provoking. Thank you TFB The location is convenient. The people are pretty friendly and welcoming. Small parking lot, but this church isn't very large nor packed. Low on young people. Props to Michael, Carla, Pastor Matt, Rog, and Alex. Very inclusive atmosphere,everyone is welcome.Bible based sermons,with classes for all ages .Music covers all the bases,from hymns to contemporary and even some choir music.Your sure to find a place here.

Very inclusive atmosphere,everyone is welcome.Bible based sermons,with classes for all ages .Music covers all the bases,from hymns to contemporary and even some choir music.Your sure to find a place here.

name: Torrance First Presbyterian Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Real Church.
True Christians.
A community that pursues holiness. They have a Korean school and the teachers are very kind. Good church ever. Pretty good Korean Presbyterian church

name: Torrance New Life Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter was searching for a church to attend and praying for guidance. ‘One day, she told me, this is the place where the Lord is showing me to attend’. That is how we joined the congregation, there we felt the moving of the Holy Spirit and the love of the pastor and congregation. I praise the
Lord for guiding us to New Life Church. I had so much fun with Jesus.  I got healed.  The best time ever at a church.  Magnificent people of God.  God bless you all.  ❤️ My family and I attend and serve at this beautiful church!.

I thank the Lord Jesus Christ for saving me and turning my life around at a time when all hope was lost. It's this very church where my family and I heard the gospel for the very first time.
Since that Sunday morning back in 2014, my wife and I have never looked back. We found very friendly, loving people that welcomed us and made us feel at home, eventually we became like family. There is lots of great potential in this church and many Opportunities for growth. The worship is fantastic!, There is also a beautiful nursery for babies and toddlers and a children's ministry upstairs. After service everyone is invited to the fellowship hall for a delicious meal and a time to connect with guests and staff. But most important of all is that the gospel of Jesus christ is preached with no watered down messages! And everyone gets to experience the power of God.

I would highly recommend coming to this church to fellowship with other believers!
And to EXPERIENCE GOD then FIND HOPE and SHARE CHRIST. People were very kind and welcoming. The sermon was even better. There so many small groups and activities. In addition, teen ages can hangout with their peers. Pastor Glen and wife Marie, prayed for me during a time of need and that was comforting to be able to get to know the  leader of church on a personal level. Many other churches I have attended before, I was only able to greet the Pastors in passing and know of him by what was posted on Internet. Torrance New Life Church was intimate but yet just as spirit filled as the bigger denomination churches. I would definitely recommend checking out a Sunday service on Sunday and attending  a life group Wed. Nights at the church.

name: Torrey Pines Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Look, I've tried to find a reason not to love this church. I've got nothing.

Pastor Mingo is the kind of pastor who makes you forget you're sitting in a chair. Every. Single. Sunday. Enlightening, funny, edge-of-your-seat stuff, the man does not miss.

Maya's worship? Banger after banger. I don't know how she keeps topping herself but here we are. The worship is fire Sunday after Sunday, come and see for yourself!

I don't even have young kids and I was genuinely jealous today. 500 children. 8,000 Easter eggs. Multiple jumping castles. I'm a grown adult and I seriously considered getting in line.

The location is La Jolla. As in, arguably the most beautiful place on the planet. As in, you're sitting there thinking about God with the Pacific Ocean basically just off in the distance.

And then — THEN — they hand you a pour-over coffee. For free. Just because.

Five stars isn't enough. My wife and I have attended this church for many years, and it truly feels like home. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and open to believers, seekers, and skeptics alike. There are both modern and traditional services with the same Bible-based message. The pastors are engaging, practical, and thoughtful. The campus is beautiful, parking is easy, the kids’ program is excellent, and there are great opportunities for fellowship and spiritual growth. Such an amazing atmosphere to worship and friendly people who feels like a family.  Wonderful family environment with caring and safe kids ministry.  Nice to see so many young adults and you families. A wonderful, warm and welcoming church. Every week brings multiple blessings- from the strengthening message from Pastor Tim (always bible based), to the gracious members who are always welcoming and the presence of the Lord that surrounds us all! Great place to feel welcome love the vibes we are always doing community events and inviting everyone to find and follow Jesus

name: Town & Country Christian Church - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary:
I was a member for 4 years or so and I spent some time there in my elementary school days. The members of the congregation were very friendly, I attend their college age bible study as regularly as I could. Nice group of people, though whenever we did have class it seemed to be 60% gossip and 40% bible study which always left me feeling a little uneasy hearing others' private matters.

The worship leader had a serious staring problem with me. She would direct lingering glances and intense eye contact at me during various moments whether it was during the worship, communion or while I was praying. I never brought it up to anyone in the congregation out of guilt and fear of stirring up drama.

After two years of being a member we started to connect through work related emails I had received from her, my job helped promote one of her ventures and all within the last month I was allowed at Sunday services SHE initiated an in person conversation with ME, she sent ME a friend request on Facebook and offered ME in person a role as part of the audio/visual background team.

During a conversation related to hostile language and imagery I saw on one of her social media pages, I offered to stop attending services regularly and disconnect with her on social media after she claimed ignorance multiple times to what I was implying. She said she would pray for me and told me she wanted me to continue being up there.

No less than a week later she's twisting the narrative and putting in print that all of our interactions were unwarranted. She's filing papers against me which she lied multiple times on, and exaggerated conversations between us accusing me of harassment and trying to frame me as a cyber stalker.

Having never been through anything like this before I kept my mouth shut before I had any evidence together with cases of some churches covering evidence of misconduct to protect their staff's image and reputation. When the lead minister informed me of the action she took I had a meeting with him and asked to see documentation he had been sent proving something was filed in the courts so I could start getting any evidence together but he refused. My address on the report was listed wrong which gave me less than a week to prepare, nevertheless I showed up to court with what paper trail I could collect in that short time frame. She requests the case be dismissed with the added caveat I wasn't allowed at their Sunday morning services anymore.

I consulted with the D.A's office and the sheriff's office in the county where it was filed about my options afterwards. 7 months later I had to threaten a lawsuit in order to have a meeting with the eldership in what I was promised as one elder only turned into each one involved in a small cramped room. I was offered a potential "onboarding process" where I was told to stay on my best behavior and any more push backs from me would keep me out of the college age bible study I was regularly attending. Any points or questions I made were met with a shrug or questioning why I would feel the need to document my interactions with a woman repeatedly leering at me while acting in a religious leadership role who's over a decade older than me.

I hope the elders offered some guidance to the worship leader as it pertains to keeping her eyes focused on her sheet music and her soul focused on her Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Hopefully she and the rest of the staff learned to be more open and honest about their emotions with members of the congregation if they feel any interactions in person or online are considered "unsettling" or "unwarranted"  instead of leading them on and baiting them into sending an apology which is turned around and used as a weapon. Unless you don't mind her sitting on her perch week after week singing songs, collecting a check, and not bothering to practice the principles in the songs she's singing to the congregation; though I can't imagine she makes it a habit to enable and prey on the emotions of young impressionable men.
Hiding your Facebook reviews, not surprised. We have gone to Town and Country over a year now and we love this Church.  People are very friendly and accepting.  My children love this church as much as I do and this is the first one we have gone to in years that we feel comfortable, accepted, and enjoy listening to the services.  Every week we go we look forward to the next week.  (Although I work alot so we unfortunately don't get to go every week at times, but still watch the service when we can live:).) My husband and I are enjoying getting to know TCCC and the community of believers.  We've been very warmly welcomed which means a lot to both of us.  Our granddaughter attended with us last week and has asked to start attending with us regularly.  She loved kids church!! Great Church family that focuses on helping the surrounding community and providing a place to learn and grow for all walks of life. Left my church of 40 years looking for a church with good children's program 7 year old brought into sanctuary during service kids will be kids quite disruptive when ask to be silent and dont move left service early will be looking for another church to attend focus around youth that can handle disruptive children this is so disappointing.

name: Trabuco Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly supportive local church. The preschool is absolutely outstanding.

name: Trabuco Presbyterian Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: A few years ago I was trying to find a place to rest because I had just become homeless. I tried to rest on the lawn in front of the church. There were people there who came out to tell me to leave. Not a big deal, I started packing up my stuff and I started asking about the church. The women basically told me it wasn’t for me, and turned me away. Come to find out years later it’s a Presbyterian church like I grew up going to?? I didn’t even get into the fact that I was a young girl in my 20’s on the streets - something they couldn’t care less about. People like this and how I was treated make me sick now because I realize how full of it you all are. Yes, I have a family now and we’re not homeless. Y’all are heartless. Trabuco Presbyterian is the most inclusive and engaging church community I have been to. Shoutout to Caleb Henry for his amazing youth program, he is truly the best. This church is a good place to raise your kids in and in my opinion the best. We’ve attended this church for many years. Christ-centered, biblical-based worship and caring, warm community. Offers children’s programs, bible studies, and many other programs. Church community actively serving many other ministries, as well (support missionaries, food drives, work with homeless programs, etc). All welcome! Phenomenal community that seeks to build people up, encourage them, and create space for authentic life together while preaching and teaching Christs truth in unique and creative ways!! Easter Sunday! Loved celebrating Easter with our community and church family!

name: Tracy Community Church - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary: Went here once with my mom when I was 5.  But, I must thank them for one program they did in the late 90s or early 00s.  On Friday nights they put on this event with music, go karts, carnavales and other party themed activities for tweens, both inside and out.  It was great.  The first block was form 7 until 9.  Then at 9 pm everyone had to go inside, sit down and listen to the youth pastor talk to them for about half an hour about being a good person and god.  at 9:30 the fun resumed until 11, but it just wasn't as fun as the first block.  If you were smart, you went home shortly after that PSA. This church is like family! The pastors are so compassionate and truly care about everyone that comes through the doors. My life has been impacted by Pastor Sam and His leadership. If you are looking for God or community with others, come and see! I have been so blessed to go here. The staff and congregation has poured in to my life in such a great capacity. They have taught me how to be a blessing to others and how to love God in a real way. I really love TCC! I have been going for years upon years and every Sunday I leave with a deeper knowledge of Jesus and more fellowship within my community ! Each and every pastor brings their own unique gift from God ! I am beyond blessed to know the Lord and attend TCC Ever since joining TCC I have grown exponentially in my faith. I have learned how to carry out disciplines more effectively. Pastor Sam preaches with love and conviction. Very thankful for Pastor Sam and TCC.

name: Traders Point Christian Church
reviewSummary: Dynamic worship experience, passionate biblical teaching from Aaron Brockett, and a massive heart for regional outreach and global missions.

name: Traders Point Christian Church - Downtown - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Dynamic worship experience, passionate biblical teaching from Aaron Brockett, and a massive heart for regional outreach and global missions.

name: Traders Point Christian Church Carmel - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: Born and raised Catholic but not always feeling like the Catholic Churches in area are what I need any more. I have attended TP multiple times at 2 locations. I like live service the best and that facility. It’s an adjustment with music but everyone is super nice and welcoming. I hope to get more involved and meet others. Also it is nice you can watch it later if you can’t make it on Sunday. Love the guest speakers and Aaron. The sermon is never boring. They have a way to keep you engaged It was a pleasure serving family friendly drinks to such generous and kind congregation. All night the staff were asking us if we needed anything or how they could help us. Such a pleasure to be apart of a night like this. We hope and pray we can do this all over again! TP is the best! I just wonder, what groups of people are they trying to reach. It's the rich! My husband car broke down,  we have taken Ubers there,  I asked them do they have vans to pick people up.  The lady said no.  We'll there you have it. Welcoming and encouraging. I’ve been attending for almost a year. When they say get involved and serve, it really does build community within the church quickly and it’s a beautiful thing. It is very crowded but it is wonderful worshipping among a crowd. Try first steps, rooted, serving Saturdays, FAM. This is for north campus. We’ve gone here 5 years and it’s time to move on.  The sermon is broadcast not live.  While Aaron Brockett is a dynamic pastor it’s just not the same.  It’s a big church people come and go.  No real community involvement at this location nice multi million dollar building but it’s closed to the community no scouts, aa, etc.  I imagine there is more of this type of thing at the main campus in whitestown.  Child care is Constantly understaffed.  My children come to the main service when it’s closed but the music while very good is excessively loud 100+ db, fog machine and led lights blasted in your face.  I think it’s nice place with nice folks but this particular body is going nowhere and being very loud.  I’d try somewhere else before stopping here

name: Traders Point Christian Church Fishers - Fishers Campus
reviewSummary: Been a member for 5 years and love the pastor(Brockett), the church, and the message! Everything is inspirational along with the worship!! Coming from churches where people could be mean or fake its wonderful to know and a blessing that there are churches that care about the spiritual growth of a believer. We have found our home church!  We’ve attended Downtown in the past, but after a move and COVID our family fell off. My wife insisted we get back to church and Fishers has been wonderful. The children’s ministry is AWESOME.  We are fully onboard and ready to be involved in transforming our city.  We look forward to seeing what God has planned for us. I really like this church, I think the message and the vision are something easily understandable and super accessible to most people. I feel like they do really good work in the community. I do want to note this is a live stream sermon from their main campus with live worship. The worship is really fun and engaging! Great church, message, and purpose. However, they are caught up in making every event like a concert. You need ear plugs to sit in service bc it’s uncomfortably loud and I’m in my thirties. If you want to experience the Peace that passes human understanding, feel unconditionally loved in the warm open arms of your Creator, build new friendships that will last eternally, and leave better off than you came, Come and See.

name: Traders Point Christian Church Midtown - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
This is one of the 6 campuses of a terrific church in the Indianapolis area. If you are looking for a Christ centered home where you can  learn from annointed teachers and worship in a contemporary style with talented musicians who lead the worship with genuine praise and who respect the Lord, you will love this church! In an era of mega churches that are often more financial business oriented with overpaid pastors and far too many staff members, Traders Point has found a way to keep their eyes on Jesus,   have unpaid elders make important decisions about the direction of the church after prayer and creative and cautious thinking and still use their funds for good to further the Kingdom of God.  Even though it's a very large church in terms of numbers the feeling of small is possible if you get involved and find your people and live life together in Christ. I praised the Lord for this church. Personally I usually attend the downtown Indianapolis campus. Kyle Riley is a terrific campus pastor and you can't get a better worship leader than Rocky Martinez. Very inclusive church. Everyone is so friendly and encouraging - opportunity to connect beyond a Sunday service. Amazing messages from all pastors! Great place to worship with people who love God and others! Wonderful friendships developed from my small group! Good music. Pastor genuine. Friendly congragation "For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I with them."

Matthew 18:20,

name: Traders Point Christian Church Northwest - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Let me start by stating that I am a Secular Humanist. You may think that means athiest but it is not that simple. That said, I will tell you that my experience with Traders Point Christian Church in Zionsville was a wonderful experience. It started when I was in town visiting my youngest daughter and she asked me to attend a service with her. Those of you who are fathers will understand that it is almost impossible to say no to your baby girl even if she is all grown up with children of her own.
From the moment we arrived I was deeply impressed by the genuine friendship that all of the volunteers (a/k/a Difference Makers) showed us. I never got any sense of a holier than thou attitude. The facilities were very impressive and the children’s rooms were some of the nicest I have ever seen. The service itself was both entertaining and uplifting. The pastor was a great orator and obviously educated and intelligent. I never felt any pressure nor was I made to feel as if I was an outsider. I will admit that I was actually envious of the parishioners that were believers and were able to fully enjoy the fellowship offered by this church. If you are agnostic or searching for something outside of the mainstream uptight religious organizations I would highly encourage you to attend a service at Traders Point. I believe it may give you what you are searching for and change your life. AB, Ryan, the worship team, and volunteers are AMAZING! For such a large church to feel this small, it's just incredible.  Pastors who know your name and face, who come up to you to see how you're doing when you are sourround bt thousands of other people... it means you are not just a face in a sea of faces, it's absolutely astounding!! God's blessing is at TPCC and He is on the move.

If you have never been to church or are looking for a great place to call home, now is the time! We welcome you to join our family! This church has truly become a special place for me. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with kindness by some of the friendliest people I’ve ever met. Pastor Aaron consistently shares a clear and meaningful message that speaks to my heart every week. He isn’t forceful, but he delivers God’s Word with honesty and real conviction. I would encourage anyone who wants to experience genuine community and hear God’s truth to visit this church—you’ll be glad you did. Great pastor, great message, however the uncomfortable feeing due to disappointing leader put in place needs to be reprimanded removed or replaced any of those three R’s.

to CADE , you not only lied to me, but you also gave me a very disappointing and uncomfortable feeling. I called the church after hours crying and the only thing you did was you prayed and reject me. Let me ask you a question did you tell anyone else in the church that you spoke to a man crying asking for help ?? I’m 100% sure you didn’t!  After crying and explaining to you what I needed expecting you were going to give me a call back. Which you said with your own mouth. Don’t be a lying hypocrite, assume some accountability and responsibility. which you didn’t which is why I said you lied to me.. Then you proceeded to sign me up for a financial class where no spots were open. So you decided to send me to a location 20 minutes further than my one hour destination it already takes me. I explained that to you once again you explained to me that there’s only one time this class happens a year. However, the reason you’re getting a one star review is because I explained to cade what I needed. And it wasn’t money for my rent and it wasn’t money for my car payment and it wasn’t money for my electric. I want to let you know I called crying my eyes out  because of my current situation. CADE you should be embarrassed and be replaced.My entire life is falling apart Including a 12 month old baby . I asked for A certain type Of assistance that did not include money!  If you’re not man enough, strong enough or smart enough to help me with anything that I asked for. Then that is why you have a church that you are  a part of that you can ask that is why I expected a phone call back because you’re not the owner of the church you don’t run the church so the little power trip that you’re on you need to come back down From and humble yourself. I asked you to ask your congregation or the network the church created that put you in a role to help.  Why didn’t not call me back? That means you don’t care or that means you forgot or that means that my life and my 12 month old daughter lives are not important. “The only thing that is important is a financial class so you can receive money” ???   How dare you lie to somebody and say you’re going to call them back and never call them back. How dare do you think that you’re the owner of the church. You were trying to make up answers to questions you dont know. Which is why I reiterated my questions. And elaborated on Detail of what I meant, but you kept trying to answer the questions yourself acting like you wanted to be proud of helping somebody with zero answers. Quit playing King while the king is away. You should’ve said it a table with your peers and explained to them a man was crying in the night. Can anyone help this young man who called our phone at night, crying?
Do not call me or reach out to me Unless you are pastor Aaron himself. CADE your truly need to step down you aren’t the man for that job clearly you aren’t man enough to even call somebody back when you tell them you’re going to call them back. Call them! You know the reason I called you was not to speak to you CADE. I asked you questions you didn’t have answers to and you said you would have to ask someone else. Which you didn’t and you never called me back.. step down give your position To somebody who has more empathy, accountability And responsibility. Zero excuses need to be given ! Take a accountability and responsibility that 30 minute phone call ended with a prayer a financial class enforcement, and Was supposed to have a call, being returned with more information or resources provide provided. However, you thought I was just going to join the class make money and not say anything about how you treat people who go to your church. The next time you want to offer any suggestion without asking the church first maybe it should be resources from your family not offering mine that are going through a divorce. I told you this.i dont expect a 30min solution. Can’t say enough about Traders Point!!!  Message is always on point and we always feel beyond welcome!!
