name: Traders Point Christian Church Plainfield - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary:
Even though it's not the main campus, (Whitestown is) you can tell that the same love and care is put into this building.

I've have regularly attended both the Plainfield Campus as well as the Whitestown Campus. The only real difference in the two is physical size, as well as the services being live broadcasts.(the worship music is in person) The live broadcasting style of the services is actually not as weird feeling as someone might think. It feels the same as being "in person." You still get a wonderful sense of community, especially if you seek it out through various groups and events you can get plugged into!
This is a great place to attend church!

This is also a very "come as you are" casual church. You can wear jeans and a ball cap and fit right in.

They have a kids ministry that is very SAFE and LOVING towards your children! All TPPC volunteers in the kids ministry go through EXTENSIVE background checks. I just moved to Indiana from Cincinnati OH, and have been attending Traders Point for the last 4 weeks. Traders Point is everything I have been looking for in a church. Some churches can feel like a chore getting up and going every Sunday, but this one is the complete opposite. I look forward to going every Sunday! Yes, very good Bible teaching Church.  This is where I go.  They do have flexible service times.  I like the early service on Sundays. I love this church! The messages are great, it’s welcoming and my kids love it! Proud to call Trader’s Point Plainfield home. I have been attending Traders Point for almost 3 years now Traders point is the most amazing church I've ever been to! Pastor Aaron, nobody better I've ever seen!

name: Traders Point Church of Christ - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
The fruit of the Spirit is practiced and seen with the christians who worship at the Trader’s Point church of Christ. We show love, joy, peace,forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control. We strive to adhere to the teaching of Christ in the new testament Christianity . My husband and I have worshipped with this body of christians for 8 years. Very loving group of SCRIPTURAL Christians. They seek daily to get closer to God NOT just on Sundays and Wednesdays.

They are extremely welcoming of new visitors, making you feel comfortable as if you were home. They have 2 preachers and 3 Elders for a congregation around the size of 250 people.

So far, every lesson I've heard for the past month and a half is supported with Scripture. And I don't mean just taking a single verse either. They look at context of the entire passage.

I have become so energetic, buoyant like I'm floating on air, encouraged, strengthened. I actually feel God's presence as we worship. I've not had that feeling in almost 20 years.

And they have such a diverse group of people that attend. Black, Brown, & White people all worshipping the 1 true God trying to ensure we get to heaven. There is also a wide range of ages as well. From newborns to people in ther 70's or 80's, they have a varied and great "family" atmosphere.

Go to Trader's Point, you will feel the love too. I have been a member of this church family since 2009. As a first-time visitor, I was overwhelmed (in the best way!) by the warm reception and genuine interactions with the members I met. I arrived with just a basic understanding of the Bible, a firm belief in its inspired nature, and a strong desire to know more. I was thrilled to find a place where I could learn more about the Bible, simply presented from the Bible itself, in a way I could directly and immediately apply to my own life.
As the years have progressed, I've been incredibly encouraged by the opportunities to grow my faith, serve others, and watch my children flourish as they move through the children's classes. The relationships I've formed here are unique to anything I've ever known. We are all trying to live life God's way, and while there are inevitably challenges and obstacles along the way, what a tremendous blessing to walk alongside this group of Christians. This is an amazing group of Christians seeking truth and pursuing God's will. I have worshipped here since 2008 and have seen many of the members go through challenges, tragedies, etc.... and this congregation is a loving, supportive, and sincere group of people. I am honored to be able to serve in this church family. We are new to the area and have really enjoyed getting to know the congregation at Trader's Point! There are a variety of adult bible studies and children's classes as well as groups that meet throughout the week to study together outside of the regular church services. Very welcoming to visitors!

name: Transformation Church
reviewSummary: Exploded in popularity through social media. Mike Todd's illustrative sermons are viral hits. The culture is urban, fashionable, and culturally relevant.

name: Transformation Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: I experienced a great church full of friendly people in a welcoming environment with pastors who lead with integrity! And, most importantly, there was a tangible presence of God that permeated the service! I highly recommend this church! Hello, and prayers to everyone reading also God Bless and have a happy new year! I’ve been struggling as a college student for a while now and started two new jobs PT and looking for a Third, because I am in school I haven’t received many blessings and now with possibly leaving college im begging God to send me signs and what to do so this what God decides, ask the community . I’ve been denied food stamps, rental assistance . I was told to sell my body and I refused started crying and praying for God to send me ANYTHING!!! I called churches all over and have been told I need to be a member and pay a fee but because I’m low on money there is NO WAY I can pay. My cash app is $Cponds19 I know I can go to the pantry for food but ANYTHING will help✨🙏🏽 I’ve been in a really bad place the past few years. I hid it well from everyone. I got myself together. I drive by the transformation church all the time. Finally I was like you know what I’m gonna go. Even though I grew up Catholic. I was welcomed. They brought me inside. I had some coffee. They introduced me to some people. I’m alone in Tallahassee so I have no friends or family. Right away the girl said please think of me as family. I went into the church. I sat next to this wonderful lady. During the singing and when the pastor came out to talk, I boo-hoo’d like a baby. The lady next to me comforted me. This church has transformed me. I haven’t gone to the other meetings yet, but I will. After the first time I went two weeks ago in the front, they had these wonderful people saying well you can come up personally and we will pray for you. I didn’t want to say why I was asking for prayer. I said you know health and other things. The lady exactly knew what was wrong with me immediately and said to God, please help her with her trauma. How did she know? She said God spoke to Her. At that point my heart opened. I left a very traumatic relationship that I was abused in every way for three years. About a year ago I moved to Tallahassee. Since then, I tried to drown my sorrows and that didn’t work. But opening my heart to Jesus has changed me in so many ways. Two times I’ve gone and like I said, transformed me. Try it maybe you’ll love it. I hope you do❣️praise God and praise this church. 🙏🙏🙏 A true welcome to the kingdom of God . A wonderful vision and mission at Transformation Church. You immediately find guidance and support! The fellowship is amazing. Every Sunday you are able to takeaway a meaningful message from service for the week ahead. This was one of the first churches my husband tried out before the rest of our family moved to the area to be with him. He loved the message given that day and was excited to take us there. Since then we enjoy worship and every message. Pastor Ryan, Andrea, James, and Mike always deliver well and are passionate about the lord. The children’s ministry is TOP NOTCH. Pastor Emily is really the heart beat of the next gen wing and everyone who interacts with her loves her! She is feeding the children’s ministry with all the love and guidance each child needs to know Him! I am proud to call this church my “home” thankful and blessed to have found this church! Our family’s faith has TRANSFORMED since attending. We love you transformation!

name: Transformation Fellowship Christian Church - Apex Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful little church where kids can be kids.

name: Travis Park United Methodist Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church in the heart of downtown San Antonio ♥️.  Its very authentic Travis park United Methodist Church is San Antonio's oldest protestant congregation, founded in 1846. It's known for its inclusive, all means all approach and host cultural events like candlelight concerts. This is my 2nd event with the candlelight concerts and I really enjoyed both.
The staff is very organized and helpful.

The following pic is of section C, if you'd like to use it for reference. It was perfect for us, but I wouldn't mind trying section A in the future. I’m not someone who typically likes a symphony or an orchestra but I thought I would give this event a try. It was very beautiful in the church with what seemed like thousands of candles. One of the musicians would tell some stories in between some of the songs and he was really funny. The musicians did a great job. We enjoyed this event. Pretty church in downtown San Antonio. We came for the candlelight show. The church was set up beautifully and they had people directing you to the proper area. They also had some small snacks and waters. I loved the rainbow streamers at the entrance. Bought these for my cousin’s birthday… because who doesn’t like Fleetwood Mac?! 😭🎶 They were TOO good. I’m booking Bad Bunny for the whole family next 😌

name: Tree of Life Church - Blue Ash / Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
The Word Is Strong here! Yet there seems to be a dresscode that as a newbie one is unaware.women
Dresses, no makeup, no jewelry. I am interested in learning more. However, some on the praise team -
Although dresses, very
Very tight and form revealing. I am not sure.
Confusing From the moment we entered the parking lot at Tree of Life Church, we were embraced by a warm, welcoming atmosphere and the undeniable presence of God. As we approached the entrance, the friendly smiles and open doors of the greeters made us feel right at home. The entire congregation radiated kindness and joy.

The worship experience was incredible—led by an anointed praise team and talented musicians, who truly ushered in the presence of God. Pastor Joel Urshan’s sermon was powerful and full of truth, leaving us inspired and uplifted.

If you’re searching for a church where you can encounter God and be part of a loving community, look no further—Tree of Life is where you belong! The music was great. The messages were great. The building is beautiful and well lit. The bassist plays a Fender. That alone is worth four stars. Those are all positives. We went three times and never heard the Senior Pastor preach. He looked like Joel Osteen with a robot arm, and a wore a suit that probably cost more than a used Toyota Camry. If you are seeking the presence of Jesus then please stop by. You will feel His great Power and Peace at this church. It is truly a place of healing and love. The church is loving and accepting of everyone and is very multicultural! The senior pastor thinks he knows why people cry at his church, e.g. sermons on The Cure for the Lukewarm Condition & Golden Head Syndrome. I was crying on the first service I attended. On the next service, he denounced crying. Then, the Spirit led me to watch The Cure...where he was mocking people who cry in church! I was crying because 4 members of my family had died since the pandemic started, one each year, with my mother dying just this past May.  I was mourning, I am the only one left in my family line. Also, I was crying because I was so happy I thought I finally found a church to go to after 9 years, tears of joy. I was born again 10 years ago, repented of drinking, smoking, fornication, among other sins and resisting every single day to all temptations. I have been baptized and giving out gospel tracts in parks, stores, streets, and other public places. I was not crying at that time because I felt sorry for my sins and not repented, and pretending I am good on Sundays. I forgive the pastor for his assumptions, but I will just find another church to attend who has a pastor with empathy. I am thankful for the people who were very supportive of me, God bless your beautiful souls.

name: Tree of Life Church - New Braunfels Campus
reviewSummary:
Thank you very much for the Thanksgiving Turkey and the bag of Vegetables. Lots of delicious food. You are blessing so many people it brought tears to my eyes. I really appreciate all this food. God Bless You 🙏 Great church that we just so happened to find when searching for a church near us. Been going a little over a year now and ABSOLUTELY love it. Great Pastors and SUPER friendly people Love this Church in New Braunfels Texas...they are very good to the community...come join them for Sunday service to see for yourself🙌🏻🙌🏻⚓ I love this church been coming for over a year 🤍 Love filling up on The Holy Spirit as we start our week. Very welcoming "Come as you are" church FOR all. Come enjoy great fellowship and worship. Hope to see you there.
🛐 🕘 or 🕚 Sundays ➕🙏

name: Tremont Temple Baptist Church
reviewSummary:
We loved our time worshipping with the saints of Tremont Temple Baptist Church. Visiting from out of town, we looked for a faithful, gospel preaching church. We were greeted by the loving saints of Tremont. Located within a beautiful old theater, the congregation exhibited a beautiful gospel diversity. It was beautiful to see a range of ages, cultural backgrounds, and ethnicities united by the grace of redemption in Jesus Christ. The music was a faithful blend of old and contemporary hymns, including a special, 4 part harmony song lead by some members of the congregation. The preaching was faithful and expositional. I was encouraged by the pastor’s message through both his explanation of the meaning of the text yet also his thoughtful application to living the Christian life. It was a joy to be with these people, and it saddened me to leave them.

If you are in Boston and you want to know what Christianity is really all about, if you want to experience a faithful church, if you want to be apart of a faithful, gospel congregation look no further than Tremont Temple Baptist Church. To God be the glory! This church is absolutely beautiful and breathtaking. Please understand that only maintenance has been done for upkeep, I don’t believe it’s handicap friendly (didn’t check this sorry!) but wow!

You walk in and kept help but just stare and look up.

Came here for a conference and I’m excited and hopeful to comeback again and explore more! If you are considering going to church, Tremont Temple Baptist Church, is a biblically faithful congregation grounded on the authority of scripture. The sermons are expository, taught verse by verse, of sound doctrine, avoiding the tickling of ears you are likely to find at so many other ‘churches’ in the local area. We enjoyed warm fellowship with other believers during our visit from New Mexico. The history of the church and building are also fascinating, and worth digging into. Highly recommend this church for any believers who love the whole Word of God being preached! Deep theological worship songs, expository sermons, and encouraging fellowship! I was a visitor here for one week and knew this church would be one I’d attend if I lived near the area. Thank you, Pastor Jaime and the family at Tremont Temple for your focus on Christ in everything! The Tremont Temple Baptist Church in Boston, observed from the outside, boasts an impressive façade that commands attention. While not exuding the warm and welcoming ambiance of some other churches, its imposing presence exudes a sense of historical significance. The architectural design reflects a unique character, setting it apart from traditional Episcopal or Lutheran churches. As an observer, I admired its distinct style and appreciated the glimpse into Boston's diverse religious landscape. Despite not meeting certain expectations, the Tremont Temple Baptist Church leaves a lasting impression, adding to the city's architectural tapestry and historical charm.

name: Tri-City Bible Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve visited this church a few times now, and each visit has been a great experience. The messages are clear, accurate, and grounded in scripture. The worship leader is very talented and leads others well during worship, which really adds to the experience. The atmosphere is welcoming, and everyone I’ve met has been kind and friendly. I am so thankful for this church, I joined eight years ago in 2016. The expository verse by verse Bible teaching has been such a blessing to my heart. We are now in Matthew. Our pastor preaches through the Bible and I receive such wonderful instruction and guidance every time I listen to him. There is a sense of family here. This is such a loving, caring body of believers. I love our women’s ministry as well as many caring connections. Next year we will be studying through the book of Isaiah. I’m praying God‘s blessing on our church and the year ahead.

Numbers 6:24-26
“ May the Lord bless you and keep you;  may the Lord make a face to shine up on you and be gracious to you; may the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace,”

Jude verses 24-25
“Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present, you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy, to the only God, our Savior , through Jesus Christ our Lord,  be glory, majesty, dominion and authority , before all time and now and  forever. Amen “ Tri City Bible Church is a blessing to anyone looking for solid, biblical teaching. The pastor is truly gifted and dedicated to delivering God’s Word in a clear, powerful way. Every sermon is expository, going verse by verse through Scripture, allowing the truth of the Bible to be the foundation of every message. This approach keeps the focus on God’s Word and its application in our daily lives. If you're looking for a church that takes Scripture seriously and seeks to glorify God through accurate, meaningful teaching, this is the place to be! Recommend avoiding the church due to integrity issues on behalf of the pastor. Won't get into it but lots of people left because of it and no change was made. Some of the elders then told the congregation that people left for differences in belief when in reality it had to do with lying and lack of integrity issues from leadership. Anyone who left was labeled as divisive dissenters.

Attended the church myself for about a year and introduced myself a bunch of times. Each time the pastor  totally forgot who I was, he and his wife also seemed to shun us away. Others have reported the same. So unfortunately the pastor seems annoyed by the sheep. Best to get yourself into a church that cares for all of their people and not just a select group. Hope this helps and God bless you in your church search. I have attended here for 7 years and continue to be blessed with the faithful teaching of scripture and the community of genuine believers who continue to love and serve the body of Christ.

For the young man who left the one star review, my heart is grieved that you would take to the internet to air opinions and slander a fellow believer's character in front of a watching world.  This does not glorify our God, or Christ, who prayed that we would be one as He and the Father are one.  Christ builds His church and doesn't need us to take to google reviews to help people hear the Gospel, or brothers and sisters in Christ find a church to worship God and serve the body.  Yet here we are.  Church is not for perfect people and it's not free from human error in perception and judgement, and we aren't immune from hurt feelings and broken relationships.  But we are called to be humble and to pursue peace and reconciliation in love.  My hope is that you have found a church body that you can continue to grow in Christ.

I had to select a number of stars to leave this review, but I would've preferred not to.  Only to God be the glory, and for the seeker of a church, if you walk through our doors you will be welcomed and loved.

name: Triangle Christian Center - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: No matter what it is open! Politically incorrect Bible correct message. Gifts of the Holy Spirit are welcome to manifest and daimons are casted out. Sick are healed, broke get wealthy. Plenty activity for the kids during and after church. Come and see the with your own eyes. I used to go to this church when I was younger I’ve now moved back into town first experience back my car was having a issue left car on property to run to get oil for my truck and I was coming back because I was looking to see if I could get my self back into the church once I come back to my truck they have my truck towed and told me it’s because my truck looked suspicious I was gone less than 45 min you walk with god but you judge by appearance judge by faith not by site super disappointed in the owner of that church or whoever is the property owner For a reasonable price triangle learning center gives the best support and development they rival any school we have researched and the response my child has expressed is always a pleasant surprise develomentally.  They have security that is effective and consistent and use a cellular app that gives you status updates of your kids during the course of the day.  They have had some turnover during the 3 years we have been there but culture Has stayed consistent This is a very nice Christian school. My nephew graduated from here and they did an amazing job with the ceremony! One of the best preschool graduations I've been to! My husband and I love the way the staff treats our child. The staff has been very helpful in our child's developmental progression and we are very happy to have found this Center.

name: Trinity Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Trinity Baptist Church has been an incredible blessing to my life. If you’re looking for a church that takes the Word of God seriously, this is the place. Pastor Matthew Hardy’s expository teaching is truly exceptional—he doesn’t skip around or rely on shallow interpretation. He opens the Scriptures, explains them in context, and applies them with clarity, conviction, and accuracy.

Every sermon is grounded in the text, not opinion. Pastor Hardy walks verse-by-verse through Scripture in a way that is both deeply instructive and easy to follow, and you can tell he’s committed to faithfully handling God’s Word. I consistently leave each service encouraged, challenged, and spiritually fed.

Trinity Baptist is a church where truth is taught, Christ is exalted, and the Bible is central. I can’t recommend it highly enough.

name: Trinity Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Really nice group of people here. I recommend them if you are in the area Spanish Fridays 7
English 9

name: Trinity Baptist Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: A very caring church endeavoring to spread God's love & being Christ-like.  I have known the minister, Pastor Dave Speas & his family for a very long time & sincerely feel he is anointed by the Holy Spirit. Pastor David Speas and his wife Carol have been pastor here for many years. Small church family friendly. Good worship Gracious enough to let us use their parking lot to quickly repair our vehicle. Was just passing through. Don’t know much other than that, but I felt it needed shared.

name: Trinity Baptist Church - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
A function I attended was held here today. This place was as busy as a downtown office building. Something going on in every corner of the complex. The place is large and parking was plentiful. I see why the place rents out that spot for their functions. Convenient and accommodating. My family has been attending for almost one year. Medium-Large traditional church with a welcoming community feel. There are many small events during the week at which you can engage in different ways and get to know members in a more intimate setting. The strong leadership team there does a good job of making you feel recognized, remembered, and important. We had one lapse of attendance for something like a month and received an email from the pastor  checking in on us. Despite having a thousand or so regular attendees, most of the leadership knows us by name.

Very impressive place overall. Great church, staff, programs, newly expanded sanctuary, and fellowship area. I have been a member here since 1989.  Wonderful church family.  Live streaming of Sunday's worship services,  and special programs, with an archive of services available for viewing.  Mission oriented church locally, and internationally. Great weekday preschool. When a job transfer brought me back to Raleigh in the year 2000 we visited 10-12 churches and felt called to Trinity.  The kind and loving people, the depth of relationships in small groups / Sunday School classes, the amazing children's /  youth offerings, an excellent ministerial staff all make TBC a great platform to grow in your faith.  Now I look back 21 years and to see how my children have developed a strong faith, the support of the church body through the ups and downs of life (and being able to support others), and the way I have grown in my faith I am so thankful for finding TBC.  Hope you'll join us :-)! This church is a very community orient and mission driven place of worship. They have activies for all ages from babies to senior adults. This is a very inviting and family friendly church.The ministers and church members are very friendly and welcoming. If you are in need of a church home I recommend visiting this church and making it your place of worship.

name: Trinity Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly environment, message lift up spirit. Cool My church!! Very kind and the pastor very courteous

name: Trinity Bible Church - Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
Feels like your home church when you walk in. Pastor noticed we were new and introduced himself and entire family. Great biblically sound sermon. We’ll be back. Trinity is an amazing church! My wife has been going here ever since she was a kid, and she was one of the people who in my journey helped me find Christ, and I’m glad that I found Him here, many years ago! Pastor Dennis ending up doing our wedding as well. And I also did my first mission trip with trinity as well. Tim is really awesome to go on a trip with I think he is a phenomenal missions pastor! I highly recommend this place to anyone in their journey to find God! Dennis ~ the Pastor is a very wonderful man of God, & he does a fantastic job of researching his  bible & deliver very good sermons,  in a format that is easy to follow and he teaches us how the scriptures apply to us in our daily lives.  He shows us how the bible is a very vital guide to human life if we are to live a life with a joyful purpose, feeling blessed by God, as we live accordingly to His will, for us here on earth.
I always leave there inspired & encouraged by his sermons.
I can really feel Gods presence in His house of worship. Wonderful church!  Great teachings and amazing music.  The pastor and worship leader are wonderful people.  Definitely check out the Christmas Production! Very welcoming church family and the pastor Dennis Malcom is very real and down to earth. You can see God move through him each week.

name: Trinity Cambridge Church
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful, inviting community! We visited Trinity Cambridge during a trip to Boston and were blown away by the hospitality. The signage at the college made finding the service easy, and the service itself was fantastic.
Shawn gave a great message. Ed and David went out of their way to welcome us personally before, during and after. We truly felt like part of the family for a day. A beautiful church with a big heart! Trinity is a small church with BIG love. I've been a member for about 2 years and God has really grown me here. Pastors Shawn and Matt, and pastoral intern Ed are all excellent speakers, and each sermon is prayerfully written with God's word in the foreground, and the Gospel at the core. I have never met a church that prays as much and as faithfully as Trinity, and praying all together each week for an unreached nation is a highlight for me for sure. Come check it out! Trinity is an excellent, gospel centered church. They’re a loving family of faithful believers with sound leadership and great exegetical preaching. This is a church that lives life together and you’ll get a hearty welcome whether you’re a fellow believer or just interested in learning more. Trinity Cambridge Church, gracefully situated at 830 Cambridge Street, is, in my meaningful estimation and based on the frequent, genuinely moving testimonials from friends involved in its ministries and worship, a profoundly caring and active faith community that extends far beyond its physical walls, truly living out a mission of service and radical welcome right in the heart of the neighborhood. Everyone I’ve spoken with consistently praises the incredibly inclusive and supportive congregation, the engaging and thoughtful sermons offered during worship, and the strong, consistent dedication to local outreach programs and social justice initiatives, emphasizing that the church successfully fosters both deep spiritual growth and tangible civic engagement. I’ve learned from their narratives that the atmosphere is one of unwavering acceptance, intellectual openness, and vibrant, focused commitment to community well-being, making it an exceptional place for spiritual seekers and anyone looking to connect with others dedicated to positive change. My subjective conclusion is that Trinity Cambridge Church is an irreplaceable spiritual and social asset - a true beacon of hope and fellowship - so I encourage you to visit their website or attend a service to experience their genuine warmth firsthand. Great worship experience! The music is uplifting and the message is solid.O know the pastor personally and he is the king of man that relies on the Holy Spirit. That's what you want. I recommend.

name: Trinity Cathedral Episcopal Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the most beautiful church I’ve ever been to! Sometimes they lay out a big canvas labyrinth maze, you take off your shoes and walk around in prayer and meditation, and it’s absolutely beautiful. Usually quiet and empty and when you do see someone else approach, that’s your cue to finish up. Fantastic service everybody is warm and friendly and welcoming !
They even brought back the coffee shop downstairs- also amazing!!!
Can’t possibly say enough good about the work they do here.  Definitely Check it out!!! This church was absolutely immaculate very big high ceilings extricate paintings immaculate glass windows very very clean bathrooms the staff there was just amazing and very helpful the location is just amazing and it's located and beautiful downtown near Cleveland State University very old vintage Church but in wonderful condition very very big beautiful rooms they even had a donation area for food for like a food pantry this church is just amazing I'm definitely five thumbs up for great service wonderful wonderful location and a beautiful view of a church definitely a must must must must must travel place if you're a visitor or if you're in Cleveland Ohio highly recommend going to this place If you are looking for a truly amazing episcopal church in the Cleveland area, definitely check this church out. So amazing. How fortunate we are to have such an architecturally amazing church in our area.  It is awe inspiring.  Highly recommend the docent tour to hear the amazing history. Located on Euclid Avenue in Midtown Cleveland across the road from the Cleveland State University campus, Trinity Cathedral is the a gorgeous gothic building with stunning stained glass, beautiful altar-pieces, a handsome Flentrop organ at the west end of the nave. The Sunday morning worship services offer everything from contemporary jazz to traditional Anglican worship. Lovers of the Anglican choral evensong would rejoice to know that the cathedral offers choral evensong every Wednesday evening from 6pm. The cathedral also sponsors weekly free Wednesday afternoon lunchtime concerts and performances featuring local talent. Highly recommended for good worship, good music, and social justice ministries in the neighborhoods!

name: Trinity Christian Church of Greater Philadelphia - Lower Merion Township Campus
reviewSummary: Local Chinese congregation. Strong Bible teaching and community, with good programs for the children. Teaching is in both Chinese and English. If you like Jesus and/or Chinese people, you'll love this church! I sure do! This church fully love!! Because they can recognize you easily, feel like being home A great place to worship God and hear the Bible preached accurately and persuasively This church has an amazing story. Come and find out.

name: Trinity Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Great work space! Nice and clean  building Great little church!!

name: Trinity Church - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary: They made me feel welcomed. The worship was incredible. If I may ask, I'm in town working only till Thursday and I was just wondering if yall have service Wednesday evenings? I'd love to attend! Please change the requirements for older children walking with a parents to drop off small children. My 10 year old wasn't allowed to walk back with us and drop off my young children the man at the door wanted her to stand alone in the lobby, that's unacceptable. Fortunately a lady church volunteer let my daughter stand next to her inside the children's lobby waiting for me to drop my little kids off but there needs to be a better solution since supposedly "safety" is the reason. Upon picking my little kids up my 10 year old was required to wait 10 minutes alone in the main lobby. I enjoy Pastor Carl's sermons and my young children have enjoyed children's church unfortunately this won't be our church home. Great church, great lessons, good child service. But also they are very greedy, hypocritical, and rude. I personally know a woman who went here loyally for 20 years and when she passed they refused to hold her funeral there for invalid reasons. They held a charity where you donate to families in need and they made the stand on the stage in humiliation and thank people for the gifts instead of just donating it to them and leaving it at that. They will jump at any chance to get money. I will say, there are some wonderful people there who work/attend. But I wouldn't put my full trust in this church or any Mega-Church for that matter. I just moved to Lubbock and tried a few churches. I tried Trinity and it was amazing. The building is beautiful. The praise and worship is fantastic. Pastor Carl is a phenomenal teacher. He is truly blessed by the Holy Spirit. The people are very friendly. I recommend this church 100%.

name: Trinity Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️ 2/5 – A Disappointing and Uncomfortable Experience

I attended Trinity Church with my daughter because we simply wanted to hear God’s message, worship, and spend some peaceful time together. We sat toward the back and were fully participating — repeating the prayers, listening, and being present. However, from early on we felt pressured to move to the front, almost as if sitting in the back wasn’t acceptable. It created an uncomfortable feeling, like we were obligated to respond a certain way rather than allowed to worship freely.

We’ve been to many churches, and we understand every congregation has its own style. But the overall approach here felt very aggressive and pushy. At one point, the pastor highlighted items like crutches and other objects as proof of people being healed in the church. While I respect testimonies and personal beliefs, the delivery felt more like a performance than a message, and it didn’t sit well with me or my daughter.

There were also giveaways, which at first sounded generous, but they were presented in a way that came across as if the church itself was providing everything — when clearly these things come from the people who faithfully give to the church. It felt more like a show than genuine outreach.

Overall, my daughter felt uneasy, and I walked away disappointed. I understand their intentions, but the pressure and intensity overshadowed the message. I hope they find a way to share their faith without making visitors feel obligated or uncomfortable If there was a way to leave 0 stars I would. I grew up here and this church turned me off to Christianity. They care about money and if you have it. The teachings are shallow and if you want a safe place for your family it’s not here!! Love this church! It's been my home church for 14 years and it has incredible people! It good dude without being too big and had all kinds of events throughout the wee. The love Jesus and love the Bible. Highly recommend. Im so glad I found this wonderful church. The congregation are very kind and genuine. The teaching is easy to understand and the worship is pleasing to God. Lastly, there are many ways to get involved. I have been searching for an amazing Church and a friend recommended Trinity.  I checked out sermons online and it is perfect for me...a Bible focused Church for sure and wonderful Church family...So many program and group opportunities for Christian's from all age groups...walks of life including those with any special needs. Have been there faithfully for 10 weeks and look forward to it each week. Check out the family and sermons online or better yet come on down on Sunday for one of the 3 convenient services.

name: Trinity Church - Scottsdale Campus
reviewSummary:
It truly is a blessing to get to meet wonderful people who are for one another, and help Young Men grow in their manhood through the Real Men and Real Faith ministries; if you missed any I'd recommend them for how to become an honest Man of God, and faithfully serving and blessing those around you. God bless Trinity Church and The Families for being bold and faithful to bring the Truth.

2 Timothy 4:7 (ESV) - I have fought the Good Fight, I have Finished The Race, I Have Kept The Faith. This is a really fun and sociable congregation with many large festivals through out the year.  It is an Iconic building of scottsdale.  the front lobby has a museum wall telling the history of this unique building.  I enjoyed touring the inside after one of thier celebrations. We came to visit and never left. We have now been here since 2019. We enjoy Pastor Mark sermons and teaching. The message are relevant to the times we are in, over and over again. You never stop learning regardless of how new or long your relationship has been with the Lord. The kids enjoy coming as well and that is important. The programs for the children to learn, serve and grow in faith is unprecedented. People are friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended to my family and friends. So incredibly Thankful for Trinity Church! Having a truth speaking, bible believing, bible teaching Pastor and Church family is so important and appreciated! Too bad we can't copy and paste Pastor Mark so more people can learn the truth. Grateful I get to see him LIVE. #Repent #ThankYouJesus!! #BeautifulChurch This is my Church! Absolutely love Mark!
I’m new to the Church. Talks about true repentance & topics other pastors rarely wanna talk about. Jesus is King!

name: Trinity Church Austin - Austin Campus
reviewSummary: We have been to this church several times and just love it!  Great biblical teaching and very friendly young church with good representation of every age group.  Love the music and they have great small groups for people to attend.  This church is very worthwhile to visit! We love Trinity, their gospel focused message is crucial in this time. Very welcoming and friendly atmosphere, I would encourage anyone to come see for yourself on a Sunday! My family and I visited Trinity today. The environment was spirit-filled. The hospitality was perfect and friendly. The Word is Solid! The kids enjoyed the youth dept (Torch). The worship team sang current and engaging songs. Will be back! Thanks, Ehren & Sara! This church always preaches solid theology, has wonderful worship, and has a welcoming community that has a wide range of families/couples/singles in different stages of life. Amazingly welcome community, great preaching, excellent theology. A wonderful place to call your church home.

name: Trinity Church Dallas - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
What A Welcoming Church With Arms Open Wide To All Walks Of Life.  Heard A Timely Message On Fear.  Worship Time Takes Others Into A Heavenly Experience! I apologized, I am charging my review. The church got back to me with my question. Thank you. Below was my original review.

Original Review:
Very disappointed. I was trying to get information about the church with a question. Thinking of a student who is coming from out of state and looking for a church to attend. After taking time to write I didn’t get a reply. I just couldn’t believe it! Unless there is a glitch in their website, I am not trusting them to be there for my student to get any help if she needs support. Very sad. Great church! Pastor Joe and the leadership are holy spirit led, with two campuses to attend. Love the ethnic diversity! Beware: this is a new charismatic movement, based on 7 mountains of dominionism, with heavy emphasis on money collecting/tithing (which is outdated concept if you believe Jesus Christ is our High Priest & no more animal sacrifices are needed; tithing was a “salary” for High Priest), and political dominance, and very light on the Word of God. This is a “new era religion”  that emerged no so long ago (!).  Not Holy Spirit filled like other reviews mentioned. No mentioning of Holy appointed times ( I was attending during Feast of Trumpets), no touching on prophecies, the worship was very sleepy. I have been attending for a few months to get a better feel after the original visit which left me with heavy feeling but I won’t be returning. I've been to this church probably about 10 times.  The last time I went is probably the last time I will ever go.  There's a difference between charismatic and spirit filled.  This church is charismatic, but not spirit filled in my opinion.  Specifically my wife and I had an unpleasant experience where the woman at the front was very rude to us in telling us to move seats.  Situations like this separate the charismatic from the spirit filled.  Every church should very carefully decide who they put at the door of their church as this person, in many cases, is the face of the church. In my opinion this church is looking for warm bodies and not spirit filled people.

On the other hand they do have a good youth ministry and the few times I've met the senior pastor he's been a very genuine person.  Also, my wife said she liked their women's group alot.  There are definitely some positives about this church, but it doesn't seem like their turning out spirit filled people.  Just animated charismatic people that are a bit rude when their true spirit is tested.  It appears the seeds here are not being planted in good soil.

name: Trinity Church Dallas (Highland Park Location) - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
Living in the Lemmon/Oak lawn area this is a great walking stop!
✔️ Brandon at Smitten Coffee is open till 2:30 and makes the best hot chai!
✔️  Bring a friend, your lap top and get some things done
✔️ kill a little time watching dogs play in the little doggy park!

We just hosted a ladies sat a.m. get together in the hospitality room - lovely, bright fresh with big windows
Exceptional bathrooms (important 😉)
Love the people.
Thank you, Meredith, for all you do to make others feel welcome Came here for the first time last Sunday and really liked it! Definitely wanting to go back. Nice…inspiring and inviting. I like it. God bless her soul for being so beautiful and caring.

name: Trinity Church Denver - Denver Campus
reviewSummary: Brian's preaching is solid meat! What a wonderful brother in Christ! I 10/10 would recommend him as someone capable of shepherding your family well, while also preaching the Word of God faithfully! The Liturgy at Trinity Church is excellent. These men would be great to follow into spiritual battle with. God bless Trinity Church Denver! Attended an excellent conference here on Raising Families in the Secular City. An outpost of sanity and truth in the darkness. We've been attending Trinity for several years and made our beliefs known through membership.  The community is incredible and the family we have at Trinity is something we treasure. Beautiful church

name: Trinity Church in Menlo Park (An Episcopal Community) - Menlo Park Campus
reviewSummary: I appreciate that they are offering online services and have an excellent ensemble of musicians and devoted community leaders featured weekly. Great community. Family friendly. Awesome sermons. All are welcomed. This church is friendly with beautiful grounds an d a great day care Wonderful baroque Christmas concert. What a treat! A lovely and warm Christian community

name: Trinity Church of Greenville - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
We love the worship services at Trinity and have felt each one to have been truly inspired, filled with a distinct humbleness and a deep longing and commitment to know the triune God and understand the teachings of Jesus Christ. The congregation, while small, is incredibly welcoming and genuine. The building is an absolute gem and so is Pastor Toni Pate. There is space for everyone here because this is truly a church that patterns itself after Jesus. Lastly, the church has undergone some wonderful recent renovations and has a top notch area for children. Our toddler loves it, but he needs more friends... so give it a try! 😊 I have been attending for a year and absolutely love this community, their vision, and feel so loved. Beautiful and vibrant church. Relevant and intelligent teaching with genuinely friendly and diverse congregation. I attended a morning worship on 10/18/20
. A wonderful church and congregation! Meetings of sorts are held here. It's got a lot of history behind it.

name: Trinity Church of Sunnyvale - Sunnyvale Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended for a while. Music is good, men's group on Mondays 630 is great. Women's ministry is minimal and lacks. I've hoped for a prayer ministry, prayer for after service maybe? You can walk in and walk out without notice at times. Seems it's been the same people for a long time w lil change. Seeing yelp previous to mine, it's evident it needs a revival.
I'll be praying . A pantry, volleyball league held there, but ..... I just hope more happens eventually I really appreciate Trinity opening up their facility to AARP volunteers who perform a WONDERFUL public service: they do taxes for SENIORS for FREE! I went there to have my taxes done & submitted electronically. I paid $200 the last 2 yrs to H & R Block, so this was a terrific savings for me! 👏The church & grounds are lovely, the church receptionist was friendly & helpful! Trinity🙏🏼Church is Wonderful & I appreciate their community involvement.👍 Everyone is super friendly. We went to the fall festival and were welcomed like family. Then we went for a Sunday service, and our son had a great time at Sunday school, so we actually got to enjoy the spirited worship. My son is still playing with the craft they made in class. Revive Presbyterian Church has their service on Sunday at 4pm in the Trinity Hall. Enjoyed our time at the Revive service greatly and plan to go again. Very welcoming and warm people. Amazingly generous church! They have opened up their space to the community so all kids of sports and activities happen here. They have even made space available for smaller churches to gather and meet here. Trinity is a true blessing on the area.

name: Trinity Church Wall Street
reviewSummary: Where faith meets the financial district. Known for world-class music and a deep commitment to social justice.

name: Trinity Community Church - San Rafael Campus
reviewSummary: Great community, new building, cool tech setup for a small church. Pastor Will is a very gentle and wise man. Welcoming and comfortable seating, Pastor Will and his wife Martha blessed and filled with Holy Spirit!

name: Trinity Community Church-EFC
reviewSummary:
Excellent middle-road (between liberal and conservative, maybe wee bit more on conservative side) Evangelical Free Church of America small community church (the only EFCA in the triangle region). ESV Bible translation usage. Modern Christian songs in lieu of hymnal. Communion regularly, but not every week. Biblical doctrine is sound - sermons use many direct Biblical references, as well as a tiny bit of delving into some Greek/Hebrew words once in a while. Sunday school for adults before service during non-summer months feels like light seminary school. Small children's youth section, but we definitely need more kiddos so it can grow. Drop-in daycare is provided for youngins for the service if you prefer, but don't have to utilize. Everyone is extremely extremely kind and welcoming with that small community, family feel. We've been attending Trinity Community Church for 10+ years and we enjoy the friends and fellowship there. The preaching is deeply Biblical. Come check us out!! Caring and gospel proclaiming church…Excellent preaching, prayer and fellowship!  Love visitors!!!
Susie Folk Excellent sermon Sunday on Stewardship. Wonderful caring small congregation.

name: Trinity Cristo Rey Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church. I miss it when I am not there to worship. Its a small congregation. We enjoy each others company and the best of all we have some amazing Pastors' sharing and teaching us the gospel! Might not be hip, but it's all about Jesus! My church and second home. Small loving congregation. English speaking and Spanish speaking are all welcome to join and praise the Lord for his many blessings. We enjoy coming to Trinity Cristo Rey and all the friends we have made!  A very Family friendly Church.  God is good! Nice church and the stand in pastor is amazing My home place of worship.

name: Trinity Episcopal Cathedral
reviewSummary:
Candlelight Concerts definitely made up for the cancellation.  The Drella Quartet was fantastic and location at the historic church awesome.  I hope they add “One Vision” to their Queen set.  Highly recommend going to one of these concerts. The Candlelight Concert-‘A Tribute to Taylor Swift’ was outstanding. What a wonderful atmosphere and the acoustics in the Cathedral were great!  So relaxing with all the candles and lighting. The MC, part of the quartet, was excellent and made the evening even more engaging.
What a memorable experience! Beautiful church. I’ve never attended a service. However, in 2023 I was homeless… my fellow ladies at my shelter brought me here for an outreach event they had, and had a lovely lunch. All the volunteers / spiritual leaders at this church gave me good vibes and made me feel normal at a time when it was easy to feel the worst I felt about myself. A special organization that stood out in my humble origin story of abruptly moving to Pittsburgh after becoming suddenly homeless. Big thank you to them! (Bonus: Stunning part of my Pittsburgh church core architecture photos) Beautiful scene of candles. Intimate experience and the music of Queen was great! The only thing I would have changed is offering the performance at a venue that offers tiered seating so the audience has a better view of the stage, candles and musicians. The performance of Queen was held at a church. The pews were a bit uncomfortable for an hour show. But it was nice and the musicians were great to listen too! This checked all the boxes for us. Affordable, beautiful venue,  classic music, classical style, and relaxing vibe. Loved the personality of the groups into to the set. Very unique date we will do again.

name: Trinity Episcopal Cathedral Downtown Campus
Trinity Episcopal Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Warm, inviting to young and old - and all ages in between.  A great mix between contemporary and traditional.  During "COVID Sheltering," Trinity  offers an excellent Zoom service at 9 am on Sunday morning. Sprouts is a good store, for sure! Glad to have it in our neighborhood! Such a beautiful memorial service for my wife's grandmother. Thank you for making a tough day a special one to remember. Companions of the Holy Cross meet there regularly. Prayed for me Deb and Jack

Trinity Episcopal Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
I don't know this as a church, but as a singing group, it's great! We rent out some space for our rehearsals and sometimes our concerts. Please join us! We are a ladies barbershop group. We meet Monday nights at 7pm.

AA groups also meet here, and they are happy with their meeting place as well. Pricing is much more affordable this year. They take really good care of this garden and there are many available. They have a portapotty and now tables with benches so you can picnic here if you have a plot. Mother Meg is outstanding.  Her sermons are on point and inclusive, brings you into the teaching. She is socially active and a joy to have discussions with. I took my 90 day token at an NA meeting here and everyone was so welcoming and friendly and supportive! Awesome place! This is a great caring church. People are warm and inviting. Mother Meg gives great sermons, and genuinely cares for her parisheners.

name: Trinity Episcopal Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi everyone ☺️
If you have a special event to plan and need the space to do it, reach out to the Trinity Church for more information to book the space. Sunday Refuge Recovery meetings at 7pm. Come and get down with breathing and love! A shadow of its former self....its huge pipe organ lies silent, its choir stalls empty.  The tiny remnant of congregation is friendly, but WHAT HAPPENED HERE? They host great CMA meetings at 8pm on Mondays and Fridays My new main church.  Very inclusive people here

name: Trinity Episcopal Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Warm welcoming community with active youth program.  Choir and music are outstanding.  Community is involved with community outreach.  The have several unique services throughout the year including Gay Pride Sunday, Native American Sunday, Youth Sunday, Kirkin of the Tartans and others. Social events include Mother's Day Brunch and Octoberfest.  Trintiy Camp an annual week-long camp for children is a tradition that is over 100 years in the making.  All are Welcome. This school is such an amazing school! The teachers are very loving an kind and also take their time with their students! My 2 children attend here! My children have advanced so much within the semester Beautiful old church, friendly and welcoming congregation and clergy.  Worship bends slightly Anglo-Catholic. Better-than-average music.  Choral Evensong every few months or so with outstanding chamber choir. It's 5-star on a variety of points best discovered by attending....oldest worship edifice in Redlands, built circa 1867, shortly after the Smileys arrived. Currently taking too much advice from England and it shows in the issues we pray for ardently and those deemed "commonplace." No longer reflecting other Universities along the Coast well.  Well-mannered, quiet place of reflection to raise musically-inclined children! My Great Aunt Georgie Petit. Aunt Georgie gave this world more than 100 years of a beautiful life well lived. Trinity honored her as she passed from this world to the next. I was moved by the love that sad day in January made all the better by the open and welcoming hearts of Christ and our families. Greg Chase

name: Trinity Life Church
reviewSummary: Such a sweet gathering of people who really love Jesus and each other. Excellent teaching. Great for singles and families So thankful for the people and the strong, solid Biblical teaching. Wonderful welcoming church community.

name: Trinity Life Church - Dacula / Hamilton Mill Campus
reviewSummary: Trinity Life Church is a great church. You will grow spiritually with other believers who love God and each other as well. I recommend anyone who is looking for a Church home to attend. Very impressed with everyone I met. Looking forward to going back. Sound, bible based Christian church. The Pastor of this congregation is working really hard to get the community involved.  Visited on a Wednesday night to hear a brief message from Rep Chuck Effstration. The very first time my family and I met (TLC) we felt like family. Now since then it's been a wonderful journey!! There is so much I can say about TLC. I thank God for this ministry and my church leaders, Pastor and Lady Brunson ❤️

name: Trinity Life Church - Durham Campus
reviewSummary: Such a sweet gathering of people who really love Jesus and each other. Excellent teaching. Great for singles and families So thankful for the people and the strong, solid Biblical teaching.

name: Trinity Life Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve had the privilege of serving at this church and have seen firsthand the genuine care the staff and volunteers have for the community. The messages are biblically grounded, the worship is uplifting, and there’s a welcoming atmosphere for people from all walks of life. I’ve watched lives be impacted through the church’s ministries and outreach, and I’m grateful to be part of what God is doing here. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow in your faith and build meaningful relationships, this is a wonderful place to visit. Trinity Life Church in Las Vegas is a welcoming and uplifting church. Dr. Robert Griffith, the new Lead Pastor, brings strong biblical teaching, fresh vision, and a genuine heart for people. His messages are encouraging, practical, and filled with hope. I’m excited to see what God continues to do through Trinity Life Church. Trinity Life Church is a blessed church in downtown Las Vegas. Dr. Robert Griffith brought a powerful word that was clear, real, and full of truth. You can feel the love, the faith, and the heart for the community. It’s a place where families can come together, worship, and be encouraged. Been going to this church for over 10 years. If you want an encounter with the Holy Spirit, this is the church to be at every Sunday morning. Worship is beautiful and the message is always rooted in the Word of God. Beautiful church and felt very welcome by the staff & congregation for the Sunday 10 am service during our visit in town. Worship was amazing and Pastor Randy was right on with his message. God bless them all!  We will be sure to stop in again!!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: Beautiful church with a wonderful congregation. As soon as I entered the Church I was greeted with a warm welcome and after service, the congregation gathered for fellowship with coffee and snacks. I have been looking for a good Lutheran church in the greater St Petersburg area and I'm satisfied with this one.  The sermon was good and the music was spiritually uplifting.  In the end, they even had a little solo with the pianist. I left there spiritually lifted and will go back. Really good place with a strong support for the community! This church has alcoholics anonymous meetings and other 12-step recovery meetings. And they provide food and shelter for the homeless. Do all of these programs they had become a very large part of the community. They truly seem to care about the community that they live in Very caring and nice people who serve the community. This Church has one of the kindest Pastors I have ever met. They are always doing clothes drives, food drives and offer comfort and support to the less fortunate. Pastor Paul has the most beautiful singing voice I have ever heard in any Lutheran Church and I would encourage everyone to come and hear his sermon on Sundays. Great location and overall welcome appearance

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
We are beyond grateful for this school. The environment is loving, nurturing, and truly focused on helping children learn and grow at their own pace. We have seen so much learning and development, and it’s clear how much care and dedication the teachers put into each child.

Communication with parents is excellent—we always feel informed, supported, and included. We also deeply appreciate that the school teaches children about God and strong values, which means so much to our family.

We feel very blessed to be part of this school community and highly recommend it to any family looking for a caring, faith-based environment. Great preschool and daycare facilities. My daughter attended this school through Junior High School. The facility currently has pre k and after school care. We are praying they will expand there curriculum and include kindergarten classes so our grand daughter can continue a Christ based education with caring and nurturing Christ centered people. We love what the educators and Pastor Elmore have created here. The preschool and church are family! They have been foundational to my children's early education with strong academics, a loving faculty, with an emphasis on fun that inspires creativity. TLC continues to bless us through the church. We are honored to call this place our home church. We love Trinity Lutheran Christian School and Preschool.  Trinity has a wonderful staff, high academic standards and teaches Biblical truths and character traits! Wonderful school with really caring faculty and staff! The academics are top notch and the Christian environment is warm and sincere.

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Grand Island Campus
Trinity Lutheran Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Very good groups of all kinds held there even Mothers meeting oldest in long beach history. Gorgeous church. Incredible pastor and congregation. I'm going back for sure. First time was the best. Thankful for the food/clothing distribution on the fourth Saturday of the month at 10:30 a.m. The pastors are very friendly! Awesome Sunday night NA meeting held here. Attended a beautiful wedding here. Kind people and inspiring message. Loved it!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Main Campus
Trinity Lutheran Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I noticed how austere this church looks ordinarily, so I wanted to get intimate with it in optimal light. Warm and welcoming congregation. Bright and articulate, kind and caring Pastor. Very involved in mission to the community. They have a weekly food bank and work with the community emergency shelter. Review their programs and photos and see. Thursday Rejoicing Spirits service Beautiful, historic church with wonderful stained glass windows, a welcoming minister and congregation, and Sunday services (with Communion) at 8:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. I have been a member of this church since I can remember.  From Sunday school, vacation bible school every summer, my first communion, confirmation, quinceanera, and wedding.  I have many fond memories.

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Enjoyed the service of worship and praise very inviting congregation ! Everyone filled with Love and concern. First time guests receive free gifts relating to God. They gave free food and a free sermon on CD. Very personal church. After service you get to meet the Pastor and chat for a minute. The pastor delivers a powerful and insightful message sermon. Church very well kept and I truly felt blessed in my spirit AMEN Mister Pastor Lance is one outgoing and charismatic speaker.  I was honoured that he invited Britta and I to the ARK for life fundraiser.  The church is great.  If you are looking for a house of worship, check this church out. Trinity Lutheran Church is a relevant community place that seeks to bring all who enter it's doors to the hope, love, and forgiveness of our Lord Jesus Christ. The pastor here currently is Pastor Lance Irey and the decon is Gene Bohat, and they are absolutely amazing people and very welcoming. Everyone here is so nice and so welcoming it's like a second home to me, and the services here are a lovely traditional format. Trinity is also a grounds for 2 other  churches called  CDC or Christian development center & Revive Christian church, both of which also offer amazing services with great pastors. CDC is a more modern approach and revive is a spanish speaking church. I'm sure that all who come here will feel welcomed and blessed. 🙏🙏 It's a church ya'll,  with a cross no less. VERY CLEAN CHURCH , SMELLS AMAZING AND GREAT STAFF

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I was happy that I got to visit Trinity today. It is a beautiful church. This church is trying to bring the congregation back to pre pandemic days as is my church, it's difficult. The message on Sunday was biblically based, but set in a business setting.
I am an outgoing person, so I got to meet most of the people by going up and introducing myself, although there were a handful that greeted me.
I was glad that I was invited to their luncheon workshop, I was able to meet another group of people, and I was able to participate in the workshop, even though I was just visiting. I got some insight as to what my church can do better.
In closing I just want to share that although I was a visitor, I did not feel like a stranger, because I was in the midst of other children of God, and that was what united me with both those that greeted me, as well as those who did not. It was a pleasurable experience. They hold AA meetings here, there is a meeting known as the Casa Blanca into action meeting every Thursday here at 7:30 pm. If your looking to stop drinking, need a sponsor, or just looking to hear a story with a good spiritual message then definitely make the time to stop by here and sit in for one of the meetings, you definitely won't regret it The pastor makes the church pastor Kent is soft spoken ,compassionate and easy to talk to.My wife and I embrace his genuine influence . Great church and great programs ay Trinity. Incredibly friendly congregation. Lutheran services - one more contemporary & one tradional. Excellent music & fabulous Pastor!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church & miss the congregation and Pastor very much since moving out of state. The people here are warm, friendly and caring. Pastor Jeff is wonderful as a minister. I highly recommend this church 'family' to worship with or learn about our Lord and Saviour. Tremendous education and leadership in to faith, love and a understanding of all. A caring group of people with strong community outreach. These people truly walk with the lord. Apparently this is the address of where the famous Super Smash Bros. Melee Wombo Combo happened I attended this church every Sunday with my Mom when I was growing up. 😊 It is my church and I love going there!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Best people ever!
People are warm and inviting without being overbearing. No one looks down on anyone else. Trinity is The children's ministry here is known throughout the community due to the God Rocks musicals performed winter and spring. I've been to churches all over the world.  I believe this is one of the best I've ever been to. There is a warm family atmosphere that has activities for every age group. The leadership and preaching is excellent. If your looking for a church that sticks to Bible, and want to develop friendships with solid Christians this is the place to come. This church and it's members are truly a blessing in my life.
So many things going on.
I've found a home, they have been so very welcome to me and my service animal. I was introduced to the church by a wonderful friend of mine. I also love Trinity Church.  True Gospel Living from the teaching of the pastors.
I wish I could do much more as a volunteer but it is almost impossible to get around.  The congregation has been very loving toward me and that's what I need.  Thank The Lord for that. One of the best churches I’ve ever attended. Great fellowship, the congregation of people are so wonderful and friendly,  It overwhelms me with delight, in addition to our Pastor Nathan,  Exceptional Pastor, Preacher And teacher,  very smart intelligent guy, makes thinks easy to understand, inspirational like a Joel Osteen and a T. D.. Jakes, combination!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church Temecula - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely school and staff went for a conference, nice location, near old town and the freeway. I love the open space where the cross sits in the picture, nice size classrooms and the sanctuary was small and cozy. I am very thankful for Trinity Lutheran. Pastor Jim and his wife, Jennifer, are excellent. I always feel cared about and welcomed when I enter and leave this terrific church. The staff compliments the experience of belonging here. If you haven't found your church home, give Trinity a try. A loving God is there. The people at Trinity are so warm and genuine.  Went to the preschool
Veterans Day parade, and it was awesome. Trinity Lutheran Church is the most reverent and welcoming church my family and I have ever attended. The Pastor preaches in truth and love, and genuinely cares about the salvation of others. The staff are the hardest working, warmest people I’ve ever met. And as great as all that is, what tops it off, is that Christ is truly at the center of it all. This is a Bible based church focusing on God's love for us and our response to that love. There are multiple community outreach projects because we are part of the larger community of Temecula. Our hope is to show God's love by our actions towards each other and to our visitors.
