name: Trinity Lutheran Preschool And Kindergarten, Temecula - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE Trinity Lutheran Preschool! The staff is so warm and caring! My children look forward to going to school everyday! Classrooms are clean, safe, and full of fun learning activities! My kids and I feel safe and supported by the staff! Couldn’t have chosen a better school for my kids. Thank you! We were looking for a preschool; we found a community & ultimately an extended family at Trinity! The teachers are caring, patient, and truly invested in each child's growth. We are grateful that our children are learning in a safe, nurturing, faith-based environment where kindness and Christian values are #1 We absolutely love Trinity Preschool! Our daughter started in the toddler classroom when she was 2½ years old, and we have been so grateful for our experience.

I was so nervous to drop her off at school for the first time, but the teachers are incredibly warm, kind, and welcoming. They have helped her feel loved and confident from day one.

She has blossomed so much over the past year, and we’re so excited for her to begin the preschool classroom this week!

The teachers put so much thought and creativity into the art projects, hands-on activities, and classroom experiences. She loves bringing home her artwork and talking about the fun things she did at school.

We also feel confident in Trinity’s commitment to safety. The school has excellent safety protocols in place and does a wonderful job communicating with families, which gives us so much peace of mind.

The staff truly goes above and beyond by planning special events that bring families together and create such a strong sense of community. We especially love the music performances the children work so hard to prepare for. Watching them perform is always such a joy!

We are incredibly thankful we found Trinity Preschool and couldn’t recommend it more highly! Our family has been part of this preschool for the past four years, and we truly can't say enough wonderful things about it. From the moment we enrolled, we've felt like more than just another family—we've felt like we belong.

The teachers and staff genuinely love and care for each child, and it shows. Our kids have always felt safe, excited to learn, and have grown so much academically, socially, and emotionally.

Some of our favorite memories have been the Christmas program and the Mother's Day celebration. These special traditions are so thoughtfully planned and create memories our family will always treasure.

As busy working parents, we also really appreciate the school's communication. The reminders about upcoming events and important dates help us stay connected and never miss out on the special moments.

We are incredibly grateful for the love, care, and exceptional education our children have received. If you're looking for a preschool where your children will truly be known, loved, and prepared for the future, we couldn't recommend Trinity more! Truly such an amazing place! The staff are incredibly kind and caring and the activities they prepare for the kids are fun and engaging. We are so thankful our son got to spend 3 years here!

name: Trinity New York - East Village - New York Campus
reviewSummary: I love this EV location! Is such an intimate and cozy space, perfect to make friends, talk about Jesus and build up your faith 🫶🏼 This church is amazing! It’s a place to worship God in an environment that makes me feel welcome and loved. This is a great ministry! People who become your family 🫶🏼 I’ve been part of this church for two years now, and it’s truly been life-changing. If you’re looking for a church in New York City that feels like home, talks about Jesus, and inspires you to grow, this is the place for you!🏙️ Love serving here, and I particularly love how PT And PK use their personal experiences and relate them to biblical times, it's so much easier to understand the Bible when you relate it to current events. It makes service enjoyable, My daughter also loves church kids, and connecting with all the other kids, the teachers always have fun projects and activities, and I love when she tells me a new thing she leans about God, and Jesus. Also service is 1 hour, not.4-5 hours like other churches I've been to. Love this place, highly recommend. I love this Church.. 10/10 would recommend to those who haven’t accepted Christ, those new in the faith, and the veterans! Got something for everyone.

name: Trinity New York - Upper West Side - New York Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love this place—it’s the best church I’ve ever been a part of. It’s truly changed my life and strengthened my walk with God. I found a genuine sense of community here, made friends and even got baptized. What makes it even more special is that it’s local and led by millennial pastors who come from a strong lineage of ministry. Their teaching is rich, deep, and rooted in biblical truth. Every Sunday, I feel welcomed, seen, and excited to be there. This is what the church is! I’m so happy there’s a church that understands the importance of creating a space to meet with God, and build community! God bless and protect this ministry in Jesus name. At Trinity New York I found community and friendships with amazing girls, who pray for me and have become my best friends. I love everything about this church from the worship to the preaching, and I’m so blessed to have found my church home. This has been my home church for the past three years, and what a glorious journey it has been. I can share my own testimony and it’s one filled with gratitude and awe. I’m so deeply moved that these two young people chose to come to the busiest, wildest city on earth and bless us with their unwavering obedience to God. Church often feels like a hospital a place full of broken, hurting people seeking healing. But here, in this sacred space, we are not only mended ..we are restored, renewed, and reminded of our purpose in Christ. It’s where grace meets growth, and where faith takes root in community. I’m genuinely overjoyed to be part of this body, this journey, and this move of God. This is a Church for everyone. The lost who are seeking God for the first time, and the mature in their faith. This Chruch sticks to the word of God and pursues people who are far from God with love, grace and truth! 🙌

name: Trinity Ohio City Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary: We love Trinity Lutheran Church!  Not only because of the  beautiful architecture but also because we have family roots at Trinity.  There are wonderful organ concerts that take place.  There is also great comfort knowing that both the Law and Gospel are preached to God’s people after its founding almost 150 years later. This place is breath taking. The congregation is extremely nice as well! Definitely recommend. Helps the community as a whole spiritually. They also help those who may need help with food with a food pantry and they also help cloth those who need it as well. Beautiful church with a fantastic organ presentation . they have been very supportive of my recovery

name: Trinity Presbyterian Church of Orange County - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: What draws me back to this church is its desire make Jesus the center of their lives. The messages spoken here aren't your typical self-help sermons. It centers around who Jesus is, and who we are in relationship to Him. The truth that finally sets us free. Freedom from our restlessness, into joy and peace. The people aren't perfect, but that's the point. The church allows people like me to come as I am, and be welcome to ask the difficult questions, and to struggle through them together. No judgement, but freedom to pursue truth in community. I go here for A.A. meetings so by default I have to give it a 10/10 because it's a great building to rent for a couple times through the week. Been in churches most of my life, this  church has the best of everything, people, pastor, programs, music, and love!!

name: Trinity San Diego Assemblies of God - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
My mom and me were visiting the area for a family bridal shower last Sunday. We wanted to find a church close by the celebration. My mom gets the credit for finding this awesome church.

I really liked the vibe and like that it is a church where the Holy Spirit is welcome and invited….super hospitable. Both Pastor Todd and his wife Katie are friendly, warm and involved in the church too. The moment we walked in the church we were greeted and offered donuts and coffee. Then, we loved the nice welcoming touch with the sign that says, this seat has been prayed over (or something along those lines…).

I love that their prayer meeting is at 7am and it’s via zoom. I have been to other churches and they are in the evening or during my workday. I think I can participate.

The church seems very pro community and wanted to help out and get involved by building churches in Mexico and beginning to help foster families which I think are both amazing causes.

I’d love to visit and bring my family of five back especially after seeing their children’s church room had a slide 😂!!if you’re thinking about visiting, do it! You will be blessed 😊. We went to this wonderful church  for Easter Service at the invitation of our family who are members ! Great message , warm and welcoming congregation too   ! They have been praying for us as we endured life changing events w our health , and are grateful for the power of prayer 🙏🏻 Truly a place that my entire family can call "home."  Vulnerable, practical, bible-based teaching, riveting worship experience, connect groups everyday of the week and a fantastic children's program. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area (or online!) Love this church and filled with love! The presence of the Lord is there and his word is not just spoken but also brought fourth in action. His grace and mercy is made evediant in the life of the people. My mental health state is not very good, I am trying to cope with memory loss
I don't want to cause any problems for anyone, I just want to be Grateful for the time I have left,Thank you Jesus for everything 🙏

name: Trinity United Methodist Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
They are doing so much for the community. I love this place… Melissa and her dad Steve are amazing. The pastor Miss Debra is awesome. The work they do with the homeless population is amazing. Got to tour the sanctuary- beautiful.  A shame the parishioners are too few to take advantage of it. A Common Community’s Historical Place Love Melissa pastor Debra is outstandingly amazing I love this Church Suga Time LLC
Minister Dedria Medlock I was homeless, and this Church provided food and shelter until I could find another place. God bless this church family.

name: Trinity United Methodist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: This is a beautiful church where my mother's funeral service was held. One could imagine just as easily a beautiful wedding here as well. The outside of the building does not portray the beauty of its inner sanctum. There is a quintessential courtyard at the center of the building. Even a skeptic like me could imagine angels dancing to celebrate the new love of marriage or an angelic entourage welcoming a tired soul home to heaven. It is an old, yet beautiful church with a vintage air that makes one feel there is a connection to the other world within its doors. Church in there is a kitchen and medium sized reception hall upstairs. It's a simple, no-frills  space, but efficient and economical. Staff was very friendly and helpful during this mournful time for me and my family and we are profoundly grateful. I was baptized in this church. Ive was married and baptized my children here also. It is a beautiful church with a lot of history. OK place to worship. It has indoor court and a large theater chamber for events. Was used in the 2017 movie "I Believe ". Good movie. Only place in Pomona where the homeless can shower when the shelter isn't open.

name: Trinity United Methodist Church - Ontario Campus
Trinity United Methodist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus

name: Trinity United Methodist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: When there for a be prepared disaster training presentation. The staff was very nice, and the speaker was very knowledgeable . It's a neat little church! They're progressive in their theology, but don't beat you over the head with it. They're supportive and affirming of LGBT+ folks, and it just feels like your little local church, with a few great surprises when you visit. The music, for example, is phenomenal. It's a great church! I love the sense of community at Trinity Unity Methodist Church. Is very warm and loving and compassionate. This is because it's a small congregation. Love this very Welcoming Church.  And Celebrate Recovery is Awesome. I used to visit on Christmas Eve. Nice service s. I wish Pastor Tim was still there.

name: Trinity United Presbyterian Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great praise and worship music and solid Bible teaching, genuine Christian folks at Sunday School who love the Lord and bate about each other, and this church is  supporting Jesus' command to go to all nations and make disciples. Highly recommend this church. What a welcoming church!
We have been very grateful for the presence of the Spirit in this place & the transformation of lives we’ve witnessed.
May you know the joy of being welcomed into community here, too!
God is good, all the time. All the time, gGod is good. Very caring and intelligent group of believers.  Wonderful children's and young adult programs. Loving our neighbors. Came back to my childhood church to join in their 150th anniversary celebration. Came all the way from Maine to California. Was not disappointed. First attended Trinity about 8 years ago after moving to Orange County. Immediately knew we had found our church home. The worship, music and preaching make Sunday mornings a highlight of every week. Off the charts children's and youth ministry. Deeply invested in partnership with many local and international ministries that address physical, emotional and spiritual needs. Easy to find a way to make a difference by serving at the church and in the community.

name: Trinity World Christian Center - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary: If you're looking for a church home, the doors are always open. Great pastor and teacher and family members, as well as church members, come and let the spirit of God be with you today and every day. The Prasie team and the greeters will make you feel very much at home. Great place to worship. I felt at home the very first time I visited. All members welcome you and the senior Pastor is amazing and 💯 real!! See you there! Trinty is an amazing church. The people there are very friendly and loving. I absolutely love the atmosphere. Wonderful place to worship Please stop on by You'll be Glad You Did!!! Family is Family around these parts. Awesome music as well

name: Trinity-Central Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful, warm congregations. Spanish service at 9:30, English at 10:00 and Korean at 11:30. Always a blessing. As long as there aren't any homeless people nearby, it is an old building but well-organized and clean. Dear fellow parishioners with beautiful and warm hearts! Thank you.

name: Triumphant Christian Center Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: I think it’s location would be better Woodland Ave.,or closer Pilgrim Baptist Church needs a minister. They are kind caring people. My mother said she would join his church. True Christians are hard to find. Amazing Pastor! Fire at the pulpit! I get hungry for my Sunday message!! Very friendly,  welcoming and family oriented!! Serving God authentically and genuinely! Wonderful place to worship and learn how to life a Christ life. Very nice church the people there very friendly Great place

name: Troy Assembly of God
reviewSummary: Great church.  Small enough to be very personable. Pastor Bob preaches directly.l from the bible and serves communion on the first Sunday of the month. I have been attending 13+ years. I've known Pastor Bob and the pastoral staff here for over 20 years. He is a godly man and takes his calling seriously. He is a friend to the most vulnerable and will always speak truth and preach Gods best and hope over you.  One of those rare places you automatically feel at home. God's Holy Spirit is in this House. We went there before its a good loving church We Feel So welcomed there with Pastor Bob as their leader(: Pastor Bob and his staff are so welcoming and generous. The first Saturday of each month is a Men's Prayer Breakfast where we come together to pray for our loved ones, receive an encouraging word from the Bible, and pray for our country. It's a true blessing. This is a small church and the people are sincere. They really do care about every person.  The pastor and wife have wisdom and are very down to earth!! Great group of people that love God!

name: Troy Christian Chapel
reviewSummary:
This is a beautiful non/interdenominational, locally-governed group of believers in the Jesus who is described in the continually improved and updated protestant version of the Bible, which they take to be the authentic and eternally and entirely true written words of God, when fully and properly interpreted.

At least, that’s what I took away from it.

So, overall, when compared with every other religious tradition known to man, and pretty much every denomination, this one quite based.

I am biblically proud and grateful that it was the church I was raised in and trained in.

I always feel welcome here when I visit. This is where we meet for our CBS Bible study on Tuesday evenings. What a wonderful church to open their doors for us.  Thank you Troy Christian chapel, how nice of you. The pastors and the people are very friendly. The teaching is sound and relevant. I love TCC! I went online to check out the events calendar and easily found what I needed. Very comfortable and homey. Everyone welcomes you!

name: Troy Church of Christ
reviewSummary: Troy Church (Troy Church of Christ) has been apart of my story for over 40 years and, although I moved down South years ago, the church continues to be a part of my heart to this day. Pastor Manu and the congregation are eqally as amazing at being spiritual leaders as they are being great friends. I try to visit when I am in town visiting family. If you are looking for a new church I recommend you sit in on a sermon and, perhaps, one of these Sundays I might see you there, too. This is a great community Church that we are happy to be attending.  We enjoy the family feel, and the desire of this church body to engage in spiritual self-improvement and growth. Smaller church, but everyone is so very nice! This is a church that you can really feel like a part of a family. Loving, sincere congregation and some of the most inspiring and thought provoking preaching I've encountered. Genuinely caring local church...people that practice what they preach.

name: True Hope Church - Downtown
reviewSummary:
This church preaches prosperity gospel which is a foundational component of a cult mindset that ultimately results in victim blaming when a member is faced with adversity. “If you serve God, you will be blessed and people whose lives are turned upside down are following themselves” is false teaching. This cultivates a reward and punishment system that replaces God’s grace.

Apostle Paul proves this when he states that he begged God to remove the “thorn in his flesh” three times - to no avail. 2 Corinthians 12:9 states, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in weakness.” We don’t need His strength if serving Him resulted in a life of “ease”.

“Jesus suffered so we don’t have to” is a manipulation of the Word of God. John 16:22, “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”

Our purpose is not to strive for a life of “ease”. We grow through our trials and tribulations. Many evil people are successful and “blessed”. We see this every day.

Oftentimes, prosperity gospel teaches that wealth is indicative of a servant of God. This also goes against scripture:

Mark 10:25: "It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God."

Matthew 19:21 “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”

Be careful that certain members of the church aren’t lifted up as “examples” to follow when only Jesus should be lifted up as the example to follow. This can be subtle or not so subtle worship of others which manifests in constant praise of those who serve.

It’s weird. This Church teaches the fundamental basics of living a moral and Godly life.  Our new Pastor has a heart of lion and such a heart for the youth. I am so proud to be a part of such an amazing local body. Praise the Lord for He is Good, His mercy endures forever. They have watermelon, real fruit and donuts and cookies every Sunday not just junk food you're allowed to eat in the chapel. Just use your manners by chewing with mouths closed. We felt like family the first time we walked in the door. That was 15 years ago.  Our children love the youth services and have personal relationships with their mentors. There are so many great small groups to plug into and our pastor gives sermons straight outta scripture. The Saturday foodbank is awesome and we love the community around us to the best of our ability. Thanks for showing us what living out our faith looks like and encouraging us to have a relationship with our Savior instead of just being religious about following rules and preferences. I came to this church as a visitor from out of town. I was welcomed and was encouraged by the message the pastor shared. I liked that it was a friendly atmosphere. They were not pretentious and gladly opened their doors to a newcomer. I hope to be able to come again sometime soon. reviewSummary:
My wife and I have loved being a part of True Life Church for the last 5 years. We are deeply grateful to have a community of believers we can enjoy life with and a pastor who preaches God’s word with conviction I have been attending True Life since 2019, and I can't say enough good things about this wonderful representation of the body of Christ.

The preaching is on point, biblical, and never boring. The worship is beautiful, and not all about the "show". The kids ministry is fun and engaging. And the people a kind, caring, and welcoming.

When I first tried this church, I was immediately welcomed and got plugged in to events, community groups, and small groups. It's not just friendliness- people really wanted to get to know me! And they have always been there to support me (and I them, hopefully) since. The Lord has truly blessed me leading me into this True Life community! We love attending True Life and being a part of this church family.  The teaching is amazing and truly helps you to learn how to apply the Gospel to your own personal life and live and walk with Jesus daily.  We are thankful for a welcoming church and a community that serves and loves each other so well. I grew up in church my entire life, but I can honestly say that I have never experienced the depth of growth that I have had in the time that I have been a part of True Life. Love that every part of the Bible is preached even when it may feel uncomfortable or challenging. The community is also incredible- I have formed the best friendship I've ever had here and I am so thankful for this church! Excellent Biblical preaching. Also many opportunities to be taught on how to apply the Bible to your life. A few characteristics that have stood out to me is how focused True Life is on building community and relationships and caring for and serving one another. I’ve grown so much during my 5 years attending True Life!

name: True Life Fellowship Church - Round Rock Campus
reviewSummary:
Seems like everyone should write a review for the community that has not only become family, but truly acts like it! I witnessed a pregnant first-time visitor who just moved here be asked if they had anyone throwing them a shower. And another family taking in someone who didn't have a place to go. These are the kind of people that attend, and not just that, but they are truly seeking God's heart and fulfilling the great commission on the earth. All kinds, come as you are, and let the Holy Spirit minister to you. Great kids program, worship, and healing rooms too! I’m sure it’s a lovely place if you don’t mind the pastoral staff being passive aggressive or insulting towards people who have different political beliefs than they do.

Or if you want to only find acceptance and community if you are part of the “in crowd.”

Or you want to have the lead pastor, Richard, be more concerned about protecting abusive authority figures from “judgment” and to do so at the expense of supporting survivors in their healing.

The childcare is not equipped to handle neurodivergent kiddos- so if you kid is on the spectrum, or has adhd, or is sensitive, just know they’ll be unsupported and you as the parent will be judged.

The music is okay. I love this church! True Life has become a family and a home outside of home for me. From the moment I walked in the door I felt loved, the young adults pastors have since became close friends and love better than anyone I have ever met. If you want to encounter God and be loved so that you can love others this is the place for you! What a wonderful community orientated and caring non denominational church. I loved the word and worship. We felt very welcome there. There is a great emphasis on relationship, family and love. All aspects of family are catered for here and it is a wonderful place for families. Excellence and love for each other is the spirit I picked up amongst these believers. Will definitely visit again. I first went to True Life right around the time my mom was diagnosed with cancer. That following Monday, while driving to M.D Anderson in Houston, someone from the church called and prayed with us. We could feel God's love during the prayer, the drive, and the treatments. We continued to attend True Life because of the powerful worship, the poignant messages, and the freedom we experienced during the services. Since that first-time, my mom has been healed and is cancer-free, I lift my hands and dance before The Lord, and that man who called and prayed with us is my daughter's youth group leader. If you want to do more than just "go to church" go to True Life.

name: Truth & Triumph Christian Assembly - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful church here in the heart of Redlands, California. The energy is so abundant and welcoming. Highly recommend everyone to check this place out. A amazing church filled with the Holy Spirit! Felt like family as soon as I walked in. The pastor preaches solely on God’s Word and never adds or subtracts from it. You can feel the power and FIRE of God here! I was attending a JogDawgs running event next to this church when I needed to use the restroom. I politely asked a greeter if I could use the facilities and was told they were only for people attending the service.

While I understand policies may exist, this felt unnecessarily unwelcoming given the church’s location beside a public community event. Churches are often seen as places of hospitality, and I hope there is more awareness of how interactions like this impact visitors and the surrounding community. An amazing church where the Holy Ghost is present everything I attend their services. Very encouraging environment and the people are so kind. Misleading and Disappointing Experience

We attended this church’s “back-to-school” event expecting, as the flyer suggested, a school supply and backpack giveaway. Instead, it turned into something very different — and honestly, very misleading.

We arrived about an hour early, stood in line in the blistering Redlands heat for over an hour, and were asked for our names, phone numbers, and how many kids we had before being led into their assembly room. Inside was unbearably hot — my husband almost passed out — and there was no water or refreshments for the families who had already been waiting for hours.

Instead of quickly distributing backpacks, the event turned into a nearly hour-long sermon. The pastor repeatedly said he was “just about to pray” but instead kept speaking about parents being on drugs, which was disheartening and felt like an unfair assumption about the community. At one point, people were asked to come forward to “surrender to Jesus.” A woman even approached my children asking if she could “take them” to pray, despite us politely declining multiple times.

Families with young kids, including one mom who had been waiting since 6 AM with five kids, were left hungry, thirsty, and frustrated. The flyer never mentioned that we would be required to sit through a lengthy service before receiving any supplies.

If the event was intended to be a ministry service first and foremost, it should have been clearly stated. We would have made an informed choice and avoided putting our children through that uncomfortable and disappointing experience. We will not be returning.

We came for a backpack giveaway — instead, we got over an hour in the scorching sun, then forced into a hot room for a long sermon. No water, no snacks, and kids were hungry and uncomfortable. The flyer never said we’d have to sit through a ministry service.

When we asked for water, we were told to go back inside. When we asked for backpacks, they seemed reluctant and told us to go back in to “finish the ministry” first. Only after pushing did someone finally give us a backpack so we could leave.

If this was meant to be a church service, it should have been stated upfront. This felt manipulative, and we won’t be back.

We appreciate all the yummy food we're given here, thank you all so very much! Best church of the people, by the people AND doing good deeds for the people. Great humble people who volunteer to service the homeless and people who are in financial stress.

name: Tulsa Christian Fellowship - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: I received Jesus at TCF. Though many hurdles have been thrown in my path, many of my own making, I learned to return to Jesus at TCF. Jim Garrett, Bill Sanders,  and David & Beth Troutman often come to mind. I believe that the home group ministry was the spearhead that pierced my heart for Jesus. Thank you TCF for what I learned while there. I have been going to TCF for over 20 years. The thing that most attracted me to TCF was that people genuinely loved God and each other. People who are real. This church has become my family! Past member who moved. Had a huge impact on my life. Probably the most New Testament and missions oriented churches anywhere. They make you feel welcomed Missions minded church with caring community; our home church

name: Tulsa Church of Christ - Tulsa Campus
reviewSummary: I had a great week visiting this loving congregation. They practice Bible based teaching and promote a family atmosphere.  I loved the fellowship and worship.  I highly recommend! A place where God's word is preached truly, with a strong family presence. They all want to grow better in service to Christ. Family integrated scriptural Bible teaching! Lovely people. A wonderful group of kind Christians who truly love each other and have a deep desire to serve God! If you're in Tulsa, you'll be so blessed to worship with these lovely people. Family friendly and welcoming to all! Beautiful singing, truthful sermons from God’s word, and it is obvious they love God!

name: Turlock Church of Christ - Turlock Campus
reviewSummary: Very clean! People are welcoming and many baptisms happen here!❤️ My family and I went here last month for their Halloween trunk or treat. It was fun and there was so much to do. The people were friendly. Thanks for the great event. This Church of Christ has been around for many years, and the members will make you feel like family. If you need a friend, prayer, or just someone to listen, there is someone there for everyone. They offer children’s classes for ages 0-17, and adult classes for all others. There is a ladies class that also meets regularly. The church hosts events such as a hot dog lunch during the summer, fun in the sun day, fall festival, progressive dinner and a sweethearts dinner. The church also offers a smaller more intimate setting with their life group families, where you can get to know people better. The Turlock Church of Christ is a warm, welcoming and loving group of people who are interested in each other as well as in the people living in Turlock. It's not a huge congregation, like those I've attended in the past, but this group of people sure make a huge impression in everything they venture to take on Went to a celebration of life there it was cool but different to me.They have no music they sing Accopella.Which was beautiful. And they made a fabulous feast afterwards the food was the best..

name: Turning Point Church - McDonough Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor McMichael and his wife & whole family are awesome people 😁 they love God and they're all about church business!!! 😻 The staff from the front door all the way around is awesome!!! 😎
Their children area is excellent for any age groups. The services are awesome when you're listening and looking for the word of God, the teaching is superior!!! Very family oriented, they treat you really great 😃 they have some awesome classes for you to take. There prayer and praise team is thebomb.com. 😊😇 Their security team does an awesome job!!! If you want Church without all the other stuff this is a great place to go with your family, they love family here. Lots of parking  outside, they have playgrounds for children inside and outside. The cleanliness is awesome!!! The love is tremendous there, they have small groups.
There are always showing  you there respect and  love!!! 💕 😊😇 A wonderful place to serve!!! ❤️ GOT TO LOVE 💕 THIS PLACE!!! Love the worship and the Pastor is very passionate about the word of God.  They have small groups to help further your walk with Christ and the church community is just so loving.  Making a choice to worship here will be the best decision you could make this year. This is a GREAT church. Would definitely recommend. We love it and so do our kids. My partner and I have only been to this location twice, but we already feel at home! I was awestruck on our first visit when I saw they had a coffee shop, store, and indoor playground! They have several different age groups for kids during services, and the rooms are great! They give you a gift on your first visit and send you thank you cards and a letter inviting you to take a “Next Steps” class with them. The pastor is great, the messages are powerful, and it’s so laid back. Casual wear! The band is contemporary and they sound great! They really know how to wake everyone up! Church atmosphere is strong , powerful fellowship, songs, and word. I was a member for a while until I had to take a step back from the church and activities as I experienced discomfort with the intentions of members of the church. Group leader and praise team member, flirted with many married and coupled men. Leading to a strong questioning of the motive of these small groups. Creating a hostile environment for my home and church lifestyle unfortunately.

name: Turning Point Community Church - Lubbock Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church, Amazing people, encourages learning about the word of God! Encourages developing your own opinions. Honestly this church was the first of many on my list to try before I made a decision.....I never tried a different church. They were so amazing, they have several pastors, most of which have checked on me personally. Even helped with food when my sister had surgery! They have never met my sister but were still kind enough to help us out. I LOVE LOVE LOVE this church! It's my home! I’m sorry, but there really needs to be better supervision during Wednesday church. My daughter has tried attending several times over the past year, and she has been bullied every single time. I do have the names of the kids involved.
I’ve also noticed that after dismissal, kids are running into the street and causing problems at nearby restaurants and stores. This is behavior that needs to be addressed with the group. It has been an ongoing issue, and it’s becoming a safety concern as well as a community concern. We love this church for so many reasons. They have a great kids ministry and everyone is so welcoming which is exactly what you want when attending a new church! I never felt out of place or like we didn't belong and Pastor Chuck and his wife Jill are the absolute best! The entire staff and praise and worship team are wonderful!! Highly recommend if looking for a new church home! been here going on 14 years wouldn't change it for nothing else... opening up 2nd location at the old cinemark theater The first time I ever walked into TPCC, I knew I was home. Everyone was so nice and not too long after, I started serving on Sunday mornings. I have since moved and still love to tune in every week for sermons. I highly recommend getting involved in a community group! I did the last couple of months I was there and so that is my only regret was not doing so sooner! If you are looking for a church filled with the Holy Spirit, then you gotta check it out! Also, worship time will leave you with chills. So. Dang. Good. Y'all! I miss you, my church family!

name: Turning Point Fellowship - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
A place where you are celebrated not tolerated..
Where the pastor preaches right out the bible and lives what he preaches...!!

Youth, Children and nursery available!!. I like how the pastor spoke, but honestly I hate how light it is with the babies being in the main sanctuary, there was a couple behind us with a loud baby, never took it out, had it running around and playing with loud toys, I couldn't hear some of the service and then i decided to leave early and that couple decided to start CHANGING their baby right on that pew, I cant respect a church that allows this type of disrespect from the audience, says nothing and allows for tje rest of audience to be bothered or annoyed the whole time. No wonder its such a small church. I visit this group with my church group. The deliverance of the Bible, teaching and preaching is uncompromising plus straight to the heart.
Not only that they really care about people and are very approachable when it comes to fellowship.
When I'm able to go and be around them. I very much trust I can be open around 'em, as well as, my safety.

If your reading this and are near by give them a honest try. Very recommended Sadly I asked for the day off to come to their event though apparently when me and my husband showed up they rudely kicked us out and I couldn't attend the event with my children. How can you call yourself a church of faith if you don't allow people to come and receive any faith you have to give? If you see two young parents with a truck it doesn't mean we're there to be reckless it's means we want something different and people like you don't help others reach out to God because it shows we were right you don't care for those whom seem to appear reckless. Pastor Angel teaches precept upon precept straight out of the bible and always challenge us verify the word against what he is preaching or teaching because what he says if the truth isn't coming from the pulpit then you need to run!!! Turning point fellowship is a place were you can come and worship the Lord Jesus Christ, it's a place of second chances always remember that we are all under construction so if you feel you were not accepted give Turning point fellowship a chance.

name: Tusculum Hills Baptist Church
reviewSummary: A neighborhood Baptist church in Nashville offering blended worship with a strong sense of family community.

name: Tustin Presbyterian Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: Great church. Could feel God's presence.   Nice people!!!! Wonderful church and a great location for local AA meetings.  The staff, Linda and Patty, are wonderful and blessings.  Thank you! Good people. Good times beautiful church and super nice people I went to an AA meeting there

name: Twin Lakes Fellowship - Cedar Park Campus
reviewSummary: They have so many ministries to help people with all kinds of things. They have helped us with food several times. Everyone is very friendly and kind. They make you feel so welcome! Love this church and the people who go here. My wife and I have called this place home since 2018. Biblical teaching, strong christian mentorship, and true gospel outreach. Life changing. God moves through His church. If you're looking for a church that walks the walk and not just lip service. This is it! Praise God that He has brought my family and I to this church. This is HOME. Warm and very friendly group of believers.  Music is meaningful and uplifting.   Pastor Nathan's an excellent Bible expositor (and musician).  The messages are passionate and relevant.  Great church! Very kind people and they offer a food pantry. However my client got sick twice on the food because most of the time the food is expired. People who need the food still eat because they are hungry. It's very sad.

name: Twin Pines Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Twin Pines has always been a wonderful congregation, accepting me like one of the family when my wife and I got together. They're open, honest, and accepting. All honestly means ALL here. Twin Pines Christian Church is one of the most Spiritual and one of  the most loving church that, l  had been affiliated with in a very long time. I am appreciative of being a part of their family. I started going here when I was a baby and it was always like a second home, this church was a big part of my life. It always felt like a big family, thanks for making me feel like I always had a place there. Miss y’all The pastor is lovely and everyone who works there is super welcoming and kind. I appreciate how inclusive they are. Very friendly and open church. Their reach out and community service is great.

name: Two Cities Church- Winston Salem Campus - Winston-Salem Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended the 11am service this morning. I haven't been to church in a little over 30 years. When I walked up to the front doors, I and a couple of other people I was accompanied with, were greeted with a smike and a polite staff. I have never been to church this big, but it wasn't overwhelming. The readings were inspirational and the music (especially the drums) were energetic. I left feeling positive, inspired, and an instant mood changer --- good to great. Thank you for a positive experience, Two Cities Church.

God bless,

Frank What a great church. The Word is from the Gospel. It aligns with topics of today and is rooted in the Word of God.

The worship is spot on. Upbeat, great sound, and production without trying to be a full-blown concert.

Everyone is welcoming without being in your face and overbearing. The facilities are top-notch and seating is extremely comfortable.

Really enjoying the experience and being fed the Word. I attended this church for a few years. At first, it seemed like a welcoming and friendly church, but over time it was more and more obvious that they’re more concerned about the numbers of attendants over caring for their congregation.
It’s a very greedy church, dedicating at least the last 5 minutes of every service begging and even guilting the congregation to give them money. They’ve bragged about how much money they make during the service and one time even shamed a member of the church who they thought wasn’t giving enough.
As for the teaching, I know some people like the blunt, in-your-face kind of preaching style, but it definitely blurs into being flat-out offensive at times. Especially towards LGBT people, Catholics, and people who are overweight. I was at a service once where they compared the beginning stages of the holocaust to Christians not being able to discriminate against transgender people, and saying that gay people were “newer than the iPhone” And they constantly shame people who are overweight with senseless jokes and more or less encourage people to not eat, saying that “an empty stomach will reveal how close you are with God, because an empty stomach shows who you really are.”
To give credit where credit is due, their music is pretty good. If you’re looking for a free Christian concert, it’s good! Their band is very talented.

I don’t often leave reviews on anything, much less churches, but if this stops one person from having a negative experience, it’ll be worth it. There are PLENTY of other churches in Winston Salem that’ll be more worth your time and that won’t be after your wallet.

This is the kind of church that would’ve made Jesus flip tables. I have attended this church before on several different occasions, I totally enjoy the service and the fellowship of all the people that I have encountered every time that I come.  However on this particular Sunday April 12th 2026 upon me walking through the front door I had my backpack and greeted everyone who greeted me, but for some reason one gentlemen in particular approached me about my backpack.  I had never really felt an uncomfortable feeling coming here until that moment, he proceeded to ask me about my backpack and first thing he says is " Excuse sir but you are not allowed to have the backpack inside ."  On one other occasion I had brought a bag with me and no said anything to me at all, also a lady that greeted me upon coming through the gate from the parking lot followed me all the way into the building and came to stand right directly beside of me and preceded to approach me and say hello and asked me if I was waiting on service to start.   Now I arrived at the end of the 9am service so I thinking to myself well of I am here for the next service time,  I am saying all of this to say that I feel that some people really need to be screened or for that matter every one needs to be screened before they are put on the greeter team.   I just felt so uncomfortable because the gentlemen that approached me about my bag made me stand outside until other members of the security team came to get my bag to put it away.   So a gentlemen named Sam came out and stated that there was nothing wrong with my bag and told me to come on in and provided a great welcome to me (kudos to Sam).  I just want to say that I know that this a great place to worship and I will say with the way that the world is I totally understand safety precautions but when I see other people walking by with bags and women walking by with pocket books but I am the only one being pulled to the side about my bag they raises a question about some people at this church. I finally opened up my heart to Jesus 2 years ago and my life hasn’t been the same since.  I was a critical skeptic of Christianity for the majority of my life and the first series I listened in to was addressing “what is wrong with the church.”  I was in a dark place in my life and the series had me intrigued.  I found myself returning, joining a community group and spending my free time volunteering elsewhere (not with the church, but with other Christian organizations, so was never a full member).  I have since moved from NC yet continue to listen on live-stream with my now wife, who I met through a path that only Jesus could have led me on.  God bless and Godspeed.

name: Two Rivers Church, Fort Collins - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary: I walk away from Two Rivers Church truly feeling the love of Jesus Christ. This family preaches Christ's unending love for YOU, given to YOU through His Grace. Such a wonderful church open to everyone. I have been attending 2 Rivers since moving to Fort Collins a little over two years ago, and this place has changed my life. If you want to come to a place  where are you are constantly reminded of the grace and love of God and Jesus, this is the place for you and your family. We love the family atmosphere this church creates, we love the relational connectionship the pastor and his family creates with the body, and we love how friendly of an environment it is.  From the first day I walked into this church, I was greeted with such love and kindness and I felt right at home. When my fiancé moved to Fort Collins about eight months ago, I brought her  to church with me and she felt the same love and positive spirit immediately.  This church provides many small group opportunities to connect with people at the same stage of life as you, and we have truly made lifelong friends through these connections. We recently did a premarital course with other engaged couples through the church where we not only built a foundation of marriage on God, but made  Great friends through the process. I highly recommend checking out this church to anyone that is looking to be filled with love, grace, and the true message of what Jesus came to do. The best community of people who love sharing about who Jesus truly is through a focus on grace, understanding, and freedom in Christ! Truly a church that embraces freedom and Grace in Jesus. A place to find authentic community. If you're looking for solid biblical teaching and a great community of people Two Rivers is it!

name: Tyler Christian Fellowship - Tyler Campus
reviewSummary:
Really wonderful church, pastor, people, music. My Tyler family ! Wonderful church, great messages and inviting people. We'd been looking for a church to call Home for a while that we felt inspired and touched when we attend and this is it! We felt welcome and part of the body immediately, Tyler Christian Fellowship church is definitely home. This is a vibrant church family who genuinely love and care for each other and the community.  Come and be part of the fellowship! Warm, loving, and helpful people who desire an intimate relationship with God through knowledge of Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit. Wonderful service
Great worship team and friendly people.

name: Ultimate Life Church - Denton Campus
reviewSummary:
I never make a promise I can’t keep.  So I boldly & without wavering promise you there is no place on earth like Ultimate Life Church! You will never find a more prolific theologian & honorable man of God than Dr Russell E. Lewis or a more authentically loving & prophetic Pastor, atmosphere shifter & Preacher as his beautiful wife for life Dr Keisha Lewis.  There are no words to adequately describe the praise & worship experience led by our extraordinarily anointed Worship Leaders Pastor Jeremy Lewis & his incredibly anointed wife Pastor Maya Lewis. God has been very generous with the oil on their life’s!  ULC is comprised of a team of Elders, Pastors, Ministers, Servers & Greeters &  Children’s Church staff that prioritize their personal relationship with God & make it their mission to make sure everyone that enters the doors of Ultimate Life Church feel welcomed. It is my prayer that you not only experience Ultimate but that the experience of Ultimate will be greatly impactful & lead you to an elevated life which is the Ultimate Life! Loving church. Pastors Wife very loving and  beautiful inside & out. During the sermon you're told to touch or tell your neighbor at least 20x or more. At the end your told to put your arm around your neighbors shoulder. Sitting next to an unknown MALE & constantly touching them is inappropriate for Me.   For some men thats all it takes nowadays.  I won"t do it.  Again, Lovely caring people. We pulled through the parking lot to take a photo of a building across the street for my daughter’s school project. A man walked out and screamed at us to move our car. We were not blocking anyone. I politely said we would and continued to figure out the picture. The man continued screaming at us and walked up on us in a threatening manner. He was extremely rude and threatening. We took our quick picture and left before he could do anything more.

I’ve never seen someone who calls themselves Christian treat others with such distain and malice just for driving through a parking lot - a shared parking lot at that.

Based on this experience, I wouldn’t go inside this church ever. This is an amazing House of God! From worship, fellowship, 3 prayer calls a week, deliverance, prophetic words & songs, the way that God uses Dr Russell to bring forth the Word, the musicians, but most importantly the Holy Spirit is welcome and we experience God's Presence! I don't know how anyone can be a member of this church and their relationship with God won't grow because this is not only a place of fellowship, but accountability and encouraging you to stay on the direct path of God which helps elevate our individual relationships with the Father. I love this church! God sent me here, and it truly is a place where God's people are elevated in faith and maturity. Holy Ghost filled Pastors. Freedom, authenticity, love, and prophetic anointing graces each service. Presence of God is heavy. Moved into larger building downtown Denton. On the move for God's Kingdom agenda in Denton!

name: Umstead Park UCC - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary: Great open and affirming place. Progressive place where all are welcome whatever situation their life's in. And they mean it! Our family has always felt welcome. Friendly folks. They seek to follow Jesus's teachings and example without being preachy about it. They admit it they don't know everything ... a church, without all the answers! Just travelers on a journey seeking to understand God. Very cool. My wife and I had been looking for a church for a year since moving to Raleigh. The problem is Umstead Park UCC doesn't look like a church from the outside. No one is going to drive by and think, "Let's try that out."   We found the church online and decided to visit. We immediately felt welcomed.  Two months later we joined as members. The church is Open & Affirming which was important to us. The music is inspiring, the sermons thought provoking, the community is welcoming.  Everyone is welcome. There was no pressure to join, we wanted to. There was no pressure to give, we decided to. There was no pressure to  'believe what we tell you' we were welcomed as we are - where we are. Check it out for yourself. The people at Umstead Park UCC are so warm and welcoming! They made me feel right at home the minute I walked through the door, and have since become like family to me. If you are looking for a community that values justice, love, safety, and belonging for all people, then this is the place to go! Welcoming, open, fun, thoughtful, progressive, very laid back. A haven from all the craziness. If you're looking for an inviting, loving, safe, progressive community of faith, this is the place. The people are welcoming and friendly (and not just on Sunday!), and the message feels thoughtful.

name: Union Baptist Church - Durham Campus
reviewSummary: I'm a member along with my wife and sons at this church. I always feel a good vibe when I leave after hearing the Pastor preach his sermon. He picks a scripture from the Bible, talks about his experience relating to the scripture and expands on  the scripture by breaking it down. The music is good and there are so many wonderful people there. So much love at this church. If you're looking for a church home, give Union Baptist a chance! I was vacationing and was recommended your church. Really great service! March 17 was my first time visiting, and I absolutely loved everything. The environment was relaxing, calming, receiving, etc. I will be returning whenever I'm in the area! I don't attend this church and i don't know anybody at this church but this place of worship is the true definition of loving one,s neighbor as yourself and being kind to one another.i called in needing help with an issue, and i was attended to with no questions asked.i was very surprised at how kind the lady I spoke with was with no judgement,and how quickly this church came through for me.whoever the pastor is must be a great minister and a kind person. It has become very difficult to find parking here. Seems to be because there is only one service now, back in the day there used to be 3 services. Now, even if you arrive early, the parking lot is already full and street parking is scarce. Hope they have a plan to help address the parking as more and more people desire to come in person after the pandemic, they may need 2 or 3 services again The Pastor is an awesome preaching, spirit-filled with the Holy Ghost Man of God.  He and our congregation are welcoming and I’m sure you will fill right at home in one of our many Ministries! So, please come and pay us a visit on Roxboro St, Durham, NC.  Peace and Grace

name: Union Church - Columbia
reviewSummary:
I love how friendly and welcoming it was at Union. The preacher is young, funny and direct about God's word. He said to commit to going to church for the next 4 weeks. I am committing to that and much much more. The music is great is uplifting also. It was such a blessing to be at a church where the vibes were positive!!!! Thank you! Words can’t explain the transformation that has happened in my life due to attending this Church. The atmosphere is electric inside! You’re greeted the minute you park your car all the way to leaving service. Also, they have free coffee, bathrooms are filled with feminine necessities and although the campus doesn’t have live preaching, the campus pastor is so involved and interactive with the congregation. I haven’t seen another culture as excellent as Union! I’m looking forward to Easter weekend! It's a friendly church which focuses on helping people know God, find freedom, discover purpose, and make a difference. There are many opportunities to network with people and experience life together. They have services for children, teens, and adults of all ages.
Pastors Steven Chandler and Zai Chandler stream live from the BWI campus. I love this church! They are so focused on providing an environment where experiencing God is priority. If you looking for good community, amazing preaching, and place to grow this is the place to be! The attendees of this church absolutely fly through the parking lot on their way to the church, which is at the back of the lot. My son and I have nearly been run down multiple times while leaving sky zone, which is in the same lot. I have never been to this church and would never go now after seeing the extremely unsafe and selfish behavior, exhibited by the reckless driving of this church’s attendees with no regard for safety of anyone, not even children.

name: Union Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: I went to Union Church back before they launched services in 2017. It is a great church that preaches the gospel and has a focus on discipleship and building God’s kingdom. They have grown quite a bit since 2017. People there are very welcoming and there are definitely lots of ways to serve and grow. The pastor is nice and so are the elders. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a church. I have been going to Union church for a little over a year and a half and it has been a great experience. The church is biblically focused and the staff and pastor put a huge priority in following scripture as it was intended. In addition to this, the church is small enough that it is easy to build community and meet new people. There is a wide range of age groups and a lot of young people who attend.  Very different from my experience at larger churches in the past where I never met the pastor one on one or knew as many of the people that attended. Cant say enough great things about this church! Everyone is very friendly and inviting. The pastor preaches straight from the bible and leads well.  My Kids love coming to church here Also! This church is home! Please come join us, it’s been life changing for our family. Rich community, gospel preaching, discipleship and weekly fellowship. So good!

name: Union Church of Cupertino - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary:
Come here often for my daughter's choir performance. The church acoustics are amazing...music and vocals reverberate around the church. A very lovely, sweet, very nice people and feeling of family traditional church! Music is good and extraordinary.
Wonderful choir group. Offering food to elder people twice a month through Second Harvest. Praise God

name: Union Church of Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It was an amazing Sunday Service today. Celebrating 3 years of service with @NewCityChurchLA at the #UnionChurchOfLosAngeles.
Celebrating fabulous service with friends and family😊 We hold an AA meeting here on Wednesdays at 5pm-6pm

name: Union City Church ⛪ - Washington Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is unknown to me but I do like it's aestheics. It appears to be small and somewhat quaint in personality. I was very lucky to find Union City when looking for an Easter Service while visiting DC for the weekend. I would absolutely recommend!

What stood out to me about the experience was:
1) The pastor was an inspiring speaker. He taught instead of preached, and left with real takeaways. He was also compelling, high energy, funny, and intentional about brining the crowd into the sermon. Everyone was engaged the whole time.
2) I felt welcome. Those around us were friendly, the ushers helped us get seats even though we were a bit late, and they had donuts and coffee after the service.
3) The people in attendance were truly diverse. It felt like a true cross section of the community.
4) It was family friendly, and on the younger side for average age (25-45) To know Union City Church is to live their tagline- "A church united in a world divided." Founded with Biblical principles, it's not conservative or progressive. It's a church that pushes people toward Jesus so that congregants can be bridge builders and a witness to Washington, D.C. That's who Union City is at their core. Now for the details.

1) Service: There are two services- 9:30 a.m. and 11 a.m. every Sunday. Each service starts with 3-4 songs for worship with lyrics projected onto a main screen and two side TVs. Announcements are made by various members of the congregation. Sermons are around 30-45 minutes and are steeped in Scripture. The wife-husband team takes turns preaching and both are equally gifted communicators and orators. Each service ends with a reading of the Union City liturgy. (It's the liturgy- how Biblical and bridge-building- that first convinced my family to make Union City our home.)

2) Atmosphere: Union City Church is intentional about creating a welcoming space. Greeters with "welcome" signs say hi to you as you walk in and the lobby is set up with places to sit and connect with people, coffee/water/juice, and the "Connect" area for people who want to go deeper in the church. When my family and I were visiting churches, Union City was the most genuinely friendly.

2) Location: After renting space at two different locations, they have their own building just up from The White House along 16th Street NW. Built at the end of the 19th century, the building is stunning inside and out.

If you're a Christian and want a church family, consider going to Union City Church. It's led by the most thoughtful and integritous people, filled by kind congregants, and is intentional about serving the city and world. I love my church. Look forward to serving and seeing everyone there. This is just the beginning. God is working in this place. The worship music is great and so is Pastor Brandon’s sermon each week! Union City isn’t just a Church - it’s community - it’s family - it’s unity - it’s a vibe. I moved to DC from Tampa 2 years ago, and the one thing that I have been missing the most is a Church and Community that felt like what I left behind. I’ve been searching for a Church home ever since. Finding Union City has given me back something I’ve been missing - and I finally feel like I am home again.

This is a new church that’s just getting started in DC, but based on their heart for this City, the atmosphere of the gatherings, and the kindness, knowledge and professionalism of the Pastors and their launch team - you’d never know they’ve only been here for a few months.

The Church itself will launch in September but to prepare they have already started hosting small group Bible studies, worship nights, community socials, serve days, and more. The messaging from the Pastors at the pre-launch events is relevant, relatable and real.  The vibe is always positive, easy, zero pressure, judgement free and incredibly welcoming.

There is something at Union City for everyone - no matter what season of life you are in, or where you are in your walk with faith. I have already met some of the most amazing friends here, who I know will be lifelong. I am so grateful for Pastor Brandon, Pastor Delaney, and this amazing community. I cannot wait to watch this Church grow in the DMV!

name: Union Grove Christian Church - Douglasville Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful church that focuses on the word of God without allowing the world to interfere with the truth.

I had always been very wary of churches and the people in them. I always felt they were very arrogant and with an attitude that they are "greater than thou"... this church made me realize what it means to be a true follower of Christ, and I have never been the same since my baptism in October of 2017 right here at Union Grove. I love the people who are welcoming and loving! Great church! Awesome Pastor Mike! Awesome Pastor's wife, Gina! Very nice congregation! Really can relate to his sermons and learn a lot from them. Pastor Mike baptized my daughter and my re-dedication. I live in Jacksonville,FL now, and was so glad Union Grove Christian Church started streaming Sunday sermons! Warm, friendly congregation! Pastor Mallory is a "true" preacher / teacher of the Gospel, No compromise. Standing for what the Bible says 🙌🏽 bless the name of the Lord!! I'm grateful for the invitation to visit and now, I'm a member. ❤ Love God, Love People. I love the pastor! He is genuine and a good Christian man. He preaches the Word of God with a King James Bible. He does it with love and compassion and understanding yet speaks the truth. Wonderful church.... wonderful people. Led by a wonderful pastor.
Teaches the Word of God from the Book of God. Thru Jesus Christ this church has made a big difference in my life.

name: Unite Church Nashville - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary:
If your looking for a church community,  this is your new home.
Come check out the accurate teachings in His Word.
Authentic people doing life together. This is my church home away from home!
The passion these people have for God and showing love genuine love to others is something that is sadly not common in churches today. So grateful to call you all my extended family Love the Nashville Downtown Vineyard church...The worship music is great.... they really allow you to worship and enter in...and they worship too, not entertain. The pastor, Grant is a nice guy. He really is open to the Holy Spirit and allows him to move in the gifts of the spirit as well as prophetic gifts which I  don't see much of any more in the churches I've visited. The people are friendly, and its located in a beautiful old church with turrets and a big old beautiful pipe organ in the front when you enter, as well as beautiful stain glass windows.... Love it, just wish it was closer to me. I live 55 minutes east of it! I visited this church for the Risk It All conference and really loved the atmosphere. They have the best worship band I have seen in years with amazing energy, talent, and vocals. I was blessed by brother Robby Dawkins and also the prayer team in their prayer meeting. I know the pastor must be awesome too and I plan to visit again soon. Unite Church Nashville is an amazing church the people are nice and friendly and respectful they help out others and themselves they have nice dinners they pray they are loyal to the Unite the church name of Nashville i encourage you for new ideas to help others to come closer to God and Jesus Christ and the holy ghost kingdom Amen and please keep up with the amazing great work words of encouragement pass it along please and thank you! 💜🪽⛪

name: United Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
I started going here and they are no longer my church family, they became my true family.  They have showed me that through thick or thin we will always be here for you!  I'm a Deacon there and I feel right at home.  I love everyone in our church home.  Our church means the world to me!  Please join us!  Become our family!❤️ After having gone to a Christian University, and being totally turned off regarding churches for many years, this is a location I can finally call my spiritual home again. They are open and affirming, calling in everyone to worship and receive God's love without excluding people or throwing judgement around. I'm currently only able to attend service about once a month or so, but would go every weekend if I could. Great classes for kids as well.  I've been a part of many church communities, from Catholic to non-denominational, and this community is by far the most progressive, welcoming, affirming and inclusive congregation I've ever been a part of. Everyone is invited to communion, all genders and orientations are celebrated and share in every part worship and the community is diverse in race and age.  The children's and youth ministies are excellent, the focus on social justice is inspiring, and the traditional format of the gospel, communion and hymns is lovely and familiar.  If you've ever felt like you aren't welcomed in a house of God for any reason, or that Christians are just a bunch of judgemental haters, this community will restore your faith in the faithful and give you an opportunity to restart your dialogue with God. Excellent place! We come to get our pumpkins and do all the little events they have going on.

We eventually plan on addending a service as they seem like a great place and welcoming to all. Great church that is very inclusive! Very welcoming and spirit-filled.

name: United Christian Fellowship - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary:
My membership at United Christian Fellowship has been a beautiful blessing to me and my family. My eldest son played the piano there for a short time and my youngest son was baptized there. The pastor is a teacher and preacher. He is a wonderful man of God that leads the congregation in knowledge of God's word. “UCF” has been amazing for my husband and I . We were welcomed via Zoom in 2020 for Bible Study. The  knowledge of the bible, the teachings, the discussions , the conversations was an experience that we have never had before. We yearned  for more and more each week. We knew we had to be a part of this  “No Judgement Zone” Church Family.

Pastor Childs, First Lady and the UCF family have welcomed us with open arms. The love, compassion, empathy and embracing atmosphere is truly refreshing. Sunday services are filled with singing, music and an awesome message that won’t have you sitting and being still. You have to get up and give “Praise”. So blessed to be a member of such a Spirit-Filled church. I LOVE UCF!!!!!

S. McDaniel It is really great being a part of a ministry that are full of life long learners of the word! There is nothing more thrilling than being in the midst of God pouring out his spirit on all in the room and virtually! I've been going here since high school and it has challenged me in a lot of ways to seek community when I don't want to. The environment is very welcoming and has allowed me to grow as a Christian with a body of believers who truly love the Lord. I love my church. Awesome worship experience and a word you can use RIGHT NOW !!!

reviewSummary:

I just don’t feel the same without him. The messages now feel soft, hesitant, and lacking that bold conviction that once stirred our hearts. The best s"seeker friendly" church in the area.  All are welcomed. Being a part of the United Church Family has been such a life giving supportive journey.  Pastor Ray and Pastor Tommy speak bible truth through their messages with so much grace and compassion each week.  This really is a special group.  If you’re looking for a place to support your community and grow your faith - I can’t think of a better place❤️ First time visitor. Moved here from Jax, Florida.
Tremendous first time experience. 2nd visit was for their stations of the cross, which by the way, was really a beautiful experience. Looking forward to attending this Church again. Glad its not a mega church. Very community oriented. Such a dynamic and welcoming worship experience where sincere love and concern was shown within the membership.   So many sweet servant's hearts...just the way a vibrant, growing group of believers should look!
