name: United Church of Christ - UCC Petaluma - Petaluma Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church. They believe in loving everyone. My daughter was transgender, and she would have been loved at this church.  This is an affirming church.  The pastor Jason is amazing and the congregation is very loving. Church starts at 9:30 and lasts about an hour.  After church there is a coffee and snack time that is delightful.  The church also has a bible study and book study for anyone that is interested.  All are welcome. Over a twenty year period we were fortunate to have been able to attend a group meeting on Tuesday evenings at the United Church on Middlefield. Situated on a large piece of land overlooking the southwest quadrant of Petaluma. A sense of peace filled the air as we walked up to the church doors after the long rush hour drive from San Francisco. We would sit together in silence, after listening to a video our meditation teacher from Tomales, Eknath Easwaran. We were always joined by his widow Christine. There were about 35 of us regulars in the 2000’s, up until the pandemic. Of the many fond memories a sweet one is of listening to the birds through the open door. I’m sure that is still happening even though we don’t meet there anymore. I haven't been here for any actual church services, but I imagine they would be pretty inspiring, what with their magnificent hillside views and giant stained glass cross. I grew up with UCC. Great memories. Now that I am engaged, hopefully I will be married at UCC. My childhood church. A think about days past and those who are not longer with us.

name: United Church of Christ at Valley Forge - Tredyffrin Township Campus
reviewSummary: United Church of Christ at Valley Forge is such a beautiful and welcoming place! The piano is absolutely stunning, and the sound quality during services is amazing—so rich and uplifting. The location is convenient and peaceful, and everyone I’ve met here has been incredibly friendly and kind. You can really feel the sense of community. Highly recommend visiting! Went there in early-Autumn, 2023 for Mem. Service, my step-mother, late Gwynne ("Gwynnie") Linton-Hagee, who succumbed to M.A.C. lung disease in her late-70s just few wks. prior The friendliest and most open church I've ever been to. They are simply wonderful! Very welcoming church in a lovely facility. Beautiful church.  Serene space.

name: United Church of Christ Community Church - Mill Valley Campus
reviewSummary:
The facility is a nice tree-nestled, vintage wood aesthetic church and hall. It's a solid place for smaller or medium weddings, along with other gatherings like that. There are also two side rooms that are pretty good for small groups to meet in.

As for the congregation, it's a very intellectual, justice-oriented community. They're Open & Affirming (church-speak for pro gay rights/clergy/marriage). Long history of walking the walk - backing Freedom Riders, founding an affordable retirement community in town, and so on.

Church services are 10 am every Sunday and last about an hour; there's an adult bible study at 9 am most Sundays as well. Simply lovely Christmas eve service last night. Could not have asked for more. Nic looking church

name: United Church of Christ Fort Lauderdale - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary: Gorgeous church and every Thursday it caters to the homeless people with 🚿 showers, clean clothing, haircuts 💈 and hot meal. They also help with getting a phone and other services. A true gem in Fort Lauderdale and one of the only churches that lives out the calling of Christ through the collective works of its members. If you want to raise your kids in a setting that will show them respect for all and how diversity is the true engine for innovation, this is the place to be. Open and affirming to people from all walks of life. Excellent Pastor. There is a streaming service. Go to the website and review past services to see if this could be your spiritual home. The definition of giving back to the community!  An amazing staff of volunteers and Pastor Jim is truly unique and amazing This church and their volunteer do nothing less than a miracle for homeless people. They have a soup kitchen, and they bring in portable showers and give clothing to the less fortunate. Thanks to all that pass on to help other. Thank you Evelyn Torrey for bringing my attention to this wonder place!

name: United Church of Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
If you love the vibe of Gainesville then you'll love the vibe of UCG. It's a place to find community founded on joy & love. A Spiritual place for anyone disappointed by the dogma of traditional religions. Truly a place of "God, however known." A place for all religions and Buddhism, atheism, and agnosticism. I reached out to the church I attended as a child seeking guidance and resources during a difficult time. I hope that in the future, programs could be made available to help community members who have nowhere else to turn. Non-denominational support like this is rare and deeply needed. I was seeking assistance for immediate survival needs, but was referred elsewhere. A perfect church for anyone who wants the social & community benefits of a church without the heavy doctrine and fire & brimstone of regular churches. Sure, there are prayers during the service but without the "leave it all to god" hopelessness. Rather, prayer is to boost our own strength, resilience, and compassion. UCG treats Jesus more as a god inspired teacher to follow rather than an all powerful deity who will fix all your problems if you pray well enough. Unlike and much better than any doctrine infused church I have attended.
Also, of note, UCG is open & welcoming regardless of any label you have, like gay, trans, queer, or your race, gender, or age.
(I'm new to UCG and will soon start the membership process.) Wonderful place to find spiritual fulfillment regardless of your personal beliefs. I am agnostic -- neither religious or atheist -- and made some great friends here. They do not discriminate based on gender or sexual expression. The youth group is well-run. Most of all, they practice the teachings of Jesus in the way they were intended -- with love and acceptance. UCoG offers a joyous, open-hearted and creative celebration as a thriving Christian community. The welcome here is authentic and intelligent, socially conscious and inclusive. I am new here, but delighted to say I have not missed a Sunday since the first time I came.

name: United Congregational Christian Church - Eureka Campus
reviewSummary:
"My previous experiences in churches made me feel like I could only belong if I didn't identify as my authentic self. At UCCC I'm supported in my spiritual growth by a church where inclusivity is more than a word - it's a weekly celebration." My husband and I visited UCCC for the first time on September 8, 2024 and had a very good experience.  Many people were warm and friendly towards us.  The music was meaningful and the sermon was inspiring and uplifting.  We hope to return again. I am a new member of this church after having attended off and on for the last 4 months.  This is a small, extravagantly welcoming congregation which offers a variety of programs and activities along with weekly worship services for its members.  The new pastor, Cindi Knox, is warm and genuine.  Her very accessible and relevant sermons incorporate scripture, thoughtful interpretation and historical explanation along with humor and personal experiences.  The physical space is beautiful, inviting and comfortable.  As part of the United Church of Christ and Disciples of Christ, this is a non-doctrinal church which means all are welcome (seekers and believers) and all faith journeys are respected. I have been attending services here for 20 years. I always find it very welcoming and very supportive of my views with the LGBTQIA community, immigration, the homeless and all other social justices.
This congregation is small but mighty in love for others. Enjoyed the sermon and especially the message of inclusion. All are truly welcome. Everyone is very inviting and warm.

reviewSummary: I REALLY ENJOY THIS PLACE!!!! DEFINITELY IS ONE ON THE MAP IF YOU ARE NEW TO THE AREA. TALKING ABOUT A GREAT JOYFUL TIME AND DEVIL-FLEEING SPIRIT FOR THE REST OF THE DAY AS WELL AS THE WEEK. POWERFUL TEACHING WITH A LOT OF PRAISE!!!!!!! NOT THE BASIC CHURCH. Awesome place to worship! Family friendly environment, great children's ministry, sweet people! Awesome church the best atmosphere to worship in!!! Friendly and nice people you can meet come see for yourself!!! Our Bishop and lady Mixon are amazing leaders who love God and people so come out and visit!!! Pastor Mixon and his congregation hosted a wonderful Easter family event! The spirit fell on me the second this woman began praying & all I could do was thank God I was in an atmosphere full of people who realize how desperately we NEED Jesus!!!! Oh how breathtaking it was to see young people praising God. The Bishop hit head on speaking about Faith. The members were so welcoming & loving to say the least. I’m just forever grateful for this AMAZING experience. I will definitely be back. Asia, if you see this— thank you for taking me. I love you past this life! Thank you Unity Christian Center! God speed.

name: Unity Christian Church - Fayetteville Campus
reviewSummary: It's just like another family. You feel the love as soon as you enter the doors. They praise God, and the pastor not asking for your rent money. He's a blessed and anointed man of God! He's a living and kind man, that wants only the best for his congregation and beyond those doors. He tells us the word as our father sees fit for him to. He's understanding and never refuses to help. Great group of series people; no loud rah rah music; good worship n teaching, well worth your commitment n learing. I've been a member at this church for over 10yrs. and the word is awesome and always right on time.  The Pastor leads by example, is true to his word and loves God with everything in him.  I have witnessed this for myself.  I thank God for my Church! My first time visiting unity and i must say i had a wonderful experience. Pastor Atwater is an excellent teacher of the gospel. Then i visited bible study it was awsome also i will be going back great people at this church it's hard to find that these days. Very friendly loving Interactive Word Church...AWESOME service!

name: Unity Church of Daytona Beach - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: If you are a long time student of Unity, Reverend Cynthia Alice Anderson is the REAL DEAL!! If you are new to Unity, she simplifies the most complex topic's so that her message is understood by all. I actually joined Unity of Daytona Beach and I live in KANSAS!!! I’m new to the area and I am pleased to say that this Church leadership and congregation is amazing. I’ve found a new spiritual home 🥰 I have been attending this church for 15 years. Amazing people, amazing place, teaching how to live your best life. After watching the video I give this church one star, please repent and seek Jesus RCA and the worship services are amazing. Meditation is my favorite part of service. You are welcome here. 💜

name: Unity Fellowship of Christ Church Philadelphia
reviewSummary: A warm, spiritual, un pretentious sanctuary. Warm welcoming sanctuary

name: Unity of Carlsbad - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
A very welcoming community. Love abounds and lessons are shared. I always leave with something to carry me through the week. I liked the music. The message of the service was positive but somewhat disjointed and also very emotive. This is part of the schtick. Everyone got in a circle and held hands at the end. I felt pressured to join in. I thought it was weird. I think it’s fine to hold hands in public but it’s weird to ask everyone to do it upon demand. They said you didn’t have to join in but how much of a square/standout would I be if I was the only person in the entire congregation not to?

I didn’t bring a donation and was chastised for “next time”. Some members of the congregation thoughtfully prepared some snacks. One of the organizers made a weird joke about me flirting with his wife, which was news to me.

Those who prescribe to the dogma established by the council of Nicaea will find this church heretical. I don’t personally care about that, but the vibe was off. I’ve heard the location in San Diego itself is better, could be worth checking out. I'm a member of Unity San Diego . I found this church here but its still developing. So am I. Inspiring talks, non denominational, loving atmosphere for all paths to God. Great people!

name: Unity of Fairfax - Local Area Campus
reviewSummary:
Easter service was great. Minister was very inspiring with his message. Also, included songs and live music! Very welcoming church. My organization will *definitely* consider hosting our future events here again!

Recently held an event here over the weekend and Chasity was extremely helpful! She helped us get everything squared away and was always a positive presence. She'll get you squared away.

Unity of Fairfax has been nothing but kind and accomodating to us, and their team is quite open minded, professional, and ready to go. This is such a lovely church to be a part of! Rev Russ is very funny, wise and engaging. I really love the metaphysical group he leads before church. The congregation is warm and welcoming!! They always have so many interesting things to do as part of the church. Lastly, Amy the music director always has a new set of talent to display and the music is different all the time. Amazing 🤩 A warm, friendly, welcoming spiritual community with many activities for all ages. Unity Church is a wonderful Church, full of wonderful and caring ❤ people.  Pastor Russell is devoted and passionate about teaching the core values of this Church.  And the Golden Rule taught and practiced here.  Basically, everyone is taught to give and receive love and to practice foregiveness.  The Sunday service is from 11am - 12 noon.  The congregation supports the learning from other world religions.  For example, there is an hour study in The Bhagavad Gita before Sunday Church service currently.  Unity believes in the Unity of all humanity and the Unity and divinity of all world religions.   There are attendees of this place of worship who have been coming for 5 to over 30 years.

name: Unity of Tustin - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent church experience. All are welcome. Universal peace on this property for all ages. Endless love for all who enter. The Meditation Garden is a grand location for such wonderful service and life celebrations. Peace, Love and Positivity creating Joy to the universe from above. I AM G IN ACTION. So Quiet and beautiful for reading or meeting friends and taking pictures and memories. I would love to come back again. The parking lot is available and free. The space is so peaceful and inclusive, a great place to ground yourself among the hustle and bustle of every day life. There’s a donation box on site to help maintain the grounds, A tree where you can leave prayer notes for folks as well as a beautiful pond to listen to. This church acknowledges and welcomes all of the wisdom traditions.  They have several ministries within the church that serve the community.  There are several individuals trained in the Reiki energy healing modality.
The grounds are spectacular with a large variety of trees and plants like this blooming vine covering a trellis over the pathway.  I was warmly greeted by many church members during my visit.  They had a guest speaker that led a meditation covering the 7 chakra system which was both a delightful surprise and quite informative.  I have found a new fellowship and community. I enjoy coming here during sunset or to come picnic with my family. I’ve spent good days with family and friends walking and meditating in the gardens. Love watching the clouds roll by on cloudy days. Rainy days are also very beautiful 💙

name: Unity Temple on the Plaza
reviewSummary: Lovely historic building on the Plaza.  We attended a beautiful, quiet candlelight string quartet concert of some of our favorite music from The Lord of the Rings movie scores.  The setting was perfect, except for the very loud amplified music coming from the event happening one floor below.  The building is used extensively as a cultural center and has multiple spaces to support simultaneous events. My recommendation would be to double check which events are being hosted in the building at the same time and purchase tickets for a quiet event when a louder event is not going on (unless you enjoy traveling through Middle Earth to a rave beat!) Loved this place. The stain glass is beautiful, very comfortable seating We had a Simple Ceremony with Ben — it was exactly what we expected “simple”.  There are no worries whatsoever.  Book your event using the online calendar, and you’ll receive a call with contact information.  I prefer to communicate via text, and they were willing to accommodate. I received reminders and regular communication at times that made sense before our ceremony.  Important things like “having a marriage license in the State of MO”.  KS is so close by, some people don’t think about that and get their license in the wrong state.  Our officiate, Ben, was organized, responsive, and helpful.  The Temple is beautiful with plenty of places for family photos.  We were able to take photos with a photographer before and after the ceremony.  There is also very convenient parking.  The free, covered parking garage is steps away from the temple — same side of the street — right next door. For the actual ceremony— you get to choose what type — religious or not, blessings before or after, rings or not.  There is no need for a rehearsal because it’s truly “simple”:  A few days beforehand, Ben confirmed we would have witnesses.  In our case we we had the maximum 15-guests including ourselves.  It’s meant for very small and intimate weddings.  Our parents on both bride and groom sides are mid 70’s and didn’t want big risks associated with larger groups and covid.  We had our small, safe family ceremony for the actual wedding with a big reception later that evening.  I couldn’t be happier with Unity Temple and highly recommend. We went there for their Candlelight Concert.  The staff was very kind and helpful. The place is beautiful and clean. We had a great time! Beautiful venue! We wished it would have lasted longer however.

name: University Baptist Church - Chapel Hill Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a loving, supportive fellowship, please consider visiting University Baptist Church.

I'm relocating to Seattle, but UBC has been my home Church as I've been a member since October 2004. I made many long-term friendships. The people here are solid vessels of Christian love. Thank you UBC! Amazing staff, welcoming congregation! Gives back to the community and welcoming to all Glad they allow orchestra members to park in their lot. About 70 feet tall, I would guess. Great VBS workshop

name: University Bible Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
University Bible Church provides solid biblical teaching, a welcoming community, and meaningful worship. Ideal for those seeking deep spiritual growth and authentic fellowship. Highly recommended! I attended this church for 6 months while living in LA for school. A welcoming, down-to-earth community that made me feel right at home. Unique, especially in the Hollywood area! Lovely people. Excellent biblical teaching. The folks there make you feel comfortable right away. I highly recommend it. A welcoming and warm church that is doctrinally sound--a rare find in California. Wonderful church.

Friendly people.

Pastor Brain is a wonderful teacher.

name: University Bible Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
University Bible Church provides solid biblical teaching, a welcoming community, and meaningful worship. Ideal for those seeking deep spiritual growth and authentic fellowship. Highly recommended! I attended this church for 6 months while living in LA for school. A welcoming, down-to-earth community that made me feel right at home. Unique, especially in the Hollywood area! Lovely people. Excellent biblical teaching. The folks there make you feel comfortable right away. I highly recommend it. A welcoming and warm church that is doctrinally sound--a rare find in California. Wonderful church.

Friendly people.

Pastor Brain is a wonderful teacher.

name: University Catholic Center - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: I asked Father Jamie about a Knights of Columbus chapter on campus. This was his answer. You'll see that the mistake (spacing) between "here" and "anywhere" is intentionally placed. He is indicating that he is playing. Never put your trust in a Priest who acts in this manner. For confession, I would suggest a different priest. Went to Mass here the weekend we dropped our daughter off for freshman year. Everyone was very friendly. The pastor took the time to personally introduce our daughter to other students. The homily was perfectly appropriate for students about to begin their academic year. Were happy this place is available to the students at UCLA. Nice location. Attended a friend's wedding ceremony here. A chapel and welcoming spirit. A small but welcoming community of Catholics. This church holds mass twice a day on Sundays. They also plan retreats in the fall and spring.

name: University Christian Church - Austin Campus
reviewSummary:
This was the very first church I entered upon moving to Austin, and I cannot express how blessed I am to have found this lovely community of faith. UCC has served as one of the capstones of my life for the past couple of years, with its beautiful music, friendly congregants, and compassionate leadership altogether demonstrating the fullness of God's love and grace. Verily, this is a safe and joyous place; a place I am proud to call home. An older church with a traditional service, wonderful choir, and friendly congregation, but with many modern innovations like using a QR code to donate or register attendance. Located just south of UT campus. If you aren't familiar with the Disciples of Christ, they originated in the United States, and have no creeds except devotion to Christ, so no one will tell you what you "have to" believe. They take communion every Sunday. I like the freedom of belief this denomination offers. I attended here when I was a UT student and would probably still go there if I lived in Austin. My husband and I did premarital counseling with Reverend Megan Peglar here. I highly recommend her.

We also visited the church for service. Both Megan and the assistant pastor were great.

The church is very welcoming, and communion is open to all people. I have not actually attended mass here, but the Church itself is a very welcoming environment and is on a central place on campus that allows students to easily integrate worship into their everyday lives. They occasionally hold outreach events to try to expand their membership or spread their religious message. This is a gorgeous building in which makes people feel peaceful. Its existence makes UT-Austin students feel positive both for their academic and daily life. Every time I walk through this church, I can amazingly get rid of part of the annoyance in my mind.

name: University Christian Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary:
Very kid friendly. I was welcomed as soon as I entered. I am now a Baptist preacher but I am very ecumenical and I support this church 💯.  I grew up at phillipus ucc in otr from the 1980s through the 1990s. I serve in God's art and music ministries. I love this church very much.

Check out my Christian art 🎨 Check out the college/young professional small groups! They're fun for hanging out and learning more about the Bible, great balance of fun and curiosity in how to live well.

The Rohs cafe is the perfect spot to grab drink with a friend after church!

I love how the music fills all that space all the way up to the high ceiling. A great place to hang out with friends. Apart from the fact that it is a church, the building houses a very nice coffee shop. The inside is lively, much better off than Starbucks. Tue church service is usually filled with young people, which gets the sense of community back to the culture of isolation. Another unusual thing about this church is that the pastor is a lady, which speaks volumes of the progressive mindedness of the congregation. A unicorn of a church. They care about the christian calendar while also being such a supportive and loving community. Highly recommended.

name: University Christian Church - Fort Worth Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is truly a blessing to our students.  The staff is amazing.  They are very efficient.  Placed a large order one day and the next day I received a call that my order was ready.  FWISD counselors and staff greatly appreciate you.  May God continue to bless the church and the wonderful people there. The annual Boar's Head and Yule Log Festival production was exceptional, definitely worth adding to your 12-days of Christmas schedule. Presented early in January near Epiphany each year, over 300 players in stunning costumes tell the story of the Three Wisemen and the Boar's Head and Yule Log story with impressive pageantry. Gorgeous Church and such a great environment! As someone who has recently begun to identify as Demi and NB, I have been looking for an inclusive, open-minded (Welcoming AND Loving to all) place to worship, and I am so glad to have found this place.

There really aren't that many churches out there that provide a traditional feeling while being more progressive in their core principles.

I strongly believe that anyone should be able to hear a good message and learn about the scriptures. If Jesus didn't keep his sermons away from anyone, all should be able to hear it, regardless of how they identify. The pastor's messages are very easy to follow, to the point, and always devotional-esque.

Instead of just focusing on the past, there's a lot more thought-provoking statements and future-facing excitement in his messages, and that is something I have yet to encounter in other churches.

This is truly somewhere that I am so glad to be a part of, and the "come-as-you-are" counter-culture attitude (similar to the hippie movement when Calvary Chapel was founded-watch Jesus Revolution!) is very refreshing.

Thanks for having so many available worship times as well so more people can attend! I am so excited for Christmas and Easter Service in the future. Great ministerial staff. There are 3 services, 9:00, 10:10 (casual service) and 11:00. A beautiful, busy place to worship or gather for meetings. The hospitality is outstanding and they are welcoming to All people

name: University Christian Church (Disciples of Christ)/United Church of Christ - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: This was an awesome experience! Everyone is so friendly here everyone is welcome this was palm Sunday it was alot of fun service was not long and drawn out either It’s a business, and the man running it does not exemplify a man of God in any way, shape, or form. I’ve never been treated with so little grace and compassion in entire my life, and I grew up in small town churches. This place is a farce. They hide behind a fake veil of inclusivity, but Jesus asked us to LOVE. they do not operate from a place of love or mercy here. He runs a business in Hillcrest. Not a church. I’ve been attending this amazing church for about 18 months and I continue to be overwhelmed at the friendliness, creativity, love, and genuine caring that radiates from everyone here.  I am a straight older woman and this is a very diverse congregation that truly welcomes EVERYONE and encourages each of us to be the hands and feet of Jesus in our community, nation, and the world.  We’re actively involved in social justice and vigorously fight for the rights of all people because we’re all children of God!  The pastors and staff are empathetic and caring and we have tons of fun, too.  As part of every Sunday service, we say “I am welcome here.  You are welcome here.  We are welcome here.”  And we truly mean it! This is a fabulous church to worship God and learn about Jesus. As Christians we go out into the community to be good people and spread, love, warmth and positivity. It is an LGBTQ open and affirming church. Everyone is welcome here. It’s sad when family members are homophobic . We have never had cheesy drag shows. However, there are some fabulously written and performed acts that take place in October for our Theology of Broadway theme. These services will not disappoint and are beautifully portrayed by the loving congregation members. Never a dull moment and we have a fun and positive approach to our children’s Worship and Wonder as well. This is not a Christian church and it does not follow Jesus or his teachings.

name: University Church of Christ - Tuscaloosa Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a great experience in church from the Sunday school to the actual church service.

There was time for communion and prayers and there is a section for children depending on their grades.

The church is also into church planting in other places with missionaries. They have great innovations on attending to the welfare of people.
It was really a great time in God's presence. We are members at UCC, and we love it there. We’ve been able to grow in our faith and make lasting relationships. The Spirit of God is alive there. People are kind, authentic, and gracious. Great worship experience. We love visiting when in Tuscaloosa! Very much built on a founding family model…if you’re not one of those 5-6 families, you’re not “in” Love this church. So welcoming, and if you are a guest you are literally in for a treat. Yummy treat. Has 2 church services. Sometimes they are combined. They also have classes for children.

name: University City Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary:
They claim they are a loving church but don’t show it to people who aren’t there people. A great uplifting sunday service. Lots of great music and a great crowd. TRIA Service.  Excellent Pastor Tony Bravo *Update as of 5/2/2020- Attended drive through food distribution event today. It was very well organized and orderly. I appreciate this very much. I believe this modified distribution system is much more effective. As a senior with some mobility issues, this experience  was so much easier for me. The selection of food items I received was quite surprising and much needed. Thanks to the Pastor, the staff, the volunteers and all who have organized this event. May God continue to bless you all.

Attended their food distribution event today for the first time. As a senior citizen on limited income this really makes a difference in my ability to make ends meet. Plenty of fresh produce, breads, and other items to choose from. Staff are very welcoming and even help carry items to your vehicle. Also offered free cold water and lemonade. My most sincere blessings to the staff, volunteers and congregation.🙏🙏 Great service with alot of happy congregants (if that's a word)
The music was a little loud, but we are of this world after all. Traditional Church building, with a contemporary message and feel. Lots of young people and families. Very uplifting.

name: University City United Church - San Diego (UTC / La Jolla) Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm so glad the church is here.  It's refreshing to be apart of a church were openness and tolerance is so important!
Also my children attended the preschool and it is amazing!! Also, very affordable. Pastor Iona is great. The church welcomes everyone and is also great for families and kids. This church has had a powerful positive impact on my life. Love Jesus Yeah yeah yeah yeah

name: University Covenant Church - Davis Campus
reviewSummary:
UCC has a wonderful and affordable summer camp for Davis children.

Each summer they go all out- from the decorations, to the many volunteers, the to multiple large jump house slides, the kids are in for a big treat!

This summer is a jungle theme and last year there was a pirate theme with a large boat.  There is lots of activities and dancing so the kids have fun.  The kids have a great time and something they look forward to along with the wholesome teaching.  👍 Place of worship on extended and beautiful setting. UCC has been our church home for over 11 year.  They have a thriving youth program, they have a strong inclusion program for families with children who have any type of special needs.  We have always felt welcome and supported.  the sermons are easy to understand and applicable to the things happening in our community. I've been attending this church for over ten years. I love the high-energy worship band that rocks the stage during the contemporary services (9:30AM, 11AM and 5PM) and I enjoy the staff who really do seem God-focused and Christ-centered. Finally, what originally drew me to this church was their awesome kid's programs from preschool care, to their high-energy Breakaway Summer camp (K-6th) to their high-school and college ministries. I love being here and I adore the community. Spirited, lively faith-filled large church. They encourage joining one of their many small groups to make friends as you grow spiritually and move through life. Great youth programs, preschool, teaching and community. Their pastors are great, including the main one, John Fanous.

name: University Heights Christian Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary:
Have been member a long time. Am sick or injured in hospital frequently. So haven't been active for long time.
I'm going to try begging on street for med money 💰$107.04.
Please pray for help if you can.
God bless you all ✝️🕊️🙏📖🌺😄 Holy Spirit filled They had a wonderful Christmas service Best Christian Church.
Please come see
Sundays at 1030am Feels like home I loved the church I feel very welcome I loved it imma keep going

name: University Lutheran Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Very nice LCMS parish with generally traditional order of mass; I know the guy carrying the Processional Cross pretty well.
Congregation is lovely, very friendly and also provides a meal every Sunday. Weekday Bible studies are also great, and also have a provided meal.
Wonderful place overall to receive Word & Sacrament for students and non-students alike, and to praise Christ for His victory in the Gospel. ULC is an amazing church that I proudly call my home Small church, great organist, service is on a tablet  available in lobby if you don't have one, use a qr code to access it, most of service is projected. Lovely folks  - Sharing the Gospel - receiving Grace

name: University Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
University Presbyterian Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church! Attended UCLA for undergrad and this church was conveniently located very close to campus and they also offer shuttle services from the dorms. Great community of fellow college students, post-grads, and families as well. They also have small groups that meet during the week for undergrad, recently graduated, working adults, and families. ++ anddd they serve lunch after service every Sunday so it was very easy to get acquainted with other attendees :) This is the church that make you feel like a home. People here are genuinely nice, warm and kind! Great church family.  Great pastor and loving pastor wife

name: University United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: A lovely, progressive Methodist church. Highly inclusive and welcoming.

name: University United Methodist Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I am not the most consistent attendee at this church, but when I am able to attend (in person or online), I find the people welcoming and warm.  I really like the pastor and other members of the church.
It is a place for those who are leary of attending any church.  I recommend anyone to attend (via Zoom right now) and you will find it a comfortable place to be.  It is a scripture based church that looks at the love that God has for His people.
Come. Enjoy. Stay for the breakouts after the service. Friendly and welcoming. No pressure to join if you want to try it out.  traditional services and slowly merging with contemporary. The congregation is small, so may not be for those that are trying to hide but nobody will be offended if you are just trying to find a new home and this is not a fit for you. Beautiful church and grounds. People are friendly. One of their missions is serving the Homeless a hot meal each Saturday Open hearts, open minds, open doors! Come visit and worship with us! We are now starting a Spanish service at  12:00 p.m. on Sundays ❤️ We served a meal for the homeless in the social hall.  It has plenty of room for a large gathering.

name: University United Methodist Church Irvine - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been coming here about 8 years. What drew me in, and defines the church, is how welcoming they are. The leadership and the congregation lead with grace. There is a focus on serving God and each other through community and actions.

This is an LGBT-affirming church, and when the pastor says "all are welcome", she means it. It leans socially progressive without being overtly political. Love, not judgement, is emphasized.

The main service is at 9:30am and lasts about an hour. Children begin in the main service with their parents and then are dismissed to the children's program. There is an active social gathering on the patio after service with coffee and treats. I would encourage you to stay for 15-30 minutes rather than sneak out the back - I guarantee someone will come and talk to you!

Methodism has a rich musical tradition thanks to the Wesley brothers and we have a fantastic choir. Praise is mostly traditional hymns and the church sings together, as opposed to a praise band signing to the church. Accompaniment is usually by piano, though we also have guest musicians.

Communion (the Lord's Supper) is the first Sunday of the month. Services are lightly liturgical - more so than an evangelical church but much less so than a Catholic Mass. We say the Lord's Prayer together every Sunday.

Come and visit us and see for yourself. This is a place that feels like all truly are welcome. The church members are so friendly and you get the sense that they really care about each other and, through their programs and services, they are putting God’s word into deeds throughout the community. The sermons are inspiring, the choir is second to none, and the work of this church is alive and well. I came to this church at age 8, 51 years ago. It never fails that visitors tell us that our members are some of the most welcoming people that they have met at any of the churches they tried. Where they were ignored at other churches,  they were made to feel welcome here: Introduced around the Gathering Grounds after service and invited to chat as they were comfortable. All ages are equally welcome and we have wonderful children's and youth programs. Plus we are known for our choir. Belong, Believe, Be Love! UUMC has been a home for my family for 50 years. The gospel is preached each Sunday along with beautiful music from our choir & accompanist. For all ages there are classes & events which encourage us to learn about our faith and how to practice Christ’s love in action. Multiple members actively participate in the many outreach programs. Our church motto summarizes this well:  Belong, Believe & Be Love.  Mickey Chase My husband and I were looking to “belong” to a Church family and we absolutely found it in University United Methodist Church.  It’s everything we were looking for.  A warm Pastor (Cathi Capp) who truly wants everyone to feel welcome.  There are no exclusions- only inclusion! For anyone new to Irvine or is out there Church shopping, come on in and be marvelled. The congregation couldn’t be nicer- in addition, our post services provide the best baking in Irvine.  You’re all invited🙏😁

name: University United Methodist Church Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been coming here about 8 years. What drew me in, and defines the church, is how welcoming they are. The leadership and the congregation lead with grace. There is a focus on serving God and each other through community and actions.

This is an LGBT-affirming church, and when the pastor says "all are welcome", she means it. It leans socially progressive without being overtly political. Love, not judgement, is emphasized.

The main service is at 9:30am and lasts about an hour. Children begin in the main service with their parents and then are dismissed to the children's program. There is an active social gathering on the patio after service with coffee and treats. I would encourage you to stay for 15-30 minutes rather than sneak out the back - I guarantee someone will come and talk to you!

Methodism has a rich musical tradition thanks to the Wesley brothers and we have a fantastic choir. Praise is mostly traditional hymns and the church sings together, as opposed to a praise band signing to the church. Accompaniment is usually by piano, though we also have guest musicians.

Communion (the Lord's Supper) is the first Sunday of the month. Services are lightly liturgical - more so than an evangelical church but much less so than a Catholic Mass. We say the Lord's Prayer together every Sunday.

Come and visit us and see for yourself. This is a place that feels like all truly are welcome. The church members are so friendly and you get the sense that they really care about each other and, through their programs and services, they are putting God’s word into deeds throughout the community. The sermons are inspiring, the choir is second to none, and the work of this church is alive and well. I came to this church at age 8, 51 years ago. It never fails that visitors tell us that our members are some of the most welcoming people that they have met at any of the churches they tried. Where they were ignored at other churches,  they were made to feel welcome here: Introduced around the Gathering Grounds after service and invited to chat as they were comfortable. All ages are equally welcome and we have wonderful children's and youth programs. Plus we are known for our choir. Belong, Believe, Be Love! UUMC has been a home for my family for 50 years. The gospel is preached each Sunday along with beautiful music from our choir & accompanist. For all ages there are classes & events which encourage us to learn about our faith and how to practice Christ’s love in action. Multiple members actively participate in the many outreach programs. Our church motto summarizes this well:  Belong, Believe & Be Love.  Mickey Chase My husband and I were looking to “belong” to a Church family and we absolutely found it in University United Methodist Church.  It’s everything we were looking for.  A warm Pastor (Cathi Capp) who truly wants everyone to feel welcome.  There are no exclusions- only inclusion! For anyone new to Irvine or is out there Church shopping, come on in and be marvelled. The congregation couldn’t be nicer- in addition, our post services provide the best baking in Irvine.  You’re all invited🙏😁

name: Upland Lighthouse Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
God is still working in this church. The praise team has the seal of approval and the altar is on fire for the Lord. You can feel the presence of the Lord our God. He is eager to fill us with His spirit. Join us for a time of fellowship, communion, and Sharing the word of God. If you’re looking for a church, look no further this is it! God loves you 🥰 God bless you ALL All glory to the Lord Jesus Christ. I thank him every day that he planted my family and I at the Upland Lighthouse. This church has been a critical in every aspect not just for me but for my wife and 3 children .They have grounded us in truth and changed our lives forever. As we continue to grow I suggest anyone searching for truth searching for purpose in their life to come and see what Jesus Christ can do for you . Love you all and God bless you. Best church in the inland empire!
The Presence of God is so strong and everyone is so welcoming❤️ I've been attending ULC for 12 years now. And I am HONORED to call this my home church. God has restored my relationship with my husband and has restored my kids' relationship with their father. We have an amazing Pastor who loves everyone, and he sees the potential in every family. We love God, and we worship God with all our hearts. If you are looking for a church,  please come by, and you won't be disappointed. The Spirit of God will be evident. Best church you’ll ever visit. 🙏🏼🤍

name: Upper Arlington Lutheran Church: Lytham Road Campus - Upper Arlington / Northwest Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a neighborhood, true Bible-based church with a welcoming congregation, this is the place. Different Service times offer Beautiful worship music- traditional or modern. They’re very involved in community service and offer many ways to serve. This is the church where we were married.  We didn't go in just took some selfies. I have always avoided Upper Arlington Lutheran Church because their theology is extremely conservative.

However, I had the opportunity to briefly visit their Lytham Rd. campus on 5-15-2018 so that I would be able to attend a "Welcome to Medicare" presentation that had been sponsored by the Upper Arlington Commission on Aging.

Lytham Rd. had been closed because of construction so my Uber driver had had to "go around the block" and use the Middlesex Rd. entrance to their parking lot.

The "Welcome to Medicare" presentation had been interrupted, before it had even begun, by a tornado warning. Those wishing to do so were invited to move to the basement; no one, as I recall it, left the room.

The program continued; the church building was not destroyed by a tornado; I learned much useful information about Medicare that evening.

I then walked back to Middlesex Rd. [knowing not to use Lytham Rd.] and requested an Uber Ride home. Wonderful body of Believers! lovely setting, friendly people, serving God and the community.

name: Upper Merion Baptist Church
reviewSummary: My daughter loves UM school , Teachers are friendly and i.e,..Tammi, Katie & Linda are exceptionally good and profissional. My daughter learned a lot in one year. I totally love it, Have only five starts here otherwise i want to give ten starts.... It's great school. We love to send our son happily here. Teachers and the management are very caring and understanding. When I click on the website button provided by Google it takes me to a Pharmacy Website. Not the UMBC's website. I called the office and they are looking into it. In the meantime if you get the Pharmacy, you can get UMBC's site by using the IP Address 97.74.181.200. My son really enjoyed going to the school. Teachers are very friendly and helpful. My son goes there and enjoys it. The teachers are great and very helpful.

name: Upper Room Christian Fellowship - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary:
Back in 1992 my wife and I were young believers and attended here for a year.  To this day we both say hands down the best fellowship we've ever been apart of... If they haven't changed much, which it looks like they have not, they are as close to what Yeshua wanted... maybe they be one! I have attended this church for two years and counting while my spouse finishes his grad program at the university near by.
What I value so much about this church is my opportunity to learn and grow in my faith journey. I love the church teaches Jesus Christ our Lord and savior.
I love that the teaching, preaching, and Bible studies are biblically focused.
I love there are many opportunities to gather for prayer.
I love the community and fellowship opportunities.
I love that we support, and pray for missionaries around the world! Sharing the Gospel of Jesus Christ our redeemer!
If you want to grow in your faith walk I would definitely encourage anyone to visit this church. The most spirit filled non-denominational church friendly people I am Catholic now but this is the best non-Catholic church i have ever gone to(I have been to over 100 churches) ! The atmosphere is so great because of the meal and the small group and homeschoolers!

Pray for unity in the church!

I Highly recommend Catholic confession the Eucharist changed my life!

Just try one mass and hear the words Lamb of God you TAKE AWAY the sins of the world! Christ-centered worship with solid teaching. Missions-focused with a large international congregation. Very family friendly. Sincere God-seekers, young and old.

name: Upper Room Community Church - Auburn Campus
reviewSummary: Went to Upper room church today.  Loved it.  The Lord was so present in the service.  Friendly people. Great community of people, welcoming environment, family friendly atmosphere URCC consistently brings me closer to God. The Upper Room a place that is filled with God's Spirit It is very homey

name: Upper West Manhattan church of Christ - New York Campus
reviewSummary: A place where different nationalities[ Caucasian,Black Americans,Africans and Latino's] worship together the same GOD which is wonderful, I cannot forget the greetings as you walk in or someone walking after you, very friendly and lovable congregation with  sound preaching and singing. Fantastic group of Christians! If you're looking for the truth and a family to help you along your journey Upper West Manhattan Church Of Christ is the place to be! Such a friendly congregation! The acapella singing and Lord's Supper was a balm to the soul - so beautiful!  Fantastic group of Christians that welcome everyone and make all feel at home. Congregation meets in the Soho Room of the HI-NYC hostel. Great place to sincerely worship with other Christians. Incredible acapella singing and one of the friendliest congregations I have visited. It was great to worship here. Had a great worship session. The sermon was very instructive. The preacher and members of the congregation were very friendly.

name: UPPERROOM Dallas - Dallas Campus
reviewSummary:
We have traveled all the way from South Africa to visit Upperroom in Dallas and the EOY conference... The worship was amazing and I would say the translator that was in the service translating the words preached was so huggable I just wanted to give him a hug 🫂  I even felt the tears streaming down my face while he was talking and translating. We'll done for him.
I was greatful to see that there was police in the street infront of the church supporting the church. I hope they will consistently support the church. The Coffee Shop people were friendly though making great coffee and gave a smile here and there. We hoped there will be more people welcoming us and chatting to us but there were so many people there.
Junior were very welcoming and greeted us and welcoming us at the EOY conference. Thank you Junior for your kindness as we traveled very far to visit Upperroom and we felt greatful that someone noticed us. Thank you for your bright smile and kindness towards us.
I hope this space of Upperroom stays 'sacred'. I would suggest that they create more prayer rooms for EOY. The small prayer room felt as if the Holy Spirit was there and the worship was powerful. We already miss the prayer sessions 😢
Thank you also Camille Riggs for your kindness towards us and the book. Your friendliness and warmness towards us was greatly appreciated. Your book so far is amazing. Thank you for the beautiful art you created. Also the other people creating art at Upperroom - it was greatly appreciated and I even bought two copies.
We hope to visit again in the future. We already miss Upperroom and hope to visit soon again. Much love xxxxxxx Beautiful campus, very welcoming community. My spouse and I were looking locally for our new home church and this place came up because of the sense of community and younger crowd. The experience was overall great, but this is a Pentecostal church which was not made clear online. If a more energetic church experience is what you’re looking for, this place is worth giving a try. Thank you for a beautiful time meeting in His presence here. We visited from Canada and came to Texas primarily with this in mind. We attended 3 times and just felt the lovely nearness of God. I know they are moving and we hope one day we'll make it to the new location.

As a worship leader, (and my husband a pastor) coming here was a breathe of fresh air and it set a renewed fire under us. We love spontaneous worship. It was amazing to sit and bask in His presence and receive and not be the ones up front! After living in DFW for nearly 50 years there are only 2 churches I trust. Upperroom is one of those churches. They know how to worship. They know how to make room for Holy Spirit during worship. They are a church that prays. If you want to encounter God go to Upperroom. The teaching I could take or leave but the worship is in spirit and in truth. 🙌🏻🔥🙌🏻UR is a hidden gem, nestled in the heart of Dallas' industrial district, renowned for its powerful prayer services. 🙏 Arriving early is key to securing a seat, but the wait is a blessing in disguise, offering ample time to connect with a diverse community from around the world. The church is currently expanding, which will soon eliminate the wait times. The atmosphere is saturated with God's presence, ensuring every attendee leaves touched by the Holy Spirit, the worship, and the preached Word.

❤️ One standout feature of UR is its profound appreciation for the arts, using it as a form of worship that resonates deeply with its diverse congregation. Whether you're a local or just passing through, UR is more than a place of worship; it's a spiritual home worth finding. Services are held all week long. This location is kid-friendly. 🏠

name: Upstate Church Greenville - Greenville Campus
reviewSummary:
The Young Pro’s community (20s - 30s) is such a blessing! Our Sunday group currently meets at 11:15am on site after 10am service.

God truly is moving at Upstate Church GVL! This church is truly special!! There is sound teaching of the Bible and a multi-generational and diverse community of believers. The people are genuine and seeking to honor and glorify God with their whole lives, not just their Sunday morning attendance. Come join us!! There is so much room for people of all ages! From 0 to senior, everyone is welcomed joyfully. There is an incredible student ministry, kids ministry, and several groups for young adults/adults. The pastor is also top-tier as well as very personable. 10/10 church highly recommend. If you're looking for a church home in Greenville, this is the one. My family has attended multiple churches in the area, and this church campus is amazing! You can really tell they just love people and love Jesus. It feels like a real community. Pastor Hayden is such a great teacher too. Just moved here from Arizona & found my forever church home. First impressions walking in you’re noticed right away by the staff and volunteers because it’s such a tight knit community, so they recognize new faces. If you’re looking for genuine fellowship with a Bible believing pastor, this is where you belong.

name: Upward Call Church Chino - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful family. It was a privilege to visit, we loved the opportunity to experience this amazing community. A wonderful church where everyone is welcome. The focus is on Jesus and the Scripture. Hi, upward call chino church
Im a local resident nearby your church, your alarm system has been blaring off for the ENTIRE night. Please fix this issue.

It is not the first night this has happened also.
.
From,
Sleep deprived chino resident Wow! Darian, Pastor at Upward Call, tells it like it is! His messages are clear and always points the listener to Jesus! Another thing I love about Upward Call is that they take a 7-minute fellowship time during the service every week to give people a chance to actually have a conversation with others around them. They believe church is family and encourage people to connect in a real, meaningful way. We love it! Church like it is meant to be. IMHO An old but nice church used by the city for different types of events and meetings. Wedding receptions, company parties, group meetings, etc. Two large rooms, one with a stage, and a couple smaller rooms. Large kitchen also available. Folding tables and chairs available at the facility. Large parking lot and a small park with swings and a playground. I attend two events there each week.  Check it out for your next event, contact the city of Chino for rental dates and times.

name: Urban Grace: The Downtown Church
reviewSummary:
I want to update my review of the Sunday morning breakfast that the church has sponsored for the past 26 year.  Feeding the homeless of Tacoma is  a blessing from God delivered to the less fortunate through the volunteers that devote their time and culinary skills to provide a holson and delicious meal that is legendary.  I would visit the once a week feed on occasion. Being homeless myself it was beacon of light and I expressed my appreciation adamantly. Then it came to my attention that some of the volunteers were a part of my history growing up in Tacoma.  Eventually I was asked to join the team of volunteers and help . I was honored.  To be part of such graciousness  gave me a purpose. I now project a warm greeting to the homeless as they enter the dining room. Getting there at 5 am to set up, greeting each individual with a smile and  putting the equipment away makes me feel closer to my community through the efforts of God's volunteers. The food is prepared with love and kindness and  being  homeless while giving to the homeless completes the circle.  I have established a lasting bond with those who are the giver and the receivers of God's goodness. Great space for events! Centered in the heart of downtown Tacoma, it is great to see how many awesome community events are held here.

This year was my first time catching the 253 Short Film Party here and it did not disappoint. Came here for the 253 film fest from grand cinema. It's an old building and super out of date but it was still cool. They have the Best Grits In the World, you can come any Sunday to get a free all you can eat French toast, eggs, and bacon. Thanks For all of your spiritual needs. Great place to meet that someone special. Start a new relationship or rekindle an old one. It's never too late, don't let this one get away.

name: V1 Church - Brooklyn - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
Been attending V1 church now for almost 4 months. Growing up I attended different churches and it was always a battle due to so much judgment. Being at V1 church it's home this is truly family. The welcoming from everyone the service and different groups and the prayer team is amazing.  I'm currently at a Breaker group learning more about the Bible and our lord. Again almost for months I did my baptism on my first visit and haven't missed one service because even from home I'm able to watch if I can't make it to service.  V1 is family now I hope whoever reads this takes the time to come in and see what family and what our lord is like with V1. GOD BLESS EVERYONE 🙌 Visited V1 church in Brooklyn for the first time with my lady last Sunday. We decided that celibacy before marriage is something we both wanted to practice, and that we want Jesus to be a central part of our relationship, our family and our home, and we want to experience this journey with one another... I was completely blown away! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and a bit busy at times, but the sense of camaraderie and community was unlike anything I've experienced! Nothing was forced, I never felt awkward, the service was full of music and worship and the pastor connected with people who seemed to be in need, acknowledged them, consoled them, the entire church rallied behind in support, and with brief, straight to the point and very practical preaching, we all praised the good lord in worship. It's hard to explain, but I felt something positively unmistakable there, and I left feeling like i didn't choose my church, but my church chose me!!! From a realist that isn't easily swayed, don't take my word, just pop in one day and see and feel what it's about.... thank me later... thank you pastors Ed, and Jocelyn, and pastor Mike ... All praises to Jesus! 🙏🏾🙏🏾🙏🏾 I’ve been searching for a church for the past few months, and last Sunday, I finally visited V1 for the first time. I went alone and was a little nervous, but from the moment I walked in, I was warmly welcomed. It felt as if I had known everyone there for years, and more importantly, I truly felt the presence of God in that place. I’m so grateful to have found a church that accepts me just as I am. Highly recommend! I watched a few videos of the pastor before attending in person. The venue is nice inside (warehouse area of Brooklyn) and clearly a lot of caring people there seeking to serve others.

Messages carry deep insight from the Holy Spirit which is awesome and rare to find imo. Great especially for believers looking for deeper insight and to grow closer to God through a biblical and spiritual understanding of Him.

Definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area or even passing through on a given Sunday. Such a welcoming environment. As I was sitting down waiting for the service to start a young dude I think named Isaiah randomly came up to me and introduced himself and welcomed me, also introduced me to another church member. As a guy looking for fellowship and kindness in a church I thought that was powerful. And the worship team also did their thing!!

reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Valencia Hills Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: It is definitely an authentic Biblical community in Valencia and Santa Clarita, founded on God's word, seeking to love God and love our neighbor. I've attended the Arabic services with pastor Issa. The Arabic church started there recently and it has been growing and growing. It is definitely a great place to check out if you speak Arabic and planing to grow spiritually and learn the Bible. They have actual services in Arabic every Sunday at 6:30 pm and they have Bible study and multiple other activities for the whole family My daughter invited me to VHCC 3 years ago, I  am now a member.  I was looking for a small intimate church that was also welcoming and friendly,  and thats what I found here. My family have been attending just over a year. We quickly noticed and felt the authenticity of the people we met, the emphasis on teaching God's Word, God uplifting worship, and the importance of reaching outside of the church doors to bring the love and grace of God to others through the many ministries and opportunities to serve. We like this church, and go there whenever we are visiting my mother-in-law. Paster Denis does a great job of delving into the gospel, and explaining it in layman's terms. Great Bible-based church full of caring people practicing authentic Christianity. Pastor Dennis exudes the love of God and his preaching is excellent.

name: Valencia United Methodist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: Wow.  Church reviews, what a concept....  My partner and I have been members here for decades. It was the obvious love of music on display during services that initially attracted us, but now we're grateful to have found such a warm and caring Faith Community.  Drop in at 9:00 or 10:30 Sunday morning and see for yourself...we've been praying for you. I love this church! All are welcome here. It’s a warm and welcoming community of faith. The choir and music ministries are fantastic and help to lead worship in amazing ways. There are many opportunities to serve our community too. When we moved from NJ 5 years ago, we visited many churches in town. When we first arrived to VUMC, we immediate felt welcomed and accepted. The programs for the kids and youth are great! My teen actually asks to go to youth group and a teen being enthusiastic about anything is saying a lot. 😉 It is important to me that this is one of the few LGBTQIA+ affirming churches in town. I feel the members truly live out the motto “All are welcome and all means all.” Pastors Andy and Camille are very down to earth, open minded, and welcome questioning and discourse. My family found our church home here. ❤️ My family and I love attending Valencia United Methodist Church. We generally go to the 10:30 praise band service, but try to take my Mother In Law a few times a year to the 9:00 service to hear their amazing Choir. This Church has a great youth program, Kids Zone,  Vacation Bible School, and many more activities. I've been attending Valencia United Methodist Church for many years, and for many reasons. It's a warm and welcoming church with relatable sermons and friendly people. And the music is amazing! The first service has a beautiful choir and the second service has a lively modern band. All very talented. Through a small group I joined (a blend of Bible study, book club and support group) I made new friends whom I cherish.

name: Vallejo Bible Church - Vallejo Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful Church kind people courteous, polite and they really seem to care. You want to hear the word of God. That is the place to be. However, I was a little shocked when they sung the Star-Sprangled banner there Sunday. I understand that they wanted to give their thanks and appreciation memorial Day Holiday. That's just how kind they are. Beautiful Church highly recommended Fantastic deaf culture experience for a hearing person  learning ASL! Great pastor! We enjoyed his wife doing the interpretation for the hearing during the sermon and because she would provide voice almost at the same time he signed we could actually learn a few new signs. We were also blessed to attend a church potluck after the service where we were able to attempt to communicate with various deaf people from the church. Great experience for a hearing person. I live in Oklahoma and had a fraudulent loan taken out in Vallejo CA, under my name. The IP address routes back to this church address. I have the banking account information provided for the deposit and will be filing charges once we have a name!! Absolutely disgusting. This is Jevon love it here free food and free worship Nice church and the pastor is great. Super friendly people as well
