reviewSummary: [object Object]

name: Valley Bethel Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: 8-19-18 came here today and i loved it, this place has english service at 11am and this place has quality worship time, the parking lot is spacious, there is lunch after the worship time and everyone is so nice. Thank you again for being a blessing to the city of Chatsworth

name: Valley Bible Church - Gilbert Campus
reviewSummary:
After attending Valley Bible Church (including The Refinery) for about two months, I wanted to share my experience for others considering this church.
The church has strong Bible teaching and a welcoming atmosphere. However, I was surprised to learn they hold a clear Reformed / 5-point Calvinist position on salvation (election, irresistible grace, etc.). This is not clearly stated on their “What We Believe” page.
After speaking with a pastor, it became evident that while Arminians can attend and become members, they would not be permitted to lead small groups or serve in any discipleship/leadership roles. I hold a more Arminian understanding of Scripture, so this church is not a good long-term fit for me.
If you are non-Reformed (especially on the doctrines of grace), you may want to clarify leadership expectations before getting deeply involved. Take this into consideration as you visit. Blessings MBC East Valley has been our home church since December 2020. Moving here from California, my husband and I wanted to find a church that doesn’t shy away from the Word. We wanted a reformed church that would hold us accountable and keep us in unison with the Word of God. The pastor here, Albert Kilgore, is kind and collected. His sermons are filled with context as he takes you through the chapters verse by verse. I cannot express how much I’ve learned in just a few short months. The church body is very kind and welcoming. Please consider this church if your heart is seeking truth and a healthy understanding of God’s word. At this church, they love God, love people, and make disciples. My family and I have been attending Mission Bible Church East Valley for a little over a year now and we are immensely blessed to call this church our home. With Bibles open, the word of God is diligently taught from the pulpit each Sunday with faithfulness. The body of believers is amazing, and their love for the Lord and for His people is evident. If you're looking for a Church to call home, I encourage you to attend Mission Bible Church East Valley! My husband and I found Mission Bible Church in February 2021. We were looking for a church that was reformed and that preached straight from the Bible. We also wanted a church that has a deep sense of community and was small enough that members were actually shepherded and discipled. We have found that and so much more here. The gospel good news of Jesus is regularly and faithfully preached. The Word is opened, read and taught from every week. The community is sincere and genuine. Pastor Albert takes seriously his calling to shepherd the local body of believers that he has been entrusted. But don’t take my word for it, come and see. I visit Queen Creek Az frequently and it was so hard to find a Christian church that preaches the true, untwisted word of God. Pastor Albert nails it every time and has a way of preaching that truly honors God. The kids church is amazing and my boys love seeing their friends when we are in town. If you are looking for a new church, this is it!

name: Valley Christian Assembly-God
reviewSummary: I was working near Charleston when I found VCA. This Assemblies church is a very blessed house. I felt home as soon as I entered and now anytime I'm working a couple hours, this is my home congregation away from home. Charleston is fortunate to have Pastor Philip, who has an amazing testimony, and Pastor Jerome, who is a great young pastor!  Thank you VCA for continuing to serve our Lord! Loved the casual and friendly environment.  Pastor shook our hands and made us feel very welcome.  Bible study was very in depth and a great learning opportunity for a novice or a more advanced audience. They welcomed me with opened arms they don't judge you by what you wear or the color of your skin they're just glad to have you there to worship with them There is so much peace and rest here. I’m so thankful for the Holy Spirit leading us to Valley Christian Assembly of God. My favorite church

name: Valley Christian Bilingual Church Concord - Concord Campus
reviewSummary: Good day, dear ones! Help me find a sponsor for my family! Glory to Jesus Christ!

name: Valley Christian Church
reviewSummary: What a refreshing place. Join in and meet believers who will walk with you, help lift your spirits and brighten your day. Pastor Kendall Holmes is real and motivated. The congregation is friendly and ready to greet you as a family member. Very loving. They want you to conform, not live through Christ. To live and serve them at their leisure. The pastor hates you for showing up and when he shows up, it’s your fault and your problem. Good biblical teaching Everyone was very welcoming. The sermon was good. Good fellowship, learning opportunities, & interesting sermon series.

name: Valley Christian Church - Birmingham Campus
reviewSummary:
Fantastic atmosphere. The preacher always has a great sermon, congregation.  Treats you like family. Very welcoming. I can say a few things about this place...
First of all I've never attended church here, nor have I visited here, but they assisted me before is ugly as that sounds of not ever attending but gaining resources.
A church is in the business of helping folks as long as it's helping people..
You have to understand from a church perspective it's really hard to help meet the needs of someone immediately if they're not going to church at your location. It's great to be able to provide somebody with food but you want to provide somebody with food immediately and meet their needs long-term to where they can learn how to acquire in grasp a hold of what's going on with them financially in order to make their financial means last longer.
In a long story short, a church if they were to help meet the needs of everyone short-term they wouldn't be in existence for longer than a month. That's just reality. So I need was a short-term need because I wasn't from around and needed help with fuel..

Next let me say that they got a new minister. I don't really know who was the one prior to the new guy here but his name is Mr Rick he's the preacher hereand I can speak on my part for him, he was not only enjoyed to talk to you on the phone but when I got to meet him face-to-face he was really a character. We laughed and cut up, he was kind and his attitude was that of a service and you could just see that in his overall life you could tell that Christ was coming through him

So if you have not gotten a chance to go here and you are from this area or live in this area or used to go to this area, y'all go by and see Mr Ricky's doing a tremendous job and he really exuberates what a Christian is he's not one of those guys that have helped you and then you know kind of forces an opinion or belief. We all know that the reality is, those who don't follow God are not going to be able to make it to heaven and the goal of each Christian because in reality we are our brother's keeper. We are Brothers keeper and we're supposed to help those who fall around us not because of them but rather because we need to hopefully keep them accountable so that they can acquire salvation as well

You can just tell that Mr Rick was in the business of meeting people's needs at whatever level they were on if he was able to.

He's doing great things and great work and if you're able to and can, I would go by and see Mr Rick
He definitely wasn't One of a Kind guy and that church is absolutely beautiful! Great congregation. Wonderful people. Historic windows. Spanish and Christianity services good brothers and sisters Good church!

name: Valley Christian Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited VCC for the first time today! Great to learn and study systematic Theology. Everyone was very welcoming and brother Rick prayed with me towards the end. Looking forward to returning. God bless. Such a fantastic church!

The beauty of Valley Christian lies in the people who populate its sanctuary every week. The kindness and love conveyed by the congregation members become infectious. The members are as genuine and authentic as can be. The feeling of welcome-ness my family received when they set foot in that place was phenomenal!

Unfortunately, my family was only able to be part of the church for a little over a year before life relocated us out of state. Yet, even though our time of fellowship in the congregation was brief, members from VCC still reach out to us periodically to ask about our family's well-being. That, my friends, is how you do church!

That being said, if you still haven't found a church to call home and want to experience the love of God in fellowship and sound teaching, Valley Christian Church is a surefire bet...although some of Pastor Mike's sermons may persuade you to reconsider the practice of making bets in the future...I digress, but I hope you get my point.

Shalom! I love how this church is so welcoming since the start. Im proud growing up and it being a great neighbor. The church has made the surrounding neighborhood a safe and granted faith with those who surround it... The community is supper friendly we move from New Hope Center because it close down. A good worship experience.  Warm and freindly church.

name: Valley Christian Church - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: Jesse is so cool, I could listen to him all day. The church 'family' are loving, caring and friendly.My husband & I feel at home here. Voting Nice church

name: Valley Christian Family (VC Family) - Redding Campus
reviewSummary: Chill vibe. Very organized. Very welcoming. I appreciate the family, all inclusive feel. Wide range of ages. Loads of ministry and be of service opportunities. Excellent worship and sermons. Relatable. Grounded. In complete alignment with my belief systems. Respectful. Friendly. Pastor Travis, your Easter message was wonderful, great job! I attended your church for the first time today with my mother and I have to say that we loved it. Great worship music and a wonderful sermon. Been looking for a church in the area to call home and I believe I've found it. Looking forward to getting to know this church family. This church is such a great place. Love the worship. Love the sermon. They feel like family. VCF is a Christ centered family led through biblical teachings. Praise, worship and belonging: all we were meant to have in a church.

name: Valley Church - Cupertino Campus
reviewSummary:
This community is so welcoming and hospitable. We joined them for the weekend's special events and hearing all the ways they have auch a positive impact not only in the Bay Area but the entire world truly inspires! Consider bringing the entire family and getting to know other like-minded caring families. Great church.
Everyone is super friendly and helpful.
I really enjoyed the service and also got to see  two children get baptized  the children gave a wonderful speech especially the little girl.
Her speech was very moving. Hello to all at valley church, praise him so much,this is jimmy Munyaho one of the founder of GUECABafrica located in Jinja Uganda along on budondo Road, committed to empower youths with development skills and to carry out charity programs to help members people like orphans widows young mothers street childern and so on,we kindly come before,in requesting your prayers, support to our programs including the program called New life after gospel program. Wonderful family of Jesus followers preaching the Bible and living out Jesus Christ's command to love one another. Awesome children's ministry, dynamic youth group, vibrant music ministry, support missionaries around the globe. Two services on Sunday morning, multiple Bible studies, prayer groups throughout the week. AWANA on Wednesday night. My family loves this church! The church that give so much to the community. We live down south so we don’t go to this church but my kids have been going to their free tennis clinics, vbs, summer camps. They also have bible study and youth groups meeting open for everyone who are interested. Thank you Valley Church!

name: Valley Church - Phoenix Campus
reviewSummary:
I want to share my honest experience with this church because I believe transparency is important for anyone considering joining.

When I first came, I was hopeful to find a welcoming, loving community where I could grow in my faith. Unfortunately, I found the atmosphere to be unwelcoming.

I believe Jesus would listen to people’s feelings and struggles with compassion. Sadly, when I shared my honest thoughts on their social media, I was blocked rather than heard. That response made me feel even more excluded.

If you’re looking for a church where openness and genuine listening are prioritized, I encourage you to keep searching. Faith communities should be a place where everyone feels valued and supported.

I pray that this church grows in grace and hospitality, but for now, this was not the experience I had. Music was far too loud for the space. We arrived “too early” and were shuffled to go to either Panera Bread or Starbucks… No offer to wait in the lobby seating. We ended up leaving and won’t be back per the drive distance (came from Laveen).

Update… reply from Chris, who did “greet’ us, forgot to mention we literally had to yell at each other to get to the point we did. We left the lobby outside and walked around building and left after agreeing music was going to be far too loud. I would recommend adding coffee, water and donut “times” to your site if arriving early is frowned upon to scope out a new church home. Kind of the reason for landing early if I’m honest. I have been attending Valley Church since October 2024 after not having been to church in years. I was brought up Catholic but never really practiced my faith. Coming to Valley Church has renewed my faith and I am excited to attend services every Sunday and even groups during the week. Everyone is nice and welcoming and I am excited and thrilled to be a part of Valley Church. Valley Church is the best! The community is unmatched. Since I’ve joined, I’ve made friends I couldn’t imagine my life without now. Pastor Chris messages are always on point and hit home. The worship is beautiful and the kids team will help your kids have a fun morning while also helping them know Gods word. I Found God in the Valley(one of the Valley Church T Shirts), but it's true I found him at Valley Church. To my surprise I also found an amazing community, life long friends, a dope place to hear a sermon and to worship God, a way to positively impact the city of PHX, and share the gospel with others! Valley Church is a place where you can experience God and not feel pressured, you can be yourself and be accepted, and you can learn about Jesus in a  fun way with some cool peeps. Vally Church is a 10 out of 5!

name: Valley Church - Vacaville Campus
reviewSummary:
We held a Christian comedy show with Bob Smiley last night. It turned out great. Staff very helpful and friendly. We were visiting from Oregon last week and want to thank you for the love and kindness that was extended to us... you truly made us feel that we were “home”.
I carry tow ropes in our Jeep and tried to think of a way to wrap them around the Church so we could take all of you back to Oregon with us!
In the Grace that is Jesus we send our love. Amazing sermon today.  Encouragement is such a gift.  Pastor Jeremy inspired me to be more generous with words and actions.
Thank you for being open in-person and online and allowing us personal choice to attend and be safe. God Bless A full-of-grace, bible-teaching church full of genuine, caring people. Heartfelt worship. A great place to bring your family or even come by yourself. Traditional venue in the student center for those who prefer hymns, and online access to sermons for those who can't come in person. Something for everyone. I’m originally from Philadelphia, i’ve traveled to California to see family and have attended this church multiple times and each service was amazing. Pastor Jeremy is amazing and so inspiring. I love it here and plan to keep attending every time i visit!

name: Valley Community Baptist Church - Tracy Campus
reviewSummary: We were lucky enough to encounter this church as it was across the street from where we lived. They have a great childrens program, every one was always very nice. If you are on the fence, try it. They are warm and fuzzy and not overbearing. Attended service with my family and it was a great experience. Everyone was welcoming and oh so kind. Agape love was overwhelming. Left with a smile on my face and heart. The pastor was very kind when I met him, even though I was just stopping by the business during the week on a Tuesday. We worshiped with them on Christmas and the host beautiful women’s tea conferences annually- our church had a good time- great traditional family fellowship. Recently started attending this church you will experience an annointed contemporary worship! Come Join us. Service time should be changing soon to 10AM

name: Valley Community Church - McAllen Campus
reviewSummary:
Most friendly church in the RGV.  Wonderful time of worship Sunday mornings! Solid expository teaching of The Word of God, beginning in Sunday School and followed by a traditional Worship Service.  I love singing hymns straight traditional hymnals.

VCC also has plenty of opportunities to get connected and serve in various ministries from AWANAs program, women and men’s ministries. Members are incredibly friendly. Pastor is passionate without yelling. Music is more traditional. Teaching is verse by verse. This is the most welcoming church we have found in the valley. Highly recommend. Met some very nice people, the pastor taught/preached the absolute word of God! If I lived there that would be my church! I had the honor of going with Mary Louise to her church. Beautiful  Reformed Church Sound and teaching a true blessing a family of believers with a love for Christ … A sound Church. Expository preaching. Verse by verse Bible classes. I am overwhelmingly grateful towards the Lord for this local assembly of believers.

name: Valley Community Church - Pleasanton Campus
reviewSummary:
We received a warm invitation from Brother Roland and Sister Pam, and from the moment we walked into VCC, we felt completely welcomed. The environment was peaceful, with beautiful prayers and scripture readings, and even a bit of laughter to keep things light. My 20-year-old son loved the Narnia-themed treasure hunt, and we both had so much fun. Not only was the service inspiring, but we even got to share a wonderful meal. VCC truly feels like a family, and I’m so grateful to be a part of it. I previously attended for 5 years. The people are very nice and desire to serve and care for others. Even their disability ministry is a blessing. I even developed some friendships there and served in the sound booth for at least a year.

The reason why I have to give three stars however is because I disagree with them theologically due to the emphasis on spiritual formation (a practice that I do not affirm as biblical). That was part of the basis of my departure.

Despite my dissention from their theological stance, I still love them and value them as my friends and pray for them every day. We went to this church for 3 years before moving to a different state. Such a wonderful community that preaches the gospel, teaches, and equips believers! Feels like home! Amazing pastors and beautiful music!  Ash Wednesday service was so fun & family oriented.  I can't explain how much I felt like I was with my own Christian family "the body of Christ" We started checking out Valley Community Church almost a year and half ago, and we’ve found more than just a place of worship – it's family. Located in the heart of Pleasanton you’ll be hard pressed to find a more faithful and welcoming community.

From the uplifting and thought provoking Sunday worship services to youth activities and child care VCC has really just left us feeling so blessed to be a part of such a wonderful community. We joined a Com Group and found a group of people looking to live life together as we walk in faith. What really brought us in was the disability ministry for our special needs child which spoke volumes to us. Their focus on apprenticeship is genuine, and their dedication to the community is evident.

name: Valley Gate Church - Tempe Campus
reviewSummary:
I was genuinely drawn to this church from the start—something about it just spoke to me spiritually. When I reached out through social media, they responded with warmth and kindness, inviting me to attend a Sunday service. I showed up feeling a bit nervous, but the members I met were welcoming and kind, which made the experience all the more meaningful.

The following week, I had plans to attend a young adult group I was truly excited about. Unfortunately, unforeseen circumstances changed everything—my mother suddenly became very ill, and I had to rush to California to be by her side. In the midst of receiving devastating news from doctors, my family and I were desperate for a miracle. I reached back out to VGC asking for prayers, simply hoping for support in a moment of deep need.

To my heartbreak, my message was read but never acknowledged. I waited, hoping someone would respond with at least a few words of comfort or encouragement—but nothing came. That silence was painful. It made me question whether the sense of community I had initially felt was real. As someone who’s been cautious about stepping back into church life after four years of distance, this experience, sadly, reminded me why I had stepped away to begin with.

It’s incredibly disheartening to feel dismissed in a moment when you’re most vulnerable. I still believe in the power of faith and community—but it’s clear this isn’t the space for me. I hope my experience can serve as a reminder of how deeply a simple act of compassion can impact someone’s journey. Great church! The people are so loving and kind. It was super sweet to be a guest and have people ready to help me get the kids checked in for a service for them. Worship was beautiful and Ps Darryl was amazing. He's so honest and transparent, he's relational and solid in his love for Jesus and his theological beliefs. An amazing place full of loving parishioners and leaders who give back to the community in a number of ways. I’ve been in church my whole life. When I’m here it feels like home. It’s real, it’s candid, it’s in your face, it’s humbling, it’s warming and most of all it’s bible based. Nothing said that isn’t back by multiple scriptures.  There couldn’t be better leaders than Pastor and the First Lady of this church ❤️. Thanks for taking up handicap parking in front of a dialysis center and blocking the road directly in front making it difficult for people to get picked up and dropped off. Insanely selfish

name: Valley Lighthouse Pentecostal Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm a tough sell for where I worship.  I stick to what is written by inspiration of Yahweh thru the hands of the writers.  I am not one that follows traditions.  This is a Pentecostal congregation so some traditions are apparent but they are such a loving group I easily look past that.  I have only attended a few months now but am comfy here. Visited this wonderful church two Sundays ago. Anointed, warm, a thriving house of God. Because the Pastor and his Wife and members  are so genuine.  The members  love the Lord , they believe  in Praise, Prayer , &  Worship .
No one is Perfect but it's a Blessing  to be apart of this Church  and the Ministry. A great place to worship. Pastor Chacon and his wife are the best. The worship team is the best. I highly recommend it for anyone in the area looking for a new church Awesome church! The Spirit baptized me through a Pastor visiting from TX with the gift of tongues! Aside from that, great place!

name: Valley Lights Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
such an amazing and welcoming place! nice refreshments and very friendly congregation! loved worship and took a lot of great notes from the sermon!!! Valley Lights Church has been a great place to visit! Whether it was a Sunday service or a midweek event, I’ve always felt welcomed and encouraged to invite others along. Even in the different spaces they’ve met in, the team consistently creates an excellent environment to worship God and connect with others in.

I’ve been especially impressed by the way the church leaders sacrifice for the mission and stay focused on helping people take steps to get closer to Jesus — all without any pressure. It’s a group of people that genuinely cares about people. Valley Lights Church is amazing! The whole church is a community in the truest sense, and have always made me feel so welcomed when I join in on a Sunday. The messages are biblically focused, and always have my husband and I leaving in a state of worship. We can’t recommend this church enough! I’ve visited Valley Lights Church twice now, and each time I’ve felt genuinely welcomed by the community. The message was encouraging and practical—rooted in the Bible, but easy to apply to everyday life. I also love that the church values staying connected throughout the week through different events and gatherings. It’s clear they’re intentional about building real relationships. I can definitely see myself coming back again! I’ve had the pleasure & blessing of attending Valley Lights while visiting Southern California many times since the church began. One can expect a warm welcome, uplifting worship, relevant Biblical preaching, a great children’s program, & most times, delicious drinks & treats! I’ve enjoyed the sense of community & connection they put an emphasis on which is why I make every effort to attend when visiting!

name: Valley Lutheran Church - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary: Valley Lutheran Church has good sermons, music and youth programs doing several outreach ministries. Very friendly Church. Love the. Musical  service  at 10.30 sundsys
