name: Valley Metro Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I've visited Valley Metro Church twice now, and each time the preaching spoke directly to my heart. I truly felt like the message was meant for me. I'm so grateful to God for leading me there and for the amazing ministry happening through this church. 🙏 Though still fairly new to the church, here at Valley Metro my husband and I have found more love and support than we even knew existed!  I personally find myself being brought back to my early days as a young Christian, when  the worship was clean and pure and the sermons impacted my life and my heart directly where I needed them to.  I tell you folks, this church is an absolute treasure in the heart of the San Fernando Valley and the Holy Spirit is moving there in purity and in power.  The church is free of so much of the nonsense that goes on in some churches today and instead, you leave each Sunday feeling loved and challenged to be a better Christian!  So thankful to call Pastor Brian and Kristi our Pastors! Pharmacy is hands down the worst!  4 people chatting it up behind the counter.  3 customers waiting!  Called in the prescription 24 hours prior and they put it on hold and didn’t bother to call.  Then asked me to come back the next day!  Finally the pharmacist came and released the hold but after already waiting for 20 minutes it’s another 10 minutes!  Can’t make this up.  Cvs needs to clean house in the pharmacy on Roscoe and de Soto! We are so happy to have found a church we can identify with and feel the holy spirit. Having moved from Glendale to Northridge, we began our search for a new Calvary Church due to the commute! We searched for a new holy home in the valley, but didn't truly feel like a community, nor identify with the ones we visited. Finally, we found one we attended for a period until we didn't appreciate the jokes of other dominations, so we continued our search until we were finally found Valley Metro (Calvary Church). Valley Metro Church has been our home for years now! Pastor Brian and his beautiful, humorous wife our incredible! Valley Metro is a bible teaching church that reflects just that! Come and see! I am so happy to see that Valley Metro Church is a blessed house of Christians being a part of the united body of Christ.  I attended church here in the 1950's and 60's when it was the a Disciples of Christ Church.  I was saved here and baptized by Reverend Hensley.  My father who was a master sheet metal worker made the steeple and donated it as his "mite".  The building looks great!  Thank you and God bless all of you.

name: Valley Park Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
My children attend this school, and it's the best option for us. The teachers here are very attentive and friendly, always happy to see you and always kind to your children. I really appreciate the individualized approach they take. This is a wonderful place. I’ve been coming to this church almost every week for the past two years. The people here — staff and volunteers — are truly amazing. It’s thanks to places like this that my attitude toward churches has changed significantly. Year after year, they carry their challenging mission with dedication. Thank you so much! I attended service this Sunday and I really enjoyed it. I'm happy I found this church. The pastor was very knowledgeable and really preach from the bible.the choir was also really great everyone was very nice and welcoming. Very welcoming. They have helped me and my family multiple times. Amazing people These folks are the absolute best!!
Even if you don't attend services, they'll still love you anyway

name: Valley Presbyterian Church - Chagrin Falls / Bainbridge Campus
reviewSummary: I don't go here as a church, just for meetings in their holiday let us use it's a very nice facility. They also have a thrift store that's opening on weekends. This Church/Thrift Store hands down has to be the most caring and thoughtful people. Just recently they opened their whole store which had (Decorations, glasswear, crafting, clothes and shoes for men woman children and babies, toys, and much more) for a couple hours and everything inside was free to anyone who came whether it be for Christmas or just because. They had donation table at front but from what i could tell they never pressured for it. Im not positive but i think they just opened the store recently within the month and already let people have things for free. I know i personally went there on a separate occasion and got free baby items aswell. Thank You everyone at the Valley Presbyterian Church They were giving away all older items.  Too many people in the building.  Barely could move.  No masks.  Nice, but I didn't stay too long. Check out their Pass It On shop for unique gently used items at great prices or donate you unwanted items. Very nice resale shop

name: Valley Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Scripture is taught by going through chapters, not only by popular topics.
Strong Bible study groups for adults at various times. Friendly congregation. God glorifying, Christ-centered preaching and Spirit filled worship. Very kind church that allowed us to begin a Bible study for the Assyrian speaking members. Thank you and God bless! Great preaching and fellowship. Extremely grateful for this church! Warm people, combined with an excellent Bible centered ministry.

name: Valley Presbyterian Hospital - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
This place was absolutely incredible. The hospital is  very clean. I got a private room. It's very well set up with equipment and honestly looked like a good movie about doctors.

Everyone gave me so much warmth and attention, starting from the ER, then into the hospital and the staff that prepared me for the operation and the care after. I wrote several recommendation letters regarding the staff here. The doctors were amazing, very knowledgeable and willing to take a bit of time and talk to you. The nurses knew the smallest details of my information and passed information over to the next shift next day.

Specifically wanted to mention Male Nurse - Neiman, thank you for your care and attention man!  And you're so knowledgeable hope you'll be a doctor, to enrich lives of many patients!

And Nurse Alexis , thank you for showing so much love towards your patients! Appreciate you guys!

I felt very well taken care of and very safe.

I give this place 10/10 , and staff 12/10

Much love, Alexey I have the unfortunate experience of having to come here often. All times being the emergency room. I’ve grown up coming here and I must say there kid department is much much better.

The emergency room is a mess. I try to write this review from a place of understanding and actively studying the medical field. But the way things are handled are so poor it’s a disgrace to anyone in the medical field.
Everyone has no sense of urgency or passion at all. This is the fast food of hospitals, a mear transaction. A formula. Quantity of quality.
I’ve had many experiences where I’ve waited hours upon hours. To only be transferred to wait even more hours and more hours.
The staff made it an agonizingly and miserably a slow experience. Again, no sense of urgency. I see staff, nurses, chatting before patients. I’ve had nurses who were about to draw blood for an exam. And before even drawing blood. She stood outside my room chatting with a nurse. A whole 5 minute conversation before getting on with my blood extraction. Again, after she finish, another conversation. Like please get the process at least started for crying out loud. Then maybe chat.

I think a lot of staff choose to ignore, or simply forget the fact a lot of people are in pain. They come here because maybe this is the only option? Maybe this is their only turn for help. I hope some sort of upper management has some sort of reform. It honest sucks seeing so many people in pain being talked back to, stalled, and in endless waiting for them to do a half ass job with half ass results. This review is about nurse Eric Bell and the rude staff who needs an attitude adjustment. Because why are you rude to sick patients?

I would never come back here, even though my insurance says this is the only hospital I can be admitted to. I have sickle cell, so that should tell you a lot. On June 20th, I was transferred from Kaiser Woodland Hills to this hospital. I was supposed to get a room immediately since I was being transferred from Kaiser‘s ER bed. Instead, I waited two hours in the hallway, even though I was having an active sickle cell pain crisis. I was placed in the hallway with other sick patients, which is known not to be appropriate for sickle cell patients because we are high risk and our immune system is non existent. I wasn’t even given a face mask. Not only did I wait in the hallway for two hours, but once Igot an ER bed, I waited three hours for a room (which I never got because I left). When I finally gor an ER bed, about 30 minutes to an hour later, I was given IV Dilaudid and fluids because that’s what sickle cell patients are supposed to receive, and that’s what I was given at Kaiser. They were supposed to give me IV antibiotics, but they never did. Three hours later, upon receiving the first IV Dilaudid, I asked for more Dilaudid because I was still in pain and still waiting to be admitted to a room, even though I was told I would be admitted immediately. My nurse (Eric Bell) told me that IV Dilaudid is administered every six hours, which is not true—it is every three hours. That’s why I asked about more Dilaudid on that third hour, even though I am used to nurses and doctors who know about sickle cell administering every one to two hours. I realized my nurse did not know about sickle cell because, before I asked for more Dilaudid, he asked me several questions about sickle cell and how it affects me. Even though he is African-American.. that should also tell you a lot about this hospital. I decided to call my husband and leave. When my husband arrived, he asked my nurse why he said every six hours for IV Dilaudid when it is actually every three hours, the nurse only kept repeating, “for IV Dilaudid it is every three hours.” When my husband asked how come when I asked, he said six hours then?, he just kept repeating, “for IV Dilaudid it is every three hours.” I asked to file a grievance, but even though they knew I was in constant pain, they made my husband and me wait at least 20 minutes just to tell us I had to file the grievance online or over the phone. I signed an AMA and left. If you have sickle cell, I would never in life come here. Not only did Eric Bell not know what he was doing, but all of the staff was very rude except for the doctor that I had Because she seemed to know about sickle cell. She said if I needed anything to ask her, and if I needed more medication to ask my nurse, and that is what I did and I was turned away. i’m very disappointed. We always used to go here as a child. But today I went in with a severe fever and a severe headache they  Drew blood out two times. They did x-rays a took me back outside. I waited for four hours  my head was hurting really bad. I told the lady in the waiting room is there anyway I could get medication or a cup of water  She said no unfortunately that will have to be inside and we don’t know how long it’s going to take. Very disappointed. Very bad service. The lady was rude. Never gonna come back ever again to the hospital. I’m very disappointed. They took 5 days to insert a feeding to into my grandma's stomach!! She was 82. She's needed nutrients and that left of time without food was making her weaker and her organs will begin to fail. Then they inserted it and she was starting to feel better and then they said the tube was leaking and they took it out and she did not receive food for another 3 days. At that point she was very weak. And the doctors didn't seem to be helping at all. Some of the nurses don't even speak good English and can't explain what is going on when asked for details of the situation. After 2 weeks my grandma died. If I were you I WOULD NEVER BRING MY PARENT TO THIS HOSPITAL!!!!!!

name: Valley Presbyterian Hospital Emergency Room - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been to this ER many times. I don't get people who are mean to nurses or doctors. I've only had good experiences! The doctors and nurses listen. I can see that they care. Just be patient when they're understaffed please. Anyone who has/had a job where they're understaffed will understand! The Healthcare system sucks in this country but at least the nurses and doctors care here! I had a very disappointing experience at this emergency room. I waited almost four hours without being placed in a room, even though I told the staff I was feeling dizzy and felt like I might faint.

The nurses seemed dismissive, and I felt that my concerns were not taken seriously. When I spoke with the doctor about how I was feeling, I did not feel that there was much concern for my symptoms or my well-being.

When someone goes to the emergency room, they are usually scared and not feeling well. Patients deserve to feel heard, cared for, and treated with urgency. Unfortunately, that was not my experience during this visit.

In contrast, I have had much better experiences at West Hills Hospital. The nurses there are attentive, and the doctors genuinely seem to care about their patients’ health and well-being. I hope this hospital can improve its level of care and communication so patients feel safer and more supported. I am extremely disappointed with the level of care I received at this hospital. From the moment I arrived, the experience was frustrating and stressful. The staff seemed disorganized, and communication was poor throughout my stay.

The nurses, in particular, were inattentive and unprofessional. It often felt like I was being ignored when I needed assistance, and when they did respond, their attitude came across as rushed and dismissive. Basic requests took far too long, and there was little empathy or concern shown for my condition.

Cleanliness and overall management also raised concerns, making the environment feel uncomfortable and unsafe. A hospital should be a place where patients feel cared for and supported, but unfortunately, that was not my experience here.

I would not recommend this hospital to others based on the lack of proper care, professionalism, and attention from the nursing staff. If I could give 0 stars, I would. Absolutely horrible ER. The waiting room was dirty and smelled awful, with trash all over the floor. I told them my sibling had diarrhea and was vomiting — no one cared. The staff were laughing and chatting with each other instead of doing their jobs. 0/10.
Tarzana Hospital is the best — fast, organized, professional, and respectful. If you have time to make a choice - it should be TARZANA!!! Great service. Great empathy. Great speed. I went here 2 times this year and they took great care of me in a timely manner and diagnosed me properly as well.

name: Valley Presbyterian Professional Center - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Why is police car illegal parked and blocking patients to get pickup or walk through. No police light are on no police officers inside the vehicle. This is a illegal parking and he is going to get a parking ticket plus violation for leaving the vehicle unintended. This has been send to parking enforcement. And we will be heading over to the Van Nuys police station to find the driver of this vehicle. I've been to their ER twice. Once I wasn't in much of a rush a they took care of me well and I'm uninsured so I just paid about $187. The second time it was very much an emergency​. I just had my nose (deviated septum) fixed 2 days prior and woke up with a severe nose bleed, with blood coming out my nose, mouth on being swallowed. Worse, I had an 8 inch long blood clot from my sinuses going down my throat or I could cough it out so it hung out my mouth like my tongue and was choking on it for around 45 min at least while waiting for the Dr and since it was covered in blood and slippery I couldn't grip it to pull it out. A nurse tried with gloves to pull it out but twas too slippery. Finally when the Dr and his nurse came in she tried to pull it out by wrapping a small towel around it and it worked and I told her that's all I was yelling about for the past hour and was no longer choking. Then because of all the blood I swallowed I threw up approx a half pint to a pint of blood into a bed pan. The Dr called the Dr who did the surgery and the surgeon told him to put these inflatable long things in my nose and kept pumping them full of air, which was what he was told by the surgeon to do. But it hurt more than most things in life. It was like Arnold Schwarzenegger pulling that thing out of his nose in that 80's movie Total Recall. But that also just cost me $187.
So for an ER visit that was very cheap with no insurance. They must get govt funding. Didn't like the wait but​ was grateful for them for taking care of me for just $187... Worse experience I had at this hospital
I have arrived 930 pm and left 2 am
I was feeling horrible with serius flu the waiting time was horrible also they don’t have no water either tissues people have flu.
After I waited 5 hours the doctor come to check me and tell me that he can give me any medication for my flu basically I went there for no reason I waste my time and money because they still charging my health insurance. The elevators in the building dont work properly Terrible, they give you an appointment and then wait two hours. I don't like it.

name: Valley View Community Church - Tredyffrin Township Campus
reviewSummary: This is my home church and I love it here! Everything is Christ centered and the people who attend are very welcoming. I have been going here for over 15 years and made many close friends. Valley View (VV) is a fabulous church. The people are very warm an inviting. They come from all walks of faith. The church is very diverse as well comprised of many ethnicities and ages. The Pastors and members are very good at remembering each other and inviting one another to events. The Pastors and prayer teams are also very good with following up on prayer requests and praises. It is a great place to come to Christ, learn about Christ, and build a strong relationship with others. One thing I love about VV is that people are transparent and willing to share their testimony to strength their neighbor. Amazing. Went for a social visit. I never knew this church rxhisted. Beautiful worship. Jesus-focused staff. Inspiring and faithful pastors,  music, and worshipping community

name: Van Nuys United Methodist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: This place was so nice I went to there night swap meet and it was absolutely fabulous, the people where so nice They rent rooms 2 groups and give music lessons Awsome church It was basically church!

name: Vanguard Church - Central - Colorado Springs Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are searching for a deeper relationship with God that is supported by scripture, this is the place to be. Everyone is so welcoming, and Pastor Kelly speaks on all points of the gospel. Not just fluffy rainbows and sunshine but also those hard truths that we all need to hear to grow! This is also a church that is raising up the next generation of believers. Perfect for everyone of all ages. Honesty, solid characters, kindness and very informed in ways to lead kids and families. We have been going for almost 5.5 years and I personally as a parent appreciate that the children’s ministry is very caring. My son spends a lot of time in hospital without question I’m so grateful for the love and support from Vanguard. It’s not just a building they are very welcoming. I began coming when my family was struggling and we are still struggling but now we have relationships. Honest, deeply loved and we have friendships that have helped us grow. A great extension of God in his character, gentleness and love. I have always been so welcomed every time I enter these doors. The sermons are amazing. Every church is different. Everyone worships different. I'm quiet and listen but others might yell out Amen or Hallelujah. Neither is wrong and this church proves that. They are welcoming to all. If you're looking for a church to call home, look no further. Very inviting and people seem to know one another. I'm went over to see if they had a piano for worship.
I was told they don't have a piano.
That's a disappointment, and for me, a deal breaker. I hoped I wouldn't have to go somewhere else but cest la vie.
What church doesn't have a piano?

name: Vaughn Forest Church - Montgomery Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have been going to this church for quite a while and I must say that this church has grown us deeper as a couple both in our marriage but also in our theology. I appreciate the deep connection the staff has with its community and I love the pastor's sermons. They challenge you in the best way and most important way -- to go to God more often and to depend on Him more. We went to this church today for the first time today. We hadn't been to church for 30 years but it felt, after recent events, like the right time to go back. We felt right at home. We met Megan and she showed us around and even got us coffee. The church is large but does not feel like a "mega-church". People are encourage to come as you are and we saw people in shorts and flip flops to being nicely dressed. There was never a time when we detected judgement from anyone, including the Pastor, Jim.

They go out of their way to make you feel at home. The music was awesome and Pastor Jim gave a bible based message. You are given the opportunity to get up and take communion. We enjoyed every minute of this non-denominational church and will be going back.  If you are looking for a church, try this one it might be for you too. I went to a Women’s Conference here but if I lived in town, this would be where I would choose to worship regularly. The members are so friendly and welcoming and the facilities are beautiful. The Praise Band and Singers are recording worthy. Very welcoming. Atmosphere is amazing. Everyone is so friendly. My husband and I are glad to be attending. Love love love this church. People are genuine and actually truly care. The pastor is my kind of leader, with tattoos and a past history of not liking church at all, just like me. It is a non-churchy kind of church which fits me really well. The service is more like a teaching with definitions of words from the original language, which really sheds light on the the intended meaning of scripture. And the music truly rocks.

name: Velocity Christian Church
reviewSummary:
No perfect people allowed, no one stands alone and everyone's story matters. Met in the movie theater once upon a time. Weekly Communion. Very down to earth, no ear plugs needed during band music, meets you where you are. Great friendly people, our kids were very well taken care of...excellent message and a great worship band.  Love that they have so many small groups. Such a warm loving church . I always feel welcomed and I never leave without feeling blessed! Friendly
They teach about Jesus's teachings, His Love
His coming again, their mission in the summer. People that love Jesus.
Greatful for how God used them to encourage my life in Christ.

name: Venice Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Great fast growing church for all who are looking for a church home. They have good beliefs and transparent what they do and expect. They even have three worships on each Sunday. They have a diverse community with different age groups, backgrounds and ethnicity. Discovery class was a good place to know what their history is and what to expect. Rooted class is an opportunity to connect with new members and deepen the faith. I’m happy to recommend this church. Vacationing here, from Texas, I looked up churches in our area & came across Venice Church.  I’m so glad God led us to visit this church!  Everyone was so warm & friendly!  There was a sense of joy radiating among the church goers!  Pastor Mark preached a very interesting sermon that I got a lot out of & he referenced Bible scripture often.  The Holy Spirit can truly be felt here.  I also love the mission work they are doing in the Venice community!  If we lived here, this is the church we would attend & serve in!  We loved worshipping with y’all!! This church has been here since I’ve lived in Mar Vista for over 30 years. They have kindly allowed Steve with Petramale Pizza to have a pop-up of the world’s best pizza every FRIDAY. This is the best best best pizza! This is from me studying abroad in Italy and traveling around the world. There’s nothing like it! Please support your local community and try some of his pizza on Fridays. Love this church!! Very welcoming. You can be yourself, and Pastor Mark is so good. We always leave feeling good and learn something we can apply to our daily life and relationship w God and his people. Overall, it is one of the most peaceful,  calming atmospheres. Generally, I don't want to even leave. This is the best church in california in my opinion

name: Venture Christian Church - Carmel Campus
reviewSummary: We have had the most wonderful experience with our young boys at this Christ-centered preschool. The teachers are loving and caring. The director is organized and transparent. The facilities are wonderful. The children are learning in a fun, loving, and safe environment and will be well-prepared for kindergarten. I highly recommend this school. Still a newby but feel blessed to be here for the ministries and more. Pastor Mark's messages are spot on for these times! I really like seeing folks I know from Westfield and a church that has serving Westfield/Carmel on their radar! We went to this church for the first time. All of us really enjoy and worship together. Actually we missed Pastor Stan’s teaching. I don’t know yet, we are going to change the church or not. I was introduced to Rob by my aunt bae who has known him for a very long time I've had a hard times in my life and then made a decision to give my life to God talk to my aunt bae and she suggested Rob so I drove from Kentucky to Indianapolis to meet Rob and to get baptized in his great church it was very emotional with my aunt and everything the time I'll never forget everybody there was so great soon as I walked in the door I got a hugs from people I didn't even know my only regret is that I don't live by his church Making a difference!! Wondering what God has in mind for us all!

name: Venture Christian Church - Fort Wayne Campus
reviewSummary: If you want to know about a family that has a priority of gathering those desiring a deeper relationship with Jesus, this is the place to come.  Here the family of God strives to show our community that we too have had situations in our lives that need repair, blessings, forgiveness, hope, peace and love.  We find that in sharing life together through prayer, worship, and service.  Joining us is not for sitting back and letting others do the work of God.  We all have gifts, skills, talents, and passions given through the Holy Spirit.  Our roles are expressed with love and grace.  Come and experience blemishes and healing with a lot of hope.  Venture is not a place to just wait, we are a people of action.  Come just as you are, with God nothing is impossible. I’ve had a great experience getting to know the people at Venture Church. Everyone has been welcoming, and it’s clear they care about serving the Fort Wayne community. I’m excited to see this church grow and make a positive impact through faith, compassion, and outreach. A place you feel like u belong Rooted in Christ. Highly Recommended. Great family to be adopted into

name: Venture Christian Church - Katy Campus
reviewSummary: When my husband and I were looking for a new church we wanted and needed someone welcoming of all backgrounds, all denominations but a church that taught biblical truth.  We met a group of the most warm and welcoming people and felt at home from day 1.  We have made some life long friends who have supported us through some really dark times.  The worship time and sermon each Sunday is what I look most forward to in my week and I love being able to share that with time with my husband and friends.  My relationship with God has grown so much in the 2 years we have attended Venture and I can't wait to see what else God is going to do through this church! I’ve been attending Venture since May 2019. Just moved to Katy 3 years prior and looking for a church home. The way God works is amazing. All of the pieces came together, like a puzzle. I was invited to be a part of their music team. It was a dream come true; was just nervous in not being good enough to rise to the challenge. If you should choose to experience Venture for yourself, you will surely hear a great message you can take with you throughout the rest of the week, great music, and you’ll always feel welcomed. In my personal opinion, this is home to me and you’re gonna be treated like family. You definitely want to experience it for yourself. I’m glad to have discovered Venture and I pray you’ll be glad too!! I first got a flyer card in the mail from this church at the time I was in a bad way I wasn't really receptive to any kind of church or any kind of help but I thought the flyer was pretty and looked cool so I kept drawing my attention to it when I was finally ready to attend church again I thought I can't believe 6 months later I still have this flyer so maybe this is God telling me to attend this church which is what I did and I have never felt more at home and all my life I love going to church I love the Lord I love biblical truth being taught in the church so I've been to a lot of churches I've listened to a lot of sermons I've read a lot of books I've read the Bible and I know the Bible tells us that we are made to worship and we are meant for Fellowship I'm just extremely happy to be a part of this church anytime that I step into it it's always a warm welcome they stick together they all love each other and I'm just happy I'm about to attend my first Celebrate Recovery meeting at this church tonight and I'm so excited I can't wait Venture has really grown me with God more than words can speak upon. I grew up in church with my grandparents, but had withdrawn from the church as time went on. God put venture in my path, and it has changed my life forever. I sincerely hope we can change yours too. God Bless you. Venture Christian Church is a wonderful place to worship and grow in Christ. I was invited to VCC by a good friend in 2020 and I haven’t stopped attending. The minister is warm and inviting, the music is amazing and the people are wonderful.

name: Venture Christian Church - Los Gatos Campus
reviewSummary: This place is amazing! The event was huge and everything was top quality. So many fun things for kids—face painting, cotton candy, bounce houses, slides, games, and shows. Totally worth visiting! Venture Christian Church has excellent Bible teaching.  We found ourselves grown a lot spiritually since we made Venture our home church.  Their worship team is also first class.  Their staff is super nice and dedicated.  The congregation has very good diversity reflecting the demographic in the Bay Area.  They also have a Spanish speaking service on Sunday afternoon. The music is great here. The word always hits home. There's no selling to convert if your new . Many classes & events to choose from. You ALWAYS leave feeling better. Each sermon I’ve attended spoke to me deeply!  Great Church! I'm Catholic and I visited this church for a family members event and I'm not very used to this style of the service compared to a Catholic mass but I'm not criticizing. They know Christ and that's what matters.

name: Venture Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I began attending Venture Church about three months ago after our previous church, Revé, merged with Venture. We were baptized at Revé, so this new season has been especially meaningful. The transition has been smooth and from the very beginning we have felt genuinely welcomed by the people and staff.

The worship is uplifting and Christ centered, and the messages are biblically-grounded and relatable. We have especially enjoyed being part of the grow groups, which have helped us connect with others and grow deeper in our faith.

We especially love that Venture Church offers so much through its ministries, grow groups, university, and camps, all focused on helping people know and follow Jesus.

If you are looking for a church home where you will be encouraged, equipped, and welcomed, I highly recommend Venture. I just attended Venture Church this past Sunday for the first time and I LOVED it! Everybody was so welcoming. I even found my first friend in the women’s bathroom, who asked me my name. My new, dear, big blonde sister, Genta! I will definitely be returning, thank you! God is good! Venture Church welcomes all who enter to worship our Lord! I feel comfortable the minute I walk in the door. The Worship Team is amazing and I love and anticipate the Venture News; very informative and always a good laugh! The sermons are Biblical and always related to our daily lives. This is seriously such an amazing church I am so grateful the Lord led me to this church and Pastor Troy and his wife Jessica. They are fabulous and so is the message of love and Jesus they spread. Great group of people and everyone will feel welcome and loved here. Enjoying their Christmas Eve Candle Light service, I must say everyone seemed very welcoming. Going in, following the previous service, made things a little confusing. But who isn't confused their first time. The music was great and helped to eliminate the distractions for me to praise and worship. FYI: one may find ear plugs useful to dampen the impact of the sound. It was a different kind of Christmas message, a reflective message. Try out the weekly messages and see what you think.

name: Venture Church - Gulf Coast Campus - Gulfport Campus
reviewSummary: What an inspiration experience. I cannot wait to go again. I have been coming to Venture now for two years. I have found a family here. The very first time I walked into Venture I felt like a friend they were so welcoming and didn’t bombard me with question which has happened to me a lot at new churches. They actually said welcome home like I had always been going there. The people are so amazing and there is an amazing kids experience that they have. They also have an amazing youth group for middle and high school kids. This is an absolutely amazing church. Venture Church has been a life changer for my family and I. The staff and volunteers are always so welcoming and actually care about us and who we are. My 4 year old loves to attend their Kids Experience and gets upset when i tell him we cant go to church on Mondays! 10/10 would recommend! Venture Church is a great place to find hope, connect or reconnect your faith. The staff and attendees are so welcoming and inviting. The worship is next level and the pastors invoke scripture into their messages in ways that can only come from God.  You will wonder what you did before Venture! Venture in general is a great place to worship, but this new campus on the coast is something special! Such a great family atmosphere, always makes me feel welcome, messages are always on point and relateable, and the music is TOP NOTCH. 🤙🏻

name: Venture Church - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
Maybe next time you see someone in parking lot, instead of driving close to them intimidatingly like a bat out of hell you should, "like a man of GOD". pull up casualy and ask what's up We have been searching for a home church for awhile and visited many other churches.
When we came here it felt welcoming but not overwhelming. It was bigger than our last church but still felt friendly.
My son loves the youth program, we love all the classes/activities available for all ages, the people are friendly and the pastor is awesome with very uplifting messages.
So glad we found this Church! A welcoming church for sure. Plenty of smiles to go around. I visited here with my daughter and her family on my visit to Colorado. Had a good experience. Very nice & helpful!wonderful personal experience! Can anyone just attend? Sunday at 9am?

name: Venture Church Carmel Valley - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary: Do not I repeat do not attend this church, complete superficiality, lack of true authenticity, and really miss the boat of what it means to live out with love. Grateful after this experience to find a church much more welcoming, less judgmental or shame based This church is truly incredible. The sermons are grounded in truth, the people are kind and welcoming, and the pastors genuinely care. I joined their small group and have gained invaluable insights into emotionally healthy spirituality. You can feel the church’s sincere commitment to the well-being of its congregation. I came and stayed during an incredibly painful season of my life and God has used this church to heal me in ways I never even knew I needed. From the very first moment I came to Reve the pastor Todd & his wife Shannon along with Derek, Liz, Robert and all there amazing dream team were so welcoming! They were and are all so friendly. I’ve learned so much from there Womens Scripture study, their small groups, and I get so much out of the sermons. Every time I walk into worship you can really feel the presence of God. This church has become my home ❤️ And they have such an amazing and powerful story as to how they got here which I find to be inspiring! Revé church is a welcoming and supportive environment where I have been able to enjoy our pastors as well as the community of believers. Sunday service has awesome music, coffee and bible based teachings that give me something to reference all week. There is a great children’s church program keeping the littles happy and entertained. Love it and definitely recommend. Reve has been such an amazing home & community for us! Shannon & Todd are so incredibly welcoming and warm, the kid’s-care activities impressive, and the entire team such a light in our world. We are new to our faith journey but knew that a community based in compassion, selflessness & mutual support was something we wanted to raise our daughter within. Reve has been just that. They have welcomed us, nourished our budding relationship with God & made it fun & exciting along the way. Such a pleasure to call this community home!

name: Venture Church Salinas - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary: Very welcoming and friendly.  Great music and fellowship.  Wonderful Pastors.  I look forward to Sundays now. Venture is awesome.  I have been going for about 2 weeks and I love it.  It is such a postitive and kind environment.  Every Sunday I wake up happy and excited to go to church.  Pastor Matt is so funny and kind.  There has not been one Sunday that he has failed to make me laugh.  Venture is like another family to me.  I hope this review encourages you to go to Venture church and join our welcoming, kind, and loving family.❤😇 Loved this church it is supper welcoming and they make you feel life home. I was greeted by Caroline I felt very welcomed got a great message from God. Life Changing...hands on Ministry for all ages!

name: Venture Español - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: very welcoming This is a wonderful church! I felt God's love through the people of Venture Español. They welcomed me with open arms, and I currently attend their services. God is doing great things in the Hispanic community!

name: Verbo Redwood City - Redwood City Campus
reviewSummary:
Words can’t fully describe how much Verbo has impacted my life and the lives of so many others. I started attending consistently about a year and a half ago, and the blessing Verbo has been to me since then is truly beyond words.

From the very first day I stepped into the church, I was welcomed with genuine love and kindness. It wasn’t only from the people serving, but also from the attendees themselves. I was greeted warmly by the ushers when I arrived, and after service, many others took the time to welcome me personally. At Verbo, it feels like more than just a church — it truly feels like family.

During some of the hardest moments in my life, I’ve had leaders and members sit down with me one-on-one, pray with me, encourage me, and simply be there when I needed support most. By the grace of God, the impact they’ve had on my life is something I’ll never forget.

What I love most about Verbo is the genuine devotion to God’s Word and the heart the church has for serving others. You can see it not only inside the church, but throughout the entire community. Verbo supports people in so many ways through programs like tutoring, counseling, food distributions, and much more.

Verbo is constantly striving to be a light in Redwood City and North Fair Oaks, and it has truly made a meaningful impact in the community.

Honestly, if it weren’t for Verbo and the people God placed there, my life would look completely different today. I’m deeply grateful for this church and everyone in it.

If you’re looking for a church community where people genuinely care, love God, and serve others, I would wholeheartedly recommend Verbo. From children to elders, there is care, support, and community for every age group, along with special events and ministries for both men and women. Verbo is truly a place where people are welcomed, loved, and supported. This ministry is undoubtedly one of the most beautiful entities of any kind I have ever seen in my entire life. This single structure on the corner of Bay Road and Warrington Avenue in the North Fair Oaks neighborhood of Redwood City in San Mateo County, CA is having a profoundly positive impact on the citizens of our city, county and state.

The leadership and members help to restore marriages and families. They unite together people from completely different national and socioeconomic backgrounds. They provide the equipment, scheduling and needed space for a large-scale adult soccer league that is utilized by at least several hundred loyal community residents. They provide free tutoring for children and free English classes for adults. They distribute high quality, healthy food (dairy, fruit, meat, vegetables) twice a week, every week, month after month, and year after year. They collaborate with the sheriff, city and county leaders, and elected officials to serve the great citizens that these same public servants represent so very well.

My life, personally, is being absolutely and totally transformed 180° through the compassion, generosity, kindness and love of the people who constitute Familia Cristiana Verbo. Please do yourself a favor and visit us as soon as you're able. You and your family will be blessed abundantly. And I can guarantee you of this, because it's already happening to me.

Thank you, beautiful people of Familia Cristiana Verbo. Here's to many more years to come at 2798 Bay Road, North Fair Oaks, Redwood City, San Mateo County, CA. I love each and every one of you very deeply. Millón de gracias. ♥️ If you are looking for a church that truly lives out its faith, this is it. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with an authentic, family like warmth that makes you feel instantly at home.
The worship here is absolutely amazing. It is deeply uplifting and sets such a beautiful tone for the service.

They also do an incredible job serving and supporting the local community. What I appreciate most, though, is their approach to the Bible: they stay deeply rooted in the truth of the Word without being legalistic or rigid about it. It’s just a loving, Christ-centered community doing great things without any pretense. Highly recommended! Good afternoon, I came to the lobby to inquire about the church around 1230 today, Friday afternoon, I was going to ask this gentleman about it. He blew past me didn’t give me more than three seconds.” It’s my church and I’m the pastor of this church and it’s only Spanish-speaking” is what he said and kept on going inside

Unfortunately, that five second snippet showed me how cold and rude this church pastor is.   Are these what Christian people are like?

I sent this email to them two weeks ago and did not get a response hence this post The staff and volunteers have a heart of gold. They truly care about the community of North Fair Oaks. This church has a strong presence in the community as they minister to people who are in need. They serve meals with second harvest Food Bank. They give counseling. They have programs for kids in the summer and give out backpacks. These are just a few things at the church does to enrich the lives of others

name: Veritas Community Church - Short North - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary:
We really enjoyed visiting 😊

Worship was intimately charismatic toward Jesus in worship.

Preaching was straight from the Bible, and very accurate, and pointed directly to the Gospel.

Medium sized church- not too big not too small.

Very rare kind of church,
We will be back! 😊 Yep it's mostly a younger congregation, but I felt welcomed immediately and am over 50. I love this fellowship of true believers who walk the talk as best as they can. The music ministers as deeply as the pastor's message and I always leave there refreshed in the Lord and challenged to spread the the Good News in word and deed throughout the Columbus area community. Solid evangelical teaching, super friendly, and great music. The congregation is rather young (largely college and post-college) but the structure of gatherings has a traditional feel. Veritas has a heart for reaching the lost in their community.  If you're nearby and looking for a church, definitely check it out! Veritas has been a home for my husband and I for the last year... we found gospel centered teaching, plenty of grace, and a welcoming community group to join at this church.  Pastor Joe is so authentic and real... they don't care about the "show," they care about YOU and they care about spreading the joyous news of the Gospel in Columbus. Can't say enough about the church's heart behind everything they do. Plus, She Has A Name is an incredible organization run out of this church. I came to Veritas broken and in need of healing. My family and I have a lot of church hurt in our past and we have been in desperate need of clear expositional preaching from God’s word , as well as biblical community and accountability . I am thankful to say that we have found this at Veritas community church. The people at Veritas love Jesus and seek to obey him out of thankfulness in their hearts for the gospel. The leadership is amazing and are deserving of double honor . The brothers and sisters love one another sincerely and practically and they will go without so that another brother or sister may be served well. I don’t think I knew what biblical community looked like,  until Veritas.

name: Vermont Avenue Baptist Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church ever!  Pastor Lance is so knowledgeable and entertaining.  Best Bible based church i ever attended.  They have a sunday school that my 6yr daughter loves!
Best Christian band ever!  They are really involved with the community.  I just cant say enough with this house of love! How disgusting and shameful that a church and school keeps living animals in such an inhumane and dreadful condition. How dare this church and school deny the proper care for these animals and refuse to give them up so they can be taken to a veterinary hospital. It’s also disgusting and cruel how one of your workers even laughed about the death of one your rabbits recently. Rocken Band, good people,good message, great for young adults. Parking lot needs work😞. Basketball court still works. Pot luck lunches really work.😄
Check em out.

PS. Casual and friendly also works  😁 Very pleasant church! Congregation is warm and welcoming & Pastor Lance delivers a Great message every week! Suggest you bring your family and friends to visit :) I went here back in 1977 to 1987 and was in the kids choir and really enjoyed the pastor back then was John  H Wilson  and the music was great and when the kids choir took over the entire morning service and night service as well  we had Pastor Wilson sit in the congregation as the kids choir took over the the service, I also attended the school there as well back in 1977 to about 1980 and yes the potlucks are very good at the end of a morning service and  so are the round up Sundays when Pastor John H Wilson brings in the horses from Oklahoma.

name: Vertical Church
reviewSummary: I went for the first time Sunday,November 23,2025. We walked in the door and were greeted by awesome people. I can't explain how but  the music and sermon hit home for me.   A loving Bible believing church.  I felt a warm welcome.  Thank God for Virtical Church.  God bless Virtical Church and the people. This is a Bible believing Church where the expositional preaching each Sunday is solid. The people are genuine, friendly and inviting. This is a place where genuine disciples of Jesus learn and grow together. Also, our kids love coming each week! What a great and loving community! Welcome toward all people and the worship is so beautiful. The pastor is fairly young and a great preacher of the word. Come to find a loving community and family Wonderful community with great teaching that glorifies his name biblically. A Bible believing and teaching church. A wonderful family of believers, being trained to be true disciples of Jesus Christ.

name: Vertical Church - Columbus Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church!! Full of friends who become like family. God’s Word is preached unapologetically. Incredible congregation! My husband and I feel so at home with the great people at Vertical. The sermons always hit home for me and keep me leaning into the Lord and striving to grow in my relationship with Christ. Absolutely recommend this church for anyone looking to deepen their faith, make new friends, and learn more about God’s love for us. My husband has been attending for over 11 years and I have been attending VCC for just about 5 years. The sermons are centered around truths from Scripture and this congregation is like a second family for us. We appreciate the awesome children's ministry that we can send our baby to, knowing that he his being taken care of and one day will be taught about Jesus in his classes. We love VCC! Wonderful church to call home! Pastor Luke is dedicated to Biblical teaching and I am always left convicted and encouraged. I have felt very loved and cared for by the pastor, staff, and people in the congregation. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a new church in Columbus! Being a part of Vertical the last 2 years has helped me grow in my faith. The staff offers great resources and classes to further connection within the church and additional learning. It’s truly a church that puts God and worship at the center!

name: Vertical Church - Madison Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely amazing place! The spirit is definitely moving here so if you’re looking for a friendly, welcoming, warm atmosphere for all and wanting to feel that Holy Spirit baptism kinda love just drop by!! You most definitely won’t regret it!!!💕💕💕💕 Come seeking Him!  All are welcome!  Do not wait until you have it “together,” as we are all sinners saved by Grace and striving to be more like Jesus daily! Come as you are! A great church to call home!  A welcoming, passionate family of believers who are eager to spread the Word of God to all of Madison county and beyond.  Great atmosphere for people of all ages! The best religious experience ever. We just love all the people there Wonderful sweet friendly people. Great atmosphere. Great message!

name: Vertical Church - Plainfield Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I had an amazing experience. We absolutely enjoyed how all the volunteers recognized we were new and helped us make our visit wonderful from the greet to the seat. Pastor Chris is a phenomenal speaker. We loved the worship session. They played very well and went beyond our usual expectation of a 3-song checklist. We loved that. Sometimes people need a little time with the Spirit in worship (beyond just a 3-song set) to prepare their hearts for the message and Vertical Church delivered. Overall, it was an absolutely wonderful visit. As a member of the ARC, we had high expectations for VC, and we were not disappointed at all. Thank you guys for what you do! ❤️🔥 I love how the people love each other there; it is genuine love.

There is fruit their! Also I love how pastor Chris and Brian teach the truth and doesn't compromise the word of God.

I know you will love this place, don't settle for half truth and not know God, and be far from him, like the religious people.

Jesus is relational! He wants a relationship with you for you to be his son or daughter.

Thanks Pastor Chris and Brian for being good teachers! Everyone is so kind and friendly. Very welcoming atmosphere. The pastor is genuine and speaks from his heart. Great place to worship 🙌 This is the NOW generation church. Pastor Chris & Stephanie Gilbert are two amazingly talented people. They're staff & volunteers are wonderful.  I would highly recommend Vertical Church to anyone.  Great ministries from the youngest to the oldest. My son enjoyed seeing the Easter Bunny

name: Vertical Church San Jose - San Jose Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Mike and his wife Dawn are 2 of the nicest and most caring people I've ever met. The first time I started going to this church I felt at home. Amazing church. They truly preach the gospel, and everybody is so welcoming and kind. I love this place because it's holy place and I love all the people in this church thank you for accepting me in this church Good I was invited to this place on Sunday, but I'm confused because it's in a Denny's, hehehehe.

name: Verve City Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I am an on-line participant, and I follow Verve because Pastor Josh never fails to meet us where we are, and is REAL about what is happening in our personal lives and in the life of our country.  I always appreciate how he is courageous enough to preach about what is really happening around us, and does not give in to the political manipulations of many churches in America today. We love Verve City Church! We’ve called this place home for years and years for so many reasons. The mission of our church is to help people find life by following Jesus and we see that happening through baptisms, outreach events, people volunteering their time, and investing their gifts to grow in their relationships with God. These things are true for us as well, we know the importance of being part of community in growing as Christ followers and have experienced this in more ways than we can count here. We feel it’s so welcoming too, and we really enjoy Josh’s messages. We feel encouraged and challenged each Sunday. These are just a few of the things that help us to know The Verve is where we’re meant to be. If you’re looking for community, Verve City is the place to be! The people and staff are all welcoming, friendly, and very helpful. They have incredible ministries for every age— the children's and students ministries are engaging and all around a great place for the kids to learn about Jesus. It’s a safe and fun place to bring the whole family.
The main church teachings are centered on the gospel and are presented in an educated and easily digestible way. I always feel like I get something practical out of the messages that directly relates to my life. You can really feel the love this church has for each other and for the Lord! AND amazing free coffee! My husband, three elementary age kids, and I, have been attending Verve City Church for 2 years now. We instantly knew this was the place for us and have been at this church ever since our first Sunday. The kids church is incredible. The people are friendly and so welcoming. I am most proud of all that this church does for our community. Visit once and it will feel like home. I am so grateful to be a part of Verve City Church. The community here is warm, welcoming, and truly feels like family. The services are inspiring and meaningful, with messages that uplift and challenge me to grow spiritually. The worship team is wonderful, and it’s clear that everyone involved puts their heart into every aspect of the service.

name: Verve Community Church - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary:
We had the honor of providing our ‘SHINE’ marquee letters for Verve Community Church’s 2026 Night to Shine, and it was a truly unforgettable experience.

This prom-themed evening for individuals with special needs was filled with so much joy and genuine connection. The community at Verve was incredibly welcoming, making the setup and pick-up for our equipment smooth and stress-free. The building is spacious, beautifully maintained, and perfectly suited for large-scale events.

When we returned for pick-up, the energy in the room was still so uplifting — you could truly feel the care and intention that went into every detail of the night. Verve has built something special here, and we are so grateful to have played a small part in such a meaningful event. I highly recommend them for their beautiful facility and, more importantly, the heart they have for our community!

— Annalicia | Together Time Party Rentals This is a place that my family and I reached out to when we we're lost spiritually, and they have taken us in like their own family. Everybody looks out for each other and it's always a good time. I invite anybody that would like to come out to the services. It's on Sunday. There are 2 services. The first service is at 9:30 AM and the second service is at 11 AM. Hope to see you soon. This church is very dear to my son and me. From the moment you walk in, you can truly feel the love and warmth. They offer classes for just about everyone, no matter your stage in life. If you're looking for a welcoming place to grow in faith, come visit one of the services at 9:30 AM or 11:00 AM. We'd love to see you there. 🙏💛 The architecture alone is beautiful to come and look at. The entire Parish is filled with awesome mind human beings.  The preschool program there is fantastic! My children absolutely look forward to going there during the week. The staff is an exact replica of their parish staff. They make you feel comfortable and right at home. A church that is truly HOME.   Friendly, warm atmosphere and very welcoming.   I was tired of traditional church and actually had given up on being a member anywhere.  Just me and Jesus.  Then when life happened and lost my Dad I went to church with my sister to get comfort for my grief. What I found is a leadership team that is authentic, inspired and transparent teachers of the Word who live out their walk like you and I.  Looking forward to walking out our faith walk collaboratively.  There is a place for YOU.

name: Vibrant Church - The Woodlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Vibrant Church!! I have never felt more at home. This place is full of Godly, loving people who have been our lifeline and our family. Sunday services are an amazing time of Spirit filled worship and biblical teaching, but my favorite thing about Vibrant is the relationships we have built there. The search for a church can be tough, I was thankful that one of my friends had recommended that I check out Vibrant church.

After my first few visits I realized that the people here are so genuine. I’ve been to so many different churches and it would always seem like I would walk in; listen to the sermon, and then walk right out without anyone knowing. Vibrant church was the complete opposite, I felt so welcomed and people recognized me and made me feel like I was apart of a family. They truly are a real people with a real passion to live a vibrant life in Jesus.

Can’t wait to see what else God is doing in Vibrant Church and looking forward to being apart of it 🙌🏼 I was searching for a new church, and found Vibrant. I wasn’t expecting it, but my life was forever changed. If you are looking for a new church. Looking to connect with real people. Looking for true fulfillment in your life. You will find it here! Come and see for yourself, and change your life. Have a true relationship with God. I hope to see there. Talk about a life giving church! Come on now! This is it!!!  This is the church I was looking for!!! The Lord lead me here!!! Found this church right after their launch way back 2019 and I was welcomed by the Pastor himself and everyone!  Such a great environment!  I felt home… If you are new to the area or if you are looking for a church, check out Vibrant Church!  You’ll love it here! I really wanted to like this church. I had been looking for a church that was small and more local to me. Although no one was directly rude, I never really felt welcomed. It felt like the ppl who already knew each other kept to themselves in their own little groups. I also wish they had Spanish service so I could bring my husband along. When I asked I was told they didn't have one yet. My child really liked it though and still asks if we can go, I'm glad atleast one of us felt comfortable.

name: Vibrant Church Assemblies of God
reviewSummary:
I have been going to this church for 40 years.  I have gone through both victories and challenges.  I can say that in the last 4 years, my life as a Christian and a Vibrant member have taken off.  I have experienced more love and support than ever before. I have grown in my walk with the Lord, and I have been encouraged and taught how to grow deeper in my relationship with Christ. One important thing that I have been taught and now has been engrained in me, which contributed to my growth is this.  Seek the Heart of God through Prayer and Devotions, that is the key Prayer is so important. Now I have made it a priority in my life. Devotions, the 2nd most important thing.  You can't grow in the Lord and allow Him to change your life if you don't know what God's Word says. These two things are vital in one's life to be able to see changes.  God is in the life changing business.  I know because my life has been radically changed.  At Vibrant, there are plenty of opportunities to be taught and discipled.
Vibrant Church is family, whether you come in the door for the first time or have been there a long time you get loved on and treated like family. I would encourage anyone who is looking for a church to visit or to find a church home to check out Vibrant Church. I am from Portland, Oregon and planning my move to VT. My priority is to find a great church that does a lot of great humanitarian and ministry for the advancement of the gospel of Christ. As my planning to move to VT slowly unfolding, the Pastor of this church Pastor Mark, and their staff and members have been very helpful in my moving, and Pastor Mark shared with me what they have been doing in the community and their plan to have more ministries. Many churches have forgotten the real work of Jesus Christ, I am happy that I will very soon be a part of this vibrant church, the name itself speaks to what the church is all about, to stay active, in reaching the poorest of the poor. I speak more blessings to this church. I’ve been going to church at Vibrant for years.
I worked in Connecticut for almost three years
So whenever I got home for a weekend, I had to make sure I attended services here.
I attended services since 1976 after my Husband and I chose to retire from 22 years serving in the Navy on mostly Submarine Duty.
I remember when pastor Mike was attending services .
And throughout the years , growing and being a pastor to a large church .
Considering attendance use to be 25 .
Now the church expanded years ago.
And large amount of Christians attend.
I’m proud to have Pastor Mike Kreisel  head of our church.
A great ministry, preacher, loves his people.
Always happy. Loves God
I’m proud to call it my church
Welcome to all who cares to attend a great live service praising God, live band
Come join us.
Dorothy Woodrum Pastor Mike is an excellent pastor! The people are so nice and friendly. They have a great children's church while adults attend the service and even a nursery for your little ones. I highly recommend this church. I have been attending this church since I was 6 yrs old,I've left a few times for a bit and visited other churches. I always end up back to this church! It's awesome. Pastor Mike is a good preacher!

name: Vicars Community Center | Community Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: My cousin Cat's funeral was there. Everything was beautiful and the bathrooms were immaculate! I LOVED how the fellowship building is decorated. Attended little cousins' birthday day party.  The children had a good time, not a lot included for the adults.  Party rooms, pizza and cupcakes are available in the party price. Excellent event hall.  Pastor Kelvin Early is a young and dynamic minister who delivers the Word every Sunday. Very friendly congregation. Great community projects The local Community Resilience Hub, I don't go to church, but if I did, I'd go here!

name: Victoria Presbyterian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful church, with nice folks.

I travel for work, and often find myself visiting Presbyterian churches in distant cities. Sometimes you're positively surrounded by curious members of the congregation, and that's nice, but not always quite what you're in the mood for.

Victoria was not this kind of church, though. Folks were welcoming in a reserved kind of way; I definitely felt that if I'd been seeking a lot of attention for being a visitor, I could have gotten it, but I let myself rest instead on the respectful and reserved warmth the Fellowship here offered.

I will attend again, if I stay long enough to have visited some other Churches I'm interested in visiting in the area. They treat people that are homeless with respect and dignity and they don't run you off as fast as most places do if your homeless so always you can go by the Presbyterian Church he'll keep you safe Closed during open hours 1-9 People are kind and sharing and worship is great. I highly recomend coming and finding out for yourself. Great grandson goes to preschool there.  It's clean & teachers are very caring.

name: Victory Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: A welcoming community check them out. Absolutely lovely church with the most welcoming faces. Before knowing of them, I tried all around Orange County to find a church where I can worship and learn more about God, but never quite felt like I could settle in anywhere. That is until I found Victory in Anaheim! Both the church and the people who attend are some of the kindest which makes you feel welcome and at home. I am very thankful and fortunate to call Victory my church because they are helping me grow my relationship with Jesus! Thank you! I Love this Church because of the Worship Team, they play great music, and it fills you with the holy spirit. This Church has drawn me closer to God through learning about his Son Jesus. The Pastor teaches you and helps you understand the Bible and explains it so well. I'm so glad I came to this Church, and they welcome you with open arms. Recent moved from NY and found this church. Haven't been to it in a while but planning to go back. great church preaches the word of God and provides bibles references - really friendly staff, never felt judge for not being consistent. Always feel like God represent. I love the worshipping time!! I have been going to victory Anaheim about 6 months now. I really liked Pastor Dave and his wife Marcia.

name: Victory Baptist Church - Burbank Campus
Victory Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor JC is truly a blessing of a man. It was my first time at the church, and I was battling spiritual struggles. He made me feel more welcome than any other church I’ve been to. God used him to help save me, and I’ll always be grateful for that. God bless Pastor JC and everyone there. My family and I love Victory Baptist Church! The staff and people who attend are wonderful. Pastor Jaysen Brown truly has a love for people. There are many good preachers in other churches but they are not so great at pastoring. Pastor Jaysen Brown is an excellent pastor and a phenomenal preacher/bible teacher. God has truly given him a large heart for people. If you have children, this is a perfect church for your children to grow in the knowledge of Jesus and the Bible. If you are single, newly married or even a senior, there are ministries for every age in life at victory Baptist Church. I highly recommend you check it out! Love this church! Family feel with friendly people! Pastor Brown does a wonderful job preaching the Word of God. The kids program is super fun, my kids love it! We also have teenagers, Pastor Nathan gives them a place to connect and learn the importance of following Jesus. The whole family has a place to worship and grow in the Lord, it’s fantastic! If you’re looking for a place to call home, visit Victory Baptist Church! Its hard to explain the sense of peace and belonging here at this church. They have great kids programs and youth group which is what brought us through the doors. My husband and I were in awe that our kids didn't want to miss a week. As we became regular attenders we felt what they felt. Super convicting and energetic pastor, loving and welcoming people and overall great ministry leaving anxious to get back to church each week. God is good!! LOVE this church. I came to this church back in 2018 and it's where I accepted Jesus as my savior 🙌. The pastor here is great and preaches right from the bible and doesn't sugar coat. I've been to a few churches before this one and the welcome here is like no other. You feel seen and not invisible like all the other large churches that you can sneak out of after the service. It's impossible to not make a friend here. Also, they have an amazing Awana program for the kids!

name: Victory Baptist Church of Chino - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Great pastor who really loves God and wants his flock to love God, too.  He teaches the Bible sort of verse by verse.  He has 3 sermons in the morning (8:30, 10:00, and 11:30) so it is quite accomidating. Also given it is a small building it has a nice small church feeling to it which is great if you want to grow and mature in Christ.  I recommend third service because that is when I am there, and I can see how many people read this review.   I highly recommend you come.  If you want to find out all the sermon times, just come and see.  Also, as FYI, it is the second oldest building in Chino, so it is a historical landmark which is kind of cool.  If your not a Christian come on down anyway, you are never so lost that God can't find you. "They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your household.”  Acts 16:31 I'm giving three stars only because of my experience with a few members. One is a present member and the other is a former member. Grandparents to a child who I love dearly.. The Elletts are truly not of God ! Not at all ! Pharasees is the practice I see from the grandparents. Abusive mentally and physically towards one of their daughters. Towards me they have been completely rude, controlling and judgemental. The father is a control freak and complete hypocrite and the mother condoning his actions is sick. They need prayers !!! Pastor Brian is a True Son of GOD and Shepherd. Preaching The Word of God. Feeding GOD's Sheep, and Pointing Many to Jesus Christ. We have found our new church. We loved the Word given thu pastor Brian Pattison. God bless this church. We will be back next week. We just visited for the first time and the people were so kind and welcoming.  They teach the truth, which is hard to find nowadays in a world where you can't tell who or what to believe.  Nice honest traditional service.

name: Victory Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi! I started going to Victory mainly for youth on Wednesdays after a friend recommended I try it. I hadn’t really been attending church and was hopeful this would be a positive experience. Unfortunately, from the moment I walked in, the environment felt noticeably judgmental and uncomfortable. We were split into groups and talked for a bit, and afterward I opened up slightly to the main worship leader. At first, she appeared kind and trustworthy, which made me feel comfortable enough to share, but looking back, that assumption was clearly misplaced. I struggle with anxiety, so opening up was already a challenge. Instead of receiving support or guidance, I was met with passive-aggressive responses and unnecessary snarky comments. I was simply talking about school and things I was going through, yet somehow left feeling out of place and uncomfortable. Later, I found out that what I shared had been discussed with other people in the church, which was especially hurtful—considering it was one of my first times opening up to someone in that setting. A church should feel welcoming and safe, and this experience was anything but that. When you are in a leadership position, sharing someone’s personal information should not be optional or based on convenience; unless someone is in danger, those conversations should remain private. Unfortunately, this situation felt far more like gossip than genuine care. I also expressed interest in joining the worship team, as I have a strong passion for singing and growing closer to God. I went through the audition process with the same leader and submitted a singing video as instructed. Weeks passed, and I continued to feel uncomfortable walking into the church, only to never hear back at all. The lack of follow-up or communication felt unprofessional and dismissive. The people are what make up a church, and unfortunately, a small group of individuals managed to overshadow what could have been a meaningful experience. Being in a “godly” environment should not feel like walking into a space filled with gossip and judgment—especially when those who claim to worship God are the ones participating in it. sadly, I’ve since spoken to several others who shared similar experiences with this same leader, including favoritism, bias, poor communication, and sharing personal information. (this is not only with one person, it’s with multiple people)
While the preaching and vocals were good, the overall environment was unhealthy and took a toll on my mental health. Because of that, I would not return, and I would not recommend you go/ send your child to this church.

name: Victory Church - Hamilton Mill - Buford Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is not friendly at all. We had not been to church in years and felt very unwelcome from the second we walked in. We were immediately sat in the back of the sanctuary because we had our children with us. We were being watched like hawks by the usher and the second my daughter made a single peep we were approached and asked to leave the sanctuary. I told him that my children were not being disruptive and that if we needed to step out we would, but for now we were okay. He basically gave us no choice and said we needed to leave and that we could go to their “family room.” He then called for another usher who came and sat right behind me with her arms crossed just staring at me. At this point, I felt extremely uncomfortable and decided to leave. It felt like a huge red flag that a church could be so uninviting. Children are a blessing from the Lord and we choose to include our children in our lives. My children are very well behaved and there is a difference between a wailing kid who is being disruptive and one that is sitting quietly. Very very disappointed in this church and it resulted in us leaving and heading to 12 stone down the street which welcomed us and our children with wide open arms, apologizing for the experience we just endured. I felt really sad that we had such a bad experience with this church. I wish I could leave better feedback. I really like the pastor of this church and I think he does a very good job teaching God’s Word. But this is a mega church, and mega churches often have two problems: worship and fellowship. Victory Church borrows a lot of songs from Elevation, Hillsong, and Bethel. While no church is perfect, these aforementioned churches’ worship is rooted in theological heresy. Victory doesn’t need to borrow anyways. Their worship band, Victory House Worship, is great! Go check them out on Spotify! Anyways, the large setting of mega churches makes it hard to have fellowship with other believers in Christ. I was a part of the youth group here for close to two years, and I never felt like I was a part of anything. I think I am going to go to a different church from now on. I’m sorry, Victory. This is my home church, but when I visited here for the first time, I felt very much at home and welcomed by everyone that was volunteering or on staff. This is a great Bible Based Jesus church, the music is wonder, and the campus pastors are wonderful at delivering God's word in a correct way and in a way that truly makes you understand what Jesus is saying. Last night was my 1st time in YEARS since I been in Victory. I use to visit the other location in Norcross. But last night… Christmas Eve… God did something in me that I know I will never forget. To Mrs Cindy.. I love you!!! You took the time to listen to a woman that walked in still feeling somewhat broken and I left feeling a whole lot WHOLE! And to the pastor/brother who spoke to me on the phone the day before…. I’m home again!!! For the past few years, we have been attending this location for worship and community. We are a family of seven in total and our church has everything for everyone. From various prayer and worship offerings to community restoration and transformation as well as midweek prayer services.

Our church is multicultural and offers church services in more than one language!

Our location is handicap accessible, as well as child friendly 🥰

name: Victory for the World Church, Decatur - Decatur Campus
reviewSummary: Today, thousands of Ethiopians celebrated Timket Ketera holiday (Epiphany), in this majestic Church This is my home church and I love it!
