My mother’s fiancé has been a member for over 15 years. I have been a member of a church and with membership to the church certain courtesies are extended to you. Especially if you put into the church, you give and they give back, otherwise what is the point of being a member. With that being said the way this church did a long standing member was disgusting. Everything was a tug of war, the church was booked and paid for before they decided to give a contract, contract came less than a week of the event, they was rushing the event, the contact person was more concerned with arguing instead of providing customer service, they did not want an flash photography for the wedding, you had to specifically specify if you wanted sound to be played for a wedding. Certain things should be self explanatory. Not at this establishment everything had to be specifically requested. Apparently the pastor doesn’t do rehearsal and also doesn’t ask bride and groom colors, doesn’t wear a robe (so he looks like a last minute stand in for pics instead of a planned entity), didn’t follow the intended program, and was in a rush to leave. Made their ceremony more about himself by not respecting their written wishes. Not sure if that was an ego thing. To top it off, 2 different people caught them (pastor on one occasion and pastor, coordinator, and musician) talking about the bride and groom. If this is what happens to a member I can only imagine how a person off the street is treated. Facility was ok but the customer service sucked. in my opinion, this whole situation could have been executed a lot better. I come from a customer service background and one best practice is to put forth what you can do instead of telling a person what they can not do. Weddings are already stressful and adding more stress should not be a part of the process. Reducing stress and providing your best service should be your top priority to your clients (because they are clients at the point they are paying to be there) They need to reevaluate how they do business and what is needed for a wedding when using the facilities. Each time I have visited this church, I receive liberation and transformation! I love Dr. Kenneth Samuel's ministry. He exegetes God's Word like no other! reviewSummary:

Yesterday, I was a first-time visitor there.  Right off the bat, you can see that there is some kind of dress code being followed (very formal for men and modesty for women).  There is also some emphasis on a certain denomination / doctrine.  Church seems to be focusing on structure, strict adherence, and to some extent ritualistic behavior.  Nothing wrong with these things, if that is what you are looking for.  But a word of caution for those who seek more of a non-denominational, relaxed and friendly environment.

One specific incident stood out for me.  Right after the worship, before they get into announcements and messages, I stepped out to the lobby to use restroom.  My family was seated in one of the front rows.  When I re-entered the sanctuary, I was promptly stopped by an usher (an elderly gentleman).  He said I could not return to my seat because at that time Prayer was going on.  The Usher also said that the Holy Spirit is active during the prayer, therefore I could not walk in the aisle and disrupt the environment.  He then placed his hand on my shoulder and started praying (I wasn't sure if he was genuinely praying for me or was physically restraining me from moving forward).   He was not angry or rude, but he wasn't pleasant and welcoming either. I guess, he was resolute in enforcing what he believed to be the "right order" in the Church service.  Maybe it works for some people, but it left me a bit disturbed for rest of the service.  I had never experienced this in a church (big or small). I am thankful to Victory Outreach.  This place makes miracles happen. Thank you for everything ❤️ Nice clean atmosphere, I felt welcomed. However the volume on the speakers during the music and singing/worshipping was extremely loud. Truly a House of Miracles

God bless you I love this church very much. It is the very truth of God’s word. Pastor Blake and his church family had welcomed my family in the way Jesus Christ would. name: Vida Church - Las Vegas Campus
reviewSummary:
I googled churches near me and found quite a bit of churches in the area. What stuck out to me was the name! Vida Church! Vida means life and thats what God gave us. Life! From the moment I hit the parking lot to entering the building everyone was friendly and welcoming! The worship team is amazing and the message was uplifting and truly heartfelt. It can apply to everyone and anyone. No shaming or condemning just simply showing love and teaching real life lessons through the Bible! I happened to visit on a day they were having baptisms and it was a heartfelt experience. Very friendly!
Vida Church is truly home for my family and me!
We go to the Las Vegas campus and love that they have both Spanish and English services, it makes it easy for all of us, including my mom, to feel included and connected. The worship is powerful, the messages always speak to the heart, and the youth group is amazing for our Jr high kid.
I also love knowing the Lancaster and Mojave campuses share the same heart and energy. No matter where you go, you feel the same love and sense of family.
¡Dios está obrando en Vida Church ⛪️ ♥️ If you’re looking for a new church to call home, your search ends here. This place is filled with great church goers whom want to build a community with you and lift your spirits up. The pastors are amazing genuine leaders who care and spend intimate moments with you and bring out your spiritual gifts to serve. This place is definitely a great church and only wish to build a strong family where community goes hand-in-hand to make your journey in knowing God is your friend and seeks to heal your life. They offer bilingual services so everyone in your family can enjoy a great message. As well, the youth ministry is strong and seek to raise a stronger generation who also praise God and are genuinely caring to your teens and young ones. Only my review can go so far, come experience this wonderful ministry yourself. Don’t be shy to spend time to talk to Pastor Joe & Pastor Danielle, Pastor Chuy & his wife, the Youth Leaders Billy & Ashley, they are amazing folks themselves. Vida church is such a wonderful place to be at every sunday, the moment i walked in everyone was super friendly and kind, they approached my husband and i like as if we were already a part of their community. they didn’t fail to make me feel at home and welcomed can’t wait to come back every sunday. ☺️🤍 I heard the pastor on SOS radio and the church sounded perfect. I arrived and was greeted by someone who spoke only Spanish. It took him longer than it should’ve to find someone who speaks English. I stood there not knowing where to go and nobody to help me. I left, I didn’t feel welcomed.

reviewSummary: Loving atmosphere. Friendly people. Amazing Praise and worship time. Life changing message. We attend the second service. Something for everyone, regardless of age. Bright and open, comfortable , enjoyable experience. You should be there! Network rooted in love and truth, when we know God loves us we rest in his finished work. The world will never understand the Perfect Law of Liberty, that gives us the power to stand. God Bless this likeminded community True Worshippers in Spirit and Truth John 4:23-24 Vida church has been our home since 2020. They love the Lord and are filled with grace for every story, for every season, and every person that walks through the door. If you’re looking for an amazing church and want to truly belong to a church family, Vida Church is the place. The love and acceptance that this church gives so freely is warm and welcoming for all!  Both English and Spanish services!!! Visited this church a couple weeks ago and loved it real preaching happens here. Definitely recommend.

name: Vida Springs Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Vida Springs is a phenomenal church. I have been attending church here for several years now and I have been very thankful for the community that I've found. Vida Springs is a very warm and welcoming church that genuinely has a heart for people. I moved here for college and quickly found my best friends upon attending this church.

At Vida the Sunday morning talks are centered around biblical passages and the message of Jesus Christ is always preached. The leadership here is extremely humble and always growing, challenging, and loving the community.

This church genuinely feels like a family that constantly looks to encourage, correct, and do life with each other. Vida Springs is amazing! So thankful to have found an incredible community that feels like a family here. Since my first day at Vida I have been able to experience a warm and welcoming atmosphere (specially as an international student that had just recently moved to the US). I inmediately felt like I belonged here and it's been so amazing to meet people from so many different cultures & ages. You can tell that they have a passionate heart for Jesus and that extrapolates in the way that they love and serve people and everyone is just so intentional :)

I also really appreciate how clear and Bible-based the teachings are (specially as someone whose first language is not english),  the humility displayed on the way that the Staff Pastors lead and the intentionality and care of the prayer ministry. The leaders at Vida are focused on making disciples and planting churches. Sunday services are filled with amazing worship, intentional prayer, and meaningful teaching. There are a variety of small groups to foster personal growth and community. If you’re looking for a church home, attend a few weeks in a row and you’ll find this to be a special place. I absolutely love Vida Springs and can't recommend them enough! I've been going here for about 1.5 years and it's truly been life changing! One of my goals when I was looking for a church was to be a part of a place that had genuine community and made you feel like you belonged. The first time I tried Vida, 3 out of the 4 pastors came and introduced themselves to me and even remembered my name when I came back the following week! Vida loves people so well, but they love Jesus so much better. It is so evident that the Bible is the core of Vida. So thankful to be a part of this church and community! We love Vida springs and can't recommend them enough. After first visit our kids begged us to return. Never before have we heard sermons with bible and life application that stuck after service , nor have we felt more welcomed , and cared for like we were always a part of this church family. We are beyond happy to have found a community where you can feel Holy Spirit moving and changing our lives. Thank you, Vida !

name: Viewpoint Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Viewpoint Church is truly a special place!

This church is intimate, connected, and welcoming. From the moment I walked in, I felt at home with how friendly and genuine everyone is. One of the things I really appreciate about Viewpoint is the worship—it’s powerful and heartfelt. The messages are always relevant, based on the Bible readings for the upcoming week, which helps you dive deeper into Scripture and understand what you're reading. Pastor Roger and Becky Tirabassi are amazing co-pastors with a wealth of wisdom and hearts on fire for the Lord! Pastor Dr. Ryan Montague has amazing sermons with practical takeaways for you each time he preaches!

Viewpoint Church isn’t just a place to attend; it’s a place where people truly do life together. I came in as a nonbeliever, just exploring, but when I decided to give my life to Jesus, I’m so thankful for the community that supported me on my journey. If you’re looking for a welcoming, Bible-focused church, I highly recommend checking out Viewpoint Church! Family friendly church. Viewpoint’s DNA includes a dedication to reading and studying God’s word, community outreach, worship, and weekly prayer meetings. They have excellent teen and young professional ministries, a diverse congregation with warm and welcoming members. Also, experienced (teaching) pastors who focus on Scripture. Definitely worth checking out! This is by far one of the most joyful and loving Bible-based churches I've ever been to.  It's a family and a community. Even the pastors are so personable you can have lunch with them after church. Come check it out! We love Viewpoint Church, it’s been a blessing in our lives. We’ve been going for about 11 years,  and we have been reading the whole Bible along with the church for just as long. Every Sunday we can expect to hear a message on what we will be reading the following week, along with the whole church. The sense of community on Viewpoint is something we missed when we used to go to a big church, it’s easy to connect and get to know people. If you’re looking for a church that will pray with you and encourage you to read your Bible I highly recommend Viewpoint. Being a part of Viewpoint Church has done so much to better our marriage, our family, and our faith. VP is small enough for you to feel welcome and engaged (we found that hard in larger churches) but still has many resources like a bigger church to support you. For great fellowship and wonderful pastors who speak biblical truth, VP is the place.

name: Vilano Beach Christian Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Great small community church with a caring and God-fearing pastor. The online services are really wonderful since I’m not in the area. Thanks pastor Ed and Karen for your faithfulness and love!

name: Village Bible Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been attending Village Bible Church for nearly five years now and am so grateful to be part of this church family who is devoted to serving one another, side by side, as each grows in their faith-filled walk. Working with the jr. high youth has been such a blessing to me. One of the best groups of sinners, saved by grace, we have had the opportunity to worship, grow and serve with.  Teaching from scripture with core values: Outreach, Community, Spiritual Growth and Ministry. A cross generational community.  Realizing the unique experience, my boys concluded that it is a result of transparency and accessibility to leadership. If you don't have a home church, please join us.  Our annual Living Nativity is amazing. I came to this church when I was 11 years old and fell in love on the first day. 8 years later and i'm still coming. The Lord has used this church and it's people to teach and show me so many wonderful things. My ministry is welcoming booth so come say hi! I used to live right across the street and would go to Awana as a kid, best place to have been during some rough times being so young. It really was a blessing. I miss worship time with all the sing along songs. My favorite was “Don’t build your house on a sandy land”. Stay blessed.🫶🏼🥹 This church does a wonderful live re-enactments of the birth of Jesus back in the old days of Jerusalem and animals are there too with refreshments in the month of December each year. An awesome back in Time experience. I truly enjoyed it!!!

reviewSummary: Kudos to the young adults that prayed and supported the gentleman that was exersizing his free speech right to video in public places.  Ya'll Rock! name: Village Church
reviewSummary:
I have experienced extremely friendly atmosphere in different set ups at this congregation talking to folks of various ethnic backgrounds at Village Church for the last 2 weeks. Today's sermon was very deep and delivered in a way I have never heard before. I have never been inside. But I live around the neighborhood and I love taking my dogs on a walk to the field they have. It's always been a nice little Park. No playground at all just a field with a bunch of different varieties of fruit trees. I've never had them have a problem with me picking a bunch of apples or pears and taking them home with me. They probably appreciate it to keep the bees away. I love coming here when they're isn't so many people so I can let my dogs off leash and walk them all the way through the parking lot to the field. Can't say enough about this church. Truly multicultural and truly evangelical. Great Bible preaching from a variety of pastors, lively contemporary worship, and very friendly and caring community people.
Korean, English and Spanish lyrics and Bible readings on the projections. More formal worship (choir, older hymns) at the  early worship service. Spanish language service at 11AM in the smaller chapel.
Other language-based worship and Bible studies at various times. (Personal note: as an older white guy, I didn't feel out of place here. Great job of integrating cultures without getting a self-congratulatory attitude. Only been going here for a few months.) Went here for a chess competition. Ample parking. Decent bathrooms. Large room suitable for hosting chess competitions. I'm at a Beaverton Symphony Orchestra concert.

So much to say but I'm listening to the 2nd half now.

Photos and videos I will post soon will tell more of the story.

For now, I wanted to remember that they are very professional. Look and sound good.
This 2nd half is much more in tune than the first. Perhaps it's the high humidity from the rain...
Even the principal violinist couldn't settle on a pitch from the start.

Back to listening... now Harry Potter!!! The kids love it... adults too.

name: Village Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely welcome and good fellowship, home from home...(on holiday from Wales, UK with wife and 2 kids in late teens).
Good biblical teaching from Pastor Ryan with honest worship.
Bless you guys. My Husband Andrew and I have been at Village Church since 2005. And as we enter our 15th year I must say this is an amazing Church. Pastor Wade and his staff are all so kind and loving and they make everyone feel worthy and special and they make you feel at home. I am always blessed to be part of Village Church and there is no other Churxh I would rather be at than the one God brought us to.  Thank You Village Church for giving us a him to be at . Music lyrics were very biblical and meaningful and easy to follow on screen.  Sermon was also. Enjoyed the enthusiastic children's choir and the membership seems to cover a wide range of age groups. This was the Saturday evening service I attended. Great church, very inviting and friendly, non judgemental, lots of great small groups that meet during the weeks, so something for everyone. From celebrate recovery, to general bible studys, young married group, young singles group, youth group, womens bible study, mens bible study, and several others... sunday morning before the main service there are several sunday school groups that meet for all age groups, and youth groups, and child care durring the service. The saturday night and sunday morning services are full of great biblical teaching, and sound doctrine...Pastor Wade is a great Teacher who has a down to earth easy to understand & apply way of teaching thru the Bible! the musical portion of worship service is more modern, with some classic hymns. the members are very loving and welcoming. There are people from all over the world, and every background all together with love for eachother to worship the creator & savior of the world! Also the church supports and participate in a variety of mission trips thruout the year. If you are looking for a congregation to join in worship , or just have questions or are curious about God, Jesus, & the Bible come check it out! Village church would love to have you, and serve you! And please check out the welcome center in the back of the auditorium, there are people there who would love to answer all your questions, & help you get plugged in! God Bless! Went to a Sunday night dinner that was all kinds of chili made from all the different people of the church it was really cool..

name: Village Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church. We are all a family, and our pastors are such a blessing.  LOVE ,ACCEPTANCE, FORGIVENESS IS THE ROLE MODEL. Every one is welcome  if you are tired,lonely and need some awesome people to lift you up an encourage you this church is for  yo. The presence of God is felt when we the church come together.  We wait with open arms to welcome you and all your loved ones. This place personifies God's love in every way imaginable. What a cool, eclectic congregation. The father-and-son pastoral staff truly reflect the Lord in their words and actions. This church is incredibly amazing! They preach what the Bible says, believe in the full gospel, (The indwelling of the Holy Spirit, the gifts of the Spirit, & the fruit of the Spirit,) and are true to their motto, LOVE, ACCEPTANCE, FORGIVENESS. Also, their praise & worship team Rock! The pastor, (i think he was) he had the biggest bible and a nice cross is absolutely nuts. the first thing on their mind is someone who is different is a satanist. shame full. If your looking for a family church. This is a place to be. The Pastors and everyone else there will love you and make you know, you are most welcome everytime you walk through the doors of the church. I am always looking forward for all the services.

name: Village Church of Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I visited first outdoors during Covid and have made this our new church home. This is a place of authentic people seeking Jesus. We especially love the “family dinner” style first sundays of the month where you can have some great food and meet some new friends. I found the Village after several months of trying churches in Irvine and my family have been members now for over 3 years. The Village met all the Biblical criteria of a faithful bible teaching church. The authority of scripture is foundational. The Gospel is shared often. The leaders are hospitable, gracious, and humble. The church has great community groups all across orange county, where discipleship and spiritual growth take place. The Village believes in reformed theology, but they do not make secondary issues overly important. They give the congregation the room to disagree on secondary issues which allows for appropriate defense of primary issues.

If you are a follower of Christ, I highly recommend The Village Church in Irvine. On the very first Sunday we visited Village Church back in 2016, we were warmly greeted and even invited to join a community group. Nearly seven years later, we continue to be grateful every day being part of a local church that emphasizes biblical authority, gospel centrality, and community. I’ve been attending VCI for several years now, and I’ve grown tremendously in my faith here. I know so many people at this church who are real people with flaws, but who are growing because they are sincerely following Jesus and pursuing a relationship with Him. Come join us on a Sunday, and get plugged into a community group or Bible study so we can do life with you, too! We love Village Church of Irvine! Solid, Biblical teaching and training, great community, good serving opportunities, and a great kid ministry. We love being part of this church!

name: Village Heights Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
10 years later. Still home. More involved in my church and in my community than I could have ever possibly imagined. Join us in an Action Group sometime.

It feels like home to me. I appreciate everything this church has to offer. "Love thy neighbor" and oh boy do we. It's not enough to say we believe, we need to act. Village Heights encourages action. There aren’t enough words to describe how much Pastor Bill & Hannah do for the church and the community. Since the moment I stepped foot in the door I felt right at home. Awesome people and amazing music to back up the worship. Pastors Bill & Hannah are the most heartfelt, down to earth people you'll ever meet. This church is so special. You'll feel like family from the moment you walk in the door. Come find peace and encouragement no matter where you're from or what you're going through. There's no judgement here, just good people, uplifting truth and lots of love. Hope to see you soon! I had the privilege to be there at the very first Sunday service with Pastors Bill & Hannah White. It is rare to find people as genuine, compassionate, fun, and amazing as them. They put their hearts & souls into every detail, every service, & engage every person. If you are looking for a place to be loved & to grow spiritually, you absolutely must visit Village Heights & get to know their pastoral team. You will not regret it. Love it

My family growing up wasn’t Christian and when I finally got baptized I wasn’t sure the church lived up to its ideals.

God we pray for the Heights to not only know you but set themselves apart for you Father

Last note. My 3yr old daughter said  I like that church. Let’s go back next week.

name: Vine Church Tampa - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
As a follower of Christ for many years, I have had the joy of being a part of many fellowships. Last year I found Vine Church Tampa and was able to join them in worship and fellowship. I  highly recommend this church for anyone looking to grow in their faith and needing a welcoming community. This group of believers seeks to Glorify Christ in every aspect of their gathering. A family united in Christ, who gathers at the hotel-for now- every Sunday for 2 services (English and Spanish) to listen to the Holy word of God. A place to call home in the midst of this chaotic life. Welcoming family and sane doctrine preached on every encounter. We immediately felt welcomed at this church! The sermons are Bible focused and Christ centered. Community is genuine and friendly. Vine Church Tampa is a bilingual church, with one service in English and another in Spanish. Although there are two languages, the church is intentionally lived and feels like one family.

It is a church that is:

• Serious in its doctrine.

• Focused on Christ and Scripture.

• Intentionally supportive of community and its members.

This is a family of faith, a place to grow in Christ and His commission. Vine Church Tampa is a healthy church where you can find excellent biblical exposition of the Word, Jesus Christ-centered worship, and a fellowship that transcends the physical limits of a building.

name: Vine Street Christian Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: We had our wedding ceremony at Vine Street and we couldn’t recommend it more! Working in coordination with Sarabeth was seamless and she was very accommodating throughout the entire planning and day of. The church is full of natural light and the grounds outside of the church are beautiful. If you’re looking for a church ceremony in Nashville, Vine Street is your place. Finding Vine Street for both our wedding ceremony and reception was a humongous blessing. We had been looking far and wide for the right venue, balancing proximity to the city, budget, capacity, and being able to host our entire wedding day at the same place.  Meeting and working with Sarahbeth was such a great experience.  She was so responsive to our many questions and very helpful throughout the entire process.   Our friends and family are still telling us how beautiful the ceremony was - especially with the organ music.   Thank you again, Vine Street! You will always hold a special place in our hearts!  This is absolutely a beautiful venue with the wide open windows. I watched one of my best friends son get married there and it was very nice. The reception was downstairs. There’s a large dining room with a kitchen. Very nice venue would highly recommend it. I’m sorry, but I did not take any pictures. We were just enjoying the wedding and the food.😅🙏 Vine Street was a beautiful place to get married. If you are interested in marrying in a religious venue, I would highly HIGHLY recommend Vine Street Christian Church. I was initially interested in marrying in a nice-sized venue such as a barn/mansion/garden, as Nashville has some absolutely gorgeous venues. I was unable to find a reasonably priced venue for my budget, so I decided to keep it traditional and get married in a church. I do not regret that decision at all. Vine street has lovely huge windows that allow for lots of natural light for photos, as well as beautiful small hidden garden areas to take pictures in. Sarahbeth, Vine Street’s wedding representative, was so easy to work with. She would always be willing to meet me if I needed to stop by with a potential vendor, or come and measure something for the reception space. We had 168 guests in the ceremony, and probably more like 160 in the reception space downstairs. All we really needed was some string lights to make the room more romantic and some up-lighting from the DJ and it really helped transform our reception space. It was a whirlwind, but I remember thinking how cozy the reception space felt from this addition of light. I would recommend having your wedding here! We got married and Vine Street and recommend it for anyone looking for an easy and simple church to celebrate their marriage. Sara Beth is so organized, making everything about your visit and your booking easy. The booking comes with an audio tech who nailed all of our requests day of. Thank you!!

name: Vine-Life Christian Fellowship - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I love Vinelife ,I love pastor Wilks....he's real and down to earth.he always makes his sermons relatable. Im always able to connect with the words he's giving for the day. He appeals to the youth the elders & every walk of life in between. I really love this church. Always receiving the word Pastor Wilks is very transparent, doesn't hold anything back, If you are looking for a Pastor who will tell you what you need to hear and know about the word of God, come join us on Sunday morning, very powerful message each and every service.God has called and anointed Dr. Robert L. Wilks, Jr. to teach people how to position themselves for God to bless them so that they can be a blessing to other people The Church seems to be a little unorganized. I really didn't know when church started from all the people that was standing around talking while the young man on stage was trying to sing praises. It looked like the people gathered themselves after the Pastor came, and even then, I got the feeling that things was still out of order. I pray that everything will come together. The Pastor is the best Teacher of THE WORD of GOD! He lives to give and has taught me about: THE LOVE OF GOD now I live to give like GOD!!! VLCF is dedicated to teaching the unaltered Word of God, strictly as it is biblically written. Great teaching!

name: Vineyard Christian Community - Tucson Campus
reviewSummary: A warm welcoming and devoted community. Has uplifting worship and focuses on the word of God with practical and meaningful messages in a structured plan concluding with communion. Outstanding fellowship , friendly , warm and inviting, teaching the truth and carrying the great co mission to the Tucson community.  For all who live in Tucson you're are blessed to have Chris Dehaan and his family to share the journey in becoming more like the Jesus who loves us. A wonderful feeling.  Rhe word of God is spoken here. Pastor Chris has a Heart of Gold. Precious saint's worshipping the King of Kings. Wonderful in Glendale. Hope it is as great. I want my church family in Tucson!

name: Vineyard Christian Fellowship - Concord Campus
reviewSummary:
Attending the Vineyard Christian Church helps fill my heart and soul w God's love and The Holy Spirit.  TYJ
Awesome music, too. Could actually say it's soulful. I mean it's soul filling.

name: Vineyard Christian Fellowship - Salinas Campus
reviewSummary: nice place, great atmosphere Great worshipping love it Not sure about this place. I love it Beautiful spiritual movement, excellent treatment of people!!

name: Vineyard Christian Fellowship of Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I went to this church when it was on 43rd ave and Dunlap. Don't trust this church. They don't know Jesus at all. They however, do know Satan very well. Wonderful people great church and awesome service. Wonderful people. They really care I love how we been service here People are very nice

name: Vineyard Church - Indianapolis Campus
reviewSummary: Me and my family joined the vineyard in 2016 when we first joined I was in and out of church and was struggling with addiction one of the things I loved most about the vineyard was how inviting they are and they never judged or looked down on me for being an addict as I started to rebuild a relationship with Jesus my life began to change and so did my desires! I finally got sober and felt joy again and when my dad seen what Jesus did for me it started to renew his faith in Jesus🥹 and recently my mom started attending with us 🙌 my kids love going to their youth group and they love their youth pastor Valerie she's been there for my babies through some really hard times 💗 and they have made the best group of friends a momma could ask for ...l'm so thankful for my church family and the work that Jesus is doing in the vineyard! If your looking for a good church that doesn't have a dress code and that's like family this is the church to go ✝️🥹🙌 This is an AMAZING Church, a group for everyone, Youth Group is Magnificent, Kids Zone deserve Beautiful Praise, this is truly the Al around the best place to Worship our Lord Jesus, God, community, love, laughter, wonderful caring people. There is a place here for EVERYONE! Single Mom, blended families, Singles, teens, the Rockstars, The Jesus Freaks, The Tattooed and the Pierced, shy, stuck at home we are online! Great church diverse, all ages, wonderful pastor and message needed today, very welcoming! The Vineyard is a great safe place where I can enjoy fellowship and learn of God’s love by great, newer and uplifting music and awesome powerful messages delivered by enthusiastic pastors that follow the teachings of The Holy Bible! I don’t have all the answers but through the music, messages, life groups and community outreach, I’m always learning! Above all this, The Vineyard is NOT a political church, it is a Biblical church of Christ Jesus our Lord! We love the Vineyard! The “come as you are” atmosphere has kept us coming back for many years. Grateful for our church family:)

name: Vineyard Church Glendora - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary: A rich and good combo of smart, loving teaching with sincere community-building and outreach opportunities. The worship is talented without being a production, sincere and ministering. My fav thing is ministry time every week for prayer—if you need support for comfort or breakthrough, every week it’s available in prayer time with pastors and the people attending. VCG is what I imagine church should and can be—discipleship and togetherness. The people of this church have been very supportative, in practical ways (transportation to & from Chemo, meals, yardwork, pick up prescriptions ), during the time my roommate was struggling with Cancer. And, now that I am alone, they have continued with support and sharing God's love with me.  I am so grateful for this church Family. Vineyard Church Glendora is a welcoming community church with bible based teachings.  Vineyard has programs for children, youth and adults, and also has periodic activities for the surrounding community.  Pastors Abigail and Jacob truly have hearts for the Lord! This church is very supportive. When my sister was dying of cancer they went above and beyond with support and love for her. I can’t thank God enough for them. A good group of people

name: Vineyard Church of Augusta - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: They live out the gospel A church home. Come as you are, you will be loved. Provides an incredible framework to serve God, do the ministry, and build the kingdom. The pastors are incredible, legitimate,  and love what they do. Warm and friendly. I went to this church in childhood before we moved and I loved it I was baptized here Love our Pastors and the feeling of being home when there. Great kids programs and options for serving community.

name: Vineyard Columbus - Pickerington Campus - Pickerington Campus
reviewSummary: You can come as you are, and people are so friendly and inviting. There is a welcome center for guests, and an information center for any questions you may have. The sermons are always authentic and never watered down. (Head Pastor Charles Montgomery is fantastic!) I have found a church home here. The morning we visited Vineyard East Campus, we traveled across town to have breakfast with relatives at a nearby hotel. As we departed we realized that we would be late if we drove to the main campus. It was a pleasant surprise to know still we could attend Vineyard Columbus, as usual. We were welcomed and felt like we were in a different room of an already familiar house of worship. So grateful that time with family led to discovering this additional location of a church we've grown to love. My woman's group meets here every 2nd and 4th Wednesday and I love them. They are soooo awesome and remind me of what really binds church folks together. They are the glue needed in fellowship to help others stick. The church itself is community based and good at what they do. The children's ministry is too notch as well. This is a great place to worship. Very laid back and friendly. They welcome you in, offer you a seat and let you make your own decisions, but answer questions if you need it. Although we got out in a timely manner, there was no choir, musicians on stage, singing some times one at a time. Not a traditional church.

name: Vineyard Community Church - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: It's a very alive congregation whose intentions are to truly serve the Lord. The kindness and love from people make you a part of the family almost instantly! The harmonics in the building are perfect during songs. But I love the history of this building and the character it has, very beautiful. The teachings are always detailed and spoken from the word of God.  It's not the same vibe as other places I've been. It's truly and fully christ driven! Love this place, took a broken man like me, and became a healing place with people who actually put effort into knowing you. This is a wonderful church with wonderful people. The worship is phenomenal as the worship leaders live and breathe worship in their own lives. The pastor is very real and shares the gospel through challenging messages that engages the congregation to go and do the stuff that Jesus did! Its an amazing environment. I love it. I have been going here since I want to say 2020 to 2021 and its like home. Its a place I feel truly comfortable being myself and that I love. If you are looking for a church to go to come we are welcome to everyone. Its a community full of good people We're new to the area. We've been at this church the past 5 months. We have been challenged in our walk with God and how to live out our faith loving God and others. We like the opportunity to visit with others during the coffee break also. For those of you who remember Keith Green, our pastor reminds me of him. I have been saved over 50 years. I need teachings to minister to me when a pastor preaches.. I needed a pastor who will seek God's face what the Lord wants taught. I found that pastor at the Vineyard.  The sermons minister to me . I believe it's because pastor Jeff seeks the Lord! He also visits the homeless regularly. I noticed he has compassion for those who are hurting and can feel their disappointment they've experienced in life. This is what Christ did too. Jesus reached out to the sick, drunkers, adulters, tax collectors. When we sing, the words are Holy Spirit inspired.  We feel blessed that God led us here!

name: Vineyard Covington - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: My family loves it here! So friendly and welcoming. This is a new building for the church but the church has been gathering for a few years elsewhere. It’s a great place to be! Warm and inviting place to worship Jesus! Wonderful church with wonderful people that are relatable, down to earth, and just what you need

name: Vineyard Fullerton Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church and wonderful people who make you feel welcome. Discovered this church in 2015 and absolutely fell in love with it. Now that we're back in SoCal, we are attending again. The people are authentic and real. The worship music is by far the best I think I've ever experienced. The sermons/teaching is always relevant and thought provoking.
This church goes out of their building and in to the community to try and make a difference in the lives of those who call Fullerton home. Lots of opportunity to get involved.
This is a great church to call "home". Great group of people who care about you. Real biblical application in this modern world. Wonderful worship team and pastors. Highly recommend. A great place with great people. Meeting on Saturday night is nice since we have Sunday to reflect and rest before the week starts. Such a wonderful place. Meet another of people.  Been in hospital  but am out now. Hope to come to to service again.

name: Vineyard Laguna Niguel - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Great services, I really enjoyed this Easter but my favorites are Monday nights in person, you can check it out on Facebook, they broadcast it live Monday nights . I have attended this church for over a dozen years now. More so while my kids were growing up. The Wednesday nights are amazing as well as the Monday’s for those who want to learn and grow in a way that you and God see fit. People are non-judge mental. Truly a come as you are church. Meaning don’t be worried by the cares of this world. You can be broken, afraid or fully on fire. Wear your Sunday best or without shoes. People are real and authentic. Life happens to all of us including all of us at this church.  There is more here than the traditional Bible teaching. Hear from God. He shows up to do business with each of us. This Church is a healthy place to grow in God. It Carries the Father's Love, A Love for Worship and Teaches you hands on to help you grow. This church gives room for others to grow in their gifts and pursue a relationship with God. Its becoming a kingdom culture community seeing the best in others,praying for others,encouraging one another. Learning how to operate in Mark 16 mandate. You also see and learn of many miracles operate at this church and it's one of the largest in the community that serves the poor and needy. You get God connected in a NEW deeper way. And if you been wounded by past churches,this is a safe place to restore you. I Love Love Love this Church Family !!!
Pastor Mike is A Genuine Pastor.
His Love and Care as a Good Shepherd for his Congregation is Awesome.
This is a Place to be fed the Truth of God’s Word. The Atmosphere is Filled with The Holy Spirit at Every Service and Event by the Dedicated Worship Leaders and Bands. They Literally Change the Atmosphere with Their Music. We have Experienced Emotional and Physical Healings during times of Worship !!!
I’m Glad I found my Church Family Here. I've been to many churches throughout my Christian life and have never seen so many true miracles in all my life!  I love the people and the teaching and am growing so much!  I love this church and everyone I've invited many friends and they've all felt the same way!  Come by on a Monday night at 7:15 for worship or come for a regular Sunday service at 11;15 on Sundays! :-)

name: Vineyard Longmont Church - Longmont Campus
reviewSummary:
A church led with love, humility, and God’s heart

Pastor Alex is a true shepherd — humble, caring, and genuinely looking after his people. His wife, Donna, reflects the same grace and warmth. Since merging with Rêver, Sam and Melodie have also been very welcoming, and the transition has been full of peace.

This community is authentic, loving, and centered on Jesus. Vineyard  Longmont Church is truly a blessed place to grow 🙏🏻❤️ I HAVE FOUND MY PEOPLE!! I am home!! Thank you Alex and Donna for creating such a diverse,  loving,  welcoming and spiritual environment for our small community!! I absolutely love this little church and everyone is so welcoming and awesome!! Praise the Lord!! Spirit is moving church is growing God is faithful I'll be honest, I have a difficult time with the idea of church, but I feel as though I found a healthy community in Vineyard Longmont. I knew it from the moment that I walked in. I felt welcomed as I am. I feel as though we are living out the teachings of Jesus in a unique way. Thank you, Alex and Donna Ackermann for leading such an accepting, lovely church. I've known the Ackermanns since 1997. They are good people

name: Vineyard Yorba Linda - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: This church is so good I love Jesus 🙏🙏😭😭😭👍👍👍👍👍

name: Vinings United Methodist Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary:
Definitely felt the love of this Church.  My heart was warmed from the message of the assistant pastor today!  God bless this Church.  🙏❤️ Vinings Methodist Church has that loving feeling as soon as you walk through the door.
The spirit of the lord definitely lives within this church. Great people, warm welcome, small and humble. Very much enjoyed my visit here! USHER Joseph love you usher Great little church

name: Vinings Worship Center - Smyrna / Vinings Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Andrea and Pastor Parrett are truly real man and woman of God I called on them for prayer and these people of God is anointed and can get prayer through.. I love this ministry..love Roz This is an excellent place to experience the love of God! Spirit filled 🙌🏿

name: Vintage Church
reviewSummary: Historic downtown Raleigh church bringing together historical liturgy and modern relevance, thoughtful theology, and neighborhood connection.

name: Vintage Church Chapel Hill/Carrboro
reviewSummary: This used to be a nice unassuming brick building that matched the neighborhood it sits in. The proprietors decided to paint that natural brick and eye-searing white. It raises my blood pressure every time I drive past it. Vintage is a church that strives to welcome anyone through its doors and help them belong. The Chapel Hill/Carrboro location is small and intimate, nestled in the middle of a neighborhood just a few minutes from downtown Carrboro, with a few small groups meeting around the community throughout the week. Blessed to call these people my family I visited Easter Sunday 2024, and was so made to feel welcomed immediately. ( from Louisiana). Loved it ! Great people.  Close to downtown Carrboro.

name: Vintage Church Downtown - Raleigh Campus
reviewSummary:
Vintage Downtown has been my home for over 3 years now. We were drawn by several aspects this church has- the sermon/message every Sunday is Jesus centered, the worship, and especially the people we have met that are on staff and volunteer there. They have helped shape my faith and have taught me what it means to truly be the church and walk side by side with eachother. Shoutout to the staff who sacrifice so much to help care for their community. This place is doing it right! The people here are so genuine! They’re loving, and caring for people inside and outside of the church. The sermons and worship are incredible to hear and experience. The childcare is also so amazing :) I know so many people work hard to make it welcoming, fun, and accessible for all children! I definitely recommend dropping in to check it out! The church leadership doesn’t know what it’s doing here.  They hired Guidepost Solutions to do an investigation which is a waste of time and money.

They do not know the Word of God nor the Holy Spirit.  Derek Prince is the best Bible teacher out there and see David Wilkerson’s 1973 vision. Great preaching, great staff, great music, and my family and I really enjoy our community group. Vintage is a place where anyone can show up - regardless of religious views - and hear the actual good news of Jesus taught. Like any church led by people, there are some things I don’t prefer, but I recommend anyone come and give it a try to see for yourself. If it isn’t for you the staff will help you find a church that is right for you. We really have enjoyed our experience at Vintage! We were immediately welcomed and felt a very warm feeling from the very first moment inside. This is a great place to get connected and encouraged. The music and sermons are always top notch!

name: Vintage Church LA
reviewSummary: Warm, gospel-centered community meeting in Santa Monica dedicated to biblical exposition, genuine hospitality, and living out the teachings of Jesus on LA's Westside.

name: Vintage Church LA Santa Monica - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Warm, gospel-centered community meeting in Santa Monica dedicated to biblical exposition, genuine hospitality, and living out the teachings of Jesus on LA's Westside.

name: Vintage Church Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited from arizona and reallt enjoyed this church. 1st there is a parking garage about a block down with free parking, plus street parking. The service was awesome.  We recited the lord's prayer together and they offered blessings with the communion.  The pastor is very down to earth and personable.  We will now be watching online along with our regular church service in our home town. Thank you for a beautiful service. I've never been to church here but they left beautiful hand painted rocks, seeds and a message of hope on many of my neighbors lots that had been burned in the fire in Altadena. I noticed them walking in the neighborhood and today found one by my mailbox and it was so lovely to be thought of. Thank you for not forgetting us up here and for leaving little pieces of kindness in all the tragedy...you have no idea how much it means. Vintage Church Pasadena is a great Church. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with warmth and love. The worship is awesome, Tom Reed is truly a gifted worship leader that is always mixing new contemporary worship songs with the old standards that is wonderfully uplifting. Pastor Ben Chase is an excellent pastor bringing the Word of God to real applications to use in our hectic lives, making faith real and relevant. This church isn’t just a place to attend—it’s a family where lives are transformed. The rest of the staff are amazing people that truly love God and want to help you in any way. I can speak from my own experience. This is the most friendly Church I've ever been to, where the word of God is being preached every service where people's faith is being renewed and nurtured.  If you're looking for a place to grow, serve, and experience God’s love, Vintage is it! Highly recommend! Truly I call HOME! Love the church, the people, the building, the community and the passion of our pastor and pastal staffs.  I know I found my home church the very first Sunday in Vintage.  People were so friendly and genuine, coffee and donuts brought in additional warm feeling, I got to know more people in 2 weeks period than I knew people in years in the previous church. Then the compassion during Eaton Canyon Fire, the community stays so strong together, helping one another, paying forward... Church activities & volunteer become the center of my life.  Prays to God! Vintage Pasadena is a welcoming, Gospel-centered community with a diverse congregation. If you're looking for a church home, it's definitely worth a visit.

Finding genuine community in Los Angeles can be tough—commitment is practically a dreaded word in LA. But if you take the leap and visit Vintage more than once, join a community group, volunteer, and embrace a few awkward conversations, you'll find a place where deep friendships and your spiritual life can flourish.

name: Vintage City Church - Fort Collins Campus
reviewSummary:
Get ready for 1 hour of worship and a 5 to 10 minutes of message from the pastor. I had to stop going here because the worship was too long. Premarital counseling is expensive with little results nor accountability. We had a session or two and decided to elope and then after the elopement we felt like we were just another customer and they didn’t seem to actually care in the sessions. It feels like they care more about the business and production and “show” with worship, dancers, lights than they do about truly giving praise and recognition to God This community is so welcoming and genuine. They love people from all different backgrounds really well. I love how excellent and pure-hearted the Holy Spirit-led worship is. The teaching team at Vintage does an exceptional job of communicating the heart of God while giving a thorough and deep teaching of scripture. I so appreciate the amount of value and reverence that is placed on sound teaching that is contextually accurate. The leadership team here puts honoring God and His presence first, and it is evident in not only the gatherings, but the church life throughout the week. Our fav church when we visit Colorado. Anointed worship, excellent preaching!! Amazing musicians, really really great music, extraordinary!! Thoughtful, engaged and engaging pastors. Don't push contributions too much like many churches do. Lots of ways to be part of this community. Good people. Check it out on YouTube every week. Highly recommend!! I started attending Vintage my family and I were new to Fort Collins. Other than the teaching and worship being a good fit,
I felt welcomed and comfortable as a new attendee. I have been attending for two years and attended the weekly women's Bible study which was how I met more people.
The leadership at Vintage are  genuinely good people who love the people of Fort Collins. The congregation is diverse and welcoming to everyone. We are happy to call it our home church now.

name: Vintage Faith Church - Santa Cruz Campus
reviewSummary:
Vibes were great and the pastor was very calming and humble. Great sermon and the ambiance is beautiful we loved the paper cranes Understandable…Teaching….. Unity Friendly….. Family….
Patient….. Community Building….
Joy ….. Peace…. Serenity…. Real for the times…. I call it the Brick Church. Love the brickwork. Cool coffee shop hangout. This is an artist's haven.
Many of the walls are painted as murals. It's a fun active place. Maybe the best church in Santa cruz, pretty nice people, parking lot is okay, stain glass is legit, pastors r also. Best place ever, from the abbey coffee shop w free wifi and tons of seating to the cool pastors and great band. You will find a home here.

name: Vintage Grace - El Dorado Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this church with my wife and our three children to ask for a little help. The first person I spoke to told me to wait for her, that she would come back to help me. I waited for almost two hours, but she never came back. After that, a second person told me the same thing and she never came back either.

Finally, the priest himself came, and instead of listening to me, he chased me away and treated me very badly. I felt humiliated and disrespected.

I left deeply disappointed. I expected to find understanding, compassion and sincerity in a church, not broken promises and such an attitude. I hope that the people involved will reflect on what happened and that God will give them the wisdom to stop making promises that they do not intend to keep, especially to people in need. We love it here! Such a warm and beautiful welcoming church. We feel like  family there and we are so grateful for the community we’ve found here at Vintage Grace. It’s like they literally thought of everyone in our entire family when they organized this ministry. The worship experience is outstanding. The word is taught with such clarity and intentionality. Of course the parking is fine for our wheelchair accessible vans and all of the bathrooms are ADA compliant as well as we appreciate how the aisles in the sanctuary or wide enough so that you can get a wheelchair down to the altar for prayer or worship. The stereo the system in the auditorium are amazing and always has a good message Had the pleasure of joining this church service with my parents yesterday. Coming from a UPC background I was so impressed. I was blown away by how beautiful the worship was and the message. It was to the point but really drove home. Pastor Drew did a wonderful job in his message on the book of Acts. Look forward in coming back to visit again Our first time experience was very positive, very friendly greeters throughout their campus, very clean, well laid out and easy to move about, music worship and praise was awesome, teaching from the pulpit was encouraging and practical. Senior pastor personally followed up with us which was quite refreshing added a real personal touch to their ministries. It was a bit of a drive for us, but would definitely revisit when in the area.

name: Visible Augusta - Augusta Campus
reviewSummary: The people at this church are sweet,  kind,  inviting.  I felt calm and included,  not awkward or uncomfortable like I usually do in any new place.  I felt the church was whole heartedly wanting to share God with people,  not judgemental or hypocritical. I hope to be able to go there quite often. Very welcoming church. It doesn't look like a church from the outside, looks more like a industrial building. The service is only in spanish though so I am thankful I know the language. They have a kids program, small groups, great refreshments, and great singers. If you speak spanish, this would be a good church to go to. 😊 Great church! Great family! Come visit us! Love going here.   Members are very welcoming Great Worship Experience!!!

name: VISION Calvary Chapel Offices - Irvine Campus
Vision Christian Fellowship - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Went to this church long ago, only lived in LA for a year. Truly remarkable — I’ve been to many churches and what Michael and this community bring is honesty, vulnerability, deep insight, connection, and spiritual gifts. I would go back in a heartbeat. Pastor Michael Koh is likely the most gifted preacher in S California right now. But the real essence of VCF is the way the spirit moves. Come here expecting that— Working in the Pasadena area i wanted to be active in a church. The genuine sense of community and compassion in this church is what made me stay and want to seek a new church to attend. I feel very Blessed to have found Vision Christain Fellowship. name: VIVE Church - Mountain View Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been at Vive Church for almost four years now and have been serving pretty much that whole time. This house has shaped me in more ways than I can explain. I love a house that unapologetically preaches the Bible and not only that, equips its members to actually live it out.

When my now husband and I started dating last January, he started coming to church with me. I invited him into something that had already changed my life, and then I got to watch it change his. The leadership here is so intentional and so dedicated to people. They really see you. They call things out of you that you might even miss in yourself. Watching him get activated in his faith was so special because it was real. It was genuine growth.

Because of that culture that is so beautiful here at Vive, we have both been able to step more confidently into our calling of leading the next generation. It feels like such an honor to be in a place that does not just talk about purpose but actually equips you to walk in it.

If I am being honest, when I first started coming years ago, I was hesitant to fully get involved. I would show up and serve but still keep parts of myself guarded. Once I really leaned in and allowed the leadership and community to love on me, everything shifted. The last three years especially have been exponential growth in my faith. My relationship with God is deeper, more personal, and more intentional than it has ever been.

And it is not just a church, it is a family. I met my closest friends here. My wedding was full of people from this house. We have been continuously blessed by the leadership and guidance we have received, not just spiritually but in our careers and personal lives. Every aspect of our lives has been touched by leaders who genuinely dedicate their time to pour into you and go the extra mile for you.

I am so grateful for a church that invests in people, believes in them, and calls them higher. This place has strengthened my faith, impacted my marriage, and positioned us to lead with confidence and conviction. Literally best church ever. I’ve been at Vive for nearly 14 years and through everything it has always been home. If you need a place to find forever friends that become your family this is the place. I’ve had many friends come and go in my life but through everything the church has stayed so consistent in my life. Because of Vive and the incredible leadership that God has put into my life through the church, I have grown so so much as a person. Because of my leaders, I’ve grown in my boldness, leading, relationships and so much more. I’ve visited other churches so I can confidently say that there is truly nothing like Vive. The culture here is so distinct and strong. It’s a culture of encouragement, health, growth, honour, truth, and truly just an embodiment of Kingdom principles. There’s no place like Vive and I thank Jesus for it every single day. The vibes are at vive!! ✨Amazing services that will actually move you (tears and action). The community of believers are friendly, on fire for Christ and actively working towards being true disciples of God. Fellowships, events, classes and opportunities to serve the community. As a member you are fully plugged in with Pastors to guide you, support you and pray for you. Highly recommend this place that I now call home. ♥️ To say that Vive Church changed my life would be a huge understatement. I was invited a few years ago and felt at home immediately. From day one, people were genuinely kind and welcoming. There’s such an excellence about everything they do, from the coffee to worship to discipleship, it’s all done with intentionality and care.

Pastors Adam and Keira are incredible lead pastors. They lead with bold faith, big vision, and a deep love for every person in the house. The campus pastors and staff are also awesome, they’re authentic, high-capacity leaders who are passionate about building God’s Kingdom.

About a year ago, I got plugged in and started serving on teams and joined a home group. That’s when everything really began to change. I found great community, opportunities to grow and serve, and met my girlfriend (now fiancé!).

I’ve been so blessed to be part of this house and it’s been a privilege to get to build the Kingdom and see life’s transformed alongside so many other wonderful people.

God is clearly moving at Vive. The sermons are Biblical and relevant, the leadership is inspiring, and the community is healthy and growing.

If you’re looking for a church or just curious about faith, I can’t recommend Vive enough. My life has been transformed and I believe yours could be too. If you're looking to grow as a disciple of Christ, this is the place for you. You will be encouraged, challenged, inspired, and edified. You will learn to war in prayer and worship, all while pouring out love without measure. VIVE Church is a house of VISION, where every member is encouraged to live their kingdom purpose because we serve a big God.

We absolutely adore the leadership of this house. Pastors Adam and Keira are God-fearing, truth-speaking, faith-filled, and lovers of people, and are relentless in spreading the Gospel (they take Matthew 28:19 seriously)! Healthy leadership trickles down to our beloved campus pastors, Ps Ben and Ps Jackie. They lead our house with so much joy, conviction, heart, and wisdom.

We can confidently say that our most joy-filled and purpose-driven years have been the ones we’ve spent serving and building at VIVE. We are grateful to our Lord for planting us here, to the leadership for stewarding us well, and to the congregation for becoming our family. God bless!

Through those 7 years, I’ve not only been ministered and poured into by this church but have also been challenged to grow in my faith resulting in fruit I couldn’t have imagined before joining. 🥰💖🙌🏾🤩🌈🕊️✝️✨ We were looking for a church that was grounded in biblical principals, personable, warm, had opportunities to help us grow and we found that in Vive Oakland. reviewSummary:
Since June 2018 through all the seasons I have had since moving to San Francisco, this church Vive San Francisco, has been home, community, friendship, growth, challenge, hospitality, worship, and everything that draws me closer in my relationship to God!

The people are welcoming, real, and passionate, and some of the funniest I know, the music moves me into the presence of God, the sermons challenge me and drive me so deep in the Word, and the food and conversation keep me long after service ends!

And how we have community all in the week, with home groups(bible studies), hiking groups, birthday parties, women’s and men’s gatherings, and opportunities to volunteer and pray together, keep me so rooted in this transient city.

Picture one was my first night at vive church and I thank God for my Yes that first day!

Walk up and say hello, and see what all the joy is about! VIVE SF has been my home church in the city since 2018 and I am JUST getting to writing a review for it! This church has become a family and community to me in a city that can sometimes feel like it’s constantly ebbing and flowing with people moving in and out of the bay. So blessed to have found this church when I first moved here and found friends and leaders, exponential growth in my Christian walk, and just so much PURPOSE in my life here! Thanks for being here VIVE SF! ❤️❤️❤️ VIVE SF is home. It’s a place to find genuine faith based/rooted community in the heart of a city otherwise rooted in tech alone.

I have gained genuine friendships, while growing in my walk with God every Sunday and even Wednesdays for group since moving to the Bay Area from Seattle, and for that I am so grateful!

We aren’t meant to do life alone, especially in a city so big as SF. Come and see! One decision could change everything for you! Randomly found this church on maps and decided to try it out. It’s been 2 years and have been going every Sunday. Such a great community. Everyone is kind and truly cares about you. I have never experienced this level of community and care within a church.

We have restaurants we go to as a group after service. It has been a great way to meet new people and catch up with old friends.

Have made some lifelong friends in this church. We all push each other to be better and support one another in hard seasons. This church is the reason I still live in San Francisco. I got a remote job and this church was more than enough reason to stay.

Can’t say enough good things. As a Black woman who has been part of this church community in Oakland, I want to share my personal experience.

Over time, I raised concerns with leadership about what I perceived as contradictions between the church’s stated values of justice, inclusion, and equity and the public political alignments of certain leaders. For me, these concerns felt especially significant given Oakland’s deep history of social justice and advocacy for marginalized communities.

When I brought these concerns forward, I did not feel heard or meaningfully engaged. That experience left me feeling disappointed and disconnected.

For some people, political affiliations may feel separate from faith. For me, they are deeply connected to how communities are impacted — especially Black, immigrant, and working-class communities. Because of that, it became difficult for me to reconcile my values with what I was experiencing in this space.

I believe churches have the opportunity to model accountability, courage, and care for marginalized people. While others may have different experiences here, I personally did not feel that alignment in this community.

If issues of racial justice and political alignment in faith spaces are important to you, I would encourage you to ask questions and discern carefully whether this church is the right fit.

I share this honestly and respectfully, in hopes that faith communities continue striving toward greater integrity and care.

— Stephaney

name: Vizion Church - West Blvd - Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Vizion for almost 4 years now. From my first time visiting, I knew this would be my church home. Pastor Tyson preaches the Word with a fire for the Truth and gospel!! He does not hold back from many topics that could cause controversy and handles it with love and compassion while still standing firm on his faith. The rest of the pastors are equally amazing. I love hearing teaching from each of them. My daughter also attends youth group here and I’ve seen changes in her own life that can only be attributed to Christ of course, but also through the leadership in her community. I could go on and on! Pastor Tyson regularly lies about science to bolster his theological points (e.g. radiometric dating) and relies on apologetics that are not rooted in reality (just dipping your toes in the scholarship will find the right answers). The venue is always busy and parking is extremely limited. Good for people who want to feel good about their faith and belong to a large assembly. I am only 14 but I went to this church for about 3 years with my family until I moved to California and I just want to say I want to move back to Charlotte just for this church. It truly is the best place to go if you want to see Jesus working and to be welcomed in as if you are family then go to this church. Also when I attend Vizion the welcome team made me feel so welcome! I love Vizion church! I remember driving one day and I saw a sign that said  “come as you are” a year before i started going to vizion church. I felt him calling..this past year I moved in the area and found this church. I’m grateful I did. Everyone is welcoming. A church that teaches the gospel of Jesus Christ. A congregation that cares about people’s souls.
A staff that welcomes you and encourages you to come back.
Pastor(s) that are not afraid to tell you what you need to hear.
Bravo Vizion church.

name: Voice Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
I ABSOLUTELY love this church! If you are looking for a smaller church to grow with, this is your church! The praise and worship is amazing. Every time I have attended service there, you feel nothing but God’s presence in the building. Taka, the head pastor, has such a gift of breaking down a topic spiritually and making it relatable to present day. I definitely leave every Sunday with my cup filled. The second time we attended service Taka’s wife Natalie made it a point to introduce herself to our family. The whole community there is very welcoming.  I have two kids that also attend their kids club while we are in service. Knowing how God views the church makes me so happy that my wife found the Voice church to make home. Started coming here couple months ago. My experience here has been so refreshing. The passion and vision of this church is what really made us decide Voice as our home church !

If anyone is looking for a safe, people loving, and Bible loving church, I’d say check this place out.

As new parents, the awesome children’s ministry didn’t hurt 😌 We’ve been attending Voice for a couple of months now and it has truly been a blessing. We love the pastors, community, and messages we receive. I feel seen here. I feel loved here. I feel at home here. I appreciate how quickly we can serve and how our voices matter. I also value how open, friendly, and transparent our pastors are with everything. I’m excited to see where God takes Voice Church this year! We had just moved into the OC and were looking for a place to call home and a church family. After visiting a few places, nothing really stood out. I found Voice after seeing their trailer in a shopping area and decided to go check it out. After the first service, it was hands down the church for our family.

The generosity and love of the people is infectious, the worship/service is simple and thoughtful, yet so impactful, the sermons drive deep into the heart and are just real, and this church really does feel like the answer to what Jesus would’ve done in modern times (diverse and reflective of the local community, outreach driven, yet purposefully built to meet the needs of its people). I’m so grateful for the amazing leaders here and highly encourage you to come check it out! You will be greeted with love, no judgments and a smile. Voice Church is unlike any church I have ever attended. I came from a past of bad experience with the church and was terrified to try yet another church where I could potentially get hurt again. However, God truly lead me to a place with people who love Him so much and have a heart for Jesus and those around them that is so evident. From the first day my boyfriend (now husband) and I walked in we were met with welcoming smiles and people who genuinely cared to know us! Pastor Taka and Pastor Natalie use God’s word at the center of all sermons and you leave every Sunday with a hunger to learn more about Jesus and the honest truth of the Bible in your heart. Coming from someone who was terrified to try church again, I can say with complete honesty that Voice Church is full of so much love that you will feel so welcomed and sought after here! My husband and I call Voice Church home and the people there our family, we thank Jesus each day for leading us to a place where we can learn more about His word and strengthen our relationship with Him!

name: Voices of Faith Church - Stone Mountain Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church fill with God loving Christians. They have a very impressive bookstore and also serve Starbucks coffee/tea. Very well organized and focused on making you feel welcome. I had a chance to meet the pastor personally and had a wonderful worship experience. Preferred the Conyers' services better. Also tired of him preaching about Tithes. If the church is struggling, just say the church h is struggling. I joined Voices of Faith in 2015 after visiting for several months. The church is warm and friendly. There are multiple services, I attend the 8am. Since I am a worshipper, it was important for me to find a Church where I could worship and praise God freely. Bishop Gary Hawkins is a great teacher of the word of God and he opens up the bible and gives insight into the scriptures that leads you to truth. The choir also sings beautifully. The are many ministries available for people to get involved regardless of age. Voices of Faith is absolutely amazing! The choir is ALWAYS live! The members are welcoming! The Bishop is humble and extremely knowledgeable in The Word. I believe that he is truly in love with The Lord and the work The Lord has called him to do! I am excited about my Spiritual growth and partaking in the festivities of VOF! This church has over an hour praise service. This is what I was looking for because God needs to be worshipped prior to hearing the Rhema word. Bishop Gary Hawkins is a prolific speaker. After hearing his sermons you leave the facility empowered for the week. The church congregation is GREAT and they REALLY care for you. If you're looking for a church home you need to visit Voices of Faith. You'll be happy and blessed that you did.

Service times are 8 a.m. and 11 a.m.

name: VOUS Church
reviewSummary: Dynamic, creative worship community led by Rich & DawnChere Wilkerson in Wynwood and Downtown Miami. Celebrated for high-energy modern praise, radical hospitality, and youthful faith culture.

name: Voyage Calvary Chapel - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful Bible church. Pastor Brent is fantastic at delivering scripture based messages going through the entire Bible, and the congregation is very welcoming. This is a great place to worship! Voyage Calvary is a wonderful community of God Loving brothers and sisters. Pastor Brent is a gifted teacher and pastor. During a time when my mother-in-law was suffering the onset of dementia, Voyage Calvary was an Oasis where Gina and I could get filled back up with God’s Word and the warm love of a Christian community. Pastor Brent officiated at my mother-in-law’s memorial service and we are so thankful we found Voyage Calvary while traveling monthly to Orange County from Colorado.If you are looking for a church that teaches God’s Word and will help your family to grow in Christ, Voyage Calvary should strongly considered. It's an awesome place to hear God's word, Pastor Brent loves God, loves Jesus, teaches God's word, scripture to interpret scripture, personal and intentional with others, like his wife Brynn, she loves people and is an awesome worship leader the leadership is genuine. Like the leadership, the people here including myself who attended this church, are real, not hiding behind some facade, and are nor afraid to share whether they are struggling or hurting. The support a person receives here in the body of Christ is a huge blessing. This is a solid Bible teaching church. Pastor Brent Wagner teaches through the Bible in a way that's very interesting and relevant. He is also a teacher at the Calvary Chapel Bible college so he comes with good credentials! The people are friendly and welcoming, it's a close-knit community Church that is starting to grow their young family ministry. You'll feel very comfortable here. Warm and welcoming, followers of Christ

reviewSummary:

name: Wake Forest Christian Church - Wake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Such welcoming people! A beautiful stone venue with bell tower and stained-glass windows! Site of a delightful afternoon music concert series with reception after in an adjacent building. Free parking lot and street parking. Available for small weddings. This church warmly welcomes children and adults to know God's love. The service follows a more traditional route, hymnals, a sermon, singing and fellowship.  The message, however, is one of love.  If you’re looking for a church that is built on love and acceptance, this might be the church for you! Church building is beautiful! Members are authentic, welcoming to all, and kind. reviewSummary: A church that strives to be what a God loving chuech should be; A community of like-minded individuals united for the cause of bringing Christ to the City and beyond.
