name: West Coast Life Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: WCLC is an amazing church, especially for youth. I look forward to youth every week. The community is so welcoming, the pastors truly care, and I’ve grown closer to God through this church. If you’re looking for a place to belong and grow in your faith, this is your church ! The growth I have experienced in my faith walk because of Pastor Ray and Pastor Beth and the guidance at this church, is crazy! I have never understood things I've heard for decades the way it resonates with me here. Praise God for this wisdom and revelation knowledge! I began attending this church Easter 2023.  I was excited as it is a Word of Faith church which lines up with what scripture teaches. I left in late Summer 2023 as the culture of the church was off.  I became involved in hospitality and a specialty group to help single mothers. No one was outwardly rude but not communicative either.  A mandatory meeting for the hospitality group was called and hardly anyone showed up.  I lived a bit of a distance from the church.  I signed up for an activity at a certain time and when I got there, the task was done by someone else.  I would get text notices about events and ask people about them and no was able to explain.  For the specialty Mothers group I had no communication about how the event would be executed.  I showed legitimate interest in being involved but felt that others were standoffish.. I really couldn't put my finger on it and just sum it up in this review as an odd culture.  Perhaps you could say cliquesh.  Just posting now as I thought the leaders weren't really interested in an honest review.  Had a change of heart as I now see the importance of speaking up.  I will say that the teaching by Pastor Ray was excellent.  The rest of church life and interaction was mediocre to poor. Love this church, and these Pastors!  My life and my family have grown in faith and in love here.  Such a great place to connect with believers.  Pastors Ray and Beth are the real deal! West Coast Life Church is an awesome church!  The pastors are amazing!  Pastor Ray is loaded with the word and only preaches the word and not his opinion.  Pastor Beth is so beautiful and sincere. The church you go to is a matter of life or death and I have many options to go to any church in my area but I choose not only to obey God but to sit under someone who will preach the truth and know that I have an amazing spiritual covering!!

name: West End Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary:
I was looking for a new church and found this one. However, the more I read the reviews, the more it seemed like it wasn't a true chuch, but a satellite church. I inquired about services and the services are indeed televised in from their main campus. I was also looking for a place to meet like minded people but I feel it's hard to do when you really can't worship together, nor when there are singles classes for adults over 45 and such. I just wasn't impressed with what I discovered on their website and what I learned via email. West End Church. RPC
Summer 2024 Visit.
I've passed by RPC on the SW Side of Hwy 59/69 many Times. I was hoping to visit one day. Soo, one day I was in this area looking for a church to attend at 9 am.
RPC West PoPped Up on the GMap. OHhh Great.. I will finally be able to visit RPC, Well, their West Campus.
Apon arriving, I was
Greeted by a parking volunteer. He told me  there is no available parking on the lot ( its small), so I parked on the street, which is not a BiG deal.
Walking into the building, I was greeted by more friendly faces. I made my way to the main room and enJoyed the worship music. I stayed in the main building, so I'm not sure if they offer coffee or not.
As soon as the announcements started, the BiG Screen behind the person started making its way down.
I looked around.
hmm.. Nope, this is not for me. So, I made my way out of the building, Thinking🤔
I can watch this same show from home.
I EnJoy Seeing oR Listening to Pastors / Preachers
~> LiVe when I go out.
It's just me.  I visit one BiG Screen church once in a while, AND 1 IS Enough for Me.

The Great thing about this Church is that it's a BiG Church with A Small Feel.
In a Great Area, accommodating the locals and/ or Being of Service. You need plenty of good coffee to communicate with God. And they have it! I believe this unique idea brings more and more young people to the church. Let us all be blessed! People were very nice also the atmosphere. They also have a very good coffee shop on their campus Love West end church, the Thursday night service and Abe’s live preaching is amazing!! Ive grown so much in Christ thru attending the Thursday night, men’s ministry and small group Bible study. Don’t hesitate to attend

name: West End Community Church - Nashville Campus
reviewSummary: Great church! Senior Pastor Carter Crenshaw and Senior Pastor John Bourgeois have a beautiful Church. I was fortunate enough to be able to attend this past Sunday. I love the way they welcome newcomers to the church. They have four floors that are accessible through stairs or an elevator. They have so many activities for the youth outside and inside the main church building. There is plenty of parking as well that wheel chair is accessible with no steps all the way into the congregation area. I highly recommend this beautiful Church 🙏❤️ Very good church Barry excellent good people people can change your life here at this church We have been at WECC many years now and what is important to me is they take care of the congregations individual needs, as well as the local community and world ministries. While the scripture education is deep in the Word, we also do fun activities, chili cook offs, music picnics etc. Since it is a large church, it offers many ways to connect if one chooses. Come visit! Love this church. Great staff. The old woman the is very rude with Spanish people

name: West Grand Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church. Beautiful and kind people!
Newly rennovated, new paint, new signs
Very welcoming. Small church is growing!
OCTOBER 31, 2025 FRIDAY IS FREE MOVIE NIGHT. PLEASE GO! YOU'LL BE GLAD YOU DID! Wonderful

name: West Harlem Church of Christ - New York Campus
reviewSummary:
This church teaches the Word according to the Bible. I attended their Sunday worship service at 12pm. Church members sing, pray, partake of the Lord’s Supper, study the Bible and worship in spirit and truth. The sermon was presented by Tim Bunting and interpreted by Gardner Hall.

They post videos on YouTube of their sermons which are bilingual (English and Spanish). I recommend checking out the videos on the YouTube page (@westharlemchurch) to get an idea of what to expect when you visit them. I highly recommend this church! Everyone is lovely and kind. Most importantly, they are eager to lead people to Christ! If I could give more stars, I would! I am so blessed to get to know this congregation for about 2 years now. A true, loving family of Christ. So welcoming and they have bilingual services as well. Great people of God.  Very good bilingual services.  Ask them about Christ and God and they will tell you anything you need to know.  The rest will be your walk.  The Lord says to gather with His people. If you love the Lord or want to start knowing what He's all about, this is a great group of people to help you on your way Helpful place for those seeking to learn more from the Bible itself.

name: West Hill Baptist Church - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely appreciate what the church offers via The Awana Club ministry. My daughter has been attending about 3 years. The entire team do a superb job at delivering the gospel of Jesus Christ to the children. The activities are always Christ centered. The pastor is genuine. Our daughter attended their week long vacation Bible school and she had a fantastic time! We were impressed with the decor, but more importantly, seeing the members desire to see little children come to know Jesus!

We look forward to next year! Visited today for a family carnival. Thank you so much. 5 stars. Beautiful event. Well planned and executed.  Everyone was so nice West Hill Baptist is a great church! They make you feel welcome when you walk in. They have lots of different programs for adults and kids. Wonderfully kind people. They have a fantastic awana program!

name: West Hills Church
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been attending West Hills for about 8 months now and love the welcoming, friendly atmosphere everyone at the church has. From the first service we attended we knew we wanted to keep coming back. West Hills has strong, biblical teaching and leadership, has Christ-centered worship, great programs for kids of all ages, opportunities for in-depth fellowship, and a diverse population both in age and ethnicity. We highly recommend checking West Hills out whether you are new to the church scene or are just looking for a new church home.

Update: I wanted to follow up on my review from a few years ago - we still attend this church and still love all of the aspects listed before! We are very thankful to have found a church family that is so supportive and loving, both to the church attendees and the community. We also especially love how fun, robust, and gospel-centered the children’s programming is for our kids! My home away from home! I have been attending for 9 years. West Hills was my first church to visit after moving to STL and I stayed. At West Hills you will find a strong commitment to deep biblical teaching, and a welcoming congregation that is genuinely interested in getting to know you. This is still my church home😍! Come on down, and discover why! 🤗! Now with 2 services, 9am & 10:45am! We truly are Gospel-grounded, Community-committed, Discipleship-driven, Mission-motivated. These are the attributes that Jesus Christ wants us all to have along with the love, faith, grace and trust in him now and forever! So come and experience, why Jesus gets and truly loves us all, and how your life can, and will be change forever! This is a very welcoming group. My wife and I moved to the area towards the end of 2016 and found this church. All of the staff we have met showed a genuine interest in our family. The music is modern and easy to sing to. Pastor Gary gives wonderful sermons that we find applicable meaning for our family in. I really feel as though the Holy Spirit is greeting me when I arrive here, partly because the West Hills congregation is so welcoming. The sermons are always biblically based and applicable, well-thought out and delivered with love. I would recommend West Hills to anyone.

name: West Hills Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: West Hills Church definitely has the Holy Spirit running through it. It is amazing to see and experience how God has been using Pastor Scott and Daniel to bring people to Christ. All the members are very friendly folks, easy to have conversation with, if you try and are open to it.  Very welcoming feel the moment I walked in. This group of people is truly a body of Christ. Proud to be a member here. Best bible teaching church of west valley in my opinion. Great worship and good group of caring families for prayers and to experience the true love of God. You should come and experience it yourself. Wonderful, small church with a real heart for the Gospel, and for following Jesus. However, the culture has become more and more conservative and less “open” over the past few years, in my opinion. Everyone there is very friendly.They make you feel welcome, & don't  push anything on you. It is communion with the Allmighty, you dont have enough stars to Express this joy.

name: West Houston Christian Center - Houston Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I have been attending WHCC for about 4 months now. We knew when we first walked in the door that we found our new church home. Everyone was genuinely welcoming and friendly. Most importantly the services are spirit filled and truth (The Word) is spoken. You will feel connected after the first few visits and greeted most times by name.  💜 Loved every aspect of this church. The church is very loving and loaded with Faith. The Pastor truly Shepherds the congregation. And the Word of God is held as the highest authority!! Even the classes I attended was phenomenal. Glad to be joining this body of Believers Let me give you the facts from my perspective: This is a Spirit filled church. They believe Jesus is the risen son of God. They believe in speaking in tongues. They emphasize the charismatic gifts (i.e. laying on of hands, healing of the sick, love, Peace of mind, prayers being answered.). They support other Christian ministries involving outreach/evangelizing/foreign ministries, single mothers, etc. They believe every word of the entire Bible is God inspired and true. They recognize/salute visitors, without being overbearing. That's it in a "nutshell". Welcoming, bible-based teaching.  Definitely feel the genuine love when you walk in! Awesome Word of God and beautiful praise and worship music. Lots of love and wonderful fellowship. Kinda partial, my brother and wife,  Jack and Mary Jean Pidgeon are pastors.  Jack C also minister.  Come visit. You will be blessed.

name: West Houston Christian Church - Houston Campus
reviewSummary: Personal attention was superb. wonderful group of people with excellent christian workship program.  it has both chinese and english services.  they even cook their own lunch food to serve which is great taste and only $3. They treat everyone the same even you are a christian or non-christian! Please go there on every sunday morning to have a feeling of yours! Great place and beautiful building! Good people too! ❤️ Great full day  homeschooling enrichment program (Houston Homeschool Education Program) here for pre k through 8th grade on Tuesdays. My kids love it.

name: West Huntsville Church of Christ - Huntsville Campus
reviewSummary: I love worshipping the Lord with the brethren at the West Huntsville congregation whenever I’m in the area. The people of this congregation of the Lord’s church has always been friendly and welcoming, and their worship is always in accordance with God’s word. Wonderful church full of friendly people striving to get as close to 1st century Christianity as much as humanly possible. Very friendly church.  Elders strictly go by the Bible. Teaches the Bible truth and only the Bible without adding human doctrine. Bible based congregation where you can fellowship with a great group while praising and worshipping God.

name: West Lafayette Apostolic Christian Church - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: Very uplifting and friendly atmosphere. The Spirit of God can be felt here and the Gospel is preached with power. One can not mistake the welcoming her is about and from Jesus!

name: West Lafayette Christian Church - Lafayette / West Lafayette Campus
reviewSummary: The Holy Spirit is alive here! The Pastor brings the word straight from the Bible! Worship/Praise is uplifting!! Great place to share in fellowship. We always feel so welcomed. Not very inviting. praise God

name: West Loop Church - Chicago Campus
reviewSummary: This is my family. I can trust God and His word because of the loving relationships I have here in this church. So peaceful, nice and biblical... it comforts me always. [object Object] [object Object]

name: West Mason Church of Christ - Mason Campus
reviewSummary: A friendly church that stands on the word of God! Great Sunday School classes for all ages.  One story building is handicap accessible.  Preaching is engaging and Biblically based. After moving to Ohio in 2015, this church has become my family. They welcomed me with open arms and has since been where I met my husband and now will be raising our son. WMcoC strives to follow Christ in all we do. Our elders shepard us and are careful to be diligent stewards.  Our preachers are not only excellent at sharing the Word, they are also enjoyable to listen to and very relatable. We have lots of kiddos of all ages and have a growing 20's & 30's group respectively. Our monthly Ladie's Bible class is always an encouragement. Stop on by if you're looking for a church home. We take COVID19 seriously so wear a 😷 or join us online via the website or our Facebook or YouTube live. 🥰 God's word is genuinely preached. The people are more than friendly.  I love this place. Thanks for the treats to a not so local FD. They were yummy! Wonderful group of Christian’s!  If you are ever in the area stop & visit them

name: West Metro Community Church - Yukon Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely one of the BEST pictures of the gospel of Jesus lived out. This church is authentic, inclusive and above all else loves Jesus and people passionately. We all come from different walks of life and are all over the map politically but love one another with the unconditional love of Jesus. Come and see for yourself next Sunday at 10:45!!! I’ll save you a seat!!❤️ “There’s no hate like Christian love.” Pastor Jeremy Coleman was being the hands and feet of Jesus, loving his neighbor, welcoming all sinners. The church removed him without his knowledge. Corrupt as can be. Mr. Coleman is absolutely a blessing from God and this church should have stood by him. Life isn't going to be easy and folks are gonna be mad no matter what you say. The truth is the truth and this man of God spoke the truth. You should stand beside the Pastor who was speaking the truth. A congregation who has the power to be upset and a pastor leaves, well that church is not run by God, but instead the people run the church. And that’s definitely not a place I would EVER want to be. God is the head of the church. Not people’s feelings. This church has welcomed my wife and I from day 1 with open arms. Authentic people doing life together and loving well!

name: West Mitchell Street CME Church - Atlanta Campus
reviewSummary: In the midst of perhaps one of Georgia’s greatest secular investments (the billion-dollar Mercedes Benz dome), West Mitchell Street CME is just one of a handful of sacred spaces remaining in the area. Our faith says to us that our sacred space will be elevated to equally become commensurate or even greater than our worldly, secular surroundings. Our doors are open for everyone who ventures into the area to take moments to “praise God from whom all blessings flow!” Worship with us along with your big event! Peace and blessings... I WAS OVERWHELMED WITH THE APPEARANCE OF WEST MITCHELL ST CHURCH. THE INSIDE IS BEAUTIFUL THEIR IS A BRIGHT HUGE CROSS THAT WAS GIVEN TO THE CHURCH BY THE GREAT LEDGENDARY BENJAMIN E MAYS WIFE SADE MAYS SEEING THIS CROSS FROM A DISTANCE SITTING SHOWS JESUS SPIRIT OF BELIEF AND TO  RECOGNIZE HIS PRESENCE IS THERE WITH US. NOW, TO HEAR THE BIBLICALLY WORD OF LIFE IN THE WORLD PASTOR MASON WILL LEAVE YOUR MIND BLOWING WITH A STRONG MESSAGE FOR YOUR SOUL TO BE UPLIFTING AND HOW MUCH CLOSER YOU CAN GET TO START OVER IN LIFE WITH ANY SITUATION.HE HAS SPOKEN SO MANY OUTSTANDING SERMONS THAT REFLECTS SIGNS OF REALITY ABOUT WHAT IS GOING IN YOU IT'S JUST MESMERIZING THAT HAVE YOU WONDERING HOW HE KNEW THAT  JOURNEY OF YOUR LIFE STORY. name: West Palm Beach Church of Christ - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary: If you’re looking for an incredibly friendly group of Christians to study the Bible with in West Palm Beach and learn more about Jesus, this is the perfect place! So friendly and kind, and the people here really care about God and worshipping together. Would recommend visiting or checking out the website! We are a small group of christians in the UK who meet each week to read and learn from God's word.  We feel grateful to God for guiding us towards your church. The studies on Romans have been challenging,  spiritually uplifting and encouraging.  Thank you so much Brent Kerchville! Have not been here, but if I was living in that area would truly go there. Loving the Bible studies from their website . I found them recently and listen 2-3 episodes a day. Very thorough, thought provoking with an intention to bring you closer to the Lord and living a life that pleases God. I came across this site after reading and studing the word, I truly believe God sent me here. Brent’s bible studies online have helped me so much! I hope I get to visit one day. I go here nearly every day. Thank you Brother Brent and I will share. God bless you. Wonderful worshipping with the church that meets here. They had an excellent class on Philemon and are studying Lamentations the follow class on the Lord's day. Would have loved to stay in Florida longer to worship with them again.

name: West Park United Church of Christ - Rocky River Campus
reviewSummary: You'd be hard pressed to find a church more welcoming than this one. If you've been church "shopping" I highly suggest you give Westpark UCC a try; warm, kind congregation, thought-provoking, and real sermons, community serving, and most importantly you belong here, how I know this is because everyone who walks through these doors belongs, is accepted, and is completely welcomed ❤️ Very kind pastor. Been looking for a church for my family. God put them in my path and has helped me once again w this wonderful church. Thank you so much!!! Friendly people and minister gives inspiring sermons. Choir is good too. I love my church,my pastor ,and all the people that make my Sundays,and everyday a joy, Very nice place of worship. Been there for an interfaith service.

name: West Philly Church of Christ Meets Here - Philadelphia Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love everything about this church. The members will embrace you as if you were a member for years. The worshiping is authentic and strictly from God's word (The Bible). In addition, if you're from out of town or just visiting Philadelphia, the Christians will make sure your schedule is full with fun/exciting places to visit during your visit.  A very welcoming Congregation! We worshipped with the Church here today. What a friendly, loving and caring congregation! Truly showing the love of Jesus! Thank you for making us feel so welcome! If you're in the Philadelphia area you need to visit this church! You'll meet Joe, Fiona, and their beautiful children. And you'll have the privilege of worshiping with a group of loving Christians who love the Lord and each other. An encouraging group of Christians meets here each Sunday. The group strives to worship according to the pattern set for God’s people in the New Testament. If you are looking for a place to worship where God’s word is taught, I encourage you to visit. I worship with this congregation every time I am in the Philly area. This is a strong group, devoted to continually learning, practicing, and teaching God's word.

name: West Rome Baptist Church - Rome Campus
reviewSummary: I love this place and all its people.   Highlight of my week. Amazing worship experience. We are so glad and proud of deciding to become a member. The sermons are taught from the Bible not conjecture. Very intelligent thought provoking Wednesday night groups too. And the food is a nice twist. It’s the home you always knew, but maybe didn’t recognize that was missing. This is a Great Church. They care about. And has a great Children's program.  And the food on Wednesday  nights is great too. Had a great experience!  Pastor was very nice. Stopped and talked with the outta-towners before the service, so that was nice.  I enjoyed his sermon as well.  Gospel centered and delivered in a way that was easily understood.  My kids even sat still for the most part...that's sayin something!  We'll go back! This Church has been great to myself and my family.  From day 1 I knew this was where God called me to be and I encourage all who seek a Church for themselves,  family,  or know friends in need, to visit and see for themselves how God is moving in this place and how souls are being saved by the blood of Christ week after week! Thank you West Rome Baptist for embracing my family and for loving us all!

name: West Side Alliance Church - Cleveland Campus
reviewSummary: We were visiting cleveland. Beautiful sanctuary. Great sermon. Friendly congregation. I Love this Church, I thank God for sending me here. Wonderful church family Nice way to learn about the lord Beautiful church

name: West Side Church of Christ - Akron / Bath Campus
reviewSummary: We meet there once a month for a transgender support group. The people of the church have always been friendly and inviting. Nothing but the word of "GOD". Friendly and welcoming. Much luv The only church ive found that sticks to the bible and nothing else. No lies no judgement . simply love and commitment to God. I'm a member of a great body of believers there. It's great if you're looking for God's truth. Love spending time with people of the same mindset. Praise God

name: West Town Community Church - Evans Campus
reviewSummary:
Good church but it looks like they've lost most of their congregation. Y'all head on over and visit for a service and see what ya think Best Church Ever.  Come as you are.  My kids and I are always comfortable in tshirts and jeans, no pressure to be dressed up.  Great praise and worship team.  The pastor is easy to understand and a wonderful speaker.  People are friendly and helpful.  The fall festival was a blast! (My family dressed like clowns).  The youth leaders are amazing and the youth group has so much fun.  The childrens ministry director, Julie, is incredible.  She loves the kids so much and has put together such a great program.  The kids learn and have fun!  This place feels like home, and has been a blessing to my family. Beautiful place to worship God! Wonderful pastor and band! Best church ever the pasture delivers a clear message each Sunday Very kid friendly.
You walk out of the church being able to deliver yourself the message throughout the week the message that was conveyed on Sunday. The pastor is very approachable and has a great sense of humor. Anyone seeking a new church I highly recommend West Town Church is great! The people are nice. They will welcome you there.

name: West Valley Christian Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
All people are welcome to a great & excellent worship followed by an inspiring and applicable to everyday living sermon from great Pastors, Pastor Rob being the Senior. He's great! Attend the best life group on the planet! Highly recommend if you are looking to dive deeper into studying God’s word and sharing your witness with others. Happiness and prayer! Great Bible teaching church. Worship is great and everyone is fantastic. All feel welcome! Welcome Home is a great saying. Very welcoming, warm atmosphere. We found our church home over 10 years ago and are still so happy in our community. Such a friendly Church! Walk in & the feeling of "welcome come & stay for awhile, immediately over came me!". The Sermon was excellent! The day's scripture reading was so in lighting, when both were put together you understood what the apostle Paul's message was conveying to each and everyone of us. How we can apply it to todays lives.
I always feel at  peace when leaving. Enjoy their website. It's great to be able to re- listen to any Sunday's service again.
God's blessings.

name: WestCoast Church - Stockton Campus
reviewSummary:
Grew up in this church and no matter how far I have strayed from God, they were always there to help me get back on my feet! Love this place ❤️ Very welcoming Church. Felt like family right away. We just moved here from AZ and absolutely love our home Church! One of the Pastors and his wife there used to live in Stockton and said this was their home Church and I was so grateful as it was so stressful thinking of finding a good Bible based Church. I really enjoy hearing the Bishop speak. He isn't afraid to tackle the tough subjects of walk on egg shells, afraid to offend, he speaks the truth and I love that! I've only been to 3 services so far but I plan to continue going! Today was my first time attending a Sunday service at West Coast Church.
From the minute I got there I was welcomed by some of the most sweet. Kind and genuine people.
The service was lovely. And powerful.
I have to mention the presence of God was truly there.
This church is the real deal.
Very welcoming.
Pastor Mark delivers a message,  clearly from his heart and spirit.
With it being Memorial weekend. Pastor Jordan,  beautifully addressed our Veterans and loved ones passed on.
My spirit is lifted and I’m feeling happy. And have more energy than I have known in some time.
Loved this Church.
Thank you to my friend Brenda, for inviting me. And for being the awesome woman she is. I m blessed to know her. I received a warm welcome. The pastors have great sense of humor, and friendly. This church family will also help you have good step of faith with Jesus Westcoast church is a great place to bring your family to Worship God, and learn how to live out your best life as a follower of Christ. My life has change greatly for the better, and each day I'm growing in my faith in my Lord Jesus Christ.

name: Western Hills Brethren In Christ Church - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome Church.  Pastor Tracie teaches the word so everyone can walk away with more knowledge of Christ Like living.    Children and adults alike will learn something to apply to their daily lives. Pastor Tracey Hunter is an awesome pastor go check out their services Sunday 1030am This is my Sunday morning place of worship I have been attending this church for eight and a half years; we are a hidden treasure! My home church away from home, pastor Tracy is awesome

name: Western Hills Church - San Mateo Campus
reviewSummary: Biblical preaching, very kind and welcoming congregation. From 2017-2019 we joined the Arabic church on Saturday evenings at 7:30 until we moved away. :( Miss my friends there. Clean, spacious and Holy Spirit filled. Very receptive staff!!

name: Western Hills Church of Christ - Cincinnati Campus
reviewSummary: Anyone looking for a church home that will embrace you like JESUS is standing at the front door with arms wide open... This is the place. A place that teaches about Christ and the good news of the gospel from the Bible and not from opinions but from GODS WORD the BIBLE... There are so many small groups and Sunday school classes, and the leaders are trustworthy mentors. We couldn't feel more at home in this awesome body of Christ, so please come visit!! This church is a friendly place that teaches from the Bible. The people always welcome me and my family whenever we visit. Friendly people. Doctorinally sound Great place to fellowship and worship God.  Everyone is friendly and made you feel at home

name: Westerville Community United Church of Christ - Westerville Campus
reviewSummary:
As a community partner this church is a great asset.

It is easy to get in and out m, they have access from both county line road and spring street.

They offer weight watchers a space within the community to host meetings. Today was their annual rummage sale- and as always tomorrow is half off pricing.

They raise money that goes to local support and helps those within the local community of parishioners.

They host Otterbein performances and other activities.

Though I don't worship there regularly, I have attended events they have hosted and one service.

My total experience has been with those who support the church and they all been gracious and friendly. Not once had anyone been curt, short or out off.

Very great community focused church. Wonderful house of worship that welcomes all. You will never be judged here. It's a come as you are place. A warm, caring church dedicated to sharing Christ's love with the community at large. The environment is upbeat and open, I felt at home as soon as I walked in the door. The church has many young families, with very active Sunday School offerings. All are truly welcome and respected here. 3.5  IMHO
Genuine, friendly people.  Strong focus on making everyone in the community feel welcome.  This seems to be their central pillar.

My wish would be that they make Christianity and Scripture, their main pillar.  I feel (again my humble opinion), they should allocate more time to the sermon.

This is just a review.  No intent to disparage.  Wishing you live your best life... We traveled to almost every UCC church in Columbus, about 6 years ago, as we were in search of a faith community. Programing and Bible Study groups for all ages and interests.  Social, loving and generous and truly walking the red letters of Jesus.  Come experience if you want a loving community for all.

reviewSummary:

Despite that, there is such a strong sense of love, hope, and encouragement rooted in Jesus Christ. The messages are real, relatable, and centered on truth. I especially appreciate how they talk about the Holy Spirit and the role He plays in our daily lives, it’s something that has really helped deepen my faith.

If you’re looking for a church where you can come as you are, grow spiritually, and feel truly welcomed, I highly recommend checking out Westgate Church.

name: Westlake Bible Fellowship - Westlake Campus
reviewSummary:

This church is a loving community of Christians who love Jesus and love people really well! It’s a wonderful place to grow in your relationship with Jesus under sound biblical teaching and rich fellowship.
Would strongly recommend! I feel very welcomed at this church. The fellowship is strong, the teaching is biblical, and the love of Jesus is present. Biblically based and scripturally supported convictions.

name: Westminster Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary:
The Candlelit Concert was an incredibly amazing experience! The venue was amazing, the music was beautiful and the parking was easy in and out. Overall it was a wonderful experience and I recommend you book an event. Overall just an amazing experience.   Beautiful venue, and breathtaking concert.  Has to be seen and heard to appreciate how special the musical experience is. Great performance of Cold Play and Imagine Dragons music by Candle Light Concerts. Such an impressive venue for the evening! Came here as part of Doors Open Minneapolis. There wasn't anything going on at the time I went, but the building itself is architecturally fascinating. The two halves of the building were built over a century apart, yet come together relatively seamlessly. The church has an inward looking feel to it with its large dome and circular stained glass windows. The pipe organs you see are for show. The real pipes (nearly 5000 I believe) are beyond the ornamental pipes and some are from as far back as the 1920s. The circular layout is very distinct from the other churches like St. Mary's and St. Mark's in the area.

The newer section of the building has a very sleek modern look with bright naturally lit spaces and modern furniture. Very interesting building. I love these kinds of experiences. The passion in the musicians who play the instruments and the ambience they bring are always such a pleasure to watch and feel!!! I love Bridgerton so and this was so romantic and beautiful!!! I hope they do another one on in even bigger stage someday

reviewSummary:

If you're trying to find a church your size as opposed to a megachurch, this is the place for you. If you want to learn from a wise, caring, gifted and understanding pastor (a great teacher!), you will have found a home and family here! Come and test it out!! I love this church. It is a smaller congregation and very warm and welcoming. Good for families, couples, older folks!!
There are 2 services, a contemporary with uplifting music at 9 and a later service with traditional hymns at 11.
Child care is also available and Great Sunday school classes for all age groups. Our grandchildren Love going!
There is a nice "fellowship" gathering time in between services too with coffee and snacks.
I really hope you too might come sit with us for a Sunday morning of praise!
Blessings to each if you!! WPC Escondido is a great place to grow your relationship with Jesus in a real and down-to-earth way. name: Westminster Presbyterian Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Such a friendly, caring, and God-loving church. Pastor Narcissis is fabulous. She is filled with the Holy Spirit and her sermons are Bible centered. name: Westover Hills Church - San Antonio Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church since I was 12, I am now 33.  I’ve seen this church grow so much and I still to this day enjoy attending but last Sunday I was very disappointed with what I witnessed.

I attend the 9:00 am service every Sunday and if you’re a regular you know that at the very front there is always a man that always comes in with his suitcase.  Now I don’t know his circumstance but one can only put two and two together.  He normally sits on the right side of the stage by the drum set but this particular Sunday (6/14/26) the seats were all taken so he instead went to the opposite side and decided to sit in the reserved seats for the pastor and his family.
During worship the pastors security (and I say security because this older man always follows the pastor around and keeps eyes on him when he’s down at the alter praying for others) basically bullied this man out of his seat.  I get that they are reserved but he could’ve waited until after the worship was through and told him during the announcements but he didn’t.  He literally grabbed the man by his arm and escorted him to another seat but it didn’t end there..the attendee was also recording with his flash on (like all elders normally do) and this security took his phone out of his hands to turn the flash off, I couldn’t believe what I was witnessing and I was so angry to the point where I almost went up to this security to say something but my family stopped me because it wasn’t the time or place.  Other attendants around also noticed and were making comments during the announcements how it just wasn’t right the way it was handled.  I get that the seats are reserved for the family but throughout the remainder of the service only pastor Danae and Lindsey (the singer) were the only ones occupying the reserved seats…so he could’ve just stayed and not have his moment with God interrupted but it was and in a VERY RUDE manner.

This isn’t the first time I’ve seen the staff mistreat this individual with the suitcase, I don’t understand why he gets treated the way he does especially because he does no harm and is a regular so it’s nothing new or strange at this point.

Then ironically the service is about “loving one another and coming to church to come together and to have a weekly encounter with God” it’s just sad that his encounter was interrupted because of some reserved seats that were never even sat on.

I hope you take this review and use it talk to that security guard and let him know that there are better ways to handle attendees sitting where they’re obviously not allowed to..it could’ve been handled with kindness and instead he handled in a way that I don’t think should be allowed at church. Do Not come to this church ! I would not recommend. I gave it two chances, but both experiences were disappointing. My first visit fell during their 40th anniversary, and the entire hour-long service was focused solely on that milestone rather than a message. I decided to return the following Sunday, but that service was exclusively about financial giving. It was handled in a way that felt very uncomfortable and repetitive, with no acknowledgment of anything other than money. Additionally, the music at the beginning felt insincere. It was a very strange experience overall This church is strictly a business…everything they do is a tax right off and you’re pressured to constantly give money to benefit the pastor and his families lavish lifestyle. My kids hated it here and we felt like outcasts. If you’re wanting to learn about God and see this church truly give back to the community you won’t find it here. We decided to visit with Westover Hills church as we are currently looking for a place to worship. We found pastor Ryan is longer there, but his daughter and son in law are now the pastors. Service was a blessing. God's holy spirit was present and filled the church. I loved the participation of the altar call. The people are very warm and welcoming. We well for visit with this churches.  God bless. So sick and tired of this pastor and his wife always talking about giving your money to the church. I wanna learn God and the bible better but DO NOT receive that here. Yes we are suppose to give but to hear that every sermon is ridiculous. Dude has a whole PowerPoint on why you should be giving. Why not put that same energy on why you should come to God and learn God. Do not come here

reviewSummary:
Been attending Westwood for a couple years and have been so blessed by God in this environment. One thing I first noticed, and have continued to observe, is everyone is smiling. The faculty / staff are “real” and accessible to all, and you can feel they are led by God in ministry. The church body is dedicated to service on many levels, and administers many outreach opportunities. It is obvious needs are being met. It is the investment in people to reach the world for Jesus that guides Westwood. Everyone is welcome and there is no doubt of God’s presence in this place. Went to vote here yesterday was great. Very nice church people. The chapel was very big and nice looked like they have a band there. They gave us free water and snacks because the wait was so long. Consider me biased when it comes to this church. What can I say I'm a member! I will reflect on my first visit here, 5 years ago. We were welcomed and greeted by everyone we came in contact with. Our boys have disabilities so we parked in the handicap areas. The handicap areas were in the best spot ever. As soon as you get out of your vehicle you're by one of the main entrances. Standing at the main entrance are four guys opening the doors and welcoming you into the church.

Pass those four guys you immediately walk into a cafe, welcome center, and guest areas. It's basically all the area accessible to church members and guests outside of the worship center/sanctuary. It is perfect for gathering with friends, and meeting new people.

On our first visit we had several staff members and guests approach us to basically live out the motto of this church. We're here to impact our world for Jesus Christ, are you new how can we help? We knew immediately this would be our church home. That's a story for another day if you can meet me in person.

The worship center has plenty of room, as I've mentioned before we have kids with disabilities. Two of them are in wheelchairs. They were more than accommodating, and still are to this day, to ask us if we need any chairs moved so they will be more comfortable. The general seating area is chairs connected together and behind them is stadium seating very similar to a movie theater.

When we started attending there were three services. During covid this got bumped back to two, and 9:15 service and a 10:30 service. They also have a wonderful student and kids ministry. Love my church. Best pastor and assistants. Great friends and Christian family. Have been members 17 plus years. We will be Westwood members for life. Highly recommend if visiting churches and looking for a new church home. You will not be disappointed. Big church and plenty of parking. First time visiting. We come from large full gospel church in Ozark Missouri. Don’t get me wrong and I don’t mean to be out spoken but the service was dry. Not much praising going on and no salvation alter call. I didn’t even hear about a giving box or tithing location to give. Maybe I missed something but the service was nothing compared to what I’m use to.

I love this place  mostly because they are have so many ways to serve and help others in the community, the nation, and the world. They are accepting and welcoming of everyone regardless of one's ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, financial standing, or belief system. They encourage folks to think, not just believe blindly.  A breath of fresh air. Thank you pastor Molly for making us feel welcome. And the greeters each week are so welcoming as well. I find the sermons relevant and insightful delivered with a genuine dose of humanity. God is so present in this church and we are so lucky we found it. reviewSummary: Our family was guided here for additional support during hard times that have fallen upon us, and I am taken back by the overwhelming support and kindness we received here. I cannot thank them enough for helping build up this community and being available to lift us up. We look forward to also attending service here based on this elevated experience. Shoutout to all the volunteers who stopped to pray with us. An amazing, strongly local and global missionminded church. If I would libe in Longmont, I would choose them. Best sound doctrine taught here -- verse by verse. The way all churches should teach. White Fields teaches verse by verse and almost always makes a solid gospel presentation. My issues, that I have brought up and have not been addressed in any way, are that they consistently play Bethel, Hillsong, Matt Redman, Phil Wickham etc...and also while picking my children up from VBS they were playing a full on rap song. I grew up on rap and there is no such thing as Christian rap. It all has the appearance of evil and we are called to avoid it. I can tell that there are some really kind people here, but it doesn't seem that discernment and being separate from the world is a high priority. I have no doubt that most people here would help you if they saw you bloodied and lying in a ditch. It is solid, but lacking in some important elements. I rate this church 5 stars because the teaching is Christ-Centered. The community is full of genuine and imperfect people like myself. The people I know here try to model their lives after Christ. Our family began attending White Fields a few years ago. I would consider pastor Nick a friend. He is discipling me and investing in my future. Pastor Mike, Ocean, Michelle, Shelby, Pastor Jason, Kurt, etc., are all people who have made a positive impact in my life, and the lives of others. Our community group gives people space and comfort to be open and honest. We lift each other up and help each other walk by faith. I enjoy the music and outreach to the community via the food pantry and so many other ministries. It is worth giving this church a visit, in my opinion.

reviewSummary:

I'm glad that you checked with your pastor, but you may have a different one now.

#wildwoodcalvarychapelc #john3:16 #yucaipacalifornia #yucaipachurches #calvarychapel #Yucaipa #godisgood #ilovejesus We visited Wildwood Calvary Chapel for the first time.  We generally attend another non-denominational church, but my granddaughter had been invited to try youth group.  Her friend ended up not coming so she joined me in church.  Positive:  We really liked the pastor who spoke.  I loved the scripture references and bases of his sermon.  I felt the sermon was lead by God, not scripted.  I do not know who the pastor was because he didn't introduce himself nor did the pamphlet we were given say who he was. Negative:  The worship hall was generic and cold. The seating is difficult to see the band or pastor.   We were seated in the back after asking for help by an usher.
Most of the closer seating being saved by people who looked at us like we were bothering them for a seat.  An usher escorted us to the "family section" in the back.  We were a party of three, myself, a 7 year old, and a 12 year old, both kids very well behaved.   None of us could see the pastor.  Growing up in a Calvary Chapel of Orange County on the 70's, things have definitely changed.  We looked clearly new and felted more judged than accepted.  I am sad because I really wanted to like it more. Such a gem of a church ! Messages are always super solid- biblically sound, verse by verse straight from the Word, no compromise, really dive deep. Worship and prayer is always incredible- so powerful and Spirit-led. I love how we have prayer/worship night every first Wednesday of the month. The Young Adults here is the best- such an awesome group to get into the Word, worship, pray, and do life with. So thankful to call Wildwood home ! GOOD MORNING. MY SON WAS REJECTED AS HE TOOK HIS 84 YRS OLD GRAMA TO SUNRISE SERVICE.MR.BOB ONE OF THE TRAFFIC CONTROLLER TOLD HIM HE COULDN'T DROP OFF HIS 84 GRAMA AS I WAS WATCHING EVERYONE ELSE WERE GETTING DROPPED OFF . UNFORTUNATELY MY SON HAD TO SLOWLY WALK HIS 84 GRAMA DOWN THE STEEP HILL. SHAME ON YOU MR BOB THIS WAS OUR 4 TH YEAR N NEVER HAD NEEN REJECTED. Wildwood Calvary is extremely warm, welcoming and hospitable. Their pastoral staff and care for their community is remarkable. name: Williston-Immanuel United Church
reviewSummary: My husband is a member of the Williston Immanuel United Church, and we held our wedding ceremony and rehearsal there in August 2021. Throughout the planning process and events held at the church, including the rehearsal and rehearsal dinner, the church staff and Reverend were extremely helpful and willing to work with us. We were able to have our ceremony and events, while still keeping people as safe as possible during the concerns of the pandemic. Kate and Reverend Reba were available for any questions or concerns and made the time to meet with me to go over the process, making everything go as smooth as was possible. We can't thank Frank enough as well for prepping the spaces for our events and guests, and for taking care of everything during and after the events. We had a beautiful ceremony in which Reverend Reba created a personal and creative message for our marriage, meeting with us in advance to get to know us and our relationship further to make it more meaningful to us and our families. The church itself is a beautiful space and Kate made sure to offer as much space as we needed to make our ceremony and experience perfect. We would highly recommend a wedding, ceremony, or other events take place at Williston Immanuel United Church as the staff and space are more than accommodating for the event needs and wants! Church staff very friendly & welcoming, though few of Wayside Kitchen staff not so much so, such as being rather "stingy" with food portions being served & few kitchen play favorites with some regulars that come for supper, which is rather obvious, which needs to change😯 My best to Julie & co for their fierce delivery a piece too all. Friendliest church in Portland.

The lead pastor is Rob Burke a young man with wisdom and teaching skills of a much older person.  A young man with spiritual depth  and maturity far reaching beyond his physical age.

This is a church that dreams big, plans strategies and takes steps to make it happen. A church that's reaching out to serve the local Fullerton community. A goal being, that all people understand through Christ everyone can have an operating manual and road map to live life to its fullest. Went for a musical concert for Christmas. reviewSummary:
I grew up going to this church. The people here are like family. name: Wisdom City Church
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Wisdom City for over a year now.  I have searched for a church with authentic love.   To my surprise it's a bit of a bigger church and l absolutely love it. When l start my week l am actually looking forward to Sunday by mid-week. Thank you, Lord for leading me to Wisdom City. I have now been planted in my new church home and I thank you. I love how Pastor Dave Martin teaches us and I love how both Pastor Dave Martin and his wife Christine are so loving and there for us standing at the door after service with a warm handshake and a hug thank you Pastor Dave Lomasney is my new pastor friend. If you’re looking for a warm inviting church, Bible based family welcoming church visit Wisdom City three times you’ll see. Thank you Wisdom City 🙌🏾 Wisdom City Church has completely changed my life.
Before coming here, I used to beg God to speak to me when I prayed. I felt like I was searching, hoping, waiting for clarity. Now, I feel His conviction multiple times a day. I feel guided. I feel led. I feel corrected in love instead of condemned in shame.
The conviction that brought me to this church was the same conviction that changed my life.
Since being here, I’ve made genuine, aligned friendships. I’ve experienced growth I didn’t know I was capable of. I’ve made hard decisions that I would have never had the courage to make without God leading me through them, and this church has helped nurture that relationship.
Wisdom City doesn’t feel like a rulebook. It doesn’t feel like performance. It doesn’t feel like shame. It feels like relationship. It feels like transformation. It feels like truth delivered with grace.
If you’re looking for a real relationship with God, not religion, not pressure, not condemnation, this church is for you.
I am so thankful God led me here. It has been one of the greatest blessings of my life. Enjoyed my worship time there, while I was visiting. Great brothers and sisters- warm welcome there. It's easily one of the best churches I've ever stepped foot in.

Amazing children's and teens groups.
3 different pastors on the team who are ALL amazing.
Love and acceptance, like you'll get nowhere else.

From new believer to old, they have everything you need in a church.

Community, faith, hope, and love.

They also have missions a couple of times a year, and tons of in-house and related charities you can assist in!

Can't wait to see the new building in a few months!

name: Wonder Church
reviewSummary:
I start coming to this church last month, and I really love this church from the bottom of my heart. It’s a relative small church, but the messages always speak right to the hearts. The pastor shares God’s word with such honesty, vulnerability, and encouragement. It feels personal and real every time. The preaching is truly what makes this place special. The train wreck series was amazing and really made me think deeply. The community is also very friendly and welcome. Sunday here always feels refreshing and meaningful! Great church, spirit filled environment, the live streams are amazing as well, I can tell the media team is super legit, by the extremely good camera angles during worship. Wonder Church is filled with multi ethnic,
multigenerational people who have a hunger to learn more about God, and to grow in relationship with Him. It has an environment of acceptance for believers, as well as for those who are just wondering what this God thing is all about.  Holy Spirit’s Presence is welcomed and encouraged through contemporary worship music, and solid bible teaching. The people truly care for one another and the feeling of FAMILY is definitely felt.   It’s a safe place to find belonging, healing and growth. For over 30 years, I wrestled with my faith, clinging to the belief that I could remain a Christian and trust in God without the structure of a church. That perspective shifted when my youngest son, Ozzy, encouraged me to attend a church, though it proved to be an ill-suited match. Then, through a connection at my workplace, (Divine intervention, God knew my needs & my heart needed her so badly) I met Kimberly, who extended an invitation that changed everything. Since that moment, my spirit has been ignited. Were it not for this church, its remarkable people, the enriching small groups, and the inspiring passion of Pastor C.J.’s preaching, I’m uncertain I’d be here today sharing this reflection.
You have nothing to lose by exploring this extraordinary community, yet everything to gain. While it’s true that a building isn’t required to be a Christian or to believe in God, the value of the people, the fellowship, and the discipleship is undeniable. My soul yearns for the family I’ve found there, especially when I’m surrounded by friends who don’t share my faith. This church offers a purity and a God-centered way of life that I’ve found lacking in other settings. I wholeheartedly encourage you to experience it for yourself. You have everything that is enriching and most beautiful to gain!
Angelle Forsythe A great, small church of warm and genuine people who are opening the door to understanding Jesus. No pretense - just caring, honest, and transparent.  Very focused on knowing and loving the Lord, as they should be. Definitely worth checking out! We went there 2+ years until moving out of state and highly recommend Wonder. It could be the church you always hoped to find.

name: Woodland Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
Being a welcoming church is a great thing and every true Christian should be open to all, but “affirming” sin of any kind (as your website states) goes directly against God’s expectations for us to rebuke and/or turn away from sin. Jesus said, “Go and sin no more,” not “Stay and sin some more,” nor did He ever state that He affirmed sinfulness. No sin is praiseworthy, nor is it affirmed anywhere in The Holy Bible.
To be authentic followers of Christ Jesus, we must all deny our earthly lusts and come to earnest repentance (for every one of our current or past wrongdoings). Anything that goes against God’s design, sullies one’s soul, or breaks His commandments MUST be repented for. We need to find sincere spiritual contrition (true guilt for sin) and we’ll never find that if we think our sinfulness is okay solely because it was praised, accepted and affirmed by the church.
Matthew 16:24 Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.”
2 Corinthians 7:10 For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, not to be regretted; but the sorrow of the world produces death.
Jeremiah 25:5 They said, ‘Repent now everyone of his evil way and his evil doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.’
If we want to affirm anything, we should be affirming that we’re all sinners and we all fall short, and that’s why everyone needs to repent. By accepting sin, you are consciously going against God’s commands and law; by affirming sin, you are deliberately denying God’s Word and truth! An exclusion of God results in an inclusion of Satan. You cannot live in habitual sin yet also live for God:
Hebrews 10:26 For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins.
1 John 2:3-5 Now by this we know that we know Him, if we keep His commandments. He who says, “I know Him,” and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him. But whoever keeps His word, truly the love of God is perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him.
Titus 1:16 They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.
FYI, Jesus spoke of hell more than heaven and sin more than love. Throughout the Bible, the need for genuine repentance is an underlying requirement, not merely God’s suggestion or recommendation. We must have a full change of heart and mind, leading to unquestionable belief/trust/faith and total repentance.
With that said, no man/woman is more worthy of redemption than another and Christ’s ultimate sacrifice can set anyone free from sinful bondage. Everyone can find salvation and be born again by earnest repentance, genuine sorrow for sin, a change of heart/mind, and belief/trust in Jesus Christ. We’re all messed up and that’s why we need a perfect Savior.
But, don’t follow false teachings and/or deceptive doctrines that claim a sinful lifestyle is an acceptable choice as Christ expects us to turn from ALL SIN. We’ll still slip up here and there but real salvation is a nonstop commitment to turn away from the things which God declared are wrong. If God called something an abomination in His own book, then who are we to affirm those same exact abominable acts?
2 Timothy 4:3-4 For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but according to their own desires, because they have itching ears, they will heap up for themselves teachers; and they will turn their ears away from the truth, and be turned aside to fables.
Everything stated here is backed up by scripture. Don’t seek affirmation for your sins, but rather, earnestly repent for them, place all of it at Christ’s feet, and put God first in your life for once. In doing so, you’ll be given new desires and a new mind. We must die to selfish desires and live for His selfless gift and sacrifice for all. I went there last Sunday. They are the most welcoming and loving people Ive ever met. They are also diverse even though they are a small congregation. A friend and I went just checking the place out and as soon as we walked through the door we felt very welcome. The pastor even sent me a card in the mail (hand written) thanking me for coming. I will definitely be coming back. I was super impressed. I've been a very active member at Woodland for 26 years! A faith community that truly walks the walk. ALL are welcomed and embraced. In my 20th year as a member of Woodland.  It is a welcoming, diverse faith community that represents the teachings of Jesus. Woodland is warm, welcoming and truly exudes love. reviewSummary:
Here’s a well-rounded review you could post:

⸻

We recently attended a service at Woodside Bible Church, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish.

The congregation was extremely friendly and welcoming. From the moment we walked in, multiple people made an effort to greet us and make us feel comfortable. It genuinely felt like a community that values connection and fellowship.

The message was strong, biblically grounded, and centered on unity — something that feels especially important right now. It was both encouraging and challenging in the right ways, delivered clearly and thoughtfully.

The worship experience was also outstanding. The live band before the sermon and closing out the service brought great energy and professionalism without feeling performative. The music was engaging and meaningful, helping set the tone for worship and reflection.

Overall, Woodside creates an inviting atmosphere with solid teaching and excellent worship. Definitely a church we would recommend visiting. I visited Troy Church and was absolutely blown away. First, Jeff, the drummer—wow! Amazing!! The music was such a highlight, especially the drummer, Jeff, who brought so much energy and soul to the worship.
But all of them: they don’t just play; they bring an energy and a precision that perfectly elevates the worship music. It was powerful, and heart felt...it pulls you in.
Then, the minister delivered a message that was truly terrific—grounded, relevant, and powerful. Honestly, if you are missing what is happening here; then you are missing out on something special.
I feel sorry for anyone who hesitates to come and experience this atmosphere. Get here next Sunday! Wow... Absolutely love this church!
The pastor will give you a kick in the butt as well as expository preaching! I enjoy the opportunity to attend a small-group Bible study as well. I love the intentionality behind each service to give attendees an opportunity to come to the Lord. Many do! reviewSummary:

God wasn’t even mentioned within the first 20 minutes of their talk and the talk was about 40 minutes long. I didn’t connect with the message at all and my 15 year old was literally falling asleep which she has never done at church before.

Some other things I noted as a first timer:

No coffee or refreshments for the community. I asked who I’m assuming is a volunteer because she had a name tag on and she said the coffee is only for volunteers but did offer to grab me a cup. She did also offer to walk us to the auditorium which was nice.

No welcoming for first timers so it was very confusing where to park at this huge church and where to go in. We had to reach out to people for every answer we needed. It would’ve been nice to have an area first timers can go and get all the info.

Overall, not super welcoming. Not engaging. Felt like a cattle in a herd. And it took 30 minutes to get out of the parking lot once the service was over. Will not attend again. Church is unique live sometimes they have remote Preacher. They have Christian Rock bands. They even have many programs for k-8, singles and newcomers. First Steps is a program that I really enjoyed learning more about the Bible and Christ. This is a friendly church family great worship including music as well as pastor. I love to attend a the Bible studies are amazing try one! Woodstock City Church is truly an amazing place to worship and grow. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by friendly faces and a warm, welcoming atmosphere that immediately feels like home. The services are engaging and inspiring, with messages that are both relevant and deeply impactful. The music is excellent—uplifting and full of energy, creating a space that’s both joyful and reflective. There are great programs for kids and students, making it a wonderful place for families. The leadership and volunteers genuinely care about people, and it shows in everything they do. Whether you’re new to faith or looking for a church to call home, Woodstock City Church is an incredible community to be part of. Not happy attending a screening of Andy Stanley. I wish they would just change their time and have him drive to Woodstock to do the service there. Or better yet, have pastor Sameer actually run this church location.

name: Word of Life Church - El Paso Campus
reviewSummary: Started attending in person for service since June of 2020, based on my father's recommendation and suggestion, due to the Catholic churches shutting the door on our faces (during pandemic year of 2020), and have been very happy in doing so.  I use to watch the early morning T.V. broadcasts on Ch. 4 & Ch. 9 for years with Bishop Brown, but attending in person was such a blessing and so fulfilling!  Born and raised Catholic I don't think I'd ever been able to interpret and understand the Bible better than with Bishop Brown's teachings!  Thank you Lord for this blessing!  God bless you always Bishop Brown along with your wife Pastor Sonia plus all your staff and members of Word of Life Church! 🙏😇 I first heard about Bishop Tom Brown from my mom's friend who recommended him for an exorcism. I was experiencing a lot of demonic activity in many different areas in my life and although I had been a Christian for years, I wasn't living right. I needed an exorcism. Just as I was preparing to drive to Arizona to see a pastor there, my mom's friend told us about Bishop Tom Brown, sent me some YouTube videos on his teachings. Even though they were very old videos, I felt like they were speaking to me in real time. That next Sunday morning, I showed up to Word of Life Sunday Service. I sat through service, the teaching touched my heart and I went to speak to him after service. I explained my symptoms to him. He told me, "I dont usually do these after service but The Lord is telling me to pray for you Right now." He told me to sit down and started praying over me in a different language. I couldn't understand, but I just know that after an internal spiritual struggle, I felt like a great heaviness was lifted off of me. Right when he said "there it goes" it was like I felt a hot vapor coming out of the sides of my neck. Then I felt light again. I wasn't able to eat or drink anything for the whole past month. Even if I tried to drink a glass of water my stomach would reject it. I didnt even FEEL hungry or thirsty, I only tried to nourish my body with whatever I could stomach because it was freaking me out. As soon as he prayed over me, I felt my stomach drop and I INSTANTLY felt hungry. I just cried. But I felt happy and relieved. I felt God's Love, Grace, Mercy, and Forgiveness again. That was in 2018. Have I been perfect? No. Are we a church made up of perfect people?  Absolutely not. We all fall short of the glory of God in some area, but what is important is that you keep seeking the Lord and keep pressing on .Ive been coming to this church here ever since and I even volunteer and sing in the band too. Dont go based off negative things haters got to say; I challenge you to sit through a whole service (dont skip the music!) see if God wont meet you where you're at ❣️ 20 years I know More about GOD and JESUS CHRIST.....I have appointment...I appointment on Monday JULY 2026...I need lots amount amount amount amount PRAYERS PRAYERS please please understand I need lots amount PRAYERS No Family support..no Support never Never married no kids....I live at EL Paso Texas alone... .no cars .....no vans...no trucks....nothing.....mom dad grandma grandpa all died....my sisters and brother stop talking too me 20 years...I have small....small FAITH....I am not encourage...I am not encourage I have no HOPE Times I been rejected.....times I been sick alot I been homeless before Coming from a Pastoral home, I can confidently say Bishop Brown's teachings and knowledge of the bible is the best in town (filled with the Holy Spirit). Pastor Lorenzo of the Spanish ministry challenges me to love the Lord with new insights guided by the Holy Spirit every week. Bishop Tom always has such a powerful message and I enjoy watching his tik toc on short videos, it’s also encouraging and nice to reflect on Gods, love, grace, and strength for the day. It’s a powerful reminder on who we are in Christ and who we belong to.

name: World Mission Society Church of God - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up going to church with my family, but I was never fully into it. Although I went consistently, it felt like there was always a barrier between me and everyone else. It was like we were not children belonging to the same God. It wasn't until I came to this church, the World Mission Society Church of God, that I learned what it means to be part of a spiritual family and to truly care for other people. I am thankful to now be a member of the greatest church in the world! The members of this church is full of love and warm hospitality. Their actions resemble that of Christ. If you are looking to study the truth of salvation directly from the Bible, I highly recommend coming for an in-person Bible study. They answered all of my questions about the existence of God, the authenticity of the Bible, and how to correctly follow God by keeping God’s laws and commands. The church members keep the Sabbath day holy every week on Saturday, so it’s a great opportunity to visit and meet the awesome members of the church. I had the unfortunate experience of being a member of this church for various years. At first it was exciting and lively but over the course of years I started to see how demanding and militant this place had become. Members are looked down upon for not being heavily involved in the church, they are branded as members who have bad faith and satan has taken a foothold of. These teachings come directly from the General Pastors sermon books.

I did some research on the church and discovered that the church has removed entire chapters from Ahnsahnghong's books which were failed prophecies. They have modified diagrams and verbiage. They also teach incorrect world history to force certain prophecies.

If a church claims to be the absolute truth and they have to edit/censor the writings who they claim is God, one must question if this is the absolute truth.

I am very disappointed at the lack of integrity from this church. Under the church’s advice and in guidance, I suffered emotional, psychological, and spiritual distress. I am happy to be gone from this place but feel the need to voice my experience and opinion on this group that resembles traits of other Korean cults. Escape while you can if not you're gonna waste your time in this false gospel. They are not the absolute truth and they have holes in their doctrine. This is an amazing church! The members here are always smiling and full of love. There is no other church I would rather go to. The best church ever because they follow what the Bible teaches! Please come and see!!

reviewSummary:
If you want to experience the presence of God EVERY time your in that building!
Praise God for our pastors

The praise and worship team bring you right into the presence of God at the first note. We are a multi-generational and multi-cultural church, just like heaven. Come and join us! Great children’s and youth ministry. The praise and worship is off the chart good. Come and check this church out, you will love it. WOC is a strong local church that flows with the Spirit. It’s so refreshing to be able to be a part of this solid Bible-based, Holy Spirit-led group and to connect with all their resources online, especially their live prayer time at noon.  Their prayer ministry is awesome and their focus on missions. My family and I are so happy here at WOC. reviewSummary:

Pastor Myles Rutherford and his Wife are genuine, true men and Women of God! I've found the freedom I've been looking for here! Worship with Wonders is truly a Holy Spirit led, faith filled church that puts Christ at the forefront above all else. It is a church that makes worship and honoring the Lord and welcoming his presence a PRIORITY.

You will not leave the same way you came in. The body of Christ that resides here feel like family. The pastors care for your soul & truly love & honor God & preach the true Word of God.

With love, they do not care to be liked, but rather, they care to lead you to His TRUTH, His Word & they push you to truly repent, hold yourselves accountable, seek the Lord & become closer to Christ with ALL of your heart, along with seeking His face daily & walking with Christ within and outside of the church walls.

In times like this, this is exactly what we need in the body of Christ.. The TRUTH.

I have been to their previous locations in the past before they moved to their new church & the pastors and their staff have always remained the same & their message has never changed: JESUS!

May God continue to bless Worship with Wonders!

reviewSummary:
EVERYONE here is SO very welcoming, friendly and loving! Only GOD deserves a perfect 5 stars from me for this joyous Bible based Worship filled obdient church.

If you miss it their you can't miss it in the team used to worship Him! Pastor Joe humorously breaks down The Word so that a simpleton can understand and apply to one's own life. Visit Him here and be blessed. God go w you and be w you!

2nd visit
I went back again in Dec.2021 bc I liked it SO much. Again my experience was just as excellent as my first visit. I found out no 9am service but returned for the 10:30a service. Blessed house of the Lord and wonderful obdient children of God fill this place. Allow God to lead you there. You will feel His love and mercy. We love Worshipwalk Church! Everyone is welcoming and their is a place for everyone to serve and be feed the word of God! I have been a member since it it’s beginning. O no there cameras on public sidewalk watch out you might get hurt but don't worry "God" will save you lmao Started going a couple of months ago, I usually go by myself, and started seating on the usual row. 2 weeks ago I went back & noticed one of the ushers/leaders of the church seating w/her husband where I usually seat. I didn’t think much of it, so I just sat one row ahead in front of them. When the worship started, the usher lady started praying w/her husband very loud in tongues & oddly, I felt the prayer was being targeted toward me. It seemed like she thought I was a devil & started praying against me. She was getting pretty loud & I couldn’t pay attention to the worship, not to mention I could feel the hostility in her voice. So I grabbed my Bible & moved 2 rows back to the seats behind them. As I was moving, I heard her say to her husband “that’s what she gets for seating in front of us”. Then she got up & ran to the rest of the ushers by the doors where she started gossiping telling them God knows what. When the pastor came up on stage he said that “some people only come to church to fight and trouble us”. And again… it really felt targeted towards me. When the service was done, as I was walking out of the building, one of the ushers to whom the lady went to asked me “everything alright?…” I hugged her & left. So, what I experienced in this church was a lot of self righteousness, cattiness, people that are quick to memorize the scripture yet have very little to no understanding of what it actually means. At this location u will experience leaders that are quick to try and make you “their” discipline, but w/no sincere love of God or for God. Doesn’t seem very welcoming or community oriented for a church that’s only open two hours a week to shut down a large parking lot 7 days a week near a lot of great local businesses.
